brh: اوڑان ہرا سے خواہسنے او دیتسنے نی اوڑان اسہ وارس تو خواہ نی ہور کے مونا اوست نا
en: Whoever has asked of Him, He has given. You ask of Him just once, then look — it will be there in front of you.
en_old: Whatever anyone has asked of Him, He has given. You ask Him just once, then see — it will be right in front of you.

brh: او داداتے ہمو چکاک کے ہمو کے او کرار آ ولے بابا تا ہندنو واقعہ سے کہ ارافتہ کنا استا بریک ئے او دے استا نا
en: He gives to those birds; that is what He does, He gives them peace. But Baba, there was such an incident that whenever it comes to my mind, I... that day... my heart...
en_old: He did that to those girls, he did it, but Father, there was such an incident that whenever it comes to my mind, my heart... that day's memory.

brh: ہندنیکہ فر، اصلوست ہندنیکہ فر، آخنی کنا مار انتس کرینوس کہ نی ہندن پریشان ئس ہن پاو نی بابوجی، ہن بیان کے
en: Is it like that, then? Is it really like that? Then, my son, what have you done that you are so troubled? — Come, let me tell you, Babuji, let me explain it.
en_old: It's not like that, really it's not like that. Tell me, my son, what have you done that you are so worried? Tell me, son, Babuji, tell me.

brh: بے روزگاری نا دوان باز تنگ مسس، باز کوشش کریٹ، ولے ہچ متو، ئے جاگہس ٹیسٹ انٹرویو تے سوٹ
en: I was very fed up because of unemployment. I tried hard, but nothing came of it. At one place I took a test and gave an interview.
en_old: I was very troubled by unemployment; I tried a lot, but nothing came of it. In one place I sat the test and interview.

brh: او میرٹ اٹ پاسو مسوٹ پدی کنا جاگہ ٹی نالائق نابوداتے خلکور ہرادے کیتنا رزلٹ نا رداٹ
en: And I passed on merit, but afterwards they put incompetent, worthless people in my place, who had been rejected on their own results.
en_old: I had passed on merit, then in my place they appointed incompetent, worthless people — according to whose results?

brh: ئے فنگ کیناٹ او دفتر اٹ ٹی تو گڑا سفارش او رشوت نا روکا تا کاریم مسورے ولے باز مایوس مسوٹ اسے دے دفتر اسے ٹی تینا راہی
en: I kept going around those offices, but there only the work of people with connections and bribes got done. I became very disappointed. One day, in an office, on my way...
en_old: I kept going around those offices, but there the work only got done through connections and bribes. But I was very disappointed one day in an office, on my way...

brh: زخنا رپنگ کینا ہرتو
en: [Mostly unintelligible] ... I was ... every month.
en_old: He's beating me... I'll go.

brh: اسلام علیکم سر۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ سر دا لسٹ ٹی کنا پن اف؟ ایلم دا کنا ذمہ داری اف۔
en: Peace be upon you, sir. — And upon you be peace. — Sir, is my name not on this list? — Brother, this is not my responsibility.
en_old: Peace be upon you, sir. And peace be upon you. Sir, is my name not on this list? That's not my responsibility now.

brh: جی پا سراخہ پیسہ خوریندو بندغات خور لسٹ
en: Yes, tell me, sir — how much money... these money-eating people... look at the list.
en_old: Yes, tell him, sir — those who paid the money, look at the list.

brh: کنا مطلب دادے کہ نو دا پتیار اخہ پیسہ خلکورے اوفتے نوکری ٹی خلکورے سر۔ دا نیانپانی گٹی مچے ہوش اٹ ہیت کرک۔ داسکان نا نوکری متنے نی داڑے جنگ شروع کرینوس۔ سر ئے ہوش اٹ ہیت کرنگ ٹیٹ۔ ہرا سے بندغ تو کہ ناجائز مریک نی
en: What I mean is this: how much money did you take from these people and put them in jobs, sir? — [unclear] ... talk a little sensibly. Your job hasn't even come through yet and you've started a fight here. — Sir, I am talking sensibly. When an injustice is done to any person, you...
en_old: My point is this: these people you appointed — how much money did you take to put them in jobs, sir? You've swallowed it all. Talk sensibly! You haven't even got the job yet and you've started a fight here. Sir, I am talking sensibly. Any man to whom injustice is done, you...

brh: او بھرا انو زور اٹ ہیت کیکک اور سر نوم نوم کیریک مت دغاتا میری ٹی خالی غٹی اوڑے اگر دا ٹیما ئے داڑے پیسہ تسوٹ نی تو نا دا صاحب کنے آرڈر آتے تسکے اور کنے بسکوٹ ہم پولی فیکے دان پانے غس گنو وقت آ متنس چپ کا تول پیشم تپکا دیرا
en: Oh brother, he is talking so loudly, and keeps saying 'sir, sir'... [unclear] ... If I had paid money here, this sahib of yours would have handed me the orders and offered me biscuits too... [unclear] ... have you gone mad? ... Be quiet, sit down ... [unclear].
en_old: That brother was talking so loudly and kept saying 'sir, sir'... in our empty... if this team had given money here, then your sir would have given me the orders and bought me biscuits too... at that time, be quiet, sit down... found.

brh: راست پاننگٹ سر، راست پاننگٹ، داڑے قابل انگا بندغاتا قدر افک، او داڑے رشوت تروکا بندغاتا قدر ارے، او ارا کہ میرٹ اٹ برے اونا قدر افک، او ایلم دا دفتر اسے شور کپہ، نی آرامٹ تل، نی ہیت کنے ایٹ کر، دا دفتر اسے، آرامٹ تل، ہچ ہیت کپہ، دا ناجائز کنے ہچ ہیت کپہ۔
en: I am telling the truth, sir, telling the truth: here capable people have no value, and here the people who pay bribes are valued, and the one who comes on merit has no value. — Oh brother, this is an office, don't make noise. Sit calmly, you... talk to me... This is an office; sit calmly, don't say anything. Don't say anything unjust to me.
en_old: You speak the truth, sir, you speak the truth; here capable people have no value, here those who pay bribes are valued; the one who comes on merit has no value. Now don't make a commotion in this office, go quietly, don't say anything to me, this is an office, go quietly, don't say anything, don't say anything to me about this injustice.

brh: باز ناجائز کننگ اٹی ارے، دا دفتر سے مسخرہ سے، سر دا جنگ کننگ اٹی ارے، جنگ کننگ اٹی ارے، دا کنے کاٹ مار دے تو، تو نا دنیا نا مننگ اٹی توار اف، پاد نا، پیسہ رینگ نا ہیت مننگے، رشوت نا ہیت مننگے، نم کوننگا افسر آک، نما پڈ آک وخت ئس ہم سیر مفسے، سر خدا نا
en: You are doing a great injustice; this office is a farce. — Sir, he's picking a fight, he's picking a fight; he [wants to] beat me. — In your world no voice is heard; [unclear]... there is only talk of giving money, talk of bribes. You devouring officers, your bellies will never be full, not even once. Sir, for God's...
en_old: You are committing a great injustice; this office is a joke. Sir, you are fighting here, fighting. This is tormenting me. In your world there is no voice for anything else, only talk of money, talk of bribes. You officers, your bellies will never be full. Sir, for God's sake...

brh: خوف کبو سر، خدانا خوف کبو، نم انتئے ناجائز کننگ اٹی ارے سر، اللہ غان خلبو سر، بائے تینا بند کے، داسکا ہورنگ اٹی ارے تے، کشبو تے پیش، خبردار، بکواس نی چپ کر، دا ہٹی کنا خلنگ اٹی او سر، ناجائز ئے سر دا، ناجائز بند کننگ اٹی ارے سر
en: Have fear, sir, have fear of God. Why are you doing injustice, sir? Fear Allah, sir. — Shut your mouth! — Why are you just standing there watching him now? Throw him out! — Watch it! — Nonsense, you shut up! — They are beating me, sir. This is unjust, sir; you are unjustly shutting me out, sir.
en_old: Have fear, sir, fear God. Why are you doing injustice, sir? Be afraid of Allah, sir. Shut your mouth! Now you're just standing here watching—go on, kill him! Watch out! Nonsense, you shut up! He is taking my shop, sir. This is unjust, sir, they're closing it down unjustly, sir.

brh: ئے سلف نا فائر ء خلوٹ، بے سخت ناجائز کس ء کرنٹ داڑے، گڈیکو توفک ء خلوٹ، سو توفک نا فائر ء خلوٹ، ئے ڈاکٹر نا گبر نا تہا توفک ء خلوٹ، ڈاکٹر ء تماشہ ئس جوڑ کروٹ
en: I'll fire off a [self-loading rifle?]. A very grave injustice has been done here. I'll fire the final shot, I'll fire a hundred rifle shots, I'll fire my rifle inside the doctor's [grave], I'll make a spectacle of the doctor.
en_old: I'll fire the self-loading rifle; no one has ever done such a terrible injustice here. I'll fire the big gun, I'll fire a hundred rounds, I'll fire the gun inside the doctor's house, I'll make a spectacle of the doctor.

brh: یار نی تینے دا سا ہسو پریشان کپہ۔ کنا الیتو نی
en: Friend, don't trouble yourself so much now. You're with me.
en_old: Friend, don't worry yourself so much like this. You're my own.

brh: افسوس، اینو کہ نی اوڑ، پھانگ نا نہاڑاڑے سرمست مسسٹ، اگر کن تو مسوس، نی ہم جوان و جاگہ سے سر کروٹ، انتئے کہ دا چاگڑد اٹ، حق اسو ملے پھروئے، حق ء پلوئی تمے کہ۔
en: What a pity you weren't there today; I was having the time of my life at [unclear]. If you had been with me, I would have set you up in a good place too, because in this society rights won't be had easily — rights have to be seized.
en_old: Alas, if you had been here today, you would have been the chief at the head of the gathering; if it were up to me, I would have put you in a good place too, because in this world no one gets his rights for free—rights have to be snatched.

brh: نی امن و کروس، با امن و کروس۔ نم انتس کننگ اٹی رے؟ اینو پگہ نم باز ٹپ ٹاپ خننگ اٹی رے۔ انتس گہی کننگ اٹی رے؟ اگر نی کریس تے، عیش کروس، عیش۔
en: You'll live in peace, really live in peace. — What are you all up to? These days you're looking very tip-top. What sort of thing are you doing? — If you do it, you'll live it up — live it up!
en_old: You've done well, father, you've done well. What are you up to? These days you look very spruced up. What are you doing? If you've done it, then you've had a good time, a good time.

brh: ہو یار، ئے ہم باز تنگ مسنٹ دا زند آن۔ نوکری ہچ ملنگ اٹی اف۔ پیسہ صفا کہ کاریم بس کیو۔ ارا ٹی ہم باز پریشانی کو۔ نو منتس کہ کیرے، ہنتس کہ پارے، ئے کننگ کے تیار۔
en: Yes, friend, I too have become very fed up with this life. There are no jobs to be had at all. The money is all gone, so I just need some work. At home, too, there is a lot of trouble. Now whatever you do, whatever you say, I'm ready to do it.
en_old: Yes, friend, I too am very fed up with this life. There's no job at all. Once the money runs out, the work stops. There's a lot of trouble at home too. Now whatever you say, whatever you tell me, I'm ready to do it.

brh: تیار؟ او مسخرا، انتس کہ پاریٹ نی ہمو کیڑے کریس، پیسہ ہی پیسہ مروئی اف چا دے گواہ۔
en: Ready? You clown, whatever I tell you, you do exactly that — there'll be money, nothing but money, God is my witness.
en_old: Ready? You clown, whatever I told you, you did the opposite; it's not going to be money all the time—look at that.

brh: لمہ نی کنے ہندا رفتوس
en: Mother, you have [left] me like this.
en_old: Mother, you left me here.

brh: ئس کہ ننا نوکری امر مس؟ ئے انت رپوٹ؟ اوفتونا بننگ نا شکل آن پاش ئس کہ چس متو۔ دا دے جوان ئس کہ ئے انٹرویو تینے کن دو اٹ۔ نا کنا مردو نی اتکپہ۔
en: ...so how did our job go? — What can I report? From the way they looked, it was clear it hadn't gone well. Today was good only in that I gave the interview myself. — No, my dear husband, don't you [lose heart].
en_old: What happened with our job? What about the report? From the way they talked, it seems there's nothing good in sight. It's a good thing I gave the interview myself. No, my husband, don't you come.

brh: ناامید مف، اللہ نا باز بلو ذات اسے، اونا در آن ہچ کس مایوس متنے۔ نرگس! او نرگس! زو کا ایلم کے دیر ئس ہتے۔
en: Don't lose hope; Allah is a very great being, no one has ever gone away from His door disappointed. Nargis! Oh Nargis! Go quickly and bring your brother some water.
en_old: Don't lose hope, Allah is a very great being; no one has ever gone away from His door disappointed. Nargis! Oh Nargis! Come quickly, bring it, it's getting late.

brh: ہمہ دے نو نرگس نا برام نا تاریخ کے بسو ہن مزورا بسور اینو
en: That same day they came about the date of Nargis's wedding — go, the workers have come today.
en_old: Today, now, is the date of Nargis's wedding; the workers have come today.

brh: دوندو فرمائش کرے رینار فرمائش ایلے دا ایتا تے رخ کر واہ ہمدم جان رند پارے دے اینو پگہ رشتہ داری
en: She made such a demand, [they say] — the demand... leave it... turn to these... Oh, Hamdam dear, then she said: these days, family ties...
en_old: Dondo made a request, she said the request... and then put these up on the roof. Yes, Hamdam dear, go on, say it—these days it's all about relationships.

brh: خبر افنت دے دلاری چھمے سر، مارا کے تینا اسلم نا لمہ فرمائش کرینے، لمہ جان واہ مخو پا فرمائش تانتس، گاڑی ئس نا
en: Don't you know, Dulari... [unclear] ... Aslam's own mother has made a demand on behalf of her son. — Mother dear, come on, tell me, what is their demand? — A car, no less!
en_old: You don't know, dear, with those eyes... Mara has made a request to her Aslam's mother. Mother dear, don't say no—what's the request? A car.

brh: ئے پیننت نا۔ ہمم۔ تکڑا؟ ئے اوتے باز پاریٹ کہ رحمت بے روزگار ئے نن اونا سیب بھاونہ تا پنشنہ گزارہ کننگٹی اون او ہم شش توئے او پنشن ہم ننے۔
en: I... [unclear]. Hmm. A big one? I told them many times that Rahmat is unemployed, that we are getting by on his father's pension, and even that is only six [thousand], and that pension is all we have.
en_old: I don't know. Hmm. Takra? I've told them many times that Rahmat is unemployed, we survive on his father's pension, and that's only six (thousand); that pension is all we have.

brh: نم تو مئے لبہ ملتون، ولدا ہم داخس فرمائش کننگاٹیورے؟ گڑا لمہ جا، گڑا بس چپ کریرینار۔
en: We didn't even get a bride-price from you, and you're still making this many demands? Then, mother dear, then they just went quiet.
en_old: You've already got hold of us, and you're still making so many requests? Then, mother, just be quiet, she said.

brh: تو دا پنسار نا سانگے درانہ ایلے دائے تا تبر سرخ کن
en: Then break off this engagement with the grocer's family — leave it — [and] make their [family] red [with shame].
en_old: Then this grocer's business will be ruined; make their axe red.

brh: مرشد، ہن کنے نا ٹیوشن۔ اماں، ئے کالج کاوہ کنے لیٹ مننگے۔ ئے تینا ڈگری الیوا او۔
en: Murshid, off you go to your tuition. — Mom, I'm going to college, I'm getting late. I'm going to get my degree.
en_old: Murshid, give me your tuition fee. Mother, I'm going to college, I'm getting late. I'm going to collect my degree.

brh: چپل باز خسی رے نغزے واؤ زیر خلیسے پلو لاڑو گودی تے نرفنگے تھسدا پاغے تے مشن کن تے نری رنا شیطان بابے ننے ماما بنگو ننا کھوت کھدے باز مشن تے نرفے
en: You (pl) throw sandals a lot ... [unclear] ... you put (it) down ... chasing off the adorned ladies ... the turbans(?) ... runs off from the mountain ... Satan, father ... listen to us, uncle ... our ... [unclear] ... drove (them) off the mountain a lot.
en_old: The sandal is very worn out... good, wah, he writes it down... the girls on the other side are afraid of ... his turban... the fist... Satan, our uncle... our house, many fear the fist.

brh: کنا خاتن کہ پائین کنا مچ کلک کو ہمو وڈغن تا کہ نن چائے مخلوق ئے باز پسندت چائے گابا نت مونی ایونی مو کریر ہا پنگورے شرف منداک ادا کیدنا
en: My wife, as we say ... all my ... in that way, so that we ... tea, which people like very much; tea ... in front ... yes, you heard; the honourable ones carry it out.
en_old: My wife says... I'm gathering them, so that we... what people like most, tea... in front of ... yes, he says that, the honourable ones deliver it.

brh: دا شاعر آک او نننا مخلوق ئے دا دنیا نا ہر کس بشمرے کا عرفک باجا ئے پئے شاعر سد شاعر تو داد ئے ورنا آک تو داد او ورنا آک داد او پلو دا کنا ملک نا پنی روشن کننگا ٹو نی دا سے ئنا پا نننا اینو پرے دا استاد گل حسن
en: These poets, and our people ... everyone in this world gets up and takes up the instrument(?) ... a poet, a hundred poets ... gets praise; the young people give praise, the young people praise (him); these are the ones making my country's name shine. Now you, tell us about this one: our [guest] today is this Ustad Gul Hassan.
en_old: These poets, our people, everyone in this world should know... he is a poet, a hundred poets... the young men... these are the ones lighting up my country's name; today, this is Ustad Gul Hassan.

brh: کہ بھئی نی اسے شعر ئس ننے پاتہ سارے گاما انتس ئے دا سارے گاما پا امر خلیرہ نن کے گڈاس گونگونائف نن سارے گاما ئے یل کین ہمو کین ننا باجان تیتوا کے ئے پادت گڈا گادت ہا
en: (I said,) 'Brother, recite a verse for us.' 'What is sa-re-ga-ma? How do they play this sa re ga ma pa? We hum something(?) ... we leave the sa-re-ga-ma aside, we do that ...' From our instrument(?) ... he recited it to him, then he sang(?) it, yes.
en_old: Well brother, recite a verse for us; what is this 'sare gama'? When they say 'sare gama' we get a bit confused; we'll leave 'sare gama' aside, our friends gave it to him... then he recited it, and then, yes.

brh: جغتا جغتا گپ گپ کنو کدت بس کنے ملن خلکو ددنا شاعری خطرہ تے اسہ خیال واہ پنگورے پنگورے شاعری ئے دادے پارے اندادے پارے شاعری ئے
en: Bit by bit, chatting and chatting, they just joked with me; his poetry is 'dangerous' (amazing) — one thought ... wow, you heard, you heard the poetry; he says it like this, he says it like that — poetry.
en_old: Bit by bit, chatting away, he just took me along; his poetry... one thought — wah — he recites poetry this way, says this, says that; it's poetry.

brh: ئے گاماں پیر ویراگ پیر ویراگ ہمیک جوڑ کرینوتے ہمے تہم دماغ اٹ تولنگ اف کہ دا جوڑ تے چینج کرینتے دنو شاعر پیدا مرے ننا بلوچستان اٹ رگو راہ او بو ٹیلنٹ ہنونے او ٹیلنٹ تے دوں کہ خرودے چوغانٹ کٹیر ٹیلنٹ ہنونے ننا علاقہ ٹی
en: '... ga ma, pir vairag, pir vairag' — they have made only these same compositions; it doesn't even occur to them (lit. sit in their minds) to change these compositions. Such poets are born in our Balochistan ... [unclear] ... there is talent, and talents like ... there is abundant talent in our area.
en_old: The same old patterns they have made; they don't even think in their minds to change these patterns so that such poets are born in our Balochistan. There is so much talent, that talent, like this one... there is so much talent in our area.

brh: دا کھرے خرو دے سے پاد آ شاعر سے دادے سپورٹ کبو دانا چینل سپورٹ کبو دا ٹوک بیٹھے ریا تے مخلوق آ بھلے زمانہ مون تترا سیلنگ کپ سے ما استاد گل حسن وڈے فرتھیندی استاد نیو تا بارہ ٹکراستینا رائے پا
en: This is a ... poet who stands on his own feet(?); support him, support his channel ... people ... a great era ahead ... [unclear] ... Ustad Gul Hassan ... give your opinion about the Ustad.
en_old: This is a little... a poet standing on his own feet, support him, support his channel... these people... a great era lies ahead... Ustad Gul Hassan... the Ustad... give your opinion about it.

en: Amid the Messiah's(?) prayer of goodness and blessing he strikes ...; may Allah put him into brokenness and a burden, so that his life becomes a torment. Our Khalil ... passing(?) ... this other ... a letter of advice comes to me ... Ustad ... [unclear].

en: That has happened too; it should be ... my friends are making fun of me ... his own sa-re-ga-ma ... [unclear] ... Ustad, if you say it, it would be a great help(?).
en_old: That happened too; my friends should take me along... his own... he heard me out; Ustad, if you say it, it would be very good.

en: He says every poet's ... — he says you ... every poet has a ... [unclear]. I have heard Ustad Gul Hassan ... [a commotion?] at a gathering ... he drinks ... tonic(?) ... What is this ... tonic(?), why do you drink it?
en_old: He says every poet has a place; you say every poet has his own 'rajash'... I heard Ustad Gul Hassan went to a gathering... what is this 'rajasi'... what does it mean?

brh: نائے بالکل سئی او استاد بنگل دنیا کے ئے اگہ جند تو انے کنت وٹ تو کنا دا کوٹہ نا چل بات سخت مٹیک ولائے چادے گما حاصل خلنگ کپے آ استاد گل حسن دا پارے کہ واٹس ایپ آ اینو پگے میسج کڈے نا

en_old: No, absolutely right, that Ustad... in the world... if he himself... with me, this Quetta business is very hard, but... Ustad Gul Hassan said that on WhatsApp, today or tomorrow, send a message.

en_old: Put these photos on your profile, on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube; through this what do you gain? Earn money, do your household shopping with it, do shopping with photos... wherever you want to go.

en: Show my ... photo; that channel didn't really ...; someone told me, '[Send] my ... photo on WhatsApp, then post it' ... [unclear].
en_old: Show my small photo on that channel, it wasn't properly visible; one person told me, send my small photo on WhatsApp, then I'll put it up; look, I'm telling you.

brh: او استاد ڈونگ پاپا کے آج ببا سنگتاک انچائے نم مشتاق گولہ صندل دیرے او شکتائے قائد اعظم نا فوٹو ء کشیرے دانا فوٹو ء خلیرے سد نا نوٹ آ دانا بروکا ورناک او ورنا تو اینانی ورنائی تے دسا آخری ہم پینا او آخری ٹائم اف دا سنگت
en: O Ustad ... today, friends ... if you are so eager(?) ..., you would take Quaid-e-Azam's photo off and put his photo on the hundred-rupee note. His up-and-coming young people, and the youth ... the last one too ... and there is no 'last time', this friend.
en_old: O Ustad... today friends... you... they would remove Quaid-e-Azam's photo and put his photo on the hundred-rupee note; the young men coming after him, these youths... now the last one too, there's no last time, this friend.

brh: تو بس گنجو اشتے بشونے شیر خلیکک اگر نم عاشقورے مجبورورے مغلوبورے تو دانہ شیر تے بنبو واہ واہ کنا ئے چسس کے خدا نا قسم ایراتی مٹھائی پخل کوٹہ لاؤسٹاٹے
en: So just ... he composes verses; if you are lovers, helpless, overcome, then listen to his verses. Wow, wow, it was a joy for me — I swear by God, ... sweets ... Quetta ...
en_old: Then just... you've heard, he writes verses; if you are lovers, helpless, overcome, then listen to his verses — wah wah! I swear by God, ... sweets ... in Quetta ...

brh: گولہ شنے شیف تھے، ہیٹ کنا دن نتینا خٹ کرے گہ ریخاکے، ئنا استاد ہیٹ کسک کنا شیف تھے، منئے تانکی کنا چائے دے نی او دے پورا منئے استاویس، تو نا پاسم یلمتوا کنے
en: ... below ...; the goat(?) ... my ... [unclear] ...; my Ustad, the goat(?) died beneath me ...; accept it, so that ... my tea ... you complete it; accept, Ustad; then ... your ... will not let me go(?).
en_old: ...the goat has spoiled my ... with its feet, dragged it... the Ustad's goat... accept my ... my tea, you complete that, Ustad, then I'll let your ... go.

en: All tickets are closed, the time is over; there is still something I haven't understood, O Ustad, my friend — a strange and unique case; he ... his own ...; Sindh ... sa-re-ga-ma ...; say your last message to the public: someone who wants to become a poet, an expert or an adviser, then how (should he) ...
en_old: The ticket is closed, time's up, there's still one thing I didn't understand, O Ustad my friend, a strange and unique case... your last messages, for the public, whoever wants to become a poet, an expert or an adviser, what should he...

brh: ئے انتھ راز اسس کنے شاعری خوس وسوس۔ دنو چک کہ کنا چیمت او غدی بے باز اسس کہ۔ ئے تینا بغل نا پٹٹ گٹاری خلکوٹ۔ ہموکا پد کنا زندگی س۔۔۔
en: What a secret it was — I had a passion for poetry. Such that my ... was very much .... I put the guitar(?) under my arm. After that my life ...
en_old: What a secret it was, I was fond of poetry. Such that my eyes... were very... I took the ... under my arm. After that my life...

en: ... the young people of such-and-such (places) ... listen to ...'s poetry; then they talk to me directly, chat with me, and say, 'Ustad, wow, your poetry is number one in the world' ... if ...
en_old: ...these young men listen to the poetry of ... then they directly talk and chat with you, saying Ustad, wah, your poetry is number one in the world, if you...

brh: اینو نا دا ایپیسوڈ پسند بسونے تو کنا چناٹ دا چینل ئے سبسکرائب کبو تاکہ مزید نندما مونی مونکے کنا مطلب ئے مزید نم تو ٹیلنٹ آتے شیئر کین دنو استاد گل حسن کون او ٹیلنٹ
en: If you liked today's episode, then, my dears, subscribe to this channel so that we can bring more before you — I mean, so that we share more talents with you, talents like Ustad Gul Hassan.
en_old: If you liked today's episode, then subscribe to this channel so that we can keep bringing before you — I mean, keep sharing more talents with you, talents like Ustad Gul Hassan.

brh: ئے لنتک زئیہ مننگ اٹی اٹ بلوچستان ٹی، ئے داڑے زئیہ مروٹ، چینل ء سبسکرائب کبو، اگہ نمے ٹی لنتک سر ہیتو نمون ببو۔
en: ... that are going to waste in Balochistan, that are being wasted here — subscribe to the channel, and if any of you have ..., come to us.
en_old: I'm being ruined somewhere in Balochistan, I'm being ruined right here; subscribe to the channel, and if any of you have something to say, come to us.

brh: ادا دا پا
en: Brother, tell (me) this.
en_old: Hey, say it.

brh: مورکا ایٹ پاسیا امر گم کرستے وا علم زیادہ ری اینا گمس نہ کہ دا پا گمس یا دزس دریتے اینی دز بتنے تے ہمڑے مشٹی شوان خوافے کا ہمے کہ مشٹی
en: The ... goat — tell me, how did you lose it? ... [unclear] ... Did it get lost — tell me this — or did a thief take it? If a thief took it(?), then Mashti the shepherd grazes (his flock) over there — go, that same Mashti.
en_old: Where did you lose it? You've got more sense than that; did you lose it, or did a thief take it? If a thief took it, then right there is Mashti the shepherd, there, that Mashti.

brh: ہیٹ گم مس اینو۔ ہیٹ گم کریرے جوان تو گتہ ویرے۔ دا سہ دا مشٹی کان اراڑے پٹینتے۔ بالکل او ہیت نہ صحیح ئے بینگنو مشٹی کوبنی یمارے۔ او ہیت صحیح ئے دا تو نہ
en: The goat got lost today. You lost the goat — fine, then ... Now, where shall we look for it, from this Mashti? Absolutely, that's not right; we have heard Mashti is a tough one ... That is right; this, no.
en_old: The goat got lost today. If you lose a goat, fine, then go and find it. Where was this Mashti's goat found? That thing is not right at all; it's said Mashti is expensive. That thing is right, this is not.

brh: نم بنگنون کہ مشٹی ہندنوں کوبینی زرے سے خاص۔ کوبینی تورے یک داسہ مک کہ نیٹی پٹنی او پٹی پٹ۔ ایلم حقس کہ کوبینی مرے فیٹے پٹو ئے دا کوبینی تان خلو یا فیٹے پٹو ئے ہروئی
en: You have heard that Mashti is such a tough (formidable) one, a special ... The tough one ... now ... search, search. Brother, it's only right — even if he's tough, look for the goat; either fight this tough one or look for the goat ... [go?].
en_old: You have heard that Mashti is such an expensive one, a very special one. The expensive one is such that if you put him in, he gets put in. Now it is only right that if he is expensive he should be caught; whether to buy this expensive one or catch him, go on.

brh: ننا جوان و ہیٹ ئس شوکی نواب شاہ نی سوسٹ تے۔ ئے کے کمبو پٹین تے وری کپا بو کاٹومے تنے نوئی۔ ٹھیک ہی راہی مبو کانے۔
en: Our fine, prized(?) goat — Nawab Shah, you ... it. We searched for it a little ...; don't ... again(?) ... (your) head ... All right, get going, go.
en_old: A fine goat of ours, Shoki, Nawab Shah, you set it loose. I searched a little; don't do it again, I'll bash your head. Alright, get going, go.

brh: کنا پنی بھٹو، انو نا ڈس اٹک کے وا بھٹو، مشکل کنا یان مخلوق چھٹو، کنا دشمن مسٹو، لیکن کنا یان زور افاس، سو بنائی تو لو ہننگو شکار ئس بننگٹی افاس
en: My name is Bhutto; ... it's Bhutto ...; people can hardly escape from me; they became my enemies(?), but there was no one stronger than me; ... going ... no game was coming (my way).
en_old: My name is Bhutto, it's on my ID card too, Bhutto; people hardly get free of me, my enemy is Mashti, but no one has power over me; a hundred... the prey goes home, and nothing gets caught.

brh: ادا خیر تورے یا نا؟ اینو ہم خیر کہ مسک ادو نمونے التو اٹائے۔ خیرے ہن مسک۔ ایلم دا لنگر۔
en: Brother, is everything well or not? Today too, it's good that ... It went well. Brother, this hunger ...
en_old: Hey, is everything well or not? Today too it's fine that you've come to us. It went well. Now, this free meal.

brh: ارے دا مہنگائی ننے گنوک کرے نی مہنگائی لنگڑی کہ گنوک کرے نی اوڑا کنے انتک توفک توڑے نوس ئے دا وجہ آن توفکے نیا توڑے نٹ پلی وانے نتو خلے وانے لگے کاٹومنا در موٹرسائیکلے لیکن کنا جانے الے کنے موٹرسائیکل ضرور
en: Hey, this inflation has driven us mad; you — inflation and hunger have driven (you) mad. Then what ... to me ... the rifle ... you'll break(?); because of this ... the rifle ... [unclear] ... head ... motorcycle; but my dear, I definitely [need] a motorcycle.
en_old: Hey, this inflation has driven us mad; inflation has driven you mad too; then what do I do, you'll break the gun; for this reason you'll break the gun, he'll crack it, he'll hit it; a motorcycle over the head, but my life... I must have a motorcycle.

brh: او تفیمہ کہ موٹرسائیکل ئے موٹرسائیکل کے ضرورت اف نی پین نی انت ضرورت ئے زیادہ ہیت کپہ شرافت اٹ سہ سد روپیہ کشہ جیب آن تینا، کنے ایتے۔ سہ سد اینی امر کشیسے؟ سہ سد نا سیرس گڑ نا ہلوہ کنے وائی، نی خبر اف گڑ نا با شوق کنے۔
en: Oh, ... the motorcycle — you don't need a motorcycle. What else do you need? Don't talk too much; politely take three hundred rupees out of your pocket and give them to me. 'Three hundred — how will you get three hundred out?' For three hundred, I want a seer of jaggery halwa; you have no idea how fond I am of jaggery.
en_old: He doesn't understand that a motorcycle... there's no need for a motorcycle. Say, what do you need? Don't talk too much; politely take three hundred rupees out of your pocket and give them to me. Three hundred, how shall I take that out? I'll eat three hundred rupees' worth of jaggery halwa; you don't know how fond I am of jaggery.

brh: نی دنو طاقت اف دا تنا سیل کشس اور اونا ڈیوٹی تس دت داسہ کنا دوئم کونے سے شت ئے ور دت می کنا دوئم کونے سے لغت دت بائتے نا تور
en: You don't have that kind of strength. This one pulled his own [unclear] and gave him his duty. Now give my backside three strokes of the stick, then give my backside three kicks — that's the way of [unclear].
en_old: You don't have that much power. He took this one's goods and did his duty. Now give my second... a slap, give my second... a kick — that's your way.

brh: ارے نی دا چے خلکس؟ او دا تینے خلکوٹ ولا خلکوٹ۔
en: Hey, what did you hit this one for? — Oh, this... I hit myself; by God, I hit myself.
en_old: Hey, what are you stealing? Oh, he's stealing from himself, he's stealing.

brh: اردا تتو بدمعاشی کیزے، دا تلیخ کنا یلہ کر، یا تو خلوئے وانی، نی دا تلیخ خلنگ کپیسے، دا تلیخ خلے، زندگی نا دا سفر ختم ئے ہتہ ہوریس مارے خلوس، زو کے یلہ کر مار نا تلیخ
en: Hey, are you playing the thug here? Let go of this neck of mine, or else you'll have to be beaten. You can't cut this neck — if this neck is cut, this journey of life is over. Look, you'll kill the boy! Quickly, let go of the boy's neck.
en_old: Here you're acting the hooligan with me; let go of my pillow, or else you're a thief, you can't steal this pillow, steal this pillow and this journey of life is over; look here, you stole from the boy, quick, let go of the boy's pillow.

brh: شاباش خان خٹی، دا تدا ثنا کارٹون ء کنے وی دا تدا ثنا کارٹون ء کنے وی خبردار!
en: Well done, Khan Khatti! Hand this carton of yours over to me, hand this carton of yours over to me — watch out!
en_old: Well done, Khan Khatti, give me that carton of yours, give me that carton of yours, beware!

brh: گٹو کتے ارے نی مخلوقاتے داڑے خلیسہ مشٹی ہا
en: Choke him! Hey, so you attack people here in the mountains, huh?
en_old: Hey, you're stealing from people here like this, aren't you?

brh: ارے نی دیر اسس بسس دا ہرکس ٹی ہر کس کے مرے نی دیر ئس
en: Hey, who were you? Enough — among all of these, whoever anyone may be, who are you?
en_old: Hey, who were you? Enough, among all of these, whoever it may be, who were you?

brh: نا پارے دا مخلوق دا مشٹی انتک خلیس تروکیس انتکے ناجائز مستونا شکایت بیگن او پینی کے مسافراتے داڑے تنگ کرینس اچھا نی گڑا داتے خلیسہ دا تینے خلپرے نا کارم قانونونی خلنگس
en: He said: why do you attack these people here in this mountain and [harass] them? Why this wrongdoing? We have heard complaints that you have harassed other travelers here. All right, so you attack these people? — Don't you people strike them yourselves? Your own job is striking people under the law.
en_old: He said, these people, why do you steal like this, why do you rob them; there have been complaints of wrongdoing that others, travelers, are being harassed here. Okay, so you steal from these ones; this one is stealing himself, stealing is the job of the law.

brh: ناجوز نی انت کس خلیک، نی دا پاکو نی مخلوقے تنگ کنت کیس۔ نی کنا کانی نا خبر اف کنا باز دردناک کانی اسے۔ پا دا پا نند کانی سے۔
en: Why do you wrongfully attack people? Tell me this: why do you harass people? — You don't know my story; mine is a very painful story. — Tell it, tell it — what kind of story is it?
en_old: Sick man, who are you stealing from? You say this, you harass people. You don't know my story; I have a very painful story. Tell it, tell it, sit down, what's the story?

brh: نن ہم پین ئس کنے تو انت مسنے؟ دے خبر اف؟ آ خلوک کہ مہنگائی تباہ کرے، ہندا مہنگائی نا وجہ آن وس و مش اٹ تما، خنتو اسہ باز زور اسنے، کسے لختے تباہ کرے، کنے کس دم کائے دے۔
en: I too was someone else — what has happened to me? Who doesn't know? I am that victim whom inflation ruined; because of this very inflation I ended up out in the [wilds] and the mountains. I used to have great strength. It has ruined people by the lakh; nobody let me catch my breath.
en_old: We are others too; what has happened to me? Don't you know? That thief whom inflation destroyed; because of this inflation I was left wandering the hills and plains, I used to be very strong, it destroyed someone's livelihood, nobody gave me a moment's rest.

brh: کنتو ناخہ ظلم مس ہمسا کنیرغ نا باہو ستوسم کنتو باز ظلم مسونے ہر کس دا مہنگائی ودفینے اللہ اود برباد کے کنا ایلوم نن
en: So much cruelty was done to me... [garbled stretch: neighbor... arm...]... great cruelty has been done to me. Whoever brought about this inflation, may God ruin him, my brother, we...
en_old: Such injustice has been done to me, the price of my ... I have suffered so much injustice; whoever brought this inflation, may Allah ruin him, my dear brother.

brh: مننے مہنگائی حد آن زیادہ تیز ئے مہنگائی نا دو آن کئی مخلوق آک خوار کئی مخلوق آک خودکشی کننگ اٹی ہننو بندہ خاندانوں کے تینے ہم خلکونو ختم کرینو تینا چناتے ہم خلکونو گولی ایٹ
en: Granted, inflation is beyond all limits. At the hands of inflation many people are destitute, many people are committing suicide; people have killed their families and themselves too, finished them off; they have even shot their own children with bullets.
en_old: Inflation has gone beyond all limits; because of inflation many people are miserable, many people are committing suicide, people are killing their families and themselves, even shooting their own children.

brh: ننو بندغ ہم خنانن کہ جنتا ہم زار کننگو تینا اولاداتے ہم زار تسر دا حکومت ئے کسے نا زی آ رحم بفک انتئے کہ دا آخر زمانہ نا نشانی او
en: We have also seen people taking poison themselves and giving poison to their own children too. This government has no mercy on anyone, because these are the signs of the end times.
en_old: We also see people who are killing their wives and killing their own children; this government has no mercy on anyone, because these are the signs of the end times.

brh: نی وسنا دا مشٹی تمانس و ہکٹی تمانس، ئے دادے کہ نی اسے مہنگائی نا ستافیو کو بندغ اسوس، نی تو مہنگائی نا خلوک ئس دا ایلو مخلوق غریباتی انتئے تنگ کیس؟
en: You have ended up in this mountain, ended up in [this wilderness]; I grant that you were a man tormented by inflation — you are a victim of inflation — so why do you harass these other poor people?
en_old: You've become like this and gone astray because of your own situation; it's that you were a man struck by inflation, you're a thief because of inflation, so why do you harass these other poor people?

brh: ئے مخلوکء تنگ کپرہ، مخلوک برے کنے تینٹ تنگ کیک۔ مجبورا کنے اوفتے تنگ کروئی تمک۔ او بندغء پا، دزنہ، لخی یلہ کر۔ بس ٹھیک ئے ادا، یلہ کر دانا لخی۔
en: I don't harass people; people themselves harass me. I'm forced to harass them. — O man, I'm telling you, let go of the thief's neck. Enough, it's fine, brother, let go of his neck.
en_old: I don't harass people; people sometimes harass me themselves. I am forced to harass them. Tell that man, thief, let go of the stick. Okay, fine brother, let go of his stick.

brh: آئندہ نم کل ایلم ارے اینو ہم پد ایچو ناراضی سلف نم کل ایلم ارے اسلو نا بازو رے اسلو نا
en: From now on you are all brothers; from today on let no resentment remain. You are all brothers; you are each other's arms, each other's...
en_old: From now on you are all my brothers; from today onward there's no more resentment, you are all my brothers, Aslu's, many of Aslu's.

brh: اسے نا طاقتورے، اسے نا ہمت وری اسے نا مدد وری داسانی دا مشے الے، برکا ننتو، نا ہند خدمت اسے ننا زیاتی، جاگہ ننے ایتنے، نوکری ننے الینے ایتنے، نی بے فکر مر تول۔
en: Be each other's strength, each other's courage, each other's help. Now leave this mountain and come with us; serving you is our responsibility. We'll give you a place, we'll get you a job; you just sit back without worry.
en_old: One is powerful, one has courage, one has help; don't be like this now, come with us, serving you is our duty, we'll give you a place, we'll give you a job, be free of worry.

brh: بلکل نی باز جوان ہیت کریس۔ ئے ہم نی اللہ آباد کے نی باز جوان بندغ اسس۔ کنا ایلم ننے ٹی ہچو جوانی اف۔ نن باز گناہگارو بندغ آن جوانینگا بندغ تو
en: Absolutely, you have spoken very well. I too say, may God keep you prosperous; you are a very good man. My brother, there is no goodness in us. We are very sinful people; the good man is you.
en_old: Absolutely, you spoke very well. May Allah keep you prosperous too, you're a very good man. My brother, there's no goodness in us. We're very sinful people, not good people.

brh: او مرید، کہ دا وخت دا مشٹی بغیر کوننگ آن نی امر زند مسنوس امر ہینگانوس، بے شک نا نیت صفائے کہ نا پچاک دون صاف ستھرا او، نی باز اسہ جوان بندغ اسہ اوس، بر داسہ دڑنگ کانہ۔
en: O Murid, how have you lived in this mountain all this time without eating, how have you gotten by? No doubt your intentions are pure, since your clothes are so clean and tidy. You are a very good man. Come, let's go down now.
en_old: O Murid, how have you lived like this in these times without eating, how do you survive? Surely your intention is pure, just as your clothes are so clean and neat; you're a very good man, come, let's go now.

brh: خودکشی حرام ء، گڑا امر کروسٹ؟ امر کروسٹ؟ بس تو گڑا سسکارا ئے ہم پورا متوٹ ئے نوکری نا خاطرا دا دفتر ئے دفتر ولے داڑے نوکری گریڈ
en: Suicide is forbidden, so what am I to do? What am I to do? So then I couldn't even manage [unclear] either. For the sake of a job I went from this office to that office, but here the job grade...
en_old: Suicide is forbidden, so what should I do? What should I do? Even the sacrifice isn't complete; for the sake of a job I go from this office to that office, but here the job grade...

brh: ئے صاحبٹ باہ مریٹ تو نیکن پائمر کیو یار اکن نوکری باٹ لگریٹ باوا ہرا کن خبر افم ہرا خواناٹ تینا خواننگے پورا کریٹ دا خاطرٹ
en: I would become an officer, and then I'd [do something] for you — friend, I'd land a job. Father, I don't know why I studied and completed my education — for this?
en_old: I went to the officer, so I'd tell you, friend, that I would get a job somewhere. Father, I don't know what I studied for and completed my education for, for this sake...

brh: ایس پیسہ الو کنتو کہ نوکری الکوٹ، ئے باز خوش اٹ کہ نوکری ئس ملیک کنے، ئے تینا لمہ و ایڑ نا زند ء آسرات کیو، بلے چوتو باوہ؟
en: I didn't have the money to get the job. I was so happy that I would get a job, that I would make my mother's and sister's lives comfortable — but how, father?
en_old: If I had had money, I would have gotten the job. I was so happy that I would get a job, that I would support the lives of my mother and sister, but how, father?

brh: ئے چوٹو ہر جاگہ مایوسی ہر جاگہ مایوسی اسے حضور پاک نا ارشاد ئے جوانی گہ بندہ غمو دے اراڑے نی لفتے فائدہ ملے
en: What do I do? Despair everywhere, despair everywhere. There is a saying of the Holy Prophet that there is good in it: on a person's days of sorrow, somehow you receive a benefit.
en_old: What should I do? Disappointment everywhere, disappointment everywhere. There is a saying of the Holy Prophet that it is good that when a person is in a day of sorrow, you do him good and he benefits.

brh: مدا رسول اللہ اشہد آن محمد
en: ...mad is the Messenger of God. I bear witness that Muhammad...
en_old: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I bear witness that Muhammad...

brh: محمد رسول اللہ ہی علی الصلاہ
en: Muhammad is the Messenger of God. Come to prayer.
en_old: Muhammad is the Messenger of God, peace be upon him.

brh: اللہ اکبر اللہ اکبر
en: God is great, God is great.
en_old: God is great, God is great.

brh: یا اللہ یا اللہ غریب آن یا اللہ کنے این بلو خطاس ئس یا اللہ غریب آن معاف کر یا اللہ خبر افے معافی نا لائق ارے ڈم بڈی غریب آن معاف کر
en: O God, O God, [forgive] this poor one; O God, I have made such a big mistake. O God, forgive this poor one. O God, I don't know whether I am worthy of forgiveness... [unclear]... forgive this poor one.
en_old: O God, O God, forgive this poor one; O God, I have made a very big mistake; O God, forgive this poor one; O God, I don't know if I am worthy of forgiveness... forgive this poor one.

brh: ئے اللہ ئے باز گناہ گار ئس ئے اوٹ ئے اللہ ئے اللہ ارے کے معاف کر ئے اللہ ئے باز گناہ
en: O God, I am a great sinner, I am... O God, O God, forgive me. O God, I am a great sin[ner]...
en_old: O God, I am a great sinner, I... O God, O God, forgive me, O God, I am a great sinner...

brh: گلاس دیر انتو
en: A glass of water? What is it?
en_old: Glass? Who? What?

brh: دڑے پکارا بچپو
en: Do you need [something] here, son?
en_old: Don't shout here.

brh: بابا جی خبر اف اللہ کنے معاف کروئی انے کنے آن باز بلو خطاس مس انتئے لا او غفور و رحیم ئے
en: Baba ji, I don't know whether God will forgive me; I have made a very big mistake. — Why not? He is Forgiving and Merciful.
en_old: Father, I don't know whether God will forgive me; I have made a very big mistake. Why not — He is the Forgiving and the Merciful.

brh: گھوڑا نا کے شوق نی گڑا کاریم انت کہ پیسہ کٹے پیسہ کم پیسہ نند خالی شہزادہ غنڈا بندہ کاریم کے خوار کیپتنے تانگ تس خوار کتنستنے پیسہ رقم ملک نی ہٹ مٹ مخلوق کے پلوس کنوس
en: If you're so fond of jaggery, then what work do you do to earn money? You don't earn any money, you just sit around idle like a prince, a thug of a man. You don't do any work, you've made a wreck of yourself. Money, cash, property: you just rob people and live off it.
en_old: You're fond of horses, then what's your work, that you earn money? Little money, you sit idle like a prince, a good-for-nothing fellow; you've made a mess of work, you've ruined it; money, cash, land, you just go about cheating people.

brh: او بارف دا سے سال مرے کہ مخلوق پلنگ و کوننگ اٹی اوٹک۔ دا سے سال اٹی اسہ وار ہم نی الینگ تانوس۔ باغ نا ڈوک ئس ہمے انت کلنگی وی۔ ڈوک تو نا باغ تمانے دا سے سال مخلوق کہ پلنگ ئس کوننگ ئس اور ہسے
en: Oh, it's been three years now that people have been busy robbing and eating, and in these three years you haven't caught them even once. All that's left of the garden is a clod of earth, what good is that? Your garden has gone to dirt. For three years people have just been robbing it and eating from it, and that's it.
en_old: Oh, it's been three years that people have been going in, eating and taking. In these three years you haven't come even once. The garden's share is just this, what is it worth? The garden's share is all gone; for three years people have been eating and taking, and that's it.

brh: ئے وارم نی الینگتنس آغا اسل الینگتنوٹ لگے کاٹم نا سے سد دا سے سد روپیئی تیونی
en: Not even once have you caught them? Agha, I really never have. It's three hundred a head, so hand over these three hundred rupees.
en_old: I didn't come to you, sir, I really didn't come; three hundred per head, give me these three hundred rupees.

brh: وا جوان و بندغسئے شرافت اٹ سے سد کشا تسوس کنے۔ کنے نا حال اٹ ترس بس کنے کشا تسوٹ نی سے سد روپئی۔ کنے آ تو نی ترس بتو آکا؟ ئے کنے داڑان خلئیسوس ک۔ زیادہ ہیت کپہ بس سے سد ملانے گڑا۔
en: Well, you're a good man, you'd politely take out three hundred and give it to me. If I'd felt any pity for your state, I'd have taken out three hundred rupees and given them to you myself. Didn't you feel any pity for me? You'd have beaten me out of here? Don't talk too much, just three hundred, and that's it.
en_old: Well, you're a good man, politely take three hundred out for me. Just leave me alone in my own state; you'd take three hundred rupees out? Did you just come to me? I'll be gone from here. Don't talk too much, just three hundred, then.

brh: دا ہن بس کنا کسر الے، ئے مونا رنگا کہرا نا فٹ انجوک کشا تنے، عجیب بندہ
en: Now go, just get out of my way. He pulled it out right in front of me and handed it over... What a strange man.
en_old: This is just my shortfall; first he snatched the pot from in front of me and took it away, a strange man.

brh: دا غزل سے تا کنے سئے سد روپئی تسک، کاوا دا سئے سد نا گوڈ الیوا، منے دا کاوا ہمہ مشہ، ہمیدے کاوا تس دے گوڈ تے کنے وا، کنا پنی بٹو، لیکن دا بندہ کتا وٹ گٹو
en: This one gave me three hundred rupees. I'll go and buy three hundred rupees' worth of jaggery with it. I'm going right now; I want my jaggery. My name is Bhutto, but I didn't squeeze this man.
en_old: This fellow gave me three hundred rupees, and I'm not taking the three hundred; I won't take this at all, I'd give it back; my name is Bhutto, but this man has really got me stuck.

brh: انتس نا توار مس؟ خبر افے؟
en: What was that noise? Any idea?
en_old: What was that sound? Don't you know?

brh: دا علاقہ سے باز کوبینو اللہ رحم کے ایننا اللہ خیر کے کیجو
en: This area is very dangerous. May God have mercy today, may God keep us safe.
en_old: This area is very expensive, may Allah have mercy on it, may Allah bring good to it.

brh: ہڑے ہنتس داڑے پٹنگرے ننا ہیٹس گم مسنے نن ہیٹے تینا پٹینہ نمے خبر ہف دا دتاتا علاقہ ئے
en: Hey, what are you looking for here? A goat of ours has gone missing, we're looking for our goat. Don't you know this is their territory?
en_old: Hey, what are you searching for here? Our goat is lost, we're looking for our goat. Don't you know this is Dittas' area?

brh: ننے انت خبر ادا تاتا علاقہ ء۔ نما دا جرات؟ نم بسرے بشام نا علاقہ ٹی۔ ننے دا ڈاڈے امر کشی کل نما انارے خام کنوے۔ جائیننے خام کنویسہ؟ او ہی نمے خام۔
en: How would we know, brother, that this is their territory? How dare you? You've come into Basham's territory. How dare you shout at us like this? I'll finish off every one of you. Really, you'll finish us off? Yes, you're finished.
en_old: What do we know here, this is our own area. How dare you? You have come into Basham's territory. We... all of you, I will kill you. Really, you'll kill us? Yes, I'll kill you.

brh: کنیروہ نی اسیکہ فاش تو کرتنے ہورین نی ہا دادوٹ ہبک نی خنارے
en: ... you've never once been exposed. Let's see. You, over there... you'll see!
en_old: I'll do it; you were the first to expose it; look, yes, over there, you'll see.

brh: چنے ہاؤ ہاؤ بالکل نی خنان نی تولوک مارتے نا خلنا زیا نن کانہ داسا تینا ہیٹے پٹینے اچھا ہیٹے پٹیرے ہاؤ کانہ نن تینا ہیٹے پٹینے او ہیٹ ہتی ہت سرے
en: Yes, yes, absolutely, we'll see you... We're going now to look for our goat. Oh, you're looking for a goat? Yes, we're going to look for our goat. That goat...
en_old: Yes, yes, absolutely, you see, you... the sons' ... Now we are looking for our goat. Okay, you're looking for a goat? Yes, we are looking for our goat. That goat has gone off somewhere.

brh: او باز جوان ایٹ اسسکہ جھگہ سوبنا پالتسکہ اور جھگس نیمروچ تو پالتنا تسکہ اور شامنا جھگہ
en: It was a very good goat. In the morning it would give a jugful of milk, at midday it would give a jugful, and in the evening a jugful...
en_old: It was a very good goat; it was milked in the morning, it gave milk again at noon, and in the evening too.

brh: گس پاتنا تے سگہ باز جوانوں ہیٹ سسگہ ہنا وجہ پٹے نتھے اوہو ئے تو باز بلو غلطیس کرے نٹ آن غلطیس کرے بلہ تم
en: ...it would give a jugful of milk. It was a really good goat, that's why we're searching for it. Oho, that was a very big mistake, a mistake has been made...
en_old: I told them to go... it was a very good goat; for that reason it hasn't been found. Oh, you have made a very big mistake; the mistake was made by you, Ballah.

brh: ئنا یعنی بس بس او ہیت الہ بو بس ہمبو ایٹٹ نا پٹبو زو کبو خانے نما ودارے خنپر ئنا ہیت نی خراب لکا دانے بل زہر آخر انتس کرینوس دانے فہمٹی شاغہ ہمو خاطر انم پنا ننے پا
en: I mean, enough, enough, drop that talk. Enough, go, look for your goat, hurry up, I don't want to see you around here. Did my words sound bad to you? After all, what have you done? Get this into your head. That's why... tell us.
en_old: Right, I mean, enough, enough, leave that goat alone, just go and look for your goat, hurry up, I don't want to see you here. You've ruined my goat... what on earth have I done? Make him understand that; that's why... tell us.

brh: کنے نمے ہم بد رنگاک بد بننگے ہمبو گمبو کلے نمے گٹاکروٹ علاج نمے جوان کروٹ زو ہمبو گمبو ادا داتا تو مغز خلپبو راہبو کامبو کانتو سہی دا بلہ زیر ہیتے صفا کننگٹیو
en: You ugly lot... go, get lost, I'll squeeze every one of you, I'll sort you out good. Quick, go, get lost! Don't nag me here; hit the road, go, go, got it? Right. These people are clearing up the matter.
en_old: You too, you wretched ones, listen — go, get away, all of you, I'll deal with you, I'll treat you, I'll set you right; hurry up, go away, don't eat my brain here, go, do your work, you hear? Right. This Ballah... go and clean the goat.

brh: ئے چہ اگر صفا کریٹ دا پنجٹی کوٹنہ منوسوے دا اسہ امبو گومبو لوچک، رائیں بابو ادا کانہ کیٹی پٹین دانے تا زی خفتو پبو، او یار رائیں بابو خام، سہی پارے
en: Well, if I had cleared it up, this... wouldn't have happened. This one is a 'go, get lost' rascal. Let's head off, Babu, let's go search over here... Yes, friend, let's head off, Babu, we're finished. He was right.
en_old: Yes, well, if I clean it, it won't stay in this pen... this one here, go, go away, Raees Babu, here, what should I do with it... don't say 'go dig'. Oh friend, Raees Babu, I'll kill it. He said right.

brh: ایٹ ئس باز جوان مسنے؟ ئے ہچ پومتاوٹ کہ ایٹ ئس جوان او۔
en: Since when is a goat so precious? I never understood what's so good about a goat.
en_old: Was the goat very good? I never even knew that the goat was good.

brh: نواز جان میری خنا سے یا خنتویس؟ ایلوم میشے خنتنوٹ۔ تڑے برک میری پارے
en: Nawaz Jan, have you seen the ewe or haven't you? Brother, I haven't seen the sheep. Go and come back, the ewe, he said.
en_old: Nawaz Jan, did you see Meri or not? Ilum, I didn't see Mishi. Meri said, 'come back quickly.'

brh: بٹینا کوڑی مکی تولوکوس۔ ٹھیک ہی دڑے و برے و۔ زو کے ہرے کپے۔ ہاو ہاو۔
en: I'd been sitting at Bati's... Fine, go there and come back. Be quick, don't be late. Yes, yes.
en_old: I was stuck at Bati's place. Fine, go and come back. Go quickly, don't be late. Yes, yes.

brh: جائی پا سے میرے خنتویس؟ ہاؤ ایلم ہاؤ جائی پا مگینے تو دروخت تڑپے، دروخت تڑپیسے پر کاندہ سے میرے پٹے۔ ہاؤ ایلم۔
en: So tell me, haven't you seen the ewe? Yes, brother, yes. Then climb the tree; climb up the tree and look for the ewe over on the far side. Yes, brother.
en_old: Jai, tell me, haven't you seen Meri? Yes, Ilum, yes. Jai, say... then climb the tree; climb up the tree and look for Meri over on the other side. Yes, Ilum.

brh: دا مکان
en: This house.
en_old: This house.

brh: اولا ہڈے کرتے دے دزاٹے کنگوٹے تاسدا گنڈکپ ہرانگینا ارادہ
en: First... the bones... the thieves... don't make any trouble, whatever your intention is.
en_old: First of all... these days... thieves... don't cause trouble, whatever your intention may be.

brh: دے نا ایو اسل خنمپہ، دا گنڈ کپی، خدا خلے ہرا نگینہ، او کورے گنڈ کپہ ننگے
en: Don't look at all at... Don't make trouble. God forbid, whatever it is... O blind one, don't make trouble for us.
en_old: Don't look at it that way at all; don't cause trouble; God forbid, whatever happens... he will bring trouble on us.

brh: ارے گنڈکپ بسس نی دیر ئس
en: Hey, don't make trouble. You've come, who are you?
en_old: Hey, don't cause trouble, who are you that has come?

brh: بسوس کنے گنڈ کپاسہ، نہ کس نا گمان نہ گٹ ایر دت، دت نی راک اچانک بسوسک، نہ کس نا گمان نہ گٹ اچانک بریک دت، بسوس تو جوان کرس بسوک دا سئے نا گمرک چاستو کنین نن، ارے نی تنہا تنہا چا کونیس؟
en: You've come to me... nobody expected it, nobody had any idea, you came suddenly; nobody expected it, nobody imagined it, you turn up out of the blue. You came, and you did well to come; let's drink a cup of tea together, the three of us. Hey, do you drink tea all by yourself?
en_old: You came and didn't even let me know; nobody expected it, nobody had any idea, you came suddenly; nobody expected it, nobody had any idea, suddenly you've come. You came, well done for coming; the three of us will drink tea together here. Hey, do you drink tea alone?

brh: کسے سلام خلپیسے، دا مہنگائی تینے رخ ہنسے، نن انت اسہ سلاہ خلینومے، ئنا مہنگائی نا دوٹان ایدا مشتے ٹی تموگٹ، مخلوق کے لیکن بوڈاسم کمک پب، اخس کے مہنگائی زیادہ مریک
en: You don't greet anyone; this inflation has made you turn your face away. What advice can we even give? Because of this inflation we've fallen into its grip here. But nobody gives people even the slightest help, however much inflation goes up.
en_old: You don't greet anyone; this inflation has turned your face away. What should we decide? Because of inflation nothing stays in our hands here. But people... no one helps anyone, however much inflation goes up.

brh: مخلوق چپ و رک، بس دے اسم، مہنگائی نا خلاف ظالمہ کڑتال کپس، کئی غریباک خودکشی کیرے، تینا چنا تے خلیرے، لیکن کسے ترس اف، خبر اف دا۔۔۔
en: People are silent and quiet, just like this; they don't strike against this cruel inflation even for a day. Many poor people are committing suicide, killing their own children, but nobody has any pity. Who knows what this...
en_old: People are silent and quiet, just like that... nobody holds a strike against this oppressive inflation; many poor people commit suicide, they kill their own children, but no one has pity, no one cares about this...

brh: دا بندغ و دا استاد خلنا کہ غریباک مہنگائی ہم کینگو کس کس نا زئی رحم اف ئے حیران اٹ دا مخلوق کے ہنت مسونی مہنگائی ہس کے زیادہ مرے دا
en: This man and this teacher say that the poor... inflation too... Nobody has mercy on anybody. I'm amazed: what has happened to these people? This inflation keeps getting worse.
en_old: This person and this teacher say that the poor... inflation too... nobody has mercy on anybody. I am amazed, what has happened to these people? This inflation keeps getting higher and higher.

brh: دا سل خاموشو غریب نا توارے کس بنپک امیرک تینا ولیتن بگڑا خوافیرہ تینا کچکاتے ہیٹنا سوبت ترہ نن غریباک دا لسم خمپنہ دافتن خدا ضرور ارفک دردنائیں
en: Nobody hears the voice of the silent poor. The rich sleep in comfort in their homes and feed their dogs goat meat, while we poor don't even get to see lentils. God will surely make them answer for this, the painful...
en_old: This year is silent; nobody hears the voice of the poor; the rich sleep with full bellies in their homes and feed goat meat to their dogs; we the poor don't eat like this; God will surely take them to account, the painful...

brh: نی تا بالکل صحیح او، نی جوان او عید کیسہ، لیکن دا ٹیم انی ہنک، کنے الے کے چاس کے کنیو، کنا کاٹم ہم کھلٹٹی ئے نی چا کنیسے گڑا کنے تفیسے، نی دت اسیوس، انسان اسیوتک، چا مافک بس ہنک، دے دتک
en: You're absolutely right, you're a good one, you celebrate Eid, but this time it's all gone. Let me have a cup of tea, my head is aching too. You drink tea and then you don't give me any. You're a ghost, not a human being. There's no tea, that's it, it's gone... that ghost.
en_old: You're absolutely right, you're a good man, you celebrate Eid, but this time it's not for me; if you'd make me a cup of tea... my head is aching too; if you make tea then give it to me. You're a thief, you're not a human being; tea doesn't even suit you, that's it—he's a thief.

brh: صلوات دا مہنگائی نا دوت انت تاتس جوڑ مسر او امر نی داتس جوڑ مسوسک ئے غریب اسٹ ہمسایہ کنا خیال کتووس کنا حال ہم دم مسر لیکن کسے رحم
en: Good heavens, this ghost of inflation, what has happened, and how did you come to be like this? I'm a poor man; the neighbours never looked after me; my state became like this too, but nobody had any mercy.
en_old: Blessings! What kind of smoke has this inflation stirred up—what have you become; I'm a poor neighbour, you never gave me a thought; my condition has also become like this, but nobody shows any mercy.

brh: اللہ کنے ایرا گست روسس کنے ہم ساغہ کمباہ ظالم مسرے خبر اف قیامت ٹی اوتا ہنتال مروئی اگر اوک جوان مسرے ئے دا مشٹی دتاس متوٹے او بیس بیس بندہ کنا اسٹنگا فڈنا خیالے کتوس بس
en: O God... my neighbours turned cruel too. Who knows what their fate will be on Judgment Day. If they had been good, I wouldn't have become a ghost in this mountain. There were twenty people at a time, and they didn't care about my one single belly, that's all.
en_old: God, how many times have I gone down and come back; I too am the same—they have become cruel, there's no telling what will become of them on Judgment Day; if they had been good, I wouldn't have become a thief; twenty, twenty people, and not one of them gave a thought to my single belly, that's all.

brh: ئے رانڈ تا زکے وامر بس رانڈ تا پدھر کنے اف پین کسر داسہ نی کنے بسس نظر ئے تو نی نظر بسوٹک لیکن نی ہچ تینے کفر ئے تینا لنگاڑ سے اٹک ئے مہنگائی نا خلوکوٹ ہنا وجمدا مشتے ٹی تمانوٹ کا مخلوق پھلے وا گڈلے وا کھنے وا سے سال مرگ
en: I... have no one to back me up, no other path. Now you have come into my sight, and I have come into yours, but you... nothing... yourself. I'm a hungry man myself; I'm a victim of inflation, that's why I've ended up in this mountain. Go, rob people, or... or... a hundred years of death.
en_old: I... the widow's... I have no other way out; now you have come into my sight, you never came into sight before, but you never... I've been beaten down by inflation, that's why I'm trapped in this fist; may people be ruined and... for a hundred years.

brh: چٹو تنہ گندگی سے کیوا، صرف ئنا گڑتیا گزارہ کیوا، نیم کنا جان الے ہنک، دونگ کپے، گڑنا ٹکورس کنے ام آتے دا وڑ جوان اف، ئے پورا تو اٹی سیرس گڑنا کنیوا، اگاری اینا سے گڑس آتے
en: All alone I live in filth; I get by only on molasses. Half my life is gone. Don't be like this, bring me a piece of molasses too; this way is not good. I'd eat a whole seer of molasses... if there's any today, bring a lump of molasses.
en_old: Just eat some filth, only get by on those things; half my life is gone; don't do that, give me a piece of something; this way of yours, with us, is not good; I'll eat a full seer of stuff inside; some of those things of yours.

brh: زوٹ کنے نشہ برابر مفک خنا خراب ہن گومانی نی دا پا کنے گھوڑ سے تسے یا تفیسے دا تینا اسل گھوڑ تیننگ کپرا دا سا نامونٹ مروئی جل نا گھوڑک مروئی خل داسے
en: Quick, my craving isn't being satisfied, damn it... You tell me this: will you give me some molasses or not? I really can't give my own molasses... there will have to be... molasses... a stone, now.
en_old: Hurry, my intoxication isn't even right, my eyes are bad, I'm not sure; will you give me a horse or not? If you don't give your real horse, this will be a disgrace, there'll be jail horses; go now.

brh: دا رنگینا گم مسک دادے چا رنگینا گم مسک دا دیوان مس نا گم مس دا دا زہ تنہائی ٹی گڑاس گنیوا
en: This dappled one is lost. What, the dappled one is lost? This one has gone mad, yours is lost... in this loneliness I'll eat something.
en_old: It got lost this way; what, it got lost this way? This is what has become of it, it's lost; this... I'll eat something in solitude.

brh: ئے دا جائی تا خل جوڑ مسونو خدا خلک دا دھتے دا توکنے بدوا
en: I... the stones of this place have been turned into... God has struck this ghost... this one is a curse on me.
en_old: I've been struck in this place; may God strike you; beat this thief for me.

brh: دا زراڑے پٹوٹا، خانہ خراب دا دتو کنے کسفے، نہ زوالائی لوہی تمک، کسے پل لوہی تمک، ولا گڈا لوہی تمک، ولا داڑے بروہی تمک، اوڑا گڈ کونوئی تمک، دا دتو کنے خوار کرے، دا زراڑے پٹھیوتا، چنا غیب مس
en: I was searching this area. This damned ghost will be the death of me. ... then he ends up coming here, and afterwards he ends up eating over there. This ghost has made me miserable. I've been searching this area; the young one has disappeared.
en_old: Search this field; the wretched thief won't let me be; he won't let me go up, won't let anyone cross, won't let me go later, won't let me come here, won't let me sit there; this thief has made me miserable; search this field, the child has vanished.

brh: او دا ترانگ نا ذات، نا دتو نا گم مسک، نا سئیہ مرگ ایو، دتنا سئیہ تیو، نا سلنگانی تو کھیوا
en: Oh, what a breed this is! Your ghost... has gone missing... the ghost's... I'll give... your...
en_old: Oh, this kind of thing; your thief is lost, may your shadow die; give the thief's shadow; I'll eat from your spoils.

brh: کاو دتے کاو پٹے وکی
en: Let me go after the ghost, let me go and search, okay?
en_old: Where's the thief, where do we search, hey.

brh: نی کسنا گمان نی گت ئے ہردت۔ ارے نم دیر رے؟ ئے دیر اسیوس۔ ئے دت اسیوٹ۔ نی کسنا گمان نی گت ئے ہردت۔ اللہ خننگ پیزے۔
en: Who do you take me for... every ghost? Hey, who are you people? Who are you? I'm a ghost. Who do you take me for... God... seeing...
en_old: You don't suspect anyone, you... Hey, who are you? Who am I? I'm a thief. You don't suspect anyone. God sees everything.

brh: دا سا خننگوے خیر نومے تماشتے رولرے پٹت نتینا غولرے نی دیر اسوس نن تینا میر پٹنگاٹو نی داڑے مکے اسوس اینو مکے
en: Look at this! Well, are you people out roaming to watch the show? Searching... you're careless! Who are you? We're searching for our sheep. What are you doing here, today...?
en_old: Now it seems well, you're all out watching the spectacle, walking around searching; who are you? We are searching for our master; what are you doing here, what are you doing today?

brh: او سئے خلیوے دا کنا علاقہ ئے نن ہم چانہ علاقہ نائے نن کانہ تینا مہری پٹینے عجیب و مخلوق کسے کسء نا ایٹ گمے کسء نا میٹ گمے دا کل شوانتا کاری مے لاپروا
en: Oh, I'll hit you! This is my area. We know whose area it is too; we're going to search for our sheep. Strange people! Someone's goat is lost, someone's sheep is lost; all of this is the shepherds' doing, they're careless.
en_old: He beats it; this is my area; we don't know whose area it is; we go searching for our own camel; strange people—someone's goat is lost, someone's sheep is lost; all this is the shepherds' doing, careless.

brh: او مالنا خیال کپیس شوانگ نما اگر لاپرواہ اوتے گٹو کیوا ہنتئے کہ ہڈے نما مالے گوم کیرے نم تو ظلم کیرے دوننگا شوان ئنا دوا گٹوئے
en: Oh, you don't look after the livestock. Your shepherds, if they're careless, I'll throttle them, because they lose your livestock. You people are doing wrong; such a shepherd ought to be throttled.
en_old: He doesn't look after the livestock; shepherds, if you are careless I'll scold you, because you will lose your livestock; you're doing wrong; tie the shepherd's two hands.

brh: دتنا ایتاک تو سہیو ننے شوانگ ننا است مفس کہ اوفتے گٹو کین شوانتے گٹو کپیرے دن تو اڑتے دم ایٹ گم مرے تا تو دنیا ٹی مرے کائک لیکن ئے پاوے دنیا ٹی دم مف نیدت اسے ئس نا خیال جتا
en: The ghost's goats, then... We shepherds don't have the heart to throttle them; you don't throttle the shepherds. That's how goats go missing; where in the world would they go? But I say nothing like this happens in the world. You're a ghost; your way of thinking is different.
en_old: If the thief came, then fine; we shepherds don't have the heart to scold them; you don't scold the shepherds; a goat got lost that day; where in the world will it be; but I say there is nothing in the world like a thief, your thinking is different.

brh: نن نا خیال جتائی ئنا اڑنتو نما زندگی تباہی دا تنہائی تک باز مسو داسہ کانہ میش تے پٹینہ سالے بو اسے گئی کا واللہ نم گما بو دا رنگنا غیب مس
en: Our way of thinking is different from yours; your life is ruin; this loneliness has become too much. Now we're going to search for the sheep. Wait... By God, get lost, you lot! This dappled one has disappeared.
en_old: Our thinking is different; your life is in ruin; this loneliness has become too much; now go search for the sheep, by God, you've lost it, it disappeared this way.

brh: دا تس اسہ کا دا تک تو غیب مریرے، جو اما سو اینا غیب مس، دا تسبیحان میش پٹی
en: This... go, these ones just vanish... today it vanished... search for the sheep with this rosary.
en_old: If you give this one, then you'll disappear; yes, it disappeared this way; search for the sheep with this rosary.

brh: خدا خلیدے دے خلک کنے ئے دا تنت کنے خلکوس ئے دونا پٹنگ کے بننگا سوٹا ہندک کنے پٹ سے پھنگے زہیر کریس ئے تو نی کہ زہیر کترنا بگرتے کنے
en: May God strike you! You hit me, you struck me. I had come to look for it... you upset me; and you... upset me...
en_old: May God strike you; you struck me; I was searching for that, I came and found it; you've angered me; if you're angry, then take it from me.

brh: دا خلک جوڑ کرے سک ہمو تے واپس گوڑ جوڑ کرک ہنا غاتری نا پھٹنگ کے بسوٹا ہمو خلک پھدا گوڑ مفاس انتئے کہ نی باز کنجوس و بندغ اسوس خان آباد نا است
en: He made these stones into something and would turn them back into molasses. When I came to look for it, those stones would not turn into molasses again, because you are a very stingy person, of Khanabad...
en_old: He made this stone, and turned it back into a stone; when I came here that stone wasn't turned, because you are a very stingy person, from Khan Abad.

brh: دے اسل رحم اف نی ہم کنا ہمسایہ تمبر سنگت ایلو بندغ اسس نی اینا اخہ منت کریٹ نی کنے گڑت تے تس داسہ گڑتہ نیمہ نا ئے نی دعاس کرک ہمو خلق واللہ نا گڑ جوڑ مریرک تہ
en: You have no mercy at all. You too were my neighbour, my friend, a fellow human; I begged you so much today; you gave me some molasses, but now half of the molasses... If you said a prayer, by God those stones would turn into molasses.
en_old: You truly have no mercy. You were my neighbour, my friend, you were like one of my own; how much I pleaded with you, you gave me the goods, and now you are claiming half of them. If only you had prayed, by God, those people's affairs would have been set right.

brh: آسان لیکن ہچ مفکک نی خبرے کنا بددعا بددعا ئے انتئے کہ مہنگائی نا خلوک اٹ ہرا بندغاک مہنگائی ء ودفینو او خوار و خراب مرور ہننگ کنا گڑک خالی جوڑ مسور ہمو ظالمہ کم ہمو ظالمہ کم
en: It's easy, but nothing will come of it. You know my curse is a real curse, because I am a victim of inflation. The people who have driven up inflation will become miserable and ruined; look, my things have all been left empty. Those cruel ones, those cruel ones!
en_old: Easy, but nothing happens. You know my curse is a real curse, because I am one of those crushed by inflation; whoever causes this inflation, may they be ruined and wretched. My home has been left empty. Those tyrants, those tyrants...

brh: جہنمی مروک، انتئے کہ کنا بددعا غان کس بچیپک، ئے اسے مظلومو بندغ ئس اٹ، کنے آ کس رحم کتو، دا وجہ آن کنے آ رحم کتوس، او غریب آتہ چناتہ گزارہ متو سے، انتئے کہ مہنگائی زیادہ مس، دا سامو
en: They will go to hell, because nobody escapes my curse. I am an oppressed man; nobody had mercy on me, that's why they had no mercy on me, and the poor people's children could not get by, because inflation went up; this...
en_old: May they burn in hell, because no one will escape my curse. I am an oppressed man; nobody showed me any mercy, for that reason no one took pity on me. The poor people's children could not make ends meet, because inflation rose so much, this...

brh: دا سموک توغہ کے سکھو پٹور اسل خوشی خنپرور اخس کے پورا دنیا اوتا مریم اسل سیر کپپرور برباد مرور اندے کے ننے غریباتی برباد کرینو دا سینے اینار ناللہ نی بیگوان نائل نی
en: These people, may they seek comfort even in their sleep, may they never see happiness; even if the whole world became theirs, may they never be satisfied; may they be ruined, just as they have ruined us poor people. This... by God, you...
en_old: May these people never find peace, may they never see true happiness; even if the whole world became theirs, may they never be truly content, may they be ruined, those who have ruined us poor folk. This... by God, you... you...

brh: نہ کنے الے پائم پا دونو ظلم کپہ نی کنجوس اسس سخی اسفس اینے الے وکارہ دا کنے تو دونو ظلم کپہ کنے الے پائم پہ ئے الے کناسی کنا اسو گرس تے
en: No, don't tell me 'leave it'; don't do such injustice. You're a miser, you're not generous... don't do such injustice to me; don't tell me 'leave it'; I... my one little thing...
en_old: No, don't say that to me, don't do me such injustice. You were a miser, you were never generous, and now you say that to me? Don't do me such injustice, don't say that to me, I... my only...

brh: ایلے کاف اینا سول ایلے پرے تانکے کنا او گڑتی گڑ کتن اوسی ننا ایلے پرے انتئے کہ مجبور وٹک گڑا بغیر ئے کھئے وا توبہ اینو بد کنجوسی ایلے سلے بیسے توبہ کنے اینو بد کنجوسی کا پر اراز گڑ خوائس تے وا تھا
en: Leave it... saying 'leave it'... until... my... we did things... don't tell us 'leave it', because I am helpless; without it I'll die. I repent of today's wretched stinginess... I repent, today's wretched stinginess; whatever molasses you had asked for...
en_old: Don't say that about him, don't say that, until... he did those things to me, so don't say that to us, because we were compelled, without any reason... I repent of this wretched stinginess, I repent, I say, of this wretched stinginess; whatever you had asked for, I would have given it...

brh: بس ٹھیک ئے نی اینو پٹ کنا سنگت اسس ئے ہم لنگڑ نی ہم لنگڑ نا کنا ہلمی باز مزہ کیک لیکن دا مہنگائی ولا صبح چپس ئے اندے کے کنا بد دعا باز سخت ئے بس پان ننتینا بخت ئے
en: Okay, fine. From today you're my friend. I'm hungry and you're hungry. My... tastes very good, but this inflation... in the morning... since my curse is very harsh. Let's just say it's our own fate.
en_old: Fine, all right. You were my friend; I am hard up and you are hard up too, my... would have tasted very good, but this inflation... chips in the morning... my curse is very harsh. Well, just say it is our own fate.

brh: یلے کہ کنا سنگت آتیکن گڑا کانہ
en: Leave it, then we'll go for my friends' sake.
en_old: Leave it, since my friends... then I will go.

brh: دا توفک کے جنے بٹہ توفک کے کے بٹی نن مخلوق مپھلون ولا گوڑا را کالون ئے اونی کونون ننے مخلوق کے پھلوئی اف ننے ظلم کروئی اف انتئے کہ نن ظالم افن نی داسہ کنا سنگتس بغیر از گوڑان بغیر از سراغان
en: Throw this gun away, throw the gun away. We won't rob people; then we'll go back to the molasses and eat it. We must not rob people, we must not commit injustice, because we are not oppressors. Now you're my friend, without molasses, without a trace.
en_old: Take this gun and shoot; with this gun... we will not crush the people; whatever happens, we must not crush the people, we must not do injustice, because we are not oppressors. Now you are my friend, without any reason, without any trace...

brh: نا گزارہ مریک او ملنگٹ ننا گزارہ مریک او بے یقین نی اسو یقین اف ادا ئے تینا ئے سمجھے توٹ ئے دادے نی اللہ نا ذکر کر ہر گڑا ملنگ نی ئے دادے دا مشٹی ننے صرف اللہ نا ذکر کروئی ء خواجہ غادوری
en: You'll get by, and we'll get by as dervishes. O man without faith, you have no faith at all! Here, I... understood... You do the remembrance of God; everything... dervish... In this mountain we must only do the remembrance of God, O Khwaja Ghadori.
en_old: ...we will get by. We will get by like dervishes. O faithless one, you have no faith at all. Here, understand yourself, this is it. You do the remembrance of Allah and you will get everything, that's it. Now we must only do the remembrance of Allah, O Khwaja Ghadori.

brh: زوت پانے لنگڑی ننے امر کیک اور نی سمائی دا مشہ سم بزرگ او واقعی اداک نی جوان وئی تسکننگوس او بالکل کنا ایتاک جوان او نا ایتاک جوان او گڑا ئے توفک ئے بٹی وا
en: Say it quickly: what can hunger do to us? And you know it too, there are holy elders on this mountain as well. Truly, brothers, you have given good [counsel]. Absolutely, my words are good and your words are good. Then I'll put that gun down.
en_old: Quick, tell us, hunger is giving us orders, and you listen; this is now... that elder, truly, he's here, you have taught him well; absolutely, mine is good, yours is good. Now then, put down the gun...

brh: ادا مش ہنامس علاقہ ہنامس
en: Brother, we've been over the mountain, been over the area.
en_old: Here, the mountain is gone, the area is gone.

brh: پٹان پٹان دا ہیٹ خننگ پاو، دا سپاہ بو کے نمار، ادا تان کے ہیٹ خنتنو پدا اینو یف، ادا ہیٹ تو نن سجو مشٹی پٹان خننگ تاؤ، دا پدا ہم پن، داڑے امر کین، شاباش خان ہیٹ ایلم خنوئی ئے ولدا
en: We searched and searched, but this goat can't be found. You troops... Brother, until we have found the goat there's no going back today. Brother, as for the goat, we searched the whole mountain and it wasn't seen. Again... what are we to do here? Come on, Khan, brother, the goat has to be found, whatever it takes.
en_old: Keep searching, this goat must be found; be soldiers, you people. Here where the goat was seen, it's not there anymore. For this goat we have all been searching everywhere. This one too, again; I'll give the order here. Well done, Khan, brother, the goat must be found, then.

brh: ادا نم کٹلہ پیری گڑا پٹے نتھے توکل خدا نا زیا پانے کنیننے دھت نم خوش مابو شاباش ہانی غم کپہ دھت ننے ہچ کپک دھتے دنو مجال ارے کہ ننے کنک ادا دھتنا رزا
en: Brother, you've been going round in circles, then searching... trust is in God, I tell you. As for the ghost, cheer up, all of you. Come on, don't grieve. The ghost won't do anything to us; does the ghost have the nerve to devour us? Brother, the ghost's will...
en_old: Here you are, searching in vain, so don't search; trust in God, I'll tell them quickly. Dhat, be happy; well done, Hani, don't grieve. Dhat won't do anything to us; does Dhat have the nerve to do anything to us? Here is Dhat's...

brh: ئے آ کنے باز خراب لگاک ہمر کینو وا مرضی ادا جھٹ ئس ہند آٹی تولین آرام کین ولدا پدا ایٹی پٹون ٹھیک ئے کنا ایلم ٹھیک ئے تول بو دا است نا تینا مراد آتے پورا کبو
en: That seemed very bad to me. Whatever we do, it's your call. Brother, let's sit in this spot for a moment and rest, then afterwards we'll search there again. All right, my brother, all right, sit down, all of you, and fulfil your heart's own wishes.
en_old: This seems very bad to me; whatever we do, it's up to you. Let's sit here for a moment and rest, then search again. Okay, my brother, okay, sit down. May God fulfil your wishes.

brh: اللہ جوان کے
en: May God make it good.
en_old: May Allah make it good.

brh: ہیٹ اسہ سگا ہیٹ کنا ہاسہ دوست آن ہم پپا باز جوان ہیٹ اسس دونو ہیٹ دننے والا مشکل ئے السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام
en: It was a goat, a goat of my very own, from a close friend of mine too. It was a very fine goat; a goat like that is hard to come by. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace.
en_old: The goat was a special goat, it was from my dear friend too, a very fine goat it was; getting such a goat is difficult. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace.

brh: ایلوم نمے خیر نم دا تٹ مکھرے؟ ایلوم بس اوئی تنا ہسل ارف پیس۔ آخران مسک۔ ایلوم ننا مہر ئس مسونے گم، دے دے مننگٹ۔ پٹان پٹان تخننگ پک۔ نم تو ہسا۔۔۔
en: Brother, is all well with you? What's the matter with you here? Brother, it's just that... nothing came of it in the end. Brother, a ewe of ours has gone missing; it's been days. We search and search and it can't be found. You, though...
en_old: Brother, are you well, why are you sitting here? Brother, just... he has gone far away. In the end it happened. Brother, one of our goats got lost, it's been days now. We've been searching and searching but can't find it. You're...

brh: ادا ننا والا قصہ ئے چوہے انتئے نوم تون وسک ادا ننا امانو ایٹہ شوکیو گم مس ئنا مشٹی پٹان پٹان خم پنا تے کشان کشان سگریٹ دا ڈبی خالی مس دڑانگ نا ڈبی اول تما داڑے وات خالی مس ننا
en: Brother, our story... why [tell it] to you... Brother, ours went missing. On that mountain we searched and searched and we can't find it. Smoking cigarette after cigarette, this pack has gone empty; the other box ran out first, and now ours is empty here too.
en_old: Here is our story, why would I tell it... here our aunt's kid got lost; we've been searching everywhere, smoking cigarette after cigarette, this pack is empty, the matchbox was already empty before, now this one is empty too, our...

brh: ئے ٹی خنتون، نن گڈا ئے ٹی پٹار خنتو رے، ادا ئے ٹی پٹام پٹام سے بیوس مسون خنتون تا، نم ئے ٹی خننگے تا نن تینا کان میرے پٹے، او نارا کا خننگے کے دے ننا خننگ پک نن دا خلنا زی آ ڈپی سنگرے نا کشا خنتون تے نی وا دا مئے
en: We haven't seen it in there. Then we searched in there and you didn't see it either. Brother, we searched in there again and again until we were worn out, and we haven't seen it. Did you look in there? We searched for our own ewe... it's been days and we can't find it. We haven't seen it up on this rock or beside the stone ridge either...
en_old: We saw it there, we finally saw it there while searching; here we have looked again and again and grown weary. You looked there; we didn't look at our own place. He's shouting that we can't see it; we saw it the day before yesterday on the ridge of that rocky hill, and you...

brh: انٹ اوٹی کاظم رے خانے سے پائینوس پاش کونو ئے تھی انتے؟ نن کانے میرے پٹینے دن اسل سلیپانے۔ ادا دا مشل نن کنڈ کنڈے پٹان خل خلے پٹان نما میٹ مسہ نن خنا نتے نا ایٹی خنتون۔ نما میٹرا کا خننگک۔ داسہ گڑا ہمر کین؟
en: What's in there, Kazim? Did you tell the Khan...? Will it turn up, or what? We've searched for my ewe... Brother, we've searched this mountain corner by corner and stone by stone... we looked, but we haven't seen it in there. Yours is nowhere to be seen. So now what do we do?
en_old: What's in there, Kazim? What else have you found? We searched and licked clean every spot. Look, we've searched every corner, every stone; we've looked through your things, we've looked in your house. Your meter is nowhere to be seen. So what do we do now?

brh: چاپ خلین پینامرکن بغیر از دولن چاپم مزہ کپک دا تولم لک کنے تسکرس دا ساہی نی بغیر از دولن چاپ مزہ کپک ارے دا تو بے مراد نی تو بسس دا چبوکس تینتو راگڑیسس دادے
en: Let's clap and dance... but without a drum the dance is no fun. This... I told you... Now, you: without a drum the dance is no fun. Hey, this one's a wretch. You've come, and he's brought this whip along with him, this one.
en_old: Dance, strike up the dance — but without a drum the dance has no flavour. This is why I told you: without a drum, dancing is no fun. Hey, this fellow is hopeless; you just keep this whip to yourself.

brh: ئے جوان چاوا بلو دز اسے خبردار کنے دز پاروس یادا نہ بفا کنے آن سے سد روپیہ الکوس سے سد روپیہ اینا نلکوٹک ایرا نیا پیسہ دز اٹ اچھا نی داسہ پاس کنے دز ئس افیس بالکل ئے دز ئس افٹ ئے اگر دز ئس مروٹ نا موٹر سائیکل
en: Fine, I know it well. Look, you're a thief. Watch out, are you going to call me a thief? Don't you remember? You took three hundred rupees from me. Three hundred rupees? I didn't take them... your money, thief. Oh, so now you tell me you're not a thief? Absolutely, I'm not a thief. If I were a thief, your motorcycle...
en_old: Fine, good. Look, be warned: don't you call me a thief. You took three hundred rupees from me — three hundred rupees — and now you won't hand over the money, thief. Oh, so now you say I'm not a thief at all? If I were a thief, then your motorcycle...

brh: ہو اندا ہیت نا درست ئے او بے مراد آ گواہیت آ تے الیبو، نم دا پاپو ننا ہیٹ خنانورے خنتنورے، نی ہیٹ نا پاننگ ئس ننا غم تے تازہ کننگ ئس غم نوان تکے تازہ مریرہ
en: Yes, what you're saying is right. And leave aside the testimony of those wretches. You tell us: have you seen our goat or not? Your talking about the goat is reopening our grief; the sorrows are coming back fresh all over again.
en_old: Yes, that is right. Don't take the testimony of those worthless ones. You have seen our words and heard them. Your saying such things only refreshes our grief; grief gets renewed all over again.

brh: ہمو ہیٹ نمائی زندہ زندہ کنگوٹ اگر کنے خبر مرووسوس ہیٹ نما پارٹی سے یوتھ کنتو وٹی ئنا خاطر آن کنا غم تازہ مننگو ہیٹ نا پارٹ کنا استا بننگو دانت پاننگو جائی
en: That goat, you people ate it alive! If I had known... the goat, your party... with me... Because of it my grief keeps being renewed; the goat comes back into my heart. What is there to say?
en_old: I listened to that talk of yours while still alive. Had I known... that talk of yours, for the sake of that party, my grief is renewed; part of that talk burns my heart — what can I say, truly.
