brh: ننا ہیٹ ی کنگنوس، ئے دروغ تڑو بندغ ئس افٹ، بلکل نما ہیٹ ی کنگنوس، نی کہ ننا ہیٹ ی کنگنوس نی بچیسن، نی گڑا کنے ہمار کیسہ، نی خبر اف ہمو ہیٹ اخہ قیمت ئسس، ارے کھٹک، نی دزے دے پیڑی آ سودا کیوہ، ہمو ہیٹ نا قیمت
en: You've eaten our goat. I'm not a lying man; you absolutely have eaten the goat. If you've eaten our goat, do you think you'll get away with it? Then what will you do to me? You don't know how valuable that goat was. Hey, you... hand over the thief and I'll strike a bargain at the market. That goat's price...
en_old: You have heard our words. I am no liar; I have indeed heard your words. If you listen to our words, you will be saved. Then you will count me in. You don't know how much that word was worth. Hey, you fool, you bargain with the thief in broad daylight — the value of that word...

brh: قیمت برابر مفک، نی دنو طاقت تف، کنے دز دے، پیری دے سودا کے، اوڑے دت، تاسا ننا ننا مقابلہ مریک، ہرنے طاقتور نی ئس یا کہ ننن، نی دا خبر
en: The price won't come out even. You don't have that kind of strength. Give me the thief and strike the bargain at the market; [hand him over] there. Then it'll be a contest between us: who is stronger, you or us. You'll find out.
en_old: The price doesn't match. You don't have that much power. Hand me the thief; strike your bargain in daylight; give him over there. Then there will be a contest between us — whoever is stronger, you or us. You know this.

brh: بلو ہیت کننگٹوس نی دزت اوار تیرت کے ویلوہ دوست آ بلو بلو ہیت کننگٹوس کشین دے دا کام شاباش خان دا تو نرا رینار کارا رانگیا ہلکوٹون گنڈاریتا کشیوہ
en: Look, you're the one talking. You go around together with the thief, friend. Look, look, you're talking... Let's get this job done. Well done, Khan! Where's this one running off to? I'll grab him and drag him out.
en_old: Look, I'm telling you, you roam around together with the thief, you call him a friend. Look, I'm telling you plainly, this is his doing. Well done, Khan! This one grabs people by the neck and strangles them.

brh: کارٹیکرے کھڈ کے وتا کھڈ بشبو کار
en: Get to work: dig a pit... his pit... get up and work.
en_old: Do the work, dig the pit; dig your own pit — that's the job.

brh: ارے اسٹ اسٹ مابو ہر خلخ نا گرا پٹے بو ہراڑے خنارے تے شت کبو تا ہمو اسٹ خلخ
en: Hey, split up one by one and search around every village. Wherever you see him, give him the stick, as far as that one village.
en_old: Hey, go one by one to every person's house and search; wherever you see them, throw them out — that one person.

brh: دا دیر اسے ارے دز، نی کنے درست کننگٹ حفیس؟ درست تو کیو نی کنا خنک مچے کمزور او
en: Who's this? Hey, thief! Don't you recognize me? Oh, I recognize you all right. Are my eyes that weak?
en_old: That one there is a thief. Hey thief, can you set me right? You're going to set me right? To you I look weak all over.

brh: دتا وڈ کے دیر ئس نا وجہ درست کتا وڈ نی دا سا کے دکھ منے تمنے ولا جوان کرے درستا کیسنی ایلم ننے وقتا مہنگائی خلکونے نی تو ننے خلپے نی بلو ہرے اسس مخلوق پلسے دا سا
en: Whose fault is it? Because of someone [else], you didn't recognize [me]. Now, you see, sorrow has fallen on [us], but he did well; you do recognize [me]. Brother, the inflation of these times has hit us, so don't you go hitting us too. Look, you: everyone, the people, the police, now...
en_old: Hand him over; because of someone else, set him right. You — this breath — suffering came upon us, but he did well; you'll set it right. Nowadays inflation is hitting us, and you hit us too. Look, where is... the people... this breath.

brh: دا بسل ننے مہنگائی خلکونے ایلم ئے تو غریب و بندغس اٹ ایلم کن تو اڑف پانے کہ جوان ئے اگہ ننے تو اڑف تے نی گڑا گڑا نن ہم کمزور افن گڑا نا انجام
en: Inflation has really hit us. Brother, I'm a poor man. Brother, don't hold me back; I'm telling you it's fine. But if you try to hold us back, then we're not weak either, and then [you'll see] the outcome.
en_old: This year inflation has hit us. Now for a poor man, tell someone it's fine; if someone hits us, then we are not weak either — then see the outcome.

brh: خرا مروئی اڑے دز، سل کہ داسہ کونیک نا کاٹم ء، دانی طوفان و بندغ اسے او سب، نی ہم دو خنتنس کہ دزی کے سے مخلوق ء خلیسہ پولیس داڑے، سے سال مروئی
en: It's going to get ugly, hey thief. Wait, now he'll have your head. You're a violent man, the whole lot of you. Hasn't it been seen that you steal and beat people? The police are here; it'll be three years [in jail].
en_old: It will have to be settled, hey thief. Look, now his itch... he's a stormy man, that one. You too have seen it: he steals, he beats people. The police are here; it'll be three years.

brh: ارے کنے دنو دو لگے تنے اینو نی کنے خلکوس دا سائی نرے وا کاوا دا تنے کیپاوا ئے نڑے نی پا دتے تینا
en: Hey, what a blow landed on me! Today you hit me. Now do you think I'll run away? I'm going... I'll tell you this... say it to your own [people]...
en_old: Hey, give me two of those. Today you hit me; this breath will go. I'll have you... you say so yourself — give your own.

brh: ایلوم دا نین تے تینا ڈکا نو چک۔ دوزینے کے تینا ڈکا نو ٹ۔ ایلوم کانتو ٹکا سم افک۔ کنکے دا تینا ڈکا سم۔ کنے ٹکا ضرورت اف۔ تے منا دک بکا تانا۔ ایلوم ننے مینگ۔
en: Brother, put this away and keep it hidden for yourself. Take it and hide it for yourself. Brother, I don't have even a penny with me... I don't need money... Brother, us...
en_old: Hey, put this money in your pocket. Take it and put it in your pocket. Hey, I don't need money. I'll keep it in my own pocket. I don't need money. Then give me my share. Hey, let us go.

brh: ننے ئے خلوئی اور نی ننے خلیس عجب و کاریم کسہ ادا اینو نا واجہ خلیوہ کہ نی دزد اسے ئس اڑے دزد ارانگ نرنگ ئس نمے اللہ خلے نم دزد نا ساتھ اتیو
en: We're the ones who should beat him, and you beat us? What a strange thing you're doing! Brother, today I'll beat you, mister, because you're a thief. Hey thief, where are you running off to? May God strike you all; you're siding with the thief!
en_old: We'll beat you — and you beat us? What a strange thing you've done. Look, today the gentleman is saying you're a thief. Hey thief, where are you going? May God strike you; you side with the thief.

brh: اللہ تو نی خلکونے کہ نی دزی ا کیس اٹ ارے دز لوز نی ننے
en: God has already struck you down, in that you've taken to stealing. Hey thief, your word to us...
en_old: God has already struck you, that you have committed theft. Hey thief, give us your word.

brh: نرسہ، دا پا کنا سے سد روپئی اتسہ یا نہ؟ ارے سے سد ٹی کنتو مسہ کراغین نا بلاٹہ۔ دا زنا کنے کاٹم ئے دیونے سنگت آ تا جوان آ علاج ہمیدے کینے، وائے مکھان۔
en: Running away? Tell me this: will you give me my three hundred rupees or not? Hey, those three hundred have become a real calamity for me. This one has driven me out of my head. Friends, we'll give him a proper remedy right here, and then woe to him.
en_old: Don't go. Tell me, will you give my three hundred rupees or not? Hey, you've become... over three hundred, a cripple's lot. This woman has driven me crazy; friends, I'll give her a proper treatment right here, and what then.

brh: او دا خلق داتی ارانگینا؟ ہا دت، ہمک کسے دتی۔ داتی نا سیلے کشی و دوٹی نا آتے و، بے نمکے ونے۔
en: Are these villagers in here, or where are they? Yes, inside; everyone's inside. Pull out what the one in here has, and the things in both their hands... the worthless lot.
en_old: Are these people in here? Yes, inside, everyone's inside. Pull off the shawl from the one in there and take the things of the two of them, and eat it without salt.

brh: ہمو کہ اسہ دے بہار ئس اسہ دے ہمو کونی نا بندغ آتیا کسر مفروک، ہرا تینا دے بے وقوف جوڑ کریر، خوانندہ او، ولے تینا حق آتے پوہ اف، کنا چنا اللہ اوفتیان ارفے، نی الے دا ہیت آتے
en: That one [is like this]: one day it is spring, the next day ... there is no way out for those people, who have made fools of themselves; they are educated, but they do not understand their rights. My child, may God take it from them; you leave these matters alone.
en_old: Those who are one day spring and one day... never become a support for those people who make fools of themselves; they are educated but don't know their rights; my child, Allah is with them; you leave these matters.

brh: نی دوتئے سلہ کنے کیرہ، چپ کن، مگہ کسراتو؟ اینا بے وس ء چاگہ سنتو گدرینگی، دا وخت آ کنے دفتراک بند مسو، ایادے برو، اللہ خاطر ء نورے مستا، ہمم؟ ایادے؟
en: You [all] keep advising me — be quiet. But is there any way? The life of this helpless one is passing by; at this time the offices have closed on me ... come ..., for God's sake ..., hmm? ...?
en_old: You're giving me advice; be quiet, ...? This helpless one's life is passing; at this time my offices are closed, go home, for Allah's sake ..., hmm? Home?

brh: او ابا کن تو سد روپیہ سے ارے مفتی تے سور کا اف کنا خدا دا امر و مجبوری سے کنا پیسہ پیسہ کسے کے وٹی
en: Oh dear, I only have a hundred rupees on me; [nothing comes] for free. My God, what kind of helplessness is this! My money, money ... someone ...
en_old: Oh, father has a hundred rupees, ... not for free; my God, this is a compulsion; my money, money, someone ...

brh: ہیلو، جی نم رحمت صاب ات کنگرے؟ جی ہو ئے رحمت ئے کنگٹ۔ جی نرگس نمائے ڈی جی ہو ہک کنائے ڈی جی نا ایکسیڈنٹ مسنے؟
en: Hello, sir, is this Rahmat Sahib speaking? Yes, yes, this is Rahmat speaking. Sir, is Nargis yours? Yes, yes, she is mine. Sir, she has had an accident.
en_old: Hello, is this Rahmat sahib speaking? Yes, this is Rahmat speaking. Is Nargis your daughter? Yes, she is my daughter. Your daughter has had an accident.

brh: ایکسیڈنٹ؟ او ایمرجنسی وارڈ اٹ ئے نم زو ببو۔ انت مسونے نی کنے پاتو سہی۔ اما کنا نرگس نا ایکسیڈنٹ مسونے۔ ابو کمک کے ابو۔
en: An accident? She is in the emergency ward, come quickly. What has happened? Tell me properly. Mother, my Nargis has had an accident. Dad, help, Dad!
en_old: An accident? She is in the emergency ward, come quickly. What happened? Tell me properly. My Nargis has had an accident. Father, help, father.

brh: داڑے نی تول، داڑے تول، ہماری داڑے تول
en: You sit here, sit here, ... sit here.
en_old: Look here, look here, look at us here.

brh: ڈاکٹر صاحب رپورٹ اٹ ہند بس؟ جی او اماں جی رپورٹ تا تو بس، دانا کرے دوئی پینانے ننے آپریشن کروئی مریک تے اور اٹ شاغونی مریک تے، ئتو
en: Doctor sahib, has anything come in the report? Yes, mother, the reports have come; her arm has broken, we will have to operate on it and put [a rod] in it.
en_old: Doctor sahib, is the report ready? Yes, auntie, the report is ready; according to it we will have to operate and put a rod in, ...

brh: آپریشن کبو تان تورے رے اما جی دادے کے راڈ واسکو بینی دار کے نمے پینجا ہزار روپی جمع کروئی مریک پینجا ہزار پینجا ہزار
en: Do the operation ... Mother, for this, for the rod and ..., you will have to deposit fifty thousand rupees. Fifty thousand? Fifty thousand?
en_old: Will you do the operation? ... Auntie, for this rod and other things you will have to deposit fifty thousand rupees. Fifty thousand, fifty thousand.

brh: ڈاکٹر صاحب، نم آپریشن نا بندوبست ء کبو، نن پیسہ نا انتظام ء کینہ۔ ٹھیک ہی بالکل۔
en: Doctor sahib, you arrange the operation, we will arrange the money. All right, absolutely.
en_old: Doctor sahib, you arrange the operation, we will arrange the money. Fine, absolutely.

brh: او بس زو کرک ئے دادے درزو سو سودا تفو ہنی بس ہیت کپہ نن تو داخہ وخت افک بس ڈاکٹر آپریشن کیپہ تبس زو دو تینگ ہن
en: Oh, just be quick, take this quickly ... [for] sale ...; now just stop talking, we don't have this much time; the doctor won't do the operation [otherwise], so just go quickly.
en_old: Oh, just do it quickly, ... now stop talking, we don't have that much time; the doctor won't do the operation until you quickly pay.

brh: یا اللہ یا اللہ نی کس اسے داخس مجبور کپیس کس اسے مجبور کپیس یا اللہ نی کنکے او
en: O God, O God, may You not make anyone this helpless, may You not make anyone helpless; O God, You, for me ...
en_old: O Allah, O Allah, do not make anyone this helpless, do not make anyone helpless; O Allah, you...

brh: کنے کسے مسیحس جوڑ کر یا اللہ ناداران بے دست یران کا ئے دیران خواوا یا اللہ خیر کنا مار اینو باز پریشان ئس
en: Make someone a savior for me, O God. The poor, the helpless — where would they go, from whom shall I ask? O God, [grant] well-being; my son is very distressed today.
en_old: O God, make someone a savior for me; O God, the poor and the helpless have nowhere to go, O God have mercy, my son is in great distress today.

brh: اللہ اکبر
en: God is great.
en_old: God is great.

brh: کنا ایرا ہسپتال اٹ داخل ء، کنے علاج کن تو پیسہ اف، کنا آپریشن ء، کنا لمہ تینا خفتہ والی
en: My sister is admitted in the hospital; I have no money for the treatment; [she needs] an operation; my mother [gave] her own earrings.
en_old: My wife is admitted in the hospital, I have no money for her treatment, she needs an operation, and my mother is on her own.

brh: دے کشا کنے تسلی دے کدر سوداگر تا سوداگر تا ہم پیسہ غاک پورا متوس سنگتاتے تینا اوفتے آن خواہش اٹ کسس تو دو کرے کسس ہم تو دو کرے
en: [I] sold [them] ... reassured me ...; even the merchants' money did not make up the full amount. I asked my own friends with a request; one lent a hand, another lent a hand too.
en_old: Give me some comfort — even the merchants' money wasn't enough; I asked my friends for help, some helped and some also did what they could.

brh: صدیقہ نی پا ئے برکیو دیران خوفس دیران خوفس کنا مات دا مصیبتاتے دا مجبوری تے
en: Siddiqa, you tell me ... from whom shall I ask, from whom shall I ask? Oh mother, these troubles, this helplessness.
en_old: Siddiqa, you tell them, the poor, the poor, my mother, these troubles, this helplessness.

brh: مر خلوکا اللہ نا ذات او کنے تینا مخلوقات نا امتحان اٹ چشاڑیکی ہاؤ تہ
en: God's own being ... He is putting me through the test of His creatures, yes indeed.
en_old: God, who takes away sons, has thrown me into the trial of His creation, yes.

brh: او تھی باز مہربانی نی نی مخلوق نا تنے بلکہ تینا رب نا کنڈ آ توجہ کرک
en: There is great kindness in Him. You, you [should not look to] the creatures, but rather turn your attention toward your Lord.
en_old: That is very kind of you; you should not look to people but turn your attention towards your Lord.

brh: دا کل دا کل بخیرو دا کل محتاج او دا تینا انت خواست دا تینا مونا دا دوئی مونا کروس تینا رب آن خوا
en: All of these, all of these are [poor], all of these are needy; whatever you wish, raise your hands before you and ask it from your Lord.
en_old: All of this, all of this is well; everyone is needy. Whatever you want, raise your hands, turn your face to Him and ask it from your Lord.

brh: نا روش کے اسا ڈیک کے داسے داسے باز وقت کدر یانے چے باز وقت دا وخت اوفتے
en: Your ...; now, now a lot of time has passed ... a lot of time; at this time, them ...
en_old: That's just your way, someone gives, and now, now it's taking a lot of time; how much longer? It's been a long time, this time is theirs.

brh: نا سوجھ وتی ئے تینے ہسپتال آ سر کرک اللہ کل ء جوان کیک اللہ کل ء جوان کیک نی غم کپہ دا تسبیح
en: Your ...; get yourself to the hospital. God will make everything well, God will make everything well; don't grieve. This rosary ...
en_old: Your advice is right, get yourself to the hospital; God will make everything well, God will make everything well, don't grieve, here is this rosary.

brh: اللہ نا ذکر کرسا اللہ تعالی کل کستے احسان کے کل کستے احسان کے نما دعاٹ ننے
en: Keep remembering God; God Almighty does favors for everyone, does favors for everyone. [Remember] us in your prayers.
en_old: Keep remembering God; God Almighty does good for everyone, does good for everyone; remember us in your prayers.

brh: یا اللہ، کنا ہر مشکل ء آسان کر، کنا ہر مشکل ء آسان کر۔
en: O God, make every difficulty of mine easy, make every difficulty of mine easy.
en_old: O God, make every difficulty of mine easy, make every difficulty of mine easy.

brh: مجبور و گناہگار اٹ، تینا دروارٹ، قبول فرما، قبول فرما، قبول۔
en: I am helpless and sinful, at Your court; accept [me], accept, accept.
en_old: Helpless and sinful, at Your door; accept it, accept it, accept.

brh: رنگ ناسس دا خورے کریسک ننا دن پریشان اسو نا لمہ جانی تو اللہ کل خیر کرے اللہ کرے نا ڈاکٹر نا
en: Your color ... we were so worried. Your mother, dear ... God has made everything well; God did ... your doctor's ...
en_old: Your color has gone pale, what are you doing to yourself? We were so worried about you; your mother, my dear, may God make everything well, may God... your doctor...

brh: بیشک لٹی فرشتہ ئس مونتس ننکے آپریشن ء تہم مفت کریسے گڑا فاتو کل گڑاتے نٹ کرے بھلدا ایتھس پاو نی ڈاکٹر پائیداس اسل جوانیں نمے نورا غا دننگ کیرے تا بیشک اللہ پاک بیشک
en: Indeed, [he was] an angel for us; he even did the operation for free, then ... all the things .... Truly a good one ... you ...; indeed, holy God, indeed.
en_old: Indeed an angel appeared before us and did the operation for free; then Fatu settled everything. Tell the doctor this, that you are a truly good doctor, may God grant you light; indeed, Almighty God, indeed.

brh: اللہ پاک نی تینا بندہ غاتے تون، یار مددگار الیپیس، تینا بندہ غاتے کنے کسر کشی سا اللہ پاک، ئے اللہ پاک نا لکھ لکھ شکر، نا لکھ لکھ شکر، لمہ
en: Holy God, You [are] a friend and helper to Your servants, You do not abandon [them]; You make a way for Your servants, holy God. O holy God, a hundred thousand thanks to You, a hundred thousand thanks to You. Mother ...
en_old: Almighty God, You give Your servants friends and helpers; You never leave Your servants in want, Almighty God. O Almighty God, a hundred thousand thanks to You, a hundred thousand thanks to You, mother.

brh: نم سامان تے مچ کبو ئے کاو کرے فائل تے ارفیو۔ ہو
en: You gather up the belongings; I'll go and pick up the files. Yes.
en_old: You gather up the belongings, I'll go and bring the files. Okay.

brh: جی سسٹر۔ ایلم، نما ماما جی ڈسچارج مسنے، نم برے۔
en: Yes, sister. Brother, your uncle has been discharged; you can come.
en_old: Yes, sister. Brother, your uncle has been discharged, you may go.

brh: برچی تا دا ایٹی مٹ دے تے ٹھیک ئے بس اینو راغدے تے جی او ٹھیک ئے شوکت نی زندہ ئس
en: ... these days it's fine; just today ...; yes, it's fine. Shaukat, long may you live.
en_old: For all of them, these days it's fine; just now it's fine, yes it's fine; Shaukat, you are alive.

brh: ئے مونا نوکری کن درخواست ہم جمع کریوٹ۔ صحیح کنا مسڑ۔ اللہ نی کامیاب کے۔ ننا مال تا کنا دے پدی خراب مرسا ہننگٹی او۔ دا خسکو بے نصیب مسونے کہ بندغ تینا ہڈ ولے۔
en: I have also already submitted an application for a job. — Good, my daughter. May Allah make you successful. Our circumstances are getting worse day by day. It has become so unfortunate that a person ... his own bones ...
en_old: I've also submitted an application for a job there. Good, my son. May Allah make you successful. Our condition is getting worse day by day. This land has become so unfortunate that a person can't even keep himself together.

brh: بس اماں دعا کر کہ اللہ کسر ئس کشی او دا نوکری کنے ملے ہائے اللہ نی مالک ئس نی ننے آ رحم کر اللہ کسر ئس نمو تروک
en: Just pray, mother, that Allah opens up some way and I get this job. Oh Allah, You are the Master, have mercy on us. — Allah will give you some way.
en_old: Just pray, mother, that Allah opens some way and I get this job. O Allah, You are the Master, have mercy on us. Allah will surely show you some way.

brh: کسب نا نیام آن خوار او اللہ دا دوئی کس نا مونا مریفنت توفیق تفیس اماں کنتو کرایہ کم نی نم تو پپی سا کنا چنا کنتو دا سد روپئی او دا فتنہ نی ہرف دا ہم بازے
en: People are wretched in the midst of earning a living. O Allah, let these hands not be held out before anyone; grant us the means. — Mother, I'm short of money for the fare; do you have money? — My child, I have these hundred rupees; take this, even this is a lot.
en_old: Amid all the toil... may Allah never bring this before anyone... not give the strength. Mother, how is the rent less? You... my child, how come these hundred rupees? Oh this mischief, you... this is also a lot.

brh: اما دعا کر۔ اللہ نا امان اٹ مرے گدے تینا کاٹم آ کر۔ یا اللہ ئے کسے دا خسم
en: Mother, pray. — Go under Allah's protection. Put your shawl over your head. — O Allah, do not make anyone this ...
en_old: Mother, pray. May you be in Allah's protection; put the shawl over your head. O Allah, I am dying of this grief.

brh: محتاج کپیس بے وس کپیس بندغ تے نا اولاد کے چھڑا کننگ کپ او دے گڑاس تنی کپ اگر اولاد پیسہ خوائے ننتو دا پیسہ کپتین ولدا مس
en: Do not make them needy, do not make them helpless. A person cannot support his own children, and cannot give them anything. If the children ask for money and we don't have this money, then what?
en_old: Don't make me needy, don't make me helpless, don't leave anyone's children stranded, don't do such a thing to anyone. If the children ask for money and we don't have the money, then what?

brh: حشر نا ذات، حشر نا ذات انداخس بے وس مریک، تینا لمہ ایلم تا دوئی ہرفک، تینا براخہ غا کل، تینا ٹل
en: It is like Doomsday, Doomsday — a person becomes so helpless; he takes hold of the hands of his own mother and siblings, all his ..., his own ...
en_old: Of the Day of Judgment, of the Day of Judgment... how helpless one becomes; he lets go of his mother's and sister's hands, all his brothers, his family.

brh: ہاؤ مجیب جانی یار ہمو کریز دا مونکا ریڑ نا پاریس نی یار اللہ مالک ہی بس بندہ غفار ہی ہو نا اللہ مالک ہی اہی دا سورا مت راوت زین اسمتس نہ یار نہ یار بس یار کاو مچے کاری مسرے کا
en: Yes, Mujib, my dear friend ... that thing you told me before, friend. Allah is the Master; one is just a servant ... yes, Allah is the Master ... No, friend, no, friend, that's all — friend, I'm going, there's a little work left.
en_old: Yes, Mujib dear, friend, that's the thing, you told me this before. Friend, Allah is the Master; one is just a servant, He is the Forgiver. Yes, Allah is the Master. Oh, this... don't go... No, friend, no, friend, just go, friend, all the work will get done.

brh: او رمضان جوڑ وڑ تکڑا ٹٹ نہ یار یکاؤ مچے کاریم سرے پدا یار چا تزوتے یار نی تل چاس تو کنے تو نانہ اوڑے نا خنتنون نم چیا لاوالس کینی تونا پین انتالے جوڑس ٹھیک ٹھاک
en: Oh Ramzan, I'm well, in good shape. — No, friend, I'm going; there's a little work to finish, later. — Friend, have some tea, friend; sit down, have a tea with me ... What else is new with you? — Fine, all good.
en_old: Hey Ramzan, are you doing well? No, friend... all the work has been done. Then, friend, give me tea, friend. You drink tea, I'll... there... you've seen them. How are things with you, is everything fine? Fine, all good.

brh: طبیعت نا؟ اللہ نا احسان۔ رمضان کنے باز افسوس مس یار۔ انتئے؟ ہند گڑانا افسوس؟ یار اندا کہ نا رشتہ پنا نی تو ظلم مسک۔ انت پاننگ اٹی ئس دے؟ اینا مطلب ء پو متوٹ۔ او ایلم نی چاوسٹ۔
en: How is your health? — Fine, by Allah's grace. — Ramzan, I felt very sorry, friend. — Why? Sorry about what? — Friend, just that your match broke off; an injustice was done to you. — What are you saying? I didn't understand what you mean. — Oh, brother, don't you know?
en_old: How's your health? By Allah's grace. Ramzan, I felt very sorry, friend. Why? Sorry about what? Friend, that your proposal was turned down; an injustice was done to you. What are you saying? I didn't understand what you mean. Oh, sister, you don't know?

brh: سما اف تاتانا نماسڑنا برام نا کنا تاتانا نماسڑنا ہاؤ ہمودے کنا ہمسا ایس نا سانگ مسس تے اونا برام مننگٹی ئے یار واقعی کنے سما اف بس ایلو اینو پگہ پیسہ نا دور ئے ہر کس تو کہ پیسہ مسنے
en: No idea? Your aunt's daughter's wedding. — My aunt's daughter's? — Yes, that one, the one who had been engaged to my neighbour; her wedding is taking place. — Friend, I really didn't know. — Well, besides, these days it's the age of money; whoever has money ...
en_old: I don't know. Grandfather's grandson's wedding? My grandfather's grandson? Yes, the one whose engagement was with my neighbor? Is he getting married? Man, I really don't know. Anyway, these days it's the age of money; whoever has money...

brh: دنیا اونہ، خیر یار، ئے کاو کنے کار ئس ارے، نی تو چپ، نن دا چپ ہم کرو، چپ ہم کرو پدا برے، لمہ، لمہ
en: The world is theirs. Anyway, friend, I'm going, I have some work. — You just stay quiet. We'll keep quiet about this too; keep quiet, and then come. — Mother, mother!
en_old: That's how the world is. Alright, friend, I'm going, I have some work. You just keep quiet. We've kept quiet too; we keep quiet and then come back. Mother, mother!

brh: لومہ! ئے دانز بننگٹٹ۔ ثریا نا برام ء؟ ہو راستی تو لومو کنے دشتارے؟ اسہ کنے دشتار، داسہ کنے دشتار اف۔
en: Mother! I'm hearing this — Surayya's wedding? — Yes. — Truly? Then, mother, isn't she my fiancée? She was my fiancée before; now she is not my fiancée.
en_old: Mother! I'm going to the dance. Surayya's wedding? Yes, really. Mom, do you recognize me? Once I knew you, now I don't know you anymore.

brh: ہمو نا وخت مست او نا لمہ بس ننا ارا غا ننا حالت ء خنا او نن ہشت سال مس ہشت سال مس دا سنگ ء او نن دست کنے چڑا متے او ننا دوتے اٹ
en: At that time her mother just came to our house and saw our situation, and for us it has been eight years, eight years, this engagement, and we ... with our own hands.
en_old: At that time his mother was there; she came to our house and saw our condition. It's been eight years, eight years since this engagement, and he hasn't let go of my hand; we're still in each other's hands.

brh: ولدا ٹومٹ کستے نما شیڑے تولفک ٹومٹ ئے دا سوف تے نشان آتے کہ پیسہ ہمر کٹیرے
en: Then the tomatoes — how much? Weigh half a seer of tomatoes. Show me these apples — what price are they going for?
en_old: Then take the tomatoes, weigh these for me, the tomatoes. Show me these apples, how much do they cost?

brh: دا صفا ہن پاش ئے نی یقین کر کنے تو پنجاہ لکھ روپیہ اف ننے شتے پانے
en: This is quite plain — believe me, I don't have five million rupees ...
en_old: Tell me this plainly. Believe me, I don't have five million rupees. They are lying to us.

brh: کنے پیسہ درکار ئے داسہ فیصلہ نا دوٹی ئے گولی یا پنجاہ لکھ؟ نم یقین کبو کنے تون دا خذ پیسہ اف، کنے تون پنجاہ لکھ روپئی اف، خلپبو کنے، خلپہ رے، کنے یلہ کے رے، کنا خیال پائے، دا تومک کائین خواری
en: I need money. Now the decision is in your hands: a bullet or five million? — Believe me, I don't have this much money, I don't have five million rupees. Don't hit me, don't hit me, man, let me go, man, my mind says ... this ... hardship ...
en_old: I need money. Now the decision is in your hands: a bullet or five million? Believe me, I don't have that much money, I don't have five million rupees. Don't hit me, don't hit me, let me go, my thinking says this is going to be trouble.

brh: انو نا شکار رحمت نا پل شروع کرتے ایب دادے ہمت کے ہستے خدا نا فضل خلفیس کنے خلفیس
en: Today's prey ... of mercy ... started ... take courage with this one ... it is God's grace. Don't hit, don't hit me!
en_old: Today's prey... the flower of mercy began. Now have courage with this, God's grace is there. Don't hit, don't hit me!

brh: کنا چنائے خلپیس، کنا چنائے خلپیس، خلپیس کنا چنا، ابا دے، ہمت کے، بر، نہ خدا نا پینٹ، دنے خلپو، دنے خلپو، کنا چنا خلپو
en: Don't hit my child, don't hit my child, don't hit my child! Father, have courage, come! No, in God's name, don't hit him, don't hit him, don't hit my child!
en_old: Don't hit my child, don't hit my child, don't hit my child. Father, have courage, come. No, for God's sake, don't hit him, don't hit him, don't hit my child.

brh: خلپبو، خلپبو، کنا چنا غولینگے، خلپبو، خلپبو
en: Don't hit him, don't hit him, my child is frightened, don't hit him, don't hit him!
en_old: Don't hit, don't hit, my child is crying, don't hit, don't hit!

brh: یا اللہ کنے معاف کیس
en: O Allah, forgive me.
en_old: O Allah, forgive me.

brh: دا گناہ کنے ہم ئس بابا، اسہ بندغس، اسہ بندغس کنا دوتیان مرگ نا
en: This sin is on me too, father: a person, a person met death at my hands.
en_old: This sin is on me too, father; a person, a person died by my hands.

brh: گواچی مسٹ ئے خونی ئس جوڑ مسٹ خونی ئس نہ نہ بابا جی نی پا
en: I got caught up in it; I have become a murderer, a murderer. — No, no. — Baba ji, you tell me.
en_old: I became a witness, I became a murderer? A murderer? No, no, Baba ji, you say...

brh: نی پا اللہ کنے معاف کروئی اسے خونی سے معاف کروئی اللہ ہاو کنا مار او غفور رحیم ء او معاف کروکا ذات ء نی اسٹے خلقس
en: Tell me: will Allah forgive me? Will He forgive a murderer? — Allah — yes, my son — He is the Forgiving, the Merciful, He is the Being who forgives. You killed one person;
en_old: You say Allah must forgive me; would He forgive a murderer? Allah... yes, my son, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful, He is the One who forgives; don't you be afraid.

brh: ئے ہٹہ جانے بچہ فیس، دا نا فیصلہ ہم تینٹ کنکے، لیکن پریشان کپہ، جوان نی احساس مس، نی راستی نا کسر آ بسس۔
en: but you saved lives; He will make the judgment on this Himself too. But don't worry; it's good that you came to realize it; you have come onto the path of truth.
en_old: ...save a life; make this decision yourself too, but don't worry; it is good that you felt it, you have come onto the right path.

brh: یا اللہ کنے معاف کر، یا اللہ کنے معاف کر، یا اللہ کنے معاف کر
en: O Allah, forgive me, O Allah, forgive me, O Allah, forgive me.
en_old: O Allah, forgive me; O Allah, forgive me; O Allah, forgive me.

brh: کنے معاف کیس بابا، کنے معاف کیس۔ دا نی انت پاننگ اٹی ئس ئے ہچس کنے کتوٹ۔
en: Forgive me, father, forgive me. — What is this you are saying? I haven't done anything.
en_old: Forgive me, Baba, forgive me. What you are saying, I have done none of it.

brh: تصویر
en: Picture.
en_old: Picture

brh: کنا چھنا نی انتئے دن سوسس؟ ہراڑے کنا رسک لیپوکے؟
en: My child, why had you become like this? Where will my sustenance come from now?
en_old: My child, why have you become like this? Where will my livelihood come from?

brh: ملک نی او نا درر نا امید مفک نا سا تو خبر کیو اما خبر کیو ہران کاہ دا خلق نا مزیری نی انتئے او دے پاپیسے
en: Malik, ... there is no hope of his getting out. I'll let your ... know — but whom shall I let know, where would I go? The labour of these people ... why don't you tell him?
en_old: Malik, there is no hope of his getting out; let your ... know. But let whom know? How... these people's ... why don't you tell him?

brh: لوٹا تا وخت آ مرزوز و برک دروازہ غاتے ٹکی فگ منت زاری کے ہن پاتہ بلکہ نوکری ئس اتنے مرو۔ اوہو نوکری دا ہرا سدے نا دروازہ غاتے بند کرینو نن کن تو ہرا نوکری کے
en: At the time of ... he comes, knocks on the doors, pleads and begs, saying maybe some job will turn up for him. — Oh, a job! Those who have shut the doors on us — what job would they give us?
en_old: At the time of begging, I knocked on the doors of every house, pleaded and begged, saying maybe some job would be given. Oh, a job—those who have shut a hundred doors on us, what job is there for us?

brh: اللہ مدد ایتو نی ئے کاوہ کنے اوداس پینجانہ کریٹ تیرٹ بولی کہ پینجا پینجانہ طاقت ایر کلہ ہنتو اسہ یکہ کاوہ ہناٹ چھٹاٹک بچار چباری وقت ہائے ٹھیک ہی دا ہنا ہم خبر نا راہ خلک کھڈ ئس صیف کھڈ نا تاقی بش ہرا داسہ بسہ کشہ درے ہنا بیتو خدا کے آکھے بچا چو ایری بچکے
en: "God will help. [...] I'll go [...]" [They] said that Panjahi has the strength of fifty [men] [...] "No one else went; I'll go all alone." I went [...] at that time [...] "All right." So he too went along the way to the grave, dug a pit and [hid] inside the pit, [to see] who now comes, pulls [the corpse] out and carries it off. He went [...] God [...] save [...]
en_old: God help... 'You... fifty... have the strength of fifty... alone... time...' 'Fine.' ... the pit, a well... 'God save...'

brh: انارے توسس جھٹ ئس جوار مسوندا ایتمہ مچے گہ دھنز کلنور وری پھولیک مون مس روہنگاک تا پدا مشو خار تمن رسینگہ رسینگہ ایتو خلک ئس چمبے ہنا قبرٹی کہ ایلو ایتو خلک دا بھٹے ہنا کزامے کہ خسیہ قدرتی بس ہنا بیوہ نا دا کدوئے زغم گانٹ
en: He sat there. A moment passed [...] dust [rose] [...] it appeared in front; after [...] it kept coming closer and closer and struck a claw into that grave; when it struck at this [mound] again [...] as fate would have it [...] that widow's [...] he [struck] its hand with the sword.
en_old: In a moment a flood came... dust... he arrived, grabbed someone, put him into the grave... another... as God willed... the widow's... sword...

brh: تو یہ ہندن فریاد ئس کرے ہندن جی ہانٹ ئس کرے ہندن دین بسن فرار کرے واپس دانا ہنا دو کرے ہنا اڑے تما ہندن دو سے تک ہچ نا لکھے خے ہندن بلا دا ہم کرے اوئے لا ہنا دا چائس کدا سہ ہنا ہندن
en: Then it let out such a wail, let out such a scream, [...] fled like this and went back from here [...] the hand; it fell right there, a hand like this [...] nothing [...] such a monster; it did this too [...] he knew [...] like this.
en_old: Then he made such a plea, he cried out like this, he fled like this and came back; he did this with his hand, like this, "until these two…" nothing of it… he did this too, and that one… like this.

brh: نا کمیس نا ٹکرے نا دو آن تکشا کمیس او دے گڈینگاسس دا دے جی بٹتے نا شاغاسس پکا بادشاہ نا شاہ جوز نا نشانی ئے تدوئے تا گڈار دو آن ہاڑ تمانی ایلا بس وراٹی تے نا لودے صاف تما ودا بادشاہ بے بس پائے پنجاہ ئے ہو بوکے
en: [...] a piece of the shirt [came off] the hand; the shirt had been cut; this [...] had been put [...] Surely it is the token of the king [...]; [...] cut off [...] it has fallen from the hand [...] came [...] clean [...] The king [...] he said, "Panjahi, yes [...]"
en_old: …the piece of his shirt, torn from his hand — he had cut that shirt and he was carrying it tied up; it was surely the token of the king's… take it from his hand; the stains on his clothes were clean… the king was helpless; he said, "Alright, go."

brh: ئے ہمہ کڑی دے چا بچہ فہمہ پائے ہن نا پائے ہوکان نکتو ہننوٹی ضابطی نٹ پیشنگا اینا پائے ہوکان شاہ سلامت استو بس سناڑے دوئی تو گڈار دا دوئی نا تو بشانی دا پوچے داد استو نی دو تہ ہمے تمانی گداری مخلوق نی کار گھیرے رہت
en: [...] that same [...] he said, "Go." He said, "Yes, I'm going." [...] he came out [...] He said, "Yes, Your Majesty, last night it came [...] I cut off its hand; this is its hand [...] these clothes [...] last night [...] its hand fell right there [...] the people [...]"
en_old: …that girl… He said, "Yes, Your Majesty, so it is." …He said, "Yes, Your Majesty, …take it from his hand; give these clothes… You… these… a treacherous creature, you… "

brh: دا بادشاہ بے وقوف ہم کرے ہنا پتی کہ تینے ہن ہلکے درے دانا مست ار زائی پس ورہ درے نشان تس کہ دا ہو بو پتی
en: He made a fool of the king too: he went [...] that he took it himself and carried it off [...] he gave the token, [saying] that this is it.
en_old: He fooled the king too; he himself… this one… he gave the sign that "this is it."

brh: بیگارا کسم نس ئے بگو او زسک دہنتی پکا دا دیو نا پچارا کمیلو مائی کہ خنار بس بادشاہ ء ولتوس شاہ وننگ کہ ہنا پچی ہتا لت ننے تو سری پن توبہ کرے بادشاہ پدا ننگ کہ پچی ہتا پسی ننا اسل ننے بادشاہ چیرینگا بس پنجائی ء پی
en: In the evening [...] surely these are the dev's clothes [...] the woman [...] when they saw [them] [...] the king [...] "bring us those clothes" [...] he said "God forbid" (tauba); the king again [said], "Bring the clothes [...] our [...]" The king [...] said to Panjahi [...]
en_old: …in the evening, he said… surely these are the dev's clothes; when they saw them… the king… "bring us those clothes"… he repented; "the king again… bring the clothes, our origin, the king… us." He said, "Alright."

brh: بر کہ دا ساہلتاک پین بسو پائتو پادشاہ سلامت نی ہکل لو کہ دا پوچینی اوفتینی شانکیسا دا دیواتا ئے دا سا دیواتا نما نن ملو اوڑے تو ایدوئے تو بوڈاٹو تما پدا سا نی ہرا حال کہتہ نت کنے الے رکار گڑا ئے مکھی
en: Come [...] He said, "Your Majesty, you order [me to bring] these clothes, [but] these clothes are theirs; they belong to the devs. These devs [...] we [...] there [...] after that, whatever state you are in [...] me [...] then [...]"
en_old: Come, these… come. He said, "Your Majesty, you shout that these clothes are theirs — they are the devs'. These devs, we and you met there; afterward, whatever state you are in, tell me, …"

brh: سبق پد ناتو کنے قبول کرو ئے حکم ئے لیکن داسہ ئے ہنا دے کاوہ گڑا کنے تو ئس لگے شش تو لگے سال ئس لگے پنج سال لگے دیوا تا کارنے گڑا کنے ملے یا کنے پد مرے کاوہ کنا دا مچو ناتا کل نا خیال ئے کے سوختہ زیادہ گھاٹ مرو ئے باقاعدہ
en: "[...] I accept your order, but now I am going. It may take me a month, it may take six months, it may take a year, it may take five years; it's the devs' business. Then whether I find them or [...], I'm going. Take care of all these [people] of mine [...] let there be more guarding, properly."
en_old: "…I accept your command, but now I am going; it may take me a month, six months, a year, five years — the devs' work; whether I find it or not, I am going; take care of all my people…" more properly.

brh: دا پردہ ٹی او پائے بالکل چٹانو سوختہ ہر سامان او دا ملو تا را ہیمس پنجاہی ہناکا دا سیالہ کنے دا ارا تری کٹ ملو قدرتی ہن بس بس جنگلہ سے جنگلہ تا ٹی ئس دیر سے لچھہ سے ہنا لچھہ ٹی ئس دیر سے پھسنگانے
en: In this [...] he said, "Absolutely everything has been destroyed and burnt, every bit of the goods [...]" Panjahi went [...] which direction [...] by God's will he went on and came to a forest; in the forest there is water, a pool; in that pool the water is [held] [...]
en_old: …he said, absolutely… all the goods… "alright" — these are the two or three roads I found naturally; there is a jungle, in the jungle there is water, a pool, and in that pool water is flowing.

brh: پیشن کاپا کنا بجا مہ السلام علیکم ماما کریم منیر سپاہی ماما کتو ہسکہ پریش دان کریٹنی بس ماما کے رشی ہنا چونائی دے دوستی تو ہرزادہ و داسا او منا شکار کریسہ ہترسا ئنا دے کلے فسا کے کزدی
en: [...] came out [...] "Peace be upon you, uncle." [...] the uncle [...] "Why are you worried?" [...] came [...] the uncle [...] that boy [...] in friendship, nephew; and now he goes hunting and brings [game] [...]
en_old: …he came. "As-salamu alaykum, uncle." "Karim Munir, soldier… uncle, …" "Uncle, that boy… with friendship… and now he has gone hunting…"

brh: بلو دیرادے مس دے اخیرا پائے دیرے پارے پائے دا سما مہ کنا اسہ کاریم سے نی کرتن ئے دا لچا بے کشیوے نی دا خسی کنے شکار کیوپے بزا واقعی نا نیمغہ کارپٹی کنے سانبسہ دا کہ کشیپ آن انت سے دا ہنا کہ پچے کہ کشا تورے یا تا پائے
en: After a long while, finally he said [...] he said, "Listen, do one task for me [...] you hunt this for me [...] really, in the middle [...] keep it for me [...] whatever [...] the clothes that she takes off and puts down, bring them," he said.
en_old: After a long time, finally he said… he said, "Listen, do one task for me: you kill this… you hunt this for me; truly, in the middle keep it for me; whatever comes out of it, the clothes that she takes off — bring them," he said.

brh: پائے بس کنے دا پچ ضرورت ئے کہ پائے ابو ماما کتو اسہ قسم شاہ فیس کا حضرت سلیمان نا آ لے قسم شاہ توڑ پری زاد داتون ننا سردار نا دوئی گڈیاں اسنی یا دیر دا ہمونا پچی پائے بس کنے ہندا پچ ضرورت ئے پائے بس کنے دا کا کشی دا سہی قسم شاہ حضرت سلیمان نا
en: He said, "I just need these clothes." [...] he said, "Uncle, swear an oath by Hazrat Sulaiman [...]" "[...] the fairy-born [...] with this one, our chief's hand was cut off [...] these are those very clothes." He said, "I just need these very clothes." He said, "[...] all right, [I swear] by Hazrat Sulaiman."
en_old: He said, "I just need these clothes." He said, "Father, uncle, swear an oath — by Hazrat Sulaiman." "…swear an oath… the fairy-born, with her, our chief's hand… these are her clothes." He said, "I just need these clothes." He said, "I just… that's right, swear by Hazrat Sulaiman."

brh: ئے چکار و فٹ دا چغہ ختا چی گانہ تتا دا یک شاک پیشنگا شاتن تست تینا ٹوپی دے پدا ٹوپی تے کھاٹما تینا ہراڑے ہناس دا نیکس دیوا خانوفس گڑا دا ہنا تئی کٹ کیرے دے وری بے ہمو دیواتا ملنگا
en: [...] came out [...] this cloak [...] he gave him his own cap. Then [he said], "[Put] the cap on your head; wherever you go, no one, no dev, will see you." So he went off [...] again [...] to meet those devs.
en_old: …he came out and gave him his cap; he put the cap on his head again, so that wherever he went the devs would not see him; so he went off and set out to meet those devs.

brh: پوچ پئے ہاؤ دا سخص خنے خرف پئے آ ٹوپے تے خا کاٹم آ یر ہورا دے چخنے خمپک ئے تو خنے او تیرنگا بجنگا کریدے گڈس دے پئے نیکی نا پد گڈی ئے کنے گڈی کے پئے ہی ہورا ٹوپنا کے داٹی ہرے وا
en: Clothes [...] he said, "Yes, this person [...] sees [...]" He said, "Put that cap on your head [...] look, does he see you? He doesn't see you [...]" [...] he [ran off] [...] He said, "Is this how kindness is repaid? You do me harm?" [...] "Look, his cap [...] in this [...]"
en_old: Clothes… "Yes, this person sees…" He said, "Take that cap off your head…" then I see him… he ran and fled… "In return for kindness you do me harm?" he said. "…that cap of his, in this…"

brh: او کے پائے تو پائے نی کہ کس خنوف نی تو خنتا نی ما گڈی کس۔ دا سے ہتہ پائے دا سے فلان کیرے جنگل سے مش سے ہنا تٹی سے بھلو جنگل سے ہنا ٹی بھلو تلاف دیر سے۔ دے دیگر مس ہنا ٹی ما کیرے دے واک پری پیر ہموٹی غسل کیر نی ہموٹی
en: He said to him, "No one will see you, but you will see them. Go." "Take this," he said. "There is a certain forest [and] a mountain; inside it is a big forest, and inside that a big pond of water. In the late afternoon the fairies come into it and bathe there; you [go] there."
en_old: He said to him, "No one will see you, but you will see them; go." "Take this," he said; "go to such-and-such jungle, a mountain, in it a big forest, and in it a big pool of water. In the afternoon the fairies come to it and bathe there; you be there."

brh: او تیریس آخیرٹی کرے ہنا بادشاہ نا مسٹ برو غسل کرو صاف صورت والو سٹے او پی ہا پوچاتے نا کشانی ہنا ٹوپے کاٹما کس کس خنوف او دھڑنا دیرٹینی پوچات ہفستے نا کاٹما کیراں کے کیراں کے سولس او کا پدا او پیشیم خنوف گھوڑا کرے
en: He [...] at last the king's daughter will come and bathe, a fair-faced one [...]; she took off her clothes. With the cap on his head, no one, no one sees him. She is in the water of the lake; he picked up the clothes [and put them] on his head [...] here and there [...] after that she came out, does not see [them], and [looked] around.
en_old: …finally the king's daughter comes and bathes, the fair-faced one… he took her clothes; with the cap on his head no one sees him; he took the clothes from the edge of the lake; she comes out, looks here and there… he made a horse…

brh: یاد کرو آخیر نی پارو کہ نہن کاری مسے کرو گڑا ٹھوپے اسے سو نی خنے کاری منے ہمو کس شمس افیس گبوڑا بہ ٹھیک دا ہنا ہمو تلاف ئ پٹےس ہنا ہمو دے ئ خرے توس دے وی گمس دا اسدے واکو پھری کو برسا
en: "Remember: in the end you will say [...] then [put on] the cap [...] you will see [...] no one [will see] you." "All right." He went and searched out that pond, went to it and sat down [...] one day the fairies came [...]
en_old: "Remember, finally you said we should do the work; so take this cap; with it no one will see you… alright." He searched for that pool, he sat there… the fairies come…

brh: ہندا دھڑنگرا ہندنا زیوا او دھڑنگرا دیرٹی غسل کیرہ غوازی کیرہ اخیرہ گہ ہنا غسل کرے سا پیشنگ سا آخرٹی ہنا بس پیشنگ یکہ بس دھڑنگا دیرٹی پچاتے نا کشا دا ہنا پچاتے ہفدے نا کیرا ہنکاری توسی ئے غسل
en: At that very lake [...] they bathe in the water of the lake, they dive about; finally, after bathing, they come out. At last, as they come out one by one [...] she took off her clothes at the lake's water [...] he took those clothes [...] [while she was] bathing.
en_old: This bank… they bathe in the water of the lake, they swim, and finally after bathing they come out; at last, as they come out one by one, in the lake she took off her clothes; he picks up those clothes… bathing.

brh: خدا نا واسطہ کرے پشنگا پدا سپو چاکافس پائے بیلی ہنتس کریس دیو سے پری سے خدا واسطے کرے ننا سر کنا پچا تیٹی نا ہنت مشکلی سے حل کیو پائے قسم شاہ حضرت سلیمان نا کنا ہچ بدی کرو فیس بوڑا پچاتے نی
en: She pleaded in God's name; she came out, then [...] He said, "Friend, what have you done? [Are you] a dev or a fairy?" She pleaded for God's sake: "[...] my clothes [...] I will solve whatever difficulty you have." He said, "Swear by the oath of Hazrat Sulaiman that you will do me no harm; then [you get] your clothes."
en_old: He pleaded in God's name... afterwards... he said, friend, do you... a div, a fairy... pleaded for God's sake, our head... my wife... your difficulty will be resolved. He said, by the oath of Hazrat Solomon, I will do no harm to you... bring the wives... you...

brh: جی ہاں۔
en: Yes.
en_old: Yes.

brh: ہاؤ کنے قسم ئے کہ ہرا حضرت سلیمان نا کہ ہرا نا ہچو بدی ئے کارو فٹ پائے یعنی کہ ہرا ہرا کاڑے مسرے او کنے پچتا ضرورت ئے کہ او دے بے پائے ہاؤ کنے قسم ئے سو حضرت سلیمان نا او بے کاری مننگا دا ٹوپے افے کاٹم اٹ کنے ارے پچاتے بے ٹیئی ہتن پچاتے بے نا ٹوپے افے کاٹم اٹ کنے دا خوبصورت
en: "Yes, I swear by Hazrat Sulaiman that I will do you no harm," she said, "that is, whatever happened [...]; I need the clothes, [give] them to me." He said, "Yes, I swear by Hazrat Sulaiman." [...] this cap [off] his head [...] the clothes [...] bring the clothes [...] the cap [off] his head [...] this beautiful [one].
en_old: "Yes, I swear by Hazrat Sulaiman that I will do you no harm," he said, "that is, whatever happened, I need your clothes — give them." He said, "Yes, I swear by Hazrat Sulaiman." She did not believe him. He had the cap on his head; she took the clothes… with the cap on his head, this beautiful…

brh: تو انسان اسے، پائے کاریم نی انتس، داسہ کنے نی، نی تو انسان اسے نا چھنا اسے، دیو اسے نا او؟ پاڑ کاریم ہن، پچے کے کشہ پئے پئے، دا تو ظالم دیر مسنے کنا باوا نا دوئی گڈا او دے رنڈو کرے، او دے تو پریستان کروئی اسہ گلے کن لیکن داسہ کنے کن قسم شاہ پئے نمسہ ہزار
en: "You are a human," she said. "What business is it of yours? Now me... you, you are a human's child; [am I] a dev's? Go about your business. Why do you take the clothes?" she said. "This tyrant, who has he turned out to be? He cut off my father's hand and left him maimed. He ought to be made to suffer once; but now swear to me [...] a thousand [...]"
en_old: You are a human, he said; what business is it of yours? Now, you... you are a human's child, and she is a div's, is she? Go and do your own work. Why do you kill... Who has this tyrant become? He cut off my father's hands and then made her a widow; she was to be taken to Fairyland for one... but now, for my sake, swear, O king, said... a thousand...

brh: دا سا پچے کہ مے تیوک دا سا خاری ئے دیونے تینا بسل بھاوا دا سا انشاءاللہ دا سا مے تو اقرار کینوٹ لیش برام بھی کروٹی پچ بھی ہلوٹوٹ پائے ایڑے دے سکنے دو مف کہ تینا دوا کہ تینا کنے پریزانہ کہ پائے آ ایٹ ٹوپے
en: "Now the clothes that you won't give [...] now [...] the dev [...] his own father [...]" "Now, God willing, I have made you a pledge: I will marry [you], and I will take the clothes too." He said, "[...] there [...] my hand [...] his own [...] me [...] fairy [...]" He said, "Give [me] that cap."
en_old: Now, since you won't give it to me, this div... his own... now, God willing, now I have made a pledge to you: I will not marry, nor will I take a wife. He said, go there and... that his prayer, that his... let me go free.

brh: ئے تے کھٹ وانے کس ہم پخ ٹوپی تے خاکاٹ مابس حل دوٹی پھرار کرینا دھرے پینا جاگہ اینا باوے تینا پائے بھاوے پائے کنا سے مطالبہ سے دادے پورو کر پائے پارک پائے کنے برام کروئی انسان سے نا چھنائے
en: [...] no one at all [could see him]; he was hidden with the cap on his head [...] she fled from his hands to another place, to her father. She said, "Father," she said, "I have one demand; fulfil it." He said, "Say it." She said, "I must marry a human's child."
en_old: ...reads... nobody at all... hat... in the dust... fled from his hands to another place... his father... He said, I have one demand; fulfil it. He said, speak. He said, I must marry a human's child.

brh: پائے نن دے وہ انسان نا چنا تو امر نی براتی تپہ بس کنا کاریم کے سکھر کھپے ستو ئے بس نیٹ سکھر کھپہ ئے بس داؤد انسان نا چنائے تیونے لیکن خن اوتہ پائے نہ او خن کرو فستل حضرت سلیمان نا قسم اف کہ او دے ہچ کرو فست تو قسم اف حضرت سلیمان نا کہ ہچ کرو پائے او نا سے
en: He said, "We [...] a human's child, how [...] marriage [...] my work [...] hard [...]. I will give you [in marriage] to a human's child, but [won't you harm] him?" She said, "No, I will not do [anything to] him, by the oath of Hazrat Sulaiman." "Then swear by Hazrat Sulaiman that you will do nothing to him." She said, "[...]"
en_old: He said, we will give you a human's child, but you... bring... my work... Sukkur... just... Sukkur... we will give you a human's child, but will you kill her? He said, no, I will not kill her, by the oath of Hazrat Solomon, I will do nothing to her. Then swear by Hazrat Solomon that you will do nothing. He said, it is hers...

brh: ہمو کاری مسرے ہمو کاری مت ابی کروس پئے او وعدہ کہ حضرت سلیمان نا قسم نی کاری مت ابی کروٹ پئے ٹھیک ئے دادے پئے ٹوپی ہپ کاٹما ٹوپی ہپ کاٹما ہورا شہزادہ و بندہ سے سفت زیباؤ پئے ٹھیک ئے دا سے برام تے تیونے کاری تینا
en: "That deed that happened: don't do that same deed again." She said, "I promise, by the oath of Hazrat Sulaiman, I will not do such a deed." He said, "All right." Then he said, "[Take] the cap off [your] head." [He took] the cap off his head; they looked: a prince, a very handsome man. He said, "All right, I will give this one in marriage [...]"
en_old: Don't do that same deed, don't do that same deed... He said, the promise, by the oath of Hazrat Solomon, you will not do such a deed. He said, fine. Then he said... hat... a prince, a man, very handsome. He said, fine, we will give this one in marriage, your work...

brh: پچے کہ کشا تورے اتہ پابو دا ظالم تو دیر ئس کراتہ دوئی گڈیا کنے ٹھنٹھی کرے گھادے یراڑے لٹکداسہ دادے پیبزاسہ نیازاں سلیمان نا قسما پینس ہنا پچاک بے ضرورتو کنے برام بے تے برام تے ستن
en: "Why did you take the clothes [she] took off and put down? Tell me, this tyrant, who was he? He cut off [my] hand and made me handless [...] hanging there [...] now [...] By Sulaiman's oath [...] I [don't] need those clothes [...] marriage [...]"
en_old: Why do you kill... don't say that; who was this tyrant? He cut off my hands... hanged... now... by the oath of Solomon... go, I have no need of a wife, I have my marriage...

brh: اور ایتے نا پائکار نا زہم تے خا ہیمٹ تے نا پائکار نا پاسو اسے کتب فیس کنا اسے مرشد سے ئے اوڑان ہلوٹ تے نا کا دعا خوارٹ اوکا پدا نا پاسو بلٹ ئے خست کدیوس تے نا چناوس بے کنا پاسو بفیس۔ ئے ٹھیک ہی شاہ محمد سدا سلامت۔
en: "And [...] the wound [...] I have a spiritual guide (murshid); I will get [it] from him; I will recite a prayer for you; after that your [...] [...] your children [...] my answer [...]" "Yes, all right." Shah Muhammad, may you always be safe.
en_old: And... the warrior's sword... I have a murshid (spiritual guide), I will go to him, I will pray for you, then your... be my... Alright, Shah Muhammad, may you be ever safe.

brh: دا سپائی کنے ہندا پچاک ضرورت او تو حکم کرے ایرو دیوا تے پی ببو دا کا پچ ہبو اسہ دیوا خندنو کے ٹکا نا بڈے ہپیر رائے مسپائدا سدا دیوا تے پی فلانگ کرے بادشاہ نا شار نا خڑکا دا بڈ ہڑبو ہموڑے نن برے نرے
en: This soldier [said], "I need these very clothes." Then he gave the order: "Go and tell the devs [...] bring [...] the clothes." A dev [...] they carried loads of cloth [...] set out; the devs leapt [into the air] [...] near the king's city: "Put these loads down there [...] we come [...]"
en_old: This soldier... I need a wife... He gave the order: go and tell the divs... a div laughed... bring... he took the divs and went off; near the king's city... we come there...

brh: ہاؤ ئے زند اٹ دا تو نا کمال ئے کہ کنے پوسکونو زند ئس تسک بے شک خلوکاڑ نا بچی فوکا باز بھلن اللہ پاک نا کسس ئے زند اٹی کنے
en: Yes, in this life it is Your miracle that You gave me a new life. Indeed, the one who saves is far greater than the one who kills. Almighty God has someone of His in my life, for me.
en_old: Yes, in this life it is Your wonder that You gave me a new life; indeed, the One who takes away also saves; Almighty God is very great, He has given me someone in my life.

brh: او تو دنیا نا اسے طاقت اسم کسفنگپک، یار شکر کہ نی زندہ ئس ئے تو تنے اسے قاتل ئس تصور کریسٹ، بس اللہ تعالی نا شکر ئے اور نا خلنگ کنے خوش
en: Then no power in the world can kill him. Friend, thank God you are alive; I had been thinking of myself as a murderer. Just thanks be to God Almighty, and seeing you makes me happy.
en_old: He cannot be killed by any power in the world; friend, thank God you are alive, I had been thinking of myself as a murderer; all thanks to God Almighty, and seeing you makes me happy.

brh: دا کسر نا کسر ئس اف۔ بے شک۔ خلوک آن بچفوک آ باز بندغ ارے۔ ئے ہرا کسر آ کیناٹ، او کسر اٹ صرف ناکامی ئس اینو دا کسر اٹ نا واجہ نا رٹی کنے بس خوشی ئس
en: There is no path like this path. Indeed. There are many more people who save than who kill. The path I was going down held nothing but failure; now, on this path of the master, I have nothing but happiness.
en_old: There is no path like this path. Without doubt. There are many people who have been saved from ruin. The path I was on, on that path there was only failure; now on this path, following my master, I have only happiness.

brh: بخیر، نم داڑے انت کننگ اٹیورے؟ بس ئے بس سوٹ مچے چیک اپ کرفنگ کے، پٹی بدل کرفنگ کے، ولے نی، نی داڑے انت کسے؟ او یار کنا ایڑ نا ایکسیڈنٹ مسس مچے دو تے فریکچر
en: Hello, what are you doing here? — I just came for a little check-up, to get my bandage changed. But you, what are you doing here? — Oh friend, my sister had an accident; her hand is slightly fractured.
en_old: Hello, what are you doing here? Oh, I just came to get a check-up and have the bandage changed, but you, what are you doing here? Oh friend, my brother had an accident, both his hands are fractured.

brh: بس تو ڈاکٹر کنا آپریشن ء کرے، اینو او دے چھٹی تسر، تو اینا گھنٹہ اسٹے سواری سے نا بندوبست کریس، لیپا کے اینو پگہ انت کننگٹی ئس سئی چنگا ننے نا پٹ، ہارے پٹ، اللہ اللہ خیر اللہ۔
en: So the doctor did the operation, and today they discharged her, so in an hour or so I'll arrange some transport. But tell me, what are you up to today or tomorrow? — Alright, fine... Oh God, God, all is well, God.
en_old: Well, the doctor did my operation, and today they discharged him, so in an hour or so I'll arrange a ride and take him home. So what are you doing today or tomorrow? Good, fine, come to us then, come whichever way. God, God, keep us well.

brh: خدا جوڑ۔ اینو درکارک پگہ اوڑا غا ضرور بریس۔ نا اسہ فرشتہ سے تو ملاقات ء کریف۔ انشاء اللہ باز فائدہ مریک۔ ہکا نا۔
en: May God keep her well. Today if need be, or tomorrow, be sure to come over there. I'll have you meet an angel. God willing, it will be of great benefit. Okay?
en_old: God willing. Today or tomorrow you must come over there. I'll have you meet an angel of a man. God willing, it will be of great benefit. Right?

brh: ب اللہ بشو کجہ تو اللہ
en: In God's name... God.
en_old: By God... forgive... where... oh God.

brh: پین باوا جی نم جوڑے؟ اللہ نا کرم ئے ئے تینا وسٹ اٹیٹ۔ شکریہ باوا جی۔ طبیعت نمنا جوان ئے شکر۔ باوا جی دا کنا سنگت ئے شوکت۔ دا نا وجہ آن ئے باز پریشان اسوٹ۔ کنا دوٹی انت دادے گولی لگا۔ تو درو ہسپتال اٹی ایتا تو ملاقات مس۔
en: And Baba ji, are you well? — It is God's grace; I'm getting along on my own strength. — Thank you, Baba ji. Your health is good, thank God. Baba ji, this is my friend Shaukat. I was very worried because of him. A bullet hit him at my hands. Then yesterday we met in the hospital.
en_old: Pir Baba ji, are you well? By God's grace, I'm in good health. Thank you, Baba ji. Your health is good, thank God. Baba ji, this is my friend Shaukat. I was very worried because of him. A bullet hit me here in my hand. So I was there in the hospital, and that's how we met.

brh: قسمت مس، شکر ہی اللہ پاک نا کہ دا زندہ اٹ او کنا پریشانی کل مر مسر۔ اللہ پاک نا شکر ادا کرت کہ اللہ پاک نی اسہ پوسکنو زند ئس تس۔ دو مچے گپ شپ کبو، ئے برے وا؟
en: It was fate; thanks be to Almighty God that he is alive, and all my worries have come to an end. — Give thanks to Almighty God that Almighty God gave you a new life. — You two chat for a bit; I'll be back, okay?
en_old: It was fate; thanks be to Almighty God that he's alive, all my worries are gone. Give thanks to Almighty God that He gave you a new life. You two chat for a while; shall I go?

brh: بابا جی دا کنا لمہ ء، دا کنا ایڑ ء۔ السلام علیکم بابا۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ امر ئس کنا مسڑ؟ الحمدللہ ئے جوان اٹ۔ گودی نما ملونے۔ بس۔
en: Baba ji, this is my mother, this is my sister. — Peace be upon you, Baba. — And upon you be peace. How are you, my daughter? — Praise God, I am well. — Madam, and you? — Just fine.
en_old: Baba ji, this is my mother, this is my brother. Peace be upon you, Baba. And upon you peace. How are you, my son? Praise God, I'm fine. So now you've all met. That's it.

brh: اللہ نا رحم کنا نی ئنا دعا کو بابا جی شکر ئے اللہ نا اینو ہسپتال آن خیر خوشی اٹ ارا غا بس تسر جوڑ ئے جی رحمت باز نا ذکر ئے کریکہ ہر وقت نا ذکر ئے کریکہ بس اینو اللہ نا شکر ئے مونا
en: By God's mercy and your prayers, Baba ji. Thanks be to God, today she came home from the hospital safe and sound; she is well, yes. Rahmat used to talk about you a lot, he mentioned you all the time; and today, thanks be to God, we are before you.
en_old: By God's mercy and your prayers, Baba ji, thanks be to God, today I'm coming home from the hospital safe and sound; he's been fully healed. Yes, Rahmat talks about you a lot, he mentions you all the time. Now, thanks to God, we're face to face.

brh: او ہمو نا دیدارس، بابا جی داسہ ننے اجازت ئے نم تولبو چاکمبو مجلس کبو۔ جی۔ ڈاکو۔
en: And that is just to see you. Baba ji, now give us leave; you sit, drink tea and have your chat. — Yes. — Dacoit...
en_old: Oh, that's just seeing him. Baba ji, now give us leave; you sit and talk, hold your gathering. Yes. Go on.

brh: مالک نا مہربانی او کہ خوش مس تو کل گڑا جوان مرے اینو نن کل محتاج آن نن ہنتس کہ ضرورت مرے
en: It is the Lord's kindness; when He is pleased, everything turns out well. Today we are all in need of Him, whenever any need arises.
en_old: By the Lord's kindness; if He is pleased, then everything will turn out well. Now we are all dependent on Him; we are nothing on our own, whatever the need may be.

brh: نم اڑوم خوان، نم غنی ئے کل جہان نا بادشاہ ئے ننے آ وخت ئس کیندو، حالات ئس برے، نن ہم مالک نا کنڈا
en: You are... You are rich, the King of the whole world. A time comes upon us, hard circumstances come, and then we too turn toward the Lord.
en_old: You rest; you are wealthy, king of the whole world. Give us some time, let circumstances come right; we too are in the Lord's hands.

brh: تینا روحی کن ہور کنا لا کسر کم و مار ملنگ اٹ باباجی داڑکن ہم دعا کر اللہ پاک دادے ہم کیرے کسر آتھے باباجی دا دا نیت کننگے
en: For the sake of his own soul, he too has come a little way onto the path by meeting my son. Baba ji, pray for him too, that Almighty God brings him onto the path as well. Baba ji, he is making this intention.
en_old: For his own soul, he has come a little onto the path through meeting my son. Baba ji, pray for him too, may Almighty God bring him onto the path as well. Baba ji, he has made this intention.

brh: باز بھلو غلطی ئس مس، مال و دولت نا لالچ اٹ ہر ناجائز کاری مے کریٹ، خلنگ، پلنگ، ولے اینو منت وار اٹ، تینا ایلم، تینا سنگت رحمت جان نا۔
en: I made a very big mistake: in greed for money and wealth I did every unlawful thing, beating and robbing; but now I am grateful to my brother, my friend Rahmat Jan.
en_old: It was a very big mistake; in greed for wealth I committed every illicit act—beating, fighting—but now I am grateful to my brother, my friend Rahmat Jan.

brh: کنا واجہ نی دا کلے کسر تے الٹ، ئے اللہ کنے سے پوسکونو زند ئس تس، ہمو اللہ کنے معاف کے، کنے معاف کے، اللہ کنے معاف کے، معاف کروکا ہی نا ذات ء۔
en: My master, I have left all these ways; God has given me a new life; may that same God forgive me, forgive me, may God forgive me; His being alone is the one who forgives.
en_old: My master, you leave all these ways; God has given me a new life; may that same God forgive me, forgive me, may God forgive me; it is His being alone that forgives.

brh: عاف کرو کائنا زاتی نن اونا محتاج اون نن اونا دراخاں کن دراخ ملنگنے کن دراخ ملنگنے استے چنا کپک
en: His being alone is the Forgiver; we are dependent on Him; we seek healing from Him, so that healing may come, so that healing may come; He does not leave the heart disheartened.
en_old: The One who forgives is His being; we are in need of Him; to reach His door, to reach His door, a little effort is needed.

brh: ننا کل نیکی دعا کینہ اللہ ننے آ رحم کے ننا گناہ تے معاف کے ننا گناہ تے بشک ننے رحمت کنا مار ایم کنا مار
en: We all pray for goodness: may God have mercy on us, forgive our sins, pardon our sins for us. Rahmat is my son, and he too is my son.
en_old: We all pray for good: may God have mercy on us, forgive our sins, pardon our sins, grant us mercy. My son, come, my son.

brh: ئے نوہے باز خوش اٹ کہ اللہ پاک نمے سہی انگا کسر آ شاغا
en: I am very happy with you that Almighty God has put you on the right path.
en_old: I am very happy today that Almighty God has brought you onto the right path.

brh: ایدے کننگ ئس جوئے ارے پاشن شوکی اوٹ نتو چالان کے ونی دانگ برک ددنگری پاشن شوکی اوٹ گڑا چنڈی ئس برام کرک اوٹ تو ڈگی باز کنا غریبی ات چہ خراب کننگ ئس ارے زرن چہ نغنی نغنی داسہ کتے تو اسپال ایم نا کاٹم نا قسم کن
en: What is there to do here... otherwise they issue a fine... then I'd make a little something. My poverty is so great — what a ruin this is! From the Zaranj comes my bread, my bread... now they have done this... I swear on your head...
en_old: There's something to be done—I used to go hauling and pushing, then I'd drive the vehicle wherever it went, I kept at it, then I'd earn a little, but my poverty was only being made worse; a bit of money, a bit of bread—now I've done this, I swear by your head...

brh: ایم ئے سے فینٹلی چٹو آتھ نیور پلامہ صاحب آپ انصاف کرو اگر آج ہم سٹیکس لیا ہم اپنا زرنج ادھر جلائے گا اگر نہیں جلایا ہم بھی اپنے باپ کا تیسرا بچہ نہیں ہوں گے ارے ارے پہلا دے دے گڑیا یار پہلا پہلا جسٹس فاؤٹ کرے
en: ... Sir, you do justice. If today we took... we will burn our Zaranj right here; and if we don't burn it, then we are not our father's true sons. Hey, hey, first give, give... man, first, first do justice...

brh: کنا حوالاک کنا، بئے ورنا نی سچ پاریس، داسہ تو ٹھنڈا ڈی نی ہرا کنا بیوی کسورک ہموفتے ہترے نی نشان تے بلکنی نا رسکیس نا ایلا کٹے بندہ من بسو، بئے ہاؤ بئے ئے ٹھیک ئے ہنا آخری ٹھمی مونا ضعیفے
en: 'That is my story.' He said, 'Young man, you have told the truth. Now be at ease. Those who are my wife's ... bring them ... you (know) the signs ... your brother ... a man has come.' He said, 'Yes,' he said, 'all right.' ... the woman in front ...
en_old: My affairs are my own. Yes, young man, you speak the truth. Now go calmly; those whom you bring as my wife's kin... you have noted the signs; a man has come. Yes, yes, it's all right; the woman in front, at the last stop.

brh: تے ہیس دا سد دیوانہ چنا ہیس دا بادشاہ نا مسڑ ء تینٹ بتوسنے تینٹ تو بادشاہ ء تو پدا دا ہنناڑے ہور ہننا بندغاتیٹی ہور درست کپل کے نوا دا ہنناڑے ہورا ہورا سوچ خلک ہمے مونا بادشاہ نا کہ ہمے ورا تسا کہ ہمیدے درست کرے ہمو پدا دانا متے رند لگیک
en: ... this crazy child ... this is the king's daughter; she came by herself. Then the king, look here, look among those people, look, don't say anything ... look here, look, look. He thought: right in front of the king ... that he gave ... that he set it right; then after this ... follows ...
en_old: ... this crazy one, this ... the king's ... he himself came; then look here, look among those people, don't say anything, look here, think: before the king, if he gives us this, he will settle it; then this will follow from it.

brh: پہ پین تپہ پرک پاہو بلکہ نوا ہلو تینا چاس آخر نٹ ہورا ہورا شک تمبک تکیرا پاوندا دا جندے تو ہور بادشاہ پاو کنا ساہی پوس ٹھوکے کرے سمس پاہ ہچ شانک پرک پاہ مچ سرے ہنا آخر نٹ
en: ... said ... rather, don't ... take your ... knew ... finally, look, look ... doubt ... he himself, look, king, he said ... my ... he did ... he said nothing ... said ... in the end ...
en_old: ... don't say anything, take ... look, look, doubt ... he himself said, look, king, my ... he did ... said nothing, ... in the end.

brh: پٹی ئے پچ بینا چرنگا بس پائیکنے بادشاہ بدرینے کہ ہن ہمو کچاری تولک دا ہنا دا پٹی بندغاتے ئے پٹی او سے اوٹ تو دا ہناڑے ہرا پائیکنے میہ بے شکتمک پائے ہاؤ پائے ہاں پائے وڑا دا سدنا دا ضعیفاک
en: ... the clothes ... walking around. Then the king said, 'Go, that council is sitting.' He went ... these people ... look here ... 'Tell me, ... without doubt ...' He said, 'Yes,' he said, 'yes,' he said, '... these women ...'
en_old: ... came ... the king said: go, that court is sitting; he tells the people... then look here, what did he say? ... yes, he said, yes, he said, these women...

brh: نورا غا خیر و خوشی اٹ سرمتنے مشکل ئے کہ نما ہم سنگ و برام مرے پومسوری آ ایلم دا ہند بننگا چوٹ چے ایلم دا نی سہی بننگٹی اوس ہچ سما تمپک اٹ خیرا بندغ
en: ... it has (not) arrived with goodness and happiness; it is hard for your engagement and wedding to take place too ... brother, coming to this place ... brother, are you hearing this properly? I can't make sense of anything, good man.
en_old: Now that you have arrived in peace and happiness, it is hard... may you also have companions... learn and come to this place... you were not understanding; I had no idea, good man.

brh: امر ایلو نا است ٹی جاگہ کیک، ولے زلی، دا تینا مون امر است ٹی جاگہ کیرہ، او ایڑ، ئے ہم سد وار کوشش کریٹ، ولے پیرو ء است آن تینا کشنگ کتوٹ، نی تو پیرو نا الکونے، نی کنا غم تے کم کرک، نا غم تے کم کروکا شار اٹی ئے ولے کنے خوشی تروک
en: How does one make a place in someone else's heart? But Zali, how do they make their faces find a place in the heart? Oh sister, I too tried a hundred times, but I could not get Piro out of my heart. As for you, Piro has taken yours; you lessen my sorrows. The one who lessens your sorrows is in the city, but the one who gives me happiness ...
en_old: Love makes a place in another's heart, but, Zali, it makes its face a place in the heart... I too tried a hundred times, but I could not pull myself out of Piro's heart; you are Piro's own; you lessen my sorrows; the one who lessens your sorrows is in the city, but the one who gives me happiness...

brh: گنداڑ خلق ٹی ئے او بوئے ڑے پیر صاحب دا نی انت مسونے؟ سائیں چھلہ کشنگ کے ناسس ئے کان جراہ تنتمہ مچٹ ئس چھرا انگ بستے
en: ... among the people ... Oh, Pir Sahib, what has happened to you? Sir, pulling off the ring ... a wound ... a little ... knife ... came ...
en_old: ... among the people ... Oh, Pir Sahib, what has happened to you? Sir, pull out the ring... from the ... the whole ... came.

brh: عجبو ئے تسی درو تو پیروم درختان تماسوس پیشیم تو تماسوس شام تو راغبس راس پاننگاتی سائیں پیشیم تو تماش شام تو سرمس
en: It's strange ... yesterday Piro too had fallen from a tree. He had fallen in the late morning, and in the evening ... I'm telling the truth, sir: he fell in the late morning and got here in the evening.
en_old: It is strange... the trees... in the morning it was finished, in the evening... I speak truly, sir; in the morning it was finished, in the evening it arrived.

brh: اسل ئے تے مئے پسا تینتون تینٹ ہیت کریسے ایننگٹی دا ہم خبر افتا کہ کسس کنے آن سوال ئس کننگٹی ہمرو زمانہ ئس بسونے ننا وختاتی تو اسل دن الوکا بزرگاتے احترامے کریرہ اوفتے اطاعت بنغورہ اوفتے گورے
en: Really, you are just talking away to yourself; you don't even know that someone is asking me a question. What times have come! In our day people truly respected their elders, obeyed them, and listened to them.
en_old: In fact you are talking to yourself; you don't even know that someone is asking you a question. What a time has come! In our days people respected the elders, obeyed them, and stayed with them.

brh: دوزخا ولے دا زمانہ ٹی بستی نی خالی صرف سوکارہ
en: To hell with it! But in this day and age you have turned up just empty, nothing but ...
en_old: To hell with it! But in this age you have come only for nothing.

brh: اسلام علیکم! وعلیکم السلام!
en: Peace be upon you! And upon you be peace!
en_old: Peace be upon you! And upon you be peace!

brh: خیریت صاحب؟ شیر خان جوانس؟ جی جی شکر ہی تو ہم جوانی؟ اسلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ شیر خان ئے باد آباد ہنی دروست کیسی
en: Is everything all right, sir? Sher Khan, are you well? Yes, yes, thank God. Are you well too? Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Sher Khan ... go and set it right.
en_old: Is everything all right, sir? Sher Khan, are you well? Yes, yes, thank God. Are you well too? Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Sher Khan, afterwards go and settle everything.

brh: نصب کنے یاد بننگٹی اف۔ خدانی بننگٹی اف شیر خان نا دوست کسے۔ ہو
en: I don't remember. By God, it isn't coming back to me. Some friend of Sher Khan's? Yes.
en_old: I don't remember half of it. By God, I don't. Sher Khan has no friend. Yes.

brh: بچ مچ کنے یاد بننگٹی اوٹ۔ نندول بو۔ نندوک چل زاتے؟ جی سر۔ نندوک چل زاتیس؟
en: Really, now I remember. Sit down. Will you sit? Yes, sir. Will you sit?
en_old: Truly, I was remembering. Sit down. Will you sit? Yes, sir. Will you sit?

brh: جیو! نم ہم کبو، تانکہ چابار نا چنا ہم پارے نن، نم تینا پگ ء سگھاتی کبو، ہراسی منزل ئس ء سرمارے رے، نما خدا کے نما نمسلال مارے رے، اسہ لوئے نما درست کیرے۔
en: Bravo! You do it too, so that the children of ... will also speak of us. Uphold your turban (your honour); whatever destination you reach, may God keep you safe, and may you build a single home of your own.
en_old: Bravo! You do the same, so that the children of Chabahar also say 'we'. Keep your turban on your shoulders; whatever destination you reach, may God be with you, may you have your son-in-law, may you all settle in one house.

brh: ئے ہم تینا ایڑا باوہ نا مچا وٹ گڑا ئے پینٹ چیچ لگیو دادے گم کرے گیا درک بلوم ئے نین گم ئے تولوک اوٹ سے ایم کو بلاو او مارا مسئلہ حل کرے اینا دے مسئلہ نا کس حل کپک
en: I too, (with) my sister and my father, all of us... then I... (my) pants... (and) lost it... I have no idea (?); I am sitting here in grief. Call the CM so he solves our problem. Today nobody solves anyone's problem.
en_old: He too, his father's whole... then he put on the pants... lost it... call the SHO, he'll solve our problem. No one will solve this problem.

brh: تودا توار کرے کہ ماڑی محلات نا مار ئنا و عیدا سہ گھناراڑی مرو نا و پئے ہو پئے ہا بس دا نہ چاکو نہ دیر کو بش مس واپس بس ہنارے وزیر وکیلاتے پارے کہ ئے نمے پاریٹ کہ بندہ ئس جوان و بھاز
en: Then he called out that the mansions and palaces are your son's... (unclear)... he said 'yes', he said 'yes'. But he took neither tea nor water; he got up and came back. He went and told the ministers and chancellors, 'I told you that he is a good man, and very...'
en_old: Then he called out that the son of the palace... he's the son of... He said, yes, he said, 'Enough, this is neither... nor...' he returned. Then he went and said to the ministers and advisers, 'I told you that this man is good and very...'

brh: انگوالو ہوشارو مرے دان منن بے عقل سلکنور ہیسنور شابا کنا مار کے پٹے بو پین بندغس گدرے آ بزیر وکیل آتے ئسیٹ تا ہنا دے ٹکا ئسیٹ دے کھیلے ماسیٹ دا طرف آ ئسیٹ دا طرف آ ہنا پٹے سا ئسیٹ سا خلٹ ہنا پیشنگا کسر ئسیٹ ہننگا ٹی اسکا چھنا منٹ
en: ...and clever he will turn out; don't (think him) foolish... (unclear). I order you: search for my son! Send another man.' (So the order went) to the ministers and chancellors: one went that day... one this way, one that way; they went searching. One went out onto the road; as one of them was going along, after a little while...
en_old: Be wise and alert, don't be foolish... Well done, my son... found... another man passed by, the ministers and advisers went; then he went that way, went this way, went that way, there he found him, he went, and in going out, in a little while...

brh: اسل کماں گوازی کیرہ کسرا اسل متی گیشترو سے ایلو مچٹ چناکو ہنو خنار موران دانا ہلیے تو چھمپاک نریار پائے نریبو ہلیس بریک تو ہنا بھلاتا پائے بابا ننے آنبارو انسان سے ہلی بے بندہ ئے کڑتنے نمانتے نریرے دا ہنا مسینا ہیتاتے بنگ دانا
en: On the road (children) were playing a game with bows (?); a great many of them, all the other little children, when they saw him from afar, ran off, saying, 'Run! He'll catch (you)!' When he came, the eldest of them said, 'Baba, he's a human being like us; the man won't catch (you). Why are you running away from him?' Hearing that girl's words...
en_old: They play on the road... all the children, when they see him they run after him, saying 'catch him!' They come running. His elders say, 'Father, he is such a person, don't catch him, he is a man...' hearing these words of his...

brh: استے ڈیلہ غا کے یار ہنا سمجھدار چنا سے بس ئنا ڈی ہلی ئے تورے پائے تہ خبر ادی نی دنا مسڑس پائے ئس بے قرار پارک مٹ خوافکو ہیٹی بنداس سکھ کھریا سے ہمو نا مسڑ اوٹی نشہ نا مسڑ اوٹی خلق نا نا
en: (It touched) his heart: 'Man, she is a sensible child.' So he took her (aside)... and said to her, 'Tell me, whose daughter are you?' She said... restless (?)... '(he is) a man with goats, a goatherd; I am his daughter, I am the daughter of... (unclear)... of the village (?)...'
en_old: One's heart... man, he is a sensible child. Just take him... saying 'don't tell'... his companions said, 'he's restless'... his friends are intoxicated, the people's...

brh: دانا رنگ و روپ لگارے اوستٹی تے یردہ ہناسے زیبا بندغ بیرے ہوشیار بیرے چھرا سے آخر چرینگیسا وی یک ہنا مسٹ ہنا چار ہنا باوہ نا وراٹی تو ہنا اینگوانی ئے بیتی نا مالا بس خوش مس یر بادشاہ نا وزیر ئس
en: Her complexion and looks pleased him in his heart: she is a beautiful person, she is clever... In the end, after wandering about... (he came) to her father's house... and he was simply delighted. (He was) one of the king's ministers.
en_old: His color and appearance pleased his heart; he's a handsome man, clever, ... in the end... his father's... then he was pleased with his goodness; he was a vizier of the king.

brh: بس نی داڑکے داڑکے ہمو کڑئی ہلک میتھس تڑی دعوت کرے تن حال حوال کرے ہریا ایتے خبر حوالاتی تو ارام پیشی من پئی ارغنا بادشاہ نا مار ہمو استسی داڑکے بندوبست پٹیور ہنا ناخنا چنکو مسے سری
en: So then, from here, he took him to that (house); he slaughtered a sheep and gave a feast for him; they exchanged greetings and caught up on news; he told him all the news. Then after rest and the meal, (he spoke of) the king's son... making arrangements here... his... little... (unclear)
en_old: Just... he took him there, invited him, they talked and exchanged news. He told him everything... then... the king's son... he made arrangements there... his... a little...

brh: ہنا مسٹ نن آ بسٹ ٹیلا گاگڑت سانگ بندی کسے تو تو تو نن آ بادشاہ نا مارے وقار ارا ئے غریب سے رگو ہٹ خوافے وا بادشاہ تو سانگ بندی کرے تو کنکے بھاز جوان مارو ٹھیک ئے را سانگ کے وا دعا خواہ آخر اٹ شاہ محمد لودی بس بادشاہ نا مبارکبادی تے سپائے نا
en: '...came to us... to arrange an engagement...' (He replied,) 'The son of our king has dignity; I am a poor man, only...' And the king then arranged the engagement: 'For me he is a very good boy; fine, arrange the engagement.' And they offered prayers; in the end... (unclear)... then the king's congratulations... the soldiers'...
en_old: His friend came to us... 'arrange the engagement'... 'We have the king's son's honor, he is poor...' The king arranged the engagement, saying 'he's a very good young man, alright, do the engagement.' With prayers, finally Shah Muhammad Lodi... the king's congratulations... the soldiers'...

brh: ہمارا سانگی کرین فلانا جاگہ پئے ٹھیک ہی آخیرڈ وری بادشاہ چیرفے وری ماڑی محلاتس جکہ ایڑ کے تفی تیار کرے مسد بے بس بھلم مس راہی مسور ہنا کا جن مس اینا رخت دان نکاحے ہلکر ہیس بستہ
en: 'We will hold the engagement at such-and-such place,' he said; 'fine.' In the end the king again... again had a mansion-palace prepared at a place over there... it became grand (?); they set out; the wedding took place... the goods... they performed the nikah, brought (her) and came.
en_old: They did our engagement at such-and-such place, fine. In the end the king again... another palace, he built there, prepared it... he grew up, set off, his wedding took place, they performed the nikah...

brh: بس ہما نرا دیمزی بادشاہ نا جند ہم پک مستمیکو دے ہنا مڑی وراٹی تو مکھناتہ ملخور تو بس بخیر کرے جاگہ شاہی کے تن پائے بادشاہ سلامت دیر چا کونس تین پائے لمہ کہ توت داڑے ہیتہ سرفیانے ورا دیر چا کونس
en: So then, on the third day, the king himself also (came)... to that house of hers... they welcomed (him) and made a royal place (for him); he said to him, 'Your Majesty, will you have water or tea?' He said, 'Mother, sit here... (and ask)... will he have water or tea?'
en_old: So there, before the king himself... that house... 'Take a seat, Your Majesty, where are you going?' He said, 'My wife is here... where are you going?'

brh: توس پینت بادشاہ سلامت پارک پائت خبر دا ماڑی محلات نائے یا کنا مار نا او پد بادشاہ سلامت ماڑی او محلات دا کہ کنا او باقی ئے ارے نا مار نا او اوکا مس دا تفنگ تف تو دا کم کے تفنگ
en: Sitting down, he said, 'Your Majesty, tell me: are these mansions and palaces yours, or my son's?' Then His Majesty (said), 'The mansions and palaces, these are mine, and whatever else there is is your son's.' ...then... this gun... tie... this... gun (unclear).
en_old: Sitting there he said, 'Your Majesty, tell me — these houses and palaces, are they yours or my son's?' Then His Majesty said, 'The houses, the palaces, whatever remains of mine belongs to my son...' This gun... this gun.

brh: دا کہ بس اڑو نا باقی ئے جند کنا کنے نا مار نا وٹ بادشاہ خوش مس گڑا دا سمیدار ئس بیارے بادوال ئس بیارے تینا دا تو سخن ار دا چا کرتست دیر کو بس بادشاہ دا سا خوشی قدرت دا بادشاہ نا مار ہنتس کہ شکار تو بادشاہ
en: 'This (being so), the rest... I myself... (belong) to my son.' The king was pleased. Then (he said), 'Bring a..., bring a...' (unclear)... he had given his word on this... who knows... So the king (was) very happy. As fate would have it, the king's son went off hunting... the king...
en_old: So that is the rest of it... the king was pleased with his son's words — 'bring a ... bring a ...' — he had given his word on this, who knows... so the king was very happy. As it happened, the king's son went off to hunt... the king.

brh: ہمو کس کہ شکار کرے کچھرنگا کہ جنگلاتا نینا ہمو سید خلکا کہ مرو خلکا کہ ازدی راہی مس ہفے توبک تینا راہی مس ہنا کہ ہلیسیا سوار مس پائیکاو شکار ہنا ہمو جنگلسا جنگل ٹھینگٹی اسہ کاسے سیدس مورانتا پیشنگا سندھ دریا پارتا ہرنی نن
en: That one, whoever goes hunting, roaming the forests, would shoot game... he set out; he took up his rifle and set out; he went and mounted a horse, saying, 'Let me go hunting'; he went into that forest, the dense forest... a game animal came out from far away, a doe from across the Sindh river (?)...
en_old: The one who went hunting, roaming in the forests, that hunter... each set out with his gun; he mounted his horse and went hunting. In those forests, in the dense jungle, he saw a hunter... beyond the Sindh river, deer...

brh: پارے پا ہن سید ددا توپک کشا کوپا مریفے توپک خلنگا تو سید زاں کرے پائے نوا خنیس کنے خلپیس خلقس درست بادشاہینی ہوشنگو یو دا حیرامنز یا اللہ دا سدا دائے دے کرے انت و جان آخر خولیس انپارے کنے مڑتو خلق تے سید تما
en: He said (to himself), 'Go on, (there is) the game'; he drew the rifle... when he was about to fire the rifle, the game animal spoke: 'Now that you have seen me, don't shoot me! I am truly a human being, (of) a royal (family)...' He was astonished: 'O God, what is this one doing?' ...In the end he got frightened. She said to him, '...me... dead (?)... the people...' ...the game animal fell (?)...
en_old: He said, 'Go now, Sayyid, draw the gun, don't be... in firing the gun.' Then the Sayyid said, 'If you see me, don't shoot me, all the people are the king's... O God, this... what and... finally he said, 'I'm dead, the people...' the Sayyid...

brh: اینا تھڑی صلہ جوڑ کرے ہفے راہی مس شام تما تن بیہم ہنا جنگل اٹ بننگاٹی ئے دوں کرے مونی ہرسیا کہ با کنا باوا لمہ تو مکھا ضعیفہ خن نت شپاز بننگاٹی ہنا جنگل اٹ
en: They came to an agreement (?); he took (it) and set out. Evening fell... While coming through that forest, he looked ahead and (heard): 'Oh, my father, my mother!' ...a woman, barefoot, coming through that forest at night.
en_old: Today they made the decision together and he set off. Evening fell... in that forest, as he came he looked ahead and... 'Oh my father, my mother,' ... an old woman... at night, coming into that forest...
