en: Is your honesty bad? Your elder [brother] fought a war for the homeland. Didn't he kill the enemy in the army? Is that bad, [unclear]?
en_old: Is your honesty bad? Your father fought for the homeland, killed the enemy in the army — is that bad, son?

brh: سکول ء پدا براہوئی ٹی نن کرے نن وائے دے داسے نن نبائے پنت نا دشمن
en: After school we did [it] in Brahui; we [unclear]... now we [unclear] the enemies of [unclear]...
en_old: After school we did it in Brahui; we... today we are not the enemies of the path.

brh: ناتے نن ملک نا مچائے پین دینا دشمناتے نن ملک نا مچائے پین
en: ...we will wipe [them] out of our country; the enemies of the faith, we will wipe them out of our country.
en_old: We will tell the whole country about them; we will tell the whole country about these enemies.

brh: کسکونس بچانوس؟ کسکونس بچانوس۔ نا ایلم نا کسپنگے کنے پچاس لاکھ روپئی ملانے۔ بے غیرت نی تینا پیسہ کے ایمانے تینا سودا کیس۔ ایمان ہمو دنیا نائے پیسہ تو دا دنیا نائے۔ دوننگا منافق۔
en: Did you die, or did you survive? Did you die or survive? I got fifty lakh rupees for killing your brother. Shameless! You traded away your faith for money. Faith belongs to the other world; money belongs to this world. Such a hypocrite.
en_old: Whom did you save? Whom did you save. For killing your brother I got fifty lakh rupees. Shameless man, you sold your faith for money. Faith belongs to the other world, money to this one. Both of you are hypocrites.

brh: ئے کیمہ نا مسٹ۔ انفائس۔ بائے۔ ایدے گرکسہ۔
en: I became [unclear]. [unclear]. Come. This [one], [unclear: take it?].
en_old: I was in the camp. Don't be afraid. Come. Take this.

brh: تینا واری ء ہمرو؟ دا سنی بچنگ نا پیچ ء۔ دا سنی پورا دنیا آتنکوادی سمجھی۔ ہرانکاس دا پولیس نا کنے لپس ء۔ ئے کلے خلوسٹ ٹملپارا راکنا زند ء تباہ کرینے۔
en: What about his own turn? This is the Sunni's trick for getting away. The whole world considers this Sunni a terrorist. Whatever this police [has against] me... I would have killed them all. [unclear] has ruined my life.
en_old: Is it your turn? This is your chance to escape. The whole world considers this terrorism. Whatever this police wants from me... I killed one, and in Tumlpara it ruined my life.

brh: خنے ہمبچنکا پیسہ لدرسا
en: Look, [all] this money [unclear].
en_old: Look, so much money is loaded here.

brh: ارے دا دیر تے
en: Hey, who is this?
en_old: Hey, who is this?

brh: ہر بو دا چکانا ودی مس
en: Look, this [unclear] has turned up.
en_old: Where was this child born?

brh: تارا دا سما کرے برزا کبزہ
en: Tara found out about this; up there, it is under [his] control.
en_old: Tara did this and took possession up there.

brh: ایرو کنا اراڑے سنور، خلپہ خلپہ ننا سنگت تاکوم، مدیرسس نا پندیرے، کنا پن شازدئے بے نوم دیرورے، ئے تارا اور دا جاگہ نا سردار اور، نا حال دے دوم کرے، تارا ایلے کنا بلو اسٹوری او
en: [unclear] where [unclear]... Don't shoot, don't shoot, our friends [unclear]... My name is Shahzad. And who are you? I am Tara, the chief of this place. Tell me your situation. Tara, brother, mine is a long story.
en_old: Who is here with me? Kill, kill, our friends... he didn't become... your path; my name is Shahzad, nameless... I am Tara, and the chief of this place, that's how things are; Tara, that is my story.

brh: وام دے خلک نی ننے انیٹی ڈکپننا سنگت آک ہم تارا ننا ملک نا پولیس آک ننا دونا حالت کریر نا گناہ کنا بلا ایلوم فوجٹی نا گناہ خلکو زند نا
en: [unclear] you... us; we won't hide anything: our friends too, Tara. Our country's police have put us in this state. Innocent: my elder brother was in the army. Innocent, and they killed [him]... [our] life...
en_old: Today you will kill us, our friends too, Tara; the police of our country have put us in this state. It's your fault — my brother was in the army — your fault, you killed him, his life...

brh: دا سنگت تا خلکور، ایلو ایلم ء کنا منوں سٹری خلکور، ایلو ایلم نا ریفنگ کنا ٹک، بھلا کنے ہم خلکور، ئے زور اٹ تینا جان ء بچفینٹ بسونٹ، دا ہم نی ہمبارو بندغ ئس او، ملک ئنا صورت آن خلاف او دا ہم، اینو
en: They killed these friends. They killed my other brother right in front of me; the other brother's [unclear]... my misery. Well, they shot me too. With great effort I saved my life and have come [here]. This one is also a man like you; he too is against the country's [government], today.
en_old: They killed these friends, they killed one brother right in front of me, the other brother's... they would have killed me too, I saved my life by force and came away. You are such a man too, against the face of the country, today.

brh: ئے نوم پدی شاہ زیب کس شاہ کا زندم ئس ہرف دادے تینا دشمن تے ختم کے۔ ئے نوم پدا کور نا سنگت آک لالے عمران نعمان۔ لالے دا ئے نوم پنو آ بھلا ہی گروپ۔
en: From now on, Shahzeb is dead and Shaka is alive. Take this and finish off your enemies. From now on your friends are Lale, Imran and Noman. Lale, this [unclear] is a big group.
en_old: My name is Shahzeb; nobody kills Shah... alive, take this and finish off your enemies. My name... the blind man's friends, Lala Imran, Noman. Lala, this is my name, the biggest group.

brh: پشتم شاکا کنے سمانی اناڑ کوس نا بچن نا کل کسگ بند مسونو عزت ارتے نی ننا حوالہ کر
en: [unclear] Shaka, [unclear]... All the roads for your escape have been closed. If you have any honor, hand yourself over to us.
en_old: ...me... all your escape routes are closed; if you have any honor, surrender yourself to us.

brh: شاباش نی بچنگ کپیسہ ہتھیار نا ننا دوٹی تکھا نی بچنگ کپیسہ شاباش نا قسمت سہی ہی اینو کاوے تو بین
en: Well done, you can't escape. Put your weapon in our hands. You can't escape. Well done, your luck is good today [unclear].
en_old: Bravo. You can't escape. Put the weapon in our hands. You can't escape. Bravo, your luck was good today.

brh: غلطیس مس۔ باز بلو۔
en: A mistake was made. A very big one.
en_old: A mistake was made. A very big one.

brh: غلطی ئس مس۔ اینے پارے سوٹ۔ زندگی نا مزہ بسٹریٹ ئس باز بلو غلطی ئس مس۔ شاہ کائلوم تتے نا وار خلتون۔ غلطی ایم نی کرے شاہ کائلوم تتے وار خلتوئے ئس
en: A mistake was made. I had told you. [unclear: the pleasure of life...]. A very big mistake was made. We didn't take our shot at Shaka. You made a mistake too: [we] had not taken our shot at Shaka.
en_old: It was a mistake. I told you. Enjoying life... it was a very big mistake. Shah Kailum, I took the turn. No, you made the mistake, Shah Kailum, you had taken the turn.

brh: شاہ زیب ہم شکانن جوڑ کریسو نا؟ اینے پاریسوٹ۔ آن پاریس کننے۔ اخن اخن بند کے۔ ئے تواسے پشتری ایراٹ سمجھوس۔ کننے دا چار پشتری ہم ایراٹ لگنگو۔ دا چار پشتری پت ئسیٹ سے۔ دا چار او۔ آخا دا ئسیٹ سے۔ نہ دا چار او۔ دا ئسیٹ سے۔ دا چار او نا۔ بس کبو۔ شکانہ گلاس کبو۔
en: Have you turned Shahzeb into Shaka too? I had told you. [And] you told me... Shut [it], shut [it]. You'd take one pastry for two. To me these four pastries also look like two. These four pastries are just one. These are four. Ah, this is one. No, these are four. This is one. These are four, aren't they? Enough, stop. Fill Shaka's glass.
en_old: Did you turn Shahzaib into a Shaka too? I told you. I told you so. Shut it down a little. You take those four as one. To me these four also look like one. These four are just one. These four... in the end this is one. No, these four. This is one. These four, no. That's enough. Make Shaka's glass.

brh: تا کہ شاکائے خلتنوٹ دا پشری کن یارا ورترا ننا ملک انڈیا ٹی استقبالے مصطفی پی
en: Until I have killed Shaka... for this [unclear], friend [unclear]... Welcome to our country, India, Mustafa.
en_old: So that I can catch Shaka for this... friend, brother, welcome to our country, India, Mustafa.

brh: انت حال و احوال؟ بیدار بیدار، نا انت حالے؟ اللہ نا احسانے، مرتولک
en: How are things? Wide awake, wide awake. How are you? By God's grace, [unclear].
en_old: How are you? Fine, fine. How are you? By Allah's grace, I'm still alive.

brh: تارا نا کاریم تون ننا صاحب آک ناخوش ء او مصطفی نا صاحب آتے گڑا امر خوش کین تارا تنیا نی تون خوش مفوسے گڑا تارا انت کہ چارا شاری لیکن نی تون بندغ ارے نا سے شاہر غا جان اتیرے او
en: Our bosses are unhappy with Tara's work. Mustafa, then how do we make your bosses happy? Tara, they won't be pleased with you alone. Then, Tara, what remedy [is there]? But you have men with you who would give their lives at a single signal from you.
en_old: Our bosses are unhappy with Tara's work. Mustafa, then how do we make the bosses happy? Tara, not only are they unhappy with you, so Tara, whatever it is... look, but there are people with you who would give their lives for the city.

brh: او توارے؟ نی ہمو بندغاتے بارڈر آن دنگ اتوئی تا۔ اتینا دا مسئلہ صاف خاص کر شاکاہ ئے۔ اوہو شاکاہ بارڈر نا نمے پر مشہور مس۔ او شاکاہ نا اخبار تک سے۔ کہ ئے ہکا۔
en: Is that his voice? You have to bring those men across the border. But this problem, especially, is Shaka. Oh ho, Shaka has become famous on your side of the border. Yes, Shaka is even in the newspaper. [unclear].
en_old: Is that his voice? You didn't send those people across the border. This matter of theirs is clear, especially Shaka's. Oh, Shaka became famous on your side of the border. There is even a newspaper about Shaka. That's true.

brh: کسہ غا دے بنگنون شیوٹم ئے خبر تیتم بنگنون اچھا شاکا این تانگا تو اینے نا تنن پاکستان اٹے تباہی کینے کبو کبو تباہی کبو تباہ کبو تے برو کافتاغا شاکا انڈیا غا
en: We have heard the story... [unclear] we have heard the news. All right, Shaka, [unclear]... destruction in Pakistan... Do it, do it, cause destruction, destroy! [unclear] Shaka will come to India.
en_old: I'll tell someone tomorrow... I'll inform you tomorrow. Okay, Shaka, if you go there I'll... you'll cause destruction in Pakistan. Do it, do it, cause destruction, destroy it, come on... Shaka ran off to India.

brh: وقتیس، نہ اوکا وقتی، اوکا پد، او مصطفی نی چٹانس، دانا نی بلو قیمت ئس ملیک، ٹھیک ئے مصطفی ٹھیک ئے نین کاو، ہا ٹھیک ئے ہن، و ایلو ہفتہ غا ملاقات مریک۔
en: Some time... no, not that time, after that. Oh Mustafa, you're a rock. You'll get a big price for this. OK, Mustafa, OK, I'll be going. Yes, OK, go, and we'll meet next week.
en_old: Some time; no, not now, later. Oh Mustafa, are you a rock? You'll get a big price for this. Okay, Mustafa, okay, we're going. Yes, okay, go, and we'll meet next week.

brh: جوان مصطفی
en: Good, Mustafa.
en_old: Good, Mustafa.

brh: دا بغیر بٹنگو کم ننا لخیٹی تما کنا اندازہ پائک ئنا چادانے ئنا کمپ چادانے کونیک
en: This uninvited one has just landed on our necks; my guess is he'll drink up your kettle, your cup, the whole kettle.
en_old: Without this tying, there's little for us here; my guess says that the camp has nothing there.

brh: گڑا بھچک نی بے فکر مر اوت خالی سوائی چانہ تروئی او مفت خورا گیرے نی واقعی کنے کھلی تا پنن الین تے کھننگ نی اسیتس پیرم پاوے نی ایلوم ہوشیار مرے
en: So, kid, don't you worry: he's only a beggar for tea, someone you have to give tea to; he's a freeloader. You really ... me ... to see ...; the old man says so too: you be careful of the other one as well.
en_old: So, kid, don't worry; he's just going to come empty-handed, he's a freeloader. You've really put me in a tight spot; you'll see, be careful of the other one too.

brh: ایلو او ارائیتے ایلو ہی دادے کیمبلے ئے ہونم بٹنگتنو ایڑے کھڑے سوموا دو خلنگلے پستے شار کستنے دمف بٹوتھرے ئنا پلیٹ نا تہی ادانی غم کپہ
en: The other one, that one, which one is he? The other one too, this one with the blanket, he hasn't been invited either. Standing over there ... don't touch ... then ... the bottom of your plate ... brother, don't you worry.
en_old: The other one, there, the other one too, this blanket also got tied; stand here, don't put your hands on it, don't break the city, then the plate's bottom... don't worry.

brh: اوئے سوت کل نن کنینے اڈا تے خاص او دتنے انتئے کہ او دے بٹنگتنو واکے دے باہنے کاریم کیک بے بٹنگ او کارینے ایہو نم باس کنیک شاری ہلیس کلے
en: Hey, we'll eat all the sweets ... especially him, because they haven't invited him; he does his work on some pretext; he has come uninvited; now he'll eat it hot; go on, take it all.
en_old: Hey, we'll all eat the sweets, especially that one — because today he got tied up; the one who works for the house, he does it untied; now you eat up, take the whole city.

brh: ٹیپ ئس تے تیرٹ کونیس نی اسل بے فکر مے ایلو ئے دادے کہ او بے وقتے تینا راہ تولفیس دنو محفلوک پوم افس تے نی پوم اریس تے دوم افس کہ ایلو
en: ... you'll eat; you be completely carefree. The other thing is that he set out on his way at the wrong time. Such gatherings, he doesn't understand them; you do understand them too, ... the other ...
en_old: I gave you a tape, you have nothing; you be completely worry-free; the other thing is that he set off on his road at the wrong time; these gatherings, you don't know them, you'll come to know, the other...

brh: شکر خان او دے ایلو سنگت ئتو تولنگ کے لپارتے او دے تینا ماسہ تولفے وی انتئے کہ اونا نصیب اٹ اڈ لکھوک ئس
en: Shakar Khan told him to sit with the other friends; he seated him beside himself, because it was written in his fate.
en_old: Shukr Khan, that day he went off with other friends; that day he took his mother along, because that was what was written in his fate.

brh: مارک او پاٹ ہتیر چائے کین، چا تیار مرے، ہوشیار کیس تنے، ہنا تینا رات اولی فیس، دمف میدان خالی کے، بے فکر
en: Boys, bring that pot, let's make tea; the tea will be ready. Be on your guard; go ... your way first; then he'll clear off the field. Don't worry.
en_old: Mark, drink your tea, the tea is ready; I've warned you; go take your first night; then the field is clear, don't worry.

brh: اومے او دے آخیر ٹی موچا تتوے بالکل ہنن کیس انتئے کہ او بٹنگ تانو بے بٹنگنگان ہر دے روانے اینو کہ دا سزا ملاتے دوبارہ بے بٹنگنگا کسے تو ہمفرو
en: Yes, in the end he ... — you did exactly right, because they hadn't invited him, and he goes around uninvited every day. Now that he has been given this punishment today, nobody will go uninvited again.
en_old: Yes, in the end that day I made him exactly so, because he was tied, and the untied one walks about every day; now that he's gotten this punishment, if he goes about untied again, then so be it.

brh: انتئے کہ سلیسوس؟ میر صاحب ئے دا وجہ آن سلیسوٹ، خیرات دیناسک کنے تو برام نا بٹنگ تنو۔ گڑا ہمہ کین؟ میر صاحب! پین ہیچ کپے، کنا کڑئے پنج شش کڑئے بادشاہٹ
en: Why have you been standing there? — Mir Sahib, I've been standing for this reason: they're giving out charity, but they haven't invited me to the wedding. — Then what should I do? — Mir Sahib! Don't do anything else; my ... five or six ... royally.
en_old: Why are you standing? Mir Sahib, I'm standing for this reason: I was given charity, but I haven't tied the marriage knot. So what should I do? Mir Sahib! Do nothing else; my five or six... kingdom.

brh: تو جوان زیبا فوٹو ہلیس۔ مخلوق کے کرے فوٹو تے نشان تیوی۔ پاو تھارے دانگ او بو۔ کنے کرے برام بٹنگ تھوس ولہ منٹ بعد شتو فوٹو ہلکوٹ۔ واہ رے واہ نی تے پورا او ٹکو سیوس۔ میر صاحب نی پاس یا پاپیس ننے او نم ٹکو ہریس۔
en: So take a nice, beautiful photo. The people ... show all the photos. ... come over here. If they had invited me to the wedding, I'd have taken a photo a minute later. Wow, oh wow, you've ... the whole piece. Mir Sahib, whether you tell us or not, you'll see that piece.
en_old: Then take a nice, beautiful photo. People will mark the photo. Stay still, come here. If I'd tied the marriage knot, I'd have taken a photo a minute later. Wow, oh wow, you've taken the whole piece. Mir Sahib, whether you say so or not, we'll see that piece of yours.

brh: رحمت اللہ خان سنگت آتے ہورین چائے کریر یا کتبس
en: Rahmatullah Khan, let's check on the friends: have they made tea or not?
en_old: Rahmatullah Khan, look, make tea for the friends — or have you already made it?

brh: برباد آ ایلو ہیت، دا تو برام نا بٹنگ تنے۔ دا عجیب و بندغ او، برام نا بٹنگ پسہ دم یلہ او۔
en: Damn, that's another matter — this one hasn't been invited to the wedding. He's a strange man: no wedding invitation, and still he's completely at ease.
en_old: Ruined... another matter: this one has tied the marriage knot. He's a strange man; after tying the marriage knot, he's let go of it.

brh: دا سہ نی ہور دا دا امر سلے کشوئے ہاؤ خوارزادہ ہاؤ دا تتو سلے کشوئے مریکک ماما دا سہ
en: Now look, look how this one is taking a selfie. — Yes, nephew, yes. — This one is going to take a selfie too, it's happening, uncle, look now.
en_old: Look at this, this one has taken a selfie. Yes, nephew, yes. This one has taken a selfie too, uncle, look at this.

brh: کنیورے سئے اوفتہ امر ئسیٹ ئسیٹ اسلے کشو گل ناتھ اسلے کشپہ گڑاسہ کنکیلے ایم گڑاسینا اسلے کشو ماما نی با سلے کشانس داسہ کنا نمبرے نی نمبر باز ڈسنٹ داسہ گڑاسہ کنکیلس ہاو
en: ... look at them, how they take selfies one by one. Gul Nath, don't take a selfie, then cancel it. I'll take a selfie of something too. Uncle, have you taken a selfie? Now it's my turn. Your number is very decent. Now cancel it, yes.
en_old: I'll do it. Look, each of them takes a selfie one by one; Gul Nath takes a selfie, then some others take selfies. Uncle, you've taken a selfie too? Now my number — your number is very decent. Now some of them, yes.

brh: او ماما ہاؤ واقعی کہ کنا خوارزادہ او نی۔ دا جوان پولیس برامسی ٹھیٹ
en: Oh uncle, yes, truly you are my nephew. This is a fine, proper police wedding.
en_old: Oh uncle, yes, you really are my nephew. This fine policeman has come here.

brh: سنگت نی کنا سنگت ئس ئے دا بامرادی گڈنا سواری خزمتی
en: Friend, you're a friend of mine; after the happy occasion, this ride is at your service.
en_old: Friend, you are my friend; this is Bamuradi, the service of the last ride.

brh: ہنا سواری کھڑنا ارے، متنا ارے، ہر قسم نا سوٹ جی غواہ کو، ہنو ٹیٹ کونیس، ہنو ٹیٹ کونیس، کوننگا ڈیچو کمی کپیس، ہنو کون ہنو کون ٹیٹ کون، خرا سامبا پلوکاتے نی تا کہ انتک نی بھٹک، پائیسئی تھیوا، ایونا پنساری ئے تھیوا
en: That ride is ...'s, it's ...'s. Every kind of sweet, whatever you want. Eat this, eat this, don't hold back on eating at all; eat this, eat this, eat ...; ... what is it that you ...; I'll give the money, I'll give it to his grocer.
en_old: That ride is a donkey's, a mule's; every kind of suit, whatever you want. Eat this, eat this, don't cut down on eating; eat this, eat this, eat this. What is it that you have brought? What are you? Pay the money, give it to the grocer.

brh: کنا پیسہ غاک کنے دنا نا دا خیالے کیس کہ دنا نا پین ہچ ہرا سست خلتو، ٹھیک ہی بشا، ہنا خیالے کیس، چنا پیالہ کم ہفینن، نن چا کنن، نیک شانہ نیم تنے
en: My money ... you made me think this about the world: that nothing else in the world comes cheap. Fine, all right — you had that idea: let's pick up a small cup, we'll drink tea, and ... half.
en_old: My money... I had this thought about the world, that nothing else in the world is cheap. Fine, all right, I had that thought: let's take a small cup, let's drink tea, give half of it.

brh: ٹھیک ہی ماما ٹھیک ہی السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ چائے زوت تیار کرے رپنگٹی ہورے او میر صاحب چاس ماشاءاللہ ٹائٹ او
en: Fine, uncle, fine. — Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace. — Mashallah, mashallah, he got the tea ready quickly; look at it ..., oh Mir Sahib, the tea is, mashallah, strong.
en_old: Okay uncle, okay. Peace be upon you. And upon you peace. Mashallah, mashallah, make the tea quickly. Look at the pouring, Mir Sahib, the tea is, mashallah, strong.

brh: میر صاحب تول بو چاس باز جوان مسنے۔ میر صاحبے ئے کنے ہمے مٹہ والا کپ اٹ چا کنوئے؟ ہئو ادا ہئو اینے اوستی پڑ کننگٹی کمی کپا۔ فی الحال ئے چا کننگٹو۔
en: Mir Sahib, sit down, the tea has turned out very well. — Mir Sahib, I have to drink my tea from that clay cup. — Yes, brother, yes, ... don't skimp on filling it. — For now I'm drinking tea.
en_old: Mir Sahib, sit down, the tea has turned out very well. Mir Sahib, will you give me tea in that clay cup? Yes, brother, yes; don't fall short in pouring it. For now I'm drinking tea.

brh: دا مالٹا والا کپ گھنٹے سے پد فارغ مریک۔ دا کپ کن ایرا گھنٹہ م انتظار کیوے۔ نی تو واقعی چانہ دیوانہ بندغ اسیس۔ ہن نمف جمپ تے سے نا کپ ہلیس۔ نہ نہ جمپ تفر۔
en: This orange cup will be free after an hour. — I'll wait two hours for this cup. — You really are a man crazy about tea. Go, take someone's cup over there. — No, no, don't jump the line.
en_old: This orange cup will be free after an hour. I'll wait two hours for this cup. You really are a man crazy about tea. Go, take a cup from the ones over there. No, no, don't jump.

brh: ارے کپہ کے انتظار کیوے، ہدا چائے چاکوم، ہاؤ چنا ہاؤ، اسیکہ نن چائے کونین ولدا نیم چائے تنین
en: Hey, I'll wait for the cup. There, pour the tea — yes, a little, yes. First we'll drink tea, then we'll give out half the tea.
en_old: Hey, I'll wait for the cup; here, pour the tea; yes, a little, yes. First we'll drink tea, then we'll give half the tea.

brh: ادا کنے ایرا چاتی تیویرے ایلم نی فلاح
en: Brother, will you give me two teas? Brother, bless you.
en_old: Brother, will you give me two teas? Alam, you go ahead.

brh: اول کپا کن انتظار کے کپ پارا ٹائم فارغ مرے ٹھیک ئے بابا دیر تے خدا گھنٹے سے پین انتظار کینہ پھرا کین ادا دا سے کپ خالی مسونے ئے مت نی داس کا
en: First wait for the cup; the cup, they say, will be free in a while. — All right, father, it's late; by God, we'll wait another hour. ... Brother, this cup has become empty, now you go ahead.
en_old: First wait for the cup; the cup will be free in a while. Okay, father, it's late, by God we'll wait another hour. Brother, this cup has become empty, now you...

brh: گھنٹس تو پین گدرینگا۔ او ادا کپ خالی مس داس چا شاغوکنا۔ فی الحال چا کنبو ولا نما علاج جوان کیوے۔
en: Another hour has passed. — Oh brother, the cup is empty; now I'm going to pour the tea. — For now drink your tea, then I'll take good care of you.
en_old: Another hour has passed. Oh brother, the cup is empty, now I'll pour the tea. For now drink tea, then I'll treat you well.

brh: ایلم دا مکرے سرے چا مچک کن کیسوس ادا نی ایرا گھنٹہ انتظار کیس سنگتک چا تے کنغور بچائے نا ناک وا
en: Brother, you pulled this trick for a little tea; brother, you waited two hours. The friends will drink the tea ... what's left.
en_old: Alam, you've had tea from this cup; brother, you waited two hours. Friends, drink the tea, let it not go to waste.

brh: باقی کہ پیرنگک پارہ کرے انتظار باز خراب گڈاسی اگر کہ دا مالٹا والا کپ کہ انتظار کتا وٹی چا باز کونگوٹے او تینا مقدر ئے پا ننے ہرا انت گلا کھسے تینٹ پاریس ئے انتظار کیو ایرا گھنٹے پاریس دا مالٹا والا کپ کنے باز وڑانے او ایلو سئی پاسے ہرا بنہ کہ
en: As for the rest, the elders used to say waiting is a very bad thing. If he hadn't waited for this orange cup, he'd have drunk plenty of tea. He should blame his own fate; what complaint can he have against us? He himself said, 'I'll wait,' two hours; he said, 'I really like this orange cup,' and the other side, which ...
en_old: As for the rest, the elders said waiting is very bad; if one has waited for this orange cup, I drank a lot of tea; he told his own fate, whatever it is. He says himself, 'I'll wait, two hours,' he says, 'this orange cup is very dear to me, the other ones...'

brh: پسند کیک اونا علاج کرے ہن مریگا ادا زو کن ہمو زرایت نا گلوم کا کان ٹائم ہنا
en: He likes it; take care of him. Go on, it'll be fine; brother, do it quickly, that farm's ... time to go.
en_old: He likes it; treat him, go on, brother, quickly, that farm wheat... the time for it.

brh: وارزادہ بسس؟ ہاؤ ماما بسٹ
en: Nephew, have you come? — Yes, uncle, I've come.
en_old: Nephew, have you come? Yes uncle, I've come.

brh: سٹھاو، انت حوال اسے سوس؟ حوال دادے ہمبل آک چاس کریر کنگر ہموکان پیشتمار۔ او ادا، ہنا ہیتے، او ماما او ہنا ہیتے بالکل، پین پوسکونو ہیت میت؟
en: Good. What news have you brought? — The news is that those people made tea, and then they came out of there. — Oh brother, that's the thing. — Oh uncle, that's exactly it. Any other new news or anything?
en_old: Sit down, what news have you brought? The news is that the Hambal folks made tea, from them it was presented. Oh brother, that's the talk. Oh uncle, that's the talk, absolutely. Any other fresh news?

brh: بٹ تنے ہاں آخا شکا نکس پیزے سے کس پیزے شکا ہمپا دھا شئیٹا خلتہ او خلے بے پا خل بوتا سلو گنوک سر پا سلو گنوک
en: But yourself... yes, right? ...nobody... anyone... say that too... he hit him, and he hits... say it... hit! ...Stop, you madman! Then say: 'Stop, you madman!'
en_old: ...yes, Shaka... nobody... Shaka... he threw stones at him... stone... unfortunate... (unintelligible)

brh: پا گولی سینٹ تخا بجا دا ٹنگر تخا پا ٹنگر تخا بجا پا گولی سینٹ گولی سینٹ تخا بلپا ئے نا ٹنگر ملتے نربو داسے پاتہ داسے ہم پاتاں پا نربو نربو
en: Say: 'He put the bullet in...' this trigger... say: 'He put the trigger...' say: 'He put the bullet in, put the bullet in'... his trigger... 'Run!' Now say it, now say it to them too, say: 'Run, run!'
en_old: Say it... bullet... this... say it... bullet... run away, now say it, now you say it too, run, run.

brh: دا ہرا وخت ء؟ مخل، کنے لغت ئس بٹنگا، دونمبرا مانا لغت ئس تس، دا ہرا خننگ ء؟ دا ہرا خلے استے؟ سیدھا خننگ ئس
en: What kind of timing is this? Don't hit — a kick landed on me, and the second one gave me a kick too. What kind of looking is this? What kind of hitting is this? A straight look!
en_old: What time is it? Makhal, you told me one thing, number two gave me another... what is this you're looking at? What are you staring at? Look straight ahead.

brh: دا دا سنتے دا پستول ئے دا دا دا کے سورے ونے دا مونا مونا واری ئے ملتا ہا ہا فیرو ہا ایکشن
en: This, this... this pistol, this, this, this... sorry... this — forward, forward... the turn... yes, yes, fire, yes, action.
en_old: This, this one, this pistol, this... yes, put it on, this one in front, first turn... got it, yes yes, fire, yes, action.

brh: دہشت گرد آتہ تلاطم جنگے شاہ شاٹ ٹو دہشت گرد آتہ تلاطم دہشت گرد سوری یار شاٹ فور ایکشن جنگ
en: The Terrorists' Turmoil, war... shot two. The Terrorists' Turmoil, terrorists... sorry, man. Shot four, action, war.
en_old: The terrorists' turmoil, war... shot two, the terrorists' turmoil, terrorists... sorry, man, shot four, action, war.

brh: دا زئی مکھا، دا زئی مکھا، اوئے بڈھامان، سالہ سالہ، چپ، سالدا
en: Don't do this, don't do this! Hey, old man! Bastard, bastard! Shut up, bastard!
en_old: Don't do that, don't do that, hey old man, you rascal, rascal, quiet, rascal.

brh: خالد تخستہ، خدا کے، چپ
en: Khalid, put it down; for God's sake, quiet!
en_old: Khalid ran off, by God, quiet.

brh: بر علی جم بسس؟ ہاؤ ایلم بسوٹ۔ بسس جوان کریس دا زرنج ء در کنے مچے کار ء مرے ٹھیک ایلم ٹھیک۔
en: Welcome, Ali, did you arrive all right? Yes, brother, I've come. You came, good of you. Take this Zaranj [loader rickshaw] for me; I have a little work to get done. Okay, brother, okay.
en_old: Hey Ali, did you arrive safely? Yes, Ilam, I've come. You came, good that you came; take this car out for me so it gets done. Okay, Ilam, okay.

brh: علی جان ننے سوب نا پٹنگ آٹون اراڑے مسونس؟ اناڑے مسونٹ نراگ اینانو۔ دا پاکے برام نا بٹنگ آٹونے آخا؟ آ واوا کنے برام نا بٹنگ اینانو۔ برام نا؟
en: Ali Jan, we've been searching for you since morning; where have you been? I've been right here... [unclear]. Tell me, have they invited you to the wedding or not? Oh yes, they've invited me to the wedding. To the wedding?
en_old: Ali Jan, since telling us about the matter, where have you been? I haven't been anywhere, I'm telling you now. Is it the wedding you're telling about? Yes, father, I'm telling you about the wedding. The wedding?

brh: ہما کے بٹنگانو نی برکاں داڑے انت سورے سے ایلم برام آ چنانے ہنینگ بسنے لیکن ئے بسنٹ تو ڈر علی جانے برام آ زرنجے نن سنبھالینہ پین ہما ٹھیک ہی ایلم نما مہربانی نم زرنجے سنبھالے بو
en: That's what I mean — since they've invited you, come, let's go. What's the problem here, brother? The boy has come to go to the wedding, but since I've come, take Ali Jan to the wedding; we'll look after the Zaranj. Anything else? That's fine, brother, thank you; you look after the Zaranj.
en_old: That's what I'm telling you, you come here... what's with you? Ilam, the children have come to go to the wedding, but if I've come then... we'll handle the car for Ali Jan's wedding, alright? That's fine, Ilam, thank you, you take care of the car.

brh: یلی جانے دے وکھانہ برامہ ٹھیک ہی ادن ایو علی جانے بو برامہ نو اللہ نگہبان علی جان راہیمہ خان
en: Ali Jan... the wedding... fine then... take Ali Jan to the wedding. God protect you, Ali Jan; off you go, Khan.
en_old: Ali Jan, it's your day, the wedding, fine then. Ali Jan, come, go to the wedding. God be your protector, Ali Jan, Rahim Khan.

brh: شہزاد خیر دین آ برام آ بٹنگانو نی آخا؟ ہاؤ شکر خان بٹنگانو کنے۔ اگر بٹنگانو نی گڑا زو کر کان ہریت امانے نی خبرے منزلم مرے گرمی بازے داسا خیت کرے ننے۔
en: Shahzad, have they invited you to Khair Din's wedding or not? Yes, Shukr Khan, they've invited me. If they've invited you, then hurry up, let's go... the destination too... The heat is intense; it's already drenching us in sweat.
en_old: Shahzad, has Khair Din told you about the wedding? Yes, Shukr Khan, he's told me. If he's told you, then make it quick so we reach the destination; the heat is intense now, it's already made us sweat.

brh: کان کہ ہورے تمنگ نی کان سرمری۔ او شکر خان، کامبو رائی موبو۔ دا مونی مینوئی ننے بھلو منزل سے کان سرمری۔ ہورے تمنگ نی دے بھانتس بوڑزا برے گرمی بڑھائنگٹی سرمری خیرٹ۔ السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ بر مرے
en: Let's go, because we're getting late; let's go so we arrive. Oh Shukr Khan, go on, set off. Ahead of us is a long journey; let's go so we arrive. We're getting late, the sun is climbing high, the heat is rising; we'll arrive safely. Peace be upon you. And upon you peace. Welcome.
en_old: Where will it be... you'll die of thirst and heat. O Shukr Khan, don't go on foot. This way we have a big destination ahead of us, you'll burn. You'll die of thirst, the day is getting higher, the heat has increased, you'll burn, alright. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Come along.

brh: میر رسول بخش بر بسس خیرٹ۔ ہو شکر خان ہو بسس۔ میر رسول بخش بسس جوان مس کہ کامبورا ہیمور لیٹ مس۔ ہو ادا واقعی منزل مورے رائی مرو کامبورا ہیمت ممی۔
en: Mir Rasool Bakhsh, come, welcome. Yes, Shukr Khan, yes, I've come. Mir Rasool Bakhsh has come — good, because we were getting late. Yes, this destination really is far; let's set off, go on, get moving.
en_old: Mir Rasool Bakhsh, come, did you arrive safely? Yes, Shukr Khan, yes, I came. Mir Rasool Bakhsh, it's good you came; we got late going on foot. Yes, this really is a long way, going on foot won't do.

brh: خیر ئے ادا نی ہرا کا بسوس؟ ئے تو نما کا بسٹ نم داپا ورا ہننگٹی ارے ادا جوان مس کہ بسوس، نن تو ہننگٹی آن خیر دین نا برام آ۔ نی بٹنگاتو؟ بٹنگتو دا وار۔ ایلم کنے بٹنگتنو۔
en: Well, where have you come from? I came from your place; you're heading this way. Well, it's good you came — we're going to Khair Din's wedding. Didn't they invite you? They didn't invite me this time. Brother, they haven't invited me.
en_old: Well, where have you come from? I came from your place; you said we're going there... it's good that you came, we're going to Khair Din's wedding. Have you been told? I've been told this time. Ilam, I've been told.

brh: اینوں تو سٹی بریوے، نیک بٹنگ تنو ادا گڈنی بریسنت سے کے، ایلوم برے نہ کونی کے پیرنت سے کے برے نہ، عجیب و بندغس ئس بٹنگ تنو نی سٹی کوننگ کے بریسے، ایلوم کنے بٹنگ تنو اینوں تو بریوے، بر ادا نی
en: Today I'd just come like that... they haven't invited you, so you'll come afterwards... brother, won't you come? ...won't you come? You're a strange man — they haven't invited you, and you'll come along to eat just like that? Brother, they haven't invited me, but today I'll come anyway. Come on then, you.
en_old: Now you've come to the city; we told you nicely, you came from here, Ilam, come, don't... you're a strange person, we told you to come to the city, Ilam, I told you, now you've come, come here, you.

brh: میر رسول بخش ٹھیک نا باز مہربانی ادا ئے تو باز مس زہرائی مبو خان دا شو مسل پھٹنا خلوک اسے مبو خان
en: Mir Rasool Bakhsh, fine, thank you very much. Well, that's plenty now. Don't get angry, Khan... this... [unclear]... don't be like that, Khan.
en_old: Mir Rasool Bakhsh, fine, thank you very much. Yes, that was a lot. Don't get angry, Khan; this one is like someone who strikes with a stone... don't, Khan.

brh: خیرات دے نا وی میمان تے خدائے دیت کے ہورے کریرے۔
en: Guests of the feast day — by God, you've been late.
en_old: May God grant that the guests of the feast day be taken care of.

brh: مارکو لے خیر دین داڑے سلف تنے نما کسرہ جی او میر صاحب کنے خیر دین سلففینے نما کسرہ اندا سدا موٹرسائیکلاتے مونی کسر ارے افک میر صاحب موٹرسائیکلاٹ مونا ایم پسا مونا پندٹی نوتمک مارکو موٹرسائیکلاتے گڑا داڑے سلففین
en: Boys, hey — did Khair Din have you stop here on your road? Yes, Mir Sahib, Khair Din had me stop on your road. Is there a road straight ahead for the motorcycles? There isn't, Mir Sahib; ahead it's a footpath, the motorcycles won't get through there. Boys, then let's park the motorcycles here.
en_old: Marko, Khair Din, did you park here in our row? Yes, Mir Sahib, Khair Din made me park in your row; here the motorcycles are in front, there's no row, Mir Sahib; the motorcycles are in front, on the road ahead... Marko, then park the motorcycles here.

brh: موٹر سائیکلا تے دا درخت نا کیران سلف بو۔ دا موٹر سائیکلا تے گڑا دا کن کس دپکک۔ نوم بے غم مابو موٹر سائیکلا تے داڑے کس دو خلپک۔ خیردین نا کلے خبرے۔ ٹھیک ہی گڑا سنگموٹ تے سلف بو نا رے۔ جائی پاسی رے منا سلفین تا گڑا نوم پیدل کامو۔ ادا کرے ایون دم بٹنگ ترو۔
en: Park the motorcycles near this tree. Then nobody will take these motorcycles. Don't you worry, nobody will lay a hand on the motorcycles here; everyone knows Khair Din. Okay then, park the... and... Let's park them first, then you go on foot. Well... they haven't invited us.
en_old: Park the motorcycles beside this tree. Then nobody will touch these motorcycles. Don't worry, nobody will take the motorcycles from here. Everyone knows Khair Din. Alright then, park them by the stone and go. Everybody go, after parking go on foot. We've done it, we've told you.

brh: نی تو عید کننگ نا حق کپک ادا ہمت کو موٹر سائیکل ء سلفبو گڑا کاہن ٹھیک ہی ادا ہمت کبو کاہن بو
en: You don't even have the right to celebrate Eid. Well, go on, park the motorcycle, then let's go. Okay, well, go on, let's go.
en_old: You don't have the right to celebrate Eid... here, have courage, park the motorcycle, then come. Alright, here, have courage, then come.

brh: او چھوٹے دا چا زن مازن ارے پھل کاک چا مس کنے گڑا کن۔ ہاو اڑے زی ارے ہمڑے چانس کین کنے۔ ہا ٹھیک ہی جو ہمڑے چانس کنے گڑا کن۔
en: Hey, Chhotu, is this tea... ready? If the tea's done, then make me some. Yes, there's some up there; get me a tea from there. Yes, fine, get me a tea from there, then make it.
en_old: Hey, boy, is this tea boiling over there? Has the tea been made? Then make some for me. Yes, there, from yesterday — give me that same chance. Yes, fine, do that same chance for me.

brh: ہن خانے سہ ماما برام کنو کدو موٹر سائیکل اٹی خوارزادہ فکر تے کپہ او برامی کننگ کپہ سہ ننوفتے کنینا
en: Go... uncle, he'll get married... on the motorcycle. Nephew, don't worry, and don't go getting married... we'll eat them up.
en_old: Go to the house... Uncle, we'll get married; when on the motorcycle... Nephew, don't worry, he's not going to get married, he'll just eat us up.

brh: واہ ماما واہ نی ہم کنا وڑنا بندغ اسس مچے ہنا دے چہرہ نا خالی چینج خوارزادہ او ہیت ہم ئے چاوہ کنا کچا نی مننگ کپسہ انتئے کہ نی آن مچے زو
en: Wow, uncle, wow! You too are a man just like me — only a little... only the face has changed. Nephew, I know that too: you can't measure up to me, because [I'm] a little quicker than you.
en_old: Wow, uncle, wow, you're a man just like me; only the face today is a little different. Nephew, that's exactly it; see, you can't keep up with me, because I'm quicker than you.

brh: زیباء خننگیوہ، ماما او ہیتے تو شیشہ پائک ئے زیباء خننگیوہ، آخر کہ نی تینے شیشہ ٹی ہرس، نا زیبائی کنے آن کم مئے، ماما مچ قرار ہیت کر، شیشہ نا مون ہنو ہیت کرے شیشہ۔
en: I look beautiful. Uncle, that's just what the mirror says: I look beautiful. After all, when you look at yourself in the mirror, your beauty would be less than mine. Uncle, talk a bit more calmly; go in front of the mirror, the mirror will tell you.
en_old: I look beautiful. Uncle, that's just what the mirror says — I look beautiful. After all, if you look at yourself in the mirror, your beauty is no less than mine. Uncle, don't talk like that; go stand in front of the mirror, the mirror will speak.

brh: خوارزادہ ئے تے الے کان دفتران دے ہورین کہ ارانگ ہنار ہاو ماما کان رسینگن تا شام آ ماما نی پین ہمروس اناڑے خننگوس کنے ہمروس
en: Nephew, leave this; let's go and look from the office to see where they went. Yes, uncle, let's go; we'll get there by evening. Uncle, how are you otherwise? You look like this to me — how are you?
en_old: Nephew, I'll go and look at the office, where he went. Yes, uncle, go, reach there by evening. Uncle, you're the same as before; that's how you look to me, just the same.

brh: سنگت آک، اشتہ ہنا دے زو کبو چاکم او نڑ کونی گڑا کان۔ او میر او گڑا سنگت ہر مبو کامو پاٹکی۔
en: Friends, quick, hurry up today; drink the tea and the rest, then let's go. Oh Mir, oh, then, friends, every one of you, go for firewood.
en_old: Friends, get up, hurry today; look, he has nothing, so go. He's the Mir, so friends, be ready, let's get to it.

brh: چوچو چا داری کنے تے نومیں بپاٹ سے کے
en: Chhotu, bring the tea to me... [unclear].
en_old: Hey, little one, bring the tea over here to me... (unintelligible).

brh: شہزاد یار آک پاٹہ ستیر چانس گڑا جوانو کیس کاٹوم نانا خلٹ کنے ٹائیٹ مرے شکر خان نی بے فکر مے انو چاس کے وطن نی کاٹوم نانا خلٹم کائک باز جوانو ایتس
en: Shahzad, friends, [get] the firewood and make a good tea then; I've got a headache — [it'll] set me right. Shukr Khan, don't you worry; now this tea... your headache will go away too; it does a lot of good.
en_old: Shahzad, friends, look at the chance and make it good; keep my family's hold tight for me. Shukr Khan, don't worry; now you'll see, the family's hold is very good indeed.

brh: کرس، کنا کاٹم نا خرچ دا ساہیان ایننگٹی نا ایتا تان۔ آزادی نا چخ بکال نا چکرس خلمے اسہ گال ئس کچا۔ ٹھیک ئے میر۔ چخ آزادی۔
en: Do it... my head's expense... from this... I'll give... The taste of freedom... one word... Fine, Mir. The taste of freedom.
en_old: Do it; the expense of my household, I'll give it... Free the neck, don't say a word about it. Fine, Mir. Freedom of the neck.

brh: ئے شاکا او شاکا دا بس صبا مسونے نا پیری داڑے پوداڑا نا پیری داڑے پولوک نوما زادوریمبو
en: Hey Shaka, oh Shaka, that's it, it's morning now; your coming and going here ... your coming and going here ...
en_old: Hey Shaka, oh Shaka, it's just become morning; is your old man here, or is your old man there? ... your people...

brh: ناصر تپیس؟ او شاکم۔
en: Don't you know Nasir? Oh, Shaka.
en_old: Did you find Nasir? Oh, Shakam.

brh: ہلو دارا ہلو وا کنا شے دارا او ئے تینا کاریمے کریٹ ٹھاکر نا ایلم ایلکو نون ئے تینا کاریمے کریٹ داسی تینا کاریمے کیو ہاو تارا نی ثنا تون تینا سودائے خلک
en: Hello Tara, hello, oh my ... Tara. Oh, I have done my job; Thakur's brother ... I have done my job, now I'll do my own work. Yes, Tara, you've struck your deal with Sana.
en_old: Hello Dara. Hello, where are my things, Dara? I have done my work; Thakur's... I have done my work, now I'll do my own work. Yes, Tara, you settle your deal with Sana.

brh: ہا ٹھیک کنے بے غم خا، ایدا ثناء غریب کیوے۔ ہیلو ثناء، ہیلو سارہ۔ چاکور نی رم نا کوزہ ٹی۔
en: Yes, okay, don't worry about me; here, I'll make Sana poor. Hello Sana, hello Sara. Thakur, you are in Ram's custody.
en_old: Yes, okay, don't worry about me. Here, Sana is calling. Hello Sana, hello Sarah. Chakor, you're in Ram's pot.

brh: زارا! ناصر ادا گڈاس مس نا خیر اف۔ فوجی نی کچک پنی سودا خلوئیے۔ کنا ہمو چار بندغ نی تو بند امو تیالک۔ زارا! اینا چار بندہ تلے وائے لیکن ناصر ادا گڈاس مس نا خیر۔
en: Tara! If anything happens to Nasir, it won't go well for you. Soldier, you dog, a deal has to be struck. Those four men of mine who are locked up with you ... Tara! ... four men ..., but if anything happens to Nasir, it won't go well for you.
en_old: Zara! Nasir has gone missing and you don't care. Soldier, you go buy a little bread. Those four people of mine, you... Zara! Those four men of his will be found, but Nasir has gone missing and you don't care.

brh: نی ننا بندغاتے یلہ کین ننا تیر یلہ کین دنگا پولیس ننا بندغاتے الے رے یلہ کے ننا
en: You, release our men, release our ...; the police have taken our men like this, release ours.
en_old: Release our people, release our arrows; the police over there... release our people, release ours.

brh: شکنی دا خس بیرے مسہ چنا کینت نی سنگت تون دن کننگس کنے ہچ سنگت منگت تاک یاد افس کنے کنا صرف دشمنک یادو ئے کلان بدلہ تینا ہلوہ دا شارے تباہ کیوئی شکنی تو دن الہ ویسے تو وطن پرست اسس نی
en: Shaka, have you become this merciless ... children ... would you do this to a friend? I don't remember any friends or anything like that; I remember only my enemies. I will take my revenge on all of them, I will destroy this city. Shaka, you weren't like this; you used to be a patriot.
en_old: Shakni, this... three children... you were having dinner with your friends; I don't remember any friends at all, I only remember my enemies. I'll take all my revenge, I'll destroy this city. Shakni, if you'd had dinner... you were a patriot.

brh: انتک دم بسس۔ کنے پاکستان ہم بد بپک کنے پاکستان نا بندغات ہم بد برک۔ شکا نی کنے دا خواہسنگا تیک کرے دانا بدلچ کنے گڑاس تستی فیس۔ فانتس فواس سنگتی کے جانم نم قربان۔ شکا دا کاریم تے نی لے، لے دا کاریم تے کنے وقت
en: Why have you become like this? I don't hate Pakistan, nor do I hate the people of Pakistan. Shaka, you did this thing I wanted for me, and in return for it you haven't given me anything. ... friendship ..., my life is yours. Shaka, you take on these jobs, take on these jobs ... me time.
en_old: What are you saying? I don't hate Pakistan, nor do I hate the people of Pakistan. Shaka, you did me this favour; in return I'll give you something. ... friendship, may I be sacrificed for you. Shaka, you take this job, take it, my time...

brh: استا نہ شاباش ضرورت ہی وائے سو زنون او گڑاس دانام، شاہ کا وعدہ کرے شاہ کا وعدہ تینے پورا کے، کاریم تلنگ کپرے کنے لیوے
en: ... no, well done; it's needed ... and something ...; Shaka made a promise, Shaka should keep his promise; ... the work ... to me.
en_old: Listen, no, well done, there was a need... a hundred... that name. Shaka made a promise, Shaka fulfilled his promise. Don't leave the work; give it to me.

brh: وا خیری، درا شکا غہ درائی کرے، ننت کرے شکا، ناصری الک کرے، ہدان پاسے، ہاؤ شکا ناصری الک کرے، شکا
en: Oh, is everything alright? Tara, Shaka has betrayed us; Shaka did this to us, he has taken Nasir away ...; yes, Shaka has taken Nasir away, Shaka.
en_old: Oh, fine. Dara wrote to Shaka, Shaka wrote back; he took Nasir away, that's what he said. Yes, Shaka took Nasir away, Shaka.

brh: ئے غداری نا سزا ملے، شاہ کائے زندہ یا مردہ کنے یاد البتہ بوتے۔
en: He will get the punishment for treachery; bring Shaka to me, alive or dead.
en_old: You'll get the punishment for treason. Shaka, alive or dead, I will remember you, though.

brh: کنا نیت بین نی تونی تس کروئی انتس کروئی ہچ متو نی ساتھا نیت بین ثناء
en: My intentions are good; with you ... what was I supposed to do, what should I have done? Nothing happened. My intentions toward you are good, Sana.
en_old: My intention is good; you yourself said... what did I do? What did you do? Nothing. My intention toward you is good, Sana.

brh: ئے چپ مریسہ صفا، اینو رفنے، اخس طاقت ارے نی بش مرے سنائی تو بش مرے
en: Hey, you've gone completely quiet ... today ...; however much strength you have, get up; Sana, get up.
en_old: Be completely quiet, get up now. How much strength do you have? Get up, listen to me, get up.

brh: ثنا سے وری تیتو بن واللہ، انتے داسے پا؟ ثنا
en: Sana, just once ..., by God, why are you saying this now? Sana.
en_old: Sana, I swear by God, once... why are you saying this now? Sana.

brh: ثنائی تارا نا گروپ دا سے لانوٹ ئس دروغ تڑیسہ نی۔ ثنائی تارا دا ملک نا خلاف او۔ تو گڑا نی ارا دا ملک نا خیر خواہ سے۔ ئے ملک نا خلاف افٹ ملک نا رول آتا خلاف اٹ۔ ثنائی قسم کنوئے ثنائی تارا نا گروپ دا سے لانوٹ ئس دا ئے تو گڑا
en: Sana, I have left Tara's group ... You are lying. Sana, Tara is against this country. So then, are you a well-wisher of this country? I'm not against the country, I'm against the country's rules. Sana, I swear, Sana, I have left Tara's group ..., so then ...
en_old: Sana, Tara's group is a gang of thugs; you are telling lies. Sana, Tara is against this country. So then, are you a well-wisher of this country? I am not against the country, I am against the country's rules. Sana, I swear to you, Sana, Tara's group is a gang of thugs, that's what it is, so then...

brh: راشا کنا عید ستارا نا خلاف فٹ گناہ دا عید دروغ مسرتو ثناء نی کنے بھروسہ کدا واری کھلی کنے بس داراتے نا بندغات انڈیا غرائی کرینگے داتے برتورینا اگر داتے روکتا ونتو پاکستان برباد مارے کسے سے چناو چئی بس
en: Sana, what I'm saying against Tara ... it would be a sin if these words were a lie. Sana, trust me this one time. ... Tara's men are being sent to India and they bring these back; if we don't stop them, Pakistan will be ruined ...
en_old: Come, my... going against Tara is no sin; this is a lie. Sana, trust me just this once. These people are being sent in by India, they bring them; if they are not stopped, Pakistan will be ruined, nobody... that's all.

brh: شاکا گردائی تے خوشا جنی تے سات کے شاکا بسنے لے دا کارم تے گم کے این تے قانون نا حوالہ کر
en: Shaka, the traitors ... with you; Shaka, that's enough, drop this work and hand them over to the law.
en_old: Shaka, take the ... and the ... with you; Shaka, enough, leave this work, hand them over to the law.

brh: ئے لو کل ئے سنبھالے وی بے شک ثناء دا ہیت نا راستی لیکن نی کنے منع دے لے تارا اگہ بارڈر پاس کرے تو تباہی ماری شاہ کا دا ہیت نا تو صحیح ہی لیکن نا داڑے فیری خلنگ باز نی کہ خطرہ ہی تارا
en: I'll handle everything. No doubt, Sana, what you say is true, but don't stop me; if Tara crosses the border there will be destruction. Shaka, what you say is right, but your coming and going here is very dangerous for you; Tara ...
en_old: I will handle everything, without a doubt, Sana. What you say is true, but don't stop me. If Tara crosses the border, there will be destruction. Shaka, what you say is right, but your going there is very dangerous, Tara is a danger.

brh: خلیفک نی یرا لٹونے خلیفک ثنا تانکی نی تونو ٹیچ موت نا غمس ثنا زندگی موت تا بروسہ فہ خینگہ مستی نا ملک نا دشمن تے ختم کے شاکا گردائی تے تو نین تاران نا پد
en: ... you ...; Sana, as long as I'm with you I have no fear of death at all; Sana, life and death can't be counted on; before dying, the enemies of the country must be finished off. Shaka, as for the traitors ..., then I'll go after Tara.
en_old: ... you ... Sana, until you ... fear of death, Sana; life and death are in God's hands. Finish off the enemies of the country, Shaka, ... and then go after Tara.

brh: دا پدانہ تکائم پئی املہ کے وی ٹھیک اسنا ئے کاوا بارڈر انی تکائم پملہ کنے شاکا، توفک شیف کیت گولی لگانے
en: From behind this ... attack ...; all right ..., I'm going to the border ... attack on me, Shaka. Put the rifle down! A bullet has hit him.
en_old: I'll take care of it later... alright, I'm fine... the border... take care of that for me, Shaka; the gun... he's been hit by a bullet.

brh: کنا ایٹی تے دوبمبو سالہ ثناء ثناء دیر ئس دا دا لالے خیر ئے لالے شاہ کا ئے ہم تھارانا گروپ فیلانوٹ شاہ کا دا جنگٹی ہم نم تواروٹ ثناء
en: My ... Sana, Sana, some water, here, here. Lale, it's all right, Lale. Shaka, I too have left Tara's group; Shaka, in this war I am with you too. Sana.
en_old: My ... Sana, Sana, bring some water. This... Lale, it's alright, Lale. Shaka, he too was in Tara's group. Shaka, in this fight you too will ... Sana.

brh: توشاکا یعنی کہ شاہ زیب تھارانہ الفنگٹ کرے
en: So Shaka, that is to say Shahzeb, did his part in catching Tara
en_old: So Shaka, that is, Shahzeb, killed Tara.

brh: پولیس نا مدد تے اور تینے پن قانون نا حوالہ کرے ہنا وجہ آن سرکار اونا سزا تے کم کرے پنج سال پنج سال او اینا جیل آ اور داسہ ایلے سادہ زندگی ئس گدریفنگے اور تارا
en: ... [helped] the police, and also handed himself over to the law; for that reason the government reduced his sentence: five years, he went to jail for five years, and now he is living a simple life. And Tara ...
en_old: ...with the help of the police, and handed himself over to the law, for which reason the government reduced his sentence to five years; he spent five years in jail and now he is living a simple life, and Tara...

brh: نم ئس ہمروک ایت تارا داسہ جیل اٹی تارا سما تما کہ تینا ملک تو غداری کننگ نا انجام خراب مریک اور لالے لالے تو وقتی ہمو شاہ کا تو اوار ئس اور داسہ ہمو شاہ کا یعنی کہ شاہ زیب تو اوار ئے
en: You may be wondering about Tara: Tara is now in jail. Tara has realized that betraying one's own country leads to a bad end. And Lale, Lale was with that same Shaka at that time, and now he is with that same Shaka, that is, Shahzeb.
en_old: You may be wondering about Tara: Tara is now in jail. Tara realized that betraying one's own country leads to a bad end. And Lale, Lale was with Shaka at that time, and he is now with that same Shaka, that is, Shahzeb.

brh: اور ٹاکور نا غداری نم سنائے یعنی کہ کنے سما تما اور اودے پندرہ سال سزا ملا داسہ او جیل اٹھی اور ئے وستے نا انتے تعریف کروٹی ئے دا
en: And Thakur's treachery, you heard about it, that is, I came to know of it, and he was sentenced to fifteen years; he is in jail now. And how can I praise this ... enough ...
en_old: And you heard about Thakur's treachery, that is, it was found out and he was sentenced to fifteen years; he is now in jail. And what more can I say in praise of this...

brh: قسم سوچنگ اٹ کہ داکا پد ہموارے فلم ئس کشین سلام علیکم ننا ڈائریکٹر نا باز منت وار کین ننے فلم اٹی دا خسر کرے نن کیمرہ مین نا تینا باز منت وار اون کہ ننے دا خسر
en: I swear I'm thinking that after this we should make another film just like it. Peace be upon you. Many thanks to our director, who brought us this far in the film; we are very grateful to our cameraman, who [brought] us this far.
en_old: I swear I'm thinking that after this I'll make another film just like it. Assalamu alaikum. Many thanks to our director, who cast us in this film; we are very grateful to our cameraman, who did this for us.

brh: ار جگہ غا شوٹنگ اٹ ایلوٹ ننا ایم ئے ساتھ تس ننا ڈائریکٹر باز باز منت وار اونا کہ ننتون داخہ ساتھ تس ننے داڑے سر کرے اگے سنگت تا تانگو یارے سے کہ اگے دا فلم ہر کسے وڑ ئے
en: He supported our team in the shooting at every location; we are very, very grateful to our director, who supported us so much and brought us this far. Friends ... that this film suits everyone ...
en_old: He supported us in shooting at every location; many, many thanks to our director for supporting us so much and bringing us this far. To any friend out there I would say that this film is for everyone.

brh: تو ضروری ایلو تا شاعر کیتے باز باز مہربانی ایلو سنگت باز منت وار تینا ڈائریکٹر صاحب نا کے ننا ڈائریکٹر نا ایفرٹ او تو دے
en: then be sure to share it with others. Thank you very, very much. Also, friends, we are very grateful to our director sahib, because it is our director's effort ...
en_old: So be sure to share it with others, thank you very much. Other friends, many thanks to our director sahib, because it was our director's effort that made it.

brh: دا دے ڈائریکٹر جی او دا فلم نا ڈائریکٹر ئے اوٹ اور دا فلم آ باز خواری کرین نن، ننا سنگت آک باز خوار مسنو اور اگر نمے پسند بس دا فلم تو نمے آن گزارش ئے دا دے مونی شیئر۔
en: This here is the director; he is the director of this film. And we worked very hard on this film, our friends went through a lot of hardship, and if you liked this film, our request to you is to share it onward.
en_old: This is the director sahib, he is the director of this film, and we worked very hard on this film; our friends worked very hard, and if you liked this film, our request to you is to share it forward.

brh: سپورٹ کبو اور ننا دا ایلم نا فلم ٹی روئے اور ئنا دے مچے سپورٹ کبو باز باز مہربانی منت وار
en: Support us, and in our next film ..., and support us all. Thank you very, very much, many thanks.
en_old: Support us, and we'll move on to our next film; support all of us, thank you very, very much.

brh: ماما نا خوارزادہ ئس ماما برے اودے ہم ایلے پروٹ۔ دا سسل ئے نی تو جوان ٹیبے۔
en: You're Uncle's nephew? Let Uncle come, I won't let him go either. As for this (unclear), you (unclear) it well.
en_old: He was uncle's nephew; uncle came and sent him off elsewhere too. This is the chain; you're the fine young man.

brh: امر خناس جن نا طاقت ء۔ جن تو نا طاقت ء خنا دا سنی کنا طاقت ء خنیسہ۔ اچھا جن نا تو بلبلی۔ جن تو نیم مخلوق ء گٹو کیسہ تو نا دوام خلنگنگ ء۔
en: So how did you find the jinn's power? The jinn has seen your power; now you will see my power. All right, jinn, as for you... (unclear). You, jinn, throttle half of all creatures, so you will always be getting beaten.
en_old: Have you seen the jinn's power? The jinn has seen your power; now you'll see my power. All right, jinn, your... The jinn catches half the people; your reign will be struck down.

brh: ئے اللہ کرکنے، ساہ کنے ہلکوس۔ نا ساہ کائے کنے مخلوق ناجائز خلئیسے۔ ئے مخلوق کے خلے وا اور ڈلے وا۔ فی الحال تو
en: O God... you've taken my breath away! You'll lose your life, since you strike people unjustly. I strike people and I bite them. For now, though...
en_old: Yes, by God, you've taken my breath away. Your life... you have struck people unjustly. If I strike people, I strike them, and I'll knock them down. For now...

brh: ئے ننا دے ننا گٹو خننگاٹی اٹ۔ نی کنے ہچ کننگ کپیسہ۔ انت خناس جن نا طاقت ء۔ جنی واقعی طاقتور اسے، نن ہم کم افن۔ نی اگر کم افس تو بر دوئی اسہ
en: I'm watching for our day, for our throttling (of you). You can't do anything to me. What did you see of the jinn's power? The jinn is truly a powerful one, but we're no less either. If you're no less, then come on, one grip...
en_old: Yes, our day... our capture lies in seeing. You can't do anything to me. What have you seen of the jinn's power? The jinn is truly powerful, but we're no less. If you're no less, then come, one hand...

brh: ئے دا جاہ نا جن ء گٹو کننگ ئس گٹو مریس کہ نی بلو زور سرفینوس۔ ماما ہراڑے کنوس دا کنے گٹو کرینے۔
en: I was throttling the jinn of this place, and it was getting throttled, but you put up a great deal of force. Uncle, where are you? This one has grabbed me by the throat!
en_old: Yes, you were about to capture the jinn of this place; you would have caught it if you hadn't used too much force. Uncle, where are you? This one has caught me.

brh: خوارزادہ حکم کر الماس نی ماما نا دا خانے سے گٹو کرے نی نا دا مجال ماما نا خوارزادہ گٹو کرے نوس نا خوارزادہ
en: Nephew, give the order! (unclear) You've throttled this one of Uncle's? How dare you! You have throttled Uncle's nephew, the nephew!
en_old: Nephew, give the order. Almas, you've captured uncle's Khan... You have this audacity, to capture uncle's nephew? ... your nephew.

brh: خورزادہ کنا دو گٹیا نی لگا داسہ ئے کاوہ متی نا چاس کاریم نی چائے
en: Nephew, my hand is at your throat, you're caught! Now I'm going... (unclear)... you know the job.
en_old: Nephew, my two hands are tied; you... now it's not... the work is yours, you...

brh: نی کانتو بدمعاشی کیسہ، امر خناس بے بخت الے جنا، نی لیٹے ایناٹے
en: You're acting the thug with me? So how do you like it, you wretched jinn? You... lie down (unclear).
en_old: You're acting the thug with me; how did you see it, you wretch? Don't say that, jinn; you lie down here.

brh: فرزادہ او دے گٹو کریسے کہ کھس گیا بچا؟ ماما ئے تو تینے ہم گٹو کریٹ تے دا سو نا قسمت
en: Nephew, did you throttle him, or did he slip away and escape? Uncle, I did throttle him myself, but now it's down to his luck.
en_old: Nephew, did you catch him, or did he escape? Uncle, I would have even caught myself, but this is his fate.

brh: بچے بچے خوارزادہ کچا او کارم کپک و نہ پکا او کارم کیک نی اودے گٹو کرینوس بچے کو امر ماما ئے تو باز کوشش کرینٹ داسے اینگو اونا قسمت او تو ٹھیک ہی جوان کریسک بش مرے کانے داسے لو
en: He escaped, he escaped! Nephew, you neither do a half-baked job nor a finished one! You had him by the throat, so how did he escape? Uncle, I tried very hard; now it was his luck. He got off quite fine... Get up, let's go now, come on.
en_old: He escaped, he escaped. Nephew, you neither do the job half-done nor do you finish it properly. You caught him and he escaped—how? Uncle, I tried very hard; now it's his fate. He would have been fine... let him wake up, now...

brh: چٹا خلیل، ٹھیک ئے ماما ٹھیک ئے
en: (unclear) All right, Uncle, all right.
en_old: Quick, Khalil. Fine, uncle, fine.

brh: اڑے نی تو خیر تورے؟ ہاؤ کنے تو خیرے، نا تو خیر اف۔ جنت ئس تینکی، الکوٹ سائے نا کشوٹ۔ اچھا، دن جنت تو باخرزے۔ باخلنگان تینا سائے لیو۔
en: Hey, are you all right? Yes, I'm fine; it's you who isn't fine. There was a jinn on you; I caught it and pulled out its shadow. Okay, so the jinn is aware. (unclear) your own shadow...
en_old: Hey, are you alright? Yes, I'm fine; it's you who isn't fine. There's a jinn on you, under the shade at Alkot. Okay, so the jinn has latched onto you. Since it's latched on, take your shadow away.

brh: اچھا ایتا کنا دو ہاو بالکل ایتا کنا دو کنا خیال بائید ماما ئے توار کیو تمنیک توار کما مائی نا ماما ہنت کروئی ماما ورزادہ انٹ
en: Okay, give it here into my hand. Yes, absolutely, give it into my hand. I think I should call Uncle. (unclear) call... Uncle! Nephew, what is it?
en_old: Okay, give me your hand. Yes, absolutely, give me your hand. I think I should call Uncle. Don't call out! Don't call out. Uncle—what has he done? Uncle! What is it, nephew?

brh: ئنا دا گٹٹ کنا الکو پین انت سے؟ نا دا جرات خوارزادہ نا گٹٹ الکونس۔ نا خوارزادہ یک بلو بدمعاش سے۔ خوارزادہ نا بدمعاشی خناس۔ داسہ ہور کہ ماما انت بدمعاشی کیک۔ نی ننتو بدمعاشی کیسہ؟
en: What's this, you've grabbed my throat, what else? How dare you, you've grabbed the nephew by the throat! The nephew is one big thug. You've seen the nephew's thuggery; now see what thuggery Uncle does! You're acting the thug with us?
en_old: Whose is this... what else is mine? You dared to grab the nephew's... Your nephew is a big thug. You've seen the nephew's thuggery; now watch what thuggery the uncle does. Are you acting the thug with us?

brh: خوارزادہ دا وڑ مرے گٹو کننگ نی ہم بندغاتے گٹو کیسہ؟ ماما ئے ہم اراد گٹو کرینٹ او زندہ بچتنے نی ہم کنے جوان سما ہی
en: Nephew, is this how throttling should be done? Do you throttle people too? Uncle, I've throttled people on purpose too, and they didn't come out alive. You know me well too.
en_old: Nephew, is this how you tie someone up? Do you tie people up like this? You tied up your uncle so tight—did he even come out alive? You really have looked after me well.

brh: شپات کپتو نی بس ماما بس، خلیفیس کنے دا خلق ہم ودی ہنینگو۔ ہچ مفک نی کس، پیسے بر بر راہی مر کان!
en: (unclear) Enough, Uncle, enough! You're scaring me; these people will turn up too. Nothing will happen to you. Bring the money, bring it, and get going, go!
en_old: Don't talk nonsense. Enough, Uncle, enough! Let me go—these people are going to gather here too. Nothing will happen to you; just bring the money, bring it, and be on your way!

brh: ماما آن سوچ کننگٹ۔ خوارزادہ سوچئے ورنا و جوان داتے امر خلین؟ انم کہ ئے رٹ تے خلقٹ نی ایلو تمنا خلین۔ واقعی کنا خوارزادہ اوس لیکن ہنانے خرابی نی مچے کنے ہم بیزیب اوس اگر نا ہوس
en: Uncle, I'm thinking. Nephew, think! How shall we strike these young, healthy ones? Now that we've done this village, let's hit the next settlement. Truly you are my nephew, but you have a bit of a flaw; you'd shame me too, if your greed...
en_old: Think about Uncle. Nephew, think—how could we strike down a young, decent man like this? Now that you've knocked him down in the race, next time you'll knock him down again. Truly, you were my nephew, but you've ruined everything; I too would have been disgraced if your wish had come true.

brh: زن کنا کڑچہ مسکہ دا دنیا تیویک نناز ہاؤ ماما ہاؤ نازے بائے نا ہچ مثال ئس اف دا ہیت نی ٹھیک ئے جوانی بش مبا کانے ارٹ پین ارٹ ئس تا پی خلین ہاؤ
en: My wife (unclear)... this whole world is ours! Yes, Uncle, yes; I'm proud, there's no one like you. What you say is right. Good, get up, let's go and strike two more, another two. Yes.
en_old: My wife has turned against me; this world is not ours. Yes, Uncle, yes. There's no one like you anywhere. What you said is right. Don't lose heart—I'm going; one way or another we'll find another one. Yes.

brh: ماما ہاؤ
en: Uncle? Yes.
en_old: Uncle, yes.

brh: دا مکنو ہت گٹٹ کنا لوش بس زیادہ ہیت کپہ ناخیر کدے ئنا دے خانہ بادے ئے براہوئی انٹرنیشنل نا سوک اونٹ نی ہم کنا
en: This... throat... my... Enough, don't talk so much, otherwise (unclear)... house... (unclear) of Brahui International... you're mine too.
en_old: Tie this one up too, my dear—enough, don't talk so much, otherwise one of these days this household will be ruined. That one is a product of Brahui International, and you too are mine.

brh: نی گٹو کسے؟ اینی دا وا جوان گٹو کے وی نی براہما جوان سرمفے، ایڑے کھلی سوتے کنیسے، ایڑے ئنا خبر سو کھٹوئی افس، نی یلکہ کنے کان کن توبرا نیم کنا میڑی، ئے تو سو کنے وی نی والی زندے
en: Did you throttle it? Now this one is nicely throttled too. You won't (unclear) well; there you eat (unclear) meat, there you know nothing; you won't earn anything. If you let me go, I'll go, I repent; half is mine... you'll stay alive.
en_old: Did you tie it? Yes, you've tied this one up nicely too. You're not a decent Brahui; over there you sit idle and drink, you don't have a clue about anything there. If you let me go I'd leave—half my share would be yours—and you would stay alive.

brh: اچھا ایتا کنا دو ہاؤ نادھاجرہ نی کنے کھرکوس کنے ہر حالت برامائنوئی او چھوکنوئی ئے چائے کنے نی کنے اوڑ کے کسفوئی تمے ہاؤ نی کنے کسفوئی تمے
en: Okay, give it into my hand. Yes. (unclear) you've (unclear) me; I have to be gotten out and freed no matter what. I know... you'll have to kill me there. Yes, you'll have to kill me.
en_old: Okay, give me your hand. Yes. You wretch, you've tied me up; I must get out of this at any cost. Come on, you have to untie me here. Yes, you have to untie me.

brh: چٹ کے ونے سلیپر نی سال امام اعتبار کیم نا کنے کاسم کے ماما انت سے خوارزادہ
en: (unclear) slippers... year... I'd trust you... swear to me. Uncle! What is it, nephew?
en_old: Pick it up, put on your slippers; this year, Imam, trust me, I'm your Qasim. Uncle! What is it, nephew?

brh: اما تکنے مچس خلکونے او نی مچس خلکونے نی اودین گٹہ کر پنا دو نا بجاٹے اینزو گٹہ کتہ اچھا انی کل گٹہ کسے ہاؤ الہ گٹہ کیون پین
en: But he's landed a punch on me, and you've landed a punch too. You grab that one by the throat; instead of the (unclear) hand, grab this one too. Okay, have you got them all now? Yes. Come on, let's do another one.
en_old: But look, you've tied them all up—you've tied them all up. Tie that one too; instead of the other hand, tie this one too. Okay, now have you tied them all? Yes. Now let's tie the other one.

brh: خانہ خراب الیکیسو کل تڑداسکا سوک
en: Damn you, you're letting (unclear)... all of them (unclear)...
en_old: Damn you, you'll ruin me; cut them all off.

brh: کمپانی نی کہ جوانی، الیک کرے نی کہ جوانی، الیک کرے کف سوکنے، نی سو ہم بس سفت نا علاج کینگی پنی چھپنے
en: (unclear) if you're all right... if you're all right... (unclear)... you too are just being treated for (unclear)... hiding.
en_old: The company—if you're well; the election—if you're well; the election has done its work. And you too are just getting treatment for your pain, hiding away.

brh: ماما بغیر ئس بٹنگو کین خلکون۔ جو مسکے او دے
en: Uncle, we struck without anyone finding out. It's done, as far as he's concerned.
en_old: Uncle, I tied them up without anyone noticing. Well, that's done then.

brh: او زی خلکوس بغیر از پٹنگنگن ہر براہوئی نا کنا سودا کے مو گونگا کے ننے جناتے مشت ماتا یکائی لنگڑ بسوٹے سئی پاس ہڈا تیتا مسو الے توکا کڑا جاہ ساما کینا تاسا کان کھولے تا خلین
en: You struck him without being found out. Every Brahui's... my deal... mute... us... the jinns... a fist... one... lame... three... bones... the place... open... let's strike.
en_old: He struck yesterday without being caught; every Brahui's deal is with me—don't make him dumb. The jinn gave us a fist; one went lame, three passed, bones were scattered; now, elsewhere, up to that spot, open your eyes and strike.

brh: ہاؤ ماما ہاؤ فورزادہ خان فورزادہ لشکر بننگٹی ئے دا سوت نا علاج کنے ہمت کر
en: Yes, Uncle, yes. Nephew, Khan, nephew, an army is coming! Find me a remedy for this; take courage.
en_old: Yes, Uncle, yes. Nephew, Khan—nephew, an army is on its way. Deal with this matter for me; have courage.

brh: او خلتا، اوفتے گٹہ کپر اوفتے خاخراٹ دوشیوے، زوکو، اوشاتا
en: Hit them! Don't throttle them; get them with fire, quickly, pour it on them!
en_old: He struck. Tie them up, bind them with the khakhar cords—quickly, now.

brh: ارے ماما پشکن غئی دادے بغیر بٹنگو کا نا کل تہ دشمنو ئے ہم نی تو ہمونا دشمنون ماما کنکے تو غٹ تہ دشمنو انتس کریر اوس پائک غٹے خان خاخر
en: Hey uncle, ... this one goes [to weddings] without an invitation. All of them are your enemies, and you are their enemy too. Uncle, for me... and what have all those enemies done? He says: all of it, Khan, fire.
en_old: Hey uncle, listen, this is without... all of them are enemies, and you too are their enemy, uncle; what did the big enemies do, he says, the big one, Khan...

brh: دا بتہ گٹو کیپن خوارزادہ نی فکر کپہ کلے تا گٹو کینہ کس تہ سلیپرو۔ ہو ماما ہو
en: We'll catch these, nephew, don't you worry; we'll catch every one of them, none of them will be left standing. Yes, uncle, yes.
en_old: We'll settle this, nephew, don't you worry; we'll finish everyone off, nobody will be left standing. Yes, uncle, yes.

brh: برام خوراک مشکل برام سرمری رے
en: Wedding-crashers: it'll be hard — will you make it to the wedding?
en_old: The wedding food is hard to manage, but the wedding will go ahead.

brh: دا دنا توارے دیر ئس خننگ پکلے۔ نوما دعا مجل، نوم براما کاری توار تو بندغ اسنائے، لیکن خننگ پک۔ خننگ تو جتا تو پٹے۔ ادا براما اینارے، سوکونرے یا ہڈ کونرے؟
en: Whose voice is this? Someone's — but he can't be seen. Your ... ; you're going to the wedding; the voice is a person's, but he can't be seen. Being seen is another matter... Brother, you're going to the wedding — will you eat meat or eat bones?
en_old: I haven't heard this one's voice for a while, and he can't be seen. Your prayer... you have the voice of a person doing the wedding work, but you can't be seen. Seeing is one thing, but what about it? Tell me, at the wedding, do you eat the meat or the bones?

brh: ادانی ہر کس کے ارے فاش کتے نی تیلے فاش کتو صیح گول نن پانیک نی سوکونے ہڈ کونے، ہائے نو پگا نا بندغک برام کننگ کے چتا او صفا، زو کا فاش کتے نی نن تنے
en: Brother, reveal [yourself] to everyone — reveal yourself! You haven't shown yourself. Let's put it plainly: do you eat meat or eat bones? Hey, tomorrow people are going to hold a wedding, all neat and clean; quick, reveal yourself to us.
en_old: Here you have exposed everyone — you've exposed yourself. We'll say it straight: you eat the meat and the bones. Hey, tomorrow's people are going to hold a wedding, that's all clean; you were quick to expose it, we gave it to you.

brh: پاش کنا وللہ نوم خولی پیری ارے ڈائن نی تینے پاش کنا نوم خولی پنی ارے نوم دیر وری نان ہر کس کہ مرے نوم ہندکے برام کننگ کے کاورے
en: Show yourself, by God — aren't you afraid? Hey, witch, show yourself — aren't you afraid? Hey, who are you? Whoever you may be, are you going to hold a wedding here?
en_old: Show it, by God, there's a fairy in your house. You witch, show yourself; there's a fairy in your house. Whoever it is, you're going to go there to do the wedding.

brh: برام کن کہ کانے نن نی انت تکلیف ئے سوہنا شوق ئے نومے تو کام دے نومے براما۔ نم کھپبو نن تو ڈرامہ۔ نم بفن نومے براما۔ اینو خلینن نومے شامہ۔ اناڑی کسر نا نیامہ۔
en: We're going to the wedding — what's it to you? It's your craving for meat; what business do you have at the wedding? Don't play drama with us. We won't come to your wedding. Today we'll beat you in the evening, you bumblers, in the middle of the road.
en_old: Hold the wedding, what trouble is it to us? It's your fine hobby, your business, your wedding. Don't you interfere, we're the drama. We won't come to your wedding. Today we'll strike you this evening, in the midst of the novices.

brh: ننے الیبو ننے نن کانے، ایڑے لشکر ننا انتظارٹی ئے ننے ہورے تمک، نم تو ایہن دن بیکار او بندغورے، ننے الیبو ننتو کام براما، او برام خور، نی مشکلے رسینگاس
en: Let us go, we're going; over there an army is waiting for us, we're getting late. You're such useless people. Let us go, we have work at the wedding. O wedding-crasher, you've landed in trouble.
en_old: Don't hold us, let us go; there's an army waiting for us over there, let us go. You're just such idle people. Don't hold us, we have work at the wedding. You wedding-glutton, you've landed us in trouble.

brh: ایلم دا ساہی پومہ سوٹ دا کیرے جنو جن کیرے نی ایہو شر و شرارت ہر کس
en: Brother, this ... what are you doing? Jinns, are you up to jinn tricks? You are such mischief and trickery, every one of you.
en_old: Hey, this one here, what will you do? You jinn, will you do it? You're nothing but mischief and trouble, every one of you.

brh: دفت کار ایمی نم شرارت کپیرے ننے جناتے پارے ئس کنا پائک کلہ نمے گٹہ کیر ٹھیک ئے نی جن ئس اوس ننے الے
en: Get away — don't you make mischief. The jinns had told us ... they'll catch all of you. Fine, you're a jinn; so let us go.
en_old: Hey, don't you make mischief; we told the jinns. My feet... it will finish all of you, fine. So you're a jinn, are you? Take us.

brh: کان برامہ سر مرین ننے اوڑے تما او بے وقوف نی تو بٹنگتنو نی امہ کاسہ برامہ نی امہ خبر تما کہ کنے بٹنگتنو برامہ او بے وقوف جنات ئے تو ہر گڑا نا معلوم مریک ٹھیک ہی خیر سے کنے برامہ بٹنگتنو داسہ
en: Let's go, let's get to the wedding — we're getting late. You fool, you haven't been invited; how are you going to the wedding? How did you find out that I haven't been invited to the wedding? You fool, jinns know everything. Fine, never mind — so I haven't been invited to the wedding now.
en_old: Let's go to the wedding when it takes place, let's go there. You fool, you weren't invited, did you come to the wedding? Didn't you tell me that I wasn't invited to the wedding? You fool, the jinns know about everything, fine. Alright then, now I'm invited to the wedding.

brh: آئی لے ننے کے کانے ننے ہورے تما مچ مہربانی ئس کبو کنا الہ ترس کبو کا مچیڑے سوس کوریف مچ ہولوم مریف او بے وقوف نی اگ ایڑے برام مکس ہم ایچ ملپک نا انتہیکی نا سنگتک فراڈی او
en: Let us go, we're going; we're late. Do us a little kindness, have mercy on me for God's sake... a little meat, a little ... You fool, even if there is a wedding there, you won't get anything, because your friends are frauds.
en_old: Hey, let us go, let us leave; please do a kindness, have mercy on me, nothing at all will be... You fool, even if there's a wedding there, you'll get nothing — what's in it for you? Your friends are frauds.

brh: نی تو برام ضرور دے رے لیکن ایڑے سوغ ہم بھروس صرف ہڈا دے نصیب نا کھیرے ئے جوان نا سنگت آتا ئے داتے بنگنٹ جوان نا سنگت آک نا خیر خواہ افس نی یا گناہ نا برام اینگو صفا ارے جن
en: You'll certainly go to the wedding, but there won't even be meat there — only bones; it's down to luck. Well, about your friends, I've heard this: your friends are not your well-wishers. Or else it's a sinful wedding altogether, hey jinn.
en_old: You'll certainly go to the wedding, but trust me, there won't be any meat there — only bones; it's the luck of the draw. Listen to this: you're no well-wisher of good friends. Or is it a wedding of sin? It's all clean over there, jinn.

brh: علی جا ئے پاننگوس ئے اللہ جا ئے پا پارہ نن دروغ تڑینئے تنے نن دروغ تڑ مفسن ارے سنگت آک واقعی ئے تکنو نو ایلو جناک کہ اون دروغ تڑیرے او تا ہیتا یقین کپے اچھا
en: You're saying it's Ali's place? Say it's Allah's place. Do they say we tell lies? We don't tell lies. Hey friends, really... the other jinns who tell lies — don't believe their words, okay?
en_old: You say 'Ali's place'? Say 'Allah's place'. Do we tell lies? We've never been liars. Friends, really... these other jinns who tell lies — don't believe their words, okay?

brh: چا نندروک تڑ مسن سالرے دا زنمے جوان کنیک نیم کپہ چا نہ نمے تسنے داسکان نمے بھروسہ بفک
en: Tea... have we become liars? ... This makes life good; don't do it by halves. We've given you tea, and still you don't trust us.
en_old: We've been sitting here for years; this makes life good, don't do things by halves. We've given you tea and you still don't trust us.

brh: دا رنگ غیمزین ارے نی بھٹنگ تانو نی ننتو برے سے برامہ ادا آن منیا چانک
en: Why are you looking so sad? Hey, haven't you been invited? You'll come with us to the wedding. Brother, ...
en_old: This color is... Are you invited? You come with us to the wedding; from here... I don't know.

brh: کونے اچانک ایڑے برے سے ننا سوان ہم بشخے کونے سے بابا کنے بیزاری سوان کنے کنے مچے شوروا ایتیبو سوت نم کومو بس ٹھیکے نی اڈسم چونڈنگ کتی فرون بابا داغے بیرے مفو
en: You'll suddenly come there and eat a share of our meat too. Father, I'm sick of meat; give me a little broth, you all eat the meat. Okay, fine; you nibble on a bone too. ... father, ... don't ...
en_old: Come there suddenly and share our meat too. Eat it, father — I'm sick of meat, just give me a little broth; you eat the meat. Fine. You, grab my hand... Father, don't come over here.

brh: ابو کنے اڈس تو ایتو باویڑے چھوڑننگ کے ارے انچے خلنگوس نی ایڈے اڈ چھوڑیسے سوتو ایونتی فیرننے ایلے بو اڈس تو چھوڑنے ریڈی دا سائیں نی اڈس چھوڑے فیوے
en: Father, give me a bone! Father, over there, to let go... Hey, why are you hitting me like this? Let go of the bone here... let go, let go of the bone... ready... here, sir, you let go of the bone...
en_old: Father, give me your hand, father, I'm going to let go. Why are you hitting me? Let go of my hand there... Take it, let go of my hand. Ready. Sir, you let go of my hand, let me go.

brh: دے خیر اسے، دا خیر اسے، خیر اسے، خیر اسے، خیر اسے، دان مس، الے بو کنے دادے کسفبو، انمس نی اڈہ کہ کنے کسفنگس، داس کا اڈہ سر متو وقتے گٹٹ کرکوس، نا دادے
en: It's fine, this is fine, fine, fine, fine. That's done. Let go — kill this one for me. Now, with the bone, you're killing me; just as the bone ..., you grabbed [my] throat, your this...
en_old: It's fine, this is fine, fine, fine, fine; that's done. Now come, untie this for me. Now you've tied me up like this and I can't reach over there—the moment you tied my throat up, your this...

brh: واہ اننے برا اما بغیر بٹنگ آن کاسے بس ادا یلہ کتے سنگت تینا اسوئی لپر نی بس ادا بس ئے او گٹو بس ادا بس بس بس یلہ دے یار بس کسپیس تے کشک لیبو نمے ہم کیو گٹو بس کسپیس دے ارے بس ادا نمے ہم کیو گٹو
en: Wow, how come you go [to weddings] without an invitation? Enough, brother, let him go, he's your own friend... Enough, brother, enough — he's caught. Enough, brother, enough, enough, enough, let go, mate. Enough, don't kill him... let go; I'll catch you too. Enough, don't kill him; hey, enough, brother, I'll catch you too.
en_old: Wow, what — brother, you came without being invited? That's it. Let go, friend, your own... That's it, this is finished. Enough, enough, let go, mate. Whoever does it, we'll cut off their hand, and we'll finish you too. Whoever is here, we'll finish you too.

brh: اوئے او گٹو بس ادا بس ادا نی خبر اف جنی غیب مس ہندا بندغے بس پیا ہندا خاطر سنگت آت گٹو کننگے خیال کبو یانتے ادا میر صاحب دم و دود تسکرتے ہاو ہاو دا تو کسفک داسا دا سہی دم کے ہاو اللہ لا الہ الا ہو الحی القیوم لا تاخذہ
en: Oy, he's caught! Enough, brother, enough, brother. Don't you know the jinni has vanished — this very man... enough... so, friends, be careful to catch him. Brother, Mir Sahib has performed incantation and fumigation on him. Yes, yes, now this will kill it; this is the proper incantation. Yes: Allah — there is no god but He, the Living, the Self-Subsisting; [neither slumber] overtakes Him...
en_old: Oh, finish it, that's it, that's it. Don't you know a jinni has vanished? That's it, this man... for the sake of friends, finish it, don't worry. Mir Sahib has done the incantation and the smoke. Yes, yes, now this one won't go anywhere, this is the proper incantation, yes: Allah, there is no god but He, the Living, the Self-Subsisting, neither slumber overtakes Him...

brh: ادا امرے طبیعت نی جوان مس مچے؟ انتئے؟ انت مس؟ انت مس کنے؟ سوہب آن کنے گٹ اٹی حل کننگ اٹی و دا صفا سست مسک۔ نہ بابا نی کنا سنگت اسینا مٹ۔
en: Brother, how is your health — have you gotten a little better? Why? What happened? What has happened to me? Since morning my throat has been hurting, and this has become completely weak. No, father, you're like a friend of mine.
en_old: Hey, are you feeling a bit better? Why? What happened? What's happened to me? Since morning my throat has been stuck and I've become completely weak. No, father, you've become like my friend.

brh: تینا نشان تے نمے ہباسی نمے او جن او جن نی دستگیر ہدایت کے کسرے دن حال تھین ننے ایلے نن کام برامہ ہورے تمہ
en: Your own signs ... to you ... O jinn, O jinn, may Dastagir guide you to the path ... Let us go; we have work at the wedding, we're getting late.
en_old: Show us your signs... oh jinn, oh jinn. Dastagir, guide us; tell us what the situation is, and we'll do the rest. Bahram, look over there.

brh: دستگیر نا پن الکونس دا غائب بو لیکن برام نا سر مفیرے سنگت آک چناک تو غائب مسنو دا غائب بو خان
en: You've invoked Dastagir's name — this one has vanished. But you won't make it to the wedding. Friends, the little ones have vanished; this one has vanished, Khan.
en_old: Dastagir's... was caught, and this one vanished; but Bahram's head... his companions and the children have vanished; this one has disappeared, Khan.

brh: مارزادہ! دا نامراد آتے توامک کین۔ ماما! ہنچ کنے پاس، ہنن کنے تا۔ ارا سیٹا دادا؟ ہنگیں کین داسا؟ ماما! ارا سیٹ نا، نی پاس ناپسند۔ ئے پسند مسند خپرا، تا ارا سیٹ دوٹی نبسک ہمونا لکھ۔
en: Nephew! I'll finish off these wretches. Uncle! Tell me like that, give it to me like that. Which one, brother? What shall I do now? Uncle! Which one? You say you don't like it. I don't care about liking or disliking; whichever one hasn't come into your hand, write that one down.
en_old: Nephew! I'll catch these wretches. Uncle! Don't tell me that, hand it to me. Whose is that, brother? What shall I do now? Uncle! Whose is that—you say you don't like it. Forget about liking or disliking; whoever that is, write his name in my hand.

brh: ئے خان ماما ٹھیک کے بس ٹھیک کے
en: Yes, Uncle Khan — all right, just make it right.
en_old: Yes, Khan. Uncle, fine, that's fine.

brh: مہمان پا ساراتا لے، ارا ستا ابا نی وڑے کھموتا گٹو کھرک، مہما دا ساوتے رسائفے کسر نا نیامہ، ہرزادہ ہمت کے الے
en: Guest, ... father, how did you catch them like that? The guest has brought these ... into the middle of the road. Nephew, have courage, let go.
en_old: Guest, don't say that... whose is that... father, how could you have caught him like that? The guest has brought these three into the middle of the... Nephew, have courage, don't...

brh: ایستا ماما قرار ائس کہ کنے خلیس بریک ہمت ک داسہ زو کر ہو ماما ہو
en: Uncle, I was at ease just now, but fear is coming over me. Have courage, now be quick. Yes, uncle, yes.
en_old: Uncle had agreed that fear would come over me; have courage, now hurry up—yes uncle, yes.

brh: نوار خلپہ جن نا آخر نان دشمنی سے ننتون۔ دشمنی مرے گڑا اینے باوا۔ پاپیسہ کنے گلہ کنے کاو دا سئی ننگ نا چھٹانے خوشوس کاوا۔ جن دن کپر مانگھروز۔
en: Don't shout — after all, the jinn has some enmity with us. If there is enmity, then so be it, father. Don't you complain to me ... The jinn doesn't do that ...
en_old: Don't lay a hand on him... after all, the jinn has an enmity with us. So what if there's enmity, father? Don't you say that—he complains to me; these three of ours... he's released them, he's pleased... The jinn... the day...

brh: ارے جنی کنے کمزور سمجھانوس؟ نا دہما جال، نی ماما نا خوارزادے خلکوس۔ نی تو ماما
en: Hey jinni, did you take me for weak? How dare you — you struck uncle's nephew! You, uncle's...
