brh: ئے کنا محبوبا دے آن زیادہ آن نی روشن ئس توبے آن زیادہ آن نی روشن ئس محبوبا دے پاش کرے شام نا ختم مرے لیکن نا نبوت یکارے نا تجلی یکارے ہی کمرٹی تارمٹی دے نا روشنائی بفک لیکن محبوب نا نبوت موجود
en: O my Beloved, you are brighter than the sun; you are brighter than the moon. My Beloved, the sun gives light and ends in the evening, but your prophethood is constant, your radiance is constant; in a room, in the darkness, the light of the sun does not come in, but the Beloved's prophethood is present.
en_old: ...my beloved, you are brighter than the day; you are brighter than the sun. My beloved, the day shines and ends at evening, but your prophethood is one, your effulgence is one. In a room, in the darkness, the light of day does not reach, but the beloved's prophethood is present.

brh: قبر ٹی نبی نا نبوت موجود آسمان نا غاتے پاک محمد نا نبوت موجود پورہ دنیا نا روشنی ختم مریک لیکن کنا محبوب نا نبوت والا روشنی قیامت اسکان دیوہ مار لگک اللہ پانٹینے روشنی
en: In the grave the Prophet's prophethood is present; in the heights of the heavens the pure Muhammad's prophethood is present. The light of the whole world comes to an end, but the light of my Beloved's prophethood will stay lit like a lamp until the Day of Judgment. Allah has said: light [...]
en_old: In the grave, the Prophet's prophethood is present; in the heights of the heavens, the pure Muhammad's prophethood is present. The light of the whole world will come to an end, but the light of my beloved's prophethood will keep shining until the Day of Judgment. Allah has said: light...

brh: ئے ہمو دیو ئس کرینوٹ، اینے چراغ ئس جوڑ کرینوٹ، ہرا بندہ نا چہرے خنا او کلمہ خوانک مسلمان مرے گڑا جنت اٹ وتا۔ حضور کسر اٹ ہناکا مائی سلوک ئس چنا ئس دوٹی ئس، حضور اوچے سوار ئس۔
en: [Allah says:] "I have made him that lamp, I have made him a lantern; whoever sees his face and recites the Kalima becomes a Muslim, and then [goes] to Paradise." The Prophet was going along the road; a woman was standing with a child in her arms; the Prophet was riding a camel.
en_old: ...We have made him that lamp, We have made him a lantern; whoever sees his face and recites the Kalima becomes a Muslim, and so enters Paradise. The Prophet was going along the way; a woman had a child in her lap, a small child; the Prophet was riding.

brh: پارے قافلہ تو نین ٹی حضور پارے لمہ مرے سلوکوس پی یا رسول اللہ چنائے جنس انس ابا جنس حضور ہرفے مونا تن تخا پارے اللہ نا دشمن پیش تما
en: [She] said, "[...] with the caravan [...]" The Prophet said, "Mother, why are you standing [here]?" "O Messenger of Allah, the child has a jinn; alas, a jinn!" The Prophet took up [the child], set him before himself, and said: "Enemy of Allah, come out!"
en_old: ...said, the caravan... the Prophet said... 'Mother, what is wrong with the child?' 'O Messenger of Allah, the child is possessed by a jinn; a jinn has taken the child.' The Prophet put his hand forward and said: 'Come out, enemy of Allah!'

brh: اللہ نا نبی نی پاننگ ٹی مسوار پاریتہ خوار بابا اللہ نا دشمن پیش تم اللہ نا نبی نی پاننگ ٹی اللہ نا دشمن پیش تم اللہ نا نبی نی پاننگ ٹی حضور دعا خوانا مائتست لمہ تا تینٹ ہنار اراتم وا
en: "The Prophet of Allah is telling you" — he said to it three times — "Wretched one, enemy of Allah, come out! The Prophet of Allah is telling you. Enemy of Allah, come out! The Prophet of Allah is telling you." The Prophet prayed; the woman, the mother, went off on her own; when again [...]
en_old: 'I am the Prophet of Allah,' he said... 'Come out, enemy of Allah; I am the Prophet of Allah. Come out, enemy of Allah; I am the Prophet of Allah.' The Prophet prayed; the woman, the mother, took her child home; when...

brh: او سے بسور تمو مائی ارا کھڑ خلیفہ نی محبوب نا کسرے یا رسولا چنا کن جن ہلا چنا کن جوڑے غازی کن دروم کلنٹی ایدا ارا کھڑ نی کن ہلاٹ حضور پارے انتئے تکلیف کرینوس حضور اسے
en: [Later] the woman came, having taken two rams, onto the Beloved's road: "O Messenger of Allah, the jinn has left the child, the child has become well [...]; I have brought these two rams for you." The Prophet said, "Why have you gone to the trouble?" The Prophet [took] one [...]
en_old: A year passed and that woman came again to the Beloved's path: 'O Messenger of Allah, the jinn has left the child, the child has become well, you made him healthy; I have brought these two rams for you.' The Prophet said: 'Why did you trouble yourself?' The Prophet took one...

brh: براہوئی عنایت لہڑی کا
en: Brahui, by Inayat Lehri.
en_old: Brahui, by Inayat Lehri.

brh: کہتے ہیں کہ براہوی موہنجودڑو اور مہرگڑھ جیسی عظیم شہروں کو جنم دینی والی سندھو تہذیب کے قدیم زبان ہی یہ دنیا کے واحد زبان ہی جس مین موسیقی کے سرگرم کے سروں کے معنی بھی موجود ہی
en: It is said that Brahui is the ancient language of the Indus civilization, which gave birth to great cities like Mohenjo-daro and Mehrgarh. It is the only language in the world in which the notes of the musical sargam also have meanings.
en_old: It is said that Brahui is the ancient language of the Indus civilisation that gave birth to great cities like Mohenjo-daro and Mehrgarh; it is the only language in the world in which the notes of the musical scale also have meanings.

brh: براہوئی اسکالروں کا خیال ہی کہ موسیقی کے سات سروں کے الفاظ ایک دوسرے سے تھوڑا سا جوڑنے سے براہوئی زبان مین آن کے باقاعدہ معنی نکلتی ہی جیسے کہ سا رے کو اگر ایک لفظ مانا جائی تو ئس کے براہوئی مین معنی ہوگی
en: Brahui scholars believe that if the syllables of the seven musical notes are joined a little to one another, they produce proper meanings in the Brahui language. For example, if 'sa re' is taken as one word, its meaning in Brahui would be...
en_old: Brahui scholars believe that by joining the words of the seven musical notes slightly to one another, proper meanings emerge in the Brahui language; for example, if 'sa re' is taken as one word, it would have a meaning in Brahui.

brh: دھی، سنبھال کے، خیال سے، دھیرج سے۔ ئس طرح گاہ، ما ایک دوسرے سے مل کر جو لفظ بناتے ہیں، ئس کے براہوی مین معنی ہی آہستہ، آرام سے، سکون سے۔ پا کے معنی ہی
en: ...dhi: carefully, with care, with patience. In the same way, 'ga' and 'ma' together form a word whose meaning in Brahui is slowly, gently, calmly. 'Pa' means...
en_old: Dha: carefully, with attention, with patience. In this way, 'ga' and 'ma', when joined together, form a word which in Brahui means slowly, gently, calmly. 'Pa' means

brh: کہو، بولو یا گاؤ۔ دا کے معنی ہی یہ۔ نی کے معنی ہی آپ یا تم۔ ئس طرح سا رے گا ما پا دا نی براہوی زبان مین ایک جملہ بنتا ہی جس کے معنی ہی
en: say, speak, or sing. 'Da' means 'this'. 'Ni' means 'you'. In this way, 'sa re ga ma pa da ni' forms a sentence in the Brahui language whose meaning is...
en_old: say, speak, or sing. 'Da' means 'this'. 'Ni' means 'you'. In this way, 'sa re ga ma pa da ni' forms a sentence in the Brahui language, whose meaning is

brh: دا سر نا زیانی بلو عیب او ایلو اسباب ہیکہ چار سر نا ئے دے کریٹ چار سر نا دونگی
en: The loss of this note is a big flaw, and the other reason is that I made it with four notes, a four-note [scale].
en_old: The loss of this note is a big flaw; and the other reason is that they made it of four notes, this four-note thing.

brh: دا چار سر ارے نا، دا سا کے رے را تھاٹ نی دا تھاٹ ایسن سیکھتہ کپائینگے، جتے ایس سور تو دا تھاٹ کپائینگے
en: There are these four notes, right? This 'sa, ke, re, ra' thaat: you can't learn this thaat like that. Until you have these notes, you won't get this thaat.
en_old: These are four notes, right? This 'sa', 'ke', 're', 'ra' — the thaat (scale); you cannot learn this thaat like that; only when the notes are there can this thaat be learned.

brh: قدیم دورے ننتو وختی ننتو دا دروشم موجود ء ننا خلقی ٹی براہوئی راگ اٹی دا رے صحیح قدیم اٹی ننا مہری خلقی دور اٹی ننا مہری اور جدید اٹی ہم دا سکرے دا ٹھیک رے بالکل براہوئی نا واقعتا ترانہ اسے ٹی ننا دا تے لوکن دا سا افسوس رے صحیح
en: In the ancient era, among us, early on, among us, this form existed. In our folk [music], in Brahui raga, this is right. In the ancient [era], in our Mehri (Mehrgarh) village era, our Mehri [era], and in the modern [era] too, this... this is quite right, absolutely. In a truly Brahui anthem of ours, these... but this, sadly, is right.
en_old: In ancient times, when this form existed among us, in our people, in Brahui raga — this, right, in the truly ancient, in our people's tribal period and in the modern one too, this — right, this is absolutely correct: in a truly Brahui anthem, these folk things of ours — this, sadly, right.

brh: پانے داسہ مکے مئے تمبر اسے ٹلٹ موسی ٹلس یا پین اسے ٹلس پانے داسہ نی داسہ پا ماما مارے پا گارے سا پا گانام سر ریٹتے ریٹتے
en: He says, now [play] a tambura with a beat, a three-beat or some other beat. He says, now you, now: 'pa ma ma ma re pa ga re sa pa ga', repeating the notes over and over.
en_old: He says, now pick up a tambur, pick up some instrument or another thing; he says now you, now 'pa ma ma ma re pa ga re sa pa', singing the notes over and over.

brh: دا قبر رینا مریٹ تے سامرا کے کنج شنیج سکیل دا کمرے ریٹ تے نی داسا پا داسا نی پا ماما مارے پا گارے سا پا
en: This... the scale... repeating it: you now 'pa', now 'ni pa ma ma ma re pa ga re sa pa'.
en_old: This ... in the room, you now 'pa', now 'ni pa ma ma ma re pa ga re sa pa'.

brh: اچھا گارے ساپانا مطلب؟ گارے ساپا گچٹ یعنی گارے مٹی۔ تو ہندن دا صورتئے پارے داڑ تو وار را کہ ننا لئی۔ صحیح۔ سائیں نی ہنداڑے داڑے دا سبلا ٹھیک ہی تین تال نا پاراتے مسے تالی مسے تاڑی، ٹھیک ہی نا؟ تال۔ دا سدا کرے
en: OK, what does 'gare sapa' mean? 'Gare sapa'... that is, 'gare' means mud. So in this way he explained this form, that it is ours. Right. Sir, you, here, this is right: teen taal is called 'musi tali, musi taari', three claps, isn't it? Taal. He always did it this way.
en_old: Okay, what does 'gare sapa' mean? 'Gare sapa' is picked up, meaning 'gare' is soil. So in this way he says this form, that this is ours. Right. Sir, you here, this is right; in three beats he said it became 'tali', it became 'tari', right? Taal. He made this call.

brh: خلق دادنا براہوئی ٹی دادنا یہ کس کا؟ نوم انگلش آن ماشاء اللہ تینا ایلور نن خلقی ء بندہ آن تینا ظاہر ہی براہوئی لٹریچر اٹ این ئے ایم فل اسکالر اسے۔ داڑ توار دادنا نا دنا؟ ظاہر ہی بنیاد دا موسیقی تالی پارتے دا
en: Whose is this in Brahui? Whose is it? You are from English, mashallah, your own... we are village people... obviously you are an MPhil scholar in Brahui literature. So whose sound is this? Obviously its basis is this music; they called it 'tali'.
en_old: People, in this Brahui, whose is this? His name in English — Masha'Allah, his other... we people, from a person his evident... he is an MPhil scholar in Brahui literature. So then whose is this? Obviously the basis is this music, the tali, he said this.

brh: دانا کرے اسٹ دا مسٹ دادے مسٹ تا الپارے مسٹ چار مسٹ تال دانا مقصد دادے اولیکو راک ماترایت او دے پارہ برام اینی دے سنسکرت ٹی یا تروم ناٹی
en: Of this: one, this is three, this is three; he called it 'taal': three, four, three, taal. Its meaning is this: the first is raga, by matra [beat count]; they call this 'Brahm' in Sanskrit or in...
en_old: Of this: one, it became this; it became this, three it became, four it became — the beat. Its purpose is this: the first, 'matra', he says 'Brahm', this in Sanskrit or in Dravidian.

brh: برے رے ٹی ٹی کیٹ ناگ ناگ دا گڑاک برے رے دا گری لفظاک براہوئی تو ایلو تخیرے زرے آ گہ نن ہورین دنیا نا سنسکرت تمپائے کوٹیو نا بمانی جوڑ مفک اینو براہوئی ٹو نا بمانی ارے انت کرے صحیح امیر و سے زبان سے
en: 'Bare re ti ti kit nag nag': these things, 'bare re', these few words in Brahui... if you put them side by side and we look a little, in the world's Sanskrit their meaning doesn't fit; today in Brahui they do have a meaning. What does that show? Right: a rich language.
en_old: 'Bare re ti ti kit nag nag', these then 'bare re', these few words in Brahui — if we look, the world's Sanskrit cannot be matched with it; today in Brahui this meaning exists, what has it done, right, a rich language.

brh: کہ محبوب نا دعا اللہ زو قبول کیک، ئے ارا غا سرمفوٹ محبوب نا دعا قبول مریک، ئے چنائے خمٹی کپوٹ کہ محبوب نا دعا قبول مریک، آئی پارے چنائے محبوب تینا مون اٹی خا حضرت آن سے حضور دعا خوان آئی آتے
en: ...that Allah quickly accepts the Beloved's prayer. 'I will not go home until the Beloved's prayer is accepted; I will not [take] my child away until the Beloved's prayer is accepted.' The mother said, 'Child, the Beloved is right in front of you,' and she asked the Hazrat: 'Prophet, pray for him.'
en_old: that Allah quickly accepts the Beloved's prayer; I had not realized that the Beloved's prayer is accepted; I had not even thought as a child that the Beloved's prayer is accepted. She said, 'Child, the Beloved is before you; go to the Prophet, let the Prophet make dua for you.'

brh: ئے اللہ دانسی ئے اللہ دا چنائے برکت والو زکس اللہ اللہ دانہ چنا اولاد اور مال ٹی برکت شاس مال تبے باز مرے تو اولاد تم باز مرے رب کعبہ نا قسم حضرت انس پانے
en: 'O Allah, this... O Allah, make this child blessed. Allah, Allah, put blessing into this child's offspring and wealth; may his wealth be plentiful and may his children also be many.' By the Lord of the Kaaba, Hazrat Anas says:
en_old: O Allah, this one... O Allah, bless this child... Allah, Allah, grant this child blessing in offspring and wealth; may his wealth be plentiful and may his children be many. By the Lord of the Kaaba, Hazrat Anas says

brh: ئے داسہ کنا پیری نا ٹائم ئے لیکن دا ثمر و قصہ دن کنا چناک زیادہ او نواسہ کڑاسہ غاک دا کنا محبوب نا دعا ئے حضور دعا خوانا اولاد کن کنا نواسہ کڑاسہ غاک کنا غا باز مسور قصہ دن
en: 'Now it is the time of my old age, but this is the fruit [of it], and the story is this: my children are many, and my grandchildren too. This is my Beloved's prayer: the Prophet prayed for my offspring, and my grandchildren have become very many; that is the story.'
en_old: Now it is the time of my old age, but this fruit and this story — my children, and even more my grandsons and granddaughters — this is my Beloved's prayer; the Prophet prayed for my offspring; my grandsons and granddaughters have become many, the story

brh: ہم بڑزا مسر اللہ سئیں مال ہم باز تس کنے دولت ہم باز تس کنے حضرت اسپانٹی اللہ نا پین ہم مہربانی اسے ایلو تا باغ کنا باغ ئس ہسکا ایلو تا باغ ئس کا ایلو تا باغ دوازدہ توغے فصل اسے ہرا کنا باغ شش تو
en: '...have grown up too. Allah the Lord gave me plenty of wealth and plenty of riches too.' Hazrat says: 'There is another kindness of Allah too: others had gardens and I had a garden; others' gardens gave one crop in twelve months, while my garden [gave one] in six months.'
en_old: also grew. Allah gave me plenty of wealth, plenty of riches. Hazrat said, there is one more favor of Allah: others' gardens — my garden was one, others' gardens were others; others' gardens gave one crop in twelve months, while my garden in six.

brh: ئے فضل ئس کہ کنا محمد عربی نا دعا قبول ئس درو نا بیست نہ نی ملے، اینو ہم نن سیر آن محبوب نا خاطر، لنگڑا فون، کہ کلمہ ارے نن تون، الحمد للہ دا زی بھلو خزانہ ئس نن تون ارے، حضرت انس پانٹی
en: 'It was a grace that the prayer of my Muhammad the Arab was accepted... Today too we are full for the Beloved's sake; we are not hungry, for we have the Kalima with us. Praise be to Allah, this very great treasure is with us,' Hazrat Anas says.
en_old: O grace, that my Muhammad the Arab's prayer was accepted... I did not get... Today too we, for the sake of the Beloved, ... that we have the Kalima with us, Alhamdulillah, this great treasure is with us, Hazrat Anas said.

brh: ایلو تپ باغ آک سالئی تینا میوہ ئس اوڑان وقتس کم وقتس باز لیکن کنا فضل کنا بخشش تو ایتن فصل ء تیار کرے کنا محبوب نا دعا آن برک حضور دعا ء خواننگٹی حضرت ئس پارے اللہ نا
en: 'Others' gardens gave their fruit once a year, sometimes less, sometimes more. But by the grace and bounty upon me, [my garden] made its crop ready twice, through the blessing of my Beloved's prayer, the Prophet's praying.' Hazrat said, 'Allah's...'
en_old: Other gardens gave their fruit once a year, sometimes less, sometimes more, but my grace, my blessing — it produced crop twice, by the blessing of my Beloved's prayer, the Prophet making dua. Hazrat said, Allah's

brh: خدا نا قسم کنا باغ ٹی سے پھل نا درخت ئس اسکا ہنو پھل ہر باغ ٹی اسکا لیکن اوتا خوشبو کم اوتس ہرموڑس گڑانے خوشبو بسکا لیکن کنا باغ ٹی کہ ہمو پھل اسکا ہنو مشک نا خوشبوئی کرے کا کلو میٹر
en: 'By God, in my garden there was a fruit tree. The same fruit was in every garden, but their fragrance was weak; barely any fragrance came from them. But in my garden that same fruit gave off the fragrance of musk, which carried for a kilometer.'
en_old: By God, in my garden there was a tree of a fruit — the same fruit was in every garden, but their fragrance was little, no one anywhere could smell their fragrance; but in my garden that same fruit was there, and it gave the fragrance of musk for a kilometer.

brh: داسہ مروار حمید نی خوشبو سرمست کا باغ نا ئے گونہ غزل ہمیدا خوشبو سرمست کا دا کمال کنا اللہ تا کنا پاک محمد عربی نا دعا ئس اوڑا نن نن پیا انت گنتی ارے نی کہ دنو نبی ئس ننے ملا لیکن اللہ ننے حیات ایت کے نن
en: Now... that very fragrance goes through the garden, intoxicating; like a ghazal, that very fragrance goes, intoxicating. This is the miracle of my Allah; the prayer of my pure Muhammad the Arab was upon it. What worth do we have, that we were given such a Prophet? But Allah gives us life so that we...
en_old: Now... Hamid, the fragrance intoxicates the garden... a ghazal, the fragrance intoxicates... this is the wonder of my Allah, of my pure Muhammad the Arab's prayer there; we... what count are we, that we should have found the Prophet, but Allah gave us life, we

brh: نبی درست کے نبی نا پاننگ آ ہلن۔ نماز متونے نبی درست کتوس۔ باوہ لمہ ئے تتوس تو نبی تتوس۔ باوہ لمہ نا نافرمانی کریس تو نہ نبی ئے چاسس نہ خدائے چاسس۔ ہمسایہ نا عزت متونے نبی تتوس۔
en: Recognize the Prophet; heed the Prophet's words. If you haven't prayed, you haven't recognized the Prophet. If you did not acknowledge your father and mother, you did not know the Prophet. If you disobeyed your father and mother, you knew neither the Prophet nor God. If you haven't honored your neighbor, you did not know the Prophet.
en_old: Affirm the Prophet; walk according to the Prophet's words. If you did not pray, you did not affirm the Prophet. If you did not recognize your father and mother, you did not recognize the Prophet. If you disobeyed your father and mother, you neither knew the Prophet nor knew God. If you did not honor your neighbor, you did not know the Prophet.

brh: اگر بندہ غاتون ظلم کرے زیادتی کرے تو نبی تے توس ہمو کنا محبوبہ حضرت ابوہریرہ پانٹی کنا لمہ کفرٹی مسلمان محبوب نا خدمت برے وا حضرت ابوہریرہ ہمو صحابی کنا محبوب نا
en: If you oppress people and wrong them, then you have not known the Prophet. That [companion] of my Beloved, Hazrat Abu Hurairah, says: 'My mother was in unbelief, while I, a Muslim, would come into the service of the Beloved.' That Hazrat Abu Hurairah, that Companion of my Beloved...
en_old: If one oppresses a person, does injustice to him, then he has not known the Prophet. That beloved of mine, Hazrat Abu Hurairah, says: my mother was in disbelief while I, a Muslim, would go into the service of the Beloved. That Hazrat Abu Hurairah, that Companion of my Beloved...

brh: پین نا خلنگٹ مسٹ آ، پین نا خلنگٹ مسٹ آ، کہ مسجد نبوی نا نمازی نا ٹکا کسری تماٹا، بے ہوش مسٹ لنگڑی غان، ہٹو بیماری سلو کنے، بینگن نا کھپاز مسٹ آ، سا آ
en: 'I would be stricken by hunger, I would be stricken by hunger, so that I would collapse in the way of the worshippers at the Prophet's Mosque. I would faint from hunger; [people thought] some illness had seized me. I was utterly famished...'
en_old: I was struck with hunger, I was struck with hunger, so that I would fall down among the worshippers in the Prophet's Mosque; I would fall unconscious from hunger; they would say a sickness had seized me; I had become like the dried shell of an eggplant.

brh: صحابہ صفہ نا شاگرد ئس مسوٹ آ پاک محمد نا شاگرد ئس مسوٹ آ تینا نبی تون خواناٹ اللہ نا قرآنے خواناٹ لیکن ئنا حال ئس کہ پچ جان نا نلوکا اسے چادر ٹی تینے گزارو کرینا لیکن
en: 'I was a student of the Companions of the Suffa; I was a student of the pure Muhammad. I studied with my Prophet; I studied Allah's Quran. But our condition was such that five people would get by under a single sheet. But...'
en_old: The Companions were students of the Suffah, students of the pure Muhammad; they learned from their Prophet, they learned Allah's Quran, but their condition was such that five people would get by wrapping themselves in a single sheet, but...

brh: ننا نماز آ کم قضا متورا، ننا تہجد آ کم قضا متورا، نن دہ دہ سپارہ قران ہم خوانانہ، مچو دے اللہ نا ذکر ہم کرینہ، محبوب نا خدمت ہم کرینہ، حضور نا چوٹ مبارک آتہ
en: 'Our prayers were hardly ever missed, our tahajjud was hardly ever missed. We would each recite ten sipāras of the Quran, we would remember Allah the whole day, and we would serve the Beloved too. The Prophet's blessed shoes...'
en_old: Our prayers were rarely missed, our tahajjud was rarely missed; we would also recite ten parts of the Quran, remember Allah all day long, and serve the Beloved too; the blessed hair of the Prophet...

brh: ۔۔۔رفینا، محبوب مرے پارے کمون کرینا، حضور پارے کا بش مبا بش مسنا، حضور پارے کا تول بتو تولانا، حضور پارے کا دے پارے کا ننے نن پارے نن ننے، اگر ننے پاروس دے تو نن پارے نی دے
en: '...[we would] carry. Whatever the Beloved said to do, we would do. If the Prophet said, "Stand up," we would stand up; if the Prophet said, "Sit," we would sit; if the Prophet said "day"... if he said it was night, we said it was night; if he had told us it was day, we would have said, "Day, as you say."'
en_old: ...we go; the Beloved says 'Do this,' we do it; the Prophet says 'Do not get up,' we do not get up; the Prophet says 'Sit,' we sit; the Prophet says 'day,' we say 'day'; he says 'night,' we say 'night'; if he said 'night' is 'day,' we would say, 'Yes, day.'

brh: امرے محبوب پارے کمو نن کرینا حضرت ابو ہریرہ پارے لمہ کنا محبوب کلمہ خوانتا او کنا خنتن کھڑی کا دعا ئے کنا لمہ انس گنتن موقع تباہ کلیندیوس لمہ قیامت اچلا کنن کا پوٹ لمہ
en: Whatever the Beloved said to do, we did. Hazrat Abu Hurairah said: 'Mother, recite my Beloved's Kalima.' And with tears in my eyes I pray: 'My mother, don't waste this chance; Mother, on the Day of Judgment I won't be able to [help you], Mother.'
en_old: Whatever the Beloved says, that we do. Hazrat Abu Hurairah said: 'Mother, my Beloved... recite the Kalimah.' She saw me standing there... 'I pray for you, Mother... Mother, do not ruin this chance, Mother; who will stand you up on the Day of Judgment, Mother?'

brh: لمہ قبر ٹی نا سیچ ڈاکننگ کپوٹ لمہ قبر نا عذاب ٹی نی بچفنگ کپوٹ کنا لمہ نی کان کنتو محبوب نا کان تو سہی محمد مصطفی نا خدمت ٹی بر تو سہی پانے کلمہ خوانپلک نی محمد نا دیدار کر تو سہی لمہ پارے ککنے ولدا دن پاپا
en: 'Mother, I won't be able to [help] you in the grave; Mother, I won't be able to save you from the torment of the grave. My mother, come, let's go together to the Beloved; just come into the service of Muhammad Mustafa.' She says she won't recite the Kalima. 'Then just come and see Muhammad.' The mother said, 'Don't say such things to me again.'
en_old: 'Mother, who will light up your grave? Mother, who will save you from the torment of the grave? My mother, come with me to the Beloved, come into the service of Muhammad Mustafa; I say, recite the Kalimah; behold Muhammad.' Mother said, 'Get away from me; don't say it again; go away.'

brh: داڑے فیل و حلا، پیدا دے نی درتینگکن، دادے ئے تینگدیو، دادے نی تینگکندر، کنا محبوبا، دوتے بڑزا کرے کتو جنا کمینارا، محبوب دوتے بڑزا کرے کتو گنوکا کمسیدارا سرا، امو بندواک
en: Here ... [unclear] ... the day of birth ... [unclear: 'this one ... you give, this one you ...'] ... my Beloved raised his hands ... [unclear]; the Beloved raised his hands over the head of the mad one ... those people ...
en_old: Here the elephant... the day you were born... this one you gave, this one you... my beloved raised his two hands... he raised them over the wretched... my beloved raised his two hands over the sinners, the lowly... these servants...

brh: کہ پاک محمد نا چہرہ نا دشمن کسرا نبی نا چہرہ خنن اللہ نا ذات نا قسم پاک محمد نا مون ئے اوغار خنتن کھڑی شولار حضور نا قدماتے تمار کلمہ خوانار مسلمان مسار۔ جمعہ نا دے ئس انت نا دے وا؟
en: ...that even the enemies of holy Muhammad, on the road, would see the Prophet's face; by the essence of Allah, when they saw the face of holy Muhammad they [unclear], fell at Hazrat's feet, recited the kalima and became Muslims. It was a Friday — what day was it?
en_old: ...that even the enemies of the holy Muhammad's face, when they saw the Prophet's face — by the essence of Allah — when they looked at the holy Muhammad's face, they would stand up and bow, fall at the Prophet's feet, recite the kalima and become Muslims. It was a Friday — what day was it?

brh: مزنوی ٹی کل تولوکو اخ دے پیر بندے درخت آک بار سور مال تے دیر الو بندغاتے دیر الو فصل تباہ اسے بدویس بش مس حضور خطبہ تننگ ٹی مجمع پارا یا رسول اللہ
en: In the Prophet's Mosque everyone was sitting. For so many days the rain had stopped; the trees had dried up, the livestock had no water, the people had no water, the crops were ruined. A Bedouin stood up while Hazrat was giving the sermon, and said before the gathering: 'O Messenger of Allah ...'
en_old: In Medina everyone was sitting; for so many days it had not rained, the trees had dried up, the livestock had no water, the people had no water, the crops were destroyed. A Bedouin stood up while the Prophet was giving the sermon in the gathering and said: O Messenger of Allah...

brh: اللہ پئے ہنسی خیری پئے یا رسول اللہ بندغاک تباہ مسر حیساداراک تباہ مسر یا رسول اللہ دیرم بے دیرین تباہی مس پھر کپا کخوت یا رسول اللہ فصلاک ننا تباہ مسر مال ک
en: 'For Allah's sake, [unclear], for goodness' sake! O Messenger of Allah, the people are ruined, the animals are ruined. O Messenger of Allah, there is water no more — from lack of water ruin has come, it does not rain. O Messenger of Allah, our crops are ruined, the livestock ...'
en_old: Allah... 'O Messenger of Allah, the servants are ruined, the livestock are ruined; O Messenger of Allah, the land has gone dry, ruin has come... the drought... O Messenger of Allah, our crops are ruined, our wealth...'

brh: ننا ملاسینکی کینٹی او امام لمبیا پارے ہاں دعا خوانا ئے اللہ بندغاتے دیر ضرورت ء اللہ جنگل نا ساداتن دیر ضرورت ء اللہ درختاکن دیر خوارا اللہ نی تون کمی اف نی تون ہر گڑا بازی
en: '[Pray] for our thirst.' That Imam of the Prophets said, 'Yes,' and prayed: 'O Allah, the people need water; O Allah, the animals of the wild need water; O Allah, the trees want water; O Allah, with You there is no shortage, with You everything is plentiful.'
en_old: Our ... that Imam said yes, and prayed: O Allah, the people need water; O Allah, the wild animals of the jungle need water; O Allah, the trees are thirsty for water; O Allah, there is no shortage with You, You have everything in abundance.

brh: اینا محمد عربی دعا خوانے ٹی اللہ پیری شروع کا صحابہ پار اللہ نا ذات نا قسم ہمو تم مال و آسمان صاف وس کا خبرے تم تو تارمے شروع مس جمر آک شروع مسر پیرم شروع مس حضور نا جان ت دیر شروع مسر صحابہ تا جان ت دیر شروع مس
en: Now, as Muhammad the Arabian was praying, Allah started the rain. The Companions said: by the essence of Allah, at that moment the sky was completely clear; who knows at what moment darkness began, the clouds began, the rain began; water began running over Hazrat's body, water began running over the Companions' bodies.
en_old: Now, as Muhammad the Arabian was praying, Allah started the rain. The Companions said: by the essence of Allah, at that time the sky was completely clear; we don't know when the darkness began, the clouds began, the rain began, water began running on the Prophet's body, water began running on the Companions' bodies.

brh: مسر ہر کس تینا من خوشی ٹی پیش تما کہ ملک ننا آباد مرے را، فصل ننا آباد مرے را، دونتے ٹی دیر تمے، اینان خلقاتے جمعہ نا دے پھر کرے، ہفتہ نا دے پھر کرے، یک شنبہ نا دے پھر کرے، پھر کرسا پھر کرسا ولدا جمعہ نا
en: ...began. Everyone came out with joy in their hearts, (saying) that our land will flourish, our crops will flourish, water will fall into the wells. From then on, for the people it rained on Friday, it rained on Saturday, it rained on Sunday, it kept raining and raining, until again on the Friday ...
en_old: It happened; everyone went forward with joy in their hearts, saying our land will flourish, our crops will flourish, water came into the wells. Then it rained on the people on Friday, it rained on Saturday, it rained on Sunday, it kept raining and raining until the next Friday.

brh: ہمس یکہ پھر کننگ ٹی ء، دڑوک دیر ٹی نار، اوڑاک دیر ٹی نار، مالاک دیر ٹی نار، فصلاک دیر ٹی بڈل کر، ولدا حضور خطبہ غا سلوک ء، بش مس پارے سائیں دلبر نبی، ئے گل پاک محمد عربی، ارانگ ضرورت ء پھر نا۔
en: With the rain falling continuously like that, the low-lying places went under water, the houses went under water, the livestock went under water, the crops drowned in the water. Again Hazrat was standing for the sermon; (the man) stood up and said: 'Sir, beloved Prophet, O flower, holy Muhammad the Arabian, where is there any need for rain?'
en_old: With that same continuous raining, the paths went under water, the houses went under water, the livestock went under water, the crops drowned in water. Again the Prophet was standing for the sermon; (a man) stood up and said: Sir, beloved Prophet, O flower, holy Muhammad the Arabian, where is any need for rain now?

brh: سئیں نن سیر کرین سئیں اوڑاک نان بڈل کل، مالک نان بڈل کل، بندہ غاک شریں کپسہ، معبود دعا خوان کے پھر نن ایلی، حضور جھم کرے، ارانگ ضرورت ارے ہمونگ جمر در، پھر ہمونگ در، داتے ضرورت اف ئے امت
en: 'Sir, we have had our fill; sir, our houses have all drowned, our livestock have all drowned, the people are not well. Pray to the Lord that the rain leaves us.' Hazrat gestured: 'Wherever there is need, take the clouds there, take the rain there; these people of my Ummah have no need of it.'
en_old: Sir, we are satisfied; sir, our houses have drowned, our livestock have drowned, do not let the people perish; pray to the Lord that the rain leaves us. The Prophet raised his hands: wherever there is need, take the clouds there, take the rain there; these people do not need it, O Ummah.

brh: مدینہ تار مئی چس کا حضور نا دعا نا خاطرن اشار نا خاطرن امو تار مئی ختم مس ہردم ٹی مچو مدینہ ظاہر مس جاگہ آک ظاہر مسر جمر الہی نا پھر الہی نا مچو مدینہ علاقہ مچو
en: Medina was in darkness; because of Hazrat's prayer, because of his gesture, that darkness ended, and in an instant all of Medina came into view, the places came into view; the divine clouds, the divine rain ... all of Medina, the whole area ...
en_old: Medina was entirely dark; for the sake of the Prophet's prayer, for the sake of his gesture, that darkness ended at that very moment; all of Medina became visible at once, the places became visible; the divine clouds, the divine rain, all of Medina, the whole region...

brh: نی روشن ئے روش مسپک نا پاک محمد عربی نا دعا خو نن اینو دعا خوانر گڑمتو اچڑا داسے نا ملا کھسکر انیل بچانس نیم کھاوس دعا کے نی لگتو ملا کھسکر نی حلال کن
en: ...is bright ... [unclear]. That was the prayer of holy Muhammad the Arabian; but when we pray today, nothing happens, nothing at all. Today's mullah ... [unclear] ... half ... 'pray' ... [unclear] ... 'mullah, ... you make it halal.'
en_old: You are the light, the one who gives light. That was the prayer of the holy Muhammad the Arabian; but when we pray today, (it is) ... a mullah of today, a crook, ... pray that ... 'mullah, you keep it, you make it halal'...

brh: خدا تینا دعا قبول مرے محبوب نا دعاس کا دا کائنات نا نبی ئس قیامت ئے انشاءاللہ ایلو نبی تے قومک پٹور مرسلو گھنور ددینگور ننا محمد عربی ننتون اوار مرو پا انشاءاللہ او بے
en: May God accept our prayers. It is the prayer of the Beloved, who is the Prophet of this universe. On the Day of Judgment, God willing, the nations will be searching for the other prophets, the messengers ... [unclear], but our Muhammad the Arabian will be with us — say, God willing! He ...
en_old: May God accept His beloved's prayer; he is the Prophet of this universe. On the Day of Judgment, God willing, the nations of the other prophets will search for them, the messengers will be taken and brought along, but our Muhammad the Arabian will be with us; say insha'Allah, he is without...

brh: کنے خبر کہ سندھ نا بندغاک دادے بازو محمد علی سندھی نا وعظ کیا پوء وڑنی تو مونجھو واسطو نہ ہی ئے تے خفتئو و کنا ایلم آک ہمو نبی کہ نی کنے ملا رب کعبہ نا قسم ہچو قوم سے تنو نبی
en: I know that the people of Sindh have listened a lot to this, to Muhammad Ali Sindhi's preaching: '[Sindhi:] then you have nothing to do with me' ... And my brothers, that Prophet you have been given — by the Lord of the Kaaba, no nation has been given such a prophet ...
en_old: I know that the people of Sindh have today listened to a lot of Muhammad Ali Sindhi's preaching; 'then there is no connection to me,' ... and my brothers, that Prophet whom you have been given — by the Lord of the Kaaba — no nation has been given such a prophet...

brh: ئے ملتو کہ اللہ نا کنا زی مہربانی ہمو پاک انگا نبی صحاباک پانٹ یا رسول اللہ قربان مرین نیکے مدینہ ٹی محبوب انگانے صحاباک ہجرت کریر مدینہ غے بسر صحاباک مکہ غان مدینہ غے بسر مدینہ ٹی بیماری
en: ...was given, for it is Allah's kindness upon me — that pure Prophet. The Companions say: 'O Messenger of Allah, may we be sacrificed for you!' In Medina — the beloved Companions migrated and came to Medina; the Companions came from Mecca to Medina; in Medina, sickness ...
en_old: ...was obtained; that Allah's mercy upon me is that pure Prophet. The Companions said: O Messenger of Allah, may we be sacrificed for you. In Medina, the beloved ... the Companions migrated, they came to Medina; the Companions came from Mecca to Medina; in Medina there was sickness.

brh: مکہ ٹی مسس صحابہ کہ مکہ غان مدینہ غا بسر بیمار مسر بیمار مسر داغان سردی ہم زور داغان بیماری لگائنا ایلو مکہ ئیلاسر پیدا مکہ ٹی مسسر است تا مکہ غا اسکا مدینہ غا استے تلک توکا مکہ غا
en: ...had been in Mecca. The Companions who came from Mecca to Medina fell ill, they fell ill; here the cold was also severe, here the sickness struck them; besides, they had left Mecca, they had been born in Mecca; their hearts were in Mecca, and though in Medina, their hearts were drawn to Mecca.
en_old: The Companions who had been in Mecca, who came from Mecca to Medina, fell ill, fell ill; the cold here was also severe, the sickness here caught them; besides, they were people of Mecca, born in Mecca; their hearts were in Mecca, and though they were in Medina their hearts were pulled toward Mecca.

brh: مکہ نا محبت باز ئس کا بش مسر مکہ یاد بس کا زونڈار مکہ یاد بس کا دا اینگنہ بیماری تنگ کرے تا اینگنہ مکہ نا محبت پدی درے کتا اینار حضور نا خدمت یا رسول اللہ سائیں نن بیمار مسنون سائیں مکہ ننے با
en: Their love of Mecca was so great that when they stood up they remembered Mecca, when they sat down they remembered Mecca. On this side the sickness troubled them, on that side the love of Mecca was pulling them back. They went into Hazrat's presence: 'O Messenger of Allah, sir, we have fallen ill; sir, [take] us to Mecca ...'
en_old: Their love of Mecca was great; when they stood up they remembered Mecca, when they sat down they remembered Mecca. On one side the sickness troubled them, on the other side the love of Mecca drove them mad. They came into the Prophet's service: O Messenger of Allah, sir, we have fallen ill; sir, take us to Mecca.

brh: داز یاد مننٹی امام لمہ دعا خوانا اللہ دا تپ بیماری مدینہ غان مر کر اللہ مدینہ ء بیمارین پاک کر اللہ دا تا استاتے مدینہ تون شا صحابہ غاک پارہ اللہ نا ذات نا قسم انن کہ محبوب دعا پورا کرے ننا اوستی مدینہ
en: Remembering this, the Imam of the Ummah prayed: 'O Allah, remove this fever and sickness from Medina; O Allah, cleanse Medina of sickness; O Allah, settle their hearts in Medina.' The Companions said: by the essence of Allah, as soon as the Beloved finished the prayer, our hearts ... Medina ...
en_old: Remembering this, the Imam of the Ummah prayed: O Allah, remove this fever sickness from Medina; O Allah, purify Medina of sickness; O Allah, make their hearts content with Medina. The Companions said: by the essence of Allah, as soon as the beloved completed the prayer, our hearts settled in Medina.

brh: بس مکن اینے نا بیماری کم کل ہنار۔ دنو زیبا نبی سن اینے ملا۔ لیکن کنا ایلم آک دا تو انے نو دارو دے خو کھرینگا دارو ٹی فائدہ ارے۔ ابا کھرینگا دارو ٹی شوگر
en: ...came (to rest in Medina, away) from Mecca; the sickness lessened and all went away. Such a beautiful Prophet you have been given. But my brothers, as for this sweet medicine — well, there is benefit in bitter medicine. Yes, in bitter medicine, for diabetes ...
en_old: Enough — the sickness of the body lessened and went away. Such a beautiful Prophet you have been given. But my brothers, this is ... well, medicine — there is benefit in English (Western) medicine. Yes, in English medicine, diabetes...

brh: شوگر والا ئے کھرینو اتھرے یا ہنینو کھرینو کھرینو بابا کھرینو اور سے تو است کھنڈ روا مود لیٹوئی شوگر والا ئے کھرینو او بیماری ننا تٹی بازرے دیخہ کھرینو دارو ہم مرے لیکن ئے تے بمبو قران مچو ہنینو آ قران مچو
en: For a diabetic, is (the medicine) bitter or sweet? Bitter, bitter, sir, bitter ... [unclear] ... for a diabetic, bitter. That disease is very common among us; so the medicine may be a little bitter too, but listen: the whole Quran is sweet, the Quran — all of it is sweet.
en_old: Is diabetes an English disease or ours? English, English, sir, English... (unintelligible) ... diabetes is English; that disease is plentiful among us, so let there be English medicine too, but ... the whole Quran is ours, the whole Quran is ours.

brh: خرینن ئنا وجن کہ قران نا دیخ مورسلو کن اگر قران سمجھن نا توحیدی اللہ نا ذاتن قسم دنو ہنینو گڑانے دنیا ٹی ملتو دا تو کلام محبوبی ایلو نبی تم گپاتے بے معنی
en: ...bitter; the reason is that the Quran ... [unclear] ... if we understand the Quran and its oneness of God — by the essence of Allah, no such sweet thing is found in the world. This is indeed the word of the Beloved; the words of the other prophets ... meaningless.
en_old: ...the reason being that the Quran's ... If one understands the Quran, the Oneness of Allah — by the essence of Allah — nothing like ours has been found in the world; this is the Word of the Beloved; the words of other prophets are meaningless in comparison.

brh: ئے زکریا نبی سلو کہ دعا خوانے ئے ابراہیم نبی سلو کہ دعا خوانے ابراہیم نی پیر مسنوس انت پاسا وقال انی ذاھب الے ربی سیھدین
en: Prophet Zakariya stood and prayed; Prophet Ibrahim stood and prayed. 'Ibrahim, you have grown old, what do you say?' 'And he said: Indeed, I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.'
en_old: Prophet Zakariya, peace be upon him, prayed; Prophet Ibrahim, peace be upon him, prayed. Ibrahim, you have grown old, what do you say? 'And he said: Indeed, I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.'

brh: نبی دعا خوانے مہربانی، نن و پین تے پانا مولوی ہمو کہ دعا
en: A prophet prays (and receives) mercy; as for us and others, the maulvi says that prayer ...
en_old: The Prophet prayed — mercy; we and others say... the maulvi, that prayer...

brh: خوارس بیگہ کنکے جندء خواپک ضرورت جندتا او مولوی دو مولوی تینکے خوائے کہ نیکین خوائے کہ بے مراد مولوی تینکن اوغک نیکین انتء اوغک نبی اللہ ابراہیم علیہ السلام پچھادی عمر ریش پیہ مسنے ئے
en: A poor man (comes) in the evening: '(pray) for me.' He does not ask himself, though the need is his own. That maulvi — does the maulvi ask for himself or does he ask for you? ... [unclear: 'without his wish'] ... The maulvi weeps for himself; why would he weep for you? The Prophet of Allah Ibrahim, peace be upon him, late in life — his beard had turned white.
en_old: He asked for it himself; he needed it for himself. Those mullahs ask for themselves – they ask for good; does a mullah ask for himself without any wish? What good is there in it? The Prophet of Allah, Ibrahim (peace be upon him), in his later years his beard had turned white.

brh: سد سالہ خوڑ کرے ضعیفاں ختم جنتم پیر لیکن اولاد اف اولاد دعا خوانک دیر توار کیک اللہ ئے ئے کنا اللہ ئے نا نبی ابراہیم اٹ ورنا ئے وٹ اینے توار کیو لیکن داسہ پیر
en: He came close to a hundred years old; weakness had worn him out, his body was old; but he had no offspring. He prays for offspring — whom does he call upon? Allah: 'O my Allah, I am Your prophet Ibrahim; I was young and I called on You, but now I am old ...'
en_old: He had reached a hundred years, weakness had worn him out, his body was old, but he had no children. He prays for a child, he calls out – who? "O my Allah! I am Your prophet Ibrahim; I called upon You when I was young, but now I am old."

brh: ئے مزل اللہ، اللہ لٹ زوٹی کنا، اللہ کمزور مسنوٹ، لیکن ارا کنا خالی، ئے ہمو کدو، کدو سب تاتی چوری معاف، جھکا تم چوری نا ضرورت ارے، جھکا تم اور چنا نا ضرورت
en: 'O Allah, Allah, the stick is in my hand; Allah, I have become weak, but my house is empty.' ... [unclear] ... At the time of stooping one needs a walking stick; at the time of stooping one also needs a child.
en_old: "O Allah, the staff is in my hand, I have become weak, but my lap is empty." At that time – when one is small, there is need; when one is small, there is need of a child.

brh: کرے اللہ نا نبی اوٹ پورا زندگی گدرینگا نی چھنا سے کنے توار کے واللہ ہی داسہ پچھاڑیے کنے رحم کر پیونا پٹھاتے کنے ہور پیونا ریشے کنے ہور اللہ پانڈے براہیما نی دعا خواناس پیرا سریٹی خدانا دعائے قبول کریٹ
en: 'I am Allah's prophet; my whole life has passed; I have called on You for a child. By Allah, now at the end have mercy on me — look at my white hair, look at my white beard.' Allah said: 'Ibrahim, you have prayed in your old age; I have accepted your prayer.'
en_old: "I am the Prophet of Allah; I have passed my whole life; I called upon You for a child. By Allah, now at the end have mercy on me – look at my white hair, look at my white beard." Allah said: "Ibrahim, you have prayed." In his old age God accepted his prayer.

brh: ورنائی ٹی تیوہ نی مرضی، پیری ٹی ایتو نی مرضی، پدا طاقت خدانے، اللہ زبارے ابراہیم، غٹ ٹی کپا، داسے نہ داسے نی چنا سے تیوہ، لیکن او چنا معمولی چنا ئس مفوئے، اسماعیل نبی دے رب، اسماعیل
en: 'Whether You give in youth is Your will, whether You give in old age is Your will; after all, power belongs to God.' Allah said: 'Ibrahim, do not [grieve]; sooner or later I will give you a child, but that child will not be an ordinary child — Ismail, a prophet of the Lord, Ismail.'
en_old: "Whether You give in youth is Your will, whether You give in old age is Your will; all power is God's." Allah said: "Ibrahim, do not be troubled; sooner or later I will give you a child, but that child will not be an ordinary child – Ismail, a prophet, O Lord, Ismail."

brh: اسلام نبی، نبی اللہ دعا خواہ نبی دعا خواہ نا، اللہ تستے چناس، اسماعیل پینور چناس تستا، زیبا، باوہ زیبا، مار زیبا، باوہ نبی، مارم نبی، نبی پاک کلن زیبا
en: A prophet of Islam. The Prophet of Allah prayed, and because the prophet prayed, Allah gave him a son — He gave him a son named Ismail: beautiful; the father beautiful, the son beautiful; the father a prophet, the son also a prophet; the holy prophet is the most beautiful of all.
en_old: A prophet of Islam; the Prophet of Allah prayed, and in answer to the prophet's prayer Allah gave him a child; He gave a child like Ismail – beautiful; the father beautiful, the son beautiful; the father a prophet, the son too a prophet; the holy prophets are all beautiful.

brh: ایوا مریرا نبی چنا کھیل جنگ کپسا نبی چنا کھیل کرینٹ کپسا نبی چنا کھیل غلط کارم کپسا نبی تے پیدامنی آن وٹی حفاظت رکاپا خدا نا زاتی او تن غلط کارم کرے پ
en: That is how they are: prophets, as children, do not fight at play; prophets, as children, do not play (cricket); prophets, as children, do not do wrong things at play. From their birth God's own Self keeps the prophets under protection, so that he does not do any wrong deed ...
en_old: There are no such prophets: a prophet does not fight as a child, a prophet does not play as a child, a prophet does not do wrong things as a child; God's own Self protects the prophets from their birth, so he never did any wrong.

brh: بلکہ بلنیٹی بندغ معیارے تورتا اڑے چنکیٹی دنو سدہ سالہ بزرگ جوڑ مسوس پان نبی کا ہر گناہ غان پاک اسماعیل علیہ السلام پیدا مس ابراہیم باز خوش گلان اینو چنک چنک چنک بل مس داسہ باونہ دوٹی الیک چھرینگک
en: Rather, a man (normally) attains that standard when grown up, whereas in childhood he had become like a hundred-year-old elder — a prophet, you see, is pure of every sin. Ismail, peace be upon him, was born. Ibrahim was overjoyed. Now, little by little, he grew up; now he holds his father's hand and walks about.
en_old: Rather, in old age a man loses his strength – the hundred-year-old elder had become like a child. Then, pure from every sin, Ismail (peace be upon him) was born. Ibrahim was overjoyed. Now the child grew little by little, by little, and now he holds his father's hand and walks about.

brh: دا سدو تفینے مار تڑپا ئے ابراہیمی حضرت ابراہیم پارے بے ایمان شیطان مرم کنے نر خلیو نی ٹک ٹک کیو نی ئے نبی تے شیطان بفسا کنے اللہ نا حکم ئے اڑے دا اسماعیل نا
en: [unclear] — "Don't slaughter the son, O Ibrahim." Hazrat Ibrahim said, "Faithless Satan, get away from me! Run off, or I'll strike you and knock you about. Satans don't get through to prophets; I have Allah's command." Hey, this is Ismail's...
en_old: 'Don't do this, don't slaughter the son, O Ibrahim.' Hazrat Ibrahim said, 'Faithless Satan, get away! Don't stop me, don't pester me. Satan cannot deceive the prophets. I have Allah's command.' Here Ismail's...

brh: بارو کے اسماعیل بریر اللہ کرے حکم کر سکا ئے تڑ سکا وا نبیک اللہ نا او ماتک مفسا سیالک مفسا نبی خدا نا پاننگلیرا پا شیطان شکی مز ہڑسینگا ولدا بے ہنتو
en: ...about Ismail [unclear]. "Allah has given the command; I can do it, I can slaughter him." The prophets of Allah have no mothers, no kinsmen [to hold them back]; a prophet [follows] what God says. Satan turned back ashamed; then [unclear].
en_old: ...Ismail... 'Allah has given the command; you may slaughter.' The prophets of Allah are not mothers, they are not kinsmen; the Prophet of God... Satan got nothing, and then he went away.

brh: برزا دڑو سے لگا ورکت تھڑپک تہ ویلو چونکا شیطان تہ بسو پیمانہ امرے پیاوا تھڑپکت مڑی ہنو ہسکتن جپھلکت تھڑپکت، آسمانا ملائکہ کوریرا
en: He brought a stroke down from above; it would not cut. Because [unclear: Satan had come?] ... it would not cut. He turned it [unclear] and struck again; it would not cut. The angels of the sky were watching.
en_old: He laid him face down and struck, but the knife would not cut; Satan came ... the knife would not cut, he struck again and again, the knife would not cut, and the angels of heaven were watching.

brh: ئے نمے نرفیوہ تڑنگ کے درے ادتوت ابا پد ناتھ نرفیوہ نم ہم برے کدا سید برے ک انشااللہ متکنا پیسہ دے کشبو او انت پائک استاد گڑا
en: I [unclear] you ... he took him to be slaughtered ... father, after [unclear] ... you come too ... God willing, take out the money for the elders(?) ... and what does the Ustad say then?
en_old: "I will take you along" — he took him to be slaughtered; father ... "I will take you, you come too" ... God willing ... bring out the money ... what does the Ustad say then?

brh: دا سال زئیفہ کن کے کے گڑا ایلو سالی کے شریعت نا بھاونائے درک مسئلہ تے تربو گڑا کبو نی کر بے مراد بلا نی ئس نی کر گڑا پدن ہر کس کے کے کے بلا تو کے نا لمہ کن کے کس گونے تئی کے کپک باوا کن
en: This year do it for your wife; then next year do it [for another]. Take the guidance of the Sharia and ask about the rulings; then do it. Don't [leave anyone] without their wish(?) [unclear]; then after that, for everyone — for your mother, for someone [unclear] — it isn't done for the father(?).
en_old: This year do it for the wife, then next year do it for someone else — ask the scholars about the matters of Sharia; then do it ... then after that for each person ... for someone's mother, for someone else ... it cannot be done for the father.

brh: اسکن ہور کہ تینکپہ تینکن ضرور کر کھئے پیسے انشاءاللہ پا روزی ٹی نا خدا برکت شائے ہور کہ نبی مار تینا مرے تڑیک نبی تینا مارے تڑینٹی مار کو اسماعیل انو زیبائی انو جوڑے ابراہیم نا خنتن کھڑی کا کم کم ویرا
en: Until then, look, do it for yourselves without fail; spend the money. God willing, God will put blessing into your livelihood. Look: a prophet slaughters his own son. The prophet is slaughtering his own son — the son being Ismail, so beautiful, so handsome — and from Ibrahim's eyes tears were flowing, little by little.
en_old: Until then, see that you certainly do it for yourself; spend the money, God willing, God will put blessing in your livelihood. See — a prophet slaughters his own son; the prophet, in slaughtering his own son — the son being Ismail, so beautiful, so handsome — from Ibrahim's eyes tears kept falling little by little.

brh: کہ دسبس دمٹ نتھڑی سرمریو مناغے مارے تھڑی وا نیتھ ئنا کننگ ٹی لیکن خنتھ دیدی کھڑنگا گویرا مار خیرن دودنگ پچھونا اسماعیل پچی ابا پچھونا دے خمو دسل تو سئی سلیس جند مرے نا سلیس
en: ...that [unclear] I should carry it out(?), slaughter my son, in fulfilling the intention; but from his eyes tears were flowing. The son was running behind; Ismail [said], "Yes, father" ... [unclear].
en_old: ... he would slaughter his son, in the way of God ... but tears were falling from his eyes; the son ran ahead happily, Ismail was asking, "Father ..." ... three ... then you will come to know, let me come to know ...

brh: پارے چنا دا ستو دے آن کنے ابر اسماعیل دے غا باور انٹی دا باور خنتن کھڑی گاویر پانٹی اللہ ہچ کس دن کتو کے کے وا اللہ دا مار نا پنی قربان کے وا ہائے اللہ امرو چنا چنواس
en: He said, "Child, since last night(?) I ..." — Ismail ... trusting, with this trust — tears flowing from his eyes, he is saying: "O Allah, no one has ever done such a thing ... O Allah, I am sacrificing this son in Your name. Oh Allah, what a child ..."
en_old: He said: "Child, from these three days ... Ismail ... belief ... this belief" — tears falling from the eyes. He says: "O God, no one has ever done this ... O God, sacrifice this son ... O God, such a child ..."

brh: یک جی نو تس نس گنے اسماعیل دودینگ اسماعیل دودینگ اونا دوتے اورک اونا بالاد اورک اونا رندات اورک خنتن کھڑی کاگویرا اسماعیل پیا بانہ خنتن کھڑی کاگویرا پیا با خیر سے خنت کھڑی کا ترپکنا
en: [unclear] Ismail running, Ismail running. He looks at his hands, he looks at his stature, he looks at his footsteps; tears were flowing from his eyes. Ismail: "Father, ... tears are flowing from your eyes. Father, is everything all right? Tears are dripping from your eyes."
en_old: ... Ismail running, Ismail running — his hands, his stature, his walk; tears were falling from the eyes. Ismail: "Father, why are the tears falling?" ... "Father, what is the matter, why are tears falling?"

brh: ناصبہ لن ددینگ تاکہ خیرن خنفتے مارے ولنا تو تڑیوتا اسماعیل مونی ددینگا باوہ خیر تورینٹی بج تورینٹی دتے تا تورینٹی نت تے تورینٹی خندن خڑینگک ویرا ئے اللہ مالو اسماعیل
en: ... running, so that [he] would not see the son from behind(?) ... Ismail ran on ahead. The father keeps holding back — holding back, holding back his hands, holding back his feet; tears were flowing from his eyes. O Allah, ... Ismail.
en_old: ... running, so that ... the son again ... "you would slaughter me" ... Ismail running ahead; Father, in his hand ... the knife in his hand ... running ... in the eyes tears were falling ... O God, Ismail ...

brh: اسماعیل کنے باز دوست ئس کا، انو نستو کنے حکم کرے است تڑنگ نا، اسماعیل نا محبت است آن کشار او، صرف نا محبت نا استے جاگہ تسنو، مار دن کائک اسماعیل، ابراہیم ہرک، دانگم بریک بابا ہرک، دونو بابا ملہ دونو مار
en: "Ismail was very dear to me; now You have commanded me to slaughter him [last night?]. I take Ismail's love out of my heart; I have given the heart's place only to Your love." The son, Ismail, walks along like this; Ibrahim watches. He comes this way too, the father watches. Such a father, and such a son.
en_old: "Ismail was very dear to me; now He has commanded me to slaughter him. Take Ismail's love out of the heart; give the heart's place only to His love." The son walks ahead, Ismail; Ibrahim looks; he comes this way, the father looks; both the father and the son are such ...

brh: پنج سال نا چنا بلن مس زلفے پی چنا پی جیا با پی چنا عیدس کے ونے تو پی جیا با پارے کنا چنا عید بنتو سہی عید مسٹمی ننے توکٹی خنو کے نی تڑے وا ئے ڈگی ء تڑیڑ پی ہاؤ ابا پی اللہ کنے استو
en: The five-year-old child had grown big, [with his] locks ... the child: "Yes, father." When Eid came ... "Yes, father." He said, "My child, hasn't Eid come? On the third [day of] Eid we will see ... whether I slaughter you ..." ... "Yes, father." ... "Allah [commanded] me last night."
en_old: The child of five years grew up ... his locks ... the child's grandfather ... when the child's Eid came, the grandfather said, "My child, Eid has come." ... "We will see" ... "will you slaughter me?" ... "Yes, father" ... "God has given me ..."

brh: حکم کرے ئے اسماعیل خواب پیچ نا خواب ارا کنا چنا چاقوئے سنوٹ چٹے سنوٹ ئے تو تیار اٹ انتئے خدا نا حکمے منوئی ئے فانظر ماذا تری فان
en: He gave the command — O Ismail — in a dream; the dream is this: "My child, I have readied the knife, readied the rope; I am ready, because God's command must be obeyed." "Fa-nẓur mādhā tarā" (so consider what you think) ...
en_old: He commanded ... Ismail, the dream — the dream is: "My child, I have sharpened the knife, I have sharpened it; I am ready. Why? To obey God's command." "Fanzur madha tara" (so look, what do you think?).

brh: فانظر ما ذا تری مانے تکبو فانظر ما ذا تری ہاں باقی کننگ ئس مرے گڑا ماما دا کبو دا کبو دا کبو کنا کنڈ آ تینا چنا تے کل تے بغل آن تینا نامردی
en: "Fa-nẓur mādhā tarā" — consider its meaning: "fa-nẓur mādhā tarā." Yes — [nowadays] if some other job remains to be done, then [people say] "Uncle, do this, do this, do this" — pushing it my way — while keeping all their own children at their side: that's their own cowardice.
en_old: "Fanzur madha tara" — understand its meaning. "Fanzur madha tara" — yes, if anything remains to be done ... then uncle, do this, do this, do this ... on my shoulder, all your children, in his embrace ... his cowardice.

brh: ہاں ماشاءاللہ دانگ دست ملا ہمونی کتو چٹا تندانگ جپ فیٹ تکے جواب ایتر کے کنا عید بمو کنا عیدو ماک ابراہیم علیہ السلام پارے کنا چنا پجی ابا چنا مونی تولو کے باوا ہرنگٹی اینمے سلام اینمے پاوا
en: Yes, mashallah ... [unclear] ... they give the answer: "My Eid ... my Eid ..." Ibrahim, peace be upon him, said, "My child." "Yes, father." The child sits in front, so that as the father looks ... [unclear] salaam ... [unclear].
en_old: Yes, MashaAllah ... the mullah ... he gave the answer: "My Eid has come, my Eid ..." Ibrahim (peace be upon him) said: "My child ..." — "Yes, father" — the child in front ... he should not look at the father ... "convey my salaam, say ..."

brh: کہ باوہ یقینی کہ دستڑنگ۔ شنام زیبا، خن سرمہ و سرے تیل خلوکی، پٹاکم زیبا، مارکوم زیبا، نبیکم زیبا، مریرم مارم زیبا، مونی تولفے نی تا۔
en: ...that the father is certain he will slaughter him. His bearing beautiful, kohl in his eyes and oil put on his head; his hair beautiful too, the son beautiful too, the prophet beautiful too, [unclear] the son beautiful too. He seated him in front ...
en_old: "Father, surely you must slaughter me." Beautiful of face, with kohl in his eyes and oil on his head; beautiful of hair, a beautiful son, a beautiful grandson, beautiful in every way — "do not look at my face."

brh: پرے کنا چنا پجی کنا باپ اللہ کنے حکم کرے نا تڑنگ نا استو اللہ کنے ظاہر حکم کرے کہ اسماعیل تڑ کنا چنا اینے بے شلفیٹ لمہ غنے سنورداں چاقوئے سنورداں
en: He said, "My child." "Yes, my father." "Allah commanded me last night to slaughter you; Allah commanded me plainly: slaughter Ismail. My child, today(?) [unclear] ... your mother got you ready(?), I have got the knife ready."
en_old: He said: "My child" — "Yes, my father" — "God has commanded me to slaughter you; God has clearly commanded me: slaughter Ismail. My child, without ... the mother ... I have sharpened the knife."

brh: چھتے زڑت کنا چنا داسہ ئے تو فیصلے تے خدا نا حوالہ کریٹ کہ ئے فیصلہ کیوا ئے نی تو تڑنگ کے بسوٹ داسہ نی تو پا نا مرضی ہنت کنا چنا نا اوس خواہک یا خواہپک تڑفسے یا تڑپسے تنے
en: [unclear] ... my child, now I have handed the decision over to God — that I make the decision — I have come to slaughter you. Now you tell me your wish: what does my child [want]? Do you want it or not? Will you let yourself be slaughtered or not?
en_old: "... my child, now I have entrusted the decision to God — 'I will decide' — I have come to slaughter you; now tell me your wish, what is my child's will — does he want it or not, will you be slaughtered or not? You tell me."

brh: ئے کنا چنا ہی تو تڑوا تڑنگو کنا یوز کے رنگن رغاک نی کٹنگور سل کٹنگوے سال پیش تموے فن ظلم ازاترا ببو چنانی تپ بمبو اللہ کے نمے ہاں
en: "My child, I will slaughter you ... the slaughtering ... my ... [garbled: veins, cutting, years ago, cruelty] ... come on, child ... God ... you. Yes."
en_old: "... my child, shall I slaughter you or not?" ... my face ... its color ... you ... years ago ... oppression ... the child ... God ... yes ...

brh: اللہ نمے ننے ہنو ایمان زیتے ئے معصومہ چنا لمہ ہاجرہ مرے باوہ ابراہیم مرے تو چنا با اسماعیل بارو جوڑ مرے ننا برام ننا نوالو خلیرہ نوالو خلیرہ ولدا چنا منوس مرے خیرات
en: May God give us such faith. O innocent child — when the mother is Hajar and the father is Ibrahim, the child becomes like Ismail. Our weddings, our [unclear] — they do [unclear], they do [unclear]; then if a child becomes [unclear] — charity.
en_old: May God give us such faith — the innocent child's mother is Hajar, the father is Ibrahim, so the child becomes Ismail. Our wedding ... our morsel ... then the child becomes obedient ... charity.

brh: ایلو خلک یک ہی موبائل غٹ آت ہا بس نی اذان ملئے بم پکت کہ لمہ تہ مچو زندگی ایلو خلکونے چنائے گوانزٹی لوڈ ایتک گنگنا ایلو خلک تینا پھل جان کن خیرات کیو پھل جان کن پھل جانو
en: Other people are all on their mobiles; [unclear] ... the call to prayer, the mullah ... that a mother [gives] her whole life ... other people put their children in the cradle [unclear]; other people give charity for their own darlings — for their darling, their darling.
en_old: Other people are all busy with their mobile phones; you just give the call to prayer... a mother who gives her whole life — other people load their children into the cradle; other people give charity for their own flesh and life, for their own flesh and life, for their own flesh and life.

brh: نی وڑ کے لوتی وڑپک نا پھلن لک مرتبہ اسماعیل پھلسس لیکن سلام ئے لمے پی شیطان بے ایمان نی بسنس کنے برغلافیسا کہ باوہ مارے تڑیک اڑے ظالم ئے لموٹ
en: [unclear] ... a hundred thousand times, Ismail ... But hats off to the mother! [She said,] "Faithless Satan, you have come to lead me astray, saying the father is slaughtering the son? Hey, you cruel one, I am the mother!"
en_old: Whatever way you... Ismail turned him away a hundred thousand times, but... the mother... Satan, the faithless one, you have come to me to mislead me, saying the father is slaughtering his son — there, O tyrant, go to the mother.

brh: پٹی تورے اونتو چنائے، اگر اللہ کنے حکم کروسئے ابراہیم علیہ السلام کتوٹ تینا مار تڑیٹو خدا نا پنا قربانی قبول کرے۔ شیطان ناامید بنرائنا پئے چنا داسہ پا ئے تیار اٹ بسٹ نی تینا وال
en: She held the child [unclear]. "If Allah had commanded me, I would have done as Ibrahim, peace be upon him, did; I would have slaughtered my own son; God accepts the sacrifice made in His name." Satan was left hopeless. Then: "Child, now say: I am ready, I have come; you [tell me] yours."
en_old: If he had held the child by the hair ... "If God had commanded me, I would have done as Ibrahim (peace be upon him) did, I would have slaughtered my son" — God accepted the sacrifice. Satan became hopeless. Then he said: "Child, now I am ready; you tell your ..."

brh: راضی ئس ہا، قبول کیس اللہ نا فیصلے قبول کپیسا، خاچیسا خاچپیسا، تڑنگے ہلسہ یا ہلپیسا، دا اسماعیل نا جواب باوا۔ بنفے ونے؟ یا ایلو گو نس
en: "Are you willing, yes? Will you accept Allah's decision or not? Will you lie down or not? Will you accept being slaughtered or not?" Here is Ismail's answer to his father — have you heard it? Or something else ...
en_old: "Are you willing? Will you accept God's decision or not? Will you run away or not? Will you accept being slaughtered or not?" This is Ismail's answer, father. Did you hear? Or something else ...

brh: سخت آ نیت کبو گڑا خوانون ایت قران پاک اسماعیل نبی مولا سنڈوک پارے ابا بچیا ابا اللہ اکبر فانظر ماذا تری قال یا ابتی او با قران پاک چھنا عید
en: Make a firm intention, then let us read the Holy Quran: Prophet Ismail [unclear] said, "Father, [unclear] father" — Allahu Akbar. "Fa-nẓur mādhā tarā"; "qāla yā abati" — "O father." The Holy Quran, the child, Eid.
en_old: Make a firm intention and then recite — the Holy Quran, Prophet Ismail; the son said to his master, "Father, Father!" Allahu Akbar. "Fanzur madha tara" — "so look, what do you think?" "Qala ya abati" — "he said, O my father." The Holy Quran, the son, Eid.

brh: باوہ بننگٹی چھنا باوہ پائک قال یا ابت افعل ما تؤمر ستجدنی انشاءاللہ خیر انشاءاللہ کتو معصوم چھنا سے انشاءاللہ یاد ایتو ننا پیری
en: As the father listens, the child says to the father: "Qāla yā abati, ifʿal mā tuʾmar, satajidunī in shāʾ Allāh" (O my father, do what you are commanded; you will find me, God willing ...). Good, God willing. An innocent child said "God willing" — remember this, our elders.
en_old: As the father comes, the son says to the father: "Qala ya abati if'al ma tu'mar, satajiduni insha'Allah" — "O my father, do what you are commanded; you will find me, God willing..." Good, insha'Allah. An innocent child said "insha'Allah". Remember this, our elders.

brh: پگہ جیٹ کے باوہ گڑو برے ہمودے برے او تو لیس گائی خان چوک بس ہمودے سر مرے عزرائیل مالے لبٹ فیتہ آ در نی گائی خان نا سر مرے اگر انشاءاللہ کروس اللہ نا مدد کرے ہر گراٹ انشاءاللہ کرو ئے اسماعیل نا قران گواہ ہی
en: Tomorrow [unclear] ... father, then he comes, comes there; he [unclear] reached Gai Khan Chowk, arrives there — Azrael [unclear] ... you arrive at Gai Khan Chowk. If you had said "God willing", Allah would have helped. Say "God willing" in every matter; Ismail's Quran is witness to it.
en_old: Tomorrow... father, then come, come to that place, he... Gai Khan Chowk — he reached there. Azrael... go out, you arrive at Gai Khan Chowk. If you say insha'Allah, Allah helps. Say insha'Allah in every matter; the Quran of Ismail is witness to this.

brh: ستجدنی آن شاء اللہ من الصابرین من الصابرین من الصابرین ئے ابا اولی کو نن انتئے تڑتوس کنے ارٹمی کو نن انتئے تڑتوس کنے داسا مسٹمی کو نن انت خبر کہ خدا انت انت پائے داسا ابا
en: "Satajidunī in shāʾ Allāh min aṣ-ṣābirīn" — among the patient, among the patient. "O father, the first night, why didn't you slaughter me? The second night, why didn't you slaughter me? Now the third night — who knows what all God will say now, father."
en_old: "Satajiduni insha'Allah min as-sabirin" — "you will find me, God willing, among the patient" — among the patient, among the patient. Father, the first time why did you throw me? The second time why did you throw me? Now the third time — who knows what God will say now, father.

brh: آئی تے خپ تو اگر نی تیار ئس تو ئے ہم تیار او ئے لما غے مپارا ئے بشم مپارا دیخم پدی مپارا ستجدنی انشاء اللہ من الصابرین ابا انشاء اللہ خنوستے نی چنا
en: [unclear] ... "If you are ready, then I am ready too. Don't tell my mother; don't tell her [unclear]; don't tell her afterwards either. Satajidunī in shāʾ Allāh min aṣ-ṣābirīn — father, God willing, you will find your child [so]."
en_old: Come... if you are ready, then I too am ready. Don't tell my mother, don't say I was hungry, don't say it again. "Satajiduni insha'Allah min as-sabirin." Father, God willing, you will see, your child...

brh: دا دنیائے باز مسنے کئی باوہ غاتے چنا مسنے نی ہم کیمس کے یاد کروس غنیم خدا چنا سمرو تس کہ ہمری پاریٹ تمون کرے ستجدونی انشاء اللہ من الصابرین انشاء اللہ انشاء اللہ انشاء اللہ
en: In this world there have been many; many fathers have had children. You too, remember: the Bountiful God gave such a child, who, as I said, fulfilled it: "satajidunī in shāʾ Allāh min aṣ-ṣābirīn." God willing, God willing, God willing.
en_old: In this world there have been many; many fathers have had children. You too, when you remember... the Generous God gave such a son who said this and fulfilled it: "satajiduni insha'Allah min as-sabirin." Insha'Allah, insha'Allah, insha'Allah.

brh: او چرنگو کہ چنا، باوہ غا باز دوست مرے، باوہ لمہ غا، دا سے اللہ سئیں امتحان لنگھ تیت۔ ابراہیم علیہ السلام گلان، کہ دا مار ورنا مروئی شنکیس خلوئے کنے دا ورنا مروئی بلو۔
en: He would walk about as a little child, and he became very dear to his father, to his father and mother. Now Allah Sain put [him] to a test. Ibrahim, peace be upon him, had the thought that this son would become a young man, would [be a help(?)] to me, and this young man would grow up.
en_old: When a child walks, the father loves him dearly, the father and the mother both. On that day Allah Almighty put him through a test. Ibrahim (peace be upon him) thought this son would grow into a young man, would be a support for me when this young man grows up.

brh: مروئی شام نا خاچوکا نا عیدی تیکو، ہی بیست و ہپتی ذوالحج بلنگٹی داسا، بیست و ہشتم ذوالحج بلنگٹی، بیست و نوئے ذوالحج بلنگٹی، توغٹی خنا کہ مارے تھڑے وا، ولدا بش مس پائینو توغ سے، مارے تینے
en: ...will become. In the evening, while he was asleep, [... Eid ...]; yes, as the twenty-seventh of Dhul-Hijja came on, now, as the twenty-eighth of Dhul-Hijja came on, as the twenty-ninth of Dhul-Hijja came on, he saw in his sleep: 'I am slaughtering the son.' He woke up again; another dream: 'your own son...'
en_old: In the evening he gave the children their Eid gifts. Now, on the twenty-seventh of Dhul-Hijjah, on the twenty-eighth of Dhul-Hijjah, on the twenty-ninth of Dhul-Hijjah, he saw in a dream that he was slaughtering his son; he woke up, went back to sleep – again the same dream: slaughter your son.

brh: دے تڑک، ولا کھا چائرتھمی کونن، ولا اورا مارے تڑوا، پیا لائے خیرات نظر اوتے اللہ کن اشارہ کلن ٹیکی خیرات کر، ڈگی تے تڑے، ایٹ تے تڑے، اللہ زبر ابراہیم، کنے تنو زاد کبرانہ کسم
en: [He would] slaughter [them]; then ... [unclear] ...; then [he thought], 'I will slaughter the son.' He gave charity and offerings for them; taking it as a sign from Allah, he gave charity to everyone: he slaughtered cows, he slaughtered goats. Allah [said]: 'Ibrahim, [I want] your own offspring as a sacrifice to me.'
en_old: Slaughter – once in the house, once slaughter the son at home; he gave offerings as charity; Allah gave the sign: give charity to everyone; slaughter cows, slaughter sheep. Allah said: "Ibrahim, I want your own offspring."

brh: دگی ئے تٹ کاری مفک ابراہیم آ، ہمو کہ خمٹی نا خاچوکی، ہموڑ کن کہ مچو زندگی دعا خواناس، ہمو اسماعیل کہ نی باز دوست ہی اوار چرنگرے، اوار کننگرے، کٹے زلفس اتہ
en: A cow is of no use, O Ibrahim. [I want] the one who sleeps in your [eyes(?)], the one for whom you prayed your whole life, that Ismail whom you love so much, with whom you walk about together and eat together, who has [?] locks of hair.
en_old: "A cow will not do, Ibrahim; the one who is the apple of your eye, the one for whom you prayed all your life, that Ismail whom you love so much, with whom you walk, with whom you eat, who has long locks of hair."

brh: لختے خذتہ نی باز دوستی ابراہیم ہچڑا نین خواب پریانہ اسماعیل نین خوابا انت خوابا با اسماعیل خوابا ڈگی مگی تا لختڑوس ہچڑا مفک ئس
en: ...you love [him] very much, Ibrahim. It was nothing [else]: in the dream, Ismail. In the dream, what dream? In the dream, Ismail. Cows and the like were of no use at all.
en_old: "...you love him very much, Ibrahim." He told no one about the dream. "Ismail..." In the dream – what dream? In the dream Ismail; cows and such things were of no use.

brh: اسماعیل ئس تڑ ئے خدا نی اسماعیل نا قربانی خواہوا اینو نی اللہ نا قسم نمے نن دنو قربانی کننگ کینہ ایٹ سلے نی پیڑیانو بے دوانزہ وار مکھے دونو کینہ چرپی باز ئس ئے ہک ہک پنج کلا کا پد
en: 'Slaughter Ismail. I, God, want the sacrifice of your Ismail.' Today, by Allah, you and we, we make sacrifices like this: [we take] a goat, you [bring it] from the market and feel it over a dozen times like this [to see] if it has a lot of fat... five kilos each... after...
en_old: "Slaughter Ismail." "God, You want the sacrifice of Ismail?" Now, by Allah, you and we make such sacrifices: you buy a sheep, you have slaughtered it a dozen times over in your mind; it has a lot of fat – after five kilos each...

brh: چرپی باز ات، و اینگہ ایلو واپاری تا کہ ایو داڑان زیادہ پکی نا بابا بس ٹھیک بس ہفتہ تڑینگانی او چھنڈ سے کپن بڑزا تڑینگانی، چھنڈ سے تڑینگانی جائز مریک، مدا پنچ روپیہ سودا مریک
en: It had a lot of fat, and still [we tell] the other traders, 'I will give more than this...' 'Baba, enough, fine, enough.' It is to be slaughtered in just a week... we don't [?]... is it permissible to slaughter a [?]... The deal comes down to five rupees.
en_old: It had a lot of fat, and the other traders too, so that more than that... "Baba, alright, enough, slaughter it in a week" – slaughter it above; is it permissible to slaughter a ...? A five-rupee bargain is made.

brh: اسماعیل اللہ نبی نا مارے اور ہنو ذبح مننگ کن پیش تمانے نا دشمن ہم چہرے تو ہرے اور ہنو زبان سے تانینو اسماعیل عید کے دنیا توجہ کے گدان مارکو چونگان تیت کننے اللہ پی ابراہیم نا ہمو گدان
en: Ismail is the son of Allah's prophet, and he came forward to be slaughtered; [your] enemy too... face... and with his tongue... Ismail... Eid... the world's attention... [a ram(?)]... Allah says: that [ram(?)] of Ibrahim's...
en_old: Ismail, the son of Allah's prophet, presented himself to be slaughtered; even an enemy's face... Ismail, Eid – the world pays attention; a ram was sent down; Allah said to Ibrahim: that ram...

brh: کہ اوار اینے تونہ دگی ایٹ خاکہ ئنا دے تڑ اسماعیلا کشی بس پئیت کپیس ئنا مارے تڑ داس حضرت ابراہیم وڑہ اللہ اکبر دا تو مار نہ زی امتحان کنا زی بسونے
en: ...that along with them, cows, goats, all of them, today slaughter Ismail. Enough, don't [make excuses]; slaughter your son. Now Hazrat Ibrahim [said]: 'Allahu Akbar! This is not about the son; it is my test that has come.'
en_old: ...together with them cows, sheep, all of them; today slaughter Ismail. "Enough, do not refuse; slaughter your son." Now Hazrat Ibrahim said: "Allahu Akbar. This is not about the son; my test has come."

brh: لیکن ابراہیم ہچ گنتی کتو رب کعبہ نا قسم پر اللہ دا تو اسٹ ئے اگر ہزارے دنو اسماعیل ایت کنے کھلی نا پین تڑنگ کے تیار اٹ۔ نن عیدی کپن مولوی صاحب بس دعا کر اینو خودی خل آخرو تول کتو دونے مانی۔
en: But Ibrahim did not hesitate at all. By the Lord of the Kaaba: 'O Allah, this is just one; if You gave me a thousand Ismails like him, I am ready to slaughter all of them in Your name.' [And] we [say]: 'We won't do the Eid [sacrifice], Maulvi Sahib, just say a prayer.' Today... did not weigh [it] up to the end; that is what it means.
en_old: But Ibrahim did not hesitate at all. By the Lord of the Kaaba – "O Allah, this is only one; if You gave me a thousand Ismails like him, I am ready to slaughter them all for You." "We won't do Eid, Maulvi sahib, just pray." Now, having weighed it all up to the end, this is what it means.

brh: خبردار نا لاغری ہرا جاگہ غٹ منا ئس کش پک کنا پنج ہزار دہ ہزار خرچ کپا اسماعیل ام بارنگا مارکو ابراہیم نبی نا مار کہ پورا زندگی دعا خوانا مار کن تینا
en: Beware of [the animal's] leanness, wherever there is any... 'I won't spend my five thousand, ten thousand.' Ismail too... the son of the Prophet Ibrahim, the son for whom he had prayed his whole life, for himself.
en_old: Beware – wherever it gets stuck, don't spend my five thousand or ten thousand. Ismail too was being taken; the son of the Prophet Ibrahim, the son for whom he prayed his whole life, for himself...

brh: بس ہمو تم فیصلے قبول کرے پی اللہ اگر اولی کو نن کرے ہنا خبر مروز کہ اسماعیلء تڑوئی ئے عیدا ڈھگی ہیڑ تے ہما کرے ٹئی اسماعیلء ہمو تم تڑوٹا لیکن ہمو تم پی چنا پی جی ابا پی کان اوراغے تو کان پی ہو ابا نن آ چناتم بارو لوک
en: Then at that moment he accepted the decision. He says: 'O Allah, if we had known from the start that Ismail had to be slaughtered, [instead of] cows and goats at Eid I would have slaughtered Ismail at that very time.' But then he says: 'Child!' He says: 'Yes, father.' He says: 'Let's go together, come, let's go.' 'Yes, father.' [Father and] child set off...
en_old: He accepted the decision right then and said: "O Allah, if we had been told beforehand that Ismail was to be slaughtered, we would have slaughtered cows and goats at Eid." He would have slaughtered Ismail right then, but then he said to the child, "Son" – "Yes, father" – "Come with me" – "Yes, father, let's go"; the father and son set off.

brh: کہ باوہ مونٹی مارکو دا گلی لا نرا پینجا گسنا مار ام باوہ تو تودے ہنار پی ہاجرہ پی جی ابراہیم پی ہاجرہ سے کارمز کر پی جی ابراہیم ء خبرے کہ چنائے تڑوا لیکن لمہ ء خبر اف کہ مار تڑنگک
en: ...that the father in front and the son [went] out of the door of the house; the son went along with the father. He says: 'Hajra!' She says: 'Yes, Ibrahim.' He says: 'Hajra, do a job [for me].' She says: 'Yes.' Ibrahim knows that he is going to slaughter the child, but the mother does not know that the son is to be slaughtered.
en_old: ...that the father went out of the house with the son in front of him. The son went along with the father. He says, 'Hajra! Ibrahim! Hajra, do something!' Ibrahim knows that he is going to slaughter the child, but the mother does not know that the son is to be slaughtered.

brh: پلو مے خبر اف برے دادے بیشل اسماعیلی خنت تے سرمہ کر سرے تے تیل خل جوان زیباکتا اینو دعوت سے کانا واپسی ئے پاٹم کینا گڈنا ہموکا پاٹ پٹھیٹ لمہ منٹی بیشل آتا
en: ...she does not know. [He said:] 'Go, get this one ready: put kohl in Ismail's eyes, put oil on his head, make him nice and handsome; today we are going to a feast, and on the way back we will also gather firewood.' ...that firewood... The mother, in front, got [him] ready.
en_old: The mother did not know. 'Go and dress Ismail up nicely, put kohl in his eyes, put oil on his hair, make him look nice; today we are going to a feast and we will come back.' ... The mother dressed Ismail up nicely.

brh: ئے مالم زیبا اسکا سرمہ کریتہ سرے تا تیل خلک پچ جوانوں کریتہ سبحان اللہ داسہ اسماعیل نا مونی تے ہورے پچنا کان پی کان چاکو ئے داکا خلک چٹے ہرفے پیش تمار ہاجرہ کان واپس برینا داسہ لمے تا ئنا
en: ...[made him] handsome: she put kohl on him, put oil on his head, made his clothes nice. Subhan Allah, now look at Ismail's face! 'Let's go,' he says, 'let's go.' He put the knife here, took up the rope, and they went out. 'Hajra, we're going; we'll come back.' Now the mother...
en_old: ...She made him look nice, applied kohl, oiled his hair, dressed him in good clothes. Subhan Allah! Now look at Ismail's face. He took the knife, took the rope: 'Goodbye, Hajra, we will come back.' Now the mother...

brh: ہم خبر اف نبی نا ضعیف ء لیکن لمہ ء دا خبر اف کہ باوہ نا نیت ٹی انت ء اور مار ئے ہرانگ دیک داڑان معلوم ئس کہ سینہ نا رازاتے چاؤکا فقط اللہ نا ذات نتے ابراہیم نا نبی نا ضعیفہ غان ودیک نااہل مف نن آوا ستی جتی وچیران کارا برا نا
en: ...she too does not know, the prophet's wife. But the mother does not know what is in the father's intention and where he is taking the son. From this it is known that the one who knows the secrets of the heart is Allah's being alone; otherwise it would have become known to the wife of the prophet Ibrahim; she is not unworthy. We... separately... [unclear].
en_old: ...also does not know; the Prophet's wife does not know what is in the father's intention and where he is taking the son. From this it is known that only Allah's Being knows the secrets of the heart, otherwise the Prophet Ibrahim's wife would have known. We ourselves would say, 'We are going separately...'

brh: علم نبی نا ضعیف نا آواز تیز ئس لیکن خبر ہلو ابراہیم نبی نا موٹی نا اللہ زپٹے فلما بلغ معہ السعی قال یا بنی انی ارے فی المنام انی اذبحک فانظر ماذا تری قال یا ابت افعل
en: ...knowledge... the prophet's wife's voice was sharp, but she did not get the news. The Prophet Ibrahim... Allah says: 'And when he reached the age of striving with him, he said: O my son, I see in a dream that I am slaughtering you, so consider what you think. He said: O my father, do'
en_old: ...the Prophet's wife's voice was loud, but she had no knowledge. Ibrahim... Allah says: 'And when he reached the age of striving with him, he said, O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I am sacrificing you, so see what you think. He said, O my father, do...'

brh: مات و مار ستجدنی آن شاء اللہ من الصابرین قران پا نٹی چنا واری بابتون شیطان خبر تما کہ اینو بلو معاملس مننگٹی ہی
en: 'what you are commanded; you will find me, if Allah wills, among the patient.' The Qur'an says [so]. The child is [going] with his father. Satan came to know that today a great matter is taking place.
en_old: '...what you are commanded; you will find me, if Allah wills, among the patient.' The Qur'an says this. The child is with his father. Satan came to know that today a great matter is going to take place.

brh: کہ کم از کم بندہ کل جنت ئے کارا اگر ابراہیم کامیاب مس تو امتی کل پدی ہنوک کرور کاوہ نا مسئلے تا خراب کیو دودینگا پیرو ریشس کرے تینے بلو بزرگس جوڑ کرے تینے نبی نا ضعیفہ نا دروازہ ئے کھڑکا فے اماں ہاجرہ پدی
en: ...that at least all people will go to Paradise. If Ibrahim succeeds, then the whole ummah that comes after, crores [of people]... [my] affairs will be spoiled. He ran off, made himself an old man's beard, made himself into a great elder, and knocked at the door of the prophet's wife. Mother Hajra then...
en_old: ...that at least all people will go to Paradise. 'If Ibrahim succeeds, then all the nations that come after will... my affairs will be ruined.' The accursed one made himself a white beard, made himself into a great elder, and knocked at the Prophet's wife's door. Mother Hajra then...

brh: پئے ئے بلو بزرگ سے اوٹ، بلو جبہ قبہ کرے پینو ریشس کرے، پئے او اماں ہاجرہ پئے ہا، پئے با ارغ نا ہران گنا، اسماعیل ہران گنا، پئے با وتون تنانے پئے خیر، پئے دا وس سے درینے تا واپس
en: He says: 'I am a great elder.' He had put on a big cloak and robe and made [himself] a white beard. He says: 'O Mother Hajra!' She says: 'Yes.' He says: 'Where has your husband gone? Where has Ismail gone?' She says: 'He has taken him along with him.' He says: 'Is all well?' She says: 'He has taken this one for a while; [they will come] back.'
en_old: He says: a great elder, wearing a big cloak and robe, with a white beard. He says, 'Are you Mother Hajra?' She says, 'Yes.' He says, 'Where did your husband go? Where did Ismail go?' She says, 'He took him along with himself.' He says, 'Well, they will come back...'

brh: سے ئے پارٹ کیرا بیان نا خاطر نی بسوٹ ئے دا پیرنگ آئی باز چرینگ پر لیکن ئنا خاطر نی بسوٹ آن سے گندارے خبر اف نی پیا پی موسی دے مار نا تڑیک مار نا چاکوٹ تڑیک
en: ...[?] I came for the sake of telling [you]. I, this old man, wander around a lot, but I came for your sake. Don't you know? He says: 'He is slaughtering your son, he is slaughtering your son with a knife.'
en_old: ...I am telling it in parts for the sake of explanation. 'You have come...' This old man, very... 'But do you know for what reason you have come?' 'You don't know?' He says, 'He is going to slaughter the son, slaughter the son with a knife.'

brh: چاکو سمرفینے چٹی سمرفینے مار نا تفو اولا تڑکتا اماں ہاجرہ نا ایمان ء سلام ء نام کنا لمہ اگبرو سر ضعیفاک فریاد ء شروع کریرا ہوڑے رمکبہ بے مراد ہلبو شوم ء ہلبو سے مارس کنے تہ مار نا تڑنکے
en: 'He has prepared the knife, prepared the rope; he will tie your son up and slaughter him.' Salute to the faith of Mother Hajra! If it had been my mother [or other] women, they would have started wailing: 'Hey, run! Catch the wretch, catch the ill-omened one! I have only one son, and he is slaughtering my son!'
