en_old: 'He has sharpened the knife, prepared the rope, he will tie up the son and slaughter him.' Peace be upon the faith of Mother Hajra! If it had been one of our mothers, other women would have started wailing: 'Run after him, catch the wretch, catch the ill-fated one! I have only one son, and he is going to slaughter my son!'

brh: لیکن اما ہاجرہ پارے پیش تم کنا دروازہ غان مر ما او شیطان بے ایمان پیش تم باوہ تینا مارے ہمری تڑے کر پی ہاں تو ئس ہنانے پانٹی اللہ کنے حکم کرے نی کہ مارے تڑ پی خبردار نبی تڑ
en: But Mother Hajra said: 'Get away from my door, go, O faithless Satan, get out! Would a father really slaughter his own son?' He says: 'Yes, he has gone, saying that Allah commanded me: slaughter the son.' She says: 'Beware, [then] the prophet [will] slaughter [him].'
en_old: But Mother Hajra said, 'Get away from my door, you faithless Satan, get away.' 'Will the father really slaughter his own son?' 'Yes, he is going, saying that Allah commanded me to slaughter the son.' She says, 'Beware, don't...'

brh: شیطانی تخم فضا نبی تا تغ آکا سچاؤ کنا اراغان مر مر ہی دا تو ابراہیم اللہ حکم کرے نی اگر کرے لمے حکم کروس ئے ہم تینا مارے تڑیٹا شیطان دن ہرفے مونٹی تن خلک
en: 'Seed of Satan! The dreams of prophets are true. Get away from my house, go, go! This is Allah commanding Ibrahim; if He had commanded me, the mother, I too would slaughter my own son.' Satan then took off and threw himself ahead [of them].
en_old: 'Seed of Satan, get away from my house, go, go! If Allah has commanded Ibrahim, if He had commanded me, the mother, I too would slaughter my own son.' Satan fled from there and went on ahead.

brh: پیدا بے مراد نی چڑا متو، کھا مار کوئی خلیفہ۔ دوذینگ سئی نا حضرت اسماعیل رندٹ مونی باوا۔ واذکر فی الکتاب ابراہیم انہ کان صدیقا نبیا۔
en: '...you wretch, nothing came of it for you.' ...a son... a caliph... Running [on], Hazrat Ismail behind, the father in front. 'And mention in the Book Ibrahim; indeed he was a man of truth, a prophet.'
en_old: '...you wretch, did you not weep? Such a son, a caliph...' The accursed one three times... Hazrat Ismail behind, the father in front. 'And mention in the Book Ibrahim; indeed he was a man of truth, a prophet.'

brh: اللہ اللہ پاندو کنا محبوب نبی او کنا محمد رسول اللہ کنا دلبر نبی کنا آخری نبی ابراہیم نا گپاتے امت بنتو سہی واہ جو ابراہیم نبی سسکا امرے تینا مارے تڑنگے درے کا شیطان خیرم بس اسماعیل رے خیر ننگٹی پرے او چنا دا
en: Allah, Allah! My beloved Prophet, my Muhammad the Messenger of Allah, my darling Prophet, my last Prophet [says]: let the ummah hear the words of Ibrahim; right, well done. The Prophet Ibrahim is taking his own son to slaughter him. Satan came too: 'Ismail, is all well, where are you going?' That child...
en_old: Allah, Allah! My beloved Prophet, my Muhammad the Messenger of Allah, my dear Prophet, my last Prophet says: let the ummah hear the words of Ibrahim. Well done! The Prophet Ibrahim is taking his son to slaughter him. Satan came: 'Well, Ismail, where are you going?' That child...

brh: پان بار پین سے پیرا پی نر پی انتئے خیرٹ پی باوت نا چاکو سے تڑکنے چٹ سے تفکنے مستی تڑکنے پارے ابا پی جی چھنا پی دا پیرنا کنے پنٹی باون تڑکنے پی با دا بے ایمان شیطان ہی
en: ...with the father, another old man. He says: 'Run!' He says: 'Why, what is the matter?' He says: 'Your father has [readied] a knife and tied a rope; he is going to slaughter you.' He said: 'Father!' He says: 'Yes, son.' He says: 'This old man is telling me that father is going to slaughter [me].' He says: 'Son, this is the faithless Satan.'
en_old: ...with the father. An old man says, 'Where are you going?' He says, 'What is it?' He says, 'Your father has sharpened a knife, prepared a rope, he is going to slaughter you.' He said, 'Father, this old man tells me that the father is going to slaughter me.' He says, 'This is the faithless Satan.'

brh: ابراہیم علیہ السلام خل مچ کرے ٹھوکا مونٹی تے خلک ہنو نرا ہنا ولنا بس کرائی لوماک ولنا بس اسماعیل نا پاسو الک ولنا ہچڑا متو آسمان نا ملائکہ کل رنجیو کینو ابراہیم تینا چنائے ہمری تڑک مسے وارز کان خل خل کرے
en: Ibrahim, peace be upon him, gathered stones and struck him in front of him; he ran away. Again he came to... [the mother(?)]; again he came to Ismail's side; again nothing came of it. All the angels of heaven were grieved: 'Is Ibrahim really going to slaughter his own child?' Three times he pelted him with stones.
en_old: Ibrahim (peace be upon him) picked up a stone and struck him in front: 'Get away from here!' Then he went to the mother; then he went to Ismail's side; nothing came of it. All the angels of the heavens were grieved: 'Is Ibrahim really going to slaughter his child?' He struck him with stone after stone.

brh: نی تان آخر ارا متو اچ لا متو دودینگس بس ابراہیم نا مونائے با ابراہیم دیخہ کنا ئے تے بنتو سہی ٹھیک نی کنے درست کیس ئے شیطان اٹ نی کنے جوان چاس ئے شیطان اٹ لیکن ئے تس باونے کنے رحم بلنگٹی کنے ترس بلنگٹی
en: '...in the end... nothing came of it.' He came running in front of Ibrahim: 'Ibrahim, listen to me a little. Right, fine, you have recognized me correctly: I am Satan; you know me well: I am Satan. But let me tell you, I am feeling pity, I am feeling compassion.'
en_old: '...at last you came.' Nothing came of it. The accursed one came before Ibrahim: 'Ibrahim, listen to what I say. Alright, you have recognized me correctly, I am Satan; you have known me well, I am Satan. But I am telling you, father, I feel pity, I feel compassion...'

brh: ئے دا معصومہ چنائے تڑسا ولنا پی چنا خدا تفکنے چنا لبے نا سٹے ئے نا توکٹی بسوٹ ئے شیطان نا توکٹی بسوٹ خدا کس نبی دن پاتنے تنے ماتے تڑبو ئے نا توکٹی بسوٹ مہربانی کر ئے غلطی ئس کرے کہ توکٹی نی بسوٹ
en: 'Will you slaughter this innocent child?' Again he says: 'The child... God... the child... I came into your dream; I, Satan, came into your dream. God has never told any prophet like this: slaughter your own son. I came into your dream. Please, I made a mistake in coming into your dream.'
en_old: 'Will you slaughter this innocent child? Will God ...? You have fallen into error, you have fallen under Satan's deception. God does not tell any prophet to slaughter your own son; you have fallen into error. Please, you have made a mistake, you have fallen into error.'

brh: اللہ ئے داسہ خاچوہ نی چاکوئی کش کرے شانت کرے پرواف خدا نا پنی قربان مروہ انشاءاللہ تینا دو تے صرف پوڑ تینا نت تے صرف پوڑ ئے خس پوڑ تنے نیتو عید کپ پوڑ تینا جان اللہ نا پنی قربان کروڑ ئے ابا ئے خدا غان پین خواوہ کہ قیامت نا
en: Allah! Now I will lie down; you take out the knife and sharpen it. No worry, I will be sacrificed in God's name, God willing. I will not move my hands, I will not move my feet, I will not thrash about. I will not be celebrating Eid with you; I will sacrifice my life in Allah's name, O father. I want one more thing from God: that on the Day of Judgment...
en_old: Allah, now I lay myself down; you take out the knife, sharpen it; have no worry, I will be sacrificed in God's name, insha'Allah. Only bind your hands, only bind your feet... I am celebrating Eid by sacrificing my life in Allah's name, father. I want nothing else from God except that on the Day of Judgment...

brh: میدانے نبی تا چناک مرور گوازی کرسا پچاک مرور ئے بروٹ کنا لختڑوک مروئی کنا پچاک دتر مرور آخر خدا ہرپوئے کہ دا لختڑوکا چنا دنائے آخر دنیا ہرپوئے نبی کرفور کہ دا لختڑوکا چنا
en: ...on the field [of Judgment] the children of the prophets will be playing, their clothes will be ...; I will come with my throat cut, my clothes will be [soaked in] blood. In the end, won't God see that this child with the cut throat is his? In the end, won't the world see, won't the prophets see, that this is the child with the cut throat?
en_old: In the field the children of the prophets would be playing, the little ones would be... my little lamb, my little ones, my daughters... In the end God knows that this is a little child; in the end the world knows, the prophets know, that this is a little child.

brh: دنا دا تا چکر کیک دنیا نا بنداک پارور خدا نا جند ہم پاروئی دا کنا ابراہیم نا چنکا زیبا اسماعیل ء کہ کنا خدا نا پن ء تتی جان ء قربان کیک پئے ہند خواہ خدا نا پئے چنا سبحان اللہ
en: ...goes around... The people of the world will say, and God Himself will also say: this is my Ibrahim's little, beautiful Ismail, who sacrifices his life for my name, the name of God... the child. Glory be to Allah.
en_old: ...goes around for this. The people of the world say it, and God Himself also says: this is my Ibrahim's little child, the beautiful Ismail, who sacrifices his own life for my God's name... for God's name... the child. Subhan Allah.

brh: اللہ اللہ زبردست فلما اسلما ارتوماک ٹیسورینا تینا فیصلہ غاتے ایپئی تڑیوہ داپئی تینا تڑفیوہ چھونا خاچا ابا نو چھونارے ہلی چھونا تلے بل بلہ بلوٹی انوارے ننیٹی
en: Allah, Allah, magnificent! 'When they had both submitted' (fa-lamma aslama): the two of them ... their decisions: 'This way I will slaughter', 'this way I will let myself be slaughtered.' The child lay down: 'Father, now...' ... the child ... under the child ...
en_old: Allah, Allah, magnificent! "Falamma aslama" — when they both submitted — ... their decisions: "I will cast mine this way", "I will cast mine that way." The child was laid down. "Father, now take the child, put the knife under the child's throat, the blade in the blade's..."

brh: چھوڑو منگی اسکو نین نی انشاءاللہ مسیت نماز ء پھرک ء محمد علی چولو تا لاہے دوشہ سینانے تٹی منگی ایم نماز ء پھرک ء سنر ریسا نی ولکھے خاچوس نی لکھے تڑفوس ایٹ سلنگ کپیسا
en: ... you, God willing, the mosque prayer ... Muhammad Ali ... last night ... the prayer ... You will lay down a lakh, you will have a lakh['s worth] slaughtered, yet you cannot even stand [for prayer].
en_old: ...what's left, the mosque prayer, the prayer... Muhammad Ali... last night the... the Monday prayer... You laid down a hundred thousand, you threw away a hundred thousand, and now you cannot even stand.

brh: ڈھگی سے پٹنگ ٹیو مسے ہفتے تا بازار باز باسونینو گرمے باس۔ بازار یخے کوٹہ تو یخے ہر انگا باسونوس۔ ئے تناٹ کہ نا بخیلی باسونوس۔ نی جوانوں گڑا ہرپیسہ۔ نی ہنو خراسے سر کہ مرغاک تمنو۔
en: Searching for an ox for three weeks: the market is very hot, it's warm, hot. The market is cold, Quetta is cold too — how come you are hot? I tell you, you are hot with your own stinginess. You don't look at a good thing. You go for an ox ... such that the birds fall.
en_old: Looking for a heifer for weeks in the market — the market is very hot, it is hot. The market is cold, Quetta is cold, yet you are still burning. I tell you, you are burning with your stinginess. You don't know a good thing. You go and get that ram, so that the chickens...

brh: او نا خنک نی وانی، او نا خفک نی وانی، او نا سل نی وانی، او نا رنگ نی وانی، او نا چھرنگ نی وانی، او نا سلنگ نی وانی، داسہ نی اودے کر آن شاء اللہ، ئنا خراس نی گرکر سا دودیف سا بالتیف سا ئے جنت نا خراس سے
en: You examine its eyes, you examine its ears, you examine its skin, its color, its gait, its stance. Now you go ahead with it, God willing. My ox — you fattening it, feeding it, raising it — it is an ox of Paradise.
en_old: His eyes are yours, his ears are yours, his waiting is yours, his color is yours, his walking is yours, his standing is yours; now you take him, insha'Allah. My ram — you... the... the... — is a ram of paradise.

brh: نی علیہ السلام اغروس لاغرو ایدت تمک نیم ڈھیر ولہ ہفت بندغور کے کلاغرو کے کلو خراسان غن بیر فنکک ئے جینو سادارس اسماعیل علیہ السلام خاچہ باونہ مونہ خاچہ
en: ... peace be upon him ... lean ... when Eid comes ... half ... or seven people ... all ... lean ... than all the oxen ... a living animal. Ismail, peace be upon him, lay down; he lay down before his father.
en_old: ...peace be upon him... thin... half a heap... seven men... all of them... all the rams... the living animal... Ismail, peace be upon him, was laid down, laid down before his father.

brh: باوتنا کاچوئی کشا اللہ سخی قطارے کشا باوت چٹیم تخا مار خاچا پہ بائے تیز بنتو سئی پدی کنا چھنا پہ ئے تے کن بین پاریا با سے مہربانی سے انت کتا ئس اللہ
en: The father took out his own knife — Allah is generous — took out the knife; the father placed ...; the son lay down. He said, 'Father, ... sharp ...' Then, 'My child, say...' ... he said, 'Father...' What a kindness, what a kindness Allah did!
en_old: The father took out his knife — Allah the Generous — drew the line; the father laid the son down. "Father, it is sharp, it is ready." Then again, "my son..." ... what a kindness He did, Allah.

brh: ئے تا تے کنے لمہ نا مونی پاروس، ئے لمہ کنے باز دوست ئے لمہ کنے باز دوست، ئے تینا لمہ نا بکل کٹ آ، تینا لمہ نا خن کٹ آ موکلافیٹا، داسہ ولدا قیامت اسکان لمہ ہاجرہ نا خن پٹ نیم خن پٹ، ئے کنا باوہ اگر ارا
en: If only you had told me this in front of my mother! I love my mother very much, I love my mother very much. I would have taken leave from my mother's embrace, from my mother's eyes. Now, until the Day of Judgment, mother Hajar's eyes will keep searching, her half-open eyes searching. O my father, if...
en_old: ...you told me this in front of my mother; I love my mother very much, I love my mother very much; I was sent away from my mother's embrace, from before my mother's eyes. Now, then, until the Day of Judgment, mother Hajar's eyes will be on the road, one eye on the road... I, my father, if...

brh: دا سٹھی پاروس، ئے لمہ نا زیارت ء کریٹہ، ہمو طریقہ لمہ تون عید کریٹہ، لمہ بہ کنے خناکا، ئے بہ لمہ ء خناٹ، تنے زری مرو کریٹہ، لیکن باوہ دا سٹھی انتس مس مسنا، دا ہسی مہربانی ئس کر، ئے تینا کوشی کشی وا او خلتے
en: Had you told me this, I would have visited my mother, I would have celebrated Eid with mother in that same way; mother would have seen me and I would have seen mother; I would have ... But father, whatever has happened has happened. Do me this one kindness: I will take off my shirt, and ...
en_old: Had you said this, I would have visited my mother, I would have celebrated Eid with mother in the same way; mother would have seen me, I would have seen mother; we would have been together. But father, whatever happened to that, do me one kindness: I will take off my own clothes...

brh: ہی وا ارا تم تمننگو کنا کوزے کنا لمہ غدیس لمہ کنا شانے توستا ضرور لمہ نی پائے کنا اسماعیل مکرے کنا پلنگا چھرا مکرے کنا زیبنگا چھرا مکرے آخر نی پاروس دے تڑے نورتا لمہ او غو
en: ... when you get there, take my shirt to my mother; mother ... my ... Mother will surely ask you: 'My Ismail...? My leopard-like boy...? My beautiful boy...?' In the end you will tell her ... slaughtered ... mother ...
en_old: ...when you reach home, give my clothes to my mother; mother will surely ask, you tell her: don't say my Ismail did it, don't say my leopard cub wandered off, don't say my beautiful child wandered off. In the end you said... the mother...

brh: اوئے لمہ نا خنتنے خنیکا خوار لمہ کنے کوزے شانیت کنا لمہ ء پاو پاو انشاءاللہ قیامت نا میدان ئٹی ایلو چڑا تنے لمہ باوہ نا کسر تے سلوک مرو ئے ہم نما کسرے سلوک مروٹ اللہ ء پاروٹ اللہ چنکی ٹی ئے لمہ نا مزے خنتوٹ
en: Oh, looking into mother's eyes ... poor mother ... my shirt ... Tell my mother, tell her: God willing, on the field of Judgment the others will be standing on the paths of their mothers and fathers; I too will be standing on your path. I will say to Allah: 'Allah, in childhood I never knew the joy of a mother.'
en_old: Looking at the mother's eyes... the poor mother... my mother... say, say: God willing, on the field of Judgment, whatever treatment was given to the shortcomings of your mother and father, the same treatment will be given to your shortcomings. Allah will say: in childhood you tasted the mother's love.

brh: توڑ لمہ نا زیارت ء باز کننگ کتوڑ کنے زو بٹنگاس ئے باوہ نا خدمت ء کننگ کتوڑ لمہ نا خدمت ء کننگ کتوڑ اللہ داسہ کنا لمہ باوہ ء زو کن تو ملاف ئے جنت ء تینتون ہوار دیفتہ تاکہ زہری کن ختم مرے مار تف
en: I could not visit my mother much — I was taken away early. I could not serve my father, I could not serve my mother. Allah, now soon unite my mother and father with me; I will take them along with me into Paradise, so that my longing comes to an end ... son ... tie ...
en_old: If you have made many visits to your mother, I was told late... if you have served your father, if you have served your mother, Allah will now take my mother and father, together with you, into Paradise, so that it is finished forever... there is no son.

brh: منگا مار خاچا باوا سینہ غژوندا پارے چنا پجی ابا پیدا ستر وڑ پیا او ابا قطارے تخا باوے یقینی کہ مار از دمٹی تڑنگک ہشکنا خلقنا سل لکھ والا زو تڑنگک لیکن اللہ
en: ... the son lay down; the father held him to his chest and said, 'Child!' 'Yes, father.' ... The father placed the knife; the father was certain that the son would be slaughtered in an instant — the knife that would quickly cut the skin and neck of any creature — but Allah...
en_old: ...the son... the father pressed him to his chest and said: 'Son...' 'Father...' ...he placed the knife on the throat. The father was certain that the son would be slaughtered in an instant, a knife that would quickly slaughter a hundred thousand of creation, but Allah...

brh: تو کاتھے ویس؟ خدا نا ذات نی قسم، ابراہیم تو نی پالنٹی لیکن ئے خدا نی منع کیوا۔ ابراہیم علیہ السلام مار نا چنکا سینہ غا زلفانی، امر و زیبا انگا مار، جوان گا مار نا سینہ غا زلفانی، کنا لمہ غاک نم بمبو، کنا
en: 'So why don't you cut?' 'By the essence of God, Ibrahim, you are telling me to, but God forbids me.' Ibrahim, peace be upon him, [looked at] his son's little chest — what a beautiful son, a fine son's chest ... My mothers ... my...
en_old: 'Then why do you not cut?' 'By the essence of God, Ibrahim, you command, but God forbids me.' Ibrahim, peace be upon him, on his young son's chest, the handsome and beautiful boy, the good son's chest, his locks... 'My mother... tell her, my...'

brh: ایلم نم ہمو وخت آ کہ تنے ایمان کامل کیمل باور تنے مار نا سینہ غہ زنڈانے ہئے ہمو جسم کہ دنیا او جسم ہرا کا خنے سینہ غہ زنڈانے کٹارے لختے خا خوشکینی شروع کرے اللہ نا سے بندے خبردار کٹار تڑپیس تو پی تو بے خنے
en: Brothers, at that moment when his faith was perfect and complete, his belief — with his own son's chest ... — that body which the world [sees], that body which anyone sees, against his chest — the knife began to go dry on the neck. Allah's ... servant: 'Beware, knife, you shall not cut!' ... then he saw...
en_old: ...knowledge... at that time when your faith is complete, your belief complete, you have the son alive against your chest, that body which the world sees, alive against the chest; the knife on the throat began to dry up. Allah's... servant, beware, the knife did not cut, then he saw...

brh: اللہ اینز کے تڑے وتا کتار ابراہیم خوشکا خوشکا دم درینگا ہنو سبکی خل نزی وینٹی اینٹین سے نزی وینٹی اسماعیل کے رنغاجو کے اسماعیل اوغا پرے ابا پجی کنا چنا پرے ابا ئے تے بنوٹ
en: Allah ... would the knife cut? Ibrahim — dried, dried — his breath ... now a stone nearby ... nearby ... Ismail ... Ismail wept and said, 'Father!' 'Yes, my child.' He said, 'Father, I...'
en_old: Allah... the knife... Ibrahim, with dry, dry breaths... now a light stone near... Ismail... Ismail said: 'Father...' My son said: 'Father... you will hear...'

brh: تپتو سئی شاید کنا مونی ہورنگٹی اوزنے رمبلنگٹی ہی کنا جان نی وننگٹی کنا چہرہ غنے رمبلنگٹی آباد اسا زو کر مونی کنا بند کر خنت تنے تپتو سئی کنا چہرے خنپئی باز دوستو
en: '[If they are] not bound, perhaps while looking at my face, ..., while seeing my body, while ... my face — Father, do it quickly now: cover my face, close your eyes; [if] your eyes are not bound you will see my face — you love me so much.'
en_old: 'Perhaps you will hesitate while looking at my face, in seeing my face, in seeing my body, my face trembling... quickly, cover my face, close your eyes, lest you hesitate on seeing my face, for you love me very much.'

brh: او کنے کنے خبر ئے اسٹ او مار سے اٹ خنتاتے نی تف مڑا قطار اٹی خزورٹ ہلاو کنا باوا تاکہ زو قربان مرے پجی کنا چنا خنتاتے تفینے پارے باوا اسٹ پئی تس کر مہربانی کا کنا دوت تے ہم تف کنا نت تے ہم تف پین تے چنا پئے ابا بل کنے سکھ
en: He said, 'I know one thing: tie your eyes with something, otherwise I will thrash about at the knife. Come on, my father, so that I may be sacrificed quickly.' 'Yes, my child.' He tied his eyes. The son said, 'Father, one more thing, do me a kindness: tie my hands too, tie my feet too.' ... 'Child...' 'Say, father...' 'Let me...'
en_old: He... I know... look at that son's eyes: 'You do not...' He said, holding the knife... 'Come, my father, so that it is sacrificed quickly.' The son said: 'Father...' He said: 'Father, I beg you kindly, do not tie my hands, do not tie my feet either.' The son said: 'Father...'

brh: سکرات باز سختی حیاراتن تڑنگوٹ لکھ کن جدا مروئی ساہ کن پیشتہ موئے ہموتن کنے خبر تمپوئے دوتے خزوڈ ابا نیلہ گور ہئے نت کن نیلہ گوئے قیامت اللہ نمونے بروڈ پارو اسماعیل کائے کینگ نمونے
en: 'The death throes are very hard; when I am being slaughtered, my neck will be separated from me, my breath will leave me, and at that moment I will not be aware of anything; I will thrash my hands about, father; ... my feet ... On the Day of Judgment Allah ... I will come ... He will say, "Ismail..."'
en_old: 'The agony of death is very hard, the throat has to be cut, the soul has to be separated, the breath... when you slaughter me, tie my hands, father, tie them tightly, tie my feet tightly; on the Day of Judgment Allah will ask you.' Ismail said... 'You...'

brh: تینا باون مونٹی شماتے خلکوت تینا باون سینیٹی لغت تے خلکوت ابا یارانان خدان مونی ات کننگ کروڑ ابا کنا ہرتوما دوتے تف کنا ہرتوما نت تے تف گڑا کنے تڑ لیکن تینا خنتیم بند کر تاکہ کنا مونی ہڑپا باوا پی جی کنا چنا اینو اینا
en: '... lest I strike blows in front of my father, lest I land kicks on my father's chest. Father, how will I be able to face God? Father, tie both my hands, tie both my feet, then slaughter me — but close your eyes too, so that you do not look at my face.' 'Father!' 'Yes, my child.' 'Today...'
en_old: 'Lest I kick in front of my father, lest I strike my father's chest; father, you have to face God. Father, do not tie my hands, do not tie my feet, then slaughter me, but close your eyes so that you do not look at my face.' 'Father...' 'My son, today...'

brh: دوا ئے کلے بڑو نشان مسلمان دنو باور آکھنوری کہ مارنا دنیا گپاتے بنٹی واللہ ہم دوک تہ کارم کیرا ہموتم تینا مون خانتے بند کرے مارنا دوتہ نتہ دفے ہائے سلام است ابراہیم علیہ السلام نا کہ داخہ قربانی تہ ننگٹی اسماعیل
en: ... of all ... a great sign ... Muslims, believe this ... that hearing the son's words, by God, even the hands would ... work. At that moment he closed his eyes and tied the son's hands and feet. Ah, salute to Ibrahim, peace be upon him, who was making such a sacrifice ... Ismail...
en_old: Prayer... the sign... Muslim... believe... that the son's words in the world... by Allah, the hands... then he closed his eyes, the son's hands and feet... Peace be upon Ibrahim, peace be upon him, who performed such a sacrifice; before us Ismail...

brh: قطار شروع کرے اللہ سے پانتے جبرائیل جی کنا اللہ پیزو کر ابراہیم ہبو ملائکہ کا اسمان آن ہرنگتی ابراہیم سلامے ابراہیم سلامے ابراہیم سلامے کہ مار تنے تڑنگتی خدا نا ذات نا قسم آخری کنا جملہ غاکو او جبرائیل
en: He began with the knife. Allah said to Jibril, 'Jibril!' 'Yes, my Allah.' '... Ibrahim ...' The angels were watching from the sky: 'Salute to Ibrahim, salute to Ibrahim, salute to Ibrahim, who is slaughtering his own son!' By the essence of God, my last sentences ... Jibril...
en_old: He began with the knife. Allah said to Jibril: 'My...' Allah... Ibrahim... the angels looking down from heaven: 'Peace be upon Ibrahim, peace be upon Ibrahim, peace be upon Ibrahim,' that he is slaughtering his son. By the essence of God, my last sentences... that Jibril...

brh: ئے خڑ ئے ذوالجلال نا ٹی خواہش اور پزور مسنے ئنا خڑ ئے شیف در در اسماعیل ئے در تا اسماعیل ئے بر کر خڑ ئے کیرغنے ابراہیم نا خن تپوکو کٹار خڑ نا لکھے تخ تاکہ خڑ تڑنگے ایڑ تو ماتا قربانی تے قبول کیت
en: ... the ram ... the wish of the Lord of Majesty has been ... My ram — take it down, take, take Ismail away, take Ismail out, put the ram underneath — Ibrahim's eyes are bound — put the knife on the ram's neck so that the ram is slaughtered. I accept the sacrifice of both of them.
en_old: ...the ram... in the Lord of Majesty... the wish... the ram... take Ismail away, bring the ram, lay the ram down; Ibrahim's eyes were closed; place the knife on the ram's throat so that the ram is slaughtered; there... 'Your sacrifice has been accepted.'

brh: ارے کسے طاقت، اینگ چڑو اسٹ بانگوس ئس بغل ٹی دے پر ابا یو ئے ہلو مدرسے مین کہ سائیں اکو ہی بانگ، مولوی صاحب آ، ہی بانگو کہ ہبو آ، بانگوس ئس ایتون دا داخو بغل ٹی تائسٹ دانا جواب
en: Hey, who has that kind of strength? Here, just one rooster under the arm ... 'Father ... take it to the madrasa' ... 'Sir, here is a rooster, Maulvi sahib, here is a rooster' ... a rooster like this, this size, under the arm ... his answer to this...
en_old: Who has the strength? ...a small goat under his arm... father... take it to the madrasa: 'Sir, here is a goat, Maulvi sahib, here is the goat'... a goat like this under his arm... his answer.

brh: ئے پاو اڑے واجہ سوسرے تان کین سدھا مدرسہ تان تڑے سائیں ہی بانگو کوہبو آ ئے پاو باوے بادام تیتو کہ بانگوئے کنفی باوت مین بادام خنتوسوس کہ بانگو دا بے ایمان کنکا
en: I said, 'Hey sir, ... straight from the madrasa ... slaughter it, sir, here is the rooster ...' I said, 'Father did not give almonds to feed the rooster' ... 'Your father ... have you never seen almonds? ... that this rooster, this faithless one...'
en_old: He said there, the master... straight to the madrasa, sir... the goat... he said the father gave almonds, that the goat... father... you have seen almonds, that goat, this faithless one...

brh: اور خناٹہ دبنگو دے چرے فکا، اڑے اسماعیل امبار مر، ابراہیم امبارو باوہ ہراکا پیدا مریک، اسماعیل امبارو چنا ہراکا پیدا مریک، خبرے تمتو، کھڑ بلنتی اللہ اکبر اللہ اکبر لا الہ الا اللہ واللہ اکبر اللہ اکبر وللہ الحمد
en: ... I would see ... Hey, be like Ismail! Where is a father like Ibrahim born? Where is a child like Ismail born? He did not realize ... the ram ... Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, there is no god but Allah, and Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, and to Allah belongs all praise.
en_old: ...then... 'There, Ismail, get up.' Where will a father like Ibrahim be born, where will a son like Ismail be born? Do you know? The ram standing... Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, Allahu akbar wa lillahil hamd.

brh: ابراہیم دادے پارے اسماعیل کیرنگ پارے اللہ اکبر قطار لکھے توخے ہم خدا استانے پاک ازدم تو اسماعیلے جبرائیل کشا دانگن خڑ کیرنگ تس خڑ تڑنگا خڑ تڑنگا اسماعیل ایدے باوا دادے
en: Ibrahim said this; with Ismail lying underneath, he said 'Allahu Akbar' and put the knife to the neck — God is pure — in an instant Jibril pulled Ismail out and from here put the ram underneath; the ram was slaughtered, the ram was slaughtered. Ismail ... father ... this...
en_old: Ibrahim said this, laid Ismail down, said Allahu Akbar, placed the knife on the throat; God is pure, in an instant Jibril pulled Ismail away and laid the ram there instead; the ram was slaughtered, the ram was slaughtered. Ismail... 'Father...' this...

brh: خنگ ملنگار اسماعیلے دوغک باوہ دا دوغک شاید کنا ٹی اسہ غلطیس مسنے گڑا سستیس مسنے کہ اللہ کنا چنا نا قربانی قبول کتو اسماعیلے دوغک شاید ئے دیر خا غلطیس کرینوٹ کہ خدا کنا قربانی قبول کتو خڑ نا قربانی قبول کرینے اللہ پارے فلہ
en: When their eyes opened, Ismail weeps and the father weeps: 'Perhaps there has been some fault in me, or some negligence, that Allah did not accept the sacrifice of my child.' Ismail weeps: 'Perhaps I have made some mistake, that God did not accept my sacrifice and has accepted the ram's sacrifice.' Allah said: 'Fa...'
en_old: When their eyes met, Ismail weeps, the father weeps: 'Perhaps there was some fault in me, some laxity, that Allah did not accept the sacrifice of my son.' Ismail weeps: 'Perhaps I made some mistake, that God did not accept my sacrifice and accepted the sacrifice of the ram.' Allah said: ...

brh: ئے ابراہیم نا تغ پورو مس اسماعیل نا قربانی پورو مس ابراہیم نی سلام مرے اسماعیل
en: O, Ibrahim's dream has been fulfilled, Ismail's sacrifice has been completed. Ibrahim, peace be upon you; Ismail...
en_old: Ibrahim's dream was fulfilled, Ismail's sacrifice was completed. 'Ibrahim, peace be upon you. Ismail...'

brh: ننا سلام مرے ننا باوہ ماننا قربانی قبول کرین ئے محبوبا، ئے محمد مصطفی، قیامت اسکان تیوہ امت نا پاہ کہ ننا داتے تے قربانی قبول تاکہ اسماعیل نا قربانی زندہ مرے ابراہیم نا قربانی زندہ مرے اور الحمدللہ نن کننگ ٹی آن تا انشاءاللہ قیامت اسکان مسلمان قربانی کیک۔
en: Our greetings of peace be upon him, our father. "We have accepted the sacrifice. O Beloved, O Muhammad Mustafa, until the Day of Judgment I give this to your whole Ummah; tell them that their sacrifice will be accepted, so that Ismail's sacrifice stays alive and Ibrahim's sacrifice stays alive." And praise be to God, we are doing it, and God willing, Muslims will go on offering sacrifice until the Day of Judgment.
en_old: Peace be upon us; our father (Ibrahim) — "We have accepted the sacrifice. O Beloved, O Muhammad Mustafa, until the Day of Judgment I grant it to your Ummah; We accept this sacrifice from your hands so that Ismail's sacrifice stays alive and Ibrahim's sacrifice stays alive." And praise be to God, from our doing until the Day of Judgment, God willing, Muslims will keep offering sacrifice.

brh: ابا قربانی سسی الو اسہ بلو قربانی چمکو، نن نماز خوانے کبو، ئے کہ خنک تا، ئے گلیٹ کا کڑین تینا المسی، مولوی صاحب اسہ دعا کر، درو صفا ہنا اسہ دعا کنا کوٹہ چپی مس
en: Alas, the sacrifice was no cheap thing; it was a great sacrifice. We pray... [garbled stretch]... Maulvi sahib, make a supplication. Yesterday it went completely... a supplication... my... [unclear].
en_old: 'Father, let the sacrifice be...' a big sacrifice... we offer the prayer... that... the Maulvi sahib made a prayer; yesterday he went... one prayer, my room was flooded with mud.

brh: درو صفا ہناس، ہورا ترر کہ درو دا بیمار ئس پی بیمار ئس کہ واللہ الحمدللہ تال برنج نا کھوم سیر کریتنے، تندور نا ارغ ئس مچو کھوم، نہ ایلا دا پنی نہ ایلا ہربوئے، نہ ایلا دھڑوئے، نہ ایلا چمانٹوئے
en: Yesterday it all went by. Look: people say yesterday this one was sick, that one was sick, but by God, praise be to God, they have eaten their fill from a tray of rice and a tandoor bread, and there is neither this nor that complaint [the list of ailments is unclear].
en_old: Go all the way to Dero Safa and look there: who is sick, which one is ill? By God, praise be to God, they have filled their bellies with rice, a tandoor bread on a full stomach, and nothing else — no such ailment, no such complaint, no body ache, no eye ache.

brh: کلن خلسینہ خلسینہ باقی مسیتے بس دعا کر مولوی نی دعا اچنا کپیرے کٹنگوس کباٹی کٹنگوس قیامت نا دے مرو بے نمازی خدا نا مونی مہر پوئے وجوہ یومئذ ناضرہ الے ربھا ناظرہ کیا
en: We have all finished, finished; the rest is left over. Now just make the supplication, Maulvi. Why don't you pray? [unclear]... On the Day of Judgment the one who does not pray will stand before God [without mercy]. "Some faces on that Day will be radiant, looking at their Lord" — what does it mean?
en_old: We have explained it all, explained it all; the rest remains — just pray. Maulvi, you pray; why don't you? I have been cut off, cut off in the cupboard. On the Day of Judgment the one who neglects prayer will find no mercy before God. "Some faces that Day will be radiant, looking at their Lord" — what does that mean?

brh: امو تا خدا امو تا چہرہ غاتے ہرک کہ ہرا اللہ نا سجدہ کننگ اٹی ء، نمازی اخہ گناہ گار مرے ہم نماز انشاءاللہ پل سے جوڑ مریک دیک تا، نماز بھلو نعمت سے، داسہ مغرب نا اذان مریک انشاءاللہ، دیر
en: God looks at the faces of those who prostrate themselves before Allah. However sinful a person who prays may be, his prayer, God willing, becomes a bridge for him. Prayer is a great blessing. Now, God willing, the Maghrib call to prayer is about to sound...
en_old: God looks at their faces, those who are in prostration to Allah. However sinful a person who prays may be, prayer, God willing, will become a bridge for him. Prayer is a great blessing. Now the Maghrib call to prayer is about to come, God willing...

brh: دیر دیر نماز خوانیرے باوہ؟ انشاءاللہ۔ ہا انشاءاللہ کیرے پدن تو دبیہ مکے ونے۔ ایر انت ٹونو منتے۔ انشاءاللہ نارو خلیرا دو خلیرا واللہ اذان آن پد او سدے خے خے اورا غدا سے فون ئس بس۔ ضعیفہ نا فون برے نا مصلے الکائے۔
en: Do you pray late, father? "God willing." Yes, you say "God willing" and then afterwards [you don't do it]. What sort of thing is that? "God willing," they say, and [unclear]... By God, after the call to prayer he goes "ahem, ahem", and then a phone call comes. When the wife's phone call comes, your prayer mat gets rolled up.
en_old: Do you pray from time to time, father? "God willing." Yes, you say "God willing" and then afterwards you don't do it. What is the use of that? "God willing, I'll pray, I'll pray" — by God, after the call to prayer he starts coughing, hemming and hawing, then a phone call comes. The old woman's phone call comes and you hang up your prayer mat.

brh: دا لرزو کہ نم تس مرو، دا خلو کہ نم تس مرو، کنا ایلم آ کنا دوست آ بابا، نبی کریم ﷺ نا زالبول آ کے زمانہ ٹی سورا، مکہ مدینہ ٹی ہم زالبول آ کے سورا، ئے کنا ایلم آ خریت، ارغ آتہ پچ آتہ جوڑ کریرہ، آنج آتہ شاغارہ، خن
en: This should make you tremble, this should make you afraid. My brothers, my friends, elders: in the time of the Noble Prophet (peace be upon him) there were women too; in Mecca and Medina there were women too. O my brothers, [listen]: they made bread, made clothes, put drawstrings in the trousers — look...
en_old: This trembling that you have, this fear that you have — my brothers, my friends, father: in the time of the Noble Prophet (peace be upon him) there were women living too; in Mecca and Medina there were women living too. O my brothers, take care: they baked bread, they made clothes, they did the household chores — look.

brh: دے سرمہ کرے را ارغاتے غسل تسرا تیل خلکورا رائی کرک در محمد کریم دا سے اعلان کرین جنگ مننگٹی در لیکن مرو فیز کنا محبوب نا آواز سے حضرت عمر فاروق حضرت خبیب توار کرے یا خبیب تال ہنا خبیب دانگ با بس پین
en: They would apply kohl, bathe them, rub oil on them and send them off. The noble Muhammad made an announcement: "A war is happening — go!" But... [unclear]... it was the voice of my Beloved. Hazrat Umar Farooq called Hazrat Khubaib: "O Khubaib!"... "Khubaib, come over here." He came. Then...
en_old: Applied kohl, gave them bread, bathed them, rubbed oil on them, sent them off... Muhammad Karim... we made this announcement; in the midst of battle... but no... it was the voice of my Beloved. Hazrat Umar Farooq, Hazrat Khubaib — he called out: "O Khubaib, go there, Khubaib, come here, enough, again..."

brh: بے خبر! نی کلمہ خوان ئس نی خخ خلکو رخک کٹار، پیامبر! خلیفۃ المسلمین! پین کنے ہرے پبو، صرف دا کوزے کنے خیرم برزا کمنو، تینٹ سمجھیرے کہ کلمہ نا خاطرن اخ خلنگانوٹ، ارا دم کوزے تے برزا کرے، سو ہلو، چھڑو ہڈاکس۔ پین کنے
en: "Unaware one! You were a reciter of the Kalima; they put fire on you... daggers..." "Prophet! Caliph of the Muslims! Don't ask me any more. Just lift this shirt of mine off my back, and you yourselves will understand how much I was beaten for the sake of the Kalima." When he lifted the shirt, there was no flesh, only bones. Then me...
en_old: Unaware one! You who recited the Kalima, you who... wounds and daggers... Prophet! Caliph of the Muslims! Do not look at me again; only lift this shirt of mine a little, then you yourself will understand how much I have been struck for the sake of the Kalima. When he lifted the shirt — a hundred wounds, bare bones. Again, me...

brh: پوغات خاچفیرا ہشنگاٹا ہشنگاٹا ہشنگاٹا ہشنگاٹا لیکن محبوب نا کلمہ پوغات زیئم خواناٹ۔ گڑا انو کلمہ خوانرے مضبوطو عید کبو انو مضبوطو کلمہ خوانرے صبرم کیرے تکلیفاتے ٹی۔
en: They would lay me down on the coals, and I would burn, burn, burn, burn, but even on the coals I kept reciting the Kalima of the Beloved. So today, recite the Kalima and celebrate Eid steadfastly; today recite the Kalima firmly and be patient in hardships too.
en_old: They lit the firewood and burned, burned, burned, burned — but I kept reciting the Kalima of the Beloved amid the firewood. So today recite the Kalima firmly and celebrate Eid; today recite the Kalima firmly and be patient in hardships.

brh: عالم اتون گڑاس ملیرے ملپیرے یا مولوی تے چہرہ وڑپک وقت ئے ہا انشاءاللہ عالم اتون وار ئے جمعیت علمائے اسلام نا جھنڈا غاتے خنانورے خنتنورے ہمرو بابا مونو بلنا پیو نو ئسیٹ کنے رفیق
en: Whether you get something from the scholars or not, or whether the Maulvis' faces don't please you — the time... yes, God willing, it is the scholars' turn. Have you seen the flags of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam or not? That old man in front, the elder — he is a companion of mine.
en_old: Whether you get something from the scholars or not, or whether you cannot stand the faces of the Maulvis — the time is... yes, God willing, it is the turn of the scholars. You have seen the flags of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam, you have seen them. Father, that old man with the white hair in front, he is my companion.

brh: بابا دھار انگا ناسخ پدا جوانوس ئے ماما پرنے خنفمٹ کے پا انشااللہ دروازہ تن خلپو خلیپو شیر نا استو استاتن بلنگ کبو لڈسپو خلیپو سنم پیش تمپک طاقت خدا نا ذات نا ئے اللہ کنا
en: Bābā, ... afterwards you are fine. O uncle, I haven't seen you before... say "God willing". Don't [knock] at the door, don't be afraid; with a lion's heart... don't [waver], don't be afraid; [nothing] will come forward. Power belongs to God's own being. O my Allah...
en_old: Father, there is no erasing it afterward, young man. Uncle, I haven't seen... say "God willing." Do not knock at the door, do not look; wrestle the lion with your bones; do not shake, do not look; the idol will not stand before it. Power belongs to the essence of God; Allah is mine.

brh: بننگے قبول کے، اللہ نما تولنگے قبول کے، دا قران حدیث گپاک قیامت اسکان چلینگرہ، ئے و نی کینہ و پین بریرہ، مولوی پین مروڑ، بنوکاک پین مروڑ، کے پیر مروڑ، کے ورنا، کے زالبول، کے نرینہ، آن شاء اللہ ننا زمزیر نا کڑوک مضبوط او اسلام والا
en: May He accept your coming; may Allah accept your sitting here. These words of the Quran and Hadith will go on until the Day of Judgment. You and I will die and others will come: there will be other Maulvis, other listeners — some old, some young, some women, some men. God willing, the links of our chain are strong, the links of Islam.
en_old: May He accept your coming, may Allah accept your sitting. These words of the Quran and Hadith will keep going until the Day of Judgment. You and I will pass away and others will come; other Maulvis will come, other listeners will come, some old, some young, some women, some men — God willing, the links of our chain are strong, the people of Islam.

brh: مدینہ اسکن حوار او صحابہ تو نبی تو حوار او انشاءاللہ اگر کہ خدا زندگی تس ننے نن اللہ نا حکماتے منینا نبی نا شریعت ئے جی کینہ درستی جاگہ ایتنہ مسیتاتے آباد کینہ مدرساتے ٹی چناتے خالفنہ حافظ و قاری عالم جوڑ کینہ انشاءاللہ ننا قبر ہم زیبا ننا حشر ہم زیبا
en: They are joined all the way to Medina, joined with the Companions, joined with the Prophet. God willing, if God gives us life, we will obey Allah's commands, put the Prophet's Sharia into practice and give it its rightful place, fill the mosques, teach children in the madrasas and make them hafiz, qari and scholars. God willing, our grave too will be beautiful and our resurrection too will be beautiful.
en_old: Together all the way to Medina, together with the Companions and with the Prophet, God willing. If God grants us life, we will obey Allah's commands, we will live by the Prophet's Shariah, we will give everything its proper place, we will fill the mosques, we will send the children to the madrasas and make them hafiz, qari and scholars — God willing, our grave will be beautiful and our resurrection will be beautiful too.

brh: نا قیامت نا زیبا اللہ نا مون ئے برون آن شاء اللہ اللہ ننے ہروئی صرف پاروئی انت نی تو حساب کے و سدھا در جنت ہی محبوب پاروئی ولدا ہنبا مبارک مرے نی کنے جنت نا دربار ئے محمد نی کھمب کے نبوت والا سینہ تو ملا فک پیتانگ با دانگ با کنا
en: Our Day of Judgment will be beautiful; God willing, we will come before Allah. Allah will look at us and will only say, "What reckoning is there with you? Go straight to Paradise." The Beloved will say, "Then go, congratulations to you"... at the court of Paradise, Muhammad will embrace you to the chest of prophethood: "...come this way, come here, my..."
en_old: Your Day of Judgment will be beautiful; we will go before Allah, God willing. Allah will not question us; He will only say, "What reckoning is there with you? Go straight to Paradise." The Beloved will say, "Then go, congratulations to you." In the court of Paradise, Muhammad will embrace you against the chest of prophethood — "Come here, come here, mine..."

brh: ئنا اعطیناک الکوثر فصل لربک وانحر آن شانئک ہو الابتر، بر حوض کوثر کنا دوٹی، ایلو نبیک مرو قبضہ کنائے، کنا امت تے تینا مال و کنفوا، بر نکھراس بر، ہراتم امتی بریک، حضور پیالہ س پر کیک ایتک تا، اگر پنجاہ
en: "Indeed, We have given you al-Kawthar; so pray to your Lord and sacrifice; indeed, your enemy is the one cut off." Come, the Pool of Kawthar is in my hands; there will be other prophets, but the possession is mine. I will give my Ummah to drink from what is my own. Come, ... come. Whenever someone of the Ummah comes, the Prophet fills a cup and gives it to them. If fifty...
en_old: "Indeed We have granted you al-Kawthar, so pray to your Lord and sacrifice; indeed your enemy is the one cut off." Come, the Pool of Kawthar is in my hands; no other prophet has it, it is in my possession. I will give my Ummah to drink from my own property. Come, don't be shy, come. Whenever a member of the Ummah comes, the Prophet fills a cup and gives it to him. Even if fifty...

brh: ئے نمے ٹی دونو رنگ خنپرہ کہ نم غلہ غریب آتے بشخیرے تیرے، مہمان ئے اودے آتے لے نی غلہ غاتے قیمت کر، کریم خان فی الحال نم ہمبو ئے دا دے مسے دے سوچ کیو اوکانے پد نم تو حال احوال کیوہ اوکانے
en: I don't see that kind of thing in you — that you would hand out wheat to the poor and give it away... [guests]... you set the price of the wheat. Karim Khan, for now you go; I'll think it over for a couple of days, and after that I'll talk things over with you.
en_old: I do not see in you the kind who would forgive and give wheat to the poor. To the guests — "Take it; you set the price of the wheat." Karim Khan, for now you go; this day has come, I will think it over and after that I will talk things over with you.

brh: پد ایلم غلہ ٹیوہ سلیمان بوئد نا صحیح ہی مار کوشش کے غلہ ننہ نیتے ٹھیک ئے ایلم ئے دا دے موزئی سوچ کیوہ ولا نم تو حال احوال کیوہ صحیح ہی سلیمان بھائی نن دا سیلان صحیح ہی
en: Then, brother, I'll give the wheat... Suleiman's... all right? — Try, give us wheat. — Fine, brother, I'll think this over in these days and then talk things over with you. — All right, brother Suleiman, we [unclear]... all right.
en_old: Then, brother, we'll give the wheat, Suleiman... right? Make an effort, try to get wheat for us. Alright, brother, think this over carefully, otherwise you... we'll check back with you. Right, Suleiman brother, we're on this, right.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام میر سلیمان خان۔ خیریت دے؟ خوش؟ طبیعت صحت خیر؟
en: Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace, Mir Suleiman Khan. Is all well? Are you happy? Is your health good?
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace, Mir Suleiman Khan. Is everything well? Are you happy? Is your health fine?

brh: سلیمان خان انت حال احوال؟ ایلو حال احوال خیر ء، دا کریم خان کیرے غلہ خوارنگاٹی، انت سلاہ نی تینے اتیفنتہ۔ ئنا ایلو، دا بندغاتے غلہ اسل تفیس۔
en: Suleiman Khan, how are things? — Brother, otherwise things are fine. This Karim Khan is asking me for wheat; what is your advice, should I give it to him? — No, brother, don't give these people any wheat at all.
en_old: Suleiman Khan, how are things? All is well, brother. This Karim Khan is asking for wheat; what do you advise, shall we give him some? No, brother, don't give these people any wheat at all.

brh: چائے اخس کہ پیسہ ایتینے زیادہ اخس کہ زیادہ قیمت ایتینے دا بندغاتے فیس خدو نا سال اٹی دا بندغاتے گنی غلط اسوس ہزار اٹ نا غلاتے الکونیان لیکن
en: No matter how much money they give you, no matter how high a price they give you, don't give it to these people. Last year these people did a great wrong: they bought up wheat at a thousand, but...
en_old: Tea — however much money you give, the more you give, the higher the price you have paid. These people, in that year, these people were very wrong; they hoarded wheat by the thousands, but...

brh: دھیرے رکھ، اسے جاگہ سے اسٹاک کرے۔ تمنہ وخت خلت مسنے نا کڈی غلہ نا۔ تو اوکان پد ہزار روپیہ پنجاہ کلو اسے گہ موتا نا۔ تو پورا بسے ہزار مس۔
en: They held it back bit by bit and stockpiled it in one place. When the time came and the wheat ran out, then after that it was a thousand rupees for fifty kilos... So in all it came to twenty thousand.
en_old: Keep it slowly, stock it in one place. By the time your sack of wheat ran out, after that it was a thousand rupees for fifty kilos in a good season. So the total came to twenty thousand.

brh: انت وجہ غان کہ غلہ ء او شاٹ کرے غلہ ء ڈکا دا نو بندہ او غلہ ء الیرے او دیر ئس چانس ء ڈکے تینا گودام اٹ اوکان پد
en: For what reason? Because he made wheat scarce and hid the wheat. These people take the wheat and, waiting a while for a chance, hide it in their own warehouse; after that...
en_old: For what reason? Because he created a shortage of wheat; he hid the wheat. These nine people took the wheat, waited for their chance, hid it in their own warehouse, and after that...

brh: علاقہ ٹی کہ غلہ کم مس، مخلوق ء غلہ نا ضرورت مس، تو نا قیمت ء اسٹ نا ارٹ کیرہ، سمجھاس؟ دا بندغ آک کبھی تفیس، اور دا بندغ آک ملک نا خیر خواہ افس، دا اینو پگاہ ملک نا دشمن او۔
en: When wheat became scarce in the area and people needed wheat, they make its price double — understand? Never give it to these people; these people are not well-wishers of the country — these days they are the country's enemies.
en_old: When wheat became scarce in the area and people needed wheat, they doubled the price — understand? These people never stop, and these people are not well-wishers of the country; today or tomorrow they are the enemies of the country.

brh: عوام نا دشمن، غریب نا دشمن، غریب آتان تھالو واری۔ سئی پارے سیرم نی۔ دا سانیور مخلوق، نیم نیم سیر ہمو تلنگٹی۔ آ مچے ہزارہ پنجاہ کلو ہرا گانی۔
en: Enemies of the people, enemies of the poor, [they take it] from the poor. — You've said it right. — These [poor] people are buying it weighed out half a seer at a time, while those ones have thousands of fifty-kilo sacks.
en_old: Enemy of the people, enemy of the poor, cheating the poor. You said it right, sir. These poor people are buying half a seer at a time, while those others have thousands of fifty-kilo sacks.

brh: مخلوق دا سدھ ئے خبر اف ہمو ہر کس تینا غیرت اٹی چپ ئے جواننگا جواننگا بندغاتا وراٹ ٹیبو تف، مخلوق نیم نیم سیر نت اٹی گٹی ئے سیر سیر نت اٹی تینا گزارہ کننگ اٹی ئے
en: People don't know about this; everyone keeps quiet out of their own sense of shame. The homes of good, decent people [are in want]; people are getting by on half a seer, a seer at a time.
en_old: People don't know this truth; everyone keeps quiet out of their sense of honor. Good, respectable people have nothing at home; people are getting by on half a seer at a time, a seer at a time.

brh: دا حالت ہنوننگا بندغاتا بجان مسونے کہ دا اسے وارا بولا یالے دے اسٹاک کیرے و یالے دے اسٹاک کیرے پیسہ اوفتو باز سمجھاس اور ئے دا تپرہ کہ دا پیسہ دے راکا تیرہ دا ننا مخلوق کرے نو خوار
en: This situation has come about because of such people: at one go they stock up one load, and then they stock up another; they have a lot of money, understand? And I don't know what they do with this money... they have made our people miserable.
en_old: This situation has become a game for such people: now they stock one thing, now they stock another; they have plenty of money and think they understand, but they don't know that with this money they are ruining our people.

brh: غریب عوام دے پدی آن پین غریب ملس ہائینگ اٹی ئے مخلوق خودکشی کننگ اٹی ئے تو کنا غریب تلے زکنا ایلوم دا بندغاتے غلطی افس صحیح پاریس ایلوم دا سا کنا دماغ
en: The poor public are getting poorer day after day; people are committing suicide. So, my poor... my brother, you are not wrong about these people; you said it right, brother... this... my mind...
en_old: The poor public are becoming even poorer, people are committing suicide. So my poor... brother, it's not these people's fault, you said it right, brother, this... my mind.

brh: ہندا بس کدا انت کہ غلہ خواہنٹ کنے آن کنے باز منت کر ئے پا ئے سلاہ کہ ولدا نومے پاوہ جوان کہ کنا دماغ ء ٹھکانہ ء ہیسس داسہ دا بندغاتے دا نین چرے فبہ غلہ
en: That's just it: what happened is that he asked me for wheat and pleaded with me a lot, and I said, "I'll consult someone, then I'll tell you." Good that you brought my mind back to its senses. Now I won't give these people wheat.
en_old: That's just it... what? He asked me for wheat, he pleaded with me a lot. Tell me, what do you advise, then I'll tell you. Good that you brought my mind to its senses. Now I won't give these people wheat.

brh: آخری وار پاننگ اٹیٹ، توپک ء تخ، توپک ء ہندا سل کپرے، کنا ول خلے وتہ، توپک ء تخ، ثمر توپک ء ہندا سل کپرے، لک انت خلوٹ؟
en: I'm telling you for the last time: put the gun down, don't hold the gun this way. [Unclear: something about striking me in turn.] Put the gun down! Samar, don't hold the gun this way. What am I going to shoot?
en_old: I'm telling you for the last time, put down the gun, don't aim the gun here; he's hit my hand; put down the gun, Samar, don't aim the gun here; what are you shooting at, fool?

brh: ئے دا وجہ آن خلکوٹ نی نی کنا ہیت آن تیل تیویس۔ نی دیر ئس ہوس نا ہیت الیف۔
en: I hit him for this reason: you, you went against my word. Who are you? It's not for you to say.
en_old: That's why I'm hitting you — you, you went against my word. You're shouting; you won't take my word.

brh: بلے اینو نم نا زی آ ٹل کوس زی آ ٹینا الپرا لنجیکے ہا کھلی کاٹم ئے اچھا نی دا داسہ مسس کنے توفک اٹ خلئیسے نا کرے دوا خلنگے نی گڑا داس کنے خلئے
en: Yes, today, on you... [unclear]... the head... All right, so now you've come to this, you're going to shoot me with the gun? [unclear]... Then go on, shoot me now.
en_old: Yes, today you've stolen from your own... yesterday... hey, take the cartridge. All right, so now you've become like this, you're going to shoot me with a gun? Go ahead, hit me then, hit me now.

brh: ایسے انو سمجھا کہ داسہ نا کاٹو مینا داسہ
en: Make him understand that now... your head... now [unclear].
en_old: Someone make him understand now; this is his turn now.

brh: سلیمان ئے تینا ایلمی خلنگٹ اسوٹ نی انتئے بمبے کنئے خساس؟ ارے کم
en: Suleman, I was beating my own brother; why did you throw a bomb at me? Hey, [unclear].
en_old: Suleman, you were beating your own brother; why did you bring the gun to me? Come here, boy.

brh: مولائیک نی ایلوے تے ننت خلیگٹوس نی ایلوے دا واجہ خلیوے کنما کرے مختفی ئیکے ہنا وجان تو نا دا حالے حال تو کنا جوانی حال داسہ نما برا مریک کھلی نما خلیوے کارتوسٹ چٹکے دانگی کیو سلہ والی مت کے داسہ
en: O master, you've been beating our brothers? I'll beat you, brother, this gentleman too... [unclear]... For that reason, this is your state, and my state is fine. Now your turn will come; I'll beat you too, I'll fire the cartridges this way... [unclear: weapon-carriers?]... now.
en_old: Mullah, you were beating our brothers; you'll beat your brothers, you'll beat this gentleman... if this is your condition, my condition is fine; now it'll be your turn, I'll hit you, I'll fire the cartridge; you armed men, now...

brh: نی کنا ایلوم ولا کنا دشمن نی کنے آ تفک ء توریس نا کنا ایلومی آ موٹے مچٹ چٹا ایلومی تے اونے کے چٹانے داسہ نی ہم چٹفوی
en: Are you my brother or my enemy? You pointed a gun at me, you fired a little at my brothers; he has fired at the brothers, and now you too must fire.
en_old: Are you my brother or my enemy? You pointed a gun at me; you fired at my brothers... he fired at the brothers, now you fire too.

brh: دا وجہ آن کنا ایلم کنے کنا دشمن نا مونی
en: That is why my brother stands against me as my enemy.
en_old: For this reason my brother stands before me as my enemy.

brh: کریم خان نی جک سلوک ئس مسے دا خلنگ او کس۔ خلیر نی کہ جوانی نی کس نا ایت ایلپیسے نی ئے مات کما داتی کلا کر دا کسیفے ک۔ کسیفین نی جوانی نی کہ کنا ایت ایلپیسے
en: Karim Khan, you've turned foul-mannered; this is beating and [unclear]. They hit him, and you think that's fine? You won't listen to anyone's word. You... [unclear]... he'll kill this one. Shall we kill him, then? Is that fine with you, you who won't listen to my word?
en_old: Karim Khan, you've behaved badly; who is this hitting? Let them hit you, so you don't take anyone's hand... open this, pull it out, he's going to kill. You'll be fine if you don't take my hand.

brh: اوئے تاتے لب داسہ بچف کنے، نتو داسے لمہ کرک سفیق، نی کوننگا لغوراک خیر جوانی لغورا سفر لری ریشوٹ بر بچف کنے، آئندہ دن کپیسے، توبہ کنے اینو پد
en: Hey, [unclear], save me now! Otherwise now Shafiq's mother [unclear]... You cowards! Well, fine, cowards... [unclear]... come, save me. In future you won't do this. I repent from today onward.
en_old: Hey, father, spare me now; otherwise... mother... Shafiq... your ways... well, fine, come on, spare me; you won't do it in future; repent from today.

brh: بس سلیمان بس، دا توبہ کرے بس چھٹا، اناڑے مشے تو خورد کیفتے، بس بس بس، الے ایلوم کنے یلہ کہ، بس بس، دا است توبہ کپہ، بس، الے ایلوم، الے کہ دانا دوا کرے خورد پتی
en: Enough, Suleman, enough! He has repented. Enough, let him go! You'll smash him to pieces. Enough, enough, enough! Leave it, brother, let me go. Enough, enough! He's repenting. Enough! Leave it, brother, leave him so he can get treatment; he's been smashed up.
en_old: Enough, Suleman, enough; he's repented, enough, let go; you'll kill him, enough, enough, enough; let go, brother, release me; enough, enough; don't be stubborn, enough; let go, brother, let go; take him for treatment, he's been beaten.

brh: بس ادا بس ادا خیر سے خیر نا بلے ہفے اینو واللہ کلو سوڑنے اینو مشاخ خورت کرے ٹنے
en: Enough, brother, enough, brother. It's fine, it's fine. Yes, but today, by God, he was [unclear]; today he's been beaten scarred and crushed.
en_old: Enough, brother, enough, brother; it's fine, fine... yes, today by God he's beaten him badly, today he's beaten him to pieces.

brh: ابا دا زولخی کہ بہ خوش مروئی یار ، عافیت ، عافیت نیمے یار ، ہندا سنگت آتہ بلے افا
en: Oh, this is something one should be happy about, friend. Peace, peace to you, friend. Such friends, yes, there aren't any.
en_old: Father, this is something you should be happy about, friend; well-being, well-being is what matters, friend; such friends are not to be found.

brh: جوان ایلم خوش مسورے جنگاتیٹی ہچ اف دا نن ہم چانہ جنگاتیٹی ہچ اف دا ایلم سلوئی اللہ وکے اوئے تا تے ہلیبو داسہ کنے معاف کبو
en: Good, brothers, you've made up. There's nothing in fights. We know that too: there's nothing in fights. Brothers should stand together. For God's sake, hey, take them; now forgive me.
en_old: Fine, brother, be happy; there is nothing to be gained in fights, we have seen that too, there is nothing in fights. Brother, for God's sake, take these; now forgive me.

brh: معاف تو کرینے، پین ہفتے لی خاطر نا تے کھرنے، بس اینا جامس پاش مسرے، بختی منت کرینے سلی تو اسپیل تو ادک منک
en: He has forgiven, all right. [Unclear: for the sake of another week?]. It's just that today something came out into the open. I begged my luck... [unclear].
en_old: I have forgiven; I did it for the sake of one more week; it's just that today a glass got broken; I thanked my luck ... it doesn't get through.

brh: نم ئس گڑا تو بگرے، ہمار کے کنے ہم کرے ہنا دھکک نصیب وسو، ما ہم سننا دھکک کنے لگار، نتو اجازت متو ہڈ داتی، ایلو نما باز مہربانی مسک، نم بسورے کنے بچیفیرے، معاف تو کریرے نی داسکان راہی
en: [Unclear]... Whoever did this to me as well, may blows be his lot. I too got hit by blows. Otherwise there was no permission [unclear]... Besides, it was very kind of you; you came and saved me, and you forgave. Now I'm on my way.
en_old: You didn't take anything; whoever did the same for me... may good fortune be yours; I too... without your permission... Otherwise, you have been very kind; you came and saved me; you have forgiven me; now you are on your way.

brh: کن کہ صحت نا قدر و قیمت انت؟ اور ہرا بندغ کہ رب تعالی دا نعمت عطا کرینے، او شاید ہمو وڑٹ اونا قدر و قیمت تے کرے، پرواہ کرے، درست کننگ کپک۔
en: ...that is, what are the value and worth of health? And the person to whom the Lord Almighty has granted this blessing perhaps does not value it in that same way, does not care for it, and cannot do so properly.
en_old: For what is the value and worth of health? And the person to whom God Almighty has granted this blessing perhaps does not value it in that way, does not care for it, does not keep it properly.

brh: تو ننا اللہ پاک آن دعا کینہ کہ ہراڑے کسس ناجوڑ ئے ہراڑے کسس بیمار ئے کسس پریشان ئے تو اوفتے اللہ پاک بیماری تے اور پریشانی تے کلے۔
en: So we pray to Almighty Allah that wherever anyone is unwell, wherever anyone is sick, wherever anyone is troubled, may Almighty Allah free all of them from illnesses and troubles.
en_old: So we pray to Almighty Allah that wherever anyone is unwell, wherever anyone is sick, anyone is troubled, may Almighty Allah free them from illnesses and from troubles.

brh: سردارک زندگی نا باز آ پڑ آ تیٹی زندگی نا باز آ شعبہ غاتیٹی ہر شعبہ ٹی کنا نظر شاغیسا کانے تو ہمو بندغاک ہمو ورنا ک ہمو لائق آ بندغاک ہرا زندگی نا ہر پڑ ٹی کنے قوم نا ملک نا ہمو شعبہ نا کنے تعمیر و ترقی ٹی تینا توانائی ء صرف کیرہ
en: Honourable sirs, in many spheres of life, in many fields of life, as I cast my eye over every field, there are those people, those young men, those capable people who, in every sphere of life, spend their energy on the building and progress of my nation, of the country, of that field.
en_old: Sardar, in the many spheres of life, in the many fields of life—when I cast my eye over every field, those people, those young men, those capable people who, in every sphere of life, spend their energy on the building and progress of my nation, of my country, of that field.

en_old: ...we gave you. You take your own country's grain, hide it, store it in warehouses, then sell it off and make the people miserable—is that good work? Every year you buy grain from me; that work you did was very good work; now too come to me and buy the grain...

en: It's a good thing I didn't sell [you] the grain today. Brother, what's wrong with the grain business? We buy it from you and sell it at four rupees' profit; what sin is that? Your sin is that you take that grain...
