brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ ایلو جوڑ ٹھیک ٹھاک بیدار فے ایلو۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Brother, are you well, all fine? ... brother.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Brother, all well? Fine, be well, brother.

brh: نی سہی پاریس دا ملک اسے خوار ہیکرے غریب خان میر خان ہاؤ بالکل بالکل دا استا کاری منا دیلو ہننا استا دعا ہندا مہنگائی مسونے اللہ تعالی راسے وارا دیر گزار وٹی ڈکیرے ڈکیرے تیز کے غلہ نا پیدا مس
en: You said it right: they have made this country miserable, Gharib Khan. Mir Khan? Yes, absolutely, absolutely. This is their... [unclear]... such inflation has come about. God Almighty... [unclear]... they hide it and hide it, and [prices rise] when grain becomes scarce.
en_old: You said it rightly, they've made this country miserable, Gharib Khan, Mir Khan. Yes, absolutely, absolutely. This is their doing... such inflation has come, may Allah Almighty have mercy... they hide it and hide it, and when grain is produced...

brh: اوڑا کشیر سوداگر زکار تا اوڑا ملک نا حال تا پائے اوخس کہ بادہ پائے ہموخس مخلوق مجبوری ہلی ئنا مہنگائی نا دور مخلوق تباہ مسنے خوار مس دا ہفتے گٹو کننگے دوا تا دا غریب نا ہیرے دشمن او دا بے مراد آک بس اللہ ئے رسول ئے
en: Then they bring it out, the merchants... whatever the state of the country, whatever price they name, the people are forced to buy at that price. In this era of inflation the people have been ruined and made miserable. These [people] are strangling them. These are the enemies of the poor, these wretches. Only God and His Messenger...
en_old: ...then the merchants bring it out and sell it; whatever they say about the state of the country, whatever price they name, the people are compelled to buy at that. In this era of inflation the people have been ruined, made miserable. These are the enemies of the poor, these wretches. Only Allah and His Messenger...

brh: دا ہیت ء دا پین ننا وس اف۔ ٹھیک ء، اللہ خیر کے، یا دعا کے۔ صحیح ء اللہ حافظ۔
en: This matter, this other thing, is not in our power. All right, may God make it well, or pray. Right, goodbye.
en_old: This matter—it is beyond our power. Alright, may Allah do good, or pray. Right, Allah hafiz.

brh: میر خان تو فک انت کرفینوس تو فک دا وجہ غان ہرفینوٹ مارکونام کاٹوم کائیک سلیمان نام کاٹوم کائیک ایتاک جائی ہنونو او ایلم او ایتاک ہنونو انت پاسے تو فک ہٹی خلیف تے
en: Mir Khan, why have you taken up guns? I've taken up the guns for this reason: [someone's] head will roll; Sulaiman's head will roll. They've gone off somewhere? Brother, have they gone? What do you say? [Use] the guns to scare them?
en_old: Mir Khan, what have you brought? I've brought this for this reason... Sulaiman's name... Where have they gone? Brother, where have they gone? What do you say? Don't be afraid.

brh: نی خلسٹہ ایلوم نی تکلیف کپتنے ئے خلیوٹہ براہوئی کے چٹکیوٹہ السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام حبیب خان انت حال احوالے خیریت ئے ٹائٹ خوش ئس ٹھیک ٹھاک حبیب خان نی امر ئس جوڑ بخت ٹائٹ
en: You were scared, brother; you didn't take the trouble... I would have struck... the Brahuis... I would have wiped [them] out. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Habib Khan, how are you, how are things? All well? Fit and happy? Fine, all well. Habib Khan, how are you? Well, fortunate, fit.
en_old: You were afraid, brother; you wouldn't have had any trouble... I'd be afraid... Brahui... Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam, Habib Khan, how are you? All well? Happy? Fine. Habib Khan, how are you? Well, thank you.

brh: دا فیٹڈ بدر، کھرے دوئی لومس، نم دان کنے گٹ اٹی ملک، بندغ کنے کیر، کنے روکارم کیر، نم کنے گری، کریم خان نی ایلم میر خان نی، انتئے دون کیرے، انتئے تینا وازوئے
en: This ... [unclear] ... you have me by the throat here ... country ... people ... you make me ... you ... me ... Karim Khan, you, and brother Mir Khan, you: why do you do this? Why [do this to] your own ...?
en_old: This... you came to my house, you grabbed me by the throat, you made me a man, you made me what I am, you... Karim Khan, you and Mir Khan, why do you do this, why your own...

brh: کنا ایلم تے انتئے تباہ و برباد کیرے انتئے دونو کاریم کیرے ہر سال کہ ہولم نا ٹائم مریک کلے ئے تے ئے ایریا نا علاقہ نا ہولم تے کلے باٹ الیرے دیرے گداس تے دترہ ڈکیرے ڈکیرے تا
en: Why do you ruin and destroy my brothers? Why do you do such things? Every year when wheat-harvest time comes, you buy up all the wheat of the whole area and hide it away, hide it in godowns.
en_old: Why do you ruin and destroy my brothers? Why do you do such things? Every year when harvest time comes, you buy up the whole harvest of the area, lock it up and hide it in warehouses...

brh: اوکا پندرہ کلو ماتی ہلوک نا بیدامس او نا کشی ہسینا ڈائرا کسء ماتی ہندے گوکی ہندے غریباتی باخو ماتی ہندے جدید ماتی ہندے ہلوک نا جوان و بڑا سب کرائی دو
en: Then fifteen kilos ... when it becomes scarce for the buyer, they bring it out ... [garbled] ... the poor ... a morsel ... the new ... the buyer's good and big ones, all ...
en_old: Those who take fifteen kilos of it, their almonds... whoever takes it, whether the poor take it or the rich take it, the modern folk take it too; they take the good and the big ones, all of them.

brh: ہزار روپئی والا، اوا دا پنجاہ کلو متنا ہزار ئس دا سبوسی ہزار آ، مخلوق اسہ اسہ باخو کے ترسی، راجہ اسکا پپو جوانی مڑا افس، ئے تینیا نومے پاریٹ، اسہ جوانی سے
en: The thousand-rupee one: yes, this fifty kilos costs a thousand, this one a thousand; the people are craving every single morsel. ... it's not good ... I told you myself ... a kindness.
en_old: The thousand-rupee one — yes, this fifty kilos is a thousand, that makes thirty thousand; people are each taking a sack. Raja, you were not a good man; he just says his own name — it's a fine thing.

brh: اونا اینو مرضی ئے تھیلے رے الپھیرے دا عید ہم نما نما دوتیان برباد مریر نم کے جوان اف اینو میان ایناٹ خدا حافظ
en: Today it's all at his whim... the bags... you don't take; this Eid too will be ruined at your hands. It is not good for you. ... Goodbye.
en_old: Today it's his wish, let it be, let him go; this Eid too will be ruined by your hands; it's not good for you. Today... goodbye.

brh: ایلم، دا انت پارے؟ او تو جوان پارے مگر نن اونا ایتا تلنے۔ ایلم، ہنا ایلم ننا ایتا تلن، ہنا ننگ تلن۔
en: Brother, what did he say? He spoke well, but we are under his thumb. Brother, that brother is under our thumb; it's a matter of [our] honor.
en_old: Brother, what did he say? He spoke well, but we are in his hands. Brother, that brother is in our hands; we hold our honor.

brh: ایلم، ننے اللہ تسنے، نن تو گنجا کو، تینا غریب
en: Brother, God has given us [plenty]; we are well off. [These are] our own poor [people].
en_old: Brother, God has provided for us; we are poor, our own poor people.

brh: ایلوم تے انت کہ دا ہچ عذاب کین ایلوم ہچ عذاب مزاب افک ننا کہ دا کاریم کپن پیشن نا ملک آ ننا ہراڑ پیسہ تیرا ایلوم اینو آن پد ننے توبہ کروئی ئے
en: Brother, so what if this... no torment... Brother, no hardship of any kind will come to us if we don't do this work, [nor from] the money the foreign countries give us. Brother, from today on we must repent.
en_old: Brother, what is it? This is no torment at all, brother, there's no torment or anything; we don't do this work. In a foreign country, who will give us money? Brother, from today on we must repent.

brh: دونو کاریم کرو اوف نی اگہ دا گڑاٹ خوش افس لیکن ئے دا سیننگ اٹ چھوٹو ختم کیوہ کاوا دا سلیمانم ختم کیوہ نی تو لہنڑی ایلوم اسہ منٹ
en: I'll do such work... If you aren't happy with this, [so be it], but I will finish off Chhotu right here and then go finish off this Sulaiman too. You... brother, one minute.
en_old: Don't do such a thing if you're not happy with this, but I'll finish him off right here with a shot; otherwise I'll finish this Suleman. You... brother, one minute.

brh: خیر ایلم۔ خیر ئنا دے، توفک تے تخ، جنگ کپے۔ نامعقولی دماغ خراب، ہچو صورت ئسیٹ توفک تے معاف کپیرے!
en: Easy, brother. For goodness' sake, put the guns down, don't fight. Nonsense, you've lost your mind! Under no circumstances will you give up the guns!
en_old: Fine, brother. For goodness' sake, put down the gun, don't fight. Fool, crazy-headed; under no circumstances will you be forgiven for the guns!

brh: تفارتہ ہا بس ہلوم کے او مسس بالکل دا زاکر دا بندغاتے غلہ تفار ہا ٹھیک ہی بس نی اجازت سئی اللہ حافظ بس ہنا ئے دے ہرے ہلوم کے دا بے غم مرے سئی اللہ حافظ
en: I won't give it to them. Yes, okay, brother, yes, it's done. Absolutely, [...] I won't give these people wheat. Yes, fine. Okay then, with your permission, sir, goodbye. Okay, [...] brother, don't worry about this, sir. Goodbye.
en_old: Don't give it. Yes, just hold on, that's how it is. Exactly, like this, don't give these people wheat. Yes, alright then, with your permission, sir, goodbye. Right, go on, hold on, don't worry about it. Okay, sir, goodbye.

brh: میر خان ڈرائیورے پاریس کہ او چاتے ایران نا سر کے پگیس کن۔ او کریم خان ڈرائیورے پارینوٹ۔
en: Mir Khan, did you tell the driver to send those off to Iran by tomorrow? Yes, Karim Khan, I've told the driver.
en_old: Mir Khan, tell the driver to take those to Iran early in the morning. I've already told the driver, Karim Khan.

brh: اوچاتے سرکک، پاستے زو سرکیتہ ایڈے بولی سلوک اوچاتے، ہاؤ ایلو پارے نٹتے دا سوکارے، میر خان ڈرائیورے پا اوچات زو سرکے ایرانہ سرکیتہ ایلو دے دبئی اسکان سرمریرے، ہاؤ ایلو موجے پارے نٹی اوکائی
en: Send those off! Tell him to send them off quickly, the ones standing over there. Yes, brother, I've told him [...]. Mir Khan, tell the driver to send those off quickly, send them to Iran; the others will get as far as Dubai. Yes, brother, I've told him, he's going.
en_old: Take those, tell them to take them quickly, those ones... Yes, brother, I told them, these... Mir Khan, tell the driver to take those quickly, take them to Iran, and the others will go as far as Dubai. Yes, brother, I've told them, they're coming.

brh: تسلی کروسو۔ او اینا سئی ئے او تو جوان مسک۔ تو آکھٹ سلیمان غلہ آتھے تیننے۔ پیشا نمونہ کائے کنتا۔ کریم خان نی باز سادہ بندغ ئس ئس۔ نن کرے
en: Rest assured. Yes, today, sir, that went well. So in the end Suleiman is handing over the wheat? [...] sample [...]. Karim Khan, you are a very simple man. We...
en_old: Rest assured. That's today's... well, that turned out fine. So Suleiman has given you wheat? ... Karim Khan, you're a very simple man. We...

brh: پیشن نا ملک آن تغرا کتہ نن کرے ہناڑے ڈکنتہ صرف غلہ دے کرے موسے تو ہناڑے ڈکت گڑا اور مخلوق ہم لنگڑی ہلک تا ارا تم کہ مخلوق لنگڑی ہلک گڑا اخس کہ ننا باپائے ہموخس
en: [...] from the foreign country [...]; we hide it there. If only the wheat is hidden there, then the people too will be gripped by hunger. When the people are gripped by hunger, the more they go hungry, the more business for us.
en_old: We've sent them out of the country, so nothing is left for us here. If there's only wheat... if there's none, nothing is left here, then the people will go hungry. The more the people go hungry, the more profit for us.

brh: ننے پیسہ ملیک۔ میر خان، نی تو باز ہوشیار و بندغ ئس ئس کنا پن کرے مرے میر خان، ولے ئے ہوشیار امر مفرو۔ ہیلو
en: We'll get money. Mir Khan, you really are a very clever man, you make a name for me, Mir Khan. But how could I not be clever? Hello?
en_old: We'll get money. Mir Khan, you're a very clever man, Mir Khan, stay by my side; but don't get too clever. Hello.

brh: ہیلو السلام علیکم جی او سر غلہ نا موسم بسنے غلہ تیار ئے بالکل نئے تھک سئیوم اسے ارب ئس پیسہ نا راہی کرینوس دنکہ اسے ارب ئس پیسہ نا پین راہی کے
en: Hello, peace be upon you. Yes, sir, the wheat season has come, the wheat is ready. Absolutely, yes, fine, sir. You have sent one billion in money; likewise, send another billion.
en_old: Hello, peace be upon you. Yes sir, the wheat season has come, the wheat is ready. Absolutely, I've sent you one billion rupees; send another billion.

brh: برا کاریم پکا مریک۔ نی بے فکر مرک۔ الا کنا حالات کل الینے، جوان کہ دا مخلوق لنگڑی ہن کائے جوانی ٹھیک ہی نی فیصلت رائے کے کاریم جوان مریک۔
en: Brother, the work will definitely get done. Don't you worry. [...] my circumstances have all [...]; it's good that these people go hungry. Good, all right. You make your decision, and the work will go well.
en_old: Brother, the deal will be done. Don't worry. Otherwise my situation... all of it... it's good if these people go hungry. Fine, you've made your decision, the work will go well.

brh: ہر بار پیسہ راہی کے کپک، پیسہ تے راہی کے پیسہ تے مون راہی کپک، اسہ گلہ تلے گودام تلے دکن تا، گڑا اور مہنگائی کے امر آسمان سر مائک مفک، ارہ ٹھیک
en: Money can't be sent every time: send the money, but the money can't be sent in advance. Let's stash the wheat together in the warehouses; then how will prices not shoot sky-high? Yes, right.
en_old: You can't just send money every time; sending money, you can't send the money up front. Some wheat in the warehouses, some in the shops; then prices rise, how can they not reach the sky? Yes, right.

brh: غلہ اٹی الکون، کورا ہور مخلوق کے لنگڑی ئنا برک کیک، ننے تو نا وجہ پیسہ ملیک، علاقہ غلہ شارٹ کنن، علاقہ نا عوام کرے عذاب مریک، خیسہ نا ملک ننے کرے اخس خوش مریک، نن تینا علاقہ کرے نیست کننگو، دعا
en: We bought up the wheat; then hunger will come down on the people. We get money because of you. We make the area short of wheat, the people of the area suffer, and the foreign country is so pleased with us. We are wiping out our own area. Pray [for us].
en_old: We take the grain, the people are all hit by famine, we get money because of you, we make the area short of grain, the people of the area suffer, and the foreign country is so pleased with us; we are destroying our own area. Pray for us.

brh: کسے کہ غلہ الین او کپت کرے غریب آتہ اور نیامٹ لنگڑ مریرہ۔ غلہ ئے دا وڑ کو ایلا کنا کلے الوی۔ خیال کیس کہ پین واپرس غلہ غاتے الوی۔ غلہ غاتے کلے الین مخلوقے برباد کین۔ آگیر دوم کتون۔
en: If we buy up the wheat, the poor will go even hungrier in the middle. The wheat has to be bought up this way, all of it. Watch out: some other trader might buy up the wheat. Let's buy up all the wheat and ruin the people. [...]
en_old: If anyone takes the grain, the poor will be struck by famine. The grain will not be taken from my village like this. Make sure no one else takes the grain again. Taking all the grain ruins the people. That's it, I've made up my mind.

brh: پیشہ نم ملک نا پیسہ تے فک۔ صاحب دا دراڑ تے خف۔ کاٹم آ کلا تیختے۔ ارے دا نی انت لے کے بسس داڑے؟ میر صاحب ئے دا دیسٹ بسٹ۔ نی خبر اف نی اٹ وار پاریٹ داڑے کنے بغیر اجازت نا کنے آ بفے۔ میر خان غلطی مس کنے آن۔
en: [...] the foreign country's money [...]. Sir, [...] these [...]. Put it all on [the] head. Hey, what have you come here bringing? Mir Sahib, I just came with this. Don't you know how many times I've told you: don't come to me here without permission! Mir Khan, it was my mistake.
en_old: Pesha, you're taking the country's money. Sir, don't say such things. In the end you put it all in. Hey, what have you brought here? Mir Sahib, I brought this. Don't you know? I told you once: don't come to me here without permission. Mir Khan, I made a mistake.

brh: پیندس بغیر اجازت ہم بفرے۔ رضوان! ٹھیک ئے ٹھیک ئے داسہ پیش تمنک۔ ئنا چھوٹو ایلم ایتا تینا تو بینگاو۔ ایتا تینا بنگ وا بمپک چامر۔ ایلم دا ایتا بنگ تو ننے
en: Don't come without permission again. Rizwan! Okay, okay, now get out. No, little brother, these are our own people [...]. [...] ours [...]. Brother, this one is ours, [he's] with us.
en_old: Next time don't come in without permission. Rizwan! Okay, okay, it won't happen again. No, little brother, these are our own people. These are ours, let them come, let them... Brother, these are ours, so for us...

brh: ئے تو ٹھیک آ کیک دا تو اللہ نا رضا تو کاری دا تو شیطانی ہیت نہ کیک نی خبر اف اسے کو شیطانی کیک ئے اودے کھڈ کیو ڈغارٹی نی اودے تانکہ کھڈ کیس ننا کاروبار نا مون مون مارک نی اسل بے فکر مارک ٹھیک ئے ایلم ئے بے فکر مریوہ مارک ننا پد رندے خنک
en: He'll do just fine. This one is God's will [...]; this one doesn't talk mischief. Don't you know, if anyone makes mischief, I'll bury him in a pit in the ground. You bury him, and you stay at the front of our business. Don't you worry at all. Okay, brother, I won't worry. Just watch our trail.
en_old: You'll set it right. This is God's will... this is devilish talk, don't do it. Don't you know, if anyone does something devilish, we'll bury him in the ground. You... until you bury him... don't get in the way of our business. Don't you worry at all. Okay, brother, don't worry, we'll watch our backs.

brh: ننا پدھرندے لازمی خلنگے، ہیلو! ہاؤ خیر ایلم کنے اینو تو بھلو کاریم ئس
en: Our trail must definitely be watched. Hello! Yes, all's well, brother; today I have a big job.
en_old: The one following us has to be dealt with. Hello! Yes, all is well, Alam, I have a big job today.

brh: سئیں، میر خان ء توچاسے؟ ہمو میر خان بھلو کٹ پٹ اسے۔ ارے نی دیر تو ئت کنے گسس؟ نی پارے ستہ کے کٹ پٹ اسے اٹ، ئے داسہ کٹ پٹ اٹ مسٹ۔
en: Sir, do you know Mir Khan? That Mir Khan is a big troublemaker. Hey, who were you talking to? You told him I'm a troublemaker. So now I've become a troublemaker?
en_old: Sir, did you call Mir Khan? That Mir Khan is a big crook. Hey, were you spying on me? You said he's a crook, now you've become a crook yourself.

brh: نیکی میر خان نی نی نا پاتروٹی پیرس نا باری ٹی گنجا چسو ڈروک ٹرپئے نی دا پاہ کہ او دیر اسہ سیت کرے سیتوت ئے تینا ماما ڈیت کرے ٹی نا پنی الیتونٹ ارے نی پارے سے میر خان کھٹ پٹ چسی دا سیت تینا منی پیسے میر خان
en: [Garbled] Mir Khan, you [...] about an old man [...]. You tell me who he was [...] a Seth [...] with his uncle [...]; I haven't mentioned your name. Hey, you said, 'Mir Khan is a troublemaker' [...] this Seth [...] money [...] Mir Khan.
en_old: Niki, Mir Khan, by your account, in Piras's matter the treasure was hidden away. You say he made a deal far away; he took his share from his uncle's wealth. You said, Mir Khan, that with a bit of scheming this deal would become ours, Mir Khan.

brh: ارے خدا خیر دے دا رنگینہ گم مسے
en: Oh God, let it be all right. This Rangina has gone missing.
en_old: Oh God, have mercy, this Rangina has gone missing.

brh: بر کدا نی ارنگینا خننگ توسس چاٹ مسس ایلوم دا رضوان بلو کھٹ پٹ سے خیر ئے انتس کرے رضوان ہمے دے آ کہ چپ چپ ننا ہیتاتے خن سے بنگو ہاو ہاو ہمو ہیتاتے ننا فون نا سیٹی پاننگ اسس ارے دان پاننگ اسس
en: Come here, did you see Rangina? [...] Brother, this Rizwan is a big troublemaker. Well, what did Rizwan do? He's the one who secretly watches and listens in on our conversations. Yes, yes, he was passing those very conversations of ours on over the phone. Hey, he was telling it from here.
en_old: Come here, where did you see Rangina? Have you gone mad? Alam, this Rizwan is a big schemer. What will become of him? Rizwan is the one who secretly listens to our talk, isn't he? Yes, yes, he was passing on those very things through our phone, hey, that's how he was telling it.

brh: ئے بالکل نی سئی پاننگٹوٹ گڑا الاس تنی دراخ ئے دو خلکوٹ چٹ کرے ٹتے لیکن او کنے نرا دا تو باز خرابو قصہ ئس مسک گڑا داساں باز ہمار کین گڑا الم کرے سا پاننگٹوٹ پٹوسس خلوسس نی باغٹی نرا اینا
en: Yes, absolutely, you're right, I'm telling you. Then I grabbed [her] by the hand [...], but she ran away from me. This has turned into a really bad affair, so now we'll have to [...] a lot. So, brother, I'm telling you: you should have searched, you'd have found her in your garden; she ran away today.
en_old: Yes, you're absolutely right, so I grabbed hold of your tree there, cut it down, but this has turned into a very bad story for me, so now it has to be settled. Alam, I'm telling you, you searched and looked in the garden today, right?

brh: کنے آ گم مسیس خنتوٹ ٹیرنگ اینا؟ باغتو خنتوس؟ ئے دا صفا پٹا این گم کا خلتس۔ ٹھیک ایلوم بس کا او پٹی او دے خلے او پین او کے۔ تان کے پٹتنس خلتنس تے کنے آ اسل بفس شکلتے نا نشانم تفیس کنے۔ ہاؤ ایلوم ہاؤ داسہ ئے کاوہ۔
en: She went missing on me. Didn't you see her [...] today? Didn't you see her in the garden? I've searched this whole place, but I didn't find the missing girl. All right, brother, just go, search for her, find her and [...]. Until you've searched for her and found her, don't come to me at all, and don't even show me your face. Yes, brother, yes, I'm going now.
en_old: She went missing on me, did you see her today, Tirang? Did you see her in the garden? Yes, I searched the whole place, but no, I didn't find her. All right, Alam, just go search there, find her and come back. When you've searched and found her, come to me; I'll give you the picture of her face. Yes, Alam, yes, I'm going now.

brh: گڈو کلے اسے
en: It's the last one of all.
en_old: This is the last village.

brh: ارے نی کنے انریشہ والا بچی سودا کا۔ نی انتئے کنے جتو ہمکنا رندے الکنس آخیر۔ جتو پرے کاٹمے مرے داسہ۔ دینا ہیتاتے بنیس والا چپ چپ مخلوقہ سر کسہ تا۔ داسہ نی کنے انرسو بچی پیسے۔ دینا ہیتاتے بنیس کسے پپا نہ۔
en: Hey, you [...] me [...]. Why did you follow me, after all? [...] now. You listen to the talk here and secretly pass it on to people. Now you won't get away from me. Don't tell anyone the talk you hear here!
en_old: Hey, you've been dealing behind my back. Why did you follow me after all? Leave it, it's over now. You listen to the talk here and secretly deliver it to people. Now you deal behind my back. Don't tell anyone what you hear here.

brh: نی لیٹ ئس کاو دا سا دا کا نا ہننگ کرے مشکل ئے کنے خلوص نی انتس ملو، نی ننا کرے ارب کرباتاک کاریمے کرے خراب کننگٹی ئس ولدا پاش کے انتس ملونے، ئے بابا کسے نا ہیت ئس پاتنو
en: You [...]; your going like this is hard for me. In short, what will you get? You're ruining our business worth billions and crores, and then what will you get by exposing it? No, Baba, I haven't told anyone a single word.
en_old: You come late; seeing you go like this is hard for me. Honestly, what will you get? You're spoiling our work with the Arabs; what will you get out of it then? Yes, father, I won't tell anyone a word.

brh: بلکل ئے جوان ء چنا سے ئس کسے پاتہ نس حمیدہ دا پارک ٹی فون نا دیر تو ہیت کریسے ادا ئے کسے تو ہیت کتوٹ ہیت کتنوس باز جوان کرینوس داسہ کرے نا ساہ کشی نی ہیت کرنگا ختم مریسے
en: Absolutely, you're a good child; you haven't told anyone. Hamida, who were you talking to on the phone in this park? Here? I didn't talk to anyone. You haven't talked? Very good, you've done well. Now, on your life: if you talk, you'll be finished.
en_old: Absolutely, good girl, don't tell anyone. Hamida, were you talking on the phone in this park far off? Here, I talked to no one. You didn't talk? Very good, you did well. Now, on your life, if you talk you'll be finished.

brh: ہر داسہ خبر تمینگے نی آ؟ انت دے مار نا گٹٹ یل کنوس؟ سلیمان نی یل کک کنے نا کاریم اف۔ ارے نی دا پدا چنائے نا گٹو انت کن نگٹوس؟ او ئے تے پاننگ کپپرہ نی بس یل کک کنے چنائے کسیفیوے۔ او انت ہیتس ئے کہ نی کنے پاننگ کپیسے؟
en: Has word reached you now? Why won't you let go of my son's throat? Suleiman, you let go of me; it's none of your business. Hey, why have you grabbed this child by the neck? Oh, I can't tell you. You just let go of me, or I'll kill the child. What is it that you can't tell me?
en_old: Do you have any news now? Why have you grabbed my son by the throat? Suleiman, let go, I have no business with you. Hey, why have you seized the child's neck again? They won't tell you; just let go, you'll kill my child. What is it that you can't tell me?

brh: سلیمان یس کروڑ استے وانی نی کنے یل کک دا کنے ہیت
en: Suleiman, one crore [...]; you let me go, this is my word.
en_old: Suleiman, there's one crore, Wani; you let me go, that's my word.

brh: ارے شوک نی اسے کروڑس پاسہ پنجاہ کروڑ تیس کنے بے دا چھنائے نی خلنگ الے پر دا چھنائی ہر قیمت اٹ خلنگوئے کنے دا پا چھنائی الہ کیسہ یا کپیسہ چھنا نا کرے الہ کنے مشکل ئے نی تینا خیر خواہی دا کہ ہنک داسہ سلے داسہ ئے کاوہ
en: Hey, you fox, you say one crore! Even if you give me fifty crore, [...] this child; this child has to be killed at any cost. Tell me, will you hand over the child or not? Handing over the child is hard for me. Your own good lies in this: go now [...]. I'm going now.
en_old: Hey, fool, you say one crore; even if you give me fifty crore you can't have this child; no, this child must be killed at any cost. Tell me, will you hand over the child or not? Handing over the child is hard for me. Your own good lies in this: leave now, go now. Yes, I'm going.

brh: اینو تو نرس پین دے برے سکنا دوٹی پڈیرے ہریوانو
en: Today you got away. Another day will come when you'll fall into my hands [...].
en_old: Not today; come another day, or you'll end up in a tight spot.

brh: سلیمان خان نا باز مہربانی کہ دا جانی بچفے۔ بچا نی دیر اسیس، ئے تو نی درست کتا وٹ، نی کنے ہمہ درست کریس۔ سلیمان نی باز بلو بندغ ئس نی ننے اڑ چاسے۔
en: Many thanks to Suleiman Khan for saving this life. Son, who are you? I didn't recognize you, but you recognized me. Suleiman, you are a very great man; you know us.
en_old: Many thanks to Suleiman Khan for saving this life. Son, you were far away; yes, I would have set you right, but you set me right. Suleiman, you are a very big man, you looked after us.

en: ...they would wait. Like that poet, a poet said: 'He hasn't come, hasn't come, he will come.' That is, waiting for the doctor: you [keep saying], 'He hasn't come, hasn't come, he will come', until the time when he finally arrives, the patient will have breathed his last; at the moment the patient is in his very last death throes, that is when he comes.

Yes.

en_old: The point is that Asma sahiba reflected on this at this moment — that generally, through social media, news spreads by way of falsehood, and in the forest, where things just get scattered and wasted — well, anyway, generally the idea is just that this wall should be put to use, but perhaps that cannot happen.

brh: او سے بلو سے گڑا ئس افک، بالکل سر دنا اسمانی گپک دا، سو بالکل تلف مریرے دا، تے باقاعدہ ننا اسہ جتا ء پلانٹ اسے دا، سپین روڈ آ ہمیدے دیرتہ ہمیدے اوشارتہ دا تے ضائع کیرہ سا، منظور صاحب دا ننا زی آ گنوک اسہ روشن شانک ء، بالکل ئنا ایٹی مہمستی دنو دیوائے کہ
en: It is not some big thing at all; these are quite simple matters, sir. So these are completely destroyed. We have a separate plant for this, on Spinny Road; they take them right there, burn them right there and dispose of them. Manzoor sahib, this is one bright side of ours; absolutely, in this, such a [program] that…
en_old: That is no great matter at all, these are quite straightforward things; so these are completely destroyed. And we have a separate plant for this — there on Spin Road, they take them there, unload them there, and destroy them. Manzoor sahib, this is one bright side of what we saw yesterday; absolutely, in this…

brh: ئے انسنیٹر پلانٹ کرے نصب ئے او مسے وڑ نا ڈسٹ بن ہر وارڈ ٹی کرے تخنگانے۔ سہی۔ اراڑے ارا کہ باز خطرناکی آ گڑا کریرک اوفتے باقاعدہ تربیت
en: …an incinerator plant has been installed, and three kinds of dustbins have been placed in every ward. — Right. — Those who handle the very dangerous items are properly given training…
en_old: The incinerator plant has been installed, and likewise dustbins have been placed in every ward. Right. And those who handle the very dangerous items are given proper training.

brh: دے ننیانی کہ بابا دا اسہ سرنج اسے دا اسہ ہندنوں خطرناکو گڑا اسے دا ڈیفیوز کروئی دادے دا ڈسٹ بن اٹ شابو دا اینو گڑا اسے دادے مسے وڑنا دا ڈسٹ بن آکو اور دافتے کلیکٹ کیرے صبح نا وقتی مچ کیرے گڑا کیرے دا
en: …we tell them: look, this is a syringe, this is such a dangerous item, it has to be defused, throw it into this dustbin; this is another kind of item, and for it there are these three kinds of dustbins. And they collect these, gather them up in the morning, and then they…
en_old: We tell them: look, this is a syringe, this is a very dangerous item, you must defuse it, throw it into this dustbin; this is such-and-such an item, so that is the kind of dustbin for it; and they collect them, gather them up in the morning, and then…

brh: دافتے ہمو انسنیٹر پلانٹ اٹی باقاعدہ اونا اسہ جتاؤ عملہ سے ارا کہ بریرہ اور دافتے ہرفیرہ اور ہموڑے دیر تلف کیرہ تا ضائع کیرہ تا تو دا ایلو کرے اندن کرے سیوریج ٹریٹمنٹ
en: …these, to that incinerator plant; it properly has a separate staff of its own who come, pick these up, take them there, destroy them and dispose of them. So apart from this, likewise, the sewage treatment…
en_old: Those go to that incinerator plant; it has a separate staff of its own, who take them and carry them away and destroy them there, burn them up. So apart from this, likewise, sewage treatment…

brh: ٹریٹمنٹ پلانٹ ئے ارا کہ دیر مریک او دے ہم صفا کیرے دا درختاتے کہ داڑ کیڈ کے اونا ہم استعمال ارے تو باز کوشش تا کہ مننگ ٹی او کہ ہمو گڑاک مارکیٹ اسکا سر مفس باز وقت اندا ہم
en: …treatment plant, where there is water; they clean that too, and it is also used for these trees here. So a lot of effort is being made so that those things do not reach the market. Many times this too…
en_old: Whatever goes to the treatment plant, that too is cleaned; and these trees that are cut down, those are also put to use. So a great deal of effort is made that those things do not reach the market; many times, even that…

brh: آننگانی کہ اندا گڑا کہ ہائیکہ کہ پیش تمنرے دن کہ ڈرپ آک مسر یا سرنج آک مسر یا گڑا کہ ہنو پکے سرنج آتے ہندن جوڑ کرینو کہ آٹومیٹک لاک مریرے اسے وارس کہ آخیر اسکان سرمس ولدا او سرنج کاریم کپک دا کمپنی تا
en: …[it has been seen] that these things that come up, be they drips or syringes — and now they have actually made syringes in such a way that they lock automatically, so that once it has been used to the end, that syringe will not work again — these companies'…
en_old: …that the things which come before us — whether they are drips or syringes, or now they make syringes in such a way that they lock automatically, so that once it has been used to the end, that syringe cannot be used again — these companies'…

brh: بلو کاریم ئس مسونے داڑے باز گچین باز گچین ہاو واللہ نی اوڑے کرے او سرنجاتے ڈیفیوز کننگ کے اوفتادا نیڈلاتے یا سرنجاتے کاٹم نا پرغنگ کے ہمو اوفتے تو مشین ارے دا مشین تیٹ سونگو کہ دا تیندارے پرغ بونو باز گچین دا کل مننگٹ او مطلب اسہ وختس ایٹ تو ہمو مرو شاید
en: A great piece of work has been done here, very good, very good. Yes, by God, there you have it: for defusing those syringes and breaking off the tips of their needles or syringes, there is a machine for them; [you put them] into this machine and it breaks them. Very good, all of this is happening, and I mean, given some time, then that will probably happen too.
en_old: A great job has been done here; very good, very good. Yes, by God, you have done it there — those syringes are defused, and their needles or the syringes are cut off; there is a machine for that, that machine is there, and it cuts them off. Very good. For all of this to happen — I mean, if it is given a little time, then that will probably happen.

brh: لیکن داسے دون اف داس اف داس اف داسے افاس مننگ کیک اسے ہندونو ہیتس مننگ کیک دا سے باز دنا زیا کنٹرول کننگانے وام گڑاسے نا گڑاس مارکیٹ ٹی گڑاس ہندونو سرمریرے کہ کس نا خنان اندر مریرے جیا کس دیک سودا کیک تو او جتا او جتا گڑاسے بالکل یقینی وڑٹی
en: But now it isn't like that, now it isn't, now it isn't — it can happen, such a thing can happen — but now this has been brought under control a great deal. And also, some things do reach the market in such a way that they slip out of anyone's sight; or if someone takes them and sells them, then that is a separate, separate matter. Absolutely, for certain.
en_old: But that is not possible, it is not, it is not — it could happen, such a thing could happen; this has been brought under control a great deal. Otherwise, some things do reach the market in such a way that they are beyond anyone's sight — if someone sells something, that is a separate matter, that is a separate thing — but with complete certainty…

brh: نن خننہ کہ سوشل میڈیا غا ہر قسم نا ہرا کہ اردو ٹپہ غاک قیاس آرائیاں مریسہ کاری عظمت صاحب اسہ وار ولدا دوبارہ مریسہ کاو کہ انو کہ منظور صاحب تو باز گچین وٹ و ڈوم دادے باز گچین درشانی کرے کہ داد تو تلف مریر، لیکن اسہ گچین و شعبہ ئس پین مرے کہ اراٹی کنے اسہ
en: We see that on social media all kinds of speculation keep going around, in Urdu posts. Azmat sahib, once again — Manzoor sahib has explained this very well and shown very clearly that these are destroyed. But there is another important department in which I [have] a…
en_old: We see that on social media all kinds of — Urdu posts — speculation has been going around. Azmat sahib, let me say it once again: Manzoor sahib has explained it very well and in great detail, and has shown very clearly that these are destroyed. But there is one other important department in which, for me…

brh: صفائی نا پانے ہرا کہ بیڈ تا زی آ چادر آک مریسا کاری خدا نخواستہ کساس سے ٹیسٹ بریک تو اون ہرا کہ یا دتک لگے رے یا کہ جراثیمس مریک اندونو تو دا صفائی نا انت وڈو ڈولے ہسپتالٹی کہ دا بیڈ شیٹ آکو یا کرے عموما تو نن ہرا کہ صفائی والا بندہ
en: …about cleanliness, [I] say: the sheets that are on the beds — God forbid, if someone comes for a test, then either blood gets on them or there are germs, things like that. So what is the cleaning arrangement in the hospital for these bed sheets? Generally we [see] the cleaning staff…
en_old: Speaking of cleanliness — the sheets that are on the beds: God forbid, if someone has a test done, either blood gets on them or there are germs on them. So in the hospital, what kind of cleanliness arrangement is there for these bed sheets? Generally, we have the cleaning staff…

brh: دا تے خنسا کین ارا کہ پوچ آخرے لیکن ارا کہ اوور آل ایکوپمنٹس آ کو سامان کو دافتا صفائی نا نظام ئے دا تا بالکل سر دا تا دنو کہ دا ارا کہ ننا وارڈ ٹی وارڈ بوائے آک مریرے دا روزانہ نا بنیاد آ سر چینج مریرے۔ اچھا۔ دا تے دا کان ہر بیڈ شیٹ
en: We keep an eye on these, whatever clothes there are, and as for the overall equipment and supplies, there is a cleaning system for them. It is absolutely like this: in our wards there are ward boys, and these are changed on a daily basis. — Okay. — From here, every bed sheet…
en_old: We have seen this — whatever is there... but the overall equipment and supplies and their cleaning system: in our wards there are ward boys, and these are changed on a daily basis. Good. So every bed sheet…

brh: دا چے اردا کے دا تکیہ نا پوش مریک تو داتے دیر ننا جندا نا بے ایم سے نا اندر لانڈری نا اسہ ڈیپارٹمنٹ اسے باقاعدہ بلو بلو مشین خلکو داتے کلے ہمیشے سر سلنگیرہ
en: …these sheets and these pillow covers are taken to our own BMC, where there is a proper laundry department with big machines installed, and all of these are always washed there.
en_old: Whatever there is — the pillow covers — these go to our own BM('s) facility; inside there is a whole laundry department with proper big machines, and all of these are always washed there.

brh: باز گچین، دوبارہ مثلا ول۔۔۔ قابل استعمال مریرہ؟ او دا روزانہ نا بنیاد آ چینج مریرے۔ اچھا، مطلب روزانہ نا بنیاد آ کہ مطلب صبح آن شام اسکان استعمال مس، صبح اوفتے کرے چینج مریرے۔ جی او، ہر صبح نا تقریبا نو سے
en: Very good. Again, for example, then… are they reusable? — Yes, and these are changed on a daily basis. — Okay, meaning on a daily basis, as in they are used from morning until evening and in the morning they are changed. — Yes, every morning at about nine to…
en_old: Very good. Again, for example... are they reusable? And these are changed on a daily basis. Good — meaning on a daily basis, meaning they are used from morning until evening, and in the morning they are changed. Yes, every morning at about nine…

brh: دہ بجا ڈاکٹر نا راؤنڈ آن مست دا بیڈ شیٹ آک دا صاف ستھرائی ہر وارڈ نا اسل مریک مریک باز گچین لیکن وارڈ اٹ تے صفائی نصف ایمان نا مرے اور داسے باز ضروری امر اسہ مرے عموما انتئے کہ نن عموما کینسر نا مریض آتے خناسن اوٹ دا مس کہ باز اوقات وائرس نا صورت اٹ ہم
en: …ten o'clock, before the doctors' round, these bed sheets [are changed]; this cleaning is done in every ward, it is done. — Very good. But in the wards cleanliness is half of faith, and generally this is a very necessary matter, because we usually see cancer patients, and with them it happens that many times, even in the form of a virus,…
en_old: …before the doctors' round at ten o'clock these bed sheets [are changed]. This cleanliness is the very essence of every ward. Very good. But in the wards, cleanliness is half of faith, and this is a very necessary matter, generally because we usually see cancer patients, and it happens that many times, even in the form of a virus…

brh: انسانہ کرے ایفیکٹ کرے سکاک اللہ پاک امانت تے ہر بندغے منظور صاحب اسہ سوال ئس مئے پین اریفوا کہ انو کہ شروع نم پاریرا کہ نن تینٹ دارو درمان کینہ دا انگلش اسہ لفظ ئس پاریرا کہ سیلف میڈیکیشن نن بعض اوقات خننہ کہ کسے زردوئی مرے او کٹ ئس خلے کا
en: …it can affect a person; may Allah keep every person in His safekeeping. Manzoor sahib, I have one more question for you: at the start you said that we treat ourselves — you used an English word, self-medication. We sometimes see that if someone has jaundice, he gets a cut made…
en_old: …it can affect a person; may Allah keep everyone safe. Manzoor sahib, I have another question for you: at the beginning you said that we treat ourselves — in English there is a word for it, self-medication. Sometimes we see that if someone gets a fever, he takes a pill…

brh: یا پیماز ئس لیخٹنگک جیو کسس سورک سورک الیکک تو دے دودی گندے تیرا یا کسان کور گندے تیرا تے بالکل بالکل وخت ئس داسہ کہ کسس بیمار مسک او دے سل ئس ٹھیک کرے سل کرے رے علاج آک اسو علاج آک اسو یا داغ تننگاکے داسہ دور جدید ئے لیکن اونا باوجود نن خننہ کسس سورک مریک تو کسان کور ئس تنگیٹو
en: …or an onion is hung on his neck; or if someone gets measles, they give him some traditional [remedy], or some other [folk remedy]. There was a time when, if someone fell ill, they would do something to set him right; there were such treatments, or he would be cauterized. Now it is the modern age, but despite that we see that if someone gets measles, some [folk remedy] is hung on him.
en_old: …or an onion is applied; if someone has a fever, they give him milk and jaggery, or they give him some little home remedy. There was a time when if someone fell ill, they would cure him, there were treatments, there were treatments, or they would cauterize him. This is the modern age, but despite that we see that if someone gets a fever, they give him some home remedy.

brh: دا گنگتہ گندتیرے تو دا نمے لگے کہ بطور مطلب ہرا کہ ہیلتھ نا شعبہ نم چندی مریضاتے دینہ خنیرے ڈاکٹر ئتو توریرے بش مریرے تو دا وار او تین پارے؟ آ، ئے دنکہ مالو پاریٹ اسہ توہم پرست ء معاشرہ ئس نا نرینہ داٹی چوشکہ صفائی
en: When they do these [things], how does it strike you, as, I mean, someone in the health sector — you see so many patients every day, they stay with the doctors and get back on their feet — so what do you say about this? — Ah, yes, as I said earlier, ours is a superstitious society, in which, just like cleanliness…
en_old: When they do these things, how does it strike you — as in, in the health sector you see so many patients every day, they come to the doctors and talk to them, so what do you say about that? Ah, as I said, ours is a superstitious society, isn't it, in which, just as with cleanliness…

brh: ولے دا دے کہ ارا کہ نی پاریس دا گپک ہندن داسم مننگٹی داسم خلقاتے ٹی یا ہمو جاگاتے آ اراڑے کہ حکومت نا دا ٹیم آتا رسائی مفک کس اوڑے سر مننگ کپک
en: But it is this: what you said, these things are like that — they are still happening even now in the villages, or in those places where these government teams have no access, where no one can reach.
en_old: But this is it — what you say, these things do happen like this, among such people, or in those places where the government's teams have no access, where no one can reach.

brh: وخت تو یقینا اوڑے داسہ ہم ہندا گڑاک برجا او بالکل انتئے کہ فاصلہ غاک باز زیادہ او مشو دامان تا نامٹ مخلوق تمو کے گدان تے تنا خلو کے ننا مخلوق زیادہ تر ہندن او کہ ہیلتھ کارڈ انت کہ او
en: …back then, and certainly even now these same things persist there, absolutely, because the distances are very great, and the people who live out among the mountains and plains, who pitch tents — most of our people are like that — [don't know] what a health card is, what it…
en_old: At that time certainly, and even now these things still exist there, absolutely, because the distances are very great; the people out in the hills and plains, those who live in tents, most of our people are the kind who don't know what a health card is, what it...

brh: دا شناختی کارڈ آک جوڑ افس او بالکل او ہندن او جاگہ تمو کو کہ اوڑسکا نہ کسوف تے خنانے نہ بنگونے نہ سر مننگ کے کوفتہ بالکل خلقاتیہ یا رسائی اف اوڑکا رسائی افک نی بالکل تو دا گڑا کرے آہستہ آہستہ وقت او ایجو
en: …these identity cards have not been made [for them], and they live in such places that, out there, nobody has seen them or heard of them or can reach them; absolutely, there is no access to those villages, no access there at all. So this thing, gradually, slowly, time and edu…
en_old: These identity cards weren't made; they are in such places where nobody has ever seen them, heard of them, or reached them; there is absolutely no access there, no access at all. So these things, slowly over time, edu...

brh: ایجوکیشن کرے تعلیم دافتے ختم کرے ساکا کائک۔ اسہ جوان ء تعلیم یافتہ معاشرہ ئس او وخت آ کہ وجود اٹ بریکک گڑا دا گڑاک تینٹ کاک۔ ایسر مریرے ختم مریرے فنا مریرے تو ایونا گڑا دافتا
en: …education, learning, will gradually put an end to these. When a good, educated society comes into existence, then these things will go away by themselves; they will come to an end, finish and vanish. So the matter of these…
en_old: Education, learning, will put an end to these things. When a good, educated society comes into existence, then these things go away on their own. They get resolved, they end, they vanish. So the thing is that these...

brh: بارونی اخس کہ کوشش کیس او مننگ کپسے، اندا کہ سے شعوری عمل اسے تانکہ اسکان یکتر راج اٹی ہمو وخت اسکا دا ختم مفسے۔ بہرحال داسہ ہمے وخت آن ہمو گڑاک باز کم مسنو۔ داسہ ہما ریرک اراڑے کاس
en: …however much you try, it won't happen, because it is a conscious process; until [it reaches] the whole nation, until then this will not end. Anyway, now, compared with that time, those things have decreased a lot. Now wherever you go…
en_old: However much you try, it won't happen, because it is a conscious process; until it reaches the whole nation, until then it won't end. Anyway, compared to that time those things have greatly decreased. Now, wherever you go...

brh: ہر کس تینا وڈٹی علاج نا کوشش تے کیک، کس پائیک دا روحانی علاج ئے کس انت وڈٹی، ولے داسہ کم مسنو، کمبوتی بسنے ایٹتا، اول نا کچا زیادتی اف تا، ہا ختم افس، مطلب ارے، برجا سلوک ئے کس نا۔
en: …everyone tries treatment in his own way; someone says this is spiritual healing, someone [does it] some other way. But now it has decreased, a reduction has come in it; there isn't as much excess as before. Yes, it hasn't ended — I mean, it exists; some people's practice persists.
en_old: Everyone tries treatment in their own way; someone says it is spiritual healing, someone says something else; but now it has lessened, it has come down a lot, there isn't as much excess as before. Yes, it hasn't ended, I mean it exists, some people still keep up that practice.

brh: نن پانہ کہ پوخ کہ زندہ او آخر لگنگ لگنگ دست کا کستانو۔ بالکل منظور صاحب یقینی وڑاٹی ہمو ہرا کہ ننا معاشرہ غان نن دست کا تعلق تخنے وخت ننا کتاب آتیا بننگو نن نوں کہ منظور صاحب پاریکہ پائے کس ئس کہ اگہ جن الکرو تو ہودے سروزو دمبورہ والا
en: We say that […] is alive, and in the end, little by little, it has [stayed] until now. — Absolutely, Manzoor sahib, certainly; it is something our society has kept a connection with until now, and at times we hear of it in our books. Now, as Manzoor sahib said, someone says that if a jinn has seized someone, then for him the suroz and dambura players…
en_old: We say that the smoke that is alive eventually, bit by bit, goes away.
