en: Watching TikTok is not good; it turns a person's brain. Everything has its proper way. You sit for hours and hours watching the mobile, which is no good thing to do. I mean, don't be angry. I know that his brother [unclear: 'hope']... your brother is a good man.
en_old: Watching TikTok is not good; it eats a person's brain. There is a proper way for everything. You sit for hours and hours watching the mobile, which is not a good thing. I mean, don't be angry – I know that your knowledge, your education, is good.

brh: جوان کریت ئے بس ستو تو ریت صحیح ہی ہنی دا ئے تاتیا نوس کٹے گپے ئے بس سستو جوان کریس کنے خبرے کنے ہنا وجم بس نوس کدا ایلم تے دا ئے تولے کینو ایلمی منہ پگ بونو بندہ بس او موبائل نہ دا دنیا نا کرے نہ ئے دنیا نا اونا مغز ہندا فے
en: You've done well... alright, that's right... enough talk, you did well. I know, I know... this brother just sits there [unclear]. The mobile has left him neither of this world nor of that world; his mind isn't here.
en_old: You did well, just sitting there; the right thing – this is it. Enough talk now, you've done well, I know. I have nothing more to say; this brother of mine just sits there, mouth open, he does nothing. The mobile has left him neither of this world nor of that world; his brain is stuck in there.

brh: نمے خبر ئے دا شریف و بندغ اسے، جنگ منگ آن مر اٹ۔ ولا، تینا المی نمے دا تینا کپہ چٹ، تینا المی سمجھائفے۔ اگر سمجھائف پک، گڑا حاکم تارے، تینا حکمے چلیفے۔
en: You know he's a decent man, far from fights and such. So let his own brother [unclear] make his own brother understand. If he can't make him understand, then Hakim is there; let him enforce his authority.
en_old: You know this is a decent man; stay away from fights. Then, that brother of yours – take him by the ear and make your brother understand. If you can make him understand, then Hakim's turn comes, and your order will be followed.

brh: حاکم خان صبر صبر ننے اوڈے سمجھائفنہ ہرو برو ہیت جھلتا اوڈے چمس کینہ حاکم خان نی ناراض مفہ دا ئے تو ناراض مفرے دو مف پین اسنے ناراض مرے ولا دا سہ نو پرے
en: Hakim Khan, patience, patience. We will make him understand. [unclear: 'every word...'] we'll [unclear] him. Hakim Khan, don't be angry; don't be angry with him, don't... if someone else gets angry, then [unclear].
en_old: Hakim Khan, patience, patience. We will make him understand there; we'll close our eyes to all this nonsense talk. Hakim Khan, don't be angry; don't be angry with this one, don't... if someone else gets angry, then this three... say.

brh: گنوکی والا پارین ننا جواننگا ہناس الک مخان ننا ئے تلتینا اندا سیو نی تینا اندا سیوس دا تینا ایلومے سمجھافک ہرو ہرو سمجھتاؤ بس تینٹ خلے ٹانگ وانگے تے پھرغے بیٹھے دوراٹی
en: It's madness, by God, we said it... for our own good... [unclear: 'look within yourself'?]. This one makes his own brother understand, but he doesn't understand at all; he just hits himself, he'll break his legs and such, sitting around all the time. [garbled]
en_old: Craziness – we said it. For our own good he went... our... look within yourself, you look inside yourself. This is your brother; make him understand, explain to each and every one. He just sits by himself, legs stretched out, sitting there all day.

brh: شاید گنوک محسوس مرے تو دا نظریہ کرے مو مستی ریسرچک مرو سا کروئی منظور صاحب پروگرام تو استخواہی نم تو گپ کریسہ کانے لیکن وقت نا پاس نا ننا اڑسر مرے لیکن ننا وروک بینوک خنوکاتے گونڈو ئس ایند کلو استین خواہی
en: ...so that [the other person] may perhaps seem mad; so this theory should be researched further in future. Manzoor Sahib, it was our wish to keep talking with you on the program, but because of the limits of time we are constrained; still, for our listeners and viewers, we request a short closing message.
en_old: ...may perhaps perceive him as mad; so this notion must be researched further. Manzoor Sahib, we would gladly have gone on talking with you through the program, but because of time constraints we have reached the end; but for our listeners and viewers, please give a short closing word.

brh: گڈیکو کلوف دادے کہ تینا او تینا خاہوت نا خیالداری کین کرے ہمیشے ہندا خیال ئٹی تخیر کہ اگر اوفتے چنکو ناجوڑی ئس مریک نن انتئے چنکا غاواتے سر کپنہ بالکل نن ایتاں اسکان بلو ناجوڑی ئس متنے نن ہمو
en: My last message is this: take care of yourselves and your families, and always keep this in mind: if they have a minor illness, why don't we attend to the small complaints? Really, we [wait] until it has turned into a big illness, and we that...
en_old: My last word is this: take care of yourselves and your families; always keep this in mind that if they get a minor illness, why do we not take them to a doctor at once—absolutely, until it has not become a big illness, we...

brh: ٹیما کہ ننے کسس جالن جولی کتنے نن تینٹ پاپنے تو آگے کہ چونکو آگے معمولی کسس ناجوڑی ئس مریک تو بائیدے کہ ہموڑے خڑک نا ارا کہ دارا غا خڑ ئیرک اور جانجوڑی نا اودے اوڑے سر
en: ...time, [only] when someone has had to carry us off in a cloth [sling], do we ourselves [go]. So from now on, since in future if anyone has even an ordinary illness, one should take him to whatever place is nearest, close by, for his health.
en_old: ...that if someone among us has fallen ill, we ourselves say that if someone has a small, minor illness, then one should go to the place where medicine is given, and take the matter of recovery there.

brh: انتئے کہ ولدا ہندا چنکا ناجوڑی ودیسہ باز بلو ناجوڑی ئس مریک ولدا اونا علاج کرے مننگ مفک سخت مریک او ولدا اسہ وار نا اگہ بندغ ئس کاۓ تو انسان اودے کدی پورو کننگ کپک بالکل تو باز منت وار
en: Because otherwise this same small illness keeps growing and becomes a very big illness; then its treatment can no longer be done, it becomes serious, and then if a person dies even once, no one can ever make up for it. — Absolutely. So, thank you very much.
en_old: Because otherwise this small illness grows into a very big illness, and then its treatment becomes impossible, it becomes severe; and then if a person dies once, one can never make up for it. Absolutely, thank you very much.

brh: باز منت وار حاجی عصمت اللہ صاحب ارا کہ گڈی کو کلو ئے پواسو بس دس سیکنڈ نا بس مختصر پاو تینا خیال کبو تینا فیملی نا خیال تخبو آباد مریرے خوش مریرے باز چین باز منت وار حاجی عصمت اللہ
en: Thank you very much, Haji Ismatullah Sahib. Now, would you give your last message — just ten seconds, just say it briefly. — Take care of yourselves, take care of your families; may you prosper and be happy. — Very good, thank you very much, Haji Ismatullah.
en_old: Thank you very much, Haji Ismatullah Sahib; now give us your closing word, just ten seconds, say it briefly. Take care of yourselves, take care of your family, may you prosper and be happy. Very good, thank you very much, Haji Ismatullah.

brh: سنگت آ باز ہنین و گچین و کچاری ئس نم تون منظور کہ عزیز صاحب تون اللہ چہ گست و استخوائی کیتو گپ کرے ساکن لیکن وقت تون سنگتی کروئی تمک پئے وقت تون سنگتی کریس وقت نی تون سنگتی کیک نما سر باز منت وار کہ نم بسورے پروگرام ء زیبدار کرے نن اللہ پاک نمے عزت ایت حاجی عصمت اللہ صاحب نما باز منت وار شرفدار آک
en: Friends, it was a very sweet and excellent gathering with you, with Manzoor, our dear Sahib; God knows how much we wished to go on talking with you, but one has to keep company with time; they say if you keep company with time, time keeps company with you. Thank you very much for coming and making the program beautiful; may Allah Pak grant you honour. Haji Ismatullah Sahib, thank you very much. Honoured [viewers]...
en_old: Friends, it was a very sweet and fine gathering with you, Manzoor and Aziz Sahib; we would gladly have gone on talking, but we have to keep company with time—if you befriend time, time befriends you. Thank you very much that you came and graced the program; may Allah give you honour, Haji Ismatullah Sahib, thank you very much. Listeners...

brh: صحت کرے داڑتون گوازی کننگے پاوا کرے انسان اگر گوازی کرے تو مون مستی کرے نقصان نا کرے گواچی مرسا کائے صحت نا تینا خیالے کبو تینا راج نا تینا دے نا تینا در او ہمسائے نا خیالے اسپیشلی چنکا چناتا خیالے کرسا کبو موسمیاتی تبدیلی ء
en: ...health: I am talking about playing with it. If a person plays with it, then later on he keeps falling victim to harm. Take care of your health, of your people, of your land, of your home and neighbours, and especially keep taking care of small children. Climate change...
en_old: Don't play with health; if a person plays with it, later on he suffers harm. Take care of your health, of your people, of your village, your home and your neighbours, and especially take care of small children; climate change...

brh: شروع مسونے تو صحت تننگ رب تعالی نا ڈیوٹی ئے احتیاط کننگ انسان نا ڈیوٹی ئے سردار زین ساتھیز بروکا پروگرام ئس کنا نمتو نمار مرو، کنے سار احمد محمد شاہی، منظور احمد قاضی صاحب، حاجی عصمت اللہ لانگو او ننا پینل پروڈیوسر میر احمد کاکڑ صاحب ء موکل اٹ بو اللہ نگہبان۔
en: ...has begun, so giving health is the duty of God Almighty, and taking precautions is the duty of man. Sardar Zain and friends, I will be with you in an upcoming program. Allow me, Sar Ahmed Muhammad Shahi, along with Manzoor Ahmed Qazi Sahib, Haji Ismatullah Langov and our panel producer Mir Ahmed Kakar Sahib, to take leave; Allah be your guardian.
en_old: ...have started; giving health is the duty of the Lord Almighty, taking precautions is the duty of man. Sardar Zain and companions, I will be with you again in the next program. Along with me, Sar Ahmed Muhammad Shahi, Manzoor Ahmed Qazi Sahib, Haji Ismatullah Langove and our panel producer Mir Ahmed Kakar Sahib—give us leave; may Allah be your guardian.

brh: موبائل الہ گوگوش، دماغ کنا خراب کپہ، انت کاری مرے نی زو پاہ، کن تو خٹیمف، اینہ ہچ دت بنف، گوازی مازی تے نا الے، ئے کاوش ارا نی بر دکانے سنبھالے، دا انت پاننگ اوسک، ئے دکانے سنبھالے
en: Put the mobile down, listen. — Don't mess with my head; whatever the work is, tell me quickly; don't keep on at me, I won't listen to anything else. — Leave your games and stuff. I'm going; come, you look after the shop. — What is he saying? That I should look after the shop?
en_old: Put the mobile down, don't mess with my head; whatever the work is, tell me quickly, don't argue with me, I won't listen to anything else; take your games and stuff away. Where are you going? Come, look after the shop. What is this he's saying—look after the shop.

brh: او خلوک کہ بورہ تولک ایوتے وا شرم بفک نی شرم تو نی بفک بلہ علم تو بندغ ہم دن ئے تکیک ہمے ٹائم ئے نی پارے ٹہ دا موبائل نی یوپہ موبائل اگہ اوتا ویسہ دم بے ادب ماتا ویسہ کنے موبائل خوار کتے کنے نی خوار
en: Look at this one who just sits around; doesn't he feel any shame? You have no shame at all. But even a person with some sense would consider this. At that very time I told you: don't take this mobile. If you hadn't taken the mobile, you wouldn't have become so rude now. The mobile has ruined me; you have ruined me.
en_old: Look at him, aren't you ashamed? You have no shame at all; a man with some sense would at least pay attention at that time. You say, 'This mobile—don't you take the mobile; if you take it, you become ill-mannered; the mobile has ruined me, and you have ruined me...'

brh: او ککر زرس موبائل ء الا کنے۔ الا کنے ایناک جٹ ئس موبائل ء سیل کیو۔ موبائل نا سیل کننگ پی چراٹھی مھورنے اناڑی چولوک پی موبائل ء ہوریسے۔ ہلی کاریم دے خیک۔ زندگی ہم کروئی نی یا آخا؟ چڑہ موبائل ء سیل کیسی
en: Oh, just let me have the mobile a little. Let me, let me look at the mobile for a while. — Looking at the mobile... you keep staring at the mobile. The work...? Do you have to live your life too, or not? You're always looking at the mobile.
en_old: Hey, hold on, let me put the mobile down for a bit. Let me put it down—first let me sell the mobile. For selling the mobile, first unplug the charger... from where did you get this mobile? Do you do any work at all? Do you have to live life too or what? Go sell the mobile...

brh: کنے آن کاری مارے مپھک، ہن تینٹ دکانے سنبھالے، نئے داسہ کنا ایٹی الپیسہ بفیسہ دکانے سنبھالپیسہ، ایٹی اسو پومفیسہ، پاریٹ نی دکانے تینٹ سنبھال کنے آن مپھک، دوں کپہ۔
en: I can't do any work; go look after the shop yourself. — No, now you don't take my words, you don't listen, you won't look after the shop, you don't understand my words at all. — I said, you look after the shop yourself, I can't; don't do this.
en_old: I can't do any work, go look after the shop yourself; now you don't come to me, you don't listen, you don't look after the shop, you don't even think of me; I said, look after the shop yourself, I can't, don't do this.

brh: کپ جوان فکر نا بندغ بلائلم نا ہیت الے بلائلم ہم کارم کپک باری کنے پنت آتے پئے نی کارم کرک رفیق دا سا کاوے نا ہیت آتیک کنا ارمان کروس ٹھیک ٹھیک بس
en: 'Be a man of good thinking.' Forget the elder brother's talk; the elder brother doesn't work either, yet he gives me advice: 'You work!' Friend, these words of... You'll regret [losing] me. Okay, okay, enough.
en_old: Be a sensible man. As for the elder brother, the elder brother works too, doesn't he? You're giving me advice, friend, you go and do the work. Who are these words for? You've fulfilled my wish. Fine, fine, enough.

brh: نی تینٹ ڈغارئے کتوئس بسوس کنا کاٹم آ توسس، ئے لمدا پار کسیداٹی دنیا بھرئے تولیک یرا بس وٹ گناس کریٹ، نی بلو گناس کریس بسوس کنا رئی آ توسس، مخلوق کنا سیخاغان نرے نی بسوس کنا خورک آ توسس، ئے لم نی تنگ سینئی کپے اگہ نی نارا
en: You didn't take the ground yourself; you came and sat on my head. — Brother, in this park the whole world sits; so what sin did I commit? — You committed a big sin: you came and sat in my spot. People run from my shadow, and you came and sat right next to me. — Brother, don't be so intolerant; if you...
en_old: You left your own place and came and sat on my head. I... in this place the whole world sits; I committed one sin, you committed a big sin, you came and sat beside me. People run from my shadow, and you came and sat on my chair. I... you don't recognize me, if you...

brh: بسوس توئی نی امر کا وتولے وی مسئلہ صفتونو امر مسئلہ سفت بسوس کنا خوڑکا توسوس نا خوڑکا تولنگ مگہ جرم ئس ایلم نی جرم اللے نی دا پا ایلم انت کنے پاریس ایلم نی کنا ہچ دماغ تولنگ اف کہ نی انت طریقہ نا بندغ ئس اؤس لے خنا خلیف
en: You came and sat; how could you go and sit [here]? — What's the problem? How is it a problem? — You came and sat next to me. — Is sitting next to you a crime, brother? — You say it isn't a crime? — Tell me this, brother: what did you say to me? Brother, I just can't fathom what kind of man you are...
en_old: You came and sat... wherever you go and sit, the matter is clear, the whole matter is clear, you came and sat on my chair. Is sitting on your chair a crime? Brother, it's no crime; you say this, brother, what did you tell me, brother? I have no mind to sit... what kind of man were you? Look at that, Khalif...

brh: دا خبر تمپک کہ دا وڑو بندغ اسے، دا وڑو بلو بلو ہیت کپے، اگر نی منے پیسے، ئے کاو پین جاگہ ئس تولیوہ، مسئلہ ء ضبط کنو۔ کنے کاٹم اٹی نا مسئلہ مسئلہ، بس ئس کنا خورک آ تولوس۔ ہمر پاسے مسئلہ صاف۔
en: One doesn't realize that he is this kind of man. Don't talk so big. If you won't accept it, I'll go and sit somewhere else, and let's settle the matter. — For me, the problem is the one in your head: just that you sat next to me. However you put it, the matter is clear.
en_old: Don't you know that this is such a man, he talks so big? If you want, I'll go and sit somewhere else; let's settle the matter. For me your problem is a headache; you just sat on my chair. Whoever you ask, the matter is clear.

brh: دم نی بانگ کنگونوس نشہ کرینوس مثلا انتے کنے پا چہ کنا رئی آ تولپے۔ ہو اجل ہو نی دون آسانی ٹی کنا ایتاتے پومفیس۔ لغت منے برین گڑا ایتاتے پومریس۔ ئے بوچہ سے نا ماسن تر کتنٹ کنے لغت منے تیسے۔ بوچہ۔
en: Now you've had a puff of bhang, you're intoxicated. Tell me, for instance, why you shouldn't sit in my spot? — Yes, yes, you won't understand my words this easily. When the kicks land, then you'll understand the words. — Hey Bocha, I haven't backed off from you; you're giving me kicks? Bocha!
en_old: Now you've smoked bhang, you've taken drugs; for instance, tell me why you don't sit beside me. Yes, Ajal, yes, you won't get rid of me this easily. If you get a kick, then you'll be rid of me. Hey Bocha, I've given up your... give me a kick. Bocha.

brh: خانی پت اسنا ماس انت ترک کریروش خنا عیداتے پو مافیسے اور کنے منفیسے دا سئی نا جوان علاج کیوے
en: ...what have you given up? You don't understand my words and you don't obey me; I'll give this one a proper treatment.
en_old: Khani... what did you give up? Look at these hands, don't say no and don't refuse me, I'll deal with these three properly.

brh: ارے بدمعاش اینو اسکا دونو بندغ پیدا متنے کنے خلئے اور نی کنے خلیسس نیکی مخلوق خلیسے گڑا نیم کس معاف کپک ئے خبر اف نی رفیق تون ٹیلیفون استنے دا
en: Hey, you scoundrel! Until today no man has been born who could hit me, and you hit me? You who hit people, then nobody will forgive you either. I don't know... you had a telephone with a friend, this...
en_old: Hey, scoundrel, until now no man has been born who could hit me, and you hit me? You've hit people before, so nobody forgives you. Don't you know? You took a telephone from a friend, this...

brh: نی کنے ہم پچپیسے، ئے کہ مخلوق ء خلیسے، گڑا نی ہم کس معاف کپک، ادا خیر ء ہنمس نمے، خیر ء ہن، خیر تورے ہنمس، ہن مس، جا برے کنا خڑک آ تولی کپک، نا خڑک آ توسٹ گڑا ایلم جرمس کریٹ
en: You don't spare me either; you who hit people, then nobody will forgive you either. — Here, go in peace, go in peace, go safely, go. Come on, [nobody] can sit next to me. — I sat next to you, so, brother, did I commit a crime?
en_old: You don't even ask me; you hit people, so nobody forgives you either. Here, go in peace, go in peace, go safely, go on. Then come, you can't sit on my chair. If I sat on your chair, brother, did I commit a crime?

brh: ایلو کچٹم آما زاتی موبائل ہرا ٹوپئی کنا مازٹ نی بش ما موبائل اوپئے ئنا ایتنا زی آ جنگ کنے موری ئنا ایتنا زی آ بشمہ تھور بدمعاش مسونے انت کے برے کنا خودکار تفنگے دا بلوک بار کسے ئے دے کنا بت بس سورا جی انتھے
en: The other... my personal mobile which... you, get up... our mobile... over your words, fight with me... over your words, get up. You've become a real scoundrel. Why...? Come, my automatic gun... this carries a big load... give me my... enough, Sora ji, why?
en_old: Another... that personal mobile that... my... you get up, our mobile... for his hand, a fight... for his hand, get up. You've become a big scoundrel, why? Come, my automatic gun, this... carries a big load, give me my... enough, Sora ji, why?

brh: بارٹ تینا مسہ مورکاو تولیبو بدمعاشی شروع کرے کبو نہ نہ نہ دا ایتا کنا گپ ہبو اسہ علاقہ نا بندہ اسہ ملک نا بندہ اسہ خلق نا بندہ ادے دو گھنٹہ ری جھن جھن نٹ پورا دا دنیا ہمو چھلے
en: Come, sit down in front, all of you, and start the thuggery! — No, no, no, listen to these words of mine: [we are] men of one area, men of one country, men of one people; here for two hours... the whole world is like that.
en_old: Come, sit in front of me, don't start acting like a thug. No, no, no, listen to my words: a man of one area, a man of one country, a man of one people, here for two hours... the whole world is like that.

brh: سوال کپا بو بچی نی جوانو خیر ئس مریک چلو باز غلتیس کرینار او جاہ فس نا خاطرن نہ نہ نہ نہ نہ بس ایندے زانو کپس ہاں بالکل خیر ئس خیر ئس ایندے تینا کسرے ہتہ
en: Don't ask questions, kid; you're fine, it'll all be fine. Okay, a big mistake was made over a seat. — No, no, no, no, no, just, now don't... — Yes, absolutely, fine, fine; now go your own way.
en_old: Don't ask questions, son, you're fine, everything will be well. Okay, I made a big mistake, for the sake of that place... no, no, no, no, no, just don't know this. Yes, absolutely, fine, fine, now take your own path.

brh: واڑے کنا نادان ارے دنیاس نادان دنیا ٹی باز ئس بس نا خاطر آن معاف کننگوٹ تے واللہ بس الے پارے باز باز مہربان باز نا مہربانی
en: Oh, he's naive, my friend; there are naive people in the world, many of them. Just for your sake I'm forgiving him. — By God, enough, let it go, he said. — Very, very kind; many thanks.
en_old: Hey, my ignorant one, there are many fools in the world; for your sake they are forgiven. By God, enough, he said, very, very kind, many thanks to you.

brh: او بے وقوفے رفیق تہاڑے فکتے نی رفیق نمونہ تے کس ہورنگ کپہ کو وا اورتے رفیق تہاڑے فکتے نی خبر اف تے
en: He's a fool, friend; don't pay attention to him. Friend, nobody bothers looking at specimens like that... friend, don't pay attention to him, you don't know him.
en_old: He's a fool, friend, don't be fooled by him. You, friend, nobody looks at samples... go, friend, don't be fooled by them, you don't know.

brh: جمال کنا ایلم خیر تو ارے یا نی پریشان پریشان خننگسہ ایلم ئے داسہ نن واری کے
en: Jamal, my brother, is everything all right? Or... you look worried, worried. — Brother, now our turn...
en_old: Jamal, my brother, is everything all right? Or... you look worried. Brother, now it's our turn.

brh: جمال کنا ایلم خیرے انت مسس؟ ہاؤ کنا ایلم ئے انوٹ پارک آ تو رفیق ہموڑے تولوک ئس ئے اونا خڑک آ توسٹ موبائل یوز کرے چے او بش مس کنتو جنگ کرے
en: Jamal, my brother, is all well? What happened? — Yes, my brother, I went to the park, and a guy was sitting there; I sat next to him and was using my mobile, and he got up and fought with me.
en_old: Jamal, my brother, is everything okay, what happened? Yes, my brother, today I was in the park, a friend was sitting there, I sat on his chair and was using the mobile; he got up and fought with me.

brh: آخر نی ہمیتس کرینوس خامخواہ نی تو انت کہ جنگ کے ایلو میڑ تو ہچ ہیت میتس کتوٹ او کنتون اکوناک جنگ کرے او نیتو اکوناک جنگ کرے نی ئے کاوہ تینٹ اوڑتو ہیت کیوہ نی فی الحال اوڑتو ہیت میت کپیس
en: After all, you must have said something; why would he fight with you for nothing? — Brother, I didn't say anything at all; he fought with me for no reason. — He fought with you for no reason? I'll go and talk to him myself; for now, don't you talk to him.
en_old: After all, you must have done something; nobody fights with you for nothing. Brother, I didn't say anything to him, he fought with me for no reason. He fought with you for no reason? I'll go and talk to him myself. For now, don't talk to him.

brh: مجال مرینی ٹھیک ایلم ٹھیک انتس کہ نی پاس
en: How dare he! — Okay, brother, okay, whatever you say.
en_old: ...fine, brother, fine, whatever you say.

brh: ادا رفیق کنا ایلم تون ہتہ کہ جنگ کرینوس۔ اللہ ایتا کہ پیسہ تا۔ ادا رفیق جان ئے نی پاننگٹ کنا ایتا بنیسہ آخا؟ او رفیق ایلم ئے نی تو۔۔۔
en: Here, friend, so you fought with my brother? God... money... Here, my friend, I'm telling you: are you listening to my words or not? — O friend, brother, you...
en_old: Here, friend, you fought with my brother. God knows what for... money? Here, friend, I'm telling you, don't you hear my words? Hey friend, brother, you...

brh: خواہ مخواہ پین مسلمان اسے توڑے فکری نی خواہ مخواہ جول اسے ہاجرہ نا لکھٹی نن سوب نی ئنا وجہ نی امیر بسونے داد سمجھائفے نی داد تینٹ پارے کہ بھئی کنے اسو مننے تک دکانے ملانے کسونے دکانہ تولپک او دکانے ٹی مچو علم اسے دا غریب ہمو تو دو کسے سمجھاس
en: Needlessly another Muslim ... worried; you needlessly [got into] a mess ... in Hajira's [...]. We are the reason, it is because of you. Amir has come; Dad explained it; Dad himself said, 'Brother, for me ... until ... [since] the shop was opened, nobody sits in the shop, and he has a little knowledge of the shop.' This poor man — you two explain it to someone.
en_old: Needlessly another Muslim... you think, needlessly... Hajira's... we are the cause, you are the cause, you've become rich. Explain it to him, tell him yourself: 'Brother, I've sat in the shop for a while, I've done the shop's work.' He sits in the shop, and all the knowledge is there in the shop. This poor man – you two explain it to him.

brh: اللہ خیر کے نی ناراض مفے ننو اٹو براس کے ٹھیکے دار ٹھیک ہی ہننگٹوٹ اینیا مونی نم چارے نما کاریم چائے ئے ہنم داسا پارے گنوک کوسٹے دومو بلو کھڈ اسیٹی بٹونومے ولا دن کے پیش تمنگ ہم کپرو رے ولا پارے
en: May God make it well — don't be angry. We're [like] brothers; it's fine, hold on, all right, I'm going on ahead. You all know, you know your own work. I'm going. Now he says we're crazy, that we would throw ourselves into such a big pit and then wouldn't even be able to get out like this — that's what he said.
en_old: May God keep things well, don't be angry. We're brothers; the contractor is right, he's right. Before leaving, you look at this, our work – see, right now he's saying 'crazy'; don't fall into some pit. Then the day before, going ahead also fell... then he said...

brh: یارا حاکم جان نا ہیت آک سہی اسو داسہ ننا داغ نمے بدل کرے پھگہ پرو یارا واقعی جوان او بندغ ئس جوان ننے سمجھائفے نن پو متون نن تینا عقل آن کاریم ہلتون چھڑا پارین گنوکے گنوکے گنوکے مگر او گنوکے بوڈان سے
en: Friend, Hakim Jan's words were right; now he has changed our minds. Friend, truly he is a good man; he explained it to us well. We didn't understand, we didn't use our own reason; we just kept saying 'he's crazy, he's crazy, he's crazy', but that 'crazy' one is [wiser] than an elder.
en_old: Friend, Hakim Jan's words were correct; now he has changed our mark. Friend, truly, that man is a good person, he explained it to us well. We didn't know, we didn't use our own reason, we just kept saying 'crazy, crazy, crazy', but that 'crazy one' is actually the wise elder.

brh: زیادہ و گنوک کرے ایلم، بھگ بٹیگ نو مے بلو کوا سے ٹی، پیش تمنگم کپ بیرے، جوان اللہ مدد نن خدا حافظ نرہنان
en: He has driven [us] really crazy, brother. [If] you fall into such a big well, you can't even get out. All right, may God help; goodbye, we're going.
en_old: He acted far too crazy, brother; one shouldn't fall into a pit of such size. Going ahead and falling – well, may God help us. Goodbye, we're off.

brh: صاحب ایتا تے؟ ہاؤ صاحب۔ ادا ننے سوب نا ئے سمجھائفینے کہ دا بندغ غنلو گڑا ئس کیک۔ جی او۔ اچھا صاحب بس ایلو کس دا بندغ دا تننگے پگہ پین اسے بریک۔ ئے دا دے کوٹ سمجھائفٹ پگہ سمجھپک۔ دا غاتہ غٹ پرغ۔
en: Sir, did he give it? — Yes, sir. — Brother, he has explained to us the reason why this man does such things. — Yes. — All right sir, enough; [leave] the other one, this man; tomorrow another one will come. I explained it to him today; tomorrow he won't understand. Break all of these.
en_old: Sir, are you there? Yes, sir. Brother, explain to us the reason why this person does such a thing. Yes. Alright, sir, that's enough – someone else; this person, tomorrow another one will come. I've explained so much to him; tomorrow he'll understand. These ones – throw them all out.

brh: مٹ توڑا ٹی خامخواہ بیٹی کنا سنگت دے تینا خلنگا تینا خلنگا او اللہ جوڑ مرے تینا خلنگا جی او اللہ خیر اسہ نی ہنا دے کہ دا اسہ نی سرگردان کرینے نی اسہ جوان دکانہ ٹی پیش تمنسہ فصل آتے ارٹان نی سہی ئے ہا ٹھیک ئے خدا حافظ خان میر صاحب
en: Needlessly [sitting] in the dirt, my friend — take care of yourself, take care of yourself; and may God make him well. Take care of yourself. — Yes. God keep it well; you went that day, [and] this one has left you distraught; you were [doing] well in a shop, you came out, the crops ... — You're right, yes, all right. Goodbye, Khan Mir Sahib.
en_old: Don't sit around needlessly in the dust, my friend. Look after your own, look after your own – may God make it well. Look after your own, yes. God keep things well – did you go? Because he has set you wandering, you were ahead in a good shop, among the crops... You're right, yes, alright, goodbye Khan Mir Sahib.

brh: کنا ایلم سفر نا تاننا نقصان اسے
en: My brother, the journey has [caused] a loss.
en_old: My brother, the journey involves a loss of... something.

brh: ایلم اران کاسے؟ کنے الے ادا نی تینا حوال ایٹ نی اران کاسے؟ ئے نی ابنگٹ۔ خیرے کنکے زہیر کریس کنے ابنگس۔ ایلم ئے دا وجہ غان نی ابنگٹ۔
en: Brother, where are you going? Brother, tell me — tell me your news; where are you going? — I was coming to you. — Is everything all right? Did you miss me, that you were coming to me? — Brother, I was coming to you for this reason.
en_old: Brother, where have you come from? Tell me, brother, tell your news – where did you come from? You had gotten lost. Well, you worried me, I had gotten lost. Brother, that is the reason you got lost.

brh: ئے گٹ موبائل نا پیکج ختم مسنے، گڑاس پیسہ تنے۔ درو مسی ہزار روپئی تسوٹ نی او تچ ابلا ہرا فیس؟ نی مسی ہزار نا پاسے، دا موبائل ٹی پنجاہ ہزار ہم اچ صفا س۔ پنجاہ ہزار مسی دے ٹی ختم مفرک۔ نی گنے مسی ہزار تسوس، ئے رافٹ۔
en: Hey, my mobile package has run out; give me some money. — Yesterday I gave you three thousand rupees; what fee did that go on? — You talk about three thousand — in this mobile even fifty thousand gets wiped clean. Fifty thousand is finished in three days. You gave me [only] three thousand, and it's gone.
en_old: Hey, the mobile's package has run out, give some money. Didn't I give you three thousand rupees? Was that for your Facebook? You talk about three thousand – fifty thousand goes clean into this mobile. Fifty thousand gets used up in three days. You gave me only three thousand, and it's gone.

brh: ہنا موبائل نی صفا خوار کرے برباد کرے ہر ئسیٹ تو کاس اڑے فساتے نی اینو حاکم خان بس کنے نا دائے تیس نی اونا ایلوم تونتے جنگ کرینوس او نا ایلوم اندا کنا رئی بس توس او نا رئی بس توس
en: That mobile has completely ruined you, destroyed you; you go picking quarrels with every single person. Today Hakim Khan just told me this about you — you've fought with his brother; his brother came here to me, he came to me.
en_old: This mobile has ruined you completely, destroyed you; every single day there are quarrels and trouble with someone. Now, Hakim Khan, just give me mine. You've quarreled with his brother; his brother is here, my... just... his... just.

brh: او چونا اینگو ڈس تو خواتب، اینی اوڑ تو جنگ کریس، او ایتا تلے دا پا پیسہ آتے سے یا تفیسے، ئے تے نا کا موبائل اٹی پیسہ شا، کنتے ایچ پیسہ میسہ اف، راہی مئے دکان ئے چلے، پیسہ کے اف نی جوان گڑا خبر تموئے
en: That kid ... today you fought with him; he is saying, 'Say this: will you give the money or not?' Should I pour money into your mobile? I have no money at all. Get going, run the shop. There's no money; you'll find out what's good for you.
en_old: He went off with you there and fought with you; he says these are the money... or you've put it – your money goes into the mobile; I have no money at all. Go and run the shop; there is no money, you don't know anything worthwhile.

brh: بڑے ٹاپونی انتس کیس کے کنے خبر تمک آخری وار پاننگٹ نی پیسے آتے جائی یا تفیس کنتو ادا نی آک ٹکا سم اف اگر ٹکا سف تماشہ گڑا سیل کیس مست نی باز تماشہ کرینوس
en: Hey, what have you been doing that I keep hearing about it? I'm telling you for the last time: will you give the money or not? — I don't have even a single penny on me here. — If you don't have a penny, then you'll see a show. You've caused a lot of trouble.
en_old: Hey, what have you done that I didn't even hear of it? Last time I told you, will you pay the money properly or not? But here you don't have a single rupee; if there's no money then there's no show, and you've made quite a spectacle of yourself.

brh: دا سورنگ ٹیان تماشہ کروس، ہستی کہ ٹھیک کہ بس دا سورنگ ٹی تماشہ مر مریک
en: You'll make a spectacle out of this tunnel? Fine, all right, enough — a spectacle will happen in this tunnel.
en_old: You made a spectacle in this tunnel – fine, alright, it's enough; in this tunnel a spectacle does happen.

brh: السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام رسول بخش تنے جوان خبرے کنے داڑے انتئے تولوک ئس
en: Peace be upon you. — And peace be upon you. Rasool Bakhsh, is all well with you? Why are you sitting here?
en_old: Peace be upon you. — And peace be upon you. Rasool Bakhsh, is all well with you? Why are you sitting here?

brh: سیلو من پاہ نن ہم گنوک انگا ایلم ننے ہم گنوک کرے اللہ جند تے گنوک کے صفا ننے ہم گنوک کرے اللہ رسول بخش دنیا نا ہر تہو تو سینت روئی تمو نی ول نن منع کرینگے تینا ایلم ئے دا ہیت ترک دنیا نا
en: Look, what can I say — we've gone crazy too; [my] crazy brother has made us crazy as well. God made him crazy himself, and he has made us completely crazy too. By God, Rasool Bakhsh, he [keeps falling out] with everyone in the world. Won't you forbid your brother this business of renouncing the world?
en_old: Look, brother, we too have gone mad; my brother has driven us mad as well. God Himself made him mad, and he has driven us completely mad too. By God, Rasool Bakhsh, he wanders all over the world; you never once stopped your brother from this; leave this talk of worldly things.

brh: دا سا اینو، نئے نا ہیت ادی برے نئے ننا ہیت ادی برے، بوڈا نی انپاسہ داسہ داڑ کے انت کسر ئس پٹین کنا ایلم کنے تو ہچ کسر نظر بفنوس، انتئے؟
en: Now, today, neither your word gets through to him nor ours. Old man, what do you say — now what way can we find for him? My brother — I can't see any way at all. Why?
en_old: This time now, neither your word is accepted nor ours. Old man, what do you say now, what fault did you find in him? He is my brother; I haven't seen any fault in him, why?

brh: او نی نا ہیت الیک نی ننا او داسہ ننیا نن پائنا اوڑ کے صرف دعا کر او دعاسہ سر کیتہ پین اوڑ کے ہچ کسر کننگ اف
en: He accepts neither your word nor ours. Now we are telling you: just pray for him. If prayer works on him [well and good]; otherwise there's nothing else that can be done for him.
en_old: He doesn't listen to your word, nor to ours. Now we are telling you, just pray; if that prayer is answered, fine, otherwise there is nothing else to be done.

brh: مردا رفیق خیر تورے یانے انتڑی وا خلق نی نا گنے کاٹمے کنا شکایت سے نا ایلم کرے نی کنا ایلم نا نوم تو کنے علاقہ ٹی رسوا کرے رے سبا
en: Hey man, Rafiq, is everything all right? I mean, what is this — people [say] I'm mad in the head; your brother made a complaint about me. You have disgraced me in the area using my brother's name.
en_old: Hey man, Rafiq, is all well? What happened? Why did the people... your mad brother made a complaint about me; your brother has disgraced me in the area in my brother's name... tomorrow.

brh: ئنا وجان اینے سلیوے نا سائے ہلیوے اینے مڈیوے رفیق کنا ایلم بندغ دا کس گنوک مفک ئے تو گنوک افٹ لم کنے گنوک کریرے رفیق کنا ایلم بندغ سریل مریک دون کپک چمکا چمکا ایتا چا جم کپک
en: Because of you ... [unclear] ... Rafiq, my brother, a man doesn't go crazy like this. I'm not crazy — you people will make me crazy. Rafiq, my brother, a man may go astray, [but] he doesn't act like this ... he doesn't pile up [...].
en_old: He won't stand with you, won't take your side, won't come to your aid. Rafiq, my brother, no one becomes mad like this; I'm not mad, it's you people who will drive me mad. Rafiq, my brother, a man gets caught, he doesn't do that, with his eyes wide open he doesn't gather anything.

brh: نی انت مسونے آخر ہم کنے چھٹ کرے الارے ئے مسونٹ نی پارے جی جان ایلم بندہ تو نی گچکا گچکا ئے جتا ناراض مفک نی کنا ایلم ئس رفیق
en: What has happened to you? In the end you too abandoned me. Oh, what have I become? You used to say 'yes, dear brother'; a man ... you [keep] setting me apart bit by bit. Don't be angry — you are my brother, Rafiq.
en_old: What has become of you? In the end he has let me go too. What has happened to you? You used to say 'yes, dear', my brother; now you pick and choose things. Don't be angry, you are my brother, Rafiq.

brh: ہمت کرے مالک اسے خول مین خوافس چت کرے فصل
en: Take courage — there's only one owner. Graze [them] in the wheat; they've wiped out the crop.
en_old: Take courage; the Lord is one, He is called upon at home; the crop has risen.

brh: ہمت کر زو کش ہتا شرافت نا زمانہ اسلوف نن ہچ کپن تو ملک اسے دیڑی چٹک ئے دا مال زو کشی مال ہمت کر
en: Take courage, drive [them] out quickly! The age of decency is gone. If we don't do anything, then some landlord will lick [it] clean. This livestock — drive the livestock out quickly, take courage.
en_old: Take courage, pull quickly; this is no longer an age of decency. If we do nothing, the land is somebody's; this livestock, pull quickly, this livestock, take courage.

brh: ارے دا خدا نا عذاب دا تو رسی کے حاکم نا ایلم ء مڑنگی کنا خیال اٹ دا نعرہ و خلیک ہندا بندغ زیارت کا ہنانا صاحب بچفیو کنا ایلم ہندا سیکا پاو گڑا ولدا نندتہ کا
en: Hey, this is God's punishment that has come upon Hakim's brother. In my opinion he goes around shouting slogans. Let's take this man to a shrine; the holy man will save him. My brother, tell him this, then we'll go and sit again.
en_old: Hey, this is God's punishment that has come upon Hakim's brother; in my opinion he shouts slogans. This man should go to a shrine; the holy man may save him, my brother. Tell him so, then let's go and sit.

brh: برجا کرغان خیر تورے ین المڑ بننگٹوس اللہ کنے آ تو خیرے حاکم ہمو گنو کاڑا خیر اف کنا ایلو
en: Hello there, is everything all right? Where are you coming from? — By God, I'm fine, Hakim; [but] that crazy one isn't well, my brother.
en_old: Stand up, is all well? Where have you come from? By God, I'm fine, Hakim; that mad one is not well, my brother.

brh: ایلمی مڈی سداریکے کلاسہ ڈیوٹی چس۔ میر چاکر خان دنا پاننگٹوس۔ ہمو کانو کا رسیق ایلمی مڈی سداریکے ہمو خل پیل مینی۔ اورے کپا کان ایلمی مڈی بچخے۔ میر چاکر خان دنا پاننگٹوس۔ ازائی اینا جوان پاننگٹ پشا ہمت کا کان کہ ایلمی مڈی بچخے۔
en: My brother's goods and animals are ... I left my duty. Mir Chakar Khan, you are saying this. That [one] went and arrived; my brother's goods and animals ... Don't do that; let's go, so my brother's goods are saved. Mir Chakar Khan, you are saying this. You're speaking well. Take courage, let's go, so that my brother's goods are saved.
en_old: My brother's cattle were lost; I left my duty. I told Mir Chakar Khan this. Wherever I reached, I said my brother's cattle were lost, I kept telling it. Don't do that, let's go, my brother's cattle have been saved. I told Mir Chakar Khan this. Then he said well, take courage, let's go so that my brother's cattle are saved.

brh: رسول بخش نا ایلم دا
en: This is Rasool Bakhsh's brother.
en_old: This is Rasool Bakhsh's brother.

brh: نا زندگی ٹی ڈکھ سوکھ بریک بس دعا کرک نا ایلم دعا سیٹ سدھا مرے چے کہ نا دپین نا دا دے چو علاج او
en: Sorrow and joy come in your life. Just pray that your brother gets well through prayer, because there is no other cure for this.
en_old: In life sorrow and joy come; just pray that your brother gets well through prayer, because there is no other cure for this.

brh: ادا خیری انو، خیر خیرا گدرینگانے الوم، ئنا جاتو ادا
en: Brother, is all well today? — All's well, things are passing fine, brother. How about you, brother?
en_old: Is everything well here? It's going fine, brother, in my place here.

brh: رسول پنی ئے دوماف نا غنوکا مارکو نا رندٹ تفک دوٹی ہنا مڑسے نانے مارکو ہنا مش نا سیڈا حاکم خان دا ہن پاننگوس ئے ہم ہورے کپو راہی بو کا غنا غنوکوس مارے خلک ٹھیک ہی میر صحیح پاننگٹیوس کامبو خان ہورنگ کنا
en: Rasool, don't you keep your crazy son tied behind you? [He had something] in his hand — that man's son, on that mountain ... — Hakim Khan, you were saying this; I won't wait around either. Set off, go — your crazy one has beaten [my] son. — All right, Mir, you're saying the right thing. Kambo Khan, let's go and see.
en_old: Rasool, you don't keep hold of your mad son; go inside, come back, let the son go... Hakim Khan, I told you this already, don't wait, set off and go. Your mad son beat my son. All right, Mir has spoken rightly, Kambo Khan, let's see.

brh: کنا کتو مف کہ دانا ایلومے خلو راہی مبو خان مبو
en: Don't let it come to me beating his brother. Set off — Khan, get going!
en_old: Don't make me angry, that I beat his brother; set off, Khan, set off.

brh: ارے گورپٹ نی تینے کنے آن ڈکیسے وللہ گڑا نی بچیسے او ناراوا کنے خلئے چنے انتس دو بریک نوم کنے دنیا ٹی رسوا کرے رے خوار کرے رے خلے ولے پرانے ننے رسوا کتنو نی تینے تینٹ رسوا کرے نوس
en: Hey, you grave-digger, you hide yourself from me! By God, and then you get away? He beat me unjustly... kids, what do you (all) get out of it? He disgraced me before the world, he humiliated me, he beat me; but it is not outsiders who have disgraced us. You have disgraced yourself, by your own doing.
en_old: Hey, you hid yourself from me in the dark, by God, and then you escaped. That wretch beats me, what has he done, broken my hands? Disgrace me before the world, humiliate me, beat me; but it was not he who disgraced us, you have disgraced yourself.

brh: پا چنا تور گمہ دا سہ خلیو چٹکے ولے دا زندگی نا دے اینو نی
en: Speak, child... hold on... now shall I give him a smack? But today is the day of your life, you!
en_old: Speak, child, don't hold back. What is this, a slap? But today is the day of your life.

brh: اڑے نم ہرا کسرے؟ ننا انت خیال ئے نی مارے خلسا گڑا بچیسہ؟ نن چائیرہ کہ
en: Hey, who are you people? What do you take us for, that you beat the boy and then get away? We know that...
en_old: Hey, who are you? What do you think, you'd beat our boy and then get away? We will see that...

brh: کان کہ بریں، بس ننت نی کینہ، رفیق نی دا مارے لاوارث سمجھانوس، دا مشٹی خالی سے۔ رفیق نی اسو جوانوں بندغ ئس فیس، کنا ایلم ئے نی اخس سمجھایفیٹ، ہننگ کپہ۔
en: Let them come; enough, we'll deal with you. Rafiq, you took this boy for someone with no one behind him. Did you think this mountain was empty? Rafiq, you are not a good man. How much I warned my brother: don't go.
en_old: Let them come; we'll deal with them. Rafiq, you took this boy for an orphan with no one behind him; this is just empty talk. Rafiq, you are not a good man; however much you tried to make my brother understand, don't go.

brh: کپہ اینو اور کے نان انت انجام مریک صفا آخر زمانہ نشانی بسنے ایلم ہم ایلم نا دشمن ئے ہم خوایشوٹ کنا ایلم اسرے کنا ایلم صفا ڈکو اسرے دشمن
en: Don't. Who knows what end today will bring for him and for you. Truly, the sign of the end times has come: a brother is his brother's enemy too. I kept thinking 'he is my brother, he is my brother', but my brother is truly a hidden enemy.
en_old: Who knows what will become of us today? It has clearly become a sign of the end times: a brother is a brother's enemy. I kept saying he is my brother, he is my brother, but clearly he is an enemy in disguise.

brh: دشمن توار بسنے کنے خلک دشمن کونے کاٹومے نی نا پھالا گنڈنو ایلم ہم نا دشمن ئے نی تینا باء تور نی تینا ایلم تو ہیت کننگ اٹ اڑے رفیق موت نا باٹی سلوک ئس
en: Enemy! A shout has come, he hit me... the enemy... my head... Your own brother is your enemy too. Hold your tongue; you are talking to your brother. Hey Rafiq, you are standing in the mouth of death.
en_old: The enemy's voice has come; the enemy beats me; I'll cut off your head. Your own brother is your enemy; you, hold on to your father; you talk with your brother. Hey Rafiq, death's share still remains.

brh: ولا بلبلی کے شنی ئے بلبلی کپن نم تو کنے خام کونے رے بلبلی گونے کاٹومینے دسا ہمت کیس
en: By God, Bulbuli, who ... is it? Bulbuli, let's not. You (all) take me for a fool. Bulbuli... my head... now, if you have the nerve!
en_old: Hey Bulbuli, whose is this? Bulbuli, don't, you'll hurt me. Bulbuli, I'll cut your head off; so now you've got courage.

brh: ارے نی انت سوجیس؟ اینو نی ننا تون بچیسے؟ آخا کنے زوراک مریس کنے آن زوراک بس۔ ہنا ہیت آکو؟ اہو ہنا ہیت آک۔ ہنا بلا بلا ہیت آک نی ایسو اینو داڑیس کسر کروس۔ اگر نی ننا ہیت ایل کسے تینا بلا ایلم نا ہیت ایل کسے میر مرتضی برا دا ہیت
en: Hey, what were you thinking? Today you'll get away from us? So at last you'll get the better of me? He has become stronger than me. Those words? Yes, those words. Those big, big words of yours... today you've come to this here. If you won't heed our word, heed your elder brother's word. Mir Murtaza, come, this matter...
en_old: Hey, what did you think? Today you've escaped from us? So at last you've become stronger than me, stronger than me. Those words? Yes, those words. Those big, big words you kept saying have been cut short here today. If you won't accept our word, accept your elder brother's word. Mir Murtaza, come, this matter...

brh: کسے دن خوار ذلیل متیویس۔ ہنا نا بد دماغی، ہنا نا مغوزی، ئے نا کاٹم ء کٹک۔ ارے نی گنے خلکس گنے۔
en: You were never humiliated and disgraced like this by anyone. His arrogance, his pride, it has gone to his head. Hey, you hit him, you madman?
en_old: No one has ever humiliated me so. Their arrogance, their brains, are cutting off my head. Hey, you beat me too?

brh: اوڑے بدمعاشو ئے نی خلکوٹ اور داسہ اینا جوانی علاج کیوے
en: Hey, you scoundrel, I hit you, and now I'll give this one a proper treatment.
en_old: Hey scoundrel, you were beating me, and now I'll fix you good today.

brh: دا امر کریس؟ تنے تو خلقس برباد کریس۔ رفیق، نی دا ستا بربادی خنتوس؟ پین اوئی۔
en: How could you do this? You've ruined yourself and the people too. Rafiq, did you see this ruin? Ouch, again!
en_old: Why did you do this? You've ruined a whole people. Rafiq, have you ever seen such ruin? Come again.

brh: اڑے توار نا کاریم کیف کہ مورنگ مورنگ تو کیک دا سہ خراب عید کننگوس کنے انو لگے دا کنتینا جان کشوئی تمنے اڑے بدمعاش کنے انو نا جان مشکلی بچی اڑے سالی نرسے
en: Hey, it's the noise that... (unclear)... Now you are ruining the Eid. It seems to me this one is set on taking my life. Hey, you scoundrel, to me it seems your life will barely be spared. Hey, you bastard, you're running away?
en_old: Hey, do as you're told; he does it face to face. You've ruined this Eid; it struck me today; this one wants to kill me. Hey scoundrel, today my life barely survived; hey, brother-in-law, he's run away.

brh: رنگ سلی
en: (unclear: 'rang') Stand!
en_old: Rang Sali.

brh: کنے کین او کاٹم اٹی برے اینو اناڑی سلیج اٹ دم کشی وی اڑے اینو اناڑی سلیج اٹ دم کشی وی
en: Just let him come at me... today I'll only catch my breath right here, once [it's done]; hey, today I'll only catch my breath right here.
en_old: Let him fall into my hands; today he'll breathe his last right here; hey, today he'll breathe his last right here.

brh: ارے نی اراکا بسس؟ نی خبر اف؟ ما و ترا دا کمرے بریکک۔ اچھا، داسا نی کنا مہمان اوتوس؟ ہاؤ کٹوک، ہاؤ ئے نا مہمان اوتوس۔
en: Hey, where did you come from? Don't you know? It's you and me in this room. Oh, so now you're my guest? Yes, champ, yes, I am your guest.
en_old: Hey, where did you come from? Don't you know? This room is for me and you. So now you are my guest? Yes, fool, yes, I am your guest.

brh: پنت نا سٹ فوے، ئے ہم اینو نا داڑے سائی کشیوے، اینے لکھ مکھ کے وی
en: ... advice ...; today I'll squeeze the breath out of you right here too, and I'll make this one a laughing stock.
en_old: Mind your way; today I'll drag his shadow here too, he'll be left with nothing.

brh: اڑے خبردار ہن مارے لکھو مکھ کیسہ، لکھو مکھ تو، اینے کے وڑے شوق، اڑے نی کنے شوق پاریس، نا کاریم کنا نو شوخیونو
en: Hey, watch out, you're making a laughing stock of the boy? A laughing stock, eh? What kind of fox is this one? Hey, you called me a fox? Your business is... (unclear).
en_old: Hey, watch out, don't go mocking my son. Mocking, eh? What sort of fancy is that? Hey, you call me a fancy? Your business is nothing but my fancies.

brh: شوک پا پرہلہ شیر پاو نی ئے شیر اسوٹ نیکن ئے پو وننگ ہفس ئے نی جوان پومسوٹ ئے
en: A fox? Don't say that, call me a lion! I was a lion... for you...; I've understood you well.
en_old: Ha, you called a jackal a lion; if I were a lion I wouldn't have run away; you understood well.

brh: رفیق نی ملخمو تان نرنگ کپیسہ، اینو کرے دیگ نی کھٹانو۔ نیکون انگا رفیق کچ کپیسہ، آغا نی بہادر اسس تو فخر بیٹ اوڑندے نی دو ئس ہاؤ لغور ہاؤ۔
en: Rafiq, you can't run from the angel of death; today you've won the pot. Rafiq, you're no match for me. If you were brave, you would... with pride...; you are a... yes, coward, yes.
en_old: Rafiq, you can't run from the fight; today you've done it. Nothing will happen to you, Rafiq; if you are brave then come out with pride, you are... yes, weakling, yes.

brh: ئے داسا توفک ء تخیوہ اینہ دوار خلنگ نا ہم لائق کٹ حاکم نا مونا نا حکم چلینگپک دادے توفک بر ہرین تینے داسا گری اینہ دوارٹم خلنگ کیوہ نی کنے خلنگسے ایلم نی صرف پسترنے
en: I'll put the gun down now; this time you're not even worth hitting. Before Hakim, your orders don't work. Here, take this gun...; now then, this time I can hit you. Can you hit me? Brother, you're only backing off.
en_old: I'll put the gun down now; I'm not even fit to strike with a stick; your order does not run before the ruler. Take this gun, go; now I'll strike with this stick. You can't hit me, brother, you're only afraid.

brh: ئے چاپ دا چائے ٹھیک ایلوم ٹھیک انتس کنے پاس دا سئی نی دا چیمپی ریٹ کرے جھر بھور کے وی
en: Ah, this tea is fine, brother, it's fine. Tell me something: is this right? Did you do this champi (head massage) properly? I'll give it a good shake.
en_old: Hey, this tea is fine, brother, it's fine. Tell me something—look, did you do this head massage and rub it in properly?

brh: ارے نی ہناڑے نا ساہ کشو گٹک ئے واری نی جوان اتہ مورت تمتنس ارے نی ہم ارس تا دوٹی وتنس کہ دونو ڈرینگس
en: Hey, you're choking the breath out of me there! This time you've really... Hey, you've also got [my] arms in your hands, pulling at them.
en_old: Hey, you're squeezing the breath out of my throat! You've really wrung my neck well; hey, you've got hold of my arms too and you're yanking them.

brh: دا خلیسہ اینو موج غاربہ ساہنے کشیبہ
en: If you hit like this, today you'll... take my breath away.
en_old: If he beats me now, he'll gladly take my life.

brh: آگہوم خان، دنو کے خلکوس؟ میر خلتن اڑتے، اسے ہکل اسوس۔
en: Aghom Khan, who did you hit like that? Mir, I didn't hit him; it was just one shout.
en_old: Agham Khan, who did you beat? Mir, I hit him there, I gave one shout.

brh: ہوڑتے ہکلا آن بے ہوش مس واہ شیر واہ بے شک شیر تا ہکلا آن شوک آ بے ہوش مریرہ اوڑے انت مس کنے انت مس کنے
en: He fainted from that shout. Bravo, lion, bravo! Indeed, foxes faint at the roar of lions. Hey, what happened to me? What happened to me?
en_old: He fainted from that shout. Bravo, lion, bravo! Indeed, jackals faint at the roar of a lion. Hey, what happened to me, what happened to me?

brh: اڑے نم داڑے مکھنگ اٹی ارے، کنے انو لگے کہ ہمو وخت آ تو خلٹی لگا، ہمو وخت آ تو تھڑا نی کنے ہچ متو نم تھڑا ارے، ننے تو ہچ اف، نی تھڑا ئس کنے درست کیسہ یا کپیسہ، او درست کیو نی
en: Hey, you're standing here laughing. It seems to me that at that very moment the blow landed; at that moment, a little... nothing happened to me. You (all) are... a little; there's nothing wrong with us. Can you fix me up a little or not? He'll fix you up.
en_old: Hey, you're standing here laughing; it seems to me that at that moment he landed a slap, at that very moment... I got nothing, you've got it all, we have nothing. Can you fix my head or not? He'll fix it for you.

brh: اللہ ئے دوشکنہ امر تپرنے ہخس گیلونہ دروشکیس نی تڑالوس نی دیر درے نی داسہ نی داسہ نو چا چھٹاسنا نی اوہاری درے داسہ داسہ چپ کا کاٹم شیف کا
en: By God... how... you... now you, now you... take water... now, now be quiet, put your head down.
en_old: By God, you're complaining and cursing... you've been delayed, now you, now you... be quiet, lower your head.

brh: خلقو استے اینا دا سا گڈوک مسنے کارٹون تے تیرا مونی ئنا ایلوم گنوک متنے ہنی ہنی لگے دا بندغ دا سا نم پا سارٹوس ابا دا بندغ گنوک کس دا سا سارٹوس دماغ
en: People, look at this one: now he's gone dazed, cartoons are spinning before his eyes. His brother hasn't gone mad? It looks, it looks like this man... and now you say he's come to his senses? Father, this man is a madman; how is he in his senses now? His brain...
en_old: People, look at this one, his head is gone—cartoons are spinning in front of his eyes. Brother, he's gone mad; it seems this man... and you say he's gotten better? Father, this man is mad, who says he's recovered? His mind...

brh: خلق اوڑ کاٹم ئٹی خلٹی، مامودی کاٹم تٹی کہ خلٹی لگا، مبارک مرے نمے، کنا ایلم نی مبارک مرے، کنا ایلم سارٹ مس، دانا کہ کاٹم لگا
en: People, on his head, a blow! When the blow struck Mamodi's head... congratulations to you all! My brother, congratulations to you; my brother has come to his senses now that his head got hit.
en_old: People hit him on the head; when the slap landed on Mahmud's head—congratulations to you! My brother, congratulations to you, my brother has gotten better, now that he's been hit on the head.

brh: لٹی انو پدانہ کاٹم ہندا بس ہمے گڈاک داڑان ہنار دا پا پیندس موبائل ہرسے او پیسے نی موبائل ہرسی ہنت کے موبائل ہریوے ئے مگن او کسٹ کے موبائل ہریوے سیل
en: With a stick, like this, the back of the head, it came right here... those... went from here. Tell me, would you buy a mobile with some money? With that money you'd buy a mobile? Where would I buy a mobile? But... from whom would I buy a mobile... sell...
en_old: Now behind his head, right here... these kids go from here. Tell me, did he buy a mobile? With that money you bought a mobile? Where did you buy the mobile? But he... who did you buy the mobile from? Sell...

brh: اسکہ مشغول عجب جوان او تینا سنگارٹی ناگمان اچا نلکتہ شیشے لوڑتہ اسکہ مشغول عجب جوان او تینا سنگارٹی ناگمان اچا نلکتہ شیشے
en: Someone was busy, looking wonderfully lovely, doing her make-up; suddenly, all of a sudden, he pulled the glass out. Someone was busy, looking wonderfully lovely, doing her make-up; suddenly, all of a sudden, the glass...
en_old: Busy, wonderfully beautiful, in her adornment; suddenly a mirror shook and fell, looking... busy, wonderfully beautiful, in her adornment; suddenly a mirror shook and fell...

brh: دا لائن چلک اینٹنا کیچی بٹیوے غلام الدین چلوک تانکہ سدھت د سدھت ننے ملے نن تینک دا گڈ دس کس کس چلی تانکہ کاریم ننا مونا کائے کم کپیسے چلو نی دا پیری ننا لیازے ہمو سادے ہاتھ سو
en: This line is working... the antenna... Ghulam-ud-Din, the one who runs it, so that we get it directly; we ourselves... this... so that our work goes forward; don't you do less. Come on, you... this... our... that same...
en_old: This line goes... Ghulam-ud-Din goes so that we get... we ourselves... walk until the work comes before us; he does little work; go, you, this old man... our... the same simple hand...

brh: او ساڑھے آٹھ سو تو دستگیر بخن چھٹکینی ساڑھے آٹھ سو تو خدا خلیلی پاوا ہتی تین چار سو روپے مادی یکونیم سد نا جوڑے ساڑھے آٹھ سو روپیہ باوا کنا ہنا نی موری اینگا دنو چچی او بند یا اللہ
en: Oh, eight hundred and fifty then. Dastagir, the butter... eight hundred and fifty then, by God... three or four hundred rupees... a suit for a hundred and fifty, eight hundred and fifty rupees. Oh my father! ... you... O God.
en_old: Oh, eight hundred and fifty... Dastagir, look at the butter... eight hundred and fifty... Khuda Khalili says three or four hundred rupees, plus a hundred and fifty makes eight hundred and fifty rupees. Father, my... you... oh God, stop it.

brh: انت پاو نی ادی دا زیز مسوٹے خدا نا قسم ئے کل نا پچاتے آن فری موغاتے، ئے تو روچنگ خوار ولا بانہ کیرے کہ بجلی اف، آہا ئے دروغ، ماما نی دا خبر دے لک تو خلپے، دا سے بس ننا دے تنگ تینے تاکہ ننا ناپت ولین، ئنا پنکاتے تنگ۔
en: What can I say to you here... By God, everyone else's clothes have been sewn... and you keep making the excuse every day that there is no electricity. Ah, that's a lie. Uncle, you... this news...; this is just to give us trouble, so that our... our fans...
en_old: What are you saying, have you become this child's mother? By God, everything in the shop... he just keeps making the excuse that there's no electricity. That's a lie, uncle, you've taken this news and made it big; this is only to harass us so that our shop... our affairs are ruined.

brh: اچنی چونکنا نن ننے فغدوئے دین ہمو کنا نتس کنا پٹولنگے نا پلنگوس یا پانسی تے لنگوس کنا نی غوچادی پنکتے ملولونچ کیفتے تمے شلوار نا ڈبڑیوسے ول انت پاد کنے مخلوق پائے ماما کٹ

brh: بنمونا الپاپا بسم اللہ خنتانو ریچس استغفراللہ خوانیرے عباس واللہ کرے ئے او دے راٹو کانے ئے او راکا ئے واللہ آن گبرائنگٹٹ مچے گبرائنگانہ او گبرائنگا یا نی او او گبرائنگا ہا ئے تو ہمیشہ کرے انتسے شکاری بندہ کرے تفک توارے
en: ... In the name of God ... God forgive me. Read it, Abbas. By God, he did ... that day ... by God, I got scared. Did the fish get scared? Did he get scared, or you? He, he got scared, yes. So he always did ... what a hunter he is ... the gun made a sound.
en_old: ...Bismillah... astaghfirullah, you read it, Abbas. By God, he did it that day... he went... By God, everyone got frightened — was he frightened or were you? He was frightened, yes. So he always did this — what, a hunter fired a gun?

brh: ہمخا شکال گبرنگی کینتہ ابس داں اراداں اراداں موناٹ برابر بننگا سوار مسٹ کرے شیرو جی پٹ چنا تو دا مچے چپاٹ بس کدارا ٹائم کائیکک تئی ظالم دون چپاٹ ٹوار شیشاٹ خلکوٹ سے
en: That much ... got scared ... until now ... coming straight on in front ... I had got on, Shero ji [was on] the ground ... then this fish [gave] a slap ... just ... time ... oh, the brute, such a slap, such a sound; I hit it with the glass ...
en_old: That much hunting... until now, directly in front, level... he had mounted, Shero ji sat on the ground, so this fish... just... time... oh tyrant, ... a voice... in the glass...

brh: اچھا گڑا شیکو ولانت مس؟ واللہ وئی مچے ایتھے دو ٹیرفیس ئس دو ٹیرسٹرینگ بس چوٹوراغا مچے سل کرے ٹک بس خات تدانگینگ گڑا ننا بخش
en: Okay, so then what happened? By God, ... the fish here ... two ... just ... the fish ... just ... then our share.
en_old: Okay, so what happened then? By God, all of it here... just... everything got ruined, just... so forgive us.

brh: نم کسر آ پاچو ممائی دان ٹی خسان۔ جی او سر۔ تو درک، درو ئے مرا سبق سکھانٹ انگلش نا، ٹوئنٹی ٹو مہنا نا ٹیوٹوریل۔ اگر نم سرپد مفرے، ننا ایئر تھرٹی ڈی نا نصیحت نا پڑ مفرے ننا گرامر۔ تو نی بر، نی بشا۔
en: You (all) on the way ... — Yes, sir. — So note: yesterday I taught a lesson in English, the twenty-two-month tutorial. If you don't understand, ... our 'year thirty-D' advice ... our grammar. So you come, you get up.
en_old: You'll get stuck in this along the way. Yes sir. So look, I taught you a lesson in English, a twenty-two-month tutorial. If you don't understand, if you don't follow our year-thirty-D advice, our grammar... then you come, you go.

brh: شاباش شاباش شاباش ماشاءاللہ باز امپروو کرینے موسٹ ویلکم
en: Well done, well done, well done, mashallah, [this one] has improved a lot. Most welcome.
en_old: Well done, well done, well done, mashallah, you have improved a lot. You're most welcome.

brh: اگر نا یاد برے ارا وقتی بس ارا وقتی ہنا ئے بے سے نا مطلب آ شاباش۔ اسٹوڈنٹ آک ہینو گڑا کل اسٹوڈنٹ آک بسونے کل اخاص کیرے او رینو علم نا ٹوپا منا خاص ہوئیٹ کے با انتئے دا ئے تو توجہ نمو انشاءاللہ مستقبل بہتر مرو اگر نصیحت پی
en: If you remember, whenever, just whenever ... the meaning of ABC ... well done. Students, today then: all the students have come; you all ... and ... the cap of knowledge ... why? ... Pay attention to this; God willing, the future will be better if [you heed] the advice ...
en_old: If you remember, sometimes... sometimes it's this... what does it mean? Well done. Students, today — all the students have come, everyone pays attention; they... the cap of knowledge... why is that? So pay attention, inshallah the future will be better if you take the advice.

brh: کنا عمل کے غوارے اگر کپے تو اینو ما مرے تو لیکن کنا یقین اینو کے پڑھائی نا باروٹ علم باز بلو گراس سے سئی نا علم نا وجہ نی انسان آسمان تے سر مسے علم نا وجہ نی انسان زمین نی چھانز کر
en: Whether you want to act on what I say: if you don't, then today ... But my conviction today is that, as regards studies, knowledge is a very big thing, right? Because of knowledge man has reached the skies; because of knowledge man has searched through the earth.
en_old: If you don't act on what I say, then today... but my firm belief today is that, as regards education, knowledge is a very great thing. Because of knowledge man has reached the skies; because of knowledge man has explored the earth.

brh: اور علم نا بدولت، علم نا وجہ اٹ انسان مارس، جوپیٹر، ارتھ، اور دافن مونا مختلف سیارات اسکان رسینگانے۔ و دافتے چکاسنگانے۔ دا علم نا بدولت، دا علم نا بدولت انسان انسان جوڑ مسنے۔ اگر علم مف تو انسان انسان مف۔
en: And thanks to knowledge, because of knowledge, man has reached Mars, Jupiter, Earth and the various planets beyond these, and has examined them. Thanks to this knowledge, thanks to this knowledge, man has become human. If there were no knowledge, man would not be human.
en_old: And thanks to knowledge, because of knowledge, man has reached Mars, Jupiter, Earth, and the various planets beyond them, and has examined them. Thanks to this knowledge, thanks to this knowledge, man has become human. If there were no knowledge, man would not be man.

brh: نم کسر مروک آ صلعم نا مکھورے، پائے اگر نمے تعلیم حاصل کننگ کے چین ئے الوئے برے، ہمبو۔ ئے وخت آ چین من باز مور ئس، ٹرانسپورٹ نا سسٹم الوکا، تو دا مقصد دادے کہ تعلیم باز اہم ئے
en: The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'If you have to go to China to acquire education, go.' At that time China was very far away; there was no transport system. So the point is this: education is very important.
en_old: You who are on the way... the Prophet (PBUH) said: if you have to go to China to acquire education, go. At that time China was very far, there was no transport system, so this means that education is very important.

brh: آج جس پہ ہرا وقت کہ نا حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پہ پہلا وحی نازل مس اقرا۔ تو دانا مچٹو معنی مفہوم ہربو اقرا مینز انت؟ پڑھو یعنی خوان بو۔ یعنی خواننگ داخہ اہمیت تخک کہ پہلا وحی حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نا
en: Today ... at the time when the first revelation, 'Iqra', came down to Hazrat Muhammad (peace be upon him). So look a little at its meaning and sense: what does 'Iqra' mean? 'Parho', that is, read. That is, reading holds so much importance that the first revelation of Hazrat Muhammad (peace be upon him) ...
en_old: Today... when the first revelation came down to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him): Iqra. So look at its full meaning — what does Iqra mean? Parho, that is, read. That is, reading holds such importance that the first revelation to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)...

brh: زینا دے مسئلہ ء خواننگ نا باروٹ۔ تو باہر کنے خوانف، اسہ چلو مگت کے کے، کنے ایلو تے خوانف، زینب کن رشتہ دار تے خوانف، پین نا مسائت خوانف، مقصد علم اٹ شرم اف، چنکی بلنی ابدال تے، علم حاصل کبو، علم حاصل کبو علم اٹ نا سامباہی کن، علم حاصل کبو علم اٹ نا سیوا کن
en: ... the issue regarding studying. So teach outside ..., teach the others, teach Zainab's relatives, teach in other people's mosques; the point is, there is no shame in knowledge. Young and old ..., acquire knowledge; acquire knowledge for the safeguarding of knowledge, acquire knowledge for the service of knowledge.
en_old: Yesterday's issue was about studying. So, 'I won't study outside, ... I won't study with the others, I won't study with Zainab's relatives, I won't study at someone else's' — the point is, there is no shame in knowledge. Young and old alike, acquire knowledge; acquire knowledge for safeguarding through knowledge, acquire knowledge for serving through knowledge.

brh: ایشن تہذیب ئس جوڑ مرے، علم حاصل کیرے تو تاریخ نا پٹ سے کیرے، اگر علم حاصل کیرے نی تاریخ نا بروکا قوم آتیا یاد کرو تا، تپلانٹو قوم آتیا، دا صرف اور صرف علم نا وجہ اٹ، علم نا وجہ نی استاد نما پاک
en: A civilization is built [this way]. If you acquire knowledge, you research history; if you acquire knowledge, the nations to come in history will remember you ... nations. This is only and only because of knowledge; because of knowledge the teacher tells you:
en_old: A civilization is built; if you acquire knowledge you create a page of history; if you acquire knowledge you will remember the nations that have passed in history, the lost nations. This is only and only because of knowledge; because of knowledge the teacher tells you.

brh: باوا علم نا بچہ علم نی پائے بغیر علم نا انسان کورے خنپک مقصد ہما اگر جاگہ سے گڑاس لکھوکے خوانے کپے تو نی محتاج اسے نا دوئی لیسے پاسے دا علم دا بیرے خوانے تو داڑے نی محتاج کیپیرے بغیر ارا
en: 'Dear, child of knowledge ...' — about knowledge, he says: a person without knowledge is blind; he cannot see. The point is, if something is written somewhere and you cannot read it, then you are dependent: you will go to someone and say, 'Read this.' [But] if you have this knowledge and have studied, then here you will not be dependent, without ...
en_old: Father, the child of knowledge is knowledge — you say that without knowledge a person is blind, cannot see. The point is, if something is written somewhere and you cannot read it, then you are dependent on someone; you'll take it and say, 'read this to me.' But if you have studied, then there you won't be dependent, without...

brh: تعلیم اف دن پائے محتاج کیک، جہالت انسانیت نا دن پائے محتاج کیک، تو علم نی خانے تک، نی کسے محتاج مفیسہ، اینو پگا جدید دور ئے کمپیوٹر نا دور ئے سائنس و ٹیکنالوجی نا دور ئے دا ریس
en: Lack of education, as they say, makes one dependent; ignorance, as they say, makes humanity dependent. So if you have knowledge, you will not be dependent on anyone. Nowadays it is the modern era, the era of computers, the era of science and technology; this race ...
en_old: Lack of education makes a person dependent; ignorance makes humanity dependent. So if you have knowledge, you won't be dependent on anyone. Today, tomorrow — it is the modern age, the age of computers, the age of science and technology; this is the race...

brh: دا ترے سنگت دا دور اٹی، بائے دننو، ایسارٹی، بائے دننو مونا کین، بائے دننو کین، مروک نسلہ کہ سیب، نسلہ استومانی، عمل کیرے انشااللہ، انشااللہ
en: In this era, friends, ... we must go on like this ... we must go forward like this, we must go on; the coming generation ..., the generation ..., [if] you act [on it], God willing, God willing.
en_old: These three friends in this era... go forward, go ahead, go on; the coming generation, the next generation, act on it, inshallah, inshallah.

brh: صحیح ہی عمل کبو تانزی اور سوچ کبو، انشاءاللہ ننا
en: Act rightly, and think; God willing, our ...
en_old: Act rightly and think properly, inshallah our...

brh: علی اینو اینو پگامرے خوانے نا؟ زبردست ماشاءاللہ دا سال نا بدولت مالے خوانے ئے بے سے لکھنگ بسونے ئے بے سے بسونے ریڈنگ بسونے رائٹنگ بسونے دا سال نا بدولت ماشاءاللہ باز گڑاس ہیت کرینے۔ اچھا ماشاءاللہ
en: Ali, today, today ... tomorrow ... he is studying, right? Great, mashallah. Thanks to this year he has studied: he has learned to write ABC, ABC has come to him, reading has come, writing has come. Thanks to this year, mashallah, he has learned many things. All right, mashallah.
en_old: Ali, today — what will tomorrow be for your studies? Great, mashallah. Thanks to this year you did study; you learned writing, you learned reading, you learned writing; thanks to this year, mashallah, you learned many things. Okay, mashallah.

brh: اور ہمس رزلٹ نا ماشاءاللہ فرسٹ پوزیشن مسنے ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ دا کل نا سر نا بدولت ئے انشاءاللہ اسنا مستقبل ئس جوان و برائٹ مرے
en: And in that result, mashallah, he got first position, mashallah, mashallah. This is all thanks to sir. God willing, may his future be good and bright.
en_old: And he, mashallah, got first position in the results, mashallah, mashallah. This is all thanks to the sir. Inshallah his future will be good and bright.

brh: جوڑ برابرس جوڑس؟ الحمدللہ سر دعا ہی نم جوڑو، وراٹھی خیر خیریت ئے شکر اللہ نا، سمیع نب، او، ایہہ تمبک پئے نا، نا جوڑ مسٹ، ہمو سے نا ڈاسکر کراچی آ۔
en: Are you well, all right, well? — Praise God, sir, by [your] prayers we are well; at home all is well, thanks be to God. Sami ... oh ... he got well; that one's doctor is in Karachi.
en_old: Are you well, all right? Alhamdulillah sir, by your prayers we are fine, everything is well, thanks to God. Sami... oh, that one got well; that one's doctor is in Karachi.

brh: جونید آ سر؟ جی او سر انت مسنے سر؟ انت متوکا دا ٹی وی پارہ دا بلا دا بیماری ئنا سر ٹی وی ٹی وی ٹی وی جی او سر بس ئنا وجہ آن مجبورا بند مسٹ سینہ آن دا سم مچٹ سے جک توورے بس کورس مننگے بس دعا کر سر
en: Junaid, sir? Yes, sir. What has happened, sir? What hasn't happened! This TB, you could say, this curse, this disease, sir — TB, TB, TB. Yes, sir, it's just because of it that he was forced to stop. From his chest now there is a bit of a cough [unclear]; the course of treatment is just going on. Just pray, sir.
en_old: Junaid, sir? Yes sir. What happened, sir? What happened to it — this TV, say, this plague, this illness, sir, TV, TV, TV. Yes sir, just because of it, it was forced to close; since then this... just the course... just pray, sir.

brh: مختک تور مامہ سنوں طبیب کا سورینو پگہ داسہ کرک تو بندہ لوٹیرا سے خالق سر نینت پاسا سر ایچ تپاسا واللہ بڈ پیسہ کنے اندرینو ایچ فائدہ فک دواک تا نقلی روپے خبر فنتو ارش گونی گونی دوایئے تیرا
en: [unclear] ...uncle... we've been to doctors [unclear]; tomorrow, now he does [it], so they want a person... Khaliq sir, what do you say? Sir, they say nothing. By God, I've spent loads of money, and there's no benefit at all. Their medicines are fake; the money — who knows; they give out medicine by the sackful.
en_old: ...uncle... the physician... tomorrow, now he does it, so a person... the Creator, sir... by God, I spent a lot of money, there was no benefit at all; the medicines are fake, the money... they gave medicine...

brh: واللہ سر داخس دوائی او کنا ورا مچ دوائی ہم ہورے او آوا دے ٹرسٹ ایتک توبہ مزن علی نا حوالے تمن علی علی سر باز ماشاءاللہ جوان ئے اسل خو
en: By God, sir, so much medicine — at my house even a little medicine is also [unclear]; the trust gives it [unclear]. God forbid. As for the elder Ali — Ali, sir, mashallah, is very good, truly.
en_old: By God, sir, so much medicine — he didn't even take his medicine along with me; he put his trust in that one... by God, Mazan Ali's... handed over to Ali. Ali, sir, is very good, mashallah, truly.

brh: ماننگ تدو جوانی کے آن پاس اول شرارت کرے کا وراٹی تنگ کرے کا ہمسایہ تے گلی انچی داسہ ماشاءاللہ باز جوان مسوئے سردار دا بس کل نما محنت نا واجہ نا نا نا نا
en: Before, in his younger days, he used to make mischief at first, he used to cause trouble at home, the neighbours, the street, like that. Now, mashallah, he has become very good, sir. This is all just thanks to your hard work, sir. — No, no, no, no.
en_old: From the very start of his youth he used to make mischief, he used to hang around in the street with the neighbors; now, mashallah, he has become very good, Sardar. This is all thanks to your hard work, sir. No, no, no, no.

brh: بالکل ننا، دا ننا فرض ئے ہر اسٹوڈنٹ نا ننا تربیت تے تینا پان نا، دا ننا فرض ئے دا ہر ٹیچر نا فرض ئے باید است تینا فرض چائے، باز استاد تے ننا معلوم ئے کار ئے بس کلاس ئے ہلیرہ ننا خیر ئے تو گپ ئے تو کسو ئے لکھنا تے ننا تینا محنت کے، دا ٹیچر نا فرض ئے
en: Absolutely, it's ours. This is our duty; raising every student is our job, on our own part. This is our duty, it is every teacher's duty; one must know one's duty by heart. As we know, for many teachers the job is just to take the class; for them it's fine whether it's chit-chat or whatever writing. But we put in our own effort. This is the teacher's duty.
en_old: Absolutely, it is ours — it is our duty, for every student, to train them, our own word; it is our duty, it is every teacher's duty, they must know their duty. We know many teachers who just go to class, say good things, chat, write something — that's our own effort; this is the teacher's duty.

brh: او رے داسہ بشخا ہرا تکیت کہ بگ مست ہرا تکیت کہ بگ مست بس او داسہ ہچ شرارے تکا او تفنگ چیدی نی دے پرغیوادے چھینٹ دے پرغیوادے چھینٹ دے پارے کہ وطن ننے جی او داسہ بس سو بنلے شام ئس کو بس او
en: Oh, now [God] has granted [it]... the one who [unclear], the one who [unclear]. Now he doesn't get up to any mischief at all. He [used to go about with] a gun, [saying] 'I'll break you that day... I'll break...', he said 'the homeland is ours'. Yes, now he's just [at it] from morning till evening, just that.
en_old: Hey, now forgive me... the one who got out of the bag... just now, no mischief at all... the gun... you'll break the day, broke the day, said the homeland is ours, yes... now just a hundred... one evening... just that.

brh: او دے ہمو کتاب ئس پاش خوانداس باز جوان مس۔ بس مت چکر مکر پا دو خلپہ۔ نہ دا سوڑا ٹی پورا دے مرے گا پورا ولاتی تنگ خپہ کا۔ بس دا اول باز جوان مس سر بس ئے ہس نما منت واری کیو خدا ہمے کسء احسان احسان۔
en: These days he reads that book; he has become very good. He doesn't go wandering about at all anymore. Nor does he stay out in this street the whole day, or bother the whole neighbourhood. He has become very good, first [in class], sir. I'll just be grateful to you — God... this kindness, this kindness.
en_old: That day he read a book and it went very well. Just don't go roaming around. Don't spend the whole day sitting in the lanes, don't keep wandering the whole day. At first this went very well, sir. I'll just be grateful to you, by God, this kindness, this kindness.

brh: بس بس بس باید مزید ہم محنت کینہ انشاء اللہ کوشش پین کینہ کوشش برجا تخینہ مزید دا سہی کا او سہی پیزند مت کینم کین انشاء اللہ سر دے
en: That's enough, enough, enough. We must work even harder; God willing, we will make more effort and keep up the effort, so that this goes right and becomes right [unclear] — we'll do it, God willing, sir.
en_old: Okay, okay, we'll have to work even harder; God willing, we'll try again, we'll keep up the effort. If this one is right, then it's right; we'll pick the right one, God willing, sir.

brh: کسہ کریڑ ارتے نی کسس مخولی پابو کسس کٹ کٹورا کنے پابو کسس بدمعاشی کرے
en: Is there anyone [unclear]? You — go on, call someone a joker, call me 'kat katora', [say] someone has been acting the thug!
en_old: Someone has done it — don't call anyone a joker, don't call anyone 'kat katora', someone has been doing thuggery.

brh: پابو کنے پابو، ہنن سادکئے اندا رے، دا پورے شہر اٹی بدمعاشی اوٹ، ہر کس کنے خلیکٹ، یار انو چپ تو تو ننا کٹ بدمعاشی کیک، یار شیخو موبائل ء دے زرے دے
en: Say it, say it to me! [You take me for] a simpleton like that, eh? In this whole city I am the thug; everyone is afraid of me. — Man, today [keep] quiet, you... he's playing the thug with us. — Man, Sheikho, give [me] the mobile, give the money!
en_old: Say it, say it to me, that's enough now; I'm the thug of this whole city, everyone is afraid of me. Friend, be quiet, you're talking big thuggery to us. Friend, Sheikhu, give me the mobile.

en: Oh man, the tea-seller's (son) was studying, with his bags and books; we used to study at our tuition.
en_old: Oh you, father, the tea-seller's son is studying, with the bags and the books; he goes to our tuition to study.

brh: اینو دا اور حالتینا روڈ ئنا کر آ تموک دنیا دا کار کر ئے بیش ریڈی والا درنگینگ نن ئے آ بیٹ کک صفا خدا کے منن مسے حالت ئس مست ئے ماسٹر ئس نن ئے آ محنت کرے کا ہمو مار ئے اینو اینا خوانا خدا چائے دے چاڑے سرمس
en: Today, in this condition, lying at the side of the road... the world, the cars, even the donkey-cart man... us... completely... God... we've fallen into such a state. A master worked hard on us; that boy studied, and today God knows where he has reached.
en_old: Now, in this condition, sitting by the side of the road, the whole world, this car, the one with ready cash drives it and beats us; it is a condition that God has brought about; a master worked hard on us; that boy is studying now, God knows where he has reached.

brh: بابا کنا حالت ء خننگ ئس تینٹ۔ خدا غا داسہ چرس نا سے منٹ ئس مفن۔ شراب کننگ آن
en: Baba, see my condition for yourself. By God, now we can't go even a few minutes without hashish. And from drinking liquor...
en_old: Father, look at my condition yourself. By God, now there isn't even a bit of hashish. From drinking liquor...

brh: گڈز ایون کرسٹل ہمو ٹیم اتنا ہمے بے چارینگ کہ استاد نا قدری کروسنو اینو ننا دا حالت متویکہ۔ داسہ ننے تینا سما اف انت ایتس کین خبر اف انت پاننگٹ ننا جندے درک لگپک۔ اگر زندگی ٹی ننے کامیاب خواری
en: ...even crystal... back then, we poor wretches: if we had valued the teacher, our condition today would not be like this. Now we have no awareness of ourselves; we don't know what we're doing, we don't know what we're saying, we aren't even aware of it ourselves. If you want to be successful in life,
en_old: Guys, even crystal (ice)... that same team of ours, we poor ones, if we had valued our teacher, now this wouldn't have been our condition. Now we have no awareness of ourselves, we don't know what we eat, what we say, we don't even realize it ourselves. If we want to succeed in life...

brh: ہمو تینا استاد نا قدر ء کبو، او لمہ باوہ نا نصیحت آ عمل کبو، دا دا زند ئس ء، ہچ تپہ نمت کین، ہمو شاعر بیچارہ پارے، ننے نن پو متہ وین، ایٹم ء خوارانہ پریکا
en: value your teacher, and act on your mother and father's advice. This, this is life... That poor poet said it, but we didn't understand... he used to say.
en_old: Value your teacher, act upon the advice of your mother and father, this is what life is, you will find nothing else; that poor poet says it, we didn't understand it, they used to say time is passing.

brh: استاد کے عظمت کو ترازو مین نہ تولو، استاد تو ہر دور مین انمول رہا ہی نن پماتون ننا دا زندگی
en: 'Do not weigh the greatness of the teacher on a scale; the teacher has been priceless in every age.' We didn't understand; this life of ours...
en_old: Do not weigh the greatness of a teacher on a scale; the teacher has been priceless in every era. We did not understand; this life of ours...

brh: السلام علیکم، وعلیکم السلام، منت وار، بھلا سیٹ جوڑ رے، ٹھیک ٹھاک رے، خیر خیریت رے، جان ئس ساذ اسنے، اللہ پاک نا احسان، او ساذ اسنے، تھینکس رے، شکر ئے شکر ئے جیو جیو، ساذ ساذ، جیو
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Thank you. Are you well and fine? All right? All good? Is your health well? By the grace of Allah Almighty. And are you well? Thanks. Thank God, thank God. Bless you, bless you. Well, well. Bless you.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Thank you, is everything well? Everything fine? All well? Is the family fine? By the grace of Allah Almighty. Oh, are they well? Thanks. Thanks be to God, thanks be to God, bless you, bless you, well, well, bless you.

brh: او چھورما چاماں، سبی تا روان تٹ
en: Hey boys... I'm off to Sibi.
en_old: Oh boys, hey, let's go to Sibi.

brh: خیر خیرے دا بندغے درست کیرے
en: Well, well, do you recognize this man?
en_old: Well, well, you will set this person right.

brh: ادا تولوک سگریٹ کشنگے نا چرسی۔ سر دا پیر مسونو۔ سر دا ہمو اسٹوڈنٹ علی نن تو خوانا کسے جا سر دا اسور کلاس نی تو بدتمیزی کرے۔ ہا علی۔ جی او سر دا ہمو بندہ ہی
en: Sitting here smoking a cigarette, the hashish addict. Sir, he has aged. Sir, this is that student Ali who studied with us, sir; he was the one in class who was rude to you. Yes, Ali. Yes sir, this is that same person.
en_old: Hey, you're smoking a cigarette, you hashish addict. Sir, this one has become an old man. Sir, this is that student Ali, we studied together somewhere; sir, this one used to misbehave in class. Yes, Ali. Yes sir, this is that same person.

brh: سخت افسوس یار، باوا یار سخت افسوس، دا وڑ نا نشہ شروع کرینے، یار صاحب دا وڑ نا نشہ ئے فیل کتوٹ، دا خیر کے نیتینے اور ماشاءاللہ راٹ سر مزہ ایم فل کننگو صاحب نشہ کننگے یار، اینی ہمو
en: Very sad, man; really, man, very sad. He has started this kind of drug habit. Man, sir, I never imagined this kind of addiction... and mashallah, sir, (the other one) is doing an M.Phil while this gentleman is doing drugs, man. Now that...
en_old: Deep regret, man; father, man, deep regret; he has started this kind of intoxication; man, sahib, I had never felt this kind of intoxication; what a fine thing he has taken up, and mashaAllah, sir, he is doing an M.Phil and sahib is taking drugs, man, this one...

brh: دا وخت جوان ئس جوان اسس، محنت کریسا، دا ہمو وخت مچے اللہ خیر کے تندار، دنیا، ایدا دنیا ٹی جواننگا بریرہ سلیرا، اوست اٹی خرابنگا بریرہ، پیست سل پاسہ، دا دنیا ٹی جواننگا بریرہ اور خرابنگا
en: That time was good, it was good; he worked hard. That was that time... may Allah keep him well... the world: in this world good people come and stay, and among them bad people come too... in this world good people come, and bad ones too.
en_old: That time was good, it was good, we worked hard; may Allah keep well that whole time; the world, in this world the good ones come and go, and in it the bad ones come, go and stay; in this world the good ones come and the bad ones...

brh: اللہ خیر کیک پنتان، اللہ خیر، چنا جاننے ک برکان مولی، اللہ خیر کیک، اللہ خیر راستی
en: May Allah do good... may Allah grant good. Child, dear, may blessings come, Lord. May Allah do good; truly, may Allah grant good.
