en_old: Believe me, God knows there is goodness in my heart, but sometimes a person is so helpless that he has to say yes to every decision.

brh: اینو ئے ہمداخس مجبور اٹ کہ کنے دا فیصلہ نا مونا ہو کروئی تمک۔ تینا لمہ باوہ نا فیصلے رد کروئی تمتو۔ فیضان نی خبرے کہ اوفتہ است آ خشت پیو۔
en: Today I am so helpless that I have to say yes to this decision. I could not reject my own mother and father's decision. Faizan, you know it would have come down on their hearts like a brick.
en_old: Today I am so helpless that I have to say yes to this decision. I couldn't reject my parents' decision. Faizan, you know it would have broken their hearts.

brh: نی کسے سے نا استے پین؟ دا سدا ٹھپاتے کنے و نیم مچا زند ہلوئی تمک۔
en: Would you [break] someone's heart? You and I will have to carry these wounds forever, all our lives.
en_old: Will you break someone's heart? You and I will have to carry these scars our whole lives.

brh: کنا مسڑ، کنے معاف کیس، معاف کیس
en: My daughter, forgive me, forgive me.
en_old: My daughter, forgive me, forgive me.

brh: مریم بس کہ مریم بس کہ ایلو پیشن مخلوق ء انتظار کریر ہلک
en: Maryam, enough, Maryam, enough. The other people outside are waiting; take [her].
en_old: Maryam, that's enough, Maryam, that's enough, the people outside are waiting, come on.

brh: امو سورتینا باوہ
en: That same face... her own father.
en_old: That's your father.

brh: اوئے معاف کیس، استٹ معاف کیس کنے، کنے صبر ایت خدا، رخصت ئے رخصت ئے
en: Forgive him, forgive me from your heart. God, give me patience. Farewell, farewell.
en_old: Forgive him, forgive me from your heart. God, give me patience. Goodbye, goodbye.

brh: مجبور اسوٹے کنا وسٹ ہچ مننگ متو
en: I was helpless; nothing could be done that was in my power.
en_old: I was helpless, nothing was in my control.

brh: تینا خیال ء کیس، تینا خیال ء کیس، اللہ مہربان ء
en: Take care of yourself, take care of yourself. God is merciful.
en_old: Take care of yourself, take care of yourself, God is merciful.

brh: زینت نا باوہ تئی زکا نا مسٹ تو ننت کرو انت مروئی
en: Zeenat's father, [unclear: 'tai zaka na mast'], then what will we do? What is going to happen?
en_old: Zeenat's father became your... so what shall we do, what will happen?

brh: جوانا نا سوچک کپیس مریم نن تینا مسولے فخر شاغم
en: Don't think such thoughts, Maryam. We will be proud of our daughter.
en_old: Don't think such thoughts, Maryam. We will be proud of our daughter.

brh: بس گیرہب کتے بس گیرہب کتے ہمار گیرہب ہمار گیرہب
en: Enough crying, enough crying. Don't cry, don't cry.
en_old: Just don't cry, just don't cry, don't cry, don't cry.

brh: او دے کنا او دے تینا دو اٹ خاخر اٹ شاغا او تو شنگے مچا زند نا موڑ تو شنگے بس کر امو کنا گولی چٹو
en: Her, my [daughter]: he threw her into the fire with his own hands, and then [...] her whole life's turn [...] Enough, stop it! Those pills of mine...
en_old: With his own hands he threw her into... and then her whole life's... Enough, stop it, my bullet...

brh: مائن تنے ایٹ ئے بابائے فون کریٹ او داسے سر مریک بشہ پالٹ کن۔ نا کنا ئس کشی پک۔ دوا کنوئے نی بشہ پالٹ کن۔ نا نا ئے چس کمپرو۔ تو ٹھیک ہی
en: Mother, I've phoned Dad; he'll get here any moment now. You [lie down?]. [unclear] You have to take your medicine. You [lie down?]. [unclear] Okay then.
en_old: Look, I told you I called Dad, he'll get here soon. I'll give the medicine; you just... Okay then.

brh: گڑا آرام کرک
en: Then rest.
en_old: Then rest.

brh: ہیلو
en: Hello.
en_old: Hello.

brh: ہیلو اللہ اماں، ئے مرید، مرید کنا ساہ امر اسنے؟ اماں، ئے جوان اٹ، بس مائی نا طبیعت جوان اف۔ زرس اماں تون ہیت کننگ خواہی، اودے اماں
en: Hello, Mother? It's me, Murid. Murid, my dear, how are you? Mother, I'm fine; it's just that Mai isn't well. Would you like to talk to Mother for a bit? Here, Mother.
en_old: Hello, Mother. Yes, Murid, Murid my dear, how are you? Mother, yes, I'm fine, it's just that Mother isn't feeling well. Please talk to Mother a little, give it to her, Mother.

brh: کنا سا او داڑے افو او ننے آن باز مرے نانے ارانگے ننے ولہ امہ باز مرے نانے
en: My dear, he isn't here; he is very far from us. Where are you? You are also very far from us.
en_old: My dear, he isn't here, he misses us a lot. Where are you? We miss you a lot too.

brh: او داسہ نم تون ہیتم کننگ کپرو، اخہ درنگ اینانی، ہیلو، ہیلو، ہیلو
en: He can't talk to you right now. No, [wait a moment]... hello, hello, hello.
en_old: He can't talk to you right now, no, wait a moment. Hello, hello, hello.

brh: انمس خبر اف فون ء بند کرے۔ انپارے کہ بلہ اما
en: I don't know, he hung up the phone. What did he say, Grandma... Mother?
en_old: I don't know, he hung up the phone. He said, "Okay, Mother."

brh: پاریکہ کہ نما اما باز مرینا نی باز مر؟ انت مطلب؟ دے چا فون ء بند کرے۔
en: He said, 'Your mother is very far away; are you very far away?' What does that mean? And then he hung up the phone.
en_old: She said, "Your mother misses you a lot, do you miss her a lot?" What does that mean? Look, she hung up the phone.

brh: الئی ثنا وان سکس فون کننگ اٹی ئس اسہ ارا سے نا تباہ کریس نا دوان مار کنا جیل آئی نا مسل نا کنا زندے برباد کریس دوزخ جوڑ کریس
en: Sana, [why] are you calling? You destroyed a home. Because of you, my son [went] to jail [...]. You ruined my life, you turned it into hell.
en_old: Sana, you are still calling... you destroyed someone... you ruined my life, you made it hell.

brh: دنیا ٹی رسوا کریس کنے، دا سوانت مطلب اینا؟ ہرانگے ننے الا، نانتس؟ نانتس کنے داڑے فون کننگ اٹی ئس ننے تو اسہ سیالی اسہ سسہ کے اودے ختم کریس، دا سوال دا نی کہ کنے داڑے فون کریس؟
en: You disgraced me in front of the world. What is the meaning of this? Where has it left us? What is it? What is it you want, calling me here? We had a relationship, and you ended it. So the question is, why have you called me here?
en_old: You disgraced me in front of the world. What does this mean? Where are you taking us? Why? Why are you calling me here? We had a relationship and you ended it. The question is, why did you call me here?

brh: فون کننگ نا ضرورت افک نا باز مہربانی ہیلو
en: There's no need to call. Thank you very much. Hello?
en_old: There's no need to call, thank you very much. Hello.

brh: سنگت کنا جتامس سنگت کنا جتامس
en: My friend has become separated from me, my friend has become separated from me.
en_old: My friend, my separation; my friend, my separation.

brh: زاہد بس بابا اینو دم درینگٹ کنیا پین مونی بننگ مفک کمال کیسر دا خزو دم درینگس دے تو داسہ کن توار مچا زین قدم تے قدم تے خوئیے بلے نم قدما تے دا خزو
en: Zahid, enough, dear. Today I'm exhausted; I can't go any further forward. You've done wonders [...] you're exhausted. Look, now [...] call [...] the steps, the steps [...] but you [...] the steps [...]
en_old: Zahid came. Father, today I'm worn out, I can't go any further. You did wonders, you're tired out today. Now... the steps, take the steps.

brh: نم بیمانی تے خپبو کہ پدی سروگ مریر نمے کنا خیال تے خوئی مریک زندے یک جاگہ گدریفنگ نا وعدہ ء کینٹ اٹ تینے وخت ئس ہم تنے
en: Don't commit betrayals that later become [unclear]. You should care about my feelings. I have promised to spend my life together [with you] in one place. Give yourself some time too.
en_old: Don't you see the sick, that they get well afterwards? You should care about my feelings. I promised to spend my life together; give yourself some time too.

brh: خیال کپس فقط نا عشق نا دیوانہ اٹ تراز نی انچاؤس ہمو مریام دا عشق نا آغاز نی انچاؤس انمس شریف و سیال و دوستا
en: Don't think [otherwise]: I am crazy only for your love. [unclear] you [...] that same Maryam. This beginning of love, you [...] noble, and kin, and a friend.
en_old: Don't think it's only that I'm crazy in love with you. How are you? This is the beginning of love. How are you? I'm noble, a relative and a friend.

brh: گل اسے کونڈان پنیگان ارے نادان کن کے نی دیروس تینا اعزازے انچاؤس۔ نی تو ماشاءاللہ شاعری؟ جی جناب شاعری تو نزائفہ مچے باز رنگ تو ارپوٹی انتء
en: A flower [plucked?] from a hollow [...] ignorant [...] you [...] your own honour [...]. So you write poetry, mashallah? Yes sir, as for poetry, I don't really [know it], but it has many shades.
en_old: A flower has been picked from a branch. Who are you to me, that you take your honor like this? Mashallah, poetry from you? Yes sir, I don't know much about poetry, but I do have many colors.

brh: او تان دا خاشو کے کے دا ورا ایلو۔ نہ ثناء اللہ نی غلط سوچ کینگ اٹی ئس کسس تینا ہورا ایو تینا چنا
en: [unclear] this [...] the other. No, Sanaullah, you are thinking about it wrongly. Someone [...] their own, their own child.
en_old: ...No, Sanaullah, you are thinking wrong. Someone left their own... their own child.

brh: دے تونے لنگا پک، او پدا نیتو اودے تینا ہراغان بے عزت کریس کشاس، اونا چنا تے پلاس، داسا نا اونا تون ہچو تعلق ئس اف
en: [unclear: 'the days with you...'], and then you yourself disgraced her, threw her out of your own house and took her children away from her. Now you have no relationship with her at all.
en_old: The day passed with you, and then you insulted her and threw her out, you took her children away. Now she has no relationship with you at all.

brh: پرسنہ۔ کسہ سینہ زیاتون شک کننگ جوان اف۔ داسہ ہم نیتو وخت ارے۔ اگہ نی تینا او تینا چناتا زند جوان کننگ خواسہ تو۔
en: ... Being overly suspicious of someone is not good. Even now you still have time, if you want to make your own life and your children's lives good.
en_old: Listen. Being too suspicious isn't good. You still have time, if you want to make your life and your children's lives better.

brh: برامس کر نا کل پریشانی ختم مریرہ کنا تو نی ہندا سلاہ ایلوم بابا نا فون
en: "Get married and all your worries will be over" - you give me this same advice, brother. It's Father's phone call.
en_old: If I marry, all my worries will be over. You're the one who gave me this advice. It's Father's call.

brh: دیرے؟ بلا مائی نی تویت کنے خائیکو۔ ئے زرس دا فون اٹینڈ کیو۔ او
en: Who is it? Grandma, you ... me. Hey, let me answer this phone for a moment. Oh.
en_old: Who is it? Okay, Mother, you were waiting for me. Yes, please answer this phone call. Oh.

brh: جی او جوانٹ جی او جی بھلا مت دا بات نیت کے
en: Yes, she's fine. Yes, yes... well, this matter ...
en_old: Yes, he is fine, yes, yes, may God keep him well, may he make this matter right.

brh: ہیلو ہاں نمے دا خاطر آن تکلیف تسوٹ کہ زینت نا گڑا سرٹیفکیٹ شناختی کارڈ ہموڑے سلیسونو اگر دا فکسٹ مون اتیستو نمے باز مہربانی مروئی اماں
en: Hello, yes, I've troubled you for this reason: Zeenat's things - her certificate, her ID card - have been left there. If you could send these over by fax, it would be very kind of you, mother.
en_old: Hello, yes, we troubled you for this reason: Zeenat's things, her certificates and ID card, were left there. If you could bring the file over, it would be very kind of you, ma'am.

brh: نم امر ارے؟ ارا ٹی خیریت ء؟ خبر اف ننا ارا ء دنا نظر لگا۔ ئے انت پاننگ کیوہ؟ غصہ ٹی مروکا فیصلہ غا کن۔
en: How are you all? Is everything well at home? I don't know whose evil eye has fallen on our home. Hey, what can I say? Decisions made in anger...
en_old: How are you? Is everything well at home? I don't know whose evil eye has fallen on our home. What can I say? Decisions made in anger...

brh: ہم عمرے را ہما زینت ہمارے کنے خبر اف کہ او ہمارے خوناٹی درو کما زڑنا زندہ مرمر
en: The same age... that Zeenat, there - I didn't know that she ... there in blood yesterday ... may she live, may she live.
en_old: She is the same age, that Zeenat. I don't know whether she is in the same blood... yesterday my heart... may she live, may she live.

brh: نوکر انت مرو ئس انت بس تینا زند نا دے تے گدریفنگ اٹی او ہا تاتی مجیب کنا مار ء کسپ ء
en: A servant - what would one become, what? Just passing the days of one's life. And ... Mujeeb is my son ...
en_old: What would a servant be? Just passing the days of his life. And Mujeeb is my son's friend.

brh: سینہ تو نا خون اٹی ہاؤ او نا ایلم تو کانہہ مسنے ہاؤ
en: Her chest was in blood, yes, and as for her brother, he has become ..., yes.
en_old: Her chest is covered in blood, yes, and her brother has gone, yes.

brh: راشد کل قصور کنائے کنا وجہ آن دا کل
en: Rashid, it's all my fault; all of this is because of me.
en_old: Rashid, it's all my fault, all of this is because of me.

brh: خراپ ڈسٹرب مس۔ زینت نا ہچ قصور ئس اف۔ اینو کنا وژن او اسہ خواب اسے ٹی تمینگا۔ خبر اف۔ خبر اف انتال تمارے۔
en: She got badly upset. Zeenat is not at fault at all. Today my sight was as if falling into a dream. I don't know. I don't know why you fell.
en_old: Badly disturbed. Zeenat is not at all at fault. Today my vision fell into a dream. I don't know. I don't know why you fell.

brh: ہمدا ت مروئی نی الے دا ہیتاتے کانے ایلو کمرے ٹی چناک نم ہنداڑے ریلیکس مرو بش بش شاباش
en: It has to be just this way. You leave these matters. Children, go to the other room. You all relax right here. Up, up, well done.
en_old: This has to be done. Don't you take these things... go to the other room, children. You relax here. Get up, get up, well done.

brh: بش مرو کنے لوخ مرو
en: Get up, ... me.
en_old: Get up, I'm feeling dizzy.

brh: جی، دا نما ناشتہ۔ ایڑے ٹیبل آ تخ۔ جی ہاؤ۔
en: Yes, this is your breakfast. Put it on the table over there. Yes, okay.
en_old: Yes, here is your breakfast. Put it here on the table. Yes, okay.

brh: پین، پین گڑا سینا ضرورت توف؟ نہ، ارختہ مس پان۔
en: Anything else - do you need anything else? No, that's enough.
en_old: Anything else, do you need anything else? No, that's enough, I'd say.

brh: خناستہ؟ امر ارے؟ اینگہ بسکنے؟ خیر ئے صیب، اولیکو وار خنانے، ہندا خاطر۔ دادے منع کر، کنا کمرہ ٹی برپ۔ مگہ ئے پاریٹ تے؟
en: Did you see him? How is he? Has he come yet? It's all right, sir - he has seen it for the first time, that's why. Stop him; he must not come into my room. But hey, did I tell him?
en_old: Did you recognize him? How are you? When did you come? It's fine, sir, I'm seeing you for the first time, that's why. Stop him, don't let him come into my room. But what did you say?

brh: نی تیراٹ منع کتے؟ ئے شکلے تورنگ خواہپرا بس دادے منع کا۔ کلو کمراتی تنا منو سنگتہ ماتی تخ۔ بس داسہ غصہ دے نا کم کا بر ناشتہ کا بر۔
en: Did you stop him? I don't want to face him, just stop him. Keep him in the room with his friends. Enough now, calm your anger; come, have breakfast, come.
en_old: Why did you stop him? I don't want to see his face, just stop him. Keep him in the room with his friends. Just now, put your anger aside, bring the breakfast.

brh: نہ نہ سر نو وصول بے غم مرو انشاءاللہ انت سے باٹ ہندوم مرے کہ جی جی جی نہ نہ نہ اللہ خیر کے
en: No, no, sir, ... received. Don't worry, God willing. What, can a thing like this happen, that... Yes, yes, yes. No, no, no. May God make it well.
en_old: No, no, sir, it's received, don't worry, God willing. What... may it be so, yes, yes, yes, no, no, no, may God make it well.

brh: جی خدا حافظ سردار اسس باز خوش قسمت و بندغ اسس جرگہ مسوس نما فیصلہ مس اونی اینو ضمانت ہریا مننگا چس نتو سدا سدا
en: Yes, goodbye. Sardar, you were a very lucky man: the jirga had been held and your case was decided ... today bail ...; otherwise, forever and ever.
en_old: Yes, goodbye. He was a chief, a very fortunate man. A jirga was held, your decision was made, and today his bail... otherwise forever and ever.

brh: پانچ سے مسٹ کنڈے، زند ایلوک اللہ پاک نا داتی، امر کہ او سوچیک امر کہ او چاہیک ہندن بندغ تون مریک۔ ولے خالد اب آئندہ دن کپیس، وار وار دن بچی پروس۔
en: ... Life is in the hands of God Almighty: as He thinks, as He wishes, so it goes with a person. But Khalid, from now on don't do this again; you won't escape like this every time.
en_old: Five hundred became... life and death are in the hands of God Almighty; as one thinks, as one wishes, so it happens to a person. But Khalid, from now on don't do that again, again and again you won't be spared like this.

brh: او مسوس او مسوس ایس ایچ او صاحب نی کنے نصیحت کننگ اٹی ئس یا خلیفنگ اٹی ئس امر کے خیال کیس؟ فاضل سوس نی تسنے۔ داڑے بندغ مجرم اف مجرم جوڑ مرے کک۔ دان پاننگ اٹی ئس نی؟ خاص پاننگ اٹی اٹ۔
en: So it happened, so it happened. SHO sahib, are you advising me or threatening me? What do you think? You have given ... Here a person is not a criminal; he gets made into a criminal. Is that what you're saying? I'm saying exactly that.
en_old: Oh, it happened, it happened. SHO sir, were you advising me or threatening me? What do you think? You've given the order. Here a person isn't a criminal; he is made into a criminal. Is that what you're saying? Yes, that's exactly what I'm saying.

brh: اگر پولیس نا رویہ دا ڈول مریک تو باز مشکل ئ کہ معاشرہ نا بندغ سیدھا انگا کسر آ برے دا ننا سوچ ئ کہ ہر وخت نن پولیس نا بارہ ٹی منفی سوچ تخنہ اگہ پولیس نا رویہ دو ماہ گڑا پولیس دے
en: If the police's attitude is like this, then it is very hard for the people of society to come onto the right path. It is our mindset that we always hold negative thoughts about the police. If the police's attitude ..., then the police ...
en_old: If the police's attitude is like this, it is very difficult for people in society to come onto the straight path. It is our thinking that we always think negatively about the police; if the police's attitude is good, then the police...

brh: ولے انسپکٹر صاحب داڑے ہر بروکا بندہ گناہگار افک بازاک بے گناہ او ہمو گناہگار آتیان تیل پیری کیرا کے معاشرے ٹی انون چکر خلنگٹی او کس پاروک افتا۔ نا اعتراضس دے ولے جرم ثابت کننگ کن
en: But Inspector sahib, not every person who comes here is guilty; many are innocent. And those guilty ones ... who are roaming around freely like that in society - there is no one to say anything to them. You have an objection, but to prove a crime...
en_old: But Inspector sir, not everyone who comes here is guilty; many are innocent, and they bribe the guilty ones who are roaming freely in society, and no one says anything to them. You have an objection, but to prove a crime...

brh: ولے داڑے بندہ مجرم جوڑ کننگا خانی کنا خن تے ترکے اونا باروٹ بیچیت کپہ ورنہ مجرم ء بر مجرم ثابت کننگا ہسی تس یاد تخس ہمیشہ پازیٹو سوچ تخس نیگیٹو سوچ
en: But here a man is being made into a criminal ... my eyes ... Don't talk about him; otherwise, go and prove the criminal to be a criminal ... Keep in mind: always think positively, not negatively.
en_old: But here a man is being made into a criminal. My eyes have opened. Don't say anything about him, or else you'll end up proving a criminal is a criminal. Remember, always think positively, not negatively.

brh: دا ہوکا ہمیشہ نقصان ارفی داسہ نی ہننگ کیسہ جان کارا ہک لک دے
en: This kind of hearsay always does harm. Now you may go ...
en_old: This one will always end in loss. Now you can go, do your work and give up your claim.

brh: گودی، اللہ ننگاڑے آرامٹ تولوک ئس کاریم تے دیر کیک؟ جی، جی کلہ کاریم تے ختم کرینٹ۔ بس، زیات چالاکی
en: Lady, my God, you're sitting here so comfortably - who is going to do the chores? Yes, yes, I've finished all the chores. Enough - too much cleverness.
en_old: Daughter-in-law, my God, why are you sitting here relaxing and putting off the work? Yes, yes, I've finished all the work. Enough, that's too much cleverness.

brh: کپہ، مہمان بسونو، اینا کیرغ تیار کرک۔ جی، ہن کے نماز اوکن۔ تا کہ ارا والا خاشتنو نا، دا کمرہ ٹی نی بننگ نا ضرورت اف، سمجھس؟ جی او۔
en: Don't. Guests have come; get today's meal ready. Yes. Go ... prayer ... so that the household ..., there's no need for you to come into this room, understand? Yes, okay.
en_old: Listen, guests have come, get the kitchen ready today. Yes, let me just say my prayers first. And so that... you don't need to come into this room, understand? Yes.

brh: بس دا سائن ات تینا کاریم تے کرک۔ ہن، پیش تم دا کمرہ غان۔
en: Just sign this and get on with your own work. Go, get out of this room.
en_old: Just sign this and get on with your work. Yes, get out of this room.

brh: ئے دا ہوسہ کپے سیاہ تا، ایلے تا داڑے برے تینٹ پوکے وتہ، بس وری ہمو کینتھس کروئی ایس کنے۔
en: Hey, don't ... this ...; let them come here ... yourself ...; I just had to do that ... once.
en_old: Hey, don't do this... bring the others here, ...just that one time I had to do it.

brh: دا سم پکا گوند مونی اونا زند جوان کروئی یا نہ نی کمال کیس ئے زند اٹ دا خط تباہی و بربادی خناٹ ننا خیری کنے دا خط سماٹ
en: ... Should his life be made good or not? You've done wonders! Hey, in my life I have seen ruin and destruction from this letter. For our good, this letter ... me ...
en_old: This bitterly made glue... will it make his life good or not? You've done wonders in life. This letter has seen ruin and destruction. For our own good, I know about this letter.

brh: او دادو ننگا بندہ آک مفت اٹ کارڈ خواری ہسٹ تو دا فنکار آک ہم سرمتنو پنچ بجنگا نی شش بجہ کنے شو شروع کروئی ئے اور داس کانے دا فنکار آک
en: Oh, these shameless people go asking for free passes, and these artists haven't arrived either. It's already struck five, I have to start the show at six, and until now these artists...
en_old: Oh, these people have been begging for cards for free, and these artists haven't arrived yet either. It's five o'clock, at six o'clock I have to start the show, and until now these artists...

brh: انو فنکار تو فنکار خدا خلے کنا اسسٹنٹ ء او ہم داسکان سرمتنے او مائی گاڈ انت مروئی آڈینس تولوکے ٹکٹ آ کل سودا
en: Today, forget the artists, damn it, even my assistant hasn't arrived yet. Oh my God, what's going to happen? The audience is seated, and the tickets are all sold.
en_old: Today, never mind the artists, God help me, even my assistant hasn't arrived yet. Oh my God, what will happen? The audience is seated, all the tickets are sold.

brh: آ مسنو شوش و فلی فنکاراک دیسکان متنو قران خلیداتے انتئے دادا دن کیرے اول مریرے کنے آن چانس خواری ولدا کیرے موک نخارے
en: These ... artists still haven't come to this day, curse them! Why do they do this? First they're the ones asking me for a chance, and then they go and do this...
en_old: These good-for-nothing, worthless artists, since when have they been swearing on the Quran? Why do they do this? First they ask me for a chance, then they do this and don't keep their word.

en: Look, Mujeeb, what can we do? You could have done anything else, father, but you should never have done this cruelty.
en_old: Come, Mujeeb, what shall we do? Whatever we do, we'll do it, Dad, but we won't put up with this cruelty.

brh: کنے سزا رسینگا کہ پھانسی مسکے ولے دا ڈکو ویل آتے دا سہو سگنگٹی ء مچ آ زند او کینن برداشت کننگ کپرونک نن ہم ہمو خاخر آ ٹوشنگون اوڑتا وار ہمو کروسٹ مجیب
en: Even if I had been punished, even if it meant hanging, but these painful troubles — enduring them for a whole lifetime, we cannot bear it. We too are burning in that same fire. I would have done the same as them, Mujeeb.
en_old: I would have been punished, even hanged, but these great sorrows... I couldn't bear them my whole life. We were thrown into that same fire too. Now it's their turn. We did it, Mujeeb.

brh: کنا وسٹی ئے چلو ایچ کننگ کتوٹ دا فیصلہ جرگہ نا فیصلہ ئس اور جرگہ نا فیصلہ ئے منوئی ئس ئے تینا سکہ غا
en: As far as it was in my power — well, I could not do anything. This decision was a jirga's decision, and a jirga's decision has to be accepted.
en_old: I couldn't do anything for my sister. This was the jirga's decision, and the jirga's decision has to be accepted as it stands.

brh: ئے لمہ کنے منت کرٹ کہ خدا نا پنٹ تینا مسڑ ء ایتک، انکار کرے، لمہ تینا ایڑے منت کرے انکار کرے، پین ہچ کنڈ آن نا امید مسٹ۔
en: Mother, I begged her, for God's sake, to give her daughter; she refused. Mother begged her own sister; she refused. I lost hope from every other side.
en_old: Mother begged me to give her daughter for God's sake, and I refused. Mother begged her brother, and he refused too. There was no hope left from anywhere.

brh: تینا ماراتے خدا نا خاستہ ننا اسے ٹوماراسی پانسی ملنگ کیک ننا دا پریشانی اوڑسا زینت دا فیصلہ تینٹ کرے
en: Our own sons... God forbid, one of our sons could have been hanged. Seeing this distress of ours, Zeenat made this decision herself.
en_old: God forbid, one of our sons could get hanged. This worry of ours... Zeenat made this decision herself.

brh: بندے ہوس نا سو واہ واہ ابا واہ او دا فیصلے کرے اور ننا ریتی تو گڑا ہر
en: ... Bravo, bravo, father, bravo! She made this decision, and our custom, then every...
en_old: That man... bravo, bravo, Dad, bravo. He made this decision, and our customs, then everything...

brh: امر کروسٹنا امر کروسٹنا دا پیریٹی ہرا لمہ باوہ فخر کنا سیٹنگا اولادے پھانسی مرے دا پیریٹی
en: What could I have done? What could I have done? In this old age, when the child their parents took pride in is hanged — in this old age!
en_old: What will we do, what will we do? This is a calamity, when parents who took pride in their child see that child hanged. This calamity.

brh: نی ہما باوہ غا تینا جغر تا ٹکر کے تینے سودا کننگ کے تیار مرے رے۔ نن نن ہندا خاطر آن مجبور مسن، مجبور مسن۔
en: You think that father was ready to trade away a piece of his own heart? We were forced, for this very reason we were forced.
en_old: You, for that father's sake, the piece of your heart, were ready to sell yourself. We were forced into it for this reason, forced.

brh: امر کے رنگ کاف کنا اللہ ہنو دانت ئس مننگٹی ئے کنا وجر مننگٹی ئے
en: How... my God, what is this that is happening? Something is happening to me.
en_old: What will happen... my God, what is happening? My heart is breaking.

brh: زینہ ترا دوزخ اٹی اوشنگ اٹی ئے ئے اوٹ قصور وار تے خبر اف خبر اف اونا انت الم روئے کاش کہ دا ہیتاتا نمے ہم سما تمو سس
en: Zeenat is burning in hell, and the guilty ones have no idea, no idea what will become of her. If only you too had understood these things.
en_old: The stairs lead into hell, and those who are guilty don't know, they don't know what will surely happen to them. I wish you had known these things too.

brh: کنا اسہ معمولی غلتی اسے آن پین نا لمہ باوہ خاص خوار زلیل مریرے نما جند نا
en: Because of one ordinary mistake of mine, your parents are being humiliated and disgraced, especially your own...
en_old: Because of one small mistake of mine, your parents have been especially humiliated and disgraced, your own...

brh: مستقبل ارمانک اخس کارہ پد سلرے ننا دا غلط انگا حرکات آتا وجہان ایلوف تا مستقبل اخس کاری تباہ مریرے
en: How many regrets about the future remain behind! Because of these wrong deeds of ours, how badly the futures of others are ruined.
en_old: How far future regrets go, later they remain; because of these wrong deeds of ours, the future of others is destroyed so badly.

brh: کاش دا ارمانی نی ہمے وخت کروسس شاید تو بفروسس بہرحال
en: If only you had felt this regret at that very time, perhaps things would not have come to this. Anyway.
en_old: I wish you had had this regret at that very time, maybe then you wouldn't have... anyway.

brh: انتس کہ اللہ ء منظور
en: Whatever is God's will.
en_old: Whatever God wills.

brh: او کنا مار، داسہ ہنبو آرام کبو۔ بابا نا طبیعت جوانہ اف، ننے اراڑے آرام بریک۔
en: Oh my son, go now and rest. Father's health is not good; how could we rest?
en_old: Oh my son, now go and rest. Your father's health is not good, we will get rest here.

brh: کنا ماری جوان اٹ۔ بازار ئس کا ٹم کنا خلک نی گٹیٹیس۔ گولی ئس کن گٹ جوان مریوا۔ بابا اسیت اسیر فینین؟
en: My son, I'm fine. Go to the market; my head is aching, you bring... Bring me a pill and I'll get better. Father, one aspirin?
en_old: My son, I'm fine. Go to the market, my head is hurting, you bring it. Bring a pill for me, it will get better. Father, did you bring it?

brh: اوسے تو گپ اسے؟ نکرہ مسٹ، عارف انت تیسے؟ ابا نی انت سوچیسے؟
en: Is something the matter? Don't, daughter. Arif, what is it? Father, what are you thinking about?
en_old: Is that a matter? Don't, daughter. Arif, what are you giving? Father, what are you thinking?

brh: ہچس نہ مسٹ ہچس نہ ئے ات بریک نی کنا مسٹ
en: Nothing, daughter, nothing at all. Come here, my daughter.
en_old: Nothing, daughter, nothing happened. Come here, my daughter.

brh: او دے یاد کننگ نا انت فائدہ، کسہ کسر آ کنتون جتا مسور کے منزل پٹنگ بے کار ئے بابا
en: What use is it to remember that day? Those who parted from me along the way — searching for the destination now is pointless, father.
en_old: What's the use of remembering that day? Those who parted from me along the way, searching for the destination is useless, father.

brh: دن پاپا بابا، اگہ خدا کپنے گڑاس مس تو گڑا ننا الم مروئی، ننا زند تباہ مروئی بابا، نہ کنا وار، انتئے دونو ہیت کیسہ، ئے کیرٹ، نمے فکر
en: Don't say that, papa, father. If, God forbid, something happens, then what will become of us? Our life will be ruined, father. No, my dear, why do you say such things? ... don't you worry.
en_old: Don't say that, Papa, father. If, God forbid, something happens, then what will become of us? Our life will be ruined, father. No, my child, why do you say such things? Don't worry.

brh: کنے نا ضرورت اف دا سے بس اینو کنے زندہ اوٹ گڑا پریشان کپتنے دا خضوج خلپے
en: I don't need anything from you; that's enough now. Today I am still alive, so don't worry, don't fret about this.
en_old: I don't need anything, this is enough; today I am alive, so don't worry, don't bother about this.

brh: ٹھیک ئے کنا مسڑ، ہنتس کہ نم پارے ہندن بنک، بابا ئے داسہ نم کن تدیو، کنا مار ہنتس کہ نم
en: All right, my daughter, whatever you say, so be it. Father, now I'll... for you. My son, whatever you...
en_old: Alright, my daughter, whatever you say, so be it. Leave your father to you now, my son, whatever you...

brh: تین کے جوڑ کریرے ہموتے کنکے ہتبو ئے ہم کونیوہ بابا ئے دا ستے کنا بابا نم زرہ سار ہم کبو ئے دا سرگڑانا بندوبستے کیوے
en: Whatever you have made for yourselves, bring me some of it too; I'll eat as well, father. Here, my father, you take a little care of yourself too; I'll arrange these things.
en_old: What you have made for yourselves, bring those to me, I will eat them too, father. This is the thing, my father, don't worry at all, I'll arrange this thing.

brh: جی دا پینوم کے گرم کرے۔
en: Yes, heat this other one too.
en_old: Yes, heat this pan for me.

brh: مہربان۔ سینت۔ جی۔ تول داڑ۔ داڑے؟ ہاؤ ہاؤ، اناڑے۔
en: Thank you. ... Yes. Sit here. Here? Yes, yes, right there.
en_old: Please. Come in. Yes. Sit here. Here? Yes, yes, there.

brh: گورزیلا، نی تینے داڑے تنیا سمجھی پیس، ننے ہر انتس کہ ضرورت
en: Gorzila, don't think of yourself as alone here; whatever you need from us...
en_old: Gorzilla, don't think of yourself as alone here, we have whatever we need.

brh: نی کنے پاس، ہنداکس کہ یک فضا نا دا وراٹی نام ہنداکس ئے نی تینا دا ور نا گودی خیال کیس۔ جی، جیا، جی نما، نما پارت کہ یخ مسر۔
en: You tell me. As much as anything in this house is ours, that much is yours; consider yourself the lady of this house. Yes, yes, yes... I told you, I told you that they had gone cold.
en_old: You tell me, as much as there is in this atmosphere, that much you consider of this time. Yes, yes, yes, you, you said that it became cold.

brh: او نی تاتنا مار فری ہتینگوس کان سمائی کل ٹکٹ آک ہتوس لوسنی پو مے بیٹا پو مے مسخرہ کپہ قران نی منے آڈینس تولوکے ٹکٹ آک کل سودا مسنو شو ہاؤس فل نی نی داسہ
en: And you'd let your aunt's son, your cousin, in for free... [unclear]... you'd bring all the tickets... [unclear] son, [unclear]... Don't joke, I swear on the Quran, believe me: the audience is seated, the tickets have all been sold, the show is house full. You, you, now...
en_old: And you're letting them in free ... all the tickets are ... Go, son, go. Don't joke, I swear on the Quran, the audience is seated, the tickets are all sold out, the show is house full, you, you now...

brh: کم مسخرہ گری کننگا ٹی ئس آرٹسٹ آتے توار کے، آرٹسٹ آتے توار کے برباد مروئی کنا ساہ ئے مجو، او مجو جانی توٹی نا خوار ئے مجو
en: You're busy clowning around! Call the artists, call the artists! My life is going to be ruined, Majo. Oh Majo jani, [unclear]... is wretched, Majo.
en_old: Joke around less, call the artists, call the artists. My life is going to be ruined, Majo, oh Majo jani ... Majo is ...

brh: اوہ! السلام علیکم۔ خدا حافظ۔ گیٹ آؤٹ۔ ایرا تو ختم۔ ڈائریکٹر نی بسنو ڈرامہ کینی آرٹسٹ اسیوٹ نی دا ٹائم اسینا بننگ نا بدتمیز کینورے اول بریرے
en: Oh! Hello. Goodbye. Get out. That's it for you two. Director, you've come. We're putting on a drama, and I'm an artist. And you: is this any time to come? You're being rude. Come early.
en_old: Oh! Peace be upon you. Goodbye. Get out. That's it, it's over. Director, you've come, we're doing a drama, I'm an artist, and you're coming at this time, how rude, they come first...

brh: چانس خواری ولدا نخرہ غاتیان شروع کیرے بابا ناراض مفہ ڈائریکٹر صاحب کن تو اینو بلو قصہ ئس مس ہا تٹ دروغس بابا دروغ تڑنگا پٹ راست پاننگا ٹوٹھ ہن قصہ ئس مس دن مس کہ لوکل ایٹ سوار مسٹ تو کلینڈر کنے پارے مچے مونا تل بندغس نا جگہ ارے
en: You want a chance, and then you start up again with your airs. Sir, don't be angry, Director sahib, a big thing happened to me today. Yes, a lie, is it? Sir, are you telling lies? No, I'm telling the truth, the truth. Yes, something happened. It went like this: when I got on the local bus, the conductor said to me, 'Move up a little and sit, there's room for one more person.'
en_old: Now that you've got the chance, you start throwing tantrums again. Sir, don't be angry with the director. Something big happened today. Yes, a lie, sir, you're lying. No, I'm telling the truth, something like this happened: when I got on the local bus, the conductor told me, 'Everyone move forward, there's room for one more person.'

brh: تو این مچ مونا اینا ٹوکن ئس پولیس والا توس تیودے بندغ ایوٹ دا پولیس والا انتئے توس ارے کنے تو اینو خبر تمدا بندغ اسے ننا ننا خیالے دا سردار اسے من ایوٹ این مچ مچ بولیندا
en: So I moved up a little... a policeman with a token sat down... I'm a person! Why has this policeman sat down? Today I found out that he counts as a person. We, we thought he was a sardar. I am... [unclear]... everyone, everyone speaks...
en_old: So all of you, in front ... a police officer gave a token ... a person ... why did this police officer give it? Today I got the news that a person ... we thought he was a sardar ... all of you speak...

brh: مچے ادا بٹیٹ کا تمیز اٹ بٹیٹ کا فنکار او اللہ دا ایلو فنکارا کرا دو بننگو خیراتیہ فنکار کے نا اوڑنگا فنکار کا سٹہ سٹہ پین نانتے مجو جان نا پین عاجز عاجز عاجز اسل ذرہ سا عاجزی افی ٹینا عاجزی ہمار
en: All of you sit here, sit with some manners, artists. Oh God, these other artists... [unclear]... charity artists... [unclear]... What's your name? Majo jan's... name? Ajiz ('humble'), Ajiz, Ajiz. Actually there isn't the slightest humility in him, his own humility... [unclear]
en_old: All of you sit here, sit politely, artists. Oh God, these other artists ... the charity artist ... the artist ... Majo jan's other ... humble, humble, humble, not a bit of humility at all ...

brh: ماچس؟ مچا خیال اتیت کہ؟ جی، مچو جان! ئے کلان مست بسنوٹ، گڑاس پیسہ مئے تس؟ دا تس نی پیسے؟ انتئے؟ تس نی دا پیسے؟ ہاں، ننا تیرٹ مس کال نہ گزارے دا پیسے ایت کنے۔ ارے دا امر ایتس کریس؟ ئے تاتین لیپو کیپ کوائٹ۔
en: Matches? Did you all take care of it? Yes, Majo jan! I came first of anyone. Did you give some money? Did you give this money? Why? Did you give this money? Yes, [unclear]... give me this money. Hey, how did you give this? [unclear]... Keep quiet.
en_old: Matches? Have you all brought them? Yes, Majo jan! I came drunk ... did you give some money? Did you give this money? Why? Did you give this money? Yes, we ... last year ... give me this money. Hey, how did you give it? ... Keep quiet.

brh: عزیز جی جی نی کہ ارے دا ڈرامہ ٹی ملاخی نا کردار ء کننگ اٹی ئس بالکل بالکل بیٹا جملہ تے تینا یاد کر ٹائم کم ء آڈینس ٹولوک ء ٹکٹ آ کل سودا مسنو شو ہاؤس فل ء
en: Aziz! Yes, yes. You're the one playing the role of Malakhi in this drama, right? Absolutely, absolutely. Son, learn your lines by heart. Time is short, the audience is seated, the tickets have all been sold, the show is house full.
en_old: Aziz, yes, yes, you're the one playing the role of Malakhi in this drama. Exactly, exactly. Son, memorize your lines, time is short, the audience is seated, the tickets are all sold out, the show is house full.

brh: ڈائریکٹر صاحب! دا ماریا ہراڑے کے؟ اوہ البتہ نی! او چائنا نا بدنی ئے کھتویس، مائی ہیا ہاتی، تولجا، اڑے ہیت کپا بو، آڈینس تو!
en: Director sahib! Where is this Maria? Oh, of course, it's you! Oh, [unclear] China's... [unclear]... Sit down! Hey, stop talking, all of you, the audience is here!
en_old: Director sir! Where is this Maria? Oh, of course, you! ... China ... sit down, hey, don't talk, the audience!

brh: لوگی! ہی واہ واہ بننگٹیورے سیٹی تا توار بننگٹیورے شور نا توار بننگٹیورے بالکل بالکل تو دانا مطلب دا مس کہ آڈینس توللوکے ٹکٹ آک کل سودا
en: Look! Hey, can you hear the 'wah wah'? Can you hear the sound of the whistles? Can you hear the sound of the noise? Absolutely, absolutely. So that means the audience is seated and the tickets have all been sold...
en_old: People! Hey, the 'wah wah' is being heard, whistles are being heard, noise is being heard. Exactly, exactly. So that means the audience is seated and the tickets are all sold out.

brh: امسڑو شو ہاؤس فل ئے فہیم فہیم بیٹا جی امرے پوزیشن سیٹ تے پوزیشن باز ئے ہا رش ئے رے رش مش ارے رش مش ارے او او باز ئے رش ہا دہن کہ بچہ جی
en: ...the show is house full. Faheem, Faheem, son! Yes? How's the position with the seats? There are plenty. Yes, is there a crowd? Hey, there's a crowd and all, there's a crowd. Oh, oh, there's a big crowd. Yes, just like that, kid. Yes.
en_old: Today the show is house full. Faheem, Faheem son, yes, what's the position? The seats are in position, there are a lot. Yes, it's crowded, there's a crowd, oh, very crowded, yes, like that, kid, yes.

brh: سیٹ ہم غلفیس، ادو سد سیٹ پین خواہف کنا پیناں پرچی اسے دے او ٹینٹ والی شاباش بیٹا شاباش بچکے بچکے پیسہ دے ملخی بیٹا جی جملہ بادے تینا جوانی فس کے
en: The seats too, did you [unclear] them? We need another hundred seats there. Give me another slip. And the tent guy: well done, son, well done, give him the remaining money. Malakhi, son, yes, learn your lines and do a good job.
en_old: Count the seats too, bring a hundred more seats there, give me another slip, and the tent guy ... well done son, well done kid, kid, give money. Malakhi son, yes, remember your lines, do your best.

brh: بسک او مسوس یاد کے یاد کے جوانی کے کنا آئی ماریہ بسک ماریہ بسک
en: Enough, okay? Have you got it? Learn them, learn them, do a good job. Oh my, Maria has come! Maria has come!
en_old: That's enough, have you ... remember, remember, do well. My Maria came, Maria came.

brh: بس بس خوش مپہ خنانٹ ماریہ بس کنا کچن نوسہ او نا خنانٹ تول تول دا کا ماریہ بسک مگر لیڈی ڈائنا بسک ڈسکو ڈانس کننگ اؤس السلام علیکم میڈم وعلیکم السلام تول او اینم کے کرسی ئس ہٹ اسہ منٹ
en: Enough, enough, don't get so happy. I saw Maria come... [unclear]... I saw her. Sit, sit. Is this Maria who's come, or has Lady Diana come to do a disco dance? Hello, madam. Hello. Sit. Oh, bring her a chair, just a minute.
en_old: Enough, enough, don't get so happy. I saw Maria come... my kitchen... I saw her. Sit, sit. This isn't Maria who's come, it's Lady Diana come to do a disco dance. Hey, Assalamu alaikum, madam. Wa alaikum assalam. Sit. Oh, bring her a chair, one minute.

brh: خادم جان کنا کرسیء موندا دیر ارا، ہمینگر سنی ہمینگ ہمینگ، نی مگہ پینانو چائیکہ تینٹ کرسیء زبر برک، خادم جان کنکن کرسیء ہتے، کیپ کوائٹ بدتمیزی کپا۔
en: Khadim jan, who is in front of my chair? That way... that way, that way. Do you only serve tea to others? Bring the chair up yourself. Khadim jan, bring the chair for me. Keep quiet, don't be rude.
en_old: Khadim jan, how long has my chair been out front? Like this, Sunny, like this. You're bringing tea for others, so bring the chair up yourself. Khadim jan, bring me a chair. Keep quiet, don't be rude.

brh: او نیاڑی خنتنو رے اینٹ نو میڈم پلیز سٹ ڈاؤن سٹ ڈاؤن ماریا کہ رے ایکچولی انگریزو نیاڑی سے انگریزو مسڑ ئس اولیکو واری براہوئی ڈرامہ ٹی کاسٹ کرے
en: Oh, haven't you ever seen a woman, hey? No, madam, please sit down, sit down. Maria, you see, is actually an Englishwoman, an English girl, cast in a Brahui drama for the first time.
en_old: Oh, look at the woman, hey... No, madam, please sit down, sit down. Maria, hey... actually, for the first time an English woman, an English girl, has been cast in a Brahui drama.

brh: یاد کبو مئے ناکو جملہ غاتے نا یاد کبو مئے ناکو ایلا تم تو جملہ غاتیٹ یاد کبو شٹ اپ کنا گیغانہ غاتیٹ کسے شرم بفک نی داسے اسکرپٹ ئے الیوا دوانا گیچاؤٹ کیونی بس بس بس بس بس میہڑ کپر بس بس
en: Memorize them, our uncle, memorize the lines, our uncle... you too, memorize the lines. Shut up! Doesn't anyone feel any shame in my...? You, this script, I'll leave... enough, enough, enough, enough, enough, don't..., enough, enough.
en_old: Remember the lines, uncle, remember them, uncle, last time too, remember the lines. Shut up, nobody feels any shame in my songs, you're taking this script... enough, enough, enough, enough, enough, don't make a fuss, enough, enough.

brh: قمیض کے لیوس ڈائریکٹر مجو سڑیابینا نقل کیسی نہ۔ جملہ غاتے نہ یاد کبو دا سڑیو ہتکپبو تینا مونو ٹائم باز کم ئے انتئے دون کیرے نوم۔ جملہ غاتے نہ یاد کبو۔ ہندا پارہ تے مجو بائیک ہنتو اسکرپٹ۔
en: ...the shirt... Director Mujo, you're talking rot, aren't you? Memorize the lines; don't bring this rotten stuff; the time ahead of us is very short; why are you people doing this? Memorize the lines. Tell him this same thing: brother Mujo... the script.
en_old: Director, don't imitate the shirt... Remember the lines, don't bring this mess, the time ahead is very short, why do you do this? Remember the lines. Same thing over here, script.

brh: اسکرپٹ افک اسکرپٹ افک خدا خلے نی رچنا موڈ دا ہس اسکرپٹ تے نم لند کیرے کنیرے دا اسکرپٹاتی چڑ فوٹو اسٹیٹ چڑ فوٹو اسٹیٹ ڈائریکٹر صاحب دانا اسکرپٹ امو اسہ کے
en: There's no script, there's no script! May God strike you... you people do... to the scripts, you eat them... these scripts... photocopy, photocopy. Director sahib, this one's script is that same one...
en_old: There's no script, there's no script, by God, you... this is it, you people ruin the scripts, you eat them, photocopy these scripts, photocopy them, director sir, this one's script is the same one.

brh: ایٹ نوشی جان کرے اوہ اڑے او ہورے او دس ویلر نا ٹائر دمرتوما دسی اسکرپٹ خوامبو یاد کبو مجبوری ئے غریبی ئے گزارہ کبو ٹائم کم ئے اڑے
en: Eat, bon appetit (nosh-e jan)... oh, hey, oh look, oh, the ten-wheeler's tire... Read the script, memorize it; it's necessity, it's poverty, make do; time is short, hey.
en_old: Noshi jaan did it, oh, there he is, he's looking, the two-wheeler's tire... I want the script, remember it, it's out of necessity, it's poverty, make do, time is short.

brh: دا خادم رنگ نانے؟ انتھے امر کیسہ تے؟ کنا گاڑی ایڈروڈ اسلوک ئے پمچ سائیڈ اسلفتی۔ صاف صاف پاکیبش ریڈی کنا تھیٹی سلفے گڑا گاڑی نا
en: Is this servant... yours? Why, how are you doing this to him? My car is standing on the... road; [it got a] puncture, I parked [it] at the side. Clearly, clearly... ready... I parked it at my..., then the car's...
en_old: Whose color is this? Why, how are you doing them? My car on the road... a puncture on the side. Clearly, clearly... ready, in my... then the car's...

brh: دا با نکسے مونی تھینو ٹریکٹر امر خاننگک او ئے درو خناٹ تے بازار ٹی گاڑی تے نا لٹ کریسس دن کریکہ کرو کرو کرو کرو اوہ کرو کرو چپ کے گومے خدائے منا بو اسکرپٹ یاد کبو جملہ غاتے یاد کبو
en: ...how a tractor looks in front... I saw him yesterday in the bazaar; he had been looting the cars, he was going like this: 'karo karo karo karo, oh, karo karo'. Be quiet... for God's sake, memorize the script, memorize the lines.
en_old: Look how a tractor looks in front of you. I saw him the other day in the bazaar looting the cars, he was going like this, do it, do it, do it, do it, oh, do it, do it, be quiet... for God's sake, remember the script, remember the lines.

brh: چپ کبو ٹائم کم ئے چپ کبو چپ کبو ئے ربی ننگا ڈوری شور ئے سیٹی تا توار ئے اخس باز رش ئے آڈینس تولوک ئے ٹکٹاک کل سودا مسنو شو ہاؤس فل ئے
en: Be quiet, time is short, be quiet, be quiet. Oh Lord... there's noise, the sound of whistles, what a huge crowd! The audience is seated, the tickets have all been sold, the show is house full.
en_old: Be quiet, time is short, be quiet, be quiet... the noise, the sound of whistles, what a big crowd, the audience is seated, TikTok, it's a sold-out show, house full.

brh: نوم مسخرہ کننگا، دا سکرپٹ تے نی یاد کر بچا، اندا سکرپٹ یار برتوما کہ یاد کبو، ئے دا سکرپٹ تے دیفر، مجبوری ئے کمپرومائز کبو، ہاؤ ئنا خط کبو، او ماتی یار، تو دا خالی، دا داستان ئے ہرا کریکٹر ئے کہ دا پنجہ خان نا
en: You people are joking around. Memorize this script, boy; this very script, friend... memorize it. Eh, this script... it's out of necessity, compromise. Yes, do today's... Oh, mate, friend, so this [is] empty. This is the story: which character is it? This one is Panja Khan's.
en_old: To make fun of the name... remember these scripts, boy, bring this very script, friend, remember it, put these scripts..., it's out of necessity, compromise, yes, write a letter, oh mate, friend, so this is empty, this story, which character is it, that of Panja Khan.

brh: دا کریکٹری کریکہ ہوم سرمتنے دا ایلو ملک گرگٹ اسہ گدراسہ کہ او بدبختو نسکان بتنے ابوئے
en: The one who was playing this character hasn't arrived either; this other one, Malik, a chameleon... that wretch hasn't come yet, father.
en_old: This character did... home... this other country, a chameleon, one... that poor wretch until... Abu.

brh: اسلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام سلام ختم مسک ولدا بندہ ختم مننگٹی افک
en: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. The greeting is over, but then the fellow just doesn't finish.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. The greeting is over, but the man won't finish.

brh: باز دادے آ، پٹ نا کاریمٹ، اینے معاف کریش، دا شار والا بتاؤ، بریک، ضرور بریک، نی امر پھسہ کہ او بریک، ئے اونا خنتٹی نیکین مہر خناٹ، نی یقینی کہ او بریک، او اگر بتاؤ تو
en: There's a lot to this... in the work of searching... forgive [him]... Won't this city fellow come? He'll come, he'll surely come. How can you say that he'll come? I saw kind love in his eyes. Are you sure he'll come? And if he doesn't come, then...
en_old: This is a lot... in the work... forgive him, tell this city person, he will come, he will surely come. How do you know he will come? I saw kind love in his eyes. Are you sure he will come? If he tells, then...

brh: کنا نام پنی بدل کیس، ولیا سے گپ اسپاو نی او بریک، ہمودے بریک اور ہمو جاگہ غے بریک۔ راست، او راست۔ آ ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی اگر نی داغس وس افک گڑا
en: ...change my name. But tell me one thing: will he come? Will he come on that very day and to that very place? Truly, it's true. Ah, all right, all right; if you don't have this much power, then...
en_old: Change my name... but tell me one thing, will he come? Will he come on that day and to that place? True, it's true. Ah, okay, okay, if you don't have this much power then...

brh: نی دھم کر دا تعویزے عرفہ کسٹس ہیت تتہ شارا دے شیر خانے کنفتہ او شیر خانے ولاتنے خلقا سر کیک اور ہراٹمی گو ہیت دادے ہرا تعویزے کہ اینا
en: Blow [a prayer] on this amulet... someone gave word... the day [he comes] to the city... Sher Khan... Sher Khan... back... it reaches the village, and when... the thing is this: which amulet is it that today's...
en_old: Blow on this amulet... someone said things, on the day of the city, Sher Khan will be brought, he'll bring Sher Khan, people... and when... the thing is, which amulet is it...

brh: ایلم تتی سسوٹ نا، ہمو تعویذ ہم اسر کرے رکھ، خدا سنی اینی نہ چاس، کنا معلوم نا شکل بالکل نم تون ملپک، ولے کنا سالوم نا شکل نم تون ملپک، نا وڑ نا
en: Brother... yours. That amulet worked too; keep it. God... you don't know. As far as I know, [his] face doesn't resemble you at all, but my son-in-law's face doesn't resemble you [either], your kind of...
en_old: Brother... that amulet also worked. God knows... the face of someone I know doesn't resemble you at all, but my brother-in-law's face resembles yours, sort of...

brh: شکل نا ارا کے بندغے، او اراڑے مروئی دا وخت اراڑے کنے ملوئے، چاؤ کہ دا سپوز کن گنوک مننگٹی اوس۔
en: What kind of man is he, judging by his face? And where would he be at this time, where would he meet me? Know that you are going crazy over this [unclear word].
en_old: What kind of face does this man have, where is he, where should he be at this time, where will he meet me? Look, this one is going crazy over his spouse.

brh: بارک بارک بخیرٹ بخیرٹ مٹاخان
en: Come in, come in, welcome, welcome, Mitha Khan.
en_old: Welcome, welcome, welcome, welcome, Mitha Khan.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ خیر و خیریت؟ جوڑ، ٹھیک ٹھاک، طبیعت خوش؟ پین شکر ئے خیر خیریت ئے شکر ئے آ، تول۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Is everything well? Are you fine, all right, in good spirits? Otherwise, thank God, all is well, thank God. Come, sit down.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Is all well? Are you fine, alright, in good spirits? Thank God, all is well, thank God. Come, sit down.

brh: بھین ف خیر خیریت ئے ئتو خیر ئتو ابا، جوان ممانم تور بو ننے چس کینتے، جی او، یرا جانداد خان نی اسئے ایت ئس کریس، بدامون ہم کتیس، ہاؤ ہمو
en: [Garbled] all is well... all is well, dear. Good, [guests?] sit down... Yes. Hey Jandad Khan, you said something, and you didn't [garbled] either. Yes, that...
en_old: Sister, is everything well? Well, father, good, uncle... Yes. Hey Jandad Khan, you did a... you also spoke badly, yes, that...

brh: شیر خان والا ڈغار تا بارو اٹ نا؟ او او شیر خان نا۔ اور جانداد خان نا۔ او ڈغارک شیر خان نا او۔ ٹھیک ئے او شیر خان شار ئے نانے۔ اینو برے پگا برے او بریک۔
en: About Sher Khan's lands, right? Yes, yes, Sher Khan's. And Jandad Khan's. Those lands are Sher Khan's. All right; Sher Khan has gone to the city. Whether today or tomorrow, he will come.
en_old: About Sher Khan's lands? Yes, yes, Sher Khan's. And Jandad Khan's. Those lands are Sher Khan's. Alright, Sher Khan has gone to the city. He'll be back today or tomorrow.

brh: مشکلے مشکلے کہ والدا شیر خان بریک بیٹا خان ہندا موقع ہندا موقع دا موقع فائدہ گرفوئے کنا ایلو ہنون کہ ہوشیار آئنا
en: It will be difficult, difficult, once Sher Khan comes back. Beta Khan, this is the moment, this very moment; we have to take advantage of this moment. My brother, let's go... be smart.
en_old: It's difficult, it's difficult, because Sher Khan will come back. Bita Khan, this is the moment, we should take advantage of this moment, my other... be smart.

brh: پدا شارن خلکا بس ولدا شار اینا انون واپس بروئی او مسوس کنا ایلوم ئنا خاطر آن پانے اڈے اوڑنے کہ دا ڈغار نا قبضہ نا قصہ الے
en: Then he came from the city to the village, and went to the city again; he is due to come back. When that happens, for my brother's sake, tell him there that there is no question of seizing this land.
en_old: Then he went to the city, and when he comes back from the city, for the sake of my others, tell him there that there's no question of seizing this land.

brh: ئے نی قبضہ کیسا یا کپیسہ ئے قبضہ کیوا ہر کنا سنگت نی کنا سنگت ئس او ہر کاری مے اوار کرینن ولے دا کاری مٹی نی تون اوار مفارہ مفیس بے
en: So will you seize it or not? — I will seize it. — My friend, you are my friend, and we have done every job together, but in this job I will not be with you. — You won't, eh?
en_old: Will you seize it or not? I will seize it. My friend, you are my friend, and we have done every job together, but I won't be with you in this one.

brh: بیشک نی مفیس ولے کنے تو الیک ئے تینا کاریم تو کیوا نا ہنا تو ئے تے نی ہم الے پرہ جانداد خان انتس کہ کیس ئے نی تو نوارٹ ولے دا کاریم کنے الے پرہ
en: Of course you won't, but leave me be; I will certainly do my own work. [Garbled] ... you're not in it either. — Jandad Khan, whatever you do, I am with you, but this job is not for me.
en_old: Of course you won't, but I can't let it go. I'll do my job. Jandad Khan, whatever you do is up to you, but I won't do this job.

brh: قصہ انت؟ قصہ ہچ اسہ تفک، بس چائے غا رادو۔ بریک چائے، زلی!
en: What's the matter? — Nothing at all is the matter; I've just sent for tea. The tea is coming. Zali!
en_old: What's the matter? Nothing at all, just come have some tea. Bring the tea, Zali!

brh: او زلی زو کا بسک ماما اندنو چاس کھرینوٹ کہ پورا زندگی چاکم پروسہ وٹ آ تو مطلب بسک
en: Oh Zali, hurry up! — It's here. — Uncle, I've made such tea that you won't drink the like of it in your whole life... [garbled], I mean...
en_old: Zali, bring it quickly! Uncle, I've made such tea that you'll remember it your whole life.

brh: مطلب دا کہ اندونو چاۓ سینہ کنفیونے پورہ زندگی اخہ چا کنونس کولے استن دروس۔ ابا ظلیم مسخرہ کننگے ننے تو سماۓ واہ ہم نی اونا ایتاتیا ایناس نی صرف چاۓ کنتے نا ہورتا۔ ہاؤ۔ ہاں۔ آ تاؤ کادے گلا۔
en: I mean, such tea that you won't have drunk the like of it in your whole life, no [garbled]. — Oh you rascal, you're just joking; we know you. Wow, you too were taken in by his words; you're only here to drink tea. — Yes. — Yes. — Ah, [garbled].
en_old: What I mean is, such tea that... I won't drink tea like this again in my whole life. Dad, you're making a big joke. We know you only came here for the tea. Yes. Yes...

brh: کنے معلوم ئے چائے ہسکو جوانو گنٹی مے تا او پا او با خلق نا تو اندا چائے پین انت ارے داڑے جی سر
en: I know the tea is [very] good... [garbled] of the village; besides this tea, what else is there here? — Yes, sir.
en_old: I know the tea is good... what else is there here besides this tea? Yes, sir.

brh: اوہو جی سر دا بئے نیوز مکریموس نا پدا مکریم نامرمس چرے کریم توئی کریک مس ویری گڈ جی تھینک یو سر کنے ام امید ئس نمے آ جی سر لیکن دا پتا کہ شیر خان انت پارے سر شیر خان اینو پگاہ باز پریشان ئے سر
en: Oh ho, yes sir, this is big news... [garbled]... very good. Yes, thank you, sir. I too had hopes in you, yes sir. But do you know what Sher Khan said? Sir, Sher Khan is very worried these days, sir.
en_old: Oh, yes sir, this is big news... very good. Thank you, sir. I had high hopes for you too. Yes, sir. But do you know what Sher Khan said? Sir, Sher Khan has been very worried these days, sir.

brh: سدے، پریشان مفہ قمر، جی، اسینا ضعیفہ چناک توڑا مڑ مڑ ایت، جی، دا خپٹنگا باوجود خننگ بس، پریشان تمری، بالکل سر، سر گڑا دم کے خلک واپس کائے سر، شیر خوار خلک نا کشتی تے گلیشانی بسونی، دا زگنیو نا خلک غا ننگ بس
en: [Garbled], don't worry, Qamar. — Yes. — Someone's wife and children [garbled]... — Yes. — Despite this, [he] came to see... worried... — Absolutely, sir. Sir, then he will catch his breath and go back to the village, sir... [garbled] ... came to this village [garbled].
en_old: Don't worry, Qamar. Yes. Some weak children... Yes. Despite this... don't worry. Absolutely, sir. Sir, then he took a breath and came back, sir...

brh: دا ہچ مشکل اف۔ سر شیر خان تو کشتی وشان ء وسون ء لیکن دا پتیٹ مٹ کننگ نا ٹائم اٹ چھٹی مروئی سر۔ نی اونا فکر ء کپہ انشااللہ تعالی دا مشکل زو آسان مریک۔ جی سر۔ اگہ متو ہم ئے ریڈی سمبالی وتے۔ جی سر۔ تو سر اگہ نی اجازت تس۔
en: This is no difficulty at all. — Sir, Sher Khan [garbled], but at the time of this exchange there should be a break, sir. — Don't worry about it; God willing, this difficulty will soon be resolved. — Yes sir. — Even if it isn't, be ready and handle it yourselves. — Yes sir. — So sir, if you give permission...
en_old: This isn't difficult at all. Sir, Sher Khan... but there will have to be leave at the time of the change, sir. Don't worry about it. God willing, this difficulty will soon be resolved. Yes, sir. Even if it isn't, be ready to handle it. Yes, sir. So, sir, if you permit me...

brh: تیس گڑا شیخ خان نما ورا غا سر کے گنوک مسنس صاحب صاحب ورا انکشفی سے ننا تو نیتس وفاک ئے اوڑ گوٹ لڑی کمرے سلیوے جی سر جی سر کنے معلوم ئس کنے کہ صاحب ورا
en: You gave it, and then Sheikh Khan [came] over to your side, sir — has he gone mad? Sahib, sahib, [garbled: some revelation]... our [intention]... in that room [garbled]... — Yes sir, yes sir, I knew, sahib, that...
en_old: Then Sher Khan came to us, sir, he's gone mad, sir... sir, he revealed something... yes sir, yes sir, I knew it, sir...

brh: اللہ گو راغہ دے، انتئے کھرائے کنا ولدا، پو مسس، قربان، چپ، بس ایت کبو وتے نہ بد کر، سر بات تو بندے لیکن تو داسہ ننے ننگ کین سر، ایمبو، اجازت دے تومے، کانہ، کاریمے کبو، کانہ سر
en: O God [garbled], why did you do this to me again? Understood? Qurban, quiet! Just do [as you're told], don't spoil things for yourself. — Sir, the matter is closed, but now [you are shaming] us, sir. — Go. — Give us permission. — Go, do your work. — We're going, sir.
en_old: May God give you... why did you do this to me? Quiet. Just don't talk, don't make yourself look bad. Sir, the matter is closed, but now... sir, give us permission. Go, do your work. Go, sir.

brh: اسے وخت برین اینا گیتل بیرت اچلو کنے کان قربان اینک نی کان بابا نیم برے کان یا خلیسہ پتری نیم بابا نی کان صاحب غصہ ٹی نیم برے یا صاحب غصہ ٹی الے کنے من نہ قربان
en: Come some time... [garbled] ... Qurban, ... Father, are you going? ... are you going, or will you beat [him]? [garbled] Father, are you going? Is the sahib angry, or is the sahib not angry? [garbled]... no, Qurban.
en_old: Come here sometime... come with me, Qurban... will you go, father?... Is the sahib angry, or isn't the sahib angry?... No, Qurban.

brh: یا مالک یا اللہ کنا مشکلاتے آسان کیس مالک ئے تنا چناتے درد سگ کپرہ مالک
en: O Lord, O God, make my difficulties easy. Lord, my children are in pain; I can't bear it, Lord.
en_old: O Lord, O God, ease my troubles. Lord, don't let your children suffer pain, Lord.

brh: کنے رحم کر رحم کر مالک رحم رحم کر
en: Have mercy on me, have mercy, Lord, mercy, have mercy.
en_old: Have mercy on me, have mercy, Lord, mercy, have mercy.

brh: اللہ پاکا ئے کنا قصور انت؟
en: O holy God, what is my fault?
en_old: O God, what is my fault?

brh: دسکا نرفیسہ کہ کنا قصور انتے ہرا وختس کہ باوہ نا داڑے خل کٹیاس نشامہ مستی نی اوراغا سر کریسہ او داسہ کہ باوہ نا اینانے نی نمنے اسکا چرنگیسہ
en: Now you are driving me away. What is my fault? When Father was here, you would come round to the house [garbled, possibly: drunk and merry], and now that Father has gone, you scold us this much.
en_old: Tell me now, what is my fault? When Father was here, you'd come to his house drunk, and now that Father is gone, you push us around this much.

brh: سلوفرا تیمبر دا سپننگٹ اوسو۔ آئی ایراغ ری؟ شرم بفک نی دسکانے ایراغ خواسہ؟ اینو نا سزا دادے کہ لنگڑ خاچ۔
en: [Garbled]. — Mother, is there any food? — Aren't you ashamed, asking for food at this hour? Today's punishment is this: go to sleep hungry.
en_old: ... Have you eaten? Aren't you ashamed, wanting food at this hour? Today's punishment is that you sleep hungry.

brh: آئی مچ توئی رغیت کنے، جسہ کاسہ یہ ولدا چپلا خواسہ، نا آئی توبہ کنے دونہ باز کوبینے آئی
en: Mother, [garbled] me. — Get going, or do you want a slap again? — No, Mother, I repent; it's so very heavy for me, Mother.
en_old: Mother, all of you are fed up with me. What else do you want, then? No, Mother, I repent, so many curses are on me.

brh: او پیرونا باوا بر پدا
en: O father of Piro, come back!
en_old: Oh, Piro's father, come back.

brh: نی ہم بے دے سورا کنک
en: You too are making trouble for no reason.
en_old: You're arguing for no reason too.

brh: نظام نی دا گڑا تے مچ کے ئے ثناء ء گڑاس نشان تیو ہم باری وا ہن گڑا یار جمال
en: Nizam, gather up these things, and show Sana something too, then go. — Okay then, friend Jamal.
en_old: Nizam, gather all these things, and give Sana some sign too, then go. Okay, friend Jamal.

brh: ئے ہم بروتٹ نا۔ نی پین وخت اسے۔ کانسہ نا؟ جماعت نن ارنگ کانے؟ نی برتوس سئی۔
en: I'll come too, okay? — You, some other time. — You're going, right? — Class... where are we going? — You didn't come, right.
en_old: Didn't you come too? Some other time, then. Are you going? Will we have class? You didn't come, right?

brh: داڑے؟ ہو، داڑے، ہمم، سئی، داڑے تو سئی، مسن کنے توار برے، داڑے تو لے، مسن کنے توار، نی امر سماۓ؟ کنے سماۓ، بروٹو۔
en: Here? — Yes, here. — Hmm, okay, here then, fine. It seems I hear a voice. Here then... It seems I hear a voice. — How do you know? — I know. I'll come.
en_old: Here? Yes, here. Hmm, right, here then. It seems I hear a voice. Here, take it. I hear a voice. How do you know? I know, I came.

brh: وعلیکم السلام ماسٹر صاحب خیریت ٹھیک ٹھاک انسپکٹر صاحب خیریت تے
en: Wa alaikum assalam, Master sahib, is all well? All fine and well. Inspector sahib, is all well with you?
en_old: Wa alaikum assalam, Master sahib, are you well? Fine, fine, Inspector sahib, how are you?

brh: دا تکڑ کرے نی پین خیرے؟ شکریہ اللہ نا، طبیعت نا جوانی؟ اللہ نا احسان ئے مہربانی۔ او کیس نا لمبا شقنداری فائنہ مچو دیرے مسنے نی ئنا پرواہ اف، نن نما انتظار ئے کننگٹ ئسن امر چنا تس لگانے داڑے؟ جیو باس۔
en: Are you keeping fit? Is everything else well? Thanks to God. Is your health good? It is God's kindness, thank you. Oh, the case dragged on so long, it has gotten a little late. Never mind, we were waiting for you. How have the children taken to it here? Yes, just fine.
en_old: Did he get this done? How else are you? Thanks to God, how is your health? It's God's grace, thank you. Oh, the case is taking long, it's been quite late, don't you worry, we were waiting for you. How many children have you got here? Long live, boss.

brh: خوشو باز خوشو مریم سلام کن کڑدے تنا السلام علیکم بیٹا امر جوانو ئس الے دا شعیب نا رنگینا؟ ہوا دا خیر نا یکتنا اینا؟ خیرہ سورے نتا
en: Happy, very happy. Maryam, say salaam to [...]. Assalamu alaikum. Child, how lovely she is! Is this Shoaib's? So pretty. Yes. God bless, is she your only one? [...]
en_old: Happy, very happy. Maryam, greet him. Assalamu alaikum, child, how nice. Is this Shoaib's color? Yes, is this the only one of Khair? ...

brh: نشار نما انت حالے؟ ٹھیک ٹھاک، تکڑا مسنو؟ بخیر ئے بیٹا داسے ماسی، شاباش کر بیٹا، نن کان شوئے برن، جی او، نم ایرے نم نشار، ئے جاگہ ئے خنس، ئے کسرے داد۔
en: Nishar, how are you all? Fine and well. Have you grown strong? All is well, child. This is aunty. Go on, child. We are going, we'll come [back] [...]. Yes. You two, Nishar, have you seen that place? That road [...]
en_old: Nishar, how are you? Fine, fine, have you become strong? Fine, child, this is aunty, well done child, we'll come tomorrow, yes, you sit, Nishar, have you seen the place, the way is this.

brh: دا کٹ گدنی ببو دا کٹ دا کٹ ببو شاباش ایمبو نا
en: Come this way, [...] come, this way, this way, come. Well done [...]
en_old: Come sit here, come sit here, well done...

brh: السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام بیٹا السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام بیٹا السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام دادا دیر اسے بچا
en: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam, child. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam, child. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Dada, who is this child?
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam, child. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam, child. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam, grandfather, who is this child?

brh: دا ہمو مارے کہ اولیکو دے نن خنان دانا ایٹک روڈء بسور۔ ہاؤ ہاؤ ہاؤ ہاؤ ہاؤ ہاؤ کنے یاد بس روڈء داکے ایٹ دبسور ہا؟ ہنتلے نا بچہ؟ جوانٹ ماما۔ ابا دا دے خوانے نا باشے
en: This is that boy we saw on the first day, whose goats came onto the road. Yes, yes, yes, yes, I remember, his goats came onto the road, right? How are you, child? Fine, uncle. Abba, he has a great love of studying.
en_old: This is the boy we saw on the first day, he came to the road. Yes, yes, yes, I remember, he came onto the road, right? How are you, child? Fine, uncle. Father, this one is fond of studying.

brh: جوان دادے خوانے نا باز شوق ئے دا تو باز جوان ویتے سے ابا دن مف کے نن کانہ دانہ اورا غٹ دانہ ابائی پان کے دادے خوانیفے باز جوان ٹھیک ئے کنا چنا نن کانہ دا ہفتہ اورا غٹ
en: Good, he has a great love of studying; that is a very good thing. Abba, why don't we go to his house and tell his father to have him educated? Very good. All right, my child, we'll go to his house this week.
en_old: Good, he is very fond of studying, that's very good. Father, isn't it so that tomorrow we'll go to his house, and tell his father to educate him, very good. Alright, my child, tomorrow we'll go to his house this week.

brh: دفتر بائے خنینا، اورائتم خنینا، وبائتہ پانک کہ تینا شنائے اسکول ٹی داخل کرفے۔ ٹھیک ہی داسہ بچہ، کان نن دنی رخ کبو۔ نہ ماما، اسہ معاف کنے، مالہ کرم سر مسنو، ارے رخ مریر، کن توئی کاو ماما۔ جان۔ کامبو سر۔ کامبو ماما۔
en: We'll go and see his father, see him at home too, and tell his father to enroll his child in school. All right now, child, we're heading off this way; come along. No, uncle, please forgive me, the flock [...] they will wander off, so let me go, uncle. All right, dear. Goodbye, sir. Goodbye, uncle.
en_old: Go to the office and see, see at home, and tell your father to enroll his son in school. Alright now, child, tomorrow we'll set off. No, uncle, please forgive me, I'm very busy, they will be leaving, I can't come, uncle. Dear. Thank you, sir. Thank you, uncle.

brh: آنٹی نی ہمبر اما نی ہمبر مریم ضد کپے بر اکداڑے دیک یخو بیمار مرسے کنتو غازی کبو نا جوان کنا چنا ئے بریوا نئے
en: Aunty, you come too; Mama, you come too. Maryam, don't be stubborn, come here, it's cold, you'll get sick. Play with me! All right, my child, I'll come, okay?
en_old: Aunty, you too, Ama, you too. Maryam, don't be stubborn, come here, it's cold, you'll get sick. Don't make me angry, my good child, you'll come, won't you?

brh: نی ایڑے تے او چنا سے ضد کننگٹی ئے نی ایڑے تے چنا سے است خوش مرو۔
en: Let her be, she's a child, she's being stubborn. Let her be, she's a child; her heart will be happy.
en_old: Sister, you are being stubborn like a child; sister, the child will be happy.

brh: دے تپاوا انسپکٹر صاحب انسان دا سوچ کروئی ئے
en: Don't say that, Inspector sahib. A person ought to think this:
en_old: Don't say that, Inspector sahib, a person must think about this.

brh: کہ او دا دنیا ٹی دا خاطر آن ودی مسنے کہ او تینا قوم او تینا دا بندغاتا نمائندگی کے او تینا دا فرض پورا کننگ کن ہمیشہ تیار مرو راست پاریس
en: that he has been born into this world for this reason: to represent his nation and his people, and he will always be ready to fulfill this duty of his. You spoke the truth.
en_old: That he was born into this world to represent his people and these people of his, and he will always be ready to fulfill this duty of his. You spoke the truth.

brh: ہر بندغے شنکیٹی اسے پینستے ننگیٹی شنکیٹی لمہ و دے لولی تریسہ ناز ایفک و بلن کیک۔ ہندا خاطر کن تیوے پیشہ کنا مقصد باز عزیز۔
en: Every person, in childhood, [...] in childhood, is sung lullabies by the mother, who pampers him and raises him. For this very reason the whole profession, my purpose, is very dear to me.
en_old: Every person, in childhood, is sung lullabies by their mother, pampered and raised. For this reason, the whole profession, my purpose is very dear.

brh: او داڑکن ئے ہمیشہ تیار اٹ ہا آئندہ فروٹ اتت بو
en: And for this I am always ready, yes, and in future too [...]
en_old: He is always ready for this, and in the future too he will be...

brh: جی ارباب ملک صاحب، جی او، حق علم
en: Yes, Arbab Malik sahib, yes. Truly, knowledge [...]
en_old: Yes, Arbab Malik sahib, yes, oh, rightful knowledge.

brh: روشنائی
en: [is] light.
en_old: Light

brh: چاوکے اینو کیٹلی نا دیر تے کل ختم کرینوس؟ او اما اینو کیٹلی نا کل دیرک چٹار۔ ئے گرمی مس کہ ملنگ بابا ملاسہ مس۔ اوفوہ! ما ملنگ بابا؟
en: [...], did you use up all the water in the kettle today? Oh Mom, today all the water in the kettle got used up. It was so hot that Malang Baba got thirsty. Ugh! Malang Baba?
en_old: Hey, did you finish all the water in the kettle today? Oh mom, today the water in the kettle all spilled. It got so hot that Malang Baba was bathing. Ugh! Malang Baba?

brh: دا دیرسے ملنگ بابا اینے سد وار پارینوٹ اینٹ مٹ مرغ مرنگ بے چمرو بندغسے نامہ نی خلیپے او باز جوانو بندغسے ہمیشہ کنے مال و اوراغ رائیکے
en: This Malang Baba, I've told you a hundred times, [...] he's a [...] person, don't you be afraid of him. He is a very good man; he always gives me things and food.
en_old: This water... Malang Baba, I've told you a hundred times, don't call him a useless person who just eats and does nothing. He is a very good man; he always gives me goods and food.

brh: آن بائیک؟ اندا کہ زو راخین، نال مباونے کے پریشان مرے رے۔ بس ئے پینچ دے پرے پیندی سراغ زو برک۔ جوان جوان اما، ولے کنا سے شرط اسے۔ نی
en: [...]? Just so that he comes back soon, so that I don't get worried. He only [stays away] five days and then comes back soon. Fine, fine, Mom, but I have one condition. You—
en_old: Is that so? Just that he should come soon, so that I don't get worried. He just comes back after five days. Fine, fine, mom, but I have one condition. You...

brh: ئے چوشہ شرط ئس اف۔ او مسوس نی؟ اما ٹھیک ئے مسے گڑاس ہم پارے۔ آپا انت نا شرط؟ کنے سکول اٹ داخل کر۔
en: —it's not that kind of condition. Did you agree? Mom, it's fine, it's settled, say something too. Apa, what condition? Enroll me in school.
en_old: ...there's no such condition. Did you agree? Mom, okay, say something. Sister, what condition? Enroll me in school.

brh: ٹھیک ہی اگر نا شوق خوانے نا ارے، گڑا دانا زی آ سوچ کین۔ ہاؤ ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی
en: All right, if you have a desire to study, then we will think about it. Yes, all right, all right.
en_old: Okay, if she has a passion for studying, then let's think about it. Yes, okay, okay.

brh: کنے تو داسے سازش ئس لگنگٹی ئے او ہم کنا خلاف نہ تو داڑان مست اسل دن متنے انت فیصلہ ئس کہ مسونے کنیا ضرور ارفنگانے داسے ماسٹرز بننگٹی ئے کنے خبر اف
en: To me this seems like some conspiracy, and against me too. Otherwise it was never like this at all before. Whatever decision has been made, it has surely been taken against me. Now some master is coming, and I don't know about it.
en_old: To me this seems like some conspiracy, and against me too. Otherwise it was never like this before. Whatever decision has been made, I'll surely have to take it up. Some master (teacher) seems to be coming, I don't know.

brh: اسے پولیس والا ئس بننگٹیئے کنے خبر ئے تو گڑا ٹھیک ئے نم تینا فیصلہ تینا وڑٹ کبو ہم تینا فیصلہ تینا وڑٹ کیبو جیو
en: When even a policeman is coming, I know about it. So then, fine: you make your decision your own way, and I too will make my decision my own way. Fine.
en_old: Some policeman seems to be coming, I know. So fine, you make your decision your own way, make your decision your own way. Okay.

brh: کنا کچک گپہ شکنی تیوہ کنا مونا کلئے کسفوی
en: My dogs [...] all of them, right in front of me, every one of them must be killed.
en_old: My dog, don't say a word, I'll kill everyone in front of me.

brh: او ماسٹر صاحب ماسٹر صاحب ماسٹر صاحب بابو السلام علیکم تولبو تولبو تولبو السلام علیکم وعلیکم
en: Oh, Master sahib, Master sahib, Master sahib! Babu, assalamu alaikum. Sit down, sit down, sit down. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum...
en_old: Oh, master sahib, master sahib, master sahib, sir, peace be upon you. Sit down, sit down, sit down. Peace be upon you. And upon you.

brh: وعلیکم السلام۔ تل بو، تل بو۔ ماستر صاحب، انت حال ئے بچا؟ جان ئے سر۔ تل بو، بخیر اٹ۔ تل بو بخیر اٹ۔ ماستر صاحب انت حال ئے نما؟ انت حال ئے نما، ٹھیک ٹھاک وری خیر خیریت ئے اللہ نا شکر۔ مہربانی۔
en: Wa alaikum assalam. Sit, sit. Master sahib, how are you, my dear? Fine, sir. Sit, welcome. Sit, welcome. Master sahib, how are you? How are you all? Fine and well, everything is well, thanks be to God. Thank you.
en_old: And peace be upon you. Sit down, sit down. Master sahib, how are you, son? Fine. Sit down, welcome. Sit down, welcome. Master sahib, how are you? How are you, all fine? All is well, thanks to God. Thank you.

brh: ئے بس سوٹ، نم تون اسیتس کروئی اسکا۔ جی ہو، حکم کبو۔ نما دا چنا ماشاءاللہ باز لائقو چنا سے، و دا دے خواننگ نا باز شوق
en: [...] just, I needed to have a word with you. Yes, please, go ahead. This child of yours, mashallah, is a very capable child, and he has a great passion for studying
en_old: ...just, I had to have a word with you. Yes, please go ahead. Your child, mashallah, is a very bright child, and she has a great passion for studying.

brh: ئے دا خواہٹ کہ نم دا اسکول اٹ داخل کیو۔ تافے اسکول اٹ۔
en: and the wish is that you enroll him in this school. Him, in the school.
en_old: ...it is my wish that you enroll her in this school. Your daughter, in the school.

brh: ئے لوٹی داخل کین تو دا تہم رٹیکے ارے کنا کوپہ جوڑ مسنے دا خوانو ہینتہ ساسن کروئی نہ بابا الے دے کورے چرفے نیلوم دن پاپا
en: If we enroll him, then he too [...]; he has become my support (literally: my shoulder). If he studies, the goats will need [tending]. No, sir, let him take the flock out to graze. Brother, don't say that.
en_old: ...if we enroll the girl, then this kind of thing... my shoulder has healed, she will study, the week... no, father, ... like that, papa.

brh: شیف بننگ اٹی او گڑا ئے امر کیو؟ ہچ ہم کپہ خالی اورتا۔ اونا ننگ آن نت مرے ہچ مپہ خالی مہر مرے السلام علیکم
en: How will he do that thing while coming down? Don't do anything at all, only what is theirs. Let it not touch his honor, let nothing happen, let there only be love. Peace be upon you.
en_old: What will he do once he becomes a chef? Don't do anything, just leave it to them. May it be blessed, nothing else, just love. Peace be upon you.

brh: دادے رے، اسینہ دا ثناء ئے او ثناء دا اسینہ ئے اور ئے زلی اسینہ نا سنگت، ئے اٹ ثناء جمال نا سنگت، کنزہ بے بے نم ننا ہیتے تو بنبو
en: Here, look: Hasina, this is Sana, and Sana, this is Hasina. And that is Zali, Hasina's friend, and I am Sana and Jamal's friend. Kinza Bibi, all of you listen to what we are saying.
en_old: Here, this is Asina, this is Sana, and Sana, this is Asina, and this is Zali, Asina's friend, and this is Sana, Jamal's friend. Kinza, sister, listen to what we're saying.

brh: شیرے خان ارا غا ارا وخت بریک یا پفک ہا حل اچھا دنو آسانی ٹی پفک
en: Sher Khan, at what time does he come home, or does he not come? Ha, solved. Okay, he doesn't come that easily.
en_old: Sher Khan, whenever he comes to the house or leaves... okay, solved. He does it that easily.

brh: آخیر نم کنے دا پاپو کہ پیرو نا برام ازینت تو مرے یا مفک ادانہ حسابے خلیری استاد بس پیرو بسنے
en: In the end, you tell me this: will Piro's wedding with Zeenat happen or not? You do the reckoning for this. Master, enough, Piro has come.
en_old: In the end, tell me whether Piro's wedding will happen or not, according to these calculations, master. Just Piro has come.

brh: ارے بے وقوفو، چریا، گنوکو، لوسی، لاچار، اڈے نی گھنٹہ ویسی ئے جناتے تو ہیتا کریٹ، ارے دو خلکو سکنے جنات کم ہنار۔ استاد محترم، نی ٹی
en: Hey, you fools, crazy ones, madmen, idiots, wretches! Look, I have been talking with the jinns for twenty hours; hey, with a touch the jinns have lessened. Respected master, in you...
en_old: Hey, you fools, crazy, idiots, mad, helpless people! You've been talking to the jinns for twenty hours. Hey, ... the jinns won't go away. Respected master, in you...

brh: ئے کمال رے کنے جناتے واپس خائفیس واپس نیٹی ہمو حساب کتاب ارے کنے جناتے خائفیس او خواجہ نا کرم ئے پیر جان نا کرم ئے پیر جان بسونے استاد ہا
en: Wow, amazing! You called the jinns back for me, back! That same reckoning is in you. Hey, you called the jinns for me. It is the grace of the Khwaja, the grace of Pir Jan. Pir Jan has come, master, ha.
en_old: Wow, amazing, you drove the jinns back for me! The same calculations are in you. You drove the jinns away for me. It's the grace of the Khwaja, the grace of Pir Jan. Pir Jan has come, master.

brh: السلام علیکم او وعلیکم السلام وعلیکم السلام میر جان ارے نی تو اسل خوش قسمت و بندغس ئس ارے ناکارے مبا زومرے کک خالی ابانا با
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace, upon you be peace, Mir Jan. Hey, you are truly a lucky person. Hey, your work... may it be done soon. Just... father's...
en_old: Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you, peace be upon you, Mir Jan. Hey, you're truly a lucky person. May your work be done quickly, just...

brh: وری پس ابا سہی ابا تانکہ شارن خلقا برے اسینہ نا توسانگو برم پین اسیتو مریک بے وقوف نالائق نی کنا ہستادے یقین افک
en: Well then, father, all right, father, until the townspeople come... Hasina's engagement and wedding will happen with someone else. You fool, you good-for-nothing, you don't believe in my master.
en_old: Come on, okay, bring it from the city/village... Asina's... with another one. Foolish, worthless one, you don't believe in my master.

brh: کنا اوست اٹ اندو تعویز ئس اٹکنے مچا عمر مسٹ نا مرو مپرو ہی ہمار استاد ہراس مریس اندو تیز مسوس
en: Such an amulet has got stuck in my mind, my whole life... whether it happens or not. Hey, master, whoever you may be, you have become so sharp.
en_old: An amulet like this is hanging on my heart, my whole life... Master, whoever you are, you've become so sharp.

brh: ولے ولے دا ار کنے اسہ جوان ء پزور ء خراسے توئی مرے خراس الائی، خراس تو ننا وراٹ اسائی
en: But, but look, I need one good, strong ox. There is no ox; as for an ox, there was one at our house...
en_old: But, but give me one good, strong donkey, a donkey. A donkey is with us...

brh: افک ولے بیا ئے گنڈس پیسہ تو زانٹ پیسہ تو زانس تو دنکا سے خراس ئس سمجھوسے اماں ئس دا چے خراس تو زنگ باز مشکل ئے ارے ہلی بو دے
en: No, but come, here is some money. Take it as money, consider it as if it were an ox. Getting an ox is very hard. Hey, take it, all of you.
en_old: No, but come, if you tie it, you'll know, if you know... you'd think it's like a donkey... Mother, this donkey, living is very hard, take it.

brh: دا ایتا تے دا ایتا تے انت کیرے نی کسء پیسہ غاتے
en: Give these, give these! What are you doing with someone's money?
en_old: These, these, what do you do with them? Someone's money...

brh: او سدھن کشی ہمو تعویز کنے ستا تاکہ ئے اودے پوکیو وقت آہ تعویز ئے ایتو ونے گڑا جوانی اٹ پوکیس تا انتئے نی چریایوس کانا مطلب نی نی بزور اٹ بزور
en: And he pulled out that very amulet he gave me so that I would bury it. When I gave you the amulet, you were then supposed to bury it properly. Why did you go crazy? What I mean is, you, you did it by force, by force.
en_old: He tied it tightly, the same amulet he gave me so I would bury it. When I gave you the amulet, you should have buried it properly. Why did you go crazy? I mean, you did it by force, by force.

brh: دا دے دا دے تعویز دا دے ہپو چٹیکیس ہومسس شار نا کلان مرغون انگا درخت نا سئے
en: This one, this one, this amulet, take this one and tie it up at the top of the tallest tree in the town.
en_old: This one, this amulet, take this one and hang it on the tallest tree in the village, that one.

brh: جی ئنا تفستہ مزیٹ پدا دادے لروٹ کیس تاکہ ہوا لگتے ہوا کے لگتے بس چس کے ابا نا بس ابا یا ہوا لگے منٹ
en: Yes, I tied it, then hung it up so that the wind would hit it. So that the wind would hit it! Just... father, no, enough, father, let the wind hit it for a minute.
en_old: Yes, I tied it, then hung it on a tree so the air hits it. Let the air hit it, just a minute of air.

brh: دا تعویز خیرات ولدا نی ہتمے استاد ہراست پارے ہراست پارے ئے گھڑا کاوا ئے پاوے ابا درخت ٹی تنگانو اودے تاؤ لگے ننائے توبہ توبہ توبہ چریا مسنس ئے
en: This amulet, the offering, and then you brought it? The master who said it, who said it... 'go,' he says, 'father, hang it in the tree so the wind hits it.' God forgive us, God forgive us, God forgive us, he has gone crazy.
en_old: This amulet, charity, and then you... the same master who said it, who said it... what does it say? Father, it got hung in the tree, he grabbed it... God forgive us, God forgive us, he's gone crazy.

brh: لمہ تے نا پاپے لمہ تے نا پاپے نمے خولہ ئے ئے کاکے توبہ توبہ توبہ ابا نا بس سر بس پدا دیرے پائے ہا گولی پیپ ئے لمہ تے نا پاپے کاکے
en: Don't tell your mother, don't tell your mother! ... uncle. God forgive us, God forgive us, God forgive us. Father, no, enough, sir, enough. Then he says 'water'... the bullet... Don't tell your mother, uncle!
en_old: I'll tell your mother, I'll tell your mother! Your mouth... God forgive us, God forgive us. Father, just, just, then water... say it, the bullet... I'll tell your mother.

brh: ارے شاگردی پاہ استنا اینا ولے استنا اینا استنا اینا شاگردی بس بس بس کر دے پاہ بند کیتوس اینو بس بس بس بس ہپ ہپا ہپ ہپا نا استنا
en: Hey, discipleship... the master's today, but the master's today, the master's today... discipleship. Enough, enough, enough, stop it! You have put a stop to it today. Enough, enough, enough, enough. Hup, hupa, hup, hupa... the master's...
en_old: Hey, disciple, the step... master, but master, master, discipleship... enough, enough, enough, stop it, I've stopped the steps today, enough, enough, enough, hup hup ha, hup hup ha, master.
