brh: صاحب نما باز باز مہربانی باز مہربانی نما نمے کتو سے تادی ہرمور مسٹ یاد بس کنے صاحب ونت بس کنے
en: Sir, thank you very, very much, thank you so much... you... I remembered, sir... it came to me.
en_old: Sir, thank you very, very much, thank you very much, ... I remembered, sir, I remembered.

brh: پوتونکس اسکہ پوتونکس او ودر جی سر نی دونکت دا شیر خانی درک مونگیا جی اونا پوتونکی تیتے جی سر اسے تس نا خیال کیس پوتونکا ٹھیل کے گڈاس اونا سورہ پورا مریر
en: A shoe, a shoe... yes sir... there's no trace of this Sher Khan. Yes, his shoes... yes sir, take care of one of them... the shoes... then his... will be complete.
en_old: Grandchildren... yes sir, there's still no trace of this Sher Khan. Yes sir, take care of his grandchildren, and then his wishes will be fulfilled.

brh: جی سر۔ نمو برخیتہ کشوتے لزئی فکر مفس۔ نہ نہ سر توبہ توبہ دا ہن پیننگس نہ سر دن کپرا کل گڑاک تے تو انشاءاللہ نی بے فکر مر۔ سر انتو نم بلو پکا ڈورے۔ توبہ توبہ توبہ کان ماما۔
en: Yes sir. Don't worry about your share. No, no, sir, God forbid, God forbid, [don't say] such a thing; no sir, I won't do that. All of it, God willing, don't you worry. Sir, what, you're a big... God forbid, God forbid, God forbid, uncle.
en_old: Yes sir. Don't worry about your share. No, no, sir, God forbid, don't say such a thing, sir, I wouldn't do that. Everything will be given, God willing, don't you worry. Sir, what a big... God forbid, God forbid, uncle.

brh: دا مارے اللہ ہدایت کیتہ دا وقت اسکان اونا درک اف۔ پیرو! او پیرو!
en: May God guide this boy; until now there's no trace of him. Piro! Oh Piro!
en_old: May God guide this boy, there's still no trace of him. Piro! Oh Piro!

brh: ئے دند دا وختہ سے ننا برننگ نا ئے گنے کاٹی منے ئے
en: I... at this time... of our coming...
en_old: ...at this time our coming...

brh: تے اینتی درست گمس بمبارس دا وخت ئتو شام ئنا مال و برگ ئے دا زتو شام ئنا نماز مس بابا دل مراد داسہ مسیت اینا کا نماز خواننگ کے۔ ماما دل مراد اینا کا مسیت نی نماز خواننگ کے۔
en: ...at this time it's evening, the time for the livestock; now it's time for the evening prayer. Baba Dil Murad is now going to the mosque to pray. Uncle Dil Murad goes to the mosque to pray.
en_old: ...it's evening now, time for the evening livestock, and it's time for the evening prayer. Baba Dil Murad is now going to the mosque to pray. Uncle Dil Murad is going to pray at the mosque.

brh: او وختس تو نی مونی تینا قبلہ غائے تے نماز خوان تینا باوا غمبر دا جمعہ ئے جمعہ نماز ایناکا ابا تو دا جمعہ ئے جمعہ نماز کنا کے ماما سکندر و حیات دا عید
en: At that time you face your qibla and pray... your forefather... the Prophet... this Friday he goes to the Friday prayer; father, this Friday, the Friday prayer... Uncle Sikandar and Hayat, this Eid...
en_old: Sometimes you pray facing your qibla... your father... this Friday, the Friday prayer, father... this Friday I'll do the Friday prayer, Uncle Sikandar and Hayat, this Eid...

brh: ئے ئے دا نماس خاٹنگ کے کاری نی ماما تے تینا زو خوڑکن خنا سو نا ماما تینا کبرٹی کارا نی تینا کبرٹی کاس ہر کس تینا ایمن نا جواب تینا ٹٹی تک اندا خاطرہ ماما دل مراد پاریکے نیاڑی تے
en: I, I... for this prayer... you, uncle... uncle goes into his own grave, and you go into your own grave; each person gives the answer for his own faith himself. That is why Uncle Dil Murad would tell the women...
en_old: ...for this prayer... uncle... each person lies in his own grave, and each answers for his own faith. That's why Uncle Dil Murad tells the women...

brh: نما سنگت آت سردار قطب خان گڈا خان نورزئی۔ توار توار ئس بننگ اٹی ئے ننا کن۔ جی او توار ئس
en: Your friends: Sardar Qutb Khan, then Khan Noorzai. A voice, a voice is coming toward us. Yes, it's a voice.
en_old: Your friend Sardar Qutb Khan, then Khan Noorzai. A sound is coming toward us. Yes, it's a sound.

brh: چاو کہ گڑاس نا گمس نا کلہ تفک نا کارتوس نا نڑجا گس بے خیال مسر
en: You know, something of yours is lost... the gun's cartridges... they were careless.
en_old: You know, some of the gun's cartridges went missing... they were careless.

brh: ئے چکو زور ئس کتنٹ۔ صاحب نمے معلوم ئس نہ کہ ئے بے گناہ اٹ۔ ون سیکنڈ ہرانٹ۔ یرغانی تو خلق نا رش ئے بسوس۔ ولے دا سپاہ دا شہر والا گن نا رند اٹ۔
en: I haven't used any force at all. Sir, don't you know that I'm innocent? One second, let me look. ... the crowd from the village... you came. But these troops are after this city man.
en_old: I didn't use any force. Sir, didn't you know that I'm innocent? One second, look. You've brought the village crowd here. But this soldier is after the city man.

brh: کنا خیالے نا تفک ہم گمے جی تفک تو تینا جاگہ ٹی کنا سنگت آک جاگہ ئس داڑے کیمپ خلکنو ہموڑے تخوکے بلے نم دا
en: I think your gun is lost too. Yes, the gun is in its place; my friends have set up a camp at a spot here, and it's kept there. But you, this...
en_old: I think the gun is lost too. Yes, the gun is in its place; my friends have set up a camp somewhere here, it's kept there. But you this...

brh: خداڑی ہو ننا بندغ نا ڈس و نشان ہندا کنڈ آ رسینگا دے ہندا خاطر آن ننا اونا رند اٹی اٹ جوان اللہ کے خیر اٹ مرے اونا پریشانی مر مرے نی کنے دا پاک ئے داڑے خوڑک
en: By God, yes, our man's trail led to this side, and that's why we are after him. Fine, may God make it turn out well; his trouble... You tell me this: is it near here?
en_old: By God, yes, our man's trail and traces were found on this side, that's why we're after him. Well, may God keep him safe and his troubles go away. You tell me this is clean; it's cold here.

brh: خلق ملک صریف ہاؤ داڑے رے مچے خلق خوڑ کٹے ولے ارخت یاری ارخ کنبو والیمبو ہوشی جان
en: The village, Malik Sharif... yes, here; the whole village is close by. But ... friend ... (unclear) ... be careful, dear.
en_old: Village, Malik Sharif, hey, come here, everyone gather, the village is cold... but how much, friend... be careful, dear.

brh: نی رنگینس، نی اوفتے خناٹ ہرا کاٹ تینے
en: You're a lively one; you [will] see them, the ones who ... themselves.
en_old: You're a lively one; you'll see those who harm themselves.

brh: جوان کریس، ولے دا وخت آ دا کنڈاٹیکو، دا وخت آ جاگہ سننگ جوان اف، اینو کہ ئے رغی سونٹ، ولے مچن ئے داڑے تنیا مروٹ، دا کنڈاٹ
en: You did well, but at this time on this side... at this time it isn't good to [be at] that place. Today I ..., but I'll be alone here [for a while], on this side.
en_old: You did well, but at this time from this side, at this time it's not good to go to that place. Today I've..., but tomorrow I'll be alone here, on this side.

brh: ننا کم بالکل داکا خورکے نم تینا ناری ڈکبو نم فکر کپبو ئے نما خیال داری ٹی مروٹ اوہا دا ٹارچے بیرہ غترفو
en: Our camp is right near here. You hide your women; don't you worry, I'll be keeping watch over you. Here, just [keep] this torch.
en_old: Our work is completely... don't run away, don't worry, I'll be looking after you. Just flash this torch.

brh: اگر نمے خطرہ ئس محسوس مس تو دا ٹارچے بند کبو ولدا یلہ کبو تہ ئے تینے سر کیو
en: If you sense any danger, switch this torch off and then on again, and I'll get myself to you.
en_old: If you feel any danger, turn this torch off and then turn it on again, and I'll reach you.

brh: بس اما بس، انگہ نی پاسہ کیو، بے خطائے، بے کسر
en: That's it, just that. As you say, I'll do it, without mistake, without fail.
en_old: That's all, just that. As you say, I'll do it, without fault, without fail.

brh: او با تو ہنت داڑے ہم گل بے بے ہم بارو تیز و نڑیارے گل بے بے کے کرے شکر کشبو شہر والا نڑیارے خنتنس
en: Oh, so ... here too. Gul Bibi too ran off very fast. Gul Bibi ... Give thanks: the city man has run away. Didn't you see?
en_old: Oh, then come here too. Gul Bibi, Gul Bibi also runs very fast... thank God, the city man ran away, did you see?

brh: قصور ء ننا کل نا عزت ء مش تے ٹی ملائفے اسہ گؤ کنا دو ٹی برے ئے اودے زندہ الیپروٹ کنا مار نا ایڑ دونو مسے اسہ پت او تینا زند ء برباد مننگ نا بچفنگ نا خاطر اٹ دن کرینے امی یقین
en: The fault... he has dragged the honor of all of us into the dirt. If he ever falls into my hands, I won't leave him alive. My son, your sister has turned out like this... A father has done this to save his own life from being ruined, I'm sure of it.
en_old: The fault... he has dragged all our honor into the dust. If one of them falls into my hands, I won't leave him alive. My son's sister... a father did this to save his life from being ruined, I'm sure.

brh: انت اسے؟ ایڑے میر بہادر خان نا کنا مسنا رندٹی ئے او داسا نی اودے کسم نا رندٹی اوس؟ اما میر بہادر خان نا قصہ داسا ختم مس، داسا ئے چاو کنا کاریم چاو۔
en: What is it? There, Mir Bahadur Khan is after my daughter, and now you are after killing him? Well, Mir Bahadur Khan's story is over now. Now I know my business, I know.
en_old: What is it? Mir Bahadur Khan was out to kill me here, and now you're out to kill him? Well, Mir Bahadur Khan's story is over now. Now I'll take care of my own work.

brh: اگہ میر بہادر خان کنا مونا بس تو ئے اودے زندہ الیپروٹ۔ ہیلو؟ ہیلو؟ ہیلو؟ ہیلو؟
en: If Mir Bahadur Khan comes before me, I won't leave him alive. Hello? Hello? Hello? Hello?
en_old: If Mir Bahadur Khan comes in front of me, I won't leave him alive. Hello? Hello? Hello? Hello?

brh: واہ ہن مس دنا فون ئے جہانزیب نا فون اسکا ہندوارے کہ شیریں ملیا یا نہ؟ کنا مسٹ شیریں نا ئے جگ خبر پکا سما فرما
en: Wow, it went [dead] like that. [Call] the phone, Jahanzeb's phone, and see whether Shireen has been found or not. Get me definite news of my daughter Shireen.
en_old: Wow, so it happened. Call Jahanzeb's phone and see whether Shireen has been found or not. Get sure news of my daughter Shireen.

brh: تنگ اینانے اسے کنڈ آن دا بازوخان کنے پریشان کرینے ایلو کنڈ آن جھانزیب دا کل نا دیوار مس اچے ہوش ٹی کاری ملکوسٹ
en: I'm fed up. On one side this Bazu Khan has been troubling me, on the other side Jahanzeb has become a wall in the way of all this. I'm in no state of mind to get anything done.
en_old: I'm fed up. On one side this Bazu Khan has been troubling me, and on the other Jahanzeb has become a wall in front of all this. I'm not in my right mind to get anything done.

brh: ایسے تو مشورہ کریسہ؟ احمد ورا دے نن قندھاوینا۔ نیس چپ کا، ئے تینٹ پریشان اٹ، پین پریشان کپہ کنے، ہنک۔
en: So what do you advise? Ahmed ... we ... Kandahar. You just keep quiet; I'm worried myself, don't worry me any more. Go.
en_old: So what's your advice? Ahmed, tomorrow we'll go to Kandahar. You keep quiet. I'm already worried myself, don't worry me any more. Go.

brh: شروال نا لڑی غنا زندگی بر خپ تڈی الوس ولدا پدا کپا نیکا سرنگیا سب ہرنگ ناٹ کا وتنا ورائی او ماتی پٹی وا کے بے سال مستوفتے الاسوٹ اناسوٹ دا کٹ ہمو کنا باز بلو
en: The shalwar's drawstring... life... again, back... don't... and mother... years passed; I had left them... this... that was a very big [thing] for me.
en_old: The thread of the shalwar... I never saw such a life, and then again... my mother and father... for years I kept them... this was a very big thing for me.

brh: جوان مس، کنے بسس؟ آن مس۔ خرماسس؟ خرماس؟ او، خرماسس کنے کننگ کے بننگ اٹ ئس نی تیر چونا خن تے خولکٹ۔
en: Good. Did it come at me? Yes. A wolf? A wolf? Yes, a wolf was coming to eat me; you ... [the torch?] ... its eyes...
en_old: Good. Did you come to me? Yes. Dates? Dates? Oh, dates. When you were coming to me, you opened your eyes.

brh: او مڑی سلیس، اندا خاطر ٹارچ آن اف کرے ٹو۔ ناصر؟
en: It turned and stopped there; that's why I switched the torch on and off. Nasir?
en_old: He turned back, so he switched off the torch. Nasir?

brh: نی داڑے ئے پریشان اٹ اسہ انت ہندا غٹ ہندا غٹ نا واسطہ ایچ اسہ مین ئے برے ئے کاوا ولے ولے ولے
en: You're here, and I'm worried. What is it? All this, for the sake of all this... just one minute, I'll come, I'm going... but, but, but...
en_old: You're worried here. What is it? All this, all this... for the sake of... come for a minute, come... but, but, but...

brh: جوان، نی خبر لگا، دا نا باز بلو قصہ سے سنگت، باز مجبوری، دا کنے
en: All right, you've found out. This is a very long story, friend, a great helplessness. This, me...
en_old: All right, you've heard the news. It's a very big story, friend, a real helplessness. This, for me...

brh: گما خوارس دانا بندغاک دانا کسم رندٹ ہننگو، ارے نی دا دیر انتس؟ اللہ خیر کے، سو مرے گڑا فیصلہ ئس کیلے کہ دانا انت پاو۔
en: The poor wretch is lost(?); his men will go after him to kill him. Hey, what's this delay of yours? May God keep us safe. If so, then let's make a decision about what I should tell him.
en_old: If you like, his people will go after him to kill him. Hey, what's this delay of yours? God keep us safe. If so, then let's make a decision about what to tell him.

brh: کن کے الیبو نو پدین ئے بریوہ بلکل خالت خرمار ئے داری
en: Let me go, then; I'll come back later, absolutely... the wolf ... I ...
en_old: Let me go, I'll come back later, for sure. Keep the dates.

brh: چکاس کنا؟ ہاؤ، بڑا خوش قسمت مرو، ئے جوان مرید
en: A bird, mine? Yes, he'll be very lucky. I'll be fine.
en_old: Checking me? Yes, you must be very lucky. You'll be fine.

brh: نی تینا پریشان کفتہ چک کسس او دا مشٹی بے قسم قسم نا جانور ارے زن باز دوستی نی زن ہر کس کے دوستی ء مگر چک کسس یا خرما لائی
en: Don't worry yourself; it was some bird. And on this mountain there are all kinds of animals. Women are very friendly; a woman is friendly with anyone. But whether it was some bird or a wolf...
en_old: Don't worry yourself about the child. There are all kinds of animals on this mountain. Women love a lot, women love just about anyone, but the child or the dates...

brh: کنا خنتٹ تما او مونی سلیس ہاؤ واقعی زند جی ہچ نہ نی آرام کر
en: It caught my eye and stood in front of me. Yes, truly, life is nothing. No, you rest.
en_old: It passed before my eyes and went on ahead. Yes, really, life is nothing. No, you rest.

brh: ایو منٹ دے۔ نہ نہ نی مرام کے کنے چھوٹا کر۔ خدانے سلامت کے نی زندہ مروئی ئے ہنوٹ۔ اچھا۔
en: Give me one minute. No, no, you rest, let me go. May God keep you safe; you must stay alive. I'm going. All right.
en_old: One minute. No, no, do what you want, just let me go. May God keep you safe, you have to stay alive. Go. Okay.

brh: زندہ نا دے کلیہ سسکے وڑائے لاٹھی ناٹ۔ شیر خان! انسان کرے کم عقلی ٹی بلو غلطی ئس کیک۔ جیو صیب، او دا غلطی نا اوت بلو نقصانس بریک۔ دوکانو نی نقصان مسونے؟ جی
en: The days of life are all ... like a stick. Sher Khan! A person makes a big mistake out of foolishness. Yes, sir, and a big loss comes from that mistake. Did you suffer a loss at the shop? Yes.
en_old: The days of life are all like a stick. Sher Khan! In his foolishness a person makes a big mistake. Yes, sir, and that mistake brings a big loss. Did you have a loss at the shop? Yes.

brh: بیٹا! ہمو رے بلو درخت پوتونکے تغاٹا خاچاٹا۔ دن کنڈا پی کرے رے ولے مزاٹی خاچو کسٹا! ارٹ دے کنے الہ ولے تساکس؟ انت کنے ہنگم سر؟ بتا!
en: Son! There, by that big tree, I would put down my bundle and sleep. [I got by] like that, but I slept in comfort! Two days, but did any of God's people give me anything? What was there for me? Tell me!
en_old: Son! That big tree, I slept with my shoes as a pillow. I did it like that, but I slept happily! Two days, God, but who gave it to me? What, my bad times? Tell me!

brh: اسلام علیکم بو۔ این جی زو۔ شرخانی نی توتے۔ صاحب۔ داتے اوڈے۔ نما باز باز مہربانی۔ گواشر نا۔ کامبو۔ ورگ۔ ونم۔ دادے مر۔ او دادے ہرفیو۔ داتے ۔ تمبر۔ داتے؟ نی توتے۔ چپ کر۔ ہی
en: Assalamu alaikum, everyone. [Unclear], quickly. Sherkhani, you [unclear]. Sir. These are over there. Thank you very, very much. [Unclear]. Go. [Unclear]. This one... And I'll pick this one up. These. [Unclear]. These? You [unclear]. Be quiet. Hey.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. ... Sher Khan, you stay. Sir. These, over there. Thank you very, very much. ... Go. Take it. ... This one, take it. Pick that up. These. ... These? You stay. Be quiet.

brh: بھلے ننا مہمان ئس چلو ئے ہم بریت تولٹ
en: All right, he's a guest of ours. Come on, let him come in too and sit.
en_old: All right, a guest of ours is leaving, let him come too, sit down.

brh: ایلم! ہا ایلم، ہن مس۔ او ایلم، خیر ئے ایلم!
en: Brother! Hey brother, it's gone. Oh brother, is everything all right, brother?
en_old: Sister! Hey sister, it's gone. Oh sister, is everything alright, sister!

brh: دا تیر اسک، او کنا سادنگا ایلم، ہنا تو سناسکئے، درو اینے پاریٹ ایئرپورٹ نا تتے، ہاؤ، نین توے سک، ہنا اسکے، ہائے قسمت
en: This was a lucky draw, oh my naive brother. It went, and you [let it slip]. Yesterday I told you about the airport, yes, and you didn't [listen]. It's gone. Oh, fate!
en_old: This was a mistake, oh my naive sister, it went and you lost it, yesterday I told you near the airport, yes, you didn't believe it, it went, oh what luck.

brh: دا ثناء اسسک؟ او ہندا ثناء۔ خیر، دا صفا ہند سے کت وڑ کریس۔ ایلم، مبارک مرے نی ئے کاریم ایلاٹ۔ انتئے؟ ایلم، ئے استاد اف نہ، ئے کنے پاک نی
en: Was this Sana? Yes, that same Sana. Anyway, you did this exactly that way. Brother, congratulations to you: I quit the job. Why? Brother, he's no master [of mine], is he? He [unclear] me.
en_old: Was this Sana? Yes, the same Sana. Anyway, you did this place up really well. Sister, congratulations on your work, sister. Why? Sister, you're not a teacher, are you, you tell me.

brh: اوئے ستی شاٹ کیسہ نی تینٹ پا ئے وختس بے ایمانی کرینوٹ نہ کرینو نی بالکل بے ایمانی کرینس تو بس ئنا ئے ئے نکاری لغتس خلکوٹ الاٹ
en: Hey, [unclear]. You tell me yourself: have I ever been dishonest? I haven't. You were completely dishonest, so I just gave your job a kick and left.
en_old: Hey, you're showing off, tell me yourself, have I ever been dishonest or not? You were totally dishonest, so I just hit you with a word of refusal on that.

brh: باز جوان کریس کنا ایلم باز جوان کریس خیر ئے داسہ کاوہ دفترا نی تول ئے ولدا بریوہ صحیح او قسمت ہائے میرو ہمو چانس ئس مس کریٹ
en: You did very well, my brother, you did very well. Well, I'm going to the office now. You sit, I'll come back. Right. Oh, fate! Alas, Meeru, I missed that chance.
en_old: You did very well, my sister, you did very well. Well, now I'm going to the office, you stay, I'll come back. Right, oh luck, oh my, that was the chance I had.

brh: ئے نو سوٹ ایئر پورٹ ئے ئے کئیت کرسا گاڈی ٹی تودٹ سوٹ دا ثمر کے دا ثمر کے دعا و سلام کیو سوٹ تو میرو نا شرم ئے ثمر کے چل
en: I would have gone to the airport, I would have sat in the car waiting, I would have greeted this Samar, this Samar, with prayers and salaams. Then Meeru's shame... Samar, come on.
en_old: When we went to the airport, I got in the car crying, this Samar, this Samar, I was greeting and praying, so out of my embarrassment Samar, come on.

brh: ارے بائے تینا بند کرک چریا، نی خبر اف کہ او ہمو
en: Hey brother, shut yours, you crazy one. Don't you know that she's that one...
en_old: Hey brother, shut your mouth, you crazy one, don't you know that he is the same one?

brh: طوفانو نیاڑی اسے
en: ...she's a stormy woman.
en_old: A stormy woman.

brh: جی جی کہ نما براہوئی ادب اٹ سندھی ادب اٹ باز بلو دو اسے، جی جی باز بلو کاریم اسے۔ سندھ اٹ براہوئی ادب آ خاص کاریم مننگ اٹی ء یا خاص مسنے۔ براہوئی ادب نا بارہ اٹ انت پاریرے سندھی ادب سندھ اٹ۔ بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم، اول تو ئے مچے
en: Yes, yes, so in your Brahui literature, in Sindhi literature, there is a very big hand. Yes, yes, it's a very big contribution. In Sindh, special work is being done, or has specially been done, on Brahui literature. What would you say about Brahui literature, about Sindhi literature, in Sindh? In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. First of all, I [would like] all...
en_old: Yes, yes, in our Brahui literature and Sindhi literature this is a very big step, yes, yes, a very big work. In Sindh, special work has been done on Brahui literature. What would you say about Brahui literature in Sindhi literature in Sindh? In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, first of all...

brh: جی ہسٹری نا کنڈ آ کاو کہ سندھ ٹی براہوئی تمام بھاز ء قدیم دوران ئ تقریبا شش ہفت ہزار سال آن ئ کہ نا دا بنوسنے بابا خوشی محمد کہ نا دا سندھ لفظ ارے اینو او براہوئی نا سندھ
en: Yes, if I go toward history: Brahui in Sindh is very, very ancient, from roughly six or seven thousand years ago. Baba Khushi Muhammad has noted that this word 'Sindh' that exists today is the Brahui 'Sindh'.
en_old: Yes, if we go toward history, Brahui in Sindh is very ancient, from about six or seven thousand years ago, Baba Khushi Muhammad has written that the word Sindh exists, today it is the Brahui word Sindh.

brh: لفظی اسل ہرا کہ دراوڑی ئے حد سندھ حد ہرا کہ نن پانہ واہ ہرا کہ بھاز مشی آ کسرہ اینگی کسرہ کشت کشار میدانی ڈوار والا کسرہ یعنی او ہموڑے ہرا کہ پیر و مریگی باقاعدہ پارنے کہ را سندھ لفظ ہرا دراوڑی
en: Its literal origin, which is Dravidian: 'had', boundary. Sindh is a boundary, what we call a 'wah' [canal], which is a path running along the mountains, a [unclear] path, a path through cultivated fields, a path along a stream in the plains. That is, the elders there have explicitly said that this word 'Sindh' is Dravidian.
en_old: The word's origin, which is Dravidian, 'hadd', Sindh means boundary, what we call a path, a very wide path, a path along fields, cultivation and plains, that is, that place, and the elders have stated plainly that the word Sindh is Dravidian.

brh: ارونا معنی کہ فلو دیرنا وہنگ یا حد۔ حد۔ اونا ارٹمی کو معنی دا کنے کے کہ دا نہڑی کر سیم کشیرہ، او بس حد سے نا او کہ سیم اور سند دا ہرتو لفظ براہوئی نا او
en: Its meaning is 'flow', the flowing of water, or 'boundary'. Boundary. Its second meaning, as I see it, is that they draw a boundary, and it's just a boundary. So 'sīm' and 'sind': both these words are Brahui.
en_old: Its meaning is the flow of water or a boundary. Boundary. Its second meaning, as I'd put it, is that they draw a line in the furrows, it is just a boundary, so 'seem' and 'sind', both these words are Brahui.

brh: براہوئی اوڑ بھاز قدیم ئے اوڑان پد ہر انڈس سولائزیشن نا ہرا کہ تہذیب ارے سندھو تہذیب نا، او نا باقاعدہ کلیئر پارہ کہ بھئی او براہوئی تا او، موہنجوداڑو مرے یا داڑے بلوچستان ٹی مہر گڑھ
en: Brahui is very ancient there. After that, the Indus Civilization, which is the civilization, the Sindhu civilization: they state quite clearly that, well, it belongs to the Brahuis, whether it's Mohenjo-daro or Mehrgarh here in Balochistan.
en_old: Brahui is very ancient there; after that, the Indus Civilization, the civilization of the Sindhu, they state clearly that it belongs to the Brahuis, whether it's Mohenjo-daro or Mehrgarh here in Balochistan.

brh: دا دور نا صیب این سندھی شعر اسے جبلن جی ڈوئی جو آڈو آریچن کے وٹھی واٹ ویا برفت بروہی رنجن مین روئی پسا شالہ پنو کے بس دا شاعری کرے شاہ لطیف کرے نی دا دور کرے بلوچستان ٹی نصیر خان نوری نا دور ئے
en: Sir, from this era there is a Sindhi verse: 'Jablan ji dui jo aado Arichan ke, vathi vaat viya, barfat Brohi ranjan main roi pasa shala Punhu ke.' Just this: this poetry was composed by Shah Latif. This era, in Balochistan, is the era of Naseer Khan Noori.
en_old: From this era is a Sindhi poem: 'Jablan ji dui jo aado arichan ke vathi vaat viya barfat Brohi ranjan main roi pasa shala Punho ke' — this poetry was composed by Shah Latif; this was the era, in Balochistan it was the era of Naseer Khan Noori.

brh: اچھا ارا ٹمبک اوئے دادے کہ نصیر خان نوری نا شکار پور نا شہر اٹی۔ آئنہ ہمونا مسیت قائم ئے کہ اوار تما 1761 ٹی۔ دنگا انڈیا غا ہنا نادر شاہ افشار نا ہندا پاننگا تو دنگا کہ ہنا کہ انڈیا غا تو ہندا دے او سے جوڑ

en: He established the madrasa and built a mosque for offering prayers, and its foundation was laid by the great scholar of Sindh, Taj Muhammad Shah Amroti, with his own hands. Mashallah, very good.
en_old: He established the madrasa, built a mosque for offering prayers, and its foundation was laid by the great scholar of Sindh, Taj Muhammad Shah Amroti, with his own hands. Mashallah, very good.

en: What were you doing? And Sher Khan, if we leave you here, someone else will take you, Sher Khan. With us it's fine, we know you; with the others you won't manage. No, no, no, no, no, you won't sleep here; I'll just go my own way. Get up, friend; pull him, pull him.

en: To the police station? Come on, friend, for God's sake, I beg you, you are a good man ... you were a very, very good friend of mine, you were an old friend; at least have some regard for that friendship of mine. Get up from there, get up from there; get up, get up.

brh: دیر ارے؟ نن سکندر آیاٹٹ۔ بہ دروازہ ملہ ماما کنا۔
en: Who is it? It's us, Sikandar's people. Come, open the door, my uncle.
en_old: Who's there? We're Sikandar's people. Come open the door, uncle.

brh: ساہ ننا کشا نن نیمہ غاک پرنگا توغاں ارے ملتہ خولنگوسن ایلم خیر ئے دا نن نیمہ غاک او میر سنگت اسے اینا سم گوازی ئے
en: You scared us to death! At midnight, startled out of our sleep, we were terrified. Brother, is everything all right? It's midnight; oh Mir, [you're] a friend, what kind of game is this today?
en_old: We nearly died of fright. It's midnight and we were asleep... we had dozed off. Brother, is everything all right? It's midnight, and Mir, a friend... what kind of game is this today?

brh: ئے کنا دوستی کنا جان پارین نی ہم خنین۔ ساہ نننا کشارے نم پارین آخر دز مز ئس بسونے ماما خیر تو رے دزی مزی نا ارادہ تو بتونے رے۔ پیر تا پیروئے پوک، اگر اللہ خوار زادہ متو کنا بوزے پرغاتے
en: Hey, my friend, my dear, we said, 'Let's go see you too.' You scared us to death; we thought some thief or other had finally come. Uncle, it's all right, we didn't come with any intention of stealing. Piro ... in vain; if, by God, it weren't for my nephew, my face would have been smashed.
en_old: Hey, my friend, my dear, tell me, did you see it too? You scared us to death. You'd think a thief had come after all. Uncle, it's fine, there was no plan to steal anything. Pir's... if Allah hadn't disgraced him... my goats...

brh: اوئے ہم نی تو سما اسدے بے عقلے باوہ غم خوار شرم بفک نی ماماتے تینا پاسہ باوہ خیر تو اسکہ نم نن نیمہ غا بس تورے اوہو ایڑنا سندانگ سنگت
en: Hey, you too, you knew, you fool! My dear man ... aren't you ashamed, saying this to your uncles? It was all fine, but you came at midnight. Oho, [my] sister's ... friend.
en_old: Hey, you know, one day, you fool... father is grieving, you have no shame, you call your uncles... father, it was fine when you came at midnight... oho, sister's... friend.

brh: ایسے نا ارا غے تاش گوازی کننگ کین ولدا دا کہ گدرینگا پارین کنا ایڑ تینا خنین ہورے نا حال و احوال کتنوں تے ئے تو گپ متنے اوڑتو۔ ہیلو دا نن نیمہ غا دا وخت ئس حال و احوال نا بننگ نا نمے تو سما ء بیرو نا باوہ داڑے اف۔ نن مگ
en: We were playing cards at Ise's house; then when that was over, we said, 'Let's go see my sister; we haven't asked how she is, we haven't had a chat with her.' Hello! It's midnight, is this any time to come asking how people are? You know Piro's father isn't here. We ...
en_old: Let's play cards until then, and once that's over, say, my sister, look, we haven't asked how you are... we haven't spoken to her. Hello, it's midnight, this is no time to come asking how people are. You know Piro's father isn't here. We...

brh: او خلیپہ نا کتاب تا واختا نوا دزس برے ہوئے مخلوق کے کلے معلوم ئے کہ دا دن نا اورائے۔ پیرو نا باوا نا اورائے پین دن نا ئے کھڈے ٹکا ئے پیرو نا باوا خلے چٹ ضعیفہ نا دو آن اورائے لائے نا۔ او ایلوم ضعیفہ نا دو آن
en: Oh, in the days of Khalifa's books, maybe a thief would come; hey people, everyone knows whose house this is. It's Piro's father's house, whose else's would it be ... Piro's father left the house completely because of his wife. Oh brother, because of his wife.
en_old: In the times of the Caliph's books, a thief came... everyone knows whose house this is. It's Piro's father's house, whose else would it be... the ditch... Piro's father, completely at the old woman's hands... brother, at the old woman's hands.

brh: نورا الہ تو نرتو نمار تو ماتا دوان بئے تنے تنے بشیر کنے سے چہرے بس ہا ہا ہا ہائے نن انت کرین کنا وجان او نورا الہ اینا دس کم پاسا نن انت نوم تو خلیفے رتہ چڑ لٹہ تسورتا ہاؤ دادا
en: Noorullah, you didn't run away ... from the hand ... Bashir, to me ... a face ... ha ha ha, oh! What shall we do, my dear? Oh Noorullah, don't say so much today ... what name ... Khalifa ... they gave him a beating with sticks. Yes, grandpa.
en_old: Nora, God, with the man... Bashir, a face came to me, ha ha ha! Oh, what have we done, my dear? Oh Nora, God, don't talk so much today... what name did we... the frightened ones got a beating, yes, grandpa.

brh: ہاو دے۔ بس۔ نن دا پاکو کن بسونو رے انتکے؟ نن دا خاطرم بسونو کہ نن نی پانے کہ نن شارا ایمپنہ۔ ئے ویٹ! شاراٹی بندغے پٹنگٹی؟
en: Yes, well. Enough. What have we come here to say? We've come for this reason, to tell you that we won't be going to the city. Hey, wait! [You're] searching for someone in the city?
en_old: Yes. That's enough. Why have we come here? We've come to tell you that we're leaving town. Hey, wait! Looking for someone in town?

brh: دا بلو مشکلو کاری مسے، اسدے نا کسے تو اسم لگنگ کیک دا کاری مٹ۔ واہ! دا ننے، ننے دا پاننگ کے بسونو رے کہ نن شار ایمپنا تو دا ہیتے نم دے آنم کننگ کریرے۔ بشبو ایمبو گڑا۔
en: This has become a really difficult job; one day someone could get caught up in this work. Wow! You came to tell us this, that we won't be going to the city; you could have said this in the daytime too! Get up, let's go then.
en_old: This is a very difficult job. One day someone could lose their life in this work. Wow! We came to tell you that we're leaving town, so you can deal with this in the daytime. Get up, let's go, then.

brh: کنا انت کہ توغے خراب کریرے بش مئے ایلوم کانے نو ایڑے نا موڈ اف بے بس خاب توغ ہم بل مل دروازے
en: What of it that you've ruined my sleep? Get up, brother, let's go now; sister isn't in the mood. Never mind, forget about sleep too; open the door.
en_old: What's it to me that you ruined my sleep? Get up, brother... sister isn't in the mood, it can't be helped, forget about sleep too... the door.

brh: ئے کاکا کڑپاسہ پیرو گنو پیرو گنو دا ماما تین بلہ گنو کرے
en: Hey uncle, you keep saying 'Piro is mad, Piro is mad', but it's this uncle himself who has made him mad.
en_old: Hey uncle, you're saying Piro is crazy, Piro is crazy, but it's this uncle himself who drove him crazy.

brh: بخت متو کنے، نی مار ئنا نی ایلم ئنا نی ارے نا۔ اوند مس، سردار فٹ پاتا خاچوکا کنا سرمس۔
en: I had no luck. You're my son, you're my brother, aren't you? What happened, Sardar, is that I got caught while sleeping on the footpath.
en_old: I've had no luck. You're my son, you're my brother, aren't you? What happened, Sardar, is that I slept on the footpath, that's what happened to me.

brh: گڈو! سردار تو دا خوش قسمتی کہ نن سر مسن، اگہ ایلو تھانہ والا تا دو ٹی تماکہ تو داسکان ڈرائنگ روم مس مسکہ سر۔ شیر خانی دو پا! ننے فٹ بال تتا خاچو کسوسے، بس ہم پاو نی ئے تینا و۔۔۔
en: Gaddu! Sardar, it's our good luck that we ended up with you; if we had fallen into the hands of the other police station's men, by now it would have turned into the 'drawing room', sir. Sher Khan, you tell them! We were sleeping on the footpath; just tell them yourself, your ...
en_old: Gaddu! Sardar, it's good luck that we got caught here. If we had fallen into the hands of the other police station, by now it would have been the 'drawing room', sir. Sher Khan, speak! We were sleeping on the footpath, just tell them yourself and...

brh: ئے پٹسا پٹسا دا گلی ئے گلی ہر جاگہ ایناٹ ئے پٹ تینا اولاداتے وریو ولے نہ اولادک ملا نہ لمبت ملا نہ باوت ملا نہ اورا ملا دا گلی ئے گلی ہر جاگہ ایناٹ
en: Searching and searching, this street, that street, everywhere I went, searching, looking for my children, but neither the children were found, nor their mother, nor their father, nor the house; this street, that street, everywhere I went.
en_old: Searching and searching, street after street, everywhere, today I search for my children, but I found neither the children, nor their mother, nor their father, nor the house, street after street, everywhere.

brh: ولے اسہ دستار ئس ہتو آخر پٹ کاوسے دروازہ ئس ٹکیفیو ولے براٹ نن نی مگہ دیر کا کہ دروازہ ئے ملو ئے بس توبہ ئس کنے دا پوتونک تے تینا ہموڑے فٹ پاتھ آ تٹ
en: But just a turban ... in the end I'd go searching and knock on a door, but brother, who would open the door for us? So, oh my, I laid these bundles of mine down right there on the footpath.
en_old: But I didn't get a turban, so in the end I went looking and knocked on a door, but brother, we... don't take so long to open the door... just, oh my, I put these shoes of mine there on the footpath.

brh: اموڑے خاچاٹ گڑا توبہ زن توغان ایناس کمال کیسہ صاب امر توبہ فکنے یقین چاس خلک دے نا وختس کے دا پیرو نا لمان تنگ مسوٹنے تو ایڑے منو پدو کسر
en: I slept right there. Then, oh my, woman, [waking] from sleep, you went ... You're amazing, sir! How ... oh my ... believe me, ever since the day I got fed up with Piro's mother, then, sister, the way back ...
en_old: I slept there, and then, oh my, woman, waking from sleep today, what a wonder you are, sir, how... oh my, believe me, the day I got fed up with Piro's mother, then sister, the way back...

brh: ولے اونا مقصد انت اسرا؟ ولے آریا ہراتم بسو تو اوتا کھلا بھلا مقصد دادے کہ سندھو دریا ہرا کشت و کشار ئس دیر نا بنیادی مقصد ئس کلچر نا، تہذیب نا، او گری دانا وئی قبضہ کننگ نا خواہش اسرا۔ تو اوتا قبضہ نا وجہ غان
en: But what was their purpose? When the Aryans came, their plain, main purpose was this: the Indus River, which was a land of farming and water. Their basic purpose was the desire to take over the culture, the civilization, and all of this. So because of their occupation...
en_old: But what was their purpose? When the Aryans came, their main purpose was the Indus River, its farmland and its water. Their basic aim was the desire to take over the culture and civilization. So because of their occupation...

brh: مچ آ دا تہذیب آک ڈسٹرائڈ مسنو۔ اسہ پورا تہلکہ ئس مچینگا۔ گڑا داڑے ہمو بندغ آک کہ ہرا کہ داڑے راہ رہباس، آرام اٹ ہمو سکون اٹ تینا کلچر ء ڈیولپ کریرہ، دا تیبے اسہ تہلکہ ئس
en: All these civilizations were destroyed. A complete upheaval took place. Then the people here, who lived here and had been developing their culture calmly and in peace, were hit by an upheaval.
en_old: All these civilizations were destroyed. A complete upheaval took place. The people who lived here had been developing their culture calmly and peacefully, and then came an upheaval.

brh: قسمس گڑاس رہ غریب غربا کو او دنگ ہم پیل ہمو علاقہ ٹی ہرا علاقہ ٹی کہ دا اینو جنوبی ہندوستان پاننگے گڑاس کرے ایلہ مہینار اور ہرا کہ گڑاس رہنگار او اینو براہوئی او
en: Some of them, some of the poor and needy, also spread into the area that today is called South India. Some went away, and those who stayed are today's Brahui.
en_old: Some of them, some of the poor people, went to the area that today is called South India and settled there, and those who stayed behind are today's Brahui.

brh: سندھ ئٹی سندھی او ار پین تینا مختلف کرے چنکو چنکو قبیلات آتے کہ دا اسکان تینا موجود او۔ اہم۔ شوکت صاحب، نم تو ئے جاری او؟ جی۔ چنکو وقفہ سے آن پد اسہ وار ولدا شرفدار آتا خدمت ئٹی حاضر مرون۔
en: In Sindh there are Sindhis and others too, their various small tribes, which still exist to this day. Hmm. Shaukat sahib, will this continue with you? Yes. After a short break we will once again be at the service of our honourable viewers.
en_old: In Sindh there are Sindhis and others too, with their various small tribes, who still exist to this day. Important. Shaukat sahib, are you continuing? Yes. After a short break we will once again be at the service of our honorable viewers.

brh: دے کرے ہورٹی ڈکے پا فائرنگ برام نمام مسنے فائرنگ نم کرے نورے داسہ نی پاسہ کے کا ہر فے فائرنگ نم کرے نورے مون تے
en: That day at the ... tell me about the firing: it happened at your wedding. Did you fire? Now you tell me who ... did you fire? Face up to it.
en_old: That day at the wedding... tell me about the gunfire. The wedding is over. Who did the firing? Now you tell me, who fired? Say it to my face.

brh: دفیرے یا تفیرے سدھا سدھا پاک او رٹی دے ڈھکے پ مرکو تے نرف گڑا اینے پاروٹ کے اندھیر فائرنگ کرنے انون سٹی کرنے ایچ پاپرے نیتے ندا خرنگ کپہ کنا
en: Whether you face it or not, tell me straight, straight out ... that day ... Then I will say that someone fired in the dark and did it without thinking. Don't say anything. Don't do this to me.
en_old: Whether you hit someone or fired, tell me plainly and honestly... someone fired in the dark... don't say such a thing to me.

brh: شکر خان دا ایتا تینے ٹپر دا خیسن کپہ خنت دے آخنے آ مون تیزہ یا تفیسہ جمشیر ئے کا مارکو تینا ہرفے گیو تینا دیر فائرنگ کرے نی دون سٹینے امر مونی تیو کنے خبر اف کہ دیر فائرنگ کرے
en: Shakar Khan, this ... don't glare at me red-eyed with anger. That day ... whether you face it or not, Jamsher's ... who fired? How can you speak so thoughtlessly, how am I to face this? I don't know who fired.
en_old: Shakar Khan... don't do this... Jamsher's son... whoever fired... how can you say this to my face? I don't know who fired.

brh: شکر خان فائرنگ کروکا نیوز مون تے سم سدھا پا تفے سم نرامبا سدھا پا جمشید نیتو مون تے نن کبر وسی ہناٹ کان ملک
en: Shakar Khan, the one who fired ... face up to it. The bullet: tell me straight, who fired the bullet ... tell me straight. Jamshed, face him with you ... we ... I went ... Malik.
en_old: Shakar Khan, the one who did the firing... tell me straight who fired the bullet, tell me straight. Jamshed, you didn't tell me to my face... we went... Malik.

brh: آبیدے دا تو فی الحال جک ئس سلک ہینا دا
en: Abid, for now this is just some foul talk ... it has gone by.
en_old: Abid, for now only this one thing is left.

brh: جوان او رے نا ویڈیو ء تو بند او کرے دا ہیتاتا کنا کاٹو کائک بالکل بالکل دا ہیتاتا نونا کاٹو خوامخواہ کائک عابد نی غم کپہ اونا سدھا کننگ کنا کاریم ء
en: Fine, hey, turn off your video. These things make my head spin, really, really. These things make your head spin for no reason. Abid, don't you worry, setting him straight is my job.
en_old: Fine, stop your video. These things give me a headache, really. These things give you a headache for no reason. Abid, don't worry, setting him straight is my job.

brh: زاہد خان خیر ئے رنگ ایننگ اٹ انس
en: Zahid Khan, is everything all right? You seem upset.
en_old: Zahid Khan, I'm fine, all is well.

brh: آ شکر خان ئے بنتی ننے نی غفر نی ابا نی بیگم نا قلی حمید آ تینا ایلم نا برام آ کرینوس فائرنگ او سم کینانو تمانو جمشیر نا وراٹی
en: Ah, Shakar Khan, listen to us: you, your father, your wife's ... Hamid, at his brother's wedding you fired, and the bullets went and landed in Jamsher's house.
en_old: Oh Shakar Khan, tell us: you, your father, your wife's... Hamid, at his brother's wedding you fired, and the bullet hit... it struck Jamsher's son.

brh: او جمشیر نی کہ کلو کرینے نی نا نصیحت ہمیدے پارینے کہ کنتو مون ایت نی پارینوس تینا مون تے فرق کے خبر اف کہ سنتو دے خلکنے دنیا ئے خبر ئے کہ ہمیدے نا ایر نا برامس وائرک نوم کریرے نما سنگت نان اونا ور
en: O Jamsher, what you did: you gave your advice and told Hamid, 'Face me.' You said it to his face ... What difference does it make? Who knows on what day it struck, but the world knows that at the wedding of Hamid's sister you fired shots into your friend's house.
en_old: Oh Jamsher, what you did... you advised Hamid and said, tell me to my face. You said it to his face... who knows on what day it hit, but the world knows that at Hamid's brother's wedding shots were fired, and your friend's son...

brh: داٹی تما نو شکر مس کہ بندہ وادی لگیتا وگر کنا ہیت الیسے جمشید تو مون ایتے نیکی جوان اوڑتو ہچ مون تفیرے سمک تمار تو تمار داٹی تو ہچ ہیت ئس اف او دا سم تے کنے انت خبر کہ ڈائریکٹ اوڈا کاری
en: They fell in there. Thank God no one was hit, otherwise ... my word ... Jamshed, face him ... fine, but you won't face him at all. The bullets fell, so they fell, there's no issue in that at all. And these bullets, how was I to know they would hit right there?
en_old: Thank God for this, otherwise... my word... Jamshed, you told him to his face... good... whatever bullets hit, they hit; there's no issue in that. How would I know the bullets would hit directly there?

brh: ننتو ابا ئے فائرنگ کرو۔ شکر خان نی دا ہیت ء باز چنک سمجھینوس۔ اچو کنتے صفا دا باز بلو ہیت اسے۔ دیوان نا اوراٹی دا سم تما نو دا چنکو ہیت اسے۔ اوڑتو مونی تے نی کہ جوانی نئے تو دانا پد باز خراب مرو۔
en: He'd fire at our father? Shakar Khan, you have taken this matter far too lightly. To me it is plainly a very big matter. These bullets fell in the diwan's house, and that's a small matter? If you don't deal with him properly, things will get very bad after this.
en_old: They shot at our father. Shakar Khan, you've taken this matter far too lightly. In my view it's a very big deal. A shot fired in the courtyard of the diwan is no small thing. If you don't deal with him properly now, things will get very bad after this.

brh: اوڑتو نی ہچ مونتے فیرنگ، اگے اللہ امانتی لگوس تک سوس گڑا گڑا زوری مونتے سوٹی، داسہ تو ہچ لگے تنے، اینو تما نو ہوائی فائرنگ، خوامخواہ خیر سمتے آخر واپس بروئی ئے ڈغار آ تموئی، داسہ او نن اینٹ خبر کہ او نوراٹ
en: There was no firing straight at him at all. If, God forbid, it had hit someone, you would have been forced to answer for it. As it is, nothing has hit anyone. Today it was just firing into the air, for no reason. But in the end a bullet has to come back down and land on the ground, and how are we to know whether it lands in your house?
en_old: Don't fire straight ahead with it at all. If, God forbid, it hits someone, then you'll have trouble on your hands. Right now it won't hit anyone. Today, don't fire into the air for no reason. In the end the bullet has to come back down and land on the ground, and we don't know where it will land.

brh: شکر خان کنا ایلم کنا ہیتے پومرک نی کے جوان ئے پر گنا دے ارمان کروس خوامخواہ نا ہیت نا زیا پڑاس مرو ولانے
en: Shakar Khan, my brother, understand what I'm saying. You think it's fine, but one day you will regret it. Over a pointless matter there will be strife, by God.
en_old: Shakar Khan, my brother, understand what I'm saying. You are fine for now, but one day you'll regret it. You'll fall into trouble over pointless talk.

brh: نی پورا کروس تنے جمشیر پورا کروتہ کنا ہیتے حل اور تو مونی تے اونا غلطی معاف کیک جمشیر توئی مون تفرے او دہنتس کروئی اونا کسر یلے اوتینٹ کے نی جوان کنے
en: You will settle it. Jamsher, settle what I said and resolve it. Face him and he will forgive the mistake. Jamsher, if you don't face him ... he has to do this much. Get out of his way and he will do it himself. Do me this good turn.
en_old: You've done it, Jamsheer. Do what I said and settle it, and after that he'll forgive his mistake. Jamsheer, you turn your face away... he has to do this much. Leave his path, he'll do it himself. You do right by me.
