en: Love is something pure, a feeling, and this was my sin: I loved you. My fault was that I took you for a pure, sincere human being, and that day [made you] the companion of my life.
en_old: A man, pure and kind... he did my wrong; I considered you a man, a pure human being, and that day [I made you] the companion of my life. (partly unintelligible)

brh: نسرین اینو کنے سنگتی نا کساس تینا ارا و تینا چنانی قدریم کتویس
en: Nasreen, today you did not value me, your companion, nor your own home and your own children.
en_old: Nasreen, today you didn't value even a little friendship with me, nor yourself and your children.

brh: آخر تینا ضدء پورو کریس، داسا نی کنا زندان پیش تماس، اوئی متکنا مہر و محبتء تینا وجودان کشاٹ، داسا کسس کنا استے پدی زندہ کپروئی، انتئے؟
en: In the end you got your stubborn way. Now you have fallen out of my life; I too have pulled all the old love and affection out of my being. Now no one can bring my heart back to life. Why?
en_old: In the end you fulfilled your stubbornness. Now you have finished completely from my life; I have pulled out all your love and affection from my being. Now no one can bring my heart back to life, why?

brh: ئے نیتے تینا زند خیال کریسوٹ۔ دروغ، دا کل دروغ او۔ نی تو صرف تینکن، تینا ذات کن سوچاسے۔ نی دا خوار تیویسے۔
en: I had thought of you as my life. Lies, all of this was lies. You only thought about yourself, about your own self. You have made this [home] miserable.
en_old: I considered you my life. Lies, all of this was lies. You only thought about yourself, about your own self. You made this miserable.

brh: کہ ئے نی تون سلیوک، کنے نیان نفرت ئے نفرت ئے کنے نیان، نی کنے دا زند آن نت کشوس
en: ...that I would stay with you? I hate you, I hate you. You have pushed me out of this life.
en_old: That I stayed with you... I hate you, I hate you; you have thrown me out of this life.

brh: ئے نیال سپدی چک خلپروٹک
en: I will never turn back to you.
en_old: I won't turn back from you.

brh: بو کنے توخ بننگٹی اف
en: Oh, I can't fall asleep.
en_old: Well, I don't feel like coming.

brh: خاچ کنا مار صوبہی اسکول ء ہنوئی ء۔ خنتہ ترپ شاہ بش خاچ۔ ممہ کنے توغ بننگ افٹی۔
en: Sleep, my son, you have to go to school in the morning. Close your eyes, well done, sleep. Mama, I'm not getting sleepy.
en_old: My son has to go to the provincial school. ... Mother, I'm not allowed to come late.

brh: نی او نن نیمہ مسونے نی ہاچ
en: You and we have been left half... you sleep.
en_old: You and we have become half... you sleep.

brh: خاچ شاباش خاچ تو نی خاچ اسہ گڑایم کوشش کیوہ خاچنگ نا ہو ئے خاچیو دا ئے خاچیو خاچ نی ہم خاچ شاباش ئے دا خاچ
en: Sleep, well done, sleep. Come on, you sleep. I'll try something too: sleeping. Yes, I'll sleep; look, I'm going to sleep. Sleep, you sleep too, well done, there, sleep.
en_old: Sleep, well done, sleep. You sleep, I'll try for something. It's time to sleep, sleep, sleep this. You too sleep, well done, this sleep.

brh: کسء پریشان مننگ نا انت ضرورت ہی ئے تینکے پریشان افٹک، ئے تینا چناٹکے پریشان افٹک، اوڑان بغیر اسہ ئے زند
en: What need is there for anyone to worry? I'm not worried about myself, I'm not worried about my children. Without him, a life...
en_old: What need is there to worry about anyone? I'm not worried about myself, I'm not worried about my children; without him, a life...

brh: نورین گپ ہنداتومصیبت ئے دا پریشانی ئے نی ودی کریس چنائے پریشان کریس اگر نی اولاد تون مہر مسکن تو گڑا انت ہندن کریس افسوس تو ہندائی تنے برام آن ملف انت انت وعدہ غاک
en: Noreen, the point is just this: you created this trouble, this worry; you upset the children. If you had love for your children, then why did you do this? The regret is just this: from the wedding on... what promises, what promises...
en_old: Noreen, the point is exactly this: you created this trouble and worry, you upset the children. If you had love for your children, then why did you do this? The regret is that you won't get out of it... what promises were made.

brh: مریرے اور برام مننگ تون کل گڑاک ختم مریرے اگر زرس برداشت کریرے تو دا ایتاک متورے آخری امر کرو سوٹک زندگیدریفنگ نا داغے گٹی
en: ...are made, and with getting married everything comes to an end. If you had put up with it a little, these things would not have happened. In the end, how would one get through life in this state?
en_old: They die, and with marriage everything ends; if they endure a little, these days wouldn't have come. In the end, how will they spend their life in this condition?

brh: ئے تینا وعدہ غا ریسوستٹ، ولے کلے گیرام کرے، انسان نا دا خواہشاک ہچ اسل پورا مفس، انسان داخس ناشکری کیک، نی اگر پاننگٹ خواسے، نسرین کنا ایڑ
en: I had stood by my promise, but he forgot everything. These desires of a human being are never fulfilled at all; a human being is so ungrateful. If you want to say [something]... Nasreen, my sister.
en_old: I kept my promise, but everyone forgot. These desires of a person are never fulfilled at all; a person is so ungrateful. If you want to say something... Nasreen, my sister.

brh: کنا مثال نمونہ ٹی ئے ئے زند اٹ اخس خواری خناٹ ولے دا کلے حوصلہ اٹ صبر اٹ برداشت کرے تینا اورائے برباد کتوٹ اینو شکر ئے آسرات اٹ
en: Take my example: how much hardship I saw in life, but I bore all of it with courage and patience; I did not ruin my home. Today, thank God, I am comfortable.
en_old: Take me as an example: how much hardship I saw in life, but I endured it all with courage and patience. I didn't ruin my home. Today, thank God, I am at peace.

brh: خوشو ئے دا فیصلہ کرینٹ او کنا فیصلہ مروئی نسرین ایلے طلاق نا فیصلہ ء تینا وراغائے
en: Happily I have made this decision, and the decision has to be mine. Nasreen, drop the decision of divorce, [go back] to your home.
en_old: I'm happy I made this decision, and it will be my decision. Nasreen, leave the decision of divorce to your husband's family.

brh: اوڑے مروک آکے، اوڑے مروک آکے نرنگ نا کوشش کپئی
en: You who are there, you who are there, don't try to run away.
en_old: Those who are there, those who are there, don't try to run away.

brh: گرفتار کبوتے! بیست و پنچ سال جیل اٹ گدریفے والا سما تمک تے بدمعاشی انت اسے۔ ئے سچو! ہرا یو وعدہ کے
en: Arrest him! When he has spent twenty-five years in jail, by God, then he'll realize what thuggery is. I am truthful! Whatever promise I...
en_old: Arrest him! After spending twenty-five years in jail, you'll find out what thuggery is. Look! Whatever promise...

brh: کرے سوٹ، ہمو وعدہ تے نا پورا کرے سوٹ، ہیسس چوٹ، داسہ نی اگر کرے پاسی تس ہم نی خنے غما فک ظالماتن، بدلہ کر کر تینا ایلوم نا، نواب نا، ڈول پاسی ات کرے، ئے دنیا لوٹے او ظالمات کے ولنگولاش، کنا خنے غما فک ظالماتن
en: I had done it, I had fulfilled those promises of yours... Now even if you send me to the gallows, you will see that I have no fear of the oppressors. I took revenge, for my brother, for the Nawab... like that, with the gallows... The world is being looted, and the oppressors... I have no fear of the oppressors.
en_old: I did it, I kept those promises. Now even if you... you'll see the pain of the oppressors. Take revenge for your... for the Nawab... This world is plundered by the oppressors... my eyes see the pain of the oppressors.

brh: افسوس بدمعاشی، ایس ایچ او، دانی جوان کتویس، ایس ایچ او، ایس ایچ او، جی سر، نی آ کنے فخر ئے نی ہم بارو نا ملازم جوڑ مسوس، نا ایمانداری آ کنے فخر ئے نی ہم بارو نا منا سرپند مریس، ننے
en: Shame on such thuggery! SHO, didn't you handle this well! SHO, SHO. - Yes sir. - I am proud of you; you too have turned out to be a true employee. I'm proud of your honesty; you too have understood our [cause]. Us...
en_old: Shame on this thuggery, SHO, you didn't do this right. SHO, SHO. Yes sir. I'm proud of you. You became an employee too, I'm proud of your honesty. You also understood our point, us...

brh: اینا سے مجرم آسان بچنگ کپرو۔ پلت آ جیل اٹ مرو یا دا شہر نا روڑ اٹ مرو۔ انشاءاللہ سر۔ نا حکم مرے۔ کنا پین آ میسج ء شیئر کیرے۔ دا کل نا تہا شام نا تغ ء حرام کیوے۔ ڈی ایس پی۔ پست نا راست پارینو۔ حکومت کرے مشے۔ مشے ٹی۔
en: A criminal like this won't be able to escape easily. He will either be in jail or on the roads of this city. - God willing, sir. As you command. Share my other message too. Tonight I will make sleep forbidden to all of them. DSP. It has been rightly said: the government is a mountain. A mountain.
en_old: A criminal like this won't get away easily. He'll either be in jail or on the roads of this city. God willing, sir. As you command. Share my other message. Tonight he won't get any sleep. DSP. You've told the truth. The government... the mountain... in the mountain.

brh: کاٹم ء خلیس کاٹم پنک، ولے مش ہچ مفک۔ ئے ہم بے وقوفی ئس کریٹ، حکومت نا نراٹک نریتوٹہ، ہینو کنا دالمت اوٹ۔ گلو! نی جرم کرینوس، نی مجرم ئس دانا سزا نی ضرور ملیک۔
en: If you strike your head against it, your head breaks, but nothing happens to the mountain. I too did something foolish: I ran from the government, I shouldn't have run; today I am ashamed. Gullu! You have committed a crime, you are a criminal, and you will certainly be punished for it.
en_old: If you hit your head, the head breaks, but nothing happens to the mountain. I also did something foolish; I didn't run from the government's... today I am... Gullu! You've committed a crime, you are a criminal, and you will definitely be punished for it.

brh: عدالت اٹ درخواست کیو نی کم سزا ملے، تو ئے ہمو کم کاٹوٹ۔
en: I will request in court that you get a lighter sentence. - Then I'll serve just that lesser sentence.
en_old: I'll ask the court to give you a lighter sentence, then I'll do that much.

brh: بستم دا ورا غان، ئے تنے چنائے ارفف، ولدا ننے کنا مونی ہم خم پازوٹ، خبردار مسرے، چنا نا گرا اینی نا خوشی تے کپس، ئے ہمورے وی چنائے کین، دے تنے کک، چنا کنائے
en: Get out of this house! I will take the child, and then you'll even come bowing before me. Be warned! Don't [ruin] the child's happiness. I'll keep the child right there too; I'm telling you, the child is mine.
en_old: Enough of this. He won't take your child. Then don't bow your head before me either. Be warned, don't take away the child's joy. I'll keep the child just like that, I'm telling you, the child is mine.

brh: ئے اونا باوٹ۔ او ہیلو ئے ہم اونا لمہ اوٹ۔ دنیا نا ہچو طاقتس ہچو قانون ئس کنے آن کنا چنائے توننگ کپک۔ واہ دنیا نا ہچو قانون ئس چنائے توننگ کپک۔ ٹھیک ہی
en: I am his father. - And hello, I am his mother too! No power in the world, no law, can keep my child away from me. - Wow, no law in the world can keep the child away? All right.
en_old: ...he is his father. And that one is his mother too. No power in the world, no law can take my child away from me. Wow, no law in the world can take the child away. All right.

brh: خلت نا طاقت نا زوری ہمورے او خزور خالی کسے نی ئے پاوے مڑم کنا مونن ئے پاوہ چپما کنا مونن جوانی انداٹی ئے کہ نت جوان مفہ کڑف نہ سرینی نی یا آخری وار نی پاوہ
en: That's all the force of your power amounts to... empty. You talk to me like that, man, in front of me? I'm telling you, shut up in front of me. The good lies in this, that you... or say it to me one last time.
en_old: The force of the clan's power is just that. Those women are empty. You say, man, in front of me, shut up in front of me. The good thing is that you won't be all right, neither the daughter nor you... or say it for the last time.

brh: انت کروس؟ انت کیسی تو ہرفیسے داسہ کنے آ؟ واؤ! ئے دونم کنے کیوے۔ امی، امی۔ بر کنے ساہ کنے آ۔ خبردار۔ امی۔ خبردار۔ امی۔ چونانا گورم بفیس۔
en: What will you do? What are you doing, are you raising your hand at me now? Wow! So you'd do this to me too. Mom, mom! Come to me... Beware! Mom! Beware! Mom! Don't come near the child.
en_old: What did you do? What are you doing, are you taking it from me now? Wow! You're doing this to me. Mom, mom. Come, help me. Watch out. Mom. Watch out. Mom. You won't come near.

brh: پیش تم دا، گیٹ آؤٹ، ارف بیگے تینا پیش تم، کنے ایچو شوق ئس اف نمتو رہینگنگ نا، کنے ہم ایچو شوق ئس اف نی داڑے تخنگ نا، پیش تم، ظالم جوان کنے غا فائر کرے، اینہ کیس کرانٹ اینہ کیس کرانٹ، عدالت اٹ کنے اینہ کیس کروٹ، پیش تم دا، گیٹ آؤٹ فرام ہیئر، گیٹ آؤٹ
en: Get out of here, get out! Take your bag and get out. I have no desire at all to live with you, and I have no desire to keep you here either. Get out! The cruel man fired at me! I'll file a case against you, I'll file a case against you; I'll file a case against you in court. Get out of here, get out of here, get out!
en_old: Get out of here, get out. Take your bag and get out. I have no desire to live with you. I have no desire to keep you here either. Get out. Cruel man, you fired at me. I'll file a case, I'll file a case. I'll file a case against you in court. Get out of here, get out of here, get out.

brh: چپ مرے امی نا مار خبردار امی نا پن الپیس داس امی اگر نی تو مہر و محبت متو کنے تو ہو ہردے کنے تو داڑے جنگ کتوک ئے او دنو فیصلس کتو کہ دا وڑ ہنی
en: Be quiet, Mom's son! Don't you dare take Mom's name! Now, if Mom had no love and affection for you, she wouldn't be fighting with me here every day, and she wouldn't have made a decision like this, that things should go this way.
en_old: Be quiet, mom's son. Watch out, don't say mom's name. Mom, if you had no love and affection for me, then every day... you didn't fight here for me, nor did he make such a decision that it should go this way.

brh: زرا سودے کنا عزت نا خیال اف چپ کے پا بے
en: Think a little, you have no regard for my honour. Be quiet, don't say it.
en_old: Give a little of it. You don't care about my honor. Keep quiet, say it.

brh: اینا درد ء پومریوا ہنتیکے تا خاخرچے ئے تینٹ ہموشے
en: I understand her pain; the fire of those people... I myself am in the very same.
en_old: You understand her pain; their expenses are their own.

brh: ہچ معاملہ اف ارا انت کہ ہران کا دیر پاوک ایتے ایدے
en: It's no problem at all, because wherever you go, who is going to say anything about it?
en_old: There's no problem. Why, where will you go, who will tell you this?

brh: دے انداڑے ختم کبو کسہ سمبو فروئے ما گنج کسہ سمبو فروئے ٹھیک ہی
en: Come on, end it right here; the matter won't be settled this way, it won't be settled at all. All right?
en_old: End the day right here, you won't understand the story... you won't understand the story. All right.

brh: داڑے دا خاخرے تیر شاغوک کسس مفروئی بلکہ داڑے پین تیل شاغور انت کہ دافتا خنت ایتن ساڈنا کھڑینک نا سے پوڑی ئس مف
en: Here there won't be anyone to pour water on this fire; rather, here they'll pour more oil on it, because in their eyes... not even one generation...
en_old: Here, there won't be anyone to throw an arrow at this, but instead they'll pour more oil on it, because their eyes... so that it doesn't become a three-generation feud.

brh: نم تینٹ کڑاس کبو ئے پین سگنگ کپرہ۔ انت کیو؟ ہران کاو؟
en: You yourselves do something; I can't bear it any more. What shall I do? Where shall I go?
en_old: Do it yourselves, the others can't bear it. What will I do? Where will I go?

brh: دے رے پاو بس دعا کا کہ دا فتنہ تیٹی پونگ مریر نی انتئے تینٹ نسرین
en: Whom should I tell? Just pray that they come through these troubles. Why don't you yourself..., Nasreen?
en_old: Don't say it, just pray that they get out of these troubles. Why are you yourself afraid?

brh: ایت کپیسہ، ایت باوہ نی تینٹ ہیت کرک، شاید اونا ہیت منوئی، تینا چناتا تو مچے خیال کیو، پگانہ دے آ اونا چنات پاروئی کہ کنا لمہ باوہ انت کریر۔
en: You won't talk to him? Father, you talk to him yourself; maybe he'll listen. At least think a little about your own children; tomorrow his children will say, 'What did my mother and father do?'
en_old: Don't talk. Father, you talk to him yourself. Maybe he'll listen to you. Think about your own children; tomorrow his children will say, what did my parents do?

brh: باکنج، اگہ اوف دا ہی تے بومسر ہنا تو دا جنجالک ودی متورہ
en: [...] If they had understood this matter, these troubles would never have arisen.
en_old: Bakanj, if they had been like this, these troubles wouldn't have arisen.

brh: داڑے ہر ست نی شیف بٹنگ نا کوشست کیک پگ شیف ہورپک ضد کیک ہمدا ضد نا وجہ آن اوفتا چندی ارا غاک تباہ برباد مسنو چندی نسل
en: Here everyone tries to bring the other down; no one will lower his turban and back down; they are stubborn. Because of this very stubbornness, many of their households have been ruined and destroyed, many generations.
en_old: Here everyone tries to put the other down. The next one won't listen and is stubborn. Because of this very stubbornness, many of their homes have been ruined and destroyed, many generations.

brh: ئس لکھی نانو گم و گار مسنو۔ داڑے ننا ئنا بے ڈولنگا رسم و دود آتا گواچی ہنو۔
en: ...hundreds of thousands have been lost and vanished. Here they have fallen victim to our ugly customs and traditions.
en_old: Hundreds of thousands have been lost. Here they have fallen victim to our ugly customs and traditions.

brh: داسکان نا جہالت نا تارمئی ٹی نن اختہ اون نن تینا بروک آ نسل آتئیش فکر اف نن نن اوفتے کن روشنائی
en: Until now we are stuck in the darkness of ignorance; we have no thought for our coming generations. We, we... light for them.
en_old: Until now we are trapped in the darkness of ignorance. We don't think about our coming generations; we [must bring] light for them.

brh: نی چے فکری کتنو؟ تو انت دا تارمہ غا نن نا سوب روشنائی بفرو؟ نن پورا زند ہندا غلط انگا رسم و دوداتا گواچی مرو؟
en: Haven't you given it any thought? Then will the light of our morning never come into this darkness? Will we remain victims of these same wrong customs and traditions our whole lives?
en_old: Why are you so worried? Will no light ever reach us in this darkness? Will we spend our whole lives as victims of these wrong customs and traditions?

brh: نا نمکچ، سوب ضرور مروئی ضرور مروئی اللہ مہربان
en: Don't despair; morning will surely come, it surely will. God is kind.
en_old: Don't worry, there must be a way, there must be. God is merciful.

brh: کسر ضرور کشوئی ننے، ضرور کشوئی۔ بس اللہ رحم کے، رحم کے۔
en: A way will surely be found for us, surely. Just may God have mercy, have mercy.
en_old: We will surely find a way, we surely will. May God just have mercy, have mercy.

brh: نسرین یقین چاس نی باز زیباس۔ ئے کہ زیبا متوٹے گڑا؟ اگر نی زیبا متوس سے گڑا مینے تنداخس میر کٹے۔ دا زیبا۔۔۔
en: Nasreen, believe me, you are very beautiful. - And what if I weren't beautiful? - If you weren't beautiful, would I love you this much? This beauty...
en_old: Nasreen, believe me, you are very beautiful. And what if I weren't beautiful? If you weren't beautiful, would I love you this much? This beauty...

brh: ئے بئے دا سے بے معنی و اضافی او گڑاسے، نہ کنا خنتی ٹی، او نہ اینا جون اٹی، بلکہ دا ہرتو ماتا نیامٹی ودی مروکا سیالی نا احساس ء۔
en: To me, this is something meaningless and superfluous. Beauty is neither in my eyes nor in your body; rather, it is the feeling of closeness that grows between the two of us.
en_old: Hey, this isn't something meaningless and extra, not in my eyes and not in your body. It's the feeling of the bond that grew between the two of us.

brh: دروغ، بکواس، نہ دا رشتے، نہ دا سیالی، دا کل دروغو، کنے نین نفرت
en: Lies, nonsense! Neither this relationship nor this kinship — all of this is lies. I hate you.
en_old: Lies, nonsense! Not this relationship, not this bond, it's all lies. I hate you.

brh: ئے تے نفرتی کرینیان
en: I hate you.
en_old: I hate you.

brh: کنا مسڑ، انت کینہ ننے مس کدن تولوک ئس اما، نم مبارک بو، کنے تنیائی الیبو زرے۔
en: My daughter, what can we do... [you have been] sitting [like this]... — Mom, congratulations to you all. Leave me alone for a while.
en_old: My daughter, what can we do? We've been sitting like this for so long, Mom. Congratulations to you. Leave me alone for a while.

brh: کنا مسر دا زند دن تنیا گدرینگپک اما کس کس نا بغیر کسپک نا دا وخت آ دوسلیکاک
en: My daughter, life does not pass alone like this. — Mom, no one dies for lack of someone else. — At this time of yours... (unclear)
en_old: My daughter, life doesn't pass alone like this, Mom. No one can live without someone. At a time like this, friends...

brh: کل نا وقت گدرینگک، بیک تو گدرینگیرہ، ولے جانی تیٹ اگر گدرینگیر تو دا زند باز زیبدار مریک۔
en: Everyone's time passes; the days do pass, but if they pass with loved ones, this life becomes very beautiful.
en_old: Everyone's time passes, the days do pass, but if they pass with loved ones, life becomes very beautiful.

brh: برکان داڑے تولوک ئس بر کمراٹھی
en: Come, let's go — [you've been] sitting here — come into the room.
en_old: Come, sit here, come into the room.

brh: خبردار! ہا ہا ہا! نی کٹاس، شاباش ویری گڈ، بر تو داک۔ باز جوان گوازی کریس، ویری گڈ، شاباش بیٹا۔ ابو! امی ہرا دے؟ چہ وخت بریک؟
en: Watch out! Ha ha ha! You won — bravo, very good, come here then. You played very well, very good, well done, son. — Dad! Which day is Mom [coming]? When will she come?
en_old: Careful! Ha ha ha! You won, bravo, very good, come here. You played very well, very good, well done, son. Dad! Which day is Mom coming? When will she come?

brh: بیٹھے نی اٹوار پارینٹ او دے یاد کپے پنیل پونہ۔ انتے ابو؟ دا خاطر آن کہ او ننے الائینہ۔
en: Son, I have told you: don't remember her, don't speak her name. — Why, Dad? — Because she has left us.
en_old: Son, promise me that you won't remember her and won't say her name. Why, Dad? Because she left us.

brh: او دے اگر نن تو مہر مس کنے، تو ننے دن تنیا ئے لیتوک گنتوک۔ نیکے بہتر اندادے اونا پنی الپیس ولدا۔ انت ابو، او داس بفک؟ او دے اگر بروئی مس تو بریک، ولے نی اودے اد کپے۔
en: If she had loved us, she wouldn't have left us alone like this. It's better for you not to speak her name again. — What, Dad, won't she come now? — If she were going to come, she would come; but don't you remember her.
en_old: If she had loved me that day, she wouldn't have left us alone like this. It's better that you don't say her name again. What, Dad, won't she come now? If she were going to come, she would come, but don't you remember her.

brh: بیٹا، نی ہند گڑاس نا ضرورت مرے کنے پاہ۔ یریٹ نی نا ابو، کنے ہچ گڑاس نا ضرورت اف۔
en: Son, if you need anything, tell me — I'm your dad. — I don't need anything.
en_old: Son, if you need anything, tell me. Yes, Dad, I don't need anything.

brh: مزمل ہیلو مزمل بیٹا ہمم بشہ بیٹا
en: Muzammil, hello, Muzammil, son — hmm — get up, son.
en_old: Muzammil, hello Muzammil, son, hmm, get up, son.

brh: صبح مسک بش اسکول نا وخت ء نی بش زو کہ بش شاباش ہلہ بش بیٹا بش پچہ شاباش خاچپیس خاچپیس ایبو خاچپیس بش بش این موندو غرک برک اینو نیکن ناشتہ جوڑ کیٹ
en: It's morning, get up, it's time for school, get up quickly, get up, well done, hurry up, get up son, get up kid, well done, don't sleep, don't sleep, ... don't sleep, get up, get up, come on ... let's go; today I'm making breakfast for you.
en_old: It's morning, get up, it's time for school, get up quickly, get up, well done, come on, get up son, get up, open your eyes, well done, you slept, you slept, enough, you slept, get up, get up, today your mother is making breakfast for you.

brh: او بش شاباش ملخ ت شاباش بش برک بیٹا برک زو کہ بش او نام کنے ہٹیٹ
en: Oh, get up, well done, open your eyes, well done, get up, let's go son, let's go, quickly, get up, oh... (unclear).
en_old: Oh get up, well done, ... well done, get up, come son, come quickly, get up, oh, I've taken the name.

brh: بیٹا فرائی جوڑ کرنگٹی نی کے۔ امو داڑے جوڑ کپہ سے۔ ہیں؟ فرائی پان اٹ جوڑ کیرے۔ ہا ہا یاد تننگ نا مہربانی۔ فرائی پان اٹ جوڑ کیرے کنے سما س کنے سما س فرائی پان اٹ جوڑ کیرے۔
en: Son, I'm making fries for you. — You don't make it in here. — Huh? — You make it in a frying pan. — Ha ha, thanks for reminding me. You make it in a frying pan, I know, I know, you make it in a frying pan.
en_old: Son, are you making fries? Mom doesn't make them here. Huh? They're made in a frying pan. Ha ha, thanks for reminding me. They're made in a frying pan. I know, I know they're made in a frying pan.

brh: ابو گیس صفا ہنا کہ گڑا سلنڈر ء درتو۔ جوان پاریس، بالکل جوان پاریس، سلنڈر اور سلنڈر۔
en: Dad, the gas has completely run out, so let's take the cylinder. — Well said, absolutely well said — the cylinder, and the cylinder.
en_old: Dad, the gas has run out completely, so bring a cylinder. Good idea, very good idea, a cylinder it is.

brh: لگا آخا لگا
en: It's lit — no — it's lit!
en_old: Got it, oh, got it.

brh: ننے اسپیشل او فرائز گونے فیوا نی بے فکر مے، بیدے؟ آ نی آئل، آئل، آئل، ہرو مچھی سا، آ سمائی کنے سمائی کنے برے برے
en: I'll feed us some special fries, don't you worry, okay? Ah — oil, oil, oil... (unclear)... ah, I know, I know, come on, come on.
en_old: We'll make special fries, don't you worry, okay? Oil, oil, oil, every fish... I know, I know, come, come.

brh: او نی کل بریرہ کاریم، کل بریرہ کاریم، بورہ غاتے پٹنگٹ، بورہ غاک اراں، بورہ شان پکیٹنٹ، ہیں؟
en: Oh, they will all come in handy, they will all come in handy — looking for the sacks — there are the sacks — the sacks... packet... huh?
en_old: Oh, all of you come to work, everyone come to work, looking for the sacks, the sacks are here, packing the sacks, huh?

brh: دے مسالحہ مرچی شدر۔ آہا خنے سمائی خنے سمائی خنے سمائی بریک خنے بریک۔ اسپیشل او فرائی سکول نا بیٹا انشاءاللہ ہر دے خا
en: Now spices, chilli, [put them] in. Aha, I know, I know, I know, I can do it, I can do it. A special fry for school, son, God willing, every day...
en_old: Spicy chili... Aha, do you see, do you see, do you see, it's coming, you see, it's coming. A special one, oh, fried, son, for school, God willing, eat every day.

brh: آزگی نا دونا تہو کنیسے نا پٹ نا خلف کک اسکول اٹ۔ اینو انشاءاللہ اوریس نی دا فرائی کنوس۔ آ فرائی کنیسے فل فرائی کنیسے دا پا۔ اوہ ابو! انچ کمال کیسی ہا بیٹا، دا سے تو نی دا پرغاش آ غاستے۔
en: (unclear) ... at school. Today, God willing, you'll see, you will eat this fry. Ah, do you eat it fried, fully fried? Tell me. — Oh Dad! What a marvel you've done! — Yes, son, ... (unclear).
en_old: ...at school. Today, God willing, you'll see, you'll eat this fry. Ah, are you eating it fried, eating it fully fried, tell me. Oh Dad! You've done such a marvel, son, you've put this on the plate.

brh: قاسم نی پاسے ہاف فرائی آ فل فرائی؟ ہاں، دا دراصل اٹی پوسکونو اسٹائلس نا فرائی ئے دے، اینو نی انشاءاللہ اینو نی پوسکونو اسٹائلس نا فرائی کنوئی شو نی بچا
en: Qasim, do you want half-fry or full-fry? Yes, this is actually a new style of fry; today, God willing, today you have to eat a new style of fry, kid.
en_old: Qasim, do you say half-fried or fully fried? Yes, this is actually a new style of fry, today God willing you will eat a new style of fry, son.

brh: دا تو گڑبڑ مس گڑبڑ مس برگر مس برگر برگر فرائز کنے روانہ اینو آ ہر دے نی کنے ہاف فرائی کنے سے نی
en: This has turned into a mess, a mess — it's become a burger! Burger, burger fries... me... today — and every day you make me a half-fry.
en_old: This turned into a mess, it turned into a mess, it became a burger, burger, burger, fries, send me... today, every day you make me a half-fried, you...

brh: اینو کرے اینے برگر فرائز کونفوا اللہ اللہ اللہ اللہ اللہ واہ ابو انت کمال کے زی بس دونا او شنگان ہی ابو دا دا دف دا دف
en: Today I'll feed you burger fries. Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah! Wow, Dad, what a marvel you've done... like this... hey Dad, this, this — this one, this one.
en_old: Today... burger, fries, eat... God, God, God, God, God, wow, Dad, what a marvel... like this, oh... Dad, this, this, this...

brh: ہاؤ جی، صحیح؟ ہاں ہاں، بریک کنے بریک، ہاؤ کنے بریک، دا کل کاریم تے شروع ہنی، ہاؤ، کتانوٹ، اگر دا کاریم تے ایل کریسٹ تو اینو دا ایل کریسٹ۔
en: Yes sir, right? Yes, yes, I know how, I know how, yes, I know how. All this work has been started — yes — I hadn't done it before; if I've learned this work, then it's today that I learned it.
en_old: Yes, right? Yes, yes, come, come to me, yes come to me, all these jobs have started, yes, I did it, if you leave these jobs, then leave them today.

brh: مسٹر مزمل نا بریک فاسٹ تیار مس۔ ابا چولہے نا بند کر؟ آ، چولہے نا۔ ایرفون نا کر۔
en: Mr. Muzammil's breakfast is ready. — Dad, did you turn off the stove? — Ah, the stove. — And the earphones (?) — do that one too.
en_old: Mr. Muzammil's breakfast is ready. Dad, turn off the stove? Yes, the stove. Turn off the earphones.

brh: انتئے بیٹو؟ گلاس کمی اٹ؟ او ابو، امی تو کنے پاسم تسکہ۔ ہا۔۔۔
en: Why, son? Is something missing from the glass? — Oh Dad, Mom used to give me milk too. — Ah...
en_old: Why, son? Is the glass short? Oh Dad, Mom gave me an answer... Ha...

brh: بکن بیٹا اینو ہوٹل اٹ بریک فاسٹ کینہ۔ کم آن۔
en: Come on, son, today we'll have breakfast at a hotel. Come on.
en_old: Come on, son, today we'll have breakfast at a hotel. Come on.

brh: ئے زو حسینہ نی یونیفارم تبدیل کسء شاباش۔ ہاؤ، تو چاتے بین زو بریس تیار مرے جو۔
en: Hey, quickly, Hasina — change your uniform, well done. Yes, so ... come quickly and get ready.
en_old: Hey, quickly, Hasina, change your uniform, well done. Yes, so let's see, come quickly, get ready.

brh: ئے مرے وی نم کنا چنائے راٹھی مسکا کنے انت ہورورے
en: Hey, ... you (all) have upset my child — what are you staring at me for?
en_old: Hey, even so, you've made my child angry, what do you care?

brh: جی گودی، حکم؟ امر یاد کریرے کنے؟
en: Yes, madam, at your command? How did you remember me?
en_old: Yes, sister, what's the order? How did you remember me?

brh: تصویر کنے بشے
en: Give me the picture.
en_old: Give me the picture.

brh: خبردار بادشاہ، صرف پیری تیری، بادشاہ دوتے پٹار کر، خبردار، اوہ اوہ اوہ، بادشاہ الے پیر، نواز نواز داد نی انت کریس
en: Beware, King, just ... King, put your hands up, beware! Oh, oh, oh! King, let go ... Nawaz, Nawaz, what have you done?
en_old: Careful, King, just... King, put your hands up! Watch out! Oh, oh, oh! King, don't... Nawaz, Nawaz, what have you done?

brh: گلو دا علی جوان کتویس کنا خاص انگا بندغے خلکوس بادشاہ نی تینا زندگی نا خیر خواہ پین او کنے ہم بچین کپیسے نی دے بادشاہ ئے کسے فون کا
en: Gullu, you didn't do right by Ali; you killed my special man. King, pray for the safety of your own life, and you can't save me either. You, go on, phone someone, King!
en_old: Gullu, you didn't treat Ali well. You killed my special man. King, you only care about your own life, and you can't save me either. King, call someone!

brh: ئے انعام جان کنا چھٹا بادشاہ، دا سے نا واری گلو! خبردار! ئے نوکنا ہنکس نی بچے فینٹاپاک۔ سوبل! سوبل دانی ہنت کریس؟
en: Oh Inam Jan, my little king! Now it's your turn, Gullu! Beware! ... you won't escape ... [unclear] ... Sohail! Sohail, what is this you've done?
en_old: Inam Jan, my little king, now it's this one's turn, Gullu! Watch out! ... you can't save... Sohail! Sohail, what have you done?

brh: سہول، سہول، دا نی انت کریس کنے تینا جان ء قربان کریس۔ سہول، سہول، دا نی انت کریس۔ سہول۔
en: Sohail, Sohail, what is this you've done? You sacrificed your life for me. Sohail, Sohail, what is this you've done? Sohail.
en_old: Sohail, Sohail, what have you done? You sacrificed your life for me. Sohail, Sohail, what have you done? Sohail.

brh: بادشاہ! اینے زندہ الے پرے! بادشاہ! بادشاہ، اینے زندہ الے پرے! ئے تینا ایلم نا بدلہ ء نیان الیوہ! نی ہرا ہنگ نریسے!
en: King! I won't leave you alive! King! King, I won't leave you alive! I will take revenge on you for my brother! Where will you run to?
en_old: King! I won't leave you alive! King! King, I won't leave you alive! I'll take revenge for my brother from you! Where will you run?!

brh: سلہ بادشاہ، دا رنگا پیسہ کنے ہت۔
en: Wait, King, bring me money like this.
en_old: All right, King, give me this kind of money.

brh: کنیانے نو بچنگ کپیسے نو زندگی نا اینو کرے آخری دے تو ہاکینے کثف تھنوٹ زند نی لیپرے ایٹی مٹی افک تو شوانہ نا ایراغے
en: You can't escape from me. Today is the last day of your life ... [unclear] ... I won't leave you alive ... [unclear] ... the shepherd's meal.
en_old: You've eaten... you can't escape. Today is the last day of your life, so die... your life... there's nothing... then the shepherd's...

brh: گنک! گلو! دا خاخر نی مٹ سمجھسے، توفک ء بٹ، ولا اورنے دیر دیر ء کسفسک۔ بادشاہ! گلو نا خدا دوتر دا طاقت تستنے، نی کسفنگ کن۔
en: Madman! Gullu! Do you think you're a match for this fire? Drop the gun, or else I'll kill him slowly. King! Gullu's God has given these hands this power, to kill you.
en_old: Ganak! Gullu! What do you take me for, after all? Drop the gun, or else I'll kill him slowly. King! Gullu's God has given these hands this power, to kill you.

brh: گلو نا دو کم کافی او، دا ہم فرمائش نا پورہ کیوے، ہمہ کینی بازی نی تون جنگ کیوے، اینو کرے کنے آن نی بچنگ کپیسہ، دا پسٹلے بٹی
en: Gullu's hands are enough too; I'll fulfill this request as well. I'll fight you in this game of revenge; today you can't escape from me. There, I drop this pistol.
en_old: Gullu's hands are enough. He'll fulfill this request too. I'll fight you through the whole game. Today you can't escape from me. Drop this pistol!

brh: بش مغلو! ہمو بے گناہ تے مکسفسر، کنو کنئے! بش ظالم، نی باز ظالمی کرینس۔
en: Stop, Mughal! Don't kill those innocent people; me, take me! Stop, tyrant, you have committed a great deal of cruelty.
en_old: Leave them, Mughal! Don't kill those innocent people, kill me! Leave them, tyrant, you have committed too much cruelty.

brh: او لنکی بس سس ہمتا جو نا باگو ہمبار کاٹمے تا کنگوٹ حل گڈ گڈ لیا
en: (Largely unintelligible) Oh ... came ... by their stream ... their heads ... cut, cut ...
en_old: He came... beside the bank of the stream... the Kat... (partly unintelligible)

brh: جنگ باز جنگ باز جنگ باز جنگ باز جنگ باز آگئے جنگ باز آگئے ظالم نی امہ بچاس
en: Fighter, fighter, fighter, fighter, the fighter has come, the fighter has come! Tyrant, how will you escape?
en_old: Fighter, fighter, fighter, fighter, the fighter has come, the fighter has come! Tyrant, how will you escape now?

brh: خلوک آ ڈنگ کرے پچی فوک آ زورے، خاصہ خدا خل، نیکو نا بادشاہ کو دے ہچ کپسے، تانکہ ایرے کسف تنٹ، کنے ہچ مفکک
en: [Garbled] Strike with a sting, with full force ... hit him, for God's sake! You can't do anything to the King; until I have killed you, nothing will happen to me.
en_old: Hit him, strike him hard, for God's sake hit him! You can't do anything to the king. Until you kill him, nothing will happen to me.

brh: واہ دشاہ، توار نی کنے آ نررنگ کپیسہ
en: Wow, King, you can't run away from me.
en_old: Well, king, you can't run away from me.

brh: گڈو کنے کسر سے سنگت ہن پا دے دا سنگت کنے کسر پا مبارک ہن ہمدا بشیر پا روڈ پتی ئس مروسے کانتو مروس
en: Then on the road a friend told me, go ... this friend told me on the road, congratulations, go. This same Bashir said there would be a stretch of road ... it would be ...
en_old: Then a friend told me on the way, go and say this; this friend said congratulations to me on the way. This same Bashir was on the road...

brh: عاشق راس! نا بنگلہ غاک مرو، نا جند نا گاڑی غاک مرو، نا جند نا نوکر چاکر غاک مرو۔ واہ بادشاہ واہ! نا و کنا نوکر چاکر آک مرو، نا و کنا بنگلہ غاک مرو، نن راج کرون دنیا نا زی آ۔
en: Ashiq, it's true! You'll have bungalows, your own cars, your own servants. Bravo, King, bravo! You and I will have servants, you and I will have bungalows, and we will rule over the world.
en_old: Ashiq Ras! You'll have bungalows, your own cars, your own servants. Wow, king, wow! You and I will have servants, you and I will have bungalows, and we'll rule over the world.

brh: بس کرک دا شیطانی آ سوچ آتے تینا اینی ہمبر شیطان ئس تے ہرا کہ نی ہمبر شیطان اسے دا دنیا ٹی ہر کسے ضمیر مرے
en: Stop these devilish thoughts of yours ... [you are] such a devil, because you are such a devil. In this world everyone should have a conscience,
en_old: Stop these devilish thoughts of yours... a devil... because you are a devil. In this world everyone should have a conscience.

brh: ایمان مرے، ہی چس پا اوڑاننگ، ایماندار کس تپک، بادشاہ نی ہم باس کریس، اینو کنے ہم بچنگ کپیس، کنے معاف کرک، ئے نا پیسہ نا لالچ ٹی بسٹ، شکتی داس نی تینا خاہنگوت ات تیار مرے
en: should have faith ... [unclear] ... no one is honest. King, you've done enough too; today you can't save me either. Forgive me, I fell for the greed of your money. Shakti Das, get ready for your death.
en_old: There should be faith... no honest person... King, you did it too. Today you can't save me either. Forgive me, I fell into the greed for your money. Shakti Das, get ready with your family.

brh: توشنہ ہلوکا بچک لیکن پادشانک ہلوکا بچک
en: [Garbled] The thirsty ones' children were taken, but the kings' children were taken.
en_old: Thirsty children, but the children of kings.

brh: بادشاہ ظالم او ظالمی کریس دا دے پارہ کچک نا موت ہتینا کاری انجام کریس انو مریسہ
en: The King is a tyrant, and you committed tyranny. On this day they will say it was a dog's death; you have met the end of your own deeds; today you will die.
en_old: King, you are a tyrant and you have done tyranny. Today they'll say you died a dog's death; you met the end your deeds deserved.

brh: نی چوک قسم دادے کسفنگ نا دا قانون نا مجرم ئے دادے قانون سزا ایتو
en: Give up your oath to kill him. He is a criminal under the law; the law will punish him.
en_old: You swore to kill him. He is a criminal under the law; the law will punish him.

brh: دادے پولیس نا والا غاک ہلو صرف پیش تنے گرفتار کبوتا
en: Policemen, take him! Just ... arrest him.
en_old: Police officers, take him away. Just arrest him.

brh: خبردار ایس ایچ او بے وقوفی کپے دا بنداتنے مرغ کنا کسر آن مرغ کسر آن دا تو بلے وتا بلو بے وقوفی نی کننگوس قانون آن بچنگ کپیسے قانون نا حوالہ کے تینے سر جی نمے رے زبان
en: Beware, SHO, don't do anything foolish! Get these men out of my way, out of the way! This is a big, big foolishness you're doing. You can't escape from the law. Hand yourself over to the law. Sir, ... [unclear].
en_old: Watch out, SHO, don't do anything foolish! Out of my way, out of the way! You're doing a very foolish thing. You can't escape the law. Hand yourself over to the law. Sir, ...

brh: سمجھ بپتو؟ سر جی! خدا واسطے دادے داری شوٹ کین۔ سر جی! ڈی ایس پی صاحب پدہ زندہ یا مردہ کنے ضرورت۔ ننے ہچو کسفک! دانا کسفنگ نا دا مجرم اسے، جرم کرینے، دادے قانونا حوالہ کینہ، دادے عدالت سزا ایتک۔ ہینڈز اپ شو!
en: Don't you understand? Sir! For God's sake, let's shoot him right here. Sir! The DSP sahib said, 'I need him dead or alive.' We don't need to kill him! He is a criminal; he has committed a crime. We'll hand him over to the law, and the court will punish him. Hands up!
en_old: Don't you understand? Sir! For God's sake, let's shoot him right here. Sir! The DSP says he wants him dead or alive. Don't kill him on our account! He is a criminal for killing; he has committed a crime. Hand him over to the law, the court will punish him. Hands up!

brh: ئے ٹھیبا نی اور نادان اتھراڑے سورے نوما خنتیا پٹی ت فوکس کے دا ظالم گلی کوچاتیٹی سرعام چرس سودا کریکے دادے نم گرفتار کننگ کتویرے اگر ہمو ٹیم آ نم دادے گرفتار کریرے ہینو ئے تنی مجرم ئس متوٹے کنے
en: Hey, you're naive too ... [unclear] ... a blindfold over your eyes ... focus. This tyrant used to sell hashish openly in the streets and alleys, and you couldn't arrest him. If you had arrested him at that time, I would not have become a criminal today.
en_old: Theba, you're naive too... focus... This tyrant sells charas openly in the streets and alleys, and you couldn't arrest him. If you had arrested him back then, I wouldn't have become a criminal today.

brh: دا دورے دا پشول متوکے بلو دانہ گودام ایرووری چھاپہ خلکوٹ ولے کنے ہچ ثبوت ملتو نی سمائی عدالت ثبوت خواہک دانہ خلاف کنتو ہچ ثبوت الو ئے مجبور اسوٹ تو ہنکے نمے ثبوت ملتو نی نم دادے گرفتار کپیرے
en: [Unclear] this time ... I raided his big warehouse twice, but I found no evidence. You understand, the court wants evidence. I had no evidence against him; I was helpless. So you found no evidence, then you can't arrest him.
en_old: This time this pistol... I raided his warehouse, but I didn't find any evidence. You understand the court wants evidence. I had no evidence against him, so I was helpless. So you didn't find evidence? Then you can't arrest him.

brh: ہراتم نمے ثبوت ملیک دنیا سماپ دشا دنا مریک پور کدا بنداک تینا سچو پور کدا حبیب بادشاہ گرفتار کبو
en: When you get evidence ... [unclear: the world will know ... people ... their own truth ...] ... arrest Habib Badshah!
en_old: When you get evidence, the world will know... arrest Habib Badshah.

brh: سر دا تو کسکول ئے سر دا سفر مروئی جام کسکول ئ مروئی نا دا ڈپٹی لوئے تان کہ ایس ایچ او شیر دل زندہ ہی
en: Sir, this is a begging bowl. Sir, this journey must go on ... [unclear] ... must become a begging bowl ... this deputy of yours ... as long as SHO Sher Dil is alive.
en_old: Sir, this is a beggar's bowl. Sir, this journey... as long as SHO Sher Dil is alive.

brh: ایچ مفک نما نوکری کے، کلو غئی آ بچنگ کپک، کامب گرفتاری دے۔
en: Nothing will happen to your job. [Unclear] he can't escape ... [successful?] arrest.
en_old: Nothing will happen to your job. Nobody can escape. Arrest him.

brh: اجازت ئے جوان، اللہ حافظ۔ ریلیکس، ریلیکس جہانزیب، ریلیکس۔
en: Alright, I'll take my leave. Goodbye. Relax, relax, Jahanzeb, relax.
en_old: Alright, with your permission. Goodbye. Relax, relax Jahanzeb, relax.

brh: ابو ابو آہا ہاں ابو اخیریت انتئے نی انتئے پریشانوس؟
en: Dad, Dad, aha, yes Dad, is everything all right? Why, why are you worried?
en_old: Dad, dad, ah, yes dad, is everything alright? Why, why are you worried?

brh: ہاں؟ رنگ راہی کینگوس کنے؟ نی ئے پریشان افٹ بچا، نی ہمیشہ سوال کریسہ کہ کنا مما انتئے نان بفک، اینو بننگ ء، اونے کہ خوشی نی دا دے، نا دننگ کے بننگ ء
en: Huh? Are you playing games with me? I'm not worried, child. You always ask why my mama doesn't come to us; today she is coming. That's why this is a happy day for you: she is coming to take you.
en_old: Huh? Are you teasing me? I'm not worried, kid. You always ask why my mom doesn't come home; today she's coming. That's the happiness of this day — she's coming to see you.

brh: ابو انت نی بفیسہ؟ نن کنا مار نی تنیا اینو میمارک خیال کیس اودے تنگ کپیس اینو ہم پد نی او تورنگیس نا ابو ایمپارے
en: Dad, what, won't you come? No, my son. Today you alone take care of Mama, don't trouble her. And later today you ... her (unclear) ... your dad too.
en_old: Dad, what, aren't you coming? No, my son. Today only you take care of Mimarak, don't bother her. Today too, later you'll ... her, okay, dad?

brh: کنا مار، ضد کپہ، اگہ نی ضد کیسہ نی تو ئے نیان غصہ کیوہ۔ نا، بو ئے نی ایلنگ کپرہ۔ نہ، او پکا کنا صاحب، ئے بریوہ نا اورنگ کے۔
en: My son, don't be stubborn. If you're stubborn, I'll get angry with you. No, Dad, I can't leave you. No, oh, for sure, my dear, I will come to see you.
en_old: My son, don't be stubborn. If you're stubborn, I'll get angry with you. No, I won't let you go. No, definitely, my dear sir, I'll come to see her.

brh: مجبوری ئے نی تو اینو ہیمریک۔ ابو، نی تو دد تنی ہیمریسے، نان مریک؟ کنا مار، کنے وقت گدریفنگ مریک۔
en: It can't be helped; today you have to go. Dad, you'll come too, won't you? My son, it will take some time.
en_old: I have no choice, you'll have to stay today. Dad, you'll stay, won't you? My son, I have to get going.

brh: بش آ تیاری کر۔ نا بئے امبرے۔ ضد کپہ۔ مزمل اگر نی ضد کیسہ لے ئے دے غصہ کیوا بس۔ نا بئے امبرے۔
en: Get up and get ready. Your dad will come too. Don't be stubborn. Muzammil, if you're stubborn I'll get angry, that's all. Your dad will come too.
en_old: Get ready quickly. Your mother is coming. Don't be stubborn. Muzammil, if you're stubborn I'll be angry with you, that's it. Your mother is coming.

brh: ئے دوئی تہمک نابو نی کاسے نابو ہمبرے کاسے نی نابو ہمبرے کاسے نی دوئی تہمک ئے دوئی تہمک نی کنے وار کنے معاف کیس
en: I ... (unclear) ... your dad. You go, your dad will come too; go, your dad will come too; go ... (unclear) ... please forgive me, forgive me.
en_old: Hey, take my hand... your father... a little... your father is coming... hey, take my hand... you forgave me this time.

brh: ئے نا خیال اٹ تھک اٹ، کنا لمہ نا جوان خیال اٹ تھک اٹ، بش تیاری کر کنا بوین برے
en: I'm fine in your care; I'm fine in my mother's good care. Get up and get ready, come on, my dear.
en_old: Hey, I'm fine thanks to you, I'm fine thanks to my mother's care. Get ready quickly, let's go.

brh: تینا خلیو دے دیر بسنے
en: Who has come for their own ...? (partly unclear)
en_old: Who has come to hit you?

brh: نسرین، نم بسرے؟ ہاؤ۔
en: Nasreen, have you come? Yes.
en_old: Nasreen, have you come? Yes.

brh: کنا ماری توار کبو ہاؤ توار کیوٹ ولے اسہ خواست ئس نی
en: Call my son. Yes, I'll call him, but I have one request of you.
en_old: Call my son. Yes, I'll call him, but I have one request of you.

brh: او زملہ باز خیالے تخیرے ئے اونا خیالے لمہ غمبر کرینٹ او دے ہچو تکلیف ئس تفیرے
en: Take very good care of Muzammil. I have looked after him like a mother; don't give him any trouble.
en_old: Take very good care of Muzammil. I've made a promise to his mother, don't cause him any trouble.

brh: ئے اونا ئے اونا اوغنگے برداشت کننگ کپرہ جہانزیب اینو انتئے دون بیناس دا ڈکھ پہلا تا گواچی مسس ڈکھ و پہلا کن انسانی پرغے بسے
en: I, I can't bear his crying. Jahanzeb, why are you like this today? You've been consumed by this grief and sorrow; grief and sorrow come to every human being.
en_old: Hey, I can't bear his crying. Jahanzeb, why are you sitting like this today? This grief... grief and sorrow come to people.

brh: دک آتٹی تینا رویہ غان بندغے پھرغرے۔ دا کل ئنا ذمہ دار نم ارے۔ کسر تے جتا کننگ آ نم کنے مجبور کریرے، داسہ دا کل
en: In these sorrows you have broken a person with your own behavior. You are responsible for all of this. You forced me to go our separate ways, and now all this...
en_old: With your behavior you've driven a person away in this pain. You are responsible for all of this. You forced me to go our separate ways, and now all this...

brh: ئے دا تا ہچ فائدہ ئس افک کنا مارے توار کر ئے کاوے۔ ہو ہتے ہتے۔ مزمل!
en: There's no use in any of this. Call my son, I'm leaving. Yes, I'm bringing him, bringing him. Muzammil!
en_old: Hey, there's no point in this. Call my son, I'm leaving. Yes, wait, wait. Muzammil!

brh: ئے کاوداک ئے اونا ہینگ برداشت کننگ کپرہ مزمل بیٹا مما نا بسو نی مما
en: I'm going; I can't bear to see him leave. Muzammil, son, Mama has come, your Mama.
en_old: Hey, I'm going, I can't bear his crying. Muzammil, son, come to Mom, come to Mom.

brh: ماما، نی ارانگ ئناسس؟ ئے جوان، یمروسیک! نی باز مس کریٹک۔ ہاؤ، ئے جوان اٹ ئے ہم نی مس کریٹک۔ کنا جان تینتو دیوے۔ ماما، ننا ارانگ کانہ؟ بابا انتئے غصہ کرینے؟ نم ہرتوما کانتو؟
en: Mama, where had you gone? I'm fine, how are you? I missed you so much. Yes, I'm fine, I missed you too. My darling, I'll take you with me. Mama, where are we going? Why is Baba angry? Will you both be with me?
en_old: Mama, where were you? Hey, fine, come here! I missed you so much. Yes, I'm fine, I missed you too. Come to me, my darling. Mama, where are we going? Why is Baba angry? Aren't you coming with us?

brh: او سکرے نورے؟ نی دا ہیتاتے پومہ فیسے، نا سوالاتا جوابات کانتو افس۔ ولے ماما؟ ئے ایم ابونہ بغیر مننگ کپرہ۔ ابو! ابو! نی اراڑے ئس
en: Do you miss him? You won't understand these things, and I don't have answers to your questions. But Mama? I can't live without Dad either. Dad! Dad! Where are you?
en_old: Oh, are you awake? You won't understand these things, and I don't have answers to your questions. But Mama? Hey, I can't live without Dad. Dad! Dad! Where are you?

brh: کنا زیبانہ ہم سئیٹ
en: My beautiful one too ... (unclear)
en_old: I've seen my Zeba too.

brh: پارے نما باوہ نما باز خیال ء تخک، کنے آن باز زیادہ نمے پیار کیک، او نما غمخوار نما خیال ء تخک، نمے اونا باز زیادہ ضرورت ء، ئے نمانے ہم کاوہ
en: She said: your father takes great care of you, he loves you much more than I do; he is the one who cares for you and looks after you; you need him very much. I'm going away from you as well.
en_old: She said your father cares for you a lot, he loves you much more than I do. He looks after you and takes care of you. You need him very much. I'm going too.

brh: ماما بابا انت ننا اسہ جگہ مننگ کپنہ؟ انت ننا وار مننگ کپنہ؟
en: Mama, Baba, can't we be in one place? Can't we be together?
en_old: Mama, Baba, can't we be in one place? Can't we be together?

brh: حق علم اور راستی اندا دے چلتن نا گلاؤ
en: Truth, knowledge and honesty: this is Chiltan's message.
en_old: Truth, knowledge and honesty: this is Chiltan's message today.

brh: آگاہی، راستی، علم نا روشنائی، دا علاقہ نا مخلوق کل زمیندار او، اگر او تینا چناتے محنت مزدوری
en: Awareness, truth, the light of knowledge. The people of this area are all farmers; if they put their own children to hard labor...
en_old: Awareness, truth, the light of knowledge. The people of this region are all farmers; if they make their children do hard labor...

brh: دے کرپوس تو کنیر راک نہ گل خان دا ہیت اف دا معصوم غا چناتا دا عمر اف کہ او کار زمین تیا کاریم کیر اوفتے دا عمرے اسکول
en: ...if they don't do it, then what will they eat? No, Gul Khan, that's not the point. These innocent children are not of an age to work on farmland; at this age, for them, school...
en_old: If you do this, then... no, Gul Khan, that's not the point. These innocent children are not old enough to work on farmland; at this age they belong in school.

brh: خواننگ نا تمورے بادی کے اوفتے تون دا ناانصافی مف او تے دا پاپو کہ نی ہخس کہ کوشش کیس چنا کس سکول آ خواننگ کہ اسل بفیسے
en: ...for the sake of their education, so that this injustice is not done to them. Tell them this: however hard you try, no child will ever come to school to study.
en_old: ...the light of education, so that this injustice isn't done to them. Don't tell them that no matter how hard you try, child, you'll never get to go to school to study.

brh: واہ ماسٹر ئے دا پبو کہ میر جلال خان نا چنائے خوانفنگ کے نی اوڑا غا بروئی تمک او مننگٹ اسنا نمے درخواست ئے کہ نم تینا چناتے
en: Wow, Master, tell them this: that to teach Mir Jalal Khan's child you will have to come to his place. And our request to you is that you send your children...
en_old: But the master doesn't know that to teach Mir Jalal Khan's child, you will have to go to his place. And we request that you send your children...

brh: اسکول ء مون ایتبو۔ ماسٹر صاحب دا تو خوشی نا ہیت ء، ننا چناک ہم خواننگ نا خواہرا، ولے داڑے کس خوانفوک الو۔ داسہ انشاء اللہ نن بسون، نما چناک خوانور۔ ولے
en: ...to school. Master sahib, this is happy news. Our children want to study too, but there was no one here to teach them. Now, God willing, we have come, and your children will study. But...
en_old: Send them to school. Master sahib, this is happy news. Our children want to study too, but there was nobody here to teach them. Now, God willing, we have come and your children will study. But...

brh: دا سے نمے چنا کرا تو ہا ماسٹر اینا انتظار ء کننگ اٹی اٹ جی میر صاحب نم یاد کرے رے نن حاضر مسن ماسٹر نم
en: Now ... (unclear) ... I've been waiting for that master. Yes, Mir sahib, you sent for us, so we have come. Master, you...
en_old: This is the child who... I have been waiting for the master today. Yes, Mir sahib, you called for us, so we have come. Master, you...

brh: درتی مرے کینوم داڑے بسونرے ولے کنا ملنگت بتونرے ہنو دا خلکٹ کنا ارٹمیکو دے پدا نما کنے خبر ملو او پدا دا خلکٹ کسے درستم کپرا
en: It's true that you came here, but you didn't come to meet me. Well, this is only my second day in this village; then I got your message, and besides, I don't know anyone in this village yet.
en_old: Sorry, I know you came here to meet me. That was my second day in this village, then I got your message, and after that nobody in this village did anything right.

brh: جوان مس دلاور نی بسس۔ کنے سوب آن نا انتظار اسکا۔ خیر تے تاتی اینو امر یاد کریس کنے۔ اینے انت پاو نسرین تینا اورائی الانے۔
en: It's good you came, Dilawar; I've been waiting for you since morning. Well, how is it that you remembered me today? What can I tell you, Nasreen has left her home.
en_old: It's good you came, Dilawar. I was waiting for you because of this. Well, how did you remember me today? What can I tell you, Nasreen has left her home.

brh: نبسنے اوڑے خوش افک ہنت اورائلہ نبسنے او اورائل ملانے داسہ تو وکیلم کرینے طلاق الینگ نا خاطرہ
en: Nasreen isn't happy there, so she left the house. Nasreen has left the house, and now she has even hired a lawyer in order to get a divorce.
en_old: She isn't happy there with her husband's family; she has left her husband's home. Now she has even hired a lawyer to get a divorce.

brh: ئے پاوہ کہ او کہ وکیل کرے نی نی اونا خیال ء کرک اوڑتو اوار مرک اونا کمک ء کرک تاتی اودے اسلت تننگ کے اونا ہمسفر مننگ کے
en: I'm saying that now that she has hired a lawyer, you should look after her, stand together with her, help her, give her heart, and be her companion.
en_old: I'm saying that she has hired a lawyer. You should take care of her, stand with her, help her, give her comfort, be her companion.

brh: ئے مالہ تیار اسوٹ، ولے نم؟ اینا انت پا؟ ئے تو باز کوشش کریٹ کہ نا او نا رشتہ مرے، ولے او باز ضد کریکہ۔ منیتاؤ ئے انت کریٹ؟ ضد کریکہ تو گڑا؟
en: I was ready from the start, but you people? What can I say to you? I tried very hard to make the match between you and her happen, but she was very stubborn. She didn't agree, so what could I do? She kept being stubborn, so what then?
en_old: I was ready for it, but you? What can I say? I tried very hard so that your relationship with him would work, but he was very stubborn. Didn't I do something? If he was stubborn, then what?

brh: دا سنت طلاق نا ضد کننگ اٹی او تو تنا مرضی ئ داڑے برام کرے الے دا متکنا ہیتاتے نی بس اونا کمک ئ کرک کنے کسنا
en: In this insistence on divorce... she married here by her own choice. Leave these old matters; you just help her. I don't need anyone's...
en_old: In this stubbornness over divorce, she married here of her own will. Leave these old matters; you just help her. I don't need anyone's...

brh: ضرورت افک، کنے ٹی داخس حوصلہ و طاقت ارے، کہ تینا جنجالاتا تینٹ مقابلہ کیو۔ نسرین! نسرین! داسکان تو نا دا ضد ختم متو؟ نسرین! او شتیمار! ئے دلاور ء خواہفینوٹ، تاکہ او نیتو
en: ...help. I have enough courage and strength in me to face my troubles myself. Nasreen! Nasreen! Hasn't this stubbornness of yours ended even now? Nasreen! Oh...! I have called Dilawar so that he would go with you...
en_old: ...help. I have enough courage and strength to face my problems myself. Nasreen! Nasreen! Hasn't this stubbornness of yours ended yet? Nasreen! You stubborn girl! I called Dilawar so that he would be with you.

brh: وار وکیل اکئے، کنے کس نا ہمدردی نا ضرورت اف، ئے چاف کنا گھاری مگچر، بس، بس ایت کنے نا ضرورت اف، ہراٹی پین نیاڑی مرے ولے کس نا جرات اف کہ تو نرینہ تمنو ایت کیر۔
en: ...along to the lawyers. I don't need anyone's sympathy; I know my hardships will pass. Enough, enough, I don't need you. Other women may be like that, but none of them has the courage to speak up in front of men.
en_old: Brother, lawyer... I don't need anyone's sympathy. I know my struggles won't end. Enough, enough, I don't need you. Wherever there are other women, but no one has the courage to stand up to men.

brh: ئے اسے خوانوک نیاڑی اسے اوٹک ئے تینا جوان بدے جوان چاوہ نہ دا خسی کمزور اوٹ کہ کس نا مونا ہیت کننگ کپر بس نسرین بس مس کس نا کرامت ئس دوئی نا کشاٹا ولے کنے افسوس ئے کہ کنے داتی داڑے فائفے بے عزت مننگ کے کنے تو نین
en: I am an educated woman. I know my own good and bad well; I'm not so weak that I can't speak in front of anyone. Enough, Nasreen, enough. ... But I regret that I was called here only to be humiliated.
en_old: I am an educated woman. I know my good and bad, not so weak that I can't speak in front of anyone. Enough, Nasreen, enough. Someone's dignity was taken by their husband, but I regret that I let myself be disgraced here like this.

brh: ہمو دے نفرت مس ہرا ٹیم نی کنتون برام نا انکار کریس ولے دا سہی پاوہ باز جوان مس نا کوننگا نیاڑی تو کسر نا زندگی برباد کپک تان تون نوم جھگڑا شروع کریرے دلاور اینے خواہفیت کین نوم دا ہڑم بے عزت کننگ نا خواہفیس کنے
en: I hated that day when you refused to marry me, but I'll say this truthfully: it turned out very well. Wouldn't a woman like you ruin anyone's life? You have started a quarrel... Why did you call Dilawar? Did you call him here to humiliate me like this?
en_old: I hated that day when you refused to marry me, but I say this rightly, it turned out very well. Such a woman ruins the life of the household; quarrels started with you. Dilawar, why did you call me? Did you call me to disgrace me this way?

brh: دا وخت اودے کنا کمک نا ضرورت ماروئے، ولے او؟ کنے کس نا کمک نا ضرورت اف، ئے چف کنا جنجال آک چٹار۔ نسرین، ہینو آن پد خاندان تون ایچ تعلق ئس مفروئے۔ کنے نما ضرورت اف، نم دا کانی لنکے۔
en: Right now she needs my help, but she...? I don't need anyone's help; I know my troubles will come to an end. Nasreen, from today on there will be no relationship at all with the family. I don't need you; you can go.
en_old: At this time she needs my help, but her? I don't need anyone's help; I know my problems won't end. Nasreen, from today on there will be no relationship with the family. I don't need you, get out of my sight.

brh: نسرین نسرین دلاور نی تو تول دلاور
en: Nasreen! Nasreen! Dilawar, you stay seated, Dilawar.
en_old: Nasreen, Nasreen, Dilawar, you sit down, Dilawar.

brh: یا اللہ، اما سدا وختہ سمجھوئی۔ ہاں امر ئس نسرین؟ گڑاس تینا باروٹ سوچانس؟ سوچنگ نا ٹائم داسہ ختم مسک۔
en: O God, how will she ever come to understand? Yes, how are you, Nasreen? Have you thought something over about yourself? The time for thinking is over now.
en_old: O God, we'll understand in time. Yes, how are you, Nasreen? Have you thought something about yourself? The time for thinking is over now.

brh: داسہ کنے فیصلہ نا انتظار ئے اور انشاءاللہ فیصلہ ہم کنا حق اٹ مروئی ئے او منیوہ دا فیصلہ ہم نیکن مروئی ئے ولے مونی انت مروئی ئے دا فکر کرے نوس؟
en: Now I'm waiting for the verdict, and God willing the verdict will be in my favor. Yes, I agree the verdict will be in your favor too, but have you thought about what will happen next?
en_old: Now I am waiting for the decision, and God willing the decision will be in my favor. I agree the decision will also be for you, but have you thought about what will happen next?

brh: مونی نا گڑی فکر کریٹ نا تو عدالت اسکا ئے سر متوٹے خبر اف نی انتے دن کیسہ اوڑ ایڑ نسرین بے شک نیاڑی ئے حق ارے ولے گڑاس ہیتک ہندنو مریرہ کہ نیاڑی ئے برداشت کروئی تمک
en: I have thought about what lies ahead; otherwise I wouldn't have come as far as the court. I don't know why you're doing this, oh sister Nasreen. Of course a woman has rights, but some things are such that a woman has to put up with them.
en_old: Think about the future. Otherwise I wouldn't have reached the court at all. I don't know why you do this. Sister Nasreen, of course a woman has rights, but some things are such that a woman has to endure them.

brh: اور نازیہ، ننا ہم توکک مریرے۔ دا چاگردٹی ننا ہم ہناک ملیپسہ۔ اندا خاطران ئے اسے مثال ئس مننگ خواہوے اور ئے تینا حق ء ضرور الوٹک۔ بس نازیہ، پگہ۔
en: And Nazia, we have rights too. In this society we don't get our rights either. That's why I want to become an example, and I will certainly claim my right. That's it, Nazia, tomorrow.
en_old: And Nazia, we will also stay. In this society we too don't get our rights. That's why I want to be an example, and I will surely take my right. That's all, Nazia, tomorrow.

brh: ئے پیشیٹ، نی تو اگر وختس اگہ تنی ضرور برے سک، نت تو ولدا ئے تینٹ اینوٹک۔ کنا مشکل ئے ایڑ، ئے پدا نمے احوال کرو۔ بس ٹھیک ئے اللہ حافظ، ٹیک کیئر۔ اللہ نگہبان۔
en: I'll be at the hearing. If you ever need me at any time, I'll come with you myself. It's my difficulty, sister; I'll let you know afterwards. Okay, fine, goodbye, take care. May God protect you.
en_old: I'm outside. If you ever need something, then call me, I'll come myself. It's my problem, sister; I'll tell you later. Okay then, goodbye, take care. May God protect you.

brh: بابا جانوم کنا مسڑ داڑے تولوک انت سوچنگٹی اسنے؟
en: My dear, my daughter, what are you sitting here thinking about?
en_old: Dear father, my daughter, what are you sitting here thinking about?

brh: مچے زند نا غم کم مریر کنا مسڑ وخت ئس نی سوچا نس
en: May all the sorrows of life grow less, my daughter. Have you ever thought...
en_old: May all the sorrows of your life lessen, my daughter. Were you thinking about something?

brh: کہ دا جنجالاتے آخر انتئے ننا ودیکے نا کہ ننا خوشی تے گپ و غار کیرے بابا چا بسیدو وڈی خلنگ مفک داد کے ہلو دوئی مونی کروئی تمک
en: ...why, after all, these troubles are brought upon us, so that they make our happiness vanish? Father, you know, it doesn't work just by ...; to get justice, one has to step forward.
en_old: ...that why do these troubles arise for us, that they turn our happiness into quarrels. Father, you know that the saying is not enough; one has to put this into practice.

brh: دا پیریٹے، دا سہینا، دا دردا تے سگنگ کیوا، او نا لوما سگنگ کیکے۔ بابا نی دا قدر کمزور مسوسک، نی تو کنے حوصلہ تسوسے۔
en: In this old age, can I bear these pains? Can her mother bear them? Father, have you become this weak? You were the one who gave me courage.
en_old: This old age, these breaths... can I endure these pains? Can her mother endure them? Father, have you become this weak? You were the one who gave me courage.

brh: امر کیو کنا مسڑ باہوٹ نا ہراتا کتو رنگا باوا تینا ہولہ نا دادے سگنگ کیک
en: What can I do, my daughter? How can a father bear his child's pain?
en_old: What can I do, my daughter? In what way can a father endure this for his daughter?

brh: داسہ نی دنت درداتے سگنگ نا طاقت اف کنا مسڑ۔ نی تینٹ کنے تینا نت آ سلویس۔ کنے ٹی اعتماد پیدا کریس۔ داسہ نی کنے
en: Now you don't have the strength to bear such pains, my daughter. You yourself made me stand on my own feet. You built confidence in me. Now you...
en_old: Now you don't have the strength to endure so much pain, my daughter. You yourself made me stand on my own feet. You built confidence in me. Now you...

brh: ئے ہم زور کننگ نا کوشش کننگٹوس کنا مسڑ دیر خواہک کہ اونا اولاد خوار و برباد مرے دیر خواہک کہ اوفتہ اولاد نا زند جوانی اٹ گدرینگے ہر کس نا دا
en: I too am trying to stay strong, my daughter. Who would want their children to be miserable and ruined? Everyone wants their children's lives to pass well; this is everyone's...
en_old: ...I am also trying to push, my daughter. Who would want their children to be miserable and ruined? Everyone wants their children's lives to pass well; this is everyone's...

brh: خواجہ کے، اوفتا اولاد خوش و خوشحال مریر، آباد مریر، ہسے آباد و زندس گدریفیر۔ داسے نی کنا فکر ء کپہ، کنے ٹی داغس طاقت ارے۔
en: ...wish, that their children be happy and prosperous, that they flourish and live just such a settled life. Now don't you worry about me; I have this much strength in me...
en_old: I pray to God that their children are happy and prosperous, that they flourish, that they live a settled life just like that. Now don't you worry about me, I still have this much strength in me.

brh: کہ ئے او تا مقابلہ کیو۔ نی پریشان مفے۔ کنا مسٹ ہندا حوصلہ ء تینا لومہ ء ایت۔ ہندے کہ ئے اودے دنو رنگ کپر۔
en: ...that I can face them. Don't you worry. My daughter, give this same courage to your mother, so that I don't have to see her in such a state.
en_old: ...so that I will face them. Don't you worry. My daughter, give this same courage to your mother, so that I don't do such a thing to her.

brh: یا اللہ، دانت وس
en: O God, what was that?
en_old: O Allah, what is this?

brh: جہانزیب خیر ئے تب نا جوان؟ او یار بس مچے ٹھنڈن کاٹم کنا چکر کرے، پریشانی ئس توف۔
en: Jahanzeb, is everything all right? Are you feeling well? Oh friend, it's just that my head spun a little; there's nothing to worry about.
en_old: Jahanzeb, is everything alright? Are you feeling well? Oh friend, just that all this cold made my head spin; there's no worry.

brh: داڑے عدالت نا مونا خیر تو ارے؟ او نی اندن مچٹ، اورائیتو کنا جھگڑا چلینگنگے، اینو چنا نا فیصلہ ئس جوان گڑا، اندا فیصلہ مس کہ چنا تینا لمہ تو رہینگے، جوان۔
en: Is everything all right here in front of the court? Oh, it's just a small matter. My dispute with my wife is going on; today there was a decision about the child, a good thing: it was decided that the child will stay with his mother. Good.
en_old: Is everything alright here in front of the court? Oh, it's just like that. My dispute with them is ongoing. Today the child's case got a good decision; it was decided that the child will stay with his mother. Good.

brh: ہاں دا سپو مسٹ واقعی پریشانی نا ہیت ئس توڑے ولے نی پریشان کپتینیس بش م کانہ ایڑے ہوٹلا تولینہ چاس کنینہ گپم کینہ۔ پا نہ ئے وراغہ کاو کانہ ئے وریتہ مانے۔
en: Yes, this really is a worrying matter, but don't you worry. Get up, let's go, sister; let's sit at a restaurant, have some tea and chat. Tell me, shall we go for a meal? Let's go...
en_old: Yes, this really is a matter of worry, but don't you worry. Let's go, sister, let's sit at the hotel, have some tea and chat. Tell me, have you eaten or not? Let's go eat.

brh: تو کنتو موٹرسائیکل ارے دیو سر کیو نی نہ نہ باز مہربانی کنتو سواری ارے پین کنا لائق کار خدمت ئے حاضر اٹ خوش مرس ہا جان گڑا کنا
en: I have a motorcycle with me; I'll drop you off. No, no, thank you very much, I have a ride. Is there any other service I can do for you? I'm at your service. Be well. Yes dear, then my...
en_old: I have a motorcycle with me, I'll drop you off. No, no, thank you very much, I have a ride. Is there any other service I can do for you? I'm at your service, I'd be glad. Yes dear, then my...

brh: انو سیدھا اسکولے ناٹ اسکولے ملانٹ جوان تو اسکول نا چناک نی بخیر کریر میر صاحب خبر اف کے اٹ وقتان اسکول بندے او کس سے خبرم اف
en: Today I went straight to the school and opened the school. — Good, so did the school's children welcome you? — Mir sahib, who knows for how long the school has been closed, and nobody even knows about it.
en_old: Today I went straight to the school and visited it. Good, so did you greet the school's children? Mir sahib, I don't know how long the school has been closed, and nobody knows either.

brh: آستہ آستہ کسے خبر تموے تو برسہ کرور باز مشکل ئے کہ کسس تینا چنا کے سکول آ مون ایتے انت میر صاحب
en: Slowly, slowly, once people get word, they will keep coming. — It is very difficult for anyone to send his child to school. — What do you mean, Mir sahib?
en_old: Slowly, once people find out, they will come. It's very hard for anyone to send their child to school. What do you say, Mir sahib?

brh: خواننگ تو اوفتہ حق ء۔ امر و کس؟ میر صاحب چاو کہ نی دائے تے گرام کرینوس کہ چناتا ہنداکو۔ جوان!
en: Studying is their right. — How so? — Mir sahib, I know that you have kept these people [enslaved?] so that their children stay this way. — Good!
en_old: Studying is their right. How so? Mir sahib, look, you have called these people here so that the children would come. Good!

brh: داسہ نی کنے دا پاوکیس کہ دا علاقہ اٹ چنا تا انت حال کو۔ کنا خیال اٹ کہ ماسٹر نی کنے تپیسے۔ انت کہ اسکول نا چپراسی کنے کل ہیت آتے پارے نی اگر کنے چاسہ نا۔
en: Now are you going to tell me what state the children of this area are in? I think, master, you don't know me. Because the school's peon has told me everything, whether you know me or not.
en_old: Now will you tell me what the situation of the children in this area is? I thought you wouldn't tell me, master. But the school peon told me everything, whether you know me or not.

brh: تو داڑے خالی کنا مارے خوانفوس۔ دا خلکٹی اسہ چنا ئس اسکولہ بفروک دا پومرک۔ اگر نما مار تون اوار دا خلک نا چار چنا پین علم نا روشنائی آن فائدہ ارفیرہ۔
en: So here you will teach only my son. Not a single child in this village will come to school, understand that. — If, together with your son, four more children of this village benefit from the light of knowledge...
en_old: So here you will teach only my son. Not a single child in this village comes to school. If four more children of this village benefit from the light of knowledge along with your son...

brh: تو گڑا دا ٹینتھ فارغ تمبک؟ ماسٹر ئے نی پاریٹ نا پین کسس اسکول ا بفروئی بس نم کنا مال ء خوانفوری بس
en: So then, won't this [tenth? unclear] be over? Master, I told you that no one else is to come to school. That's all — you will teach my son, that's it.
en_old: So is this tenth class finished then? Master, I told you that nobody else would come to school, so you will teach my son.

brh: ٹھیک ہی میر صاحب، اگر کس بتو تو ئے پدی کاوا۔ جی، بیرہ نو اچونائے نما غوراٹ چفانی فنکے بفر اوٹ۔
en: All right, Mir sahib, if no one comes, then I will go back. — Yes, ... [unclear] ... in your care ... I will come [unclear].
en_old: All right, Mir sahib. If nobody comes, I will go back. Yes, only tomorrow I will bring them to you.

brh: انتئے کے؟ ئے سکول نا ماسٹر اٹ، نا چنا نا ماسٹر افٹ۔
en: Why? I am the school's teacher, not your child's teacher.
en_old: Why? I am the school's teacher, not your child's teacher.

brh: اسے گھنٹہ اسے گھنٹہ ٹی آن دونو سبق ہتیس تینے کہ مچا زند یاد کروس نا مئے
en: One hour — within one hour you have earned yourself such a lesson that you will remember it your whole life.
en_old: In one hour, in just one hour, you gave me such a lesson that I will remember it for the rest of my life.

brh: صاحب، گونزو نا، انتئے کہ محلہ والا ماسٹر نا الزام ء مخلوق نازیہ خلنگے، گلو کنے کسے نا پرواہ اف، دا ماسٹر ء ہندنو سبق ئس ایتنے۔
en: Sahib, [unclear], because the people of the neighbourhood are laying the blame for the master on people. — Forget it, I don't care about anyone; this master has been taught such a lesson.
en_old: Sir, wait, because the people of the neighborhood are blaming the master and mocking people. I don't care about anyone; this master has taught such a lesson.

brh: کتاب مچا جندیا تیخی۔ نو فکر کپا وکیل صاحب۔ دادے سبق تینن کنا کا۔ داسہ کنے اجازت ئے بس۔
en: Keep all the books with yourself. Don't worry, Wakil sahib. [unclear: this lesson ...]. Now give me leave.
en_old: Keep the whole book with you. Don't worry, lawyer sahib. Teach me this lesson yourself. Now give me permission to leave.

brh: اسکول نا سفت خوار، تانکے کسس تینا چنا کے اسکول آ متف، ماسٹر تینیاں چک چک بسروتی
en: Praising the school is pointless; until someone sends his child to school, the master will sit there all alone [unclear].
en_old: Praise the school all you like, but until someone sends their child to school, the master will keep sitting there alone.

brh: او دے شیف کروئی او دے شیف کروئی انتس کہ نما حکم، ہنبو
en: He has to be brought down, he has to be brought down. — Whatever you command. Go!
en_old: Should it be moved to that day? Whatever you order, all right.

brh: کنا مار نی دا کلم ء دا خاخرٹ انتئے سکرنگ اٹی ئس ہائے دا کلم اٹی باز بھلو طاقت ئس ارے
en: My son, why are you heating this pen in this fire? Oh, there is very great power in this pen.
en_old: My son, why are you holding this pen like that? This pen has very great power.

brh: او کنمار دا کلم نا باز بلو طاقت اسے۔ ئے دا طاقت آن انتئے محروم اٹ یا دا کنا نصیب اٹ اف؟ نہ کنمار دنو ہچو ہیت ئس افک ہر بندغ
en: Oh my son, the pen has very great power. — Why am I deprived of this power, or is it not in my fate? — No, my son, there is no such thing; every person...
en_old: Oh my son, this is a very great power of the Kalima. Why am I deprived of this power, or is it not in my fate? No, my son, there is no such thing; every person...

brh: دے تینا نصیب اٹ اینو ایڈ جوڑ کیک۔ تھوما، ئے ٹماٹ کڑخائفٹ، باوہ چنا کیٹی کڑخائفک، ورنا مس، مونا پد مار، انت؟ دا؟
en: ...makes his own fate himself, today. [Partly garbled, sounds like a recited lesson:] Thoma(?), I boiled tomatoes; father boils [it] in a small pot; he became a young man; front, back, son. What? This?
en_old: Today he is making his own fate. Thoma, I cooked tomatoes, father cooks in the pot, he grew up, then the son, what? This?

brh: دا ننا سیلن دن اینے ساکروئے کنا مار نی اینو دا مروئت کنا گٹیس اردا کلمنے دیتسساک دا اسہ ٹینا امانت اسے ہرا خنارتے ہمے ٹائم تے وتے میرو
en: This is our ... it must be kept safe like this, my son. Today you [showed] this kindness ... I [gave you] this pen. This is a trust of your own, which ... at that very time ... will become [unclear].
en_old: This is our... you must keep it like this, my son. Today you have this... my... I have given this Kalima to you. This is a trust of yours, which you will get at that time.

brh: نی خواننگ نا شوق کیرے؟ ہائے ادہ انزہ ملنگ بابا مندا پائیک۔ بابا؟ دا بابا آخر دیر ئس ہرے اسہ بندغ ئس
en: Do you have a desire to study? — Yes, ... Malang Baba tells me [so]. — Baba? Who is this Baba, after all — some person?
en_old: Do you like studying? Yes, there Malang Baba says so. Baba? Who is this Baba after all? A person.

brh: کنا سنگت بابا نا سنگت دا نین پاننگٹ ئس انت ئ انت مس
en: My friend — Baba's friend. — What is this you are saying? What, what happened?
en_old: My friend, Baba's friend was saying this just now. What happened?

brh: او باز جوان و بندغاسے کنا است کیک ئے پورہ دے اوت مریو باز جوان و جوان ہیت کیک کنے نصیحت کیک کنے نیک دعا ایتک کنے پائک بختی وراغین جوان
en: He is a very good person; he loves me. I stay with him the whole day; he says very good, good things, gives me advice, gives me good blessings, and tells me, 'Be fortunate [and prosper]', good boy.
en_old: He is a very good person, he loves me. I stay with him all day, he talks very nicely and kindly, he gives me advice, he gives me good prayers, he tells me, may you be lucky and prosper.

brh: شریف مریم بوتل بوتل ہمار بوتل داڑے بوتل ئس نم ترفتے ورتے نم تینا ڈو توارے بینگم بسو
en: Sharif, Maryam — bottle, bottle, that bottle, a bottle here. You ... [unclear] ... you heard your own call too — come!
en_old: Sharif, Maryam, the bottle, the bottle, that bottle, a bottle here. You put it away, bring it, you called out your... come.

brh: گڑا دے درتے ہند کسس بس تاوے ہندا توئے حیران اٹ گدے بس دے درتے ضرور جن ئس مروئی ننا کنا صیب خلیفہ نی
en: Then someone came to the door like that, and I was amazed by it; then it came to me that it must surely be a jinn at the door. Our— my sahib, Khalifa, you...
en_old: Then that day someone came to the door, I was surprised at this, then it came to me that there must surely be a jinn at the door. My... Khalifa, you...

brh: ہن مس ہن مس بوتل دارتے توکوک اسہ گٹی ہنٹ بوتل دارتے توکوک اسہ گٹی دیر پور کریٹے اسے بوتل پور کریٹے ایلو بوتل کہ دوئی پٹی
en: Yes, that's how it happened, that's how it happened: the bottles are kept in one [room]. I went — the bottles are kept in one [room]. I filled the water, filled one bottle, and the other bottle, which [was in the] box...
en_old: It happened, it happened. The bottles are kept in one room. I went, the bottles are kept in one room. Fill the water, fill one bottle, the other bottle that is in the second room.

brh: اوہو! بابا کسہ سرفوئی تا، نوں پریشان مفبو، ئے دا سہ چوکیدار نا ریفو وا، چوکیدار!
en: Oho! Baba, [unclear], don't worry now; I'll [call] the watchman now. Watchman!
en_old: Oh! Baba, it's nothing to worry about, don't be worried now, I'll call the watchman. Watchman!

brh: دا دے چوکیدار بس داڑے دیر نا بوتل ئس تخوک اسکا دا دے نم تو ارسفنہ رے او آ ئے تو داڑے بتانوٹ
en: Here, the watchman has come. A bottle of water had been put here; [unclear] you were not ... I haven't even come here.
en_old: That day the watchman came here. A bottle of water had been placed. That day you were not... he... I had told him here.

brh: جوان؟ توبہ! دیر درے تا؟ بس ہب، ہن پاو نی داڑے اکثر ہنو مریخ۔
en: Really? Good grief! Who was at the door? Enough, wait — come on, tell me, does this often happen here?
en_old: Good? Goodness! Who is at the door? Just wait, tell me, do you often come here?

brh: اکثر دنمرک ہن مطلب مطلب دادے کہ داڑے ہر بندہ خوش ہنے
en: It often happens like this, yes. I mean, I mean that everyone here goes away happy.
en_old: It often happens like that, I mean, I mean that everyone here goes happily.

brh: ٹھیک ہی نومبر
en: All right... November.
en_old: Alright, November.

brh: ببو، کم، داکان
en: Come on, come, this way.
en_old: Come, come over, from here.

brh: السلام علیکم سر۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ خیریت ئے نور ئے ٹھیک ٹھاک؟ ٹھیک ٹھاک، خیریت ئے دعا ئے خیریت ئے نم جوڑ ارے؟ شکر اللہ نا۔ ادا با ماسٹر صاحب ہراڑے تولو؟ ماسٹر صاحب سے دفتر اٹ تولو۔ مہربانی، مہربانی۔
en: Peace be upon you, sir. — And upon you be peace. — Is all well? Are you fine? — Fine, all is well, thanks to [your] prayers, all is well. Are you well? — Thanks be to God. Brother, where would the master sahib be sitting? — The master sahib sits in that office. — Thank you, thank you.
en_old: Peace be upon you, sir. And peace be upon you. Is everything well, are you fine? Fine, all is well, thanks to prayers. Are you well? Thank God. Brother, where does the master sahib sit? The master sahib sits in the office. Thank you, thank you.

brh: کرائی مرو سور، کل اوٹ کھڑینکا کرائی مرو سور، ننا غم کے ہمنے کے جائی مرو سور، وہ سور نا خنتیاں نا کجلا کم، وہ سور نا خنتیاں نا کجلا کم، شہداتا شہتے کے سیائی مرو سور، وہ سور نا
en: …would have become […]; all the tears would have become […]; our grief would have found a place […]; even the kohl of your eyes, even the kohl of your eyes would have become ink for the martyrs' […]; your…
en_old: May all my tears be a wedding; may all my tears be a wedding; may our sorrow be a wedding. The kohl of your eyes, the kohl of your eyes, may it be ink for the martyrs' epitaph...

brh: خن تیان نا کہ جلاکم شہیداتا شیت کہ سیائی مروسر، نا دا خیسوننگا اناریا جوڑاک، دا بیماراسے کن دوائی مروسر۔ نا دا خیسوننگا، نا دا خیسوننگا اناریا جوڑاک، دا بیماراسے کن دوائی
en: Even the kohl of your eyes would have become ink for the martyrs' […]; these red, pomegranate-like lips of yours would have become medicine for this sick one. These red lips of yours, these red, pomegranate-like lips of yours, medicine for this sick one…
en_old: The kohl of your eyes would be ink for the martyrs' epitaph; these red pomegranate-like cheeks of yours would be medicine for a sick person. These red, these red pomegranate-like cheeks of yours would be medicine for a sick person.

brh: شاہی مروسس نی تولوک اینو برامی مروسس نی تولوک اینو برامی مروسس کنا وڑ کم بادشاہی مروسس نی تولوک اینو برامی مروسس
en: …would have been royalty. Had you been sitting here, today would have been a wedding; had you been sitting here, today would have been a wedding; even for the likes of me it would have been kingship; had you been sitting here, today would have been a wedding.
en_old: ...would be royalty; your sitting today would be a wedding; your sitting today would be a wedding. For me too it would be royalty; your sitting today would be a wedding.

brh: کنا وڑ کہ ہم بادشاہی مروست، ئے مچو غزل پاو نی کے وزن ٹی، ئے مچو غزل پاو نی کے وزن ٹی، نا چاریت پختہ رباعی مروست، ئے مچو غزل پاو نی کے وزن ٹی
en: Even for the likes of me it would have been kingship. If I recited a whole ghazal about you in meter, if I recited a whole ghazal about you in meter, your four [lines] would have become a perfect quatrain; if I recited a whole ghazal about you in meter…
en_old: For me too it would be royalty; say a whole ghazal in meter, say a whole ghazal in meter; your four lines would be a polished rubai. Say a whole ghazal in meter.

brh: ننا درد آ کزارو نی انعام مس، ننا درد آ کزارو نی انعام مس، کینگس کل اشار
en: Leaving us to our pain, you have gone; leaving us to our pain, you have gone; [death…], all the signs…
en_old: Our pain, you became the reward; our pain, you became the reward; everyone's signal...

brh: ارو نی انامس، ننا دھد آ کزارو نی انامس، کہینگس کل اشارو نی انامس، ننا پرنگا خنتے اورتو ہو، ننا پرنگا خنتے اورتو ہو، ننا دو تیا تخارو نی انامس، ننا پرنگا خنتے
en: …you have gone; leaving us to our pain, you have gone; [death…], all the signs, and you have gone. Our […] eyes […], our […] eyes […]; placed in our hands, and you have gone; our […] eyes…
en_old: Where did you go? You passed by our door and went away, all the signs faded, you went away. Our waiting eyes kept watching, our waiting eyes kept watching, you put it in our hands and went away, our waiting eyes...

brh: اوڑتو رہو ننا دوتیا تخارو نی ئنا مس نرخ موم بتی تا ودا بازار اٹی نرخ موم بتی تا ودا بازار اٹی جوان مس کاروبارونے ئنا مس نرخ موم بتی تا
en: […] placed in our hands, and you have gone. The price of candles rose in the market; the price of candles rose in the market; business boomed, and you have gone; the price of candles…
en_old: With that, you put it in our hands and went away. The price of candles in that market, the price of candles in that market; business did well, and you went away, the price of candles...

brh: اود نا بازار اٹی جوان مس کاروبار او نی اینا مس تنیا تولو کسون دشت اٹی ہیو قیس تنیا تولو کسون ئے دشت اٹی ہیو قیس سنگت آ کل اینار او نی اینا مس خنتیا نون
