en: …in the market business boomed, and you have gone. Sitting alone in the desert, O Qais; sitting alone in the desert, O Qais; the friends have all gone, and you have gone too; from the eyes…
en_old: Business did well in that market, and you went away. Sitting alone in the desert, O Qais, sitting alone in the desert, O Qais, all the friends left, and you went away with tears in your eyes.

brh: خنتیان ہونا مستو غاٹی اما ہو غوسو یار او نی اینا ہمبس خنتیان ہونا مستو غاٹی اما ہو غوسو یار او نی اینا ہمبس عمر نا خاخرا ہوسنو نا عجیب کرے سوس استو لار او نی اینا ہمبس
en: From the eyes […], O friend, and you too have gone; from the eyes […], O friend, and you too have gone. At the [end] of life […] a strange thing […], and you too have gone.
en_old: From the eyes... what was there, O friend, and you went away too. From the eyes... what was there, O friend, and you went away too. At the end of life you did a strange thing, and you went away too.

brh: عمر نا خاخر اوس نو اونا عجیب کرے سس تس تولار اونا اینامس اردو است دے خفا بوڑو بس اردو نا پنڈے برنگ کے
en: At the [end] of life […] did a strange thing […] sat […], and you have gone. (Host:) Urdu… [someone] is upset at heart… so, [there is] a request for Urdu…
en_old: At the end of life you did a strange thing and went away... Urdu... now there is a request for Urdu.

brh: اردو بس کم کم مختلف غزلات ہن جی جی ایک تجھ سے ذرا قریب ہیں ہم ایک تجھ سے ذرا
en: Urdu — just a few different ghazals. Yes, yes. 'It is only to you that we are a little close; only to you, a little…'
en_old: Urdu, just a few different ghazals. Yes, yes, 'We are a little close to you, a little to you...'

brh: بس ایک ہی نصیحت ہی دیکھ کر بھول جانے کے مشکل، دیکھ کر بھول جانے کے مشکل یاد رکھنا تو پھر سہولت ہی دیکھ کر بھول جانے کے مشکل یاد رکھنا تو پھر سہولت ہی لا۔۔۔
en: Just one piece of advice: 'The hard part is forgetting after seeing, the hard part is forgetting after seeing; remembering, then, is the easy thing. The hard part is forgetting after seeing; remembering, then, is the easy thing…'
en_old: Just one piece of advice: 'It is hard to forget once you have seen, it is hard to forget once you have seen; if you remember, then it is easy. It is hard to forget once you have seen; if you remember, then it is easy...'

brh: لاکھ صورت بگاڑ دے ئس کے، لاکھ صورت بگاڑ دے ئس کے، زندگی پھر بھی خوبصورت ہی خوبصورت ہی لاکھ صورت بگاڑ دے ئس کے، زندگی پھر بھی خوبصورت ہی
en: 'However much someone's face may be disfigured, however much someone's face may be disfigured, life is still beautiful, beautiful. However much someone's face may be disfigured, life is still beautiful.'
en_old: 'Let someone ruin your face a hundred thousand times, let someone ruin your face a hundred thousand times, life is still beautiful, still beautiful. Let someone ruin your face a hundred thousand times, life is still beautiful.'

brh: غرور ئس کا اتارنے دو، غرور ئس کا اتارنے دو، مین سن رہا ہوں پکارنے دو۔ غرور ئس کا اتارنے دو، مین سن رہا ہوں پکارنے دو۔
en: 'Let someone's pride be brought down, let someone's pride be brought down; I am listening, let them call. Let someone's pride be brought down; I am listening, let them call.'
en_old: 'Let someone's pride come down, let someone's pride come down, I am listening, let them call. Let someone's pride come down, I am listening, let them call.'

brh: براہوئی مجلس نا سارئیے، نمار جی منظور کیازئی۔
en: Your RJ Manzoor Kiazai is here with Brahui Majlis.
en_old: This is Brahui Majlis, please accept our respects.

brh: براہوئی مسکستو ساڑی ئے نمار جی منظور کیازئی
en: Your RJ Manzoor Kiazai is here with Brahui Majlis.
en_old: Brahui Majlis is on, please accept our respects.

brh: راوی مجلس تو ساڑی ئے نمار جی منظور کیازئی۔
en: Your RJ Manzoor Kiazai is here with [B]rahui Majlis.
en_old: Rawi Majlis is on, please accept our respects.

brh: براہوئی مجلس تو ساڑی ئے نما ارجے منظور کیازئی، چلتن نا شاہ شان اٹ جی جی، مچ ٹولہ و بولان اٹ جی جی
en: Your RJ Manzoor Kiazai is here with Brahui Majlis. In the grand glory of Chiltan, yes, yes; in Mach, [Tola] and Bolan, yes, yes.
en_old: Brahui Majlis is on, please accept our respects. In the grandeur of Chiltan, yes yes, in Much, Toleh and Bolan, yes yes.

brh: دا چتن و شانتی جی مچ امبو گولانتی جی دا چتن و شانتی باڑی گدانٹ چلتنی ار استخوانٹ چلتنی میر نما
en: In this Chiltan's glory, yes; in Mach and Bolan too, yes; in this Chiltan's glory, […] in [every] tent, Chiltani; in every bone, Chiltani; your Mir…
en_old: This is Chiltan and peace, yes, Much and Bolan, yes, this is Chiltan and peace... Chiltan... Mir, your...

brh: براہوئی مجلس تو ساڑی ئے نما آر جی م۔
en: Your R[J] M… is here with Brahui Majlis.
en_old: Brahui Majlis is on, your...

brh: تو پیاز ئے ننا نما ارستنا توا
en: […] is here(?), our… your…
en_old: So... our... your...

brh: نم بننگورے چلتن ایف ایم ہشتاد و ہشت
en: You are listening to Chiltan FM eighty-eight.
en_old: You are listening to Chiltan FM eighty-eight.

brh: براہوئی مجلس تو ساڑی ئے
en: Here with Brahui Majlis is…
en_old: Brahui Majlis is on.

brh: نمار جی منظور کیازئی کنا بختئے کنا پڑکا تھنا دلدار تولوکئے کنا بختئے کنا پڑکا
en: …your RJ Manzoor Kiazai. (Song:) My fortune, my […], the beloved is seated; my fortune, my […]
en_old: Please accept our respects. 'My fortune, my... the beloved sitting... my fortune, my...'

brh: بلبلات علی کوئی ہرکاک چاپاٹو، ہر گلاب لڈینگے، مخساؤ میرٹ تو، چلتنے
en: Nightingales […], everyone with clapping, every rose is swaying, laughing […], Chiltan…
en_old: Nightingales... whoever dances, every rose sways... Chiltan.

brh: ئے بنوکاٹی، میر نا سلامات تو، میر نا کلپتھیرے۔ نما تینا چلتن ایف ایم 88
en: …to the listeners, with Mir's greetings, Mir's […]. Your own Chiltan FM 88.
en_old: ...to the listeners, greetings from Mir, Mir's... Your own Chiltan FM 88.

brh: براہوئی مجلس نا ساڑیئے نما آر جی منظور کیازئی
en: Your RJ Manzoor Kiazai is here with Brahui Majlis.
en_old: With the Brahui program, your RJ Manzoor Kiyazai is with you.

brh: درو ننگورے شلتن ایف ایم
en: [You are] listening to Chiltan FM.
en_old: ... Chiltan FM

brh: براہوئی مجلس توساڑی ء نمارجے منظور کیازئی کنا باغ تے کنا پھل کا کنا دلدار تو
en: Your RJ Manzoor Kiazai is here with Brahui Majlis. (Song:) My garden, my flower, my beloved…
en_old: Your RJ Manzoor Kiyazai is with you in the Brahui program. My garden, my flower, with my beloved.

brh: تولوکے کنا بختے کنا پڑدے کنا دلدار تولوکے
en: …is seated; my fortune, my veil, my beloved is seated.
en_old: You are the one, my fortune, my veil, my beloved, you are the one.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ ماسٹر صاحب نوم داری ئے تہو غس توخنی گیٹیا پٹ۔ انسپکٹر نواز صاحب۔ جوڑ بخیر تکڑا۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Master sahib, you here... [unclear] ...at the gate. Inspector Nawaz sahib. Are you well, all fine and in good health?
en_old: Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you. Master sahib, my name... at the gate... Inspector Nawaz sahib. Are you well and strong?

brh: سر، نم داڑے امرے؟ بس ماسٹر صیب ہما کین، سرکار نا ڈیوٹی ئے ہراڑے راہی کین ننے، ننے نوکری کروئی ئے واقعی تلبو، مہربانی، نم چا سے نا بندوبست کبو۔
en: Sir, how come you are here? Well, master sahib, it's just that wherever the government's duty sends us, we have to do the job. Really. Please sit. Thank you. Please arrange some tea.
en_old: Sir, how are you here? Well, master sahib, wherever the government sends us on duty, we have to do the job. Really, sit down please. Thank you, please arrange some tea.

brh: ولے نیت نا بینف نیت داڑے امر؟ کنا ہم نی امبار ٹرانسفر مس داڑے، باز جوان، کنے درو سما تما کہ اسکول ملنگانے، گڑاس چنا مشار ئنا ہریر، ئے پاو موتے آتے اسکول آ داخل کننگ کے، باز جوان کریس۔
en: But how come you are here? I was also transferred here, just like you. Very good. I learned yesterday that the school had opened. Some children [unclear]. Let me tell [them] to get them admitted to the school. You did very well.
en_old: But how did you come here? I was also transferred here like you. Very good. When I learned that the school was opening, I told some children's parents to get them admitted to the school. You did very well.

brh: دا اسکول بند ئس کسس خواننگے بتوکا؟ ماشا صیب اسکول بند اسہ کہ دا چناتے کے باز پریشان اسوٹے، ولے دا سا کرے نا بننگان کنا پریشانی مرمز۔ بس یار انت پاوٹے؟
en: Was this school closed, and did nobody come to study? Master sahib, the school was closed, so I was very worried about these children, but now with [your] arrival my worry has gone away. Well, friend, what can I say?
en_old: Was this school closed, did no one come to study? Master sahib, the school being closed made me very worried about these children, but with your coming my worry has eased. Just, friend, what can I say?

brh: دا جگہ نا دا اسکول نا حالت ء خنے وا، توس کنا کپ ماریک، چنا تے خنے وا، توس کنا لاڑ کیک، کہ انتئے دا جگہ نا دا اسکول
en: When I see the state of this school in this place, I feel torn in half. When I see the children, I shudder: why is this school in this place...
en_old: When I see the condition of this place, of this school, my heart breaks; when I see the children, my heart aches, that why is this place's school like this?

brh: دا چناتے پد بٹینو۔ انتئے دن مننگٹی دافتو۔ انتئے دا چناتے روشنائی آن تارمٹے دک تننگٹی۔ ماسٹر صیب دا سکرے نم بسنورے اراسٹ تینا چناتے روشنائی نا
en: They have left these children behind. Why is it happening like this to them? Why are these children being pushed out of the light into darkness? Master sahib, you have come this far [unclear] so that your children [would be brought] to the light of...
en_old: Keep these children behind. Why is this happening? Why are these children being pushed out of the light into darkness? Master sahib, you have come this far to bring your children into the light...

brh: سراتوئی، انتئے کہ علم ئس روشنائی ئس ئ، علم آن بغیر تو تارمئی۔ بس انت پانو انسپکٹر صاحب؟ ئے بسٹ ہمو جوزہ ٹی کہ دا اسکولے ملوا، ملم تون
en: ...[they] must be brought, because knowledge is a light; without knowledge there is only darkness. Well, what can we say, Inspector sahib? I came with that very passion, to open this school, with knowledge...
en_old: Sir, because knowledge is a light, and without knowledge there is only darkness. So what can I say, Inspector sahib? I came with the passion to open this school, with knowledge...

brh: میر صاحب نا بندغ آک بسو۔ کنے دکت ارا سد میر صاحب پیش کرے، ئے خوش مسوٹ کہ میر صاحب کاوا، ہر ماسٹر پاو کہ اسکولے ملات تو میر صاحب خوش مروئی
en: Mir sahib's men came. Mir sahib extended an invitation to me, and I was happy that I would be going to Mir sahib. I thought, I've opened the school, so Mir sahib is bound to be pleased.
en_old: Mir sahib's men came. Mir sahib invited me to his house. I was happy that Mir sahib had called me. Every master thinks that if he opens the school, Mir sahib will be pleased.

brh: کنے شاباشی تروئی ہلی راڑے، او کنے دھمکی تس کہ نی واپس کنا ٹرانسفر کریس، داڑے چھندی ماسٹرک بسنو، چھندی کنے واپس اینائے۔
en: He should have praised me, but there he threatened me instead: 'Get yourself transferred back. Many masters have come here, and many have gone back.'
en_old: Instead of praising me, he threatened me: "You'll be transferred back. So many masters have come here, and I sent every one of them back."

brh: خیران اٹ، بخران اٹ، انتئے دن مریک دا جگہ نا چناتے تن، اوفتے جند نا اولاد آن تو پیش خوانیرہ، ولے دا جگہ نا چناتے او خوار و بس ہمیش۔۔۔
en: I'm astonished, I'm bewildered. Why does it go like this for the children of this place? Their own children get ahead in their studies, but the children of this place they keep miserable, and just always...
en_old: With goodness, with pride... why does it happen like this to the children of this place? They push their own children ahead in education, but the children of this place are always left miserable...

brh: ہمیشہ کن ڈاکٹر غلام جان مرے گڑا گڑا انت کنے صفا صفا پارے کہ نی اسکول نا نا بلکہ کنا ارا نا ماشٹر
en: ...[so that they remain] slaves forever. Then, then what? He told me quite plainly that you are not the school's master, but the master of my household.
en_old: May Dr. Ghulam Jan be... forever. Then what? He told me plainly that I am not the school's master, but the master of his household.

brh: ٹر جوڑ مٹ۔ انداڑ کنا وراٹ ئے بر، کنا چناتے خوانف۔ ئے بارٹ۔ صفا انکار کریٹ تا۔ ئے اسکول نا ماسٹر اٹ۔ نا ورا نا ماسٹر افٹ۔ وڑا غصہ
en: ...[you have been] made master. 'Come here to my house and teach my children.' I said... I refused him flatly: 'I am the school's master. I am not your household's master.' He got so angry...
en_old: ...so it can be made. "Come to my house and teach my children," he said. I refused flatly. I am the school's master, not the master of your house. He got very angry.

brh: غصہ کرے انت؟ غصہ کروئی تو انت کروئی داڑان مست ہم چندی وار کنے تون ہندن مسنے۔ خیر نیلے دا ہیتاتے، نی تینا بندغ پین امر ہروئی خیر
en: He got angry, did he? Of course he'd get angry; what else would he do? Even before this, it has happened to me like this several times. Anyway, leave these matters. How are your own people and the others? All well?
en_old: He got angry? Of course he would get angry. Even before this, the same thing has happened to me several times. Anyway, leave these matters. How will you go on from here? Anyway...

brh: ماسٹر صیب دا سے نما کلاس ئے ولے فارغ مسس کنے آ تھانہ غا ضرور بریس۔ تھانہ غا؟ ہرا سے جرم نا سزا ٹی؟ ٹرانسفر مننگ نا جرم نا سزا ٹی تاکہ نا کریکٹر سرٹیفکیٹ جوڑ مرے۔
en: Master sahib, it's your class now, but when you are free, be sure to come to me at the police station. To the police station? As punishment for what crime? As punishment for the crime of getting transferred, so that your character certificate can be made.
en_old: Master sahib, this is your class, but when you're free, be sure to come to the police station. The police station? As punishment for what crime? As punishment for the crime of not getting transferred, so your character certificate can be made.

brh: اسلام علیکم انسپکٹر صاحب۔ وعلیکم السلام خیر ء نوم داڑے؟ ننا ہمیش انسپکٹر صاحب ایننگ بننگ ارے اسکول اٹی۔ ولے داسہ کنے نما بننگ بند مسونے۔
en: Assalamu alaikum, Inspector sahib. Wa alaikum assalam. All well? You here? Inspector sahib, we have always been coming and going at the school. But now you have stopped coming to me.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum, Inspector sahib. Wa alaikum assalam, is everything well? What brings you here? Our inspector sahib always used to come and go at the school. But now you've stopped coming to us.

brh: انتے کہ ماسٹر صاحب بسنے اسکول ملنگانے ہنو تینا میر ئے پاو بیٹھک بند مسنے تینا مہمان تے ہموڑے جاؤ جاگہ ایتے، ولے میر صاحب ئے میر صاحب ئے پاو انسپکٹر نواز ننا اسکولاں
en: Because the master sahib has come and opened the school, go tell your Mir that his guest house has been shut, [where] he would put up his guests. But Mir sahib, tell Mir sahib, Inspector Nawaz, our school...
en_old: Because the master sahib has come to open the school, he went to tell his Mir that the guest room was closed and to give his guests a place there. But Mir sahib said that Inspector Nawaz from our school...

brh: عرض کرینے۔ بھلے انسپکٹر صاحب، نوم تو میرنا غصہ ئے جوان چھارے۔ کنا خیال ئے نوم انسپکٹر نواز ئے تپیرے۔ ہر بتنا گمو بو۔ کار۔
en: He has submitted [a request]. Well, Inspector sahib, you know Mir's anger well. I think you don't know Inspector Nawaz. Everyone... get lost [unclear]. Car.
en_old: I have made my request. Well, Inspector sahib, you know Mir's anger well. I think your name is Inspector Nawaz, isn't it? Whoever came got lost. Car.

brh: بسوس خیرٹ؟ جی او بسوٹ۔ خیرے؟ الینو باز مونجا مونجا خننگنگٹیوس۔ ہاں؟ نہ دنو تو ایچوئی تسفک۔ ئے تس تو ضرور ارے
en: You've come back, all well? Yes, I've come. Is everything all right? Today you look very sad. Huh? No, it's nothing like that. There is surely something.
en_old: You've come, is everything well? Yes, I've come. Is everything well? You look very sad. Huh? No, it's nothing like that. If you say so, then there must be something.

brh: انتئے کہ دا کانی مالو اینو دن مونجہ خنتنوٹ۔ بس زراس دا میر جلال خان نا بارٹ سوچاٹے۔ داودے رسے۔ دا علاقہ نی میر ئے بختہ کنا۔ وانت مستی او دے ہچ متنے ولے اونا دعا آن دا پورا علاقہ
en: Because I have never seen you as sad as today before. I was just thinking a little about this Mir Jalal Khan. Who is he? He's the Mir of this area [unclear]. And so what? Nothing has happened to him so far, but because of him this whole area...
en_old: Because I have never seen you this sad before. I'm just thinking a little about Mir Jalal Khan. Who is he? He's the Mir of this area, my fate... What did he become? He has nothing, but by his prayers this whole area...

brh: دا علاقہ تہار مٹی ئے انت مطلب؟ ئے پومہ تٹ، کنا مطلب دادے کہ جندے روشنائی ٹی رنگک، ولے دا پورا علاقہ تہار منا گواچی کرینے، دا ماسٹر بس اسکولے ملا ولے میر جلال خان نا بندغاک
en: ...this area is in darkness. What do you mean? I didn't understand. What I mean is that he himself lives in the light, but he has made this whole area a victim of darkness. This master came and opened the school, but Mir Jalal Khan's men...
en_old: This area is dark? What do you mean? I'll tell you. What I mean is that he lives in the light himself, but he wants this whole area to stay dark. This master came and opened the school, but Mir Jalal Khan's men...

brh: بس او کنے اسکولے بند کنے۔ انتئے؟ مگر دا اسکول نا خواجہ او دے۔ اسکول اسے سرکاری اسکول اسے اور کل خرچ تے سرکار برداشت کننگ اٹی۔ تو او دے انت تکلیف؟ تکلیف تو ارے تے۔ بس او دا خواہی کہ اوفتا علاوہ
en: They just shut the school on me. Why? But is he the owner of this school? The school is a government school, and the government is bearing all the expenses. So what is his problem? He does have a problem. He just wants that apart from them...
en_old: So he shut the school down on me. Why? Is he the owner of this school? The school is a government school, and the government is paying all the expenses. So what is his problem? There is a problem. He wants that apart from them...

brh: کسس خوانندہ مف او دا خوائے کہ انت آسراتی ئس مرے مچا نن کے مرے ایلو کل بیرے محتاج سلیر باز افسوز نا ہیت اسے تینٹ تو ہچ کننگ کپسا کم از کم ایلو کے اگر گڑاس کننگ خوارہ اوف تے تو الر دن مسکہ گڑا دا علاقہ نا
en: ...nobody should be educated. He wants whatever comfort there is to be all for them, and all the others to remain dependent. It's a very sad thing: they themselves can't do anything, so at least if others want to do something, they should let them. If it goes on like this, then this area's...
en_old: ...nobody should be educated. He wants only them to have comfort, and everyone else to stay dependent. It's a great pity: they can't do anything themselves, and at least if others want to do something... If it goes on like this, then this area's...

brh: دا علم ئس کے باز مشکل اٹ اسے ماسٹر ئس بس کہ دا اسکول اٹ ئے چناتے پنی فکری ولے او ہمودم نرفنگ خواری بس اللہ ہدایت کیتے تانکہ داڑے کوٹ کسے سے جرات مفرو کہ او ماسٹر ء نرفے نی لے
en: ...for knowledge it is very hard. A master came so that he would [educate] the children in this school, but they wanted to drive him away at once. May God just guide them, so that nobody here will dare to drive the master away. You leave...
en_old: This knowledge is very hard to come by. A master came to teach the children in this school, but they wanted to drive him away at once. May Allah guide them, so that no one here dares to drive the master away. You...

brh: دا ایتا تے اینو کین چا جوڑ کریتوٹ
en: ...these matters. Today I've made tea for [you].
en_old: I made tea for you today with these.

brh: جوان ہندن ہندن دا نک و دوک تفوک مرے ہندن تموک مرے تاکہ
en: Good, like that, like that. Let his feet and hands be tied, let him lie fallen like that, so that...
en_old: Good, like that, so that the nose and lips are tucked in like this, so that it stays like that.

brh: تانکہ دا ہنکہ تنے دا ہندن تفوک سلوک ذلیل چیف صاحب بس ڈیٹھو بندغ اسے بائے تینا نی پاش الیخا کرے اسل بائے تینا ملپک
en: ...so that this one stays tied up like this for now, the wretch. Chief sahib, he's just a stubborn man; he hasn't let anything out of his mouth, he won't open his mouth at all.
en_old: So that until now you have been treated this way, humiliated. The chief sahib is just a shameless person. Brother, you did it openly... in truth, brother isn't his own...

brh: ہلو، الے تاکہ بائے تینا ملپ، آخر بائے تینا ملک تا، ہنداڑے تپوک مرے تموک مرے
en: Alright, leave him until he opens his mouth; in the end he will open his mouth. Let him stay here, tied up and lying fallen.
en_old: Hello, let it go, so that brother doesn't... after all, it's brother's own land. Let him lie fallen here.

brh: اوہاں اینو پد تانا دیر ہم بندے خوراک ہم بندے سمجھا رے؟ میر صاحب ئے تپ او دادے گولی ئس نا گواہ ئے
en: Oho, from today on his water is stopped too and his food is stopped too, understood? Mir sahib, [you know], this one is a witness to a shooting.
en_old: Oh, so from today the lake is closed and the food is closed too, understood? Mir Sahib, you know, this is the witness of a bullet.

brh: ناخرونا دادے دھنزو کسوئی افک دادے استے استے خوراک ہمبک کمزور کروئی ہندن دادے کمزور کروئی
en: No, he must not be killed [outright]. He must be weakened slowly, slowly, through food; that's how he must be weakened.
en_old: Our sick one must not be ..., it must not be weakened slowly with food, it must not be weakened like that.

brh: او کہ بلا درخت دھکا کے پنی
en: And that big tree... push [it]... [unclear]
en_old: And he who did not push the big tree.

brh: بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم، بنا اللہ پاک نا انے نا کچینا بابرکت آ پینان، ارا کہ کلے جہان تا ودیکروکے ساتوکے۔
en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. I begin with the most excellent, blessed name of Allah Almighty, who is the creator and the keeper of all the worlds.
en_old: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. I begin with the blessed name of Allah Almighty, the most exalted, who is the creator and protector of all the worlds.

brh: رکو کہ درود پاکنگا پیغمبر حضرت محمد مصطفی صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ وسلم نا بجا ہرا کہ صادق و امین ئس او مخلوق نا حق آتا چاہنداری او حق آتے تننگ نا پاسدار ئس چلتن ایف ایم
en: [Countless] blessed salutations upon the Prophet Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family), who was truthful and trustworthy, and who knew the rights of the people and guarded the giving of their rights. Chiltan FM.
en_old: Countless blessings upon the Prophet Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family), who was truthful and trustworthy, who knew people's rights and upheld the giving of those rights. Chiltan FM.

brh: ایف ایم ہشتاد و ہشت نا براہوئی مجلس تون ساڑی ئے نما آر جی منظور کیازئی۔ کنا مہرانہ سلام آک ہمو کل مہروان آت اسکان سرمریر ہرا کہ بننگ اٹی او چلتن ایف ایم ہشتاد و ہشت ٹی۔ السلام علیکم۔
en: Here with FM 88's Brahui program is your RJ Manzoor Kiyazai. My loving greetings go out to all the dear ones who are listening to Chiltan FM 88. Assalamu alaikum.
en_old: With FM 88's Brahui program, your RJ Manzoor Kiyazai is with you. My loving greetings go out to all the dear ones who are listening to Chiltan FM 88. Assalamu alaikum.

brh: السلام علیکم، ہنے نا مہروان آک، ارجمند قیاسی نوما خدمت اٹ ساڑی ئے چلتن ایف ایم ہشتاد و ہشت آن بالکل لائیو، او دا مجلس دا وخت آن ہلیس تن شش بجے اسکان نوما خدمت اٹ پیش مریک او پیشداری ئے دا مجلس نا۔
en: Assalamu alaikum, my dear ones. RJ Manzoor Kiyazai is here at your service, completely live from Chiltan FM 88, and from this time until six o'clock this program will be presented at your service, and the presentation of this program
en_old: Assalamu alaikum, my dear ones, Arjmand Qiyasi is at your service on Chiltan FM 88, completely live, and this program will be presented to you from now until six o'clock, and the presentation of this program...

brh: خواجہ آر جی خالد بلوچ صاحب نا او ننتون کمک کار ننا انجینئر ئے خواجہ عمران درانی منت وار داڑتوما خواجہ غاتا کہ دا مجلس نومیس کان سر کننگٹی او اور دا مجلس نومیس کا سر مننگٹی ئے
en: is by Mr. RJ Khalid Baloch Sahib, and with us is our assistant, our engineer Mr. Imran Durrani. I am grateful to these gentlemen, who are delivering this program to you, and through whom this program is reaching you.
en_old: Khwaja RJ Khalid Baloch sahib, and with us our assistant engineer Khwaja Imran Durrani; thanks to these gentlemen for bringing this program to you, and this program is reaching you.

brh: مہربان دوست آک امید اندا کیوہ کہ خیر اٹ کے مرو رے انشاءاللہ خوش و خوشحال آباد آسودہ و آسرات و رب پاک آن دعا کیوہ کہ اللہ پاک کنا بنوکاتے خیر اٹ کے مرو رے اوفتے خوش و خوشحال آباد آسودہ و آسرات تخے و مدام خوشی تا
en: Dear friends, I hope that you are well, God willing, happy and prosperous, flourishing, well-off and comfortable, and I pray to the Lord Almighty that Allah Almighty keeps my listeners well, keeps them happy and prosperous, flourishing, well-off and comfortable, and that the [clouds] of happiness always
en_old: Dear friends, I hope you are well, God willing, happy, prosperous, content and at peace, and I pray to Almighty God that Allah keeps my listeners well, keeps them happy, prosperous, content and at peace, and always in happiness.

brh: جمبر آک نمان ئنا کلنا زیا تالان مریر، ہنے نا شرف منداک دعا ہمیش مرے کاک او دعا کینہ ہمو کلے مہروان تے کے ارا کے دا وخت آ سفر اسیا پیش تمانو اللہ پاک اوفتے خیر
en: clouds be spread over all of you. My honoured ones, may [this] prayer always be [with you]. And we pray for all those dear ones who have set out on a journey at this time: may Allah Almighty [keep] them well
en_old: May the clouds spread over all of you. My honorable ones, may prayers always be with you, and we pray for all the dear ones who are traveling at this time; may Allah Almighty keep them safe.

brh: خوشیت اوفتا مزل اسر کے او دعا کینا ہمو ناجوڑ نا دوراخ خاتے کینا را کہ ہسپتال آٹی دے دا وخت آ تموکو یا پین وراٹ تموکو ناجوڑی اسے ریتا تو اللہ پاک اوفتے جک کے جوڑ کے دوراخ جوڑ کے او ہم گلوبال مرے
en: and bring them happily to their destination. And we pray for the health of those sick people who are lying in hospital at this time, or who are lying ill in some other way with some illness: may Allah Almighty heal them, make them well and healthy, and may they also blossom
en_old: May their happiness reach its destination, and we pray for those sick people who are lying in hospital at this time, or lying elsewhere with some illness; may Allah Almighty heal them and restore their health, and also...

brh: خوش مریر او گل گلیر مخر ننے امبار مجلس و تران کیر اللہ پاک اوفتے جان جوڑی ایتئے ہندا دعا تون آمین پاو او داڑمبے دے مہروان آ کراک امتحان اٹ سرسوب مسنو یا پین زند اٹ
en: may they be happy, blossom and laugh, and keep holding gatherings and conversations with us like this; may Allah Almighty grant them good health. With this very prayer I say amen. And besides this, the dear ones who have succeeded in exams or elsewhere in life
en_old: May they be happy and blossom, and keep having programs and conversations with us like this; may Allah Almighty grant them good health. Say amen to this prayer. And those dear ones who have passed their exams, or in other areas of life

brh: سر سوبیس خنانو اوفتے باز باز مبارک او ارافت کہ اینو نا دے خاص کر اتوار نا دے ننا راج ٹی ننا ڈیہہ ٹی او ننا ادو ایلو ٹی مخلوق زیادہ برام او سانگہ کا مریرے ہمو کل مریرے واری
en: and have seen success, many many congratulations to them. And as today, and especially on Sunday, in our nation, in our land and all around us, people have weddings and engagements more than usual, to all of those that are taking place
en_old: have achieved success, many many congratulations to them. And since today, especially on Sunday, in our nation, in our land and in our surroundings, people have more weddings and engagements, congratulations to all of them.

brh: بان کینون ادے بادشاہ و براہمی کو کنڈی تیان سنجو تولو کو شیر و باگولہ او لیلڑی تا نامٹ تولو کو ہمو کلے باز باز مبارک مرے اوفتہ خوشیک اوفتہ دوستاتا خوشیک او
en: we offer [congratulations]. Those who today are grooms and brides, who are sitting adorned with garlands, who are seated amid poetry, songs and wedding chants: many many congratulations to all of them, to their happiness, to their friends' happiness, and
en_old: Those who are getting married today, the grooms and those sitting adorned... sitting in the name of lions and... and brides, many many congratulations to all of them, their happiness, their friends' happiness, and

brh: او ہندون اوفتہ خوشی ٹی نن ہم اوار اونک تو ہمو کلے بادشاہ تے باز باز مبارک مرے اللہ کے نما بروکا زند اٹ کہ نما گام تھنگا ٹی ارے اسہ باز زیبدار و خوشحال و انینو گچین و زندس مرے او دا زند کرے ہمو کلے مراد آتہ
en: and in this way we too join in their happiness. So many many congratulations to all the grooms. May Allah make your coming life, into which you are stepping, a very beautiful, prosperous, sweet and excellent life, and may this life [fulfil] all the wishes
en_old: and so we too join in their happiness. Many many congratulations to all the grooms. May Allah make your coming life, into which you have stepped, a very beautiful, prosperous and wonderful life, and may this life fulfill all your wishes.

brh: ننے ہم دا کوشش تے کروئی ئے کہ دا سدک ننا او ننا چائنداری او ننا علاقہ نا دا تتا واران کرے ننے سیبو ئس رسینگے کہ ننا او است کرے مچٹ ئس بلو مرے کہ ننا زند زیب دار مرے کک دا گڑا تے ننے سوچنگک۔ مہربان دوستاک برے ننا گڑا ئس کو
en: We too have to make these efforts, (recognizing) that these animals are ours, they are our identity and [...] of our region, so that, well, some benefit comes to us, that our heart, well, grows a little bigger, that our life becomes beautiful. We have to think about these things. Kind friends, come, something of ours...
en_old: We too must make efforts so that this fact — our identity and our region — ... we should get a lesson, so that our heart grows from small to big, so that our life becomes beautiful. We have to think about these things. Dear friends, come, something of ours...

brh: کلوہ تنے مغا را کہ بسنو سے این ایٹ ایٹ رے کرینو تا سے این ایٹ ایٹ لکھو کلوہ نا موبائل نا تنہ کلوہ لکھو کجاہ لکھانو او چار چار ہفتہ سے ٹرا کلوہ بسنو ہفتے رینے رم جھم اسمارٹ
en: Messages... those that have come; send them... SMS 'S N 88', write 'S N 88', write your message on your mobile... where they have written from, and messages have been coming for four weeks... the weekly Rimjhim Smart...
en_old: My song... come... for those who sent SMS... wrote SMS... my song from mobile... where did I write my song... for four weeks... my song came... weekly Rimjhim Smart.

brh: دا فرینڈز اینکر ہی ثناء گفتار اسور ولدا نا پئی کہ بابر سلیم نا شعر ئس عادل بھائی کین میر سمیر کین او کلے رمجھم اسمارٹ فرینڈز والا کتے کین تو عادل دا کلے کن کرے نن ئس شعر
en: These friends: anchor Sana Guftar then says that a song by Babar Saleem is for Adil Bhai, for Mir Sameer and for all the Rimjhim Smart Friends folks. So, Adil, for all of these, (play) us a song.
en_old: These friends, the anchor Sana Guftar, then said that a poem by Babar Saleem is for Adil Bhai, for Mir Sameer, and for all of the Rimjhim Smart Friends group. So Adil, for all of these, play us a poem.

en: Well, the artistry of [unclear] and with Babar Saleem's voice, surely the listeners will be pleased. Yes, S.H. Tareen said: 'How are you?' Peace be upon you. And upon you peace. Yes, S.H. Tareen, yes, yes.

en: How are you? It's superstar Jani Noorzai again, from Moonstar Friends. You have sent greetings to Nargis, Najma Noorzai, Rahim Noorzai, Shaista Tareen, and also to Shahzadi and Noreen,
en_old: How are you? It's again superstar Jani Noorzai from Moon Star Friends, sending greetings to Nargis, Najma Noorzai, Rahim Noorzai, Shaista Tareen, also Shahzadi and Noreen.

en: and to Noorani, S.H. Tareen and all the Moonstar folks. So thank you, thank you, Jani Noorzai, a lakh thanks, a lakh prayers; the loving greetings you especially sent to all your loved ones have reached them, just like that.
en_old: Yes, Noorani, S.H. Tareen, and all the minister folks, thank you, thank you, Jani Noorzai, a lakh thanks, a lakh prayers, and greetings of love, especially... you did... all the loved ones... reached... like that.

en: Mir Taqi Mir of Galaxy of Smart Friends, Pak(?), many, many thanks for the song. Welcome Safia Naz, Sana Guftar, Zahid Jan Parkani. Thank you, sir, for sending a message and making the gathering beautiful. A lakh thanks, lakhs and lakhs of thanks.
en_old: The galaxy of Smart Friends' Mir Taqi Mir, the pure one, many many thanks for the song. Welcome Safia Naz, Sana Guftar, Zahid Jan Parkani, thank you, sister, for requesting a song and making the gathering beautiful, a lakh thanks, lakhs and lakhs.

brh: ہیلو، السلام علیکم، السلام علیکم، جی ٹیلیفون نا لگانے دیر ننتون اواری، السلام علیکم لالا کیا حال ئے جی دیرس؟ کیا حال ئے ٹھیک ٹھاک؟
en: Hello, peace be upon you, peace be upon you. Yes, who is with us on the telephone line? Peace be upon you, brother, how are you? Yes, who is it? How are you, all well?
en_old: Hello, Assalam-o-Alaikum, Assalam-o-Alaikum, yes, who is with us on the telephone line? Assalam-o-Alaikum, brother, how are you, yes, who is it? How are you, all fine?

brh: شکر اللہ پاک کا، کون ہی ہمارے ساتھ؟ مین اسپیل ترین کوئٹہ سے بول رہا ہوں، یس یس ترین، جی کیا کہنا چاہو گی؟ جی بس مین سلام کہنا چاہتی ہوں، جی جی بتا دین اپنا سلام جن کے نام ہی مین سلام جلیل نورزئی اور حکمت نورزئی
en: Thanks be to Almighty God. Who is with us? I'm [S.H.] Tareen, speaking from Quetta. Yes, yes, Tareen, what would you like to say? Yes, I just want to send greetings. Yes, yes, tell us your greetings, to whose names? My greetings to Jalil Noorzai and Hikmat Noorzai.
en_old: Thanks to Allah. Who is with us? I'm Spell Tareen speaking from Quetta. Yes, yes, Tareen, what would you like to say? Yes, I just want to send greetings. Yes, yes, tell us your greetings, whose names? I send greetings to Jalil Noorzai and Hikmat Noorzai.

brh: ئے مچس گھڑیٹ سب مونسٹارٹ کرتٹ نا بالکل آپ کا سلام پہنچ گیا میرے لیے ایک سونگ میرے لیے ایک سونگ جی جی اردو سونگ ہاں کوشش کرین گے کہ ابھی اردو سونگ آپ کے لیے پلی کر دین صرف دس منٹ کے بات پندرہ منٹ کے بات کیونکہ پروگرام ختم
en: ...and to all [...] all of Moonstar [...]. Absolutely, your greetings have reached. A song for me, a song for me. Yes, yes, an Urdu song. Yes, we'll try to play an Urdu song for you shortly, just after ten minutes, fifteen minutes, because the program is ending.
en_old: ...everyone... started... absolutely, your greetings have reached. A song for me, a song for me. Yes, yes, an Urdu song. Yes, we'll try to play an Urdu song for you right now, just after ten minutes, fifteen minutes, because the program is ending.

brh: مگہ پھر اردو سونگز ئے چلائیں عاطف اسلم کے آواز مین ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی تھینکس۔ ٹھیک ہی اللہ اللہ حافظ۔ اللہ حافظ۔ آہ یس یچ ترین یس یچ ترین اسہ کنا تونا منت وار گودی نا کہ کلم ہم
en: But then play Urdu songs, in Atif Aslam's voice. Okay, okay, okay, thanks. Okay, Allah... goodbye (Allah Hafiz). Goodbye. Ah, yes, S.H. Tareen, yes, S.H. Tareen, thanks from me as well, sister, that ... too...
en_old: But then play Urdu songs in Atif Aslam's voice. Okay, okay, okay, thanks. Okay, Allah Hafiz. Allah Hafiz. Ah, yes, Yasich Tareen, yes, Yasich Tareen, thank you from me too, sister, for the song as well.

brh: مجلس ٹی بشخ الکاکو لک منتوار لک لک تورو آک مجلس ء زیبدار کریک۔ اونن دا دیر ننتو ٹیلیفون کال السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ جی دیر ننتو نا واری۔ ڈاکٹر صاحب۔ توار نی بیر متف۔
en: To those who took part in the gathering, a lakh thanks, lakhs and lakhs of thanks; they make the gathering beautiful. Now, who is this with us on a telephone call? Peace be upon you. And upon you peace. Yes, who is with us? Doctor sahib. Your voice isn't coming through.
en_old: Those who took part in the gathering, a lakh thanks, lakhs and lakhs, made the gathering beautiful. Now who is with us on the telephone call? Assalam-o-Alaikum. Wa Alaikum Assalam. Yes, who is with us? Doctor sahib. Your voice is not coming through.

brh: خبر پنت وجے کے توار باز کم بسکہ او ولدا نی لائن ڈراپ مس۔ اسلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ جی دیر نا توار ئے
en: Who knows for what reason, the voice was coming through very faintly, and then your line dropped. Peace be upon you. And upon you peace. Yes, whose voice is this?
en_old: ...the voice was coming very faintly and then your line dropped. Assalam-o-Alaikum. Wa Alaikum Assalam. Yes, whose voice is this?

brh: دیر بنگل زئی؟ صفیہ ناز بنگل زئی صفیہ ناز جی صفیہ گودی بخیر اٹ پانے۔ الحمدللہ جوان ئے شکر ئے اللہ پاک نا نی بنے جوان ئس دراخ جوڑ ئس الحمدللہ جوان ماشاءاللہ نمے پروگرام ٹی
en: Who, Bangulzai? Safia Naz Bangulzai. Safia Naz, yes, Sister Safia, welcome. Praise be to God, I'm well, thanks be to Almighty God. Are you well yourself, are you healthy? Praise be to God, well. Mashallah, you in the program...
en_old: Who, Bangulzai? Safia Naz Bangulzai, Safia Naz. Yes, Safia sister, are you well? Thanks be to Allah, it's good, thanks to Allah. How are you, is your health good? Thanks be to Allah, good, mashallah, you in the program...

brh: باز چانے واقعی نن ننا پروگرام نا انتظار ٹی مریٹ لیکن نن دا پاننگ کپنہ نی کہ ئے دوبارہ نی ہتوٹ نن اسہ فیملی اٹ کرین نن اسہ پروگرام اٹ تمبو تبار۔ ہاں بالکل انت پاننگ خواسہ اینو ننا دا مجلس اٹی۔ ایلم ایلو میسوات نا بارہ ٹی ہیت کننگ اٹی ئس تو۔
en: Very much indeed; really, we are always waiting for our program, but we can't say that you [...] again; we are like one family, in one program we are one household. Yes, absolutely, what would you like to say today in this gathering of ours? Brother, you were talking about the other [unclear: 'mesuwat', prob. creatures], weren't you?
en_old: You know a lot, really; we are always waiting for our program, but we can't say that you came again; we are like one family, we are one program, one family. Yes, absolutely, what would you like to say today in our gathering? The other ones were talking about...

brh: اگر نن انسان تینا احساس نی دا ہلو حفاظت کے کنے تو او کے ملانو سستو سرو تمنو نی حفاظت کے کنے سا بالکل او مرے دا کپ کنے سستو جانور سینا چائے پٹو گلاس مرے
en: If we humans, out of our own feelings, would take up the protection of this [...], protect it [...]; absolutely, it would be [...] this cup [...] animals [...] tea [...] a glass...
en_old: If we humans, with our own feelings, protect this... protect it... absolutely, it may be... animals... a cup of tea or a glass...

brh: او نا صاحب یعنی اتیکی او نا صاحب برے کنے نا سامنی دوستی او کہ نما سامنی دوستی حقیقت او ہمندا وڑ زند تا دے پھرے او تم زند سرے او زند نا انت پولن باز جوان جی او ایلوم اور ماشاءاللہ نمے نمنا پروگرام کے
en: His master, I mean, [...] his master; come, the friendship in front of me, and the friendship in front of you, is real, and in this same way the days of life pass, and the whole of life goes by; what is there to seek in life? Very good, yes. And brother, and mashallah, to you and your program...
en_old: Sir, I mean, sir, come in front of me — friendship in front of you is real, and that's how life's days pass, and it's the end of life; what is there to search for in life? Very good, yes. And mashallah, to you and your program.

brh: باز منتوار نما پروگرام نا دا جہان ہمو ٹاپکس تے چائری تو ننے باز جانکاری ملیک اور ہمو ننے لیسن مریک باریٹ کیرو تو ایتا تے ننے باز معلومات مریک باز منتوار نمام بشخالیرے او تینا جواننگا ایتا تالان کیرے تو داڑان کلے بنوکات فائدہ مریک
en: Many thanks. In your program, the topics you take up give us a lot of knowledge, and they become lessons for us; when they are talked about, we get a lot of information from the words. Many thanks; you all take part and share your good words, and so all the listeners benefit from this.
en_old: Many thanks for your program; when we watch these topics we get a lot of knowledge and they become lessons for us; when you talk about them, we get a lot of information. Many thanks to all of you who take part and share your good things, so everyone who listens benefits from this.

brh: جی او ایلم اور ایلم ننا مہر ایلو ممبر میرا بندغ نا طبیعت خراب اسے ازمان خان زیادی اسے میر تکلیف کے اوڑتو توار پینا خط لمنا غریب مہر اوت کے باز دعا گو آن کلو او کسے یت پئی بند کیتا عرض جان جوڑی کیتا اللہ جان جوڑی یتے تا باز منت وار
en: Yes, and brother, and brother, one of our dear ones, another member, a person dear to me(?), was unwell: Azman Khan Ziadi; Mir(?) is in distress [...]; I pray a great deal for that poor dear one; I request everyone to pray for his health; may Allah give him health. Many thanks.
en_old: Yes, and another of our dear members, Mir's person, is unwell, Azman Khan Ziadi; Mir is in pain; I send him a voice and letter; poor dear, I pray for him a lot; I request everyone to pray for his recovery; may Allah grant him health. Many thanks.

brh: باز باز مہربانی ئے او نیلم نا آخر آخری ڈیوٹی او دا نصیر نا باز جوانو شعر ئس پلی کریس تے باز باز مہربانی۔ انشاءاللہ کوشش کینہ کہ دا شعر او باگول ئس بنفین نصیر نا باز جوانو گونڈو کلوک ئس تے باز باز سلام میر ٹوٹل میر تبریز او تینا خط نا بندغ آتے۔
en: Many, many thanks. And Neelam's last, very last duty(?), and you played a very good song by Naseer; many, many thanks for that. God willing, we will try to play this song and another song for you, a very nice short piece by Naseer. Many, many greetings to Mir Total(?), Mir Tabrez and the people in his letter.
en_old: Many many thanks, and Neelam's last duty, and you played this very beautiful poem by Naseer; many many thanks. God willing, we'll try to let you hear this poem and a song, a very lovely short song by Naseer. Many many greetings to Mir Total, Mir Tabrez, and the people of his letter.

brh: اللہ حافظ۔ صفیہ ناز بنگلزئی نا توار اسس کہ یقینا تینا جوانی ٹی ہندا وڑ کہ اللہ پاک قوت دے ہمو دنو احساس تے سنی رسادا
en: Goodbye. That was the voice of Safia Naz Bangulzai, who surely, in her goodness and in this way — may Almighty God give her strength — conveyed such feelings to us.
en_old: Goodbye. That was the voice of Safia Naz Bangulzai, who surely, in her fine manner, as God Almighty gives her strength, conveyed those feelings to us.

brh: دا کرے را کہ اوفت آ خلنگان، ہا کرے ہندن سوچین کہ اندنو ننا سائی اندنو اوفتے، تو او سلام ری کرے تینا مہرواناتیکن، اونا سلام آکو مہروانہ سر مسوس، اسہ شعر باگلس بنینے دا وختا او حسین نصیر نا او کان گڈ ولدا او مچو
en: This, well, [...] from hitting them; yes, well, let us think like this: just as we have life, so do they. So she sent greetings to her loved ones, and her greetings have reached the loved ones. Let's listen to a song now, by Hussain Naseer, and after that, again, all...
en_old: He did this so as not to hit them; yes, he thought that this is how our ... is, and theirs too; so he sent greetings to his loved ones, his greetings reached the loved ones. Let's listen to a poem/song now by Hussain Naseer, and after that, again, all...

brh: دے سمو مست دیدین، باوہ کے بینوسے نصیر
en: [Fragment, possibly song lyrics:] The day... intoxicated eyes... father... have you heard... Naseer.
en_old: Let's see first today – Naseer, have you heard what father said?

brh: نصیر نا کچینی آ ننے غا توار بننگو نی ہا یقینا مہروان آ کہ برینے گڑاس ورنا کہ کلو بس کس نی بسونے تو دیوار کینے او دا وخت آ کہ کلو بسونے السلام علیکم ادا کیسی ہو آپ مین
en: We got to hear Naseer's fine voice; yes, surely, dear ones, let's come to something: the messages that have come, whoever you are who have sent one, then we [...], and at this time, from the messages that have come: 'Peace be upon you, brother, how are you? I...'
en_old: In Naseer's kitchen we hear your voice; you are surely kind. Some young man has come, everyone has come – whoever you are, you have come, the wall... at this time that everyone has come: Assalamu Alaikum, brother, how are you?

brh: آل مونسٹار سے عاشق علی چھانڈیو، عاشق علی انت حال احوال ایلوم تکڑا اوس دراخ جوڑ اوس فٹ فاٹ سلام ٹو نرگس بڑوچ، حکمت جانی نورزئی، علیم کشمیری، روزی محمد، خوشحال، عزت خان، آل مونسٹار کلے سلام پارینوس تو نا مہر نا سلام آک سر مسرک منت وار پین کلو وری کبو فی الحال
en: From All Moonstar, Ashiq Ali Chandio. Ashiq Ali, how are you, brother? Are you strong, are you healthy, fit and fine? Greetings to Nargis Baloch, Hikmat Jani Noorzai, Aleem Kashmiri, Rozi Muhammad, Khushhal, Izzat Khan; you have sent greetings to everyone in All Moonstar, and your loving greetings have reached them. Thank you. For now, other messages...
en_old: All Monsters: Ashiq Ali Chandio. Ashiq Ali, how are you? I'm fine, strong, well, fit and fine. Greetings to Nargis Baloch, Hikmat Jani Noorzai, Aleem Kashmiri, Rozi Muhammad, Khushal, Izzat Khan – greetings to all the All Monsters. Your loving greetings have been received, thank you; for now, let everyone else speak.

brh: ننت ئے کہ وختو پاس ننتو کم مے او برین ٹیلیفون کال ئس ارے نی السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام منظور جان جوڑ ئس ہنتا حال احوال ئے خواجہ بڑ ئس تکڑا ئس جوڑ بڑ تکڑا ٹھیک ٹھاک خیر سے دراخ جوڑ ئس دیر ننتو نا واری ساجد جان بنگل زئی فروم
en: ...that the time is nearly up, we have little (time) left, and come on, there is a telephone call. You: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Manzoor Jan, are you well? What's the news? Khwaja, are you fine? Are you strong? Well and fine, strong, all right; by (God's) grace, healthy and well. Are you well? Who is with us? It's your turn. Sajid Jan Bangulzai from...
en_old: We say that the hour has passed, our time is short... Hey, there's a telephone call for you. Assalamu Alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam, Manzoor Jan, are you well? How are you? Khwaja, are you strong and fine? Fine, strong, fine and well, thank God, doing well. Come on, it's your turn: Sajid Jan Bangulzai from...

brh: فیضان، فیضان انت احوال ئے جوڑ ئس فیضان ئس شکر ئے اللہ پاک نا، نی ٹائٹ ئس خوش باش ئس اللہ نا احسان ئے نی امر ئس جوڑ ئس فیضان ئس کرم ئے رب پاک نا، انت پاش ئے اینو نا سرال نا بارہ وٹی، ئے ترے اف نیٹ او گڑاس۔
en: Faizan, Faizan, what's the news? Are you well, Faizan? Thanks be to holy God. Are you fit? Are you happy and well? It's God's favour. How are you, are you well, Faizan? It's the grace of the holy Lord. What do you have to say about today's topic? ...isn't there (a) net (connection) or something?
en_old: Faizan, Faizan, how are you? Are you well, Faizan? Thanks to God Almighty. Are you doing great, happy? By God's grace. Are you in good spirits, Faizan? By the grace of the Holy Lord. What do you say about today's topic? Isn't there any net or something?

brh: مطلب دا کہ دا چکاک دا ساداک دا تینن خلے نی شکار کینے دا تینن امر حفاظت تے کین اسے شے
en: The point is that these birds, these animals: we ourselves kill them, we hunt them; how should we ourselves protect them? That is the one thing.
en_old: This means: these birds, these animals – don't kill them yourselves, don't hunt them, protect them yourselves; that is the thing.

brh: خیر ئے سے نصیحت اٹے اگر دا تپہ خلپاس تو باز بہتر ئے تینا ملک ئے ضد اٹے تو خلپاس تو جوان ئے آخا بس خیر ئے کسے شوق ارے تو بس او خلپہ دا تینا نچخانی کپن نی بالکل دا باز گچین ہیت اسے پین ہن سلام دعا ہنرے تو تینا وختو پاس بالکل آخیر
en: Fine, it's (meant as) a piece of advice: if they don't shoot these, that's much better. It goes against one's own country, so if they don't kill (them), that's good. But well, fine, if someone has a passion (for it), then just... he shouldn't kill; let's not make this our own [unclear: pastime]. You're absolutely right, this is a very good point. Now go ahead, (send your) greetings and prayers, since your time is nearly up, right at the end.
en_old: It's good advice. If you hunt out of hunger, that's much better; if you hunt in your own area out of stubbornness, then fine... well, if someone has a hobby, he hunts – but don't make it your pastime. This is a very good point. Now go, greet the others, then come back for your own time. Absolutely, at the end.

brh: ہیلو ٹھیک کنا کنڈ آن کل سماٹ فرینڈز سلام بالکل نا سلام اکثر مسو باز منت وار فیضان بنگلزئی نن تون اسہ کسر او تینا مہر ئنا
en: Hello, okay. From my side, greetings to all the Smart Friends. Absolutely, your greetings have reached (us). Many thanks to Faizan Bangulzai, (who was) with us on one road, and his loving...
en_old: Hello, okay. From my side, greetings to all the Smart Friends. Absolutely, your greetings have mostly been received, many thanks. Faizan Bangulzai, with us for a while, his love...

brh: درشانی تے تینا جوانی اٹ کلہو اٹ کرے او یقینا دا کال الینے گڈی کو کال الینے کہ دیر ہن تو السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام جی دیر ہن تو نا واری
en: He presented his views well, with a (good) message, and surely we take this call. We take the next call: who is it? Go ahead. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Yes, who is it? Go ahead, it's your turn.
en_old: They did the presentation well, in a fine manner. Surely this call... alright, the call is connected – come on then. Assalamu Alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Yes, come on, it's your turn.

brh: جی پشتو کے خبر کو سوک دے؟ بریشنا کلا خبر کو سنگے شے؟ بریشنا سہ وائے بریشنا؟ اوہ وائے خپلہ یو پیغام ورکئے
en: (In Pashto:) Yes, go on, speak. Who is it? Breshna, speak; how are you? Breshna, what do you say, Breshna? Oh, say it, give a message of your own.
en_old: Yes, Pashto – do you know what's going on? Breshna, do you know what's happening? Breshna, what does Breshna say? Oh, she says she herself gave a message.

brh: ډیر ډیر سلامونہ واستوہ او واستوہ او بیا خپل سلامونہ زما لہ طرفہ ډیر ډیر سلامونہ واستوہ جی جی لالا کاکړ تہ ډیر ډیر سلامونہ واستوہ جی زما یو فرمایش دے جی جی
en: (In Pashto:) Send many, many greetings, send them, send, and then your own greetings; from my side send many, many greetings. Yes, yes, send many, many greetings to Lala Kakar. Yes, I have one request. Yes, yes.
en_old: [Pashto] Many, many greetings to you, and also my greetings, many, many greetings from me. Many, many greetings to Lala Kakar. I have a request.

brh: اووے، بس دا نیو تے، ہئو انشاء اللہ کوشش باکوم، ما گدرشنا ملہ واسم برونہ، ٹھیک دے ٹھیک دے، ڈیر ڈیر مننہ ڈیر ڈیر مننہ اللہ حافظ، او نا سکا ننتونہ
en: (In Pashto:) Ooh, just this... [unclear]. Yes, God willing, I will try. [unclear]... Okay, okay. Many, many thanks, many, many thanks. Goodbye. And... [unclear] with us.
en_old: Yes, just this is new; yes, God willing, I'll try, I'll go to... okay, okay. Many, many thanks, many, many thanks, goodbye. He too, from us...

brh: پشتو کوشش کینہ کہ ارا زوبان ئس مرے ارا بولی ئس مرے ننا کل جند نا داڑے بولیک ء داڑے ننا اسہ جاگہ رہینگنے او دا بولیک دا کل ننا چائنداری ء نن کرے دا بولی تو بس مہربانہ دوستاک گڈی کو تینا ایتا تک اونڈا برے
en: Pashto: we try because, whatever language it may be, whatever dialect it may be, all of them are our very own. The languages here (are ours); here we live together in one place, and these languages, all of them are our identity. We did (it in) this language too. So, dear friends, next... [unclear].
en_old: Pashto – we try that whatever language it may be, whatever tongue it may be, all these are our own; the languages here, where we live together in one place, these languages are all our own, and we do this with the language. Alright, dear friends, wait until your turn comes.

brh: کہ نی اخس کہ مہربانی کر میسج کریر کلوف کریر ٹیلیفون کال کریر کہ یا خاموشی اٹ بنگر کہ اوفتہ اول منت واری ادا کینہ کہ اوفتہ لک منت وار لک تھورا وقت کشار وقت سور او ننا مجلس آتے پسند کریر اور مجلس بنگر دا اوفتہ جوانی ئے
en: Those of you who kindly sent messages, sent greetings, made telephone calls, or listened in silence: first I express thanks to them, a hundred thousand thanks to them, who took out a little time, gave (their) time, liked our programmes and listened to the programme. This is their kindness.
en_old: That you... please send a message, make a call, make a telephone call, or listen in silence – first I express thanks to them, many thanks to them; those who spend a little time, a short time, and like our gatherings and listen to the gathering – this is their goodness.

brh: دا اوفتہ بلونی اوفتہ باجام مجلس زیبدار مسک انینے شرف منداک سادات آتے کرے باڑوٹ ہندا خسبیرہ پانے کہ رب پاک ہر ارا نعمت آتے ننے تسونے یقینا دا نعمت آتے کرے نناو او داتار رب
en: This is their magnanimity; thanks to them the programme became beautiful. [Unclear: ...honoured/noble... the animals...] In this regard I would say this much: the holy Lord has given us every kind of blessing; surely He made these blessings for us, the generous Lord.
en_old: These are their words; their gathering became beautiful; the honorable Sayeds did this... In this way I say that the Holy Lord has given us every kind of blessing; surely for these blessings we... the Lord.

brh: دفتر کو سنبھالنا ننا ذمہ واری جوڑ مریک۔ اینو اگر نن تینٹ دا دفتر کو سنبھالے کین تو بروکا نسل ننا ہم دا دفتر کو سنبھالے کیک اور نسل در نسل اسہ جوان و کلچر ئس کائیک۔ اگر اینو نن تینا چناتا دوٹی غلیل اتین یا تینٹ کرے اوفتے خلینے
en: Taking care of this nature becomes our responsibility. If today we ourselves take care of this nature, then our coming generation will also take care of it, and generation after generation a good culture will carry on. If today we put slingshots in our children's hands, or we ourselves kill them...
en_old: Taking care of the office becomes our responsibility. Today, if we ourselves take care of this office, then the coming generation will also take care of this office, and generation after generation a good culture will come. If today we put slingshots in our children's hands, or we ourselves kill them...

brh: بے دردی اٹ تو بروکا نسل ہم ہندا وڈ اٹ اوفتا خلیس آ کائیکک۔ بائد ہندا کہ وخت آک بدل مریسہ ہننگ ٹی او ہنو شہری زندگی ٹی انسان جوانی اٹ تپاتک سکھنگ ٹی ہراڑے کہ مشین تا توار کو موٹر تا کو جیٹ تا کو۔
en: ...cruelly, then the coming generation too will go on killing them in this same way. It should be that, as the times keep changing, and in this urban life, where people are learning to [unclear] well, where there are the noises of machines, of motors, of jets...
en_old: If it is done with cruelty, the coming generation too will grow up in fear in this way. It should be that, as times change, in this urban life a person should learn well to find (peace) where there are the sounds of machines, of motors, of jets.

brh: او دا مشینی زندٹ کہ دے انسان جوانوں ہنینوں توار بننگ خوائک تو ہمو توار کرینانا ادو حویلی ٹی او چھوکاتا ساداتہ بائیدے کہ نن ہموتے سنبھالن رکینک۔ آ منتوارم کل دوستاتا آر جی خالد بلوچ نا لکھ منتواری کہ دا مجلس نا ننے اسکان سر کرے
en: And in this mechanical life, when a person wants to hear good, sweet sounds, then those sounds are of the [unclear] in the courtyard and of the birds and animals; we must take care of them. I am grateful to all friends, and a hundred thousand thanks to RJ Khalid Baloch, who carried this programme with us up to this point.
en_old: In this mechanical life, when a person wants to hear good sounds, those sounds – the birds and animals in our houses and courtyards – it should be that we take care of them. Thanks to all friends; many thanks to RJ Khalid Baloch, who conducted this gathering with us to this point.

brh: او نن تنا منت وار اون براڈ کاسٹنگ انجینئرز آ تا خواجہ حسن خان آ عمران جان درانی نا بروکا مجلس انشاءاللہ مرو اتوار نا دے ہمو وخت اسکان تنا آر جی منظور پیازی ء براہوئی نا دا ننگا گچین آ مجلس آن موکل ات بو اللہ ننا و نما کل نا نگہبان گڈ سر ٹی اسے گچین و رنگ
en: And we are grateful to our broadcasting engineers, Khwaja Hassan Khan and Imran Jan Durrani. The next programme, God willing, will be on Sunday at the same time. Until then, (allow) your RJ Manzoor Piazi (to go): give (me) leave from this fine Brahui programme of ours. May God be the protector of all of us and of you. At the very end, a fine, colourful...
en_old: We thank the broadcasting engineers, Khwaja Hassan Khan and Imran Jan Durrani. The next gathering, God willing, will be on Sunday at the same time. From RJ Manzoor Piazi, take leave from this beautiful Brahui gathering of ours. May God be the guardian of us and of you all. At the end, a nice song...

brh: سنگت وسیم عالم نا توارٹ نمکن دادے بمبو دانا چس ہلبو او کنے اتیبو اجازت اللہ نما ننا کلنا نگہبان
en: In the voice of friend Wasim Alam, for you: listen to this, enjoy it, and give me leave. May God be the protector of all of you and us.
en_old: In the voice of friend Wasim Alam, for you – with this, enjoy this song, and give me leave. May God be the guardian of you and of us all.

brh: ہندن ہمو مسائل ٹی داسہ کہ انت سبب ئس مس کہ اسہ وخت اسے 2005 ٹی براہوئی سٹوڈنٹس فیڈریشن نا چیئرمین مسٹ تو او وخت آ اسے صوبہ غا بلکہ مچ آ بلوچستان آ اسے ہندن او حالت ئس بس توڑے باز آ مسئلہ غاک ہم مسور او وخت نا امن و امان نا صورتحال ئس او وخت نا پین باز آ مسئلہ غاک ہم مسور
en: Likewise, among those problems: now, what was the reason that at one point, in 2005, when I became chairman of the Brahui Students Federation, at that time such a situation arose in the province, or rather in all of Balochistan; even many problems arose as well, the law and order situation of that time, and many other problems of that time arose too.
en_old: Likewise, among those problems, what was the reason? At one point in 2005, when I became chairman of the Brahui Students Federation, a situation arose in the province, or rather across all of Balochistan. Many problems arose too: the law and order situation at that time, and many other problems as well.

brh: او وخت نا راجیو سچویشنز او تنظیم سازی نا شاید ہموخس اکٹیویٹی ہلتو بازا مسئلہ مسور اور ملکی حالات آتے مدنظر تخیسا گڑاس دنہا کہ براہوئی سٹوڈنٹس فیڈریشن بالکل اسٹاپ کننگا دا مس کہ تینا ترتیب اسہ ننا کاریم نا اودے چینج کریسہ
en: The political situations of that time and organisation-building: perhaps not that much activity took place; many problems arose, and keeping the country's conditions in view, it was not something like the Brahui Students Federation stopping completely; rather it changed its own arrangement, the way of our work.
en_old: Given the political situation at the time, there may not have been much organisation-building activity. There were many problems, and in view of the national situation, it wasn't that the Brahui Students Federation stopped completely. Rather, it changed its approach, the way we worked.

brh: ئے ریسپین ہمدا سٹ دے اسپیشل ٹریننگ اکیڈمی مستی دے لیکن موجود اسو، موجود گراؤنڈ اسکہ باز علاقہ غاتیٹی تو عملی وڑ اٹ اسکہ بالکل گراؤنڈ بسکہ ایلو تنظیم اتون اوار مرسا تینا احتجاج آتے کریسٹ کرے کہ ایون 2008 ٹی براہوئی
en: [Unclear]... the special training academy earlier... but it was present; it was present on the ground; in many areas it was practically, completely out on the ground, and joining together with other organisations it went on holding its protests, so that even in 2008 the Brahui...
en_old: ...in those days the special training academy was also present. It was present on the ground, and in many areas it was practically out on the ground, holding its protests together with other organisations, so that in 2008 the Brahui...

brh: زبان ء مردم شماری ٹی شاغفنگ نا اسہ بھلو تحریک ئس چلیفے 2008 ٹی ہنا ئس کانسٹیٹیوشن نا تحریک ئس لیکن ہلہ تا توجہ لوٹتے ملتوی کریر تما او اسہ جتا ء سے بیسس آ کین ٹائم اسور بہرحال داسہ کہ براہوئی سٹوڈنٹس فیڈریشن نا
en: ...it ran a big movement to have the (Brahui) language included in the census. In 2008 there was a movement about the constitution, but they postponed (attention to) the demands, and at that time they were on a separate basis. Anyway, now that the Brahui Students Federation's...
en_old: It led a major movement to include the language in the census. In 2008 there was a constitutional movement, but they put off their attention to the demands; at that time they were on a separate basis. Anyway, now that the Brahui Students Federation's...

brh: موجود ہسس لیکن اونا کاریم نا تینا ترتیب اسس بھلو اوپن گراؤنڈا کاریم کننگے تس لیکن گڑا اسیک متی ہم عملی ترتیب تریسہ انڈر گراؤنڈ پلس تینا انداز اسیرن کاریم تس۔ داسا انت امید آک اونو پوسکنا چیئرمین صاحب بسونے؟ یقینا وخت و حالت تون اوار تنظیم ہرا جوانی اٹ تنظیم مریک ہرا مضبوط مریک او وخت و حالت تون
en: It was present, but its work had its own arrangement: it stopped working out in the big open ground, but then it also set up a practical arrangement and worked underground, plus in its own style. Now what hopes are there, now that a new chairman sahib has come? Certainly, along with time and circumstances, an organisation that is well organised, that is strong, (moves) with time and circumstances...
en_old: It still existed, but it had its own way of working. It stopped working openly on the ground, but after that it set up a practical approach and worked underground in its own way. Now what hopes do you have of the new chairman who has come in? Certainly, an organisation that is good and strong keeps pace with the times and circumstances...

brh: بنا وطن نا حکمت عملی ہم بدل کرے سکے تو اینو نا وخت آ دے کہ براہوئی اسٹوڈنٹس فیڈریشن اوپن میدان آ کاریم کروئی ئے ارا موجودہ حالت آک کہ براہوئی زبان آ براہوئی قوم آ یا براہوئی ثقافت آ نقصان تننگ کے بسو دا تے کنٹرول کننگ کے کاؤنٹر کننگ کے یقینا دا وخت آ بے ایس ایف نا اشد ضرورت ئے
en: ...it can also change its strategy. So in today's time, the Brahui Students Federation has to work in the open field. The present conditions that have arisen to harm the Brahui language, the Brahui nation or Brahui culture: to control them, to counter them, the BSF is certainly badly needed at this time.
en_old: ...and changes its strategy too. So at present, should the Brahui Students Federation work in the open? Given the current circumstances, which have arisen to harm the Brahui language, the Brahui nation or Brahui culture, the BSF is certainly badly needed right now to control and counter them.

brh: ارس باز بلو زورسس کہ بے ایس ایف فعال مرے، عملی وڑٹ گراؤنڈ آ موجود مرے، اونا باقاعدہ کیبنٹ آک مریر، اونا باقاعدہ یونٹ سازی مرے، تو امید ئنا دے کہ انشاء اللہ چیئرمین اکرم عامل براہوئی صاحب نا قیادت ٹی براہوئی اسٹوڈنٹس فیڈریشن مضبوط مرو، پین تینا کاریم تے، جوان وڑٹ ترتیب اسے تو، ار جوان وڑٹ کاریم کریسہ براہوئی
en: There is very great pressure for the BSF to be active, to be practically present on the ground, to have its regular cabinets and its regular unit formation. So it is hoped that, God willing, under the leadership of Chairman Akram Aamil Brahui sahib, the Brahui Students Federation will be strong, will organise its work further and well, and by working well, Brahui...
en_old: There is very strong pressure for the BSF to be active and practically present on the ground, with its regular cabinets and regular unit formation. So we hope that, God willing, under the leadership of Chairman Akram Aamil Brahui, the Brahui Students Federation will be strong and will organise its work well, and by working well, Brahui...

brh: ثقافتی براہوئی قوم براہوئی مخلوق فائدہ تریسہ کرو اور خاص وڈ آ کرسی تا زیات او جنگ مریک سر نوم دا امرو بندغ ارے کہ دادے پارے کامیاب مرو ہند مرو دا تو بالکل پسکنو انداز اسے براہوئی سٹوڈنٹس فیڈریشن نظریاتی تنظیم اسے کرسی نا جنگ اموڈ مریک ہراڑے بندغاک ہمو نظریہ کرسی کے ایڈاپٹ کیرے
en: ...will keep benefiting the Brahui culture, the Brahui nation, the Brahui people. And in particular, there is a lot of fighting over chairs: 'How is this person? The one who said this, will he succeed, will he [unclear]?' This is a completely new style. The Brahui Students Federation is an ideological organisation; how could there be a fight over chairs (in it)? (That happens) where people adopt that ideology for the sake of a chair.
en_old: ...the Brahui culture, the Brahui nation and the Brahui people will benefit. And in particular, there is often a fight over positions: how is this person, who said this, going to succeed? This is a completely new style. The Brahui Students Federation is an ideological organisation, so how can there be a fight over positions there, where people adopt that ideology for the sake of a position?

brh: اڑاڑے معاملے نظریاتی مریک اوڑے گڑا کرسی اہمیت تخپک اوڑے کاری اہمیت تخپک کنا قومے دیر نا خاص فائدہ ملنگٹی ئے نو مکمل یعنی ساتھ ایتیتو رے تو تا مکمل تعاون کرو ہمون انشاءاللہ ہمون امر کہ نن مالا تینا دوٹی چلفسکن اوکان زیاد تخسکن ننا وس مس
en: Where matters are ideological, the chair holds no importance there; what holds importance there is the work. If my nation is getting a particular benefit from someone, then, I mean, if they stand by (us), we will fully cooperate with them. Likewise, God willing, likewise, as far as we could run (things) in our own hands and keep (them going), it was within our power.
en_old: Where matters are about ideology, positions have no importance; there the work has importance. If my nation's people stand to gain a particular benefit, and if they stand with us, we will cooperate with them fully. Likewise, God willing, as far as we could manage things in our own hands, beyond that it wasn't in our power...

brh: براہوئی سٹوڈنٹس فیڈریشن ادا سا ہم خنات تنظیم ئے براہوئی سٹوڈنٹس فیڈریشن براہوئی قوم نا تنظیم ئے تو ننا ارا جذبہ ئے دا قوم کن دا ثقافت کن دا رسم رواج کن دا زبان کن او ہمون برجا ئے او چے ودیکی بسنے کمی متنے تو انشاء اللہ ہر پلیٹ فارم آ او
en: The Brahui Students Federation: even now you can see, it is an organisation. en: Razzaq.
en_old: Razzaq

brh: کنا باوہ خیر ئے پریشان خننگسہ؟ پریشان امر مفا، دا کنا ایلم نا باوہ جاگہ جاگہ غا تولوک پائک کہ رضیہ کنا ئے ئے اودے ہر حالت اٹ
en: Father, is everything all right? You look worried. — How could I not be worried? This brother of mine, the [boy's] father, sits around in every place saying that Razia is his... her, in any condition...
en_old: My father, is everything alright? You look worried. How could I not be worried? This brother of mine, acting like a father, sits everywhere saying that Razia is mine, and he wants her no matter what.

brh: حاصل کرو دا داسے ایتو چائے او دے نرے فو ایتو دم کے کنے کنا مار پیپر آ کنا مرے نی گاٹی او
en: ...[I] will get her.' Now give me tea, and ... brew it for me. My son ... the paper ... my ... you ...
en_old: Get it, give me tea now, and give it… brew it for me, my son, on the paper… you…

brh: بس ابو جوان مننگٹی او بس مننگٹی او مطلب ئے دا محسوس کننگٹ کہ نی تینا تعلیم آن مچے نا توجہ ختم مسنے یا دا محسوس کیو کہ نی تینا
en: It's fine, Abu, it's going well, it's just going. — I mean, it's being felt that your attention to your education has completely gone, or I feel that you, your...
en_old: It's just, Father, it's getting better, it's just getting… I mean, it feels like you've lost all focus on your education, or do you feel that you…

brh: دا ذمہ واری تے انت نی پانہ ہت کرینوس؟ ابو کنے سمجھ بننگٹی اف کہ دا ٹی رضیہ نا انت قصور اسہ کہ چنکی آن الیس تا وی دا وخت اسکا او دے کنا تختے نشان تننگا ہر وخت آ او نا توخ قرب اسر اوفتہ
en: What do you say — have you fulfilled these responsibilities? — Abu, I don't understand what Razia's fault is in this, that from childhood until now she has been marked out as my intended; at all times her ... closeness ... was ...
en_old: What responsibilities do you say you have fulfilled? Father, I don't understand what Razia's fault is in this, that since childhood until now she has always been marked as mine…

brh: دا کلے کاریم کونا لمہ ناؤ، دو آن دو تینا مسڑئے لمہ نا مار تون نرفے داسے تینے سادہ کرینے ہوغک، ننے بے عقل جوڑ کرینے، داڑے تولنگاٹ چس مفک
en: All of this is my mother's doing: with her own hands she had her daughter run off with [her] mother's son; now she has made herself out to be innocent and is crying; she has made fools of us. There's no pleasure in sitting here.
en_old: All of this is my mother's doing. She was eager to marry her daughter to my mother's son. Now she's acting innocent and has made fools of us. There's no joy in sitting here.

brh: دا بیست و نیم سال پیر غاری قصور معاف کنہ مار قصور تو اونا باوہ نائے ہرا کہ تینا ایلم نا چرسی آ مار کہ تینا ایڑ نا رشتہ خواہسکے
en: These twenty and a half years ... forgive the fault of the elders, son. The fault is her father's, who sought his sister's match for his brother's hashish-addict son.
en_old: This is twenty and a half years old… forgive the fault, son. The fault is his father's, who asked for his sister's hand for his brother's addict son.

brh: دانات کسور کے ایتنا زندگی عذاب کیو خیر نی فکر کپہ ثمینہ ٹی چکمی سفت او کنا ایلم نا سیڑی او تعلیم یافتہ ئے
en: Over this one's fault you're making your life a torment? Anyway, don't you worry; Samina has no lack of good qualities; she is my brother's daughter, and she is educated.
en_old: Whose fault are you making your life a torment over? Anyway, don't worry. Samina is very virtuous. She is my brother's daughter, and she is educated.

brh: ہچ سمینانہ مننگٹی افٹ، ہو مرے ئے دادے کہ، ئے ہم رضیانہ تختا سے، سس سیوڈ، ہرا دے نم بزرگاک اسیدے مریفیرے دو پرغارٹ، کنا مار۔
en: I am not going to be Samina's at all. — Yes, maybe; it is this, that she too is of Razia's standing ... the day you elders make [a match for] someone ... my son.
en_old: Nothing is wrong with Samina. Yes, it's just that she too is betrothed to Razia's… the day you elders betrothed her, my son.

brh: موبائل ء تلپ ترغہ۔ دھمکی تسینے نا۔ دھمکی؟ انت دھمکی تس؟ پائے آئندہ مسڑ نا موبائل ء ہت کننگا خمپٹ۔ آخر وجہ ئس تو ضرور مروئی نا۔
en: He smashed the phone. Did he threaten you? A threat? What threat did he make? He said that from now on no one is to lay a hand on the daughter's phone. After all, there must surely be some reason, mustn't there.
en_old: He threw the phone away. He threatened you? Threatened? What threat did he make? He said, from now on, don't touch my daughter's phone. There must surely be some reason.

brh: انت وا جسمر مچا مخلوق پائک ایلم نانا مار نشہ کیک اراٹی ہردے جنگ کیرہ رضیہ نا میرو تو سانگ نا مطلب تدی ہاخر ٹی بٹنگ پین ہچ اسل
en: What else? ... all the people are saying, brother, that your son takes drugs and they fight at home every day. Raziya's engagement to Miro means ... in the end it will be broken off, nothing else at all.
en_old: What else? The whole community is saying, brother, your son takes drugs, there's fighting at home every day. Raziya's Mir... what's the point of the engagement? In the end it has to be broken off, nothing else at all.

brh: جوان، ننا دا جرات آ، دنو ہرا کے کیک، دا زورے او ٹھانگوئے، ٹھانگا تا پرغبوئے، ہورے او داست۔ یا اللہ نی خیر کپس، ئے میرو ہم خرد دماغس، جھگڑاس۔
en: Fine, such audacity toward us, who does a thing like that? This is too much. His legs... break his legs! Look at him now. O God, have mercy. That Miro is arrogant too, a brawler.
en_old: Fine, this audacity of ours, who does such a thing? That's force, he beats them, slaps them, look at this. O God, have mercy. This Mir is small-minded too, a quarrel.

brh: باجی داسہ تو خوش ئس نی داسہ تو نا اور شاہ جان نا کسر اسل صفا مننگٹی ہی
en: Sister, now you're happy, aren't you? Now the way for you and Shah Jan is becoming completely clear.
en_old: Sister, are you happy now? Now the way for you and Shah Jan is becoming completely clear.

brh: چپ کنو، دیر آ مس چپلا تے کشی پد۔ اونا دا جرات؟
en: Be quiet! It's been a long while since I took off my slippers (to beat someone). How dare he?
en_old: Be quiet, it's been a long time since I took off my slippers to someone. How dare he?

brh: نی اتفاتا مسے نٹ تے پرغوسو تمننگٹی بس ایلم بخت جوانس کے ہیورے لاٹو نتو جوان ء سبق ئس تے سوچنگٹی ایلم
en: If you hadn't happened to be there, I would have broken his legs... Just, brother, his luck was good that... otherwise... I'm thinking up a good lesson for him, brother.
en_old: By chance you... brother, luck was good that... otherwise... brother is thinking of a good lesson.

brh: نن فیصلہ کرینوں کہ تینا چنا نا زند ء ورتو برباد کننگ ہپنا۔ ایلو ایلو خدا نا پن اٹ دن کپیس، نا چنا ننا چنائے، تانکہ نن زندٹ آن نا چنا داڑے ڈکھیا مفروئے
en: We have decided that we will not let our child's life be ruined. Brother, brother, for God's sake don't do that; your child is our child. As long as we are alive, your child will not be unhappy here.
en_old: We have decided not to ruin our child's life again. No, no, for God's sake don't do that. Your child is our child; as long as we are alive, your child won't be hurt here.

brh: خلیپا ایرا خون نیت دیرس انت کنے دا ڈول بند کرینورے اول ایرا خون پدا ایت کینا خلیپا
en: Don't hit! Eat some bread... give some water. Why have you locked me up like this? First eat the bread, then we'll talk. Don't hit!
en_old: Don't hit me, brother... blood... Why have you locked me up like this? First brother's blood, then... don't hit me.

brh: بس ایلوم ئے نا خنتیکے مجبور اٹ نت او دا مار نا وڑ ڈول جوان اف کپر ہیرو چنا مار اسے او دے ئے پوک ئے برے
en: Enough, brother... I am helpless, and this son's ways are not good... he's just a young boy... it's in vain...
en_old: Just, brother, in your eyes... helpless... and this son's ways are not good... a son... come...

brh: ننا دوٹی ء، ولدا تین پہ تین ننا سنگبندی ء، ایچو مٹ ئس افک، وختنا بندغ پارے رے، تینا اخس کہ مرے خلے، ولدا ہم است منے پگر کے، بٹوک سے خاٹی، پین ئس خلک، توموری دے مونا الک، نن ہم تونا۔
en: It's in our hands; and besides, among ourselves, in our ties of betrothal there is no difference at all. People of old used to say: however much your own kin may beat you, he will still lay you down in the shade; a stranger beats you and leaves you out in front of the sun. We are with you too.
en_old: In our hands, and again among ourselves, our relationship has no difference. People of old said, however much it is, strike, still the heart doesn't change. One is broken, another strikes; the day moves forward, and we are with you.

brh: تین پتی ننا سوچ کینا، نتودان زیات بھروسہ، پگدا پاروئی کہ رضیہ اسکولئے خواننگ کن انت سے کائک؟ آہن نا ایلوم، ننا سل دون سوچپ، رضیہ کنا مسڑے، کنا ایلوم نا مسڑ اف۔
en: For our part we'll think it over; there is more trust than that. Later people will say, why does Raziya go to school to study? Yes, I'm your brother; don't think of us like that at all. Raziya is my daughter, not my brother's daughter.
en_old: We'd think about it among ourselves, trust more than that. Then they'll say, why does Raziya go to school to study? Yes, brother, don't think like that at all. Raziya is my daughter, not my brother's daughter.

brh: رضیہ نا خنتیا تخیوا
en: I'll keep an eye on Raziya.
en_old: Keep an eye on Raziya.

brh: افسوس کاٹم ئے کنا برغاس شاہ جہان نی؟ او اراتم بسس؟ داسہ بسٹ۔ رسیہ؟ نی ہر وخت کنا استٹی ئس
en: Ow, you've cracked my head! Shah Jahan, is that you? Oh, when did you come? I came just now. Raziya? You are always in my heart.
en_old: Sorry, did I wake you, Shah Jahan? When did you come? I just came. Raziya? You're always in my heart.

brh: کنا فکرٹی کنا استٹی چائے دا کچن مرے یا نائس پول مسکہ خلپہ کنے
en: In my thoughts, in my heart... Whether it's tea, this kitchen, or... don't butter me up.
en_old: In my thoughts, in my heart... whether it's tea, this kitchen, or something... don't scold me.

brh: خفا مف انسانس اوٹ ایرا کمپرہ اتنا ورغہ کاوا کنا بابہ لمہ کنا بابہ لمہ پریشان مفرہ ایرا ورغہ کاوا ہرا ننے گٹیسو
en: Don't be upset, I'm a human being. I won't eat food; I'll go to their home, so that my father and mother, my father and mother won't be worried. I'll go home, the one who... us...
en_old: Don't be upset, a person... I won't do that... my parents won't be worried... the one who...

brh: ننا ننے مننگٹی، دسکہ مارنا دس و پدف، امی دے نا رسیا تونا سانگ پنانے۔
en: ... ever since that very day the engagement with Raziya was broken.
en_old: As we become one of us, with the son... the engagement with you from that day, Raziya's...

brh: ہمے دے ننا دا مار ننا کؤریا بریک۔ او دے پہ دے تو اونا صحت ہم کمزور مننگٹی ئے ئے دے بسک۔ شاہ جان۔ ہت پی
en: Since that same day this son of ours comes to us... and day by day his health is getting weaker too... Shah Jan...
en_old: Every day this son of ours comes to our house. Day by day his health is also getting weaker. Shah Jan. Eat.

brh: انتئے؟ انتئے کنا مار نی ننا سزائے تننگ اٹی ئس انتئے بابو؟ ہن مس۔ نہ نہ نہ نیمہ برننگ اٹی ئس نی خبر ئے کہ ما انتظار اٹی
en: Why? Why, my son, are you punishing us? Why, dear? - All right. - No, no, no, you come home in the middle of the night; do you know that we are waiting?
en_old: Why? Why, my son, were you punishing us, why, dear? Yes. No, no, no, you were coming at midnight; do you know that we were waiting?

brh: ننا خنک سڑیرے، داسہ نی سدٹ پاننگٹی ئس ہنمس بابا، بابا ایڑے ہسٹلٹی مچے سنگتاتے تون ہیت ہم کیک، او پدا وقتی بروٹ تا وراٹی ہیت کروٹ۔
en: Our eyes have rotted from waiting, and now you're just saying 'okay, Baba'? Baba, over there in the hostel one also talks with all the friends, and later, when I come home on time, I'll talk about it.
en_old: Our eyes are burning; now you were telling the truth, yes Baba. Baba, over there at the hostel he also talks with all the friends, and then when he comes in time we will talk about it.

brh: ہو کنا مار، دا انتئے پاپیسہ کیپ، کنے ہت و تمتو تولنگ دوست اف، ہنا پا، تنو ہت اسو۔
en: Yes, my son, why don't you say this? I don't like sitting... so say it...
en_old: Yes, my son, why aren't you saying this? I don't like sitting hungry and thirsty, so say it, eat with us.

brh: حلیمہ! دا ہند بنے گٹی ئے خیر درک گڑا نہ گڑاس کروئی تمک کنے۔
en: Halima! This place is getting too tight for me. Well, I'll have to do something or other.
en_old: Halima! This place is getting tight for me; well, I have to do something or other.

brh: واہ واہ کنا کاکو قسم ئے امر جنگس کریس استے کنا خوش کریس خیرات مسوٹ کنا واہ کنا کاکو واہ
en: Wow, wow, my dear uncle, I swear, what a fight you put up! You made my heart happy; I'd give my life for you, my... wow, my dear uncle, wow!
en_old: Wow, wow, my dear kaku, I swear, how well you did! You made me so happy, I'd give my life for you, my dear kaku, wow!

brh: ایلو اڑے مبین ہن کے ایلو نی دا رضیہ نا موبائل ء ہرف برو ابا او پین چے ٹویٹ کریکے پین دبنگا ٹویٹ کریکے
en: Brother, hey Mubin, do this, brother: go pick up Raziya's phone and bring it, dear, and see what else she has tweeted, what other bold tweets she has posted.
en_old: Listen, hey Mubin, do this: go bring Razia's mobile, father. And what else did he tweet, what kind of tweet did he post?

brh: انت کتیس؟ اینو مارے تپہ دار نمبر سیر کیوتے؟ ارے ننا لیتا بس کتیٹینا ڈغارٹ، ارے ننا ٹک کنے پاوے، بس ہن۔
en: What did you do? Today, son, ... number ...? Hey, we just ... on the ground. Hey, tell me what's troubling us, that's all.
en_old: What did you do? Today, son, are you going to dial a marked number? We just put our things down on the ground, tell me our thing, that's all.

brh: دم تو کلمو نمورکہ ایندہ را را غان کاوا دم تو ئے جوانی ٹی بوم افس خدانا رضا اللہ بو کنے
en: ... the Kalima ... in future I'll go from home ... in youth ... It is God's will; God, help me.
en_old: Breath... don't let it end, may it not come again... we were not well in breath... God's will, God be with me.

brh: او مش! نی انتئے دنو بے عقلی او کاریم کیسہ؟ انت کہ موبائلے تا پرغاس؟ ئے اودے گپ کننگا خناٹ، خنے اننم لگا کہ او شاہ جان تو ہیت کریک۔
en: Hey! Why do you do such senseless things? Why did you break her phone? - I saw her talking, and it seemed to me that she was talking with Shah Jan.
en_old: Oh, enough! Why do you do such foolish things? Why did you snatch the mobile? I saw her talking, and it seemed to me that she was talking to Shah Jan.

brh: آخر دا شاہجان انت کہ نادان نا دماغہ سوار ئے اوڑن تو سنگت پینا اسہ ارٹس تو گیت کے کے اماں او کنا ماروئے ہر حالٹی کنا ماروئے تانکہ زندہ او ٹوپ تا والہ
en: After all, what is it about this Shah Jan that he has got hold of the foolish girl's mind? He and a friend, one or two others... - Mother, he is my son; in every situation he is my son, as long as I'm alive...
en_old: After all, what is it with this Shah Jan that has taken over this foolish one's mind? With him one or two other friends... Mother, he is my son, in every situation he is my son, as long as he's alive...

brh: ننگے لپا روتا اماں۔ مار صبر کرک، حوصلہ کرک، صبر نا بلو بشخ اسے، ہرا تما بس توراٹی پلتا ہمار کے نی چاش ہمون کرک۔ اماں کنے شاہ جان نا کونڈل خوف بریک۔ انت کے خوف بریک شاہ جان؟
en: Don't cry like this, Mother. Son, be patient, take courage; the reward of patience is great; whatever happens... - Mother, I'm so afraid for Shah Jan. - Why are you afraid of Shah Jan?
en_old: Don't cry like this, Mother. Son, be patient, have courage; patience is a big part of it, and whatever happens in the end, do as you wish. Mother, I'm terribly afraid for Shah Jan. Why are you afraid for Shah Jan?
