brh: اما، او آسانی اٹ چست ایر فنگ اٹی ئے اللہ خیر کیک، نی استے خنا چنا کپہ۔ ئے داسہ نا ارام کپہ، دونو بے پیر کاریم کپہ۔ نا ارام کپہ۔
en: Mother, he is getting up and moving around easily; God will make it well, don't lose heart. Don't get restless now, don't do such reckless things. Don't be restless.
en_old: Mother, she is getting up and down with ease, God will make it well, don't see the child that way. Don't be at ease now, don't do such foolish things. Don't rest.

brh: رضیہ، گانگو، دا بیچارہ ء، نیرو، دا ہچ کیک داری چاوہ کنا جاہ چٹی ء۔
en: Raziya, the poor dumb thing, this poor girl... she doesn't do anything... I know my place is ruined.
en_old: Razia, the dumb one, this poor thing, look, she doesn't do anything at all, she knows my place is...

brh: انتئے نا چنا کے بوجا خننگ برداشت کپنہ۔ شاہ جہان او رضیہ چنا کمبل نا سجا خوار۔ او اسیل نا پنا سورہ۔
en: Why? We can't bear to see your child as a burden. Shah Jan and Razia [have been together] since they were little children, and they were promised to each other by name.
en_old: Why can't they bear to see the child as a burden? Shah Jahan and Razia want the child's blanket. They are named after Asil.

brh: اسٹ اسٹ چمکووی تاسب دا رشتہ کنا او گنا خواجہ ئے تے دن غانجو لپے سدا کشتے پانے گن خواسی ارے ماما نبی بخش دادے کے
en: One by one... this match [was made by] me and your husband... like this... always... is there any wish? Uncle Nabi Bakhsh, what I mean is...
en_old: Little by little, because of this, this relationship of mine and his owner... like this, always... is there any desire? Uncle Nabi Bakhsh, this one...

brh: جان غزیہ دستکان اوستن دننگ کے تیار اف ئے خواہو کہ ہمو مستنا رشتہ برقرار مرے ہی مستنا رشتہ او رشتہ تو اینا پنا شیشے
en: Dear, [she] is not ready to let it slip out of [her] hands. I want that old relationship to stay intact, that old relationship, and that relationship is like glass.
en_old: Jan, Ghaziya is not ready to let go of it yet; she wants that old relationship to remain, that old relationship, and that relationship is like glass in her name.

brh: سوئچس جوڑ مس، ٹکل ٹکل مس، ورجاسلیتو، مخلوق خنا، مخلوق بنگ، داسے نیامو ریشتے دوارہ جوڑنگ نا کوشش کننگٹی ئس نن مخلوق نا مونا ہنون
en: Something was formed, then it broke into pieces... people saw, people heard; now you are trying to rebuild the relationship between [us] again, [so] we will go before the people.
en_old: A switch was set, it broke into pieces, it was put back together; people saw, people... now we were trying to rebuild the relationship between us, we were like this in front of people.

brh: شلم دم مرے غازی جوڑ مرے مخلوق تو عید کننگ نا عادت ئے او عید ئے خاخر آتے کک ننے ننے ننا چناتا خوشی نا عید ئے کروئی ئے آ جان تو گڑا داسے نی
en: Be it ..., be it [all] well, people have the habit of celebrating Eid, and they celebrate Eid for [others'] sake; we, we must celebrate the Eid of our children's happiness. O dear, so then now you...
en_old: Whether it's Shalam or Ghazi, people have a habit of celebrating Eid, and they celebrate Eid for the sake of others; we must celebrate the Eid of our children's happiness, Jan, so now you...

brh: تینا مسڑے تننگ کن راضی ئس ئے دادے کہ ئے دا پاننگ خوارہ کہ اگر میر احمد نی پین جاگہ غس پین بندہ غس ایتے رے تو ئے لب تننگ کن تیار اٹ۔
en: You are willing to give your daughter; what I mean is, I want to say this: if — Mir Ahmed — you give [her] to some other place, to some other person, then I am ready to pay the bride price.
en_old: You were willing to give your daughter; what I mean is that I want to say this: if, Mir Ahmed, you give her to another place, to another person, then I am ready to pay the bride price.

brh: باجی، نی ننے تینا لائق سمجھپیسے، ہندا خاطر آن پیسنا ضرورت تینا جانی کشنگٹی وئی۔ ماما، ئے داد کے
en: Sister, you don't consider us worthy of you; that's why, out of need for money, you are selling off your own darling. Uncle, what I mean is...
en_old: Sister, you didn't think we were worthy of you. That's why your need for money drove you to take your own life. Uncle, I will give…

brh: ارام آ ماحول اٹ کنا چنا چنا کمبل او مسور۔ دا صاحب او دا ماحول ء برداشت کننگ کپیسہ۔ تو دانا مطلب دا مس۔
en: My children grew up from childhood in a peaceful environment. You can't tolerate this gentleman and this environment. So this is what it meant.
en_old: My little children were comfortable in a peaceful home. This gentleman can't stand this home. So that's what this meant.

brh: کہ نن نما بندغ نا لائق افن نم بندغ دیرے بندغ تکوے او غلام دین ہم گڑا سیت کر دا ننا چنا تا خوشی نا دے تے ئے انت ایت کروٹ
en: That we are not worthy of your people? Who are your people... and Ghulam Din too, then... These days of our children's happiness — what will I do [with them]?
en_old: That we are not worthy of your people. You give a person, you look at a person, and Ghulam Din also said something. What will I do with these happy days of our children?

brh: ادا نبی بخش عید کنے اٹی، و دا ننا رواج اٹی چناتا خوشیاں زیات بلا تا فیصلہ غاتا اہمیت ارے، بس۔
en: Brother Nabi Bakhsh, Eid... and in this custom of ours, the decisions of the elders carry more weight than the children's happiness. That's all.
en_old: Here Nabi Bakhsh is not my Eid, and in our custom the elders' decisions matter more than the children's happiness. That's all.

brh: ہی تنداس بندغے ٹی رے تو ننم تیار اون بندغ دیر مک او ہور ماما ئے اول آ مندا پاریٹ او داسہ مندا پاوہ کہ میر احمد نا لب کے اخس کہ پیسہ لگے کا
en: If [the problem] is in the man, then we too are ready... the man... and, Uncle, I said this at first and I say it again now: however much money Mir Ahmed's bride price takes...
en_old: If there is something in the person, then we are ready. Give a person… I told Uncle this at first, and now I'm saying it again: how much money will Mir Ahmed's bride price take?

brh: ئے لب تننگ کے تیار ہٹ۔ خواجہ محمد امین نن میر احمد نا لب نا لائق او۔ ہمیرو؟ جی او بالکل۔
en: I am ready to pay the bride price. Khwaja Muhammad Amin, we are up to [paying] Mir Ahmed's bride price, aren't we? — Yes, absolutely.
en_old: …I'm ready to pay the bride price. Khawaja Muhammad Amin, we are worthy of paying Mir Ahmed's bride price. Is that so? Yes, absolutely.

brh: شاہ جان ابا، اینے پارے سوٹ، ایت نسرین نا مروئی، بلے نی منت اویسو، بلے ما
en: Shah Jan, father, I had told you: give [her], she should be Nasreen's — but you hadn't agreed, but...
en_old: Shah Jan, father, I told you, give it, it would be Nasreen's, but you didn't agree, but…

brh: دا سمودہ کشنگٹ انت مریک؟ ننتو کس نہ یدی ال تا ویرے، برے رزیانہ نا مار اینو سریلا کریرے تے، داسہ پورا کبو تا، نین اونا خیر خواہ اوسی یا بد خواہ اوسی۔
en: What comes of striking this bargain? You didn't leave anyone for us... you have made [Razia's?] son so willful today; now see it through yourselves. Are you his well-wisher or his ill-wisher?
en_old: What comes of pushing this deal? We have no one… Come, you have made today's son… now finish it. Are you his well-wisher or his ill-wisher?

brh: ئے تینا بس کوشش کرٹ، مجبور اسوٹ، شاید اللہ ء منظور الو، تول کنا ایڈی بن کنا وار
en: I did my very best; I was helpless; perhaps God didn't will it. Then, my sister... my turn...
en_old: I tried my best. I was helpless. Maybe it wasn't God's will. Then my… my turn…

brh: اللہ تعالی انسان ء صرف کوشش و جستجو نا اختیار تسنے۔ کاریم مننگ یا نہ مننگ او اللہ تعالی نا کاریم ء۔ نن اونا
en: God Almighty has given human beings only the power to try and strive. Whether a thing gets done or not is God Almighty's work. We [are] His...
en_old: Almighty Allah has given people only the power to try and strive. Whether a task succeeds or not is Allah's work. We his…

brh: ادو اللہ تعالی دا دنیا ٹی ہزار آ رنگ آک جوڑ کرینے اسہ ٹس ملے تو ایلو تن بائدے بندغ مایوس مف مایوسی دا دنیا ٹی انسانہ تے کے جہنم
en: And God Almighty has made a thousand colors in this world; if one [does not work out], then there must be another. A person should not despair; despair is hell for human beings in this world.
en_old: Almighty Allah has made thousands of colors in this world. If you can't find one, you should look to another. A person shouldn't lose hope. Despair is hell for people in this world.

brh: ننا نام جوڑ کیک کنا مار کنے امید ئے کہ نی مایوس مفروس اللہ تعالی نا نعمت آتیان فائدہ ہرف
en: ...makes our name. My son, I hope that you will not lose heart; make use of God Almighty's blessings.
en_old: …makes our name. My son, I hope you won't lose hope. Make use of Almighty Allah's blessings.

brh: رضیہ، رضیہ اللہ تینا منٹ چپ کر، انت کہ
en: Razia, Razia, for God's sake, be quiet for a minute, whatever...
en_old: Razia, Razia, for God's sake, be quiet for a minute, because…

brh: ہنت کہ خدا نا کنڈان حکم مسکہ ہندن مریک اور ہنداٹی ننا انسان تا بہترے ئے اماں نن انساناک تینا کروک آ فیصلہ نا الزام ئے
en: Whatever has been ordered from God's side, that is how it happens, and in that lies the good of us humans. Mother, we humans [take] the blame for the decisions we ourselves made...
en_old: Whatever God has ordered happens that way, and that is what's best for us humans. Mother, we humans blame the decisions we made ourselves…

brh: اللہ کنتئے شاغنے، حالانکہ اونا ننے تینا فیصلہ کننگ نا اختیار ہم تسونے، دنیا آخر میرود انت بارہ ئٹی پارے، اوٹی انت پارے؟
en: [and say] 'God has cast this on me', even though He has also given us the power to make our own decisions. In the end, what did the world say about [it], what did it say about that?
en_old: Why has Allah put me in this, when He has also given us the right to make our own decisions? In the end, what did people say about Mir…, what did they say?

brh: نی ایندہس دوستے نی ابے پار نی ایتتہ کنا جان چھٹے بس کبو بس انتئے نومے تینو کچکاں بار الکونورے نم نم
en: You... such a friend... you tell Father... you didn't give [it]... My dear, leave me be, enough, stop it, enough! Why have you all... dogs... you, you...
en_old: You're such a friend. You tell father, you give it. My dear, let it go. Enough, stop. Why did you buy…? You, you…

brh: رضیہ رضیہ کنا چنا اخس دے مریک نی نی سکولہ ہنتنس دن مبا
en: Razia, Razia, my child, how many days has it been that you haven't gone to school? Don't be like this.
en_old: Razia, Razia, my child, how many days has it been since you went to school? Don't be like this.

brh: نی انت پاننگٹی ئس کس پائرس ہراستے نن نرا نی ننے۔ آخا نرانگٹ مگا مرغ مریک دا کان زیات پین شزی انت مرو؟ این پیشن پیش تا ارک مخلوق انت پاننگٹی ئے
en: What are you saying? Who told you... we... you... us? In the end, by running away... what more could happen than this? Out there today, what are people saying?
en_old: What were you saying? Who will say… that we… you, us? In the end, by running off… what could be more shameful than this? What are people, past and present, saying?

brh: گلن کشیرے اماں کشیرے کنے تو کشیر کنا اینو زندگی تباہ مسونے اسکول این تاوت تونٹ مرو
en: Kill me, mother, kill me, just kill me! My life has been ruined today. School today...
en_old: Kill me, mother, kill me, just kill me! My life is ruined today. How will I go to school now…

brh: دن پاپو دن پاپو کنا شہت نمونہ دے
en: Don't say that, don't say that, my sweetheart...
en_old: Don't do this, papa, don't do this, papa, my…

brh: السلام علیکم سر۔ وعلیکم السلام۔
en: Peace be upon you, sir. — And upon you be peace.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum, sir. Wa alaikum assalam.

brh: ادا تو نی اسکول ا بسنس؟ سر طبیعت کنا خراب ئس تو ایپلیکیشن ترو سوس یا کسے اطلاع کرو سوس؟ استادہ ذمہ واری بیرہ فقط خالی گپ افک۔
en: So you've come to school? — Sir, I was unwell. — Then you could have sent an application or informed someone. A teacher's responsibility is not just empty talk.
en_old: So why didn't you come to school? Sir, I wasn't feeling well. Then did you send an application or let anyone know? Being a teacher isn't just about talk; it's a responsibility.

brh: اسکے معاشرہ ٹی اسہ جذبہ ئس پیدا کروئی ہی ارا ملک و قوم نا جوان خدمت کے سر آئندہ نمے شکایت مفرو خیر امید ہی ئے تینا ذمہ داری تے پومروس جی سر اوکے تھینکس
en: [We] must create a spirit in society that serves the country and the nation well. — Sir, from now on you won't have any complaint. — All right, I hope you will understand your responsibilities. — Yes, sir. — Okay, thanks.
en_old: So we have to create a spirit in society that serves the country and the nation well. Sir, from now on you won't have any complaints, God willing. I hope you've understood your responsibilities. Yes sir. Okay, thanks.

brh: خواجہ ہم کہیرے، نن کس تون ہم مقابل مننگ کپنہ، خن اف ننے کہ نن پیشن چرنگٹ۔ ورما مونا برسا، کرینہ شکر نا بٹ مننگ کے۔
en: Khwaja also says we can't stand up to anyone; we can't show our faces (lit. we have no eyes) when we go about outside. ... coming forward... we do... to become a lump of sugar.
en_old: Even the master says it: we can't compete with anyone. Don't we see that we're out wandering? Verma came forward, Kareena became a piece of sugar.

brh: او درو نہ ئتو او کے استندار اینتینا بروکا وقت نا بارو اٹ سوچ کر کہ او خسی بمرک ابو درو نا قصہ ہم دنز او استن مس
en: He didn't give it to you yesterday... he thought about his own future, whether he would be happy. Father, yesterday's story also turned out the same way...
en_old: He doesn't lie… think about his future, about whether he will be happy. Father, Daro's story is just like this too.

brh: شاہ جان شاہ جان نی ناشتہ کیملے پس نا دے ہدی نہ دا سامر پوکیتے متے پو مفکک
en: Shah Jan, Shah Jan, have you had breakfast? The other day... explain this matter to him; he doesn't understand at all.
en_old: Shah Jan, Shah Jan, have you had breakfast? Don't waste these things.

brh: ابو اراٹینگ بائے جان نا سنگ پینانی نہ کسء تو جوانیٹ کیک نہ مسخرا کیک
en: Father, where Bai Jan is engaged, among those other people nobody either treats anyone kindly or jokes around.
en_old: Father, in Bai Jan's company no one does anything good; they just make fun.

brh: دا دے پارا دھک ئنا زیا دھک
en: This is what they call a blow on top of a blow.
en_old: He said this: the price of Dhak, Dhak.

brh: لا حول ولا قوۃ۔ مرو تمباکو ہسوس۔ خار تپیس۔ مودی علی دا محمد علی برانگی۔ تینا کوٹہ وٹی تولوک ئے ضعیفہ نا مونا ضعیفہ نا بوزٹورک۔ او۔
en: There is no might or power except through God! Mero... the tobacco... you don't know. Mudi Ali, this Muhammad Ali, where has he gone? He's sitting in his own room in front of his wife, at his wife's face. Oh.
en_old: There is no power or strength except with God. Tobacco smoke… you don't know anything. Mudi Ali, this Muhammad Ali… sitting in his room in front of the old woman, the old woman's face…

brh: نی کنا بوزٹ ئے اورنگٹ ایوس ماما جانی کنا اورائی نا بوزٹ ئے اورنگٹ ئے بس میرل جان بس بننگ تو زلزلہ بس ڈونکی۔
en: You're looking at my face, Mama Jani; you're looking at my wife's face. Enough, Miral Jan, enough. Just as we came, an earthquake came. Donkey!
en_old: You're looking at my face, Mama Jani, looking at my wedding face. Just Miral Jan, just as I came, an earthquake came, you donkey.

brh: دا کہ پیش تمن تو گڑاس کین دا کہ پیش تمن مخلوق نا ہزار سوال آ کن ننگی ماما غلام احمد تو تینا اوراغ آن پیش تمن کپک ہرا مونٹ پیشتامو بے بس کنے
en: If this gets out, then we have to do something; if this gets out, people will ask us a thousand questions. Uncle Ghulam Ahmad won't be able to step out of his own house; whoever he comes face to face with, he will be helpless.
en_old: If this happens, we'll do something; if this happens, people will ask a thousand questions. Uncle Ghulam Ahmad won't be able to step out of his house; whoever faces him will leave him helpless.

brh: کے تو خدا ہچ کپک ئے انتئے مرو دروازہ ئے پرغوئے اڑے سلو او سلو برنگٹی ئے اڑے ما بدنی ابا کا دروازہ ئے ملیس بس زلزلے
en: Who is it? God, he does nothing! Hey, why are you breaking the door, Mero? Hey, wait, oh wait, I'm coming. Hey... Father, go open the door. Enough, it's an earthquake!
en_old: Who is it? God does nothing... why are you breaking the door? Wait, wait, I'm coming! Father, who opened the door? It's just an earthquake.

brh: بنی گتھو ٹوڈا میرو! مزہ ڈیل، خدا خلنے شوم دروازہ پرغاس۔ خوار وریس خوار کریس ننے۔ دروازہ ملنگ تینے مزہ ڈیل تینے اوس۔ خیرات کیو
en: ... Mero! Maza Dil, may God strike you, you wretch, you've broken the door. You've become wretched and you've made us wretched. Opening the door yourself... Maza Dil, it's you... I'll give alms.
en_old: Bani Gatho, Toda, Mero! Maza Dil, fear God, you've broken the door. You've disgraced us and brought us to ruin. Open the door, Maza Dil, it's me. I'll give alms.

brh: دے تو تینا ضعیفہ نا بوزل چوریسے ضعیفہ نا محتاج ئس ئے شکر ابا نا محتاج خپٹ تینا کمائی کیوے تینا کونیوے ارے اسے تو سپاونے اور نی ناگ تینے کنتو الے پٹ
en: You... your own wife's...; you're dependent on your wife. Thank God, I'm not dependent on Father; I earn my own living and eat my own food. Hey... and you... yourself with me...
en_old: You've stolen your old woman's things; you're dependent on an old woman. Thank God, I'm not dependent on my father; I earn my own living and eat my own bread. Where is she? Where did you send her? And you, who do you think you are to keep her?

brh: حل کٹ دے نا استاد دے نشانی توڑنے کسکے کسکے ارے دے اللہ او کھٹو کھٹو کھٹو کسے چومے وطن نا خیرات زندے نا کسے فانی
en: ... his master... he has broken the engagement token. He died, he died! Hey, O God... won, won, won... someone... the alms of the homeland... everyone's life is mortal.
en_old: Hal Kat, his master, he broke the sign; who is it, who is it? O God, he... who kisses whom? The charity of the homeland, life is mortal for everyone.

brh: بشہ بو انتئے نومے، بشو خط نمبر جنگل کوہڑی، نم تینا انسان سمجھرے، انسان رے نوم، کجکاک، میرو، بننگ چوبہ، دہت ہفنا شروع مس، اب
en: Get up! Why are you...? Get up! ... letter, number, jungle, Kohri... Do you consider yourselves human? Are you human? Dogs! Mero, come... it has started, now...
en_old: Hey you, why, what's your name? Letter number, jungle, hut; do you consider yourselves human? You are human, you're named Kajkak, Mero, come here; the tenth, the seventh has begun, now...

brh: واہ خنیس تے کلپے کشانے کنا خلنکے دے پاہ کیدانہ بلائی نموچ ارے مونی گام ہرفیس گامی ہرفیس نا لاشے تینا کوپ
en: Wow, did you see him? He has pulled a trick... you're all a curse! Hey, take one step forward: take one step and you'll be carrying your own corpse on your shoulder.
en_old: Oh, you saw them and scratched them away; my fear... tell him, trouble has come upon you. Step forward, lift it up, lift the corpse, your own...

brh: پغہ چا جک مٹ مورا مورا چا نا مار تافیس کہ
en: Tomorrow, the tea... Mora, Mora, son, did you heat up the tea?
en_old: Tomorrow, tea... Mora, Mora, haven't you heated the tea?

brh: دا ودی بٹ دروازہ
en: This door has fallen out.
en_old: This door is wide open.

brh: او اللہ تا کوک کا نا، بے تاب اولاد بننگان، اللہ بے اولاد کرے ککہ جوان اسس، ہپش ہن، مست مریغانے، ہرا کڑو مارا کوک
en: O God, whose shouting is this? Restless children... It would have been better if God had made me childless. Shoo, go away! You've gone crazy. Whichever son is calling...
en_old: O God, who is calling? They're restless for children to come; it would've been better if God had made them childless. Go away, don't get carried away, whichever son calls...

brh: داستکان باور بپک کہ رضیہ شاہجہان تو ہنانے۔ اسو باور بپک۔ ہلت! نمو چشارٹی بلے ننا عزت نا تو جلا رکھ۔ داستکان او پارہ کہ واقعہ ئس مسونے
en: I still can't believe that Razia has gone off with Shahjahan. I just can't believe it. Wait! ... our honour ... Still, they say that something has happened.
en_old: I still can't believe that Razia has gone with Shahjahan. I just can't believe it. Wait! In front of all of you, keep our honour intact. Until now she says that an incident has happened.

brh: ننا ننا انت بھیرہ سری نا باری مڑفوکا کو واہ باریم واہ ننا باریمے اڑفوک ننے آ باریم مروڑ باریم ئے غلام محمدا نا مچن ٹی او
en: Our... our... what... a burden... oh, a burden! Oh, the one who would carry our burden... a burden to us... a twist... the burden is in Ghulam Muhammad's fist, he...
en_old: Ours, ours... what is this? The turn of the head? Oh, a turn, oh, our turn has come, our turn, the turn, the turn is in Ghulam Muhammad's hands, he...

brh: مار ئنا ہچو ہچو کمی اف تفتہ۔ بے شک۔ موبائل کہ خفاتے نا تخرہ گھنٹہ تا گھنٹہ دچا دیر دیر تو ہیت کیرہ۔ پاتی نا پنت۔
en: Son, there's no lack of anything at all. Of course. It's the mobile that they keep at their ears; hour after hour they talk to who knows whom. ... advice.
en_old: My son lacks nothing at all. Indeed. The mobile they keep to their ears, they talk for hours and hours. That's the thread of it all.

brh: نی نی ایو نم کنا کنا ایلوم نم چنا تا رندٹ تمان اسوٹ ڈی پی ہور اچ مرے تو او تینا کاٹم اٹ تو خوانے پی اما ایندے رضیہ پاس
en: You, you, hey, you, my, my brother, you... I was running after the children... if the DP is seen, then she reads it in her own head... Razia...
en_old: You, you, hey, you, my friend, you were running after the children; if the DP is seen, then she in her room reads it and says... Razia's...

brh: ئے اورتو موبائلے خنپر۔ واہ لٹھو واہ۔ موبائلے چٹ چٹ خنپر۔ ارے داسکان مچڑی تے تنونے۔ ارا وخت مچڑی تے تورنے۔ گڑا نرینے تینا نشانی تے چٹ۔ ئے لٹھو واہ۔ چپ مرو۔ چپ تینے
en: I won't look at the mobile with her. Oh, Lattho, oh! I won't look at the mobile at all. Hey, has she been handing out the ... until now? When did she take hold of the ...? Then give the man back his engagement tokens altogether. Hey, Lattho, oh! Be quiet. Keep quiet.
en_old: Hey, don't look at the mobile there. Oh, Lattho, oh! Don't keep staring at the mobile. Until now you've been counting on your fingers. When did you hold your fingers? Then clean your sign. Oh, Lattho, oh! Keep quiet, quiet yourself.

brh: خیر خیر او خیر
en: All right, all right, oh, all right.
en_old: Alright, alright, fine.

brh: بخیر ات میر احمد جان۔ بخیر ات صاحب
en: Welcome, Mir Ahmad Jan. Welcome, sir.
en_old: Welcome, Mir Ahmad Jan. Welcome, sir.

brh: امرس طبیعت نا جوان ئے شکر اللہ نا احسان ئے تاتا دا پا کہ رضیہ ارانگ ہنانے؟ مار رضیہ دا کمرہ ٹی نی موبائل اٹ تینا سہیلی سے تون
en: How is your health? It's good, thank God, it's God's grace. Dad, tell me, where has Razia gone? Son, Razia is in this room, on her mobile with a friend of hers.
en_old: He's fine, his health is good, thank God for His kindness. Grandpa, tell me, where has Razia gone? Son, Razia is in this room, on the mobile with her friends.

brh: او ئے جوانٹ نہ بور مننگٹ اسوٹ سوچاٹ نی چکرس خلیو او
en: Oh, good, I was getting bored. I was thinking I'd go out for a stroll.
en_old: Oh, good, I was getting bored. I was just thinking you'd drop by for a visit.

brh: دیر تو ایت کننگ اٹی ئس آئندہ ئے تو نا موبائل ء ہم پاش۔ ارکس تو ایت کیک؟ ننے
en: Who were you talking to? From now on, show me your mobile too. Does she talk to just anyone? To us...
en_old: You were about to give water; from now on, hand over your mobile too. Who gives it? To us?

brh: شام! نی دیر ئس کنے منع کروکا؟ ہاتے پوک کدا مسڑیتینا! آئندہ ئے تودہ موبائلے خناٹ، جوان مبا روئے! دادو ابا نا دوستنگا ایلوم نا مار۔
en: Sham! Who are you to forbid me? Look at this good-for-nothing daughter of yours! From now on, if I see you with the mobile, it won't end well! Dado is the son of Father's dear brother.
en_old: Sham! Who are you to forbid me? Look at this ruined one! From now on, don't look at the mobile, it won't be good! Dado is the son of father's friend.

brh: دا سے انت الے دا چنگ مچ پتا زندہ ہمت گت ری فوٹو بس نی تینے پریشان کپہ انشاءاللہ نی دانا احوال کپرون
en: What is this? This... all... alive... courage... a photo came. Just don't worry yourself; God willing, we won't tell anyone about this.
en_old: What is this? This child of ours... everyone... courage... a photo came. Don't worry yourself; God willing, we won't tell anyone about this.

brh: برے شام نا امباوہ جوانی کیت کے وئی توت نزیا دا میرو نا موبائل انسک پرغا
en: Come, in the evening... Father will do you a good turn... and snatch away this Mero's mobile.
en_old: Come by in the evening, Father will sort it out for you... and take Mir's mobile away.

brh: نازو نی پا ارکسان تے ئے انت پاو میرو آن اریف دا نادرا تو عید کننگٹی اسکا
en: Nazo, you tell me, what am I supposed to say to everyone? Ask Mero whether he was celebrating Eid with this Nadra.
en_old: Nazo, you tell me, what should I say to the in-laws? Ask Mir whether this Nadra is going to celebrate Eid.

brh: نی کسک ماما غلامو دستورا شرم فک نی ابا رضیہ خان نی فک خبر فراڑے مروئی او انتالٹی مروئی چپ کرک انتالٹی مروئی تولدڑ گمرک ایرا کسفنگ نندٹی او ئے کاو ماما غلامو دستورا
en: You... died(?) — Uncle Ghulamo, as custom demands... have you no shame? Father, Razia Khan — you have no idea where she might be and what state she might be in. She went silent... what state she might be in... [unclear: sit... lost]... I am set on killing both of them, and I am going to Uncle Ghulamo, as custom demands.
en_old: You killed... Uncle Ghulam, by custom... shame on you, father. Razia Khan, you don't know where she will be or in what state. Be quiet... sit down... after killing... I'm going, Uncle Ghulam, by custom...

brh: آ ہا ہا، دیر انگ؟ ابا کالج آ، ہنے سے تا کالج آ۔
en: Ah-ha-ha, who (went)? — Father, to college; she has gone to her college.
en_old: Ah ha ha, who's there? Father, to college, she went to her college.

brh: ئے ضرورت اف کالج ہننگ نا، ئے زیانہ خوانفنگ باز بس، ابا کنا پیپر آکو کنے تیاری کروئی ئے ارے پارٹ نا کالج ہننگ نا ضرورت اف، نی ہم خوانوس پگا ٹیچر ئس جوڑ مروس نا، ولدا ہرا ایلوک ہنوس نرس ہنوس
en: There's no need to go to college; enough of all this schooling. — Father, my papers are coming, I have to prepare for them. — There's no need [for any of this] going to college. You'll study too and tomorrow become a teacher, won't you, and then the other one will go off — go and become a nurse.
en_old: There's no need to go to college; you've studied more than enough. Father, I have to prepare for my papers. There's no need to go to college, part... You'll study too and become a teacher tomorrow, and then the other one will go and become a nurse.

brh: انک انک ہمو ہراٹی کمرہ ٹی بس ہنو ٹیچر جوڑ مریرہ کنکے سنبھالتا رتا
en: Now, now — those who just stay in a room go off and become teachers... looking after me...
en_old: Enough, enough, those who sit in a room become teachers... look after me.

brh: فریدہ کنا چنا چپ کر تینے پریشان کپہ داسہ اوغین
en: Farida, my child, hush, don't upset yourself; now don't cry.
en_old: Farida, my child, be quiet, don't worry yourself now.

brh: ئے ہندا نا مقدر جوڑ مس۔ اماں داسہ کنے امتحاناک مننگٹی او۔ ئے داخس خواناٹ ابا کنے داسہ خواننگ کے الپک۔ فریدہ فریدہ ئے انت کیو۔
en: So this is what her fate has come to. — Mother, my exams are happening now. I studied so much, and now Father won't let me study. — Farida, Farida, what can I do?
en_old: This became her fate. Mother, my exams are happening now. I studied so much, and now father doesn't let me study. Farida, Farida, what should I do?

brh: او دے او دے کنا عید ہم بد بریک اماں بروکا سال کنا پورا تعلیم ضائع مریکک ئے داخس خواناٹ کنا تعلیم پورا ضائع مس اماں نی ابائے پانے اللہ نا
en: Oh, that day, that day — even my Eid turns bitter, Mother. Next year my whole education will go to waste. I studied so much, and my education has been completely wasted. Mother, you tell Father, for God's sake.
en_old: That day, that day my Eid was ruined too, mother. Next year my whole education will be wasted. I studied so much, and my education was completely wasted. Mother, please tell father, for God's sake.

brh: انت کے وی؟ انت کے وی؟ اینگا کنے روزیانہ پریشانی گٹانے۔ دنگا نی اینگا شہر بانو میرو خاخر لگے فنگر تے۔ انت کے وی؟
en: What do I do? What do I do? Like this, worry has been pressing on me every single day. And now you, likewise... Shahr Bano, Miro... [unclear: fire has caught... fingers]... What do I do?
en_old: What will happen? What will happen? Here I face worry every day. And now here Shahr Bano, Miro... fingers... What will happen?

brh: اینا مونا دوتا فبے نی گنگے گڑاس کا کنے سمائی نی مجبور اوس ولے کنا نی نیلاوے چا
en: In front of him... [unclear]... you stand there mute — do something! I know you are helpless, but you... mine... [unclear].
en_old: In front of him you... something. I understand you were helpless, but you didn't let go of me...

brh: کنا سبق کنا چنا ئے تینٹ بے وس اٹ اینا کن ہچ کننگ کپرہ
en: My studies... My child, I myself am helpless; I can't do anything about this.
en_old: My lesson... my child... we ourselves are helpless, we can't do anything for him.

brh: برہ با نی داڑے تولوکوس نی دنیا نا سد اف میر عباس کیرے باز غصہ
en: Come on, you're sitting here — you have no idea what's going on in the world. Mir Abbas is very angry.
en_old: Come on, you're sitting here, you have no idea what's going on in the world. Mir Abbas is very angry.

brh: دے تے مخلوق شغان خلکونے دے کینا، خومنا مسڑ شاہ جہان تون نرانے۔ اوڑا ئے ہمک او، کنا تو دماغ ہچ کاریم کننگٹی اف۔ ڈی عباس کیرے، ماما نبی بخشے، غلام احمدے، پگا غائبے نی
en: People have been taunting us day after day. Your daughter has run off with Shah Jahan. And there... [unclear]... my mind isn't working at all. (Mir) Abbas is [...], Uncle Nabi Bakhsh, Ghulam Ahmed... and you've been missing since morning.
en_old: These days people have disgraced us. Today the girl has run off with Shah Jahan. What is going on with him? My mind isn't working at all. D. Abbas is angry, uncle Nabi Bakhsh, Ghulam Ahmed... and where have you disappeared to?

brh: بس غگ کیرے سر کبوتے نن تینٹ میر اینگٹ ایسن معلوم مرے کہ حقیقت انتئے یار حقیقت صاف ظاہر ئے ہتو مگ نہ رانو ہرا تم کہ دا مسئلہ مسنے شاہ جہان خننگ پک
en: Just [call them] and bring them over; we ourselves, Mir, will [see], so it becomes known what the truth is. — Man, the truth is plain to see... [unclear]... ever since this trouble happened, Shah Jahan is nowhere to be seen.
en_old: Just stay quiet, let them arrive. Mir, we ourselves will see what the truth is. Friend, the truth is plain to see... ever since this problem happened, Shah Jahan is nowhere to be seen.

brh: ہر کنڈ آ پٹ آ تیار خننگک اٹی او بابے واہ رے واہ نی کنا کس ئس یا او کنا کے برے پائے نی کہ میرو بر ئے دادٹ کنے ال بس پگہ سرکبو تینے
en: They're ready to search every corner; they are looking. Oh father, wow, oh wow! Are you someone of mine, or... will he come for me? You say that Miro should come... me... enough... tomorrow, get yourselves here.
en_old: Preparations can be seen everywhere... oh father, wow, wow, are you someone of mine, or... will you say that Miro... came to me... get yourself here tomorrow.

brh: ایدا سگریٹ کشی وا کاوا مو سگریٹ کشی با سگریٹ کنے تے بس نین آک سر کتے نی دا دوانو معاملہ صفان تولو گزرختاتے کنے بس سگریٹ کشیسے
en: Here, a smoke... I'm going... a smoke — come on, give me a cigarette. Just... you settle this matter of the two of them cleanly... sit... let it pass... just let me have a cigarette.
en_old: Here, smoking... a cigarette... just give me a cigarette... settle these two matters cleanly, sit down and let it pass... just give me a cigarette.

brh: دا دے پارے دکہ نہ زیا دکہ، بس میر ہننگ ننا ضرورت ئے اوڑے ننا تو بتی ڈنڈورہ مرو، ابا انتس کہ مس مس۔
en: Today he said: grief, no — more than grief. — Just, Mir, we need to go; otherwise there will be a public scandal about us. — Father, whatever happened has happened.
en_old: That day they said, no more grief, no more grief. Just, Mir, we need to go. Otherwise it will be broadcast everywhere about us. Father, whatever happened has happened.

brh: ہر کاری مے میر کروئی اوفتے کلے پٹوئے اتوئے، ادا، میرئے اننگ نا ضرورت اف، وڑے پتر مخلوق نمونے ننے افوئے بے عزت کروئی ادا
en: Whatever has to be done, Mir must do it: all of them must be searched out and brought here, brother. There's no need for Mir to go himself; otherwise people will dishonor us, brother.
en_old: Whatever Mir has to do, he should search for all of them and bring them here. Mir doesn't need to go himself. Otherwise people will dishonor us here.

brh: ئے سلیم پارم مونی دا مارکو پارٹی غا کائک تو کائک، ایڑے جوانی تا احوال ایتک تا بس۔
en: I told Salim: from now on, if this lad goes to the party, let him go; there he only passes on good news to them.
en_old: Salim, I said, if this Marko party comes next, let it come. It only brings news of good things here.

brh: صاحب، صاحب جان، بس کنا۔ توار کتے؟
en: Sir, Sahib Jan, ... Did you call (for me)?
en_old: Sir, dear sir, that's enough from me. Did you call?

brh: السلام علیکم پیر۔ وعلیکم السلام بخیر و۔ السلام علیکم پیر صاحب۔ وعلیکم السلام۔
en: Peace be upon you, Pir. — And upon you be peace, welcome. — Peace be upon you, Pir Sahib. — And upon you be peace.
en_old: Peace be upon you, Pir. And peace be upon you, welcome. Peace be upon you, Pir Sahib. And peace be upon you.

brh: میر صاحب دا پکاری کیدے دا وار سفر نا واری
en: Mir Sahib, this... and this time's journey — [how did it go]?
en_old: Mir Sahib, make this call. This time it's the journey's turn.

brh: دا وار نا سفر باز بہترین گدرینگا۔ میر صاحب ئے وخت ئس نی تونو یاد کریٹہ میرو نا بارہ ٹی۔ دادے میر احمد۔ اچھا تو دادے میرو۔ ارے میرو ئے پنگنور کنا؟
en: This time's journey went very well. Mir Sahib, at one time I used to mention Miro to you. This is Mir Ahmed. — Oh, so this is Miro. Hey Miro, do you recognize me?
en_old: This week's trip went very well. Mir Sahib, you once mentioned Miro to me. This is Mir Ahmed. Oh, so this is Miro. Hey Miro, do you recognize me?

brh: ایستار نا رانی۔ نپ سن نا ریتنی اغوا مسو۔ دیر اغوا کرے؟ شاہ جان۔ محمد امین نا مار۔ ئے بنگٹ کہ نا ایستار ٹیچر اسس اسکے۔ جی او۔ دا سہی ئے
en: (My) sister(?) Rani... [unclear]... was kidnapped. — Who kidnapped her? — Shah Jan, Muhammad Amin's son. — I heard that your sister(?) was a teacher. — Yes. — That's right.
en_old: The older sister, Rani... was kidnapped. Who kidnapped her? Shah Jan, son of Muhammad Amin. I heard that your sister was a teacher. Yes. That's right.

brh: ئے کہ او تینٹ نرا نی خیر ئے تینٹ او خواجہ غاتے ہورے وی ہیلو مرزا صاحب نینو ناشتہ
en: ...that she ran off herself. Well, fine — she herself looked to the gentlemen... Hello, Mirza Sahib, (your) breakfast.
en_old: ...that he himself ran away, it's fine, he himself looked after the masters... Hello Mirza Sahib, your breakfast.

brh: دا ہما مریاد کرے صیب واہ امین واہ مخلوق نا توغاتی پرفینورے اور جن نا ناشتہ کننگٹی او صیب ئے صیب ئے ہما متم کو متم
en: That's exactly what he remembered(?), sir. Well done, Amin, well done! ... among people... [unclear]... and they're having breakfast. Sir, sir, that very... [unclear].
en_old: That's what he did, sir. Wow, Amin, wow... in front of people... and while eating breakfast... sir, sir...

brh: ہمین ئے ارادے نا تئیٹی شاہجہان و رضیہ نا خواب ء ارادہ اسہ خاندان سے نا مسئلہ تو اف دا اسہ قوم سے نا مسئلہ ء یاد تخیس ہمین
en: Amin, at the root of this intention lies Shahjahan and Razia's dream; the intention... This isn't one family's problem; this is a whole tribe's problem. Remember that, Amin.
en_old: This is the very intention... Shahjahan and Razia's dream and intention. This isn't a problem of one family, it's the problem of a whole nation. Remember that.

brh: شاہ جان شاہ جان رڑ کے خیر تو رے نی دا خا پریشان مسس ہاؤ
en: Shah Jan, Shah Jan, ... is everything alright? You've become so worried, eh?
en_old: Shah Jan, Shah Jan, let it go, alright? Why have you become so worried?

brh: خیر شاہ جان بس بچو نی ہمت کر تینا بیگ تیار کر نی داڑے مروئی اف خیر ابا ہن مس نی خیر یلہ کرک ہنتس کہ پاو نی ہموڑ کرنی ابا رضیہ خنک پک
en: Alright, Shah Jan, just, son, be brave, get your bag ready; you must not stay here. — Alright, Father... go... — Well, leave it; whatever I say, you do just that. — Father, Razia is nowhere to be seen.
en_old: Alright Shah Jan, just get away. Be brave, pack your bag. You must not stay here. Alright father, go... leave it, they went... tell them you did it that way... father, Razia will see.

brh: او تاتہ غستنا ضرورت دے ہمودے نی کنے لیتوس، ادا سیننگا پرے، نی کاوت سیدھا تاتہ غستیا، ٹھیک گنو گوس دماغ نا خراب مسونی، اینا کسفنگ نا رندٹی او، نی بس کاوت تاتہ غستنا وراغا، پپا نی کاوت تاتہ غستیا
en: The day there was need of (going to) Aunt [Ghust?], that very day you left me(?)... brother, [unclear]... you went straight to Aunt [Ghust?]. Fine — are you crazy? Has your mind gone bad? They're bent on killing him, and you just went off to Aunt [Ghust?]'s house. Papa, you went straight to Aunt [Ghust?].
en_old: Oh, the day he needed to be tied up, that day you took me... she says this... you went straight to tie him up. Fine, have you gone mad? Have you lost your mind? In the matter of his killing, you just went straight to tie him up. Papa, you went straight to tie him up.

brh: انداخس تے پاو کے کنا ایچ قصورس اف ئے بے قصور اٹ انداخس کے رضیہ اوفتے کنے کمک کے انداخس ہی نی ابا اینو مصیبت اٹ ایو ئے اوفتا مدد کے کاوہ ستان پنی وٹیسو نی اوفتا مدد کے کا
en: Just tell them this much: that I'm not at fault at all; I am innocent. Just do this much, Razia: get them to help me. — Just this... Father is in trouble today; I'm going to help them... [unclear]... you go and help them.
en_old: Tell them again and again that I am not at fault at all, I am innocent. Razia, make them help me. Father, today I am in great trouble, help them... help them.

brh: آخری انت کرینوٹ؟ نیکنے! انکا نی پاسے کہ ئے انت کرینوٹ؟ مچو چوراٹی خاخر لگیفیس، انکا پاسے کہ ئے انت کرینوٹ؟
en: After all, what have I done? — You're asking me?! And now you say 'what have I done'? You have set the whole place on fire, and now you say 'what have I done'?
en_old: What did I do in the end? Me? Now you're saying what did I do? You disgraced the whole village, and now you're saying what did I do?

brh: ہزار آ قصہ غاک جوڑ مریرہ اما ئے امر کین دا مخلوق نا خوشی ٹی
en: A thousand stories are being made up, Mother — how are we supposed to take part in these people's happiness?
en_old: A thousand stories get made, but how do we fit into the happiness of these people?

brh: کنا استے ٹپی کیرہ، انت لگے دا کنا لاشہ لاچ کننگٹی او۔
en: They are wounding my heart. What is this — it's as if they are busy disgracing my dead body.
en_old: They wound my heart. What does it matter, they're busy burning my body.

brh: وناک دوکو برزا کبو دعاس کین۔ ہاؤ سر۔ الحمدللہ۔ یا اللہ عافیت فرما۔
en: Raise your hands, let's say a prayer. — Yes, sir. — Praise be to God. O God, grant us well-being.
en_old: Raise your hands, let's pray. Yes, sir. Praise be to God. O God, grant us well-being.

brh: صلی اللہ تعالی علی خیر خلقہ اجمعین برحمتک یا ارحم الراحمین۔ مبارک خیر مبارک خیر مبارک خیر مبارک بادشاہ صاحب مبارک خیر مبارک اللہ خوش کے اللہ خوش کے
en: May God Most High bless the best of His creation, all of them, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful. Congratulations! — Blessings to you too! Congratulations — blessings! Congratulations, Badshah Sahib! Congratulations — blessings! Congratulations! May God keep you happy, may God keep you happy.
en_old: May God Almighty send blessings upon the best of His creation, all of them, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful. Congratulations, congratulations, congratulations! Congratulations, Badshah Sahib! Congratulations, may God make you happy, may God make you happy.

brh: ماما ماما، انمس، پولیس والاک بسنو، پولیس والاک بسنو، انت سے کن؟
en: Uncle, uncle! — What happened? — The police have come, the police have come! — What for?
en_old: Mama, mama, my brother, the police have come, the police have come! What for?

brh: میر احمد خوانے میر احمد پولیس والا خوانے اٹی او ئے زرا سورینتا
en: Mir Ahmed, you're wanted! Mir Ahmed, the policeman is calling for you. ... just a moment ...
en_old: Mir Ahmed is calling. Mir Ahmed, the policeman is calling. He got a little angry in there.

brh: سلام علیکم۔ سلام علیکم۔
en: Peace be upon you. Peace be upon you.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Assalamu alaikum.

brh: اوئے لو بس داسہ صبر کر دا بے وس نا انت قصور ئے انتئے تینے دا سدو اندو عذاب کیرے داڑان زیات عذاب پین انت بروئے کماش تے لمبہ کنے تباہ کریسے
en: Hey, well, that's enough now, be patient. What is this helpless one's fault? Why are you tormenting yourself so much like this? What other torment could come that is worse than this? In my old age you have set me ablaze and ruined me.
en_old: Hey, that's enough now, be patient. What is this helpless one's fault? Why are you tormenting yourself like this? What torment could be worse than this? The elders have pushed me down and ruined me.

brh: سلام خیریت خیریت طبیعت ٹھیک مہربانی ایس ایچ او صاحب خیر اٹ نم مرے خواجہ پیری موٹر سائیکل نا دزی نا کیس اٹی موٹر سائیکل نا مالک ہرا بندغ تون اوار
en: Salaam. All well? All well. Are you in good health? — Thank you. SHO Sahib, I hope all is well with you. — Sir, in the motorcycle theft case, the owner of the motorcycle, along with the person who ...
en_old: Hello. Are you well? I'm fine, thank you. SHO Sahib, I hope you're well. Khawaja Peeri, in the motorcycle theft case, the motorcycle's owner, together with the person who...

brh: میرو نا پنی ہم تسنے موٹرسائیکل نا دزی میرو ایس ایچ او صاحب اینو اونا سانگ ء مہربانی کبو اینو الے بوتا
en: He has also given Mero's name — the motorcycle theft, Mero. — SHO Sahib, today is his engagement; please, let him off today.
en_old: He has also given Mero's name. The motorcycle theft, Mero. SHO Sahib, today is his engagement, please be kind, don't take him today.

brh: او گودی ئے تینٹ اٹی او۔ غلام صاحب نن دافتے مجبور آن ننے اودے گرفتار کروئی ء۔ ٹھیک ء۔ ہیا کبو۔
en: He himself is involved in it, lady. Ghulam Sahib, we are helpless in this; we have to arrest him. — All right. — Come on, go ahead.
en_old: The woman is in her own house. Ghulam Sahib, we are helpless here, we have to arrest him. All right. Go ahead.

brh: دشمن پولیس والا دبارو یاد ایتے کسے بیخام پرائم
en: Remind the enemy, the policeman, once again ... someone ... a message.
en_old: The enemy policeman, remember again, send someone a message.

brh: قاضی صاحب او قاضی دا کبوتر دا ڈیکھ
en: Qazi Sahib, oh Qazi, this pigeon — look at this.
en_old: Qazi Sahib, oh Qazi, look at this pigeon.

brh: خان، باز وخت آن انتظار اسکا۔
en: Khan, I have been waiting for a long time.
en_old: Khan, I've been waiting for a long time.

brh: ہر زبان ء دا ہیت ء کہ دا مسڑ ء دما ایلو نا مار تون مسڑ ء تینٹ درفک دا نا دما دا نا
en: It's on everyone's tongue: that this girl ... with someone else's son ... the girl herself ... this one's ..., this one's ...
en_old: Every language has this saying: this girl, ... someone else's son, the girl holds on herself, ... his/hers ...

brh: انکس؟ داسہ ارانگینا؟ آخر او امر اینا داکا؟ بچا، ئے دروازہ ملٹ، او خن توکا۔
en: What? Where did she go now? How on earth did she get out of here? Son, I opened the door, and she was nowhere to be seen.
en_old: What? Where is she now? How on earth did she get out of here? Son, I opened the door and her eyes were closed.

brh: اچانک کاتم اٹ کنا کڑاس خلک، خلک نا کاریم بس، ئے تماٹ۔
en: Suddenly something struck me on the head — it hit, and that was it, I fell.
en_old: Suddenly something hit me on the head, the blow did its work, and I fell.

brh: ہیلو، غازیان نرا، داتوننگے باز بلو مصیبت سے جوڑ مس
en: Hello — she has run away; this has brought a very big calamity upon us.
en_old: Hello, she has run away from Ghazi; this has turned into a very big problem.

brh: دا گوئے تے نا مخلوق آ سرمس تو نن کے باز بھلو عذاب ئس جوڑ مروئی سائیں اینو جواب ایتون سائیں ننا زند ء لپ مروئی زو ئے سر کڈینے
en: If this news reaches the people, a very great torment will come upon us, sir. Today we will have to give an answer, sir; our life will be ruined. Hurry, find her.
en_old: If this news reaches the people, it will be a huge torment for us, sir. Give an answer today, sir, our lives will be ruined. Find her quickly.

brh: رضیہ! رضیہ! رضیہ! دے وان مس؟ مالو ایتو خنا کدہ سے با۔
en: Razia! Razia! Razia! — Has she gone crazy? ... Did she see something?
en_old: Razia! Razia! Razia! Where did she go? Hey, did you see her anywhere?

brh: نا واری نا کنا رضیہ نا رد تنے کنا رضیہ نا رد تنے رضیہ مصیبت اسے ٹی گڑاس کبو اما انت مسنے انت
en: ... bring me some trace of my Razia, bring me some trace of my Razia! Razia is in some trouble — do something! — Mother, what has happened? What?
en_old: Who... give me news of my Razia, give me news of my Razia. Razia is in trouble, do something. Mother, what has happened, what?

brh: انٹیک ہینجیر فلکوس ئے تو ہٹی خناٹ رضیہ رضیہ جنگل اسیٹی نری نگٹی کنا رضیہ مصیبت اسیٹی کنا رضیہ نری تنے
en: ... I saw in a dream: Razia, Razia was running in a jungle. My Razia is in trouble, my Razia is running away.
en_old: ...I saw it in the shop. Razia, Razia ran into a jungle. My Razia is in trouble, my Razia has run away.

brh: گڈاسکو فریدہ اما ایتنے دیر اسے آرام کنے
en: Then, Farida, let Mother rest for a while.
en_old: Let it go, Farida. Mother, let her rest for a while.

brh: دروئے نی دروئے نی یلکہ یلکہ یلکہ دنوکو مہمانی توم چپ آرام اٹ داڑے بے غیرت آ چمبڑ چولنگ انجوانے کے اوفتے کسوئی آتینے
en: You're lying, you're lying! Let go, let go, let go! ... Be quiet and rest here calmly. The shameless ones ... it's not good; I'll have to kill them myself.
en_old: You liar, you liar! Leave it, leave it, leave it. Such a guest... be quiet and rest here calmly. Shameless, wandering around is not good. I will have to kill them myself.

brh: او مار بر داڑے توسہ، خدا نا پناٹ اولان مصیبت آک نن کے تخوکو پین مصیبت بش کپہ۔ داڑان زیات مصیبت انت ماروئے ابا؟ بازار اٹ تینا مون نشان تننگ کپنہ۔ ہر زبان آ دا ہیت ئے کہ میرون نا دستار نا رائنہ۔ مخلوق نا باموٹے بد مروک ء نن غڑاس کرون۔
en: Oh son, come here and sit down. For God's sake, troubles are already on us; don't stir up more trouble. — What trouble could be greater than this, father? We can't show our faces in the bazaar. It's on everyone's tongue — the turban of the Mirs ... Our name is going bad in people's mouths; we'll have to do something.
en_old: Oh, don't bring that name here. For God's sake, we already have troubles; don't bring us more. What trouble could be greater than this, father? We can't show our faces in the bazaar. Everyone is saying that the Mir family's turban has been disgraced. We have done something that has ruined our honor before the people.

brh: او کنا خننگ جوان چانے ہسیکا او خننگے کیراڑے ڈکانو تنے آرامٹ
en: He knows full well ... he knows where they have hidden her away, comfortably.
en_old: Oh, she went to see my... where did she see her? She is hidden away, resting comfortably.

brh: ہبک، تانی ہن پاننگٹی ئس ہیچ، ہیچ پومنگٹی افٹ، پو متویس ئے ننے بیوقوف سمجھنگٹی ئس نی، ہا، دا خلکٹی ہر جاگہ دا مشہور ئے کہ نی
en: Well! Until now you kept saying 'Nothing, I don't understand anything.' You didn't understand? You were taking us for fools, you. Yes, it's well known everywhere in this village that you ...
en_old: Come on, until now you kept saying nothing, nothing, I don't understand. You didn't understand? You thought we were fools. Yes, it's known everywhere in this town that you...

brh: او رضیہ نرانوری اماں اماں دا دا امر مننگ کیک او رضیہ نرانوری اماں او رضیہ
en: Oh, Razia has run away! Mother, mother, how can this happen? Oh, Razia has run away! Mother — oh, Razia!
en_old: Oh, Razia has run away! Mother, mother, how can this happen? Razia has run away! Mother, oh Razia!

brh: ئے ہفتہ ئس مرے کہ رضیہ او خننگٹی اف ارا غا تینا پیشانی نانے ئے داسہ کاوہ ماما سے خبردار خبردار شاہ جہان کہ نہ تینا پیش تریسک نہ تینا پٹیوے اینا کسفنگ نا رندٹ یو
en: It must be a week now that Razia hasn't been seen ... her own forehead ... I'm going now, uncle. Beware, beware, Shah Jahan, that neither your ... nor your ... after killing her ...
en_old: It's been a week that Razia hasn't been seen... the shame is on my forehead. Now I'm going, uncle. Beware, beware, Shah Jahan, neither your... after killing her...

brh: داسہ کہ او زندے الر کریو افتے متکیس نا؟ نہ نہ نہ، نہ بیٹا، تو مفک۔ داسہ کرے نی تینا سامان مامان ئے پیک کرک، نی داڑے مروئی افک، نی پی جاگے سے ہنوئی ئے ہمت کر، ہمت کر۔ او کنا مار، زو کر۔
en: Now, will they leave him alive — won't they [come after] them? No, no, no — no, son, that won't happen. Now go on, pack up your things and stuff; you mustn't stay here, you have to go somewhere else. Be brave, be brave. Oh my son, hurry.
en_old: Now that he has ruined his life, won't they leave him alone? No, no, no, no son, that won't happen. Now pack your things. You must not stay here, you have to go somewhere else. Be brave, be brave. Oh my son, hurry up.

brh: اینہ کہ! ایلم، غلام محمد، دا میر عباس، محمد امین نا کلف راہی کرینے، کہ رضیہ و شاہ جہان ہراڑے کیرے؟
en: Listen! Brother Ghulam Muhammad, this Mir Abbas has sent Muhammad Amin's [men], [asking] where Razia and Shah Jahan are.
en_old: What is this! Brother, Ghulam Muhammad, this Mir Abbas has sent Muhammad Amin's men, asking where Razia and Shah Jahan are.

brh: اوفتے ننا حوالہ کبو۔ متو۔ اینا بندغاتے تن داڑے! زو بر! اول تو سما تمے کہ اوڑ تونے ادے دم کیرائیکے۔ دسکا نہ سما اف۔
en: Hand them over to us. No. Bring those men here! Come, quick! First of all you'll find out what they're doing with him... So far I have no idea.
en_old: Hand them over to us. Don't... Bring those people here! Hurry, come! First of all, you'll find out how they deal with you. I don't know yet.

brh: او چمکی رائی کنیٹ او ئیلوم او چاچاڑٹی دا اچ چر رینگنگٹی ئے کرسی او شاہ جان نا روانو اوفت نا رپنگٹی جن نا تلوم ایڑ نا دوی ئے مسڑ پنتان تمس بے مرادہ شوم نادرہ نادرہ کاسی
en: O ... [garbled] ... O brother, in this riddle, in this wandering about ..., oh, Shah Jan's going away, in their ..., the woman's ..., the sister's ..., the daughter fell from [good counsel?] ... luckless, ill-fated Nadira, Nadira, you are going.
en_old: He... I eat... brother... in this walking around... Shah Jan's going... in their running... he became a girl... unlucky evening, Nadira, Nadira...

brh: دے تا کرینے، تروائے، غلام مرت، تروائے، غلام مرت، ادا تروائے نی کرینے، ہندا مننگ تروائے پدا، دا ہندا مرگ جوانی
en: ... has done it ..., [oh], Ghulam Murad, [oh], Ghulam Murad, brother, you have done this; this happening again ... this very death is better.
en_old: He has done it for days... brother, Ghulam Murad, brother, Ghulam Murad, this brother, you have done it... this is how it is, brother, again... this death is better.

brh: یکا تینا چدینگنگٹی نرینہ نمہ نرینہ نرینہ نرینہ نا امبار مکھا کھڑوئی بس خدا جائی
en: Alone in his own ..., like a man, a man, a man, a man ... standing ... only God knows.
en_old: Alone in his... like a man, a man, a man... standing... only God knows.

brh: ئے ئے ہچ کتنوت، ئے بے قصورٹ۔ دادے مر کا، دادے کنا مونا مر کا، کنے دنا شک نم بت برے، ارے، صبر، او کنا ایلم، صبر، بیڑی بس۔
en: I, I haven't done anything, I am innocent. Take him away, take him away from in front of me. You suspect me like this ... hey, patience, oh my brother, patience, that's enough.
en_old: I didn't do anything, I'm innocent. Take him away, take him away from in front of me. I suspect you... come on, hey, patience, oh my brother, patience, that's enough.

brh: داٹی داسہ دا تانپ ختوڑے مخلوق ئے تے ہزار رنگے تے چرفک چرفک ہت رنگین کیتے خدا دا کنا زندے تباہ کرے
en: In this, now, this ... the people, in a thousand ways ... going round and round ... colourful ... God, this has ruined my life.
en_old: Now in this... people... a thousand colors... they turn and turn... God, this has destroyed my life.

brh: برباد کرک کنا زندگی ء، ئے داسا، داسا، ہچ جاگہ نہ رینتنوٹ، ہچ جاگہ نہ رینتنوٹ
en: Ruined my life — I, now, now, have nowhere left, nowhere left.
en_old: You have ruined my life. Now, now, I have nowhere left, I have nowhere left.

brh: پارے سفر نا بھلو بشخ اسے
en: He said it is a big part of the journey.
en_old: He said it is a big part of the journey.

brh: خیر کنے دا وختا بسوس۔ ہما مشل نا جوان کتو۔ اینا رفی انتئے ارا دے شاجان ئس دماغ نا خراب مسنے دنوک مسنس۔ تمام مسڑی بے وسی نا خبر کنے۔
en: Well, you've come to me at this time. That ... did not go well. Why, for two days now, has Shah Jan lost his mind and become like this? All of it is news of helplessness for me.
en_old: Well, you came to me at this time. That matter did not turn out well. Why for the last two days has Shah Jan lost his mind like this? All this news of helplessness for me.

brh: ارنگا کاسدیے تکہ ریکہ چپ کے بایتنا تو شرم بفک نی دا ایتا زو دماغی کنا خراب کریسس گڑا دماغ نا خراب مسن کروسہ اینو گم مر اسکہ تینا ارا والاتا خیالے تخا کنے
en: ... be quiet ... aren't you ashamed? You had wrecked my mind so quickly, then by driving me out of my mind ... get lost today ... at least keep your own household in mind ...
en_old: ...be quiet... aren't you ashamed? You've messed up my mind so much... you've lost your mind... get lost today... keep the thought of your family in mind for me.

brh: ارے واہ نی دے برک ہموسس عارف تینے خیر خواہ والا کنے بارا دندان چک شوک کس کورک او پرک دورک
en: Oh wow! You came that day, Arif, making yourself out to be a well-wisher ... about me ... [garbled: teeth ... fox ... blind ...]
en_old: Oh wow, you came that day, Arif, calling yourself a well-wisher... to me... someone... he goes and runs.

brh: ئے وخت آ دے تپے ری، بلے ترفے ری، داسہ اوغے ری، میر جان نا حالت نونے، کس پی داسہ اسہ گنوک
en: At one time ..., but ..., now [she] weeps ...; Mir Jan's condition is ..., now [he is] someone ... a madman.
en_old: At that time... now... Mir Jan's condition is bad, someone... now a madman.

brh: مرک، دا سدھو ہیتے نا میر عباس نا سرمرز، دسے ننے، ننے اللہ نا آسرا ئے، ننا تو تینا کم ننا دشمن مسر، بیگانہ دنت کے لگور
en: ... this plain talk of Mir Abbas's ... us — we have God's support. Our own people have become our enemies; they seem like strangers.
en_old: Die! This simple matter of Mir Abbas's... tell us. We have God's support. Our own people became our enemies, they look like strangers.

brh: تینا توست دشمن کے ئے تس کیرہ، خنے تو نم ایونم تینا دشمن خیال کیرے، خنے تو دا مست نم نا درے نی او نا وڑ کنے دوست اللہ وسور
en: They make their own friend into an enemy; look, even today you consider ... your enemy; look, this ... you, like him, are a friend to me, by God ...
en_old: They treat your friend as an enemy... you see, you consider yourselves your own enemy... you see... you are like a friend to me, God...

brh: اخس کہ ضد کروس تینے نقصان تروک کنے تینا دوست سمجھ تو دا حویلی ٹی وخت نا جوڑ کننگ کن بروک تاکہ کنے خبر متو
en: However much you insist, you will only be harming yourself. Consider me your friend; then you were coming to this mansion to pass the time, so that I wouldn't find out.
en_old: However much you insisted, you would only harm yourself. Consider me your friend, then you would come to this mansion to pass the time, so that I wouldn't find out.

brh: کنے دیر تڑے انتئے قید کرینے؟ کنے آرام بفک۔ کنے ہچ خبر اف۔ کنا کاریم تنخواہ ہلنگ، اونا خیال داری ء۔ پین کنے ہچ خبر اف۔ تڑے ایچو شہر افن۔
en: Who ... why have you locked me up? I can't rest. I don't know anything. My job is to take my salary and look after him. Beyond that I know nothing. We're not in any city here.
en_old: Who are you? Why have you locked me up? I can't rest. I don't know anything. My job is to collect my salary and look after him. I don't know anything else. You're not from this city.

brh: آخا، داڑے مرغ مریسکا، شار اف۔ دا کنا رنگ بسختے، حویلیان پیشن اسے بندغس گاڈ سلوک ئے اسلہ تیتو نا ورچرنگے۔ کنا دشمن دیرے؟
en: No — here ..., it isn't a town. This is my ...; outside the mansion a man is standing guard, walking around with weapons. Who is my enemy?
en_old: Brother, here chickens die, not the city. This is my way... outside the mansion a man is handing out weapons like a gangster. Who is my enemy?

brh: او کنے انتئے داکے ہتکنے؟ آزادی نا امیدء مف۔ ضد کپہ پین ہنت کیو؟ اگواہ نا کیس، پدا تو او غلطو قدم ئس ہرفنے۔
en: Why has he brought me here? Don't hope for freedom. Don't be stubborn — what else will you do? The kidnapping case — then he has taken a wrong step.
en_old: Why has he brought me here? Don't hope for freedom. Stop being stubborn, what else will you do? The witness's case... then he took a wrong step.

brh: پیسہ، تو اینے تینتون دا ویڈیو تے چرنگے الیبو۔ انت غلطو قدم؟ دنو غلطو قدم۔ حقیقت ئے دا نرنگ او آزادی نا کوشش ئے کننگ غلط ئے
en: Money — so let him take these videos around with him. What wrong step? That kind of wrong step. The truth is, this running away and trying to be free is wrong.
en_old: Money... then let him watch these videos himself. What wrong step? That kind of wrong step. Running from the truth and trying to get free is wrong.

brh: تو کنا نی تو وائتائے اینا خاطرن مرینگ نا کوششے کپروٹ انتے کنا نصیب کرے کنا برام نا تیاری ء
en: So I ... for this one's sake I won't try to get away — why has my fate done this? My wedding was being prepared.
en_old: So I didn't try to die for your sake, because my fate prepared my wedding.

brh: او اچانک غائب مسو کنا دشتار او مخلوق انت پاروے او بندغ دیر ئس ہرا کنے داڑے ایس او نا مونٹ آ گوس
en: He suddenly vanished — what will my fiancée and the people say? Who was that man who brought me here and went off ahead of him?
en_old: He suddenly disappeared. What will my fiancée and the people say? Who was the man who brought me here and went in front of him?

brh: ارٹ سوال نا کہ جواب کن تو اف کنے نا رپ جوانی نیرو
en: I don't have the answer to two questions ... [garbled] ...
en_old: I don't have the answer to two questions; my youth...

brh: ئے ننے کیرے مھلہ نا صورت اٹ نی تو حساب اٹ این جوام پوز در سرکتہ کنے آ نینا الت نا خبر ئے بابے ننا خدر پریشانی ٹی ٹکم ئے
en: ... to us ... in the form of ..., by your own reckoning ... I have news of your condition; father, we are in such trouble.
en_old: ...you do it to us, in the neighborhood, by your reckoning... the news of your condition reached me, father, our... is in trouble.

brh: توان کہ دا مسئلہ حل متنے، ہیچ پاننگ کپارہ، مسئلہ حل بریرے، دیر پاس کیرے محمد علی خائفنے، ارے نی تو کاریمے
en: Until this problem is solved, I can't say anything. The problem will be solved — who will ...? Muhammad Ali has gotten scared. Hey, it's your job.
en_old: Until this problem is solved, don't say anything. The problem will be solved. Who will pass it? Muhammad Ali is scared. Yes, it's your job.

brh: بس کرک، گڑاس جیب اٹ نا مرے، بھرک کنا است، پیسہ ہر گڑا غان پینا نی تانکہ ئے شاہ جہان نا لاش ء خنتنوٹ، ہچ پاننگ کپہ رے بابے، نی فکر ک
en: Stop it. Let there be something in the pocket; fill my heart; money is something apart from everything else. Until I have seen Shah Jahan's corpse, don't say anything, father — don't you worry.
en_old: Enough. Whatever is in the pocket... fill my heart. Money comes before everything. Until you see Shah Jahan's corpse, don't say anything, father. Don't worry.

brh: ئے دپہ ہیرو ہر جا نی تو ہواری ئے دپہ اسکے محمد امین ہائے ہائے محمد امین انتس کروئی اوڑ انتس مرے
en: I ... hero, everywhere you are together with ... Muhammad Amin, alas, alas, Muhammad Amin, what is to be done, what will happen to him?
en_old: ...don't say, hero, everywhere you... don't say, Muhammad Amin, oh, oh, Muhammad Amin, what should be done, what will happen?

brh: خیرو جی سائیں غلہ دا ہمبلہ خننگ پسی سائیں خبر اف تو میرو دوپارے کے
en: All right — yes, sir ... to see this ..., sir, I don't know; then Mir ... said ...
en_old: Fine, yes sir... this can't be seen, sir. I don't know, Mir said...

brh: برینے؟ ونے نمبرک چہ خلین، نمبرک ہم بندو۔ محمد امین! اینو پگا بلو قدم افنگا ٹیورے، مخالف نما دیرے۔ صاحب، دا ہیتک شک نا زی آ
en: Has he come? Why don't we dial the numbers? — The numbers are switched off too. Muhammad Amin! These days ... a big step ... Who is your opponent? Sir, these matters rest on suspicion.
en_old: Has he come? Why don't you dial the numbers? The numbers are switched off too. Muhammad Amin! Don't take a big step today or tomorrow. Who is your opponent? Sir, these things are just suspicion.

brh: او تو نما پنی الیرے او پارن نن تون ثبوت ہم ارے اگر ننا پنی الیر تو گڑا ہرا دے او مخلوق ہرا دے او بندغاک اوفتان مجبوری مروئی سما اف ننے
en: Then they'll name you and say, 'We have proof as well.' And if they name us, then who knows on what day those people, on what day those men will be pressured by them; we can't know.
en_old: They'll put your name out there and say they have proof too. If they put our name out, then which day those people... we don't know what they'd be forced to do.

brh: اگا گنے ثبوت مس ننا ہرتو ماتی نی آن خوانہ دا مسئلہ نا باراٹی کنا بندغ آک لگوک او سائیں اگا ثبوت مس توئی تینا مار نا سزا تے نی
en: If I get proof, the two of us will demand it of you. My men are working on this matter, sir. If the proof turns up, then you yourself punish your own son.
en_old: If there is proof... I'll find out from you. My men are working on this matter, sir. If there is proof, then you punish your own son.

brh: انگاٹی نیتو نا وار سلوک اٹ دا کنا وعدہ ء سائیں گڑا کنے اجازت ہوبے جی سر محمد امین ء گدریف
en: In this, I stand with you; this is my promise, sir. Then give me leave. Yes sir, see Muhammad Amin off.
en_old: ...your turn, this is my promise, sir. Then give me permission. Yes sir, let Muhammad Amin go.

brh: خیرو جی پیر صاحب محمد امین ڈیوٹی بننگٹی افک دھاڑ کین
en: Khairo! Yes, Pir Sahib. Muhammad Amin isn't coming in for duty; we'll raid him.
en_old: Fine, Pir sahib. Muhammad Amin isn't coming to duty, we'll throw him out.

brh: پین کسر ئس کشوئی تمک۔ سئی نمے حکم کبو۔ ننا حاضر و۔ نین دون کرک اول میرو اور میرو نا ایلم ئے حاضر کر۔ ہم شاہ جہان ئے
en: Another way will have to be found. Right, you give the order; we're ready. Now do this: first bring Miro and Miro's brother here. And Shah Jahan too.
en_old: We have to find another way. Okay, give your order. We're ready. Now do this: first bring Mir and Mir's brother here. Shah Jahan too.

brh: بٹبو جوان لٹ ات بوتے حاجی محمد امین ہم سورے نن حاضر آن دا دے پارے ڈک لٹ ڈک
en: Beat him properly with a stick! Haji Muhammad Amin too... We're here, ready. He said this today: hide the stick, hide it!
en_old: Tie them up, beat them good... Haji Muhammad Amin too... we're here. That day he said, beat them, beat them.

brh: او اللہ ہاں او جھمبل لڈو علی صاب علی صاب ایتے احوالی انت احوالی تیو نی ابا خیر جان انت دا پاریکہ نمے
en: Oh God, yes. Oh ... [unclear] ... Ali Sahib, Ali Sahib, tell us the news! What news would you give? Dear, is all well, dear? What is this he has been telling you?
en_old: Oh God, yes, oh Jhambal, Laddo, Ali Sahib, Ali Sahib, give the news, what news, you give it, father, is everything well, dear, what did this one say to you?

brh: انتئے بتویرے؟ ماما دمی نا اسکول لشکر بسوسو، نم بتویرو۔ ہندا پارے کہ میر تمے آ باز غصہ ایٹ کسے۔ پدا پا ماما غلام احمد ہم تو بفک۔ ئے غلام احمد اٹ۔
en: Why didn't you come? Uncle, troops had come to Dami's school, and you didn't come. He said this: that Mir is very angry with you. Then, uncle, Ghulam Ahmed isn't coming either. I'm Ghulam Ahmed!
en_old: Why have you come? Uncle, the army came to Dami's school, you came. He said that Mir is very angry with you. Then, uncle, Ghulam Ahmed isn't coming either. It's Ghulam Ahmed.

brh: ایٹ سے آ بنے بیچارہ بیمار ئے ہنانے چھوڑانے بازنگا پریشانی چٹ فیرتے نمائی تا تئی بنگوٹ خطرہ نا تو ایتا صف ابس کٹ تے پورہ خجر
en: ... the poor thing is sick; he has gone and left. There is a lot of worry, all scattered... I heard [there is] danger to you... [the rest is unclear].
en_old: The poor thing is sick, he has been left behind, there is a lot of worry, all of them... there is danger in your... complete...

brh: کنے نائٹ ئس غٹ رے نا وانڈھیٹ ئس مستوار کرینتا، پکی کھسپتا، بیرا حوال کیہ حوال کرینتا، نہ دا مسڑ غلام احمد نائے، او ولتہ کم پکا ناماک نیامٹی خوارو۔
en: One night, all of them... in a ... they made [it] firm; ... they only gave the news, they told them: 'No, this girl is Ghulam Ahmed's.' And ... [we'll] be disgraced among ...
en_old: I had a night of... in the wasteland, they made it firm, they cooked and ate, the waiter gave the news, they gave the news, this is not Ghulam Ahmed's daughter, and they are crying among the half-cooked names.

brh: ئے مٹی خوارو او خراب مار نا لومے تدبیر مسنے مسئلہ دا مسئلہ جرے مچا خوتنائی واہ میر صاحب واہ دادے پارے دکھ نزیات
en: ... disgraced, and the bad son's mother(?) ... A scheme has come about; the problem, this problem ... all ... Bravo, Mir Sahib, bravo! He said this ... grief ...
en_old: ...they are crying in the soil, and the bad son's mother... a plan has been made, the problem, this problem... all of it, wow Mir Sahib, wow, he said this, more sorrow.

brh: دک میرو جی سر ئے دے پارے رے کہ نن برینے ئے محمد امین ء خوائفٹ نمے رنگ مسرے جی سر ارا ئے تے مسخرہ سمجھے رے
en: [unclear] Miro. Yes sir. That day he said, hey, that 'we'll come' ... I called Muhammad Amin. You've become like this. Yes sir, who do you take for a fool?
en_old: Look, Miro, yes sir, he said that day that we have come, I want Muhammad Amin, you have become like this, yes sir, he has taken them for a joke.

brh: براہیتھو، جی پیر صاحب، پین پوسکون موسکون حال احوال ئس پیر صاحب بس بندغ تا گپ او، بس بند کبو دا غوازی ء، کمبو
en: [unclear] Yes, Pir Sahib. Any other new news, Pir Sahib? It's just people's talk. Just stop this game, enough!
en_old: Brahui-tho, yes Pir Sahib, any other new news, Pir Sahib, it's just people's talk, just stop this fighting, stop it.

brh: دا ہرا توار باریدے کہ بندغ آتے نا مونا تے میرو عید کیرو ولے نی نہ دا دنیا نا اوس نہ ئے دنیا نا اوس گندہ سفت
en: What sort of talk is this, that in front of people, Miro, [you] will celebrate Eid? But you are neither of this world nor of the next, you foul-natured one!
en_old: This is the Sunday they say people celebrate Eid in front of you, Miro, but you are neither of this world nor of that world, filthy...

brh: ارے ایلبو چنا دے
en: Hey, leave the child alone!
en_old: Hey, leave the child alone.

brh: او رے میرو بابے کس سے تو عید کپیس ہندن سمجھے کہ نی اچ سماعت
en: Oh hey, Miro, old man, don't celebrate Eid with anyone; act as if you know nothing at all.
en_old: Oh Miro, father, if someone doesn't celebrate Eid, don't think like that, that you... hearing.

brh: میر دادا جی خلکور تو اینا رے یار، ولے دادے تین تو وار انت دے تواس یار۔ پیرو بابے، ہا بابے، دا کیرے میر نا حکم ئے
en: Mir, grandfather, they beat [him] today, hey friend, but this ... what day was it, friend [unclear]. Piro, father! Yes, father. Carry this out: it's Mir's order.
en_old: Mir, grandfather, they hit him, yes friend, but how many times, what day was it, friend. Piro father, yes father, he is doing what Mir orders.

brh: ہنت کہ او پارے ہندن مریک۔ سلام ئے بابے میر۔
en: Whatever he says, that's how it will be. Greetings, Father Mir.
en_old: Whatever he said, it will be so. Greetings, father Mir.

brh: دا دے خواری دکہ نا زیا، دکہ
en: Today it's misery on top of grief, grief.
en_old: Today is misery, more than sorrow, sorrow.

brh: کنا مٹ، داسہ نا طبع مرے اما جان۔
en: My dear, how are you feeling now? Mother dear.
en_old: My friend, may you be well now, dear mother.

brh: آخر او دیر اسو، انتئے خنکور؟ خبر اف ابا، ئے درست کتوٹ، ئے پارک اٹ تولوک اسوٹ، منا بندغ گاڑی آن دڑنگار، او کنے خلکور۔
en: Who on earth were they? Why did they beat you? I don't know, father. I didn't do anything; I was sitting in the park, some men got out of a car and they beat me.
en_old: After all, who were they, why did they hit you? I don't know, father, I didn't do anything, I was sitting in the park, some people got out of a car and they hit me.

brh: ننا دشمنی تو کسے تو افک ولے کنے میر عباس نا زی آ شک بریک۔ آخر ونت کے ننا رند اٹ تمانو؟ دا سودی
en: We have no enmity with anyone, but I suspect Mir Abbas. After all, why have they come after us? This ... [unclear].
en_old: We don't have enmity with anyone, but I suspect Mir Abbas. After all, why would they come after us? This...

brh: او کڑسنگی مٹ کے او نا توبہ سیکی دا اسہ نن شاہ جہان نی دا کمرہ درو ہتمک نہ ببا ئے جگیئم پرہ ئے ہندارے نم تو تلوئے پنی اماں دون تنہائی النگ کپرہ
en: Oh ... his repentance ... this one; we, Shah Jahan, you ... this room yesterday ... no, father, I ... like this ... with you ... Mother, I can't leave [you] alone like this.
en_old: Oh, ... my friend, his repentance... this one, we Shah Jahan, you this room... don't come... they say it's like this, you are... alone, mother, we can't stay like this.

brh: کنا مار نی انتئے پومفیسے ئے ننا زی آ حمل مسٹ پگہ خدانخواستہ پنگڑاس مرے داسکا تو دا خبر اف کے دا خلوک آک دیر او
en: My son, why don't you understand that we were attacked? Tomorrow, God forbid, something may happen. Until now we don't even know who these attackers are.
en_old: My son, why don't you understand that we were attacked? God forbid something happens tomorrow; until now we don't even know who these attackers were.

brh: میروئے جوان پو کریس دا دعا مرے میر صاحب اسل اوفتہ مرضی اٹ پین اسکن متکنو حال احوالس اسل خیر خیریت ئے میر صاحب
en: You instructed Miro well. May this prayer [be granted], Mir Sahib, entirely by their will. Any other old news? Everything is perfectly well, Mir Sahib.
en_old: Miro, you have done well, may this prayer be... Mir Sahib, not at all of their own will, nothing else happened, just news, everything is fine and well, Mir Sahib.

brh: دا پاکے دہفتہ بندہ غا کنتے مونا بفسے میر صاحب دا ہفتہ بندہ غا کمر مونا برت باوا تو ارا غان ہم پیش تمپکک مخلوق شک کے سونے کہ مسڑے لمہ و ایڑ ندر
en: Say this: this week you won't come before me, Mir Sahib; this week ... come before ... Father, nothing comes up from anywhere either; people will suspect that the daughter, the mother and the sister ... [unclear].
en_old: Say this: this week the man won't come before me, Mir Sahib, this week the man will come before... father doesn't go out anywhere, people will suspect that the daughter, mother and sister...

brh: تریفینو دا باز جوان او ہیتس بنفے خیرو دا ننے مونا کاریم ایتوئے بالکل
en: Splendid! That's a very good point you've told us, Khairo. This will definitely be of use to us going forward.
en_old: Wow, that's a really good thing you've said. Anyway, this will definitely give us work to do from here on.

brh: وا اما وا خنیسے ایلہ نا مشتٹی اخس مہر محبت ارے کنکے اسہ ڈنی ء زہنے بے عزت کرے ایلہ نا مونا نی اسل اودے چپاتوس۔ انت بے عزت کرے نی لالا اودے جائی پاتفتے پدا خاموش ء چاکو گس گس رنگ نا
en: Wow, mom, wow, do you see how much love and affection sister has? For my sake she insulted some guy... In front of sister you really [slapped?] him. How did you insult him, brother? I really ... him, then quietly ... the tea ... sort of fizzing.
en_old: Oh mom, look how much love and affection Sister has! I insulted a guy, and in front of Sister you didn't recognize him at all. How did you insult him, brother? I put him in his place, and then quietly the tea... all fizzy, kind of.

brh: امو نرسنگا آئی دے آئی دے امو نو چا بس مو نو چا بس؟ آ دا دا دے چا واہ واہ چا نا خلوک اسیتو پڈ نا خلوک مرے نی چا نا خلوک ئس بدتمیز نی ہمو وقتی پارٹی ٹی کپ انیامٹی
en: That one ... today, today, his tea came? His tea came? Ah, this, this today, tea! Wow, wow, you were a tea drinker, you'd be a ... drinker. You're a tea addict, you rude one; that time at the party, in the middle of the cup...
en_old: That one, came today, came today, the tea came, didn't the tea come? Oh, today the tea, wow wow, you were a tea lover, be a tea lover. You were a tea lover, you rude one, at that time at the party, in the middle of the cup...

brh: نوکر استوں نوکر مئے نوکر کیتے نخرہ کے چا واہ واہ واہ چا چا چا واہ دا ایلو چا مزو بس خیر نی باور بفک نی ہا کنے باور بریک ولے کنے دا بندغ آ باور اف نی گون
en: Servant... servant... putting on airs for a servant? Tea, wow wow wow, tea, tea, tea, wow, this other tea turned out tasty. Anyway, you don't believe it. Yes, I believe it, but I don't trust this man with you.
en_old: We are servants, servants, servants put on airs. Tea, wow wow wow, tea tea tea, wow, this other tea was tasty. Anyway, you don't believe it. You... yes, I believe it, but I don't trust this person with you.

brh: نی مگہ نی سرکسٹی بھرتی مننگ کے دننگ آٹو کہ نی دافتے بینانوس۔ بابو سرکس والا اندونو پچ بینرے؟ آ بس خانا نی بس مچے سرخی او پاوڈر خلیر مونا نی بس اوفتے
en: So are you going off to join the circus, then, that you've put these on? Babu, do circus people wear clothes like these? Ah, enough, Khana — you just slapped all that lipstick and powder on your face, you just... those...
en_old: Are you going to join the circus, that you've put these on? Babu, do circus people wear clothes like these? Oh Khana, you just put red and powder all over, in front you just them...

brh: نمبر خننگ اٹ اٹ بابو دا پچاتے کنے اسے دھوبی اسے پارے باس لنگان مچے رنگ تھینانے بس خالی دن پئیدا تھینانے دا چما تفیتے کنے تفنگ ام بفک داسہ ہمو کاو تو اینے اندا خاطر ام پارے خنانے کسے وار اٹ ترے امر خن
en: ...seeing the number, Babu... these clothes — a washerman [gave them] to me, a washerman said, boss... all the colour [ran] from the... it just came out like this, that's all. These... I don't even know how to tie them. Now that same... so that's why I said, look... at some point... how [it] looks.
en_old: The number is showing, Babu, these clothes... a washerman told me, boss, ... all the color has... it just came out like this. These eyes, I can't even see properly, now that... that's why I said...

brh: ننے غاٹے اوز نی دا پچاتے دن محبوب گڑا سلاہ سیت کنے امر کین او نی دوں کرخانہ نی دا سینے پیسہ ایتو اینتینگن پیم پچ مچ اسل پومسوس دا پچاتے داتے کشا مخرا ننے آ او او ہاڑ دا پیسہ
en: ...you [treat] these clothes like some precious, beloved thing... how am I supposed to manage? And you went and did it like that — you gave money for this... the clothes, every last one, are completely ruined. Take these clothes off... to us... oh, oh... this money.
en_old: ...you treat these clothes like some beloved thing... how should I... you did it like that... gave this money... the clothes are completely ruined, take these clothes off... this money.

brh: صلواتے، اینا جوانو پچ الٹینکے، شامس اینک، اینا جوانو پچ الور، اینا نیک، اینک، بابو بابو بابو بابو، ٹھکری این دا خم مفک کہ دا مارے کہ منا پچ
en: Blessings! Such nice clothes, turned inside out... an evening, today... such nice clothes... so nice, today... Babu, Babu, Babu, Babu! Thakri, today this won't bend, because this boy... my clothes.
en_old: Bless you! Such nice clothes, turned inside out... evening comes... such nice clothes... so nice... Babu, Babu, Babu, Babu... this won't fit, because it says, 'my clothes'...

brh: ئے چنا جوڑ کیوک تا دا پیندا تے بیران ہمو خننگے واہ رے ٹھکری واہ ئے ستو دا اوران اللہ غپا صفائی کو بندہ حیران ہمو کیوک ئے ستا
en: I'm the one who fixes [things] up, and these... get ruined — just look! Wow, Thakri, wow! I [keep] this house — by God, such cleaning that a person would be amazed...
en_old: ...the ones who make children... wow, Thakri, wow... this house, by God, such cleanliness, a person is amazed.

brh: نی دن زو کائے پیسہ کور مور اینک، میرو انتس بدتمیز کنیوس، یاری نی پاریٹ چائے دان
en: You [go off] so quickly like this... money, blind-and-all, today... Miro, what rudeness are you up to? Friend, I told you: the teapot...
en_old: You come so quickly... money... Meeru, what rudeness you're doing! Friend, I told you, tea...

brh: دا چا جوڑ کیس کنکی نی اسہ پیالس جوڑ کرینوس شرم بفک نی ارے نی دا انتس کاٹم اٹ تخانوس دا قصاب نا وٹوئے ہرفے تخانے ہموڈے دوتے تینا صاف کیرے۔ خبردار شٹ اپ بدتمیز دانا باراٹ ہچ پاپیس دادے کنا اونے والا مال ئے
en: Make this tea for me — you made just one cup, aren't you ashamed? Hey, what's this you've put on your head? This is the butcher's [cloth] — he picked it up and put it on — that's what they wipe their hands with. Watch it! Shut up, you rude man! Don't say a word about it — this is my own thing.
en_old: Did you make this tea for me? You made just one cup, aren't you ashamed? And what have you put on your head? That's the butcher's cloth he keeps there to wipe his hands. Watch it! Shut up, you rude one! Don't say anything about it, this is my... stuff.

brh: دا لونگ کن کیل کونے، اینتو چائک نی بدتمیزی سوس ہندن او ٹوپ ہستسنے، دا استین اٹ ٹو ہرفینے کاٹم اٹ تخانے کے ٹوپ ہستخانے ٹوپ ہستخانے، بدتمیز، شپات، اٹوار بالون اٹنے، نوکر ئس تو نوکر جوڑ مئے، داڑے کنا صاحب جوڑ مفے، ہا؟
en: This [turban] is... mine. Today [I see] you've been rude — and that hat... he picked it up with his sleeve and put it on his head, made himself a hat of it, made a hat of it. Rude, barefoot [lout]... ball... If you're a servant, then act like a servant; don't act like my master here, huh?
en_old: Why are you making such a fuss over this? Don't you know you were rude? You took that hat, tucked it into your sleeve, put it on your head, put the hat on, put the hat on. Rude! Saturday, Sunday, playing ball... You're a servant, so act like a servant. Don't become my boss here, huh?

brh: ئے نوکروٹ توڑی بال کننگٹی اوٹک بدتمیزی کپے دا ٹوپ نا باراٹی ہچ پاپیس دا ذکرے کنا معلوم الخونے کنکے او السلام علیکم ارے داد اسکاٹما کرنس خرنک دامے ٹوپی ارا دانہ تخوک اسورے ایندا دے بیناٹ ارے
en: I'm a servant; ... even while playing ball he doesn't behave rudely. Don't say a word about this hat. I didn't know anything about this matter... And peace be upon you. Hey, ... this cap that had been put here... I've put it on today, hey.
en_old: You're a servant. Don't be rude to him, not even while playing ball. Don't say anything about this hat. I didn't know about this. He says, 'Assalamu alaikum.' ...this hat that was kept here... I saw it today.

brh: خدا خلیل نی دا دے ہمو تینا سنگت شاعر پک دیر پمس تے یوسف دیر بس ہمو سنگت کنا شاعر اوڑ کل کسوٹ نا ٹوپ تو دا دے کشو دے شاباش نہ دا جوان ء ٹوپ اسے کش تپاوہ دا دیر پک دے دا دیر پک بازار پنڈنگ ٹی کش تپاوہ نی چپ کہ گم مے
en: God, Khalil! Today that poet friend of yours... Yusuf, who came — that poet friend of mine — everyone took their hats off for him, so take it off today. Well done. No, I won't take off this nice hat. Even if... begging in the bazaar, I won't take it off. You keep quiet and get lost.
en_old: God, Khalil, today that poet friend of yours... Yusuf came, that poet friend of mine. I took off everyone's hat, so take it off today. Well done. No, I won't take off this nice hat. Even begging in the bazaar I won't take it off. You be quiet and get lost.

brh: ئے تینٹ جوان اٹ۔ بابا نی تینا بائے بند کر۔ ہاؤ بند کے بالکل۔ شاباش او دے پاننگٹ۔ ئے دے پاننگٹ۔ شاباش نی پاننگٹ۔ ارے شاباش۔ دا کنا ٹوپیو۔ ہاؤ ارے مرغہ۔
en: I'm fine by myself. Baba, shut your mouth. Yes, shut it completely. Well done, he's saying it too. I'm saying it too. Well done, you're saying it. Hey, well done. This is my cap. Yes, hey, rooster.
en_old: You're fine yourself. Baba, shut your mouth. Yes, shut it completely. Well done, he's saying it. You're saying it. Well done, you're saying it. Hey, well done. This is my hat. Yes, hey, rooster.

brh: واہ واہ داسہ نی داسہ انسانس خننگس نی ہور عالمیرو جی دادے مچے پھو کر دا شار نا باروٹیا کہ داڑے امر مخلوق رہینگی کا ہاں بالکل داسہ پھوکے وتے پھوکس تا ہاں پھوکے وتے گلجان دا
en: Wow, wow, now you look like a human being! Look, oh Miro-ji, blow all of this out — about this city, what kind of creatures live here. Go — yes, exactly. Now blow it, blow it — yes, blow it, Guljan, this...
en_old: Wow, wow, now you're seeing a human. You... look, blow all of this up. About this city, what kind of creatures live here. Yes, exactly. Now blow it up, blow it up, Guljan, this...

brh: نی انت پوک ہکک دا واسی کتے نی تو پوک ہی نی نی پو مسٹ نی ہات کن تو ہیت کپا توار پارینٹ نی نوکر کیتے نخرہ کیتے۔ آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے کپتی ارے کپتی آئی دے۔
en: What nonsense are you blathering?... you're good for nothing, you... you won't even talk with me... shouted... you act the servant, you put on airs. Aai de, aai de, aai de, aai de, aai de, aai de, aai de! Kapti, hey Kapti, aai de!
en_old: What nonsense are you talking? ...you're the nonsense one, you... You don't talk with your hands... you shouted. You act like a servant, you put on airs. Aaiday, aaiday, aaiday, aaiday, aaiday, aaiday, aaiday... there's a captain, captain, aaiday.

brh: ایدے ایدے ایدے خدائے نا منت اوئے خلائی بخلوق ایدے ایدے ایدے ابا ایدے ایدے پند پند یا وار دے اٹی ایدے خواصہ یار ایدے ایدے ایدے ایدے ارا کے تنے سلک ایدے برے ایدے تنے ایدے ایدے ایدے ایدے
en: Aai de, aai de, aai de! For God's sake, hey, alien creature! Aai de, aai de, aai de, oh dad, aai de, aai de, walk, walk... aai de, master, friend, aai de, aai de, aai de, aai de... to you... aai de, come, aai de, to you, aai de, aai de, aai de, aai de.
