en_old: Here, here, here, thank God! Oh, alien creature! Here, here, here, dad, here, here... walk, walk... here, my dear friend, here, here, here, here... come to you, here, come here, to you, here, here, here, here.

brh: آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے اینا اعلان کا کل کل کل پی آئی دے آئی دے نا نغمہ یار ایٹ ئس مے جی
en: Aai de, aai de, aai de, aai de — today's announcement: everyone, everyone, everyone... the song 'Aai de, aai de' — friend, may it be a hit, sir!
en_old: Aaiday, aaiday, aaiday, aaiday... this announcement... everyone, everyone, everyone... aaiday, aaiday, the song of aaiday, friend... yes.

brh: ہن مئے ہن مئے ہن مئے ہن مئے اڑے اڑے اڑے دھوم دھوم دھوم دھوم اللہ اللہ اللہ بابو اللہ اللہ اللہ اللہ بابو بابو ئے ہوٹ ئے ہوٹ گل جان ڈسکو
en: Hun mae, hun mae, hun mae, hun mae! Hey, hey, hey! Dhoom, dhoom, dhoom, dhoom! Allah, Allah, Allah, Babu! Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah, Babu, Babu! Hey, hot! Hey, hot! Guljan disco!
en_old: Go on, go on, go on, go on! Hey, hey, hey! Dhoom, dhoom, dhoom, dhoom! Allah, Allah, Allah, Babu! Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah, Babu, Babu! Yes, yes, Guljan disco!

brh: ڈسکو بابو۔ دیر؟ دزہ صاحب بابو گلجان ڈسکو ئے اوٹ ئے اوڑے خان نیک نی تو صفا کنا زرد ہوستے کشاس۔ اہاں بابو ئے ہمر لگیگٹ دا بلا پجھتنو بابو۔ او خان نیک کش دا پجھ غاتین کٹ کٹین۔ اہو۔
en: Disco Babu. Who? ... Sahib, Babu, Guljan disco — I'm here, I'm over there. Khan Nek, you've completely drained the colour out of me. Aha, Babu, how do I look? These fabulous clothes, Babu. Oh Khan Nek, take off these clothes... cut, cut. Aho.
en_old: Disco Babu. Who? ...Babu, Guljan disco. Yes, over there. Khan Nek, you've completely worn me out. Aha, Babu, how do I look? These amazing clothes, Babu. Oh Khan Nek, take off these clothes, cut, cut. Aho!

brh: دنگ بر ہن نم بژانو دنگ تو بر تول داغہ کوٹ کپرتے کوٹ کپرتے تول داغہ او ہننے داہنت کرے نستنے اسے وار ہرتنے شیشہ ٹی خاننے تنے ور اسو گنو کاتم بر کرے نست
en: Come this way, go, you... come this way, sit here; the coat, the clothes, the coat, the clothes — sit here. And he went, did like this, sat down; once he looked, he looked at himself in the mirror... a crazy-looking head... came and sat down.
en_old: Come here, go... come, weigh it... the coat, the clothes, the coat, the clothes, weigh it... he went, did this, sat down, once... looked in the mirror... your head...

brh: کشی دافتے نہ بابو دادے کشپرہ بابو ئے بنگنوٹ کہ دا دشتارے کنے بلو پوجا باز دوست مریگ بابو ہندا خاطرے دا وگ یل کنوٹ تینگے او خانانے اوڑتنے چہرے تنے صفا نو کمباروس کشی دادے ہیں
en: Take these off? No, Babu, I won't take this off, Babu. I've heard that this turban... I like it a lot, Babu. That's why I kept this wig for myself. And Khanane, his face... your face is completely... take this off, hm.
en_old: Don't take these off, Babu. They won't take this off, Babu. I was thinking... I love big celebrations a lot, Babu. That's why I kept this wig for myself. And Khanane, your face there is completely... take this off.

brh: بابو ئے نوک امبرٹ؟ ہئو نوک امبرس۔ ئے زیب اٹ بابو ہئو؟ ہئو زیب اوس مے۔ بابو ئے نوک امبرٹ ئے توبے امبر انتئے افٹ؟ اڑے بابا ار ونت پاننگاٹیٹ جو۔
en: Babu, am I the crescent moon in the sky? Yes, you're the crescent moon in the sky. Am I beautiful, Babu, yes? Yes, you're beautiful. Babu, if I'm the crescent moon in the sky, why am I not the full moon in the sky? Hey, man, I've been saying so all along.
en_old: Babu, am I not number one? Yes, you're number one. Am I beautiful, Babu, yes? Yes, you're beautiful. Babu, am I not number one? Why not? Hey baba, I've been saying it the whole time.

brh: بابو ئے پل امر انتئے افٹ؟ ہن مسوس پوم افیدی نی پاہٹ چپ گبائدین تو دے۔ بابو ئے اگر پلاس مسوٹے تو
en: Babu, why am I not like a flower? ... you be quiet... Babu, if I had been a flower, then...
en_old: Babu, why am I not a flower? ...you be quiet... Babu, if I had been a flower, then...

brh: گواڑخ نا پھل مسوٹہ بابو، خانانے! گواڑخ نا پھل مسوسہ، گواڑخ نا پھل، گواڑخ نا پھل، ہی بابو، ئے چمبیلی نا پھل انتئے متوٹ؟ نہ، اگہ ئے چمبیلی نا پھل ئس مسوٹہ گڑا انت مسکہ بابو؟
en: I would have been a tulip, Babu, Khanane! You'd have been a tulip, a tulip, a tulip. Hey, Babu, why wasn't I a jasmine flower? No — if I had been a jasmine flower, then what would have happened, Babu?
en_old: I'd have been a tulip, Babu, Khanane! A tulip, a tulip, a tulip. Hey Babu, why wasn't I a jasmine flower? No, if you had been a jasmine flower, then what would have happened, Babu?

brh: ارے کنا نی دماغ ء کنگس، دماغ ء تلا کنگس، ئے بابو، بابو کنے لگے کہ مسنے بشریڑی چلے فیس، ارے ہتہ بر، او ننا لٹ نا پیریاک پاننگو، ارے نی دے پارے کہ بشریڑی
en: Hey, you've eaten my brain, eaten my brain right down to the floor. Babu, Babu, it seems to me that... hey, bring it here... he's saying what our elders [say]... hey, you also said that...
en_old: Hey, you've eaten my brain, you've fried my brain. Babu, Babu, it seems to me that... hey, come here, he's saying about our... hey, you said today that...

brh: ئے چلے وینٹ، نی سما ء کہ جواننگا بندغاتے خلسان کرینے، بس محبوب محبوب خلپیس محبوب، پھڈ دے نت تے کنے، محبوب کنا جواننگا محبوب، ہچ جوان پھڈک، دوک نہ پھنانو، نہ نہ محبوب قسم ئے انو لگے کس پی وقتی ماسٹر جی ئس مسونس نی محبوب، ارے با چپ کر
en: You... you know you've given good people a hard time. Enough, Mahboob, Mahboob, don't hit [me], Mahboob... my belly and feet... Mahboob, my good Mahboob... nothing good... No, no, Mahboob, I swear, today it seems you've become some kind of part-time master-ji, Mahboob. Hey, shut your mouth.
en_old: You... you know you've ruined good people. Just, beloved, beloved, don't hit me, beloved... my good beloved, beloved... no, no, beloved, I swear... you've become some temporary master ji, beloved. Hey, be quiet!

brh: چپ کریس بابو، اوہ، ہندوں پین، او سونگ کریس کریس، پلہ پلہ، پلٹنگوٹ بابو پین ہمہ پلٹنگیا، ئے تو بینہ ٹکورہ سے تاؤ، ہاؤ، ئے چمیلی نا پل، اڑے گڈے اخلیر، اڑے گڈے
en: I'll keep quiet, Babu. Oh, like that again... and... flower, flower... I'm spinning, Babu, spinning around again... you'll see... yes, I'm a jasmine flower. Hey, then... hey, then...
en_old: Be quiet, Babu. Oh, like that again... flower, flower... I was turning, Babu, turning again... you'll see... yes, jasmine flower... hey, then... hey, then...

brh: ٹوکر ئس کنے نن ڈیکہ کنا پٹ، معاف کیس بابو معاف کیس، الہ ڈیکہ شاباش، جی بابو، جی بابو جی
en: A kick for me... my... Forgive me, Babu, forgive me... well done. Yes, Babu, yes, Babu, yes.
en_old: Throw a basket at me at night... my stomach... forgive me, Babu, forgive me... well done. Yes, Babu, yes, Babu, yes.

brh: او یڑو! دا ہڑو ٹیم ئس بس کنے آ! بیزار کنے دن نوکری آن۔ مہمان مہمان مہمان ہر دے مہمان۔
en: Oh, sister! What a time this is that has come upon me! I'm fed up with this kind of job. Guests, guests, guests — guests every single day.
en_old: Oh brother! What a time has come upon me! I'm fed up with this job. Guests, guests, guests, guests every single day.

brh: ابوئے کنکے آئی کا میر صاحبے اورک پائکانے ابا ابا اور انونیٹ کنے ریفنگاٹی ئے دا دور حالات اٹی اسل احساس افک کہ اسٹ تو نوکر ئس ننا میرو عرف میر جان ہئے ہئے
en: Father, for me... go tell Mir Sahib... father, father... I'm [pretending]... In these times and circumstances there's no sense at all that one is a servant. Our Miro, alias Mir Jan, hey, hey!
en_old: Father, call Mir Sahib for me, tell him... father, father... in these times there's no sense at all that one is a servant. Our Miro, also known as Mir Jan, hey, hey!

brh: میرو ہریس تو نوکرس داٹی اچک افک ہمے انت پارے تے نوکر گی تے نخرہ کے میرو میرو اینو ابوی نی انت کننگ اوسی ئے چاپ خلنگٹیوٹ ڈانس کننگٹیوٹ
en: Miro, look, you're a servant — there's nothing [wrong] in that... that's just what they said: a servant putting on airs. Miro, Miro, today, dad — what are you doing? I'm doing the chaap, I'm dancing.
en_old: Miro, if you're a servant, there's nothing wrong with that. It's just as they said, servants and their tantrums... Miro, Miro, today, father, what are you doing? You're clapping, you're dancing!

brh: دے پین انت کننگٹی او؟ میمان بننگٹی او، کنا ایڑ اوفتے کے تیاری ئس کروئی ئے کنے۔ دا دتک اسے دتینا۔ دا کنا ایڑ دا دتک پاپیز خیال کیسک شاباش دا دے بازار آ در درک ئے دے نا پچر۔ انت پاننگ؟
en: What else is he doing today? Guests are coming; my sister, I have to make preparations for them. This... this, my sister... don't say... take care. Well done, today go to the bazaar... What are you saying?
en_old: What else are they doing these days? Guests are coming. My sister, I have to make preparations for them. This is... this is my sister... Papiz thinks... well done, go out to the market today... What can I say?

brh: تھینک یو اماں، اسل دا ئس بندغہ کنے باور اف کہ سمے کس، ہممم، دا چائے تم شوشڑو کرینے الے، انت پاریس؟ راست پاریٹ بدتمیز، دا امر و چائے جوڑ کرینوس، بلے
en: Thank you, Mom. Honestly, I don't trust this one person, that ... hmm, this tea's taste ... has it been made ...? What did you say? I said the truth, you rude one. How have you made this tea? Well!
en_old: Thank you, mom. Honestly, this person... I don't believe that... hmm, this tea has gone cold, hasn't it? What did you say? I said it right, you rude one, how did you make this tea? Well...

brh: دا بد تمیز نیوز کے بلا تیتو صوفہ غا تولوک ئس خیر خیر دا ایتا تے الیبو۔ ایڑ نن دم کبو کہ سفر ئس کرورے ہا مچے آرام کبو ہا؟ ہاو، چا کمبو ولدا آرام کبو۔ کامبو ئے اینو مے نما کمرے نشان ئے تیو۔ ہمبو۔
en: This rude one was sitting on the sofa ... the news ... Fine, fine, let's drop this talk. Sister, shall we rest? You've made a journey, so rest a little, yes? Yes, let's have tea and then rest. Come, today I'll show you your room. Let's go.
en_old: This rude one was sitting on the sofa like... the news. Fine, fine, let's leave these. Sister, shall we rest? We've been traveling, so shall we all rest? Yes, let's have tea and then rest. Come, I'll show you your room. Okay.

brh: گل جان گل جان گل جان جی ابا نی تول چاکن ہو ولدا گڑاس نا ضرورت مسنے نی ہو میرو تے کیتکنے او ہا شاباش جوان جوان یلہ
en: Gul Jan, Gul Jan, Gul Jan! Yes, Father. You sit, I'll make tea, yes. Then, is anything else needed? Have you seen to Meeru? Yes. Well done, good, good, leave it.
en_old: Gul Jan, Gul Jan, Gul Jan! Yes, dad. You sit, I'll make tea, yes, and then if anything is needed... Did you tell the guests? Yes. Well done, good, good, leave it.

brh: چپ کر گم مئے بدتمیز۔ خیرات۔ زو ئس دا چائے کے خالی کر کنے پین ہم کارم کروئی ہی نی دا چائے دان تو ہنتس ہنتینا کارم تے کر یار۔ گڑا دا چا تھدے؟ چا تھدے؟ دو خپ ایس چاتے پوا۔ چا تھدے؟ خبردار چا تھدے پیس چا تھے نا؟ کنے۔
en: Shut up, get lost, you rude one. Khairat! Quickly finish this tea, I have other work to do too. You, take this tea from here and go do your own work, man. So is this tea cold? Is the tea cold? Take two sips of the tea and see. Is the tea cold? Careful, is the tea cold? ... the tea ...? Me.
en_old: Shut up, get lost, you rude one. Khairat. Quickly empty this tea, I have other work to do too. You finish this tea and go do your own work, man. So is this tea cold? Is the tea cold? I'll pour two sips of tea. Is the tea cold? Watch out, is the tea cold? Is the tea cold? Me.

en: Do I have to stand around here now? Today let me do my own work; until the teas are finished, he won't let us leave here. You, you tell me this: am I Khairati's servant or this house's servant? You tell me how many more days you will stay a novice. Man, the job...
en_old: Who's going to stand here now? Let me do my own work. Until the tea is finished, how will we... You tell me this: am I Khairati's servant or this one's servant? You tell me how many more days you'll be clumsy. Man, the job...

en_old: What do you think? At least spend a few days here. Dad told me to celebrate Eid, and after that we'll decide whether to stay more days.

brh: انو لگک وتتہ مومسونو موننگا چھانہ خوننگا او یڑے ئے ٹکری او لختہ لوڑانی دندونٹے را را ٹریفک والا مبرشا

en_old: It seems that now... in the season... looking... and the stones and sand in the teeth... come, come, traffic man...

en_old: I was in this house like a crazy person. Eid Mubarak, Eid Mubarak, Eid Mubarak, Eid Mubarak, Eid Mubarak, Eid Mubarak! Khair Mubarak! Eidi, Eidi, Eidi, give me Eidi, give me Eidi, man, oh God.

en: For God's sake! For God's sake! The other one has me working ... and hey, give it, give it, give it! Oy, oh brother, leave it, you gave it to me here ... I'm asking for it, hey, give it, hey, give it, hey, give it, give it!
en_old: My God, my God, the other one is making me work, and hey, today, today, today, hey, sister, leave me, give it to me here, I want today, it's today, it's today, today, this day.

en_old: This is Ali, Khairat Ali, first... this is Saleem ji... this water... lassi, Sheikhan's lassi... my purpose is this... my sister's... my sister's... she came today, she came today, today, today.

en: Hey man, hey, enough, enough, enough, come tomorrow! Hey, hey, oh, call the ambulance, dear. Oh, goodbye, today's one, come tomorrow ... oh man, I ... up to now, man ... isn't it Eid yet? You give me Eid greetings ... me ... my friend ... let's go.
en_old: Hey man, hey, enough, enough, enough, come tomorrow, yes, yes, call the ambulance, dear. Goodbye, whoever's leaving, come tomorrow. Hey man, this much, man... isn't it Eid? You're giving me Eid greetings... my friend, this... let's go.

en: I ... you, oh, oh, I ... you, oh, you're fine and ... oh, your ... my meaning is this, today you ... get lost, get lost ... Oh God, an alien creature! God ... this alien ... fear ... me ... what misfortune, Dad.
en_old: You were... oh, oh... you were... you're fine, good... your... my purpose is this, today you... Oh God, an alien creature... this alien... what bad luck, dad.

brh: اوئے خلیفہ کنے پو جناک بسور شاید میرو جی جی دان شور شرابہ اسس دا شور شرابہ اللو دا ہمو گنوکنگا مار بسک ہا دا گلجان ڈسکو خاننگ پکاو
en: Hey Khalifa, explain to me, have jinns come? Maybe it's Meeru ji. Yes, yes, there was a racket here. This racket isn't from them; it's that crazy boy who has come, yes, it's surely Gul Jan Disco.
en_old: Hey Khalifa, tell me, guests have come, maybe the guests. Yes, yes, there's a lot of noise here. This noise isn't... it's that crazy guy coming, yes, it's definitely Gul Jan Disco.

brh: گل جان ڈسکو کنے چا نا پارے جنتئے نا دم سئے نا کھڑے غسل اتنگاٹی۔ ہا؟ دانت پاننگاٹی ئس جوم پاننگاٹی اٹ۔ کمال ئے عجب او بندغس ئے کنا عزت نا پرواہ اف تے؟ بس کر۔
en: Gul Jan Disco told me ... that he is giving your ram a bath. Huh? What are you saying? I'm saying ... Amazing, how strange! Is he someone who doesn't care about my honor? Enough!
en_old: Gul Jan Disco told me about the tea... to bathe... huh? What are you saying? I'm saying... Amazing, strange! Is he a person who doesn't care about my honor? Enough.

brh: دانہ پہ دانہ دانہ نا ہو دانہ پہ دانہ دانہ نا داڑ دوتے لگانی نانہ نا داڑ دوتے لگنو کر گنیو سیڈ اما گوم داڑ دوتے لگانی دور گل جان اینا نی ارا وقت بسوس ایلے دا پاکے نی ارا نگنا سوس ایلے
en: Grain by grain, grain ... grain by grain, grain ... (song lyrics) ... Gul Jan, when did you come today, brother? ... when did you come, brother?
en_old: Grain by grain, grain... grain by grain, grain... Gul Jan, when did you come, sister? When did you come, sister?

brh: ئے دا ہمسایہ نا ارا غا اینا اسوٹ مچے چکر ٹی انتئے دے ایرا کسر اسور نئے نئے ایرا خو کتو اسر کنکے بس اینو نن ہنا ہندون راست پاننگٹی ئس راست پاننگوٹ ہندون بس گیٹ آ سلوک اسوٹ اینو ہڑ نا توار بس
en: I was at this neighbor's house today, on a little visit ... why ... there were two roads ... no, no ... two ... Just today we went like that. Are you telling the truth? I'm telling the truth. I was just standing at the gate like that, and today the sound of the ram came.
en_old: I was going to the neighbor's house. Why was everyone going around in circles today... two roads... no, no... today we just went that way. I'm telling the truth, I'm telling the truth, I was just standing at the gate today when a sound came.

brh: وارس بس مے مے مے ئے پارٹ دا تخر بیمار ماروئے ہندا وجہ غان ئے نات کھڑی تے غسل تسوٹ ہا انت بیماری ئس تے ہا ہچ الوتے الا بس ہندون مچے جگر اٹ تیکرے گرمی اسکے گڑا گڑا بس نبض تے چیک کریٹ پین انت انت پین
en: Once it went 'meh, meh, meh.' I said this ram is going to get sick, that's why I gave your ram a bath. Huh? What illness does it have? Nothing at all, it's just that there was a bit of heat in its liver, so then I just checked its pulse. What else, what else?
en_old: Once he came and said, this boy is sick, that's why I bathed him this morning. What illness? Nothing at all, just his whole liver is full of heat. Then I just checked his pulse, and what else, what else...

brh: ئے ونا تا ڈاکٹر اسے تون انتئے نیم تینا علاج ئے کرفوئی کنے انت بدتمیز ہیرو جی نی تینا بکواس ئے بند کر جوان جوان امر بے عزت مسوس نی گڑا دم کروسس مچے کاٹو متے چمچے

en_old: ...with their doctor, why should I get only half my treatment done? What a rude one, Hero ji! Shut your nonsense! Fine, fine, how did you get insulted? Then you would have... all the spoons...

en_old: ...I'm sorry, Meeru ji, forgive him, alright, forgive him... about that house, about this city, dear.

en: Oh wow, Gulan, wow, Gulan, la la la la, enough! I'm not late at all; then I have to bathe now, quickly. Babu, Babu, Babu, Babu, I've come, Babu.
en_old: Oh wow, Gulan, wow, Gulan, la la la, that's it, I'm not late at all, then I have to bathe now, quickly. Babu, Babu, Babu, Babu, Babu, I've come, Babu.

en: Babu, come here, Babu. You keep going 'Babu, Babu.' I've come, Babu, I've come, yes, Babu. I bathed, I just put on only this waistcoat, I put on my clothes and came, Babu.
en_old: Babu, come sit, Babu, Babu, I was in the middle of doing it, I came, Babu, yes, I came, Babu, I bathed, just came in this waistcoat, came in my clothes, Babu.

en: That's why he got especially cleaned up. This person looks ... He said to Babu ... said, 'Thank you.' Hey, this smell of the dance!

en: Ladies and gentlemen, ... Babu, hey, ladies and gentlemen, like this it will all be the smell of socks. Hey, then notice that the smell of camphor is coming too. Didn't you put on camphor? Yes, yes, camphor; I poured camphor and a bottle of rose water into the bucket, Babu.
en_old: Ladies and gentlemen, look, Babu, ladies and gentlemen, it's all the smell of socks, then see, the smell of camphor is coming too. Did you put on camphor? Yes, yes, camphor, and I poured a bottle of rose water into the bucket, Babu.

en_old: You, this day... put on your clothes, well done, put on two sets of clothes, ... put those on.

en_old: Father, this one was very mischievous in childhood. But I'm surprised why this Thakri is humiliating this boy like that. He's a very simple boy. It's Thakri's daughter who is crazy.

en: Ah ... the daughter: if this boy weren't so simple, would he have given him his daughter, dear? Because his daughter is crazy too; if she weren't crazy, he wouldn't have given this daughter to him. Anyway.
en_old: Oh, the daughter: if this boy weren't so simple, would he have given him his daughter? Because his daughter is crazy too; if she weren't crazy, he wouldn't have given this daughter to him. Anyway.

brh: اڑے زو کر ہند مسنے زو کر بابو بابو بابو بابو خان نیک دانت اسپین ہنوس
en: Hey, hurry up, it's time, hurry up! Babu, Babu, Babu, Babu! Khan, what is this? Where are you going?
en_old: Hey, hurry up, it's time, hurry up, Babu, Babu, Babu, Babu, Khan, what is this, where have you gone?

en_old: Babu, Babu, what suit is this you've put on? It looks like you've put on a suit... why, can't a suit just be seen as it is, Khana?

brh: حوصلہ کر شہباز خان ایلم حوصلہ کر
en: Have courage, brother Shahbaz Khan, have courage.
en_old: Have courage, brother Shahbaz Khan, have courage.

brh: شہباز خان ایلم کنے ابخش خیر ایتا کل کنا ابخش جغم مننگٹی ایلم نا وجہ ہچس متنے دا سڈ بلا نا دے کھٹاو بلا نا بلا نا
en: Brother Shahbaz Khan, forgive me, have mercy, forgive me everything. In the fighting, brother, none of this happened because of you. This is Dabla's... Dabla's, Dabla's...
en_old: Brother Shahbaz Khan, forgive me... forgive me for everything... it was because of the brother, nothing happened... this Dabla's day...

brh: ڈابلا نی اینو کنیا نرنگ کپسے ئے نا موت اٹ موت نی تینا موتا نرنگ کپسے
en: Dabla, today you cannot run away from me. Your death... death... you cannot run away from your own death.
en_old: Dabla, today you can't escape me. Your death is certain; you can't escape your death.

brh: گلاب خان
en: Gulab Khan!
en_old: Gulab Khan

brh: او ئس بچی کو بچا کے دکھاؤ
en: Hey, let's see you save this girl!
en_old: Hey, save the child and show us.

brh: روکو ہی ابھی آن کو شوٹ کرو شوٹ کرو آن لوگوں کو ڈبلا ئس مین گولی نہیں ہی ارے گولی تا باز ایتے ہنو پا کہ تفنگ خالی کپر بہانہ تے کے
en: Stop! Now shoot them, shoot them, those people! Dabla, there are no bullets in this. Hey, give them plenty of bullets! Go tell them not to empty the guns; he's making excuses.
en_old: Stop! Now shoot them, shoot those people! Dabla, I don't have any bullets. Hey, I gave you plenty of bullets. Tell them not to empty their guns, they're making excuses.
