en: Away from this one, away from this one, get back!
en_old: Step back from this, step back from this, get back!

brh: جلدی کرو، لوانگ کنڈو کو مارو، جلدی کرو، جلدی کرو، جلدی کرو، کیا ہوا؟ ڈوبلا، گولیاں ختم ہو گئے، کیا؟ گولیاں
en: Hurry up, kill... hurry up, hurry up, hurry up! What happened? Dabla, the bullets have run out. What? The bullets...
en_old: Hurry up, surround him and kill him, hurry, hurry, hurry! What happened? Dabla, the bullets have run out. What? The bullets...

brh: جاہد بشخ مت کر ہمبل آ تا گولی ختم مسونے زوت گولی بازے بشخ مت کے فرکے
en: Jahid, hand them out! The guys' bullets have run out. Quickly, hand out plenty of bullets...
en_old: Jahid, help me! The gun is out of bullets. Quick, give me some bullets, pass them over!

brh: جئی دنزہ سدہ ادا گولی کو ختم مسو ایرو گولی کے ختم مسرو کشہ بوتے ہائے ساری گولیاں ختم ہو گئے ہیں ابھی
en: Hey... guys, the bullets have run out here... the bullets have run out... oh, all the bullets have run out now.
en_old: Hey brother, the bullets have run out here, the bullets are finished now... all the bullets have run out now.

brh: سب لوگ جاؤ اپنا جان بچاؤ ادھر ادھر ہو جاؤ چلو ادھر ادھر ہو جاؤ
en: Everyone go, save your lives, scatter! Come on, scatter!
en_old: Everyone go, save your lives, scatter! Come on, scatter!

brh: دابلا کنا تو مقابلہ ارانگ نریسہ ادا دابلا تو نرا حملہ کبو خلینتا
en: Dabla, where are you running to, away from a fight with me? Guys, Dabla has run away! Attack, let's kill him!
en_old: Dabla, you can't stand up to me. Dabla, you can't escape. Attack, kill him!

brh: ہن خاچ کہ ڈبلانی ہم بھاز خوف اینی
en: Look, see, even Dabla is very afraid.
en_old: Look, see, even Dabla is very afraid.

brh: ڈبلا، ابھی کہاں بھاگ رہی ہو؟ کر مجھ سے مقابلہ۔ بابا ڈر۔
en: Dabla, where are you running off to now? Come on, fight me! Baba, (he's) scared.
en_old: Dabla, where are you running off to now? Fight me. Baba is afraid.

brh: غافلا تو تمہارے علاقے مین پردیسی آدمی ہی تم کیسی ئس سے مقابلہ کرو گے؟ غافلا وہ دن تجھے یاد ہی جب تو نی میرے بھائی کو مارا تھا آج مین تجھے زندہ نہیں چھوڑوں گا
en: You heedless fool, you're an outsider in your area; how will you fight anyone? Fool, do you remember the day you killed my brother? Today I won't leave you alive.
en_old: Ghafla, you're an outsider in your own area. How will you fight anyone? Ghafla, do you remember the day you killed my brother? Today I won't leave you alive.

brh: مارنا ہی تو بھائی مار، تلوار سے تو نہیں مار، تابلا تجھے مارنے کے لیے میرے ہاتھ ہی کافی ہیں۔
en: If you want to kill, brother, then kill, but don't kill with a sword. Dabla, my hands alone are enough to kill you.
en_old: If you want to kill, brother, then kill, but not with a sword. Dabla, my hands are enough to kill you.

brh: ارے نم ننا بندہ آ ننا علاقہ نا بندہ آک دا بلانا چمچہ گیری کیرے تینا ملک اٹ
en: Hey, you are our men, men of our own area, and you toady to Dabla in your own country?
en_old: Hey, you are our people, the people of our area, and you suck up to Dabla in your own land?

brh: شاباش شاید آپ کو پتا نہیں ڈابلا کو مارنا اتنا آسان کام نہیں
en: Well done. Perhaps you don't know that killing Dabla is not such an easy job.
en_old: Well done. Maybe you don't know that killing Dabla isn't such an easy job.

brh: حاجی فدا دا مکرس تینا ایلمی کنکے خلکوس
en: Haji Fida, this deceiver killed his own brother...
en_old: Haji Fida, this cunning man killed my brother.

brh: کنا ایلم نی ہرا ہدف او نی خلنگس نی ہمو استو دے خلکو حاجی فتح سئی کتر سینا ایلمی خلکو دا شیطان نا زندگی ختم ئے دادے خلوئی ئے دادے ختم کروئی ئے
en: My brother, who was your target, whom you were out to kill, you killed him that very day. Haji Fateh, he killed ...'s brother. This devil's life is over; he must be killed, he must be finished off.
en_old: My brother, the target you were supposed to hit, you hit it that very day. Haji Fateh, he killed someone's brother. This devil's life is over. He has to be killed, he has to be finished off.

brh: نم اراکا بسورے؟ دادے دیر خلک؟ دادے ئے خلکوٹ۔ جوان کرے میر صاحب دادے خلکوس دا کنے خلنگس۔ شکر مس کہ دماغ نی ٹھکانہ بس۔ میر صاحب دا کل نا مہربانی کو۔ حاجی فدا ببو کنے۔
en: Where have you come from? Who killed him? I killed him. Well done, Mir Sahib, you killed him; he was about to kill me. Thank God you have come to your senses. Mir Sahib, all of this is thanks to your kindness. Haji Fida, come to me.
en_old: Where have you come from? Who killed him? I killed him. Well done, Mir Sahib, you killed him; he would have killed me. Thank God you came to your senses. Mir Sahib, this is all thanks to your kindness. Haji Fida, forgive me.

brh: ظالم نا انجام ہندا دے
en: This is how a tyrant ends.
en_old: This is the end a tyrant meets.

brh: شاباش دریکہ کہ کائے، ڈبلا، ڈبل من
en: Well done! ... Dabla, Dabla...
en_old: Well done, brave one, it's good that he's gone. Dabla, Dabla is dead.

brh: ایلوم باز جوان کرے ڈا بلا خلقوس، بیشک ننا ملک آن برے ننا ملک اٹی بدمعاشی کیک۔
en: Brother, you did very well, you killed Dabla. No doubt, he came from outside our land and acted like a thug in our land.
en_old: Brother, you did very well killing Dabla. He came from outside our land and was going around as a thug in our land.

brh: شہباز ایلوم کنے معاف کیس ہمے دے کنا دماغ تینا ہند آ الو۔ نی خلکوٹ۔ جلال کنے خبرے نا دماغ تینا ہند آ الو۔ ئے اونی کنا
en: Brother Shahbaz, forgive me; that day my mind was not in its right place. I hit you. Jalal, I know your mind was not in its right place... he... my...
en_old: Shahbaz, brother, forgive me, that day I wasn't in my right mind. You killed. Jalal, I know you weren't in your right mind. He... my...

brh: وڑ خلوکسے مرشد صاحب کنے معاف کر کنے بشخ کر کنا ادمیان باز تکلیف مسورے باز خوار مسورے مرشد صاحب دا کل نما مہربانی کو کنا ایلم اینو زندہ ہی حاجی فتح دا تو ننا حق سے نی ننا
en: ...like a killer... Murshid Sahib, forgive me, pardon me; because of my men you suffered a great deal and were badly humiliated. Murshid Sahib, it is all thanks to your kindness that my brother is alive today. Haji Fateh, this is only our duty; you are our...
en_old: Like a killer... Murshid Sahib, forgive me, pardon me. My people suffered a lot and were badly humiliated. Murshid Sahib, this is all thanks to your kindness. My brother is alive today. Haji Fateh, this is our right, you are our...

brh: ہمسایہ سوس، ہمسایہ غا بندغ ئنا جان مال کلے لٹائے کک، ببو کانی علم نا سا
en: You were a neighbor, and a neighbor loots all of a person's life and property? Come, let's go...
en_old: You were a neighbor; a neighbor loots everything a person has, life and property... (rest unclear)

brh: ارے کنے نرسہ نی کنے آن بچی سارنگ کاسہ
en: Hey, are you running away from me? Escaping from me, where will you go?
en_old: Hey, running away from me? You can't escape me.

brh: ئے نرسہ، ئے ننے ہوسٹلا چا ہا
en: Hey, are you running away? Hey, we... the hostel... (unclear)
en_old: Hey, running away? Hey, we know the hostel.

brh: شاباش
en: Well done.
en_old: Well done.

brh: ننے تیٹ پچ خنپنے ایت کے او دا دت کے ہلنگٹی ئے نی ولدا دا دت پاریس، نی انتئے دا دت پاریس، نہ نہ نہ اوخپہ اوخپہ اوخپہ کنے ڈاکٹرک پارینو ننے کے اوغنگ جوان افک، نی
en: ...we don't see... talk... and he is taking this thing... You said this again — why did you say this? No, no, no, don't cry, don't cry, don't cry. The doctors have told me that crying is not good for us. You...
en_old: We don't see each other... he's taking this... then you said this again. Why did you say this? No, no, no, oh no, oh no, oh no. The doctors told me crying isn't good for us. You...

brh: ئے دنکہ کڑہ نا دتو کے کنیتے ئے دادے بازار ئے دیوے گڑا نی دنکہ ہمے مہمان تے کے چھاس جوڑ کرک۔ ہو، ٹھیک ٹھیک، شاباش۔ بس صبا۔
en: Hey, like... give me... today to the market... then you, like, make some tea for those same guests. Yes, fine, fine, well done. That's all — tomorrow.
en_old: ...like... bring me... go to the market today, and then, like, make something for those same guests. Yes, okay, okay, well done. That's all, tomorrow.

brh: پئے کنا چنکا ایرے دتی کاتے مئے کیرے ایرتے نا جوڑ کرینے ارے خلک تے دموف کے دو بورے نا جاگہ بے مرچی شاغوتہ کاورفتے کنا پئے کنے
en: Then my little sister... has made the food... and instead of sugar she poured in salt and chilies... my... me...
en_old: My little one has... made... instead of two sacks, put chili... my... me...

brh: سلامت مسونے نی نہ دا جاگہ ء صاف کے۔ عیدے عیدے عیدے عیدے عیدے عیدے عیدے عیدے عید مبارک۔ خیر مبارک کنا
en: It has turned out all right; you, clean this place. Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid Mubarak! Khair Mubarak, my...
en_old: You're well now, so clean this place. Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid Mubarak! Khair Mubarak, my...

brh: دا زکنی نی دے خواپیس دا سا جٹ ئس مرے کائے دے ادریس تھوڑا مٹھائیس دا دے دا دے ہا دا دے ارپت دا دے کل پلیٹ ات ات ئے دے ئے دے ئے دے ئے دے
en: This... you don't want... today. Let it be... a moment... come, Idrees, a few sweets... today, today, yes, today isn't... today bring all the plates, bring... hey, here, hey, here, hey, here, hey, here...
en_old: This... you don't want it today. Now let there be... come today, Idrees, a few sweets. This day, this day, yes, this day isn't... this day, all the plates... today, today, today, today.

brh: او ایلم دا الئے ارا مرغی آ دے رسہ کہ خیر اٹ دا چنار آ سنگت مرغی خانہ منے سنوٹ ایلم عید نا مبارک مرے خیر مبارک خیر مبارک
en: O brother, this... which chicken... with goodness, this is from our friend Chinar's poultry farm... Brother, happy Eid to you! Khair Mubarak, Khair Mubarak!
en_old: Oh brother, this... the chicken... with good wishes, this friend Chinar's poultry farm... Brother, Happy Eid! Khair Mubarak, Khair Mubarak!

brh: نام ایتو مارا خیر مبارک مرے خیر مبارک مرے دا ادی ما گنج خننگ پاک او ما گنج ایڑے چا جوڑ کننگٹی ئے تھنکے کل تا چاخور اوداسی ایرا نو ٹمکے وخت اوئے لو جی اینو مگر نی پارے
en: ...Khair Mubarak to you, Khair Mubarak to you. This sister, Maganj... and Maganj is making tea over there... everyone's tea... meal... time. Oh, here you go, ji. Today, but you said...
en_old: Name... Khair Mubarak to you, Khair Mubarak to you. This sister is... making tea... everyone's tea... time... yes, today, but you said...

brh: بانہ سل سلیپک جی جی جی کنا بائے ارپہ اینو جی تسکہ ونتو جی حکم کبو اوئیلو خیرٹ عیدم بس جی عیدم بس زوئے
en: ...he doesn't stop... yes, yes, yes, my brother isn't here today, yes... gave me... yes, give your orders. Oh brother, Eid has come with goodness too; that's it, yes, Eid has come too, quickly.
en_old: ...yes, yes, yes, my brother isn't here today, yes... yes, at your command. Oh well, Eid has come in peace, yes, Eid has come, quickly.

brh: دا سچونا تا برامے کرف۔ او انتئے دے، انت ننا خوانے۔ میرو۔ جی۔ نی یلہ کاٹو منا ننا جیک سلوکوسے صاب کیسہ بائے کنا اوریسے اینا کنا گلجانئے توار کہ۔ گلجان۔
en: These... their wedding... Oh, why today, what is ours...? Miro! Yes. You leave it... our standing... sir... my brother... go and call my Guljan. Guljan!
en_old: Make... of these. Oh, why today? What is our... Miro. Yes. You left... clean our... my brother... call my Guljan. Guljan!

brh: او کنتو ہیت کننگ خواہپک، مشکل ء خیرات کنتو برے یا توار کیفت۔ نی سلوک سلوک پیش گوئی کننگٹس بفق، نی کنا پینٹ ہشکنتئے بفق او، ارتا مر بفق۔ میرو! جی۔ اینک، بابو نا کمرہ ٹی۔
en: He doesn't want to talk with me; only rarely does he come to me or call. You were... standing... making predictions... you... my trousers... dry... Miro! Yes. Here — in Babu's room.
en_old: He doesn't want to talk to me. He hardly ever comes to me or calls. You were predicting a slap? You didn't dry my pants... Miro! Yes. Here, in Babu's room.

brh: دیر تے او پاتک نا اما توار سن گھٹی شاباش آن ئے کاو ولے مشکل ئے برے شاباش آن او کاو
en: Who... said... your mother... calling... well done... he'll go, but he hardly ever comes. Well done, then he'll go.
en_old: ...well done, he would come from there, but he hardly ever comes. Well done, he would come.

brh: کن کن مٹھائی کن۔ کننگاٹو چاس مسکہ دا مٹھائی تے تون وا کلو متاسے۔ واہ عید نا دے ئے ابا بالکل چام مرک۔ مئی ایڑ کنا خیال پی کہ گل جان میر میر گل جان سخت خدیگ آن
en: Eat, eat, eat the sweets. With the eating, some tea and butter... with these sweets... a kilo... Wow, on Eid day, oh my, it's become completely... My sister, I think Guljan, Mir... Mir Guljan is very...
en_old: Make, make sweets. ...tea with these sweets... a kilo... Wow, father, Eid day is just perfect. My sister, I think Guljan, Mir, Mir Guljan is very stubborn.

brh: انتئے؟ اللہ امانتے مگر کنا مار تو جنگ و جیڑہ والا سے۔ ئے شکر کنا مار باز شریف و سادہ و چنا سے۔ بالکل بالکل نا مار تو باز شریف ئے ہندا خاطر تو سالم کریٹ تے ہا؟ بس کر بس کر بس کر۔ اوئے سالم تپست مانے۔
en: Why? God protect him, but my son is the type for fighting and quarrelling. Thank God, my son is very decent, simple and still a child. Absolutely, absolutely, your son is very decent — that's exactly why I greeted him, right? Stop it, stop it, stop it. Hey, you didn't even greet me.
en_old: Why? God keep him, but my son is a quarrelsome one. Thank God my son is very decent, simple, just a child. Absolutely, absolutely, your son is very decent, that's exactly why I greeted them, huh? Enough, enough, enough. Oh, you didn't even greet me.

brh: یا اللہ یا اللہ انت زلزلہ بس زلزلہ بتو مصیبت مس غضب مس انت مس انت بتو داسہ اینو اینت بتو زوبہ ابو چلک پیڈی دیر دیر مس پنتھ گلجان گلجان ابو کنکے انت مس گلجانئے گلجان
en: O God, O God, what — an earthquake came! Has an earthquake come? A disaster has happened, a calamity has happened! What happened, what has come? Now, today, what has come? Come quickly, father... Guljan, Guljan! Father, what has happened to me? Guljan, Guljan!
en_old: Oh God, oh God, what is it? An earthquake? Was it an earthquake? A disaster, a calamity! What happened? What's come now, today? Quickly, father... it's late, late... Guljan, Guljan! Father, what happened to me? Guljan, Guljan!

brh: ئے مروستو جوان اسہ کٹ آ ہا باغت ہمنے نی کنا مقصد دادے ہلبستے ئے ایڈے پل ہتی ٹی ڈکانے تینے توار خلنگٹی ہمو انتئے کنے خبر اف فکر مست اینا اورفتے لو اورپوتین ابا ابا باٹہ گریا باٹکے
en: Hey... well... at once... in the garden... you, my intention was to take this one... he has hidden here in the... he is calling out to himself... why that is, I don't know; I've become worried... go... to them... father, father...
en_old: ...afterwards, well, on one... you, my aim is this... here... calling out to himself... why, I don't know, worried... father, father...

brh: ئے ابا، ٹکری ابا! ہا، ہا، ہا، انت مس؟ حویلی ٹی دزس بسونے ابا! دزس بسونے؟ جی او، ابا۔ گڑا؟ گڑا، نی ہم کھرے ئس ابا، ئے نا بہادر انگا مسڑ اٹ، کیاری انگا کشتس کشاٹ، خلکوٹ کٹاٹ۔
en: Hey father, Takri father! Yes, yes, yes, what happened? A thief has come into the mansion, father! A thief has come? Yes indeed, father. Then? Then, you too... father, I am your brave daughter: I pulled one out of the flowerbed, struck him and beat him.
en_old: Hey father, Tikri father! Yes, yes, yes, what happened? A thief has come into the mansion, father! A thief has come? Yes, father. So? So you too, father... with your brave daughter, she pulled something out of the flowerbed and struck him with a stick.

brh: کاٹومٹ تے بے ہوش کرستے؟ بے ہوش کرستے؟ او دانت پانے گٹیوس۔ ابا اینا بہادر انگا مسڑ اٹ۔ جوان کرستے، جوان کرستے، سر کس کیرے، جوان، تول تول جوان کرستے، اسے مصیبت ئس تو کم مسک۔ کاٹپا! کاٹپا!
en: You knocked him unconscious with a blow to the head? You knocked him unconscious? Oh, what is he saying... Father, I am your brave daughter. You did well, you did well... good, sit, sit, you did well — at least one trouble is less. Don't cut! Don't cut!
en_old: Did you knock them out with a blow to the head? Knocked them out? He was saying such things. Father, I'm such a brave girl. Well done, well done, sit down, good, sit, sit, well done, at least one trouble is gone. Don't cut! Don't cut!

brh: دے ئس مشت کیس کنا خیال پئے چوٹا اماں کس کوا ایدے بننگٹی سلیم چیانٹ اماں
en: ...a day... in my opinion... little mother, someone is coming here... Salim... a shout, mother.
en_old: A day... in my opinion, little mother... Salim is coming here, mother.

brh: کسکوٹ، دا دے انت؟ ہمو، گلجان، کسکوٹ، ہمو، گلجان، السلام علیکم، لا الہ الا اللہ، الا اللہ
en: I'm dead! What is this? That one, Guljan — I'm dead — that one, Guljan. Peace be upon you. There is no god but God, but God.
en_old: Kaskot, what is this? That, Gul Jan, Kaskot, that, Gul Jan, peace be upon you, there is no god but God, but God.

brh: دا رنگ کسکوٹ دا رنگ نو گلجان گلجان خیرات مریو نا خنت گلجان ئے دادٹ چپ کے بدتمیز کنے ئس نوکر نی دیر اجازت تس اوڑے صوفہ غا تولو نا خن پی کے دانا مزغ م اینا اینا جی کس
en: This is how I died, this is how... Guljan, Guljan, may I be sacrificed for your eyes, Guljan. Hey, shut up with this, you rude one, you're a servant — who gave you permission to sit there on the sofa? ...his brain too... go, go, yes...
en_old: This colour, Kaskot, this colour is yours, Gul Jan, Gul Jan, I'd give my life for your eyes, Gul Jan, shut up here, you rude one, you're my servant, who gave you permission? Sit there on the sofa... his brain... yes...

brh: خشت ئے گلجان ایڑے پٹینگٹ گلجان ہتہ مس ہتہ مس کنا مارے آ تاتا مانگنج نی ہم مسس برخوداتے تاتا مانگنج راکان لمہ اوٹنا
en: A brick... Guljan, I'm searching there... Guljan, bring it... it's come onto my son... Tata Manganj, you too have become... the kids... Tata Manganj... mother...
en_old: A brick, Gul Jan, hit the sister... Gul Jan, it got brought, brought... on my son... you too became... the boys... mother...

brh: امہ، امہ نا خشتس خلکنے امہ، کنا کاٹمٹ گڑا خشتس خلکنے امہ۔ ابو ئے کنک ایلو، ڈاکٹرے درتہ۔ آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے ڈاکٹرے درتہ، ڈاکٹرے۔ امیرو، جی! میرو اینا زو گاڈیٹ ڈاکٹرے درتہ، شاباش۔
en: Mom, mom, a brick has hit me, mom; a brick hit me right on my head, mom. Father... fetch the doctor. Ow, ow, ow, ow, ow, fetch the doctor, the doctor. O Miro! Yes! Miro, go quickly by car and fetch the doctor, well done.
en_old: Mom, Mom, someone threw a brick at me, Mom, a brick hit me on the head, Mom. Dad, call the doctor. Ow, ow, ow, ow, ow, call the doctor, the doctor. Amiro! Yes! Miro, go quickly in the car and bring the doctor, well done.

brh: اما! اما! ننا گاڈی ء۔ او ننا کل ء۔ ئے ڈرائیور ء پا، زو کر۔ ئے ڈرائیور ء پا۔ گڑا جولن جول کن، دین تے پیش تم۔ بٹ کبو تے، بٹ کبو تے۔ آئی دے! ہو بس کنا مسٹ۔ تا کبو تے، تا کبو تے۔ تا کبو تے، نی۔
en: Mom! Mom! Our car. And all of ours. Hey, tell the driver to hurry. Hey, tell the driver. Then... come out... Do it to him, do it to him. Ow! Yes, enough, my... Do it to him, do it to him. Do it to him, you.
en_old: Mom! Mom! Our car. And all of us. Tell the driver to hurry up. Tell the driver. Then... take them out. Hit them, hit them. Ow! Yes, enough, my son. Hit them, hit them. Hit them, you.

brh: مجھے تو اندازہ نہیں تھا کہ ڈابلا تم اتنا چالاک ہو۔ ابھی تو تمہیں اندازہ ہو گیا ڈابلا کتنا چالاک ہی کتنا
en: I had no idea, Dabla, that you were so clever. Well, now you've found out how clever Dabla is, how
en_old: I had no idea, Dabla, that you were so clever. Now you know how clever Dabla is, how clever.

brh: چالاک ہی واہ ڈابلا وا واہ ڈابلا وا تم تو بہت چالاک انسان ہو
en: clever he is. Wow, Dabla, wow, wow, Dabla, wow, you're a very clever person.
en_old: Clever! Wow, Dabla, wow, wow, Dabla, you are a very clever person.

brh: ابھی چلیں تھوڑا بیٹھیں آرام کرین ابھی آرام کا ٹائم نہیں ہی آرام نہیں کرین گے چلو چلیں آج غلام خان سے
en: Let's go now, let's sit a little and rest. Now is not the time for rest; we won't rest. Come on, let's go — today with Ghulam Khan
en_old: Let's go now, let's sit a little and rest. It's not time to rest now, we won't rest. Come on, let's go, today with Ghulam Khan

brh: دشمنی کے شروعات کرین گے چلو چلیں
en: we'll start the feud. Come on, let's go.
en_old: we will start the feud. Come on, let's go.

brh: ادا خیری آ نما؟ ننے آ تو خیر ئے لیکن نا خیر اف پینوں۔ ادا خیری آ نما ہمے دا بس روکنا علم تو دو لخی کرین او بس روکنا مون ہریرے۔ او دو لخی تو ڈابلا نا ادا۔ ڈابلا اجازت ئے اسکو گولی سے ماردو؟
en: Brother, is all well with you? With us all is well, but you're not well... Brother, is all well with you? This very... Do Lakhi... and just look at the face of... That Do Lakhi is Dabla's brother. Dabla, do I have permission? Shall I shoot him?
en_old: Brother, are you well? We're fine, but you're not well... Brother, are you well? We broke it into two pieces and... its face... That one is Dabla's brother. Dabla, may I shoot him?

brh: خدا تو ڈبل نہ ڈبل بات کرتا ہی نہ سنتا ہی تم خاموش رہو
en: By God, Dabla doesn't — Dabla neither talks nor listens. You keep quiet.
en_old: God, Dabla neither talks nor listens. You keep quiet.

brh: اللہ! تم نی میرے بھائی کو کیوں مارا؟
en: Oh God! Why did you kill my brother?
en_old: Oh God! Why did you kill my brother?

brh: خلتہ خلوک شٹپتہ حاضر دا ہرا دا داسکان خلوک ایہ
en: Struck, struck... [unclear]... here he is — this one, this is the one who has been hitting until now.
en_old: The one who hit... is present, this is the one who's been hitting until now.

brh: دا ہن تنے بابو خان نی دے بابو خان
en: This one hasn't gone, Babu Khan — you, hey, Babu Khan.
en_old: Like this, Babu Khan, you, Babu Khan.

brh: کنا مسلے ئے دا خلکنا
en: My problem is the problem of these people.
en_old: These people's problem is my problem.

brh: چنا، بلا، پیر، ورنا، بیمار، ناجوڑ، نکسرہ اور کنا مسٹ
en: Children, elders, the old, the young, the sick, the ailing, [unclear], and my daughter.
en_old: Children, the elderly, old and young, the sick, the ill, the poor, and my daughter.

brh: نیکن تو نا وار
en: As for you, it's your turn.
en_old: Then it's your turn.

brh: ارا وخت کہ ننا کسرک جتا مسنو گڑا اوار بننگنان فینل اچھا آ
en: Once our paths have separated, then — as for coming back together — it's final, okay?
en_old: When our paths have parted, coming back together is final, okay.

brh: آپ کے والد کا کیا نام تھا؟ عبداللہ۔ یاد ئے نمے کلے۔ اچھا آپ کے والدہ کا کیا نام تھا؟ حضرت بے بے آمنہ۔ دا نمے یاد ئے شاباش کنا چناک۔
en: What was his father's name? Abdullah. Do you all remember the name? Okay, what was his mother's name? Hazrat Bibi Amina. You remember this name — well done, my children.
en_old: What was your father's name? Abdullah. You all remember it. Okay, what was your mother's name? Hazrat Bibi Amina. You remember this, well done, my children.

brh: ایو راٹی نی کلہ ویشے ئے ئے بالکل تنیا سوٹ کنا مسٹ تنیا
en: In that house you... [unclear] ... I was completely alone, my daughter, alone.
en_old: Mother, in this house you... I was completely alone, my daughter, alone.

brh: دا کنے پیش تپوس پاروس بابا ئے کنے پیش تپوس
en: You should have told me this earlier, father — told me earlier.
en_old: You didn't tell me this before, father, you didn't tell me before.

brh: خوش پاروس بابا، ولے ئے تے نا توختے اسل برباد کپرا، زیبا بیرا نن تینا زندگی سوچ کین۔
en: You say it cheerfully, Baba, but I won't waste my time at all; Zeba, let's think only about our own life.
en_old: You said it happily, father, but don't waste your time at all, Zeba. We'll think about our own life.

brh: دا خلک نا چنا کم ننا چنا کو اگر دافتا مستقبل کے نن سوچ کتون تو گڑا دیر سوچ کروئی کنے بیرہ تینا مسڑ نا مستقبل نا سوچ کروئیے او بس باز افسوس نا ہیت اسے وا
en: These people's children are our children too. If we don't think about their future, then who should think about it? Should I think only about my own daughter's future, and that's it? That's a very regrettable thing.
en_old: These people's children are our children too. If we don't think about their future, then who will? Should I only think about my own daughter's future and that's it? That's a very sad thing.

brh: انت مس اباجی انت سے؟ پا انت مس سوب نا دہ منٹ گڈ ئس گدری خاچانوس۔ نی کالج اینو یفک؟ ابا کالج؟ ہا، اباس پا کالج ہموڑے کنا مستقبل ئے ہمودے پارہ کالج۔ پہمسس؟
en: What happened, Abaji, what is it? Tell me what happened — it's ten minutes past in the morning and you're still asleep. Aren't you going to college today? College, Abba? Yes — Abba says college; my future is right there, that's what he says: college. Understood?
en_old: What happened, Dad, what is it? Tell me what happened. It's ten minutes past and you're still asleep. Aren't you going to college today? College, Dad? Yes, Dad, he says college. My future is right there, he says, college. Understood?

brh: دم دریفینوس تینے بس داسہ نی آرام کرک۔ او ابا اٹ مٹ کرے دا اوراٹی تنے آئی ٹی مرک نا گواچی کروس۔ دنوئی تنتے کیسہ۔
en: You've worn yourself out; that's enough, now you rest. Oh father, how long [will this go on]? In this house you'll make yourself a victim of death. Is this what you do to yourself?
en_old: Take a breath, just rest now. And father gestured... In this house you were made a victim of... Is this how you do things?

brh: اما انتسے نا کمی دا وراٹی ئے اریٹ دا نوکر آ کرٹ انتئے نت نی اوس ارے کمی ابا ارے کمی کنا مار ملخوڑ سینہ کمی
en: But what is lacking? I'm here in this house, I've taken on this servant, so why... you're... — There is something lacking, son, there is something lacking, my son: the lack of a daughter-in-law.
en_old: Mother, what's missing? I'm here in this house, I made this one a servant. Why, you're here. Is something missing, father? Yes, something's missing, my son... something's missing.

brh: دا لیڈی ڈاکٹر ڈسپنسری ء امر مرانی۔ دنیا نا ڈاکٹر آک دڑے بسور و سے ہفتہ ئس ہٹ کریر ہنار۔ دا لیڈی ڈاکٹر دستخط و لوک ء۔
en: How will this lady doctor manage at the dispensary? Doctors from all over the world came here, stayed a week or so and left. This lady doctor has signed [on]...
en_old: How will this lady doctor work at the dispensary? Doctors have come here from all over, stayed for a week and left. This lady doctor has signed...

brh: کمال کے سمیر بہروز خان، داڑے کئی ڈاکٹر آک بسورینار، نی انت پاسے، دا ڈاکٹر ہم دا خلقت تولوک مرو دا مخلوق نا خدمت ئے کرو، مننگ کپک۔
en: Really, Mir Behroz Khan! Many doctors have come here and gone. What do you say — will this doctor too stay settled in this village and serve these people? It can't happen.
en_old: Kamal, Sameer Behroz Khan, many doctors have come here and gone. What do you say, will this doctor also stay with these people and serve them? It can't happen.

brh: مخلوق نا خدمت ء کے یا کپ۔ دا دے ایر دنیا تو ترقی کننگ اٹی ارک۔ انور کنا ایلم، وخت ء
en: Whether she serves the people or not. These days the world is progressing. Anwar, my brother, time...
en_old: Serve the people or don't. These days the world is moving forward. Anwar, my brother, time...

brh: دا تیر مس دہ پھسکنا وختی اینو پگنا نیاڑی زندنا ہر گامٹ نرینہ غتونا واری دا گپ ئے دے پومسوس یا نہ جوانی اٹ پومریوے دا دور اینو پگنا نیاڑی نرینہ غتوار گامٹ مون مستی سلوکو ہیتس پاپنے ابا ہا استو کمرہ ٹی پشیس بسوس
en: Gone is the time when the idea that today's woman should be equal to men at every step of life was either not understood or not understood well. In this era, today's woman stands moving forward in step with men — it's not just talk. Father, yes, someone has come; they're in the guest room.
en_old: Ten years have passed. In the past, the idea that today's woman should walk alongside men at every step of life was either not understood or not understood well. In this era, today's woman stands shoulder to shoulder with men. Father, someone has come and is sitting in the guest room.

brh: ئے انکھلیز کنے توار کریرے داسہ دا ترقی کرو اندازہ۔ خیرے نم کنتو ملنگ کے بسنورے۔ جی صاب کنا پن نورے ڈاکٹر نور۔ ماشاءاللہ۔
en: [Unclear]... you called me. Now this [place] will progress, I reckon. Well then, you've come to meet me? Yes sir, my name is Noor — Doctor Noor. Mashallah.
en_old: ...you called me, now that's a sign of progress. Anyway, you've come to meet me. Yes, sir, my name is Noor, Doctor Noor. Mashallah.

brh: دا تو باز جوان وئی تسی۔ نم تینا درستی راستی کن تو کرفتہ وئی رے۔ نی صاب، ئے نما بسگر رحیم داد نا مسڑ وٹ۔ کنا لما باوا بیماری نا وجہ خان مر
en: That's all very good, but you haven't introduced yourself. Sir, I am the daughter of your tenant Rahim Dad. My mother and father, because of illness, died...
en_old: That's very good. You should introduce yourself. Sir, I am the daughter of your tenant Rahim Dad. My mother and father, because of illness, died...

brh: مرگ نا گواچی مسر۔ ماسٹر ماما محبوب کنے خوانیفے۔ او داسہ ئے ڈاکٹر اٹ۔ او دا خلق نا خدمت کن بسونٹ۔ ماشاءاللہ۔ دا تو باز
en: ...fell victim to death. Master Mama Mehboob, my maternal uncle, educated me. And now I am a doctor, and I have come to serve this village. Mashallah. That's very...
en_old: ...they passed away. Uncle Master Mehboob educated me. Now I am a doctor. I have come to serve the people of this area. Mashallah. That's very...

brh: خوشینی داسے ہر دو چا کہ کنا لمہ باوہ زندہ او انتئے کہ نی تینا محنت آن اوفتے پین ئس زندہ کرینوس اینو نا خدمت کننگ کن
en: I'm glad — now it's as though both my mother and father were alive, because you, through your hard work, have brought them to life once again, to serve [people] today.
en_old: It's a joy now. It's as if my mother and father are alive, because through your hard work you've brought them back to life, to serve...

brh: میر صاحب نم دا علاقہ نا بلا اورے خلق نا مخلوق نمے آن بھلو امید ئس تخک او دا ہفتہ حق مرے جی کلمہ صاحب نی پانے نا انت خواس میر صاحب
en: Mir sahib, you are the elder of this area; the people of the village hold great hope in you, and that is their right. Yes, [unclear] sahib, tell me, what do you want? Mir sahib...
en_old: Mir sahib, you are the elder of this area. The people of the area have great hope in you, and that is their right. Yes, Kalma sahib, tell me what you want. Mir sahib...

brh: ئے تو ہندا بندغ آ ڈسپنسری ء ملنگ خواہوا تاکہ داڑے مخلوق نا علاج مرے دا تو باز جوان ء ہیتس ء اینا اجازت نا کدری کیو او ہسی تو پاو نی
en: I want to open this closed dispensary so that the people here can get treatment. That's a very good thing. I would honour [your request for] permission — and let me tell you, you...
en_old: I want to open a dispensary right here, so that the people here can be treated. That's a very good thing. With your permission, I... and tell me...

brh: نی نیاری اسے ئس دا جاگہ نا مخلوق ذرہ سادہ ئے ناپوہ ئے نی برداشت کپرو۔ او کنا مسئلہ ئے میر صاحب۔ نم بیرا دن کبو کہ محکمہ صحت آن کنا پوسٹنگ ء انداڑے کرفبو۔
en: You are a woman. The people of this place are a bit simple and ignorant; you won't be able to bear it. That's my problem, Mir sahib. You just do this much: have my posting made here by the Health Department.
en_old: You are a woman. The people of this place are a bit simple and ignorant. You won't be able to put up with it. That's my problem, Mir sahib. Please do this: have the health department post me here.

brh: اوئے رو دارو تا بندوبست ئے کبو تاکہ ئے زوت آن زوت تینا فرض ئے پورا کیو۔ ہمم ٹھیک ئے نم تینا کاریم ئے شروع کبو انشاءاللہ زوت آن زوت نما پوسٹنگ ئے داری
en: And please arrange for medicines so that I can fulfil my duty as soon as possible. Hmm, all right, you start your work; God willing, your posting will come through here as soon as possible.
en_old: Please arrange for medicines so that I can fulfill my duty as soon as possible. Hmm, all right, start your work. God willing, your posting will be done as soon as possible.

brh: ئے صاحب نا باز مہربانی۔ دا تے مہربانی نا نتیجہ سے۔ دا کنا خلق ئے ئے خواوہ کہ دا کنا خلق نا مخلوق آسودہ مرے، آسرات مرے، اوفتے صحت نا سہولیات رسینگے۔
en: Thank you very much, sir. This is the result of your kindness. This is my village; I want the people of my village to be prosperous and comfortable, and to receive health facilities.
en_old: Thank you very much, sir. This is the result of your kindness. This is my area. I want the people of my area to be prosperous and comfortable, and to get health facilities.

brh: اور انتیکہ کنے تینا خلق نا مخلوق کنے تینا اولاد نا بارٹ دوستی۔ میر صاحب کنے نمے آن اندا امید اسکا۔ کنا مسٹ دا حویلی نا دروزہ غٹ کن ہروخت ملو ء۔ دے آن ضرورت ئس مس، انتس کاریم ئس مس، کنے ہروخت بننگ کیرے۔
en: And because I love the people of my village like my own children. Mir sahib, this is exactly what I expected from you. My daughter, the doors of this mansion will always be open for you. If you ever need anything, any work at all, you can always come to me.
en_old: And because I love the people of my area like my own children. Mir sahib, this is exactly what I expected from you. The doors of this mansion will always be open to my daughter. If you ever need something or have any work, you can always come to me.

brh: ضروری پاوا۔ داسہ کنے اجازت ئے نن ادون مننگ کپک۔ دادا ویلینا دودے کہ دا کان بغیر چائے غان کس ہننگ کپک۔ نی چائے ور
en: I certainly will. Now please give me leave. No, that can't be. It's the custom of this mansion that no one leaves here without tea. Do have some tea.
en_old: ...had to say it. Now please excuse me, we can't stay any longer. It's the custom of this mansion that no one leaves without tea. Have some tea.

brh: ارغ کنت، واللہ آن شاء اللہ نی، نامے صاب دانا ضرورت اف۔ نم کنا ہیتے خف توریرے عمل کریرے دا کنکن باز بلو گڑاسے۔ ارغ اچا ولدا کنیوہ داسہ کنے باز کاریم کروئی۔
en: Have something to eat, by God — God willing... No, Mir sahib, there's no need for that. You listened to what I said and acted on it; that's a very big thing for me. As for food — okay, I'll eat another time; right now I have a lot of work to do.
en_old: Have something to eat, by God... God willing you... No, sir, there's no need. You listened to what I said and acted on it, and that means a great deal to me. I'll eat some other time; right now I have a lot of work to do.

brh: جی انشااللہ کنے تین پہ وار خنوری۔ مہربانی میر صاحب، ننتون ملاقات نا خوشی مس۔ داسہ کنے اجازت۔
en: Yes, God willing, you will see me again another time. Thank you, Mir sahib, it was a pleasure meeting you. Now, with your permission, I'll take my leave.
en_old: Yes, God willing, you'll see me again. Thank you, Mir sahib, it was a pleasure meeting you. Now please excuse me.

brh: فراز؟ جی اما۔
en: Faraz? Yes, Mom.
en_old: Faraz? Yes, Mom.

brh: دا ہم کنا مار، دا تول، کنا مار اسہ جوان ء مسڑ اسے۔ انت سے کہ قران کریم تیکے؟ ہانے۔
en: This is my son too. Sit here. My son, she is a good girl. And what's more, she teaches the Holy Quran? Yes.
en_old: This is my son too. Sit down. My son, she's a nice girl. Does she recite the Holy Quran? Yes.

brh: او ہرا نا کاریم تے کہ تینا ملخوڈ کننگ کے ملخوڈ کننگ کے اسیتس پا کنے اما مچنگا دے نی ہراٹی اوس دا مسٹ ئے ہراڑے خنانوس او
en: And whose doing is it, that you want to make her your daughter-in-law, to make her your daughter-in-law? Tell me one thing, Mom: where were you all day? Where did you see this girl?
en_old: And whose work is it... to meet... to meet... tell me something, Mom. The other day, where were you? Where did you see this girl?

brh: داڑے برے کوراغہ ہاں تینٹ اراغہ بریک ہاؤ دا ہمار ودی مسے ابا تون کہ کنے پلاتا شوق ئے نا اودیم پلاتا شوق ئے بریک انداڑے کنے
en: She comes here, to the house. Yes, she comes to the house by herself. Yes, this came about with ... because I have a love for flowers, and she too has a love for flowers; that's how she comes here to me.
en_old: Come here in the evening... yes, she cooks the food herself... yes, this son was born like his father, he's passionate about flowers. Just like me, he has a passion for flowers...

brh: دا پنیری دے۔ جان، دا پنیری تننگ کے برے کوراغا نی دوست ہم بس او دا سمل خورم کنے کے تیار مسوسا نی او، دیر اسیدا مسوسا نی ننا ہمسائے نا پروفیسر جمال او نمسوسا نی
en: These are plants (seedlings). Dear, she came to the house to give these seedlings, and your friend came too, and she had got this hyacinth ready for me... who was she? Our neighbor Professor Jamal's (daughter)...
en_old: These are seedlings. Dear, come in the evening to deliver these seedlings. Your friend came too, and he had prepared this food for me... you were late... our neighbor, Professor Jamal...

brh: شبانہ اچھا پروفیسر جمال چاوتہ باز جوان و بندہ اسے یقینا اونا مسڑ ہم باز جوان مروئی ولے اماں نی یاد ئے ہمو دے اینی تو
en: Shabana? Oh, Professor Jamal - I know him, he is a very good man; surely his daughter must be very good too. But Mom, do you remember that day, when...
en_old: Shabana, okay, I know Professor Jamal is a very good man, and his daughter is surely very good too, but Mother, do you remember that day when you came...

brh: ڈاکٹر نور نا عید گریٹ او دا وختہ خلک کٹیے او اما اوڑن بیدس ئے کسسے تون برام کپرا
en: ...Dr. Noor's Eid greeting, and at that time ... and Mom, apart from her I will not marry anyone.
en_old: Dr. Noor sent his Eid greetings, and this time he said he won't marry anyone but her.

brh: اگا ڈاکٹر نور خلک انداڑے شارا بتو گڑا مچا زنی برام کپسہ؟ دونویت کپا اما ڈاکٹر نور
en: If Dr. Noor never comes here to the city, then will you not marry your whole life? Don't say that, Mom. Dr. Noor...
en_old: If Dr. Noor said he would bring her here to the city, then won't you get married at all? Don't do that, Mother, Dr. Noor...

brh: کنا زندی بس بس کنا مار اللہ ہدایت کے
en: ...is my life. Enough, enough, my son, may God guide you.
en_old: My life... enough, enough, my son, may God guide him.

brh: شاباس نا لمہ، ارے نی دا انور نا کمرہ ٹی؟ بس کنا کاٹم خل خل کرے کدا ارے بس سوٹ مچے خاچ اٹ۔ تمنہ تو جوانی نی
en: Well done, mother (of the children)! Oh, you're here in Anwar's room? My head was just pounding, so I lay down here and slept a little. Is your health all right?
en_old: Well done, mother of... are you in Anwar's room? He just kept pestering me, asking where it is. Just go to sleep for a while. Tamana, are you well?

brh: کنا دوست کنا طبیعت جوان مرے یا خراب مرے نہ نہ دونو ہیت کپہ اللہ نی سلامت کے نی تو کنا زند ئس گولی مولی کنس گولی مولی کنو پارہ کنے گولی نا ضرورت اف
en: My friend, whether my health is good or bad... No, no, don't talk like that; may God keep you safe, you are my life. Pills and such - did you take your pills? 'Take pills,' you say - I don't need pills.
en_old: My friend, whether my health is good or bad... no, no, don't talk like that, may God keep you safe, you are my life. Pills and such... don't talk about pills, I don't need pills.

brh: نی ینک بس متی پین آرام کیوا۔ آرام کیسا؟ اینا خدمت کیو۔ جمال مچا دے دا چنا تے کیرے جنگ و جھیڑا کیرا۔ دا ہفتہ کوکار و صلوات تیان کیرے کنا کاٹم خلکنے۔
en: You go; I'll just rest a little more. Rest? Today I'll look after you. Jamal, these children fight and quarrel all day long. This week, with their shouting and carrying on, they've given me a headache.
en_old: You've just come, rest a bit more. Rest? I'll take care of you. Jamal, these children fight and quarrel all day. This whole week, with all the shouting, they've been driving me crazy.

brh: کنگٹیا سگا، اندا خاطر داڑے بسٹ مچا آرام کریٹ۔ ہسی دستو پاو نی کنا واجہ ارٹ تو نا کاٹم خل، کنگٹیا فک عید نی تو اسل جنگ نتن اوٹ۔ مچا زنتو نی ہم کنا تو جنگ کرینوس، ہر عید تا زی آ نی کنا تو
en: I couldn't bear it, that's why I came here and rested a little. Just tell me straight: are you my husband, or a headache? This Eid I haven't fought with you at all. All your life you too have fought with me; on every Eid you have (fought) with me...
en_old: I'm worn out, that's why I came here and rested all day. Just tell me, are you my husband, or are you here to pester me? This Eid I won't fight with you at all. You've been fighting with me all day too, every Eid you fight with me...

brh: جنگ کرینوس، امر دے جنگ کتونوس؟ ہا، نہ، دونو ہیت ئس افک، ئے تو جنگ جھیڑا کپرا، ئے تو مہر کیو، ہندا جنگ جھیڑا تون ننا جوان زند گدرینگانے، او دعا کیو کہ ننا چناتا زند ہم ہندن، نی امر کرے امر گدرینگے
en: ...fought. Which day have you not fought? Yes - no, it's nothing like that: I don't fight and quarrel, I love you. It's with this very fighting and quarreling that our life has passed well. And pray that our children's life is the same - however you make it, that's how it passes.
en_old: Did we fight? Which day didn't we fight? Yes, no, it's not like that. Sometimes we fight, sometimes we love each other, and with all this fighting and quarreling our life has gone well. Pray that our children's lives turn out the same way. Whatever you did, however it went...

brh: اچھا ندن کر آرام کر پرواہ سلف ئے نیکن دوتے چائے جوڑ کیوہ تینا دومٹ سہی؟ چمر ندن کر نداڑے تو ئے کیرٹ جوان مریوٹے
en: Okay, do this: rest, don't worry; I'll make tea for you with my own hands, all right? Look, do this... here I'll ..., you'll be fine.
en_old: Okay, do this: rest, don't worry, I'll make tea for you with my own hands, all right? Look, do this, I'll take care of it here, it'll be fine.

brh: اماں باواں پد ہتس کہ مہر نی کنے تسوٹ کنے دن لگے کہ دنیا نا
en: After Mom and Dad, the love you gave me made me feel as though all of the world's...
en_old: After Mother and Father, the love you gave me made me feel like the world's...

brh: آ کل گڑاک ہنرسنگا کل مہر کن ہنرسنگا بس نی کنے آن غصہ کپیسہ ارا دے نی کنے آن غصہ کریس نی ئے دا دنیا ٹی سلیپر وٹک خوش ہس نی بس ئے تولہ گٹ کنا مہر
en: ...things had come to me - all of it came through love. You just never get angry with me. The day you get angry with me, I ... in this world ... happy... Just sit, my love.
en_old: I learned all these things, I learned them all for love. Just don't get angry with me. The day you get angry with me, you... in this world... slippers... happy... just sit down, my love.

brh: ئے نما تول ئے نما تول ئے نی اریو نی کنے او صحیح ہی ہاں نی چاس جوڑ کے بر نہ بس کنا گورا تول تک ئے تیڈٹ جوڑ مریو اللہ سلامت کے نی اللہ خوش تے خیر کے نی ئے نڑے امین
en: Sit, sit. You are ... to me... Oh, right, yes - you make some tea and come back. No, just sit beside me; I'll get well by myself. May God keep you safe, may God keep you happy and well. Amen.
en_old: Come sit, sit, you are... to me... all right, yes, you make tea and come. No, just sit next to me... May God keep you safe, may God keep you happy and well... Amen.

brh: اسلام علیکم۔ گودی، کنا مطلب ڈاکٹر صاحبہ، کلو آن زیات کاریم ئے کرینوٹ داڑے، چپ کڑئے الئی انت کریٹ اسو؟
en: Assalamu alaikum. Madam, I mean Doctor Sahiba, I have done more work here than anyone. Hush... what is it you have done?
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wife, I mean Doctor Sahiba, I've done more work here than anyone. What were you doing sitting there quietly?

brh: چاغہ چا کنیسہ خاچیسہ پین ہند کریسہ، گودی نم مچا زند ہنداری مرو رے، بالکل، نم اسل شاران پیری ہسنہ، گڑا گودی اسہ کاری مسکبو
en: You drink tea, sleep and do other such things. Madam, will you stay like this your whole life? Absolutely. You've really grown old away from the city. So, madam, do one thing.
en_old: Drinking tea, sleeping, doing other things. Wife, will you spend your whole life like this? Absolutely, you've grown old away from the city. So, wife, do one thing.

brh: انت کاری گڑا گودی اسہ کاری بس نم پین کبو۔ نم اناڑے برام کبو۔ ایلو کنا مطلب دادے برام ہم ضروری ئے نی
en: What thing? So, madam, just do one more thing: get married here. I mean, is marriage necessary for this too?
en_old: What thing? So, wife, just do one more thing. Get married here. I mean, marriage is necessary for you too.

brh: ایٹ ضروری او، دا ڈسپنسری نا چلیفنگ باز ضروری او۔ ڈاکٹر صاحبہ نم اسیکارے مس پین کبو، او آن نم اسے ڈاکٹر ئس داڑے پین بٹنگبو، داڑے ڈاکٹر
en: It is necessary; running this dispensary is very necessary. Doctor Sahiba, do one more thing: then call another doctor here, a doctor here...
en_old: It's very necessary, running this dispensary is very necessary. Doctor Sahiba, do one more thing: bring in another doctor to settle here, a doctor here...

brh: ڈاکٹر پفک ڈاکٹر پفک گڑا نرسس خوائبو او انکے کنکے مطلب دا ئے برام کیو ایتوتے او کرے نرس مرے ئے کمپوڈر مریوے او کنا خیال اٹ تخے ئے اونا خیال اٹ تخوے
en: If a doctor doesn't come, doesn't come, then call for nurses, and I mean, I'll marry one of them: she'll be the nurse and I'll be the compounder; she'll look after me and I'll look after her.
en_old: If there's no doctor, no doctor, then ask for nurses. I mean, marry someone like that, whoever it is, a nurse or a compounder, who will take care of me and take care of her.

brh: اللہ مخلوق نا خدمت ء دیر کیک، مخلوق نا خدمت ء، نم، کنا مطلب نن کل، بس ہیت باز کرے، امبو کاریم کبو، ئے تو نمے سلاہ تسٹ مونا نما مرضی
en: God greatly values service to His creation, service to creation. You - I mean all of us - just talk a lot; now get to work. I have given you my advice; from here on it's up to you.
en_old: God greatly loves serving His creation. Serving creation... you, I mean all of us, have just talked a lot. Now do the work. I've given you my advice; from here on it's your choice.

brh: گان شو، چا چا چا چا چا چا چا، بسم اللہ، بسم اللہ، آہا ہا ہا ہا، کنا مسڑ
en: ... Tea, tea, tea, tea, tea, tea, tea! In the name of God, in the name of God! Aha-ha-ha-ha, my daughter.
en_old: Sing a song, cha cha cha cha cha cha cha, Bismillah, Bismillah, aha ha ha ha, my daughter.

brh: ئے باریٹ کہ ئے ہم تینا فرض ادا کیٹ چا دانے بیٹ کریٹ چا تیار کریٹ ئے چھٹی پکھنا مسٹ دم دننگانے ہنا خاطر آن چا تیسوٹ ماما ایلو تے ہم چا تیسورے
en: I said that I too should do my duty: I put on the teapot, I made the tea. During the break everyone had gotten tired, and that's why I gave tea. Uncle, did you give tea to the others too?
en_old: I said I'd do my duty too. I made the tea, prepared the tea. During the break, when everyone was resting, that's why I gave tea. Uncle, I gave tea to the others too.

brh: نی نی بے بے جی نی کنا مطلب ڈاکٹر صاحبہ ایو دا شوم چاکون تنن ہمارڑے شوم سئی باز ماما دا فتی ہم چائت ماما مجبوری تے صحت کیس ہاؤ اینا دے پورنا گھانٹہ تولوک
en: You, you, Bebe ji, you - I mean Doctor Sahiba - this evening we'll give tea; there in the evening, a lot... Uncle, these ones want tea too. Uncle, out of necessity you take care of health... Yes, today, the whole day, sitting for a full hour...
en_old: You, you, Bebe ji, you — I mean Doctor Sahiba — this evening we'll give tea. There in the evening a lot... uncle, these ones also want tea. Uncle, it's out of necessity, for health. Yes, today the whole day, hour after hour...

brh: بورا ہیت زیات کیس پین دا زرہ غا بورا تیٹ کنا نت غا نغل تو بو دا دے بورا ہراٹی گڑا نا زیات جنگ ہکیرے داڑے بورا زیات شاس مرغے
en: When you're bored you talk too much... more on this... my foot... today, bored... where there is more fighting over things, here one gets even more bored.
en_old: You talked too much about being tired. Then on this heart, among the tired ones, my feet... today the tired one, in which there's a lot of fighting over things, here the tired one has become very...

brh: مزہ نی مزہ نی نہ نہ او شار کنے لنگڑی با خلقونے او شیرانے ہلی ہمو مزہ کنے تو مزہ کینگو ابورارے تا پورے بورارے تا ہاو
en: Fun? You call it fun? No, no - that city has left me starving... that fun - for me, fun... they're bored, completely bored, yes.
en_old: Fun? You call it fun? No, no, that city has made me lame. Those lions... that fun, for me fun doesn't... they're tired, completely tired, yes.

brh: اڑے شبانہ بس نی تو جائی اوغنگٹی ئس ہرک ہندن کہ نا پگہ سالگرہ ء ہندنا سدے
en: Hey Shabana, enough, you're actually crying! Look, it's like this: tomorrow is your birthday, [unclear]...
en_old: Hey Shabana, you were just about to cry, and tomorrow is your birthday...

brh: داسہ نا برام مروئی اور ہندن دو لوچا پٹی تے نا ایڑ رخصت کروٹ کنا زندگی نا مو کل آن جوانینگا دے مروئی انور نی سلا سلا دستوں رستہ ہمبیتسہ سدیس
en: Now your wedding is to take place, and in the same way I will send off my own sister [unclear words]; it will be the best day of my life. Anwar, you [unclear]...
en_old: Now there will be a celebration, and I'll say goodbye like this... It will be the best day of my life. Anwar, you... the road...

brh: اراک نا سفر؟
en: Where are you travelling to?
en_old: Where is the trip to?

brh: کنا مسڑ، کاریم کے منیٹی ہا؟
en: My daughter, are you (still) working?
en_old: My daughter, have you done the work?

brh: بس کر کنا ماما، داسہ آرام کرک۔ لا ماما، کنے باز کاریم کروئی ئے اسہ اسہ گڑانا لسٹ جوڑ کروئی ئے تاکہ کل داروک بریر و ہسپتال تینا کاریم شروع کے۔ او کنا مسڑ۔
en: Enough, my dear, rest now. — No, Uncle, I have a lot of work to do; I have to make a list of each and every thing so that all the medicines come and the hospital can start its work. — Oh, my daughter.
en_old: Stop it, my mother, rest now. No, mother, I have a lot of work to do; I have to make a list of each and every thing so that all the medicines arrive and the hospital can start its work. Oh, my daughter.

brh: انشاء اللہ دا ہسپتال ضرور کاریمے شروع کرو، او کاریم کل مکمل مرو، مگر دانا مطلب دا اف کہ نی نی تنے بیمار کرک۔
en: God willing, this hospital will certainly start its work, and all the work will be completed, but that doesn't mean you should make yourself ill.
en_old: God willing, this hospital will definitely start working, and all the work will be completed, but that doesn't mean you should make yourself ill.

brh: داسہ آرام کرک، پگہ آن شاء اللہ دا لسٹ تے نا مکمل کرک، ٹھیک خنا ماسی؟ جان ماما، امر کہ نامرسی؟ ئے شاباش، اللہ نی آباد کے شاباش۔
en: Rest now; from tomorrow, God willing, finish this list, all right, my dear? — Dear Uncle, as you wish. — Yes, well done; may God keep you thriving. Well done.
en_old: Rest now, and from tomorrow, God willing, finish this list. Okay, auntie? Yes dear, how are you? Well done, may God bless you, well done.

brh: تکلیف مرے، ننا ضرورت اف۔ تکلیف ارا دے۔ ئے برے پگا نی کٹیوس ہمے گن بس نا خدمت ء کے ولدا قسمت ہرا وخت نی خنیٹ۔ فراز۔
en: It would be a bother; we don't need it. — What bother? Come on, tomorrow you [unclear]; let me do you just this little service, then who knows when fate will let me see you again. Faraz.
en_old: Whatever the hardship, we don't need it. Hardship is on what day? Come, tomorrow you will stay here and serve this place, then fate, whenever you see. Faraz.

brh: اینا باز کتریکے وا، ہم کنا باز ہیلپ کریرے، ناؤ ماما محبوب نا کمک یان بیدس ایتنا منزل اسکان سر مننگ کتا وا۔
en: [Unclear, perhaps 'Thank you very much'] — you also helped me a lot, and without Uncle Mahboob's help I could not have reached my goal.
en_old: Today I did a lot; they also helped me a lot. Without the help of uncle Mahboob I couldn't have reached my destination.

brh: او کنے دا یقین ء کہ نی داڑے واپس بروس، کنے آ۔ خیر خان دا سدھو خان بازوری مٹ ء۔
en: Oh, I am certain that you will come back here, to me. — Well, Khan, this Sidhu Khan is very [unclear]...
en_old: He had this belief that you would come back here, to me. Well, Khan, this Sidhu Khan is very strong.

brh: اسلام علیکم استاد جی۔ وعلیکم السلام۔
en: Peace be upon you, teacher. — And upon you be peace.
en_old: Peace be upon you, teacher. And peace be upon you too.

brh: وارس جان انت آ ولے؟ تول پنا پاچ۔ مہربانی۔ خیر ئے اول بسس۔ ماسٹر جی اسہ خوشی نا ہیت اسے۔ ہوانت اسے؟ خلقت اسپتال ئس ملنگانی۔ دا تو باز
en: Waris, dear, what's the matter? Sit down and tell me. — Thank you. — Is everything all right? You've come early. — Master ji, it's a piece of happy news. — Oh, what is it? — The village is getting a hospital. — That is very...
en_old: Waris dear, what's the matter? Sit down, tell me. Thank you. I hope all is well, you came first. Master ji, it's some happy news. Oh, what is it? The village is getting a hospital. This is very

brh: خوشینا ہیت اسے خوشی تو نا وار وار اسے حیرانگی والا ہیت اسے مرے اوہ انت اسے نیاڑی ڈاکٹر ئس بننگٹی ئے یاڑی دا نیاڑی دیر اسے ہمو کہ ماسٹر محبوب خان فیک اتہ مسڑ ئے بزغر نا مسڑ اسے دا تو باز جوانو ہیت اسے
en: ...happy news. — Happy, yes, and [unclear] also surprising news. — Oh, what is it? — A woman doctor is coming. — A woman? Who is this woman? — The one who is Master Mahboob Khan's [unclear] daughter, a farmer's daughter. — That is very good news.
en_old: happy news. Happiness, it comes again and again, it's surprising news. Oh, what is it? A female doctor is coming. Who is this woman? The one who is the daughter of Master Mahboob Khan, the daughter of a great man. This is very good news.

brh: سے انتئے کہ ننا خلکٹی داسا نا جوڑی ختم مروئی ہمو کہ عید آ سکولے ملانوٹ او ہسپتال ملنگٹی ئے ننا داڑے چنا نیاری تا مسئلہ غاک ہم حل مریرے باز خوشی نا عید اسے دے چہ ماسٹر نی انت پاسہ ئے پوم افٹ وارس
en: ...because now illness in our village is going to end. Just as we got the school, a hospital is now being provided, and the problems of our children and women here will also be solved. It's like a very joyful Eid. — Master, what are you saying? I don't understand. — Waris...
en_old: Because now the suffering in our village will end. Just as we got a school at Eid, now we're getting a hospital; here the problems of our children and women will also be solved. It's a very happy Eid day. Master, what are you saying? I don't understand, Waris.

brh: دا زنی باز زوپو مرسے، نی ثمارے کنے دا خوشی مننگٹی ئے کہ ننا چنا نیاڑی بیمار مسورے نن دو سد میل شار آ درین تے دا سٹو ہنا خلکٹی علاج مریک چنا نیاڑی تا۔ جی ماسٹر جی۔
en: This will [happen] very soon. You know, I'm so happy: when our children and women fell ill, we used to take them two hundred miles to the city; now the children and women will be treated in our own village. — Yes, master ji.
en_old: This will be very soon. You, Samar — I am happy that when our children and women fall sick we take them two hundred miles to the city; now the children and women will be treated in this very village. Yes, master ji.

brh: سئی پاسہ۔ اماں؟ جی کنا مسڑ۔ ننا اسل شار ء ہمپنا؟ انتئے ہمپنا؟ کانہ؟ ارا وخت آ؟ زو کانہ۔ اماں؟
en: You're right. — Mom? — Yes, my daughter. — Won't we go to our real city? — Why wouldn't we go? We will. — When? — We'll go soon. — Mom?
en_old: You're saying it right. Mother? Yes, my daughter. Won't we go to our own city? Why won't we? We will go? When? We'll go soon. Mother?

brh: نی ار دے پاسہ، زو کانہ، زو کانہ، زو کانہ۔ وخت وخت ئس انسان مجبور مریک، بے وس مریک، کنا است ہم خوائک کہ دا خلق نی بشارہ کان، بھلے اماں۔
en: Every day you say, 'We'll go soon, we'll go soon, we'll go soon.' — Sometimes a person is compelled, becomes helpless; my heart also wants us to get up and leave this village... — All right, Mom.
en_old: You keep saying 'two days', 'we'll go soon, we'll go soon, we'll go soon.' Sometimes a person is compelled, becomes helpless. My heart also wants you to leave this village, mother, right?

brh: انتولے؟ نی بلائی یاد بفک؟ بریک، انتئے بفک؟ کنے تو باز یاد بریک۔ ئے بلائی آ کاوا، تینا شار آ کاوا۔
en: What then? Don't you remember Granny? — I do, why wouldn't I? I remember her a lot. — I'll go to Granny, I'll go to my city.
en_old: Why not? Don't you remember the bungalow? I do, why wouldn't I? I remember it a lot. I'll go to the bungalow, I'll go to my city.

brh: او، اندن بنا کانہ، بلائی کانہ، دیوتہ نا مسیت اٹ، بازو دیو۔ السلام علیکم۔
en: Oh, like that we'll go, we'll go to Granny's... [unclear: 'devta's masit', 'bazu dev']. — Peace be upon you.
en_old: Oh, we will go like that, we'll go to the bungalow, at the temple of the gods, Bazu Dev. Peace be upon you.

brh: بسورے؟ جی او۔ اوہ ابا! اسکول مورے، بندغ ہم دم درینگک۔ ایراغاتے؟ جی ہاو، ایراغاتے۔ ہا مسیر، انت ہی؟
en: Have you come? — Yes. — Oh, Father! School [unclear]... a person gets tired too. — The food? — Yes, yes, the food. — Yes, daughter, what is it?
en_old: Have they come? Yes. Oh father! Schools are closed, people also take a breath. Where are they? Yes, where are they? Yes, daughter, what is it?

brh: ابا، نن دا خلکٹی مفنہ، نن شارا کانہ۔ کنا مسٹ، بندغ تو دونو ہیت سوچپک، دا خلکے ننا ضرورت ئے ہچ ضرورت اف۔
en: Father, we won't stay in this village, we'll go to the city. — My daughter, one doesn't think that way; this village needs us. — There's no need at all.
en_old: Father, we won't stay in this village, we will go to the city. My daughter, a person doesn't think like that; this village needs us, there's no question of not needing it.

brh: ئے بلای کا تینا شار کا وا اوہو اینے ہمر پوک ئے کنا پھلو ہمر پوک ئے نی نم ایرا کونگنو رے
en: Asha. — Yes, Mom. — [unclear]. — Why did you put the girl forward? — Today is the day our Rafiq was murdered.
en_old: Come, I'll go to the bungalow, I'll go to my city. Oh, where is my... where is my flower? Where have you all gone?

brh: آشا۔ جی اما۔ ئے دے ٹی لک۔ انتئے مسڑے مونی تسس؟ اینو ننا رفیق ئنا خون ئنا دے ء۔
en: We are very worried [unclear]... — What are you saying now? — I'm telling the truth: in this village our life is being ruined, my daughter's life is being destroyed. — Oh, is that so?
en_old: Asha. Yes, mother. Look at the day. Why did you give the daughter in front? Today is the day of our Rafiq's blood.

brh: ننا باز پروارے، نن کے زارنا زرسہ تک، دانی انت پاننگٹی ئس ئے راست پاننگٹی اٹ، دا خلگٹی ننا زد برباد مننگٹی ئے کنا مسیرنا زندگی تباہ مننگٹی ئے اچھا دا؟
en: Your life is being ruined in this village? — Yes, yes, our life is being destroyed here: there's neither a good school to study in, nor a good environment. — Is this such a [bad] life, Zeba? If...
en_old: We don't care much; we keep... what are you saying now? You're telling the truth. In this village our lives are being ruined, my daughters' lives are being destroyed. Oh, is that so?

brh: دا خلق اٹی نما زند برباد مننگٹی ئے ہو ہو داڑے ننا زند تباہ مننگٹی ئے نہ خوانے کے جوانو اسکول ئس ارے، نہ جوانو ماحول ئس ارے، دا دنو زند ئس ئے زیبا، اگر۔۔۔
en: If I don't teach the children of this village, then who will come to teach them? Nobody comes here. — Oh yes, so you've taken on the contract for this village's children? You've done a double MA, and with a double MA you teach primary-school children? — Zeba!
en_old: In this village your lives are being ruined. Yes, yes, here our lives are being destroyed. There's no good school for studying, nor a good environment. Is this kind of life befitting? If...

brh: دا خلق آتا چناتے ئے خوانفتوٹ تو دیر بروئے دافتے خوانفنگ کے؟ کس بفک داڑے۔ ہاؤ، دا خلق نا چناتا ٹھیکہ نی ہرفینوس؟ ڈبل ایم ئے کرینوس ئے ڈبل ایم ئے او خوانیفیسہ پرائمری اسکول نا چناتے؟ زیبا!
en: The hardest work of all is teaching little children. If their foundation is strong, they will study well later on. — Oh, I know. You care about the village's children.
en_old: If you don't teach the children of this village, then who will come to teach them? Nobody comes here. Yes, have you taken the contract for the children of this village? You've done a double MA, and with a double MA you'll teach primary school children? Zeba!

brh: دا کل آن مشکل کار این کہ چنا تے چنائے خوانفنگے۔ اگر دافتا بنیاد مضبوط مرے تو دا مونا جوانی اٹی خوانیرہ۔ او ئے چاوہ۔ نی خلق نا چنا تا پرواہ ارے۔
en: But you don't care about your own daughter. Today you have let this [unclear] go to waste. Don't waste me; I have wasted myself. — Oh ho!
en_old: The hardest job is teaching young children. If their foundation is strong, they will study well later on. He knows that. You care about other people's children.

brh: باز پریشان آ، باز پریشان آ ہچ سمجھ اٹی بننگ اٹی اف کہ امر کین مارے پریشانی ئے پشخنگ ئتو ختم مریک، ختم متو تو کم تو ضرور مریک، دا مسئلہ ہندا، بھلے دوستین، تے کنا زند نا سوال ئے
en: I'm very worried, very worried; I can't understand at all how I can [deal with] this worry. When it is shared, it ends; and if it doesn't end, it surely at least lessens. This is the problem, my good friend: it's a question of my life.
en_old: I'm very worried, very worried. I can't understand at all how I can get rid of this worry. If it doesn't go away completely, at least it will lessen. This is the problem, dear friends, it's a question of my life.

brh: ئے پاو مسوٹ نا خیال ڈاکٹر نور نا واری ٹی۔ نئے تراس دے بلکہ کنا ہم منے تینا سے ضد سے۔ ننا ہمسایٹی سے مسڑ اسے شبانہ۔
en: I understand: you're thinking about Dr. Noor. — No, [unclear]; rather, I too have a stubbornness of my own. There's a girl in our neighbourhood, Shabana.
en_old: I was thinking about Dr. Noor. Not just for three days — I too have my own stubbornness. In our neighbourhood there's a girl, Shabana.

brh: او پائیکی ہمو تون براہوئی ٹی گپ کیو۔ نی تینٹ پا یار دا نمبر بننگ کیک۔ او کنا سادہ انگا سنگت فون ایرف او دے کال ئس کر اوکستنا تینا احوال ء ایتے اگر اونا انتٹ مس تو برام کننگ کن تو تیار مریک۔ نا دعا
en: He says, let me talk with him in Brahui. You tell me yourself, friend, can this number get through? Oh my naive friend, pick up the phone and give him a call, tell him how things are with you; if he has any intention, then he will be ready to get married. (Give us) your prayers.
en_old: He says to speak with him in Brahui. You tell me yourself, friend, can this number work? My simple friend, put the phone down and call him one day, tell him how you are; if something happens to him, at least he'll be ready to get married. Your prayers.

brh: دوستے، اینو دے باز جوانی کٹساوے۔ او بفک۔ او ہچ وڑ تینا خلکے النگ کپک۔ ہمم۔ اگر نی اوڑ تو مہر ارے تو نی اونا خلکا ہینگک۔ باز مشکل ئے دوستے۔
en: Friend, today you've earned a lot of good. He won't come. He can't leave his village in any way. Hmm. If you love him, then you'll have to go to his village. It's very hard, friend.
en_old: Friend, today the day passed really well. He won't come. He can't leave his village at all. Hmm. If you love her, you'll go to her village. It's very hard, friend.

brh: یار ئے تینا لمہ غا النگ کپرہ۔ او گڑا ایلم لمہ نا ہیتے سلف شبانہ تو برام کرک۔ نا دوست دا تو بے وفائی مریک گڑا نی دنگ۔۔۔
en: Friend, I can't leave my mother. And then, brother, he'll stick to mother's word and marry Shabana. For your friend, this would be betrayal, so then you like this...
en_old: I can't leave my friend to his mother. And then my brother will listen to his mother and marry Shabana. My friend, that would be betrayal, so you...

brh: او ہم گڑاک مچ اسین ڈاکٹر نور نا انتظارے کرک ئے ناٹ نی تیت ئے تیتو بن کنا یا نی کنا ئے تیتو پومرک نو مائی ڈیئر ارا بندغ تینا زندگی نا فیصلہ غاتے کننگ کپک اودے مشورہ تننگ بیکار ئے
en: And also, everyone is all waiting for Dr. Noor... [unclear] ...you... or do you understand me? No, my dear, a person who can't make his own life's decisions, there's no use giving him advice.
en_old: And we're all gathered here waiting for Dr. Noor... No, my dear, there's no use advising a person who can't make his own life decisions.

brh: ادا او ادا
en: Brother! Oh, brother!
en_old: Here and here.

brh: ننے دا ریسٹ ہاؤس کنے نوئی ئے
en: We need to take this rest house.
en_old: This rest house is new to me.

brh: دا چناک، چناکن تو نا وارو
en: These children... as for the children, it's your turn.
en_old: These children, for the children it's your turn.

brh: ہاں، ہلبو۔ دا نما کرایہ ئے ہلبو تا۔
en: Yes, take it. Here, take your fare.
en_old: Yes, take it. Take your rent.

brh: اربوتا کمبو ئے دے ئے دے رستہ اوش بابو
en: Pick them up... [unclear]... mind the road, sir.
en_old: Bring the... come along the road.

brh: جی دا ریسٹوریشن نا لیٹر ئے بابو
en: Yes, sir, here is the reservation letter.
en_old: Yes, bring the restoration letter.

brh: دبئی کے داڑے تخت۔ اوفوہ مرا خوفناک او جاگہ سے تہارمہ تہارمہ۔ ہا داڑے
en: Put the box down here. Ugh, what a frightening place, dark, so dark. Yes, here.
en_old: Dubai... put it here. Oh, what a scary place, so dark, so dark. Yes, here.

brh: بجلی افنت؟ بجلی کاٹو۔ دا چراغ استعمال کر۔
en: Isn't there any electricity? The power has been cut. Use this lamp.
en_old: Is there no electricity? The power's been cut. Use this lamp.

brh: ابا چوکیدار دن مریرے؟ ہا کنا مار ہن مس
en: Dad, are watchmen like this? Yes, my son, he has gone off.
en_old: Father, how is the watchman? Yes, my son has gone.

brh: عجیب قسم نا بندغ اسے۔ اوفو دا ایتاک نم داسے الیبو اول کننگ نا گڑاس بندوبست کین کہ باز بینگنوں ار چنا کوم بینگنوں۔ ہاں ٹھیک ہی ئے داسے اینا بندوبست کیوہ۔ دا موم بتی نم کے لگین۔
en: He's a strange kind of person. Oof, leave these matters now; first let's arrange something to eat, because we're very hungry, and the children are hungry too. Yes, fine, I'll arrange for that now. Let's light this candle for you.
en_old: He's a strange kind of person. Oh, he said, now make some arrangements to cook something — there are lots of eggplants, a few eggplants. Yes, fine, I'll make arrangements for that now. Light this candle for us.

brh: ئے دا سرغ نا بندوبست کیو برے وا؟ مچے زو برے رے، ہاؤ نم تول۔
en: Shall I arrange this chicken, then? Everyone come quickly; yes, you all sit down.
en_old: Will you make arrangements for this chicken, then? Come quickly, everyone — yes, sit down.

brh: دا مئے جواننگا؟ او دا مئے؟ او دا کنائے۔ دے چا پسند بسنے تو؟
en: Is this one nice? And this one? And this one is mine. So, did he like the tea?
en_old: Is this one good? And this one? And this one is mine. So, did you like it?

brh: ارے چلو بندہ مکھا رے سالو۔ ہاں۔ ٹھیک ہی خدا حافظ۔ خدا حافظ۔ در در۔ ہلو ہلو ہلو۔ در در۔ کام۔
en: Hey, come on, man... [unclear] you rascals. Yes. Okay then, goodbye. Goodbye. Off you go, off you go. Hello, hello, hello. Off you go, off you go. Go.
en_old: Hey, come on, man, ... Yes. Okay then, goodbye. Goodbye. Go, go. Come on, come on, come on. Go, go. Work.

brh: سبحان اللہ امر زیباء جاگہ سے۔ دانتس مون پین جوان زیباء جاگہ ئے۔ ہمم ابو داڑے باز زیادہ چکر خلینے۔ او کنا مار باز زیادہ چکر خلورینے۔ او کنا مار نما ابو کنے اندا خاطر
en: Glory be to God, what a beautiful place. A little further ahead there's another nice, beautiful place. Hmm, Dad has been around here a great deal. Oh my son, I've been around a great deal. Oh my son, your dad, for this very reason...
en_old: Glory be to God, what a beautiful place. Further ahead there's an even more beautiful place. Hmm, Dad has toured around here a lot. Oh my son, I have toured around a lot. Oh my son, your father, me, for this reason...

brh: انترن ٹرانسفر داڑے کرفے کہ نمے زیبا زیبا جاگہ نا نشان آتے تک۔ امی ئے ہم چکر خلیوہ۔ او کنا مسڑ نی ہم باز زیبا زیبا جاگہ نا نشان آتے تنہ سہی ہی ہا رسیکام برو مونی کام برو۔
en: ...had his transfer made here, so that he could show you beautiful places. I'll take Mom around too. Oh my daughter, we'll show you lots of beautiful places too. Right, yes, go on, go on ahead.
en_old: I'll do the transfer here so that I can show you beautiful places. I'll take Mom around too. Oh my daughter, you'll also show me lots of beautiful places, right? Yes... come on, let's go, let's go ahead.

brh: دا ڈغار کنے تا، دا کل کنا، شکار ہم داڑے باز، باؤ
en: This land is mine, all of this is mine, and there's plenty of hunting here too, Dad.
en_old: This land is mine, all of this is mine, and there's plenty of hunting here too, Dad.

brh: باوا جی کنا باوا مندا ہیت کریسس۔ ہک اللہ بش کنا مار دا سورہ غیننگ نا تیاری کرک۔
en: Baba ji, my father had said this very same thing. Haqq Allah! Rise, my son; he is preparing to go to this [unclear].
en_old: Baba ji, my father told me this. Truth, God bless, my son is preparing to read this surah.

brh: ارواس کداڑی تولوک مروز وخت آن بے پروا او تھرمائی چن بے خوف باوا جی نی ہم تنیا رنگیسے انی تھرما غا
en: Sitting like a lone soul somewhere, careless of time and unafraid of the harsh weather — Baba ji, you too are all alone in this weather.
en_old: Sitting on this rock, unconcerned with time, fearless in this heat. Baba ji, you too are alone in this heat.

brh: خلیفہ صیب حق اللہ حق کنمار ہرا سدھ کے روشنائی حاصل کیک
en: Khalifa sahib: Haqq Allah Haqq! My son, whoever is upright attains enlightenment.
en_old: Khalifa sahib, Haqq Allah Haqq. My son, the one who is upright attains enlightenment.

brh: اوفتے تروئی نا ہچ خلیس ئس مفک، ہن کنا مار، نا لمہ باوہ نی کے پریشان مرو۔ کاوہ بابا جی، ولے؟
en: They have no fear at all of [unclear]. Go, my son, your mother and father will be worried about you. I'll go, Baba ji, but...?
en_old: They have no fear of anything. Yes, my son, your mother and father, why are you worried? Go, Baba ji, but?

brh: ولدا اگہ مگہ فقیر تا دنیا ٹی اگہ مگہ مفک فقیر تا دنیا ٹی حق مریغے حق حق اللہ پا
en: Again, 'ifs and buts' — in the world of the faqirs there are no ifs and buts; in the world of the faqirs there is only Haqq. Say Haqq, Haqq Allah.
en_old: Then there are no ifs and buts in the world of the faqirs; there are no ifs and buts in the world of the faqirs. There is only truth. Say Haqq, Haqq Allah.

brh: انت سرفنگ خواسہ؟ باوا جی! انت کسس روشنائی ئس کا سر مننگ کیک؟ حق اللہ! حق!
en: What is it you want to attain? Baba ji! Can a person reach some light? Haqq Allah! Haqq!
en_old: What do you want to understand? Baba ji! How can someone attain enlightenment? Haqq Allah! Haqq!

brh: باوا جی انی روشنے جسکاں سرمسنس حق اللہ حق کلمہ حق حق علم اور حلم
en: Baba ji, how have you reached this light? Haqq Allah Haqq, the Kalima, Haqq, Haqq, knowledge and forbearance.
en_old: Baba ji, I have reached enlightenment. Haqq Allah Haqq, the word of truth, truth, knowledge and forbearance.

brh: روشنائی اراسٹ علم حاصل کرے روشنائی حاصل کرے اور اراسٹ روشنائی حاصل کیک
en: Light: whoever gained knowledge gained light, and whoever [does so] attains light.
en_old: Enlightenment: from where did he acquire knowledge, acquire enlightenment, and from where does one attain enlightenment?

brh: ہائے، حق حاصل کرین اور حق کس کا سر بس۔ حق، راستی، علم نا روشنائی۔
en: Hey, let us attain Haqq, and someone has come to Haqq. Haqq: truthfulness, the light of knowledge.
en_old: Oh, I attained truth, and someone reached the truth. Truth, honesty, the light of knowledge.

brh: بابا جی کنا ہچ سمجھ ٹی بفننگا برے کنا مار برے جوان بابا ایناٹ ہین کنا مار
en: Baba ji, I don't understand anything at all. Come, my son, come. All right, Baba. Now go, my son.
en_old: Baba ji, I don't understand anything at all. Come, my son, come. Good, Baba, today, yes, my son.

brh: پاتی پاتی رنگینہ ہاؤ پلہ تے دیر تننگ ٹی مروک او رفتہ
en: Every single petal is so beautiful, yes; that comes from watering the flowers ... little by little.
en_old: Auntie, auntie, we color them, yes, and the one who waters the flowers has gone.

brh: دا لے آ دا پل آک برے سنو ہشت وار مالی ء پارینو دا تا خیال ء تخ بے وساتے دیر ایتے تاتی دیر ایتے
en: These flowers on this side have dried up. I've told the gardener eight times: look after them, give them water on time. Auntie, give them water.
en_old: These flowers are on this side... I've told the gardener eight times, a hundred times, to look after them, to give them water. Auntie, give them water.

brh: ایڑ پٹنگا ٹیٹ نیداڑ کینوس خیر ئے مسڑ اللہ نی دو نلاؤ شوس نا تھاتی ایچم متارے کنا مطلب ئے جوانوس نی گڑاس تو ارے کہ نیدونس تھاتی گپ دادے کہ نوما مار تین تین تے فراخ
en: Sister ... are you looking for something? You here ...? Is everything all right, daughter? God ... your hand ... — Auntie, nothing happened. I mean, are you well? — Is there something that you ...? — Auntie, the thing is that your son himself ... Faraz ...
en_old: Sister, you're searching... it's fine, you've become... God, you... Auntie, nothing happened. I mean, you're fine? You've got something, right? Auntie, the thing is that your son, they themselves...

brh: فراز او فراز اینو مئے پٹاٹہ کہ اودے خناٹ اوڑتو ٹکرائنگاٹ نہ کنا مطلب دادے کہ فراز تو خیریت تو نا سکنہ ہا تینا مئے مطلب کنے مگا مرغرے
en: Faraz, oh Faraz. Today I was out looking for something when I saw him, and I bumped into him, you see. I mean, the thing is, is Faraz all right? ... his ... I mean, I ... (unclear).
en_old: Faraz, oh Faraz, today I was looking for him to see him, to run into him. I mean, is Faraz all right? Yes, my... I mean I'm worried.

brh: تاتی، او بالکل خیریت او نیو۔ گڑا امر مس؟ امر مس؟ ئے سوری کریٹ اور نومے بسٹ۔ جوان کریس۔ او تسا دا پاکے خیرٹ بسسہ کنے پٹاسہ؟ جی او گپ دادے تاتی کہ پگا نومے ننا ارا غا بروئی۔ ہا، انت کہ کنے
en: Auntie ... — Oh, he's perfectly fine, he is. — Then what happened? What happened? — I said sorry and came to you. — You did well. Oh, have you come here in peace? Were you looking for me? — Yes, well, the thing is, auntie, that tomorrow you have to come to our house. — Oh? Why, for me?
en_old: Auntie, he's perfectly fine. So what happened? What happened? I called him and he came to you. You did well. He gave... did you come in peace looking for me? Yes, the thing is, auntie, that tomorrow you're to come to our house. Yes, why, for me...

brh: نما ورا غا بروئے ننا ورا ٹی چنکو پارٹی اسے پارٹی اسے ہم خوشی اٹ دا پارٹی ء پگا خیر اٹ تاتی ئے بیس سال نا مروتا ہاں ماشاءاللہ گڑا تو چاس کے ئے ضرور بریوا
en: Come to your house? — At our house there's a small party, a party with happiness too; the party is tomorrow, God willing. Auntie, I'm turning twenty. — Oh, mashallah! Then of course, you know, I'll definitely come.
en_old: You're to come to our house. In our house there's a small party, a party, happily, this party is tomorrow, God willing. Auntie is turning twenty years old. Yes, mashallah. Then of course I'll definitely come.

brh: اینا دے تھنا فیس نا نگام ئس مچے دے کائستہ کائری، گڈے فیس نا نی السلام علیکم، وعلیکم السلام، بے بے جی، کنا مطلب ڈاکٹر صاحبہ، ڈس
en: Today, about the fee ... for a little while ... going, going. Then, about the fee, you ... — Assalamu alaikum. — Wa alaikum assalam. — Bebe ji, I mean Doctor Sahiba, the dis-
en_old: Today only the fee... a whole day, I'll go, I'll go. Then the fee... you — Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Bebe ji, I mean Doctor Sahiba...

brh: ڈسپنسری تو ملنگا نہ دارو ئے نہ مریضے بس اکھنا دشمنہ مونی بس پنیچے نم فکر کپابو دارو کم بریرا خلقنا مخلوقے تاسکان ڈسپنسری نا سما اف میڈم ڈسپنسری تو ملنگا
en: The dispensary has opened, but there's neither medicine nor any patients, just ... (unclear) ... — Don't you worry, the medicines will come. The village people don't know about the dispensary yet, madam. The dispensary has only just opened.
en_old: The dispensary has been found, but there's no medicine and no patients. It's just... don't worry, the medicine will come. The people don't even know about the dispensary yet, madam. The dispensary has been found.

brh: دا سا دول خلنگ مخلوق ء پان بابو؟ نی دول خلپے۔ گلی گلی ٹی کوکار کنے، ڈسپنسری ملنگانے، چنا تے تنا تبو علاج کے، دولہ خلینے کس پی سانگتے۔
en: Should we beat a drum now to tell the people, sir? — Don't you go beating a drum. — Let's shout it in every lane: the dispensary has opened, bring your children and get them treated. Let's beat the drum ... friends.
en_old: Should we beat the drum like this to tell the people? Don't you beat the drum. I'll shout in every street that a dispensary has been found, bring your children and get them treated. I'll beat the drum, friends.

brh: دا نا اسے ضرورت اف۔ ئے تینٹ اسے اسے ارا غا کاوا تاکہ خلکے معلوم مرے۔ ڈاکٹر صاحبہ دا تو باز مشکلو کاریم اسے۔ مشکل مرے یا مف کاریم تو کروئی ہی بے بے
en: There's no need for that. I'll go myself to each and every house so that people find out. — Doctor Sahiba, this is a very difficult job. — Difficult or not, the work has to be done. — Bebe ...
en_old: There's no need for that. I'll go myself to each and every house so that people find out. Doctor Sahiba, this is a very difficult job. Difficult or not, the work has to be done, Bebe.

brh: جی نی کنا مطلب ڈاکٹر صاحبہ کس نی تو کائے ئے تو بریوے اوڑے شوملے ئے یلے ہم بریوے نی تو او نی ہر جگہ بل مٹریوس کان نی ہم بر شاباش کنے
en: Yes, you, I mean Doctor Sahiba, look, you just go and I'll come; I'll come there in the evening as well ... you, you go everywhere ... Go on, you come too. Well done!
en_old: Yes, you, I mean Doctor Sahiba, you'll go and come back, there in the evening... you go everywhere... then you come too. Well done.

brh: اینو میان اندا امید اسکا۔ نی دنکا دا چٹھی ئے ڈاکخانہ اسکا سر کر۔ جی آ جی آ جی آ۔ ارے شوم ئے پنچ منٹ ا کے کاوہ نی گھنٹہ ئس داڑے انتظار کیس کنکے او اللہ حافظ۔ ڈاکٹر صاحبہ دا تو باز جوان ہیت اسے دا دا۔
en: Today, sir, there's just this one hope. You take this letter to the post office right away. — Yes, yes, yes. — Hey, ... I'll go for five minutes; you wait here for me for an hour. Okay, goodbye. — Doctor Sahiba, this is a very good thing, this.
en_old: Today, sir, there was just this hope. You take this letter to the post office right now. Yes, yes, yes. Oh, I'll go in the evening in five minutes; you've waited here for an hour for me. Okay, goodbye. Doctor Sahiba, this is a very good thing.

brh: بلوت ننے ترے، بلہ میر تو نوار ننا ہم فرض ارے، حکومت آن بیدس سماجی تنظیماتے آن کمکے ہلی دانا مطلب ئے پریشانی نا میڈم ہچوئی تصف داٹی مخلوق نا علاج جوان مروئی
en: ... us. Yes indeed, sir, now it's our duty too. Apart from the government, by getting help from social organizations ... I mean, madam, there's no need to worry at all; with this the people's treatment will be good.
en_old: We'll need it, but sir, now it's our duty too. Apart from the government, by getting help from social organizations, it means, madam, there's no worry at all. Through this, people's treatment will be good.

brh: انشاءاللہ۔ جمار، عارف نی کچا ہیسن؟
en: God willing. — Jamar(?), Arif, have you brought tea?
en_old: God willing. Jamar, Arif, where are you going?

brh: ئے ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ اینو کنا پانے غان مست چائے ہیسس خیریت ئے ئے خیال کریٹ کہ نی دم درینگانوس ہندا خاطران نی کن چائے ہٹ۔ ئے نہ ئے تئی دستو ارے کنے داخہ مہربان
en: Oh, mashallah, mashallah! Today you've brought tea before I even asked. Is everything all right? — I thought you'd be tired, that's why I brought tea for you. — Oh no, ... is this your way now? Being so kind to me ...
en_old: Oh, mashallah, mashallah, today you've brought tea before me. Is everything all right? I thought you'd be resting, that's why I brought tea for you. Oh no, you're... so kind to me.

brh: مسونس، ہاو ئے تسرے، انت ات؟ ئے تادے، گشپانہ دا سہ بیس سال نا مسونے۔ ہاو اونا سالگرہ نا تو کنے سما ئے سالگرہ تو ٹھیک ئے لیکن نی اونا فکر
en: ... you've become. — Yes, I ... — What is it? — I'm saying that Shabana has now turned twenty. — Yes, I know about her birthday. — The birthday is fine, but you, about her ...
en_old: It's happened, yes, I gave it. What was it? Oh, him — don't say he has turned twenty. Yes, I know about his birthday. The birthday is fine, but you, about him...

brh: فکر کروئی مریک، انتئے کہ او دا سوار نا مسونے تاکہ کائت اینا اوراٹی آباد مریک۔ آہا، انت فکر کین، ماشاءاللہ، لائق ئے خواننگاٹے، پین، پین انت فکر تے کیناک۔ لائقی او خواننگ کن ارے نا، اونا اورائے۔
en: ... we have to think about it, because she has come of age, so she should go and be settled in her own home. — Aha, what is there to worry about? Mashallah, she's capable, she's studying; what other, other worries could we have? — Ability and education she has, right; her home ...
en_old: We have to think it over, because he has become settled so that she can be settled with him today. Aha, what else is there to think about? Mashallah, he is capable and educated, so what other worries could you have? He has the ability and the education, and he has his own house.

brh: دا بات کننگ کہ چکارے مست فک۔ ننے اورکن سوچ خلوئی مریک، فکر کروئی مریک۔ اچھا، نا مطلب دادے کہ اوتے نا اورنا مرے تو لمہ باوہ اسرات مرے۔ ہندا پانے خواجہ نا؟ ہمم، ہندا پانے خواجہ۔ چا ہندا دے۔
en: ... this matter has to be thought through carefully beforehand. We have to think about it for her, we have to worry. — Okay, so you mean that once she has a home of her own, the mother and father can be at ease. Is that what you're saying, Khwaja? — Hmm, that's what I'm saying, Khwaja. — Yes, that's it.
en_old: Before talking about this, we need to think about him and consider it carefully. Okay, so you mean that if it is meant for them, the parents should be happy too. Is that what you're saying, dear? Hmm, that's what I'm saying. Yes, that's it.

en: ... I mean that among our relatives I don't see anyone like that. Is there anyone in our sights? — Yes, there is someone in our sights. — Who? — Faraz. — Faraz? Which Faraz? — Faraz, our neighbour.
en_old: Is there someone like that among our relatives? Have you seen anyone? Yes, there is someone I have in mind. Who? Faraz. Faraz? Which Faraz? Faraz, our neighbour.

brh: ڈاکٹر اسے، جوان و مار اسے، لائقے، لمہ تان باز مہربان بندغ اسے، پیری ولدا، او ننا شبانہ تون ہم باز مہر کیک۔ اچھا، دانا مطلب دادے کہ نی۔۔۔

en_old: He came just to ask how we were doing. Yes. That's a very good thing. So if this matter is going to happen, then, since tomorrow is Shabana's birthday...
