en: I've invited Faraz and his mother to the birthday. You sit with them, talk and chat, ask after each other nicely at home, and then God will make it turn out well. — God willing, I'll certainly talk to them, and God will make it turn out well too. Okay, ... (unclear).
en_old: ...invite Faraz and his mother to the birthday. You sit with them, talk and chat with them, all in a good way, and then God will make it turn out well. God willing, I'll definitely talk to them, and God will make it turn out well. Okay, see you later.

en_old: Just this once, look, you and your servant... You don't understand anything. May God guide you.

en: ... a wish I'll make. — Your birthday? — Yes, my birthday. Now, cake, kak, maror, biscuits, toffee, chocolate, and this doll.

en: What demands there will be today! Dad's budget has already turned to junk; you're needier than everyone else, and he can't afford to give gifts. — You won't give me a gift? — Rather than giving you a gift, that money is better ...

en: I said ... I don't have the slightest interest either. The one who makes me happy, Anwar, my brother: you give me news of ... Just once, tell me this: do you love me?

en_old: Truth, knowledge.

en: Oh Silum, I don't know, it seemed to me like someone is here, something is here, I don't know. I'll go and look at it... no, no, I'm scared. Don't be scared, I'm coming now.
en_old: Oh Saloom, I don't know, it seems to me there's somebody here, there's something, I don't know. Go see... no, no, I'm scared, don't be scared, I'm coming now.

en: What was it? Nothing? Was it a cat, or did you get scared of a cat?
en_old: What was it, did you get scared, or did you get scared off?

en: You didn't tell me 'no', and so we went along after it; if you had said no, then you too would have ... me, son.
en_old: You had told me so and then you went back on it; if I had said no, you would have beaten me too.

en: You'd go crazy. Whoever... to me... this Piro is a madman. Man, they should be told that the quality of our goods is very good.
en_old: He'd be crazy. Some man would say to me that this old man is crazy. Man, tell them that the quality of our goods is very good.

brh: ہندا خاطر چندی بندغ ننے آرڈر تسنو۔ سو؟ ئے داڑے ہسوٹ۔ کنے دنیا غان ہرفیفیس۔
en: That's why several people have given us orders. So? I came here. You've finished me off (lit. lifted me from the world).
en_old: That's why several people gave us orders. So? I came here. You've made me lose everything.

brh: نالائق آ شاگرد، دنگ با، اورک کہ دے بسنے ہنک بش
en: You useless disciple, come here! Look, the sun is up — get up!
en_old: You useless student, stop, look, the day has come, go open it.

brh: خیرات ماشاءاللہ استاد شیخ خان بسنے بسم اللہ اللہ تنے واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ سبحان اللہ خل صیب السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام
en: Welcome, mashallah! Ustad Sheikh Khan has come. Bismillah, God... wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, subhanallah, sahib! Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace.
en_old: Charity, mashallah, Ustad Sheikh Khan has come, bismillah, God bless you, wow wow wow wow wow wow wow, subhanallah, sit down sir. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam.

brh: سلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام ابا بشیر خان اینو ہمر نن غریب آتا ہستوں کٹے معاف کیس آستینا غا امر رد کریس سئی بس سئی انت پاو نی آخر
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Dear Bashir Khan, how come (you thought of) us poor people today? Forgive me, how did you stray to (our) threshold? All right, fine, all right... so what do you have to say, after all?
en_old: Salam alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Father Bashir Khan, how did you remember us poor people today? Forgive me, how did you end up at our door? Fine, fine, what can I say, after all.

brh: بس پا سائیں پا ہنتس کہ پاروئی نی پا داڑے سائیں ایتاک کہ ہریر راز راز نا زیاٹے استاد کنے اندن لگنگٹیئے کہ مسٹمی کو وار آ نا باری ٹی سوچنگٹیئے
en: Just say it, sir, say whatever has to be said, say it here, sir... secret upon secret... Ustad, it seems to me like this, that I'm thinking about (doing it) a third time.
en_old: Just tell me, sir, tell me what you have to say here, sir. They gave... secrets upon secrets... Ustad, it seems to me that I've been thinking about my daughter's matter.

en: Ha ha ha, you said absolutely right. As for mine, they eat a lot, but... she... I'm not... Piro's mother... she... You don't worry at all, sir; I'll give you just such an amulet.
en_old: Ha ha ha, you're absolutely right. Mine eats a lot, but Piro's mother, she's not here. Don't worry at all, sir, I'll give you just the right amulet.

en: Okay, Piro's mother herself... for you a nice child, a third one, has to be found. For you, well, your third one... For now, take care of Piro's arrangements... a third one. Hey Piro! Piro! Piro! ... nothing...
en_old: Okay, Piro's mother herself... we'll find a good boy for you, a daughter... for now, arrange things for Piro... Piro, Piro, Piro, isn't there anything?

brh: سائیں چوکنی کرین زیادہ خولی گٹیوس۔ سائیں خولیسے جوانوں گڑاسے ہنتیکہ ہرا بندہ خولی کنا اوزو کے پکا۔ آ جوان جوان نم چداں خڑک با کنا ہیت تے بن۔ سائیں
en: Sir, the children are very scared. Sir, (give) something good against fear, so that no one is afraid... me... Ah, good, good, you (all) come close here and listen to my words. Sir.
en_old: Sir, the boys are very scared. Sir, give me something good for fear, so that a person won't be afraid when he's with me. Come, good, good, come closer and listen to my words. Sir.

brh: ئے ہناڑی جوان اٹ ٹھانٹ اسے کے پارو ئے ننے سئی ہم پارے ساہی رکھی بھنی سا کاوے اوئے دادے کے ہمے بلا درخت والا بونڈے خنانس نا او ہاو انت بلا خنانس او استاد ہمو بونڈ نا کیرغال کے دا تولے کک
en: I... with a young man... I'll tell you... he told us properly too... Oh, (tell) this one: have you seen the trunk of that big tree or not? Oh, yes. What, the big one, you saw it? Oh Ustad, beneath that trunk this... sits...
en_old: In the morning... he told us too... he saw that big tree's bush, what did he see? Ustad, under that bush he does this...

brh: اوہو اوہو اوہو اوہو مسنے امبو دا ختہ کیرغان پیرو اینانے چوٹا تے کشانے دا سہ جھنک درینو تا جھنک او سائیں جھنک درینو تا نی
en: Oho, oho, oho, oho! It has happened! ... from under this... Piro has gone, (they) have pulled off the ... now ... take ... oh sir, ... take ...
en_old: Oho, oho, oho, oho, it's done! Now, from under this, Piro has brought it, he pulled out the hair, this braid... sir, the braid... you.

brh: اسل و فکر کپیس ئے داسا ہندنو تعویذ ئس ایتیو نی جنات تے پیش کیوا مونا نا نہ سائیں نہ جنات تے پیش کپہ بس پیرو یت وری سائیں باز خطرناکو مسلہ سے دا
en: Don't worry at all; I'll now give you such an amulet that I'll bring the jinn before you. No, sir, no, don't bring the jinn before me — just bring Piro back. Sir, this is a very dangerous problem.
en_old: Don't worry at all, I'll give you such an amulet now that you'll call the jinn up in front of you. No, sir, don't call up the jinn, just bring Piro back. Sir, this is a very dangerous problem.

brh: داڑ کے کیرے نی سائیں ہزار روپئی تروئی تہمے کنا سائیں ہزار روپی ہاؤ سائیں ہزار روپی امر سائیں ہزار روپئی پنچ سد روپئی جناتے تروئی ہاؤ پنچ سد دانگی ہور کنا
en: For this, sir, a thousand rupees have to be given... mine. Sir, a thousand rupees? Yes. Sir, a thousand rupees — how so, sir, a thousand rupees? Five hundred rupees have to be given to the jinn. Yes, five hundred here, and the rest is mine.
en_old: What will you do here, sir? You'll have to give a thousand rupees. Sir, a thousand rupees? Yes, sir, a thousand rupees. How, sir, a thousand rupees? Five hundred rupees have to be given to the jinn. Yes, five hundred, and the rest is mine.

brh: سائیں دنو ظلم کپو نا ئے تو پی ہزار روپیہ نم پیروتے کبو۔ ئے سائیں پیروئے مکیوئے گھوڑا اڑے گھوڑا اینو مے ہرا ہزار روپیہ تے وا بس کنا سے کاری مس کبو۔ کنا سے کاری مس؟ ہاؤ
en: Sir, don't commit such cruelty. Here, a thousand rupees — you do (it) for Piro. Sir, Piro... then, hey, then today take these thousand rupees, just make it work for me. Will it work for me? Yes.
en_old: Sir, don't be so cruel. Here's a thousand rupees, do it for Piro. Sir, I'll finish off Piro... there's a horse, the horse today... take those thousand rupees, just get my work done. My work will be done? Yes.

brh: او سئیں دے کاریم او پاہے راجا رٹ تو باز کاریم ارے کہ کنا سئیں حکم کر سئیں ئے شار ایننگ خواوہ ہاؤ کنے کنا چناک باز یاد بننگٹیو ہلی ہلی ہلی بس نم اسہ انتو تعویزس کبو کہ پیرونڈا لمہ کنے شار ایننگ کنے الے
en: O sir, ... the work ... there is a lot of work; my sir, give your order, sir. I want to go to the city. Yes, I miss my children a lot. Come on, come on, come on, just make some kind of amulet so that Piro's mother lets me go to the city.
en_old: Oh sir, the day's work... tell Raja there's a lot of work, my sir, give the order. Sir, I want to go to the city. Yes, I miss my children a lot. Just make some kind of amulet so that Piro's mother lets me go to the city.

brh: سائیں اللہ خیر کے کہ دا کاریم کنے ولا نہ برک، استاد دا، ہاں ہاں بابا دا تعویزے نی ہر وقت ہو پو مسس ولا ایلو تعویز کے رندٹ
en: Sir, may God make it turn out well, so that this trouble doesn't come to me again. Ustad, this... Yes, yes, baba, keep this amulet with you all the time; then the other amulet comes after it.
en_old: Sir, may God make sure this trouble doesn't come back to me. Ustad, this... yes, yes, father, keep this amulet with you all the time, then the other amulet comes after.

brh: دا ورا کہ انشاءاللہ داڑان ودیکو تاویز اسے ایتوروٹ نی کاری مرو اینا سئیں؟ ہاو ہنتئے نا۔ ضرور مروک۔ مہربانی۔ باز مہربانی نا سئیں داڑے بسوس۔
en: This time, God willing, I'll give you an amulet even better than this. Will it work, sir? Yes, why not. It surely will. Thank you. Thank you very much, sir, for coming here.
en_old: This time, God willing, I'll give you a better amulet than this one. It will work, right, sir? Yes, why not. It surely will. Thank you. Thank you very much, sir, for coming here.

brh: استاد! شیر خان! شکرانہ! ادمک دا خلک لنگٹ اوٹ ٹنگٹ اوٹ شکرانہ! استاد چا تو ونڈونی ارے خیر سے خیر سے پروا سفک بریکک ولا آخر بریکک نا
en: Ustad! Sher Khan! A thank-offering! People... I'm hungry, I'm... A thank-offering! Ustad, is there tea to go around? It's fine, it's fine, never mind, he'll come; he'll come back eventually, won't he?
en_old: Ustad! Sher Khan! Thank you! People beat me here, I was hung up, thank you! Ustad, is there tea... all is well, all is well. Piro hasn't come yet, he'll come eventually, right?

brh: شارا کے کائک کہ شارا کے تو تعویز ئس الیک چریا مسنوس ہڈے
en: Is he going to the city — that when he goes to the city an amulet will let him? You've gone crazy...
en_old: Does he come to the city? If he goes to the city, he has no talisman with him...

brh: یا اللہ کنا زیبائیں گل انگا مار نا حفاظت ء کیس، یا اللہ پرو ء تینا حفظ و امانت ٹی تخس، یا اللہ
en: O God, protect my beautiful, flower-like son. O God, keep Piro in Your care and protection. O God.
en_old: O God, protect my beautiful, flower-like son. O God, keep Piro in Your care and protection. O God.

brh: اللہ کنا مار پیر جانی خیر و خوشی اٹ راغاتس اللہ نی اونا حفاظت ئے کیس اللہ نی جنات تیان خلاص کرتا اللہ نیکے بازو ایراغس خیرات کیوہ کنا پلنگا مار
en: God, bring my son Pir Jan back in safety and happiness. God, protect him. God, free him from the jinn. God, for You I will give a big meal in charity, my flower-like son.
en_old: O God, may my son Pir Jan come back safe and happy. God, protect him. God, free him from the jinn. God, I will give a lot of food in charity for You, my dear son.

brh: اللہ خیر و خوشی اٹ ارا غا برے آمین ئے اللہ نصیب کے
en: God, may he come home in safety and happiness. Amen, may God grant it.
en_old: God, may he come home safe and happy. Amen, may God grant it.

brh: بس خیرٹ؟ ہاؤ، ابی تسبیح خناس؟
en: All well? Yes. Have you seen the prayer beads?
en_old: Is everything fine? Yes, have you seen the prayer beads?

brh: تعویذ تس؟ ہو پین انت پارے؟ دا تعویذ تس۔ پارے پوشکونو پوچس ایٹی
en: Did he give an amulet? Yes. What else did he say? He gave this amulet. He said (to keep it) in a yellow cloth.
en_old: Did he give a talisman? Yes, what else did he say? He gave this talisman. He said to wrap it in new cloth.

brh: چار تلک ایتا ہزار روپیہ مخواہس گڑا گڑا ہزار روپیہ ایت کنے کاوے
en: (Fold it) four times... he wants a thousand rupees. So then, then give me a thousand rupees and I'll go.
en_old: Give a thousand rupees up to four times; I don't want it, then give me a thousand rupees.

brh: تیوت نا ایرا کاتیوا ہزار روپئی ایتک ایرا کاکاوے تیوتا مرید تے زبا زبا پارے
en: For the talisman ... two ... he gives a thousand rupees ... two ... he told the disciples about the talisman [partly unclear].
en_old: For the talisman he gives two thousand rupees; give me two... he told the disciples of the talisman over and over.

brh: دا شکرانہ تسورٹ تو دا تعویز کاریم کروئی نہ تو اسل اسر کپروئے، وہ محسوس تو گڑا، تو گڑانٹ، ایت کنے نا کاوی تو تا
en: If you give this thank-offering, this talisman will work; otherwise it will have no effect at all. ... you'll feel it then ... then ... give me your ... [unclear].
en_old: If you give this offering, the talisman will work; otherwise it will have no effect at all. Then give me your...

brh: اینو صفا پاننگ کٹیوٹ، تندونو خطرناک او جنو مارے نہ قبضہ کرینو، اگہ شکرانہ تسوس
en: Today I'm telling you plainly: such a dangerous jinn has taken possession of your son, if you give the thank-offering...
en_old: Today I'll say it plainly: such a dangerous and evil jinn has taken possession of the son, unless you give the offering.

brh: تعویز اسر کروئی نہ تو مار نا میشک جنات تا اوزٹی مروئی آ نہ نہ اللہ امانت ئے مارے کنا، ئے کاوا تیوا، ہاں زو ہست۔
en: ...the talisman will take effect; otherwise your son will remain forever in the grip of the jinns. — No, no, O God, my son is in Your trust. I'll go and give it, yes, quickly...
en_old: The talisman will work, otherwise the son will stay in the grip of the jinns. No, no, God, I entrust my son to You... yes, quickly.

brh: ابا، الانی مخنگوس؟ ہن، ئے مخنگوٹ؟ اراڑے مخنگوٹ؟ دیر پارے؟ کنا با بندے؟
en: Dad, are you laughing now? — Huh, am I laughing? Where am I laughing? Who said so? My mouth is shut.
en_old: Dad, why aren't you sleeping now? Hm, why am I not sleeping? Where would I sleep? Who said so? Is my father locked up?

brh: آئی نا کنا بائے اندو بند کرے نی اسل بائے تنے ملنگم کپرا، اینک آئی دون تنے مو پشکنہ غا پوچے پٹو بو جگو ست بو
en: Your mother has shut my mouth like this; I can't even open my mouth at all. Now look how your mother has [wrapped] you in the yellow cloth like this ... [rest unclear].
en_old: She locked up my father like this; you'll never get to see your father again. Now she has wrapped you up like this in clothes...

brh: دا سے وری وکے کنے شار نا ہنگن دیر او خف کے تینا مات ئے کوا مات کنا شار نا
en: This ... time ... who [will stop] me from going to the town? ... listens to his own mother ... my mother ... of the town ... [largely unclear].
en_old: These three years... me of the city... who listens to his own mother, my mother of the city...

brh: دا تعویذ اسے توئے کنے کسس کنے روکک کپروئے ہا کس روکنگ کپروئے
en: This is a talisman such that no one can stop me; yes, no one can stop me.
en_old: This is a talisman; no one can stop me, yes, no one can stop me.

brh: تعویذ جوڑ کریس؟ تعویذ جوڑ کریٹ، بس ایتے خوتہ۔ ننے کنے ایتے خوتہ۔ ننا ایتے خوتہ۔ ئے پاریٹ ایتے خوتہ۔ ایتے خوتہ۔ ایتے خوتہ۔ ایتے خوتہ۔ ئے پاریٹ ئے
en: Did you make the talisman? — I made the talisman; just [chanting an incantation: 'ete khota']. To us, to me, [the same chant]. Our [chant]. I said [chant]. [Chant repeated three times.] I said ...
en_old: Did you make the talisman? I made the talisman, just give it, I want it. Give it to us, to me, I want it. I said give it, I want it. Give it, I want it.

brh: ئے تخواتہ ئے تخواتہ ئے تخواتہ ہن زدی و مائیسوس سائے کنل کس ہسیتو مالو دمدرٹ ہیروداسا بیس دور
en: [Mumbled incantation, largely unintelligible: 'i takhwata' repeated three times] ... go ... no one ... before ... twenty ... far ...
en_old: ...keep it, keep it, keep it. Hm, quickly... before... now...

brh: کنے پیسہ غاتے کاوے تو شکرانہ ٹی۔ نذر پیر صاحب دا پیسہ غاتے ٹی۔ جوانی اٹ تخیس تعویزے۔ آہا چٹانوس عیدین اٹ تخیس آتا اسر کپوروے خیال کیس۔
en: Give me the money as a thank-offering. The offering for Pir Sahib is in this money. Keep the talisman carefully. Aha, if you keep it [unclear], it will have no effect; be careful.
en_old: Give me the money as an offering. An offering for Pir Sahib, put this money in. Keep the talisman carefully. Otherwise it will have no effect, be careful.

brh: نین تاتیان خمیرہ ستے کینو تے بیغف ہینزوکے
en: [Largely unintelligible] ... from them ... the dough ... knead it ...

brh: اللہ نا شکرے کہ دا تعویز سلامت
en: Thank God that this talisman is safe.
en_old: Thank God this talisman is safe.

brh: کنا پینم گلب بے بے ء
en: My name is Gulab Bibi.
en_old: My name is Gulab Bibi.

brh: بہ شیر خان اللہ تنے بسم اللہ بسم اللہ برک خواجہ دا کتو
en: Bashir Khan, God [keep] you! Welcome, welcome (Bismillah), come in, master ... [unclear].
en_old: Bashir Khan, may God bless you, in the name of God, come in, Khwaja...

brh: بسم اللہ بسم اللہ السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام سائیں وعلیکم السلام بشیر خان بر چا وکے سائیں
en: Welcome, welcome (Bismillah). Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace, sir. — And upon you be peace, Bashir Khan; come ... sir.
en_old: In the name of God, in the name of God. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace, sir. And upon you be peace, Bashir Khan, come in, sir.

brh: پیسہ غاتے ایسنس۔ او سائیں پیسہ غاتے تو ایسنٹ ولے ہمو شار والا تعویز کنے ہم بسنٹ۔ ارے سائیں ئے باز بھروسہ والا بندغ اسے۔ ادا سخی دے۔
en: Have you brought the money? — Oh sir, I have brought the money, but I have also come for that talisman for the city person. Oh sir, I'm a very trustworthy man. Brother, (be) generous.
en_old: You brought the money. Sir, I did bring the money, but I also need that amulet for the city person. Yes, sir is a very trustworthy man. He is generous.

brh: ئے تازی تروئی تمکنے ولے حساب نا خلکو نوٹس آئی نی اسہ جوان و پزور و مونو متس اتوئی تمکنے او دے تڑوئی تمک خیرات کروئی تمک
en: You will have to [unclear], but according to the reckoning I have cast, you must bring one good, strong, black he-goat, and that day you must slaughter it and give it away as alms.
en_old: You have to give it fresh, but with the calculation that has been made, you have to bring a good, strong and beautiful … you have to tie it that day, you have to give alms.

brh: تاکہ نا مسئلہ غاک پین ہچ آسان مریر۔ اولے سئیں دا دنو متو چارٹی ملیک نا، نم کسے کا کنے تعویز ایت بو، ئے اشارہ ئے کا۔
en: ...so that your problems become easier still. — But sir, will such a he-goat be found around here? Please, just give me the talisman; give the sign.
en_old: So that your problems become much easier. But sir, such a thing is not found in the market, would you give me an amulet, just give a sign.

brh: او تینا مات تون ملیو، اوست آن پیسہ ہلیو، ولدا کاو پڑی ئے ہندونو مت ئس ہلیوتے وا، نمے ایتیوا۔ شیر خان! دن مف کہ ننے رے فوس ہک۔
en: Let me go see my mother, take money from her, then go to the cattle market, buy such a he-goat and give it to you. — Sher Khan! Let it not be that you deceive us.
en_old: Go meet your mother, take money from her, then go buy something like that from the market and give it to you. Sher Khan! Let's hope we don't get fooled.

brh: بس ایڑے شیر خان باز بھروسہ والا بندغسے۔ ہو، پو مسس؟ ہمے تعویز کے شام تو لکاٹنسے، ہمودے آتے تا آتے تا ہلا۔ ہمودے ئے ہندن ڈکانٹ اسٹاسٹ۔ شیر خان دا تا۔
en: Well, sister, Sher Khan is a very trustworthy man. Yes — did you understand? That talisman which I wrote in the evening, take that one ... I kept it hidden just like this. Sher Khan, here it is.
en_old: Well, Sher Khan is a very trustworthy man. Yes, did you understand? I wrote that amulet in the evening, took it from them. I hid it just like that. Sher Khan, here it is.

brh: اوئی زی پوچ کنو پوچ اسے ٹی کیس پومسس ہاؤ پوچ کنو ہاؤ اور چوکاٹ نا زی آ تخ تہ زی آ زی آ کہ تخاس تہ دوار دا کاریم کے واہ ٹکا ٹک نظر مرو ہا سائیں بس مس
en: Put it in a yellow cloth — did you understand? Yes, a yellow cloth, yes — and place it on top of the doorframe, on top, on top. Once you have put it there, then this will do the job — wow, you'll see it work right away. — Yes sir, done.
en_old: Put it in a pouch, did you understand? Yes, a pouch, yes, and put it on the doorframe; once you put it up there, then this work will be seen right away. Yes sir, that's it.

brh: کنا دے سے ٹی ارسے کاریم نا مرو، ہنے نی مروثس نا شار والا ارائی، او کنا شار والا ما، چیخات چیخات
en: Within a day your work will be done; then you will have your city girl at home — and my city girl ... [unclear exclamation].
en_old: In my day there will be some work, then you will be a city person, she is my city person, screaming and screaming.

brh: او کڑانے شکرانے مرکا
en: Oh, ... thank-offering ... [unclear].
en_old: Oh, thanks be to God.

brh: کنا پن جمال ء۔ ئے شال اٹ رہینگوہ۔ ہفتٹی اسہ دے ئس
en: My name is Jamal. I live in Quetta. One day a week ...
en_old: My name is Jamal. I live in Quetta. One day a week...

brh: داڑے پکنک کے بریوے، گڑا ئے امر کیو، خان اسینہ اورے تمک، خان، قصور نا اف
en: I come here for picnics; so what am I to do? Khan, ... [unclear] ... Khan, it's not your fault.
en_old: You come here for a picnic, then what will you do? Khan, it has to be there. Khan, it's not her fault.

brh: قصور نا حسن نا ئے کہ او نی مغرور کرے ولے ئے ہم جمال اٹ نا حسن نا غرور ء پرغتا وٹ تو کنا پن جمال مفروک۔ ہسی ت اسپاونے؟ پاو
en: It's your beauty's fault that it has made you proud. But I am Jamal too — if I don't break the pride of your beauty, then my name isn't Jamal. ... [unclear]? Tell me.
en_old: It's the fault of her beauty that it made her proud, but if I don't break the pride of her beauty, my name isn't Jamal. Did you understand? Tell me.

brh: ہندا شار والا مار نی باز خورٹ خورٹ ہراکا او ننگان تمارے دون تو پورا ملک ئس الو ہورے نی خنتویس تا او نا خنت ایچ ممکن مہر ئس انت مطلب کنا مطلب ئے او نی مہر اٹ ہراکا

en: This is our promise: on that day we will rain down hatred.
en_old: This is our promise: the day we will rain down hatred.

brh: میران او تینا کاریم اٹ سردست ئس اما خوائیٹ ئس اونا جند نا کاریم اٹ سستک
en: Meeran is busy with his work at the moment. What do you want? He is worn out by his own work.
en_old: Meeran, he is currently busy with his work; what do you want? He is tired of his own work.

brh: ہور زیبو، نی کنے آن گڑا ئس ڈکنگ اٹی ئس راس پا، انتئے بسس؟ نہ میران، دنو ہچو ہیت ئس اف۔ نی تول، اینے کنے چائے جوڑ کیو۔ ہور کنے راس پا، نت تو ایدا سکھا تینا ٹڈے پواینتہ کہ ونتا کے بسس تاڑے
en: Look, Zebo, you are hiding something from me. Tell the truth, why did you come? No, Meeran, there is nothing like that. You sit down, I'll make you tea now. Look, tell me the truth; otherwise ... you have come here...
en_old: Look, Zebo, you are hiding something from me, tell me the truth, why did you come? No, Meeran, there is nothing like that. You sit, I'll make you tea now. Look, tell me the truth, otherwise you wouldn't have walked here on your own feet...

brh: میران نی انتئے بومہ فیسہ؟ نی گنوک تو متنس؟ اگر سے کچک ئس غوگک، دانا مطلب دا اف کہ نی بے اوڑتو اوار غوگس؟ تنے کہ کچک کاتک، گڈا تڑیدئی۔ پٹانہ شاہین ئے جوان چائسہ۔
en: Meeran, why don't you understand? You haven't gone mad, have you? If a dog barks, that doesn't mean you should bark along with it. If a dog bites you, then ...? ... you know Shaheen well.
en_old: Meeran, why don't you understand? Have you gone mad? If a dog barks, that doesn't mean you should bark along with it. If a dog bites you, then you run away. Tell Shaheen, you know him well.

brh: خیر سے میرک نی الے ودی اونا جواب تے نی کدی جوان بریکے دا وار نا دادے جواب ئے تینٹ ایتیوہ میران نی انتئے پوم افیسہ نی تے بسک نی کن کینت سہس
en: All right, Mirak, you leave it; when have you ever answered him well? This time I'll give the answer to this one myself. Meeran, why don't you understand? ... for you ...
en_old: Well, Meerak, you... the answers to that, you were never good at them; this time I will give the answer myself. Meeran, why don't you understand? ...

brh: میران دا نالند نہ اف ہڑے دوستی دشمنی نا ہچو اہمیت ئس اف ولے داڑے دوستی دشمنی سالہ دسر چلینگک داڑے کسس کسے دسر کپک
en: Meeran, this is not London, where friendship and enmity have no importance. Here friendship and enmity go on for years, and here no one spares anyone.
en_old: Meeran, this is not our land where friendship and enmity have no importance; here friendship and enmity go on for years and years, here no one spares anyone.

brh: اوڑان ئے دا انتئے دشمنی اٹ ہنکاو تینکے ماما کنے تو نما سوچ آ افسوس مننگٹی ئے کہ نم دا وڑ سوچرے
en: ... why should I get into enmity over this...? Uncle, I feel sorry about your way of thinking, that you think like this.
en_old: Why are you taking this so far into enmity? Uncle, I feel sorry about your thinking, that you think this way.

brh: کنے خبرے کہ کنے کسس داڑے دستار کھپک، وٹنا ئے داڑے بادشاہی سینا لنک بسونٹ، ئے تو تینا ڈغار نا ایتے کنے گٹوٹ، تانا بندغاتا لاچاری نا ایتے کنے گٹوٹ۔
en: I know that no one here will tie a turban on me, and I have not come here for any kingship. I got caught up in this for the sake of my land, for the sake of my people's helplessness.
en_old: I know that no one here takes my turban; they came here for my kingship. They caught me for the sake of my land, they caught me for the sake of the helplessness of my people.

brh: اوفتہ بے وسی تا مونا سلوک اٹ پندام نو کنے پاننگٹی ارے کہ ئے اوشکیو راستی ماما کنے زمالوکا تا ڈغار غا تاخا
en: Standing before their helplessness ... you are telling me that I should ... the truth. Uncle, ... on the land of my ...
en_old: Their helplessness and the behavior before them... I am telling you to listen to the truth, uncle, they have trampled on the land of my ancestors.

brh: نی زور مسنس، کہ ہر بندغ داڑے تینا جند نا اورانا، تینا پیڈ نا، او تینا دستار نا ہیت ء کننگ اٹی۔ میران! نی ئے وخت نا ہیت اٹی کیسہ۔
en: You have become mighty, when every person here is talking about his own home, his own [family] and his own turban. Meeran! You are talking about those times.
en_old: You have become strong, while every person here is speaking about their own home, their own family, and their own turban. Meeran! You are speaking of the times.

brh: دا سدا دے پندک ہوشیار مسنو کسس تینے پٹا ٹی پٹ پک ولے نی خنا مار نی ئے اسے وخت سے نا ایتاتی کن گٹوس داسا
en: These days people have become clever; no one throws himself into a trap. But you, look, son, you have now got yourself caught up for the sake of a single moment.
en_old: These days are full of tricks; someone who has become clever doesn't fall into the trap, but you, son, you were caught for a moment's sake now.

brh: ہر بندغ او شرمسونے مفت نا پڈاٹی کس تنے بٹپک نی کنے اسیت نا جواب ایت دا نا بلا پڈاٹی کسس نی بس کس نی تو سلیس کسس نی اوار کرے
en: Every person ... no one throws himself into a feud for nothing. Answer me one thing: in this big feud of yours, did anyone come to you? Did anyone stand with you? Did anyone join you?
en_old: Every person and the shameless one... no one will throw you into free trouble. Give me the answer to one thing: who came into this great trouble? Who left you? Who joined you?

brh: ماما، نم انت خوایرے؟ ئے امر کیو؟ ئے خواوہ کہ نی تنے دا پڈ آ تئی مر کرک، او ہن تنے جوان زند ئس شروع کرک، دا مردہ غاتیٹی ساہ شاغنگ نا
en: Uncle, what do you want? What should I do? I want you to keep yourself out of this feud, start a good life again, [and stop] trying to breathe life into these dead...
en_old: Mama, what do you want? How should I do it? I want you to come to your senses about this, and then start a good life for yourself, [instead of trying] to breathe life into the dead.

brh: کوشش کپہ، وتی نا وخت ء ہم ضائع کپہ، ماما، کنا مطلب ء کہ واپس لندن آ کا۔
en: Don't try, and don't waste your own time either. Mama, what I mean is: go back to London.
en_old: Don't try, and don't waste your time either, Mama. I mean, come back to London.

brh: نی صاحب سلوٹ ئے دا دے پارہ دشمن نا مورچہ غان دشمنہ جلو کننگے، اللہ نا ورا ویرا نا کل آن بلا مورچہ ئے
en: Salute to you, sir! Today they say the enemy should be attacked from the enemy's own trench. God's ... is the biggest trench of all.
en_old: Sir, salute! Today they say attacks are being made on the enemy from the enemy's own trench; God's ... is the biggest trench of all.

brh: او او عمر پیرو میر صاحب دا ہست و سادہ افٹ اللہ معاف کے ننو دے ئنا خلک اٹ یو لو کے لو کتارا تے خنیوے کہ دیر ارا
en: Oh, oh, Umar, Peero, Mir sahib, this is not so simple. God forgive me, on the day of our battle we will see the ranks, who stands where.
en_old: Oh, Umar, Peero, Mir Sahib, this isn't so simple. God forgive me, in our day we will see the ranks and who stands where.

brh: ہن کائیک، انت کیک؟ گڑ پیرو، شف شف کپہ، سیدھا پا کہ انت کھیل کتار۔ میر صاحب، انت پاو ننگ، نی تینا ٹوک
en: He'll go off — what can he do? So, Peero, don't mumble; say it straight: what game did they play? — Mir Sahib, what can I tell you, you yourself...
en_old: He'll go and come, what will he do? So, Peero, don't whisper, say it straight: what game did they play? Mir Sahib, what can I say, you, your word...

brh: شارو بندغ اسیوس، ئے وننگ میر صاحب، نی کنے آن اسے ہیت ئس ڈکاس، انتے ہیت ئس ڈکاروٹ نی آن، خیر میر صاحب
en: ...are a clever man. Eh..., Mir Sahib, you hid something from me. — Why would I hide anything from you? Well, Mir Sahib...
en_old: I was a sensible man, I'd say, Mir Sahib, you hid something from me. Why would I hide anything from you? Well, Mir Sahib...

brh: امیر صاحب، نی او ئے تے الک کرک۔ ئے او نم امیر صاحب، ئے نا باز وفادار او سنگت ئس ایوٹ۔ کنا باوہ پیرہ، نا باوہ پیرہ نا ڈیرہ ٹی دا ہس خدمت کریر، خواریم کریر۔ تو دا ہس تو خبر اف نی ہر کیلو قطار ہتا کہ دیر ہرا
en: Mir Sahib, you separate them. I..., Mir Sahib, I am your very loyal man and a friend. My forefathers served in your forefathers' household this much, they toiled hard. So don't you know even this much — in every clan and lineage, who is who?
en_old: Mir Sahib, you would separate them. Mir Sahib, I am your very loyal friend. My father and grandfather served and toiled in your father's and grandfather's household. So I don't know which row you put who in.

brh: ارانگ بریک اراکہ بریک ارانگ کائیک ویرو تحصیلدار راس پاریک کہ اخس کہ نی دغار نا زی آ ٹیوس
en: From wherever he comes, wherever he comes, wherever he goes, ... a tehsildar says that however much you are on top of the land...
en_old: He comes, the tehsildar comes, and says that as long as you sit on the land...

brh: اندا خس ڈغارٹی کڈوس پڈائیکینوس اللہ معاف کے میر صاحب نن اغاسے ٹوکے سنگتی کینے تو اونا کل خیل و قطار آتے آن تینے خبردار کینے
en: ...that much in the ground, buried... God forgive me, Mir Sahib, if we make friends with someone, we make ourselves aware of his whole clan and lineage.
en_old: We would have buried that much in the land... God forgive me, Mir Sahib, if we befriend someone, we keep ourselves informed about his whole clan and lineage.

brh: اینا اشارہ ء پومسٹو، ولے پیرو؟ جی، ئے کنا ارٹمی کو پراجیکٹ ء، ہراتم آ کنا ضرورت تما۔
en: Didn't you get his hint, Peero? — Yes. That's my second project, for whenever I need it.
en_old: Didn't you understand this signal, Peero? Yes, this is my second project, for when I needed it.

brh: دا شیطانی دماغٹ زر کاری ملوٹ میر صاحب ہر توما کاریم تیٹی رکاوٹ میرانی اگر دا خبر
en: With this devilish brain [I'll] ... money, Mir Sahib. There'll be obstacles in both jobs. If Miran [gets] this news...
en_old: Money will come out of this devilish mind, Mir Sahib; there would be obstacles in every kind of work if this news...

brh: نیرانی خبر مرے کہ نی الوستا اوراغہ ہنانس تو چاس کہ نت نا لٹی کتے تفنگا پیرو کنا است ہمودے ہمودے یخ مروئی کے
en: If Miran finds out that you went to Allu's house, then you know there'll be kicks... Peero, my heart would go cold right then, right then.
en_old: If they find out that you went to his house, then see, they'll break my legs. Peero, my heart would freeze right then and there.

brh: کنا نت او میران نا لخمروئی میر صاحب اگر میران ئے دا خبر مرے کہ نی خولم ئس نا گوا
en: It'll be my legs and Miran's kicks, Mir Sahib, if Miran finds out that you [took] a sack of wheat...
en_old: My legs would be broken, Mir Sahib, if Miran finds out that you went to someone's...

brh: نی تو اوار اللو آستہ وراغہ اینانوس تو دن چا کہ نت نا لغت تے تخنگا اللہ معاف کے ئے ہم ئے ہم ہندا خواب ہندا خواب کے ہر کنڈان داخس
en: ...you went off together to Allu's house, then know this: there'll be kicks. God forgive me — I too, I too have this same dream, this same dream, that from every side so much...
en_old: If you went to his house together with Allu, then see, they'd break my legs. God forgive me, I too have the same dream, the same dream, from every side so much...

brh: سرگردان کیوتے دا خس سرگردان کیوتے کہ کیوتے خبر تمے کہ میر جمال نا دشمنی اخس کوبین تمکتے اخس کوبین تمکتے
en: I'll leave them distraught — I'll leave them so distraught that they'll find out how heavily Mir Jamal's enmity falls on them, how heavily it falls on them.
en_old: I'll make them wander, I'll make them wander so much that they'll learn how heavy Mir Jamal's enmity is, how heavy it is.

brh: اما، دا گھولی غلہ نا وار آ ک بستہ؟ ئے نوم میر جمال بسسس نا وار آ کہ، اولیکو وار بسسس مخلوق او نا بارہ وٹی پانہ۔
en: Mother, who came with this sack of grain? — That was Mir Jamal; he had come with it. It was the first time he had come. People talk about him.
en_old: Mother, who came with this sack of grain? Mir Jamal came; this is the first time he came. People talk about him.

brh: دا دے ئے دے ولے میر جمال ہدو بندغ ئس اف اماں نی ہوش اٹ تو ارس ایسا نہ نی میر جمال نا تروکا خیرات آتیر ذمہ وار اوس ولے نی ہوش اٹ ارے چاوا نی ہوش اٹ افیس
en: ... but Mir Jamal is not a bad man. — Mother, are you in your right mind or not? You are answerable for the charity Mir Jamal hands out, but are you in your right mind? Look, you are not in your right mind.
en_old: Today is today, but Mir Jamal is not a bad man. Mother, are you in your senses or not? You're the one responsible for the charity Mir Jamal gives, but are you in your senses? Look, you're not in your senses.

brh: او فانی نا توس خیرات کیو نی اللہ ایلم نا سلامت کے نی خیرات نا پیشائی کے سا او توست خوائے نی خیرات پاسا اماں ننے ضرورت اف او نا خیرات آتا او نا است اٹ انت خل ہسے ئے او نا خل ئے جوان پو مریوا گنوک تو مریوا
en: He gives charity out of ... — may God keep your brother safe — you ... charity, he wants ..., and you call it charity. Mother, we don't need his charities. Whatever is in his heart, I understand it well; it would drive me mad.
en_old: He gives charity out of his wealth, may God keep your brother safe... Mother, we don't need his charity. What fear is in his heart? His fear would do him good, or he would go mad.

brh: خیر اما پاو نی، اگہ پین داسہ میر جمالی نا اوار آن اسہ گلاس ہنار داڑے، گڑا کنے اگہ لکپیس، بلاس خلپنے انشاءاللہ دا دوئی تون، ہندا زوراکی تون، نسیب بخت مرو، تولوس ہنداڑے، کڈ مرو، زرب بے بے راست پاریکہ کہ دا
en: Well, Mother, I'm telling you: if from now on even one more glass from Mir Jamal's house comes here, then if you don't ... me, ... God willing, with these hands, with this very strength, fortune will come; you will sit right here, ... Zarb Bibi was right when she used to say that this...
en_old: Well, Mother, you tell me: if anyone brings even one more glass from Mir Jamal's house here, then if you don't... God willing, with this prayer, with this strength, there will be good fortune. We will sit right here... Zarb Bibi spoke the truth when she said that this...

brh: دا راکھی او دا بلا بادوئی تو دا دے کسستو نا اوراکھی تو پخیرات مرے سنداڑی چاوا انو کے دنداو کونا پوٹاک نا پیول مرو رنداڑے شت مر
en: This ... and this great ... then today ... the house ... will become charity ... look ... like ... the clothes ... will be ... afterwards ... lost...
en_old: This rakhi and this great curse... today ... charity ... look ... clothes ... will be left behind, will be lost.

brh: بنی راس پارے سا حقیقت اٹ زمانہ نا دستور وڑ و ڈول باز بدل مسنو داڑے ہرا بندغ کہ تینا بارہ وٹ سوچک تینا پیٹ نا و تینا اورانے تکک
en: You speak the truth: in reality the customs, ways and manners of the times have changed a great deal. Here, the person who thinks about himself, who looks after his own belly and his own house...
en_old: Bani Ras said, it's true, the customs and ways of the times have changed a lot; here a person who thinks of himself looks after only his own belly and his own house.

brh: او دے عقلمند و دانا پارے۔ وڑ آ بندغ کہ تینا راج، تینا ڈغار نا ہیت ء کیک۔ او دے کم عقل و کنوک پارے۔ شاید ہندا وجہ غان ننا زند اٹی دا تہار مئی۔
en: ...him they call clever and wise. The kind of person who speaks of his own people, his own land — him they call foolish and mad. Perhaps that is exactly why this darkness has come into our lives.
en_old: They called him clever and wise. The kind of person who talks about his own nation, his own land, they called foolish and mad. Maybe that's why our lives have gone dark.

brh: ودی سیننگے کنے اینو ہندن لگک کہ کنا بے وسی نا بلا وجہ ننا جند نا رویہ غاک او ہمو بندغاک ہراتی تینٹ طاقت خیال کریٹہ
en: ... Today it seems to me that the biggest reason for my helplessness is our own attitudes, and those people whom I myself used to consider my strength.
en_old: ...Today I feel that the cause of my helplessness is our own attitudes, and those people I myself thought of as my strength.

brh: اینو ہمو رویہ غاک کنے بے وس کرینو ئے لندن کونو شہر اسیٹی ہم تینا خستنی آ خیال کتوٹ دا خست کہ اینو تینا ڈغارا تینا اوراٹیٹ
en: Today those very attitudes have made me helpless. Even in a city like London I never felt my loneliness as much as I do today in my own land, in my own home.
en_old: Today those attitudes have left me helpless. Even in a city like London I never felt my loneliness the way I feel lonely today in my own land, in my own home.

brh: تینا بندغ آ تنیامٹ تینا تنیا خیال کننگ ایٹ ئے گمان کتویسٹ کہ ہرا بندغ کہ کنا ہر غمی خوشی ٹی کنا وار سلک اینو ہم تینا مون کنے آن ارسانے انتئے
en: Among my own people I am alone; I feel myself alone. I had never imagined that the person who stood by my side in every sorrow and joy would today turn his face away from me as well. Why?
en_old: Among my own people I am alone... I never imagined that the person who stood by my side in every sorrow and joy would turn his face away from me today. Why?

brh: مسر، ئے خاخر ئے ٹی راخک نہ تیخوکون ئے راخنتئے کومپیسہ، نی انتئے جک کجوڑنگا وراٹی ماتنے شروع کرینوس؟ جیا
en: Daughter, I'm ... in the fire ... why have you started this nonsense, this mourning, in the house? — Yes?
en_old: Misr, burning in the fire and not cooling down... why have you started this...? Yes.

brh: اما خدا نا پیاٹ الے کنے، کنا است اراغ بفک، تو آخر بے مراد کنے پانئے ہن جنہ کلکورو ہن بسونے نی کنے ہچ متنے، کنے تنیا الے، کھڈٹی کاس کنے تنیا الے
en: Mother, for God's sake leave me alone, I don't feel like eating. — So then, wretched girl, tell me ... you have come ... — Nothing has happened to me, leave me alone, ... a pit ... leave me alone.
en_old: Mother, for God's sake leave me alone, I don't feel like eating. So tell me then, wretched one, go... you've come... you don't care about me at all, leave me alone, leave me alone in the pit.

brh: بے مراد انگا شو انتس کہ ایلومنا بریک شال نا بلواک نا کاٹم آ تمیر نی تو باوا کنا پجنگ کپک بلوا دوئی تو کس نی انداڑ کنبائنا مشتے انتو
en: Wretched girl, what is it that ... comes ... fell on the heads of the elders of Shal ... you ... my father ... who are you here ...
en_old: Wretched one, what is it that others... fall on the head of the... of Shal... you don't... my father... if you hold... then who are you here...

brh: ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ واہ لالو اینو تو باز خوبصورت خننگاٹیوس ہوس کنے ننگا پچاک ہلا دا ریش واہ ریش اٹ
en: Mashallah, mashallah! Wow, Lalu, you're looking very handsome today. ... my ... clothes ... this beard — wow, with the beard!
en_old: Mashallah, mashallah! Wow Lalu, you're looking very handsome today... this beard, wow, with the beard!

brh: واہ یار بابو واہ بندغ جیل اٹی مرے تو نی کون ء سنگت ئس تو مرے ئے حیران اٹ ہمو زدون بے کچ و بے گڈانہ
en: Wow, friend Babu, wow! If a man is in jail, he should have a friend like you. I'm amazed at that ... beyond measure and without end.

en: What have I seen here now? What do you want to say? What else do you want? Then answer me this: what was that man doing here in my absence? Why did he come? Who is that man, that ... of this land?
en_old: What have I seen here? What do you want now? Do you want to go out? Then answer this: what was that man doing here in my absence? Why did he come? Who is that man, from this land?

brh: دا نا مخلوق نا او کنا دشمنی، انتئے بسوسو داڑے؟ میرات! نی سوائے نی انت پاننگ اٹیوس؟ نا پاننگ نا مطلب ہندا بے کہ میر جمالی
en: The enmity between this one's people and me: why had he come here? The inheritance! What are you saying? What you mean is just that Mir Jamali...
en_old: The people of this place and my enmity, why did you come here? Inheritance! What are you saying other than that? What you mean is that Mir Jamali...

brh: ئے تینا اراغ تون خوش فینٹ، نی کنے سمٹ خلکوسہ، ولے کنے دا وڑو بھلو الزام ئس خلتہ ویسہ، شرم بریک کنے تینیا، کے نی تون مہر کرینٹ، نفرتی کرینے انت؟
en: I was happy in my own home. You could have slapped me, but you shouldn't have put such a big accusation on me. I am ashamed of myself that I loved you. Have you come to hate me, is that it?
en_old: I was happy with my food. You could have slapped me, but you shouldn't have made such a big accusation against me. I feel ashamed of myself that I loved you. Did you hate me?

brh: نفرتی گانی نی ہبینگوس زیبوں ہتو زیبوں ہن مس ایچ متنے تا
en: Hatred? You ... (unclear), Zebo. ... Zebo, it's done; nothing has happened.
en_old: You were cursing me with hatred, beautiful one. Yes, beautiful one, it turned out that way, nothing happened.

brh: میر صاحب امر خناس دا کیکا نا اراسٹ چٹ لگانے پدا اوباش متانے ئے ہم تاسی درجن
en: Mir Sahib, how did you see this? ... completely ... then he has turned into a scoundrel, and I too ... dozen (garbled).
en_old: Mir Sahib, how did you see this? It sticks completely to the cake, then it has become rotten, and that too by the dozen.

brh: دا ارادے نی پورو اونا چارے اٹ، اسے منٹس اراغان پیشتمپک، اللہ معاف کے پورو واکی دکھ نل الکنے تے۔ دامو دوشے تانکے دانا کاٹمے جگی تنوس۔
en: This plan of yours ... fully, as a remedy for him: he doesn't step out of the house for a single minute. God forgive me, he has really caused a lot of grief. ... you have given his head a place ... (unclear).
en_old: With that intention you were watching him completely; he doesn't go a minute without food, God forgive me. He fully troubled us. Just like that, you gave his head a place on your shoulder.

brh: صاحب مرو اڑے مروئی ہٹی با خلوئے دھانہ چار دے نا لندن نیننگ کیند غرض کروئی ئے ہندا خواہوے ئے ہندا خواہوا کہ انی کہ انداخس بیزار مرے انداخس بیزار مرے کہ
en: Sir, it will happen. Hey, it has to happen. ... for four days to London ... in short, it must be done. This is exactly what I want, exactly what I want: that he gets so fed up, so fed up that...
en_old: Sir, it will happen, it must happen; we have to take him for four days and show him London. That's what I want, that's what I want, that he becomes so fed up, so fed up that...

brh: کہ آئندہ اودا خلکنا دا ڈغارنا ہیت اسل کپتینا میر صاحب کنے تو لگے پک کہ اودا خلک واپس برے او دا سد
en: that in future he never says a word about those people and this land at all. Mir Sahib, I don't think he would come back to those people and this...
en_old: So that in the future he'll never talk about this land again. Mir Sahib, I'm certain that he'll come back and this...

brh: دا خلق ئے لٹکائک سیدھا لندن اللہ معاف کے پیرو دسترخوان ہرا دے دا تو نمے چھمتی کرو کہ دانا ہفت پشت ہم یاد تخور
en: He'll leave these people hanging and go straight to London. God forgive me, ... a full spread ... the day ... we'll make it such for you that even his seven generations will remember it.
en_old: He hangs people up, straight to London, God forgive me, the old man's dining spread; we'll make you so sorry that you'll remember it for seven generations.

brh: نی بس خالی مونا ہرسک، داڑتو نی بند کیو، تحصیلدار صاحب خوش مرے، خوش مرے
en: You just look ahead; from here on I'll put a stop to this. Tehsildar Sahib, be happy, be happy.
en_old: You just keep looking ahead; I'll stop this here, so the Tehsildar Sahib will be happy, be happy.

brh: یار بابو یار نی قسم ء واقعی کمال ء بندغ ئس ئس کنے یقین بننگ افٹ نن آجو مسن
en: Babu, my friend, I swear, you are truly an amazing man. I can't believe we are free.
en_old: Friend Babu, friend, I swear you're truly an amazing person. I can't believe we're free.

brh: یالے، دے ننا پفکک، یا اینو ننا پسک، ارے سائیں پاریسس کہ نو یازدہ بجہ اسکان نم ریڈی مریرے، خا یار سائیں سلام ئے یار
en: Either the day ... for us, or today ... for us (unclear). Hey, Sain had said that you would be ready by nine or eleven o'clock. Well, my friend, Sain, hats off to you, friend!
en_old: Either the day will turn against us, or today will go well for us. Sir, you said you'd be ready by eleven o'clock, my friend, sir, greetings, friend.

brh: قسم خدا ننتس کے پارے ہندم کرے یار۔ یار دا صنم ننتس پارے ہندم کروٹ۔
en: I swear to God, whatever he said, he did exactly that, man. Man, whatever this sweetheart says, I'll do exactly that.
en_old: I swear to God, I didn't say anything to anyone, friend, I did it this way. Friend, this beloved, I didn't say anything, I did it like this.

brh: ہنمس ہنمس ڈی فزا ہوشی ٹیبے چھاکے توغس خناس
en: It's over, it's over ... (unclear) ... you had a dream.
en_old: It's gone, it's gone... in the air, in happiness... I saw a dream.

brh: خطرناک ء تواسس۔ توا کراس تیمہ فیسے پریشان کپہ تینے خاچ۔ ساہد کنے خبر اف انتئے خولیسہ ہرفنگ ٹی ئے انتس ایان؟
en: It was a frightening dream. ... (unclear) Don't worry, go to sleep. Maybe... I don't know why you are afraid. What is there in ...?
en_old: It's dangerous. Don't worry, don't be afraid. Maybe, I don't know why you're scared — what's there in taking it?

brh: دا کنے بسونے دا واقعی کنے نشان تے ہن مطلب مطلب دادے کہ کنے نقصان استے
en: This came to me; this is really a sign for me. I mean, I mean, it means that harm is coming to me.
en_old: This has come to me, it really shows me, I mean, it means that I've suffered a loss.

brh: اونا باٹی زبان اف کہ عید کے او ہرا کن نقصان ایتک۔ نن ساہی کنے خبر اف انت خلیس اسے۔ تو خولی پپ ایچف خاچ۔
en: It has no tongue in its mouth to say whom it will harm. Well, maybe... I don't know what fear this is. So don't be afraid; it's nothing, go to sleep.
en_old: He has no tongue in his mouth to say who he's hurting on Eid. I don't know what it is. So don't be afraid.

brh: ماہین ہندا مس دا سوچنگٹی ئس ئے دا سوچنگٹی اٹ کہ دا سما اسل بفک۔
en: Maheen, that's just how it was. I was thinking this, I was thinking that this would never come to light.
en_old: Maheen was just like that, she kept thinking, thinking that this would never be found out.

brh: ادا نا سوچنگ اٹی شروع کریس ئے ئے او سنگت نا کپرہ مائیں ہائے دتے او سنگت نا کیک دا سفر کے
en: You started thinking about him... I, I won't ... that friend's ... Mother, oh ... she makes this journey with that friend (partly unclear).
en_old: He started thinking about this... the friend's... mother... he makes this journey with the friend.

brh: ئے کاوہ، پد اٹ ایواٹ۔ نہ، دا منی کپک۔ داسہ ہائی نا یات آتیٹی ننا زندگی تیر مریک۔
en: I'm going; I'll come back later. No, this can't be accepted. Now our life will pass in her memories.
en_old: Yes, I'll go, I'll come back later. No, this can't happen. Now our life passes in the memories.

brh: ولے؟ نی اوڑان بغیر زندگی تیر کپارہ۔ مائی! مائی نی گنوک مننگٹی اوسیٹ۔ نی تے پومفیسٹ۔ ئے پومریوے؟ ولے؟ نن پومفیری۔
en: Why? You can't live your life without him? Mother! Mother, you are going mad. You don't understand. Will I understand? Why? We don't understand?
en_old: But why? You can't live your life without him. Mother! Mother, you're going crazy. You don't understand. Will you understand? But why? We won't understand.

brh: نن جوان پومرینہ، ولے کنے دا سائی ایتنگ کپنہ، ہور نائے اوڑتو ملنگ کینہ، ولے ئے کاوہ اوڑتو ملیوا، مائی بابا سما تما گڑا
en: We understand very well, but I can't be given this ... (unclear); we could meet him [later], but I am going to go and meet him. Mother, Dad will find out then.
en_old: We understand well, but I can't give this; you can meet him, but I will go and meet him. Mother, father, do you understand?

brh: سما تمتا؟ اگر نی برداشت کننگ کیس او برداشت کننگ کیک، ولے کنے نا جتائی برداشت مفک۔
en: Won't he find out? If you can bear it, he can bear it, but I cannot bear being separated from you.
en_old: Do you understand? If you can bear it, he can bear it, but I can't bear being separated from you.

brh: دا شور شش کرے او ریا؟ پاپا دا مائیں آن مس مائیں؟ خبر اف
en: Did she make all this commotion? Papa, did this happen because of Mother? Mother? I don't know.
en_old: Who made this noise? Papa, did this happen because of mother? I don't know.

brh: مائی، ہندی تے سے؟ ابا ئے دادے کے آئی، بس ابا
en: Mother, is it like that? Dad, this ... her ... Enough, Dad.
en_old: Mother, what is this? Dad, give this to her. Enough, dad.

brh: دا کتنا اینا پن الکس؟ اگو د نم تم مہر مسکا یا نما خیال مسکا تو گڑا او برام کریکہ؟ انت ابا؟ اینا برام؟ ہاؤ، اونا برام۔ نہ ابا!
en: Did you mention her name like this? If you had had love for her or cared about her, would she then have married? What, Dad? Her marriage? Yes, her marriage. No, Dad!
en_old: What is her name? If you had any love or care for her, would she have gotten married? What, dad? Her marriage? Yes, her marriage. No, dad!

brh: آئی دون کننگ کپک آئی ننائے بس انتس کہ او دے کروئی ئس او کرے نا داسہ نم او دے اوست آن ڈبو گیرام کبو او دے
en: She can't do that. For us, she just did whatever she had to do. Now you all forget her from your hearts, her...
en_old: She can't do that. What she had to do, she did. Now you go and get her married willingly.

brh: کیمونی داڑم خرابو دے بننگ کیرے جوان تو نی کنے دھمکی تننگٹی ئس نہ ئے تو نی ئے تو نی
en: ...that in the future a bad day can come here too. Fine, so you're threatening me, are you? No... so you... so you...
en_old: ...could have a bad day here. Fine, so you are threatening me? No... so you... so you...

brh: نی بروک دیتا باروٹ پاننگ اٹی اٹ، او نی پاننگ نا کوشش کیو کہ نی تینے پریشان کپہ، پریشان تو ئے دوانا رٹ، ہن فضا، فضا ئے تینا مرضی اٹ دا وراٹی بسونٹ۔
en: I'm telling you about the days to come, and I'm trying to tell you not to worry yourself. As for worry, I am... (unclear). Yes, Fiza... Fiza, I have come into this house of my own free will.
en_old: You were talking about the coming days, and you will try to say that you shouldn't worry yourself. Worry is for those... go on, Fiza, Fiza, I came into this house of my own will.

brh: کنے خبر ء نی امر داڑے بسنس تو گڑا گڑا پوم مننگ نا کوشش ء کر کنے ضرورت اف بس نی تینا کاریم تے ٹی کاریم تخ او کنا کمرہ ٹی بننگ نا
en: I know how you got here, so then, then try to understand: I don't need it. Just keep to your own business, and (don't come) into my room...
en_old: I know how you came here, so then try to understand. I don't need it. Just keep your work to your work, and coming into my room...

brh: ضرورت اف ضرورت اف ئے تو حکم نا غلام اٹ بس اینو نی پاریس اینو پد اینو پد نا کمرہ ٹی قدم ہم تخپروٹ
en: No need, no need. I'm just a slave to orders. Enough, today you've said it: from today on I won't even set foot in your room.
en_old: ...no need, no need. So I'm a slave to orders. Enough, today you said it — from today on I won't even set foot in your room.

brh: ہن سوچوٹ ہن سوچوٹ کنے چائے
en: Yes, I'll think about it, yes, I'll think about it. Get me some tea.
en_old: Go on, I'll think, I'll think. I want tea.

brh: زینت نا مثال ء، اوڑان ظلم مننگ اٹی مروئی ء۔ انت پاننگ کیوہ؟ مریم، اسہ چنکو غلطی
en: Zeenat is an example: a wrong was bound to come about through her. What can I say? Maryam, one small mistake...
en_old: ...Zeenat's example; there would be cruelty done to her. What can I say? Maryam, one small mistake...

brh: اسہ بھلو مصیبت ئس بش کیک، ہندا مصیبت نا وڑ ہفشے کارہ، ہمیشے ہمیشہ کن برباد مریرے۔
en: ...stirs up a big calamity; in the same way as that calamity they go (unclear), and you are ruined forever and ever.
en_old: ...raises a big trouble; in the same way as that trouble, they are ruined forever and ever.

brh: راست پاشا صبح شام اینا خیال او خبر اف ایراغ تیرا تفاسہ کا مروکی توبہ مسکری مسکر
en: You're right. Morning and evening there's no thought of him and no news... food... (unintelligible)... God forbid... (unintelligible)
en_old: Honestly, morning and evening there's no thought or news of it... (partly unintelligible) ...repentance... smiling.

brh: نی اینو اودے احوال کر کہ انت حالتے۔ نی ہم کائک اودے دن مپہ کہ غصہ کرو۔ کمال کیسی
en: Today, tell him how things are. And don't you go acting with him in a way that makes him angry. You're something else!
en_old: Tell her today what the situation is. And don't say anything to her that would make her angry. You're amazing.

brh: انتئے غصہ کیرے؟ تینا اولاد نا احوال کبین گناہ مگے۔ بچا ہم خیال کرو۔ انت خیال کیو چھی؟ ولدا اوست نا سما نا؟
en: Why are you getting angry? Is it a sin to ask after one's own child? The child will also think about it. What am I supposed to think, eh? And besides, do you know his heart?
en_old: Why are you getting angry? Asking about your own children isn't a sin. The child will also think. What will he think? And then, do you know his heart?

brh: سما تما کہ نم تینا اولاد ء بیرام کتنو نن ہم تینا اولاد کن خوشی مٹی کین نی انت پاسہ فون کے ہرفتا اوف کنا خدا فون آن سما تما کہ
en: It would have become known that you haven't married off your children; we too do (want) happiness for our children. What are you saying, he didn't pick up the phone? Oh my God, from a phone call it would have become known that...
en_old: We would have known that you didn't make your children sick; we too want happiness for our children. What do you say, call... my God, from the phone we would have known that...

brh: او امرے انت لٹی خوش ئے خوش اف صحیح ئے امر کہ ناراض اوکے نیک ہا دا وار کستے ئے چنت زمانہ دے انکریں باز یاد بننگٹی
en: And how is he? What... is he happy or not happy? Is he all right? How come he's upset... this time... (unclear)... it's been so many days, I'm missing him a lot.
en_old: How is he? Is he happy or not? Is he all right? Since he's upset... this time... how many days it's been, I'm missing him a lot.

brh: اللہ جوڑ کیتے ننا مور کے پریشان مجیبندے ننا مور کے باز پریشان انتھے پریشان مف اونا ایلے نیتھر چہ لار کیکیتے
en: May God set it right. Our mother, don't be worried... our mother is very worried. Why wouldn't she be worried? Her... (rest unintelligible)
en_old: May God make things right; our mother shouldn't be worried. Our mother is very worried. Why wouldn't she be worried? Her brother... (partly unintelligible)

brh: او نمونہ تینے مونجا کپہ اونا غصہ نی چاسہ نن ہم نی ئے او نمونہ تینے پریشان کپہ مے اسکارے مسکر مے او دے پاکے
en: Don't make yourself sad like that. You know his anger, and so do we. Don't worry yourself like that... (unclear)... tell him.
en_old: Don't make yourself sad like that. You know his anger; we do too. Don't worry yourself like that... smile... tell him that.

brh: سہب نا خوشی بالکل اودے ہچ فکر افک ہومسس؟
en: All that happiness since the morning — he has no worry at all, does he?
en_old: The joy of the morning — she has no worries at all, right?

brh: اسلام
en: Salaam.
en_old: Salaam.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ راشد نی؟ ہراڑے مسنوس؟ یار چناک باز ڈسٹرب او، کنے ہم باز ڈسٹرب کرینو۔
en: Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you. Rashid, is that you? Where have you been? Man, the kids are really upset, and they've upset me a lot too.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Rashid, is that you? Where have you been? Man, the kids are really upset, and they've upset me a lot too.

brh: یا ثناء جان ہمدا خاطر آن تو ئے نی پاوہ کہ چنا تے کن گڑاس کر یار چنا تے کن گڑاس کر یار نی ایتے دے سے دے سے ہمداڑے برام ئس کرکیس جیو برام بلکہ ئے تو
en: Oh Sana dear, it's for this very reason that I keep telling you: do something for the kids, man, do something for the kids. One of these days you could hold a wedding right here — yes, a wedding — in fact I...
en_old: Oh Sana dear, that's exactly why you keep saying, do something for the kids, man, do something for the kids. You could hold a wedding right here one of these days, yes, a wedding, actually...

brh: ئے چودہ اگست نا عید ء ہم کرینوٹ۔ یار مریوت کنے گٹ ہوس۔ عید اسکان ہچ فیصلہ کتوٹ۔ او نی برام نا تیاری تے شروع کریس۔ یار ثناء جان راست ارفیس تو اینا چناتے دن خنیوہ کنے ہم برداشت مفک۔
en: I have even celebrated the Eid of August 14th. Man, my sense of obligation has me in a bind. I didn't decide anything until Eid. And you started the wedding preparations. Man, Sana dear, honestly, when I see his kids like this, I can't bear it either.
en_old: I even celebrated the Eid of August 14th. Man, I'm in trouble, I'm stuck. I didn't decide anything until Eid. And you started the wedding preparations. Man, Sana dear, honestly, when I see your kids like this, I can't bear it either.

brh: نی راست پاسہ سنگت راست ارفیس تو داسہ دا استے ٹی پین کسس جاگہ ہلنگ کپک
en: You're right, friend. Honestly, now no one else can take a place in this heart.
en_old: You're right, friend. Honestly, there's no room left in this heart for anyone else now.

brh: او نا کنا ذہن دا ہیتے منے دا تو غلط ئس یار اینا ہیتے پکا کننگ اٹی اٹ او نی انکار کننگ اٹی ئس دا تو جوان ئس اف یار سنگت نا خاطر تو پاننگ اٹی اٹ کہ کنا ہیتے پومنگ نا کوشش کر
en: And would my mind accept this? This is simply wrong, man. I'm trying to settle his matter and you're refusing; that's not good, man. For friendship's sake I'm telling you: try to understand what I'm saying.
en_old: And my mind accepts this, but this is wrong, man. I'm trying to settle your matter and you're refusing, that's not good, man. For a friend's sake I'm telling you, try to understand what I'm saying.

brh: تو ٹھیک ہی وڑا کنے
en: Then fine, that way is all right with me.
en_old: So that's fine with me.

brh: اما، امو رے، ننے خلٹ گولیٹ
en: Mother, oh mother, they shot us with bullets.
en_old: Mother, oh mother, they beat us, they shot at us.

brh: نی پنیامرس، انت پاوما، انتس پنی خاصہ، بس، بس دا سمجھے، زند نا دے تے پورا۔
en: You'll be... what can I say, mother, what is (so) special... enough, enough, just understand this: the days of (my) life are over.
en_old: You're... what should we say, what's special, enough, enough, just understand this, the days of life are over.

brh: کننگٹیو کنا ساوتوئی تینوٹ خناٹ کیو نی اناخس نفرت کیرہ تینا غصہ نی اکشیرہ اماں
en: It was happening... I saw my own (death?) with my own eyes. Why do you hate so much? You are taking out your anger, mother.
en_old: I saw my death myself. Why do you hate so much? You're taking out your anger, mother.

brh: اما دانے دانے بخیر کتوک جان کتوک پرواہ سف کنا سا
en: Mother, this... this one... not welcomed, not cared for, no concern for my... (partly unintelligible)
en_old: Mother, you didn't forgive this, you didn't care, my...

brh: ئے اوفتہ فکرے کپرا کنے تو نا فکرے بس اماں آئی نو بٹ ئے ہم کسس نا پرواہی کپرا بس
en: I don't worry about them; I only worry about you, mother. I know, but I don't care about anyone either, that's all.
en_old: They don't care about them, I only care about you, mother. But they don't care about anyone either, that's all.

brh: خڑنگ خلپہ کنا مسڑ، بٹ ت خدا غا، اما دا خڑنگک تو نا بندغ نا خوشی ٹی پیش تمار، او کنا چنا۔
en: Don't shed tears, my daughter, leave it to God. Mother, these tears came out of happiness for your loved one. Oh my child.
en_old: Don't cry, my daughter, trust in God. Mother, these tears will fall in your loved one's happiness, oh my child.

brh: کنے دا ہرفنگ نا ضرورت اف کہ نی امر ئس او تو اوفتا رویہ غان، نا چیرہ غان ظاہر مس، کنے داڑے ہم، امر گتریفنگٹ ئس تیرا زندگی، اماں، اماں نی کنے دا ایتا تے
en: I don't need to ask what you are going through; it showed from their behaviour and from your face. And here too, (I can see) how you've been spending your life, mother. Mother, mother, you gave me this...
en_old: I don't need to be told who you are. It showed from their behavior and from your face. Here too, how did I spend my life, mother, mother, you gave me this...

brh: او گدی! داسکان داڑے تولوک ئس چاوہ کہ ایرا دیر نا ہچ فکر اف نی ئے پاننگٹ نی زو ایرا تیار کر۔ جی، جی او۔
en: Hey girl! You're still sitting here — I know you don't care at all about the food and water. I'm telling you, get the food ready quickly. — Yes, yes.
en_old: Hey girl! You're still sitting here even though you know there's no worry about the bath water? I'm telling you, get the water ready quickly. Yes, yes.

brh: کنے یقین ئے کہ ہرا تغاتے ابا خنا سس اونا او امیدے دا اسہ ننا مار پورا کروئی بالکل ہمدن مارو انشاء اللہ ہمدن ماروئے ماشاء اللہ ماشاء
en: I am sure that the dreams Father had seen, his (dreams) and his hope, it is our son who is to fulfil them; it will turn out exactly like that, God willing, exactly like that it will be, mashallah, masha-
en_old: I'm sure that the dreams father had, that hope of his, our son will fulfil it, it will be exactly like that, God willing, it will be just like that, mashallah, mashallah.

brh: ماشاءاللہ اباجی نوم تاڑے نوم تینا ایتا تے ہندارے کیرے یا پیشن لانچٹی ہم بریرے اباجی کن دا اراٹی کہ اخس کہ خوشی او اخس کہ خوشی بننگٹی او ئے کل نما وجہ اٹ
en: Mashallah, Father, you are here; you watch your own ..., or you also come out to the lounge. For Father this ... how much joy, and how much joy is coming, and it is all because of you.
en_old: Mashallah, father, your name here... they show their name, or it also comes on the fashion launch. For father, how much happiness there is in this, how much happiness is coming, it is all because of you.

brh: ہوا کنے یاد بس کنے نشار تون ہیت کروئی اسکہ نی ہیت کرینوس بس اباجی داسہ ہیت کننگٹی اسوٹا بلے دا داخس ہیت کیک داخس ہیت کیک ہیت کنا استنے نا اباجی ہیت
en: Yes, I remembered: I had to talk with Nisar. Have you talked (to him)? Well, Father, I was talking just now, but this one talks so much, talks so much... talking... my ..., Father, talking.
en_old: Yes, I remembered, I had to talk to Nishar, have you talked? Well, father, I was talking just now, but he talks so much, talks so much, talking... my heart, father, talking.

brh: تکیرہ، دا کنا زی آ الزام خلنگ اٹی ء، اسل غلطینٹی تکپک۔ خیر الے بو دا ہیت آتے، کابو پیشن لانچ اٹی، ہموڑے تولن، ہموڑے ہیت و گپ کین۔ جیو باوہ، سلطانہ، ئے مچٹ چائے اتوٹ؟
en: See, this one is putting the blame on me; in fact (I) am not at fault at all. Anyway, leave these matters; go on out to the lounge, let's sit there and talk and chat there. Long live, Father. Sultana, shall I bring a little tea?
en_old: Look, this is an accusation against me, it's not wrong at all. Anyway, leave these matters; come on, let's go to the lounge, sit there and talk there. Long live, father. Sultana, did you bring a little tea?

brh: خیریت کہ ئے دا پین غوئیوٹ کہ امر جوانو موقع سے ماشاءاللہ وراٹی داخس خوشی بسنو دونو وختان نن سیدنا برام نا ئے تے ابہ تو گپن چاوکت
en: All is well, I was just saying what a fine occasion this is; mashallah, so much joy has come into the house. At such a time we ... Saeed's wedding ... talk with Father ...
en_old: It's all good, I was just saying what a good occasion this is, mashallah, so much happiness has come into the home. At such times we... Saeed's wedding... (partly unintelligible)

brh: نی سئیجان کے مسلس خنانس؟ ہاؤ نا، ہمے ہفتہ نا والا ریحانہ؟ ہاؤ، ریحانہ تو باز جوان و مسلس۔ ولے سلطانہ؟ سئیجان نا بارام نا اختیار
en: Have you seen a girl for Saeed Jan? Yes, isn't it, that one from this week, Rehana? Yes, Rehana is a very good girl. But Sultana? The choice in Saeed Jan's marriage ...
en_old: Sain Jan, have you seen the girl? Yes, the one from this very week, Rehana? Yes, Rehana is a very good girl. But Sultana? Sain Jan's wedding is his own choice.

brh: ہر گنتو افک اینہ برام نا اختیار کنا لمہ بابا تون ء
en: Not at all; the choice in my marriage lies with my mother and father.
en_old: Not at all, the decision about my wedding is with my mom and dad.

brh: بابا جان، نما خنتٹی خڑینک؟ نم اوغنگ اٹی وری کنا مسڑ، کنے گڑاس یاد بس۔ متکنی۔۔۔
en: Father, are there tears in your eyes? Are you crying? My daughter, I remembered something. The old days...
en_old: Father, are there tears in your eyes? Are you crying, my daughter? I remembered something. Earlier...

brh: دا وخت گڑا وخت یاد بریک کنے کنے باز مونجا کیک بابا جان ئے اینو مائی تپو مت وٹ کنا مسڑ پگہ
en: At this time, that time comes back to my memory and it makes me very sad. Father, today mother ... My daughter, tomorrow...
en_old: At this time I remember things, I miss father a lot. Today mother didn't give... my daughter tomorrow.

brh: چاندہ اگست، چاندہ اگست نا دے ننا دا ہنینی آ ملک پاکستان جوڑ مس۔ ہمو ملک
en: Fourteenth of August: on the day of the fourteenth of August this dear country of ours, Pakistan, was created. That country...
en_old: Fourteenth of August, on the day of fourteenth August our dear country Pakistan was created. That country...

brh: کہ ننا ملک کن ننا بزرگ آک ننا پیرینگ آک قربانی تسنو۔ انت چائے ننا ملک ننے باز انگا قربانی تیان پد ملانے۔ ہو کنا مسڑ چنا۔
en: that for our country our elders, our forefathers, made sacrifices. You know, we got our country after a great many sacrifices. Yes, my daughter, child.
en_old: That our elders, our forefathers gave sacrifices for our country. What do you know, we got our country after many sacrifices. Yes, my daughter, child.

brh: اومکا بھلا ورنائیں غاک پیریں غاک کل دا ملک کے قربانی تیسنو ولے اینو نا نسلے ننا دا ملک نا باروٹ ہچ سما اف کنا بچا ہچ سما اف
en: Those elders, the young and the old, all made sacrifices for this country, but today's generation knows nothing about this country of ours; my child, they know nothing at all.
en_old: Those elders, the youth, the elderly, all gave sacrifices for this country, but today's generation knows nothing about our country, my child, knows nothing at all.

brh: دا ملک ء جوڑ کننگ اٹی قائد اعظم نا باز بھلو کردار اسے۔ دا ملک نا تصور ء علامہ اقبال تسنے۔
en: Quaid-e-Azam played a very big role in creating this country. The idea of this country was given by Allama Iqbal.
en_old: Quaid-e-Azam played a very big role in creating this country. The idea of this country was given by Allama Iqbal.

brh: اور دا ملک دون آسانیٹ ننے ملتنے، دا ملک کن نن باز کوشش کرینو، ننا بزرگ آک ننا پیرہ غاک دا ملک کن باز کوشش کرینو کہ اینو نن دا جاگہ غا توسن۔ السلام علیکم
en: And we did not get this country so easily; we made great efforts for this country; our elders, our forefathers made great efforts for this country so that today we are sitting in this place. Peace be upon you.
en_old: And we did not get this country so easily; we made many efforts for this country, our elders and forefathers made many efforts for this country so that today we are sitting in this place. Peace be upon you.

brh: سلام بابا جان وعلیکم السلام سہی جان کنا پھل سہی جان ہیمر ئس کنا جان ئے جوان بابا جان ہنے اللہ حافظ برا والا کل نا انتظاری کینگٹی اٹی
en: Hello, Father. And peace be upon you, Saeed Jan, my flower; Saeed Jan, how are you, my dear? I am fine, Father. Okay, goodbye. Come, everyone is waiting.
en_old: Hello father. And peace be upon you too. Fine, my dear, my flower, fine dear... my dear is good, father. Go, goodbye. Come, everyone is waiting.

brh: او گاڑی مخلوق تو سوار نی پٹیکو نی خننگ بیسہ خبر اف کے ارانگوس بس ئے بابا جان ئے بچ سنگت ئتو اوار اسوٹ اوفتے ٹریٹ تروئی ئس تو اوفتے ٹریٹ تسوٹ اینو پد فارغ مسوٹ بسوٹ داڑے تو نم
en: That car, loaded with people... (we) searched for you, you were nowhere to be seen, who knows where you were. Well, Father, I was together with friends; I had to give them a treat, so I gave them a treat; today after that I got free and came here, so you...
en_old: That car full of people... you weren't found, you couldn't be seen, I don't know where you were. Well, father, I was with my friends, I had to give them a treat, so I gave them a treat. Today afterward I got free and came here, so you...

brh: ابو نما حکم سئی جان سئی جان مبارک مرے نی بھائی ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ خوش کریس کنے یار بس ماشاءاللہ سئی بس روز مبارک مرے خیر مبارک نیک خبرے
en: Father, as you command. Saeed Jan, Saeed Jan, congratulations to you, brother; mashallah, mashallah, you have made me happy, man. Well, mashallah, Saeed, well, congratulations on the day. Thank you. It is good news.
en_old: Father, as you command. Okay dear, okay dear. Congratulations to you, brother, mashallah, mashallah, you made me happy, man. Well, mashallah, okay, well, congratulations for the day. Thank you. It's good news.

brh: بابا جان کرینا ہندا خوشی ٹی کل رشتہ داراتے کل سیالاتے دعوت نا پروگرام جوڑ کرینے نانت خیال ئے دا بارہ ٹی ہرات کہ نما خوشی نما خوشی ٹی کنا خوشی اللہ نی آباد کے اللہ نی
en: Father has, in this very joy, arranged a feast for all the relatives, all the kin. What is your opinion about this? Whatever you wish; your happiness, in your happiness is my happiness. May God keep you prosperous, may God (make) you...
en_old: Father has, in this very happiness, arranged a dinner party for all the relatives and all the kin. What is your opinion about this? Whatever, your happiness, in your happiness is my happiness. May God keep you prosperous, may God...

brh: سر سوب کے گنما، آمین، مبارک، خیر مبارک، اللہ نی آباد کے، اما جان سعید محنتی ئس تو رے، بھلے اور تو اوار وار نما تا دعا خیر اٹ سا ایم ہریرا، سبی آن تگ زون خاموش
en: ...successful. Amen. Congratulations. Thank you. May God keep you prosperous. Mother, Saeed is a hard-working one, so ... alright, and along with that, your prayers, with goodness ... from Sibi ... quiet.
en_old: Sir, may you be successful... Amen. Congratulations. Thank you. May God keep you prosperous. Mother, Saeed is hardworking, so... alright, and together with your prayers, goodness... from Sibi... quiet.

en: Silence! Just now you were saying that you would give your friends a treat, that you would invite them; now why are you sitting so quiet and silent? I am upset with Saeed. Why? He told me ... that with the gift...
en_old: Silence! Just now you were saying you'd give your friends a treat, you'd invite them, why are you sitting so quiet and silent now? Okay, you're angry, why? He told me... about the gift.

brh: ستو بھلے گفٹ ایتو الے اینو پگہ تو نن کے ٹائم افیتونٹا۔ سعید سبین پنی گٹی ئے دانا عادت ئے بس دانا عادت ئے نا نیچنا فرض ئے پورا کر۔ ابا جان نادانہ گفٹ ئے گیراں کر۔ بس بابا جان کنا رند کنا گفٹ ئے
en: So, fine, a gift will be given; leave it, these days we don't even have time. Saeed ... it is his habit, just his habit. Fulfil your ... duty. Father, he forgot her gift. Enough, Father, my ... my gift...
en_old: Well, give the gift, these days we don't even have time. Saeed... this is his habit, well, this is his habit, fulfill your duty. Father, I forgot his gift. Well father, my... my gift.

brh: ئے گفٹ ئے گرام خریست خن تے پٹ خن تے مال دا سمبالت خن تے مال اسے وا نی کنے گنوک جوڑ
en: Did I forget the gift? Look, search, look, the item, I kept this safe, look, it is something; and you are driving me crazy.
en_old: You forgot the gift... look for it, the things, take care of this, look, it's a thing... again you're making me crazy.

brh: دے خبر دے خبر
en: Who knows, who knows.
en_old: What news, what news?

brh: دا دے ایم بے بے ایس، پی ایچ ڈی او بھلو بھلو خواروکا بنداغ اوفتے نوکری ملے تو او نی ملے ایم سے ایس کرینوس باز بھلو غرض کرینوس
en: These days, if MBBS, PhD and very highly educated people get a job, then will you get one? You have done an MS; as if you have done something very great.
en_old: These days MBBS, PhD and highly educated people, if they get a job then you'll get it. You've done an MS, you've done a big favor.

brh: سجاد اراسک اوچاتی ٹی نی اؤس ہا
en: Sajjad, where are you? Are you in there?
en_old: Sajjad, where are you, are you in the office?

brh: نی خبرے؟ نی خبرے داڑے، دا ملکٹی، داڑان بغیر ہچ کاری مفک۔ اسے یا چار، یا پنچ ویکینسی بریرے۔
en: Do you know? You know, here, in this country, nothing gets done without this. One, or four, or five vacancies come up.
en_old: Do you know? Do you know that here, in this country, nothing gets done without this. One, or four, or five vacancies come up.

brh: ہسار آ مرگ و بلین آ سلوک ہودے دا ملک اٹ تینا زندگی دریفک پاسہ؟ گنوک کرینوس تینا؟ سجاد
en: Dying a thousand deaths and sitting idle - is that how one spends one's life in this country, you say? Have you gone mad? Sajjad.
en_old: Starving to death and staying jobless — is that how you'll spend your life in this country, you say? Have you lost your mind? Sajjad.

brh: داڑے بوم ڈاکٹر واچنگ یو ہمم راست پاننگٹ نی
en: Here ... 'doctor watching you' ... hmm, you are telling the truth.
en_old: Here... hmm, you're telling the truth.

brh: پیسہ کہ ور ہمم ئے کنا تاری بسس دا جاہ غا کل بندغاک موری کتیہ برکنے ہمم
en: If I had money, hmm, ... in my hand, all the people in this place would come swarming to me, hmm.
en_old: If there were money, hmm, in my hand, all the people in this place would come running to me, hmm.

brh: ہین زہیران، ہین، ہین، پیشانی۔ کنے تینا زند ئس پین سیٹی ٹی گدریفوئی۔ ہئی جوان چا؟
en: Hmm, out of longing, hmm, hmm, worry. I have to spend my life in another city. Hey, do you understand that well?
en_old: What, Zaheeran, what, what? Worry. I have to spend my life in another city. Do you understand that well?

brh: مرید آئی برا بس داسہ تسلی مسنے؟
en: Mureed, Mother... so, are you satisfied now?
en_old: Mureed, she came. Are you satisfied now?

brh: حمیداتی کینی پانے کتوٹا جوان ئس جوان ئس کہ بابا تینٹ پارینے نہ آئی برام کننگ کپک
en: Hameeda... I couldn't say it: it's good, it's good that Baba himself has said no, Mother cannot marry.
en_old: Hameeda told her, it's good, it's good that father himself said no, she can't get married.

brh: دا کتیخو؟ ہش مرجا، کنا تو با ہشنگا، داسکا دادے کتیخ بیٹ کننگ افا، تو پاپ، بندغ اسل با ہوس کننگ کپک ایتیتا، زینت، او زینت!
en: Is this...? Hush... my mouth is burning too... she still won't... so don't say anything; you can't bring her round at all. Zeenat, oh Zeenat!
en_old: Was this killed? Be quiet, my mouth has gone dry, it still can't be done. So, papa, a person can never... Zeenat, oh Zeenat!

brh: جی جی انت مس؟ دا کتہ غان نکرے استا؟ انتے انت مس؟ دا قسمت تو دیر؟
en: Yes, yes, what happened? Did this...? Why, what happened? Whose fate is this?
en_old: Yes, yes, what happened? Did this... what happened? Why, what happened? Whose fate is this?

brh: نی دانے ہسپتالاتے دے ہوسا، اللہ کے، دانا نظرو ایت کیرے، او زینت، تینا ہوشے تینتو تخ، اللہ چائے، ئے تینٹ جوڑ کریٹ تا، مرچو ہیت تا، برابر ئس
en: You take her to the hospital, for God's sake, keep an eye on her. Oh Zeenat, pull yourself together. God knows, I made it for her myself; today I talked with her, she was fine.
en_old: Take her to the hospital, for God's sake, someone has put the evil eye on her. Oh Zeenat, get hold of yourself. God knows, I made it myself. Talk to her today, properly.

brh: دادے کین بفک باہو ستے وتا حف کن امر
en: She isn't coming round... how...?
en_old: How will I raise these children and take care of them alone?

brh: سما تمانے؟ اف خدایا ئے ئے ہرا وخت آ جوڑ کریٹ تا تو کل گڑا تا برابر ئس تو گڑا ننے یاد کرینا؟ نہ آئی کنا مطلب ئے تینا مطلب ئے تینت تخ
en: Has she come to? Oh God, when I made it for her, everything was in order for her; and then did you remember us? No, Mother, what I mean... keep your insinuations to yourself.
en_old: Do you understand? Oh God, when I made you, did you remember us equal to everything? No, I mean, keep your meaning to yourself.

brh: ہوشا ٹی کاریم کرواسیٹ اوہو داسہ بند کبو دا قصہ ئے ارے سالتہ ہپ مچ کدا بشہ فضا
en: I had done the work carefully. Oh ho, now stop this story... Fiza, get up.
en_old: You'll work with your senses about you. Oh, stop this story now...

brh: زینت! او زینت! جی؟ دے کے باونہ تینا اوشاس۔ جی۔
en: Zeenat! Oh Zeenat! — Yes? — Today, for Father, your... — Yes.
en_old: Zeenat! Oh Zeenat! Yes? Bring me some tea today. Yes.

brh: تیما تے خن کنا لگا نی ننے برباد کننگ کے دا وڑ آٹی بسنوس؟ ایلوم نا تو شاکر نا بلاغاتے ہرفے او نی داڑے بسنوس ننے برباد کننگ کے؟ آئی پین دے دن مفروئے پین دے
en: Look, it seems to me you have come here like this to ruin us? You brought calamities on your brother and on Shakir, and now you've come here to ruin us? Mother, it won't be like this any more, not one more day.
en_old: Look at them, do you think you came here in this way to ruin us? You took Shakir's brother away from us, and you came here to ruin us? It won't be like this anymore, not anymore.

brh: انت مسئی؟ دے گڑا مونی مونی کرے پین انت مس؟ انت؟ تانا باوا نا اوڑائی انتس کہ اوست نا کشی؟
en: What happened to her? So today she answered him back to his face — what else happened? What? What is it about your father that tugs at your heart?
en_old: What happened? So he went ahead today, then what happened? What? What was it about your father that he had to suffer?

brh: کسے؟ تینا اوشاتی انتئے تفس؟ التہ زاہد، التہ۔ نی التہ کنے آئی، اینو دادے کسوئے؟ التہ بس داسہ معاف کر تا، التہ۔ قسم کنے، قسم کنے، دا زنا تو مرگ جوانی واہ، اینو تینا زبانے ملانوس نی۔
en: Who? Why are you out of your mind? Leave her, Zahid, leave her! You leave her... Mother... are you going to kill her today? Leave her, just forgive her now, leave her. — I swear, I swear, for this woman death would be better; today you have opened your mouth!
en_old: Who? Why did you spit out your tea? No, Zahid, no. Not you, me, will you beat her today? No, just forgive her now, no. I swear, I swear, death would be better for this woman, today you have let your tongue loose.

brh: آ کنا عیدی کیوہ، انتئے دون کیرے کنتو، کنا قصور انتئے؟ صبو شام اسکان نما خدمت ئے کیوہ، او ہم دون کیرے کنتو، انتئے؟ بند کہ با تینا، دا ہچ ئس اف مائی، اگر نن خوہنہ نی تون
en: Ah, I do my... why do you treat me like this? What is my fault? From morning till evening I serve you all, and still you treat me like this, why? — Shut your mouth, this is nothing, woman; if we wanted to, with you...
en_old: I am doing my duty, why do you treat me like this, what is my fault? From morning till evening I serve you, and still you treat me like this, why? Shut your mouth, this is nothing, mother, if we want you...

brh: او انتئے نو نم کنے کیرے کنے تو مچ آ زند نمہ غلامی ٹی تنگانے ئے تو بے وس ئے چسپاننگ کپرا ئے تو نیاڑی سے اٹ نا
en: Oh, why do you do this to me? My whole life has gone in your servitude; I am helpless, I can't hold out any more; I am a woman, after all.
en_old: Oh, why do you do this to me? My whole life I have lived in your slavery, I am helpless, I cannot bear it, I am a woman.

brh: کنے چختے ارا بو، نمے کولے ارا رے، نم اگے انتوس پائے، نم کانتو ظلم کبو، ہک کسے تون فریاد کپروٹ
en: ... Whatever you say, even if you treat me cruelly, I won't complain to anyone.
en_old: I have no one, you have everyone; whatever you say, don't be cruel to me, I couldn't even complain to anyone.

brh: کنا دا دنیا ٹی کس اف کنا بابا لمہ سیال و عزیز آک کل ختم مسور کل ہمیدے آ ختم مسور ہرا دے کہ او کنا داڑے نوہورا ٹی راہی کریر
en: I have no one in this world. My father, mother, relatives and kin all perished — they all perished on the very day they sent me off here.
en_old: I have no one in this world; my father, mother, relatives and loved ones all perished, they all perished on the very day they sent me here to Nohora.

brh: نم ظلم کروئی نم کبو نم کنتو کین کرے نمے اختیار ئے مت کپا چنا
en: If you must be cruel, then be cruel; you bear a grudge against me; the power is yours... my child.
en_old: You must be cruel, do it, do whatever you want with me, you have the authority, child.

brh: ہیلو، ہیلو ایڑے مجیب ات کنے اٹ ہٹ، مجیب امر ئس
en: Hello, hello, sister, it's Mujeeb, it's me. — Mujeeb, how are you?
en_old: Hello, hello, here Mujeeb, it's me, Mujeeb, how are you?

brh: ئے بالکل جوانٹ، ئے تو ئے تو باز خوشٹ، بس بس نما کمی ئے
en: I'm perfectly well, I'm very happy; it's just, just that I miss you.
en_old: I'm completely fine, I'm very happy, it's just that I miss you.
