en_old: ...they talk about it; whatever understanding God gave our minds. There's the fear that the Sardar will kill me, so-and-so will kill me. If I speak the truth, the MPAs can remove me from the Chief Ministership, the people in charge can remove me too, everyone can remove me. My God is present there too, and there's fear there too.

brh: کہ ایم پی ئے نکالیں گے مطلب اللہ کے بعد ادھر بھی دل مین خوف ہی کہ میرا ایم پی ئے بھی مجھے نکالیں گے اللہ کہتا ہی اچھا مین بھی ہوں آپ کے ایم پی ئے بھی نکال سکتے ہیں تو مطلب مجھے اپنے ئس سے نکال اپنے ایم پی ئے کو طاقتور کرتا دھرتا بھی نکالتے ہیں اچھا ادھر بھی تمہارا خدا بستا ہی وہ بھی تم کو نکال سکتے ہیں کامیاب ناکامیاب اچھا
en: ...that the MPAs will remove me. I mean, after God, there is also fear in the heart here that my MPAs too will remove me. God says: fine, I am also here; your MPAs can also remove you. So I mean, remove me from your own..., make your own MPAs powerful; the people in charge also remove you. Fine, your God lives there too; they can also remove you. Successful, unsuccessful, fine.
en_old: ...that the MPAs will remove me. It means that after God, there's fear in the heart here too, that my MPAs will also remove me. God says, fine, I'm here too; your MPAs can remove you, so it means removing me from your own... you make your MPAs powerful, and the people in charge remove you too. Fine, your God lives there too, and He can remove you as well. Success, failure, fine.

brh: وزیر اعلی بلوچستان میر عبدالقدوس بزنجو صوبائی اسمبلی مین اظہار خیال کر رہی ہیں۔ اپنے خطاب مین میر عبدالقدوس بزنجو کہتے ہیں تمام تر طاقت کا منبع اللہ تعالی ہی
en: Balochistan Chief Minister Mir Abdul Quddus Bizenjo is expressing his views in the provincial assembly. In his address, Mir Abdul Quddus Bizenjo says that God Almighty is the source of all power.
en_old: Balochistan Chief Minister Mir Abdul Quddus Bizenjo is speaking in the Provincial Assembly. In his address Mir Abdul Quddus Bizenjo says that Allah Almighty is the source of all power.

brh: او یس ہندا دو نابود کنا خیال پاک نام کاٹومٹی بارڈر ئے
en: And yes, this... destroyed; in my opinion... [Pakistan's?] name... on top of the border. (garbled)
en_old: And yes, this was destroyed; I think Pakistan's name... the border.

brh: نی انتئے ہرفینوس تے؟ ئے او پینٹ آخا اینہ دارو کو۔ دادے تو تیتہ نوستہ۔ اسل داستے سرتہ۔
en: Why have you picked it up? Hey, that paint... no, this is medicine... This one wasn't even given [unclear]. It never even got here at all.
en_old: Why did you take them? That paint is like this medicine. You didn't even drink this. It never got here at all.

brh: اسے دے کنا مسڑ، نی کنے کسفیسہ، او مائی گاڈ! دا، الے ہکنگٹیوس شاوکی، ابانا یاد کننگٹیوس؟ ابا یاد کننگٹیو، ابا
en: One day, my daughter, you will kill me! Oh my God! This... are you [unclear]? Are you missing Father? I'm missing Father, Father.
en_old: One day, my daughter, you'll kill me, oh my God! This... aren't you listening? Are you remembering father? I'm remembering father, father.

brh: دا نمس، اسے دے کنے ابا غا ضرور رائیکے، انتئے آن مس؟ دا کنے باڈی ئنا ہندا دارو تے کنے وینے!
en: This... [unclear]. One day you will surely send me off to Father! Why did this happen? These are those body medicines of mine... [unclear] me!
en_old: This... one day I'll definitely tell father. Why did it happen? This gave me this medicine for the body!

brh: او مائی گاڈ! ایلو، داڑے کھٹی! ایلو، داڑے کھٹی! ئے دیدہ اوئے یار! دا جس کنے بھینڈی کنے
en: Oh my God! Hey, here... [unclear]! Hey, here... [unclear]! Look, oh friend! This one... me... okra... me... (garbled)
en_old: Oh my God! Hey, sit here! Hey, sit here! Look at him, man! This guy is driving me crazy!

brh: صحیح بتن صحیح بتنگو ئے وا خوش اسوٹ ایت کھرک غٹ چور کن کن کٹے غس ایرا غس تیار کرو اٹ کنوٹ نوشی جان کرو اٹ تے ایلو اینٹی پارے تے ئے کنے دا پارے اینو مٹ کستاو را غان بلو باڑ باڑ نا توار ئس بس کنے پارے ہندا شو
en: Right... properly... [unclear]. I was so happy. Give... all... [unclear]... I'll get two things ready, I'll eat, I'll eat it with relish. The other one told her, and she told me this: today a loud banging noise came from the house... [unclear], and she told me, 'That's it.' (partly garbled)
en_old: Right, sit properly, sit down. I was happy. I'll get everything ready and make some for Noshi jaan. The other day she told me that today a loud noise came from the house, and she said, that's how it is.

brh: او مخدے مسنابو اندا لمے تینا بوٹیو دارو کنے پینے
en: Oh, [unclear]... Mother, your herbal medicine, for me to drink.
en_old: Oh, it's been so long. Mother, give me your herbal medicine.

brh: او کنا لمہ یکا بیماری جوڑ تو ئے ہم مفٹ گڑا جوان ہشیمونہ جان او نی اما مرو عید کننگاٹی ئس انتے کنا پشک و خرنو پیونو عید اہ مگر کسس لمہ تینا کسفینے ایرن جاہ پائے
en: Oh my mother, this illness... I'm not getting well at all. Well, all right, dear Hashimona... and how will you be, are you celebrating Eid? Why, my clothes and [unclear] for Eid... but someone... Mother has killed her own... [unclear].
en_old: Oh mother, this illness isn't getting better at all. Fine, dear, but won't you celebrate Eid? Why, my clothes and shoes for Eid... but nobody... Mother says leave it where it is.

brh: اہئی اون اینو پگہ وخت ہندنے کنا کاٹم دا سدائی دت تما امر تما او دن تما کہ صحت خاتون دوئی کرے یک
en: Yes, this morning, like this, my head... this constant [pain] came over me; how it came on, and it came on so badly that Sehat Khatoon had to take hold of me.
en_old: Yes, this morning my head... this constant pain... how... and then Sehat Khatoon caught hold of me.

brh: او ملک جنبش ایراٹمی کو برام ء کننگ خوائٹ۔ ایراٹمی کو برام؟ ہا دا مننگ کپک۔ انتئے مننگ کپک وی نی
en: That Malik Jabash wants to make a second marriage. A second marriage? Oh, this can't happen. Why can't it happen, you...?
en_old: That man Jabash wants to arrange a second marriage. A second marriage? No, this can't happen. Why can't it happen, you...

brh: ئے چاوہ کہ مئے بشریئے درست کپے ستیت وستس کنے او تینا مسڑے دا شرط اٹ تس جبش جی کہ اونا ہر وڑٹ خیالے تخک اگہ او دن کتو گڑا چانس
en: I know that [unclear]... He gave me his daughter on this condition, Jabash ji, that she would be looked after in every way. If he doesn't do that, then you know...
en_old: I know that if he doesn't show any humanity... He gave me his daughter on this condition, Jabash ji, that I would look after her in every way. If I don't do that, then...

brh: سنت مریک جبشنا ملکی ہمینا او شاہ پاولیسے کے محتاج مریک یرنے ہیتنا تاشتے دودی کھرخاتون ملک شیری یرنے چھینا پنا بر اسکم شیری خدا بش
en: It is a sunnah [religious custom]... Jabash's country/property... and the king becomes dependent on Pauli... [unclear]... these two matters... Khar Khatoon, Malik Sheri... [unclear] name... Sheri, God forgive. (garbled)
en_old: It's the custom of Jabash's country, and the king comes to depend on Pauli... these words... Khar Khatoon, Malik Sheri... that name... Sheri, God help us.

brh: ملک شری ہنا شرطاک ہم ہنا امر ہنار شرطاک منگا کارا دا کل لکو پڑ مسنو دا شرطاک لکو پڑنا ایتاک اسولیننگ کپسہ ہندا خاطرا دا لکو پڑ
en: Malik Sheri's conditions too, those... how could those conditions be accepted? All this has become a mess; the matters of this mess, these conditions, can't be sorted out, and that's why this mess...
en_old: Malik Sheri's conditions, how can those conditions be accepted? All of this has turned into a mess. These conditions can't be sorted out, and that's why this mess...

brh: دا پیساتے کلے غریباتیٹی بشخے، دا فیکٹریٹ نیاسل آباد مفیسہ، ایلو خنانی فیکٹری سنبھالپیسہ، کنے زہ انتس، دا مہنگائی غمپیسہ مخلوق خودکشی کننگے کاری ملپکتے، نادوٹ فیکٹری ئس ہٹی
en: Distribute all this money among the poor. You'll never prosper with this factory, and you won't manage the other Khani factory either. What is it to me? You don't worry about this inflation; people are committing suicide, they don't get any work. With your own hands, a factory...
en_old: Give all this money out to the poor. You won't make this factory thrive, and the other Khan won't run the factory either. What do I care? This inflation won't end. People are killing themselves because they can't find work. With your money, a factory...

brh: امو نا ہمو لائق افیس ادا ئے محنت مزدوری کیوہ تینا پڈے پالیوہ نا فیکٹری سنبھالنگ کپرا ایچ ئے نی ہر حال ٹی سنبھالوئی ئے
en: You aren't even worthy of that. Here I do hard labour and feed my own belly; I can't manage your factory. No, you have to manage it no matter what.
en_old: You aren't even worth that. I do labour here and feed myself. You can't run the factory? No, you have to run it no matter what.

brh: ادا ہیکہ مزور کیوے محنت کیوے پھپھور کیوے پین کاریم کیوے نا فیکٹری کا
en: Here I [unclear] do labour, I work hard, I do [unclear], I do other work. Your factory...
en_old: Here I do labour, I work hard, I do odd jobs and other work. Your factory...

brh: کنا وس آن تیرے تیرے تیرے کنے کپر بابا سلہ پا وانی
en: It's beyond my power, beyond, beyond. Don't do this to me, father. Give me some advice, please.
en_old: It's out of my hands, out of my hands. Don't do this to me, father. Tell me what to do, please.

brh: اللہ ہدایت کے دے کنا ایلم گنڈ دوجان مروسس ئے ہنون کاروبار کروسٹ دنیا حیران مرو ایلم نی صبر کر کنا فیکٹری سنبھالوکو باز ئے ایلم کنے کس ضرورت اف شاباس
en: May God guide him. My brother, had it been [unclear], I would have done such business that the world would be amazed. Brother, you be patient; there are plenty of people to run my factory. Brother, I don't need anyone. Bravo.
en_old: May God guide you. My brother, once I'm well I'll do such business that the world will be amazed. Brother, be patient, there are plenty of people to run my factory. Brother, I don't need anyone. Well done.

brh: خانی بروئے دمے کنا فیکٹری ء سنبھالک ہو، او تو ئنا دینی کرے جواب نا فیکٹری دے سنبھالک، نی صبر کر نی سما اف کنا طاقت نا ئے امر کیوے
en: Khani will come; let him run my factory for a while, yes. As for him, he gave [his] answer: he will run your factory. You be patient; you have no idea of my strength, how I'll do it.
en_old: Khani, come, let him run my factory, yes. He gave his answer: he'll run your factory. Be patient, you don't know my strength. How will I...

brh: ہیلو! ہا لمان خان اراڑے کوس؟ زو!
en: Hello! Yes, Laman Khan, where are you? Quick!
en_old: Hello! Yes, Laman Khan, where are you? Quick!

brh: کنے اسر کتی نی ہا ٹھیک ہی پگہ برے ضرور
en: You didn't [unclear] me? Yes, fine, come tomorrow for sure.
en_old: Didn't you do it for me? Yes, okay, come tomorrow for sure.

brh: اینو لوانگ خان بریک شاباش خان نا کاریمے جوان کیک
en: Lawang Khan is coming today; he does Shabash Khan's work well.
en_old: Lawang Khan is coming today. Shabash Khan does his work well.

brh: نمان خابر نی اللہ تے جوان مس کے بسس جمیل خان
en: What news of you? Thank God, it's good that you came, Jamil Khan.
en_old: Good to hear from you, thank God. It's good that you came, Jamil Khan.

brh: خیر توارے، باز وختم پد، تپنگ خانے یاد کریس، دا خاطر نی یاد کریٹ، کنا ایلم ئے شاباش خانے جوان چاسے، ہمو کنا عیدئے الینگے اف، او تو نا آخے
en: Is all well? After a long time you remembered Tapang Khan, and that's why I remembered you. My brother, you know Shabash Khan well; he isn't one to [unclear] my Eid; he's yours, isn't he?
en_old: Hello, after such a long time you remembered Tapang Khan. That's why I remembered you. My brother knows Shabash Khan well. He isn't spoiling my Eid. He is yours.

brh: ئے الومے اگر او نا ہیت ء الپک گڑا نن نی کینتھس کرون نی ہر گڑا کننگ کیسہ انتئے کہ نی تو خرماس ارے نی تو کنے اسہ خرماسے نا پاسے کنتو وڑ وڑ نا خرما مرے کنتو
en: Hey, brother, if he doesn't accept your word, then we will [unclear] you. You can do anything, because you've got a wolf, after all! You tell me about a single wolf; I have wolves of every kind.
en_old: Yes, brother, if he doesn't listen to what he says, then we'll... you can do anything, because you're a donkey. To me you're just a donkey; I have all kinds of donkeys.

brh: او شیر ہم مرے لیکن اونا خوراک نا بندوبست نی کننگ کیس؟ نی سمائی دوشے پین تین چوٹ چوٹ کوٹٹی سدا کائک لیکن ئے ہمودٹ کوٹٹی ہم چوٹ چوٹ کاوے نی
en: He may even be a lion, but can you arrange his food? You know the snake: elsewhere it goes crooked, crooked, but into its hole it always goes straight. But I go crooked, crooked even in that very hole, you know.
en_old: He may even be a lion, but can you arrange food for him? You go straight into the room, but once you're in there, you walk all crooked.

brh: سہ خرما جائی نا بسے ئے ہزار خرما خوراک تننگ کیوے ضمیر خان نی واقعی سہی پاننگ اٹی ئس نی اگر ہزار خرما تے خوراک تننگ کروس
en: One wolf is enough for a place? I can feed a thousand wolves. Zameer Khan, you're really speaking the truth, if you can feed a thousand wolves.
en_old: I'll feed a thousand donkeys from my own place. Zameer Khan, you're really right, if you can feed a thousand donkeys.

brh: تو کانا اسے ارمانم کاری مے کننگ کرو کانا ایلم پیش تما نی پائیکاوٹ کے وا کاروبار روزگار ئس کے بے لیکن ئے ہراٹ کروڑ پتی ئے
en: So let's go. I have a wish too, to be able to do some work. Let's go, brother, this has come up. You say: do some business or get a job, but who has ever become a millionaire that way?
en_old: So I wanted to do some work, and a brother showed up. You say, get a job or start a business, but how does anyone become a millionaire?

brh: کھنائی ایلم کاریم کے مزدوری کے لیکن نومیں بو دے رول ات بو رول اور تو اننو کاریم کبو کہ مزدوری نا پنن توبہ کے دا مو ہیت مس خرما والا تو ہیت متو داڑے ننے شوکامر چالاکی کرو
en: Brother, a person works, does labour, but ... [unclear: 'role'] ... so do your work in such a way that you swear off the very name of labour. This is what it came to: the wolf way didn't work. Here we have to become foxes and use cleverness.
en_old: Brother, work, do labour, but... in that role, don't do the kind of work that makes you swear off labour altogether. That's what we were talking about; the donkey guy didn't say anything. Here we have to be clever.

brh: اوئی تمک، گڑا ناہی لم نا مزدوری اٹ است پنوئی۔ بالکل، شوق والا چالاکی ئے خبو؟ نما نما چالاکی چئینا خاری مرے۔ جمال خان، ناہی تک سئی او۔
en: Oh, it happens. Then your brother's heart breaks from labour. Exactly. Do you know fox-style cleverness? Your own cleverness, we know it, it ends in hardship. Jamal Khan, your words are right.
en_old: Yes, it happens, so a brother has to earn his living by labour. Exactly, you know the cleverness of the keen ones? Your cleverness should be... Jamal Khan, ...

brh: نی خوراک نا بندوبست ء کر، نن کانہ تینا کاریم نا بندوبست ء کے۔ قائم وضو کبو ہورے کپبو۔
en: You arrange the food, and we'll go and arrange our own work. Keep your ablution [intact], don't be late.
en_old: You arrange the food, and we'll go take care of our work. Keep your ablution, don't look.

brh: ہاشم خان نی جوان خبرے، دوشے پینٹین چوچوٹ، کوٹٹی سدھا کھائیک، لیکن ئے ہموڈوٹ، کوٹٹی ہم چو
en: Hashim Khan, you know well: the snake goes crooked everywhere else, but it goes straight into its hole. But you, there, even in the hole, cro-
en_old: Hashim Khan, you put it well. He goes straight into the room, but once he's there, in the room he walks cro-

brh: چوٹ چوٹ کاوے نی تو کوٹٹی چوٹ چوٹ کاسے دا لوان خان ہم سیدھا و بندغہ صف نی بختاور اسیوس کنے منو بندغہ ضرورت ئس
en: -oked, crooked you go. You go crooked even in the hole. This Lawan Khan, though, is a straight and clean person. You're a lucky one; I need just such a person.
en_old: -oked. You walk crooked, you walk crooked in the room. This Lawan Khan is a straightforward person too. You're lucky, I need a man.

brh: کنے ہمبرکوٹیٹی چوٹ چوٹ کائے
en: As for me, I go crooked even in the hole.
en_old: I walk crooked in that room too.

brh: ایلم ٹرک ئس خالی کروئی پھوگ ئنا برے سے بفیسے او ایلم سلو کوٹ گاڑی شف کننگ کے اللہ بفروا امر ٹھیک ہی ایلم سوار مر کان گاڑی اموڑے سلو کے
en: Brother, there's a truck to be unloaded ... come, there's money ... And brother, I've stopped, unload the vehicle. Oh God, ... how, is it all right? Brother, get in, let's go, stop the vehicle over there.
en_old: Brother, a truck needs to be unloaded... bring it. Brother, move the car slowly. Oh God, how is that fine? Brother, get in, the car stopped slowly over there.

brh: ایلم، دا گاڑی ہرا دے؟ گاڑی خننگ پک۔ ایلم نی اینا سورے کریس، ننے
en: Brother, which vehicle is this? The vehicle can't be seen. Brother, you went and caused us trouble ...
en_old: Brother, which car is this? I can't see the car. Brother, what have you done to us today...

brh: ننا گاڈی ء تو خالی کرے گدرے فینتہ۔ انم خان ئے دا مسکین ء کنے فینٹے سوٹ۔ دا امر کرینوس؟ نی وا دا گاڈی ء پین اسہ ٹا خالی کر فینوس۔ ایلم نی تو جوان کریس۔ دا سدا ایلم ایسٹ دا سد روپئی سے تتے راہی کتو راغہ پین ہمو کس۔
en: He unloaded our vehicle, and then ... Anam Khan, this poor man ... me ... How have you done this? Now unload this vehicle one more time ... Brother, you did well. Here's a hundred, brother, here, this is a hundred rupees for you ... sent off ... that same one ...
en_old: Unload our car, then... Anam Khan, this poor guy... How did you do this? Now unload this car one more time. Brother, you did well. Here, brother, here's a hundred rupees for you...

brh: یار ننا مذاق سمجھانو رے انت کننگ اٹی ارے کنتو ایلوم تو گڈا شیف کننگ نا گاڑی نا مسخرہ صفہ او پین ایلوم ئس ہسس گاڑی خالی کرینا اونا قسمت اوڑ تو نا قسمت نیٹ تو نی داسے انتینا وراغا واہ ادا واہ شاباش
en: Friend, have you understood our joke? What are you doing? With me, brother, the unloading of the vehicle was just a joke, and another brother came and unloaded the vehicle. His luck is his and your luck is yours. So now why are you ...? Wow, wow, bravo!
en_old: Friend, get our joke. What are you doing? My brother, the clown who drives the car... and another brother came and unloaded the car. His luck is his and your luck is yours, so now what... Wow, wow, well done!

brh: واسے نومے کلا سجو دے گم کرے نی داسہ واپس عرا اٹ گم کا ٹومیں نما عرا ایلوم عرا غا ہمپپیسہ گڑا نی امر کیسی داڑے ایلوم ئے عرا غا ہمپپر ئے نمے داڑے کھدہ کیوہ ایلوم نی ناراض مفے ئے نی آن ہم معذرت
en: He made you lose the whole day. Now go back home, to your own home. Brother, if you don't go home, then what will you do here? Brother, if you don't go home, I'll put you in a hole here. Brother, don't be upset; my apologies to you too.
en_old: Now you've lost the whole day, so go back home... your home, brother. If you don't go home, then what will you do here? Brother, don't be upset, I apologize to you too.

brh: خواہب، نہ اینو نا دیہاڑی اخس کے مریک؟ مسٹ سد، چار سد، پنچ سد مریک ئے نی آتے وی ایلو نی باز جوان بندغ اسس، دا باز چوٹو بندغ اسے، دانا ہیتک کنے کنگو، ینا ختنا داڑا غصہ کریٹ۔ ایلوم معذرت، نی پنچ سد پاسے ئے نی پنچ سد آتے وی ہزار۔
en: Well, how much does today's daily wage come to? Three hundred, four hundred, five hundred, here, take it, brother. You're a very good person; this one is a very crooked person, his words got to me, that's why I got angry here. Brother, sorry. You say five hundred? Not five hundred, take a thousand.
en_old: Brother, how much is today's daily wage? It's three hundred, four hundred, five hundred. Take these, brother, you're a very good person. This one is a very petty person, his words hurt me, and that's why I got angry here. Brother, sorry. You said five hundred; take a thousand instead.

brh: پاس ئے تینا ایڈومے ہزار اتوے، غلطی کنائے کہ دا خموران ایسونے تینا گاڑی نا خالی کننگ کے، کنے لنگڑی خلتنے پنچ سد کے، پنگو کنے دانا ہیت آک چوٹنگا وڑ اتوس، کنے دا اللہ تیک داڑے مزدوری متے
en: You say, take a thousand; keep your thousand. The mistake is mine, that this fool was brought to unload my vehicle; he tripped me up over five hundred. His words came across to me as crooked. God, may there be no labour for me here.
en_old: He says, keep your thousand. The mistake is mine for bringing this fool to unload my car. He made me limp along for five hundred. His words were petty to me. God, may I not have to do labour here.

brh: پین انت اسہ کو مزدوری کیوے، پدا نا ہیتک کنے خراب لگار، مزدور اسیوٹ، مزدوری کیوے، داڑے کہ سجو دہاڑی کنا ہنا اونا ہیتک کنے خراب لگار ہمو خاطران اود تو ہیت کریٹ، کنے پیسے ضرورت اف، اللہ حافظ، دا پیسہ دا بشخئیانے
en: What else? I'll do labour somewhere else. His words felt bad to me. I'm a labourer, I do labour, and here my whole day's wage is gone. His words felt bad to me, that's why I talked back to him. I don't need the money. Goodbye; I forgive this money.
en_old: What else? I'll find labour somewhere else. His words felt bad to me. I'm a labourer, I do labour, for the whole day's wage... his words felt bad to me, that's why I talked back to him. I don't need the money. Goodbye, I forgive this money.

brh: نری نا سے زوکا قربان اینی عالم خان اینو عمر یار نا دے ضائع کرینگ
en: ... Alam Khan, today Umar Yar's day was wasted.
en_old: Qurban, the one who carried the three of Nari, Alam Khan, today wasted Umar Yar's day.

brh: تویں دا دے پارہ شوق والا کارم۔ دا سو مزدور تاکہ کائے کورا غا در بدر مرے۔ اینو نا دیہاڑی تو اینا، کشم فون ئے خلین تے جمیلہ۔
en: So this day was fox-style work, as they'll say. Now the labourers go home and end up wandering from door to door. Today's wage is gone. Let me take out the phone and call Jamila.
en_old: So this day... the work of a keen one. These labourers end up wandering door to door. Today's wage is today's. Take out the phone and call Jamila.

brh: ہیلو ضمیر خان اینو ایڑو ننا پیاری زائم ئس زائم ئس ئے سورتی ہنداڑے پورا دے
en: Hello, Zameer Khan. Today our precious day was wasted, wasted, the whole day here.
en_old: Hello Zameer Khan, today brother, our dear time, time... the whole day here at Surti.

brh: موٹر سائیکل اراؤنڈ تسوٹ تسوٹ آخر آخر ئے سوٹ تے میدانی آ تازہ دا کا پیدل کائے کورا اسکان تو شام نا اذان مرے آن پاشے نی
en: I went around and around on the motorcycle; finally, finally ... to the field ... now I'm going on foot, and by the time I get home the evening call to prayer will have sounded, you'd say.
en_old: I went around on the motorcycle, I went around, finally, finally... on the field, fresh, now walking on foot until the house, by then the evening call to prayer will happen, you say.

brh: دوبارہ جوان و خوار و مسخرہ ایس راہی کے سنگتی تینا خوراک نا بندوبست کے، خوراک نا بندوبست کے، ہا جوان اللہ حافظ
en: Once again it was good, and miserable, and a joke. Set off, friend, and arrange your own food, arrange food. Yes, good, goodbye.
en_old: Again, good, poor and joking... go on your way, friend, arrange your food, arrange your food. Yes, good, goodbye.

brh: چکر خان جی ہور تو باز زبردست جوڑ مسنے اچھا دا سہ ٹھیکیدار برے ہورینتہ کن پوزیشن ئے ٹھیکیدار نا جی او برے ٹھیکیدار اللہ وارس ہی
en: Chakar Khan ji, look, it has been built really superbly. Okay, now the contractor will come and we'll look at it ... the position ... the contractor's, sir. He'll come, the contractor. God is the guardian.
en_old: Chakar Khan ji, the bridge has been built really well. Okay, now let the contractor come and look at the position, sir, the contractor; let the contractor come, God is the guardian.

brh: میر امر مس پول تیار مس، ٹھیکیدار پول دنا دے تیار مس، پگا اللہ خیر کے خیرات آتے داڑے بھلو کیس، میر صاحب با جوان کریس، پولے تیار کریس، پگا انشاءاللہ
en: Mir, how did it go? The bridge is ready. Contractor, the bridge got ready in these few days. Tomorrow, God willing, you'll hold a big charity distribution here. Mir sahib, you did very well, you got the bridge ready. Tomorrow, God willing.
en_old: Mir, how did it go? The bridge is ready. Contractor, the bridge was ready in this many days. Tomorrow, God willing, we will hold a big charity distribution here. Mir sahib, you did well, you got the bridge ready. Tomorrow, God willing.

brh: باز بلو خیرات تس کنے۔ ننا منا انتظار اٹ آن پگہ بر خیرات کر پل نا افتتاح مرے آن شاء اللہ۔ بس ٹھیک ہی پگہ نن برینہ۔
en: He gave me a very big charity. We'll be waiting for you; come tomorrow and give the charity, and the bridge will be inaugurated, God willing. Okay, fine, tomorrow we'll come.
en_old: He gave me a very big charity. We are waiting; come tomorrow, give the charity, the bridge will be inaugurated, God willing. Okay, fine, we will come tomorrow.

brh: با جوان و گھری مسخرے نی علم تو ہنم مرے جوتے جوانی کار مین تو نا عباس شوکت کننگن خوراک نا والیت خوراک نا مر کریس ہمے دے آ مچے لک نا
en: Very good, and a deep joke. As for you, knowledge comes too ... good work ... the food ... you made the food; on that same day, all ...
en_old: Very good, and a deep joker... you, knowledge too... good work... Abbas Shaukat is doing it... food, the food arrangement... you made food, on that day all of Lak...

brh: او کونٹٹی جمع کرینٹ دا تے ہمہ کریز آخری۔ الم خان! دا دے خنیس پئے موزی لک، موزی لک تو شوک والا خوراک کیے۔ الم خان آ! بلال شوک والا کاریمے کننگورے، شوک والا نمے حساب کتاب ملے گا۔
en: He gathered them in the hole; he did all of these at the end. Alam Khan! Did you see this day? The miser, the miser gets his food the fox way. Alam Khan! Bilal, you're doing fox-style work; with the fox way, you'll get your reckoning.
en_old: He gathered them in the county; he did all of these at the end. Alam Khan! Do you see this day, Muzi Lak? Muzi Lak, the Shauk-wala, makes the food. Alam Khan! Bilal is doing the Shauk-wala work; you will get your accounts settled with the Shauk-wala.

brh: اراٹی ما خرما والا کاریمے کرینے خوراک تینٹ زیادہ مرے نمے خبرے دوشے پین تین چوٹ چوٹ کوڈیٹی سدھا گائیک لیکن ئے ہمو ڈوٹ کوڈیٹیم چوٹ چوٹ
en: Where the wolf-style work has been done, the food itself becomes more. You know: the snake goes crooked everywhere else and goes straight into its hole, but in that very hole too it goes crooked, crooked...
en_old: Where they did the dates work, the food itself will be more. You know, the shoulder... the rest in small, small bundles goes straight... but in those same bundles, small, small...

brh: جمیل خان! نی داسہ خوراک نا کوشش ء کر، داسہ کنے نن ہر معاملہ نا کاریم ء کیپوئی ء۔
en: Jamil Khan! Now you make the effort for food. Now we shouldn't have to do the work of every matter.
en_old: Jamil Khan! Now you try to arrange the food; now we have to do the work for every matter.

brh: دا اسمان، دا شوبہ نا پٹی اونے دا، داڑیند کننگ او
en: This sky, this ... strip of the department, this, doing it from here ...
en_old: This sky, this... the strip of the department, this, from here doing it...

brh: دا والا کاریم نا کنے بسے، اول ہم دا ریس کنے انو خوار خراب کریس، کنے بسے بیزاری نا کنے ہن کنے پین تینا کاریم بازے، ئے نا کاریم کے حیران افٹ، مزور اسٹ کنے ہستین کاریم بازے، ئے نم کنا غصہ کپے، مزدور کنے ہم باز ملیرہ۔
en: I've had enough of this kind of work. Even before, this trickery made me miserable and ruined today. I've had enough of this annoyance. Go, I have plenty of other work of my own; I'm not desperate for your work. I'm a labourer, I have plenty of work like this. Don't be angry with me; I'll find plenty of labourers too.
en_old: This kind of work came to me; before, too, this race wore me out today. I got fed up. Go, I have a lot of my own work. I am not surprised by your work. I am a laborer, I have a lot of work. Don't be angry with me; I get plenty of laborers too.

brh: اللہ کے لیکن اینے خنے وی نی ایماندار بندغ اسوس کانے نو ایرا گاڑی اوفتے خالی کپے نی دفر سوار مر سوار سوار مرنے است کپ استٹ کپ سوار مر سوار سوار مر سوار
en: God will provide, but today I see that you are an honest person. Let's go now; don't unload those two vehicles. You, get in, get in, get in, don't hang back, don't hang back, get in, get in, get in, get in.
en_old: God willing, but look today, you are an honest person... no, why don't you unload the vehicle for them? You get on in the office... get on, get on... don't stop, don't stop, get on, get on, get on, get on.

brh: اوور! خنا شہباز خان نا زوری
en: Whoa! Look at Shahbaz Khan's strength!
en_old: Wow! Look at Shahbaz Khan's strength.

brh: اغس کے سٹھ خلوئے نی سٹھ خل، اینو زندے لئی پرے پھڈے ارے رے، کنے دون لکپک، نیکونہ حرام خورا کنا پھڈے ارے رے، پوئے تینا ٹوٹے دا خل پھڈے
en: If you're going to hit with a stick, then hit with the stick! Today [unclear] the belly, hey! That doesn't hurt me like this. You crook, (hit) my belly, hey! Then [unclear] your own [unclear], hit this belly!
en_old: If you're going to hit, then hit. Today there's a fight in life. Don't do this to me, you scoundrel, my fight is on. Then smash your pieces in this fight.

brh: خان خان، نی ہرا کپسوس
en: Khan, Khan, what are you doing?
en_old: Khan, Khan, what are you doing?

brh: لوا خان ئے ہراکا بسٹ تو بسٹ نم دا پابو کہ شاباش خان انت کے خلنگورے شاباش خان قرضدارے کنا نی خلنگورتے نی ہراکا بسٹ انت کے بسوس کنے انت کے خلکوس شاباش خان نا قرضدارے کنا خلتے نی
en: As for Lawa Khan, wherever (he) came from, (he) came. You (all) tell me this: why are you beating Shabash Khan? Shabash Khan owes me (money), and you are beating him. Where did you come from? Why did you come? Why did you hit me? Shabash Khan owes me, and you hit him.
en_old: Whoever came to Lawa Khan came. You tell me, why are you beating Shabash Khan? Shabash Khan is my debtor and you're beating him. Whoever you are, why did you come? Why did you hit me? Shabash Khan is my debtor, and you're hitting him.

brh: نی خبر اف دنیا نا قرضدار تے انداش چار شاغٹ کثفیس ہودا مونا سے نیم کثفویو ہیکہ کنے مزدوری کنے گیسوس داری کنے مزدوری آتے تپیس داسہ نی کنے کثفیسہ واہ کہ شکل سے زیبا او جوانو کثفیسہ نن تو مگے دو اف
en: You have no idea: you beat the world's debtors to death like this with a pitchfork, and before that you (all) half-killed (them). You made me do labour, you don't give me my wages, and now you're killing me. Wow, what a handsome, fine face you're killing! Don't we have hands too, though?
en_old: You don't know. You drag the world's debtors around like this with insults, and before that you dragged off three and a half. You made me work, you didn't pay my wages, and now you're dragging me around. Wow, what a pretty face you're putting on. We have no hands left.

brh: ننا دو کرنگء نہ رلے، زیادہ ہیت کپے، داسہ می پڈء ناروے، عالم خان اسمنس نی سنگت کنا خلکوس بٹیس، نی خلنگ بٹنگ
en: Our hands are not [unclear] either. Don't talk too much. Now [unclear]. Alam Khan, [unclear] you hit my friend and knocked him down. You and your hitting and knocking down!
en_old: Our hands won't be tied. Don't talk too much now. Alam Khan, you beat my friend, you hit him. You're beating and hitting.

brh: شاباس ئے ہر توماتینو ما داڑے اینو دانگ ہینکیوہ شاباس خان تاسہ خیری پدا نورینے کانے پد مادب دا زپد کرے کمو نی کاٹومینو ما اینو نادے فیصلہ داں
en: Shabash, [unclear] here today [unclear]. Shabash Khan, now [unclear] again [unclear] afterwards [unclear], you [unclear]. Today is your day; the decision [is made] here.
en_old: Bravo... here today I'll... Shabash Khan, now, well, again... afterwards... today the decision is yours.

brh: یا ہینگ! بس شاباش خان بس، نرینہ ہار منا، بس اودے لوئی، شاباش خان، دستار سخی دے ہر راج مخال۔
en: Hey! Enough, Shabash Khan, enough. The man has given up. Enough, let him go, Shabash Khan. [unclear: a generous man's turban ... every community].
en_old: Hey! Enough, Shabash Khan, enough. A man doesn't accept defeat. Enough, let him go, Shabash Khan. A generous turban for every tribe.

brh: ماشااللہ نن خننگ اسکارینے باز جوان
en: Mashallah, we have watched it. Very good.
en_old: Mashallah, we've seen it. Very good.

brh: نواب خان احوال آتے بو ہمک کریرے انت وا
en: Nawab Khan, (tell us) the news. What are you all doing, then?
en_old: Nawab Khan, tell us the news. What is everyone doing?

brh: ہالے تیو نیم نا والا مو شریکف میر او اینو بفروزوس ایروم ننا کیمیا تینو داڑے ایسوٹ تسوٹنے کہ کتاب میر اینو بس درمیانٹ کاریمے ننا خراب کرے
en: Still [unclear] your (pl.) [unclear], not a partner [unclear], Mir, and today [unclear]. I brought [it] here and gave [it] to you, [book?]. Mir just came in the middle today and spoiled our work.
en_old: ...partner, Mir, today you... we brought our... here and gave the book. Mir came in the middle today and ruined our work.

brh: میر لعل خان ء خدائے دیتکے او وراکا بس اوڑے سرمس۔ نی خبر اف او وراکا سرمس۔ نی جوان خبر ء۔ رائے ہم نی کرے نست۔ اڈے او نالائق خلنگ کتوے آستہ ولدا باز بہانہ کیسی
en: Mir Lal Khan, God [unclear], and he came from somewhere and showed up there. (As if) you don't know where he showed up from! You know very well. You're the one who sent him, too. Hey, you useless one, you couldn't beat (him), and then you make a lot of excuses.
en_old: God gave to Mir Lal Khan. Whoever came reached there. You don't know who got there? You know very well. You didn't even give your opinion. Hey, you worthless one, you couldn't hit, and then you make a lot of excuses.

brh: پئی نی راہی کریست، ئے راہی کریٹ تو گڑا نی پاریٹ کلنگ کے۔ جمیل خان کنا مقصد داف کہ نی راہی کرینوس تے، دا ئے تینا زی آ سوچئے کہ عین موقع غا دا امر بسس۔ چلو قدرتی بروئے، داسہ نی پا گڑا انت ئس کے؟
en: So you sent him? If I had sent him, I'd have told you. Jamil Khan, I don't mean that you sent them. Think it over yourself: how did he show up at exactly that moment? Fine, say he came by chance. Now you tell me: then what is it?
en_old: Brother, you had sent it. I sent it, and then you said... Jamil Khan, I don't mean that you sent them. Think it over yourself: how did this come up at exactly the right moment? Fine, say it's natural. Now tell me, what is it for, then?

brh: ایلا ریلوے نا کٹنگ ایلی بو کو مس کمبو جاگہ ہموڑے تولینے گپ کینے ٹھیک ہی کمبو تولینے ہموڑے ہیت کینے کمبو
en: Hey, the railway crossing [unclear]. Let's go to a place; we'll sit there and chat. Okay, let's go; we'll sit there and talk. Let's go.
en_old: At the railway crossing... where is the place? Let's sit there and talk. Okay, where should we sit and talk? Where?

brh: السلام علیکم، میر صاحب، خواجہ بھٹ سکھ آ، خیر آ، طبیعت ٹھیک آ؟ السلام علیکم، سر یہ جو چنگ چی آ
en: Peace be upon you, Mir sahib. Are you well? Is all at peace, all fine? Is your health good? Peace be upon you. Sir, it's all good.
en_old: Peace be upon you, Mir sahib, Khwaja Bhatt, are you well, is everything fine, is your health good? Peace be upon you, sir, this one on the Chingchi rickshaw.

brh: شہباز خان تینا حال احوال ء ایت۔ حال احوال خیر ء یار۔
en: Shahbaz Khan, tell us how you're doing. All is well, friend.
en_old: Shahbaz Khan, tell us how you are. All is well, friend.

brh: او، پین حال احوال آتہ میران آ، او جی او، میر صاحب پین نی ہم پنت حال احوال، حال احوال ہمنا تو کہ شہباز خان نا خبر ئے نتھین غریب و بندہ سے مزدوری محنت کے حلال نا روزی کننگے
en: Oh, other news [unclear] yes, yes. Mir sahib, you tell (us) some news too. The news is just this, that you know about Shahbaz Khan: he's a poor man, he does labour and hard work and earns an honest living.
en_old: Oh, more news and updates, Mir sahib, yes. Mir sahib, you tell some news too. The news is that Shahbaz Khan is a poor man and a laborer who works hard and earns an honest living.

brh: بے شک۔ دانا ایلم ئے جمیل خان۔ جمیل کنے بندغاتے شوانے دانا رند اٹ خلفینے، قیامت او خلبو ایلمی کنا۔ ارے بئے انتئے خلفیسہ تا؟ ارے مزید نی معلومات کریاتہ کہ انتئے خلفیسہ دا۔ پیر صاحب ئے دا دے کہ جمیل خان پیسہ نا گھمنڈ اٹ۔
en: Of course. His brother is Jamil Khan. Jamil has set men on his trail and had him beaten. What an outrage: 'beat my brother!' Hey, brother, why are you having him beaten? Hey, you should find out more about why he is having him beaten. Pir sahib, it's this: Jamil Khan [does it] out of arrogance over his money.
en_old: Of course. His brother is Jameel Khan. Jameel has set people after him and had him beaten. Doomsday! Don't beat my brother! Hey, why are you having him beaten? Hey, you should find out more about why he is having him beaten. Pir sahib, it is that Jameel Khan is arrogant because of his money.

brh: ئے بس او شہباز خان ہم کنے خبر ہمے دئی بسٹ کسرے موٹرسائیکلا ہرفیٹ تکنتو احوال کرے کنے احوالے کلے کس او نی تینٹ خبرے دنے آ زیادہ نا سنگتی کہ دا پولاتا ٹھیکہ دار ہرفیرے دا روڈ آ
en: I just [unclear], and Shahbaz Khan also told me this news himself. I came along the road, I picked him up on the motorbike, [unclear], he told me what happened, told me all of it. And you yourself know (your friendship with him is closer than mine) that these [unclear] contractors take [them] along this road.
en_old: ...that's all. And Shahbaz Khan also gave me the news; he came on the road, carrying him on the motorbike, he told me the news, he told me everything. You yourself know about the friendship more than me, that the contractor of these bricks carries them on this road.

brh: ہا ٹھیک ہی وارفارین ئے او، تو ئے دادے کہ دا بندہ غاسے انو حلال خور و دا ہمے ٹھیپہ سے نم خنان چا نتھے۔ سمجھا سمجھی تویس۔ اسے وقت دا بندہ خیسو نا گھڑی ئس خنا سس۔ بس اسالس کبو بڑی درپت فوکس۔
en: Yes, okay, [unclear]. So the thing is this: this man is an honest person, and this same [unclear] you (pl.) [unclear]. [There was] an understanding. Once this man had seen a gold watch. Just [unclear] a big [unclear].
en_old: Yes, okay, warfarin... so the thing is, this man is honest, and this is the same... you didn't see... you understood. Once this man saw a watch... Just... a big...

brh: کہ بھئی نوا کہ مالک ئس مرے تے مالک ئس مت وڈئی لیکن ادا بندغ درے ہمود غریباتی یتیماتی پیرہاو پیسہ کریتس دادو نو بندغ ئس حلال خور او ہائے ہمو بندغ کہ اوت او پاننگٹی کہ بھئی دا کار
en: That, brother, whether one becomes rich or doesn't become rich, [unclear], but this man [unclear] those poor people and orphans, Pir, yes, [unclear] money. Such a man is honest, and yes, that man who is saying, 'brother, this work...'
en_old: That, brother, whether someone is rich or not rich, but this man there earned money from the poor and orphans... no, this man is an honest earner, yes, that man who is saying, brother, this work...

brh: کمک واری تو دے کنے او دا پاننگٹی ورا پیسہ حرام نا ہم جس ایم آرام کنے دا ہلال خور و بندغ اسے باز جوان و بندغ اسے ننے خبرے دا نا تو بلا ئے دادے کہ نی نا جن و سمجھائف ئے تے الیگم نا ئے تے الیگم نا ئے تے الپک او
en: When help is needed he gives (it) to me, and he is saying that [unclear] money [unclear] haram [unclear] comfort. This man is honest, a very good man; we know him. The problem is this: that you [unclear] advise him [unclear]. He's your brother, he's your brother; he won't leave him alone.
en_old: When it's time to help, he tells me that money is haram too... he's an honest earner and a very good person. We know about him; the issue is that you... [partly unintelligible] ...his brother...

brh: نی توار او نہ کرپہ کوزہ پوتاباکو جیو نی معلوم دا گڑا نا خبر اللہ دا ساتو خبر تمانے اللہ سئی برا جیو ربانی دادے کہ نی اوڑان ارف کے وئی دا گڑا ہلی بس دادے دادے نا زندگی تو خوشی چائے چار چاغہ فے پھوک خالی کے گاڑی تے شیف کے پھر کے نادارتو ایچو کاری بس
en: Don't you raise your voice [unclear]. You know about this matter; by God, word of it has got out [unclear]. The point is that you take this up with him and let this matter go. That's all. His life is a happy one: tea, the pitchfork, emptying [the chaff], unloading the trucks and loading them up. A poor man's work, that's all.
en_old: Don't you shout... [partly unintelligible] ...you know about this thing, God, this news has reached... the point is that you take it from him and let this thing go; that's all, his life is happiness, tea, four cups... empty it, unload the vehicles, load them again... the poor man's work, that's all.

brh: او بس روبرو کس تے خانے کے ابسیلو دا کاروے لپر کنے پئی نی انت لے کسے سمجھا استا ایتے پیر صاحب ئے دادے کہ دا سندھ اینٹ سمجھا ایفتے ٹھیک ہی شاہ صاحب ٹھیک ٹھیک ہی شاہ صاحب بس سئی ہی اللہ خیر کے ٹھیک ہی مہربانی
en: And just [talk to him] face to face [unclear]. Brother, what are you [unclear], understand [unclear]. Pir sahib, it's this, that [unclear], advise him. Okay, Shah sahib. Okay, okay, Shah sahib. That's it, fine; may God make it turn out well. Okay, thank you.
en_old: And he just met people face to face... he told me, what are you... understand... Pir sahib, it's that this Sindh... understand them. Alright, Shah sahib, alright, alright, Shah sahib, that's all, fine, may God make it well, okay, thank you.

brh: جی او وزیر صاحب مہربانی جی انشاءاللہ سمجھائفہ مہربانی
en: Yes, Minister sahib, thank you. Yes, God willing, I will advise him. Thank you.
en_old: Yes, Minister sahib, thank you. Yes, God willing, we will make him understand. Thank you.

brh: دا وار نمے ہم بچا اگر مونی نمے ہم بچا نونگے خیر اف ہاؤ جمیل خان ہاؤ دا وار نہ اودے نن رضا کائلا السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام
en: This time you got away too. If [it happens] again [unclear], it won't go well. Yes, Jamil Khan, yes, this time not [unclear] him, we [unclear]. Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you.
en_old: This time you were saved too, but next time you won't be saved, it won't be good. Hey Jameel Khan, hey, this time no... we Raza... Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you too.

brh: بر میر لال خان بر انت احوال آک اویتونا؟ جمیل خان خیر ئے اللہ نا مہربانی ئے شکر ئے نی دافا کنے کتا نی علم ئے دینا انت کہ خلفنگ اٹی ئس
en: Come, Mir Lal Khan, come! What's the news with you? Jamil Khan, all is well, by God's grace, thanks be to God. You did this to me [unclear]. You know this: why were you having him beaten?
en_old: Come, Mir Lal Khan, come. What's the news with you? Jameel Khan, all is well, by God's grace, thank God. You did this to me; do you know why you were having him beaten?

brh: صاحب نی گنا باز جوان سنگت اسیس لیکن نی ننا نیمٹی بفے ئے گھڑی کروڑ پتی او بنغاسیٹ اوکا دھوڑ پتی او بارم کیک نی پا دنیا
en: Sahib, you are a very good friend of mine, but you don't come over to our side. One moment a millionaire and [the next] a pauper, [unclear]. You tell me: (such is) the world.
en_old: Sahib, you are a very good friend of mine, but you don't come among us. One moment he's a millionaire and the next he's a pauper... tell me, the world...

brh: نا ایلم ء خلپرفے نمک کیفتے یا جمیل خان دا کمال ء بندغ اگہ ایلم تے تینا خوافیر ء ایلم تا خیال ء کیرہ او نی تینا ایلم ء خلوفیسہ کمال نا ہیت ئس دا کمال نا ہیت ئس اف میر صاحب
en: [unclear] your brother beaten [unclear]. O Jamil Khan, this is an amazing man: while brothers take care of their sisters and brothers, you are having your own brother beaten. What an amazing thing! This is no amazing thing, Mir sahib.
en_old: ...you had your brother beaten... or Jameel Khan, what an amazing man! When brothers take care of their brothers and sisters, you are having your own brother beaten. What an amazing thing, this is not a remarkable thing, Mir sahib.

brh: ئے کروڑ پتی او ونہ غو چار شاخ ئیر فیکائک پھگ لوڈ کیکک، مخلوق کنے ہن پائک۔ جمیل خان نی خبر ئے کروڑ پتی نی امر ایٹ ئے امر ایٹ، لیکن مزدوری حلال والا کرے کلا زوری، کنے روزگار ئس ملے ئے امر
en: I'm a millionaire, and he [unclear] picks up a pitchfork and loads chaff, and people talk to me about it. Jamil Khan, you know (you're) a millionaire; how [unclear], how [unclear]? But he did honest labour with all his might. How would I get a job?
en_old: ...he's a millionaire, otherwise he unloads four branches and loads bricks; people call me that. Jameel Khan, you know you're a millionaire, how is it, how is it? But I did honest labor by force; how did I get a job?

brh: گیوت برو ایتس تف دا گاڑی لوڈ کننگٹ پھگ پھر کننگٹ بندہ خراب خننگپک، اسہ وخت ئس تیرہ ٹم گاڑی لوڈ کرینو پھگ پھر کرینو۔ میر صاحب نیم گاڑی لوڈ کرینوس۔ ہاؤ ایلوم غران دسے داٹی۔ آرام میا ری۔
en: ... A person doesn't look bad loading this truck and filling chaff. At one time we loaded trucks thirteen times and filled chaff. Mir sahib, you've loaded half a truck. Yes, brother, [it's] heavy ... in this. Rest ...
en_old: ...in loading this vehicle and stacking bricks a person doesn't look bad. At one time he had loaded vehicles thirteen times and stacked bricks. Mir sahib, you had loaded half a vehicle. Hey, the other brother put his hand in it. Rest...

brh: میر صاحب نا ہیت واقعی سہی ئے لیکن ئے پین وختس ئس اینو پین وختس سے۔
en: What Mir sahib says is really right, but that was another time; today is another time.
en_old: What Mir sahib says is really right, but that was another time; today is another time.

brh: چار شاخے فک لخا تینا تخک او دے بد بفک بد بروکا دا انسانی بد بریک اور باز خراب خننگک۔ لالا واہ خاص عجیب و ہیت کننگ اٹی ئس ننے دا ساگر ٹی ملے ننے دا ساگر
en: He picks up the pitchfork and puts it on his neck, and he doesn't mind it. The one who looks down on it — this person dislikes it, and that looks very bad. Lala, wow, you're saying a really strange thing ... we get [it] in this ..., this ...
en_old: He keeps four branches on his own back... it gives a bad smell; this human odor comes and it looks very bad. Lala, wow, it was a strangely special conversation; we got this in this ocean, we got this ocean.

brh: دا چا شاہ غوینہ، کانہ گاڑی لوڈ کینہ، دا گلان نا دوکان نا مخ، مخلوق آن گلان نا کاریم کننگو، مخلوق آ زبیلو، حالتا زبو، زمانان مسونے، دا تو حلال نا روزی اسے دادے کننگ کپن، پندے کیک تے، میر صاحب گڑا نیدسان پسان کینک، ایلو چمی کینہ
en: We drink this tea, we go and load trucks — at the front of the grain shop, doing grain work for people. People have become weak, conditions are bad, the times have changed. This is an honest livelihood, after all; we can't do it ... he gives them advice. Mir sahib, then ... the other one ... we do.
en_old: Drinking tea, loading vehicles, this is the front of the shop of... doing work for people, ...for people, ...the times have changed. This is an honest living; I can't do this... Mir sahib, then you... the other kisses...

brh: میر غازی صاحب پین نی ہچ کپہ نا ایلم ہنتس کے پانیکے نی اونا پین ہلپہ میر نی ننا خاص و سنگت اسیس ننا ایتے لے نا ایتے پین کپنہ دا ہنتس کے کے کے باز ہلو باز مہربانی نی شاباسے کرائے دے ہلپس
en: Mir Ghazi sahib, don't do anything else; your brother ... says ... don't take his ... anymore. Mir, you are our special friend; we won't do anything else to ours or yours ... very ... thank you very much; you ... Shabash ... didn't take it.
en_old: Mir Ghazi sahib, don't do anything else, brother... you won't leave him otherwise. Mir, you are our special friend... we won't do anything else to you... thank you very much, well done, you did it.

brh: بس ایراٹیا نما تینا ایلم نا خیال ء کر۔ ایلم نا ملپ بندغ ء۔ صحیح۔ ٹھیک ء۔ سربند۔ سربند۔ سربند۔ ایلم خان؟
en: Just ... you all take care of your own brother. A brother ... person. Right. Okay. Done. Done. Done. Brother Khan?
en_old: Just in the meantime, take care of your own brother. Brother's... person. Right. Okay. Done. Done. Done. Brother Khan?

brh: جی لوانگ خان، دا میر تو نن دا روزی ٹی لغت تے خلک۔ لوانگ خان! او نما روزی ٹی لغت خلتنے، نم بشبو علمی ہنم کبو نتے دوتے تے پرخبو، ہتبو کنے نشانی تبو واللہ یو ہن کے۔ ہنبو خلبو ہتبو۔
en: Yes, Lawang Khan, this Mir is kicking at our livelihood. Lawang Khan! He has kicked at your livelihood; all of you, get up, take action, break his legs and arms, bring him, and bring me a token of it — by God, do it. Go, beat him, bring him.
en_old: Yes, Lawang Khan, this Mir is kicking at our livelihood. Lawang Khan! He has kicked your livelihood; get up, go, break his hands, bring him, give me a sign, by God, do it. Go, beat him, bring him.

brh: جمیل خان، کنے امی دست کنے ہندا ئے تے پاسے، عالم خان، جی لونگ خان، رحیم خان
en: Jameel Khan, ... tell me this very one: Alam Khan, yes, Lawang Khan, Rahim Khan.
en_old: Jameel Khan, my mother... tell me this right here: Alam Khan, yes, Lawang Khan, Rahim Khan.

brh: اشفاق خان، ہا جمیل خان، دعا کہ ایلم نا کاریم مرے ہڈ و گڈ خیر ت برے، واللہ اینے جہاز اسے ٹی دبئی آ رائی۔ خیر انت کا دبئی آ؟ اینا مون ادا شیخ شمبو آ
en: Ishfaq Khan — yes, Jameel Khan — pray that my brother's work gets done and turns out well from start to finish. By God, today I'm off to Dubai on a plane. Well, why are you going to Dubai? Today ... here to Sheikh Shambo ...
en_old: Ishfaq Khan, yes, Jamil Khan, pray that brother's work goes well from start to finish. By God, today I'm going to Dubai on a plane. Well, what will you do in Dubai? Today's face here, at Sheikh Shambo...

brh: ئنا شش کروڑ روپئیو امو تے اش بٹ ٹھیک ٹھیک ٹھیک عالم خان جی لور خان جی تو کریس کنے کنے اوار ملانے شاباش خان
en: Your six crore rupees ... those ... Okay, okay, okay. Alam Khan, yes; Lor Khan, yes — you did it, and I've been brought in along with you too, Shabash Khan.
en_old: Your six crore rupees... okay, okay, okay. Alam Khan ji, Lor Khan ji, you did it, and you included me too. Well done, Khan.

brh: کنا مٹ تولوک ئے اینا ڈگوٹ کھرک، زو برک، ہاؤ لوہ خان ہاؤ، ہاؤ تو کھرے زو دڑنگنے، کھائے عالم خان خٹک
en: The one sitting in my place ... today ..., comes quickly. Hey, Loh Khan, hey! Hey, you ... get down quickly ... Alam Khan Khattak.
en_old: The one sitting across from me is calling today, come quickly. Yes, Lohar Khan, yes, then call, run quickly... Alam Khan Khattak.

brh: لیک جان نا چھٹے داڑان ارے کنا خاچوک المنے ہڑی مسوس اولارنا ایام تونی ولہ بسونس کنتو زیادہ ہیت کپہ او خسکنتو ٹائم افک بسورنا لخرہ خلیکی داسہ
en: ... the way out is from here ... you've gone mad; you've come back again with the ways of the old days. Don't talk too much with me, and I have no time ... now.
en_old: Leak Jan's letter is from here... my sister... you came back with the days of the first one. Don't talk much with me, he doesn't have time for me... now.

brh: او ٹاکرو بے بختی کنا خلنگے بسونس۔ ہاؤ نا خلنگے بسونٹ۔ او اللہ اللہ کر کنا خلنگ نی آ باز مرے مرے دے تینے دوس۔ سلگے بٹو دے خٹی دے دا چار چاغس کنے باز سلوئی افس۔ کنا لکٹی خلک۔
en: Oh, you wretched ..., you've come to beat me. Yes, I've come to beat you. Oh, say 'God, God' — beating me will be too much for you ... this pitchfork ... I don't have much ... He hit my ...
en_old: Oh, misfortune, you came to beat me. Yes, I came to beat you. Oh, say 'Allah, Allah'... may my beating fall hard on you... these four sides... I don't have much... it hits my stick.

brh: پیسہ لکھ تو داسہ نا کائیک۔ ارے پدی ہورے موشے خنزہ خمپیسہ۔ موشے خنیو یا خمپر۔ لیکن نی کرا دعا مچے پیسہ ہنو۔ اسے کہ پدی تہور موشا کہ انتس نا موشے۔ نی خوش اوس کہ موش ترا سیڈ ہورف۔ ولا نی
en: The money, lakhs of it — it's going now. Hey, then look: will you see death or won't you? Will I see death or not? But you pray — all the money will go. Then once you look at death, [you'll see] what kind of death it is. You were happy [thinking] that death wouldn't look your way. And then you ...
en_old: I don't get lakhs of money now. Yes, then you'll see death, or you won't. Will you see death or not? But you pray, and all the money goes. Then... what kind of death. You were happy that death... Then you...

brh: چار چاخے چوکھے ٹھیکہ را کھٹک، نی اکو چکر چلیفیسے یاسے چکر اسم چلیفپر، نی اکو ٹھگی کیسی ٹھگی کپر، نی اکو فراڈ کیسی فراڈ کپر، ایچو فراڈ مراڈ اسفک، ننا ہر کارم کرے سدھائی، اسوارس پدی موسی ہرک، ولدا دچا زندہ مریس خنزدا موسے
en: ... wins the contract. Whether you run a scheme or don't run any scheme, whether you cheat or don't cheat, whether you commit fraud or don't commit fraud — there's no fraud or anything of the kind; all our work is done straight. Once death comes, then who knows whether you'll stay alive? You will see death.
en_old: On all four sides... you may run a scheme or not, you may cheat or not, you may commit fraud or not. There's no fraud of any kind; all our work is straight. Once death comes, where will you stay alive? You'll see death.

brh: دچا خمپیس، ئے ہنا خطرہ پاونے، ہنکہ نیتے تینا اسہ وار ہر، استنا تینا مرادے پورا کر۔ مورتھا نی ہرک، ئے ہنچو گڑیم نا دیکھار کٹانو۔ ٹھیک ہی مورتھا ہرسا ہمپیس، داسا ہمت کیس۔ دیکھار چر چاکھٹ خل کش، خل پرالے جی۔
en: Who knows, you might not see it. I'm telling you about that danger, so look at yourself once and fulfil your heart's wish. Death is watching you; ... such ... wall ... Right — you look at death but you won't see it; now have courage. ... the pitchfork ... take out a stone, a stone ..., yes.
en_old: You don't see it there. I'm telling you about the danger. So go once yourself and fulfill your wish. Death will come to you... the wall... Right, when you see death you won't... Now have some courage. The wall... on all four sides, throw a stone, throw stones.

brh: ئے کے ونے اینے پانے مورچے ہورنی مورچے ہپیزے سلی داسنے خبر تمبک ہلمستو بھلو کریس
en: ... today I'm telling [you]: look at death, death ... stood ... now you won't even know [what hit you] ... you did a big [thing].
en_old: ...today... the trench... the trench... now the news is falling... you made it big.

brh: دا سہورنگ کین غزا کیسی نی شاباش خان ء دکت ء سنوس، تینا موت ء دکت ء سنوس۔ موت دا سکون ء داسے مت کیس۔
en: This ... you are doing ..., you've brought trouble on Shabash Khan; you've brought on your own death. Death ... this peace ... now ...
en_old: You eat this food... you've put Shabash Khan in trouble, you've put your own death in trouble. Death... this peace... now...

brh: اوئے نی بلو ڈیلہ خلکو سے اسے چار چاخہ خلکو سے
en: Hey, you've struck a big blow, you've struck [him] with a pitchfork.
en_old: Hey, you're a big lump of a guy, hitting on all four sides.

brh: شاباش خف کلمہ او نی مونی مونی کرے
en: Shabash, recite the kalima! And he moved you forward, forward.
en_old: Well done... the kalima, and he put you in front.

brh: چپ کرہ صابر ہنک ایلو نا بلہ ایفے داسہ اوغسہ او شاباش خان توڑے فک تنے مش شاباٹی ٹی شاباش خان ایلو مے کن انتہ غل کوس او کے کنہ خلوسہ کڈائی لو سڑتے او چوناس
en: Be quiet, Sabir ... the other one's ... now crying ... oh Shabash Khan ... Shabash Khan, why did you ... for the other one? ... you're hitting me ... oh child ...

en: Oh, you dog, you hit [him] — it's become a mess. Oh father, by God, ... well ... it's astonishing — how did you do it, brother? You came and did this ...
en_old: Oh dog, you hit him, it became filthy. Oh father, by God, good... I'm amazed at what you did, brother. You came and made this food.

brh: دا ہرا استا اور جوانی کنگس، ئنا نا حرکتاک، ئنا نا گندئی، ئنا نا حرام خوری، داڑے ہرا انت آلیسس، جوانگا برناتا بلے ہپیر داڑے ہراک، ئنا نا پاڑنے کپا حرام خوری، کپا حرام خوری نا نتیجہ ئنا دے، ہرا کا پھیری زار اڑے نا ساتھ اما، اینے
en: This ... goodness ... your deeds, your filth, your eating of haram — look here, what have you left? The good young men's ... look here. I'm telling you: don't eat haram! Don't eat haram! The result of eating haram is this day of yours ... with you ... today.
en_old: This goodness... your actions, your filth, your eating of forbidden things... what is here... good young men... here... your forbidden eating... the result of forbidden eating is your day... which... with... today.

brh: ہنا دے سلوک و نزلوک نا مونان نی امدا بھلے تما نی ام بے کاری ورتہ وا کہ کاریم کریس کریس ہنا دے ہنا دے غریب نا بھلے حرفیسک نی این مسک چپ کروس استولوس ہیش ہیش رت کروس
en: That day, in front of those standing and ..., you too fell ..., you too [brought] joblessness ... that you worked and worked. That day, that day you took up the poor man's ..., you became ..., you kept quiet, sat down, [saying] 'hush, hush'.
en_old: That day, in front of... you also... you also brought joblessness... that you worked, worked. That day, that day the poor man's... you became... you kept quiet, sat down, hush, hush...

en: This poison ..., eating this poison ..., this poison — this man is equal [to it] ... my prince, father, father, this young man ... our eating of this ... father; oh mother, ... has become ... oh mother's ...

en: ... we wanted this much money, we wanted a car, you wanted a bungalow, my lord ... I don't want it, I don't want it, I want nothing ... your brother ... I don't want it from you, I want nothing else. Bring my brother back to me! My brother's ... this life — my brother's ... doesn't come back ... this life.
en_old: ...I wanted this much money, wanted a car, wanted a bungalow, my master... I'm here. I don't want it, I don't want anything, your brother... I don't want anything more, my brother... brother, once this life is gone it doesn't come back...

brh: ایرا مچے بنگلے ٹی ونے تول ٹائمز کھرک مچے کنے نا بنگلہ غاتا ضرورت اف کنے عیش و عشرت نا زندگی نا ضرورت اف
en: ... all ... in the bungalow ... I don't need your bungalows at all; I don't need a life of luxury and pleasure.
en_old: Brother, I don't need all those bungalows... I don't need bungalows, I don't need a life of luxury and pleasure.

brh: ئے ہرا وڑ تینا زندگی ء گدریفٹے۔ کنے ہمے وڑ زندگی سہی ئے کنا ایلم اینا، لے لے لے اللہ خیر کے۔ نی کنے پاریس کنا ایلم قسم، کنا بلا تھم آ۔
en: The way I spent my life — that same kind of life is right for me, my brother ... Oh, oh, oh, may God make it well. You told me, my brother — I swear — a calamity has befallen me.
en_old: ...the way he spent his life. That kind of life is right for me, my brother. Oh, oh, oh, may God have mercy. You told me, my brother, I swear, my...

en: Oh my mother! Oh my ... oh ... oh mother ... you all, after my ... the soul's ... my ... oh mother ... you ... my money and pennies ... my trust ...
en_old: Oh my mother... oh mother... you all came after my brother... my money... my trust... has been betrayed...

en: Oh my ..., oh, the young man's ... this cruel one ... what locks [of hair] ... the young man's head ... oh my ..., the young man's head ... Ah, this young man!
en_old: Oh my mother, oh this young man's... oh this cruel... this young man's... Oh my mother, this young man's... Ah, this young man!

en: The news reached me just now, just now ... you did ... the bed ... Oh mother, everyone's prayers ... you did not spare me; your intention was bad, you set [them] on my trail ... [my brother?] fell. You, what ...
en_old: The news reached me just now... everyone's prayers were... your intention was bad, you came after me... brother, what are you...

en: That day ... today ... such treatment ... brother ... is not ... deliver my brother's body to the house. — Yes, at once, at once.
en_old: Today... such behaviour... my brother's body has been brought home... here, here.

brh: دا زبلہ تمبیانہ باہڑ نور بائے مئے گان مس، مئے صیب دا کنا علم آ بلا تما دا ورنا نا بلا ء ہرفے
en: This ... has fallen ... our light is lost. Our sahib, a calamity has befallen my brother; he took upon himself this young man's misfortune.
en_old: This... my... has been lost, my fate... take this young man's...

brh: نا ایلوما ولت ہمے تو دا کل کاریم نا او میر صاحب ہاو صاحب ہمیدے میر صاحب کنے کل احوالے تس دا کل نا کاریم ک نی دا درائی کنے سزانا خلنگ اٹ کین انجام داس کہ دا مسلمان ہنا اگہ نی دا درائی کتوسے انت کہ دا اینا تفار
en: Your brother ... it is you; all this is your doing, O Mir Sahib. — Yes, sir. — That very Mir Sahib told me everything: all this is your doing. You carried out this [deed] to punish me, so that this Muslim is gone. If you had not done this, why would this ... today ...
en_old: Your brother... all this was his doing, O Mir Sahib. Yes sir, Mir Sahib told me everything. All of this was your doing; you did this to punish me, so that this Muslim... if you hadn't done this, what...

brh: نا ایلم دا وجہ نی خلاف ئس کنے حرام خوری کیسی دو نمبر او کارم کیسی مخلوق نی ریفیسے زمین قبضہ کیسی دنیا نا زمین تے قبضہ کرینوس دا پیسہ تے کٹانوس دا جوان او کارم اف ئس نا ایلم خدا نا خوف ہکیک جہنم آن خلیک۔ دا دنیا سے عارضی او ارادے نا دنیا سے۔
en: Your brother was against you for this reason: that you live on unlawful earnings, you do crooked ('number two') work, you cheat people, you seize land. You have seized people's land all over the world and you have amassed this money. This was not good work. Your brother feared God and was afraid of hell. This world is temporary; it is a world of two days.
en_old: Your brother, this is why he was against you: you eat haram, you do crooked work, you deceive people, you seize land; you have seized land everywhere and piled up this money. This is not good work, brother. Fear God, fear hell. This world is temporary, a passing world.

brh: دا دنیا لنگڑی اٹ غم اٹ گدرینگک لیکن ئے دنیا باز سخت ئے دا دورا دے نا دنیا سے کائیک لیکن ئے دنیا نا گدریفنگ سخت ئے ئے دنیا ٹی اسدے اسدے پورا ڈاٹی نا ہزار
en: This world passes in poverty and sorrow, but that world is very hard. This is a world of two days; it goes by. But getting through that world is hard: in that world one day, one day is a full thousand
en_old: This world passes in poverty and sorrow, but that world is very hard. This world of a few days comes and goes, but getting through that world is hard. In that world, a single day is a full thousand...

brh: سال گدرینگی رے نا اسے عذاب نا سختی دارا دا کرے زبو خدا نا خوفی کرے کور نی خنیسہ دا دنیا غا بس خنیسہ غیر مذہب نا عیش پرستی عیش و عشرت بس اوڑ مفک مسلمان مومن کے دا دنیا اسے قید خانہ سے میر صاحب جیو دا ڈی منے دا دنیا تو محبت کرو یف
en: years of this [world] pass ... the severity of a torment ... fear God. Blind man, you look only at this world; you see only the luxury-worship, the luxury and pleasure of other religions — that is not fitting for a Muslim believer. This world is a prison, Mir Sahib. — Yes ... — This world must not be loved.
en_old: Years passed... the hardship of a torment... he came to fear God... You only see this world, the luxury and pleasure-seeking of other religions; that is not for a Muslim believer. This world is a prison, Mir Sahib. Long live! We should not love this world.

brh: ننے تینا نغئی نا ایتا تے ہمل کرو۔ نی خبر ارے کہ منے مسی دا بندغ پارے کہ بائے دا بندغ نا خیال ء کیس۔ ہو اینو ولدا دا ننا رند اٹ تمی پیس۔ خلپیس تے خلپیس تے۔ ہو انتک ننے پئیس۔
en: We should act on the words of our own Prophet. Do you know that ... this man said, 'Brother, take care of this man'? Yes, don't come after us again today. Don't hit him, don't hit him. Yes, why are you telling us?
en_old: We should leave our... You know this man said, brother, take care of this man. Yes, today he is after us again. Don't hit them, don't hit them. Yes, why are you telling us?

brh: او ہمو وخت خلیفہ سئی دے ہلمی، او حرام خوری کے او تینا خدا تے او چائے نا، نی حرام خوری کیسہ نی چاس نا کاریم چاس۔ نہ نہ حرام خوری جوان اف نی ہم حرام خوری ئے اینو پد بند کرک، حرام خوری سئی او گڑا صاف اگہ نی پا کے سئی او گڑا سے تو پا۔
en: And at that time the caliph ... He who lives on unlawful earnings — does he know his God? You live on unlawful earnings; you know your own business. No, no, unlawful earning is not good. You too, stop unlawful earning from today on. Is unlawful earning a right thing? Say it plainly: if you say it is a right thing, then say so.
en_old: Then he said to the caliph that day, "O you who live off unlawful earnings, do you know your God? You live off unlawful earnings; you know your own business." "No, no, living off unlawful earnings is not good. You too should stop living off unlawful earnings from today on. Is living off unlawful earnings right? That matter is clear. If you say it is right, then say so."

brh: نہ بابا سئی او گڑا صاف۔
en: No, father — a right thing? Plainly [not].
en_old: No, father, that matter is plainly right.

brh: بندغ نا غلطی مسک ایلوم ایلو کرے بابا اسرات مریو راٹی کارم کپ گاڑی تے ٹی پیڑی کے کلین زبا ایلوم دونو کٹس کے کٹ ننگ کے لخڑ ننا دا صفا ہمو عیش و عشرت نیان کارم ئتو کلین دا سیچ کارم تفک ئے دا سے دا
en: A person makes mistakes, brother. He said, 'Father, ... don't do ... work; [work] in the vehicles as a cleaner ...' Brother, he earned this way ... earning ... this is exactly that luxury of yours ... the work of a cleaner ... this work ...
en_old: People make mistakes, brother... he said, father, be... don't do this work, work as a cleaner in cars... brother... this is exactly that luxury... work as a cleaner, learn this work...

brh: بندغ نا خناٹک گم گیششرت نا زندگی بس غریبی کر کاریم کر دو نا پوریا کر پنج وقت نا نمازے کر بس شاباش۔ دا سدا مسلمان تو ہنا ہا نی پا دس اند کرو سما بنگلا تے محلا تے نی پا
en: A person ... a life of luxury ... Just live in poverty, do work, earn by the labour of your own hands, say the five daily prayers — that's all. Bravo. This is a true Muslim ... yes. You say, what shall we do with bungalows and palaces, you say.
en_old: What a person sees as a life of luxury... just live in poverty, work, earn your living, pray five times a day. Bravo. This is a true Muslim... you say, what should we do with bungalows and palaces...

brh: ئے اینو پد تینا کل ملکیت غریباتی بشخیوے بس کاریم کیوے چار شاخے تینا ارفیوے مزور ملا ٹک ملے توکل اللہ شاباش دا بہترین و طریقہ سے جوان و کاریم اسے ہا میر صاحب ئے دا جوانم پد بلو پنت اسے
en: From today on I will distribute all my property among the poor. I will just work; I will take up my own pitchfork; as a labourer, whatever morsel I get — trust in God. Bravo, this is the best way, a good deed. Yes, Mir Sahib, that is great advice from this good man.
en_old: From today on I will give away all my property to the poor. I will just work and earn my own bread by labour; whatever bread I get, I trust in God. Bravo, this is the best way, a good deed. Yes, Mir Sahib, this young man has given great advice.

brh: لیکن دا جوانم پد عبرت کریٹک بابا بس دا زندگی کرے دادے نا ایلم باز خوشی نا ہیت اسے کہ نا ایلم ہدایت مس نی کرے سسے حلال خورو بندغ ئس سسے نا حلال خوری نا نتیجہ
en: But this good man took heed, father; he just lived this life. Your brother — it is a matter of great joy that your brother has been guided. You were an honest man who earned lawfully; [this is] the result of your lawful earning.
en_old: But this young man learned a lesson, father; he lived this life. My brother, it's very happy news that brother found guidance. You became an honest man who earns halal; this is the result of your halal earning.

brh: نامس کنا ایلم و مئے نوید احمد سے۔ حلال خوری باز جوان او گڑا سے دا زندگی کائے گدرینگک۔ اسہ بندغ لنگڑ مرے پانے مرے لیکن حرام خوری کپ کہ ناحق خلق۔ کس پین کسسے سزا کپ۔ دا بندغ مہر کبو دائے سرپد کبو۔
en: His name — my brother, our Naveed Ahmed. Lawful earning is a very good thing; this life goes on and passes. A person may go hungry, may be in want, but do not live on unlawful earnings or wrong people unjustly. Do not punish anyone else. Have mercy on this man; make him understand.
en_old: My name, brother, is Naveed Ahmed. Earning halal is a very good thing; this life passes somehow. A person may be lame or hungry, but don't earn haram and don't oppress people unjustly. Don't punish anyone else. Have mercy on this person and make him understand.

brh: میر صاحب نا موکانی رنگ کرک اتھے ایمبولینس ئس دادے اینو رغاتے سر کین ولا پدا مرک و میڑ کین ٹھیک ہا ٹھیک ہی بس دادا فوئی دروئے ہاں صحیح
en: Mir Sahib, ring for an ambulance here; let's take him home today, then afterwards we'll see to the death rites and the settlement. — Okay, yes, okay. Just this dead one must be taken ... — Yes, right.
en_old: Mir Sahib's... call an ambulance here, take him to the hospital today, then later we'll bury him... okay, okay... yes, right.

en: Even if there is a tribal enmity, if some child or some woman is with him, he is spared. Where respect for women — this was a distinction for which, here, in my opinion, perhaps a journey of a thousand years has been travelled.
en_old: Even if there is a tribal feud, if a child is with a woman, that is overlooked. Here, respect for women was a distinction which, in my opinion, has perhaps travelled a journey of a thousand years here.

en: And this has become a value system. It is an unwritten code — that constitution, that law, which may not exist in writing, but which here, in the character of every child, every elder, every senior and every respected person,
en_old: And this became a value system. It is an unwritten code, that constitution, that law, which may not exist in writing, but here, in the character of every child, every elder, every senior and every respected person, it...

en: You're looking for labour work. However much money you need, tell me and I'll give it to you. What will you take for a little trickery? Me? I need a rightful, halal livelihood. I don't need your money; I earn only halal income.
en_old: You're looking for labour work. However much money you need, tell me and you'll get it. What will you take for four sacks? I won't take it. I need honest, halal earnings. I don't need your money. I'll only do halal work.

en: I do labour, I earn halal, I eat halal. You don't even get an evening meal; you eat one meal. I do hard labour and on top of that I eat four meals a day. Look here, what joy there is in hard work, you see...
en_old: I do labour, I earn halal and I eat halal. You don't even get an evening meal; you eat one meal. I do hard labour and on top of that I eat four meals. Look here, what joy there is in hard work...

en_old: May God strike... we eat this... Shahbaz Khan, four sacks... a bungalow... with a TV, luxury. Why do labour for nothing and suffer? Just give me this bungalow.

en: I don't need it. There is the hereafter. I do hard, halal labour and eat, and I make my hereafter good. You lot, go on, eat haram, eat and eat. This world is temporary, a life of two days. I won't ruin my own world. Brother, you, which...

en_old: He trades and a man eats; this is the old man's sign. So use your sense. Emil, you've driven me crazy too and you've driven yourself crazy too, so use your sense. Eating haram, just eating... it's a haram shop, a haram shop, a haram shop... say these four...

en: Hand over all the daily wages! The monster has wiped out this money from you, the monster has wiped it out from you. Shabash Khan, today you didn't give the hundred of the daily wage. May the monster strike you! Don't mess with my head, all of you, with this-and-that about the daily wage.
en_old: He cleaned out all the people's money, he ruined your name. Shabash Khan, today you didn't give the people their hundred. Then don't mess with my head, where are the people?

en: The vehicle got... your..., these little tricks of yours, your fights every day. Now I've come to know that you're stirring up this kind of fight. Alam Khan, priceless...

en: We have one more message for the viewers of Channel Brahui TV. We say that there is one thing: that you love [your] language. As for language, we say, the whole world even calls it the mother [tongue]; so 'mother' is such a sacred word ...
en_old: We have another message for the viewers of Channel Brahui TV. We say there is one thing: that you love your language. As for language, the whole world even calls it the mother tongue, and 'mother' is such a sacred word...

brh: مقدس و رشتہ سے کہ مہر محبت ایثار قربانی دا کل ہموڑے ختم مریرہ کہ ہراڑے لمہ نا پین بریک اور سد دکھ لمہ برداشت کننگ کیک لیکن دا خواہپ کہ اسے بوچس کنا اولاد
en: ... a sacred bond, such that love, affection, selflessness and sacrifice all come to an end there, where the mother's name comes. A mother can bear a hundred sorrows, but she does not want that even a single blade of grass [should touch] her child ...
en_old: ...it is a sacred bond: love, affection, selflessness and sacrifice all end where the mother comes in. A mother can bear a hundred sorrows, but she does not want any harm to come to her child.

brh: دا تمے تو دا زبان کیرے دا لمہ تو ریلیٹڈ ئے لمہ ہی لولی تیک لمہ ہی اغا او ہیل ایتک لمہ ہی چنائے تینا خومبٹی کیک تو کلان بھلا ارا کہ ثقافتی تہذیبی تحفہ ء او زبان
en: ... should befall. So this language you speak is related to the mother: it is the mother who sings lullabies, the mother who ... and teaches, the mother who takes the child into her arms. So the greatest cultural and civilizational gift is language.
en_old: ...so the language you speak is connected to the mother. It is the mother who sings lullabies, the mother who teaches, the mother who holds the child in her lap. So the greatest cultural gift, the greatest gift of civilization, is language.

brh: ننے کہ او تینا اولاد ایتک تا تو دا کرے لمبنا تروکا امانت ء ار دا دے نن اخس کہ دا کہ خدمت کننگ کینہ دا دے مونا دننگ کینہ دا دے شون تننگ کینہ نن تینا افعال و گشاد ء استعمال کین دا دے مونی دن
en: ... which she gives to us, her children. So this is a trust handed down by the mother, and however much we can serve it, take it forward and help it advance, we should use our abilities and talents and take it forward.
en_old: For us, it is like our own children; it is a trust handed down to us by our forefathers. Today, however much we can serve it, take it forward and guide it, we should use our actions and efforts to take it forward.

brh: چم کہ دادے کہ زبان ہر بندغے دوستے اور دنیا ٹی ہچو زبان ئس کھرے او خراب اف کل زباناک جوان او ننے محبت کل زبان تے کے کروئی ئے لیکن خدمت اور تخلیق اخس کہ مننگ کیک او ننے
en: Since it is so, language is dear to every person, and no language in the world is inferior or bad; all languages are good, and we ought to love all languages. But service and creative work, as much as can be done, we ...
en_old: Look, the fact is that every person loves language, and no language in the world is bad or worse. All languages are good, and we should love all languages, but as much service and creative work as is possible, we should...

brh: تینا زبانٹ کین ایلوفتے ٹی بے ممانعت افک لیکن ہراٹم آ کہ ننا زبان ترقی کرے ہمو دے اسکا بس کہ ننا ہمسایہ زبان آک ہریر تو اوک ہپت ایلو زبان تے کہ کاریم کن نیگیٹیو ئے ہچ افک
en: ... should do in our own language. There is no prohibition on the others either, but [only] until the day our language has developed to where our neighboring languages are; after that, there is nothing negative in working for other languages.
en_old: Doing it in our own language is not prohibited among others, but when our language develops, it is enough that when our neighboring languages see it, they too... there is nothing negative about working for other languages.

brh: جوان ہندون ہندون
en: Good, like that, like that.
en_old: Good, just like that, just like that.

brh: دشمن آ ہندونو وار ئس کر تاکہ اونا فرشتہ غاک ہم خبر تمپ کہ اوڑتو انتس مس گنو کنا ایتونو بومانی غا ڈیو رینا جی اومے بابو کن تو
en: Strike the enemy with such a blow that even his angels won't find out what happened to him... [garbled: my ... ] ... yes sir ... for father, then.
en_old: Strike the enemy with such a blow that even his angels don't find out what happened to him... yes sir, for father then.

brh: ہیلو ہا انسپکٹر صاحب اورے کرے رے جیاؤ نا سرمسونو شام کونگون نما انتظار مننگے چے جی جی
en: Hello, yes, Inspector Sahib, hey, yes... long live [you], have [you] arrived? We've been waiting for you since evening. Yes, yes.
en_old: Hello, yes, Inspector Sahib, yes, it's been done. Long live you, we've been waiting for you since evening. Yes, yes.

brh: اچھا خوڑکرے ہا ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ٹھیک مہربانی
en: Okay, well done. Yes, fine, fine, fine. Thank you.
en_old: Okay, well done. Yes, fine, fine, fine. Thank you.

brh: دا خلک
en: He struck [him].
en_old: This was killed.

brh: او ٹی اسے چنا سے سکول آ بفرو دا پومارک، اگہ نما ارتو نا وار داخل کنا چار چنا پین علم نا روشنائی فادھر فیرا تو گڑا دا جنگ فتم بیک، ماسٹر! دا کلمہ
en: Not a single child there would come to school, they understand this. If your family's turn [comes and they] enroll, my four other children [will also gain] the light of knowledge, then this war will end. Master! This kalima...
en_old: Oh, a child in it, bring the children to school, they say. If a child from your family enters... my four children get the light of knowledge, then this war will end. Teacher! This Kalima.

brh: او کلمہ، دا کلمہ نا باز بلو طاقت اسے۔ ئے دا نا طاقت آن انتئے محروم اٹ؟ یا دا کنا نصیب اٹ اف؟ نہ کنا مار، دنو ہچو ہیت ئس اف۔
en: Oh, the kalima! This kalima has very great power. Why am I deprived of its power? Or is it not in my fate? No, my son, there is no such thing.
en_old: Oh, the Kalima, this Kalima has a very great power. Why am I deprived of its power? Or is it not in my fate? No, my son, there's nothing like that.

brh: ہر بندغ تینا نصیب ء تینٹ جوڑ کیک۔ داڑے دیر ئنا بوتل ئس تو ہرفیسہ کسکا، دا دینم تو ہرسرونرے؟ ہا، ئے تو داڑے پتانوٹ، جوان۔
en: Every person makes his own fate himself. There was a bottle of water here; did someone pick it up? Did you take this one too? Yes, I had searched here. Fine.
en_old: Every person makes his own fate himself. Here, will you pick up a bottle of water, little one? Have you seen this [book]? Yes, I left it here, good.

brh: دوارا دیر دریتہ بس صاحب ہن پاو نی داڑے اکثر ہن مرے خیر انم داڑے ننا ہمیشہ اسپیکٹ صاحب ایننگ بننگ ارے اسکول اٹی ولے داڑے
en: Have some water again. That's enough, sir. Well, tell me, are you here often? Well, here our Inspector Sahib is always coming and going at the school, but here...
en_old: Give water again. That's enough, sir. Come on, tell me, do you come here often? Well, Inspector Sahib always comes and goes here, to the school, but here...

brh: دا چا کرے؟ نما بنی بند مسونے، انتئے کہ ماسٹر صیب بسونے اسکول ملنگانے۔ اینو تینا امیرے پاو، بیٹھک بند مسونے، تینا میمانتے اموڑے جاؤ جاگہ ایتے۔ بلے میر صیب، میر صیب پاو انسپکٹر نواز ننا اسکول آ
en: Is he the servant? Your [place] has been shut down, because Master Sahib has come and the school has been opened. Today tell your Mir: the guest hall has been closed, give your guests a place somewhere else, over there. Fine, Mir Sahib; tell Mir Sahib that Inspector Nawaz [is] at our school...
en_old: What did he do? Your business has been shut down, because the teacher has come and the school has opened. Tell your master today: the guest room is closed, put your guests up somewhere else over there. Fine, Mir Sahib, Mir Sahib, tell him, Inspector Nawaz at our school...

brh: بند کرینے بھلے انسپکٹر صاحب نم تو میر نا غصہ جوان چارے کنا خیال ئے نم انسپکٹر نواز دے تپیرے
en: [He] has closed it. Fine, Inspector Sahib, you know Mir's anger well. I think you don't know Inspector Nawaz.
en_old: It has been closed, fine, Inspector Sahib. You know Mir's anger well. I think you don't know Inspector Nawaz.

brh: تانکہ دا ہاک تنے دا ہندن تفوک سلوک زلی ئے صاحب باس دیٹو بندغ اسے بائے تینا نی پاس ہیس بے خلکو
en: Until he [talks], he stays tied up like this, standing... Sir, the boss is a stubborn man; his own mouth... you say... [garbled] ...without being beaten.
en_old: So that he is treated this way, sir, the boss is such a person... brother, your own... not killed.

brh: آخر بائے تے نہ ملیک ایلو ایلو تا کہ بائے تے نہ ملپ آخر بائے تے نہ ملیک تا ہندارے تفوک مرے تمبوک مرے او ہا
en: After all, won't he open his mouth? Another, another... as long as he won't open his mouth... After all, won't he open his mouth? Until then let him stay tied up, let him lie there. Oh, yes.
en_old: In the end the brothers don't meet each other, so that the brothers won't meet. In the end the brothers don't meet... let them be tied up, let them be beaten, oh yes.

brh: آئندہ پد تانا دیرم بندے تو وختم بندے سمجھارے؟ میر صاحب ئے تپہ او دادے گولی ئس نا واچیکیو ناخ
en: From now on, if their water is cut off, then their time is cut off too, understand? Mir Sahib, I don't know... he [will put] a bullet in him...
en_old: From now on, if my water is stopped, my time will be stopped, understand? Mir Sahib doesn't know; he'll fire a bullet at him...

brh: خرونا داتی دن زو کوسپوئی افک دادے استے استے خورا غا بک کمزور کروئی ہندن دادے کمزور کروئی دوکے بلا درخت ٹھکا کے پنی
en: [He] can't be killed that quickly. He has to be weakened slowly, little by little, the way woodworm does; that is how he has to be weakened, the way a big tree is [brought down]...
en_old: It isn't easy to uproot it so quickly. It has to be weakened bit by bit, slowly; it has to be weakened like that, like cutting down a big tree...

brh: میر صاحب ئے تو دا ہیت آ حیران اٹ کہ دا ننا خلاف گواہی امر کیک۔ ہرور ننا دشمن آ سرے کہ دا ننا خلاف ہوسلے ٹی اور ننا خلاف۔ او گل۔
en: Mir Sahib, I'm amazed at this: how can he testify against us? Look, he has gone over to our enemy, so that he [stands] against us in the [hearing?], against us. Oh, Gul.
en_old: Mir Sahib, I am surprised at this, how he can testify against us. Look, he's become our enemy, so that he's in court against us... against us. Oh, enough.

brh: او! نی راست بسے، نہ تو دا ولنگا بندغاتا ہن حیثیت اسے کہ میر نا مونا بش مرے میر صاحب! ئے اینو داڑا ضرور معلوم کیوا کہ ننا دشمن دیر اسے۔
en: Oh! You came at the right time; otherwise, what standing do these people have that they stand up before Mir? Mir Sahib! Today I will surely find out from him who our enemy is.
en_old: Oh! You've come at the right time. Otherwise, what standing do these outsiders have to come before Mir? Mir Sahib! Today I will surely find out who our enemy is.

brh: او گلو! نی داہڑان؟ زو مرو ماری کس۔
en: Hey Gulu! Where are you? Hurry up, boy.
en_old: Hey Gulu! Where are you? Hurry up, son.

brh: باورچی او باورچی باورچی او باورچی
