en: Everything has gone into lockdown, everything has closed. The Zoom app is such that you can hold meetings with many people ... whether by video or by audio, you can easily hold a meeting there. You are teaching us the Zoom app; what other benefits does the Zoom app have, what else...
en_old: Everything is in lockdown, everything is closed. The Zoom app is such that you can hold meetings with many people, open video or audio, you can easily hold a meeting there. Teach us about the Zoom app; what other benefits and uses does the Zoom app have?

brh: بندغاک او اگر اودے ہیل کیر یوز کننگ تو اونا انت انت پین فائدہ کو انت انت کاریم زوم ایپ آن ہلنگ کین نن؟ زوم ایپ نا دا اینو پگاہ سکولاک بے بند مسنو ٹیچرز آک خوانفنگ بے کیرہ ایلو مطلب اگر میٹنگ نما کرو یہ ہر گڑا بند مسنے بندغاک بننگ کپسہ میٹنگ آسانی ٹی کننگ کیرہ باز بندغاک
en: People, if they learn to use it, what other benefits does it have, what tasks can we get done with the Zoom app? — With the Zoom app, these days schools have closed too, and teachers are also teaching (with it); and also, I mean, if you have to hold a meeting, everything has closed and people cannot come, they can easily hold the meeting, many people.
en_old: People, if they learn to use it, what other benefits does it have, what tasks can we take from the Zoom app? With the Zoom app, these days schools are closed, teachers are teaching too, and also, I mean, if you have a meeting while everything is closed and people cannot come, they can easily hold meetings, many people.

brh: توار ایلو باز مطلب فائدہ تارے دا کوار نن آسانی تو آن لائن فری بے ارے ایلو باز بندغات تو بے مریک تو ننے مچے ہمو کمپیوٹرے ملورے بنفورے کہ دا زوم ایپ ء امر یوز کیرے تاکہ ننا مخلوق ننا ورناک اودے یوز کیر تین تین تو رابطہ کننگ کے ہکو بے تو میٹنگ
en: Voice, and also, I mean, it has many benefits; ... it is easy for us, it is also free online, and it also works with many people. So open the computer and tell us all of it, how you use this Zoom app, so that our people, our young people, can use it to contact one another, and meetings...
en_old: Voice, and also, I mean, it has many benefits; it's easy for us, it's also free online, and it works with many people. So show us on the computer how you use this Zoom app, so that our people, our youth, can use it and contact each other, and hold meetings.

brh: نن انکی وقت وقتس نن براہوی ٹی وی آ کسنہ انٹرویو ہلین تو ننم زوم ایپ یوز کین تو ننے ہمو گڑائے مچ بنفنگ کرو رے؟ جی جی بالکل انت بنفورے تینا کمپیوٹر آ کا؟ تینا لیپ ٹاپ آئی بنفونو نمے چلو دا سہم نم تینا لیپ ٹاپ آ گڑا ننے ہم مچا گڑائے بنفبو۔ صحیح ہی ٹھیک ہی با۔
en: If at some time we take someone's interview for Brahui TV and we use the Zoom app, will you be able to show us that whole thing? — Yes, yes, absolutely. — Will you show it on your computer? — I will show you on my laptop. — Okay, so now you, on your laptop, then show us everything too. — Right, okay.
en_old: If sometimes we want to take an interview for Brahui TV, and we use the Zoom app, will you show us everything? Yes, yes, of course. Will you show it on your computer? I'll show you on my laptop. Okay, now you show us everything on your laptop. Right, alright, okay.

brh: فلم مالو نمے زوم ایپ آ
en: First, the film for you, on the Zoom app.
en_old: Show you the film on the Zoom app.

brh: ڈاؤن لوڈ کننگ کے کروم آ ہنوئی مرو، ایلو سرچ کروئی مرو ڈاؤن لوڈ زوم۔ ڈاؤن لوڈ زوم نم امر سرچ کریرے، دا باز آپشنز برور، پر کلو مالو آپشن برو ڈاؤن لوڈ سینٹر زوم نا طرفان، زوم نا ویب سائٹ نا طرفان۔ ہموڑے باز آپشنز
en: To download it you will have to go to Chrome, then you will have to search 'download Zoom'. As soon as you search 'download Zoom', many options will come up, but the very first option that comes up will be the Download Center from Zoom, from Zoom's website. There, many options...
en_old: To download it you have to go to Chrome, then you have to search 'download Zoom'. When you search 'download Zoom', many options will appear, but the top option will be the Download Center from Zoom, from Zoom's website. There, many options...

brh: آپشنز مروڑ پر ارا آپشن نمے کلک کروئی ئے او مرو زوم کلائنٹ فار میٹنگز ہمونا شیف ڈاؤن لوڈ بٹن ئس مرو ہمودے خلورے۔ امر زوم کلائنٹ فار میٹنگز نا ڈاؤن لوڈ بٹن ئے خلورے ڈاؤن لوڈ شروع مرو۔
en: There will be options, but the option you have to click will be 'Zoom Client for Meetings'; under it there will be a download button, press that. As soon as you press the download button for Zoom Client for Meetings, the download will start.
en_old: There will be options, but the option you need to click is 'Zoom Client for Meetings'; under it there will be a download button, press that. As soon as you press the download button for Zoom Client for Meetings, the download will start.

brh: ایلو مٹ ڈاؤن لوڈ مسنے ننے اوڑے کلک کرو رے تو انسٹال بے تینٹ مرو ہینو۔ امر انسٹال مسنے اوڑے ایرا آپشن نشان ایتو جوائن ئے میٹنگ یا سائن آن ننے انت کروئی مرو اگر نما اکاؤنٹ ئس اف تو۔
en: Then, once it has downloaded, you click there and it will install by itself, like this. As soon as it has installed, it will show two options there: 'Join a Meeting' or 'Sign In'. — What will we have to do if you don't have an account?
en_old: Then, once it has downloaded, we click there and it will install by itself, like this. As soon as it's installed, it will show options there: 'Join a Meeting' or 'Sign In'. What should we do if you don't have an account?

brh: نم تینا اکاؤنٹس جوڑ کرورے سائن اپ اینورے یا گنو اکاؤنٹس ارے نم سائن آن اینورے ہن ہرتو ماتا نس گڑس کرورے نم تینا اکاؤنٹ ہنورے زوم نا ہمت نم تینا
en: You create your account and sign up, or if you have an account, you sign in. ... whatever you do, you go to your account, Zoom's ... your...
en_old: You create your account and sign up, or if you already have an account you sign in. Whichever way you do it, you go to your account, Zoom's... your

brh: اکاؤنٹ ملنگ ارے ہنا اسکرین نومے خننگو۔ اگر نومے تینا پروفائل اٹ ایما چہ چینجز اتوئی ئے گڑاس بھی کروئی ئے نا سیٹنگز آتہ ہنوئی ئے تو نوم تینا سیدھا دونا کونڈا ہنو رے ہموڑے چینجز کننگ کیرے۔ ایلو اگر نومے میٹنگ ئس جوائن کروئی ئے کسہ
en: The account opens, and you will see that screen. If you need to make any changes to your profile or do anything at all, you need to go to Settings; you go straight to this side and you can make the changes there. And if you need to join someone's meeting...
en_old: account opens and you will see this screen. If you want to make any changes to your profile, or do anything else, you need to go to Settings. Go straight to this side and you can make the changes there. And if you want to join a meeting,

brh: نم میٹنگ اٹی اوار مننگ کن نم جوائن میٹنگ ء خلورے، ایلو کنڈ آ نمے پروفائل آئی ڈی تسنے ہمودے لکھسا، تینا پنی لکھسا میٹنگ ء جوائن کننگ کیرے۔
en: To take part in a meeting, you press 'Join Meeting'; then on the other side, you write the profile ID you have been given, write your name, and you can join the meeting.
en_old: To join a meeting you click Join Meeting. Then, on the other side, you type the profile ID you were given, type your name, and you can join the meeting.

brh: ادا نور خان ہمیدے لمبلک نینتگے خلقو؟ نی سما ئے نور خان نا ہزار دشمنو
en: Brother Nur Khan, why did you shoot right here like that? You know Nur Khan has a thousand enemies.
en_old: Brother, why did you kill him like that, Nur Khan? You know Nur Khan has a thousand enemies.

brh: تیرے سما ئے دا نور خان ایندکے خلقورے، ادا نور خان ہمک سے گواہ تو تے چنڈے نا کے، انے ہموفک کنا پٹ کھٹ کننگے نی اگہ چنڈے سے تے چنڈے تے، نور خان کنے آن ہم چنڈنگ مفک
en: You know why you shot at this Nur Khan. Brother Nur Khan, those are some witnesses, shake them off; and those people are out to dig into me. If you shake some of them off, shake them off. Nur Khan, I can't shake them off myself either.
en_old: You know who killed like this, brother Nur Khan, those are the witnesses... they are hunting for me. Even if you break them, Nur Khan can't be broken, not even by me.

brh: نور خان ہمت کیس، ہمت باز ادا، ارے خدا خلتی، نور خان انتین گھنٹہ تو فوکس کرو نی ہمت کدا، مورچہ ہمت کین
en: Nur Khan, have courage, a lot of courage, brother! Oh God, it didn't hit! Nur Khan, focus for an hour; have courage now. Let's hold the position with courage.
en_old: Nur Khan, have courage, great courage, brother. Oh God! Nur Khan, focus for an hour, have courage, hold the trench with courage.

brh: دا دے منجخ تے مت کے
en: Today, don't fret over these worries.
en_old: Today, put these troubles aside.

brh: ہن مس تیدا ہم کوٹہ ار ہم کوٹہ ار ادا گڑا گان نرفنجا
en: Yes, okay. There are rooms here too, there are rooms too. Brother, then don't run off.
en_old: Yes, there are rooms here too, there are rooms. Brother, then don't go far.

brh: دا بشخ کڈے او رسینتا بشخے المس ہمبرات نرا ردا بشخ کڈاس
en: Put this share away... he didn't arrive... the share... he ran off with it... put this share away.
en_old: Take out this share. He didn't arrive, take the share... run with the share.

brh: ادا نسیم السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام خلے جان ہمو کرے نور خان ئ خلتنورے خلتنورے دستہ افسوس کے نسیم جان اینو ننا سم کٹار
en: Brother Naseem, peace be upon you. And peace be upon you. Dear, did you do it? Haven't you shot Nur Khan? You haven't shot him? What a pity. Naseem Jan, today our bullets ran out.
en_old: Brother Nasim, peace be upon you. And peace be upon you. Brother, did they do it, did they kill Nur Khan? They killed him. My condolences. Nasim Jan, today our ammunition has run out.

brh: ننا تو نور خان نا ٹوپے ٹھم ٹھم کرینہ سمتے ٹین۔ ہا سم نمے اکھا ضرورت ئے ئے نمے سم ایتو بہرحال نور خان ء خلبو۔ سم ننتوم بازے لیکن دا واریکو نور خان ننا نیلے پنی نسیم دا وارنا نور خان ننا دوام بچی پک۔ ہنا ئے تو۔
en: We were going thump-thump at Nur Khan's cap with bullets. Yes, however many bullets you need, I'll give you bullets; anyway, shoot Nur Khan. We have plenty of bullets too, but this time we won't let Nur Khan go, Naseem. This time Nur Khan will never escape us. That's how it is.
en_old: We riddled Nur Khan's cap with bullets. Yes, if you need ammunition we'll give you ammunition, but kill Nur Khan anyway. We have plenty of ammunition, but this time Nur Khan won't escape us, Nasim. This time Nur Khan certainly won't survive us. Yes, indeed.

brh: ٹھیکیدار جی رانی انت اراٹ
en: Contractor sir, Rani, what is it?
en_old: Contractor sir, what's going on, Rani?

brh: ئے کاوے بس پھڈا پھڈا کیو۔ ادا ناگر ستارہ گردش ایٹی۔ اول اینا زفت ولے تیا۔ ادا دا زفت پیرا ہن دعا خواہ نا ستارہ سہی مرے
en: I'm going; I just keep making a fuss. Brother, your star is in a bad turn. First, today's... but... Brother, go to this pir and ask for a prayer so that your star comes right.
en_old: Go, I'll just split them up. Brother, the star of fate is turning. First take this... brother, pray that this star turns right.

brh: نی جوان سما
en: You know well.
en_old: You know well.

brh: کسس متو کنا ئے خواجہ ہر قدم تنیان انے نا زند نا درختانی بے برم
en: I had no one, O Khwaja; every step alone, and the trees of my life without fruit.
en_old: I had no one, O Khwaja. Every step I walked alone, the trees of my life were without honor.

brh: اعظم نا پنٹ کینی گڑاس، انے نا فاروق اعظم نا پنٹ رحم ذرا، جناب سید یا مصطفی کرم نا نگاہ، جناب سید
en: In the name of Azam, give me something; and in the name of Farooq-e-Azam, a little mercy. Honoured Sayyid, O Mustafa, a glance of grace, Honoured Sayyid.
en_old: Give me something for the sake of Azam, for the sake of Farooq-e-Azam have a little mercy. O Master, O Mustafa, a glance of kindness, O Master.

brh: ئے گناہگار یا بدکار گناہ کرو کس اریٹ، خواجہ انتس کہ اریٹ نا پنی الو کس اریٹ، تورے نٹ جھولی ئے
en: I am a sinner or a wrongdoer, one who has committed sin. Khwaja, whatever I am, I am one who takes your name; fill my begging cloth.
en_old: I am a sinner or a wrongdoer, one who has sinned. O Khwaja, whatever I am, I am one with nothing. Fill my begging bowl.

brh: آقا نی آن خواو کس اریت کنے توار کوس افی مرسلو کس اریت صدقہٹ حضرت عثمان غنی نا کنے گڑاس صدقہٹ
en: Master, I am one who asks of you. Call me; I am one who stands far off. For the sake of Hazrat Usman Ghani, give me something, for his sake.
en_old: O Master, who do I have besides you? I call out, there is no one else. For the sake of Hazrat Usman Ghani, give me something.

brh: حضرت عثمان غنی نا کنے گڑاس جناب سید یا مصطفی کرم نا نگاہ جناب سید یا مصطفی کرم نا نگاہ
en: For Hazrat Usman Ghani's sake, give me something. Honoured Sayyid, O Mustafa, a glance of grace; Honoured Sayyid, O Mustafa, a glance of grace.
en_old: For the sake of Hazrat Usman Ghani, give me something. O Master, O Mustafa, a glance of kindness. O Master, O Mustafa, a glance of kindness.

brh: خواجہ تارمہ کنا غریب نا
en: O Khwaja, the darkness of me, a poor one.
en_old: O Khwaja, protect me, poor me.

brh: ارے ارے ارے علی جان اسکو نور خان اسکو
en: Hey, hey, hey! Ali Jan, that one! Nur Khan, that one!
en_old: Hey, hey, hey! Ali Jan, come here! Noor Khan, come here!

brh: خٹلی جانی خٹلی جانی خل شکاری نور خان خل خل لیمونٹف لگے توریسا فیسٹ
en: Khatli Jani, Khatli Jani! Shoot, hunter Nur Khan, shoot, shoot! ...holding... fist.
en_old: Khatli jani, khatli jani, hunter Noor Khan, stone, stone... lemon... fist.

brh: ئے خوار تعویذ کنے ایتنے سوچ لگے پاسہ کنے ہنے منوں لگے جی یار
en: Oh, the wretched amulet he gave me. Think about it; you tell me, and I'll go along and accept it, yes, friend.
en_old: That wretched amulet you gave me got me thinking. Tell me and I'll go along with it, I'll believe it, yes, my friend.

brh: ہن مزہ دا سم چھٹر ارے خدا خالق ئے بش مرو ہمبل آتا سم کٹان ہا
en: Yes, what fun, this spray of bullets! Oh God, the Creator, it's getting back up! We've run out of bullets on the hambals, ha.
en_old: What a pleasure this hunt is! God the Creator will be pleased, with the hunting from our side.

brh: خنما دے کٹانو شاباس ادا دانگ بابو نا تو دے خنما کٹانو
en: Look, we've won the day! Well done, brother Dang Babu. With you, look, the day is won.
en_old: We'll see the day we hunt. Well done here, Dang Babu. We'll see the day we hunt.

brh: نم کنا نور خانء شکارنٹی ارے، آخر ہندا دشمنی سے ننتون نم۔ پاپو کنے۔ کنے ادا دا پاننگ نا ٹیم اف۔ ارے شکاری مت خلتا!
en: You are out hunting my Nur Khan. After all, this is some feud you have with us. Tell me. Brother, this is no time to talk about it with me. Hey, hunter, don't shoot!
en_old: You're out hunting my Noor Khan. After all, this is some feud you have with us. Tell me. Now isn't the time to talk about that. Hey, hunter, don't shoot!

brh: خبردار روپ خان دا سدے گنا پٹار روپ خان
en: Beware, Roop Khan! This one is a hundredfold blast, Roop Khan.
en_old: Beware, Roop Khan! This is a ... Roop Khan.

brh: دا نیم باز جنگ نا شوقی او، دا سئی نا نشانی تیوہ جنگ نا مڑ مڑیک، دا سدیک نا پھٹار، خبردار، دا سہور نا کہ دنا دے پھٹیرے، نایا نور خان نا، نور خان نا دے تے پھٹہ فوخاک داسکا پیدا متنو۔
en: These ones are very fond of fighting. This is a sign of... the whole fight... this is a blast of a hundred. Beware! ...who would end his days... The ones who could end Nur Khan's days, Nur Khan's, have not been born yet.
en_old: This one really loves to fight. This is a sign of ... it stirs up the whole fight ... Beware! ... The man who can break Noor Khan, who can break Noor Khan's days, hasn't been born yet.

brh: چھا خبردار ہمار شکاری جال ٹی پھسینگاس علی دوست دانگ بابو
en: Watch out, beware! The hunter has got caught in the net, Ali Dost, Dang Babu!
en_old: Watch out, beware! The hunter got caught in the net, Ali Dost, Dang Babu.

brh: علی جان جی نی دا پا کہ دا نور خان انت کہ سانہ دشمن مسونے ادا نور خان جان و کرم کتنے نسیم بال تے ننگے تتنی جازی نسیم پارے نی اخس کہ پیسہ خواری ئے نیمے تیو
en: Ali Jan, sir, you tell me this: how has this Nur Khan become such an enemy? Brother, Nur Khan Jan didn't do him the kindness; he didn't give Naseem the plane to fly. Naseem said, 'However much money you want, I'll give you half.'
en_old: Ali Jan, yes, tell me how this Noor Khan became such an enemy. Noor Khan Jan did a favor and gave Naseem the flying ... Naseem said, "However much money you want, I'll give you half."

brh: نور خان ء خلبو کسیفبو۔ او ہمو جہاز اسے ننا اینو اسکان نور خان تو سائیکلس خنتنون وا او جہاز کے جنگ ئٹی گیگی توتہ۔ نور خان کیرے پلاسٹکی ء جہاز اسے سلکوس سبی نا جلسہ غان۔ ہمو جہاز ء بال تننگ کیتے تفیسس نسیم ء۔ او بیوقوف آک نم آن خولک۔
en: Shoot Nur Khan, kill him! And that plane: to this day we haven't even seen Nur Khan with a bicycle, and they treat that plane as if it were for war! Nur Khan had bought a plastic plane at the Sibi fair. He had tied up that plane for Naseem to fly. Those fools are afraid of you.
en_old: They shot Noor Khan and brought him down. And that plane... to this day Noor Khan has only ever seen a bicycle, and they took that plane for something used in war. Noor Khan bought a plastic plane at the Sibi fair. He was flying it and gave it to Naseem. Those fools are afraid of you.

brh: دا نور ء صفا، اسہ پلاسٹکی جہاز اسے کے مخلوق ء خلیرے کزے فیرے، انت گتونو کارم کیرے خانہ خراباک، ایرا پیسہ کے اور دا قیمتیہ بندغاتے خلیرے کزے فیرے، باز افسوس بنے کیرے باز، باز شاباش ننے
en: This Nur is innocent! Over one plastic plane you shoot people and kill them. What rotten work you do, you home-wreckers! For two pennies you shoot and kill these precious people. It's a great shame, what you do, a great shame. Well done to us!
en_old: This Noor is innocent. You shoot people over a plastic plane and bring them down. What wicked things you do, you home-wreckers! For a couple of coins you shoot these precious people and bring them down. It's a great shame, a great shame. Well done to us!

brh: نی غلتی مس ننے معاف کرک۔ ئے دیر اون نومے معاف کروکا۔ اگر انوں کینے ٹھیکیدار نا جاگہ اسہ فیصلہ ئس تخنے۔ نور خان ہم بریک نسیم ہم خائفنے نم ہم ببو گڑا ہنت ہیت گپ ئس مس ٹھیکیدار نا جاگہ ہم بریک۔ ٹھیک ہی ادا ہنتس کے پاس ننے قبول ہی
en: You... it was a mistake; forgive us. Who am I to forgive you? If so, let's hold a settlement at the contractor's place. Nur Khan will come too, Naseem too, and you come as well; then whatever talk there is, it will come to the contractor's place too. Fine, brother, whatever he says, we accept.
en_old: You made a mistake, so forgive us. How long will you keep refusing to forgive? en: [unclear] my rooster came... cot... has hung [it] up... like that, freeloader(?)... the little child [unclear]... like that... [unclear] have come out... [unclear] the wall [unclear]... has hung [it] up on himself... [unclear] saw us.
en_old: Next to it... came... hung it up... like that, charity... the little child next to it... like that... came out... angrily, angrily... the wall... hung it up on himself... we saw...

brh: برو تتنا مچ نی پسٹ چمنی ٹی پیڈل ئس تموکے ئے نرس خیراتی سرکو کہ بروک تمنہ انونس نی انونس شوکی پلی پستہ پی ایس کے انونس امو پی نی ڈیوٹی خیراتی سے دا اینگو ما خدا خیر خیر ننا چے بروک چواڑا کل ننا تلن با
en: Come [unclear]... a pedal fell in the chimney... I, the nurse, freeloader(?)... that [unclear] come... [unclear] the PS [unclear]... on duty... freeloader(?)... this [unclear]... God, all is well, well... [unclear] all our [unclear].
en_old: Come... in the chimney a pedal fell... the nurse, charity... that they won't come... that one... the PS... that one on duty... charity... may God keep it well, well... comes... all our...

brh: نی تینا خنتے دراز نا تھلیامبارو ہمو کسے انن مرے کہ نی پاشے شلوار نا انجے پیش تمن نی تینا خنتے کھپو نا تھلیامبارو اینا استے گومے نی نرے توم مونی
en: You [unclear] your eyes [unclear]... let it be that same person... that you [unclear] the shalwar's [unclear] come out... you [unclear] your eyes [unclear]... today [unclear]... ahead.
en_old: Look with your eyes... let it be that person... that you... the shalwar... come out... look with your eyes... forward...

brh: انو سدے اسکولے ناٹ اسکولے ملاٹ جوان تو اسکول نا چنا ک نی بخیر کرے میر صاحب خبر اف کے اٹ وقتان اسکول بندے
en: Today [unclear] I [went to] the school, I opened the school. Good. So the school's children... welcome, Mir sahib. I don't know since when the school has been closed.
en_old: That day at the school... at the school... fine, the school's children... well done, Mir sahib, I don't know since when the school has been closed.

brh: او کسسے خبرا مف، آستہ آستہ کسے خبر تموئے تو برسہ کروڑ، باز مشکل ئے کہ کسس تینا چنا کے اسکول ا مونی تے، ہن تیمور صاحب۔
en: Oh, let nobody find out about it; gradually, once people come to know, then they will keep coming. It is very hard for anyone to send their children to school, right, Taimur sahib?
en_old: Don't let anyone know. If people slowly find out, word will spread. It's very hard for someone to send their child to school, go on, Taimur sahib.

brh: خواننگ تو اوفتہ حق ء، امر وکس مرزا صاحب چاو کہ نی دائے تے گرام کرینوس کہ چناتا ہنتک او
en: Studying is their right, after all. — How so? Mirza sahib, I know that you have been stirring these people up so that the children would go...
en_old: Getting an education is their right. How is it that Mirza sahib doesn't know you have warned these people about the children going...

brh: امان، داسہ نیکانی دا پوکیس کے دا علاقہ اٹ چنا تا انت کاکو؟ کنا خیال پائے کہ ماسٹر نیکانی تپیسے۔ انتئے کہ اسکول نا چپراسی کنے کلے تا دے پارینے۔ اگر کنے چاسنہ۔۔۔
en: Mercy! Now what is this [business] with the children in this area? My thinking is that the master [...]. Because the school's peon has told me all of it. If I had known...
en_old: Aman, now, what does this police do with the children in this area? I think the master doesn't know about it. Because the school peon told me everything. If they had known me...

brh: تو داڑے خالی کنا مارے خوانفوس۔ دا خلکٹی اسہ چنا اسکولہ بفرو ئے دا پومرک۔ اگر نما مار تون اوار دا خلکنا چار چنا پین علم نا روشنائی آن فائدہ ہرفیرہ تو گڑا داٹی انت فرق تمبک؟
en: So here you will teach only my son. Not a single child of this village will come to school, understand this. — If, along with your son, four more children of this village benefit from the light of knowledge, then what difference does that make?
en_old: So you've been teaching only my son here. Everyone knows no child from this village comes to school. If four more children from this village benefit from the light of knowledge along with your son, what difference does that make?

brh: ماسٹر ئے دے پاریٹ نا پین کسس اسکولہ بفروئے بس نم کنا مالخوانے فورے بس ٹھیک ہی میر صاحب
en: Master, I told you this, didn't I: nobody else will come to school; you just teach my son, that's all. — All right, Mir sahib.
en_old: I told the master that nobody else comes to school, so just teach my son, that's all. Okay, Mir sahib.

brh: اگر کس بتو تو ئے پدی کاوہ۔ ئے بیرن واچمنائے نما ہورا چفانی فنکی بفر اوٹ۔ انتئے کہ ئے اسکول
en: If no one comes, then I will go back. I [am not your] watchman [...]; I will not come over to you [...]. Because I [belong to] the school...
en_old: If no one comes, I'll go back. I'm the watchman... I came to you... because the school...

brh: کل نا ماسٹر اٹ، نا چنا نا ماسٹر افٹ۔ باز مہر کرے۔
en: I am everyone's teacher; I am not just your child's teacher. That's very kind of you.
en_old: You are everyone's teacher, not just my son's teacher. Please be very kind.

brh: ماسٹر اینا دے تے پسی اسے گھنٹہ اسے گھنٹہ ٹی اندنو سبق کتیس تے نی
en: Master, today, in one hour, in just one hour, you gave him such a lesson,
en_old: Teacher, these days in one hour you gave such lessons.

brh: کہ مچا سدھ یاد کروس۔ نا مصاحب نا گونزو نا۔ انتئے کہ محلہ والا ماسٹر نا الزام ء مخلوق نازیہ خلنگ ء۔ گلو کنے کس نا پرواہ اف۔ دا ماسٹر
en: that he has memorized all of it. — No, Mir sahib, no [...]. Because the people of the neighborhood are spreading accusations about the master among the people. — Well, I don't care about anyone. This master...
en_old: That I memorized all the lessons... the companion's... because the neighborhood people are blaming the teacher in front of everyone. Well, I don't care about anyone. This teacher...

brh: دا ہندنوں سبق اسے تنے کہ تنے مچہ سند یاد تکھے نو فکر کپہ میر صاحب دادے سبق تننگ کنا کام داسہ کنے اجازت ہی بس
en: It is such a lesson that he has kept all of it in memory. Don't worry, Mir sahib; teaching him lessons is my job. Now give me leave, that's all.
en_old: He gave such a lesson that you memorized all the lessons. Don't worry, Mir Sahib, teaching him is my job. Now please give me permission to leave.

brh: اسکول نا زرتخ پاو تانکے کسس تینا چنا کے اسکول آ متیفے ماسٹر تینین چک چک بوسرو تینا ڈھیے او دے شیو
en: [...] of the school, tell [...] whether anyone [sends] their children to school; the master himself [...] his own [...] that day [...]
en_old: Tell the school... did someone not send their child to school? The teacher himself... and that day...

brh: انتس کہ نما حکم ہمبو حق
en: Whatever your order is, that is right.
en_old: Whatever your command is, that is right.

brh: علم، روشنائی
en: Knowledge, light.
en_old: Knowledge, light.

brh: کنا مار نی
en: My son, you...
en_old: My son, you...

brh: دا کلم ء دا خاخرٹ انتئے سگورنگٹیس؟ ہائے! دا کلم اٹی باز بھلو طاقت اسے۔ او کلمار! دا کلم نا باز بھلو طاقت اسے۔ ئے دانا طاقت آن انتئے محروم اٹ؟ یا دا کلم
en: Why are you [doing this] to this pen in this fire? Ah! There is very great power in this pen. O pen-wielder! This pen has very great power. Why am I deprived of its power? Or this pen...
en_old: Why did you write this word on this paper? Oh! There is great power in this word. O writer! This word has great power. Why are you deprived of its power? Or this word...

brh: نصیب اٹ اف ننا گمار دنو ایچوئی تسفک ہر بندغ تینا نصیب ء تینٹ جوڑ کیک توما ئے ٹمٹ کور خائفٹ باوا چنا کیٹی کور خائفیکہ
en: It is not [written] in fate. Our [...] gives no such thing. Every person makes his own fate himself. [...] blind [...]; the father would [keep] the children blind.
en_old: It isn't written in fate. Our elders said that every person makes their own fate. ...called Tuma blind; the father called the child blind.

brh: ورنامس مونو پد مار انت داسہ لندن اینی ساکر اوئے کنا مار نی اینو دامر ہیت کننگا ٹیس او دا قلم نی دیر تسک دا سیٹھ نا امانت اسے
en: He has grown up... son, what now... London... — My son, why are you talking like this today? And who gave you this pen? This pen was entrusted to us by the Seth.
en_old: He has grown up... son, what now... London... My son, how are you talking today? And who gave you this pen? It belongs to the Seth; it was left in your care.

brh: راؤ کھنارتے ہمیر چمتے وتئے۔ میرو نی خواننگ نا شوق ارے؟ ہائے ادا نزان، ملنگ بابا مندا پائیک۔ بابا؟
en: [...] — Miro, are you keen on studying? — Oh, brother, I don't know; Malang Baba says so. — Baba?
en_old: ...Miro, do you like reading? Yes, I don't know, Malang Baba says so. Baba?

brh: بابا خیر دیر اسے؟ ارے اسے بندغ اسے کنا سنگت۔ بابا نا سنگت؟ دا نین پانے گٹ اسے؟ انتئے؟ ہن مس۔ اوہ بابا!
en: Baba, is everything all right? Who is it? — Oh, it's a man, a friend of mine. — Baba's friend? What does he tell you, is something wrong? Why? — Okay. — Oh, Baba!
en_old: Baba, is everything okay? Who is it? Oh, it's a person, my friend. Baba's friend? Did he tell you something? Why? Okay. Oh, Baba!

brh: باز جوان و بندہ اسے کنا است گیک ئے پورا دے اوت مریو باز جوان و جوان ایت گیک کنے نصیحت کیک کنے نیک دعا ایت کیک کنے پائ وقت ئے راغین جوان
en: He is a very good man; he [cares about] my heart; I'm with him all day. He speaks very good words, he gives me advice, he gives me good blessings, he tells me [...] time [...], good.
en_old: He's a very good person. My heart... he's with me all day. He's very good, he gives me advice, he prays for me, he tells me when it's time to pray. Good...

brh: بوتل ہمار بوتل داڑے بوتل ئس نم طرف تے وریتے ننتو نہ توار بنگم بسم گڑا دیر دریتے انت کسس بس داڑے اندا تو حیران اٹ کہ دیر بس دیر دریتے ضرور جن ئس مروئی
en: The bottle, that bottle! There was a bottle here. Did any of you take it? We neither heard a sound nor came over. Then who took it? What, did someone come here? That is exactly what surprises me: who came, who took it? It must have been a jinn.
en_old: The bottle, where's the bottle? There was a bottle here. Did you take it? We didn't hear any sound, so who took it? Did someone come here? That's what surprises me: who came, who took it? It must have been a jinn.

brh: ننہ کنا مسٹ خلیپنے ہن مس ہن مس بوتل در تے فوکس کے ہنت بوتل در تے فوکس کے دیر پر کرے ٹی
en: No, no, don't be afraid [...]. Okay, okay, focus on the bottles, just focus on the bottles. Who filled them?
en_old: Don't hit me... okay, okay, focus on the bottles, just focus on the bottles. Who filled them?

brh: اسے بوتلے پر کریٹ ایلو بوتلے کہ دوئی مریفٹ کہ بوتل غیب مسکے اوہو بابا کسے سرفو ایتا نم پریشان مفبو ایداسہ چوکیدار نا ریفو وا
en: I filled one bottle, and when I went to get the other bottle, the bottle had vanished. — Oho, Baba, someone [...]. Don't you worry; I'll ask the watchman now.
en_old: I filled one bottle, and when I went to get the other one, the bottle had disappeared. Oh Baba... don't worry, now the watchman will...

brh: چوکیدار! دادے چوکیدار بس۔ داڑے دیر
en: Watchman! Here, the watchman has come. Who's here?
en_old: Watchman! Here comes the watchman. Who's here?

brh: ئے دا بوتلے استے غو کسکا، دا دے نم تو ہرسرن رے، ہا ئے تو داڑے پتن اوٹ، جوان، تو برا دیر دیرتا
en: I [...] this bottle [...]. You were watching it today, weren't you? — Yes, I was right here. — Fine, then who took it?
en_old: You... this bottle... were you watching? Yes, I was sitting right here. Fine, then who took them?

brh: بس اب ہن پاو نی داڑے اکثر ہندن مریک اکثر ہندن مریک ہن مطلب
en: All right, now, yes, you tell me: does this often happen here? — It often happens like this. — Meaning?
en_old: That's it, now tell me: does this often happen here? Does it often happen like this? Meaning...

brh: مطلب دادے کہ داڑے ہر بندہ بسونے اوڑتون ہم بسونے ٹھیک ہی
en: Meaning that whoever has come here, the same has happened to him too, right?
en_old: Meaning that whoever came here came with him too, right?

brh: نومبر بابو سامبو
en: November, Babu Sambo.
en_old: November, Babu Sambo.

brh: السلام علیکم سر۔ وعلیکم السلام خیریت ئے نور اللہ۔ صحت ٹھیک ٹھاک؟ خیریت ئے ٹھیک ئے دعا ئے خیریت ئے نم جوڑ او؟ شکریہ اللہ نا۔ ادا کنے ماسٹر صاحب اراٹ تولو؟ ماسٹر صاحب سے دفتر اٹ تولو۔ مہربانی۔ مہربانی۔
en: Peace be upon you, sir. — And upon you be peace. Is all well, Noorullah? Is your health fine? — All is well, fine, thanks to your prayers, all is well. Are you well? — Thank God. — Brother, [tell] me, where does master sahib sit? — Master sahib is sitting in the office. — Thank you. Thank you.
en_old: Peace be upon you, sir. And upon you be peace. Is all well, Noorullah? Is your health good? All is well, fine, thanks to your prayers. Are you well? Thanks be to God. Where does master sahib stay? Master sahib sits in the office. Thank you. Thank you.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ ماسٹر صاحب نوم داری ئے تو غسل خانے ٹی ہفٹ۔ انسپکٹر نواز صاحب۔
en: Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace. — Master sahib, are you here? I was in the bathroom. — Inspector Nawaz sahib.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Master sahib, your name... isn't he in the bathroom? Inspector Nawaz sahib.

brh: جوڑ بخیر تکڑا ٹھیک ٹھاک؟ بس وشی مسنے توم ملنگ۔ سر نم داڑے امرے؟ بس ماسٹر صاحب ہمہ کین، سرکار نا ڈیوٹی ئے ہراڑے راہی کینین، ننے نوکری کروئی ئے واقعی تلبو۔ مہربانی۔
en: Are you well, in good health, strong, all fine? I'm just glad to meet you. Sir, how is it that you're here? Well, master sahib, it's just this: wherever the government sends us on duty, we have to do the job, really. Please sit. Thank you.
en_old: Are you well, strong, all good? I'm just happy we've met. Sir, how come you're here? Well, master sahib, it's the same for you: wherever the government sends us on duty, we have to go and do the job, really. Thank you.

brh: نم چاسے نا بندوبست کبو۔ ولے نی تینا بنف نی داڑے امر؟ کنا ہم نی امبار ٹرانسفر مس داڑے، باز جوان، کنے درو سما تما کہ اسکول ملنگانے۔
en: Make arrangements for some tea. But tell me about yourself, how is it you're here? I too got transferred here, just like you. Very good; I only found out yesterday that the school had been opened.
en_old: You arrange some tea. But tell me about yourself, how come you're here? I got transferred here too, just like you. Very good, I had no idea at all that the school had been opened.

brh: گڑاس چنا مشارنارے ئے پاو امو تیتے اسکولہ داخل کننگ کے۔ باز جوان کریس دا اسکول بند ئس کس ئس خوانے کے بتوکا۔ ماسٹر صاحب اسکول بند اسہ کے دا چنا تیکی باز باز
en: Let me tell the elders of some of the children to enroll them in the school. You did very well. This school was closed; nobody used to come to study. Master sahib, when the school was closed, for these children I was very, very...
en_old: Tell the parents of some of the children to enroll them in the school. You did very well. This school was closed, and nobody came to study. Master sahib, since the school was closed, these children were very, very

brh: پریشان اسوٹے، ولدا سا کنے نا بننگان کنا پریشانی مر مس۔ بس یار انت پاوے؟ دا جگہ نا دا اسکول نا حالت تے خنیوا، تو کنا کف مریک، چناتے خنیوا تو کنا لار کے۔
en: ...worried, but now, with your coming, my worry has gone away. Well, friend, what can I say? When I see the state of this school in this place, I seethe with anger, and when I see the children, my blood boils.
en_old: I was worried, but then when you came, my worry went away. Well, friend, what can I say? When I see the condition of this school in this place I feel choked up, and when I see the children my heart weeps.

brh: کہ انتئے دا جاگہ نا دا اسکول دا چناتے پد بٹوینو انتئے دن بننگ ٹی دا فتو انتئے دا چناتے روشنائی آن تارمہ ٹی
en: ...why has this school of this place left these children behind, why is it happening like this, why are they keeping these children from the light, in darkness...
en_old: Why has this school of this place left these children behind? Why does it happen like this to them? Why are these children kept in darkness, away from the light?

brh: دکت تینے گٹہ، ماسٹر صیب دا سکرے نم بسنو رے، ارا سٹ تینا چناتے روشنائی نا کسر آ ہتوئے، انتئے کہ علم اسے روشنائی اسے، علم آن بغیر تو تارمئے، بسنت پانے نست
en: ...(they are) pushing them. Master sahib, thank God you have come, someone who will bring the children onto the path of light, because knowledge is a light; without knowledge there is only darkness [unclear].
en_old: I took the beating myself. Master sahib, thank God you've come, someone who will put our children on the path of light, because knowledge is light, and without knowledge there is only darkness...

brh: بخش صاحب ئے بسٹ ہمو جوزٹ کہ دا اسکولے ملوا ملنگ تون میر صاحب نا بندغاک بسور کنے دکت تریسہ میر صاحب ئے پیش کریر
en: Bakhsh sahib, I came, and at the very moment I opened this school, as soon as it was opened, Mir sahib's men came, shoved me along, and brought me before Mir sahib.
en_old: When Bakhsh sahib came, as soon as I opened this school, Mir sahib's men came, beat me, and brought me before Mir sahib.

brh: ئے خوش مسٹ کہ میر صاحبے کاوا اور ماسٹرے پاو کہ اسکولے ملاچ تو میر صاحب خوش مروئی کنے شاباشی تروئی ہنراڑے او کنے دھمکی تس کہ نی واپس کنا ٹرانسفر کرے
en: ...I was happy, thinking that I would go to Mir sahib and tell him that I, the master, had opened the school, and Mir sahib would be pleased and would praise me. But there he threatened me: 'Get yourself transferred back.'
en_old: I was happy, thinking that Mir sahib would come and tell the master to open the school, that Mir sahib would be pleased and praise me. Instead, he threatened me and told me to get myself transferred back.

brh: داڑے چھندی ماسٹرک بسنو چھندی کنا واپس اینائو ایرا نوٹ تخرنتے انتئے دن مریک دا جاگہ نا چناتے تون
en: Many teachers have come here, and many have gone back [unclear]. Why does it happen like this to the children of this place?
en_old: Many teachers came here, and many were sent back. Why does it happen like this with the children of this place?

brh: اوفتے جند نا اولادک تو پیش خوانیرا ولے دا جگ نا چناتے او خوارہ بس ہمیش ہمیشہ کن دافتے غلام جوڑ مریرہ اوڑا
en: Their own children go on to study, but the children of this place, they just want them to be made his slaves forever and ever.
en_old: Their own children study and get ahead, but the children of this place they want to keep as their slaves forever.

brh: گڑا انچ کنے صفا صفا پارے کہ نی اسکول نا بلکہ کنا ارا نا ماسٹر جوڑ مریس۔ ہنداڑے کنا ارا ٹی بر کنا چنا تے خوانف۔ مبارک صفا اینکار کریرتہ۔ جی اسکول نا ماسٹرٹ۔
en: Then he told me quite plainly: 'Become not the school's teacher but rather my household's teacher. Come right here to my house and teach my children.' Mubarak flatly refused him: 'Sir, I am the school's teacher.'
en_old: Then he told me flat out: don't be the school's teacher, be my household's teacher instead. Come to my house and teach my children. Mubarak flatly refused. 'No, I am the school's teacher.'

brh: نا ورنا ماسٹر افٹ۔ بوڈا غصہ کرے انت۔ غصہ کروئی تو انت کروئی داڑان مستم شندی وار کن تو نندوم مسونٹ۔ خیر نیلے دا ہیتاتے نی تینا بندغ پین ہمروس۔
en: 'I'm not some young teacher of yours.' So the old man got angry, so what? If he gets angry, what can he do? I've been through this many times before. Anyway, leave these matters aside; you [unclear].
en_old: I'm not a new teacher. Did the old man get angry? What can his anger do? I've put up with it many times before. Anyway, forget all this and make your man understand.

brh: خیر ماسٹر صیب، داسہ نما کلاس ئے ولے فارغ مسس کنے آ تھانہ غا ضرور بریس۔ تھانہ غا؟ ہرا سے جرم نا سزا ٹی؟ ٹرانسفر مننگ نا جرم نا سزا ٹی۔
en: Anyway, master sahib, it's your class now, but once you're free, be sure to come to me at the police station. To the police station? As punishment for what crime? As punishment for the crime of getting transferred.
en_old: Well, master sahib, once your class is over, make sure you come to the police station. The police station? As punishment for what crime? As punishment for the crime of getting transferred here.

brh: تاکہ نا کریکٹر سرٹیفکیٹ جوڑ مرے
en: So that your character certificate can be made.
en_old: So that your character certificate gets issued.

brh: اسلام علیکم انسپکٹر صاحب۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ خیر ئے نم داڑے؟ ننا ہمیشے انسپکٹر صاحب ایننگ بننگ
en: Peace be upon you, Inspector sahib. And upon you be peace. Is everything all right, that you're here? Inspector sahib, we have always had our coming and going...
en_old: Peace be upon you, Inspector sahib. And upon you be peace. Is all well, what brings you here? Inspector sahib, we're always coming and going.

brh: نگانے اسکول ٹی ولے داسا کیرے نما بنی بند مسنے انتئے کہ ماسٹر صیب بسنے اسکول ملنگانے ہنو تینا میرے پابو بیٹھک بند مسنے تینا مہمان تے اموڑے جاؤ جاگہ آتے ولے میر صیب ی میر صیب ی پابو
en: ...in the school, but now your coming here has been stopped, because the master sahib has come and the school has been opened. Go tell your Mir that the guest house is closed; let him take his guests elsewhere, to other places. But Mir sahib... tell Mir sahib...
en_old: ...in the school, but now your business has stopped, because master sahib has come and opened the school. Go tell your Mir that the guest house is closed, and to take his guests somewhere else. But tell Mir sahib, tell Mir sahib...

brh: او انسپکٹر نواز ننے اسکولاں بند کرے نی بھلے انسپکٹر صیب نم تو میر نا غصہ جوان چارے۔ کنا خیال ئے نم انسپکٹر نوازی تپیرے ہر پاتنا گما بو۔ ہن۔
en: Oh, Inspector Nawaz would shut us out of the school? Fine, Inspector sahib, you know the Mir's anger well. I think you don't know Inspector Nawaz. [unclear] Get lost. Go.
en_old: Oh, Inspector Nawaz shut down the school on us. Go ahead. Inspector sahib, you know Mir's anger well. I think you understand, Inspector Nawaz, whatever I said. Go.

brh: بسوس خیرٹ
en: Welcome.
en_old: Welcome.

brh: جی او بسوٹ خیرے الینو باز مونجا مونجا خننگ انگاٹیوس ہا نہ دنو تو ہیچو ہیت ئس افک ہیت ئس تو ضرور ارے انتئے کہ دا کانی مون
en: Yes, I've come. Is everything all right? Today you're looking very, very sad. Oh no, it's nothing like that. There is something for sure, because this face of mine [unclear]...
en_old: Yes, he has come. Is everything okay? You're looking very sad today. Oh no, it's nothing like that. There is something, of course, because this is in front of me...

brh: سلام اینو دن منجہ خنتنوٹ بس ذراس دا میر جلال خان نا باروٹ سوچاٹے دا و دیر اسے دا علاقہ نا میر ء بختہ کنا وانت مستی او دے ہچ متنے ولے
en: Salam. I've never seen you as sad as today. It's just that I was thinking a little about this Mir Jalal Khan. He has been the Mir of this area for a long time [unclear]; nothing has happened to him, but...
en_old: Hello, why are you looking so sad today? I was just thinking a little about this Mir Jalal Khan. He has been the Mir of this area for a long time. What harm has he ever done me? He hasn't done anything to me, but...

brh: اونا دوان دا پورا علاقہ تارمٹی ئے انت مطلب ئے پومتوٹ کنا مطلب دادے کہ جند تے روشنائی ٹی رہنگک ولے دا پورا علاقہ ئے تارمہ نا گواچی کرینے دا ماسٹر بس اسکولے ملا ولے میر جلال خان نا بندہ غاک
en: ...because of him this whole area is in darkness. What do you mean? I didn't understand. I mean that they keep themselves in the light, but they have plunged this whole area into darkness. This master just opened the school, but Mir Jalal Khan's men...
en_old: Because of him this whole area is in darkness. What do you mean? I didn't understand. I mean that they themselves live in the light, but they have plunged this whole area into darkness. The teacher just reached the school, but Mir Jalal Khan's men...

brh: بس او کنے سکولے بند کنے۔ انتئے؟ مگر دا سکول نا خواجہ او دے۔ سکول سے سرکاری سکول سے اور کل خرچے تے سرکار برداشت کننگٹی۔ تو او دے انت تکلیف؟ تکلیف تو ارے تے بس او دا خواہی کہ او
en: ...just shut down the school on me. Why? But is he the owner of this school? It's a school, a government school, and the government is bearing all the expenses. So what problem does he have? Oh, he has a problem all right; he just wants that he...
en_old: He just wants to shut down the school for me. Why? But is he the owner of this school? It's a school, a government school, and the government is paying all the expenses. So what's his problem? Oh, he does have a problem. He just wants...

brh: ہفتے نا علاوہ کسس خوانندہ مف او دا خواہک کہ انت اثرات ایس مرے مچا ننگ کے مرے ایلو کل بیرے محتاج سلیر باز افسوز نا ہیت اسے تینٹ تو ہچ کننگ کپسا کم از کم ایلوک کہ اگر
en: ...apart from them, no one should become educated. He wants his influence to be over all of us, and everyone else to remain dependent on him. It's a matter of great regret. You yourself can't do anything about it, but at least the others, if...
en_old: Apart from that, he doesn't want anyone to get an education. He wants his influence to stay over all of us, and everyone else to stay dependent on him. It's a great shame. You can't do anything yourself, but at least the others, if...

brh: گڑاس کننگ خوارہ اوفتے تو الیر؟ دن مسکہ گڑا دا الک کنہ دال مسکہ باز مشکل اٹ اسہ ماسٹر ئس بس کہ دا اسکول اٹ ئے چناتے خوانفیو ولے او ہمودم نرفنگ خواری بس اللہ ہدایت کیتے۔ تانکہ ئے
en: ...want to do something, will they let them? That's how it is; would he let them, then? Now, with great difficulty, a teacher came to teach the children at this school, but he wants to drive him away right away. May God just guide him. Until...
en_old: If they want to do something, will he let them? That's how it is. He doesn't let them. Just now, with great difficulty, a teacher came to teach the children at this school, but he wants to drive him out right away. May God guide him. Until...

brh: داڑیکو کسے سے جرات مفروک او ماسٹر نا رفیق۔ نیلے دا ایتا تے اینو کن چا جوڑ کر تیو۔
en: No one around here would dare to be that teacher's friend. Leave these matters aside; make some tea for today.
en_old: Nobody around here has the courage to be the teacher's friend. Neelay, make tea for them today.

brh: جوان ہند
en: Good, like this.
en_old: Good place.

brh: ہندن، ہندن دا نک و دوک تفوک مرے ہندن تموک مرے تاکہ، تاکہ دا ہاکتنے، دا ہندن تفوک سلوک زلیخا، سیٹھ صاحب، بس ڈیٹھو بندغ اسے
en: Like this, like this: his legs and hands should be tied, he should be lying down like this, so that, so that he [unclear]. Let this one stay tied up like this. Zulekha, Seth sahib is just a shameless, stubborn man.
en_old: Like this, like this, his nose and hands should be tied, he should fall like this, so that, so that he dies. This Zulekha stays tied up like this. Seth Sahib is just a shameless man.

brh: بائے تینا نپت ئے ویخکونٹ اسل بائے تینا ملکت ہلو ہلی تا کہ بائے تینا ملپ آخر بائے تینا ملکتہ ہندارے تپوک مریٹ
en: Oh, my own [unclear]... never [unclear] one's own property... in the end, oh, I'm lying tied up right here on my own property.
en_old: Brother, I hung up my own rug. Brother, never [leave] your property... brother, in the end I'm left tied to my own property.

brh: تمبوک مڑی اوہو اینو پد تانا دیرم بندے ویرختم بندے سمجھارے میر صاحب
en: [unclear] Oho, from today on, consider his water cut off, consider his food cut off too, Mir sahib.
en_old: The tobacco is finished. Oh no, from today on, consider the water shut off, consider it closed off, Mir Sahib.

brh: ئے تپہ او دادے گولی ئس نا گواچی کیو نا خرونا دادے دن زو کسوئی افک دادے ہستے ہستے خوارا ہمباک کمزور کروئی ئے
en: ...[unclear] he would make him the target of a bullet, but no, he shouldn't be killed so quickly; he has to be made miserable and weakened slowly, slowly.
en_old: I know he'll have it shot, but no, we shouldn't do it to him so quickly. We have to weaken it slowly, slowly, like that.

brh: اندن دادے کمزور کروئی داکے بلا درخت دھکا کے پنی۔
en: That's how we have to weaken it; this big tree [won't come down] with a mere push.
en_old: We have to weaken it like this; this big tree won't fall just by pushing.

brh: او عباس ولیکہ کرا ہلمہ میس اسٹ تدا دے اسٹ تورانٹی ئے او ہمدا ڈمبار مروئی آخا او کنے ہمبارے کنے ہنسمائے دیر ہمبارے
en: O Abbas, [largely unintelligible: ... one ... one ... it is in the ..., and right here it must become ... me ... to me ... water ...]
en_old: Hey Abbas, come here, let's go. I have one thing, it's in a pot. It's going to be that same smoke. Oh, he... me... to me... [partly unintelligible]

brh: دانا مطلب ئے کہ کنا توغ راست مس۔ نا توغ تو راست مس ولے؟ ولے مئے ئے چمف تے نہ کولہ سلیس۔ علم داد دیر ہی دا زلی ہی واہ جان داد نمسڑے گڑا ماما مئے
en: That means my dream came true. — Your dream came true, then? — But ... [unclear]. Alam Dad, who is it? This is Zali! Wow, Jan Dad's daughter. Then, uncle, our ...
en_old: That means my dream came true. Your dream came true, but? But our eyes stayed... [unclear]. Alam Dad, here is this Zali, wow, Jan Dad's daughter. Then uncle, our...

brh: مٹل نا مسٹ دیرے جوان، گڑا دا ئے تپہ، ہاں؟ ہاو، ئے دا کندھاو کے نی پاریٹ، گڑا مٹلن پارے کہ؟ مٹلن پارے، او پارے کہ ئے سلو سوجس کیوہ، گڑا نو
en: Who is Mitthal's daughter? [She's] a good one. — So I don't know her, eh? — Yes, I told you this ... [unclear]. — Then what did Mitthal say? — Mitthal said... he said, 'I'll ask around a bit', and then, well...
en_old: Mitthal's daughter is very good. So you know this, huh? Yes. This is what you said about the shoulder. Then what did Mitthal say? Mitthal said... he said, 'I'll ask her.' Then...

brh: مے باوا، بلے پیرو نا مروئی انتئے؟ دا کے زولیکھا رے، لیکن او تے حسینہ تون برام کننگ خواہی سس، پیرو حسینہ تون برام کننگ خواہی، نی ہم تو سکینہ تون برام کننگ خواہی سس، مگر نا برام مس۔
en: But father, why should it be Piro's? This ... Zulekha ..., but he had wanted to marry Hasina. Piro wants to marry Hasina. You too had wanted to marry Sakina, but then you got married.
en_old: Our father, but why should it be Peeru's? This is Zulekha's, but he wanted to marry Haseena. Peeru wants to marry Haseena. You also wanted to marry Sakina, but you got married.

brh: ہو یار ئے او مٹر خان نا مندا ایتا تے کرے تو گڑا خان فاتحہ کا آخا نم دون کبو کلے والا کسء کبو پگہ کلنا اسد خان نا جوان خان جی
en: Yes, friend, he spoke [of it] in front of that Mittar Khan, and so then, Khan, do the fatiha ... you (all) do it like this ... [unclear] ... tomorrow ... Asad Khan's ... all right, Khan ji.
en_old: Yes, friend, he talked in front of Mitter Khan, and then Khan said to go for the fatiha... tomorrow... Asad Khan's good Khan ji.

brh: او غریب انت سوچنگ اٹی ئس
en: Oh, poor fellow, what are you thinking about?
en_old: What was that poor man thinking?

brh: ئے پاوہ ارا سوچ آٹی گمس؟ ہاو، ئے تو دا سوچنگٹی اسوٹ کہ دا مٹل تینا مسڑے
en: I say, what thoughts are you lost in? — Yes, I was just thinking that this Mitthal, his daughter...
en_old: Tell me, what thoughts are you lost in? Yes, I was just thinking that Mitthal's daughter...

brh: جمال خانے ایت کینہ نا؟ اسیت اسپو نی ہا ابا! اگر ئے سکینہ تو ایت کریٹ نی چس کہ دا کاری ماسس۔ ہا!
en: We'll speak [on behalf of] Jamal Khan, won't we? — Say a word then, yes, dear! — If I talk with Sakina, you'll see, this matter will be done. — Yes!
en_old: We'll talk to Jamal Khan, won't we? Yes, father! If it's Sakina, I'll talk to her. You'll see, this will get done. Yes!

brh: تو گڑا اورے سنتھ سکس نیکی نا کاریم ٹی بندہ بورے کپک فورا دا کاریم ئے کیک تو ایناخ نا ہننگ ء تو است نا نیمہ غا کا اورا غاتا ہنانا کنا مطلب دادے نا
en: So then ... [unclear] ... in a good deed a person doesn't delay; he does the work right away. So, as for your going today, go ... [unclear] ... to their house; that's what I mean.
en_old: So then, a person doesn't delay in doing a good deed. He does it right away. So go today, with your heart at ease, and come to their house. That's what I mean.

brh: سو بننگے۔ ہمم تنے۔ اسیتس پاو نی ہا پا۔ چنکا مار نا تو ماشاءاللہ جوان اسے نیکو مار اسے بو مار اسے باز لائقے۔
en: So, [unclear]. Hmm ... Say something, yes, say it. Your younger son, mashallah, is a fine one — a virtuous boy, a ... boy, very capable.
en_old: Come in. Hmm, go ahead. Tell me, yes, say it. The younger son, mashallah, is a good, virtuous boy, very capable.

brh: سدو خاص، ئے کہ ایلو چٹ نا دوس لالا۔ ہاؤ، ایلو چٹ ہمو گنوک آ پیروئے نانے۔ ہنت پاریس، پیرو نا پن ء الپیسہ، ہمے کہ نی بسنوس داخہ وخت آ۔
en: Especially Saddo — the one who is the other one's friend, brother? — Yes, the other one is that crazy Piro of yours. — What did you say? You won't even mention Piro's name, the one you have come for at this hour?
en_old: Saddo, especially, the other one... Yes, the other one is that crazy Piro's. What did you say, you don't know Piro's name? The one you came for at this hour.

brh: ہم پد ماتے تینا مار فیسیس اسدس نی کنا لائقہ زیبائنگا پیرو ء اینو میرو تو برابر کیسہ نہ نہ نہ نہ نہ کنا مطلب دا الوکہ او تو باز زیباؤ مار اسے ارتوماک باز زیباؤ باز لائقو عقل نا خواجہ
en: [unclear: then afterwards ... his own son ... Asad ...] Are you equating my capable, handsome Piro with Miro? — No, no, no, no, no, I didn't mean that; he is a very handsome boy; both boys are very handsome, very capable, masters of wisdom.
en_old: Then he went on to his son... Asad, are you comparing my capable, handsome Piro to Miro today? No, no, no, no, no, what I mean is that he's a very handsome boy, very handsome, very capable, a master of wisdom.

brh: او تو عقل نا خواجہ نی امر ئس او اگر کنے ٹی عقل مسکہ تو گڑا انت مطلب ئے نا؟ مطلب دادے کہ اگر کنے ٹی عقل مسکہ نا گڑا
en: He is a master of wisdom, and what about you? And if I had any sense, then what's your point? — The point is that if I had any sense, then...
en_old: Oh, so he's a master of wisdom, and what are you? If I had any sense, then what does that mean? It means that if I had any sense, then...

brh: ئے شار ئٹہ؟ او ہمیکو نشار ہم بسونس نی باز عقلنا ہیت کننگٹی ئس بس آتے گل بے بے دادے نا ہر کس کہ شار ء کائک نا او عقل نا خواجہ جوڑ
en: Is he in the city? He has also just come from the city. You are talking with great wisdom. — Enough now, Gul Bibi; it's like this: whoever goes to the city becomes a master of wisdom.
en_old: Is he from the city? He also came from the city recently. You're talking very wisely, Gul Bibi, that's the thing: whoever comes from the city becomes a master of wisdom.

brh: او غریبی تسو ہنے؟ آہا انتس؟ اگہ نن ایلم جانداد نا ارا غا کانہ پیرو کس انگبندی خوانتو گڑا مرے پیرو
en: Oh, poor thing, [unclear]? — Aha, what is it? — If we go to brother Jan Dad's house and ask for an engagement for Piro, then it can be Piro['s].
en_old: Did he give poverty? Aha, what? If we go to our brother's property and house, and if anyone wants an engagement for Piro, then let it be Piro.

brh: کسے انگ بندیکی کان آخر ہمو ماتونہ نا ماتونہ مسس اسر صبر کر جمال خان نا سنگ مرے ولدا اونا سنگ نا سوچنا اینے پاریٹ نی کہ
en: ... someone's engagement; after all, he too is your son. — Be patient a little; let Jamal Khan's engagement happen, then we'll think about his engagement. I told you that...
en_old: Someone's engagement... after all, they're the same mothers. Be patient, let Jamal Khan's marriage happen first, then we'll think about his marriage. What did you say?

brh: ئے سکینہ تو ہیت کریٹ نی چاس کہ دا سنگ مس بس نی پیرو نا غمے کو اور گل بے بے اگر دا سنگ بندی مس نہ تو گڑا نن جاندانہ وراغے کانہ
en: If I talk with Sakina, you'll see this engagement will be done. You just take on the worry about Piro. — And Gul Bibi, if this engagement happens, then we'll go to Jan Dad's house.
en_old: If it's Sakina, I'll talk to her. You'll see, this marriage will happen. You just worry about Piro and Gul Bibi. If this engagement happens, then we'll come into the property.

brh: ور تو ما ماتے سانگے اسے جگہ کرفین اوہ دا ہم جوانوں ہیت سے ہا انداسا ننے ما مسونے ئے زرس آرام کننگ خواوہ او
en: ... then we'll hold both sons' engagements in one place (together). — Oh, this is a good idea too. — Yes, like that. Now [unclear] ... I want to rest a little.
en_old: Then we'll get our son engaged in one place. That's also a good thing. Yes, like that. Now I want to rest a little.

brh: ارینین خاچی مارا کوٹہ ٹی تولے واک بریر واک خوس کنیر کے خاچی۔ آ جوان۔ ہی توبہ توبہ دا اینو پگا نا ورنائنگا ماتا حالت ء ننے ماما سونٹ دستار نا
en: Where are they? Asleep? Son, [they are] sitting in the room ... [unclear: let them come back ... sleep]. — Ah, good. — Oh, God forbid, God forbid! The state of today's young sons ... [unclear: ... us ... the turban (honor)].
en_old: Where are you? Go to sleep, son, sitting in the room. Come, go to bed and sleep. Ah, good. Oh, God forbid! The state of today's youth... they've brought shame on our turban.

brh: درخت آ فک خبر آ فراڈے پیری کننگٹی او اما اور واد ئس کانتو لوکے ہاؤ ابا نو
en: [Largely unclear: ... they ... the news ... fraud ... and Amma ... or a promise ...] Yes, dear, well.
en_old: On the tree... they're in fraud... Piro... and promise... Yes, father, no.

brh: لمہ، ئے رختونون تینا ایلم نا سنگت نا وراٹ ٹی کننگون۔ داسہ نن خاچنہ، کنے تو باز توغ ہلی ہاؤ، بارک اللہ۔ ٹھیک ہی
en: Mother, [we] were at [our] brother's friend's wedding procession. Now let's go to sleep; I'm very sleepy. — Yes, God bless you. All right.
en_old: Mother, they were at their brother's friend's wedding. Now let's sleep, I'm very sleepy. Yes, bless you. Okay.

brh: جمال کنا مات، جی لمہ، ابئی لم تیل دے خاچر کنے نی تو نیتس کرو یعنی بر داڑے سٹ
en: Jamal, my son. — Yes, mother. — [unclear: ... have gone to sleep]; I need to have a word with you. I mean, come here and sit.
en_old: Jamal, my son. Yes, mother. ...sleep for a few days. Do me a favor, come here and sit.

brh: است تسلی اٹ نیتو من ایت کروئی جمال خان کنا مار اندا خاطرہ تولے فیٹ نی کہ من ایت کروئی نیتو
en: I need to talk with you calmly, Jamal Khan, my son; that's why I told you to sit, because I need to talk with you.
en_old: Calm your heart, you need to talk to me. Jamal Khan, my son, sit here for this reason. You tell me, you need to talk to me.

brh: ئے بنگنوٹ کے نی حسینہ تو برام کننگ خواسہ؟ جی او اما، راست پاوس۔ نی ابا، اسل فکر کپہ، حسینہ نا لمہ سکینہ کنا ہندا نیڑکو، ہنتس کے پاو نا کپک۔
en: I've heard that you want to marry Hasina? — Yes, Amma, you're right. — Don't you worry at all, dear; Hasina's mother Sakina is close to me; whatever I say, she won't say no.
en_old: I've heard that you want to marry Hasina? Yes, mother, you're right. Father, don't worry at all. Hasina's mother Sakina is my own relative. Whatever I say, she won't refuse.

brh: چا اسکنا کاریم ئس مطلب اسے نا تو کنا سانگ مریک نی انتئے مفک لمہ نا زندہ ئے آخا او تو فوت کرے اللہ او دے بخشے
en: Look, it's a matter of mine — I mean, it's through you that my engagement will happen. Why wouldn't it? Mother ... is she alive? She passed away, may Allah forgive her.
en_old: Look, it's my business, meaning my marriage will happen. Why isn't mother alive... She passed away, may Allah forgive her.

brh: ئے ابا ئے تینا ہیتے کننگوٹ مگر نا لمہ فٹ۔ داڑیتو چشک صف اور نی باز عظیم ء نیاڑی اسوس۔ بس انت پاوا ابا، اسر دا پیرو نا باوے کہ کنا قدرے تپک۔
en: Oh dear, I was just saying my own piece, but I am not your mother. — There's no doubt about that here, and you have been a very great woman. — Well, what can I say, dear; this Piro's father is such that he doesn't value me.
en_old: Father, I was saying my own piece, but your mother... here... and you were a very great woman. What can I say, father, how is it that Piro's father doesn't value me.

brh: خیر داسا نم آ خوار نا او نا خیال تے تخرے نی تو اوار او اللہ زندگی تنے ابا پیر و بے وس تو سادے اگر نم کنا خیال تے تخرے تو یا اثرات مروٹ نما
en: Well, now it's up to you all: take care of him, [I'm] with you; may Allah grant him life. Father is old, helpless and simple. If you all take my feelings into account, then I will be [unclear] to you.
en_old: Well, now you're needed; take care of him. You're with him, may God give you life. Father is old and helpless. If you look after my wishes, it will have an effect on you.

brh: نی اسہ بے فکر مرو اما نن نا خیال ئے ابا غان ہم زیات تخون انشاء اللہ نی لتے نا ابا منے اسیت ئس پاو نی جی نی اسہ کاری مس کرک نی تینا ابا تو ہیت کر
en: You just be free of worry, Amma; we will take care of you even more than of father, God willing. [unclear: ... say a word to ... father ...] — Yes. — You do one thing: talk with your father.
en_old: Just don't worry, we'll look after you even more than your father does, God willing. Say something to your father... you do one thing: talk to your father.

brh: نی لوم پیرو نا سانگ بندی نا باراوٹی؟ ہند؟ پیرو تین کے مسڑس پٹانے؟ بس! پیرو ہم تو نا ایلم ئے نیکے مسڑ خوش کننگ کے سما گو کننگ کپک؟ داٹی تو چشک ئس اف۔
en: Mother, [have you heard] about Piro's engagement? — What? Has Piro found himself a girl? — That's it! Piro is your brother too; can't he choose a girl for you? There's no doubt about that.
en_old: Have you heard about Piro's engagement? Really? Piro found a girl for himself? Well! Piro is your brother too. Can't he do something to make you happy? There's no doubt about that.

brh: نی داسہ دا اسکول نا اسٹ خوانوک چناسے ئس ہنداخس ایلوفتا کے ہنداخس نا کے۔ ماسٹر صاحب ئے خواننگ کے وی انتئے خواننگ کے پیسہ؟ خواننگ نا حق کے۔ اونا دا کے۔
en: Now you are a student, a child of this school: as much as there is for the others, that much is for you. For the master sahib it is for studying... why money for studying? It is for the right to study. That is his [duty].
en_old: Now you are a student of this school; you have the same rights as the others. Why does the teacher get money for teaching? It's the right to education. That is his right.

brh: کسس پلنگک پک نی ہم خوانوس نی ہم اسئے بلو بندغس جوڑ مورس ہمسس جی ہاں برک برک شاباش
en: Someone [says]: surely you too will study, you too will become a great person... Yes, yes. Come, come, well done.
en_old: Someone is saying that surely you too will study, and you too will become a great man. Yes, yes, indeed, well done.

brh: انشاء اللہ خیر خنیس دا سودا آن کنا جواد خان اودیت نا دو سئی ئے پائدہ نی ٹھیک نن دا پانہ کہ بندہ علم آن ہرفک شریک شریک آن ہرفک علم علم آن ہرفک دا کاریم جوانی
en: God willing, you will see good from this deal, my Jawad Khan... his hand... profit. You are right. We say that a person gains from a brother, a partner gains from a partner, a brother gains from a brother. This work is good.
en_old: God willing, you will see good from this deal, my Jawad Khan, his hand... profit. You're right. We say that a person gains from knowledge, a partner gains from a partner, knowledge gains from knowledge. This work is good.

brh: ملک صاحب او علم سودا کرینے فائدہ کرینے اوٹی نسخہ کتی نی اوٹی
en: Malik sahib, that brother made a deal and made a profit; in it... you, in it.
en_old: Malik sahib, he traded in knowledge and made a profit, he... in it.

brh: نم خوش مبو، خوش و ہیت کبو، نما جوان و گپسے دا، اصیل و مس، فائدہ ئس خنانے کہ شریک نا حق ء ئیلومینا، ئیلومی فائدہ کرے ننے او جوان ء، اوڑکے او جوان ء، نما جوان و واپارس
en: Be happy, all of you, and speak happy words. This is a good word of yours; it was noble. He has seen a profit in this, that a partner's right is the right of brotherhood; brotherhood brought profit. It is good for us and it is good for him. Yours is a good business.
en_old: Be happy, speak happily, this is a good matter of yours, it was genuine. He saw the profit in giving the partner his right; giving brought profit. It's good for us, it's good for him. Yours is a good trade.

brh: جوان کرینے ایلوپ جوان کرینے واقعی نواب خان نی خیر خواہ او جوانوں بندغ اسیس جوانوں ہیت ئس کریس ایلم ایلمی تفک شریک شریکے کھٹیک تیک باز گچینوں ہیت ئس کریس نی
en: He did well, the other one also did well. Truly, Nawab Khan, you are a well-wisher and a good man. You said a good thing: a brother does not give to a brother, but a partner earns and gives to a partner. You said a very fine thing.
en_old: Well done, father, well done. Truly, Nawab Khan, you are a well-wisher and a good man. You said a good thing: knowledge doesn't run out by giving, and a partner earns through a partner. You said a very fine thing.

brh: نی جوانو ہیتس کریس، جوانو وپار ئس کرینوس۔ داٹی گڑے ملک حقے کہ خوش مرے۔ انتئے کہ جوانو سودا ئس کریس، گاڑی نما پنچ روپئی کھٹانے، او حالتاتے خنرے، گاڑی پدکارے، نی شاباسے نی جوانو
en: You said a good thing; you have done good business. So Malik has every right to be happy about it, because you made a good deal: the vehicle has earned you five rupees. Look at the circumstances: the vehicle falls behind. Well done to you, you are a good [man].
en_old: You said a good thing and made a good trade. So Malik has the right to be happy, because you made a good deal. The vehicle earned you five rupees; you see the circumstances, the vehicle... Well done, you are good...

brh: بھارے مسخرینس با، شریک شریک ء دستپک، نی شاباس ء کہ نی سچائیو گپہ کیسہ با، ننا حساب ٹی نی باز جوانو بندغ اسیس، دونو شریک دادا زمانہ ٹی کسے خنپنے، نواب خان، جوہر خان، گاڑی زو ہنبو
en: Well, you are quite the joker, man: 'a partner ... a partner'. Bravo to you, for you speak the truth, man. In our reckoning you are a very good man; one does not see such a partner in this day and age. Nawab Khan, Jauhar Khan, go to the car quickly.
en_old: Hey, you're quite a joker. Partner, partner, he says. Well done, you speak the truth. In our view you're a very good person; we haven't seen a partner like that in this day and age. Nawab Khan, Jauhar Khan, let's go quickly by car.

brh: دا گاڑی بخت اور اسس اینو اسکا خراب متو ننا استروٹی اسس دا خاطر پنچ کہ اگر پنچ لکھ فائدہ دہ لکھ فائدہ ننے اوڑان زیات دسونے پیسے چلو نی دا سودا کریس تو پرواہ سے افک۔ شاہ زیب نی انت سوڑیسے اینو ہمو کنے نوجوان کوٹ خستتو برک۔ جی او داسے
en: This vehicle was a lucky one; to this day it has never broken down. It was among our ...; that is why five: whether it is five lakh profit or ten lakh profit, it has brought us more money than that. Fine, you made this deal, so it does not matter. Shahzeb, what are you looking at? Today that young man did not bring me a watermelon. Come. - Yes, here he is now.
en_old: This car was lucky; it hasn't broken down to this day. It was among our horses, that's why, five. Even if it's a five-lakh profit or a ten-lakh profit, we've made more than that from it. Come on, if you've made this deal then it doesn't matter. Shahzeb, what are you looking at? Today that young man was supposed to bring me a rooster. Yes, here it is.

brh: شاہ زیب نی سیدھا ہن ہمیرے لالو نا دکان آن کنے کوٹخ ئس حل بہ پیسہ ئے تینٹ تیوتے پیسہ
en: Shahzeb, go straight to that Lalu's shop and buy me a watermelon; as for the money, I will give him the money myself.
en_old: Shahzeb, go straight to Lalu's shop and buy me a rooster. Take the money and pay it all yourself.

brh: سفت ء، نی چھٹا لوچی ٹی اڑپیسہ تے اینال بدل
en: [It's] firm... you ... in the small ...; change them now.
en_old: Praise be. You get caught on the sixth push; change it now.

brh: ئے نی پارے ٹن کاریم ہچ کر، نی داڑے بسوس بروس ریس تیسے۔ ایروم ارا دے اگنے کاریم کریس، گڑا ئے
en: I told you: do some work. You have come here, you keep coming ... It has been two days now; if you had worked, then I...
en_old: You said, don't do any work at all. You came here, you've been coming for two days now. Today it's two days; if you'd worked, then...

brh: ئے کارم کیوائے او بیوقوفی بھلا اوٹ ئے کہ کارم کیو نی امخلی مخپک چھوکا گر تو متوسو بھلا ایلو کارم کینتے ایلوم نی مارکانت مسگے گڑا ننم کارم کین نی ارے سونا ندامہ جال نی بھلا ایلو تباہ خلیس سے نی ہن
en: I am the one doing the work, and it is a great foolishness of mine that I do the work. You don't even laugh ... if it had been a small house ... the elder brother would do the work ... you became ... then we too will do the work. You, hey Sona, ... shame ... you have ruined the elder brother. You go.
en_old: He does work, and that's a big foolishness, that he works. You don't even laugh; if it hadn't been a small house... The big one does the other work. Now you've become Markant, so we do the work. You have... the shame... you've ruined the big one. You go.

brh: دا خدمت اف کہ بلا ایلم نا انتو قدر ئس نی انت چس قدری؟ اوس کنا پائے نا ہلو نا ایلم، لکھے نا پیری تے۔ لکھے کنا پیری تے سس، ئے تو کیو نی کہ گڑا دے گارم کیک۔ نی کونگا کشکو تو دے مست کیر، لیکن نی لو ایلم تورے
en: This is not service. What kind of respect is this for the elder brother? What do you know of respect? Yes, my father's ... brother, the elders ... I would do it, so that he then works by day. If you had ..., they would have ... by day, but you ... the brother.
en_old: This isn't service. What respect do you have for the elders? What value do you give them? Yes, my father's good elders, my respected forebears, my elders. I'll do that, so then he works by day. If you'd killed it, they'd have gone mad by day, but you kept the good elder.

brh: او تو چنا سے کنے کے کسے فیس بک نا کنے کاریم دے کک باز مغز کنا کپہ ہن کاریم کدا سا بغیر کاریمہ کرے نا کرے شکل کرے وڑپک ریمے وڑیک وڑیک نی دسا مچ ڈغار خنے نی دسا کنے کے کسے کٹیا کنے برینے زیادہ ہٹ کپا بو ہمبو داس کاریم
en: He is just a child. Someone on Facebook ... makes me work all day. Don't pester me so much. Go, do the work ... without work ... he made a face ... it doesn't please ... it pleases, it pleases ... you ... saw the whole land ... someone ... has come to me. Don't be so stubborn. Come on, go, work now.
en_old: He's a child. Someone on Facebook gives me work. My brain doesn't work much. Go, do the work. Without working... he made a face... You showed me, you saw the whole land. You showed me. Someone cut me... it's come to me. Don't hit too much. Let's go, such work.

brh: مارکو، دزگنہ بوزٹ او پکانک
en: Marko(?), ... thief ... face ... and they cook it(?).
en_old: Marko, the thief's goat, and they cook it.

brh: اڑے دا امر چناڑے امر کوٹھے غرفینوس؟ نا انتس چا امر کیففتے؟ امر وا کنا انتس؟
en: Hey, how did this kid... how have you picked up the watermelon? What's the matter with you, how ...? How ... what of mine?
en_old: Hey, how did this kid lift the rooster? What happened to you? How did he do them? How about mine?

brh: کنا علاقہ ٹی کوٹخہ خراب ارفینوس ولہ کنے پاسے نانتس ادا کنے ٹیم اف کنے الے کاو ایننگ گئیم نی تھوپا ہین بس کوٹخہ اتہ کنا اللہ کمک کوٹخہ نی اواتے کوٹخہ کنے الونو تے زکنا دنیا خن وئی کن تو دنو کوٹخہ اف کنے
en: In my area you have picked up a bad watermelon. But tell me, what's with you? I have no time here ... to go and bring ... you ... just bring the watermelon. My God, help... the watermelon ... you ... the watermelon for me ... my world ... see ... I have no watermelon like that.
en_old: In my area the roosters have been taken badly, but they tell me... There's no time for me here; for me to go and bring... Game. You just go. The roosters came. My God help me. The rooster... you them... the rooster for me... to show my world. There's no rooster like that for me.

brh: اڑے پوٹ نا دا ضرورت نستے سونا تو دونو تغیر و تغیر وت کیسی زو کے کوٹہ غا سونا نا کوٹہ رے بٹ۔ نتھو خنتینا کشک سونا۔ سونا ئے نی دا کوٹہ غا تے ننگا پارے۔ اڑے نی گنتے بٹ۔
en: Hey, there was no need for this ..., Sona; such changes and changes ... quickly ... the watermelon, Sona's watermelon ... dropped. Didn't you see? ... Sona. Sona, you said this about the watermelon... Hey, why did you throw it down?
en_old: Hey, there was no need for this... so such changes and changes... quickly onto the rooster... the rooster's... Didn't you see it? Kill it. You said this about the rooster. Hey, why did you...

brh: دا مکر اسکوٹر انتئے بٹیس؟ نی کہ کنا کوٹہ غا تفیسے، کوٹہ نا دوا ہننے۔ ارا گڑا کنے سونا ملتو، لیکن ئے لورا نصیب مفو۔ ئے دا سینی وٹ ناخیر مفرو۔ نی ہنے نڑے سونا۔
en: Why did you throw down this ... [watermelon]? You who ... my watermelon; the watermelon's ... is gone. Then I didn't get [it], Sona, but it was not in my fate. This ... will not end well. You go, Sona.
en_old: Why did you bring this scooter? When you threw it on my rooster, the rooster's medicine is gone. I didn't get two things, but I wasn't lucky. This won't end well. You go, the man...

brh: اڑے چنا نی داڑے مارا کیس ہنک ادا کٹہ غار پی
en: Hey kid, what are you doing here? Go... there's the watermelon ...
en_old: Hey kid, what are you doing here? Go, there's the rooster, take it.

brh: ادا کوٹک براہوئی نا فخر ء براہوئی نا شان ء
en: This watermelon is the pride of Brahui, the glory of Brahui.
en_old: This rooster is the pride of Brahui, the glory of Brahui.

brh: شاہ زیب جان، ہلو دوک نی خالی او، کوٹہ غا رادے، جرو خانی اینا ٹم ئے کلالو آن کوٹہ غا سلکوٹ، ادا کوٹہ غا تے ہلکوس، خانی
en: Shahzeb dear, hey, your hands are empty... the watermelon ... Jauhar Khan, today I bought the watermelon from Lalu; you took this watermelon, Khan.
en_old: Shahzeb dear, good, your hand is empty. Onto the rooster... Khani, at this time I took the rooster from Kalalu; you've taken this rooster, Khani.

brh: او باقاعدہ دے کوٹہ نواب خان ئے کوٹہ غے الکوٹہ مسٹ نا کسرٹ سونا کوٹہ غے الکوٹہ دا ڈغارٹی پرغاتی او نائے باٹی مشاخف او ہندکے خلک کوٹہ غے ڈغارٹی پرغا
en: He deliberately, in broad daylight, ... the watermelon. Nawab Khan, he took the watermelon on the mosque road, Sona; he took the watermelon and smashed it here on the ground ... and struck it like this, smashed the watermelon on the ground.
en_old: He properly took the rooster from Nawab Khan by day... he took the rooster... he slammed it on the ground, and... he struck it like this, slammed the rooster on the ground.

brh: نین اسٹو تے، تو کرے پارے کوٹر غا کنیتے کنے وتی، ئے کوٹر غا دتوٹ تو او خلق ڈغارٹی پرغاتے، شاہ زیب! او کوٹرے غے ڈغارٹی خلق پرغا، ئے اونا کاٹومے ڈغارٹی خلے و پرغیوہ۔ ملک صاحب!
en: ... then he said, 'Give me the watermelon.' I gave him the watermelon, and he struck it on the ground and smashed it. Shahzeb! He struck the watermelon on the ground and smashed it. I will strike his head on the ground and smash it. Malik sahib!
en_old: ...so he said, give me the rooster. I held the rooster, and he slammed it on the ground. Shahzeb! He slammed the rooster on the ground. I'll strike his head on the ground and slam him down. Malik Sahib!

brh: نی توس ئے داسہ کاوہ سونا نا دوا ء کیوہ بریوہ۔ زورا خان خیر اسے کوٹہ غا کاوہ بابائے خلسا پر وسہ ئے خدا کوٹہ غا پین کوٹہ غا زین نا مسئلہ پاو۔ ملک صاحب دا نی انت پاسہ چنا آن کوٹہ غا ہلکونے پر غانے نہ دا
en: You stay; I am going now, I will get Sona's medicine and come back. Zora Khan, is everything all right? I'm going ... the watermelon ... hitting father ... God ... the watermelon, another watermelon ... tell [me] the problem. Malik sahib, what are you saying about this? He took the watermelon from the child and smashed it, didn't he?
en_old: You stay; now I'll go and bring the medicine. Zora Khan, I hope all's well. I'll go to the rooster... hit father... God... on the rooster, tell another rooster about the saddle problem. Malik Sahib, what are you saying? He took the rooster from the kid and slammed it, didn't he?

brh: داسہ کانہ اونا کاٹو ء پرغنہ، بشہ جوڑہ کانہ یعنی؟ بشہ دا جوڑہ کا۔ ارے دا جوان مس درین پھپھو! کانہ نن داسہ، جوان۔ دافتے خدا ہدایت کے داسہ کار کوٹہ غی جنگل بشہ گیر
en: Now let's go and smash his head. Get up, shall we go together as a pair, I mean? Get up, go with this pair. Hey, this turned out well, auntie! Let's go now, fine. May God guide these people. Now the job ... the watermelon ... jungle ...
en_old: Now I'll slam his head down. Shall I set up the pair, I mean? Set up this pair. Hey, this turned out well, auntie! Now we... fine. May God guide them. Now the work... the rooster... let it go into the jungle.

brh: ارے دوک نوما خالی او کڈاس کاری کریر کتے ور ہنو بنئے ٹورے کاری مسو جوانو کرین
en: Hey, your hands are empty. They did a ... job ... went ... the job got done, we did well.
en_old: There are two empty names. They did some paperwork, they went to the side... the work got done, we did well.

brh: لیکن نصیب ہچس متو نی اڑے سونا داسا نصیب پورے کاٹمے نی واہ جوہرو واہ دا انت پاننگوس نی سونا ادون پاریس۔ اڑے سونا
en: But nothing came of fate. Hey Sona, now fate is fulfilled ... the head ... you. Wow, Jauhar, wow, what are you saying? Sona, you said that much. Hey Sona.
en_old: But fate gave nothing. Hey Sona, now fate is fulfilled... you've ruined me. Wow, Jauhar, wow, what are you saying? Sona, you said that much. Hey Sona.

brh: آ جورک نی کاٹومینے دا چھنان کٹخے پہلوانس ڈغارٹی خلکونس انت کے پرغانوستے نی ابا لٹم ٹماٹر مونی نی داسکان جورو جورو کیسہ جورک نی داسکان خبر اف نی سونا چاندی دویت کننگوس سونا چاندی تون
en: Hey Jauhar, you ... the head... You, a wrestler, have struck this child's watermelon to the ground! Why have you smashed it? You, man, ... tomatoes ... Until now you keep saying 'Jauhar, Jauhar'... Jauhar, you still have no idea; you are acquiring gold and silver with gold and silver.
en_old: Hey Jorak, you've ruined me! This boy, a wrestler, you knocked him to the ground. Why did you throw him? You, old man, tomatoes in front... until now you keep saying 'fine, fine.' Jorak, you still don't understand, you're mixing up gold and silver.

brh: ادا گل خان او پیندے اڑے است کنا پارے گٹٹ ہلت انن ساتھ پشتمے کنا است انن کے کے گٹٹ ہلت ساتھ کشی واہ رے واہ اڑے نی دا س
en: Brother Gul Khan and ... hey, my heart said: grab him by the throat ... my heart ... grab him by the throat and drag him ... wow, oh wow! Hey, you, this ...
en_old: Here, Gul Khan and... hey, my heart said... wow, wow, hey, you this...

brh: دا اندازہ خلک تک نا سے ئے دا خلک والا تا داغا خدمت کرے ہا ہا انے کنا حق جوڑ مپک کنا اسینہ کھجلی تو کنا برام بہ مرے ہا ہا انچئے کنا برام مرے اسینہ کھجلی
en: He guessed this ... I have done this much service for the people of this village, ha ha, so why don't I get my due? My chest itches, so let my wedding happen too, ha ha. Why should my wedding happen? Because my chest itches.
en_old: This is a guess... he served these people... ha ha, why don't I get my right? I have an itch, so let my wedding happen, ha ha. Why should my wedding happen? Because of an itch.

brh: ارے نی ہڈ پاہننگا تیوسٹ ئے نا استاد اٹ نا بلا مہمڑ مننگ کیپک ئے شاگرد اٹ نا اوار کنا برا ارے نی کیرے شاگرد اسو نی کنا اکتی دڑ
en: Hey, I would have broken your bones! I am your teacher; you can't become the elder ... am I your student? ... along with me ... Hey, you were a student, you ... my ...
en_old: Hey, you're going to break bones. You're the teacher, you can't be the big guest, you're the student. My brother is with me. Hey, you're a student, you're my...

brh: دستبردار مروک؟ ہاؤ، انتئے نی کنا آغا حق اٹی دستبردار مریس تو نی انت مروک؟ ارے دن مننگ کپک، ہمو مننگ کپک، ہمبس مننگ کپک کپک، ئے تے کنا حرفنتو، کنے ہچ نی تو
en: Withdraw? Yes — why, if you, sir, withdraw in my favor, what would become of you? Hey, that can't happen, that can't happen, it simply can't, can't! I ... my words ... nothing to me, you ...
en_old: Withdraw? Yes. If you withdraw from my agha's right, then what will you be? Hey, that can't be, that can't be, it just can't be. My words... nothing for me, you...

brh: گیپر مونا خسوتے دا اینو آن پڑھ کنا و نا استاد شاگردی ختم ارے اسے وار نا کروڑ وار ختم نا کسر دون کنا دون ہنا گنا کے کنا کسر دنے نا کسر دنے ئے تینکے
en: ... in front of me. From today on, the teacher–student bond between me and you is over. Hey, not once — ten million times over! Your road goes this way, mine that way ... my road is this one, your road is that one; I myself ...
en_old: Get out of my sight. From today on, the teacher-student relationship between you and me is over, not just once but a million times over... my path is mine, and your path is yours.

brh: ئے الگو ئس اوٹ لیس جوڑ کرو، او ئے ابا بسک کنا مسڑ خلق دا کمورے اینانو ظاہر ایرا مسدے ہم پد برے
en: I'm a separate one now, I'll make ... And then Dad came: my daughter ... the village, this ... Zahir ... even if it gets late, come back.
en_old: I'm a separate one, I'll make lace. And father comes: my daughter... this village is short of... it will show, even if you come back later.

brh: دا خا وخت آ پدی نامی۔ وعلیکم السلام، باز نظام، امر ئس خیریت؟ بر تول، تول، تول۔ انکل جمال نا افس بتوسس، خیر توس؟
en: After such a long time ... Wa alaikum salam, Nizam! How are you, is everything well? Come, sit, sit, sit. Had you gone to Uncle Jamal's office? Is everything all right?
en_old: Back at this time... Wa alaikum salam, Nizam, how are you, is everything all right? Come sit, sit, sit. You had gone to Uncle Jamal's office, is everything all right?

brh: نظام جان ئے خلک اینانو تینا زہیرے خلک دا کمو رے ایرا مسدے ہم پد برورے دم مف انکل کہ خلک اٹ تینا ماتہ برام کے کروئی ہند مطلب انکل کنے مچے شک کے شک نا ہیتے تے الے صاف ہیتس کرہ کہ انت
en: Nizam jan, I ... the family ... your own Zaheer ... the village, this ... even if it gets late, come back. — Don't worry, uncle; in the family one has to arrange one's own sons' weddings ... I mean, uncle, you suspect me completely! Drop this talk of suspicion and say something plainly — what is it?
en_old: Nizam jan, ...your Zuhair... come back even if it's late. Don't worry, uncle, I have to arrange my sister's wedding. I mean, uncle, you suspect me completely. Don't talk about suspicion, just tell me clearly what...

brh: او انکل! خلک نا مسنگ باز زیبا مریرہ، ننت خل، مگر کنا مسنگ نا کسر کم ئے انکل سنات نا مٹ تینٹ ئے ولے اونا قدر کس تپک، اگر نی پاسہ تو ئے خلکن کا احوال ایتو۔
en: Oh uncle! The girls of the village are very beautiful, ... but for me (other) girls matter little; uncle, Sana is one of a kind, but nobody knows her worth. If you say so, I'll send word to my family.
en_old: Oh uncle! Other people's homes are very beautiful, ... but mine is lacking, uncle; it's just like Sanat himself, yet no one values it. If you like, I'll tell you about the people.

brh: نا دنیا کے خلک اوار کک، نیم دے وا او خلک مریرہ او خلک والاتے مریرہ، تانکہ ایو خلک مریرہ او ٹورون کسر کے ہم خنانوٹ، ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی نیم تین تو اوار دے
en: The family brings your world together ... half a day ... they become family, they become the family's own, until ... they become family; and I have seen this road too. All right, all right ... half ... together ...
en_old: In your world people come together; half the day they are people again, ... until ... I have seen the way too. Okay, okay, ... together.

brh: تو انکل کڑہ ثناء اینتون دینہ؟ ثناء نا مرضی ئے ثناء برے تو بالکل دینہ تو، ہمو ثناء، نی بریس؟ ملازم این بابا، اینو چکرس خلنگ، ہو، خلکی تم فنینے۔ جوان ئے داسہ۔ ابا!
en: So uncle, then, will you give Sana to us? — It's up to Sana; if Sana is willing, then we'll certainly give her. Sana, will you come? — ... Baba, today (we're) going out for a drive. — Yes, ... — Fine, now. — Dad!
