en_old: So uncle, will you give Sana to us? It's up to Sana; if Sana agrees, we'll definitely give her. Sana, are you coming? ... Baba, we're going out for a stroll today. Yes, ... Good, now. Dad!

brh: داڑے تو کسر فا، صرف ئے و نی اون۔ تو برا۔ ابا، کنے نی تو نی نو اسہ ضروری ہیت ئس کروئی ئے اہو با داکو تو۔
en: There's no one here, it's only me and you. So come. — Dad, I need to have an important talk with you. — Oh, come here then.
en_old: There's no way here, only you and him. So come. Dad, I need to have an important talk with you, okay, wait.

brh: ابا ئے بنگنوٹ کہ کنا ارتوم ایلم تا سانگ و برامی نی کننگتوس ہاؤ کنا مار نا ارتوم ایلم تینکن تینٹ
en: Dad, I've heard that you did not arrange the engagements and weddings of both my brothers. — Yes, my son, your two brothers (arranged them) for themselves, on their own.
en_old: I told Dad that you couldn't arrange my two sisters' engagements and weddings; my son will take care of his two sisters himself.

brh: سانگ پٹانو مسٹ تے خوش کرینو اگر نی مسٹ ئس خوشی نا تو کنے پا نام سانگو برنگ پکاوا پا کنے مسٹ خوشی ولے کنے چرے پٹ
en: They found their own matches; they chose the girls they liked. If you like a girl, then tell me — I'll get your engagement settled. Tell me which girl you like, but don't ... me ...
en_old: Engagement... you made daughters happy; if you made a daughter happy, then tell me... tell me about a daughter's happiness, but don't ask me.

brh: او او کنا سادن گمار ئے ہم نی ہمبر پرنائی ٹی مسٹ ئس خوش کریٹ ہندن شرم کریٹ لکٹی کنا گل بے بے تما نا ابا
en: Oh, oh, my simple boy! I too, just like you, liked a girl in my youth, and I was just as shy. ... my Gul Bibi ... fell (to) your father.
en_old: Oh, my ... you too, in your youth, made a daughter happy, and likewise brought shame... my flower... father.

brh: ئے جوان و نیاڑی سے۔ اوہو او کنے سما ہی کہ اخہ جوان و نیاڑی سے۔ پومسوس نا؟ ولے نی تینا پا؟ اگر نی مسٹ ئس خوش ئے نا تو کنے پا ئے ضرور نا
en: She is a good woman. — Oho, I know what a good woman she is. Understood? But tell me about yourself. If you like a girl, then tell me; I will surely (arrange) yours.
en_old: She is a good woman. Oh, I know what a good woman she is. Did you understand? But what about you? If you made a daughter happy, then tell me, surely.

brh: سنگی کڑفیوا ابا اونا پن کے ارے نا ثناء ہی ابا ثناء ہی
en: ... Dad, her name is ... hey, it's Sana, Dad, it's Sana.
en_old: ... Dad, what's her name? It's Sana, Dad, Sana.

brh: دا سراوت دیر اسے ایلو ثنا انکل احسان نا مسڑ احسان نا مسڑ یات ونے تون برام کپروئے
en: This ... water ... the other Sana, Uncle Ehsan's daughter? Ehsan's daughter! Remember, you are not to marry her.
en_old: This is spring water; the other one, Sana, is Uncle Ehsan's daughter, Ehsan's daughter, remember; you must not marry her.

brh: انت؟ انت کپک؟ دا خاطر آن کہ او او کنا خیلے جمالے دوست کے۔ کنے نی نی ڈنکر؟
en: What? Why not? Because he, he ... likes my ... Jamal. — Do you take me for a dumb animal?
en_old: What? Why won't he? Because he loves my ... Jamal. Do you ... me?

brh: دا خلق اٹی مسٹ باز ئ لے ابا ثناء کنے دوست کیک کپک ئے ثناء ء دوست کیوہ بس ئ
en: There are many girls in this village, but Dad, whether Sana loves me or not, I love Sana, and that's that.
en_old: There are many daughters in this world, Dad. Whether Sana loves me or not, I love Sana, that's all.

brh: شپ مسنے دیرٹ دیرٹ ہن مسنے تاشا نسرین نسرین خنت مل ہن مس
en: Night has fallen, it has gotten very late ... Nasreen, Nasreen ...
en_old: It's become night, it's gotten very late... Tasha, Nasreen, Nasreen...

brh: باندا بٹو بسوکہ ایر کٹ کا دانہ ویمے نورا بش بش شاباش بش ما
en: Tomorrow ... came ... this is just your imagination. Noora, get up, get up, well done, stand up.
en_old: Tomorrow ... came ... put it down ... Nora, get up, get up, well done, get up.

brh: دا ننون داڑے ئے اوٹ دا مریم ئے دا شعیب ئے دا دے دا دے دا دے چے سو او چے سو اوخپت نن نا مون اسہ لوکن وڑک آخر انت مننگ ئے
en: This one is here with us; I am here; this is Maryam, this is Shoaib, this ..., this ..., this ... what ... what ... in front of us ... What on earth is happening?
en_old: This is here with us: this is Maryam, this is Shoaib, this day, this day... why do all these faces look strange to us? What on earth is happening?

brh: کنے پا ہا نہ نہ نہ نہ ئے تینٹ خناٹ تے ئے تینٹ خناٹ تے نہ نہ نہ نہ نہ نہ نسرین دانا ویمے ویمے نا ئے تینٹ خناٹ تے ئے تینٹ خناٹ تے
en: Tell me — no, no, no, no, I saw it myself, I saw it myself! No, no, no, no, no, no — Nasreen, this is your imagination, your imagination — I saw it myself, I saw it myself!
en_old: Tell me... no, no, no, I saw them myself, I saw them myself. No, no, no, no, no... Nasreen... I saw them myself, I saw them myself.

brh: چپ کر، ئے داسہ دن کیوہ، انسپکٹر صاحب ء فون کیوہ، بس؟ ٹھیک ہی نا؟ ہا، دا چنا تے۔ ابو کنے ہم پولیس ہرفنگٹی ء۔
en: Be quiet. I'll do this right now — I'll phone the inspector, okay? All right? Yes, these children... — Dad, are the police going to take me away too?
en_old: Be quiet, I'll do it right now, I'll call the inspector, okay? Fine? Yes, these kids. Dad is having me arrested by the police too.

brh: ئے پین کسس اف تاڑے کسس اف کسس اف او بابو فکر کپا بابو ئے پین جاگہ سے نا بندوبست کیوا نن کانہ میڑے رہنگینہ
en: There's no one else here, no one, no one. Oh dear, don't worry, dear, I'll arrange another place; we'll go and live there.
en_old: There's no one else here, no one, no one. Oh dear, don't worry, dear, I'll arrange another place; we'll go and live somewhere else.

brh: ہو، ببو، ببو، داڑے تولو، شاباش، آہور، میر تولو، شجاع تولو۔
en: Yes, come, come, sit here, well done; Ahwar, Mir, sit; Shuja, sit.
en_old: Yes, come, come, sit here, well done, Ahwar, Mir, sit down, Shuja, sit down.

brh: خیری انت سوچنگٹی ئس ہچ ہستو سوچنگٹی افٹ۔ وام بلو سوچ اسے ٹی گم ئس ئے دا سوچنگٹی اسوٹ کہ آخر کنے ٹی انت خرابی ء کہ یرا ڈی کاوے؟
en: Is everything all right? What are you thinking about? — Nothing, I'm not thinking about anything. — But you seem lost in some big thought. — I was thinking: what is wrong with me, after all, that every couple of days I have to move on?
en_old: Nothing, what would I be thinking, I'm not thinking anything. You seem lost in some big thought. I was thinking, what on earth is wrong with me that they keep transferring me?

brh: منہ وخت آن پد ہور وا ٹرانسفر انت نا ٹرانسفر مننگٹی؟ نئے دا سکات و متنے لیکن کنے ہندن لگنگٹی کہ دا جاگہ نا بندغاتے خوشہ فٹ آخر انت ئس کرینوس نی ئے ہچ ئس
en: After a little while, a transfer again? What, is your transfer happening? — No, this ... hasn't happened, but it feels to me that the people of this place are not happy (with me). What have you done, after all? — I, nothing ...
en_old: After a while, a transfer again? Why is the transfer happening? No, this is fine and all, but it seems to me the people of this place weren't happy. What did you do, after all? Nothing.

brh: کتنٹ، لیکن ننتس کہ کنا ڈیوٹی ئے ئے اود ایمانداری اٹ کننگٹیوٹ۔ اندا تو ایتے، نم مچٹ ئس تینا سختی تے کم کبو، مخلوق تینٹ نمے خوش مروئی ولے مخلوق ء خوش کننگ کن ئے تینا ڈیوٹی تو بے ایمانی کننگ کپرہ۔
en: I haven't (done anything), but the thing is that I do my duty there honestly. — That's just it: you should ease up on your strictness a little, and people would be happy with you on their own. — But I can't be dishonest in my duty just to please people.
en_old: I didn't, but I know that I was doing my duty there honestly. That's just it. You should ease your strictness a little, the people would be happy with you on their own. But I can't be dishonest in my duty just to please people.

brh: ولے مسڑ دیر اسے ایلم جانداد او نا مسڑ زلی پور کے پاوہ سانتا مارے خیر ورک ئس کیرے یہ با تو ریت کیوے انشاءاللہ او ابا زلدا کنا کاری مے گیرام کپیس
en: But who is the girl? Brother Jandad's, his daughter. I'm saying, get it finished quickly ... [unclear] ... for the son ... do something good, and I will carry out the custom, God willing. And father, then don't forget my task.
en_old: But the girl, a brother's... his daughter... I'm telling you, if you do a good deed, then I'll arrange the wedding, God willing. And father, quickly, don't forget my task.

brh: نی بالکل بے فکر مر، ئے دا ہیت آتے یات کینہ، اچھا۔ ہو جیا۔ او نی ولدا آرام کرک۔ جیا، پریشان کپہ۔ ولے کنا دا کاریمے گیرام کپیس۔ نہ نہ بالکل نہ۔
en: Don't worry at all, I'll remember these things, okay. Yes, sir. And you go and rest. Yes, don't worry. But don't forget this task of mine. No, no, not at all.
en_old: Don't worry at all, I'll remember these things, okay. Yes, sir. And you rest again. Yes, don't worry. But don't forget this task of mine. No, no, not at all.

brh: اللہ دے سپیرونہ باوہ دمبرینگا سو سمز توتنگا نینا کھو دروازہ بند کین تنوارا
en: God ... [unclear] ... father has got tired ... [unclear] ... let's close the door ... [unclear].
en_old: May God... father... close the door and call...

brh: باس سیاست نا خناٹ باس خناٹ
en: Enough, I've seen politics. Enough, I've seen it.
en_old: Boss, look at the politics, boss, look.

brh: ولے ولے دا نا ڈولو دا نا ڈولو اسل خنتوٹ توبہ توبہ توبہ توبہ توبہ
en: But, but something like this, something like this I have never seen at all. God forbid, God forbid, God forbid, God forbid, God forbid!
en_old: But, but look at the way it is, look at the way it is, I had never seen anything like it. God forbid, God forbid, God forbid, God forbid, God forbid.

brh: عجب و نیاریس، عجب و نیاریس، اسل بندغ پومفکت، توبہ، توبہ، توبہ
en: Strange and peculiar, strange and peculiar; a person can't make sense of it at all. God forbid, God forbid, God forbid!
en_old: Strange and unusual, strange and unusual, a person really can't make sense of it. God forbid, God forbid, God forbid.

brh: ئے بچٹ شیر خان نورا غنی نا ٹیپ او خیرٹ انتئے
en: Hey ... Sher Khan, Noora, Ghani's ... [unclear] ... oh, welcome, is all well? Why [have you come]?
en_old: Hey boy, Sher Khan, Noora, Ghani's tape... is everything all right? Why?

brh: ایستو تو پارے نی کہ شیخ خان اورا شیخ خان اورائنا تپہ تے اکھس؟ گڑا سلا ئے ہم برے ونی تو۔ آخا نی سلا خلخ نا نیاڑی تے تو کاس۔ ایدے
en: Last night you yourself said that ... Sheikh Khan's house, the ... of Sheikh Khan's household, did you ...? Then let someone come with you for consultation too. Oh, you go and consult with the women of the village. That one.
en_old: Isto said: did you see the ... of Sheikh Khan's house, Sheikh Khan's house? Then a weapon will come to you too. Oh, you killed the women of Khalakh with a weapon. Hey.

brh: خل کنا نیاڑی بس بخیر اٹ گل بے بے ٹول بخیر اٹ جان جوڑ اسے اللہ نا شکر ئے کنا ایلم نی جوڑ اسے جوڑ تکڑا خیر اٹ شکر ئے اللہ نا مہربانی ئے
en: Well, my wife is just fine. Gul Bibi, everyone is fine, in good health, thanks be to God. My brother, are you well? Well and strong, fine, thank God, it is God's kindness.
en_old: Khal, my wife is just fine, Gul Bibi, the whole household is fine and healthy, thank God. My brother, are you well? Well and strong, fine, thank God, it is God's grace.

brh: دا پکے شیر خان نا اوراٹی ئس ہرانگے نوئے، شار والا ضعیفہ غان تو دو تے تینا سلا، خیرٹ بس مروڑے کس۔ نہ نی خیرٹ اونا
en: This is surely in Sher Khan's house. Where is it ...? From the city man's wife ... your hands, your own counsel ... welcome, just ... someone ... No, you are welcome, his ...
en_old: This is surely in Sher Khan's house, where it is... from the old woman of the city, take your weapon in hand. Is everything all right? Just someone... No, are you... his well-being...

brh: امارفنگاٹیوس؟ بس ہندن دا خلق والاک پاریرہ کہ کانہہ ارائینا تا فاتحہ کن۔ ہم بس ہفت و بیست سال مست نا فاتحہ ادے نہ خنانے؟ ولدا ہم فاتحہ تو کروئی تمک۔ ہئو۔
en: What are you up to? Just, these village people are saying, let's go for the fatiha [prayers for the dead] of those people. But it's only a fatiha for twenty-seven years ago; hasn't that been taken care of? Still, the fatiha has to be done. Yes.
en_old: Why did you come? Well, the people of this village say let's go for the fatiha of those people. It's the fatiha for something from twenty-seven years ago, didn't you know? Still, the fatiha has to be done. Yes.

brh: ایم فاتحہ کبو متکننگا استنا ٹپاتے تازہ کبو۔ ننے ایم نی ابسوٹا؟ او بخیرت کنے ابسوسا
en: Go on, say the fatiha too, and freshen the old wounds of the heart. Have you come to us too? Oh, welcome, you've come to me.
en_old: We'll say the fatiha... reopen the wounds of the heart. Did you come to us? Oh, fine, you've come to me.

brh: دا دو برزا کننگ کے پین انت کے بس دو برزا کننگ انداڑے دوتے برزا کننگ کن دا پاہ دا جمال نیت نا مہر مسہ راست پاوا کنا کنڈ آن تو ہاوئے دانا بد
en: Raising these hands, what else does it do? Just raising hands. Raising the hands here for this ... this Jamal ... the kindness of intention ... To tell the truth, from my side it is yes; her [father] ...
en_old: Raising these hands, what else, just raising hands, raising the hands here, this side, this Jamal, the love of the intention... to tell the truth, from my side, yes, its bad...

brh: ئے نا کنڈا نا مہم وئی، ولے ئے نا باوہ پارے کہ ئے اسہ وار تینا الملٹ اتون سلاہ کیو ولدا اوکا پد جواب ایتیو۔ الے نی الملٹ او ایڑ ئے تو باوہ بس اوکا بو، اندنو جوانو مہم
en: From his side too it is yes, but her father said, 'I'll consult my brother Mithal once, and after that I'll give an answer.' Go, you tell brother Mithal and the sister: father should just say yes. Such a good ...
en_old: There was a proposal from your side, but your father said he would talk it over with your mother once and then give an answer. Your mother and sister... father just... such a good proposal.

brh: وار، خمپرو رے، ہو! اسل حسینہ نا قسمت ملنگک، اینا پا حسینہ راضی تھے، نٹکا وار ارفپتا، ہا، ئے تراستی، مرے داسا حسینہ اینانے زلی تو اور پچ سلنگ کے، برے گڑا ارفیس تا، ہا، جوان۔
en: ... a boy you won't find, yes! Truly, Hasina's luck is opening. Now tell me, is Hasina willing? ... you didn't take the turn. Ha, you got scared. Well, now Hasina ... [unclear] ... come on, then you'll take it. Ha, good.
en_old: Turn, Khampro..., yes! Hasina's luck has truly come through. Tell me, is Hasina agreed? ... didn't take the turn, ha, you got scared. Now Hasina will... quickly... come, then you took it, ha, good.

brh: میر جان؟ او ابا، اور دروازہ غا دیرے؟ او ابا
en: Mir Jan? Oh father, who is at the door? Oh father!
en_old: Mir Jan? Oh father, who's at the door? Oh father.

brh: ابا توس توس ننا توس توس بچا ننا ہمسایہ غا کو داکا با داکا توس توس
en: Father, a thief, a thief! Our ... a thief, a thief! Help! To our neighbour's ... come this way, this way! Thief, thief!
en_old: Father, run, run, our... run, boy, to our neighbor's... run, run.

brh: ہاں دوتے پورتا کبو فاتحہ اسکیں، ارے دا دو تیپپک فاتحہ کیرے تول نی تول بچہ تول، اوارائی کینہ، ہاؤ ہاؤ
en: Yes, raise your hands, let's say a fatiha. Hey, this one isn't raising his hands. Say the fatiha. Sit, you sit, child, sit, we'll do it together. Yes, yes.
en_old: Yes, raise your hands, let's say a Fatiha. Hey, these two... say the Fatiha. Sit, you sit, child, sit, we'll do it together. Yes, yes.

brh: کنا ئے کسک ارے با نہ تمنہ ئے نہ ہو نا ئے کسکونے کنا ئے کسک کسک ولدا کسک مخلوق راہی اسے وار کیر کنا ئے شیر خان اسے تسکے
en: Oh, mine has died! Hey ... no ... no, yes, yours has died. Mine died, died, died again. The people ... are sending [him] off at once ... my Sher Khan ...
en_old: I have heard something... no... I heard it, heard it, and then heard it again: people once... Sher Khan gave me one.

brh: ہاؤ یار ولے خیر انیتے کس؟ ہاؤ ہاؤ خیر انیتے کس۔ یارا اولی کوار دانہ بان خیر انیتے کس بننگا ٹیوٹ۔ بھئی آصف وار بنک انٹ پائے ولے کنے تولوک پکے دانہ بان۔
en: Yes, friend, but is everything all right? Yes, yes, is everything all right? Friend, for the first time ... is all well ... I was coming. Brother Asif says 'come', but I'm surely sitting right here.
en_old: Yes, friend, but is everything all right? Yes, yes, is everything all right? Friend, first tell me, is everything all right? I was coming. Brother Asif said come, but I'm sitting here firmly.

brh: خیر کرک تنے ایتے مٹھل جی جی جی خواجہ شیر خانی بنگلو ٹی نی تینا مار نا رشتہ مٹھل خان نا مسڑ تو کننگ خواسہ یار
en: All right ... Mithal ... will give you. Yes, yes, yes. Khwaja, at the Sher Khani bungalow, you want to arrange your son's match with Mithal Khan's daughter, friend?
en_old: May it be good, I'll give you Mithal. Yes, yes, yes. Khawaja, at Sher Khan's bungalow, you want to arrange your son's match with Mithal Khan's daughter, friend.

brh: گل جان دا ئے دا جاگہ ٹی کیننگ نا ئس شیر خان او دے اللہ جنت نصیب کے او مسکینے بیس سال مس اونا چہ اڈا کم ہش مس ہم بس ہنکرے
en: Gul Jan, this ... in this place ... Sher Khan, may God grant him paradise, the poor man. It has been twenty years; since then ... [unclear] ... and just like that.
en_old: Gul Jan, this is about staying in this place. Sher Khan, that day, may God grant him paradise, the poor man. It has been twenty years, and since then it has been over, it has ended.

brh: پیرو جی ابا اینا آئی تے نہ پا جوس چاس جوڑ کے آتے ابا آئی تو صبح مالو پیش تمانو راغان اینا نی آئی درجانستے آ آئی ماما گل خانستے آ آئی وس تے آ دم دم کبو ارتو ملم
en: Peero ji, father, today don't tell mother to make juice and tea for them. Father, mother went out of the house early this morning. Today your mother went to Darjan's, mother went to uncle Gul Khan's, mother went to ...'s. Rest a while, the two of us ... [unclear].
en_old: Peero ji, father, don't tell them. Make juice and tea for them. Father, she was here early this morning... she's at the Darjan family's, at uncle Gul Khan's... come and sit down for a while, the two of us.

brh: چا زوز جوڑ کبو اوہ با ننہ اینو تولبو تولبو کنے اورے مننگاٹی گڑا کنے اجازت ئے پچا ما کبو ودائبو ننہ شیر خان اینو کنے اورے مننگاٹی گڑا کنے موکل ئے ئے ہم کاوا
en: Make the tea quickly. Oh no, not today, sit, sit. I'm getting late, so give me permission; don't make tea, let me say goodbye. No, Sher Khan, I'm getting late today, so give me leave; I'll be going too.
en_old: Make tea quickly. Oh no, sit today, sit. I'm getting late, so give me permission. Don't make tea, let me go. Sher Khan, I'm getting late today, so give me leave too.

brh: آ کانہ گڑا ننے موکلے؟ آ جوان پین کاری مارے مگر مہربانی مہربانی آ جوان گڑا ننے اجازت تپے؟ آ نمام کاری او ننے کاری آ جوانی نمے کاری بر تھمبول جوان گڑا ئے توسوٹ ئے چاسوٹ
en: Ah, we're going then, will you give us leave? Ah, fine, you have other work. But thank you, thank you. Ah, fine, so won't you give us permission? Ah, you have work and we have work. Ah, fine ... [unclear] ... All right then, [count it as] I've sat and I've had tea.
en_old: Ah, so will you give us leave? Okay, fine, there's other work. But thank you, thank you. Okay, so won't you give us permission? Ah, our work... your work... come back, okay, so you had the tea.

brh: بس کن ایوے تینا یار تو شیر خان تو گپ مپ ہلی غڑا برے توممبو بچات کنتنے نا اسل دا کم پروئے امر گل جان او شارا تے باشو کیرو شیر خان نی سما ہی نی سما ہی کہ ننا سال
en: Just, I'll have a chat with my friend Sher Khan, then come back ... sit down ... [unclear] ... The real thing is this matter: how will Gul Jan and the city folk ...? Sher Khan, you know, you know that our year ...
en_old: Just talk with your friend Sher Khan and then come back... the real thing is this matter... how will Gul Jan and the city folk... Sher Khan, you know, you know that our year...

brh: کنا نام شیر خان کنا مار کسینہ رشتہ خوائنگے بوتو گل جان نا مونا عید کرے اگر دا عید مسونے گڑا باز مشکل ئے کہ عید ننا رشتہ نا باروٹ چٹک گڑا کنا خیال پائے کہ اگر شار والا مئے
en: My name is Sher Khan. My son ... to ask for someone's hand ... Gul Jan's ... ahead of Eid. If this Eid has already passed, then it will be very hard ... about our match at Eid ... So my thinking says that if the city folk's ...
en_old: My name is Sher Khan. My son went to ask for a girl's hand, and then he celebrated Eid in front of Gul Jan. If this Eid has happened, then it will be very hard, because Eid... about our match... so I think that if the city people...

brh: مطلب کہ خواری نی دے تو ایڑے خواری تمک کہ او ننا رشتہ نہ ایتر۔ ہن مطلب ننا رشتہ؟ مطلب دا کہ کنا رشتہ نہ ایتر۔ انتئے؟ ئے کسکوٹ مگر نا بئے اسیتو مرے انتئے؟ ئے کسکوٹ کہ نا
en: I mean, if you [tell] him, then there will be trouble there: they won't give us the match. Huh, what do you mean, our match? I mean this: they won't give me the match. Why? I'd die! But yours would be with someone else? Why? I'd die if your ...
en_old: I mean that if you cause trouble, then I'm afraid they won't give us the match. What do you mean, our match? I mean that they won't give me the match. Why? I heard that... but why? I heard that your...

brh: آئسٹ مرے بلہ ئے اوٹ کنا رشتنا اول ایٹ مرے اوہو چنکا ئے اوٹ کنا جوڑ مرے اوہو اوری نی پاننگاٹیٹ کہ بلہ ئے اوٹ اول کنا رشتنا ایٹ مرے پومسس نا تو مننگ کپک او کنا ایٹ مسنے انتئے مننگ کپک کنا
en: So be it: I'm the elder, my match should have priority. Oho, I'm the younger, so my match should be made? Oho, so you're saying that because I'm the elder my match should have priority? Understood? Yours can't happen first. And mine has become the priority? Why can't mine happen?
en_old: Let it be the elder one, she should be engaged to me first. Oh, the younger one should be matched with me. Oh, are you saying the elder one should be engaged to me first? You can't have her, she's become mine. Why can't she be mine?

brh: مریک امر مفک بس ساقی مریک تو کنا مریک او مست نت وادی نا کسر او کنا کسر دا آ بس اینک دیر تین استاد آخر دان پاریکے انے دیر
en: It will happen, how could it not? Just: if it works out with the beloved, she'll be mine, and if not, then it's his road and my road. That's it ... today ... late ... the teacher finally said ... [unclear].
en_old: It will happen, how could it not? If the saqi is there, then mine will happen too. He's drunk... the road to the valley, and my road... just today, late... in the end the teacher said, why are you late?

brh: آخر نم اٹ بندغ ارے کو؟ کسس بف کسرہ، ولے تینا کاریمے، تینا ڈیوٹیے ایمانداری اٹ کروئی ئے ہیلو
en: After all, you are human beings, aren't you? Even if no one comes your way [unclear], one still has to do one's work, one's duty, honestly. Hello?
en_old: After all, are you human or not? Nobody may listen, but one should do one's work, one's duty, honestly.

brh: جی وعلیکم السلام انسپکٹر صاحب ئس مسئلہ ئس جی انت مسئلے سے سر گھنے ہندون لگے کہ ننا دا ہرا کبینے انت مطلب مطلب دا کہ گھنا ہورائی ئے
en: Yes, wa alaikum assalam, Inspector sahib. A problem? Yes, what problem? Sir, it seems to me like this, that this [kabīne: unclear, possibly 'heavy'] of ours... what, I mean, I mean that there is a lot of delay [unclear].
en_old: Yes, wa alaikum assalam, Inspector sahib. Is there a problem? What problem? Sir, it seemed to me that our cabinet... what I mean is, there's a lot of commotion.

brh: اچو برکت کننگٹی اسہ وار اورتا اوہنگٹی پدا اورتا مہنگٹی ہچ کنا سمجھٹی بننگٹی اف کہ انت مننگٹی ماسٹر صاحب مننگٹی
en: She is acting strangely: one moment she is crying, then she is laughing. I can't understand at all what is happening, Master sahib, what is happening.
en_old: Just now we were celebrating, and once again they're leaving. I can't understand at all what is happening, Master sahib.

brh: کیک کنا خیال ئے کہ دا وار نما کوبینے نم دون کبو فین اوراس کے راٹ ایلبو ٹھیک ئے دا جوان او ہیت اسے سردار صاحب کنا چناک ہم خوفزدہ او ماسٹر صاحبہ کنا ضرورت ئے
en: [...] I think that this time you should handle this [heavy matter?] of yours like this, [unclear] let it go. All right, that's good, it's a [good] word. Sardar sahib, my children are frightened too, and Master sahib needs me.
en_old: I think this time you should do it like this for your cabinet, let the thing be. It's fine, that's a good thing, Sardar sahib. My children are scared too, and they need me, Master sahib.

brh: ئے بریوے، ننا سر سوبنا چکرس خلیرے تو، ٹھیک ئے ئے بریوے، جوان صاحب، باز مہربانی، اللہ حافظ، اللہ حافظ
en: I'll come. And you, come pay us a visit some morning, then. All right, I'll come. Good, sir, thank you very much. Goodbye, goodbye.
en_old: You'll come, you'll come over and visit us, right? Okay, you'll come. Fine, sir, thank you very much. Goodbye, goodbye.

brh: او شپک چپ نسرین نسرین آن مس وانت بس ہنتس خناسا
en: Oh, [unclear] quiet! Nasreen, Nasreen, what happened? What came over you? Did you just see something?
en_old: He went quiet at night... what happened to Nasreen? What came over her, did you see?

brh: ورک ہچ صف دارین ننون ہا دا دے را دے را ہمبو کمبو بسم اللہ کبو دے را ہمبو
en: [Garbled:] Come on, line up in a row with us, here, this way, this way, [unclear], say Bismillah and begin, this way [unclear].
en_old: Come on, line up in rows with us, come this way, this way, go, say Bismillah, go this way.

brh: دیرس؟ ایوٹیا ہنمسنے۔ رتھم بسس۔ یار کنے انو لگک نا تھباس خرابی ہن مس کنے۔ زرس تپ کنا خرابی کنا خیال پائے۔
en: Some water? [unclear] [Someone?] has come. Friend, it seems to me today that something has gone wrong with my health. A little fever, my illness, I think.
en_old: Some water? I'll go get it. Rhythm came. Friend, I feel like today something went wrong with me. A little fever, I think, is what's wrong with me.

brh: ماسٹر نی گڑا سپارے نی ماسٹر انت کنے ہن پائٹ؟ ملے کنے خبر افک نی کنے اینو جوان لگے ناٹیا فیس۔ نی خبر اف؟
en: Master, what are you saying, then? Master, why are you saying this to me? Well, I don't know; you look well to me today, [unclear]. Don't you know?
en_old: Master, what are you saying? Master, why are you saying that to me? I don't know, you looked good to me today, you look nice. Don't you know?

brh: ئے خر انتئے باور کپیسے؟ او چے؟ گر دے پبو۔ ننے کر غلہ تپہ زرس جوان۔ نی صاب نہ۔
en: Hey, you donkey, why don't you believe it? What, that? Then say [it]. [unclear] the fever is a little better. Not you, sahib.
en_old: Hey donkey, why don't you believe it? Who, him? Say it again. Do a little something for us, it's better. You're not a sahib.

brh: دا دے تسک۔ ہاؤ ہاؤ، کنے ت دا دے تے۔ بس نی دوں کر، نی چھاز بیٹھ کے ئے دونو ناٹ دوں بسٹوٹ۔
en: [He] gave this. Yes, yes, give this to me. Just do it like this; you sit down, I came like this [unclear].
en_old: Give me this. Yes, yes, give me this. Just do it like this; sit down here and I came like this.

brh: ہن بس ہن بس کنا یار ہن بس نی
en: Go, enough! Go, enough, my friend! Go, enough of you now!
en_old: Go, just go, my friend, just go, you.

brh: نی اڑے گنوک مسس، ہن بے بختی ئس امتحان اٹ تینا بچہ غا فیل مسٹ، میر صاحب ء فون کر، ننا واسطہ ئے تو تے
en: Hey, have you gone mad? Such bad luck: our own boy failed the exam. Phone Mir sahib; we have a connection with him.
en_old: Have you gone mad? Unfortunately, my son failed his exam. Call Mir sahib, we have connections with him.

brh: باز افسوس نی داسے اسٹ نیاڑی سے خولنگٹی ارے نم شرم بفک نمے یار
en: What a shame! You are afraid of a single woman like this? Aren't you ashamed, man?
en_old: What a shame, you're going around stealing from one woman like this. Aren't you ashamed, my friend?

brh: ہمر کین او میر صاحب میر صاحب باری اللہ خیر کے اللہ خیر کے
en: What shall we do, oh Mir sahib? Mir sahib, oh Lord God, may God keep us safe, may God keep us safe.
en_old: What do we do now, Mir sahib? Mir sahib, may God keep things well, may God keep things well.

brh: خلیفہ بو کچک کسے نا توار ئے چاوہ کہ کسس بسونے واللہ کچک وکھنگاٹیئے ہاؤ
en: Khalifa, oh! The dog... I can tell from the sound that someone has come. By God, the dog is barking, yes.
en_old: Khalifa, the dog knows someone's voice; someone has come. By God, the dog is barking, yes.

brh: نسرین ئے کاورے اوٹ۔ نانا نم ایم پبو نون تولبو۔ تسلی کبو۔ اریفے او برے اوٹ۔
en: Nasreen [unclear]. Nana, don't you go; sit with us. Be at ease. [unclear] she is coming [unclear].
en_old: They've brought Nasreen. Nana, you sit down with us. Calm down. Bring her, they've brought her.

brh: غریبہ بو کچک پین ایوان اسے خنانے اندا خاطرن ورکنگٹی ئے
en: Poor thing, oh! The dog has seen some other animal; that's why it's barking.
en_old: The poor dog has seen another animal, that's why it's barking.

brh: پیشن دیر اسکہ؟ کسلو، ایوانی، وکھنگٹی، پدا۔
en: Who was outside? No one; an animal. It's barking again.
en_old: Who's outside? Kaslo, Ewani, Wakhangti, then.

brh: چوکیدار ایماندار کنے۔ نی مہربانی کر تینا داڑے ٹرانسفر ء کرف۔ نچے انت انت پریشانی تیٹی اختہ مننگٹ۔ افوہ خوامخواہ تینے پریشان کیرے۔ بابا پوسکنو جاگہ سے۔ دنگا
en: The watchman, the honest one... me [unclear]. Please, get yourself transferred from here. We are getting caught up in all kinds of troubles. Oh, you are worrying yourselves for nothing. Baba, it's a new place. That's how it is.
en_old: The watchman is honest with me. Please get yourself transferred here. We are caught up in all sorts of troubles. Oh, you're worrying yourself for nothing. Baba, it's a new place. Like that.

brh: پریشانی تو کارہ بریرہ نا؟ تسلی کبو۔ نم داسہ آرام کبو، آرام کبو۔ قمبر شاہ، شعیب آرام اٹ خاچو۔
en: Troubles come and go, don't they? Take comfort. Now rest, all of you, rest. Qambar Shah, Shoaib, sleep peacefully.
en_old: Troubles come and go, don't they? Take comfort. Rest now, rest. Qambar Shah, Shoaib, sleep peacefully.

brh: سمچے پریشان پریشان خننگٹ۔ نا، دانا چوی تے سفت خیر، نا مرضی۔
en: Everyone looks very worried. Well, [unclear: something about his children's well-being], it's up to you.
en_old: Everyone looks so worried. Praise be to your children, as you wish.

brh: اماں بس کر کنے ہورے مانی کنے مار سکول نا چناک صاف ستھرا کاری کچٹنگا چناتے ماسٹر دوست تفک اماں ئے ہم خوانوہ ئے ہم ماسٹر ئس جوڑ مروہ او کنے مار اگہ نی ہندن ئس
en: Mother, that's enough, I'm getting late. My son, school children go neat and clean; the teacher doesn't like dirty children. Mother, I'll study too, I'll become a teacher too. Oh my son, if you [study] like that,
en_old: Mother, that's enough, look at me. My child, the school's children are clean and tidy; the teacher doesn't like untidy children. Mother, I will study too and become a teacher. Oh my son, if you do that,

brh: کنا بٹوانس تو نی اسیتس ضرور ماسٹرز جوڑ مریسے۔ اماں علم روشنائی ئے او؟ او کنا مار علم نی روشنائی نا کسر نشان ایتک۔ او اماں ملنگ بابا ہم ہندا پارے کہ۔
en: my [unclear], then you will surely become a teacher. Mother, is knowledge light? Yes, my son, knowledge shows you the path of light. Yes, Mother, Malang Baba said the same thing too.
en_old: if you study like that, you will surely become a teacher. Mother, is knowledge light? Yes, my son, knowledge shows you the path to light. Yes, Mother, Malang Baba said the same thing.

brh: حق راستی علم نا روشنائی۔ واہ ملنگ بابا، نی داسہ ملنگ بابا کنے ماسٹر نا سبق ء خلویئے، پمسسنے۔ شاباش وری مسنے، سیدھا سکول آ کاسو۔
en: Truth, honesty, the light of knowledge. Wow, Malang Baba! Now, Malang Baba, you [are teaching] me the teacher's lesson [unclear]. Well done; it's gotten late, go straight to school.
en_old: Truth, honesty, the light of knowledge. Wow, Malang Baba, now Malang Baba has taught me the teacher's lesson, you understood. Well done, you're late, go straight to school.

brh: جوان خدا کنا مار اللہ سرسوب کینے او بختاور دادا سانتس خوانو تورینتاس
en: Good! My God, my son, may God make you successful, oh fortunate one. [unclear: something about grandfather/elder and studying].
en_old: Good, by God, my son, may God make you successful, oh fortunate one; grandfather made him study.

brh: خواجہ کہ دا مچ آ زئی نیمہ غا شوانز جوڑ مرے کنا مطلب دا افک کنا مطلب دادے کہ نن دادے امر خوانفوں دا سکل گڑاتے ماسٹر صاحب تینٹ کننگٹی ئے مونی گڑوری نا کانے جوان
en: Sir, [do you mean] that he should become a shepherd halfway up on this [unclear]? That's not what I mean; what I mean is how we should educate him. Master sahib is doing all these things himself. Going forward [unclear], good.
en_old: He wants him to become something at this gathering. I don't mean that; what I mean is how we should educate him. The teacher himself is doing all these things, from now on, good.

brh: ہمکے نامرض چاس اتکنے جیو شاباش بچہ ایمبو گلاس ٹی آجو شاباش آجو
en: [unclear: something about your illness]. Bravo, well done, kid! Go on into the class, come on, well done, come on.
en_old: Whoever was sick has come. Bravo, well done, child. Now free in the glass, well done, free.

brh: میر محمد بسس؟ جی ابا
en: Mir Muhammad, have you come? Yes, Father.
en_old: Has Mir Muhammad come? Yes, Father.

brh: سر ماسٹر صیب، السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ نی دا رنج اٹ تے شامل مسوس؟ ماسٹر صیب! کنے ہچ تفک، کنا ولے کجی اینو مہربامد۔
en: Sir, Master sahib, assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Have you joined in this grief? Master sahib! Nothing's wrong with me, but my [unclear] today [was kind?].
en_old: Sir, Master sahib, peace be upon you. And peace be upon you. Have you joined in this grief? Master sahib! I don't have anything, but my... today, please be kind.

brh: نا ادا مجال اڑے چاندی مونی نی خدا خلنے دا چنائے انتئے خلکونس اڑے کوٹغے دا خلکونس نی ڈغارٹی پرغانس اڑے نی تینا خواجہ تو بھلا جورک تو ہیت کیسہ دونو یار پنی سونا
en: How dare you, here! Hey, the silver is right in front of you! God strike you, why have you beaten this child? Hey, you watermelon, you've beaten this one, you've smashed him onto the ground. Hey, is that how you talk to your own master, the big Jorak? Friend, its name is Sona (gold)...
en_old: How dare you here! Hey, silver in front of you... God strike you, why did you hit this child? Hey Kotagh, you hit him, you threw him to the ground. Hey, your master is the big Jorak and you talk like that, my friend? Sona's name...

brh: ہائے پر خمپیسے نی پیتل ئس دان پاننگ ارے سونا ئس پاریس پیتل ئس ہم خمپیسے دان پاننگ ارے نی کنا تو سمجھٹ ہچ بننگ اف کنا خیال ئے نی دھک نا پھیرستے گڑا نا سمجھٹ ئے تولک جورو نی خبر اف
en: Oh, but you can't tell: this is what brass is called. Hey, you called it gold; you can't even tell brass, this is what it's called. Nothing I say gets through to you at all. I think the blow has made your head spin; then it will settle into your understanding. Joro, you don't know.
en_old: Oh, but you don't know, a piece of brass is called this. You said gold, you don't even know what brass is called. I don't understand you at all. I think those blows knocked you senseless, then your mind will settle. Jorak, you don't know.

brh: فوک سونانا بلا علم سلو کے اونا مونا نکنا دھکنا پیری استے سے جو رک ئے تیدے لغت منٹ دا بھلو ہیت کرے گھٹی سے سئی پاسہ نواب خان داسا ہورس نوابیو دھکے تے وتے ہیت کر
en: ...of the gold (Sona), without knowledge, standing in front of him, he got the spin of our blows... Jorak, give him a kick, he has made this big claim... say it properly. Nawab Khan, now look, with nawab-style blows... then talk.
en_old: Gold's worth... without knowledge... in front of him, from our blows... Jorak, cursed one, just now he said a big thing... Nawab Khan, now some nawab-style... blows... talk.

brh: او پپا، خلت بوریفتے ناڑی دا انت پاننگورے، کنے خلیر موریفیرے، ہاؤ پریک ہاؤ، نی خلیوے
en: Oh papa, they beat him and... what are you saying? They beat me and... yes, he says yes, you'll hit me.
en_old: Oh papa, they beat and... what are you saying? They hit me and broke me. Yes, they break, yes, you hit.

brh: نورک ہمبلے دے ٹمسال کریس مرے ئے تو دے پانے کے اسلوئی افا دا سکان ارادے تاسے مچے خلکرتے ایلو مچے خلکرتے چلتنا چوٹیا
en: Nurak, that day, friend, you made a show... if it happens, I'll tell him that it isn't real... until now the intention... they beat them all, they beat all the others, up to the peak of Chiltan.
en_old: Norak, if you've... the day, then say that... until now, intentions... they hit all of them, they hit all the others, on the peak of Chiltan.

brh: خاک تمک، دونگا پیز، چلتنا سر کا پیز کنا ولا دڑنگا پارے، خاک نی ترپست منینٹو، شیف دڑے گماکی، اسٹ سپین تیونی، وا سوفنا چوٹی اینوس، دعا کبو کہ اناڑے مرے، آگے دڑنگاٹ
en: Dust falls... climb to the top of Chiltan... my... said to go down; the dust... you...; he went down and got lost; one white...; today the peak of ...; pray (all of you) that it happens there; I went down ahead.
en_old: Dust falls... the top of Chiltan... my... said, you... dust... go down... one white..., and the peak of... pray that it is there, I'm going ahead...

brh: نما خیر مفروئے، شوکے کے دیر درے کپائے آسمان فاشے، نیتو ہمو کسے، صفا نی ہمو شوکنا ہاڑی اسوس، ئے شوکنا ہاڑی اسہ فرسٹ، ئے سیرنا ہاڑی اسوٹ، بس اسہ ایمبو خلے وکے او نمس ذلیل، خاچ خاچ دا
en: May no good come to you! The fox who... water... the sky will expose him. You're that very same one; you were exactly that fox's servant. I was the fox's servant first, I was the lion's servant. Just one... he hit and humiliated you... sleep, sleep, this...
en_old: Damn you... the sky... you're that same one, you were exactly that Shok's servant. I was Shok's first servant, I was the master's servant. Just one... and he humiliated you, beat you and beat you.

brh: دا پردہ ماموڑے وا کھڈ کے ونے ڈغارٹی درخت نا ٹونگ کاٹو دس کا دا ہیت کنے آن تمیپیسے اڑے چھنا ئے تو با خلنگ آن سلیسونو لیکن نما با سلیپک آ جوانی کہ درخت نا ٹونگ کاٹو چک شیف مروسے نی بہن بھلو ہیت کریسے سازے بس جوانی نما نا
en: This curtain... dig a pit in the ground... the tree's hollow... I won't let this matter slip past me. Hey boy, I've stopped running my mouth, but yours won't stop. It's a good thing the hollow of the tree was cut and came down. You made a very big claim... well, good for you.
en_old: This curtain... and dig a pit in the ground, cut the tree trunk... this matter slipped from me. Hey boy, you were saved from father's beating, but your father won't be saved. Good thing the tree trunk was cut and fell down. You made a really big claim, just good for you.

brh: او دے کسارے ال بوئم بو، نت او کوٹھا غا ولے کرونوم تو نو۔ چاسے جک خلپ، زو کا کوٹھا نا پیساتے کش۔ نوکر خان، نی چپ و ڈکانو سے نی گڑا زیب نارے تو کش ایتے تا۔ کنا جان ئے خلاص کرک۔ تافو خوش۔
en: That day... leave the road... the foot... to the room... You know, don't talk nonsense; quickly go and take the money out of the room. Naukar Khan, you've kept quiet and hidden it; so if it's in your pocket, take it out and give it to them. Get me off the hook. ...happy.
en_old: That day... feet on the roof... you know, hurry, take out the money from the house. Naukar Khan, you're quiet and hidden. If you have something in your pocket, take it out and give it. Save my life. Be happy.

brh: عشق نی ولا پر کے وتی وی ایلم ایلم کے نقصان تفاق پین دیرے تیک ارے خو بیٹی نی پاریٹ کے نی کارف کرک اینا زر گنجی ٹی گوری بٹ کے انتہ کارف کتویس کارم ہم کپیسے ولا غلطو کارم کیسی او ایلم نوکر خان
en: Love... brother, brother... harm... I told you to work: today haul sacks at the market for money. Why didn't you work? You don't do any work either, and then you do the wrong kind of work, O brother Naukar Khan.
en_old: Love... brother, brother... harm... I told you to work and put a little into the savings. Why didn't you work? You don't work, and then you do wrong work, oh brother Naukar Khan.

brh: کنے خیال ئس ارے کہ ئے گونی بٹکے وک۔ گونی کہ بٹکنے کپیسہ گڑا مخل نا تہ کوٹی وت پھرسے، بے شرم بفک ئے داسہ تولیف چٹھی پر کیو نیکی۔ چٹھی تو نی پر کروئی تمک انتئے کہ ئے نا ایلوموٹ۔ او نا پیسہ کن تف ئے نیکی کرے ہت۔
en: I have an idea that I'll haul sacks. If you won't haul sacks, then inside the room you'll... Shameless, it won't come. Now I'll sit you down and fill in the letter, a good deed. You'll have to fill in the letter, because I'm your brother. For his money... I did a good deed, bring it.
en_old: I have an idea that I'll... the sack. If you don't... the sack, then inside the house you... Shameless, now sit down, fill out the letter, do a good deed. You have to fill out the letter because I'm your brother. For his money... do a good deed.

brh: سٹم چھٹی پور کے وتو نی چاس نا کاریم چائے ئس کنا تو پائے اسوار الیب نی دکھنا پھیری اسیتو ئس کنا تو پائے سرینا کشیو بس بلائیلموس ادا ننا مغزے کمپبو ننا پیسہ تیتبو کوٹہ غا نن کانہ گڑا نم ایلمورے
en: ...finish the leave... you know your own work... say it with me... you're in a round of misery... say it with me, take it out from your waistband... just... Here, don't eat our brains; give us our money; we're going home, and then you're still our brothers.
en_old: ...you know your work... you were... just brothers. Here, don't mess with our heads, give us our money. At home... then you're brothers.

brh: ادا ئنا دے ایلمی منت کننگٹ پیسہ تننگ اف نوم پو کبو مچ سمجھائبو تے ادا اگر ایلم نی پیسہ تفک نی گڑا پھگہ پیڑیا ضرور بریس جورو دان پو
en: Here it's all brotherly pleading, no handing over of money. You (all) make him understand, explain it all to him. Here, brother, if you don't give the money, then tomorrow you'll definitely end up at the market. Joro, understand this.
en_old: Here, the day is about brotherhood and pleading, not about giving money... explain it all to them. Here, if you don't give the money, brother, then you'll definitely end up at the market.

brh: خرنگوسک، پکے پیڑیا وان تاکہ بریوک، بارامو نی پیڑیا پھگے، چھوٹا دے نی لیلام کینے سودا کینے، کوٹنا رقمے کشینے، دھکستینے گدریفینے، پینمر کینے نی جیڑا روت تیڑا ختمہ، تینا رقمے وصول کینے
en: You'll be walked off tomorrow to the market so that I come... you to the market tomorrow; we'll auction your small things, we'll sell them, we'll take out the money from the room, we'll... get by...; your quarrel... bread... finished; we'll collect our own amount.
en_old: Rabbits... go to the market so that you come... you'll go to the market. On a small day you'll auction, you'll sell, you'll take out the house's money... get by... the bread will run out, you'll recover your money.

brh: اللہ اللہ خیر سلا، جوڑو نم انت خیلے، ولدا ئے ڈغار شپاد چرینگم، کنا دو کڑو خانہ خراب مریک، نا ہر کنا گنو، ہننو کاریم کیس، ضرور شپاد چرینگسہ، ادا نی جوڑ
en: Allah, Allah, all's well... Joro, what are you (all) doing? I'll be wandering the land barefoot again; my hand... my home will be ruined. You, my madman, if you do such work, you'll surely end up wandering around barefoot. Here you're fine.
en_old: Allah Allah, all is well. Fine, what are you... again I'll graze on... land. My hand... house ruined. My crazy one, you do this kind of work, you'll definitely end up grazing..., here you're fine.

brh: تولہ نا کاریم کریسے نی کس پاتہ وخت تولہ مونی سونا ئنا غسی نا گرائنگا کینم کہ تولہ جوڑ مس ادا نیمہ تولہ نا کچا مفیسہ ادا تولہ غا نی امبارو کاریم دونو کپیسہ تولہ غا امارو کاریم کپیسے دیان دے در مخلوق نا
en: You do the jackal's work; nobody... at that time, in front of the jackal... of gold... so that the jackal was made... Here you're not even the size of half a jackal. Here you don't do work like a jackal, you don't do work like the jackal... the people's...
en_old: You do the village's work, nobody... at the time, in front of the village, gold... the village was built. Here you're not even half the worth of the village. Here you don't do that kind of work for the village... the people.

brh: ککڑا کے دوزیرے، پنج سوار! تولہ نا ککڑا کے دوزا، کپوتا کے دوزا، اینوسکا نی الکونس اوتے؟ داڑے بسونس کنا نیتا کے سے۔ تولہ غا تلنگ گپیسے وائے نا بسونس کنا الکونس، وا نا وافام وا عارفو گفیا نہ بس۔
en: You (all) steal chickens, five horsemen! The jackal steals the chickens, steals the pigeons. Have you taken them up till today? You've come here to my... You don't... the jackal; oh, you came and took mine... oh, ...
en_old: You steal chickens, five riders! You steal the village's chickens, you steal the pigeons. Why did you take them now? You came here to my... you came to the village... took mine...

brh: ادا نی خبر اف ئے بیست و سے تولہ خلکنٹ کسیفینوٹ نی ہم بارو ئے خنتنوٹ کہ نی چناتے پلہ کوٹہ غاتیتا ہرفک واہ واہ نواب خان واہ عجب او ہیتس کرے ہو ادا جوانو
en: Here, you don't know: I have struck and killed twenty-three jackals. And I've never once seen you carry the young ones off home. Wow, wow, Nawab Khan, wow, what a strange thing he said! Yes, here, a good one.
en_old: Here, you don't know: I've worn twenty-three tola, I had it made. You also saw the bracelet when you took the children... Wow, wow, Nawab Khan, wow, what a strange thing he did. Yes, this is good.

brh: دا سے نی ہور رش کلے تو پاہا دا سا نی حل کوٹ دو زمین خفتو دماغ نا گپاتے خفتو دماغ نی ملنگی کنا تو دماغ ملنگو گے لیکن نما انتئے دماغ ملنگ پگے اکھنا کنے انتئے کل کنو گے دا سا پا کوٹ نا پیسہ دے تیس یا تفے
en: This one... you... look further, then say: have you settled it now? ...the room... the land... the talk of a sleeping brain; a sleeping brain, you're a malang (crazed wanderer). My brain is malang, but why isn't your brain malang? Why do you put everything on me? Now say, will you give the money for the room or not?
en_old: Now if you push this further, then say: have you solved it now? ... the words of a wandering mind... my mind wanders, but why doesn't your mind wander? Why do you blame everything on me? Now tell me, will you give the money or not?

brh: بریسہ یا کھڈ کیونے یا پڑی آ بریسہ دا چھوٹا دین سودا کیوہ ربڑی او چھوٹا لیوتینے تینا رقمے پورا کیوہ او ایلم گڑا صدری نا جیب اٹ ہرف گاشوم تے
en: Either you come, or I'll dig a pit for you, or you'll come to the market; I'll sell these small things, rabri and small..., I'll make up my own amount, and brother, then I'll lift it out of the vest pocket.
en_old: You come, either to the shop or to the market, and buy these small things, rabri and little items, to make up your amount, and the brother takes things out of his vest pocket.

brh: تے دا دوہ اسو الکونو کنے باز خراب۔ براس کوشش کر وڈس کر کنگے کہ دا ستاس پاسنگا باز خراب پاسنگا مگر ایلوم اسو اسہ نئے پین دیر آ کاف دو تورے بو ادا کن تو پاولئی اسہ مفک گڑا نی این پاسے دا بندہ کنے خلیر کسیفیر
en: This... I took has been very bad for me. Brother, try, find some way so that... it's going very badly. But brother... no, other people's... hand... Here I don't have even a quarter-rupee, and then you'll say 'these people beat me and killed me'.
en_old: This one I've taken has been very bad for me. Brother, try, do something so that... it's very bad. But the brother, no, with other people... it won't happen for me, and then you'll say this man beat me and killed me.

brh: یا پگے پڈیٹے دیر چوٹا دے گنا سودا کیرے گڈانی خوش مرے سے ادا چوٹا تا جگہ نی دیر اسو سودا کیر کرے اسو ہچو فکر اسف سونا ننگے ونس کر ننگڑے ملک تولوکے ننے فارغ کر ننگ کان ادا جوہرو
en: Or tomorrow at the market, sell the small things... then you'll be happy. Here, instead of the small ones, you made a big sale; there was no worry at all. Gold... us... the Malik is sitting... free us from this... Jauhar.
en_old: Or tomorrow in the market, buy small things for the day, and then you'll be happy. Here, instead of small things, you buy a lot, with no worry at all... to set us free from this...

brh: کنتو پینا سٹھا کاسمپ، دا ٹوپ کنا ارے، پاسے توتے وتنے درتے، ہننگ کے ٹوپ پانے آخری لکھو کینے، نام دے کھٹانو، نام دیک آخری او، ادا۔
en: With me another... This cap is mine. You say... take them...; ... the cap... the last fate is written... the name has won... the name is the last one, here.
en_old: With me another... this hat is mine, say it... it's the last entry being written, the name... the name is the last one, here.

brh: ننے چناٹ آن برے افہ یا ننے پیسہ ایتے دا ٹوپے کھیرے اللہ نصیب نیکی یا راہی مکان پیڈیا چھوٹا دینی سودا کیوے ایتنا پیساتہ وصولی کیوے ہن کھڈنا تھروٹی تما خیر مرے خیر
en: Either it doesn't reach us from the children, or give us money and take this cap. It's God's fate, a good deed... or go home; sell the small things at the market, collect your money; go and fall into the pit's... May it be well, well.
en_old: Either the children should come to us, or give us money and take this hat. It's God's will. Do good, or go home. Buy small things in the market, recover your money... may it be well, may it be well.

brh: ادا دا چناڑان نلکو نی کوٹرخے پرغا ٹکر کرے نقصانی کرے دا سا نقصانے کوٹرخنا تفک پاوتے دے وی چھوٹا تنے سودا کیوے تینا وصولی کیوے ہران کاز نلکو نی ٹو
en: Here, you took this from the child... you smashed the scooter, crashed it and did damage; now tell him the scooter's damage... sell the small things, collect your own money; where did you take it from...
en_old: Here, you took it from this child. You hit the scooter and caused damage. Now tell him the damage to the scooter is on him. Buy small things, recover your money; where did you take it from...

brh: ٹوپس شش پیسے یو پیدا ٹوپے دبو بس کنا جان یلو ٹوپے نا نما رکینہ ایلوم نی اندا کہ خلقونو سکوٹر غا پرغانو زبابانہ ایلوم ئے اسو بھروسہ کیس لمڑ اسوٹی رخوندو اسوٹ بیمو اسوٹ دا مار امی گبستگے کسری ئے اسوٹ دا
en: A cap for six rupees... take the cap; just, my dear, leave the cap... we'll keep yours. Brother, you know they beat him and smashed him against the scooter... brother, you trust him... I was... I was... I was afraid... this son... I was a traveler, this...
en_old: The hats are six rupees... just my dear, the other hat... the brother on the scooter... you trust him... in one... this...

brh: بس گری پارین ننہ کوٹ خننے تے کونین تے دا تتف تے نن تو مماری کرے، کنے درد بس گری خوار سوٹ تے جوانی ہڑچی، ئے بڑ کنے تے تتف تے کنے بس، او دے تو بے نصیب کڑٹ کڑٹ ننہ بے نصیب مسن، ہرفٹ خلقو تے ڈار تے تراخہ بشٹ مسن
en: Just say... they see our room... they... didn't give it; they got into a brawl with us; I got hurt, I became miserable... good... me... didn't give it to me; that day, unlucky... we became unlucky; they picked them up, beat them... we got up.
en_old: Just tell the wretched ones... they beat us, I got hurt, I became miserable... they are unfortunate, we have become unfortunate... the people took them and they were scattered.

brh: دا سفر نا او کبرو پیسہ آک ایتے۔ نہ، نی ہناک منڈی ٹی گوڑی بٹ کے کاریم کے۔ مخلوق خلیس ئے پولیس انت کے انت کے درد بسنے نی پیسہ تے تسنوسنت گڑا او مسلمان نا ہلپونی در ننگا
en: Give the money for this journey and... No, you go to the mandi, haul sacks and do work. The people got scared... the police, what will they do, what will they do... I got hurt; you have given the money, then that Muslim's...
en_old: Give the money for this trip. No, you go and do work in the market. People got scared: police, what happened, what happened? You got hurt, you gave the money, then the Muslim...

brh: ئے دا وڑ نیسٹی نیامٹی درد بریک انت کے؟ کنے دا وجہ درد بس کہ ئے رخ کن توسوٹ۔ نا ایراغ نا زمے کسفت۔ این کاریم کر مزدوری کر کھٹا کن۔ ایلو مخلوق نا پولیس نی دون درد بریک لنگڑیان۔
en: Why does it hurt me like this, right in the middle? It hurt me because I stayed... Nobody is responsible for your food. Go work, do labor, earn your living. Other people's... police... it hurts you like this from hunger.
en_old: Why does it hurt like this in the middle? I got hurt because I was hit. Your bread is your own responsibility. Go work, do labor, earn. Other people's police... you get hurt like this, limping.

brh: ئے بندغہ غلنگاٹو، دونو پارین کپہ سنی کننگس، کنے تو انو درد بس، انو درد بس، ئے بگجیندے سے سے پٹکے کننگ، بس ہموکے مجبور، بچہ کھل پجا دے الکوٹ گوٹ تڑی نسا اینے کشوٹ، ادا اٹنو آ پیسہ کھوٹا، دوسو درہم
en: I got beaten by people. Don't say such things... It hurt me so much, so much... I... was forced into it. Child... I took..., I took it out from..., here... the money, two hundred dirhams.
en_old: A man was beaten. Don't say such things... I was in such pain, such pain... I was forced, child... I took it out here, the money, two hundred dirhams.

brh: روپئیو؟ دوسدو؟ ہاؤ۔ ہا دا دوسد روپئی ات کر جی بٹی نشا، بس۔
en: Rupees? Two hundred? Yes. Yes, bring these two hundred rupees [...], that's it.
en_old: Rupees? Two hundred? Yes. Yes, make it two hundred rupees, that's it.

brh: ہندا بنانا بلہ اف باز مہربانی نومے اللہ نگہبان نومے تول نلکوٹ نی جھڑکی آ ملخینے کشکاٹے باز مہربانی نی باز مہربانی دا جوان او خوش کرے راہی مدہ ادا الے بو گم کبوتے دڑنگ شیف شیف دڑنگ شیف دڑنگ دا ایلومے تینا اور
en: It's no big deal. Thank you very much, may God protect you. [...] I got you out of [...] the scolding. Thank you very much, you... thank you very much; this is good, and you made (me) happy. Get going. Leave him here, get rid of him... Get down, down, get down, down, get down. This other one of yours, and...
en_old: This is no big deal. Thank you very much, may God protect you. You... thank you very much, this is good and you made me happy. Go on your way. Here... down, down, down.

brh: دا ایلم اسہ مرو جوانو خاندان نا ایلم اسہ نی اور نی بش مسرے دونو کاریم کے سنتے کہ بر اداتاں سنتے دادے ننے رسوا کرے دادے بر دادے دا ایلم اتنا اور دا لکھ روپیہ پورا سے ٹھوپہ خلکونے خاندان نا بندغاسے اور نی ولہ دا نا عزت مٹ کرے
en: This brother is a brother from a very good family, and you... you got up and did such a thing that... Come here. This one has disgraced us. This one... come, this one... this brother is so (respected), and he has put on a hat worth a full lakh rupees. He is a man of (good) family, and you ruined his honor.
en_old: This brother is from a very good family, and you did such a thing... come here, he disgraced us. This brother's... a hundred thousand rupees for the hat... a man of the family, and you destroyed his honor.

brh: دے ٹی ملافسے دونو کارم کیسنے ہنتئے دونو کیسنے ادا دا ہن ئے ہنتس کننگوٹ دا کل دانا وجہ آن کننگوٹ دا کارم کل دانا وجہ آن کننگوٹ ئے ہچ کننگ افٹ نی غلط کننگٹی ئس دونو کارم ہندا کپک پیندس دوں کپک ئے ایلم نا گناہ ہچ پئے ہت بس شداد باز بے عزت کرینے دے دا ہلی دانا ہنتئے دونو کیسنے دا ہلی کم سے کم
en: In the daytime [...] you did such a thing. Why did you do such a thing? Here, what am I doing? I'm doing all this because of him; I'm doing all this work because of him. I'm not doing anything; you are the one doing wrong. Nobody does a thing like this, nobody does that. The brother is not at all to blame [...]. Enough. This Shaddad (tyrant) has badly dishonored him. Why did you do such a thing to him? ... at the very least.
en_old: You did such a thing in the middle of the day; why did you do it? Everything was done because of him, all this work was done because of him. I didn't do anything; you were in the wrong. Nobody does such things. It wasn't the brother's fault at all. He insulted us badly. Why did you do such a thing? At least...

brh: پین ہچ کپیس دا خاندان نا عزت ئے تکر کرک دا ٹوپے الکونے الک روپئی او۔ ہی بے عزت۔ رائے مکان۔ کھا رائے مگومہ۔
en: Don't do anything more. This strikes at the family's honor. He has bought this hat; it is a lakh rupees. Hey, you shameless man! Get going. Go, get on your way.
en_old: Don't do anything else; this damages the family's honor. He took this hat, a hundred thousand rupees. Hey, shameless. Go home. Go, don't...

brh: دا تو چند در پدر مسٹ خوار مسٹ سونارا
en: As for this, I've been wandering from door to door for a while; I've become miserable [...].
en_old: I've been wandering from door to door and I've become miserable, goldsmith.

brh: تو بند یٹیس ئے قندھاری بازار آن بننگوٹ کنے سہ سد روپئی ضرورت ء کنتو سہ سد مہ سد افک کنے ٹیپ ٹاپ لک روپئی ئس نیتون ٹوپ ہلکس کنے سہ سد تننگ کپیسہ کنا کاریم تیتو
en: Then [...]. I was coming from Qandahari Bazaar. I need three hundred rupees; I don't have three hundred or anything. You've bought yourself a tip-top hat worth a lakh rupees, and you can't give me three hundred? My work...
en_old: Then he stopped me. I was coming from Qandahari Bazaar. I need three hundred rupees, I don't have three hundred... you took a hat worth a hundred thousand rupees from me, and you can't give me three hundred? My work...

brh: دا سے کرے نا دخل افک کسے تینا چھل کن گمرک ایلومس کنا ہما کنا کاریم نی تو افک دا سہو رے گپک سے ست روپئی تگنے کے کا بازاراں دا سے کرے قندھاری بازارا بنیس ول انت کس قندھاری بازارا ئے قندھاری بازار
en: This is none of [...]'s business [...] the other one. My... my work is none of yours. [...] three hundred rupees, give (them) to me [...] go to the market. You came to Qandahari Bazaar [...]; then what did you do in Qandahari Bazaar? I... Qandahari Bazaar.
en_old: This has nothing to do with anyone... my work is not your business... seven rupees... from the market. Come to Qandahari Bazaar; then what is in Qandahari Bazaar? Qandahari Bazaar.

brh: برے نا ڈکامی دا چکر خلکو مخلوق کباب کنوکے مخلوقے خناٹ کن تو پیسہ الو دا سزو سست روپئی تے گنے دا سزو سست روپئی تے گنے کا میزان چوک آ کباب کنے برے او نو کرے کن تو پیسہ افک کاس یا سلیس پیسے تو نی ترو
en: Come on. I made a round of your shops. People were eating kebabs; I saw the people, but I had no money. Give me these three hundred rupees, give me these three hundred rupees; I'll go to Mizan Chowk and eat kebab. Come [...]. I don't have any money. Whether you go or stay, you will give the money.
en_old: Come on, I was wandering around the shops and saw people eating kebabs. I saw them, but I don't have any money. Count out these seventy rupees, count out these seventy rupees, and I'll eat kebab at Mizan Chowk. Come on, I don't have money for that, a glass or so... you give me the money.

brh: او تمغک اگر پیزہ تفیسے ئنا ٹوپہ نا دے و کندھاری بازار اٹی لیلام کیوے۔ ارے نا دا جرات کنا ٹوپہ نا پین الیسے۔ نی دنو جرات ارے کہ کنا ٹوپہ دے سے کرے کندھاری بازار اٹی لیلام کیس تے۔ نی کسے سے سد روپئی
en: If you don't give the money, I'll take your hat and auction it in Kandahari Bazaar. Hey, you have the nerve? You'd take my hat? You have such nerve that you'd auction my hat in Kandahari Bazaar? You... three hundred rupees.
en_old: If you don't give me the money, I'll take your hat and auction it in Kandahari Bazaar. Hey, you have the nerve to take my hat? You dare to auction my hat in Kandahari Bazaar? You... a hundred rupees.

brh: ئے گنتھ افٹ او ٹوپے نا مجبور آن کنے لیلم کرو تنے دا دا ساہ نا کھرے کاٹم پرے دا علم گنا نا طوفان ئس گنا صفا چٹ کرے
en: I'm not [...]. I'm forced to auction that hat [...]. This storm of my grief has wiped me out completely.
en_old: ...I don't count it. Because of the hat I'm forced to auction it. Today a storm hit me and wiped me clean.

brh: دا سفر کے پیسہ خوائیس خوا پیسہ ، دا ساعت او ڈبل پیسہ خواوے کہ کنے مچس ، صبر داسہ کنے نی ڈبل خلنگ خوائیسے
en: For this trip you asked for money; you want money. Right now I want double the money, because [...] me. Wait, now you want to charge me double?
en_old: For this trip you asked for money, you wanted money, and now you want double the money from me. Wait, now you want to charge me double?

brh: نی کنے اخس کہ خلیسنے نی آ باریم اٹ اخس کوبے مریک، ئے نوکر نی موت ستیوے، نی کرے تینا عزت ء ہم پومفسے، نی کنا بلا ایلم اوس اینا عزت ء کریٹہ، داسہ نا خنتہ سٹففوے، داسہ زور اٹ ہم نا جیب آن پیسہ کشیوہ دیوے
en: However much you have beaten me, how heavy it gets with that load of yours! I'm a servant [...] death [...]. You don't even value your own honor. You are my elder brother; I used to respect you. Now I'll smash your eyes. Now I'll take the money out of your pocket by force.
en_old: How much you've beaten me, how much I've suffered because of you! You servant, you'll die. You didn't even keep your own honor. I respected you like my own brother. Now I'll gouge out your eyes, and now I'll take the money out of your pocket by force.

brh: نا دا جرات کہ نی بلئی لو نا گٹہ ٹی ہرفس؟ نی گٹہ نا پاشے، ہنا ڈی نا پسیفک نا باری ٹی۔
en: How dare you grab the elder by the throat? You... the throat [...]
en_old: How dare you grab him by the throat? You... the throat... about the Pacific...

brh: امار داسہ کنا تھک نا خبر تمانے آخا امار پیسہ تیفیسے تیفیسے؟ ادے ئے تھک پیسہ عید کنے؟ ارے کھینٹی پیسہ راغہ تینے بیبخت! دوں کپہ یلہ کلو مے تینا گمبہ۔ نا چکارے مصنف نی تینا کسر ال تھن۔ عید ادے کصفے وی دانہ خن کے ستفے وی دادے اسل الپے۔
en: How is it now? News of my [...] has got out. So how is it, will you give the money or not? Give me this [...] money! Hey, [...] money, you wretch! Don't do that, let go of the brother [...]. [...] you take your own road. Give [...], don't beat his eyes, don't take this at all.
en_old: Now the news about my exhaustion has spread. Will you give me the money or not? Is this money for Eid? Hey, the money... you wretch! Don't do that, let go of your fist. You scoundrel, go your own way. Eid... don't hit him, don't let him go, don't take it at all.

brh: ئے دا کائلو مے کہ خلے او کے ونے خوار نان کاری مس کائلو مے کنے خلاص کرے شکر ئے جوانوں بندغاسیوٹ نیکی کنے کنا کاری مے کنا ایلے کنا باغ ہٹے ندین جوان سمجھائے فیٹے
en: I... this [...] who hit (me) and made (me) miserable [...]. [...] freed me. Thank God, I'm a decent person; (he) did me a kindness. My work, my brother, my garden [...]. I explained it to him nicely.
en_old: He came to beat me and I was in a bad state. He came and saved me. Thank God, a good man did me a kindness. My brother, my garden... he explained everything to me very well.

brh: ئے اسلئے پاراتٹ کہ دا نا خنتی تو توفک او دا ساخرے و دا نا سگ و تے اسلئے پاراتٹ
en: I said it for this reason: his eyes are like a gun, and he is a sorcerer, and his dogs [...]. That's why I said it.
en_old: I said it because his eyes are like a gun, and he is a sorcerer, and his dogs... that's why I said it.

brh: ئے لمہ تو صفاس خوار کریکٹ تغ تے ٹی بننگ اٹیٹ
en: Mother, I've been made completely miserable; it keeps coming into my dreams.
en_old: Oh mother, I've been completely ruined, I can't even get to sleep.

brh: جوڑ آخاں خیر ازا ہربیشیورے ڈھیر آسا تم آسا بننگورے اللہ خیر کے ہاؤ ملک صاحب بالکل خیر ئے ہاؤ ادا ئے ہم اللہ پاک نا ہما خیر مرے ڈھیر آسا تم آسا بننگورے خیر مرے
en: Jora Khan, is everything well? How are you all? You've come after a long, long time. May God keep you well. Yes, Malik Sahib, everything is perfectly fine. Yes, may we here too have God Almighty's blessing. You've come after a long, long time; I hope all is well.
en_old: Jora Khan, is everything well? It's been a long time since we've seen you. May God keep you well. Yes, Malik Sahib, everything is fine. Yes, may God Almighty keep it well. It's been a long time since we've seen you. May all be well.

brh: ملک صاحب نوے سارون ہمو سون نانا سئے ٹی نتھ ننا دا حال متوکہ دا تھابڑنگس متو نہ اسٹائلک ننا فل کرے سنی دیول آنبارو ناسمجن تپائکہ خیر جوڑا خان امی اللہ اعجاز کے اسے کوٹھو ئس غنارے بامان رند ہمہ کرے دے اند کرے دے
en: Malik Sahib, in all those [...] years of ours we were never in such a state; there was never such a [...]. [...] made fools of us [...], we don't understand [...]. Well, Jora Khan, may God [...]. A room [...] after [...] what did he do, what did he do?
en_old: Malik Sahib, in all these years we were never in such a state, there was never such a fight. They made fools of us. We don't understand... Well, Jora Khan, may God grant honor. A room... they made a fuss and caused trouble.

en: Kamal... Mir... that day... Listen, listen, listen! ... Now he has come to the village; he is looking for a girl. He left the city and is looking here in the village.
en_old: Kamali Mir, Ismat... this day... sleep, sleep, sleep... now it has come among the people; the daughter is being searched for in the city, God willing, she is being searched for here among the people.

brh: خیر ئے نی داخہ واری کریس؟ او مچے واری مسکنے۔ نی خبر ئے گلببی انتئے کہ بسسوس؟ آہا کنے انت خبر۔
en: Is everything all right? Did you take this long? — It all took a while. — Do you know why Gulbibi had come? — No, what would I know?
en_old: Well, did you take such a turn? Everything has turned. Do you know why Gulbibi came? No, how would I know?

brh: ارے کا جمال تو نا مسٹ ٹی ہندا خاطر رسالے ہو کبو۔ ارے کا ماتو نام تو نیت کننگ کے۔
en: Hey, it's about Jamal and your daughter — for that very reason, go ahead with the proposal visit. Hey, ... so as to pledge [her] in your name.
en_old: Hey, Jamal, that's why we will hold the ceremony in your... Hey, we can make the intention in your name.

brh: ئے ہم دا ہیت ئے را، مئے بے بے تینا مار کھیت کتئو؟ جمال کھیت کرے۔ آخر جوانی ئس کروئی۔ دیر ئس ئے روٹ جاندار۔ آ بار بار جاندار، دروازہ مل۔
en: And there's this matter too: didn't our Bibi speak to her son? Jamal spoke. After all, one has to do a good deed. — Who is it? — Jandad. — Ah, come, come, Jandad. Open the door.
en_old: Did you hear this too? Did our Bibi get her son engaged? She got Jamal engaged. After all, a good deed must be done. It's getting late, Jandar. Again and again, Jandar, open the door.

brh: ہیلو کے بر بخیر اٹ بخیرے ایلم جاندا السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام او بخیریت ٹھیک ٹھاک خیریت خوش خیر خیریت انت حال ایلم جاندا الحمدللہ شکر دعا ہی بخیر خیریت ٹھیک ٹھاک ایلم جوان مس کہ نی بسس
en: Hello, come in, welcome — are you well? Brother Jandad! Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace. — Are you well, all fine? — All's well, fine and well. How are you, brother Jandad? — Praise be to God, thanks; by [your] prayers all is well and fine. — Brother, it's good that you came.
en_old: Hello, come, welcome. Are you well, brother Jandar? Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you too. Are you well, all fine? All good. How are you, brother Jandar? Praise be to God, thanks to your prayers, I'm well and fine. Brother, it's good that you came.

brh: نی توم جانو سلاہ ئس کنے کروئی سلاہ ئس تو کنے ہم نم توم کروئی ئس اللہ خیر کے ہرا وخت آ شیر خان شار آ بسونے ہر بندغ بننگٹی ئے سلاہ و مشورہ کے، ہن پاو سکینہ شیر خان نا خاص پراک ہم بسونو سلاہ سوچ کنے
en: I need to have a good consultation with you too; I also need to consult with you all. May God make it well. Ever since Sher Khan came to the city, every person has been coming for advice and counsel. — What can I tell you, Sakina — even Sher Khan's own special pirs have come to consult me.
en_old: You and Jano should have consulted me; you should have asked my advice too. God bless. Ever since Sher Khan came to the city, everyone who comes asks for his advice and counsel. Go tell Sakina that Sher Khan's special guests have also come for consultation.

brh: او کسری اول اٹ کنے پیر ملا، و ولدا کنے مرید ملا، اوف ہم کنے آن سلاہ خواہسرہ، اوف کنے آن سلاہ مشورہ کے بسرہ، خیر ایلے دائے تاتے، اسے
en: On the way, first a pir met me, and then a disciple met me; they too were asking me for advice, they were coming to me for advice and counsel. Anyway, leave these matters aside; one [thing]...
en_old: On the way I first met the pir, and then I met the disciple; they too wanted my advice, they came to me for advice and counsel. Anyway, leave these matters aside, one thing...

brh: اسکا جانداد دے حوال کیر او ہم سلاہ مشورہ ئس خوائنگ کے بسونے جانداد جی اسل مین ٹاخان کے سدونی کے شیر خان کنا ہرا گا بس او پیروک کن زرینہ رشتہ ئ خوارو ہاؤ او ہم داڑے
en: ...inform Jandad too; he too has come to ask for some advice. — Jandad ji, the real story is this: Sher Khan came to my house; he is asking for Zarina's hand for Piro. Yes, and he is here too.
en_old: Tell Jandad too; he has also come seeking advice. Jandad ji... Sher Khan came to me; he is asking for Zarina's hand for the elder one, and he is here too.

brh: بس بس اسہ اینو نا رسالہ کے تینا مار جمال کے گڑا نم انت پارے؟ نی انت پارے؟ نم انت پارے؟ یارا فیصلہ داسہ نا دو ٹی ئے
en: He came, came with a proposal for Hasina, for his son Jamal. So what did you all say? What did you say? What did you all say? Friend, the decision is now in your hands.
en_old: Enough, enough. Today's ceremony for my son Jamal, so what did you say? What did you say? What did you all say? Friend, the decision is now in your hands.

brh: نی پا کنا خیال ئے کہ او کے نی گڑ ایو نم زلیو اسینا سنگتو ئے تراس یوٹ نی انت پاسہ نی ہم آخرت نا بائے مل ئے انت پاننگ کیو
en: You tell me. My thinking is that for him we would then ... Zali, Hasina's friend... What do you say? You too are ... What can I say?
en_old: You tell me, I think that he... I gave it to a friend of mine. What do you say? You too are bound for the hereafter. What can I say?

brh: انتس کن نما صلہ؟ ادا ساکی بس اوک ئے تو اوک ایو۔ برا ننا ما اوک اینا؟ او۔ ماسی ایلوم جان نات کے جوان و چائے ئس جوڑ کرک اتک۔ چائے کمپر ابا غا باسی۔
en: What do you need advice for? ... If it's OK, then I'll give my OK. Brother, shall we give our OK? — Yes. — Auntie, make a nice tea for brother Jan and bring it. Tea ... to father ...
en_old: What is your advice for? Saki came here... then bring it. Shall we bring it? Yes. Aunt, Elum Jan, make some good tea and bring it. Tea...

brh: دا زوری نا ئے کہ نما اوڑا گا ایرا کنتونو۔ اگر تیاری گڈے تیس با۔ ایرا ئے ایتے وتینا ایلم کے نیتو۔ بے شک کنا خیال آ جوان بشخاس۔ بس اللہ خیر کے اللہ خیر کے۔
en: This is a matter of force, that you haven't ... to her ... If it's ready, then bring it. Give it to your brother ... Certainly, in my view it is good ... Just may God make it well, may God make it well.
en_old: This is forcing it, that we can't place it on him. If you're ready, then come. Give it to your brother. Of course, in my view it's good, forgive me. Just may God bless, may God bless.

brh: ایڑو، اللہ ئے ارادے۔ ارانگ ئے دانے؟
en: Sister, it is God's will. Where is that one?
en_old: Brother, it is God's will. Where is it?

brh: الہ خیر نئے او نیم کرے آئی ہم برورا کنیکک تاتی جمیلہ نا وراغے ننگٹوس
en: All is well, God willing... he did ... Mom, I'll come too ... to Jamila's house...
en_old: God bless, he did it; I will also come... Jamila's...

brh: آئی تینا لمہ ء یاد کریٹ۔ ایڑے اندا پاریٹ کہ اونا لمہ ہسراٹی کاریم کیک تنیا۔ نی ہم مچے کاریم کڑک؟ ہمیش کاریم کیک بخت ء فین کننگ نا کہ دا
en: I remembered my mother. I said exactly this there: that her mother works alone at the in-laws' house. Do you also do all the work? She always works ...
en_old: I remembered my mother. Sister, I just said that his mother works in the house alone. Do you also do all the work? She always works...

brh: ئے کاریم کے دیان دے درست خلق نا مسنگ تے تو گوازی کے کندا دے گدے کاٹومہ شاغانے۔ الے تائی نی بر تول اینیڑنی گوازی کرو۔ نی بر تول سائی دا کا ئے تسباو نی واہ پا واہ انت سستینا بس۔
en: ...she works all day long; she plays with all the village girls ... that day ... has poured it on her head. Leave it, Mom — come, sit, let's play together. Come, sit ... say 'wow', wow ... that's all.
en_old: ...does work, and all day long the people's... plays games; that day... Come, brother, come sit, let's play. Come sit... wow, say wow, what... that's all.

brh: آئی نی دا پدا نن اوار ٹی اینٹ مننگٹی ئے ئے کنا مار ہندا دے نا و جمال نا سنگ و برام نا تیاری ئے پدا نن اینٹ مننگٹی ئے آئی اسے تو پاو دے ئے زلی تو اسل برام کپرا ئے اسے نا تو برام کیوا۔ خفتو بو۔
en: Mom, now we are getting together ... it is the preparation for my son's [wedding] on this same day and for Jamal's engagement and wedding; now we are ... — Mom, I'll tell you one thing: I will not marry Zali at all; I will marry Hasina. Listen.
en_old: Now we are gathering together for the preparations for my son's and Jamal's engagement and wedding. Tell me one thing: if... I won't marry at all, I'll marry only the one. Go to sleep.

brh: شکلاتے نا خنانوس نی حسینہ تو برام کے حسینہ تنا باموسہ ایٹھے تولنگے روادار اف گڑ نی تو برام کیک ہمک کیپ تے او کنا اوستے عمر ولدا دائے تے کپس
en: Have you looked at your face? You'll marry Hasina? Hasina won't even let a fly sit on her nose — and then she'd marry you? ... Oh Umar, my dear, don't do these things again.
en_old: You haven't seen their faces; you will marry Hasina. Hasina is not even willing to sit with you, so how will she marry you? ... my... life won't do these things again.

brh: خیال کیس، اگر نا باوہ ء سما تما کہ نی تینا ایلم نا دشتار ء خنانا کیرغ آن کرینس، دا غارک ٹی زندہ زندہ کٹک کک نی آئی، اگر بشار ء اتوکئے، ئے کدا ایلم تے اتوکئے، تو کنا پسینہ تو براھ مسکنے۔
en: Mind you: if your father found out that you have been eyeing your brother's fiancée on the sly, he would bury you alive in this pit. Oh, if it had been brought to Bashar, or to those brothers... I'm breaking into a sweat.
en_old: Just imagine: if your father had found out that you had looked at your brother's bride, he would have buried you alive in this cave. If Bashar had been there, or however many brothers there are... I broke out in a sweat.

brh: خفتو ولدا ہم متوکہ اوما حسینہ تینا اوستن کش زلیخا نا خیال تینا اوستٹی اتہ کومسس آئی اما کیو حسینہ تو کنا اوست لچانی ہائے حسینہ نا مگیس حسینہ نا اوست لچانی گنوک
en: Listen, again ... — that Hasina, pull her out of your heart; bring the thought of Zulekha into your heart. — Mom, what shall I do? Hasina, my heart is helpless; oh, Hasina's ..., my heart is helpless for Hasina, crazy.
en_old: I couldn't sleep, and still that beauty... the thought of Zulekha stayed in my heart. What do I do? Oh beauty, my heart is restless. Oh beauty, my heart is restless, crazy for her.

brh: شکر کشہ شکر کشہ کہ اندا زلیخا نا برام نیتون مرے ہاو۔ ہاو۔ گڑا شکر کنے۔ ئے گڑا اینو ہم پداسین نی باجی پاو۔ ہاو۔ داسین تینا کاریم تے کرک مغز خلفہ کنے۔
en: Give thanks, give thanks that it is this very Zulekha whose marriage will be with you. — Yes. — Yes. — Then thank me. — So from today on, will you still call [her] 'Baji'? — Yes. — Now go do your own work and stop pestering me.
en_old: Thank God, thank God that Zulekha's wedding will be with you. Yes. Yes. Then thank me. So will you still call her sister after today? Yes. Now go do your own work and stop bothering me.

brh: بس نی وخت آ ورست اڑے نن پیش تمن گڑا ریل بریک مہربانی بریک بریک دا سوب نا چس کے بننگ والا ئے چائے سوٹ کے بننگ والا ئے مہربانی کبو دا ڈیشن ئے خالی
en: That's it, you're right on time. Hey, let's go out, then the train will come. Please, it'll come, it'll come. This ... is about to come, the tea ... is about to come. Please clear this station.
en_old: You just arrived on time. Hey, we went out and then the train will come. Please, come, come. This Sobna's... is about to come, tea... is about to come. Please clear this station.

brh: کبو تاکہ دا ریل برے خیر ئے دا ریلے اسہ وار چیک کسکٹ
en: Wait until this train comes. All right, let me check this train once.
en_old: Wait until this train comes. It's fine, check this train once.

brh: ریل بازی نا جوان آ شوب
en: A fine show of train antics.
en_old: A good show of the train game.

brh: اوئے مبارک مبارک مبارک مبارک مبارک مبارک مبارک خیر مبارک نی خیر مبارک نی مچے دانگ مرگ نی خیر مبارک نی چاوٹ تو ہنا کے نوکری
en: Oy, congratulations, congratulations, congratulations, congratulations, congratulations, congratulations, congratulations! Thank you, and to you! Thank you, ... all of you ... I know you've gone off and got a job.
en_old: Oy, congratulations, congratulations, congratulations, congratulations, congratulations, congratulations, congratulations! Bless you, congratulations to you, all of you... bless you, congratulations, you got a job!

brh: خنینگ ارے دا نا چکنی گٹیا سٹائل و امبارے ارے نا چکنی گٹیا فٹ چاپ خلنگا جٹ مبارک مرینے بابا ہر وخت ننا خف کے ورینی ٹھنگ کریسس ہینو تو
en: It's worth seeing: this one's slick ... style, and over there, hey, your slick ... fit, the fellow clapping along. Congratulations, father. Every time you go 'thang' in our ears like that.
en_old: Look, hey, his... style and... his... fit for a photo shoot. Congratulations, father. Every time you bring it to our ears... like this.

brh: یقین مس کہ ریل بننگٹی ئے بننگٹی ئے دا سد خوشی نا واری
en: It's certain now that the train is coming, it's coming. This is a moment of a hundred joys.
en_old: I became sure that the train is coming, it's coming. This is a time of hundredfold happiness.

brh: واقعی گاڑی بننگٹی ئے ہبو ہبو کنے کے ماما ماما ننا واقعی غب کے ماما ٹنگو کرے وقت سے پاسے ریل بننگے وقت سے پاسے دجہ بننگٹ ہرے ہپک وقت سے پاسے
en: The train really is coming. Hey, hey, tell me, uncle, uncle, uncle has really kept us hanging. Tell us a time, a time when the train will come; it's coming, look, or it isn't; tell us a time.
en_old: The vehicle really is coming. Wait, wait... uncle, uncle, we really... uncle... at some point the train is coming, at some point it's coming... at some point.

brh: آ واقی بننگٹی ئے نی تینا خف نی تینا مونی وری ڈک کنے مونی ڈک کتا بذات تو ماما سے او او خیالٹ او خیالٹ خیالٹ خیالٹ ابا روشنا تو ئے مچ آرامٹ مچ خیالٹ
en: Ah, it really is coming. You... your ears, you hide your face again, you hid your face from me. The rascal, uncle... oh, careful, oh, careful, careful, careful. Father, it's bright; all calm, all careful.
en_old: Oh, it's really coming... your sleep, you covered it in front of me again, you covered it in front of me. Actually it's uncle, he's lost in thought, in thought, in thought... Father, it's bright, everything is calm, all in thought.

brh: انتئے دوں جنگ کننگ اٹی ارے؟ آرام اٹ، آرام اٹ۔ روشن نا مطلب ئے ابا ئے تو دادے نی انت پاش کرے۔ واقعی دا ایلم کنے راست پاننگ اٹی ئس۔ ہنو بس شروس تینا۔ ہماڑے شروئے؟ ئے مگہ تو ئے تو خدانخواستہ مگہ تھوڑی جنگ کننگ اٹی اٹ۔
en: Why are you fighting like this? Calmly, calmly. The point is clear, father: so what is it you've revealed today? This brother really was telling me the truth. Yes, just ... you're good yourself. Where's the good? Well, God forbid, but I'm only fighting a little.
en_old: Why are you fighting like this? Calm down, calm down. Roshan means father, so what did you reveal today? This sister was really telling me the truth. Yes, it's just your own good one. Where is the good one? Well, God forbid, but I was fighting a little.

brh: ئے تو کنا تو داتو اسٹائل ئے کنا سئی ئے ہا بابا بالکل نما اسٹائل ئے برقرار مبو حوصلہ کبو کل گڑا مرے را مچے صبر کبو آہا تو داتی چڑنگ نا اینتی دے سے ئے تو ایوں ئے ترس کنے مچا سوٹے
en: Well, this is just my style; it's fine by me. Yes, father, absolutely, keep your style as it is. Take heart, everything will work out; be patient, all of you. Aha, so the other day, getting on this ... like this, I got scared ... my whole suit.
en_old: Well, this style of mine is my own. Yes, father, absolutely, keep your style, take heart, everything will work out, be patient, all of you. Aha, so the other day of climbing... so like this, I was scared, my whole suit...

brh: ورک ماما نی ہمے دے کہ تولوکو سندا اسٹیشن آ ننا کونی گھٹی اوس مغز ئے سائیں نی کنا مغز ئے کدو کرینوس تازہ کنے مونا ہیتے کریسہ کڑنا خیر افک
en: Look, uncle, that day when you were sitting at the station, our ... brain, sir, you've turned my brain to mush. And now you talk to my face like this; it's no good.
en_old: Wark uncle, that day when we were sitting at the Sindh station, our... Sir, you've fried my brain. Talking in front of me like that, it's no good.

brh: نی تینا مونی مچے داغ کرک۔ کنے نی چپ چپ سوجاؤس۔ ہمرک ئے غضب نا گرمی سے۔ او داہی کنے راستی گرمی تو بازے سے صفا کنا است پتو سینگ اٹک۔ نی تینا مچے استے ہرف۔
en: Hide your whole face. You quietly, quietly ... to me. There's a terrible heat there. And honestly, the heat is too much for me; my heart was really ... . Hold on to your whole heart.
en_old: Everything in front of you got stained. You asked me quietly. It's terribly hot there. And really, the heat is intense; my heart was burning right in my chest. Take your whole heart.

brh: گڑا ننے مائی تو مچے مجلس کرک۔ ارا مائی تو؟ ئے مائی اف کہ نرینہ غاتے تو تولوک ئے آئی دا سے کا ئے نرینہ غاتے تو اوار مریو۔ تو انفرقت مے کک۔ نی دا سے کا سنت پاروئی دا عمرٹی۔ نہ، نی کنے پیر و جڈو سے۔
en: Then chat with the lady, all of us together. With which lady? She's not a lady who sits with the men; would she now go and join the men? So what difference does it make? What should you be saying now, at this age? No, to me you're an old, doddering man.
en_old: Then the lady held a whole gathering for us. Which lady? She isn't a lady who sits with men; she'd join in with the men. So there's a difference. Is that what you should be saying at this age? No, to me you're old and...

brh: خیال کرینوس داسم دے انجانٹ جوان مائی جوان نی زیبا اللہ پاک نی پین زیبا یتے بس ہا انت نی اوشنگاسئو کنا زیبایین توبہ توبہ توبہ توبہ
en: You've been taking care of yourself these days ... nice, lady, nice; you're beautiful, may God Almighty give you even more beauty. Just... yes, what, you're going on about my beauty? For shame, for shame, for shame, for shame!
en_old: I was thinking that these days you've been looking very good, lady. You're good, you're beautiful, may God give you even more beauty. Just... yes, what did you... my beauty? God forbid, God forbid, God forbid!

brh: اسل مچیٹم برداشت دا مائٹی اف غصہ کدیس بولی تانکا تسی کاوا ایرتونا لاوال کے ہا پیرنگا ہا ورناینگا ابا اینمے ئس
en: This lady has no tolerance at all, not even a little. You got angry ... yes, the old one, yes, the young one; oh dear, that's how it was.
en_old: Honestly, this lady has no patience at all. She got angry, her tongue... yes, the old age, yes, the youth, father, like this.

brh: سیک کسے سیونٹی ففٹی نا ورنائی نا سائیں اڑے داسکا پیر کسے مینیفیسے سوبنائے درو تڑیس تڑیس اسل مڈولین نا ہر ساس دانا مطلب ئے
en: ... seventy, fifty ... of youth, sir. Hey, an old ... until now. You lied to Sobna, you lied ... honestly, every breath ... that's what it means.
