brh: بارک ایوا دا نظیر احمد تا تو حضرت جبریل وس پارے یا رسول اللہ اللہ سلام مونتس نا کنڈے کہ پیغمبر نی کنے باز دوست ئس ئے نبی تا سردار نی کنے باز دوست ئس لیکن ارا وقتس کان کہ دا مارکو غے لمہ راضی مفک ئے
en: [unclear] ...then Hazrat Jibril came and said, "O Messenger of Allah, Allah has sent His greetings to you: 'O Prophet, you are very dear to Me; O leader of the prophets, you are very dear to Me, but as long as this boy's mother is not pleased [with him], I...
en_old: …at that moment Hazrat Jibril came and said, "O Messenger of Allah, Allah sends His salaam to you, saying: O Prophet, you are very dear to Me; leader of the prophets, you are very dear to Me, but as long as this boy's mother is not pleased…

brh: ئے خدا ہم راضی مفرو حالانکہ نی دعا خوارانوس دارکن پیغمبر نی کنے باز دوستوس نا دعانا بلو عزت سے لیکن ہرا وختس کان کہ لمہ تینا مارے راضی مفک ئے خدا ہم راضی مفرو داڑان معلومس کہ لمہ راضی کریس گڑا خدا را
en: ...I, God, will not be pleased either, even though you have prayed for him. O Prophet, you are very dear to Me, and your prayer has great honor, but as long as the mother is not pleased with her son, I, God, will not be pleased either.'" From this it is known that if you please the mother, then God becomes...
en_old: …God will not be pleased either, even though you are praying for him. O Prophet, you are very dear to Me, and your prayer has great honor, but as long as the mother is not pleased with her son, God will not be pleased either." From this we learn that if you please the mother, then God is pleased.

brh: آدی مرے اگر لمہ ناراض مس تو خدا ہم ناراض۔ سہی ہرے ننے گنتی آ نا گڈان۔ لمہ باون پروا ہرے ننے۔ برام آ پد گڈ لمہ ہم درست کپن باوہ ہم درست کپن۔ گڈ ہر گڈان نا ہمو تٹی۔ لمہ ہم چھٹا باوہ ہم چھٹا۔ دن تے پکن آخریت تبا مننگ ٹی ئے کنا قبر تبا۔
en: ...pleased. If the mother becomes displeased, then God is displeased too. Now look carefully at us [unclear]. Our regard for our mother and father: look at us! After marriage we treat neither the mother right nor the father right. Then, after that, in that same [house], the mother is cast aside and the father is cast aside too. In this way our Hereafter is being ruined; my grave is ruined.
en_old: She was human. If the mother is angry, God is angry too. Now look at us, after all this. We don't care about our mother and father, look at us. After marriage we treat neither our mother well nor our father well. Then, at that time, the mother is left and the father is left. In such days our Hereafter is being ruined, my grave is being ruined.

brh: قیامت ٹی اور آخرت ٹی خدا نا مون اٹ تنپوئے کہ دا ایرماک لمہ باوہ نا رضا غان سوا پا جنت ملپک تو حضور اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ولدا لمہ نا اعتبار کرے پارے آئی پجی پہ آئی داسی دعا خواناٹ
en: On the Day of Judgment and in the Hereafter he will not be able to face God, because, my brothers, without the pleasure of mother and father, paradise is not obtained. Then the Holy Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) again appealed to the mother; he said, "Mother, look, mother, I am now going to make such a prayer...
en_old: …on Judgment Day and in the Hereafter, (they) will not stand before God, (to show) that these brothers cannot get paradise without the pleasure of their mother and father. Then the Holy Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) again tried to persuade the mother. He said, "Mother, look, mother, now I will pray…"

brh: اللہ سے ولدا نائے دے حکم کرے کہ لمہ راضی متو ئے راضی مفرا ئے دا سے محمد ولدا نی پاو اماں رتن راضی مت پر یا رسول اللہ اگر نی پاسا ئے راضی مرے وا پیر نائے پارے پیغمبر ئے راضی
en: ...Allah again commanded that unless the mother is pleased, I will not be pleased: "O Muhammad, tell her again: Mother, be pleased with him." She said, "O Messenger of Allah, if you say so, I will be pleased." Then she said, "Prophet, I am pleased...
en_old: Allah commanded once more: unless the mother is pleased, I will not be pleased. "O Muhammad, tell her again: Mother, be pleased." She said, "O Messenger of Allah, if you say so, I am pleased." The Prophet said, "Are you pleased?"

brh: آدی مریوا ئے خوش مریوا تینا مار تون ارا تما ئے پارے معاف کرت قسم ئے خدا نا حضور اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم سلوک ئے صحابہ کرام سلوک او خبر ئے تم تو حارث پاننگ شروع کرے اشھد آن لا الہ الا اللہ واشھد آن محمد رسول اللہ
en: ...I am pleased, I am happy with my son." When she said, "I have forgiven him," I swear by God, the Holy Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), the noble Companions... at that very moment Harith began to say, "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah."
en_old: She was human; she was pleased with her son, and then she said, "I forgive him." By God, the conduct of the Holy Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), the conduct of the noble companions! At that moment Harith began to say, "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah."

brh: دا لمہ راضی مت پمار نا دویا کلمہ شروع مسر سبحان اللہ کنا ایلم آت اگر لمہ راضی اف تو دا گڑاک نصیب مفسا امام الانبیاء رحمتہ للعالمین پارے ہمو بندغ نا بامس مشٹے ٹی بڈلے مسے وار
en: As soon as this mother was pleased, the son's tongue began the kalima. Subhanallah, my brothers, if the mother is not pleased, these things will not be granted to you. The Imam of the Prophets, the Mercy to the Worlds, said three times: may that person's nose be rubbed in the dust...
en_old: When this mother was pleased, the son's tongue began the kalima. Subhanallah, my brothers, if the mother is not pleased, these things will not be granted. The Imam of the Prophets, the Mercy to the Worlds, said three times: may that person's nose be rubbed in the dust.

brh: رحمت اللعالمین پارے ہمو بندغ نا بخت مس نبی پارے مشتے ٹی بڈلے کہ لمہ باوہ نا پیر اوراتی مریر و ہمدا جنت نا سفر لمہ باوہ پیر مریر اوراتی زندہ مریر لیکن مار کوئی جنت مل پی پیغمبر پارے اگر دا لمہ
en: The Mercy to the Worlds said: that person's nose, the Prophet said, may it be rubbed in the dust, whose mother and father grow old in his presence. And this is the very road to paradise: the mother and father grow old and are alive with him, yet the boy does not attain paradise. The Prophet said, if this mother...
en_old: The Mercy to the Worlds said: that person's fortune… The Prophet said: may his nose be rubbed in the dust, the one whose mother and father grow old in his presence. This is the path to paradise: the parents grow old and are still alive, but the boy does not attain paradise. The Prophet said, if this mother…

brh: لمہ باون عزت و قدر کرو تو جنت تیتے نتنا کا حضور پارے اماں ئنا باومس مشٹے ٹی پڈلے کہ لمہ باوتہ پیر او اودے موقع ملا خدمت نا لیکن لمہ باون خدمت کتو دا سونو ساپش تم اللہ اوڑکن دوزخ نا فیصلے کرے مارا معلومت لمہ نا قدر نمے نا
en: ...if he had honored and valued his mother and father, paradise would have been given to him. The Prophet said: may that one's nose be rubbed in the dust whose mother and father are old and who gets the chance to serve them, but he did not serve his mother and father, and like this his breath departed; Allah decreed Hell for him. We have come to know the worth of the mother; your...
en_old: …if he had honored and valued his mother and father, (God) would have given him paradise. The Prophet said: may that person's nose be rubbed in the dust whose mother and father grow old and he gets the chance to serve them, but he did not serve his mother and father, and he died like that; Allah decreed Hell for him. Brothers, we have learned the value of the mother.

brh: ننے نہ کروئی باوہ نا قدر ننے نہ کروئی دا کنا گپا کفو، پخدا نا قران نا فیصلہ غاکو، اللہ صیب پانٹئے، وقضی ربک الا تعبدو الا ایاہ وبالوالدین احسانا، او بندغاکو
en: Shouldn't we value the mother? Shouldn't we value the father? These are not my words; by God, these are the rulings of God's Quran. Allah Sahib says: "And your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him, and that you be good to your parents." O people,
en_old: Shouldn't we value our mother? Shouldn't we value our father? Don't take my word for it, listen to the ruling of God's Quran. Allah says: "And your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him, and that you be good to your parents." O people,

brh: لمہ تو تنہ جوانی کبو باوہ تو تنہ جوانی کبو داڑان معلوم مس لمہ باوہ نا جوانی نا سوار نما نا عزت بچپک لمہ پیر مرے باوہ پیر مرے اللہ سے پانٹیے واخفض لہما جناح الذل من الرحمہ اللہ پانٹیے دن کہ تنہ دوتے
en: Be good to your mother, be good to your father. From this it is known that without [repaying] the goodness of mother and father, your honor will not survive. When the mother grows old, when the father grows old, Allah says: "And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy." Allah says: like this, your hands...
en_old: Your mother did good to you, your father did good to you. From this we learn that the reward for parents' goodness is to protect their honor. When the mother grows old, when the father grows old, Allah says: "Wakhfid lahuma janah adh-dhulli min ar-rahmah" (and lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy). Allah says, lower your hands like this...

brh: رحمت والا دوت شیف کبو، تینے بسترہ مار شیف کبو، لمہ باونہ قدر کبو، لمہ باونہ عزت کبو، لمہ پیر داسنہ محتاجے، باوہ پیر داسنہ محتاجے، حضور اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پارے، صحابیس پارے یا رسول اللہ باوہ لمہ نا حق آک اولاد نا زی آ انتو؟
en: Lower the hands of mercy, lower yourselves like a bed, value your mother and father, honor your mother and father. The mother is old and now in need; the father is old and now in need. The Holy Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said... a companion said, "O Messenger of Allah, what are the rights of parents over their children?"
en_old: Lower the hand of mercy, humble yourself and lie low like a bed, value your parents, honor your parents. The mother is old and now in need, the father is old and now in need. The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said... a companion said, "O Messenger of Allah, what are the rights of parents upon their children?"

brh: اللہ نا نبی پارے ہا باوہ لمہ نا حق آک ننا دو، کہ ہرا وخت ئس کہ مار کو ارے باوہ لمہ پیرو، مار تت تینا ملکت تے تینا جان ء لمہ باوہ نا حوالہ کے، دا لمہ باوہ نا حق آک تینا مار نا زی آٹو، حضور اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پارے ہرا تم باوہ
en: The Prophet of Allah said, "Yes, the rights of parents are in our hands: when the son has grown up and the parents are old, the son should hand over his property and his own life to his parents. These are the rights of the parents over their son." The Holy Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said that when the father...
en_old: The Prophet of Allah said yes, the rights of parents are in our hands: when the son is grown and the parents are old, the son should hand over his property and his own self to his parents. These are the rights of parents upon their son. The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said that when the father...

brh: لمہ کسکر او ننا نماز جنازہ مارکو خوانے دا لمہ باوہ نا حق آک تینا مار نا زی آٹو اللہ نا نبی پارے ہراتم کسکر دفن مسر مارکو نزی دا ذمہ داری ئے کہ تینا لمہ باوہ کن دعا خوانے استغفار خوانے
en: ...and mother die, the son should lead their funeral prayer. These are the rights of the parents over their son. The Prophet of Allah said that when they have died and been buried, it is the son's responsibility to pray for his parents and to ask forgiveness for them.
en_old: When the mother dies, the son should lead her funeral prayer. These are the rights of parents upon their son. The Prophet of Allah said that when they die and are buried, it is the son's responsibility to pray for his parents and to seek forgiveness for them.

brh: کہ ئے اللہ کنا باوہ لمہ نا زی رحم کر دنکہ چناکی ٹی کنے غوار کریر ئے اللہ ئے لوچ اسوٹ کنے پچ جان کنے ناتو سر ئے لنگڑ اسوٹ لمہ خدمت کرے بلن کرے باوہ تینا لکھے کنے چرفے ئے اللہ عید کنے ایتس توٹا لمہ باوہ کنا زی
en: ...that: 'O Allah, have mercy on my father and mother, as they cared for me in childhood. O Allah, I was naked and they put clothes on my body; I was hungry; my mother served me and raised me; my father carried me around on his back; O Allah, at Eid they gave me [things]; my mother and father, on me...
en_old: ...that: "O Allah, have mercy on my parents as they cared for me in childhood. O Allah, I was naked and they clothed me; I was hungry, I could not walk, my mother served me and raised me, my father carried me on his back. O Allah, they gave me everything; my parents upon me...

brh: باز رحم کریرا داسو پیر و کمزور او یا اللہ ئے مارکو ورنا اوٹ کنا دعا تے لمہ باوا نا باراٹ قبول کر کنا لمہ باوا نازی رحم کر سبحان اللہ حضور پارے ارا تا لمہ باوا پیر مسور اولاد نزی ادا ذمہ وار
en: ...showed great mercy. Now they are old and weak, and, O Allah, I, their son, am young; accept my prayers for my mother and father, have mercy on my mother and father.' Subhanallah. The Prophet said that when the parents have grown old, this responsibility is upon the children...
en_old: ...showed great mercy. Now they are old and weak. O Allah, I, their son, am young now; accept my prayers for my parents, have mercy on my parents." Subhan Allah. The Prophet said that when the parents grow old, it is the children's responsibility...

brh: ذمہ واری ئے کہ لمہ باوہ کن دعا خوانبو۔ اور کنا ایلو ماک دائے تے ہم یات کبو، اگر باوہ لمہ اسہ قبرستان سیٹی او، نی ہموکا کاسہ برے سا، لیکن اینگ ہم پی سا، زیارت ہم پی سا، کل خواننگ ہم پی سا، دعا خواننگ ہم پی سا، قیامت دے لمہ باوہ نی میار ایتیرہ کہ چنا!
en: ...it is a responsibility: pray for your mother and father. And my brothers, remember this too: if your father and mother are in a graveyard and you go by there, but you don't even go in, don't visit them, don't recite the Qul, don't pray, then on the Day of Judgment your mother and father will reproach you: 'Child!
en_old: ...it is their responsibility to pray for their parents. And my sisters, remember this too: if your parents are in a graveyard and you pass by there, but you don't go in, don't visit, don't recite Qul, don't pray, then on the Day of Judgment your parents will reproach you: "Child!

brh: ننا وٹ ہناستو سہی لیکن ننے یادم کتوس ننے قل واللہ سے خوانتوس ننے ہچ نہ تیتوس کنا ایر و مار لمہ باوہ نا تینا اولاد زی حق او کہ باوہ لمہ اگر قبرستان ٹی او مار مسڑ ہموکا کارا تو مار زی ذمہ داری ئے کہ لمہ باوہ نا قبر کا کائے ہمے دا دعا
en: You passed by our side, fine, but you did not remember us, you did not even recite a Qul Huwallah for us, you gave us nothing at all.' My brothers and sons, parents have a right over their children: if the parents are in a graveyard and the son or daughter goes by there, then it is the son's responsibility to go to his parents' grave and [say] this prayer.
en_old: You passed by our side, fine, but you did not remember us, you did not recite Qul Huwa Allah for us, you gave us nothing." My brothers and sons, parents have a right over their children: if the parents are in a graveyard and the son or daughter passes by there, it is the son's responsibility to come to his parents' grave and make this prayer.

brh: او کنا ایلم تاکہ تینا لمہ باوہ نا حقاتے پورو کے حضرت حسن بصری رحمتہ اللہ علیہ بلو بزرگ سے بیر سے سئیں بلو بزرگ سے پارے بیت اللہ شریف ئے دا خیرات مریو بیت اللہ نا پن کے او کنا ایلم
en: ...O my brothers, so that one fulfills the rights of one's parents. Hazrat Hasan Basri (may Allah have mercy on him), a great elder, a pir, sir, a great elder, said: the noble House of Allah, may I be a sacrifice to the name of the House of Allah, O my brothers...
en_old: O my sisters, so that they fulfill the rights of their parents. Hazrat Hasan Basri (may Allah have mercy on him), a great saint, sir, the great saint said: "This is the House of Allah, is this a place for charity? You have invoked the name of the House of Allah." O my sisters...

brh: کامبو بزرگ پارنگ ٹی بیت اللہ ٹی طواف کیوا اسہ ورناؤ مار کس خناٹ کہ اودے بلو پچ سے نا کامبوس تافوک ئس کامبو ایتھارے نا کامبوس تافوک ئس بزرگ پارے او ورنائنگا مار کس
en: ...a basket. The elder says: I was doing tawaf at the House of Allah, and I saw a young lad who had a basket made of a big cloth tied on him, a basket [unclear] tied on him. The elder said, "O young lad...
en_old: The basket. A saint says: I was circumambulating at the House of Allah when I saw a young son who had a basket made of a big cloth tied on him, a sling basket tied on him. The saint said, "O young son...

brh: او نی بیت اللہ نا بے ادبی کیسہ کہ بیت اللہ نا دا کامبو خالی اف دانا تٹیک نا پیرنگا لومئی دا کامبو نا تٹیک نا پیرنگا لومئی ہفت میکو سال ئے
en: Oh, you are being disrespectful to the House of Allah, [bringing] this basket into the House of Allah!" "It is not empty; inside it is the old mother. Inside this basket is the old mother. It is the seventh year...
en_old: "Oh, you are being disrespectful to the House of Allah." (He said) "This basket is not empty; inside it is an old woman. Inside this basket is an old woman. This is the seventh year.

brh: کہ کنا لمہ پیری ئے تینا کوپہ غاتے لمہ یکا دادے حج کرفیوا۔ سبحان اللہ۔ اللہ اکبر۔ ئے حسن بصری بزرگ ئے دا مکہ شریف نا صفٹ ئے شام نا ملک نا صفٹ شام آن بے پشنٹ لیکن ہمے
en: ...that my mother is old; I carry my mother on my shoulders and make her perform the Hajj." Subhanallah. Allahu Akbar. "O Hasan Basri, O elder, I am on this journey to noble Mecca; I came on a journey from the land of Sham; I set out from Sham, but on these same...
en_old: My mother is old; I carry her on my shoulders and take her on Hajj." Subhan Allah. Allahu Akbar. "O Hasan Basri, O saint, this is the side of noble Mecca, and this is the side of the land of Sham (Syria); from Sham... but still...

brh: یک کوپہ غاتے، ہفتمی کو گمرئے تینا لمہ ء بڈ کے واتے، تینا آئی ہمے کا بڈ کے واتے وا، داتے بیت اللہ نا طواف ہم کرفیوا، ایلو ہم احکام آتے تے کل پورئو کیوا، قربانی والا حق آتے، کل پورئو کیوا
en: ...shoulders. This is the seventh round: I carry my mother on my back and bring her; I carry my mother on my back to this very place; I also take her around the House of Allah in tawaf, and I fulfill all the other rites as well; the obligations of the sacrifice, I fulfill them all."
en_old: ...on my shoulders. It is the seventh time I have carried my mother on my back, carried her to this very place. I take her around the House of Allah in tawaf, I fulfill all the other rites as well, the obligations of the sacrifice, I fulfill them all.

brh: ئے بزرگ ایت خبر ہفتمی کو گبرو ئے کرے کنا کانبوناتا ٹی وخت ئس تینا لختے دا پیرینگا لمے حج کرفیوا بیت اللہ ٹی طواف کرفیوا ئے بزرگ ایت خبر لم نا حق آ کنا زی خلاص مریرہ یا مفسہ سمجھ ارے سم تورے مارکو پانٹے اللہ نا والی
en: "O elder, tell me: this is the seventh Umrah I have done. On my shoulders, sometimes on my neck, I make this old mother perform Hajj and I take her around the House of Allah in tawaf. O elder, tell me, are my mother's rights upon me fulfilled or not?" Do you understand? Pay attention: the son is saying this to the friend of Allah.
en_old: "O saint, tell me, it is the seventh time I have done this; at times on my shoulders, on my back, I take this old mother on Hajj and take her around the House of Allah in tawaf. O saint, tell me, are my mother's rights upon me fulfilled or not?" Do you understand, the son says to the friend of Allah...

brh: او بزرگ ہفتمی کو سال ئے لکھے چرے فیول لمے سئیں لمہ نا حقاک پورا مسر متو اللہ اکبر بزرگ پارے قسم ئے کلے خدا نا او مار کونی سوال کرے رس دا زبنتو سئی ہفت وار نی پاسے لمہ
en: "O elder, this is the seventh year I have been carrying my mother around on my neck. Sir, have my mother's rights been fulfilled or not?" Allahu Akbar. The elder said, "I swear by God, O son, you have asked a question... sir, you say seven times; your mother...
en_old: "O saint, it is the seventh year I have carried my mother on my back. Sir, have my mother's rights been fulfilled or not?" Allahu Akbar. The saint said, "I swear by God, O son, you asked... you say seven times, mother...

brh: لمہ ئے تینا شام نا کوپا تے سنٹ لیکن اینے پاوہ ہفتاد گمرہ ہفت وار آ خا ہفتاد گمرہ شام نا ملک آن تینا لمہ ئے کوپا تت بیت اللہ ٹی طواف کرف لیکن کنا ایلم ئے دادے کہ مونا نن کے لمہ نا پنڈ نا چٹی وخت ئس نی تینا چپی خسا
en: you brought your mother on your shoulders from Syria, but I tell you: seventy Umrahs, not seven times but seventy Umrahs, even if you carried your mother on your shoulders from the land of Syria and took her around the House of Allah in tawaf..." But my brothers, this is because earlier, inside your mother's belly, at times you flung out your left...
en_old: You carried your mother on your shoulders from Sham, but I tell you, even seventy times, not seven but seventy times, if you carried your mother on your shoulders from the land of Sham and took her around the House of Allah, still..." But my sisters, this is because before, in the mother's womb, at times you kicked with your left...

brh: وخت ئس ناسی خساسہ، وخت ئس دوت ئے خساسہ، وخت ئس نت ئے خساسہ، ہمو تکلیف والا تھورواتے لمہ باوانا، ہفتاد وار اگر حج کرفتہ تبی لمہ نا ہمو اسہ نن نا تھورواتے شف کننگ کپیسا۔ نم نن ہم خستارون تے یا خستن؟
en: At times you flung out your right, at times you flung out your hand, at times you flung out your foot. Those painful favours of mother and father: even if you made her perform Hajj seventy times, you could not repay your mother's favour for even that one night. Didn't you and I kick as well, or did we?
en_old: ...at times you kicked with your head, at times with your hand, at times with your foot. Those painful hardships of the parents: even if you took her on Hajj seventy times, you could not repay the hardship of a single day of your mother's. Did we kick too, or not?

brh: ہم لمہ نا پنٹ اٹی۔ سئیں! بزرگ لکھنگ ٹی ئے کہ دنی ہست واری ئسن استا۔ اگر ہفتاد وار لمہ تینا کوپہ غات ہڈ، ہم لمہ نا امو تھور و شیف کننگ کپیسہ، کہ لمہ نا پنٹ اٹی نی خساس اتنے۔ وختس چپی، وختس راستی، وختس۔
en: also in the mother's belly. Sir! The elder writes that he said this: even if you carry your mother on your shoulders seventy times, you still cannot repay that favour of your mother, because in your mother's belly you kicked; sometimes left, sometimes right, sometimes...
en_old: ...also in the mother's womb. Sir! The saint writes that he said this: even if seventy times you carry your mother on your shoulders, you still cannot repay that hardship of the mother, because in the mother's womb you kicked; sometimes left, sometimes right, sometimes...

brh: نتے سرفیسہ، وقتس نتے سرفیسہ، امو لمہ نا تھور واد نی شیف کننگ کپیسہ، صرف اسٹ نا۔ داڑان معلوم مس کہ لمہ باوہ نا تھور واد، بندغ نا زی آ، اولاد نا زی آ تمام بازو کہ مچو زندگی اگر نن تینا لمہ باوہ ئے لیکھ
en: you would shake your feet, sometimes you would shake your feet. You cannot repay that favour of your mother, not even a single one. From this we learn that the favours of mother and father on a person, on their children, are so very many that even if all our lives we carried our mother and father around on our necks,
en_old: ...you moved your feet, sometimes you turned your feet. You cannot repay that hardship of the mother, not even of a single one. From this we learn that the hardships of parents upon a person, upon children, are so great that even if for our whole life we carry our parents on our back...

brh: ئے چرے فن ہم لمبا تھورا چیف کن کپن۔ عائشہ پارے نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ضعیفہ پارے کنا ایلوماک حضرت ابوبکر صدیق نا مسڑ پارے محمد عربی تو نوار تولوک اٹ تو ایڑا بندغ بس۔ اماں عائشہ نی تاتن قربان۔
en: we still could not repay our parents' favours. Aisha said... the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him)... the lady said, my brothers, the daughter of Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq said: "I was sitting together with Muhammad the Arab when two people came." Mother Aisha, may we be sacrificed for you.
en_old: ...we still cannot repay their long hardship. Aisha said, the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him)... my sisters, the daughter of Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq said: Muhammad the Arab was sitting in prayer when a man came. Mother Aisha, may I be sacrificed for you.

brh: دا تورات پاروکو آئسے آئی پارے تولوکٹ اسہ ورناس مونٹی اسہ پیروز پدتٹے نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کنا خڑک تولوک ہراتم بسر تو ورنا مالو ڈغارے زنڈا پیرنگا پدمبہ زنڈا تو حضور اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ورنا
en: The narrator of this, Mother Aisha, said: "While we were sitting, a young man came in front and an old man behind. The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) was sitting near me. When they came, the young man sat down on the ground first, and the old man sat down after him." Then the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said to the young man,
en_old: This is narrated; Aisha said: a young man was sitting in front and an old man behind, and the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) was sitting near me. When they came, the young man sat down on the ground first and the old father sat down after him. Then the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said, young man...

brh: نا پارے او ورنا پچیسئی پدا پیرنگانے تون دیر پی کنا ابائے ہندے سئی ابائے کنا اللہ اکبر نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پارے کنا ئے تے خپ تور اگر دانا ابائے نم پدون کیس دا باول من مونٹی اسل نی گپ پی باول
en: "O young man, who is this old man behind you, with you?" "He is my father; this, sir, is my father." Allahu Akbar. The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said, "Listen to me: if you keep this father of yours behind you... let this father be in front; never step ahead of your father.
en_old: He said, O young man, after this, when you walk with your old father, say 'my father'. Allahu Akbar. The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said, look, if you have kept this father of yours behind you... keep your father in front, and never call him by his name.

brh: نمونٹی مرے مار پدت مرے کنا محمد نا سموخ تے خوش مروئی باوغان مونٹی نیمہ فیس اشرف نم توار بندے رکھو تنے نا ہا سئی نمام حال تو پورا دے سئی شام نی دیکھ لیں گے
en: Let him be in front and let the son be behind; it will make my Muhammad happy." In front of the father... [background voices:] half fee... Ashraf, keep your voices down... your whole situation, the whole day... we'll see in the evening.
en_old: Whether it's in front of you or behind, my Muhammad's friends will be happy; in front of father, half fee, Ashraf, keep your voice down... the whole situation, all day... in the evening you'll see.

brh: نا! بیلاوینی نا غٹ تیار متورو تو آسمان ئم بٹیک۔ بس ننا ٹیم ہم تینائی نا۔ پیغمبر پارے او صحابہ ورنا! ایروان پد! باوہ نا مونٹی گام کپیس۔ باوہ مونٹی مرے، نی پدٹ مر، ئے پیغمبر نا فیصلہ نا دے۔
en: No! If all of yours are not ready, then the sky will fall too. Well, our time is our own too. The Prophet said, "O young companion! From today on, do not step ahead of your father. Let your father be in front and you be behind." This is the Prophet's ruling.
en_old: No! If the ... is not ready, the sky will split. Just our team is our own too. The Prophet said, O young companion! From today on, do not step ahead of your father. Let your father be in front and you stay behind; this is the Prophet's ruling.

brh: پہاوڑہ ارس نی پنگ مر پارے داہی تم خفتور ارا مجلس تے باوت نا وار بسستو دن کپیس نی مالو زنڈ باوت سلوک مرے ننا مالو باوے پیرنگا ئے تولف گڈا نی تولٹی محمد نا فیصلہ کھنا نادے
en: Be careful, he said: from now on, listen: in whatever gathering you come together with your father, do not do this. You sat down first while your father remained standing. First seat your old father, then sit down yourself. This is Muhammad's ruling.
en_old: ...listen, be careful, he said: from now on, whenever your father is present in a gathering, do not do this. You sat down first while your father was still standing. First seat your old father, then sit down yourself. This is the ruling of Muhammad.

brh: دا معلومات کہ باوہ مار وار مریر اسہ مجلس ٹی سر مسر باوہ مار وار مسر اسہ کچاری سیٹی سر مسر اول باوہ تولے گڑا مار کو تولے پا محمد عربی نا فیصلہ نا دے حضور اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پارہ او صحابی
en: This is the lesson: when father and son are together and arrive at a gathering, when father and son together arrive at a council, the father should sit first and then the son should sit. Say: this is the ruling of Muhammad the Arab. The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said, "O companion,
en_old: This is the teaching: when father and son come together to a gathering, when father and son come together to a court session, the father should sit first and then the son should sit. Say: this is the ruling of Muhammad of Arabia. The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said, O companion...

brh: او ورنا پدی یا رسول اللہ پئی تے کنے دا خوف تور ہرا تم لمے توار کریس باوے توار کریس پنتے ہلپیسی محمد ناراض مرے وا ابا ئے ابا کر آئی کر لمے آئی کر او ابا او آئی انن توار کر خدا ہم راضی مرے کے محمد ہم راضی مرے
en: O young man, from now on" - O Messenger of Allah - "listen to me: whenever you call your mother or call your father, do not use their names; Muhammad will be displeased. Call your father 'Abba', call your mother 'Ami'; call them 'O Abba', 'O Ami' like this, so that God is pleased and Muhammad is pleased too."
en_old: The young man then said, O Messenger of Allah, now I have this fear: whenever I call my mother or call my father, if I call them by name, Muhammad will be displeased. So call your father 'Abba' and call your mother 'Ammi'. Call them 'O Abba', 'O Ammi' like this, so that God is pleased and Muhammad is pleased too.

brh: پا لمہ باوانہ پنا ہم الوئیف ہا سئیں لمہ باوانہ پنا ہم الوئیف آئی کتا وار کتا ابا کتا وار کتا لیکن پنا الوئیف انتئے کہ پاک محمد عربی شریعت خواجہ پیغمبر پارے خبردار
en: Say it: do not call your mother and father by their names either. Yes, sir, do not call your mother and father by their names either. Say 'Ami' as many times as you like, say 'Abba' as many times as you like, but do not call them by name, because the pure Muhammad the Arab, master of the Sharia, the Prophet, said: beware!
en_old: Do not call your mother and father by their names either, sir. Do not call your mother and father by their names. Say 'Ammi' as many times as you like, say 'Abba' as many times as you like, but do not call them by name, because the pure Muhammad of Arabia, master of the Sharia, the Prophet, said: beware.

brh: ار دا ہیتم بنیس کہ لمہ باوے کرینگ تفیس سئیں اینو پگت لمہ باوے شاماتٹ خلیرہ لمہ باوے لٹاک لگیرہ ورنائیں گاماک تلا لمہ باوتے کٹنگ چیوراتہ چٹی باو
en: And hear this point too: that you must not abuse your mother and father. Sir, today, in these times, parents are slapped, parents are beaten with sticks, and young men raise their feet against their parents...
en_old: And this is the point, sir: you must hold your parents dear. Today, in this age, parents are being insulted, parents are being kicked, young men raise their feet against their parents and cut them off...

brh: باوہ ماتے بے عزت کننگ ٹی او خلکن کشنگ ٹی او قران کنا مون ٹی تخوکے اللہ نا قران نا فیصلہ نادے کہ اگر بیا باوہ لمہ راضی او تو جنت ملک اگر باوہ لمہ ناراض او تا جنت ملنگ کپک پیغمبر رحمتہ اللعالمین صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم
en: in disgracing their father and mother and in throwing them out of the house. And the Quran is placed before me; the ruling of Allah's Quran is that if your father and mother are pleased, paradise opens for you, and if your father and mother are displeased, paradise cannot open. The Prophet, Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him),
en_old: In disrespecting father and mother and throwing them out of the house... the Quran is placed in front of me, and the ruling of Allah's Quran is that if your father and mother are pleased, you get paradise, and if your father and mother are displeased, you cannot get paradise. The Prophet, Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him)...

brh: وسلم این اللہ نا قران پاریک اللہ زپاتی کلہ پیغمبر رحمتہ اللعالمین دنیا نا بندہ تے دائم راستی پا رب کوم قران پارے ارا بندہ نا اسنہ تٹی لمہ باوہ نا عزت ارے لیکن او ظاہر ٹی بے ادبی کیرے دیخو غلطی
en: (peace be upon him). Now Allah's Quran says, Allah has said... The Prophet, Mercy to the Worlds, always told the people of the world the truth: the Lord said in the Quran, a servant who has respect for his mother and father in his heart but is disrespectful outwardly has made a mistake,
en_old: ...(peace be upon him). Now Allah's Quran says, Allah said... the Prophet, Mercy to the Worlds, always told the people of the world the truth. Say, the Lord said in the Quran: a servant who has respect for his parents in his heart but is outwardly disrespectful has made a big mistake...

brh: غلطی ئس کرے اللہ تعالی نا تٹی ئے ئے استاد تا خواجہ ریٹ نما استنا تٹی لمہ باوا نا عزت ارے لیکن بانہ باٹنٹا نوئی تس کرے اسکے بے ادبی مس نا اللہ سے پاٹی خبردار داسہ توبہ تا امر گڑائے خدا نا گناہ معاف کیوا اگر توبہ تا متہ
en: made a mistake. Allah Almighty [says]: ... in your heart there is respect for your mother and father, but with your mouth you said something, so disrespect happened. Allah is saying: beware, now repent; then I, God, will forgive the sin. If you did not repent,
en_old: ...made a mistake. Allah Almighty says: O my servant, there is respect for your parents in your heart, but your tongue said something, so disrespect happened. Allah says: beware, now repent, and then I will forgive the sin, if you repent...

brh: قاضی خدا نا گناہ کنے قیامت ہلوٹ پیغمبر پارے رحمت للعالمین صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پاننگ ٹئے انو گناہ رے دنیا نا چٹی کہ اللہ تبارک و تعالی امو گناہ نا خاطر اگر حلف قیامت اسکان حلف تو اللہ تینوں کننگ
en: God the Judge [says]: I will take up the sin on the Day of Judgment. The Prophet, Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him), is saying: there are such sins in the world that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, may hold them back until the Day of Judgment, and then Allah himself is able to
en_old: ...God says, these sins of yours I will not hold until Judgment Day. The Prophet, Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him), said: there are such sins in the world that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, may hold off for until Judgment Day, and then Allah will deal with them...

brh: کیک لیکن باوہ لمہ نا نافرمانی قیامت اسکان الپک او دے دنیا ٹی ہم سزا ایتھوئے یعنی پین ہنو گناہ بندغ کیک کہ اگر اللہ ہمو گناہ نا سزا داسہ تف دنیا ٹی آخرت ایٹی انن مریخ لیکن پیغمبر پارے لمہ باوہ نا نافرمانی
en: deal with them. But disobedience to father and mother He does not hold back until the Day of Judgment; He will punish the person in this world too. That is, a person commits other such sins that, if Allah does not give the punishment for that sin now in this world, it will be so in the hereafter. But the Prophet said that disobedience to mother and father,
en_old: ...but disobedience to father and mother He does not leave until Judgment Day; He punishes the person in this world too. That is, there are other sins a person commits where, if Allah gives the punishment for them now in this world, then it will be so in the hereafter too. But the Prophet said that disobedience to father and mother...

brh: اللہ سئیں قیامت اسکان ہلپک دنیا ٹی او دے ذلیل خوار ضرور کیک اور دنیا ٹی نم ہبو مچو علاقہ ہبو کہ باوہ لمہ نا نافرمان دنیا ٹی لازما ذلیل مریک اور رحمت اللعالمین صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پارے اللہ نا نبی دنیا نا بندہ تے سمجھائے
en: Allah, sir, does not hold back until the Day of Judgment; in this world He will surely disgrace and humiliate that person. And look around in this world, look at your whole area: one who disobeys his father and mother is inevitably disgraced in this world. And the Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him) said; Allah's Prophet explained to the people of the world
en_old: ...Allah, sir, does not leave it until Judgment Day; He will surely disgrace and humiliate that person in this world. And look around your whole area in this world, and you will see that someone who disobeys his father and mother is always disgraced in this world. And the Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him), Allah's Prophet, explained to the people of the world...

brh: دا فے کہ لمہ باوہ نا حق آک انتو کنا ایلم آک کنا دوست آک پیغمبر رحمتہ للعالمین صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم تائی تم پارے کہ لمہ باوہ ہر کس کہ سوب نا دے ٹک نا ٹائم ئے دے ابتداء شروعات ئے ہرا بندغ تینا لمہ باوہ ئے راضی کرے
en: this: what the rights of mother and father are. My brothers, my friends, the Prophet, Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him), said at that time that whoever, in the morning, at sunrise, at the very beginning of the day, whichever person pleases his mother and father,
en_old: ...what the rights of father and mother are. My brothers, my friends, the Prophet, Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him), said in his time that whoever, from the morning, from the very start of the day, pleases his father and mother...

brh: او اللہ مے اعلان کے کہ او ملائکاک دا ورنا اینگا مار کو تینا پیرینگا لومے راضی کرے تینا پیرینگا باوے خوش کرے نی سینگھڑ ہمک کن اللہ پانٹی جنت نا ایرا دروازہ داڑ کن ملو سبحان اللہ کہ پیغمبر پارے ارا ورنا اینگا بندہ مارکو
en: Allah makes an announcement: "O angels, this young son has pleased his old mother and made his old father happy; you go for him." Allah is saying: "Open two doors of paradise for him." Subhan Allah! For the Prophet said that whichever young servant, whichever son
en_old: ...Allah announces: O angels, this young son pleased his old mother and made his old father happy. Go for him, Allah says: the eight doors of paradise are opened for him. Subhan Allah! The Prophet said that any young servant, any son...

brh: تینا لمہ باوے سوب نا ناراض کرے اللہ پانڈو ملائکاک جی اللہ زو کبو دوزخ نا ایرا دروازہ ملبو کہ دا پیرین تینا لمہ باوے کاوڑے فینے ئے اللہ داڑکن ایرا دروازہ دوزخ نا ملوا ہنو خاص کنا تو دوزخ ٹی تباہ برباد مرو حضرت موسی علیہ السلام امرو بلو نبی سے
en: angers his mother and father in the morning, Allah says: "O angels!" "Yes, Allah." "Quickly, open two doors of hell, because this one has angered his old mother and father." Allah [says]: for him two doors of hell will open. Such a person will be ruined and destroyed in hell. Hazrat Musa (peace be upon him), what a great prophet he was,
en_old: ...who angers his father and mother in the morning, Allah says: angels! Yes, Allah. Go quickly and open the eight doors of hell, because this person has angered his old father and mother. Allah says, for him the eight doors of hell are opened. Such a person will be ruined and destroyed in hell. Hazrat Musa (peace be upon him), such a great prophet...

brh: صحیح؟ نبیسے نا؟ عرض، عرض دعا خوان اللہ نا دربار اٹ کہ ئے اللہ! بھلا جنتی کن تو پین کسس ہم مروئی اوار، پینس ہم مروئی نبیسے اوٹ۔ نبی نا درجہ ہم بڑزا، نبی نا جنت ہم عزت۔
en: Right? He was a prophet, wasn't he? He made a request, a supplication at Allah's court: "O Allah! Well, in paradise will someone else also be together with me? Will someone else be there too? I am a prophet." A prophet's rank is high, and a prophet's paradise is an honour too.
en_old: Right? A prophet, wasn't he? He made a request, a prayer at Allah's court: O Allah! Surely someone else will be with me in paradise too, someone else will be with me. I am a prophet. A prophet's rank is high, and a prophet's paradise is an honour too.

brh: تعالی سئیں جنتی پین کسس ہم کنتو مروئی تو اللہ صیب پارے ہاؤ موسی اگر پارے نس تو فلانی شارتٹی دا پنیا بندغ تولوکے ئنا نی تون جنت ئے وار مروئی سئیں ئے نبی دا عامو بندغ ئے
en: "Almighty, sir, will someone else also be with me in paradise?" Then Allah said, "Yes, Musa. If you go, a man of this name lives in such-and-such town; he will be together with you in paradise." Sir, O Prophet, this is an ordinary man.
en_old: ...Almighty, sir, will someone else be with me in paradise? Then Allah said, yes, Musa, if you go, a man of this name is sitting in such-and-such city; he will be your companion in paradise. Sir, O Prophet, this is an ordinary man...

brh: حضرت موسی حیران مس کہ دا ہمڑے حضرت موسی علیہ السلام برے کا او ہمو بندغ ہریو تو سئی کہ جنتی کن تو نوار مریک ہمیکہ پیش تما پٹ سئی راہ ہمو شہرے سرمس ہمو خلکے سرمس دنو راہ اللہ اکبر سے ورنا سے تولوک ئے صوبہ کے کاسائی سے
en: Hazrat Musa was astonished, wondering who this could be. Hazrat Musa (peace be upon him) said, "Let me go and see that man who will be together with me in paradise." As soon as he set out on the road, he reached that town, reached that settlement. On the way, Allahu Akbar, a young man is sitting, in the morning, a butcher.
en_old: Hazrat Musa was astonished at who this could be. Hazrat Musa (peace be upon him) went to see that man, to see who would be his companion in paradise. He set out on the road, reached that city, reached that place. On the way, Allahu Akbar, a young man is sitting there in the morning, a butcher...

brh: سبحان اللہ! اندو بہا کیک سئیں؟ الے کبین ہتی گھڑزان۔ نما نن کے کیا زیک۔ ہاں سئیں بیس تے ہلبو ولدا پانزدہ بہا کبو انوں کیرے۔ بیست و پنچے تو کروڑ ئے لیکن پانزدہ مشکل ئے سئیں؟
en: Subhan Allah! How much are you selling it for, sir? ... Yes sir, take the twenty, then sell at fifteen, do it like that. Make it twenty-five; fifteen is hard, sir?
en_old: Glory be to God! How much does this cost, sir? ... Yes sir, take twenty, then make it fifteen... Twenty-five is too much, but fifteen is hard, sir?

brh: حضرت موسی ہرا سبحان اللہ دا امر و بندغ سے کہ ہلنگ تے کویت تننگ تے ہڑساں پشاید ئنا عمل تاننا خباز قبول ئے کہ کنتو جنت نا وار مریک ولنا پی دا دنو عمل ئس پف کہ جنت نا نبی تو نا وار مریک
en: Hazrat Musa looked: "Subhan Allah, what kind of man is this, busy with taking and giving? Perhaps his deeds are so accepted that he will be together with me in paradise. But I see no such deed in him that would make him a companion of a prophet in paradise."
en_old: Prophet Moses said, "Glory be to God, what sort of person will this be..." He asked which of his deeds were so accepted that he would be his companion in Paradise. Then he was told that there is someone with such deeds that he will be your companion in Paradise.

brh: ئے اگر لمہ باوے ناراض کرے تو دوزخ ئے داڑان معلوم ئس کہ جنت اور دوزخ لمہ باوے کن، کنا ایلو مار، داڑان معلوم ئس کہ لمہ باوے راضی کرے تو جنت ملوئے، اگر لمہ باوہ ناراض مسور تو دوزخ ہم ملوئے، دوزخ نا عذابک تمام سخت
en: ...is. If you displease your mother and father, then it is Hell. From this it is clear that Paradise and Hell lie with one's mother and father, my brothers and sons. From this it is clear that if you please your mother and father you will get Paradise, and if your mother and father become displeased you will get Hell as well, and the torments of Hell are all severe.
en_old: And if you displease your mother and father, it is Hell. From this we learn that Paradise and Hell depend on mother and father, my other brothers. From this we learn that if you please your mother and father you will get Paradise, and if your mother and father are displeased, you will get Hell. The torments of Hell are all severe.

brh: او پاک رحمت اللعالمین صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پارے اللہ تبارک و تعالی دنیا نا بندہاتے پاننگ ٹی ئے خبردار لمہ باوہ ء راضی کرے رے کنے راضی کرے رے ہر کس تینا لمہ باوہ ء ناراض کرے پہ خدائے ہم ناراض کرے کتاباتے ٹی انو نو واقعہ لمہ
en: That pure one, the Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him), said that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, is telling the people of the world: beware, whoever pleases his mother and father has pleased me, and whoever displeases his own mother and father has displeased God too. In the books there are such incidents about mother...
en_old: That pure Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him) said that Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, tells the servants of the world: beware, whoever pleases his mother and father has pleased me, and whoever displeases his mother and father has displeased God as well. In the books there are such events about mother...

brh: ہم باون بارٹ بلنگٹیو قسم ء کنے خدا نا است لرزک خنت خننگ کے توننگ کپسا کنا ایلو مار لیکن دان پنزہ صدی نا مسلمان تا استاک ایناخو سخت مسنو کہ قران ء ہم بنینا نبی نا فرمان ء ہم بنینا لیکن مسلمان عمل کپک لمہ
en: ...[when one] hears [them], I swear by God, the heart trembles, the eyes... you cannot hold back, my brothers and sons. But in this fifteenth century the hearts of Muslims have become so hard that we hear the Quran, and we hear the Prophet's command too, but the Muslim does not act on it. Mother...
en_old: ...and father that if they are told, I swear, by God, the heart trembles, the eyes cannot bear to look, you cannot hold back, my other brothers. But in this fifteenth century the hearts of Muslims have become so hard that they hear the Quran and hear the Prophet's command, yet Muslims do not act on it. Mother...

brh: لمہ باوہ نا عزت ء کپک لیکن فرمانبردار انگا چنا ہمودے کہ قران ء بنگ تینا لمہ باوہ نا عزت ء کرے اور جنت نا خواجہ مس۔ سبحان اللہ! کتاباتے ٹی بریک اسہ ورنہ ء مار کوس لمہ تا پیر ئس اندا زلمہ تا
en: ...they do not respect their mother and father. But the obedient child is the one who heard the Quran, respected his own mother and father, and became the master of Paradise. Glory be to God! It is told in the books that there was a young man, a son; his mother was old, this mother of his...
en_old: ...they do not respect their mother and father. But the obedient child is the one who heard the Quran, respected his mother and father, and became the owner of Paradise. Glory be to God! It comes in the books that there was a young man, a son, whose mother was old, this mother of his...

brh: سئیں پیرس پارے لمہ پجی کنا چنا پارے لمہ یا حج کعبہ کنا شوق ء کنے موکل ات پارے ابا کنا حیاتی پورہ وی ئے پیروٹ کنے دا دلسا نہ کنے پی چنا فی درپدر مریوا اسہ سال صبر ک ئے کیف گڑان یکہ حج ء دا سال
en: Sir, [she was] old. He said, 'Mother...' [She said,] 'My child.' He said, 'Mother, Hajj to the Kaaba is my wish, give me permission.' She said, 'Dear, my life is nearly over, I am old, don't [leave] me like this, son; I will be left wandering from door to door. Be patient for one year, then after that go on Hajj; this year...'
en_old: Sir, an old woman. He said: mother... my child... he said: mother, Hajj to the Kaaba is my desire, give me permission. She said: son, my life is nearly over, I am old, do not leave me like this, son, you will wander from door to door. Be patient for one year, then after that go to Hajj; this year...

brh: ثالث ثالث رہنگا اورا لمہ کئیتو سئیں ولدا پی لمہ نی کئیتوس دا سمو کلیت کنے کاوچے پی ابا انت حیاتی تو خدانا دوٹی چوری مدیکہ صبر کر بلکہ کاو گڑا نی یکا ہجے در مہربانی کر دا گمرو ہمپا
en: A year passed there and the mother did not die, sir. Then he said, 'Mother, you did not die; this year [let] me go.' She said, 'Dear, what is life? It is in God's hand... be patient; maybe when I die, then you go on Hajj. Be kind...' This misguided one...
en_old: ...stayed... the mother did not die, sir. Then he said: mother, you did not die... give me leave. She said: son, what of life, it is in God's hand... be patient; rather, when I die, then you go to Hajj, be kind... this misguided one...

brh: ولا ایلو سال ہرا کہ لمہ کہیتو، سئیں؟ دا بندہ کنا سمجھانو کہ لمہ باوہ پیر مسور بدس کیت۔ او سے مائی پیرو بل بلسس ہراتم باز بیمار مس تو مار تو رمٹ دردی ئس نا۔ دا بے مراد آک ماک لمہ غاتر بیزارو۔
en: Then the next year, when the mother [still] did not die, sir? These people have understood that when parents grow old, [they are] something bad. That old woman... when she became very ill, then the son... These wretched sons are fed up with their mothers.
en_old: Then next year, when mother dies, sir? This servant thought that when parents grow old, ... That old woman became very ill, and the son felt pain (?). These unfortunate ones are fed up with their mothers.

brh: اوڑے رمکہ بہ کفن ہلبو لمہ ہنو بچپک لمہ کے دائے تے بنکاو پی باوئی مکھے وکن کفن ہلس باوئی جوڑٹ یعنی مارنا ئنا رضاس کا کہ لمہ کے جان کل چھٹے کفن کے ب خرچ کے ہر دے نا بیماری تا نا علاجاتن خرچاتن لمہ کے دا سنت کرے کاری
en: There [he would say], 'Run, buy a shroud, mother won't survive; mother is dying...' ... 'I will buy the shroud'... That is, the son's wish was that his mother would die and her life would be completely over, so that he would spend [once] on a shroud rather than on the expenses of her treatments for illness every day... he did this to his mother...
en_old: ...there... bring a shroud; the mother... the son was saying I would bring a shroud for father... meaning the son's wish was that his mother would die, so that he would be free of spending on the shroud, and of the daily expenses of her illness and treatments; he did this to his mother...

brh: کہ توئ تو لمہ پارے چوریسہ سال ئس سل ہر انتظار کر بلکہ کئے غڈان یکہ حج ازر بہرحال مسہ سال ئس کن ہر آ لمہ کئے تو فیر لمہ داسہ نت تے دمے وا نی کئے پی سے نا سہی
en: ...when she did not die, the mother said, '[Son], one more year, stay, wait, be patient; maybe I will die, and after that you [go] on Hajj.' Anyway, three years [passed] and the mother did not die. Then [he said], 'Mother, now [my] feet... you do not die...'
en_old: When he said this, his mother said, "Son, wait a year, be patient. Maybe I'll send you on Hajj. Anyway, wait three years." Then the mother said, "Now my legs... and you..."

brh: کا حجے بس موکل ایتیس نامرضی تفیس نامرضی حجے کاوہ پوا ہی موکل تفر نی پا لمہ موکل تتو پا ایتیس نامرضی تفیس نامرضی حجے کاوہ نی کائے پیسہ کتاب اکلے کرم مار کو پیش تما ہنا ہنا سے شار سے ٹی شام نورا
en: '...I am going to Hajj, that's enough. Whether you give permission or don't give it, as you wish, I am going to Hajj.' [She said,] 'I will not give permission.' The mother did not give permission. He said, 'Whether you give it or don't give it, as you wish, I am going to Hajj.' He took money and books, the son set out, he went on and on, and in the evening [he reached] a town...
en_old: "I am going on Hajj. Give me permission or don't, whether you like it or not, I am going on Hajj." The mother did not give permission. He said, "Give permission or don't, I am going on Hajj." He took money and books and set off, and in the evening he reached a city.

brh: دا کہ مسیٹی خاچو واران کا اینا مسیٹی وضو کر نفل آتے سلیس نن نیم منٹ ایبی مسیت نا وٹی ہوراسس کموڈی دزاک بسو اینگن خواجہ غاک سما کریر دز سامان ہرفے سامان کلور کے داسن ماننا اورا کم پورو ئے تا
en: [He thought,] 'I will sleep in this mosque.' He performed ablution in the mosque and stood for nafl prayers. At midnight... beside the mosque there was a house... thieves came... The owners woke up; the thief picked up the goods... the goods...
en_old: He said, "I came to this mosque, performed ablution in the mosque and was praying nafl. Within half a minute, inside the mosque... the thieves came here. The owners found out that a thief had taken the goods, and the goods were placed..."

brh: دا موراٹی تین استافوس ایرا گڈو ایرا ڈو سئیں دا زہرا موراٹی کوٹی ڈی در سبحان اللہ ہنو ساریرت ہنو سارے ئے چھتیس کا سئیں دا یکا لیپا کو بدا قبرٹی نا لیپاتی ئے دوزخ
en: [Largely unintelligible:] ... in this ... himself ... both ... cut ... both ..., sir, this ... Glory be to God ... he went ... thirty-six ..., sir, this ... in the grave ... Hell.
en_old: In this mosque he stood... in this mosque... Subhan Allah... thirty-six... in the grave... hell.

brh: او زہمری کرے ہنگن کے ہکل مستا نرا مسیت مسیت بس اورا کے ہلنگے وا ہمو دز کے گگڑاتے ئنا دان وٹی تخا دا نفل ٹی یار سلو کے لمے ہلان نران ہجکائے ہمو سامان تخا نان وٹی جنتا بھتہ
en: He [the thief] did [his work]; when an outcry went up there, he fled and came to the mosque, the mosque. There... that thief put the things beside this one, who was standing in nafl prayer, the one who had left his mother and set off for Hajj; he put those goods beside him...
en_old: He went on, and when night fell he went to the mosque. Then a thief went into a house to steal, and he put the stolen goods inside the mosque where this man was praying voluntary (nafl) prayers. The people of the house woke up, and the thief had left the goods inside...

brh: دا کروم کر زبر سور پیڑے دز مس ویٹی۔ بس سور دا نفل ڈسلوکی۔ دا کشامت ٹھوکانت۔ اورار سامان وٹی تخوکے۔ حل کر دوت تفے۔ سدھا درتے بادشاہ غے۔ بادشاہ پارے امرے؟ پیسندہ دز حبہ؟
en: ...the thief went in. [The people] came; this one was standing in nafl prayer... the goods were placed beside him. They seized him, tied his hands, and took him straight to the king. The king said, 'What is it?' [They said,] '[He is] a thief...'
en_old: He did this. A thief went in. This man was standing in nafl prayer. They followed the tracks, and the goods had been placed inside. They seized him, tied his hands and took him straight to the king. The king said, "What is it?" They said, "This is a thief."

brh: اوڑا غان دزی کرے مسیت ٹی نفل شروع کرے تہجدے شروع کرے سامان وٹی کے خوک پیتم بادشاہ کم جوان و اسرہ دیندار اسرہ داسنا تا مار ہلو را داسنا گبار دزی کبو ننے کنبو ئے بادشاہ ک دیندار اسرہ پارے دا
en: [They said,] 'He stole from there, started nafl prayers in the mosque, started the Tahajjud prayer, with the goods placed beside him.' The king was quite a good man, a pious one. [He said,] 'Nowadays... commit theft... us...' Because the king was pious, he said, 'This...'
en_old: From there the thief stole and put the goods inside the mosque, where the man had started his nafl and tahajjud prayers. The king was a good and pious man. He said, "People like this steal and slander us." Being pious, the king said this...

brh: دا دے مسٹیکو سزا ملنگے اولیکو سزا کہ دا دزی کرے دا نہ دوئی گڈبو انت کہ بدوئی تا گڈبو تا ایراٹمیکو کہ دا مسیت ٹی سامان تے خا دا بلو ڈوس کرے نی نت تے تم گڈبو
en: 'This one must be given three punishments. The first punishment: since he stole, cut off both his hands. Why? Because... cut off his hands. The second: since he put the goods in the mosque, he did this big [wrong], so cut off his feet too.'
en_old: He must be punished. The first punishment: because he stole, cut off both his hands. Second... Third: because he put the goods in the mosque and did something so terrible, cut off his legs too.

brh: مسٹمیکو کہ ولدا نفل آتے شروع کرے بزرگ آتے بدنام کرے کا۔ مون تہ مان کبو بیشے سوار کبو شہر ٹی اعلان کبو کہ ارا مسیت نا وٹ آن دزی کرے سامان مسیت ٹی تخا نفل آتے تے شروع مس بادشاہ نا فیصلہ نا دے کورٹ آن دونو تادی مریک۔
en: 'The third: since he then started nafl prayers and brought disgrace on the pious elders, blacken his face, mount him on a donkey, and announce in the city that this is the one who stole from beside the mosque, put the goods in the mosque and started nafl prayers.' In the days of the kings' judgments, this is how [punishment] came from the courts.
en_old: "Fourth: because he then started praying nafl and brought disgrace on the pious, blacken his face, mount him on a donkey and announce in the city that this is the man who stole from a house beside the mosque, put the goods in the mosque and started praying nafl." The king's decision was carried out. In those days courts decided such cases quickly.

brh: دوئی تم گڈار، ہا دوئی تا، نا سلومئے پاریکے چوا کئیسہ، دو نم بلیرفی، نت تم گڈار، ئے سرمانے تم مون کرے، بیش ئے سر، بادشاہ پہ اعلان کبو، کرکس
en: They cut off his hands, yes, both his hands... [because he] was standing [in prayer]... both his hands... they cut off his feet too, they blackened his face, [put him] on a donkey; the king [said], 'Make the announcement'...
en_old: "Cut off both his hands, yes, both. Because he stood praying, cut off both his hands, cut off his legs too, blacken his face, mount him on a donkey, and make an announcement on the king's behalf."

brh: دونو کارم کرو تو دونو سزا ملیک، پی بادشاہ مہربانی کا، دونو گڈنگم سئی، نت کنے گڈاسم جوان کریس، مون نی کنے مونکریسم جوان کریس، بے شیم سوار کرے کرے بالکل حقدار اٹ، لیکن اعلان غلط۔
en: Whoever does such a deed gets such a punishment. He said, 'King, please be kind. Cutting off my hands is right; you did well to cut off my feet too; you did well to blacken my face; [mounting me] on a donkey, I fully deserve it. But the announcement is wrong.'
en_old: "Do such deeds and you get such punishment." He said, "King, have mercy. Cutting off my hands is right. You did well to cut off my legs, you did well to blacken my face, and mounting me on a donkey is fully deserved. But the announcement is wrong."

brh: ئنا اعلان کے کس نہ کہ مسیت نا بغلن اوران ارکا دزی کرے سامان مسیت ٹی تخا نفل شروع کرے او دے دس ہزار ملیک ئنا اعلان نی من پر اعلان دے خماٹا کہ ارکس پیرنگا لمے تن اورا ٹی بٹی حجائی نا اوڑتن دروتادی مریک
en: 'Your announcement is that someone stole from the house beside the mosque, put the goods in the mosque and started nafl prayers... Instead of your announcement, make this announcement: that whoever leaves his old mother at home and [goes] to Hajj, this is how he is dealt with.'
en_old: "Your announcement is that someone stole from a house next to the mosque, put the goods in the mosque and started praying nafl. Instead, make this announcement: whoever leaves his old mother and goes on Hajj without her permission, this is what happens to him."

brh: مینگل صاحب منت واری، پارو ڈی ہمری پیسہ ایت دادے، خدا نا قسم ئے دز افٹ، لمہ تنے ہلانٹ، پیر انگا لمہ ئے موکل تتو کنے ہلانٹ بسونٹ، دا ہمو سزا ئے اللہ نا نیم تنے، او رتانہ مسلمان، پیر
en: Mengal Sahib, thank you... [he] says... money... [The man said,] 'By God, I am not a thief. I left my mother; my old mother did not give me permission, and I left [her] and came. This is that punishment, in God's name.' O Muslims, the old...
en_old: Thank you, Mengal sahib... "By God, I am not a thief. I left my mother. My old mother did not give me permission, and I left her and came. This is that punishment, in the name of Allah." O Muslims, the old...

brh: پیرنگا لمہ نا اجازت آن سوا، حج اینٹی ئے دو نم بلیر پی نت ہم گڈپ پی مونی تنے مونکرف پی بیشم سوار کرف پی تنے، دادا معلوم نس، دا انو بلو خراب و عمل سے، انو خراب و گناہ سے کہ اللہ دا غٹ ہم نریفک، او۔
en: Because he went on Hajj without his old mother's permission, his hands were cut off, his feet were cut off too, his face was blackened, and he was mounted on a donkey. From this it is clear that this is such a very bad deed, such a bad sin, that Allah rejects even this [Hajj]...
en_old: For going on Hajj without his old mother's permission, both his hands were cut off, his legs were cut off, his face was blackened and he was mounted on a donkey. This shows that it is a very bad deed, such a terrible sin that Allah does not even accept the Hajj.

brh: اور بندہ نا حالت دن خراب کے ہمو نکاح، نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم، امام الانبیاء، پیغمبر رحمت اللعالمین صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم، اونا شفقت آن قربان مرے صحابیس پارے یا رسول اللہ، امرو جو۔۔۔
en: And it makes a person's condition so bad... that... The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him), the Imam of the Prophets, the Messenger, the Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him), may one be sacrificed for his compassion: a companion said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what kind of...'
en_old: And a person's condition becomes so bad... The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him), the imam of the prophets, the Messenger who is a mercy to the worlds (peace be upon him), may I be sacrificed for his compassion. A companion said, "O Messenger of Allah, which..."

brh: امو عمل سے کہ خدائے کل عملاتن ودیخ دوست برے تو نیکی تو باز اونا، پیغمبر امو ارا نیکی ئے کہ کل نیکی تن ودیخ خدائے دوست برے تو اللہ نا نبی پارے لمہ باوہ تون جوانی کننگ، لمہ باوہ نا
en: '...what deed is it that God loves more than all deeds? There are many good deeds; O Prophet, which is the good deed that God loves more than all good deeds?' Then the Prophet of Allah said: 'Doing good to one's mother and father; [serving] one's mother and father...'
en_old: "Which deed does God love more than all other deeds? There are many good deeds. O Prophet, which good deed does God love more than all others?" The Prophet of Allah said, "Being good to your parents." Of parents...

brh: خدمت کننگ انو انو عمل سے کہ کل نیکی تان ودیگ باز خدا غا دوست ئے نما ارادہ انت ئے ادا پا انشاءاللہ کین لمہ نا خدمت امام الانبیاء پارے کنا ایر و مارک رحمت اللعالمین صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نا
en: '...serving them is such a deed that God loves much more than all good deeds.' What is your intention? Say here: God willing, we will serve our mother. The Imam of the Prophets said, my sisters and sons, the Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him)...
en_old: Serving is a deed that God loves more than all other good deeds. What is your intention? Say, God willing, we will serve our mother. The imam of the prophets, my... the mercy to the worlds (peace be upon him), said...

brh: پینن قربان مریو اسہ صحابی سے ارفے سئیں ئے دیر تون جوانی کیو ئے اللہ نا نبی دیر تون جوانی کیو تو نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پارے تہ لمہ تون تینا دیر تون سئیں لمہ تون پارے سئیں اوڑان پد دیر تون جوانی کیو پئے لمہ تون تینا پارے سئیں اوڑان پد دیر تون جوانی کیو
en: ...may I be sacrificed [for him]. A companion asked, 'Sir, with whom should I do good, O Prophet of Allah, with whom should I do good?' Then the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said, 'With your own mother.' '[And then] with whom, sir?' 'With your mother.' He said, 'Sir, after that with whom should I do good?' He said, 'With your own mother.' He said, 'Sir, after that with whom should I do good?'
en_old: May I be sacrificed for him. A companion asked, "Sir, who should I treat well, O Prophet of Allah? Who should I treat well?" The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said, "Your mother." He asked, "And after that, who should I treat well?" He said, "Your mother." He asked, "And after that, who should I treat well?"

brh: پئے لمہ تون تن، پئے سے اوڑے پد دیر تون جوانی کے، پئے باوہ تون تن، مسہ وار نبی تا سردار پاننگ ٹی ئے لمہ تون جوانی کا، چارمیکو وار پاننگ ٹی ئے اللہ نا نبی پاننگ ٹی ئے کہ باوہ تون جوانی کا، انتئے کہ لمہ پھرٹی نی نتو تورینے، لمہ نی کے بھلو تکلیف کنگونے
en: He said, 'With your own mother.' He said, 'After that, with whom should I do good?' He said, 'With your own father.' Three times the leader of the prophets says: do good to your mother; the fourth time the Prophet of Allah says: do good to your father. Because your mother carried you in her womb; your mother has gone through great hardship for you.
en_old: He said, "Your mother." "And after that, who should I treat well?" "Your mother," and then, "Your father." Three times the leader of the prophets said to be good to your mother, and the fourth time the Prophet of Allah said to be good to your father. This is because your mother carried you in her womb and went through great hardship for you.

brh: لمہ تا نا توغ پھٹافنے ارا تم کہ ننے مئے مسکان مار کورا غا سر مفک ضعیفہ تنگا نلے مسن تنگا نلے دا ایلم خاچرا لیکن پا لمہ نا توغ پھٹوکے ارے انو نا فضا لمہ باوہ نا انتہ درست کپنا لیکن ئے تناتے کہ لمہ باوہ
en: Your mother has broken her sleep [for you], from the time when we [were small] until a son grows up... weak... these brothers sleep, but the mother's sleep is broken. Such is the virtue of mother and father that we cannot properly describe its extent; but... that mother and father...
en_old: Your mother gave up her sleep for you, from the time we are small until we grow up. Weak... though these things... still, the mother gave up her sleep. Such is the virtue of parents that it cannot be fully described, but... that parents...

brh: نا توغا پینٹوکو تانکہ اسکان نافرمانی آ فرمابرداری نا اولاد وراٹی سرمتنے اما باوہ نا رضائیت آن سوا پاک خدا راضی مفک اور اونا خاطر آن کن اللہ تبارک و تعالی نبی پاک ئے او پیغمبر او رحمت اللعالمین صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم دنیا نا بندغ
en: ...[mother] broke her sleep, yet until now the offspring have not come to understand disobedience and obedience. Without the approval of mother and father the pure God is not pleased, and for this reason Allah, Blessed and Exalted, [sent] the holy Prophet, the Messenger, the Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him), to the people of the world...
en_old: ...so that the offspring do not cross over from obedience into disobedience. Without the parents' approval, the pure God is not pleased, and for this reason Allah, Blessed and Exalted, [sent] the Holy Prophet, the Messenger, the Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him), to the people of the world...

brh: ہا تبا، کہ ہمو بندغ، ہمو بندغ نا حال باز خراب مرے کہ خدا ناراض اٹ، ہمو بندغ نی خدا کاوڑینگوک اٹ، ئے خدا ناراض اٹ کہ اونا باوہ لمہ پیر مریر او باوہ لمہ نا پاننگ ہلپ، ئے خدا اوڑان بیزار اٹ، صحابی گزر
en: Yes, [he said] that that person, that person's state becomes very bad with whom God is displeased; that person with whom God is angry, God is displeased with the one whose father and mother grow old and he does not heed what his father and mother say; God is disgusted with him. A companion...
en_old: Yes, he said that that person, that person's state is very bad, God is angry with him. That person, God is angry with you. God is angry with the one whose father and mother grow old and he does not listen to what his parents say. God is disgusted with him. A companion passed...

brh: دے ہورف تا تو سہی ارا تم شام نا ٹائم تما دا کوسونو جوانو خازو ٹکرس ہرفے پیش تما تو موسی علیہ السلام مونی تسلی تس ارے او ورنا پجی موسی علیہ السلام تینا پنی پاتو تا پر مہر
en: He watched him through the day, right. When evening time came, this (young butcher) took a nice, good, choice piece [of meat] and came out. Then Moses, peace be upon him, came up in front of him and greeted him: "Hey, young man..." Moses, peace be upon him, did not tell him his own name...
en_old: He watched all day, and when evening came, this young man took a nice good piece of meat and came out. Then Moses, peace be upon him, came forward and greeted him: "O young man..." Moses, peace be upon him, told him his name...

brh: ئے ہم نا مہمان مریو کنے تینا ارا غا در تو سہی۔ خواجہ بر اللہ نا پن کنے خیرات مریو، اگر نی مہمان مریس تو ئے دے نا رقم کنفواٹ۔ حضرت موسی اون عمل او روئی ئس کا کہ دا ہرا عمل کننگ ٹی ئے کہ جنت کن تو نا وار مریک۔
en: "I will be your guest too; take me to your home, alright?" "Master, come, in God's name, I would be honored (lit. may I be your sacrifice); if you become my guest, I will feed you from the day's earnings." Hazrat Musa (thought): his deed has to be seen: what deed is he doing that he will be with me in Paradise?
en_old: "Will you make me your guest? Take me to your home." The young man said, "In God's name, my master, it would be a blessing for me; if you are my guest, I will..." Prophet Moses wanted to see what deed this man does that makes him his companion in Paradise.

brh: ہر توم آک بسرا اوڑا ہغے سرمسر ہمے مہمان ہمے اورانو خواجہ پارے حضرت موسی درست کتو تاکہ نبی سے او پی ایمنو مہمان سے پاو مہمان پی جی پی گرداس پاس نیرغے تے ولنا پی ڈوٹس کرے کروئی کاری مس کروئی کرے ولنا
en: When they came and arrived there at his place, the guest... the master of the house said... Hazrat Musa did not make it known to him that he was a prophet; he was just a guest... the guest... then he did some work... the work that had to be done, he did it, then...
en_old: When they arrived at his home, there he was, a guest at that house. The young man said to Prophet Moses... a prophet... and the guest... he did the work he had to do...

brh: دا کرے ہوڑے تم کہ اگر نی پاس نن نا ہمو کاریمے پورہ کیو گڑا تینا خواجہ غا ہیتے حضرت موسی استے پارے ئے اینا کن کے تو پتن وٹی ہمے کاریمے مریوا پین نن نی تینا فارغ کر نی آزاد مر تینا کاریمے پورہ کر گڑا
en: He said: "If you agree, I will finish that work of ours, and then (attend to) my master's talk." Hazrat Musa said to him: "I will be here while that work is done; then free yourself, be free, finish your work, and then (we will talk)."
en_old: He said that if you finish this work of ours, then... Prophet Moses said to him, "Do your work; I will wait. Then you are free, finish your work."

brh: کنے راکھورے فیتونس کا صبر کیوا پی مریٹھی کے حضرت موسی پانجی ورنان کونڈے ہوراٹ ہوراٹ کوٹھی نامٹی اسے دونکے گواز زرن چوک مرے اسے بلو چادر سے چادر ہنون تفوکے کامبوں بار برزا تفوکے پاٹ سیٹھی امودے برزا
en: ...(he said to) me... "I will be patient"... Hazrat Musa watched in the young man's direction, looking and looking: inside the room something was hanging, a big sheet, the sheet tied up like this, tied up high on a wooden beam, up there.
en_old: He told me, "Be patient, I'll come." Prophet Moses watched the young man; he looked and looked, and in the room there was something like a big bundle hanging up high, covered with a large sheet and tied up high.

brh: بلا، لیکے ہیت کا، اسپیشل ہیت کا، سبحان اللہ! دا تو سد سال آن برزا پیر و بلہ سے نا پچ نا تٹی خاچوکے، سبحان اللہ، پیر و بلہ سے، پیر و بلہ سے پچ نا تٹی خاچوکے
en: Indeed, here is the thing, a special thing, glory be to God! In it an old woman over a hundred years old was lying in the cloth bundle. Glory be to God, an old woman, an old woman lying in the cloth bundle.
en_old: The old woman... said something, something special. Glory be to God! An old woman over a hundred years old was lying in that bundle. Glory be to God, an old woman, an old woman lying in the bundle.

brh: بسم اللہ کرے ئس میدان ٹی خات حضرت موسی پئی خنار تے پاریر دا ہنا کر دھک ہنا دے دا ورنا نا دھک ہنا دے عمل ہنا دے پی مشکل عمل مریتا دون ہورا کہ امو سوتے لارت تسس کیما کریسس چمچہ ہرفے امو فیرین
en: He said "In the name of God" and laid her down on the floor. Hazrat Musa watched and said: "Let's see what this is, what this young man is up to, what deed it is; it must be a difficult deed." He saw that he had prepared that meat and minced it, took a spoon, and...
en_old: He said "Bismillah" and went into the field. Prophet Moses watched and said, "Let's see what this young man's deed is, what hard deed he does." He saw that he had prepared that meat, cooked it, and taken a spoon...

brh: پیرنگا اینو باٹی ساغا مینگورے ادا ارے ننا نیٹی انو بندغس کلو پیرنگا لمہ نا باٹی اراغ ئتن باخوئے تو پھلون کنون لیکو غمبار باقی لمئے تے فون سئی باوانا باخوئے پھلون باوائے تے فون لمئے پیرنگا
en: The old woman: he puts (food) into her mouth like this. Here, among us, is there such a person who puts bread, morsel by morsel, into his old mother's mouth? ... The rest (just) phone their mother, sir; the father's morsel... they phone the father, the old mother...
en_old: This old woman... we have a person like this. When the mother is old, the son feeds her by hand... the father..., the mother...

brh: لوما توار کے مسڑ دہور دلما کاٹما گنتھم مار توار کے باوا توار کے مارے مار اینگن کرینگے تے لوما مسڑ مسڑے توار کے مسڑ ایرنگ کرینگے تے یاد کبو اگر لوما باوانا باغان ہیتس پیش تما تو مار مسڑنا ہڈ
en: When the mother calls, the daughter... (on my heart, on my head)...; when the son is called, when the father calls the son, the son... them; when the mother calls the daughter, the daughter... them. Remember, if a word comes out of a mother's or father's mouth (against them), then the son's and daughter's bones...
en_old: When the mother calls, the daughter... the son calls, the father calls... Remember, if something happens to the mother or father, then the son and daughter...

brh: او تو مدام برباد مرے حضرت موسی پی ہمو چمچگٹ کنفنگے شروع کرے بلے بلہ سیر کرے فبلہ سیر کرے دوتے تسلہ باٹ تسلہ پیرو سے تمام کمزور
en: ...he will be ruined forever. Hazrat Musa (watched): (the young man) began feeding her with that spoon; he fed the old woman until she was full, fed the old woman until full, washed her hands, washed her mouth: a completely frail old woman.
en_old: He will always be ruined. Prophet Moses then began feeding her with that spoon; he fed the old woman until she was full, he gave her water, the frail old woman...

brh: تورے حضرت موسی بلن کنڈے ورا کہ بلن جوڑ سرنگ شروع کرے سائیں بلہ لمہ منو مرین ننا لمہ غاک الو خلوکو سائیں شیر خلوکو لمو الو خلوکو لمو دیر غاتے چاپ خلوکو لمو پین نا برامے روم کروکو لمو لمہ کوزو کے
en: Then Hazrat Musa looked toward the old woman: (the young man) began washing the old woman's clothes. Sir, old women, mothers, such are our mothers: the mother who sang lullabies, sir, the mother who sang songs, the mother who sang lullabies, the mother who clapped (for us)..., the mother who (celebrated) our wedding, the mother...
en_old: Then Prophet Moses looked down and saw that he had begun to wash her clothes. Sir, there are mothers like this... not our mothers who... sir, the mother who gave milk, the mother who... the mother who... the mother...

brh: حضرت موسی پئی ورا تدا او ہڑتوما جوڑک سورنگ شروع کرے جوڑک ت سورار دا ہڑکی یتا مارکو آراتم جوڑک ت بند مسر مارکو ہرفے ولدا پچتی خاتپے تا ولدا درنجا تا ہرسنگا بس
en: Hazrat Musa watched there; he began washing the clothes; he washed her clothes... the son; when the clothes were done, the son picked her up, laid her back in the cloth bundle, hung it up again, and came...
en_old: Prophet Moses watched; then he began washing her clothes. When the clothes were washed... when he had finished with the clothes, he picked her up, put her back in the bundle, and hung it up again.

brh: پارے خبر دا دیرے پیرنگا پارے دا کنا آئی انتیکنا سئیں لمے کنا پارے تینا حقیقت بنفتو سئیں پاہیت دادے کہ مچو دے ہچ نا کنپرا اول لمے کنفیو گڑا ئے کنیوا سبحان اللہ سبحان اللہ انم شار کاری سئیں
en: He said: "Tell me, who is this old woman?" He said: "This is my mother." "Why do you ask, sir? She is my mother." He said: "Tell me your story, then." "Sir, the thing is this: every day I eat nothing; first I feed my mother, then I eat." Glory be to God, glory be to God, what a great deed, sir!
en_old: He asked, "Who is this?" He said, "This is my mother." "Why, sir?" He said, "My mother. To tell the truth, sir, it is this: every day I do not eat until I first feed my mother, then I eat." Glory be to God, glory be to God, what a deed, sir.

brh: لمہ نا ایراغ دا دے لمہ نا نتوس اوراٹی مرے مپ دا تینا ہوٹل آ تے سیر کروئی وڈ گاڈ تینگے تہ ہورنا لمہ غریب ئے باخواس ملتو لمہ لنگڑ تما اوراٹی دا ہوٹل آ تے چا کننگے ہمے ورنا پارے حضرت موسی ئے کہ قسم ئے کنے خدا نا ئے مچو دے ہچرا کمپرا تنک
en: The mother's food... nowadays the mother is left at home, while they themselves go to hotels to eat their fill... Look, the poor mother does not even get a morsel, the mother lies hungry at home, while these people drink tea at hotels. That young man said to Hazrat Musa: "I swear by God, every day I eat nothing until..."
en_old: The mother's bread... this mother's... these people who go around the hotels... the poor mother... the young man said to Prophet Moses, "I swear by God, every day I do not eat..."

brh: کس کہ لمہ تے فر ئے باخوز ہنتو پر۔ سبحان اللہ۔ پارے او تو ٹھیک ہی لیکن دا لمہ نا جوڑ کسرارک ہنسے کے پئے او جوڑ تے سرفے کنکے دعا خوانہ۔ سبحان اللہ۔ انت خوانہ سئی؟ دعا خوانہ۔ پئے
en: ...until I have first fed my mother; I do not take a morsel before that." Glory be to God. He said: "That is fine, but when you were washing this mother's clothes, what was she saying? While you were washing the clothes, she was reciting a prayer." Glory be to God. "What was she reciting, sir?" "She was reciting a prayer." Say...
en_old: ...that he would put the mother first, then eat. Glory be to God. He said, "That's fine, but when you were washing your mother's clothes, what was she reciting?" "She was reciting a prayer." Glory be to God. "What was she reciting, sir?" "She was reciting a prayer."

brh: پنت پارے دعا ٹی پا یکہ ہنو پائک ئے اللہ کنا دا ورنا انگا مار کوئی موسی تون اوار جنت اٹ سر کے۔ سائیں دنو لومہ مارین اللہ اکبر۔ پا ہر دے ئنا دعا خوانے کریغے تے وتا جوڑ تے سرفک مدام اودان ئے اللہ
en: He said: "In her prayer she says this: 'O God, make this young son of mine reach Paradise together with Musa.'" Sir, such are mothers! God is great. He said: "Every day she recites this prayer when I wash her clothes; she always says, 'O God...'"
en_old: He said, "In her prayer she says, 'O God, may this son of mine reach Paradise together with Moses.'" Sir, mothers like this! God is great. He said every day she prays like this when I wash her clothes, always, 'O God...'

brh: او کنا دا جواننگا، انینگا، فرمانبردارنگا مارے، اللہ موسی نبی تون اوار جنت اٹ سر کے، ئے ورنا پانت ایٹ ئے سئیں نی تینا پنی پا، حضرت موسی پی موسی نبی اٹ، اللہ اکبر، خم کرے تا، پی قسم ئے کنے خدا نا، بس لمہ نا دعا نا صدقہ اٹ کنا زی مہربانی کو۔
en: "'...this good, kind, obedient son of mine, O God, make him reach Paradise together with the Prophet Musa.'" The young man said: "Sir, tell me your name." Hazrat Musa said: "I am the Prophet Musa." God is great! He bowed to him and said: "I swear by God, it is only by the grace of my mother's prayer that kindness has come upon me."
en_old: "'...this good, kind, obedient son of mine, O God, may he reach Paradise with the Prophet Moses.'" Then the young man said, "Sir, tell me your name." Prophet Moses said, "I am the Prophet Moses." God is great! He bowed and said, "I swear by God, it is only through my mother's prayers that this kindness has come upon me."

brh: کنا کل تکلیفاک برو کنا ایلم آک لمہ باوہ اگر ئتن بندغ راضی کرے تو لمہ باوہ اور کنو دعا خوانرہ او لمہ باوہ نا دعا اللہ نا دربار اٹ قبول ہم مریک۔ پائین انشاءاللہ تینا لمہ نا عزت کیرے۔ انشاءاللہ۔ نتو اسکان لمہ نا پٹی تمانو۔ سہی۔ دیر ننا خواجہ ئے کیک۔
en: "...all my troubles go away." My brothers, if a person keeps his mother and father pleased, then mother and father pray for him, and the prayer of mother and father is also accepted in God's court. Say: God willing, you will respect your mothers. God willing. May you never fall under a mother's curse. Right. Who will do it for our master?
en_old: My troubles all go away, my brothers... if a person keeps his mother and father pleased, the mother and father pray for him, and the prayer of a mother and father is accepted in God's court. Say, God willing, we will respect our mothers. God willing. We will never fall short toward our mothers. Right. Who will do it like our master did?

brh: پیدا مننگ نا وختی کچرا ول سئی انت صفائی ارے ننا انت حال ئے ننا دا لمہ نا مہربانی کو کہ نن کمزور آن او طاقت سے او لیکن ننا خدمت کیرا ارا تم کہ نن ورنائی نا سرمرین تو داس ننا دا ذمہ داری ئے کہ نن تینا لمہ نا عزت کے
en: At the time of our birth there was filth, sir; what cleanliness was there, what a state we were in! It is this mother's kindness: we were weak and she had strength, yet she served us. Now that we have reached youth, it is our responsibility to respect our mother.
en_old: At the time of our birth, what filth there was and what cleaning, what state we were in! It is through our mother's kindness: we were weak and she was strong, yet she served us. Now that we have reached youth, it is our duty to respect our mother.

brh: آخری وعظ بمبو کتاب آتے ٹپنک اسہ بندغس بس اسہ خلک سے ٹی خاچا مچو نن بیشہ سراک انت کرے کہ سئیں بیشہ سراک آ دا وبش مس کنا کا بیش ہکل آتے بشڑا خنتو واللہ بٹی تینے
en: Lastly, a sermon from the books: a man came and slept in a village, and all night a donkey kept braying. What did he do, sir? The donkey kept braying; this (man) got up... the donkey's cries... (I) did not see (it), by God... myself.
en_old: In the final sermon, the books tell of a person who came and slept in a well (?). All night we stayed awake, sir. What did he do, sir? He got up awake... I did not see my calls (?)... by God, in myself.

brh: من دا بیش سرہ، من دا ہنا ہورا بیش اف، من دا خاچا، من دا بش مس بیش سرنگے، بہرحال مچو نندانہ توغنا بیش نہ سرنگ، سوہب نا ٹیم تما خلق نا تے توار کرے، پیرو نا مکن تو دشمنی سس کپیان تے
en: "I (thought) this donkey was braying; I went and looked, and there was no donkey; I slept; I got up, the donkey braying. Anyway, all night... sleep... the donkey's braying." In the morning he called the people of the village: "...I bear them no enmity..."
en_old: I am awake; I am not fully awake; I slept; I got up to stay awake. Anyway, all night, the sleep, not staying awake. At dawn she called out to the people: the old woman... I hold no enmity toward them.

brh: بے کنا مچو نن تو ختم مسونے بیش سر آک بیش نہ سرنگ کنا توغے ختم کرے امرو بیش سے دا امرو بیشس کنا ٹاٹہ کھنتوٹا تا پٹاٹہ کھنتوٹا تا لیکن مچو نن سر آکا
en: "My whole night has been wasted; the donkey brayed, the donkey's braying ended my sleep. What kind of donkey is this, what kind of donkey? I looked and did not see it, I searched and did not see it, but all night it kept braying."
en_old: Without me the whole night has passed, staying awake. Not staying awake ended my sleep. What kind of waking is this, what kind of waking? I did not see my father, I did not see them, but I stayed up all night.

brh: پارے دا نا پیرو بلہ سے مودے توار کا موڈن ہرف پیرنگا بلہ سرمس دا ورنا مہمان ہرفے تپائے ہیت خبر دادے بیشستو مچو نن سرا تو آئینے خندن کھڑینگا بھرینگ شروع کرے پارے
en: He said: "This is about an old woman... she called out that day... the old woman arrived." This young man took the guest aside and told him: "The matter is this: (the donkey) brays all night... then (she) began weeping and said:"
