en_old: She said this old woman... call out that day... the old woman got up, this young man took the guest... talk and news, kept her awake all night, then began to weep in front of the mirror (?) and said:

brh: او بیش صف کنا مارے، اللہک، او بیشہ صف کنا مارے، انو جوانو مار کوس کنے دوستسکا، مچو نن ہنا کہ نن مئے اسکن کست زونڈو کست سوڈک کہ کنا مار کو برے کڑی کنے تغلے، یور کنے تیر تے خاٹا، ایر تے خاٹا
en: "Oh my donkey-like son, O God, oh my donkey-like son! Such a good son, who was dear to me! All night I sat up waiting until my son would come... no sleep for me..."
en_old: Oh my son who keeps me awake, O God, oh my son who keeps me awake, such a good son who loves me! All night we... until... when my son comes... he hurt me, he shot arrows at me, he shot arrows.

brh: دا پروال تے کھاتا تینا توغے ختم کرے دا مار کو نزاتی زنڈو کسو ڈا ہرا تم بسکا پارے جی کرے مار کو خیرات وریم نی کن کنا چنا انتئے دا خورے کیسہ کتو کرے پارے کہ بیش چپ کا کنتو نیت کپہ سائیں ئے مچو نن تینا توغے تینا مار
en: ...she gave up her own sleep. When this son came (home)..., she said: "Dear son, may I be sacrificed for you, my child, why do you do this?" He said: "Donkey, be quiet! Do not bother me." Sir, all night (she gave up) her sleep for her son...
en_old: ...shot these arrows (?) and ended her sleep. When this son came near dawn, he said yes. She said: son, may I be sacrificed for you, my child, why did you do this? He said: stay awake, do not intend it with me, sir. All night her sleep, her son...

brh: کوکے ختم کریٹا، دنگن توار ئس مس کہ بش مسٹا، اللہ ئے توار کریٹا کہ اللہ کنا مار کو سلامتی ٹی لمہ غا سر کا، دنگن چوٹ نی توار ئس بنگٹا، اونگ رم کریٹا گھنوکا تا مار، تینا مار کو انتظار کریٹا، لیکن ارا تم بس ئے پاریٹ مار کو خیرات مریو نی کن کنا چونان تے دا
en: "...I gave up my sleep. Then there was a sound and I got up; I called out to God: 'O God, bring my son safely back to his mother.' Then I heard a sound again; I hurried... my son; I waited for my son, but when he came I said: 'Son, may I be sacrificed for you, my child, this...'"
en_old: I gave up my sleep. Suddenly there was a sound and I got up. I called out to God: O God, bring my son safely back to his mother. Suddenly again a sound came, I ran, the son... I waited for my son, but when he came I said: son, may I be sacrificed for you, my children, this...

brh: خورا کرینوس تو گئے سائیں ئے تنادے تو کرے پارے بیش چپ کا تو کنا مستن اینا ئے پاریٹ نی خدا بیش اسکی ئے تو مچو ننا انتظار کیوا نی کرے بیش پاسا تو کنا
en: "...you have done (this)..." Then, sir, he said to her: "Donkey, be quiet!"... I said: "May God make you a donkey! I wait for you all night, and you call me a donkey!"
en_old: ...you did, sir. Then he said: stay awake, then... he said: for God's sake, stay awake... so all night you will wait, she said, stay awake, then my...

brh: چنا زوال مسنے ہمودے قبرتا داسہ ہر کس کہ مہمان برے کل پاننگ تیو کہ مچو نن بیشمار سر دے کنا ایلم آ کنا دوست آک لمہ باوہ نا پٹن خلپو اللہ نا نبی اعلان کرے
en: "...the child has perished; that day... the grave. Now whenever anyone comes as a guest, everyone tells him that all night it brays like a donkey." My brothers, my friends, do not bring your mother's and father's curse upon yourselves. The Prophet of God declared:
en_old: ...child perished that day, the grave. Now whoever comes as a guest, everyone says that all night countless times... My brothers, my friends, do not break the hearts of your mother and father. The Prophet of God declared:

brh: دا دنیا نا بنداتے پارے کہ خدا نا فیصلہ نا دے صحابیس حضور نا خدمت ئے بس پارے پیغمبر جنت انتے پارے دوزخ انتے پارے ئے پیغمبر جنت انت سے دوزخ انت سے تو نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پارے
en: He told the people of this world that on God's Day of Judgment... A companion came into the presence of the Prophet and said, "O Prophet, what is Paradise?" He said, "What is Hell?" He said, "O Prophet, what is Paradise, what is Hell?" Then the Holy Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said:
en_old: Since the beginning of this world, he said, on the Day of God's Judgment... A companion came into the presence of the Prophet and said: O Prophet, what is Paradise, what is Hell? O Prophet, what is Paradise and what is Hell? Then the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said:

brh: جنت لمہ باو ئے دوزخ لمہ باو ئے صحابی حیران مس کہ لمہ باو امرے جنت مریرہ لمہ باو امرے دوزخ مریرہ پارے سئیں نی سرپد مفنا اللہ نا نبی پارے کہ لمہ باو جنت ئے لمہ باو دوزخ ئے اگر لمہ باوے راضی کرے رے تو جنت ئے
en: "Paradise is mother and father; Hell is mother and father." The companion was astonished: how can mother and father be Paradise, how can mother and father be Hell? He said, "Sir, we do not understand." The Prophet of God said, "Mother and father are Paradise, mother and father are Hell: if you keep your mother and father pleased, then it is Paradise."
en_old: Paradise is mother and father, Hell is mother and father. The companion was surprised: how can mother and father be Paradise, how can mother and father be Hell? He said, sir, you have not understood. The Prophet of God said that mother and father are Paradise and mother and father are Hell; if you please your mother and father, it is Paradise.

brh: پئے انت مس؟ نی باور کیس بازار نا نوچ کے خانا نا خنک تا پاش کریر دم پشتمار اسو سوب نا است آ رمبار سوب نا است آ رمبار باور کیس کنے پارے
en: Then what happened? Would you believe it — at the market ... they opened the eyes of the house ... (unclear) ... believe it, he told me.
en_old: Then what happened? Would you believe it, the market's... they opened the eyes of the house... would you believe it, he told me.

brh: او متکون آ تاویزے، زو سات بلکنی دیر اٹ سلتا، او متکون آ تاویزے سیتے ونے، نی ہورسک پیر جان امر اسہ ارادے اٹ چورا ہبرے سر مرے، ارادے ٹی؟ ارادے چنڈ
en: That old amulet — quickly ... or rather after a while it ...; that old amulet ... You'll see, Pir Jan, how with a single intention he will arrive ... With intention? Intention ...
en_old: Oh, the amulet on the old one, quickly... in a while... oh, the amulet on the old one... you see, Pir Jan, how with an intention he reaches the crossroads. With an intention? An intention...

brh: بلکہ اسہ دے ٹی بروئے، ہینو بروئے، دیگر اسکان بروئے، شام اسکان بروئے، سر مبروئے، ہاو، ہسور اسنی، ہور ئس دا ساہ نا، دا تعویز نا کراماتا ہور ئس امر کاریم کرو۔
en: Rather, he will come within a day — he will come today, he will come by afternoon, he will come by evening, he will arrive. Yes ... you'll see, you'll see how the miracles of this master, of this amulet, work.
en_old: Or rather he will come within a day, he will come today, he will come by afternoon, he will come by evening, he will come, yes. Just watch how the power of this, the miracles of this amulet, work.

brh: دا ٹیٹو چوشہ کسف کے ساہنہ تعویزہ زور اور دا ساہنہ تعویز
en: This ... is the revelation of the master's amulet, its power — and this is the master's amulet.
en_old: This tattoo... the power of the amulet, and this amulet.

brh: انتنے مر سما ہی نہ نہ، کنے تو سما اف، نی دا شار والا کندن سفت آک تکیرہ، آ جوانی جوانی کے سما اف نی ئے زراستنا ایڑسٹ
en: Why — do you know? No, no, as for me, I don't know. You see these city folk heaping praise; I don't know about all that goodness ... your ... sister.
en_old: Why... no, no, I don't know. You see these praises from the city folk... I don't know about all the good things...

brh: او راہی کاوا شام اسکان بریوا شام تو مننگٹی ئے نینا سپرجنا پدوران دے تو خلکورسا؟ ینت سے کہ اونا پدوران دے خلو؟ داسہ اونا پدوران دے سائن نا تعویز خلوئے او مسس
en: He has set off — he'll come by evening — and it's already getting to be evening. Did they put it on your ...? What is it that will strike his ...? Now the master's amulet will strike his ..., and he became ...
en_old: He went away. He will come by evening. It's already getting to be evening... Did he put it on? Now the amulet has been put on, and he became...

brh: کنے امر سما افک
en: How would I not know?
en_old: How would I not know?

brh: دا تو پیر صاحب نا تعویز نا کرامات او کہ ننے دسکانے شار ئنا کپ اسے
en: This is the miracle of the Pir Sahib's amulet, that it has brought half the city to us.
en_old: This is the miracle of the pir sahib's amulet, that it has brought us a cup of the city.

brh: سائیں اینو ننا مرید آتے ٹی پوسکونو مرید اسے نا اضافہ مس۔ ارے ہرا مرید نا ہیتے کننگٹی اوس ننا تو ہردے مرید آک ببو کیرے پوسکونو
en: Sir, today one new disciple has been added to our disciples. Yes, the disciple you're talking about — for us, new disciples come every day anyway.
en_old: Sir, today a new disciple was added to our disciples. Yes, that disciple we were talking about... every day new disciples keep coming to us.

brh: او نمارے را، ئے دیر مسپنتہ، او نا کہ ضعیفہ تینا ارغ کے تاویز النگ کے بسک، آن ہڑے، شیر خان نا ئے تے کننگٹی ئس ہڑے ارغ
en: Oh ..., it's gotten late. His wife came to get an amulet for her food. Look, you're talking about Sher Khan — look, the food ...
en_old: Oh Namare, come, it's gotten late. The old woman came to get an amulet for her bread. Look, about Sher Khan... look, the bread...

brh: ہرا وختان کہ او ننا مریدی ہم پیشن مروئی گڑا کیرے گوالا نی اور کھیل کھتاراتے داسا ئے اودے ہندن او تعویز ئس دسونٹ کہ او نا ضعیفہ اودے
en: Ever since he too was supposed to come over to our discipleship, they've been playing their games and tricks; now I've given him such an amulet that his wife ... him ...
en_old: Since he also has to become our disciple... and now the games and tricks... I gave him an amulet so that his old woman would...

brh: اروی انچارا ولے استاد کنے اسہ گڑاس سمبھنگٹی اف منہ سال مست نی اونا زیب آ تعویذ ئس شوشکے او ایم
en: Yes, I understand, but master, there's one thing I don't understand: some years ago you slipped an amulet into his pocket ...
en_old: Yes, I get it, but master, there's one thing I don't understand. A few years ago you slipped an amulet into his pocket...

brh: دا سنی شیر خان نا تاویز ئس تریس کہ او کائے ارے او بے وقوف ارے او چریا خاصگی ارے نی تو خبر ہی او نا ضعیفہ گونڈو
en: And now you gave Sher Khan an amulet saying that he's a ..., he's a fool, he's a real idiot — you know, his wife is short ...
en_old: You gave this Sher Khan an amulet saying he is a crow, he is a fool, he is a special kind of idiot. You know his old woman is short...

brh: گل بے بے ننے سد و دو سد روپئی ایتک، ہور و شیر خان ننے پنچ سد روپئی ایتک، ہور ہرا تنی کو ایت دادے، دہ و ہشت ہزار نا ہیٹ و سملے کیتک ننے
en: Gul Bibi gives us one or two hundred rupees, and Sher Khan gives us five hundred rupees, and whoever gives this ... gives us goats and ... worth ten or eight thousand.
en_old: Gul Bibi gives us one or two hundred rupees, and Sher Khan gives us five hundred rupees, and whoever gives this... they make deals of ten or eight thousand with us.

brh: او اسلنگا ہیت دادے شیر خان ننا تعویز تے ٹی ٹپوکف او گل بے بے نا ایلم تے ہٹ ٹپوکے او اما او دن کے
en: And the real thing is this: Sher Khan isn't caught up in our amulets, but Gul Bibi's brothers are caught up in them, and that's how he ...
en_old: The real point is that Sher Khan is stuck in our amulets, and Gul Bibi's brothers are stuck too, and that's how he...

brh: ئے شیر خان خانی پینا شیری او تینا خاص پراتیان ہندن خلے تو کہ پسی کچکاتیان خلے ساہی اسیتس کہ ویتن ہاو گنک
en: That Sher Khan, a Khan and a lion only in name, beats her with his own ... in such a way, worse than one beats cats and dogs ... yes, he's mad.
en_old: Sher Khan, being such a fierce lion, beat her with his special sandals the way you'd beat a cat or a dog...

brh: استاد کنے نی تو داخہ سال مس ولے نی کنے تعویذ لکھنگے تیتویس اڈے او چھریا آ پیری مریدی بھاز زور خوائیک من وقت سے پین خدمت
en: Master, it's been so many years for me, but you haven't taught me how to write amulets. Hey, you fool, this pir-and-disciple business takes a lot of effort, some time, and more service.
en_old: Master, it's been so many years for me, but you haven't taught me how to write amulets. Hey crazy, this pir-and-disciple business takes a lot of hard work, some time, and more service.

brh: فی الحال کیرے نیکیرے چھانہ کیرے خدمتی کرک دن مفکے مخلوق بھروئے ہمو چاتے ہم
en: For now, do it, keep doing it, do service; it doesn't just happen that people come. That tea too.
en_old: For now, keep serving. If not, people won't fill up... the tea too.

brh: پنوئے پاروئی پین چائتنے امر کنا ہکم بس گڑا چاس تا ہور چریا ئے پائے کے کنے
en: Say it, tell them: more tea. As soon as my order comes, then a tea. And look, the fool is saying to me ...
en_old: Say it, tell them, bring more tea. When my order came, then bring tea... and the crazy one says to me...

brh: ئے مریدی لکھی فوڑ کنے ہیلت تے تاویزاتے ہڑے اگر ہینے تاویز لکھنگے ہیلت اسٹ ئے ولہ کاو بھڈی گوازی کیو کاو پنڈو ہا ہینے کلے ہا
en: Teach me the disciple business, teach me the amulets, look. If you teach me how to write amulets, fine; otherwise I'll go play games, I'll go begging, yes ...
en_old: Teach me the disciple business, the amulets. If you learn to write amulets, it's one thing, but otherwise go play games, go beg, go eat.

brh: دینا ایلو تیتو، نی ہیلو تیتو، ہائے شاباش، واہ، پین، ہا، واہ
en: You didn't teach the other ..., you didn't teach me! Hey, bravo, wow, more, yes, wow!
en_old: Didn't you learn it today? You learned it. Bravo, wow, more, yes, wow.

brh: واہ رے شیر خان واہ، دا سے نا مشکل آ کاسہ مس، گلببی ہن جان نا چٹا، گلببی ہکا کوشش کے
en: Wow, Sher Khan, wow! This one has turned into a hard job. Gul Bibi, go, dear ... Gul Bibi, give it a try.
en_old: Wow Sher Khan, wow! This turned into a hard job. Gul Bibi, go, dear... Gul Bibi, give it a try.

brh: اونا کوششاک دا دیر اٹ وہار اینار، داسہ نی چاس نا ماک چار، واڑے ماک کنا شار نا ئے بننگ اٹ، شام مس داس کنے پیر غونٹ باونہ درک کپا کنا سوب
en: His efforts at this late hour brought spring ... Now you look at the tea ...; look, my ... are coming from the city. Evening has come, and now ... I can't find out where father is ... my reason.
en_old: His efforts brought spring to this water. Now look at your tea's mother... my mother is coming from the city. Evening has come, and now my father... I don't understand the reason.

brh: او گنے پشتمانی خبر فرگنا دا ایدیر تو نیت کننگٹی دا مسٹ تو خاچنگٹی آئی رخ آئی مش ایرخ ایش ایرخ
en: He ... regret, the news ... this ... while intending, this happened; while sleeping ... (unintelligible).
en_old: He regrets it... this water... in intending it, it happened... in sleeping...

brh: ننے تینا غم الکونے ایلم نا دیشے ارانگینانے اودے جناک درینو نی الکونے اراغ نا کنا تو اسل اراغ استم بفک نہ اراغ بسینوٹ نہ کتے کھرینوٹ
en: We're consumed by our own grief — where has our brother gone? Jinns have taken him away. You've taken my food; as for me, I have no appetite for food at all — I have neither baked any bread nor swept the ...
en_old: We don't have our own grief, only our brother's. Women have stolen him... you don't have bread for me, I never get any bread, no bread has come to me, and I haven't eaten anything.

brh: الو دن چھانٹ خلنگٹی ئس ابا، ئے پا ایراغ غا۔ ایراغ غا؟ بش مپا، دا معصوم ئے، ایراغ سے تنا؟
en: Hey, why are you lashing out like that, father? Say something about the food. — The food? — Enough, don't say it, this one is innocent. Do you have any food?
en_old: Hey, don't whip like that, father. Talk about the bread. The bread? Don't wake him, he's innocent. Where's your bread?

brh: نی نی انت مسنے نین پیری کر کر بے غمش ننا ارغ مگا اوست بریک مار نا سمائنے مارا راڑیک مگا پد ورندی تا خلنگاٹی ئس ننت اینکے پریشان ئس مسڑو باوے ارغ نل کنے
en: You, you — what has happened to you? Keep playing the pir, carefree — does our food ever even cross your mind? ... the boy ... but you keep talking back. Why are you so worried, girl? Father, give me food.
en_old: What happened to you? Today, practice your pir business without worry. Our bread... hope will come... my son... after that, while hitting the answers... don't get worried, father, give me bread.

brh: بنگن مسونے نا بنگن مسونے نا ئے تو اینا ٹکرے رمبونا باونا خیرات اسموٹینا مچے نوشی جان کرٹ لعنت نی تینا پڈے ولے ہمر کے مار مائی کھڈٹی مار کائے کھڈٹی کاو خالی نی تینا پڈے پر کے
en: Have you gone mad? Have you gone mad? Today's piece of bread ..., father's charity — I relished all of it. Curse you, your own belly! But how ... let the son and the mother go to the grave, let the son go to the grave, let me go empty — you just fill your own belly.
en_old: You've gone crazy, you've gone crazy! Today a piece... father's charity... all of it, Noshi dear. Curse you, you fill your own belly, but how can a son... the son eats in the pit, go away, you just fill your own belly.

brh: نی ہم کنتو نوسو؟ کنا مگست بریک نی کنتو نوس۔ ہم کنتو نوس برے دا خا خوسانتے کیسہ مسڑ کو ئے برٹم و نیم روش نا ٹکر ئس بچانے تو ایتنا۔ ہاو
en: Will you join me too? ... comes, you join me. Come, join me too ... and if a piece of the midday meal has been left over, then give it. Yes.
en_old: Will you come with me too? I wish you would come with me. Come with me too, if you're going to do this... I'll bring the ..., and save a piece of the midday bread and give it to me. Yes.

brh: دا نیمروچ تو چاول چھولے تے نم نو غٹارے تو اگر ارے مشیسس تو ہمبو کمبو گڑان آتے دادم نیم کون
en: This lunchtime, did you eat the rice and chickpeas? If there's any left over, then those few little things — eat half of this too.
en_old: This afternoon, did you eat the rice and chickpeas? If there's any left, then the little that remains, half of it now...

brh: نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نا خدمت اٹ حاضر مریرہ۔ ہا پیغمبر نا شان آن قربان مریو۔ لمہ باوہ نا حق آتہ غان پارے، پد نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پارے۔ لمہ باوہ نا حق آتہ پارے، پد اللہ نا قران پارے۔ سورۃ لقمان اٹ اللہ تعالی پارے و وصینا الانسان
en: ...they present themselves in the service of the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him). May I be sacrificed for the glory of that Prophet! He spoke about the rights of parents, then the Noble Prophet (peace be upon him) spoke. The rights of parents were spoken of, then Allah's Quran spoke. In Surah Luqman Allah Almighty said: 'Wa wassaynal-insana' (And We have enjoined upon man)
en_old: ...they come into the presence of the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him). May I be sacrificed for the Prophet's glory. He spoke about the rights of parents, then the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said... he spoke about the rights of parents, then Allah's Quran said. In Surah Luqman, Allah Almighty said: 'Wa wassaynal insana' (And We have enjoined upon man)

brh: وبالوالدین سورۃ لقمان اٹ اللہ فیصلہ کرے کہ کنا نبی دنیا نا بندہ تے پا کہ پین گڑا تو تینا جاگہ لیکن لمہ باوت تون جوان کبو لمہ باون زئی احسان کبو کہ داسہ گہ لمہ باو پیر مسنو داسہ اوتا خدمت کبو اوتے جوانی اٹ توار کبو اوتے استاتے
en: '...wa bil-walidayn' (...to parents). In Surah Luqman Allah decreed: 'My Prophet, tell the people of the world that other things have their own place, but be good to your parents, show kindness to your parents, now that your parents have grown old; now serve them, speak to them kindly, and their hearts...'
en_old: 'wa bil walidayn' (...to his parents). In Surah Luqman, Allah decreed: My Prophet, tell the servants of the world that other things have their own place, but treat your mother and father well, be very kind to your parents, now that your parents have grown old, serve them now, speak to them kindly, [do not] break their hearts,

brh: خراب کپبو او تمنے کاوڑ کپبو او تا راضی کننگ نا کوشش کبو لمے تن لمہ کبو جی جان کبو تینا لمے توار کبو باوے تن ابا کبو جی جان کبو تینا باوے توار کبو اللہ صفا تیک نی پیغمبر ہڑتاتم کے تینا لمہ باوے نا خدمت جوانی اٹ کبو
en: ...do not hurt them, do not make them angry, try to please them. To your mother say 'Mother', say 'ji jan' (dear), address your mother this way; to your father say 'Abba', say 'ji jan', address your father this way. Allah makes it clear: you, Prophet, tell them always to serve their parents well.
en_old: do not hurt them, do not make them angry, try to please them. Call your mother 'mother', call her 'ji jan' (dear); call your father 'abba', call him 'ji jan'. Allah makes it clear: you, Prophet, [tell them] at all times to serve their parents well.

brh: وار کرے جوانی اٹ عزت احترام کرے تو ہمو بندہ کنے باز دوست ء اگر تینا لمہ باوہ نا عزت ء کتو لمہ باوہ نا لمہ باوہ نا بے ادبی کرے تو ئے خدا ہم اوڑان بیزار اٹ درود شریف سختا نہ اللہ درود شریف سختا
en: ...whoever addressed them kindly and showed them honor and respect, that servant is very dear to me. If he did not honor his parents and was disrespectful to his parents, then, eh, God too is disgusted with him. Recite the Durood Sharif... Allah... recite the Durood Sharif.
en_old: ...whoever treated them well and showed them respect, that servant is very dear to me. If he did not respect his parents, if he was disrespectful to his parents, then God too is disgusted with him. Recite the durood sharif, Allah... recite the durood sharif.

brh: اللھم سل علی محمد وعلی آل محمد کما صلیت علی ابراھیم وعلی آل ابراھیم انک حمید مجید۔ تو کنا ایلم آک کنا دوست آک لمہ باوہ غان سوا نمے ننا چاڑو مفک ہمو نی کہ پیغمبر پارے کہ لمہ باوہ نا رند آ تا کیرغ آن جنت
en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; truly You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. So, my brothers, my friends, apart from our parents there is no recourse for you or for us. That is why the Prophet said that Paradise is beneath the footsteps of parents.
en_old: Allahumma salli ala Muhammad wa ala aali Muhammad kama sallayta ala Ibrahim wa ala aali Ibrahim innaka Hamidun Majid. So my brothers, my friends, apart from our parents we have no other way. That is why the Prophet said that Paradise lies beneath the feet of parents.

brh: جنت ء سائیں لمہ باوہ نا نت تا کیرغ آن جنت ء حالانکہ جنت شیف اف جنت برز ء یعنی لمہ باوہ نا خدمت ٹی جنت ملیک لمہ باوہ پیر مریرہ تو خیال کرو ئے مریرہ دو تڑتینہ باخو ء ٹکر کر لمہ باوہ ء کنف پٹ
en: Paradise is, sir, beneath the feet of parents. Paradise is there, even though Paradise is not below; Paradise is above. That is, Paradise is found in serving your parents. When parents grow old, take care of them; they become frail, their hands tremble. Break their food into morsels, feed your parents.
en_old: Paradise, sir: Paradise lies beneath the feet of parents. Yet Paradise is not below, Paradise is above. That means Paradise is found in serving your parents. When parents grow old, take care of them. Their hands tremble; hold them by the arm, hold your parents by the shoulder.

brh: داسہ سل لمہ باوہ نا، انو کے چنکی ٹی نین پرہیز کتوڑا، نین تینا اوستاتے خراب کتوڑا، نین بیزار متوڑا، داسہ پیری ٹی نی لمہ باوہ بیزار مفا، ہیں؟ چنکی ٹی چنکی نی کے سنا، ذرا سا سنا، لمہ باوہ ننے بیزار مسورا، مسے مسے وار بے شولارا، صابو نا
en: Now, as for your parents: back when you were a child, they did not shun you, they did not let their hearts sour, they did not get fed up with you. Now, in their old age, don't you get fed up with your parents, okay? In childhood you were small, just a little one; did our parents get fed up with us? Three times over they bathed us, with soap
en_old: Now look at your parents. When in childhood you did not hold back, you upset them, they did not get fed up. Now, in their old age, don't you get fed up with your parents, okay? In childhood you were little, just little, and our parents did not get fed up with us. They washed us again and again, with soap,

brh: خلقرا پاؤڈر خلیرا پچاتے مٹافرا او وختی لمہ باوہ نی آن نفرت کپسا نی آن بیزار مفسا اگر ئنا ہا لمہ باوانا زیے ماس پا مارنا زیے ذمہ داری ئے کہ تینا حقاتے پورا کے لمہ باوانا خدمت ء کے لمہ باوانا پچا
en: they scrubbed us, they put powder on us, they changed our clothes, and back then your parents did not hate you, did not get fed up with you. Concerning those parents of yours, it is the duty of the daughter and son to fulfil their rights, to serve the parents, to wash the parents' clothes
en_old: they rubbed [oil on us], put powder on us, changed our clothes, and back then your parents did not hate you, did not get fed up with you. If... it is the son's and daughter's responsibility to fulfill their rights, to serve their parents, [to wash] their parents' clothes.

brh: تہ تسلے لمہ باوے بے شولے لمہ باوے بستر آتے خاچوے اللہ نا نبی رحمتہ اللہ علیہ صلوات علیہ السلام پاننگٹی ئے امو برنا انگا مار امو مسڑ امو مار کو کہ لمہ دانگن لمہ خاچو کہ دانگن باوہ خاچو کہ او نامٹی تما خاچو کہ کھٹے تے نا نامٹی تے خا
en: ...washes their clothes, bathes the parents, lays the parents down in their beds. Allah's Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) is saying: that young son, that daughter, that son who lays his mother down on this side and his father on that side, and lies down himself in the middle, lies down between the beds
en_old: ...washed their parents, laid their parents down in their beds. Allah's Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) is saying: that young son, that daughter, that son who laid his mother here, laid his father there, then laid himself in the middle, laid himself between the beds,

brh: راستی کو پاسون لمہ، چپی کو پاسون باوا، یا راستی کو پاسون باوا، چپی کو پاسون لمہ، نامتی مار کو تینے کھٹے تے کھا، داسہ لمہ ہم مخفنگٹی ئے باوا ہم مخفنگٹی ئے لمہ او دے مخفنگٹی ئے باوا مار کو مخفنگٹی ئے ایلو اسیٹون جوانو
en: with the mother on the right side and the father on the left, or the father on the right and the mother on the left, and the son himself in the middle between the beds. Now the mother is laughing, the father is laughing too; the mother is laughing with him, the father and the son are laughing, nicely with one another
en_old: with his mother on the right side and his father on the left, or his father on the right and his mother on the left, the son lying himself in the middle between the beds. Now the mother is laughing and the father is laughing too. That day the mother is laughing, the father and son are laughing, talking nicely with each other,

brh: گپ کننگٹی او مار کو کوشش کننگٹی کہ لمہ مخے لمہ نوس خوش مرے کنا مست پدی مرے باوا مخے باوا خوش مرے کنا مست پدی مرے ہنگ نبی رحمت العالمین اللہ سے پاننگٹی ئے کنا پیغمبر کنے تنا ذات کبریا نا قسم ئے ارا مار کو کہ تنا لمہ
en: chatting, and the son is trying to make his mother laugh, so that his mother's heart is happy and my aim is fulfilled; to make his father laugh, so that his father is happy and my aim is fulfilled. Thus Allah says to the Prophet, the Mercy to the Worlds: 'My Prophet, I swear by My own Majestic Being: the son who his mother
en_old: chatting, and the son is trying to make his mother laugh, so his mother is happy and pleased with me; to make his father laugh, so his father is happy and pleased with me. Then Allah says to the Prophet, the Mercy to the Worlds: My Prophet, I swear by My Majestic Being, the son who [is busy with] his mother

brh: لمہ باوے خوش کننگ ٹی ئے لمہ باوے راضی کننگ ٹی خدا ہم راضی مننگ ٹی اوٹ سبحان اللہ ئنا نیت اٹ نان ٹی خاچنگ ٹی لمہ باونا کہ لمہ ئے ہم مفک باوہ ئے ہم مفک ہرتوما راضی کیک اللہ سے پانٹی ئے بندہ ئے نی آن ہم راضی اوٹ
en: and father, making his parents happy, pleasing his parents, I, God, am also becoming pleased.' Glory be to Allah! With his intention of lying down in the middle between his parents, so that it is not only the mother and not only the father, he pleases both of them, Allah says: 'My servant, I am pleased with you too.'
en_old: and father, making his parents happy, pleasing his parents, God is pleased with him too. Subhan Allah! By his intention of lying down between his parents, with neither his mother nor his father left out, whoever he pleases, Allah says: My servant, I am pleased with you too.

brh: ننے اوخفنگ تو لمہ باوہ نا برکت ئے لیکن مخفنگ مفک۔ آواز ہنڈو کرے باز ہرے مسیٹی۔ مخفینرے وقتس ننا نیت لمہ باوہ کہ اللہ راضی مرے۔ تینٹ مخیر تو قدرت نیت سے ورنہ نن مخفنگ کپن۔ اوخفنگ تو کین لیکن مخفنگ ننے آن مفک۔ کنا دعا اللہ سے نمے تون
en: We manage to make our parents cry, though parents are a blessing, but making them laugh does not happen. [Unclear: '...the voice... it has been a long time...'] Make them laugh at some point! Our intention toward our parents should be that Allah is pleased. If they laugh by themselves, that is by God's power and intention; otherwise we cannot make them laugh. Making them cry we can do, but making them laugh is beyond us. My prayer to Allah, with all of you:
en_old: We can make them cry, though our parents are a blessing, but we cannot make them laugh. [His] voice grew..., it became very... Make them laugh. Sometimes our intention toward our parents is that Allah may be pleased. If they laugh on their own, that is by divine will; otherwise we cannot make them laugh. We can make them cry, but making them laugh is beyond us. My prayer to Allah is that you

brh: اللہ تعالی کنے لمہ، لمہ باوہ نا عزت نا توفیق عطا فرمائے۔ آمین۔ اللہ سئیں پارے، 'واخفض لہما جناح الذل من الرحمہ'۔ تینے انوں عاجز کر لمہ باوہ نا مونی دو کے رلی، کیرغان شاس لمہ باوہ تولیرا۔
en: May Allah Almighty grant me the ability to honor my mother, my mother and father. Amen. Allah the Lord said: 'Wakhfid lahuma janaha adh-dhulli mina ar-rahmah' (And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy). Make yourself that humble before your parents: with your hands, spread a sheet beneath them and let your parents sit.
en_old: May Allah Almighty grant me the ability to honor my mother, my mother and father. Ameen. Allah said: 'Wakhfid lahuma janahadh-dhulli minar-rahmah' (And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy). Make yourself that humble before your parents, [keep your] hands down, sit below your parents' feet.

brh: نن تینا پرغاتے دوتے تنے شیف کا لمہ باوہ تون تینا مقابلہ کپہ صحابی پانڈے یا رسول اللہ اگر لمہ باوہ ظلم کیر تینا مار تون گڑا لمہ باوہ تون جنگ کین یا کپن زیادتی کیر ملکیتاتے پلیر مال تنے نہ پلیر گڑا ہمری کیر
en: Lower your wings, your hands, yourself; do not set yourself against your parents. A Companion says: 'O Messenger of Allah, if the parents commit injustice against their son, then should we fight with the parents or not? If they wrong us, seize the properties, seize our wealth, then what should we do?'
en_old: We should lower our wings, our hands; do not set yourself against your parents. A companion asks: O Messenger of Allah, if parents treat their son unjustly, should we then fight our parents or not? If they do us wrong, take our properties, take our wealth, then...

brh: اللہ نا نبی پانت کہ باوا واللہ مظلوم کے رحم باوا واللہ مت مقابلہ مفک ہمجا سنگتوس ہمونن پانو سئیں کنا باوا مولوی صاحب کنے خبر ئے کل ملک دے بھلا چمچہ مارے کنے ہنڑ مڑا خالی دو تے اڑے نا
en: Allah's Prophet says: 'As for the father, by God, even if you are the wronged one, show mercy; as for the father, by God, there must be no confronting him.' Right there a friend said thus: 'Sir, my father... Maulvi sahib, I know: he gave all the land to the big favorite son, and has now left me empty-handed.'
en_old: Allah's Prophet says: the father, by Allah, even the wronged one [should show] mercy; by Allah, do not set yourself against your father. A friend said to him: sir, my father... Maulvi sahib, I know all the land and days... he hit me with a big spoon, ... me with empty hands here...

brh: ہچڑا ہفت تو سہی گڑا خالد او تینا مڑے اونا مرضی اگر گڑاس ایتنے اونا مرضی اگر باواتون مقابلہ کریس خدا ناراض مرے بے شک۔ ملکتارے تلم باوانے خواجہ تلم باوائے یاد کبو کنا ایلوم آک امو نی کہ رحمت اللعالمین صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پارے کہ
en: Even if he gives nothing, that is fine; then it is his own property, his choice. If he gives something, that is his choice. If you confront your father, God will be angry, without doubt. The father is the owner of the property; remember your father. My brothers, that is why the Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him) said that
en_old: Even if [he takes] seven, that is fine. So, Khalid, he is his own; it is his choice. If he gives you something, that is his choice. If you set yourself against your father, God will be angry, without doubt. Properties... remember your father, my brothers. That is why the Mercy to the Worlds (peace be upon him) said that

brh: لمہ باونہ قدرے کبو لمہ باونہ عزتی کبو اللہ زات پاک فرمائفے واخفض لہما جناح الذل من الرحمتہ و قل رب ارحمھما کما ربیانی صغیرا اراتم دوتے بڑزا کبو کہ لمہ پیرنگا وٹی تولوک ئے باوہ
en: Value your parents, honor your parents. Allah, the Pure Being, has commanded: 'Wakhfid lahuma janaha adh-dhulli mina ar-rahmati wa qul rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayani saghira' (And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy, and say: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small). When you raise your hands in prayer, say that the mother is sitting here in her old age, the father
en_old: Value your parents, respect your parents. Allah, the Pure Being, has commanded: 'Wakhfid lahuma janahadh-dhulli minar-rahmati wa qur rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira' (And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy, and say: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small). When you raise your hands [in prayer], your mother is sitting in her old age, your father

brh: او کمزورنگا کنا وٹ تولوکئے تومار کوتنے دوتئے بڈاکئے ہمے تمنی چنک اسہ لومہ نیکن دعا خوانا کا باوہ نیکن دعا خوانا کا ئے نو ہو کمزورو بشمننگ کپسا تولنگ کپسا نی ورنا ئس بشمننگ کیسہ تولنگ کیسہ داسہ نیتنے دوتئے بڈاکا اللہ
en: is sitting here weak; so the son should raise his hands. Back then, when you were small, your mother used to pray for you, your father used to pray for you. Eh, now he is weak; they cannot stand up, cannot sit down. You are young, you can stand up, you can sit down. Now raise your hands: 'O Allah,'
en_old: He, the weak one, is sitting beside me; raise your hands. Back then, when you were small, your mother prayed for you and your father prayed for you. Now he is weak, he can't stand up and he can't sit. You are young, you can stand and you can sit. Now raise your hands, O God.

brh: ئے اعتبار کر کہ جوان نی آ خدا انے نی آ خدا دا لمہ کنا پیرینیا تولوک ئے باوہ پیرینیا تولوک ئے ئے اللہ بے ہچڑا کننگ کپرے مسکین تہ غریب سے اٹ لیکن نی اعتبار کیو کنا لمہ باوہ نا زی آ رحم کر خدا عرض
en: eh, have faith: 'You are good, O God; You, O God... this mother of mine is sitting here old, the father is sitting here old. Eh, Allah, I cannot do anything, I am a poor and needy one, but I trust You: have mercy on my mother and father, O God,' I plead.
en_old: Eh, trust that God is good to you, God is with you. My mother is sitting here in her old age, my father is sitting here in his old age. Eh, O God, we can't do anything, we are poor and needy, but you trust, have mercy on my mother and father, O God, I beg you.

brh: اگا چوپ، دندو نا خطرناک او جنو، مارے نا قبضہ کرینو، اگر شکرانہ تسس تعویذ اسر کروئی نتو مار نا ہمیشہ کے جناتا قبضہ ٹی مروئی اہ نننا اللہ
en: If he is quiet, it is such a dangerous jinn; it has taken hold of your son. If you give a thanks-offering, an amulet will have to be made; otherwise your son will be in the grip of the jinns forever. Oh, our God!
en_old: If it is quiet, it is so dangerous, and a jinn has taken hold of the son. If you give a thanks-offering, an amulet must be made, otherwise the son will be in the grip of the jinns forever. Oh, our God.

brh: انتے مارے کنا ئے کاواتیوہ ہاں زو ہست اوہ اللہ نا شکرے کہ دا تعویز سلامت
en: Why [are you ...] my son...? Yes, quickly... Oh, thank God this amulet is safe.
en_old: Why are you taking my son away? Yes, quickly... Oh, thank God this amulet is safe.

brh: کنا پن گل بے بے ئے کنا پن جمال ئے
en: My name is Gul Bibi. My name is Jamal.
en_old: My name is Gul Bibi. My name is Jamal.

brh: ئے شارٹ ہینگوٹ، ہفتہ ٹی اسہ دے ئس داڑے پکنک کے بریو۔ گڑا ئے امر کیو؟ خان حسینہ اوریت ہم ہنک۔ کانے۔
en: Eh, it's a short hangout: one day a week I come here for a picnic. So what do I do? Khan, Hasina, the women go too. ...
en_old: Eh, a short hangout. Come here for a picnic one day a week. Then what will you do? Khan, Hasina, the women go too. ...

brh: دا ہرا تعویذ، دا ہسے تعویذ ئس تو پیرو کے نس؟
en: Which amulet is this? Is this the same amulet you got from the pir?
en_old: This amulet, is this the same amulet you got from the pir?

brh: دا دنائے ہاو شیر خان دا تعویز ضرور نیکن مروئی تاکہ نی شار ایم پی
en: That's how it is, yes, Sher Khan. You must have this amulet so that you become the city's MP.
en_old: This is how the world is, yes, Sher Khan. You must have this amulet so that you become the city's MP.

brh: نہ بابا نہ بابا خیر سے چمٹ شاٹہ ہاؤ
en: No, Baba, no, Baba, everything is fine... yes.
en_old: No, father, no, father, everything's fine, I just got stuck, yes.

brh: نی انت کننگ اٹی ئس اوڑے؟ ئے ئے داڑے تعویز تے تخنگ اٹی اسوٹا
en: What were you doing there? Uh, uh, I was placing the amulets here.
en_old: What were you doing there? Eh, I was placing the amulets here.

brh: ئے سائیں کنے پارے ئے بد کننگ نا تعویز کشس دا پھس کننگ نا تعویز تخک ئے ہمو دے تخوٹ اسٹ چٹ راست پاسہ تا ئے اینو اسکان نی تو بروت الینٹ ارا وختہ نی برو
en: Eh, sir, he told me: 'Eh, take out the amulet for doing harm, and put in this amulet for making things fizzle out.' Eh, I placed it that day. Tell me the honest truth: until today you have not come. When will you come?
en_old: Eh, the master told me, eh, take out the amulet for causing harm; this one is the amulet for ruining things. The day I placed it, tell the truth, you haven't come until today. When will you come?

brh: دا ختر تنیس تینا شار والا برامے مردک کاش دا کنا ایلوم کاکا پٹرول تے خلتوسہ تو دسکاں نی پاتا ونسس گلو ئے متکنو گائتا تلنے نا ئے تو دا سئیں باز پریشان مسوٹ
en: [Unclear: '...this... to the wedding of his own townsfolk... man...'] I wish this brother of mine, Kaka, had not poured in the petrol. Then... you said... [unclear]... old... So, sir, I got very worried.
en_old: Did this star... your city brother would die. I wish my uncle hadn't put the petrol in... then you said... so, sir, I got very worried.

brh: ایڑ کڑ کہ دا براہوئی دستار نا متفق ئے اور انشاءاللہ کوشش کرون اللہ کہ دا ثقافت تینا سوگو کین محفوظ کین دنیائے نشان ایتن کہ بھئی ننا امر او گچین او ثقافت تو سنگتاک میر صاحب نا گپاتی بنغورے زیبدارا گپ آک اوڑپ او نمے نشان تس کہ براہوئی دستارے
en: ...[may] learn (?) that this is the agreed-upon Brahui turban. And God willing, we will try, by God, to keep this culture of ours safe and preserve it, and to show the world, brother, how fine our culture is. So, friends, you heard Mir Sahib's talk, his beautiful words, and he showed you what the Brahui turban is.
en_old: ... agree on this Brahui turban, and God willing we'll try to preserve this culture of ours well and show the world how beautiful and excellent our culture is. So, friends, you heard Mir Sahib's talk, his beautiful words, and he showed you what the Brahui turban is.

brh: امر تفنگی امر شان و شوکتٹ زیبائیٹ تفنگی کنے یقین ئے کہ داڑان ہم ہیل کرورے اور ننا نوجوان نسل ہم تینا ثقافت ء دیران کپرو تینا ثقافت ء تینا است آ تخیباتو اور دنیا ء ننا نشان تون کہ اخس ننا زیباء براہوئی ثقافت
en: How it is tied! With what grandeur and beauty it is tied! I am sure that you will learn from this too, and our young generation will not let its culture go to ruin either; it will keep its culture in its heart, and we will show the world how beautiful our Brahui culture is.
en_old: How beautiful it looks, with such grandeur and beauty! I'm sure they will learn from this too, and our young generation will not let its culture be ruined either. They will keep their culture in their hearts and show the world our identity, how beautiful our Brahui culture is.

brh: تو دانا پروگرام انشاءاللہ نن مونی ہسائینون براہوی ٹی وی نا فیس بک ء لائک کبو یوٹیوب ء سبسکرائب کبو نمنا بھاز بھاز مہربانی
en: So, God willing, we will carry this program forward. Like Brahui TV's Facebook page and subscribe to its YouTube channel. Thank you very, very much.
en_old: So, God willing, we'll end this program here. Like Brahui TV's Facebook page and subscribe to the YouTube channel. Thank you very, very much.

brh: ننا نما ارستنا توا
en: Our... your... [unclear]... voice (?)
en_old: Ours, yours ...

brh: یا یخ باز کرین کلمہ غا مسختہ لا الہ الا اللہ خدا کے صیح خوانے رے نتہ نام ٹمے گدرے پھر کاری پی انشاءاللہ درود شریف یاد کرے
en: ...[unclear]... at the kalima... 'There is no god but God'... you recite [the name of] God correctly... [unclear]... then, God willing, [one should] remember the Durood Sharif.
en_old: ... at the kalima, 'La ilaha illallah' ... recite it properly ... then, God willing, remember the Durood Sharif.

brh: کلمہ یاد کبو دا ہنچو نا زوا بینگنن ئے ورا والا پینا ئے زیادہ بینگن چنا تلوکیرا دادے ہمونگ رائی کبو نن کمپنا ت نن داس کمدی دیخا طبیعت اگنا برابر او
en: Remember the kalima. This one... is hungry... the other one is even hungrier, the children ... [unclear]; send this one off the same way. We don't do [that]... now... temperament... equal.
en_old: Remember the kalima ... this much ... the eggplant ... the children fry a lot of eggplant ... do it the same way ... we don't ... temperament ... equal ...

brh: ہفت ورا اسکان ئنا صفا فیرنگا ولا مورا غا سر مس۔ سمجھا ئس نا؟ داسہ نی ککڑ ئس سڑیسہ قسمتی۔ دانگن تاتن ورا اینگن، ولن ورا اینگن، اینگن ماما علی شیر ئے لیکن کنے سے تینٹ۔
en: ...up to seven... completely... reached... Did you understand? Now you, a chicken... [unclear]... luck. Like this... like that... that's how it is, it is Uncle Ali Sher, but to me... himself.
en_old: Up to seven ... it was completely ... and reached ... Understood? Now you'd burn a chicken, bad luck... ... Uncle Ali Sher, but to me...

brh: زئیفہ نصیب ئس پھیری کنے دوشمبا دیر باز شاپیس دیر باز شاپیس کہ دا نماز باز خوانانے سو تہجد ہم خوانانے دا ہچ جان و جان و بے دیر کنے پا اگر نماز خوانتنو گڑا مشکون ہمو ککڑ نا کننگ نا لائق اف
en: A woman... [unclear]... to me on Monday, [said] a lot, [said] a lot, that this one prays a lot, he even prays tahajjud... tell me: if he has not prayed, then he is not worthy of eating that chicken.
en_old: The old woman's fate ... she told me on Monday, she said many times that this one prays a lot, he even prays tahajjud ... she told me that if he doesn't pray, then he's not even worthy of eating that chicken.

brh: واللہ نہ مخلوق ئے تڑنگ ئے کہ ایذا کنیک نا پھڈ ئے بریک تو کم از کم نی خدائے تو درست کا نبی ئے تو درست کا سجدہ بہ کتنوس کنیک بہ چپی گدوٹ پھڑہ انت ئے ماما انت ئے ریش پیئن مسنے
en: By God, it is not [right] to hurt (cut off) people so that trouble comes upon [their] belly. So at least set yourself right with God, set yourself right with the Prophet; you have not even done a prostration, and you even eat with the left hand. What is this, uncle, what is this? Your beard has turned white.
en_old: By God, people cannot bear it when harm comes their way. Then at least you should have made things right with God, made things right with the Prophet, and prostrated... I kept quiet... what is it, uncle, what is it, the beard has turned white.

brh: اسرائیل مچ خلسا ایتت دا لیٹ فیونو تے بلین حرفوا تبی چپی کودوٹ کونیک راستی کوئی تپا پاریستا ئے چھونا کین راستی گودوٹ کھنتنو سمجھا سمتو
en: Israel... gathered (?)... gave... [unclear]... he eats with the left hand... the right hand... said... small... [they] have not eaten with the right hand... did you understand?
en_old: Israel gathered everything and gave... truly... understood...

brh: ادا ذات درتو دے ایت کے، درتو دے ایت کے کہ چھنکی وٹی جوابن نہ ایتک گناہ، ادا غلطی ئس بلو کرے نو، اینن پتو بے کنے، راستی کو دو اخہ کہ کاریم کے اناڑٹ کنے و دادو اٹ کنے
en: That Being gives..., gives..., so that if a small one does not give an answer, [it is a] sin; if this one made a big mistake, then... today... me. The right hand: whatever work it does, [it does] there, and with this hand...
en_old: This being grants patience, grants patience, so that if someone does not answer an insult... if this one made a big mistake, then... truly, how much work is done there, and here...

brh: ہم پارہ کہ ثواب ہم ملے نی خدا ہم راضی مرے اونگ توجہ ئے ئے صحاباک ئے تینا محبوب نا زندگی نا راٹ ئے پٹ اٹ خدا نا قسم ئے
en: They also say that you also get a reward and God is also pleased. Pay attention to that: the Companions sought out the path of their beloved's life, I swear by God.
en_old: They also say that one gains reward and God is pleased too. Pay attention: the Companions searched the path of their beloved's life, by God's oath.

brh: بدر نا جنگ مس بدر ٹی بلو جنگس مس قران پائک ولقد نصرکم اللہ ببدر وانتم اذلہ اللہ سئی پینٹی بدر ٹی جنگ مس ہنین ٹی جنگ مس
en: The Battle of Badr took place; a great battle took place at Badr. The Quran says: 'And Allah had already given you victory at Badr while you were weak.' God the Lord [says] elsewhere: a battle took place at Badr, a battle took place at Hunayn.
en_old: The Battle of Badr took place; a great battle took place at Badr. The Quran says: "And Allah had already helped you at Badr while you were weak." God says a battle took place at Badr and a battle took place at Hunayn.

brh: او دے بیہ بسور لیکن سلامت واپس بسور۔ ولقد نصرکم اللہ فی مواطن کثیرہ ویوم ہنین اللہ سئیں پارے کہ ئے محبوب، او کنا محبوب نا شاگرداک ہر جاگہ غان نما مدد
en: That day they came..., but they came back safe. 'Allah has given you victory in many places, and on the day of Hunayn.' God the Lord said: O beloved, and [you,] my beloved's disciples, from every place [I came to] your help...
en_old: That day they came back wounded, but they came back safe. "Allah has already helped you in many places, and on the day of Hunayn." God said: O beloved, I helped you and my beloved's disciples everywhere.

brh: نم بننگ اٹی ارے، چلتن ایف ایم ہشتاد و ہشت۔
en: You are listening to Chiltan FM eighty-eight.
en_old: You are listening to Chiltan FM 88.

brh: کرے نوٹ لیکن مین ہنین نا میدانے خطرناک و جنگ ء زد دشمنک نمے گھیرو کریر نمے حلقو کر کہ محمد عربی موجود ئس کا ئے خدا نم کن بلو مدد ئس کرے ہنین ٹی
en: ...I have done [it]. But the battlefield of Hunayn was dangerous, and in the battle the enemies surrounded you, encircled you; [but] since Muhammad the Arab was present, God gave you great help at Hunayn.
en_old: ...but the field of Hunayn was dangerous and the battle was fierce. The enemies surrounded you and encircled you, but since Muhammad the Arab was present, God gave you great help at Hunayn.

brh: ئے ورنا نم پاسینگا سورے باز تکلیفاتے ٹی پاسینگا رے لیکن کنے خدائے رحم بس محمد عربی نا ذات او را چہرے او را کنے رحم بس اینو ممد کرے ئے کنے محبوب تینا امت پا کنے مزن پا کم کم
en: O youths, you had been surrounded, surrounded by many hardships, but I, God, felt mercy: for the person of Muhammad the Arab, for his face, I felt mercy; today help was given (?). O my beloved, tell your ummah, tell [them]... very few...
en_old: O young men, you went through many hardships, but God had mercy on me. The person of Muhammad the Arab, his face, moved me to mercy. Today Muhammad did... O my beloved, tell your ummah that it is great to me...

brh: نما اوچا کم کم نما اولی کم کم نما کوننگ ہم کم لیکن مددی خدا تینٹ کرینوٹ دا سہ فصل غلہ تے تکنے نما وا ساری تے تکنے می خولم تے تکنے دا سپیرنگ آ دنو استادی تے کپے سین غصہ پا
en: Your camels were very few, your horses very few, your food too was little, but God Himself helped: 'I have done it.' Now crops and grain... your ... wheat... [unclear]... do not show cleverness... anger...
en_old: Your... were few, your first ones were few, and you had little to eat, but God Himself helped. Look at these crops of grain, look at your... look at... do not show mastery... anger...

brh: دے اینا ہرا گنا ئس پنی مرو ہرا گنا ئس دانگ دزیسہ دزی کرے کہ چوٹا تین جوڑ کرفیسوس ئے وڈ اینا کہ دانگ چوٹا تا مون دانگ ئس کہ بس دانگ کائک مخلوق دانگ دودینگا کہ پٹاک دے اینا کہ دن ننا ہا
en: Today, whatever sin... becomes..., whatever sin, like this, he stole by stealth so that he would make himself (crooked) right... like today... like this... the face... like this... it just comes like this, people... like this... the day that... our...
en_old: One day some sin... some sin, grain... he stole, so that he could make himself great... like grain... just the grain comes, the people... the day that we...

brh: الا مودی اللہ اکبر وا کبرے کرا سنگت اسرا انت با ایرا سنگت دادنے مکھنرے وختا سنگت آ گڑا سیواڑو پچ کیرا پچ بے اسیواڑو بوٹ
en: ...God is great... friend, what... friend... at this time, friend, then they wear ... clothes, clothes... boots.
en_old: ...God is great... friend, what... friend, at this time, friend, in spring things ripen, ripen in spring...

brh: سیوڑو کوڑا او خیسنو رنگ سے تیرا دا کشار ہر کس پہ جئی خیسن شاخ فیل رتا دیراٹی خناٹ ساسولیسس زیر صبا
en: ...and a red colour... this crop field, everyone... a red branch... in the water I saw... under the morning breeze.
en_old: Spring, green and red colour... this field, everyone... a red branch... in the water I saw... under the morning breeze.

brh: او دے خناٹ تو مچو جبت چھڑو مشس، دادے خناٹ تو رت آٹی بس بروتاک دون ٹوپ چپی، خیسونے چلا بس داکے شاغوک، ڈبل گھوڑا ئے پڑے ہمودس پنسس، چھپ کیسوس استاد شیر کا پیس کنے سئے
en: When I saw that one, it had all become just...; when I saw this one, ... he came, mustache like this, cap [tilted] to the left, the red ... came, wearing ..., Double Horse ... that was its name; 'keep quiet', master Sher said to me...
en_old: When I saw that day, everything had become just... When I saw this, I flew into a rage(?)... the mustache like this, the cap tilted to the left, the red one came walking... Double Horse... it had the same name... be quiet, master, lion...

brh: انگس کے وا سمجھارے سنتو؟ او تسکہ خنے وزدہ غریبی ئے پمری اڈے سانگل کوس پیامو امو جوڑی اسانتے سرک نن تے تور پد نی چرافت
en: Do you understand it that way? He gave... sees... poverty... a chain... that pair... road... we... after... you...
en_old: Do you understand it like this? He gave, so he sees... poverty... chain... that pair... road... after...

brh: بلو روفنگ سے ڈیوٹی تھا، گڑا اسہ وڑ پچ کیرا، مونو کرو تو اسہ وڑ کرو، رنگ ریرو اسہ وڑ کرو، لیکن جی باتیر تیچڑاو سنیا بھڑ بھین، با قانون نی خنت نی پاز بس دا۔
en: It was a big ... duty; then they make the clothes in one [same] way: if they make the front, they make it the same way, the colour too they make the same way. But ... by law you see... this.
en_old: A big... duty, then it ripens in one way; the face is done one way, the colour is done one way, but... by law you see... this.

brh: آجو خواستی ن بلا ہنا دے شاہین ن بلا ہنا دے یاد کبو کنا ایلو مارک، نبی ن شریعت ن زی عمل کرون، نبی ن سنت ن زی عمل کرون، صحابہ تا
en: ... the great day has gone; Shaheen's great day has gone. Remember, my brothers and sons: let us act upon the Prophet's sharia, let us act upon the Prophet's sunnah, [and on] the Companions'...
en_old: Grandpa, great days have gone; Shaheen, great days have gone. Remember my other... Let us act on the Prophet's sharia, let us act on the Prophet's sunnah, and that of the Companions.

brh: براہوئی مجلس تو ساڑی ئے نما ارجمندیں منظور کیازئی۔
en: Present with [us on] Brahui Majlis is your esteemed Manzoor Kiazai (?).
en_old: The Brahui gathering... your esteemed... accepted.

brh: طریقہ اٹ زندگی گدریفون، آن شاء اللہ دنیا ہم زیبا مریک پکا قیامت ہم زیبا مریک۔ ئنا دا ڈغار زندان اورینا، ئنا دا ڈغار ٹی کڈ ختیرین، ننے دا ٹی تخیرین۔ لیکن دا ڈغار زگہ چے نو دا دلپسند او مئے
en: ...let us live our life in [their] way; God willing, this world will be beautiful too, and the Hereafter will surely be beautiful too. This earth of ours is a prison; in this earth they will dig a hole for us and place us in it. But this earth... this is pleasing and...
en_old: If you live your life in the right way, God willing, this world will be beautiful and the Hereafter will surely be beautiful too. This earth is a prison for us; they will dig a grave in this earth and place us in it. But this earth is pleasant and...

brh: کلر انگا دغار ئے دیر ات دنوک، دغار ئس کہ آباد مف، چھڑو کھرے مرے، کاشم مرے، او شنز مرے، مرن نا درخت مرے، ہموت گورا کیرن کھڈے ختیرہ، اڑے ابائے سے خان ئے کیرن تے خان، ابا نا سو گوانزا تے لوڈو کنٹی۔
en: ...saline land ... by water, a land that is not cultivated, where there is only scrub, reeds and shinz bushes, and ... trees; there they make the grave, they dig the pit. Hey, father... khan... father's ... [unclear].
en_old: ...land in the water. A piece of land that is not cultivated, with only thorns, kasham and shinz bushes, and a dead tree. There they dig a pit... father... khan... father's...

brh: اغان دا نی تولٹاکن شروع مریرا ابا نماز خوانا نی تنک گڑاس کرین تو گنجاک باقی جمعہ نا نن ودی غا تغاریس کرور گڑ شاغور تا گڑاس کشمش شاغور تا استاد حافظ حسین احمد صاحب دعا کے سبا کے
en: From here it starts ...; father prayed, then [they] did something; ... on the rest of Friday night we..., they will make a basin [of food], put jaggery in it, put some raisins in it, and teacher Hafiz Husain Ahmed Sahib says a prayer [over it] ... in the morning.
en_old: From here it starts in the evening. Father prays, then they do something. On the rest of Friday we make a pudding, add jaggery and some raisins, and the teacher Hafiz Husain Ahmed Sahib says a prayer.

brh: دا گڑوٹ ابا نا چھڈینگ پکا او جوان ئس تو سست و کنگر دا ننا تو سپدے مس ننتو سیر کرے لیکن ابا نا دا گڑو غے چھڈینگ پکا ابا نا تینٹ محنت کے دنیا نا تٹی تینا کاریمے تینٹ کے تینا پیسے مچ کے تینا عملاتے مچ کے تینا نیکی تے مچ کے
en: With this jaggery, father's release is certain (?), and it was good... this became ... for us, it filled us up; but is father's release through this jaggery certain? Father himself does the toiling: in the world he does his own work himself, gathers his own money, gathers his own deeds, gathers his own good deeds.
en_old: This... father's legacy was solid and good... this became... for us, it filled us, but father's legacy... father worked hard himself; in this world he did his own work, saved up his own money, built up his own deeds, built up his own good deeds.

brh: اندو نورینگا چک اسپئے، خلوکا خرا سنبھال، باز مرخ کشیتانوس، نی پاوا، جی رہبر نی ہم مچے نوشی جان کر، بسے نو
en: Like that, turn the [unclear] horse (?), look after the beaten donkey, you haven't pulled much [unclear]... I tell you, sir guide, you too eat a little, enjoy it, that's enough now.
en_old: Look carefully like that, hold on to the beaten donkey, you've pulled a lot of ... and you said, 'Sir guide, you enjoy yourself a little too, come on.'

brh: تینا پڈء پر کبو کنا توست بفک آجوانی ہئے کنا پیروتے چارک
en: Fill your bellies; I don't feel like it (?)... [unclear]... look after my Pero.
en_old: Fill your stomach. My voice won't stop... freedom... it watches my Pero.

brh: اڑاڑی کنے دڑنگوئی ئے اموڑی دیر شاہ خان او او تم سماتم پیرو مشاری آئی یا اللہ امڑ دڑنگو
en: Where am I supposed to stop? Who is that over there, Shah Khan? And when I came to my senses, Pero [unclear]... O God, how will I stop here?
en_old: Where do I hide? Over there, Dir Shah Khan... and when I realized Pero had gone... O God, where do I hide?

brh: شام تمنگٹیئے، مگہ ئے نی درداتیان ابانم زند مسکینہ نندن کرے درختاتے اکدرینگا، نی تو مندن مروئی
en: Evening is falling, but I... from your pains [unclear]... life is miserable... the trees [unclear]... you will have to stay (here).
en_old: Evening is falling, but you... from the pains... life is miserable... the trees... you have to stay.

brh: پیرو دان مس داسہ دا نمبر ء او رے
en: Pero is [unclear]; now it's this one's turn... oh, hey.
en_old: Pero has grown up; now this is the number...

brh: ئے نوری مسافتا ما تمام کتنوں
en: We have not completed the [unclear] journey.
en_old: Yes, we have finished the whole journey.

brh: سلساف دمہ الیس
en: Stop, catch your breath.
en_old: Completely out of breath.

brh: یا اللہ خیر دا انتو انت نا رنتو دا خو بلو بلو یا اللہ
en: O God, let it be good! What is this, what kind of thing is this? This one is huge, huge, O God!
en_old: O God, have mercy, what is this, what on earth is this... it's huge, huge, O God!

brh: او پیرو نا باوا او پیرو نا باوا بش من بش بش منی با بش امبر
en: O Pero's father, O Pero's father, get up, get up, get up, come on, get up and come!
en_old: O Pero's father, O Pero's father, wake up, wake up, wake up... wake up!

brh: انٹ بسنے؟ دوزخ بسونٹ، دوزخ بسونو، جنک بسونو۔ جن؟ جن؟ اراکا بسو دیرس تا؟ انٹ بسو؟ الے کنے۔
en: What has come? Hell has come, hell has come, jinns have come. Jinns? Jinns? Where did they come from? Who are they? What came? Leave me alone.
en_old: What has come? Hell has come, hell has come, a girl has come. A jinn? A jinn? Who came, from where? What came? Tell me.

brh: انکا نی ہمثو مئے دا راک بسور امر بسور انت کے بسور نی بش نی تینے ڈکیسہ بش متو کان نی خناست نا نی خناست عبد الصمد جی خناٹ تا
en: Now you too... these came here? How did they come? Why did they come? You, get up! You're hiding yourself, you didn't get up. Did you see them? Did you see them? Abdul Samad ji, I saw them!
en_old: Then you too... these came here, how did they come, why did they come? You wake up, you're hiding yourself, didn't you wake up? Did you see? Did you see them, Abdul Samad ji, did you see them?

brh: بس التا او تینٹ کارا دازا نیمن خاچک کنے ملنگا جنا خننگا کہ خناٹ تا او ہرا ہنگنوس پیرونا کوٹی ٹی او نہ بابا ہو پیرونا کوٹی ٹی ہو نی بش مروٹ
en: Enough, leave them, they'll go on their own... [unclear] sleep... I saw dervish-like jinns, that's how I saw them. — And where did you go? Into Pero's room? — Oh no, dear. — Yes, into Pero's room. — Yes, you get up.
en_old: They came... and they themselves... I saw the jinns gathering... that you saw them? Where did you go, into Pero's room? No, father, yes, into Pero's room. Yes, you'll be awake.

brh: دا چے؟ مگے جناک خننگرہ ننے لٹ خلیرہ؟
en: What is this? But do jinns show themselves and beat us with sticks?
en_old: What's this? Do the jinns see us? Will they beat us with sticks?

brh: او تپہ، او مپہ، لٹ اٹ او تپہ، بر، برک، برک، الیاس
en: Hey, hit it! Hey, don't! Hit it with the stick, hey! Come, come here, come here, Ilyas!
en_old: Hey, hit it! Hey, don't hit! Hit it with the stick! Come, come, come, Ilyas!

brh: او نا تو برتھو برتھو سئی دان تو برتھو نی اینا کتے خڑک کے گڑاس خنیس
en: And come on, come on, all right, come this way, come on; bring the dog closer here, you'll see something.
en_old: Bring it out, bring it, bring it right out; bring the dog closer here, you'll see something.

brh: دادور اینٹ پاریٹ؟ جلو بس ہلو ترو کمرہ ٹی نانو۔ گلو! ہت جلو! جلو گلو! جلو!
en: Dadur, what did I say? Quick, come, take it... into the room. Gullu! Bring it, quick! Quick, Gullu! Quick!
en_old: Dadur, what are you saying? Quickly, come, put it in the room. Gullu! Hurry, quick! Quick, Gullu! Quick!

brh: چٹ چٹ چٹ چٹ چٹ چٹ رے رے چٹ گلی گلی چٹ چٹ خانہ بد نی کاندو سے لتے نی ڈکیسہ
en: Shoo, shoo, shoo, shoo, shoo, shoo! Hey, hey, shoo! Gulli, Gulli, shoo, shoo! You wretch, you're hiding your legs [unclear]!
en_old: Shoo, shoo, shoo! Hey, hey, shoo! Down the alley, shoo, shoo! You wretch, you're hiding your legs.

brh: مکا نن تنے جناتی انٹ کن کینا؟ دادا نن دادا نن نداکو جنداکو دا مو جنداکو پیرو دیرے سو پیرو ئے ارکان نن نی کان انچکان سے۔ نی تو باو الیتو خدائے تنو من الیتو۔ آخر جناتی تو کشوئی۔
en: Don't! Why would we bring jinn possession on ourselves? Dada, we... Dada, we... [unclear]... Pero... who... Pero... we... you... [unclear]. You didn't let it, father; God didn't let... In the end, the jinn possession has to be driven out.
en_old: Then why are we doing the jinn exorcism for you? Dada, we... Pero is... Pero... we... you... You weren't... God... In the end, the jinns have to be driven out.

brh: نی کاریم ئس کننگ کینا، ہاؤ ہاؤ، پدی برتھ تو سہی، ددھک ہنگا چچ مفک، برک، نی مونی مر، نی مونی مر، ئے مونی مرم، ئے کینٹ او
en: We can do one thing — yes, yes — come back then, all right; [unclear] won't happen; come on, you go in front, you go in front. Shall I go in front? I'll do it.
en_old: You can do a job, yes, yes, then bring it back, all right, it won't get ruined here, it's coming, you go ahead, you go ahead, I'll go ahead, ...

brh: خدا نا مہر خدا نا مہر او گلو گلو گلو
en: God's mercy, God's mercy! Oh Gullu, Gullu, Gullu!
en_old: God's love, God's love, and glu glu glu

brh: داک تہ ہمو نت نا شاراکو ہمو جناتا کہ پیرو دریسور۔ راست پاوہ۔
en: These are the footprints (?) of those very jinns that had taken Pero away. I'm telling the truth.
en_old: These are the descendants of that lineage, of those people who were elders. I'm telling the truth.

brh: اونا کے پاس او پارہ مول، مول پارہ، او پارہ مول دا خدو مرے جی جی جی، تو دا خاص یخ ختی، اچھا دا یخ ختی خلیرا، ہو دا یخ ختی
en: For it... they call it 'mol', 'mol' they call it, they call it 'mol' [unclear]. Yes, yes, yes. So this is especially for the cold (?). Oh, they wear this one for the cold? Yes, this is for the cold.
en_old: He says to him 'mol', he says 'mol' ... yes, yes, yes, so this is special ... OK, this ... yes, this ...

brh: کل آن زیات ئے بندغ نا، جی، باز ایت ئے یار حساب اٹوسے، اوڑس احوال پوک کیر ئے بندغ نا کاٹم ئے صحیح صحیح صحیح، تو دا کاٹم نا، دا حصہ ٹی کل ئے کھڑے دا مون نا بند ئے دا کاٹم نا، ماشاءاللہ، بالکل، بس خاص ئے
en: More than anything, a person's... yes, it's a big matter, friend, by that reckoning; as they tell it, the most important part of a person is the head — right, right, right. So of this head, in this part, all of it... this is the band for the front of the head. Mashallah, absolutely, it's just special.
en_old: Above all, for a person, yes, it is very... friend, by this reckoning... a person's head, right, right, right, so for the head, in this part, the whole front band of the head, mashallah, exactly, it's just special.

brh: تو دانا ٹھیک اسٹ نا دے دا کفن ایرا لجم کریس کس کو دانا کفن واہ واہ واہ ایرا تمیکو لجم گاک مریرے ٹھیک نا مست کسے بنوس تہ زغمس بٹی دانا کاٹماں بچاؤ تمس ایرا ولے کا دستار نا
en: So the proper thing about it: first, on the day (of death) this is the shroud; secondly it also keeps one's modesty [unclear]... its shroud, wow, wow, wow; secondly it becomes modesty [unclear], right. In the past, if someone came at you, if a sword struck, it protected the head. Secondly, though, the turban's...
en_old: So the right thing about it is that on the day [of death] this serves as a shroud... its shroud, wow, wow, wow... and in the past, if someone was wounded, it protected his head, but the turban's...

brh: دا درے نم لیکن پچا واہ اونا حفاظت حفاظت تمس صحیح ایرا ٹمیکو یخکی صحیح صحیح ناموسی سبیلہ کل دستار ماشاءاللہ انگریز نا الے رسماتے دستار براہوئی
en: This [unclear]... but the clothing, wow — its protection, it gave protection, right; secondly, against the cold, right, right; a means of honor, the whole turban, mashallah. The customs of the English... the Brahui turban.
en_old: This ... but its protection, protection, right ... right, honor ... the whole turban, mashallah, the customs of the English ... the Brahui turban

brh: انگریز نا الے رسماتے دستار براہوئی تے بائے نا ٹوپو دا صدری خیریتو سینگار
en: The customs of the English... the turban, the Brahuis' [unclear] cap, this waistcoat — [unclear] adornment.
en_old: The customs of the English ... the turban of the Brahuis, the father's cap, this waistcoat is an adornment.

brh: دا مسنا دا مسنا تور یا مولا تو یخ اولاد
en: This has happened, this has happened... [unclear], O Lord... [unclear] offspring.
en_old: This became, this became... O Mawla, ... children

brh: او ماشاء اللہ دروت ہم ہما سے باز تات ہم زبردست ئے ہم ہندرے سے صحیح او مچ باز چیف ہندرے او ئے ون ہما رواج کے صحیح ایلو یخ ئنا گڈا نو گونڈ مرو صحیح
en: And mashallah, bravo — it's also such a very [unclear], also excellent, also [unclear], right; and very much a chief's [unclear]; and I [unclear] that custom, right. The other one, for the cold — then it would be short, right.
en_old: And mashallah, the whole thing is very ... also excellent, right, and very much a chief's ... that custom, right, the other ... then it will be short, right.

brh: دا مس بغیر مولانا بغیر
en: This was done without — without the mol (head cover)?
en_old: This became, without Maulana, without...

brh: ماشاءاللہ باز زندہ باد باز زندہ باد باز مہربانی میر صاحب ئے معذرت خواہ وا ئے معافی خواہ وا نمے تکلیف تسوٹ لیکن دا ہمو خاطرا کریٹ کہ کنا بروکا نسل کنا ورنا
en: Mashallah, bravo, bravo! Thank you very much, Mir Sahib. I apologize, I ask your forgiveness for having troubled you, but I did this so that my coming generation, my youth...
en_old: Mashallah, long live, long live! Thank you very much, Mir Sahib. I apologize and ask your forgiveness for troubling you, but I did this so that my coming generation, my youth...

brh: قبر آن تا خوشبو بننگ ٹی حضور اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم پاریک کہ دا قبر دن نا ئے عرض آتے نی یا رسول اللہ ئنا صحابی پی امرے خوشبو مفک کہ بدن نا جنگ ٹی خلنگا اور شہید مسونے ئے
en: While the fragrance was coming from the grave, the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) says that this grave is like this. They submitted: "O Messenger of Allah, how could your companion's grave not be fragrant, when he was struck down in the battle of Badr and has been martyred?"
en_old: When fragrance came from the grave, the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said that this grave is like this. They submitted, "O Messenger of Allah, why would your Companion's grave not be fragrant? He was struck in the Battle of Badr and has been martyred."

brh: او نا قبر آن خوشبو نا گند آک بلنگرہ او پاتا دا سم جنت نا کھٹ آک قیامت اسکان جنت نا خواجہ جوڑ مس۔ نن نن تکلیف کرینے۔ ساری تا ٹائم ئس پین آ تا دیر آ تا سٹ کے نا غلہ باہ کیک۔
en: Fragrant smells were rising from his grave, and he said: these are the beds of Paradise; until the Day of Judgment he has become a master of Paradise. We, we have taken trouble. Everyone has a time (a turn); other people's water ... and he sells your grain.
en_old: Fragrant scents rose from his grave. He said this is the scent of Paradise; until the Day of Judgment he has become a master of Paradise. We have taken trouble. It was everyone's time... (unclear)

brh: پین دا ستلی تنی گھٹے نا و نماز ہم خوانک و جمعہ ہم خوانک و اولی کو صف تے زونڈک و دوتے بڑز کرے۔ اللہ سئیں، اللہ سئیں رحم کے ننا زی، ساری دعا کرے
en: Then this one also prays, and also prays the Friday prayer, and sits in the first rows, and raised his hands: "O Lord Allah, O Lord Allah, have mercy on us," and made all the supplications.
en_old: And this one also prays, and also prays the Friday prayer, and seeks out the front rows, and raised his hands: "O Lord Allah, O Lord Allah, have mercy on us," and everyone prayed.

brh: پچا ہمو پچاتے الکونے نا حرامی نا پیساتٹ ہمو پچاتو نماز ہم خواننگ ٹی ہرا کہ نماز باونہ بادشاہی نماز قبول مریک نا شریعت حرام نا پیساٹ کافرک اسر مشرکاک بیت اللہ نا طواف کریرہ نا
en: The clothes, those clothes he has bought with your haram money; praying in those clothes, which prayer... is the prayer accepted? In the sharia, with haram money... the unbelievers and the polytheists used to circumambulate the House of Allah, and...
en_old: The clothes, those clothes he wore were bought with unlawful money; praying in those clothes — which prayer... is the prayer accepted? In the Sharia, with unlawful money... the unbelievers and polytheists used to circumambulate the House of Allah.

brh: پوچا تے دڑ فیر لوچ کر کے پوچاک ننا حرام نو کافر کن خلیس ارے لیکن مسلمان کن خلیس اف پرواہ اف مسلمان دادے دے خدا ظالمو لاخ اینگن گڑو تے ساری ہم پر کیرے تے
en: They would take off their clothes and make themselves naked, (saying) "the clothes are from our haram." The unbeliever had fear, but the Muslim has no fear, no care. The Muslim today, by God, the oppressor... in this way they fill up all the sacks too.
en_old: They took off the clothes, stripped them off — the clothes from our unlawful earnings. The unbeliever has fear, but the Muslim has no fear, no care; the Muslim, this... by God, the oppressor... in this way they fill up all the vehicles.

brh: دنگن کارنگ گڑوتے سٹم پرکیرنت لمہ نا دغارے دغار پین ئے دغہ لتے باکا گڑا بورال ایرا مولوی ہم کنیک مولوی عبدالصمد پیشمام ایننا
en: In this way they fill all the sacks... the mother's land, the land, another's land... the agent... then... the maulvi eats it too, Maulvi Abdul Samad, the prayer leader...
en_old: In this way they fill up all the vehicles; the mother's land, land, another's land... the maulvi does it too, Maulvi Abdul Samad, the prayer leader...

brh: ادبی مجلس نا ساری ئے نمار جی منظور کیازے
en: Everyone of the Literary Society... please accept it, sir.
en_old: Please approve the whole literary gathering, sir.

brh: شیر شاہ سکر مو نی ترت کہ نی تینا بلے بئے ہرف تینٹ ہم کنور مہمان تے ہم کنفور چانہ چادان پھری بورا غاک تخوک او ساری نا پیسہ غاک تخوک پیرنگا لٹ
en: Sher Shah, Sukkur... you... that you take your own...; they eat themselves and also feed the guests; the tea, the kettle,... the sacks are set out, and everyone's money is set out... the old man with a stick.
en_old: Sher Shah, Sukkur, you did not let yourself eat your own... nor feed the guests; the tea, the teapot, ... were kept, all the money was kept... (unclear)

brh: اما دلو زہیر نا پگ ما ولہ کنا دا سچڑائی اف دا سا ورنائی نا اینا بڈکنگ کپنا پین نہ دیر او تھکلو ایت انشااللہ سر بتو پین نہ دیر او تھینا ئے بیماری تا پین نہ غلہ او پین نہ
en: ... this is not my ...; now the youth of today... we do not...; no more water and..., God willing...; no more water and..., the diseases...; no more grain and no more...
en_old: ...this is not my truthfulness; now today's youth do not bow... and no more, God willing... and no more illness, no more grain shortage, and no more...

brh: دا حرام آتے اراٹی اگر نی حرام ئس ہرفیس نا چناتن برکت کائیک نا عملاتن برکت ختم ہمو لنگڑی نی کہ جوان ئے سلیمانی چائے کن پر حلال نا کن حرام نا کن
en: These haram things, in which... if you take something haram, the blessing leaves your children, and the blessing of your deeds ends. That poverty of yours is good, (even with only) Sulaimani tea: for the halal, for the haram.
en_old: These forbidden things... if you take something haram, there is no blessing in your children and the blessing in your deeds ends. That free meal you think is good, for Sulaimani tea... for halal, for haram.

brh: ابا حرام جوانی یا حلال؟ راستی گدھوٹ پاوو۔ حلال جوانی یا حرام؟ نماراتن کن ہننگ ٹی اورے۔ ہا ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ۔ اللہ کرے اون خوش ہاری تان انشاءاللہ دانس پی نرفورے۔ غلط تپو۔
en: Elder, is haram good or halal? Tell the truth. Is halal good or haram? ... you are going for... Yes, mashallah, mashallah. May God keep them happy... God willing, from now on you will not... Don't (say) anything wrong.
en_old: Father, is haram good or halal? Tell the truth. Is halal good or haram? It is in going to prayers. Yes, mashallah, mashallah. May God keep them happy, God willing... Don't do wrong.

brh: و ننا براہوئی غا لیکی کہ دا دسترگر دستگیر بادشاہ نا لیکی داسہ دزبس کھور مریک ہیشام نا مسہ گونی تے درے دستگیر لٹ تو اسہ نیزہ خاچ دستگیر نا نوکر لٹ تو اسہ ہلک دادے تفنگ تو تھوریک دستگیر بادشاہ نا لیکی
en: And in our Brahui (there is a saying) that this is for the sake of Dastagir the king: now if a thief comes, he goes blind. (A thief) took the three sacks of...; Dastagir, with a stick, a spear, slept; Dastagir's servant caught one with a stick and holds this one at gunpoint. (That is the miracle) of Dastagir the king.
en_old: And our Brahui saying about this Dastagir king, the helper: now a thief comes and steals three sacks of wheat from Dastagir's place. Dastagir's servant strikes him with a spear, strikes... shoots him and he falls. That is Dastagir the king's saying.

brh: ئے کنا پار پارے تک ارا بس خوار مائک و پیرنگا بلہ دروغ تڑک ئے دسٹ بس نن دستگیری کن دوئی تا دوک تا منڈ مسو ال بلا نی دوز اسے یکا نان تا دوک منڈ مفسا نی پین ہن زیر و غل اتسا پین ہن سٹا نتسا پین ہن
en: He told me, he told me: whoever comes becomes miserable, and the old grandmother tells lies. We (believed that) for Dastagir's sake the hands of thieves become crippled. Hey grandma, you are a thief...; the hands... don't become crippled; go again..., go again..., go again.
en_old: ...he told me... he just becomes miserable and old... telling lies... we, for Dastagiri's sake, the hands of... were crippled... you are a thief... the hands of a lonely man's bread are not crippled... you go on...

brh: دا غار ء قصہ، راہک نا ملکیت اف، ملکیت تو وڈیرہ نا ء، ارا نا دا غار نا خواجہ ء، نی اگر گڑا سرفوئی تو اجازت ہت کہ دا گڑا نی کننگ ضرور ارے۔ لانگ براہوی، نواب شاہ نی پار جلسہ ئس ئس، بلو جلسہ ئس بیس سال نی ئس۔ واعظ آن پد، باغی
en: This is the matter of the land: it is not the tenant's property; the property belongs to the landlord, who is the owner of this land. If you need to use something, get permission, (saying) that you need to eat this. ... Brahui; in Nawabshah there was a gathering, a big gathering, twenty years ago. After the sermon, a Bagri...
en_old: This is the story of the land: it is not the peasant's property, it belongs to the landlord, who owns this place. If you need to move something, take permission, because you have to do it that way. Lang Brahui... in Nawabshah there was a gathering, a big gathering, twenty years ago. After the sermon, a rebel...

brh: نی ت گلہ او کوٹہ کسرا چادرت تنتے نی پٹ کرسینو کشک سا پٹ واعظ نا واپسی ئس اراغے کار نئے لال گلہ اواتنے کوٹہ غاتے پگا کہ مولوی ت جمعہ غا واعظ ئے باز دبا فیتہ کہ حرام خواراک واعظ ہم بنیرے دزی ہم کیرے پئے مولوی گنوک سے
en: You... the flock and the pen on the road, with a sheet... you search... dragging... after the sermon, a return... what work is it... the flock... the pens... tomorrow; that the maulvi presses hard in the Friday sermon that you haram-eaters both listen to the sermon and commit theft. So is the maulvi crazy?
en_old: You steal herds and pens on the road... the preacher's... you take the herds and the pens, and the mullah presses hard in the Friday sermon that those who eat haram listen to the sermon and also steal. Is the mullah crazy?

brh: باگڑی تا سرا، قربان ئے مسلمان تا لورا، او رے ہرا شریعت اٹ کہ، قاری عبدالخالق صاحب باگڑی تے جائز ئے ارے آ خواجہ، باگڑی تے جائز ئے مئے؟
en: About the Bagris, sacrifice... the Muslims... and in which sharia is it, Qari Abdul Khaliq sahib, that it is permissible against the Bagris? O master, is it permissible against the Bagris or not?
en_old: About the Bagris, and the sacrifice for Muslims: according to sharia, Qari Abdul Khaliq sahib, is it permissible for the Bagris? Sir, is it permissible for the Bagris or not?

brh: ارے حرام حرامی دزی دزی ہر کس نکے مرے بھیل سے نہ مرے نیکوئی ئس باگڑی سے نہ مرے نیکوئی ئس حرام حرامی ننا روزی آن برکت انتئے نارے ننا اؤرات آن برکت انتئے نارے کہ حرام ننا اؤراتی ٹی بسنے
en: Yes, haram is haram, theft is theft, whoever's it may be: if it is a Bhil's, it is no good deed; if it is a Bagri's, it is no good deed. Haram is haram. Why is there no blessing in our livelihood? Why is there no blessing in our homes? Because haram has entered our homes.
en_old: Yes, haram and theft, theft — let no one be a thief, let no one be a Bagri... Why is there no blessing in our sustenance? Why is there no blessing in our women? Because haram has entered our households.

brh: ایراٹمی کو بیماری سیالی ہم ختم، دا سیالی، ماما تینا بھانجہ تا دشمن، بھانجہ ماما تا دشمن، سوٹ سوٹ نا دشمن، ایلو سڑتونی کپسا۔
en: The second disease, rivalry among relatives, should also end. This rivalry: the maternal uncle is the enemy of his sister's sons, the nephew is the enemy of the uncle, cousin is the enemy of cousin, and you don't (reconcile) with one another.
en_old: Today the disease of feuding should also end. This feud: the uncle is his nephew's enemy, the nephew is the uncle's enemy, cousin is cousin's enemy, and you don't make peace.

brh: دروازہ دروازہ تونی چھنکا چھنا غریباک دانہ چھنا گھیر آک کارا پھیرنگا لٹ تون زنڈو کے حق لے تک چھناتے تودے فک نن عید کپنا داتون دانتے ننے بریرا او ظالم معصوماتہ رحم کے
en: Door to door, the little children, the poor..., the little children... going around with sticks... their right... the children (say) "we will not celebrate Eid"... with this they come to us. O oppressor, have mercy on the innocents!
en_old: Door to door the little children, the poor... the beggars, going round with sticks... their rights... the children say we won't celebrate Eid... O oppressor, have mercy on the innocents.

brh: کہ خدا دا معصوم آتیرن کلن دے دا دشمنی تے پزا دا صغیر و چناؤ خدا نا قسم ئے نہ ورنائی نا خدائے پرواہ اف نہ پیری نا خدائے پرواہ اف انو چنکا تے رحم کروس تو خدا نازیر رحم کرو
en: So that, for God's sake, for these innocents, (end) these enmities today; have pity on these little ones and children. By God's oath, God cares neither for youth nor for old age; if you show mercy to these little ones, God will show mercy to you.
en_old: May God, for the sake of these innocents, forgive these feuds today. These little children — by God, God does not care about youth or old age; if you show mercy to the little ones, God will show mercy to you.

brh: اوڑے چنکا چناتل پنی خیراتاتل پنی ایلو سٹ زالبولاتل پنی امپیرے اوڑے بابا اینا باوے ضعیفنا باوے پاہ ایلو خاروٹ اوڑے نی دادے بہاٹل کل سنا نی اونا مسڑے بہاٹل کل سنا
en: There, the little children..., the ones living on charity..., and the other women... there, the grandfather, ... father, the weak father..., and in anger, there you sell this one, you sell his daughter.
en_old: There the little children..., the beggars... and the women... there the grandfather, the weak father... and the sister there; you sell this one, you sell his daughter...

brh: نی خروس نا مسٹ الے تیرا باوہ لمہ نا رخ کائے تینا ایلم سے نا برام ئے کائے نا خڑیا نا دزار مرے کائے ئے میڑ بر غریب آک دا منپک چار مولوی آ تیرا ئے کیف دا تے دا کنا کٹ سے بیل پس
en: You..., the honour of your father and mother goes, your brother's wedding goes, your... goes; come to a settlement. The poor man does not accept this... the maulvis... this... my...
en_old: You... the rooster's..., your father's and mother's face, your brother's wedding... the poor do not accept this... the mullah... this is my...

brh: ایم نانا او کھٹ نا سو لکھے تکھے ایون گر گر قبر نا کسر نا کڈ سے ٹی یکی کھٹے پھیری تھیرن دودے سردار او کھٹی بٹھورے پیما کیرن ہمو کھٹ نا سوار مننگ نا مالا خوش ما راضی کتے نا سیالا تے سیالی
en: ... that bier... on the road to the grave, into a pit..., they carry the bier around... the sardar... on the bier...; before being carried on that bier, make your relatives happy and content, (end) the rivalry among relatives.
en_old: ...on the way to the grave, the bier is carried... the sardar sits by the bier... to ride on that bier happily and content, end the feud.

brh: اوار کر تاکہ کھٹے عزت اٹ سوار مئے اور قبر ٹی عزت اٹ درے، ئنا سیالی ختم، اینو مسٹٹ تھورے اینو مسٹٹ تھورے سانگ کرینو براہ مف، دس سال گزرینگا نی دا تا کاوڑ ختم مفک ارے رم علم مار، ارے رم ماما
en: Reconcile, so that you are carried on the bier with honour and go down into the grave with honour, your rivalry with your relatives ended. Today he holds back the daughter, today he holds back the daughter; the engagement has been made but the wedding does not happen; ten years have passed and still their anger does not end. Hey, son! Hey, uncle!
en_old: Come together so that the bier is carried with honor and lowered into the grave with honor; your feud should end. Today... today... the engagement is made... ten years have passed and still this anger does not end. O boy, o uncle...

brh: او ارے ہم تاتن مسنک ئے اینہ ضعیف ئے ہڑتو ٹھیک او دے بے تھورے چکار تھورے ئے ارے ضعیف ئے ٹھیر اتین تون خوشو دا زوری او تورن تینا ننا اوتے خواپنا او ننائے خواپس ننا اوتے خواپنا اسہ ٹگا
en: He, yes, they have become...; today he is weak... fine; he holds..., holds worry; yes, he is weak... with... happy; this coercion they keep to themselves: "We don't want them, and they don't want us; we don't want them." At one...
en_old: ...he is weak... he says fine... he is weak... with you... this force... we do not want them and they do not want us... we do not want them...

brh: اگر بے ایمان مرے تو نی تو بے ایمان مفیس، ارے حذیفہ اگر نی جتا کیسہ خدا ناراض کک، مسڑ تا انو تینٹ ریش نا پیو نی انعام تے خانے، ایہہ سدے خناٹ خیس نا ریش ٹونٹ کٹور زوٹی تا، ابا کاڈے تہو ونے؟ چیسے مڑے رنڑ نا کوہ غا
en: If he is dishonest, you at least should not be dishonest. Hey, woman, if you keep them apart, God becomes angry. The daughters... today you yourself... the beard... you see the rewards... I saw... your beard... Father, what...? ... on the mountain...
