brh: مے مانے کنے دیدار تے گلرنگ او گلرنگ گلرنگ دیوانے برائے جلتی جار تے گلرنگ دیوانے برائے جلتی جار تے گلرنگا جلتی جار گلرنگا جلتی جار
en: [...] me a sight of you, Gulrang, oh Gulrang, Gulrang, crazy for [your] burning [...], Gulrang, crazy for [your] burning [...], Gulrang's burning [...], Gulrang's burning [...]. (song lyrics, largely unclear)
en_old: ... my sight, Gulrang, oh Gulrang, Gulrang, crazy for the burning fire, Gulrang, crazy for the burning fire, Gulrang's burning fire, Gulrang's burning fire

brh: سائیں بدیں چھمبیاں مچار تے او لا آ منی سائیں بدیں چھمبیاں مچار تے گل رنگ
en: My lord (Sain), [...], oh, my lord [...], Gulrang. (song lyrics, largely unclear)
en_old: My beloved, your eyelashes and eyes, oh my beloved, your eyelashes and eyes, Gul Rang

brh: واہ واہ واہ گلرنگ ہوسٹ خائیسہ
en: Wow, wow, wow, Gulrang, [so] beautiful!
en_old: Wow, wow, wow, Gulrang host, you're singing beautifully.

brh: کہ نواز بلوچ نا رادک ننے پورو کرینے کہ علی مسرور نا ہم رنگی ننے کرے بنفین نمے یقینا ننا مہروان آ دوست آتا سے بلو خواہش ئس کہ علی مسرور نا کرے گچین
en: ...that Nawaz Baloch's [song] has fulfilled [the request] for us; we will also play for you a tune by Ali Masroor; surely it is a great wish of our dear friends that Ali Masroor's excellent...
en_old: Nawaz Baloch's voice has satisfied us, and Ali Masroor's harmony too. Let us hear it. Surely it is a big wish of our dear friends to hear Ali Masroor's selection.

brh: راج نا ہر بندغ نا دا ذمہ واری مریک کہ او دافتا کرے ہرا وخت آ کہ راج ئس مرے سد باب ئس مرے کہ دا دن مفاس۔ ٹیلیفون کال ئنا کنڈا برین اوڑا مست ننا ہن سوج صوبت آن چار نہ تا کائیک پیشیم نا ایرا نہ تا او شام اتون مسے نہ تا
en: It is the responsibility of every person in the community that they [do something about] these — whenever there is a community, there should be some preventive measure so that this doesn't happen like this. Let's come to the telephone calls. Before that, our question: from morning it goes on four feet, at noon on two feet, and in the evening on three feet.
en_old: Every person in the nation has a responsibility to... whenever there is a nation, there should be prevention so that this doesn't happen. Let's go to the telephone calls. Before that, our question: from four o'clock in the morning until two in the afternoon, and in the evening until three o'clock.

brh: عبدالرحمان مینگل دا وخت اسکا دا سوج نا جواب اٹ سونی ہرو کس ئس تیتنے تے منت وار ارین کہ دیر اینٹ او۔ السلام علیکم۔ ہیلو السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام جی دیر اینٹ او نا واری
en: Abdul Rehman Mengal — up to now nobody has given the answer to this question. We are grateful. Who is it? Assalamu alaikum. Hello, assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Yes, who is it? It's your turn.
en_old: Abdul Rehman Mengal, so far... answered this question... thank you. Who is it? Assalamu alaikum. Hello, assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam, yes, who is it? It's your turn.

brh: اسٹار اسٹار نرگس جی نرگس کیا کہنا چاہتی ہو؟ آ تیہنا تو صفی بہنجی تیہنا چھانگی چے پتی شومنے مچس چے تیہنا آ تیہنا اکا ہنی کیتی پکی اوڑ نرگس ہنا مچس
en: Star, star? Nargis? Yes, Nargis, what would you like to say? [The rest is unintelligible, apart from the name Nargis.]
en_old: Star, star, Nargis, yes Nargis, what do you want to say?... Nargis...

brh: جی جی بالکل جی نرگس ہیلو
en: Yes, yes, absolutely, yes. Nargis, hello.
en_old: Yes, yes, absolutely, yes. Nargis, hello.

brh: آ، یہ شو کہ ہم بہت اچھے جا رہی ہیں۔ ئس کے علاوہ آن سب بول چال بالکل پوری طرح سے بہت سر سے ہم، اینڈ اب میرا دل بہت ناراض ہوا ہی کیا، چونکہ ہماری پرائیویٹ آتے ہی ہماری اسکول کے آتے ہی آتے ہی کہ نوروز خان کے شو کب ہی آپ پلیز بتائیے مجھے۔ آپ
en: Ah, this show — we are going very well. Apart from that, all the conversation is completely, fully, very much... we... and now my heart has become very upset, because as soon as our private... as soon as our school [term] comes... when is Nauroz Khan's show? Please tell me. You...
en_old: Ah, this show of ours is going very well. Apart from that, all the conversation is completely... and now my heart is very upset, because as soon as our private... our school... when is Nauroz Khan's show? Please tell me.

brh: تانی ابھی تو شیڈول یہاں پہ نہیں لگا ہی جب ہوگا تو مین بتا دوں گا ٹھیک ہی اوکے اور ہم کچہ نیوز بھی دیکھتے رہیں گے ئس کے علاوہ ستارہ کے طرف سے عدیل منوس کو بہت سارا سلام اور سب مونسٹار والوں کو میری طرف سے بہت سارا سلام اور سونگ پلی کرین توصیف
en: Well, right now the schedule hasn't been put up here; when it is, I'll tell you, okay? Okay. And we'll also keep watching some news. Apart from that, lots of greetings from Sitara to Adeel Manus, and lots of greetings from me to everyone at Monstar. And play a song, Tauseef.
en_old: Tani, the schedule hasn't been put up here yet. When it is, I'll let you know, alright? Okay. And we'll also keep watching some news. Apart from that, lots of greetings from Sitara to Adeel Manus, and lots of greetings from me to all the Monstar folks. And play a song, Tauseef.

brh: او گودی نن تونس گودی نرگس تو منت وار گودینا
en: Oh sister, you were with us — sister Nargis, so thank you, sister.
en_old: Oh sister, with us... sister Nargis, thank you, sister.

brh: او کین آ میرا کہ او تینا گچین انگا اسرا متیس السلام علیکم آر جی یوٹ محلب بلوچ مجلس باز جوانی او کل بلوچ راج سلام مریتو وعلیکم السلام تینا پسند نا شعر ئس بنفیس ننے بالکل بالکل گودی لکھ منت وار لکھ تورو ہک نا زیڈ شہزادی السلام علیکم مجلس
en: ...that he/she [did] his/her best... Assalamu alaikum, RJ, I am Mehlab Baloch. The program is very good, and greetings to the whole Baloch nation. Wa alaikum assalam. Let us hear a poem of your choice. Absolutely, absolutely, sister, a hundred thousand thanks, a hundred thousand kindnesses... Zed Shehzadi: assalamu alaikum, the program...
en_old: ...his best... Assalamu alaikum, RJ, this is Mehlab Baloch. The program is very good, and greetings to the whole Baloch nation. Wa alaikum assalam, play a poem of your choice for us. Absolutely, absolutely, sister, a hundred thousand thanks, a hundred thousand... Zed Shehzadi: Assalamu alaikum, the program...

brh: باز گچینیں انتہ الوالیں زہیر شہزادی نی جوان ئس دراخ و جوڑ ئس و پرینوس کہ ندیم شہزاد نا شعر ئس بنبو ننے و دادے پنا کننگ خواہس ننے سرمچت وئی گلشن نور نا و پرینوس گرا مونا مجلس
en: Very excellent, [extremely good]. Zaheer Shehzadi, are you well, healthy and fine? And you said we should play a poem by Nadeem Shehzad for us, and you want this to be [dedicated] in the name of ... Gulshan Noor, and you said, then, [about] the program ahead...
en_old: The very best... Zaheer Shehzadi, are you well and healthy? You asked us to play a poem by Nadeem Shehzad, and you want to... send greetings to Gulshan Noor, and you said the program...

brh: دا ستے مصروفیت آتا وجہ غان اختہ مننگ نا وجہ غان بشخالتن اوٹ تو مریک ہائیک ہائیک مریک ہائیک ہائیک دا زند ئے داٹ انساناک مصروف مریرے اول تینا کاریم اول تینا زند و بود اوکان گڈ واللہ نا کرے مجلس آ کچاری دا تو مدام مریسا کارہ۔ السلام
en: Because of these busy schedules, because of being busy — forgive me... It happens, yes, yes, it happens, yes, yes. In this life people are busy: first their own work, first their own life and livelihood; after that, by God, the program and the gathering — this will always keep going on. Assalam...
en_old: Because of these busy schedules, and because I was late, forgive me... it happens, yes, yes, it happens. In this life people are busy: first their work, first their life and livelihood, and after that, by God, staying connected to the program always continues. Assalam...

brh: السلام علیکم منظور جان امر ئس شکر اللہ پاک نا ئے جوان اٹ او میر تقی میر عرف نور الہی بنگلزئی دا وخت ننتونے میر تقی میر انت حالے خواجہ بڈس دراخ جوڑس اسو درک ناف او پرنس کے مجلس باز
en: Assalamu alaikum, Manzoor jan, how are you? Thanks to Allah, I am well. And Mir Taqi Mir, alias Noor Elahi Bangulzai, is with us at this time. Mir Taqi Mir, what's the news? Sir, are you well and healthy? ... and you said the program is very...
en_old: Assalamu alaikum, Manzoor jan, how are you? Thank God, I'm fine. And Mir Taqi Mir, also known as Noor Elahi Bangulzai, is with us right now. Mir Taqi Mir, how are you, sir?... a big gathering...

brh: خاص گچینی او کنا سلام آ کسر مریر ممتاز بگٹی ئے حیات بنگلزئی ئے او عبدالحق جان ئے عابدہ بنگلزئی، آسیہ بنگلزئی ئے نرگس، نرگس بنگلزئی، صبا بنگلزئی، انمول
en: Special best wishes, and may my greetings reach Mumtaz Bugti, Hayat Bangulzai, and Abdul Haq jan, Abida Bangulzai, Asia Bangulzai, Nargis, Nargis Bangulzai, Saba Bangulzai, Anmol.
en_old: Special best wishes, and may my greetings reach Mumtaz Bugti, Hayat Bangulzai, and Abdul Haq jan, Abida Bangulzai, Asia Bangulzai, Nargis, Nargis Bangulzai, Saba Bangulzai, Anmol

brh: آ شوانی، تو بلکل نامیر نا سلام آ، کرخس کنے پارےسوس بڈا تہ بڈ، امو ڈسکا سرمسر راڑ کنے خوائسوس، باز منتوار، لک تورا واک، ولے ننا سوج نا جوابے تتنوساک کہ سوبت تون چار نا تا کا ایک پیشیم نا کرے ایران تا؟ آ شوانی
en: Ah, Shawani — so, absolutely, greetings to Mir... you had told me ..., you had asked me for that same ... Thank you very much, a hundred thousand thanks. But you did not give the answer to our question: what goes on four feet in the morning and on two feet at noon? Ah, Shawani.
en_old: Ah, Shawani, greetings to Mir... Someone told me... called me, thank you very much... but you didn't answer our question about... Iran? Ah, Shawani.

brh: شامتون مسنتہ جی او جی او سو پیشیم شام زندنا کرے ہمو دے کو تدینگسا کاری ٹیلیفون کال ئس الینور اینو کنا دیرے ننتو السلام علیکم وعلیکم
en: And in the evening on three feet. Yes, yes — so it is the morning, noon and evening of life, that day which keeps passing. Let's take a telephone call: who is with us today? Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum...
en_old: Good evening, yes, okay... the evening of life... on the day that passed... a telephone call... Who is with us today? Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam.

brh: اقبال میر بلوچ بخیر اٹ خواجہ؟ ٹول بخیر اٹ سر نم جوان اورے؟ شکر اللہ پاک نا احسان آکو نی بنف نا انت احوالے؟ جوان ہوس؟ الحمدللہ شکر ہی اللہ نا احسان آکو سر اقبال میر بلوچ
en: Iqbal Mir Baloch, are you well, sir? All well, sir; are you well? Thank God, it is Allah's grace. You tell me, how are things with you? Are you well? Alhamdulillah, thanks — it is Allah's grace, sir. Iqbal Mir Baloch.
en_old: Iqbal Mir Baloch, are you well, sir? All well, sir, are you well? Thank God, it's Allah's grace. How are you? Are you well? Alhamdulillah, thanks be to Allah, it's His grace, sir. Iqbal Mir Baloch.

brh: دا سوال نا تنے خبر مروئی جی او سر دا شروع آن نما شو ء بننگ اوٹک ولے دا تعین مننگ اٹف کہ اسل ذمہ دار دیرے دا روڈ آتے زیا کرے دا یلئی انگا کچک آ
en: You must be aware of this question. Yes, sir, this has been coming up on your show from the start, but it has not been determined who is actually responsible for these stray dogs on the roads.
en_old: You must know about this question, sir. This has been on your show from the start, but it hasn't been decided who is actually responsible for making these roads worse, these stray dogs.

brh: او دا مخلوق ڈگی تے خراس تے مئی تے تینا کوکا بٹیرے دا نوشکے رتا انتئے ہر بندغ تینے انت دا تینا کریکوپہ غت انت دا ئے تے خسیک نی انت پاس؟ سر ئے تینا جن و جاتی ہرا کہ کچک مریغ نا
en: And these people [keep] cows, oxen, sheep, their own [fowl] and quails — here in Noshki... why does every person... himself... what... his own... what... this...? What do you say? Sir, its own kind and breed, the one that is the dog's...
en_old: And these creatures, donkeys, sheep... in Noshki... why does every person... what do you say? Sir, its own kind, the dog's...

brh: تو نیدس تو نوکا ٹپک کنے کہ ارا کہ الیئے کچکو تو اوفتے ٹی اڑیو مریک کلوکو مریکک بالکل ارا کہ الوکا مریم یوڑم باز خلیو
en: So you've told me something new: that among those which are stray dogs there are rabid ones and there are diseased ones. Absolutely. The ones that are stray... they bite a lot.
en_old: So someone told me something new: among the stray dogs there are rabid ones. Absolutely, the stray ones... bite a lot.

brh: او مفن نی دے اینو پئے خنیسے باز وختان ننو مریخے مخل مخل چونانی اڑے تے اسہ لال بیگ آتیا خلیرے او بالکل تو ئے کچک آتیم باز خلیو کنا سنگت سر کنے ہمیشہ مخل صاحب ئے انتئے یار نی تینے اورک دا سیدانہ خلے
en: And... you can see it today; for a long time now... Mughal, Mughal... the children... they strike the rabid ones like cockroaches... And absolutely, so dogs bite a lot. My friend, sir, always [says] to me: 'Mughal sahib, why, friend, do you yourself kill this animal?'
en_old: And... today you can see that for a long time... they hit... with a red bag... and absolutely, dogs bite a lot. My friend, sir, always told me, why, my friend, do you...

brh: انگیٹھے نا اور ئے پاوہ ئے احتیاط لازمی ئے دا دا کسر ئے کچک کسر ئے دا نا نی انت خبر ئے انت خبر ئے بالکل ہمو رسی ہمو نا اچانک باشا غی تینے الے بالکل تو ئے دا ارا کے سردار ئس نا الے تو
en: I tell him that caution is necessary. This is the road — the dog is on the road; what do you know about it, what do you know? Absolutely, that same [dog] reaches [you], and suddenly it grabs you. Absolutely, so if it grabs [the child] of some sardar, then...
en_old: I say be careful of the fire in the fireplace... this way, the dog's way... what do you know about it? Absolutely, that same... suddenly... so if a chief has one...

brh: او نی چا سے کہ کنے دا نقصان تیکک تو اسلام او نا اجازت تسنے او دے نی خلسا صفا بالکل اگر کنے نقصان تننگ اف مسید ارے یا دوشہن نا سار ننے پاننگوس کہ چا کے پین ننو مسید ارے
en: And you know that if this harms me, then Islam has given permission for it — you can kill it outright, absolutely. If it is not harming me, it is a living creature; or [as for] an enemy... we were being told that, you know, it too is another living creature.
en_old: And you know that if it harms me, then Islam has given permission, and you can kill it, absolutely. If it doesn't harm me... or an enemy... we were told...

brh: اگر ویتے تلاڑے دفترا اسلام ہم اجازت تیک کہ دا نقصان تیرہ تو دفترا خلنگ جائز ء اور اجازت ئس تنے خلتا بالکل تو بہرحال نن اوسی دان ماری دے کوشش کیر اگر کسر یو تو ہر بندغے اجازت ارے اوفتے
en: If ... them, Islam also gives permission: if they cause harm, then killing them is permissible, and you have permission to kill them, absolutely. So anyway, from now on we should try: if there is a way, then every person has permission [to deal with] them.
en_old: If it attacks you in the office, Islam also permits it: if they cause harm, then killing them is permissible, and you have permission to kill. Absolutely. Anyway, we should try from today on; if there is a way, every person has permission to...

brh: تو خلے اول تو حکمت اللہ انت کہ تو دونو سیدار مریرے تو خلیتا گرا نا کہ اوڑا والا سیدار سنونو اگر بادشاہ غیک اڑے کوچک کسے توف تے
en: So kill it. First of all, what is God's wisdom in such animals existing? So kill them; then [it is] that such animals... if a king has a rabid dog, someone [ties it up]...
en_old: So kill it. First of all, God's wisdom is that if there are such... then kill... if a king has a dog...

brh: قنیرک انتئے کے اسہ کچک ہڑ کرئے تو ایلو کچک ہاتے منن ہنا کچک نا ہڑ کرسا کیکک بالکل نن ہنا پنوک ہاں منظور چن باز منت وار باز جوان نی سلام دعا ئس نریتے تو ادوئی ہنا لغوشتے تنے بس
en: ...because if one dog goes rabid, then the other dogs [with it] — that dog keeps making them rabid too. Absolutely. We... Yes, Manzoor jan, thank you very much, very good. If you have any greetings to send, then ... go ahead.
en_old: ...because if one dog barks, the other dogs follow and bark along with that dog. Absolutely. Yes, Manzoor jan, thank you very much, very good. Your greetings... so your message has come through.

brh: مولا بخش مرے عبدالحق مینگل، اور ارشد وحید، نواز بلوچ، نقیب اللہ، اور اسرار نیچاری، عتیق بنگلزئی، عابدہ بنگلزئی، ممتاز بگٹی، اور مچٹ
en: [Greetings] to Mola Bakhsh, Abdul Haq Mengal, and Arshad Waheed, Nawaz Baloch, Naqibullah, and Israr Nicharee, Atiq Bangulzai, Abida Bangulzai, Mumtaz Bugti, and everyone.
en_old: Mola Bakhsh, Abdul Haq Mengal, and Arshad Waheed, Nawaz Baloch, Naqibullah, and Israr Nicharee, Atiq Bangulzai, Abida Bangulzai, Mumtaz Bugti, and everyone.

brh: سلام بلوچ قوم بلوچ راجی سلام مرے اللہ پاک بلوچ قوم مدام سلامت کے منت وار منت وار نما مہرنا سلاما کہ ہراڑس کا کہ توار نما اینا سرمس تو دست تیار ئس کہ دوئی نلوش
en: Greetings to the Baloch nation; may there be greetings to the Baloch community. May Allah keep the Baloch nation safe forever. Thank you, thank you for your kind greetings — that wherever it went, your voice reached [there] today... so ... ready...
en_old: Greetings to the Baloch nation, Baloch national greetings. May Allah keep the Baloch nation safe forever. Thank you, thank you for your kind greetings... when your voice reached us...

brh: ٹھیک ئے جی او صاحب۔ ہا، ہشتاد و شش، داد وقتی ہم باز پارینس، آسان ئس پانے، تاکہ نی کرے آسانی اٹ پاننگ کیس، اسے ایلار، ایرا ایلار۔
en: That's fine, yes, sir. Yes — eighty-six; you've already said that one a lot. Say an easy one, so that you can say it easily: 'one lār, two lār'.
en_old: That's fine, yes, sir. Yes, eighty-six... said a lot at that time too... say it easily, so that you can say it with ease: one lar, that lar.

en_old: ...it is a good deed to save lives, so that God helps them. But at that time I was very worried, I thought about the animals, but if this animal harms someone, a person, if someone is harmed... on the road someone kills an animal outright or someone saves it, so I mean we feel sorrow for this thing.

brh: نم پانہ دوں کہ دا بے وارثہ کچک آتے کے اور انوننگا بے وارثہ پین گڑا کو پیشی کو دائے دا تیکے مندو نہ جاگہ مریر بائیدے کہ دا تیم سنبھالیر محکمہ ئس جوڑ مریر دافتیکن ہم چندی تا روزگار ہم لگے کہ اور دا ہم سنبھالنگر
en: We say this: for these ownerless dogs and other such ownerless things, like cats and so on, there should be a place for them; it should be that they look after them, and a department should be set up. Through this, some people would also get jobs, and these animals would also be looked after.
en_old: You say that for these stray dogs and other stray things like them, there should be a place for them. A department should be set up to take care of them. That would also give jobs to many people, and these animals would be looked after too.

brh: بے شک نا ملک آت اٹ کرے مکھ مت آت اٹ کرے یارے دا سئی دا گڑا اٹ کرے ننا پاکستان ٹی کرے دا گڑا تے فخر اوتک مکھ مت مرے بے ہمو تولوک آ کرے ہمو پیسا آت نا جیب اٹ خلے رارے لیکن دا تئی مکھ مت لیکن بندہ آک دا فتا کرے سار سنبھارے کپاس ہمو پیسا آت کرے کونے را بے شک نا ملک ٹی کرے ہر
en: Of course, in other countries there are departments; yes, right, for this thing... in our Pakistan too, for these things... A department may exist, but those sitting in it put that money in their own pockets. There is a department for these, but the people do not take care of them; they eat up that money. Of course, in the country... every
en_old: Of course in other countries they do this, and in our Pakistan too these things should be done. There should be a department, but the people sitting in it put the money in their own pockets. There may be a department, but people don't take care of these animals and just pocket that money. Of course in other countries...

brh: ایوانہ کرے مکھ مارے داڑ لیکن ننا ملک ہف دا گڈا بھائی دیکھے دونو مکھ مئے اسمرے انتئے کہ دا ارانگ کار دیر آ کار اسے علی بھائی اسہ کے خیال ایتا کرو پینتین تو ار جاگہ حفظ دا حفظ لیکن حقیقت پاسہ انتئے کہ اینو پگہ کرے نن پین عید تے کین دونو زاد ہرس خلے نتو تے خلے نا خل نقصان
en: for animals there are departments there, but our country is not like that, brother. Look, there should be a department like this, because whose job is this, whose job is it? Ali bhai, give it a thought... otherwise everywhere there is protection, this protection... but you would say the truth, because nowadays we will celebrate another Eid; they strike them like that, strike their legs... harm.
en_old: ...but in our country, brother, look, there should be such a department, because this is a long-term job. Ali bhai, think about it... otherwise everywhere there is care and protection, but tell the truth, because today or tomorrow we have other Eids... harm...

brh: ئے تینا ول تو کوشش کین بھائی دا گڑا تا خیال کین، دا دفتر نا کاریم مکمل مسنے، باز جوان اسکا۔
en: on our own part we should try, brother, and take care of these things. The work of this office has been completed; it was very good.
en_old: ...try on your own, brother, take care of these things. This office work is done, it was very good.

brh: باز جوان علی بھائی، دوئی اینا دا خاطر لوٹسٹے فرا کہ ننا وخت پاسن دا اڑے سر مننگٹی ئے یقین کر سیم نمے کم ئے لیکن نم باز محنت کریرے انتئے نا شو ئے ننا بننگ ک ستا، گنا باز مچے
en: Very good, Ali bhai... for this reason... because our time is passing; it is coming to an end here. Believe me, it may seem little to you, but you have worked very hard, because... listening to our show... a lot.
en_old: Very good, Ali bhai... believe me, it may seem little to you, but you worked very hard for the show... a lot.

brh: ئے ہرا ایلو نا آخا ایلو نا گندنگ تو مچ اوست نا وڈ اٹ سلام دعا کیوا اور اسپیشلی عاجز جمروز ئے اور خالد جان بلوچ ئے اور کاشف ئے بالکل اور قدیر جان قاضی ئے باز باز کنا اوست نا وڈ اٹ اور دعا کیوا اللہ پاک نا ایلو نا مچ طبیعت سہی اللو دے اللہ پاک صحت ایتے۔
en: whoever, everyone else..., I send greetings and prayers to all with all my heart, and especially to Aajiz Jamroz, Khalid jan Baloch, Kashif, absolutely, and Qadeer jan Qazi, very, very much from the depth of my heart; and I pray that Almighty God keeps everyone's health well, and may Almighty God give him health.
en_old: ...I send greetings and prayers with all my heart to everyone, especially to Aajiz Jamroz, Khalid Jan Baloch, Kashif, and Qadeer Jan Qazi, with much love, and I pray that Almighty Allah keeps everyone well and gives them health.

brh: آمین
en: Amen.
en_old: Amen.

brh: ننا اونا صحت کن دعا کینہ آمین آمین باز منت وار اللہ حافظ اوکے اللہ حافظ اللہ حافظ تو علی بھائی نا دعا توار ننام دعا کہ اللہ پاک کلے جانجوڑ کے ایہہ صحبتون چار نتا کائیک
en: We pray for his health. Amen, amen. Thank you very much, goodbye. Okay, goodbye, goodbye. So that was Ali bhai's voice and prayer; our prayer too is that Almighty God keeps everyone healthy. In the morning it goes on four legs,
en_old: We pray for his health. Amen, amen. Thank you very much, goodbye. Okay, goodbye, goodbye. So that was Ali bhai's prayer. Our prayer is that Almighty Allah keeps everyone healthy... walks on four legs.

brh: پیشیم ناہران تا اور شامتن مسے نتا اینو نا سوج نا جواب انسان ئے انسان چناک مریک چنائے گوگلاٹ کیک چار نتا کاہیک او ولدا نا کرے مچ ورنا مس تو ورنائی ٹی مچ حیران ات او پیر مس مسے
en: at noon on two, and in the evening on three legs. The answer to today's question is the human being. When a human is small, the child crawls and goes on four legs; then when he becomes a young man, in youth he goes on two legs, and when he grows old, three
en_old: ...and in the evening it became... The answer to today's question is the human being. A human is a child, the child crawls and walks on four legs, then he grows into a young man, and in his youth everyone was amazed, then he grew old...

brh: لیٹ ٹریفک دا اونا مسٹمی کونا تے تو عبدالرزاق جان نی باز باز مبارک مرے اسہ میسج ئس پین بسونے ریفریش کریٹ تے پنکی شاہوانی نا بسونے یوٹ پنکی شاہوانی ہر جی سوال نا پریشان کرے ننے اور ولدا جی ئے کرے جی
en: a stick, that is his third leg. So Abdul Razzaq jan, many, many congratulations to you. Another message has come; I refreshed it, and it has come from Pinky Shahwani: 'Pinky Shahwani: yes, the question troubled us, and then again, yes'
en_old: Late traffic... his third... So Abdul Razzaq Jan, many, many congratulations to you. Another message has come. I refreshed, and it's from Pinky Shahwani. Pinky Shahwani, yes, the question troubled us, and then again, yes...

brh: زو زو جواب تسٹ مہمان تا بجا غان کوئی سمجھٹ کنا بتاوا کہ بالکل بالکل بالکل سوجنا جواب اتیتانو سک کہ شیر و باگول استوائی کرینوس انشاء اللہ
en: 'I answered quickly, from the guests' side... I understood, tell me.' Absolutely, absolutely, absolutely, you have given the answer to the question, and you have requested songs and poems, God willing.
en_old: You answered quickly. On behalf of the guests... understood, tell me. Absolutely, absolutely, absolutely, give the answer to the question... that you said lion and tiger, God willing.

brh: شیر باگلاٹ نا پورف کرینا کراکھنی پاریسوس تو باز باز منت وار نا لکھ منت وار پنکی گڈی کو کوشش ئم کریس ولے اینو نا میدان عبدالکجان نا پنا عبدالکجان مینگل میدان نا بادشاہ باز منت وار نا ہنے مہروانہ کہ
en: We will fulfil your request for the songs and poems you had asked for. So thank you very, very much, a hundred thousand thanks, Pinky. You did try at the end, but today's field is in Abdul Haq jan's name; Abdul Haq jan Mengal is the king of the field. Thank you very much for your kindness, that
en_old: You've said lion and tiger... So thank you very much, a hundred thousand thanks, Pinky. You tried at the end, but today's field goes to Abdul Kajan, Abdul Kajan Mengal, king of the field. Thank you very much for your kindness.

brh: سدھار ئس مرے جھگڑا ئس مرے بائید کہ اگر کسے سے نقصان تفک تو نن امو دے نقصان تفنک او ہر بندغ تینا زمواری سمجھے دا دے دا وطن دا علاقہ کل ننا او ہندنو کرے سدا
en: Whether it is a reform or a dispute, it should be that if someone does no harm to anyone, then we do no harm to him either, and every person should understand his own responsibility: this, this homeland, this area is all ours, and [we should] always act like this.
en_old: Whether it's an improvement or a quarrel, it is necessary that if someone does not harm us, we do not harm them. Every person should understand their responsibility, that this homeland and this area all belong to us, and always act that way.

brh: اراکا اگر او نم خنرے کہ جان جوڑی کے جان سلامتی کے خطرہ او تو محکمہ غاک جوڑ او اوفتے نم شکایتے ایبو اوفتے نٹ کرے خاص کر دا ہفتہ سد بابے کیرے بروکا مجلس اسکان نم ارجے منظور کیازے نم تون ہندا ہیت تون اوار نمے آن کیک موکل کہ
en: Wherever it is, if you see that there is a danger to health or to the safety of life, then the departments have been set up; give your complaints to them and have them note it. Especially this week, take preventive measures. Until the next gathering, please accept my request; with these same words I take my leave of you.
en_old: ...if you see a threat to health or safety, the departments are there, so file complaints with them and... especially this week, prevent it. Until the next gathering, accept... With these words, I take leave of you.

brh: اللہ پاک نمے سلامت تخے او گٹ سرٹ کرے عبید جان نا توارٹ سحر بینفین نمے او یقینا عبید جان نا دا کچنگا رنگ نم کلکن مروئی تو کنے ایبو اجازت اللہ نما ننا کلنا نگہبان او مہر باناک انشاء اللہ زندگی مس
en: May Allah keep you safe. To close, we will let you hear 'Sahar' (Dawn) in Obaid Jan's voice, and surely this ... style of Obaid Jan will be for all of you. So give me permission. Allah is the protector of you and of all of us, and He is kind. God willing, if life remains,
en_old: May Almighty Allah keep you safe... With Obaid Jan's voice, Sahar... and surely Obaid Jan's little touch will be for all of you. So give me permission. Allah is the protector of us all and kind. God willing, if life remains...

brh: استو ایتوار اولا ساڑی مرون اللہ حافظ باز باز منت وار اللہ حافظ
en: we will be with you again next Sunday. Goodbye, thank you very much, goodbye.
en_old: We'll be with you again on Sunday. Goodbye, thank you very much, goodbye.

brh: طبیعت کنا خدو غا نمبے ہنو ہنو ہچڑا اف۔ ہند کڑاس کرے وا باٹی کیو تا زار سے۔ ہنگا ضعیفہ غا درے پی مسے را غا سوب نا کرے آک دا بے ہمراہ۔ دعا زکو مچو۔
en: My health, by God ... there is nothing [to it]. ... I have grown weak ... for that reason ... Please pray, all of you.
en_old: My health, thanks to God, is... it's nothing. A little... I've grown weak... for that reason... Everyone, please pray.

brh: تو دے ٹی سلیمانی چا کورین شیر چا ملات او ہم گدرے فکت پھڈ ٹی دا بیماری شکیہ مفیسہ اللہ جو قران تو فرمائے کافر سب گڈ تھی پیا ابو
en: In a day [whether you have] Suleimani tea or milk tea ..., and still ... this illness in the stomach does not [go away]. Allah's Quran says that the unbelievers all gathered together; Abu...
en_old: If in a day you drink Suleimani tea or Korean milk tea, still in the end this disease in the stomach will not go away; Allah says in the Quran that the unbelievers have all gathered together...

brh: جلدا کٹ دشمن مونا پاک محمد کریم سائیں جو پیڑے اللہ نا قران نا بب بب دانا مونا او پبو اللہ سفت کلاما پبو کنا دلبر نبی کریم نا ذات کبریا نا قسم
en: ...Jahl was the bitter enemy of my holy Muhammad Karim, my master ... Allah's Quran ... before him ... the praise of Allah, [His] word ... of my beloved noble Prophet; I swear by the Almighty Being.
en_old: Quickly before the enemy, holy Muhammad the Noble, master... the Quran of Allah... before him... praise of Allah... I swear by the being of my beloved noble Prophet, by the Almighty...

brh: انو ئے خدا زیبا او نیم انو زیبا کرینو ہمو زیبائی نا چہرہ ٹی شاغانو انو ئے زیبا کنا کلامم زیبا کنا قرآنم زیبا
en: God is beautiful, and He made you beautiful too; He put that very beauty into [your] face. You are beautiful, my word too is beautiful, my Quran too is beautiful.
en_old: God made you beautiful, and you made... beautiful. He placed that beauty in your face. You are beautiful, my words are beautiful, my Quran is beautiful.

brh: ئے کنا دلبر نبی ئے بندہ غاتے اور انٹرویو کنے ہوشنگرا تینتو میٹنگ کننگٹیو کہ اگر محمد کریم ننا گلی ٹی بس تو خلینہ تا قران تے بمب اٹ
en: O my beloved Prophet, these people ... an interview ... were holding a meeting among themselves, [saying] that if Muhammad Karim comes into our street, then we will strike ... the Qurans with a bomb.
en_old: ...my beloved Prophet... people, and in an interview... were holding a meeting among themselves, saying that if Muhammad the Noble came into our street, we would strike... the Qurans with a bomb...

brh: نہ جنگ کے نیتون تا کنا محبوب نی برا کپا اینو تہ اہل برا ئے خدا نی تو نواروٹ جبرائیل نی کے راہی کیواں ملائکت نی تو نوار کیواں کنا دلبر نبی انتئے کہ سے سے پارہ قران پورا کروئی کنا دلبر نبی مچٹ
en: Do not fight with them; my beloved, do not take it badly. Today the people are bad, [but] I, God, am with you. I will send Gabriel to you, I will put the angels together with you, my beloved Prophet, because the thirty-part Quran must be completed. My beloved Prophet, [even if] the whole
en_old: Do not quarrel with them; my beloved, do not take it badly, today the people are bad, but God is with you; I will send Gabriel with you, I will send the angels with you, my beloved Prophet, because the Quran must be completed in thirty parts, my beloved Prophet.

brh: او دنیا دشمن مرے اسٹنگا خدا کل تومور نی دیوا پیغمبر غم چی کپہ نی تینا تبلیغ جاری کر بنداتے پاک کرے کلمہ خوانبو اللہ نا سجدہ کبو دا بتاتے الیبو اسٹے
en: world becomes [your] enemy, the one and only God is with you ...; O Prophet, do not grieve at all, carry on your preaching, purify the people: recite the kalima, prostrate to Allah, abandon these idols, [worship] the One
en_old: O beloved, even if the whole world becomes your enemy, God alone is with you; my prophet, do not grieve, continue your preaching, purify the people, have them recite the kalima, prostrate to Allah, and abandon these idols.

brh: ٹنگ آ خدائے تعالی نن آ پنڈوس خلت کرے مسے لوٹ تکھو گبڑزا، بلا مو دے کشی سیٹس کنے، بلا کشی بلا نونے کے، پد ہیڈ ماسٹر اسکول نا، ہزدہم ٹی کشالو، ما داڑان جی غزر اسکن، پڈ نا خلک
en: ... God Almighty ... us ... three ... then the headmaster of the school ... in the eighteenth ... we from here ...
en_old: Up there, God Almighty made us... three... the headmaster of the school, in the eighteenth... from here...

brh: تے خمپیسا؟ ایو نن گتہ کلاک کمبل خلتہ لا کدس مسے کلاک پیڑتہ خلتک مشرے کونس گڑ پیڑنہ خلتک کیک یا بچیسا؟ اللہ نا قران اعلان کیک اللہ زبردست و گھبرائے نا
en: Don't you see it? ... we ... a blanket ... three o'clock ... will it ... or will you escape? Allah's Quran declares: Allah is mighty, and do not be anxious.
en_old: Don't you see? ... Will it happen, or will you escape? Allah's Quran declares that Allah is Mighty...

brh: منجا محبوب تو پرواز کے جاری کر تبلیغ کے جاری کر سوہنا ئے سب تنجا دشمن بن با اج اینن کے تنجو چہرو نتھو ونے توجی بولی نتھی ونے توجی گال نتھی ونے منجا دلبر مکھے پنی ذات
en: My beloved, continue your flight, continue your preaching. O beautiful one, these have all become your enemies; today they do not like your face, they do not like your language, they do not like your words. My beloved, by My own Self,
en_old: My beloved, continue your flight, continue your preaching, O beautiful one; let them all become your enemies; today they do not like your face, they do not like your speech, they do not like your words; my beloved, I Myself am with you.

brh: خدا جو قسم گوڏیون ٿیندو ایئن ویجہائی ڏئی ایئن ویجہائی ڏئی سری ڏئی تنہنجو چہرو بہ وڻندل تنہنجی ٻولی بہ وڻندل تنہنجو قران بہ وڻندل سھڻا پو پری کان وک وک کڻی تون محمد
en: by God's oath, it will happen that they come close like this, draw near like this ..., [and] your face too will please them, your language too will please them, your Quran too will please them. O beautiful one, then from far away, step by step, to you, Muhammad
en_old: By God's oath, it would happen that if they came close, really close, your face would please them, your speech would please them, your Quran would please them, O beautiful one... Muhammad.

brh: او کریم جو سامو ایندا، سوہنا ایہے ئے ماڑو جکے اج دشمن ہن تو محمد تے کلمو پڑھی پکا مسلمان تھی ویندا۔ سبحان اللہ۔ حضور جی چہرے مین برکت، آسان وعظ کیوں تھا تہاں کے ننڈ اچے، آسان وعظ کیوں تہاں کے آرام نہ
en: Karim, they will come before [you]. O beautiful one, these are such people who are enemies today, [but] they will recite Muhammad's kalima and become firm Muslims. Glory be to God. There was blessing in the Prophet's face; we preach and you fall asleep, we preach and you find no ease.
en_old: They would come before the Generous One; the beautiful one is such a man that whoever is an enemy today would recite Muhammad's kalima and become a firm Muslim. Glory be to Allah. There was blessing in the Prophet's face; when he preached so gently, they could not sleep; when he preached so gently, they had no rest.

brh: حضور صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم جو قران پڑھے تو ملائک بھی حیران سبحان اللہ ایڈو سہنو نبی آ کافرن کے غصو آیو تہ ہی تہ مڑے نتھو روز اچے تہو مکے شہر جی گھٹی گھٹی مین گھمی کرے تبلیغ
en: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) recites the Quran, even the angels are amazed. Glory be to God. He is such a beautiful Prophet; the unbelievers got angry, but he does not turn back; every day he comes, goes around every lane of the city of Mecca and preaches.
en_old: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) recited the Quran, even the angels were amazed. Glory be to Allah. Such a beautiful prophet, yet the unbelievers became angry; still he did not turn back; every day he would come and go around the streets of the city of Mecca, preaching.

brh: تو کرے بابا اللہ جی عبادت کرو جنجی مان محمد عربی عبادت تو کیا تون اونی جی کرو چھو تہ مان اللہ جو نبی آن یار موتے کلمو پڑھدو تہ جنت ملدو جی موتے کلمو نہ پڑھدو تہ جہنم مین ہلا ویندو خدا تہ میر جی
en: he would say: 'Folks, worship Allah, whom I, Muhammad the Arab, worship; you too worship Him, because I am Allah's Prophet. Friend, whoever recites the kalima [affirming] me will get paradise, and whoever does not recite the kalima [affirming] me will go off to hell.' God ...
en_old: ...he would say: brothers, worship Allah, just as I, Muhammad the Arab, worship Him; you too worship Him, for I am Allah's prophet; friend, whoever recites the kalima will attain paradise, and whoever does not recite the kalima will go to hell. God...

brh: ایلو ما وازینتھ ایلو ما کلمے وارو کافرن کے کاوڑ پئیچے تے ہک الوکو چھوکرو ئسن کے کلمو تو پڑھائے چھو کلمو پڑھو ہک بے سا میٹنگ جھاتا جن قران تو فرمائے اللہ فرمائے تو وقال الذین کفرو لا
en: ... the reciters of the kalima ... The unbelievers got angry that a lone boy is making us recite the kalima: why should we recite the kalima? They held a meeting with one another, which the Quran mentions; Allah says: 'And those who disbelieve say: do not
en_old: That one... that reciter of the kalima; the unbelievers became furious that a young boy was making people recite the kalima; they held a meeting, which the Quran mentions; Allah says: 'And those who disbelieve say, do not...

brh: لا تسمعوا لہذا القرآن والغوا فیہ قران پاک فرمائے پاڻ ۾ ٻڌی ڪری چون پیا اڙی خبردار ٿی وڃو اڄ نہ سڀاڻی محمد عربی ضرور ایندو پوء جڏہن قران پڙہی پوء
en: listen to this Quran, and make noise during it.' The Holy Quran says: banding together among themselves, they were saying: 'Hey, be warned, today or tomorrow Muhammad the Arab will surely come; then, when he recites the Quran, then
en_old: ...listen to this Quran, and make noise during it.' The Holy Quran says they gathered together and said: be warned, today or tomorrow Muhammad the Arab will surely come, then when he recites the Quran, then...

brh: پو رڑیو کیو، پو رڑیو کیو، پو سیٹیوں وجایو، پو تاڑیوں وجایو، پو پٹھی رے بھجو، کن بند کرے بھجو، اکھیوں بوٹے بھجو، پر محمد جو قران نہ بدھو، اللہ فرمائے تو کافرن فیصلو کرے چھڈیو، اللہ
en: then shout, then shout, then whistle, then clap, then turn your backs and run, close your ears and run, shut your eyes and run, but do not listen to Muhammad's Quran.' Allah says the unbelievers made [this] decision. Allah
en_old: Then shout, then shout, then whistle, then clap, then turn your backs and run, cover your ears and run, shut your eyes and run, but do not listen to Muhammad's Quran. Allah says the unbelievers made this decision. Allah...

brh: فرمایو تہ وقال الذین کفروا لا تسمعوا لہذا القرآن ہن قران کے ٻڌڻو ئے ناہی محمد ڪریم جو چہرو ڏسڻو ئے ناہی مصطفی کے ہٿ ملاڻو ئے ناہی محمد ڪریم جی ویجہو ویہڻو ناہی محمد ڪریم سان ڳالہہ ڪرڻی ئے ناہی
en: said: 'And those who disbelieve said: do not listen to this Quran': this Quran is not to be listened to at all, Muhammad Karim's face is not to be looked at, hands are not to be shaken with Mustafa, one is not to sit near Muhammad Karim, one is not to talk with Muhammad Karim.
en_old: He said: 'And those who disbelieve say, do not listen to this Quran': do not listen to the Quran, do not look at the face of Muhammad the Generous, do not shake hands with Mustafa, do not sit near Muhammad the Generous, do not talk with Muhammad the Generous.

brh: برادری ختم تاہ کین، رشتہ ختم تاہ کین، دوستی ختم تاہ کین، پر محمد غدار نہ ہی اللہ فرماتا سونا بھلے میٹنگوں کر، بھلے پان مین فیصلہ کر، ہکڑو ڈینہہ ایڑو تھیندو یہ سب جھکی پوندا کلمہ پڑھی مس
en: 'Let kinship be ended, let relations be ended, let friendships be ended, but [never go] to Muhammad.' Allah says: 'O beautiful one, let them hold meetings, let them decide among themselves; one day it will be such that they will all bow down, recite the kalima and become
en_old: Kinship may end, relationships may end, friendships may end, but Muhammad is no traitor. Allah says, O beautiful one, let them hold meetings, let them decide among themselves; one day such a time will come that they will all bow down and recite the kalima.

brh: مسلمان تھی ویندا سبحان اللہ ایہی مکے وارا دشمن آ ایہی مکے وارا سجن تھیا جن کے چنڈرائی کھئی اوئے تباہ تھی ویا ورنہ اکثریت مین کلمو پڑھی مسلمان تھیا سبحان اللہ ایہو منھنجو پاک محمد کریم سئیں
en: Muslims.' Glory be to God. These very Meccans were enemies, these very Meccans became friends; those who persisted in mischief were destroyed, otherwise the majority recited the kalima and became Muslims. Glory be to God. Such is my holy Muhammad Karim, my master.
en_old: They would become Muslims, Subhan Allah. The very man who was an enemy in Mecca became a friend in Mecca. Those who held malice were destroyed; otherwise most of them recited the kalima and became Muslims. Subhan Allah, this is my pure Muhammad, the Generous, my master.

brh: ادا زبان اسر ہن قران ۾ جو اللہ اسر رکیو آ، اچو، پڙہان؟ ڪن بس ڇڏیان ہاڻی؟ پوء دعوت ڪندو، کارائیندو مانی وانی؟ مفت ٿوڙی آ، ڪروڙین مان قربان ڪیان قران مٿان۔
en: Brother, [there is] power in [its] language, the power that Allah has placed in this Quran. Come, shall I recite? Or should I just stop now? Then will you invite me, feed me a meal and all? It isn't free! I would sacrifice crores for the Quran.
en_old: Brother, the tongue has power. God has put power in the Quran. Come, shall I recite? Or should I stop now? Then will you give a feast and feed me bread? It isn't free! I would sacrifice millions for the Quran.

brh: اللہ نا قران تہو فرمائے فرمائے انما المومنون الذین اذا ذکر اللہ وجلت قلوبھم واذا تلیت علیھم
en: Allah's Quran says, it says: 'The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts tremble, and when are recited to them
en_old: The Quran of God states: "The believers are only those who, when God is mentioned, their hearts tremble, and when [His verses] are recited to them..."

brh: آیاتہ زادتہم ایمانا وعلی ربہم یتوکلون۔ سبحان اللہ۔ اللہ فرماؤ مومناک، ئے اللہ نا قران پاک ٹی مومناک نا سفت بیان کرے
en: His verses, it increases them in faith, and upon their Lord they rely.' Glory be to God. Allah speaks of the believers; He has described the qualities of the believers in Allah's Holy Quran.
en_old: '...His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith, and upon their Lord they rely.' Glory be to Allah. Allah speaks of the believers; Allah has described the qualities of the believers in the Holy Quran.

brh: مومن دے رے پارا مومن جنت تے کائک مومن دے رے پارا اللہ پانٹیک کلمہ والا کلمہ والا تے پاک اگر مومن مروئی نمے گڑا ارا تم کنا خدا نا پن النگے نما است آک لرزہ رکھانے
en: Who is a believer, he said? The believer goes to paradise. Who is a believer, he said? Allah says: the people of the kalima, the people of the kalima are pure. If you are to be believers, then whenever the name of my God is mentioned, your hearts [must] tremble.
en_old: The believer, they say the believer... the believer will reach paradise... Allah says the people of the kalima... the people of the kalima are pure; if you are to be believers, then whenever my God's name is mentioned, your hearts tremble.

brh: خلیس ارادھم کنا قران خوان مونی کسس یا تینٹ خوانبو یا پینس خوانے یا تینٹ خوانبو یا خفٹ بنگو اللہ پاک دے کرے تنے ذات کبریا نا قسم اگر قران نا بننگے مزہ بسنے دا ایمان نا
en: ... with sincere intention ... my Quran ... someone ...: either recite it yourselves, or [when] someone else recites it, or recite it yourselves, or listen with your ears. Allah Almighty [swore] by His own exalted Self: if you have found pleasure in listening to the Quran, this is [the mark] of faith
en_old: ...whose intention is to recite my Quran, whether he recites it himself or someone else recites it and he listens; Allah Almighty says, I swear by My Majestic Self, if you have found joy in listening to the Quran, this is a sign of faith.

brh: نشانی ئے ہرا بندغ قران نا بننگس مذہب ئس نی ئے اللہ نا ایمان مضبوط ہم کیوا، ئے نا ایمان تازہ ہم کیونے، جنت نا خواجہ ہم کیوا، ہرا بندغ کہ کنا قران ونا، کنا قران نا بننگ ونا تا، کنا قران نا مجلس ونا تا، الحمدللہ پین جنت نا نشانی ئس ملار۔
en: is the sign. Whoever finds pleasure in listening to the Quran, I, Allah, will strengthen his faith, will also refresh his faith, and will also make him a master of paradise. Whoever likes my Quran, likes listening to my Quran, likes the gatherings of my Quran, praise be to God, has found another sign of paradise.
en_old: It is a sign: whoever listens to the Quran, Allah strengthens his faith, refreshes his faith, and makes him a seeker of paradise; whoever loves my Quran, loves listening to my Quran, loves the gatherings of my Quran, praise be to Allah, he has gained another sign of paradise.

brh: پارے نی کسوہ زندے الپارے نی دیدے شول نہ دیدے کمپرہ دا سبق بسم اللہ تو محمد بن عبداللہ نی دا تو نن اف پارے ابا خلیس کنے خط کسف کنے کسف لکھے
en: He said, 'Will you kill her? Will you not leave her alive?' ... [unclear] ... 'This lesson, Bismillah, belongs to Muhammad bin Abdullah; it is not ours.' He said, 'Father, I am afraid ... a letter ... kill ... write "kill".'
en_old: He said, will you kill her or let her live? He said, you see, will you or won't you... this lesson of Bismillah is from Muhammad bin Abdullah, this is not ours. He said, father, you are afraid; write me a letter, write that she should be killed.

brh: بسم اللہ اسندن ننگ کپرا، ئے ابا گٹ ٹکر ٹکر کرکنے محمد نا کلمے گیرام کننگ کپرا، باوا سمجھائنا کہ دا محمد نا اعلان ئے دا بسم اللہ بوکا خوانانے کلمے بوکا خوانانے
en: 'I cannot give up Bismillah. O father, even if you cut my throat to pieces, I cannot forget the Kalima of Muhammad.' The father explained that this is Muhammad's proclamation: she recites this Bismillah, she recites the Kalima.
en_old: She won't stop reciting Bismillah like this. Father, even if you cut her to pieces she won't stop reciting the Kalima of Muhammad. The father explained that this is the declaration of Muhammad; she recites this Bismillah, she recites the Kalima.

brh: اوستاد نا فیصلہ کرے دا سم مسڑے زندے لوئیف دا سم مسڑے کسپ وا اگر دا مسڑ زندہ مس دا بسم اللہ اوراٹی کنا بروئے دا کلمہ کنا چنا تے سر مروئی دا بسم اللہ کنا چنا تے سر مروئی کنا اوراٹی
en: The master made his decision: 'I will not leave this daughter alive; I will kill this daughter. If this daughter stays alive, this Bismillah will come into my house, this Kalima will reach my children; this Bismillah will reach my children in my house.'
en_old: The master made his decision: either let this girl live or kill this girl. If this girl stays alive, this Bismillah will come into my house, this Kalima will reach my children, this Bismillah will reach my children in my house.

brh: محمد ندیم بروہی امریکہ مسڑے کسپوئی کنے مسڑے زندہ ہلپرا امریکہ سپتا اگر ہنو خلیفتو بدنام مریوا کو پین طریقسٹ مسڑے کسپوا کنا ایلو ما کو
en: [Muhammad Nadeem Brahui, America — unclear] 'I have to kill the daughter; I will not keep the daughter alive ... [unclear] ... if I kill her this way I will be disgraced; I will kill the daughter by some other method' ... my other ...
en_old: Muhammad Nadeem Brahui... the girl must be killed, I will not leave the girl alive... if we kill her like that we will be disgraced; we will kill the girl some other way...

brh: او مسلماناک، مسٹ کو کلمہ خوانانے تو باوہ کسفنگر اندر تمانے۔ بسم اللہ کلمہ خوانانے پی کسفنگر۔ او داسہ کلمہ والا کلرے نف نہ با، لا الہ الا اللہ۔
en: O Muslims, the little girl has recited the Kalima, so her father has set about killing her. She has recited Bismillah and the Kalima, so he means to kill her. Now, people of the Kalima, all of you say it: There is no god but God.
en_old: O Muslims, the little girl recites the Kalima, so her father set out to kill her. She recites Bismillah and the Kalima, so they kill her. Now all of you recite the Kalima together: La ilaha illallah.

brh: محمد رسول اللہ الحمدللہ نہ کس شاماز خلک ننے نہ کس جنگس کیک نن تون قران ارا اراٹی تخوکے ہر جاگہ دا قران تخوکے خواننگے پابندی ئے دا مدرسہ نی ئے کونڈور ئے کونڈور اخہ مدرسہ دا دین نما کل چنا خواننگ
en: Muhammad is the Messenger of God. Praise be to God, no one beats us, no one fights with us. We have the Quran, it is kept in every house; this Quran is kept everywhere. Is there any ban on reading it? This madrasa, in this corner, in that corner, so many madrasas, this religion, for all your children to study.
en_old: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Praise be to God, no one beats us, no one fights us. We have the Quran, it is kept in our homes, the Quran is kept everywhere; is there any ban on reading it? This madrasa, that madrasa, so many madrasas; this religion, all your children could study.

brh: الحمدللہ جاگہ ارے، چنا تے رے ہندا فک، وارا چنا خوانپک، اوخ سکا کورا، کنے استو بے رختی تنو، سو بے رختی تنو، کنے ابا ولمت خیرات اٹ تینا پھل کن۔
en: Praise be to God, there are places, there are children, yet the children do not study ... [unclear] ... (they say) 'I was shown indifference, shown indifference,' and the father and mother, with charity, for their own reward.
en_old: Praise be to God, there is a place, there are children, yet the children don't study... they complain, saying they gave me no leave, they gave me no permission... father, mother, charity for their own sake.

brh: خدا خلئے نما مولوی تے ملا تے تینا پیڈاتے پر کیرہ چنائے خلنگٹ کرینو دا چنائے کہ لمہ دن پارے دا چنا خوانے کے اینو نرفیو چنا خوانے کے اوڑے سد چناؤ کلہ میتٹ اداسٹ نا ٹانگو نرانے
en: (They say,) 'May God strike your mawlawis and mullahs; they fill their own bellies; they have beaten the child' — this child about whom the mother said, 'This child will study.' Today the child runs away instead of studying; there, a hundred children all run away from the teacher ...
en_old: May God strike... your mawlawis and mullahs only fill their own bellies; they have beaten the child. The mother said this child is going to study, but today the child runs away instead of studying; there a hundred children run away from the madrasa's teacher.

brh: کنا سنمس کہ بے ایمان نائے سچونا زنڈو کو نان تینا نرا ہم سے کہ دروغ تریں ٹی استاد ئے لیکن کنا صحابہ تو زندگی اور دا مسڑکوڑہ زندگی اور کلمے پالانے
en: I came to know that the faithless one ... even his own son is a master at lying; but the life of my companions and the life of this little girl — they uphold the Kalima.
en_old: I had heard that the faithless man... even his own son is a master at lying; but the life of my companions and this little girl's life... they recite the Kalima.

brh: ئے نوباوہ خلنگ نا تیاری تے ٹی اینا اونغ نا دودینگا خیسن نا چھلو اسے پرے چھنا پجی ابا پدا چھلو درٹی تخ وڑا خواب تے نین پگا اگر تتوس کنے خوشو مس خوشو زندہ ہلپر نی کنے
en: In the preparations for killing her, a fine gold ring was made for her ... then the girl's father (meant to) put the ring in the ... [unclear] ... 'Tomorrow, if you do not give it back to me ... I will not keep you alive.'
en_old: He began the preparations to kill her: a beautiful box was made, the girl was put in, and then the father placed the box in the river... if I had not done it I would have been happy... you leave me alive.

brh: اسپیوانی مسر کوزہ لے دوٹی الکے باوہ سلوکے پارے بسم اللہ بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم
en: The little girl took it in her hand, with the father standing there, and said, 'Bismillah, In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.'
en_old: The young little girl took the ... in her hand, the father standing there, and she said Bismillah, Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim.

brh: چلم ء دوتے کرئے اراٹی پیہنا، دریٹی تخات برے بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم، باوہ پدی اینا خناٹ ہرا تیکہ ہرا تیکہ تخات مسڑ کو دانگ
en: She took the ring in her hands, went into the house, put it away in the ..., saying 'In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful'; then her father watched where she put it, where the little girl put it.
en_old: He took the box in his hands, put her inside, and placed it in the river; she said Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim. Then her father saw that wherever he placed it, the little girl...

brh: اینا بابت تو دے غینا کشا چلوے اینا دریاب ٹی خسا تا نہ پگ مسڑ کو چلوے توئے نہ مسڑ کو زندہ مروئی پگ مسڑ کو کسفیوا ہرا تم سوب تمبا پیدا سہ مسڑ کو کسفیوا چلو تے دے ٹی خسا تا داسہ کا مچے سلے جوانو
en: Her father, during the day, took out the ring and threw it into the river: 'Now tomorrow the little girl will not be able to give the ring, and the little girl will not stay alive; tomorrow I will kill the little girl; once a reason turns up, I will kill the little girl.' He threw the ring in, in the daytime. 'Now let it rest a little — good.'
en_old: Her father then pulled the box out in the daytime and threw it into the river. Tomorrow the little girl... the box... no, the little girl will live; tomorrow the little girl will be killed; when the reason arises the little girl will be killed. He threw the box into the river in the daytime; now everyone stood, fine.

brh: دے نٹم کنو مسڑ کن گونے گڑا مسڑ کسپ وا اینا بلو مچے سل کے پارے اوراٹی سل مے او مسڑ پجی ابا پارے دادے چیر بس جوڑ کتا نیم کن ایم کنو استے پیمانی کے مچیم پد مسڑ کسپ وا اللہ پرے زاد
en: 'If by day the girl does not ... then I will kill the girl.' Her elder waited a little and said, 'Stay in the house.' The girl's father said, '[unclear] ... a little later I will kill the girl,' by God ...
en_old: ...then the girl will be killed. His elder stood up and said, stand in the house. The girl's father said, this... then afterwards the girl will be killed, by God...

brh: ہالے ما نی مسڑ کو ہچلا کننگ کپیسہ ئے کلمہ محمد عربی نا سبق یاد کرینے نی تو اسہ چٹ زگرہ ہزار دشمن مریر ہچلا کننگ کپیرے مسڑ کو نا حفاظت ء خدا تینٹ کیوا
en: Now you cannot do anything to the little girl; she has learned the lesson of the Kalima of Muhammad the Arab. You are just one man; even if there were a thousand enemies, you could do nothing. God Himself will protect the little girl.
en_old: Now, little girl, no one can do anything to you. You have learned the lesson of the Kalima of Muhammad the Arab. Even if there are a thousand enemies, they cannot do anything to you; God Himself will protect the little girl.

brh: مسٹکو چا گیدو ٹی کرے پارے بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم نن شاتا بسم اللہ خوانسہ خان صاحب پدی
en: The little girl put [it] into the ... and said, 'In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.' We too recite Bismillah, Khan Sahib, afterwards.
en_old: The little girl ... said Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim. We too recite Bismillah, Khan Sahib, afterwards.

brh: چلوے زنخنا تینا مونٹی شماتے باوت خلک تینا گوڈاتے خلک ئے محمد عربی کنا مسڑکو گھڑی سیٹی امرو بلوچ جادو سہیل توسونس کہ دریا بمبتا چلوے کشانے حالانکہ جادو الو
en: He saw the ring in front of him; he struck his ... and struck his knees: 'O Muhammad the Arab! My little girl, in a moment — what kind of magic have you worked, that the river has given back the ring?' Yet it was not magic.
en_old: He saw the box in front of him, beat his head, beat his knees: O Muhammad the Arab, my little girl... how... is this Baloch magic... that the river pulled the box out? Yet it is not magic.

brh: پدا خدا نا غیبی مدد ئس کا سبحان اللہ ایرا شامت مونٹی تے ٹھوکا پی جوامس بابو جوامس خلک تے بابا باوتہ باوتہ خلیرندو ایرا شامت مونٹی ٹھوکا پی محمد
en: Then God's unseen help came — glory be to God ... in front of them ... it was all right, father, it was all right ... struck ... father, father ... in front ... Muhammad.
en_old: Then a hidden help from God came, Subhan Allah... in front of them... father... Muhammad...

brh: ہمرو علم نا سسرا تا کہ دریا بند خلوے کساس دا سپارے الپہ دا زندے الپہ اوڑے شو بند مسنے نمک نا ستا پدا سے کساس پدا چلو نا کساس پی ابا
en: That is knowledge, that someone would dam the river ... neither ... nor leave this one alive ... there it was dammed ... of salt ... then someone ... the ring ... father.
en_old: That is the knowledge, that the river would be dammed... he said, neither kill her nor let her live... there the dam was made... then the box... father.

brh: گڈا! بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم۔ نو مے ارغ نا وخت آ بسم اللہ ء خوانیرے اوا؟ اینو ننا ارغ، داست و کل اوکی، را او شے قران ء۔ اینگن مسے ارغ آن پد داستک، استاد بسم اللہ اوستاں کنے گڈا ہمری کے، دا!
en: Then! In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. So do you recite Bismillah at mealtime, yes? Today our meal ... now and all ... the Quran. Now, after the meal, the teacher (said) Bismillah to me ... then likewise, this!
en_old: Then! In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. So do you recite Bismillah when you eat? Yes? Today our food... and the Quran... Now after the third meal, the teacher said Bismillah to me, then the same... this!

brh: حضور ذات بسم اللہ ننے نی ہنا بے دیخ مونن تے خو کے رگاک تے خو کو اینگن مہمان زمین لٹ بند کر سبرے پیرو ابا نا بنی ٹی بیمار آت نا زوری اور تمک مون ء دانگ کروئی ایہہ
en: Revered one, Bismillah ... us ... you went ... before us ... now the guest ... the land ... closed ... in the father's ... the severity of the illnesses, and it has to be faced this way.
en_old: Holy one, in the name of God... go before us... now the guest... closed the land... in the father's... the force of the illnesses, and it has to be faced.

brh: پیروز اتسوٹک، چے بیر اسرا، الار اسرا، انت اسرا، پیروز اتسوٹ۔ ئے پامامہ نی بہ گؤنک دا سنگتاک او ارٹ او مسٹ بر او بہ کنیر۔ ئے پویٹ بہ بیت، نی ہم کن، دا شاغات کٹے تے نہ دنداز نو۔ اوڑے دا تے خدا خلقی تو۔
en: Victorious ... whatever it was, whatever it was, victorious ... You go and tell these friends, two or three of them, to come and do it ... you do it too, don't pour out these ... There God created these.
en_old: I was victorious... whatever it was, I was victorious. ...you go and tell these friends, two or three of them, to come and do it... you do it too, don't throw these pieces... There God created these.

brh: چپ کے ئے تے بے کنفی پیرنگا! حالانکہ چٹ کننگ کتوکا دا باز اسرا، لیکن بخیلی اور تو سہی نہ بلکہ امیر خان اور کننگ کتوکا۔ بائے پاچ کتوک دا بلا مہر تے سٹاکا، کلہ کاک تے پھیری کنگورا، بائے پاچ
en: Be quiet ...! Although this could not be done completely, it was a lot; but not out of stinginess — rather Amir Khan could not do it ... these big ... were thrown ... everyone goes around ...
en_old: Be quiet... Although this could not be done completely, but not through stinginess... rather Amir Khan could not do it... these were thrown... turned around...

brh: ملک کس کس کنے خنوئے لیکن آ مسلہ کو نائے ایمانی سلامی ئے کنا محبوب نا وظیفہ سلامی بسم اللہ خواننگ ٹی ئے الحمدللہ اگر ئنا بسم اللہ غا ننہ ملکے
en: Some people in the country will look at me, but the issue is the safety of your faith; my beloved's daily practice — safety lies in reciting Bismillah; praise be to God, if your Bismillah ... us ...
en_old: Some people looked at me, but the issue is your faith and peace; the litany of my beloved is peace, it is in reciting Bismillah, praise be to God, if your Bismillah...

brh: انشاءاللہ باخدا ہمودے بسم اللہ نا طاقت ہمودے بے شک ننا چڑو رزان ئس مڑزانت ہمو راغن نا جواننگا ہنس فلحالی نم ہنس نن چھنکار ہنس دا درو ملخو دونن نا
en: God willing, by God, on that day — the power of Bismillah, that day — without doubt our ... the best one of that ... went; for now you went, we ... went ...
en_old: God willing, by God, on that day, by the power of Bismillah, on that day, without doubt our... the best of that... for now... we...

brh: غیبات و جن و جن و اینگہ نینگ چر کشنگ ٹی تھادان اچے بچے جن و دو ہم اینگ استاد عبدالقدوس دو ہتہ و تر مٹ ہتہ و ہتہ دا ہم مولوی گیا دنیا ہراتم جن نا کٹھرے گڑا مولوی برے
en: The unseen beings, and jinn, and jinn ... in drawing them out ... jinn ... also teacher Abdul Qudoos ... this maulvi too ... in the world, whenever a jinn ..., then the maulvi comes.
en_old: The unseen, and jinn and jinn... in drawing... teacher Abdul Qudoos... the maulvi too... in the world, when the jinn is ... then the maulvi comes.

brh: ڳالھ سمجھو، توھان کان پڇان ٿو، دلیر آھیو نہ بابا؟ دلیر آھیو؟ ہا اللہ ڪرم ھڪڙو جن ما وٽ اچے ڇڏیاس، ڦٽی ڪیاس، وچان ڀڄی، پوء ویندو؟ لڀنداسین نہ تہ ڪاڏی ویندو؟ ایت الڪرسی یاد ئے ناھی ڪنھن کے
en: [Sindhi] Understand the point, I am asking you: you are brave, aren't you, son? Are you brave? Yes, by God's grace. If a jinn came to me, I would tear it apart and it would run off from the middle; would it get away then? We would find it, otherwise where would it go? Does no one remember Ayat al-Kursi?
en_old: Understand the point, I am asking you, you are brave, aren't you, son? Are you brave? Yes, by God's grace. If a jinn came to me, I would leave it torn apart, it would flee from the middle; then would it go? We would find it, otherwise where would it go? Doesn't anyone remember Ayat al-Kursi?

brh: کلمو پڙہی تہ جان ڇڏائی، تہ ڇوڪری، پڻس چیو تہ ہاڻ ہن کے ڇڏڻو ئے ناہی، اڙی ظالمو! ڪلمو پڙہیو تہ منہنجی سہڻی نبی تے ڇتا ڇو ٿیا او، ڪھڙو قصور ڪئی، ڌیء بہ تنہنجی آ، چئی نہ منہنجی
en: [Sindhi] She recited the Kalima, so he wanted to be rid of the girl; her father said, 'Now I am not going to spare her.' O you cruel ones! She recited the Kalima of my beautiful Prophet — why have you turned so heartless over it? What crime did she commit? She is your daughter too — say, is she not mine?
en_old: If you recite the Kalima your life will be spared, and the girl... she said, now I will not leave it, O tyrant! Recite the Kalima; what did my beautiful Prophet do to you, what fault did he commit? She is your daughter too, is she not mine?

brh: جی دھی کھپئی نہ جی دھی جی سینے مین کلمو آ جی نینی جی زبان تے بسم اللہ ہی ایہہ منھنجو دشمن آ دشمن آ مان آن کے جیرو چھڈن گھرائیں نہ تہو بھاگو کہیں جوگی فقیر وٹ بھگو آ با ایہڑو کو نانگ اتھوا جو ایہہ ڈنگ ہانے تہ مانھو
en: [Sindhi] 'I do not want such a daughter — a daughter with the Kalima in her heart and Bismillah on her tongue. She is my enemy, an enemy; I do not want to leave her alive.' So he ran to some jogi, a fakir: 'Is there such a snake here that, when it bites, a person ...'
en_old: Yes, daughter, don't you want it? Yes, daughter, in her heart is the Kalima, on her tongue is Bismillah. This one is my enemy, an enemy; I will not leave her alive. Don't panic, then go to some jogi or fakir... there is such a snake that bites a person.

brh: ادا مرے دوا تئی نہ پجے چائے پیسہ دے ڈوکڑ دے ہرا پیسہ دے ناگ ورتے ہن چس ٹوپڑے مین بند کجائیں بابا متاں بھول مین تو انگور لائے متاں توجوئی
en: [Sindhi] 'Brother, (I want) her to die so that no medicine can reach her.' He said, 'Give money, give cash, give the money.' He took the cobra and closed it in a basket: 'Son, be careful not to put your finger in by mistake, lest it bite you.'
en_old: Brother, if she dies there will be no medicine; take money, give it to the doctor... give the money to the snake charmer... close it in a basket, son, lest by mistake...

brh: کلمہ لہی ونجے، ڈرنجے بے دا ڈوٹھو بند کیو تے کھو تے منا متا اچانک نہ تھے، ہانے کینجھے لاء؟ چھوکری لاء۔ چھو؟ کلمہ پڑھے تھے، بسم اللہ پڑھے تھے، چھوکری جڈے گھر مین بیٹھی آ کا خبر ناہیں تہ بابے جی دشمنی کینجھا
en: ...so that the Kalima would be gone [from the house]. ... he shut it up, and [warned] lest something suddenly happen. Now, for whom [was this]? For the girl. Why? She recites the Kalima, she recites Bismillah. The girl, sitting at home, has no idea at all what enmity her father holds.
en_old: The Kalima... this box was closed... suddenly... for whom? For the girl. Why? She recites the Kalima, she recites Bismillah; the girl, while sitting at home, does not know what her father's enmity is.

brh: کھنیا ئے ٹوبڑو کھنیا او او ننڈڑی تچی بابا ننڈڑی ہمے سونو ہارا ئے ٹوبڑو ونی کرے رکھو جری ما گھوراں ت مونکے سونو ہار کدی دیجائے بے ایمان کے دل مین بے ایمانی
en: He picked up the basket, picked it up: 'O little one, child; dear little one, there is a gold necklace in this. Take this basket and put it away. When I ask for it, take the gold necklace out and give it to me.' The faithless man had treachery in his heart.
en_old: He took the basket, took it... the little one, son, the little one... this gold necklace is in the basket, put it there; when I am away she will take out the gold necklace... in the heart of the faithless one there is faithlessness.

brh: تہ جلی ما چوندم تہ سونو ہار کڈیا ئے ٹوبڑے جو ڈھکڻو متھے کندو اندر ہتہ وجھندو تہ نانگ ڈنگ ہڻندس چھوری مرے ویندی بدنامی کا نہ تھیندی چھوکری مرے وئی نانگ ڈنگ ہینس اللہ فرمائے
en: Then when I tell her, she will take out the gold necklace: she will lift the lid of the basket and put her hand inside, and the snake will bite her. The girl will die, and there will be no disgrace at all: 'The girl died, a snake bit her.' Allah says:
en_old: Then when I tell her, she will take out the gold necklace, lift the lid of the basket and put her hand inside, then the snake will bite her and the girl will die; there will be no disgrace. The girl will die, the snake will bite her. Allah says...

brh: ادا تو کہڑا ہیلا کر ناگ کیر تھیندو آ کہن کے طاقت آہی جو منہنجے بانہے کے کچہ کرے سکے چو جو طاقت مان اللہ جی آ اللہ زبردست خبردار ہی تہ ناگ آ ہی تہ ہی تہ چھا ہی
en: 'Brother, make whatever schemes you like; what is a snake? Who has the power to do anything to my servant? For the power is mine, Allah's.' Allah is Mighty and All-Aware; whether it is a snake or this or that, what is it [before Him]?
en_old: Brother, whatever trick you play, the snake will... who has the power to do anything to my servant? Whatever power there is, it is from Allah. Allah is Mighty. Beware, whether it is a snake or whatever it is.

brh: ئے موت نا دھڑاؤ جک سور نا ہار او جی قران اینے فرمائے فرمائے ونفخ فی الصور فاذا ہم من الاجداث الے ربہم ینسلون
en: This [is] the shock of death, when the Trumpet [sounds], about which the Quran says thus: 'And the Trumpet will be blown, and behold, from the graves they will hasten to their Lord.'
en_old: This is the terror of death, the blast of the trumpet, and the Quran says: 'And the trumpet will be blown, and behold, from the graves they will hasten to their Lord.'

brh: انسانو یاد رکھو کدی او ڈیہہ تان متھو ایندو جڈے قبراں منجھ نکرندو او وہندو نہ تھکی پوندو بھجندو ملائکہ تان کھے بھجائیندا پیر اگھاڑا ہوندو کپڑا بھی نہ ہوندو بھکھ
en: O people, remember: one day that day will come upon you, when [each] will come out of the graves. He will not [just] walk; worn out, he will run; the angels will drive him running. Feet will be bare, there will be no clothes either; hunger...
en_old: O people, remember, one day will come when you will come out of the graves; they will run without tiring, running, the angels will drive them on; they will be barefoot, without clothes, hungry.

brh: انتے ہوندو، انتے ہوندو، زمین ٹامے جی بنبی، انی زمین تے ڈوڑندو ڈوڑندو، فاذا ہم من الاجداث الے ربہم ینسلون، قران تو فرمائے، ہیاں بھجندہ، ہیاں بھجندہ گوبردار وانگر
en: There it will be, there it will be: the earth will be made of copper, and on that earth he will run and run. 'And behold, from the graves they will hasten to their Lord,' the Quran says. They will run like this, run like this, like [unclear]...
en_old: That is how it will be, that is how it will be, the earth will shake, and on the earth they will run and run: 'And behold, from the graves they will hasten to their Lord,' the Quran says. They will run like this, they will run like this, like...

brh: دا خبر نہ ئے تون مکارے تھوں یا اڑے کیڑے رستے سا تھوں یا چھو تون اون آ ڈوڑندو وتان بھجندو وتان اللہ فرمائی یاد رکھو جی دنیا مین کلمے تے عمل کندو تہ قیامت دے ذلت خواری کو بچائیندو مان جی کلمو چھلیو قران چھلیو دین چھلیو تہ قیامت دے حشر
en: There is no knowing whether from ... or, hey, by which road, or from where; he will be running about over there, fleeing about. Allah says: remember, whoever acts upon the Kalima in the world, it will save him from humiliation and disgrace on the Day of Judgment; but whoever abandoned the Kalima, abandoned the Quran, abandoned the religion, then on the Day of Judgment the Gathering...
en_old: It is not known whether... deceitful... or on which path... they will run there; Allah says remember: whoever acts upon the Kalima in this world will be saved from humiliation and disgrace on the Day of Judgment; but whoever abandoned the Kalima, abandoned the Quran, abandoned the religion, then on the Day of Judgment the resurrection...

brh: درے ھوندو کوئی ہتہ وٹھن لاء تیار نہ ھوندو ھتے آیوں نا مزاح امام و حاجی آئی سئیں او بروھی او بیو ھکڑو مولوی صاحب چیس پئے نماز خوان اٿس ھنتے خوان اٿس اڑے ھکڑو چو تہ ذاکر
en: [...] will be there; no one will be ready to take his hand. 'Here we have come, no joke: the imam and the hajji have come, sir, that Brahui and another maulvi sahib.' He said to him, 'He has a father who prays, he has a reciter of the Quran.' Hey, one says, 'a zakir.'
en_old: There would be someone at the door, but nobody was ready to lend a hand. The ones who came here were the imam and the haji, sir, and the Brahui, and another maulvi sahib said, 'Are you one who prays? Do you pray?' And one says, 'a zakir.'

brh: اول مولوی تا بچے پان مولوی تا بچے، بچے تو توکھے بہ کھڑے نا نبھاگا، آہیں نماز نماز کو سوا زندگی نائے، کلمے کو سوا زندگی نائے، خدا جی سجدے کو سوا کائے زندگی نائے، بنی جہان جی بھلائی آہے تو نماز مین آ۔
en: First the maulvi has to be saved, the maulvi himself has to be saved! If he is saved, [will he save] you too, you wretch? It is prayer: without prayer there is no life, without the Kalima there is no life, without prostration to God there is no life at all; the good of both worlds lies in prayer.
en_old: First the maulvi's children, the maulvi's own children; the child would not... Without prayer there is no life, without the kalima there is no life, without bowing down to God there is no life. All the good in the world is in prayer.

brh: پاک محمد عربی جی سنت آ۔ آخری واعدو آ، آخری واعدو۔ چھوکری چھا ڪئی، پڻس آیو، پٽ، ہی ٽٻڙو کڻ، درے ۾ رکجائین، ہن ۾ سونو ہار آ، اہو جڏہن چوان مان ڪڍی ڏجانء۔
en: It is the sunnah of the holy Muhammad of Arabia. It is the last promise, the last promise. What did the girl do? Her father came: 'Child, pick up this basket and keep it in the niche. There is a gold necklace in it; when I tell you, take it out and give it [to me].'
en_old: It is the sunnah of the holy Muhammad, the Arab. It is the last promise, the last promise. What did the girl do? Her son came. 'Son, pick up this box and keep it by the door. There is a gold necklace in it. When I tell you, take it out and give it.'

brh: چوکرے منتھمے ہتہ وجان صاحب فرمائے بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم ایتاں چودہ بچان واری ذات کیرا بابا
en: The girl, putting her hand into it... the Sahib says, 'In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.' Here, who is the Being that saves, baba?
en_old: Boy, ... go, the sahib says, 'In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.' These fourteen children, whose turn is it, baba?

brh: اللہ جی ذات مئیں کے طاقت ناہیں بیماری دے اوہنجی مرضی تے بیمارن کے صحت دے اوہنجی مرضی کہیں گھر وارن مان کنیاڑی نہ دے اوہنجی مرضی ہکڑی گھر واری مان بارھاں پٹ
en: It is God's Being; no one [else] has power. Giving illness is His will, and giving health to the sick is His will; not giving even a little daughter to some households is His will; to one wife, twelve sons [is His will].
en_old: No one has power except God. Giving illness is His will, giving health to the sick is His will, not giving a daughter to some couples is His will, and giving twelve sons to one wife is His will.

brh: جوڑی دے مرضی طاقت رب سائیں جی آ، متاں بھلے، متاں رلے، متاں بھجے، متاں ڈوڑے، کہ جی ہتہ مین کا شے ناہی جو سب کچہ مٹھڑے اللہ جی ہتہ مین آ، چھوکری ویچاری جو
en: Giving a pair [of children]: the will and the power belong to the Lord. One may stray, one may wander, one may run, one may race about: nothing is in anyone's hands, because everything is in the hands of beloved Allah. The poor girl...
en_old: Giving a pair is the Lord's will and power. Maybe things go well, maybe they get lost, maybe they break, maybe they run off, because nothing is in one's own hands. Everything is in the hands of dear God. The poor girl...

brh: چپنے کہت ودی فرمائیں بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم چپنے کہت ودی کھڑی وئی منی کر اندر رکھی پنس تکے تہو سڑے پی سڑے تہو
en: She took off the lid, saying, 'In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful'; she took off the lid, went and put [her hand] inside. Her father watches, and he burns, he burns [with rage].
en_old: ... he says, 'In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful' ... he put the bread inside. His son looks, and it is burnt, it is burnt.

brh: جلدی مرے جان چھٹے بسم اللہ ونجے منہنجے گھر مان کلمو منہنجے گھر مان ونجے رب سائیں فرمایو این کون تھیندو نانگ چھا کندو نانگ منہنجے قبضے مین آ چھو تہ مخلوق منہنجی آ مان ہک اللہ جی ذات آ کینجی طاقت آ
en: 'Let her die quickly so I am rid of her; let Bismillah go from my house, let the Kalima go from my house.' The Lord said, 'It will not be so. What will the snake do? The snake is in my control, because the creatures are mine. I am the One, the Being of Allah; whose power is there [besides mine]?'
en_old: Hurry up, let it be over with. Bismillah, go from my house. The kalima: go from my house. The Lord said, 'Who will make this happen? What snake will eat? The snake is under my control, and the creatures are mine. I am the one God. Whose power is it?'

brh: اڄ تہ کڻی ہتی اعلان ٿیو آ مولانا عبدالفتاح صاحب وارن جماعت ہن ڳوٺ وارن سمورن ڀت ڪئی آ مانی ڪئی آ کائے ڍئو ڪری ویٺا آہیون روایت آ اللہ جو ہی پوری زندگی ڪنہن کارایو آ ڪا خبر پئی آ ڪنہن
en: Today, well, an announcement was made here: Maulana Abdul Fattah Sahib's people, the congregation, and all the people of this village have cooked rice and made bread, and we have eaten our fill and are sitting here. There is a narration: it is Allah's: who has fed [us] this whole life? Does anyone know who?
en_old: Today an announcement was made here. Maulana Abdul Fattah sahib's group and all the people of this village have made rice and made bread, and we are sitting here full. There is a narration: whom did God feed for his whole life? Does anyone know whom?

brh: کو جوار جی مانی، کو ڪڻڪ جی مانی، سائین کو گوگڙو سان، کو گوشت سان، کو دال سان، کو بسر سان، کو ڪیئن کو ڪیئن، پر ڇڙو ہی نہ، چئو پوری ڪائنات، پوری دنیا، سمندر جی اندر جیڪا مخلوق آ، انہن کے بہ رب سائین کارائی، نبی
en: Some [eat] sorghum bread, some wheat bread, sir; some with [unclear], some with meat, some with lentils, some with onion, some one way, some another. But not only this: say the whole universe, the whole world, the creatures inside the sea, the Lord feeds them too. The Prophet...
en_old: Some get sorghum bread, some wheat bread, sir; some with ..., some with meat, some with lentils, some with onion, some one way, some another. And not only this: the whole universe, the whole world, the creatures in the sea, the Lord feeds them too. The Prophet...

brh: دا دنیا رب سائیں موکلائے قران آہے، ئے بدھن کھپے، دسن کھپے، نبی جی زندگی دسو تا سہی، آخری واسطو کیا، سلیمان علیہ السلام کیر ہو بابا؟ داڈھیاں تھوڑا گالھایو، نبی، نبی ہویو نا؟ ہاں بس
en: The Lord sent [it] to this world: it is the Quran. It must be listened to, it must be told. Do tell [us] about the life of the Prophet. Last [question]: who was Solomon, peace be upon him, baba? Speak a little louder. A prophet, he was a prophet, wasn't he? Yes, that's it.
en_old: The Lord sent the Quran to this world. You should listen to it and you should tell it. Tell the life of the Prophet properly. The last ... Who was Solomon, peace be upon him, baba? Speak up a little louder. A prophet, he was a prophet, right? Yes, that's it.

brh: شاہ بے نبی وی بادشاہ بے بادشاہی وری کیڈی وڈی خبر تھوا ہوا تے حکم سلیمان نبی دے پکھیں پرندیں تے جنیں انسانیں تے پوری شے متو حکومت نبی سلیمان دے نبوت
en: A king too, a prophet too, a king too; and what a vast kingdom it was, you know! The wind was under the Prophet Solomon's command, and so were birds and fowl, jinn and humans; over everything was the rule of the Prophet Solomon, along with prophethood.
en_old: A king, a prophet and also a king, and with a kingdom too. What great news! The wind was under the command of the Prophet Solomon, and so were the birds, the jinn and the humans. Everything was under the rule and prophethood of the Prophet Solomon.

brh: دا بادشاہی ویا ہی بادشاہی ویا ہی جری حضرت سلیمان دسی ورتو ت نبوت م مکے آہے، پر بادشاہی م منجی وڈی آ، چے منجا رب چے جی سلیمان سے تھوڑو عرض آ قبول کرو، فرما سلیمان کہڑو عرض آ، سے منجو عرض ہکڑو آ
en: This kingship... the kingship... When Hazrat Solomon saw that 'I have prophethood, and my kingdom too is great,' he said, 'My Lord,' he said, 'Solomon has a small request; accept it.' [God] said, 'Solomon, what request is it?' He said, 'My request is one.'
en_old: This kingship... Hazrat Solomon said, 'I have prophethood, but my kingship is great.' He said, 'O my Lord, Solomon has a small request. Please accept it.' God said, 'Solomon, what request?' He said, 'My one request is...'

brh: مہربانی کاو مکھے اجازت دیو تہ مان پورو مہینو سجی مخلوق کے طعام کھارایاں اللہ فرمایو سلیمان ایو جیڑو سوال کر ٹھیک آ لیکن ایو کم تو کھاں چڑیل آ ایو تنجے حوالے نہ کندم مخلوق کے پریشان نہ کندم
en: 'Please give me permission to feed food to all the creatures for a whole month.' Allah said, 'Solomon, the request you make is fine, but this task is beyond you. I will not hand it over to you; I will not put the creatures in distress.'
en_old: 'Please give me permission to feed all the creatures for a whole month.' God said, 'Solomon, asking a question like this is fine, but where would this be possible? I will not hand this over to you. I will not trouble the creatures.'

brh: سائیں فرمائینو جی مہینوں نہ تو پندرہ ڈینہہ فرمائینو سائیں اٹھ ڈینہہ فرمائینو سائیں ہکڑو ڈینہہ فرمائینو جبل ہکڑو ویلو چٹھی سبحان اللہ ہکڑو ڈینہہ بنہ چو ڈینہہ بے
en: He said, 'Lord, if not a month, then fifteen days.' He said, 'Lord, eight days.' He said, 'Lord, one day.' [God] said, 'One meal: a permit.' Subhanallah! Not even one day, what days?
en_old: He said, 'If not a month, then fifteen days.' He said, 'Sir, eight days.' He said, 'Sir, one day.' Permission for one time, subhanallah. One day, not two days.

brh: ہکڑو ویل، جیسے ٹھیک، جیسے وارا مہربانی کر، مہنو مون کے اجازت دے، زما طعام تیار کر، سجی مخلوق جو ناشتو۔ چئے مہنو اجازت، مہنے کان پو وری طعام جنن کے سد کئی، دیون کے سد کئی۔
en: 'One meal; as You see fit, as suits You. Please give me a month's permission so I can prepare the food, the breakfast of all the creatures.' He said, 'A month: permission [granted].' After the month [was granted], he summoned the jinn for the food and summoned the demons.
en_old: 'One time, as You think right, as it suits You. Please give me permission for one day to prepare my feast, a breakfast for all the creatures.' God said, 'One day, permission granted.' After that day, he called the jinn for the food and called the demons.

brh: چئی تہ جھنگ ۾ وڃو، حلال جانور جیڪا ملیو سڀ کائے چوڪ ڪندا وڃو، نہ ھرڻی ڇڏیو، نہ سیڙھ ڇڏیو، نہ تتر ڇڏیو، نہ بٽیرو ڇڏیو جھنگ ۾، جنن کے ڪو ڏسی ئے نہ، تہ جنن کے ھاڻی
en: He said, 'Go into the jungle; whatever halal animals you find, keep clearing them all out. Don't leave a deer, don't leave a porcupine, don't leave a partridge, don't leave a quail in the jungle.' No one sees the jinn at all, and the jinn now...
en_old: He said, 'Go into the forest and slaughter every halal animal you find. Don't leave the deer, don't leave the porcupine, don't leave the partridge, don't leave the quail in the forest.' No one can see the jinn, and the jinn now...

brh: آتے جن کوڙ ویٺا آہن، قران ٻڌن ٿا، توہان ڏسو ٿا؟ پر ہڪڙی کے ٿورو پاسو ڏی نہ، او منہن ڏیکاریس پنہنجو، رب ڪعبہ جو قسم آتے ئے ڦٿڪی۔ ہن مس ماما آہی ہن، ہن مس ماما آہی، آتے ئے ڦٿڪی۔ جن جو ڀڄڻ جھنگ ۾، ہرڻین جی ڪڍ۔
en: Right here many jinn are sitting, listening to the Quran; do you see them? But if one just turned aside a little toward someone and showed him his face, by the Lord of the Kaaba, he would convulse right there. 'This is his uncle, this one; this is his uncle,' and he would convulse right there. The jinn ran into the jungle after the deer.
en_old: Many jinn are sitting here listening to the Quran, do you see? But one of them, he moved aside a little and showed his face. By the Lord of the Kaaba, they would jolt in fright. 'That one is my uncle, that one is my uncle,' and they would jolt. The jinn ran into the forest, after the deer.

brh: او ہرا نی داسہ ئے کنا ٹنگا کاوٹے لیٹ ہیمے چائے۔ بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم، بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم۔ ہا ملک ڈھیر کرے چھڑے۔ اینو سے سلیمان نبی جوڑے دیون کے چے کہ دیگی چاڑیو۔ دیگی تیار تھی دیون جی دسترخوان بچھایو۔ دسترخوان
en: Those deer... now... [garbled: legs... laid down...]. In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful; in the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Yes, they piled [them] up in heaps across the land. Then the Prophet Solomon told the demons, 'Put the cauldrons on [the fire].' The cauldrons were ready, and the demons spread the tablecloth. The tablecloth...
en_old: ... Bismillah, Bismillah. The wealth piled up. That day the Prophet Solomon told the demons to put the cooking pots on the fire. When the pots were ready, the demons spread the tablecloth. The tablecloth...
