brh: ہاڻو ڪیترو جو مہینی جی پنڌ تائین ڪیترو ابا مہینو جو ہڪڙو ایترو اسپیڊ سان جو نڪری تہ سبی تے ہیامان سان ڪو چاڪو پری ہلائی وینداسین اہو ملڪ سڄو دسترخوان انی تے طعام ہاریو طعام ہاریندا ویا وری ہوا
en: Now, how big? Up to a month's journey. How big, son? A month's [journey], at such speed that if one set out, to Sibi... with this [vehicle] we would drive a long way. That whole land was the tablecloth; they poured the food out on it, they kept pouring out food, then the wind...
en_old: Now how far? As far as a month's journey. How long, baba? A month's journey, at such speed that if it went out it would reach Sibi... we will take it far away. That whole land was the tablecloth, and they spread the food on it. They kept spreading the food, and then the wind...

brh: حکم کئی ٹھدی ہوا متھوں گھلیس، جی طعام خراب نہ تھے، ٹھدی ہوا ہلی پئی جھڑ ایئر کنڈیشن، طعام ٹھیک ٹھاک گوشتن جا مزا، بٹیرا، باڑو، ہرنیوں، سیاڑا، ہر قسم جو طعام، ہر شے متھوں موجود کلمے وارو۔
en: He gave the order and sent a cool wind over it, so that the food would not spoil. The cool wind kept blowing like air-conditioning. The food was just right: the flavors of meats, quail (bateer), quail (baaro), deer, porcupines, every kind of food; everything was there on it, O people of the Kalima.
en_old: He ordered a cool wind to blow over it so the food would not spoil, and the cool wind blew like an air conditioner. The food stayed fresh and fine: the taste of meat, quail, partridge, deer, every kind of food. Everything was there, O believer.

brh: مال، جانور، گھور، ئے مانی تیار تھی وئی، ہر شے تیار تھی وئی، پورو مہنو مانی تیار تھی، ڈھیر تھیا جو جبل وانگر ٹھئی پیا، او جی پہاڑ اوجن نا، ایئن لگیو ملکو سلیمان کے چئیں سائیں، ہانے دلجا کرے لت دے سمھ۔
en: Livestock, animals, horses: the food got ready, everything got ready. For a whole month the food was being prepared; there were such heaps that they stood like mountains, like those mountains over there. That is how it looked across the land. They said to Solomon, 'Sir, now rest easy; stretch out your legs and sleep.'
en_old: Livestock, animals, horses: the food was prepared, everything was prepared. A whole month's worth of food was prepared, and so much that it was piled up like a mountain, like those mountains. Then Solomon said, 'My Lord, now my heart is content, let it be.'

brh: یا رسول اللہ کل کا کنا سو ملنگ ٹی او لیکن ہچ دا غلطی کنا اف صرف ننا پینل کروڑ کے محمد زادے بس نی متنے کنا باوہ نی یکا کنا گرینگ تیک کنا لمہ نی بد دعا کیک کنا بلہ پیرہ غاک نی بد دعا کیک
en: O Messenger of Allah, everyone is [turning against] me (?), but none of this is my fault at all; it is only that I took your name, Muhammad [...]. My father [...] you, [...] me; my mother curses you, my old women and old men (elders) curse you.
en_old: O Messenger of God, everyone is against my... but none of this is my fault; only... Muhammad came, you did not... my father beats me, my brother hits me, my mother curses me, my elders curse me.

brh: مچو محلہ نا خلافے کل سیالاک ننے خلافو یا رسول اللہ ئے خلنگانوٹ ہمو تمپاری ٹی محمد کریم ء کاوا او تنہا محبوب نا چہرے وریو ارا محمد کن خلنگانوٹ او محبوب نا چہرے وریو او محبوب ء کلمہ خوانو او محمد نا مونا چورے
en: The whole neighborhood is against [me], all the relatives are against us. O Messenger of Allah, I have been beaten. At that time (?) I go to Muhammad the Generous and, alone, [gaze upon] the beloved's face; I have been beaten for Muhammad's sake, and I [gaze upon] the beloved's face, and I recite the beloved's kalima, and [...] before Muhammad.
en_old: The whole neighborhood is against us, all the relatives are against us. O Messenger of God, they beat me, because in that darkness I go to Muhammad the Generous; alone, I came to see the beloved's face. For Muhammad they beat me; I come to see the beloved's face; I recite the beloved's kalima and stand before Muhammad.

brh: یا رسول اللہ خن کنے پدی مزار ئس کنے پدی مزار تھپا کنے درو مزار جوڑ مزار دا خطا کنے نار خف نہ خلک کنے نار چہرے کنے برابر مزار نا دیدار کلنگ تول یا رسول اللہ کنے زو کرے کلمہ خوان فی مسلمان مرے
en: O Messenger of Allah, look at me: behind me there is a [mark? 'mazar'] [...] yesterday [...] was made [...] this fault is mine; [they] struck me on the ear (?), my face [...] the sight of [...]. O Messenger of Allah, quickly make me recite the kalima so that I may become a Muslim.
en_old: O Messenger of God, look, after me a shrine... after me a shrine was set; a shrine was built for me. This was the fault... they beat me, my face... to see the shrine sit beside me. O Messenger of God, he quickly made me recite the kalima and become a Muslim.

brh: سبحان اللہ۔ او ننا پیرنگان نکے دا مار کوتہ خوانک، پاڑے ارٹمی کلمہ خوان۔ ئے براہوئی سس پی کلمہ سا دا سے ٹی کلمہ بادشاہی چاکو دوٹی تسنو۔
en: Glory be to God. And our elders would make us little boys recite this; they said, 'Recite the second kalima.' Hey, a Brahui [...], say [which] kalima [...]: in this, the kalima has given kingship into the hands of servants (?).
en_old: Glory be to God. Our elders used to recite this to us; say, recite the second kalima. A Brahui... the kalima of kingship was given into his hands.

brh: شرمم بفکتا گانی دوٹی تفوکو ہاں سئیں حارث ہمشاہو گٹ پنچ ہزاریو لکٹی تا اولی کلمے بے مزا مزا خوان لا الہ لا استاد مزا مزا تیز خوان پا کلمے بے تیز خوان پا نی حیا بفکتا
en: Aren't you ashamed, holding [...] in your hand? 'Yes, sir.' Haris (?), [...] five thousand [...] lakhs [...]. Recite the first kalima nicely, nicely: 'La ilaha [illa...]'. Teacher, [...] nicely, nicely; recite it fast, say the kalima, recite it fast, say it! Aren't you ashamed?
en_old: Aren't you ashamed, with a mobile phone in your hand? Yes, sir, Haris, the same... five thousand, in lakhs... the first kalima, recite it with feeling, with feeling: 'There is no god but...' Teacher, with feeling, recite it quickly, say the kalima, recite it quickly. Have you no shame?

brh: نی کلمہ یاد بپک، نی کلمہ یاد بپک، مسلمان او، مسلمان کلمہ یاد کپک، مسلمان درود یاد کپک، مسلمان نماز نا رکعات آتے خبر اف، کسے برزا کا، پیشی نا رکعات آک مسافری ٹی اخہ رکعات مریرہ، استاد
en: You don't remember the kalima, you don't remember the kalima, and [you are] a Muslim! A Muslim who has not memorized the kalima, a Muslim who has not memorized the durood, a Muslim who doesn't know about the rak'ats of prayer! Get someone up: how many rak'ats are the afternoon (Zuhr) rak'ats when traveling? Teacher...
en_old: You don't remember the kalima, you don't remember the kalima, and you are a Muslim! A Muslim who doesn't remember the kalima, a Muslim who doesn't remember the durood, a Muslim who doesn't know the rak'ats of prayer. Ask anyone: how many rak'ats are the afternoon prayers while traveling? Teacher...

brh: مسافر، دا کنے خبر اف استاد، ایمان نا توش بر، ایمان سے نی داغ ء بلو، ہوش اسہ داغ چنک مروک، نی نماز نا خبر اف، نی سفر نا خبر اف
en: 'Traveler... I don't know this, teacher.' Bring the provisions of faith; [with] faith your stain [becomes] big [...], awareness [...] a stain that becomes small [...]. You don't know about prayer, you don't know about travel.
en_old: Traveler — I don't know this, teacher. Bring the strength of faith; with faith you will make this mark big, awareness is a small mark. You don't know about prayer, you don't know about travel.

brh: نی لمہ نا خبر نی باوہ نا حیا نا خبر نی قران تے پیسہ نی دین تے پیسہ نی حلال تے پیسہ لیکن حلال حرام کل اسٹ ئے شام نا بس توفنگے ڈیوٹی کرے چھٹی ڈیوٹی کرے ہنا دوزخی دریا خوری نا اندر دوزخی
en: You [care nothing] about your mother, about your father's honor; to you the Quran is money, religion is money, halal is money, but halal and haram are all one [to you]. In the evening [he takes] the bus (?), did his duty, did holiday duty, and went off, hell-bound, into hellish [drinking?], hell-bound.
en_old: You care nothing for your mother, nothing for your father's honor. You sell the Quran, you sell your religion, you sell what is halal, as if halal and haram were all the same. In the evening he gets off the bus, he has done his duty, done his off-duty shift, and off he goes into the hellish river of drinking, into hell.

brh: خبر تین پی سا عزرائیل ننا کٹ او اینکے دزی زیر گلنے کشوئے ئے دزی کے کاوا وا باوہ لمہ خیرات او چنا ہر دے امپا بندغ کاٹ پنچ دے گا شش دے گا ہر دے امپا پنچ دے گا جائز ء دا باوہ نا نصیحت آک پنچ دے گا
en: Do you know [when] Azrael [will be] at our bedside, [...] to pull [the soul] out from under [...]? [...] father, mother, charity, and child; every day [...] a person [...] five [...], six [...], every day [...] five [...]; it is permissible; these are the father's counsels: five [...].
en_old: Do you know when Azrael will come to us? ... the father, the mother, charity, and the child; every day... a person five times a day, six times a day, every day... five times a day is permissible; these are the father's counsels, five times a day.

brh: کہ دروغ ہر دیر پا دا پتو کہ مسڑ سے دا خو کنا محبوب نا مونی زونڈانے رحمت اللعالمین سرغتے دوئی خوشکا خڑکرتے تھینن الحمدللہ حضور کلمہ خوان فیتہ دا مسڑ کو کلمہ خوانا اور پکا ہم مسڑ نا کلمہ پکا ہم مسڑ نا
en: [If anyone calls it] a lie [...], [know] that this little girl is the one who sat before my beloved. The Mercy to the Worlds stroked her head with his hand and drew her close (?). Alhamdulillah, the Prophet had her recite the kalima; this little girl recited the kalima, and the girl's kalima was firm too, firm too was the girl's.
en_old: Whoever lies... see, this girl is in front of my beloved. The Mercy to the Worlds took her head and held her close. Alhamdulillah, the Prophet had the girl recite the kalima, and the girl's kalima was firm, truly firm.

brh: حضور صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم وعظ و تبلیغ کرے ہراتن کہ ما بش مسسنا صحابہ غراتن بش مسسور چونکہ مسڑکو تولوک ہمودے اوتے حضور کہ بش مس تو میدان خالی مس مسڑکو نا خندن خڑنگ
en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) preached and gave his sermon. When he stood up, the companions stood up too; the little girl stayed sitting there. When the Prophet stood up, the field became empty, and the little girl's eyes [filled with] tears.
en_old: The Prophet (peace be upon him) preached and gave his sermon. When he rose, the companions rose too. The girl was still sitting there. When the Prophet rose, the field became empty, and the girl's eyes were watching.

brh: اوغنگ ء شروع کرے ثابث بزبرے چھنا دے خلکن ننے انتئے اوغسہ پیکن ء خلتنے کسس ئے محمد کریم کن اوغوہ ارا تنکن محبوب کرے بروک کنا خنتہ کھڑی خا ختہ برو ئے محمد
en: She started crying. Thabit (?) said, 'Child, [...] did they beat you? Why are you crying? Has anyone hit you?' [She said,] 'I am crying for Muhammad the Generous, whom [God] made His beloved; [...] my eyes [long for him] [...]; come, O Muhammad.'
en_old: She started to cry. Thabit said, 'Child, why are you crying? They beat us...' She said, 'I cry for Muhammad the Generous, whom I have loved. My eyes long for him. Come, O Muhammad.'

brh: حضور نا زیارت کن زہیر کرینو حضور ارا خنا مرے زہیر کپک نم زہیر اریرے یافک ابا ارا تم دا عمرہ والاک دا حاجی حج کارا حضور نا روضہ غان تو جپیرہ قبر مبارک آن تو جپیرہ ہر رفیق انت کہ داسہ انت خنیسہ
en: Have you longed to see the Prophet? Whoever has seen the Prophet, does he not long for him? Do you long [for him]? [...], dear, when these Umrah pilgrims, these hajis perform the Hajj, they [cling?] to the Prophet's shrine, they [cling?] to the blessed grave; every companion [asks]: what is it now, what do you see?
en_old: Have you longed to see the Prophet? The Prophet whom the eyes long for. Do you long for him? Father, when these Umrah pilgrims and Hajj pilgrims kiss the Prophet's shrine, when they kiss the blessed grave, every companion... what do you see now?

brh: الصلوۃ والسلام علیک یا رسول اللہ، اللھم سل علی، داسکہ حضور ء خواناس، او نگن حضرت ابوبکر سلوک ء پی خنے بے ہر، ئے محمد نا وار زندگی کیترے پھیرؤٹ، انگن حضرت عمر سلوک ء پی خنے تو پیغمبر تینٹ خواہش خدا غان کہ عمر ء مسلمان کا۔
en: Blessings and peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah; O Allah, send blessings upon [him]. Now that you have invoked [blessings on] the Prophet: if you look at Hazrat Abu Bakr's conduct, [you will see] he [spent?] his whole life around Muhammad; and if you look at Hazrat Umar's conduct, the Prophet himself asked of God that He make Umar a Muslim.
en_old: Peace and blessings be upon you, O Messenger of Allah. O Allah, send blessings. Until now the Prophet called him. When you look at the conduct of Hazrat Abu Bakr, he spent his whole life around Muhammad. When you look at the conduct of Hazrat Umar, the Prophet himself asked God to make Umar a Muslim.

brh: ایتنا زندگی محمد کن قربان کرے رب کائنات نا قسم ئے اوفتا قباراتے راتم نظر کیتھم مکنا نا جہان نا ارادہ غاک نا خیالاک نا دیل من چنکو مسٹ سے حضور اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نا درواہ کھڑکا فیر وہ
en: He sacrificed his own life for Muhammad. By the Lord of the universe, when I look at their [graves?] [...] the intentions and thoughts of [...] the world [...]. A little girl knocked at the door of the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him).
en_old: He sacrificed his life for Muhammad. By the Lord of the universe, their graves at night... the intentions and thoughts of the world... A little girl knocked at the door of the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him).

brh: حضور پئے تمہ پئے خیر ء، پئے سے مسٹ کوغنی یا رسول اللہ، پارے صحابی اوغکا تہ خشک کرو کئی محمد کریم اٹ، چنا تہ خشک کرو کئی محمد کریم ببہ ئے تینٹ ہمبرے وا، پیغمبر تینٹ بس مسٹ کوغنی پارے چنا
en: The Prophet [said], 'What has happened? Is all well?' 'A little girl is crying (?), O Messenger of Allah.' The companion said, 'Her tears will be dried by Muhammad the Generous; the child's tears will be dried by Muhammad the Generous.' [...] he himself [came out]: the Prophet himself came to the little girl and said, 'Child...'
en_old: The Prophet said, 'What is it? Is everything well?' 'A girl is crying, O Messenger of Allah.' The companion said, 'Dry her tears, for the sake of Muhammad the Generous. Dry the child's tears.' The Prophet came out himself and said to the girl, 'Child...'

brh: نی تو مخ الحمدللہ، نی جنت ملا، نی کلمہ ملا، دوزخ آن بچاس، او یا رسول اللہ مخنگ الے کرے لیکن اوغے وا، پارے چنا دا اوغے سا، پی کلمہ بو قربان مریو، کنا باوہ
en: 'Laugh, Alhamdulillah! Paradise has opened for you, you have received the kalima, you have been saved from hell.' And [she said], 'O Messenger of Allah,' and [tried to] laugh, but cried again. He said, 'Child, why are you crying now?' [She said,] 'May I be sacrificed for the kalima, [but] my father...'
en_old: 'You laughed, Alhamdulillah. You have gained paradise, you have gained the kalima, you have been saved from hell.' She said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I laughed.' But then she cried. He said, 'Child, why are you crying now?' She said, 'May I be sacrificed for the kalima, but my father...'

brh: باوہ و راٹی کسف کنے ئے کلمہ خوانے وا کنا زندگی ختم مرے خلکے سرمروہ باوہ کنے کسف کک ہمو نی کوغہ و کہ باوہ کنے خلک ئے کلمہ نا دشمن پائے نا پن ہلن کنے شمات خلکونے کلمہ ئے ہلن کپرا
en: 'My father and [the people] at home will kill me; if I recite the kalima, my life will end. They beat me, [and] I [will be finished?]. My father will kill me. [...] because my father beats me; he is an enemy of the kalima; he says, don't take your name; he has beaten me [badly]; [but] I cannot give up the kalima.'
en_old: 'My father and the people at home will kill me for reciting the kalima. My life will end. They beat me and I am worn out. My father will kill me. My father beats me and calls me an enemy of the kalima. He has whipped me to make me give up the kalima, but I will not give it up.'

brh: ضرور اراٹی خوانوا باوہ کنے خلیک اسفکک جنت تو ملیک لیکن نا دیدار نا مزہ جتا ہی ئے جنت نا مالم نا دیدار نا سیر کرتنوٹ کنا دلبر نبی باوہ ہموکے باوہ کنے خلیک حضور پارا چنا گنتی کپہ انو جوانو وظیفہ سے دیونے ہمو وظیفہ
en: 'I will certainly recite it at home. My father beats me; [if] he kills me, paradise will open for me, but the joy of seeing you is something else; [...] I have not had my fill of seeing you, my beloved Prophet. [It is my] father who beats me.' The Prophet said, 'Child, don't worry; I will give you a good litany (wazifa), that litany...'
en_old: 'I will certainly keep reciting at home. My father beats me, and if he kills me I will gain paradise, but the joy of seeing you is something else. I have not had my fill of seeing you, my beloved Prophet. My father beats me.' The Prophet said, 'Child, do not worry. I will give you a good litany (wazifa), that litany...'

brh: پیراتی خوان ارادے نا سوان، نہ باونے خلنگ کیک، نہ دشمن دشمنی کیک، اللہ نا دیرڑ غیبی مدد کیک۔ سبحان اللہ۔ فارس صاحب بابو کرے، حضور سئیں بسم اللہ خوانفتے۔ انت ابا؟ خوام بہ سختہ بسم اللہ۔
en: 'Recite it with intention [...]; then neither will your father be able to beat you, nor will an enemy harm you; Allah will give [you] unseen help.' Subhanallah. Faris Sahib (?) [...]: 'O Prophet, sir, teach [me] Bismillah.' 'What is it, dear?' 'I want to learn Bismillah.'
en_old: Recite it with intention, morning and evening. Then your father will not be able to beat you and your enemy will not be able to harm you; Allah will send unseen help. Subhanallah. Faris Sahib said, 'O Prophet, teach me Bismillah.' 'What is it, father?' 'I want to learn Bismillah.'

brh: بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم استاد محمد رسول آ تو شاگرد چنکا مسڑ کوئی پارے چنا خوان بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم
en: Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim. The teacher was Muhammad the Messenger and the pupil a little girl. He said, 'Child, recite: Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim.'
en_old: Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim. The teacher was Muhammad the Messenger, and the student was a little girl. He said, 'Child, recite: Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim.'

brh: چونکا چنا بسم اللہ خوانا پرچنا اوراٹی نا سنگت کاری مسکرے اول بسم اللہ خوان دشمن دشمنی کنے کپک مسڑ کو کلمے م یاد کرے بسم اللہ م یاد کرے اوراٹی سر مس نی کلمے م خواننٹی بسم اللہ م خواننٹی
en: The little child recited Bismillah [...] the people of the house [...]: 'First I recite Bismillah, [then] the enemy cannot harm me.' The little girl memorized the kalima too and memorized Bismillah too. When she got home [they said], 'You are reciting the kalima too, reciting Bismillah too!'
en_old: When the child recited Bismillah, the people at home were taken aback. 'First I recite Bismillah, and then no enemy can harm me.' The girl learned the kalima by heart and learned Bismillah by heart. The people at home got fed up: 'You keep reciting the kalima, you keep reciting Bismillah.'

brh: ئے نمے نرفیوہ مچو دے ٹی کلمہ یاد ارے نمے نماز ٹی او اذان ملے یا نماز خوان بے ہیت سے ورنہ کلمہ بس یاد اف درود نا خبر اف نمے کہ درود امرے اور کلمہ امرے بسم اللہ امرے خواری نا بے دینی رزق چھن
en: I ask you: over the whole day, do you remember the kalima? [Only] in prayer and when the call to prayer [is given], or when you pray [...]; otherwise you don't remember the kalima at all. You don't know the durood; you don't know what the durood is, what the kalima is, what Bismillah is. The misery of irreligion: [your] livelihood [is snatched away].
en_old: I ask you: on how many days do you remember the kalima? You only come across it in prayer and in the call to prayer, or when you pray, and otherwise you don't remember the kalima at all. You don't know what durood is, what the kalima is, what Bismillah is. Wretchedness, irreligion, the blessing taken from your livelihood...

brh: او مس تو بنا بسم اللہ ء خوانے تا بلکہ اسو ئے کرر ہوس او مسہ کنے بٹالو بٹالو مس بیمرازو نی قدوس بس گڑا بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم ننے رک مریسے ہو ڈاکٹر پارے نی ہنا بٹالو بیمرازو گھومپیس
en: And so she would begin by reciting Bismillah, and even [again and again?] [...]. [He said,] 'I am going crazy (?), crazy [...] sick (?) [...] Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim [...] we are [restricted?].' The doctor said, 'You have gone crazy (?), you wander around sick (?).'
en_old: When it happened, she would recite Bismillah first, and then again and again. He said, 'I am going crazy, crazy... Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim, we are fed up with it.' The doctor said, 'You have gone crazy, you are wandering around like a madman.'

brh: ایٹ نہ سوکن پارینیتہ پی امروسوس مرے ڈاکٹر پاریندو کن وگدان غہ رکہ لا جلسہ مرے کمی دہ شکارپورے اوڑا سد یوکن ایم سد پیرو برہ مولوی علی شیری بخیرات بب بخیرات آ او چندہ کہ ذریعہ دا سیر تا سٹی
en: [...] said [...] the doctor said [...] a gathering (jalsa) will be held [...] in Shikarpur [...] Maulvi Ali Sheri [...] through charity and donations [...] this [...].
en_old: I said... the doctor said... a gathering will be held... in Shikarpur... Maulvi Ali Sheri came... through charity and donations... this city...

brh: ایسے نراگ کوئی مولی عریشہ کنا طبیعت باز خراب ئے ڈاکٹر کنے رگ کرے نی پمبے دیر ئس کونگٹ پھدا ملئے وا، اللہ بچپوئے نی ماما، دیر دم کیوت ئے وننت پھدا ملیس پش ئے
en: [...] a maulvi (?) [said]: 'My health is very bad; the doctor [...] me; [...] drinking some water [will] benefit [you] (?).' 'May Allah save you, uncle; I will blow a prayer over water for you, you will get benefit [...].'
en_old: One night Maulvi Arisha said, 'My health is very bad. The doctor gave me an injection...' 'May Allah protect you, uncle. I'll recite over some water and blow on it for you...'

brh: مجبوری سے رے سورے بوری سے رے وڑم اوتھریت کنے، منا کننگ کن ضرور الینا، لیکن دین نا کاریم مسلمان پدی اور اینو اینو پوا دا مدرسہ سے اف، مدرسہ سے نا، چناتا دستار بندی مرے رہ مفسا، ئنا معصومہ چنانا استے اگر نیورے
en: There is compulsion, there is necessity [...]; we certainly have to [work] for [a living], but in the work of religion Muslims are behind. And today, today there is not a madrasa; [if there is] a madrasa, [whether] the children's turban-tying (graduation) [ceremony] happens or not [...]; if you [...] the hearts of these innocent children...
en_old: There is compulsion, there is need; surely you have to work for a living, but in the work of religion Muslims are lagging behind. And today, today there isn't even a madrasa... at the madrasa, the children's turban-tying (graduation) ceremony is held... if you put your hand on the heads of innocent children...

brh: دا خزرسے اور سیسی پارہ تٹی۔ نا زنا مہربانی با خدانہ۔ او بے چپ مس، مسر کوسے، لیکن محبوب نا مونا زنڈانے بسم اللہ یاد کرے، کلمہ یاد کرے اور اونا سر مس، ئے بے ہمراہ شوننگا باوت مس۔ پر مسر کو!
en: This [...] and in a sipara (section of the Quran) [...]. Your [...] kindness [...] of God. And she fell silent, a little girl, but she had sat before the beloved, had memorized Bismillah, memorized the kalima, and she reached home [...] became [...]. But the little girl!
en_old: This is a story... it is God's grace upon her. She went silent, the little girl did, but in front of the beloved she remembered Bismillah, she remembered the Kalima, and it reached her heart... But the little girl!

brh: بجی ابا پرمسڑ کو دیرت کنکے ملا زور پہ ہوبا رزانی ڈوٹی کرے پرے بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم
en: [Then] father [said] to the little girl, '[Give] me water [...]'; [...] she put [it] in [his] hand and said, 'Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim.'
en_old: Then the father went to the girl and asked for water... she said, 'Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim.'

brh: دا دل و دیر جھلو پر بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم، باوہ دن پین کے دا بسم اللہ خواننگ ٹی، باوہ دن پین کے ضرور دا محمد نا سبق دادے بسونے، انن مسڑ کو
en: [She] held this [...] and the water, [saying] 'Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim'. The father [thought]: what is in this reciting of Bismillah? The father [thought]: surely this lesson of Muhammad has reached her, such a little girl.
en_old: This heart and this water... upon 'Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim'. The father said, what is this in reciting Bismillah? The father said, surely this lesson of Muhammad has reached her, this little girl.

brh: ایمان تازہ مرے قران اٹ، پھڈ تازہ مرے کننگ اٹ، ہندا ڈبہ، دا سدھ ارا غٹ کن گورے، دا سگار مولانا عبدالفیض صاحب اعلان کیک سائیں الحمدللہ پانزدہ
en: Faith is refreshed by the Quran, and the stomach is refreshed by eating. This very box... this ..., which ... for everyone ... Maulana Abdul Faiz Sahib is announcing, sir: praise be to God, fifteen...
en_old: Faith is refreshed by the Quran, the stomach is refreshed by eating; this same box... this is for everyone... Maulana Abdul Faiz Sahib announces, sir, praise be to Allah, fifteen...

brh: دیگ بسنو دغرت ٹانگا کمتٹی اوتھا بسوکو او اینا مے پاو کونیر نمت نا کھیر کاوڑینگے ہرا ڈٹو سا مڑے من پشس کونے نا منا باخو کونین اوتے کونگورے دیگ
en: The cooking pots have come ... on the ground ... in the committee ... they came ... and they say, 'Eat' ... the kheer of blessing ... which ... whoever eats a piece ... let us eat a morsel ... them ... the pot.
en_old: The pot came... it came into the kitchen... the milk of blessing was boiled, which... the pot.

brh: آتے ریڈے فیر واللہ اعلان مرے بیست دے داں زردانہ بسونو ایروم کھونے روکھوم فیر ارا انینو ہا انینو کھونینا سیر کیسہ یکہ کھونیسہ پھڈ سیر ایتئے
en: ... Then, by God, it is announced: twenty ... of zarda (sweet rice) have come so far ... eat ... then ... we eat and get full; eating alone, it fills the stomach.
en_old: Then, by God, it was announced: for twenty days now... then the stomach would be filled... you will be satisfied.

brh: خوننگٹ است سیر آتے تترہ است سیر آتے تسا دا اللہ نا ذکر اللہ نا قران سبحان اللہ دا خا تکلیف کمبو کافراک میٹنگ کریر اللہ سئیں پارے واذ یمکر بک الذین کفرو لیثبتوک او یقتلوک او
en: By reading [it], it fills the heart; it fills the heart. This is the remembrance of God, the Quran of God, glory be to God. This ... trouble ... the unbelievers held a meeting. God the Lord said: 'And when those who disbelieved plotted against you, to restrain you or kill you or...'
en_old: At meals he fed some until they were full and gave to others. This is the remembrance of God, the Quran of God, Subhan Allah. When they could not lessen his suffering, the unbelievers held a meeting. God the Lord said: "And when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or..."

brh: پئے بابا داسہ میٹنگ ئس کیمون دا محمد عربی تو مقابلہ کین اڑے نمنتا
en: 'So, man, let's hold a meeting now; let us take on this Muhammad of Arabia.' Hey, ...
en_old: So, father, let us hold a meeting now. How can we stand up to this Muhammad of Arabia? We are no match for him.

brh: کیرے مقابلہ کن محبوب تون کہ خدا اور تونا وار۔ نمان مقابلہ۔ میٹنگ کریر، کوٹی سیٹی زلدار، ہکڑے کمرے مین سب سردار گجی پیا، چنگا مڑس کمرے مین گجی پیا۔
en: Who can compete with the Beloved, when God is with him? You are no match. They held a meeting: the mansion-owners, the merchants, the wealthy; all the chiefs gathered in one room, the prominent men gathered in the room.
en_old: They set out to compete with the Beloved, as if it were God's turn and yours. They held a meeting: the chiefs and the wealthy gathered together in one room, the leading men gathered in one room.

brh: اڙی دروازو بند ڪیو، پاڻ ۾ میٽنگ ڪیو ٿا، ڪنہن جی خلاف؟ جنہن مٽی محمد عربی ﷺ جی خلاف، او سہڻا تنہنجی صبر تان مان قربان وڃان، سہڻا تنہنجی اخلاق تان مان قربان وڃان، سہڻا تنہنجی عادتن تان مان قربان وڃان، سہڻا تنہنجی گہم
en: Hey, they shut the door and are holding a meeting among themselves. Against whom? Against Muhammad of Arabia ﷺ. O beautiful one, may I be sacrificed for your patience; beautiful one, may I be sacrificed for your character; beautiful one, may I be sacrificed for your ways; beautiful one, your walk...
en_old: Brother, they closed the door and held a meeting among themselves. Against whom? Against Muhammad of Arabia ﷺ. O beautiful one, may I be sacrificed for your patience, may I be sacrificed for your character, may I be sacrificed for your habits, O beautiful one, for your gait...

brh: سوہنا تہا قربان ونجاں، سوہنا تہا گھمن سبن کون نرالو، سوہنا تہا وہن سبن کون نرالو، پر بدھو کنارے جا مسلمانو خدا جی ذات جو قسم کافی دشمن محبوب جو چہرو مبارک دسی کرے جو کلمو پڑھی مسلمان تھی ویا
en: O beautiful one, may I be sacrificed for you; beautiful one, your walk is unlike anyone's; beautiful one, your sitting is unlike anyone's. But listen, O Muslims: I swear by God's own being, many enemies, on seeing the Beloved's blessed face, recited his kalima and became Muslims.
en_old: O beautiful one, may I be sacrificed for you. O beautiful one, your gait is unlike anyone's, your ways are unlike anyone's. But listen, O Muslims, by the essence of God, many enemies saw the blessed face of the Beloved, recited the kalima and became Muslims.

brh: ہکڑی ننڈڑی چھوکری دا خمس قس بدو بار باراڑی مے رہندا جبلن مے ایتری چھوکری پر سارو خاندان ننڈھا وڈا صبح شام حضور سئیں دے گلا کندا ہا ئے بد دعا
en: A tiny little girl, about five or six, ... lived out in the wilds, in the mountains; such a little girl, but her whole family, young and old, would speak ill of the Holy Master morning and evening, and curse him.
en_old: There was a little girl, five or six years old, who lived in the mountains. She was such a little girl, but her whole family, young and old, spoke ill of the Holy Master morning and evening and cursed him.

brh: کندا شکست کندا، اہو ڪاڏو آیو آسان کے مڪی کان محروم ڪیو ٿئی، نہ تہ آسان روز مڪی وڃڻ وارا، آسان کے تباہ ڪیو ٿئی، زوری ٿو ماڻہن کے مسلمان ڪندو وتی، پوء لات و عزی کے بتن کے سڏیندا ہا، انہی کے ختم ڪیو محمد عربی کے ختم ڪیو اہو ہو
en: ... [they would say,] 'He will defeat us. Where has he come from? He has cut us off from Mecca, when we used to go to Mecca every day. He has ruined us; he goes around forcing people to become Muslims.' Then they would call on the idols Lat and Uzza: 'Finish him off, finish off Muhammad of Arabia!' That is how it was.
en_old: "...he would defeat us. Where did he come from? He has kept us out of Mecca, when we used to go to Mecca every day. He has ruined us. He forces people to become Muslims. We used to call on the idols Lat and Uzza, and he has put an end to that. Finish off Muhammad of Arabia," that was...

brh: او چے نا رب سا فرماؤ اللہ تو سا کچہ نہ ہی سب کچہ مین خدا پاک سبحان اللہ تو ننڈو ننڈی چھوکری وی گھر مین ہنجو پیو گھٹ ود گالائے پی حضور سئیں جی شان مین چھوکری صرف اترو ئے پچھاکیو سے جی بابا دے خبر تو سہی ایہو محمد عربی جی کے تو گھٹ ود
en: Oh, what the Lord says: there is nothing but God; holy God is in everything, glory be to God. So the little girl was at home; her father spoke very insultingly about the honor of the Holy Master. The girl asked only this much: 'Dear father, just tell me, this Muhammad of Arabia, whom you speak so ill of...'
en_old: Oh, what does the Lord say? God, you are nothing and everything is God. Pure God, Subhan Allah. There was a little girl at home whose father spoke very badly of the Holy Master. The girl only asked, "Dear father, do you even know who this Muhammad of Arabia is, that you speak so badly of him..."

brh: ڳالھائی ٿو اہو ڪری آسان جی محلی ۾ آیو آ چئین وری تون محلی جی لاء ٿو چوین محلی ۾ اچے ہا تہ گڏھ وانگو ماریونس ہا ٺڪا ڇوڪری کے چمبو ڏئی تہ محمد ڪریم جو نالو ورتوئی ڇو سبحان اللہ جیئن
en: [He] speaks: 'That's because he has come into our neighborhood.' She said: 'So you are saying it because of the neighborhood?' 'If he came into the neighborhood, we would beat him like a donkey.' Smack! He slapped the girl: 'Why did you take the name of Muhammad the Generous?' Glory be to God, as soon as...
en_old: He kept talking: "He has come into our neighborhood." She said, "Then why do you say that about the neighborhood?" "If he came into the neighborhood I would beat him like a donkey." Then he slapped the girl: "Why did you say the name of Muhammad the Generous?" Subhan Allah, just as...

brh: نڑی کے کمبو لگو تے متھوں ہدایت جی درے بہ کھلی ہدایت رب کرے متھوں ہدایت جی درے کھلی چھوکری زمین تے گری پی روان لگے پر دل مین چئے انشاءاللہ اللہ کرے منہنجو بابو کادے ونجے
en: As soon as the slap struck the girl, the doors of guidance opened from above too; the Lord grants guidance; the doors of guidance opened from above. The girl fell to the ground and began to cry, but in her heart she said: 'God willing, may God make my father go away somewhere.'
en_old: When the slap struck the girl, the doors of guidance opened from above. May the Lord grant guidance. The doors of guidance opened from above. The girl fell to the ground and began to cry, but in her heart she said, "God willing, may God let my father go to him..."

brh: سویرے بھجی کرے پن محمد عربی نا زیارت کنا جنے گرمو کے چمبو لگو آ ابا کنے شاماتس خلقونے کنا خف اب سو ملنگ ٹی کنا مون ہم سو ملنگ ٹی ابا کنے خلقونے محمد کریم نا پن کے
en: Early in the morning, running off to the sight of Muhammad of Arabia; my body is hot where the slap struck: 'Father hit me in the evening; my ear is still burning, and my face is burning too; Father hit me for the name of Muhammad the Generous.'
en_old: Early in the morning he hurried out... the vision of Muhammad of Arabia... my girl was slapped... "Father, you hit me in the evening. My sleep was gone and my face was burning. Father, you hit me for saying the name of Muhammad the Generous."

brh: دا سکھ باوکنا پیشن کائے شام یمن واپار کائے ئے وعدہ کیوا ہیتن اورار پیشن تمنا کعبہ مکہ ہیتن محمدر بین دیدار کیوا اللہ اللہ سئیں پارے نبینا دشمن نی شام
en: This ... my father goes out, goes to Syria and Yemen to trade. I make this promise: when he goes out, my wish is the Kaaba, Mecca; then I will behold Muhammad. God, God, sir! [She] said: 'Enemy of the Prophet, you [go to] Syria...'
en_old: ...the father went out to Syria and Yemen to trade... a promise was made... my wish is the Kaaba and Mecca, to see Muhammad... God, God the Lord said: the Prophet's enemy, you, Syria...

brh: دا تے خلقونی اینے جنت نا خواجہ کے ہدایت کرو کا خدائے باوہ پگ پر چھنائی کاوا پی باوہ رام کاسا پی شام کاوا پار نوستی پی پاڑ نا پٹنگا مونگ در ئے زیبائنگا محمد نا دیدارے توکے
en: '... you have struck this one' ... God will guide [him] to the master of Paradise ... Father, tomorrow ... I am going ... 'Father, are you going?' ... 'I am going to Syria' ... seeking ... the beautiful ... the sight of Muhammad...
en_old: "...you hit me..." Guidance from the master of paradise... the father with his turban... went in the evening... to see Muhammad...

brh: مسڑ قوم جو ننا مسڑ کو کہ داخل مس دائرہ غا چاپ خلک سمجھا نہ سمجھو با وتو خیرات ہرتین مسڑ کے این غنہ الحمد یاد اف مسڑی داس کنا دا غوز مسونے الحمد یاد افتا او انو نو الو خلکے
en: A girl of the community, our little girl: when she entered the circle, she clapped; whether she understood or not ... charity ... the girl: '... I don't remember the Alhamd'; the girl: 'now this has become ... for me'; she doesn't remember the Alhamd ... and ... struck [her].
en_old: ...the women of the people... when she entered the circle... understand or don't understand... charity... praise be to God, I don't remember... this has happened to me... they don't remember the praise...

brh: لمہ تہم خل تنے زندگی چے دے سمجھا لمہ ہم گلا نی بابہ ہم گلا نی بلہ بتی رو دے دانگنے خیرات اللہ کھنا سایا نا ڈیشہ گیشینو کھارم سے الو خلے گیشینو الو
en: Mother ... understand your own life ... Mother too is complaining, father too is complaining ... charity, God ... the shade of ... more ...
en_old: Mother... understand what life is... mother complained, and father complained too... charity, by God, in the shade of... more than that...

brh: ناؤ کنا مسنگ الو تے دے پورو مدینہ نا مکہ نا مسنگ داخہ آ قران حافظ باوا پیش تما مسڑ ہم پیش تما مسڑ نا خپ و سم ملک ٹی ئے ظالم خلق اونا تہ تخت آن کڑنگ او
en: Now my becoming ... all of Medina's, of Mecca's ... becoming ... the father, a hafiz of the Quran, came forward; the girl came forward too; the girl's ... in the land ... the oppressive people ... his ... from the throne ...
en_old: Now, for my days that remain, in all of Medina and Mecca... the father, a hafiz of the Quran, came out, and the daughter came out too; the girl was gentle and quiet. The oppressive people of the country removed him from his throne.

brh: نن متنا دشمنی کین اینا اللہ پاو وما ارسلناک الا رحمتہ للعالمین ئے کنا دلبر ئے نی رحمت کرین راہی کرین کنا محبوبا
en: 'Let us show enmity [toward him]...' God says: 'And We have not sent you except as a mercy to the worlds.' O my darling, We made you a mercy, We sent you, my beloved.
en_old: We do not hold enmity; God says, 'And We have not sent you except as a mercy to the worlds.' My beloved, You sent you as a mercy, You sent you forth, my beloved.

brh: آسمان تے نی بر آسمان نا ملائک نی سلام کرور جنت تے بر جنت تے زیباک کرور برزا بر تو کسر تے زیباک کرور کنا محبوبہ صرف ئے خدا نا دربارا جھکا کنے چارا مٹ کنے
en: Come to the heavens, and the angels of heaven will greet you; come to Paradise, and they will adorn Paradise; come up on high, and they will adorn your path. My beloved bowed only at God's court; they know me ... me...
en_old: If you go to the heavens, the angels of heaven greet you; if you go to Paradise, they adorn Paradise; if you go up, they adorn your path. My beloved bows only at God's court; know me, my...

brh: کنے چارا درک دا کنے چارا کنا دلبر سمجھارا عقلمندا بندغاک نی چارہ لیکن گنوکاک نی محمد چارا سبحان اللہ دنیا زیبا کن نبی نی کرے ملا ننتو بخت والا
en: They know me, they are aware of this; they know me, my darling, they understand. Wise people know you, but the madmen know you, Muhammad. Glory be to God! You were made a prophet to adorn the world; we have been blessed with good fortune.
en_old: Know me, understand me, know me, my beloved, understand. Wise people know you, but the mad ones know you as Muhammad. Glory be to God! You made the world beautiful for the Prophet; the mullah is fortunate with us.

brh: کہ اللہ سے ملو جھورس کرے اللہ پاک دے لقد من اللہ علی المؤمنین اذ بعث فیہم رسولا من انفسہم یتلوا علیہم آیاتہ ویزکیہم ویعلمہم
en: ... that God did [this favor]; God Almighty says: 'Certainly God conferred a favor upon the believers when He sent among them a Messenger from among themselves, reciting to them His verses, purifying them and teaching them...'
en_old: That God bestowed a favor; God Almighty says: 'Certainly did God confer a favor upon the believers when He sent among them a Messenger from themselves, reciting to them His verses, purifying them and teaching them...'

brh: نوراٹیکارے میشامرے نمے ایٹارے نمے ڈھگیارے نمے درست کیرے نمے
en: He fills you with light, ... you, raises you up, ... you, and sets you right.
en_old: He makes it radiant, makes it clean; He raises you, lifts you up, sets you right.

brh: لیکن توار کرو ہور ہور کہ خواجہ بننگٹی ئے و خواجہ نو کاوڑ اسے شڈو ڈی ٹھوک ڈی ٹھوک اٹ لیکن او کنا محبوبہ او کنا دلبر نا چہرہ غان قربان مرے ہمو جھمکا مسڑ کو دو دے زبس مکر
en: But someone calls out, 'Look, look, the master is coming!', and the master's ... with a knock, knock... But O my beloved, O my darling, may I be sacrificed for your face! That shining little girl ... two days ...
en_old: But call out and look, look, for the master is coming, and the master's... with a knock, a knock. But may it be sacrificed for the face of my beloved, my darling; that girl was shy... for two days they did not...

brh: سرمس حرفن ٹی عین محمد عین محمد کتابٹ لکیرے حضرت علی مونٹی دا بس حضرت علی خنا وی او ماما آبجی خنا چھرا مسڑ کو
en: ... in the letters, exactly 'Muhammad', exactly 'Muhammad' is written in the book. This [girl] came before Hazrat Ali; Hazrat Ali saw [her], and [she said], 'O uncle' ... saw the little girl's face.
en_old: In the letters, the 'Ayn' of Muhammad, the 'Ayn' of Muhammad is written in the Book. Hazrat Ali came before; this happened when Hazrat Ali saw... the uncle and the sister saw the girl's face.

brh: ماما ئے مرو مرے جوڑ جنگل ال ماما کنے پاک مکہ ٹی پوسکنو نبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم محمد پنیو ہمودے شہرت کنے مور ملنگ کے بسنوٹ حضرت علی مورت خنا کن علی رحم بس ہمو کہ دوٹی الک چھنا نا سدا کن محبوب نا خدمت ئے
en: 'Uncle, ... the jungle ... Uncle, [I heard] that in holy Mecca there is a new prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, named Muhammad; that day his fame reached me, and I have come to meet him.' Hazrat Ali saw her face; mercy came over Ali; he took her by the hand and [brought] the child straight into the presence of the Beloved.
en_old: The uncle, may he be... the forest. Uncle, in holy Mecca a new Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, named Muhammad, that day his fame reached me... When Hazrat Ali saw his face, Ali felt mercy; that which was in his hand, forever in the service of the beloved.

brh: مونی تا حضور جن تولوکو صحاباک مونی تولوکو حضور وصیت کنٹی وعظ کنٹی نصیحت کنٹی چونکا مسڑ کو ئس بس کر محبوب نا مونی زلفے حضور اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نا مونی مسڑ کو نا مونی
en: The Companions were sitting before the Holy Prophet, sitting before him; the Prophet was giving counsel, preaching, advising, when a little girl came before the Beloved ... the locks ... before the Holy Prophet ﷺ, the little girl before him.
en_old: The Companions sitting before the Prophet, sitting before him, the Prophet giving advice, preaching, counseling. The girl came forward... before the beloved, the locks of hair... before the Holy Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, the girl was before him.

brh: کہ مسڑ کو نہ خنتن کھڑیگا گویرہ مسڑ کو نہ جوڑ بارسنو گنا چمکا چنا نہ دوئی بارسنے خنتن تا کھڑیگا گویرہ گنا ماہب نہ مونی خنا مسڑ کو بور ئس خلک نون کے لمہ بابے پنت خنا چمکا چنا خنا ماہب وی
en: ... from the little girl's eyes tears were flowing; the little girl's ... had dried up, my shining child's hands ... had dried; tears were flowing from her eyes. My beloved saw her before him; the little girl ... now ... mother and father ... saw the shining child; my beloved saw [her] too.
en_old: The girl's eyes were flowing with tears; the girl was... my shining child was in my hands, tears were flowing from her eyes. My moon saw the girl before her; she was struck... now the mother and father saw it, my shining child, my moon too.

brh: ابونا پاکیں چہرے خنا حضور محترم سر غدا دوئی خوشکا او چنا نی پریشان مفہ او چنا نی گردی کپا ئے محمد نا دنتو لوکٹو چنا اوغنگے شروع کرے یا رسول اللہ کنے کنا کنے کنا باوہ خلکونے محبوبا خف کنوس ملنے
en: She saw his holy face. The revered Holy Prophet stroked her head with his hand: 'O child, don't be upset; O child, don't cry.' Before Muhammad, the little child began to weep: 'O Messenger of God, me, my... my father has beaten me; O beloved, my ear is [burning]...'
en_old: She saw her father's holy face. The Holy Prophet put his hand on her head and stroked it: 'O child, do not worry; O child, do not cry.' Sitting before Muhammad, the little child began to weep: 'O Messenger of God, my father has beaten me, beloved, my ear...'

brh: ہاڻ سڄی مخلوق کے تہ ویلو آ، جنن چیو دیون ماڻہن، جی مہینو کائین کٽائی ڪونہ سگہن۔ ہاء، انہن چرن کے ڪہڙی خبر، تہ کارائڻ واری رب جی ذات آ۔ سلیمان چیو تخت کے گہرایو، تخت ائین نہ، او جیئن ویٺا ہئو۔ ہا ہلو تخت ملڪن ۾، اڙی چڙہو!
en: Now it was mealtime for all of creation. The jinn, the demons and the people said, 'Even if they eat for a month, they won't be able to finish it.' Ha, what do these fools know? The one who feeds is the Lord Himself. Solomon said, 'Send for the throne.' It was not a throne like this one, not like the ones you are sitting on. 'Yes, come on, the throne is going out over the lands. Hey, climb on!'
en_old: Now it was time for all of creation. The jinn, the demons and the people said, 'They will not be able to finish it even if they eat for a month.' Ha, what do these fools know? The one who feeds is the Lord Himself. Solomon said, 'Bring the throne,' not just any throne but the one they used to sit on. 'Come, the throne is going out over the lands. Hey, climb on!'

brh: جنو دیوو چڙہو سڀ چڙہی ویہی رہیا ماڻہو چڙہی ویا چئی اللہ جی حڪم سان ہوا کے حڪم ڪیائین تہ ہیٺئون کڻ تخت کے ہوا جی ذریعی ہیٺئون کڻی آہستی آہستی آہستی ہی مٿی وڃی زون مہینی جو پنڌ ہڪڙی وقت ۾ گہڙی ۾ خبر ئے ناہی
en: 'Jinn, demons, climb on!' Everyone climbed up and sat down, and the people climbed on too. By God's command he ordered the wind, 'Lift the throne from below.' The wind lifted it from below, slowly, slowly, slowly it went up, and then zoom! A month's journey in a single moment, in an instant. You wouldn't even notice.
en_old: The jinn and demons climbed on and all sat down, and the people climbed on too. By God's command he ordered the wind to lift the throne from below. The wind lifted it from below, slowly, slowly, up it went, and it covered a month's journey in a single moment, in an instant, without anyone even noticing.

brh: جی طعام دسوں تہ تیار ہی ہن کنڈ کان جو شروع تھیو ہن کنڈ تئیں سلیمان نبی کے دلجائی تھی تہ الحمدللہ رب سئیں ہروبرو ماکھے نہ پیو چھڈے جی مہنو چھڈے ہا نہ تدی وی طعام کھٹائے کون سگھاں اللہ فرمائے ٹھیک سلیمان اللہ سئیں فرمائے تو اماں
en: The food, I tell you, was ready, starting from this end and going all the way to that end. Prophet Solomon felt reassured: 'Praise be to God, my Lord, this surely won't leave me short. Even if they ate for a month, they still couldn't finish the food.' God says, 'All right, Solomon.' The Lord God says... [rest unclear]
en_old: The food was ready, from this end to that end, and the prophet Solomon was satisfied: 'Praise be to God, my Lord, surely no one will be left out. Even if a month passes, the food will not run out.' God said, 'Very well, Solomon.' God said...

brh: وما من دابہ فی الارض الا علی اللہ رزقہا، پوری دنیا ۾ ڪا چرندڙ شئی ناہی، اللہ ٿو فرمائی مان کارائیندو آ، مان ئے کارائیندو، ٻئی کے کارائڻ جی طاقت ناہی، صبح جو ٽائیم ٿیو، اللہ فرمائی سلیمان
en: 'And there is no creature on earth but that its provision rests with God.' In the whole world there is no creature that grazes [whose food does not come from God]. God says, 'I am the one who feeds; I alone feed. No one else has the power to feed.' Morning came, and God says, 'Solomon...'
en_old: 'And there is no creature on earth but that its provision rests with God.' In the whole world there is no grazing creature that I do not feed, God says. I feed them; no one else has the power to feed them. Morning came, and God said, 'Solomon...'

brh: برے ئے بحری برے معنی جھنگواری مخلوق بحری معنی دریا سلیمان اگ مین کیڑی مخلوق اجازت دیاں توڑے اچے کھائن جلا سلیمان ڈٹھو تو اول ہی اچن بیچارہ بحری دریا مون ایہہ کومیں ڈیڈر مچھی بچھی ہی ہو ایہہ اچے کھائی
en: Land and sea: 'barri' means the creatures of the wild, and 'bahri' means the river [creatures]. Solomon [asked], 'Which creatures should I let come and eat first?' Then Solomon decided, 'First let the poor sea creatures from the river come, those kinds, the frogs, the fish and so on. Let them come and eat.'
en_old: Land and sea creatures: land means the creatures of the wild, and sea means the river. Solomon asked, 'Which creatures shall I allow to come and eat first?' Then Solomon decided, 'First let the poor sea creatures come, the ones from the river, like frogs and fish. Let them come and eat.'

brh: پوہے بلا چی ویندا ہاتھی ایڈن کنن سا شیہ ایندا بگڑ گدڑ ئے لومبڑیو ئے تو ملک ڈراہ ویندا اول ویچارہ باہری چرے ایسے باہری کے اجازت دے رب فرما ٹھیک ہی باہری کے دے مانگر مچہ نکتو تکی دیر تھی وئی فرما رب اج کاوڑ جی وئی
en: Otherwise the beasts will come: elephants with ears this big, lions will come, wolves, jackals and foxes, and then everyone will be frightened. 'First let the poor sea creatures eat; give the sea creatures permission.' The Lord said, 'Fine, give it to the sea creatures.' A crocodile came out. It had gotten late for it, and it said, 'Lord, have You gotten angry today?'
en_old: Then elephants with ears this big would come, and lions, wolves, jackals and foxes, and the whole land would be frightened. 'First let the poor sea creatures graze; give the sea creatures permission.' The Lord said, 'Very well, give it to the sea creatures.' The crocodile came out, but it was late. The Lord said, 'Today he has become angry.'

brh: مان نہ تو کھارائیں چے جو گالھ بے آ اڄ تانجی روزی جکا ہی سلیمان ڏیا تانجی دعوت سلیمان ڏیا اڄ مان نہ کھارائیندومان سلیمان وٹ وڃی کرے کھائو مانگر مچہ حیران سائین وڏی تکلیف تھی آ پنڌ وڏو آ چے جلدی وڃ
en: 'I'm not feeding you, because something else is going on: today your food is whatever Solomon gives you. Solomon is giving your feast. Today I won't feed you; go to Solomon and eat.' The crocodile was astonished: 'Sir, this is a great hardship, the journey is long.' He said, 'Go quickly.'
en_old: 'I will not feed you, and here is why: today your provision is whatever Solomon gives you. Your feast is with Solomon. Today I will not feed you; go to Solomon and eat.' The crocodile was astonished: 'Sir, this is a great hardship, the journey is long.' He said, 'Go quickly.'

brh: سویرے جی منڈی کڏہن پچلٹ کائیندو مان گرمچ پہتو او سلیمان چاچی چھا مسئلو آ سلیمان مان ہمیشہ سویر کائیندو اج دیر تھی وئی آ مان اللہ کے سرکس ڏیکارائیندو اچ سلیمان
en: 'When will I ever eat my morning meal...' [partly garbled] The crocodile arrived: 'O Solomon!' He said, 'What's the problem?' 'Solomon, I always eat early in the morning, and today it has gotten late. I... God... [unclear]... Today, Solomon...'
en_old: 'Early in the morning I always eat...' The crocodile arrived. 'O Solomon...' 'What is the problem?' 'Solomon, I always eat early, but today it has gotten late.' ... 'Come, Solomon.'

brh: پیری ونج مہربانی کر مکھے بکھ ڈاڈھی لگے آ مکھے جلدی کھراۓ تہ مان موٹی ونجاں سلیمان چئیس بے بھی مخلوق آہے سب ایندا چھڑو تون آن بھنا بھگو بیٹھو آن سبن کان اگ مین بیا بیا ہن ناں تھوڑو صبر کر چئیس صبر ببر کون تھی سئیں مان کراہیں
en: [It said,] 'I'm at your feet, please have mercy, I'm terribly hungry. Feed me quickly so I can go back.' Solomon told it, 'There are other creatures too, they're all coming. Only you came rushing in and are sitting here ahead of everyone. There are others, aren't there? Be a little patient.' It said, 'Patience? Patience is impossible, sir, I'm groaning [with hunger].'
en_old: He went: 'Please, have mercy, I am very hungry. Feed me quickly so I can go back.' Solomon told him, 'There are other creatures too, they are all coming. Only you came running and are sitting here ahead of everyone. There are others, so be a little patient.' He said, 'What patience, sir? I will...'

brh: کجو کھارا! جڏہن ہن پیو مڃی تہ نبی تہ رحمتن تہ ہوندا آہن۔ چئی ڀلا وڃی ڪلی مان کائجاء، لتارجاء نہ، ٽنگ نہ ہڻجاء، پڇ نہ ہڻجاء، چئی مان کے توبہ آ۔
en: 'Feed me something!' When he gave in (prophets are merciful, after all), he said, 'All right, go and eat, but don't trample anything, don't kick with your legs, don't lash your tail.' It said, 'I swear I won't.'
en_old: Who will feed him! When he accepted it, for prophets are a mercy, he said, 'Fine, go and eat, but do not trample anything, do not kick, do not strike with your tail.' He said, 'I repent.'

brh: چکلی موخائی کرین کریون، ہی ہی جوایو، ایوا تین، ہن کنڈ کا ہن کنڈ تائیں تام تہ کھایو پر دسترخوان وی پیٹ اٹ، بہاری دے یو بہاری، کا شے ریلی۔
en: ... [garbled] it finished it off... From this end to that end it didn't just eat the food, it put the tablecloth into its belly too. The sea creature... not a thing was left!
en_old: ... Hee hee, from one end to the other it ate up the food, and even the tablecloth went into its belly. The sea creature left nothing behind.

brh: وری ڈولن دعا ہاؤ حاجی سلیمان ویٹھو آ نفلن مین رب تون جا تھورا کہیں نبی ایڑے دعوت نہ کئی آ جو مکھے تو موقع ڈنو جو سجی مخلوق کے کھارائیندو آن انو کم الہی ہئو جو کم
en: Then he prayed. Now Solomon is sitting in his voluntary prayers: 'Lord, thank You. No prophet has ever given a feast like this. You gave me the chance to feed all of creation.' That work, though, was God's work.
en_old: Then he prayed again. Hajji Solomon sat in his voluntary prayers and thanked the Lord: 'No prophet was ever given such an invitation as You gave me, the chance to feed all creatures. This is a divine task.'

brh: ہاݨے جو عالم الکل سلیمان کے سمجھو تہ سلیمان تہ لیساں ویٹھو آ تہ مخلوق اچے کھائے اوڏو داݨو ئے ناہیں وری بیہر آیو چیس سلیمان چئی جی چھا مسئلہ آ
en: Now the All-Knowing made Solomon understand. Solomon is sitting there waiting for the creatures to come and eat, but there isn't a single grain left. Then it came back again. Solomon said to it, 'Yes, what's the problem?'
en_old: Now the All-Knowing made Solomon understand. Solomon was sitting there thinking the creatures would come and eat, but there was not a single grain left. Then he came back again, and Solomon said, 'What is the problem?'

brh: چئی سائین بک لڳی آ کاراء چئی ڙی تون ساڳیو اڳوڻو چوان ڪنڍڙی مڪائی ہلیو وڃ وری ماڙی ڀڳو ویٺو آہین چریو آہین ڇا ڀلا چئی سائین ڪاوڙ نہ ڪر اللہ سائین مون تے ڪڏہن ڪاوڙیو ناہی کارائڻ جی باری ۾ تہ مان مہمان آ
en: It said, 'Sir, I'm hungry, feed me.' He said, 'Hey, aren't you the same one from before? You finished off every corner and left, and now you've come running and are sitting here again. Are you crazy or what?' It said, 'Sir, don't get angry. God has never gotten angry with me about feeding me, and I am a guest.'
en_old: He said, 'Sir, I am hungry, feed me.' He said, 'Hey, aren't you the same one from before? You finished off everything and left, and now you are sitting here starving again? Are you crazy?' He said, 'Sir, do not be angry. God has never been angry with me about feeding me, and I am a guest.'

brh: ہا! مہمان سئیں نا ڳالھایو با اللہ جا نبی مکھے کھارایو مان کھاواں، چڑے توکھے چمٹا کرڑی موکھائی، ہلو ونجو، چئے اللہ جی ذات جو قسم کا شے ناہیں، نندرا گھنان کے آ؟ ہتہ متھے کیو جن کے نندرا۔
en: 'Yes! A guest, sir, don't talk like that. O prophet of God, feed me and I'll eat.' He got irritated: 'You've finished it all off. Go on, get going.' He said, 'I swear by God, there is nothing [left].' (To the audience:) Who's sleepy? Raise your hands, those of you who are sleepy.
en_old: Yes! 'A guest, sir, don't talk like that. O prophet of God, feed me and I will eat.' He got irritated: 'You have finished it all off, go away.' He said, 'By God, there is nothing left. Where did you put it all? Where did you put this?'

brh: ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ جن کے نن راوت متھے کیو ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ الحمدللہ وداوشا مانگر مچے جاتے تماجو ادھلے چھا کیو سبحان اللہ کلمے وارو
en: Mashallah, mashallah. Those who are sleepy, raise [your hands]. Mashallah, mashallah, praise be to God. ... And the crocodile, what did it do there? Glory be to God, O people of the Kalima.
en_old: Mashallah, mashallah, the one who did this, mashallah, mashallah, praise be to God... The crocodile, what did you do here? Glory be to God, O believer.

brh: چیسے موکھے کھارا بکھ لگیا چئے جو چوما کلے موکھا چیسے کاشے نئیں چہ ہا چیسے لپڑو وی لپڑو این لپڑو اوتھا کھادم جو تئی ڈسائیں تہ جیڑے چھورا ڈسو جنن کے دیون کے بٹرے چمبا ٹھوکا
en: It said to him, 'Feed me, I'm hungry.' ... He told it, 'There's nothing.' It said, 'Yes, but a little handful, even a little handful, bring a little handful...' [garbled] ...he told the jinn and the demons... [unclear]
en_old: He said, 'Feed me, I am hungry.' He said, 'There is nothing left.' He said, 'Just a mouthful, even one mouthful.' The servants told them, the jinn and demons who had brought it all...

brh: چڑو چڑو تخت تے چڑو چڑیا تخت تے چے ہوائے اڑام اللہ نا حکم سا تخت ہلو چے ہنا کونڈ کا ہنا کونڈ ہلو اودو نا پھرے جو بہاری دے دے پھوکے
en: 'Climb, climb onto the throne!' They climbed onto the throne. He told the wind, 'Rise, by God's command.' The throne moved. He said, 'Go from this end to that end.' Over there... [unclear], and the sea creature took a deep breath in.
en_old: They climbed, climbed onto the throne. He told the wind to rise by God's command, and the throne moved from one end to the other. There the poor sea creature breathed in.

brh: ہک پھوکا ساں جھڑو بہاری اڑے کاری او جن سائیں چے سائیں ئے تو ملک سجو بھریو پاو آ ایہ انہیا ایہ کھائیو سو ہور اوتے بیٹھو آ در تے جلدی کر کھارائے جوان ویہڑا ہوجن چھیڑے کاری او مال سجو چھیڑے
en: With a single breath the sea creature [swallowed it all]. Hey, the jinn [said], 'Sir, the whole land was filled [with food] and this one, this one ate it all, and he's still sitting there at the door [saying], "Hurry up, feed me." ... the whole herd of livestock...'
en_old: With a single breath it swept everything clean. Hey, the jinn said, 'Sir, the whole land was full and he ate all of it, and he is still sitting there at the door saying, "Hurry, feed me."' ... the whole herd ...

brh: کاشے نائے ہنے کونڈے تارے ٹھے چے بلے دستار خالو کاچے آ چے اوہو ئے ہود کاشے نائے چے بلے ئے اوتو کھائے وی چمن ٹمے آ حضرت سلیمان واپس چے تون جی گراڑو ما کھاد مے خدا جی ذات قسم سلیمان
en: 'There's nothing [left], in this corner...' He said, 'Well, the tablecloth is empty.' He said, 'Oh, there's nothing there.' He said, 'Well, he ate it all...' Hazrat Solomon turned back to it. It said, 'I've eaten one morsel of yours. I swear by God, Solomon...'
en_old: The tablecloth was spread... and it ate it all up. Hazrat Solomon came back and said to it: 'I swear by the essence of God,' Solomon...

brh: سلیمان نبی آ گوڑ آ رحمت وارا وہی جی سئیں سلیمان گال بتو جی تو سنبھارے نتوت زمانہ جھکوی سلیمان گال بتو ایڑا ٹرے گھرو اللہ مکے اوتے ہی کھڑائیندو آ
en: Solomon is a prophet, a merciful one. 'Oh, sir... Solomon, listen... [unclear]... Solomon, listen: right there [where I live], God feeds me three morsels like that.'
en_old: Mercy be upon Prophet Solomon. 'Lord,' Solomon said, 'the whole world bows to You.' It said to Solomon: 'Allah gives me three such morsels every day, and only then am I fed.'

brh: ملائیندو ناہے پند نہ کرائیندو آ روز مونکے ٹرے گرو ایڑا کھارائیندو آ اج ہکڑے گرو تے کاوڑجے تو چے ہاں مون کان پرے تھی ونج پرے تھی ونج منٹ مین نمانو بیہہ رہیو دعا گھری او ربا مونکے بچا اللہ مخلوق کے موٹائے ربا ہانی
en: 'He doesn't make me... [unclear], He doesn't make me travel. Every day He feeds me three morsels like that, and today you get angry over a single morsel.' He said, 'Yes, get away from me, get away!' Within a minute the humble [prophet] sat down and prayed: 'O Lord, save me. God, send the creatures back. O Lord, now...'
en_old: '...It feeds me three such morsels every day; today you have fed me only one.' He got angry and said, 'Get away from me, get away!' Within a minute the poor one sat down and prayed: 'O Lord, save me. Allah feeds His creatures, O Lord...'

brh: نہ تیرا وارا چل نہ جنگل وارا چل ما سلیمان وٹ کا شئے نہ مٹھا ربا بس طاقت تنجی آ منھنجی طاقت نہ مان کمزور اھیاں ربا تو کھارائے پر بدھو آخری جملو عالم سڳورا پوء تائین کلمے وارو چھوکری چمچو جو رکھی کرے آئی بسم اللہ پڑھی
en: 'Let neither the river creatures come nor the jungle ones. I, Solomon, have nothing, dear Lord. All the power is Yours, none of it is mine. I am weak. Lord, You are the one who feeds.' But listen to the last sentence, honored scholars. Meanwhile, O people of the Kalima, the girl who had put the spoon in came and recited Bismillah.
en_old: 'Neither your power works nor the forest's.' Solomon said: 'Not mine, O sweet Lord; all power is Yours alone. I have no power; I am weak. Lord, it is You who feeds them.' But listen to the last sentence, honorable scholars: meanwhile the girl who recited the kalima held the spoon and said 'Bismillah'.

brh: پنا زو چھوکری چے تھی بابا چہ ون ڈھکنو متھے کر اندر ہتہ وجی کرے جلدی کھڑی آ ارے چھا تھیا ابا کاتھے گال چھڈے مین ٹوبنو پنا زو
en: ...quickly. The girl says, 'Father...' 'Go, lift the lid, put your hand inside...' ...she quickly stood up. 'Oh, what happened, father?' ... [unclear] ...quickly.
en_old: The girl Panazo said: 'Father, put the lid on.' He put his hand inside, and she quickly stood up: 'Oh, what happened, father?' 'Don't say that, I am drowning, Panazo.'

brh: بیٹھو آ تارا فوٹارے، چے چھوکری جلدی کر، ارے کپ سو کر، دت ٹبڑی نا ڈھکنا بڑزا کر، اموس خیسن نا ہارے، شاباش خیسن نا ہارے، مسٹ کو پارے بسم اللہ الرحمن
en: He is sitting there... [unclear]. He said, 'Girl, hurry up... lift up the lid of the pot. There's a gold necklace, well done, a gold necklace.' Three times she said, 'Bismillah ar-Rahman...'
en_old: He is sitting there... 'Girl, hurry, bring the cup, put the lid on top of the pot.' ...a gold necklace, well done, a gold necklace... and she said, 'Bismillah ar-Rahman...'

brh: مان الرحیم، پند کننگ شروع کیتے پر قدم قدم تے بسم اللہ، چھوکری پند پی کرے تھی بسم اللہ پڑھدی تھی وتے، منی کر پوتی خیر آن ٹوپڑے وٹ
en: '...ar-Rahim.' She started walking, but at every step she said Bismillah. The girl walks along reciting Bismillah, and she arrived safely at the pot.
en_old: '...ar-Rahim.' She began to walk, but at every step 'Bismillah'. The girl walked along reciting Bismillah, and she arrived safely...

brh: او ڈھکڑے مت ودئی فرما بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم ئے ڈھکڑو جو متھے کرے بسم اللہ پڑھیا تندر نئے ئے جھکے جو کڈئی تو سونوں ہار
en: He told her, '[Lift] the lid.' Saying 'Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim', she lifted the lid and recited Bismillah, [put her hand] inside, and when she pulled it out, there was a gold necklace!
en_old: He told her to put her hand in the pot. Saying 'Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim', she put her hand into the pot and recited Bismillah, and when she pulled it out, it was a gold necklace.

brh: سبحان اللہ شاباش سونو ہار سونو ہار اچے دے واپس فرمائے بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم پیر صاحب آیو آیتڑی فرمائے با
en: Glory be to God, well done: a gold necklace, a gold necklace! 'Come and give it back,' he says. Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim. The Pir Sahib came and recites a short verse...
en_old: Glory be to God, well done: a gold necklace, a gold necklace! Then it was given back, with 'Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim'. The Pir Sahib came and recited a verse...

brh: بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم پینز کڑی مو پاجے مین بٹی چما پیا ہیا ئے محمدا کیرو تہ جادو سیکھارے تہ منی ننڈی کے گھڑی مین جو نانگن کے سون سونے ہار کے نانگ تہ پانجی جائی تے
en: Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim. ... [garbled] ... 'O Muhammad, who taught you this magic? In my little girl's pot the snake turned to gold, into a gold necklace, and yet the snake was right there in its place?'
en_old: Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim... 'Muhammad, who taught you this magic, that the snake in my little girl's pot turned into a gold necklace, and the snake went back to its place?'

brh: مان نانگ رقم سونو ہار بنجی ویو اللہ فرمایو منہنجی محبوب جو سبق آ منہنجی محبوب جو وظیفو آ بسم اللہ جی برڪت آ چندرا جی تون بسم اللہ پڙہین ہا تہ تون بہ اٿی وڃین ہا پر ننڍڙی پاک محمد جی زہرا
en: 'I put a snake in, and it turned into a gold necklace.' God said, 'This is My beloved's lesson, My beloved's litany. It is the blessing of Bismillah. You wretch, if you had recited Bismillah, you too would have been raised up.' But the little, pure Zahra of Muhammad...
en_old: The snake turned into a gold necklace. Allah said: 'This is my beloved's lesson, my beloved's litany, the blessing of Bismillah.' O moon, if you had recited Bismillah you too would have risen, but the pure little Zahra of Muhammad...

brh: دے تمنے پا باوہ نبی نبی خبر تمتو پا نبی خبر ابا عید کبو پا باوہ تنسسکا ئے دے تمنے یوسف علیہ السلام مسدے باوہ ہنا دے پٹکتا یوسف اللہ رانجن اتھو اینو ئے دونس کانی
en: The day came... say, the father was a prophet, yet the prophet did not find out. Say, did the prophet know? 'Dear father, let us celebrate Eid,' (they said), 'father...' The day came, Yusuf, peace be upon him,... father, that day... Yusuf... (Sindhi:) 'Allah...' today... a well... going.
en_old: The day comes; he says, father, prophet, prophet; he didn't know; he says the prophet knows; father, let's celebrate Eid… the day comes, Yusuf, peace be upon him, became… father, that day he went… Yusuf, Allah…

brh: ننا پیرہ ننا پیرہ اسہ بھلو بزرگ اسس مولوی نوابی نا من پیری دا دامب نا کسر اٹ ہنتے تینا ہنو نی درو ور ننا خنکم شیطان کے
en: Our elder, our elder was a great saint... Maulvi Nawabi's... pir-hood... he went by the road of this trap, his own... yesterday... Satan... our eyes too.
en_old: Our elder, our elder was a great saint, Maulvi Nawabi's… I accept discipleship; he went on the path of this trap, went himself… our eyes… to Satan.

brh: نا خنک راجوانی گپ خنک دیوتے کسے ننے ننا پیرہ ارانی مریدٹ نا ئے سجاگہ سے اینا ٹہ وایزے بسے ٹی سوار سوٹ مکنو زمانہ سے ئے رٹ زونڈو کسرا سندھی اسرا ئے پی منجو مرشد سبن کو ڈاڈو وا ئے پی منجو
en: ...your eyes... talk... (we) saw... our Pir, the one whose disciples... at one place... I was riding in a bus, some time ago... on the way there was a Sindhi; he says, 'My murshid is the mightiest of all,' he says, 'my...'
en_old: We have not seen such... our Pir's disciples are everywhere... I rode in a bus... in olden times, on a crooked road... Sindhi... he says my Murshid is the greatest of all...

brh: منجو مرشد زورا، ئے پی منجو مرشد زورا، او مونس ئے تڈو خیر نصیب ئے ئے پی واری ویرا وایزس جوڑ مریک، علی ات کتوٹی تودا، ئے پی منجو مرشد زورا، ئے پی کھنا مرشد زوری، ئے پی کھنا زوری، دا پی نا مرشد انت کرے، پیڑے کھاؤ کنیا ککڑ، ککڑ کھاؤ
en: 'My murshid is mighty,' he says, 'my murshid is mighty'... fortunate... he says, 'brother, ... becomes well,' ... 'my murshid is mighty,' he says, 'my murshid is mighty,' he says, 'mine is mighty.' (I asked:) 'What did this murshid of yours do?' (He said:) '...the rooster was eaten, the rooster was eaten...'
en_old: He says, 'My Murshid is mighty, my Murshid is mighty'... he is blessed... he says the brothers get united... I said Ali... 'my Murshid is mighty, your Murshid is mighty.' What did this one's Murshid do? He ate the rooster, ate the rooster.

brh: بشکا خلق والاک حساس اورتو پیشن سائیں ننا موقع نا مرید آک جودو سرا اوئے سائیں اینا کے اتھار تا سہی دادے بشکا پیر بابا چھڈیو زپا آسان جو کیڑو کمال آ کہ جی ککڑا جی چھت دے
en: 'Raise it up (bring it back)!' The villagers... came out: 'Sain, the disciples of our place... Sain, today this one... raise it up, Pir Baba!' (Sindhi:) '...what a miracle it is that the rooster's...'
en_old: Those who forgive people are tender-hearted... Sain, our disciples... Sain, forgive this one, Pir Baba... It is a miracle that the rooster...

brh: سائیں سائیں سائیں دا دے بشکہ کو کے سائیں نا مسے مار کسکو اودے بشکہ تو کھوگا ککڑ بشکہ شرم بفتو کم از کم قران دے خبے نا ضعیفہ تا کس میراث چرے کرے کرے
en: 'Sain, Sain, Sain, raise this one up today... Sain, your... son... died... raise it up! You ate the rooster, raise the rooster up! Have you no shame? At least... the Quran... the woman's... inheritance...'
en_old: Sain, Sain, Sain, give this... forgive him, Sain... you ate the rooster; forgive, have you no shame? At least give the Quran... who takes away the inheritance of a poor old woman?

brh: سیدھا سیدھا ضعیفہ تکس سائیں ضعیفہ کن کھس کا مسلخ پور کرے ضعیفہ کے ضعیفہ کھس کنا سائیں اسدے ضعیفہ زندگہ نکتو نتہ قبرن کشا کدو فارغ کنے ئے تنا ضعیفہ الپارہ ہا سائیں لیکن ڈامو تو
en: Straight, straight the woman... Sain, the woman... the problem... the woman... the woman... 'my Sain, one day the woman... was not alive, otherwise... from the grave pull out... free me...' ...your woman... yes, Sain, but...
en_old: Plainly, the old woman... Sain, who will pay the old woman's money? Sain, this old woman has no one alive, nor... from the graves... free me... your old woman... Sain, but...

brh: بے پارہ سائیں لا ککڑ بش کا بے ہلبوتا سندھی دے پرگڑ چھڈیس بے سائیں سائیں سائیں مہربانی بس اندو مسئلہ ہلا ککڑ اتھو ہلا کتے خل خسا ڈراں ڈراں ڈراں پرگاتے دم مسرا ہلا ڈراں کرسا ککڑ ڈرائیں
en: She said, 'Sain, raise the rooster up!' ...the Sindhi... left... 'Sain, Sain, Sain, please, just this one problem.' 'Come on, rooster, get up! Come on...' 'Draan, draan, draan'... he blew a breath on it, 'come on', and the rooster went 'draan'...
en_old: Sain, forgive the rooster... let it go... Sain, Sain, Sain, thank you; just this one problem... take the rooster... the rooster crowed, 'cock-a-doodle-doo'...

brh: او جمر شاہ زور آ قزین منرفوا راست پارے ادروک کم پانے ٹی او دروک ہسکا بیماری ارے ہاں درود شریف خوانبو رومال تین تفو اللہ
en: Oh, Jamar Shah is mighty!... he said it truly: the liar... the liar has a sickness. Yes, recite the Durood Sharif... handkerchief... Allah.
en_old: Jamar Shah, mighty... said rightly: the liar... has an illness. Yes, recite Durood Sharif, tie a handkerchief, by Allah.

brh: بزرگ آک باز بسو کنا وعظ نا پچھاڑی انشاء اللہ ہفتہ او کنا ایلم آک ئے بال نا مرشد پڑے دا ککڑ ء زندہ کننگ آنسی پئے مرشد نا پن پئے گھوٹ گھوٹ دا مئے
en: Elders came in large numbers at the end of my sermon, God willing, (this) week, and my brothers... the murshid of... said... to bring this rooster back to life... the murshid's name... 'Ghot, Ghot'... this...
en_old: Many elders came at the end of my sermon, God willing on Saturday, my brothers... the Murshid said to bring this rooster back to life... the Murshid's name...

brh: عید تہ وچارک مریرو فضولی آ گواٹ ئے بنے و خیرے نی بیو کنا اللہ عید کیو دا خلیرہ کن بے ایمانک ئے دے پاوک تون کوڑ تہو گالائے ئے جنگ جش توما گاور تمے انتک الکفر ملت واحد مشرک توار
en: On Eid... the poor wretches... uselessness... '...O my God, I will celebrate Eid'... for these... the faithless ones... they say... war, celebration... 'disbelief is a single nation'... the voice of the polytheist.
en_old: On the day of Eid… the useless talk is heard, and good, you come, my God, celebrate Eid… for this fear… they call the dishonest one on the day… the war, the celebration… for disbelief is one nation, the call of the polytheist.

brh: دیر نا ہرتوما کاورتمے پائیک کنا سائیں نا پن گھومٹے گھومٹ مانا پزورنگا نڑنگا بچ نون تینا مونا سرے خلے مشتیٹی بونڈاتیٹی خلے ہنوسے ہما گھومٹے کنا والا
en: ...both... they say, 'my Sain's name is Ghomat; Ghomat means...' ...he struck himself on his own face and head, struck with his fists... went... that Ghomat of mine...
en_old: Of the past, both of them… say my master's name is Ghomat, Ghomat meaning… the one who flies… he struck his head in front of him, struck with fists and blows, went… that Ghomat of mine.

brh: کنا کومٹ کنا اوڑے ککڑے کھجی ارا کانی او کا وڈو مسلہ آ جا مہنجا مرشد سائیں چڑھیلا ئے ببڑی عید کے بسمنگٹی تیز دنگنے ئے بیمرات شیر ملاپنگٹی عیدا کومٹ نئے تاتی
en: My Ghomat, my... there the rooster... where did it go?... is that a big problem? My murshid Sain... at the big Eid... in the gathering... fast... like a lion... Eid... Ghomat...
en_old: My Ghomat, my… the chicken… where is… the big problem, my spiritual guide, master… at Eid… in the gathering… like a lion… the Ghomat of Eid…

brh: پئے منجھو سائیں مائی مرے وئی مرے وئی مائی ارے تو بس پیرہ سائیں گڑ ننا مریدن سینون ضعیفہ کرینا دس کداس برام کریوت چھنا متل پئے ہاؤ پئے ہاؤ پئے ہلی تبا اینا خدا نا حکم ئے قبول
en: (Sindhi:) 'My Sain, the old woman has died, she has died, the old woman!' Then, just, the Pir Sain... our disciples... the woman... he says, 'yes, yes'... he says... today God's command is accepted.
en_old: So in between, master, whether it is a woman or a man, if it is a woman then just the elder, master… our disciple… made the old woman… said yes, yes… God's command is accepted.

brh: دور کر پائے نہ سائیں ضعیفہ ئے کھئے وا صفا کھئے وا نیٹ مجبور مس سائیں ئے سڑ سائیں بش مس ہنادے فوت چوری پیراں پیر جی حکم ساں بغداد والی جی حکم ساں اتھی ڈیکھا مسڑ کو چھنڈا تینا بش مس
en: 'Get away,' he says. 'No, Sain, the woman... completely... she truly became helpless.' The Sain... the Sain got up and went that day to the dead woman... (Sindhi:) 'By the command of Piran-e-Pir, by the command of the one of Baghdad, rise!'... she shook herself and stood up.
en_old: Take it away, he said; no, master, the old woman… truly she was helpless; the master… the master stood up, went on that day… Piran-e-Pir, the command is from the one of Baghdad… he himself stood up.

brh: نا ککڑی زندہ کرے ککڑان سے مائی زندہ کرے اللہ اکبر ئے بو یا اللہ داسہ عید کپر تو قیامت ئے خلے دام خلنگ کپسہ کن عید تو ٹھٹسہ سلو داسہ نما وعظ آک دام
en: He revived your hen; along with the hens he revived the old woman, God is great! ...O Allah, now if I don't celebrate Eid it will be Doomsday... cast a trap... you cannot... for Eid... now your sermons are a trap.
en_old: He brought your chicken back to life; from the chicken he brought the woman back to life, Allahu Akbar! O Allah, if he doesn't celebrate Eid now, doomsday will strike… you will not set a trap for Eid… stand now, your sermons are a trap.

brh: سلہ سر کرے ہا سائیں کسرٹ خنے را اوٹل سائیں پین خیر ہراتم سوار مر سائیں گڑا چاس کنوس ہا گڑا لاغر مفن پین مفن سوار مرور گڑا سلہ ئے خلے کہ سلہ سہی ہی ابا انویلر فون سلہ استوالا دادے پاپت ہراتم لگا نتے تغان سائیں گڑا
en: ...yes, Sain, (he) saw on the road... Sain, otherwise fine; when you ride, Sain, then you would know, yes; then we don't become weak, otherwise when they ride, then ... the prayer is right, father... phone... when ... from your sleep, Sain, then...
en_old: He made a plan, yes master, saw on the way… master, otherwise fine; when you ride, master, then… yes, then don't be weak, otherwise when you ride, then the counsel is given that the counsel is right, father… phone… when sleep overtakes you, master, then…

brh: دا چانس گنو سائیں خیرات ء دا زارات سائیں حیات ڈگزے گنو کنا جائی پوٹ دمٹ نی تو نظرو کزو تمبان بندہ دا سائیں لگنگ دے دا خل خل خلیت گنائی نو کنا دوست احباباک دا تمس گونٹ نا مار مائی بش کرے یوسف نبی دوندی تمو کے مصیبت
en: This chance, Sain... charity... this shrine, Sain, life... my place... you... look... a person... this Sain... strike, strike... my friends and companions... the son of... raised the woman up. Prophet Yusuf fell into a well, what a calamity!
en_old: This chance, master, charity, this shrine, master, life… my place… you look… man, this, master, seems the day… strike, strike… my friends and acquaintances… son of… the woman raised… Prophet Yusuf fell into… calamity.

brh: باوا نبی بابا نبی لیکن ئے کسرہ کائک یا اللہ کنے خبر مروز یوسف دا خوری کیک ئے ما تون حل توٹا تاو رب کعبہ نا قسم ئے اگر یعقوب علیہ السلام ئے غیب نا علم مروز
en: The father a prophet, the grandfather a prophet, but he goes along the road: 'O Allah, had I known that Yusuf would suffer this humiliation, I would not have sent him with them.' By the Lord of the Kaaba, if Jacob, peace be upon him, had had knowledge of the unseen...
en_old: Father is a prophet, father is a prophet, but he comes along the way: O Allah, if I had known that Yusuf would do this… by the Lord of the Kaaba, if Jacob, peace be upon him, had knowledge of the unseen…

brh: علم غیب مرو، اسے مسہ کلو میٹر نبی نا علم کاریم کرو، ایرا مٹر کلو میٹر نبی نا علم کاریم کرو، یعقوب علیہ السلام ارا ٹی زنٹاو کا، یوسف نا عاشق ئس کا، پریشان ئس یوسف نا سوا، دزینگ سے نا کا، تینیم دو تے بٹیک ئس تینا مار ئے۔
en: If he had knowledge of the unseen, the prophet's knowledge would have worked over one or three kilometers; the prophet's knowledge would have worked over two or three kilometers. Jacob, peace be upon him, was in the house... he was in love with Yusuf, he was distressed without Yusuf... and he himself had let his son go.
en_old: If he had knowledge of the unseen, the prophet's knowledge would work for three kilometers, the prophet's knowledge would work for so many kilometers; Jacob, peace be upon him, was in the house… he was a lover of Yusuf, he was distressed without Yusuf, he was weeping… his son.

brh: ایلو چاکا لیکن اللہ نا قران شاہد ئے یعقوب علیہ السلام ہچڑا خبر اف صرف کست سلوک اللہ تبارک انتے یا اللہ کنے یوسف دانگ ہت یا اللہ کنے یوسف دانگ مبرے او چنا یوسف اللہ نا دا کست ہوئی اینے بکھلوٹ اینے واللہ ہچ پرائی لمتوٹ
en: The others knew, but Allah's Quran is witness that Jacob, peace be upon him, had no knowledge at all; only envy... Allah, the Blessed... 'O Allah, bring Yusuf here to me, O Allah, ... Yusuf here to me.' And the child Yusuf... this envy... by God, nothing...
en_old: The other… but Allah's Quran is witness that Jacob, peace be upon him, knew nothing; he only stood… O Allah, give me Yusuf here, O Allah, bring Yusuf here; that child Yusuf… by God, I did not…

brh: اللہ نی دانگ نہ توئے چار مکو نی یعقوب علیہ السلام پھیری کون تھیئے لیکن یوسف دونٹی تما نی باوہ نبی لیکن نبی خبر تمپک اللہ پانٹی کنے ہر گڑانہ خبرے لیکن نبی ہچڑا خبر تمپک ہاں نبی اگر ئے بنفوا وحی نا ذریعے تو آسمانا راز آتے بنفوا تا اگر بنو
en: O Allah, you... here... Jacob, peace be upon him,... but Yusuf fell into the well. Your father is a prophet, but the prophet does not find out. Allah says, 'I know everything,' but the prophet knows nothing. Yes, if (Allah) makes the prophet hear through revelation, then he makes known the secrets of the heavens, if he hears.
en_old: Allah, you did not put… you, Jacob, peace be upon him… but Yusuf fell into the well; your father is a prophet, but the prophet doesn't know; Allah says, I know everything, but the prophet knows nothing; yes, if the prophet hears through revelation, then he hears the secrets of the heavens…

brh: تو نبی نا کرسی نی خیر نبی نا قبر اصلی فضل وہابی نبی نی منپس دا ہفت اور کنے علم قرآنی دانگا زلیخا دانگا یوسف قالت ہیت لک او یوسف پچی
en: Then the prophet's chair... the prophet's grave... grace... 'Wahhabi, you do not believe in the prophet'... and to me Quranic knowledge... here Zulaikha, here Yusuf: 'She said, come to me' (qalat hayta lak), O Yusuf...
en_old: So the prophet's chair… the prophet's grave, the real grace… Wahhabi, you don't accept the prophet… and the knowledge of the Quran for me… here Zulaikha, here Yusuf, she said, the words… O Yusuf…

brh: پدی خدان تو بر حضرت یوسف سمجھا داسہ کہ زلیخانا نیت خراب ء خندن کھڑی کا گواڑ پرے زلیخا پجی پینی دو پاسہ دان بر زلیخا کر نکم کارم کنے کپسا زلیخا
en: ...'come over'... Hazrat Yusuf understood now that Zulaikha's intention was bad; (she had shut) the windows and doors... Zulaikha... 'come over here'... 'Zulaikha, you will not make me do such a deed, Zulaikha.'
en_old: Then by God, Hazrat Yusuf understood now that Zulaikha's intention was bad… the door… Zulaikha… come here; Zulaikha, don't do such a deed with me, Zulaikha.

brh: موئی تے یاد ارینے ارا تمنا ارک نی نی سر کرے اوراٹی سر کرے نی انت پارے پیپا اکرمی مسوا او زلیخا دانا عزت کیس زلیخا دانا خدمت کیس زلیخا ایت کنے خپ تور ارک نی تو موجود و لیکن خدا تو موجودے زلیخا
en: 'Do you remember in which house you grew up? He brought you up, in the house he brought you up. What did he say? "Akrimi mathwahu": O Zulaikha, honor this one, Zulaikha, serve this one.' Zulaikha... (said) '...no one...' — 'You are... present, but God is present, Zulaikha.'
en_old: Do you remember in which house you grew up? You grew up in this house. What did you say…? Zulaikha honored him, Zulaikha served him. Zulaikha said to me, no one sees; you are present, but God is present, Zulaikha.

brh: زلیخا ئے نبی نا مار، کنا باوہ نبی، کنا پیرہ نبی، کنا دادا نبی، زلیخا نن زندگی ٹی گناہ خنتنن، زلیخا دا گناہ غنی خیف کنکے جوانی، ئے ٹکر ٹکر مریو کنکے جوانی، خنتن خنے کا گوینٹ یو
en: Zulaikha, I am the son of a prophet: my father is a prophet, my grandfather is a prophet, my great-grandfather is a prophet. Zulaikha, we have never seen sin in our lives. Zulaikha, this sin... my youth; let my youth be torn to pieces...
en_old: Zulaikha, I am the son of a prophet; my father is a prophet, my grandfather is a prophet, my great-grandfather is a prophet. Zulaikha, we have never seen sin in our lives; Zulaikha, I will not commit this sin; my youth would be torn to pieces…

brh: انت پارے اللہ نا فضل ئ۔ دے نا بابا۔
en: What did he say? 'It is by the grace of God.' ...your father.
en_old: What did he say? By the grace of God. There you go, father.

brh: اللہ ن ئے اللہ ئے کنے اللہ کے خبر اللو کہ دانا نیت ئے دا گرا ئے ہیتم نراٹ پیشن نراٹ ہناٹ اللہ کنے خبر اللو ئے زلیخا ئے اللہ غان پناہ لیوا نا تیر کونوٹ
en: O God, ... I had no idea what her intention was, what this thing was; at that moment I ran, I ran outside, I went. God, I had no idea... Zulaikha... I take refuge in God...
en_old: O God, God, I had no idea what his intention was, what this thing was. At that moment I ran, I ran outside. God, I had no idea. Zulaikha... I seek refuge in God.

brh: نا ایر غوران پونگوٹ، نا اوراٹی رہنگانوٹ، ئے دونو کاریم کنے کپرا، ہرا اوراٹی کنیو، اونا نمکے کنیو، ہمو مائی ٹی ہمو اوراٹی تین نظرے خراب کیو، ہڑائی تو ظالم سمرے وا، اللہ سے ظالماتے کامیاب کپک، زلیخا یاد کر ئے
en: I grew up in your care, I have lived in your house; I will not do such a deed. In the house where I eat, whose salt I eat, in that very house should I cast an evil eye? Then I would be counted a wrongdoer; Allah does not make wrongdoers succeed. Zulaikha, remember...
en_old: I grew up in your care, I lived in your house; I will not do such a deed; in the house where I eat, whose salt I eat, in that same house I will not cast an evil glance; then I would be a wrongdoer; Allah does not grant success to wrongdoers; Zulaikha, remember.

brh: ئے یعقوب نا مار ئے یوسف علیہ السلام مریو نین خڑک بریو زلیخا ئے ہچ نا گونڈے بننگ کپرا زلیخا تگرنی بفسہ ئے بریوا کوٹی تو چنک گران نا نرسہ خندن یوسف نا کھڑنگا گواہ ئے کنا اللہ
