en: 'I am the son of Jacob, I am Yusuf, peace be upon him; should I come near you? Zulaikha, I cannot come for anything.' Zulaikha... came into the room... then a small child... running... is witness to Yusuf..., my Allah.
en_old: I am the son of Jacob, I am Yusuf, peace be upon him… come near… Zulaikha cannot do anything… Zulaikha… came into the room, then a small child… is the witness of Yusuf standing, my Allah.

brh: ایلم کنے کسف او زر کنے باز جوان ئس کا لیکن اینو ننا دا مصیبت آٹی پھاسینگاوٹا ئے کنا اللہ دونٹی بھڈی نوسٹ کھوسٹ کنے جوان ئس کا لیکن دا عذاب آک دا بھلا گناہ ٹی تو پھاسینگاوٹا ئے کنا اللہ دا اثران کا دا سکن کا
en: [Yusuf prays:] If the brothers had killed me, it would have been much better for me, but today I have been caught in this calamity of ours, O my God. In the well, [being clawed and torn apart] would have been good for me, but [these] torments, I have been caught in this great sin, O my God, this influence, this [unclear]...
en_old: Brother, my sisters and gold were very good to me, but today we're trapped in this trouble, my God. Even old, worn-out clothes were fine by me, but these torments have trapped me in this great sin, my God, because of this effect, this hardship.

brh: او زلیخا بس ئے رنگ نہ روڈ حکم مستو حکم مستو سنٹ دے پئی یوسف گردی کپا او یوسفا ہراتم ایلو نہ چاقو تو نازیہ سلو کسر اینے بچویڑ تو نہ چٹی اینے بچویڑ داسم اینے بچو گردی کپا پیسے تو بندڑ دادے گوٹی ڈیپ
en: And Zulaikha, just... the command came, the command came... 'Yusuf, don't [unclear]. O Yusuf, when the others stood over you with a knife on the road, [who] saved you then? [unclear] ... [who] saved you? Now too [I will] save you; don't [unclear]... when [they] tied [you] up and [threw] this one into the well...'
en_old: O Zulaikha, just... the order came, the order came... O Yusuf, don't turn around. O Yusuf, when the other one with a knife... on the road, save me... save me... don't turn around... the people, throw him into the well.

brh: بند اوٹ را عنقاب، ئے اسوداسہ نت تے زور ایت، نرنگ نا کاریم، دودینگ دروازہ غے نا کاریم، دو نہ خلنگ نا کاریم، نہ دو تون ترے ٹکو ٹکو کننگ نی پیشن کشنگ کنا خدانا کاریم، دے ننا مہربانی، دے ننا بابا
en: I am shut in, O [unclear]; O [God], now give strength to [my] feet. Running is the task, [opening] the door is the task, not laying a hand [on her] is the task, not cutting [anything] to pieces with the hand... getting you out is my God's work. This is [His] kindness to us, [our] elders.
en_old: I am bound, O punishment... make these feet strong. The fleeing was the work, the door opening was the work, not touching with the hand was the work, not cutting into pieces with the hand; you being pulled out was my God's work. It's His kindness to us, father.

brh: ننے دے ہلو ہلو زمست دستگیر نی توار کے خاص کرے دا پیرنگاک نا پیرنگا بللاغاک صفا پیرنگاک کہ ہفتاد سال آن بڑزا جوپے لٹ بند کے
en: 'Help us, help us, [O] Dastgir!' — they make this call, especially these old men, the elders, the really old men who are over seventy years of age and [lean on] a stick.
en_old: We were rescued. Dastgir, you specially called out to these old men, the elders, really old men over seventy years old, leaning on their sticks.

brh: او پنج مولوی مغز خلیرے تون تن نا ابا بس نم پاو ہمت کہ ئے ئے نمائے فانی ہیلپر اوڑے خلے کہیسہ قبر ٹی ملائکہ کتر تیروس ننے رحم بن ٹی قبر ٹی خلیرے قیامت نا میدان ٹی لرزوس پیری ٹی
en: And the five mullahs argue with [you], with their own father... just you say it, have courage: 'O, O, your mortal helper — he himself dies.' In the grave the angels will [unclear] you; [who will] have mercy on us in the grave? You will be afraid in the grave; on the plain of Judgment Day you will tremble, [unclear].
en_old: And the five mullahs were racking their brains along with the father: just say it, have courage... In the grave the angels will strike us; have mercy on us in the grave. We will tremble on the field of Judgment Day.

brh: دا عقیدئے ٹائٹ کا، شرکن تے نی بتف، اللہ غان سوا پین دے امید تخپا، کہ کنے کاریم ایتوئے، لایغنی مولا عن مولا شیئا، اللہ پانتی ہچکس، کس کس نا دوست ئس سنگت ئس کس ئس قیامت ئے مدد کس نی کپوئے، ئے خدا کہ رحم کرے تو ٹھیک ئے
en: Make this belief firm, cast off shirk, and don't place your hope in anyone other than God [thinking] he will get your work done for you. 'The day when no friend will avail a friend in anything.' Other than God, no one: no one's friend, companion, or anyone will help you on the Day of Judgment. O God, if He has mercy, then all is well.
en_old: Make this belief firm and break down shirk. Don't put your hope in anyone except God to get your work done. 'No friend will be of any use to a friend at all.' No one except God. No one's friend or companion will help you on the Day of Judgment. Only if God has mercy will it be fine.

brh: خدا رحم ہموتے کے کیرا دنیا ٹی دے خدا اعتبار کرے اور اول علم ٹھیڑی ٹی طالب خوانا رے ٹھیڑی ٹی منگنور ٹی ٹھیڑی طالب آ خوانارا خلق را کل مشرک پیر پرست قبرا تے سجدہ کرے را آخری وعظ منبو منا درخت ہمو
en: God has mercy on those who trust God in this world. And at first, [religious] knowledge: in Theri, students were studying, in Theri, in Mangnor, in Theri, they were studying as students. The people were all polytheists and saint-worshippers; they used to prostrate to graves. The last sermon... that tree.
en_old: God has mercy on those who put their trust in God in this world. At first there was knowledge in Tehri; a student studied in Tehri, in Mangochar Tehri. The people were all polytheists and saint-worshippers who bowed down to graves. The last sermon... that tree.

brh: او دے ہمو قبرستان سے من قبر ہریے اف لیکن درخت آتے براہوئی کے اللہ نو، بابا دا کھوبین او داتے دو خلپیری، چنکا چناتے پاریرا کہ شنک ئس تے کشپیری، ہر کس کشکا کور مریک منڈ مریک، کھے براہوئی کے درخت اکھائے کھرے نہ درخت، اوڑے کھرے
en: And there was a graveyard there with no graves at all, but trees, which the Brahuis [regarded as] God's: 'Father, these are [unclear], and don't touch them.' They used to tell little children, 'Don't pull even a twig off them; whoever pulls one goes blind and lame.' A tree which in Brahui is called the tamarisk tree — there was a tamarisk there.
en_old: And there was a graveyard there, without any graves, but there were trees that the Brahuis called God's: father, these are sacred, don't touch them. They told little children not to pull off a single branch, because whoever pulls one goes blind and crippled. There was a tree there, a tree.

brh: دا ہما کک، کرے نا درخت آ خلیرہ، مچو خلق خلیرہ، دا کفانا ٹھیڑی ٹی دادے خبر تما ہر گڑا نا، کہ دا کرے تے ڈھچڑاف، دا ہر گڑا خدا نا دوٹی، ہمنگا بسپارے نا جہاد کروئی ئے ئنا درختاتے گڈوئی ئے قصبہ ولو۔
en: These [people] fear the tamarisk tree; all the people fear it. [But] this [man] in Theri knew everything: that these tamarisks are nothing, that everything is in God's hands. So he said, 'Jihad must be done; the trees of the town must be cut down.'
en_old: They are afraid of that karir tree, all the people are afraid of it. In this unbeliever's Tehri he knew everything: that these karir trees can do nothing and everything is in God's hand. So he said we must do jihad, we must cut down the trees of the town.

brh: اما کل غریب آ شرک تیو دا دبس پلمہ پجی پلمہ اینو یلہ درتت گون بے باوا ہم مسنے انتئے تنے کور منڈ کیسہ قران اتھورے ونے ایمبیس دا پلمہ
en: But all the poor people were [committing] shirk... [unclear]... today... let go... [unclear]... also happened... why would it make you blind and lame? The Quran... [unclear].
en_old: But all the poor people were committing shirk... today... why would it make you blind and crippled? The Quran...

brh: دا پینو جہاد کروئی ئے باقی فانی ونسی کے لمہ تروں کہ ایڑ چئی کرے ہرے گا چئی کرے زانگ مخلوقے خلق والا دے کلے خبر تما کلے کے مخلوقے خبر تما
en: This is another jihad that must be done; the rest are mortal... mother... the sister found out, whoever found out... the people, the folk, they all came to know; all the people came to know.
en_old: This is the jihad that has to be done; the rest... mother... brother... All the people knew, all the creatures knew.

brh: کنا ایلم آ کنا دوست آ کلے کے خبر تمے بس کھنوم کرے مے درختاتے سلیسس مار کوپے بفیس بفیس کور منڈ مرے سا درختاتے دو خلپیس انو چتری سرفیسس تیز کریسس مرغنو لٹیس چتریس تیزو
en: My brothers, my friends, everyone came to know. They just [said], 'Don't cut the trees, son, don't, don't — you will go blind and lame; don't touch the trees.' Today he had sharpened the axe, a long-handled axe, a sharp one.
en_old: My brothers, my friends, everyone knew. They just said: don't cut the trees, don't do it, don't, you'll go blind and crippled. Don't touch the trees. Today I sharpened the axe, a sharp axe...

brh: پئے بس کور مرے و منڈ مرے اینو درختاتے لوئی خساتیں بسم اللہ کرے یا اللہ اچ اکپیس کنے اگر دیخ نتس کن پنانا پئے بس ہنا کلہ غوخ کنے سائیو منڈ کریتہ اینا بسم اللہ کرے اسئے درختے گڈا چھتری اینو تیزس
en: [He said,] 'So let [me] just go blind and lame; today the trees [will be cut down].' He said Bismillah: 'O Allah, if [unclear] me... then fine... [even if I am] made lame...' He said Bismillah [and went at] one tree; and the axe was sharp that day.
en_old: So let me go blind and crippled; today I will cut the trees. He said Bismillah: O God... if... then today the axe is sharp.

brh: کھرے بش کنا نن کے خلک تا کھرے تما ابو نت کنا خلٹ کے نت کنا لمہ تا پی ابو چنانے باتوت دا نت پیرغی خور کے زیشتم بے زیشتم پر نت کنا پنا
en: The tamarisk [stood]... he struck it, the tamarisk fell. 'Father, my foot!'... 'my foot, mother!'... the father [told] the children... this foot [will] break... my foot... [unclear].
en_old: ...my foot... my mother's... the father said to the children... my name...

brh: کل مخرہ بسم اللہ کرے ٹھوکا الوئے گڈا ہائے ہائے دو کے نوسو مننگ ٹی لڑسہ لڑسہ مسٹمی کو گڈا کل پنچ سو روپئی پنچ گڈا جک کل پیش تما نعرہ تکبیر اللہ اکبر نہ دو کے نہ منڈے نہ نٹ کے نہ منڈے وڑ پیش تما دا خدا نا زور و پیر دا تھمکا دا پیر نا تھپکا
en: Everyone [watched]; he said Bismillah, struck a blow, then 'hai hai'... the hand... [the tree] shaking, shaking... the third [blow]... then all... five hundred rupees, five... then everyone came out: 'Cry of Takbir! God is great!' Neither his hand became lame nor his foot became lame; he came out just like that. This is God's power — and the saint, this is the saint's [so-called] slap.
en_old: Everyone... he said Bismillah and struck a blow, then 'hai hai'... fighting and fighting... then five hundred rupees... then all the people came out, with the slogan Takbir, Allahu Akbar. He wasn't crippled in his hand or his foot; he came out like that. This is God's power, and this is the saint's slap.

brh: دا آخر شرک تے مسلمان تباہ ئے ئے دا یوسف علیہ السلام نڑنگ شروع کرے تن کے خلق دروازہ نا تن کے خلق دروازہ نا زلیخا رندٹ یوسف علیہ السلام مونی اینو مے نڑفوا امتحان ہرے آ
en: So in the end, shirk is the ruin of Muslims. Now Yusuf (peace be upon him) started running toward the door, toward the door: Zulaikha behind, Yusuf (peace be upon him) in front. Today [I'll make you] run — look at the test!
en_old: In the end, shirk is the ruin of Muslims. Yusuf, peace be upon him, started running toward the door; Zulaikha was behind and Yusuf, peace be upon him, was ahead. Today... where is the test?

brh: وا نن نن نن رنگ کے نا سوالی پیدانس منڈ منڈ کروئی مدام مدان سلوئے کہ خڑک برے خنیائے دن تے پیسے کہ جوجو کا نہارا کنور نی کمر تٹی ٹی وی ئے جمان نن کے مریک مزا زنڈو گدا دے
en: Well, we, we... how a question arises... [he] must be made lame... always stands... that he came near and saw... [unclear]... you [have] the TV in your room... it becomes fun for us... [unclear].
en_old: ...a question arose... he must be made crippled... always... he came near and saw... TV...

brh: ٹھیک تھروک آنسہ خن تے برزا او توبے روچ نا نو کے دنو ربک نو کے دادے خنک ہر گناہ نا کاری مسلمان کننگے ہمورک ننا دعا غاک ہم مفسا یوسف علیہ السلام ہفتمیکو دروازہ غا سرمس خصاتے
en: ...raise [your] eyes upward and [repent]: by day and by night the Lord sees it, every sinful deed a Muslim does; that is why our prayers too are not answered. Yusuf (peace be upon him) reached the seventh door...
en_old: ...raise your eyes up; day and night the Lord sees it, every sinful act a Muslim commits, and then our prayers are not answered either. Yusuf (peace be upon him) reached the seventh door...

brh: زلیخا خیر کوسٹی تدوئی شاغا یوسف خسا تنی یوسف علیہ السلام کدارا دوئم لپ کرے پی نظار بو نا کوس مچو ہرنگا بج پاش اللہ نا نبی پیش تما آخری جملہ عزیز سلوک اتانگن زلیخا ہم سا
en: Zulaikha [grabbed] the back of the shirt with her hand... Yusuf... Yusuf (peace be upon him) [ran] a second time... the shirt was all torn, the back laid open; God's prophet got out. The last sentence: the Aziz was standing over there, and Zulaikha too...
en_old: Zulaikha... Yusuf... Yusuf, peace be upon him... a second time... the whole city found out; God's prophet was proven innocent. The last sentence: the Aziz... Zulaikha too...

brh: سر مس، عزیز نا پٹ سا پٹ سا دروازہ غا سر مسونے، تو زلیخا خنا ارغ کنا سلوکے، ارغ تون ہیت کننگ شروع کرے کہ ہر دادے، زوری درین کن، زوری نرانٹ۔ یوسف علیہ السلام نا خنتن خڑینکاک ویرا، پارے: اللہ، دا ولدا مصیبت نا کٹے کنے تما۔ ارغ نا ضعیفہ نا پاننگ الو کنے
en: He reached it, and the Aziz, searching and searching, had arrived at the door. Then Zulaikha saw her husband standing there and began talking to her husband: 'Look at this one! He was taking me by force; I barely got away.' Tears flowed from the eyes of Yusuf (peace be upon him), and he said, 'O Allah, this calamity has fallen on me again. What the [Aziz's] wife says will...
en_old: He reached it, and the Aziz had come knocking at the door. When Zulaikha saw her husband standing there, she started telling him, 'This one tried to take me by force, I was running away from him.' Tears came from Yusuf's (peace be upon him) eyes, and he said, 'O Allah, do not throw this calamity on me again. What the Aziz's wife is saying will...

brh: بدنام کرور، قیامت اسکان بنداک پارور کہ نبی نا مار، نبی نا زون، گناہ نا کاریم ئس کرے، اللہ پارے یوسف گنتی کپہ، پریشان مننگ نا ضرورت اف، داساں داس نا پاکی بیان کرفیوا، قیامت اسکان ہر کلمہ والا پارو کہ یوسف پاک ئے یوسف علیہ السلام
en: ...disgrace [me]; until the Day of Judgment people will say that a prophet's son, a prophet's [offspring], committed a sinful deed.' Allah said, 'Yusuf, don't worry; there is no need to be troubled. Right now I will have your purity proclaimed, and until the Day of Judgment everyone who recites the Kalima will say that Yusuf (peace be upon him) is pure.'
en_old: ...disgrace me. Until the Day of Judgment people will say that a prophet's son, a prophet's own, committed a sin.' Allah said, 'Yusuf, do not worry, there is no need to be troubled. Right now I will have your purity declared, and until the Day of Judgment every believer will say that Yusuf, peace be upon him, is pure.'

brh: ہم پاکے خوبصورت تو زلیخا نا یوسف پاکے سئی کنا داتے نہ سال نہ کو برادری نہ کو علم کنا داتے کسے پئی خدا کرے ت غوانزٹی چمکو چناس خاچوکے اللہ ہمودے بش کرے زنڈوے او معصومہ چنا نی بش مر دوئی تو نائے لیکن حکم کنائے
en: He is pure and beautiful too... Zulaikha's... my Yusuf is pure and true. 'These [witnesses] of mine have no years, no community, no knowledge.' God arranged it: a small child was asleep in a cradle; Allah woke that one up: 'O innocent child, wake up; it is yours to do, but the command is mine.'
en_old: Yusuf is pure and beautiful too. Zulaikha's Yusuf is pure and true. 'This one of mine has no years, no community, no knowledge...' God willed that a small child was sleeping in a cradle, and Allah woke it: 'O innocent child, wake up. The tongue is yours, but the command is mine.'

brh: طاقت امیت و نیت کننگ نا معصومہ چنا بش مس عزیز دانگن سلوکے زلیخا دانگن سلوکے یوسف نا مون شیف اٹ اللہ ئے کواسٹ کن کے جوان اللہ ئے کواسٹ کن کے جوان دانگن چنکا چنا ہیت کننگ شروع کرے وشہد شاہد من
en: [Allah gave him] the power of speech; the innocent child woke up. The Aziz was standing here, Zulaikha was standing here, Yusuf's face was lowered, calling on Allah: '[make it] good', calling on Allah: '[make it] good'. Here the little child began to speak: 'And a witness testified...'
en_old: ...the power, the hope and the intention... The innocent child woke up. The Aziz was standing here, Zulaikha was standing here, and Yusuf's face was lowered as he called on Allah: 'Allah is good, Allah is good.' Then the small child began to speak: 'And a witness testified...'

brh: چنکا بس بس آخری جملہ گاکو۔ عزیزہ نی ہرتوماتا نریپا بیانی کنا بن۔ اگر یوسف نا کوس مونا ہریغانے تو اسنا زلیخا سچاک کنا یوسف دروغ ترو۔ یوسف زوری زلیخا غا لچانے۔ زلیخا مونا کوسے درانے نڑانے۔
en: The little one [said]: 'Just, just [this is my] last sentence. Aziz, you [stay] and listen to my statement. If Yusuf's shirt has been torn at the front, then Zulaikha is truthful and my Yusuf is lying: Yusuf grabbed Zulaikha by force, and Zulaikha tore his shirt at the front and ran away.'
en_old: The small child said, 'Just one last sentence. Aziz, listen to my statement. If Yusuf's shirt is torn in the front, then Zulaikha is truthful and my Yusuf lied, because Yusuf would have attacked Zulaikha by force and Zulaikha tore his shirt from the front as she ran.

brh: دا نعرہ چنا جھلاپینے زلیخا راست اورنا یوسف کنا دروغبر لیکن عزیز ئے تخم دورتو سہی اگر یوسف نا کوس خیر نا درنگوک ئے گڑا زلیخا دروغ پر کنا یوسف راست پایک یوسف نعرانی زلیخا خیر انت لے
en: [The verdict] the child declared: [in that case] Zulaikha is truthful and my Yusuf a liar. 'But Aziz, [look] carefully: if Yusuf's shirt is torn at the back, then Zulaikha is lying and my Yusuf is telling the truth — Yusuf was fleeing, so what [was] Zulaikha [doing] behind him?'
en_old: The child gave this verdict, whether Zulaikha is truthful and my Yusuf a liar: 'But Aziz, look carefully. If Yusuf's shirt is torn from the back, then Zulaikha is the liar and my Yusuf tells the truth. Yusuf was running away, so what was Zulaikha doing behind him?'

brh: چانے زلے یوسف نڑانے کھیرن کوستے چھکانے کوستے ترانے گڑنا ضعیفہ دروغ ترنچی کنا یوسف راست بائک عزیز بن چنانے گپاتے زلیخا مونی شیف کرے یوسفے یقین مس کہ خدانا مہربانی غیبی مدد کنا زی بسونے حضرت یوسف
en: Zulaikha [chased him]; Yusuf was running; she pulled the shirt from the back and tore the shirt; then the woman is lying and my Yusuf is telling the truth.' The Aziz heard the child's words. Zulaikha lowered her face. Yusuf became certain that God's kindness, [His] unseen help, had come to him. Hazrat Yusuf...
en_old: But if Zulaikha chased him while Yusuf ran, and she tore the shirt from the back, then the woman lied and my Yusuf tells the truth.' The Aziz heard the child's words. Zulaikha lowered her face. Yusuf became certain: 'God's grace and unseen help have come to me.' Hazrat Yusuf...

brh: مچو تنے چہرے برزا کرے پارے یوسف دان تو بر حضرت یوسف مون تینا مون ئنا وڑا بٹنا تے دو لگوک افک کھوس ہیچڑا خاصگی افک خیر اندن پی خیر تنے دان کا بج تنے دان کر مچو نبینہ کھوس و خیر ختم ئے بج تا مچو جان تلوچے خیرن کھوسے مچو ہرانے
en: Everyone raised their faces, [and he] said, 'Yusuf, come here.' Hazrat Yusuf's front — at the front, the buttons had no hand touching them; the shirt had nothing unusual. 'Now the back: turn your back here, turn your back here.' The back of the shirt was completely done for; the back was all [torn]; she had torn the shirt from the back completely.
en_old: Everyone raised their faces and said, 'Yusuf, come here.' Hazrat Yusuf's front, the front of his shirt, had no hand marks on it and nothing unusual. 'Now look at the back, turn around here.' The whole back of the shirt was torn; they all saw that the back of the shirt was torn.

brh: کنا ایلم آک عزیز پارے زلیخا نون سال بولاک بلو مکرے لورے نما مکراتون کس مقابلہ کننگ کپک او یوسفا اللہ نا ذات نا قسم کنا ایلم آک کنا دوستاک پارے یوسف معاف کر یوسفا کنے بدنام کپیس کنا ضعیف نا مسئلہ
en: My brothers, the Aziz said, 'Zulaikha, the guile of you women is great; no one can compete with your guile.' And, 'O Yusuf, by the essence of Allah' — my brothers, my friends — he said, 'Yusuf, forgive; O Yusuf, don't disgrace me; it is my wife's matter.'
en_old: My brothers, the Aziz said, 'Zulaikha, the guile of you women is great. No one can match your guile.' And 'O Yusuf, by the being of Allah,' my brothers, my friends, he said, 'Yusuf, forgive. O Yusuf, do not disgrace me, this is my wife's matter.

brh: اگر بندغاتے صحیح کریس تو کہ بندغہ کرے ملنڈ خلور پارور عزیز نا ضعیفہ او نوکر عزیز نا مسنے او یوسفا زلیخا زو کر معافی ہٹ کنا یوسف نا قصور مچو ناء کنا یوسف پاکی
en: If you tell people [about it], then people will mock and say [that] the Aziz's wife and the Aziz's servant got [involved]. O Yusuf... Zulaikha, quickly ask for forgiveness; it is not my Yusuf's fault at all; my Yusuf is pure.'
en_old: If you tell people, they will mock me and say that the Aziz's wife and the Aziz's servant... O Yusuf. Zulaikha, quickly ask for forgiveness, it is not my Yusuf's fault at all, my Yusuf is pure.'

brh: خدا نا طاقت رے آ نما سہارا دیرے داسہ مشکل سیٹی دیرے تما کین پریشانی سیٹی پڈس خلک کرے درود خوان رے قران خوان رے یا مشن لپس کونی رے پا مشکم پنا برینج اللہ ئے تکنے نسو
en: God's power, which is your support: now whoever has fallen into difficulty, whoever is in distress, [unclear]... recite durood, recite the Quran, or [unclear]... Allah... [unclear].
en_old: By God's power, may He be your support. Now in difficulty, do not lose hope. In distress, recite durood, recite the Quran... and call on Allah.

brh: کونے نا، بھرج کونے نا، شربت کونے نا، لیکن سویدے تے نا خدا نا کہ اللہ نمے آباد کے، نما علاقہ ئے آباد کے، اللہ مدرسہ ئے آباد کے، بزرگ آک تمام باز ٹولوک آن شاء اللہ شکر کبو کہ اگر مچو نن قران نا تلاوت مرے، وعظ آک مرے، تو اللہ نا نعمت آتین نن خوب الون، مچ کرون تے کہ جوکہ گونی تے گونی تے بندہ مچ کیک جوانی گا
en: ...for the food, for the rice we ate, for the sherbet we drank. But [we ask] of God that Allah keep you prosperous, keep your area prosperous, and that Allah keep the madrasa flourishing. Elders and all the many people seated here, God willing, give thanks that if all of us have recitation of the Quran and sermons are held, then we will receive Allah's blessings in plenty; we will gather them, the way a person gathers goodness by the sackful.
en_old: ...for the food, for the bread, for the sherbet. But pray to God that Allah makes you prosperous, makes your area prosperous, and that Allah makes the madrasa flourish. The elders and all the big gatherings, God willing, let us be thankful that if we all have Quran recitation and sermons, we will do well with Allah's blessings. We gather them the way a person gathers sacks, for the good.

brh: داسی خا زلیخا غستے مچے ئے واپس بریو رزان سے لوک مریر دیگ تیار مرے ایراغاتے بسس ئے بینگن مریو ہزو او جانے خدا دے نی آن پریس ئے بریت مچے زو بریس آن
en: Now, Zulaikha... I'll come back for all of it. There will be dishes, the pot will be ready, the bread had come... I'll get hungry... Oh dear, by God, ... you, come back quickly.
en_old: Then Zulaikha... everyone comes back... people will be there, the pot will be ready... eggplant... God knows... come back quickly.

brh: دا دیگ نی چکوئی نا بچے بیت زیادہ ئے یا کم ئے کس کنا جیب ء خلکونے جیب ء کنا کس خلکونے جیب ء کنا کس خلکونے جادو کنا جیب ٹی ارے اڑے اڑے
en: This pot, you... is it more or is it less? Someone has picked my pocket! Someone has picked my pocket, someone has picked my pocket! There's magic in my pocket! Hey, hey!
en_old: This pot that you... is it more or less? Someone has put their hand in my pocket, someone has put their hand in my pocket, someone has put their hand in my pocket! There is magic in my pocket, hey, hey!

brh: پوتونک کسہ نی کسہ نا پوتونکا درفتنوٹ پوتونکا تے تو ابا کنا ارفے شہر اینا نرا ہلی کنے ئے پاوے ہلی کنے آئی کنا نی ہمبلو جن اسے اگر توار کریٹ تو نم کٹنے انت نی
en: The bundle... whose... your bundle? I didn't pick up the bundles. Then Father picked up mine and went off to the city... he ran off. 'Take me,' I say, 'take me!' Mother... You're such a big jinn; if I shout, then what will you do?
en_old: Grandchildren... your story's grandchildren... My father took me to the city... he said, 'Let me go, let me go'... you big jinn, if I shout, then what will you do?

brh: ایم ئے یم الئی ئے نی یم ہاؤ ئے یم ئنا داڑے گڑا پاریس کہ نا ہر شرط کنے منظور ئے مرزا صاحب پین وقت کن تو دونو ہیت کپیس
en: ...yes... here you then said, 'Every condition of yours is acceptable to me.' Mirza sahib, another time don't say such things.
en_old: ...here you said that I accept your every condition. Mirza sahib, don't talk like that another time.

brh: انتئے کہ ثناء کنے باز، باز کنے باز دوست ئے ہا، ابا، پیرو شار ایننگٹی، شار باز بلو نی دن کہ ماما شیر خان شار اینا اوڑتو اینگا، دمف پیرو ہم شار اینا
en: Because I love Sana very, very much. Yes, Father: Piro going to the city... the city is very big. You're just like Uncle Sher Khan, who went to the city, and [someone] went with him; now Piro too has gone to the city.
en_old: Because Sana loves me very, very much. Yes, father, about bringing Piro to the city: the city is very big. You are like Uncle Sher Khan, who brought him from the city... so Piro was brought to the city too.

brh: ننا ہنوئی گونگوئی اور پیرو کونا سادہ انگا بندغاک شار ٹی زو گونگرہ
en: We're bound to go and get lost there; simple people like Piro get lost quickly in the city.
en_old: When we go around there, Piro's simple people quickly get lost in the city.

brh: او عمر گنوک تو متنس
en: Oh Umar, you haven't gone crazy, have you?
en_old: He, Umar, wasn't crazy though.

brh: شار اینا جوان جوانینگا گواینگر نیتو سادہ مار اسوس ہائے الے تکائے خفتے بے ہائے الے تکائے او او چپیٹ نی نہ شار خنانوس نہ شار والا تے خنانوس او بندغے ہندن قبضہ کیرہ دن
en: [He] went to the city, the really fine ones there... you were just a simple boy. Ow, let go... my ears... ow, let go! Oh, oh, a slap! You have neither seen the city nor seen the city people, and that is just how they take hold of a person.
en_old: The city has really fine-looking girls, and you were just a simple boy. Hey, don't, wait! Hey, don't, wait! And on the left... You've never seen the city or the city's people. That's how they take hold of a person.

brh: کہ باوے نا ڈین قبضہ کرے او نا عشق ٹی نی ہم گیرم کرے کنے ہم گیرم کرے پیرو ہم گیر بلکہ مچا شار والا تے گیرم کرے ولے آئی نی ہم تو ہا پا پا پا داسہ نا مطلب انتے باوے نا مگر ئے مڑے
en: ...that she took hold of Father's [heart], and in his love for her he forgot you too, he forgot me too, Piro too; in fact he forgot all the people of the town. But Mother, you too, then... yes, say it, say it, say it! Now what do you mean, that Father's... ?
en_old: When Father's land was seized, you were caught up in his love too, and so was I, and Piro too. In fact the whole city's people were caught up in it. But Mother, you too... ha pa pa pa. Now what does this mean, that Father's... turned?

brh: داٹ کشاٹ تا؟ ہائے خالی نا دو ئنا ماما تام دو ئنا آئی نم تیرا جگ او جھیڑے الے بو کدا فیصلہ ئے کبو۔ ہنا مامر او فیصلہ سے کنا پوتوک کتاف کنا پوچاتے تخ۔ او ابائے پٹ
en: I pulled it out with this? Oh, your hand is empty... Uncle... your hand... Mother, all of you, stop your arguing and quarrelling and make some decision. Yes, Uncle, the decision is: tie up my bundle, pack my clothes, and [I'll] go look for Father.
en_old: Who pulled at this? Hey, empty-handed... uncle, the time... mother, you... the quarrel, don't, come on, make the decision. Hey uncle, a decision that won't ruin my grandchildren, keep my... and look for Father.

brh: او ٹی وٹیف شارن۔ ماری نی مالو پارٹ، دا شار اوستن تے نہ کشی ماماک نا زوت ئے نور، باوا نا نلی خٹی چٹے شاغور گرسات اورتے۔ آئی، ابا نا باروٹی دنو اسکا پی اسکا، ابا نا مسڑ چالاک کنے رس۔
en: ...in the city. ...you said earlier that this city... from the heart... the uncles'... Father's... they will throw... Mother, about Father, like this... Father's daughter is clever; get me there.
en_old: Settle in there, in the city. Mari, you said before that this city... uncle's... Father's... Mother, about Father like this... Father's clever daughter, it reached me.

brh: باوہ کتنو استوشسے، نیکن کہ استوشسے، نہ ایلم کہ، چپ کہ گمہ، آن خاچ، بشہ بشہ، بشہ، بشہ کہ نما تروٹنا چپلس، چھالاک دھاڑا، پو، نی بر، نی بر خاچ۔
en: Father hasn't done [it]... no, brother, be quiet... now sleep... enough, enough... your... sandals... clever... come, you come and sleep.
en_old: Father didn't... a heart for you, don't, brother, be quiet, sleep, good, good, good... your slipper, clever... you come, you come and sleep.

brh: بس ابا کڑائی تو نیامٹی سلی انشاءاللہ آئی ادا بائے ادا بائے انشاءاللہ او نی نی نی نی ارے ہلی نی ارے ہمت ہلی
en: Enough, Father, the fighting will stop between [us], God willing. Mother... brother, come, brother, come, God willing. Oh you, you, you, you... hey, hold on, you, hey, take courage.
en_old: Enough, father, God willing the fighting will settle down between them. Come here, come here, God willing. And you... you have courage, take courage.

brh: بل بروئے، بلک تمن ئے ہا؟ چپ کا خاچ، ولدا نشار نا پنت و نصحت آتے گٹ کرو، خاچی وائے خاچی وی
en: Let it be, he'll come... right? Be quiet and sleep; then he'll take up the advice and counsel about the city. I'm sleeping, let me sleep.
en_old: Come, brother, whatever happens, huh? Be quiet and sleep, then forget the city's advice and counsel. Sleep, just sleep.

brh: بر بر ویلکم۔ دا ننا افس ئے واہ زبردست۔ ہمم کم آن، گدرینگ گدرینگ گدرینگ ہک ہک۔
en: Come in, come in, welcome. This is our office. Wow, terrific. Hmm, come on, go on through, go on through, go on through. Hic, hic.
en_old: Come in, come in, welcome. This is our office. Wow, amazing. Hmm, little by little, go on, go on... hic, hic.

brh: اچھا دا پابو، چا، کافی یا کولڈ ڈرنک؟ فی الحال تو ہچ موڈ افک۔ دن تو مننگ کپک، نی کنا مہمان ئس داڑے
en: Okay, tell [me] this: tea, coffee or a cold drink? For now I'm not in the mood for anything. That can't be; you're my guest here.
en_old: Okay, tell me: tea, coffee or a cold drink? I'm not in the mood for anything right now. That can't be, you're my guest here.

brh: پاس یا ریسٹورنٹ اٹ۔ نن صبح نوریہ نا ناشتہ کریٹ ہندا خاطر۔ بازو ناشتہ کتنس؟ بس سلارانی گری خلنگانوس تندرے ڈک شام نا۔ ہندا خاطر دہ سے یک بجہ نا خن کنا ملنگارک۔ اچھا۔
en: Nearby or at a restaurant. We had breakfast at Nooriya's this morning, that's why. Haven't you had much breakfast? Just... until the evening. That's why my eyes [only] opened around eleven o'clock. Okay.
en_old: Nearby or at a restaurant. We had breakfast at Noorya's this morning, that's why. Did you have a big breakfast? Just... I've been eating since the evening. That's why my friends met me at around ten or one o'clock. Okay.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ ثناء! جی۔ دا نظام ء۔ شوروم نا کاریم کیک اور ٹھیکیداری ہم کیک۔ اور نظام دا ثناء ء۔ احسان صاحب نا مسڑ۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you peace. Sana! Yes. This is Nizam. He runs a showroom business and also does contracting. And Nizam, this is Sana, Ehsan Sahib's daughter.
en_old: Hello. Hello. Sana! Yes. This is Nizam. He runs a showroom and also does contracting work. And Nizam, this is Sana, Mr. Ehsan's daughter.

brh: کنا دیس ماریک تے فارن ہم بسنے۔ دور دور۔ باز جوان باز جوان۔ واپس نم پیری۔ اور اینا گرداڑے نا اوست لگا ٹکڑا۔ شاید ہم پارے۔ نم بے فکر مبو۔ نمے واپسی نا ٹکٹ مل پاروں۔
en: Boys from my country have also come abroad, from far, far away. Very good, very good. You'll be going back. And around here... (unclear). Maybe he said so too. Don't you worry. We'll tell [them] to get you your return ticket.
en_old: Boys from my country have come abroad too, from far away. Very good, very good. You'll go back. And around here... Maybe they said so too. Don't worry. You'll get your return ticket.

brh: خیر دا تو وقت پائکک۔ جمال جان نین پاس دبارو ٹی۔ این پارنگ کے وی ہنو کے ثنا پارے۔ دا فیصلے وقت الینے؟ چلو نم داڑے تولبو گپ شپ خلبو۔ ئے کا یاسمین توم لیو پرے وا۔ تو پین کاری مارے مسنے؟
en: Well, time will tell. Jamal dear, ... (unclear) ... the way Sana said. Have you left this decision to time? Come on, sit down here, let's chat. Hey, Yasmin... So has anything else happened?
en_old: Well, time will tell. Jamal dear, about that... Sana said... Is this decision too late? Come on, sit here and let's chat. Yasmin... So what else happened?

brh: اچھا کنے پا۔ نی فی الحال تو ہچ کاری متفک۔ ہم کہ بندہ کنے خناٹک تو گڑا امیر نا باری ٹی اسہ سوج ئس پسٹ ہلو۔ اچھا۔ جی۔ کان گڑا پیشن بر۔ بر ممتام۔
en: Okay, tell me. You... for now, nothing at all has happened. Also, when someone sees me, then [he'll] ask a question about Amir first. Okay. Yes. Let's go then; come outside. Come, Mumtaz.
en_old: Okay, tell me. You're not doing any work at the moment. Also, when someone sees me, ask a question about Amir. Okay. Yes. Then come outside. Come, Mumtaz.

brh: ئے پیرو نا باوہ ہند پاو نی بد دعا ہم کننگ کپرہ نی کن نا چنا تا باوہ اوس خنے خوار کپر
en: Oh, Piro's father, what can I say like this? I can't even curse you; you are my children's father. Let me not disgrace you.
en_old: Piro's father says this: you can't even curse. He is your children's father, don't humiliate him.

brh: ہلو، دا غا پریشان خننگنگٹی ئس بر سکینہ جان اللہ تنے، اماں سنتوئے تو پریشان ئس
en: Hello, you're looking worried about this. Come, Sakina dear, God... Mother, ... you are worried.
en_old: Hey, why are you looking so worried about this? Come, Sakina dear, God keep you. Mother is fine now, she was just worried.

brh: او کنا ایڑ انتئے پریشان مفہ ہمے کہ پیرو نا باوہ اور ایلہ نا نرہ کلے کاریم تے کنے کروئی تمک اللہ دم اسنگ اینو پگہ نا چناک مگہ ایتیان ہیرے
en: Oh my sister, why wouldn't I be worried? It's that Piro's father went off and ran away, and now all the work has fallen on me to do. God... Nowadays the children, though...
en_old: Oh my sister, why shouldn't I worry? Piro's father and brother... I have to do all the work. God... today and tomorrow, the children...

brh: دا ہت نا راس، جائی ابی غونور دستک نا، ئے لومنتانو شارا، شیر خانی آ تنگی، ہنداڑا تو ئے حیران اف سگینا، ئے تعویزے تینا دوت چٹ سلا تہشت
en: The truth of this matter is... a knock... to the city... Sher Khan's hardship... here, then, he isn't surprised, Sakina... that amulet, with his own hand...
en_old: The line on this hand... a big knock... in the city... Sher Khani... you're not surprised here... the amulet on his hand...

brh: شربتاتے ٹی شغاٹ شربتاتے کنا مونا کنا ایلم کونگور ولدا مہر گونڈ کس کنا اسارتے یفف جائی پینیتس پاونے وانت ماس برکے پیرو تیارئے
en: I put it into the sherbets; my brothers drank the sherbets in front of me. Then ... someone ... my ... said ... come, Piro is ready.
en_old: The sherbets... in front of me, my brother... then love... my... Piro is ready.

brh: پائک کنا پچاتے تفیکا وا شارہ باوے پٹنگ کے کاٹوم نارسنگانی دونو غلطی کپیس چنا مارسے اران شارا رائی کیس تا ولدا سادہ او چنا سے گم مروئی نہ نہ نہ نہ نہ کنا
en: He says, 'Pack up my clothes, I'm going to the city to look for Father.' It doesn't get into [his] head. Don't make such a mistake! Why would you send a little boy off to the city? A simple little child like that is bound to get lost. No, no, no, no, no, my...
en_old: He says, don't give away my children... to look for Father... don't make such a mistake, a little boy... from the city... then a simple little child will get lost. No, no, no, no, no, my...

brh: نی تو توبہ ء اسٹ تو شار ئنا گم ئس اینو اسکپا دورندے تکس کلپ اسٹ تو مار اسے کنا دا سودے تینا دو اندر فو بس خیال کے سیٹھ دون مف کنے چنائے غوس
en: God forbid! You'd get lost in the city... today... you're [just] a boy... this deal of mine... in your own hands... just take care. Seth, don't be like that, ... me the child...
en_old: You should repent... the city's grief today... a boy... this deal of mine is in your hands... I thought, Seth, don't be like this, give me the child...

brh: ہینا؟ آن نی تینے انت سمجانوس؟ انت مس خیر تو ارے؟ نی پیروئے تینا نوکر سمجانوس انت؟ پیرو؟ ارادے پیرو؟
en: What? Who do you think you are? What happened, is everything alright? Do you think Piro is your servant? Piro? Where is Piro?
en_old: What? Who do you think you are? What happened, is everything okay? Do you think Piro is your servant? Piro? Piro?

brh: نم دن کبو، پگہ ببو، ئے نمے پین تعویز ئس ایتیوہ، انشاءاللہ کیرے نا، کاریم کل مریرہ، انشاءاللہ۔ بس سکینہ، پگہ مرفت، پگہ برینہ، کان گلبیدی۔
en: You (all) do this: come tomorrow, and I will give you another amulet; God willing, all your work will get done, God willing. — Okay, Sakina, tomorrow then; we'll come tomorrow. Let's go, Gul Bibi.
en_old: You do this: come tomorrow, I'll give you another amulet. God willing, all your work will get done, God willing. Okay Sakina, tomorrow then, we'll come tomorrow, Gul Bibi.

brh: ہو کنا ایتے جوان جمبنس پگہ تونن برے نولے جوان حساب کتابے خلیس اریسک نتو کنے جوان چسہ کنا پن گل بے بے ئے ہو ہو عیدانہ سنگ
en: Yes, give me a good one. Tomorrow we'll come; settle the account properly, otherwise — you know me well, my name is Gul Bibi. — Yes, yes ... Eid ... (unclear).
en_old: Yes, give it to me nicely, come with us tomorrow, then settle the accounts properly, otherwise... see me well, my name is Gul Bibi. Yes, yes, Eid... friend.

brh: سنگت اوٹ سکینہ سائیں کنا ہیت راست مسے ہاؤ بالکل اونا ہیت راست مسے ادے
en: Friend ... Sakina — sir, my word has come true. — Yes, absolutely, his word has come true, brother.

en: ... my duty ... health ... Let me tell you, Gul Bibi, you know well that all these men are alike. We poor ones ... wherever you tie us, we become of that place.
en_old: ...my duty was health... say, flower, ma'am, you know well that all these men are the same. We are poor... everywhere... you don't... we are of that place.

brh: نکا گڑا نان تھی ننم نرین توبہ کامروٹ کسانی کنا تو است کشاس نا ہیتا کیننو ئے تو انتوم پاننگ اٹٹ بس زواس
en: ... then ... we men too ... God forbid ... my heart, then, you pulled ... they've been talking about you; what am I even saying? Just quickly.
en_old: Then we men will also repent... my heart, did you take it? We will talk about you; what should I tell them? Just quickly.

brh: لو مایات کا او دادے اتیر دا ئس تو تعویز پیر صاحب نا کہ امر کنا علم تے زوشارا مون تروئی تعویز نا تو ٹک پٹ تعویز نا اسر مسونیداسہ اندا ترت تمیک ہبوئی کنکے اندا تو کنے
en: Look, ... and they brought this; this was the amulet from Pir Sahib, so that my brothers would quickly turn toward the city. The amulet ... the amulet's effect has taken hold now; it happens just like this ... for me, like this, to me.
en_old: Mother remembered, and they brought this; this is Pir Sahib's amulet so that my brothers [knowledge] go forward quickly. The amulet... the amulet has had its effect now. This is how it falls... why would it, for me...

brh: خیری ممن کنتو ملنگ کے بسنورے؟ جی صاحب کنا پن نوریٹ، ڈاکٹر نور۔ ماشاءاللہ دا تو باز جوان ویت اسے۔ نم تینا درستی راستی کنتو کرفتورے؟
en: Is everything well? Have you come to meet me? — Yes sir, my name is Noor, Doctor Noor. — Mashallah, that is a very good thing. Won't you introduce yourself to me?
en_old: Is all well, have you come to meet me? Yes sir, my name is Noor, Doctor Noor. Mashallah, that is a very good thing. Won't you introduce yourself to me?

brh: ئے سبی نا مسکر رحیم داد نا مسٹ روٹ کنا لمہ باوہ بیماری نا وجہ خان مرگ نا گواچی مسور ماسٹر محبہ محبوب کنے خوانیفے او داسہ ئے ڈاکٹر اوٹ او دا خلق
en: I am the daughter of Rahim Dad, the coppersmith of Sibi. My mother and father died because of illness. Master Mohib... Mahboob educated me, and now I am a doctor, and this village...
en_old: Yes, I am the daughter of Rahim Dad, the cobbler of Sibi. My mother and father died of illness. Master Mohib, Mahboob, educated me, and now I am a doctor, and this town...

brh: کنا خدمت کن بسنوٹ۔ ماشاءاللہ دا تو باز خوشینی ہیت اسے ہر دونچا کنا لمہ باوہ زندہ او انتئے کہ نی تینا محنت آن اوفتے پنی زندہ کرینوس۔
en: ...I have come to serve it. — Mashallah, this is a very happy thing. In a way your mother and father are still alive, because through your own hard work you have kept their name alive.
en_old: I have come to serve it. Mashallah, this is a very happy thing. In any case, my mother and father are alive, because through your hard work you have made their name live on.

brh: اینا خدمت کننگ کیو؟ میر صاحب نمدا علاقہ نا بلا ہورے، خلق نا مخلوق نمے آن بلو امید ئس تخک او دا اوفتا حق ہم ارے، جی کنا بسل
en: What can I do for you? — Mir Sahib, you are the elder of this area; the people of the village have great hopes of you, and that is their right too. — Yes, my dear...
en_old: How can I serve you? Mir Sahib, you are the elder of this area; the people of the town have great hopes of you, and that is their right too. Yes, my dear.

brh: پانے ہم خواس۔ بے بے صاحب ئے دا بندینگا ڈسپنسری ء ملنگ خواہوا تاکہ داڑے مخلوق نا علاج مرے دا تو باز جوان او ہیت اسے، اینا اجازہ نا کدر ء کیو۔ او۔۔۔
en: Tell me, what do you want? — Yes, yes, sir. I want to open this closed dispensary so that the people here can get treatment. — That is a very good thing indeed; I appreciate your asking my permission. And...
en_old: Say it, I want to hear. Yes, sir, I want to open this closed dispensary so that the people here can be treated. That is a very good thing indeed; I will value your permission. And...

brh: اسے تسبانی نی نیاڑی اسے ئس دا جگ نا مخلوق ذرا سادہ ئے ناپوہ ئے نی برداشت کپورو۔ او کنا مسئلہ ئے میر صاحب، نم بیرا۔۔۔
en: ...one thing: you are a woman, and the people of this place are rather simple and ignorant; they won't put up with you. — And as for my problem, Mir Sahib, you just...
en_old: You are a woman, and the people of this world are rather simple and ignorant; you won't be able to bear it. And my problem, Mir Sahib, is that you only...

brh: دن کبو کہ محکمہ صحت آن کنا پوسٹنگ ء ہنداڑے کریفبو۔ او ایلو دارو تا بندوبست ء کبو تاکہ ئے زوت آن زوت تینا فرض ء پورو کیو۔ ہمم۔ ٹھیک ء۔ نم تینا کاریم ء شروع کبو۔
en: ...do this: get my posting from the Health Department made right here, and arrange the other medicines, so that I can fulfil my duty as soon as possible. — Hmm. All right. You start your work.
en_old: Do it so that my posting from the Health Department is made right here, and arrange the other medicines so that I can fulfil my duty as soon as possible. Hmm. All right. You begin your work.

brh: انشاء اللہ زود آن زود نما پوسٹنگ ئے داڑے کریفٹ۔ میر صاحب نما باز مہربانی۔ دا ٹی مہربانی نا انت ہیت اسے۔ دا کنا خلک ء ئے ہم خواوہ کہ دا کنا خلک نا مخلوق آسودہ مرے آسرات مرے اوفتے
en: God willing, I will get your posting made here as soon as possible. — Mir Sahib, thank you very much. — What is there to thank me for in this? This is my village; I too want the people of my village to be well off and comfortable, that they...
en_old: God willing, I will have your posting made here as soon as possible. Mir Sahib, thank you very much. What is there to thank in this? This is my town too, and I want the people of my town to be prosperous and at ease, them...

brh: صحت نا سہولیات رسینگے اور انتئے کہ کنے تینا خلق نا مخلوق کنے تینا اولاد آنبار دوست ء۔ میر صاحب کنے نومے آن اندا امید اسس کہ کنا مسٹ دا حویلی نا دروازہ غان نی کس ہچ وقت ناامید کپرو۔
en: ...receive health facilities, and that's because I love the people of my village like my own children. — Mir Sahib, this is exactly the hope I had of you. — My daughter, no one will ever be turned away disappointed from the door of this mansion.
en_old: Health facilities were provided, and that's because I love my people as if they were my own children. Mir sahib, this is what I hoped from you: that while I'm here, no one would ever leave the door of this mansion disappointed.

brh: نی ہن ضرور تس مس، انت کاری مس؟ کنے آ رخ بننگ کیس۔ ضروری باوا، داسہ کنے اجازت ئے نن ادون بننگ کپک، دادا ولینا دودی کدا کا
en: If you ever need anything, whatever work comes up, you can come to me. — Certainly, baba. Now give me leave to go. — We don't let anyone go like this; it's the custom of our forefathers...
en_old: You must have come for something. What's the matter? You could have come to me. It's important, father. Now I've been given permission; we can't come here... it's the custom of the in-laws.

brh: بغیر چائے رخ کن کسے ہنکپک نی چائے رخ کنک واللہ انشاءاللہ نی نامے صاب دانا ضرورت اف نم کنا ہیتے خف توریرے عمل کریرے دا کنکن باز بلو گڑاسے
en: Nobody leaves without having tea; you must have some tea, by God. — God willing. No, Mir Sahib, there's no need for that. You listened to my words and acted on them; that is a very big thing for me.
en_old: Nobody leaves without having tea, you must have some tea, by God. Inshallah... Sahib, there's no need for that. You just listen to what I say and act on it, that means a lot to me.

brh: ایرا غوچا ولدا کونیوا داسہ کنے باز کاریم کروئی ئے ٹھیک انشااللہ کنے تینٹ اوار خنوری مہربانی میر صاحب ننتون ملاقات نا خوشی مس داسہ کنے اجازت
en: Another time; I'll have it then. Right now I have a lot of work to do. — All right, God willing, you'll come and see me yourself again. — Thank you, Mir Sahib. — It was a pleasure to meet. — Now, with your permission.
en_old: Sit down, then we'll talk... I have a lot of work to do now. Fine, inshallah, I hope to see you again. Thank you, Mir sahib, it was a pleasure to meet you. Now, with your permission.

brh: فراز جی اما دا ہم کنا مار دتول کنا مار ئس جوان و مسڑ ئس
en: Faraz ji... mother, this is my son too... my son... a nice girl...
en_old: Faraz ji, mother, this is my son too... my son was a fine boy, and a daughter.

brh: انتس ئے گے؟ اورانا کاریم تے گے؟ گنوک، اورانا کاریم تے گے، تینا ملخوڈ کننگے، ملخوڈ کننگے، اسیت ئس پا کنے اما، مچنگا دے نی اوراٹی ئس
en: What are you doing? The housework? — Silly, the housework? You're just joking, joking. Tell me one thing, mother: you're at home all day...
en_old: What is it? Have you done the housework? Silly, the housework? You're joking, joking. Tell me one thing, mother: you're at home all day.

brh: دا مسٹ ئے اراڑ خنانس۔ اونداڑے برے کورا غا؟ ہا، تینا ٹورا غا بریک۔ او، دا وامور وتی سے۔ ہبک تم کے کنے پلا تا شوق ئے نا، او دے پلا تا شوق ئے برے کنے دا۔
en: ...where did you see this girl? Does she come here to the house? — Yes, she comes to the house. Oh, this... You know I'm fond of flowers, right? And she is fond of flowers too; she brought me this.
en_old: Where did you see this before? Did he come there to the...? Yes, he comes on his horse. Oh, this is... Whenever... I love flowers, don't I? He loves flowers too, and he brought me this.

brh: داڑے کنے آن پنیری دے۔ جوان۔ دا پنیری دننگ کے برے کو راغہ نی دوست ہم بس او دا سمل خوڑ کنے کے تیار مسوس دا نا۔ او۔ دیر اسے دا مسڑ؟
en: Give me the seedling here. — Good. — She comes to the house to get this seedling; your friend came too, and this... had been made ready for me, this one. — Oh. Who is this girl?
en_old: Give me the seedlings here. Good. He came to plant this seedling... your friend came too, and he got ready for this. Oh. Whose daughter is this?

brh: ننا ہمسایہ نا پروفیسر جمال اونا مسڑ شبانہ۔ اچھا پروفیسر جمال چاوتا باز جوان و بندغ اسے۔ یقینا اونا مسڑ ہم باز جوان مرو۔
en: Professor Jamal, our neighbour — his daughter Shabana. — Oh, Professor Jamal, I know him; he is a very good man. Surely his daughter will be very good too.
en_old: Professor Jamal from our neighborhood, and his daughter Shabana. Oh, I know Professor Jamal, he's a very good man. His daughter must be very good too.

brh: ولے منے یاد ئے ہمو دے اینی تون ڈاکٹر نورنا عید کرٹ او دا وختہ خلک کٹئے او اما اوڑن بیدس ئے کسسے تون برام کپرہ
en: But I remember that day when I celebrated Eid with Dr. Noor, and at that time he swore: 'Mother, I won't marry anyone except her.'
en_old: But I remember the day I celebrated Eid with Dr. Noor. At that time he made a promise: mother, I will not marry anyone but her.

brh: اگر ڈاکٹر نور خلق انداڑے شارا بتو گڑا مچا زنی برام کپیسہ دانو عید کپا
en: If Dr. Noor had not come here to this town, would you then never marry in your whole life? Don't carry on like this on Eid.
en_old: If Dr. Noor hadn't come to the city back then, you would never have married in your whole life, and you wouldn't be celebrating Eid like this.

brh: ڈاکٹر نور کنا زندے بس بس کنا مار اللہ ہدایت کے نی
en: Dr. Noor is my life. — Enough, enough, my son, may God guide you.
en_old: Dr. Noor is my life. Enough, enough, my son, may God guide you.

brh: شاباش لمہ، ارے نی دا انور نا کمرہ ٹی؟ بس کنا کاٹم خلٹ کرے کہ داڑے بسٹ مچے خاچاٹ۔
en: Well done, mother! Are you here in Anwar's room? — It's just that my head started aching, so I came here and lay down for a little while.
en_old: Well done, mother. Are you in Anwar's room? My head just started aching, so I came here and lay down for a bit.

brh: تپ مت جوان ئے نی انتس؟ کنا تپ جوان مرے یا خراب مرے، نا نا دونو ہیت کپہ، اللہ نی سلامت کے، نی تو کنا زند ئس گولی مولی کنوس؟ گولی؟
en: How's the fever, are you all right? What's wrong with you? — Whether my fever gets better or worse... — No, no, don't talk like that, may God keep you safe, you are my life. Have you taken your pills? — Pills?
en_old: Is your fever better? How are you? Whether my fever is better or worse, don't talk like that. May God keep you safe, you are my life. Did you take your medicine? Medicine?

brh: گولی مولی کپہ کنے گولی نا ضرورت اف۔ نی اینک بس مچے پین آرام کیوا۔ آرام کیسا؟ اینا خدمت کیو۔ جمال مچا دے دا چنات کے۔
en: Forget the pills, I don't need pills. I'll just rest a little more today. — You'll rest? Then I'll look after you. — Jamal, all day long these children...
en_old: Stop with the medicine, I don't need medicine. Today I'll just rest a while. You'll rest? Today I'll look after you. Jamal, all day this child...

brh: دے جنگ او جھیڑا آخیرا۔ دافتہ کوکار او صلوات تیان کنے کنا کاٹم خل کننگٹی اسکہ۔ ہندا خاطر داڑے بسٹ مچے آرام کریٹ۔ ہسی دستو پاو نی کنا واجہ تو نا کاٹم خل کننگٹی افک؟ عید نا ہچ اصول جند نا تروٹ۔
en: ...fighting and squabbling all day. My head was aching from their shouting and hollering. That's why I came here and rested a bit. Now tell me honestly, my dear husband, isn't your head aching? Eid has no rules at all...
en_old: Every day ends in fighting and quarrelling. All this shouting and noise gave me a headache. That's why I came here and rested for a while. Now tell me honestly, my dear husband, doesn't your head ache? Eid has no rules for anyone.

brh: مچا زند تو نی ہم کن تو جنگ کرینوس ہر عید تازیانی کن تو جنگ کرینوس امر نی جنگ کنتوس؟ اینا دا نو ہیت اسے فک ہیت تو جنگ جھیڑہ کپہ ہیت تو مہر کیو انت دا جنگ جھیڑٹ ننا جوان زند گدرینگان او دعا کیو کہ ننا جوان زند مندو مننے
en: All your life you've fought with me too; every Eid you've picked a fight over something. When did you ever not fight? — Today is something new: today I won't talk of fighting and quarrelling, I'll talk of love. Our good life has passed in all this fighting and quarrelling, and I pray that our good life stays like this.
en_old: You've fought with me all your life too, every Eid you've fought over Eidi. When did you not fight? Today is something new, no fighting today, today is about love. Our good life has passed with all this fighting and quarrelling, and I pray that our good life stays this way.

brh: ئے ہمبر کرے ہمبر بترینگے، اچھا، ندن کر، آرام کر، پرواہ سف، ئے نی کین دودھ پتی چاء جوڑ کیوہ، تینا دو اٹ، سہی؟ چمبڑ، ندن کر، نی داڑے تل۔
en: I... it'll get better. — All right, sit down, rest, don't worry. I'll make you milk tea with my own hands, OK? Stay put, sit down, you sit here.
en_old: ...it'll get better. Okay, sit down, rest, don't worry. I'll make you milk tea with my own hands, alright? Sit down, you stay here.

brh: ئے کیرٹ جوان مریوت ایٹ پردہ ایٹ نمن بابا نا پد ہتہ دس کے مہر نی کن تسوس نی کنے دن لگے کہ دنیا نا
en: I'll do it, I'll be fine... After Baba, all the love you have given me — you seem to me like the world's...
en_old: ...I'll do it, it'll be fine... After your father, the love you gave me makes me feel like the world's...

brh: دا کل گڑا کنے رسینگا، کل مہر کنے رسینگا، بس نی کنے انو ہسکا پیزک، ارا دے نی کنے انو ہسکا کریس نا، ئے دا دنیا ٹی سلیپر اٹک، پشو نا۔
en: All these things reached me, all the love reached me. Just don't ever do this to me like this; the day you do this to me, I'll be... in this world...
en_old: I got all these things, all the love reached me. Just don't belittle me like this. The day you belittled me like that... in this world... slippers...

brh: بس ئے تولوک اٹ، نی کنا مونا تول، ئے نا مونا تول، ئے نی اورو، نی کنے اورو، سہی؟ ہا، نی چاس جوڑ کیوہ؟ نہ، بس کنا گورا تولٹہ، ئے تینٹ جوڑ کیوہ، اللہ سلامت کے نی اللہ خوش تخے نی
en: There, I'm sitting. You sit in front of me, I'll sit in front of you; I'll look at you and you look at me, OK? — Yes. Shall I make you some tea? — No, just sit beside me; I'll make it myself. May God keep you safe, may God keep you happy.
en_old: Just sit down, you sit in front of me, I'll sit in front of you, you look at me, I'll look at you, right? Yes, should I make you tea? No, just sit with me, I'll make it myself. May God keep you safe, may God keep you happy.

brh: سلام علیکم ئے گودی کنا مطلب ڈاکٹر صاحبہ کلو زیادہ کاریم ئے کرینوٹ داڑے چپ کڑی الئی انت کریٹس اوبنے نی چڑہ چا کونسہ خاچس
en: Peace be upon you, madam — I mean, Doctor Sahiba. I have done more work than anyone; keep quiet here for a moment... what did I do? Now you drink a little tea and get some sleep.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum, sister. I mean, doctor sahiba, I've done a lot of work here, I kept quiet for a while, what did I do? Okay, now you drink some tea and rest.

brh: فراز ننا ہمسایہ ڈاکٹر اسے جوانو مار اسے لائقے لمہ تا باز مہروانو بندغ اسے پیری ولدا او ننا شبانہ تون ہم باز مہر کیک۔ اچھا دا نا مطلب دادے کہ نی مچا حال
en: Faraz is our neighbour, a doctor, a good boy, capable, a person very kind to mothers and the elderly, and he also cares a lot for our Shabana. Okay, so this means that you [know] all the news...
en_old: Faraz, our neighbour's son, is a doctor, a good and capable boy, very kind to his mother, a very kind person, and he loves our Shabana very much too. Okay, so that means you know the whole situation...

brh: احوال ہر کس واللہ بسوس ہاؤ دا تو باز جوان و ہیت سے گڑا دا قصہ ہم مروئی ئے تو کارینوٹ کہ پگا دن کہ ننا شبانہ نا سالگرہ ئے ئے فراز ئے
en: ...about everyone; by God, you've come [with it all]. Yes, this is a very good thing. So this matter should happen too, and so I've [thought] that tomorrow, which is our Shabana's birthday, Faraz...
en_old: Everyone, by God, you've come. Yes, this is very good, and there's something else — this matter has to be dealt with too, so I was thinking that the day after tomorrow is our Shabana's birthday, Faraz.

brh: او نا لمے بٹنگانو سالگرہ ٹی نی اوفتے تون تولٹک عید گپ کرک احوال ئس کرک ہورتا جوانی اٹ ولدا اللہ خیر کیک۔ انشاءاللہ ضرور عید کیوا او اللہ خیر ہم کیک ٹھیک ہی نا ہن کنے ہسی۔
en: ...and his mother, we'll invite them; at the birthday you sit with them, talk and chat, exchange news, look him over properly, and then God will make it turn out well. God willing, I'll definitely talk [to them], and God will make it turn out well too. All right? Now go and [get] me...
en_old: At his mother's birthday, you sit with them, talk about Eid, chat a bit, all in a nice way, and then God will make things turn out well. God willing, we will definitely do it, and God will make things turn out well too. Alright, now you go and give me...

brh: دا اسیکو پشکین کن چھانے نا چاکرا دو نی چاتے کوٹ انو سمجھا ئے ہم چاتے کوٹ اللہ نی ہدایت ایتے مہربانی بہت
en: This one... for... tea... you [made] the tea... understood, and [made] the tea too. May God give you guidance. Thank you very much.
en_old: For this one cup of tea... you know how to make tea, you understand that too, you know how to make it... May God guide you. Thank you very much.

brh: باز زبردست چا جوڑ کروت باز زبردست ماشاءاللہ
en: You made really great tea, really great, mashallah.
en_old: You made really great tea, really great, mashallah.

brh: ہو ہند مس خیری اٹ واری نی پارینٹ کنا کمپیوٹر نی توخلپہ دا کمپیوٹر بیرا ناف دا کنا مرے دا کمپیوٹر ناف دا کمپیوٹر کنا مرے
en: Yes, it's done, all fine. I've told you, don't touch my computer. This computer isn't yours, it's mine; this computer isn't yours, this computer is mine.
en_old: Yes, it worked out well this time. You... don't touch my computer. This computer isn't only yours, it's mine too. This computer isn't yours, this computer is mine too.

brh: کنا نی جوانی غا ضروری آ نوٹس آتے فیس بک آن ڈیلیٹ کرینوسک۔ ماشاءاللہ! نوٹس او، پورا دے نی کمپیوٹر نا مونٹ آ تولوک اوس، انٹرنیٹ چیٹنگ کیسا، او بسنوس کنا نوٹس آتے نی ڈیلیٹ کرینوس۔
en: You've deleted my good, important notes from Facebook. Mashallah! Notes, oh! The whole day you sit in front of the computer chatting on the internet, and you came and deleted my notes.
en_old: You've nicely deleted my important notes from Facebook. Mashallah! Notes, oh, you sit in front of the computer all day chatting on the internet, and you came and deleted my notes.

brh: کنا زیادہ دماغ ء کمپہ، پگہ کنا سالگرہ ء، ئے وڑ کنا سجوان ء کاٹ ڈس کشیوہ۔ نا سالگرہ؟ جی او کنا سالگرہ۔ داسہ کیک، کاک، مروڑ، بسکوٹ آک۔
en: Don't pester me so much; tomorrow is my birthday, how am I going to manage my...? Your birthday? Yes, my birthday. Now [there's] cake, kaak bread, twisted pastries, biscuits.
en_old: My mind isn't working much. Tomorrow is my birthday, how will I get my preparations done? Your birthday? Yes, my birthday. Now there's cake, ..., sweets, biscuits.

brh: چاک، دے چدہ گودی نا انت انت فرمائش آک مرو، ابا نا بجٹ نا تو کباڑ جوڑ مس، پنی سم کلاں زیات نی لنگڑ اور ٹیکی نا تننگ نا واک کپک، نی ٹیکی ء تف، نی ٹیکی تننگ نا
en: Look, what all demands will the lady have these days! Dad's budget has already been turned to junk, and on top of that you're the most broke of all and don't have the means to give a gift. Don't give a gift, then; you, giving a gift...
en_old: Look, what demands will there be in these days... Dad's budget has been wrecked... there's no strength left to give... you give the ticket, you... giving the ticket...

brh: جوان ئے ہمو پیسہ آتے چے ملنگ آ ستیف کم سے کم دعاس تو کیک کنے بس ایرے تو اتکپہ کنا ارواست خوائیک کنے تو اتکیوک اسے وار نہ سد وار اتکپئے خالی مہربانی کے بش ہنا کمپیوٹر آن کنا ئے پارے ٹینے او
en: Fine, give that money to some beggar; at least he'll say a prayer [for you]. Just... you don't bring me [anything]; my heart wishes you'd bring me something; not once but a hundred times you haven't brought [anything]. Just do me a favour, get up and go away from the computer...
en_old: Fine, with that money... at least pray for me. Just... my soul wants... not once but a hundred times... just thank you... went from the computer... told me...

brh: کنے ایلو مچٹ شوک ئس اف کہ نی خوش کیوک انور کنا ایلم نی کنا اینا نا خبر دے سس؟ اسے واری نی کنے دا ایتے پا کنے تو مہر دے کیکک
en: I don't have any other little wish for you to fulfil, Anwar, my brother. Do you even know anything about me today? Just once, say this to me: that you love me.
en_old: I don't have any other little wish for you to fulfil, Anwar, my brother. Did you get news of my...? Just tell me this once, love me...

brh: ارے شبانہ بے بے ئس نی تو جائی اوغنگ اٹی ئس ورک ہندن کہ نا پگہ سالگرہ ئے ہندن اسے دے ئس نا برام مروئی اور ہندن دو لوچاپ اٹی تینا ایڑ رخصت کرو
en: Hey Shabana, sister, you're really crying, as though tomorrow, your birthday, were going to be the day of your wedding, and as though [I] were sending off my own sister...
en_old: Hey Shabana, sister, you're crying so much, as if tomorrow were not your birthday but your wedding day, and you were sending off your sister...

brh: کنا زندگی نا موکل آن جوانینگا دے مروئی انور نی سلا سلا دا سستین توریس دا امبیز دا سلیس ہرام نا دا سستین پاک
en: It will be the best day of my life. Anwar, you...
en_old: It will be the best day of my life, Anwar... (rest unintelligible)

brh: کنا مرید، کاریم کننگٹی ہی بس کر کنا مار، داسہ آرام کرک۔ نا ماما، کنے باز کاریم کروئی ہی اسہ اسہ گڑانا لسٹ جوڑ کروئی ہی تاکہ کل داروک
en: My dear, you're working; stop it, my child, rest now. No, Mama, I have a lot of work to do, I have to make a list of each and every thing so that everything...
en_old: My dear, stop working now, my son, rest now. Mama, I have a lot of work to do, I have to make a list of every single thing so that everything...

brh: ایرو ہسپتال تینا کاریمے شروع کیک۔ او کنا مسڑ۔ انشاء اللہ دا ہسپتال ضرور کاریمے شروع کرو۔ او کاریم کل
en: Today the hospital starts its work. Yes, my daughter. God willing, this hospital will definitely start its work. And the work, all...
en_old: The hospital starts its work today. Oh, my daughter. God willing, this hospital will definitely start its work. And all the work...

brh: او کنا مار مار، مگر کنا مطلب دا اف کہ نی نی تینے بیمار کرک، داسہ آرام کرک، پگہ انشاءاللہ دا لسٹ تینا مکمل کرک، ٹھیک ہی کنا مسے؟ جوان ماما، امر کہ نا مرضی۔
en: Oh my child, my child, but I don't mean that you should make yourself ill. Rest now, and tomorrow, God willing, complete your list. All right, my daughter? Okay Mama, as you wish.
en_old: Oh my son, my son, but I don't mean that you should make yourself sick. Rest now, and tomorrow, God willing, finish your list. Okay, my dear? Okay Mama, as you wish.

brh: ئے شاباش اللہ نی آباد کے
en: Well done, may God keep you prosperous.
en_old: Well done, may God keep you prosperous.

brh: دا کسر ہراڑے کاک؟
en: Where does this road go?
en_old: Where does this road go?

brh: تکلیف نا ضرورت اف، کنا ضرورت اف۔ تکلیف نا، ئے برے پگہ اینی کٹے ئس اینی گن بسٹ نا خدمت اٹ۔ ولدا کسے
en: There's no need to trouble yourself, there's no need for me. No trouble... tomorrow... I came to be at your service. Then...
en_old: There's no need for trouble, no need for me. Trouble... tomorrow, today... at your service. Then someone...

brh: فراز اینا باز کتریک ایوا تمکنا باز ہیلپ کریرے ناؤ ماما محبوب نا
en: Faraz, today [you did] a lot... you helped me a lot... Uncle Mahboob's...
en_old: Faraz has helped me a lot today... Mama, Mahboob's...

brh: دا کمک یان بیدس ایتنا منزل اسکان سر مننگ کتو
en: Without this help, I couldn't have reached my destination.
en_old: Without this help I could not have reached my destination.

brh: کنے دا یقین ء کہ نی داڑے واپس بروس، کنے آ۔ خیر خان دا ساہ تو کنے بازوری مرے
en: I'm sure that you will come back here, to me. Well, Khan, this life will be very hard for me.
en_old: I'm sure you will come back here, to me. If this life stays safe, it will give me great strength.

brh: اسلام علیکم آستہ جی۔ وعلیکم السلام، وارس جان۔
en: Assalamu alaikum, Ustad ji. Wa alaikum assalam, Waris jan.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum, Asta ji. Wa alaikum assalam, Waris jan.

brh: سلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ تول۔ مہربانی۔ خیر ئے احوال بس ہنس۔ ماسٹر جی اسہ خوشی نا ہیت سے۔ ہو ونتس۔ خلکت ہسپتال ئس ملنگانی۔ دا تو باز خوشی نا ہیت سے۔ خوشی تو نہ و۔
en: Salam alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Sit down. Thank you. Is all well, what news? Master ji, there's a piece of happy news. Yes, what is it? The village is getting a hospital. That's very happy news indeed. Not just happy...
en_old: Salam alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Sit down. Thank you. Is everything well, what's the news? Master ji, I have some good news. Yes, tell me. The village is getting a hospital. That's very happy news. It's more than just happiness.

brh: وار وار ئس حیرانگی والا ہیتس مرے او ہنتس۔ نیاڑی ڈاکٹر ئس بننگٹی ئے نیاڑی؟ دا نیاڑی دیر سے؟ ہمو کہ ماسٹر محبوب خان فیک ات مسڑ ئے بزغر نا مسڑ سے۔ دا تو باز جوانو ہیتس ئے انتئے کہ زنانہ غا
en: Sometimes it's surprising news too. And what is it? A woman doctor is coming. A woman? Who is this woman? The one who is, Master, Mahboob Khan's daughter, the farmer's daughter. That's a very good thing, because for the women...
en_old: Sometimes there's surprising news too. What is it? A woman doctor is coming. A woman? Who is this woman? Master Mehboob Khan's daughter, the daughter of that poor man. That's a very good thing, because for the women...

brh: خلکٹی داسا ناجوڑی ختم مروئی ہمک عیداس سکولے ملانوٹ او ہسپتال ملنگنگٹیئے ننا داڑے چنا نیاڑی تا مسئلہ غاک ہم حل مریرے باز خوشی نا عیداسے دے چہ ماسٹر نی انت پاسہ
en: Now illness will end in the village. It's like an Eid: we got the school, and now we're getting a hospital, and the problems of our children and women here will be solved too. It's a very happy Eid of a day. Master, what do you say?
en_old: Now the illnesses in the village will end. It's like Eid: we got the school, and now we're getting a hospital. The problems of our children and women here will be solved too. It's a very happy day, like Eid. What do you say, Master?

brh: وارس جانی بازو پومرثے، نی ثمارے کنے دا خوشی مننگٹی ئے کہ ننا چھنا نیاری بیمار مسونے نن دو سد میل شار آ درینتے، دا ستو اندا خلکٹی علاج مریک چھنا نیاری تا۔ جی ماسٹر جی، سئی پاچھا۔
en: Waris jan, you understand very well. You see, I'm happy because when our children and women fell ill, we took them two hundred miles to the city; now the children and women will be treated right here in this village. Yes, Master ji, you're right.
en_old: Waris jan, you understand it very well. You know, I'm happy because when our children and women fell ill, we took them two hundred miles to the city. Now the children and women will be treated right here in this village. Yes, Master ji, you're right.

brh: امہ! جی کنا مسڑ۔ ننا اسکول شارء ہمپنا؟ انتئے ہمپنا، کانہ۔ ارا وخت آ؟ زو کانہ۔ امہ!
en: Mom! Yes, my daughter. Won't we go to the city, to school? Why wouldn't we go? We'll go. When? We'll go soon. Mom!
en_old: Mom! Yes, my daughter. Are we going to the city? Of course we'll go. When? We'll go soon. Mom!

brh: نی ہردے پاسہ زو کانہ زو کانہ زو کانہ وقت وقت ئس انسان مجبور مریک بے وس مریک کنا استم خواہک کہ دا خلک کنے بشارہ کانہ
en: Every day you say we'll go soon, we'll go soon, we'll go soon. Sometimes a person is compelled, becomes helpless. My heart wants us to go from this village to the city.
en_old: Every day you say we'll go soon, we'll go soon, we'll go soon. Sometimes a person is compelled and helpless. My heart wants to leave this village and go too.

brh: ولے اماں انت ولے نی بلائی یاد بفک؟ بریک انتئے بفک؟ کنے تو باز یاد بریک ئے بلائی کاوہ
en: But Mom, what? Don't you miss Grandma? I do, why wouldn't I? I miss her a lot... I'll go to Grandma.
en_old: But Mom, why? Don't you miss Grandma? Of course I do. I miss Grandma a lot, I'll go.

brh: نا فکرے نا زوزو کاری مفک نی دا لگت مشکل ئس گفرتہ جی
en: Don't worry, things don't get done in a rush. This cost won't be a difficulty for you, sir.
en_old: Don't worry, it won't be done in a hurry. You won't find this cost difficult, sir.

brh: جی او، اونا پن ثناء ء۔ نئے اندو ہرفیٹک، ئے پاٹ کنا سنگت نا سلتنے، ولے اللہ ء کہ کنا سنگت نا است ء۔ شارٹی اف۔ بیا امر کریس؟ ثناء ایلو۔
en: Yes, her name is Sana. I asked you like this, I said, my friend's... hasn't..., but by God, it is my friend's heart. It isn't in the city. Come, how did you do it? Sana, the other one...
en_old: Yes, her name is Sana. I asked you like this, and I said she is my friend's... but God knows my friend's heart. She isn't in the city. Come, how did you do it? Sana, the other one.

brh: ہم بس ہرسکینہ، ارس کنا دوٹی، سہیت اسنے پاو گل بے بے جوان چاسک دا کل نرینہ اسیوڑ مریرہ، نن غریبی پیوننگا میل ٹمبارون ارجا
en: ...just... it is in my hands... Gul Bibi knows well that all these men are of one kind. We, in our poverty... everywhere...
en_old: We are also just looking. It's in my hand. Just a moment, say... Sister knows well that all men are the same. We, in our poverty...

brh: کتا فیس ننے، امو جاگہ نا مرے نکھا، گڑا ننا خیال ئے ننا منری، توبہ کمر، او ایت کے سنی، کنا دوست کساس، ناہی تا کیندونو، ایت ونتون پانے گٹٹ، بس زو ئس
en: ...you tie us down, we become people of that place. Then our thinking, our... God forbid... my friend, did you take...? We'll do as you say... what should I say... just quickly.
en_old: Wherever you take us, we will become people of that place. So our thinking is that we are men. We repent... My friend, did you take it? We will talk about you; what should I tell them? Just quickly.

brh: لمہ حیات کار او دادے ہتیر دا استو تعویز نا پیر صاحب نا کہ امر کنا ایلم تے زوشار مون تروئی تعویز نا تو ٹک پٹ تعویز نا اسر مسنے داسہ
en: Mother remembered and brought this. This is an amulet from Pir Sahib, so that my brothers quickly turn their faces toward the city. The amulet... the amulet has had its effect now.
en_old: Mother remembered, and they brought this. This is Pir Sahib's amulet, so that my brothers go forward quickly. The amulet... the amulet has had its effect now.

brh: اندا ترا تمک؟ ہبو ئے کنکے اندا تفک نیام فکری۔ نہ زوزو کاری مفک نین۔ دا لگت مشکل ئس گفٹ تا۔ جی۔
en: Does it turn out like this? Because this way it doesn't... don't worry. It won't get done in a rush. This cost won't be a difficulty for you. Yes.
en_old: Does it fall like this? Why... for me this doesn't... Don't worry. It won't be done in a hurry. You won't find this cost difficult. Yes.

brh: ہر جاگہ تفیس ننے، ہمو جاگہ نا مرینہ کانہ۔ گڑا ننا خیال، نن ہم نرینہ۔ توبہ کانہ، مروئی اتکیس ننے۔
en: Wherever you tie us, we become people of that place and go. Then our thought is: we too are men. God forbid... you have brought us to where we should...
en_old: Wherever you take us, we will go and become people of that place. So our thinking is that we are men too. We repent; you have brought us to the point of death.

brh: تو نا دوستے کشاس؟ نا ہیتا کیندونو۔ ئے تو انتون پاننگٹٹ بس زو ئس ایلم یاد کار او دادے اتیر۔ دا اسہ تو تعویز پیر صاحب نا کہ امر کنا ایلم تے زوشارمون۔
en: Did you pull your friend away? We'll do as you say. What are you saying... just quickly. Brother remembered and brought this. This one is an amulet from Pir Sahib, so that my brothers quickly turn toward the city.
en_old: Did you pull out your friend? We will talk about you. What should I tell them? Just quickly. The brothers remembered and brought this. This is Pir Sahib's amulet, so that my brothers go forward quickly.

brh: دروئی ہا تعویز نا تو ٹک پٹ تعویز نا اسر ہم مسونے داسا ہندا درت تمک ہبوئی کن کہ ہندا توک کنے ہم فکری نا زوزو کاریم مفک نی دا لگت مشکل ئس گفٹ تا
en: ...should turn. That amulet... the amulet has had its effect now too. It is turning out just like this, because this way I am worried too. Don't worry, your work won't get done in a rush. This cost won't be a difficulty for you.
en_old: ...the amulet, the amulet has had its effect now. This is how it falls, because this... me too. Don't worry, it won't be done in a hurry. You won't find this cost difficult.

brh: جی، ہو نا، مشکل اسیٹی لگفیتہ، جی، الہ توسس؟ الہ مکیو، تو دا نوٹ تے در تے خک دیسس کنا مونا تے خاستہ، ابوئی
en: Yes, yes, you have put me into a difficulty. Yes. Did you sit down? Yes, don't... Then take these notes... in front of me... father.
en_old: Yes, yes, you have put me in a difficult position, yes. Where did you keep it? Mother, don't do that. So take out these notes. You saw... in front of me, you wanted it, father.

brh: درتکنا مون اینتو رنگٹی ئس وا کٹنا مفک امو کہ پٹاٹہ غاتے پیماش تیتے ٹکر کننگ کے بنیسے اینہ
en: ...in such a way that it doesn't get cut; then the potatoes are to be cut into evenly measured pieces...
en_old: Take it out in front in a way that it doesn't get cut, then cut the potatoes into measured pieces and start.

brh: ایتے بین جی دوشنے
en: Listen to this, sir...
en_old: Give it, look, yes, yesterday.

brh: تولنگ اٹ توسٹہ جی حکم کبو این کاریم باز ء ہیتے بن جی جی
en: I was sitting here, sir. Give the order. There is a lot of work today. Listen to the matter. Yes, yes.
en_old: You were sitting down, sir. Give the order. I have a lot of work. Listen to the matter, yes, yes.

brh: داسہ کا وا زلیخا غستے مچے ئے واپس بریو رزان سلوک مریر دیگ تیار مرے ایراغاتے بسیس ئے بینگن مریو ایزو او جوان خدا دے نی انت پاریس
en: Now I'm going, Zulaikha; I'll come back in a little while. Have the dishes ready and the pot ready, and cook the meals, or I'll be hungry. Okay, good, by God... What did you say?
en_old: Now, Zulaikha, gather up the rice and come back... the pot will be ready... you came to the... eggplant... okay, good, God willing. What did you say?

brh: ئے دا خلک نا چنا بلا پیر ورنا بیمار ناجوڑ
en: These children of this village, the grown-ups, old and young, the sick and the ailing...
en_old: These people's children, old and young, sick and unwell.

brh: ننا کسر آ ہورک ہنا مسٹ
en: Our road has gone empty...
en_old: We went looking along our path.

brh: نی کنے دا وار بفیسا ہر وخت کہ ننا کسرک جتا مسنو گڑا اوار بننگ ننا فائدہ
en: Won't you come to me this time? Every time our paths have parted, so what is the use of us coming together?
en_old: You won't come to me this time. Every time our paths have separated, so what is the point of us coming together?

brh: اچھا آپ کے والد کا کیا نام تھا؟ عبداللہ۔ یاد ئنے نمے کلے۔ اچھا آپ کے والدہ کا کیا نام
en: Okay, what was your father's name? Abdullah. You remember all of it? Okay, what was your mother's name...
en_old: Okay, what was your father's name? Abdullah. Do you all remember? Okay, what was your mother's name?

brh: دا نمے یاد ئے شاباش کنا چنا، ایو راٹی نی کھلی ویسے
en: You remember this! Well done, my child, you...
en_old: Do you remember this? Well done, my child, you've come out with flying colours.

brh: ئے ئے بالکل تنیا سوٹ کنا مشیر تنیا یکو تنیا کنے دلے کاکے
en: Yes, yes, absolutely. I am alone; my adviser... alone, all alone... me...
en_old: Yes, absolutely, you alone, my adviser, you alone have won my heart.

brh: دا ہچٹ، دا کنے پیش تمنگء پاروس بابا، ئے کنے پیش تمنگء پاروس بابا، ولے ئے تینٹ تو۔۔۔
en: This... you told me to go out, father; you told me to go out, father, but you yourself...
en_old: Look at this — you told me to come forward, father; you told me to come forward, father, but you yourself...

brh: زیبا بیرا نن تینا زند کے سوچ کین دا خلک نا چناک ہم ننا چناک او اگر دافتا مستقبل کے نن سوچ کتن
en: Zeba, if we think only about our own lives... the children of this village are our children too, and if we don't think about their future...
en_old: Zeba, only if we think about our own lives... the children of this town are our children too, and if we think about their future...

brh: تمن تکڑا دیر سوچ کروئی کنے بیرہ تینا مسٹ نا مستقبل نا سوچ کروئی او بس باز افسوس نا ہیت اسے زیبا انت مس باجی انت اسے باز انت مس صبح نا دہ منٹ نا دا قصہ اسے
en: Who is supposed to think about the whole tribe? I have to think only about my own daughter's future, and that's it. It's a very sad thing. Zeba, what happened? Sister, what is it? What has happened? It's a matter of ten minutes this morning...
en_old: You've thought for a long time; I just have to think about my daughter's future, that's all. It's a very sad thing. Zeba, what happened, sister? What is it, what happened so much? This is the story of ten minutes this morning.

brh: کڑی خاچانس نی کالج اینو یتفک ابا کالج ہاں ابا سپاہی کالج ہموڑے کنا مستقبل ء ہموڑے پارہ کالج تھمسس دم دریفینوس تینے بس داسہ نی آرام کرک او ابا اٹو
en: Have you been asleep? Didn't you have college today? Father, the college... yes father, the soldiers' college, my future is there, there... college. You've worn yourself out. That's enough, now you rest. And father...
en_old: You've worn yourself out — didn't you go to college today? Father, the college — yes, father, the sepoy college, that's where my future is, said the college. You've worn yourself out, catch your breath. That's enough, now you rest, and father, that's it.

brh: مرٹ کرے دا اوراٹی تنیا اٹی مرگ نا گواچی کروس دونوئی تنتے کیسہ اما انتسے نا کمی دا اوراٹی ئے ہریٹ دا نوکرا کریک انتئے نی تنیا اوس
en: ...In this house, all alone, you'll make yourself a victim of death. Why do you do this to yourself? But what is lacking in this house? Every one of these servants does the work. Why are you alone?
en_old: They died. In this house, alone... you lost them to death, how do you live alone? What is missing in this house? Every servant here works — why are you alone?

brh: ارے کمی ابا ارے کمی کنا مار ملخوڑس اینا کمی ئے دا لیڈی ڈاکٹر ڈسپنسری امر مرانی دنیانا ڈاکٹرک داڑے بسور ہوسے ہفتہ ساٹ کریر ہینار دا لے
en: Oh, there is something lacking, dear, there is something lacking: my son, a daughter-in-law, that is what's lacking. How will this lady doctor run the dispensary? Doctors from all over the world came here, stayed a week or so, and left. This la...
en_old: There's a lack, father, there's a lack. My son is ill — what is lacking here? How will this lady doctor's dispensary work? Doctors from all over the world came here, stayed for a week or so, and left.

brh: ئے دے ڈاکٹر، تس کتوک ئے کمال کیسہ میر بہروز خان، داڑے کئی ڈاکٹر آک بسورینار، نی انت پاسے، دا ڈاکٹر ہم۔۔۔
en: Yes, the doctor... you're amazing, Mir Behroz Khan. Many doctors have come here and gone. What do you say? This doctor too...
en_old: Yes, doctor, you've done wonders, Mir Behroz Khan. Many doctors have come here and gone. What do you say — this doctor too...

brh: دا خلکٹ تولوک مرو دا مخلوق نا خدمت ئے کرو مننگ کپک مخلوق نا خدمت ئے کے یا کپ
en: Will she settle in this village and serve these people? That can't happen. Will she serve the people or not?
en_old: Will they stay settled in this town and serve these people? It can't happen. Will you serve the people or not?

brh: دا دور دنیا ٹی ترقی کننگ اٹی ارک۔ انور کنا ایلم، وخت اینا تیر مس، دا پوسکنا وخت ء۔ اینو پگہ نا نیاڑی زند نا ہر گام ٹی نرینہ غاتون اوار ء۔ دا گپ ء نی پومسوس یا نہ؟ جوانی اٹ پومرہ، دا دور۔
en: In this era the world is progressing. Anwar, my brother, that time has passed; this is a new time. Today the woman of today and tomorrow stands alongside men at every step of life. Have you understood this point or not? Understand it well: this era...
en_old: This era, the world is progressing. Anwar, my brother, that time of yours has passed; this is a new time. Today women stand alongside men in every step of life. Have you understood this or not? Understand it well — this is the age.

brh: ئے نا پگہ نا نیڑغ نا غٹ تور غا مٹ مچے سلوک او۔ ہیچس پاپنے ابا؟ ہا، استو کمرہ ٹی پشی ئس بسس شینٹ خلسا کنے توار کرے نی داسہ دا ترقی کرو اندازک۔
en: Your women of tomorrow all stand as equals. Won't you say anything, father? Yes: a cat came into the room and called out to me... now you have these progressive ways.
en_old: Tomorrow's woman will stand shoulder to shoulder. Won't you say anything, father? Yes, a cat came into the room in the afternoon and called out to me with a mew — now you've become this progressive in your ways.

brh: چپ ایند کریسے گودی نم مچا زند ہنداری مرورے بالکل نم اسل شار این پیری اسل نا گڑا گودی اسے کاریم اسکا
en: Why have you gone so quiet, lady? Will you stay here like this your whole life? You don't go out around the town at all, not at all. So, lady, there was one thing I had (to say).
en_old: Why are you so quiet, sister? You've spent your whole life like this, you've never even seen the city, nothing at all, sister, it's just one job.

brh: انت کرے؟ بیڑا گودی اسہ کاری بس نم پین کبو۔ نم اناڑے برام کبو۔ ایلو کنا مطلب دادے برام
en: What thing? Well, lady, just one thing: you do one more thing. Get married here. Also, I mean, this... marriage
en_old: What did she do? Look, sister, just do one more job. You arrange things here. I mean, arrange this.

brh: ہم ضروری ئے نی ہٹ ضروری اف، دا ڈسپنسری نا چلیفنگ باز ضروری ئے ڈاکٹر صاحبہ نم اسیکارے مس پینت کبو، اوہان نم اسے ڈاکٹر ئس داڑے
en: is also necessary for you. It's not necessary at all; running this dispensary is very important. Doctor sahiba, do one more thing; then you would have a doctor here,
en_old: It's important too, no, you're not that important, running this dispensary is very important. Doctor sahiba, you just make one more effort, then you'll have a doctor here.

brh: پین بٹنگبو۔ داڑے ڈاکٹر کس بفک۔ ڈاکٹر بفک؟ گڑا نرسس خوائبو۔ او انتئے؟ کنکن؟ مطلب دا ئے برام کیو ایتوتے او کرے نرس مرے ئے کمپوڈر مریو۔
en: Look for another one. No doctor comes here. A doctor won't come? Then ask for a nurse. Oh, why? For me? I mean, I'd marry this one... she'd be the nurse and I'd become the compounder.
en_old: Search some more. No doctor comes here. A doctor doesn't come? Then call a nurse. Why? Who, me? I mean, I'll arrange this, whoever she is, a nurse or a compounder.

brh: کنا خیال اٹ ٹھیک ئے ایونا خیال اٹ ٹھیک ئے ہلا، مخلوق نا خدمت ئے دیر کیک؟ مخلوق نا خدمت ئے؟ نم، کنا مطلب نن کل۔ بس، ہیت باز کریرے!
