en: She'd take care of me and I'd take care of her. Come on, who will serve the people? Serve the people? You... I mean, all of us. Enough, you talk too much!
en_old: I think it's fine, I think she's right too. Well, who will serve the people? Serve the people? You, I mean all of us. Enough, you talk too much!

brh: بو کاریم کبو۔ ئے ئے تو نمے سلاہ تسٹ مونا نما مرضی۔ کان شو۔ چا چا چا چا چا چا چا بسم اللہ بسم اللہ۔
en: Now get to work. I've given you my advice; from here on it's up to you. Let's go... Tea, tea, tea, tea, tea, tea, tea! Bismillah, bismillah.
en_old: Okay, get to work. I've given you my advice, the rest is up to you. Look... tea, tea, tea... Bismillah, Bismillah.

brh: کنا مسڑ ئے پاریٹ کہ ئے ہم تینا فرض ادا کیو چاء دانے بٹ کریٹ چاء تیار کریٹ ئے چھوٹی پا کنا مسڑ دم درینگانے ئنا خاطران ئے چاء تیسوٹ ماما ایلو دے
en: My daughter, I told myself that I too would do my duty: I put in the tea leaves and made the tea. I thought, my daughter has gotten tired, so for her sake I've made the tea. Uncle, the others...
en_old: My daughter told me that she would also do her duty. She took out the tea leaves and made tea. She said, little one, my daughter is tired, so I made the tea for her, uncle, the other day.

brh: دا شوم چاتے سورے؟ نی نی بے بے جی نی کنا مطلب ڈاکٹر صاحبہ ایو دا شوم چا کنتنو ہمڑے شوم سئی باز ماما دا وتی ہم چائٹ ماما مچے بورے تاسے ہات کیس ہاؤ دا مچے بورے نا کانا تولو کوٹ
en: This wretched tea, is it sour? You, you, Bebe ji, you, I mean Doctor sahiba, haven't you drunk this wretched tea? ...so very... Uncle, I tried it myself too, uncle. Did you put in a little sugar? Yes, a little of this sugar... (rest unclear)
en_old: Is this tea salty? You, you, Bebe ji, I mean doctor sahiba, this tea of hers is so salty, uncle, I tasted it too, uncle, all of it is sugar... (partly unintelligible) ...sitting by the sugar.

brh: او دے تے زیات کس پین نظر کہ بورہ تیوی کنا نت نغڑتو بو دا دے حل حل بورے او راٹی گڑا نا زیہ جنگہ کیرے داڑے بورہ زیات شاہ مرغے مدا نا زہ مدا
en: (Largely unintelligible) ...too much... look, the sugar... my foot... stir, stir the sugar... here you've poured in too much sugar...
en_old: (Largely unintelligible) Don't look at them anymore... the sugar... don't step on my feet... here there's too much sugar...

brh: نا نا ہوشیار کنے لنگڑی با خلقو نی نیو شیرانے الے ایو مزہ کنے مزہ کنے ابورا ریتا پر ابورا کڈا ہو کافی
en: No, no, careful... it's sweet... it tastes good to me, tastes good to me... the sugar... quite (a lot).
en_old: No, no, be careful, don't make me limp... (partly unintelligible) ...it's tasty, it tastes good to me... quite a lot.

brh: تاٹی تاٹی رنگینہ ہاؤ پل تے دیر تننگٹ مروک کا و رفتہ
en: Sister, sister, how beautiful! Yes. Who has been giving the flowers... (rest unclear)
en_old: (Largely unintelligible) Dad, Dad, we'll paint... who is giving the flowers...

brh: دالے، آ دا پلک برے سنو، اٹوار مالئے پارئے نردا تا خیالئے تخ بے وساتے دیرئے تے
en: Here, these flowers... listen, I've told the gardener eight times to take care of these... who gave them?
en_old: (Largely unintelligible) This flower... listen, on Sunday... keep the thought in mind... who...

brh: تاتی اینے ایڑے پٹنگاٹیٹ نیداڑ کینوس خیر مسٹ الے نیدو نلا اوشوس نا تاتی ایچم متارے کنا مطلب ئے جوانوس نی گڑاس تو ارے کہ نیدونس تاتی گپ دادے کہ نوم
en: Sister, I've been looking for you here... is everything all right?... No, sister, nothing has happened; I mean, I'm fine. You have something (to tell me)...? Sister, the thing is that...
en_old: Dad, I was looking for you here... (partly unintelligible) ...I mean, is everything good? You have something to say, Dad, the thing is that...

brh: نی ہما مرتین تیتے؟ فراز؟ او فراز، اینو مئے پٹ آٹا کہ اودے خناٹ اورتو ٹکرائناٹ۔ ننا کنا مطلب دادے کہ فراز تو خیریت تو نہ سکنا؟ ہاتے نما انت مطلب؟
en: You mean that boy? Faraz? Oh, Faraz. Today I was looking around when I saw him, and I bumped into him. I mean, Faraz is all right, isn't he? Huh? What do you mean?
en_old: Who is that you're talking about? Faraz? Oh, Faraz. Today I was searching and I saw him and ran into him. I mean, is Faraz doing well? Yes, what do you mean?

brh: کنے مگہ مرغرے؟ تاتی، او بالکل خیریتٹ اٹیو۔ گڑا امر مس؟ امر مس؟ ئے سوری کرے ٹورنو مئے بسٹ۔ جوان کریس۔ او داسہ دا پاکے خیرٹ بسسے کنے پٹاسے۔ جیو گپ دادے تاتی۔
en: ...me? Sister, he's perfectly fine. Then what happened? What happened? I apologized and came away. You did well. And now you've come here safely, looking for me? Yes, the thing is, sister,
en_old: Why are you worried about me? Dad, he's perfectly fine. Then what happened? What happened? He apologized and came back. You did well. Now he has come back safely and found me. Bless you, that's the thing, Dad.

brh: ئے کہ پگہ نمے ننا ارا غا بروئی ئے انتئے کہ کنے نما ارا غا بروئی ئے ننا ارا ٹی چنکو پارٹی اسے، پارٹی اسے، انت خوشی اٹ دا پارٹی ئے پگہ خیر اٹ تاتی ئے بیس سال نا مروٹہ
en: that tomorrow you have to come to our house. Why do I have to come to your house? There's a small party at our house. A party? What happy occasion is this party for? Tomorrow, God willing, sister, I'm turning twenty.
en_old: So tomorrow you have to come to our house, because I need you to come to our house. There's a small party at our house, a party. What joy, this party tomorrow, God willing, Dad is turning twenty years old.

brh: ماشاءاللہ گڑا تو چاس کہ ئے ضرور بریوہ۔ جوان انگا ساتھی۔
en: Mashallah! Then you know I'll definitely come. Good friend.
en_old: Mashallah, then you know I'll definitely come. Good friend.

brh: ئے دا دے دم دے فیس نا نگاہ چاس، نون چدے کائست کائستہ کاہین، گڈے فیس نا
en: (Largely unintelligible) I... this day... a look at the fee, you know... now... going... then the fee...
en_old: (Partly unintelligible) Look at this fee... then the fee...

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ بے بے جی کنا مطلب ڈاکٹر صاحبہ ڈسپنسری تو ملنگا نہ دارو ئے نہ مریض ئے بس اکنا دا شوم نا مونی بس پنیچو۔ نم فکر کپابو دارو کم بریرا خلق نا
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Bebe ji, I mean Doctor sahiba, the dispensary has opened, but there's neither medicine nor a patient; we just... in front of this wretched place... Don't you worry, the medicines will come too; the people's...
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Bebe ji, I mean, doctor sahiba, the dispensary has opened, but there's no medicine and no patients; we've only got as far as this evening. Don't you worry, the people's medicine will come soon.

brh: مخلوق ء داسکان ڈسپنسری نا سما اف۔ میڈم ڈسپنسری تو ملنگا، داسہ دول خلنگ مخلوق ء پان بابو۔ نی دول خلپے۔ گلی گلی ٹی کوکار کنے، ڈسپنسری ملنگانے، چنا تے تینا تپ ء علاج کے۔ دول۔
en: People don't know about the dispensary yet. Madam, the dispensary has opened; now, shall we tell the people by beating a drum? You beat the drum. Shout it in every street: the dispensary has opened, get your children treated for fever. The drum.
en_old: People still don't know about the dispensary. Madam, the dispensary has opened, so now beat the drum to let people know. You beat the drum. Shout it in every street: the dispensary has opened, get your children treated for fever. The drum.

brh: خلے نی کس پی سانگے تے؟ دانا ایچ ضرورت اف۔ ئے تینٹ اسہ اسہ راغہ کاوا تاکہ خلکے معلوم مرے۔ ڈاکٹر صاحبہ دا تو باز مشکل او کاری مسے۔ مشکل مرے یا مف کارم تو کروئی ہی بے بے
en: Beat a drum, as if it were someone's engagement? There's no need for that at all. I'll go house to house myself so that people find out. Doctor sahiba, this is very difficult, hard work. Difficult or not, the work has to be done. Bebe...
en_old: Will you hit anyone, the ones who don't listen? There's no need for that. I'll go house by house myself so that people find out. Doctor sahiba, this is very difficult, hard work. Whether it's difficult or not, the work has to be done, Bebe.

brh: جی، نہ، کنا مطلب ڈاکٹر صاحبہ، کس نیتو کائے یا اف، ئے تو بریوہ، اوڑے شوملہ، ئے الہ، ئے ہم بریوہ نیتو، او نی ہر جاگہ بل مٹر ایوس، کان، نی ہم بر۔ شاباش، کنے نمے آن اندا امید اسکا۔ نی دن کا۔
en: Ji, no, I mean Doctor sahiba, whether anyone goes with you or not, I'll come; there... I'll come with you too; and you... everywhere... Let's go, you come too. Well done, I expected exactly this from you. You do this:
en_old: Yes, no, I mean, doctor sahiba, whether anyone comes with you or not, I'm coming; I'll go there in the evening, I'll take it, I'm coming with you too, and you can call people from everywhere — come, you come too. Well done, I expected exactly this from you. You do that.

brh: دا چٹھی ئے ڈاکخانہ ٹی شاغ۔ جی آ، جی آ، جی آ، ہو! اڑے سوم! ئے پنچ منٹ ئس کن کایوہ، نی گھنٹہ ئس داڑے انتظار کیس کنا، اللہ حافظ۔ ڈاکٹر صاحبہ! دا تو باز جوان وئتس، دا دارو تے ننے ایتر؟ بلے!
en: Drop this letter at the post office. Yes, yes, yes, OK! Hey, you wretch! I go for five minutes and you'd wait here an hour for me. Goodbye. Doctor sahiba! This is a very good thing; will they give us these medicines? Sure!
en_old: Post this letter at the post office. Yes, yes, yes, OK! Hey Som! I'm going for five minutes, and you wait for me here for an hour. Goodbye. Doctor sahiba! This is very good, will you give us these medicines? Sure!

brh: اللہ مہر تو نوار ننا ہم فرض ارے حکومت آن بیدس سماجی تنظیماتے آن کمک ہلین۔ دانا مطلب ئے پریشانی نا میڈم ہچ ضرورت اف داٹی مخلوق نا علاج جوان مروئی انشاءاللہ۔
en: By God's kindness... it's also our duty to get help from social organizations besides the government. That means, madam, there's no need at all to worry; people will be treated well here, God willing.
en_old: If God is kind, it's our duty too to get help from social organizations besides the government. That means, madam, there's no need to worry at all; God willing, people will get good treatment here.

brh: جمال، ارف نی کہ چائے ہس پون؟
en: Jamal, here, take it: some tea?
en_old: Jamal, will you make some tea for us to drink?

brh: ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ اینو کنا پاننگ آن مست چائے ہیسس خیریت ئے ئے خیال کریٹ کہ نی دم درینگانوس ہندا خاطر آن نی کن چائے ہٹوٹ۔ اینا دا ہی چستو ارے کنے دا خا مہربان مسنوس۔
en: Mashallah, mashallah! Today you've brought tea before I even asked. Is everything all right? I thought you were tired, that's why I brought tea for you. What's the occasion today, that you've become so kind to me?
en_old: Mashallah, mashallah, today you made tea before I even asked. Is everything alright? I thought you were tired, so I made tea for you. What's the special occasion today, that you've been so kind to me?

brh: ہاؤ ئے تسرے۔ ہمم؟ انت اسے؟ ئے تادے کہ شبانہ دسا بیس سال نا مسونے۔ ہاؤ اونا سالگرہ نا تو کنے سما ہی سالگرہ تو ٹھیک ہی لیکن نی اونا فکر کروئی مریک۔
en: Yes, I'll tell you. Hmm? What is it? I'm saying that Shabana has now turned twenty. Yes, I know about her birthday; the birthday is fine, but you have to think about her.
en_old: Yes, I've told you. Hmm? What is it? I've told you that Shabana is turning twenty now. Yes, I know about her birthday; the birthday is fine, but you should be thinking about her.

brh: انتے کہ اودا سوار نامہ سونی تاکہ کائت اینا اوراٹی آباد مرے آہا آن فگر کین ماشاءاللہ لائق ئے خواننگاٹی پین پینت فگر دیکیناک۔ لائقی او خواننگ کے ارے نا۔
en: Because she has reached this age, so that she can go and settle in her own home. Aha, what are we worrying about? Mashallah, she's capable; in her studies... what more is there to worry about? Talent and studying are there, aren't they.
en_old: Because they took him on horseback so that his house would be settled; I'm proud of him, mashallah, he's capable, he'll show even more in his studies. He has the talent for studying.

brh: اونا ارا آباد کننگ کن چکارے مستی فک۔ ننے اودکن سوچ خلوئی مریک، فکر کروئی مریک۔ اچھا، نا مطلب دادے کہ او تینا ارا نا مرے تو لمہ باوہ نا اثرات برور، ہندا پانے خواہی سا نا؟ ہم۔
en: It's not too early to settle her in a home of her own. We have to think about that, we have to worry about it. Okay, so you mean that if she has a home of her own, then her mother and father's influence will show; is that what you want to say? Hmm.
en_old: They are planning to settle his home. We have to think about that, we have to consider it. OK, so you mean that if he has his own home, his parents' influence will come in — is that what you want to say? Hmm.

brh: ہمدا پانے خوا۔ اچھا ادا، دا کہ ننا عزیز قریب ٹی تو ہنو مچو مار اسے خنپرا۔ نا نظر ٹی کس استرے؟ ہاؤ ارے ننا نظر ٹی۔ دیر؟ فراز ء۔ فراز؟ دیر فراز؟
en: That's exactly what I want to say. Okay then, among our relatives I don't see any such boy. Do you have anyone in mind? Yes, we do have someone in mind. Who? Faraz. Faraz? Which Faraz?
en_old: That's exactly what I wanted to say. Okay then, we don't see any boy like that among our relatives. Do you have anyone in mind? Yes, we do have someone in mind. Who? Faraz. Faraz? Which Faraz?

brh: بھلے مشکلی مشکلی میر ابمل کہ تئی واپ پورا بے پئی مشکلی
en: Yes, it is hard, hard, Mir Akmal, for your dream to come true. It is hard.
en_old: Even if it's hard, Mir Akmal, your wish will come true, however difficult it is.

brh: انو اللہ ممانیت ہر واپیل وت کالو من ہر چیزے بکنین ہما ڈول بیت ہم میر میر اکملئے ضد ات
en: Now, God [unclear]... every dream... Kalu, I will do anything, whatever way it has to be done. This is Mir Akmal's stubborn resolve.
en_old: Now, God forbid, Kalu, I'll do anything, whatever it takes. Mir... it's Mir Akmal's stubbornness.

brh: واجہ ناگمان برباد بے بلے تو بگوش کہ نازکئے چے بے کالو، ئے دنیا باز ظالم انت کالو، آ تا قد ئے ظلما برداشت کرتہ کنت، آخر مجبور بے
en: Sir, Nagman has been ruined. But you tell me, Kalu, what will become of Nazuk? This world is very cruel, Kalu. How long can she bear this cruelty? In the end she will have no choice.
en_old: Sir, Nagman is ruined, but tell me, what happened to Nazuk, Kalu? This world is very cruel, Kalu. How much cruelty could she bear? In the end she had no choice.

brh: لاچار بیت، راضی بیت غلامو، واقعی واجہ، بس کلو، تو ایوا کا آئی الا والا منا سر کر، تو فکر مکن واجہ، من ماسی آ ڈیوٹی آ جتا گون
en: She will become helpless, she will give in. Your servant agrees. Truly, sir. Just, Kalu, keep me informed of every little thing about her. Don't worry, sir, I have put the auntie on duty with her.
en_old: She was helpless and gave in, your servant, really, sir. Just, Kalu, keep me informed of every little thing. Don't worry, sir, I'm going off separately to my aunt's duty.

brh: آ ہر روچ حال احوال منا سر کنت بس خالو تو انو برو دریا ہنے وگا مارا بچار کہ مہلوک چے گشگا انت ٹھیک ئے واجہ
en: She reports all the news to me every day. Just, Kalu, now go down to the seashore and see for me what people are saying. All right, sir.
en_old: She tells me how things are every day. Just, Kalu, go down to the river now and see what people are saying about us. All right, sir.

brh: نازک تو دیما بچار کہ من گون تو چونیں لہبیں گنی
en: Nazuk, you will see later what kind of games I play with you.
en_old: Nazuk, just wait and see what kind of games I play with you.

brh: گلان، تو پاہ جوانی کاری کو، وجنو یدارا کجا برگی انت، اشارہ برگی نینت، اشارہ ٹکر ٹکر کنگی انت، تانکے ناگمانے دل امچش ٹکر ٹکر پہ مدام۔
en: Gulan, do a good piece of work for me. Sir, where are these to be taken? They are not to be taken. They are to be smashed to pieces, so that Nagman's heart is broken to pieces like this forever.
en_old: Gulan, you do good work. Where are the wedding parties being taken? The signals aren't to be taken; they're to be broken into pieces, so that Nagman's heart is broken into pieces forever too.

brh: کامیاب ببیت۔ یعنی کہ واجہ، شر پروشگی انت۔ او پلان، ایشرا زوت پروشگی انت۔ ایشی نام و نشانہ گم کنگی انت۔ بس۔ تو واجہ بیغم بو۔
en: May it succeed. That is, sir, they have to be smashed properly. And the plan is that this has to be smashed quickly and every trace of it wiped out. That's all. You rest easy, sir.
en_old: May it succeed. That is, sir, it has to be broken off. And the plan is to break it off quickly. Every trace of it has to be wiped out. That's it. So don't worry, sir.

brh: بزانت تئی ئے کارم بوت۔ بولان! بس ہمے کاری بکن ات پدا منی خدمت آ بیا ات۔ دگہ مئے لائق او کمو واجہ؟
en: Consider this job of yours done. Bolan! Just do this job, then come back to me. Is there anything else we can do for you, sir?
en_old: You know this is your job. Bolan! Just do this job, then come back and serve me. Anything else we can do for you, sir?

brh: منتی تابدار، شوٹو، شوٹو اللہ حافظ، واڑے پلانو وا
en: Thank you, loyal one. Go, go. Goodbye. [rest unclear]
en_old: Thank you, loyal one. Shoto, Shoto, goodbye, ...

brh: نا کتو؟ او مرو۔ بیا۔ چنا جک تو؟ اللہ نا شکر ئے ہرچی وھان چوتام مورت آکے۔ دے کے شو۔
en: Uncle, is that you? Oh, come in. Come. How are you, my girl? Thank God... [unclear]
en_old: Uncle, it's you? Oh, come in. Come. Child, my girl, it's you? Thank God, whoever... Give it here.

brh: اللہ نا شکر۔ ایبوش کہ مرچی تئی زہگ گندگ بوگانے، کجا ہشتگاں باری زہگ وپتگاں۔ مئے جنک نازوک، ممارو چاتکا گون تو ہبر ئے کوتگاتے؟
en: Thank God. [unclear] today, your children... where have you left them? The children have gone to sleep. Our girl Nazuk, I have come today. You had something to talk over with me?
en_old: Thank God. It's good that today I'm seeing your children. Where did you leave them? The children were asleep. Our girl Nazuk, did Mamaru come and talk to you?

brh: منا ما ہبرے ہرا گرگاتکو نا بارہ ٹی تو چے فیصلہ کوتے؟ نا کو منی زند تو بربادی من تگے چے زند سوارینگے؟
en: What did you decide about the matter I came to you with? Uncle, my life has fallen into ruin. How am I to live my life?
en_old: What did you decide about the matter I came to you about? Uncle, you're ruining my life. How will my life ever be settled?

brh: بگنہ! ئے ہرت مئے خوش بخت اٹ کہ نی کنے بچارنے۔ زند اٹ تو کسہ غاک، شوری، پریشانی، ئے المہ کانہٹ۔ ئے تو نسانہ خاطر آ چکاس اٹ۔ او مڑدم ارا ایوڑین جاور اٹ تو کنے دلپوش بوک نہ لوٹیٹ مننگک۔
en: Look! It is our good fortune that you look to me. Life has troubles, turmoil and worries, and all of these come. This is a test for human beings. And a person in such circumstances should not lose heart.
en_old: Look! It's our good fortune that you came to see me. Life is full of troubles, quarrels and worries. This is a test for your sake. And in a situation like this, a man doesn't want to keep me as a cover.

brh: بلے ناکو؟ او، بشار نا سوک۔ جانوک استے نا، ہباز جوانیں مردومے۔ آتھ رات لوغا وش تاریت۔ او منا امیدے کہ تو آئی لوغا تکلیف نہ بیت مئے جنک۔ بلے ناکو۔
en: But, uncle? Oh, look, Nazuk. There is Jano. He is a very good man. He will keep you happy at home. And I hope you will have no hardship in his house, our girl. But, uncle...
en_old: But, uncle? Oh, Bashar's son. Jano is a very good man. He takes good care of his home. And I hope you won't have any trouble in his home, our girl. But, uncle.

brh: ناکو ماتی چکنہ خوار کٹ نکو نی مشار نازو کے تو زکنہ فکر نہ کت جانو استنے ہاتی زکنہ وس خیال داری اکت ناکو
en: Uncle, he will make my children miserable. No, Nazo, don't you worry about the children. Jano is there. He will take good care of the children. Uncle...
en_old: Uncle, the mother is poor, uncle. Nazo, don't worry about the children. Jano is there, he will take good care of the children, uncle.

brh: تمنک باز بلین چکاسی تمنکن گے بلکہ ایتے زاگانی زندے سوال انت پدا تمن ئے بگوش تو تکا تتی ئے زاگانی خیالداری کنے ہا پدا ئے زاگ
en: You have fallen into a very big test, but more than that, this is a question of these children's lives. So tell me, can you look after these children of yours on your own, huh? Then these children...
en_old: Your worries are real, but more than that, this is a question of these children's lives. So tell me, who will take care of your children then, these children?

brh: دنیا چمپاتیس ارا ساعت اٹ، اغا خدا مکن، خدا مکن، اغا ترا چیزے بوت، گڑا تئی زہکانی چیبٹ، ہا؟ بے چارہ نازک، جانو ہماروس کنا لوٹ اٹ۔
en: This world lasts only the blink of an eye. If, God forbid, God forbid, if something happens to you, then what will become of your children, huh? Poor Nazuk. Jano asked me that very day.
en_old: The world can change in the blink of an eye. If, God forbid, God forbid, something happens to you, then what will become of your children, huh? Poor Nazuk, Jano is the one I want.

brh: او تینا ارا سہندے کچرانت، اہم عروسے نا مچا نفرت کنت، ترا یہ ہم معلوم ات کہ ئے او تینا ارا پرچا سہندات، ئے تو ہمے لوٹٹ کہ
en: He broke up his own home [unclear]. He even hates everything to do with marriage. You also know why he broke up his home. All he wants is that...
en_old: He hates his own two..., he even hates the whole wedding. You also knew why he... this is all I wanted.

brh: دا لبوک کہ استے آ لوغا منندی لوغہ خیالداریا بکن امی خاطرا منا گوشگام کہ تو شری فکرا بکن من گون جانو ہبر کتاک آ ہرو سے واسطہ تیار ایت
en: ...whoever is in his house stays at home and looks after the household. That's why I am telling you to think it over carefully. I have talked with Jano, and he is ready for everything.
en_old: The point is that he will stay at home and take care of the household. That's why I'm telling you to think it over carefully. I've talked with Jano, and he's ready for anything.

brh: نو دیما تئی رضا شرے منجانک تو فکر بکہ عمر اندا خانتی ہالا گرا شرے
en: Now it is up to you from here on. All right, my girl, you think it over. [unclear: something about life in this same house] It will be good.
en_old: Now if you're willing, then think it over: life in this same house will be good.

brh: بچہ نازک ہر چی کنے او سوچ و خیالہ بیکا۔ ما سوچتا ترو ما فیصلہ کتا نو ئے زاگانی پرورش ما تنہا کت نکنے۔
en: Child, Nazuk, whatever you do, do it after careful thought. I have thought it over, aunt, and I have decided that I cannot raise these children alone.
en_old: My child Nazuk, whatever you say, I will think it over. I thought about it, and I decided that I cannot raise these children alone.

brh: منے سہارے ضرورت ئے بل زری براسہ وار شریعہ زانے، ئے ہمزانے، یا ہیا پیسرا عروسی کتا، بل آتے
en: I need someone to lean on. But Zari... once... you know well, you also know that he married before, but they...
en_old: I need support, and Zari... once, the Sharia allows it, this one knows too, or she married before, and them...

brh: جنینا سون انتاتا؟ مزانی، مشری زانی۔ آ باز ترندے منی جنک، ہما نزانہ کہ ترا وش ترو ترند و خراب کسے نا۔
en: What was the matter with the woman? I don't know... you know well. She is very harsh, my girl. She doesn't know how to make anyone happy. She is harsh and nasty to everyone.
en_old: What was the women's talk? I don't know, I don't know. She is very harsh, my daughter; she didn't know you would be happy... harsh and unkind to someone.

brh: انسان اگر وت شر بے کسے یار خراب گش نہ کا او ما زانی کہ ئے وتی جائنا را پرچہ سوندا تگا بلے نازک ترو یک جانی
en: If a person is good, nobody can call them bad. And we know why he broke up with his own wife. But Nazuk, you [unclear: '... one soul']...
en_old: If a person is good themselves, nobody calls them bad, and we know that she left her own place for this reason, but Nazuk, you two are one soul.

brh: نی وتی مرتا کو اکا دب جنی بکا، گڑا زانا لوک آباد بیت؟ یا مرد و جئینے نیاما مہر و محبت بیت کنت؟ اینا ترو، شری و خرابی انسانی وتی دستئی۔ شر جنک۔
en: If you talk back to your own husband, will the home prosper? Or can there be love and affection between husband and wife? Look, goodness and badness are in a person's own hands. Good girl.
en_old: If you beat your husband, will the home thrive? Or can there be love and affection between husband and wife? Know this: good and bad are in people's own hands. Well done, daughter.

brh: ہرچی کہ تئی رضا اللہ ترا خوش پدی منی لائقہ کاری بو گڑا منا اللہ مبخشی
en: Whatever you wish. May God keep you happy. Then, if there is any task I am fit for and I don't do it, may God not forgive me.
en_old: Whatever you want, may God keep you happy. And if I'm not worthy of something, may God forgive me.

brh: بلے توئے زریب نا سبا شریعہ زانے ئے ہم زانے کہ آیا پیسرا عروسی کتا بدتی جنینا سونان داتا
en: But you know Zarib's case well. You also know that he married before, and [unclear] the woman...
en_old: But for Zarib's sake, the Sharia allows it, and this one also knows that she married before, and she said bad things about the women...

brh: نازک، گل خاتون، چیا؟
en: Nazuk! Gul Khatun! What is it?
en_old: Nazuk, Gul Khatun, why?

brh: نازک بس زندہ گوازی آن گایو بس گواڑ مردم چے کرت کا راست گوشے قسمت آ بچار تے دومی آ روسا
en: Nazuk, life is just a game... [unclear]... What can a person do? You are right. Look at fate. The other day...
en_old: Nazuk, life just went by, just as people do. Honestly, look at fate; the other day...

brh: تینا شار آ کاوا۔ او انتئے بنا کانہ بلائیکا نہ دیوتنا مسٹورے بازو دیوا۔ اسلام علیکم۔
en: I'll go to my own town. Oh, why... come, let's go, to Grandma's [unclear words] for many days. Assalamu alaikum.
en_old: I'll go to my city. Why would we start... to Grandma's... Assalamu alaikum.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ بس رے۔ جی او۔ اوہ بخت، سکول مرے، بندہ ہم دم درینگک۔ ایرا غاتے؟ جی ہاو ایرا غاتے
en: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. You're back? Yes. Oh, my luck: with school, a person gets tired too. Food? Yes, yes, food.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. That's enough. Yes. Oh, what luck: when there's school, a person also gets a break. Where are they? Yes, where are they?

brh: کنا مسل انت ہیت کریرے۔ ابا نن دا خلکٹی مفنہ نن شار کانہ۔ کنا مسل بندغ دونو ہیت سوچے پک دا خلکے ننا ضرورت ہی
en: My daughter, what are you saying? 'Dad, we won't stay in this village, we'll go to the city.' My daughter, a person shouldn't think that way; this village needs us.
en_old: What did my daughter say? Dad, we won't stay in this village, we'll go to the city. My daughter, people think things like that, but this village surely needs us.

brh: ئے زڑہ تپ، ئے بلایکا، تینا شارکا۔ اوہو، ئے نی امر پوکیو کنا پھلو، امر پوکیو نی
en: Hey [unclear], hey, off to Grandma's, to my own town! Oh ho, hey, how silly you are, my flower, how silly you are!
en_old: Hey, little sweetheart, to Grandma's, to our city. Oh, how did you fall, my flower? How did you fall?

brh: نم ایرا کنگنو رے؟ عائشہ! چے مئے؟ ئے ٹی وی لکھ
en: Are you all eating? Ayesha! Yes, Mom? Hey, put on the TV.
en_old: Where are you all going? Ayesha! What happened? Hey, the TV...

brh: انتئے مسڑے مونی تسس؟ ئے ننا ریفرٹ ایرا خون ارے؟ ننا پاس پروارے، نن کے زار نا نظر ئس اٹکاو، دانی انت پاننگ اٹی ئس ئے راست پاننگ اٹی اٹ۔
en: Why did you send the daughter away? Hey, [garbled: '... our ... blood ...']? We do care a lot; [garbled]. What are you saying now? I'm telling the truth.
en_old: Why did you give your daughter away? Hey, what blood ties do we have with them? We have our family. We look at them with sorrow. What is there to say now? I'm telling the truth.

brh: دا خلک کٹینا نا ضد برباد مننگٹیء، کنا مسینا زندگی تباہ مننگٹیء۔ اچھا، دسے دا خلک کٹینو نا ضد برباد مننگٹیء، او؟ ہاو، داڑے ننا ضد تباہ مننگٹیء۔ نا خوانے کے جوان ء
en: In this village our life is being ruined, my daughter's life is being destroyed. Oh, really? So in this village your life is being ruined, is it? Yes, here our life is being destroyed. For studying there's no good...
en_old: This village is ruining my child's future, and my daughter's life is being destroyed. Okay, so this village is ruining your child's future, is it? Yes, our future is being destroyed here. Your education is good...

brh: اسکول ئس ارے، نہ جوان ء ماحول ئس ارے، دا انتس ء زند ئس ئے زیبا! اگر دا خلق آتیا چنا تے ئے خوانفتوٹ تو دیر بروئے دافتے خوانفنگ کے؟ کس بفک دڑے! ہو دا خلق نا چنا
en: ...school, nor is there a good environment. What kind of life is this? Zeba! If I don't teach the children of this village, who will come to teach them? Nobody comes here! Yes, this village's children...
en_old: Is there a school? No, there's no good environment either. What kind of life is this, Zeba! If I don't teach the children of these villagers, who will come to teach them? Nobody comes here! Yes, this village's children...

brh: دا تکے نی ہرفیس ڈبل ایم ئے کرینوس نی ڈبل ایم ئے او خوانفیسہ پرائمری اسکول نا چناتے زیبا کلان مشکل کاریم کیرے چنکا چنائے خوانفنگے اگر دا فتا بنیاد مضبوط
en: ...have you taken on the contract for them? You've done a double MA, and with a double MA you're teaching primary school children? Zeba, the hardest job of all is teaching small children. If their foundation is strong...
en_old: Look, you've done a double MA, and with a double MA you're teaching primary school children. Zeba, teaching small children is the hardest job of all. If their foundation is strong...

brh: دوت مریک تو دا مونا جوانی ٹی خوانے رے؟ او، ئے چاوا، ئے خلق نا چناتا پروا ہرے ولے تینا مسڑ نا پروا افک نی ئے نی دا زامر پوک ایو۔
en: ...is strong, then they will study well later on. Oh, I know. You care about other people's children, but you don't care about your own daughter. You... you're making a fool of [unclear].
en_old: What's going on, is she studying at this young age? Oh, you know, she cares about other people's children but not about her own daughter, you... this...

brh: کنے پگپا، نتے کنے پگپا۔ اوہو!
en: Don't make a fool of me; you, don't make a fool of me! Oh ho!
en_old: Don't leave me, don't you leave me. Oh!

brh: ایٹ، باز پریشان اٹ، باز پریشان اٹ، سمجھ اٹی بفننگ اٹی ئے کہ امر کیو۔ باز پریشانی ئے پشکنگ اٹی اٹ۔
en: I'm very worried, very worried; I can't understand what to do. I'm sharing a great worry with you.
en_old: Mother, I'm so worried, so worried. I can't figure out what to do. I'm going through a lot of trouble.

brh: ختم مروک، اگہ ختم متو تو کم تو ضرور مروک، دا مسئلہ ہم ارے، ولے دوستین، دا کنا زند نا سوال ئے ئے پامسوٹ نا خیال ڈاکٹر نور نا بارہ ٹی
en: It will go away; and if it doesn't go away, it will surely at least lessen. That's a problem too, but, friend, this is a question of my life. I've understood how you feel about Dr. Noor.
en_old: It would go away, and if it didn't go away it would at least get smaller. That's a problem too, but friend, this is a question of my whole life. I asked what you think about Dr. Noor.

brh: نی تراستے؟ ولیکہ کنا لمہ نا تینا ست اسے۔ ننا ہمساہتیہ سے مسڑ اسے شبانہ۔ او پائیکہ ہموڑتون براف کہ۔ نی تینٹ پائے یار، دا ہمر مننگ کیک؟
en: Are you afraid? But my mother has her own insistence. Our neighbours have a daughter, Shabana. She says, 'Marry her.' You tell me yourself, friend, how can this be?
en_old: Do you know? Now my mother has her own promise. Our neighbour has a daughter, Shabana. She says I should marry her. You tell me, friend, how can that be?

brh: او کنا سادینگا سنگت فون ارف او دے کال ئس کر اوست نا تینا احوال ء ایتے اگر او نن تت مس تو برام کننگ کن تو تیار مریک نا دوست ء ئے نور ء باز جوانی کٹ چاوہ او بفک
en: Oh my naive friend, pick up the phone, give her a call and tell her your situation. If she agrees, she'll be ready to get married. Friend, I know Noor very well. She won't come.
en_old: Oh my simple-hearted friend, pick up the phone, call her today and tell her about your situation. If she agrees with us, she'll be ready to get married, friend. I know Noor very well, she'll come.

brh: کچ وڑ تینا خلک ئے لنگ کپا ک۔ اگر نی اوڑ تو مہر ارے تو نی اونا خلک ئے ہرا ک۔ باز مشکل ئے دوستے۔ یار ئے تینا لمہ ئے لنگ کپا ک۔
en: In no way will she leave her own village. If you love her, then you go to her village. It's very hard, friend. Friend, I can't leave my mother.
en_old: No one can go against their mother's word. If you love her, you listen to what she says. It's very hard, friend. A person can't go against his mother.

brh: او گڑا ایلم لمہ نا ہیت ء سگ شبانہ تو برام کرک نا دوست دا تو بے وفائی مریک گڑا نی دنگ کرک مچ اسے ڈاکٹر نور نا انتظار ء کرک ئے نہ
en: Oh, then, brother, accept your mother's word and marry Shabana. Friend, that would be disloyalty. Then what will you do, keep waiting for Dr. Noor all along, or not?
en_old: Oh, so if you accept your mother's word and marry Shabana, friend, that would be betrayal. Then what will you do? Dr. Noor has been waiting all this time, hasn't she?

brh: نی تا ایت ایت تے بن کنا یا نی کنا ایت تے پومرک۔ نو مائی ڈیئر ارا بندغ تینا زندگی نا فیصلہ غاتے کننگ کپک او دے مشورہ تننگ بیکار ئے
en: You either listen to what I'm saying, or understand what I'm saying. No, my dear, giving advice to a person who can't make his own life's decisions is useless.
en_old: Either you obey my words or you... my words. No, my dear, giving advice to a person who can't make his own life decisions is useless.

brh: او خیالا خیالا سرپدی نا؟ بابو تو وجم وجم من برباد متے من غریبیا یکہ یکہ دار ظالما ظالما ایمبٹ نم منی روزی نم منی نوکری بارا گچرا ناگمان براس ناگمان براس
en: Oh, in my thoughts, in my thoughts... do you understand? Babu, you... I've been ruined; me, a poor man. All at once the tyrant, the tyrant [took] my livelihood, my job... suddenly, brother, suddenly, brother.
en_old: Oh, do you understand the idea? Father, we have been ruined, we have become poor. Suddenly, all at once, a cruel man came... our livelihood, our job... he came suddenly, he came suddenly.

brh: اللہ خیر کنت، تو وتارا پریشان مکا، یار شکر جان، انچی واقعہ علاقہ کدی ہم نہ بوتا، یارو
en: God will make it well; don't trouble yourself, friend Shakar Jan. Such an incident has never happened in the area, friends.
en_old: God will make it right, don't worry yourself, my friend Shakir Jan. Nothing like this has ever happened in the area, friends.

brh: اللہ خیر کنت، انو شما بریت دومی کمرہ، ایف آئی آر ئس کاٹف کنت۔ اللہ ترا آباد بکنٹ واجہ، تو ہمکس گوشت، ہمکس مے خاطر آ باز ئے واجہ۔ من نی تون سد
en: God will make it well. Now you go to the other room; they'll get an FIR registered. May God keep you prosperous, sir. What you've said is plenty for our sake, sir. I'm with you...
en_old: God will make it right. Now go to the other room and have an FIR registered. May God keep you prosperous, sir. Whatever you have said is a great deal for our sake, sir. I am with you...

brh: میر تو انچیں کاری کو کہ م ترا چے گوشیں بچار میران ناگمان وترا باز مزنیں متبرے خیال کورتت دریا ہر کارا وتی مرضی ء سر
en: Mir, you've done such a thing that what can I say to you? Look, Miran suddenly considered himself a very great dignitary and does everything according to his own will.
en_old: Mir, you did such a thing that I don't know what to tell you. Look, Mir suddenly thought of himself as a very great and respected man and did everything as he pleased.

brh: نا کڑتت بس یک وار ناگو ناگمانے یکدار بے رسید رندا الما ما و شما چیز نہ چیزے کنا واجہ غضبی شما مہربانی کنیت مئے تھانہ ٹی یک فون ئس بجنیت کہ وتی جود و کوشش تے
en: ...he didn't. Just once, sud-, suddenly, all at once, without any receipt, and after that, we and you, something or nothing... My sir, it's an outrage. Please make a phone call to our police station, so that your own strength and effort...
en_old: ...did not do it. Just once, suddenly, all at once, with no receipt, and afterwards... but we and you, something or other. My dear Ghazbi, please make a phone call to our police station so that your efforts...

brh: کنا گانٹیا نا جی واجہ من نو ایس ایچ او ئے گون گپ جنی بس یکے روزگار ات نو مچکنے اللہ خیر کا شما فکر مکنیتا
en: [unclear]... Yes, sir. I'll talk with the SHO now; it's just a matter of one livelihood... God will make it well; don't you worry.
en_old: Yes, sir, I will speak to the SHO now, just a moment, and then all of us... God will make it right, don't you worry.

brh: مچے کرت کنا نا کو اللہ خیر کے توس اللہ نا دیما کے
en: Everything has been done, my uncle. God will make it well; leave it before God.
en_old: Everything has been done, my uncle... God will make it right, leave it in God's hands.

brh: ئے کالو، ئے کالو، اماں دست تئی گسا چا دراگا، ئے پا خیریت کائدا؟
en: Hey Kalu, hey Kalu! Mother, [unclear] out of your house... hey, tell me, is everything all right?
en_old: Hey Kalu, hey Kalu! Mother, your hand... from the house... tell me, is everything all right?

brh: آبی پہ ہمدردی نا ہاترا تککا۔ میر اکمل نا زاکانی واستہ ٹیکی روان داتکا۔ میر اکمل نا زاکانی ہاترا ٹیکی؟ عید نزدیک آئیگنا۔
en: Sister has come out of sympathy. Gifts have been sent for Mir Akmal's children. Gifts for Mir Akmal's children? Eid is getting close.
en_old: Abi has come out of sympathy. Are Mir Akmal's sons going to Tikki? For Mir Akmal's sons? Eid is coming soon.

brh: ہم شکو تو پچ روان داتگی۔ ہمم گڑا آہ گڑا تو چھیک ات۔ من ائیے دے ماجتا۔ ایے تو باز شرت کو جنک۔ ئے ئے کالو کسے نا، ئے باز بیکارے مردومے، بے شرپے مردومے۔
en: Clothes have also been sent for Shako. Hmm, well, ah, then it's fine. I [unclear] her. She's a very good girl. This Kalu is a nobody; he's a very worthless man, a man without honour.
en_old: We're also going... Hmm, so, ah, so you are... I didn't... Oh, she's a very good girl. Hey Kalu, whose... He's a really worthless man, a man without honour.

brh: جان نومہ زربت پتا
en: Dear, [unclear].
en_old: Dear, ... father.

brh: بیسائی سچی کار میر آک ملنگے نو مزانت پرچا ناکو نا گناہ نا چو سزا دے کے چو برباد کن گے
en: [unclear], the real business is Mir Akmal's... I don't know why he is punishing uncle like this when he has committed no sin, why he is ruining him like this.
en_old: Besides, the real work of the Mir... Why is my uncle being punished like this for someone else's sin? Why is he being ruined like this?

brh: بروشے، شش تسبیح ہندے، شش تسبیح، اینو ہنتارے؟
en: Go... six rosaries here, six rosaries! What is it today?
en_old: Brother, six rosaries here, six rosaries. What's today?

brh: نازک زانو
en: Nazuk, you know.
en_old: Nazuk, you know.

brh: ننے چبو تا اصلا شمئے کسہ نوک ئے نا ہمشے آ کمو حیران آ بھلے تو فکر مکہ آہستہ آہستہ
en: For the kids, actually, your story is new; that's why they're a little surprised by it. But don't you worry. Slowly, slowly.
en_old: Our story is actually new to you. If you're surprised by it, don't worry, little by little.

brh: اوٹ شربا من اشی نا جذبات آ سرپد آن من زانی ایشاں بلے من ئے ہم زانی کہ منی ئے گس نا توکا آیگ گو تو نندگ
en: Yes, all right. I understand her feelings, I know them, but I also know that her coming into my house and living with you...
en_old: Yes, I know. I understand her feelings and I know her, but you also know that she can't come and live inside my house.

brh: کنتو گپ کنک، چنا دوست نبی، منترہ گونا، آہستہ آہستہ شہر بام، اسل آ تنی گاوتی پتراب بیال کو
en: He talks with me, but the child hasn't become a friend yet... with me and you... slowly, slowly it will get better; really, their own father...
en_old: Talk to me, dear child... slowly come to the city. Really, your own son will come back.

brh: نکن کایا۔ ہا، من ایشانا پسی مہر دیگ لوٹی۔ من لوٹی کہ ئے گما بیاہاں، انباز بیباں۔ ایشانا بغل کنیت لوٹی۔ ایشانا مہر دیگ لوٹی۔ پسی مہر دیگ لوٹی۔ من زانا۔
en: [Unclear.] Yes, I want to give them a father's love. I want to be with them, to be their companion. I want to hug them. I want to give them love. I want to give them a father's love. I know.
en_old: I don't know. Yes, I want to give her a father's love. I want to be with her, to be her companion. I want to hold her in my arms. I want to give her love, a father's love. I know.

brh: ولے تو ہم کم و جاگہ نا واد بدے، کمی واد مہر نا گیش کہ۔ تو راز بشہ نازک، آن لوٹی کہ او نا پسی کمی احساس مبیت۔ من ہم ہمے لوٹی، ایشانی باندا۔
en: But you too, give it a little time and room; add a little more love. You be content, Nazuk. I want them not to feel the lack of a father. I want the same too, for their future.
en_old: But still, make a little room, give a little more love. You know the secret, Nazuk: I want her not to feel the lack of a father. I want that too, for them.

brh: دا تہار مبی، مروچی اگہ مہ زندگ ئنا ہمے چکانی ہترا، منی دنیا مچے چکا، ایشانی ڈر تما سگتہ کنے۔
en: Don't be gloomy. If I'm alive today, it is for these children. These children are my whole world, and fear for them weighs on me terribly.
en_old: Don't let it be dark. If I'm alive today, it's for these children. These children are my whole world, and my fear for them is very strong.

brh: او لیکن نازک من ترا رضا گانہ ہچبر ہچ تکلیف ندے او ہرچی کہ بوتک او شمارا وشی تے چدے شو
en: Oh, but Nazuk, I will never, ever give you any trouble, and whatever has happened, I will keep you all happy.
en_old: Oh, but Nazuk, I will never cause you any trouble, and whatever happens, I will keep you happy.

brh: انہ شما نا سلامت بکار۔ مرونک امو زاغانہ چارہ، ٹھیک ہن۔
en: No, your well-being is what's needed. Now look after those children, okay.
en_old: No, your well-being matters. Today, look after that child. Okay.

brh: ٹھیک انگے شما؟ ہا؟
en: Are you all right? Yes?
en_old: Are you all right? Yes?

brh: منی چنک منزانی تو زاہ
en: My little one, I know you know.
en_old: My little one, I know you know.

brh: ارے بلے ما ہرچی کتا نا بس ہمے ہاترا کتا بس اما ئے گپا ختم کا تو ہرچی کتا مئے ہاترا نہ وتی ہاترا کتا بلے ماہل جان
en: Hey, but whatever we did, we did only for this reason. Enough, Mom, end this talk. Whatever you did, you did for our sake, not for your own sake. But Mahal jan...
en_old: Hey, but whatever I did, I did only for this reason. Just let this talk end. Whatever I did, I did for us, not for myself. But Mahal jan...

brh: ئے دراہی بشومے ہاترہ کتا۔ تو نزانی ئے دنیا سگ ظالم ئے ئے مارا زند گوازنگا نشتگا۔ اما، بیرتہ یک پیری بے نہ سوچتا کہ ابا باری
en: I did all of this for your sake. You don't know: this world is very cruel; it hasn't let us live our lives. Mom, not even once did [you] think that Father...
en_old: I did it for your health. You don't know, this world is very cruel. It doesn't let us live our lives. Mother, an old man didn't think that, father...

brh: اما جو تنا بئے ماہل جان شو منی جنت ئے منس تنا شو بے پسا ہومار تا
en: Mom... Mahal jan, you are my paradise. I'm all alone; without you, without a father...
en_old: Mother, it's so good of you, Mahal jan. You are my paradise, you are mine. Without you...

brh: کنا یلدا شو، تو نہ سنی مائل، مچون زند گوازینگو، من و یک زندگی لاشو، بس۔
en: Leave it. You don't know, Mahal, how I'm getting through life. I'm a living corpse, that's all.
en_old: My dear, you don't understand, Mahal. How will life pass? You and I have one life, that's all.

brh: او شمے حترا زنتگاں، او شما وابتے، مدیرے مرتگ ئتو اینما دست بگش، دست بگش اما
en: I'm alive for your sake... and you... it's been a while since [he] died... and you, give me your hand, give me your hand, Mom.
en_old: They were beaten for your sake... the director has died... give me your hand, give me your hand, mother.

brh: اللہ تنے سلامت کے بچا سگت۔ ماہی جان تو نا سانی مچونی حالت آن چکو زبائو۔
en: May God keep you safe, child. Mahi jan, you don't know what a bad state I'm in.
en_old: May God keep you safe, child, friend. Mahi jan, you're in a worse state than me.

brh: او بش مئی منی مچوش کنے او ربوکو تے اما کوجا بروتے اماں منے فیل کا نو تا کدی پریشان تکنہ اماں بلہ کدی پریشان تکنہ
en: And... Mom, where would you go? Mom, [you] ... me ... don't ever worry. Mom, but don't ever worry.
en_old: And that's all... Mother, where should I go? Mother, I have failed... never worried, mother, but never worried.

brh: آ شاباش او غاش لک جان دستے ایدستے ایدستے ارے
en: Ah, well done! Oh, dear... the hand, this hand, this hand, hey!
en_old: Ah, well done, dear. Give me your hand, give me your hand, hey.

brh: واہ رے واہ واہ واہ شاباش واہ رے واہ باز جوانی بچک بیار بیار تو تو بکن ارے تو کٹے نازک چا تیار بوتن بیارے
en: Wow, wow, wow, well done! Wow! Very good, boy. Bring it, bring it, you do it, you. Hey, where are you, Nazuk? The tea is ready, bring it.
en_old: Wow, wow, wow, well done! Wow, very nice, child. Bring it, bring it, you do it... Nazuk, is the tea ready? Bring it.

brh: بیارے بیارے اونی بچکم بدے اونی جنکم بدے شاباش ابسو منت وار
en: Bring it, bring it. Give some to the boy too, give some to the girl too. Well done... thank you.
en_old: Bring it, bring it, give it to my son, give it to my daughter. Well done, thank you.

brh: زاگ باز وشم۔ نازو، زاگ مہر لوٹنت۔ او ئے عمرہ اشنو مہر ء کسر بیت۔
en: Children are very sweet. Nazo, children want love. And at this age, any shortfall of love shows on them.
en_old: Children are very sweet. Nazo, children need love. They should be shown the path of love all their lives.

brh: ہو ہمشانی خاطر آ ماما سیر کوتہ تاکہ اوشانی پرورش شر مرے او اوشانا پیتے کمی محسوس مپائے نازک زانے ہنگو تو سور کوتہ
en: Yes, it was for their sake that we got married, so that their upbringing would be good and they would not feel the lack of a father. Nazuk, you know that's why you got married.
en_old: Yes, it was for their sake that Mother married, so that they would be raised well and not feel the absence of their father. Nazuk, you know, that's why she married.

brh: نم زاغانی آترا من ترا وتی لوگا نبورتن ہمے داٹ کرتن ہمے داتن ایشنا مہر بدے ئے وتی شرے کہ تمے
en: Didn't I bring you to my home for your children's sake? I did this, I gave this... give them love; this is for your own good.
en_old: You... the children, I brought you to my home, I gave them... give them love, it is for your own good.

brh: انکس خیال داری کنے ئے زاگنو ایوکا تئی زاگنا منی ہم زاگن بچار شکوجم روچم ایشنا مہر دیگوں چکا واش شن نازک ایشنا
en: Take care of them like this. These children are not only yours, they're my children too. Look, night and day I'll give them love... the children... Nazuk, their...
en_old: Take good care of them. The children aren't only yours, they're my children too. Look, give them love every day... Nazuk, theirs...

brh: بس مہری چھڑے کمی نہ بیت۔ چا سرد بیت تا۔ سنگت پنا توار۔ وری توشرن چا بدے۔
en: Just let there be no lack of love. The tea is getting cold. Friend, call [them]; come and serve the tea.
en_old: Just don't let love be lacking. The tea is getting cold. A friend is calling. Come back and serve the tea.

brh: ئے بس اتنگ مکن ئے او شاباش شاباش دروازہ بند کر
en: That's enough, don't do so much... oh, well done, well done. Close the door.
en_old: Just don't stay so long... well done, well done, close the door.

brh: السلام علیکم واجہ۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ چونے ناکو قاسم؟ بس چونوں واجہ۔ زند گوازینگاون، دگہ چے۔ بلے زندے روچ چون گوازگانت؟ بس ہمے وڑ۔
en: Peace be upon you, sir. And upon you be peace. How are you, Uncle Qasim? Just fine, sir. We're getting through life, what else? But how are the days of life passing? Just like this.
en_old: Peace be upon you, sir. And upon you be peace. How are you, Uncle Qasim? Just fine, sir. Life is passing, what else? But how are your days going? Just the same.

brh: زندء اڑاند و جنجال آن تو خواجہ ، پدا چے بوناکو ، چے بگو شنتھر آ خواجہ ، ہمے بے روزگاری ، منی جاگ بے کار ، منی جند بے کار ، حیران آن کہ چے بکنہ ، پر چا
en: Life's troubles and hassles, sir. What else would it be, uncle? What can I tell you, sir: this same unemployment. My child is out of work, I myself am out of work. I'm at a loss what to do, for...
en_old: The troubles and hassles of life, sir. What else would it be, uncle? What can I say, sir, the same unemployment. My place is useless, I myself am useless. I'm at a loss what to do, why...

brh: ترا کجا سر کون گہار ترا ما ئے ہاترا لوٹتا کہ تو منے یک صلاحے بدے سلاہ چونے سلاہ تو ازانے گہار
en: Where should I begin, sister? I called you here for this reason: so that you would give me some advice. — Advice? What kind of advice? — You know, sister.
en_old: Where have you gone, sister? I wanted you to give me some advice. What advice? You know, sister.

brh: کہ قسمت منی مچے چے کن گئی، ئے کاروسے بوت، ئے دریائے آماچ بوت، دومی اروس بوت، اہم
en: ...what fate has done with me: one marriage happened, and he fell prey to the river; a second marriage happened, and also...
en_old: As for my fate, someone had a wedding, someone was taken by the river, another became a bride, too...

brh: ئے ہم مجبور اٹ۔ نو یک انچے چکاسی تا کپتنگو کہ ہچ فیصلہ کتن کینگائے۔ نازوک تو چھے گوشگ لوٹے؟ گوار نی کسانی زا گند۔ ایشانی پرورشے ہاترا۔
en: This one too was helpless. Now I have fallen into such a test that I cannot make any decision. — Nazuk, what do you want to say? — Sister, look at the little children, for the sake of their upbringing...
en_old: This one is also helpless. We've been put through such a test that no decision can be made. Nazuk, what do you want to say? Sister, look at your little children, and think about raising them.

brh: یک مردے ضرورت ئ۔ او نما فیصلہ کن کائیکہ کہ من عروس بکھلا۔ جوان، ئے تو باز جوانی فیصلہ ئ، بلے کجا؟ گو جانو۔
en: ...a man is needed. So now I have decided that I will get married. — Good, that is a very good decision, but where? With whom, dear?
en_old: A man is needed. He has come to you for a decision that I should get married. Well, that's a very good decision, but where? To whom, dear?

brh: چے جانو ترا ما ئے ہترا جوس کنغایا کے جانو چونی مردمی بچہ نا اسو من ترا چے سلاہ داتکنی مئے بارو ترا ہچ گشتنہ کنے چیا کے ئے منا طلاق
en: What, dear? I'm asking you this because, dear — what kind of man is he, and the children...? What advice can I give you? You have never told me anything about it. — Why? Because he gave me a divorce...
en_old: What is it, dear? I wanted to ask you, dear, how is your husband, and the child? What advice did you give? You never told me anything about it. Why... my divorce...

brh: بچار گل توتی لوگانی وش وشہ زند گوازینگے چونیہ باش شریف مئے
en: Look, Gul, you are living a happy life in your own home. How are you? — Fine, well...
en_old: Look, Gul, you're living happily in your home. How are you? Good, fine.

brh: ہردمی منی آئی جدائی یوکہ یک معمولی ہبرے سرا بتو آ روچ منا شریہ یادے
en: My separation from him came about over one ordinary matter; I remember that day well.
en_old: Every time we were apart, it was over some small, ordinary thing. I remember that day well.

brh: جا جا لگوئے ئے تو جسپست نا بت آن
en: Everywhere, at every step — this questioning of yours...
en_old: It hurts all over; that's from your questioning.

brh: درمتی مردم تو منی جنین من نم ترا جست کین تو کجا روگے او من تے جنین اٹ جنین ئے مطلب نئیں کہ تو ارا وتی غلام بزانک اچھا سرپد نامٹ من کدی ترا غلام ایال کرتا
en: I'm your husband and you're my wife; can't I ask you where you're going? — Yes, I am your wife, but 'wife' doesn't mean that you should regard her as your slave. — Oh, I see. I don't understand: when have I ever treated you as a slave?
en_old: In front of everyone, you are my wife. I can ask you where you're going. And a wife doesn't mean you should treat her as your slave, okay? Do you understand? Have I ever treated you like a slave?

brh: تو منی جنینے من ترا غلام عیال نہ کنے ئے وہ قصہ تو جست کنے تو کجا روگے ئے ڈھول سرنائے آواز اشکننگے منی دزگوارے عروسی امودا روگوں ہزم تورا
en: You are my wife; I don't treat you as a slave. It's just that I am asking where you're going. — You hear the sound of the drum and the sorna? It's my friend's wedding; I'm going there...
en_old: So you're my wife and I'm not some servant of yours... I'm asking you where you're going. You can hear the sound of the drum and the sarnai; it's my friend's wedding, so I'm going there.

brh: ڈھول سرنا نا توار و ہر گسا کائت، ہر مردم گوش کشی، ایشی مطلب نی کہ بس سرکس وتی دیما ود برو تے ہر کسے اروسا، تو چے فرق کپی، آ منی دزگوارے، آئی لوٹیک یا نا لوٹیک، ئے اچ سدے
en: The sound of the drum and sorna comes to every house, and everyone hears it; that doesn't mean that everyone should just head off on their own to everyone's wedding. — What difference does it make to you? She is my friend; whether she invited me or not, this...
en_old: The sound of the drum and the sorna comes from every house, and everyone listens. That doesn't mean you should just come forward at everyone's wedding. What difference does it make to you? He's my brother-in-law, whether he wants it or not. This is a hundred...

brh: ضرورت نئیں، سارگل خاتون، تو منی جنینے، منی عزت ئے، منی لج ئے، ترا نو منی عزت و منی لج ء خیال داری ترا کنگی انت، چو مکا؟ جوان، تو گڑا چے گوشئے؟ منی اوکے
en: There's no need, Gul Khatun. You are my wife, my honour, my modesty; now you must take care of my honour and my modesty. Don't do this. — Fine, then what are you saying? — My point is...
en_old: There's no need, Gul Khatun. You're my wife, my honour, my dignity. You should keep my honour and my dignity in mind. Don't do this. Fine, then what do you say? I'm okay with it.

brh: گوشگ لوٹی، یک مردم ترا عروسا نلوٹینتا، منا نلوٹینتا، گڑا تو پرچا روئے؟ ئے بوت نہ کن ما الما رویں، چے گوشگے تو؟ تو بے زانوک۔
en: ...what I want to say is: nobody invited you to the wedding, nobody invited me, so why are you going? — That can't be; I am definitely going. — What are you saying? You don't understand.
en_old: What I mean is, nobody invited you to the wedding and nobody invited me, so why are you going? Hey, there's no way we won't go. What are you saying? You don't understand anything.

brh: گومن، بوجانو وت دبجنی کنے؟ ایشی تا دبجنی چے گپے، امن دزگوارے، مئی سورہ روگو۔ بچار گل خاتون، نو منا مجبور مکن، نتو؟ نتو چے کنے؟
en: With me? Oh dear, are you yourself picking a quarrel? What is there to quarrel about in this? She is my own friend; I'm going to her wedding. — Look, Gul Khatun, don't force me now, or else— — Or else what will you do?
en_old: Well, are you going to make a fuss yourself? What fuss is there about this? It's my friend's wedding and I'm going. Look, Gul Khatun, don't force me, or else... Or else what will you do?

brh: منا جنے، منا خوشی من ترا گشت نہ کے، منیت از خواری اروسی، ارما اللہ مراویں۔ گل خاتون، تو واپس منا جسکنگے، ما اللہ مراویں۔
en: Will you hit me? It's my own wish. Didn't I tell you? It's my friend's wedding; I'll definitely go. — Gul Khatun, you're talking back to me again? — I'll definitely go.
en_old: You're my wife, my happiness. I won't let you go... It's my sister's wedding, and I'll go there, God willing. Gul Khatun, you're stopping me again, but I'm going, God willing.

brh: مارامی۔ شر۔ روگ لوٹئے برو۔ ترا موکل اٹ۔ بلے یک گپ وتی دل آ بیدار ہی یک وار تو ایشے دروازہ غا وتی پاد آ ڈن ایر کو۔ گڑا واپس ایسار نیائے۔
en: I'm going. — Fine. If you want to go, go; you have my permission. But keep one thing in your heart: once you set your foot outside this door, then don't come back here.
en_old: Fine. If you want to go, then go. You have my permission. But keep one thing in mind: once you set foot outside this door, don't come back.

brh: منترہ منترہ طلاق طلاق انترا گل خاتون طلاق انترا بس ئے وڑا یک کسانے گپے سرا منا سونگیاتے ولے گہار
en: I give you, I give you — divorce, divorce, you are divorced, Gul Khatun, you are divorced. — Just like that, over one small matter, he did this to me, oh sister.
en_old: I divorce you, I divorce you, I divorce you, Gul Khatun, I divorce you. That's it. Over such a small matter you've burned me, oh sister...

brh: ئے دروتی وتی سبو ہنچو بٹا، اگر تو چشمہ کتی گڑا، او گوار تو راست گشے، قصور منی اٹ، آئی ئے وڑ فہمٹ
en: This is how everyone breaks their own pot; if you hadn't done that, then... — Oh sister, you are right, the fault was mine; he took it that way.
en_old: Hey, everyone breaks their own pot... If you had thought about it... Oh sister, you're right. The fault is mine; I understood it that way.

brh: فیصلہ کوٹ تو گرا منا چے سلاہ دے گوار منتو گیشین تو تئی اور تیئی جاگہ نا خاطرہ کہ باز جوانی فیصلہ ئے
en: You have made your decision, so what advice can I give, sister? I'd say, for your own sake and for the sake of your place, it is a very good decision.
en_old: Once you've decided, what advice can I give you, sister? ...for your own sake and your place, because it's a very good decision.

brh: امہ بٹ وارنا توار جان اللہ امہ بٹ وارنا تو چھپابی نا وارتا امہ توار
en: That sound of the... oh dear God, that... of the... that sound.
en_old: That sound of the rain... dear God, that sound of the rain... the sound of the rain...

brh: کنا منبی نا وارا
en: At my [unclear] turn...
en_old: My turn...

brh: نازک تو ورخ ورنا بٹن چوہرا تو وڑتے ہاؤ مما وانو چون وڑ
en: Nazuk, eat your food, eat... — Yes, Mom, I'll eat... how can I eat?
en_old: Nazak, you eat, eat... how are you...

brh: بٹوا ہمہ پی مئے؟ تو منا یلدے، تئی تپ شر نینے نا؟ تو نواری گڑا تئی تپ چوں شر بئے تارا خوراکے ضرورت ئے شیم تو ور۔ مئے لپس مچو ہوارٹ کنا، تو ور۔
en: ...is that for me? — Leave me alone. — Isn't your fever better? If you don't eat, then how will your fever get better? You need food. Eat dinner. I'll eat a few mouthfuls together with you; eat.
en_old: Where is the wallet? Leave me alone. Your fever isn't better, is it? You don't eat, so how will your fever get better? You need food. Eat this... eat.

brh: کڑا تئی چے خیال ئے من وارت کنا؟ ہچ پیمو من بے وارت نہ کنا۔ تو زانے نازک من لوٹا تئی ہچ پیمے تکلیف پی مبی۔ تو وریگوا بیزا بیزا من وا۔
en: So what do you think, that I can eat? I can't eat in any way. — You know, Nazuk, I want you not to have any kind of trouble. Eat, come on, come on...
en_old: So what do you think, that I'll eat? There's no way I'll eat. You know, Nazak, I don't want you to have any trouble at all. You eat... eat a little.

brh: اما، اما چے مس؟ تو چیا خواروکے؟
en: Mom, Mom, what happened? Why are you so upset?
en_old: Mom, Mom, what happened? Why are you crying?

brh: اما بگو نا چیا گروکے بگو نا اما چیا پتا ہشنا پنت چا ٹوئی پنا
en: Mom, tell me, why are you crying? Tell me, Mom, why... (rest unintelligible)
en_old: Mom... what are you crying for... (unintelligible)

brh: شاباش شاباش پروش پروش دا سامان ء دا دے دیشی درش دے بس بس درش درش درش درش درش درش درش پروش ٹکر ٹکر ء بکن نی شاباش شاباش شاباش شاباش
en: Well done, well done! Break it, break it! This stuff, this — crush it! Enough, enough — crush, crush, crush, crush, crush, crush, crush! Break it, smash it to pieces! Well done, well done, well done, well done!
en_old: Bravo, bravo! Break it, break it! This stuff... break it, break it! Smash it to pieces! Bravo, bravo, bravo, bravo!

brh: ارے! ایس مچے کنا گائت؟ چے تو کورے نگندگے کنا گائیا؟ بھلے شوئے یکتار چے پروشا گائت؟ مے مرضی مرچی کنا تونگا جوس کنا۔ ئے یکتار منی ہی
en: Hey! What happened to my guitar? What, are you blind? Can't you see my guitar? — Fine, but why break the yaktar, the guitar? — It's my choice; today I'll question you. — This yaktar is mine.
en_old: Hey! What happened to my guitar? Are you blind? Can't you see my guitar? Fine, but why did you break the ektara? It's my choice; today I'll do what I want. That ektara is mine.

brh: ئے شمالک منو، تئی اینو میگیں پلانیگیں، برو، تنگ مکہ برو، من پریجی، شوازہ، شنگوادر آتگوں، منی یکدارب دے، برو برو برو، ئے میگیں، می مرضی می شرف
en: Hey... (unclear)... 'yours', 'ours', 'so-and-so's'... go, don't bother me, go... I've come from Gwadar... give me my yaktar; go, go, go; this is ours — our choice, our honour.
en_old: Hey, Shamalak... today is our... come on, don't trouble me, come on. I've come from Gwadar... my... come on, come on, come on. It's our choice, our honour.

brh: اوشے بندے ارچیکہ نی مہ گیس تو برو تے کاراب کم برو من دستہ پتی ئے یکدار منی ئے شر مفروچت شر دے یار دماغہ خراب مکن بابا روپانے ہمدا چپٹ برو تے کاراب کم نا پروش دے پچا
en: Stop it, man... you go and do your own work... This yaktar is mine; don't sell it; give it back properly. Man, don't mess with my head, father. The money is right here... go do your work; don't break it — why?
en_old: Stop that. If you're not going out of the house, then go and do your work. I've given up on you. It's not good, friend, don't mess with my head, father. The money is right here... go do your work.

brh: دانا کو قاسم، دئی بچ، پھلانے جگدار چلائنگا نین، اینا واجہ، پھلان وتی تبی مردومے، اگا ئے موڈ بیتو دریا روت، نتو درائے۔
en: So, Uncle Qasim, your boy... isn't so-and-so's [boat?] running? No, sir. So-and-so is a man of his own moods: if he's in the mood, he goes out to sea, otherwise he doesn't.
en_old: Uncle Qasim, the son of so-and-so isn't running the boat. What's this, sir? So-and-so is a moody person: if he's in the mood he goes out to sea, otherwise he doesn't.

brh: روز قصہ کپہ۔ نا کو قاسم ئے شر نینت۔ وجہ ہمو کار چے بوتا۔ تو فکر مکن، من کوشش کننگان، اللہ خیر۔
en: It's the same story every day. Uncle Qasim, this isn't good. Sir, what happened with that matter? Don't you worry, I'm trying. God willing, it will be fine.
en_old: Don't tell stories every day. Uncle Qasim isn't well. Why did that happen? Don't worry, I'm trying. God willing, it will be fine.

brh: بس واجہ، ہغے کار بوتو، ما دعائے زند شمارا دوادے این، شمے ہترا دعا کین واجہ۔ سرکار وعدہ کے، ہر چنکس کے ناخدا استاں، آوانا سہولت بے
en: Well, sir, if that work gets done, we'll pray for your long life. We pray for you, sir. The government has promised that however many boat captains there are, they will get facilities.
en_old: Well sir, if that work gets done, we will pray for your life. We pray for you, sir. The government has promised that however many boat captains there are, they will get facilities.

brh: بس اللہ پاک نا توکل آ ئے کار آ کہ شما کریتو ما دروشما نا منت وار با۔ ئنا ناکو قاسم چوش مگوش ئے منی فرض انت۔
en: Just, trusting in God, if you get this work done, we will all be grateful to you. No, Uncle Qasim, don't say that, it's my duty.
en_old: Just trusting in God, we thank you for the work you have done. Uncle Qasim, don't say that, it's my duty.

brh: آوے غلام غوث کے چون کرتے؟ واجہ کہ نبلو اسو گرفتار بوتوں۔ چے؟ گرفتار بوتت؟ ئے تو چے گوشہ گے؟
en: Hey, Ghulam Ghaus, how did it go? Sir, Nablo has been arrested. What? He's been arrested? What are you saying?
en_old: Hey Ghulam Ghaus, what did you do? Sir, Nablo has been arrested. What? Arrested? So what are you saying?

brh: جیا واجہ من راستی گشنگاؤں من اوترا چھیڑ دات او تے جان چھڑائینٹ اوہو ئے شر نہ بوت بلے آ کجانت واجہ پولیس تا قبضہ ٹی آن بلے پلم بگوش کہ چون گے
en: Yes, sir, I'm telling the truth: I left him there and saved my own skin. Oh, that wasn't good. But where is he? Sir, he's in police custody. But tell me properly how it happened.
en_old: Yes sir, I'm telling the truth. I let him go, he got himself free. That wasn't good. But where is he, sir? In police custody. But tell me how it happened.

brh: گرفتار بوتن۔ من نزانو واجہ۔ شاہ میر امداد تگہ شومرو چمدا توتی کشتی پجار ات مچاری چمدا شوت و شوت پولیس ء زرت و آت۔ گڑا شما یکدارا دگہ جاگہ پرچا نہ برت ات؟ واجہ ما یکدارا چون برت کنین کہ آئی کپلنگ اش پچ کتگہ۔
en: How he got arrested I don't know, sir. Shah Mir, Imdad... from there the boat was recognized(?), they went on from there, and the police seized [him] and brought [him]. Then why didn't you take the Yakdar somewhere else? Sir, how could we take the Yakdar when they had opened up its coupling?
en_old: He was arrested. I don't know, sir. Shah Mir's help... at night the boat was... the police caught him and took him. Then why didn't you take the Yaktara somewhere else? Sir, how could we take the Yaktara when they had opened it up?

brh: یکتارہ بارو بگوش پلان۔ واجہ یکتارہ پولیس نا قبضہ ٹی ء۔ شر انت۔ تو تے پدا سر کن۔ بلی خیال کنے۔ پلان تمنئے بگوش کہ۔
en: Tell me about the Yaktara, so-and-so. Sir, the Yaktara is in police custody. All right. You head back again. But be careful. So-and-so, tell [him] that...
en_old: Tell me about the Yaktara, so-and-so. Sir, the Yaktara is in police custody. All right. Then you go back. But be careful. Tell so-and-so that...

brh: نبلو ازو دپت پچ کناٹ؟ نا نا نا واجہ تو بیگم ببو میرم بلے زبان پچ کناٹ۔ شر شر واجہ مہربانی مہربانی۔
en: Nablo, did you open your mouth? No, no, no, sir, I would die before I opened my mouth. Good, good. Sir, thank you, thank you.
en_old: Nablo, did you open your mouth? No, no, no, sir, I would rather die than open my mouth. Good, good, sir. Thank you, thank you.

brh: گجوی بے او پیدان، پیدان۔ بختاور، چھمتہ؟ چھمتہ۔ بختاور، اللہ نی سرفراز کے، مئے اقتدار
en: [unclear]... it's been found, found! Bakhtawar, [did you hear?] [I did.] Bakhtawar, God has exalted [us], our standing...
en_old: Sit down and walk, walk. Bakhtawar, the eyes? The eyes. Bakhtawar, may God exalt you, our authority.

brh: تو براہوئی حلوا جوڑ کہ، شکنی جوڑ کہ، اللہ نا نمہ خیرات ایوکہ بختاور، اللہ نا لکھ شکران، بھلے شاہ میر کجے، شاہ میر، ایمنی منیکہ، شاہ میر ایمنی یک دراک ہمو کہ نقصانی دست گٹ، ہمو ایمنی منیکہ شر کنگو ڈی
en: Go and make halwa, make a thanksgiving treat, give alms in God's name, Bakhtawar. A hundred thousand thanks to God. But where is Shah Mir? Shah Mir, this [boat] of mine... Shah Mir, this Yakdar of mine that suffered the loss, he's the one who is making it right [unclear].
en_old: So make Brahui halwa, make shukni, give charity in God's name, lucky one. A hundred thousand thanks to God. But where is Shah Mir? Shah Mir... Shah Mir is the one who suffered the loss... he...

brh: کہ تینا؟ بچا، من ترہ گوشت نا، اللہ غفور الرحیم ئے اللہ مئے مدتا ضرور کا، دستے نا؟ ہاؤ گنجا، ئے اللہ تے لاکھ لاکھ شکر ئے کہ تو مئے سفر آ راحت و مئے یک گام آ راست۔ ما شونو حلوہ جوڑ کن کانہ تری۔ ہر، زوت کا۔
en: ...his own? Son, didn't I tell you? God is forgiving and merciful, God will surely come to our help, didn't He? Yes, my treasure. A hundred thousand thanks to God that You are our comfort on our journey and true to us at every step. We're making halwa for you. Go, come back quickly.
en_old: Your own? Son, I'm telling you, God is forgiving and merciful, God will surely help us, won't He? Yes, baldy. Thanks to God a hundred thousand times that you are comfortable on our journey and steady at our every step. Tonight we'll make halwa for you. Go, come back quickly.

brh: تو یار اکمل تو ایدا مانی لوغہ
en: So, friend Akmal, you stay here at home.
en_old: So, friend Akmal, you stay here at home.

brh: بیا بیا جھنے بیا۔ او باز بے غیرتیں مردم دیستٹ۔ ولے تئی وڑیں بے غیرتیں مردم ایہہ جگہ من نہ دیستٹ۔ بکواس کننگ نا ضرورت اف نی تا۔ تو زانے تو کئی او گنوک ئس اگر من بلوچ اٹ نا۔
en: Come, come, woman, come. I've seen many shameless men, but a shameless man like you I have never seen anywhere. You have no need to talk nonsense. Do you know who you are? A madman, if I'm a Baloch...
en_old: Come, come, come here. I have seen many shameless people, but I have never seen a shameless person like you in this place. You have no need to talk nonsense. You know you're a madman, if I'm a Baloch.

brh: مطلب چپ دو منٹ آ مٹ ٹکر ٹکر کنائے نی ارے تئو مانا چھی دو منٹ آ ٹکر ٹکر کنائے نی ہنو بے وس پتر آ چارے کے توکھے
en: I mean, every two minutes you start bickering. Hey, you... every two minutes you start bickering. Look at that poor helpless boy...
en_old: I mean, quiet, every two minutes you start bickering, every two minutes you start bickering, look at that helpless boy...

brh: دا ولدا ننگٹی خلکا؟ نی سما انت کہ ننگٹی؟ نہ، او دا خاطرہ ننگٹی کہ کا کڈے معلوم کے کہ نی اخہ راست پس اخہ دروغ تڑیسے۔ جی جی بیشک۔
en: Did he put on this [neck]tie again? Do you know why the tie? No. He wears the tie for this reason: so he can find out how much truth you tell and how many lies you spin. Yes, yes, of course.
en_old: Did he put this on again? Do you know why he put it on? No, he put it on so that he can find out how much truth you tell and how many lies you spin. Yes, yes, of course.

brh: بے شک سر نمو دے کنا وراغ راہی کبو ولے اوفتے دا پاپیرے کے اراڑ کے اوٹ او کار معلوم کیرے کے راست پاننگٹیوٹ یا دروغ پاننگٹیوٹ ایلوم دا نی انت پاننگٹیوس ایڑ پارے کہ دا تعویز نا دیک او نا گٹاں شیف اینار تو سمجھ کہ او
en: Of course, sir. You send him to my house. But this paper of theirs, the thing that lets you find out whether I'm telling the truth or lying... Brother, what is this you're saying? Sister said that if this amulet is hung down from his neck, then understand that he...
en_old: Of course, sir, send my clothes today, but tell them about this paper, the one they use to find out whether he's telling the truth or lying. Brother, what are you saying? He said that if you hang this amulet down his neck, then understand that he...

brh: او خلکہ بس ہاں شیخانہ گہ خلکہ سرمست گڑا نناں مرو گڑا ایلوم دن کینے دا تعویز جوڑ اسے ٹی سلنے اندن اسے تعویز سودے کنفنے تاکہ ننا دروغ راست مرے ارے نی
en: He put it on. Yes, Sheikhana put it on too, Sarmast; then it will be ours. So, brother, do this for me: make this amulet into a pair(?), get me an amulet just like it, so that our lies become truth, hey you.
en_old: He put it on, yes, Sheikhana put it on, Sarmast, then it will be ours. So, brother, do this: put this amulet into a pair, sew an amulet like this so that our lie becomes the truth, right?

brh: نی دن کپ پگہ گل بے بے بریک، گل بے بے ہئو، گل بے بے بریک، نی اسہ جوان او خرن او پھوٹا والا چاس جوڑ کیس، قران تے نا، بند سے کسے پاپیس، اگر پاس تو ڈاس ایان چاڈانے بے
en: Don't you do that. Tomorrow... Gul Bibi, break(?); Gul Bibi, yes; Gul Bibi, break(?). You make a nice green tea with [unclear]. Swear on the Quran, don't tell anyone; if you tell, then [unclear]...
en_old: Don't do this, tomorrow Gul Bibi, break; Gul Bibi, yes; Gul Bibi, break. You make a nice tea... I swear on the Quran, don't tell anyone; if you tell, then...

brh: دڑبو ایلم دڑبو او فرانچ والا دڑبو ایلم خاچانو ارے ابا اف نما بس سکی ایلم دڑبو کانے ہر قربان بے الے بائے الے بائے الے بائے ولے خیرا کراچی نی مرو؟
en: Get down, brother, get down, you in the front(?), get down. Brother, they've fallen asleep. Hey, father isn't with you... just [unclear]. Brother, get down, I'm going. [unclear] Bye, bye, bye. But is everything all right? Will you be in Karachi?
en_old: Wait, brother, wait, that French guy, wait, brother, I'll go to sleep, yes, father, no, yours is just strict, brother, wait, I'm coming, go, I'd give my life for you, bye, bye, bye. But anyway, will you be in Karachi?

brh: ہو ڈاکٹر آن ٹائم الکونٹ چیک اپ کنے گاٹور۔ سہی ئے نم تینے بالکل پریشان کپبو ئے داڑے اریٹ۔ نی اریس تو اندا خاطر ئے فکر کپرو۔
en: Yes, I've taken an appointment with the doctor for a checkup. Okay. Don't worry yourselves at all, I'm here. You're here, so that's why I won't worry.
en_old: Yes, I've got an appointment with the doctor for a checkup. Fine, don't worry yourselves at all, I'm here. You're here, so that's why I won't worry.

brh: تہو نن دا تو دا تو، نی دا مسڑ کو راٹھی تھولک، نہ مارا کو تھولک، آئی کائک چڑا چوناتے تو دوتو گوازی کیک، اینا چڑا ہر پھولے لئی چوکاتے، ہمبر اللہ تے نی، بابا نی
en: So we, this, this... This daughter of yours sits at home, but the son doesn't stay sitting [at home]; he goes and plays with the little children, [unclear]... [unclear] God..., your father.
en_old: So we, this, this, you this woman... the boy... he comes and plays with the birds... by God, father.

brh: توئے نوم ارا ئلان نرا نی تو تھلو راٹی کاری مارے مسخرک آئی کاری میلک پین کاری مستما انت کاری مستما پیشن ایرا بابا سلوکو انتکے آئی ماما مٹل پئے دا مسافرو دتت داورا
en: Your name... which... ran off(?)... you sit at home... the boy [makes] jokes(?)... other work... what work... father... uncle... these travelers... [largely unintelligible].
en_old: What is your name... the boy... another job... what job... father... uncle... this traveler...

brh: ئے دا دیر و چاس اتتہ مٹھن نا وراٹی ڈکانی ہن نا وراٹی مونی تکتہ کین چا وراٹی تتا ئے اونے وراک نوا باوانا نا بارہ وٹی گڑاس معلوم مرے توار کپتہ توار کتا
en: [I] brought this water and some tea... in Mitthan's(?) house, at the shop, in [someone's] house... so that maybe something becomes known about father; [he] didn't call, [then] called.
en_old: This late tea... at the shop... so that something becomes known about father; he didn't call, he called.

brh: او ماما جی بابو بابو ابا بر بر السلام علیکم تول بو السلام علیکم
en: Oh, uncle! Babu, babu, father, come, come. Peace be upon you. Please sit down. Peace be upon you.
en_old: Oh uncle, babu, babu, father, come, come, peace be upon you, sit down, peace be upon you.

brh: خیر ئے امر بسونرے؟ ایڑے اسل ٹیٹ دادے کہ کنا ایلم گم مسونے ہمودے پٹنگ کن نما خلکا بسونٹ۔ مسافرون۔ نا ایلم نی آن بلونس چنا کس؟ ایڑ کنے غان مچے بلونس اکا
en: Is all well? How is it you've come? Sister, actually it's this: my brother has gone missing, and I've come to your village to search for him. We're travelers. Is your brother older than you or younger? Sister, he's a little older than me.
en_old: Is all well, how have you come? Brother, actually my brother has gone missing, and I came to your house to look for him. We are travelers. Is your brother older than you or younger? Brother, he's older than me.

brh: داڑے چنک ئس اینا داخل مچے پین چنک ئس قربان اللہ نشانی، درو پیرو نا باوا، ہور ایلہ نرا، نن اوڑ کے پریشان اون، بے وس، پیرو
en: Here is a little one, [another] came in, another little one, a gift from God(?). Yesterday Piro's father... ran off(?); we are worried about him, helpless. Piro...
en_old: Here a girl came in, another girl, by God's grace, Piro's father... we are worried about him, helpless, Piro.

brh: پیرو! ایراخ کمپک بیست و سواران مسٹ کوتہ اوئی کنا تو گٹ نا سلنے دیرس گدرینگک نی ایراخس نی چاس۔ نا روانہ پنانتہ سکھا؟ پیرو نا باوا سکھا؟ او ک
en: Piro! [He] won't eat any food... [unclear: twenty, since lunch?]... it sticks in my throat; only a little water goes down. You, [bring] some food; you, some tea. What's the name? Piro's father...? He...
en_old: Piro! ... my throat... a while passes, you... tea. Where has your... gone? Where is Piro's father? He...

brh: کنا مطلب اندادے کہ پیرو نا باوہ تو اسکہ اونا پین انت اسکہ کنا باوہ نا پین شیر خان ئس شیر خان شیر خان شیر خان ننے اجازت تن کا ہو ہمبولا
en: What I mean is, Piro's father, what is his name? My father's name is Sher Khan. Sher Khan, Sher Khan, Sher Khan. Give us leave to go. Yes, that one...
en_old: What I mean is that Piro's father, his name is... my father's name is Sher Khan. Sher Khan, Sher Khan, Sher Khan. Give us permission to go, yes, that one.

brh: نومک نومہ، ایڑونا سفت نشانی مشانی سے، مگر نی کن کے پٹیس تے ستا نشانی مشانی بس پیون ء عینک خلکونے ٹوپ ئس تے خانے بینن نشانی تنے، خیر کوشش کینے، بس کہ کہ کہ کہ خاموش بس، آ گنو مے معلوم
en: A name is just a name. Sister, [give] his description, signs and such. But for the one you're searching for, his signs are just this: he wears [white?] glasses and a cap... give [me] the signs. Well, we'll try. Just... just... quiet! That crazy one, who knows.
en_old: Names are just names; describing them takes some marks to go by. But for the one you're looking for, the only marks are that he's wearing glasses and a hat. I'll give you the marks. Well, try. Just, just... he went quiet, that crazy one, who knows.

brh: داڑے مس پیرونا باوانا کنے گوا ضرور پارے ضرور پان لکان کامبو ٹاٹا ہائے تمبر خوش ہب
en: It happened here... Pero's father... to me... he certainly said so; of course, say it... [unclear]... ta-ta, bye... be happy.
en_old: It happened here. Piro's father did tell me, of course, of course... bye-bye... be happy.

brh: دے چارا کاراکا بریرہ ننا جند نا بندغ گوئنگانے ننتیکے پریشانون ئے بننگٹیو کس پہیٹنا دغرس ننا اوراٹی پیانے پٹنگ کے تبسونو
en: Four days... they come... a person of our own has gone missing, and we ourselves are worried... someone is coming... someone [else] has entered our house... searching...
en_old: Four days... they come... one of our own people has gone missing, and we're worried. Nobody is coming... a stranger has come into our house, and we've been searching.

brh: جی پیسہ آئی نی اللہ خلے نی ہر کسے استا داڑے مگہ باوانا داڑے دنیا نا گڑا تیلا نینا کنے مہمانداری کیندی رکھ کینو اوئے اما کینی ہائے رگبے رگبے بیش آئی جک بے
en: Yes, money... you, God... you, everyone's... here, but Father's [place] is here... worldly things... yours... showing me hospitality and taking care [of me]... oh, what are you doing? Hey... [unclear]...
en_old: Yes, money... you, God willing, you are everyone's... but at father's place, worldly things... he's showing me hospitality... oh, what is he doing, oh... come on, come on, quickly...

brh: تھدرینگ تمے کننگ خاچنگ ہم بے دسپن کاری مرینے خاچنگ سہی پارے آئی پی خاچک واہ پیرو اوکا ڈنڈا ئے
en: [unclear]... eating and sleeping too... [unclear]... sleeping, right, he said... [she] sleeps... Wow, Pero, it's a stick!
en_old: Exhausted... eating, sleeping too... without a care... sleeping, right, he said, he's sleeping. Wow, Piru, that stick of his.

brh: گڑا نی انت سوچانوس؟ یرا ہیت نا تو سئیے، ولے اگہ او واپس بس گڑا؟ واپس بس؟ ہمو ہیت کسہ ئے یار، او واپس بننگ کن ننتنے، واپس بننگ باز مشکل ئے داسہ۔
en: So what have you been thinking? Man, what you say is right, but what if he comes back? Comes back? That's just a story, man. He can't come back; coming back is very hard now.
en_old: So what are you thinking? Man, you have a point, but what if he comes back? Comes back? That's just a story, man. He's not going to come back. Coming back is very hard now.

brh: سمجھ کے او خس کے نا او خس مار تتو رے ہمو پیرو مار تتو رے ہمو عید کے سہی یار او پاگل سے گنوک سے او دے الس مائی کے او ہفتا ٹگاراک ہرا تس کانو او تو تینا سما اف او دے ہاؤ
en: Understand that he's dead, he's dead... that Pero, his son... [unclear]... right, man, he's a madman, a lunatic; he wanders the land wherever he goes; he isn't even aware of himself. Yes, him.
en_old: Understand that he's... his son, he's Piru's son... that Eid... right, man, he's mad, he's crazy, he... every week on the ground... he doesn't even know himself, him, yeah.

brh: گڑا امر کیٹ؟ ہمم۔ ئے کنڈی، نی قبضہ کننگ شروع کرک۔ او ولدا ایلو کنڈی، نی قبضہ کیوہ پین انت؟ او، ہا، دنو۔
en: So what do we do? Hmm. On that side, you start taking possession. And then on the other side, I'll take possession. What else? Oh, yes, like this.
en_old: So what should we do? Hmm. On this side, you start taking over. And then on the other side, I'll take over. What else? Oh, yes, like this.

brh: او موکھا بار بار ملے پت ئے تو بس باز جوانو کریت تو بس ہانے ئے تو ہر وخت جوانی گیت کیوا او بس انشاءاللہ دے گپ فکر کپے
en: And such a chance doesn't come again and again. ...that was very well done, so that's it. Yes, I always talk about good things. And just, God willing, don't worry about this matter.
en_old: Such a chance doesn't come again and again. Father did very well, so that's it. Yes, he always talks about good things. Just, God willing, don't worry.

brh: او نکرے ئے تینتے بم پیش اکرٹ او بابا صبر کرک نی حوصلہ کرک ئے بم گٹ کھلی ئے تاتے بم دے حوصلہ کرک انت ئس کے مس بدام اللہ خیر کے نی سما ئے کہ ونت پانے گٹ اسو او کنے خبر ئے ونت پانے گٹ اسو بہرحال نی
en: Oh, [unclear]... Oh father, be patient, you, have courage... [unclear]... have courage. Whatever has happened, God will make it well. You know what he was saying, and I know what he was saying. Anyway, you...
en_old: Oh, what was it... oh father, be patient, have courage... courage, what happened... God help us. You know what he was saying, and I know what he was saying. Anyway, you...

brh: بکھا بکھا بکھا ئے پاواں نی الے پارہ او پدی نائے مڑانی انت سوچانس یرا ہیت نا تو سئی ء ولے
en: Come, come, come, I'm telling you... you... and then... What are you thinking? Man, what you say is right, but...
en_old: Barkha, Barkha, Barkha, I'm telling you... and then... What are you thinking? Man, you have a point, but...

brh: اگر او واپس بس گڑا واپس بس ہمو ہیت کسے یار او واپس بننگ کن انتنے واپس بننگ باز مشکل ئے دا سمجھ کہ او کسک کنا او کسک مارتا تورے
en: What if he comes back, then? Comes back? That's just a story, man; he can't come back, coming back is very hard. Now understand that he's dead, my... he's dead, his son...
en_old: What if he comes back? Comes back? That's just a story, man. Why would he come back? Coming back is very hard. Understand that he's... my... his son...

brh: اوے ہمو پیرو مار تورے ہمو ریت کے زیا او پاگل اسے گنوک اسے اودے ہر سمے کے وقت آ ڈگاراٹ ہراٹ اسکان او او تو تینا سما اف اودے ہاؤ گڑا امر کین
en: That Pero, his son... [unclear]... he's a madman, a lunatic; at all hours he's out on the land, wherever... he isn't even aware of himself. Yes, him. So what do we do?
en_old: He's that Piru's son, that... he's mad, he's crazy, all the time on the ground, as far as... he doesn't even know himself, yeah. So what should we do?

brh: ئے کنڈی، نی قبضہ کننگ شروع کر۔ او ادا، ئے لو کنڈی، نی قبضہ کیوہ پین نت۔ او، ہاں، دنو موقع بار بار ملے پک۔
en: On that side, you start taking possession. And here, on the other side, I'll take possession; what else? Oh, yes, such a chance doesn't come again and again.
en_old: On this side, you start taking over. And here, on the other side, I'll take over. What else? Oh, yes, a chance like this doesn't come again and again.

brh: یا بیت تس باز جوانو کرے۔ تو بس۔ ہانہ! ئے تو ہر وقت جوانی کے ہیت کیوا۔ او بس انشاءاللہ تو فکر کپے۔ او نکرے ہیت انت ابے۔
en: ...that was very well done. So that's it. Yes! I always talk about good things. And just, God willing, don't you worry. Oh, [unclear]... what's the matter?
