brh: دا و نا بہا جان نا میمانے، دا ختنگ کپتہ۔ تاتی! میمان مرے یا بادشاہ، پیسے تو کل تے روئی مریک۔ زو کشی وشے کو بکل! وشے!
en: This one is your brother's guest; he can't be charged. Auntie! Guest or king, everyone has to pay the money. Quickly, take out the money, all of it! Money!
en_old: This is the guest of his dear brother, he can't be stopped. Uncle! Whether guest or king, everyone has to pay the money. Quickly, pull out the money, give it! Money!

brh: اوہ اینو تو باز خوش لگیگٹی ئس ہنتیت اسے شائستہ نن ایم تو معلوم لگے نسرین ہاؤ اینو باز خوشٹ اینداخو خوشٹ اینداخو خوشٹ
en: Oh, today you're looking very happy. Is there something? Shaista, let us know too. Nasreen, yes, today I'm very happy, so happy, so happy.
en_old: Oh, today you're looking very happy, there's something, Shaista, we also got to know. Nasreen, yes, today I'm very happy, so happy, so happy.

brh: چٹکی ئے پانے گپ ارے آخر امر خوشی ئس ملانے ننے پا اینو کنا کل ارمانک پورا مسر تینا زندگی دریفنگ نا یخا ارمان کریسٹ ہمو کل اینو پورا مسر او دا سسما تما شارن نا سانگ بنداک بننگٹی او
en: Quickly, tell us what the matter is! After all, what kind of happiness have you found? Tell us. Today all my wishes have come true. All the wishes I had made for how to spend my life came true today, and this [unclear], the betrothal party from the city is coming.
en_old: Chatki, tell me what's going on. After all, what kind of joy has come our way? Say it: today all my wishes have come true. Every wish I had for my life has been fulfilled today, and Shaista and Shar's wedding songs are starting.

brh: او نسرین، پاریکہ صبر نا باز بلو بخشش اسے، کنا است نا ارمان آک اینو پورہ مننگٹی او۔ بلے خیال کیس، شار اینوس، ننے استن دپیس، گرام کپیس۔ نسرین، نی کنا سنگت ئس کنا ایڑ ئس نی کنا اخہ خیال ء تخانس۔
en: Oh Nasreen, they say patience brings a very great reward; my heart's wishes are being fulfilled today. But take care: you'll be going to the city, so don't put us out of your heart, don't forget us. Nasreen, you are my friend, you are my sister, you have taken such care of me.
en_old: Oh Nasreen, they say patience is a very great blessing, and today my heart's wishes are coming true. But take care, Shar. Today you mustn't hide anything from us, and don't worry. Nasreen, you're my friend and my sister, and you've taken such good care of me.

brh: اینے امر گیرام کننگ کیو؟ اسل گیرام کپرنے بے غم مر۔ اوندا پابو ننا سالوم انت کاریم کیک امرو مارسی ننے ہم معلوم مرے۔ دا کنے خبر اف کہ او انت کاریم کیک لیکن کنے دا خبر ئے کہ او شار ٹی رینگک پین کنک کسے شاہزادہ سے۔
en: How could I forget you? I won't forget you at all; don't worry. Now tell us, what work does our son-in-law do, what kind of boy is he? We should know too. I don't know what work he does, but I do know that he lives in the city, and besides, he's like a prince.
en_old: How can I not worry? Don't worry at all, put your mind at ease. Tell me, what does our future son-in-law do? What kind of boy is he? We should know too. I don't know what work he does, but I do know he lives in the city and lives like a prince.

brh: شاستہ اللہ نی خوش تخے نی خوش نن خوش
en: Shaista, may Allah keep you happy. If you're happy, we're happy.
en_old: Shaista, may Allah keep you happy. If you're happy, we're happy.

brh: چوکے نام نا رنگ باز جوان لگانے، تون غور اٹ اوننگ اٹ اوستے، یار ئے تے نام نا رنگ نا ف، ئے تے نام نا خلوک ایٹ ف، ہر حساب اٹ
en: The colour of the name looks very nice; you are looking at it carefully. Friend, for me it isn't about the colour of the name, it isn't about who put the name there; it's in every respect.
en_old: The girl's name sounds very nice. Look carefully, friend, it's not just the name, it's ... in every way.

brh: او خلق تے تو گڑا رنگ خور پونے چھان تو قصہ داڑ اسکا سر مسنے اسیتس پانے سیت شائستہ باس کمال نا مسڑ اسئی
en: Oh, so then people [unclear]... So the story has come to this point? One thing I'll say: Shaista was a truly wonderful girl.
en_old: Oh, so that's it... So the story ends here? Shaista was a wonderful girl.

brh: اچھا، اگہ دا خبراس جوان و مسٹ اسے، تو دے نی تینا زند ٹی انتئے وار کتوس؟ یار، بدقسمتی دا مس کہ اونا سنگ مس، اونا سنگ آن پد ئے سنگ کریٹ، اور کنا سنگ آن فورا پد اونا ڈیتھ مس۔
en: Okay, if this was such a good and lovely thing, then why didn't you take that chance in your own life? Friend, the misfortune was that her engagement took place; after her engagement I got engaged, and right after my engagement she died.
en_old: Okay, if this was such a good and sweet thing, why didn't you ever do it in your own life? Friend, the misfortune was that he got married, I got married after him, and right after my marriage he died.

brh: نا ایکسیڈنٹ مسک، او بیچارہ دا دنیا ئے لا۔ ہاؤ! مائی گاڈ، ویری سیڈ یار! او تو خو بس ٹریجڈی مس گورا۔ ہاؤ یار، باز بلو مسلہ ئس مسک۔ ولے نی کلے لے ناشتہ
en: She had an accident, and the poor thing left this world. Oh! My God, that's very sad, friend! That was just a tragedy. Yes, friend, it was a very big blow. But you, go ahead and have your breakfast.
en_old: ...had an accident, and the poor thing left this world. Yes! My God, that's very sad, friend! That was just a tragedy. Yes, friend, it was a really big blow. But come on, have your breakfast.

brh: فکر کرک یار اللہ خیر کیکک
en: Don't worry, friend, Allah will make it all right.
en_old: Don't worry, friend. Allah will make everything all right.

brh: شائستہ ہینے
en: Shaista is gone.
en_old: Shaista, here.

brh: فرض ء پورا کرے چٹ۔ عمر، مہربانی۔ عمر، کنے معاف کیس۔ شاستہ۔
en: ...[I] fulfilled [my] duty. Umar, thank you. Umar, forgive me. Shaista.
en_old: He fulfilled his duty completely. Umar, thank you. Umar, forgive me. Shaista.

brh: نی تنے پاریسس نا کہ مہر قربانی خواہک، داستو باور بسنے۔
en: You had said, hadn't you, that love demands sacrifice? Now I have come to believe it.
en_old: Didn't you tell yourself that love demands sacrifice? Now you've come to believe it.

brh: موڑی کٹ کرو ٹو کسفوٹے لوٹے او داسہ کنا عزت ئے ئے چاو کنا کاریم چاو نامیر صاحب آن فیصلہ ئس کہ نم کریسورے او مس ہنا داسہ دن مفرور
en: ...I will kill him... and now my honor is my business, my work is my business. The decision you all had made with your Mir Sahib, and that happened, [but] now it will not be like that.
en_old: ...and now look at my honor, look at my work. The decision you made with Mir Sahib... now it won't be like this.

brh: امام بخش مار ایتنا لگام ایت۔ دن مف کہ کنا دو آن ضائع مرے۔ خیال کیس میر بہادر خان۔ کنے آ دو ہرفیس تو کنے آن بد و بندہ خنپروس۔ بند ک باہ ایتنا نت تو۔ چپ کبو خدا نا پنا چپ کبو۔ ابا نی دادک اوہو چپ کبو۔
en: Imam Bakhsh, son, give... give the reins. Don't let it be lost at my hands. Be careful, Mir Bahadur Khan. If you raise a hand against me, you will not find a worse man than me. Shut your mouth... Be quiet, for God's sake be quiet. Oh, you, look... be quiet.
en_old: Imam Bakhsh, son, hand over the reins, hand them over. I don't want it to get away from me. Be careful, Mir Bahadur Khan. If you raise a hand against me, you won't find anyone worse than me. Tie his feet. Be quiet, for God's sake be quiet. Father, you... be quiet.

brh: انچن صاحب اینک نی اینک بش تم میر صاحب خدا نا پنٹ مچے حوصلہ اٹ کاریم ال بو ورنا سے
en: Anchan Sahib, step aside; you step aside, get up. Mir Sahib, for God's sake, act with a little patience, young man.
en_old: Anchan Sahib, come, you come along. Mir Sahib, for God's sake, act with patience, young man.

brh: ایٹ غے مسنے؟ او سچ تو بریک نا؟ نی بچٹ صبرٹ کاریم ہٹ، اللہ خیر کے۔
en: What has happened? Is he really coming or not? Be a little patient, God will make it all right.
en_old: What has happened? Is he coming or not? Just be patient, God will make it all right.

brh: مونی بفیس مونی بفیس نی دیر اسیوس مونی بفیس خلیپہ خلیپہ ئے شکاری اسیوٹ خلیپہ شریف خاندان ئس نا لگے سے
en: Don't come forward, don't come forward! Who are you? Don't come forward! Don't be afraid, don't be afraid, I am a hunter. Don't be afraid. You seem to be from a respectable family.
en_old: Move forward, move forward! Who are you? Move forward! Khalifa, Khalifa, I'm a hunter. Khalifa, you look like you're from a noble family.

brh: ولے دا بندغ نا انت تکرندٹیس بس کہ اوخپئے دا پکے دا جنگل اٹ نیمر سرمسوس بس کنے سئے
en: But what trouble has befallen this person that she has ended up here in this jungle...? ...
en_old: But what happened to this man that he ended up in this jungle at this hour of the night? I wonder.

brh: معاف کیدے مسر مسٹ ئے فوم تبیٹ نی کنے تینا ہمدرد سمجھے آن پاؤنی
en: Forgive me, girl, I didn't understand. If you consider me your well-wisher, tell me.
en_old: Forgive me, sister, I didn't understand. If you think of me as someone who cares about you, tell me.

brh: ئے داڑے مچ مسٹ کنا براہوئی مننگٹ ئس ئے ارا غن ہراٹ او کنے سما اف کہ بندغ دیر ئس کائے اور امر کنا ہندر تما باز افسوس نا ہیت اسے ننے تینا
en: I ... here. My wedding was taking place, I ran away from home, and I don't know who the person is... and how I ended up... It is a very sad matter for us ourselves.
en_old: ...gathered here because I am Brahui... and I don't know who the man is or how... It's a very sad thing for us.

brh: اوڑانا عزت نا خیال ء؟ نی تینا لمہ، باوہ، ایڑے لمہ نا۔۔۔ ننا چاگرد اٹی مخلوق تینا عزت کے، تینا جان ء قربان کیرہ۔ ولے نی؟ دا چاگرد اٹی عزت نا خیال صرف نرینہ غاتیا ارے؟
en: Concern for their honor? You... your mother, your father, your sister, your mother's... In our society people sacrifice their lives for their honor. But you? In this society, is concern for honor only on men?
en_old: Do you care about her honor? You, your mother, father, sister... In our society people give their lives for their honor. But you? In this society, is honor something only men care about?

brh: ننا نیاڑی تے ہچو کسر اسہ نیاڑی ئس برام نا دے اتینا اورا ایلی نرے اودے زند مننگ نا ہچو کسر واقعی راست پاسہ نی
en: For our women there is no way out. If a woman leaves her home on her wedding day and runs away, there is no way for her to go on living. You are truly speaking the truth.
en_old: For our women there is no way out. If a woman, on her wedding day, ... another man, there is no way for her to go on living. Are you really telling the truth?

brh: نیاڑی سے اوٹ نی دا خاطر کنا حق اف۔ ولے نی کنے دا پا اگر نا برام اسے شست سالہ نیاڑی تو مرے گڑا نی ہم کس ہا؟ دا مننگ کپک ہیسے فیصلہ ئس کر کے۔ او اگر چے نیاڑی سے انکار کے۔
en: I am a woman, and for that reason I have no right. But you tell me this: if your marriage were with a sixty-year-old woman, would you go along with it too? That can't happen; [a man] makes such a decision himself. And what if a woman refuses?
en_old: You are a woman, so it isn't my place. But tell me, if you were being married to a sixty-year-old woman, would you go through with it? That couldn't happen; how could such a decision be made? And what if the woman refuses?

brh: گڑا؟ نا مطلب کہ نا برام اسے پیرو بندغ اسے تون؟ جی او، اسے شست سالہ بندغ تون کنا برام مس کہ، او نا چار زائفہ مالہ ہم مسورے۔
en: So? You mean your marriage is with an old man? Yes, my marriage was [arranged] with a sixty-year-old man, and he already has four wives too.
en_old: So? You mean you're being married to an old man? Yes, I was married to a sixty-year-old man, and he already has four wives.

brh: بس نی کنے پا، ئے ہم کڑوسٹ، بس اینا مطلب ء باز جامپ ہم مسٹ، ولے نی ارانگ کاسے؟ کنے سما اف۔
en: Just tell me... I too... I mean... But where are you going? I don't know.
en_old: Just tell me... you too... I also became very... but where are you going? I don't know.

brh: صبر کر شام مننگٹی ئے دا جنگلٹی ئے
en: Wait, evening is falling, and this is the jungle.
en_old: Wait, it's getting dark, and this is the jungle.

brh: نی کنا سما اف کنا وجڑنی تنی جنجالٹی شاپے امر کے مرے نا کمک کننگ کنا فرضے
en: You don't know me, [but] my conscience will not let me leave you alone in trouble; how could that be? Helping you is my duty.
en_old: You don't know me. My conscience... how could I leave you in trouble? Helping you is my duty.

brh: نی خدا نا پنٹ کنے الے کاو نہ دا جنگل ٹی خرما باز ئے اینی داڑے آک تھنا الینگ کپر کنے آ بھروسہ کر ئے حفاظت اٹ امروس
en: For God's sake, leave me, let me go. No, there are many wolves in this jungle; I can't leave you here alone. Trust me, I will keep you safe.
en_old: For God's sake, don't leave me. There are many dangers in this jungle; you can't stay here alone. Trust me, I'll get you there safely.

brh: ولے ولے ملیلی بکھان کنٹ
en: But, but... [rest unclear].
en_old: But, but... please forgive me.

brh: ارے او دا جنگل اٹ انت کے سے؟ اندا سوال اینو مئے انکے وی کہ نم دا جنگل اٹ انت کے؟
en: Hey, what are you doing in this jungle? Today I ask you the same question: what are you doing in this jungle?
en_old: Hey, what are you doing in this jungle? I'm asking you the same question today: what are you doing in this jungle?

brh: چاوہ کہ بدلہ گن۔ نہ نہ امر و سوالس کہ ہر ظاہر ء انو جوابس نو ملیک۔ دا جنگلٹ بندغ شکار کے کیک۔
en: I know that... revenge... No, no, what kind of question is that? Its answer is plain to see: people hunt in this jungle.
en_old: Look, take revenge. No, no, how is it, a question that not every one gets an answer to. In this jungle people hunt.

brh: بے ننگ کیک۔ داڑے مسڑ اسے تو خنتنو رے؟ مسڑ؟ دا جنگل اٹ؟ نن داڑے مسڑ اسے پٹنگ اٹنگ۔ مچے گنو کے دماغ تے کاریم ایت۔ برا ہور۔
en: [She] brings dishonor. Haven't you seen a girl here? A girl? In this jungle? We are searching for a girl here. Use your brain a little, madman. Come, look.
en_old: It can't be. Did you see a girl here? A girl? In this jungle? We are searching for a girl here. Crazy one, use your brain. Come, look.

brh: او، اوڑے نا اورا غا بسٹ، نی خنتنس تے؟ ہاؤ، ئے پوم مسٹ، ولے داڑے کسے خنتوٹ۔ جوان۔
en: Oh, I came to your house over there; haven't you seen her? Yes, I understood, but I didn't see anyone here. All right.
en_old: Oh, I came to her house, did you see them? Yes, I went, but I didn't see anyone here. Fine.

brh: اللہ نگہبان
en: May God protect you.
en_old: May God protect you.

brh: ئے پاتہ بٹی کنا وژن تے نی جنجال اٹ شاغپے۔ الے، ئے کسفر کنے۔
en: I'm telling you, don't put yourself in trouble because of me. Leave it; they will kill me.
en_old: I said, don't put my visions in trouble. No, I'll kill you.

brh: ئے نی پنیادے لنگھ کپرے، نا حفاظت کن کنا جان کاٹ کنے پرواہ اف، ندرستی نہ راستی، واہم کنا کمک ئ کننگ ئ ٹس، انسانیت نا حیثیت اٹ انتس کہ کنے آن مننگ کیک ئے کیوہ۔
en: You can't make it across on foot. For your protection I don't care about my own life. We're not even acquainted, and still you're helping me? As a human being, whatever I can do, I will do.
en_old: I won't let you go on foot; for your protection I don't care about my life. Truth or not, if you help me, as a human being I'll do whatever I can.

brh: شاباش ہنی باز جوان کریسنے
en: Well done, you have done very well.
en_old: Well done, dear, you've done very well.

brh: دا کل نا وجہ غان مس، نی تینا نازرک انگا مسڑے اسہ پیر انگا بندغ تو بران تسس، نی سما ہس کا او ہوس چا؟
en: All this happened because of you: you gave your delicate daughter in marriage to an old man. Were you even aware that he is [driven by] lust?
en_old: It all happened because of this: you married off your delicate daughter to an old man. Did you know he was greedy?

brh: وار برم کرینے ولدا ہنا ورناؤ ورناؤ چناؤ نی تینا اولاد نا ہچ خیال ئس الوے کا
en: He has married [several] times, and again such young, young ones... Didn't you have any concern at all for your own child?
en_old: You married them off again, those young children; didn't you have any concern for your own children?

brh: ہر لمبہانہ نا خواہش مریک، کف تا اولاد نا، کف تا اولاد نا برام سے آسرات و جاگہ ئس مرے، کنا ہمدا خواہش ئس
en: Every mother and father wishes that their children, that their children's marriage be into a well-off, comfortable place. That was my wish too.
en_old: Every mother wishes that her children, that her children's marriage, be comfortable and settled. That was my wish too.

brh: شکر اللہ نا مناف نا برام خیر خیریت تو مسک۔ او دا اللہ نا مہربانی مس کہ اللہ پاک دا خوشی خیر خیریت اٹ گدریفے۔ ولے اسہ گڑا نا کنے خلیس ارے او دا کہ دا دوست عزیز آک انت پارو
en: Thank God, Munaf's wedding went off well. And it was God's kindness that God Almighty let this happy occasion pass in peace and well-being. But I have a fear about one thing, and it is this: what will these friends and relatives say?
en_old: Thank God, Munaf's wedding went well. It was God's kindness that God Almighty let this happy occasion pass in peace and well-being. But one thing worries me, and that is what these friends and relatives will say.

brh: اوفتے براہمن آن بٹنگتنو گلہ تو ضرور کرور بابا او ہند گلہ کرور ئے مگہ تینا عزیز و قریب آتے خواہیفے تو دا ہم منام سئی اسہ سسور اوفتے خواہیفین ہمو مناف جان ضد کرے ہمو خاطر ہم باقی انتنا گلہ کیرے
en: They will surely complain that they weren't invited to the wedding, father, and they will complain that he invited only his own close relatives. Well, we have to accept this too, right? We invited them because they're the father-in-law's people; it was dear Munaf who insisted, so for that reason too, why should the rest complain?
en_old: They will surely complain that they weren't invited to the Brahmin wedding, father, and they will complain, but he invited his own relatives, so this was also our right, being a father-in-law, he invited them. Munaf insisted on that, so why would the others complain?

brh: بس دا ستے نٹ سنبھالستے کنا وس نا افس دا نا رشتہ دارک۔ نی بے غم مر ہچ او پفت چٹ۔ نی بشین پین سغت تئی کا بازارا ایٹ ئس خیرات کینے۔ ہاو۔ ہمت کر۔ خرچ تو۔
en: Well, this was handled. It wasn't in my power, they're his relatives. Don't worry at all, not in the least. Get up, and in a little while go to the bazaar; we'll give a goat to charity. Yes. Take heart. Spend the money.
en_old: That's it, we managed it, it's beyond my control, these are his relatives. Don't worry at all, and don't say anything. Sit down, and tomorrow I'll give some charity in the bazaar. Yes. Take heart. Spend.

brh: کتنہ سو پیسہ غٹ۔ آخا شائستہ ئے سوچم کتوست کہ اشارن وڑٹ خدا خلقتنا زندنا سفر ء شروع کرو۔ ہو دا تو کنا مونا تختہ کمالے
en: However many hundreds of rupees, all of it. No, I had never even imagined that Shaista would begin her journey of life in God's world this way. Yes, this truly is a marvel before me.
en_old: How many hundreds of rupees, all of it. Sister, I never imagined Shaista would begin the journey of life this way, by a sign of God's creation. Yes, this is truly a great wonder before me.

brh: کئی شار نا تخت تے ہراٹ ولے نصیب اور امر ننے چکا دڑیس؟ راست پارے کس کس نا نصیب پلنگ کپک نی کنا نصیب اٹ ئسوسے ہندا خاطر کسس ہورنگ ہم کتوکئی یا نہ؟ جوان تو دا
en: Where are the thrones of the city, and where are we? But fate, how it dragged us down here! It's rightly said that no one can rob anyone of their fate. You were in my fate; that's why no one else even looked at you, right or not? Well, that's good.
en_old: Which city's thrones, but fate, and how did it bring us this far? Rightly said, nobody can change anyone's fate. You were in my fate, that's why nobody even looked, right or not? Well, that's good.

brh: آئی تے انت کسس ارے سنگ بندی کے باز بندغاک بسور ولے خبر افی کلے انتئے نا کریٹ اونی دا خاطر نا
en: As for me, what, was there no one for me? Many people came for the engagement, but don't you know why I turned them all down? It was for this reason.
en_old: Who does she have? Many people came for the engagement, but who knows why I did it, it was for this reason.

brh: دا کسر انت کہ کنے بروئی ء؟ خدا سانی نا کننگ ہم کپیسے۔ ہو شاید ہندا ہیت ء۔ کنا زند نا ہم سفر تو نی اسس۔ پین کسو سراڑے بننگ کریکہ۔ تو گڑا چے وختو روانہ مروئی انتو؟
en: What road is this that I have to come down? God, you can't even do it easily. Yes, maybe that's the point. You were my life's companion. Someone else could have come here. So then, at what time do we have to set off?
en_old: What is this road that I have to come to? God, I can't even do it easily. Yes, maybe that's the point. You were my life's companion. Someone else could have come here. So then at what time do we have to leave?

brh: دا مریفنگو پاننگ نا ایت اسے؟ آئی تو تویت کریٹ ولے۔۔۔ ولے؟
en: Is this just something you say to drag it out? I did talk to them, but... but?
en_old: Is this a way of saying it to kill? I did make the effort, but... but?

brh: اندا پارٹ نہ کے اراڑے شار نا بندغ ء اراڑے خلق نا مسڑ کنے خبر ء اندا پاروس اوہو نی تو مونجا مسس باباو
en: I said exactly this, didn't I: where is a man of the city and where is a girl of the village? I knew you'd say just this. Oh ho, you've become sad, father.
en_old: This part, here is the city's person, here the people's girl, I know, I was saying this. Oh, you've become sad, father.

brh: بندہ پارے کہ اخس زوم ارے دا کاریمے نم کبو بلکہ اوفتے اسہ اشارہ سینا ضرورت ئے او کنے آن زیات اشتافی او دا برام کے
en: The man said: do this work as soon as you can. In fact, they only need a signal, and they are more eager than I am for this wedding.
en_old: The man said that however much effort there is, you do this work, but they only need a signal, and they are more eager than me for this wedding.

brh: ئے کفت کنے ارے منی شائستہ شائستہ
en: ... I have ... my Shaista, Shaista!
en_old: ...I have... my Shaista, Shaista.

brh: خبردار! دیر ارے نم؟ زیادہ اینکپہ۔ ہن توم۔ کھن! ہور مرانگ! بھائی!
en: Watch out! Who are you? Don't come any closer. Go away! ... Look! Brother!
en_old: Watch out! Who are you? Don't come any closer. Go away. Stop! Look here! Brother!

brh: فلتا نمبر تا بندے نکے شائستہ نا کنڈا اینو
en: Their number is switched off ... toward Shaista's side today.
en_old: So-and-so's number is switched off, Shaista's side today.

brh: بابا نی؟ خیر بابا، اللہ دم پریشان س۔ او بابا، سعید نا نمبر بند ہننگ اٹی ئے استونہ ٹرائی کننگ اٹی اٹ موبائل اٹ تے۔
en: Father, is that you? Is everything alright, father? God, I was so worried. Oh father, Saeed's number keeps being switched off; I've been trying his mobile since last night.
en_old: Father, you? Is everything alright, father? God, I was worried. Oh father, Saeed's number is switched off, I've been trying on the mobile since then.

brh: گڑا کنا مار نی پریشان ئس انتے؟ نوا موبائل نا تہ چارج کھٹی؟ استو نی نندرس بجلی الو؟ آ جان دا بھکا نما کے اونا لمہ باہو چک بننگٹی جو۔ او بابا نا اسہ رات دے اسٹ چک بننگٹی او۔ نی دوں کہ کنا مار ایندا ملکا
en: Then why are you worried, my child? Maybe his mobile's charge ran out? Last night he was probably asleep, or was there no electricity? Oh dear, this ... his mother ... coming ... Oh father, one night and day ... coming ... You ... that my son, in this very land ...
en_old: Then my son, why are you worried? Has your new mobile's charge run out? Were you asleep, was the electricity out? Oh dear, this is how it is for you; his mother is having a hard time coming. Oh, father's one night and day, having a hard time coming. You, my son, in this very country...

brh: دا کنڈوتے نوان مودی مرے ئے کاوہ نبیداد نا ورا ہو
en: These ... maybe ... I'll go to Nabidad's house, yes.
en_old: These corners should become new ones, I'll go to Nabidad's place, yes.

brh: ہیلو۔ ہیلو مناف، کنا توار بننگ اٹی؟ نم دێر؟ یار ئے علی، نما ہمسایہ۔ ئے تے بن ہمو ناسا
en: Hello. Hello Munaf, can you hear me? Who are you? Friend, it's me, Ali, your neighbor. Listen, that...
en_old: Hello. Hello Munaf, can you hear me? Who are you? Friend, it's Ali, your neighbor. Listen, that...

brh: سنگت اللہ وا بودیر مسپنتے۔ سعید۔ جیو۔ ہموشیاریا۔ انت خیر ئس ئے وسس ملک آتیا ہمودا کہ چار بندہ اغوا کرینو۔ ہت۔ اغوا کرینو تے؟ دن سماف دیر اسو چار بندہ غا سو تفک کسی تو تا۔
en: Friend, God ... Saeed. Yes. ... What news is this? Word came from those areas that four men have been kidnapped. Yes. They've kidnapped him? I have no idea who they were, the four men ...
en_old: Friend, may God not let it happen. Saeed. Yes. Be careful. What news is there in those areas, that four men have been kidnapped. Yes. They've been kidnapped? I don't know who they were, the four men, nobody said anything.

brh: بس ئے خناٹ تا؟ نی کنے پائے برے ہموڑے۔ دیرس؟ بابا ہمو ننا ہمسایہ علی اسکے او پارے کہ سعید اغوا مسنے۔ ارف توس چیا؟
en: So, did I see them? You tell me, should I come over there? Who was it? Father, it was our neighbor Ali, and he said that Saeed has been kidnapped. Did they take him away, or what?
en_old: Did you just see it? Tell me, come over there. Who was it? Father, it was our neighbor Ali, and he said Saeed has been kidnapped. What did they take?

brh: دے دے غوا کرینٹ۔ نی تینے پریشان کپہ۔ ٹھیک ہی کنا مار؟ او خدا خیر کیک۔ ئے کاوا ملک میر خیر محمد نا مونا۔ ابا دا سہ ہفتہ ایننگ نا ضرورت ئے ابا ئے ہفتہ ایم خیر محمد نا کاوا۔
en: They've kidnapped him. Don't worry yourself. Alright, my child? Oh, God will make it well. I'll go before Malik Mir Khair Muhammad. Dad, this will take three weeks of going back and forth; dad, in a week I'll go to Khair Muhammad's.
en_old: They kidnapped [him] days ago. Don't worry yourself. Alright, my son? Oh, God will make it well. I'll go before Malik Mir Khair Muhammad. Father, this needs three weeks to come; father, in a week I'll go to Khair Muhammad.

brh: شائستہ او شائستہ شائستہ داڑے خفتو
en: Shaista, oh Shaista! Shaista is sleeping here.
en_old: Shaista, oh Shaista, Shaista is sleeping here.

brh: آن مسنے دن کوکار کننگ اٹی ئس خیر ئے رس تنے خبر تما؟ انگڑا نا ہمو کہ شار والا مروک انگا ندشت آرف ہو دن مس او دے کہ کس اغوا کرینے نسرین تنے آن پاننگ اٹی ئس
en: What has happened, you were shouting like that? Is everything alright, have you heard the news? About that man from the city ... yes, that's how it happened: someone has kidnapped him. Nasreen was saying it herself.
en_old: What happened to you, you were shouting like that? Is everything alright, did you hear? About that girl from the city... someone has kidnapped her, Nasreen was telling you.

brh: ئے نی راست پاننگٹی اٹ، مچ خلق والا تے ہم خبر تمانے۔ نسرین، اونا، اونا اغوا نا خیر مقصد ئس مننگ کیک؟
en: I'm telling you the truth; all the villagers have found out too. Nasreen, what purpose could his... his kidnapping possibly have?
en_old: Yes, you're telling the truth, all the people of the neighbourhood have found out too. Nasreen, what could the purpose of her, her kidnapping be?

brh: جان، داسہ کنے خبر تما، ہنت پامسس، نیلے دائے تاتی۔
en: Dear, now I've found out what you had said ... you ... this.
en_old: Dear, now I've found out what happened, you left this to me.

brh: کنے دا امید الو نمے آن کہ نم دا قدر شیف گدرینگے کیرے ئے نی تو ہیت کننگٹی اٹ۔ نی؟ ہاؤ ئے
en: I never expected this of you, that you could stoop this low. I'm talking to you. You? Yes, I am.
en_old: I never expected this of you, that you could stoop this low. You were the one talking. You? Yes.

brh: جون مس۔ جون مس کنے نا حیثیت نا ہنداسے آن خبر لگا۔ کاش۔ کاش کہ کنے نا حیثیت نا نیمہ الہ خبر لگاکا۔ تو ئے دا قسم اونی تپٹ۔
en: It's good this happened. It's good that this showed me your true worth. I wish, I wish I had known even half of your true worth. Then I wouldn't have sworn this oath to him.
en_old: Good. Good that I learned your true worth from somewhere. I wish, I wish I had learned even half of your true worth earlier. Then I wouldn't have sworn this oath.

brh: او تینا تینا دا زند ء برباد کتوے تا ئے نا فضول انگا ہیتاتے بننگ کے بتنٹ کنے پاہ کنے پاہ سئی درادے ئے ہور تونس کریس ہمم او تو
en: And I ruined my own life by listening to your useless talk ... Tell me, tell me ... look what you've done ...
en_old: She ruined her own life because of your useless words... tell me, tell me, look at what you have done.

brh: نی تو نا واری کنے انت اسہ ریفیسہ کنے تو تینا جند نا خبر اف اینا ئے چائیتس پنین خوائے پر شائستہ
en: And you, for your part, why are you deceiving me? I don't even know about my own self ... wanted ... but Shaista ...
en_old: You, for once, what are you giving me? I don't even know about myself... but Shaista.

brh: کنا اسیتس جوانیٹ بن، نیاڑی ئے وخت ئس ہم کمزور سمجھیپس، نیاڑی ہرا وخت تیناٹی بس، او ہند گڑاس چائے ہمو گڑاس کننگ کیک، نا جوانی ہنداٹی ئے کہ سعید ئے واپس اتس۔
en: Listen carefully to one thing I say: never think of a woman as weak. When a woman comes into her own, whatever she wants, she can do it. Your goodness lies in this: that you bring Saeed back.
en_old: My dear, be good. Never consider a woman weak; when a woman comes into her own, she can do whatever she sets her mind to. Your goodness lies in bringing Saeed back.

brh: نتو کسن خیر نا امید کپیس۔ دانیال پنی گٹ ئس ہاو ئے راست پنی گٹ اٹ۔ دا نمے مہر ئے مہر کروکا دن مریرہ؟ مہر کروکا تینا زندگی قربان کیرہ۔
en: Then don't expect any good from anyone. Daniyal said something, yes, it was a true saying. Is this how people who love you are? Those who love sacrifice their lives.
en_old: Don't expect good from anyone. Daniyal said something true. Yes, he spoke the truth. Are those who love you like this? Those who love sacrifice their lives.

brh: نرینہ مریر، نرینہ ہمبل قول کیر، پین تینا قولہ کے، تینا زندے قربان کیر، ولے نی؟ باز افسوس ئے کنے نازیہ عمر باز افسوس ئے
en: Those who are men, men make a promise like men and then sacrifice their lives for their promise. But you? I feel so sorry for you, Umar, so very sorry.
en_old: Men are those who make such promises, then keep their promise and sacrifice their lives, but you? I am so sorry, Nazia, so very sorry.

brh: ایلو، آخر کنا قصور انت؟ کنے انتئے کہ داڑے اسنورے؟ اڑے دا سوب ہم چانہ پیالستے بو، دن مف کہ پنگونیہ کوئی
en: Brother, after all, what is my fault? Why have you brought me here? Hey, give him a cup of tea this morning too; let it not be that someone says...
en_old: Hey, after all, what is my fault? Why have you brought me here? Hey, you don't even know the reason, may it not be that...

brh: او جی دانا مطلب ئے پومہ تود، داد انت گیسو نوڑے داد؟ سو بے پنز دہ سال مسنے نن تو، ولے دا گڑا ئے پومہ تودیس کہ نن انت کننگ اٹی او۔
en: Oh, he didn't understand what this means. What is this...? It has been fifteen years for us, but you didn't understand this thing, what we are doing.
en_old: Oh, you don't understand what this means... It's been fifteen years for us, but you didn't understand what we are doing.

brh: دا سپو مسٹ چاوہ دا صدانہ بولیئے ننے خلوئی تنے ہمم دا صدانہ نا ڈوٹیئے اور تانہ بولیئے نن خلون اڑے چانہ پیا
en: This ... I know. This is the ...'s word: we have to hit you. It is also in the ...'s hands, and on their word we will strike. Hey, a cup of tea!
en_old: I know this... we have to strike... hey, you don't know.

brh: پولیس آتے بوتے جوانینا داٹھی ئے دا چانہ پیالہ کن نت گولی ئس نا گواچی کیو نی آخر کنا قصور دے کنے
en: The police... Drink this cup of tea, otherwise I'll make you a bullet's victim. After all, what is my fault? Tell me.
en_old: The police... you'll be shot for nothing. After all, what is my fault, tell me.

brh: انتئے کنا تارے سوار ہنو؟ زیادہ بکواس کپہ۔ اسہ سوال کننگ نا ہم ضرورت اف، نتہ اسہ گولی سے نا گواچی کروڈنے۔ ہلو، کنا قصور انتئے؟ نی اسہ واری تے پو مفیسہ؟ بکواس کننگ اٹی ئے
en: Why are you making me get in? Don't talk too much nonsense. There's no need to ask even one question, otherwise I'll make you a bullet's victim. Hey, what is my fault? Don't you understand the first time? He's talking nonsense.
en_old: Why did you put me in the car? Don't talk too much nonsense. There's no need to ask a single question, otherwise you'll be shot. Hey, what is my fault? Won't you understand even once? You're talking nonsense.

brh: کنا قصور انت کنا قصور انت تلاشی خرینگٹ اسو تیرہ کشیوا خن چاتے کنا قصور انت خن چاتے
en: What is my fault, what is my fault? ... search ... I'll pull out ... eyes ... What is my fault? ... eyes ...
en_old: What is my fault, what is my fault? ... searching... what is my fault, open my eyes.

brh: ہو ئے راست پاننگٹوٹ دا نا مہر ئے مہر کروکا دن مریرے مہر کروکا تینا زندے قربان کیرے نرینہ مریرے نرینہ انبر قول کیرے پین تینا قول کے تینا زندے قربان کیرے
en: Yes, I'm telling the truth. Is this your love? Are lovers like this? Lovers sacrifice their lives. Those who are men, men make a promise like men, then sacrifice their lives for their promise.
en_old: Yes, I was telling the truth, are those who love you like this? Those who love sacrifice their lives. Men are those who make such promises, then keep their promise and sacrifice their lives.

brh: ولے نی؟ باز افسوس ئے کنے نا زی آ عمر باز افسوس ئے بس انت مروئی انت جواب ایتون؟
en: But you? I feel so sorry for you, Umar, so very sorry. So what is going to happen? What answer will we give?
en_old: But you? I'm very sorry for your life, very sorry. So what will happen, what answer will we give?

brh: دا مہرا ارانگے نا دیر درے تا؟ مریم نی تینے پریشان کپہ، اللہ کل خیر کیک۔ امر پریشان مفو، مہمان ئس اسکہ، ہکا خدا کپ اودے گلاس مس۔
en: Where is this dear girl? Who took her? Maryam, don't worry yourself, God will make everything all right. How can I not worry? She was a guest; if, God forbid, something has happened to her...
en_old: Where has this love been so late? Maryam, don't worry yourself, God will make everything alright. How can I not worry, a guest... God forbid something has happened to her.

brh: نن دیرے مون نشان ایتنگ نا قابل مرو۔ اولی کنا دا سمجھٹ بننگ اف کہ اودے اغوا کننگ نا وجہ انت مننگ کیک۔ اوفتہ کسے تو دشمنی تو اف۔ بابا اوفتہ کسے تو دشمنی اسہ کنے۔
en: To whom will we be fit to show our faces? First of all, I can't understand what the reason for kidnapping her could be. They don't have enmity with anyone. Baba, did they have enmity with anyone?
en_old: We will be able to trace him soon. First of all, I don't understand what the reason for kidnapping him could be. They don't have enmity with anyone. Baba, do they have enmity with anyone?

brh: او دا کدننگ نا ضرورت اف پین چا غاندریک آتے کنے پین وجہ ئس لگیک انت وجہ ئس مننگ کیک؟ ہندا توئی سوچنگ اٹی اٹ مناف پارے کہ
en: Oh, there's no need for this ...; the others ... It seems to me there's some other reason. What reason could it be? That is exactly what I was thinking when Manaf said that...
en_old: He doesn't need to hide this, the other ones... I think there's another reason. What could the reason be? I was thinking the same thing when Manaf said that

brh: سہی شائستہ تو برام کننگ خواہی سگے۔ بلکہ اونا لمہ باوہ ہم خواہی فیسوس۔ ہندا وجہ غا خوفک۔ شائستہ تو برام آن پین کسے آن تکلیف مننگ کیک؟ تکلیف ہس سگے۔
en: Right, he wanted to marry Shaista. In fact, her parents wanted it too. That is exactly why ... Could anyone else have a problem with Shaista's marriage? There was a problem.
en_old: Actually, Shaista didn't want to get married. In fact, her parents didn't want it either. That's why they don't know. Could anyone be bothered by Shaista's marriage? There must be some problem.

brh: او دا تکلیف اسہ کہ عمر شائستہ تو برام کننگ نا خواہش کرے شائستہ انکار کرے شائستہ کہ انکار کرے ولدا نا اسیدیس عمر کرے شائستہ ء اور سعید ء عید کننگ نا خلاص ئس کنے تو دا وجہ لگک تو گڑا گڑانت
en: Yes, the problem was that Umar wanted to marry Shaista, and Shaista refused. When Shaista refused, then Umar ... Shaista and Saeed ... To me this seems to be the reason. So then what?
en_old: Well, the problem is that Umar wished to marry Shaista, Shaista refused, and when Shaista refused, then Umar... Shaista and Saeed's Eid... To me this seems like the reason, so then what?

brh: بس اوڑان دا ہیت برداشت متو او پنچم کنے کتو اندا چم کنے کیک کنے اسل باور بفک کہ عمر دن کنے کیک باور تو کنے ہم بفک مگر ارا وخت کہ بندغ زد آ بریک او نہ تینا مونی ہرک نہ پدی ہرک
en: He just couldn't bear this, and ... he didn't do anything else ... I really can't believe that Umar would do such a thing. I can't believe it either, but when a person turns obstinate, he looks neither ahead of himself nor behind.
en_old: He just couldn't bear this, he didn't do anything, that's why he's doing this. I really don't believe Umar would do something like this. I don't believe it either, but when a person gets angry, he looks neither ahead nor behind.

brh: او بسوس؟ پدی گڈا دے، گڈاس کبو، دا مارے اتبو۔ شائستہ، او تو نما کنڈا ملنگ کے بسوس؟ ہاؤ۔
en: Had he come? Then later ... do something, bring this boy. Shaista, had he come to your place to meet you? Yes.
en_old: Has he come? Then afterwards, do something, give this boy... Shaista, has he come to meet you? Yes.

brh: بس سست سے بھلے دا انگنا رنگینا دیرے نا کنے ہچ سما افک کمالے رنگینوئے
en: Just slowly... well, this is so beautiful... I had no idea at all. It's wonderfully beautiful.
en_old: Just slowly, fine, it's so colorful, I had no idea about it for a long time, it's wonderfully colorful.

brh: اللہ کپ کے اور تو پین ہچس مف۔ کنے اسہ بندغ اسے آ شک ء۔ دیر آ؟ عمرا۔
en: God forbid; may nothing else happen to her. I suspect one person. Whom? Umar.
en_old: May God forbid, nothing else will happen. I suspect one person. Who? Umar.

brh: ولے عمر انتئے دن کیک؟ انتئے کہ ئے اونا رشتہ نا کرٹ۔ دا کل ہمو نا کاریمہ کو۔
en: But why would Umar do such a thing? Because I turned down his proposal. All of this is his doing.
en_old: But why would Umar do this? Because I turned down his proposal. All of this is his doing.

brh: خیر ئے کاوہ مارا اریفے واڑان جوانی اٹی اگر او کنے پاتاو حکومت نا دوٹی توڑتے او تینٹ اریفے ینتے بس داسہ تینے پین پریشان کپبو
en: Anyway, I'll go and ask the boy nicely. If he doesn't tell me, I'll put it in the government's hands; they will question him themselves. Now just don't worry yourselves any more.
en_old: Anyway, I'll go and call the boy, it's better that way. If he had told me, I'd have put it in the government's hands. He'll call them himself. Just don't worry yourselves any more now.

brh: اللہ کے کو خیر اٹ واپس برک بس نم انبو عمر نا اریف بو او انت پائک؟ ہو اریفے وئی انت؟ پدا شاستہ اینو اسکان دا خلک اٹ دنو واقعہ متنے۔
en: God willing, she will come back safely. Just go and ask Umar: what does he say? Yes, he should be asked, why not? And Shaista... until today nothing like this has ever happened in this village.
en_old: God willing, she'll come back safely. Just call Umar, what does he say? Yes, call him, why not? Until today nothing like this has ever happened to Shaista.

brh: دا واقعہ نن کل پریشان کرے ہو راست پاریس نی تینت اوار اسس اونا حفاظت نا ذمہ داری نا ئس ٹھیک ہی شائستہ ئے کاوہ
en: This incident has upset all of us. Yes, you said it rightly: you were with her yourself, and her protection was your responsibility. All right, I'm going after Shaista.
en_old: This incident has upset all of us. Yes, you're right, you were with her yourself, protecting her was your responsibility. Alright, I'll go to Shaista.

brh: من دعا کبو اللہ خیر اٹ اتیتے، اللہ کل ئے جوان کے، خدا حافظ
en: You all pray that God brings her back safely; may God make everything well. Goodbye.
en_old: Pray that God brings her back safely, may God make everything all right. Goodbye.

brh: دیرس؟ ننے مرو!
en: Who's there? It's going to happen to us!
en_old: Who's there? We'll be!

brh: نی دا وخت ئے سوال جواب کننگ نا؟ وخت اف ننتون، زو ہس کش تنے۔
en: Is this the time for you to be asking questions? We don't have time; quickly, pull her out.
en_old: Is this the time for questions and answers? We don't have time, hurry up and pull her out.

brh: نوا کہ بریس بش مر بش مر
en: Come on, come, get up, get up!
en_old: Hurry up, get up, get up!

brh: بابا سئی دادے مناف بابا
en: Baba, really, this one, Manaf, Baba.
en_old: Baba, forgive him, Manaf, Baba.

brh: جا مس کے اللہ پاک نی خنیفے، نن باز پریشان ئسن خناری بابا؟ بابا نم خناری؟ نمے پاریسٹو عمر داد اغوا کرینے؟ دانی انت پاننگٹی ئس ئے راست پاننگٹی اٹک، دا کل ہندان کاری مقصود۔ نی غلط ئس
en: Thank God, Almighty Allah has let us see you; we were so worried. Did you see, Baba? Baba, did you see? Hadn't I told you that Umar has kidnapped her? And what were you saying? I was telling the truth: all of this was Maqsood's doing. You were wrong.
en_old: May Allah keep you safe, you've been found. We were so worried. Did you see, Baba? Baba, did you see? Didn't I tell you Umar kidnapped her? What were you saying now? You were telling the truth, this was all Maqsood's doing. You were wrong.

brh: دا، دا محسن تو کنے اوفتیان بچیفے، اگر دا متوا کنے، تو ئے ہم اینو داڑے زندہ سلوک متوٹے، اینو دانا مہربانی کہ داڑے سلوک اوٹ۔
en: This, this benefactor saved me from them. If he hadn't been there for me, I too wouldn't be standing here alive today. It's thanks to his kindness that I'm standing here today.
en_old: This, this Mohsin saved me from them. If he hadn't been there, I wouldn't be standing here alive today. It's thanks to him that I'm standing here today.

brh: تہہ نا امبر نیک نیت او بندغ ئے تینا زند اٹ خنتنوٹ۔ عمر ہنو باز منت واروٹ۔ نی الوم۔ دا تو کنا فرض ئس ئے تینا
en: I have never seen a person as good-hearted as you in my life. Umar, I am very grateful to you. No, brother. This was just my duty.
en_old: I have never seen such a good-hearted person as you in my life. I will be grateful to you all my life. No, don't mention it. This is just my duty.

brh: اکرام مسٹ نا برام اسہ اسرات او جاگس مرے آسراتی پیسہ ٹی ہلنگ مفک پیسہ ٹی تو ہر گڑا ہلنگ مریک
en: Ikram, [my wish was] that (my) daughter's marriage be a comfortable and settled one. Comfort can't be bought with money. With money, though, everything can be bought.
en_old: Ikram, I went; may her marriage be comfortable and settled. Comfort can't be bought with money, though everything else can be bought with money.

brh: ولے خوشی کلنگ مفسا؟ نی تینا اولاد ء ہنتویس، ہرفتوس کہ نا اولاد نا انت خواہش ء؟ بس! ہنتس کہ ئے جوان سمجھوا۔
en: But happiness can't be bought, can it? Didn't you look at your children, didn't you ask what your children wish for? Enough! [I did] whatever I thought was right.
en_old: But can't happiness be had? Did you ask your children, did you ask what your children wish? Enough! I did what I thought was good.

brh: خندون کے وا۔ تینا اولاد نا دشمن تو افنہ۔ نی برات نا پین نا خاطرا تینا اولاد نا خوشی برباد کریس۔ داسہ خناس۔
en: Look here. You're not your own children's enemy, are you? For the sake of your brother's name you ruined your own children's happiness. Now you see.
en_old: Look, they're your own children, not your enemies. For your brother's sake you ruined your own children's happiness. Now see.

brh: اگا کسس سیت کے نم اینا جواب اتنگ کپنا، ہیت کننگٹ یو بندغہ حیران اوٹ کہ یمر کے بس بس داسہ نی دعا کا
en: If someone says something, we can't give an answer to it; when (he) talks, a person is left amazed at how (he does it). Enough, enough, now you pray.
en_old: If someone does wrong and you can't answer it, a person is astonished in speaking at how it happened. Enough, enough, now pray.

brh: کوزہ تت پدی ورا برے اوننا ادوچی برے کسفیسہ تا ہاو کسفے وتا
en: (Garbled) ...the pitcher... come back this way... his... come... killing them... yes, kill them...
en_old: Give her the hand, come back, her husband... come, will you kill? Yes, kill him.

brh: دا سہونا زند نا دیک ختم مسور دا سہ ودی جہان سے برا کمرے کشی کتیک کشی کتیک تا
en: Now the days of his life are over; now ... a new world ... come ... pull it out, pull it out...
en_old: The days of this life are over; now a new world, come into the room, pull, pull.

brh: اللہ خالق دا دے دنیا کے
en: God is the Creator of this world.
en_old: God is the Creator of this world.

brh: او کنے دا شہر باز دوست ئے ہاؤ باز دوست ئے کنے دا شہر۔ ونی دا دیر او؟ دا کل کنا سنگتاک او۔ نن پکنک کہ بسون۔
en: Oh, I love this city a lot, yes, I love it a lot, this city. And who are these? These are all my friends. We've come for a picnic.
en_old: Oh, I love this city a lot, yes, I really love this city. And who are these? These are all my friends. We've come for a picnic.

brh: دا سد و بیست؟ نہ، نی نرتس، ئے خاوریٹ۔ بھلی، بھلی، بھلی انت؟ شوکت کنے باور افنے۔ مے، دنو ہچو سفر، کنے نی باور افنے۔
en: This is a hundred and twenty? No, you didn't run away, I ... . Big, big, big what? Shaukat, I don't believe it. Hey, never such a journey; I don't believe you.
en_old: This is a hundred and twenty? No, you ran away, I am... Big, big, big what? Shaukat doesn't believe me. Hey, no such journey; you don't believe me.

brh: جوان دا خط ء باور کریس دا خاتون نی پنی تنے اسے شریف خاندان نا بندغ اسے او شریف خاندان نا بندغاک بے غیرت مننگ کپسر
en: All right, you believed this letter. This lady ... is a person from a respectable family, and people from respectable families can't be shameless.
en_old: Well, you believed this letter. This woman, by her name, is a person of a respectable family, and people of respectable families can't be shameless.

brh: ئے تولٹ ئے داسہ بسٹ
en: I'll sit down; I've only just come.
en_old: Yes, I was sitting, I've just come now.

brh: ایتا سہ پا وانی ایتا چھڑ سو ایتا سہ
en: Give three, say... give... a hundred... give three.
en_old: Give three, I said... give... give three.

brh: خیرے کنے سنگت؟ اورے کریس گم مسس سلام گناسی یار۔ بس یار شکار پٹیسہ پٹیسہ باز مونی نا، ولے چس متہ۔ یار خیر اسینا توارے بنغٹ۔
en: Is all well, my friend? Hey, where did you go, you got lost? Greetings, you crazy friend. Well, friend, searching and searching for game I went very far ahead, but it was no fun. Anyway, friend, I heard someone's voice.
en_old: How are you, my friend? Oh, where did you disappear to? Hello, you rascal. Well, friend, I kept searching for game and went very far, but it was no fun. Anyway, friend, I heard a voice.

brh: چاوہ کہ خالی نی مسنگٹ، پٹن نا شکار نا، ہم مطلب، کنا مطلب ئے کہ نو مندو نا جاگہ ئس بسورے، داڑے شکار نا پٹہ مس
en: Maybe you just got lost searching for game; I mean, what I mean is that you've come to an unfamiliar place. It's here that I found out about the hunting.
en_old: Look, it's only that you went missing while searching for game. I mean, I mean you've come to an unfamiliar place; here is where I found out about the hunting.

brh: انجھس کے اللہ نا رضا دا سنگت فرمائشی تینا پا نی دا پا کے ارخ تیار ی ئے سخت بیمار اٹ سنگت ارخ تیار ی بس اسہ شعر ئس مرے واللہ کنینہ مرے استاد لیکو اٹ
en: Do something, for God's sake; it's this friend's request; say one of your own. You say this: 'The meal is ready'; I'm terribly ill, friend; 'the meal is ready'. Just let there be one couplet. By God, ... let it be a Laiko song, master.
en_old: Do it, for God's sake, this friend has a request of his own. Say this: the arak is ready, a friend is seriously ill, the arak is ready. Just let there be a poem. By God, I can't. Let it be in the master's writing.

brh: ئے نی کل قصہ پاوہ ولے بس نی دفتے سنبھال صرف پستولے کنے ہنے طوفان ئے دا سنگت ات آخر قصہ انتئے ئے کل قصہ نی پاوہ دا سکنتو وخت اف نی دفتے سنبھال
en: I'll tell you the whole story, but for now just take care of these people. Just [give] me the pistol... it's a storm, this friend... What is the story, after all? I'll tell you the whole story; this isn't the time. You take care of these people.
en_old: Yes, you'll tell the whole story, but just take care of them. Give me only the pistol... the storm... this friend. Why the story, after all? You'll tell the whole story later, this isn't the time. You take care of them.

brh: اللہ خلک دادے دن کے پشیا اللہ خلک دادے دن کے پشیا قربان مسون نا خنتیک نشیا قربان مسون
en: God created her like this, ...; God created her like this, ... . We'd give our lives for her; your eyes are intoxicating, we'd give our lives.
en_old: God created her like this, like a fairy; God created her like this, like a fairy. I'd give my life for the intoxication of your eyes, I'd give my life.

brh: توار توار ئس بننگٹی ئے ننا کن جی او توار ئس برے ہمت کے کانے ہمت کے
en: A voice, a voice is coming toward us. Yes, and if a voice comes, be brave... go on, be brave.
en_old: A voice, a voice is coming for us. Yes, if a voice comes, take courage, take courage.

brh: ناظر فتح ڈیرا نی مڑسہ بندی او ٹو ناظر فتح ڈیرا کنے مڑسہ
en: (Garbled) Nazir Fateh Dera, you're a brave man... a prisoner... Nazir Fateh Dera, (be) a brave man for me.
en_old: Nazir Fateh Dera, you're a brave man... Nazir Fateh Dera, be a man for me.

brh: چاو کہ گڑاس نا گم مسنے۔ کنا تفک نا کارتوسک نا جاگس بے خیال مسر۔ کنا خیال ئے نا تفک ہم گم ئے جی تفک تو تینا
en: Maybe something of yours has gone missing. My gun's cartridges got left somewhere through carelessness. I think your gun is lost too. Yes, sir, the gun is with me.
en_old: Look, some of my things are lost. I forgot where I put my gun's cartridges. I think your gun is lost too. No, the gun is with me.

brh: جاگہ ٹی کنا سنگت آک داڑے کیمپ خلکنو ہموڑے تو خوک ئے ولے نم داسکا داڑے؟ ہئو ننا بندغ نا ڈس و نشان ہنداکونو
en: The place where my friends had set up camp here, it's empty there, but you're still here? Yes, our man's tracks and traces are right here.
en_old: In the place where my friends set up camp here, it's over there, but you're still here? Yes, our men's tracks and traces are right here.

brh: نرسنگا دے ہمدا خاطر ننا رندٹ یو جوان اللہ کے خیرٹ مرے او نما پریشانی مور مرے نی کنے دا پاکے داڑے خڑک خلک ملخ کسری اف
en: That is why Narsinga is on our trail. Good, may God make it turn out well, and may your worries go far away. Tell me this: is there no village or settlement or traveller near here?
en_old: That's why Narsinga is behind us. Good, may God make it turn out well, and may your worries go far away. Tell me this: there's no road near here.

brh: ہو، دا دیرے مسے خلق خڑ کٹے ولے ارخ تیاری ارخ کھمبو واللہ ایمبو، ہو شی جان، پناڑے
en: Yes, it's gotten late; the village is nearby, but the meal is ready. Eat the meal, by God, eat. Yes, dear, ...
en_old: Yes, it's gotten late, people are watching, but the arak is ready, drink the arak, by God. Yes, dear, here.

brh: نی رنگین ئس ئے اوفتے خناٹ، ڈڈ کاٹھی ء۔ جوان کریس، ولے دا وخت آ دا کنڈا ہنپو۔ دا وخت آ جاگہ اسینگ جوان اف۔ ئے نم کن ایرا ہیسونٹ۔
en: You... a colourful one; I saw them, sturdy-bodied. You did well, but don't go that way at this hour. At this hour the place isn't safe. I've brought two for you.
en_old: You're a colorful one, you saw them. Well done, but don't go that way at this hour. At this hour the place isn't safe. I brought two for you.

brh: ولے مچن اینا داڑت تنیا مروٹ دا کن داڑیکو ننا ہم بالکل داکا خورکے نم تینا ناڑی ڈکا برو نم فکر کپو ئے نما خیال ئے
en: But ... I'll be alone here. That's why ... ours is also very close to here. You come along with your ...; don't worry, I'm looking out for you.
en_old: But my child, I'll be alone here, that's why here... we too, completely... you bring your pulse... don't worry, that's just your imagination.

brh: اوہاں دا ٹارچ ء دا ایرا خطر ء پو اگر نمے خطرہ محسوس مس تو دا ٹارچ ء بند کبو
en: Oh yes, this torch, and these two are for danger. If you feel any danger, turn off this torch.
en_old: Oh yes, this torch, these two dangers... if you feel in danger, turn off this torch.

brh: کبو ولہ یلہ کبو تہ ئے تینا سر کٹ
en: Do it, then let it go... I'll take it on my own head.
en_old: Do it, then let it go, put it on your head.

brh: بس اما بس! انگنی پاسہ کیو بے خطائے بے قصورے ننا کلنا ئے
en: Enough, mother, enough! You still say that she is blameless and innocent, [that it is] all of ours?
en_old: Enough, mother, enough! Why do you say that? All of ours are innocent and blameless.

brh: زتے مشتے ٹی ملائفے، اسلی گاؤ کنا دوٹی برے، ئے اودے زندہ الے پرٹوٹ، کنا مار، نا ایڑ دونو مسے دا صفا، او تینا زندے برباد مننگ آن بچفنگ نا خاطر اٹ دم کرینے، ئے اکنا
en: (Someone) mixed poison into the ... If the real culprit falls into my hands, I won't leave him alive. My son, your sister has ended up like this, completely, and she collapsed (lit. 'took breath') trying to save her life from being ruined. I...
en_old: Mixed poison into the milk. If the real culprit falls into my hands, I won't leave him alive. My son, your sister has ended up like this, completely; she has fainted trying to save her life from being ruined. I...

brh: تینت رست؟ ایڑے میر بہادر خان کنا مسن نا رندا ٹی ء، او داڑے نی اودے کسفنگ نا رندا ٹی ئس اما، میر بہادر خان نا قصہ داسہ ختم مس۔ داسہ؟
en: Is that really true? There, Mir Bahadur Khan is after my daughter, and here you were set on killing him, mother? Mir Bahadur Khan's story is over now. Now?
en_old: Did you make it? Look, Mir Bahadur Khan is after my daughter, and you were here trying to kill him, mother? Mir Bahadur Khan's story is over now. Now?

brh: یار نی تینے پریشان کپہ۔ مشکل ئے کہ دا نیم روچ اسکا بش مرے رے۔ نی ایندا تے درک۔ ناصر جان نا باز مہربانی۔ نی کنتو باز کمک کرینے۔ یار کنا ایلوم سے یار۔
en: Friend, don't worry yourself. It's unlikely this one will get up before midday. You take these. Thank you so much, Nasir Jan. You have helped me a lot. Friend, you're a brother to me, friend.
en_old: Man, don't worry yourself. It's hard for this to be done by half the day. You take these. Many thanks to Nasir jaan. You've helped me a lot. Man, you're my brother, man.

brh: ایلم ایلم کے جان قربان کیک دانت کمک اسیوایا جوان گڑا اینٹ سلا دا چا تورے او گڑا آن دا چاک لار کرے دا چا تیم درک
en: A brother gives his life for a brother; what kind of help was this, huh? All right then... wait, hold this tea, and then from that thing this tea was boiled... take this tea.
en_old: A brother sacrifices his life for a brother. This help was such a good thing. Leave this tea here, from that thing take this tea away, take this tea.

brh: ارٹ دا دا
en: Two... this, this.
en_old: Two, this, this.

brh: آ ہلو۔ انت؟ جنگلٹی؟ ہمم پکنک والا تو۔ سردار نا مار اسہ کے۔
en: Ah, hello. What? In the jungle? Hmm, with the picnic people. The Sardar's son... one...
en_old: Ah, hello. What? In the jungle? Hmm, the picnic one, right. The chief's son, one...

brh: تانا مطلب دادے کہ اونن تو دروغ تڑکے ہاؤ کنا ڈی
en: So you mean that he lied to us? Yes, my...
en_old: Your meaning is that he told a lie, yes, my...

brh: داسہ نی فکر کننگ نا ہچ ضرورت اف۔ داسہ سوب مس اینا اٹکاو۔ نئے نی دن تینے الینگ کپرے۔
en: Now there's no need at all for you to worry. Now the reason for the hold-up has become clear. And you can't let yourself go like this either.
en_old: Now there's no need at all for you to worry. Now the reason became clear, why I stopped. You can't leave yourself like this either.

brh: ئے ہم نی تو بریواں کنا سما اف کچو گولی نا گواچی مریو نشیری نی دن پاپا اللہ خیر کیک
en: I'll come with you too. I don't know, maybe I'll fall victim to a bullet. Don't say that; God will make it turn out well.
en_old: I also didn't know that you would come; I don't know, would you become a victim of a stray bullet? Don't say that, God will make it all right.

brh: ہر گڈانہ اسہ فیصلہ ئس مریک آخری ہم تو
en: At the end of everything there is a decision, a final one too.
en_old: Every ending has a decision, a final one too.

brh: ئے ہم دا کنا فرض ئے کہ ئے اسہ ہندن و بندغ اسے نا کمک ء کیو
en: It's also my duty to help a person like this.
en_old: It is also my duty to help such a person.

brh: اونا بازو جوڑ مریو ہمو کہ تینا فرض اکن تینا سکون ء قربان کرے طارق صاحب نمے یاد ء نم تون قول کریسٹ کہ ہر گام آ نم تون اوار سلوک اوٹ
en: I will be an arm to the one who sacrificed his own peace for his duty. Tariq Sahib, do you remember? I had promised you that I would stand alongside you at every step.
en_old: I would become the arm of the one who sacrificed his peace for his duty. Tariq sahib, do you remember, I promised you that I would stand with you at every step.

brh: نما بازو جوڑ مروٹ نما او تینا دا بارو انگا ڈغار نا سیب سنگا مخلوق نا
en: I will be your arm, yours, and that of the... people of this dry land of yours.
en_old: May your arms stay strong, you who are the cause of the people of this fertile land of yours.

brh: امال خنا شیطانیا بوٹیئے
en: Mother saw the devil's weed.
en_old: Mother saw the devilish herb.

brh: ظالمہ، صفا ظالمو بندہ او، ہنو کٹارو سائے کنا کشر او، سائے کنا کشر او، او حاجی منظور
en: Cruel one! A thoroughly cruel man he is; that dagger of a man is the one who'll take my life, he'll take my life, that Haji Manzoor.
en_old: Cruel, an utterly cruel man he is, that ruthless one is my killer, he is my killer, he, Haji Manzoor.

brh: خدا تباہ کے اللہ تباہ کے نی دا جیل اٹی ہندن ہندن قیدی ارے کہ او ہشت ہشت خون کرینو
en: May God destroy him, may God destroy him! You know, in this jail there are such prisoners who have committed eight murders each.
en_old: May God destroy you, may God destroy you! In this jail there are prisoners who have committed eight murders each.

brh: ولے مجال کہ کس اوفتے دو ہم خلے، اللہ اوفتنا رفیق ئے کل کونا مسکین تو دن کننگو، اللہ رفیق او، تانکہ اللہ اوفتنا رفیق ئے نی
en: But no one dares even lay a hand on them; God is their companion! All this is done only to the poor like this; God is the companion... so God is their companion, you see.
en_old: But no one dares even lay a hand on them, God is their companion. Everyone does this to the poor, God is the companion, so that God is their companion, you...

brh: او مردار کیڑے، نی تو ہندن وال ئس کرو کہ کسس مور نا خنے نی پائے چھلنا چوری ئس بسو، بلے پینٹ، ارے تو چلنا چوری ئس پاو ئس مسوٹ نی کسو کتے دمبو
en: You filthy worm, you did such a thing that someone... You say you came in for stealing a ring, but... yes, a ring theft, (you) say... you have become... you...
en_old: You filthy worm, you behaved in such a way that someone... you came in for a petty theft, but... it was a petty theft, and now you have...

brh: قربان دا انصاف کے کسس ککڑس دزی کے یا کارس سزا تئے سٹے نی تے نک کش ادا تیا دان دنو جاگہ سے کسس نی آ رحم کپک داڑے صرف پیسہ ئ
en: Hail this justice! If someone steals a chicken or a car, they give him punishment... in a place like this nobody shows you any mercy; here it's only money.
en_old: Bless this justice! Someone steals a chicken or something and gets punished... here in a place like this, nobody shows you any mercy; here it's only money.

brh: پیسہ پیسہ جھٹ تے تماشہ اور۔ خدا نا دروہی ئے کرید نا عذاب اٹ کشی ار۔ خلاص کک کنے الہی خلاص کک کنے۔ ہلو ہمو وخت آ پارے۔
en: Money, money... it's all a show. For God's sake... caught in the torment of... Free me, O God, free me! Hello... he said it at that time.
en_old: Money, money, it's all a spectacle. Lying about God is caught in torment. Free me, O God, free me. Well, he said it at that time.

brh: ایت نی ولے نخرہ کریس، پاریس دہ دے کیوے ایدے کفرے، داسہ لٹہ او لغتہ تا مونا تونہ، مے یار غلطی ئس کرٹ، چک ئس خلکوٹ
en: So you were putting on airs, saying 'I'll do this, I won't do that'; and now, in front of the sticks and kicks, (it's) 'Friend, I made a mistake, I slipped up.'
en_old: Come on, you put on airs back then, you said you'd do it in ten days, and now in front of the sticks and kicks you say, 'Friend, I made a mistake, I slipped.'

brh: اسے واری کنے دا کنک کش ئے نا احسان بند بند اٹ تینا نت تے تمبے وایاں کنے نا شرط منظور ئے کنے کش دا کا دا ہم ار کنے نگٹوس کئے نی کنا گڑاس کنے
en: Just once, get me out of this, it'll be your favor; with every limb I fall at your feet... I accept your condition, get me out... this too is... you... something of mine...
en_old: Just once, do me this favor... otherwise, if my condition is accepted, kill me; there's this too... you, some of my things...

brh: کینی اللہ مالکے، مگہ الو اسے تس پاو نی دا کسر ٹی واپسی اف، دا نہ کہ پگہ پاروس دا کاری مے کیوے دا کاری مے کپرے، پوہ مسوس، گڈ اچکائے؟
en: Well, God is the Master, but let me tell you one thing: on this road there is no turning back. It's not that tomorrow you'll say, 'I'll do this job, I won't do that job.' Understood? Then what...?
en_old: God is the master, but he gave one and said there's no turning back on this path. It's not that tomorrow you'll say, 'I'll do this work, I won't do that work.' Understood? Then what?

brh: ئے دا سارے گڑا کے وی تاسہ می جیل اٹ ہچوٹ، ولدا می جیل اٹ مروٹ، ہا شاباش، اینو ئے کاو بلا سائیں تون ہیت کیو، بلا سائیں؟
en: I'll do all these things... (or) I'll be stuck in jail, I'll be in jail again. Ah, well done! Today I'll go and talk with Bala Sain. Bala Sain?
en_old: ...all these things... we'll stay in jail, and then we'll be in jail again. Well done! Today I'll go and talk to Bala Sain. Bala Sain?

brh: اللہ سائیں دے رے اللہ سائیں ئے جیل نا کلے ڈینڈ پڈ غاتے تیتی انچل نا فکر پورے سیل او کاٹھو مے کنا کشوس بس داسے ہم نی خلیسوس پدا نی وا انزغم خلو سلوم
en: O God, O God... all the... of the jail... the worry... the cell and the wooden (stocks)... enough, even now you've beaten (me), and later you'd strike (with) a sword...
en_old: O God, O God... in the jail, all the... worry... the cell and the wood... you've hit us now too, and again you...

brh: غلطی ئس کرے چک ئس خلکوٹ یار بابو داسہ نی ارا وڑ کے پاسی ہندن کرو کنے منظور ئے
en: I made a mistake, I slipped up, friend Babu. Now whatever way you tell me, I'll do it that way; I accept.
en_old: I made a mistake, I slipped, friend Babu. Now whatever you say, I'll do it that way, I accept.

brh: اینک کنا زہربند افس غلام نا ایچ کاری افک الو جانی اللہ دنیائی کے دوبار
en: Now I don't have any... ; Ghulam has no work at all... dear one, God... the world... twice.
en_old: Now I have no poison... nothing of the slave's... dear one, God, the world twice.

brh: ویم پد کے برے دا مخلوق نظر کے کتے دا دے مچ پوش کر لیخٹی تے شارتے کنے تے تئی دا خیر خنس بسم اللہ او ادی دا جاگہ نا نظرا نن دن خلیوہ نن دن خلیوہ اللہ مانتے
en: ...come back afterwards... these people... look... this day... gather... this good fortune; in the name of God, O sister, at the sight of this place we do (it) like this, we do like this, God...
en_old: Then come back, these people... gather on this day... this is good fortune, in the name of God, sister, at the sight of this place we do this, we do this, God...

brh: دا غلی سل کپ کیرہ بخیر ات تاتی تول خیر ات مزار نی ایوا آرام تول لوپل
en: This street... welcome, sit... welcome... now you sit and rest...
en_old: Don't make a fuss in this street, farewell, sit down well, may it be well at the shrine, you rest now, sit...

brh: بلوچ خیرٹ اماں سازین نا وراغہ کاو زو برس ولدا رندٹ نا دے بریک توار کننگ کینا دا وار الوداع نی الاتی بد ننگ تو سانگ برام تکرک
en: Baloch... in peace, Mother... I'll go home; come back soon. The next day will come again, we can call. This time, farewell... you... engagement and wedding...
en_old: Baloch... mother... go, come back soon, then the day will come... we can call; this time, farewell...

brh: اوئے خونہ وڑنا مسڑی یار آک پٹو ولہ خیر اٹ ئے جاگہ ٹی کہ او رہینگانئے او دے ودھا جاگہ نا مسڑک خوش برور ایڑے سیتس پاو نی او نا وڑنا سپاہ جوان مسڑ اسے خان ا جا نی پاو
en: Hey, friends, look for a girl of his kind; well, all right, in the place where he has lived, the girls of that place will be liked. Tell someone there, you tell them: a girl for a brave young man of his kind; go tell the Khan.
en_old: Hey, search for a girl of good family, friends, let it be good, in the place where she lives, the girls of that place are pleasant; tell someone there, a girl worthy of a young soldier like him, go and tell the Khan.

brh: مستونی تتف دھیرے سے ملک متو نا مسڑ ئ ایچو نا پیچتی کڈو ابو ابو زاری کتے ئے انو نا شلفت سے او دے پجک وڑا ملک ابراہیم نا مسڑ امرے بمبا جان کڈ مرے ئے پتا
en: Mastungi... Malik Mitho's daughter... Abu, Abu... pleading... today's... that kind... Malik Ibrahim's daughter, how... dear... know.
en_old: Mastungi... Malik Mitho's daughter... Abu, Abu, pleading... today's... his kind, Malik Ibrahim's daughter... let him know.

brh: ایچو کنا کاریم چائے، اگہ میر بہادر خان کنا مونا بس تو اودے زندہ الیپروٹ۔ ہیلو؟ ہیلو؟ ہیلو؟ ہیلو؟
en: That's all my job is: if Mir Bahadur Khan comes in front of me, I won't leave him alive. Hello? Hello? Hello? Hello?
en_old: Now my only job is this: if Mir Bahadur Khan comes in front of me, I won't leave him alive. Hello? Hello? Hello? Hello?

brh: ہا، اڈمس، دنا فون ئے جہانزیب نا فون اسکا۔ انٹ پاریکہ شیریں ملا یا نہ؟ کنے مسٹ شیریں نا ہچ جاہ خبر اف۔
en: Yes, it's cut off. This phone... it was Jahanzeb's phone. What was he saying, has Shireen been found or not? I have no news at all of where my daughter Shireen is.
en_old: Yes, Adams, this is Jahanzeb's phone. What did he say, was Shireen found or not? I don't know anything about where Shireen is.

brh: سما فرنگنا نی اسہ کنڈہ میر بہادر خان کنے پریشان کرینے ایلو کنڈہ جانزے دا کل نا دوئم ئس
en: Do you understand? On one side Mir Bahadur Khan has troubled me, and on the other side Jahanzeb is a second [one] in all of this.
en_old: I don't understand. On one side Mir Bahadur Khan has troubled me, and on the other, Jahanzeb is behind all of this.

brh: چے ہو، شفیق ارے ملکوسو، کستو مشورہ کریسو، اینو درو دے نن خنتو اینہ، نینس چپ کا، ئے تینٹ پریشان اٹ، پین پریشان کپہ کنے، اینک
en: What, yes, Shafiq is here. You should have met him, you should have consulted someone. Today, yesterday, we haven't seen [her]. You just keep quiet. I'm worried myself; don't worry me any more.
en_old: Yes, Shafiq is here. You should have consulted someone. We haven't seen it today or yesterday. You be quiet, I'm already worried myself, don't worry me any more.

brh: جوان مس، کنے بسف۔ ہن مس۔
en: All right, that's enough for me. That's it.
en_old: All right, that's enough for me. Let's go.

brh: خرماسس خرما؟ او خرماسس کنا کننگ کے بننگٹی ئس ئے ٹارچ اونا خنتٹ خلکوٹ و مڑی سلیس ہندا خاطر ٹارچ آن اف کریٹٹ
en: It was a wolf? A wolf? It was a wolf; it was coming to eat me. I shone the torch into its eyes and it stayed away, that's why I was switching the torch on and off.
en_old: Was it a jackal? A jackal? It was a jackal, it was coming to eat me. I shone the torch in its eyes and it froze, so I turned the torch off.

brh: ناصر نی داڑے؟ پریشان ئس بس ہنداکا ہنداکا ہننگا اٹ
en: Nasir, you're here? I was worried, so I was just going this way and that.
en_old: Nasir, are you here? I got worried, so I was going here and there.

brh: ایچ صف مین ئے برے ئے کاوا ولے ولے انت ہا ہا کے دا مست دیر ئے جوان
en: [unclear] I'm going, but, but what? Ha ha, this intoxicating water is good.
en_old: Now, don't bring the man... but what, ha ha, this intoxicating water is good.

brh: نی خبر لگا۔ دانا باز بلو قصہ اسے سنگت۔ باز مجبوری۔ دا خلیا کمک خوائس۔ دانا بندغک دانا کسفنگ نا رندٹی ء۔ ارے نی۔
en: You found out. It's a very long story, friend. She is in great distress. She was afraid and asked for help. Her own people are out to kill her. There you are.
en_old: You heard the news. It's a very long story, friend. She's in great distress. She needed help. Her own people are out to kill her. There you are.

brh: دا دیر انٹ سے؟ اللہ خیر کے۔ سوب مرے گڑا فیصلہ ئس کیلے کدانان۔ کن کے البو۔ نی پدی۔ ئے بریو۔
en: Who is she? What is this? May God keep things well. When morning comes, then we'll make some decision. Leave it to me. You go back. I'll come.
en_old: What water is this? May God help. If there's a reason, then a decision will be made from there. Leave me. You go back. I'll come.

brh: بچ خانٹ خرمارے داڑے داڑے کچک ئس نا ہاو بڑا کچک ئس مروئی
en: [unclear] Is there a wolf here? Here, that's a dog's bark; it must be a big dog.
en_old: Bach Khan, is there a jackal here? That's the sound of a dog, it must be a big dog.

brh: نی تینے پریشان کپہ
en: Don't worry yourself.
en_old: Don't worry yourself.

brh: چک اسس۔ او دا مشتے ٹی قسم قسم نا جانور اریر۔ زو باز دوستی۔ زو ہر کسے دوستی۔ دا تو چک اسس یا خرما لائٹو نا خنت تما او مرو
en: It was a dog. In these mountains there are all kinds of animals. They make friends very quickly; they quickly make friends with anyone. Was this a dog or a wolf? The light fell into its eyes and it [went] away.
en_old: It was a dog. There are all kinds of animals in these plains. They make friends very quickly. They quickly make friends with everyone. Was it a dog or a jackal? The light fell on its eyes and it stayed far away.

brh: ہو واقعی زند زند جی ہچ نہ نی آرام کر ئے ہما نڑ خلوٹ نہ نہ
en: Yes, really, life, life, sir, nothing, no. You rest; I'll [unclear] that one. No, no.
en_old: Yes, really, life, life, nothing, you rest, I won't hit that... no, no.

brh: نی مرام کے کنے ہچ متو۔ خدانے سلامت کے، نی زندہ مروئی ہن مس، ہچ متو۔
en: You rest; nothing has happened to me. May God keep you safe; you have to stay alive. That's it, nothing happened.
en_old: You'll be fine, nothing happened to me. May God keep you safe, you have to stay alive. Come on, nothing happened.

brh: خبرہ فرنگینا شیریں بنو
en: Do you know? Shireen, listen.
en_old: Do you know, Shireen, listen.

brh: جانزیب ہمینہ غائب مس خدا بندغے ہچ دنو حالات تف کہ او تینا لمہ باوہ نا
en: Jahanzeb just disappeared like that. May God never give anyone such circumstances that he [loses] his own mother and father...
en_old: Jahanzeb disappeared just like that. God, may no one ever face circumstances like these, losing his parents.

brh: ئے زف نا خیال تے خپسا سنگی نیتنا
en: Don't you see what I'm thinking, Sangeen, you yourself? [unclear]
en_old: Don't you understand what's on my mind, friend?

brh: ماننگ کے شیرینہ موڑی نانے سنگین
en: Maybe Shireen [unclear], Sangeen.
en_old: Maybe Shireen has turned to Sangeen.

brh: نی بننگٹی ئس نا؟ سنگین سنگین
en: Can you hear me? Sangeen, Sangeen.
en_old: Are you listening? Sangeen, Sangeen.

brh: سنگین سنگین سنگین سنگین ہت مس سنگین خانتے مل سنگین
en: Sangeen, Sangeen, Sangeen, Sangeen, [unclear]. Sangeen, open your eyes, Sangeen.
en_old: Sangeen, Sangeen, Sangeen, Sangeen, it's over. Sangeen, open your eyes, Sangeen.

brh: سنگت ہن مس ہنت مل کنا مسڑ شیرین بس جہانزیب بس کنا مسڑ شیرین بس آرام دے آرام دے بریک
en: Friend, it's done, open your eyes. My daughter Shireen has come, Jahanzeb has come, my daughter Shireen has come. Slowly, slowly, she is coming.
en_old: Friend, it happened, my daughter Shireen came, Jahanzeb came, my daughter Shireen came. Slowly, slowly, she's coming.

brh: او بریک سنگین بریک شیرین او شربت ہا ہا مچے دیر کو دیر کو
en: She's coming, Sangeen, Shireen is coming. And sherbet, ha ha. A little water, water...
en_old: He's coming, Sangeen is coming, Shireen and sherbet, ha ha, everyone, who's there, who's there.

brh: سنگے سنگے نی راست پاریس دا کل گراتا زمیندار ایوٹ
en: Sange, Sange, you were right. I am the landlord of all of this.
en_old: Sange, Sange, you were right, I was the landlord of all of this.

brh: ئے ہر گڑا ء پیسہ خیال کریٹہ، ہندا سمجھاٹ کہ ہر گڑا ء پیسہ ٹی ہلکیوہ، ولے نہ سنگت نا۔
en: I used to think everything was money. I believed that I could buy everything with money, but not a friend.
en_old: I thought everything was money, I believed that everything could be bought with money, but not friendship.

brh: پیسہ ٹی ہر گناہ ٹی بئے بندہ غا لنک کپک خوشی تے لنک کپک سنگین سنگین کنے معاف کبو نو معاف کبو کنے بس
en: With money, in every sin, you cannot buy a person, you cannot buy happiness. Sangeen, Sangeen, forgive me, oh forgive me, that's enough for me.
en_old: Money doesn't make a person happy in every sin, it can't buy happiness. Sangeen, Sangeen, forgive me, please forgive me, that's enough for me.

brh: داسہ پین پریشان کپہ، بریرہ کنا چنا، بریرہ۔
en: Now don't worry any more; they're coming, my child, they're coming.
en_old: Now don't worry anymore, they're coming, my child, they're coming.

brh: جان صاحب جان کنا تو خیال پائیک نن دون کین پولیس
en: Jaan sahib, my dear, my thinking says we should do this: the police.
en_old: Jaan sahib, my dear, I think we should do this: the police.

brh: پولیسے اتلیتن۔ او گڑا چسکے۔ گنوک مسنس یار۔ پولیسے اتلیتر۔ ننا عزت نا سوال ئے نی پاشا پولیسے اتلیتن۔ دم درینگا۔ دا ہلی ہم دم۔ آخر خاننگے۔ اراڑے کٹک کینے؟ ہناڑے جاگہس مروئی۔
en: Let's inform the police. And then [unclear]. Have you gone mad, man? Inform the police? It's a question of our honour, and you're saying let's inform the police! I'm worn out. This one too, [unclear]. In the end, [unclear]. Where will we bury him? There must be a place over there.
en_old: Don't bring in the police. That thing is stuck. Have you gone mad, man? Don't bring in the police. It's a question of our honor; you're saying don't bring the police. Breath stopped. This one too, breath. In the end, it has to be seen. Where will you hide it? There must be a place there.

brh: کان مو تمپہ یار خیال کیس کہ دا افتے خبر تمے
en: Don't [unclear], man. Be careful that word of this doesn't reach them.
en_old: Don't let your ears drop, man; be careful that they don't find out about this.

brh: اسمونی لمہ تا چنگا چا پخلک اگر نی دنو رستو بے عیب قسم افک ئے تو تکانو ٹیٹ بروکا ہفتہ ٹی غفور جان نا سانگے کیوہ پورا ششتو مریک کہ اوے
en: Asmoni... their mother... tea... If there isn't such a proper, flawless kind [of girl] as you say, then... in the coming week I will arrange Ghafoor Jan's engagement, and it will be completely settled...
en_old: Mother cooks the children's food; if you can't find such a flawless match, then next week I'll arrange Ghafoor Jan's engagement, and by the sixth it will be done.

brh: سلکونٹ مخلوقن پائیک ایڑ دسکن گدی چلو تکتن داخس سلا نیستی تسونے تے خیر اللہ تے علی جانے پٹ جوان مریک
en: In Salkon(?) people say ... sister ... the seat ... after so much poverty has been dealt out ... look to Khairullah's and to Ali Jan; that would be good.
en_old: People in Silkon say that between two brothers the seat of leadership passes on; after so much trouble, it would be good to look to Khairullah and Ali Jan.

brh: ایڑے ئے لوم ککڑو کشس ورا تٹی۔ ماما نورو اراریکی؟ ئے واستن نہ چار دانہ دنانو نی اینا استے بلے ہرفیسٹ۔ ایندا کا گما۔ جیو کاوے
en: There, mother(?), pull out the chicken... Uncle Noro, is he at home? ... four pieces ... I picked them up. Go over there... Bless you, let me go.
en_old: Brother, pull out the chicken and bring it here. Uncle, is Noor here? Take four or so grains of this for him. This is lost. Keep it.

brh: جیبو بخیرٹ، تو بخیرٹ، انت کنے توساسے؟ نزانٹ
en: Zaibo, welcome; and you too, welcome. What is it you're telling me? I don't know.
en_old: Is my pocket all right? Are you all right? What did you tell me? I didn't know.

brh: سنگت نی کن دا تو غلیٹی بیر چمٹ کریسے پین وادیر مروئی ہمو چوٹی غاتیستار نی ککڑو کننگ اٹی اسکہ یا بلا ئس خلیتن دا بے شرمی تون ئے تو ارٹ
en: Friend, you've clung to this mistake for your own sake; what more has to happen? Those deviations ... you keep going on and on as if some calamity had struck you, with this shamelessness of yours...
en_old: Friend, you've really clung to this mistake. What more has to happen? You're stuck on those things, as if you'd been struck by some curse, with this shamelessness of yours.

brh: ئے بابا کڑنتس خناٹ دا مار کوٹ کے سالوم کڑنتس۔ کانزیبو ایڈ کینا۔ سسی میران نا ٹوٹی میران دا ٹیلو بابا نا ایچ قصور افک۔
en: Father, I saw this snake(?) ... in the corner for a year... Go, Zaibo, I'll handle it. Sassi is Meeran's ... Meeran ... this is not Father's fault at all.
en_old: Father, I saw that this snake had been sitting in the corner all year. Zaibo, I'll take care of it. Sassi is Meeran's, and Meeran's... this isn't Father's fault at all.

brh: کل کسور نا بل خور نا ئے او تو چرے ننگے شار اٹی کلے تعویذ جادو کیک، تعویذ جادو تا وجہ آن نا باوہ نا بائے بند کرے، نی تو بلس خلیکے ادا برے سو اٹ۔
en: All the fault is your mother-in-law's. She goes around in our town doing charms and magic on everyone; because of the charms and magic she has shut your father's mouth. As for you, ... a calamity strikes ... came here...
en_old: All of it is the fault of that glutton. She goes around the town doing charms and black magic for everyone, and because of the charms and magic your father's mouth was shut. You should have hit her and brought her here.

brh: دکان اٹ کشیسہ ئے ہمہ کے میا تو نا تعویز اسے کہ کنا جادو ئے تو بے بخت نیکن خلیوہ بے بخت ئے میران کین دوم پریشان اٹ کنا تو مچا ہوش ہورتونی ماما انت پاریکے میران اغا تم
en: Pulling her out of the shop... is that charm of yours meant so that I cast my magic on you, you wretch? The wretch... I am this worried for Meeran; I've completely lost my senses. Uncle, what are you saying? Meeran is ours...
en_old: Get her out of the shop. Is that charm of yours for me, so you can cast my magic on that wretch? The wretch is upsetting Meeran again. I've lost my senses completely. Uncle, what are you saying? Meeran is ours.

brh: بابا نی تا دن اندازہ لگا کے کہ دا قد دا میران کن جوانکا ڈسخوتانے دوشس ڈنگ خالی استاتی آتا دا کلے ہمو میر جمال نا کاریم کو او بے ہمراہ تے کنا ثواب انتو میران تو خستی نا ثواب انتے کنا ثواب
en: Father, just judge it like this: that this [match] is good for Meeran ... a snake stung(?) ... All of this is that Mir Jamal's doing. ... What reward is there for me? What reward for Meeran's trouble, and what for mine?
en_old: Father, just figure out whether this match is right for Meeran. All this is Mir Jamal's doing. What's my reward in it? What's Meeran's reward for his trouble, and what's mine?

brh: او بنن نا خطرہ کے او شنگے کے میران تند کے میر کیو او نن پس پد میران بیگانو ستف نی نائلہ نا ماری سادے او نا مطلب ئے نی پومفسہ ئے تو چپوٹو
en: There's the danger that he hears of it ... Meeran gets angry ... then afterwards Meeran will treat us as strangers. You ... Naila's ... You don't understand what it means; so I'll keep quiet.
en_old: There's a danger to him. He'll get angry, Meeran will turn against Mir. Afterwards Meeran will treat us as strangers. You've given in to Naila's ways. If you don't understand what that means, then keep quiet.

brh: اگی تینا بائے مرار تو بھلو پڈس جوڑ مریک۔ زیبو، دانا پین علاج اف۔ ئے بابائے پاریٹ۔ ادہ راضی کبو، پد او کائے۔ ئے تو ہمے وخت ئس اینو نا بننگ نا حق ٹی الوٹ۔ دیر سمائیکی او بریک۔
en: If his mouth ... then a big problem will arise. Zaibo, there's no other cure for this. I told Father: persuade him, and then he'll go. I was never in favor of his coming today. Who knows whether he'll come.
en_old: If he gets his mouth shut, it'll become a big problem. Zaibo, there's no other cure for this. I told Father. Get him to agree, then he'll come. I've already spoken up about his coming today. He'll understand late, but he'll come.

brh: دا پین زیات مریش، گواچم زیبو، نی راضی کننگ کے ستے، او پین کسے منیپک، بے بخت، کنا ہم است راخی توڑا بغیر، دا دے توریس تو ڈین پین ودیخ
en: This will get even worse. I'm at my wits' end, Zaibo; you can persuade him, he doesn't listen to anyone else. Poor me, my heart too ... without... If you hold him back, more [trouble] will come of it.
en_old: It'll get even worse. Listen, Zaibo, you need to persuade him. He won't listen to anyone else. Poor me, I couldn't break my promise either. If you hold on to this day, more will come of it.

brh: ہفتس متنے کہ او دانگ بسنے، دا خضدار بلو پڈاس مسنے، نی امر او دے توکف، نی تو نا ضد نا سمائی کہ او کس نا ہیت اسے بنپک، او کنا ہراڑ بنو۔
en: It's been a week since he came here, and this Khuzdar business has become a big problem. How will you hold him back? You know how stubborn he is, that he doesn't listen to anyone's word; where would he listen to mine?
en_old: It's been a week since he came there. Khuzdar has become a big problem. How will you hold off that day? You know how stubborn he is, he won't listen to anyone. Where would he listen to me?

brh: ہاں بابو انت حوال آک او سئیں اللہ نا مہربانی ئے سئیں
en: Yes, Babu, what's the news? Oh, sir, it's by God's kindness, sir.
en_old: Yes, Babu, how are things? Sir, by God's grace, all is well, sir.

brh: او مادو ننا کاٹم آٹی ہر کاریم سے اٹ پاشو سے دا وار بیلو نی پاریس ننا کسے زوئے تے اگر دا وار او رے کرے گڑا پاش تے گلہ کرے
en: He has put every job on our heads, and in every job something comes out in the open. This time you said you'd take one of ours along. If he turns it down this time, then he'll complain about it openly.
en_old: He's put every job on our heads, and keeps a grudge over each one. This time you said you'd take one of ours with you. If he refuses this time, then we'll complain about the grudges.

brh: بس اکنا کٹالی بتس سائیں اونا جوانی غام دن ولتک سائیں اسے خواست اسے میا پا پا پا سائیں اسے پوشکنو شکارستو تما
en: I just went to him, sir, and he praised [us] like that, sir. One request, one... say, say, say, sir: a new prey has fallen into our hands.
en_old: I just went to his place, sir, and the way he praised him, sir, I had one request, sir: a new hunt for us.

brh: سئیں حاجی منظور نا دعا نا شکر سئیں داسا ئے کنا ڈوڈی ئے او ننے تو غریب کن کے سئیں تیار ئے بابو
en: Sir, thanks to Haji Manzoor's prayers, sir. Now it's my bread and butter; and he does it for poor folk like us, sir. I'm ready, Babu.
en_old: Sir, thanks to Haji Manzoor's prayers, sir. Now my bread is ready, and he's ready for us poor folk, sir, Babu.

brh: او نی جوان سمائی کہ ننا کاروبار نا جڑاسہ سوئے مریپنے اور دنزونہ کس آ بھروسہ کننگ کپسہ جی او سائیں ئے باہ زورین ئے نا تاڑ اٹ ہیت تروٹ
