en: And you know well that in our line of business ... it doesn't happen, and you can't trust anyone just like that. Yes, sir. I'll keep my mouth shut and talk to him while keeping an eye on him.
en_old: And you know very well that no one in our line of work is reliable, and you can't trust anyone like this. Yes, sir. Sir, I'll speak to him in a tone that keeps him quiet.

brh: سائیں مونا پٹ ئے چپ اٹ سائیں ولے اودے تین تو شامل کننگ نا فیصلہ دا وقت آ کپن تاکہ اودے خنتنو نی اوڑا جوان نظر
en: Sir, I'm keeping quiet in front of him, sir, but we won't make the decision to bring him in with us right now, so that we can watch him; you keep a close eye on him.
en_old: Sir, keep quiet about this in front of him, sir. But don't decide to bring him in with us right now, so that when we see him you can keep a close eye on him.

brh: او نی فرمائش ئس کیک او دے پورا کر۔ جی او سئی۔ نی واہ حکم کرے سئی۔ امر کے نی واہ حکم کرے۔
en: He'll make a request; you fulfill it. Yes, sir. You just give the order, sir. However you order it.
en_old: He'll ask you for something, and you fulfill it. Yes, sir. You only have to give the order, sir. However you order it.

brh: ننا گونڈ انگے
en: Our short one.
en_old: We're fine.

brh: ڈاکٹر صاحب بالکل ٹھیک ئس نی تینا اراٹی ہن کیسٹ، ڈاکٹر صاحب ارا نا فکر کرے تتو اینو دادے خنتوٹ، ارا نا کنے ہچ پاش مفک۔
en: Doctor sahib, am I perfectly fine? You can go to your home. Doctor sahib, if I had worried about home, I wouldn't have lived to see this day; nothing about home is clear to me.
en_old: Doctor, it's perfectly fine, you can go to your home. Doctor, if you hadn't worried about home I wouldn't have seen this day today; nothing about home is clear to me.

brh: نی سما تفک، ولے کنے تینا کاریم ء کروئی ء، تینا مسخت ء پورو کروئی ء۔ فی الحال نی دا کنڈیشن اٹ افیس کہ کاریم کیس، نی مکمل آرام
en: You don't understand, but I have to do my work, I have to fulfill my mission. For now you are not in a condition to work; you [need] complete rest.
en_old: You don't understand, but I have to do my work, I have to fulfill my mission. Right now you're in no condition to work; you need complete rest.

brh: آرام نا ضرورت ہی ڈاکٹر صاحب دا ستو آرام کنے ہمو وخت برو ہرا وخت کہ تینا بس ختک سر سو برو و دا بس ختک کنے کاریم کرو
en: I do need rest, Doctor sahib, but that real rest will come to me only when my [work] is finished and accomplished, and until it is finished I have to keep working.
en_old: I do need rest, Doctor, but I'll get that rest only when my work is finished and done, and until it's finished I have to work.

brh: اینو نم بہتر چارے، ولے اسہ ڈاکٹر نا دا فرض مریک کہ او تینا مریض ء نصیحت کے کہ مسخت آن زیات او نا ظلم اوڑکن
en: Today you know better, but it is a doctor's duty to advise his patient that, more than the mission, his own [well-being] matters for him.
en_old: Today you're looking better, but it's a doctor's duty to advise his patient that more than the mission, his own health matters to him.

brh: دا باز ضروری ء کنے امیت ء کہ نم تینا صحت نا بارو ٹی ضرور سوچیرے او تینا صحت نا خیال ء تخورے جی طارق صاحب
en: This is very important. I hope that you will definitely think about your health and will take care of your health. Yes, Tariq sahib.
en_old: This is very important. I hope you will definitely think about your health and take care of your health, yes, Mr. Tariq.

brh: کنا خیال ئے کہ ڈاکٹر صاحب سئی پارے کنے۔ مننے دیس نا آرام کبو۔ دا سا کاریم آن ضرورت ئے دا کنکن اسہ پروجیکٹ ئس اف، دا کنا زندگی ئے
en: I think the doctor sahib told me right: take [a few] days of rest. Right now there's need [of rest] from work; [but] for me this isn't just a project, this is my life.
en_old: I think the doctor told me right. Rest for three days. This is needed more than work; for me this isn't just a project, this is my life.

brh: او ہیتک نما راستو نما مقصد او دے ئے پو مریوہ او دا اسہ جنگ اسے دا ننا کل نا جنگ ء
en: And your words are right; your purpose, I understand it. And this is a war, this is the war of all of us.
en_old: That's right, your true purpose, we understand it, and this is a war, this is a war for all of us.

brh: دشمن تینا وار ء کرے او تینا جلو ء کرے ولے طارق صاحب داسہ ننا وار ء
en: The enemy has made its move and launched its attack, but Tariq sahib, now it's our turn.
en_old: The enemy has made its move and shown its strength, but Mr. Tariq, now it's our turn.

brh: کنا اودے اندونو ٹپ ئس تتو۔ کھو، پچہ زند، پر مفرور۔
en: I didn't give him that kind of wound. Well, he survived, alive, but he's a fugitive.
en_old: I didn't give him that kind of wound. Cough, live on, but don't run away.

brh: او ہموس دا دے پارین نو نمبر نا سیزا او ہموس نو نمبر نا سیزا گران خالی دے
en: And that one, let's say this day: the punishment of number nine, and that one, the punishment of number nine. A heavy, empty day.
en_old: That one was said that day, number nine's punishment, and that one, number nine's punishment, a heavy empty day.

brh: دا جلہ رین والدا کنے کٹ کٹ اوئے دا تو کنا سیلے کشیک تے چدا بابو ہرا گینا یا اللہ
en: This jailer is going knock-knock at me again; he's going to clear out my cell. What is this, buddy, what are we to do, O God!
en_old: This jailer again knocks and knocks at me, he's pulling at my cell, what is this, buddy, O God!

brh: یا اللہ دا بابو ہرا کینا یا اللہ دا بندغ تو کسفے کنے بابو بابو جوانی ٹی بسس بابو یار دا جیلر اینو ولدا کٹ کٹورا کر کنے یار
en: O God, what is this, buddy, what are we to do? O God, this man will be the death of me. Buddy, buddy, welcome! Buddy, man, today this jailer went knock-knock at me again, man.
en_old: O God, what is this, buddy, O God, this man is going to kill me. Buddy, buddy, come back to your senses, buddy, man, this jailer knocked on me again today, man.

brh: الو ہسیتس بانے اینو آن پد نی کھٹ کھٹ اوتھہ بچا یار کنے بیزارے یار ہمہ کریس نی سائیں تو احوال کریس کہ نہ انت پارے کہ سائیں یار خدا نا منت کنے دا کا کش یار
en: Hey, let me tell you one thing: from today on, you... [unclear] the knock-knock. Save me, man, I'm fed up, man. Did you do it? Did you tell the Sain or not? What did he say? Sain, man, for God's sake get me out of here, man.
en_old: Hey, listen, from today on stop the knocking, save me, man, I'm fed up, man. What did you do, sir? Did you tell him or not, what did he say? Sir, man, for God's sake get me out of this, man.

brh: صبر حوصلہ کرک کل گڈاک مریرے یار انت مریرے یار بابو نی خالی عید کے سے یار دا پترینگاکہ جیلر اینو بد کنے خنا یار باز خراب او راک کنے قسم ئے خدانا دا بد کنے دے شیطانی ئے
en: Have patience and courage, everything will work out, man. What will work out, man? Buddy, you're just celebrating like it's Eid, man. This [...] jailer looked at me badly today, man; he looked at me really nastily. I swear by God, he means me harm; it's devilish.
en_old: Be patient, have courage, everything will be fine, man. What will be fine, man? Buddy, you're just making it an empty Eid, man. This damned jailer looked at me badly today, man, very badly. I swear to God, he gave me an evil look, it's devilish.

brh: او جی ئے بابو! ہیلو! اسٹ تو نندا بے حوصلائی خراب ئے بھلا سائیں ادرے ٹی اگر اونا مونا دن کریس تو کاٹم نا اینا گڑا سڑ اندا جلٹے۔ یار کمال کیس ئے بابو، دا ور ات کرینگوس یار نی تو کمال
en: Oh yes, buddy! Hello! First of all, losing heart is a bad thing, good sir. Here, if you act like that in front of him, everything in your head will burn up right there. Man, you're amazing, buddy, this is how it should be done, man; you really are something.
en_old: Oh yes, buddy! Hello! First of all, losing heart is bad, big sir. Here, if you act like that in front of him, he'll burn the stuff in your head right here. Man, you're doing wonders, buddy, this should have been done this way, man, you're amazing.

brh: مئے یارو، ولے سیتس پاو نی بابو، قسم خدا نا دا جیلر ہندن ظالمو نظرس شاغے کنے آ، کنا تو سب صابر ہشتم کرے۔ اینو آن پد او دوہم خلپک نی ہرا سیت نا زیا کہ ننا دا عمرے او دے کسس دو خلپک۔
en: My friends, but let me tell you one thing, buddy: I swear to God, this jailer cast such a cruel look at me that he has used up all my patience. From today on he won't lay a hand on you either, whatever happens; as long as we're alive, nobody will lay a hand on him.
en_old: My friend, but listen, buddy, I swear to God, this jailer cast such a cruel look at me that he ended all my patience. From today on he won't lay a hand on you again, no matter what, as long as we're alive no one will lay a hand on him.

brh: ولے اسیتس پاو نی اگر نن تو غداری کریس تو نا انجام باز خراب مریک نا زند اوڑان ہم گندہ مریک دا ہم پاو نی یار بابو جان نی کے قربان بس
en: But let me tell you one thing: if you betray us, your end will be very bad, and your life will become even worse than his. Let me tell you this too, man. Dear buddy, I'd give my life for you, enough.
en_old: But listen, tell me, if you betray us, your end will be very bad, your life will become even worse than his. Tell me this too, man, buddy dear, may I be sacrificed for you.

brh: کنے دا پکشہ انتس کنے بارش یا میوڑ کے؟ دا دے پارے نرینہ ئے جیلرساب تو ہیت کیوہ او نی دا کہ کشک پدا نی بر کنتو
en: What is this [...] to me? Will it bring me rain or [...]? He said this one is a real man. I'll talk to the jailer sahib, and he'll get you out of here; then you come with me.
en_old: What is this to me, will it give me rain or something? He said that day he's a man. I'll talk to the jailer, and you get this out, then come back to me.

brh: ٹھیک ہی نا؟ ہموسس؟ ٹھیک ہی مہربانی بابوجان، باز مہربانی دا بابوجان۔
en: Okay, right? That's it? Okay, thank you, dear buddy; thank you very much, dear buddy.
en_old: It's fine, right? That's it? Fine, thank you, dear buddy, thank you very much, dear buddy.

brh: یار بابو منٹ ئس جیل اٹ دنو منزئی ویراخ، قسم ئے پیشانم کتہ، گلاس تو ہریس نی
en: Man, buddy, a single minute in jail is such a long, desolate stretch. I swear, [...]. Just look at the glass, you.
en_old: Friend, buddy, a minute in jail feels like such a long journey. I swear, I'll get you out. Look at the glass, you see?

brh: الو، ننا پینا مخلوق، عیش کے، جیل مرے یا پیشن، منیس یا منی پیس، یار اسے تو سرے بابو، دنیا نا بلدا
en: Hey, our other people are enjoying themselves, whether it's jail or outside, believe it or not. Man, if you have a friend you're all set, buddy, in this world...
en_old: Hey, our other people, enjoy yourself, whether in jail or outside, whether you're there or not. If you have a friend, then you're set, buddy, in the world of...

brh: او ظالم انگا جابر انگا بندغ ء جیل آک بریک اودے معلوم مریک کسے دت مپہ خدائے تے نا منے تینا دا سیاسی آ تقریر ء سائیں نمونہ کپیس نہ کہ کاٹو ئنا کونوئی نہ یار
en: When that cruel, tyrannical person comes to jail, he finds out... [unclear]. Sir, don't make an example of this political speech of yours; it's not something to be swallowed, man.
en_old: When that cruel, oppressive man comes to jail, he finds out... don't let anyone hold you, God... you don't make your political speech an example, sir. It's not food fit for eating, friend.

brh: دا خہ سادہ افٹ دا ستوئی جیل آ بسنوٹ جیل کاٹنگ آن بد کے ہرے ہر گڑائے پو متوٹ الو جیل اسے ہندنو دنیا سے تاڑے ہر بندغ نا سے جتاؤ قصہ سے
en: I'm not that naive. Ever since I came to jail, after doing jail time, look, [I realised] I hadn't understood everything. Hey, a jail is a whole world of its own, where every person has his own separate story.
en_old: This is not so simple. Ever since I came to jail, it's worse than doing jail time. Look, I didn't understand everything. Hey, a jail is a world of its own where every person has a unique story.

brh: چرا سیتو سرے؟ ہنا بندغ نا است خواہی کے دوزی کے مخلوق نا لٹ و خل نا تکلیف ء ولے بخت انسان ء مجبور کیک۔ اڑے رفعت ولے پگہ غان ہچو سوال کپرس۔
en: Why [...]? Whose heart wants to steal, to cause people the pain of robbery and beatings? But fate forces a person. Hey Rifat, but from tomorrow on don't ask any questions.
en_old: Why are you so quiet? That person's heart wants to... steal people's... the pain of robbery and beating, but fate forces a person. Hey Rifat, but from tomorrow don't ask any questions.

brh: ئے اوناٹ اٹو بابو گڈاس نی گڈاس تو راست ہرے کنے بلو بندغ ئس ہریس ولے دا پوم مفیرے نی جیل اٹ انتئے بند ئس پیشن انتئے بس ہندا تو پارے ٹی داڑے ہر قیدی نا سے کتاب و قصہ سے کسس تو
en: Hey, [...] buddy, tell me something, something true. To me you look like a great man, but I don't understand why you're locked up in jail, why you came in from outside. That's just what I said: here every prisoner has his own book and story; someone...
en_old: Hey, ... buddy, finally, you finally, tell me the truth. I've seen you as a great person, but I don't understand why you were locked up in jail and why you came out. That's what I said, here every prisoner has a book and a story of his own.

brh: ظلم مسنے او دے انصاف رسینگتنے او قسم ہرفکپک انتئے کہ اوڑا قسم ہرفکتنے
en: He has been wronged and has not received justice, and he does not swear an oath, because no oath was put to him.
en_old: He has been wronged; he hasn't received justice. He doesn't swear an oath because he has been made to swear an oath.

brh: یا اللہ خیر دا ولدا بس یا اللہ بونی تتو ریس انت احوال ئے بابو شکر ئے دا پاک ئے
en: O God, let it be good, this one has come again. O God, [...]. What's the news, buddy? Thank God, this one is clean.
en_old: O Allah, may it be good, this one came... O Allah, ... what's the news, buddy? Thank God, this is clean.

brh: ایرا غمہ رس۔ نا ثواب اٹی تو نن ہر دے جوانی اٹی رخ کنینہ۔ ہر دے دا تیان اولی کوار چیل اٹی جوانی غا رخ خلکنو۔ کائے صدقہ مرے پین ہچ سے نا نت و اندم کریٹہ تک۔
en: Don't grieve over it. By your blessing we get through every day well. Every day since my first time in jail, we've managed well. Whether it's charity or anything else, I have done everything in my power.
en_old: Don't worry about that. By your blessing, we spend every day well. Every day I've spent better than the first time in jail. Whether it's charity or anything else, I've done whatever I could.

brh: یار چخاکا کے جیل انتے پارہ او مسوس ببو لنگوس ہمار خان استے یار بابو
en: Man, [...] why do they call it jail? He had become [...] buddy [...] Hamar Khan [...] man, buddy.
en_old: Friend, ... why does he say jail, he had been... buddy, ... friend, buddy.

brh: نی ہم مجرم تو انسان ء دا وداک جوڑ کیرے
en: You're a criminal too, but it's these [circumstances] that make a person one.
en_old: You are also a criminal, but people are the ones who make these things.

brh: میر صاحب آفیسر اینو اسپتال آن ڈسچارج مننگ اٹی ء۔ داسہ دا اروئی ء کہ ایہنکا بریک یا مفک۔ اوہ، تو آفیسر اینو ہسپتال آن ڈسچارج مننگ اٹی ء پیرو؟ ہاں
en: Mir Sahib, the officer is being discharged from the hospital today. Now it remains to be seen whether he comes here or not. Oh, so the officer is being discharged from the hospital today, Piru? Yes.
en_old: Mir Sahib, the officer is being discharged from the hospital today. Now we'll see whether he comes here or not. Oh, so the officer is being discharged from the hospital today, Piru? Yes.

brh: اگر او واپس بس و کاریم شروع مس تو چاس کہ ننا کل پلان فیل مس۔ میر صاحب کنا دنو پلان افس کہ او فیل مریر۔ ئے داسہ اونا کمپنی ء لکھوا۔
en: If he comes back and the work starts, then know that all our plans have failed. Mir Sahib, my plans are not the kind that fail. Now get his company to write
en_old: If he comes back and the work starts, then know that all our plans have failed. Mir Sahib, I don't have plans that fail. Now get his company written over.

brh: کہ اونا جانی خطرہ ئس نن اودے سیکیورٹی تسن ولے او تینٹ التو۔ ولے داڑان انت فائدہ مروئی داڑان؟ داڑان دا مروئی کہ پورا کمپنی اودے لاپرواہ پاروئی
en: that his life was in danger and we gave him security, but he himself didn't take it. But what good will come of this? It will do this: the whole company will call him careless.
en_old: That his life was in danger, we gave him security, but he himself didn't take it. But what good will come of this? What will come of it is that the whole company will call him careless.

brh: اول تو پروجیکٹ بند مریک، اگر متو تو کس بندغس داڑے مون تے فرو۔ واہ تحصیلدار جان واہ! قسم خدا نا غدا دماغ تو نی بیسن نا ملک اٹی مسسٹو دا وخت آ باز بلو وزیر ئس مسس اللہ۔
en: First of all, the project will be shut down, and if it isn't, nobody will send anyone here. Wow, dear Tehsildar, wow! I swear to God, with a brain like that, if you had been in a foreign country you would have become a very big minister by now, by God.
en_old: First, the project will be shut down, and if it isn't, then nobody will dare show his face here. Wow, Tehsildar, wow! I swear to God, with a brain like yours, if you were in another country you'd have been a very big minister by now, by God.

brh: وزیری ہم خڑک مگر میر صاحب ہمت کے۔ تحصیلدار صاحب ہر گڑا مریک تینا وخت آ مریک۔ داسہ نی جوان چاس کہ ننا دوک کٹ او۔ حاتم کہ ننا دوک۔
en: Becoming a minister is within reach too, if Mir Sahib makes the effort. Tehsildar Sahib, everything happens, and it happens in its own time. Now you know well that our hands have been cut off: Hatim, who was our hands.
en_old: The ministry is close too, but Mir Sahib, have courage. Tehsildar Sahib, everything happens in its own time. Now you know well that our hands are cut off. Hatim is our hand.

brh: ایلم ئس چاس کہ نا کل حساب کتاب برابر مس۔ میر صاحب نی تینے دا مسئلہ غان اسل بے غم کر، اینا دشمنی انگا
en: A brother... know that all your accounts have been settled. Mir Sahib, put your mind completely at rest about this problem; his enmity...
en_old: Brother, know that all your accounts have been settled. Mir Sahib, don't worry about this problem at all, this enmity of mine...

brh: ئے ہمو وخت اٹ ہراٹ کہ اینا ہفت پشت ہم یات تخوئی۔ میر صاحب میر صاحب معاف کیس کنا لائق ہچ خدمت ئس اللہ معاف کے۔ پیرو۔
en: ...at such a time that even his seven generations will remember it. Mir Sahib, Mir Sahib, excuse me, is there any service I can do for you? God forgive. Piru!
en_old: At that time, when even seven generations of mine will remember it. Mir Sahib, Mir Sahib, forgive me, I'm not worthy of any service, forgive me, by God. Piru.

brh: ئے داسا دا وار ئس کے پگہ میران بریک کہ اوڑتون افیسر تودے اف اگر ہسوک آ تو دا مروئی تمک ہرا رنگ کھائیک دیر دیر تو ملیکک اسل نامراد
en: Now make this one move: tomorrow he comes from Miran's, when the officer won't be with him. If [...], then this will happen [...]; whatever color it takes, sooner or later it will come out. Utterly wretched.
en_old: Now do this one thing: tomorrow when he comes from Mir... that the officer isn't with him. If... then this will happen... whatever color it takes, sooner or later it will be found. Absolutely wretched.

brh: ہندا ہندا میر ہمے دا واپس بس تو چپ تور پروئے گڑانہ گڑاس ضرور کروئی بس نی اسیکارے مسکیس ایرا گواہ پٹیس پدو کنا کاری
en: Exactly, exactly, Mir: if this one comes back, he won't keep quiet. Something or other must definitely be done. You just do this one job, find a witness for it, and after that it's my business.
en_old: That same Mir, if he comes back, don't stay silent. Something or other must definitely be done. You just do it once, then find a witness for it later, my work...

brh: بندہ غا ہیت کننگ ٹی پگ فیصلاتی ٹی بفک تولدا خا چپ کر تولدا خا تول بو وا خیر اٹ تول بو
en: While a man is talking, one does not step into the decisions. Sit down, be quiet, sit down... sit down, all of you, well, sit down in peace.
en_old: When you're talking to someone, don't rush; it has no place in decisions. Sit down then, be quiet, sit down, sit down in peace.

brh: بس کبو گم کبو تا داسکان تلفرورے تا۔ کریم نادانہ سسکہ خیر سے الے تا۔ بس تینا نیتے تا۔ چلو ٹکری بس خیر سے الے تا۔ بس ابا ہنا ہیتاتے الے بو گم کبو۔
en: Enough, stop it, drop it... up to now... Karim is naive... it's fine, let it go. It was only his intention. Come on, Takri, enough, it's fine, let it go. Enough, dear, leave those matters, drop it.
en_old: Enough, be quiet... until now... Karim... it's fine, leave it. It's just your intentions. Come on, Takri, enough, it's fine, leave it. Enough, father, leave these matters, be quiet.

brh: کبو جمہ نا علم نا بارا ٹی سوچ کبو کہ ئنا دے دیر خلکونے بس ابا نمے اجازت ئے
en: Go, think about the matter of the Friday knowledge, about who has struck on his day... Enough, dear, you may all go now.
en_old: Think about the Friday gathering, since the day has been set. That's all, father, you may go.

brh: آبادی نا ہدف۔ ہا
en: The population target. Yes.
en_old: The population target. Yes.

brh: تو پازمبو نا تھرا سنمے ونے تو پازے
en: So say it... then say it.
en_old: Then don't say it... say it then.

brh: یا اللہ توبہ دلی دا تیان تون نا جند نا ٹوک جوان ئے بس سئی ئے گپ تا کان بابا بس دا سادہ و صفا دا دا تیان تون نا جند نا ٹوک جوان ئے بس کان چلو کان چلو
en: Oh God, forgive me! ... your own jokes with these people are good. It's fine, enough talk, let's go, Baba. Just this, plain and simple: your own jokes with these people are good. Let's go, come on, let's go, come on.
en_old: Oh God, forgive me... the words you yourself said are good, they're right. Baba, just simple and clean... these words of yours are good. Let's go, let's go.

brh: عجیب عجیب گراک بھل پسہ نا بستان کے گھیر نا آتہ
en: Strange, strange customers... of big money...
en_old: Strange, strange customers... a big...

brh: دا کنا قول آتیا نی بھروسہ کر
en: Trust these promises of mine.
en_old: Trust my words.

brh: بل شیر اور شیر دل نم ارا ہنیرے بابا؟ تول ولدا پا
en: Bal Sher and Sher Dil, where are you two going, Baba? Sit down, then tell me.
en_old: Bal Sher and Sher Dil, where are you two going, Baba? Sit down, then tell me.

brh: ننے بابا اسہ جنگ بازو بندہ ئس ضرورت ئے شیر دل بندہ ئس تو نن خانان اون
en: Baba, we need a fighting man, a lion-hearted man, and we have seen one.
en_old: Baba, we need a strong fighting man, a brave-hearted man, so we... from the khans.

brh: لیکن او باز مرے نی اوڑے امر خناس اراڑے خناس نی امر چاسا کہ او بہادر و بندغ اسے۔ بابا اسہ وخت پیر سامن ہناسن کوئٹہ غا واپس بیا بسن ہموڑے کولپور نا اسٹیشنا ریل تورے تو ہموڑے نن ہم دڑنگان جٹ ئس چکر خلکونے
en: But there may be many like that; how did you see him there? Where did you see him? How do you know that he is a brave man? Baba, once we had gone to Pir Saman and were coming back to Quetta. The train stopped there at Kolpur station, so we too got off there and took a little stroll.
en_old: But if there are many of them, how did you see him? Where did you see him? How do you know he is a brave man? Baba, once I had gone to Pir Saman and was coming back to Quetta. The train stopped there at Kolpur station, so we also went for a walk around there.

brh: سوار مسو تو اناڑے ئسیٹ ئس بیدے سوداگری تو اناڑے موشی چار بندہ پین اسور توڑا بیدے الپو والا او پیسہ تیتا اناڑے کرز وار اسینا خنا دا ہمبل ئنا ئنا ڈولی ٹی شاوکو بیدا ئنا نفی پھیری تیست
en: When we got on, there was a seat there... trading... There were three or four other men there... and their money... there a loan... he saw this guy's ... in the ... and made a round.
en_old: When they mounted, there was a seat there, then the trading; there four more people came along, then the ones with ... and their money, there they took loans ... saw this ... seated in the palanquin of this ... gave a round.

brh: بس مرو اللہ وڈے کر بس دوشاغہ دا ہتے چپل ایٹ بابا لغت مچ دانگ ہینگ بس ہمو وڈ پھدی کدنے خانہ خراب ننے خلک بس بابا او دا خانہ خراب نا جنگ دونو جنگ ئس کہ دا کرے نن تینا زندگی ٹی خنتنو کلے ہنو کرے اسو
en: Just... by God, he did it that way; he raised his hand, and with this sandal, Baba, kicks everywhere, this way and that; just in that way... the damned wretch beat us. Really, Baba, that wretch's fight was such a fight as we have never seen in our lives; he did all of it like that.
en_old: That's it, by God, do it that way; it was thrown down, these sandals... father, all the curses, his head... in that same way... damn it, he hit us. Father, this wretch's fight was such a fight that we had never seen in our lives, it was like that.

brh: مرے فیتہ غا ئے تو پاوا ئنا بندغ باز جوان و بندغ ئس ئے ئے ئنا تو پاہو دا بندغ نی بھاز کاریم ایتو ٹھیک ہی ہمو اراڑے کے اوتے ہتا بس سائی پگاہ نانو فون کینہ خواہش نا فون نمبر ایتہ نن ہلکنون وختہ وختہ اوڑتو فون ایتو
en: If it's ... then I'd say that man is a very good man... so we told him: 'You, man, I'll give you a lot of work. Fine, wherever those others are, bring them.' Just, okay, tomorrow we'll phone you; if you like, give us the phone number. We took it, and from time to time I give him a call.
en_old: If it's on tape, then say his man is a very good man; tell him: this man, you do a lot of work, fine; those over there, bring them; just tomorrow we'll call you, give the phone number; we took it, call him from time to time.

brh: دا ہم کنے بس پلوٹ پانہ وحیدی ورداڑے ایدو کاری مریک او ضرور مریک او داسہ کنے اجازت ایتے پگہ ملاقات مریک اوڑتو اوار
en: This too, to me, just ... the work will get done; it will surely get done. Now give me leave; tomorrow there will be a meeting together with him.
en_old: This also came to me... Wahidi... work gets done, it surely gets done; now give me permission, tomorrow we'll meet together.

brh: شیف تر، تفو، ابا!
en: Get down, jump, dear!
en_old: Come down, jump, father!

brh: دا دے ہور دا گونڈاک دے دا ہو پورے۔ ارے سمتافو نا ٹکورے، دھوند و بادام منتے تے بدے جنگ کیرے۔
en: Look at this today, these little ones today... Hey, ... you are fighting over ... and almonds.
en_old: Look at today, these little ones today... there are... fighting over smoke and almonds...

brh: دا ممد حسین داستاں لاغ ہتنگاس، ابا ہتیک دا خراسے، السلام علیکم، وعلیکم السلام
en: This Mamad Hussain has been brought ... Dear, he is bringing this ox. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace.
en_old: Muhammad Hussain was brought into the story; father is bringing this ox. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace.

brh: بندغ پدنا کسر اسے گنو بندغ تورے بندغ مونا مبرے لے خبر افنے دیرے آتے نا ٹیوم داد ہمو بندغ کہ دا بندغ دا مٹ نا خالی اچھا
en: A man takes the road back, a man holds back, a man does not come forward, but he does not know ... that man ... this man is empty, of this kind... okay.
en_old: A person takes the road back, a person stops, a person doesn't go forward, but doesn't know... that person... this person... this kind of empty, okay.

brh: ورتہ، انو نرے اف، صحیح صحیح صحیح، ہا بالکل بالکل، دا دوں سمجھے فیس، صحیح، اڈ ورتہ، دانا طاقت شیرنائی اور دا
en: ..., it isn't ... right, right, right; yes, exactly, exactly; you would explain it like this; right; ... its strength is a lion's, and this...
en_old: Look, it's not that... right, right, right; yes, absolutely, absolutely; you understand it like this, right; look, its strength is the lion's and this...

brh: انسانس چلاکی شوک ئنا ٹھیک شوک آن زیادہ چالاک او شیر آن زیادہ طاقتور مگر بھروسہ کپیس ایہہ تہ وا انسان شیشہ نا ذات ئے بالکل دوک پاپس کہ این ریلے دے کہ تے بٹ خواہ مخواہ نن درو کھڑ مرے نام اونہ ٹی ہمار اینو سامول
en: A human has the cunning of a fox, right, more cunning than a fox and stronger than a lion, but do not trust him; ... a human is of the nature of glass; never say that ... for no reason we ... today ...
en_old: Man is cunning like a fox — more cunning than the fox and more powerful than the lion, but don't trust him; man is of the nature of glass, don't say that... for no reason we... today in our...

brh: ادا دا نا خف تے او سنگنا گھنٹیا بارو ارے تینا باپ سے تینا مونی اسے کھرک نامو نانو نی دونگی ہچ بدل ئے لکاٹی بس داسا نومے اجازت ئے نوم ہنبو سنگت اجازت ئے نومے
en: Brother, its ears, and about the bells of the ... hey, his own father ... in front of his own ... you changed nothing ... Now you have permission; go, friends, you may go.
en_old: Brother, here are its ears and the stone bells... in front of your father... you changed nothing... now give us permission, farewell friends, farewell.

brh: برادر دا نن تومرے ہاؤ جی او باور برکان نیاز نی انتئے دن کریس؟
en: Brother, we ... yes, sir. And ..., Niaz, why did you do that?
en_old: Brother, let's ... yes sir, and Barkat Niaz, why did you do that?

brh: ئے منیوہ واقعی نمونہ نننے اوچ بدنی لتاڑے لیکن او نی انت پارے؟ او لامبو داڑے بر! ادا جی!
en: Hey, I admit it, truly a fine specimen ... he trampled us ... but what did he say to you? Hey Lambo, come here! Brother, sir!
en_old: Oh mother, truly... but what did you say? Hey Lambo, come here! Brother, sir!

brh: ادا نی کنے انتئے خنیسہ؟ دا ئے نی دا خاطر خلکو ٹک نا مون ارے گڈو ہم بریک۔ دا دے خنا گڈو نما مونی سلو۔
en: Brother, why are you looking at me? It's this: you struck for this reason ... Guddu is coming too. Look, today Guddu is standing in front of you.
en_old: Brother, why are you looking at me? For this reason... the face... also comes. Look today, ... is standing in front of you.

brh: اڑے لعل! اینو نی، گلو، ہمبو، محمد حسین ء خلبو، چٹ کبو تا۔
en: Hey Lal! Today you, Gullu and Hambo, beat Muhammad Hussain; finish them off.
en_old: Hey Lal! Today you, Gullu and Hambo, beat Muhammad Hussain, finish them all off.

brh: اڑے گلو! رائے مرکان، خان محمد اسے نی خلے، او رائے مرکان!
en: Hey Gullu! Rai Markan, you hit Khan Muhammad, hey Rai Markan!
en_old: Hey Gullu! Rai Markan, you hit Khan Muhammad, hey Rai Markan!

brh: ادا را نگاہ کریو؟ ننے درشیر راہی کرین ننے خلوئے نی ارے بے رت ننے انتئے خلوئے؟ ننے تو نیکی کرین نی کہ خائف نی نی سن درشیر اسکا سر کرین نی ولا نی
en: Brother, look! Darsher sent us, and you are going to beat us? Hey you, why would you beat us? We did you a kindness ... Darsher ... we ... you ...
en_old: Brother, did you see? Our dervish sent us; you are going to beat us, you shameless one, why will you beat us? We did you a kindness... you...

brh: ننے خلیس ننا جان نا دشمن مسس۔ بائے ننے حکم کے ئے رسول اللہ پاران
en: You beat us; you became the enemy of our lives. Brother, give us your command, for the sake of the Messenger of God.
en_old: You beat us, you became the enemy of our lives. Brother, give us an order from the Messenger of God.

brh: بس بئے خیر واللہ نی امر ننا دست نی ہلی
en: Well then, fine, by God, as you wish; you have taken our hand.
en_old: Well, alright, by God, as you command, we are in your hands.

brh: دا سے پٹک نا جوڑ مریک۔ آئی راس پائے نن پیر صاحبہ کانے۔ ٹھیک ہی ئے تینٹ کاوا، نا وجہ آن کاوا۔
en: This turns into a threefold (three-layered) match. Mother is right, she says we should go to Pir Sahib. Fine, I'll go myself; I'll go for your sake.
en_old: This becomes a three-way match. Mother says, let's go to Pir Sahib. Fine, then go yourself, go for your own sake.

brh: اسلم ویتے نا گدے بینے، ئے ہی ہی ہی مائی دا گدے ہرفیسہ نی واران کاسہ، نیتو سما ئے ارا وختہ کہ تعویزے لکھیرہ تو لمہ نا پنی لکھیرہ باوہ نا تو لکھے پسہ
en: Aslam, put on your shawl... eh, hee hee hee. Lady, take this shawl and off you go. You know, don't you, that whenever they write an amulet they write the mother's name; they don't write the father's.
en_old: Aslam, look at the donkey... hey, hee hee hee, mother, you take this donkey and go off... you know, don't you, when they write an amulet they write the mother's name, they don't write the father's.

brh: آئی لمہ نا پنی لکھیرہ نا، لمہ نا شکلے طور پسہ نا، ولدا نا تجربہ طور بو، دا پاکے دا تجربہ ہرا کلک کینوس کہ لمہ نا پنی لکھیرہ باوہ نا پنی لکھپسہ، ہیں؟ ابا؟
en: Mother, they write the mother's name, right? They don't go by the mother's face, right? So go by your own experience: this experience you've had, that they write the mother's name and don't write the father's name, eh? Dad?
en_old: Mother, they write the mother's name, right? You don't go by the mother's looks, right? Then do an experiment: this experiment where they write the mother's name and not the father's name, huh? Dad?

brh: ایم نت واری چپ داڑے تینا آئی نا خیال کر دمف کے جنہ کرے او مسوس آئی گمف آئی ایو باوا تو تینا لچانی
en: ...keep quiet here; think of your own mother... he felt it... mother... mother and father, and then your own...
en_old: ...keep quiet here, think of your mother... she felt it... mother, father, then your own...

brh: باوہ تکینا داسہ آئی ہن گم باش کنا خن پر آئی نالائقہ شاگرد دانگ بر ہرک دے بسونے ہنک پیشن خیرات
en: Father... now. Mother, go, get lost... gladly (on my eyes), mother. You useless student, come over here! Every day he's come... go outside... charity.
en_old: Father, look now, mother, go... you're most welcome. Mother, the useless student, come here; every day you've come, go outside... charity.

brh: ماشاءاللہ استاد شیر خان بسنے بسم اللہ اللہ تنے واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ سبحان اللہ خزبہ سلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام وعلیکم السلام ابا بشے
en: Mashallah, Ustad Sher Khan has come! Bismillah, God has granted it... wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, Subhanallah... Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Wa alaikum assalam. Father, get up.
en_old: Mashallah, Ustad Sher Khan has come, Bismillah, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, Subhanallah... Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Wa alaikum assalam. Dad, get up.

brh: شیر خان اینو ہمر نن غریب آتا ہستوں کٹے معاف کیس استین آغا ہمر رد کریس سئی بس سائیں انت پا پا سائیں پا ہنت دے سائیں ہی تاک کے ہریر یا
en: Sher Khan, how is it that today you have pardoned us poor people...? ...Agha, how did you turn it down? Right, that's enough, sir. What? Say it, say it, sir, say it. What day, sir... they look...
en_old: Sher Khan, today how will you forgive us poor people... Agha, how did you turn it down... yes, just, sir, what, say it, say it sir, what day, sir...

brh: استاد کنے ہندن لگنگٹی ئے کہ مسٹ میکو براؤنا واریٹی سوچنگے شاہ ہاہاہاہاہا بالکل راست پاریس ئس کنے تو باس خائک ولے مکے او ارے یا آفت پیرونا لمے مکے او
en: Ustad, it seems to me that you're thinking about a third marriage, Shah. Hahahaha! You've said exactly right. I really do want it, but there's that... oh, what a calamity, Piru's mother...
en_old: Ustad, it seems to me you're thinking of a marriage like Brown's... hahahaha, you're absolutely right, I really like it, but I've got that trouble, Piru's mother...

brh: نی اسل فکر کپہ سائیں، ئے ہندنو تعویز ئس ایتیو کہ پیرو نا لمہ تینٹ نی کے اسہ جوانو چوک مسڑ ئس پٹوئی نی کے۔
en: Don't worry at all, sir. I'll give you such an amulet that Piru's mother herself will have to look for a nice young girl for you.
en_old: Don't worry at all, sir, I'll give you an amulet so strong that Piru's mother herself will find you a nice young girl.

brh: بخیر نی مسٹ ایلے فی الحال پیرو نا بندوبست کر۔ ہند مسنے سائیں پیرو ئے پیرو ئے پیرو ئے جناک درینو۔ ارے حرام خور۔
en: All right, drop your third [marriage] for now and make arrangements for Piru. It's happened, sir: Piru, Piru, Piru has been taken by the jinns. Hey, you scoundrel!
en_old: Fine, forget your marriage for now and take care of Piru. It's happened, sir, Piru, Piru, Piru, the women have taken him. Hey, you scoundrel!

brh: چاپ تو خلوئی افنے ببھو خان نندا بے زائیڑم سائیکل موٹرے بریک ہی
en: You don't have to clap... Babbu Khan... the motorcycle's brake...
en_old: He hasn't even had to slap him... Babu Khan, sit down... the motorcycle's brakes...

brh: ارے دادے خلقونے؟ نرے جان اتنا کشا خواہ مخواہ خون اسے ٹی پاسینگنے چلو۔ چلو۔
en: Hey, has he killed this guy? Run, save yourselves! We'll get caught up in a murder for nothing. Let's go. Let's go.
en_old: Hey, have you killed him? He's still alive, pull him out. We'll get caught up in a murder for nothing. Let's go. Let's go.

brh: قاسم دا دیر ہرا ظالم خلکو نی خبر اف ٹکری صیب! بر کانے ساہی خواہش وی نا گڑا دا نا معلومات ئے کین دا دیر خلکو نی تا
en: Qasim, who did this, which cruel person killed him? You don't know, Takri Sahib! Come, let's go... let's find out about this, who killed him.
en_old: Qasim, which cruel person killed him? You don't know, Takri Sahib! Come, let's go, we'll find out about this, who killed him...

brh: دا علم کنا دے خلق نی داری بٹینو
en: This brother of mine, who killed him? He's been dumped here.
en_old: ...you killed my... and brought him here.

brh: کنا ایلم ئے دے خلکو نی داڑے بتینو دون ظلم کنو ئے توتے کنا ایلم ئے دے خلکو نی بتینو تا دون ظلم کنو ئے توتے کنا ایلم ئے دے خلکو نی داڑے دون ظلم کنے ئے توتے
en: Who killed my brother and dumped him here? Who would do such cruelty? Who killed my brother and dumped him? Who would do such cruelty? Who killed my brother here? Who would do such cruelty?
en_old: You killed my brother and brought him here, you've done such cruelty to me. You killed my brother and brought him here, you've done such cruelty to me. You killed my brother here, you've done such cruelty to me.

brh: ہیلو ٹکری صاحب انت حال ہی خوش آتے خیریت ہی ٹائٹ جی
en: Hello, Takri Sahib, how are you? Are you well? Is everything all right? All fine, sir.
en_old: Hello Takri Sahib, how are you? All well, everything's fine, all good, sir.

brh: آن اینت پاننگ اٹی ئس ٹھیک ئے باکو نی خوار فیرہ، کل مخلوق اوار کینہ خوار فیرہ، ہر اینا تے بے خلقونے دادے، کسس نہ کسس تو ہرو دادے، پرواہ کپہ نی، ٹھیک ئے خدا حافظ۔
en: Huh, what are you saying? All right... we'll summon [people]; we'll gather all the people together and summon them. Whoever has killed him, someone or other will have seen it. Don't you worry. Okay, goodbye.
en_old: What are you saying? Fine, uncle, you'll pay for this. We'll gather all the people, you'll pay for this. Whoever killed him, someone or other must have seen it. Don't you worry. Okay, goodbye.

brh: واہ چکرے ننے است کے خوار فینے۔ ننے انت خبرے مارو۔
en: Wow, what a twist, they're going to summon us. What would we know about it?
en_old: Wow, what a trick, we forgot all about it and now we're ruined. What do we know? Let's go.

brh: ابا ہمو دے ہمو لغوری خلکو دا ہمو نی چرخا کرے۔ ابا کڑا ٹکری ئے انت سما کے نن خلکو ننتہ۔ شیر دل نی قرارا ہتکہ۔ ہاؤ کاکو ہاؤ۔ ارے نی کڈے ڈغار پارے۔ ہاؤ۔
en: Dad, that day it was that coward who killed him; that's what's got you spinning. Dad, so how would Takri know that we killed him? Sher Dil, calm down. Yes, uncle, yes. Hey, you said a hole in the ground. Yes.
en_old: Dad, that day that Laghori killed him, he had you spinning in circles. Dad, how would Takri know that we killed him? Sher Dil, stay calm. Yes, uncle, yes. Hey, you said... the ground. Yes.

brh: ئے بارنے بس کبو بس کبو ہنت مس نمے خدا خلے نمے لاغک توربو
en: Hey... stop it, stop it! What happened? May God strike you, may your... [curse]!
en_old: Hey, enough, stop it, stop it, what happened? May God strike you, may your belly burst!

brh: دا کلے نا فون کریس گڑاتے بندہ آتے کلے خواہفے کل برادری خواہفینو نرے فی انت و دے خلکو نی ہم پدی۔ بابا اینو مئے نا خاطرا خواہفٹ کہ جمعہ نا ایلم ئے خلکو نو کسرہ بٹینو تا
en: Did you phone all of them? Then call all the people; the whole community has been summoned... and who killed him... you too, afterwards. Baba, today I have called you here for this reason: someone has killed Juma's brother and dumped him on the road.
en_old: Phone everyone in the village, call the people of the village, invite the whole community... and the day has been set, you come back too. Baba, today I have called you here so that after Friday prayers we can settle the way forward.

brh: علاقہ نا بندغاتو ہنادو کس نہ کستو خنانے تہ ہر کس خنانے تہ کنے پاپ ٹکری صیب ننے خبر اف ٹکری صیب ننے ہم کس خنتنے تہ ٹکری صیب ٹکری صیب پیش نہ برو آئی کس پاو نی ابا تو
en: Among the people of the area, someone or other must have seen him; whoever has seen him, tell me. Takri Sahib, we don't know. Takri Sahib, none of us has seen him either. Takri Sahib, Takri Sahib, nobody will come forward... someone say it, you, father...
en_old: Nobody among the people of the area saw anyone. Whoever saw something, tell me. Takri sahib, we don't know anything. Takri sahib, we didn't see anyone either. Takri sahib, Takri sahib won't come forward... someone say it, father.

brh: دا سنگت بسنو ئے فیصلہ ئس کرینٹ ابا ضروری کاری مسے گوری مرے چاوا ضرور دادے معلوم وڈا سرے راری ما
en: These friends have come, and I have made a decision. Father, it's an urgent matter; it must be... I will certainly find this out... [unclear].
en_old: This friend came, and a decision has been made. Father, it's an important matter. It has to be done; we must find this out for certain...

brh: بابا انت سے
en: Baba, what is it?
en_old: Baba, what is it?

brh: صاحب انت ہیت اسے؟ ڈگری داسہ اونا است آن ہنا۔ خدا خیر کے کنے فیصل آن بش کرے مس داسہ اونا است آن ہنا۔
en: Sahib, what's the matter? Takri has now put it out of his mind. May God keep us safe. He has dismissed me from the decision; now it has gone out of his mind.
en_old: Sahib, what's the matter? Takri has lost heart now. May God keep us safe. He has freed me from the decision; now he has lost heart.

brh: رائے با کان گم مت
en: Baba has lost his judgment.
en_old: Rai went missing from Baba.

brh: ٹکری صاحب دان پارے؟ ابا کنے ہچ پاتنے۔ ہمر ہچ پاتمنے۔ دا فیصلہ آن بش کرے درینے ہرا گڑا گڑا ستو پارونے۔ دا ہستے ہلن خدا
en: What did Takri Sahib say? Father, he didn't tell me anything. How come he told you nothing? He has dismissed me from this decision and taken it away; whatever things he has said... this... God.
en_old: What did Takri sahib say? Father, he told me nothing. How did he tell you nothing? He has freed me from this decision... whatever he said... God, take this...

brh: دا خلکونے گری صاحب کنا مار کوئی تے ہدایت کر تھین فتح جنگ کیرا تباہی دا فتا فیصلہ کنے کپرا دا ہردے جنگ کیرا چکری بابا دا فیصلہ کنے گھروئی مرے اڑا نی انت سے نا ٹھیکری یس
en: This one has killed him. Takri Sahib, give instructions to my sons... they'll fight, there'll be ruin. I won't make this decision of theirs; they fight every day. Takri Baba, I'm the one who has to make this decision. Hey, what kind of Takri are you?
en_old: Takri sahib has called. Instruct my son... victory... war brings destruction. This decision of theirs... they will fight. Chakri baba, this decision has to be made by me. What is it to you, Takri?

brh: نہ ماتے مشانی ڈکرے ٹھکری پاسہ بس ٹھکری بس ببا اینتے بس الے ببا نئے
en: No... you say 'Takri'? Enough, Takri, enough. Baba, why? Enough, leave it, Baba, no.
en_old: No, mother... you say Takri, enough Takri, enough, Baba, why... enough, leave it, Baba.

brh: دا دے سبق استے وا، بس بس بس، تکھین استے وا، اینے استے وا، دم ہلی تا تکھے، ہا تکھے ہلی دم، بس بس بس، شاباش شاباش، بچا دا بچا، بچا نی، ہنا بچا، فیصلہ ایبنا گونو، گپ کن
en: Today, one lesson, okay; enough, enough, enough. Let's put it once, once today; take a breath and put it, yes, put it, take a breath; enough, enough, enough; well done, well done; kid, this kid, you kid, go, kid... the decision...; talk.
en_old: Today, one lesson, enough, enough, enough; jump once, once today; let the tail jump, yes, jump, the tail; enough, enough, enough; well done, well done; boy, this boy, you boy, my boy, the decision... talk.

brh: زوراورو او حقیقت کے ارے کنا موناٹ دادے کنا موناٹ ہت مطلب بس خواجہ کنے اجازت ایتیبو دون اف کے جناک انداڑے سرمسور دا جناک داڑے امر سرمسور او کہ سما اف کے دا کنا علاقہ ئے کنا اجازت آن بغیر
en: They are powerful. Whatever the truth is, before me — bring it before me. I mean, just, Khwaja, give me permission. Isn't it so that the jinns have arrived here? How did these jinns get here? Don't they know that this is my territory — without my permission?
en_old: He's powerful, and the truth is right in front of me, bring it before me. I mean, sir, give me permission. Isn't it true that the jinns have come here? How did these jinns get here? Don't they know this is my territory, without my permission?

brh: داڑے امر بریرے؟ میر صاحب کنے معاف کربو۔ ئے درخت ء خننگا ئس جنگل والا ہمو بلا درخت۔ ہموڑے کچہ جن آک ہموڑے کو۔ دا انسان آتا ہیت اف، دا جن آتا ہیت ء۔ معافی نا گنجائش اف۔ مونی تم۔ نی بلو ئس نی میر ئس نی دا شار نا۔۔۔
en: How do you come here? Mir Sahib, forgive me. I saw that tree — the one in the jungle, that big tree. There, some jinns — they are there. This is not a matter of humans, this is a matter of jinns. There is no room for forgiveness. Step forward. You are a big man, you are a Mir, you are of this town...
en_old: How did you get here? Mir sahib, forgive me. I saw the tree, the one in the jungle, that big tree. There were some jinns there. This isn't about humans, this is about jinns. There's no room for forgiveness. Go ahead. You're a great man, you're the Mir of this town...

brh: او اللہ نی مونت آ، نئینہ مونت آ، مونت آ، داسہ اینو اینا راہی
en: O God, you go in front — you go in front, in front. Now, today, (we are) setting off on the way.
en_old: O God, you go ahead, you go ahead, ahead; today, now, set off on the road.

brh: چپ مروک، چپ مروک، دا پیناو نا نشاناک، جند نا نشاناک منی کیر
en: Be quiet, be quiet! These are someone else's marks — a jinn's marks ...
en_old: Quiet, quiet. These are someone else's marks, the jinn's own marks, believe me.

brh: چٹ اسے نا چٹ اسے نا مسلمان آک کسرے کسرے بابو زو کبو زو کبو اللہ کنا کمک کبو زو بابو شیر خان خیر اوغنگو
en: ... O Muslims, make way, make way! Babu, hurry, hurry! For God's sake, help me! Quick, Babu! Sher Khan, is everything all right? Are you crying?
en_old: Just a moment, just a moment, Muslims, make way, make way! Father, hurry, hurry! God, help me! Hurry, father! Sher Khan, are you all right? Don't cry.

brh: دا چشٹ او؟ دا نشان تے ہور، دا نشان تے پلہ پلہ ہور۔ ئے پیرو نا چواٹاکو، جنک درینو تا۔ ئے داسہ پیرو نا لمہ ین پاروٹ کہ پیرو ارانگ ہنانے؟ میر صاحب!
en: What is this? Look at these marks — look at these marks on every side. These are Piro's sandals; the jinns have taken her. Now what shall I tell Piro's mother — where has Piro gone? Mir Sahib!
en_old: What is this? Look at these marks, look at these marks on every side. These are Piro's shoes, the girl's... Now what will I tell Piro's mother, where has Piro gone? Mir sahib!

brh: خدا نا پنی خدا نا پنی گڑاس کرک گڑاس کرک۔ ننا ئے دا خلق نا بلوچ جناتا میر رفٹی ایم پارے۔ مصاحب نی پاتاوٹ کے داڑے جنات کو نی کنا ہیتا تو یقین بتو۔ امیر کنا خیال ئے کہ اورے مننگٹی ئے
en: For God's sake, for God's sake, do something, do something! The Mir of the Baloch jinns of this village has taken ours away. Sahib, didn't I tell you that there are jinns here? You didn't believe my words. Mir, I think she is over there.
en_old: For God's sake, for God's sake, do something, do something. The Mir of the Baloch jinns of this land took ours away. Sahib, I told you there were jinns here, but you didn't believe me. Mir, I think they're over there.

brh: کامبو کامبو کامبو کشتے نی نہ نہ نہ نہ نہ خدا نا پناٹے دا کنا سنگت ئے دا زمر کنے تنیا ئے لنک ئے گاک کامبو کامبو کڑاس کامبو میر صاحب نہ نہ شیر خان نی تو سما افنے ئے دا خلک نا میر او
en: Let's go, let's go, let's go! You... no, no, no, no, no! For God's sake, this is my friend. This ... me alone ... Let's go, let's go, ... let's go. Mir Sahib, no, no. Sher Khan, don't you know? He is the Mir of this village.
en_old: Grab it, grab it, grab it, kill it! No, no, no, no, no, for God's sake, this is my friend. This snake... it bit me when I was alone... Grab it, grab it, do something, grab it! Mir sahib, no, no, Sher Khan, don't you know, he is the Mir of this land.

brh: جناتا میرا فٹ نن کانہ کامبو کامبو نہ نہ نہ نہ ویڈو نیل پرے نی نی دا کاریم کرو تم کنا خاطر سنگتی نا خاطر نا میر صاحب شیر خان دا ہم منت کننگاٹی این
en: We will go to the Mir of the jinns. Let's go, let's go. No, no, no, no ... You, you do this job — for my sake, for the sake of friendship, Mir Sahib. Sher Khan, I am begging you for this too.
en_old: The jinn… Mir… at night, don't, don't, no, no, no, no… You, do this job for my sake, for friendship's sake, Mir Sahib Sher Khan. I'm begging you too.

brh: نی کنے پاتوسے اخس ہند مسونے، اگہ نی پاریٹ نا تو نی ہم کنے مار گنوک گنوک مروس، ارا بندغ
en: You didn't tell me how many places this has happened. If I had told you, then you too, my son, would have gone mad — mad. Which man?
en_old: You never told me how many places you had been. If you had told me, you would have been... crazy, crazy man.

brh: کنے تو زندگی گدریفینے نیمہ غنوک تو ئے ہن مریٹ نی کنے دا پاپ پیرو نردٹ نی نس پیرو ہراڑے ابا ایلوم ہراڑے کڈٹ کا ایلوم نا ننے تینا الکونی ایلوم نا الکونی اودے دے مون تے سوٹ پیرو نردٹ نی کنے دا پاپ ایسے پیرو ہراڑے
en: As for me, my life has passed (like this), half-mad — how could I be like this? You did this sin to me ... Piro ... Where is Piro? Father, where is (my) brother? ... our own ... brother's ... Piro ... You brought this sin upon me. Where is Piro?
en_old: I've spent my life half asleep, how could this happen? You've put this sin on me. Piro ran away. Where did you take Piro? Where is father, where is brother? Our brother, his brother... Piro ran away. You put this sin on me. Where is Piro?

brh: پیروئی جنک دریر درخت نا کیرغان شواٹک تسرت جنتا ہلوکا انت پاسہ راس پاوا پیروئی جنک
en: The jinns took Piro — from beneath the tree ... seized by the jinns. — What are you saying? — I'm telling the truth: the jinns (took) Piro.
en_old: Peeru's girl, she came down from under the tree… the jinn took her. What are you saying? Tell the truth, Peeru's girl.

brh: گل بے بے گل بے بے گلو اما آئی اٹ مس نا آئی یچ متنے ننے
en: Gul Bibi, Gul Bibi, Gulo, mother — Mother, what happened to you? Mother, nothing has happened to us.
en_old: Gul Bibi, Gul Bibi, Gul… Mother, what happened to you? Nothing has happened to us.

brh: اللہ مہربان مس۔ ابا ئے بنگو نٹ۔ تسے کن ایرا بازی ایرا کونین۔ آئی بش کیوے؟ ننا ننا ننا آئی تینا بش کے پیس۔ آئی نمچے آرام کننگے چے۔ بے وس۔
en: God has been merciful. Father, I have heard. ... let's eat some food (?) ... Mother, shall I help you up? Our... our... our... Mother, get yourself up ... Mother, rest a little. Poor helpless thing.
en_old: God has been merciful. Father… for what… Mother, will you get up? Our… Mother, get yourself up. Mother, let us rest. Helpless.

brh: خدو نا سے خاشتہ نی نا ایلے تارام کے۔ الا ایلم۔ ایلم نا گڈ جینگ دارین ونا تو پدی واپس کرور تا۔ دونو گڈا سب کے او تن تن تے خرتا موڑے برے کو۔ کنے کنے رخ کنے۔
en: For God's sake, you ... calm down. No, brother. Brother's ... then they will bring her back again. After that everyone ... their own ... come there. Me, me ... me.
en_old: By God… you calm down. No, brother. Brother's… then he'll bring it back. Then everyone… their own… come here. Me, me…

brh: سلام صاب، نم اسل فکر کپبو، ایدو نی کہ نما مال انشاءاللہ منا دیٹ نمے اسہ مریک۔ جی او، اسلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم
en: Salam Sahib, don't worry at all; your goods, God willing, will reach you in the coming day. — Yes, okay. Assalamu alaikum. — Wa alaikum.
en_old: Hello sir, don't worry at all; God willing, your goods will reach you within the day. Yes, okay, hello. Hello.

brh: وعلیکم السلام، جوان صاحب، عصمت صاحب، تو دا دے سلام صاحب کہ نما مال خیر ئے انشاءاللہ منادے شونما سر مریک، بلکہ نم دن کبو کہ پین وخت ئس ننا آرڈرس مس، نمے بننگ نا ہچ ضرورت ئس اف، اینو پگاہ میٹنگ
en: Wa alaikum assalam, good sir, Ismat Sahib. So it's like this, Salam Sahib: your goods are fine, and God willing they will reach you in the coming day. In fact, do this: next time we have an order, there is no need at all for you to come. These days, meetings...
en_old: Wa alaikum salam, good sir, Mr. Ismat. Today, sir, God willing, your goods will reach you tomorrow. Actually, do this: next time we have orders, there's no need for you to come. These days, meetings…

brh: میڈیا نا دور ئے انٹرنیٹ نا دور ئے فیکس کبو ننے، نن ہم مال رئی کین۔ اسیتس پابو کہ دا پیمنٹ ہمور کروئی مریک ننے۔ جمال صاحب، نم کرے تینا پیمنٹ نا چیک نا درو تو؟ ٹھیک ئے ہو
en: It's the age of media, the age of the internet — fax us, and we'll send the goods too. Tell us one thing: how should we make this payment? Jamal Sahib, did you send the cheque for your payment yesterday? — It's fine, yes.
en_old: It's the age of media, the age of the internet. Fax us and we'll send the goods too. Tell me how we should make this payment. Mr. Jamal, did you send the cheque for your payment? Okay, yes.

brh: سب اسیتس، باو نی کہ نن نومیان کے وی مال دننگون، اونا خاص وجہ داد ئے کہ نوما مال نا کوالٹی باز جوان ئے منتوار منتوار سلام صیب، ہندا توئی تے کہ ننا مال نا کوالٹی باز جوان ئے ہندا خا
en: First, one thing: let me tell you why we are taking goods from you — the main reason for it is that the quality of your goods is very good. — Thank you, thank you, Salam Sahib. That's exactly it: the quality of our goods is very good; for that very...
en_old: First of all, let me tell you why we're buying goods from you. The main reason is that the quality of your goods is very good. Thank you, thank you, sir. That's exactly it, the quality of our goods is very good…

brh: خاطر چندی بندغ آتنے آرڈر تسنو۔ او انشاء اللہ باز زود دا مارکیٹ نا جوان و پینس جوڑ کوا۔ او کنے یاد بس کنا اسے سنگت ئس ارے او ہم دا کاروبار ء کیک۔ ولدا او اودے ہم کنا نمبر ء آتے وا انشاء اللہ او نم تون کنٹیکٹ کیک۔
en: ...reason, several people have given (us) orders. And God willing, very soon (we) will make a good name in this market. And I remembered: I have a friend, he also does this business. Then I'll give him my number too, and God willing he will contact you.
en_old: That's why we've given orders to several people. And God willing, it will very soon become good and… in this market. And I remembered that I have a friend who's in this business too. I'll give him my number as well, and God willing he'll contact you.

brh: بس جمال صاحب نا نمبر ء تما بس اوفتے انتظار مروئی ننے یوکون ئے اڑنگا
en: Just ... Jamal Sahib's number ... we'll just have to wait for them ... it has got stuck.
en_old: Just give Mr. Jamal's number, and then we'll have to wait for them…

brh: لمہ نا ارغ تفک نی ابا نا ورا مرجانوں نی کے چولے او برنج بسینے ازو کن زو کن
en: Your mother's food won't do for you (?) — you're like your father ... Chickpeas and rice have come for you — eat quickly, eat quickly!
en_old: You don't eat your mother's food, you're just like your father… clothes and rice have come, quickly, quickly.

brh: سما کرے سو؟ ناں خیالے ئے کس کسوٹ؟ ناں اوستاکے مرے، تو کنے دنیا غان ارفیفیس، شاباش انومے، ئے
en: Did you get it? Do you think I'll die? If it were up to your heart, you'd lift me out of the world. Well done...
en_old: Did you understand? No, whose idea was it? No, if you were my beloved, you'd lift me out of the world (?). Well done…

brh: ایڑے کیرے پیرو جناتہ قبضہ ٹی ئے نیم داڑے خوشی اٹ ایراغ کننگاٹیورے پڈ تے نا پر کننگاٹیورے ہا نیم تے کے بائے شیڑ کرینوس مخنگاٹیوس ئے تو پارے
en: What are you doing there? Piro is in the jinns' clutches, and here you are happily eating, filling your bellies. Yes, you have shared it out among yourselves and you are laughing — that's what (s)he said.
en_old: Look, Peeru is in the jinn's possession, and here you are happily eating and filling your bellies. Yes, I've shared it with you… he said.

brh: نی کنا کنڈا مروس، نی تینا باوہ نا کنڈا الکنس توسوس۔ بلو، نی ہمو چک کن۔ نیش کمبو داتیان، نیش کمبو۔ نہ مار نا پرواہ نی نہ کنا پرواہ۔
en: You were supposed to be on my side, but you took your father's side and sat there. Go on, you eat that chicken. Eat from these, eat. You care neither for (your) son nor for me.
en_old: You were supposed to be on my side, but you took your father's side. Go on, you do that. Don't make a fuss about it, don't make a fuss (?). You don't care about your son and you don't care about me.

brh: ئے بے ہوش مسٹ، دا زوزو بسٹ، دو کلہ کیکن ننگٹ یو، خیرات کیو نمے، بس ککے، بلڈ پریشر تا باز ہائی مسنے
en: I fainted — I came here in a hurry ... I will give alms for you. Just ... the blood pressure has gone very high.
en_old: I fainted, so I came here quickly… I'll give alms for you. My blood pressure has gone very high.

brh: مچ کر ابے، کان سوکا سوکا، کان کے، پین غزا سکا، پش
en: Gather it up, father. Eat it dry, dry — eat it. Other food ...
en_old: Gather it up, father, eat it dry, eat it, other food… push (?).

brh: ہاں ہنداسے
en: Yes, that's the one — just like that.
en_old: Yes, that's it.

brh: کنا مطلب دادے اگہ نن پیر صاحب آن معلوم کین کہ پیرو اراڑے؟ انتئے؟ مگر پیر ڈویژن نا جمعدار اسے ننے پائے کہ پیرو اراڑے؟ جنات اتون معلوم کننگے؟ بس بس بس بس! اگر جنات تے سما تمانے تو مئے تو نوار!
en: What I mean is, what if we ask Pir Sahib where Piro is? — Why? — But would the Pir, a jamadar of a division, tell us where Piro is? (By) asking the jinns? Enough, enough, enough, enough! If the jinns get wind of it, then — no way!
en_old: I mean, what if we ask Pir Sahib where Peeru is? Why? But a jamadar from the Pir division told us where Peeru is? Ask the jinn? Enough, enough, enough! If the jinn knew, wouldn't they tell us?

brh: کنا مہر مفرور ئے ننہ دنو عید کپہ کنا اوست اسل چناک مسنے ئے ہی ہی ہی ہی دا وختی امر اوست نا چناک مریک ارا وختی کنے غا خنتے تنے نشانی تسنے تو اوست نا شیر مریک شیر
en: My beloved has run away; we won't celebrate Eid like this. My heart has become really small. Hee hee hee hee. How can the heart become small at a time like this? When (someone) gives me a sign with the eyes, the heart becomes a lion — a lion.
en_old: My love has run away, we won't celebrate Eid like this. My heart has become so small. Hee hee hee. How does the heart become small at a time like this? When someone gives me a sign, the heart becomes a lion, a lion.

brh: ایڈنی بیغم مرگ، ایدے کن کے الے، ئے رٹ نا جگہ چار گواہ توٹ، خدا نا قسم ئے مسیتا منور قسم کنور کے نن تینا خنتیٹی خنانون ت اللہ معاف کے کنے او ایڑے
en: Don't worry about that, leave that to me: instead of two witnesses I'll bring four. By God, they will swear in the mosque that we saw it with our own eyes. May God forgive me, sister.
en_old: Such a carefree death... for that, instead of ... I would bring four witnesses. I swear by God, we would swear in the mosque that we saw it with our own eyes. May God forgive me, that sister...

brh: کنا زند نا تمن تو مودی ہمروئے ہرادے کسے پاولس تینا ڈغارا تینا فصلاتے سیخاٹی تولف مروئی
en: The wish of my life is just this: that a person be settled on his own land, in the shade of his own crops.
en_old: The wish of my life is to be like the one who, as someone says, plants his crops in rows on his own land.

brh: کنا زند نا ہتم تونیس، براتم نی بفیسہ، تو خن تے سیخا کم، خاخرہ موشیرہ، ئے تینا خوشی تے، تینا خرینکا تے، کل آ مستی تے
en: You are the spring of my life. Brother, if you don't come, I'll keep my eyes in shadow, and fires will burn my joys, my tears, all my merriment.
en_old: At the end of my life, brother, when you come, I will close my eyes. Fires will burn... my joys, my tears, all my happiness.

brh: نیکن منتظر مروئی ارے خبرے کنے ئے جوان چاوہ اگر دا خڑینک آک دا خوشیک مٹور ہا
en: I'll have to wait for you. Oh, I know, I know full well, if only these tears would turn into these joys, yes.
en_old: Someone will be waiting for you. I know well whether these tears would turn into these joys.

brh: گڑا دا وخت آ ئے دا ریک تا پٹا تا نیامٹ نیتو نا وار سلوک مٹوٹا
en: Then, at this time, I would be standing together with you in the middle of these sandy plains.
en_old: Then at this time your turn would have stood between these sands.

brh: اندازے نی یاہو۔ اللہ معاف کے اندازے چوکھی ورا۔ خیر نامہ دست ورا۔ بچو نہ کنے سنگت۔
en: You ... guess. May God forgive me, the guess was off. Anyway, the letter came to hand. Don't run away from me, friend.
en_old: You guess... May God forgive me, the guess went too far. Anyway, the letter came into my hands. Don't run from me, friend.

brh: حسن نبی حیدر دا سدی چماسٹری کننگے ادا ہرا ہرا
en: Hasan Nabi Haider is doing this ... chemistry here, which, which...
en_old: Hassan Nabi Haider is doing this chemistry here, which, which...

brh: تاتی او تاتی گل بے بے دا سخت آ تاتی ہم کاریم کننگٹی ئے بابو خیر اٹ میر صاحب اللہ تنے نمے تول خیر اٹ تاتی
en: Auntie, oh Auntie Gul Bibi, even in these hard times auntie is still at work. — I'm well, Babu. Mir Sahib, may God keep you all well. — Are you well, auntie?
en_old: Auntie, oh auntie Gul Bibi, even in these hard times auntie is working too... Babu is well. Mir Sahib, may God keep you well, auntie.

brh: دانت مرزا، انتئے تکلیف کرے رے تنے؟ او چاچی بختاور! دا تے تکلیف نا انتیس اسے۔ اللہ معاف کے، پیر نا ہوس کشا دا ہولم نا گومی ئے
en: What's this, Mirza, why did you trouble yourself? — Oh, Aunt Bakhtawar! What trouble is there in this? May God forgive me, it was the old man's craving that brought out this ...
en_old: What is it, Mirza, why did you trouble yourself? Oh, aunt Bakhtawar! What trouble is this for them? May God forgive me, the old man's longing drew this... of the neighborhood.

brh: دا تے پیرو راس بائیک ننان گڑاس حق جوڑ مرے کہ داورا کن گڑاس کین دا تے ئے تو تنے داورانا بتی خیال کیوے او نی دا داورا والاتا مرضی
en: Old man, these are true brothers; we owe them something, so let's do something for them. As for these, I'll look after them myself, and you go by these people's wishes.
en_old: Old man, these brothers have earned some right over us, so for them... you think about them, and you are at the mercy of these people.

brh: امیر صاحب نی دا ویرانہ نا نہ بلکہ دا موچا خلق نا بلا ئس داتی نی دا ہستنے ننا خڑک خیسے گڑا گڑا نم نم تے
en: Amir Sahib, you are a menace not only to this wilderness but to this whole village. You've brought this right up close to us, so then, you, you...
en_old: Amir Sahib, you are not just a curse on this wilderness but on this whole village. You brought this here near us, then you...

brh: ئے ہمو مرخ آ کیٹ۔ اب نور صاحب تولبونوم کے چائے نا پیالہ ئس کیٹ۔ تاتی برے نی تولے نی اراغ نام کونے نی چائے نام کونے نی ولدا آسانی ئے وختہ کے کہ کس
en: I'll see to that chicken. Now, Noor Sahib, you sit down, so I can make a cup of tea. Auntie, come, sit down, have some food, have some tea, then at your ease, whenever someone...
en_old: Put it on that chicken. Now, Noor Sahib, sit down, I'll make a cup of tea. Auntie, come sit. Eat some food, drink some tea, and then take it easy when someone...

brh: کس اولیکو وار کس سینا وراغہ برے ہند پارتے ہند پارتے اللہ ما کے پائے وازی پارتے او پیو پاننگاٹی
en: When someone comes to someone's meal for the first time, he says this and that, says this and that... God... he says it in jest, and the old man is saying...
en_old: Someone came to someone's house for the first time and said such things... may God... said it playfully, and the old man while saying it...

brh: ایرو نا پارے نی پارنگٹ ایوٹ بنیسہ یا نہ نی پا با نی پا با
en: ... did he say? You were saying, will you come or not? You tell me, father, you tell me, father.
en_old: Did you say today that you will come or not? Say it, father, say it, father.

brh: ہلمس ہلمس ادو توپس لگانے توپ لگے نا ضعیفہ شہر والا دا خستہ ورکے ونی بمپیسے
en: Quick, quick! A cannon has been fired over there, the cannon has fired, old woman! The city boy ... tired ... don't you hear?
en_old: Let go, let go. Cannons are fired there, the cannon hit. The old woman from the city is tired... can't you hear?

brh: ننے کنے تپا دا دے نیمروچ آ نی دنو توغے خناسا او نیک بخت کس ننے توغے خنتوٹا شہر والا ماتا توغے خننگٹی اسوٹا کہ شہرٹی او ہائے کنا شہر والا ماک
en: Tell me, did you have such a dream today at noon? — O fortunate one, I wasn't dreaming of anyone; I was dreaming of my boys in the city, that in the city... oh, my boys in the city!
en_old: Tell me, did you see such a dream at noon today? That blessed one... someone saw us in a dream. I was dreaming of my mother in the city, that she was in the city. Oh, my mother in the city!

brh: داسے تو افسر جوڑ مرو۔ ئے ہی ہی ہی شہر والا مکھ افسر جوڑ مرو۔ ہندو کڈنی ہندو نمک۔ اللہ دے۔
en: Now he will become an officer. Hee hee hee, our city boy will become an officer. That's how it is, that's one's lot in life; God gives.
en_old: Now he will become an officer. Hee hee hee, the one from the city will become an officer. Just like that... God gives.

brh: دا تینا خیراتینگا پیرو انتئے پاپیسہ؟ اللہ صدقہ مریو تینا پیرو جان کے، او تو لکھ آٹی اسٹے، کروڑ آٹی اسٹ مرے نی ابا بخشے!
en: Why don't you mention this generous old man of yours? May I be a sacrifice for my dear old man; he is one in a hundred thousand, may he be one in ten million! May God forgive your father!
en_old: Why do you say this to your kind old man? May I be sacrificed for my dear old man! He is one in a hundred thousand, one in ten million. May father forgive you!

brh: ولے دا واقعی پیروارا دے ہمو توئی فانی مٹی ٹی نا سودا لنکے دست کمبتنے نی چادرے شا کھاچ پرواہ افنے مار ئنا
en: But truly this is an old man's ... that obsession with this mortal soil ... hand ... You throw your shawl over yourself and sleep; you don't care about the son.
en_old: But this is truly an old man's day, in that mortal soil... you don't care about the shawl, you don't care about the son.

brh: تینا ہمرو کچک اسے سسون دو تیراونا دا کل نا سستی
en: It's that dog of yours ... this is all your laziness.
en_old: That dog of yours... hold it... all of this is because of your laziness.

brh: دا کنا سستی مرے یا نا سستی مرے ولے؟ ایرا غاتو کچک درے نا۔ ولے دا شوم بس دراکا۔ نی دروازہ ء ملکوک الاسس۔ اوہ۔ دا سے گڑان کین۔ دا ہن کین۔ کانے پین نت مت ئس بیگہ شام نا بندوبست ء کین۔ اوہ کانے کانے۔
en: Is it my laziness or your laziness, then? The dog made off with your bread. But this wretch came and carried it off. You had left the door open. Oh. Now let's do something. Let's do it this way. Let's go and arrange something else for the evening. Oh, let's go, let's go.
en_old: Is this my laziness or your laziness? ... But now evening has come. You left the door half open. Oh. I'll do these things. I'll go like this. I'll go and make some arrangements for the evening. Oh, go, go.

brh: برک دانکا
en: Come over here.
en_old: Come over here.

brh: ارے مٹل مٹل خیرے خیرے انمس بندغ کے مورے کک نی پدی چکالے
en: Hey Mittal, Mittal, is everything all right? Is everything all right? What happened, man, that you've turned back?
en_old: Hey Mittal, Mittal, is everything all right? What happened, man? Pull back!

brh: ئے ہموڑے جناکو ئے مچیٹ جن اٹ
en: Hey, there are jinns over there! There's a jinn in the date palm!
en_old: Hey, there are jinns over there, jinns in the date palms.

brh: ہا چاچا نا
en: Yes, uncle's...
en_old: Yes, uncle's...

brh: شیرخانی یا اگہ نی شیر خا مسس
en: Sher Khani... or if you had become a Sher Khan...
en_old: Sher Khani, or if you had become Sher Khan...

brh: مسوسہ تو دا وخت اٹی خلق اٹی نہ بلکہ شار اٹی مسوسہ تینا اولاد اٹی دروم مسوسہ ولے دا وخت ئے کاو کے ہرا کاریم ٹی کنے دا گل بے بے مونی تسوسس دون معاف کے
en: ...you would have been; then at this time you would be not in the village but in the city, you would be among your own children. But this time let me go, since Gul Bibi has put me forward for this job, so forgive me.
en_old: If it had happened, then at that time it would have happened not among the people but in the town, among your own children. But forgive me this time; in the work Gul Bibi put me forward for, forgive me like this.

brh: اللہ خیر کے، کاو دنینو ئے ولے دا گنجینہ کسر ئس کسر ئس دن دن پیکا دن کاو او
en: God grant it goes well. Let me go, it's like this, but this ... a road, a road, like this, like this ... so let me go, oh.
en_old: God help us, uncle, it's like this, but this is a strange path, a path, like this, like this, uncle.

brh: ارے ارے! ارے مٹل خان انت مس؟ کچکاک رندٹ تمانو کہ دن نرنگٹی ئس بختاور؟ نہ نہ خواجہ، کچکاک رندٹ کتو۔
en: Hey, hey! Hey Mittal Khan, what happened? Are dogs after you, that you're running like this, Bakhtawar? — No, no, sir, it's not dogs after me.
en_old: Hey, hey! Hey Mittal Khan, what happened? Were dogs chasing you that you're running like this, Bakhtawar? No, no, sir, no dogs chased me.

brh: تمتانو جنات غنڈاٹ کل تمتانو جنات خلیسوس نا جناتا پینا ہائے خلیوہ ئے بندغتیا خلیفیرہ نی کنے جناتیا خلیفیسہ او میر صاحب اینو پگا نا انساناک جناتیان زیات او
en: It's jinns after me, a whole gang of them, all of them after me! — Jinns? You got scared, eh? I'm afraid of the very name of jinns; they frighten people, and you're frightening me with jinns? — Oh Mir Sahib, the people of today are worse than jinns.
en_old: The jinns are scared, all scared. I'm afraid of the very name of jinns; they frighten people, and you're frightening me with jinns? O Mir sahib, today's humans are worse than the jinns.

brh: نی پا کہ نی کنا رشتہ ئے ہنپا او تینٹ اونا بارواٹ پا بس اینجو ہم مس کہ نی تینٹ کناس دنت او پاننگ کتویس و بس نی کناس بس نن نی آن ہم درخواست کینہ کہ نی کنا رشتہ آن نن کے مرتے چلو ٹھیک ہی اینا رشتہ نا مسئلہ انشاءاللہ حل کیک
en: You tell them that you ... my proposal, and talk about her yourself. It just so happened that you yourself didn't take my ... and couldn't say it, and just you ... mine. We too request of you that you ... my proposal ... Alright, fine; God willing, the matter of this proposal will be resolved.
en_old: You say you won't accept my proposal. He talked about it himself. It even happened that you yourself are mine, but you couldn't say it, and you're just mine. We also ask you about my proposal... come on, okay, God willing the problem with his proposal will be solved.

brh: جی ہا بس مہربانی نا دا دونو کاریم ئس کیس توم اماں پارہ نا توبہ استے انشاءاللہ نی بس تسلی کا ہنن پا نا مسنے او نی جی استے ہا دا دونو کاریم ئس واری تون خدا نا منت استے انشاءاللہ اللہ مہر کرے ہا ٹھیک ہی
en: Yes, yes, it's just your kindness that you would do such a thing. Then Mother too says ... God forbid ... God willing, you just rest easy ... yes, such a thing, together, with prayers to God. God willing, may God show kindness. Yes, fine.
en_old: Yes, please just do this kind of thing. We'll tell Mother. God willing, you just stay calm... yes, this kind of thing together, by God's grace, God willing. May God be kind. Yes, okay.

brh: ادا نی لگیٹ کے
en: Brother, were you hit?
en_old: Did you get hit here?

brh: جمہ نا ایلم بشیر پلکونے نا دا نی تینٹ خناس کے ہمے دے آن ہنان روڈ آ جمہ نا ایلم تمنو بس پلکو سوچس ئے ہنی ہمو کشان تینے ہنینگاٹ
en: Bashir has killed Juma's brother; you saw it yourself, didn't you? That day we went onto the road, Juma's brother fell; he just killed him. I had a thought, and I got myself away from that spot.
en_old: Juma's brother Bashir was killed. You saw it yourself: the day we went out on the road, Juma's brother fell and was killed. I just thought about it, and I took myself away from that place.

brh: ئے سنٹ دا مہروم کا بننگا سنٹ گدرینگا کنے ہنو لگے کہ دا دلشیر نا ہیتاتے آن شیر دل نا ہیتاتے آن ہنا بندغ آت پونے کروت ہتھکنا پاسے ٹی باش مس
en: ... this late man was coming, a moment passed; it seemed to me that, because of what Dilsher said, because of what Sherdil said, those men ... and he stood up on the other side.
en_old: ...this poor man was coming, and an hour passed. It seemed to me that, because of what Dilsher said, what Sher Dil said, those people took sides and were on the other side.

brh: او چست و کین ہمدا سا کرین نن اسہ گلاس کرو ایمری اللہ خیر کے انشاءاللہ کین گلاس ایمہ ہموت نا آکھے
en: He got up, and we did the same. Let's have a glass ... may God make it well, God willing; let's have a glass ... their ...
en_old: He got up and we did the same. We'll make a glass... God willing, may God bless us. We'll make glasses...

brh: ہن بر کنے داکہ متو نیو
en: Go on, come on, don't take me away from here.
en_old: Come on, don't give me this.

brh: سائیں کنا فون ئس نی کیسٹ پاس کرینٹ ئے گڑا دا قصہ ختم؟ ہا بے وفا پنی اٹ دلشاد دلشاد او ڈاکٹر
en: Sir, a phone call of mine — you passed it on as a cassette? So is this story over? Yes, the unfaithful one, by the name of Dilshad — Dilshad, that doctor.
en_old: Sir, did you pass along my phone call as a recording? So is this story over? Yes, the unfaithful one's name is Dilshad, Dilshad, that doctor.

brh: سائیں پارہ ٹکری عبدالکریم تو ہیت کے ہاں دا معصوم کرے بے گناہ دا چخونس کتا ٹھاکر صاحب اپونا زال زام ٹی وی بائے نیوز پی ہائیں ٹھیک ہی سائیں ٹھیک ہی
en: Sir, they say talk with Takri Abdul Karim. Yes, this innocent one, the guiltless one, didn't do anything ... Thakur sahib, his wife ... TV ... news ... Yes, fine, sir, fine.
en_old: Sir, they say Takri Abdul Karim is going to talk. Yes, this innocent person... the innocent person was killed, Thakur sahib, his wife... TV, bye, news... yes, okay sir, okay sir.

brh: سائیں ٹکری ہرا پلی فائن تھیو نی ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی گڈ گڈ ٹھیک ہی بس دا بیڈ او ہنے۔ سائیں کچری کے او نا طریقہ تو ہیت کیک ہرا چھوٹان چھوٹان ہا بس ہنے۔
en: Sir, the Takri who ... has become fine — are you okay? Okay, okay. Good, good, okay. Just this ... and it's gone. Sir, he holds court; he talks in his own manner, which ... bit by bit. Yes, that's it, gone.
en_old: Sir, Takri, which... fine, are you okay? Okay, okay, good, good, okay, just this bed went. Sir, in court his way of talking is in little bits and pieces. Yes, just went.

brh: شوکت حسین پاپری ئے نازک آ گلابی شوکت حسین پاپری ئے نازک آ
en: Shaukat Hussain, the papri is delicate and rosy; Shaukat Hussain, the papri is delicate.
en_old: Shaukat Hussain, the delicate pink of the papri; Shaukat Hussain, the delicate papri.

brh: ادا دنے ہم ٹکریا ہنوئی ئے او ٹکری تینٹ بننگٹی ئے ہو بس وڑ اوڑتو ہوار کر ہوار کر ہوار کر اوڑتو
en: Brother, we too have to go to Takri, and Takri himself is coming. Yes, just — join with him, join, join with him.
en_old: Here we also have to go to Takri; the Takri himself is coming. Yes, that's enough, join him, join him, join him with him.

brh: سلام بلوچ
en: Greetings, Baloch.
en_old: Greetings, Baloch.

brh: سائیں وادی شاہ، دا ننا علاقہ نا جوان و فنکار ئس سائیں داد علی، اگر نا اجازت مرے تو اینو داڈے او شعر ئس پائے۔
en: Sain Wadi Shah, this is a fine artist of our area, Sain Dad Ali; if you permit, today he will recite a poem here.
en_old: Sain Wadi Shah, this is a fine young man and artist of our area, Sain Dad Ali. If you permit, today he will recite a poem here.

brh: ہاں بھائی دلشیر قاتلے خنارے آہا؟ او سئی لگو کو رندڑ
en: Yes, brother Dilsher, did you see the killer? He ... right, he set off ... behind.
en_old: Yes brother Dilsher, did you see the killer? He went that way, behind.

brh: دا چا؟ غلام مصطفی نمے ہنا خاطرا تکلیف تسنن کہ بشیر جمعہ نا ایلم ئے خلکونے، نرا نی ہنانے نم مہربانی کبو ہنادے کنا دوٹی ایتبو۔
en: What's this? Ghulam Mustafa, we have troubled you for this reason: Bashir has killed Juma's brother. He ran away and has gone to you. Please, all of you, hand him over to me.
en_old: Who is this? Ghulam Mustafa, we have troubled you for this reason: Bashir has killed Juma's brother. Now where is he? Please, hand him over to me.

brh: حاضر ٹکری صاحب نا کوشش کے ننا ڈیوٹی بس نن نی آتے نا سر کین۔ ٹکری صاحب او نن نی نارام کائک۔ ٹکری صاحب نن نی تو ترے آئی ٹی ملویو۔
en: At your service, Takri sahib; (we'll) make the effort. Our duty is just that we deliver him to you. Takri sahib, he ... from us ... will go uneasy. Takri sahib, we will meet you in ...
en_old: Present. Takri sahib, make an effort; our duty is only that we bring them to you. Takri sahib, he and we... you will not come at ease. Takri sahib, we will meet you in the trial.

brh: عید کرو۔ جی او بھائی اینو ہم تو ملے وا۔ ڈاکٹر صاحب بشیر جمعہ نا دے ختنے نا ڈرامہ کرینن تو نی ئے ہر چار پل دے خوار انت نی پیتاروس نا بابا کنا ایلم ئے بشیر
en: Let's celebrate Eid. Yes, oh brother, meet (me) today too. Doctor sahib, Bashir has staged a drama in front of Juma's eyes, so why have you been knocking about wretched for four or five days ... didn't you tell? Father, my brother — Bashir ...
en_old: Celebrate Eid. Yes, oh brother, today too, meet then. Doctor sahib, Bashir has staged a drama in front of Juma's eyes, so for four or five days you have been wretched; why didn't you tell? Baba, Bashir is my brother.

brh: ابا جمعہ نی تینا خنتٹ خناستے دا سائیں خان تروک تٹ دلشیر آن پاہے کرو ابا جمعہ دلشیر او شیردلے نی جوان چاوہ او قدم قدم آ دروغ تڑو بندغ او نی اوفتے آ بھروسہ کپہ جمعہ سائیں سہی پاہک ابا ننا او جمعہ غا ہچ تپہ دلشیر
en: Father Juma, did you see it with your own eyes, this, Sain Khan ...? Ask Dilsher. Father Juma, you know Dilsher and Sherdil well: they are people who lie at every step, so don't trust them. Juma, Sain is telling the truth, father; don't give anything to us or to Juma, Dilsher.
en_old: Father Juma, you saw with your own eyes this Sain Khan's killing; ask Dilsher. Father Juma, you know Dilsher and Sherdil well; they are people who lie at every step, do not trust them. Juma, Sain is telling the truth, father; don't give our... to Juma at all, Dilsher.

brh: بشیر احمد صاحب نا مونا پیش کرینو پارینو کہ قاتل ہندا دے دا سامونا خدا خبرے کہ قاتل دیرے ابا ہندا ولے ما پارے ٹائم گپ ماربو قاتلو دا سامون کل ایلم تے پارنگا ٹی وی تے کوشش کبو اوخو گسالی قاتل دیرے او دے ظاہر کبو
en: They have presented it before Bashir Ahmed sahib and said that the killer is right here, this one in front. God knows who the killer is, father — right here. But we said, don't waste time on talk: the killer is right here in front. Tell all the brothers, try the TVs ... whoever the killer is, expose him.
en_old: You have presented it before Bashir Ahmed sahib and said that the killer is right here in front. God knows who the killer is, father, right here. But we said, don't waste time talking. The killer is right in front; tell all the brothers, try the TVs; so whoever the killer is, expose him.

brh: چلو اللہ خیر کے کوشش کینہ
en: Alright, may God make it well; we'll try.
en_old: Come on, may God make it well, we will try.

brh: ہائے اللہ محمد حسین ننا ڈیھ انت کیرے میر صاحب ننا دا واہ تو جھٹ ئس تولو گوندا نا غم تے مور کینوں کہ دا نا لشی تے دوزانو ئے بس نی
en: Oh God, Muhammad Hussain, what has happened to our land? Mir sahib, let's sit a moment by this canal of ours and mourn the grief of ... that its corpses ... on their knees ... just you.
en_old: Oh God, Muhammad Hussain, what is our land doing? Mir sahib, this water channel of ours... let's sit for a moment and mourn the grief of the flood, as its corpses are kneeling... just you.

brh: داڑے بائیکانی کلوشیتو پغان جند تینا اینج چکر خلنگے داڑے بسونے کلوشیک تفص توبہ نی غریب پریشان نما جھٹ اسونا غم ٹی مورکن تولین گپ مپس خلنگو تو دا علاقہ نا موسم خوشگوار خوبصورت ٹائٹ مہربانی گڈا کانہ با خدا حافظ ٹکری صاحب جوان خدا حافظ مہربانی تکلیف معاف
en: Here ... he came around on his own like this, he has come here ... God forbid, you are poor and troubled. Let's sit a moment in your grief and have a little chat; the weather of this area is pleasant, beautiful ... Thank you, then we'll go. Goodbye, Takri sahib. — Alright, goodbye, thank you, sorry for the trouble.
en_old: Here the Baikani tribesmen came around in circles on their own and came here; the tribesmen... God forbid, you are poor and troubled. Let's sit for a moment and mourn in your grief; don't talk. The weather of this area is pleasant and beautiful. Thank you, then we will go. Goodbye, Takri sahib. Alright, goodbye, thank you, sorry for the trouble.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام، پیر خیر، خوشی سے، ٹھیک ٹھاک، طبیعت خیر؟ مہربانی، اللہ نا شکر۔ پیر خیر، برکت سے، ٹھیک ٹھاک، طبیعت صحیح ہی پیر خیر ہی مہربانی، اللہ نا شکر۔ لیکن پیر خیر ہی خوشی سے، برکت سے، امن و امان، ٹھیک ٹھاک؟ او جی بس ننے۔
en: Peace be upon you. — And upon you peace. Are the elders well? Happy? All fine? Are you in good health? — Thank you, thanks be to God. Are the elders well, blessed, all fine, is your health good? Are the elders well? — Thank you, thanks be to God. But are the elders well, happy, blessed, in peace and safety, all fine? — Oh yes, we're just fine.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Is all well, happy, alright, is your health fine? Thank you, thanks to God. All well, blessed, alright, is your health fine? All well, thank you, thanks to God. But is all well, happy, blessed, peaceful and safe, alright? Oh yes, just for us.

brh: جی ابا اینا خاطر بسٹ کہ نرگس نا دوئی محمد حسین ایتا جی جی اوڑا نا انت مرضی ئے لال بے بے نا انت مرضی ئے ہاؤ سہی ئے
en: Yes, father, I came for this reason: that you give Nargis's hand to Muhammad Hussain. — Yes, yes. What is her wish? What is Lal Bibi's wish? Yes, it's right.
en_old: Yes father, I came for this reason, so that you give Nargis's hand to Muhammad Hussain. Yes, yes, what is her wish? What is Lal Bibi's wish? Yes, it's fine.

brh: لڈن گڈا ٹھیک ہی خدا حافظ۔ ولدا ملینہ اللہ خیر کرے انشاءاللہ۔
en: ... then, fine, goodbye. We'll meet again; may God make it well, God willing.
en_old: Ladan, then it's fine, goodbye. We'll meet again, God willing, God willing.

brh: ہیلو، انپاسہ؟
en: Hello, what are you saying?
en_old: Hello, how are you?

brh: بشیر غلام مصطفی توار گاڑی ٹی بننگ ء۔ جان پاہنے۔ بس اللہ خیر کے داسہ۔
en: Bashir, Ghulam Mustafa — a voice is coming in the car. Tell me, dear. Just, may God make it well now.
en_old: Bashir, Ghulam Mustafa, the voice is coming in the car. Tell me, dear. Just may God make it well now.
