brh: بس نن نی نی سما تسس ہنا واجغانی لیو نی ئے اونے ایلومیان کشاٹ نی اینو خسی فیٹ انارے کھڈ کرٹ نی اگر اینو واپس بتوسے راہب خان
en: Well, you let us know ... I pulled him away from the brothers ... today ... dug a pit ... if you hadn't come back today, Rahib Khan...
en_old: Just, you let us know... (partly unintelligible) ...if you hadn't come back today, Rahib Khan...

brh: اڑے نو مارا کل داڑے سلوکورے مہمان تے کے دیرینا؟ مہمان تے کے فی الحال کس انتنے۔ امداد ہن ئنا مہمان تے ہتا برو نا ولدا کسرے خنتنو۔ ہاؤ ماما۔
en: Hey, you boys, are you all just standing here? The guests, who ...? As for the guests, for now there's no one yet. Imdad, go and bring the guests, then watch the road again. Yes, uncle.
en_old: Hey, are all these just standing here? When are the guests coming? There's no news of the guests for now. Imdad, go bring the guests and then watch the road. Yes, uncle.

brh: ارے نمے ئے پارد مہمان تے کے کاری کثرتہ سلیرے نم اناڑے سلیسرے مہمان نا کے رے بھلو شان اسے مہمان ئس کے بریک چھار سو
en: Hey, didn't I tell you that for the guests you ... stand? You're standing there. A guest is a great honor; when a guest comes, four ...
en_old: Hey, they told you that the guests... you are all standing here. A guest is a great honor; when a guest comes, from all four sides...

brh: ویل ء پنت کیک برے کہ اودے کرے عزت تروئی ء ننا براہوئی تا رسم و رواج اٹ دا اف کہ نن تولوک مرین او مہمان برے او نا مونا کاسہ چار قدم ہموخس نا ہم عزت مرے مہمان نا ہم عزت مرے واقعی دا ریش کنو ریداس کنو منا حساب اٹ تپیرے
en: The advice is that whoever comes must be given respect. In our Brahui customs it is not that we stay seated when a guest comes; you go four steps out toward him, so that that person's honor is upheld and the guest's honor is upheld too. Truly, this ... in my reckoning, you (all) don't know.
en_old: He gives advice that he must be shown respect. In our Brahui customs it isn't right that we stay seated when a guest arrives; we should walk four steps toward him, so that both that person's honor and the guest's honor are upheld. Truly, in my view this beard and this... (unintelligible)

brh: دا ئے تے منے وا کہ جنگ اٹی جھگڑا ٹی ننا پین کرے خراب ئے اوٹی ننا دو ارے جنگ جھگڑا ٹی لیکن ہرا ٹائم ئس مہمان ئس ننے آ بس او ننا ننے عزت کروئی او مسورے نوے خبر ئے
en: Accept this: in fights and quarrels, if someone else wrongs us, then we have a hand in the fighting and quarreling; but whenever a guest comes to us, we must honor him; that's how it has been, you know.
en_old: Accept this: in war and quarrels, if someone wrongs us, then we have our hand in fighting and quarrels. But whenever a guest comes to us, we must honor him; that is the custom.

brh: ننا مہمان دیرے ہنو، خاص مہمان ننا رئیس اوڑتو اوار بلوچستان نا مشہور ء فنکار اسے نور خان مجنا، اینو بریک داڑے ننے شعر بنفک، شعر بننہ محفل کینہ، نہ بابا
en: Who are our guests, then? Special guests: our chief, and together with him a famous artist of Balochistan, Noor Khan Majna. Today he is coming here and will recite poetry for us; we'll listen to poetry and hold a gathering, right, father?
en_old: Our guests are coming, special guests: our chief, and with him a famous artist of Balochistan, Noor Khan Majna. Today he is coming here to recite poetry for us; we'll listen to poetry and hold a gathering, right, father?

brh: ہو بابا
en: Yes, father.
en_old: Yes, father.

brh: وار رئیس نی خدا دے وعلیکم السلام جوڑ بھر تگڑا خوش ٹھیک ٹھاک او فنکار مجنا بسم اللہ جوڑ بھر تگڑا خوش ٹھیک ٹھاک اینم بسم اللہ جوڑ بھر تگڑا خوش ٹھیک ٹھاک خیر
en: Ah, Rais, God (bless) you. And peace be upon you. Are you well, in good health, strong, happy, all fine? And the artist Majna, welcome, are you well, in good health, strong, happy, all fine? And this one too, welcome, are you well, in good health, strong, happy, all fine? All well.
en_old: Welcome, chief, God bless you. Wa alaikum assalam. Are you well, strong, happy, all fine? And the artist Majna, welcome, are you well, strong, happy, all fine? Welcome, are you well, strong, happy, all fine? All good.

brh: خیروم بسم اللہ جوڑ بھار تکڑا خوش ٹھیک ٹھاک خیر بھار چھونکا خیروم جوڑ بھار تکڑا خوش ٹھیک ٹھاک خیر خیر خیر خیرے بھڑورے تکڑا خوش ٹھیک ٹھاک خیر خیر شکر اللہ نا شکر اللہ نا الحمد للہ
en: All well too. Welcome. Are you well, in good health, strong, happy, all fine? All well. And the little ones, are they fine? All well too. Are you well, in good health, strong, happy, all fine? Fine, fine, fine. Is all well, are you all fine, strong, happy, all fine? Fine, fine. Thanks be to God, thanks be to God, praise be to God.
en_old: All good. Welcome, are you well, strong, happy, all fine? Are the children well? All good, are you well, strong, happy, all fine? Fine, fine, fine. Is everyone well, strong, happy, all fine? Fine, fine. Thank God, thank God, praise be to God.

brh: ایس کان بہ ہمنگی آ تولین اڑے چھا مرے ہاؤ با حال احوال ہم کینہ ہاؤ حال احوال ہم اوڑے کینہ رائٹ
en: Yes, let's go, come, let's sit over there. Hey, let there be tea. Yes, come on, we'll also exchange news; yes, we'll exchange the news over there too. Right.
en_old: Come, let's sit over there. Hey, what's up? Yes, we'll also exchange news. Yes, we'll exchange news there too. Right.

brh: رئیس آلاوال کینو مے یا چھان پد
en: Rais, shall we exchange the news, or (do it) after the tea?
en_old: Chief, shall we exchange news now or later?

brh: شاباش مرے امداد خان لشکر احوال کین جی جی سنگت آک جی جی احوال خیر دعا خیر بزرگی اللہ نا احوال خیر احوال آتہ خواجہ ہر کس تینا ہول آک کیرے ارے نا کلمہ بس کین رسیدین تینے پین
en: Very well. Imdad Khan Lashkar, let's exchange news. Yes, yes, friends. Yes, yes. The news is good, prayers are good, greatness belongs to God. The news is good; (you are) the master of the news. Everyone (is busy with) their own affairs... (the rest is unclear).
en_old: Well done, Imdad Khan, Lashkar, let's exchange news. Yes, yes, friends. Yes, yes. News is good, prayers good, by God's grace. The news is good, sir; everyone is managing their own affairs. ... (partly unintelligible)

brh: سنگت آک بشیر نا احوال ء ہلی جی۔ بشیر نا احوال ء سیٹ تے خیر ء نا۔ ستاک احوال ء ہتن۔ امداد خان احوال ء ہتن۔ جی۔ خیر ء رئیس سال احوال آتا خواجہ ئس ہا۔ نن تے
en: Friends, take Bashir's news, yes. Bashir's news is fine. Friends, let's have the news. Imdad Khan, let's have the news. Yes. Fine, Rais, (you are) a master of the news. Us...
en_old: Friends, take Bashir's news. Yes. Bashir's news is fine. Give your news. Imdad Khan, give your news. Yes. It's fine, chief, ... (partly unintelligible) ... us.

brh: ئنا روزگارٹی ئنا پھڈا ئنا حساب کتاب اٹ تو مشغول ہائے پوسکنو علم ئس کرینن ہائے ئنا خاطر نمے برادری ئے خولے خائفن ہائے کہ بربو نم خنبوت ہائے فنکار مچنائے متبو ہا
en: We are busy with our livelihood, our troubles and our accounts. We have acquired some new learning, and for that reason we invited you, the community, so that you would come and we could see you, and the artist Majna as well.
en_old: We are busy with our livelihood, our troubles and our accounts. We have acquired some new knowledge, and for that reason we invited you, the community, so that you would come and see us, and the artist Majna as well.

brh: ارے شائراز ماریک جشن از ماریک سلوک اسونو نما انتظارا نمے خدا ہیس نما سلاما پین حوال ننتو اف خیر خدا خیر کے بڑو رے کڑاو رے خوش رے بشیر اللہ دوران خننگ پک
en: Hey, there'll be poetry, there'll be a celebration! We were waiting for you. God has brought you; (we are here) for your greeting. We have no other news. All is well, may God keep it well. Are you well, are you strong, are you happy? Bashir, by God, Dauran... (unclear).
en_old: Hey, poets are here, it's a celebration, everyone has been waiting for you. May God keep you. Your greetings... there's no other news with us. Fine, God keep it well. Is everyone strong and happy? Bashir, may God... it's good to see you.

brh: ہدایت دوران ء راہی کرے ہمو کول پور والا ڈغار ء سودا کرے سٹ گڑاس پیسہ سلوکا سرا ہمو پیسہ تے گراہی کرے تے گتے برے تا۔ رئیس نم تولبو ئے ہورف دا مار ء کوئی
en: Hidayat sent Dauran off; he sold that land at Kolpur, and with the bit of money that was left over he... that money... (unclear). Rais, please sit; look at this boy...
en_old: He sent Dauran on his way; he sold that land at Kolpur, and with the little money left over he loaned it out... (partly unintelligible). Chief, please sit; ... this... (unintelligible)

brh: موش خلنگاٹی چائے تیار کرے گر کتو۔ اوئے نی چائے تے زو کر، صوبہ نائے موش خلنگ سے مہمان کیڑے توسنو نا دا اسکا چائے تیار اف۔ او ماما چائے زو تیار مرو۔
en: Get the tea ready while it's (unclear: boiling?)... Hey you, hurry up with the tea; the guests have been sitting here since morning, and the tea still isn't ready. Oh uncle, the tea will be ready soon.
en_old: Prepare tea while the hookah is being smoked... Hey you, make the tea quickly, ... the guests have been waiting since morning and the tea still isn't ready. Okay uncle, the tea will be ready soon.

brh: چھائے جان جان کیس خیال کیس چھا دا ہنو یا نی چھا دا مگر نہ ترنت کائک۔ ٹھیک ہی ولا ہم پارین نا کہ چھا دا ہنو۔ زو کر چھائے یار انتظار کرفپنے داخس۔
en: The tea, dear: you keep thinking 'the tea is on its way', or you (say) 'the tea...', but it doesn't come right away. Fine, by God, we'll keep saying 'the tea is on its way' too. Hurry up with the tea, friend, don't make us wait this long.
en_old: Dear, you're wondering whether the tea is coming or not. It isn't coming right away. Fine, we'll keep saying the tea is coming. Hurry up with the tea, friend, don't keep us waiting this long.

brh: چھا تیار مس متنے؟ سدھ اسکن تیار
en: Has the tea got ready or not? It's just about ready.
en_old: Is the tea ready or not? It's completely ready.

brh: زو تیار کتے، بائٹ ہروا ہرفتا، اڑے دیر دا خان تے شاغان استے، پاستے الاراڑے تے شاسے، ہیرکدی تے ہیرکدی
en: Get it ready quickly. Come, look, pick it up. Hey, who poured these...? Put it over there, pour it... (unclear).
en_old: Get ready quickly, take a bite... hey, who put these things here? Put them over there... slowly, slowly.

brh: بس بس باز یو اللہ مفک تا کلے تا ڈھیر کریس سادہ
en: Enough, enough, that's a lot! Oh God, it won't do; you've piled it all up. (Keep it) plain.
en_old: Enough, enough, that's a lot. By God, don't... just keep it simple.

brh: بشکام برک چا بریک بشکام
en: Hand it out; the tea is coming, the tea is coming; hand it out.
en_old: Bring it, the tea is coming, bring it.

brh: او شلک او شلک رئیس دان کے چھا تیار متنے کرے ڈغار خمپک ڈغار تول ڈغار خلینے دنو ڈغار خلگنے نی تینا بائے تور بسٹ گٹو کرو نی میمانگ شکریا توسنو عزتیہ بندغاک ئے برف تورے وڑے ادا دا خنے اشتہ
en: Oh..., oh..., Rais, the tea still hasn't been made ready... the ground... sit on the ground... you, your own... the guests, thank you, they've been sitting here, respectable people... look here... (largely unintelligible).
en_old: He's... Rais, has the tea been made yet or not? ... the ground... you... your... thank the guests, they're respected people... look at this here.

brh: او فیوسک مار کوئی بش کتے نٹ کرچا دانی چھا ہموڈے پار تینے کہ کیران تے مغیت تے نا ٹانگے کیران تے آتے ونت امداد نما ہمے جڳڑہ دا اسکان ننتنے رئیس امداد انان تھرہ فیس ئے پاونی نن دان کا
en: Oh..., boy, someone get (him) up... this tea, tell him there that... Imdad, this quarrel of yours has gone on until now... Rais, Imdad... we... (largely unintelligible).
en_old: Oh... Rais, has the tea been made yet? ... tell them... help... this quarrel of yours has gone this far... Rais, help... we...

brh: کہ جھگڑا کتنو ننے آرام بفک۔ ابا اوڈ نما پھڈا یوڑے اینو مئے انپاو۔ رئیس نی تیار سوائے ماما ء رازدے ہٹی راموسے جھگڑا کپو دے چا آرام بفک۔ ابا دا خدائے راس کے اینے انپاو۔
en: ...that since you have quarrelled, we get no peace. Father, this quarrel of yours... today... (unclear). Rais, you are ready... uncle... don't quarrel, or there'll be no tea and no peace. Father, may God set this right... (unclear).
en_old: If there's a fight, we won't get any peace. Father, your quarrel today... Rais, are you ready? Uncle... don't fight, otherwise there'll be no peace. Father, this is God's will.

brh: ارے لوچی نی پارے کہ چھا دا کائے واپس انہ ترے تے کائے ارے پارے
en: Hey (unclear), you said that the tea is on its way... going back... (unclear)... it's on its way, he said.
en_old: Hey Lochi, you said the tea is coming back... it's coming, he said.

brh: اوئے کچاد آن کائے واللہ نی پارے او نتارے تے کائے خا، ہمو دے ہمو دے، بس ماما اینو دے، بس ماما خیر دے، آنکھو لٹ پارا دے، آنکھو لٹ پارا دے، بس خیر دے بس دے، بابا اینو دے، او خیر دے، خیر دے سے، باری نی کچاد آن کائے واللہ نی پارے او نتارے تے کائے خا
en: Hey, where is it coming from? By God, you said he's going to them... That day, that day. Enough, uncle, today. Enough, uncle, all is well... (unclear)... Enough, all is well, enough. Father, today. Oh, all is well, all is well. Hey you, where is it coming from? By God, you said he's going to them...
en_old: Hey, where is it coming from? By God, you said he's bringing it to them. That day, that day... that's enough, uncle, today... enough, uncle, all's well... all's well, that's enough. Father, today... oh, all's well, all's well. Now, where is it coming from? By God, you said he's bringing it to them.

brh: چنا الے بس بس بس بس رئیس کائے نا صدقہ ماری نا خاطران الے وتے کھزی فیٹتے خیر خیر خیر رئیس نا صدقہ نا کڑک
en: Child, leave it, enough, enough, enough, enough. Rais, I'd give myself for you; for the boy's sake, leave it... (unclear)... fine, fine, fine. For Rais's sake... (unclear).
en_old: Child, come on, enough, enough, enough, enough. Rais, for the sake of... for the sake of... all's well, all's well, all's well, for Rais's sake...

brh: دا کوٹ ء انت کہ پاتاسس ہی تے ہلپسہ بابا تے چھا دا کاک پی مئے نتارے تے کاک امر ہنا داسہ ہا ماما واقعی کنے آن غلطی
en: What is this coat, that you won't even take a sugar drop? Father, the tea is on its way... how did it go now? Yes, uncle, really, the mistake was mine.
en_old: What is this coat? Why didn't you take the sugar candies? Father, is the tea coming? ... how did it go now? Yes, uncle, it really was my mistake.

brh: ئے مسلی، غرتی تو مسیان دسس زو کہ اتہ چھاتی۔ ہاؤ، مشہ وڈے ہتہ مہمان تے چھائے تبو، توسنرے ہورے رحمتس۔ ہا بشیر دا غہ چدہ نہ ایننگ کہ چنائے کٹس۔ چنائے دا کہ بارٹ کہ چھائے سہی جوڑ۔
en: ...quickly, bring the tea. Yes, ...bring it, give the guests tea; you have been seated, look, (it's) a blessing. Yes, Bashir, this... don't bring... for the child... I told the child to make the tea properly.
en_old: ...you got it? Hurry up with the tea. Yes... serve the tea to the guests, God's blessing upon them. Yes, Bashir, don't bring this... for the child... make sure the tea is made properly.

brh: رئیس نور خان مجمنا ہنو شاعر ئس پارینے دا ٹیما اگر ئے تینا بینک ئنا کھلی پیسہ تے کشیو تتفتیم بلہ ہم کمی لیکن
en: Rais, Noor Khan Majna, a poet, has said on this theme: 'Even if I withdraw all the money from my bank... it still falls short', but...
en_old: Rais, Noor Khan, one of our poets, has said on this subject: even if I withdraw all the money from my bank, it would still not be enough, but...

brh: کرے دا ہارے او نا لکٹی شاہ وئی داسہ
en: ...did this... his... now (largely unintelligible).
en_old: He did this... his... now.

brh: بس نور خان مہربانی کدا اسہ ننے ہمو شعر ء بنف جی مرینے ہوش ہنا کنا خیال ہنا
en: So, Noor Khan, please recite that poem for us once. Yes... my wits have gone, my mind has gone.
en_old: Well, Noor Khan, please recite that poem for us once. Yes... I think...

brh: چہرہ پری او سکھنا سینہ غان کشا عشق نا دردے
en: A fairy-faced one drew the pain of love out of the (unclear) chest.
en_old: O fairy-faced one, the pain of love has been drawn from my empty chest.

brh: سالہ گدرینگانے دے باخمپرنے اسوار علاجے افک دردے کنا مسونٹ بیمار
en: Years have passed; for days I haven't seen you. There is no cure at all for my pain; I have fallen ill.
en_old: Years have passed, I haven't slept for days. There's no cure for my pain; I have fallen ill.

brh: نا پائے کنے لاڈی بر کنا شارا ہنوٹ ہی نو دلبر نا خنت خمارا وختی ہنو کا گالے نا تم کانے
en: You tell me, 'Darling, come to my city' — I will go... the beloved's eyes are full of intoxication... when it's time... your word... (unclear).
en_old: Don't tell me, darling, come to my city... my beloved's intoxicated eyes... it's time to go.

brh: سنگت اوک
en: Friends, okay.
en_old: Okay, friend.

brh: ارے بشیر! بارکو نتھڑ کافنی ئس تنگڑی خلیزدا۔ ارباب دشا! نی خبر اف کہ ہرا ٹائم آ غصہ ٹی بریک بشیر تو کھلی کک
en: Hey Bashir! ... hit this one on the leg. Arbab, now — don't you know that whenever Bashir gets angry, he lashes out?
en_old: Hey Bashir! Bring a dry stick and hit him on the leg. Arbab, wait! Don't you know that when Bashir gets angry, he lashes out?

brh: یس چیف بشیر نی دشمناتے کیسہ چیر چیر ہنا خاضرانتو مسنو زوپیر اینو ہناڑے خلیف کثف شونے ملبنے دیر نی خبر اف کنکے دعا کیس ہر فقیر بس
en: Yes, Chief Bashir, you tear your enemies to shreds ... for your sake ... today ... You don't know — every faqir prays for me, that's all.
en_old: Yes, Chief Bashir, you tear your enemies to pieces... today... You don't know, every beggar prays for me.

brh: یاد ہیت کپبو بندہ انو ماریر کنتو اسیر نی ننے خلنگ کپیسے انتئے کیندا نفن بے پیر کنا اینو شکار ردھن تنے تیر لال بادشاہ ننے امر کیک نئیں کوننگ کا امیر
en: Don't talk nonsense, you lot. Men end up as my captives. You can't beat us. Why do you do this, you faithless one? Today you're my prey; your arrow has gone astray. Lal Badshah gives us orders, not some amir who just eats.
en_old: Remember, don't talk back. I am the son of a man... you can't beat us. Why, faithless one... today my prey... Lal Badshah will give us orders, not the rich.

brh: غم کپہ بو پگہ نما کلنا کہنگنا بریک اخبارٹی تصویر، نم ننے گٹو کیرے نم تو دنو افس زنجیر، ننے ایرو خبر تما نما بو قدرنا، بٹا انارے
en: Don't you worry — tomorrow the picture of all of you dying will be in the newspaper. You try to stifle us, but you're not such a chain (to hold us). We've come to know your worth ...
en_old: Don't worry, tomorrow the news of all your deaths will be in the newspaper with pictures. You threaten us, but you're no chain to hold us. Today we'll show you what you're worth.

brh: شکر مس کہ جان نا بچا اینو
en: Thank God your life was saved today.
en_old: Thank God my life was saved today.

brh: او ایلو فی الحال جان نا تو بچا یار
en: Oh brother, for now at least your life was saved, man.
en_old: Oh, the other one... for now at least my life was saved, man.

brh: اڑے نالائقاک مچے سمان تے ہیسنرے دا سدا خلٹ تو ننتو خلنگ مفس ماما گولی چٹار دا تینا نن قصورے کنے کاٹمے نما قصورے
en: Hey, you useless lot, gather up all the stuff. Always like this — you strike, but fighting with us won't work for you. Uncle, the bullets are finished. This is our own fault ... it's your fault.
en_old: Hey, you useless lot, all of you pick up the stuff. Fighting like this all the time, you can't fight us. Uncle, the gunfire... this is your own fault, it's your fault, not mine.

brh: انو چاوا خیر ء ضرور۔ برے ہمراہ تا سم کھوٹار کا ہلینتا۔ ہاؤ یار کا۔
en: Today I'll see — surely all is well. Come, the companions' bullets have run out; go and get them. Yes, man, go.
en_old: Today, let's see, everything is fine for sure. Come along with the companions. Yes, man.

brh: ماما بشیر! اینو ننو مے خلے داڑے کنے فنی ہنجیر افسوس کہ ننا سم کھٹار نی ہم داسا بھلو ہیت کیسہ ننتو بشیر ہیت دا ہا اینو ننو مالخے خلینو لال بادشاہ ماما نا لکھے خلینو
en: Uncle Bashir! Today they hit us here ... It's a pity that our bullets ran out. Now you too are talking big with us. Bashir, the thing is this: today they have struck our property; Lal Badshah, they have struck uncle's lakhs.
en_old: Uncle Bashir! Today they beat us here. It's a pity that... you too are talking big with us now, Bashir. This is the talk: today they beat our... Lal Badshah, they beat Uncle's...

brh: خلبو کنے خلبو بابا ئے تہ غریب بندغ اسٹٹ
en: Hit me, go on, hit me! Sir, I'm just a poor man.
en_old: Hit me, hit me! Father, I'm a poor man.

brh: نی فیرنگ ارے چندنا شمکینس نی فیرنگ ارے باشا نی فیرنگ ارے چندنا
en: You've got firing ... how many bullets ... you've got firing, king; you've got firing ... how many ...
en_old: You have firing... you have firing, king, you have firing...

brh: نی ہم کم افیس، نی پورنا ارے بندہ آتے
en: You're no less yourself — you're more than a match for these men.
en_old: You're no less yourself; you're full of men.

brh: ابا کسے دے خلئے سڑے پیر نہ دوران ئے لال بادشاہ تو چالاکی کیسا لال بادشاہ ہر ٹائم اچڑے کہ دوران مخلوق مرے تے راں
en: Oh dear, someone hit (him) ... during ... You're playing tricks on Lal Badshah? Lal Badshah is always around, so that during (the fight) the people ...
en_old: Father, someone hit... Lal Badshah, you're playing clever with Lal Badshah. Lal Badshah, every time... so that the people would be...

brh: بے پیر نی، کل جنگاتی بش کیسہ، بے پیر، ئے بے پیر ئس افٹ، بے پیر ئس ہریس، ئے بے پیر ئس افٹ، نی بے پیر ئس ہریس کہ فیصلہ پیر غاسک، نا بے پیراک فیصلہ تے پیرغرے، ہاؤ
en: You're faithless — you stir up all the fights. Faithless! I'm not faithless; you're the faithless one. I'm not faithless; you are faithless, because you break decisions. Your faithless lot break decisions — yes.
en_old: Faithless one, you'll stop all the fights? Faithless one... I'm not faithless, you are faithless, because you reject decisions. The faithless reject decisions, yes.

brh: بے پیر آ تا کاریم ہننا دے کہ فیصلہ تے مننے پس۔ اچھا گڑائے فیصلہ پیر غار بے پیرس مسٹ۔ ہاؤ ئے بے پیرسا فٹ۔ ارے جنگے بس کبو۔ کنے لال بادشاہ نا فیصلہ قبول اینو۔ کبو بس بس۔
en: The way of the faithless is this: they don't accept decisions. All right, so if I break the decision I've become faithless? Yes — I'm not faithless. Hey, stop the fighting. Today I accept Lal Badshah's decision. Stop, enough, enough.
en_old: The work of the faithless is to not accept decisions. All right, then if I reject the decision I'd become faithless. Yes, I'm not faithless. Hey, stop the fighting. I accept Lal Badshah's decision today. Stop, enough, enough.

brh: لال بادشاہ نا ہر فیصلہ کنے منظور ئے ئے بے پیرہ سفت دا کنے اینو پارے کہ بے پیراک فیصلہ تے منے پس لیکن ئے بے پیرہ سفت
en: Every decision of Lal Badshah is acceptable to me; I'm not faithless. This man told me today that the faithless don't accept decisions, but I'm not faithless.
en_old: Every decision of Lal Badshah is acceptable to me, I'm not faithless. He told me today that the faithless don't accept decisions, but I'm not faithless.

brh: آئی نا پٹائی نو کنے خبر تما کہ بے پیرک فیصلہ ئے منیپس نن بے پیر افن نن نا فیصلہ ئے منانوک تسک نی پاس ننے قبول ئے واہ بشیر واہ باز جوان کریس زوت ایریا شیطانی میڑاس مر کریس اینو پگا بندغاتا دو شیطانا لٹکڑی سخت ئے
en: From that beating I came to know that the faithless don't accept decisions. We are not faithless; we accept your decision — whatever you say is acceptable to us. Bravo, Bashir, bravo! You did very well; you quickly ended a devilish dispute in the area. These days the devil's stick in people's hands is hard.
en_old: After his beating I came to know that the faithless don't accept decisions. We are not faithless, we accept the decision; whatever you say, we accept it. Wow Bashir, wow, very well done! You quickly rid the area of this devilish man. Today... the devil's stick in people's hands is harsh.

brh: اردو زو شیطان خلاص منی کپسا لال بادشاہ مالف دا بندغ فیصلہ پھرغ ئے اللہ وٹوڑی اور اینو فیصلہ نا قبول کرے
en: ... the devil doesn't get finished off quickly. Lal Badshah, you know, this man used to break decisions, by God, and today he accepted the decision.
en_old: ...the devil couldn't be finished off. Lal Badshah... this man rejected the decision, by God, and today he accepted the decision.

brh: باز جوان کرے تو ہنا ڈی نو دعا ئس مرے بشیر دعا ئس کین ماشاء اللہ مبارک مرے نمے سمنتا تے گلی خیر مبارک خیر مبارک
en: He did very well, so let there be a prayer for you. Bashir, let's say a prayer. Mashallah, congratulations to you all ... Same to you, same to you.
en_old: Very well done, may there be a prayer for you. Bashir, say a prayer. Mashallah, congratulations to you all! Congratulations, congratulations.

brh: براک، ولے دا نمتہ بپ کنے کن ار دے برے بائیدے کہ برے ہو بائیدے کہ برے انتئے کہ نا است کے پائیک، ہو اسل اٹ نمے دا خاطر آن خواہیفٹ کہ اگہ نم شار آ اینو سورے تے نسا لوم۔
en: Brother, but this (thing) of yours should come for me every day — it has to come, yes, it has to come, because your heart says so. Yes, actually I called you here for this reason: if you (go) to the city today ...
en_old: Brother, but let this letter come to me today, whether it comes or not, because your heart says so. Yes, actually I called you for this reason: in case you go to the city today.

brh: ننا پد و رندی خلکو رے تو جوان اسہ کہ بے وس بے چارا لٹی۔ ہا ایڑو اسلٹی ئے دنیا ٹی ہچ نہ تو راستی ولے سماج کے ننا خلک اٹ ننا خاص کاریم او۔ ہاو ظاہر تو۔
en: Behind our backs ... it would be good if the helpless, poor ... Yes, sister, actually in this world nothing (is) true, but society — in our village, that's our main business. Yes, it's obvious.
en_old: Behind us... it is good that the helpless poor... Yes, today... in the world nothing is true, but in society our main work is... Yes, it's obvious.

brh: کاریم چم ملنگ کپنو وڈا شہر ٹی لالا شیر خان نا پٹنگم اسیدینا کاریم اف کہ دوزم لگنگ کیک دے ہوم ئنا دایت تینٹ ہایت نما تو راستی ہمار کے ہما سال ایلوں
en: Work isn't easily found in the big city; and searching for Lala Sher Khan is not a one-day job that can just be managed ... truly ... that same year ...
en_old: There's no work to be found in the big city. Searching for Lala Sher Khan isn't something that can get done in a day. Invite him home; truly, that year...

brh: چھا، نی ثناء نا ہیت ء کننگ اٹی اوس؟ ئے پامسٹ داسہ۔ ثناء؟ ارا ثناء؟ ہمو کہ کنے تون گاڈی ٹی تولوک ئس۔ اوہ، او نا پنسنائے؟ جی ہو او نا پنسنائے!
en: Oh, are you talking about Sana? I get it now. Sana? Which Sana? The one who was sitting with me in the car. Oh, is that her name? Yes, yes, that's her name!
en_old: So, were you talking about Sana? I get it now. Sana? Which Sana? The one who was sitting with me in the car. Oh, is that her name? Yes, that's her name!

brh: خیر ئے نی ئے ہمدا ورفیٹک ئے پاٹ کنا سنگت تو ہینوس کنا گاڑی ٹھیک چنا اڈی سلطان ولہ اللہ خیر کے کنا سنگت نا استا مدیر مس بے فکر کپہ کنا یار کنا منزل خلک اٹے شار اٹ اف
en: Well, I brought you right here; I said, my friend, you'll go ... my car is fine, sister. Sultan, by God, may God make it all right; my friend's heart got upset. Don't worry, my friend — my destination is in the village, not in the city.
en_old: Well, you've come right here. I said my friend has come, my car is fine, Sultan. By God, may God make it well, my friend's heart got upset. Don't worry, my friend, my destination isn't in the city.

brh: گل بے بے امر کریس؟ ارے فہیم سخی نا ایلو شربت آ تے اندن او کن گور کس پہ روچس ارا۔ تاس ئنا ایلوم کارہ شار آ رو۔
en: Gul Bibi, how did you do it? Hey Fahim, Sakhi's other sherbets — like this, for him ... one day ... (his) brother goes to the city.
en_old: Gul Bibi, how did you do it? Hey, Fahim, the other sherbets are for him, nobody... Go to the city tomorrow.

brh: ویس دامرو دے گرفسا تیرا شیر خانی تم بسیر سکینہ اسے ارس کنا دوٹی برے ئے اودے رفے وا کہ دا عمر ٹی نی ورا ایمر لسنہ رسے
en: ... clothes ... grabbing ... When Sher Khan came, a Sakina ... came into my hands. I told him that at this age you ...
en_old: These days you grabbed... When Sher Khan came, there was a Sakina in my hands. She went off, saying that at your age you...

brh: نی للہ نہ رینا ہیت اسیٹی یکہ نی للہ نہ رینا یا او راہ للہ نہ رینا ہیت تو اسیٹی دیچا او مائی ٹی انتس خنانے کہ بیسٹ ہموڑ کے دوں گنوخ مسنے بے وساتی للہ نہ رینا اسے
en: Whether you (talk of) Lala or that (other) way, Lala's ... — the thing is one and the same. What has he seen in that woman that he has gone this mad? It's helplessness ... Lala ...
en_old: Lala, don't go, in a word. What did he see in that woman that he's gone mad like this? Poor helpless Lala...

brh: تسنہ پاو گل بے بے جوان چاسہ کہ دا کل نرینہ اسہ وڑ مریرہ نن غریب بے بس انگا نیاڑی پیو ننگا میل ٹامبارون ہر جاگہ تفیس ننے ہمو جاگہ نا مریرہ خالہ
en: Tell me, Gul Bibi — you know well that all these men are the same. We poor, helpless women are like ... wherever you tie us, we belong to that very place, auntie.
en_old: Tell me, Gul Bibi, you know well that all these men are the same. We poor, helpless women... everywhere they put us in our place, aunt.

brh: گڑا نانت خیل نن ہم نرین توبہ کامرو ایت کیسہ نی تو نتو استے کشاس ناہی تا کیندونو ہیتو انتون پاننگ ٹیٹو بس زو ئس ایلم سکندر و ایلم حیات کار او دادے
en: So what do you think — that we're men too? God forbid ... You've poured your heart out to us, (but) there's no point in saying such things. Just quickly — brother Sikandar and brother Hayat will be going today.
en_old: So what? We men repent too. You took out your heart... there's no point in saying such things. Just quickly, brother Sikandar and brother Hayat...

brh: دا استو تعویز نا کرامات مروئی پیر صاحب نا کہ امر کنا علم تے زوشار مونتیروی۔ تعویز نا تو ٹک پٹک مرو انتئے کہ بیس سال اسکان ئے ہمودے ٹینٹ اٹ تفیسس۔
en: This must be the miracle of Pir Sahib's amulet, how quickly my knowledge is moving forward. The amulet itself must be in fine shape, because I kept it tied up in that same tent for twenty years.
en_old: This must be the miracle of Pir Sahib's amulet, how quickly my knowledge is advancing. The amulet must have worn to pieces, because you kept it in that tent for twenty years.

brh: نما باز باز مہربانی بسرے ننا محفلء رونق تسرے دا سا نما کلنا اللہ نگہبان
en: Thank you all very, very much: you came and brought life to our gathering. Now may God protect all of you.
en_old: Thank you all so very much for coming and adding life to our gathering. Now may God protect you all.

brh: امداد مہمان تے سفر کریس؟ جی او ماما۔ روانہ مسو؟ جی او سائیں ۔ ئنا اسیہ دانہ کنے باز پسند بسنے۔ بے کنے دا محفل نا شان ء ودھا کریس۔ واقعی کہ امداد نی
en: Imdad, did you see the guests off? Yes, uncle. Have they set off? Yes, sir. I liked one thing about you very much: you raised the prestige of this gathering. Truly, Imdad, you...
en_old: Imdad, have the guests left? Yes, uncle. Have they gone? Yes, sir. I really liked one thing about you. You raised the prestige of this gathering. Truly, Imdad, you...

brh: منو ئے ئنا اخہ پیسہ ڈھیر کرے سینو دس کن نعمت داڑے کہ نعمت فنکار دے لوفت حافظ کنت دس کن داڑے تمانو چھنا کم دا پسو۔ رئیسا دا فنکارا اخس کہ پیسہ شنکی کیس وا ہم کم ئے نہ بابا۔ ہو بابا۔ دا پیسہ دس مچ کبو کانے۔
en: [Manno?], how much money has yours collected? ... Ni'mat is here, Ni'mat the artist ... [hafiz: blind?] ... has fallen here ... [unclear]. However much money you shower on this artist, it is still too little, isn't it, brother? Yes, brother. Collect this money now and let's go.
en_old: How much money did you collect? ... Ni'mat is here, Ni'mat the artist ... Rais, however much money you give this artist, it is still not enough, no, brother. Yes, brother. Collect this money for him.

brh: ارے کنے آن ہر ہفتہ نو ریرا ہننگا ٹورے ماما برام سے آ کانا برام آ کنے بٹنگانو ہننگا ٹوسنی ماما نی گڑا دا سہ انت پاسا انت پاوا بسنے ہرسنگ ئے کاوا براما ماما نا حکم خنتیا
en: Hey, every week you go off and leave me [unclear 'nu rera']. Uncle, I'm going to a wedding; they've invited me to the wedding, I'm going, uncle. So what are you saying now? What can I say, it has come up: I go to every engagement and wedding... uncle's order [unclear].
en_old: Hey, every week I... uncle, at the wedding... at my wedding... Uncle, then what are you saying now? What has come up? ... I'll go to the wedding, uncle, if that's your order.

brh: امرے کنے پاس؟ بس براہوئی کاوا نم کل بفبو۔ دا خمامہ ناجائزی کپر ننے اندر۔ چلو ٹھیک ہی نمے دیوا اوڑا دورانی دپہ۔ دورانی واپس ہن۔ او مرو کان۔
en: What are you telling me? That's it, I'm going to the Brahui [one]; don't all of you come. Don't do this unfairness to us. Okay, fine, I'll take you there; [not] Durrani. Durrani, go back. That will do, let's go.
en_old: What are you telling me? Just speak Brahui, all of you. Don't do this unfairness to us. Alright, fine, I'll give it to you... Durrani, go back. That will be fine.

brh: ماما دوران انت ہرف تبی؟ بے وقوف او دے لو باز کریک۔
en: Uncle, what did Duran say? The fool, he does a lot of [unclear 'de lo'].
en_old: Uncle Duran, what did you say? He's a fool, he talks too much.

brh: ارے رنگ اینا نورے؟ ماما ننے ننا شار نا کنڈا پارین فنکار ئس برینے داڑے برے ایک شعر ئس خلیک لیکن خنتون
en: Hey, what's going on today? Uncle, an artist from around our town has come to us here [pārēn: 'so-called'/'well-known'?]; he came here and is reciting a poem, but we didn't see [him]...
en_old: Hey, what is this commotion? Uncle, an artist from our town has come; he's come here to recite a poem, but with...

brh: ارے نی وا سواداں شہر بنوکا مسنس؟ نی خبر اف ئے ہمے چنکیسے آن شہر بنوے، ئے تو نی اسدے ہم خنتوٹ شہر بننگا، نی ہندزیٹ شہر بنگوٹے، نی اسو شہر بن
en: Hey, since when have you become a poetry listener? Don't you know I've been listening to poetry since I was little? But I have never once seen you listening to poetry. Where have you ever heard poetry? You, listen to just one poem!
en_old: Hey, did you become a city dweller just like that? Don't you know I've lived in the city since I was little? I never saw you living in the city. You never lived in the city; when did you ever live in the city?

brh: ناچ کہ کنے انتو خلوسہ ئے وارا خسیفیوانے کہ شہر بمپہ ماما کنے خسیفنگ نا پنی ہلپہ ارے بے وقوف ماما تو کرارا ہیت کر بے وقوفی افٹ بے وقوف ماما کنے خسیفنگ نا پنی ہلی ارے
en: [Look,] why are you hitting me? He is provoking me again, because he doesn't listen to poetry. Uncle, he won't stop provoking me. Hey, you fool! Uncle, speak calmly, I am not a fool. The fool, uncle, has provoked me, hey!
en_old: ...he's mocking me, making me cry, saying he won't live in the city. Uncle, he's calling me a crybaby. Hey, fool! Uncle, speak calmly, it's not foolishness. Foolish uncle has called me a crybaby.

brh: نی ممار بے وقوف ہریس؟ سلے کہ مچے خلیفتے، سلے، سلے دا بھلا تادب تپے خلق
en: Did you call me a fool? Wait, he has frightened everyone. Wait, wait, this big man doesn't teach people manners.
en_old: Are you a fool or a madman? Wait, let them hit everyone, wait, wait, this big one won't give manners to people.

brh: ارے بس کبو کہ پٹ کریتنے۔ نم کہ دونا سیلوئے خلیرے خسیفرے ہلہ لال بادشاہ دیر خلیک۔
en: Hey, stop it, you've made a mess of things. If you hit each other like this and provoke each other... hurry, Lal Badshah is getting late.
en_old: Hey, stop it, you've made a mess. If you all fight and cry like this... here comes Lal Badshah.

brh: اڑے لغو راک بش مابو ہمبل آ تورین بس بس الے بو کنے الے بو کنے الے بو کنے الے بو کنے
en: Hey, you cowards, get up! [unclear 'hambal-a turen'] Enough, enough, let me go, let me go, let me go, let me go.
en_old: Hey, scoundrels, don't wake up... just leave me alone, leave me, leave me, leave me alone.

brh: الے یار او تو بے دماغ اسے نی مچ سوچ کر نی ہوشی اسے نی مچ سوچ کر او تو بے دماغ اسے بس چپ کر اینے پارٹ اینے بوکھنے اینے پرٹ ٹکل ٹکل کے واجڑو اینے بوکھٹ ٹھا ٹھا بس بس
en: Leave it, friend, he's a brainless one. You think it all through, you're a sensible one, you think it all through. He's brainless. Just be quiet. [unintelligible stretch] Enough, enough.
en_old: Leave it, friend, he's brainless. You think it over, you're sensible, you think it over. He's brainless. Just be quiet... enough, enough.

brh: نوم کے دون اسلو خلیلی خانہ آباد آک کہ دشمن تیتو ولادیز جنگ کیک واہ کیرائیتے ماما جوان پاریس دوران دانگ بر حشمہ و بر
en: Do you hit each other like this? Bless you all! When the enemy fights with them [unclear]... Wow [unclear], uncle, you spoke well. Duran, come over here; Hashma, you come too.
en_old: ...may the house be prosperous... when an enemy fights like this... well done, uncle, you spoke well. Duran, come here, Hashma, come.

brh: بس کبو گڑاس خشی ئے دا کے ملیبو
en: Stop it, and share some happiness over this.
en_old: Stop it, find some happiness in this.

brh: انتو نم تو خاص انگا نو
en: Why, you are the special ones, aren't you?
en_old: Why, you are special ones.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ جوڑ ئس تگڑا خیر؟
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Are you well? In good shape? All fine?
en_old: Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you too. Are you well? Is everything fine?

brh: اچھا دا مروئی دستکاری تو تر چاکرہ سفر ئے اوٹان والا وقتی ئس پاریسٹ کہ آتھم کہ مامائے کسری خناسٹ
en: Okay, this must be handicraft... [unclear 'to tar chakra safar-e'] ... back then I once said that when I had seen uncle on the road...
en_old: Alright, this must be handicraft... travel... at that time you said that when you'd see uncle on the road...

brh: ککر او توار آتے سر کس نی تو ایدوم باز جالو بندوس داسہ ئے پومسوٹ کنے ایدوم کریٹ ایچو غلطی ئس کرت وٹ داسہ دا دوکان نا رانی توٹ داڑے گانا بن پلی مور اسو جوان کے سخی لوم نا
en: [unclear 'kakar'] ... the voices ... you were always very [unclear] like that. Now I've understood: I did it like that, I made such a mistake. Now I [run] this shop here ... [unclear] ... good ... generous ...
en_old: ...you were always very... now I've understood, I always did it, I made such a mistake, now I am the queen of this shop, here...

brh: نانو کرے سدنا ئے لغا تمو جکا کھٹنا ئے نائف فلم اورنگسے خلے نائف پینٹ ٹھوپ تے خنکے اسو دردی کرے سدنا ئے یاس بجو آمنا سنگت مس نی چوا داس کنا مرے روما پولیس ئے ٹھوپے الا تخ نئے نا داس تخ ٹھوپے تیرا تخ بے فکر مر
en: [largely unintelligible] ... knife ... film ... knife, paint, caps ... saw ... did it painfully ... became a friend ... you know ... the police ... put the cap down here ... keep yours here ... put the caps ... don't worry.
en_old: ...the knife... the film... saw the paint and hats... did it painfully... became a friend... the police... keep the hat here, keep it with you, don't worry.

brh: بس بافق ہمو واہ دیدہ تون ہا بس سینو پنا ہیدوم بس چھا پنا نی ہم چھا ہاو ہاو ہاو اللہ پاک دادو دا سے شوق ٹھیٹ ہاو دا گڈائی او منے واقعی براہوئی نا ٹوپ دستار براہوئی نا
en: Just ... that, wow, with one's own eyes, yes, just like that, you know, you know it too, yes, yes, yes. God Almighty has given it; this is a passion, the genuine thing, yes. This, finally, is really the Brahui cap and turban, the Brahui one.
en_old: Just fine, with that good view, yes, just... you know too, yes, yes, yes, God Almighty, this is a passion, absolutely, yes, this at last, it really is the Brahui cap and turban, the Brahui one.

brh: اوینا شانے داسہ برا اینو ہم پندھنے تو ہیت کرے نا پدا اوریتے نا ٹولی او بس نی چا سوچس بس اینو ہم پندھنا ہیت لمہ بس دلجائی کر داسہ کمپیوٹر تو ہستے مرو ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ اڑے نی انت کے داڑے
en: His glory... now come. Today again he talked about the journey on foot, then the women's group... and, you know, what did he think? Today again it's the talk of the journey. Mother, just reassure him. Now there will surely be a computer. Mashallah, mashallah. Hey, what are you doing here?
en_old: His... now come, today he talked about the road again, then the group of women, and just, you know, what did you think? Just today the talk of the road again. Mother, just reassure him. There must be a computer now. Mashallah, mashallah. Hey, what are you doing here?

brh: سلوک ئس دا دور اٹ تیز تیز بس ہنک، پگہ بر والا چائے نا کترون، ٹھیک ہی صاحب، ئے باوا دا دکانداری باز مزہ داسہ بشکان، ہرانگے؟ بس کار نا چکر خالی
en: [Sulūk] in these times just goes fast, fast. Come by tomorrow, by God, for tea... Okay, sir. Hey, father, this shopkeeping is a lot of fun. Now let's get up and go. Where to? Just a spin in the car, nothing more.
en_old: There's a little left; things move fast these days. Come tomorrow for the tea kettle. Okay, sir. Man, this shopkeeping is very enjoyable now... Where to? Just driving around in the car for nothing.

brh: دا دکان ئنے ہلکون تے سہب نا ٹائم پاسیکے، نی دا فکر کپک کہ پنج سو روپئی آڑاں جوڑ کیو، بس کانہ رنگ اٹ دانہ سئی پاسینہ ولدا ارا ٹو بس دس پندرہ منٹ چکر کینہ۔
en: We took this shop so that the morning time passes. Don't you worry about where I'll make five hundred rupees from. We just pass it properly in our own way, then the two of us just go for a ten or fifteen minute drive.
en_old: We work on this shop's children's things in the morning. Don't worry about how I'll make five hundred rupees. We just sew it properly our own way, then the two of us take a ten or fifteen minute stroll.

brh: توران! ننا ارا خونی و انکے لشکر دے حیران سلفینس۔ کھل مورچہ الکنو۔ ماما! دشمن تے ہچ بھروسہ۔
en: Turan! Our two killers have left the army stunned. They have taken the open trench. Uncle! The enemy can't be trusted at all.
en_old: Turan! Our two bloodthirsty men have left the army astonished. Open the trench! Uncle! Never trust the enemy.

brh: افسوس، دنا مجال ئے کہ ننتو دشمنی کے کہ ننے خلک؟ نہ بابا، ہو بابا۔ ارے داڑے بر، نی ہم دانگ بر، امداد۔
en: What a shame! Does he have the nerve to be hostile to us and to strike us? No, father! Yes, father. Hey, come here; you come over here too, Imdad.
en_old: Alas, how dare he be hostile to us and hit us? No, father. Yes, father. Hey, come here, you come here too. Help!

brh: نی ادا اورا نمبو مچا نن کانہ شکارس کینہ
en: You [stay] here at home; all of you, we are going to go hunting.
en_old: You come here, all of us are going hunting.

brh: دا کنا جوڑ سے سر؟ دس کلو تیار اف، نیم گھنٹہ سے پد تیار مرو۔ ٹھیک ہی استاد۔
en: Is this my suit, sir? It isn't ready yet; it will be ready after half an hour. Okay, master.
en_old: Is my suit ready, sir? The ten kilos aren't ready; it'll be ready in half an hour. Okay, master.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ ابا نن ہار ضرور وتی۔ سئی لومٹ وال ہار خواری ہزاری ہار ضرور وتی لومٹ چار دانے۔ حاضر ئے لوم ہار بتی۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Sir, we definitely [want] a necklace. A proper, hand-worked [lumat] necklace, we definitely [want] four pieces. Here you are, the [lum] necklace...
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Sir, we definitely need a necklace. A proper loom-made one, sir, a hand-worked necklace, we definitely need four pieces. Here it is, the necklace is ready.

brh: دا زاریا ئے؟ جی خواجہ زاریا نا دے۔ زاریا ٹی ایٹ پیسہ او؟ ابا زاریا ٹی شش و نیم سد خلوک دے۔ انتئے؟ انتئے ابا دا ٹلہ پھلاک تے دا پیسہ غان علاوہ دا ٹل تین سو ساڑھے تین سو نا دے۔
en: Is this a zaria? Yes, sir, it's a zaria. How much money is a zaria? Sir, a zaria goes for six and a half hundred. Why? Why, sir: because of these decorations. Apart from that price, this decoration alone is worth three hundred, three hundred and fifty.
en_old: Is this the zaria? Yes sir, it's a zaria. How much is the zaria? Sir, the zaria costs six and a half hundred. Why? Because of these tassels and flowers; on top of that price, these tassels cost three hundred, three hundred fifty.

brh: سو روپئی خرچہ بسونے ننا محنت دا داڑے بیس ہزار روپئی کرائے تنے دا دے دے پورا کے دا قسم یار ظلم کپہ بو جوان افک التا علم نا دزدات تے پین خرچہ ہم تو بریک ساڑھے چھ سو پیسہ جیب آن ننا نی تین سو روپئی پین کنا جیب آن کونگنے او پنجاہ سرس ننا آخر محنت نائے
en: A hundred rupees of expense has gone into it, plus our labour. Here we pay twenty thousand rupees in rent; give it, give the full amount. Friend, don't do this kind of injustice, it isn't right. [...] Other expenses come with it too: six hundred and fifty rupees out of our pocket, and you... another three hundred rupees has gone out of my pocket, and fifty on top. It's our labour, after all.
en_old: A hundred rupees were spent, plus our labour. We pay twenty thousand rupees in rent here, which these days has to be covered. Don't do such injustice, friend, it isn't right. There are other costs too, like the craftsmen's wages. Six hundred fifty comes out of our pocket; you three hundred more, out of my pocket... and fifty on top. In the end it's our labour.

brh: دا مرے 300 روپئی دانا قیمت ئے روپئی ئس ہم خلوک افتے گڑا داڑے پاسنتئے تو دا خرچ کنرے گڑا داخس ایلو کیسہ گڑا ہمو ہزار روپئی بادشاہی انور آتے گڑا دا چلہ پلہ تن ضرورت مولانا ہم گڑاس رعایت کننتو ایلوم رعایت نا گنجائش افتا پنی پنی دا 500 روپئی
en: This comes to 300 rupees, that is its price; not a single rupee has been added on to it. Then if you [have it done] here, you'd spend this, then you'd pay this much more on top, then that same thousand rupees, your majesty [...], then these decorations are needed. Maulana, we'd still give you some discount, but brother, there's no room for discount. [...] this one, 500 rupees.
en_old: Let it be 300 rupees, that's its price; not a single rupee is being charged extra. If we sew it here, then this expense... then you're asking this much more, then those thousand rupees, your majesty... Then these tassels and flowers are needed. We'd give a little discount, but there's no room for more discount. Five hundred rupees for this.

brh: شژدہ سال نا مچ نا جند و رعایت کر، ایلو پین گنجائش اف تا، شژدہ نا خاکس دا کل دیس کن گنجائش افک، واقعی کہ سہی پارنگوس، ابا سہی تو پارنگٹ اوٹ، تو دا ٹلہ پلہ تن ضرورت آ، و ہزار روپئی دا بادشاہ اینو نتے و گڑا ہر آن ضرورت آ، بس اوئی دا ٹلہ پورا چار دانہ
en: Give a discount on the whole thing, at sixteen [hundred]; there's no more room in it. At sixteen there isn't a speck of room for all this. Really, are you telling the truth? Father, I am telling you the truth. So these decorations are needed, and a thousand rupees, king, today for you, and then it's needed from every [side]. That's all: these decorations, a full four pieces.
en_old: Give a discount on the sixteen-year-old's set; there's no more room. Sixteen... there's no room for all this for the whole country. Really, you said it right. Sir, I said it right. So these tassels and flowers are needed, and a thousand rupees, your majesty, today for you, and then whatever is needed. Just these tassels, a full four pieces.

brh: سئی لمبوس ازاریو کرے مسے دانہ ارے رکھ اسہ دانہ س نیم گھنٹہ سے پد تیار مروئی نیم گھنٹہ سے پد نم برے نغدہ جوڑ کیسہ۔ بس ٹھیک دے۔
en: Right, [...] there are three pieces; keep one piece. It should be ready after half an hour. Come back after half an hour, and you'll pay in cash. — OK, fine.
en_old: Make the zaria properly long, put it in one piece, it'll be ready in half an hour. Come back after half an hour; you're paying cash. Okay, fine.

brh: ایب گھنٹہ سے پد بو تیار مریک انشاءاللہ۔ اوڑا کمبو چانس کونے بوتاں تیار جوڑ کے۔ ہاؤ دا کمبو چانس کونے بوڑا ولہ بریمو۔ ہاؤ جوانو عید کرے داسہ ننا کاٹم او خرچ ٹی چا کے۔
en: It will be ready after about an hour, God willing. [...] get it made and ready there. Yes, [...] then come back again. Yes, have a good Eid; now have some tea on us, at our expense.
en_old: It will be ready in about an hour, God willing. Make it there in less time, have it ready by then. Yes, it'll be done there in less time, come back. Yes, have a good Eid; now our work and expenses are... let's see.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ کنا جھلکس ختم ئے جی او ایلم آ ہر نمہ تیار ئے ایلم تیار کرینس کنا ایلم نا وریٹ ہم۔ حاضر ایلم۔
en: Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace. Is my piece done? — Yes, brother, everything of yours is ready, brother. — Have you got my brother's one ready too? — Here you are, brother.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Is my piece finished? Yes, brother, everything is ready for you, brother. I've had it prepared, and my brother's too. Here you go, brother.

brh: ایلو مسپہ کنا ضرورت اف بادشاہ بیرف ایوانو دلخردین شاہدے
en: Nothing more, I don't need [anything else]. King, dress [...]. [rest unclear]
en_old: No more, I don't need it. Your majesty, take it, ... have a heart, witness.

brh: ارئے بائے بیدارے خبو بادشاہئے بیرفینوس ٹھیک ء، ہا ضرور مار ئنا دفعہ وتنگا ٹیو۔
en: Hey brother, very nice, you've dressed me like a king, fine. Yes, of course, son, this time [...].
en_old: Hey brother, wake up, I didn't know it was the king. Fine, yes, of course, son, it's time to go.

brh: کنا اینو برکت نی گٹ او کنے الے نا رے ہسیت نی کنے انت نا کترے نی ناحق ہسیت نی نی سرور نا ایلوم
en: Oh, my luck today! [...] your neck... let me go! Why did you bring me? What have I done to you? You've brought me here for nothing! — You are Sarwar's brother.
en_old: My blessing today, you... leave me alone. Why did you take me? What's it to you? You took it unfairly. You're Sarwar's brother.

brh: او سرور ننا ایلوم تان کاریم کنے مونا ٹی تے مچے خلقونے لیلے ننا ٹکو ٹکو کیوے لیور نی راہی راہی مدا سدے وننا مشنا توپ کاٹی نا ٹکو ٹکو کیوے لیور نی
en: Oh, Sarwar is our brother... [...] in front of me... he'll gather the whole village... they'll cut us to pieces, you... on the way [...] with a cannon from the mountain [...] cut to pieces, you!
en_old: O Sarwar, our brothers' work in front of me, they've all gathered the people... they'll cut us to pieces, you go on your way... they'll blow us to pieces with cannon fire.

brh: باز آسا نی ہنو جاگہ غس کزیتن کہ واللہ دا جاگہ غے دوننگا
en: Many times you [come across] such a place that, by God, what a place this is.
en_old: Many times you go to places like that and you think, by God, this is a place to love.

brh: زندگٹی خنتنسنائے کہ ولا پدنا خنورتے
en: You have never seen anything like it in your life, such that you would see it again afterwards.
en_old: I've never seen anything like it in my life, and you won't see it again.

brh: نوران، خیال کیس عینکاتے بٹوس پرغوس۔ واللہ دا مشٹی عینک خاراخاتے نیکی۔
en: Nooran, be careful, you'll drop the glasses and break them. By God, in these mountains glasses [...].
en_old: Noran, be careful, put the glasses in the purse. By God, glasses are no use in this dust.

brh: اڑے امداد ارا ئے کھورٹ دا اینکے ئے شوقے بنانٹ جوانی ولا می پارے نی بائتے نا تور بس اٹھ خل نا زیا گھٹو کروٹ نی
en: Hey Imdad, [...] I made this out of fondness, [...] then he said to me, 'You, hold your tongue.' Just [...] I'll go easier on the hitting, you.
en_old: Hey Imdad, there are two... I did this out of love, then you said you're... just hit him, I'll cut down the damage from the hitting.

brh: بس بس زیادہ خلیفہ کنے دا خلنا زیان تموٹ نی خبر اف ہرا ٹائم چڑک دوران خلقت مرے حیران بس سر گستاخی معاف بس دسا
en: Enough, enough! Don't hit me so much! I'll come to harm from this hitting. You don't know at what moment [...] people are left astonished. Enough, sir, forgive my insolence, enough now.
en_old: Enough, enough, Khalifa, that's too much, don't hit me. You'll be the one to lose from this hitting. You don't know when people get shocked in a fight. Enough, sir, forgive my rudeness, enough now.

brh: چپ کر! بر داسا خبر تمینگنے داڑے برک۔ کنے الے بدا کنا زی آ رحم کبو نتہ پدا ہمونے کایو۔
en: Be quiet! Come, word has got out now; he'll come here. Let me go, [...] have mercy on me, otherwise later I'll go back to that same one.
en_old: Be quiet! Come on now, word has got out and he'll come here. Let me go, have mercy on my heart, or you'll end up going back there.

brh: ماما دادے انت کے ہیسس؟ سئے ہک نما ہیسن اٹتے، ہلمو خسیبوتے پین انت کے ہیسن اٹتے؟ ماما دانا خسی فنگر ننے انتس ملیک؟
en: Mama, why did you bring this one? — [...] I've brought him to you; take him and kill him. What else would I have brought him for? — Mama, what will we get out of killing him?
en_old: Mama, why did you take this? Three of your rights I took, and the goats too. What else did you take? Mama, what do we get from his goat finger?

brh: سرورے ایتوسس، اڑے نی دانا کسفنگ نا لائق مر، سرورے متے وائکنا، بے وقوف کے نی اوس، ماما بلا بے وقوف نی اوس کہ دادے ایسنوس، سرورے نی ایتوسس، اڑے
en: You should have handed over Sarwar! Hey, be man enough to kill this one! Sarwar [...]. You're a fool! Mama, you're a real fool for bringing this one. You should have handed over Sarwar, hey!
en_old: You gave Sarwar away! Hey, you deserve to be killed for this. Don't give Sarwar away... You're a fool. Mama, you're a huge fool for bringing him here. You gave Sarwar away, hey!

brh: ئے بمب ء بے وقوف پاریس، ہو پاریٹ تہ گڈا، گڈا گنے نا کاٹم ء
en: You called me a fool? — Yes, I said it, so what? Then, then [...] the head.
en_old: You called me a fool? Yes, I said it, so then, then his head...

brh: چپ کبو نمے خدا خلئے نمے تورے و یادادے تورے
en: Be quiet, all of you! May God strike you! May He seize you, or seize this one!
en_old: Be quiet, may God strike you! He'll grab you, and remember him.

brh: ارے لغوران نم دادے توبہ بس کنورے تماشہ مسنورے مئے کنا برامے داڑے ارے وا بس کبو نم دادے توبہ بس کنورے
en: Hey, you cowards, for heaven's sake stop this! You've made a spectacle of yourselves. It's my wedding here — hey, stop it, for heaven's sake stop this!
en_old: Hey, you scoundrels, repent of this, enough! You've made a spectacle of yourselves. My brother is here, so stop it. Repent of this, enough!

brh: بس کرے آہ تینے تینٹ خلپیرے، کپیس ماما، کپیس، کپیس ماما، کپیس، کپیس ماما، نمے خدا خلے جادو کے دادے ایسٹ کہ دادے خلے، نم ولہ تینے تینٹ خلنگا ٹورے، اسیلو تو جنگ کیرے، بس ماما داسہ جنگ کپنہ
en: Stop it! Ah, don't hit each other! Don't, mama, don't! Don't, mama, don't! Don't, mama! — May God strike you! I brought this one for [his] magic, so that he would beat that one, and instead you're beating each other; you're fighting among yourselves! — OK, mama, now we won't fight.
en_old: Stop it, ah, you're hitting each other! Don't, mama, don't, don't, mama, don't! May God strike you, I brought the magic so it would hit him, and here you are beating each other instead. First you fight... Enough, mama, we won't fight now.

brh: دا سڑے نوم ئے جان خان اټ، آ سڑے ملک، نی ہمت ک خاستے دافتے انتو ہچ ال متو۔
en: This guy's name is Jan Khan, and that guy is Malik. You, if you had the courage... why was nothing done to them?
en_old: This man's name is Jan Khan and that man is Malik. If you had the courage, why didn't you do anything to them?

brh: ارے بے وقوف اینے پارٹ کہ دادے خس نی توفک کہ لخاتی خس کنا ایلم دوکو الپاسہ کہ داد خلیوے نی دادے خلنگ کپیسہ والا پگہ نی تینا ایلمی کتوس
en: Hey, you fool, I told you to [shoot] him, you with the rifle, in the neck. My brother wouldn't let [me] hit him. You can't hit him; by God, tomorrow [it'll be] that you didn't stand by your brotherhood.
en_old: Hey fool, I told you to take him... My brother wouldn't say that you'd hit him. You can't hit him, and then tomorrow you didn't keep up your brotherhood.

brh: قطب خانے امر خلیسر، ئے دادم خلپرہ قطب خانم خلپرہ، اڑے موچنک نی دادم خلپیسہ قطب خانم خلنگ کپیسہ، وڑائنے مفت ٹی تینا ایلوں کریٹ، ئے کرے نا ایلوں اریٹ وارال کسے خلنگ
en: How would you hit Qutb Khan? I won't hit this one, and I won't hit Qutb Khan either. — Hey, you twig [lit. tweezers], you won't hit this one and you can't hit Qutb Khan either. I made him my brother for nothing; I am the brother of [...] hitting anyone.
en_old: How will they beat Qutb Khan? He won't hit him, he won't hit Qutb Khan. Hey kid, you won't hit him, you can't hit Qutb Khan. I made him my brother for free... I'm his brother, and he wouldn't hit anyone.

brh: کپارے، نی کہ کسے خلنگ کپیسہ، ولدا نی ہمے داڑ توار کھڈ کیوہ ہنارے، دوران ہس دافتے اینو کر خلکتے حیران، ماما بالکل خلیفتہ ہتھیارے کنے دے
en: ...you can't. If you can't hit anyone, then I'll call out right here [...] today [it] left these people astonished. Mama, don't hit him at all; give me the weapon.
en_old: Don't say that. You can't hit anyone. Then I'll call out... today... shocked. Mama, really hit him, give me the weapon.

brh: ارے نالائق دا انت ہتیارے؟ دوران ئے مخرن کپرت ہتیارے نیت ایو۔ نہ بابا، ہو بابا، مما نی پیرس تفکئے؟
en: Hey, you useless one, what kind of weapon is this? [...] is this a weapon? — No, father. Yes, father. — Mama, is that an old rifle of yours?
en_old: Hey, you worthless one, what kind of weapon is this? ... is that a weapon? No, father; yes, father. Mama, didn't you give Paris?

brh: کنیٹ ئے خلیوتا بس کریس کھٹے یلا کڑی نکھتے بشا ارٹوار سر جک بشا وار سر ارٹوماتن مسہ جاگہ خلیوا کہ کنے بوڈا سکون برے
en: I'll hit him myself, stop it [...] get up, twice on the head [...] get up, [...] on the heads of both of them [...] I'll hit him in three places so that I find some peace.
en_old: When I hit, stop... twice on the head, three times on the head... I'll hit in three places so my heart finds peace.

brh: ہر توم آتینوم آ دا ساسے جاگہ خلیف کہ است کنا پھدے مرے واہ ماما واہ واہ کہ کریس کنے بس دا سانی خطہ
en: Every time [...] hit this one place so that my heart [...]. — Wow, mama, wow, wow, what you have done for me! That's enough, this [...] mistake.
en_old: Every time... hit this spot so my heart... Wow, mama, wow, wow, what you did! That's enough for me...

brh: نہ بابا، ہو بابا
en: No, father. Yes, father.
en_old: No, father; yes, father.

brh: دا ہت کرو کرے پاپو اول تو دارا بش مرے ہم ہم کسے دارا لیسکا ہم ہم بلوچستان تو ونیوٹ تا پج جوڑ بس صحیح ست درا بلوچستان لو سارک دے جوڑ دعا تو برچس بلوچستان
en: This matter... first it rose up here, and also someone here... also Balochistan... was formed, right... Balochistan... was made... a prayer... Balochistan.
en_old: This was done... first it emerged here, and someone... here too, in Balochistan... was formed, right... Balochistan... prayer... Balochistan.

brh: اگر ذاکر تشر ٹھیک برے تہ ہمو اراضی نا پنا تشر او بلوچس ہمو اگر ذاکر بگٹی ایجنسی برے بگٹی ایجنسی او بو او بو ایجنسی سے تشر کہ ٹھیک ایجنسی نا بدہ بدہ اوڑا تقسیم یعنی اگر ذاکر کرے
en: If they mention it, if it turns out right, then they gave it the name of that land, and a Baloch... that one; if the Bugti Agency comes up, the Bugti Agency, and... they made it an agency, so that, right, the agency was divided up there; that is, if one mentions it.
en_old: If Zakir's division is right, then it is in the name of that land, and it's Baloch. If Zakir comes to the Bugti Agency, the Bugti Agency... a division by agency, if it's right, then the agency is split up there; that is, if Zakir does it...

brh: بس دا پارہ بو کے بھائی بلوچ آ کلات کلات کلات آ تا اچھا کلات اسے زبال سے ربطہ گریت پارہ کہ فارسی کریر تو سندھ ٹی وی فارسی چلا ک سندھ آ ہاں دفتر
en: So this is what they say, brother: for the Baloch, Kalat, Kalat, Kalat... okay, Kalat had a connection with one language; they say that they used Persian, and in Sindh too Persian was in use, in Sindh, yes, in the offices.
en_old: Just this, they say, brother: the Baloch of Kalat, Kalat, Kalat... okay, Kalat kept ties with one language. They say they used Persian, so Persian was also in use in Sindh, yes, in the offices in Sindh.

brh: ہر زبان مغل تا زمانہ ٹی کلہوڑا تا زمانہ ٹی ٹالپور تا زمانہ ٹی فارسی اسہ کہ اوفتے دیر فارسی پائک کل پارہ سودھی ہمو فارسی ہرا کہ برصغیر اٹی اسہ کہ ہرا فارسی ٹالپور تا زمانہ ٹی مقبول اسہ کہ
en: Every language... in the era of the Mughals, in the era of the Kalhoras, in the era of the Talpurs, it was Persian, but who among them speaks Persian? Everyone speaks Sindhi. That Persian which was in the subcontinent, the Persian which was popular in the Talpur era...
en_old: Every language... in the Mughal era, in the Kalhora era, in the Talpur era, Persian was such that they spoke Persian for a long time. Everyone says... that Persian which was in the subcontinent, the Persian that was popular in the Talpur era...

brh: کلو آتوزماٹی مکھ لوسکہ کلو آتوزماٹی بھٹائی صاحب پائک ہرا فارسی کیک او غلام اسے بالکل بالکل تاکس و وسی زرق بندوبست پائک کہ ہرا فارسی کیک او غلام اسے غلام اسے غلام ہا یعنی کل نا بادشاہ نا غلام اسے کہ فارسی کیک سندھی کپک
en: In the Kalhoras' era..., in the Kalhoras' era Bhitai Sahib says: whoever speaks Persian is a slave, absolutely, absolutely... he says that whoever speaks Persian is a slave, a slave, a slave; that is, he is the slave of the king of all, the one who speaks Persian and does not speak Sindhi.
en_old: In that era... in that era Bhitai Sahib says that whoever speaks Persian is a slave, absolutely, absolutely... he says that whoever speaks Persian is a slave, a slave, a slave, that is, the slave of the king of all, someone who speaks Persian and doesn't speak Sindhi.

brh: تو دا صاحب غلام حسین دا صاحب بھٹائی رحمت علی تعریفے پیش کرے کہ اگر زبا قومی زبان بلوچی تے بالکل کبو اگر براہوئی تے کبو اگر سندھی تے کبو باقی دا صاحب دا دے کہ زبان آکھو لداؤ تو جداؤ
en: So this gentleman Ghulam Hussain, this gentleman Bhitai, may God have mercy on him, put forward this point: whether it is the language, the national language, speak Balochi fully; if it is Brahui, speak it; if it is Sindhi, speak it. The rest, sir, is this, that language...
en_old: So this Sahib Ghulam Hussain, this Sahib Bhitai Rahmat Ali, gave a definition: if the national language Balochi is not spoken at all, if Brahui is not spoken, if Sindhi is not spoken... the rest, this sahib says that language...

brh: ہر بدل ازی بال قابل احترام ئے ہر بدل دسے ایلو ایلو بو دا ککر باغ تک لا ککر باغ تک نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم فرما لا تسبوا الدیک ککر باغ
en: Every [voice]... is worthy of respect; every... the others, the others, even this rooster's crow, even the rooster's crow: the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said, 'Do not curse the rooster', the rooster's crow.
en_old: Every... is worthy of respect, every... the rooster... the rooster... The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'Do not curse the rooster'... the rooster...

brh: ئے ککو نا باغ اٹی شریعت نا حیثیت اٹ صرف ئے کنا لمہ نا لولی ٹی شریعت نا حیثیت اٹ صرف کنا باوہ نا براہوئی ٹی اسہ وخت ئس بھلو کامریڈ ئس بس تو
en: ...in the rooster's crow, with the standing of Sharia; only in my mother's lullaby, with the standing of Sharia; only in my father's Brahui. At one time a great comrade came, so...
en_old: In Kakko's garden, as Sharia... only in my mother's lullaby, as Sharia... only in my father's Brahui... at one time he became a great comrade, so...

brh: دا یونیورسٹی بلوچستان یونیورسٹی دا سکا حاجی صاحب تولوک اسوٹ کابل غا پل کابل غا پل نا سنگت ئتو سنگتی چار پنج بندہ بسور پردھان صاحب زندہ سکا ٹھیک ہی حاجی صاحب تولوک اسوٹ یونیورسٹی
en: This university, the University of Balochistan, this... Haji Sahib, I was sitting there; Kabul... a friend from Kabul..., friends, four or five people came; Pardhan Sahib is alive, doing very well, right; Haji Sahib, I was sitting at the university.
en_old: This university, the University of Balochistan... Haji Sahib was sitting there... Kabul... a friend from Kabul... four or five friends came... Pardhan Sahib is alive and very well... right, Haji Sahib was sitting at the university.

brh: دا صاحب دا بد بخت دا اخراجات چار یا پنچ سو روپیہ سخت پریشان بس۔ ٹھیک۔ کہ دا زی کہ دا جوہر تونا جو سختی کیرے۔ تو اوفتے سربراہ کرے پارے پیسہ نا واجہ ہیتس کلے گٹیورے۔
en: This gentleman, this wretched man, became very troubled over these expenses of four or five hundred rupees. Right. That this... that you are being hard on this Jauhar. So their head responded and said, 'Sir, it is a matter of money; you are squeezing everyone.'
en_old: This sahib, this unfortunate man, became very worried about these expenses of four or five hundred rupees. Right. That this... is being hard on Jauhar. So he made them the head and said, the money man... has shut everything down.

brh: برا برا کرے، ہاؤ، ئے پاشے، نن کپن، ٹھیک، لاپرواہ نہ کیک نن ئے کیک، نن کپن، کرائت تئی جوڑہ سے کیک، لاپرواہ نہ کیک نن، او بدمعاشی تے، لب خلکا تے دے کیرے، اچھا
en: He settled it, yes, he says, 'We won't do it.' Right. He doesn't act carelessly; he does it for us; 'we won't do it'; he makes a pair...; we don't act carelessly; and those villainies, you do this to those who took the bride-price. Okay.
en_old: Brother, brother, yes, he says, we won't do it, okay, he is not careless, he does it to us, we won't do it, he makes a pair..., he is not careless with us, those villainies, the ones who take bride-price, you do it to them, okay.

brh: او ئے پدا سدا دے بلوچستان نا ڈغار نا پسند دے ئے پدا تولک اسہ دے ئے پدا دے اوراری ضعیفہ اوراری پدا دے ئے پدا دے مسوری کلہ خانی مسوری دے پدا مسوری دے ئے پدا سوبرا زئی نا خلک آ پیش تماسا
en: And then he, always... the favourite of the land of Balochistan; then he was settled, one day...; then the Orari, an Orari wife; then, then the Masori, the Kalkhani Masori; then the Masori; then it emerged into the family of the Sobrazai.
en_old: Then he, always, this land of Balochistan, its favourite, then sits; one day, then the Orari, the elderly Orari woman, then the Masori, the Kalhkhani Masori, then the Masori, then they emerged from the people of Sobrazai.

brh: اوفتہ ہر آ کہ البتہ ئے لفظاتے انگلش ٹی پارس، بلوچی ٹی پارس، اردو ٹی پارس یا براہوئی ٹی پارس۔ بس نا کاٹم آ تیوے تے خاص مہر کریس، ارا زبان ٹی۔ توبہ خا پاریس، ارا زبان ٹی۔
en: To them, whoever, of course, whether you say these words in English, in Balochi, in Urdu or in Brahui. Just, upon your head, you would show special affection to all of them, in whatever language. You would say 'repentance', in whatever language.
en_old: Whoever, of course, says these words in English, says them in Balochi, says them in Urdu or says them in Brahui. Just in your head you had special love for all of them, in whatever language. Repent, you said, in whatever language.

brh: باشک یور صاحب آد بس کہ۔ داسا ننے آخ ٹھیک ہی داسا دا دے یقین کبو کہ بلوچ نا زی نا پارہ بلوچ بلا بلوچ مخالف اف۔ صحیح۔ بلوچ براہوئی نا مخالف اف اسل۔ نو تو تینا
en: Indeed, sir, it came to this: now, for us, right, now believe this, that from the Baloch side, the Baloch, the Baloch are not opposed. Right. The Baloch are not opposed to Brahui at all. So then their own...
en_old: Bashak Yor Sahib came, so. Now we, right, now believe this, that the Baloch, on the Baloch side, the Baloch are not opposed. Right. The Baloch are not opposed to the Brahui at all. So then their own...

brh: تینا انت مسئلہ ء تینا کرینگم تینا تیرا او دا مچا بدبختی ٹی تیناک مونی او براہوی مونی ء انت بد دعا سے براہوی ء انت سے دا المیہ سے کہ اسہ بندغ ئس تینا قوم آن تینٹ انکاری مرے نمے ہمتا خبر مرے
en: What is their own problem, their own doing, their own...; and in this whole misfortune they themselves are in front, and the Brahui are in front. What curse is this, what is it with the Brahui? It is a tragedy that a person himself denies his own nation; you should be aware of that.
en_old: What is their own problem, their own doing, their own... and in all this misfortune they themselves go ahead, and the Brahui go ahead; what curse is it, what is it with the Brahui, it is a tragedy that a person denies his own nation himself, may you know about that.

brh: کہ قدرت تے دا ہیت کرکاک، نسل نا بچک کمزور بندہ او، اوفتے ہیت آتے یلو کرکوک کل بھلا نسل والاک، اچھا، کنا ہیت تے دا شروع کرے، نسل نا کمزور، کمزور، نہ نسل نا کسر آ کمزور بندہ
en: That nature does this: the offspring of a lineage, weak people, they are the ones who abandon their own ways; all the people of great lineage, okay, this started my point: weak of lineage, weak; no, a person weak on the path of lineage.
en_old: That nature has said this: the children of a lineage are weak people, they abandon their words, all those of great lineage, okay, my words started this: weak in lineage, weak, not weak on the path of lineage, a weak person.

brh: پر اللہ رسول اللہ کہ دا شروع کرے لوئے خبر ئے ہرا بندغ تینا قوم ذات قبیلہ بدل کیک معلوم بریک کہ اونا قبیلہ کمزور ئے نا واہ اگر وہ ہمو وٹ مثال تیسون کہ ساسوری تینے سید پارے وا معلوم بریک
en: But Allah and the Messenger of Allah, who began this, it is a great saying: whichever person changes his nation, caste or tribe, it becomes known that his tribe is weak. Well, if we give that very example, that a Sasoli calls himself a Syed, then it becomes known.
en_old: But Allah and the Messenger of Allah started this, a great saying: whichever person changes his nation, caste and tribe, it shows that his tribe is weak; if he gives that example, that a Sasoli calls himself a Syed, then it becomes known.

brh: تینا ساسولی لفظ ئ قبضہ سرپد مفس ہندا وجہ بھلو ذات سیال آ داری کمبھار او تینے قریشی پاریرہ لوہار او تینے انصاری پاریرہ او بدل مننگ نا ہندا حد ئس لگے کہ دا تینا ہمے ذات آت ہرا کہ
en: He does not understand the hold of his own word 'Sasoli'; for this very reason he claims a big caste as kin. Potters call themselves Qureshi, blacksmiths call themselves Ansari, and the changing reached such a limit that these, their very own castes, which...
en_old: One does not understand the word 'Sasoli' as a claim; for this very reason one clings to a big caste and kin; sometimes they call themselves Qureshi, the blacksmiths call themselves Ansari, and the changing went to such an extent that these are their own castes which...

brh: دا بئیلا نفرت کیرے اونا مطلب آک نما پاننگے کہ ہرا براہوئی تینا قومیت ئ بدل کننگ شروع کیرے او اسیک کم ذات آ کسر اوڑان پد گڑا دا سیاست نا رجحان لدا بل گڑا سیاست نا پد ردا خلورے اوڑا دا ہدا دے دے خبر ئکے کہ غیر منظم
en: You hate this so much; what it means is that you are saying that whichever Brahuis start changing their nationality, and one takes the path of a low caste, after that this trend in politics..., then you will push politics back; there, this is the point, that it is disorganized.
en_old: You hate this so much; what you mean is that whichever Brahui starts changing his nationality, then one goes down to the low-caste path, after that this trend of politics... then politics goes backwards, and this is what is said, that it is disorganized.

brh: دا بندغاتے ٹی ہرا کہ بلوچ آن کاریم کیرہ او ہاوی برے کاریم کیرہ۔ صحیح۔ دا بلوچ آن کاریم کیرہ۔ لالا زمانہ ٹی لولی بھاز زمانہ بلوچ آن ہاؤ بے ہاؤ بے اچھا دا سے دا دے۔ دا پروار میر ہادی سندھ نا بندغ سے دے۔
en: Among these people are those who work with the Baloch, and... also work. Right. These work with the Baloch. In olden times, for a long time, with the Baloch, yes, yes, okay, this is it. This Parwar Mir Hadi is a man from Sindh.
en_old: Among these people are those who work for the Baloch and those who work for the Hawi. Right. They work for the Baloch. In the old days, for a very long time, for the Baloch, yes, yes, okay, this is it. This Parwar Mir Hadi is a person from Sindh.

brh: دے خل، نبسہ درارے، باغی اسس، نب خل بو لکو ہمو کل باغی مچ مرو، ادہ خبر ئس بو، ایلو کسے خلور ادہ خبر ئس مرو، صحیح صحیح، اسہ وختس، کنے بھلو ڈاکٹر مگسی صاحب کنے پارے، پارے سئی، نبی دا خبر ئے کہ اسہ باغی ئس
en: Hit him...; he was a rebel; hit him, and then all those rebels will gather, there will be news there; they will hit someone else, there will be news there. Right, right. Once the great Dr. Magsi Sahib told me, he said, 'Listen, the thing is that if one rebel...'
en_old: Hit him, you have a lot left, he was a rebel; hit him and all those rebels will gather, there will be news there; they will hit someone else and there will be news there. Right, right. Once, the great Dr. Magsi Sahib told me, he said listen, the Prophet's saying is that a rebel...

brh: بیمار برے، تدا دے ٹیسٹ بجے کنے، کنے داداس بتے، اسہ باغیچ وا بیمار بسنے، بس شش سد چار سد باغیچ برو تو لو روڈ آ خاچوکو، ہراتے ہسپتالے پیش تمے، صحیح صحیح، دا بتان تل جی
en: ...falls ill; then they do tests on me there, they gave me...; one rebel had fallen ill, and then six hundred, four hundred rebels would come and lie sleeping on the road, those who had come out to the hospital. Right, right. This..., sir.
en_old: Someone falls ill, then they do a test on me, they gave me this; one gardener came sick, just six hundred, four hundred gardeners would come, so they would lie on the road, those who came out of the hospital. Right, right, this ended there, sir.

brh: دا بھلو گلاسے براہوی قومے نوجواناتی ادیباتی انت پیغامس ہنت ئس نما خوار گلاس پانے خواری ہرا ہنو گلاس کرا نما ئس پائک پانے اوڑا پائک
en: This big word: what message do you have for the young people and the writers of the Brahui nation? What is it: say your word about the hardship, the hardship which...; tell us whatever you say, tell us about that.
en_old: This great complaint of the Brahui nation, what message do you have for the young writers, what is your complaint, the hardship that you complained about, tell us, tell us about that.

brh: کنا خیال دادے الحمدللہ ئے مسلمان اٹ ئے تیناٹ ئے مال والا اولیکو کلمہ کھلم کھلا پاوہ لا الہ الا اللہ محمد رسول اللہ کسء خلیفہ ری اگر کسس پین خلیفہ ری
en: My view is this: praise be to God, I am a Muslim, I myself am a man of property; I openly say the first Kalima: 'There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.' As for whose caliph, if someone has another caliph...
en_old: My view is this: thank God, I am a Muslim, by myself I own what I have; the first Kalima I openly say: there is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; whose caliph you are, if someone is another's caliph...

brh: تو بس نظر ہفتم آ برے کہ اظہارٹی ئس جراتس مرے بس واہ واہ کنا سنگت آ تا دا خواجہ اظہارٹی جراتس مرے جراتس مرے ایلو ئس ہتسے وخت و حالت آک ئس اندازہ مفسے وخت و حالت آک ئس اندازہ مفسے بس
en: So it just seems to me that there should be courage in expression. Bravo, bravo, my friends, this, sir: there should be courage in expression, there should be courage. The other thing is that times and circumstances cannot be predicted, times and circumstances cannot be predicted. That's all.
en_old: So just the eye falls on the seventh, that there should be courage in expression; bravo, bravo, my friends, this sir, there should be courage in expression, there should be courage; the other is that times and circumstances cannot be estimated, times and circumstances cannot be estimated, that's all.

brh: ایڑو اگر نن کمزور ئس تو ازبک نن مضبوط مرو، اگر ایڑو نن مضبوط ئس تو ازبک نن کمزور مرو، تلک الایام نداولھا بین الناس، اللہ پاک نی کہ بختے ئے مقرر
en: If today we are weak, then tomorrow we will be strong; if today we are strong, then tomorrow we will be weak. 'These are the days We alternate among the people.' It is God Almighty who has ordained fortune.
en_old: Today if we are weak, then tomorrow we will be strong; if today we are strong, then tomorrow we will be weak. 'These are the days We alternate among the people.' Almighty God has ordained fortune.

brh: ئس وقت دا خواہو تو بخت برو وری ہمو خواہوتا پیش تما ایلو خواہو تو چم بخت برو ہر بندغ کن بخت آ متفق لس بندغاتے بخت مرے اورے کہ بخت بیزار سے ہرا بندغے اینو اگر جو
en: At one time, if He wills this, then fortune will come; again, that one came forward by His will; if He wills otherwise, fortune will come...; for every person, people agree on fortune; ordinary people have fortune, and there is the one whose fortune has turned away; whichever person today, if...
en_old: At a time this dream, then fortune will come, then from those dreams it emerged; the other dream, then fortune will come; for every person fortune is agreed upon, common people have fortune, and there is the one whose fortune is weary; whichever person today if...

brh: او ہرے بخت رے تو پگا جوہر نا بخت ختم مریک پروارے بیراجی نا بخت ملو اگر اینو پیرال مریک بیراجی نا بخت رے اولا بخت نا بخت مکر رے او بدر مریک تو بخت ہوش رے ختم کریو
en: And whoever has fortune, tomorrow Jauhar's fortune ends; Beraji's fortune will come to Parwar; if today... happens, Beraji's fortune remains; fortune's fortune is deceit, and it changes, so fortune... will end.
en_old: And whoever has fortune, tomorrow Jauhar's fortune ends; Parwar Beraji's fortune will be found; if today Piral it becomes, Beraji's fortune remains; fortune's fortune is deceit, and it changes, so fortune keeps its senses, it will end.

brh: واہ انشاءاللہ تعالی عزت و جرات برے آخر کار ئے تو دا دعوی کیوا اسہ دے ئس برو ہمدرد نسل ئس برو کلا گورستان تے جلا گو تے پٹیور اوفتے تلشور واہ واہ ئے پارے مستونگ
en: Bravo. God willing, honour and courage will come in the end; I make this claim: a day will come, a sympathetic generation will come, that will search all the graveyards and places and seek them out. 'Bravo, bravo,' Mastung said.
en_old: Bravo, God willing, honour and courage will come in the end; so this claim I make, that one day a sympathetic generation will come, it will dig up all the graveyards and burnt graves and search for them; bravo, bravo, said Mastung.

brh: اینو ننے دے دیگرے پگا نواب عباس برے دا وار برو او انشاءاللہ بننگٹی ئے دا وار زو بننگٹی ئے نن دروم پارینا نن اینو پارنہ او بروکا وختم پارو کہ ہرا بندغاک قوم ملک کن قربانی تسر
en: Today our day has reached evening; tomorrow Nawab Abbas comes; this time he will come, and God willing he is coming; this time he is coming soon. We said it yesterday, we are saying it today, and the coming time will also say that those people who made sacrifices for the nation and the country...
en_old: Today we have this, the evening; tomorrow Nawab Abbas comes, this time he will come, and God willing he is coming, this time he is coming soon; we said it before, we say it today, and in the coming time it will be said that those people who sacrificed for the nation and the country...

brh: او یار نظام دا ہیت نا سہی ئے ننا ابا ننا ابا ئے اورک یار کہ اینو اسکان اونا شکل ننے یاد ئے فقط او مئے یار تینا خلق والا ضعیفانہ نن
en: Oh friend Nizam, what you say is true. Our father, our father... friend, to this day we remember his face. Only He, friend, is the Creator of His creation; we are weak.
en_old: Oh friend Nizam, that's true. Our father, our father, friend... to this day we remember his face. Only He, friend, the Creator... we are weak.

brh: خدا خلیک، کینو اسکان خن پنتہ۔ خیر میرو، ہرا دے دسمستو وخت ضرور بروئے، ولے میرو کنے تو سکاریم استمان۔ کنتوم کاریم؟ ہا، دا میرو
en: God the Creator... until now [we] have not seen [Him]. Anyway, Miro, whatever day it is, the time will surely come. But Miro, I have some work for you. Work with me? Yes, this, Miro...
en_old: By God, I haven't seen it until now. Anyway Miro, whatever day the time comes, it will surely come. But Miro, I have a job for you. A job with me? Yes, this, Miro.

brh: ننا انت خدمت کنے کے؟ یار میرو، اگہ اسہ جاگہ ئس تولین او تینا ہیت پاو نی انت پاسہ؟ او، گڑا کنا اسہ شرط ئس ارے، او ایلم، نا ہر شرط کنے منظور ئے ہر ہیت نا منظور ئے کنے، او، او، ٹھیک ئے
en: What service can we do for you? Friend Miro, if we sit somewhere and I tell you my matter, what will you say? Oh, then I have one condition. Oh brother, every condition of yours is acceptable to me, every word of yours is acceptable to me. Oh, oh, all right.
en_old: What can I do for you? Friend Miro, if we sit somewhere and I tell you my matter, what will you say? Oh, then I have one condition. Oh brother, every condition of yours is accepted by me, every word of yours is accepted. Oh, oh, okay.

brh: نی تینے تک ولدا اینے پاہ کان۔ اسہ شاہ اسہ ڈیرا پلہ سرمہ سر جیتا نی دا بمبو نم۔
en: You... yourself, then again... [garbled song line] One king, one camp... you, this Bambo...
en_old: Look at yourself, then go again... A king, a camp... you, this Bambo...

brh: کسف اکونا خولیسے شیر خل جولائے تینا پیرو دا بمبو نم قصہ یو پیرو
en: [Garbled song line] ...kill... the fear... Sher Khan... his own Piro, this Bambo... the story, oh Piro.
en_old: ...Sher Khan, July... his Piro, this Bambo... the story, oh Piro.

brh: دیرس؟ پیرو! ز ز ز ز ز زلینہ توار تو بننگٹی ئے ولے جند خننگٹی اف پیر جان کنا یار داڑان مست کہ زلینہ روبرو کشتے نی
en: Who is it? Piro! Z-z-z-z-Zalina's voice can be heard, but she herself can't be seen. Pir Jan, my friend, before that, you bring Zalina out face to face.
en_old: Where are you? Piro! Z-z-z-z-Zalina, the voice can be heard but she herself can't be seen. Pir Jan, my friend, before this, show me Zalina face to face.

brh: کنے آئی سودا کرائی کرینے ئے کاوا سودا لیوے آئی نی سودا کرائی کنے مخلوق نا پوتنگاتے بٹکننگ کے پوتنگ قسم ئے کنا پوتنگاتے
en: Did you make a deal with me? What deal...? You made a deal with me to [mess with] people's bundles? Bundles, I swear, my bundles...
en_old: Have you made a deal with me? What deal... you made a deal with me to tear people's clothes? Clothes, I swear, my clothes.

brh: نرفتنٹ پوتونکاتے تو اباکان ارفے شارئے ننرا ہلیکنے ہپاو ہلیکنے ہائیکنے نی امبلو جنا سے اگر توار کرے تانوم کٹنے اینیم چاوان نہ لمیم چاوان نہ باویم چاوان نہ پور
en: I haven't taken the bundles; he took them from father... the city... it takes you... it takes you... If some man or woman calls out to you... [she] knows my name, right? Knows my mother, right? Knows my father, right? The whole...
en_old: Lift the clothes from father, the city... you, if a woman called out... she doesn't know my name, nor my mother, nor my father, not the whole...
