brh: پورا خاندانے چاوے جی نی نا پورا خاندانے چاسے پورا کنبے آننتس خواسے لیکن نی نا مسلمانی لیکن نی کنا نیتون مہر نا دشمنی ئے مہر مہر ئے ٹی تو دشمنی مفک دوستی مرے
en: ...knows the whole family, yes? You know your whole family; what do you want from the whole clan? But you, your being a Muslim... but you, is what I have with you the enmity of love? Love... in love there is no enmity; there should be friendship.
en_old: You know the whole family? Yes, you know my whole family, you want the whole clan, but you... your Muslim faith... but is it love or enmity you have with me? In love there is no enmity, there is friendship.

brh: اگر کسس نیام ٹی مس تو مہراتیم دشمنی مریک مہرانہ دشمنی دا امر وا مہرانہ دشمنی ایبم مریک پاوے الیکانے داڑا مست کہ گٹکانہ خوشبو روی الیکانے امر خلیفے ٹرے زلی دانیوس
en: If someone comes in between, then even love becomes enmity. Enmity of love, how is that? Enmity of love does happen too. Say... before the fragrance of the... [garbled]... how...
en_old: If someone comes in between, then love turns into enmity. Enmity in love, how? Enmity in love does happen. Before this, the fragrance of the flowers... how...

brh: او، سائی کنا کشاس، پیرو، بنگنوٹ نشار ایننگٹس، آہو، شار آ کاوے، تینا ابائی، ولدا کرے شاران خلقت پرے، ئے ہمو میڑی شارٹی مریوے، نہ پیرو، نی کشاس
en: Oh, you've worn me out... Piro, I've heard you're going to the city? Yes, I'm going to the city, for my father. Then... from the city, the people... I'll be in that same... in the city. No, Piro, you've worn me out.
en_old: Oh, my brother... Piro, you're bringing... to the city, yes, going to the city, his father's... then the people came from the city... that sheep is in the city... no, Piro, you...

brh: کنا قسم، شار ایمپیس۔ اگر نی پاتے، گڑا ئے شار ایمپرے۔ ٹھیک کن کنا قسم؟ نا قسم۔ کانو۔ جوان تئی تے
en: By my oath, don't go to the city. If you say so, then I won't go to the city. Fine, swear on me? On you. Let's go. Good...
en_old: I swear, I won't take you to the city. If you say so, then I won't take you to the city. Okay, swear on me? I swear on you. Go. Take care.

brh: نی پاشا کہ جمال ثناء تو برام کروئی ہاؤ نظام، اگی جمال اوڑتون برام کرے تو گڑا کنا انتس مروئی؟ انت؟ نی ہم؟ ہم، ئے
en: You're saying that Jamal should marry Sana, right, Nizam? If Jamal marries her, then what will become of me? What? You too? Me too, yes.
en_old: You say that Jamal must marry Sana, oh Nizam. If Jamal marries her, then what will become of me? What? You too? Yes, me too.

brh: نی ہم، ہلی تے، نی ہم، ہاؤ ئے ہم، ئنا جی گڑا پاریس کنا ہر شرط کنے منظور ئے نظام، پین وخت کنتون
en: You too... you too? Yes, me too. Well then, you said every condition of mine was acceptable to you, Nizam. Another time, with me...
en_old: You too, leave it, you too, yes, me too. Yes, then I said every condition of yours is accepted by me, Nizam. Another time with me...

brh: دو نی اتکپیس انتئے کہ ثناء کنے باز باز کنے باز دوست ئے ہا نا نا میرو نی تو کنا سنگت ئس یار میرو اگر جمال ثناء تو برام کرے گڑا
en: ...don't talk like that, because I love Sana very, very much. Yes, no, no, Miro, you are my friend. Friend Miro, if Jamal marries Sana, then...
en_old: You didn't come, because Sana loves me very, very much. Yes, no, no, Miro, you are my friend. Friend Miro, if Jamal marries Sana, then...

brh: اگی جمال ثناء تون برام کرے؟ نا، گڑا ئے نی ارٹوم ئے دے بابی پانہ۔ بش این چاسہ، ئے پاو نی عقل دار مرو، نی عقل نا پیدل ئس
en: If Jamal marries Sana? No, then you and I both... [unclear]. Well, you know, I'd have said you were sensible, but you're a dimwit.
en_old: What if Jamal marries Sana? No, then I'll call you... Well, you know, I'd have said you were wise, but you're a fool.

brh: زری کنا مسے انتئے نیتون
en: My Zari, what has happened with you, why?
en_old: Zari, what happened between me and you?

brh: ئے تو ہچ پاتنوٹ نی اسینہ تو گڑاس پاتنے نی ابا، اسینہ نا مجال کہ کنے ہیتس پائے۔ گڑا نی انتئے دون پریشان ئس بابا؟ ابا۔۔۔
en: I haven't said anything at all. Has Asina said something to you? Father, Asina wouldn't dare say a word to me. Then why are you so worried, father? Father...
en_old: I didn't say anything. Did you say something to Asina? Father, Asina wouldn't dare say a word to me. Then why are you so worried, father? Father...

brh: پیرو شار ایننگٹی شار باز بلو نی دن کہ ماما شیر خان شار اینا اور گوئنگا دن مف پیرو ہم شار اینوئی گوئنگوئے اور پیرو کونہ سادہ اینگا بندغک شارٹی زو گوئنگرے نی دے پارے کہ او شار
en: Piro is going to the city. The city is very big. Like how Uncle Sher Khan went to the city and got lost; may it not be that Piro too goes to the city and gets lost. And simple people like Piro get lost quickly in the city. Did you tell him that the city...
en_old: Piro is going to the city. The city is very big. Don't let it be like Uncle Sher Khan, who went to the city and got lost. Piro is going to the city too, he'll get lost. And Piro, simple people get lost quickly in the city. You told him that the city...

brh: پاننگے؟ ابا پیرو تینٹ پارے کہ شار آ کاوت اینا باوے پٹے وا۔ تو گڑا نی گل بے بے تو عید کیتوس کہ وئی پیرو تون پاننگے؟ پگا عید کیوا۔ بلے ابا نی ہم پو کتا پیرو کونا شست سادہ اینگا بندغ۔
en: Telling him? Father, Piro himself said, 'I'll go to the city and search for my father.' So then, have you talked with Gul Bibi, so that she talks with Piro? I'll talk to her tomorrow. But father, you too explain it to him; Piro is such a simple person.
en_old: Saying? Father Piro himself said that he'd look for the father in the city. So then, Gul Bibi, did you celebrate Eid, that you're talking with Piro? We'll celebrate Eid tomorrow. But Father, you too... Piro is such a simple, plain person.

brh: داک شارٹی زو گوئنگرا۔ او، کنے مسٹ نی پریشان کپیس تنے۔ تو ئے اونا ماما تون ایتکی وا، اوف تینٹ فوکیرت۔
en: Such people get lost quickly in the city. Oh, don't you go worrying yourself. So I'll talk with his uncle; he himself will make him understand.
en_old: Now, Shorty, quickly... Oh, you shouldn't be worrying me. So hand him over to his uncle; they'll sort it out themselves.

brh: اوئے اوئے ہن مس ہائے بس کنا پوتوک گتہ فشارا کا
en: Ow, ow... ow, enough! My bundle... it's being squeezed!
en_old: Oh, oh, it's happened, oh no, my... my throat was squeezed.

brh: او عمر گنوک تو متنس شار اینار جوان جوان انگا کوئنگار نی تو سادہ عمر اسس
en: Oh Umar, you haven't gone crazy, have you? People went to the city, and very fine people got lost; you are just a simple Umar.
en_old: Oh, Umar wasn't crazy. People go to the city, and even really good people get lost. You're just a simple Umar.

brh: ایلے تے کھائے او او چپٹ نی نہ شہر خنانوس نہ شہر والاتے خنانوس تو بندغے ہندن قبضہ کیرے ہندن کہ باوائے نا ڈین قبضہ کرے او نا عشق ٹی نی ہم گیرام کرے کنے ہم گیرام کرے پیرو ہم گیر
en: Leave it... oh, oh... you have seen neither the city nor the city people; they take hold of a person just the way the witch took hold of your father. In her love he forgot you too, he forgot me too, Piro too...
en_old: Look at the others, oh... you've never seen the city, and you've never seen city people, so he takes hold of a person just the way Bawa's... took hold. In his love you got lost too, I got lost too, Piro got lost too.

brh: بلکہ مچا شہر والا تے گرام کرے
en: In fact, he forgot all the people of the city.
en_old: In fact, he made all the city people lose their way.

brh: صاف یہ قوم قومیت کے زبان سے زبان سے دا سدابروپو کہ بلوچستان ٹی یا سندھ ٹی یا پاکستان ٹی ٹھیک ہی براہوئی قوم براہوئی
en: Clearly, this nation and nationality [come] from language, from language; it has always been this way, that in Balochistan or in Sindh or in Pakistan, rightly, the Brahui nation, Brahui...
en_old: Clearly, this nation and nationality come from language, from language. It has always been this way, whether in Balochistan, in Sindh or in Pakistan: rightly, the Brahui nation, Brahui...

brh: زبان نا بارہ اٹ ہرا کوم اٹ ئے خلوص اٹ چا کہ کہ زبان نا اسہ کوم ئس درکار ارے جی۔ نہ او تے پارہ کہ اسے کوم نا ایرا مسٹ پنچ داسہ تو پنچ زبان بس سلوسنو۔ مالو ایرا زبان نا گپ کرے ماشاءاللہ داسہ پرمانا پنچ زبان دا بلوچ نا زبان او۔
en: About language: whichever nation it belongs to, know sincerely that a language needs a nation, sir. It's not as they say, that one nation's two, three, five... now five languages simply stand. Earlier he talked about two languages; mashallah, now by his account five languages: this is the Baloch's language, and...
en_old: As for the language, which nation it belongs to, know sincerely that a language needs a nation. It's not that they say one nation's two became five, so now five languages are left. Earlier he talked about two languages; mashallah, now according to him there are five languages, and this is the language of the Baloch.

brh: او ہرا بیس سال ئس نا ہب جنی آ تاریخ اٹ ہنشان ہرا کہ کوم ئس پٹ
en: And which... of some twenty years... in history the sign... which a nation... searched...
en_old: The one that, in about twenty years of history, showed... that a nation searched...

brh: اسے تسکرے دور اسے ٹی نشان تس اسے بندغس پئے چیکو سلاوے کا ولا من وقت ئس آن پد او چیکو چیکو سلاوے کا ہمو کے جنگ کرے ٹکو ٹکو مسرے دا ہتہ ہرفو نی ہتہ
en: In one era, someone showed [an example]: a person... [garbled]... after some time those... fought, and they broke into pieces. 'Pick this up... you, bring...'
en_old: In one era, someone showed... a person... small... after some time, those small... fought, broke into pieces. Take this hand, you, the hand...

brh: ہرا ہرا پر خاموش زبانہ بندہ مرو ہرا ٹی نا ولشت خراب ہرا ٹی نا ولشت خراب
en: Whichever, whichever... would be a person of a silent tongue, in which your upbringing is spoiled, in which your upbringing is spoiled.
en_old: Whichever, whichever... would be a person of silent language, in which your... is bad, in which your... is bad.

brh: ہمک ہمک شاندار و ہمک عظیم و ہمک قوم نا رہنمائی نا حق ادا کریر و ہمک قوم نا رہنما و نن براہوئی زبان نا ہراتوما ہیتے کرون براہوئی قومی تحریک نا ہراتوما ہیتے کرون ہراتوما اوفتا رہنما تا ہیتے کرون تو ہمو
en: Those, those were splendid, and they were great, and they fulfilled the duty of leading the nation, and they are the leaders of the nation. Whenever we talk about the Brahui language, whenever we talk about the Brahui national movement, whenever we talk about their leaders, then that...
en_old: Each of them was splendid and each was great, and each fulfilled the duty of leading the nation, each a leader of the nation. Whenever we talk about the Brahui language, whenever we talk about the Brahui national movement, whenever we talk about their leaders, then that

brh: رہبر ننا ماتی ٹی یقینا ننے جوہر براہوئی مون مستی مون مستی برزا نظر برو ننا سائیں ئے ننا مرشد ئے ننا لیڈر ئے ننا رہبر ئے او ننا دعا ئے کہ اللہ اودے سلامت تخے اودے آباد تخے باز مہربانی باز مہربانی اللہ حافظ
en: Our guide: surely, in our land, we will see Jauhar Brahui at the very front, at the very front, high above. He is our master, he is our mentor, he is our leader, he is our guide, and our prayer is that God keeps him safe and keeps him prosperous. Thank you very much, thank you very much. God be with you.
en_old: Our guide in our homeland. Surely Jauhar Brahui will be seen moving forward, ever forward and higher. He is our master, our mentor, our leader, our guide, and our prayer is that God keeps him safe and keeps him thriving. Thank you very much, thank you very much, God be with you.

brh: ارے آدمی ہمکون انکے تستہ او ہمکونگ ہنتئے کہ او خدا نا مونا شیطان نا ہیتے منار او اوف خدا نا نافرمان جوڑ مسر ہنتئے کہ خدا پاک ئے او گناہ گارونا مونا سلنگ کپک گڑا خدا آدم او حوا
en: The man... from there... and from there, because they obeyed Satan's word before God and became disobedient to God. Because God is holy and cannot stand in the presence of sinners, God [drove] Adam and Eve
en_old: Adam and Eve were driven out from there, because they listened to Satan's words over God, and they became disobedient to God. Because God is holy and cannot bear sinners before Him, God Adam and Eve

brh: آئی باغ عدن آن کشا اوفک خدانا حکمی منیتویسور اناڑان شکی اسور ہنا سبب آن آدم حوا او اوفتا نسلی ڈکھ و مرگنا سزارا سینگا مہروانا خدانا استٹی اسکی او امر آدم
en: out of the Garden of Eden. They had not obeyed God's command, so they were guilty, and because of this the punishment of suffering and death came upon Adam, Eve and their descendants. Yet it was in the heart of the merciful God how Adam
en_old: He drove them out of the Garden of Eden. They did not obey God's command and were sinful. Because of this, Adam and Eve and their descendants received the punishment of suffering and death. Yet it was in the heart of the merciful God that Adam

brh: آدم تون ودا سیالی ء گنڈے تانکہ او ہر وقت اونا بادشاہی ٹی رہنگے پاکا کلام ٹی خدا تینا ارادے دن درشان کیک کہ انسان ہرا سزانہ کہ حقدار ئس
en: could again be bound in a relationship with Him, so that he would live in His kingdom forever. In the holy Word God reveals His intention like this: the punishment that man deserved,
en_old: would again bind a relationship with Adam, so that he would always live in His kingdom. In the holy Word, God reveals His intention this way: that the punishment which man deserved

brh: دارس او دے اوڑان چٹفنگے او اونا شکی گریئے چٹفنگے تاکہ انسان پدائے خدانا بادشاہی ٹی رینینگ کے۔ خدا تینا دا ارادہ نا اسے بشخس ابراہیم آ ظاہر کرے
en: He would free him from it and free him from his guilt, so that man could again live in God's kingdom. God revealed a part of this intention of His to Abraham.
en_old: would someday save him from it and save him from his sinfulness, so that mankind could again live in God's kingdom. God revealed a part of this intention of His to Abraham.

brh: ابراہیم خدا نا فرمانبرداری ء کرے او اونا بلو نیت ء منا۔ خدا ابراہیم ء برکت بخشنگ او اونا وسیلت دنیا نا قوماتے برکت تننگ نا قول ء کرے۔
en: Abraham obeyed God and accepted His great purpose. God made a promise to bless Abraham and, through him, to give blessing to the nations of the world.
en_old: Abraham obeyed God and accepted His great purpose. God promised to bless Abraham and, through him, to bless the nations of the world.

brh: خدا دا قول ہم کرے کہ ئے ننا نسل ء ودی فسا آسمان نا استار و دریا نا ریکا تیانبار کروچ۔ ابراہیم خدا غا ایمان ایس ہنا سبب آن خدا اودے تینا نیکی انگا بندغاتیٹی اوار کرے۔
en: God also made this promise: 'I will multiply your descendants and make them like the stars of the sky and the sand of the sea.' Abraham put his faith in God, and because of this God counted him among His righteous people.
en_old: God also promised: "I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars of the sky and the sand of the sea." Abraham believed in God, and because of this God counted him among His righteous people.

brh: اسے دے خدا ابراھیم ء ہرا کہ او اوڑا بھروسہ کیک او اونا حکم ء منک یانہ او ابراھیم ء پارے کہ تینا مار ء کنکے خیرات کر ابراھیم چائسکہ کہ ہنا مار نا وسیلہ اٹ خدا اونا نسل ء ودفنگ نا
en: One day God, [to see] whether Abraham trusted Him and obeyed His command or not, said to Abraham, 'Give your son to Me as an offering.' Abraham knew that it was through that son that God [had promised] to multiply his descendants
en_old: One day God tested Abraham to see whether he trusted Him and obeyed His command or not, and He told Abraham, "Offer your son to Me as a sacrifice." Abraham knew that through his son God had promised to multiply his descendants,

brh: کولی کرے نی ولدا ہم او خدا غا بھروسہ کرے او اونا حکم ء منا ہندا خاطران او تینا مارے خدا کن خیرات کننگ کن تیار مس
en: he had made a promise. Even so, he trusted God and obeyed His command, and for this reason he became ready to offer his son to God.
en_old: had promised. Still, he trusted God again and obeyed His command; that is why he was ready to sacrifice his son for God.

brh: ابراہیم تینا چاکوئے ہرفے
en: Abraham took up his knife.
en_old: Abraham took his knife.

brh: او چنائے قربان کننگ کن روانہ مس ہر وقت او تینا مارے قربان کننگ کن لیٹیفے تو خدا پارے کہ ئے جوان چاوہ کہ نی کنے آن خلیسہ او کنا حکمے منیسہ ولدا ابراہیم خنا کہ اونا مونا خڈاسے
en: And he set out to sacrifice the child. When he laid his son down to sacrifice him, God said, 'I know well that you fear Me and obey My command.' Then Abraham saw that in front of him was a ram
en_old: He set off to sacrifice the child. When he laid his son down to sacrifice him, God said, "I know well that you fear Me and obey My command." Then Abraham saw a ram in front of him.

brh: او مرغاک دا جرات اٹی او ابراہیم او کھڑے ارفے او خدا کین خیرات کرے مہروانا خدا ابراہیم نا مار نا بدل اٹ کہ کھڑس رسیفینے تو دن چا کے او انسان تیا تینا مہر ء ظاہر کرے
en: with its horns [caught] in this thicket. Abraham took that ram and offered it to God. The merciful God had provided a ram in place of Abraham's son, and in this way He showed His love to mankind.
en_old: And with this courage, Abraham took the ram and sacrificed it to God. The merciful God provided a ram in place of Abraham's son, and in this way He showed His love to mankind.

brh: اونا مہر انو نی دنکہ باوا نا مہر مارا کنے۔ دا قصہ غان خدا دا ہیتے ظاہر کرے نی کہ او انسان نا گناہ تا سلنگ کن خیرات و قربانی نا بندوبست کرے نی خدا تینا پاکا کلام اٹ
en: His love is like a father's love for his son. Through this story God showed that He arranged an offering and a sacrifice to wash away mankind's sins. In His holy Word, God
en_old: His love is like a father's love for his son. Through this story God showed that He provided a sacrifice and offering for the removal of mankind's sins. In His holy Word, God

brh: نبی تا وسیلہ اٹ دا اظہار کرے کہ او بنی آدم نا گناہ و شکی گری تے مر کننگ کن اسہ بے گناہ و بندغ ئس مون تروئی او دا بھلا قربانی نا ذریعہ اٹ ایمان اتوک آتیکن خدا تون خڑک مننگ نا درگہ ء ملیک تانکہ او

en: Take this boat out into the middle of the water, and let down your nets into the water to catch fish. — O master, all night we let down the nets into the water to catch fish, but nothing was caught.
en_old: Take this boat out into the middle of the water, and let down your nets into the water to catch fish. Master, we let down the nets into the water all night to catch fish, but we caught nothing.

brh: ولے ئے تینا چالی دیرٹی بٹی وا، انتئے کہ نی پاسہ۔ یعقوب! یوانا!
en: But I will let down my net into the water, because you say so. James! John!
en_old: But I will let down my net into the water, because you say so. James! John!

brh: اوک، یونا، تینا کستی ء دانگا تپو، ہمونا مدد ء کبو، زو، ہن تپانے، نن مصروف آن شاباش زو
en: Hey, John, bring your boat over this way, help that one, quick, come on... we are busy, well done, quick!
en_old: Hey, John, bring your boat over here, help them, quickly, come on, pull, we're busy, well done, quickly!

brh: خواجہ کنا خوڑ کانے
en: Master, go away from me.
en_old: Master, go away from me.

brh: ئے گناہ گار بندغ ئس اٹ، نی خلیفہ ئس خدا نا کلام ء ایلو مخلوق آتیا رسفیسہ۔
en: I am a sinful man. — You, as a deputy, will carry God's word to other people.
en_old: I am a sinful man. You will be one who carries God's word to other people.

brh: کنا ہیتاتے بنبو، کنا شاگرد مبو، او نم ہمیشنا زندگی ئس حاصل کیرے، ہمو وخت اسکان کہ موکارے تو خدا نا کسر آ ببو، او اونا مدد تے خواہبو، ئے گناہگار آک تینا گناہ تے الیبو، او گناہ نا بارہ وٹ سوچ کپبو۔
en: Listen to my words, become my disciples, and you will gain eternal life. Until that time [...], come onto God's path and ask for his help. O sinners, leave your sins, and do not think about sin.
en_old: Listen to my words, become my disciples, and you will gain eternal life. As long as you live, follow the path of God and ask for His help. You sinners, leave your sins, and do not think about sin.

brh: کنا کھیاپا ہمدا تعویز نا اسر ختم مسنے داسہ۔ ہندا خاطر نی الا نراینہ۔ داسہ ولے اینو شیر خان نا کاریم تے ہم نیک کروئی تمک۔ ہبوئی کنکے ہمدا تو۔
en: In my view, the effect of this same amulet has worn off now. That's why he has run off from you. But now, today, Sher Khan's affairs also have to be set right. So that same one has to be got for me too, then.
en_old: I think the amulet's effect has worn off now. That's why you don't... But today Sher Khan's work also has to be done properly. I'll take care of it.

brh: کنے ہم فکری۔ نہ زو زو کاری مفک نین۔ گال لگے تو کنا؟ مشکل اسیٹی لگے فٹ۔ جی۔ الہ توسس۔ الہ مکیو۔ تو دا نوتے در تیخک دیسس۔
en: I'm worried too. No, things don't get done that quickly. Did my word take effect? It has got stuck in some difficulty. Yes. Yes, you've sat down. Yes... So take these notes and put them down.
en_old: I'm worried too. Things don't get done that quickly. Did you get hurt? I'm in some trouble. Yes. Oh God, ... So he gave out these new ones.

brh: کنا مونا تے خاستہ، درتہ کنا مونی انتو رنگٹ یوز، وا کٹ نمفک، ہمو کہ پٹاٹہ غاتے پیماستے ہتیس ٹکر کننگ کے
en: [Put it] in front of me, take it. In front of me, what way is this to use it? Oh, it won't cut, those potatoes and onions you brought to chop.
en_old: In front of me... what color... it won't break, the one who smashed the bottles...

brh: بنسہ یا نہ دا دے دا بے سوتہ ئے تے بن جی توش نہ
en: Do you hear me or not? Listen to this, this senseless one! Listen. Yes...
en_old: Did you hear or not? This day, this... listen, yes, enough.

brh: تولنگ اٹ توسٹہ جی حکم کبو این کاری بازے ایتے بن جی جی
en: I was sitting. Yes, give your orders. There's a lot of work today... listen. Yes, yes.
en_old: I was sitting. Yes, give the order, what is the job... listen, yes, yes.

brh: داسہ کا زلیخا غستے مچے ئے واپس بریو رزانک سلوک مریر دیگ تیار مرے ایراغاتے بسس ئے بنگن مریو زو او جان خدا دے نی ہن پارے ئے برٹ مچے زو
en: Now go, Zulekha, I'll be back in a little while. The dishes have to be washed and the pot has to be ready; cook the food, they'll get hungry. Quickly, oh dear! For God's sake, go... come quickly.
en_old: Now Zulekha, bring all the rice back. The guests will be arriving, the pot should be ready. Come quickly, oh dear, by God... come, everyone, quickly.

brh: بریس انت کہ زو بریم دا دے کنے چکوئی نا مچے بہتر زیادہ ئے یا کم ئے اوئے کنا قسمت
en: [You say] come, but why should I come quickly? I have to taste a little of this of yours: is it better, is there too much or too little? Oh, my fate!
en_old: Why did you come? Come quickly, today I have to... whether it's more or less, that's my fate.

brh: اگر برام دادے پارہ خدا سے بندغے برام تے دادے دے فرغانے دادے داد تو او خلیس تنے پنر ہاؤ دا سادھ رسسکہ نتسکہ
en: If this is what they call a wedding... for God's sake, a person's wedding... yes, has this [word] reached you or not?
en_old: If I come, say this, God... a person... did he give you the news or not?

brh: دا تانگی چرینگاکا لگا گڑا سے تو پنا نی است مارے نی سمائی کہ دا کنا بلہ نا دوانا نشانی اسے کہ کنا بلہ ء کنا لمہ ء دستہ او ولدا کنے
en: This was moving about, it hit something, and so it broke. Don't you know that this is a keepsake from my grandmother's hand, which my grandmother passed to my mother and then [she passed] to me?
en_old: This rug looks like something special. Your heart... you know this is a keepsake from my grandmother's hand, which my grandmother gave to my mother and then she gave to me.

brh: دستہ، نی دا لکھ مراد آ پیالا مروست مس کہ نی پرغاس بلائت آ جلاس۔ جی مچے شیر چا شاغاٹیٹ تپرتہ نوئی مچے کونے ویٹ تا۔ شیر چا کونے، گندا خاطرا نا کنے دے گنا سمائی
en: ...passed on. You... this cup of a hundred thousand wishes, that you broke it...! Yes, I was pouring a little milk tea, I didn't know... [for you] to drink a little. Milk tea to drink, that's why... do you know?
en_old: Hand... you were afraid you'd get burned. Yes, I poured all the milk tea, I didn't know... milk tea... for that reason I...

brh: ننے کاریم نا سمائی نی چڑا کون! چڑا تولٹ کوناک! داسہ انت مونی کنا ہورنگاٹی ئس دانا بلا غاتے تو جلہ! پین وار دم کپیس پاننگاٹی اٹ نی اشو کپو۔
en: We're the ones who know about work; you just eat! You just sit and eat! And now what, right in front of me, while I'm watching, you put up with this one's mischief! Next time don't you dare, I'm telling you, you won't do that.
en_old: You have no idea about our work, you just eat! Sit down and eat! Now what, right in front of my eyes, these troubles of his... Next time don't, when I'm telling you, you won't do that.

brh: دین و رزاق پینٹ نا کاٹومے نا پرغوٹ۔ ابو ئے بسوٹ پچاتے سلس ولدا۔ گلو دا پچ والا کاریم اگا متوکا جوان الاؤ۔ دے پچ والا کاریم؟
en: Din and Razzaq, I'll rip the top of your pants! Dad, I came and washed the clothes again. Gulu, wouldn't it be nice if there were no laundry chore? What laundry chore?
en_old: Din and Razzaq, the top of the pants is torn. Father came and washed the clothes again. Brother, it would have been good if this clothes business hadn't happened. What clothes business?

brh: گڑا دے ہم چائے کا برے رسلے رتا سلوئی تو نی ارے کاری متے کلے کروئی نی اگر اینو کیس تئی آ پگا کیس تئی آ گڑا خیر اگر اینو متو
en: Then the tea things also have to be washed; you have chores, you have to finish all of them. If you do them today, it's up to you; if tomorrow, it's up to you. Well, if not today, then...
en_old: Then also tea... you have to wash it... you have work you have to finish; if not today, then tomorrow... well, if not today...

brh: او ولدا پگہ تو نی سلوئیے تر ئے بسوٹ تیرا غا تیار مریر بس ایڑ سکی نی دعا ککے کنا ایلمو تے خیر خوشی اٹ کارہ تیر
en: And then tomorrow you'll have to wash them; by the time I come back they'll be ready. That's all, dear sister. Pray that my brothers go about and come back in well-being and happiness.
en_old: And then tomorrow you have to wash it... they'll get ready by the time you come back... that's it. Pray that my brothers pass their days in well-being and happiness.

brh: کنا ڈیوٹی تھمے ئے گڑا اوڑتو نموکارے مکرٹ نیکے خبر ئس کائے مائنا پین الپروئے گڑا ہرس کنا ہمپین گلب بے بے مفرورئے اینے جان چاوہ نی اندوں کروس
en: My duty is over; then I didn't do anything with him... some news for you... won't let ours go again. Then my namesake Gulab Bibi has run away. Dear, I knew you would do something like this.
en_old: My duty is finished, then I didn't do anything with him, I didn't tell you anything... then my companion... dear, do you know what you did?

brh: خواجہ خواجہ بش مکن دکان ملنگے احمد صبا توکلے بشما او
en: Khwaja, Khwaja, get up, the shop has to be opened! Ahmed, Saba, Tawakkal, get up!
en_old: Sir, sir, don't get up, don't leave the shop. Ahmed, Saba, Tawakkal, get up!

brh: ئے داڑے دم درینگاسٹ ابا مچے خن کنا لکاٹ آرام کرے داڑے نی دا ابا نی داڑے کنا ماتے معلومے خنانوس
en: I had sat down here to rest, father. I dozed off a little and rested here. You, father, here... do you know about my mother? Have you seen her?
en_old: I've rested here a while, father, I closed my eyes a little and rested. You, father, here... my mother knows, I saw you.

brh: چاوا گنوک مسن، نہ مات خننوٹ، نہ معلوم اینا، ہاں، گڑا ئے دیرے نریفے وا، کنے خبر اف دکان نا مونا خدی، جوان گڑا گلشن سے کیسہ، او، کاوا
en: Maybe I've gone mad. I haven't seen my mother, I don't know [where she is]. Yes. Then who would have chased her off? I don't know... in front of the shop... All right then... Gulshan... Oh, I'm going.
en_old: Look, I've gone crazy, I couldn't see my mother, I don't know... yes, then he's late, he'll run away, I don't know, in front of the shop... alright then, do you have a garden... oh, come.

brh: یرا جان داد خان دا دغار ہراستہ ہمم دا دغار کنائے دا تونا مار داد ئے قبضہ کیوئے آ گڑا ئے کونڈے گڑا کن کنے لنگٹ ایوسا لیکن یرا ئے کونڈو ڈورے وئی یرا نا دغار ہم تو ہمے کونڈو
en: Hey, dear Dad Khan, this land, whose is it? Hmm, this land is mine! This son of yours is going to seize it, Dad. Then that corner... then you give me a hard time... But friend, that corner is far away; friend, your land is also in that same corner.
en_old: Hey dear Dad Khan, this land, whose is it? This land is mine, and that son of yours, Dad, is taking it over. Then the hill... you give me a hard time, but hey, that hill is far away, hey, your land is also on that same hill.

brh: گونڈاتی، تینا دغار تو اوار کتہ؟ یار داڑے مچے سوچوئی تمک، خیر کانہ گڈا ہمو کنڈی غوری نا؟ ہمو کنڈا پین دے ئس کانہ یار، داسہ غوری مننگٹی ء۔ تو آن یار کنے ہم کاریم یاد بس، کانہ گڈا۔ ہا کانہ، اوکے۔
en: In that corner, did you merge it with your own land? Man, one has to think a bit here. Well, shall we go then to that side, Ghori's? We'll go to that side another day, man; it's getting late now. And man, I've also remembered some work, so let's go then. Yes, let's go, okay.
en_old: Gondati, did you also join your land? Man, here you have to think a bit. Well, then shall I go to that hill of Ghori? I'll go to that hill another day, man, it's getting late now. Then, man, I also remembered some work, so I'll go then. Yes, I'll go, okay.

brh: ادا پیرنگا بس کہ کرایہ ایتے او پیرنگا!
en: Hey, old man, come on, give the fare, old man!
en_old: He has grown old here, so pay the fare, he has grown old!

brh: او ہمزہ کلینڈر کرائے خوانگے دیرے پیرنگا پارس نی پارت نا بروتک پیہنو کنا ریش فقط ئنا فرق ہی کرائے ایت ایتے وا کرائے عجیب زمانہ سے
en: Oh Hamza, the cleaner is asking for the fare. Who's the old man? You say it: your moustache is white, and my beard; it's only a small difference. Give the fare, give it. The fare! What a strange time this is.
en_old: Oh Hamza, the conductor asks for the fare; he's been late, he got old. You said your mustache has gone white; my beard... it's only a difference of... give the fare, give it. What a strange time this is.

brh: ارے استاد استاد ہند مست نمے او اسل مونی پیش اسل مونی پیش ہند مست نمے ماما پیرم گا ہند مستک انتک جنگ کننگٹی اورے
en: Hey driver, driver, stop for us right here! Oh, not any further ahead at all, not further ahead! Stop for us right here! For the old uncle, stop right here. Why are you fighting?
en_old: Hey driver, driver, stop for us! Hey, not in front at all, not in front, stop for us. Uncle has grown old, stop. Why are they fighting?

brh: کس کنا جیبے خلکونے جیبے کنا کس خلکونے جیبے کنا کس خلتنے نادو کنا جیب ہٹی ئے ارے ارے بس کو ماما بس خیر سے اللہ خیر کے توم کرے جیبے کنا بیزار
en: Someone has picked my pocket! My pocket, someone has picked it! My pocket... nobody picked it, it's your hand in my pocket! Hey, hey, enough, uncle, enough. It's fine, may God make it well... my pocket... I'm fed up.
en_old: Someone has picked my pocket! Someone picked my pocket! Someone has picked my pocket! ... my pocket is there, hey, hey. That's enough, uncle, enough. All is well, may God keep it well... my pocket... I'm fed up.

brh: نا پیسہ غاتا گم مننگا۔ معاف کیس۔ کریٹ نا معاف۔ سور کریس۔ تھینک یو تھینک یو۔ ارانگے نردہ پیسہ غا۔ بس نا پیسہ غاک۔ ایلے پیسہ غاکو۔ ئے تے وجا غا۔
en: Your money got lost. Forgive me. I've forgiven you. Sorry. Thank you, thank you. Where did the money go? It's the bus money... the money... for that reason.
en_old: Your money got lost. Forgive me. I forgave you. You made me angry. Thank you, thank you. ...the money. That's the bus money. Give the money... for that reason.

brh: دا بس مہربانی کان ایڑے چا متے نی مہربانی استاد
en: That's it, please. Let's go over there... thank you, driver.
en_old: That's enough, please, let me see over here; thank you, driver.

brh: پیرو پیرجان جوان مسکنے خنک پیرجان ئے کنے وارس جی
en: Piro, Pir Jan, it went well. Look, Pir Jan, did you call me? Yes.
en_old: Piro, Pirjan, it's good... see Pirjan, call me, yes.

brh: ہی خیری۔ بے بے جان دفتہ ہت۔ ارفیوتا۔
en: Hey, all is well. Bibi Jan, bring it this time. I'll take it.
en_old: Hey, all is well. Bebe Jan, bring it this time. I'll take it.

brh: چنے ئے پدی ہناٹ، کنے
en: I went after the child, me...
en_old: I went after the child, me...

brh: است کنا اوشاس، بے اوشاس، ہمو کہ ظالم پولیس کنے، نی ہم پولیسہ، ئے مگین سار سوپٹ، انسان سوپٹ
en: My heart burned, really burned. That cruel police [did this to] me; you're police too. I'm a... I'm a human being, a human being!
en_old: My heart is burning, let it burn... that cruel police [beat] me; you're the police too... I'm a human being, I'm a human being.

brh: نی کل نیاڑی تے مبارک اوس مبارک او چنا کہ نیا پیدا مریک ئے کنا سلام نا توارے بنگوٹ چنا خوشین پڈٹی سورا کنا سا خدا نا پن آن داستی کے
en: You are blessed among all women, and blessed is the child who will be born to you. When I heard the sound of the greeting to me, the child moved with joy in my womb. My soul praises the name of God.
en_old: You are blessed among all women, and blessed is the child who will be born to you. When I heard the sound of your greeting, the child leapt for joy in my womb. My soul praises the name of God.

brh: او کنا روح کنا خواجہ خدا غا خاش مس اینو آن پد ہر زمانہ نا بندغ کنے مبارک پارور
en: And my spirit has rejoiced in my Lord God; from today on, people of every age will call me blessed.
en_old: And my spirit rejoiced in God, my Lord. From now on, people of every generation will call me blessed.

brh: دا ہشتو قیصر اگستس نا حکم نا مطابق گلیل و یہودیہ نا مچا رہینگوک آک مردم شماری کن تینا تینا باوا و پیرا غاتا شار تیٹی تینا پن تے نبشتہ کبو
en: Thus, according to the order of Caesar Augustus, all the residents of Galilee and Judea were to register their names for the census, each in the towns of their own fathers and grandfathers.
en_old: So, according to the order of Caesar Augustus, all the residents of Galilee and Judea were to register their names for the census in the towns of their fathers and ancestors.

brh: مریم یہودا نا بیت اللحم ٹی تینا دشتار یوسف تون اوار پن نوشتہ کننگ کن ہنا۔
en: Mary went with her betrothed, Joseph, to Bethlehem in Judea to register their names.
en_old: Mary went with her husband Joseph to Bethlehem in Judea to register their names.

brh: ولے بیت الحم اٹی اوڑکن ہچو جاگہ ئس الو جاگہ رسینگا تو سادہ آ تاخور اٹ
en: But in Bethlehem there was no place for her; the only place that was found was a simple stable (manger).
en_old: But there was no room for them in Bethlehem; the only place they found was a simple stable.

brh: ہمو ملک نا خورک نا علاقہ ٹی شوانک نن نا وخت آ تینا کور نا خیال داری کریرہ۔ خدا نا اسہ ملائکہ اوفتہ مونا ظاہر مس اوفتہ چار مکنڈ خدا نا نور ئس ہکا۔
en: In the area near that land, shepherds were watching over their flock at night. An angel of God appeared before them, and a light of God shone all around them.
en_old: In the countryside of that land, shepherds were watching over their flocks at night. An angel of God appeared before them, and a light of God shone all around them.

brh: اینو نا دے آ بیت اللحم شارٹی خدا نا مقرر کروکا او نما نجات تروکا ودی مسنے۔ شوانک زوزو شار ئے نار اوڑے۔
en: Today in the town of Bethlehem the one appointed by God, your Savior, has been born. The shepherds quickly ran to the town; there
en_old: Today, in the town of Bethlehem, your Savior, appointed by God, has been born. The shepherds hurried off to the town.

brh: تولوک آ لوما واخرٹی لیٹوک آ چنائے خنار، داکان پد اوف دا قصہ اولیکو وار ایلوفتے سر کریر۔
en: they saw the mother sitting and the child lying in the manger. After that they told this story to others for the first time.
en_old: They found the child lying in the manger, and after that they told this story to others for the first time.

brh: ہفتہ سے پد چنا نا سنت نا وخت بس او نا پین عیسی تخنگا پد مریم و یوسف چنائے خداوند نا مون اٹ پیش کننگ کن دریر عبادت خانہ ٹی اسے نیک و راست پاروک و بندغ ئس ئس اوڑا خدا نا پاک انگا روح بسوسس اوڑتون وعدہ کریسس کہ ارا وخت اسکان او خدا نا مقرر کروکا
en: A week later the time of the child's circumcision came, and his name was given as Jesus. Then Mary and Joseph took the child to present him before the Lord. In the temple there was a good and truthful man; God's Holy Spirit had come upon him, and he had been promised that until he [saw] the one appointed by God
en_old: A week later came the time for the child's circumcision, and he was named Jesus. Then Mary and Joseph took the child to present him before the Lord. In the temple there was a good and righteous man on whom the Holy Spirit of God had come, and who had been promised that until the time ... the one appointed by God...

brh: انتنے کسپک اونا پن شمونس۔ ئے خدا نی تینا اقرار ء پورا کریسو داسہ کہنگ کے تیار اٹ۔ ئے تینا خنتٹی نجات تروک ء خناٹ۔
en: he would not die. His name was Simeon. 'O God, you have fulfilled your promise; now I am ready to die. I have seen the Savior with my own eyes.'
en_old: Would not die. His name was Simeon. O God, you have fulfilled your promise; now I am ready to die. I have seen the Savior with my own eyes.

brh: او کنے راہی کریس تے دوانے برکت ایتے۔
en: And you have sent me on my way. He gave a blessing to both of them.
en_old: You have let me go on my way; he gave a blessing to both of them.

brh: ہرا وخت کہ موسی نا شریعت نا مطابق کل رسماتے پورا کریر، تو یروشلم آن واپس ناصرت آ ہنار۔ ہرا وخت کہ عیسی نا عمر دوازدہ سال مس، تو یوسف و مریم پچھفنگ نا عید
en: When they had completed all the rites according to the law of Moses, they went back from Jerusalem to Nazareth. When Jesus was twelve years old, Joseph and Mary, for the feast of Passover,
en_old: When they had completed all the rituals according to the law of Moses, they returned from Jerusalem to Nazareth. When Jesus was twelve years old, Joseph and Mary went to the Passover feast.

brh: پٹنگ کن پدی یروشلم آ دریر عید خلاص مس اوف کورا غا راہی مسر ولے عیسی یروشلم اٹ سلیس اوف اودے پٹنگ کن پدی یروشلم آ ہنار مسٹمی دے اوف چنائے
en: took him back to Jerusalem. The feast ended and they set off for home, but Jesus had stayed behind in Jerusalem. They went back to Jerusalem to look for him. On the third day they [found] the child
en_old: They went back to Jerusalem to look for him. When the feast was over, they set out for home, but Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. They went back to Jerusalem to look for him. On the third day, the child...

brh: بزرگ آتے تون خنار۔ درو سوال اریفک آ دنا چنائے؟ دا نصرت نا سے۔ ننا خیال ئس کہ دا نن تونے۔ دا ران نن معافی خواہنہ۔ ارافکو دے بنغر اوفک حیران مسر۔
en: with the elders. He asks questions! Whose child is this? He is from Nazareth. We thought he was with us. We ask forgiveness for this. Those who heard him were amazed.
en_old: They found him with the elders. Then came the question: is this the child? He is from Nazareth. We thought he was with us. We apologize for this. ... They were amazed.

brh: بچہ نی نن تون انتئے دن کریس نا باوا او اینے انت انت جدر لٹ پٹال نوم کنے انتئے پٹارے نومے خبر اف کہ کنے تینا باوا
en: Child, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have searched for you everywhere. Why were you searching for me? Don't you know that I, my own Father's
en_old: Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been searching for you with great worry. Why were you searching for me? Didn't you know that I must be in my Father's...

brh: پدا عیسی اوفتے تو اوار ناصرت شار آ ہنا۔ عیسی بلنو عقل مند مریسائنا۔ اونا عزت خدا او مخلوق نا مونا۔
en: Then Jesus went with them to the town of Nazareth. Jesus kept growing and becoming wise, and he was honored before God and people.
en_old: Then Jesus went with them to the town of Nazareth. Jesus grew greatly in wisdom, and in honor before God and people.

brh: بادشاہ تبریس نا پانزدہمی کو سال اٹی پنتوس پلاتوس یہودیہ ملک نا گورنر اسکا او ہیرودیس گلیل صوبہ نا ہنان او کائفہ بھلا عبادت خانہ نا کل آن بھلا امام آک اسرا ہندا دے تیٹی زکریا نا مار یحیی غا ویرانو جاگہ سے ٹی
en: In the fifteenth year of Emperor Tiberius, Pontius Pilate was governor of the land of Judea, Herod was ruler of the province of Galilee, and Caiaphas was among the chief priests of the great temple. In those very days, to John the son of Zechariah, in a desolate place,
en_old: In the fifteenth year of Emperor Tiberius, Pontius Pilate was governor of the land of Judea, Herod was ruler of the province of Galilee, and Caiaphas was the high priest of the great temple. In those days, to John son of Zechariah in a desert place

brh: خدا نا پیغام بس۔ یحیی اردن دریا نا ریتی علاقہ ٹی دا تبلیغ کرے سپارے۔ تینا گناہ تیان توبہ کبو، پاک صاف مننگ کن دیر شولبو، تاکہ خدا نما گناہ تے معاف کے۔
en: God's message came. John preached in the sandy region of the Jordan River, saying: 'Repent of your sins and wash in water to become pure, so that God will forgive your sins.'
en_old: the message of God came. John preached in the region of the Jordan River, saying: Repent of your sins and be baptized with water to be made clean, so that God will forgive your sins.

brh: خفتبو، یسعیاہ پیغمبر نا کتاب اٹی لکھو کہ کسس ویرانو جاگہ سے آن توار خلسا پارے کہ خواجہ خدا کن کسر جوڑ کبو، اونا کسرے سیدھا جوڑ کبو۔
en: Listen: in the book of the prophet Isaiah it is written that someone calls out from a desolate place, saying, 'Make a road for the Lord God; make his road straight.'
en_old: As it is written in the book of the prophet Isaiah: someone is calling out in the wilderness, saying, prepare the way for the Lord, make his paths straight.

brh: کٹو کوڑو مشک برابر کھننگرے، ہراسی مشو زیلے برابر کھننگرے، او چوٹنگا کسراک سیدھا مننگرے
en: The pits, the hollows and the mountains will be made level, every mountain and slope will be made level, and the crooked roads will become straight.
en_old: Every valley will be filled, every mountain and hill will be made low, and the crooked paths will be made straight.

brh: اوشے پرزنگا کسر آک برابر کننگرہ، او ہر بندغ خدا نا نجات تروکا ء خنک۔ ننا بکے ہاؤ پانہ نی انت روئی مرے، او نم منافقاک انت پاتہ کدن کین؟
en: And the rough roads will be made level, and every person will see the Savior given by God. Yes, tell us, what should we do? And you hypocrites, what do you say? What shall we do?
en_old: The rough roads will be made smooth, and every person will see the salvation that God gives. 'Tell us, what should we do?' 'And you hypocrites, what do you say we should do?'

brh: با با ہرا کس ارے ہر کس تو کہ ایرا کو سرے اوفتے آن اسٹ تس دادے ئے تبو او
en: Brother, whoever there is, whoever has two shirts, let him give one of them; give it to this one, and
en_old: Brother, whoever has two, let him give one of them to the one who has none.

brh: ہر کس توم کوننگ کن ارے بش خبو تے واجہ نن محصول الو کا کن نن امر کین
en: whoever also has something to eat, share it. Sir, we are tax collectors; how should we act?
en_old: Whoever has food to eat, let him share it. 'Sir, we tax collectors, what should we do?'

brh: اخس کہ مقرر کننگانے اوڑان زیات مچ کپبو، نن کے انت حکم ئے ننے انت کروئی مرے، نوم کس سے آن زورٹ پیسہ ہلپبو، او کس سے تون دروغ تڑپبو
en: Do not collect more than what has been fixed. What is the command for us? What should we do? Do not take money from anyone by force, and do not lie to anyone.
en_old: Do not collect more than what has been fixed. 'What is your command for us, what should we do?' Do not take money from anyone by force, and do not make false accusations against anyone.

brh: تینا تنخواہٹ گزارہ کبو۔ ننے پا انت نی خدا نا نائب ئس
en: Make do with your wages. Tell us, are you God's deputy?
en_old: Be content with your wages. 'Tell us, are you God's chosen one?'

brh: ئے نمے دیرٹ بے شولنگٹ ایوٹ ولے اسٹس بننگٹی ئے کہ او کنے ہم برز ارے ئے اونا نتاتا مش
en: I am baptizing you with water, but someone is coming who is greater than me; I, the dust of his feet,
en_old: I baptize you with water, but one is coming who is greater than me; I am not worthy even to untie his sandals.

brh: او تا برابر ہم افٹ او بریک او گڑا اسے نما خدا نا پاک انگا روح نا طاقت ایتک او بروے اونا دوٹی ئے تاکہ جوانی اٹ چھپتے او غلہ غاتے تینا آنبار ٹی جمع کے
en: I am not even equal to that. He will come, and then he will give you the power of God's Holy Spirit. He will come; it is in his hand, so that he may winnow well and gather the grain into his granary.
en_old: I am not even equal to him. He will come and give you the power of God's Holy Spirit, and the winnowing fork is in his hand so that he may clean it well and gather the grain into his barn.

brh: ہمو وخت آ جنت آن کپوت نا شکل اٹ خدا نا پاک انگا روح
en: At that moment, from heaven, in the form of a dove, God's Holy Spirit
en_old: At that moment, God's Holy Spirit came down from heaven in the form of a dove

brh: عیسی غابس، او خدا نا کنڈ آن توار بس، نی کنا دوست انگا مار ئس ئے نی آن باز خوش اٹ۔
en: came upon Jesus, and a voice came from God: 'You are my beloved son; I am very pleased with you.'
en_old: upon Jesus, and a voice came from God: You are my beloved Son; I am very pleased with you.

brh: اراوختئے عیسی نا عمر سے سال مس او خدا نا کاریم تے شروع کرے او خدا نا کلام تون اوار اردن آ بس وندا کلام نا برکت اٹ مش و بیابان آ سرمس تڑے چل دے اسکان
en: When Jesus was thirty years old, he began God's work, and together with God's word he came to the Jordan; by the blessing of that same word he reached the mountains and the wilderness, for forty days
en_old: When Jesus was thirty years old, he began God's work. Filled with God's word he came to the Jordan, and by the blessing of that word he went into the mountains and the wilderness, for forty days...

brh: پدی خدا نا کسر آ بابو، خدا یقینا نم آ رحم کیک، او نم آ گناہ تے معاف کیک، دا کن پد نم خوشی اٹ تینا زندگی ء گدریفنگ کیرے، او خدا بغیر پریشانی اٹ نمار راہنمائی کیک۔ او بننگو، او داڑے کو، اور۔۔۔ عیسی!
en: Then come to the path of God; God will surely have mercy on you and forgive your sins, and after this you will be able to spend your life in happiness, and God will guide you without trouble. Hey, come... hey, over here, and... Jesus!
en_old: Then come to the path of God; God will surely have mercy on you and forgive your sins, and after this you can live your life in happiness, and God will guide you without trouble. Hey, come, over here, and... Jesus!

brh: عیسی! عرض کیو کنا مسڑے بچف۔ خواجہ رحم کرک۔ اونا عمر صرف دوازدہ سال ء او کینگٹی ء۔ خواجہ خدا کن تو بر۔ یا یار کنے افسوس ء۔ عیسی! نا مسڑ کسکونے داسہ عیسی ء ارا غاتیٹی تکلیف کپہ۔ نی خلیپہ۔
en: Jesus! I beg you, save my daughter. Master, have mercy. She is only twelve years old and she is dying. Master, for God's sake, come. Oh friend, I am sorry. Jesus... your daughter has died; don't trouble Jesus any more now. Don't be afraid.
en_old: Jesus! I beg you, save my daughter. Master, have mercy. She is only twelve years old and she is dying. Master, for God's sake, come. Oh friend, I am sorry. Jesus! Your daughter has died; don't trouble Jesus any more now. Do not be afraid.

brh: بس یقین تیخ او بچک
en: Just have faith, and she will be saved.
en_old: Just have faith, and she will be saved.

brh: او خپ بو، چنا کستنے بلکہ خاچانے
en: Stop crying; the child has not died, she is only asleep.
en_old: Be quiet, the child is not dead but asleep.

brh: مسٹ بش مئے
en: Girl, get up.
en_old: Girl, get up.

brh: مسڑے کننگ کن گلاس آتے بو نم کسے دا ہیت پاپرے
en: Give the girl something to eat. Don't you tell anyone about this.
en_old: Give the girl something to eat. Do not tell anyone about this.

brh: دا عیسی لاوی پنیا محصول ہلوکئے خنا او دفتر ٹی تولوک محصول ہلکوکہ
en: Then Jesus saw a tax collector named Levi, and he was sitting in the office collecting taxes.
en_old: Then Jesus saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office.

brh: کنا پدٹ برے
en: Come after me.
en_old: Follow me.

brh: او عیسی، دعا کننگ کن مش آ ہنا، اوڑے مچ آ نن خدا نا عبادت ء کرے
en: And Jesus went up the mountain to pray, and there he worshipped God the whole night.
en_old: And Jesus went up the mountain to pray, and there he worshipped God all night.

brh: ارا وخت آ دے پیش تما تو ہمو دوازدہ شاگرداتے بخیر اٹ پارے او دا شاگرداک اونا خاص انگا شاگرد پاننگار شمعون کہ عیسی اونا پن ء پطرس تخا
en: When day broke, he welcomed those twelve disciples, and these disciples were called his special disciples: Simon, whom Jesus named Peter,
en_old: When day came, he called the twelve disciples to him, and these disciples were called his special disciples: Simon, whom Jesus named Peter.

brh: پترس نی الم اندریاس؟ یعقوب؟
en: Peter, your brother Andrew? James?
en_old: Peter, you too, Andrew? James?

brh: او یوانا فلپس برتل مائی
en: And John, Philip, Bartholomew.
en_old: And John, Philip, Bartholomew.

brh: او متی او توما
en: And Matthew and Thomas.
en_old: And Matthew and Thomas.

brh: الفی نا مار یعقوب، او شمعون ارا کے انقلابی پاننگاکا، او یہودا یعقوب نا
en: James son of Alphaeus, and Simon, who was called the revolutionary, and Judas, James's...
en_old: James son of Alphaeus, and Simon, who is called the Zealot, and Judas son of James.

brh: ایلم، او یہودا اسکریوتی کہ پدا غدار جوڑ مس۔
en: ...brother, and Judas Iscariot, who later became a traitor.
en_old: Then, and Judas Iscariot, who later became a traitor.

brh: ایمان خواہ کاک، نم خوش قسمت وری کہ خدا نما حفاظت ئے کیک، نم خوش قسمت وری انتئے کہ نما خواہش آک پورا مریرہ۔
en: You who long for faith, you are fortunate, because God protects you; you are fortunate, because your wishes will be fulfilled.
en_old: Believers, you are blessed that God protects you; you are blessed because your desires will be fulfilled.

brh: او دا سوغرے انتئے کہ ولدا مخورے بختاور او رے نوم کہ کنا وجغان مخلوق نومیان نفرت کیرے نوم تو سنگتی کپہ سنو مین بے عزت کیرے اوفت تا باوا پیر آغا کہ ایلو نبی تے تو ہندوں کرے سور ولے نوم خوش قسمت او رے خوش مبو
en: And you who weep now, because later you will laugh. You are blessed when people hate you because of me, will not keep company with you, and dishonour you; their forefathers had done the same to the other prophets too. But you are fortunate; be glad.
en_old: And this is why: again you are blessed when people hate you because of me; they will not keep company with you, they insult you. Their forefathers did the same to the other prophets, but you are blessed; rejoice.

brh: انت کہ دانہ بدلہ نمے خدا غان جنت اٹ ملیک۔ شانزدہ، ہفتدہ، ہشتدہ، نوزدہ، بیست، کنٹو توندادو، انت مطلب؟ نی توندادو۔ نی افسوس کہ دانہ
en: For the reward for this you will receive from God in heaven. Sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty, [unclear]... What does that mean? You [unclear]. Woe to you, for of this...
en_old: For in return for this you will receive a reward from God in heaven. Sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty... what does that mean? You are full. Woe to you because of this.

brh: نی اسہ دولت مند ئس نی اسہ رات ء اودے گدریفیس، دا میر مانی خواب آک ضرور گنوک کیرے، افسوس نی اگہ داسہ مخسے
en: You are a rich man; you will pass one night with it, and these dreams of riches will surely drive you mad. Woe to you if you laugh now.
en_old: You are a rich man; you will pass a night, and these dreams of wealth will surely drive you mad. Woe to you if you laugh now.

brh: انتئے کہ او ہوسپدا داسے کل بندغاک نما بارواٹ جوان ہیت کیرے اندا ہیتاتے مستنا بندغاک دروغ نا نبی تے پاریسو
en: Because later you will weep. When all people speak well of you, the people of earlier times had said these very same things to the false prophets.
en_old: Because when all people speak well of you, the people before used to say these same things to the false prophets.

brh: ولے اینو مین پاننگ خواوہ دشمن تو تو محبت کبو نفرت کروکا تیتو جوانی کبو اوفتے نیکن دعا ایتبو اراف نمے بد دعا ایتیرے
en: But today I want to tell you: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you, give good prayers for those who curse you.
en_old: But today I want to tell you: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you, pray for those who curse you.

brh: اگر کسس چپل ئس خلینومے تو نوم ایلو نیمہء اوڑکا کبو
en: If someone slaps you, then turn the other side to him as well.
en_old: If someone slaps you, turn the other cheek to them as well.

brh: اگر کسس گڈے نا خوائے تو تے تینا خوسے متے اگر کسس نیان خوائے او دے ہمو گڑا تے ایتے اگر کسس نما گڑا تے خوائے
en: If someone wants your cloak, then give him your shirt as well; if someone asks something of you, give him those things; if someone wants your things,
en_old: If someone wants your cloak, do not hold back your shirt; if someone asks of you, give him those things; if someone takes your things,

brh: اوڑان واپس خواہوتے۔ ہندون کبو۔ دن کے تین کے سوچ کیرے۔
en: don't ask him for them back. Do the same: the way you think for yourselves.
en_old: do not ask for them back. Do so. Treat others as you would want for yourselves.

brh: اگر نم تینا مہر کروکا تتون مہر کیرے تو انت احسان ئس مروئی؟ انت کہ گناہگار ہم تینا مہر کروکا تتون مہر کیرے اور اگر جوانی کروکا تا بدل اٹ جوان سلوک کیرے
en: If you love those who love you, what favour is that? For even sinners love those who love them, and if you treat well, in return, those who do good to you,
en_old: If you love those who love you, what credit is that? For even sinners love those who love them, and if you treat well those who do good to you,

brh: تو برکت نا گدارا ہم ممرے، دا وڑ تو گناہ گار آ کام کرے، دا وڑ دے مٹ دو خلک، دا وڑ تو خن تیت کرے، شرم نا وجہ آن
en: then there is no blessing in that either; sinners also act this way. This way [he] put his hand on [unclear], this way you lowered your eyes, out of shame.
en_old: then there will be no blessing either; sinners do this too. This way they touched..., this way you lowered your eyes out of shame.

brh: ئنا دشمنتے تو مہر کبو اوفتہ خیر خواہ بو وام تننگ آن پد واپس خواہپبو تے خدا دانا سے بلو بدلہ سے ایتک ہندون نم خدا نا مار پاننگرے
en: Love your enemies, be their well-wishers, and after lending don't ask for it back; God will give you a great reward for this, and in this way you will be called sons of God.
en_old: Love your enemies, wish them well, lend and do not ask for it back; God will give a great reward for this, and so you will be called sons of God.

brh: انتئے کاو نا شکر و بے خیر آ تزی آ مہربانی رام کبو ہمک کے خدا رام کیک دنے بچی فیسہ ئے کشرے تو نوما ہمے وقت پیش تمو
en: Because he is kind to the ungrateful and the wicked; be kind and merciful, just as God is merciful. Whatever judgment you pass, the same will happen to you at that time.
en_old: Because He is kind to the ungrateful and the wicked; be merciful just as God is merciful. The measure you use will be measured back to you at that time.

brh: الزام خلیرے، نمے آ ہم الزام لگک۔ معاف کیرے، نمے معاف کننگک۔ ننے تینا کسرے نشان ات خواجہ خدا۔
en: If you blame others, blame will fall on you too. If you forgive, you will be forgiven. Show us your path, Lord God.
en_old: Judge, and you will be judged. Forgive, and you will be forgiven. Show us your path, Lord God.

brh: ایتے بو نوم ایم تیننگک ارائی تاتے ٹی کچکیرے نوم کیم کچکننگک کور کور ئے کسر نشان تننگ کپک اگر دن مست اور توما کڈٹ تمور
en: Give, and it will be given to you too. With whatever measure you measure, you too will be measured with it. A blind man cannot show the way to a blind man; if it were so, both of them would fall into a pit.
en_old: ...a blind man cannot show the way to a blind man; if that were so, both of them would fall into a pit.

brh: نی تینا سنگت نا خنت آ بوچ نظر باریک ولے تینا خنت آ بوچ ء خنپیسہ؟ خواجہ رہنمائی کر، دا سد نا نی خوانا خواجہ خدا، خوش قسمت ء ہمو لمہ کہ نی بارو مار ودی کرے نی
en: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you do not see the speck in your own eye? Lord, guide us ... Lord God. Fortunate is the mother who gave birth to a son like you.
en_old: Why do you look at the speck in your friend's eye but not see the beam in your own eye? Lord, guide us... blessed is the mother who gave birth to you.

brh: بخت اور اوف کرا کہ خدا نا پیغام ء بنیرہ او عمل کیر۔ دادے درستی راستی نا ضرورت ء۔ نا خیال ٹی انتو خدا نا مقرر کروک مننگ کے
en: Fortunate are those who hear God's message and act on it. For this, uprightness and truthfulness are needed. What do you think, can he be the one appointed by God?
en_old: Blessed are those who hear God's message and act on it. That takes true righteousness. Who do you think is God's appointed one?

brh: دا فریسی عیسی ء تینا اراغا دعوت تس، عیسی اونا اراغا ہنا، و اراغ کننگ کن توس۔
en: This Pharisee invited Jesus to his house. Jesus went to his house and sat down to eat a meal.
en_old: This Pharisee invited Jesus to his house. Jesus went to his house and sat down to eat.

brh: نمبو شاباش دا گرانہ غا شرارتو ضرور کیرہ دا تاڑیت کنے گھٹی کنے خبر اف
en: Well done, all of you! They will surely get up to some mischief over this expensive one... this... I don't know.
en_old: Well done to you! At this price they will surely make mischief... I don't know.

brh: اگر دا واقعی پیغمبر اسے تو او پومرے کہ دا نیاری کہ اودے دیر دو خلنگاٹی ئے
en: If this man were really a prophet, he would understand who this woman is who is touching him.
en_old: If this man were really a prophet, he would know what kind of woman this is who is touching him.

brh: آخا، گناہ گار زندگی ئس گدریفنگ ٹی ء۔ شمعون، ئے دا نیاڑی ء چاوہ۔ ئے نی گڑاس پاوہ۔ اسیکہ قرض خواہ ئس ارا بندغ ء قرض تس۔ ئسیٹ اسے پنچ سد چاندی نا او ایلو ء۔۔۔
en: No, she is living a sinful life. Simon, I know this woman. I will tell you something. Once a creditor lent money to two men: to one, five hundred in silver, and to the other...
en_old: Yes, she is living a sinful life. Simon, do you know this woman? I will tell you something. Once a moneylender lent money to two men. To one, five hundred silver coins, and to the other...

brh: ئے پنچاہ چاندی نا روپئی تیس۔ ارٹومہ قرضے تننگ کتو۔ ہندا خاطر آن او اوفتے معاف کرے۔ دیر زیادہ قرضے روکر خوش مریک؟ کنا خیال اٹ ہمو ہراسٹ ٹی زیادہ معاف کننگانے۔ نی راست پائس۔ دا نیاڑی ئ خناس؟
en: ...he gave fifty silver rupees. Neither of the two could repay the loan. For this reason he forgave them. Which one will be happier with the lender? In my opinion, the one who was forgiven more. You have said it rightly. Did you see this woman?
en_old: ...he gave fifty silver coins. Neither of them could pay back the loan. So he forgave them both. Which of them will be happier with the lender? I think the one who was forgiven more. You have answered correctly. Do you see this woman?

brh: ہرا وخت آ ئے نا ارا غا بسٹ، نی کنا نت تا سلنگ کے دیر ہم کنے تتویس، ولے دا نیاڑی کنا نتاتے تینا خڑین تے تو سلا او تینا پجھاتے تو بارفے تا۔ ئے بسٹ نی کنے خمب کتویس۔
en: When I came to your house, you did not even give me water to wash my feet, but this woman washed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair. I came, and you did not kiss me.
en_old: When I came to your house, you gave me no water to wash my feet, but this woman washed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair. When I came, you did not kiss me.

brh: ولے دا نیاڑی کنا نتاتے بک خلوک دیسکا ہلنگٹی ئے نی کنا کاٹم ٹی تیل تتوس ولے دا نیاڑی کنا نت تے عطرٹ سلا ولے ئے نی پاوہ اونا باز گناہک معاف کننگانو ہندا خاطران او باز محبت کننگٹی ئے ولے
en: But this woman keeps kissing my feet. You did not put oil on my head, but this woman washed my feet with perfume. So I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven; that is why she loves so much. But...
en_old: But this woman has not stopped kissing my feet. You did not put oil on my head, but this woman anointed my feet with perfume. So I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven, and that is why she loves so much. But...

brh: ارا نا کم گناہ تے معاف کننگانو او محبت کم کیک
en: The one whose few sins have been forgiven loves little.
en_old: Whoever has been forgiven little loves little.

brh: نا کل گناہک معاف مسر، نا ایمان نی جوڑ کرینے خدا حافظ
en: All your sins have been forgiven. Your faith has made you whole. God be with you.
en_old: All your sins are forgiven. Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.

brh: عیسی شار شار خلک خلک خدا نا بادشاہی نا پڑو کرے سائنہ۔ اوڑتون دوازدہ خاص انگا شاگرد آت، او ہمو ناڑی کہ اوفتا جناتی کشنگاسر اوڑتون اوار اسرا۔ مریم کہ مگدلینی پاننگے، یوانا، ایرودیس
en: Jesus went from town to town and village to village, proclaiming the kingdom of God. With him were the twelve special disciples, and the women whose jinns (evil spirits) had been cast out were also with him: Mary, who is called Magdalene, Joanna, Herod's...
en_old: Jesus went from town to town and village to village, proclaiming the kingdom of God. With him were the twelve special disciples, and the women from whom evil spirits had been driven out were also with him: Mary, called Magdalene, Joanna, Herod's...

brh: داسہ نا دیوان خوزہ نا ضیافت او سوسنا
en: Now, the wife of Chuza the court steward, and Susanna.
en_old: Now Joanna, the wife of Chuza the steward, and Susanna.

brh: گورنر ایرودیس مسیڑ سے تینا ایلوم آن طلاق ترفیسس او برام کریسس تا۔ یحیی اودے منع کریسس او ایرودیس یحیی ء جیل ٹی بندی کریسس۔ راست، دا وخت نا چار نا پارٹی غا بسون تو بندغ
en: Governor Herod had made a woman divorce his own brother and had married her. John had forbidden it, and Herod had put John in jail. Right, we came to the party at this time, so the people...
en_old: Governor Herod had made a woman divorce her husband and had married her. John condemned it, so Herod had John thrown in prison. Right, if people come to the party at this hour...

brh: دا کسہ جنازہ ئس دننگٹ ئسور۔ ہمو مردہ جنازہ نا سینہ آ سیٹنگا مار ئس عیسی اونا لمہ ء اوغنگا خنا، تو اونا خن خڑینگی بسور۔ او کفن ء تت دو خلک او پارے، ورنا، ئے نی حکم ایتوہ، بش مر! پدا مردہ بش مس۔
en: These people were carrying a funeral bier. That dead man was the only son of a widow. Jesus saw his mother weeping, and his eyes filled with tears. He touched the shroud with his hand and said, 'Young man, I command you, get up!' Then the dead man got up.
en_old: They were carrying a dead man out for burial. The dead man was his mother's only son. When Jesus saw his mother weeping, his eyes filled with tears. He touched the shroud and said, 'Young man, I command you, get up!' Then the dead man got up.

brh: بش مس توس او عیسی او دے اونا لمہ اٹ تس ارف پا نی خدا نا مقرر کروکا ئس یا آیا پارے سس یا پین کسس پاریک
en: He got up and sat, and Jesus gave him to his mother. ... Tell us, are you the one appointed by God, or ... or will it be someone else?
en_old: He got up and sat, and Jesus gave him back to his mother. Tell us, are you God's appointed one, or is it someone else, as people say?

brh: خواجہ
en: Master.
en_old: Master.

brh: خواجہ یحیی ننے ریفنگ کے راہی کرینے کہ نی ہمو بندغ ئس کہ ارادے بروئی ئے یا پین کس سے نا کسرے اورن ارا گڑا تے خنارے او بنگرے یحیی پاہ بو کورا
en: Master, John has sent us to ask whether you are the man who is to come, or whether we should wait for someone else. Go and tell John the things you have seen and heard: the blind...
en_old: Master, John has sent us to ask you whether you are the one who is to come, or whether we should wait for someone else. Go and tell John what you have seen and heard; tell him the blind...

brh: کنے ارخ بو، کوپہ غا
en: Lift me up onto your shoulders.
en_old: Lift me up onto your shoulder.

brh: ٹی ٹول، دا سخن کسے؟ کنے اسو نظر بننگٹی ئے اسہ زمیندار ئس خولم دسننگ کے پیش تما، ہرا وخت او بجاتے دغار تے چٹ تیس گڑاس اوفتا آن کسر اٹ تمار۔
en: ... Whose words are these? It seems to me like this. A farmer went out to sow wheat. When he scattered the seeds on the ground, some of them fell on the path.
en_old: Listen, everyone, whose words are these? It seems to me... A farmer went out to sow seed. As he scattered the seeds on the ground, some of them fell on the path.

brh: او بازنگاتے مخلوق لتاڑا او چپ کا کونگور۔ گڑاس خالیا ڈغار اٹ تمار۔ وخت ئس آن پد فصل خرہ ولے اوفتے ماس الو اندا خاطر آن بارسوت۔ بازنگا بج جک جرات اٹ تمار، ولے جرات آک زو برون مسور۔ او
en: And people trampled many of them, and the birds ate them. Some fell on stony ground. After a while the crop sprouted, but they had no root, and for this reason they dried up. Many seeds fell among the bushes, but the bushes quickly grew up. And...
en_old: They were trampled by many people and the birds ate them. Some fell on barren ground. After a while the crop came up, but it had no moisture, so it dried up. Many seeds fell among thorns, but the thorns quickly grew up. They...

brh: خڑومی ڈگار، گڑاس بیج جوانینگا ڈگارتیٹ تمار، فصل دک کریر او اسہ دانہ غان باز دانہ جوڑ مسر۔ خواجہ، دا مثال نا انت معنی ء؟ وختس مچے خرک مرے
en: ...ground. Some seeds fell on good ground, produced a crop, and from one grain many grains came. Master, what does this parable mean? ...a time when all of it sprouts.
en_old: Good soil: some seeds fell on good soil, the crop grew, and from one grain many grains came. Master, what does this parable mean? When it all grows...

brh: او دا نا پوسکننگا پیغام نا ڈکوک آ ہیت آک نمے پاش کننگ اٹی ارے۔ ولے ایلو مخلوق نا مثال ٹی پاننگک کہ مخلوق ہوریرہ ولے توجہ تفیسہ، او بنیرہ ولے پومفسہ۔
en: And the hidden things of this new message are being revealed to you. But to other people it is told in parables, so that people look but pay no attention, and they hear but do not understand.
en_old: He is revealing to you the hidden things of this new message. But to other people it is told in parables, so that people look but do not take notice, and they hear but do not understand.

brh: دا مثال نا مطلب دادے بیج آک
en: The meaning of this parable is this: the seeds...
en_old: The meaning of this parable is this: the seeds...

brh: خدا نا پیغام او۔ کسر اٹ تموکا بجا ہمو بندغاکو کہ پیغام ء بنرہ، ولے ابلیس بریک و اوفتا است آن پیغام ء کشک، تاکہ اوفتے ایمان مف و اوفتا نجات مف۔ بج
en: ...are God's message. The seeds that fell on the path are those people who hear the message, but the devil comes and takes the message out of their hearts, so that they do not have faith and are not saved. The seeds...
en_old: ...are God's message. The seeds that fell on the path are those people who hear the message, but the devil comes and takes the message from their hearts, so that they do not believe and are not saved. The seed...

brh: بینجا کہ خلیہ ڈغارتے تمار ہمو بندغاکو کہ اوف خدانا کلامے خوشی اٹ بنرے او ایمان تے تخرے ولے روتہ الپسے ولے آزمائش نا وخت آ ایمان آن ہڑسنگرے بینجا کہ جراتے ٹی تمار اوڑان مراد ہمو بندغاکو کہ بنرے
en: The seeds that fell on stony ground are those people who hear God's word with joy and hold faith, but they have no roots, and at the time of testing they turn back from the faith. The seeds that fell among the bushes stand for those people who hear...
en_old: The seeds that fell on rocky ground are those people who hear God's word with joy and believe, but they have no roots, and in the time of testing they fall away from their faith. The seeds that fell among the thorns stand for those people who hear...

brh: ولے دنیا نا فکر مال و مڈی و زند نا آسراتی کوفتے زور مریرے اوفتے برم اسل بسپک او ہرا بیجاک جوانیں ڈغار ٹی تمار ہمو بندغاک او ہرا پیغام ء بنیرہ او ایمان ء تینا استا تخیرہ
en: But the worries of the world, wealth and property, and the comforts of life overpower them, and they never bear fruit. And the seeds that fell on good ground are those people who hear the message and keep faith in their hearts.
en_old: But the worries of the world, wealth and the comforts of life overpower them, and they never bear fruit. And the seeds that fell on good soil are those people who hear the message and keep faith in their hearts.

brh: تخرے اندن کہ خولم جوان و فصلتیک کسہ سم چراغس لگیفے او نا زی آ کاسہ یو دے کٹ نا کیرا غا تخپک
en: ...keep it. Just as the wheat is good and yields crops. No one who lights a lamp puts a bowl over it or puts it under the bed.
en_old: ...keep. In the same way, no one lights a lamp and puts a bowl over it or puts it under the bed.

brh: بلکہ ہموڑے تخک تے اراڑے اراٹی آسانی اٹ روشنائی مرے ارا گڑا ڈکو کے روشنائی ٹی پاش مریک اندن ارا ایتاک بندغ نا است ٹی ڈکوکو اوفک ظاہر مریرے خیال کبو ارا بندہ کنا ایتا
en: Rather, he puts it where its light can easily spread. Whatever is hidden is revealed in the light; in the same way, the things hidden in a person's heart will come out into the open. Take heed: whoever... my words...
en_old: Instead, he puts it where it can easily give light. Whatever is hidden is revealed in the light, and in the same way the things hidden in a person's heart will be revealed. Think about it: whoever... my words...

brh: ہیت آ یقین تخک، خدا او دے پین پو مننگ نا طاقت ایتک۔ ولے ارا بندہ کہ یقین تخنگ نا کوشش تے کپک، خدا او دے طاقت تفک۔ خواجہ، نا لمہ و ایلم نی کے پیش سلوکو، نی تو ملنگ خواہ رہ۔ کنا لمہ و ایلم آک
en: ...believes the word, God gives him the power to understand more. But whoever does not make the effort to believe, God does not give him that power. Master, your mother and brothers are standing outside for you; they want to meet you. My mother and brothers...
en_old: ...believes the word, God gives him the power to understand more. But whoever does not try to believe, God does not give him that power. Master, your mother and brothers are standing outside and want to see you. My mother and brothers...

brh: ہمو دوارا خدا نا ہیتے بنرہ او یقین تخرہ۔ اسہ دے ئس عیسی تینا شاگرداتے تون اوار کشتی ٹی توس اوفتے پارے
en: ...are those who hear God's word and keep faith in it. One day Jesus sat in a boat together with his disciples and said to them,
en_old: ...are those who hear God's word and believe it. One day Jesus got into a boat with his disciples and said to them...

brh: جھیل نا ایلو کنڈ آ ہرا کہ ہمبو ہرا وخت آ کشتی راہی مس عیسی ہاچا
en: "[Let's go] to the other side of the lake." When the boat set off, Jesus fell asleep.
en_old: ...to the other side of the lake. When the boat set off, Jesus fell asleep.

brh: او خواجہ، خواجہ عیسی، نن کئینگٹ ایون، نن بوٹ ڈلینگٹ ایون، نن کل ڈوپالے نن، ننے بچف خواجہ
en: O Master, Master Jesus, we are dying, we are drowning, we are all going under! Save us, Master!
en_old: Oh Master, Master Jesus, we are dying, we are sinking, we are all drowning. Save us, Master!

brh: نما ایوانہ رنگا
en: Where is your faith?
en_old: Where is your faith?

brh: پدا او گلیل صوبہ غان کشتی ٹی جھیل نا ایلو کنارہ گراسین پنی آ علاقہ آ رسینگار
en: Then they crossed by boat from the province of Galilee and reached the area called Gerasene on the other shore of the lake.
en_old: Then they crossed by boat from the province of Galilee and reached the area called Gerasenes on the other side of the lake.

brh: عیسی خدا تعالی نا مار ننے ننے نن خواست کے نن خواست کے نہ کہ ننے سزائے
en: Jesus, Son of God Most High, we beg you, we beg you, do not punish us.
en_old: Jesus, Son of God Most High, we beg you, we beg you not to punish us.

brh: دا تیفے نا پن دیرے لشکر خواجہ خدا منت کینے ننے
en: ...What is your name? Legion. Master, for God's sake, we beg you...
en_old: What is your name? Legion. Master, for God's sake we beg you...

brh: کڈہ سیٹ شاہ پی ننیا خواست کنے او کما تنیا مٹی ایننگ کے ہلی
en: Do not throw [us] into the pit; this is our request... let [us] go in...
en_old: ...our request is that you let us go into...

brh: او واپس مبا سلپو سلپو پدا جننا
en: Hey, go back! Stop, stop! ... then ...
en_old: Go back... then...

brh: دا بندغ آن پیش تما مار او احکاماتاتے تینار داکان ہنبو او جادوگر ننے الے بو
en: Come out of this man! ... and the commands... Go away from here, sorcerer, leave us alone!
en_old: Come out of this man... and the commands... Go away from here, sorcerer, leave us alone.

brh: دا جگا نیمبو، دا نارنجی لیمبو، دا کٹ پیش نیمبو، اران کے نی کاسے نیتو بریوے، مہربانی کبو
en: This is a lemon, this is an orange lemon, this is a ... lemon. Which of these will you have a cup of? Please.
en_old: This is a lime, this is an orange, this is a sweet lime. Which one will you bring me a glass of? Please.

brh: کنے تنتو دبو۔ تینا راہی مبو۔ او پبو کہ خدا نم کے انت کیرے نی
en: "Take me with you." "Go on your way, and tell what God has done for you."
en_old: Don't stay with me. Go on your way, and tell what God has done for you.

brh: عیسی و اونا شاگرد آک پدا بیت صیدا پنی آ شار آ روانہ مسر
en: Then Jesus and his disciples set off for a town called Bethsaida.
en_old: Then Jesus and his disciples set off for a town called Bethsaida.

brh: اراوخت آ مخلوق ئے خبر تما اوف کنا رندٹی نار
en: When the people heard the news, they followed after me.
en_old: When the people found out, they followed me.

brh: بیگوشام پد پطرس اودے پارے، خواجہ، دا بندغاتے اجازت ایتے۔ کہ دا کرئی نا خلقاتے اکور و تینا کننگ و خواچنگ نا بندوبست کیر۔ انتئے کہ دا ویران جاگہ اسے۔
en: In the evening Peter said to him, "Master, give these people leave, so that they may go to the villages around here and arrange their own food and lodging, because this is a desolate place."
en_old: In the late afternoon Peter said to him, "Master, send these people away so they can go to the nearby villages and find food and lodging for themselves, because this is a desolate place."

brh: ولے نم اوفتے کننگ کے گڑائے تبو
en: But you give them something to eat.
en_old: But you give them something to eat.

brh: دن صرف پنچراغو بہ ارا مچے او
en: There are only five loaves and two fish.
en_old: We have only five loaves and two fish.

brh: مبارکے تو خواجہ خدا ارانا کہ بادشاہ زمینا نراغ پیدا کیک
en: Blessed are you, Lord God, the King, who brings forth bread from the earth.
en_old: Blessed are you, Lord God, King of the universe, who brings forth bread from the earth.

brh: دا توم آت چاسی؟ یقین بپا۔
en: Do you know both of these? Say it for certain.
en_old: Do you know these people? Tell the truth.

brh: مخلوق نا بارہ ٹی انت پارے
en: What did the people say about you?
en_old: What did they say about the people?

brh: گڑاس بندغاک پارہ کہ یحیی اوس، او گڑاس بندغاک پارہ کہ نی پیغمبر الیاس اوس، او گڑاس پارہ کہ نی مستنا سے پیغمبر سے اوس کہ پدی زندہ مسنس۔ نوم انت پارے؟
en: Some people say that you are John, and some people say that you are the prophet Elijah, and some say that you are one of the prophets of old who has come back to life. What do you say?
en_old: Some people say you are John, some say you are the prophet Elijah, and some say you are one of the prophets of old who has come back to life. What do you say?

brh: کہ ئے دیرٹ نی خدا نا مقرر کروکا اوس
en: ...who am I? You are the one appointed by God.
en_old: Who am I? You are the one appointed by God.

brh: دا ایتا نا بارواٹ کس سے پاپیرے ئے آدم نا اولیاد کنے آ مصیبت بریک ئے کس پنگوے او مسے دے آن پد پدی زندہ مریوے
en: Do not tell anyone about this. I, the Son of Man, will meet with suffering, I will be killed, and after three days I will come back to life again.
en_old: Do not tell anyone about this. The Son of Man will suffer, he will be killed, and after three days he will rise to life again.

brh: نمے آن دیر کنا پدٹ بریک؟ خواجہ اینو تم برے وا۔ ولے کنے الے، ئے اراغاہ کاوا اجازت اٹ۔
en: Which of you will come after me? "Master, I will come today. But let me first go home, with your permission."
en_old: Which of you will follow me? "Lord, I will come today. But first let me go somewhere, with your permission."

brh: دے و برے و اگر بندہ خدا نا کسر آ برے کو سوچے کہ ئے ہڑسنگیو داڑن خدا نا کرم تے چفاد مفک اگر کس کنتو برے تو او تینا بارٹ سوچ کے او ہردے کنا خاطر انسیلی بتفنگ کن تیار مرے
en: ...and I will come. If a person comes onto God's path and thinks, 'I will turn back,' then such a person will not be worthy of God's grace. If anyone comes with me, let him think about himself and be ready every day to carry the cross for my sake.
en_old: The day will come. If a person comes on God's path, they should not think they will turn back, because God's mercy does not end here. If anyone comes with me, let them think about themselves and be ready every day to carry the cross for my sake.

brh: ہر او بندغ دا دنیا ٹی تینا زند ء دوست تورک او مونا دا دنیا ٹی خدا نا سزا غان بچنگ کپک ولے ہر او بندغ کنا خاطر آن تینا جان ء مال ء قربان کیک او ہڑتوما دنیا تیٹی خوشی حاصل کیک اگر کس ئس کنا اطاعت ء حکماتے منے پک
en: Every person who holds his life dear in this world cannot escape God's punishment in the world ahead; but every person who sacrifices his life and wealth for my sake gains happiness in both worlds. If anyone does not obey me and does not accept my commands,
en_old: Everyone who loves their own life in this world will not escape God's punishment in the next. But everyone who gives up their life and wealth for my sake will find happiness in both worlds, if they obey me and follow my commands.

brh: توئی آدم نا اولاد تینا باوا خدا نا ملائکتہ جلال اٹی برے و پاو دا بندہ کنا شاگرد افک۔ نی یقین کے۔
en: then I, the Son of Man, will come in the glory of my Father God and of the angels, and I will say, 'This person is not my disciple.' Believe it.
en_old: Then the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father God and of the angels, and will say, "This person is not my disciple." Believe it.

brh: داڑے گڑاسنتو نمے ریر ارا کے خدانا بادشاہی ء اورنگان مست کس بسے
en: Some of you here will not die before they see God's kingdom.
en_old: Some of those here with you will see God's kingdom and throne before death comes to them.

brh: پدئی
en: Then
en_old: Then

brh: عیسی پطرس یوحنا و یعقوب ء تینتو نوار مشا دعا کننگ کن درے
en: Jesus took Peter, John and James along with him to the mountain to pray.
en_old: Jesus took Peter, John and James with him up the mountain to pray.

brh: ہرا وخت کہ او دعا کننگٹی اسکہ اونا مون بدل مس او پچاک تا پیون برف امبار مسر و سے وار
en: When he was praying, his face changed, and his clothes became white like snow, and at once...
en_old: While he was praying, his face changed, and his clothes became white like snow and shone brightly.

brh: دا وخت ئٹی ارا بندغ ظاہر مسر، اوفک عیسی تون ہیت کننگا لگار، اوفک پیغمبر موسی و الیاس ئسرا، ہرا کہ آسمانی جلال اٹ ظاہر مسر۔ نم خدا نا مقصد ء مونا ہتنگ کیرے، نما قضیت یروشلم اٹ مریک۔
en: At that time two men appeared and began talking with Jesus; they were the prophets Moses and Elijah, who appeared in heavenly glory. "You will carry God's purpose forward; what is destined for you will take place in Jerusalem."
en_old: At that moment two men appeared and began talking with Jesus; they were the prophets Moses and Elijah, who appeared in heavenly glory. "You will carry God's purpose forward; your fate will be fulfilled in Jerusalem."

brh: ہرا وخت آ او ایننگٹیا سور، پترس عیسی ئے پارے: خواجہ، دا خاص جوان مرے کہ نن انداڑے نمتون رینگن۔ نن مسے گدان جوڑ کین، اسٹ ئس نی کین، موسی کین، ایلیا کین۔
en: As they were leaving, Peter said to Jesus: "Master, it would be especially good for us to stay here with you. Let us make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, one for Elijah."
en_old: As they were leaving, Peter said to Jesus: "Master, it is very good that we stay here with you. Let us make three tents, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

brh: دسموس اکن کہ جمہ را کوف تے ڈکار اسٹ اسیلیا کے عیسی نا شاگرد آک خلیسور جمہ ران خدا پارے دا کنا گچین کروکا مارے دانہ ایتا تے بمبو
en: As he was saying this, a cloud covered them, and Jesus' disciples were afraid. From the cloud God said: "This is my chosen son; listen to his words."
en_old: While he was saying this, a cloud came and covered them, and Jesus' disciples were afraid. From the cloud God said: "This is my chosen son, listen to him."

brh: خواجہ، خواجہ، کنا چنا غا رحم کرک، اودے بچف
en: Master, master, have mercy on my child, save him!
en_old: Master, master, have mercy on my son, save him!

brh: دا کنا سٹنگ آ مارے، ئے چنا نا مدد ء کیٹ، ئے دا شاگرد آتیا فخر کیٹ، کنے اوفک ہچ کننگ کتو، ئے بے یقینی و چپی نا گواچی اٹ، ئے ہرا وخت اسکان توم تو اوار دا ہیت ء کیٹ۔
en: He is my only son. I sought help for the child; I turned to these disciples, but they could do nothing for me. O you who are in the grip of unbelief and crookedness, how long must I be with you and keep saying this?
en_old: He is my only son. Oh, help the child! I asked these disciples, but they could not do anything for me. "O unbelieving and perverse generation, how long must I stay with you and say this?"

brh: ئے چنکوٹ مارے دانگتے
en: Bring your little son here.
en_old: Bring your little son here.

brh: ننے دعا کننگ نا طریقہ ء ہرفام۔ دن کہ نی یحیی ء ہرفماس۔ ہرا وخت آ دعا کیسہ پا: ئے باوہ ننے کہ آسمان اٹ ئس نا پن پاک ہلنگے۔
en: Teach us the way to pray, just as you taught John. When you pray, say: "O our Father who are in heaven, may your name be held holy."
en_old: Teach us how to pray, just as you taught John. When you pray, say: "Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name."

brh: نا بادشاہی برے، نا مرضی ہندن کہ آسمان ٹی ئے زمین آ ہم مرے، ننا روز نا ایراغے ننے اینو ایت، ننا گناہ تے معاف کے، ہمو کہ نن تینا قصورواتے معاف کینہ، ننے آزمائش ٹی بٹپہ۔
en: May your kingdom come, may your will be done on earth just as in heaven. Give us today our daily bread, forgive our sins, as we forgive those who have wronged us, and do not throw us into temptation.
en_old: Your kingdom come, your will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us today our daily bread, and forgive us our sins, as we forgive those who wrong us. Do not lead us into temptation.

brh: بلکہ ودی تیان بچائے۔ خوابو اتک نومے پٹبو تو خنیرے تے
en: but save us from evils. Ask, and he will give to you; seek, and you will find it.
