en_old: But deliver us from evil. Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find.

brh: ٹک ٹک کبو ملنگک۔ ارا گڈانم خوارینم ایتک۔ ہر کس پٹک حاصل کیک تے، و ہر کس ئس کے ٹک ٹک کیک اوڑکن دروازہ ملنگک۔
en: Knock and it will open. Whatever you ask for, he will give you. Everyone who seeks obtains it, and everyone who knocks, the door opens for him.
en_old: Knock and the door will be opened. Whatever you ask for, he will give. Everyone who asks receives, and to everyone who knocks the door will be opened.

brh: ننا باوا کے اونا مار مچے خوائیک او اودے دوشے تک یا کہ مار بہ
en: Which father among us, when his son asks for a fish, gives him a snake? Or if the son...
en_old: Which father, if his son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?

brh: خوائے اونا باوہ اودے تیل شتک نو مخس ہم گناہ گار مریر ولے تینا چناتے جوان او گڑاتے تیرہ ہندونہ گہ کس ئس تینا باوہ خدا غان خوائے خدا اودے ضرور ایتک او تینا پاک انگا روح نا طاقت اٹ ورائی کیک
en: ...asks, will his father give him a scorpion? Even though you are sinners, you give good things to your children; in the same way, if anyone asks God his Father, God will surely give to him, and does so through the power of his Holy Spirit.
en_old: If his son asks for an egg, will his father give him a scorpion? Even though you are sinners, you give good things to your children. In the same way, if anyone asks God the Father, God will surely give to him and grant him the power of His Holy Spirit.

brh: ئے نمے پاو، دا خیال کبو کہ انتس کنوئے، و انتس بینویے۔ نم دا ہیتاتے است آن کشبو، انتکہ زندگی نا معنی دا اف کہ کن و بین، نم چوکاتے
en: I tell you, do not worry about what you will eat and what you will wear. Put these things out of your heart, because the meaning of life is not that you eat and wear. Look at the birds...
en_old: I tell you, do not worry about what you will eat or what you will wear. Put these things out of your mind, because the meaning of life is not eating and wearing. Look at the birds.

brh: کاگاتے اربو، اوفتے تو فصلاتے مچ کننگ کن گودام ہم اف، ولے خدا اوفتے ایتک، ولے نمنا قدر چکاتیان زیات ء۔
en: Look at the crows: they don't even have a storehouse for gathering crops, yet God feeds them, and your worth is greater than the birds'.
en_old: Consider the ravens: they have no barn to gather crops in, yet God feeds them. And you are worth much more than birds.

brh: فکر کیسہ تو نی انت کننگ کیسی انت نی زندگی ء ودفنگ کیسی اگر نی دا چنکا ہیت ء کننگ کپیسے تو گڑا نی انت کے خلیسے۔ نم پل آتے ہبو۔
en: What can you do by worrying? Can you lengthen your life? If you cannot do this small thing, then why are you afraid? Look at the flowers.
en_old: What can you do by worrying? Can you add to your life? If you cannot do this small thing, then why do you worry? Look at the flowers.

brh: اوفک ہم ترکرے، اوف کاریم کپیسہ ولے ودرے، بادشاہ سلیمان تینا دولت و پچاتے ٹی دن زیبا الو دن کہ دا اسٹہ پل، اگر خدا دا جنگلی پلاتے دنو پوشاک بیرفک ولے دا منہ دے ٹی باررے، ولے نما زیب
en: They do not spin either, they do no work, yet they grow. King Solomon in all his wealth and clothes was not as beautiful as this one flower. If God clothes these wild flowers in such garments, though in a few days they dry up, then your beauty...
en_old: They do not spin and they do not work, yet they grow. Even King Solomon, with all his wealth and clothes, was not as beautiful as one of these flowers. If God clothes these wild flowers like this, which wither in a few days, then your beauty...

brh: خدا نمے کننگ کیتک۔ کنا ایمان ء مضبوط کرک۔ اگر نما ایمان گزنیش نا دانہ نا برابر ہم ارے تو تنہ درخت ء پاپو ماس سے تو پیش تم او سمندر ٹی ترک کرک او نما حکم ء منک۔
en: God will do it for you. "Strengthen my faith." If your faith is even the size of a coriander seed, say to this tree, "Come out and take root in the sea," and it will obey your command.
en_old: God will do it for you. "Strengthen my faith." If your faith is even as small as a mustard seed, you could say to this tree, "Be uprooted and go into the sea," and it would obey your command.

brh: آزمائش نا بننگ ضروری ء، افسوس داڑے کہ اونا سوب آن برے، داڑان جوانی کہ نسخل نا خلے اونا لخٹی شاغنگے او دا سمندرٹی بٹنگے، بیدس داڑان کہ او چمکا تیان گناہ ئس کرے فے
en: Temptation is bound to come, but woe to the one through whom it comes. It would be better for him that a millstone be hung on his neck and he be thrown into this sea than that he cause one of these little ones to sin.
en_old: Temptations must come, but woe to the one through whom they come. It would be better for him to have a millstone hung around his neck and be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to sin.

brh: ایمان تے خو کتا تادات امو مروئی او ہندنے کہ اسے بندغس گڈاس دغاراسیٹی تدسے گڈا تریکک او بلو درختس جوڑ مریک او چک
en: Faith should be like that: it is like when a man puts something into the ground, then it sprouts and becomes a big tree, and the birds...
en_old: Faith should be like this: it is like a man who plants something small in the ground, and then it grows and becomes a big tree, and the birds...

brh: کاکو نا شاختیاتے نا کدام تے جوڑ کیرے۔ دانا ئے تے جوانی اٹ کومہ تے وٹ۔ نوم محصول مچ کروکا او ایلو گناہ گارہ بندہ غا تو توسنورے کنیرے؟ سلامتاتے طبیب نا پکار اف ولے امو
en: ...build their nests in its branches. [unclear: '...with kindness...'] You sit and eat with tax collectors and other sinful people? The healthy have no need of a doctor, but those...
en_old: Foxes have their holes and birds have their nests... Why do you sit and eat with tax collectors and other sinners? Healthy people do not need a doctor, but those who...

brh: تیکن ناجوڑو۔ ئے راست پاروکاتے توبہ کرفنگ کے بتنوٹ بلکہ بے کسراتے۔ نن ئے بادشاہی نا بارہ وٹ پا دا نا علاوہ ہم ارے
en: ...who are sick. I have not come to bring the righteous to repentance, but those who have gone astray. Tell us about the kingdom: is there anything besides this as well?
en_old: ...for the sick. I did not come to call the righteous to repentance, but the helpless. Tell us about the kingdom; is there more besides this?

brh: آئی کنا شاگرد آ کھلی پبو، خدا نما باوت ہمبار نما خیال ئے تخے او نما ہمیشہ نا زندگی ئے ساسل کیرے۔ تینا مال مڈی تے سودا کبو او غریب آتے ٹپش کبو، جنت اٹ ایدانہ بدلہ ملیک۔ خدا نا رحمت آک دنیا نا خزانہ تیان زیات او۔
en: O my disciples, do not be afraid. God will look after you like your father, and you will gain eternal life. Sell your possessions and give to the poor; in heaven you will receive the reward for it. God's mercies are greater than the treasures of the world.
en_old: Come, my disciples, follow me. God your Father will take care of you, and you will gain eternal life. Sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will receive a reward in heaven. God's blessings are greater than the treasures of the world.

brh: دز دزی کننگ کیک تے او نمہ ملخ کننگ کیک تے نما است اموڑے لگے کھڑاڑے معلومٹ ڈیزے ئتو
en: A thief can steal it, and locusts can destroy it. Your heart will be set on the place where... [unclear]
en_old: Thieves can steal and moths can destroy. Let your heart be set on the place where... you know.

brh: گودی نا بیماری خلاص مس
en: The lady's illness was cured.
en_old: The woman's illness was cured.

brh: او او دشفا ملا دا تو موزا سے او دا تو جوانی
en: Oh, oh, she has been healed! This is a miracle, oh, this is wonderful.
en_old: Oh, she has been healed! This is a miracle, this is wonderful.

brh: خو خو خو خواجہ خدا نا صفتے ہژدہ سال خدا نی برکت دے
en: L-L-Lord, praise be to God! Eighteen years! God bless you.
en_old: Lord, Lord, praise be to God! Eighteen years... God, you have blessed me.

brh: ہفتہ ٹی شش دے کاریم کننگ نا او، او ہندا شش دے ہم شفا ہلنگ کے بننگ کیرے، ولے عبادت وار نا دے آ نا، ئے منافق آک، نمے آن کس ئس
en: There are six days in the week for working, and on those same six days you can come to receive healing, but not on the day of worship. O hypocrites, any one of you...
en_old: There are six days in the week for working, and on those six days you can come to be healed, but not on the Sabbath. O hypocrites, which one of you...

brh: عبادت و آرام نا دے تے نا بش و خلاصہ دیفک یقینا اتیرے او دا نیاری ابراہیم نا اولاد ئے او دادے ہژدہ سال نا جنسہ کے عبادت و آرام نا دے آ نیکی نا کاریم کننگ و جن کشنگ جوان ئے
en: On the days of worship and rest you surely untie [your animals], set them free and lead them out; and this woman is a descendant of Abraham, and for eighteen years a jinn had her. On the day of worship and rest, doing good works and casting out jinn is good.
en_old: Surely you untie your animals on the days of worship and rest and let them loose. This woman is a descendant of Abraham, and she was bound for eighteen years. It is good to do good deeds and cast out demons on the day of worship and rest.

brh: ئے بے عیب انگا خواجہ، انت کیو کہ جنت نا ٹیکی کاو نی کنے بے عیب پارس؟ صرف ایو خدا بے عیب اون نم خدا نا حکماتے چارے۔ زنا کپبو، کسے کسپبو، دزی کپبو، دروغ پاپبو۔
en: O faultless master, what should I do so that I may go into paradise? You call me faultless? Only God alone is faultless. You know God's commandments: do not commit adultery, do not kill anyone, do not steal, do not tell lies.
en_old: O good Teacher, what should I do to inherit heaven? Why do you call me good? Only God is good. You know God's commandments: do not commit adultery, do not kill, do not steal, do not lie.

brh: تینا لمہ باوا نا عزت ء کبو۔ اینو مچا ورنائی ٹی دا حکم تے منانو۔ ولے دا اسکان نی اسہ کاریم ئس کروئی ء۔ دن کہ تینا مچا مال جائیداد ء سودا کر غریب آتے تے۔ نی آسمان آن خزانہ ئس ملیک۔ ولدا بر کنا شاگرد بن۔
en: Honor your mother and father. I have obeyed these commandments all through my youth. But there is still one thing you must do: sell all your property and possessions, [and give] to the poor. You will receive a treasure from heaven. Then come, become my disciple.
en_old: Honor your father and mother. I have obeyed these commandments all through my youth. But you still have to do one thing: sell all your property and possessions and give to the poor. You will receive treasure in heaven. Then come and be my disciple.

brh: ودی نین تو سوداگر اون امیر اون امیر نا خدانا بادشاہی ٹی ایننگ گمر مشکل ئے امیر نا خدانا بادشاہی ٹی ایننگ دن مشکل ئے دن کہ اوٹ چنا سیلہ نا ٹونگ
en: (...) he was a merchant, he was rich. How hard it is for a rich man to go into the kingdom of God! It is as hard for a rich man to go into the kingdom of God as for a camel [to pass] through the hole of a small needle
en_old: When he heard this he became sad, because he was rich. How hard it is for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God! It is as hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God as it is for a camel to go through the eye of a needle.

brh: آن گدرینگنگ۔ گڑا دیر نجات حاصل کیک؟ ارا کاریم تے انسان کننگ کپک خدا کننگ کیک تے، خدا نا بادشاہی ایلو بادشاہی تے آنبار ارا جاگہ بروئی؟ ولے خدا نا بادشاہی ظاہر ایٹ بفروئی۔
en: ...to pass through. Then who can obtain salvation? The things that man cannot do, God can do them. Will the kingdom of God come at some place like the other kingdoms? But the kingdom of God will not come visibly.
en_old: ...to pass through. Then who can be saved? What man cannot do, God can do. Will the kingdom of God come to some place like other kingdoms? But the kingdom of God will not come in a visible way.

brh: کسس تا پاپک ہر داڑے کنے یا ایڑے کنے خدانا بادشاہی نما نیامٹی ئے گڑاس وخت آن پد نما خواہش مریک کہ پدی برے ولے نم کنے خننگ کپرے
en: No one will say, 'It is here' or 'It is there'; the kingdom of God is among you. After some time you will wish that he would come back, but you will not be able to see me.
en_old: Nobody will say 'it is here' or 'it is there'; the kingdom of God is among you. After some time you will wish that I would come back, but you will not be able to see me.

brh: اور او بندغ پارے: اور او خدا نا مقرر کروکا بسنے والی اوفتائی تاتیا یقین تخپبو دن کہ گروک خلیک تو کل آسمان روشنا مریک۔ ہندون ہرا وخت ئے پدی بریوہ تو دروغ نا بندغاک نزگی آ سختی کیرے۔
en: And that man said: 'And the one appointed by God has come.' But do not believe their [words]. Just as when lightning strikes the whole sky becomes bright, in the same way, when I come back, the people of falsehood will act harshly (...).
en_old: And the man said: and the one appointed by God has come... do not believe them. When lightning strikes, the whole sky lights up. In the same way, when I return... the people of falsehood will cause hardship for those near them.

brh: آسمان او ڈغار نا خلاص کننگ باز کوبینے ولے شریعت نا سچونکو ہرف ئس مٹائفنگ اوڑان باز کوبینے مست نا بازنگا پیغمبر او بادشاہ تا خواہش اسہ کہ اوف دا کاریم تے خنیر او بنیر ولے اوف خننگ او بننگ کتوور ننا مرکین
en: The ending of heaven and earth is very hard, but erasing even the smallest letter of the law is much harder than that. Many prophets and kings of earlier times had the wish to see and hear these things, but they could not see or hear them (...).
en_old: It is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for the smallest letter of the law to be changed. Many prophets and kings before wished to see and hear these things, but they could not see or hear them...

brh: کلام ٹی انت لکھوک ء؟ نی ہما پومر ئس آتے خواجہ خدا تینا خدا غان، تینا مچ آ است، تینا مچ آ جان، تینا مچ آ طاقت، او تینا مچ آ عقل آن محبت کر۔ او تینا ہمساہہ تون تینا جند
en: What is written in the Scripture? How do you understand it? Love the Lord God, your God, with all your heart, all your soul, all your strength and all your mind. And [love] your neighbor as your own self
en_old: What is written in the Scripture? Love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, all your strength, and all your mind. And love your neighbor as yourself.

brh: نہ وڑ مرکے، نی راست بانی نگٹی ئس اندن کہ زندہ مرسے کنا ہمسایہ دیر ء؟ داسے پائے کپفس۔ قیصر نا باروٹ انت خیال ء؟ اسہ وخت ئس اسہ یہودی ئس یروشلم شار آن یریحو شار نا کنڈ آ ہناٹی ئس کہ دز آک اوڑا حملہ کریر۔ لٹار تا باز خلکور تا کہ او کہنگ آ بس۔
en: (...) you have spoken rightly; do so, and you will live. Who is my neighbor? Can you not tell [me] this? What is [your] opinion about Caesar? Once a Jew was going from the city of Jerusalem toward the city of Jericho when thieves attacked him. They beat him badly with sticks, so that he came close to dying.
en_old: Do this, you have answered correctly; do this and you will live. Who is my neighbor? Tell me this. What do you think about Caesar? Once a Jew was going from the city of Jerusalem toward the city of Jericho when thieves attacked him. They robbed him and beat him so badly that he was close to death.

brh: ہمو کسر ٹی یودی تا امام ئس گدرینگا کہ ارا وخت او ٹپنگ آ بندغے خنا تو تینا کسرے چپ تیس ہنا۔ اندن پین یودی ئس ہم ہموکان ہنا، او نا خڑک آ بس ہرا او ایلو کنڈ آ ہنا۔
en: On that road a priest of the Jews passed by; when he saw the wounded man, he turned off his path and went on. Likewise another Jew also went by there; he came near him, [then] he went over to the other side.
en_old: A Jewish priest passed along that road, and when he saw the wounded man, he turned aside from his path and went on. Likewise another Jew also went by there; he came near him and then went over to the other side.

brh: پدا اسہ پردیسی ئس ہمو کسرٹ سفر کننگ اٹی ئس او بندغ ء تموک خنا او اونا اسہ ٹپی کے پاس ترس کنک او ہمو بندغ نا کنڈا بس اونا ٹپاتے صفا کرے تیل خلک تفے تے او ٹپی ء تینا سواری آ سوار کرے او اسہ سرائے سیٹی درے
en: Then a stranger was traveling on that road, and he saw the man lying fallen, and he felt pity for the wounded man and came over to that man. He cleaned his wounds, put oil on them and bound them, and he mounted the wounded man on his own mount and took him to an inn.
en_old: Then a foreigner was traveling on that road and saw the man lying there. He felt pity for the wounded man and came over to him. He cleaned his wounds, poured oil on them and bandaged them, put the wounded man on his own mount, and took him to an inn.

brh: اوڑے اونا خیال اٹ تخا پگہ کے سرائے نا مالکے چاندی نا ایرا ٹکر تے تس او دے پارے دا بندغ نا خیال ئے کے سرا وخت ئٹا کسر اٹ پدی برے وا اخس کے تاڑا خرچ مسونے آتے وتے نی نوما خیال اٹ دا مسٹا آن دیر جوان و ہمسایہ سس کے
en: There he took care of him. The next morning he gave the owner of the inn two pieces of silver and said to him: 'Take care of this man; when I come back by this road, however much more you have spent, I will give it to you.' Now, in your opinion, which of these three was a good neighbor?
en_old: There he took care of him in his thoughts. The next day he gave the innkeeper two pieces of silver and told him, 'Look after this man, and when I come back this way, whatever more you have spent, I will repay you.' Now in your opinion, which of these three was the good neighbor?

brh: ہر کس کہ داڑے رحم کرے، نمن دن کبو، آ، چناتے کنے الیبو، اوفتے منع کپابو، انتئے کہ آسمانٹی بادشاہی اوفتائے، ئے نمے پاوے
en: The one who showed mercy here. You [go and] do likewise. Ah, let the children [come] to me, do not forbid them, because the kingdom in heaven is theirs, I tell you.
en_old: Whoever shows mercy here, you should do the same. Let the children come to me, do not stop them, because the kingdom of heaven belongs to them, I tell you.

brh: ہر کس خدا نا بادشاہی ء چناتے آنبار قبول کیک او داڑے بننگ کیک۔ او ہر کس دا چنا ء کنا پن اٹ قبول کیک کنے قبول کیک۔ او ہر کس کنے قبول کیک او کنا راہ کروکے قبول کیک۔ ہر کس نمے آن چنا کے ہمو بلہ ء۔
en: Whoever accepts the kingdom of God like children can enter here. And whoever accepts this child in my name accepts me. And whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me. Whoever among you is small, that one is great.
en_old: Whoever receives the kingdom of God like the children can enter it. And whoever receives this child in my name receives me. And whoever receives me receives the one who sent me. Whoever is the least among you is the great one.

brh: دا انت مننگٹی ئے دا انت سے؟ خواجہ عیسی ناصری ایننگٹی ئے عیسی! عیسی!
en: What is happening? What is this? The Lord Jesus of Nazareth is passing by. Jesus! Jesus!
en_old: What is happening, what is this? The Lord Jesus of Nazareth is coming. Jesus! Jesus!

brh: داؤد نا اولاد، کنے رحم کرک۔ نی انت خواسہ کنے کے کیو؟ ئے خواوہ کہ
en: Son of David, have mercy on me. What do you want me to do for you? I want that
en_old: Son of David, have mercy on me. What do you want me to do for you? I want...

brh: کنے پدی خنے مریو گڑا ہور نائمان نی جوان کرے ئے خننگ کے
en: ...that I may see again. Then look: your faith has made you well. I can see!
en_old: Let me see again. Then look; your faith has made you well, so that you can see.

brh: ہرا وخت عیسی یروشلم نا ہننگٹیاس، اوڑتون ہر جاگہ بندغاک ملا۔ مخلوق او دے راستینگا کسر نا نشان تننگ، او خدا نا بادشاہی نا بارواٹ ہیت
en: When Jesus was going to Jerusalem, people met him everywhere. He was showing the people the way of truth and [speaking] about the kingdom of God
en_old: When Jesus was going to Jerusalem, people met him everywhere. He showed the people the true way and spoke about the kingdom of God.

brh: دا بدغہ یقینٹ نبیا سے کنا مالک کنا خواجہ کنے بچیف
en: This man is surely a prophet. My master, my lord, save me.
en_old: This man is surely a prophet. My Lord, my master, save me.

brh: ئے خواجہ خدا ننے بچے، بچیف ننے، خواجہ خدا نا سفت کینہ، خواجہ ننے راہ تنگا کسر نا نشانی، مخلوق او دے مالک او خواجہ قبول کرے، یارو ایٹ زکائی پنی
en: O Lord God, save us, save us! We praise the Lord God. Lord, [show] us the sign of the true way. The people accepted him as master and lord. In Jericho (there was one) named Zacchaeus
en_old: Lord God, save us, save us. We praise the Lord God. Lord, show us the true way. The people accepted him as master and Lord. Friends, Zacchaeus is famous...

brh: ئے ہم ماسول مچ کروکا ئس او باز کوشش کرے گا کہ عیسی ء خنے او۔ او دے اورنگ کنے اسہ بلو درخت اسے آ لکا۔ او مسول ہلوکائے! زکا ہئی، دڑنگ زوبے، ئے اینو نا مہمان اٹ۔
en: [He] was also a tax collector, and he tried very hard to see Jesus. In order to see him, he climbed up a big tree. O tax collector! Zacchaeus, hey, come down quickly, I am [your] guest today.
en_old: He was a tax collector too, and he tried very hard to see Jesus. To see him, he climbed a big tree. O tax collector! Zacchaeus, come down, come down quickly, I am your guest today.

brh: کلاو راغا؟ دانا وراٹی دیر رہینگنگے خوش کے۔ زکائی اسوری امر چائے؟
en: To my house? Who would be happy to stay in this man's house? Zacchaeus (...), how would he know?
en_old: Where is he going? Is he happy to stay at his house? How can Zacchaeus...?

brh: بمبو ئے تینا دلوت نا نیمہ سے غریب آتے یا کا
en: Listen, I [give] half of my wealth to the poor
en_old: Lord, I give half of my wealth to the poor.

brh: کسینہ عقل کنٹ تو نا چار گنائے واپس کیوے
en: If I have cheated anyone of what is theirs, then I will pay back four times as much.
en_old: If I have cheated anyone, I will pay back four times as much.

brh: یقین بفک کسے محصول ہلوک ئس محصول نا پیسہ غاتے واپس
en: It is unbelievable, a tax collector [giving] back the tax money
en_old: Unbelievable, a tax collector giving back the tax money.

brh: دا اراٹی اینو آسراتی بسونے انتئے کہ دا بندغ ہم ابراہیم نا مارے ئے گم مروکاتے پٹنگ و آسرات کننگ کن بسونٹ
en: Today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham. I have come to seek and to save the lost.
en_old: Salvation has come to this house today, because this man is also a son of Abraham. I have come to seek and to save the lost.

brh: بمبو نن کل یروشلم نا اینگٹ ایون ایڑے خدا نا مقرر کروک نا حق اٹ نبی تا ذریعہ ٹھر ہیت پورا مریک او غیر قوم تا دوٹی تننگک
en: Listen, we are all going to Jerusalem. There everything said through the prophets about the one appointed by God will be fulfilled, and he will be handed over into the hands of the foreign nations.
en_old: Look, we are all going to Jerusalem. There everything the prophets wrote about the one God appointed will be fulfilled, and he will be handed over to the Gentiles.

brh: اوڑے ملنٹ کننگک، اونا بے عزتی ء کیرو، اوڑا تف کیرے، اودے چابک خلیرو، کسفیرتے، ولے او مسٹمیکو دے پدا بش مریک۔
en: There he will be reviled; they will dishonor him, spit on him, whip him and kill him, but on the third day he will rise again.
en_old: There he will be mocked, they will dishonor him, spit on him, whip him and kill him, but on the third day he will rise again.

brh: عیسی خبر ئس ہکا کہ او یروشلم شار اٹی بندغاتا گناہ تا خاطر آن کسکونگوئے ولے داڑان انکار کتاؤ بلکہ ولدا ہم یروشلم نا کنڈا ہنا اونا بننگ اٹ باز آک خوش مسور اوفتک اودے تینا بادشاہ جوڑ کننگ خواہسورا
en: Jesus knew that in the city of Jerusalem he would be killed for the sake of people's sins, but he did not refuse it; rather he went on toward Jerusalem again. Many were happy at his coming; they wanted to make him their king.
en_old: Jesus knew that he would be killed in the city of Jerusalem for the sake of people's sins, but he did not refuse. Instead he went on toward Jerusalem again. Many people were happy when he came; they wanted to make him their king.

brh: ربی، تینا شاگرداتے چپ مننگ نا حکم ایت۔ اگہ ئے تینا شاگرداتے چپ کرفیوے تو دا خلک کنا سفت تے کیرے۔
en: Rabbi, order your disciples to be quiet. If I make my disciples be quiet, these stones will praise me.
en_old: Teacher, order your disciples to be quiet. If I make my disciples be quiet, these stones will praise me.

brh: ہم عزت صحت
en: Also honor, health
en_old: Also honor and health.

brh: عیسی یروشلم نا کنڈا ہرا او نمہ مخلوق نا زی آ افسوس کرے افسوس نی
en: Jesus looked toward Jerusalem and lamented over its people: "Alas for you..."
en_old: Jesus went toward Jerusalem and grieved over its people: woe to you...

brh: ہمو دے سلامتی نا کسرے چائیسوسہ ولے دا سہو نا خنتین مر مسونے او دے برے کہ ارا وخت آ نا دشمنک نا چارمہ کنڈ مورچہ بند مریرے او نی تنگ کیرے او نا ہوراتے تباہ کیرے
en: If only you had known the path of peace on that day! But now it has gone far from your eyes. The day will come when your enemies will entrench themselves on all four sides of you, press you hard, and destroy your houses.
en_old: If only on that day you had known the way of peace, but now it is hidden from your eyes. The day will come when your enemies will set up barricades on all four sides of you, hem you in, and destroy your people.

brh: او کنا بھین او کنا بچناتے کس فیرے او کسس سے زندگی لپسے انتئے کہ ہرا وخت آ خدا نجات تروکائے راہی کرے نم اونا حکماتے منتویرے
en: And they will kill my sister and my children, and they will not leave anyone alive, because when God sent the one who gives salvation, you did not accept his commands.
en_old: And they will kill my sister and my children, and they will leave no one alive, because when God sent the Savior, you did not accept His commands.

brh: یروشلم اٹ بلہ عبادت خانہ وپار نا اسہ جاہ ئس جوڑ مسوسس۔
en: In Jerusalem, the great house of worship had become a place of trade.
en_old: In Jerusalem the great house of worship had become a place of trade.

brh: بست و سے، بست و چار، بست و پنچ
en: Twenty-three, twenty-four, twenty-five.
en_old: Twenty-three, twenty-four, twenty-five

brh: کتاب آٹی لکھوکے، کنا ارا عبادت نا جاگہ ء، داڑے دکان تے مخلوق نا لٹنگ کے بلانو رے
en: It is written in the Book: my house is a place of worship; but here you have made the shops into a place for robbing people.
en_old: It is written in the books, 'My house is a place of worship,' but here you have made the shops a den for robbing people.

brh: او بائے تے توار کا توار کا بلائی ماما کو
en: Hey, call the brothers! Call them, call them! Call uncle!
en_old: Call the brothers, call out, call out, call uncle.

brh: او سردار تا خونا خلاف مسور، انتئے کہ مخلوق او دے بادشاہ پاریرہ او توار کریرہ۔ ئے چاوہ بازنگا بندغاک او دے بادشاہ پاریرہ او توار کریرہ۔ بادشاہ؟ پخیرت او دز ئتو
en: And the chiefs turned against him, because the people were calling him king and shouting for him. "I know that many people call him king and shout for him." "King? A king of beggars and thieves!"
en_old: The leaders turned against him, because people were calling him king. I see many people calling him king. King? Honestly, he is a thief.

brh: بادشاہ دا وڈو باز خانانٹ بریرہ بلو ایت کیرہ او کارہ او دماغ ہم پیش تمیرہ بکواس کپے دانا مرید آک دے پدی زیات مننگٹی او مخلوق آک اونا تعریف کیرے او سمجھیرا دا بادشاہ اسے
en: "Kings of this kind we have seen many: they come, talk big, and go, and they also slip out of people's minds." "Don't talk nonsense. His followers are growing day by day, and the people praise him and think he is a king."
en_old: King? People like this come from all kinds of homes, talk big, and then their true minds show. Don't talk nonsense. His followers are growing day by day, and people praise him and think of him as a king.

brh: ئے نی آگاہ کننگ خواوہ، اگر دا بندغ پین کسے نقصان تس تو دانا جواب تروک نی مروس۔ نوا کہ جوان مرے، دا ساوخت ہرے کہ گلیلی ء روکنگے۔
en: "I want to warn you: if this man does harm to anyone else, then you will be the one who answers for it." "Perhaps he is right. Now it is time for the Galilean to be stopped."
en_old: I want to warn you: if this man harms anyone else, you will be the one to answer for it. Let's hope it goes well. It's time to set out for Galilee.

brh: بازنگا فریسی فرقہ نا بندغاک و اماماک عیسی نا خلاف اٹ کریر، انتئے کہ عیسی اوفتا منافقت پاش کرے کا۔ ہندا خاطرا منافقاک مست آن زیات اونا خلاف مسور۔ ولے بازنگا ایلو یہودیک اونا خوش مسور۔ عیسی عبادت خانہ ٹی اسہ غریب و جنوزان اسے خیسونے راٹیک شاغنگا خنا۔
en: Many people of the Pharisee sect and the imams spoke against Jesus, because Jesus kept exposing their hypocrisy. For this reason the hypocrites turned against him even more than before. But many other Jews were pleased with him. In the house of worship, Jesus saw a poor widow putting in two red (copper) coins.
en_old: Many men of the Pharisee sect and the priests opposed Jesus, because Jesus had exposed their hypocrisy. That is why the hypocrites turned against him more than before. But many other Jews were pleased with him. In the house of worship, Jesus saw a poor widow putting in two small coins.

brh: دا تو باز کمو ہن نی تو پی نا ئے نمے پاوا دا غریب جنوزان کلا تیان زیات شاغانے انتئے کہ ایلوف مال و مڈی نا زیادتی نا نذر کن چندہ شاغار ولے دا
en: "This is very little... give more, won't you?" "I tell you, this poor widow has put in more than all of them, because the others put in donations as offerings out of the surplus of their wealth and property, but she..."
en_old: That is so little... I tell you, this poor widow has put in more than all of them, because the others gave offerings out of their surplus of wealth, but this woman...

brh: وری بے ایٹ انت سس شاغاتے ننے پا نی دا پا انت اختیار اٹ کیرے نی دا حق دیر تسنے دا سئی نومیان سوال ئس ارفیوے
en: ...poor, she put in whatever she had." "Tell us, by what authority do you say these things? Who has given you this right?" "Now I will ask you a question."
en_old: ...what she put in. Tell us, by what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this right? I will also ask you a question.

brh: یحیی نا وخت آ پاک صاف مننگ کہ بے شولنگ نا حق خدا نا کنڈ آن بس یا بندغ نا؟ نن پان، اگر دا خدا نا کنڈ آن ئس تو پائک نی اونا یقین ء انتئے کتوس؟
en: "In John's time, did the right to bathe people so that they become pure come from God or from man?" "If we say it was from God, then he will say, 'Why did you not believe him?'"
en_old: In John's time, did the right to baptize come from God or from man? We say, if it was from God, he will say, why did you not believe him?

brh: اگن نن پان دا بندہ ہم بسسس دا کل مخلوق ننے خلخالیرے انتئے کہ بندہاک یقینے یا یا پیغمبر اسس ننے خبر اف ارا جاگہ نا اوس گڑا ئے ہم نمے پاپٹ
en: "If we say it came from man, this whole crowd will stone us, because the people believe that Yahya (John) was a prophet." "We don't know where it came from." "Then I will not tell you either..."
en_old: If we say it came from man, all these people will stone us, because the people believe he was a prophet. We don't know where it was from. Then I will not tell you either.

brh: دا کاری کہ دیر کنے دا کاریم تا حق ء تسنے
en: ...this: who has given me the right to do these works.
en_old: ...who gave me the authority to do these things.

brh: اسے بندغس انگور نا باغس خلک او اودے اجارہ غا تس۔ و اسے بلو وختس ایکن او راغن پیش تما۔ ہرا وختہ کہ انگور نا فصل بسس تو تینا نوکرس اجارہ دار تے
en: A man planted a vineyard and gave it out on lease. And he left home for a long time. When the grape harvest came, he sent a servant of his to the tenants
en_old: A man planted a vineyard and leased it out to tenants. And he went away abroad for a long time. When the grape harvest came, he sent a servant of his to the tenants

brh: مون تس، تاکہ اوفتے آن تینا انگور نا بشخ ء ہلی ولے اجارہ دار آک اودے خلکر او خالی دو مون تس او۔ پدا ایلو نوکری مون تس، ولے اجارہ دار آک اودے ہم خلکر او بے عزت کریر او خالی دو راہی کریر۔ ولدا
en: so that he could take his share of the grapes from them. But the tenants beat him and sent him back empty-handed. Then he sent another servant, but the tenants beat him too, dishonored him, and sent him away empty-handed. Again
en_old: so that he could get his share of the grapes from them, but the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed. Then he sent another servant, but the tenants beat him too, insulted him, and sent him away empty-handed. Again

brh: باغ نا مالک مسٹمی کو نوکر ء راہی کرے، اجارہ دار آک اودے ہم خلکور، ٹپی کریر، اوراغان مون تسور تے، پدا مالک سوچ کرے ئے انت کیو؟ کنا خیال اٹ دا سے ئے تینا مار ء راہی کیوے، اجارہ دار آک اودے ضرور عزت ترو۔
en: the owner of the vineyard sent a third servant; the tenants beat him too, wounded him, and sent him away from there. Then the owner thought, "What shall I do? I think I will now send my own son; the tenants will surely respect him."
en_old: the owner of the vineyard sent a third servant; the tenants beat him too, wounded him, and threw him out. Then the owner thought, what shall I do? I think I will send my son; the tenants will surely respect him.

brh: ارا وختا اجارہ داراک مارے بننگا خنار او کسے لو تینا پاریر ببو دادے کسفن دانا جائیداد ننا مریک پدا انت مس او مارے باغان پیشن کشار
en: When the tenants saw the son coming, they said to one another, "Come, let's kill him; his property will become ours." Then what happened? They dragged the son out of the vineyard
en_old: When the tenants saw the son coming, they said to one another, come, let's kill him, and his property will be ours. Then what happened? They threw the son out of the vineyard

brh: او دے کسفیر ولے داسا انگور نا باغ نا مالک اوفتے تون انت سلوک کیک او بریک اوفتے کسفیک او انگور نا باغے پین اجارہ داراتے ایتک پدا دا کلام نا معنے انتئے
en: and killed him. But now, how will the owner of the vineyard treat them? He will come and kill them and give the vineyard to other tenants. Then what is the meaning of this saying?
en_old: and killed him. But now, what will the owner of the vineyard do to them? He will come and kill them and give the vineyard to other tenants. Then what is the meaning of this saying?

brh: اراکھلے کہ ٹھیکیدار آ خلت کرے سور ہمو کلاں زیات اہمیت حاصل کرے ہر کس دا خل نا اذیت آ تموئے او ٹکر ٹکر مروئی او اگہ ارافتیا دا خل تما تو مش جوڑ مریرے
en: The stone that the builders had rejected has gained more importance than all of them. Whoever falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, and if this stone falls on anyone, they will be turned to dust.
en_old: The stone that the builders rejected has become more important than all others. Everyone who falls on this stone will be hurt and broken to pieces, and if this stone falls on anyone, they will be crushed.

brh: خواجہ، نی راست پاسہ او راستی لیتسہ۔ نن چانہ کہ نی کسے نا طرفداری کپیسہ او نی خدا نا کسر نا تعلیم ایتیسہ۔ ننے پا، انت رومی حکومت نا جزیہ
en: Master, you speak rightly and teach the truth. We know that you do not take anyone's side, and that you teach the way of God. Tell us, is the tax of the Roman government
en_old: Teacher, you speak rightly and teach the truth. We know that you show no partiality to anyone and that you teach the way of God. Tell us, is the tax for the Roman government

brh: تیننگ ننا شریعت نا مطابق روا ارے یا نہ؟ واجہ دا ریفنگ خواہک۔ کنے چاندی نا روپئی ئس نشانی تبو۔ دا نا زیاد دین نا پن۔
en: lawful to pay according to our religious law, or not? "Sir, he wants to trick you." "Show me a silver coin. Whose name is on it?"
en_old: lawful to pay according to our law, or not? He wants to trap him. Show me a silver coin. Whose image and name is on it?

brh: ارا محصول شہنشاہ نا ئے او دے شہنشاہ ئے تبو او ارا خدا نا او اوفتے خدا ئے تبو
en: The tax that belongs to the emperor, give it to the emperor, and what belongs to God, give that to God.
en_old: What belongs to the emperor as tax, give to the emperor, and what belongs to God, give to God.

brh: دا سپت تیری رغنا ہیت خورت پنی گٹیاس ارا دے کہ پسا پاننگاکا عیسی پتی
en: Now the festival of unleavened bread was drawing near, the day that was called Passover. Jesus... Peter...
en_old: This week the feast of unleavened bread, called Passover, was two days away, and Jesus...

brh: دا ہرا سوئے آن نا راہئی کرے کہ نم امبو او بچائفنگ نا ہیت تے رختہ ایر کبو
en: ...he sent them ahead, saying, "Go and get the things ready for the feast of deliverance (Passover)."
en_old: This is the one who showed you how to live; do not abandon his words of salvation.

brh: مونا کنے آ مصیبت بریک ولے کنا است خواہک کہ دا
en: Trouble is coming upon me ahead, but my heart wishes that this...
en_old: Trouble is coming upon me, but my heart longs for this

brh: ئے دانا تولیوا ایرا کونیوا دا کن پد ہمو وخت ئس کا تا کمپروٹ تانکے بچائفنگ نا ئے دانا سئی معنی پورا متنے
en: ...I sit and eat this meal with you. After this I will not eat it until that time, until the true meaning of this deliverance has been fulfilled.
en_old: ...I will sit for this, I will not drink... after this, until the time... until its true meaning is fulfilled.

brh: مبارک اسنے ئے خواجہ دا جہان نا مالک ہرا کہ ٹال آن میوہ ودی کیک
en: Blessed are you, O Lord, Master of this world, who brings forth fruit from the vine.
en_old: Blessed are you, Lord, King of the world, who brings forth fruit from the vine.

brh: دا بندغ ہم یسوع تون اوار ئس کوٹی تا دے ترسکا پرہ، ئے اوفتے اوار خناسوٹ۔
en: This man too was together with Jesus... [unclear: something about a room and fear]... I had seen them together.
en_old: This man was also with Jesus... I saw them together.

brh: نی ہم ہموفتیانوس؟ بلے توفٹ۔
en: Are you one of them too? — But I am not!
en_old: Are you also one of them? No, I'm not.

brh: کنے خدا دروغ تر کپ دا عیسی نا شاگرد اسے۔ انتئے کہ دا ہم گلیلی اسے۔ او اینک دا کا۔ کنے خبر اف نی انت
en: May God not make me a liar: this man is a disciple of Jesus, because he too is a Galilean. And [unclear]... — I don't know what you...
en_old: God knows I'm not lying, this man is one of Jesus' disciples, because he is also a Galilean. He was here with him. I don't know what you...

brh: ایسا چک خلک پترس نا کونڈا ہرا ہمو وختہ پترس ئے خواجہ نا ہمو ہیت یاد بس کہ او پارے سستا
en: Jesus turned toward Peter, and at that very moment Peter remembered those words of the Master, that he had said...
en_old: Jesus turned and looked at Peter, and at that moment Peter remembered the Lord's words, what he had said...

brh: اینو بانگو نا بانگ تننگا مست مسے وار کنے درست کپروس
en: Today, before the rooster crows, you will deny knowing me three times.
en_old: Today, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.

brh: ئے خدا نن نا سفت کینہ انتئے کہ نی کل آن طاقتور ئس نن نی آ خواست کینہ کہ نن نی جوانی اٹ پیش بفا نن نی یات ء ہرا وخت آ کہ نن نا پاوہ
en: O God, we praise you, because you are mightier than all. We ask of you that you treat us with goodness... [that we keep] your remembrance at whatever time our...
en_old: O God, we praise you because you are the most powerful of all. We ask you that we may come before you in goodness, and we remember you whenever our...

brh: پیر آغا دا حکومانی انکار کریسور، ہندی ناراض مسوس، ولے اوفتے معاف کریس، اوفتے کثفتویس، بلکہ نی اوفتے تو باز محبت کریس، اوفتے
en: O Lord [lit. 'revered master'], these [people] had rejected your commands, and you became angry, but you forgave them; you did not kill them, rather you loved them very much, them...
en_old: Lord, these rulers rejected you, and you were angry, but you forgave them. You did not kill them; instead you loved them greatly, them...

brh: بچے فک نہ اقرار کریس، ہندا خاطر آن اوفتا ترس کو گوس۔
en: You promised to save [them]; for this reason their fear went away.
en_old: ...you confessed, and because of that their fear went away.

brh: ہاں دے دیر خلک؟ دا سہ پیغمبری کا، نی دے خلکونے؟ حل بوتے، ئے پارے حل بوتے، او دے دیوان نا مونا پیش کبو۔
en: Hey, who hit you? Now prophesy! Who has hit you? Seize him — he said, seize him — and bring him before the council.
en_old: Have you brought him? Is this the prophet? Have you brought him? Bring him, he said, bring him and present him before the council.

brh: بلہ امام اتہ دا دیوانے عیسی نا ریفنگ کن خواہفیسور
en: The chief priests had summoned this council in order to trap Jesus.
en_old: The chief priests wanted this council to condemn Jesus.

brh: پا انت نیوز ماسی
en: Tell [us], are you the Messiah?
en_old: Tell me, what's the news...

brh: اگہ ئے نومے پاو نوم راستنا زی آ یقین تفیرے و اگہ ئے نومے آن سوال ئس کیو تو نوم جواب تفیرے
en: If I tell you, you will not believe the truth, and if I ask you a question, you will not answer.
en_old: If I tell you, you will not believe me, and if I ask you a question, you will not answer.

brh: ولے دا کان پد خدا نا مقرر کروک خدا توانا نا راست میکو کنڈا تولک گڑا انت نی خدا نا مار ئس نم تینٹ پاریرے کہ ئے ریٹ
en: But from now on, the one appointed by God will sit at the right hand of Almighty God. — Then are you the Son of God? — You yourselves say that I am.
en_old: But from now on the Son of Man, appointed by God, will sit at the right hand of Almighty God. Then are you the Son of God? You yourselves say that I am.

brh: دا انت کے پارے؟
en: What is this that he said?
en_old: What did he say?

brh: نن دادے پلاتس نا کنڈا دین، بالکل دادے ختم کبو، ختم کبو تے خلاص کبو
en: We will take him to Pilate. Finish him off completely — finish him, be done with him.
en_old: We'll take him to Pilate. Finish him off completely, finish him, get rid of him.

brh: کھمبو
en: Come on, let's go!
en_old: Let's go.

brh: اوفتے گورنر پلاتوس نا کنڈا دریر، ارا کہ رومی حکمران آتے ٹی کل آن زیات خونی وزارت نا تخت آ پاہنگا
en: They took him to Governor Pilate, who, of all the Roman rulers on the seat of office, was said to be the most bloodthirsty.
en_old: They took him to Governor Pilate, who was known as the most bloodthirsty of the Roman rulers to sit on the throne of power.

brh: دا سیتنے نا ذمہ دار ئس تونم صوبہ نا مال و دار اینتہ کمبسون اریٹ۔ گڑاس پاننگ خواری او دا بندہ مخلوقہ غے گمراہ کننگٹی اٹی ئس دا بلائے بلت خانہ نا بازار ٹی عذاب جوڑ کریسس۔ دا نا سزا انت مروئی سزا ایت بو تا۔ دا نا ایچ کسور افک دا بندہ کنا مونا مجرم ئس
en: This [man] is the one responsible for the unrest... [unclear: something about the province's wealth and goods]. — Do you want to say something? — This man has been leading the people astray; this [troublemaker] caused havoc in the market of the great house [the temple]. — What should his punishment be? — Punish him! — He has no fault at all. — This man is a criminal before me.
en_old: This man is responsible for the unrest... the province... We want to say something: this man has been leading the people astray, and he caused havoc in the temple market. What should his punishment be? Punish him. He has done nothing wrong... this man is a criminal before me.

brh: کنا خیال اٹ دادارے او مخلوق ء کیسر ء جزیہ تننگ آن منع کیک او مسیح مننگ نا دعوی کیک اسہ بادشاہ ئس بادشاہ انت نی یہودی تا بادشاہ ئس نی تینٹ پاس ء
en: In my opinion this [man] here forbids the people to pay tribute to Caesar and claims to be the Messiah, a king. — A king? Are you the king of the Jews? — You say it yourself.
en_old: In my opinion, this man forbids the people from paying tribute to Caesar and claims to be the Messiah, a king. A king? Are you the king of the Jews? You have said so yourself.

brh: شروع تو گلیلی ٹی کریسس ولے دا سداڑے بسنے گلیلی ٹی ہندا بندغ گلیلی سے گڑا دا معاملہ ئے آکھے میرودے سل کننگ کے
en: He started it in Galilee, but now he has come here. — In Galilee? This man is a Galilean? Then this matter is for Herod to settle.
en_old: He started in Galilee, but now he has come here. In Galilee... this man is a Galilean? Then send this matter to Herod.

brh: او داسکان یروشلم اٹ ئے دادے ہمے پارغہ دبو۔
en: And he is still in Jerusalem; take him over to him.
en_old: He is in Jerusalem now, so send him over to him.

brh: نی تینے انت پاسے؟
en: What do you say about yourself?
en_old: What do you say about yourself?

brh: او مفتی کنے شاگرد پاسا او دیر او دنگو سن کنے باز معجزہ نشان اتسے
en: O teacher [lit. 'mufti'], ...disciple... [unclear]... show me many miraculous signs.
en_old: That teacher... they call me his follower; for so long I've heard of him. Show me many miracles.

brh: ننے ہم نشان ایت۔ کنا خواجہ دا کل مخلوق خراب کننگ اٹی ئس دا تینے بادشاہ اسپائک۔ دا بندہ؟
en: Show us a sign too. — My lord, this [man] has been corrupting all the people; he calls himself a king. — This man?
en_old: Show us a sign too. My lord, this man is corrupting all the people; he calls himself a king. This man?

brh: بادشاہ! جہان نا خواجہ!
en: King! Lord of the world!
en_old: King! Lord of the world!

brh: دادے جوان خلبو دادے پیلا توس نا کونڈا دبو دا اونا صوبے
en: Beat him well, and take him to Pilate; this is his province.
en_old: Beat him well and take him back to Pilate; this is his province.

brh: دا دونو ہچو جرمس کتنے کہ دا دے کینگ نا سزا ایتیو
en: This [man] has not committed any such crime that I should sentence him to death.
en_old: This man has committed no crime that he should be sentenced to death.

brh: اندا خاطر اندادی کوڑہ خلیوہ او یلک کیوہ نی ہر وقت ہر سال دا عید نا وقتا ہر بندغ یلک کیسہ برابا نن کے یلک کر جی
en: For this reason I will have him whipped and then release him. — Every year, always, at the time of this festival, you release one man. Release Barabbas for us!
en_old: So I will flog him and release him. "Every year at the time of this feast you release someone. Release Barabbas for us!"

brh: دا بندغے ختم کر جی او ننے برابر ئے دادے پاوے استبو او دادے پاوے استبو
en: Finish off this man, and [give] us Barabbas! Crucify him! Crucify him!
en_old: Kill this man and release Barabbas to us! Crucify him! Crucify him!

brh: نی نی دادے کورا خلپو نی انت سے کورنگ اٹی جلہ توت؟
en: You, you — don't whip him! Why are you [lashing] him with the whip...? [partly unclear]
en_old: Will you not answer him? Why are you silent?

brh: دا عیسی ئے! دادے انتئے عذاب تننگ اٹی ارے؟
en: This is Jesus! Why are you tormenting him?
en_old: This is Jesus! Why is he being tormented?

brh: دا دے ٹنگبو، ولے او زور زوراں شور کریرات کہ عیسی ئے پاو ایتبو، پاو ایتبو، پورا پاو ایتبو
en: Hang him! But they were shouting louder and louder: "Hang Jesus, hang him, hang him completely!"
en_old: Hang him! But they shouted louder and louder, "Crucify Jesus, crucify him, crucify him!"

brh: پیلاتوس، عیسی ء مرکنہ سزا نا حکم تس۔ او برابا ہرا کہ جیل اٹ قتل و فساد نا جرم اٹ بند اسکا، مخلوق نا خواہش نا مطابق عیسی ء کسفنگ کن فوج نا دوٹی تس۔
en: Pilate gave the order for Jesus's death sentence. And Barabbas, who was locked up in jail for the crime of murder and rioting... In accordance with the people's wish, he handed Jesus over to the soldiers to be killed.
en_old: Pilate sentenced Jesus to death. As the people wished, he released Barabbas, who was in prison for murder and rioting, and handed Jesus over to the soldiers to be crucified.

brh: بش مر! بش مرک! ہی، نا پن دیرے؟ شمون کیرینی خواجہ۔ دادے ہرف۔
en: Get up! Get up! Hey, what is your name? Simon of Cyrene, sir. Pick this up.
en_old: Get up! Get up! Hey, what's your name? Simon of Cyrene, sir. Carry it for him.

brh: چٹ آتے تڑبو ئے دادے آ مونی راہی کٹ۔ ہٹی!
en: Cut the ropes and send this one forward. Move!
en_old: Untie the ropes and move him forward. Move!

brh: ادی خواجہ خدا ننے کے
en: Oh Lord, God, help us.
en_old: Oh Lord God, help us.

brh: ئے یروشلم نا نیاڑیک، کنکے ہوغبو، ولے تینکے و تینا چناتے کے ہوغبو۔
en: O women of Jerusalem, do not weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
en_old: Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

brh: ہنتیکہ پالوننگا پاٹ تون دن مننگٹی ئے تو باروننگا پاٹ تون انت مروئی خدا نا مدد ئے کے
en: If this is happening with green wood, then what will happen with dry wood? God help us.
en_old: If this is done when the wood is green, what will happen when it is dry? God help us.

brh: مونی مبو! داڑے اتھ بوتا، زو کبو! زو کبو! دا سدی، اینو بے پاشا بند زو کبو نا! زو کبو!
en: Move forward! Bring it here, hurry! Hurry! This... today... hurry up! Hurry!
en_old: Move forward! Hold it here, hurry! Hurry! Today, before the Sabbath, finish it quickly! Hurry!

brh: شیتاتے مچے آ لکبو
en: Gather the things together.
en_old: Gather all the things together.

brh: واہ واہ دا پتی معاف کر، دا پتی پس کہ انت کنے گٹی او
en: Father, Father, forgive these; they do not know what they are doing.
en_old: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.

brh: اوئے لفتے بچے فے، دا ستینے بچے فے
en: He saved others; now let him save himself.
en_old: Hey, save yourself, and save us too.

brh: او، اگہ نی خدا نا مقرر کروک ئس تو تینے بچف او باوا شیف تڑنگ ننے ہم تینا معجزہ ئس نشان ات
en: Oh, if you are the one appointed by God, then save yourself and come down, and show us one of your miracles too.
en_old: Oh, if you are the one God has appointed, then save yourself and come down from the cross. Show us one of your miracles too.

brh: ویسا خدا نا نبی تا پیشنگوئی تے رد اٹ قصہ دا تا سال مست مسوسوس بدکارا تا نیام اٹ ہاو تننگا
en: Just as foretold in the prophecies of God's prophets made hundreds of years before, he was hanged among the criminals.
en_old: Just as God's prophets had foretold years before, Jesus was hung among criminals.

brh: دا عجب و پچو ولے دا معمولی ئس اف دا دیل بو دا دیل کبو دا دیلپیز ئے باو بابو داڑا تیر شاغین دا سے نک دا سے نیو
en: This is a wonderful garment, but it is no ordinary one... this... [unclear]... Come on, let's cast lots for it here: this one..., this one...
en_old: This is strange and empty, but it is nothing ordinary: 'Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani...' Father, father, the arrows have been thrown here...

brh: اوڑتے دا سنبھالو، بائے نی اورتا خوزئی دا سنبھالو، دا دے نی کنے تا خوزئی، نی کنے تیار با، ارے خوزئی، مست مرو، نی ککٹا تو دان انت کروس؟
en: Hold this for them. Hey, you, hold this of theirs... this one... you... me... You get ready for me... go first. If you win, then what will you do with it?
en_old: Take care of them... you take care of them... today you... me, get me ready... wait, if you fall, what will you do from here?

brh: او اسہ تختی ئس اونا کاٹم نا زی آ خلکر کہ اوڑا نوشتہ ئس دا یہودی تا بادشاہ ئے
en: And they put a board above his head on which was written: This is the King of the Jews.
en_old: They put a sign above his head that said: This is the King of the Jews.

brh: اگہ نی یہودیتہ بادشاہ ئس تو تینے بچف
en: If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself.
en_old: If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself.

brh: آغا نی خدا نا نائب ئس بچف تینے او ننے بچف
en: Sir, if you are God's deputy, save yourself and save us.
en_old: Sir, if you are God's representative, save yourself and save us.

brh: انتئے نی خدا غان خولی پیسے دادے ہمو سزا رسینگاٹی ہمو کنے ولے او چخ خرابو کاریم کتویسس
en: Why do you not fear God? This man is receiving the same punishment, the same as me, but he had not done any bad deed at all.
en_old: Why don't you fear God? You are getting the same punishment as I am, but he has done nothing wrong at all.

brh: ایسا کنے تینتون اوار جنت آ ٹی دیس۔ ئے اینو نی تو قول کیوے کہ نی کن تو جنت آ ٹی اوار مروس۔
en: Jesus, take me with you into paradise. Oh, today I promise you that you will be with me in paradise.
en_old: Jesus, take me with you into paradise. — Today I promise you that you will be with me in paradise.

brh: او ہمو روشنا وخت آ، دے روشنائی تننگ اٹی ئس، او پیشی مسکان چار مکنڈ تہار مس۔
en: And at that bright time, the sun was giving light, and from noon on darkness fell on all four sides.
en_old: And at that bright hour, while the day was still giving light, darkness fell on all four sides from noon.

brh: او بلہ عبادت خانہ نا پردہ نیام آن گپ مس
en: And then the curtain of the temple was torn down the middle.
en_old: And then the curtain of the temple was torn down the middle.

brh: ئے باوہ، کھڈارو، نی آ، پنت و گٹی ئے
en: O Father... to you... I commit [my spirit].
en_old: Oh Father... to you... I commit my spirit.

brh: فوج نا افسر خنا کہ انت مس او خدا نا سفت تے کننگا لگا او پارے ئے خدا یقینا دا نیک او جوان و بندغس اسکہ
en: The army officer saw what had happened, and he began to praise God and said: O God, surely this was a righteous and good man.
en_old: The army officer saw what had happened and began praising God, and he said: Surely this was a righteous and good man.

brh: ہمو دے اسے یوسف پنی ء بندغ ئس ئس کہ او مجلس ٹی عیسی نا کسفنگ نا فیصلہ تون اتفاق کتویسس، او پیلاتوس آن جمعہ نا دے، دے کے الینگ آن مست عیسی نا لاش
en: That day there was a man named Joseph, who had not agreed in the council with the decision to kill Jesus, and on Friday, before sunset, from Pilate... Jesus's body...
en_old: That same day a man named Joseph, who had not agreed in the council with the decision to kill Jesus, asked Pilate on Friday, before the sun went down, for Jesus's body.

brh: دفن کننگ نا خواہش
en: ...the wish to bury him.
en_old: The wish to be buried

brh: ماف کیس نن ہم تینا خداوند نا جو نا پد اٹ آن کھلی اجازت مروئی ولے ببو عبادت نا دے خڑک بننگ اٹی ئے
en: Excuse us. We too ought to be given full permission to go after our Lord's body, but come, the day of worship is drawing near.
en_old: Forgive us. We would also like permission to follow our Lord's way, but come, the day of worship is getting close.

brh: یک شمبے نا سوب آ مالا اتر و خوشبو تروکو گڑا تینتو ہرفے
en: Early on Sunday morning they took perfume and fragrant things with them.
en_old: On Sunday they took perfume and fragrant things with them.

brh: قبر آ بسور اوفت غار نا باٹی تے ہوکا بلا خالی مرغ نہ نار اوفت غار نا تئی ٹی نار ولے عیسی نا لاشہ خنتور
en: They came to the tomb. At the mouth of the cave they saw the big stone... empty... They went inside the cave, but they did not find Jesus's body.
en_old: They came to the tomb and saw that the stone at the cave's entrance had been rolled away and the tomb was empty. They went inside the cave, but they did not find Jesus's body.

brh: داڑان کل نما اسہ اسہ گلم ہلبو، انتئے کہ ہمو وقت اسکان کہ قیامت بتنے ئے انگور نا جوس کمپرہ۔
en: All of you take a sip each from this, because I will not drink grape juice until the time the Day of Judgment has come.
en_old: Take this, and each of you drink a cup, because I will not drink grape juice until the kingdom has come.

brh: مبارک ئس نی ئے خواجہ جہان نا بادشاہ
en: Blessed are you, O Lord, King of the world.
en_old: Blessed are you, Lord, King of the world.

brh: اراکے ڈغار آن ارخ پیدا کیک، داکنا جانے اراکے نم کے تننگک، کنا یاتٹی ہندن کبو۔
en: ...who brings forth bread from the earth. This is my body, which is given for you; do this in remembrance of me.
en_old: Who brings forth bread from the earth. This is my body, which is given for you; do this in remembrance of me.

brh: دا پیالہ کنا جان ہمبارے او ئے تنا جان ء خدا کے قربان کیوے
en: This cup is like my life, and I am offering my own life to God as a sacrifice.
en_old: This cup is like my blood, which I offer to God for your lives.

brh: ولے اوربو کنے ہلوک نا دو کن تو اوار میزٹ ایو او ئے آدم نا اولات کسفنگے ولے ہمو بندغ اخس بدقسمت دے کہ کن تو غداری کے کمنگ کپک کمنگ کپک
en: But look, the hand of the one who will seize me is here at the table with me, and I, the son of Adam, am to be killed; but how unfortunate is that man who betrays me...
en_old: But look, the hand of the one who betrays me is with me at the table, and the Son of Man is going to be killed, but how unfortunate is the man who betrays me.

brh: اسل وفاک غدار نا پنی پا خواجہ
en: ... Lord, tell us the traitor's name.
en_old: Lord, tell us the name of the traitor.

brh: ولے ہر کس ئس نمیان بلونے شیف توریتنے او سردار خدمت کروکا ہمبار مرے بلون اراسٹے
en: But whoever among you is great should keep himself low, and the leader should be like one who serves. Who is greater —
en_old: But whoever is great among you should become like the younger, and the leader like one who serves.

brh: اسے تس کہ تولوک ارغ کننگٹی ئے یا ایلو کہ خدمت کننگٹی ئے بیشک ہمو ارا کہ ارغ کننگ کہ توس ولے اینو مئے نعمتی
en: ...the one who sits eating food, or the other one who is serving? Surely it is the one who sat down to eat; but I, among you...
en_old: Who is greater, the one who sits at the table eating or the one who serves? Surely the one who sits down to eat, but today I am among you as one who serves.

brh: قسمت کرو کنا باروٹ، ولے نم کنا غم تے ٹی کنتو اوار مسنورے، ہندن کنا باوا عدالت نا کاریم تے کنے تسونے ئے ہم نمے آتے
en: ...like one who serves. But you have stayed with me through my troubles; just as my Father has given me the work of judgment, I also give it to you.
en_old: ...has been appointed concerning me, but you have stood with me in my trials. Just as my Father has given me the work of judgment, I give it to you as well.

brh: نم کنا بادشاہی نا تخت آ تولورے او اسرائیل نا دوازدہ قوم آتیا فیصلہ کرورے۔ تو کرا کس ختدار مفروئے۔ شمعون، شمعون، ارک! شیطان نا رضا ئس کہ نم کلے آزمائفے۔
en: You will sit on the throne of my kingdom and judge the twelve tribes of Israel. Then no one will be guilty. Simon, Simon, listen! It was Satan's wish to test all of you.
en_old: You will sit on the throne of my kingdom and judge the twelve tribes of Israel. Then no one will be a traitor. Simon, Simon, listen! Satan wanted to test all of you.

brh: تاکہ جوان و بد جتا کے، دن کہ زمیندار خولم و پگان جتا کیک۔ ولے پطرس ئے نی کن دعا کرینٹ کہ نی ایمان آن ہڑسنگ پیسے۔ اور آ وخت آ نی کنا کنڈا بس تو تینا سنگتا کے مضبوط کے۔ خواجہ ئے نی تون اوار جیل ہننگ کے، او نی تون اوار کہنگ کے۔
en: ...so that he may separate the good from the bad, the way a farmer separates wheat from chaff. But Peter, I have prayed for you that you do not turn back from your faith. And when you have come back to me, then strengthen your friends. Lord, I can go to prison with you, and I can die with you.
en_old: So that he may separate the good from the bad, as a farmer separates wheat from chaff. But Peter, I have prayed for you that you will not turn away from your faith. And when you come back to me, strengthen your friends. Lord, I am ready to go to prison with you, and to die with you.

brh: کت تیار اوٹ؟ نی پاو پترس۔ اینو نن آن بانگو بانگ تے فقط ہمو وخت اسکان کہ نی مسے وار پاتنس کہ ئے عیسی درست کپرے۔
en: ...I am ready. I tell you, Peter: today, tonight, the rooster will not crow until you have said three times that you do not know Jesus.
en_old: Are you ready? you say, Peter. Today the rooster will not crow until you have said three times that you do not know Jesus.

brh: انتے نمے لوٹ پیسہ چوٹن بغیر راہیک کرینوٹ گڑاس کمی مس؟ نا ہچ گڑاس نا متو۔ ولے دا سارا بندغ تو پیسہ تے ہوکا لوٹ یا کشکول ہرفے ہرفے
en: When I sent you out without a purse, money or shoes, did you lack anything? No, nothing at all was lacking. But now whoever has a purse with money, or a bowl, should take it along.
en_old: When I sent you out without a purse, money or shoes, did you lack anything? No, nothing. But now whoever has a purse of money or a bag should take it.

brh: ارے بندغ تو زخمہ فکوٹ اٹ تینا سودا کے زخمہ سلیٹنگ کے اینو مے پاوے۔ خدا نا کتاب اٹ لکھوک کے کہ مخلوق کنے مجرم پائک۔ ارے ایتا کتاب اٹ لکھوکو ضرور پورا مریرے۔ خواجہ! نن تو نرا زخمو۔
en: And whoever has no sword should sell his things and buy a sword, I tell you. It is written in God's book that people will call me a criminal. Whatever words are written in the book will surely be fulfilled. Lord! We have two swords.
en_old: And whoever has no sword should sell his cloak and buy a sword, I tell you today. It is written in God's book that people will call me a criminal. And what is written in the book will surely be fulfilled. Lord! We have only swords.

brh: اندا بازو یہودی پیرنگا تا دیوان مس تاکہ فکر
en: Then many Jewish elders gathered in a council so that [they could] consider...
en_old: So many of the Jewish elders gathered in council to plan

brh: کیر، کیو عیسی نا مرتینا جانی خلاص کیر۔ ہمو وختہ شیطان یہودا اسکریوتی اوفتے تون ملا، کہ او ہمو دوانزدہ شاگرداتے آن ئس او اوفتے
en: ...how they could put an end to Jesus's life. At that time Satan... Judas Iscariot met with them; he was one of those twelve disciples, and he [went to] them...
en_old: how they could kill Jesus and take his life. At that time Satan entered Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve disciples, and he met with them

brh: او تینا وار مس او عیسی ئے ہلنگ نا منصوبہ ئس جوڑ کرے عیسی یروشلم آن پیش تما او زیتون نا مش آ دعا کن ہنا دعا کبو کہ نم آزمائش ٹی پورا مریرے
en: and he agreed, and they made a plan to seize Jesus. Jesus left Jerusalem and went to the Mount of Olives to pray. Pray that you come through the time of testing.
en_old: and they were glad and made a plan to seize Jesus. Jesus left Jerusalem and went to the Mount of Olives to pray. Pray that you may stand firm in temptation.

brh: یہوداہ اسکریوتی عیسی ء چاندی نا سے ٹکر نا بدل ٹی ہلفے عیسی چائسکہ کہ مخلوق نا گناہ تے کن اونا مرگ نا ساعت آک تیزی اٹ خرب بننگ اٹی او
en: Judas Iscariot handed Jesus over in exchange for thirty pieces of silver. Jesus knew that, because of the people's sins, the hours of his death were quickly drawing near...
en_old: Judas Iscariot handed Jesus over in exchange for thirty pieces of silver. Jesus knew that the hour of his death for the sins of the people was quickly drawing near.

brh: او دعا کرے
en: He prayed.
en_old: He prayed.

brh: او باوہ اگر نامنشاء مرے
en: O Father, if it is your will,
en_old: Father, if it is your will,

brh: تو دا مصیبت تے کنان مر کے ولے کنا خواہش نہ بلکہ نا خواہش پورا مرے
en: then take these sufferings away from me; but not my wish, rather may your wish be done.
en_old: then take this suffering away from me; yet not my will, but yours be done.

brh: و اسہ ملائکہ ئس آسمان آن اودے ظاہر مس، او اودے طاقت تس، او اونا جان نا خیدک ڈغار آ تمینگ لگار، او خیداک تہ ڈغار آ ہندن تمارا، دنکہ ٹپی نا دتک شولنگرا۔
en: And an angel from heaven appeared to him and gave him strength, and the sweat of his body began to fall to the ground; the sweat fell on the ground just as blood pours out of a wound.
en_old: And an angel from heaven appeared to him and gave him strength, and the sweat of his body began falling to the ground; his sweat fell to the ground like drops of blood from a wound.

brh: نمن تے خاچو پورے بش مبو دعا کبو کہ نمن آزمائش ٹی پورا مریرے
en: Why are you sleeping? Get up and pray that you come through the time of testing.
en_old: Why are you sleeping? Get up and pray that you may stand firm in temptation.

brh: یہودا نا خم کننگ نا معنی ئے کہ نی کن تو غداری کیس
en: Judas, does your kiss mean that you are betraying me?
en_old: Judas, are you betraying me with a kiss?

brh: واجہ، ننے دا زما ہتھیار فین؟ دادے گرفتار کبو۔ باز مس۔
en: Master, shall we strike with these swords? Arrest him! Enough!
en_old: Lord, shall we strike with our swords? Arrest him. Enough!

brh: ارے بینے موجس نم زغم و لٹاتے تو بسنورے نما خیالٹی ڈاکو اسے اوٹ
en: ... You have come with swords and sticks; in your mind am I a robber?
en_old: Have you come with swords and clubs, as if I were a robber?

brh: ئے بلا عبادت خانہ ٹی نوم تو اسوٹ ولے نوم کنے گرفتار کتویرے ولے داسہ وقت بسونے نوم کنے گرفتار کیرے
en: I was with you in the temple, but you did not arrest me; but now the time has come, and you are arresting me.
en_old: Every day I was in the temple with you, but you did not arrest me; but now the time has come for you to arrest me.

brh: بند کبوتر
en: Stop it!
en_old: Stop!

brh: اوڑے گٹ سلیف بو
en: Hold him there, tightly!
en_old: Stand there!

brh: ہمو بندغاک کہ عیسی ء خلپسور عیسی غے مسخرہ کریر او دے خلکور۔ دا بادشاہ نا پوشاک ء بینفے، شاباش بابو پنی غا ٹپے، بادشاہ سلامت ننے نی بچا فے
en: The men who were holding Jesus mocked Jesus and beat him. "Put this king's robe on him! Well done, Baba... Your Majesty, save us!"
en_old: The men who were guarding Jesus mocked him and beat him. 'Put on this king's robe. Well done, prophet, prophesy! Long live the king, save us!'

brh: نوم زندہ ء مرتغاتے ٹی انتئے پٹیرے او داڑے اف خدا اودے پدی زندہ کرینے یاد کبو ہرا وخت کہ نوم گلیل صوبہ ٹی اسورے عیسی نمے انت پارے ئے گناہ گار آ بندغاتے
en: Why are you looking for the living one among the dead? He is not here; God has made him alive again. Remember what Jesus told you when you were in the province of Galilee: that I, to sinful men...
en_old: Why are you looking for the living among the dead? He is not here; God has raised him back to life. Remember what Jesus told you when you were in the province of Galilee: that sinful men...

brh: دوتے تننگیو او کنے کسفیرہ او مسے دے آن پد پدی زندہ مریو
en: I will be handed over into their hands, and they will kill me, and after three days I will become alive again.
en_old: I will be handed over and they will kill me, and after three days I will rise again.

brh: ہفتو خلسیفتا ماسوس نن رسینگان او خواجہ خدا نا جون غیب ئس آن خواجہ خدا نا جون غیب ئس ہاؤ ایرا بندغ ننا مونا بسور
en: ... (unclear) ... we arrived, and the body of the Lord God was missing, the body of the Lord God was missing. Yes, two men came before us.
en_old: The women said: we went to the tomb and saw a vision of angels of the Lord; two men came before us.

brh: ملائکہ تا وڑ اٹ چمکو کوپوچ بے ناسور او ننے پارے نم زندہ ء مردہ غاتے ٹی انتئے کہ پٹیرے دا راستی
en: They had put on shining clothes like angels, and they said to us: Why are you looking for the living among the dead? This is the truth...
en_old: Two men in shining clothes like angels appeared and said to us: Why do you look for the living among the dead? This is the truth.

brh: ننے آ باور کبو، باور کبو، نن اوفتے خناسن، نم تینٹ ہنبو، بو، قبر خالی اسکہ، خواجہ ایناسس، پطرس نی ننے آ باور کر۔
en: Believe us, believe us! We have seen them. Go yourselves and look: the tomb was empty, the Lord had gone. Peter, you believe us!
en_old: Believe us, believe us, we have seen them! Go yourselves and see, the tomb was empty, the Lord has risen. Peter, believe us.

brh: عیسی تینا ایرا شاگرداتے پاش مس، بھوم خوشی ئم بال کریر، او ایلوفتہ کنڈائینار، بیشک خواجہ پدی زندہ مسنے، او شمعونہ پاش مسنے، ننتو درستوم کتو، کسرہ ہم، ارا وختی نانے کپ کرے تو پدہ درست کرین

en: Through respected Baba Yusuf Khan sahib, after some delay, it was taken up that there should be a newspaper in Brahui too. Wow, great. Since from childhood I had been ..., I thought in Brahui.

en: I'd write a poem, hmm, hmm, I had no connections at all. Right. The newspaper ... I liked the newspaper a lot. Right. Then I wrote a poem, yes, I wrote that poem, and all the time my eyes were on this very thing.

en: Yes sir. In this city ... a welcome ... the editor ... mashallah. You know well what kind of man Parwana was. Yes. At that time the fall of East Pakistan had happened. Okay. In that era. Right. So at that time it was seventy, seventy-one.

en: It was a matter of '71, the fall of East Pakistan, he said. It was a matter of '71. So at that time I wrote a poem: 'The soldier dies for the sake of the country; don't abandon us.' I put in a different word for this reason, so that they would print mine in place of the other word. That's what happened.
en_old: There's a mistake, he told Bushra, there's a mistake. Once I wrote a poem saying that a soldier who dies for the country, don't abandon us. I had put a different word there, but they printed the wrong word in place of mine. That's what happened.

brh: او دا ہیتے، سدھی بزبورے چلی کار، براہوئی بزبورے چلی کار، خدا نا قدرت ئے ہچو واقفیت اللف ئے ایلو نا ایڈریس ابا شاری گدھراٹ، واہ، منہ وقت آپس شیر
en: And this thing: I kept writing pieces in Sindhi and in Brahui. It was God's power; I had no acquaintance with anyone at all. The other one's address ... father ... city ... Wow. At times ... poetry ...
en_old: And this thing runs in the Sindhi language, it runs in the Brahui language. By God's power, I had no acquaintance at all. My father's address was in the city. Wow, sometimes poetry...

en: It got printed. I was amazed at how this poem got printed. I called my mother; I called all my relatives: 'My poem has been printed!' I showed everyone. I showed all my Sindhi friends: 'My poem has been printed!'
en_old: It spread. What a wonderful lamp I made, how this poem spread! The whole poem was prepared; all of it spread, my dear, the whole poem spread. All the signs, all the glory, the Sindhi... this whole poem spread.

brh: کلاپنے خوارہ باقی شیر تے سرپد متوسے ہاو اولی کو شیر ٹی کلاپنے سگ عبدالقیوم جوہر براہوی واہ واہ ملا قدرت تے ہمو کے بساسے

en_old: Everyone... the rest didn't understand the poems. Yes, in the very first poem everyone... Abdul Qayyum Johar Brahui, wow, wow. Mulla Qudrat came to them.

brh: او گھلی نستپنگا گڑا ہدا دے مسلسل دے پدی دا کاریم کرسا بسور ایرو الحمدللہ لبیرہ کرے براہوئی بلنگا فخری واہ لیکن الحمدللہ بھلو سماجی سیٹ ئس تبدیلی ئس بسور
en: And then, from that very day, without a break, day after day, I have kept doing this work. Today, thank God, I am proud to be Brahui, wow. And thank God, a big change has come in society.
en_old: He didn't stop. Day after day, without a break, he kept doing this work, and today, thank God, ... speaking Brahui is a matter of pride. Thank God, a big social change has come.

brh: بلو تبدیلی ئس بسنے سماجٹی اینو سندھٹی براہوئی نعت عام جام چلک شاعری عام جام چلک سندھی فنکاراک براہوئی ٹی شعر پارہ مہر تو اللہ بلڈس کباخار ٹوخ خلک

en_old: A big change has come to society. Today in Sindh, Brahui naat is common and poetry is common. Sindhi artists sing poems in Brahui with love, and Allah...

brh: براہوئی ادب زبان لاسی حدول کڑا شروعات بس تو او کار پد کرے اگر پروانہ صاحب بلتہ وکا تو شاید ئے دا خسی کارپ کلے کتویڑے او تو خدا نا بندہ ہجر و ہسے ظرف اسے
en: ... when Brahui literature and language had its beginning ..., after that he did it. If Parwana sahib had not been there, perhaps I would not have been able to do this much work. He was a man of God, a man of great magnanimity.
en_old: When Brahui literature and language began in the Lasi region, he carried the work forward. If Parwana sahib hadn't been there, maybe nobody would have done this much work. He is a man of God, a person of great forbearance.

en: to whom he could show his poem and get praise for it. Wow. He came to Hazrat Parwana sahib's sitting room in a black shirt, white shalwar and a turban. The young man looked handsome, very handsome, in the bloom of his youth.
en_old: So he could take the marks of his poem and the praise for it, wow. He came to Hazrat Parwana sahib's gathering wearing a red shirt, a shalwar and a turban. He looked handsome, very handsome, a boy in his youth.

brh: بس وتے سنی تو پروال صاحب پا دا شعرے کلہ ہورک دا شعرے کلہ ہورک دا شعرے تل اخبار ٹی چاپ کا پروال صاحب شا شعرے ہورا او شعر ہاسے بندس کلا یادا مرے جدائی جتائی لا اسدب ارے
en: Then he came and said to Parwana sahib: 'Look at this poem of mine, look at this poem of mine, print this poem in your newspaper.' Parwana sahib looked at the poem. One stanza of that poem, if you remember: 'Separation, of separation there is but one moment...'
en_old: Then when he heard it, Parwana sahib said, 'Look at this poem, look at this poem, print this poem in the newspaper.' Parwana sahib looked at the poem; that poem is one that everyone remembers: separation, parting...

en: God willing. Yes, yes. And later it was broadcast on TV and on the radio, later on the radio: '... O beautiful one, of my state ... separation has one day, it has one moment, one moment ...' God willing, wow. Parwana sahib said so; he said it in Soz sahib's presence. At that time I came

en_old: I rode over and came to Radio Pakistan. At that time Radio Pakistan Quetta had five minutes of Brahui. Wow, I came. Hazrat sahib... this very poem, look, out of a thousand poems Hazrat sahib liked this one.

en: we were in class, in seventh or eighth class we wrote poetry, and Parwana sahib printed it in the mushaira section. But you stood firm. Only by standing this firm and doing this much work ... then people thought ... and we would regularly say, 'Friends, we go there

brh: صبا شام اسکا جوہر صاحب ء خنینہ تولوکے کچری کے مہمان تے تو ملے خدمت کے مدرسہ ء چلا فک نن وقتس خنتنون تا ئس قلم ئس دوٹی تا آخر دا امر لکھیک انت انت دا جن سے ہمے لکھیک تا اور دا وقتس تا کہ داخہ کاریم کرے
en: from morning till evening, and we see Jauhar sahib sitting, holding gatherings, meeting guests, serving them, running the madrasa. We have never seen a pen in his hand. So how on earth does he write? What, is he some jinn who writes? And when did he find the time to do this much work?'
en_old: From morning to evening we would see Johar sahib sitting in the gathering, serving guests, running the madrasa. Sometimes we saw him with a pen in his hand. How does he write, what kind of genius is he writing this? And when did he find the time to do so much work?

brh: نمرو دا امر خدا چائے کہ نن اسہ جٹی بفک اسل ئے دادے کہ جذبہ سلامت مرے ہئی جذبہ سلامت ہرے تری اینو بے اسے تسپا دا اللہ نا مہربانی کو بس وختہ سوچاٹ کہ ننا ئے لوما
en: How he does it, God knows; it is beyond our understanding. The real point is this: that the passion should stay intact; if the passion stays intact, then ... today ... this is Allah's kindness. At one time I thought that our

brh: بس اسد زمان شہید بس صلہ اوتھوار پیوار نا قبائلی بچٹ او ہاو معاملے سے ٹی خوش کاوس یا کنا ابا مرے ودا ہدا مقصد ئے زندگی کنا بس ہاو کہ اسد زمان
en: ... the martyr Asad Zaman, from a tribal family ... yes, in some matter ... would go happily, or may my ... flourish. And that very aim came into my mind: yes, that Asad Zaman

brh: دا ناجوڑی تے اللہ تیک او دافتے دیکوم اللہ اللہ نی شفائے تیک انشاءاللہ ابا جان کنے خبر ئے کہ او کنتو لیکن اسہ وعدہ ئس کرک
en: God gives these illnesses, and He takes them away too. God, God will give you healing, God willing. — Father, I know that it is with me... but make me one promise.
en_old: May God take away these illnesses and remove them. God, God will give you healing, God willing. Father, I know that he... but he made a promise.

en: No, my child, don't think such thoughts, don't think such thoughts; God will make you well. We still haven't held your wedding; your wedding has to be held, your happiness...
en_old: My child, don't think such thoughts, don't think such thoughts. God will make you well. Then your wedding... I have to hold your wedding, the joy of it...

en: ...your children are still to be seen; you will play with them, God willing. Don't you lose heart at all; courage.
en_old: ...your children, you will play with them again, God willing. Don't lose heart at all, have courage.

en: Have courage. — Father, bury me there, by my mother's grave, my dear mother... — Don't you say such things either; my son, don't say such things. Such bad thoughts, such bad thoughts.
en_old: Have courage. Father, bury me next to my mother's grave, my mother... Don't say such things either, my son, don't say such things. Such thoughts, such thoughts.

brh: بے خبرے ٹی نمے ہند کدرینگک کنا چنا نی جوڑ مریسے انشاءاللہ دا خستو باجنگ کن کے کینگ کے اسنے ارے برا کے
en: Before you even notice, this will pass for you. My child, you will get well, God willing; this... (rest unclear).
en_old: Time passes for you without you even noticing. My child, you will get well, God willing...

brh: کہ نی جوڑ کے دا خوشی تے کے اللہ ء زاری کینہ کہ اللہ نی جوڑ کے مچے حوصلہ کر بس کنا بچو سئی ء
en: ...that you get well, these joys... We plead with God that God makes you well. Have a little courage, that's all, my son, it's all right.
en_old: ...that you get well, these joys... We pray to God that God makes you well. Have courage, that's enough, my dear son.

en: Peace be upon you, sir. — And peace be upon you. — Sir...
en_old: Peace be upon you, sir. And peace be upon you. Sir...

en: About this file number, sir, the sahib keeps phoning. Nothing will happen with this file until those who are entitled get their share; nothing will happen.
en_old: Sir, about this file number, he keeps calling. Nothing will happen with this file until the rightful owners get what is theirs.

en: Yes sir, something or other will have to be given to the sahibs, sir. Don't you worry, sahib.
en_old: Yes sir, the higher-ups will have to get their share, sir. Don't worry, sir.

en: This account will have to be rendered to God; one will have to answer before God's court, where there is only justice and nothing else.
en_old: This account will have to be given to God; God's court will come, where there is nothing but justice.

en: It's nothing... Oh-ho, Shoaib Khan, you... I know that you have been taking a lot of interest in this file.
en_old: Oh, Shoaib Khan, you gave me... I know you are taking a lot of interest in this file.
