en: Why are you worried? It's all right, my son. Don't be worried ... where has my ... gone ... it's because of him, father.
en_old: Where are you? Are you worried? It's alright, son. Don't worry, father. Where did my... go? It's for this reason, father.

brh: فکر کننگ آن کہ کجا بیت مرینی وادا۔ آ توار شری ء زانے، ہر چنگ آن مزن طوفان بیت، آئرہ ہچ چنگ آن بیت، اللہ مکھے۔ ہو من زانہ بچ، بلے مرچی نزانہ کہ دلے توک آ۔
en: I'm worried about where father might be. He knows that sound [of the sea] well; however big a storm there is, nothing happens to him, God forbid. Yes, I know, son, but today I don't know what is inside my heart.
en_old: I'm thinking about where he might be, father. He knows that sound well. Every time there has been a big storm, nothing has happened, God forbid. Yes, I know, son, but today I don't know what is in my heart.

brh: آئیے خاطر یک ترسی ودی بوغائینت۔ سر مفتہ پریشان مروتا کین۔ تو آرام کر۔ نہ بچ، ہچے پریشانی نا گپ ئس اف۔ بس من تو ریندا ریانی مائی چاراگا۔ چی؟
en: A fear is rising [in me] for him. You're worrying for nothing; you rest. No, son, there's nothing to worry about. I'll just go after him to look for him. What?
en_old: Some fear has come up in me for him. Don't worry for nothing. So rest. No, son, there's nothing to worry about. I'm just going to the sea to look for him. What?

brh: دریائے توکا؟ نون، ئے وادا! احمد تئو وائر چے گشگائے؟ من راست گشگاں، بوت کنت کہ من ئے وادا یک کمکء کد بگی، احمد، تئو وائر شری ئے زانے، امریت ترا پکمک نہ گشید۔
en: Into the sea? Now? O father! Ahmad, what are you saying? I'm telling the truth; it may be that father needs a little help. Ahmad, your father knows [the sea] well; I hope he won't [need to] call on you for help.
en_old: Into the sea? No, father! Ahmed, what are you saying? I'm telling the truth. Maybe father needs some help. Ahmed, your father knows well. I hope he won't refuse your help.

brh: ہو، آ تو باز ضدی ئے بلائیں ضدی ات، پنی زانہ مرچی منی دلے توکا آئی خاطر آ ترسی ودی بووائنٹ، بس دل گوشی بس، برو مائی کے پشتا
en: Yes, he is very stubborn, terribly stubborn, but I know that today a fear for him is rising in my heart. My heart just says: go after him.
en_old: Yes, he's very stubborn, extremely stubborn, but I know that today there is fear in my heart for him. Just listen, come, let's go after him.

brh: خوب آ تو متورس، ئے دے چنے بٹ، توم نی دا آرام کا، اینہ، تو آرام بکھ، ئے بوش کے تے مات کو یا شوٹ، مس میرینے لوگا بٹ بختہ، آ شر ی تو شو بکھ، تو ہم دا آرام کا من رے
en: Okay, don't you be afraid ... you rest here, ... you rest ... at Mir's(?) house ... sleep well. You rest here too; I'm going.
en_old: You didn't sleep well. Today, son, you rest here, okay? You rest. I'll... or go. Ms. Mary is at home, son. Sleep well, and you rest here too.

brh: دریا نیم غا ابا مونا ہم گونڈ تا کائے نہ نہ تومیا توم نی نامدار آ کمانڈ ئے ابا نہ نہ نہ تومیا مطلب گوش نہ مین نامدار آ
en: To the middle of the sea, father, and ahead too ... no, no, ... you ... the famous one ... command, father ... no, no, no ... I mean, listen, not ... the famous one.
en_old: In the middle of the river, father, and ahead there are also... No, no, Tomiya, you, the famous commander, father. No, no, no, Tomiya, I mean, listen, not the famous one.

brh: امہ، منے باز گژننگ اٹی اٹ۔
en: Mother, I'm very hungry.
en_old: Mother, I'm very hungry.

brh: کراچی سے پدی نہ ورگے وستا، ماہل، کنا وتی سود نیست، مئے چوڑنا کتا، برو، چوڑے کراچی سے بچار
en: [Karachi?] ... there's no food left. Mahal, I have nothing of my own ... go, look for some ... [Karachi?]
en_old: After Karachi, don't come back... Mahal, I have no benefit from it myself. Come, let's go look at Karachi.

brh: آئی، تترو اتک، بیا بخیر ترو، بل بخیر، آئی بٹا، ہنزا کنے باری ایشانا بٹیئے، صبح کنے اچ نوارد تگیم، مذاق
en: She ... aunt has come. Come, welcome, aunt. ... Since this morning he hasn't eaten anything ... [only] joking.
en_old: He came. Welcome, go well, go in peace. He was... Hunza... in the morning I didn't... just joking.

brh: شامل نا حال داتا تو سخت پریشان ہی ہمے آ ترا مزا گنی اسا بٹا تو برو زوکا برو برو برو بٹ واری برو
en: Shamil's condition ... you are very worried ... go, quickly go, go, go, go ...
en_old: His condition was very worrying, so you will enjoy it. Come quickly, come, come, come, son, come.

brh: تو بھی چیزے بورنا۔ اینا ڈرو۔ تیل نہ کشی۔ اللہ خیر کا۔ تو ترا ایکا پریشان ما کا۔ ہیس آ گانے تو
en: You eat something too. ... Don't lose heart. God will make it all right. Don't worry yourself so much ...
en_old: You should eat something too. Don't be scared. Don't... God will make it alright. Don't worry so much.

brh: خیال بکہ چے بکنے ترو من وتی سمانیستے من ئے ہم سمانی کہ معصومہ جی سے واڑتھینا
en: Think — what should I do, aunt? I don't understand it myself; I don't understand this either, that Masooma ji ...
en_old: Think about what you would do. I didn't understand it myself; I also understand that Masooma ji...

brh: نازک، ئے شری گپے نی آخر چے بک نترو، زاگانی بیست دریا شوتا، تنیگا نتا۔
en: Nazuk, this is not good. After all, what can be done, aunt? ... [they] went to sea and still haven't come back.
en_old: Nazuk, that's a good thing. What will you finally do? I know twenty... to the river... is not ours.

brh: نہ سدکو کجا بت؟ تو تیلا مزن کا، تو اترا پریشان مکاں۔
en: No, Sadko(?), where did he go? Take heart; don't worry so much.
en_old: No, Sadiq, where did he go? Don't worry so much.

brh: عامران برے بگوش کے
en: Amran, go and tell [him] that ...
en_old: Tell Amran to come.

brh: مرچی لانچ چنچو بجا پیدا کین منی خیال گسی کے شپئے دوانزدہ بجا سر بین جوان جوان جوان میرو من کمین شہرے روشنائی ہم بچارین بلے
en: What time does the launch set off today? I think we'll set off at twelve at night. Good, good, good, Miro. I'll also take a little look at the city's lights, but ...
en_old: What time does the launch leave today? I think it will arrive at twelve at night. Good, good, good, let's go. I'll also see the city lights a little.

brh: میر ئے شپئے تہ تئی دوربین وکارم نہ کنت۔ اہو میرو تو ئے شہرا وتی نظرا چارے ولے من ئے شہرا وتی نظرا چارگون۔ منا ہر چیز گندگہ کیت۔ میر
en: Mir, at night your binoculars won't work. Oh Miro, you look at this city through your own eyes, but I look at this city through my own eyes. I can see everything. Mir ...
en_old: Mir, your binoculars don't work at night. Oh Miro, you look at the city with your own eyes, but I look at the city with my own eyes. I can see everything. Mir.

brh: پیر مسرفد نبوتو۔ سرفد بے تو علامہ سرفد بے بیچار میرو اگر تو منی سنگت ئے باہد کے
en: Old man, you didn't understand. Understand, you learned one, understand, poor Miro; if you are my friend, you must ...
en_old: Old man, you didn't understand. Understand, Allama, understand, poor Miro, if you are my friend you must...

brh: او بے سمجھ کہ من چے کننگاں اون چوں کننگاں اون کجا روگاں اون چے بابت سوچ کننگاں اون من بائیدے منا معلوم بیوے وھدے کہ منا معلوم نئے گڑا خیر تو بگوش کہ
en: ... understand what I am doing, how I am doing it, where I am going, what I am thinking about. I should know [it]; and when I don't know, then, well, you tell me that ...
en_old: That fool. What I'm doing, how I'm doing it, where I'm going, what I'm thinking about, I should be the one who knows. When I don't know, well then, you tell me...

brh: مرچی دوانزدہ بجا کلاچ فدا کین آئی تو کہ چی چی استے؟ ہمے پٹرول، ڈیزل، آئل۔ دگہ؟ دگہ چے بس ہمیشا ڈیزل و پٹرول اچ عابد آب میر۔
en: Today at twelve o'clock we'll set off (for Kalach?). What all is in it? The same: petrol, diesel, oil. What else? What else — just as always, diesel and petrol from Abid ..., Mir.
en_old: Today at twelve o'clock I'll go to Karachi. What all do you have? The same: petrol, diesel, oil. What else? What else, just diesel and petrol as always, from Abid. Mir.

brh: جوان آ، ہو واقعی، ہاپو گوادر نی نستے، ہاں، برے من چیزے دنیائے شہرے روشنائی آن چارگ لوٹیں، میر شبا وتی دوربین کار نہ کا
en: Good, yes really ... Gwadar doesn't have [them]. Yes, come, I want to see a little of the lights of the world's cities. Mir, at night [your] binoculars don't work.
en_old: Good, yes really, hey, Gwadar isn't yours. Yes, come on, I want to see the city of the world in the light. Mir doesn't use his binoculars at night.

brh: میرو، دل کہ روشنا بیبی، گڑا ہر چیچ روشنائی ئا گندنگا کائک۔
en: Miro, when the heart is lit up, then everything is seen in the light.
en_old: Miro, when the heart is bright, then everything appears in the light.

brh: ماسیک کمو جال توڑ منا بے سے کارن سجی روچ انچو بے کار نشتیگیں کمو دست پا جنین ما تو بے
en: [Do something with] the fish and the net a little — why are you sitting idle like this the whole day for no reason? Move your hands and feet a bit ...
en_old: Fishermen, mend the net a little. Why are you sitting idle like this all day for no reason? Move your hands a bit...

brh: دگے کار بے کسہ جوڑ انچو نشتگے تو انچو منی کرا نہ نشتگے ترا دگے کس سے شو وازے منی مار آن اسے چونو تو گپ جننگائے منے تو بدنام کننگائے برے اسو
en: You have no other work, sitting like this; [yet] you don't sit with me like this ... go look for someone else ... about my son ... how you're talking! You are defaming me. Come on ...
en_old: If you have no other work, who made you sit like this? You're sitting like this, you're not sitting with me. Someone else is looking for you. My son, someone like you is talking, defaming me. Come on...

brh: شاو خیراتیں؟ منی خیرا پر ئے یک کچک ارا کشک۔ جیو ہمے کچکانے آ کشگے
en: Shaho, is it charity? [It's] for killing one dog, for my good(?). Yes, they're killing these very dogs.
en_old: Shah, is it charity? For my sake, kill one dog. Yes, they're killing these very dogs.

brh: یار زر رسید یار تو منا ئے بگوش کچکانے یا کچکے سرا چے فائدہ فائدہ گڑا برو شاہو آ چے جست کن کہ یک کچکے چے کہ زر دینتی کئے زر دنت سرکار دگہ کئے
en: Friend, has the money arrived? Friend, you tell me, what's the benefit in dogs, or in [killing] a dog? Benefit — well then, go and ask Shaho why money is given for one dog. Who gives the money? The government, who else?
en_old: Friend, the money has arrived. Friend, tell me, what's the benefit of dogs, of killing a dog? Then go and ask Shaho why one dog... Who gives the money? The government gives the money, who else?

brh: دا گڑاتے پیش کننگ کپہ۔ کنے باز ہیت کروئی ئے کنے تو دا سنبھولا بھلو کتاب اسے کپہ۔ درو ہر شے باز گچینو ہیت بلے یٹی ئے عزم سے، جذبہ سے، ہیت سے۔
en: [They] cannot present these things. I have a lot to say; as for me, even a big book could not hold all this. Yesterday everything was very good talk, but in it there is a resolve, a passion, a message.
en_old: Don't present these things. I have a lot to say; for me this isn't a big book to handle. All of it is very fine talk, but in it there is determination, passion, and words.

brh: ئے تے قابل قدر ی لیکن دا ئس کپر کہ کلا استاد دیر تننگ اٹی او او ہمو تسلیم کرے کپر کہ دا ہیت آک مستی برور او کنا بروت آک بھلو ہم مسنے تو
en: I hold them in esteem, but [they] do not do this, though all the teachers are watering [it]; and they do not accept that these matters should come forward. And my mustache has grown big too, so...
en_old: They are worthy of respect, but they did not do this, that all the teachers were giving for a long time, and they did not accept that these words would come into effect, and my moustaches have also grown big, so...

brh: کنا یاد ء اینو تینا دا اعتراض ء کیوہ کہ ہک الو اینو ذاکر صاحب داڑے بسک ذاکر صاحب دا ہیت ء کرے کرے علم و اخبار نا دا پوزیشن نا بھلا بزرگ ایو ذاکر صاحب برو دا کلا ہیتاتے
en: As I remember, today I am making this objection of mine: that there was no right... Today Zakir Sahib came here; Zakir Sahib said this, he said it. Zakir Sahib is the great elder of this standing in learning and journalism; Zakir Sahib will come to all these matters.
en_old: In my memory, today I make this objection of mine, that there was no right; today Zakir Sahib came here. Zakir Sahib said this thing, he said it, the great elder of this position in knowledge and journalism. Zakir Sahib would come, all these words...

brh: او دے شاید ملا عبدالخالق ابابکی اللہ سفت کیتہ محترم سوسن صاحب بے حاجی عبداللطیف ئے خدا فیصلہ کروک ء
en: And that day, perhaps, Mulla Abdul Khaliq Ababaki — may God praise him — respected Sosan Sahib, ... Haji Abdul Latif. God is the one who decides.
en_old: That day perhaps Mullah Abdul Khaliq Ababaki, may God praise him, respected Sosan Sahib, Haji Abdul Latif, God is the one who decides.

brh: ئے لوے بابو بھر دل سنبھالے دل فیصلہ کرے لاہنات سوصل صاحب راجا گاکے واخنا ابھلس بس پیش تمبا کہ ابھا غار کرے ئے لوے ہلبے تھم ابھا غار
en: ... Babu took heart with his whole heart; the heart decided ... Sosal Sahib, Raja ... came and stepped forward ... [the rest is garbled].
en_old: ...Babu with a full heart composed himself, the heart decided, Sosal Sahib, Raja... came forward and presented himself... (partly unintelligible)

brh: ارے ئے لب ہلب اٹ او یاد برو سوسو صاحب، ہمو وخت آتہ ننا گاڑی ٹی واپس مستونگ آ بس۔ ملا عبدالخالق نا جاگہ توسٹ، بابو مہر دین ء تیار کریر، او بس خان آباد ء
en: ... and Soso Sahib will remember: at that time he came back to Mastung in our vehicle. I stayed at Mulla Abdul Khaliq's place; they got Babu Mehr Din ready, and he came to Khanabad.
en_old: ...he will remember, Soso Sahib, at that time we came back to Mastung in our car. Mullah Abdul Khaliq's place stayed; they got Babu Mehr Din ready, and he came to Khanabad.

brh: پارا بابا ایلو بانی دوکشی کرے پجوہر انصاف راہی تسے پروانہ مار ئے دا واسطہ دادے تس کرے پجوہر ئے پا بالکل دا فیصلہ ء کہ نی دوکشے عظیم جالی اترا دا کے بھلو امید اسے
en: He said, father, the other founder made an effort(?) ... gave a path of justice ... gave it for this reason ... I said, this is exactly the decision, that you ... great ... why, this is a big hope for me.
en_old: He said, father, the other founder made an effort... justice gave a path, Parwana's son, gave this connection... he said, exactly this decision, that you made the effort, great Jali, this is a big hope for us.

brh: دا سا اسہ ہیت اسے سیلاب غوغلہ کاری پی پی ئے کاری کم از کم ہمو بند ہمو ادارہ دا کلے جوڑ کرے ئے اقرار و اسہ ہیتس تے
en: Now this is one thing: the flood ... the PP's(?) work ... at least that bund, that institution, built all of this; I acknowledge it, and one more thing...
en_old: This is one point: the flood... at least that dam, that institution built all of this, an acknowledgment and one thing...

brh: عاشق مضمون سے لکھ کاٹ کہ کرے براہوئی ہر ہفتہ دافتہ کچ ورنا سوسٹ خط بروت اللہ تو ئے براہوئی کس کرے پائے ئے شرمندہ مسٹ ئے ہرا جاگہ سے لکھ کاٹ شاید ہموٹی
en: Ashiq ... I wrote an article that ... Brahui ... every week letters would come from these young people of Kachh(?) ... then I ... in Brahui ... I became ashamed. Wherever I wrote — perhaps in that.
en_old: Ashiq wrote an article that every week letters come from these young men of Kachh(?) in Brahui... then I, in Brahui... I was embarrassed... wherever he wrote, perhaps in that.

brh: براہوئی پارے کہ شست و ہشت سالہ وختس پیزاتس پج سندھی تے پارے تا کہ براہوئی پات وٹ اسل براہوئی آ ئے شرمندگی محسوس کریٹ ہر آن تم ایلوے خلک
en: In Brahui he said that at some time in sixty-eight ... [I] told the Sindhis ... I did not say [I was] Brahui; I actually felt ashamed of Brahui, whenever ... struck the other.
en_old: The Brahui said that at the age of sixty-eight, sometime, he told the Sindhis that I speak Brahui, an original Brahui, and I felt ashamed whenever another one struck.

brh: ورنا چاہے سوچے کہ براہوئی ئس قوم ئس ئس زبان ئس ئس تہذیب ئس خوشی سکندر جان، نی ہرا کہ دا زبان کن سوچانس اللہ تعالی تنے کامیاب کے، گام گام آ۔
en: The young people should think that Brahui is a nation, a language, a culture. It is a joy, Sikandar Jan — you who have thought about this language, may God Almighty make you successful at every step.
en_old: Young people should think that Brahui is a nation, a language, a civilization. Joy, Sikandar Jan, you who have thought for this language, may Almighty God make you successful at every step.

brh: ننا کل دا سنگت آک ہرا کسرے ایلو ہرا کنا فکر تو سنگت او آن شاء اللہ تعالی ہر کمک ہر سنگت ئے اوفتو کیوہ لیکن اسہ ہیت اسے ننا بد دعا کن ڈغار نا ہیت آک و آسمان نا اسہ ہیت اسے
en: All these friends of ours who are on the road, and the others who are like-minded with me are friends; God Almighty willing, I will give every help to every one of their friends. But there is one thing: as for our curses, the matters of the earth and of the sky are one and the same thing.
en_old: All these friends of ours who are on the path, and the others, I believe, friends, God Almighty willing, we will help every friend in every way we can. But there is one thing: as for our curses, it's a matter of the earth versus a matter of the sky.

brh: ایلو برجا تخبو اسیکہ استارے برجا تخبو اسیکہ بہرے برجا تخبو اگر آہا استار بھر او دا بفوسہ تو اوفتیاسے عائد کبو جرمس کہ او دا گڈار دے کشار دے چکر دے داتے اسہ بدلہ
en: Keep the other going, keep one star going, keep one share going. If those stars ... do not come with this, then charge them with a crime, that they ... this last day, ... day, ... day ... this in return.
en_old: Keep the other going, keep one star going, keep one share going. If those stars don't do this, then charge them with a crime, that they... this last day, the day of taking out, the turning day... this in return.

brh: استاد زبیر پاتہ مے دے ٹکٹ نا زہرہ ٹی ارے تو دا پتی دیر پاریک نو کشی بو ئے اگر سنگتی بد کرے تو سیمینار ہیسٹ پدا نو انصاف کمو کہ نی امٹی بد امونی پدا ٹھیک ہی ہرا مد مونی فریدہ وی سکھو پدا بد مونی خو خو زاری استے
en: Ustad Zubair said to him ... day ... ticket ... is in ..., then ... they say ... pull out ...; if a friend does wrong, then the seminar ..., then do justice, [saying] that you did wrong ... then it is fine; whoever comes forward ..., then the wrong comes forward ... wailing ...
en_old: Ustad Zubair says that when we're in the ticket... this water is called... if a friend does wrong, then at the seminar... then do justice, that you did wrong, then fine... whoever does good... then wrong... crying...

en: Mom, don't worry yourself. These city people are very clever, selfish and self-serving; I'll deal with them properly. I've passed matric ... go ... this truck, half a truck came ... matric
en_old: Mom, don't worry yourself. These city people are very clever, selfish and only out for themselves. I'll take care of them. Matric pass... go... this truck, half a truck comes, matric

brh: پاس اما میٹرک پاس مچے قرارا ہیت کرک دا غس چیانٹ ٹی ہیت کننگوس کنا خفتہ پردہ غاتے ہراسک آئندہ احتیاط کیوا اما نی انت ابا تو ہیت کپیسہ ئے ہی ابا تو ننا ہیت کننگ
en: pass. Mom, matric pass! Speak a little more calmly — you were talking in such a voice that you tore my eardrums. In future I'll be careful. Mom, why don't you talk to Dad? Me? Hey, us talking to Dad...
en_old: pass. Mom, matric pass, everyone talks calmly... this was being talked about in... my sleeping curtains... next time I'll be careful. Mom, why don't you talk to Dad? Yes, talking to Dad...

brh: فضولی! دا تا کلنا بدل تو او دے؟ ہا جوان، ئے تینٹ ابا تو ہیت کیوہ۔ نی انت ہیت کروس تینا ابا تو؟ ئے تینٹ ہیت کیوہ اوڑتو۔
en: Nonsense! Him, in exchange for all of these? Yes, fine, I'll talk to Dad myself. What will you say to your father? I'll talk to him myself.
en_old: Nonsense! Instead of all of these, him? Yes, fine, I'll talk to Dad myself. What will you say to your dad? I'll talk to him myself.

brh: جانی نا باوہ دا نامن کرے، انت مہس انت کریتک؟
en: Jani's father refused this. What happened, what did you do?
en_old: Jani's father did this. What happened, what did you do?

brh: دا منوئی تاسس لف دا انکار کروئی تاسس تاڑے خفت او چالاکی نا نیاڑی ئے تورے موزی ہمارینا دیر چے نا سالوم کریکے دیر مسڑے تینتسکا اوڑن جوانی کے بندخ تیرا مسڑے دون ازے پٹی
en: Was this something to be accepted, or something to be refused? ... a woman of disgrace and cunning ... wicked ... who would even greet you? Who would have given their daughter ... to do him good ... to a person like that, a daughter ... like that ...
en_old: This is something to accept... this is something to refuse... sleep, and the cunning woman... she greeted... it got late... the girl... herself... good to her... the person... the girl...

brh: ولے دن اسم افک وقتس دم مسنے دیدی نا مار ایلو نا ورور خستکیک دیدی نا مار انہ جن نا مار کتا تے خرانسٹ انت ترپک خلسا کیک امر و امر حرکت کیک خرانسٹ گٹ گٹ ساہ کیک ئے دم ننے کلے پرے او طوفانی اعظم او طوفانی
en: But it's not like that at all. For a while now he's been out of breath. Didi's son ... the other one's sister ... Didi's son is a jinn's son — like dogs and bulls, what jumping and thrashing he keeps doing, how he moves, panting in gasps. Right now all of us ... oh stormy Azam, oh stormy one!
en_old: But it's not like that. Time has passed. Didi's son... the other one's sister fell asleep. Didi's son... a jinn's son... the dogs in the desert, what is it that jumps and flails about, how it moves, panting hard in the desert. Now tell all of us, that stormy Azam, that stormy one.

brh: ننا دا نیک بخت، وخت ئس کہ ماری نا اعتراض ء پکو کرے۔ ننے انت اعتراض ئس کنے چے گپ تو، دا تو جوان مس کہ نن او کرینوٹ، انکار کتون، دا ننا اوفتیا احسان ئس اسکہ۔ ئے واری ہم پد گننگ نا مار درکتسکہ، ایفتیا پکو کروکا؟
en: This good woman of ours — there was a time when she was firm about the objection to the boy. What objection do we have? ... It was good that we said yes and didn't refuse; this was a favor we did them. Otherwise, would a son have been found for her later on? Who would have settled it with them?
en_old: This good fortune of ours, when Mari's objection was settled. What objection do we have, talk to me. It was good that we did it and didn't refuse; it was a favor we did them. Couldn't they even find the son again, the one who settled it with them?

brh: دا نا جوانی نا ٹائم ادا بمپک ئے دم قرار سہی کرے زاراڑے بمپک
en: This one's good times won't come here; right now he has properly settled things ... won't come.
en_old: This is the time for his good deeds here... now the calm is right... here...

brh: دا دیرے؟ دا دیرے مسے؟ بش کبو تے دا دیرے؟ کپے!
en: Who is this? Who has this turned out to be? Make her stand up — who is this? Don't!
en_old: Who is this? Who has this become? Open up, who is this? Don't!

brh: دا برامی بادشاہ کننگٹی ئے مونی تو تینا نشانیت کنے، کل برامی شکی رے، بغیر مونی دیداری آن مونی اورثہ بازو شاروس، ہرف کنے، سمرین مسے، دا دیرے؟ م-م-ممی، ممی او ننے مسخرہ کرینے
en: At this wedding, in making [him] the groom, I ... give me your token. All you wedding guests are humiliated — without the face-viewing [ceremony] ... lift [it] up for me — it's Samreen! Who is this? M-m-mummy, mummy, he has made fools of us!
en_old: This wedding is being... the ring, give me your token. Everyone at the wedding is suspicious... without seeing the ring... the ring... the arm... take me, it became Samreen, who is this? M-m-mommy, mommy, they've made fools of us.

brh: اڑے جانی نی یار انتئے دم کریس یار نی یار اندادے تو خو پارہ شغل میلہ مسخرہ اندادے تو ڈرامہ پارئے
en: Hey Jani, buddy, why did you stop, buddy? You, buddy — this is exactly what's called fun and games, a joke; this is exactly what's called drama.
en_old: Hey Jani, why did you, buddy... you, buddy, that's what I'm saying, fun and games, a joke, that's what you call drama.

brh: دا دے ڈرامہ پارے ننا وختٹی دونا لوک ننا وختٹی نومے سمائی برامو لوراٹی دا دے رغک مسورہ خلکنا مسینک بسورہ چاپ خلکورا چاسکہ ادسہ دادسہ ایرا ایرا برام
en: Nowadays they call this drama. In our time, people of that kind ... in our time ... at weddings ... the village girls would come and clap ... at weddings.
en_old: Today they call this drama. In our time, people like that, in our time we... knew... at weddings on this day... the girls would clap, come and... they clapped and danced... at the wedding, the wedding.

brh: خیرٹ دا وراٹی مننگٹی او ہم خلکٹی اما خلکٹی نہ دیرہ س خننا نہ چاپس خننا نہ پین بشبو مار مسڑنا لمہ خنومے چاپ خلبو خوشینا وراٹی
en: Anyway, with it happening this way, and that too in the village — but in the village we see neither anyone, nor any clapping, nor anything else ... the boy's and girl's mothers ... clap in joy!
en_old: Anyway, at this... they laughed too, but they laughed. Nobody saw any... and nobody saw any dancing, nor any other... son... the girl's mother saw... clapping... in happiness.

brh: او میرین تو باز نامی مائی گیری ات آ چون او بختاور طوفان وقتے کیت آ ئے چیزا نہ چارے کہ منی دیما کین آ کیت درستیں چیزا گم گار کنت کلے روت
en: O Mirin, you were a very famous fisherman, but when that wretched storm comes it doesn't look at anything; whatever comes in front of it, it makes everything vanish and moves on.
en_old: O Mirin, you were a very famous fisherman, but when an ill-fated storm comes it looks at nothing; whatever comes in front of it, it destroys everything and moves on.

brh: راست گشگئے میران تو راست گشگئے ہنو مارا وتی الک آترا چیزے کنوئی کپیت راستی کالو میران نا لوگا ہر چیزے کہ
en: You are speaking the truth, Miran, you are speaking the truth. Now we will have to do something for our own village. Truly, Kalo, in Miran's house everything that...
en_old: Speaking truth, Miran, you speak the truth; that boy cannot do anything for his family. Truly, Kalo, in Miran's house everything...

brh: ضرورت انت۔ بدائیش۔ او واجہ، من تئی گپہ سرپد بوٹوں۔ تئی کلاوہ ضرور سر کنین۔ منی کلاوہ ضرور سر کنے۔ او پدا گپ ایش انت کہ علاقہ ء مردمانی خیال داری او چے بیئگ انت چے۔
en: ...is needed. Give it to him. O sir, I have understood what you said. I will surely deliver your message. You will surely deliver my message. And then the point is this: looking after the people of the area, and what is happening, what.
en_old: What is needed. Badaish. O sir, I have understood what you said. Your message will surely reach them. My message must surely reach them. And then the point is the care of the people of the area, and what is happening, what.

brh: ئے نبیک اٹ منا ہر حال آ کستے کالو تر کستے جواب دیگی اٹ۔ ٹھیک ئے واجہ ئے چیز ئے تو غلامی تو۔۔۔
en: This won't do. In any case I have to... Kalo, you have to give an answer to someone. All right, sir, this thing... I am at your service...
en_old: Yes, I'm fine. Ask about every bit of my condition, Kalo; I have to answer to someone. All right, sir, this thing is slavery...

brh: گوار تو اترا پریشان مفہ، اللہ خیر کیک، اینا گڑا مسالے؟
en: Sister, don't worry so much, God will make it good. So what happened today?
en_old: Sister, don't worry so much, God will make it right. What happened today?

brh: نوں منی پریشانی ایڈو شروع بوتو نوں مائی پس کتنے کتنے دے چو شمہ گوش اللہ سرا بیساکا درا شر بے من شمی
en: Now my worry has started from here. Now our father, so many, many days... you say, trust in God, everything will be fine... I, your...
en_old: Now my worry started from here. Now my father, for so many days... you say God is above, it will turn out fine, I... you...

brh: منی شمیا منی مردری یا مچکو صبر کر نازو صبر کر صبرے مزنے باری
en: My..., my husband... Be patient, Nazo, be patient; patience is a great thing.
en_old: My dear, my... be patient, Nazo, be patient. Patience is a great thing.

brh: کنا چا منی براس تو ہفتگے بارڈر آ شتا ئے انگا کو خبر نیسے کسے بشی کے بارڈر ئے کسے بشی کے ایران آ سربتا اینا گو منا تسلی متے
en: My..., my brother went to the border a week ago, and there is still no news of him. Someone says he is at the border, someone says he has reached Iran, but I am not at ease.
en_old: My brother went to the border a week ago, and there's no news of him. Someone says he crossed the border, someone says he reached Iran, but I still have no peace of mind.

brh: منزانہ نمنے تسلی ارو جھلاس بوتکا ما ہلی بزنی نیتے کدی نیتے زالبول بے چنکس بے وسے
en: I know you are consoling us, but... we have nothing, we have no one; we are women, with little children, helpless.
en_old: I know you comfort us, but it has been a struggle... we are women, with little children, helpless.

brh: مرت سے دیدی ما چوں لاچار بینا منا یرت چنکس منا کو دریا یا مرو طوفانے توڑ سے
en: The men... three days now... how helpless we have become... my little ones... the sea... a storm...
en_old: We can see death. How helpless we have become. My little ones, my... like a river or a storm that breaks through.

brh: بھلے منی گپ ئس ارتے اللہ کے منی گپ ئس ارتے مرچی اینو اوچ نا چاڑتھک نی ہچ گنگا نہ
en: If only you had listened to my word, God knows, if only you had listened to my word, today we would not have seen this day; nothing would have happened.
en_old: Whether I had something to say, God knows I had something to say. Today you are not saying anything at all.

brh: ما گری، اللہ سر بھروسہ کر بس۔
en: Don't cry; just trust in God.
en_old: Don't cry. Just trust in God.

brh: تنہا مننداں تو یاد کائے، تنہا مننداں تو یاد کائے، لوٹا ترا، ابا بیا لیپ کا، بیا لیپ کا منیزہ، اماں اماں بیا لیپ کا، بیا لیپ کا منیزہ
en: When I sit alone, you come to my mind; when I sit alone, you come to my mind. I long for you. Father, come, hold me close, come, hold me close, Maniza(?). Mother, mother, come, hold me close, come, hold me close, Maniza(?).
en_old: When I sit alone, I remember. When I sit alone, I remember. I miss you. Father, come hold me, come hold me, Maniza. Mother, mother, come hold me, come hold me, Maniza.

brh: او ننزو تو توکدیتے انو ئتو چے فکری کجا گارے چے چارگے
en: O Nazo, you... now, in what thoughts are you? Where are you lost? What are you looking at?
en_old: O Nanzo, where are you lost in thought? What are you looking at?

brh: تئی مہر تا ہنکس اسر مانہ میرین مردمہ چکی ٹوک ارے خدا ودیکے
en: Your love has such an effect on me, Mirin, that a person... God created...
en_old: Your love has such an effect, Mirin. A person's heart... may God...

brh: کسے نستے، ہدے چستو۔ پرچا، توکئی ودارے؟ منی ودار، جوکئی واستے آن۔
en: There is no one... look up. Why, whom are you waiting for? My waiting is for you.
en_old: There's no one. Look up. Why, are you waiting? My waiting is for you.

brh: ئے چم یوکا تئی ودارا کنا، ہما وقت کہ تو نیائے، منے ئے دنیا ہر زیبائی بے معنی لگے
en: These eyes are waiting for you. Whenever you don't come, every beauty of this world seems meaningless to me.
en_old: These eyes are waiting for you. When you don't come, every beauty of this world seems meaningless to me.

brh: ہمے گپ آن مکایم تانکہ تو دنیائے وشیہ بگندے اوئے جوڑ کنوکے صفتہ بگندے جی ہو
en: I won't let go of this matter until you see the joys of the world and see the qualities of its Maker. Yes.
en_old: I won't stop on this matter until you see the beauty of the world and see the attributes of its Creator. Yes.

brh: اما وعدہ کہ منام خدائے جوڑ کنوکے زیبائی اچاراں، منام خدائے خدائی گندکے، راست خوش کے، تارا کہ روچ ہم گندہ منام
en: It is our promise that we too will behold the beauty of what God has made, we too will see God's divine power, truly happy, and we too will see the stars and the sun.
en_old: Our promise is that we will see the beauty of God the Creator, we will see God's divinity, truly happy, and the stars will see us that day too.

brh: نی روچ نا گوزی، او منیشاپم بے وابیہ گوزی، میرین، پہچی حیالی، من زانا آرامہ نشتوو، منا ہم روچ و شپ ء خبر نی
en: The day doesn't pass, and my nights too pass without sleep, Mirin; with what thoughts... I know you have not sat at rest; I too am unaware of day and night.
en_old: You pass the days, and you pass my nights without sleep, Mirin. What thoughts... I know you have not sat at rest. I too know nothing of day and night.

brh: پا خدائے نامہ منا چو گنوک مکہ اللہ مکہ نازک منا چے تئی جدائی ہچ سگنتوئی اللہ چھی روچ میاری
en: For God's sake, don't drive me mad like this, by God, don't, Nazuk. I cannot bear being apart from you at all. God, may He never bring such a day.
en_old: For God's sake, don't drive me so crazy, Nazuk. I can't bear being apart from you at all. Oh God, may such a day never come.

brh: من تو جتا نبی من من بے تو زندہ وت نہ کنا میران تئی دشمن پرچے چوشیں گپ جنگ ئے میرین اگر ترا چیزے بیت من ہم زندہ نباں
en: I won't be separated from you; I, I cannot live without you. Miran, God forbid! Why are you saying such things? Mirin, if something happens to you, I won't stay alive either.
en_old: I won't be separated from you; I can't live without you. My Meer, why does your enemy say such things? Meerin, if anything happens to you, I won't stay alive either.

brh: منی ہم سفر وا توے نا، چشے گپ مکن نازک، منتے تھرنگلے ارسانہ چارتھ نکنہ
en: You are my companion, after all, aren't you? Don't say such things, Nazuk; I cannot look at your teardrops.
en_old: You are my companion. Don't say such things, Nazuk...

brh: منی تے دل یک کے ہمارے کس جدا کتنا کا
en: My heart and yours are one; no one can separate us.
en_old: Our hearts are one; who can separate us?

brh: اماں دا سامان آ، سامان۔
en: Mother, this stuff, the stuff.
en_old: Mother, this stuff, the stuff.

brh: ماہل، ئے سامان کئے داتگاں؟ بے بے من آورتگاں سامان بے بے تو؟ ہو بے بے من۔
en: Mahal, who gave these things? Bibi, I brought the things. Bibi, you? Yes, Bibi, me.
en_old: Mahal, who gave this stuff? Bibi, I brought it. The stuff, Bibi, you? Yes, Bibi, me.

brh: ترا منا نگتا، ایدا میاخ، تو سرپد نبی بے بے میر صاحب چیزے سامان دین داتہ میر صاحب، من ترا آروچا ہم گشتنہ، وتی میرہ بگوش، ئے چیزانی ضرورت نئے بچار بے بے عید نزدیکے، ئے ماسی
en: Didn't I tell you not to bring them here? Don't you understand? Bibi, Mir Sahib has sent some things. Mir Sahib! I told you that day too: tell your Mir we have no need of these things. Look, Bibi, Eid is near, these...
en_old: Didn't I tell you, come here, don't you understand? Bibi, Mir Sahib sent some stuff. Mir Sahib... I told you that day too, tell your Mir we don't need these things. Look, Bibi, Eid is near, this, aunt...

brh: تو مانا، ئے دا واسطہ چیزے سامان تو ضرورت استے بے بے پدا ئے سامان میر صاحب دیم داتا، تئی واسطہ ہم گد استے بے بے مچو چنا، برو تے میرٹ۔
en: Listen to me: for this (Eid) you need some things. Bibi, Mir Sahib sent these things; there are clothes for you too, Bibi. ... child, go to your Mir.
en_old: You understand, you need these things. Bibi, then Mir Sahib sent this stuff; there are clothes for you too, Bibi. All right, child, go to Mir.

brh: بگوش ہمے ہمدردی ارا ہلکے دیم راوی واسطہ بیکا منا ئے ہمدردی ضرورت نئے منوتی نوتی چوک خیال تادی کنا کسانی درا چائدا
en: Tell him to keep this sympathy for the other people of the village; I don't need this sympathy. I will look after my own children myself, as I have since they were small.
en_old: Tell him to keep this sympathy for the village people; I don't need his sympathy. I can look after my own children myself. He has known me since my childhood...

brh: شرین بے بے اڑائی چیزا نی بیبرین بے بے منگوشہ درا چمانی لوکا، مانو
en: Dear Bibi, I won't take these things back. Bibi, I'm telling you, in front of everyone's eyes... agree to it.
en_old: Sweet Bibi, these things... Bibi, I'm telling you, out of sight of the household, understand?

brh: واہ رے سرکار واہ، انچو سرکار اینٹ، انچو آئی سپاہی اینٹ، واہ چور، خیار، توم چٹ زادگے، ایچ سرپد نہ بئے
en: Wow, O government, wow! Such is the government, and such are its soldiers! Wow, thieves... [unclear] ... totally ... you can't make sense of anything.
en_old: Wow, government, wow! What a government they are, what soldiers they are! Wow, thieves... I don't understand anything at all.

brh: ہمیشانی کار انت۔ دگہ بیچارہ چے بکن انت ہن تو منا بگوش۔ راست گوش ئے، ئے سرکارئے سرا تاوان انت۔ روچ ء ہمے کچکاں کش انت او شپ ء کئیت تم گدوزاں مار انت۔ ہیا!
en: It's their job. What else can the poor fellows do, now you tell me? You're right, it is a loss borne by the government. By day they kill these very dogs, and at night they come... [unclear] with the thieves. Ha!
en_old: It's their job. What else can the poor guys do, you tell me. You're right, the loss falls on the government. By day they kill these dogs, and at night the thieves come and strike. Ha!

brh: یار، کاری بیبیت کہ بکنت نہ؟ شپ ء پہرہ دنت، روچ ء وتی کار ء کنت۔ بلے تئی سرا ہم آفرین کہ تو اشانی حمایت ء کنے۔ ئے گون دزاں اوار انت، شپ ء دزی ء کننت۔ چے گشگائے یار؟ اگہ مخلوق۔۔۔
en: Friend, he has to do some work, doesn't he? At night he keeps watch, and by day he does his own work. But bravo to you too, that you take their side. They are in league with the thieves; at night they steal. What are you saying, friend? If the people...
en_old: Friend, he has to work, doesn't he? At night he stands guard, by day he does his work. But bravo to you for supporting them. They are in with the thieves, they steal at night. What are you saying, friend? If the people...

brh: نن پورا، چے گپ نا چے نن؟ مالوک چے بکن، اگہ وتی دپا پچ کرت تو ئے دپئے بند کننگ آن زانن تے چانے۔ نہ یار، آخر یک روچے یک مردمے وتی دپا
en: Us, completely... what is the matter, what about us? What can the people do? If someone opens his mouth, these people know how to shut that mouth. No, friend, in the end one day a man [will open] his mouth...
en_old: Us? What's the matter, what about us? What can the poor man do? If he opens his mouth, they know how to shut it. No, friend, eventually one day a man will open his mouth...

brh: اللہ مہ پچ کنت کس نہ کنت ئے درست کرنٹ اگر اوتے دپا پچ کرنٹ کسے نہ اوشکنی تے چا نگپانہ ہا ہا آخر تانکہ چوش بیتی یار تانکہ تو زندہ گے ہمے وڑ
en: God forbid he opens it! Nobody does; these people would set him straight. If they open their mouths, nobody listens to them ... ha ha. In the end, how long will it go on like this, friend? As long as you are alive, the same way.
en_old: God forbid. Nobody does; they all do it. If they open their mouths, nobody listens to them. Ha ha. In the end, how long will it be like this, friend? As long as you're alive, the same way.

brh: بیٹ کمال ئے یار ادا میر معتبر سرکار سمگلر ہر چیز کہ بوٹنٹ کننٹ ہمے خاطرہ غریب گریوگان اوانا وراگے خاطرہ نان نیسٹ او سرے چیرتے
en: It's a wonder, friend: here the Mirs, the notables, the government and the smugglers do whatever they want. That is why the poor are weeping; they have no bread to eat, and their heads are bowed.
en_old: It's amazing, friend. Here the Mirs, the notables, the government and the smugglers do whatever they want. That's why the poor have no bread to eat and are kept under their heels.

brh: بھلے یار، با دے کہ مئے لیڈر چیز نی چیزے بکننت۔ لیڈر؟ جام لیڈر گجام لیڈر ئے گپا کننگے تو؟ ہمے کہ مئے لیڈر انت، میر و معتبر انت، ہمے۔ بس۔
en: All right, friend, our leaders ought to do something or other. Leaders? Which leaders, which leaders are you talking about? These very ones who are our leaders, who are the Mirs and notables, them. That's all.
en_old: All right, friend, let our leaders do something. Leaders? Which leaders, which leaders are you talking about? The ones who are our leaders, the Mirs and notables, them. That's it.

brh: سیار نو گپ آ دراج مکہ آغا م ایشانی بارا من تو سوچ کنین نا سنانے کپن پدا برونٹ اگہ کاری کنن پدا بیا برونٹ بیا
en: [Unclear], now don't drag the talk out, sir. I will think about these matters... [unclear] ... then they will go. If we do some work, then come on, they will go, come on.
en_old: Don't drag this talk out, sir. I'll think about them... they'll come later. If we do some work, then they'll come, come.

brh: یاد کنا دوریا تیگا فریاد کنا دوریا تیگا فریاد کنا چم اوشک بوتا کدی توبیا ہی چم اوشک
en: I remember you; far from you I cry out, far from you I cry out; my eyes are full of tears. When will you come? Oh, my eyes are full of tears.
en_old: Remember me, from afar I cry out, from afar I cry out, my eyes are full of tears. When will you come? My eyes are full of tears.

brh: تو پچیس چوں کننگائے بے ایمانی مکہ براس بے ایمانی مکہ ناخو قاسم تو ساریا ہتے تو یک کلو ہچیرین دو کلو مکنے تو
en: How are you making it twenty-five? Don't cheat, brother, don't cheat. Captain Qasim, you brought [unclear]... it's [only] one kilo, don't make it two kilos.
en_old: Why are you making it twenty-five? Don't cheat, brother, don't cheat. Nakhuda Qasim, you... it wasn't even one kilo, don't make it two kilos.

brh: ڈبی اٹی شش ڈبی وا مکھنے ننو ارٹی آستانہ بیارے ما گڑا تہو سہئی اوہ واجہ خاص وہم شے کوکارائیں توار او دا ڈنا پیدا کین رائے ملوک شما جمع خدا خیر ئے منشی چے بوگائیں چے جنگ ئے
en: In the box... six boxes... don't make... bring the [unclear]... then... Oh sir, what is this shouting, and out here... people, you have all gathered. God, is all well? Munshi, what is happening, what is this fight?
en_old: ...six boxes in the box... bring the shrine... then... oh sir, a special... a shouting noise... people gathered, may God make it well. Munshi, what's happening, what fight is this?

brh: بس، ئے منی حساب زیاد جوڑ بیان، ئے منشی گشگانت کہ نہ کم بیان، من چون بکنین؟ ایشرا من سپرد کٹ نہ کنین، تو بگوش ایشرا۔ بلے بکنئے، بلے یک تینا، چہ دو تین مکنئے شما، بے ظلم کنئے مئے سرا۔ اوشے جی، الہا بیچار، ئے بیچارہ غریبیں مردمے، دریا رو، خدا
en: That's it: my account has come out too high, and this munshi is saying no, it has come out lower. What am I supposed to do? I won't hand this over; you tell him. Fine, do it, but make it one tin; don't make it two or three. You are being unjust to us. Oh sir, God, the poor man, this is a poor, needy man, a seafarer, God...
en_old: That's it, this munshi has made my account too high, and he says it isn't any less. What am I supposed to do? I won't hand this over, you tell him. Fine, do it, but only once, don't do it two or three times. Don't treat us unfairly. Oh, God, the poor man, this poor fellow is a poor man who goes out to sea, God...

brh: باری مائیک تو اشیے حساب ہم لکھتا، ئے کاپی نا قلم منی دستائے، ئے حساب مساب درو منی دستائے، تو وتی حسابا کناگائے، بچار منشی تو چپ ک، تئی کہ اچے کہ حسابے استے نا، آئیے شری وڑیا بکا، باندے گا پوشی حسابا پدا وتی ٹینانی حسابا بکا، حسابا دیما ک۔
en: Well, [unclear], you have written his account too. This notebook and pen are in my hand; this account and everything is all in my hand, and you are doing your own account. Look, munshi, you keep quiet. Whatever account of his you have, do it properly. Tomorrow [do] the [unclear] account, then do the account of your own tins. Bring the account forward.
en_old: Bari, Maik, you've written this account too. This notebook and pen are in my hand, and the whole account is in my hand, and you're doing your own accounts. Look, munshi, you keep quiet. Since his account is with you, do it properly. Tomorrow do the accounts for your boats again and carry the account forward.

brh: تئی زیادہ ہی آئیے زیادہ ہی صحیح ہی انو چے گوشے دگہ بیارانی ئنا ٹوبورو بیار دگہ مال مال درو بیار بس صحیح ہی ٹوبورو دگہ شرے نا حجازے مانو او شرے شرے وا شرے بورو
en: Yours is too much, his is too much, is that right? Now what do you say? Bring the others... bring the [unclear], bring the other goods, bring all the goods. That's it, that's right. [Unclear]... another good one... in a ship(?)... and good, good, okay, good, go.
en_old: You've got too much, he's got too much... is it right? What can I say? Bring the others, bring Toboro, bring the other goods, all the goods. Just make it right. Toboro, another good one... Hijaz... good, good...

brh: نازت کمیرے نی کشتی نی ہتا
en: Nazuk(?), [unclear]... the boat hasn't come?
en_old: Nazuk, where is your boat? Did you bring your boat?

brh: انگت نیتا اللہ رحم کیک سجنانی کشتی توتہ میرج کشتی گبنا کجہ پشکتا امی گپو پریشانی نصنا انگت پرچ نیتا
en: It still hasn't come. God will have mercy. The friends' boat... [unclear] boat... where has it been left behind? The worry over this matter... why hasn't it come yet?
en_old: God still has mercy on you. The friends' boat... the wedding boat... Don't worry about this matter. So why are you still...

brh: اللہ بیاری مئے اما، اللہ نگہبان بئے
en: May God bring back our [people]; may God be [their] protector.
en_old: God bring back our mother, God protect us.

brh: ارے کالو! توئے دے چکنا گامنی لوگا؟ ہا؟ راڑے دا چکرا، راوی لوگا چی!
en: Hey Kalu! Are you [going] to [unclear]'s house? Huh? [Unclear]... this..., are you going home?
en_old: Hey Kalu! Did you see your... at whose house? Huh? Come here, to this... come to Ravi's house!

brh: ٹی وی ٹاک اکائی نازک
en: TV talk... [unclear]... Nazuk.
en_old: TV talk: Akai Nazuk

brh: اگر دگرو چشمارا تو ایدا دستے نا چمپل بیجا درکاشمارا بھلے پرچا تو نزانی شیا من گلی یک دو پیر تہمودتا گلی ابس مزانی ردی کو مئے شمارا گلی توک آورت بھلے تو ہم چما جست نہ کتے کئی من ترا کدی جست کتے
en: If you do that again, I'll pull out the sandal right here in my hand... Well, why, don't you know... I [was] in the alley, one or two old men... in the alley... a woman inside the alley... Well, you didn't ask me either; when did I ever ask you?
en_old: If you do that again, I'll take the sandal off right here in my hand. Why do you... I was in the street with one or two old men... in the street, a woman inside... You never asked me either, so when have I ever asked you?

brh: تو کجاروے کئگمن ایندے پاتکائے؟ دگارو چلمہ جسپکا تاکہ منتو نقصان مروئی بھلے ما ہلی پیسش کورتہ چے۔ ئے مزنی کمینے مردومے مروچی من تئی او زاگنی حیال مپتینا ایشو
en: Where are you going? When did you come here? Next time be careful, so that I don't suffer a loss. Well, we have [unclear] the fish(?)... This is a very mean man. From today on I won't spare a thought for you and your [child].
en_old: Where are you going, and when did you come today? Next time be careful so I don't take a loss. Well, we've already handed over the fish. This is a really mean man. From today I don't care about you or your place.

brh: امر ہمدا کشتگہ گرکتگہ من۔ کمی کا تو پرچائے ہستو پریشان کنے۔ نازک ہما واداتی کہ من زندگہ ترا او جاگہ نا کسے گندئی نظرا چے گندک نا کا۔
en: [Unclear] killed right here, drowned(?)... me. Why are you upsetting [me] for nothing? Nazuk, that was the promise: that as long as I am alive, nobody from that place would look at you with an evil eye.
en_old: Why have you killed and taken... Why are you bothering me for nothing? Nazuk, I made that promise that as long as I'm alive, nobody there will look at you with an evil eye.

brh: ہاؤ امر او چکی کہ مورتہ گورا ماہلی پیس تو پرچہ چوشے گپ جنے تو یلدے اوتا پریشان مکہ
en: Yes, [unclear] and the [unclear] that died... the fish(?)... why do you talk like that? Let it go, don't worry about them.
en_old: Yes, so what if the fish died? Why do you talk like that? Let it go, don't worry about them.

brh: کدی تو بیا ئے کجا تو مریس ساتھی تو بیا ئے تنہا من نندا تو یاد کائے میرین دیما بیا میرین تنہا من نندا تو یاد کائے
en: When will you come, wherever you may be, my companion? Come. I sit alone and you come to my mind. Mirin, come before me; Mirin, I sit alone and you come to my mind.
en_old: Sometimes you come, wherever you may be, my companion, you come. When I sit alone, I remember you. Mirin, come before me. Mirin, when I sit alone, I remember you.

brh: عامران، نو بگوش۔ واجہ، چیزے مردم آتنگن، آ بارڈر کراس کننگ لوٹارہ۔ ہمم، آ گڑا تو اوانے۔
en: Amran, now tell me. Sir, some people have come; they want to cross the border. Hmm, so then, them...
en_old: Amran, now tell me. Sir, some people have come and they want to cross the border. Hmm, that's their business.

brh: چے گشت؟ من تنے اوائے چی نہ گشتو نامہ اوائے جواب کرتہ۔ من یک گشتے گشتوں کہ من ترا بگیپتیں گڑا اندے حساب کتاب کرو۔ باز شر کرتے۔ تو ویراں باز شر کرتے۔ آ تو منے ایبو گش کہ آ چونی مڑتوم انت؟
en: What did he say? I myself didn't tell him anything, yet he gave us an answer. I said one thing: I said that if I catch you, then I'll settle the accounts like this. You did very well. You did it very well. Now you tell me, what kind of people are they?
en_old: What did he say? Didn't I tell you... he gave an answer. I said one thing: I said that if I catch you, I'll settle the score like this. You did very well. You did very well with Viran. Now tell me, who are those people?

brh: واجہ، شکل و صورت وا شریں متون دراویں؟ آ، چنکہ سد مردم چنکہ سد؟ ہمے چار پنچ مردم۔ بس، میران ہما کوہنیں حسابا ضرب بگرے، کوہنیں!
en: Sir, by their looks they seem decent. Huh, how many, a hundred people, a hundred? Just these four or five people. Fine, Miran, apply the old rate, multiply by the old one!
en_old: Sir, do they look good? How many came out, about a hundred people, a hundred? Only four or five people. Fine, Miran, multiply it by the old rate, the old one!

brh: ننے صبا، شرے، ہا، برت ہمنا، ئے بگشکے، السلام علیکم واجہ، وعلیکم السلام کالو، ہا برے بدے وتی حال احوالہ
en: [Unclear] tomorrow, good, yes, go there, say this... Peace be upon you, sir. And peace be upon you, Kalu. Yes, come on, give me your news.
en_old: Tomorrow morning... good, yes, go there and say it. Peace be upon you, sir. And peace be upon you, Kalu. Yes, come, tell me how you are.

brh: میرین بیچارہ دریا غار بوت میر۔ کھلو تو ئے چے گشگے گنوک ترو بوتگے ہاں چیزو روچ پیش آ طیوب میرین نا کستین جھیڑہ بوتگت چوش تو نہ کہ ارا دریائے توک تو ڈب داتگے توبہ
en: Poor Mirin was lost at sea, Mir. Kalu, what are you saying? Have you gone mad? Yes, a few days ago that Tayyub had a quarrel with Mirin. But not to the point that he would drown him in the sea, God forbid!
en_old: Poor Mirin drowned in the sea, Mir. Kahlu, what are you saying? Have you gone mad? Yes, a few days ago Tayyub had a quarrel with Mirin. But not to the point of drowning him in the sea, God forbid.

brh: توبہ توبہ واجہ ئے تو چے گشے تو منے بگوش کہ گڑا ترا خبر چون لگت واجہ منان چیزے مردم انچو گشتگن کہ اوانی گسء تہا باز مزنیں غوغا ء کوکارے شروع انت ء درستیں مردم اوانی لوگا مچ انت
en: God forbid, God forbid, sir, what are you saying? Tell me, then, how did you get the news? Sir, some people told me that a very great uproar and wailing has started in their house, and all the people have gathered at their house.
en_old: God forbid, God forbid, sir, what are you saying? Tell me, how did you get the news? Sir, some people told me that a great uproar and wailing has started in their house, and everyone has gathered at their house.

brh: آئی پشکتنا شار نا ملپوڑی نی کنا مقابلہ ئے کننگ کپیسہ روبینا آئی آنٹی نی چیلنج کرینے چیلنج کنائی نی غم کپہ آنٹی اخس کہ چیلنج
en: Lady, you city sweet-pastry (malpuri), you can't compete with me. Rubina, lady, aunty, you've thrown down a challenge? The challenge is mine. Don't you worry, aunty, however big the challenge is...
en_old: Aunty, you woman from the city, you can't compete with me. Rubina aunty, you've made a challenge, my challenge... don't you worry, aunty, however big the challenge is...

brh: ئے چیلنج کیوہ توڑے وانٹی کنتو چاپ خلنگ کے کلنگ کپک دا شار والاک ننا ہن مقابلہ کرو رک شکست دافتا مقدر اٹ دا سیلوم نی ہمت کننگ اٹی ئس آ
en: I challenge you. Even ... nobody can dance the chaap with me. These city folk are going to compete with us? Defeat is their fate. ... are you really daring to do this?
en_old: ...I challenge you. Even in Wana, nobody can beat me at the chaap dance. These city people will compete with us? Defeat is their fate. This flood... if you have the courage...

brh: گڑا کمبو چاپس مرے گڑا کمبو چاپس مرے
en: Then come on, let's have a chaap dance! Then come on, let's have a chaap dance!
en_old: Then let's have a little chaap dance, then let's have a little chaap dance.

brh: جانی کچک تے نا بدل کبر بس شغل کریس جیو بابا
en: Jani, ... in place of the dogs ... you were just having fun. Bravo, buddy!
en_old: Dear, instead of the dogs... you were just joking. Bravo, dad!

brh: اماں نن کٹان نن کٹان کٹان کٹان دا بائتنے ملک رے کٹان کٹان نن کمالس کرین کٹان کٹان وڈا ماما
en: Mom, we won, we won, won, won! This ..., hey, won, won! We pulled off something amazing! Won, won, big uncle!
en_old: Mother, we won, we won, won, won! This little boy... won, won! We did something amazing, won, won, big uncle!

brh: مبارک مرے دا تاج نا کاٹومبٹ ہچو کٹاس کٹاس کھوڑ کریس کٹان کٹان کنا یار ئے کرے چاپ نا چیمپیئن اوٹ ہفت ملک کنے منت اٹ توار کیرہ چاپ خلنگے ارے واہ واہ دادو ماما تو ایتو دا خلنگے
en: Congratulations! This crown on your head! ... you won, you won, ... we won, we won, my friend did it! I'm the chaap champion; seven countries call on me, begging, to dance chaap. Oh wow, wow, uncle Dado, you too, (do) this dancing!
en_old: Congratulations, this crown on your head... won, won, my friend did it! I'm the chaap champion. In seven countries they beg me to come and dance chaap. Wow, wow, Dado uncle, look at him dance!

brh: سرنا والا کرینیتینے دودا ہن کٹان کٹان سرنا والا ئے کرینیتینے دود نا کپڑنگا ماما نی ہم سرنا نا نمونہ مر ماما مسونو سرنا ابے تو نی ایرے لا بالٹی نا نمونہ کرینوس تینے برامے نا نی ایرے چھاپا
en: He's made himself the surna player ... we won, we won! He's made himself the surna player, in traditional clothes. Uncle, you be like a surna too; uncle has turned into a surna! Hey, you there, you've made yourself look like a bucket! At your wedding, you there, chaap...
en_old: They've made themselves surna players... go there, won, won... they've made themselves surna players... uncle, you be a surna player too... you've made yourself look like a bucket... at the wedding...

brh: نی آ پانو خننگسہ تم کہ دیوال آن پیشی تمبے نی ہم تو ننو خننگسہ توم کدو امرگی الے اسے منٹ اسے منٹ اسے منٹ ممی اسے وار دا تورے دا دن غریب نا مسنا پچک
en: You, watching like that, you'll fall out over the wall. You're watching us too ... how ... One minute, one minute, one minute. Mommy, just once show this: these are like a poor man's daughter's clothes.
en_old: I'm telling you, look, you'll fall off the wall. You look at us too... how... one minute, one minute, one minute. Mommy, just once... this poor one's child...

brh: پنڈا سستے جہانسی تانا نا کلچر یورواتا اما زیبا جوڑ کروکی دا پچاتا پاپا ممی ئے کہ مسڑ جوڑ مسنے بیچارہ غریب نا جائی دن نا پچاتے دوزا بلائی نا پچاتے بینا سستے بلائی نا صندوقٹے سرام ہوتے
en: ... cheap ... your own culture ... these clothes that Zeba made ... Papa, Mommy, the girl has turned out fine; poor thing, a poor family's, real clothes like these ... stole Bilai's clothes ... cheap ... into Bilai's trunk ...
en_old: ...Jhansi... culture... mother Zeba made... these children, papa, mommy, the girl has grown up, poor thing... children... the cat's children... in the cat's box... wedding...

brh: توبہ کبو دا انتو پوتوک پٹہ زیرہ کنا ہنا۔ دا سہ ننا کہ اخس ہیت کننگ اٹی ہنان نومے سے خاص ہیت ئس پاو۔ روبینہ ئے
en: Heavens! What kind of ... is this ... Now, since we've been talking for so long, let me tell you one special thing: Rubina...

brh: اچھا دا پارہ کن بن گلت ئے دا لتہ نا کرین زبر خمر خہ چپلک دا وی دا باز بلو قصہ سے باز بلو قصہ سے اگر
en: Okay, this... listen, it's wrong... this... [garbled]... this is a very big story, a very big story, if...
en_old: Okay, say this... it's wrong... this was kicked... this is a very big story, a very big story, if...

brh: کسے شروع کرین نا تو سوب تموئے نم دنگ کنے گورے خیر داتنے کہ نن حوالات اٹ بند کرین ولدا نی سما تموئے کینتہ سے او صاحب صاحب صاحب صاحب نم دوزے صحیح
en: Once we start on someone, you'll find out the reason... Fine, once we lock you up in the lockup, then you'll find out what's what. Oh sir, sir, sir, sir, you (think I'm) the thief, right...
en_old: Whoever started it, you'll find out... Fine, once we've locked you up in the cell, then you'll find out... Oh sir, sir, sir, sir, you're lying, right...

brh: کاہ، چک اتہ کاہ، دتہ، اوانہ تو دے بند کتو، کاہ، بشہ، بشہ، اچکو دا دے کش، مرخاتے نا کش، او کش، بشہ، بشہ، سیدھا کاہ، کاہ، کاہ
en: Go, pull, bring (him), go... they've shut... go, get up, get up, pull this one out, pull out the chickens, pull that one out, get up, get up, go straight, go, go, go.
en_old: Go, go... they've shut the door, go, let go, let go, pull this one, pull the chickens, pull that one, let go, let go, straight ahead, go, go, go.

brh: حوالدار! جی سر! جی سر! سر! چاو غٹ کس کریس بسنس؟ سر! خانوا نتو تینا نوکری نا خلاف، کنا نوکری نا ہم رندٹ تمانو۔
en: Havaldar! Yes, sir! Yes, sir! Sir! Let me see, whom have you brought in? Sir! Khano, not only are you working against your own job, you've come after my job too.
en_old: Havaldar! Yes, sir! Yes, sir! Sir! Go on, who have you all brought in? Sir! Khan, you're not only working against your own job, you're after my job too.

brh: او چوکی، نہ نہ صاحب ئے اینو باز بلو غزل ئس کرینوٹ، ابا، سپاہی قربان، جی خواجہ، این مجھے حاضر کا، جی خواجہ، خواجہ واپس، سر پارے سا صاحب تولوک ئے ہن، جی سر، ہن
en: Oh, the police post... No, no, sir, today I've pulled off something tremendous. Dear, Constable Qurban! Yes, sir. Bring him before me. Yes, sir. Sir, back... The officer said the sahib is seated, go. Yes, sir, going.
en_old: Oh, the post... no, no, sir, today I've done a very big ghazal... father, Constable Qurban... yes, Khwaja... bring him before me... yes, Khwaja... Khwaja, back... sir said the sahib is sitting, go... yes, sir, go.

brh: مجرم ہی یا ملزم سر امو آتے مجرم مارے یا ملزم ارے سر خبر ہمو تیٹی مجرم ہموتم ارے کہ جرم مس کے دا تو چہ جرم مسکتنے دا ملزم ہی دا وقتا سر معذرت خواہ غلطی مرے تو ونے
en: Is he a criminal or an accused, sir? Are such people criminals or accused, sir? You see, among them someone is a criminal only when a crime has been committed; no crime has been committed here yet, so at this point he is an accused. Sir, I apologize if I made a mistake.
en_old: Is he a criminal or an accused, sir? Should we call them criminals or accused, sir? Look, someone is a criminal only once a crime has happened. No crime has happened here yet, so at this point he's an accused. Sir, I apologize if I made a mistake.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ سر دادے مجرم حاضر مس سر۔ بش مے۔ اچھا، صاحب آن پاننگٹے۔ جی۔ ئے آخائی۔ بش مے بو۔
en: Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you. Sir, here is the criminal, presented, sir. Get up. Okay, tell the sahib. Yes. ...no... Get up, all of you.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you. Sir, the criminal has been brought in, sir. Sit down. Okay, tell the sahib. Yes. ... Sit down.

brh: دا نا جوڑ متی؟ سر دا نا باز بلوچ جوڑ ماسی سر۔ دا دانہ پتونگ آکو سر۔ دا ٹیپورغہ او چاوٹک دے خوگوسر۔ اچھا جی سر۔ سر اندا توئی تے او اندا گرا تو وجہ انتو تینا وراغن نران تینا ضعیفہ ء دوکتسونے۔ سر دا اڑاہ دفعہ لکے۔
en: What is his crime? Sir, his is a very big crime, sir. He ... sir. He ... sir. All right, sir. Sir, it's like this, and the reason is this: he has pushed his own wife out of his own house. Sir, which section applies to him?
en_old: Is he well? Sir, he's very well, sir. This... sir. This... Okay, sir. Sir, the reason is that he cheated his old woman out of his house. Sir, this is the section...

brh: داڑا گرا دفعہ لگے ہمو دفعہ کہ داڑا لگے نی آک نیہ گڑا ہزار وار لگوئی، شاباش، سر نن تو قانون ننے عمل لگے سر، اندا خاطر تو قانون داڑے ریڈائی تیکننگے، اچھا سر، جی سر، ٹھیک ہی سر۔
en: Whatever section applies here, that section which applies here ... then it should be applied a thousand times. Well done. Sir, as for us, we have to act on the law, sir; that is why the law here is ... All right, sir. Yes, sir. That's fine, sir.
en_old: Whatever section applies here, the section that applies here, if you don't come then it will apply a thousand times. Well done, sir. For us the law applies and we act on it, sir; that's why the law is being... here. Okay sir, yes sir, all right sir.

brh: ارے تیا اللہ والی تولنگ کیو تولک مہربانی صاحب دا انت کہ بھاننگ اٹ ہنا بالکل راس پانے اٹ ہتی امان اللہ جی صاحب
en: Hey, come ... sit down, have a seat, please. Thank you, sahib. What is it that you are saying ... you have said it exactly right ... Amanullah ji, sahib.
en_old: Come, sit on it, sit like a godly man, please sir. What is this... in what you said, you said exactly right, Amanullah ji sir.

brh: نی دنکا تان خلکینس؟ اگر دا ہیت سئی ئے تو دا دن یلہ کینے۔ اگر دا ہیت غلط مس تو ولدا امبوٹا ننا ڈیوٹی ئے سر خلکیننگ کہ ہراس۔ او مسب سر۔ کنے سمایے؟ جی سر۔ نا کنے
en: Have you hit him like this? If this matter is true, then we let it go like this. If this matter turns out false, then again it is our duty, sir, to find out who did the hitting. Okay, sir. Understood? Yes, sir. Your ... me ...
en_old: Did you break his head? If this is true, then we will let it go like this. If this turns out to be false, then it's our duty to break their heads again. Okay sir. Do you understand? Yes sir. No, me...

brh: خلق ت کننگٹی ئے تقریبا سر۔ کہ موٹرسائیکل ک پٹرول ک پیسہ مرے او نا چائے راخ ک پیسہ۔ جی او سر۔ ٹھیک ئے نیناک دادم درتین تو۔ ئنا نا نا نا نا صاحب۔ خدائے ت من صاحب۔
en: People are doing it, more or less, sir, so that there's money for the motorcycle's petrol and money for your tea and such. Yes, sir. Fine, take this much for now, then. No, no, no, no, no, sahib. For God's sake, sahib.
en_old: People are doing it more or less, sir, so that there's money for motorcycle petrol and money for tea and such. Yes sir. Fine, take it for now then. My sir... For God's sake, sir.

brh: صاحب کنے دا تیتنا وار مونی تفس درت کنے مونی چپہ کتے سر پس بند کے کنے تخفتو صاحب ایڑے کنا خاص پکرر باز خطرناک او کنے لور گٹو کرور ولدا نہ گلبو نہ دوت تسور نہ بس کنا زند اینا تباہ مس
en: Sahib, this one ... me ... tied me up, took me, slapped me in the face, sir, then locked me up and kept me there, sahib. There it was very dangerous for me, and they choked me; then they gave me neither ... nor ... just like that my life was ruined.
en_old: Sir, three times he pushed me forward, shoved me ahead, sir, locked me up and kept me there, sir. That place of mine was very dangerous, and they beat me with sticks, and then nobody spoke, nobody lent a hand, nobody came. My life was ruined like this.

brh: بدر کنا خیالٹ لگیستام نا الے بے، نہ سر ئے تو تینا خسپر تے باز عزت کیوسہ بلکہ تینا اورائی تے باز عزت کیوسہ سر، و انتئے کہ او ننا نت تا کراغ جنت ء سر، مننک؟ جنت کیرے؟
en: ... in my view it seems ... your ... No, sir, I respect my brothers-in-law a great deal; rather, I respect my wife a great deal, sir, because paradise is beneath her feet, sir. Is that so? Where is paradise?
en_old: Badr, in my opinion... no sir, you should greatly respect your in-laws, and even more you should greatly respect your own household, sir, because paradise is beneath their feet, sir. Isn't it? Where is paradise?

brh: لمہ نا نت تا کیرغ مرے زئیفہ نا نت تا کیرغ مرے افک، سر، اندا توئی تے او کنا چناتا لمہ ئے لہذا اونا نت تا کیرغ نم جنت ئے ایندا وجہ نی عزت تے کیوا سر، جنت چنا کنے، چناتے کنے نیک افک، دبو دت، کلمہ
en: Is it beneath the mother's feet, or beneath the wife's feet? Sir, it's like this: she is the mother of my children, so paradise is beneath her feet too; that's why I respect her, sir. Paradise ... the children ... me, the children ... aren't good for me ... the kalima.
en_old: Is it beneath the mother's feet or beneath the wife's feet? No, sir. It's the same thing: she is the mother of my children, so paradise is beneath her feet, and that's why you should respect her, sir. Paradise... children for me, children aren't good for me... pray, the kalima.

brh: بشے یلہ کر کنے ننے تولفنے ننے کان ننتو اللہ خیر کے نن قربان بند کتے اف پتو کنے مف کان بند کتے یا اللہ خیر کے مولی صاحب مچے کان کان
en: Let go of me ... seat us ... may God make it well ... we ... Qurban ... locked up ... me ... locked up. O God, make it well, Maulvi sahib, everyone ...
en_old: Let go, let me, seat us down, God bless us, we haven't stopped the sacrifice, ... O God, have mercy, Maulvi sahib, everyone...

brh: بے بے بسنے وا اللہ خیر کے گل بے بے او ماشاءاللہ اوڑتو کیرے مائی سکینہ ہم بسنے ابابو ابابو نوبے اللہ
en: Bibi has come! Oh, may God keep it well, Gul Bibi! Oh, mashallah, who is with her? Mai Sakina has come too. Oh my, oh my ... God.
en_old: Bibi has come, God bless, Gul Bibi, oh mashallah, who is with her? Mai Sakina has come too. Father, father... God.

brh: ارے ابا تل بو تل بو بسم اللہ بسم اللہ تل بو انت حال جوڑ او صاحب ابا اللہ نا احسان ئے نم گودی جوڑ رے تکڑا رے خیریت رے
en: Oh dear, sit, sit, bismillah, bismillah, sit down. How are you, are you well, sahib? Dear, it's God's grace. Are you ladies well? Healthy? All fine?
en_old: Come, father, sit down, sit down, bismillah, bismillah, sit down. How are you, are you well, sir? Father, by God's grace. Are you all well, healthy, fine?

brh: گل بے بے اللہ خیر کے اینو دن مچے منجا منجا خننگسہ، امر منجا خننگ پک نی سما اف
en: Gul Bibi, may God keep all well, today you look rather sad, so sad. How could I not look sad? Don't you know?
en_old: Gul Bibi, God bless, why do you all look so troubled today? Why do you look so troubled, don't you know?

brh: شیر خان شار اینا نی اورا ایلا نی نرا اینا نی استاد تعویز نا کاریم کرے چپ بیڑے ارا تعویز شیر خان بس بس بس
en: Sher Khan went off to the city; he left the house, he ran away. Ustad, the amulet did its work ... quiet ... two amulets ... Sher Khan, enough, enough, enough.
en_old: Sher Khan, look, like this your house, like this your man... your teacher did the work of amulets, quiet... two amulets, Sher Khan, enough, enough, enough.

brh: جوان سائیں نی گڑا ننو تعویز ئس تے سستے جی کنا بابا
en: Fine, sir, then you give us an amulet, yes, my baba.
en_old: Good, sir, then give us an amulet too. Yes, my baba.

brh: مرے ئے کڑو کور مرے کہ پیرو نا باوا نرے کائے ہو ہندا خاطرا نی ہزار روپیہ الکوس اللہ سئی گواہ شاہد ئے ئے ہزار روپیہ التنوٹ او تو شارئے نا پارے ہمے کا پزور ئے
en: Let it be, even if ... blind, so that Piro's father ... goes, yes; that is exactly why you took a thousand rupees. God is truly my witness, I have not taken a thousand rupees. He is in the city ... said ... it's by force.
en_old: Let it be, even if it's bitter or blind, so that Piro's father comes back. That's why you took a thousand rupees. God is truly my witness, I gave a thousand rupees. He said, look at this, that's by force.

brh: ایٹ سیلوا جوان نی ہندا لالے چٹیک کہ ہیٹ ئس نی کیتیک اینو اسکان تو عید قربانی کتنے نی کہ ہیٹ ارا کاتیک سائیں نی پاننگٹی اٹی تک
en: ... fine, out of this same greed of yours, that you want a goat; to this day we haven't even done an Eid sacrifice, and two goats, sir, you're saying ...
en_old: Eight... good, you that dear one... that you would sacrifice a goat. Up to today you've done the Eid sacrifice, that you'd sacrifice two goats, sir, you're saying...

brh: کنا خفتو اولہ کنے تعویذ ئس تسوس او دے نرفیس خیرٹ ولے داسہ کنے تعویذ ئس ایتے کہ پیرو نا باوہ پدا خلقا برے نت کنے چاسہ کنا پن گل بے بے ئے خلق والا مچا کنے پارہ گلی
en: At first you gave me an amulet, and that day he ran off, well. But now give me an amulet so that Piro's father comes back to the village. You know me; my name is Gul Bibi; all the villagers call me Guli.
en_old: When I first went to sleep you gave me an amulet, that day... fine, but now give me an amulet so that Piro's father comes back to the people. Everyone knows me, my name is Gul Bibi, all the people call me Guli.

brh: ئے خڑس واری کٹ تاتی جی دیرے پاشا تاتی مگہ اینا لمہ نا ایڑوش کنے نی وار وار تاتی پاشا باغ کنے پاشو باغ کنے پاشو باغ کنے پاشو اول دا خیال کر کنے تاتی پاشو توبہ توبہ کر سائیں دے پاشو
en: I ... a ram ... auntie, yes, who is it, Pasha? Auntie, but she is this one's mother's sister ... you, again and again, auntie ... Pasho ... Pasho ... Pasho ... first think about this ... auntie ... repent, repent, sir ... Pasho.
en_old: ...a time... Tati, yes, where is Pasha, Tati, but this mother's sister... you, again and again, Tati, Pasha... first think about this, Tati, Pasha, repent, repent, sir...

brh: دا سے تو مرے نانی تعویز کاریم کپک آ گڑا جوانی ئے اسے تعویز سیتی ہنوم ئے شوئستس او دے گڑا کیرے انشاءاللہ
en: If that's how it is, that your amulet isn't working, then it's better ... one amulet ... and then that day ..., God willing.
en_old: If this happens, your amulet doesn't work; then it's better to make one amulet... I showed it, then where is it? God willing.

brh: ئے تو بوتہ جوان مروئی یا نی تعویزے لکھنگ اٹی ئس دا تعویز نا نمار کنے فینتہ، او تو شار ئنا نی دا تو نما مسئلہ ئے کنا مسئلہ ہفک نا، ہاؤ ہاؤ سہی ئے نی تعویزے تینا نی
en: Will it really get better, or are you just writing amulets? This amulet's ... me ... He is in the city ... this is your problem, it's not my problem. Yes, yes, all right, your amulet ... your own ...
en_old: It should get better, or are you writing amulets? The prayer of this amulet, look... this is your problem, not my problem. Yes, yes, right, your amulet is your own.

brh: نانو رینا ننے انت کروئی؟ دادے دیر ٹی کنے بٹی او مسن تنے ہیسے دیر ٹی کنے بٹی ہن سکینہ پٹ کنے
en: ... what should we do? Drop this into the water ... and ... drop it into the water. Go, Sakina, look for it.
en_old: Grandmother, what should we do now? Bring it to me in water... go, Sakina, open it for me.

brh: جوان سائیں ننے نت جوان اللہ سائیں خیر اینو ماکی یا اللہ خیر دادے کسر دانا پین سما مہربانی مہربانی
en: Fine, sir, it's good for us. O Lord, may it be well today ... O God, may it be well ... this path ... more about this ... Thank you, thank you.
en_old: Fine, sir, it's always good for us, thank God, all is well today... God willing it's fine, I don't know anything more about it. Thank you, thank you.

brh: ارے لوز
en: Hey, the words!
en_old: Hey, words...

brh: سے نی مچے دانگ اتہ برک ادا ٹوپے تینا کاٹم آ کتو نمسا حکم کس تا اڑے لوسی جی تمام اسٹوری نا خانہ خراب کریسک اڑے
en: Then you all came this way ... put this cap on your head ... at your command ... hey, Lusi ji, you've ruined the whole story, hey.
en_old: Then you came here with all of it and put this hat on your head... at your command... hey, Lusi ji, you've ruined the whole story, hey.

brh: لنڈا پاڈس ئے شیر خانے
en: Sher Khan has a ... part.
en_old: Landa Padas is Sher Khan.

brh: یار شکریہ جانداد خان بننگٹی ئے او جانداد ہاں داغ پدان یار کاریم کے ننگٹیوٹ بس شیر خان نا قصت بن بیب نا بس بیہ چہرہ سے
en: Thanks, friend. Jandad Khan is coming. Hey Jandad, yes, after this, friend, I am working ... just Sher Khan's fate ... just ... a face.
en_old: Thanks, friend, Jandad Khan is coming. O Jandad, yes, after that, friend, I was doing my work. Just Sher Khan's fate... just a face.

brh: بس دبئی نا شیر خان شاہ جلہ نرا برتک دبئی الفاؤ نی گدا کاریم تو اسینا اسے دے استو مرویس ارے
en: Just Sher Khan of Dubai ... came ... Dubai ... your work, then, ... one day ... will become ..., hey.
en_old: Just Dubai's Sher Khan Shah... he came from Dubai... over there your work, one day it will be...

brh: نی ہم زبات ہمہ نی ہم عجیب ہیت کیسہ اور گل بے بے کوننگا نیاڑی او حیات او سکندر کوننگا خاص پاو او ولدا پیرو کوننگا اگر اولاد مرے تو
en: You too ... you too say strange things. And Gul Bibi ... a woman, and Hayat and Sikandar ... especially ..., and then Piro ... if there are children, then ...
en_old: You say the same thing too, you also say strange things. And Gul Bibi, the woman they call... and Hayat and Sikandar, especially... and then old age, if there are children.

brh: دا بادی کے بندغ دا دنیا ہلی او بیچارہ شیر خان تو خالی ہلکے لانی نا گڑا دا سامر مروئی انت مروئی شیر خان نا جان چھٹا چیریٹی شاروالا چراتے
en: This ... a person ... this world ... and poor Sher Khan went away empty-handed ... then what will become of this ..., what will happen? Sher Khan's life ... the city people ...
en_old: This man from the village left this world, and poor Sher Khan left empty-handed. The things of the house... what will happen to this property, what will happen? Sher Khan's life...

brh: دے تون زئی پاتے تون زند نا دے ٹی خوشی ٹی گدریفک۔ ولے دا پا کہ اگہ شیر خان نا جاگہ ٹی اگر نی مسوسہ کا گڑا نی انت کریسہ؟ ئے تو ہمو نا ولے ئے ہنبر دنیائی لٹ۔
en: With ... and with ..., he passes the days of life in happiness. But tell me this: if you had been in Sher Khan's place, then what would you have done? I ... that one's ..., but I ... worldly ...
en_old: Spending the days in the sun and the nights in life, in happiness. But tell me, if you had been in Sher Khan's place, what would you have done? ...in this world.

brh: بیچارہ شیر خان توبہ سے اوکا ہلکے اللہ نا ڈاڈی۔ یار ایننگ تا تو سہی ئے دا نرنگ تا خراب ئے او ولدا دا عمر اٹی۔ او شکر کش شکر کش کہ نا براء متو گل بے بے تو۔
en: Poor Sher Khan, God forbid, God took him away. Friend, going is all right, but this running off of his is bad, and at this age too. Oh, give thanks, give thanks that your marriage with Gul Bibi didn't happen.
en_old: Poor Sher Khan, God help us, he left God's world. Friend, his coming was fine, but his running away is bad, and at this age too. Thank God, thank God that your wedding with Gul Bibi didn't happen.

brh: اوڑا اندا ایتاک شیر کانا جاگہ ہا دیکن پاننگارہ۔ یرا ئے اللہ نا اخہ شکر ادا کیو نی کم ئے کہ کنا برام گل بے بے تو متو۔ ہمم اوستی تو بائے تیز او۔
en: They're giving her like this, in Sher Khan's place, that's what they're saying. Friend, however much I thank God it is too little, that my marriage with Gul Bibi didn't happen. Hmm, she's very sharp, then.
en_old: On that they gave Sher Khan's place, that's what they're saying. Friend, how much should I thank God, you're lucky that my wedding with Gul Bibi didn't happen. Yes, and then off, quickly.

brh: شکر ک شکر کے شیر خان نا باوا انکار کرے نا قسمت زور ئس ادا جندات خان ادے تئیس پام نی ہا ادے تئیس خان گل بے بے نا وراغ افسوس کین۔ ہاؤ گنداوہ وختی کنے پاسا۔ بس اینے اخلام کے و گڑا کانے۔ ٹھیک ٹھیک ٹھیک ہی با ہاؤ او وختی گڑا کانے۔
en: Thank God, thank God that Sher Khan's father refused; your luck was strong. Here, Jandad Khan gave her away... pay attention, yes, Khan gave her away... we feel sorry for Gul Bibi. Yes, tell me early about Gandawah. Just let me... and then let's go. Okay, okay, okay, yes, yes, early, then let's go.
en_old: Thank God, thank God Sher Khan's father refused. Your luck was strong. Here, Jandad Khan... Khan, I'm sorry about Gul Bibi... Yes, Gandawah, tell me early. Just... and then I'll eat. Okay, okay, okay, yes, he'll eat early.

brh: اجازت ئے خواجہ، یاری کا وا ہمو مچے کاری مرے، چاس کنو، مہربانی مہربانی خوش مریس، ببو خیرٹ، تول، تول ببو خیرٹ، تول ببو
en: With your permission, Khwaja. Friend, I'm going, so that that bit of work gets done. Have some tea. Thank you, thank you. Stay happy. Welcome, sit, sit, welcome, sit, come in.
en_old: With your permission, Khwaja. Friend, may all that work get done again. Tea... thank you, thank you, be happy, go well. Sit, sit, go well. Sit, go.

brh: امر کریرے؟ اوہو ایڑ ہنت پاون، اسے اسے جاگہ، اسے اسے بندغ، اسے اسے گاڑی پٹان ولینا خنتونٹ، بلکہ اسے برخہ والا سے نی امر رفے؟
en: How did you all manage it? Oh-ho, sister, what can I tell you: we searched every single place, every single person, every single car, but I didn't see yours. So how did one woman in a burqa slip past you?
en_old: How did you manage it? Oh, brother, I'll tell you the truth: I searched every place, every person, every car, but didn't see him. So how did one woman in a burqa take you?

brh: او نا ہچو ڈس و نشان ئس متو۔ آن برقعہ والا۔ او برقعہ والا نیاڑی ئس اوڑنا رفیق۔ او پارے ئس بندغس دا کا دن نا راکے۔ او تو پوتونک ئس مسکے۔ آن برقعہ والا۔
en: There was no trace or sign of him at all. Ah, the one in the burqa. That woman in the burqa was his accomplice. He said a man like this... He just turned into a bundle. Ah, the one in the burqa.
en_old: There was no trace or sign of him. That one in the burqa. That woman in the burqa was his companion. He said a man like this... He disappeared. That one in the burqa.

brh: ننا ناری تو پوتونک ئس مس۔ اوہ۔ چپہ لمبے ناسس۔ اوہ۔ ابو کنکے او ایلم ہمو تو اسکہ پیرو نا باوے۔ اوئے نی ہن سمائی بس ایلم کنا بخت
en: Our woman too turned into a bundle. Oh. Hidden... a long nose. Oh. ...brother, that one was Piru's father. Hey, you stay alert. Just, brother, my luck.
en_old: Our woman disappeared. Oh. Quiet, with a long nose. Oh. Father, my... brother, he's the father of an old man. Go, you'll find out. Brother, my luck.

brh: امانی ئے پارٹ نمہ کل والا مرو رے والی خدا کا توک ئنا دوکس لوک نمیا اوہو ایو ننے آن سماج کے بخراٹے دیر اسے ننو دے سلام ہم کرنی ایڑ ہم پارنتا ولدا
en: Is everyone well? I said, may all of you be well... God... Oh-ho, you have cut us off from society; for a long time you haven't even greeted us, sister, and haven't said anything since.
en_old: Peace... all of you... God's... from us, society... for a while, our day... you didn't even greet us, brother, and didn't even say anything again.

brh: دا کنے نا گاڑی ٹی بٹن نا، گاڑی نا آخری سیٹ آ تولو کسو، بس، انتس کہ مس مس، دا سے نمہ مرکے زمانو مے، جی جی، گاڑی والا بٹ رے اوڑن سم
en: This one, in my car, sat on the last seat of the car, that's all. Whatever happened, happened... this was your time... Yes, yes, the driver dropped him off there...
en_old: This one, in my car... he sat on the last seat of the car, that's all. Whatever happened, happened. This was your time. Yes, yes, the car driver...

brh: اما تمنے کیا اراڑے او دڑنگا ئے نی بے ہمت ئے اونا نت دو تے تفے واتے او تن داڑے نہ نہ نہ نہ نت و دو نا تا تفنگ نا ضرورت اف اسے بیوقوفی استونم کرے رے خیرٹ دسپین بے
en: What happened to you, and where? He's scared, you're a coward. He tied his hands and feet... No, no, no, no, there's no need to tie his hands and feet. You've done something foolish. Go in peace...
en_old: Mother, what did they do to you here? He was trembling. You're a coward. His hands and feet were tied... no, no, no, no, there's no need to tie his hands and feet. You did something foolish. Go well...

brh: بے وقوفی کپبو، او نا سل ضرورت تمے بپ، بس کنا ایلو اسے کاریم ئس کبو۔ دا شوئے استے، دا دے امر کے مرے اسے وار ئس پیرو نا باوے کنے۔
en: Don't do anything foolish; there's no need for that at all. Just do me one other job. This... today, somehow, just once, get Piru's father to me.
en_old: Don't be silly, there's no need for that at all. Just do me one other favour. This is a show... today, somehow, just once, get Piru's father to me.

brh: او ولدا اور کہ اوتے نٹ دو دے غسل کا بریک۔ ایڑ دا تعویز اسے کے؟ ایلو ہندا مہربانی کا بس اسے وارا امر کے مرے نی دا تعویزے کنے فوئی ایتا۔ بس ایڑ دا سے نی بے غم مر نن چا نن نا کاریم چائس۔
en: And then, that he comes to wash their hands and feet. Sister, is this an amulet or what? Look, just do me this one kindness: just once, somehow, slip this amulet in for me. Just, sister, don't you worry about this; we know, we know our job.
en_old: He said again that they will come for the bath in two days. Where is this amulet? Look, just do me this one kindness: somehow get this amulet to me. Just look, don't you worry, we know our job.

brh: او مسس نا؟ او ایلو، تعویزے گوئی پیتس۔ ٹھیک ئے نی بے غم آ، برک، بر کان۔
en: Is it done? Oh look, he's put the amulet in. Okay, don't you worry. Come on, come, let's go.
en_old: Did he do it? Look, he put the amulet in his pocket. Okay, don't you worry. Come on, come out of there.

brh: ایلو میلو مبارک برینے! خیر مبارک، خیر مبارک۔ تول، پن غزس خلکونس۔ دا وار اسے بلو غازس کرینوٹ۔ اچھا؟
en: Hey there, congratulations! Thank you, thank you. Sit. Have you sung a ghazal? This time I've made a big ghazal. Really?
en_old: Hey Milo, welcome, congratulations! Thank you, thank you. So, have you sung a song? This time I've done a big song. Really?

brh: عمر، اسے بندغے پولیس نا ڈیوٹی ترفیٹ۔ ہند، چاوا غریب ئس نا اورایوش ئس نا ایلم نا، او اسے بلو مجرم اسس۔ نیاڑی۔
en: Umar, I had a man put on police duty. Here, I know he's your poor... your brother, but he is a big criminal. Woman.
en_old: Omar, a man has escaped from police custody. Here, he looks like some poor man, brother, but he is a big criminal. A woman.

brh: نا برقعہ ٹی شارے بسک ئے کوراٹ دا نیاڑی افک بلکہ نرینہ سے پولیس والا اشارہ کرے ٹمبلے درے چاوا پوسکونو مصیبت ئس پیدا کرے
en: In your burqa he came to town... I was blind: this is not a woman but a man. The policeman signalled and took... away. It seems he has created a new trouble.
en_old: In your burqa a man came from behind. This is not a woman but a man. The police officer signalled and took him away. Looks like he's created a new trouble.

brh: دا سؤٹل ولہ گبش مسورے نا۔ پین نا ایلم نا وجان دشمن دار مسون۔ او کنا ایلم، ئے کے توئے رخصت کریٹ، ولے اگر دا بننگ نا بندغاک بسور، نی تو الپیسہ کنے ہم دانگنگ کیروک۔ کنا ایلم، تو ننگا
en: These... have gotten worse, haven't they? Because of your brother we've made enemies. Oh my brother, I sent you off, but if those people come, you won't let me... either. My brother...
en_old: These... have got worse, haven't they? Your brother has made enemies because of this. He sent my brother off, but if those people come, you'd know they could kill me too. My brother is ours.

brh: بندغاک باز خطرناک مریرہ، بیوقوف کے نیوس۔ ایلم قانون نا کمک کننگ ننے آ فرض ئے بس۔ جی ہاں ایلم ئے پریشان کننگ ہم ننے آ فرض ئے ئے ئنا خاطرہ بسٹ کہ نی
