en: These people are very dangerous; you're being foolish. Brother, helping the law is our duty, that's all. Yes, brother, troubling you is also our duty; that's why I came, so that you...
en_old: These people are very dangerous, don't be foolish. Brother, it is our duty to help the law. Yes, brother, troubling you is also our duty, that's why I came, so that you...

brh: نی ئنا خوشخبریئے تو، گاڑی نمبر ء سلوک ء، ئے ئے ناٹ، خدا حافظ
en: You, your good news... the car number... goodbye.
en_old: Your good news... the car number... goodbye.

brh: خیر تو ارے نی داڑے انت کننگٹی ئس پیرو نا تو خیال ٹی افس؟ اینو تنیا دے پور کننگ
en: Is everything all right? What are you doing here? Aren't you thinking about Piru? Just passing the day alone today.
en_old: Is everything all right? What are you doing here? Isn't Piru's father on your mind? Today, to pass the day alone.

brh: نین کناس، دا پاشار والا بابوئی خناس یا خنتویس؟ بدلہ لنگوس نا؟ نہ، بدلہ لنگٹیا فٹ، ولے آک نا ایتے کننگٹیوٹ۔ ار دے کن تو نواریناس، اینو وطن یا ایناس؟ ار وخت؟
en: Did you see this Babu from the bazaar, or didn't you? Did you take revenge? No, I wasn't taking revenge, but I was doing those things of yours. How many days were you away? Did you go home today? At what time?
en_old: Did you see, did you see this market's Babu or not? Did you take revenge? No, I was going to take revenge, but they were doing yours... How many days were you away? Did you come home today? At what time?

brh: نی بسس کنے درستی بو کرنگ کے اینو نی بسس ئے تنے اینٹ ناراض مفہ نیتو ہم کاوہ ولدا کاسہ نیتو تو اینو ئے تمک گڑا کان کان
en: You came to make up with me today; since you've come, I won't be angry. I'll go with you too; then will you go? With you, then, today... then let's go, let's go.
en_old: You came to make up with me today. Now that you've come, I won't be upset with you. I'll go with you too, then... today... from where?

brh: بس ایٹ ننے باز افسوس مس، باز افسوس مس کہ شیر خان اگل کے اللہ نا ہرا۔ باز کل بیبی، انتس کہ اللہ نا رضا۔ نا نا داٹی اللہ نا
en: We were just very sorry, very sorry that Sher Khan met his death, God's... Very sorry, Gul Bibi; what can be done, it is God's will. In this, God's...
en_old: We were just very sorry, very sorry that Sher Khan... by God's will. Very... Bibi, what can be done, it is God's will. In this, God's...

brh: کنا رضا الو، دا ٹی صاف صاف پیرو نا باوا نا رضا اسکہ، کنا نی بے وس آتے دن اللہ ناروا ئنا اشارہ۔ آ کے بے وجات مس۔ ننا دو ٹی تمو۔
en: It wasn't my will; in this, plainly, it was Piru's father's will. My... you, the helpless ones like this, it's God's sign. That happened for no reason. It will fall into our hands.
en_old: My will... in this it is clearly Piru's father's will. My... the helpless ones like this, it's God's sign. ...it happened for no reason. It fell into our hands.

brh: منے کنا نی وجہ نا معلوم مرے، ہاں اگر دعا تما گڑا بس، ہا گڑا ایلو سکندر حیاتی گڑا پاتس کہ او پدوران تے خلیا، ہی پارے روٹ سکندر حیاتی، زو ئس نور شہر ہمت کین، بے دس بابا
en: ...the reason may become known. Yes, if the prayer is answered, then that's it. Yes, then the other one, Sikandar Hayati, said that he would strike the... He said... Sikandar Hayati, quickly... let's take courage, helpless father.
en_old: I don't know the reason. Yes, if the prayer is answered then that's it. Then Sikandar Hayati said that he would beat the... He said, Sikandar Hayati, quickly take courage for Noor Shahr, helpless father.

brh: دا غن ترو بے وس چوری تے امبارے اوئے جنوزانہ تے امبارو اوئے ایڈے اللہ کپ انتئے دنو ہیت کیسہ ہائے لمہ مکھ کے
en: These helpless orphans, how will they manage? Oh, the widows, how will they manage? Oh, God forbid! Why are you saying such things? Oh, mother...
en_old: These helpless... the thefts... why are you saying such things, God forbid. Oh mother...

brh: حیران اٹ، ہندا غار تے سنبھالے، پیروئے دا مسڑکوئے کنے دے سنبھالک۔ نہ، نہ، نی بے فکر مر، نن ہرین نا؟ آہ، ایلو۔۔۔
en: I'm at a loss. Who will look after these, who will look after Piru and this little girl for me? No, no, don't you worry, we're here, aren't we? Ah, look...
en_old: I'm surprised. Take care of these... Piru... take care of me. No, no, don't you worry, we're here, aren't we? Ah, look...

brh: واللہ نی تینا نیاڑی ئس افیس نرینہ سے ئس نرینہ۔ ہا خف کے مرے نیاڑی نیاڑی دعا کبو کہ اللہ خیر و خوشی اٹ پیرو نا باوے واپس آتے ارا غا
en: By God, you're not a woman, you're a man, a real man. Yes, whatever it may be, woman, woman, pray that God brings Piru's father back home safe and happy.
en_old: By God, you're not a woman, you're a man, a real man. Yes, whatever it may be, woman, woman, pray that God brings Piru's father back safe and happy.

brh: ہننگے وا ہندن کروڑ پتی زیوٹ لیکن
en: If I went, I'd become a millionaire just like that, but...
en_old: If I went, I'd be a millionaire like that, but...

brh: کن ہرایٹی ہلنا لٹکم نتیمہ فک
en: Me... in which... hanging... not...
en_old: For me, in which... hanging...

brh: دا دا گلہ شکوہ کپبو۔ اڑے تور خان! ایتو ئس بئیگی۔ ہاؤ ایلوم۔
en: Don't complain like this. Hey, Tor Khan! Give me the evening's (take). Yes, brother.
en_old: Don't complain like this. Hey Tor Khan! Bring the bag. Yes, brother.

brh: واقعی جوان و کار و مسخرہ نوری، کنا اینو استے نم خوش کریرے، نتو دا بیگاہ نی خراب خساس اینا ڈول لغہ خلکوٹے، اظہر خان
en: You really are good workers and jokers; you made my heart happy today. Otherwise, this evening you'd have been in a bad way, and I'd have kicked you like today, Azhar Khan.
en_old: You really are good workers and comedians. You made my heart happy today. Otherwise you were in bad shape this evening, and I would have kicked you tomorrow, Azhar Khan.

brh: استاخی معاف ئے نی آ کڑی بیغے بیوڑ خسٹ اوئے نما سہی ئے کہ دا پاپو پٹرول کے پیسے ٹویا تے فر نمے ازار خان مسمی لندک تریساتی گونتے ننا سا پیش تما مچٹ پیسے اتنا نی لاٹی پٹرول شاغین
en: Pardon my rudeness, I then ... (to) you ... Oh, you're right that this Pappu ... money for petrol; then, Azar Khan, ... you ... we came forward and brought all the money, and we'll put petrol in your vehicle.
en_old: Excuse my rudeness, you were going to be in trouble. You're right that this poor guy needs money for petrol. Azar Khan, ... we had to hand over all the money, and you put petrol in your vehicle.

brh: نن تینا منزلء سر مرین، آئی نو کہ نم ہزار خان نا استا خوش کرینورے، لیکن ہزار خان آن کس پنچ روپئی نا فائدہ خنتنے، لیکن اینو نم اینو پیسہ اتیورے، کنا استا نم خوش کریرے
en: We'll reach our destination. I know that you have made Hazar Khan's heart happy, but no one has ever seen even five rupees' worth of benefit from Hazar Khan. But today, today you brought money; you made my heart happy.
en_old: We've reached our destination. I know you made Hazar Khan's heart happy, but nobody has seen five rupees of benefit from Hazar Khan. But today you gave money, and you made my heart happy.

brh: ہیل بولا پٹرول نم شابو، ئے دا غم کمبو، ہمبو الہ ہنتس اورنگورے کنا مونٹی، ہزار خان
en: Come on, you pour in the petrol; don't fret over this. Look, come on ... come in front of me, Hazar Khan.
en_old: Go and put in the petrol, don't worry about this. Go and come in front of me, Hazar Khan.

brh: دا دوسد نی کنے تسس، داٹی تو تور خان نا بوٹاک پالش مفسے، کنے نی آ باز افسوس بننگے، پنا تو ہزار خانی کارم نا کڑچ ارا نئے او، ایلم فلحال دا تیار بو، تینا گزارہ ء کبو، ئے باز کڑز
en: These two hundred you gave me, with this not even Tor Khan's boots would get polished. I feel very sorry for you. ... Hazar Khan's work ... Brother, for now take this, make do with it; I have a lot of debt.
en_old: These two hundred you gave me won't even get Tor Khan's shoes polished. I feel very sorry for you. As for the name Hazar Khan's work... Brother, take this for now and get by on it, there's a lot of debt.

brh: پاوٹ دیف تینا کڑزاتی خلاص کیپ او کان پدی نن مالا مالون دازہ فی الحال اینبو اکڑ مکڑ دزبوں تینا ٹیمی پاس کبو وللہ خیر کے ئے چا موسم آزار خان ئے سئی پاوٹ
en: I'd say: first clear off your debts, after that we'll become rich. For now take (this), you chicken thieves, pass your time; God willing he'll make it good. ... Azar Khan, I'm telling the truth.
en_old: I said pay off your debts, and after that we'll... For now bring it, you petty thieves, get through your time. God willing it will be fine. What weather! Azar Khan spoke the truth.

brh: حارث کنتو طور خان ارے ککڑ مکڑ دزی نی نن تینا گزارہ ء کینے نی تینا قرضا تیت واللہ اورینا کانے ابا بردک کیت
en: Haris, Tor Khan is with me. Hey, by petty chicken theft we make our own living; you pay off your own debt. By God, we're going ...
en_old: Haris, Tor Khan is with me. You petty thief, we get by on our own. Pay off your debt, by God...

brh: باز جوانو چکرس لگا لیکن دا دزدا غمو دو سدے دے تپہ سے کنا گزارہ جوان مسنے
en: It was a very nice outing, but this thief ... two hundred ...; my living has turned out fine.
en_old: It was a very nice trip, but this thief gave only two hundred. Still, I'm getting by fine.

brh: ادا ناڑی سدا تا، ہن مسدا، ادا ناڑی سلام علیکم سلام علیکم، آن دے تحصیل مستونگ بس، ایلوم ئے دادے دزک کنے ہم پیسہ دریرک، نی دا کنے پا
en: Here ... hello, hello. ... came to Mastung Tehsil. Brother, these days thieves will take my money too. You tell me this.
en_old: Here... hello, hello. Today it came to Tehsil Mastung. Brother, this is a thief, he'll take my money too. You tell me this.

brh: تینا پیسہ غاتے کنے نلیسا یا بشخیسہ تا؟ دا ہمرہو ہیت اسے کہ پیسہ غاتے ہلیسا یا بشخیسہ۔ پنچ سال مست کنے مستا داسہ کنے پائیک بشخیفتہ یعنی؟ پیسہ غاتے دریرے اینو دزاک۔
en: Will you take your money from me or forgive it? It's the same thing, whether you take the money or forgive it. Five years have passed; now he's telling me, I mean, to forgive it? Thieves are taking the money these days.
en_old: Will you give me your money or will you share it? It's the same thing, whether you take the money or share it. Five years ago I was drunk, and now you're telling me to share it? Thieves are taking the money today.

brh: بشخفتائے او ہیت نا سئے دا پکن ایرنگ دے ننگٹ ہسنے نی اوراغ دیوے ایڑے نی کہ چاک کیوے ارخ کیوے خدمت نی کیوے پی نیارنگ دیوے دوزاک دریر پیساتے نی اوراغ دیسہ انت خدمت کروسے
en: Forgive it? That's the truth of the matter: ... the day has come for us ... you'd give to them; there I'd make you tea, make food, serve you ... Thieves take the money, and you give it to them; what service would you have done?
en_old: Will you share it? That's the point: the day comes when you give to them, you look after them, you take care of them, you serve them. Thieves are taking the money and you're handing it to them. What service did you ever do?

brh: کنا پین اللہ مرک ایو کنے آخیر آخ کنین خنس پٹین گڑا نا دوزاتم پٹین خنانی یا خنتونتا او پدنا ہیت سے ولا پدان سوچ خلینے حالی تو مہمان اسو دیر آخ تو
en: My ... God ... in the end we'll search; then we'll search for your thieves too. Whether we find them or not, that's a matter for later; by God, we'll think about it later. For now he's a guest ... water ...
en_old: My other... God knows. In the end I'll go looking for the thieves. Whether I find them or not, that's for later. Think about it later; for now he's a guest. How long will he stay?

brh: کنک سیرہ ارخ تو کن، ہلمہ کرینوس، پیسہ وتنی بشخ پیسہ، خدمت ام بس ئے کنے، کانہ مو دزات تو پٹین، یار کانہ ولے ارغ مرغ کن، اراغا کانہ ارغ مرغ کن، او کانے پد کانہ دزاتے پٹینہ، ارغ کننگ ء دننے ٹونڈنے
en: Eat your fill with me first; you've run around a lot. Never mind the money and sharing out the money; the service is enough for me. Let's go and search for the thieves. Friend, we'll go, but eat some food first; where would we go, eat some food. After that we'll go and search for the thieves; ... eating food ...
en_old: Do me a favour and look after him. You've done a lot already, the money, the share of the money, and your service too. Enough for me. Let's go and find those thieves. Come on, let's go, but take care of him first. After that we'll go and find the thieves. To take care of him, we have to search for them.

brh: شتے ننگے دنے ٹی افار نی پریشان مسنس یار ایلوم ایرا گلی ننتانکے ایرا کنگن دزاک ولائتے ولائت کے رکارے پیسوات کنے ولانتس نی تروٹ نی دا سہ ہمت کے کانک دزاتے ہلی نی
en: ... Why have you got so worried, friend, brother? Where will the thieves go, which street will they take? ... my money ... Now take courage; let's go and catch the thieves.
en_old: Don't worry, they won't get away. Why are you so worried, my friend? Our thieves won't go anywhere. They'll come back to the village, they'll come back for the money. You have to be brave. Let's go and catch the thieves.

brh: ٹھیک ہی دا، داسہ کاندوزاتے پٹے نلین، نی سلوئی افیس اشتہ فیس، سوار مکان داسہ۔
en: Alright then, now let's go and search for the thieves. You don't need to stay standing around; get on, let's go now.
en_old: Alright then, let's go look for the thieves now. You don't have to stay, you're tired. Get on now.

brh: بر تورخان بر بسوس؟ او شیر خان بسوٹ، نی دا پر کین سوچ خلنگوس؟ ئے دا سوچ خلنگوٹ کہ نن ازار خان کے دزی کرین
en: Come, Tor Khan, come. Have you come? Oh Sher Khan, I've come. What are you thinking about? I'm thinking that we should rob Hazar Khan.
en_old: Come, Tor Khan, have you come? Oh, Sher Khan has come. What are you thinking about? I was thinking that we should rob Hazar Khan.

brh: ہزار خان، ہزار پتی مس، لیکن ئے و نی ہمے وڑن، ننتو چار آنہ سلف، ئے دا سوچ خلوک اٹ، نی باز جوان و سوچس خلنگس، دوزی کینہ ئے و نی
en: Hazar Khan has become a man of thousands, but you and I are just the same; not even four annas stay with us. That's what I was thinking. You're thinking a very good thought. Let's do a theft, you and I.
en_old: Hazar Khan has become a millionaire, but you and I are still the same. We don't even have four annas. That's what I was thinking. You're thinking a very good thought. Let's rob him, you and I.

brh: جی کنا تازہ خان نا کنا گڈان فائدہ مس دا کڑی نصیب نا ہیتے بلا بلا شکار کے بریک او نا دو لگک کنا اونا نصیبٹ صرف فارمیا ککڑ
en: Yes, ... Taza Khan ... there was profit from ... It's really a matter of luck: big, big prey comes and falls into his hands, while in my luck there are only farm chickens.
en_old: Yes, my Tazah Khan, I got some benefit out of it. It's a matter of luck. Big prey comes along and falls into his hands, but my luck only gets me farm chickens.

brh: کوڑی دا سا دوں کروئی نیکہ نی شکار پٹوئے تینا زندگی تینٹ سیٹ کروئی ہزار خان ننے ئتو سو روپئیز روادارفک دا وارہ خبرے نی ایدام کرے بے پچ مسونن ارمانی عید کپے واقعی ایونی دا وار نا
en: So now we have to do it this way: you have to seek out prey and set up your life by yourself. Hazar Khan isn't even willing to spare us a hundred rupees. This time, you know, on Eid we were broke; sadly, we couldn't celebrate Eid, really, you and I, this time.
en_old: Now we have to do something like that. You have to find a big target and set your life up yourself. Hazar Khan wouldn't even spare us a hundred rupees. You know, this time we were broke. Sadly, we really couldn't celebrate Eid this time.

brh: نا بے پچ مسونے دا ئے تو ہندا وجہ غان عید نماز ہم نتوی نا کرے دماغ تولنگفک عید نمازے توار خواننگٹ اسون ہاؤ ہاؤ طور خان سئی پاسے اوار نماز خوانان بے پیسے
en: You were broke; this is the very reason I didn't even do the Eid prayer: my mind wouldn't settle. We were reciting the Eid prayer aloud. Yes, yes, Tor Khan, you're right; let's pray together, without money.
en_old: You were broke, and that's exactly why you didn't even offer the Eid prayer. My mind wasn't settled. We were going to offer the Eid prayer. Yes, yes, Tor Khan, you're right, let's pray together, without money.

brh: آئی دماغ نا مچے کارم الانے۔ خان تینا شکارس پٹے، اور ہزار خان نا خفام خلپیس دایتی۔ بالکل سئی پاننگوس۔ خان شکارس پٹے، تینا زندگیئے سیٹ کے۔ نی خبر افک، دز نا وختہ زندگی سیٹ مسونے کہ داسہ مرو۔
en: The mind isn't working at all. Khan, let's find ourselves some prey, and don't let it reach Hazar Khan's ears. You're saying absolutely right: Khan should find some prey and set up his life. Don't you know? It's thieves whose lives have got set up these days, so now let it happen.
en_old: His mind is completely occupied with work. Khan should find himself a target, and Hazar Khan won't even notice. You're absolutely right. Khan should find a target and set up his life. Don't you know, people's lives get set up through robbery these days?

brh: عمرک واقعی سئی پاسے دز نا بنگلہ کس خنتنے لیکن اوستے اوست پائے کہ بنگلس خنیو نئے خبر ننا وزیر چٹ کرے دزوری جہانگیر کرے وزیر صاحب اور بھلو دز سے او کرے ملک نا کلے پیسہ تے کننگے
en: You're really right. No one has ever seen a thief with a bungalow, but still the heart keeps saying, 'let me see a bungalow.' Don't you know? Our ministers are all thieves. Jahangir, the minister sahib, is an even bigger thief; he is eating up all of the country's money.
en_old: Umar is really right. Has anyone seen a thief with a bungalow? Even so, he says, 'Show me a bungalow.' Don't you know that our minister has ruined everything? Jahangir committed robbery. The minister sahib is also a big thief. He took all the country's money.

brh: او نال بنگلہ خننگک۔ جہانگیر نا کیرے پیر نا بنگلہ اف او سرکاری ئے او بلو بلو کار روڈ آ کونی رے۔ ئے و نی ککڑ دز ون، نن وارا کا بلڈنگس خلنگ کینے؟ نا ئے تکیلوں سہی او، اگر دا مہنگائی مفروسس نن ہم دز متوانے۔ مہنگائی نا بلا تما، نن اونا دو
en: (Look at) his bungalow. That house of Jahangir's isn't his grandfather's bungalow, it's government property, and big, big cars are (standing) on the road. You and I are chicken thieves; when could we ever put up a building? Yes, you're right. If this inflation hadn't been, we wouldn't have become thieves either. Damn this inflation; we ... in its hands ...
en_old: He's seen a bungalow. That house of Jahangir's isn't his ancestral bungalow; it's government property, and big cars are standing on the road. You and I are chicken thieves. When will we ever build a building? You're right. If it weren't for this inflation, we wouldn't have become thieves either. Damn this inflation, it got the better of us.

brh: او خوارن، ننا زر خان ہردے ٹنٹک ئے دا غلتی آ کسر آ ٹنینگن۔ مہنگائی متیو کے ایونی ہم دزی کتیو نی دا سیلوم بلو دو ئس خلینے، اوک پد کرے دزی آ توبہ کینے، تور خان، خنیسے ننا ملک نا وزیر آتے۔
en: We're wretched. Our money ... every day, and we ... down this wrong road. If there were no inflation, you and I wouldn't commit theft either. Now, brother, this time let's pull off one big job, and after that we'll repent of theft. Tor Khan, do you see our country's ministers?
en_old: He's miserable. Our Zar Khan keeps falling every day onto this wrong path. If there were no inflation, I wouldn't have stolen either. This time we'll pull off one big job, and after that we'll repent of stealing. Tor Khan, look at our country's ministers.

brh: کل ملک لوٹیرے دزے کنیرے اوفتہ پنی اسہ کس سلپک ئے او نی ککڑ دزانی یا دزیتان آن پورا جہان ٹی ئے او نی ٹک آن ننا اوفتے تواجے تفوکر بلو دزو نی وتینی اوفتے تو برابر کیسہ۔ شکرے گڑاس وزیر ارے ایماندار او او اوفتہ وجہان تو دا
en: They loot the whole country and commit theft, and not a single person stands in their way. You and I are chicken thieves, ... in the whole world; you and I are small fry compared with them; they are big thieves; how can you compare yourself to them? Thank God some ministers are honest, and because of them this
en_old: They loot the whole country and commit robbery, and nobody stops them. You and I are only chicken thieves, the smallest thieves in the world. Compared to the big thieves, you're nothing. How can you compare yourself to them? Thank God there are some honest ministers. Because of them,

brh: دا ملک چلنگی؟ ہاؤ ایلم ہاؤ۔ ننا ملک اٹ کرے ایماندار وزیر بازے۔ کنے تو خوف ئے ننا ہزار خان وزیر ئس مف۔ دا تو ملک ئے چٹ کے کونے۔ دعا کر کہ ننا ہزار خان کرے وزیر ئس مف۔ ہاؤ ہاؤ ایلم۔ الا دا ایتا تے کانیڑے تے نا روزگار ئس کین۔
en: country keeps running. Yes, brother, yes. In our country there are plenty of honest ministers. I'm afraid our Hazar Khan might become a minister; he'd eat up the whole country. Pray that our Hazar Khan never becomes a minister. Yes, yes, brother. Come on, let's go there and earn some livelihood.
en_old: this country keeps running? Yes, brother, yes. Our country has plenty of honest ministers. I'm afraid our Hazar Khan will become a minister. He'd wreck the country. Pray that our Hazar Khan never becomes a minister. Yes, yes, brother. Come on, let's go take care of these guys' business.

brh: ادا خیری؟ ہاؤ ایلم خیری خیری، اسلہ بننگ اٹ۔
en: Is all well here? Yes, brother, all well, all well; I'm just coming along.
en_old: Is everything alright here? Yes, brother, all good, all good, just getting by.

brh: ایلوم ئے دادے نن کرے مفلسی نا ہلوک اٹی
en: Brother, these days we are really in the grip of poverty.
en_old: Brother, these days we've been taken over by poverty.

brh: دا موٹر سائیکل ئے اتسہ ننے یعنی ننتو جنگ کیسی۔ اسو ہنو سلاٹھ مخلوق پولی رے۔ ایلوم نی انتس کے سمجھس۔ ادا ئے جوان سمجھو نو ایتوٹے۔
en: Will you give us this motorcycle, or, I mean, will you fight with us? Go on ... there are people ... Brother, what did you understand? Here, understand properly and give it over.
en_old: Take this motorcycle from us, I mean, don't fight with us. Go on, people are around. Brother, what did you understand? Understand this properly, give it here.

brh: لنگڑی نا پڈٹی خلسا لنگڑی۔ پنجا پنجا روپئی تھینوم ایمبو۔ جاگہ استول بو پکوڑا رکھبو مونی۔ اور شرافت اٹ دا کسراٹ اینا البو ایمبو۔ پنجا اور سد نا ایتف۔ موٹرسائیکل نا نیت۔ اندا کسراٹ نس اندا اینک۔
en: Poverty piled on poverty, beating us down. Come on, we'll take fifty rupees each. Put a stool at the spot and set the pakoras out in front. And politely take [it] from whoever goes along this road. [Whoever] doesn't give fifty or a hundred... the motorcycle's... on this very road... this very...
en_old: The lame one fell on the lame one. We'll give five rupees each. Put a chair in place and set the pakoras in front. And politely, on this road we'll take... Don't give five or a hundred. The motorcycle's... on this very road...

brh: ئے کدا ایرا کسرٹ بسونٹ ہمو کسرٹ الے کا نوم دا ہمو موٹر سائیکل ئے دا موٹر سائیکل ئے کشی
en: I... by whichever road I came, I'll take that same road and go. This is that motorcycle, pull this motorcycle out.
en_old: Go back the way you came, take that road; this motorcycle, pull this motorcycle away.

brh: نادان مچار، دز آتہ خلیسئے، نی باز غلط کننگ اٹی ئس نن تو پنگا ہلنگ اٹی ئس ارے نم کونا دز آتہ دوا، شت ہی شت، شکر کرو بندغ اسے دز آتہ خلیسئے، ئے تو پدوا سٹ
en: You foolish mosquito, you beat up the thieves! You're doing something very wrong, you're picking a fight with us. Hey, you... the thieves... stick after stick. Thank God a man beat up the thieves; I was right behind.
en_old: You foolish mosquito, you beat up the thieves, you're making a big mistake picking a fight with us. Hey, give me my thieves... quiet, quiet, thank goodness, a man beat up the thieves...

brh: ارے نی ہزار خان نا بندغاتے خلیسے نی ہزار خان نا بندغاسے
en: Hey, you beat up Hazar Khan's men! You [beat] a man of Hazar Khan's!
en_old: Hey, you beat up Hazar Khan's men? Are you Hazar Khan's man?

brh: تور خان بشے او اورنگ کے داننے امر خالق
en: Tor Khan, Bashe and Aurang... how did [he] beat them like this?
en_old: Tor Khan, Bashe and Aurang... how did they beat us?

brh: دا سہ؟ نن شیر آنبار سلوک آن نن ارے نی ننے امر خلیسے۔ اڑے لچاک، دا سہ ابو کہ ئے نمے امر خلیو۔ نوم پارے۔
en: Now? We were standing like lions, hey, how did you beat us? Hey, scoundrels, now this is how I beat you, since you asked.
en_old: What is this? We are like lions, how did you beat us? Hey, you scoundrels, this is why I beat you. Tell me your names.

brh: ہم شیر امبار سلوک او کنا نظر ٹی نو شیر امبار سلوک افیرے شوک امبار سلوک او رے اڑے لچک دا پاوی آئندہ اوزی ہتھو بکیرا ہا
en: You stand like lions too? In my eyes you don't stand like lions, you stand like foxes. Hey, scoundrels, I'm telling you this: in future, no more stealing, okay?
en_old: You're like lions too, but in my eyes you're not like lions, you're like jackals. Hey, scoundrels, remember this: don't fall into my hands again, okay?

brh: ایلوم، پاہ کہ دا مہنگائی ارے، دوزی انتو بہ کپنے؟ اڑے، دا مہنگائی کل نا زیاٹی، اوڑا کل بش مریر دوزی کیر۔ ہر کس تو کیرے، او تو دوزی کپک۔ کسہ تو اف دا مہنگائی اوڑ کنے او دوزی کیک۔ انت نی عادت مئے؟
en: Brother, [people] say there's all this inflation, so why shouldn't [one] steal? Hey, this inflation is on everyone; does everyone get up and steal? Everyone else gets by, and they don't steal. It's not as if this inflation is only on him, so that he steals. What, has it become your habit?
en_old: Brother, tell me, there's all this inflation, so why wouldn't one steal? Hey, this inflation is on everyone, does everyone become a thief? Everyone else works, they don't steal. It's not as if the inflation is only on him so that he steals. What, have you made it a habit?

brh: ارے او سورخان! ارانگ نرویس بر موٹرسائیکل اٹ دا؟ چلو خدا خیر کے او تینا تینا موٹرسائیکل اٹ دے۔
en: Hey, Sur Khan! Where are you running off to? Come, on this motorcycle. Okay, God keep you safe; he's off on his own motorcycle.
en_old: Hey, Sur Khan! Where are you going, come on the motorcycle? Okay, God bless, he's going on his own motorcycle.

brh: جوان مس دا خانہ خراب
en: Good, that worked out, the damned wretch.
en_old: Well, that turned out fine, damn it.

brh: بنا سوسائٹی نا کشا
en: Over by the side of the society...
en_old: At the edge of the society.

brh: ہن خالی دے گڑا نا
en: Go, just give [it] then.
en_old: Go, just give the thing.

brh: ازار خان، ازار خان، ہن بلا خلک نی چڑا ازار خان ازار خان پین عید بفک نی ازار خان، ازار خان، بلا
en: Azar Khan, Azar Khan, go, disaster has struck you... Azar Khan, Azar Khan, you won't see another Eid, Azar Khan, Azar Khan, disaster!
en_old: Hazar Khan, Hazar Khan, go, disaster has struck, you... Hazar Khan, Hazar Khan, there won't be another Eid, Hazar Khan, Hazar Khan, disaster!

brh: سینا مولا بسٹ ہن مزنے آغر خان آباد آغر خان اینو ظالم سینا ڈیوٹی بسون ننا تو بیخی گشا سدھا سدھا ایٹکے ہنا بارہ بوری مرے فیٹ یانا بیخ نا پیشت مونی
en: ...has come, go, big man, Aghar Khan... Aghar Khan, today, you tyrant, your duty has come; for us completely... straight, straight... twelve sacks... behind and in front.
en_old: Your master has come, go, big one, Aghar Khan Abad, Aghar Khan, today, you tyrant, your duty has come; for us it's completely... give it straight, straight, go, twelve sacks... in front and behind...

brh: ہزار خان اسو عارف پی اسو عارف پی نیکو راں خلے دونا لشنگو زلائلو اڑے نارنگین سے ہمار پانے مونی مونا کنا بلاس بس سے ہمارے ہمو بلا کوم چاواکے نی تو
en: Hazar Khan, there was an Arif... an Arif... hey... in front of me a disaster came... that disaster, you don't know it.
en_old: Hazar Khan, one Arif... hey, go ahead in front, a disaster came to me ahead... that disaster, you don't know it.

brh: توفک ء ہنا کما بلا ء کسیف الپیس کنا یار ہم کونیک ئس کنا پائے دا برمبوریٹ دانگنگ چمنی لیکن ئس مف ئس کنا ازار خان ہمو نیکی توستندپے یکانیکے چولے دوزا کائیسکپ خان بچفتے
en: The gun... go, my disaster... my friend too was telling me... but it didn't happen... my Azar Khan, that kindness... the thieves... the Khan saved [him]...
en_old: The gun, go, my disaster... my friend too was saying to me... but it didn't happen, my Hazar Khan, that kindness... the thieves... Khan, save us.

brh: کان رائی مر رائی مگان ایوفتہ سلیکہ شف ہمت کر اندا توفک اٹ ٹکر ٹکر کر دشمناتے بر رائی مر بر رائی مگان دا توفک ئے داڑے تخیوے
en: Go, get moving, get moving... have courage, smash the enemies to pieces with this very gun. Come, get moving, come, get moving. I'll put this gun here.
en_old: Stand up, don't give up, have courage, smash the enemies to pieces with this very gun. Come on, stand up, don't give up. Keep this gun here.

brh: اظہر خان! دا امر کریسے تفوکے داڑے تخاس؟ تفوک ایلے، سادے، ئے دو اٹوفتہ پڈے اریوے، خان!
en: Azhar Khan! What have you done, keeping [me] tied up here? Untie [me]... my hands are tied behind my back, Khan!
en_old: Azhar Khan! How did you do this, leaving him tied up here? Untie him, quickly, his hands are tied behind his back, Khan!

brh: مظہر خان
en: Mazhar Khan!
en_old: Mazhar Khan

brh: خیر ئے رنگ افینوس دا دوز آ تا سہی شام آٹی دا ایلوم کیرے کنا قرض دار اسہ کے دبئی آن پوسکن بس کنگے پیسہ اتنگاٹی اسہ کے کسر آ بننگا اسہ کے دوز آک مورسنگلا کیرے بیگے دے پھلار
en: Well, ... these thieves do this morning and evening, brother. A debtor of mine had just come back from Dubai and was bringing me money; he was coming along the road, and the thieves ... snatched his bag.
en_old: Well, you have no shame... these thieves do this morning and evening, brother. One of my debtors came back new from Dubai and was coming to repay me, and on the way the thieves robbed him and took his bag...

brh: دا تو بلو ظلمس کرینو۔ بلو ظلمس کرینو کنے ہم پیسات پھلانو درینو۔ دا پا دزے خنس درست کیس کہ پیستے۔ خنت کنا تفم درست کے وتے۔ دزے کہ درست کیس او مشکل نا دو انکائے۔ دز کے نا دو۔
en: They've committed a real outrage. A real outrage; they've robbed me too and taken the money. Tell me this: if you see the thief, will you recognize him or not? If I see him, I'll recognize him myself. If you recognize the thief, he'll be in trouble. The thief [will be] in your hands.
en_old: He has done a great wrong. He has done a great wrong; he stole my money too. Tell this thief, recognize who the thief is. Look, recognize my... The thief you recognize will be in trouble. Thief, your hand.

brh: دے برے دا لٹٹ او دے مریفے کنا مندا پانے اسہ وار دزدنا دوٹی برے گڑا اونا انجامے نی تینٹ خنوس ایلم بے گتو ایندرے دا گڈرسس او دے مرارک
en: The day will come... this loot... Let me tell you, once the thief falls into [my] hands, then you'll see his fate for yourself. Brother, without fail...
en_old: Bring him here. Tell him that once he falls into the thief's hands, you'll see his end for yourself. Brother, without fail... he will be...

brh: ایلم نی او غم کپہ او دوز کنا نت تے بس نن اونا علاج تینٹ کینہ ایلم دوز کرے جوان و کاریم ئس کتنے کنے پلانے اڈے دا وادے رسی
en: Brother, don't you worry about that; once that thief comes under my feet, we'll deal with him ourselves. Brother, the thief did it; he hasn't done a good deed, he robbed me... here, this... has reached [him].
en_old: Brother, don't worry about that. The thief came to my feet, and we'll deal with him ourselves. Brother, the thief did a good thing, he didn't do anything wrong. He told me... this reached...

brh: کسپئی ئنا دے درست کننگٹوٹ۔ شاید سنگت ئس نا مرو درست کننگ اسے۔ ئے لنمے درست کپرے، نم دیرورے۔ دا ڈن تس کننگورے۔ نی تو ننے درست کپیسے، دا سئی نی درست کریٹ۔ نی کنے درست کیسی ئے دیروٹ؟ نی ہمو دز افس؟
en: I'm recognizing someone of yours. Maybe it's a friend of yours; I recognize one. I don't recognize you; who are you? What are you doing like this? You don't recognize us, but this one you recognized? Do you recognize me, who I am? Aren't you that thief?
en_old: I couldn't recognize anyone. Maybe a friend of yours would recognize him. I won't recognize... you brought him. You don't recognize us, but you recognized this one correctly. Do you recognize me, the one I brought? Are you that thief?

brh: کنا بیگ ء پلاس دریس۔ انپاسہ ایلم، جوانپاہ وا ایلم، دز زنا دے، خنتنا جوان پٹے ارک، دن کسے نا کسے ٹہلوس، گناہ گار مروس، دز زنا دے۔
en: You robbed me and took my bag. What are you saying, brother? Speak properly, brother... the thief... look, he seems a decent sort. Accusing someone like this, you'll become a sinner... the thief...
en_old: You stole my bag. What are you saying, brother? Speak properly, brother, the thief... He looks fine. This way you cheat people, you'll become a sinner, thief.

brh: ایتنے گناہ گار کپرے دا دز کنا ئنا دے ئے سچی پاپرے تنے گناہ گار کپرے ادا نی تنے گناہ گار کنے گھٹیؤس دزی افٹ ئے اسے کھرے خاندان و بندغ اسوٹ نی خاندان و بندغ ئس مسوسے نا پیشانیا خیدک چوٹ
en: Don't make yourselves sinners... this thief... tell the truth, don't make yourselves sinners. Here you are making yourself a sinner... I'm not a thief; I'm a man from a respectable family. You may be a family man, but sweat is dripping from your forehead.
en_old: Don't make me a sinner. This thief... won't tell the truth. Don't make yourself a sinner. I'm not a thief; I'm a man from a good family. You're a man from a family too, but sweat has broken out on your forehead.

brh: دے تو سے کنا دا واجہ خیدک برے ئے اڑیناٹ باغٹی اچانک دوشس خران نراٹ نی اڑے دا بلا بوتہ تو دوشاسے آن خولیسے ولا نرسے ایلوم لیاسیکے دوشے خن نام خیدک بریرے ایلوم ننداڑے ہزارہ دوشات خرانن نن اینو ئس کنا نرتنن نی لغورسس نرسے دوشاسے آن اڑے نی دا
en: Look, sir, [why] the sweat is coming: I was in the garden, suddenly a snake [appeared] and I ran. You, hey, what a calamity, you got scared of a snake and ran? Brother, ... seeing a snake brings on sweat? Brother, we've seen thousands of snakes around here; we've never run... you're a coward, you ran from a snake, hey, you...
en_old: My gentleman here is sweating. I was sitting in the garden when suddenly I saw something and ran. You sat... then you'd run from it, ran again. Brother, look, he's sweating. Brother, we've seen thousands like this here. Today you ran from me, you're lying, you ran...

brh: سدھا پا، نی مرشدے ریفک، یا بے مرشدے لونڈی سیوس، ننے اللہ مرشد تسنے، ئے تھوڑی لونڈی سیوٹ، اگر مرشد والا سیوس، سدھا پا، دزی کرینوس کتے نوس، اگر مرشد نا تینا زیادہ رستھڑے، لکھاں پنی سے خنگ نی سٹیرے
en: Tell me straight: do you have a murshid, or are you a hooligan without a murshid? God has given us a murshid; am I some hooligan? If you are a man with a murshid, tell me straight: did you steal or not? If your faith in your murshid is strong... lakhs...
en_old: Tell me straight: do you have a murshid, or are you a slave with no murshid? God has given us a murshid; I'm a humble servant. If you have a murshid, tell me straight, did you steal or not? If you have strong faith in your murshid... lakhs...

brh: بلکل کنے مرشد ارے لیکن ئے دزی اسو کتنٹ۔ اگر مرشد والا اسوس نی مرشد نا واسطے سچ سچ پا دزی کرینوس یا کتنوس۔ اگر نی دزی کرینوس واللہ
en: Of course I have a murshid, but I didn't steal anything. If you are a man with a murshid, for your murshid's sake tell the whole truth: did you steal or not? If you stole, by God...
en_old: Of course I have a murshid, but I didn't steal. If you have a murshid, tell me truthfully, for the sake of your murshid, whether you stole or not. If you stole, by God...

brh: منہ نی ننا مرشد نا صدقہ اٹ معاف کنے نتے دا شتٹ منہ فنی نی ایلم ئے خاندان نا بندغ اسے اٹ تینا گناہ گار کپہ بو کنے دز پاپہ بو کنے دز اسل پاپہ بو ایلم دادے ہما مرشد
en: ...you, for the sake of our murshid, forgive me... Brother, I'm a man of a [good] family. Don't make yourselves sinners, don't call me a thief, never call me a thief. Brother, this... which murshid...
en_old: Forgive me for the sake of our murshid... Brother, I'm a man from a good family. Don't make yourself a sinner, don't call me a thief, never call me a thief. Brother, this murshid...

brh: شکار از بننگے نواکھے لگے
en: Some prey is coming; he seems new [here].
en_old: A target is coming, looks like a new one.

brh: ئے لوم غرانگ ایننگس، ئے لوم ایننگا پٹ، ئے تو پئی ام پوسکم بننگا چوٹ
en: Hey brother, where are you going? Brother, I'm going ... [unclear]. Hey, so ... I'm new too, just arriving.
en_old: Brother, he's crying, brother, look behind, a new one is coming.

brh: ہو دبئی ہم بننگوس؟ او ادا او دبئی ہم بننگٹیوٹ۔ ایلم گڑا اینا ہن خدمت ئس کننگ کے وی بس ایلم بس ئے خدمت نا لائق ئس
en: Yes, are you coming from Dubai? Yes, here, I'm coming from Dubai. Brother, then can I do you some service? Just, brother, just one thing worthy of a favour.
en_old: Yes, are you coming from Dubai too? Yes, I'm coming from here, from Dubai. Brother, then can I do you some service? Brother, you truly deserve to be served.

brh: کنے مزار خان نا ڈسے تتے اراڑے کنے مزار خان وپاری نا پاننگوس ہاؤ ایلم ہاؤ وپاری نا پاننگوٹ ایلم منا کسرے ہلکنوس ہنا کسرٹ سدا ہیناک اڑے انتئے کے مزار
en: Give me Mazar Khan's address — where is it? You're asking me about Mazar Khan the trader? Yes brother, yes, I'm asking about the trader. Brother, take the road in front, go straight along that road, hey, why... Mazar—
en_old: Give me Mazar Khan's address, where is Mazar Khan? I'm asking about the merchant. Yes brother, I'm asking about the merchant. Brother, take this road, go straight down that road over there, why Mazar...

brh: مانی چنا چنا چائیک ایلم نا باز باز مہربانی کنے مزار خان نا دست تسس ادا بریدین ایلم نا خدمت ئس کیو شام ئس کن دو مر ولے
en: [Him?] Every little child knows him. Brother, thank you very, very much, you gave me Mazar Khan's address. Come here, brother, let me do you a service — spend an evening with me, at least.
en_old: Look, the children... Brother, thank you very much, you gave me Mazar Khan's address. Come here, brother, let me do you a favour, for an evening, but...

brh: آئین مزار خان نا، ایلم، نا باز باز مہربانی نی مزار خان نا کنے ڈس آتے سس، نا باز مہربانی، ایلم کنے مزار خان نا ڈس آتے سس، او پاکاں کنے ار خدمت کرے سس، ئے ایلم خیرے آن کنے
en: [Unclear] Mazar Khan's... brother, thank you very, very much, you gave me Mazar Khan's address, thank you very much; brother, you gave me Mazar Khan's address and you did me a service. Hey brother, it's nothing... [unclear].
en_old: Amen. Brother, thank you very much, you gave me Mazar Khan's address, thank you very much. Brother, you gave me Mazar Khan's address, and you did me a kindness, brother, may goodness be with you...

brh: باری مستمان مانے مزار خان تو ایلوم کنے آ مزار خان نا بھلو احسان اسے کنے بیست و ہفت میشتس سودا کرٹ تا اینار دبئی آ کاروبار کے اونا مہربانی
en: [Unclear] with Mazar Khan, brother — Mazar Khan has done me a great kindness. He did a deal of twenty-seven [unclear] for me; that today I do business in Dubai is thanks to his kindness.
en_old: Mazar Khan, brother, Mazar Khan has done me a great favour. I did twenty-seven deals, my business in Dubai is thanks to his kindness.

brh: ایلو تا بئے گٹی پنجاہ و پنچ لکھو تاوے ہزار خان نا کھڑزاتے خلاص کیوے ایلو کل تا اونو یا گڑاس بچی گیانتا بچو کاتے بئے گٹی جمع کیوے
en: In the bag there are fifty-five lakh... I'll clear Hazar Khan's debts, and of all the rest, whatever is left over, I'll put the remainder in the bag.
en_old: To the others, fifty-five lakh... I'll pay off Mazar Khan's debts, and whatever is left over from all the rest, I'll collect it.

brh: ہرے نوٹ دا مزار خان نا او دیو سر کیوتا۔ جوان کرینوس پیسہ اسینوس لیکن دا پیساتے زود مزار خان نا سر کے۔ نا باز باز مہربانی کنے مزار خان نا دس تسوس داسائی ئے کاوہ سر کیوتا۔
en: Every note of this is Mazar Khan's, and I'll take it and deliver it to him. — You did well to bring the money, but get this money to Mazar Khan quickly. — Thank you very, very much, you gave me Mazar Khan's address; now I'll go and deliver it.
en_old: Here, this note is Mazar Khan's, I'll deliver it to him. You did well bringing the money, but get this money to Mazar Khan quickly. Thank you very much, you gave me Mazar Khan's address, now I'll go and deliver it.

brh: اللہ ایراٹ کھداری دا دبئی نا کل پیسہ تے ہنا غیسونی دا زکونیک دانہ کاٹومی
en: O God, [keep it safe?] — all this money from Dubai... [unclear] I'll take it and go.
en_old: God protect it, all this money from Dubai, I'll take it there safely...

brh: ارے بھلے تمنیا نا ہرف تے ہرف تے ارے شیر خان
en: Hey, all right, [unclear] — pick it up, pick it up, hey Sher Khan.
en_old: Hey, fine, listen to my words, Sher Khan.

brh: یار بر کہ دبئی آن باز جوان شکارس بننگٹی ہی ہو ماونو بیگس ئے ڈوٹی تے پدان پدان بستس ئے او ٹوپس بینانے دستاری
en: Friend, come — a very fine prey is coming from Dubai. Yes, he has a black bag tied on behind him, and he's wearing a cap and a turban.
en_old: Friend, come, a really good target is coming from Dubai. Yes, he has a bag tied on his back, and he's wearing a cap and a turban.

brh: ہو ہنا بننگے نا کاریمے کے زگدہ کاریمے کتاوے تھپی پی کھٹے بننگے ہو ہو ہنا کسر سدھا ایننگے ایراغاں ماروت بس بلبوٹے ایلوم ہنا کسر سدھا ایننگے مزار خان نا اورا غا
en: Yes, there he comes; do your job... [unclear]... he's coming. Yes, yes, that road goes straight... [unclear]... brother, that road goes straight to Mazar Khan's house.
en_old: Yes, go and do your work... the road goes straight, from there... brother, this road goes straight to Mazar Khan's house.

brh: مزار خان نوروز کائلے پیڑے تے کنا پنی والا مزار خان بنگوس ہا ہا ہا صحیح اللہ حافظ کنا استے باز بشخیرے رے اللہ دا چکارے
en: Mazar Khan... [unclear]... you're coming for my namesake Mazar Khan? Ha ha ha. Right, goodbye. You've made my heart very happy. Oh God, this prey!
en_old: Mazar Khan... my name is Mazar Khan, he's coming, ha ha ha, right, goodbye, my heart is very happy, God, this target...

brh: دا شکار لگا ننا باوہ نا بختی
en: This prey has landed — our father's good luck!
en_old: This target seems to be our father's good luck.

brh: برے خدا خلتہ ٹوپ توئی او ننا پیسہ غات گندم دریر
en: Come — God has struck [us]... [unclear]... and they took our money.
en_old: Come, God has blessed us, now our money will turn into wheat.

brh: دا خیر اینت کہ علم اکی سے مظہر خان خیرانی تا گدرینگانو
en: What's the matter? [Unclear]... Mazhar Khan, have things gone well?
en_old: What good news is this, that... has passed by.

brh: اشرف جان ایلم انت ماسخ ننے پو کا ننام دماغ تولی نی دا حال شسے او ایلم او ایت نا روپے ئے استرخ مسوٹ اشرف خیرے دا پانے دبئی آن چوا بسوس دبئی آن ئے درو بسوٹ خاف کے
en: Ashraf dear, brother, what happened? ... [unclear] our mind ... What state are you in? Oh brother, oh ... your rupees ... I was [unclear]. — Ashraf, is everything all right? He says you came from Dubai? — I came from Dubai yesterday; listen.
en_old: Ashraf jan, brother, what has happened? Our mind is troubled. What state are you in? Brother, the rupees... Ashraf, is all well? Did you come from Dubai? You came from Dubai...

brh: مزار خان امانت تا تتیوک دا شومک پلار کنے کوسی کنا ارار سماف دے رسورے مزار خان کنتو ایلم بلو ظلم ئس مسک اشرف دا ہن پاننگٹوس نی ہم پیسہ تے ہمادے رے ایلم
en: Mazar Khan, the trust money that was to be given [to you] — these wretches robbed me, tore my shirt... [unclear]. Mazar Khan, brother, a great injustice has been done to me. — Ashraf, what is this you're saying? You gave the money to that same person, brother?
en_old: Mazar Khan, the trust I was given didn't reach you... Mazar Khan, brother, a great injustice has been done to me. Ashraf, don't say that, you also gave the money to him, brother.

brh: پیسہ تنے دریر، کوسے کنا رار، بے پچ کریر کنے، اشرف سچ نا ہمے گپہ، اگر اونا کوسے رانو، یوفتات پڈے ہریوے، اللہ خیر کے۔
en: They took the money from me, tore my shirt, stripped me of my clothes. — Ashraf, is that the truth of it? If they tore his shirt, I'll look for them [and their tracks]; God will make it right.
en_old: They took the money from me, they ruined me. Ashraf, that's the truth, if... God help us.

brh: کچ باز مرے، بس داسہ اوئیتا تلے، سوار مس سائیکل آ کان، خدمتنے کیوے اللہ خیر کیک، افتی تینٹ پٹے وخنے وا۔
en: Don't fret so much [unclear]; they're just down there now — [one] got on a bicycle. Let's go. I'll do you this service; God will make it right; we'll search them out ourselves and find them again.
en_old: Thank you very much. He's just under there now; he got on the bicycle. You're doing a service, God will bless you. They'll find it themselves and see again.

brh: خدا خلے دا لچاتے اورے کرے رکھے خبر اف کاری مے کرے کٹوس دا کاری مے کر تو جوان ئے اگر کاری مے کٹوس ئے افتا جوان کاری مے کروٹی
en: May God strike these scoundrels! ... [unclear]... Who knows whether you've done the job. If you do this job, then good; if you've done the job, I'll deal with them properly.
en_old: God strike these scoundrels! Who keeps them? Who knows what work they've done. If they do this work, that's good; if they had done the work, I would have done their work well.

brh: کنا پینم مزار خان ئے لیکن کنے ہم کس پنج روپئی نام خیر خواہ مپک۔ یار مچو زو زو دکے تتے برو تے
en: My name is Mazar Khan, but nobody does me even five rupees' worth of good. Friends, all of you, quickly, quickly, give it a push — come on.
en_old: My name is Mazar Khan, but nobody has ever done me even five rupees' worth of good. Friends, all of you push quickly, come on.

brh: ارے لچک، نمے خیرے؟
en: Hey, you scoundrels, is everything all right with you?
en_old: Hey scoundrel, are you all well?

brh: اسکوٹر ء دکہ تر صاحب ہننگ ارے۔ زر خان پٹرول آک تہ کٹار، دکہ تفنتہ، لخ آتہ خنا تہ اینتہ۔ او لخ لوڑنج آک، ہنا پاپو کاریمے کرینے۔ یا کتنور آتے نن ہڑتوم آک لخ۔
en: Push the scooter, sir is leaving. Zar Khan, the petrol has run out(?); push it — they aren't pushing; [give them] kicks... Oh, the kicks... that poor fellow has done the work. Or we'll both [kick] them.
en_old: Push the scooter, sir is leaving. Zar Khan, the petrol has run out, push it. They aren't pushing; kick them and bring it. Those kicks... the poor guy has done the work. Or we'll both kick them.

brh: خلڑوئی مرین او کارم کپن دا تو مننگ کپک ہزار خان نم مشترکہ کارم کتنو کہ دا سادہ کارم کپرون نمے شاباس ئے دا کارم کریرے ہزار خان نا است خوش کریرے
en: [Unclear] — and would we not do the work? That can't happen. Hazar Khan, have we never done joint work, that we wouldn't do this simple job? — Bravo to you, you did this job; you made Hazar Khan's heart happy.
en_old: We'll get tired and won't do the work? That can't happen. Hazar Khan, you did the work together, though you wouldn't even do this simple work. Well done, you've done this work and made Hazar Khan's heart happy.

brh: ازہر خان ننے کیرا کارم ئ کتیوے ککڑ ننے کے دوز آن ریزہ ننے کے دوز آن دروغنتیا مچ مازور اسوسے عینک اچے دوز آن ایسون اینو دا کارم ئ ہم پاریست دا کارم ئ ہم ننے کیرے
en: Azhar Khan, what kind of work do you make us do? Chickens — you have us take them from thieves; [small change?] — you have us take it from thieves; [lies?]... we were all forced; glasses we brought from a thief; and today you've ordered this job too — you make us do this job too.
en_old: Azhar Khan, what kind of work did you have us do? A chicken from the thieves for us, lies from the thieves for us, we were all forced, we brought glasses from the thief, and today you've ordered this work too. You make us do this work too.

brh: کن کے کاریم باز کرینوری، لیکن نما کنے ہسے کاریم باز وڑا۔ ہزار خان، ننا ارا کاریم نی باز وڑا؟ نما کنے ہمو کاریم باز وڑا، ہمے سلاہ غاوانہ کیرغانہ۔
en: You (all) have done a lot of work for me, but one job of yours pleased me very much. — Hazar Khan, which of our jobs did you like most? — That job of yours pleased me very much, the one with the 'salah' [weapons/advice?]... [unclear].
en_old: You have done a lot of work for me, but I liked that one job of yours very much. Hazar Khan, which of our jobs did you like best? I liked that job of yours very much, the advice you give.

brh: بلہ نا خزی دوزاری کن کے ہسوری واقعی نی سئی پاریس نن نی کے تو جوانو کاری مسکرین لیکن نی نن تو سئی او کاری مسکتویس ہمو خسیان نن اسے تو چٹ قسم تیتویس ارے نما دا جرات
en: Well, your [unclear] thieving for me... Really, you said it right: we did good work for you, but you never did one right thing by us; [that's why]... and to us, I swear, you gave nothing at all. — Hey, this nerve of yours!
en_old: Big brother, for the thieves' treasure... really, you spoke the truth. We did good work for you, but you didn't do right by us, and that's why you're tired. You never swore to us at all. You have this nerve?

brh: نم تینے کنٹوار برابر کیرے ئے نمے خسیتٹ لیکن کنا پنا نا سواری نمے کنا پن ایاز خان کنے ہم پنچ روپئی نا گس فائدہ خنتنی زو کبو اینا بیگی کنے اتبو زو
en: You make yourselves equal to me — [that's your nature?] — but you ride on my name. My name is Ayaz Khan, and I too haven't seen five rupees' worth of any benefit. Hurry up, bring me today's bag, quickly.
en_old: You consider yourselves my equals, you're tired. But on the ride under my name... my name is Ayaz Khan, and I haven't seen five rupees of benefit either. Hurry up, bring me tomorrow's bag, quickly.

brh: نا واسطہ تفے دا مون دزے ئے جوان چاوتے ادا نی پارک ئے رنگا دزس خننگ خننگ پر سدا سدا پا پیشانیا کسے نا لکھوک اف کہ دا دزے یا سادے سدا پا سہ معافم کننگ کنے نتیلے پننے
en: ...he invoked (that murshid's) sake. I know this thief's face well. Here in the park you keep seeing thieves of that kind, but say it straight, straight. It isn't written on anyone's forehead whether this one is a thief or innocent. Say it straight, then there can be forgiveness too... me... [unclear]
en_old: For your sake... I know a thief's face well. Here you're asking what a thief looks like... but tell me straight. It isn't written on anyone's forehead whether he's a thief or innocent. Tell me straight. Forgive me...

brh: مچے معاف کیبو یرا، ارے آرام اٹ کاسے، آرام اٹ۔ نی دزی کسہ والاٹ ہریسے؟ ارے دانا تپاسے ایلو۔ اینے پاتور دا دز سے۔ ہا بھلو دز سے بائے کنا۔
en: Forgive it all, man. Hey, go easy, go easy. Who do you see as the thief? Hey, look into this one, brother. Didn't they say this is a thief? Yes, he's a big thief, my brother.
en_old: Forgive everyone, man. Hey, go calmly, calmly. Who did you steal with? Hey, the other one... Tell him this is a thief. Yes, a big thief, my brother.

brh: دا مونا الکو سرعام بسونو کنے پاریکے موٹرسائیکل ننے آتے گڈا پی دزی کتنوٹ۔ واللہ ہم دروختس۔ ننے ہم پنجاہ و پنج لکھ روپئی دزانے۔ ئے اینو ہناڑے نی زندہ کھڈ کیو کہ پیندس کنا دزی کپ۔ ایلم دا دلے دا ننے ہم پنجاہ و پنج لکھ روپئی دزانے۔
en: This one came openly, right in front (of us), and was telling me, '...the motorcycle... us... I haven't stolen.' By God, that was a lie too. He has stolen fifty-five lakh rupees from us too. Today I'll bury you alive right here so that you don't steal from me. Brother, this one, he has stolen fifty-five lakh rupees from us too.
en_old: This one came openly in front of me and told me about the motorcycle... 'I didn't steal.' By God, the same lie. They stole fifty-five lakh rupees from us too. Today you'll be buried alive here unless you admit you stole. Brother, they stole fifty-five lakh rupees from us too.

brh: دا ہنو کے پانے ٹٹن دا ایلو مان پلانے۔ ہاؤ۔ ہاؤ۔ کنے ہنچو ساہ۔ نی ہن کنے۔ دا وائی نی ہن پنجاہ پنج لک درے۔ ہاؤ۔ باز بلو ظلم کرے دا تو باز بلو گنہگار اسے۔ ئے دا دے کنے۔
en: This one said that too... this other one, so-and-so. Yes. Yes. Me... like this... You go, me... This one, wow, you took fifty-five lakh. Yes. He has done a very great injustice; he is a very great sinner. I... this one... me...
en_old: Tell this one... the other... Yes. Yes. Me... you go... You took fifty-five lakh. Yes. He did a great wrong; he is a great sinner. This...

brh: نی تو داسہ ہچ دتنی کنا استو شنگنگٹی نا تو پنج پینچ لک درینی پدا سہ دا دوست نما دوٹی ہنت کہ دانا حالے کیرے ہلتے دا دل دے دانا ئے داسہ کنا دا دوٹی بسنے دانا دوائی داسہ ئے
en: You gave nothing now... in my heart... you took five, five lakh. Then this friend is in your hands now, so that you deal with him... this one... now he has come into my hands; his punishment is now (with me).
en_old: Now you gave nothing... in my heart... you took five lakh. Then this friend is in your hands to deal with... now he has come into my hands, and now his cure is...

brh: ئے جوان کیوے ہر کدانہ پالو تا عمل اٹ تیوے کنا ایلوم دا نما دوست ئے داسا نما ڈیوٹی ئے ئے ہناٹک نم چارے نما کاریم چائے او مسورے کنا داسا نی خلاص ئس خلاص داسا ہا بس ٹھیک ئے خدا حافظ
en: I'll fix him properly, each one by his own deeds. My brother, this is your friend; now it's your duty. I'm going. You know, you know your job... Now you're finished, finished now. Yes, that's it, okay, goodbye.
en_old: I'll sort him out, every... with his deeds. Brother, he's your friend, now it's your duty. You know your job. Now you're done, done. Yes, okay, alright. Goodbye.

brh: خدا خالدے دا تو بلو دز اسے۔ ئے لمہ دا دلے دا ناموس نا ہچ گپ ئس اف، دا لچڑ مروک، یلہ کر تے مروک، یلہ کر تے مروک۔
en: God, Khalid, this one is a big thief. Oh mother, this one has no regard for honor at all; he's a shameless scoundrel. Let him go, let him go.
en_old: God, Khalid, he's a big thief. Mother, he has no honor at all. He's shameless, let him go, let him go.

brh: ایروم پشک بو خلپ بو کنے ارے ناروا نی دا مخلونا پیسا تے دیسہ گڑا نی اما بچے سے نی اما الے نن نن دوزہ کہ مافی اف کنت دوزہ کہ مافی ارے
en: Brother, stop, don't hit me. Hey, it's wrong — you take people's money, so whose kind of child are you, what are you? For us there is no forgiveness for a thief. Is there forgiveness for a thief?
en_old: Brother, open up, don't hit me. It's wrong. You take people's money, so whose child are you then? We... there's no forgiveness for a thief. Is there forgiveness for a thief?

brh: اولا کہ نی مرشد نا روئی تے سن، مرشد نا روئی یعنی منت اوئے سنت کے، دا سا توئی مننگ اٹ یوٹی کے دزٹ، دا سا جوانی کہ نی مننگ اٹ ئس دا سا نا علاج جوان جام مریک۔
en: First, listen to the murshid's ways — the murshid's way means entreaty and practice. Now by confessing, you thief... now it's good that you are confessing; now your treatment will go well.
en_old: First, listen to the murshid's ways, meaning the vow and the practice... now his cure will turn out well.

brh: نی گڑا کنے لٹٹ خلپسے۔ دا لٹٹ خلپر مگہ جی کنے۔ نی سلئے دا نیلہ جی آتے وی ہو ادا خرچ استنا دے ارمان تے پورا کر۔ دا سنی ہورس ئے
en: Then you won't beat me with the stick. Don't beat me with this stick, sir. You, take these blue (notes), spend them here and fulfil your heart's desires. Look at this...
en_old: Then don't hit me with the stick. Don't hit me with this stick, sir. Take these blue notes, spend them here and fulfil your wishes. Listen to this, look.

brh: ئے امر خلیو تے انپاسہ پنچ کدو زیکے ساخا دوزئی آن توبہ ئے کنے بداسہ معاف کبو کنے خبردار ایلو دادے چھپ
en: Hey, how am I to hit him — what are you saying? ...[unclear]... I repent of stealing; forgive me now. Beware! ...this one... quiet.
en_old: Hey, why are you beating them? Aren't you saying anything... I repent of stealing, forgive me, I'm a bad one. Watch out, next time keep quiet about this.

brh: مافیا ایلو فیسٹ ئے دا نا دوا کھڈ کرو ئے کھڈ دا نی دا سا علاج کے ونی دا سا اورسٹ
en: Forgiveness?... the other... his cure is: bury him, bury him! You give him the treatment now... now...
en_old: Forgiveness... his cure is to bury him, bury him... now you cure him... now...

brh: اوئے نمبر کے! خلبوتے!
en: Hey, number...! Beat him!
en_old: Hey, number…! Beat them!

brh: دزنا دوا دادے لم نت تے تے برگھان دو تے تے برگھان سورہ پگ بس بس الے تے تمو گارے کس خلپہ
en: The cure for a thief is this: break his legs, break his arms... Enough, enough, let him go; from now on nobody hit him.
en_old: The cure for a thief is this: break his legs, break his arms… Enough, enough, nobody hit him any more…

brh: بس ادا تمو غارے کس خلپک دا چھٹا ببو کامبو
en: Enough, nobody hits him here any more. Let him go free; let's go.
en_old: That's it, nobody hits him any more. Let him go, let's get to work.

brh: پتہ ونے کسو کان دادے خلیرے امر خلقو نود خنے ستے نہ ایلان دو وڑ کے نہ ایلان نت وڑ کے اینو اسکا دون متنے
en: Who knows who beat him, how they beat him... they left him with neither an arm whole nor a leg whole. Until today it had never come to this.
en_old: Who knows who you're beating, and how they beat... I didn't spare his hands or his legs. It has never been like this until today.

brh: تنے آئنو اسکا کنا بندغہ کس دو خلتنے آئنو اسکا با کنا بندغے دن نت دو تے تہ کس پرختنے لیکن آئنو ہر کس کہ کرے نی لیکن جوان کتنے ایو دے مگلیوے ایو دے
en: Until today nobody had laid a hand on my man; until today nobody had broken my man's legs and arms like this. But today whoever did it — you did not do well. That day... that day [unclear].
en_old: Until today nobody had laid a hand on my men. Until today nobody had even touched my men's arms and legs. But whoever did it today, you did not do well. That day will come, that day.

brh: چاسٹ ٹکر ٹکر کیوے پنگوس ہچے بندغ کیرا بندغ تا خلیوے دانا خلوکاٹی چاسٹی پیسے خنیف تا اوفتا رنداتم درست کیوے درستکے ستا
en: I'll smash them to pieces. What kind of people are they, beating my men? I'll show the ones who beat him... the money... I'll go after them and set them straight, I'll set them straight.
en_old: I'll tear the thief to pieces. What kind of man beats people? In this beating I'll find the thief's money, then I'll track them down afterwards. I'll recognize you.

brh: گڑا دا داڑے الک کانٹا نا لٹ ایلن ولدا دادے دفن کین۔ کنا پنی ازار خان لیکن اینو اسکا کنے آن کس پنچ روپئی نا فائدہ ہم خنتنے او کم کنے آن فائدہ خنپرور بکان۔ رائی مر۔
en: Then let's leave the thorny stick here and bury it again. My name is Azhar Khan, but until today nobody has seen even five rupees' worth of benefit from me, and they won't see any benefit from me either. Get going.
en_old: Then put the thorny stick here and bury it again. My name is Azar Khan, but until today nobody has gotten even five rupees' worth of benefit out of me, and they won't get any from me either. Get lost.

brh: ازار خان
en: Azhar Khan.
en_old: Azar Khan

brh: او دا مے دے نا بندغے اینا نا سنگتی خلک نا نا مجال نی ئنا غٹوانگے
en: Oh, this is the man from the other day! He beat your friend... how dare you... you... [unclear]
en_old: Oh, this man is from these days. He beats my friend, how dare you…

brh: در جوڑ ئس کنا بندغ آتیا خلیس ء، خنے ٹپیس ء۔
en: Yesterday you beat my men soundly and wounded them.
en_old: Yesterday you beat my men badly and wounded them.

brh: ادا دا تو زنگا کن ہاؤ لیکن کنا پنی اظہر خان کنیا نینوس کاکس پنج روپئی نا خیر خان تنے رائے مکان اینا سنگت او ٹینیا خیر خان پرور
en: Here, this one... yes, but my name is Azhar Khan. Nobody has ever seen five rupees' worth of good from me. Get going... (today's) friend... and they won't see any good from me.
en_old: This here is for…, but my name is Azhar Khan, and nobody has gotten five rupees' worth of good out of me. Friend…

brh: توسہ خاواک نی ہراش، ایتس کنے آن آرام کر، کنے آن صوبہ چپس
en: ...you... [unclear]... take it easy with me, ... with me [unclear].
en_old: You lot… you let me rest…

brh: دا وادیرو اچانک بسو مونا ننا سلیسو ایلم کنے انو لگک دا چارلی والا ٹوپ تو ئس سنگتا ئنا دے دنا سنگتی ایلم دا مو دزاتا سنگت سے
en: This wadero suddenly came and stood in front of us, brother. Now it seems to me this is the one with the Charlie cap... friend of... brother, this one is a friend of the thieves.
en_old: This guy suddenly showed up in front of us, our brother. It seems to me that's the one with the Charlie hat. My friend, brother, this one is a friend of the thieves.

brh: اڑے دز نی ئس ہاؤ اڑے دز اورے گڑا نی ہمور کے سدے؟ نی داسا ہورک ئے اونا امر کیوہ اسل ٹڈکاٹ ویتے ہریوہ۔ کنے برے کنے
en: Hey thief, it's you, yes! Hey thief, so where do you think you're going? Now watch what I do to him — I'll rip him apart with one blow. Come at me, come at me.
en_old: Hey, thief, it's you! Hey, thief, so where are you going now? Now watch how I deal with him, I'll knock him flat with a punch. Come at me, come at me.

brh: ترس نی گنوسی چپ لسم سے اینکپیسے دا سسل بنما کھونے کاٹومی چپلے دا نمونہ دیرسے ننتو بسونے ڈیلخ خلیک دا نمونہ زپک دا خواجہ نی بائے تنا ہوش اٹکا چپڑ خلت دود خلے خنت
en: Scared... you're crazy... [unclear]... this character has come at us and is hitting... this character... This Khwaja, brother, are you in your right mind? He slapped you, he hit you, you saw.
en_old: Scared… slipper… this is the way… he came at us and hits… this is the way… Khwaja, you lost your senses, he slapped you, you saw.

brh: ئے دا دے کہ شے منون۔ خواجہ گڈو نوت کیک۔ ننے خلک۔ چارلی! دا سے سلے، اینا بوزے پرخوے۔ نی چارلی نا زورے خنتنس دا سورینے امر خلوے۔ ادا ئے دا سے اباز مس، دا سے کھریل۔
en: Hey, what has happened to us these days? Khwaja Guddu is... He hit us. Charlie! Stand up to this one, break his nose. You haven't seen Charlie's strength, how he'll hit this... Here, this has gone too far, this... [unclear]
en_old: Hey, what has happened these days? Khwaja Guddu… he beat us. Charlie! Break his nose. You've seen Charlie's strength, how he hits. Here, this got too much…

brh: لٹھ نا پیرس مریتا، نمت کبو خلبوتا
en: ...of the stick... you all do it, beat them.
en_old: …of the stick… beat them.

brh: دا پا کین بئے کنا مکھیرے، ئے سفت خان کنا مکھیرے، نا پیسہ غا، آزاد خان نا پنڈاٹی او، آزاد خان نا پنڈاٹی او
en: Say this, brother, my informer — hey Sifat Khan, my informer: your money is in Azad Khan's village, in Azad Khan's village.
en_old: Say this, my chief, Sifat Khan, my chief, with your money, in Azad Khan's village, in Azad Khan's village.

brh: اوہ! خلے نی ایلم تے، پیسہ وت کھونو، گڈات گٹو کرو، یمر لوئی تا، ہزار خان کنا وارثے، ہزار خان کنا وارثے
en: Oh! You hit the brothers! The money ... then he'll choke him ... Hazar Khan is my guardian, Hazar Khan is my guardian!
en_old: Oh! Beat the brothers… the money… Hazar Khan is my heir, Hazar Khan is my heir.

brh: مزار خان! دا تو نن خلکون، دا ساہ مزار خان خل!
en: Mazar Khan! We've hit this one; now you hit, Mazar Khan!
en_old: Mazar Khan! We've hit this one, now you hit it, dear Mazar Khan!

brh: دا دمک کرے خلقونے دا، خلقونے دا دا دزے، جوان کرے دزے خلق، دا ہزار خانے خلق مزار خان لے خام پرغاتے، واہ جوان کریس، ہیتام خلقونو رے، ہاؤ ہیتام اینا
en: This one came down with a thump, he has hit him, this one has hit this thief; he did well, he hit the thief. This one hit Hazar Khan, Mazar Khan smashed him up. Wow, you did well, you have hit ... yes ... today.
en_old: He made this noise, he hit this, hit this with his hand, well done, he hit it, this Hazar Khan hit it, Mazar Khan... wow, well done, the point has been made, yes, that's the talk today.

brh: ملک اسے خوار کرینو ہلانوں واہ جوان کریرے بئے ہرا ڈی اور غریب غرباء تے پھل لٹے باز افسوس بس کنے لا بندغ نا کہ دانا دا پیسہ تے درینو برادری تیوی
en: They have disgraced a chief and taken from him; wow, you did well! ... and robbed and looted the poor. I felt very sorry for the man, that the whole community has taken this money of his.
en_old: He ruined a country and took it, well done to those who robbed the poor. I felt very sorry for that man, that the whole community took his money.

brh: ئے پاریٹ پنجاہ و پنج لکھ بوڑی کین، دا ایلوم ایتنے والا نی ایتک، نا پیساتے خلاص کیک، نا عام حق کیک، او مصروف بھلو برادری سے، پنج پنج ہزار کیرم، پنجاہ لکھ بوڑی کین۔ خیر ایلوم اوڑتوم ناجائز مس، کبو نا مسلمان نا حق ء خلاص کین، دا ایمبولنس کان۔ او ہف گڑا۔
en: I said I'll raise fifty-five lakh: this brother, the one who gives, gives it to you; he finishes off your money, ... your rightful due. And it's a big, busy community: five thousand each, I'll raise fifty lakh. Well, brother, from him it turned out to be unlawful; should I use up a Muslim's due? This ambulance, let's go. And that thing.
en_old: I said I'd collect fifty-five lakh, and you give the rest. It finishes off your money and takes away your rightful share. en: (Unintelligible.)
en_old: Spah, take it.

brh: دا بھلا ماسٹر منیر سرکاران داخدر و بھلو تنخواہ سیلک پاپک کتن کے جوان و موٹرسائیکل اسیلک ہرفتا نت گھوڈو چڑائیسی
en: This great Master Munir draws such a big salary from the government, and he doesn't think to buy himself a good motorcycle ... feet ... riding a horse.
en_old: This great Master Munir gets such a big salary from the government, yet doesn't say... he buys a good motorcycle... whose feet ride a horse.

brh: دا بیست نٹ ئے گڈانی نہ موٹر سائیکل نٹ ارے آخا کو دا علی حمزہ دا لک پاس آ ٹرک آٹی ٹوچین کرینے ماسٹر دا وڑ دروغ موٹر سائیکل اراڑے ٹرک اراڑے خدا نا جندے نن کے
en: This is twenty ... then no, the motorcycle is ... this Ali Hamza crashed into a truck at Lak Pass. Master, what a lie! Where's a motorcycle and where's a truck? For God's sake, [spare] us.
en_old: This is twenty notes... then no, there's a motorcycle... this Ali Hamza crashed into a truck near the Lak Pass. Master, what a lie, where's the motorcycle and where's the truck, God himself knows.

brh: مچیٹا بلبل آنبار خائے گوسپئی چارمی کو شاخے چارمی کو شاخے کش کش گیرس کشک موٹرسائیکل کم گیرس کشہ ماسٹر کش کشی گادے گادے کھلی کشان ابو خواجہ کوا دا نت نت تے تخ بریک ئے ماسٹر بریک بریک ئے ماسٹر
en: Like a nightingale in the palm tree ... on the fourth branch, on the fourth branch ... Pull, pull, it pulls a gear; the motorcycle ... pull a low gear, Master, pull ... slowly, slowly, open it up ... Khawaja, put your feet down! Brake, Master! Brake! Brake, Master!
en_old: Like a nightingale in the date palms... fourth gear, fourth gear, pull, pull the gears, the motorcycle pulls less in gear, Master... slowly, slowly, open it up... Khawaja, put your feet down, the brake, Master, the brake, the brake, Master!

brh: دا ہرا وخت آ بس؟
en: When did this one come?
en_old: When did this come?

brh: ماسٹر منیر ئے تس چاسے نن جدو کمباروم بٹیننگاسن دا ئے چستٹ توئی اف
en: Master Munir gave it. Do you know, we ... a hedgehog ... this ... isn't there.
en_old: Master Munir gave... do you know, we... jado... this isn't in...

brh: دا وڑو وختہ کہ انسان نزیہ برے رکارے، اور ئس پاسہ کھودا، شمسو، نی جدو کے میدانٹ رمبا خنانوس؟ جدو کراڑے، رم کننگ کراڑے ماسٹر، گڑا کھودا پائک زندگی جدو
en: At a time like this, when a person comes close and stops, someone says: Koda, Shamso, have you ever seen a hedgehog running in a field? Where's a hedgehog, and where's running, Master? Then Koda says: life is a hedgehog.
en_old: At such a time when a person comes near and stops, someone says: Khawaja, Shamso, have you ever seen a jado running in the field? Where's a jado, where's the running, Master? Then Khawaja says life is a jado.

brh: دوک ہمبر رمبٹیئے، داسہ خواجہ کودا نا ہر گڑا رمبٹیئے، خواجہ کودا پائے کہ دوشہ چار پاد کننگٹیئے، نی پا او، سرکو گڈ ڈمبر تڑنگٹیئے، نی پا تا
en: It's running so much; now everything of Khawaja Koda's is running. Khawaja Koda says it's going along on four feet. You tell him: head down, rear up, it's ... you tell them.
en_old: The donkey is running so much, now everything of Khawaja's is running. Khawaja says it's moving on four legs, you tell him, head down and rear in the air, you tell him.

brh: او ماسٹر منیر دا ادے چاراڑے دشمن تے نامونے مون کرے کنا لولانے درے خنیس دا کنا دوٹی برے کچک زندہ
en: Oh Master Munir, look at him here ... the enemies ... he took my Lolan. You'll see, if he falls into my hands, 'kachak', alive.
en_old: Oh Master Munir, look here, I faced the enemies, I took out my pigeon, you saw, if it comes into my hand, kachak, alive.

brh: خلاص اوت۔ اندا کچک انت اسے کوا؟ کچک، کچک مطلب ساہ کشک۔ کچک، ساہ کشک، کچک، گڈا کچک، کچک اندا دے مبارک نن توتھو۔
en: It's over. So what is this 'kachak', Kowa? Kachak, 'kachak' means 'it draws breath'. Kachak, draws breath, kachak, then kachak, kachak. This very day, Mubarak, we ...
en_old: It's over. So what does 'kachak' mean? Kachak, kachak means it breathes its last. Kachak, it dies, kachak, then kachak, kachak, today Mubarak we...

brh: نما تو ہر کس کہ ارے اکبر چائک تا ولے اکبر نجی ننا
en: As for you all, everyone who is here knows Akbar, but Akbar is our own.
en_old: Everyone here knows Akbar, but Akbar is ours.

brh: دا اکبر تینٹ امر و بندغ اسے؟ انداڑیکنا دماغ کاریم کپک۔ ننا واریا نا دماغ ہم کاریم کپک۔ ہم کنا دماغ کاریم کپک کہ اکبر دز
en: What kind of person is this Akbar himself? My brain doesn't work here. Our [unclear]'s brain doesn't work either. My brain can't work it out either, that Akbar... thie[f/ves]...
en_old: What kind of person is this Akbar himself? My brain just doesn't work like this. Our Varya's brain doesn't work either. My brain also can't work out what Akbar...

brh: تو داڑے لتا ہمراہی تینا جاگہ غا دافتا برخلاف کاریم کرینے، اندا اکبر نا بدولت اٹ اینو ننا علاقہ صفائی۔ صاف کرینے بلکہ داسہ تینٹ شروع کرینے، نمے انکو دا ئے خلق نا بندہ وری
en: So here, with [his] companions, he worked against them in his own place, and thanks to this very Akbar our area is clean today. He has cleaned it up; in fact now he has started [it] himself. For you all, this one is a servant of the village [unclear].
en_old: So here, with his companions, he worked against them in his own place. Thanks to this Akbar our area is clean today. He has cleaned it up, and now he has started it himself. To you... he is a servant of the people.

brh: جی او، دنا بندغورے؟ نن خدا نا بندغون ابا، خدا نا نن کل خدا نا بندغون مطلب نوم ارا ذات و ٹکن نا بندغورے؟ نن خواجہ کل بلوچ آن پین ذات پات نا ضرورت اف، ذات خو ایک، ذات
en: Yes, what kind of people are you? We are God's people, dear; we are all God's people. I mean, by name, what caste and sub-tribe are you? Khwaja, we are all Baloch; there is no need for any other caste or creed. Caste, well... caste.
en_old: Yes, what kind of people are you? We are God's people, father, we are all God's people. I mean, your name, what caste and tribe are you? Sir, we are all Baloch. We don't need any other caste. Caste... caste.

brh: پتمندوخ چائنگ مریک نی کادائی اسے ئس رندا اسے ئس شمبیزئی اسے ئس نن دا تٹی ہچس افن نن بلوچ آن انسان نا بلا گڑا ادب ء اخلاق ء ذاتن ہر گڑا ظاہر مریک
en: [Unclear] it can be known: you are a Kadai, someone is a Rind, someone is a Shambezai. We are none of these; we are Baloch. The great thing in a person is manners and morals; everything becomes apparent from one's own self.
en_old: Lineage becomes known: you are a Kadai, someone is a Rind, someone is a Shambezai. We have none of that. We are Baloch. A person's great qualities are manners, morals and character. Everything shows.

brh: نی جوان و زات اسیس یا خراب و زات اسیس؟ ئے نی تینٹ ہن زات اسیس۔ ئے میرزئی اسوٹ۔ نا، ئے تو گپ ادب و اخلاق نا۔ خلق و جاگہ نا اسدونو گڑا ظاہر مفک کہ نی۔
en: Are you of a good caste or a bad caste? And you yourself, what caste are you? I am a Mirzai. No, for me the matter is one of manners and morals. Nothing like that about village or place shows that you...
en_old: Are you of a good caste or a bad caste? What caste are you yourself? I was a Mirzai. No, it's a matter of manners and morals. People and places don't show anything about who you are.

brh: میرزئی اسونس۔ نن ہفت پشت آن ایرا کنا خواجہ و میر وند، ننے پارہ میرزئی۔ میری و خواجی نئیتن کس بلن مفک، سئی ئے انسان عمل و کردار آن بلن مریک، ننا خلق اٹ۔
en: We are Mirzai. For seven generations we have been Khwajas and Mirs, [so] they call us Mirzai. No one becomes great through being a Mir or a Khwaja; right, in our village a person becomes great through deeds and character.
en_old: We were Mirzai. For seven generations we have been Khwaja and Mir, so they call us Mirzai. No one becomes great by being a Mir or a Khwaja. Right, in our area a person becomes great through deeds and character.

brh: او بس نن نا مہمان آن ننا دزا بندغاک گدرینگانو بائیدے نا بندغاک داکے ہلکورے گڑا نا کردار ظاہر مسکے اچھا گڑا نن کانہ نوما موٹرسائیکل نا حوالہ الینہ برینہ
en: Oh, it's just that we are your guests. Our thieving people have passed by; the [unclear] people took these, and then [their] character showed. All right, then we're going; we'll leave your motorcycle in [your] care and come [back].
en_old: Yes, it's just that some of our people went past our guests, people from outside. They took this, and then their character showed. All right, then we'll go. We'll come by motorcycle.

brh: کان ماسٹر اسیت اسپاو نی نی تینٹ تینا قدری تپیسہ نی اگہ تینا قدرے چاسہ تینے تینٹ خلوئے
en: Let's go, Master. Let me tell you one thing: you, you yourself don't know your own worth. If you knew your own worth, you'd have to slap yourself.
en_old: Master, you don't know your own worth. If you knew your own worth, you would beat yourself.

brh: نی او ئے تے الہ کرک بر کے ئے دزاتے خنانٹ کودا امر پاوا کنے یاد برے کہ اسہ دے اسے والوک نا وران ارے انگا درینگٹی اسوٹ
en: You... [unclear]... I have seen thieves. Now how shall I put it? I remember that one day I was in [unclear]...
en_old: You... did... I saw the men there. How should I put it? I remember that one day...

brh: انو بھو انو نی پچھموک سے زرت چنا نا کتاب و کاپی کے سے دا داڑے ڈاکٹراس جوڑ مفک ولدا دانا ماسٹر منیر ئے دا تینا ٹیچرس تپک چائک تپک ولے نی انتو جوانی
en: Today, brother, today you [unclear] with some money, the child's books and notebooks... This one won't become a doctor here. And then his teacher is Master Munir; he doesn't even know his own teacher — doesn't know, knows, doesn't know. But what good are you?
en_old: Today, brother, today you... took the child's books and notebooks. He won't become a doctor here. And then his teacher, Master Munir, doesn't know... but how good are you?

brh: نی چار چنا خوانیفک؟ مش خوانیفک، دا ناکاریم پیرہ کودہ تو کچاری کننگے، دا پیرہ تنخا لیک کنیک، نی گنے مسہ چار ہزار اٹ ئے کاوہ بارڈر آ کاریم کیوے
en: You're educating four children? [Unclear] educating them. This is your job: when you're old, then you hold gatherings; this old man [lives on] his salary. You, for three or four thousand... I'd go and work at the border.
en_old: Are you educating four children? Don't educate them. This is your job. When you get old you'll be in court. When you get old, the pension... You... I get three or four thousand, I work at the border.

brh: مخلوق باڈیرہ غاک پیسہ تیک نی انت کتیسے؟ جوانی نی تینا کے کرک ئے خلک نا کل میسلا تے اسٹ اسٹ دیوا با کے ور دا میسلا تا خواجہ ک نی ٹکر ٹکر کیرے
en: The people, the landlords give money — what have you done? Well, you [do] your own thing; I take up all the village's disputes one by one [unclear], and the parties to these disputes, you tear them to pieces.
en_old: People, the elders give money, so what have you done? Well, you've done your work. You set all the village's disputes out one by one, and you fight the people involved in these disputes piece by piece.

brh: دا زر تے تینا لٹہ ٹپ، جوان یانو نی تینا چنائے پار ماسٹر نا رف کہ انگریزی ٹی گوری چیند پارے۔
en: Put this money away in your [pocket]. Good, now tell your child to go to the master [and ask] what the white woman said in English.
en_old: Put this money in your pocket. Good, now tell your child to go and ask the master what the white woman said in English.

brh: جائز توئی نوزہ خوائپرے، اگر چتپ گڑا دا چھنائے خواننے فنکے مونتے فیس
en: If it's permissible, then I don't want [it]; if not, then this child's studies... the fees ahead...
en_old: If it's allowed, I want to study. If not, then this child's studies... the fees ahead.

brh: آ ماسٹر، کدا؟ آ، نی پشن نا ارا ارا ملک آن ئس
en: Ah, Master, where [to]? Ah, which foreign countries have you been to?
en_old: Ah, master, where to? Ah, which countries have you been to from Pishin?

brh: ئے دا جگہ غن بیست و پینج جگہ تنہ زندٹ خنتنٹ، گڑا اون نی پشین نا بندغ خنانوس؟ دا بلا عمرٹی ئے وڑ وڑ نا بندغ خناٹ۔
en: Apart from this place, I haven't seen twenty-five places in my life. Then have you seen foreign people? At this great age I have seen all kinds of people.
en_old: I have seen twenty-five places in my life. So have you seen the people of Pishin? At this old age I have seen all kinds of people.

brh: ئے تیتوٹ کہ دے پیشن نائے دے ہندا ملکنائے۔ گڑا نی ایلو پیشن نا زمانتے چاسے پومریسے؟ ماسٹر خیر ئے اینو نی شفی دفی جامہ جوڑ مسونس۔
en: I couldn't tell which one is a foreigner and which one is from this very country. So do you know the other foreign languages — do you understand them? Master, is all well? Today you're all dressed up in fine clothes.
en_old: I said that this one is Pishin's and this one is this country's. So do you know about the old days of Pishin, or have you forgotten? Master, is everything fine? Today you're all dressed up nicely.

brh: ئے اندا سوچیوے نی دنو ملک سے آ ہنتنوس نی پیشن نا بندغ ئس تیپیسے پین زبان ئس نی تیپیسے پین جاگہ ئس نی خنتنوس گڑا زندہ اوس انتھکی ئے زندہ متوٹے نی
en: I'm thinking just this: you haven't gone to any such country, you don't know any foreigner, you don't know any other language, you haven't seen any other place — so are you even alive? Because I haven't [really] been alive, you see.
en_old: I thought this: you went to such a country, you speak a foreign language, you speak another language, you've seen other places, so you are alive. Why am I not alive?

brh: داڑے راڑے مسوسے، ولے نی انتئے کینو دا وڑ سوچ کیسی ئے سوچ کننگٹ کہ کنے مسئلہ ئس حل کنے۔ مسئلہ ئس نی پا۔ مسئلہ دادے کہ
en: You've been here and there, but why are you thinking like this today? I'm thinking that I have a problem to solve. Tell me the problem. The problem is this, that...
en_old: It happened here and there, but why are you thinking like this today? I'm thinking that I should solve a problem. Tell me the problem. The problem is that...

brh: گوریچے انگریزی ٹی انت پارے؟ ہمم دا ہادی انگریز ئس چائے۔
en: What did the white woman say in English? Hmm, the head[master] here knows English.
en_old: What did the white woman say in English? Hmm, this guy knows English.

brh: ہیلو ہیڈ ماسٹر صاحب نی جوڑ سلامتی لے ناریہ کسف ہا نی کنے پا گوری چنگریزی ٹی انت پارے ہا انت پارے
en: Hello, headmaster sahib, are you well and in good health? [Unclear.] Yes, you tell me, what did the white woman say in English? Yes, what did she say?
en_old: Hello, headmaster sir, are you well? Tell me what the white woman said in English. What did she say?

brh: نی تینٹ پیسے؟ نی کنے آن الوس، سہی سہی ایوار۔
en: Are you saying it yourself? You took it from me. Right, right, together.
en_old: Are you saying it yourself? You got it from me. Okay, okay, together.

brh: دا نما موٹر سائیکل ئے ریڈی او چکا چک شاباش ئے یا اللہ خیر بش مبو کان بش مبو بش مبو اللہ دنا نا میر و معتبر ارا میر و معتبر خواجہ ئے ہندا ارتوما شر زاتا او دے چاراڑ جگاڑ خا
en: Is this motorcycle of yours ready? Oh, spick and span, bravo! O God, may it go well. Get up, let's go, get up, get up. God, the Mir and notable of such [a place]... which Mir and notable? It's Khwaja. These very two of good caste... and [unclear] jugaad...
en_old: This motorcycle of yours is ready. Check it, check it, bravo! Oh God, may it go well, may it go, may it go. God, which leader and dignitary of this place owns it? This good caste... they make do with jugaad.

brh: لنک اینانو۔ اوفوہ دا کل جگاڑیو۔ جوان ئے خواجہ نی میر متوس، اگر نی میر مسوسہ غریب آک زار کونگورہ۔ بشہ بشہ بشہ چمکان۔
en: [Unclear.] Ugh, these are all makeshift fixes. It's a good thing, Khwaja, that you didn't become a Mir; if you had become a Mir, the poor would be eating poison. Up, up, up — let's go.
en_old: I'm going to the link. Oh, this is all jugaad. It's a good thing, sir, that you didn't become a leader. If you had become a leader, the poor would be crying. Go, go, go, shine.

brh: بچہ شمسو تولک تولک تونگانے نا نازانو کنے کسپیر نہار ماسٹر نا ڈرائیوری باز جوان ئے اندا خاطر نی تونگانے ناٹ دا شوم پالے
en: The boy Shamsu has fallen asleep sitting there, sitting... [unclear]... look, the master's driving is very good, that's why he's fallen asleep... [unclear] this evening...
en_old: Boy, Shamsu, sit, sit... Look, the master's driving is very good. That's why... this evening...

brh: سہلنگٹ باز جوانی کودا دانہ زبان صاف شائد اسے ئے تامر بدلیفی نوم فیرنگٹ نما زرین تینٹ چپی ئے ہندا خاطرن ہریت نما چپی ئے کودا لولان واجل
en: [Unclear]... is very good. Now his speech is clear; perhaps someone... changing the name, turning... your [unclear] itself is quiet; that's why, look, your [unclear] is quiet... now... [unclear].
en_old: Speaking is very good... the language is clear... changing the name... your money itself is hidden, that's why your... hidden...

brh: انتو مرلی چوک ئس نی یات بریک پنی تے موتے خانے پنی تے موتے خا گم مبارک نا چنا گدے تے خواجہ کوتا دانا ڈاکٹر برے چاو لٹٹ کسو کیک
en: What — do you remember a Murli Chowk? [Unclear]... congratulations... the child... Khwaja... his doctor comes, let me see... [unclear].
en_old: What, do you remember Murli Chowk? ... congratulations... the doctor comes and sees...

brh: نی کینگا جوانو؟ نا غصہ پین ئے ماسٹر، شمس بلوچ نا برام مننگ ئے
en: How are you, all well? Your anger is something else, Master. Shams Baloch is getting married.
en_old: How are you? Your anger is something else, master. Shams Baloch is getting married.

brh: او دا مچو سو، دا دو مچو سو، البت، البت
en: Oh, this is a little meat, this is two little [portions of] meat — of course, of course.
en_old: Oh, this is mucho, this is two mucho, of course, of course.

brh: دا خدائی نواب دا تو خداسکو مختار دا امرونو دا تو نن ایلکو اور ڈیوٹی تے فیس تے نی خواجہ نن درنجک البتہ نن تے فینو نم
en: This one is a God-made nawab, and this one is God's own mukhtar (master) — what sort are these? This one we ..., and the duties and the fees — you, Khwaja, we ...; though you have ... us.
