en_old: This godly nawab, this is by God… Mukhtar, how is this? We left this, and the duties and fees, you sir… we… you…

brh: دافتان انت زری نور کینو متیفینو؟ گاڑی والا تیان ارف بو۔ ئے فقیر نا چنا نی اوس؟ امر اوس جوڑ اوس؟ ماسٹر دا خواجہ غاتا چناک دزی ئے شروع کرینو۔ نی فائدہ رے؟ خدا لٹم باستو دے۔
en: What money will you get out of these people? Take it from the drivers. Hey, son of a beggar, is that you? How are you, are you well? Master, these sons of the khwajas have started stealing. What do you gain from it? God's stick, too, [will come down] one day.
en_old: What little can you get from these people, what will you bring back? Take it from the drivers. Hey, son of a beggar, is that you? How are you, are you well? Master, these sons of the khwajas have started robbing. What do you get out of it? May God…

brh: اگا نا اوس خوائش شروع کرتے۔ ولے گاڑی والا جند نراڑیکے۔ لولا نراڑیکوس۔ بر ایو خواجہ کدا کمال بسونو نراڑنٹ۔ ماسٹر منیر ہم تودے۔ کنا توار مچے پین وڈے یا خلقونے کنے۔
en: If it's your wish, he started it. But the driver himself is running away. Lolan, are you running away? Come, Khwaja Kuda, they've come — Kamal and the others have come — let's run! Master Munir is with you too. My voice ... or has something struck me?
en_old: …he started pleading. But the driver himself is running away. Lola was running away. Come on, sir, Khuda, Kamal has come, let's run. Master Munir is with you too. My voice is a little… or they'll hit me.

brh: ئے شمس بلوچ اٹ، انتالے خیریت؟ لولان! لولان!
en: Hey, I'm Shams Baloch — what's going on, is everything all right? Lolan! Lolan!
en_old: Hey, it's Shams Baloch. What's going on, is everything all right? Lolan! Lolan!

brh: آ، رادے لولان، البیچے ٹوس
en: Ah, ... Lolan, ... he sat down.
en_old: Ah, Lolan of Ra… …

brh: ئے ٹی ایف ایس مگہ لولانے خنانو ہن گم مرک ہرا لولان لولان انت سے لولان کشمے
en: Hey, T-F-S(?), have you perhaps seen Lolan? He went off and got lost. — Which Lolan? Lolan what? What kind of Lolan... Lolan [kashme]?
en_old: Hey, TFS, have you seen Lolan? He's gone missing. Which Lolan? Lolan what? Lolan Kashme?

brh: بش مسے کنیریتی کنا دماغ خراب کپے شمسو نی جاتو ئس خنس جن ئس خنس آخا نوم داڑے انت دگے گون تفو کسوری نن بسن دا تفو کسور
en: Wake up, don't mess with my head, Shamso! Did you see a witch? Did you see a jinn? After all, what's the name of this place? ... the blocked road(?) — we came, this blocked road(?).
en_old: Be quiet, don't drive me crazy, Shamso. Did you see a ghost? Did you see a jinn? After all, what kind of name is this… we came…

brh: مسلہ اسرے، نوم دادے ایون دوزپ
en: There's one problem: the name of this one is ... Dozap (Hell).
en_old: There's a problem. The name is Dozap (Hell).

brh: پاننگورے، دوز آ کدو، ننے نومے دوز آ کلکونو، ہندا خاطر آن ننا نوما دوک تفوکو، ننے کسل تنے، نن نومے الکونن، دوز نوم تینا ٹورے
en: You're saying 'Doz' ... they've named us 'Doz'; that's why they put 'Doz' on our name, ... us; we took the name; 'Doz' is a name of its own kind.
en_old: They say, "Go to hell." They called us Hell, and that's why our name is… They gave us… we took on the name. Dozakh (Hell) is a name in its own right…

brh: دا تو کنا اسٹوڈنٹ چے ئے نا استاد مسٹنٹا لکھتا بس ٹاٹی کپا بو مختار دا تے گاڈیٹ شا نومی اندا تفینو مطلب ننے نومی اندا دوزخ الکونو
en: This is my student ... his teacher ... Mukhtar, throw these into the car. That's why they gave us this name — I mean, that's why they've called us Dozakh (Hell).
en_old: This is my student… a teacher… Mukhtar, put them in the car. That's why they gave us this name. I mean, they named us Hell.

brh: او دانا نم اسے تو اینن بارڈر مسونن ولک ننتو اوارے اچھا نم اسے تو بارڈر مسورے تا گڑا لولانے دے دوزا
en: And as for this one, you were with ...; today we've been at the border, ... he is together with us. — OK, if you were at the border, then Lolan has [gone] to Doz (Hell)?
en_old: And as for you, we were at the border, and he's with us. OK, if you were at the border, then Lolan is in hell.

brh: شمصو شمصو ڈیٹھ مر ک نی واپس ہنوئی ئے ڈولانے پٹوئی ئے خدا ورس کر ننے دفتم بچف ننے ویل سالو ننے
en: Shamso, Shamso, be bold: you have to go back, you have to search for Lolan. O God, help us, save us this time, we're in trouble.
en_old: Shamso, Shamso, hold steady. You have to go back, you have to find Lolan. God help us, save us from this…

brh: ئے کس پٹپرو ولے دا امر و دزو ننا مال تے لٹانو ننا سواری تے ہرفینو آخر مسئلہ انتئے؟ کودا ایندافتے پئے موٹرسائیکل و گاڑی تے ہرفبو ننا جندے یلہ کبو۔ خیر مریک خیر مریک سہی۔
en: Hey, nobody is going to search for him. But what kind of thieves are these — they've looted our goods, they've taken our vehicles; what's the problem, after all? Kuda, take these motorcycles and cars, just let us ourselves go. It'll be fine, it'll be fine, all right.
en_old: Hey, no one will find out. But how are these thieves looting our goods and taking our vehicles? What's the problem, after all? Uncle, at least take the motorcycles and cars and spare our lives. It'll be fine, it'll be fine, okay.

brh: ئے کاوہ ولے نم سرے پیری
en: Hey, I'm going, but you all go around the top.
en_old: Hey, I'm going, but you go on ahead.

brh: انت حال ئے جوڑ ئس کنا چنا طبیعت نی جوان ئے نم ننے یلہ کبو نن غریب و بندہ غون نن نمے اپن یلپنے دا سوپر تو دے دا دے مرف بو ئے گاڑی تو دے ئے گاڑی والا تینا کاٹم ئے سورفنگے گاڑی ئے مرف
en: How are things, are you well, my son, is your health good? Let us go! We are poor, humble people; we won't ... you ... this Super is ... — move this ...; hey, the car is ... — hey, the driver is shaking his head — move the car.
en_old: How are you, are you well, my son, are you feeling all right? Don't abandon us. We are poor and humble people, we won't abandon you… this… bring it today… hey, bring the car, hey driver, turn your head, bring the car.

brh: ہپ بو نی کنے دا پیوننگا ریش اورک بس سہی سلامت مرس منت وار
en: Hush, you ... me, this white beard ...; just may you be safe and sound — thank you.
en_old: Be quiet, you… me… you arrived safe and sound, thank you.

brh: خواجہ کودا نی انت پاسہ دئے ننے نیلور؟ ئے شمسو ہسبیٹینس ٹیٹ مرے کیہ وارو نیتو نی؟ ئے دنی ٹیٹ اٹ خواجہ کودا
en: Khwaja Kuda, what are you saying — today they'll let us go? Hey Shamso, you've lost heart ... toot ... how many times with you? Hey, with a toot like this, Khwaja Kuda.
en_old: Khwaja Khuda, what are you saying… us? Hey Shamso… how many times with you? Hey…

brh: ماسٹر نی این پاسے؟ کنا پاننگ اینتا سلیس؟ ئے مرزا جون است بیٹینوس ہیچ مفک دا ہفتہ گہ گلاس کرو مروز معاف کریرے زیات انت
en: Master, what are you saying? What was I saying — where did it stop? Hey Mirza Jan, you've lost heart; nothing will happen. This week ... class ...; forgive us, what more can I say.
en_old: Master, what do you say? What am I trying to say? Hey Mirza Jan… nothing will happen. This week… please forgive me, what more can I say.

brh: خواجہ سواری تے دیرے ئے چنا نی ولو کست ہمراہ ئس آخا خواجہ کنا لمہ نا طبیعت خراب ئس استو ایننگ ٹی اسوٹ کہ گولی و دوائی سلیب
en: Khwaja, who are the passengers? Hey son, was there a companion with you? Well, Khwaja, my mother was unwell; I was on my way to get pills and medicine.
en_old: Sir, the passengers… Son, did you have a companion? Well, sir, my mother was ill, I was on my way… so I bought pills and medicine.

brh: ہمو وخت اندا کنے تورینے۔ پشا بو سل بو۔ واجہ واجہ۔
en: Right at that moment they stopped me. Get out(?), stop! Sir, sir.
en_old: Hold me right then. Turn back, stop. Sir, sir.

brh: کڑائی تے جوان لٹ خفتور بو اینو مے یلہ کننگوٹ سیدھا سیدھا امبو کسس دانگ چک خلک تینا سمبر تینا ٹی
en: Give the ... a good beating with sticks — hold your ears! Today I'm letting you go. Straight ahead, straight ahead ... someone pulled this way, ... got himself ready ...
en_old: Beat the scoundrels well! I'm not letting you go today. Right then someone looks up and gets himself ready.

brh: مارک کور یلہ کریر ننے، نی مفت ٹی چرت خلنگٹی ئس ہاو، یلہ تو کریر ننے خواجہ کدا، ولے دانن کہ ہچ الیتو، نی مال، نی عزت، کل لٹار پلار۔ ہمم، بلوچ آ۔
en: ... they let us go; you were worrying for nothing, weren't you? They did let us go, Khwaja Kuda, but now they've left nothing — your goods, your honor, they looted and plundered it all. Hmm, O Baloch.
en_old: They left us blind, and you just kept thinking for nothing. They did leave us, sir, but now that nothing is left, your wealth and your honor have all been looted and plundered. Hmm, O Baloch.

brh: آک بارینو او شیر شیر اسف کشو کنا چالی تپ باز اگیڑا تا وقت نا ہمراہی اٹ فیصلہ کرک ماسٹر خواجہ کدا نند سلو لا نا پٹنگ حیران کانے ئے اموڑے نا ہندوزا کل کور
en: They've come ... lion, lion ... my trick ... much ... with the passage of time it decides, Master, Khwaja Kuda ... searching for Lolan ... I'm amazed ... over there ... all blind.
en_old: They have come... the lion... my trick... with the passage of time he decides, Master, sir, where... the search, surprised... all of them there...

brh: اموڑے کانہ ورنے لولانے ضرور خننے خواجہ پودہ گڑا کنا لومہ
en: We'll go over there, young man; we'll surely find Lolan. Khwaja, ... then my mother ...
en_old: Just like that, young one... I'll definitely see it, sir, then my...

brh: کودا او واجہ کودا کودا خواجہ کودا
en: Kuda, O sir Kuda, Kuda, Khwaja Kuda.
en_old: Where, O sir, where? Where, sir, where?

brh: دا سانی کنا برام کن مچے سوچ خل، است کنا پائک برام ئس کیو، ہیٹ نی خیرات خور، ولے نی کنے دے الیک؟
en: This year give a little thought to my wedding; my heart tells me I should have a wedding. — Get away, you charity-eater! — But won't you let me ...?
en_old: Think about my wedding this year. My heart says I should get married. Hey, you eat charity, but won't you give me a day?

brh: کنے او نی کنے شمس بلوچ ء دل دستٹی تخیرے ہر کس پائے کہ اللہ کنے شمس نا وڑو سالو مسیتے او کماشہ شمس نا عمرے برام
en: Me? Oh, you hold Shams Baloch's heart in your hand. Everyone says, 'O God, make me like Shams' ... and old Shams, at his age — a wedding!
en_old: Me, oh you, you have kept Shams Baloch's heart in your hand. Everyone says, O God, may I be like Shams, and may old Shams have a long life... the wedding.

brh: ناموس خواننگے آ شمشے ئے تس چاسے واجل خواننگی ختم کیک
en: Namoos(?) is studying ... gave it to Shams, you know; Wajal will finish his studies.
en_old: Namoos is studying... gave it to Shams... Wajal finishes his studies.

brh: نی واجو علی اسہ جاگہ غا برام آتے وی آن شاء اللہ
en: You, Wajo Ali — we'll hold the weddings together in one place, God willing.
en_old: You, Wajo Ali, God willing, we'll go to the weddings in one place.

brh: خواجہ دا سورے داڑے دیر تفینے؟ داسہ گھنٹہ ئس مس مون پچیو بندغ ئس تو تودس ہنداڑے تفیتو تین ٹونگینم داسہ کس ئس خناٹ
en: Sir, who has tied up this [sore] here? It's been an hour now ... not a single person ... nobody would tie it here; I've been stuck ...; now I've seen someone.
en_old: Sir, who parked this car here? It's been an hour, and nobody has come to open it. Nobody would park it here... now I've seen someone.

brh: ماسٹر منیر ٹینشن ماسٹر منیر ٹینشن شمسو نشو
en: Master Munir, tension! Master Munir, tension! Shamso, don't get tense.
en_old: Master Munir, tension! Master Munir, tension, Shamso, don't worry.

brh: تومے سلکونے ئے تینٹ ٹینشنٹوٹ کنا موٹرسائیکل ہن مسونے ئے تو ہچ پاتنوٹ نی تینٹ پاسٹ ٹینشن دانا خاطرہ مبارک خوشیٹ فائر کرینے کہ کنے مارس مسونے ہمو سمی دانا جڑونٹٹ خلاصوس جوان ئس
en: [unclear: 'tome salkune'] I myself am stressed. My motorcycle has gone [broken down?], and I haven't said anything, yet you yourself say 'tension'. Because of this, Mubarak has fired shots in joy, saying 'I've had a son'. If we'd been done with fixing it right then, that would have been good.
en_old: Tomorrow you'll stay... you got stressed yourself. My motorcycle was gone and I said nothing, yet you yourself said tension. Because of this, Mubarak fired shots in celebration that he'd had a son. It was a good thing we got rid of fixing it back then.

brh: ماسٹر ئے پاوا دن کہ وڑا کو موٹر سائیکل دننگ نا وڑا ٹف کنا منا خیال ئے ہمم شمزو ئے پاوا ماسٹر نا ہوائی جہاز فارغ ئے
en: Master, I'll put it like this: the way to carry the motorcycle is [to tie it up?]. In my, my opinion it's the same too. Shamzo, I say the master's airplane is finished.
en_old: Tell the master it's like a motorcycle... in my opinion, Shamzo, tell him the master's airplane is useless.

brh: کنے شومئی اسل کنے کہ کنا سنگت آک ہم نمورے شمسو گاڑی سے الے پیستہ بشہ یردو اتیتہ شمسو ہمت کر الے پیستہ کہ کائیک
en: It's really my bad luck that you're my friends too. Shamso, catch a car... [pesta: unclear]. Get up, the two of you bring it. Shamso, have some courage, catch it [pesta: unclear] so it can go.
en_old: I'm really ashamed that even my friends... Shamso, take a car... get up, both of you... Shamso, have some courage, take it, let's go.

brh: یار دا ہرتون دا نا متکوننگا مونیور دا ہرتون دے سلک
en: Man, who is this one standing with? This one's old... Munir, who is this one standing with?
en_old: Man, who is he going to stay with, the one in front of him... who is he staying with?

brh: نی بشے، نی ماسٹر ئس اوس، نی کسس درست کیک، نی تنٹ بش سلے، بشے مت کر۔ ماسٹر، اندا دے گاڑی ئس بننگے۔
en: Get up! You're a mechanic. Is someone else going to fix it? Get up and stand on your own, get up, don't [just sit there]. Master, look, a car is coming right now.
en_old: Get up, you're a master, you fix things for anyone, get up yourself, get up, don't... Master, a car is coming right now.

brh: اسے داغوس سم سلپک داغسیسا اسفتک دا بندہ داڑے تمو کودا تے ویر اسل کونی ملا سو انتھے تھا
en: A... [unclear] ...it doesn't stop... [unclear] ...this man will fall here, then he'll really be in trouble [?]... mullah... what... [unclear]
en_old: One stain... it slips... this man fell here, then... never... mullah... what...

brh: ڈانگبر واللہ کرنگ ٹی پیس
en: Come here, by God, get into the [karang: unclear].
en_old: Dangbar, by God, get out into the...

brh: ماسٹر منیر کسے توار کرک یار ہی باز دم درینگانوٹ دا بلوچاتا خلک اسے ئے نیاڑی کو ہی ہندافتے
en: Master Munir, call someone. Man, I'm very tired. This is a village of the Baloch; the women... these... [unclear]
en_old: Master Munir calls out to someone: friend, I've held on for a long time; this is a custom of the Baloch people, women... these ones.

brh: نصیب تے توار کے بناؤ برے، گودا، سرپند کرک تینا گنوکی، انو تینا مونی الائے، کسس ننے کل بے عزت کیک، مبارک نا کچک، دا بلوچی او خلق سے، ہر کس نا تینا جدا رسم سے، رواج سے۔
en: Call Naseeb and have him come out. Then he'll realize his own foolishness, what's now in front of him [unclear]. Somebody is going to disgrace all of us: Mubarak's dog! This is a Baloch village; everyone has their own separate customs and traditions.
en_old: Call Naseeb and tell him to come. Then he'll realize his own foolishness, what's in front of him. Someone dishonours us all, Mubarak's dog. This is Balochi custom and the people; everyone has their own separate customs and traditions.

brh: خواجہ جی اندن مونی فینوس یلوس مبارک کچک ایٹ لس لچاسوس مبارک نا باوے نا باوے باننگو ہا او اڑے مبارک کنا باوے خواجہ تا اکبر نا خل کھراڑیکے اکبر نا وراء
en: Khwaja ji, like this, forward... [unclear] ...Mubarak's dog... [unclear] ...Mubarak's father's father... Hey, Mubarak, my father... Khwaja's... Akbar's stone... Akbar's... [unclear]
en_old: Khwaja ji went ahead like this and let go... Mubarak's dog... Mubarak's father's father... hey Mubarak, my father... Khwaja's, Akbar's stone... Akbar's...

brh: ئے دے، انداڑے مروئی صبر کر توار کیوتے، سورہ بہا کیس؟ نہ نہ، ایون اخس الیسٹ؟ پنجٹ۔
en: Hey, look, he must be here. Wait, I'll call him. Will you sell the lamb? No, no. How many are there? Five.
en_old: Hey, it'll be right here, wait, call them. How much did you buy it for? No, no, how many did you take? Five.

brh: نم کے میمان بسنے، ببو ننے دوئی کبو، او لمہ، ببو منہ کوٹی ملبو تولبو بندغ ئس بریک، ہاؤ ہاؤ بننگون، لمہ پا کودانہ خلکن
en: Guests have come for you all. Come and receive us. O mother, come (all of you), open a room and sit inside; a man is coming. Yes, yes, we're coming. Mother says, then... [unclear]
en_old: Guests have come to you, come help us. Oh mother, come sit in a room for a while, someone is coming. Yes, yes, they're coming. Mother says then the people...

brh: گودا کمال بسنے او ماسٹر منیرے او شمس بلوچ ہم تودے دا تنی شمس بلوچ کرے اڑے یار کنا میدہ چٹ بیغنیہ باغ ہم پشت ہم بیغنیہ گودا صبر کرک نی کہ ورا سے بسنس نی رغمت
en: Then Kamal came, with Master Munir, and Shams Baloch is with them too. This Shams Baloch says, 'Oh man, my stomach is completely churning; my [bāɣ?] and my back are churning too.' Then he says, 'Wait, you've come at just the right time, your... [raɣmat: unclear]'
en_old: Then Kamal came, along with Master Munir and Shams Baloch. Shams Baloch says: hey friend, my stomach is really aching, my back is aching too. Then he says wait, you've come at the right time, your...

brh: امر رسینگک؟ کان کان سہی ئے اگہ میٹ ہستڑے پین جوانی
en: How will it get there? We'll go, we'll go, it's fine. If there's clay soap [to wash with], even better.
en_old: How is it arriving? It's fine, fine, and if... even better.

brh: سلام علیک۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ جوڑ برابر ارے ببو کانے رغس کنینے۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you peace. Are you well and fine? Come on, let's go eat a meal.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you peace. Are you well? Come, I'm making some for you.

brh: دختو کے واللہ کچاری کنے دا خواجہ کودا کمالی دا ماسٹر منیرے ئے تے پرہ دفتے ایراغس کونینہ ولدا جان پہچان مریکہ بابو خان جوانی بابو
en: [unclear: 'dakhto'] By God, we'll sit and chat. This Khwaja, then Kamal, this Master Munir: tell these folks we'll eat a meal, then we'll get acquainted. Babu Khan, well done, Babu.
en_old: Oh, by God... this Khwaja, then Kamal, this Master Munir, tell them I'll have a meal, then we'll get acquainted. Babu Khan, well done, Babu.

brh: ئے گاڑی ئس ہننگے، ئے کاوا۔
en: Hey, a car is going. I'm off.
en_old: A car is going, it's leaving.

brh: او موٹر سائیکلے گڑا گاڑی اتخینہ کنے بینگونی خلک ایراغس کونین ولدا موٹر سائیکلے جوڑ کینہ کانے ولے حال احوال کیفتہ ولدا ایراغس کونین موٹر سائیکل شاغینہ کانے
en: And the motorcycle, then we'll bring a car [?]. I'm hungry. We'll eat a meal, then fix the motorcycle and go. But they'll exchange greetings and news first, then we'll eat a meal, load the motorcycle and go.
en_old: They take the motorcycle, then the car... they hit me... I'll eat a meal, then fix the motorcycle and go, but they'll exchange greetings, then I'll eat a meal, leave the motorcycle and go.

brh: ایرا غٹ شغان او ایرا کمب و لیمنو اسہ جاہ لے ہفتاد خراسنہ طاقت مریک
en: We put it on the food: food, [kamb: unclear] and lemon together give you the strength of seventy oxen.
en_old: Dinner... and dinner with ... and lemon together gives you seventy horsepower of strength.

brh: خواجہ گودا جوانی اٹ، اشتافی کپہ، اشتافی نا کاریم شیطان نا ئے
en: Then, Khwaja, take it easy, don't rush. Haste is the work of Satan.
en_old: Sir, go slowly and gently, don't rush. Rushing is the work of Satan.

brh: ارے خدا خلتے مونی مونک کرے دا سگ سو پشکونو رنگے لکے تو چاس کے رسوا مسس خدا شمسو
en: Hey, God damn it, it lunged forward [at us]! This pale-coloured dog: if it had caught you, you know, you'd have been disgraced, by God, Shamso.
en_old: Hey, by God, he pushed them forward. This dog, white in colour... if it had been, you'd have been disgraced, by God, Shamso.

brh: شمشو پڈنا کش کننگے اللہ اکبر اللہ اکبر شمشو مچٹ نریفو
en: Shamsho is pulling back [unclear]! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar! Shamsho, don't run, not even a little.
en_old: Shamsho is being pulled. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar! Shamsho, don't run away at all.

brh: نماز؟ ئے رخون والا نماز کے کانہ۔ خدا خلے دا دے کننگ نا وخت ئے
en: Prayer? I'll go to the [raxun vala: unclear] prayer. Damn it, this is the time for eating!
en_old: Prayer? The person who prays... I'll go to prayer. By God, this is the time for eating.

brh: شمشو ککڑ دے نمونے مونک کرے سوکنا جی وٹی تموکے کھپے کھپے دا خوسپوس
en: Shamsho, the chicken went for you all [?]... it would have fallen into my... [unclear] Long live, long live! This... [unclear]
en_old: Shamsho, the rooster pushed its face forward... it fell into the... Long live, long live! This is...

brh: ئنا خسپسا تو بے ایس اوئے پرغار ئے تکنا خفتو ئے سخت بے وڑٹ یار اگئی تولیف کنیف سو ئنا پوش کنے کنا جیبم پشتمک نی اسٹ
en: [unclear] ...he [sleeps?] in a really bad way, man. If... [unclear] ...your shawl... my pocket too... you, one... [unclear]
en_old: Your sleep... the bed... he sleeps very badly, friend. If you bother him... your clothes, my pocket... you...

brh: ئے کاریم ئس کرک، ئے بش مریوہ کاوہ، نی تینا جیب ئٹی کن کے سرا غاس شاغ، سہی؟
en: I'll do one thing: I'll get up and leave. You put a [sarāɣ: unclear, perhaps a piece of food] in your pocket for me, alright?
en_old: He does a job, I'll get up and go. You put it in your pocket, right?

brh: اسٹ تو دا مخز کنا اڑسا، ایرغ کونی کے ملے پکا نی ایرغ نا وخت آ مون تے خیسونٹ سنگانے، خواجہ نیزو بش مسس، کنا جند
en: First of all, this brain of mine got stuck. When it comes to eating, for sure... At mealtime you went red in the face, friends [?]. Khwaja, you got up quickly. As for me myself...
en_old: First, this brain of mine... when going down, for sure, when you were going down you smashed faces, friend. Sir got up, my own self...

brh: دے نا ورا چکپا بسے بسے خواجہ نا مسئلہ اسرے خواجہ نا انت مسئلہ ئے خواجہ نا دا مسئلہ ئے کہ خواجہ سفر اٹ پیش تمک ہیرک کم کنک دا پارے کنا میدہ بینگونی ہم پیش تمکنگے دا سزو ئے
en: [unclear] came, came. Khwaja has a problem. What is Khwaja's problem? Khwaja's problem is that when Khwaja sets off on a journey, he eats very little. He said, 'My stomach... the hunger is starting too.' This is the punishment.
en_old: Every day it comes along. Sir has a problem. What is sir's problem? Sir's problem is that on a journey he gets sick and eats less. He said, 'My stomach is upset too.' This is the punishment.

brh: بش مس پکا دادے ویل اسل کنے
en: He got up. For sure, this is real trouble for me.
en_old: He got up. Sure, leave this to me.

brh: انت پائے تموکے بندہ کینانو نن کے تے
en: What did he say? The man who has fallen (lying there)... what are we to do with him?
en_old: What are you saying, poor man... we...

brh: خدا راستی اٹ ہندونے یا کنا خنک دھوکہ کننگونو؟ ماسٹر آن آن آن آن مس خیرے؟ مس زوبیر ئے تے پارہ کہ انت ویل اسے؟
en: God, is it truly like this, or are my eyes deceiving me? Master... uh, uh, uh, uh... Miss, is everything all right? Miss, tell Zubair what the trouble is.
en_old: God, is this really happening, or are my eyes deceiving me? Master... what happened, is everything all right? Did you tell Zubair what the problem is?

brh: بلوچ خان، واجہ لیف بر، نمے ارے تھمبنگے
en: Baloch Khan, sir, come (lift?) — you have to hold on.
en_old: Baloch Khan, sir, ... come, you have to wait.

brh: جی باوے جوان ہندادو باوے کودانہ دوائی کوٹار ولدا اینے مہلوک کیہ کورا جوان ئے بابول
en: Yes, father, good, that's right, father. ... they [got] the medicine ... Then what will people do now? Fine, Babul.
en_old: Yes, father, good, just like that, father. Where did you get the medicine? Then people now... it's good, father.

brh: تینا احوالے تے واپس اراتم بریسے تینا خواننگ نا کنڈا اندا تو نا اخیرٹ نا چھٹی ختم مریرے ولدا ئے پیش تمو جوان ئے جوان ئے جوان ئے او ولدا گڑا احوال کینے ٹھیک ئے کنا باوہ تینا طبیعت نا خیال
en: [Give him] your news; when you come back, [turn] toward your studies. At the end of this month your holidays will be over, then you'll go on ahead. Good, good, good, and then we'll talk again. All right, my father, take care of your health.
en_old: Bring your news back, come back to your studies. At the end of this, your holidays will be over, then come out. Good, good, good, and then tell us the news. Okay, my father, take care of your health.

brh: اللہ غا سپارو کسکنا سا
en: I entrust you to God, my dear (my life).
en_old: I entrust you to God, my...

brh: جوان سلامت مریس
en: Fine, may you stay safe and well.
en_old: Okay, stay well.

brh: واجل، چھتانی کپے ساؤ؟
en: Wajal, won't you sleep on the roof?
en_old: Wajal, did you sleep on the roof?

brh: وار باری، ایوب علیہ السلام بیمار مس، اللہ پارے آ ہدو نہ فقط پیسے ہنو دے اللہ پی ٹھیک، اللہ نا نبی نا زی امتحان ات بس اور نبی نا زی آزمائش ات
en: Once, Ayub (peace be upon him) fell ill. God said... not only money... the day will go... God, well — a test came upon God's prophet, a trial upon the prophet.
en_old: Once, Ayub (peace be upon him) fell ill. God said... not just money... God tested the prophet, and the prophet was put through a trial.

brh: اولی کل نبی نا کسہ غاتے ئے توڑ میلٹ کینار مختصر قصہ بیان کیو کنا ایوب نا ملکیت مچو اینا اولی کمینار سادار کور مال کمینار شیطان چات خلنگ ٹی کے
en: First, of all the prophets' stories... I will tell a short story: my Ayub's property, all of it... first [his children] were lost; animals, herds and wealth were lost, while Satan was busy striking at him.
en_old: First, I'll tell all the prophets' stories... I'll tell a short story. All of Ayub's possessions... first his children were lost, his wealth was lost, while Satan kept whispering...

brh: دا سا اینو اگر ایوب نبی خبر تما کہ اولیکو مار تا کل کسکونو تو نہ سجدہ کروئی نہ خدا نا ذکر کروئی کاوڑو ایوبے اگر ایوبے خبر افس تو کا بنفر
en: Now, today, if Prophet Ayub gets the news that his eldest sons have all died, he will neither prostrate nor remember God. Let me go to Ayub; if Ayub doesn't know, then go and tell him.
en_old: Now today, if Prophet Ayub learns that his eldest sons have all died, then he will neither prostrate nor remember God. He went to Ayub, thinking that if Ayub doesn't know, then go and tell him.

brh: ددینگ سبق درورا ہاؤ کنا ایوب نا ایمانن قربان مریم ہاؤ کنا نبی نا صبرن قربان مریم ملکیت چکم خلپک اگر نبی نا نظرے تو خدا نا زیے نظرے
en: Take a lesson from this. Oh, may I be sacrificed for my Ayub's faith; oh, may I be sacrificed for my Prophet's patience! He pays no heed to possessions; if the Prophet has a gaze at all, it is upon God.
en_old: This is a lesson in steadfastness. Oh, may I be sacrificed for the faith of my Ayub, oh, may I be sacrificed for the patience of my Prophet. He does not look at possessions; the Prophet's gaze is upon God.

brh: آزے نن آزے سوف نا درخت ئس بار رے تہجد آ کینا نفل آ کینا بس ہر اسیر توم تینا مولی نا پٹوئی بس ہمک کس دیر وتو پھر کتو اللہ بس اینگ کرے اینگ کرے اینگ کرے ننا علاج
en: We are... like an apple tree; we pray tahajjud, we pray nafl; everyone should seek his own Lord. However much time passed, he did not turn back, and God just did this, did this, did this — our cure.
en_old: We are like a tree of patience; at tahajjud he would pray nafl, and everyone should search for their Lord. No matter how much time passed, he did not turn back, and Allah just did this, did this, did this — our cure.

brh: دا کٹے کتو انتئے، نہ نوکری دنیا، مرضی خدا نی ارا دے کے وقت ئس زر ایتک، وقت ئس پلک، وقت ئس اولاد ایتک، وقت ئس پلک، وقت ئس پیسہ ایتک، وقت ئس پلک، ہر حال اٹ توکل خدا غا کر، تو خدا نا اورا غا ہرک، نا ملک اٹ باز کے۔
en: He did not complain — why? Not [for] worldly employment; the will is God's: on whatever day He [wills], at one time He gives gold, at another He takes it away; at one time He gives children, at another He takes them away; at one time He gives money, at another He takes it away. In every situation put your trust in God, then look to God, and He will greatly increase your property.
en_old: Why didn't he complain? Neither the job of this world... it is God's will. He sometimes gives gold, sometimes takes it; sometimes gives children, sometimes takes them; sometimes gives money, sometimes takes it. In every situation put your trust in God, then look to God's side, and He will do much in your land.

brh: دا ہم تو نبی سے شیطان دودھنگ سا بس ارے بے ایمان ارا انگا سفت ایوب نبی پٹی وی دودھنگ سا بس ایوب علیہ السلام سجدہ ٹی تمانے انت کننگ ٹی ادا اللہ نا سجدہ ٹی تمانے
en: He too, after all, is a prophet; Satan came running — that faithless one is like that — to Prophet Ayub, the praiseworthy one, he came running [to lead him astray]. Ayub (peace be upon him) had fallen into prostration. What was he doing? He had fallen into prostration before Allah.
en_old: This is a prophet, after all; Satan has just come to tempt him. The faithless one is there, and the praised Prophet Ayub... he came to tempt him. Ayub, peace be upon him, had fallen into prostration. What was he doing? He had fallen into prostration before Allah.

brh: شیطان توار کرے ایوب حضرت ایوب نی نماز پورہ کرے شیطان مگھنٹی خوشی کلھنٹی کہ اگر اینو دا گپا تے دا اولی دا ایرتت کینگا تے ایوب پین فیر تو ایوب نماز
en: Satan called out: 'Ayub, Hazrat Ayub!' Ayub completed his prayer. Satan was overjoyed, full of delight, [thinking] that if today [I give] Ayub these words — this first [news] and this second — then Ayub will turn away, then Ayub [will abandon] prayer...
en_old: Satan called out: 'Ayub, Hazrat Ayub!' He completed his prayer. Satan was happy, all happy, thinking that if today these words, this first and second news, reach Ayub, then Ayub will turn away... but Ayub prayed.

brh: عبادات آ تلوئے عبادات آ تلوئے اللہ نا ذکر اٹ تلوئے تینا عمر ئم کروئی گناہ تا مار چھرنگوئے لیکن کنا نبی نا ایمان آن قربان مریو شیطان تو بلو ظالم بندس اللہ پاندی آن الشیطان للانسان عدو مبین
en: He stays at worship, stays at worship, stays in the remembrance of Allah, spends his whole life [this way], while the sons of sin roam about. But may I be sacrificed for my Prophet's faith! Satan is a very cruel being; Allah says: 'Indeed, Satan is to man a clear enemy.'
en_old: He is engaged in worship, engaged in worship, engaged in the remembrance of Allah, spending his life; the sons of sin are wandering about. But may I be sacrificed for the faith of my Prophet. Satan is a great oppressor; Allah says: 'Indeed, Satan is to man a clear enemy.'

brh: یا اللہ ننا دشمن ئے ویو ابا قران انت پائے شیطان نما ننا ایتم کبو شیخ نا کننگا پیری وڑزنا تخر کوری دنا دشمن ئے شیطان ننا
en: O Allah, he is our enemy. Well, what does the Quran say? Satan is yours and ours... through the doings of sheikhs and pir-ism he keeps [us] blind... such an enemy of ours is Satan.
en_old: O Allah, take away our enemy. Father, what does the Quran say? Satan is your and our enemy. By the doing of the sheikh and the pir... keep watch; such is our enemy, Satan.

brh: بندغات نا، آن الشیطان للانسان عدو مبین، گڑا شیطان بندہ خم کیک یا شیطان خلیک؟ دشمن خم کروئی یا مڑوئی؟ دشمن کہ نا خلک کے برے خم کیک ستا؟ تو شیطان ہم نا دشمن ء۔ شیطان ء نر، شیطان ء ٹھپ، شیطان
en: ...of people: 'Indeed, Satan is to man a clear enemy.' So does a person bow to Satan or strike Satan? Should one bow to an enemy or turn on him? When an enemy strikes you, will you bow down to him? So Satan is your enemy too. Flee from Satan, hit Satan, Satan...
en_old: Of people: 'Indeed, Satan is to man a clear enemy.' So does a person bow to Satan or strike Satan? Should one bow to the enemy or turn away? When an enemy strikes you, will you bow down to him? So Satan is your enemy too. Flee from Satan, slap Satan, Satan...

brh: خل چوٹٹ خل شیطان نا میدان نا میڑ ہمو خدا نا سجدہ کر کہ چنکی آن بلونی اسکان نی غور کرے نی اور نا زی رحمت کرے شیطان سرمست حضرت ایوب سجدہ ٹی
en: Hit him with a shoe, hit him! [Don't be] a sheep of Satan's field; prostrate to that God who, if you reflect, has shown you mercy from childhood to adulthood. Satan was exultant; Hazrat Ayub was in prostration.
en_old: Strike, strike, strike Satan on the battlefield — prostrate to that same God, for from childhood to adulthood, if you reflect, He has shown mercy upon you. Satan was overjoyed; Hazrat Ayub was in prostration.

brh: پارے ایوب حضرت ایوب نماز ء پورا کرے چہ خلق پارے ایوب نی خبر اف امونی کسوئی جتن مرونک کرینوس امونی کلانے پاتت کے سا پئی خبرے تنسے پئی اولیک نا کلیک نار
en: He said, 'Ayub, Hazrat Ayub' — Ayub completed his prayer — then he said: 'Ayub, don't you know? Those of yours have died... all of yours...' So he gave him the news: 'Your eldest ones, all of them, [are gone].'
en_old: He said, 'Ayub, Hazrat Ayub,' when he had completed his prayer. Then he said, 'Ayub, you don't know — your house has collapsed, your sons have all died.' He told him the news: your eldest ones have all died.

brh: ایٹ گنا کل نا نار کور نا مچو ہرا چھناک تا خیرک ضعیفہ چھناک تا بھلو بے ایمانی سے دا گلا نی کہ دا بندہ غا تو چھنا کم تھیر جن تو تو کائپک بے ایمان قیامت ئس کا نری چھناک تا خیر گنا
en: ...all of yours, your sons and the rest, all of them — the welfare of the children... wives, children... It is a great faithlessness, this complaint of yours that this man has few children... the faithless one does not... a Day of Judgment... the children's welfare.
en_old: ...all of his sons, all of his ones, the welfare of the children, the elderly — it is a great faithlessness to complain that this person's children are few... the faithless one, on the Day of Judgment... the welfare of the children.

brh: نبی نا سوئے دے کپک اللہ پی بے ایمان غلط توس دا نبی سے نبی خبرے تم تو چنا کمینار ضعیفہ کمینار مار کور مسن کمینار توی نبی سوئے دا ٹی شیطان دودینگا او ایو
en: The Prophet does not mourn. God... the faithless one was wrong: this one is a prophet. When the news reached the Prophet that his children had perished, his wives had perished, his sons had perished, even so the Prophet did not mourn. At this Satan ran off, and...
en_old: The Prophet did not grieve. Allah... the faithless one was wrong; this is a prophet. When the news reached the Prophet that his children had died, his elderly ones had died, his sons had died, the Prophet did not grieve. In this Satan tempted him, and he...

brh: او ماک ننار اران مچو تباہ برباد مس پی اللہ اکبر ئے ظالم نی ترس کپے سکنی ئے اللہ نا نبی اوٹ خدا نا قسم ئے اللہ نا تورواتی شیف کنے کپرا این تینا چنا تو مجلس کریٹہ کچاری کریٹا داسہ اللہ تینا امانت واپس کرے
en: And the sons, the houses — everything was destroyed and ruined. Then — God is great! — 'O cruel one, have you no fear? I am the prophet of God. By God, I will not belittle God's [decree]. These were my own children; I used to hold gatherings and councils with them; now God has taken back His trust.'
en_old: All of my sons have been destroyed and ruined. Then — Allahu Akbar — 'O oppressor, you are not afraid? I am the Prophet of Allah. By God, I do not object to Allah's decree. These were my children; I held gatherings and councils with them; now Allah has taken back His trust.'

brh: کنے تو بلو ٹائم ئس بسم اللہ کہ اللہ نا تعریف کیو اللہ نا سجدہ کیو اللہ نا عبادت کیو دا سا تو بلو کنے ٹائم ئس جوانوں ملا ئے اللہ نا تھورا واتے شیف کنے کپا دا سا مچو ٹائم خدا نا سجدہ کیوا
en: Now I have plenty of time — in the name of God — to praise God, to prostrate to God, to worship God. Now I have a lot of time; good, mullah. I will not belittle God's [decree]; now all my time I will prostrate to God.
en_old: For me it is a great time, in the name of Allah, to praise Allah, to prostrate to Allah, to worship Allah. This is a very good time for me, mullah. I do not object to Allah's decree; now all the time I will prostrate to God.

brh: اللہ اکبر ہو نبی نا ایمان آن قربان مریو یہ تو نبی تھا نبی ہم تو ویسے کام نہیں کر سکتے یہ تو خدا کا نبی تھا اللہ نا نبی اللہ نا تبر بے ایمان شیطان نا تبر پئے جند تے بیمار کر گڑا
en: God is great! Oh, may I be sacrificed for the Prophet's faith! He was a prophet; we can't do such things just like that — he was God's prophet. God's prophet is of God's line; the faithless one is of Satan's line. Then he made his body sick.
en_old: Allahu Akbar! May I be sacrificed for the Prophet's faith. He was a prophet; a prophet can't do just anything — he was God's prophet. The Prophet of Allah is of Allah's party; the faithless one is of Satan's party. Then he made his body sick.

brh: اول کہ نصیحت ایلی اور بے ایمانی نن ہم نمازی دیندار بندغ نماز مرے بیمار مرے نماز خوانپ نا شیطان خوشی کیک کہ جوان مس نماز تہ ہنا روچتہ ہنا قران نا تلاوت ہنا پا آن شاء اللہ آن شاء اللہ شیطان
en: First, a word of advice... and faithlessness: we too — a praying, religious person — when it is time for prayer he falls ill and does not pray, and Satan rejoices that it went well: his prayer is gone, his fasting is gone, his Quran recitation is gone. Say 'God willing, God willing' — Satan...
en_old: First, giving advice... and faithlessness: we too, the praying, religious people — if one falls sick and does not pray, Satan is happy that it went well: prayer is gone, fasting is gone, recitation of the Quran is gone. Say, 'God willing, God willing.' Satan...

brh: تون مقابلہ کینا تینا رحمانے راضی کینا اللہ نا قرآنے بنبو حضرت ایوب بیمار مس انت مس ادا پا نبی کہ ہم بیمار مریرہ پا نبی کہ ہم بیمار مریرہ باز آ غریبہ کھلی رنہ
en: ...we compete with him, we please our Most Merciful; listen to God's Quran: Hazrat Ayub fell ill. What happened to him? Here — say that prophets too fall ill; say that prophets too fall ill. Many poor people...
en_old: ...compete with him, please your Most Merciful, read Allah's Quran. Hazrat Ayub fell sick. What happened? Here, say that prophets too fall sick; say that prophets too fall sick. Many poor people...

brh: ایتن کہ نبی نبی نبی بیمار مفسا قران شاہد ء کہ نبی ہم بیمار مس نی تو پاسہ کنا سائیں بیمار مفٹ اگر کھڈ کیست قبر تیس تا ولدا بنداتے پاسا
en: ...that a prophet — a prophet, a prophet — does not fall ill? The Quran is witness that the Prophet too fell ill. And you say, 'My sain does not fall ill.' If he goes into a pit, into a grave, then what will you tell people?
en_old: ...that a prophet, a prophet, a prophet does not fall sick. The Quran is witness that the Prophet too fell sick. And you say, 'My sain does not fall sick.' If he dug a grave... then what do those people say?

brh: دا نننا ہنانے زائرینانی بلکہ سائیں نا گپاتے پرنٹنگ نا توار ننا شادی مرادی ٹی سائیں بریک اگر بیمار مریرے تینا سائیں توار کین تو جی کے کین ننا بیماری تے مر کیک اگر سائیں کس کنے دنیا غان ہنانے
en: This is how it is with us devotees — rather, the sain's words... The sain comes to our weddings and celebrations; if we fall ill, we call on our sain and say 'yes, sir', and he drives away our illnesses. If the sain has died, has gone from this world...
en_old: This is our going, of the pilgrims; rather, the sound of printing the sain's words. The sain comes to our weddings and celebrations. If we fall sick, we call on our sain and say 'yes,' and he heals our illnesses. If the sain... someone has departed from the world.

brh: سئی دنیا ہی نا دنیا نا حال نا دینا وقت ئس تغ تے او وقت ئس سما او کئی کنا جلسات آن مثلا دھرے پیر اتھ کیرنگن بہرحال سخت اورے چنے کنا ایلم آ کہ ایوب نبی بیمار ہژدہ سال بیمار لیکن اللہ اعتبار کرے اللہ پرے کنا نبی
en: Right, the world, the state of the world... a time of sleep and a time of being awake. And from my gatherings, for example, old people ... anyway it is hard there... My brothers, the Prophet Ayub was sick, sick for eighteen years, but he trusted God, and God said: 'My prophet...'
en_old: Right, the world, the state of the world... there is a time to sleep and a time... from my gatherings, for example... anyway, it is hard. My brothers, the Prophet Ayub was ill, ill for eighteen years, but he trusted in God. God said: my prophet.

brh: ارکض برجلک ہذا مغتسل بارد و شراب او کنا ایوب نبی جی کنا نیننگا اللہ پیدا تہ ہرتو منت تے تنوس ہرتو مکھڑی تے تنوس صرف گڑا کھیر نا دیر ئس پیش ت موئے ہمو دیر نا ذریعہ خدانے جوڑ کرے
en: 'Strike the ground with your foot: this is a cool bath and a drink' [Quran 38:42]. And my Prophet Ayub, yes, my ... God brought it about: with both his feet, with both his heels [he struck], and only then some water came out. Through that water God made him well.
en_old: 'Strike with your foot: this is a cool bath and a drink.' My Prophet Ayub, sir... God created... he struck with his feet, he struck with his heels, and only then a stream of water came out. Through that water God healed him.

brh: کہ وا حضرت ایوب پی کہ نہ اللہ ئے پشمنی کپرا نہ کنا ہتہ و ملنٹی بیماری ال بوک درینو کنا نت تے کنا مچو جان درینو مچو جان نا کنا سول لگڑے نا ہرے نا نی سئیں نت تے
en: Hazrat Ayub says: 'I do not complain against God. The illness is not only in my hands and back; it has taken hold of my legs, it has taken my whole body, my whole body...' You know, sir, the legs...
en_old: Hazrat Ayub said: 'I do not complain about God. The illness is in my hands and back, in my legs, in my whole body, my whole body...' You know, the legs...

brh: ار بڑزا کنے کپر بش مننگ کپرا پارے کنا نبی بش مفو تینا نت تے دوار بڑزا کپا ارکض برجلکا انن کے خاچوک استنا سرے پا ہرتو مکھڑی تے دریخ دغارے لوڈو تنے نا
en: 'I cannot get up, I cannot stand up,' he said. My prophet could not stand; he could not lift his own legs up again. 'Strike with your foot': lying there as he was, with both his heels [he struck] the ground...
en_old: He could not lift himself up, he could not stand. My prophet could not rise. He could not lift his legs. 'Strike with your foot.' He struck the ground with his heels.

brh: دا کارم دغارے خوشکنگ نا کارم نی خوش توسئی گڑا ہرتوسئی ہندن ہرتوم نت تے تون کرے سبحان اللہ او علاقہ ٹی دیر ہم الو اگر پنچ سد فٹ شیف خلو دیر ہم ملتاو کا لیکن کنا نبی ایوب بیمار ئس
en: This work is the work of rubbing the ground; you rub it, then both... and so he did it with both feet. Glory be to God! In that area there was not even any water; even if you dug five hundred feet down you would not find water. But my Prophet Ayub was sick.
en_old: This work of digging the ground... you are happy, then he struck it with his feet. Glory be to God! In that area there was no water; even if you dug five hundred feet down you would not find water. But my Prophet Ayub was ill.

brh: نا کمزور آ نبی ہژدہ سال نا بیمارنگا نبی توحید پر صبر کروکا نبی ہرتومن نت تے تنا کھڑی تے تنا ہنا ڈغار تے خلک نکت یخ مننگ شروع کرے کیرغان چشمہ سدین نا پیدا مس کنا ایلم آک نبی نا نت تے
en: The weak prophet, the prophet sick for eighteen years, the prophet who was patient and steadfast in the oneness of God, struck that ground with both his feet and his heels, and it began to turn cold, and a spring appeared. My brothers, the prophet's feet...
en_old: Your weak prophet, the prophet ill for eighteen years, the prophet patient in his belief in one God, struck the ground with his legs and heels, and it began to turn cool. A spring of cool water came forth. My brothers, the prophet's legs...

brh: دیر سرمست نبین و سبات خوش مست فارق نہ لا دیر اسپیشت و مانے پیا او نبی ئے کشانٹ نا دیرے مچو دنیا مچ مروس داکہ دیرے کشنگ کتوک دا دیر نہ کشنگ نہ مہربانی کنا خدا نی دینا ئے بابا تا
en: The water... the prophet became overjoyed and happy... the water is special, and the water that the prophet drew out: even if the whole world gathered, they could not draw out this water; this water cannot be drawn out. It is mercy, my God's... whose is it, sir?
en_old: The water... the prophet drew it out. The whole world gathered, but no one could draw this water. This water could not be drawn. It is a mercy, my God, it is your gift, sir.

brh: طاقت دینائے؟ اللہ نا طاقت سئی دیر تو پئیستما، پئی ایوب آ، جی کنا اللہ، پئی دیخ کن تو سئی۔ دیخ کن، ہنو گل مے ہلکس، تینا بیماری تے کل ختم کیوا۔ علاج دے کلین تھی
en: Whose power is it? It is God's power, right. The water came out. He said to Ayub, 'Yes, my God.' He said, 'Drink water, right.' 'Drink'... '...I will end all the illnesses.' The treatment...
en_old: Who gives the strength? It is God's strength. Right, water came out for Ayub. Yes, my God, for drinking, right. For drinking... I will end all my illnesses. The treatment...

brh: بیمار دیرے؟ او رد کرو رے، علاج دے کننگ ٹی، اورے ہم بڈزا کیوا، بیمار دیرے؟ تو نبی ہم بیمار ئے نبی نا علاج دے کے، اوڑے ایہن ئے بیمار مرین گڑا، اللہ بیمار کپنے، اگر بندہ نا
en: Who is sick? He would refuse it, refuse getting treatment; there too I will raise it up. Who is sick? Well, the prophet too was sick, and the prophet was given treatment. There, if someone becomes sick like this, then... God does not make anyone sick, if a person's...
en_old: Water for the sick? He rejects it, in treatment he also lifts it up. Water for the sick? Then the prophet was also sick and the prophet was treated. If someone is sick like that, then... if God does not make a person sick...

brh: دا غٹ اسہ کسر اٹ ئے پین بیماری ئس مرے گڑا توار دیر کک، اللہ، اگر اللہ کھلی نمنا عقیدے تے تو وعظ نا ضرور تمپک آن شاء اللہ، لیکن ہمو کسر اٹ تو کل ٹھیک ٹھاک او، اراغے کانہ گڑا پیر انگا بلا کل اٹ بے ہمراہ دنت ئنا است ئنے پارے ہم پین، دا ہیت ئنو، اوڑے دیر او دا
en: All this is one way: if there is some other illness, then one calls out for water... God. If God ... your beliefs, then there would be no need for a sermon, God willing. But in that way everything is fine. The food... then the old man and old woman, with everyone, without a companion... he also said something else to his heart. This is the talk... there, water and this...
en_old: All of this in one way: if there is another illness, then water... God. If God... your beliefs, then sermons would not be needed, God willing. But in that way everything is fine...

brh: ننا نا بالاد آک نومیں بارانو نما پچاک ننا استو صرف خیسن و رومال سفید و ک مٹائینتو تبدیل تو متو لیکن ئے تنا دے کہ اللہ نا قران ء بنفوئی تاکہ ننا ہم ایمان تازہ مرے و ہر مسلمان نا ایمان تازہ مرے دیر پنگ
en: Our statures are like yours, your clothes and ours... only red and white handkerchiefs, and nothing was changed. But this is the day when we should listen to God's Quran, so that our faith too is renewed and every Muslim's faith is renewed... water...
en_old: Our elders, our forefathers... only our hair and beards turned white and changed, but this is our day to read God's Quran, so that our faith is renewed and the faith of every Muslim is renewed... water...

brh: الحمدللہ تن بیماری نا الحمدللہ سائیں تن بیماری سائیں تن بیماری نا پر جان کن مچو سلنا رے پارے کن نبی گردی کپا ئنا دیرن سر غت آن شا غسل کر کن نبی نیٹ چار دن پھلمبا
en: Praise God for the illness of the body; praise God, sir, for the body's illness, sir, for the illness of the body... for the whole body... He said to my prophet: 'Pour the water over your head, all over, and bathe.' My prophet... four days... the sores...
en_old: Praise God for the illness, praise God, sir, for the illness, sir... for the whole body... He said to the Prophet: strike with your foot, and bathe your head in that water... the Prophet... four days... the blisters...

brh: نا بیماری پنچ منٹ ٹی ختم کیوا نبی دیر تنا جان ئے شاغا خدا نا قسم ئے اللہ نا قران شاہد ئے ارکض برجلک ھذا مغتسل بارد و شراب ماشاءاللہ کنا وائدا ناسٹ
en: 'I will end your illness in five minutes.' The prophet poured the water over his body. I swear by God, God's Quran is witness: 'Strike with your foot: this is a cool bath and a drink.' Mashallah, my promise...
en_old: I will end your illness in five minutes, Prophet, pour the water on your body. By God, God's Quran is witness: 'Strike with your foot; this is a cool bathing place and a drink.' Mashallah, my promise...

brh: بندا کہ نن دڑنگ پارہ اخرو قدسے نا چٹی اخرو سے۔ ہا سئیں! طاقت ئنے، قلم ئٹی طاقت ہم ارے نا؟ آخری کنا عید، ئے ہنتونا اسے واک اٹی تینا وعدہ پورا کریر، پین واک ئس تو ئے اسکا لیکن بس دا ملا ئنا، عالم آک بزرگ آک بازو، کنا عید
en: A person, whom we call ... the last ... Yes, sir! It is power; there is power in the pen too, isn't there? Lastly, my Eid: they fulfilled their promise in one ..., and another ... had been, but just these mullahs, the scholars and elders, are many. My Eid...
en_old: A person, that we... the last one... Yes, sir! Strength... there is power in the pen too, isn't there? Lastly, my Eid... in one step they kept their promise, another step... but just these mullahs, scholars, many elders... my Eid.

brh: ایلوماک ہراتم ایوب نبی غسل کرے سبحان اللہ ورنا تم بار بش مس ایم تو بش من نی ہم کتوک آ خاچوک ئس خیر نہ زیلغے دا تا بش مس چھرینگ شروع کرے ایلوماک او کنا ایلوماک دا ایتے بنبو بیمار ء بش مس
en: Brothers, when Prophet Ayub bathed, glory be to God, he stood up like a young man. 'Stand up, you who were lying there [sick]'... and he stood up and started walking around. Brothers, O my brothers, listen to this: the sick man stood up.
en_old: Brothers, when Prophet Ayub bathed, Subhanallah, he became young and stood up... 'I have got up, you too who were lying down'... he got up and started walking. Brothers, my brothers, listen to this: the sick man got up.

brh: بندہ کہ جوڑ مریگ پاک خاچنگ وڑ پگتا گڑا تو چکر ہم کیک نبی کے بیمار خاچوک ئس کا ہنون بش مت پچاتن کشا ہمے پچاتے خوکو پچاتے کرے دے درست کیک زائیو بے پلم مار لگے ہنتی بیماری
en: When a person gets well after lying in bed like that, he even walks around. The prophet, who had been lying sick, then got up and took off his clothes, those clothes, the ... clothes, and he becomes sound again, young, without sores; that illness [went away].
en_old: When a person gets well after lying sick, he even feels dizzy... the Prophet had been lying sick... he got up, took off those clothes, those old clothes... he becomes healthy, young, without blisters... that illness...

brh: ایٹی پین نمونہ مریک جوڑی نا شکل پین مریک کنا ایلوم آک ایوب ہراتم جوڑ مس اللہ نا نبی تو بش مس دا کنا مورے ناز و نخرہ دے اینگن ضعیفہ ہم پریشان چکر کلنگ ٹی کہ ارے تو کاوڑینگاک کنا زی غصہ کرے کہ مور مر کنا مونی ئے
en: There it takes another form; the appearance of health is different. My brothers, when Ayub became well, God's prophet stood up. Now this ... fussing and airs... today the wife too was worried, going around searching, and she got upset; she got angry with me...
en_old: Here is another example; the appearance of health is different. My brothers, when Ayub became well, God's Prophet got up. This, my wife's fussing... today the old woman too is worried, going around searching, she got angry, she was angry with me... 'wife, die before me'...

brh: غلطی کیٹ مڑ مسٹ ہیکاو تین ارغئی نبی صلی اللہ نا بلکہ دیر خواہوئے اوتم کاوٹ ٹی کنے پارے اینو کاویٹ ہورف توتوسے باز بیمار ئس کنا ارے بلکہ دیر ئس خواہی بلکہ ارغ ئس خواہی بلکہ خوش مرے کنے تون کامو
en: 'I made a mistake, I was late... maybe the Prophet, peace be upon him, wants water.' Then, as I was going, it came to me: 'Today I went off and did not look after him; I have someone very sick at home; maybe he wants some water, maybe he wants some food, maybe he would be glad with me...'
en_old: I made a mistake, I came back... the Prophet, peace be upon him, maybe wants water. Then in anger she told me: today I went... I have a very sick one, maybe he wants water, maybe he wants food, maybe he'll be happy with me...

brh: مر آن ہورے وتہ خوڑکم پارا کہ کنا ایوب نبی نا حال انتے اراٹم آئی دانگہ بلن ٹی ہمو جاگہ نشان کرین اراٹ نبی خاچوک اسکہ داسہ تو ایوب جوڑ مس مرے نا تولوک ئے مر آن اینگہ نہ ایوب نبی ہورا کہ کنا ضعیفہ بلن ٹی ہمو جاگہ ہورین ٹی کنے پٹن ٹی
en: She looked far and near and said, 'What has become of my Prophet Ayub?' She pointed to the place in the room where the Prophet had been lying. Now Ayub had become well and was sitting some way off. Prophet Ayub saw from afar that his wife was looking at that place in the room, searching for him.
en_old: She looked and said, what has become of my Prophet Ayub? She pointed in the room to the place where the Prophet had been lying. Now Ayub had become well... sitting... Prophet Ayub saw that his wife was looking at that place in the room, searching for him.

brh: دا غندا زئیفہ بنٹی دنو را خنتو ایوب علیہ السلام ء زئیفہ او زئیفہ او ننا والا گڑس بیمار مرے پئی لمہ غا کاوا ارے قران خلے نی اریغ نی بیمار ء لمہ غا مرے کاسہ
en: This same wife came in and did not see him like this, the wife of Ayub, peace be upon him. That wife... and as for ours: if [the husband] gets a little sick, she says, 'I'm going to my mother's'... 'You are sick? [I'm going] to my mother's'... 'You go.'
en_old: This old woman came in and did not see him like this, Ayub's, peace be upon him, wife... if one of ours falls sick, he says to his mother... recite the Quran... food... you are sick... to the mother...

brh: سرکشی ہرا غے ضعیفہ کشی یا پینس کشی پین تے تینا کورتہ مکھم ئے کش وتا ئے کھاوا بد سرغہ ہمودینا لمغہ ہرغے نا دے ککڑ مار تھی ڈیکے و بندہ غا تو صفتک سے الحمدللہ کل برام
en: Defiance... the wife pulls [him] away, or someone else does... tells the others to take off his shirt... a bad head... that day to his mother... a chicken... and for the man there is praise; thank God, the whole marriage...
en_old: Rebellion... the old woman pulled, or someone else pulled... his shirt... a bad head... the mother... that day, a chicken... and for the person, praise, thank God, all is well.

brh: اگر لیکن سے کنا زئیفہ نا مٹہ زئیفہ ہمو دے بیماری ٹی اللہ ہنا کھین نا پد گڑا گد لک ٹیس مش ہسک مورت نا ہائے خیرات اٹ دنو ارغس کنا اسک کہ دنو ارغس کاتے ملتو اگر دنو زیبا و جوان ارغس آ بے مراد نراتن تئی نی
en: But if my wife ... that day, during the illness, God ... after that ... from the charity for the dead, I had such a meal, such a meal as you could not get; if such a fine and good meal...
en_old: But my wife... that day in the illness, God... after that... for the sake of the dead, from charity, such food... such food you did not get; if such fine and good food...

brh: دا سلومہ باوہ نا اراغ نا، دا سلیکو خلیک، کنا ارغ کن دن پیسہ تسکہ اینگن مش مالف کھاوڑنگو کس، کنا ارغ کن کہ دن نکاح اسکہ، دن بیزاری اسکہ، دن میوہ اسکہ، ارانغ بسکہ لوتا ٹنگورن پھرسرا اینگن بے
en: This is father's food... for my food she had given so much money... for my food there was such a ..., such ..., such fruit; the food had come...
en_old: This is father's food... for my food she gave so much money... for my food, such a marriage, such weariness, such fruit... the food came...

brh: ئے بیماری تری غلہ نا، او ایوب نا ضعیفہ، او نبی نا ضعیفہ، بس نی ہورینٹی دانگ ہورینٹی ہونگ ہورینٹی، تھی تھی ملان لیکن کسے تو پورب خروئی، دانگ ہوری ہونگ ہوری، ایوب علیہ السلام مرا خناتا کہ ضعیفہ کنے پٹینٹی، پد دانگ بر دانگ
en: ...the illness... O Ayub's wife, O the Prophet's wife, you are just looking, looking this way, looking that way... but someone ... looking this way, looking that way. Ayub, peace be upon him, saw from afar that his wife was searching for him: 'Then come here, here...'
en_old: ...the illness... Ayub's wife, the Prophet's wife, just look here, look there, ... but someone... look here, look there. Ayub, peace be upon him, saw that his wife was searching for him: then come here...

brh: دانگ بر دانگ بر دانگ بر او مائی دانگ بر ضعیفہ نا غریب نا ضعیفہ کے دروغ آ کہ اریک اناف شاید اینا دنیا غا ہرا نگنا داد اف جوڑ مننگ نا آسرو اللہ کا ہنانے این کنے حضرت ایوب علیہ السلام پچ کرے جوان
en: Come here, come here, come here, O woman, come here. His wife, his poor wife, [wondered] whether it was a lie, whether he was there or not; perhaps today in this world ... there is no hope of getting well... God ... Hazrat Ayub, peace be upon him, got dressed, fine...
en_old: Come here, come here, come here, O woman, come here. The poor wife... whether it's a lie or not, perhaps today in this world... no hope of getting well... God... today Hazrat Ayub, peace be upon him, opened up to me, well...

brh: خیر و ٹھیک ٹھاک دے پائیدامے بیماریاں نبی پھلمباں لگنگ ٹی چاردھنوں تھوئے بار پیمائیدانگ وا ضعیفائنا پارے خیر ارے دیرے پٹیسا فہیدادے کنا ارے ایوب نبی بیمار اسکا کرے
en: Safe and sound... the illnesses, the Prophet's sores... four days... He said to the wife, 'Is all well? Whom are you looking for?' 'My ... Prophet Ayub, who was sick...'
en_old: Well and fine, the day... the illnesses, the Prophet's blisters... four days... the wife said, is all well? Searching for water... my Prophet Ayub was sick...

brh: ئے کبر نغائی لا چنار اینو بسڑ ہورب تنارے جی باز بیمار اسکہ لیکن خبر درانگنا پئے ایت خبر امروس ئس کرغنا اسارغ مونا ٹی لیکن داسے جوڑے بیماری پین دونا اورا پئے
en: ...today I came to see him; yes, he was very sick, but I have no news of where he went... news... in front... but now he is well; the illness ...
en_old: ...today she came to see... said he was very sick, but news... ask... but now he is well, the illness...

brh: نی مبارک سس کا پی موئی اوٹ اللہ اکبر ماشاء اللہ چٹی کاریم کرے سئی استار مٹیان تیت کے بہرحال خوش مسٹ بہرحال خوش مسٹ الحمدللہ اللہ ارے غمنو
en: Congratulations to you... Allahu Akbar, Mashallah, what a deed he did... Anyway, I became happy, anyway, I became happy; praise be to God, God is there in sorrows...
en_old: Congratulations to you... Allahu Akbar, Mashallah, you did very fine work... anyway, I was happy, anyway, I was happy, praise God, God has sorrow...

brh: ننا دا سختہ فکر پیدا جی کاپی کے سوری ٹو سے سنگتاک شینل فالو کبو او للو کبو آغا فلوت کے نی پروگرامی جو ختم کنے گچیان ننا داسے پشکون جوشک بننگو نی داسے ننا ٹینشن او شتیسس ننے بے ہوش کرے سیار ہتو گڑا امر
en: This serious worry of ours has arisen... yes... sorry... Friends, follow the channel and like it... you end the program... our ... now ... now our tension and stress knocked us unconscious... then how...
en_old: We have this serious worry... sorry... friends, follow the channel and like it... you end the program... our tension and stress made us unconscious... then how...

brh: ئے ما پتی ارا کہ بنگلی اوڑتون انتئے چڑا دا دشمنی نا وجہ انتئے؟ یار ئے اوڑان ئنا وجہ غان خولیوے کنا اوستامی مستنا جنگاک بریک دا خانی نی کسر وجہ جیئے بریک نی پاسے ایرا تلوار تے ٹنگی
en: Do you know why Bangli is angry with him? What is the reason for this enmity? Friend, I am afraid of him because ... my old fights come back ... You put it aside and hang up the two swords.
en_old: Do you know why Bangli is angry with him? What is the reason for this enmity? Friend, I'm afraid of him because my old fights come back. Why does this happen, what is the reason? Put it aside and hang up the swords.

brh: لیکن نی انن پاسہ کہ کنا سائیں کے تنے برکو مٹاوینے دیخ پردن اوٹ ٹیننے ہنانے اگر ننے مار متو ہمسائی کانا سائیں ننے مار نہ پھل لاتے توئے اگر مسڑ متو ننے سائیں
en: But you say it like this: 'My saint, ...' ... if we don't get a son, [you say] 'saint, my saint, [grant] us the fruit of a son' ... and if we don't get a daughter, 'saint, [give] us ...'
en_old: But you say this: my lord, how many days has it been since it left you... If we have no son, O neighbor, my lord, if we are not given a son, if we have no daughter, my lord...

brh: اینا دربارے کانو سائیں مسڑنا پلا تے توننے دانگن اللہ نا قران توار کیک اینٹی کے بندغ نی کور مفہ نی کر مفہ نی منڈ مفہ کنا قران پنتو سے کل مسئلہ تے خدا نامونے ظاہر کیو اللہ سے پٹی و ایوب اذ نادی ربہ
en: We go to his shrine: 'Saint, for a daughter ...' Allah's Quran proclaims, in it [it says] that, O man, you will not become blind, you will not become deaf, you will not become lame; my Quran is counsel, God has made all problems plain by name. Allah [says]: 'And Job, when he called to his Lord...'
en_old: At His court, my lord, for the sake of a daughter... The Quran of Allah calls out: through it, O man, you will not be blind, you will not be deaf, you will not be lame; through my Quran God will reveal every problem by name... Allah... and Job, when he called to his Lord.

brh: انی مسنے الضر وانت ارحم الراحمین اللہ تعالی پارے واذکر عبدنا ایوب اذ نادی ربہ انی مسنے الشیطان بنصب وعذاب
en: "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful." Allah Almighty said: "And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord: 'Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment.'"
en_old: "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful." Allah Almighty said: "And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord: Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."

brh: ارکض برجلک ہذا مغتسل بارد و شراب ئے کنا ایلم قران نبی ایوب نا واقعہ پیش کننگٹی تاکہ چنکا کم سمجھیر، بلا کم سمجھیر، مولوی ہم سمجھی، پیر ہم سمجھی، مرشد ہم
en: "Strike [the ground] with your foot: this is a cool bathing place and a drink." O my brothers, the Quran is setting out the story of Prophet Job so that the young also understand, the old also understand, the mullah also understands, the pir also understands, the murshid also
en_old: "Strike the ground with your foot; this is a cool bath and a drink." My brother, the Quran presents the story of Prophet Job so that the young may understand, the old may understand, the cleric may understand, the pir may understand, and the spiritual guide too.

brh: سمجھی کہ نبی بیمار ئے ئے تو نبی سفت گناہگارو بندغ سے اٹ اگر نبی بیمار ئے تو تے جوڑ کننگ تیتا اگر ئے بیمار مریو کنے دیر جوڑ کروئی ارا خدا نبی جوڑ کرے پا ہمو خدا نی ہم جوڑ کروئی
en: understands that the Prophet was sick; and I, compared with the Prophet, am a sinful person. If the Prophet got sick, then healing him [was God's]; if I fall sick, who will heal me? The God who healed the Prophet, say, that same God will heal you too.
en_old: Understand this: if the Prophet falls sick, then what about a sinful person like me? If the Prophet falls sick, who heals him? If I fall sick, who will heal me? God healed the Prophet; that same God will heal you too.

brh: ننا وکسک جتاؤ، باوہ بیمار ئے بلو مت سے خفٹی تے دوئی شاغانے گھرسدیک تا، اوڑے خیر ترے ماما ہران سئیں ہموکیں ملا تے سیداتے کلے ہنان ہچامت او، تاس ہموک سئیں ئے کانے بس ہموک
en: Our times were different: [if] father was sick, an elder would put something into his ear ... the household ... There [people asked]: 'Is everything all right? Uncle, where [are you going], sir?' We all went to those mullahs and sayyids, nothing came of it ... then, sir, I go ... just to those ...
en_old: Our ... is separate; the father is sick, an elder has put amulets in his hand, the household members... there, is he well? Uncle, where did they go, my lord? They all went to those mullahs and sayyids... and then they came, my lord...

brh: باز آک ننا جوڑ مسنو باز آک ننا جوڑ مسنو دا بلہ ایٹھے اگر مسیت کے ہم پاتا خاچس سلیپتہ کہ دا نہ ایٹھے مسیت ایٹک ہر شے تا جوڑ مننگ ٹی آ سے گڑا دا سے دا تو سائیں نی بغل گڑا ملا برے
en: 'Many of ours have been healed, many of ours have been healed' [they say]. This elder ... even if [one speaks of] the mosque ... that it is not this one who gives; the mosque gives ... in the healing of everything ... so then, sir, the mullah comes to your side.
en_old: Many of ours have been healed, many of ours have been healed... this big... even if they say at the mosque... that this is not... the mosque... in the healing of everything... so, my lord, you bring something to the mullah beside you.

brh: خلق کے، او خلق کے مسدے پٹ دا بے مرادے خنپیس، مجال ء نی مسیت کن گڑاس ہلیس ایم، اللہ نا قران شاہد، حضرت ایوب بیمار، پا دیر بیمار دا، دیر ئس حضرت ایوب ارس، ال نہ پنا ایوب
en: People of the village, O people of the village, you don't look at this wretched [mosque]; you would never think of buying anything for the mosque. Allah's Quran is witness: Hazrat Job was sick. Say, who is this sick one? Who was Hazrat Job? ... the one named Job.
en_old: O people of the town, O people of the town, you don't see the poor state of this mosque; you never dare to buy anything for the mosque. The Quran of Allah is witness: Hazrat Job was sick. Say, how long was he sick? For how long was Hazrat Job... the one named Job.

brh: نبی نبی نبی خدا نا نبی نبی نا بلو شان سے نبی عبادت اٹ نبی مفک چنکی آن اللہ اودے منتخب کے کہ نبوت اٹ کہ رسالت اٹ کہ رسالت نبوت نا تاج
en: A prophet, a prophet, a prophet of God; a prophet has a great station. A prophet does not become a prophet through worship; from childhood Allah selects him, for prophethood or for messengership, for the crown of messengership and prophethood.
en_old: Prophet, prophet, prophet of God; the Prophet has a great status. No one becomes a prophet through worship; from childhood Allah chooses him for prophethood or messengership, for the crown of messengership and prophethood.

brh: اور او نہ حفاظت خدا تینٹ کے ایوب علیہ السلام بیمار مس شیطان چات خلنتی کہ دا سبس ہنے نمازاک ہنار ین تا روچگاک ہنار دا معاملہ کل ہنار لیکن الحمدللہ نبی انگت زیادہ عبادت کنٹی چہ جائی کہ بیمار ئے
en: And God Himself is his protector. Job (peace be upon him) fell sick; Satan wanted that through this his prayers would go, his fasts would go, all this would go. But praise be to Allah, the Prophet was worshipping even more, even though he was sick.
en_old: And God Himself protects him. Job (peace be upon him) fell sick; Satan hoped that through this his prayers would go, his fasts would go, all of this would go. But praise be to Allah, the Prophet worshipped even more, even though he was sick.

brh: لیکن نبی نا یقین اور توکل خدا نا زیات، اللہ نا نبی بیمار، ئنا خدی بیمار مس کہ بش مننگ کپک، خلق نا تٹی، لیکن خدا نا قسم کنا کلے اسماعیلی نومک دائے تمپہ مو نبی بیمار
en: But the Prophet's faith and trust in God were great. Allah's Prophet was sick, so sick that he could not get up, there among the village. But by God, my ... all ... do not fall into this ... the Prophet was sick.
en_old: But the Prophet's faith and trust in God were greater. Allah's Prophet was sick, so sick that he could not get up, there among the people. But by God, all my... do not fall into this... the Prophet was sick.

brh: ارے خیر نزول ء غٹ تمانے لیکن کنا ایوب نا دوٹی بندہ فلانہ ذکر او ایوب علیہ السلام اللہ نا عبادت آن مون مڑپکا اللہ نا تعریف ء کننگ ٹی اللہ نا ذکر ء کننگ ٹی پائے کنا اللہ ہر گڑا نا دوٹی ء
en: Yes, his health had completely given way, but my Job ... in his hand ... remembrance [of God]; Job (peace be upon him) did not turn his face away from the worship of Allah, from praising Allah, from remembering Allah. He says: 'My Allah, everything is in Your hand.'
en_old: Well, his health had completely failed, but my Job... My servant so-and-so, remember... Job (peace be upon him) did not turn his face away from the worship of Allah, from praising Allah, from remembering Allah; he says: my Allah, everything is in Your hands.

brh: او غنگٹ ہچ مپوئے، فریاد کننگٹ ہچ مپوئے یا اللہ، اینا جاگہ سے کاوہ، نہ پین نی توار کیوہ، بیماری نی تس، بیماری نا دروکا نی ئس شیطان بے ایمان تو نورا، کہ دا ایوب خیر نزیل غٹ، تما نہ ہم اللہ نا تعریف کننگٹی، اللہ نا ذکر کننگٹی، اللہ نی
en: He [said] nothing in weeping, nothing in lamenting: 'O Allah, I go to no other place, nor do I call on another, I call on You; You gave the illness, and You are the one who takes the illness away.' The faithless Satan [saw] that this Job's health had completely given way, yet he still [kept on] praising Allah, remembering Allah: 'Allah, You...'
en_old: He did not complain at all, he did not cry out at all: O Allah, I go to no other place, I call upon no one else; You gave the illness, and You are the one who removes the illness. The faithless Satan saw that Job's health had completely failed, yet he did not fail in praising Allah, in remembering Allah... O Allah, You...

brh: عادت کلٹی تو اینا خلق والا تے پارے پیڑے او خلق والاک استاد تے دے پترینگا کہ دا ایوب نا نو خراب ء بیماری سے اگر ایوب علیہ السلام نما خلق تے رہینگا ئنا بیماری کلے نما ہلوئی انزال زالو
en: ...in all [his] worship. Then [Satan] spoke to the people of his village and got into the hearts of the villagers, [saying] that this Job has a bad disease: 'If Job (peace be upon him) lives in your village, his disease will catch all of you; women
en_old: ...Then the people of the town spoke to his wife; the townspeople told ... that this Job has a bad disease; if Job (peace be upon him) lives in your town, all of you will catch his disease... his wife...

brh: او نارینہ تا تے کلو بیمار مرو رے ہمو نیکا ایوب تنا خلکم مڈبو تانکہ کنا شیطان ئس اودے مرے بندغاک مالو جاہل مالو گمراہ بے دین اسرا سوب نا مالو لٹا توم بسنو اللہ نبی خیر نزیل غا تمو
en: and men, all of you will become sick. Drive that righteous Job out of your village, so that ... Satan ...' The people were ignorant, were misguided, without religion; for that reason they came with sticks; Allah's Prophet had fallen frail.
en_old: And all the men will become sick; drive that righteous Job out of your town, so that... Satan... The people were ignorant, misguided, faithless; for what reason did they come... Allah's Prophet had fallen into ill health.

brh: ایوب علیہ السلام پارٹے او کنا سیالاک او کنا تاتنا مارک او کنا مھساک انت خیر ترے ہمری بسنوری اینو کنا زی ہمری بسنور پیت دادے ایوب نا بیماری بہو خرابو بیماری سے ہمو نی کن نننا خلقن مہربانی
en: Job (peace be upon him) said: 'O my relatives, O my cousins, O my neighbours, what is it, is everything all right? Why have you come? Why have you come to me today?' They said: 'This Job's illness is a very bad illness; so, please, [leave] our village.'
en_old: Job (peace be upon him) said: O my guests, O my own sons, O my in-laws, what is the matter, why have you come to me today? They said: Job's illness is a very bad illness, so, please, for our sake, leave our town.

brh: نانی کہ رہمپو، ننا خلق ٹی رہینگپا، پیڑے خیر تورے پینا بیماری ننے ہلیک، ننا چنکا بلا کنا بیماری ٹی پاسنگرہ، ہمو نی کہ ننے تنے خلق تٹی برداشت کپنہ، نبی نا خنتن خن خاخر، پیڑے نمے خبر تمبر، ارا خلق ٹی کہ نبی رہینگے، ہمو خلق ننے خدا
en: You must not stay, do not live in our village, otherwise your illness will catch us, and our young and old ... in the illness; so we cannot tolerate you in our village.' Tears [came] from the Prophet's eyes. [He said:] 'Don't you know: the village in which a prophet lives, upon that village God's
en_old: You must not stay, do not live in our town; your illness will catch us; our young and old ... from my illness; so we cannot bear you in our town. Tears flowed from the Prophet's eyes. You will come to know: the town in which the Prophet lived, that town... God...

brh: خدا نا عذابک بپسا، خدا نا دمبر و تباہی بپسا، یار کنا ننے بیماری ہچ الپت، ئے تینٹ بیمار اٹ نم بیمار مفیرے، انتئے کہ کنا بیمار کروکا خدا نا ذات ئے تو کنا بیماری نا مر کروکا ہم خدا نا ذات
en: punishments do not come, God's [wrath] and destruction do not come. My friends, my illness will not catch you at all; I myself am sick, but you will not become sick, because the One who made me sick is God Himself, and the One who removes my illness is also God Himself.'
en_old: God's punishments will not come, God's wrath and destruction will not come; my friend, the illness will not catch you. I myself am sick, but you will not become sick, because the One who made me sick is God Himself, and the One who will remove my illness is also God Himself.

brh: نن کنا براہوئی تے سورک سورک بنگنوری، بنگنوری سورک، سورک سلہہ گو پیرینگا بلا کنا، بخال آ توار کیرہ، بلا انتئے، پی بابا دا بخال سے، بیماری بخال سے، تینٹ نماز خومپک نی بخال سے افس، نی تینٹ
en: We, my Brahuis, call it 'sorak'; you have heard of sorak (measles), you have heard. Sorak ... my elder ...; they call him a Hindu. 'Elder, why?' 'Say, father, this one is a Hindu, illness is a Hindu [thing]; he himself doesn't pray.' 'You are not a Hindu; you yourself...'
en_old: We, my Brahuis, have heard the surahs, heard them... my elder... they call him ill-fated. Elder, why? Say, father, this is misfortune, illness is misfortune; he himself does not pray. You are not ill-fated; you yourself...

brh: جوانوسس بلا، اشتاب سالہ سرمسولس، قران نی تپیسا، سجدہ نی تپیسا، بانگ نی بنپیسا، اللہ نا کو عبادت نی کپیسا، انگت او شیطان، شیطان بخالہ شیطان دنیا کیسہ، ئے غریب بیماری سے نو وسرے پگہ خائیک
en: You would have been a fine man, elder; you have reached eighty years of age, yet you don't know the Quran, you don't know prostration, you don't hear the call to prayer, you don't do Allah's worship; still that Satan... Satan is the Hindu, Satan [is the one who] ... the world; this poor man has a disease ... tomorrow it [may] devour ...
en_old: You were a good man, old man, you have reached such an age, yet you don't read the Quran, you don't prostrate, you don't hear the call to prayer, you don't worship God; still that Satan, Satan... this poor man has a disease, tomorrow it will eat him away.

brh: دا دا پارم برفیگک بابا بلو سوکومبو گڑا نرک واللہ ایلو مائیک پارور آئی چناتے ہلپیرے ئے ماما کریم بخش نور آغا چناتے ہلپیرے سورک تمانے اوراچیتا
en: This, this I say ... father, a big ... thing, then they ran; by God, on the other mic they said: '... don't take the children; uncle Karim Bakhsh, Noor Agha, don't take the children: sorak (measles) has broken out ...'
en_old: This, this... father, a big ... thing... by God, the other mic, they said: don't take the children... Uncle Karim Bakhsh Noor Agha, don't take the children... has fallen...

brh: اوڑے گڑا سورک نمیا مکھک پیا ہا ننا چناتے الیک سورک نترے کے دودینگک دودینگ سموچو مہلٹی چھڑنگک اور ننا چناتے زوری جھپڑ اتیک بیماریاں بندہ غل کونی ارا بیماری ہمو راڑنٹٹی اسے چنائے
en: Then there the measles ... came out ... it will catch our children; the measles ... spreads, running it scatters through the whole neighbourhood and seizes our children by force; [it is] a disease; people raise a clamour: 'What disease is this, in that ..., a child ...'
en_old: Then worms came out of his body there, and our children... the worms spread and crawled all over the neighborhood, and they forcibly struck our children; people said, what disease is this in that village, a child...

brh: ثور و غل کونی، ئے لوئی غل پک اللہ پاک دا طاقت کنائے، ابانو خنانورے غنتنورے، یا پوسکنو گپ اسکوا، امو راٹھی، ارائی لومو، اسٹ بیماری مس، ئے لو جوڑے، نی ئے محل نا بندغ، نی اینگہ
en: They make a noise and a clamour ... God Almighty, this power ... 'Have you seen it or not seen it, or [is it] some new thing ...' In that village ... an illness broke out ... you are a man of this neighbourhood, and you still...
en_old: He shouted and cried out... God Almighty, this strength is mine... whether you see it or not, or a new word... then he fell ill... you are a man of the palace, and still you...

brh: نرسہ کہ چناتے الپیرے اگر بالفرض دا غریب چناتے نرفے مونگ وراپسے کائے خدا خلق تا چناتے ئس نی سورک کیا چناتے ڈکبو چادرا تا زیہ شاغور کہ سورک نی چار خنو رحم کر ستانے چنا ہی لو نیہ مسلمانوس
en: Running about, [they say] don't let the children [out]; if, suppose, [someone] sends these poor children running ... these are the children of God's people ... your measles ... 'Hide the children!' They put them under sheets so that your measles [would not reach them]. Have mercy, they are children; are you not a Muslim?
en_old: Tell them not to let the children go; suppose these poor children... these are the children of God's people, your worms... cover the children under their sheets so they don't see the worms. Have mercy, the children are innocent, are you not Muslims?

brh: نن خواجہ کنا ایمان نا کمزوری سلام کنا ایوب نبی کروڑ مرتبہ سلام کیوا او ایوب نا پینن قربان مریب کہ داخہ سال آخری کتاب نا تفسیر آک دنا ملخیرا کہ ہجدہ سال نبی بیمار
en: We, sir — [it is] the weakness of my faith — salutations; I send salutations to my Prophet Job ten million times, and may I be sacrificed for Job's name, that for so many years... the commentaries of the last Book say that the Prophet was sick for eighteen years.
en_old: We, Lord, the weakness of my faith... My salutations to Prophet Ayub, I send salutations to Ayub a crore times, may I be sacrificed for Ayub's name, that for so many years... the commentaries of the last Book say that the prophet was ill for eighteen years.

brh: ئے ئے مسے تو مرے نا عقیدہ نن ہم ٹھیک ہی مسے توئی اسکان اگر جوڑ متو گڑا ہرا انگن مہار نا چھکر بسر الیک ہرا انگ مہار تے چھکار پیش تماک درخت نا پنا دیپ
en: Whatever happened, let it happen, [that is] the belief, and we too [thought it] right. Until then, if he did not get well, then some ... by the nose-rope ... pulled [him] by the nose-rope, went out ... a tree's ...
en_old: If that is how it is, then so be it; our belief is also right. If he does not get well by then, then... throw him out... put him out in the shade of a tree.

brh: اسپارس سم کونیک ریڈ اسپارس لکٹی شائیک اگر خرد نہ پنٹ لپسٹ سستہ تو دیپتی شاغوی کونوئیک دادا بیماری ہچن پگ او کنا ایلم نا ایمان آن قربان مرے
en: ... if ... then they would throw [him] onto the ... this disease ... nothing ... O my brothers, may I be sacrificed for [his] faith.
en_old: ...if... then put him away... what is this disease... may I be sacrificed for the faith of my brothers.

brh: حضرت ایوب نا زی خلق نا سلوکو پارے مہربانی کر خلق نا انتوسئی پیر کنے ہم پپابو ئے بیمار اٹ کمزور اٹ ہننگ کپر کنا ایلو ماٹ پارے نن نن نن نی ہیلپ نا تینا خلق نا تٹی اللہ نا نبی تینائے ضعیفہ سر مس
en: [Such was] the village's treatment of Hazrat Job. He said: 'Please, people of the village, whatever ... me too ...; I am sick, I am weak, I cannot walk.' My brothers, they said: 'We, we, we will not let you [stay] in our own village.' Allah's Prophet's own wife arrived.
en_old: Prophet Ayub's wife said to the people: please, people, whatever you do, take me along too; he is ill and weak, he cannot walk. My brothers, she said... the prophet of God's own wife became helpless among his own people.

brh: خسونے نبی نا خنتن کھڑینک آک وئیرا کہ خلق نا کنتون جنگ کننگ ٹی او کنا ایلم آک ضعیف آ ضعیف اسے پارے ایوب خیر ترے اینو بیماری باز نی تنگ کرے نی کنا خنتن کھڑینک آک وئیرا پیا اللہ نا ذات نا قسم ئے بیماری نا اوخ پارا
en: She saw tears flowing from the Prophet's eyes because the village was fighting with him. And, my brothers, his wife said: 'Job, is everything all right? Has the illness troubled you a great deal today, that tears are flowing from your eyes?' He said: 'By the essence of Allah, I am [not] groaning over the illness.'
en_old: The prophet's eyes filled with tears, that the people were fighting with him. And, my brothers, his weak wife said: Ayub, may it be well, today the illness has troubled you greatly, your tears are flowing. By the essence of God, tell me about the illness...

brh: بیماری خدا تو سنت تینا دروئے تا ئے بیماری نا تکلیف کپرا اینو کنا خلک نا کنے مڑنگ ٹیو خلکن ئنا وجہ آن خندن کھڑی نا وغیرہ کہ کنا تینا سیالا کنے تینا خلکن مڑنگ ٹیو داسی ارانگ کا ئے تو بش مننگ کپرا
en: Illness is God's way (sunnah); He Himself will take it away. I do not [complain of] the pain of the illness; but today my own village is driving me out; it is because of the village that tears [come] from my eyes, that my own relatives are driving me out of my own village. Now where can I go? I cannot even stand up.'
en_old: Illness from God is His way with His friends. I do not complain of the pain of this illness, but today my own village has turned me out; because of the village my eyes... my own relatives have turned me out of my own village; now I cannot bear it.

brh: ئے تو چرنگ کپا، ئے تو باز کمزور، ضعیفہ بے پروا کپا کنا ایوب، اینے تینا چادر ٹی شاوا بر کے وا، ارا دینی پائنا خدمت کیوہ کنا ایوب، کنا ایلمک ضعیفم دونو مرے، کہ چادری شاوانی، تینا اریغی اللہ نا نبی چادر ٹی
en: He can't even walk, he is very weak. The wife does not neglect him: "My Ayub, I will put you in my sheet and carry you, and I will serve you, my Ayub." My brothers, the wife was such that she put her own husband, the prophet of God, in a sheet.
en_old: He cannot move, he is very weak; the wife does not neglect him: my Ayub, I will put you in my sheet and carry you, I serve both my religion and you, my Ayub. My brothers, the weak wife was such that she put him in a sheet, her own husband, the prophet of God, in the sheet.

brh: خاتونک خنپوک ارے نیتھا، دن کہ ظالمولا چناتن بد کیرہ، انو کہ نبیء بد کرینے، خلقن پیشنٹی کنا ایلمہ کسس نبیء بپک نی واپس مر، نبی نا خنتن خنیک ہکویرہ خلقن ہنینٹی لیکن اللہ نا نبی پانٹی کنا اللہ اگر مچو دنیا کنا
en: The women were not seeing it... Just as cruel people mistreat children, that is how they mistreated the prophet; they were driving him out of the village. My brothers, someone told the prophet, "You can't come here, go back." Tears were flowing from the prophet's eyes as he left the village, but the prophet of God says, "My God, if the whole world..."
en_old: Women were watching... just as the cruel mistreat children, so they mistreated the prophet, outside among the people. My brothers, someone said: we don't want the prophet, go back. The prophet's eyes shed tears among the people, but the prophet of God said: my God, if the whole world were mine...

brh: کنے ہلی کنے کس نا پرواہ اف کنے صرف نا پرواہ ئے کنے کنا خدا کنا خواجہ اوس اللہ اگر بیماری نی تسنس تو بیماری نا مہر کروکا کنا خدا نی ئس پدی مہر کیک بیماری ہنا کیدہ کل نا رے اخس کہ تولو کرے یا مڑی لکھے دم دم
