en: "...abandons me, I don't care about anyone; I care only for You. You are my God, my Master. O God, if You have given me the illness, then the one who will show mercy over the illness is You, my God; later You will show mercy and the illness will go, however long it stays..."
en_old: Leave me, I care for no one, I care only for You, my God, my Master. O God, if You gave me illness, then You who gave the illness will have mercy afterwards; the illness... however long it lasts...

brh: گڈاس مروئی ضرور، امرو فصلس تیار کرنا، گڈاسے دان اسٹ شیف اسٹ وا بڈزائے، ڈاکس ضرور مریک، باوہ جوان ئے وا مار کوٹی دے کھرے، مار کوٹی کے وا باوہ پھیرنگا لوڈو کنک، اللہ انشاءاللہ اگر
en: Something must surely happen. Just as we prepare a crop: some seed, one below, one ... some trouble surely happens. The father is fine, the son in the room ...; the son ..., the father ... God, God willing, if...
en_old: Something must surely happen; a crop is prepared... surely it happens; father is fine... God willing, if...

brh: قران بن گورے قران زی عمل کریرے پا انشاء اللہ شرک پیش تمک توحید جان تٹی بریک نا ایمانم کامل مریک پا خدا ہم راضی قیامت ئے نبی نا شفاعت نا صدقان پا انشاء اللہ جنت ننے ملیک دا تو ایوب علیہ السلام نبی ئے جنگل ئے
en: Listen to the Quran and act on the Quran; then, God willing, shirk will leave, monotheism will enter your body, your faith too will become complete, and God too will be pleased. On the Day of Judgment, by the grace of the Prophet's intercession, God willing, we will attain paradise. So this Prophet Ayub, peace be upon him, was in the wilderness.
en_old: Listen to the Quran, act upon the Quran, then God willing shirk will leave, monotheism will enter the body, your faith will become complete, God will also be pleased, and on the Day of Judgment, by the blessing of the Prophet's intercession, God willing we will attain paradise. So Prophet Ayub, peace be upon him, in the wilderness...

brh: ہچ لا ہورپ بندگف ضعیفہ درے اللہ نا نبی شے کرین سے خاص کریتا جن تا مزدوری کے باخوستک اللہ نا نبی تک اڑے ئے نی طاقت و بیمار متنون لیکن بیماری نبی ایوب علیہ السلام نی
en: No one even looks at him. The wife took the prophet of God ... she would do labor for people for a morsel of food. She said to the prophet of God, "Oh, you were strong and had not fallen ill, but this illness, Prophet Ayub, peace be upon him, you..."
en_old: ...the weak wife of the prophet of God... did labor for people... she said to the prophet of God: you were strong and not ill, but this illness, Prophet Ayub, peace be upon him...

brh: لیکن او دے سد مرتبہ سڑا مرے لیکن کس نا در ہنتو تینا خدا نا دروازہ غا لٹا۔ ایوب علیہ السلام خاچوک دا اینو سے زائفہ مزدوری کیک آتے شیطان ارا کہ دا داسکان مڑپک اللہ نا ذکر کننگٹی۔
en: But even if she suffered a hundred times a day, she did not go to anyone's door; she lay at the door of her own God. Ayub, peace be upon him, was lying there; this wife today does labor. Then Satan saw that even now this man does not stop remembering God.
en_old: But even if she went hungry a hundred times that day, she never went to anyone's door; she lay at the door of her God. Ayub, peace be upon him, was lying there; this wife today does labor. Satan saw that he still does not stop remembering God.

brh: اللہ نبی تا پدوئی ذکر اللہ نا بند مفک بیماری انو لگا کہ مچو جان ٹی بیماری لگا لیکن ایوب علیہ السلام پانٹی کنا الائی بیمار افٹ کنا استم سلامت کنا خوف خدا نا محبت کنا است نا تٹی ارے کنا اللہ
en: On the tongue of God's prophets the remembrance of God does not stop. The illness struck such that his whole body was diseased, but Ayub, peace be upon him, says: "My God, I am not ill; my heart too is sound; my fear of God and love of God are in my heart, my God."
en_old: God... the remembrance of God by the prophets does not stop. The illness struck so that the whole body was diseased, but Ayub, peace be upon him, said: my God, I am not ill, my heart is sound, the fear of God and the love of God are in my heart, my God.

brh: کنا دوئی سلامت ئے اور اتم نا ذکری نا تعریفے کیوی تنے بیمار سنپرا کنا ایلماک نبی نا دوئی ہم سلامت نبی نا استم سلامت لیکن شیطان باز غصہ ٹی چکر کلینٹی کہ امرے دا نبی تے خطائیں کیو امرے خدا نی بات
en: "My tongue is sound, and I remember You and praise You; I do not consider myself ill." My brothers, the prophet's tongue too was sound and the prophet's heart too was sound, but Satan, in great anger, was going around thinking how he could make this prophet err, how he could turn him from God...
en_old: My tongue is sound and I remember and praise You; You have not made my heart ill. My brothers, the prophet's tongue too was sound, the prophet's heart was sound, but Satan, in great anger, went around thinking how to make this prophet err, how to make him turn from God...

brh: داتن مرکیپتا کنا ایلم نا کتاباتیٹی بریک کہ دا شیطان بے ایمان بزرگاتا شکلٹی بلو بلو لوٹ تنے جان نا شاغا بلو حکیمس کریتنے بلو بلو لوٹ لکھٹی کرے مونا سلوک نا کسرے دانگن کنا نبی نا ضعیفاں بلنٹی او کنا ایلم
en: It would not work with this one. My brothers, it comes in the books that this faithless Satan, in the form of the elders, put big, big bags on his body and made himself into a great physician; with big, big bags ..., he stood ahead on the road, and there my prophet's wife meets him, O my brothers.
en_old: ...it comes in the books, my brothers, that this Satan, faithless one, took the form of elders... made himself a great physician... showed the path of treatment... to my prophet's weak wife, my brothers.

brh: دا ایوب نبی ضعیفہ تیرے بعض کتابات ٹی برے کہ یوسف علیہ السلام نا مسڑ ضعیفہ ہم نبی نا مسڑ ارے غم پا نبی گوڑ ایمان امرے کامل مفوئے دا غن دا حکیم دا بندغ بس نی شیطان بندغ نا شکل ٹی
en: This is Prophet Ayub's wife. In some books it comes that the wife was the daughter of Yusuf, peace be upon him; she too was a prophet's daughter. ... With the prophet, how could her faith not be complete? This ... this physician, this man: it was Satan in the form of a man.
en_old: This is the wife of Prophet Ayub (Job). Some books say she was the daughter of Yusuf (peace be upon him), so the wife was also a prophet's daughter. She said to the prophet... faith does not become complete... this hakim, this man: Satan came to her in the form of a man.

brh: شیطان بھلو بے ایمان سے ہر شکل کیک ہر شکل ٹی ایمان نا پلنگ کن بھلو بھلو طریقہ جوڑ کیک اگر ایمان مضبوط قران علم نی تون ارے پا انشاءاللہ لوڈو تننگ کپک اگر ایمان بچفوئی ئے تو علمائے دیوبند تون واسطہ
en: Satan is a great faithless one; he takes every form, and in every form he devises great, great schemes to rob people of their faith. If your faith is strong and you have the knowledge of the Quran, then, God willing, he cannot deceive you. If faith is to be saved, then keep a connection with the Ulema of Deoband.
en_old: Satan is a great faithless one. He takes every form, and in every form he devises great schemes to steal people's faith. If your faith is strong and you have the knowledge of the Quran, God willing he cannot deceive you. If you want to save your faith, keep your connection with the Ulema of Deoband.

brh: دا تخبو، جمعیت علمائے اسلام تون تعلق تخبو انشاءاللہ، نمے ہمو عقیدہ ملک کہ ہرا عقیدہ ء قران پاننگٹی۔ دا بلو لوت بلو لٹھی شاغا، پفاری تہ مار کسر اسے لوکے، نبی نا ضعیفہ ایوب علیہ السلام نا ہنگ بلنتی، پارے او مسڑکو پئی جی، پئی بلو حکیم سے اوٹ۔
en: Hold on to this; keep your connection with Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam, God willing, and you will get the same belief that the Quran teaches. This one put on a big bag and took a big stick and waited by a road. The wife of Prophet Ayub, peace be upon him, meets him on her way. He said, "O daughter." She says, "Yes?" He says, "I am a great physician."
en_old: Stay with this, keep your connection with Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam, and God willing you will get the belief that the Quran teaches. He took a big stick, sat by the side of a road, and the wife of Prophet Ayub (peace be upon him) met him on the way. He said, 'O woman, there is a great hakim over there.'

brh: ئے بلو ڈاکٹر سے اوٹ تفسیر آک لکھے را پی ہا پی گڈا حکیم صاحب کنا اریغ جوڑف دیر جوڑف سئی اریغ کنا جوڑف باز بیمار ئے مہربانی کک کانہ کنا اریغ نا بیماری ئے مر گڈا دارو
en: "I am a great doctor." The commentaries (tafsirs) have written this. She says, "Yes," she says, "then, physician sahib, cure my husband, cure him, sir; cure my husband, he is very ill. Please be kind and let's go ... my husband's illness ... then the medicine."
en_old: ...a great doctor. The commentaries (tafsirs) have written that she said: 'Then, hakim sahib, cure my husband, cure him, cure my husband, he is very ill. Please be kind and come, give medicine for my husband's illness.'

brh: شیطان ورا اینگنا تے درست کیک کن نبی سے انو موچڑی خلیک کنے کہ مچو زندگی یاد کیک فرمائینے کنو گوزٹ ئے برو نو ڈاکٹر صبوٹ کنارے نا رندٹ کا ئے خناٹ نارینا بیماری درست کریر داسن ئے بس دارو ال در ایتا چام
en: Satan says, "I set such people right ... a prophet ... would hit me with such a shoe that I would remember it my whole life." He said, "Come to my place; I am the doctor sahib; walk behind me ... I have seen it; they cured the illness; now just take the medicine, take it ... I gave ..."
en_old: Satan... he treats people... a prophet... He said, 'Come to my place. The doctor sahib... behind me... they cured the illness... now just take this medicine and give it.'

brh: دا چھٹک پی گڑھ خدا نا پین نا گڑائکا آئی دا خبر اف کہ دا شیطان بے ایمان ئے نبی نا ضعیف ئے نبی نا ضعیفہ ولیانسی بزرگ سے امرے تعریف ات کرم اونے لیکن براہ راست شیطان مولے سلوکے پا نبی نا ضعیفہ ام خبر تبک دارا معلوم ئس کہ استاد نا راز اتہ چاوکا
en: ... She did not know that this was the faithless Satan. The prophet's wife was a saintly elder, so praiseworthy and gracious, but Satan himself was standing right there before her, and the prophet's wife did not know it. Here it was taken that he was the one who knows the master's secret.
en_old: This... she did not know that this was Satan, the faithless one. The prophet's wife was like a saint, a pious elder, and she was praised and blessed, but Satan approached her directly. He said, prophet's wife... it was clear he was the one who knew the master's secret.

brh: خدا نذر نی تو خنتی دادہ ترکسہ ملتان نا حوالات تیتسہ ہاں سئیں نن خرٹ خنپنا نی خنتی ترکسہ خنیسہ دام تو بلو کمال سے نن ادا بلا خن دنورنا
en: A gift of God: you blink your eyes here ... the lockups of Multan ... "Yes, sir, we cannot see." You blink your eyes and you see; that itself is a great wonder. We here ... eyes...
en_old: God's gift: you open your eyes... the lockups of Multan... yes sir, we cannot see. You open your eyes and you see; that itself is a great miracle. Here we...

brh: دا تے خنے وا مستی خننگ کہ پارا اور نی خنت تر کیسہ دنیا نا سیر و تفریح کیسہ لیکن اللہ پانتھی دا خنت ترکننگ نا وقتس کور مروز قیامت اٹ ہرتوما خنگ نا پلنگور کھور مروز اور کھورنگا بندہ دوزخ ہنو دا نبی
en: You look at these things with your eyes and say it is fun to look, and you close your eyes and enjoy the sights and pleasures of the world, but God says: at the time of closing these eyes you will become blind; on the Day of Judgment whoever misused their sight will become blind, and the blind servant will go to hell. This prophet...
en_old: You look at these things with your eyes and enjoy what you see. You open your eyes and enjoy the sights and pleasures of the world, but Allah says: at the time of opening your eyes you will be blind. On the Day of Judgment, whoever stole sight will be blind, and the blind servant will go to hell. This prophet...

brh: خود ایوب علیہ السلام ایتے ئے ایوبی دادے شیطان ئے او مئے نبی نا ضعیفہ بلنٹی تو شیطان پارے ئے دونو حکیم ئس اوٹ کنارے غا پند کیو کاو پیلہ بے مراد ہمری دارو ایتیتہ ستا پئی ئنا تے دارو ایتیتہ پئی گڑی غریب سے اوڑ پیسہ اف کن تو
en: Ayub, peace be upon him, himself ... in Ayub's time ... Satan met the prophet's wife, and Satan said, "I am such a physician that of all who come walking to me, no one goes back disappointed. I give medicine; I will give medicine to your husband," he says. "He is a poor man, he has no money? For me, then..."
en_old: Ayub (peace be upon him) himself... in Ayub's time, Satan met the prophet's wife. Satan said, 'There is a hakim over there. I advise you, nobody goes back from him disappointed. He gives medicine, he will give medicine to your husband. Your husband is a poor man who has no money...'

brh: پئے پئے سال پر کنے باز ترس بسونے غریب و مسکین سے بیمار ہی لیکن اسہ شرط سے کنے ود قبول کا پئے پا پئے دا دارو تے درے تا کھلی تا کننگ تو جوڑ مرے کننگ تو لیکن انوں پاتا پئے سال پر غریب
en: He says, "I feel great pity for him: a poor, needy, sick man. But accept one condition from me." He says, "Take these medicines; as soon as he takes them he will get well. But he must say this..." ... poor...
en_old: He said, 'I feel great pity for him. He is poor and needy and sick. But on one condition, accept it from me.' He said, 'Give him these medicines and he will be cured, but tell him to say...' said the poor...

brh: اوڑے انو پاتا کہ حکیم نی حکیم کنے جوڑ کرے تو اللہ نا نبی نا ضعیفہ کس کے نبی نا ضعیفہ اوڑا کہ دا ئے تے دیو نبی سر تو کے کہ دا مرو حکیم سدھل پانٹی دارو تے
en: "He must say this: 'The physician, the physician cured me.'" So the wife of God's prophet ... the prophet's wife went to him and delivered them to the prophet, saying that this physician is telling about the medicines...
en_old: '...he should say that the hakim cured me.' So the wife of Allah's prophet told the prophet that this is what the hakim says about the medicines...

brh: کہ درے سر کرے دے ایوب علیہ السلام پارے دانگ برو دارو پی حکیم سے سلوک ئے پی ایننگ توار کتا پی دانگ بفوک بلو حکیم سے دانگ بفوک لیکن دارو تو سنی پی کننگ تو جوڑ مریسا لیکن پاغوڑ حکیم جوڑ کرے
en: She took them and delivered them. Then Ayub, peace be upon him, said, "The medicine has come here?" She says, "A physician is standing there." He says, "Call him here." She says, "He doesn't come here; he is a great physician, he doesn't come here. But as for the medicine," she says, "as soon as you take it you will get well, but you must say that the physician cured you."
en_old: ...he made his way. Then Ayub (peace be upon him) said, 'Bring the medicine here from the hakim.' He told her, 'Call him here.' She said, 'He is a great hakim, he does not come here, but he gives medicine and you will be cured.' But he said the hakim would cure him...

brh: اللہ اکبر ایوب علیہ السلام کنا ایتے بین جوکھل خسا تنے خنتن خلے کا گواہ خدا نا قسم ئے نبی نا خنتن خلے کا گواہ جذباتی تما توارے کنا ضعیفہ کنا مون آن مر کہ شیطان نی دھوکہ ٹی شاغانے کہ تپالن ٹی حکیم نا باوہ
en: God is great! Ayub, peace be upon him ... I swear by God, tears filled the prophet's eyes, as a witness; he became emotional and said in a voice: "My wife, get out of my sight, for Satan has led you into deception; that physician's father..."
en_old: Allahu Akbar! Ayub (peace be upon him) said... by God, tears filled the prophet's eyes. In an emotional voice he said, 'My wife, get away from my sight! Satan has deceived you, that hakim's father...'

brh: ڈاکٹر نا باوہ کنے جوڑ کننگ کپک جوڑ کروکا خدا نا ذات بیمار آتے شفا تروکا اللہ نا ذات اینو ئس گولی ئس کنیسہ جوڑ مریسہ پگہ بیمار مسس ہمو بیماری دوازدہ گولی کنوس ہمنا دنتان نا خلجن پک
en: "The doctor's father cannot cure me. The one who cures is God Himself; the one who gives healing to the sick is God Himself. Today you take a pill and get well; tomorrow you fall ill with that same illness. You will take twelve pills and still that same toothache does not go away."
en_old: 'A doctor's father cannot cure me. The one who cures is God Himself; the healer of the sick is Allah Himself. Today you take a pill and get better, tomorrow you fall sick with the same illness. I took twelve pills and still the toothache did not go away.'

brh: کنے مچو دنیا نی گولی دے چٹ کرینوس کنا علم شفا تروکا خدا نا ذات ئے ایوب علیہ السلام پارے بس او کنا ضعیفہ کنے آن مر مر کنتون ہیت کپہ اینو نا چہرہ کنے وڑ پک اینو شیطان کنے کمزور سمجھانے
en: "Even if you used up all the pills in the world on me, I know that the one who gives healing is God Himself." Ayub, peace be upon him, said, "Enough, O my wife, get away from me, go, don't talk to me. Today your face does not please me. Today Satan has taken me for weak."
en_old: 'Treat me with all the pills in the world; my knowledge is that the healer is God Himself.' Ayub (peace be upon him) said, 'Enough, my wife, get away from me, go, do not talk to me. Today your face... today Satan has thought me weak.'

brh: امو نیکی ککنا ہوراں نزی حملہ کرینے، داس نبی نا خنتن کھڑی کاکما ایرا، دغارون شیپ برزا کلنٹی تین جوش ٹی تما، قران پانٹی نبی انت پانٹی، امو خیر نزی لگ تما نبی انت پانٹی، پانٹی واذکر عبدنا ایوب اذ نادی ربہ
en: "...he has attacked that virtue of mine." Now tears fell from the prophet's eyes; from the ground ... upward ...; he was overcome with emotion. The Quran tells what the prophet said ... what the prophet said. It says: "And remember Our servant Ayub, when he called out to his Lord..."
en_old: That good deed... he attacked... now the prophet's eyes filled with tears, he raised his hands upward, he was overcome with emotion. The Quran tells us what the prophet said: 'And remember Our servant Ayub, when he called out to his Lord...'

brh: ئے کنا اللہ پورا زندگی بیمار اسوٹا ئے دن پا
en: "O my God, even if I had been ill my whole life, I would say this:"
en_old: 'O my Allah, I have been sick my whole life...'

brh: اوٹ کہ نی جوڑ کرے کنے انتئے کہ جوڑ کروکا نی بیمار ہم نی کریس کنے تو جوڑ ہم نی کیسہ کنے ئے کنا اللہ لیکن شیطان بے ایمان او کنا اوار غا حملہ کرے نی ئے او کنا ضعیفہ دارو تسنے کرے راہی کرے نی داسہ کنا نبی نا غیرت برداشت کپک ئے شرک نا بمبر تے نا خفٹ
en: "...that You cured me, because the one who cures is You; You also made me ill, and You will also cure me, O my God. But the faithless Satan attacked through my companion; he has given my wife medicine and sent her off." Now my prophet's sense of honor cannot bear this: the bombs of shirk in the ear...
en_old: '...so that I say You cured me, because You are the one who cures. You made me sick, and You will cure me, O my Allah. But the faithless Satan attacked my companion, my wife; he gave her medicine and sent her back. Now my honor as a prophet cannot bear the bombs of shirk (associating others with God)...'

brh: شرک نا دا عمل کنے تو بلو گلاسے لیکن شیطان کنے کمزور سمجھانے کہ ئے بیمار بش مننگ نا گپ اف باز بیمار مسنے ضرور اینا دارو ء کنوئی دارو تے چغل تیس ضعیفہ ء پارے مڑما کن تو نیت کپا اگر ئے جوڑ مسٹ تو نی سد شت خلیوا اسہ شت
en: "This act of shirk would be a great sin for me, but Satan has taken me for weak, thinking that he is ill, there is no question of his getting up, he has become very ill, he will surely have to take this medicine." He threw the medicines away and said to his wife, "I have no such intention for my body. If I get well, I will strike you a hundred strokes of the stick, one stick."
en_old: This act of shirk would be a great sin for me, but Satan has taken me for weak. It is not just a matter of falling ill: he had been very ill, so surely he should take medicine. He threw the medicines away and said to his wife, "I have no such intention for my body. If I get well, I will strike you a hundred lashes, a hundred."

brh: تس خلپنے نئے سد شست و دو ٹیکی ونے خلیوا کہ شیطان پنگل کنوس کرے بسنور ضعیفہ غریب مرمزینا ایوب جاہل لرزینجی خنتن خنیگا گویرہ اللہ نا قران پارٹی پارے او کنا اللہ نا زار
en: ..."I will strike you a hundred strokes." ... Satan ... came; the poor wife ... Ayub, trembling, tears flowing from his eyes. God's Quran says that he said, "O my God..." in lament.
en_old: ...a hundred and sixty-two... 'I will strike...' Satan... came... the poor wife... Ayub... with tears in his eyes... Allah's Quran says he said, 'O my Allah...'

brh: ئے کنے باروٹ ہچ تکتنے خننگے یار کنے لاغر ہم باری بامرستے یار یار ملک سعید بھائی کہ اسہ ٹک ٹاکر اسے ننا کوئٹہ نا باز جوان و مار اسے او پائے کہ بھئی ما بنگلہ استاد تو اونا بارٹ نی انت پیغام ایتس او امر او جوان و مار اسے امر او یار کنے
en: Hey, about me there's nothing to see, friend; I'm thin too... (unclear) friend. Friend, friend, Malik Saeed bhai, who is a TikToker of our Quetta, a really fine young man; and he says, brother, we... Bangla Ustad, so what message would you give about him? And how is he? He's a fine young man; how is he, friend, me...
en_old: ...about me, nothing is seen, friend, I am thin too... friend, friend, Malik Saeed bhai, a TikToker from our Quetta, a very good and brave man; he says, brother... Bangla teacher, so what message do you give about him, how he is a good and brave man, how he is, friend, me...

brh: نی تو وڑا خوش اخلاق و بندغ اسے ازی پین ٹک ٹاکر اسے گپ گپا کا۔ خیر و برکت اٹ گٹ تمچ پین وڑے اونا بارہ ٹی انت پائنگ اسے نی یار او مست کنا خل انگور سنبھالانی یار ٹو اونا آواز تو نما دے ہلی ہلی ہلی کس پہ گاڑی
en: You are such a well-mannered person. Another TikToker... (unclear) is talking. With goodness and blessing... in another way, what would you say about him, friend? And before that, take care of my ... grapes (unclear), friend. His voice... to you... Come on, come on, come on! Someone... the car.
en_old: You are such a well-mannered person; another TikToker from up there is talking. With goodness and blessings, what do you have to say about him, friend? And before that, keep hold of my grapes, friend. His voice is with you... go, go, someone in the car.

brh: دے لاتے یا تو کوئٹہ نا ٹک ٹاکر اتون نی وڑ ئس مقابلہ کننگ خاص اگہ بریرے تو مقابلہ کیر ارے اگر لائیو برے دے بابو ننا اوست اسکول نا دروازہ ہم بئے الے بس لغت خلبو بابو بیا گپ ئس توخلین ون ٹوک بے تنین نن ہم ٹوک بے تنین نا یار پاپک بیسٹ
en: ...(unclear) Either you should have some kind of competition with the TikTokers of Quetta; especially if they come, then they'll compete, yes, if they come live. Then, Babu, our heart... the school's door too... (unclear). Just kick it, Babu! Come, let's have a chat; we'll crack jokes, we'll crack jokes too; your friend doesn't say... best.
en_old: Either you compete in some way with the TikTokers of Quetta. If they come, they'll compete, especially if they come live. Father, our heart... even the school door... just curse, father. Let's say something, we gave our word, we gave our word too, friend. Best.

brh: گنوک مرے اٹ چغٹ خلیکے آ سئی ئے پمور وڈی مروئی اٹ باخلوئے تو ننا اینو نا دا پروگرام اختتام کینہ امید ئے نمے پسند بروئے ننا ٹوکا تان دا ہیتان ناراض مفیرے اسہ پروگرام اسے ننا سٹا سٹا تمام ٹک ٹاکرز آک ہرا کہ بننگ خواہ رے تو فالو کبو رابطہ کبو نم تون ننا پروگرام کینہ مراد
en: ...goes crazy and lashes out with kicks; all right, ... (unclear) he'll end up dazed. So we end this program of ours for today. We hope you'll like it; don't be offended by our jokes and these words. A program of ours... (unclear). All the TikTokers who want to come, follow us and contact us; we'll do our program with you. Murad.
en_old: Whoever is crazy... So we end today's program here. We hope you liked it; don't be offended by our words. All the TikTokers who want to come on one of our programs, follow and contact us, and we'll do a program with you.

brh: ئے ملک میراث افہ، ہاو، ہرا ملک بہ ہنا میراث ہنا کل گڑا ہنا۔ ہن صاحبہ، ہمو حال حوال کنانہ ہمے وقتا چلے رہ پالر، جوغہ، سیکہ، کمیرس، خراصس، ہر گڑاس۔ دا سو کل ہنار۔
en: There's no land and no inheritance, yes. Whatever land there was has gone, the inheritance has gone, everything has gone. Now, sir, that is my situation. At that time there used to be [unclear implement], yokes, [unclear], ploughshares, oxen, everything. Now all of these have gone.
en_old: There is no land or inheritance. Yes, whatever land is his, the inheritance is his, everything is his. Yes sir, that was my situation; at that time there used to be... everything. Now it is all his.

brh: ئے دا مشینگری چلی دا سراغان لشی ئنا لشی بے ٹریکٹر تمان ہرا دا دا بے پھلار یانا دا دے بے تو داسا نم انت گرا محسوس کیرے کہ بھاز دا کارم نما متکو مس ئے دا الہ نو دا کارم ئے بندہ دا کارم ابا پپو سے تو دا کارم ابا پپو سے مشینگری شروع مس مشینگری نا وتی ہاؤ دا کاروبار نا وتی
en: This machinery started running; from this end... the sickle... sickles, tractors came in, this, this... blade, I mean this one. So now what do you feel, has this work of yours become very old? ... This work, man, this work comes from father and grandfather. So this work comes from father and grandfather; then machinery started, the time of machinery, yes, the time of this business.
en_old: This machinery runs from this end, threshing after threshing, the tractor, this thresher, I mean this one. So now how do you feel? Was this work your ancestors'? This work belonged to our fathers and grandfathers. Then machinery started, the era of machinery, yes, the era of this business.

brh: ڈیلا مسینا دا سا پرانا گزارہ کینو گزارہ گزارہ او خاص و کاروبار اسب کا کاریم تما ننا خاص و کاروبار دا سا لشیبی ہنا یانا ٹریکٹر کرینگٹی اللہ نیکستینے خوش کورا کاریم او بو
en: It has become slack; now we get by the old way, just getting by, getting by. And our main business... the work has fallen off. Our main business now, sickles, has gone; I mean, the tractor is doing it. God... (unclear) ... the work.
en_old: ...we are getting by now like in the old days, just getting by. Our work is mainly this business; our main business now is threshing, I mean the tractor. By God's grace, we are happy with the work.

brh: مفک ہم سے ٹریکٹر نا زی اٹ ہاو ننا محلہ غا انت انت جوڑ کرے کا محلہ غا ننا مست نا بندہ روغدار جوڑ ارہ اللہ نا کستے نی زوم آتے جوڑ ارہ داسہ اوفتہ پد ننا کل ننا رہینگار داسہ او کرو
en: It isn't like that either; it's done on the tractor. Yes, what all did they use to make in our neighbourhood? In the neighbourhood our people of former times made ... (unclear); by God's ... (unclear) the ... are made. Now after them all of us have lived on it; now he does it.
en_old: It's also on a tractor, yes. What all did they build in our neighbourhood? Our elders built fine things in our neighbourhood; by God's grace the sons built them too. Now after them all of us live here, now they do it.

brh: دا کاروبار ہنا، داسہ نا لشی بے ہنا، دا پھلاٹ ہنا سرکار۔ اچھا۔ او دا چائنا پھلاٹ داسہ کشانے تینا، اچھا چائنا لشی ہم کشانے؟ کل گڑا کشانے، لشی کشانے، ٹریکٹر آ بسو، کل گڑا داسہ کاروبار رہی گا ننا۔
en: This business has gone; the sickle of today has gone, this blade has gone, sir. Okay. And has China now brought out its own blade? Okay, has China brought out sickles too? It has brought out everything, it has brought out sickles, tractors came; everything... now our business... (unclear).
en_old: This business is his, the threshing now is his, this thresher is his, sir. Okay. And he has now brought this Chinese thresher for himself? Okay, did he also bring the Chinese threshing machine? He brought everything, the thresher, it came on the tractor; everything, now this is our business.

brh: نمو سو حال حوال آ گواہو ننا حال و گزارو مہنگائی زیادہ ئے دا کہ چار سے پانچ ہزار تپہ نت کینتہ تپہ نا ساہ و پاسو تا چنا تے تین یا بڑی بیماری نا خرچہ کین ہچو کہ دا بڑی خطرناک کرونا تمانے
en: [As for] your situation... our situation and our living: inflation is high; it's that four to five thousand [rupees]... (unclear) ... to give the children their subsistence, or the expenses of a serious illness, nothing is left; and now this very dangerous corona has struck.
en_old: Your situation... As for our situation and living, inflation is high. We can't even earn four to five thousand rupees in a day for our families and children, or for the expense of a serious illness. Now this very dangerous corona has hit.

brh: مخلوق کرونا غان خلیک بپک بازارا بپک کس کاروبار رہینگانو او حال احوال آک ننا دا چلنگے واہ مہربانی واہ استاد اراڑے خلق نم اراڑے کے خلق ادا لزوٹی ئے بابو تو لزو ہر دے ہنانگ برے لزو ہنا دے
en: People are afraid of corona; they don't come to the market, nobody comes; business has stalled, and that's how our situation is going. Wow, thank you, wow, ustad. Where is your village? Where is the village? Here, it's in Lazo. Babu, so every day going to Lazo and coming back, to Lazo...
en_old: People are afraid of corona, they don't go to the market, no one does business, that's how things are going for us. Wow, thank you, teacher. Where are you from? Where are you from? Here in Lazo? Then, father, every day it's to Lazo, to Lazo.

brh: دا کھے پٹ برے نا صوبہ نا برے نا کاروبار کینہ بیگانہ کانہ۔ پورا ٹیم او بس خرچہ تیرا کشینہ شام نا شام تو سو بناورے اللہ نیتس برینہ وری ئنا ڈی یک جاگہ سے ٹروک جاگہ سے آ راست۔ ٹیم ئے
en: We do this ... business of the province; we go to strangers' places. All the time we just manage our expenses. Every evening, God willing, at last we come back... to one place, the truck to one place, straight. It's time.
en_old: We do business in this province and we don't go to other places. All the time we just struggle with expenses; from evening to evening, God willing, we come... in one place, the truck at one place, straight. Time...

brh: پاس کین کانہ جی استاد دا چنا نا خواننگ نا خوان بس تعلیم بس ارے اف نا چنا نا خواننگ تعلیم بس وخت آ اچھا او ولے خرچہ پینا تسکرے کپنہ تا اللہ اللہ ہنا وجہ آن دا سے خوانے پینا نہ پن ہنا کاریمے ال
en: We pass the time and go, yes, ustad. Does this child study, just education, yes or no? The child's studying, education, just at the right time. Okay. But we can't afford the other expenses. God, God, because of that he studied only this much, no more; ... his work...
en_old: We are passing the time, yes teacher. This child's studying, just education, yes or no? The child's studying and education, just at the right time. Okay, but we can't afford the other expenses. Oh God, because of that he only studied this much, nothing more; his work...

brh: خلیفہ! نیاڑی تے ہم خوانفرے؟ جی او، چنکا دا خوانے ماشاءاللہ، ماشاءاللہ۔ انتئے کہ خوانفرے؟ ما الانا مخلوق تو خوانفتو اکا؟ دا زپانو خوان، نوکری ملوئی دے، نوکری سے ہم ملے پکا یا خوانیر متی؟ اہاں، ئنا کہ مرے کہ پار کہ دا پن اسہ لکھے۔ دا لشی دا زیا لکھے تیرا پنی؟
en: Khalifa! Do you also educate the girls? Yes, yes, the little ones study, mashallah, mashallah. Why do you educate them? Didn't people of earlier times educate them? This kind of study (unclear), will they get a job? Do they even get a job, or do they just study? Uh-huh... say whether a name is written on this. Is your own name written on this sickle?
en_old: Caliph! Do you also educate the girls? Yes, the little one studies, mashallah, mashallah. Why do you educate them? Didn't people in the past educate them? This is good education; will they get a job, will they surely get a job, or will they just study? Yes, ... they say this costs one lakh. How many lakhs does this thresher cost?

brh: کنا پن ارے عبدالرحیم ئے خواجہ پارے دا کاری مے کرے مرے اللہ نا شکرے خواجہ پارے 25 30 سال مرو کرے ہندا کارم ٹی لگانو مارو کماشہ کسو داسہ نن تینٹ شکرے کارم کینہ ہندا ٹھپ ٹائے خنیسہ ننا مہنگائی تمانے خواجہ ہر گڑاس خواجہ
en: My name is Abdul Rahim. Khawaja, as I said, I have been doing this work, thank God. Khawaja, say it's been 25 or 30 years that I've done it; we've been engaged in this same work, young and old... Now we do the work ourselves, thank God, this same hammering that you see. Inflation has hit us, Khawaja, everything, Khawaja.
en_old: My name is Abdul Rahim. Khawaja, thank God I have done this work for 25 or 30 years; I've been in this same work and earned. Now, thank God, we do the work ourselves, this same thing you see. Inflation has hit us, Khawaja, everything, Khawaja.

brh: چڑا نی پوگو ہمبر اینو نما روزگار مرے بس روزی بھلو افک بس ہمو فڈ گزارے ٹی بس ئنا خالی فڈ ننا ننا خوائے پرنو کاروبار ہم تین دستو نا کنن جوڑان رسی گڑا سے کیر نا کو جاگہ غاک ننا بے مسہ وارا ہر گڑا سے ننا تینٹ خانی سخوائے پر داسا انتن جوڑے رے
en: Then... does your livelihood come in today? Just... the income isn't big; we're just barely getting by, just barely... We do our business with our own hands too ... we do something ... our places ... three times; we do everything ourselves... But now how are you doing?
en_old: ...today your livelihood is just... the income isn't big, we just get by. Our business too we do with our own hands... these places of ours, three times over, we do everything ourselves. But now how is it going?

brh: بس دا سانہ لشی نا کارم لشی نا سیزن ء ہمڈرین نا ہندا کاروبار ء کننگ اٹی آن دا ہلا ئے انتو ہی پار اور لشی ہن تو لشی ہندا لشی ہاں او واہ شیب دا لشی رمبی لشی ہندا اچھا جی ہندا کاروبار دا ستی تا سکت سیزن افک سیزن ہنداسی گندا ایرا گڑا نا او
en: Right now it's just sickle work, the sickle season; we are doing this same business. What is this, tell me? And the sickle... so the sickle, this same sickle, yes. And wow... this sickle, spade, sickle, the same. Okay, yes, this same business... Is there a season or not? The season is this... two things...
en_old: Right now it's just the threshing work, the threshing season; we do this same business. Threshing... yes, wow, this threshing... okay, yes, this same business. Is it a season or not? This is the season...

brh: ہمدرے نائے داغہ خوار پرلو شیناک اینگا رمبھینائے نیت اوس پین کاروبار داسہ سیکا فسی فکائے مہالو نا مخلوق انتن جوڑ کریکہ مہالو نا شکرے او بھی ہندا دھندے کر غریبی ہندا اسک پین داونواک خوار پر بھلو کارم کر رہی یا پین ہندا ٹھپ ٹاک
en: There... poor... full of hardship... spades... at last... other business now... What did the people of before make? Those of before, thank God, they too did this same trade. Poverty is the same... the others, poor, doing heavy work, or else the same hammering.
en_old: ...the poor... what did the people of the past do? Thank God, he also did this same trade. Poverty is the same... the poor are doing hard work, or this same thing.

brh: دا کسر نا ایر ماری ایر ماری الف چلہ نا کسر ایر روزی کرے دا کسر بند مسنے دا کسر نا لچھی ٹپ ٹپ نا ہندا روزی ہندا دے کسر نا کاروبار چنا تے نا خوان فرے خوان فرے چنا تے شکر اللہ نا مدرسہ ٹی خوان فرے ننا سے ٹپہ نا کاروبار باقی پین گڑا دہنو
en: On this road... the Alif Chilla road ... we earned a living; this road has been closed. This road's ... the hammering, the same livelihood, the same ... the business of the road. Do you educate the children? We educate them, we educate the children, thank God; we educate them in the madrasa. Our business is the hammering; the rest, other things ...
en_old: Along this road, the road of Alif Chilla, we earned our livelihood; this road has been closed. Our livelihood is the same, the business of this road. We educate the children, thank God, we educate the children in the madrasa. Our business... other things...

brh: پائپر کاروبار کرفتنوں توا مدرسہ اسکولاتے ڈڈو ہرا خوانانو ہبوستی ہفت پسہ گڑا حیرانو گپانہ پیسہ فون کے غریبہ بندہ فڈنا گزارہ کپک پائپر ساٹھ ناتے کہ پاہرہ فیس پائپر دے چا اکھس روپئی ہا دا سو
en: The private ones ... business... madrasas, schools ... those who have studied ... seven ... it's astonishing ... money ... a poor person can't even get by. The private ones ... sixty ... they say the fees ... the private ones, who knows how many rupees, this hundred...
en_old: Private businesses are running madrasas and schools that teach, and if you go to them you'd be amazed at how much money they charge. A poor person can't manage their living expenses. Private ones ask for sixty... the private ones charge fees of a lakh rupees, or this hundred...

brh: دا نا پن دیرے؟ اللہ بخش۔ اللہ بخش۔ اللہ بخش جان دا سدھ نوم انتو دا کاریم کننگ ٹی رو باف پیری یا نوم کاریم کننگے؟
en: What is his name? Allah Bakhsh. Allah Bakhsh. Allah Bakhsh jan, how is it for you in doing this work: handed down from father and grandfather, or is it you yourselves doing the work?
en_old: What is his name? Allah Bakhsh. Allah Bakhsh. Allah Bakhsh, dear, what is this called, the one used in this work, the thing for the old father's work, what's its name?

brh: دا کار تپ داسا باز کمزور مسنے نما انت خیال ئے او ئنا غریبی ئنا ہنر ئنا وا پیر غمہ کننگٹی اون تو جی اخس او بس روزگار ئنا کینہ جی نہ و نا کاروبار تا دے نٹ خبر حال تا تا کاروبار ڈیمو اف کو شکر اللہ نا ہمو ٹائم پاس کینہ آپ ہتہ جوڑ کیرے داسا اللہ لشی بشی کتر متہ ٹپر مپر مرو
en: This hammering work has now become very weak; what is your opinion? And ... poverty, ... skill, ... father and grandfather ... in doing it... so, yes, how much... We just do it for a livelihood, yes. ... no news of business ... the business isn't moving forward ... thank God, we pass that time. You make it by hand; now, God willing, sickles and such, knives and such, the hammering will go on.
en_old: This work has now become very weak. What do you think? Poverty, the skill... how much? Yes, we just do it for a livelihood, yes or no. There's no news of business... thank God, we pass the time. You do it by hand; now, God willing, the threshing...

brh: تو دا سنٹ، نی دا گڑاس بابا نا پنت پارہ کہ دادے انت پارہ؟ او دے سندان پارہ۔ سندان پارہ؟ ہئو۔ او دے انت پارہ؟ دا ئیکہ دادے ہتھوڑے؟ ہئو۔
en: So this... baba, tell us the names of these things: what do they call this one? That one is called a sandan (anvil). It's called a sandan? Yes. And what is that one called? This one, is this a hammer? Yes.
en_old: So this anvil, can you tell us what this thing of grandfather's is called? It's called a sindan (anvil). Called a sindan? Yes. And what is that called? Is this one a hammer? Yes.

brh: ایرے کو انت اسے؟ میخ سدانے سائیں؟ میخ سدانے ہئو۔ اور دادین پارہ دھموک پارہ۔ دھمن پارہ؟ دھموک۔ ہئو دھموک۔ دھموک براہوئی ٹی ننے دھموک پارہ، تتے؟ دھموک دھموک۔ ہاں، ہئو۔ تو ننا دا ناز بابا کہ ہنا دا ادے، ہاں ہئو، او دا دیر تیلے
en: And what is that one over there? Is it a nail anvil, sir? It's a nail anvil, yes. And this one is called a dhamok (bellows). Called a dhaman? Dhamok. Yes, dhamok. In Brahui we call it dhamok, right? Dhamok, dhamok. Yes, yes. So this, our Naz Baba who... this is here. Yes, yes. And this is water and oil.
en_old: What is the one down there? Is it a nail anvil, sir? Yes, a nail anvil. And this one is called a dhamok (bellows). Called a dhamon? Dhamok. Yes, dhamok. In Brahui we call it dhamok, right? Dhamok, dhamok. Yes, yes. So this is our Naz Baba, the one who is here, yes, and this is water and oil.

brh: لشی مچے خلینہ دا دیر لشی تننگ کے دا ایدے ایدے ہو لشی مچے خلینہ ہو اور ئے کہ ایدین پارس میخ سندان میخ سندان دا ہمڑے ہمڑے آن چاڑدینوس ہاں ہاں ہاں ہاں
en: We plunge all the sickles in; this water is for tempering the sickles. This one here, this one here, yes, we plunge all the sickles in, yes. And the one you called the nail anvil, the nail anvil, you've lifted it from right there? Yes, yes, yes, yes.
en_old: They dip all the tongs; this water is used for quenching. This one here, yes, they dip all the tongs in it. And what you called this, the nail anvil, the nail anvil, we've taken it out from right there. Yes, yes, yes, yes.

brh: ابا دا انتس جوڑیس کنا جانی؟ بابا رمبی نا دستہ سے اچھا دا مچے نشان ایتا۔ دا انتس کروس تا؟ بابا جوڑنگ جوڑسہ۔ ہا جوڑو تیار و رمبی ٹی شاغو۔ ہا رمبی ٹی شاغو۔
en: Hey, what are you making, my dear? Baba, a handle for a spade. Okay, show all of this. What will you do with it? Baba, I'm making it. Yes, once it's made and ready, it will be fitted into the spade. Yes, it will be fitted into the spade.
en_old: Dad, what are you making, my dear? Dad, a handle for a sickle. Okay, show all of it. What did you do with this? Dad, I'm making it. Yes, once it's made and ready, put it on the sickle. Yes, put it on the sickle.

brh: اچھا ماشاءاللہ۔ انو لشی نا دستہ نا واری؟ ہا لشی نا دست واڈ اٹی۔ اچھا او واڈ اٹی۔ تیار ئے
en: Okay, mashallah. Now is it the sickle handle's turn? Yes, the sickle's handle is in the vice. Okay, it's in the vice. It's ready.
en_old: Okay, mashallah. Is it now the turn of the tongs' handle? Yes, the tongs' handle is in the vice. Okay, it's in the vice. It's ready.

brh: ایشتماک کے خلک نا ڈغار، او شنگار، سیاہ جوڑ مسور، مون نا شنگار۔
en: ...(unclear) the earth of the village; that adornment turned black, the adornment of the face.
en_old: Shining through the soil of the earth, that beauty became black, the beauty of the face.

brh: ہیلو؟ ہاں انسپکٹر صاحب، او رے کرے رے؟
en: Hello? Yes, Inspector sahib, he did it, did he?
en_old: Hello? Yes, Inspector sir, what did he do?

brh: جیو نا سرمستو نون شام کونگون نما انتظار مننگٹی اٹی جی جی اچھا کھڈ کرے ہا ٹھیک ئے ٹھیک ٹھیک مہربانی
en: ...(unclear) evening... I'm waiting for you. Yes, yes. Okay, he dug a hole? Yes, it's fine, fine, fine, thank you.
en_old: Good evening from Geo, we are waiting for you. Yes, yes, okay, he dug. Yes, fine, fine, fine, thank you.

brh: ذات کبریا نا قسم اینا نبی غیرت والو نبی اللہ کئی سال کے زرنگار کنا بیماری ئے کس نا دروازہ گن توٹ کنا اللہ لیکن دا سے شیطان کنے کمزور سمجھانے دا سمی جوڑ کر کنے تینا پلو ہلیو ئے تینا ضعیفے سد شتم خناٹ
en: By the oath of the Glorious Being, His prophet was a prophet with self-respect: "O God, for so many years I did not take my illness to anyone's door, my God. But now Satan has taken me for weak. Now heal me; I will gird myself up, and I will strike my wife a hundred lashes."
en_old: By the oath of God Almighty, the prophet is a prophet with honor. 'O Allah, for many years I did not take my illness to anyone's door, my Allah, but this Satan has thought me weak. When I am cured I will take my oath: I will strike my wife a hundred lashes.'

brh: ہلیوا شیطان تو مقابلم کیوا اللہ کنے بیماری نا پرواہ ہزار کنا بیماری ئے کسنہ دروازہ غن توٹ کنا اللہ لیکن داسہ شیطان کنے کمزور سمجھانے داسہ نی جوڑ کر کنے تینا پلوء ہلیوا ئے تینا ضعیفہ ء سد شتم خلیوا
en: "...I will take it up and stand against Satan. O God, I do not care about the illness, not even a thousand of them; I did not take my illness to anyone's door, my God. But now Satan has taken me for weak. Now heal me; I will gird myself up, and I will strike my wife a hundred lashes."
en_old: I will not give up; I will stand against Satan. O God, I do not care about the illness, even a thousand illnesses; I will not leave Your door, my God. But now Satan has taken me for weak. Now heal me and bring me to Your side. I will strike my wife a hundred lashes.

brh: شیطان تون مقابلہ کیوا اللہ کنے بیماری نا پرواہ الو لیکن شیطان کنے کمزور سمجھا ئے اللہ کنے زور جوڑ کر پ اللہ دعا قبول کرے پ اللہ سے دعا ہی ہاں نن ارادہ دعا خوانن مسٹ
en: "I will stand against Satan. O God, I did not care about the illness, but Satan has taken me for weak. O God, make me well quickly." Then God accepted the prayer. So prayer is to God alone; yes, we intend to recite a prayer.
en_old: I will stand against Satan. O God, I do not care about the illness, but Satan has taken me for weak. O God, make me strong. Then God accepted his prayer. From God alone, yes; we intended to pray, and we did.

brh: بچہ متو سائیں اڑسا دم ریکھین چار دے یکی اللہ اعتبار کیو کنا اعتبارے بپک جنتک اسے فخ خبن کھرینہ او پی کلنہ خدا بنک پا خدا بنک اونا مرضی ء کہ ہرا وختی نی جوڑ کے شفا تروکا تودی ایوب علیہ السلام خیر نزیل ء
en: The child did not get better, sir... four days of blowing prayers over him... "O God, I will trust in You; my trust..." God hears; say, God hears. It is His will when He makes you well; He is the giver of healing. Ayub, peace be upon him...
en_old: The child did not... Sain, four days of blowing prayers over him... God, I will trust in You, my trust... we eat and drink as God's servants, His will. Whenever You heal me, You are the giver of healing. Ayub (peace be upon him)...

brh: تمانی اور شیطان تو نرا ہنا شیطان ہرا کہ بلکہ دارو کننو پائے تاکہ اونا دا منزل سر مفک شیف تمے لیکن شیطان بے ایمانے دا خبر الو کہ نبیک لوڑو گنبسا کوئٹہ والا شکار پور والا لوڑو کھنیرا پا نبیک لوڑو گنبسا کہ نبی ت ایمان
en: ...and Satan ran away. Satan is the one who even told him to take medicine, so that he would not reach this goal and would fall down. But the faithless Satan did not know that prophets... the people of Quetta, the people of Shikarpur... say, prophets... that the prophets' faith...
en_old: ...and Satan ran away. Satan is the one who tells you to take medicine, so that he does not reach his goal and falls. But Satan is faithless; he did not know that prophets... The people of Quetta and the people of Shikarpur say the prophets... that the prophets' faith...

brh: خدا نا، توکل پہ خدا نا ذات ء، ایوب دیرے توار کرے بیماری ٹی، ابا دیرے، و ایوب اذ نادی، و ایوب اذ نادی، ایوب علیہ السلام توار کرے دیرے، تینا خدائے، ارا وختی کہ ارا تم بیمار مس، تو داسہ بیماری ٹی
en: Of God; trust in God's own being. Whom did Ayub call on in his illness? Dear ones, whom? "And Ayub, when he called out," "and Ayub, when he called out" — whom did Ayub, peace be upon him, call on? His God, at the time when he fell ill, there in his illness.
en_old: Trust in God, trust in the very being of God. Whom did Ayub call on in his illness, brother, whom? Ayub cried out, Ayub cried out. Whom did Ayub (peace be upon him) call on? His God, at the time when he was ill, there in his illness.

brh: دیر ئے توار کروئی؟ دیر ئے بابا؟ اللہ ئے توار، کنے اسہ وار زردوئی کرے دک، انت کرے کنے؟ زردوئی دا خنک پشک و مرا، کنے اسہ دعا پارے براویس، پدا دا اسٹ ارے ماما سے، دم کیک، ہن قران عید کیک، جوان و جوان عید کیک، نبی تا، جوان و
en: Whom should one call on? Whom, baba? Call on God. Once I got jaundice. What did I have? Jaundice; these eyes of mine turned yellow. Someone told me a prayer, brother. Then there is this one, an uncle; he blows prayers over people, he recites the Quran, he recites it really well, the prophets', well and...
en_old: Whom should you call on? Whom, brother? Call on God. Once something was done to me. What did it do to me? It caused me to be... someone told me a prayer, brother. Then there is an uncle who blows prayers over people. He recites the Quran, recites it very well, the prophets...

brh: ایٹ خوانک بیماری خنپیسہ ئے تنی طالب سستا ئے پکان ئے دینا قلندر بھٹائی دستگیر بادشاہ نو اڑے ہن پاس او او ماما او ماما خیر ترے ہران کاسہ پی مائیں
en: He recites it, and you won't see the illness any more... "O Qalandar, Bhitai, Dastgir Badshah!"... O uncle, O uncle, grant us your blessing... where are you going?
en_old: He recites... you don't see the illness... the seeker... of the faith, Qalandar, Bhitai, Dastgir the king... O uncle, O uncle, give alms... where did you drink from the bowl...

brh: پڑھدواں بابا تون وری کیر آنیں؟ مان این پڑھدواں نا؟ بزرگن کے سدیندم تو تنی بیماری ویندی۔ ایب اللہ نی بیمار کرو خدا کرے جوڑ کیکے۔ اللہ نی بیمار کرو خدا کرے جوڑ کیکے۔ شروع کرینے قلندرے بھٹائے الحمدللہ فلانی فلانی فلانی واللہ شیزے پھیری تے داد کنا ایب ئنا لشی نا استے
en: "Baba, who are you, then?" "I am a reciter, am I not? If I call on the saints, your illness will go away." Look, God made you ill; God willing, He will make you well. God made you ill; God willing, He will make you well. They have started: "Qalandar, Bhitai, praise be to God, so-and-so, so-and-so, so-and-so"; by God, going round the shrines... my... body...
en_old: Do you go to the reciter baba? Do you believe in the reciter? If you go to the saints, your illness will go away. Brother, God made you ill; God willing, He will heal you. God made you ill; God willing, He will heal you. They start calling on Qalandar and Bhitai: praise be to God, so-and-so, so-and-so, so-and-so, by God... my brother's body...

brh: ئے خلوص اٹ پئی وا، خدا او ساندارے ئس قران چھٹائے نا، ایوب علیہ السلام ہژدہ سال بیمار ئس لیکن کسے توار کتو، توار خدا کرے، کا داسہ کہ توار کرے، دیرے توار کرے، پاک خدا رے، تو ارا نبی کہ تنے
en: I say this with sincerity: God and... the Quran... Ayub, peace be upon him, was ill for eighteen years, but he did not call on anyone else; he called on God. Now, when he called, whom did he call? The pure God. So which prophet is it that...
en_old: ...with sincerity... God is mighty, the Quran... Ayub (peace be upon him) was ill for eighteen years but did not call on anyone else; he called on God. Now when he called, whom did he call? The pure God. So which prophet...

brh: اینا بیماری ٹی خدائے توار کیک تو نی کنا سبق ہم ہندا دے کہ نن ہم تینا ہر بیماری ہر تکلیف ٹی ہمو خدائے توار کین تو انشاءاللہ ایمان ہم بچک پا انشاءاللہ بیماری ہم کائک۔ تو ایوب علیہ السلام خاچوکے اللہ پائے کنا ایوب نا دعا قبول مسنے۔
en: ...calls on God in his illness. So the lesson for you and me is this as well: that in every illness and every hardship of ours, we too should call on that same God. Then, God willing, our faith will be saved too, and, God willing, the illness will go too. So while Ayub, peace be upon him, lay there, God says, "The prayer of My Ayub has been accepted."
en_old: In his illness he calls on God. So your lesson is also this: in every illness and every hardship, we too should call on that same God. Then, God willing, our faith will be saved and, God willing, the illness will go too. So as Ayub (peace be upon him) lay there, God says, "The prayer of My Ayub has been accepted."

brh: سئی گڑا جوڑ مرے ویا، زو جوڑ مرے وی پداسے جوڑ کے ونی، سئی تو دشمنی کپرا ہنی کپرا، ایو منو خاچو کس گنتی کپا ننے جوڑ کے وا، کنا خدا نا بلو طاقت سے، اگر جھک سلنگے جوڑ
en: "Right, then you will get well, you will quickly get well; then He makes you well. Right, I bear no enmity, nor do I...; I do not count anyone lying sick; I will make you well." My God has great power. "If I heal you standing...
en_old: If something can be healed, it heals quickly, then it heals again. He does no harm and does no... He does not count anyone lying sick; He heals us. My God has great power. If...

brh: اگر کرفے جوڑ کیو تو کنا مرضی، اگر تولنگے جوڑ کیو کسے کنا مرضی، اگر خاتنگے جوڑ کیو کنا مرضی، طاقت کنا ہی ارکض برجلک ھذا مغتسل بارد وشراب، او کنا ایوب، جی کنا الینگا خدا، جی کنا زیبائنگا خدا، ئے کنا
en: If I heal you this way, it is My will; if I heal you sitting, it is My will; if I heal you lying down, it is My will. The power is Mine alone." "Strike the ground with your foot: this is cool water to bathe in and to drink." "O My Ayub." "Yes, my exalted God; yes, my beautiful God; I, my..."
en_old: If I heal by blowing, it is My will. If I heal by... it is My will. If I heal by... it is My will. The power is Mine alone. "Strike with your foot: this is a cool spring for bathing and a drink." O My Ayub. Yes, my sublime God; yes, my beautiful God...

brh: ایوب خندن خنے گاتن ختم کا ایوب یقین ئے اوڑانٹ بلو سور والو ننے بس کنا دوستیا نبیس داسا دن کا بشمنی نا ضرورت اف دارو کننگ نا ضرورت اف انن کے تمانوس ہرتومنتے کھڑی تے تن دغار
en: "Ayub, it has come to an end." Ayub, with his faith in Him, was a very patient one. "Enough now, My friend, My prophet. Now do this: there is no need to get up, no need to take medicine; right where you lie, strike both your heels on the ground."
en_old: Ayub saw... Ayub's faith in Him was great... My friend, the Prophet: now do this. There is no need for anything else, no need for medicine. Get up and strike your heels on the ground.

brh: دغار تے خل ارا دغارے خاچوک ئس کیرن لیپہ کپو بوپہ کپو کٹ ور بسترہ ف نبی دغارے خاچوک نا ایلو مار ہن کے ہرتومنو خاچوک ئس ہرتومناتن کھڑی تے دغار تے خلنگ نا کاریم نا بیماری نا مچو علاج
en: "Strike the ground." Which ground? He was lying on the ground; there was no quilt, no mattress, no cot or bedding. The prophet was lying on the bare ground. Striking both heels on the ground was the complete cure for the illness.
en_old: Strike the ground. He was lying on the ground, with no plaster and no... no bedding. The Prophet lay on the ground... other son, go... strike your heels on the ground. Striking the ground was the cure for every illness.

brh: دا دے جوڑ کننگ کن خدا نا کاری ارے قران یاف دن کبو دن کبو ارے یاف ارے نا تو پائے انشاءاللہ نم نننگ کے نا بے کسر ہچ اف دا ننا بلہ سس پیرو اوڑا خلق والا
en: Healing this one is God's work, isn't it? The Quran, isn't it so? "Do it like this, do it like this" — is it so or not? It is, isn't it? Then he says, God willing... there is no other way. This was our grandmother, an old woman of that village.
en_old: Healing this person is God's work. Remember the Quran; do it like this, do it like this. Remember? He says, God willing... there is no other way. This was our elder, the old man of that village.

brh: چنا ئس جوڑ مفوس، دا خو چنا ئس دا خو چنا ئس گڑا ئے سڑ تو بلہ غے، بلہ بس، دنو راکہ گلہ مس کہ کے شکار لگا، چمکا چنا تے مائی کےسرا، نساد اینگا، دا ثناء اللہ مدرسہ غا کو، مار کو، خوانار، حافظ مسور، قاری، عالم مسور، فالحمدللہ کسرا
en: A child was not getting well. This one is just a child, this one is just a child. Then... grew up, became big; such a thing happened that he fell victim to it... the children... this Sanaullah went to the madrasa, the boys went and studied, became hafiz, qari and religious scholars. So, praise be to God, the path...
en_old: A child was not getting well. This was a child, a child... then he grew up, became big, and it turned out he took up hunting... the children... this Sanaullah went to the madrasa, the boy studied, became a hafiz, a qari and a scholar. Praise be to God.

brh: سگ بند مسو، مالو کھرنا غمبار پلار مخلوق، تو دا پیرنگا بلے اور کہ مچو خلکے پلا کتھنیا، ورنا اسوارو سمیٹیس کا ہشتاد سالہ پیرنگا بشمنی کتوکا کب کب چھرینگا کا۔
en: ...the people were grief-stricken. Then this old grandmother, whom the whole village..., a young rider... an eighty-year-old woman who could not even stand up went wandering about.
en_old: The dog was tied up... the people... this old man was great and... the young rider... an eighty-year-old man who had not...

brh: اوم کل پلا۔ دا امریکہ کا ارا چھنا کے بیمار مروس۔ کامن ولغے چھنائے مسڑکو کامن دبوتا۔ چھنائے اسرو مٹ بلا۔ بلا زنڈو گھورا کے جوان شکار لگا۔ بلا چھنا کن واز جوڑف۔ پئے بابا تخو دادے تخارتا۔
en: ...all of them. There was this one whose child fell ill... the child, the little girl... the child got badly afflicted. The grandmother... for the child... was not well... baba, keep this one...
en_old: ...all of them. In America a child fell ill... the child, the girl... the child grew up, became a big, strong man, and he took up hunting well... his father kept this...

brh: بش مس کہ دا پارے پارن چھرینگا کا گد لھٹی شاغا کا اللہ کنا حیاتی دادیت کنا حیاتی جند ہشتاد سال ناسے مسڑ کو دا مار کو ہشتو ناسے ششتو ناسے ددا بلن حیاتی پیاخا حضرت نوح علیہ السلام نا قوم تلوک
en: She got up and went wandering this way and that, threw down her shawl: "O God, give my life to this one. My own life is eighty years; this little girl, this little boy are eight and six years old. I have had such a long life... the people of Hazrat Nuh, peace be upon him..."
en_old: It happened that he said... God, my life... my own life is eighty years; the son is eighty, sixty... such a long life... the people of the Prophet Noah (peace be upon him)...

brh: کہ ہزار سال عمر تپہ دے چے مستی دے چے چا دے دا بے مراد نہ حیاتی دا غریب شش تو ناسے ہنا سڑو کتے نا عمرے دا دے تھی گت لکھٹی او اللہ کنا پیو نا پٹ آ تا حیائے کس حیائے کس
en: ...who lived a thousand years... today, tomorrow, the day after... this unfortunate one's life; this poor one is six years old... his age... O God, my father's... someone's life, someone's life.
en_old: Even if one lives a thousand years, a day, tomorrow, the day after — this aimless life, this poor life; grandmother went, the old one's life ended, and today she is in the grave. O God, my father's... someone's life, someone's life.

brh: جند ات آیا ارے کہ مخلوقے پھلنگ تھی مڑا دا پارے پاراں چکر کرے کا مڑا پیر تے کلے توار کرے کا شسمائل جان نی توار کیوہ سلطان جان نی توار کنا مرید آ دا دیتس ولہ امت پارے دو مون کیننا ولہ زندہ ایمنا دیس کنا چناتا حیاتی بلومریک
en: ...going round this way and that, the man called on all the saints: "Shah Ismail Jan, I call on you! Sultan Jan, I call on you! My disciple..." By God, the people said, "We will raise our hands in prayer; by God, keep him alive... may my children's life be long."
en_old: It is said that people make the saints happy. The man went round the shrines and called on all the saints: 'Shah Ismail Jan, I call on you! Sultan Jan, I call on you! My disciple gave this.' The people said: 'Pray for her, keep her alive. The life of my children's grandmother...'

brh: واہ پیرنگا غریب آتا دو مون کرو خیرات مرین بلہ کہ مزٹ کروم ککڑی ست بلہ ایت بلہ نا بامال و تراشو کہ ککڑی کوری بیگا اللہ اکبر دانانا ایمان مسلمان دانانا یقین کئی تھنا تمور تین ترسینا
en: Wow, for the old woman they had the poor raise their hands in prayer, and alms were given. The grandmother vowed a chicken to a saint... the grandmother's property... the chicken in the evening. God is great! Is this a Muslim's faith? Is this one's belief...
en_old: Wow, the old woman prays for the poor and alms are given. Grandmother vows a chicken, grandmother's property... the chicken is offered in the evening. God is great! Is this a Muslim's faith? Is this a Muslim's belief?

brh: بلوچ بیمار مرو، ہمروز مرو، بلن نموئے مرو، دا پارہ پور پھیری کونکا، گد لکھٹی شاغاکا، توار کے نورانی جان نی توار کیوا، شسمائل زو کنا توارے بنس، کنا عمر دادیت، ئے پنجاہ سال ناسے، جنت ہشتاد سال ناسے، تینا عمر تے، خبرے تم تو جنت
en: When the child falls ill, the grandmother goes around this way and that, visits the shrines, throws down her shawl, and calls out: "Noorani Jan, I call on you! Shah Ismail, hear my call quickly! Give him my years! I am fifty years old, and she herself is eighty years old; her own years..." Who knows, then paradise...
en_old: A Baloch falls ill, grandmother falls ill. She goes around this way and that, visits the graves, and calls out: 'Noorani Jan, I call on you! Shah Ismail, hear my call quickly! Give me life! She is fifty years old, Jannat is eighty years old, their lives...' Who knows, then paradise.

brh: بلہ ہم لیٹا، پبلہ ہم، انتئے پریشان مریرے بلن لیٹنگ کے، بلہ ہم کھائے بابا دن گا بلہ تو کھائے نا، سئی، بلہ ہم لیٹا، ارا تم بلہ لیٹا تو نواسہ غاتے توار کے، کل مائی کو گھنٹی او مونٹی غلے ردا کندہ
en: Then the grandmother herself lay down sick too. Why do you get worried when the grandmother lies down sick? "Baba, grandmother did this too," right? Grandmother lay down too. When grandmother lay down, she called the grandchildren, all of them... in front...
en_old: Grandmother lay down too. Why do you worry about grandmother lying down? Grandmother coughed too, 'Baba, grandmother coughed like this,' right? Grandmother lay down. When grandmother lay down, she called the grandchildren, all of them, the bell, and in front...

brh: دت نی حیاتی ننا چناتے تو بلہ اینا نن کل بے مراد مرینہ دنو بلہ ئس خلق ٹی اف کے ننے ملانے ناسا بلہ کے بیمار مس ناسا نواسہ غاتے مار تے توار کیک زو کبو ڈاکٹر آتتو دارو ایتبو کنے جوڑو مریم اڑے بلہ
en: "Give your life to our children" — but then, grandmother, we would all be left bereft. There is no grandmother like her in the village. When the grandmother fell ill, she calls her grandchildren and sons: "Quick, take me to the doctors, give me medicine, I want to get well!" Hey, grandmother!
en_old: Give your life to our children's grandmother. We will all be helpless. There is no grandmother like her in the village. When grandmother fell ill, she called the grandchildren and sons: 'Quickly take me to the doctors, give me medicine, make me well.' Where is grandmother?

brh: دا تینا عمرے بشخا سد بندغے انگت بے مرادی جوڑ مریس۔ بلو وس کرے دارو کن اللہ پھل کرے نا ٹائم نہ پورو مسنے۔ پر ٹائم نہ؟ کنا ٹائما؟ آہا، بلن۔ پر کنے اورورغے دڑنگے داسہ۔ بلن۔
en: She had given her life away to a hundred people, and still the unfortunate one wanted to get well. She tried hard with medicine: "God, have mercy." Your time has come. "But — the time? My time?" "Yes, grandmother." "But now I have to..." "Grandmother."
en_old: She gave away her life to a hundred people, and still she remained helpless. Grandmother tried hard with medicine; God made her well, since her time had not come yet. But the time? My time? Yes, grandmother. But now I have to take it.

brh: ٹائم پورا مس، نواسہ غاک رم کر، اسہ مولوی حقانی ئس کا، حقانی توحید پرست ئس بارہ باللہ، عمر اتنے مچو خلق بش خانس، نذرانو آتے کلیسا، نذرانو کھم پنا، فہم بس بابا ملا جان دعا کن نا، گمرہ جوڑ مریفے، عزرائیل پئے تے
en: Her time was up. The grandchildren ran. There was a Maulvi Haqqani; Haqqani was a believer in the oneness of God... the whole village... offerings... "Baba, Mulla Jan, pray for her, so she gets well." Azrael...
en_old: Her time was up. The grandchildren ran. A maulvi Haqqani came, Haqqani was a believer in the oneness of God. They gave the whole village offerings: 'Baba, Mulla Jan, pray for grandmother, make her get well.' Azrael...

brh: دا سندس عالی اونا غورتینا، ایٹم مار تڑینتا، بلہ ہنا دوجا ہن، پیرنگا بلہ دنیا رے فے ہنا، اینو ہم دنو دنیا ٹی رے فوکو بادرے، لیکن قران ہوشیار کیک
en: This... her... her son... the grandmother went to the other world; the old grandmother left this world. Even today there are people in the world who believe like this, but the Quran warns us.
en_old: This... her son was killed, grandmother went to the other world. The old grandmother left the world. Even today there are such believers in the world, but the Quran warns us.

brh: ئے خلتنگا رندات ہمپبو سدھانگا کسر تے دبو کہ یے خدا جنت ء جوڑ کرینو دا را پھلاکو کنوزنانو دا تو دنیا نو پھلاکو او جنت نو پھلاکو پا الحمدللہ ئے دا فیمس اسے دا ذات و لوک اسے ٹی توغلے درے پکرے مسٹ ٹی لیٹوک
en: ...do not go after them; take the straight path, the one God has made into paradise. These fruits... these are the fruits of this world, and those are the fruits of paradise. Say, praise be to God... lying asleep in...
en_old: After... go straight, open the path that God has made paradise. These flowers are the world's flowers and those are paradise's flowers. Say: praise be to God. This... lying in...

brh: علم روشنائی
en: Knowledge is light.
en_old: Knowledge is light.

brh: ابا دا شعیب ء اٹ۔ شعیب انتئے ایڑے تنگ کننگٹی اسا؟ ابا دیر گلاس کیک بندخے، میم برو اخس مزیدار و یخ دیرس ء۔ جوان او سبک، صبر کر، نی دم
en: Dad, this is Shoaib. Shoaib, why were you bothering [people] over there? Dad, a glass of water ... for the man ... come, it's such tasty, cold water! Nice and light. Wait, you ...
en_old: Dad, this is me, Shoaib. Shoaib, why are you bothering people over there? Dad, the water makes a glass for people, we've brought such a delicious cold drink. Good, and light, wait, you...

brh: او منے پیسا صبر کا او چھپا او ننتو نا مستی کے سا صبر کا صبر کا صبر کا دیر شا اوتا چائے آتا دیر دیر شا
en: Oh ... wait, oh, hide, oh, you're messing around with us! Wait, wait, wait, pour the water, their tea ... water, pour the water.
en_old: Oh, they're coming, wait, oh, hide, oh, in front of us, wait, wait, wait, wait, the water... their tea, the water, water...

brh: بس آتے چا بر، نانہ نانہ نانہ، ہا، داسہ بر، معاف کیتہ، معاف کیتہ، بس مریم پارے معاف کیتہ
en: Enough ... come. No, no, no. Yes, come now. Forgive [him], forgive [him]. That's it, Maryam said she forgives [him].
en_old: Come along with the buses, no, no, no, yes, come now, forgive me, forgive me, just, Maryam said forgive me.

brh: معاف کرینے۔ ارنگینا؟ امیت نا دبہ دبو۔ ہمبو، ادبھوتا۔
en: She has forgiven [him]. Where did he go? ... hope ... Go on, ...
en_old: I've forgiven you. Are you well? Don't lose hope. Wonderful, amazing.

brh: او ہو انسپکٹر صاحب نم داڑے؟ انتئے؟ مگہ داڑے بننگ کفر ء؟ ننا تو فرض ء ننا ڈیوٹی ء۔
en: Oh ho, Inspector sahib, you're here? Why? Is coming here a sin? It's our duty, it's our job.
en_old: Oh ho, Inspector sir, you're here? Why? Is coming here a sin? It's our duty, it's our job.

brh: دا علاقہ نا مخلوق نا خیال، حفاظت ننا کاریم ء۔ ننا ہر جاگہ غا ایجنٹ ارے، اگر نی پریشانی ئس اٹی ئس تو نی پا۔ ہا ننا انسپکٹر صاحب، ہا ئے بس اندا۔۔۔
en: Looking after and protecting the people of this area is our job. We have agents everywhere; if you are ever in any trouble, just tell [us]. Yes, our Inspector sahib, yes, just this ...
en_old: Caring for and protecting the people of this area is our job. We have agents everywhere; if you're ever in trouble, just tell us. Yes, our Inspector sir, yes, just this...

brh: والدہ پا نی داڑے امر بس ئے ہندن چکر کے بسونٹ سیلو سوات کے بسونٹ گھنا علاقہ دا جوان جوان چکر خلنگ تو باز جوانی داڑان کیرین بندغنا صحت
en: Mother, tell me, how did you come here? I just came for a stroll, I came for sightseeing. This area is very nice; going on such nice outings is really good; from it a person's health ...
en_old: Mother, tell me, how did you come here? We came here on a trip just like that, we came for sightseeing in Swat. The area is very nice; going around on good trips is very good for a person's health.

brh: ہفتم جوان مریک بندغ کاریم ہم جوان کننگ کیک ہمکنے ہمبار او انسپکٹر صاحب دا کنا علاقہ ئے او پدا تینا علاقہ
en: ... becomes good, and a person can also do his work well. Same for me too. Oh Inspector sahib, this is my area, and moreover my own area.
en_old: ... a person becomes good and can also do good work, so that time the inspector sahib said this is my area and then his own area.

brh: کنا بندغاتا عزت کننگ کنا فرض ء۔ گڈا زیبائیں مش تے ہورنگ ئے ہمیش بریوٹ دا زیبائیں مش تے ہورنگ کن۔ میر صاحب دا مش تے ٹی رہنگوک آ بندغاک ارا گڑا ء؟
en: Respecting my people is my duty. And then, I always come to see the beautiful mountains, to see these beautiful mountains. Mir sahib, what are the people who live in these mountains like?
en_old: It is my duty to respect my people. I always come to see these beautiful mountains, to see these beautiful mountains. Mir sahib, what are the people living in these mountains like?

brh: حفاظت کیرے، نی سمائی اسے تینا ٹوپ نا، ایراٹمی کو تینا عزت نا، ٹوپ نا عزت ہمو بندغ کننگ کیک کہ ہرا دے کاٹم مرے، تینا عزت نا خیال ہمو بندغ تخنگ کیک کہ اونا
en: You protect [it]: you are the guardian of your cap, and secondly of your own honor. Only a person who has a head can uphold the honor of the cap; only that person can take care of his own honor whose ...
en_old: Protect it; you are a guardian of your cap, of your own honor. Only a person who has a head can honor the cap; only a person who... can take care of his own honor.

brh: او ستا ٹی ایلو تے ٹی عزت مرے ہما سوس
en: ... has respect in his heart and among others, that one ...
en_old: May he be respected among the others in his heart, that one...

brh: نی ہاؤ ئے ئے نی خناٹ بسوٹ۔
en: You ... yes ... I saw you, and I came.
en_old: Yes, you ... young man, I have come.

brh: جوانی نی خناٹ نا کنتو امانت ئس توہوکے۔ امانت؟ ہن داسے۔ دادے دا پین؟ او ہمیدے کنو مسوسورے نا دو ہندا تما ولئے نو پد بسوٹ لے۔
en: Good that I saw you; I have something of yours kept in trust with me. In trust? Here it is. This one, this pen? Yes, that very one ... it fell from your hand right here, but then I came back.
en_old: Young man, you have something of mine in trust. In trust? Well, here it is. What else is this? That's it; my hand was ... right there, and then I came back.

brh: سیکنڈ منارے خیر اسے دادا نی تے ئے دادا انت کیوے کنے خواننگ بفک ئے تو شوان اسوٹ نی شوانینا شوق ئے نہ کنے تو خواننگ نا شوق ئے تو گڑا انت ئے
en: Just a second ... all right. Dada, you ...? Dada, what can I do? I can't study, so I've been a shepherd. You have a passion for shepherding? No, I have a passion for studying. So then what's the matter?
en_old: Second, ... what is this, what would I do? I can't study, so I was a shepherd. You have a passion for shepherding, but I have a passion for studying, so what is it then?

brh: ولے دیر خوانفک نی نی پرواہ کپے کنا ابا ماسٹر اسے او نی سکول اٹ داخل کیک نما ارا ارے؟ دموں والا خلق خننگ افس؟ انداڑے کاسے داڑے گدانہ کلک گوکو انداڑے کنا اورا ئے اندا خلق
en: But who will teach me? Don't you worry; my father is a teacher, and he will enroll you in school. Where is your home? Can't you see the village over there? Right there ... here ... tents ... right there is my house, that very village.
en_old: But he takes a long time to teach. Don't you worry, my father is a teacher, he will enroll you in school. Where is your house? Can't you see the people over there? Right here ... here we pass ... over here is my house, right here, these people.

brh: ئے الکم مچ ئس مونی اسہ ریسٹ ہاؤس اسے ریسٹ ہاؤس ٹی باز بلو بنگلو ہمو ننے رنگے گڑا تو باز ہڑکو نی وراخ کنا برے سے کنا بابا پارے کہ دا میرو اسکول ئے
en: ... a palm tree in front, a rest house; in the rest house a very big bungalow; it looked that way to us ... very ... when I came, my father said that this is your school.
en_old: ... a gathering in front of a rest house; in the rest house a very big bungalow, it looked to us like that, very ... when I came, my father said that this is your school.

brh: ٹھیک ہی پاوتے گڑا نکان اینی تپہ چہ تینا ملافو گڑا ئے چاتوٹ ہناکا
en: Alright, I'll tell him. Then we'll go today ... to meet ... I didn't know about it ... going.
en_old: Alright, then we'll go today and see whatever we have to meet; I didn't know, let's go.

brh: کاکا
en: Uncle!
en_old: Uncle.

brh: وعلیکم السلام ماسٹر صاحب خیریت انسپکٹر صاحب خیریت ئے ٹھیک ٹھاک ئے تکڑا کرین ئے پین خیر ئے شکر اللہ نا طبیعت نا جوانی اللہ نا احسانی مہربانی او کیس نا لمی آ بش تنداری فائنل مچورے مسنے اینا نا پرواہ صاحب نن نمے
en: Wa alaikum assalam, Master sahib, is all well? Inspector sahib, all is well, fine and healthy. Is everything else well? Thank God, health is good, by God's favor and kindness. And the case ... has been finalized ... no need to worry, sahib, we ... you ...
en_old: Wa alaikum assalam, master sahib. How are you, inspector sahib? Fine, all well and strong. Anything else? Thank God, health is good by God's grace and kindness, and ... the case ... has been finalized ... don't worry, sahib, we ... you.

brh: آ انتظار کننگٹ اسوٹ۔ امر چناتس لگانے داڑے؟ جیو باز خوشو باز خوشو مریم سلام کن کر دے تینا السلام علیکم بیٹا امر جوان ئس اللہ دا شعیب ارانگینا؟ خبر اف ایری
en: ... I was waiting [for you]. How do [you] like it here? Bless you, very happy, very happy. Maryam, say salaam to ... Assalamu alaikum. Son, how are you, are you well? By God, where did this Shoaib go? I don't know ...
en_old: ... I was waiting. How many children are here? Live long, very happy, very happy. Maryam, say salam to him. Assalam alaikum, son, how are you? Good. By God, where is this Shoaib? I don't know ...

brh: یک تنے نا؟ خیر اسورے نا تا؟ نثار نمان تالے ٹھیک ٹھاک تگڑہ مسنور پی خیرے؟ بیٹا داسے ماتی چا مسخرہ پی تا؟ نن کان شوئے بورن جی او نم ایڑے مونو نثار ئے جا
en: Are you all alone? Have you all been well? Nisar ... you have become fine and healthy; is everything else well? Son, now ... are you joking? We are going ... Yes, and you all over there ... Nisar ...
en_old: Are you alone? Is everything well? Nisar ... are you fine and healthy? Is all well? Son, ... are you joking? We'll go ... yes, and you over here ... Nisar's place.

brh: جاگہ ء خنس؟ ہئو کسر ء دادے دا گٹ گدرینگو بو دا کچ دا کچ بو شاباش ایمبو نا گٹ
en: Did you see the place? Yes, [it's] the road. This one ... this pass will be crossed ... this ... this ... well done ... the pass.
en_old: Did you see the place? Yes, the road; it passes through this, this ... this ... well done, ...

brh: وعلیکم السلام بیٹا، وعلیکم السلام بیٹا، السلام علیکم، وعلیکم السلام، دادے رسے بچا؟ دا ہمو مار ء کہ اولی کو دے نن خنان، دانا ایٹک روڈ اٹ بسر۔ ہاؤ ہاؤ ہاؤ ہاؤ ہاؤ ہاؤ کنے یاد بس، روڈ اٹ داکے ایٹ اٹ بسر ہا؟
en: Wa alaikum assalam, son; wa alaikum assalam, son. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. And this child? This is the same boy we saw that first day; his goats came onto the road. Yes, yes, yes, I remember now: his goats came onto the road, right?
en_old: Wa alaikum assalam, son, wa alaikum assalam, son. Assalam alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Did this one survive? This is the same boy we saw the other day; he was hit on the road. Yes, yes, yes, I remember now. They were hit on the road, right?

brh: انت لے نا بچہ؟ جوان اٹ ماما۔ ابا دادے خواننگ نا باز شوق ئے جوان دادے خواننگ نا باز شوق ئے دا تو باز جوان ہیت اسے۔ ابا دن مف کے نن کاندانہ ورا غت دانہ بائے پانٹ۔
en: How are you, child? I'm fine, uncle. Dad, he is very keen on studying. Good, he's very keen on studying; that's a very good thing. Dad, why don't we go to his house and tell his father?
en_old: What is it, my son? I'm fine, uncle. Father, he is very fond of studying. Good, he's very fond of studying; that is a very good thing. Father, isn't it so? We'll go ... and tell him.

brh: ئے چدا خوانے فی باز جوان ٹھیک ہی کنا چنا نن کانہ دفترا غئے دفتر بائے خننا ورائٹم خننا او بایتہ پانہ کہ تینا چنائے اسکول ٹی داخل کرفی ٹھیک ہی دا سے بچہ کانہ نن دن نیراخ کو
en: ... so that he can study; very good. Alright, my child, we'll go to the office; we'll see his father at the office, we'll see him at home too, and tell his father to enroll his child in school. Alright, now, child, let's go, we ...
en_old: ... he will study, very good. Alright, my child, we'll go to the office; at the office we'll see ... and tell him to enroll his child in school. Alright, son, let's go, we ...

brh: نی ماما معاف کنا مالہ کرم سر مسنو اڑے غم ہریر کن توئی کاو ماما جان کمبو سر کمبو مسر بابو آنٹی نی ہم بر اما نی ہم بر مریم ضد کپہ بر
en: You, uncle, forgive ... my ... we have arrived ... grief ... let me go ... uncle dear ... they have arrived ... Auntie, you come too; Mom, you come too; Maryam, don't be stubborn, come.
en_old: You, uncle, forgive me ... don't grieve ... uncle dear, ... auntie, you come too, mother, you come too. Maryam, don't be stubborn, come.

brh: دا ارغ دادے دے یخ و بیمار مریسے۔ کنتو بازی کبو نا۔ جوان کنا چنا ئے بریوا۔ نئے ئے ڈلے تہ او چنا سے ضد کننگٹی اٹی۔ نئے ئے ڈلے تہ چنا سے است خوش مرے
en: This food ... today it's cold, and you'll get sick. Play with me, won't you? Fine, my child, I'll come. No, let him; the child is being stubborn. No, let him, so that the child's heart is happy.
en_old: Today it is cold and he gets sick. Don't argue with me. Fine, my child, I will come. ... the child is being stubborn ... so that the child's heart is happy.

brh: دے تپاوا انسپکٹر صاحب
en: I'll tell him, Inspector sahib.
en_old: Don't tell him, inspector sahib.

brh: انسان دا سوچ کروئی ئے کہ او دا دنیا ٹی دا خاطرن ودی مسونے کہ او تینا قوم او تینا دا بندغاتا نمائندگی کے
en: A person should think that he was born into this world for this purpose: that he represent his nation and these people of his.
en_old: A person should think that he was born into this world in order to represent his nation and these people of his.

brh: ڈیم نا اورنگ کے کسر اسے لفنگس خناٹ او کنے منع کرے پئے دا کئمپ آ دا بنگلہ سے نو مخلوق کے بنگلہ نا خوڑ کڈے پیرم نو ہما ڈیم ہم جوڑ مرو ہور دیر اسہ نی منع کرے کہ دا کئمپ آ میر صاحب ڈیم نا دا پار مش نا زی آ نا بنگلہ سے
en: On the road toward the dam I saw a hooligan, and he stopped me, saying, 'At this camp there is this bungalow; the people ... near the bungalow ..., and that dam will be built too.' Look, who is he? He stopped me, saying that at this camp, Mir sahib, on this side of the dam, on top of the mountain, there is a bungalow.
en_old: I saw a road being dug for the dam's... and he forbade me, saying at this camp there is a people's bungalow, ...remove it from the bungalow... that dam will be built too... he forbade, saying at this camp, Mir sahib, on the other side of the dam, on the mountain, is a bungalow.

brh: ہمو نا مالک آ کس او۔ ٹھیک ٹھیک او گڑے ٹھکری نا ایلوم مرو۔ ٹھکری نا ایلوم مچے نادانو بندغسے۔ میر صاحب ہمہ نادانو بندغسے کنے زراٹ زخمت خلکس او۔ دان پاننگاٹی ئس او کراڑی نی
en: Its owner, who is he? Okay, okay, then it must be the Takri's brother. The Takri's brother is a rather foolish man. Mir sahib, that foolish man struck me hard with a sword. This is what he was saying ...
en_old: Who is the owner of that? Okay, okay, then it must be the Thakri's son. The Thakri's son is a completely foolish person. Mir sahib, he is a foolish person, he beat me badly by force. He was saying this much, the Hindu...

brh: زغمٹ خلکک ہہ، بے حساب اوتکانے خلنگ اسک، پی مسلمان بس کنے بچے پی محمد ایوب جان، جی، نی ہنوکا دا انجینئر دا چا ما ایچے خدمت کر، ئے کا ٹھکریے خننگ کہ اونا ایلم انتئے دنو ناجائزو کاریم کننگے، بالکل
en: He struck me with a sword, yes; they were beating me without end. Then a Muslim came and saved me. Then, Muhammad Ayub Jan, yes, you go and look after this engineer; I am going to see the Takri and ask why his brother is doing such wrongful things. Absolutely.
en_old: He was wounded, they were beating him endlessly, then a Muslim came and saved me, Muhammad Ayub Jan. Yes, you who are going, serve this engineer... and see the Thakri, why his son is doing such unlawful things. Absolutely.

brh: یرین خنتے۔ ئے دے ود اسہ انجینئر نا خدمت ٹی کیوہ نی دروت خن۔ ٹھیک ہی جی اوجھل۔ بالکل۔ ئے دانا خدمت ء کیک ئے کاو چکری ء خنیو۔
en: With pleasure. I will attend to the engineer; you take a good look. Okay, yes sir. Absolutely. I will look after him, and I will go and see the Takri.
en_old: Look at them. One day I will serve an engineer, you look properly. Okay sir... Absolutely. He serves him, and I'll see the Thakri.

brh: اڑے نمونو! اڑانگ ہنانس، اڑانگا برنگوس؟ تیدم! ئے چے اڑانگا بریک؟ امی بنگلہ نا ایپا نا ڈغار اف۔
en: Hey, you character! Where have you been, where are you coming from? ... Where is that coming from? Isn't that the land across from the bungalow?
en_old: Hey, look! Where did you go, where are you coming from? Look! What's coming from over there? The land by our bungalow isn't father's land.

brh: امودے کنا سودا کروئی ئے گڑا نی انت پاسے؟ ادا کنا میٹ انت پاننگٹی اٹی اؤس؟ داسہ زمین تے سودا کننگٹی اٹی اؤس؟ ہیرو ماما کھیو کنے پیسا ضرورت ئے کنا خرچہ غاک زیات او
en: I have to sell that one of mine; what will you say then? What is this you are telling me here? Are you selling the lands now? Uncle, I need money; my expenses are high.
en_old: On that day I have to sell, then what will you say? What is my uncle saying here? Are you now selling the lands? Hero uncle, I need money, my expenses are high.

brh: ادا خرچاک نی زیادہ او، دننگے نی کم کرک، نی دے دے اٹی اسہ ٹوپہ جوڑ کرسا تخسا کاسہ تینا کاٹومانی، علم دا کوسنے، دانا فلاک او، دا طریقہ ٹی تو خرچاک باز مریرہ
en: Your expenses here are too high; you should cut them down. Every few days you have a cap made and keep putting it on your head, brother, and these shoes ..., this way, of course, the expenses will be big.
en_old: His expenses are too high, cut down on this. Every few days you build and keep a hut... this way the expenses become very high.

brh: مچے شیف تور تینے مچے غریبی تینا ہٹک بار بارا ہر ٹوپ ء بینیسہ بار بارا اسے کوس ء بینیسہ تینا بتونو خردسہ نی زمین تے سودا کیسہ تین کوس کیسہ دا مرو لو
en: Keep yourself a little humble, a little modest. Again and again you wear a new cap, again and again you wear a new shoe, you keep buying things for yourself, you are selling the lands; is this going to work?
en_old: All... you yourself... all poverty is yours... again and again you look at every hut, again and again you look at one... you sell your own lands, you... this will be...

brh: سفری کرینگٹی اؤس امر اوٹ جانی امر او زغمہ زل کنوس پنج لکھ روپئی ڈار کے پر کرینوس دادو جوانو کارم اف کہ نی دازدہ کارم جوانو کرینگٹی کنا نظرٹی تو نی صفا دا بیکارو کارم کرینگٹی اؤس
en: Are you travelling? How is it, dear, how have you taken up this sword? You have poured five lakh rupees into it. This is not good work; you think you are doing good work, but in my view you are doing completely useless work.
en_old: Are you travelling? How did it go, dear? You've spent five lakh rupees on... this is not a good deed; you think you're doing good work, but in my view you're doing completely useless work.

brh: دا زغم نی امر کیک غریب نا چنا سے اوست نا غریبی کرک ٹکری سے نا ایلوموٹ زغم تو کنا ڈوٹی لازمی ئے تونو ننا دنیا نا زغمک تیوخو کوٹی ٹی ننا باوہ پیرئی
en: What will you do with this sword? A poor man's child should be humble at heart. I am the brother of a Takri; a sword in my hand is a must. Anyway, all our swords lying in the room are our ancestral ones.
en_old: How can you inflict this wound? A poor man's child... poverty... from the Thakri's son, the wound is surely in my hands... all the wounds of our world... our forefathers' inheritance.

brh: دا گڑا کو، جا کہ جوانو جوانو گڑا ارے، دا زنی دا پنچ لکھ شش لکھ داڑ کے پرکس تینا نا ارے بابا پیرئی آ گڑا، ہمفتن تینا افک، ہرو برو کہ نشاؤ کے، ٹکری گری تو دادے جوانی اسے۔
en: These things, where there are good things, you blew five lakh, six lakh rupees here. What you have are ancestral things; they are not even your own. Surely ... being a Takri is a fine thing for this.
en_old: This thing, where there are good things, these... you spent five or six lakh on... it's your forefathers' property, not even your own... the Thakri is good at this.
