en: Why are you throwing yourself into trouble, Bakhtawar? ... my uncle ... (unclear) ... uncle, ... he wants to rise up against us; that Ali is that kind of man.
en_old: Why are you throwing yourself into trouble, Bakhtawar... uncle... we want to live... uncle, someone's... they want to rise above us; that Ali is that kind of man.

brh: بسنت پاوا با، اسہ ڈپی رو نا باوے کہ کنا قدرے تپک۔ راس پاوا، کنا کنڈان تو ہاوئے، دانا باوانا کنڈان ہم ہاوئے، ولے دانا باوا پارے کہ
en: Well, what can I say, Dad: it's some ...'s father who doesn't value me. Honestly, from my side it's a yes, and from her father's side it's a yes too, but her father said that
en_old: Basant's father... his father said that he doesn't value me. Tell the truth: from my side it's yes, from her father's side it's yes too, but her father said that

brh: کہ ئے اسہ وار تینا ایلم مٹہ تون سلاہ کیو ولدا او کنے پد جواب ایتو۔ الے نی ایلم مٹہ تون او ہڑ ئے تو پاوہ بس ہاو کبو۔ ہندونو جوان ء مار خن پورو رے ہاو۔ اسل اسینا قسمت ملنگے
en: he would consult his brothers and relatives once, and then give me an answer later. [I said,] 'Forget the brothers and relatives and all; I'm telling you, just say yes. Look at such a fine boy... yes.' Really, it's a matter of one's fortune opening up.
en_old: I said I'll talk it over with my brothers once, and then he'll give me an answer later. No, forget the brothers, just say yes. Such a good boy, look, just say yes. In the end it comes down to whose fate it is to meet.

brh: ئے چار والا مات تے پاننگٹ، او ایڑے پاروئی تمک کہ او ننا رشتہ نئے اتیٹ، انت مطلب ننا رشتہ؟ مطلب دا کہ کنا رشتہ نئے اتیٹ، انتئے؟ ئے کسکوٹ مگر نا برام اسینا تو مریک، انتئے؟ ئے کسکوٹ کہ نا رشتہ مریک، اللہ۔
en: I've told them four times: he'll have to tell his sister that he is giving our match to you. What do you mean, 'our match'? I mean that he is giving my match to you. Why? I'd die! But your marriage will happen with someone, why? I'd die, now that your match is happening, oh God.
en_old: I was telling the elders that he has to say he's part of our proposal. What do you mean, our proposal? I mean he's in my proposal, why? I thought you'd be marrying someone, why? I thought it was your proposal that was happening, oh God.

brh: ئے وٹ کنا رشتہ نا ایٹ مریٹ اوہو چنکا ئے وٹ کنا جوڑ مریٹ اوہو اورینے پاننگاٹی وٹ کہ بلا ئے وٹ اول کنا رشتہ نا ایٹ مریٹ او مسوس نا تو مننگ کپک او کنا ایٹ مسونے اینتا مننگ کپک کنا مریٹ امر مریٹ
en: And what's going to happen with my match? Oh ho, the younger one... and will my match get made? Oh ho, he's going around telling them, 'Well, first my match has to happen; until it has, yours can't happen.' And mine... why can't mine happen? How is mine going to happen?
en_old: Will my match be arranged? Oh, the little one, will mine be arranged? He's saying, first will my match be arranged? If it didn't happen, then it can't happen. Mine is settled, so why can't it happen? How will mine happen?

brh: بس ساقی مریک تو کنا مریک ہو مستوس نہ تو ادینا کسر او کنا کسر دا بس اینک دیر تین شکنا ئے تیلے صاف ئے تسکرہ کنت پنی خواس او انکل خلک کنا مسنگ باز زیبا مریرہ
en: Well, if it works out [for him], mine will happen; if it doesn't, then his road is his and my road is mine. ... (unclear) ... And uncle, the girls of my village are very beautiful.
en_old: If it's Saqi, then it's mine. If not, then her path is hers and my path is mine... The village girls are very beautiful.

brh: نانت خالہ مگر کنا مسڑ کس آن کم نہ انکل ثناء اللہ نا مٹ تینٹ ولے اونا قدرے کس تپک اگر نی پاسہ تو ئے خلق آن کاوہ احوال ایٹیو نا نا دنیکے خا
en: What, aunt? But my daughter is no less than anyone. Uncle Sanaullah is one of a kind himself, but nobody values him. If you say so, I'll go to the village and pass on the word ... (unclear).
en_old: What, aunt? My daughter is no less than anyone. Uncle Sanaullah's son himself, but nobody values him. If you say so, I'll go from the village and bring the news...

brh: خلک اوار کر نیم دیوا او خلک ایمورینا او خلک والاتی مورینا
en: Gather the family together, ... half ... and the family ... and the family's people ...
en_old: Include the village, half crazy, and the village... and the villagers...

brh: ابا داڑے تو کسہ فک صرف ئے و نی اون تو بڑا ابا
en: Dad, there's nobody here; it's only me and you, so ... Dad.
en_old: Dad, it's only me and you here, dad.

brh: کنے نی تون اینو اسہ ضروری ہیت ئس کروئی ء۔ اہو، بہ دا کتو۔ بہ ئے بنگنوٹ کہ کنا ارٹوم ایلم تا سانگ ء بٹ
en: I have to have an important talk with you today. Oh, well, go ahead. Well, I've heard that my second brother's engagement...
en_old: I need to talk to you about something important today. Yes, come on, go ahead. Look, I've heard that my second brother's proposal...

brh: کنا باوہ ئے سما تما کہ نی تینا ایلم نا دشتار ئے خنانہ کیرغان کرینوس دا غارک دے زندہ زندہ کٹک نی آئی اگر بشا رینتوکے آئی کہ دا ایلم تے ہتوکے تو کنا تسینہ تو برام مسک نی خفتو ولدا ہمو
en: If my father finds out that you have been eyeing your brother's fiancée on the sly, he will bury you alive in a pit, you. Mother, if ... mother, if you had brought these brothers, then my ... then my wedding would have happened. Listen, again that same ...
en_old: My father should know that you have seen your brother's fiancée... if you had... then my marriage would have happened. You won't sleep again...

brh: متاوکہ اوما ہسینہ تینا اوستن کش زلفینہ نا خیالے تینا اوستٹی تخ ہومسوس آئی اما کیو ہسینہ تو کنا اوست لچانی ہسینہ مگیس ہسینہ نا اوست لچانی
en: If it doesn't work out, oh Hasina, take it out of your heart; keep the thought of the curly-haired one in your heart ... Mother, what shall I do? Hasina, my heart is helpless; Hasina ... Hasina's heart is helpless.
en_old: If that beautiful one doesn't... keep the thought of her curly locks in your heart. Mother, what shall I do? Beautiful one, my heart is restless, beautiful one, my heart is restless.

brh: جانی گنوک مسنس شکر کشہ شکر کشہ کہ اندا زلی نا برام نی تون مرے ہاو ہاو گڑا شکرے کنے ئے گڑا اینو ہم پداسے نی باجی پاو ہاو داسے تینا
en: Darling, have you gone mad? Thank God, thank God that Zali's wedding is going to be with you. Yes, yes. So then, the thanks go to me? So from today on you too say 'sister' — yes, now your own ...
en_old: Jani, I've gone mad. Thank goodness, thank goodness that Zali will be married to you, yes, yes. Then thank me. Then today too... you say sister, yes, now your own...

brh: کاریم تے کرک مغز خلپہ کنے ہم دمب کریسک۔ او۔ او۔ صحیح ہی آئی ئے پاپا سے تو نہیں کوئی اور صحیح۔ ابر بر نا کمیز بر۔ مہربانی۔
en: Get on with your work, don't rack my brain, let me rest too. Oh. Oh. Fine, Mom — if not Papa, then someone else, fine. Abar, come, your shirt — come. Thank you.
en_old: Do the work and don't rack your brain, let me rest too. Oh, oh. Okay, Mom, if not Papa then someone else, fine. Abar, bring the shirt. Thank you.

brh: آئی جی کنا مات برے نی تک مسورکا او آئی کنے نی تون اسے ہیتس کروئی ئے
en: Mother dear, my mother, come here, are you ...? Oh mother, I need to talk to you about something.
en_old: Mom, my dear mother, come here... Mom, I need to talk to you about something.

brh: نا پاکہ کنا مات، نی انتئے نا اوست نا ہیتاتے پاپہ؟ آئی، خدا کنا برام دے تون کیسہ؟ کنا مات، نی کہ ہمدہ خلق اٹی مسڑ ئس پٹے، وی نا ہم برام مریک۔ ہیت ئس پاو نی
en: Tell me, my mother, why don't you say what is in your heart? Mother, by God, who are you going to marry me to? My mother, if you look for a girl in this very village, then I too will get married. Say something, you!
en_old: Tell me, my mother, why don't you say what's in your heart? Mother, by God, will you arrange my wedding? My mother, if you find a girl in this same village, I'll have a wedding too. Say something.

brh: دا شرفک خلق سے داڑے کنا مرد پتلون چلینگ پک تینا امو جوان جوان پچاتے بیر انی پاشتا چلومی تے کنے این پچاتے نا بدل کے ہاؤ ئے
en: These are respectable people here. My husband doesn't go in for trousers; those fine, fine clothes of his own ... do me an exchange for these clothes, okay?
en_old: These people are noble here. My husband wears trousers, he doesn't wear his good clothes... give me these clothes in exchange, yes.

brh: نذراننگا آئی ہاؤ آن پٹ چکار مروک ہاؤ پتن چک شاباش کنا کاریم کسے نا ہاؤ ہاؤ مالو نا کارٹون نا خٹک مچٹ اسورا پین بس لکھاتی کروٹاں
en: Nazrana ... Mother, yes, from ... yes ... well done, my work is nobody else's, yes, yes. The ... of the goods' cartons were few; then more came; I will ... [rest unintelligible].
en_old: Nazrananga, Mom, yes... well done, my work... yes, yes, Malo's cartoon... were small, then more came, I wrote a lot.

brh: واہ یار واہ استاد نن توتاسے واقعی مستونگائیسس ننے توتاس گنڈیسس بے شک بے شک اللہ نا ہرا ہرا رحمت آتا کیرے سفت و ثناء کیرے اللہ نا سنگت آتا
en: Wow, friend, wow, master! We really came to Mastung for a mulberry; you have gotten us mulberries. Of course, of course. Whatever mercies God gives, praise and glorify God, friends.
en_old: Wow, friend, wow, master! We really found a parrot in Mastung, we caught a parrot. Of course, of course. Whatever blessings God gives, praise be to God, my friends.

brh: اچھا لو، دیر استن خیرات نا، احمد زئی دے؟ ہا، او، او، توت نا، دن شوکی نا، دے وقتس کے گڑا جوٹی دم تک دن کے کرے کے توتے خلک ہمہ کڑائے ملہ کے، اوہو، بے شک بے شک کنا خاطرہ توت کمک
en: Okay then, whose charity feast is it — the Ahmadzais'? Yes, oh, oh — the mulberries, such fondness for them; at one point then ... they beat the mulberries down ... oh ho, of course, of course, for my sake the mulberries ...
en_old: Okay then, how long is the charity feast, the Ahmedzai day? Yes, oh, oh, the mulberries, the day of the feast... then at that time... the mulberries... Oh, of course, of course, for my sake, the mulberries...

brh: او شاتوت ہم برما۔ ساڈے محترم انت سے بمبراٹ ہائے بھنڈی بروتی شیر خان۔ یارا بھنڈی بروتی وانگڑ بروتی ہا واکی دا تو شیر خانی ہمودے
en: And king mulberries will come too. Our respected one, what is it ... hey, will okra come, Sher Khan? Friend, will okra come, will eggplant come? Yes, really, this is Sher Khan's own thing, that one.
en_old: He'll bring mulberries too. Our respected... hey, bring okra, Sher Khan. Friend, bring okra, bring vegetables... this is Sher Khan's own thing.

brh: جوڑ جوڑ بننگٹی ئے بیننے ڈامر مسنے، دام معلوم کرک، ہا، خیرات، بالکل بالکل، ولے ئے ہودے ہلیپروٹ، دن گٹ تر تالوٹ، ہیٹ این تالوٹ، ئے چیلے
en: It is coming along fine, you see; it has been asphalted. Find out the price. Yes, the charity — absolutely, absolutely. But I won't take that one. I'll ... it like this, I'll ... this matter, that ...
en_old: It's being built, you see, it's been paved with asphalt. Find out the price. Yes, the charity, absolutely, absolutely, but I won't take that... I'll shake it like this, I'll shake the matter...

brh: الے دا رفیق امر بسنے دا ہم چارات ہا گڑا خان سے نڑنگ نڑنگ بسنے یا اللہ گنی یا اللہ گنی ابو ارے تورے رے استا مرک مرک زیڑے تموٹ یا خدا
en: Hey, how did this Rafiq get here? This one too ...? Yes, and then a Khan came running, running. Oh God, ... oh God, ...! Father is there, hold him! My heart is going, going — I'm about to fall down, oh God!
en_old: Hey, how did this Rafiq come? He also... yes, then a khan came running, running. Oh God, help! Oh God, help! Father is there, stop... I'm getting dizzy and falling, oh God.

brh: یا اللہ یا اللہ موت اسے بچاٹ آمین خانہ نکک خلیفر کنے اسکنہ پائک کہ ہا اسکنہ پائک کہ پین برام ئس کیو ہا برام برام داسہ کنا شار والا مات
en: Oh God, oh God, I've escaped a death, amen ... They keep telling me so much — yes, they keep telling me so much that I should have another wedding. Yes, a wedding, a wedding. Now my mother from the town ...
en_old: Oh God, oh God, save us from death, amen... they keep telling me so much, yes, they keep saying I'll have another wedding, yes, a wedding, a wedding, now my mother from the city...

brh: شیر خان او ارے شار آن تو بسس چلا دا ہیٹ نن ہرا دے ہیٹ ارٹ ہمو ایٹ گاکے تعویذ کے دریسک پا
en: Sher Khan, oh, you're back from town? Come on, that matter — the one we, which day, the matter ... that matter, the amulet — did you get it? Tell me.
en_old: Sher Khan, is he there? Did you come from the city? Come on, that thing we... that day, that matter, they tore up the amulet, tell me.

brh: اریز! ایٹ ستے وئی کنوم ہمو ایٹ نپاوے۔ ایچو ایٹ مٹے صاف۔ پب مسورے۔ ہن جوان، انگور نا نن گلبیبی ئے کل ایتا تے پارو نو۔ نہ نہ نہ نہ، گلبیبی پاپیرے، گلبیبی پاپیرے
en: Ariz! ... don't say that thing. Not a word — clear? You've become ... Hmm, fine, we'll tell Gulbibi everything about the grapes. No, no, no, no, don't tell Gulbibi, don't tell Gulbibi!
en_old: Ariz! ... don't say that thing. Not a single word, clear? They've become... Okay, good, we'll tell Gulbibi all the words about the grapes. No, no, no, no, Gulbibi won't say it, Gulbibi won't say it.

brh: ٹھیک ہی نما ایٹ کنا زیہ وام، شار نا ایٹ اسہ ایٹ نا ایرا ایٹ آتے ونم کے۔ ہا، راست پاریس؟ وعدہ۔ شاباش شیر خان، دادے پارے، ولے؟
en: Okay, your word is a debt upon me. About the town matter, I won't turn one word into two. Yes — did you tell the truth? Promise. Well done, Sher Khan, that's what he said, right?
en_old: Okay, your word is my... the city's word, one word... Yes, did you tell the truth? Promise? Well done, Sher Khan, that's what he said, right?

brh: نور واجہ نا پکا مرید سے پکا پکا او او ہا اگڈا نرینہ سے شے ئے واہ جی واہ اسلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام السلام علیکم انکل وعلیکم السلام انکل ئے ننگ اوٹ خلکے اگن ہم پارے
en: He is a staunch follower of Noor Waja, staunch, staunch. Oh, oh, yes, and then he is a real man. Wow, sir, wow. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Assalamu alaikum, uncle. Wa alaikum assalam, uncle. ... he said that too.
en_old: He is a devoted disciple of Noor Waja, truly devoted, yes, yes, and then he's a man, wow, sir, wow. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Assalamu alaikum, uncle. Wa alaikum assalam, uncle... he said that too.

brh: تو گڑا ور کنا۔ اسائنمنٹ اولڈ کیسی سنا جی۔ نظام نا فون ہی ئے پاننگٹی کہ خلک ایننگٹی اور۔ اوت پا کنے مچے کاریم مسنے الوفتا کنا۔ دنکہ کہ سنا نا مچے کاریم مسنے۔
en: So then, my way. The assignment, the old case, Sana ji. It's Nizam's phone; he's saying that the family is on its way. Tell him: all my work has been done ... Just as all of Sana's work has been done.
en_old: So then... the assignment, the old case, Sana ji. Nizam's phone... he's saying that... Tell me, all their work is done. Just like all of Sana's work is done.

brh: ولا ایلو افطار کانے، انکر انتس کینو ما ہورکوم، ثناء اگر دا شیر خان اسکن دا افطار ٹی بسور گڑا، ولے ولدا ننے ایننگ نان ضرورت خلکر
en: By God, the next iftar is coming; what shall we do then? We'll see. Sana, if this Sher Khan and the others do come to this iftar, then — but then we would need to go again.
en_old: Then there's the other iftar. What will we do then? Sana, if this Sher Khan comes to this iftar, then... but then we'll need to bring it again.

brh: نظام ارا ہیتاتے کریکے؟ کنے ہموتے شک بننگ ء، نیم چٹ او راست مفس۔ نی شک ء مر کر، نی اسل فکر کپہ۔ ہفتہ سے، اگر دا ہفتہ ٹی بسر تو ٹھیک، اگر بتو تو نی ایوار کنا خلک۔ چلو صحیح ء۔ نی فکر کپہ۔
en: What things was Nizam saying? I'm having doubts about them — half of it is lies and it isn't true. Don't you doubt it, don't worry at all. It's a week: if they come this week, fine; if they don't come, then you, together with my family ... Okay, fine. Don't you worry.
en_old: Nizam, what are you saying? I have doubts about it, it's half lies, it isn't true. Don't doubt it, don't worry at all. A week; if they come this week, fine, and if they don't, then you can... me. Okay, fine. Don't worry.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ بابو خیر، مبارک مرے نماز، باز باز مبارک مرے، باز باز مبارک، قربان، باز باز مبارک مرے نماز، باز باز مبارک مرے، خیر مبارک۔ السلام علیکم۔ خیر مبارک مرے۔
en: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Babu, greetings — may your prayer be blessed, many, many blessings to you, many, many blessings, I'd lay down my life for you, many, many blessings on your prayer, many, many blessings. Blessings to you too. Assalamu alaikum. Blessings to you too.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you too. Sir, all is well. Blessings on your prayers, many, many blessings, I'd give my life for you. Many, many blessings on your prayers, many blessings. Blessings to you too. Peace be upon you. Blessings to you too.

brh: ادا مو کاریم تا کنے پارے سس نی ہاؤ ہاؤ ہموچ کاریم تا نن کرینے، ٹینٹ تا کسر، رزان تے اسونہ، کموٹ اتیکھانے، دا باز جوان کریرے، یک ہفتہ کے پریشان اسوٹ آ، شاباش ئے نمے، نہ نہ بے غم ماس، ٹینٹ والا ئے دیگ والا ئے فل ئے
en: You had told me about all that work. Yes, yes, we have done all of that work — the tents' business, the crockery ..., ... You did this very well; I was worried for a whole week. Well done to you all! No, no, don't worry — the tent man is there, the cooking-pot man is there, everything is complete.
en_old: He told me about all of that work. Yes, yes, all of that work we did: the way to the tents, the ropes... it was done very well. I was worried for a week. Well done to you! No, no, don't worry, the tent guy and the cooking-pot guy are all set.

brh: ماما پنگو نی ایت کمسونے ہر کس خناتے اونا اورا غٹر کیتے اسیناٹ اسیناٹ اونا ایلانس پنیرے ماما پنگو نی ایت کمسونے ہر کس خناتے اونا اورا غٹر کیتے
en: Uncle Pingo, your goat has gone missing. Whoever has seen it, let his household know. One by one ... listen to the announcement about it. Uncle Pingo, your goat has gone missing. Whoever has seen it, let his household know.
en_old: Uncle Pingo, you've... everyone saw him, his house... one by one, one by one, his brother... Uncle Pingo, you've... everyone saw him, his house...

brh: ارے آفتاب بنگس، مئے بنگل نا ایٹ گمس، او باز غریبہ بندغ اسے، او دے نی اولاد ئس ارے نیک و پین، او نہ بس انتس کہ ارے مئے ایٹ نا پالتس ئے ہچ الینگک، نی سہی پاسے شعیب، ننے دز مالے نا ارے
en: Hey Aftab, did you hear? The goat from our bungalow has gone missing. He is a very poor man, and he has children, good ones and so on. He didn't come ... hey, our goat's ... won't let go at all. You're right, Shoaib, we've got a livestock thief.
en_old: Hey Aftab, did you hear? Our neighbour's goat got lost. He's a very poor man, and he has children, good ones... He didn't come... Hey, our goat's... he won't let it go at all. You're right, Shoaib, we have to steal the livestock.

brh: ما بگو نی اٹی متین واپس۔ دار کس کیرے ضرور پیشن نہ بندہ وسے۔ دا شارٹ اسے بندہ واسم دونو اف کہ او دوزی کے۔ کلمستو معلوم کین کہ دا دوز دیر اسے اور کرے دا شارٹ دا کوسکونیا بندہ دیر بسونی۔
en: ... come back. Do something, definitely ... In this town there is no person like that, who would steal. Let's all find out who this thief is, and in this town, who this ... person is who has come.
en_old: Come back... Do something, but definitely don't let anyone out. This is a short... a person isn't the kind who would steal. Everyone knows the thief is someone else... this short person came late.

brh: دا شار نا بندغاک باز سادہ اور بے وقوف خننگرہ۔ اوس پائک ہنداڑے منا دے مریف گڑا سامان مچ کیو۔ گڑا کپاٹ۔
en: The people of this town look very simple and foolish. Something tells me: let a few days go by here, then I'll gather up the goods. Then ...
en_old: The people of this village seem very simple and foolish. He says, when my day comes here, then gather the things. Then I won't do it.

brh: چاٹ گفترے اینو ہم دا کنے انت کرور کلے ڈیک
en: ... today too, what will these people do to me ...
en_old: Chat... even today, what will this do to me...

brh: ماما، امر گمسیٹ نا؟ یار، ئے تے اندازے سلے وی زد بے امبوجا لیا، الکل چورنگا پالسی خننگ نا واجو چھپی، دانگی انگودان ایت
en: Uncle, how did yours get lost? Friend, ... [garbled] ... the thief ... seeing ... hidden ... wandered off this way and that.
en_old: Uncle, how did you get lost? Friend, ... somehow... the thief's way of watching, hidden... [partly unintelligible]

brh: ماما، نی اراغ اینک، ننا انشاءاللہ عید نا پٹینے اور واپس اتینے تے برینہ۔
en: Uncle, are you going home? God willing, we'll [spend] Eid and then come back.
en_old: Uncle, you're eating food. God willing, on Eid we'll... and come back.

brh: اڑے نور علی یار باز کریس دزی یار دا شار نا سوف
en: Hey Noor Ali, man, you've stolen a lot of this town's apples, man.
en_old: Hey Noor Ali, friend, you stole a lot of this village's apples, friend.

brh: او باز ہنین او، باز بنگن او، دا شار نا سوفت آ باراٹی، بر کے اینو سوفت ہم دو ئس شاغین مزہ ایتو ارین۔
en: Oh, they're very sweet, very ... — I mean this town's apples. Come on, today let's get our hands on some apples too and see how they taste.
en_old: They're very sweet, very... these apples of the village. Come on, today let's get our hands on the apples too and have a taste.

brh: اچھا تو دز دا دے کہ دتوس ننا شارٹ دزی کنے دا صاف تا بے پاوے
en: Okay, so the thief is this one, the one who did the stealing in our town? Tell me this clearly.
en_old: Okay, so the thief is the one who took him, our ... theft, tell me this clearly.

brh: باز انینو سوف اسورے اندن پاریسور واقعی اندنو سوف اسورے گڑاس دینک ہم انگسٹا کم خن جاگہ غا دینم تخن مسینگہ گڑا بندختم مرے
en: There were very sweet apples — that's what they used to say; there really were such apples. For some days we would also keep them in some out-of-sight spot ..., then they would be used up.
en_old: There were very sweet apples. They were saying there really were such apples... some days too... put them in a place... then it's finished.

brh: شکر ہی اللہ نا، ایراغ نا تو ازم مس، پڈ تو پر مس، داسہ ذرہ ئس آرام کین لیٹٹ، ہلی دا پڈ نا نمہ دے پدی آن دو لہم مریسہ ہننگ ء۔ ئے کیرے اودے تینا خن تٹ خناٹ۔ او
en: Thank God, the food has gone down and the belly is full. Now let me lie down and rest a little ... after that ... I saw him with my own eyes. He ...
en_old: Thank God, today's work is done and the pit is filled. Now let's lie down and rest a bit... after that... I saw him with my own eyes.

brh: ئے واجی لاڑی نا باغان سوف دزاکین۔ مزہ پٹ ڈسس، پٹ تو دو نمبر پشت تما سس۔ شاباش شعیب شاباش، دا باز جوان و کاری مس کینوس۔ ادا سسو چکی دا دو زمر الینک۔ داسہ نن دون کینے، ئس بل لوک ڈی
en: ... he has been stealing apples from Mr. Lari's garden. ... it had fallen back ... Well done, Shoaib, well done, this turned out really good and effective. ... Now we'll do it like this: ...
en_old: We'll steal apples from Mr. Lari's garden. The taste... the two of us fell behind. Well done, Shoaib, well done, you did a very good job. Here... these two... leave. Now we'll do it like this...

brh: ۔۔۔س ختنے، کڈ آن زی تخنے پاٹ، پاٹ تا زی شاغانے پن، ولہ پن آن زی اسہ اینو نا قیمتی گڑاس تخنے کہ او لازمی بریک، او بسک تو تمے کڈ ٹی، کڈ ٹی کہ تما ننا نلے نت، حاجی لاڈیس تہ باغ مونی کرے کڈس ختنے، او نا بننگ آن مست
en: ... we'll dig a pit, put sticks on top of the pit, spread leaves on top of the sticks, and then on top of the leaves put something valuable of today's, so that he's sure to come. When he comes he'll fall into the pit; once he falls into the pit, our ... We'll dig a pit in front of Haji Lari's garden, before he comes.
en_old: ...we dug a pit and put wood on top of it, then grass on top of the wood. On top of the grass we'll put something valuable today so that he definitely comes. When he comes he'll fall into the pit... We dug a pit in front of Haji Lari's garden before he came.

brh: ارے نورل بش مے بابا دا کس خاچنگ جوان افک پگہ دئے ٹنا مالیکاک بسور ہندا پھڈا نا من افینٹ
en: Hey Noorul, get up, man — sleeping this much isn't good. Tomorrow in the daytime your masters will come, and I'm not up for the same squabble again.
en_old: Hey Noorul, all of us, father, sleeping like this isn't good. Tomorrow our owners will come, and the same quarrel...

brh: یار شعیب کھڈ تیار ئے نیزو ئسن نا پاٹ تے، بس عید ئس نی کھڈ آن پیشتم۔
en: Friend Shoaib, the pit is ready. You quickly [get] the sticks ..., that's it — now come out of the pit.
en_old: Friend Shoaib, the pit is ready... the wood... by Eid you'll be getting out of the pit.

brh: اوے ارے خن چٹ نی شرم بدل کنا ایٹی دزس
en: Hey you, you shameless wretch! Instead of being ashamed, you stole my goat!
en_old: Hey, you shameless one! Instead of being ashamed, you stole from my house.

brh: دا زباتی نا ناس شرف زرس، خیرات، شکر تا دا چنا تا ئے کشیوک، شکریہ ادا کیوک، کہ کنا ہیٹی واپس یسور، دا ہیٹ ہم بیدستو کنا شاخائی کنارہ پاس کنتو ایدس کانی زندہ اوٹ، اللہ ہمت او بشنئے دوزی کے کنا شرف زرس
en: This is a reward of honour for this ..., as charity. I thank these children, I give thanks that they brought my goat back. This goat too, without ... [garbled] ... I am alive. May God grant them courage ... my reward of honour.
en_old: A little honour for this courage... I thank these children for the charity and give thanks that my goats came back. Without this goat too... if I'm alive, may God give everyone courage... my honour.

brh: نم نشانی تے وتے داسے، کین؟ اینا نا نشانی تے کھوکے داسے خل وتے
en: You all, the targets — like this, right? Today's targets ... like this, hit [them with] a stone ...
en_old: Do you have the signs, is that so? Today's signs ... a stone ...

brh: امر گدرینگا ولیکو دے؟ یار باز جوان باز مزہ ٹی گدرینگا۔ او سکول ارے اندنو گڑاس۔ یار شعیب ولے انتئے اوڑے بسٹ؟ خیر دا خسم اوڑے متنس نیدا سمونی این کے سے۔ ولے؟
en: How did the first day go? — Man, it went really well, a lot of fun. It's school, that kind of thing. — Shoaib, man, but why did I come there? Anyway, you weren't there ... — But?
en_old: How did yesterday go? Man, it went really well, it was a lot of fun. There's the school, something like that. But Shoaib, man, why did I come there? Anyway, this guy wasn't there, ... But?

brh: داڑکن خواننگ باز ضروری ء ابا دا باز لائق مار اسے دادے خواننگ نا شوق ء جوان تو گڑا دا باز مونی نوئے باز مونی ابا داسہ نن کان آ ذرا صبر کر اسہ جاہ سے آ کانہ ٹھیک ء ہاؤ ابا
en: That's why studying is very important, dad. This is a very capable boy; he has a real love of studying. Good, so he will go very far, very far, dad. Now we're going — just wait a bit, we're going to a place. Okay. Yes, dad.
en_old: That's why studying is very important, dad. He is a very capable boy, he has a good passion for studying, so he will go very far, very far, dad. Now we'll go, just wait a bit, we'll go to a place. Okay. Yes, dad.

brh: کنے دا سنگت ارے یوٹیوب آ۔ نا نا اول نینا وراخ سر کے گڈائی کا تینا، نومبو کنے ذرا کاریم ارے ہا دا کاریم تے ختم کیوا ولدا بریو ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی نومبو شاباش شاباش۔
en: I have this friend on YouTube. No, no, first get your meal served, then afterwards go on your own. You all, I have a bit of work, yes; I'll finish this work and come back again. Okay, okay. You all, well done, well done.
en_old: I have this friend on YouTube. First finish your meal, then ... I have a bit of work to do with you, I'll finish this work and come back. Okay, okay, you guys, well done, well done.

brh: خیر ئے نو الوری کریرنم؟ ہاؤ بس اسکول ٹی ذرا ئس کاریم اسکا، ہندا خاطرن۔ انت اینو بینگن کاریم کیسن؟ نہ نہ بس نیم گھنٹہ سے ٹی بروٹ۔ نیم گھنٹہ س دا معصوم آتے تین تو نوار بینگن کروسا نی ہن۔
en: Is everything alright? Were you delayed? — Yes, I just had a bit of work at school, that's why. — What, are you going to go work hungry today? — No, no, I'll be back in just half an hour. — Half an hour... take these innocent little ones with you, otherwise you'll keep them hungry. Go.
en_old: Is everything alright, why are you late? Yes, I just had a bit of work at school, that's why. What, are you going to work late today? No, no, I'll be back in just half an hour. Half an hour, take these innocent ones with you, otherwise you'll be late, go.

brh: شعیب بتو؟ اراغے شعیب؟ انت نی اودے تنیا الیکرینس؟ ننا نیم گھنٹس مریک اوتنا سنگت تون اوار اراغے بس۔ یا اللہ خیر۔
en: Didn't Shoaib come? Where is Shoaib? What, did you leave him alone? — It's been half an hour for us; he's somewhere with his friends, that's all. — Oh God, let it be well.
en_old: Has Shoaib come? Where is Shoaib? What, did you leave him alone? It's been half an hour for us, he's somewhere with his friends, that's all. Oh God, let it be well.

brh: نی تینے پریشان کپہ، ئے داسہ کاورے وتا، ٹھیک ہی نا؟ صحیح ہی
en: Don't worry yourself; I'll go now and bring him, okay? — Right.
en_old: Don't worry yourself, he'll go now, okay? Right.

brh: صاحبان مس، شوئم اللہ
en: Sahib, it's done ... thank God.
en_old: It's done, sirs, thank God.

brh: بندا تو ئے ارفنگٹ ایوٹ کہ او بس یا ابنا اگر بسکا تو نن بیحد پریشان مسکا نم تینے پریشان کپبو انسپکٹر صاحب تینا بنداتے دانگ مون تسنے انشاءاللہ
en: I'm getting people together [to see] whether he came or not — if he had come ... we've become extremely worried. Don't worry yourselves; the inspector sahib has sent his men out this way, God willing.
en_old: I had sent people to look for him, in case he came, or if he had come... we were extremely worried. Don't worry yourselves, Inspector sahib has sent his men in that direction, God willing.

brh: ہہ اللہ خیر کیک۔ ہن پولیس ء پاریدے؟ دا باز غلط کرینے، دن مف کہ او چنائے نقصان رسینگے۔ ہن مطلب؟ بے بے جی!
en: Hmm, God will make it well. What, you've told the police? This one has done something very wrong — may it not happen that the child comes to harm. — What do you mean? — Bibi-ji!
en_old: Yes, God will make it well. Did you tell the police? He has done something very wrong, may it not be that the boy comes to harm. What do you mean? Mother, ma'am!

brh: او پولیس ء پاننگٹ بد دیرے دن مف کہ او تینا پولیس ء چنائے نقصان ایتے ننہ کنا ماریچ مفک او کنا مار ء نقصان تنے کپسا او
en: Oh, telling the police is a bad idea — may it not be that they, with their police, harm the child. — No, nothing will happen to my son; they can't do my son any harm.
en_old: It's bad to tell the police, may it not be that they, through their police, harm the boy. No, he isn't my son... he will not harm my son.

brh: صاحب! بھلے دا ہیتاتے نی ہرسما؟ صاحب! ہر وخت دنو قصہ مسنے، ہمیش اخباراٹی دنو قصہ بریسا کائے۔ نی دا سدھارے غصہ دے نکشیسے یا مارے گن گڑاس کیسی ہاؤ۔
en: Sahib! Do you even look into these things? Sahib! Such incidents have always happened; such stories keep coming in the newspapers all the time. Won't you vent your anger on this, or will you do something for the boy? — Yes.
en_old: Sir! Do you hear these things? Sir! Such incidents have always happened, such stories always come in the newspapers. Will you not take your anger out on this, or will you do something for the boy? Yes.

brh: ئے کاوش ایوان نا مار نا ریفیو کے وراڑ کے
en: I'm going ... Ivan's son's ... [unclear].
en_old: Kawish, Ivan's son's ... review ...

brh: ماسٹر صاحب نم؟ میر محمد دا پاکے شوئے برادے
en: Master sahib, is it you? Mir Muhammad, tell [me] this: has Shoaib come?
en_old: Master sahib, you? Mir Muhammad, ...

brh: شپ تو راغنے ماسٹر صاب۔ او تو دستخوان راغہ سر متنے۔ ہنت؟ ماسٹر صاب او دے تینا ٹراغ سر کرے سٹ۔ ہنت او رے اسکان زر مس؟ جیو۔
en: Night has fallen, Master sahib, and he hasn't even come to the dinner spread. — What? — Master sahib, I had dropped him off at his own home. — What, since when has he been [gone]? — Yes.
en_old: It's night already, master sahib. He hasn't even come to the dinner spread yet. What? Master sahib, he ... What, since when has he been gone? Yes.

brh: توبہ اینارنگ او پولیسے پاننگن بد دیرے دن مف کے او تینا پولیسا جنونائے او صاب ٹھیک ئے بچا
en: God forbid! Telling the police is a bad idea — may it not be that they, with their police, [harm] the child. Oh sahib, alright, the child ...
en_old: God forbid, why did they tell the police? It's bad, may it not be that in their madness they harm him... Okay sahib, save him.

brh: ئے کمپارے کنے اراغہ سر کبو اراغہ سر کبو کنے دانکے باوہ نا بتنے اراغہ سر کپنانے اراغہ سر کبو کنے چپ کا کنے ایراغ شاباش ایراغ کن کمپارے کنے
en: He kept telling me: "Serve me food, serve me food!" — "Your father hasn't come yet; we won't serve the food." — "Serve me food!" — "Be quiet!" — "Me ... food, please, food for me," he told me.
en_old: I said to them, get my food ready, get my food ready for me. For this father's... won't you get the food ready? Get my food ready, quiet... my food, well done, I said, for the food...

brh: ہیلو؟ ہائے! ہاؤ۔
en: Hello? Hi! Yes.
en_old: Hello? Hi! Yes.

brh: اندا دم کن۔ او۔ ٹھیک ہی چلو ٹھیک ہی شامو۔ ہپتے۔ بچے۔ بچے۔
en: Just a moment. Oh. Okay, come on, okay, in the evening. A week. Kids. Kids.
en_old: Just for this moment. Oh. All right, come on, all right... A week. Kids. Kids.

brh: حق حق اللہ حق حق علم روشنائی
en: Truth, truth, God is truth, truth; knowledge is light.
en_old: Truth, truth, Allah is the Truth, truth; knowledge is light.

brh: بے شک! نم داڑے ہرو کنے احساس مس کہ ئے رد اسوٹ، نم روشنائی نا کسر آ ننگ اٹ ارے، اوئی۔
en: Indeed! Since you came here, I have realized that I was wrong; you are walking the path of light. Oh!
en_old: Of course! When you were here, I realized that I was wrong. You are walking the path of light, yes.

brh: ئے تان مئے نا کسر آ کنے باز افسوسی کنے باز خوشی کہ نم داڑے بسورے دا نن کن او دا چناتے کن باز بھلو حوصلہ افزائی اسے ماسٹر صاحب یقین چاس
en: I, on that path of mine... I am very sorry, and I am very glad that you have come here. This is a very great encouragement for us and for these children, Master sahib, believe me.
en_old: I am very sorry that I was on my way, and I am very happy that you came here. This is a great encouragement for us and for these children, Master sahib, believe me.

brh: انو ئے دا اسکول ء پدی دن آباد خناٹ۔ چناتے پدی اسکول اٹ خناٹ کنے بلو خوشی ئس مس۔ مالو ئے دافتے تینٹ پدی کریسوٹ۔ ولے ولے ماشاءاللہ سب
en: Today I saw this school thriving again like this. I saw the children back in school and I felt great joy. Earlier I myself had taken them back out of it. But, but, mashallah, all...
en_old: Today I saw this school thriving again. I was very happy to see the children back in school. Earlier I had brought them back myself. But, but, God bless, everyone...

brh: دا سا اینو تو ہم کوپہ مروٹک دا سا انشاءاللہ دون مفرو ماسٹر صاحب
en: Now from today I too will stand shoulder to shoulder with you; now, God willing, it will not be like that again, Master sahib.
en_old: Even today I wouldn't have found the path, but God willing, it won't be like that anymore, Master sahib.

brh: شاباش، نی تو ہمو کابل انگور نا باغ
en: Well done! So you have that very Kabul grape orchard.
en_old: Well done, you are that very Kabul grape orchard.

brh: ٹھیک ہی لیکن کنا ایلم نامراد ہی پیسہ غٹ ملار کنا ایلم نامراد ہی نی کنا ایلم تو تو غوارٹ خپتو او باغ ئس تورے کنا مقابلہ ٹی لیکن کنا ایلم نا تو پام کنے نی ہمو انگور نا باغ نا پدن کنا ایلم نی ملیک
en: Fine, but my brother is a wretch; with money they... my brother is a wretch. You, my brother... he too set up an orchard in competition with me, but my brother keeps an eye on me. You, of that same grape orchard, my brother, you are the owner.
en_old: Fine, but my brother is ill-fated; he got all the money, my brother is ill-fated. You, my brother, I wanted... he also kept an orchard in competition with me, but my brother didn't care about me. You, that grape orchard behind me, my brother, you...

brh: ہا دوبارہ اینو ہیت کال کپرے، صحیح ہی
en: Yes, you won't bring up this talk again today, right?
en_old: Yes, didn't make a call again today, right.

brh: بولی ئے۔ اور اوکان علاوہ گڑاس ننے دا ہم ارے کہ داختے کے باقاعدہ حکومت نا ستا غا کوئی تربیت استاداتا افک۔ دا جوان کتاب او لیکن داختا وار ابتدائی کہ تربیت استاداتا تننگے اور مزید داختے کہ رے پرائمری سیکشن آن مڈل ہائی اسکول اسکان سر کننگے۔
en: ...is the dialect. And besides that, we also have this problem: there is no regular teacher training for these at the government level. This is a good book, but for it, first of all, teachers should be given training, and further it should be extended from the primary section up to middle and high school.
en_old: ...language. Besides that, we also have the problem that there is no regular teacher training from the government. This is a good book, but at the time it was introduced, teachers were given only initial training. It should also be extended beyond the primary section to middle and high school.

brh: سر نن پانہ کہ دا اسہ بہتر ء عمل اسے ننا براہوئی مادری زبان ء گو کہ نن قلات ڈویژن نا زیادہ تعلق ہندا زبان آن ء جی سر لیکن ئے خوانفپرا بہتر انداز اٹ کہ ننا بنیادی ہرا مادری زبان ء شروع مسنے
en: Sir, we say that this is a good practice: Brahui is our mother tongue, since most of us in Kalat Division are connected with this very language. Yes sir, but I don't teach it in a better way, given that our foundation, which is the mother tongue, has started.
en_old: Sir, we say this is a good step for our Brahui mother tongue, since most of us in the Kalat Division are connected with this very language. Yes, sir, but they don't teach it properly, even though our basic education started in our mother tongue.

brh: سنیں، ایرا مثال آن تیسری اسکا دا کلاسک مسنو ہرا استاد تینا خنے ایک وکیل پیر رہبر باز موثر طریقہ اٹ پاننگ فیرا اور چناتا مادری زبانے بلکہ اردو اور انگریزی نا بجائے دا زیادہ
en: Listen, for example, up to the third class these classes have been arranged, where the teacher, as an advocate, a mentor and a guide, can explain things very effectively, and in the children's mother tongue rather than in Urdu and English, this is more...
en_old: Listen, from these examples, the third one is this classic one, where a teacher, as a guide, can explain things very effectively in the children's mother tongue, rather than in Urdu and English...

brh: زیادہ کیرے اپسیٹ کیرے اور سمجھے رے اور زیادہ کار کیرے۔ باز دلچسپی ئے نما پیننگے اردو ہم زیادہ دلچسپی ہلیرے، باز دلچسپی ہلیرے۔ تیکہ سندھراوی، اینا لمبئی زبان ئے اور ہر سال برے کتاب لیکن کنا باز شوق
en: They do more, they get upset, and they understand, and they work more. There is a lot of interest in your... they take more interest in Urdu too, they take a lot of interest. ...it is the mother tongue, and every year the book comes, but my great passion...

brh: ننا ماتانی باز مشکلہ کہ ننا معاشرہ صاف مرے نو راست پارے سر خیر نو باز منت وار اٹ کہ نم کنا مارے صحیح سلامت ہیسرے سر کریرے ننا معاشرہ ٹی
en: For us it is very hard to make our society clean. You speak the truth, sir. Anyway, I am very grateful to you that you brought my son back safe and sound, sir. You have done [this]... in our society...
en_old: Our mothers have great difficulty keeping our society clean. You spoke the truth, sir. Well, thank you very much for bringing my son back safe and sound, sir. In our society...

brh: کنتو اینو ہراسکمبو ولدا ایمبو۔ نہ سر باز مہربانی پین وختس بروٹ دانہ لمہ باز پریشان ئے دادے زو سر کننگ خواوہ۔ امر کہ نما مرضی امر کہ نما بہترے
en: Have a meal with me today, then go. No, sir, thank you very much, I'll come another time. His mother is very worried; I want to get him [home] quickly. As you wish, whatever you think best.
en_old: I won't eat or drink anything today. No sir, thank you very much, I'll come another time; my mother is very worried right now and I want to get there quickly. As you wish, whatever you think is best.

brh: درچا سر، باز مہربانی سر، باز مہربانی سر، تھینک یو، اللہ حافظ، باز مہربانی سر، تھینک یو، اللہ حافظ
en: [Unclear], sir. Thank you very much, sir, thank you very much, sir. Thank you. Goodbye. Thank you very much, sir. Thank you. Goodbye.
en_old: Thank you, sir. Thank you very much, sir. Thank you very much, sir. Thank you. Goodbye. Thank you very much, sir. Thank you. Goodbye.

brh: حق بابا حق نو بابا نی ارا بسس کنا مار ئے تو داڑے
en: Haq, father, Haq! So, father, where have you been? My son, I'm right here.
en_old: Truth, father, truth. So, father, where have you come from... my son, here.

brh: سبق بیست۔ نی دا پا کہ نی انت سوچنگ اٹی ئس باوا ئے دا اورنگٹ کہ دا باز مش آ چکر خلنگے
en: Lesson twenty. Tell me, what were you thinking about? Father, I was watching this falcon circling over the mountain.
en_old: Lesson twenty. Tell me what you're thinking. Father, I'm watching this. It's spinning around a lot.

brh: دا باغا تیرینگ کیک ولے دا بعضی مشک باز دوستو ہمدا خاطر آن او مشتے تیرینگی کیک او مشتے
en: This falcon glides about, but certain mountains are very dear to it; that is why it glides over those mountains, those mountains.
en_old: This one spins in the garden, but some of them are very friendly, and that's why it spins them.

brh: بشے دے خلیک و چکر کیک اندن انسانک ہم شاتی ٹی تینا زندے گدریفیرہ و تینا تینا زندے تینا وڈٹ گدریفیرہ بابا انسانک اسیوڈٹ
en: All day it swoops and circles. In the same way, people too spend their lives in the world, and each spends his own life in his own way. Father, are people [all] alike?
en_old: All day long it strikes and spins. In the same way, people spend their lives in the world, each living their life in their own way. Father, people are the same...

brh: او کنا مار انسان کل اسہ وڑ نا مریرے۔ ولے بابا دناف ہرسوٹ ایلو آن جتا ئے کنا مار
en: Oh my son, all human beings are of one kind. But father, it isn't so: each one is different from the other. My son...
en_old: Oh my son, all people are the same. But father, then why is each one different from the others? My son...

brh: انسان تے ٹی فرق ئے نن ودی کرینوں نن کل اسہ مش نا ودی مسونوں او اسہ مشٹی کانے بس دا سوچا تے ٹی فرق ئے
en: We are the ones who have created the differences between human beings. We were all born of the same earth, and we go back into the same earth. The only difference is in these ways of thinking.
en_old: We are the ones who created the differences among people. We were all born from the same soil, and we all go back into the same soil. The only difference is in our thinking.

brh: کس تینا اخوبت ء ویران کریرے او کس سے یاد تے رزق تروکا اللہ نا پاک اینا ذات تے کس سے زیاتی تک او کس سے اونا کچٹ
en: Some ruin their own future, and some remember the pure being of Allah, the giver of sustenance; to some [He gives] more, and to some by His measure.
en_old: Some ruin their own sleep, and some remember the pure being of Allah, the Provider; some get more and some get less of it.

brh: او دا تو ماتی کین اسیم تیان اسے کہ او خستینا ربنا شکریہ ادا کیر خس شکر گزار مریرے
en: And this is one of those [creatures] that, the more they thank their Lord, the more grateful they become.
en_old: Oh, this is one of those things: the more they thank their Lord, the more grateful they become.

brh: بابا دا ایوان آک ہم تینا رب نا شکر ادا کیرے۔ بالکل انسان، ایوان، چرند پرند تینا رب نا شکر ادا کیرے۔ اللہ پاک
en: Father, do these animals also thank their Lord? Absolutely: human beings, animals, beasts and birds all thank their Lord. God Almighty...
en_old: Father, these animals also give thanks to their Lord. Exactly — humans, animals, beasts and birds all give thanks to their Lord. God Almighty...

brh: ارسی تے دس کتی کنا بچہ دا بانز خنیس دا م
en: [Unclear], my child, did you see this falcon? This...
en_old: Look at the mirrors, my child, did you see this much...

brh: مش تیٹی تینا وڑٹ زندگی تدیفک او تینا رزق پیدا کیک اسے ڈونڈ خور ئس او ہم مش تیٹی بال کیک او دے ہم تین تون باز مہر مریک
en: It lives its life in the mountains in its own way and finds its own food. There is also a vulture; it too flies in the mountains, and it too loves itself very much.
en_old: It lives its life in the mountains in its own way and finds its own sustenance; it is a scavenger bird, and it also flies in the mountains, and it is very fond of itself too.

brh: او دے میدان ٹی تموکا اسٹ ڈونڈ اسے تون ہم غرض مفک، کل آ مست اونا خنت کشک، او دا تپک کہ دا انسان اسے یا
en: It doesn't care about anything: when a carcass is lying in the field, the first thing it does is pull out its eyes, and it doesn't know whether it is a human or...
en_old: It doesn't even care about something lying dead in the field; first of all it gouges out its eyes, and it doesn't care whether it is a human or...

brh: بابا انت انسان کن مریرئے؟ او کنا مار ہین انسان حیوان جوڑ مسنے۔
en: Father, what are people becoming? Oh my son, now human beings have become animals.
en_old: Father, why do people do this? And my son, now humans have become animals.

brh: انسانیتی گیرہم کرینٹ، ہر سد تینا فائدہ نا سوچیک، ئے دا ایلم نا فخر، رشتہ غاک سیالیک کل ختم مسو
en: People have forgotten humanity; everyone thinks only of his own benefit. The pride of brotherhood, relationships, kinship: all of it has come to an end.
en_old: Humanity has been forgotten; everyone thinks only of their own benefit, brotherly pride, relationships and kinship have all come to an end.

brh: خیر کرا مار نی دے دایتاتے دے دایتاتے دست کپو مفیس نی ننگ نا تیاری کر
en: Well, my son, these words, these words: don't let go of them. Now get ready to go.
en_old: All right, my son, don't you go after these grapes, these grapes, you won't get them; get ready to leave.

brh: ننے مبا پریشان مرو ہم؟ جی او بابا ئے کاوے اینا اللہ نا جوڑی مرے خدا حافظ بابا حق اللہ حق مولا
en: Don't be worried about us, all right? Yes, father, I'm going. May God keep you well. Goodbye, father. Haq Allah, Haq Maula (God is the Truth, the Lord is the Truth).
en_old: Shouldn't we be worried too? Yes, okay Father, go now, may God keep you well. Goodbye, Father. Allah is the Truth, the Master is the Truth.

brh: ہمو بند کینہ کہ دا نن تہا نا کیرے ارا ہوائے پو پیش تمو۔ آخرت مچ بڑائے فون گواہ بسو۔ سئی مر۔ دا سدا دے ہم خاخرٹی بٹو رے یا مر؟ نہ نہ۔
en: We close it like that so that the air inside this doesn't escape. In the end the phone will be witness to all of it. All right. Will this also be put in the fire all day, or what? No, no.
en_old: They close it so that the air inside here doesn't escape. In the end... a phone came as a witness. Is it cooked? Will this stay in the fire all day too, or what? No, no.

brh: استا خاخر نا رفا داتی لوٹ۔ اچھا۔ دا تخلص بشیر نا خاخر نا۔ اوہ۔ پیراستیکہ ساکو تو دا خوشی ساکو تو دا بول چرے گھرا سیٹ دا پچھو مچھر چرے ساکو تو۔
en: ...towards the fire... Okay. This is from Takhallus Bashir's fire. Oh. ...if it ..., then this is happiness, then this ... the mosquitoes ...
en_old: ...wants it from the side of the fire. Okay. This is the fire of Takhallus Bashir. Oh. ...if it is happiness then this... the mosquitoes...

brh: دا سرک نا مون مچے ہمینگے اندا خاطرا مچے خاخرہ خڑک دے خانوندے ایون مچے مورتے خوئی مرے اچھا
en: This is a bit in front of the road, right here; that's why it is a bit near the fire... so the pictures come out a bit better. Okay.
en_old: This is in front of the road, right here, that's why near the fire... the pictures come out nice. Okay.

brh: بائیدا دا اسکول نوں بالکل تیار ہنے خنیسہ تا اچھا واہ کل سیڈا کیرے تقریبا برابر
en: Look, this is now completely ready, do you see it? Okay, wow, all of it underneath is almost even.
en_old: Look, this one is now completely ready, you see. Okay, wow, it's all cooked, almost evenly.

brh: دا برابر برابر 20 سنی اوہ او دا شفا بے خنست دا دا کا بے 20 سنی برابر اوہ او دا سکیرے دا پورا خنست ڈڈے ہا ہا تو دانا مطلب دا دے کہ دا 30 بے 20 سنی زیا بے 20 سنی تیار ئے مطلب داست تیار ئے تو دا دے او دا دا کورنو تیار ئے سلطا صاحب کرے تیار کرے تا
en: This is exactly, exactly twenty [minutes]. Oh, look at this ... this took twenty, exactly. Oh, and look, this has become completely hard. Ha ha. So what it means is that this is ready in thirty or twenty, more than twenty [minutes]; meaning it's ready now. So this, this kurno is ready; Sultan sahib made it, prepared it.
en_old: Exactly, exactly 20 minutes. Oh, look at this... exactly 20 minutes. Oh, look, this is completely... ha ha. So that means this took 30 or more than 20 minutes to get ready, meaning it's ready. So the kurno is ready; Sultan sahib prepared it.

brh: دا سونماسکی ننے کہ پر غٹا تانا ڑے ماشاءاللہ پر بو تورین تا مر پینیک دادے دا ہم پر غٹا تا واہ دادے خنیس تا دا ایرا ٹکر مساسا اچھا دا خلت تہنا تا دا خلت پیش تا اوہو شکنی
en: This ... that we break it ... MashaAllah ... this one also broke. Wow, look at this, it has split into two pieces. Okay, this is the stone inside it; the stone came out. Oh ho, it broke.
en_old: This... MashaAllah, it's full... look at this, it has broken into a piece. Okay, this... oh, it broke.

brh: دادے خنس دا تاتہ خلام بسس سنی ہو وا پیشین تہا خرا بسس سنی ماشاءاللہ تو دادے پارہ کورنو مچٹ کورنو ہورتا امرے خوش بریک نی امر اہاں ماشاءاللہ باز بیترے باز جوانی باز بیترے دے ہاں مچٹ کرین ایتس تہ ئے ہم ہریوتہ ماشاءاللہ سنگتاک کورنو
en: Look at this, the stone came out of it, see; it came out from inside, MashaAllah. So this is what they call kurno. Take a look at the kurno. How do you like it? Mm, MashaAllah, it's very good, very nice, very good. Yes, you've made it ...; let's look at the inside of it too. MashaAllah, friends, kurno.
en_old: Look at this, it came out... from inside it came out, MashaAllah. So this is what they call kurno. How do you find eating kurno? Mm, MashaAllah, it's excellent, very good, really excellent. Yes, you've made it so well. Friends, kurno, MashaAllah.

brh: مستیار سلطان احمد شاہوانی صاحب نا کورنو تیار مسنے براہوئی ثقافتی آ خوراک تو داسہ کننگے ہرینہ کہ امر ئے دا کورنو او دا پد بھوٹے دونا نہ ہنو نا آن ماشاءاللہ
en: Mastiyar Sultan Ahmad Shahwani sahib's kurno, a Brahui cultural food, is ready. So now we'll eat it and see what this kurno is like ... MashaAllah.
en_old: Mukhtiar Sultan Ahmad Shahwani sahib's kurno is ready, a Brahui cultural food. Now let's taste it and see how this kurno is... MashaAllah.

brh: اللہ زبردست باز زیبا باز جوان بسنے ہنا کڑک بسنے کننگ نا وخت آ توار بریک ہینتا باز زیب دار باز خوش تو
en: By God, it's excellent; it has turned out very beautiful, very good, it has come out crispy; when you eat it, it makes a sound. Very lovely, very pleasant.
en_old: By God, it's excellent, very beautiful, it has turned out very good, it has come out crispy. When you eat it, it makes a crunching sound. Very lovely, very pleasant.

brh: او ننتو ڈاکٹر چاکر خان صاحب تولوک ئے اوم کورنو نا براہوئی دا ثقافتی خوراک آ تا بھلو شوقین اسے تو اوڑان بنن کہ او کورنو نا باروٹ انت پائک جی ڈاکٹر صاحب سکندر جان دا کورنو
en: And with us is Dr. Chakar Khan sahib, sitting here; he too is a great fan of kurno, these Brahui cultural foods, so let's hear from him what he says about kurno. Yes, Doctor sahib, Sikandar jan, this kurno...
en_old: And with us is Dr. Chakar Khan sahib, sitting here. He is a big fan of kurno, this Brahui cultural food, so let's hear from him what he says about kurno. Yes, doctor sahib, Sikandar jan, this kurno...

brh: او کرے دا، غپہ سے بیرے اور دا کرے، غمی ٹی بے ننا کاریم آتے کنا خاہترا کرا وخت آ ننا با پیرہ دا کین ہنار ابیشتے تینا فیرہ سفر کریر ہچاتا تینا گڑا تے ہپیرہ ہنار ہرا
en: And they made this ... and they made this; in grief ... for our affairs ... In olden times our forefathers made this when they went [on journeys]; they travelled on their own feet, and they would take their things along and go.
en_old: He made this... in times of joy and in times of grief, for our affairs... In the old days our forefathers did this when they travelled on foot; they would take their things along with them...

brh: ہمے وقتا کہ رے او بیگم مسورہ دا ارا اللہ و کہ خیباتیٹ یانور کہ رے او ارغڑ پنکتوسہ تو دا کورنو ئے کہ رے او ہمے وقتا ایجاد کرینو کہ ئے او کورنی جوڑ کر رے بڈ اسپاٹ
en: At that time, when evening came ... in the wilderness ... and they couldn't make bread, this kurno was invented at that time, so that they would make kurno ... [with their loads].
en_old: In those times, when they were in the deserts and could not cook, that is when this kurno was invented; they made kurno...

brh: دا تخار، کرنوئے، بیسر، کلے ازیر نا مسکا، دا کرنوئے تنا کونسہ ہناکا، سندھ اسکا، تسلی اٹ ہنارے، یعنی کس نا تھورا وی احسان کس نا ہفتہ وسہ۔ ڈاکٹر صاحب خراب مفک دا حق دے تتہ دا سا۔ دا کے رے باز اگر جوان مچے خلکن بیغنگے، ہمم۔
en: This ... kurno, they would bake it ...; with this kurno they would go eating along the way as far as Sindh, they would travel in comfort, meaning without taking even the slightest favour from anyone. Doctor sahib, doesn't it go bad? ... If it is kneaded really well ... mm-hmm.
en_old: This... the kurno... with this kurno they could go all the way to Sindh in comfort, meaning without owing anyone even the slightest favour. Doctor sahib, doesn't it go bad? ...if it is made well... mm-hmm.

brh: یا ڈڈ بے غنگے پتو بھلو اگر کرنوس مرے دا کرے دہ دیس کا بارپک واہ دہ دیس کا آرامٹ بندہ کونی کیک تا سفراتینا داخس سفر تو دا کنا بلوچستان نا سندھ ئس کا اوخس سفر ہمم ہمم
en: ...or if it is kneaded firm, and if it's a big kurno, it doesn't dry out for up to ten days. Wow, for ten days a person can eat it comfortably on their journey, a journey this long, from my Balochistan all the way to Sindh, that long a journey. Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.
en_old: ...if you make a kurno, it lasts for ten days. Wow, for ten days a person can eat comfortably on their journey, a journey this long, from my Balochistan to Sindh, that long a journey. Mm-hmm.

brh: دا اوچت سے آ کاہے یا بیش منٹ آ کاہے دے بیش منٹ ئے اولاخ کے ہمم چائسس ہو تو دا سدا دے نی کن مچے ووٹ ایٹ تو اخس مارکس ایٹ تو سلطان شاہوانی صاحب ئے آخا ووٹ ایٹ محنت آ کھیرے رنگ لایانو واہ دا اخس مٹھائی
en: Does this take an hour, or twenty minutes? It takes twenty minutes. Mm, you know, yes. So today, if you give it a vote, how many marks would you give? I give my vote to Sultan Shahwani sahib; his hard work has paid off. Wow, how sweet this is.
en_old: Does this take an hour, or does it take twenty minutes? Twenty minutes first... tea... So today, if you were to give it a vote, how many marks would you give? I'd give my vote to Sultan Shahwani sahib; the hard work has paid off. Wow, what sweetness.

brh: اخذ گچینی
en: How excellent!
en_old: The best choice.

brh: کم از کم نی ٹوٹل نی اٹھ ٹکی گونوس دس گونوس چک اسے ہمک ہیس موسم نی نیس دا پا نی ہون کھلی ٹکی مونی ہمے رنگٹ پا ئنا مائی ئنا گدنا نمفتے
en: At least, in total, you ... eight takas, ten ..., a cheque ... In the same way, say ... your mother, your ...
en_old: At least in total you... eight pieces, ten pieces... in the same way...

brh: اسے چوٹی نا اسکیپ سیم نا نیام آن کشیک، ئنا گھڑی نور الفقیر نا بنیا مچیرے، ئنا پینٹے بین مچیر، افٹے، اگر مشغتے رشتہ داری کرے ٹھیکٹے، قبول نی قبول اف نی قبولے کلمول صاحب قبولے
en: ...pulls out from between ...; your ... of Noor-ul-Faqir ...; if you agree to this marriage relation, it's fine. Do you accept or not? Kalmol sahib, it's accepted.
en_old: ...takes it out from between... Noor al-Faqir's daughter... if you accept this marriage relation, fine. Do you accept or do you not accept? Accepted, sahib, accepted.

brh: آ، اناں پا کہ، قبول ء نی قبول اف نی بے مراد، قبول کے کنے، ایار مولوی صاحب اسے منٹ ئس سلیسس، یار سلیس، انتس اسس، ارے خدا خل، یار مراد، دا ارا ء مچے سلہ بو، گمہ بو، یک کھکھونگور نی ایالو خوارج ہنتنے، آ مولوی صاحب
en: Ah, say it: do you accept or not, Murad? Accept me. Friend, Maulvi sahib, wait a minute. Friend, wait. What was it? Oh, God strike you. Friend Murad, wait a little ... Ah, Maulvi sahib.
en_old: Ah, say it: do you accept or not, Murad? Accept, for me. Friend, maulvi sahib, wait a minute. Friend, wait. What happened? Oh God... friend Murad... Ah, maulvi sahib.

brh: نی ہنا خل نا سفت نی کائسہ سلیپیس نی ابا تمبی ارے مراد نا نی کائسہ سلیپیس یار نی مشٹمی غا وار توپک قبولے آخا او نو قبولے نی ہشت پیسے ایتسے پیسہ خل سے
en: You ... the praise of the stone ... you go, won't you wait ... father ... hey, Murad ... you go, won't you wait, friend ... Accepted? Yes, now it's accepted. You gave eight paisa, paisa ... a stone.
en_old: You're praising the stone, you're sitting... Murad, your father is... you're sitting. Friend, ...accepted? Yes, accepted. You gave eight paisa, paisa... a stone.

brh: خون نی نا چموٹی آ جاگہ ٹی ملان کیسی ئے ہم پکا مولوی صاحب نا موری تالبی خلینے ئے ہم برابر ثواب نا کن خوانانتے نی غوز خلے دا مائی اٹ مسنے ئے تھکا چرتنے
en: Blood ... your ... in the place of the eye ... the Maulvi sahib's students have ... also an equal reward ... recited it for them ... you ... this has become ... tired ...
en_old: Blood… in a little spot in your eye… the Maulvi sahib's… also the same reward, they recited for them; you listened. This is from the mother; the tired one turned back…
