en_old: Make it your engagement, I have no objection at all, but taking the girl is good... may God... God bless, don't you worry.

brh: وا مہرین کہ گلاس کے وا ثنا جی بابا مبارک مرینے خیر مبارک ولے انتنا شیر خان نا
en: Mehreen, a glass ... and Sana — yes, father — congratulations to you! Thank you, but what about Sher Khan's ...
en_old: Well Mehreen, for the glass... yes father, congratulations to you. Thank you, but what about Sher Khan's...

brh: ہاؤ جمال نا رشتہ کے ہاؤ کرے، راست پاش پاپا، جی ہاؤ بالکل راست پاش، ئے کاہوٹ نم کے چاہ جوڑ کیٹ، داسہ ناشتہ کریٹ، بسم اللہ چاہ کن، ئے کاوہ کے کنے
en: Yes, he said yes to Jamal's proposal. Are you telling the truth, papa? Yes, yes, absolutely the truth. I'll go and make tea for you all; now I'll make breakfast. Go ahead, have some tea. I'm going.
en_old: Yes, for Jamal's proposal, yes, tell the truth, papa. Yes, absolutely true. I'm going to make tea for you, now I've had breakfast. Bismillah, have tea, I'm going for me.

brh: ولے تمبو، ٹھیک ہی نا؟ نی تول۔ چلو، ٹھیک ہی او باوا سمے بس۔
en: But ... it's fine, right? You sit. Come on, it's fine — oh father, ... that's enough.
en_old: But wait, it's fine, right? You sit. Come on, it's fine, oh father, it's time.

brh: ابا بش مرو بسک، کن منتوم، ارا دے ورا
en: Father, get up, come on ... two days ...
en_old: Father, get up, come, I won't stay, two days...

brh: اینہ کتے نا بینہ با کرا خانے ستے کن ارے دا تو مٹل نا ہورائے تو گارے
en: ... Khan ... with me ... this ... has been lost.
en_old: ...this is for... this one has been lost.

brh: ایم سیٹ بسونن کان با؟ بابا اسٹارٹ کا گاڑی ئے گاڑی ئے اسٹارٹ کا۔ توبہ، الہ با پاوانی کسے، کان۔ زوکا زوکا زوکا۔ الہ با دا زوکا، مونی کتا۔
en: Have we come ...? Go! Baba, start the car — start the car! Good grief ... leave it, don't tell anyone, go. Quick, quick, quick! Leave it, this — quick, move forward.
en_old: Have we come to the M seat? Where to? Father, start the car, start the car. Good grief, don't tell anyone, go. Quickly, quickly, quickly. Don't, hurry, go ahead.

brh: مونی کٹ۔ ادا دیر۔ بے نمیر ئس نی۔ ٹائٹ ئس
en: Move forward. Brother, water. You're a shameless one. Tight.
en_old: Go ahead. Bring it here. You're useless. Tight.

brh: او اہنگور و میرداد ارزی باؤ گاڈیس ابا ابا غمبر بندغ اسے تیز کتے تیز تیز تیز
en: Oh Ahangor and Mirdad ... a car — father, father, a ... person — speed it up, fast, fast, fast!
en_old: Oh, Ahangor and Mirdad, the old man's car... Father, father, a sad person, make it fast, fast, fast, fast.

brh: سیدھا کنے الکرا۔ ایڈے گل بے بے ہم بسکا۔ نما تو خیر اسس کا۔ کنا خیر متوکا۔ اوڑبا، دسکنا سانگو برام نمہ مرے یار نی
en: They took me straight there. Gul Bibi was coming there too. It was fine for you all, but I was not fine. Oh Lord, may you all get an engagement and wedding like this, friend!
en_old: He went straight for me. Here, Gul Bibi came too. You were fine, but I wasn't. Oh father, may this engagement be yours, friend.

brh: برا مو سنگتن الکو نی یار گڑاس کینا آئی نو الے کنے مچے سوچو کہ انت کرو ئے توبہ یار بچت فریش مرے حیران او ٹماکیو
en: Come on, from the friends... you, friend, do something. Mother, now let me think a little about what to do. Oh my God (I repent), friend, may [I] get away and feel fresh... astonished and [unclear].
en_old: Come, friends, take it. Friend, do something… I keep thinking about what to do. God forbid, friend… may it be saved and stay fresh… surprised…

brh: اڈے گل بے بے او نا مار پیرو گنوکو آ داڑے شاہ بے بے گنوکو آ مار میرو او دا جمال ہران کاو ہاؤ
en: Look, there is Gul Bibi and her crazy son Peeru; here is Shah Bibi and her crazy son Meeru; and where would this Jamal go, huh?
en_old: Here is Gul Bibi and her son Peero, the crazy one. Here is Shah Bibi, the crazy one, and her son Meero. And where did Jamal go, huh?

brh: کنا خلپئے دا کٹم کنے نروئی تمک۔ ابا خیر ئے نو دمدرینگوک خننگسہ۔
en: My [unclear]... this family, I'm going to have to run away. Father, is everything all right? You look worn out.
en_old: My brother, I have to flee this family. Father, is everything all right? You seem out of breath.

brh: او کنا مسٹ، وخت تو وار بندغ نا دم درینگیک پاو۔ ابا اگر نی تان دم درینگیسہ تو کنا انت مرو؟ کنا مسٹ، اندا ہیت تو کنے پریشان کرینے، انتئے ابا؟
en: Oh my daughter, at times a person's breath gives out, I tell you. Father, if you yourself run out of breath, what will become of me? My daughter, it is this very thing that has been worrying me. Why, father?
en_old: My daughter, sometimes a person gets out of breath, they say. Father, if you lose your breath, what will become of me? My daughter, that's exactly what has been worrying me. Why, father?

brh: کنا مسٹ زندنا ہچ و بھروسہ اف۔ ابا دنو ہیت کپہ اللہ رب العزت نی بلو عمر ئس ایتے او ابا کنا مسٹ نی اسے خواست سے۔ ابا نی حکم کہ۔
en: My daughter, there is no trusting life at all. Father, don't say such things; may Allah, the Lord of Glory, give you a long life. And father— My daughter, I have a request of you. Father, just give the order.
en_old: My daughter, life can't be trusted. Father, don't say such things. May Allah, Lord of Glory, give you a long life. Father… my daughter, I have a request. Father, just tell me.

brh: خواستن تکی کیسا نی ابا پیر و رستا کین او کڑ گپا ولے ابا نا ابا ورزی دا خواست سمجھی سا یا کنا عرض سمجھی سا
en: Will you honor the request? Your father has grown old and [unclear], but, father— a father's wish: will you take this as a request, or will you take it as my plea?
en_old: Will you accept my request? Father, I have grown old… but it's your father's wish. Will you understand this request, will you understand my plea?

brh: جی ابا انتس کہ کنا باوہ نا مرضی کنے قبول ء۔ خوش مریس کنا مسڑ اللہ نی خوش کے۔ اوہ خدائے دے پیر مرے
en: Yes, father, whatever my father wishes is acceptable to me. Be happy, my daughter; may Allah make you happy. Oh God, may [you] live to old age.
en_old: Yes, father, whatever my father wishes, I accept. I'm happy, my daughter. May Allah make you happy. Oh, may God bless this day.

brh: پیرو ایسو کٹنگ کپیسہ
en: Peeru, you can't win this.
en_old: Peero, you can't hold back.

brh: کنا واری کنا واری تو۔ پیرو۔ جی آئی۔ کنا مار نی تو ضروری او ہیتس کروئی ہی نا برام نا باروٹی۔ برام نا باروٹی؟
en: My turn, it's my turn then. Peeru. Yes, mother. My son, I have to have an important talk with you about your wedding. About my wedding?
en_old: My turn, my turn then. Old man. Yes. My son, you really have to talk about the wedding. About the wedding?

brh: ئے جندہ دلوم تون ہیت کرینٹ، ننا شاران برے زلی تون نا برامے کرفینٹ۔ زلی تون؟
en: I have spoken with Dilom myself; I have arranged your marriage with Zali, from our town. With Zali?
en_old: I spoke with Dilom myself… I've arranged your marriage to Zali. With Zali?

brh: وللہ کہ کیوائے زلی تو برام، ئے برام اسین تو کیوائے زلی تو کپرائے، نہ کہ ہمو چار والا مسڑ کے تو گھٹی خناسوٹی ہمو تو برام کیوائے۔ ضروری اف کہ بندہ ارات او تو جائی مرے ولے؟
en: By God, would I marry Zali? If I marry at all, I won't marry Zali; rather, that girl from the city whom I had seen that time, her I will marry. It's not a must that a person be [unclear] proper, is it?
en_old: By God, if you'd marry Zali... if it's a wedding, you wouldn't marry Zali. Rather, that girl you saw at the house, you'd marry her. Doesn't a person have to be in the right place?

brh: نی ہم تو جوان و مسڑ اسے۔ انتئے؟ اسیلم تو جوان و مسڑ اسے۔ ئے اسیلم ئے وائی۔ مونی تینا خنانوس شیشہ ٹی۔ ہاؤ وائی خنانٹ تے اسل نی ہم باروٹ۔ او تو صحیح ہی ولے عادت تک نا باوہ غینانو۔ آئی۔
en: You too are a fine girl. Why? Asilam is a fine girl, truly. I [say], Asilam... Have you looked at your own face in the mirror? Yes, I've seen it; really, you too, about [it]... That's right, but your habits have taken after your father. Mom!
en_old: You're a good girl too. Why? Aslam is good too. I'll tell Aslam. Have you ever looked at yourself in the mirror? Yes, I've looked, and you too, really. That's true, but you've picked up your father's habits. Yes.

brh: اوئے اخس کہ مرے نما اولاد اٹ، تسباو نی برام کریٹ، کیوے نہ کہ ہمے مسڑس شار والا، ہمودے کاوے پٹیوے شاراٹی، ہموسو ملیوائے ہموسو برام کیوے
en: Oh, whatever happens, I am your child; [unclear] as for the wedding, I'll do it, but only with that same girl from the city. The day I go and search the city, whenever I find her, that's when I'll marry.
en_old: Oh, whatever happens, you're our child. If you got married, wouldn't it be to that girl from the city? The day she comes to the city, whenever you meet her, you'll marry her then.

brh: ننو کہ باوہ نا شار نا تغے خناکا، نرا اینا تینا تغے پورا کرے ولے کنا مار نیلے پر کہ نی شار ہکاس۔ ثناء؟ جی پاپا؟
en: [Your] father, who used to dream of the city, ran off and fulfilled his own dream, but my son, I won't let you go to the city. Sana? Yes, Papa?
en_old: We saw father's dream of the city. He fulfilled his own dream, but my son, you have to go to the city. Sana? Yes, Papa?

brh: کنا مسڑو دا سال ننے برام نا تیاری کروئی۔ جمال نا باوہ کیرنے شیر خان؟ جی جی۔ تینا مار نا برام نا تیاری کننگٹی۔ ولے جمال تو کنتو دا ہیت ء ڈسکس کتا۔
en: My daughter, this year we have to prepare for a wedding. Jamal's father, Sher Khan, has done it? Yes, yes. He is busy preparing for his son's wedding. But Jamal didn't discuss this matter with me.
en_old: My daughter, this year we have to get ready for a wedding. What is Jamal's father doing, Sher Khan? Yes, yes. He's getting ready for his son's wedding. But Jamal didn't discuss this with me.

brh: کنا مسڑ ابا امر نا تو ڈسکس کے خیر نی تا پکا دا رشتہ غنے خوش تو ارس نی
en: My daughter, dear, how would he discuss it with you? Anyway, you are surely happy with this match, aren't you?
en_old: My daughter, how would Dad discuss it with you? Anyway, are you really happy with this match?

brh: خان محمد، او
en: Khan Muhammad, oh!
en_old: Khan Muhammad, oh!

brh: خان محمد خان محمد تکزئی پیرو بابا
en: Khan Muhammad, Khan Muhammad, [unclear], Peeru Baba!
en_old: Khan Muhammad, Khan Muhammad, run, old father!

brh: نا پنی غٹ بے جسم ئے جوان چاوہ ڈکھے پیرو بابا
en: Your... [unclear] whole body... I know the pain well, Peeru Baba.
en_old: Your name... the whole body is fine. I know the pain, old father.

brh: مسنا دا چے توکئی لوما نی نی تش نہ کیکے ئے ہما بد نصیب انگا لوماٹ کے
en: What has happened? This... mother, you, you don't [unclear]... I am that unfortunate mother who...
en_old: What happened? You don't let out what's inside you, that unfortunate mother...

brh: بیدس خاڑینک آتا شانہ کیہ کن تو ہچ پاہ
en: Apart from tears, I have nothing left.
en_old: Don't say anything; without tears there's nothing to show.

brh: نی سما ء اینو کنا خوشی نا ہچ کچ ئس اف۔ دا ہر وخت درفیسہ نہ کہ ئے ارا وخت بنوٹ۔
en: You know, today there's no limit to my happiness. You always say this, but when will I [actually] hear it?
en_old: You know, today there's no limit to how happy I am. You always say this, so when will I hear it?

brh: بس منے دیس
en: Just a few days.
en_old: Just give me a little.

brh: کنا مسٹ، دا منتیٹ این مننگ کیک؟ پیرو بابا، پیرو بابا نی تو ہر کڑائچس، او تینا، تینا
en: My daughter, can this happen in a minute, just like that? Peeru Baba, Peeru Baba, you always [unclear]... oh, your own, your own...
en_old: My daughter, can this happen these days? Old father, old father, you're always... he his own, his own...

brh: مان الیسٹ منش ڈسکاؤنٹ ہر گڑاتے کنے خواہش اونی پیرو بابا پیرو بابا ئے اوڑانتے تسکہوا
en: Main list, [unclear], discount... everything I wished for, Peeru Baba, Peeru Baba would give it [to me].
en_old: Man, the list, the discount... everything I wished for, old father, old father, he gave them all to them.

brh: ئے دا ہیتس پاو کہ ئے پیرو ہٹ
en: I'm saying this because I am an old man.
en_old: I'll say this, old man...

brh: کنا مسٹ ئے نی تو ہول کیوے یاد ئے شار نا کل
en: My daughter, I'm afraid for you; I remember all of the city.
en_old: My daughter, you'd be scared. Remember the whole city.

brh: کنجٹ پٹوٹ نیس کسر کروٹ تے نیس کسر کروٹ تے
en: I'll search the corners; I'll make a way for it, I'll make a way for it.
en_old: I'll open the sesame, I'll clear the way for you, I'll clear the way for you.

brh: بنگنٹ کالج نا دا چھٹی تے ٹی نی خلک آ ہناٹوس؟ ہو یار کنا خاہست خواہیک تینا کلنگا زند ء ہمو خلک آ ٹی
en: [unclear] Did you go to the village during these college holidays? Yes, friend, my wish is [to spend] my whole life in that village.
en_old: During these college holidays, did you go to the village? Yes, friend, my wish is to spend my whole life in that village.

brh: یار کمال کسنی دادے کنے ارفیس تینا جندء خلکیسو سر کریس چنت سال مروئی دا دفتر
en: Man, you did wonders today: you picked me up, you put yourself on the line, you got it done. How many years must it have been, this office...
en_old: Friend, you did a great thing, you picked me up, you beat yourself up... you finished it; how many years has this office been...

brh: انت مننگٹی دا دفترٹی ہچ سما تمپک۔ ندیم صاحب جی سر۔ سلام صاحب انت پاننگٹی۔ سلام صاحب نو انت پاننگورے۔ ئے نمے فیکس ئس کریسوٹ مگر نما کنڈا ہچو جواب بتو۔ سر۔
en: What is going on in this office? Nothing makes any sense. Nadeem sahib? Yes, sir. Hello sir, what are you saying? Hello sir, so what are you saying? I had sent you a fax, but no reply at all came from your side. Sir.
en_old: What's going on, nobody in this office understands anything. Nadeem sahib? Yes sir. Salam sahib, what are you saying? Salam sahib, so what are you saying? I had sent you a fax but no reply came from your side. Sir.

brh: نئے کنیا فیکسس بسنے او نئے جمال صاحب دانا باروٹ کنے پارے دا جمال صاحب جمال صاحب اراڑے دا جمال صاحب اراڑے کے سر جمال صاحب اینانے ہمو بل تا ریکوری کنے ہننگے کنے ایت بے مس سر سر اراڑے جمال صاحب بس نیو جمال صاحب
en: No fax has come to me, and Jamal sahib didn't tell me anything about it either. This Jamal sahib, Jamal sahib, where is he? Where is this Jamal sahib? Sir, Jamal sahib has gone for the recovery on those bills... (unclear)... Sir, sir, where is Jamal sahib? Jamal sahib has just come, Jamal sahib.
en_old: No fax has come to me, and Jamal sahib didn't tell me about it either. This Jamal sahib, where is Jamal sahib, where is this Jamal sahib? Sir, Jamal sahib is the one whose bill recovery I have to go for. It's become... sir, sir, where is Jamal sahib? Jamal sahib came, you go, Jamal sahib.

brh: خبر تومک داڑے کنے اببو کدا ڈسکس کبو دا مسئلہ ہی صحیح سر سوری سلام صاحب ہندن کبو دا فائل کنے ایبو اینا مسئلہ حل کیو میرو چائے سو
en: Look, both of you come here to me, let's discuss this problem. Right, sir. Sorry. Hello sir. Let's do it this way: give me this file and I'll solve its problem. Miro, the tea...
en_old: You know, come here, let's discuss this, this problem... right sir, sorry, salam sahib, let's do this, give me this file, I'll solve its problem. Mir, tea...

brh: میرو وال چائے جوڑ کیتا؟ مہربانی جی نی ہتے دا خوار کرے
en: Miro, have you made the tea? Thank you. Yes, you brought it; you went to a lot of trouble over this.
en_old: Mir, have you made the tea? Thank you. Yes, you took the trouble.

brh: تکلیف کسے تینے؟ کدو کنا فرض اسکے؟ اوہ فرض پائیک!
en: Trouble? To whom, yourself? Wasn't it my duty? Oh, he calls it a duty!
en_old: Did someone trouble themselves? Wasn't it my duty? Oh, he says duty!

brh: اراوختن؟ انت خوشیٹی؟ خوشی نی الے فلحال نی چاکو نا کٹ۔ او
en: Since when? What's the happy occasion? Happiness... for now you are (unclear)... Oh.
en_old: When? What about happiness? Happiness? You don't have that for now, you're cutting with a knife. Oh.

brh: چھا تے ئے امر کپاڑہ یار میرو چھا کاریم جوڑ مس داسہ
en: Okay, so how could I not do it, man? Miro, okay, the job is done now.
en_old: How would I not know about the boy, man? Mir, the boy's work is done now.

brh: دا سا بائے راضی کے ہر پاوتا کدا سانگ مراو کدا ئے لگا
en: Now get the old man to agree, say whatever it takes to him, so that the engagement happens, so that it gets settled.
en_old: Now persuade the old man, whatever you say, so the engagement happens, so that it gets arranged.

brh: ئے ہائے ئے دادے خلکٹی گاڑی ئس بس واپس اینا تو دائے تنہ کنے پالنگ نا انت ضرورت ئے آئی نی پو متؤس آہی خلکٹی ارا گاڑی کے
en: Hey, hey! Today a car came into the village and went back. So what need is there to tell just me about it? Ah, didn't you understand which car it was in the village?
en_old: Hey, hey, today a car came into the village and went back, so why do you need to tell me that? I didn't know which car was in the village.

brh: ایرامار اور اسے بندغس ابا نا شکل نا ورنا اسکے۔ مونا پا؟ ہائے اینو کنے ہمو گاڑی ئے خلکٹی خناٹ ہمو ایرامار اسورے اسے ورنا او بندغس اسکے۔
en: There were two lads, and one of them was a young man with Father's face. Go on, tell me more? Yes, today I saw that car in the village; there were those two, one a young man and the other a man.
en_old: There were two men, and one of them was a young man who looked like father. Tell me more? Yes, today I saw that car in the village, there were those two men, one was a young man.

brh: او لیور ناسخا ئے باہ مار مچے خانیگا کے آ مخکے نیوس او بے عقل تو گڑا نی ئے بندہ غاتے توریس ئے نی اوفتے نا رفیسا جوان اڑوسس بلکہ اورا غے سوس تا
en: Oh, (garbled)... and you laughed? Oh, you fool! So then, did you hold on to these men? It would have been good if you had stopped them properly, or rather brought them home.
en_old: Oh, Lever's son, the father's son, he ate dates, you're a fool, so you held these people, you'd have done well to stop them, rather they came to the house.

brh: آئی آئی گاڑی نا رند اٹ رمب کریٹ او گاڑی تیز ہنا آئی ہمو بندغ کرے اسل مچے باغ آ
en: I, I ran after the car, and the car went off fast; I... that man... (unclear)... to the garden.
en_old: I ran after the car, the car sped off, that man... I never reached the garden at all.

brh: بارکنی لگاکے اوئی آئی کنا خیال پئے ابانا روح خلکٹی بیری خلکٹی ئے باٹی نامشتمے نیداسا باویم کس کس
en: (unclear)... Oh, I think Father's spirit is in the village, wandering the village... (unclear)... Do you believe it now? Do you?
en_old: Something got hold of him... I think father's spirit is roaming in the village, in the village. You don't believe it now, who would, who...

brh: اوئے دانیال خننگوس ایلم نی انتئے خلنگوس؟ نین نین تینا کاریمے کبو گم مر۔ ئے ایلم نی انت پارے؟ پاو نی ہچ پاتو ہندوں نرفنگٹی اوس کسپہ نین
en: Hey Daniyal, are you watching? Brother, why are you hitting him? You, you: mind your own business, get lost. Hey brother, what did you say? Say it! You didn't say anything; you were driving him off like that... don't, you.
en_old: Hey Daniyal, are you looking? Brother, why are you laughing? You, you, do your own work, get lost. Hey brother, what did you say? Tell me, you didn't say anything, you weren't speaking like that.

brh: نی کنا لمہ ئس اینگو مئے، گاڑی، خلق، ایرا بندغ
en: You're turning into my mother now: the car, the village, the two men!
en_old: You're my mother now, the car, the village, the two men.

brh: او پیرونہ بھاونہ ورنائی او پیرونہ تو دانت مننگٹی
en: Oh, the old man's... youthfulness! Oh old man, so what is going on here?
en_old: Oh old man, oh dear brother, youth... oh old man, so what's going on here?

brh: ولے ئے پیروئے دا ہرفتا وٹ کہ او گڑا مائی مائیس اسہ کل لبہ کہ
en: But this has got hold of the old man in such a way that... then, lady, a lady... all of it... (unclear).
en_old: But the old man is taking these words in such a way that, well, mother, mother, someone... all together...

brh: اسلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام جوڑ تکڑے مٹھل خان خیریت ٹھیک ٹھاک جوڑ بڈ طبیعت جوڑ خیر خیریت تل بو مٹھل خان تالے طبیعت جوڑ تکڑے خیریت
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Are you well and strong, Mithal Khan? All well? Fine and dandy. Good... in good health? Good, all is well. Sit down, Mithal Khan. Is your health good, are you strong? All well?
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Are you well, Mithal Khan? All well? Yes, fine. Are you in good health? All is well. Sit down, Mithal Khan. How is your health, are you well?

brh: آئی دا کبی آ، کبی آ، ٹھیک ٹھاک، ئے بنگنوٹ دا گاڑی والا ئس نمارا غبستوس، خیر اسکے، بس ہم خبر اف دیر اسورا، بس ہنو شامے نماز پاریکہ کہ گڑاس بندغ بسور، رنا گاڑی ئس سلیسہ گورا نمونا، بندغ دڑنگاری انت، ولدا
en: I... yes, yes, fine, fine. I've heard that some car people had come to your house. Well, that's all right. It's just that we don't know who they were. It was just at evening prayer time when some men came; a car stopped in front of your place, the men got out, what..., then again...
en_old: I... this ear, ear, fine, fine, I heard that some car driver had come to your house, well, it's fine. We just don't know how late it was, it was just around the evening prayer when some people came, a car stopped in front of your house, the people got out, what... then again...

brh: واپس وار متور گاڑی ٹی نا روٹی ہسے بندہ غس شیر خان ہمبار ہستکے ہا شیر خان ہمبار ارس ارے شیر خان نا روتو غل کٹے چرنگٹی اف
en: They went back. Was there a man in the car, was Sher Khan with them? Yes, Sher Khan was with them, he was. (unclear)... Sher Khan is not walking around anywhere.
en_old: Come back again… that man in the car, is he Sher Khan? Yes, it's Sher Khan, it's him. Sher Khan's… is not out grazing.

brh: دونو عید کا پا یار دعا کا کے اللہ شیر خانے صحیح و سلامت وراغا تے انتھے پولیسوس آخا آخا دونو عیدس اف درو ہمو غریبہ گل بے بے ننا وراغا بسوس
en: Don't say such things, man; pray that God brings Sher Khan home safe and sound. Why, is it the police? No, no, it's nothing like that. Yesterday that poor Gul Bibi came to our house.
en_old: Tell me about the two Eids, man, pray that God brings Sher Khan to our house safe and sound. Why did the police... ah, ah, two Eids have passed, yesterday that poor Gul Bibi came to our house.

brh: او خا کا دا خبل و خبل کھڑنگ بٹھے کا، اہ! داسا کھڑنگ بٹنگ نا انت فائدہ؟ ارا وقت ئے کہ شیر خان بیچارہ گنداڑیا سے کا تو بے عزت کرے کا او داسا کھڑنگ بٹنگ اٹی، بس جانداد خان دا تو ہمو ہیت مس کہ
en: Oh, (stop) this... crying and wailing! Ah! What's the use of crying and wailing now? At the time when poor Sher Khan was (around), he was treated with disrespect, and now there's all this crying and wailing. Well, Jandad Khan, this has turned out just like the saying that...
en_old: He was crying and crying over this. Ah! What's the use of crying now? When poor Sher Khan was alive, he disrespected him, and now he's crying. Well, Jandad Khan, this turned out just like the saying that…

brh: کہ زند ٹی اسہ بندغ نا قدر متو اونا مرگ آن پد اودے اونا جوانی تے یاد کننگ نا انت فائدہ رمضان اندا توئی تے بادے کہ انسان زند ٹی اسے الونا عزت ء کے اسے الونا کارم ٹی برے اینہ کائنگ آن پد گڑا عزت نا ئے توصیف نا انت فائدہ
en: ...that if a person isn't valued during his life, what is the use of remembering his good qualities after his death? Ramzan, this is exactly what I'm saying: that people should respect one another in life and come to help in one another's work; once someone is gone, then what is the use of respect and praise?
en_old: If a person isn't valued during his life, what good is it to remember his good deeds after his death? Ramzan, that's exactly what I'm saying: a person should be respected while he's alive and helped with his work. After he dies, what good are respect and praise?

brh: بس یار جندات ئے ہم نا خواہو کٹ کنے آن کسے تکلیف مف ئے ہم اربان نا کاریمٹ بروٹ او گڑا نم تل بو گڑا ئے کاوہ یار ار تل بو چاس کومے
en: That's enough, Jandad, man. I too don't want anyone to be troubled because of me; I'll come to help with everyone's work too. And now you sit down. Then I'll go. Man, sit down, let's have some tea.
en_old: That's enough, friend. I don't want anything for myself, as long as nobody suffers because of me. I'll come and help with any work. Now you sit down, and I'll make tea.

brh: باری آ مچے کاریم مرے، ہندا وڑے انشااللہ ملاقات مرے، چلو ٹھیک، ہوسوس نا، ہسی پشکنو، عذاب اٹ کنے شال گٹیسو رداسا، مفت اٹ کنے شال مرے دو ٹی کنے گٹیسو رداسا
en: May all the work get done. In the same way, God willing, we'll meet again. Okay, fine. (unclear)... With all this hassle you've cost me the shawl now; I'd have had a shawl for free, and you've let it slip out of my hands now.
en_old: May all your work go well. Likewise, God willing, we'll meet again. Okay, fine… You made me lose the shawl through this trouble; I would have gotten the shawl for free, and you made me lose it.

brh: دا ہالے دفتس، ہچے تے پومفس، ہاں، ابا آخر ئے تنتے؟
en: This news... they don't understand any of it. Yes. Father, what is this, after all?
en_old: He told this story, but I didn't understand any of it. Yes, father, what did he give in the end?

brh: ننا روانہ مونی سر مسن، نی واپس گاڑی ٹی سوار مسس، ہمم، اور ئے مار کہ ننا رندٹ نرا کہ، ئے گاڑی ٹی ہراس کنے آ، کسر ئے امید کرے تپیس پاریس و ہراٹیت کنے، دا صفا آخر قصہ انت ئے؟ یٹ!
en: We had set off and gone on ahead; you got back into the car, hmm. And this boy who ran after us... who was it in the car with me? On the road I hoped... you said it and asked me, 'What on earth is this whole story?' Ugh!
en_old: Our journey went on, and you got back in the car, hmm. Then he saw that someone was running behind us. Who was in the car with me… he hoped for the road… he said to me, "What is this whole story, in the end?" Ugh!

brh: کمال کسنی ارا اورا نمونے ناس گاڑی سلفیس نی خبر او دنا اوراس مٹل نا اوراس سکا اسینا نا باونا اوراس سکا ہاؤ ئے گنوکو ہمار تاکہ گاڑی نا رندٹ نہ نرا نی خبر او دیرس
en: Wonderful, you did! In front of which house of yours did you stop the car? You know, that house: it's Mithal's house, it's the house of (unclear)'s father. Yes, and that crazy one who ran after the car, you know who he is?
en_old: Kamal… his house… you stopped the car, you know. His house is Mithal's house… his father's house… yes, that crazy one ran after the car, you know…

brh: نا ایلم اسکا کنا مار کنا ایلم ہاؤ نا ایلم تو گڑا ماما اور تون ملاقات تو کرینہ ہئیں ئے دیو ملاقات کرینہ کمال قصہ او سیدھا اینا کنا ماما تے خائفے کا ئے برو تو اینگا ماما تے تینا
en: He was your brother? My son, my brother? Yes, your brother. So then, did uncle meet him? Yes, he has met him. An amazing story: he went straight off and frightened my uncle. If he comes, then here uncle... his own...
en_old: Your brother, my son, my brother, yes, your brother. So did uncle meet him? Yes, he met him today. Kamal, the story is that he came straight over. My uncle was afraid… if he comes, then here uncle… his own…

brh: دا وخت آ کہ او اسہ نن ئس نن نا مہمان مسنو تینا چنکی نم دوزی تے منانو تولیبو تا گاڑی ٹی ران صاحب ہرے اپ ئے دز سے ئے بوا مونی مر خدا غا پاہ ہچ کپ سے ہچ کپ سے
en: This is the time when they had become our guests for one night, and you have admitted your petty thefts; sit in their car. ... Sahib, look, is he a thief? Old man, step forward. Say it before God: he has done nothing, he has done nothing.
en_old: At this time, when he has become our guest, get your little ones ready and sit in their car. Sir, go ahead, go on. For God's sake don't do anything, don't do anything.

brh: پیر صاحب السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام، وعلیکم السلام، تول بو لشکر۔ السلام علیکم۔ السلام علیکم۔ پیر صاحب جوڑ خیر؟ خیریت، ٹھیک ٹھاک، وڑ تگڑا پین خیر؟ جوڑ ٹھیک ٹھاک، زور۔ خیریت ئے ٹھیک ٹھاک، پین خیری؟ ٹھیک ٹھاک۔ خیریت ئے ٹھیک ٹھاک۔
en: Pir sahib, peace be upon you. And upon you peace, and upon you peace; sit down, everyone in the party. Peace be upon you. Peace be upon you. Pir sahib, are you well, all good? All is well, fine; are you hale and strong, and everything else good? Well, fine, strong. All is well, fine; is everything else good? Fine. All is well, fine.
en_old: Pir sahib, peace be upon you. And peace be upon you, and peace be upon you, sit down, Lashkar. Peace be upon you. Peace be upon you. Pir sahib, are you well? All is well, fine, are you strong and well too? Fine, doing great. All is well, fine. Is everything else well? Fine. All is well, fine.

brh: میر صاحب آلوم بسونے نخواہ خانی شور کین
en: Mir sahib, the cleric has come; let us start the nikah ceremony.
en_old: Mir sahib, Alum has come, let's sing and celebrate.

brh: کل آن مست ایرا وکیل مس نا رضامندی ئے معلوم کیرہ بریر
en: First of all, the two vakils come and find out the girl's consent.
en_old: First of all, both lawyers come to find out the consent.

brh: اماں، ننا داڑے کنا دتوک نا برام دے؟ نا کڑم آتیر، دا نا دتوک نا برام نا، نا برام ئے ئے نا برام کے
en: Mom, is it my doll's wedding here at our place? Your in-laws... this is your doll's wedding; your wedding... your wedding [will be later].
en_old: Mom, is my brother's wedding at our place? Your in-laws... this is your brother's wedding, your brother's wedding.

brh: اماں کنا برام ارختا مرے نا برام ہمو وخت آ کہ نی بلن مسوس نا، گڑا نی کنا اسٹ آ مسڑ ئس ئے تینا است نا کل مرادات آتے پورا کیوہ۔
en: Mom, when will my wedding be? Your wedding will be when you have grown up. Then, since you are my only daughter, I will fulfil all the wishes of my heart.
en_old: Mom, when will my wedding be? Your wedding will be when you grow up. Then, you are my only daughter, and I will fulfill all the wishes of my heart.

brh: زیبو نن لمہ
en: Zebo... our mother...
en_old: Zebo, our mother.

brh: او کلہ بس کر چپ کر ہنیک چپ چپ کر ہسے وارتینا پلنگا مسے رسوات کینہ وادے غمنا تئی کلو مستی خوار
en: Oh, all of you, enough, be quiet... quiet, quiet, be quiet... once again... she has been laid on the bed; we will perform the rites. This is a day of grief; everyone has become miserable.
en_old: Oh, everyone stop, be quiet, be quiet... we will perform the rituals; this is a day of sorrow...

brh: بش بش پیشن تلوک
en: Get up, get up, outside...
en_old: Get up, get up, go outside.

brh: کنا لمہ نی تانکے کنا جمہ نی ستارے ہراڑان کنا مہر
en: My mother, you are my..., my..., you are a star; where will my love come from now?
en_old: My mother, you are my..., my moon, you are a star, where my love comes from.

brh: اسلام وعلیکم وعلیکم السلام ببو ببو اللہ تے نومے ببو تولے ون ورنا لومے
en: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Come in, come in, by God, come in; sit down, Anwar's mother.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Come in, come in, God bless you, come and sit down, mother of the young one.

brh: ئے ڈنو ماما رت کرے رے تدی ارا کٹک تس کہ نم خیرٹ بسونرے۔ نن خیال کرے پگا عید ئے ملاقات کین۔ امر انور نا
en: Uncle Dino... sent word two days ago that you had arrived safely. We thought we would meet tomorrow, on Eid. How is Anwar's...
en_old: Uncle Dino came over, and two days ago we sent word that you would arrive safely. We thought we would meet tomorrow on Eid. How is it, Anwar's...

brh: بابا جی انور نا لمہ جوان مس بسورے ننتو پگہ بننگ نا کوشش کننگٹ اسونے ولے گودی ضد کرے پنی اینو کانی ڈس تاوراغا امر انور نا لمہ نی ڈس پاتس آ ایلم را
en: Babaji, Anwar's mother, it's good that you came. We were trying to come tomorrow, but the lady insisted, saying, 'Let's go today, to their house.' Isn't that so, Anwar's mother? You gave [us] the directions, brother...
en_old: Babaji, Anwar's mother, it's good that you came. We were trying to come tomorrow, but the girl insisted, saying today... Anwar's mother, you said it, the sister came.

brh: ئنا نی پڑیئے ہیٹ اسہ تنگ کے قربانی نا۔ داسا ایٹ ملو؟ ہورے نلہ مالکے ہنہ ور اسنگے جوانوس۔ ادا جمال داسا کین ہٹ التنے؟ ہمک۔
en: Hey, did you go to the cattle market for a goat for the sacrifice? Will a goat be found now? Look, go to the owner... a good one. Brother Jamal, haven't you bought a goat yet? ...
en_old: Your goat is a bit tight for a sacrifice. Can a goat be found now? Look, go to the owner, there's a good one. Here, Jamal, which goat did you take now? Yes.

brh: کنے لم نندون بے وس گٹ اسہ کنا نند گٹ اسہ سلو دے وار متنے اینو دے چمری سیٹی دا وار کشا اینا داسہ پیڑی ئے ایڑ دا جاگہ نا ایٹ نا مزہ او نندو پیسہ نا ملکان ایٹ فائیو ئے نون
en: Mother, I am helpless... my... this time it didn't happen; today... this time... now the cattle market, sister... the taste of this place's goat... so much money... a goat from abroad...
en_old: Mother, I sit here helpless... this time... today... the taste of the goat from this place... for so much money, five goats from the owner...

brh: امر انور نا باوا؟ جیو انور نا لمہ۔ دا تو ضد کننگٹیٹ ئس پہ جاپان نا ہٹ ئس پائف۔ ئے پٹٹ نی جاپان نا ہٹ تا قربانی مفک با مستا پتی آسٹریلیا غان ننت ئس قربانی نا ہٹ ئس پائفین۔ پورا پنجاہ ہزار خرچ مس۔ امر؟
en: How about it, Anwar's father? Yes, Anwar's mother. This one kept insisting that we get a goat from Japan. I said, 'A Japanese goat isn't valid for the sacrifice,' so in the end we got a sacrificial goat from Australia. A full fifty thousand was spent. Right?
en_old: How about it, Anwar's father? Yes, Anwar's mother. This one kept insisting that we bring a goat from Japan. I said a goat from Japan isn't valid for sacrifice, so in the end we brought a sacrificial goat from Australia. A full fifty thousand was spent. How about that?

brh: انور نا لوئے؟ نی جوان پاریس انور نا باوہ۔ خاص خرچہ بس؟ پورا پنجاہ ہزار۔ پنجاہ ہزار تینا جاگہ غا ریٹرن ٹکٹ، پاسپورٹ نا خرچہ، سلیپنگ بیگ، کساب نا خرچہ، ہتہ دا جاگہ غا کساب آتہ تو ایٹ خننگ تو کیرے۔
en: Anwar's mother? You said it well, Anwar's father. Was there a lot of expense? A full fifty thousand. Fifty thousand on its own, [plus] the return ticket, passport expenses, a sleeping bag, the butcher's fee; and here, even the butchers can [only] look at the goat.
en_old: Anwar's mother? You said it right, Anwar's father. Was there a lot of expense? A full fifty thousand. Fifty thousand, including the return ticket, passport expenses, the sleeping bag and the butcher's fee. As for the butchers here, at least you can see the goat.

brh: ننا ہیت آسٹریلیا نا، کسر ہم آسٹریلیا نا۔ ہمباز، ہمباز، جوان، اللہ قبول کے نما قربانی ء، ہینم کے کاو چاء جوڑ کے اوتے۔ اوہ، چاء غان است خراب ئس چاء تو گلاس اوار۔
en: Our goat is from Australia, and the route it came by is Australian too. Bravo, bravo, good; may God accept your sacrifice. Go, make tea for them. Oh, tea upsets my stomach; [bring] a glass along with the tea.
en_old: Our talk is Australian, and our road is Australian too. Well done, well done, good. May God accept your sacrifice. Go and make tea for them. Oh, tea upsets my stomach. Tea, along with a glass.

brh: بسکٹ مسکٹ ئس یورپ اٹ تو ننا چاء توار بسکٹ ہم کنگونے انتئے کہ صوبت و ننا ناشتہ ہم کتونن امر انور نا لمہ؟ انور نا بابا! خرے نو چاء ئس ہن ننا ایلم بسکوٹ باز چاء
en: Biscuits and the like: in Europe we also eat biscuits with our tea, because this morning we didn't have breakfast either. Right, Anwar's mother? Anwar's father! ... go [get] some tea; our brother, biscuits and plenty of tea.
en_old: Biscuits and such in Europe. We'll also eat biscuits with our tea, because we didn't have breakfast this morning, right, Anwar's mother? Anwar's father! Go then, bring some tea. Our sister, biscuits, lots of tea.

brh: باز ئے دا سکاؤ نم کچاتے و بسکوٹ آتے و ہمار انور لا لمے راست پاریٹ نی ڈروک
en: It's a lot... you... the... and the biscuits... and... Anwar's mother, I told the truth; you're scared.
en_old: There's a lot of it. You... the biscuits... and Anwar's mother told the truth. You are scared.

brh: دا دے دا دے دا دے ماما دا دے ارے دا دے دا دے دا دے ارے ماما چلو بس سہی او دے دے نی ارے ماما دے دے دے دے دے دے دے دے چلو یہ دونو دا دے دے نی اور دا دے دا دے ارے ماما دا دے دے نی اور دا دے دے نی واہ بھائی واہ کمال ہی بس دونو
en: This one, this one, this one, uncle, this one, hey, this one, this one, this one, hey uncle, okay, fine, give it, give it, hey uncle, give, give, give, give, give, give, give, give. Okay, these two; give this one, and this one, this one, hey uncle, give this one, and give this one. Wow, brother, wow, amazing, just the two.
en_old: This one, this one, this one, uncle, this one, hey, this one, this one, this one, hey uncle, okay, that's fine, give it, give it, hey uncle, give, give, give, give... okay, these two, give this one, and this one, this one, hey uncle, give this one, and give this one. Wow brother, wow, amazing, just both.
