en_old: I don't need it at all. I'm going. Zeba?

brh: زیبا غرک نی ضد کپے ئے ونی دا خلق نا چنا تے زند نا روشنائی تے تننگ کین
en: Zeba, don't be stubborn, so that you and I can give these people's children the light of life.
en_old: Zeba, don't be stubborn, so that I can give these people's children the light of life.

brh: نی مچٹ ئس حوصلہ تو کرک۔ سوری باز مشکل ئے تعلیم حاصل کننگ نا مقصد دا اف۔
en: Have a little courage. Sorry, it's very hard. Getting an education is not for this.
en_old: You should have a little courage. Sorry, it's very hard; the purpose of getting an education is not this.

brh: کنا انتینا او تینا چناتا مستقبل ء تباہ کین؟ آئی ایم سوری۔ ابا با نی ہم ننتو بر، ہمبلائن۔
en: Why should we ruin our own children's future? I'm sorry. Dad, you come with us too.
en_old: Why should I ruin my own children's future? I'm sorry. Dad, you come with us too, we'll understand.

brh: کنا انتظار ء کروس؟ نی ہم بکان؟ نی ہم ننتو برک۔ بکان نپو، بکان۔ اینو ننتو برک، برک کنا مسٹ۔ دا وڑ مفن۔
en: Were you waiting for me? Are you coming too? Come, let's go. You come with us too. Come on, let's go, come on. Today you're coming with us; come, my daughter. It shouldn't be like this.
en_old: Were you waiting for me? Are you going too? You come with us too. Don't say you're going, you're going. Today you'll come with us, come, my daughter. It won't be like this.

brh: ئے کپرکی، اگہ نی ہنوت تو نست، دا خلق نا چنک بے خوانے تم مریرہ، دافتے دیر خوانیفک، دا خلق نا کسبہ فقط دافتے خوانیفک، ئے تو
en: I can't, because if I go, there's no one; these people's children will be left uneducated. Who will teach them? In this people's town I'm the only one who teaches them. I, so...
en_old: I can't, if you go then nothing, these people's children will remain uneducated, who will teach them? These people's only work is to educate them, I so...

brh: تاو چاغہ تاو چاغہ آن بننگ کپرسہ نا ہچ تاو چاغہ آن بننگ کپرہ السلام علیکم خیر ئے
en: Taw Chagha... I can't come away from Taw Chagha. No, I can't come away from Taw Chagha at all. Peace be upon you. Is everything well?
en_old: Taw Chagha, they can't come from Taw Chagha, nobody can come from Taw Chagha at all. Peace be upon you, is everything well?

brh: جان اللہ رفیق صاحب اونی مبارک مرے عید نی ردینوسونے
en: Jan Allah, Rafiq Sahib! Eid Mubarak to you. You've arrived.
en_old: Dear Allah Rafiq Sahib, happy Eid to you, you've sent it.

brh: رفیق صاحب باز جوان و بندغ اسے۔ او اونا کلان بلا جوزہ داد ئے کہ او دا خلق اٹی ء، او چناتے خوانفنگ اٹی ئے تو خوانفے اونا جوزہ، اونا
en: Rafiq Sahib is a very good person. And his greatest passion is this: that he is among these people, teaching the children. So teaching is his passion, his...
en_old: Rafiq Sahib is a very good person. He has great passion for this — he is among these people, he teaches the children, so his passion for teaching, his...

brh: قربانی نا دے مبارک مرے، نا کنا؟ ئے تو ہمدا سوچا سوٹ کہ اینو ما ورا غا بریوا، خدائے نا روشنائی ء تالان کننگ کن نمے درخواست کیوا۔ دا خلق ء؟ بلکہ نی اونا۔۔۔
en: Happy Eid al-Adha. To you... and me? I was just thinking that today I'd come to your house and ask you to spread the light of God. These people? Rather, you... his...
en_old: Happy Eid al-Adha, my... I was just thinking that today I'd come to your place and request you to spread the light of God. These people? Rather you his...

brh: رفیق صاحب کنا ایلم ہم باری علم ء تالان کنوکا کنا دوست ء نی ہم اسہ تعلیم یافتہ اسے ئس دا خلقت ٹی علم ء تالان کننگ کن نا باز ضرورت ء
en: Rafiq Sahib, my brother, is also my friend who spreads knowledge. You are an educated person too; you are badly needed to spread knowledge in this community.
en_old: Rafiq Sahib, my brother, you too are my friend who spreads knowledge. You are also an educated person; you are very much needed to spread knowledge among these people.

brh: کانیڑ، کہ دا چنا خوانار، تو دن چا کے دا خلق نا زند بدل مریک۔ ارٹ کنے ماسک ئس ایرا دسوتا۔
en: Look, if these children get an education, then you know the life of these people will change. Two... a mask for me, over there...
en_old: Look, if these children get educated, then you know the life of these people will change. Both of them, give me a mask over there.

brh: دا خلک نا چنا تے رفیق صاحب تون اوار خوانفک تان ذمہ داری ء او دا ذمہ داری ء انشاءاللہ پورا کیو کانو راما رفیق صاحب باز خوش مرے نا دا فیصلہ
en: Teaching these people's children together with Rafiq Sahib is my own responsibility, and God willing I will fulfill this responsibility. Rafiq Sahib, I'm very happy about this decision of yours.
en_old: He teaches the children of these people together with Rafiq Sahib; it's his responsibility, and God willing he will fulfill this responsibility. Rafiq Sahib, you will be very happy with this decision.

brh: ئے دا مار اسے نن تے فوٹو کش
en: Hey, you, boy, take a photo of us.
en_old: Hey, this boy, take a photo of us.

brh: نی او پو مرے لیکن نی پو مپہ؟ انت؟ ئے پو مپٹ؟ دا نی انت پاننگٹی ئس اسہ ٹو مار ئس ننا، نی اونا مست نا ارمان ء پورا کننگ کپیسہ، ولے پاسہ ئے پو مریوٹ۔ اینو اسکان کسس
en: You should understand, but you don't understand? What? I don't understand? What is this you're saying? We have only one son, and you can't fulfill his long-held wish, yet you say you understand. Until today, no one...
en_old: You'll understand, but you don't understand? What? I don't understand? What are you saying? We have only one son, you can't fulfill his old wish, yet you say I don't understand. Until today no one...

brh: زور زبردستی اٹ برام کریفے؟ گڑا میر اٹم دا برام مننگ باز مشکل ئے گڑا نانخا دے، کینا مار کے پین نصیب اٹی ظلم کیو؟ میر دا ظلم اف، دا ننا حق ئے انتئے؟ انتئے ننا حق ئے
en: Get him married by force? Then, Mir, this marriage will be very hard to bring about. Then one day, shall I wrong my son with someone else's fate? — Mir, this is not injustice, this is our right. — Why? Why is it our right?
en_old: You got them married by force? Then, Mir, this marriage is very difficult. Then one day, will my son commit oppression on someone else's fate? Mir, this is not oppression, this is our right. Why? Why is it our right?

brh: خاصرن کن اندا مخلوق نا میر معتبر، باغار تنا مار کے انتن کپیسے، اوسٹ نی ئس کہ نی تنا مار نا ہچ احساس اف، انت مطلب ئے تنا، اندا کہ نن زور زبردستی کس یا ظلم کیرے۔
en: Especially since you're the chief and the respected man of these very people, why can't you do this for your own son? You're someone who has no feeling at all for his own son. What do you mean? That we are using force or doing injustice?
en_old: Especially for this reason, the respected elders of the people... why can't you [do] for your own son? It seems you have no feeling at all for your son. What do you mean — that we are using force or committing oppression?

brh: اونا زورٹی برامے کریفے دا کنیا مننگ کپک برا کنا کنا مارے نم دا برامے مننگ کپک اونے ورسٹ اسہ نا اسہ دے ئس ہندا لیڈی ڈاکٹر دا ودی نم نا مونا مروئی
en: They forced the marriage on him. This can't happen. Come, my son, my son. This marriage of yours can't happen. One day or another, this same lady doctor will turn up in front of you.
en_old: They married her off by force; this can't happen, my son, my son — you, this marriage can't happen. One day this same lady doctor will appear before you.

brh: زیبا، نن ڈاکٹر صاحبہ برکھا نا مسن نی؟ ایلم نی مبارک مرے، ئے زیبا نی تو نوار ہندا
en: Zeba, have we now come over to Doctor Sahiba's side, then? Brother, congratulations to you. Hey Zeba, you are just...
en_old: Zeba, we've become [friends] of Doctor Barkha? Brother, congratulations to you. Hey Zeba, you are so...

brh: خلک اٹی خوانفک۔ زبردست۔ خو۔ دا اعتراض نی ایم دا خلکنا چنا تے بیرہ اردو نا بلکہ انگریزی ہم خوانفیرہ۔
en: She teaches in the village. Great. Well. As for this objection of yours too: she teaches the children of this village not only Urdu but English as well.
en_old: She teaches among these people. Great. Well, this objection — I teach the children of these people not only Urdu but English too.

brh: زیبا اینا دا فیصلہ غان باز خوش مسٹ۔ نا باز مہربانی۔ مہربانی کنا نا بلکہ ڈاکٹر صاحب نا ادا کرک کہ او کنے دا راستینگا کسر ئس شاغا۔
en: Zeba, I am very happy with this decision of his. Thank you very much. Not me; rather, give your thanks to the Doctor Sahib, who put me on this right path.
en_old: Zeba, I am very happy with your decision today. Thank you very much. Not me, rather thank the Doctor Sahib, who showed me this right path.

brh: ڈاکٹر صاحبہ ئے نما دا احسان پورا زند تینا اوست آن دپروٹ۔ نا ایو داٹی احسان نا انت ہیت اسے دا تو ننا کلا نا فرض اسے
en: Doctor Sahiba, I will not forget this kindness of yours for my whole life. Oh no, what kindness is there in this? This is the duty of all of us.
en_old: Doctor Sahiba, I will never forget this kindness of yours from my heart for my whole life. No, what kindness is there in this? This is the duty of all of us.

brh: دا خلک کے ترقی تننگ کے تعلیم باز ضروری ہی مسنگو ماتا تعلیم دا خلک کے اسے پھوسکونو روشنائی اسے تیک او دا روشنائی نا بنیاد نم ہرتوما
en: To bring progress to these people, education is very necessary... Education gives these people a new light, and you both are the foundation of this light.
en_old: Education is very important for the progress of these people. Education will give these people a new light, and the foundation of this light is both of you.

brh: تھینکس ڈاکٹر صاحبہ۔ نو تھینکس ایلم، دادو ننا فرض ئے جوان داسہ ئے کاوا، ماما انتظار کروئی نائے دونو امر کاسہ؟ ئے چا کیوا۔
en: Thanks, Doctor Sahiba. No thanks, brother, this is our duty. All right, now I'll go; uncle must be waiting. How will you go like this? I'll figure it out.
en_old: Thanks, Doctor Sahiba. No thanks, brother, this is our duty. Well, now I'll go; uncle will be waiting. How will you go? I'll see.

brh: بلکہ ایرغ نا ٹیمے رکھوک اوڑے دا واز ایتینومے پین وختس پدی بریوا ایرغ ہم کونیوا انشاءاللہ جان اللہ حافظ اللہ حافظ ڈاکٹر صاحبہ
en: Actually, they keep a set mealtime, and I have given my word there. Another time I will come back and will eat a meal too, God willing. Dear, goodbye. Goodbye, Doctor Sahiba.
en_old: Actually, she kept bread time there, I've given [you] this message. I'll come back some other time and will also eat bread, God willing. Dear, goodbye. Goodbye, Doctor Sahiba.

brh: کنا پلنگا مسڑ، تول ذرا تول، ہا دا اسہ تو تینا اراٹی خوش اسنو، ہا بابا دا صفا لائف ارے
en: My elder daughter, sit, just sit. Yes, this one at least is happy in her own home. Yes, father, this is a really good life.
en_old: My dear daughter, sit, just sit. Yes, this one was happy in her home. Yes, father, this is a clean life.

brh: ہم دانین تو مرے ہاؤ کنا مسیر داسہ نا بھلا ایلم ہم داڑے بریک او ہم نی ہمبار خوش مروئی کنا مسیر
en: May it be like this for her too. Yes, my daughter, now your elder brother will come here too, and you too will be just as happy, my daughter.
en_old: May it be like this too. Yes, my daughter, now your elder brother also comes here, and you will be just as happy, my daughter.

brh: ایلم جان کہ او اسہ جاگہ غا کالج آ پوانانو تو صبحس کنے نو فراز نا کمک ء کرے کنتہ کہ اوڑتو مہر کرے کر ولے او نا مہر اٹ انت مرے
en: Dear brother, when they were studying in the same place, at college, then one morning Faraz helped me... that he loved her, but what would come of his love?
en_old: Dear brother, when they used to study together at college, in the morning Faraz helped me. I told him to love her, but what would come of his love?

brh: ڈاکٹر نور فراز تو برام کننگ خوابک انتئے کہ ڈاکٹر نور خلکٹی ئے او تینا مچ آ زندے خلکٹی گدریفنگ خواہک۔ جی تئی تیدڑ چٹے دستے ہچ متنے۔
en: Dr. Noor wants to marry Faraz, because Dr. Noor is in the village, and she wants to spend her whole life in the village. Yes... nothing has come into [our] hands.
en_old: Dr. Noor wants to marry Faraz, because Dr. Noor is in the village and wants to spend her whole life in the village. Yes, nothing has been left in your hands now.

brh: نا ہیتس بسنے گلاس بسنے کنا خیال پائے بس ہندا ہیت اناڑے ختم کر۔ دا ہیتے امر داڑے ختم کیو۔ ئے لمہ جان مہر کننگ گناہس تو اف کہ فراز مہر کرے کوڑ تو۔ ئے مہر کیوہ شبانہ تو۔ شبانہ کنا مہر
en: Enough of your talk, enough of the complaints; in my opinion, just end this matter right here. How can I end this matter here? Mother dear, loving is not a sin, that Faraz loved... I love Shabana. Shabana is my love.
en_old: Your words are enough, the glass is enough, I think that's enough, end this matter here. How can I end this matter here? Mother dear, love is not a sin, so what if Faraz loved? I love Shabana. Shabana is my love.

brh: مسڑی ئے اودے تینا اڑانا زیب جوڑ کننگ خواوہ ئے فراز ء تینا مار ء پوک کرینو ٹوک ئنا ہیت ء ہم منانے فراز بہہ
en: The girl, I want to make her the adornment of my house. I have... Faraz, my son, and he too has accepted the matter... Faraz, yes.
en_old: I want to make my daughter the jewel of my house. Faraz has also accepted the word of the elders that his son made; Faraz, yes.

brh: دا خبر۔ السلام علیکم۔ خبر کنا مار دا کدو سپوږمی لیفټیننټ۔ انکل۔ آن ٹھیک۔ اینو نمونہ عباس جان۔
en: This is the news. Peace be upon you. The news is about my son, this... lieutenant. Uncle. Yes, fine. Today... Abbas Jan.
en_old: This news. Peace be upon you. The news is that my son, this... Lieutenant. Uncle. Yes, fine. Today the example is Abbas Jan.

brh: کنے باز خوشی مس کہ نی ننا احساس ء کریس، دن نی پریشان کرینے۔
en: I was very happy that you considered our feelings; you had made [us] so worried.
en_old: I was very happy that you understood our feelings; you have worried us like this.

brh: معاف کیسا۔ دا نوی چیز اسے۔ دا دم باز جان اسے۔ وسیلم دا سدا ایتا کل مسوری تے باز مرغن کپا ئے
en: Forgive me. This is a new thing. This moment is very dear. Waseem(?)... don't drag all the [talks?] out too long.
en_old: Forgive me. This is a new thing. This breath is very precious. Waseem, always give this... all the lentils are cooked very long.

brh: تینا امانت تے زوت دننگ خواوہ بس کنے انت پاسہ؟ شبانہ درو نا اسکہ اینو نا اراخت است نا پائے تینا امانت تے اللہ نی سلامت کے ایلوم کنا اللہ نی خوش کے
en: I want to take my trust [home] soon; just tell me, what do you say? Shabana... from yesterday until today... the heart says she is your own trust. May God keep you safe, my brother; may my God make you happy.
en_old: I want to hand over my trust quickly; just tell me what to do? Shabana, from yesterday until today's rest... she says, your trust; may God keep you safe, and may my God make you happy.

brh: اللہ نی عمر ایت بس کنے دا پارا دے آ مٹھائی تو چلو گودا تو برے سبحان اللہ اللہ کرے اللہ نی عمر دے ہاں ایو ہم چاوہ ست کہ مہمانک بسنو اوئے واہ برے ایلو نا جندہ کہ شربت ایتس باز دماغ تا گرم مسنے
en: May God give you a long life. Just tell me this: sweets on [this] day? Come on, then come. Glory be to God, God willing; may God give you life. Yes, I also know that guests have come. Oh wow, come... give [them] some sharbat, their tempers have gotten very hot.
en_old: May God give you a long life. Just tell me this, sweets on this day, so come on then, Subhan Allah, may God give you a long life. Yes, I also know that guests have come. Oh wow, come, and the other... give some sharbat, everyone's tempers have gotten very hot.

brh: اللہ خوش تخنے، بکارے مار کن تو، جوان جوان، اللہ خوش تخنے، پیر نمے مبارک، آن نمے مبارک، اللہ بختاور کے۔
en: May God keep you happy; it is needed for the son, after all. Good, good. May God keep you happy. Congratulations to you, elder; yes, congratulations to you; may God make [you] fortunate.
en_old: May God keep you happy, it's needed for the son, good, good, may God keep you happy, congratulations to you, the elder; yes, congratulations to you, may God make you fortunate.

brh: نا مسڑ کنا اورا نا برے خیر اٹ
en: May your daughter come to my house with blessings.
en_old: Your daughter, come to my house, in goodness.

brh: ڈاکٹر صاحب دادے نا مریض بلکہ نا مہمان داسہ الحمداللہ جوڑے انت ہرا سے جوڑ ارے بے حد اللہ نا شکر جوان اٹ
en: Doctor Sahib, here is your patient, or rather your guest; now, praise be to God, he is well. So, is he well? Endless thanks to God, I am fine.
en_old: Doctor sahib, your patient, or rather your guest, is now well, praise be to God. What, which one is well? Endlessly thankful to God, I am fine.

brh: میرو جان ڈاکٹر فراز نا وجہ غان نی اینو ماشاءاللہ تندرست ئس ولے ئے تو خلک ٹی اسوٹ۔ ہاؤ نی خلک ٹی اسوس ولدا اینو نی خلک آن داڑے شار آ بسوس تاکہ ڈاکٹر دوست
en: Miro dear, thanks to Dr. Faraz you are healthy today, God be praised. But I was in the village. Yes, you were in the village, and then today you came from the village here to the city so that Doctor Dost...
en_old: Miro Jan, because of Dr. Faraz you are healthy today, masha'Allah, but I was in the village. Yes, you were in the village, then today you came from the village here to the city so that Doctor Dost...

brh: تینا علاج ء۔ فراز صاحب اینو مس شکر گزار اٹ۔ نم کنے داڑے ہسورے کنا علاج کرفیرے۔ ولے دا ظالم آ کنے گنوک کرے بالکل۔ نا منت وار آ گنی مرو ئے تو۔
en: ...[would do] your treatment. Faraz Sahib, today I am grateful. You brought me here and are having me treated. But this cruel one had driven me completely mad. I am grateful to you...
en_old: ...my treatment. Faraz sahib, today I am grateful. You brought me here and had me treated. But this cruel one has made me completely crazy. I'm indebted to you, otherwise I would have gone crazy.

brh: ڈاکٹر دوستے نا منک انتیکہ ڈاکٹر دوستے نا علاج آ کے باز محنت کرے او احسان مندی نی ہیتے تو احسان مندی ڈاکٹر نور نا منک انتیکہ ہمو کنے خلکا خوائسیو دا پاریک نا علاج آ کریسیو
en: Be grateful to Doctor Dost, because Doctor Dost worked very hard on your treatment. And as for the gratitude you talk about, then be grateful to Dr. Noor, because she is the one who called me to the village and said I should do your treatment.
en_old: I am indebted to Doctor Dost, because Doctor Dost worked very hard on my treatment. And you talk about gratitude, then I am grateful to Dr. Noor, because she called me from the village and said she would do my treatment.

brh: ڈاکٹر نور؟ جیو۔ ڈاکٹر نور۔ اوکے نمازندے۔ ڈاکٹر صاحب، دا ڈاکٹر نور ہمودے براہوئی خاتون نا مسڑ؟ دا شال ٹی خواناکو؟ ہاؤ۔ ہمو ڈاکٹر۔
en: Dr. Noor? Yes. Dr. Noor. Okay... Doctor Sahib, is this Dr. Noor the daughter of that Brahui lady? The one who was studying here in Shal? Yes. That doctor.
en_old: Dr. Noor? Yes. Dr. Noor. Okay, as you like. Doctor sahib, is this Dr. Noor the daughter of that Brahui lady? Who studies here in Shal? Yes. That doctor.

brh: ہمو نرمان اسہ کہ نی جوڑ مریس، دا سم خلکٹی اونا کسر نا چارے تاکہ نی کاسلو اونا زند نا سنگت جوڑ
en: That was [her] wish, that you would get well; even now she is in the village, watching the road for you, so that you would go and become her life's companion.
en_old: That hope that you became, she is waiting on your path in the village too, so that you would become her life companion.

brh: نی دا سنگت؟ دا نمونہ پاننگ اٹی اٹ ڈاکٹر صاحب۔ او ہمو کہ حقیقت ء ئے ہمو ہیت ء پاننگ اٹی اٹ۔ او پین تینٹ پارے سس کہ نی اونا زند ئس ارے نی اونا زند ئس
en: You, this companion? I am saying this as an example, Doctor Sahib. I am saying the thing that is the truth. She herself had also said that you are her life, you are her life.
en_old: You, this companion? I am telling you this as an example, doctor sahib. That is what's true, I am saying that thing. She herself also said that you are her life, you are her life.

brh: او مزید بچس او او ڈاکٹر صاب دا عید راستی بھلے دا عید دنف ئے دے سوچنگٹی اوٹ سر ئے دا دیکی چنکیٹی اینا لمہ وفات مس
en: And besides, a child... and, and Doctor Sahib, this Eid is truly big; this Eid... I keep thinking about that day; at such a young age her mother passed away.
en_old: And he survived further, and, and doctor sahib, this Eid, truly great, this Eid... I was thinking that day, at that young age his mother passed away.

brh: کنا لمہ و دے بلن کرے پال تیس کنا ایڑے
en: My mother raised her; she brought up my sister.
en_old: My mother raised and brought up my brother.

brh: شاہ علم تو پورے پین سے۔ شلو اللہ خیر کے شاہ علم۔ اوئے اگے بدمعاشی دے تے قلندر۔ بدمعاشی چلے کوئی پین بس۔ او اول شاہ کنے پورے یار
en: Shah Alam is something else entirely. Shalo, may God make it good, Shah Alam. Hey, if it's thuggery... Qalandar. If the thuggery goes on, someone else has come. Oh, first, Shah, me... completely, friend.
en_old: Shah Alam is complete, something else. Shalo, may God make it good, Shah Alam. Hey, if it's bullying, then Qalandar. Bullying goes on, someone else came. Oh, first Shah, for me it's enough, friend.

brh: اوڑے خیر ئے دا کسر ننے آ موٹر سائیکلا انتے کسرے سلفینوس؟ ایلوم ننا کسرے الے ایلوم ہیکائیم۔ مئے خبراوف کنا پنی نیازوئے گلو نا ایلوم اوٹ ننے مخلوق خنک موسم ایلمار نرے کک اور نی دا موٹر سائیکلا ننا کسر نا مونا سلفینوس ولا جوڑ کنے اوستی نا کسرے الے۔
en: Hey, what's going on? Why have you parked the motorcycle on this road and blocked our way? Brother, clear our road, brother, [unclear]. Don't you know? My name is Niazo, I'm Gulo's brother. People are watching us, [unclear: the brothers ran off?], and you've parked this motorcycle right in front of our road. [Unclear], clear the road.
en_old: Hey, what's going on? Why have you blocked our road with your motorcycle? Brother, let us through, brother, let us go. Don't you know my name is Niazo, Gulo's brother? People are watching us, brother... and you've parked your motorcycle in front of us on our road. Move it, get out of our way.

brh: ئے ہمبر نی گمر داسا گم تنی مرے سے خوامخواہ ایر من تڑے پبو تے ئے ہمبر نی گمر اڑے سالگے داسا اینا گم مکے وی
en: Hey mate, you're full of yourself. Now get lost, [unclear] for no reason, don't [unclear]. Hey mate, you're full of yourself. Hey, [unclear], now don't [unclear] today.
en_old: Hey friend, don't grieve now, there's no point getting upset for nothing... hey friend, don't grieve, don't be sad today.

brh: نی نیازونا خبر اف نی نیازونا مونا کزہ کے او دے ہمت تف اور نی اینو ننے گم کیسہ
en: Don't you know who Niazo is? Nobody has the nerve to stand in front of Niazo, and today you're giving us grief.
en_old: Don't you know Niazo? Nobody dares to come in front of Niazo, and today you're doing this to us.

brh: نیازو گڑا نی کنے امر کیسی نی داسہ نیازو نا خبر تمے کنے
en: Niazo? So what are you going to do to me? Now you'll find out about Niazo.
en_old: Niazo, so what are you going to do to me? Now I'll show you who Niazo is.

brh: اڑے نیازو! نی انت ریل نا انجن نمبر موٹ کشنگٹی ئس چاوہ کے نی کٹس کرینس؟ ہاؤ ادا گلو! کٹس او کرینٹ، ئنا کٹ چوان انانہ کیک چٹ۔ نیازو! بلے تمائی اینہ، چاوہ کریس کٹس۔
en: Hey Niazo! What, are you puffing like a railway engine? I gather you've given him a beating? Yes, brother Gulo! I gave him a beating, a proper beating [unclear]. Niazo! Indeed, [unclear], I know you gave him a beating.
en_old: Hey Niazo! What, did you cut him up like a train engine blowing smoke? Yes, brother Gulo! I cut him up, and properly too. Niazo! Well done, you cut him up good.

brh: او ادا گلو اسٹ نن بدمعاشی کرئے او دے خلقٹ کسفیٹ۔ لیکن افسوس نا دادے اسٹ پین کٹ پٹ ئس سموڑے ننے خنا۔ اڑے نیازو ہراڑے کسے جنگ ئس کسے ہراڑے کسے جنگ ئس کسے چڑہ ننے کرین ئے ڈینڈا ٹی پسائفینوسٹ صفا۔
en: Brother Gulo, we acted like thugs, and I beat him to death. But the pity is that someone else saw this fight and saw us. Hey Niazo, wherever someone's fighting, wherever someone's fighting, you drag us in and land us completely in trouble.
en_old: Brother Gulo, we acted like thugs and beat him in front of everyone. But sadly, someone else saw the fight and saw us. Hey Niazo, wherever there's a fight, wherever there's a fight, you drag us into it and land us in real trouble.

brh: ادا گلو ئے اگر اودے خلپروسٹ نا پین خراب مسکہ، ہر کس پارے کہ اونا ایلم خلے کک ننے انت عزت بچا کے ولدا؟ اڑے ناخنوک، اٹ منڈی کنے عزت کے جنگ کروس؟ ہمو دیر ئس کٹ پٹ کنے خنا۔ جمال نا ایلم پرویز خانانے۔ اڑے او نیازو، او جمال نا ایلم پرویز خانانے، اوسے۔
en: Brother Gulo, if I hadn't beaten him, your name would have been ruined; everyone would have said that his brother took a beating, and then what honour would we have left? Hey, you oaf, you fought for my honour in the market? Who is it that saw the fight? It's Jamal's brother, Parvez Khan. Hey Niazo, he's Jamal's brother, Parvez Khan, that's who.
en_old: Brother Gulo, if we hadn't beaten him it would have been worse. Everyone would say his brother got beaten, so what would be left of our honour then? Hey you fool, you fought for my honour? The man who saw the fight is Jamal's brother, Parvez Khan. Hey Niazo, he's Jamal's brother Parvez Khan, that's who he is.

brh: سیمور ملک ہسے او دے کنا دہشت نا خبرے او کے کائے نہ او کنا پن الپک اسل ادا گلو کنے خبرے او بندغ ننا پن الپک لیکن کنے خوفے ئنا پگاہ نا دے ئنا بندغ بش مروئی ننتو
en: [Unclear] he knows how feared I am; he wouldn't dare go; he doesn't dare even mention my name. Brother Gulo, I know that man doesn't dare mention our name, but I'm afraid that one day that man will rise up against us.
en_old: The whole region knows how much people fear me. He won't come. He doesn't know my name at all. Brother Gulo, I know that man doesn't know our name, but I'm afraid that tomorrow that man will come after us.

brh: او بلوک سے بس کروئی اڑے او نیازو، او نیچ کپک، او نا پن الپیس، اوڑتون جنگ من کپیس، اینک دا سمانہ دانہ زرکینہ شکار کرتے، دا سمانہ دانہ زرکینہ شکار کرتے
en: He's a menace, that's enough. Hey Niazo, he doesn't [unclear]. Don't mention his name, don't ever fight with him. Now he'll hunt us down [unclear], he'll hunt us down [unclear].
en_old: He's a dangerous man, that's enough. Hey Niazo, he doesn't let anyone off. You don't know him. Don't fight with him. He'll hunt us down for this, he'll hunt us down for this.

brh: ایلم خیر ئے نن دا ایرا دے مسے دے پریشان ئس نی ایلم ئے پریشان افٹ۔ ایلم پریشان تو ارے ئس اگر مسئلہ ئس ارے کنے آ ڈکی پتی کنے پا۔ جی نی ایلم ئے چھو ایتسف۔
en: Brother, is everything all right? For two or three days now you've been worried. No, brother, I'm not worried. Brother, you are worried; if there's some problem, don't hide it from me, tell me. No, brother, it's nothing.
en_old: Brother, is everything okay? You've been worried for two or three days now. Are you worried, brother? If you're worried, if there's a problem, tell me and don't hide it from me. No, brother, it's nothing.

brh: چلو ایلم ایچ اسب نا مرضی ایراٹک
en: All right, brother, nothing; as you wish.
en_old: Okay brother, nothing, whatever you want.

brh: ادا نیازو، انتئے کہ پریشان ئس ادا تانکہ پرویز زندئے دا پریشانی کنے۔
en: Brother Niazo, the reason I'm worried, brother, is that as long as Parvez is alive, I'll have this worry.
en_old: Brother Niazo, I'm worried because as long as Parvez is alive, this worry stays with me.

brh: اڑے ناخنوک پرویز خنانے ایو تو پین بندغ ہم اسگے ادا ہمے بدبخت تو نیرا بندغ پین ہم اسرک لیکن ئے ہزار بندغ خنیوم او کنا پین الپیسے اڑے دز او کنا پینیر الپسے پرویز
en: Hey, you oaf, so Parvez has seen it; there are other men like him too. Brother, that wretch... there are plenty of other men like that too. But I've seen a thousand men, and they don't dare mention my name. Hey, he won't dare mention my name, Parvez.
en_old: Hey you fool, have you seen Parvez? There are other men like him too. Yes, this wretch... there are plenty of men like that, but I've seen a thousand men. He doesn't know my name. Hey, he didn't know my name, Parvez.

brh: ئے زمنا پین الپک پین داسہ پرویز تو جنگ کپیس اور اونا پین ملپیس ٹھیک ئے ادا ٹھیک ئے ٹھیک تو کننگوس کنا ایتا ملمکیس
en: He doesn't dare mention your name. But from now on, don't fight with Parvez, and don't mention his name. Okay, brother, okay. Okay, then, do as I say and don't [unclear] my word.
en_old: He doesn't know our name. From now on don't fight with Parvez, and don't mention his name. Okay brother, okay. Okay, I'll do as you say, just don't say anything more.

brh: ہانے زو انتئے دا خفہ پریشان او سرا سوچا تچیسو خیر؟ ئے دا سوچا زیٹ اوٹ ارا دے پرویز خلیفہ کسیفے وی نی پرویز انتئے اکھے کسیفیسے؟ او نی ہم مسکین نئے گواہی تیک نئے خلاف نئے پی
en: Hey Niazo, why are you so upset and worried, sitting lost in thought? Is everything all right? I'm caught up in this thought: two days ago Parvez had Khalifa killed. Why did Parvez have him killed? He was a poor man too. He'll testify against you.
en_old: Niazo, why are you so upset and worried, sitting here thinking? Is everything okay? Brother, this is what I'm thinking about: two days ago Parvez had Khalifa beaten. Why did you get Parvez to beat him? He's a poor man too. He'll testify against you.

brh: نئے کسے او پائے کہ، اکرام چپنگا دیر آن خلے، ہنا چپنگا بندغ بش مریک، پگہ نا دے ننا کاٹمے کنے، نئے تو نی خوامخواہ خلے سو او ننا ہچ کننگ کپک، او تو کنے سما ہی او ننا ہچ کننگ کپک، لیکن کا نی او سبق ئس تننگ آتے، ٹھیک ہی ابان کے پاس، کا نی دا سبق ئس نشان تننگ آتے گڑا
en: Someone told you that Ikram was beaten by somebody unknown, that this hidden man will rise up and one day come after our heads, so you beat him for no reason. He can't do anything to us; I know he can't do anything to us. But go, you have to teach him a lesson. Okay, [unclear]. Go, then, and teach him a lesson he won't forget.
en_old: Someone told me that Ikram hit him from behind. Someone from behind will rise up, and tomorrow they'll cut us down. You beat him for no reason. He can't do anything to us, I know he can't do anything to us. But now you have to teach him a lesson. Okay, go to Dad. Now you have to show him this lesson.

brh: کنا ایلم خیر تارے نوئے؟ اڑے ننے آ تو خیر نا خیر افینوں۔ کنا ایلم آخر انت مس؟ متنے توچ ہینو آ نا اڑے کسیفی پانے۔ کنا اینتہ خلیس کنا انت خطا ئے نی ئنا وجہن خلیوے نا چ خطا اسف۔ ادائی غریبہ بندغ
en: My brother, is everything all right or not? Hey, for us there's no well-being at all. My brother, what finally happened? [Unclear] they say he had him killed. Why did you beat me? What's my fault? You're beating me for no reason; I've done nothing wrong at all. Brother, I'm a poor man.
en_old: My brother, is everything okay? Hey, nothing is okay for us. My brother, what finally happened? ...they had him beaten, they say. Why did you beat me? What did I do wrong? You beat me for no reason, I've done nothing wrong. Brother, I'm a poor man.

brh: دا غسل ناجائز کپہ بو کنے خلفہ بو، ئے دکاسے تو ناجائز کتوٹ لیکن اینو جائز کیو نی خلفے بے، بس کدا نی
en: Don't commit this injustice, don't beat me. I've never done anything unjust until now, but today I'll do what's right: you, beat him! Just do it.
en_old: Don't do this injustice, don't have me beaten. I never did anything wrong before, but today I'll do it. Beat him. That's enough now.

brh: شاباش خلقس، نی ہڑے سے دا مرگم مریک! اڑے اینو نا عید ء تکی کلونگ کیوے
en: Well done, you hit him! You're crazy, he's going to die! Hey, today I'll celebrate Eid [unclear].
en_old: Well done, you beat him! You... he's going to die! Hey, today we'll celebrate Eid.

brh: میر صاحب خیر تو رے نی گن ایندے کے خلکوس؟ ارے نیازو نی کے مخلوق غلے سگڑ اینا غلپر جی کے ونے۔ میر صاحب ئے دادے خل
en: Mir sahib, is everything all right? Why did you hit me today? Hey Niazo, you [unclear: people...]. Mir sahib, beat this one!
en_old: Mir sahib, is everything okay? Why did you call for me today? Yes, Niazo, ...people... Mir sahib, beat this one.

brh: ہلنگ اللہ وٹ خوجہ، ئے دا تو مسخرہ کننگ اسوٹ، انتئے کہ دا کنا باز مست نا پرانا مٹاو سنگت ئس ارے نیاڑو ئے نیار آخر پٹیٹ ہم تو نی تو مسخرہ کیٹ، پرویز برکات
en: By God, sir, I was only joking, because he's a very old friend of mine from long ago. Niazo, [unclear] after all, I'm only joking with you, Parvez [unclear].
en_old: Go on, by God, sir, I was only joking, because he is a very old friend of mine from way back. Even after all this time, you're joking with me, Pervez Barkat.

brh: اڑے نزو بر دا سکان کرس کٹے اینو تو کٹ کتے وٹ لیکن دا دے مونا زندے لے پرے۔ ہا ٹھیک ہی بر دا سکان۔
en: Hey Niazo, come here, come over here. Today I didn't give you a beating, but from this day on I won't spare your life. Yes, okay, come here.
en_old: Hey, come closer, come over here. Today you haven't been beaten, but from now on watch out for your life. Okay, fine, come here.

brh: خیر ئے پرویز نیا تو نیم تکی خلکتے میر صاحب سما کپڑن تکی خلنگس تو کڈ پٹ تو باری ٹی مسخرہ کننگس مسخرہ کریکے یا نہ جائی خلنگس میر صاحب او کنے تو جائی خلنگس خیر دا وار نا تو بچاوا مونا واری نا کانہ اللہ
en: Is everything all right, Parvez? You only half hit Niazo. Mir sahib, I don't get it: were you really hitting him, or were you joking in the middle of the beating? Were you joking, or really hitting? Mir sahib, he really did hit me. Well, this time you've been spared, but next time, by God...
en_old: Well, Pervez, you've been beaten up. Mir sahib, I don't know, he got beaten up. Then in turn he was joking. Was he joking or did he really get hit? Mir sahib, he really hit me. Well, this time you were saved, but next time, God willing...

brh: خیرہ کہ کل اللہ جوان کیک پش مکن
en: Never mind, God will make everything right; don't be broken up about it.
en_old: Well, God makes everything right, don't be upset.

brh: ادا اراکے گپ للی سبننگورے
en: Brother, a word [unclear]; are you listening?
en_old: There's a matter here, listen up.

brh: ایڑو دا ئے زرے تفتا کہ ننا راگہ بننگ اڑے نیازو ونت مسک ایڑو ننا موڑ تولو کسو نا پرویز بس اڑے فیز ننا انت ننا خلکون تے میر بس کنے لغت چسول کنے جوان کرے نی میر خلک ئے نمے ٹم باری ٹنے پرویز تڑف پتی
en: Sister, here's the thing: as we were coming along the road, hey Niazo, what happened? Sister, [unclear] Parvez came. Hey, what did we [unclear]? Mir came and kicked me; he really did me a favour. Mir hit you, and next time Parvez will cut you down.
en_old: Brother, this is the thing: when our turn came, hey Niazo, what happened? Brother, our... Pervez came. Hey, what did we hit? Mir came and kicked me. You did well by me. Mir hit you, and next time Pervez will knock you down.

brh: او مسن پیرن ملک خنباری تند چدند کونی کک نی او تند چنگ کروسک یس گرو کونی تو جنگ کتنے ضرور نی ہر کتس کرینوس کہ میر نی خل کونی میر نی لغتس خل کونی کنا توس بیگ میر نی مچسم خلاصک گڑا
en: He... [unclear] ...you would surely have fought. Whatever you had done, Mir would have hit you, Mir would have kicked you, [unclear] Mir would have punched you, then.
en_old: He... in the market... (partly unintelligible) ...you'd definitely have fought. Whatever you did, Mir would have hit you, Mir would have kicked you. My... Mir would have punched you all over, then.

brh: کنا اوس یخ مسکے گل خان نی دان پاننگٹوس میر دادے لغتس خلک نی وفاداری دا مچ ئس خلوسس ادا میر کلنا میری میر کلنا بلائی دا غلطی ئس کرے کہ میر دادے لغتس خلک نی نہ تو میر دادے انت کن
en: My heart has cooled. Gul Khan, you keep saying Mir kicked this one; out of loyalty you would have thrown a punch. Brother, Mir is everyone's chief, Mir is above everyone, and he made a mistake when he kicked this one. Otherwise, why would Mir [do that to] him?
en_old: My... got cold, Gul Khan. You keep saying Mir kicked him. Out of loyalty you threw a punch. Here Mir, above all Mir, above all... made a mistake when Mir kicked him. You... no, then why would Mir...

brh: دیر تو خنے خلک سئی کرے بلائی اوڑا پرویز خنے خلپن نین پاسے ادا او دینت خلیس او غریب ننا دہشتن خلیک او نی کسے بائیک ئے بے تسلی کبو او نی پنجے تینٹ بینن
en: Whoever hit you did the right thing. Above all, Parvez didn't hit you over there, [unclear]. Brother, why did you hit him? That poor man is terrified of us. And you, don't harass anyone's bike, and keep your fist to yourself.
en_old: For a long time he took the beating fine. Above all, Pervez, don't hit him... over here he hit... that poor guy is scaring us. Don't upset anyone's bike, and you, mind your own fist.

brh: ارے چک او نم تڑفپک نم خوامخواہ دے خلیرے دا سرائی با بوکم شاباش شاباش
en: Hey, look, he won't cut you down; you're beating him for no reason. Come on, [unclear]. Well done, well done.
en_old: Hey, they don't knock you down, you're hitting him for no reason. Come on... well done, well done.

brh: سرجان امرے دکان نا کاروبار یا؟ شکر الحمدللہ۔ باز گلاس جوان اشا؟ امرے؟ شکر شکر الحمدللہ۔
en: Sir jan, how is the shop's business? Thanks, praise be to God. Is it going really well? How is it? Thanks, thanks, praise be to God.
en_old: Sarjan, how's the shop business? Thank God, all praise to God. Is it going really well? How is it? Thanks, thanks, all praise to God.

brh: ارے دہ ہزار بیماری ہچ پی نہ ارے یار بیست ہزار بیست و یک ہزار مرے کے ماشاءاللہ ارے خلے نی برنجاتی کڑفس چونا تے بیمار کروس
en: Hey, ten thousand... no illness, nothing like that. Hey man, it comes to twenty thousand, twenty-one thousand, mashallah. Hey, you... with the rice... you'll make the children sick.
en_old: Hey, ten thousand is no illness at all, man. Twenty thousand, twenty-one thousand, God willing. Hey, you... (unintelligible) ...you made them sick.

brh: اڑے او ایزی لوڈرے، ہاؤ میسر، سے روپئی شاوا کنکی، سے روپئی؟ ہاؤ سے روپئی، رنگ ایت کے سدہ باز لوڈ کنے، اڑے نی ایزی لوڈ
en: Hey, is there easyload? Yes, it's available. Put three hundred rupees on for me. Three hundred rupees? Yes, three hundred rupees. Ring it through and load a hundred more for me. Hey, you, easyload...
en_old: Hey, he's the easyload guy. Yes, sir. Can you load three hundred rupees? Three hundred? Yes, three hundred rupees. Give it a ring and load me a hundred. Hey, you, easyload...

brh: او ڈاتی کھرائینو ہندنوں دہ بس آتے عمران خانی دا کنا دوانزدہ ہزار ئے راہی کٹنی یار۔ ٹھیک ہی میر صاحب ایزی لوڈ کیوے کنا کنا تم بس تگڑا۔ ئے یار نی امر کیسہ دوانزدہ ہزارے نن ارا بنگلہ خلکن دوانزدہ ہزار ا ٹھان خراب کے نی کتی فی وی ننے دس کمل
en: He... like this... ten... Imran Khan's... he hasn't sent this twelve thousand of mine, man. Okay, Mir sahib, I'll do the easyload; mine, mine... just a big one. Hey man, how will you manage on twelve thousand? What bungalow have we built with twelve thousand? It spoils the place... you... show us...
en_old: He... (unintelligible) ...these ten buses, Imran Khan's... send my twelve thousand, man. Okay, Mir sahib, do the easyload, mine... just make it strong. Hey man, how will you do twelve thousand? We... twelve thousand... ruin the reputation... you... show us...

brh: ادا پورا دنیا ملنگے کنے کہ ملا گڑا نی نقصان مگے ئے اونیٹ کے سد سے روپئی زی لوڈ کنے اوتھان بعد چونکہ پیسہ بس صحیح ئے ابا ئے سے روپئی زی لوڈ کیو گڑا پانزدہ تنے آٹو صحیح ئے پانزدہ ایتہ ولے ہاں پانزدہ ایٹیسہ گڑا نا بارہ ٹفا وتے ٹھیک ئے بس دوان تزر اینیا نلے بلا ہاں
en: Brother, the whole world is meeting me, so that then you won't suffer a loss... load a hundred, three hundred rupees for me. After that, since the money is just right, okay, I'll load three hundred rupees. Then fifteen... fine, give fifteen. But yes, if you give fifteen, then your twelve... that's fine. That's it... (unclear).
en_old: Here the whole world is... me... then you won't lose anything... load a hundred, three hundred rupees easyload for me. After that, since the money came, okay, father, I'll load three hundred rupees. Then fifteen, okay, give fifteen. But yes, if you're giving fifteen, then twelve... okay, that's it, twelve... (partly unintelligible)

brh: خبات ملتوس گڑا ملرہ ملپس نا کارم ء نہ نہ گڑا ایلوم نا پاپڑ تے بس سے شاہ کن کہ اوڑے زو کئے ایزی لوڈ کئے اروس نا نیٹوری تما مننگ ادا اوڑے کس واری ایزی لوڈ کپیس سالے ادا نیٹ ڈالر خنے سے وار ننگ
en: If you didn't get the news, then they'll meet... don't meet... your work... no, no. Then brother's papads, just three... so that over there you do the easyload quickly, your network is about to run out. Brother, over there don't do anyone's easyload again... (unclear) three times.
en_old: If you'd got the news, then... no, no, then the brother's papads, just for three... over there do the easyload quickly... the network will finish... here, over there nobody does easyload... (partly unintelligible)

brh: اڑے خلق نی دا سہ بدمعاشن نن مریک ئے وپھٹ بدمعاشی چنکو مرغ مریدے سرومپ مریک تے
en: Hey, people, so now we're the thugs? It happens... thuggery... a little... (unclear).
en_old: Hey people, are we now the thugs? A little chicken's... (partly unintelligible)

brh: نن خننگ اوس کنے بدمعاش نن مرے نہ بابا۔ بس ماش۔ واقعی یار بد تو خننگ اسے ماش دا دکاندار تو پکارے دا سودا کیرے۔ نا خبر اف نی تہ نا کاٹومہ زیادہ وت کننگ اسے ننے ازو بدمعاش
en: You're looking at us... me, a thug? We're not, man. Just stop. Really, man, it looked bad. Stop, this shopkeeper is needed, you're doing business here. You don't know... it's gone to your head too much... us, thugs?
en_old: We're seeing it... am I the thug? No, man. Just stop. Really, man, it's bad to see. Stop it, this shopkeeper called out, he's doing business. You don't know, your head is too big... we're the thugs?

brh: دوئیست کننگوس اڑے مسو سیکھ کنا بدمعاش الکوٹ چار کٹینا گڈار اینا روٹ کنا طاقت نا نی چاوہ خبر اف نی ہم کنا طاقت نا خبر اف کنا طاقت نا خبر مروئی نی ہم کنے دوئیست کننگوس اڑے کنے جوان خبر ئے نا طاقت نا
en: You're testing me! Hey... thug... four... today's... You don't know about my strength. You too don't know about my strength. You ought to know about my strength. You too are testing me! Hey, I know your strength well.
en_old: You're doing two hundred... hey, I learned... I'm the thug... four... (partly unintelligible) ...you don't know my strength. You don't know my strength either. You should know my strength. You're doing two hundred to me too. Hey, I know your strength well.

brh: ئے ہمبرو دے بدمعاش کن تو بدغری کیوے نی صبر کر ئے تینا طاقتے داسہ نشان ایتیوہ یار ننے جنگ آن تکے ہرتو ننا ملک پیسہ انتخواب ہمبو انت ئے جنگ ئے وارہ اٹھواں مسور ئس بدمعاشی کنا ہرتو نی نان پھانڈ پھڑکے ون بس سو بنا ننا توئی
en: Hey friend, one day... for a thug... You be patient, I'll show my strength now, man. ... us from fighting... whenever our country, money, elections... what is that? ...war... the eighth... my thuggery... whenever you... bread... (unclear).
en_old: Hey, one day you'll be dealing with a thug. Be patient, I'll show my strength now. Friend, war has hit us. Whenever our country, money, elections... what is that? It's war's turn... the eighth... bullying... mine. Whenever you... bread... it came, so ours started...

brh: داڑے مغز نا نا کھنگو نا بدمعاش مسنو بس بس داڑے مغز نا کھنگو نا داڑے کھٹ کننگے نمے داڑے بس بس داڑے اینگو مغز نا داڑے خلے وکے ونے ذلیل ارے سنتس کانداسا خلے کنے
en: Here, on the brain... you've become a thug. Enough, enough. Here, on the brain... here you're getting knocked... here, enough, enough. Here... the brain... hit him here... disgraced... hit me...
en_old: You've become a hothead here... enough, enough. Here, with your head... you have to... enough, enough. Hit him on the head... he is disgraced... hit me...

brh: جوان مس یار حاجی صاحبزادہ میڑاس اینو پگ موری آن کاکم بدمعاش مسنو۔ ئے ناخو بدمعاشی ہر بندہ فی ٹھکے کنا خبر اف تا خر
en: Well done, man — Haji's son... nowadays even he has become a thug. I... thuggery... every person... I don't know... (unclear).
en_old: Well done, man, Haji's son... today since the turban... has become a real thug. Hey, your thuggery... every person... I don't know... (partly unintelligible)

brh: کنے آن زیادہ داڑے کسر باز ماشاءاللہ۔ دا کسر باز کنا مونا ہم بربوری کیک صبح نا عید کتوٹی تو بس آسمان ٹی لکنگٹی۔ تینا نیت تے اینو کسر فیٹ چٹ کرٹ ہتو۔
en: Here the road is more than me, mashallah. This road even rivals me to my face. I didn't do Eid in the morning, so it's just climbing up in the sky. Today I finished off my intentions on the road.
en_old: There's more road here than me, mashallah. This road comes up in front of me too. I didn't offer the Eid prayer in the morning, so it's just up in the sky. Today I made my intentions clear on the road.

brh: نی تپہ نمبر سے آ لوٹ بس ئے وار عارضی لوڈ ایلے حاجی صاحب کنا کھاتے ٹی اینو بوتل ئس آتے ئے او کنا بوتل ئس آتے بش تپہ
en: You put it on number three, just once, a temporary load. Haji sahib, today bring a bottle on my account, and bring a bottle for me... (unclear).
en_old: You put it on number one, just once, a temporary load... Haji sahib, today a bottle in my account... and put my bottle...

brh: بٹ ٹھیک ٹھاک نم جوڑ خوش نم ٹھیک ٹھاک اللہ پاک نا احسان نم ٹھیک ٹھاک اکبر بروہی خنپنو دے بس خانی سے تینا مصیبت ئے ہاؤ اچھا بٹ ٹھیک ٹھاک شکر نم جوڑ نم ٹھیک ٹھاک
en: Fine, fine. Are you well? Happy? Are you fine? It's the grace of God Almighty. Are you fine? Akbar Brohi, we don't see you for days. Just... everyone has his own troubles. Yes, okay. Fine, fine, thanks. Are you well? Are you fine?
en_old: Fine. Are you well? Happy? Are you fine? Thanks be to Allah. Are you fine? Akbar Brohi, we haven't seen you for days... your troubles... yes, okay, fine, thank God. Are you well? Are you fine?

brh: سلام علیکم، ٹھیک ٹھاک، طبیعت ٹھیک، خیر خیریت، اللہ نا احسان مہربانی، جوڑ ماشاءاللہ، سیو موقع سے بسونو رے، ماشاءاللہ، ہرو بلوچ نا شال، سردار بہادر خان نا ہننگ اٹی، ماشاءاللہ، اونا پروگرام اٹی، ہر ٹیمپورو۔
en: Assalamu alaikum. Fine, in good health, all well, by God's grace and kindness. Well, mashallah. You've come on a good occasion, mashallah, to every Baloch's Shal, going to Sardar Bahadur Khan's, mashallah, to his program... every...
en_old: Peace be upon you. Fine, in good health, all is well, by Allah's grace and kindness. Well, mashallah. We've come on a good occasion, mashallah. Every Baloch's shawl... at Sardar Bahadur Khan's going, mashallah, at his program, every time...

brh: اکبر جانی شالا ہندن ء شادمانی فنی اینو غا دے
en: Akbar jan, God willing, may you have such joy, just like today.
en_old: Akbar jan, may you be happy like this today, God willing.

brh: تینا یار، پل دا تازہ مرے ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ جی باز جوان، بس گڑانگا سے منٹ چائے ئس پی، پی گوسا جی باز باز مہربانی، اللہ نمے خوش تخ، باز باز مہربانی
en: Our own friend. May this flower stay fresh. Mashallah, mashallah. Yes, very good. Just stay a few minutes then and have a cup of tea... Yes, thank you very, very much. May God keep you happy. Thank you very, very much.
en_old: My friend, may it be fresh. Mashallah, mashallah, yes, very good. Just stay a few minutes and have a cup of tea... yes, thank you very much, may Allah keep you happy, thank you very much.

brh: باز مہربانی سنگت آتے، باز جوان ئس تے، باز جوان، زندگی مس ملین انشاءاللہ، انشاءاللہ انشاءاللہ زندگی مس تو ضرور ہم مریرے، پاپا سخی سر سلامت مرے تو، باز، او باز بالکل
en: Thank you very much, friends. It was very good, very good. If we live, we'll meet, God willing. God willing, God willing, if we live, you'll surely be there too. As long as Papa Sakhi stays safe and sound... yes, very much, absolutely.
en_old: Thank you very much, friends, it was very good, very good. If we live, we'll meet, God willing. God willing, God willing, if we live, we surely will. As long as Papa Sakhi is safe and sound... yes, absolutely.

brh: اکرام ئے باز پریشانٹ دعا کر ئنا پرویز برے انو ٹکر کنا تھریٹ کنا دے دعا کر اسوا دوٹی برے او نیاخ
en: Ikram, I'm very worried. Pray that Parvez comes. Today the showdown... my threat... my day. Pray that he falls into my hands just once, oh Niaz.
en_old: Ikram is very worried. Pray that Parvez comes. Today there's a clash, my threat, my day. Pray that he falls into my hands, oh Niaz.

brh: ارے او پرویز
en: Hey, oh Parvez!
en_old: Hey, Parvez!

brh: ہنتسے نیازو؟ ہو اجل ہو ہمہ کنا ایسو ڈیوٹی تے سستے
en: What is it, Niazo? Oh, it's killing me, oh... those duties of mine have worn me out.
en_old: Where did you go, Niazo? Yes, Ajal, yes, my... the duties are tiring.

brh: ارے کنا ایلم اینا دے خواجہ تبر نا دیخانے رے تو
en: Hey my brother, today is Khwaja Tabar's ... day, isn't it?
en_old: Hey my brother, today is Khwaja Tabar's day, isn't it?

brh: بس ایلومن مسرومے خب بس
en: That's it, brother, we're finished. Okay, that's it.
en_old: That's it, brother, we're done... okay, that's it.

brh: میر صاحب
en: Mir sahib.
en_old: Mir sahib.

brh: انتئے دن پریشان ئس سئے کنا پریشان اٹ۔ کنے انو لگیک اندا نیاڑو نا نسدے اسنا دے کڈہ سے ٹی وی ٹی۔ پیسہ والا خیر کے۔
en: Why are you so worried? I'm worried. Today it seems to me that this Niazo's ... one day ... on TV. As for the money, may it be all right.
en_old: Why are you worried? I am worried. Today I feel like this Niazo's... one day... on TV. As for money, it's fine.

brh: ادا نیازو، خیر تورے یانومانے؟ او ادا خیرے، اینو پرویز ننتون اڑے پدی دے، اینو خلقم گٹ آ دے، میر از بسو تورے ننے۔
en: Brother Niazo, is everything all right or not? Oh brother, it's fine. Today Parvez has got tangled up with us again; today the people too are in a bind; Mir has come too, he'll stop us.
en_old: Brother Niazo, is everything okay? Oh brother, it's fine. Today Parvez is stuck with us again. Today the people... Mir has come to stop us.

brh: ارے چاکو رکٹ ئے نمے دے پارٹ کہ پرویز احمد اوڑا مروڑ چرینگو نی ولئے نا سورتو جنگ کریس ایلو گندو اوڑا مروڑ نو برک تیر نندو نڈے فک چننگے ننا مرو کیناک ارے نیاز و نی خاخر لکھی فوگو کٹنا سیوس ئے
en: Hey Chako, I told you that day that Parvez Ahmed was wandering around over there. You fought with... the other bad one... over there... Hey Niazo, you... fire... (unclear).
en_old: Hey Chako, I told you that day that Parvez Ahmed was wandering around there. You fought... the other one... over there... Hey Niazo, you finally...

brh: ئے غریب تو ملخ تیل کننگے، اینی تو نمر نفوئی تنے، خوامخواہ نی تینے اور تو ننے فینوس، ادا گل خان داسا گڑا امر کین، ادا نومے چم پستمے، داسا کامبو، میڑس کینتہ پین امر کین
en: I, poor me... (unclear)... For no reason you've landed yourself and us too in this. Brother Gul Khan, what do we do now? Brother... (unclear). Now go, let's make a settlement plea to him; how else can we do it?
en_old: Hey, poor man, the country's oil is being taken. You won't... For no reason you... us. Brother Gul Khan, what do we do now? Brother... now what? How else can we manage?

brh: میر صاحب نی دا بندغاتے نرف، اچھا، امید ئے نی پاس کیک دا نیازوئے
en: Mir sahib, drive these people away. Okay. I hope you'll let this Niazo pass.
en_old: Mir sahib, don't you recognize these people? Okay, I hope you'll let this Niazo pass.

brh: کنا کاٹم نا سفت کن
en: Praise my head.
en_old: For the praise of my head

brh: پرویز ایلومن مسنے، نیاز و اکرام خلخور کنے، نیاز و اکرام نا دا مجال؟
en: Parvez, brother, it has happened: Niaz and Ikram beat me. Do Niaz and Ikram have this much nerve?
en_old: Pervez, you've become my brother. Niaz and Ikram beat me. How dare Niaz and Ikram?

brh: میر صاحب اینو کنے نازوئے اور اکرام ء زند الے پرے۔ جمال نی حوصلہ کر کنا سائیستے سائی اوفتے سمجھائفنے۔ اگر سمجھتوس نن اوفتے جوان سمجھائفنے۔ ٹھیک ہی میر صاحب نی بلا ہوس اندس کے پاس سئی ہی
en: Mir Sahib, today I won't leave Niazo and Ikram alive. Jamal, be patient, my dear; I'll make them understand. If they don't understand, we'll make them understand properly. All right, Mir Sahib, you are the elder; whatever you say is right.
en_old: Mir Sahib, today Nazo and Ikram have made my life miserable. Jamal, be patient, I'll make them understand. If they understand, we'll explain things to them properly. All right, Mir Sahib, you're right.

brh: راہی مبو مسیت آ جنت مسیت اٹی ئے راہی مبو مسیت آ جنت مسیت اٹی
en: Set out for the mosque; paradise is in the mosque. Set out for the mosque; paradise is in the mosque.
en_old: Don't stray from the mosque, paradise is in the mosque. Don't stray from the mosque, paradise is in the mosque.

brh: سچی ئے اللہ تو عید گپنا نعمت مسیتی سچی ئے اللہ تو عید گپنا نعمت مسیتی سچی ئے
en: It's true, by God: the blessing of the Eid gathering is in the mosque. It's true, by God: the blessing of the Eid gathering is in the mosque. It's true.
en_old: Truly, by God, Eid has become a great blessing. Truly, by God, Eid has become a great blessing. Truly.

brh: جوان ئے دیلمو دیلم نی بسس کنے نا ڈٹ ما
en: It's good, brother; brother, you've come. Stay by my side.
en_old: Good, brother, brother, you came to me.

brh: باز ضرورت ئس کنا ایلم، نی ازل خدا ایچ کپک، اسہ چک ئس خلنگ کپک، ئے بنگنٹ نی مونٹ اسہ ڈیک ئس ہم گڈے خلیسہ، پگہ ئے نکھرے چلتن نا مچ شکار کے دیو۔
en: It was badly needed, my brother. You, by God, from the very start you can't do anything; you can't even shoot a single bird, yet I heard you'd even shoot a deer right in front of you. Tomorrow, [let's go] hunting on Chiltan mountain.
en_old: It's really needed, my brother. You, God never... you can't even hit a single bird, and yet you'd hit a big one too. Tomorrow, come out and let's go hunting in the mountains of Chiltan.

brh: ارے نی دا لفنگاتے تون ہرانگ اینانوس؟ گل خان دا تے نن تینتو دریسون نی ناراض مفے۔ است نا فائدہ تو زکوۃ خلینگ نمتے۔ نیازو نی تو اینو اصلی لیپرے۔ خلپیس خلپیس ایلومی۔ ہمارک نی ایلومی اینو ختار۔
en: Hey, where have you gone off to with these hooligans? Gul Khan, we took them along with us; don't you be upset. The benefit of the heart [...] giving zakat [...]. Niazo, today you are really [...]. Don't hit, don't hit, brother. [...] you, brother, today [...].
en_old: Hey, where are you going with these scoundrels? Gul Khan, we'll keep them with us, don't be angry. What good is the heart... Niazo, today you're the real one. Don't hit, don't hit, brother. Brother, today you...

brh: دا اسکہ نی گنے خلیس ئے؟ ارے نی دسکا خطا کتنس، ارے دا اسلحہ سے تو پرویز توڑے فرستینے، ایلوم بھروسہ کر ئے اوڑتون ہڈے فرستینہ او تینٹ کنتون ہڈے فرستینہ۔ داسہ کنا مغز ء کم پاپو، ایلوم دین محمد بازوری ہم بسونے، کان بو، چلتن نا مش آ شکار کینہ گڈ ئس ہلی۔
en: Did you hit him this much? Hey, haven't you made such a big mistake? Hey, we'll send this weapon along with Parvez. Brother, trust me, we'll send it with him, and he himself [will send it back] with me. Right now my head isn't working. Brother, Din Muhammad Bazori has come too. Let's go, we'll hunt on Chiltan mountain and bag a deer.
en_old: Was it you who hit him like this? Hey, you made a mistake. Hey, Pervez will send this weapon along. Brother, trust me, he'll send it along with him, and he himself will send it along with me. My brain isn't working right now. Brother, Din Muhammad Bazori has come too. Let's go, we'll hunt on the Chiltan mountain and bag something.

brh: پیر صاحب خیر تورے خیرٹ بسس
en: Pir Sahib, is all well? Welcome; you've come in peace.
en_old: Pir Sahib, welcome, I hope you arrived well.

brh: ادا دا نیازو ٹھہنگف پرویزے نا والا خلکو نی میر صاحب اوکے پرویزی خلکو نی اور ہردے خلک تے جمال خان اگر کنا ہیتے ہلیرے تو دا بندغیں بو خان
en: Here, this Niazo won't settle down: he hit Parvez, Mir Sahib; he hit Parvez, and he beats him every day. Jamal Khan, if you accept my word, then this man [...] Khan.
en_old: Here, this Niazo... hit Pervez... you hit him, Mir Sahib, you hit Pervez, and whoever hits... Jamal Khan, if you listen to me, then this person, Khan...

brh: اکبر ایلم ہندا عیدء ئے امیرء پارٹء لیکن امیر کنے اجازت تتوکہ ہینو نی ہم پا امیرء اگر کنے اجازت ایتئے ئے داسہ کنے اونٹء
en: Akbar, brother, this very Eid I told Amir, but Amir wouldn't give me permission. Today you tell Amir too: if he gives me permission, then I'll go now.
en_old: Akbar, brother, this Eid... Amir's party, but Amir didn't give me permission. Today you tell Amir too: if he gives me permission, I'll go now.

brh: جمال نی دا ایتا تے کریس کنا ایتا کا منار۔ میر صاحب نی جمالے اجازت ایتے کہ انو جمال کائے نیازونا دو تے ٹانگاتے خلے پرغے کہ اونا ایلم
en: Jamal, you have said these things; my words [...]. Mir Sahib, give Jamal permission so that today Jamal can go and break Niazo's arms and legs, because his brother...
en_old: Jamal, you did these things, my things... Mir Sahib, give Jamal permission so that today Jamal can go and break Niazo's arms and legs, because his brother...

brh: گلو ہم یاد کے نا بابا چنگا مگڑا سوف حوصلہ ہی حوصلہ ہی ٹھیک ہی میر صاحب انتس کہ نی پاسہ کہ نی پاسہ حوصلہ تو حوصلہ نن نی آن گدرینپنہ نی پہ اللہ و انتس کہ پاس نن ہمون کینہ میر صاحب اگر کہ نی اجازت
en: Gullu, remember your father too [...]. Patience, just patience. All right, Mir Sahib, whatever you say; if you say patience, then patience. We won't go against you. By God, whatever you say, we'll do exactly that. Mir Sahib, if you [give] permission...
en_old: Gullu remembers too, father... patience, just patience, that's fine. Mir Sahib, whatever you say: if you say be patient, then we'll be patient. We won't go against you. By God, whatever you say, we'll do it. Mir Sahib, if you permit...

brh: دے تسے او ہربائی نا ئے اینو نکے اردو کے کھرک ایوے نہ بائے نہ نہ دوں کپیس جمال میر صاحب منع کننگٹی ئے تو میر صاحب نا ہیت ئے ہلوئی ئے سمجھاس کہ نی اکبر
en: [...] today [...] no, no, no, don't do that, Jamal. Mir Sahib is forbidding it, so Mir Sahib's word must be accepted. Understand that you, Akbar...
en_old: ...gave, he... today... Jamal, Mir Sahib is forbidding it, so Mir Sahib's word has to be obeyed. Explain it to Akbar...

brh: کنے اجازت دے۔ ٹھیک مرزا صاحب۔ ٹھیک مرزا صاحب۔ خدا حافظ۔
en: Give me leave. All right, Mirza Sahib. All right, Mirza Sahib. Goodbye.
en_old: Give me leave. All right, Mirza Sahib. All right, Mirza Sahib. Goodbye.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ دعا خیر، خیریت، ٹھیک ٹھاک، جوڑ، وڈ، تکڑا۔
en: Peace be upon you. Greetings and good wishes: well-being, all fine, healthy, well, strong.
en_old: Peace be upon you. Prayers, wellbeing, all fine, healthy, well, strong.

brh: خوش کنے اللہ والا جوڑ برتکڑا، جوڑ برتکڑا، ٹھیک ٹھاک، جوڑ برتکڑا، مہربانی مہربانی، ملا صاحب خیریت بسرے، او خیریت بسرے، جمال خان نا مسئلہ اللہ حل کرے، جمال خان نما نا مسئلہ
en: Happy, by God's grace; healthy and strong, healthy and strong, all fine, healthy and strong. Thank you, thank you. Mulla Sahib, welcome, you've come in good health; oh, welcome. May God solve Jamal Khan's problem; Jamal Khan, your problem.
en_old: Happy. May God keep you healthy and strong, healthy and strong, all fine, healthy and strong. Thank you, thank you. Mulla Sahib, may you come in good health. May you come in good health. May God solve Jamal Khan's problem, your problem, Jamal Khan.

brh: او سائیں نی ہم خبر ارے گل خان نا ایلم نیازو اور ننا ایلم تو اڑے فک دینی پرویز تو یکا خلک تے اندا دے پوکھر او جمال خان دا مسئلہ نا کنے خبر ارے گل خان نی اخوا اسفند او بریک ئے جوان پوکھر سائیں اینا دے پوکھرک دا وار پیری تے دا وار لٹی تے اینا ورتی
en: Oh sir, you know too: Gul Khan's brother Niazo and our brother Parvez [are at odds]; he is always hitting Parvez [...] that same day [...]. Oh Jamal Khan, I know about this problem. Gul Khan, [where is] Asfand? He's coming. Make him understand properly, sir. Make him understand today; this time [...], this time with sticks [...].
en_old: Oh sir, you know too that Gul Khan's brother Niazo and our brother Parvez are always fighting each other. They fought today as well. Jamal Khan, I know about this problem. Gul Khan, where is Asfand? He's coming. They fought, sir. Today they fought. This time they hit the elders, this time with sticks...

brh: جوان اف۔ ٹھیک ئے میر سلیم او برے ئے اودے جوان پوہ کیو۔ سئیں اودے نی پوہ کرک، دا مارے ہمیشہ پریت اٹ لٹ اٹ ہڈی مسنے، شست کر، ارے پوہ کفوک افک ہم، سمجھائف تے مہربانی کر دا مسئلہ حل کرک جوانی اٹ حل مرے تو جوان ئے آدم خان؟
en: That's not good. All right, Mir Salim, he's coming; I'll make him understand properly. Sir, you make him understand: this boy has always been used to [fighting] with [...] and with sticks. [...] Hey, they don't even understand; make them understand. Please solve this problem; if it's resolved amicably, that's good, isn't it, Adam Khan?
en_old: That's not good. All right, Mir Salim, he's coming, explain things to him properly. Sir, you explain it to him. This boy is always fighting with sticks, breaking bones... Explain it to them. Please solve this problem. If it's settled peacefully, that's good, isn't it, Adam Khan?

brh: بے فکر بے۔ گل خان اتکا مٹائٹی اسل۔ سائیں مہربانی کبو تاتی بو کبو داس بلو قدم ہرفنگ غلطو۔ او میر صاحب، ما ہیا جوانی اٹ سمجھائناٹ۔
en: Don't worry. Gul Khan, [...] very [...]. Sir, please [...]; taking such a big step is wrong. Oh Mir Sahib, I explained it to him nicely.
en_old: Don't worry. Gul Khan... Sir, please... taking such a big step is wrong. Oh Mir Sahib, I've explained it to him nicely.

brh: اسلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace.

brh: گل خان، آخر تئی چے مرضی ہنی؟ تئی برات پرویز آ گون ہر روچی جھگڑا کننگ ہنی۔
en: Gul Khan, what do you want, after all? Your brother quarrels with Parvez every day.
en_old: Gul Khan, what do you actually want? You fight with your brother Parvez every day.

brh: آخر تئی براثا چے تکلیف ئے سائی مئی براتا کمی دماغ سہی نی ت ناراض نوابی۔ سائیں خو ناراض مفک؟ کنا ایلم مردے پرویز لٹھ تے کونا، ایلم خو ناراض مریک۔ آدم خان تینا گنوکے تینٹ سمجھائف کہ بندہ دے اودے لخا لگفینوس بس۔ آدم خان لالا ئے اودے باز سمجھائفٹ اور
en: After all, what is your brother's problem? Sir, my brother's mind is a little off; don't you be upset. Sir, how could one not be upset? My brother takes a beating from Parvez's sticks; any brother would be upset. Adam Khan, make your madman understand yourself, or one day someone will land a blow on him, that's all. Adam Khan, brother, I've explained it to him a lot, and...
en_old: What is your brother's problem, after all, sir? My brother isn't quite right in the head, don't be upset with him. Sir, how could I not be upset? My brother is a man, and Parvez beats him with sticks. Any brother would be upset. Adam Khan, explain things to your madman yourself, or one day someone will slap him, that's all. Adam Khan, brother, I've explained it to him many times, and...

brh: ئے دا سودا جوانیٹ سمجھائفے وی نم ناراض مفبو۔ او خا نن ناراض مفنو مگر نی او جوان سمجھائفتی۔ جی او ملک صاحب ئے او دے جوان سمجھائفینٹ لیکن دا وار نی ئے او دے جوان چھتتے وی نم دانگوت چھتتے تیرے ننا بےخی کشاو۔ پرویز جان نی بس خاندان و بو۔
en: I'll make this crazy one understand properly so that you won't be upset. Oh, well, we won't be upset, but you make him understand properly. Yes, Malik Sahib, I have made him understand well, but this time if you don't [restrain] him properly, if you [leave] him like this, he'll tear out our roots. Parvez dear, just behave like family.
en_old: Explain this matter properly so that you won't be upset. Yes, we won't be upset, but you explain it to him well. Yes, Malik Sahib, I've explained it to him well, but if this time you don't deal with him properly... Parvez dear, just stay with the family.

brh: بندہ غسس، اگدا وار نلو دا جوان خلیوے ونا سلے کشیوے، ایت باز مس آخری وار پاننگوٹے، ایت داڑان پدی تو ودیک، جیو سائیں بابا اللہ خیر کیک دا کموسٹی انشاءاللہ دون مفک، ٹھیک ہی گل خان دے اجازت ہی خیر لوٹے۔
en: A man [...]: if he doesn't [listen] this time, I'll beat him properly and [...]. It has gone too far; I'm saying it for the last time; after this, it will go further. Yes sir, father, God will make it right; [...] God willing, it won't be like that. All right, Gul Khan, give me leave; farewell.
en_old: Man, if he doesn't listen this time, I'll beat him properly and... It's gone too far. I'm saying it for the last time. After this... Yes sir, father, God will make it right. God willing, it won't happen like that. All right, Gul Khan, give me leave. Goodbye.

brh: جی او سائیں نن دا سہیل آن دعا ئس کر کہ ننا ایلم ء اللہ پاک ہدایت کے۔ ابا نن خود دعا کینہ تینا ایلم ء ہدایت کیس۔
en: Yes sir, say a prayer for us [from Sohail?] that God Almighty guides our brother. Father, we ourselves will pray that [God] guides our brother.
en_old: Yes sir, we ask Sohail to pray that God guides our brother. Father, we pray ourselves that God guides our brother.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ خیرت اٹ، جوان اٹ، ٹھیک ٹھاک اٹ، خوش اٹ۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. I'm well, I'm good, I'm fine, I'm happy.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. I'm well, good, fine, happy.

brh: سائیں گلفام این پوکریس۔ اکبر خان او دے جوان پوکریس۔ ہاؤ جی۔ سائیں بابا جوان مس کہ او دے پوکریس۔ دانا ایلم باز کھٹ پٹ او بنداس۔ باز ناجائز کننگاٹی۔ دے دے ابش ماما رے لٹیٹ۔ دا توڑ کسے
en: Sir, Gulfam, you made him understand today. Akbar Khan, you made him understand well. Yes, sir. Sir, father, it's good that you made him understand. His brother is a very quarrelsome man. He's doing a lot of wrong. Every day [...] uncle [...] with a stick. This way someone...
en_old: Sir, Gulfam, you explained it today. Akbar Khan, you explained it to him well. Yes. Sir, father, it's good that you explained it to him. His brother is very quarrelsome and stubborn. He does a lot of wrong. Every day he beats uncle... this way, someone...

brh: پیر، اکبر خان! ئے او دے پو کرٹ، اگہ پو متو جمال خان او دے جوان پو کیک۔
en: Pir, Akbar Khan! I've made him understand; if he doesn't understand, Jamal Khan will make him understand properly.
en_old: Pir, Akbar Khan! I've explained it to him. If he doesn't understand, Jamal Khan will make him understand properly.

brh: خلکورے ئے بچیفینوٹ تو انت وجے نیازو نرفیس نی پارے پاتنے ہچ پاتنے نی چاوے نیازو ہچ پاتنے ایلم نی اینو اینا ساخ انت گدا پھڈا کرے دے ایلم ئے تینا حسابٹ بسوٹے دا کرے کنا ایلمی خلکورے اور کرے ئے ہم اوتے خلکوٹ
en: They beat him, and I rescued him. So what is the reason? Did you ask Niazo? You said he didn't say it, he didn't say anything. You know, Niazo didn't say anything. Brother, today you... what was it... then he picked a quarrel that day. Brother, I came on my own account. He did this: they beat my brother, and I beat them too.
en_old: Did I save Khalkore? So what's the reason, Niazo, that you didn't recognize him? You said nothing was said. You know, Niazo, nothing was said. Brother, what fight did you pick today? I came on my own account, brother. My brother Khalkore... I hit them too.

brh: اچھا، میر صاحب نی داڑان ہرف کہ انت قصہ ء بھائی انت وجہ ء انت؟ انت خبر ء انت خنخور ء؟ میر صاحب ئے بسوٹ تینا کسر اٹ اچانک دا غٹ آ خنخور تے خناٹ۔ میر صاحب انت ہندا دے پو کرک پگا نا دے دا کیرے ڈینٹ؟
en: All right, Mir Sahib, ask him what the story is, brother, what the reason is. What's the news, what is this bloodthirsty business? Mir Sahib, I was coming along my own road when suddenly I saw all these bloodthirsty men. Mir Sahib, what, will you make it clear this very day, or [leave it for] tomorrow...?
en_old: Okay, Mir Sahib, ask him what the story is, brother. What's the reason? What's the news, what's this blood? Mir Sahib, I was on my way and suddenly I saw all this blood. Mir Sahib, will you settle this today, or tomorrow?

brh: اندنو خاخرس بش مروئی لیکن کس کیرے دادے کسفنگ کپروئے آباد اللہ خیر کیک نی جذباتی مفہ میر صیب ئے دا جمال استے پاو کرک کہ جذباتی مفس مچے حوصلہ اٹ کار ہمیر اللہ خیر کیک ٹھیک ہی فی الحال اجازت ایوا انشاءاللہ کینہ
en: A fire like this was bound to flare up, but no one will be able to kill him [over it]... God will make it right. Don't you get emotional. Mir Sahib, make this Jamal understand in his heart that he must not get emotional, and do everything with patience. God will make it right. All right, give us leave for now; God willing, we will do [it].
en_old: Such a thing has to come up, but whatever anyone does, nobody should be killed over it. Thank God, God will make it right. Don't get emotional, Mir Sahib. Tell this Jamal not to get emotional. Do everything with patience and calm. God will make it right. Okay, give us leave for now, God willing we will...

brh: ابا خدا حافظ۔ اسلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ میر صاحب امان اللہ۔ خیریت ئے ٹھیک ٹھاک؟ السلام علیکم۔
en: Well, goodbye. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Mir Sahib, God keep you. Is all well, everything fine? Peace be upon you.
en_old: Okay, goodbye. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Mir Sahib Amanullah. Is everything well? All fine? Assalamu alaikum.

brh: ابو انتو خیریت سب ٹھیک ٹھاک جوڑ ہن خیریت سنگت آت جوڑ ہن ٹھیک ٹھاک سب خیریت بندہ ما حیات مرین فخر جوڑ ہن جوڑ ہن تکڑا ہن سب ٹھیک ٹھاک
en: Oh, so is all well? Everything's fine, we're well. All well. Are the friends well? Fine, everything's fine, all well. ...as long as we're alive... proud... We're well, we're well, we're in good health, everything's fine.
en_old: Father, how are you? Is everything fine? Fine, all well. Are the friends well? Everything is fine, all well. As long as we're alive, we're proud. Well, well, strong, all fine.

brh: بے صاحب اینی ئے دا خاطر بسونٹ کنا دا ایلم کرے ہمے دا نادانیز کرے نی دا ایلم تیت پڈا کرے نی اینو بسونٹ نا سیڈا ئے پٹ کنا نا تملن جوان دا داڑ تولوکو
en: Sir, I have come today for this reason: my brother did this, he did this foolish thing. You... this brother... I have come today to your... [unclear]... Fine, sit here.
en_old: Sir, I came today for this reason: my brother did this, he did this foolish thing. Have my brother released. You came today, look into your... my... good, sit here.

brh: نن کڑدہ تیا معذرت کنے کہ بسونن دا سنگت نا فیصلہ نی کیس ایلوم ئے جلاپ ہو کرے کہ ایلوم نا کڑدے دوشنہ کوٹ ٹی دوتننگا ٹی ادا اللہ خیر کیک اللہ خیر کیک بے داخا جذباتی مفے ننے امٹ بسونن اللہ پاک کل جہان کے کنا ایلوم نا درو بندہ غا صف کیک گلو دا ایلوم نا دست
en: We apologize to the gathering for having come. You decide this friend's matter. My brother has been [charged], and my brother's case is to be [brought] before the court on Monday. Brother, God will make it right, God will make it right. Hey, don't get so emotional; that's why we have come. May God Almighty, [Lord] of the whole world, clear my brother of the lies. Gullu, this... my brother's hand...
en_old: We apologize to the elders for coming. You make the decision about this friend. My brother was arrested, and my brother's case is in court on Monday. Brother, God will make it right, God will make it right. Don't get so emotional, that's why we came. May God, Lord of all the worlds, clear my brother of the blame. Gullu, my brother's fate is in your hands.

brh: مستگیر خلکونے دا ایرا واری برے کنا ایلومے خلک دا ہیسکان پاسا کنا ایلوم جوان و بندہ غسے بدمعاش افک ادا چنا مار سے غلطی ئس کرے نی کنا داڑے بسون اگر غلطی کتو کنا داڑے انت کے بسونے گلو دا چنائے پو کرائے ہندونو سبق کس تروتے پگنا دے نی ہم یاد کروسہ ادا
en: Mastgir has beaten him. This is the second time he has hit my brother. Up to now you would say my brother is a good man, not a thug. Brother, he is a young boy, he made a mistake, so you came to me. If he hadn't made a mistake, why would you have come to me? Gullu, make this boy understand. Teach him such a lesson that you'll remember it tomorrow too, brother.
en_old: Mastgir beat him. Come this time. My brother was beaten. Say it from here: my brother is a good man, not a thug. Brother, the boy made a mistake, and that's why you came to me. If he hadn't made a mistake, why would you have come to me? Gullu, tell this boy. Teach someone such a lesson that you will remember it tomorrow too, brother.

brh: پوکنے پوکنے تے، ادا دا نور شت تسنوٹ اراٹی ریڈ تسنوٹ کٹھانوٹ تے، کلہ خدا جوان کے۔ میر صاحب، دا دے پوک اریک، کہ دا ننتو خیر کے، ننداڑا میر صاحب دا جھولی توریوے، ئے تنے علم خلقنوت باز سمجھفینوٹ، اگر دا یقین کپک، ئے دا جور اندازہ شت کشکیوٹ، تینا علم کٹیوے
en: I've explained it to him, explained it to him. Brother, I've given him this stick... I've given... I've [dealt with] them. God makes everything good. Mir Sahib, today it is understood that this will be good for us. Here we are, Mir Sahib, holding out this lap of ours [in supplication]. I have taught him and explained a great deal to him. If he doesn't believe this, I'll [take] the stick to him in good measure... his own learning...
en_old: Tell them, tell them, brother. I gave them this... I gave them a raid, I gathered them. May God make everything right. Mir Sahib, today it is known that this will turn out well for us. Mir Sahib, we are holding out our laps to you here and begging. I taught you knowledge and explained a lot to you. If you don't believe this, I can give you a good estimate. Use your knowledge.

brh: گلو ئے چودھری کیسٹ خیر مفک دادے کنا ایلومے گٹے راوڑی خیر کیو نی تون بس جمال بس ایلوم ننے آ میڑ بسونو میڑ عزت روئے ننے دا ساہ خیر کینے میر صاحب نی اللہ پاک اجر اسیتے ٹھیک ہی میر صاحب
en: Gullu, chaudhry... it won't go well... this... my brother's throat... I'll do right by you. Enough, Jamal, enough. Brother, they have come to us as a peace delegation; honor the peace delegation for our sake. We will say the blessing for this right now. Mir Sahib, may God Almighty reward you. All right, Mir Sahib.
en_old: Gullu, Chaudhry... it isn't good. My brother... God will make it right for you. That's enough, Jamal. Enough, brother. We have come to you as a delegation, honor it. God will make it right for us. Mir Sahib, may God reward you. Okay, Mir Sahib.

brh: صاحب اگر نامرضی ئے تو بس سئی ئے دوتے بڑزا کبو خیر کین۔ دوتے بڑزا کبو۔
en: Sir, if it is your wish, then fine, raise your hands and let's pray for blessing. Raise your hands.
en_old: Sir, if you are willing, then fine, raise your hands and we'll pray. Raise your hands.

brh: ارے گلو مست شہر خلقو سے ورنائی ٹی استانارے یا استدرے نوستا؟ میر صاحب دردک وامر استن کاری واہ گلو وا بیشک نی زندہ دل و بند
en: Hey Gullu, did you recite Mast's [ecstatic] poetry in your youth? Were you [in love] or not? Mir Sahib, the pains... how they [weigh on] the heart... Wow, Gullu, wow! You certainly are a lively, cheerful man.
en_old: Hey Gullu, did you recite poetry in your youth or not? Mir Sahib... Gullu, you are certainly a lively, cheerful man.

brh: میر صاحب گلو زندہ دل و بندغ اسے تو پاتہ گڑا اینو دا محفل اٹی ننے شعر ئس بنفے، گلو سنگت آ تا اوست نا راز ئے گڑا ننے شعر ئس بنفتا، ٹھیک ئے میر صاحب گڑا نا خاطرا اینو اسہ شعر ئس پاوے، گلو گام پک گڑا ایڈے چمن اٹی شعر ئس پا یار، ہازم میر صاحب
en: Mir Sahib: Gullu is a lively man, so [I] said, then today in this gathering let us hear a poem. Gullu, for the sake of the friends' hearts, let us hear a poem. All right, Mir Sahib, then for your sake I'll recite a poem today. Gullu, step forward then and recite a poem here in the garden, friend. Ready, Mir Sahib.
en_old: Mir Sahib said Gullu is a lively, cheerful man, so today in this gathering let him recite a poem for us. Gullu, for the sake of the friends' hearts, recite a poem for us. Okay, Mir Sahib, then for your sake I'll recite a poem today. Gullu, step forward, then recite a poem here in the garden, friend. I'm ready, Mir Sahib.

brh: حاضر
en: At your service.
en_old: At your service.

brh: خنتا کھڑی کا تا دریا وقتس تومروئے خم آخر خنتا کھڑی کا تا دریا وقتس تومروئے خم آخر نا
en: The tears of my eyes have become a river; a time will come when sorrow ends at last. The tears of my eyes have become a river; a time will come when sorrow ends at last...
en_old: My eyes would become a river, a time will come when the sorrow ends at last. My eyes would become a river, a time will come when the sorrow ends at last...

brh: نام تو خڑینک آ خنتیا وہور نام تو خڑینک آ خنتیا وہور ارمان ہزار نا استٹ نی ہم تو آواری کھن سکوس
en: Your name... with the tears of my eyes... Your name... with the tears of my eyes... A thousand longings in my heart: if only you too could have been with me.
en_old: Your name in the tears of my eyes... your name in the tears of my eyes... I had a thousand longings, yet you too could not be with me.

brh: ادا نن میڑہ کینن شیر خلنگ کے تو انت ونے اٹ کس مینی نا شیر خلکو سمینی اڑے چک تو نمے یتمہ
en: Brother, we're making peace here; reciting poetry, what does that have to do with it? Someone recited...'s poem... Hey,... you...
en_old: Brother, we are a delegation. Reciting poetry, what does it mean to us? Someone recited a poem of... Hey, then for you...

brh: دے تو شہر خلکوٹ خوسی نا عالم اسسگے، ایرا اوستوار مسٹ، نمے ناچ کننگ دے برے نم ناچ کریرے، ادا نیکے شہر نا خلکوٹ نن ہم ناچ کرینے، اڑے ناچ کے کریرے دا سبایتنا بند کبو، ادا کامبو آرام کے کمرہ ٹی دے دم درینگانو، ادا کم ناچ
en: So I recited poetry; there was an atmosphere of joy, and then I felt heartened. The day came for you to dance, and you danced. Brother, I recited a poem for fun, and we danced too. Hey, why are you dancing? Stop this [till morning]. Brother, go and rest in the room for a while, you've gotten tired. Brother, less dancing.
en_old: Today I recited poetry, it was a state of joy, and then I became hopeful. The day will come for you to dance, and you will dance. Brother, I recited poetry for good, and we danced too. Hey, why are you dancing? Stop this until morning. Brother, go rest in the room for a while. Brother, less dancing.

brh: شکروسس، شیر توئی خلکوٹ، نم تینے ہمدا کدم داری فیرے، کمودہ سارم کے
en: Thank you. I recited the poem. You've worn yourselves out with these very [dance] steps; come to your senses a little.
en_old: Thank you. I recited the poem. You also keep yourselves steady like this, take care.

brh: حفیظ ایلو زو کا پکوڑاک تیار ک پکوڑاس کونیرک۔ او ایلم پکوڑاک م تیار بننگ اٹی مسٹ منٹ سالے مٹ۔
en: Hafeez, quickly get more pakoras ready; [they'll] eat some pakoras. Oh brother, the pakoras are being made; wait a minute.
en_old: Hafeez, prepare more pakoras, bring some pakoras. Brother, the pakoras are being prepared, just a minute.

brh: آئی لو مکس پکوڑا بھائی۔ ادا پکوڑا نا سیر اسٹ ایت۔
en: I love mixed pakoras, brother. Brother, give me a seer of pakoras.
en_old: I love mixed pakoras, brother. Here, give me one ser of pakoras.

brh: دا چوٹو دا فدا ریڈیو اسٹیشن ء۔
en: This Chotu... this is Fida Radio Station.
en_old: Look, this is Fida radio station.

brh: اکرام، کانگے سیر کریٹ؟ نازو، کلے تا کنگوس، ہمے سیر کپیسے۔ اکرام، معاف کیس، ئے کلے تا کنگوٹ، کنے خبر تمتہ، باز بینگو مسوٹ۔
en: Ikram: Have I eaten my fill? Nazo: You ate everyone's share and you're still not full? Ikram: Forgive me, I ate everyone's share. I didn't realize; I'd gotten very hungry.
en_old: Ikram: Did you get full? Nazo: I ate everyone's share and I'm still not full. Ikram: Sorry, I ate everyone's share. I didn't realize, I was very hungry.

brh: کنے ابا شخیسک ہا ایلم پیسہ وتو پگہ تینا لباسے ہفتاد وار کنے اوڑے جک کفا پگہ پگہ ایلم نیاز و ارادے کنے اوڑے پیسہ کسے پاتنے ہمیتو نی ہم ارخوسینے بکا نی گرام یار دا عجیب و غریب
en: My father... [to] me... yes, brother, money... tomorrow his clothes... weekly... [nonsense] there for me... tomorrow, tomorrow, brother, Niazo's intention... he hasn't told me there's any money there. So you too... friend, this is strange and bizarre.
en_old: Brother, my father gives me money, and then tomorrow his weekly... over there... tomorrow, brother, Niaz and Irada gave me money there, so you too are... what a strange and bizarre thing, friend.

brh: او ننا کو پیسہ متیپہ سنو کاری دا نیاز و اسے دا کا کسیٹ نا لیر ضرور دا صبا باز بے کسر و بندغ اسے
en: He doesn't give us money... This Niazo is one who... this... the cassette's... for sure. This [Saba?] is a very wayward person.
en_old: He doesn't give us money... this Niaz... the lyrics of this cassette for sure... this Saba is a very lost, aimless person.

brh: ارے پرویز جی نی اولا ہم پارے داسہ ہم پارے مونو ننہ ایزو مونو ننہ ایزو مونو خوسے ئے تو اوڑان باز مونو ٹھوکن تو باز تینٹ اڑے میر صاحب سہی پارینگنے ایلو دا مونو خوسہ مرے مونو کتخہ مرے کوشش کہ داڑن تینے بچف ئے اوڑ توڑپفر
en: Hey Pervez ji, you said it before too, and you're saying it now too: Mono... Mono... Mono is [happy]... then from her a lot... Mono... a lot... Hey, Mir Sahib, that's rightly said. Brother, whether this Mono is [pleased] or Mono is [upset], try to save yourself from this and [break away] from her.
en_old: Hey Pervez ji, you said it before and you're saying it now too... Mir Sahib, that's rightly said. The other one... try to save yourself from this and break away from them.

brh: او کنا گوازی تنے ٹھنڈے سے اللہ خیر کے او وقار
en: Oh, my game... [gone] cold for you... May God make it well, oh Waqar.
en_old: Oh my... may God grant goodness, oh Waqar.

brh: ارے نا بادی شاہی نا دے تخان ئس کسر نا زی آ
en: Hey, is it the day of your kingship, a [throne] on top of the road?
en_old: Hey, may your reign last long... on the road.

brh: ایم بئیلم کسر یلئے، کسر تو یلئے نی کسر الکوسٹئے، ایلو کسر نوائے لے ایم بہ زیادہ ہیت کپو، ارے نی کنے پاننگ نی ہزو زیادہ ہیت کپے
en: Hey brother, clear the road; just clear the road! You've taken over the road... the other road, no way... Hey, don't talk too much. Hey, you're telling me not to talk too much?
en_old: Brother, leave the road. Just leave the road, you've taken the road, the other road is new... brother, I won't talk too much. Hey, you're telling me not to talk too much?

brh: مسکہ دا سلے تہو بڈنگا سلے خلنگو
en: Maska, stand here... stand to bat, stand to strike.
en_old: Maska, stand firm here and get ready to strike.

brh: بس کدا اسین داسلے، فرش بوس کریس، اکرام فرش تو بوس مننگ اف لیکن پرویز ئے ضرور بوس کیوے
