en: Enough... now. You kissed the floor. Ikram, the floor is not for kissing, but I will certainly kiss Parvez.
en_old: That's enough for now. Kiss the floor. Ikram, never mind the floor, but you will definitely kiss Parvez's feet.

brh: اڑے منج کاٹمی، نی اللہ خلیدے گندے گینئے کتیتو۔ نا وجگان سیدنا بیٹھے کٹینو۔ میر ملک، عبدالخان دا کل کنے کئی سوال جواب آتے کیرے۔ ئے رنا سٹم جواب اتیفتہ۔ ایلو مخ رن وجگان۔
en: Hey, you blockhead, by God you have done a bad thing. Because of you, [our] ... has been cut down. Mir Malik, Abdul Khan, all of these put many questions to me, and I could not give any answer. Brother, it is because of you.
en_old: Hey, you idiot, damn you, you've made a mess of things. Because of you, our leader's honour was cut down. Mir Malik, Abdul Khan, all of them question me, and I couldn't give them any answers. The rest is because of you.

brh: وچکونے کاٹم مینا ئے نیٹ ورک بائٹنا پرویز توڑیف پتی نی چڑ بیری کے چہ کسو غریب تو جنگ کیسی ایلم اگر ئے اودا خلپر کسے فر اونا نا خلاف ہیت کیکک۔ ننا پتی کلے پاش کیک۔ نی خبر کے بدمعاش نا
en: ... the network... Parvez, you broke [it]. Don't you know that when you pick a fight with some poor man, brother, if I don't hit him there, then he will speak out against you? He will expose all of our honour. You know, the thug's...
en_old: Why did you break Parvez's network? Don't you know that if you fight with some poor person, brother, and someone gets hit there, then people speak out against him? It exposes all of us. Don't you know about the thug?

brh: دا خون نا گواہ او دے۔ ارے بے وقوف بدمعاشی تون ئے خلکوس۔ ایرا بندغ کورٹ تون اوار اسورے۔ نانٹ خالی او گواہی ٹی بسے۔ ایلم او بندغا جرات اف نیازوس نا خلاف ہیت کیرے۔ او مئے ہیت کتے او اسپتال آن ہیت کرو ننتو۔ او غرق کار لیکن ننا پینن پس نیازونا۔
en: He is a witness to this murder. Hey, you fool, you beat him like a thug. Two men were there with the court. Only he came forward as a witness. Brother, those men don't have the courage to speak against Niazo. He hasn't talked; he will talk to us from the hospital. He is done for, but our other business is with Niazo.
en_old: He is the witness to this murder. Hey, you fool, you hit him like a thug. Two men were there at the court. He came forward as a witness on his own. Brother, those people don't have the courage to speak against Niaz. He didn't talk; he talked to us from the hospital. He's done for, but our case is against Niaz.

brh: بے وقوف کنے خبر ئے کہ اونا پین الپ سے۔ پنجاہ واری تنے پرویز توڑے فیس توڑے ننے پخال پدنے اوتے دے خلسی۔ اوہم تونا پین الپک۔ ایلوم کنے ازو ننے گان توخ بفک دا بندہ دے اسینا دے ئس ننا کاٹم او خورئی کہ کناڑ کے غا
en: Fool, I know that he won't mention your name. Fifty times Parvez himself has been broken... and you beat them... He won't mention your name either. Brother, we can't sleep over this. One day this man will ... our heads...
en_old: Fool, I know he won't name anyone else. Fifty times Parvez has broken things for us, and then he'll beat them. He won't name you either. Brother, he won't spare us. One day this man will become a headache for us...

brh: نماز خور، او مسکین سسی اسے، ئے رب نہ کنا پن الپاسے، ئے پرویز غریب نا انت پن الو، او تو ملنگ اسے، پرویز نا مونا پنجاہ بندغ ختم او کسے پاپک، بس ٹھیک ایلو میناٹ، الے مستو سئی ہمبل
en: He's a man who says his prayers, a poor wretch. By God, he won't mention my name. What name would poor Parvez give? He's just a simple malang. Even if fifty men were finished off in front of Parvez, he wouldn't tell anyone. Okay, fine, brother...
en_old: He's a poor wretch who lives off others. By God, he won't take my name. What name would poor Parvez give? He's just a beggar. Fifty men are finished off in front of Parvez and nobody says a word. Fine, that's it, brother...

brh: سائیں دادے کنا ایلم، گدان کٹارٹ الو، کٹارٹ ریٹ تے سنتے، دا سنم کٹیرے تے یا ایلیرے تے، ننے پاتاو نیلم اٹے داڑے تے، ننے پارے نمے ڈی خلت، کست، مت، کست نمے ڈی مسلے تے، ایلم نی دان گندے
en: Sir, this is my brother. At the tent, with a dagger... whether you cut them down or let them go... they told us here, they told us they would beat you, kill you... Brother, are you this wicked?
en_old: Sir, this is my brother. They took him with a dagger. Whether you kill them or let them go, they told us, here, they told us they would beat you, kill you... Brother, you dirty one...

brh: ایدا خاطرن داڑے ستے کیناو نم ولا بھروسہ کپیرے، نن تو نی آ بھروسہ کینن نی تینٹ بے بھروسہ ء بندغ ئس ارے انت کے سنونے معافی خواجہ انت شاباش، سائیں کنے دا وار معاف کرک ئے ول داؤن غلتی کپرو
en: That's why, here... you will not trust [him] again. We did trust you, but you yourself are an untrustworthy man. What, you've come asking for forgiveness? Well done! — Sir, forgive me this time; I won't make a mistake like this again.
en_old: That's why I'm saying this: you won't be trusted again. We trusted you, but you yourself are an untrustworthy person. Why did you come asking for forgiveness? Well done. Sir, forgive me this time, I won't make such a mistake again.

brh: دا وار نما معاف کریتنے پین وار دونو غلطی کریر تو جند آتے نا کشکوٹ سائی دا وار نما معاف کتے پیندا وار دون کپو نما نثوانی پیرہ بندغ اسیس نما
en: This time I have forgiven you; if you make such a mistake another time, I will take your lives. — Sir, forgive us this time; next time we won't do it like this. Your ... is an old man.
en_old: This time I forgive you, but if you make a mistake like this again, I'll take your lives. Sir, forgive us this time, we won't do it again. Your father is an old man.

brh: دا پدھرا مسٹ کہ نتا دا معافی نا لائق افک۔ سئیں نا باز مہربانی کہ کنا ایلومے معاف کریس۔ ایلومے نا تو معاف کریٹ اگر آئندہ ایلوم نا دنو غلطی کرے ایلوم تون اوار نی ہم لٹکونوس۔ نہ سئیں نہ دا اینو پدھن گپک اگر دن کرے ایدانا لکھے کشکیوے۔ بلکل۔
en: It has become clear that yours is not worthy of this forgiveness. — Sir, thank you very much for forgiving my brother. — I have forgiven your brother, but if your brother ever makes such a mistake again, you too will be hanged along with him. — No sir, no, this will not happen from today on; if he does that, I'll wring his neck. — Absolutely.
en_old: It has become clear that yours does not deserve this forgiveness. Thank you very much, sir, for forgiving my brother. I forgave your brother, but if he ever makes a mistake like this again, you'll be hanged along with him. No sir, it won't happen like this again today; if he does, I'll cut off his hand. Absolutely.

brh: دا باری وتی براثا گم کا جی او سائیں ئے دا دے وی گم کیوے نتو دا معافی نا لائق ہم افو اورنگ خان کنے خبر ء کہ نی دادخواہ جوان ء سمجھدار ئس اور نواب جوان ء بندہ ئس صحیح صحیح اللہ حافظ
en: This time, for the sake of his own brother, I'll let it go; and sir, I will overlook it today too, otherwise this one is not even worthy of forgiveness. Aurang Khan, I know that you are a good and sensible petitioner, and the Nawab is a good man. Right, right. Goodbye.
en_old: This time, for my brother's sake, sir, I'll forgive today as well, otherwise this doesn't even deserve forgiveness. Aurang Khan, I know you are a good and sensible petitioner, and Nawab is a good man. Right, right, goodbye.

brh: ایلو ایلو دادے انت خرے سے؟ دادے امر خپٹہ گل خان نا موناٹ کائک؟ ہمیٹی منے کھلتوٹ پنت ایتاوٹ نی نیکا ئس مخلوق توڑے
en: Brother, brother, what kind of donkey is this one? How does he dare go before Gul Khan? Right there I didn't hit him in the face, I didn't give him a lecture... you are too good with people.
en_old: Brother, brother, what kind of donkey is this? How dare he come in front of Gul Khan? I'd have given him some advice right there. You were good to people...

brh: ادا ہمے چمن ء ختا وٹ چہ مخلوق ء ختا خلے، دا دے ختا وٹ دا ہم چائے مخلوق ء ختا خلے۔
en: Here I was mistaken about that same Chaman, just as the people were mistaken; today I was mistaken about this one too, just as the people were.
en_old: Here I saw that same Chaman the way people saw it, and today I saw this too, the way people saw it.

brh: بس دے بس دے دا ساعت پاتے ٹی فون تے چٹو دا دے خلوص نیام تز ملوے ، اڑے نا خلکوٹ شو
en: Enough, enough. At this moment ... the phones ...; today there will be sincerity between us. Hey, I have struck your show.
en_old: Enough, enough, at this time put your phones away. Today sincerity will come between us. Hey, the show was a hit.

brh: مکھٹی؟ نی الکونس مکھٹی؟ ارے باگو دانگی برک۔ پین داسہ ننا گٹٹی کپیس کنے متم پیس نتھو۔
en: The 'makhti'? Have you taken the makhti? Hey, Bago is coming this way. Now don't put us in a bind again; don't make me...
en_old: A fly-whisk? Did you take the fly-whisk? Hey Bago, it'll come. Now don't make a fuss in our house, give it to me...

brh: دا زغمٹ نی کنا خلیوے ببو کس زو زو ببو اینو مہم ئے
en: With this sword of mine I will strike you. Come, someone, quickly, quickly come; today is crucial.
en_old: In this wound you'll kill me. Come, someone come quickly, today is important.

brh: داد خدایت کرے دا نیاز و چاوا سے گڑاس کیک ئے کہ
en: Dad, by God, this Niazo, I know, is up to something.
en_old: Dad, God did it. This Niaz is up to something...

brh: دا توغے خناٹ کسہ اینو ننے اور کے دعوت کریسس دا تو بدل پائے کے دا راکاٹو چاوکے ہنا اللہ رحم کے اللہ کرم کے
en: I saw this dream: that today he had invited us... this one is saying things have changed... May God have mercy, may God be kind.
en_old: Seeing this, today you invited us... this is a change, this... May God have mercy, may God be kind.

brh: پرویز، ہمے دے اینا وجہ آن مخلوق آن معافی خواہسٹ اور اینو نی کنے آن معافی خواہ، گڑا اینو نی معاف کیوے۔
en: Parvez, that same day, because of this, I asked the people for forgiveness, and today you are asking me for forgiveness; so today I will forgive you.
en_old: Parvez, that day, because of this, I asked the people for forgiveness, and today you're asking me for forgiveness, so today I will forgive.

brh: خراب مرو، انجام نا بس خراب مرو۔ ارے نی گندو با خلیس، گندو نی زوتو، حل بو تڑینگ۔
en: It will turn out badly; your end will simply be bad. Hey, you struck badly, you were too quick... take him, cut him up.
en_old: It will turn out badly, the end will just be bad. Hey, you hit the dirty one, you took the dirty one, solve it...

brh: لائضو! دا مچے ورنا سے، دونو ہتہ خلکو نو کسفینو انتے، ولا منو خننگ ء کس پی مخنگٹی۔ اکرام! دادے جوان کرے کش، دادے جوان کرے کش، ہمبلہ خنانور ننے، بابو، اوکان بسر اللہ۔
en: Lazo! He is just a young boy. Why have they struck him like that and killed him? ... Ikram! Handle this one properly, pull him; handle this one properly, pull him. They have seen us. Babu, they came from there, by God.
en_old: Lazo! This whole young man, both hands... why did you strike and kill him? Then again, seeing someone... Ikram! Finish him off properly, finish him off properly; when we see it, Babu, may God bring us out of there.

brh: جمال دا کاری ودی کرو دا چوس
en: Jamal, this will cause a fatal wound; look at this.
en_old: Jamal did this, look at this.

brh: یار دا امو کاریم کہ نیزہ نا پیندا تے دے خلوی۔ کسء کاوئی نیزہ ٹکر ٹکر کیوے کسفے وی نہ نہ حوصلہ حوصلہ۔ میر حوصلہ کرین کرین اینو ایلومے نا خلکو کسفے دا گنزے انت؟
en: Friend, this is exactly the kind of deed for which one should be struck with the butt of the spear. Whoever..., I'll break the spear to pieces and kill him too. — No, no, courage, courage. — Mir, have courage, have courage. Today they struck and killed your brother; what is this?
en_old: Friend, this is the same work as striking with the butt of the spear. Someone breaks the spear into pieces and kills... no, no, courage, courage. Mir, take courage; today, who struck and killed my brother, what is this?

brh: ایس کنا اوسی لکینک، کنا دانک اینو مئے پاتنو جنگپئے
en: Yes, my heart is burning; today my ... fought ...
en_old: Yes, my heart is burning; my brothers fought today.

brh: نازو پرویز تو خلکون مونا مروئی اکرام پرویز خلکون کثفین او چھٹا
en: Nazo, Parvez was struck right in front of us; Ikram struck Parvez, killed him, and got away.
en_old: Nazo, Parvez was struck in front of us; Ikram struck and killed Parvez, and he got away.

brh: انو پا کنا غم کن چٹار، داکان مستی مونا خوشی خوشی۔ ارے نیازو نی گونس کرے، نیدانت کرے نوس، پرویزا نی خلبوس کچے پینوس۔
en: Today ... for my grief ...; before this, there was only happiness ahead. Hey Niazo, you have committed a sin; what is this you have done? You have struck Parvez down.
en_old: Say it today for my grief; before this, everything ahead was happiness. Hey Niazo, you did wrong, what have you done? Parvez, you have struck him...

brh: ایلوم پرویز ننا خلپرو سون کزیپرو سون دا ٹیم ننا کل کس کونی۔ اڑے بے وقوف اونا دانتے خلکوس کزیفیسک۔ ایلوم اودے تو خلکوٹ کزیفیٹ او تو چھٹا دا غصیت انتئے کیسہ داسہ۔ کنا مغزے اکھنا کنا۔
en: Brother, we would not have struck Parvez, we would not have killed him; this time all of us... — Hey, you fool, you struck him and killed him. — Brother, I did strike him and kill him, and he is finished; why are you getting angry now? My brain...
en_old: Brother Parvez, we didn't hit him, we didn't kill him; this team is all of ours. Hey fool, you struck him and killed him. Brother, I struck him and killed him, and he got away; why are you angry now? My mind...

brh: انتئے گنوئے زہر، اڑے نیازو، سل داسی نا جوان مغز کنے وی
en: Why are you turning to poison, hey Niazo? Wait — I have a good brain too, just like yours.
en_old: Why are you turning to poison, hey Niazo? Look, I have good sense too.

brh: ارے نوبت تو پاسی خلنے تا کنے کٹنگ کثفنگ نو ملانو رسی۔ نازو صبر کر داسہ ننو دے خلینے! زو خل بو چش کے بو گنا بے خے گشا۔ ارے بارو ورسٹس کشا یانتے! زار گل خا
en: Hey, it has come to the point of beating, of cutting me down and killing me... Nazo, be patient, now we will strike him! Quickly, strike [him]! ... Hey... Zar Gul Khan!
en_old: Hey, it was our turn to strike, to cut and kill... Nazo, be patient, now we will strike him! Strike quickly... Hey... Zar Gul Khan!

brh: اڈے جاتورنگ دانت کنے گٹیوس شاباش جوان کننگے اڈے مولو نی انت ئے کنا دشمن مسس
en: Hey, why have you trapped me like this? Well done, nicely done! Hey Molo, why have you become my enemy?
en_old: Hey Jatorang, why did you do this to me? Well done, nicely done. Hey Molo, what are you? You have become my enemy.

brh: معلوم نا دا وجہ آن دشمن مس کہ ہمے دے خلقس کوٹاس تے گلو نی اودے ہمے دے ناجائز خلقس ہمودے نی اودے خلقس اینو نن نی خلینے اڈے نی کنا ایلم نی کنا دشمن مسس نی کنا یکہ خل ئس کوٹے ئس گڑا نن نی الین نا اینو موت بسنے موت
en: Do you know why he became an enemy? Because that day you struck him and beat him, Gulo, you did it to him; that day you struck him unjustly, that day you struck him. Today we will strike you. Hey, you are my brother and you became my enemy; you struck and beat my only one... so are we going to let you go? Today death has come, death.
en_old: Know that he became an enemy for this reason: that day, Gulo, you struck him unjustly. That day you struck him; today we will strike you. Hey, you are my brother, yet you became my enemy. You struck my one and only... so today we will... today death has come, death.

brh: ارے بلزیر، موت اینو نما بسونے!
en: Hey Balzir, today death has come to you!
en_old: Hey Balzir, death has come for you today!

brh: ارے نمک حرام اینو مے خر اسے اینو داڑے کسے بے بانے ارے مادو
en: Hey, you ingrate! Today... a donkey... today, here, anyone... hey, Mado!
en_old: Hey traitor, today... a donkey; today here someone... Mado.

brh: ہمت کا گل خان نیزو ئے خلقت ء فٹ
en: Be brave, Gul Khan! He has struck him with the spear...
en_old: Courage, Gul Khan, strike with the spear!

brh: ارے گلوئے خلکنو جمال خان بش کنتے لمہ رفیق انت کہ دے خلکونے گل خان او گلو
en: Hey, they have struck Gulo! Jamal Khan, lift him up! Mother! Rafiq, what is this, that they have struck... Gul Khan and Gulo.
en_old: Hey, Gulo has been struck! Jamal Khan... mother, Rafiq, what is this, they have been struck, Gul Khan and Gulo.

brh: ادا گل خان نی دے خلکدہ کنے کنا مو شلمونی ایلم خلکونے گولو ایلم دا پاکے او بدنام انت کے خلکنے کنا ایلم کرے جمال ایلم پرویز ارٹ دے
en: Here, Gul Khan, you... struck me; they have struck my elder brother, brother Gulo. Brother, this... and disgraceful one, why did he strike my brother? Brother Jamal, brother Parvez... two days.
en_old: Hey Gul Khan, you struck him; my brother has been struck, brother Gulo. This is pure and disgraced... why was my brother struck? Brother Jamal, brother Parvez, the two of them.

brh: خلق کے او ایودے پارے ٹور تو جنگ کپے او جانو بندگو ہمے دے امیر استا بیٹھے ہمے دے سئی استا بیٹھے کینن باز جنجال مس او داوے مس نو ما جند خنارے بالکل بالکل ایودے پنت سینا پارے ٹ کندو جنگ لگا ئے کھرکوٹ تے پدا کنا باڈی گارڈ کنے خلس بلو کاٹو ٹو کنا
en: The people... and he told him, don't fight; and, dear people, that day Amir was sitting there, that day... was sitting there. Then a lot of trouble broke out, and... happened, you saw it yourselves. Absolutely, absolutely. I gave him advice, I said... then a fight broke out... and then the bodyguard struck me, hard, on my head...
en_old: People said to him, don't fight... and dear people, that day Amir was sitting there, that day... was sitting there. There was a lot of trouble, and this happened... absolutely, absolutely... a fight broke out... then my bodyguard struck me hard, my...

brh: او بڈی گارڈ تونا اسو پکا اینا بس ایلوم دوست خواجہ گو منے خلک کنے استونہ دوشہ کونگے کایلوم ئے کنے بڈی گارڈ کنے خلکو کاٹومٹ کنے خلسی بے ہوش اوٹئے سما فرا ٹائم نہ تمام اوٹئے لنمو سے کنے پین خبر اف گولو
en: And one who was with that bodyguard came... brother, friend Khawaja... struck me... the bodyguard struck me, struck me on the head, and I went unconscious. I don't know how much time passed, I was done for... I don't know anything more than that, Gulo.
en_old: One came with that bodyguard... brother, friend Khawaja... struck me... the bodyguard struck me, struck me, and I fell unconscious. I don't know how much time passed... I don't know anything else, Gulo.

brh: ایلم، نی غم کپہ، اللہ کلے جوان کیک۔ جمال، اللہ کلے جوان کیک، اینو تو واروٹ، کامو نا بدنامی نا خلے ختم کیک۔ اولو، نی خبر ئس کہ ننا دا ننگے میران ہرفتا، ننے چکہ دم ئس ہف کننگ۔ نن میران ہرفنے؟
en: Brother, don't grieve, God will make everything right. Jamal, God will make everything right; today, in one stroke, it will put an end to the disgrace of the tribe. Olo, do you know that this honor of ours has been taken by Miran? We can't rest for even a moment. Shall we take it from Miran?
en_old: Brother, don't grieve, God will make everything right. Jamal, God will make everything right; today... will end the disgrace of the family. Olo, do you know that Miran took away this honor of ours, and we can't bear it even for a moment. Shall we take Miran?

brh: اللہ کل جوان کیک نم کنے کنا حال ء الیبو گلو نن نی نا حال ء الپنہ نن نی تو کنا ایلم ہر قدم وا بس وارس نن میرا نا ہرفینے میرا تو سلاہ کینہ اوکان پد گڑا پیش تمینہ او گڑا الپہ صحیح ہی بش مر داسہ نی منت اینا
en: God will make everything right. You all, leave my condition aside; Gulo, we won't abandon you in your condition. We are with you, my brother, at every step. We'll take Mir... we'll consult with Mir, and after that we'll go forward, and then don't give up. All right, get up now, come on, we're going.
en_old: God will make everything right. You ask me how I am, and we ask how you are. You're my brother at every step. We'll take Mir along and consult him, then we'll head out and ask about things. Alright, get up now, we're going.

brh: ٹپ مپہ پدا وادار مسکک اللہ گڑا حال احوال صحیح ہی ٹھیک ہی خدا حافظ
en: Don't get hurt; then be careful... God. So, all is well? Fine, all right. Goodbye.
en_old: Don't worry, I'll be careful. God willing, everything is fine. Alright, goodbye.

brh: ایلو پرویز تو خلکوں کسے فین تینا ایلوم نا بلے ارفین لیکن دا سکا پشین نا ملک آ تا داڑے تولنگ نا سئی اف داڑے پٹرا خلیرہ ننانے نیازو خلنگ آسانو کاری مس افک اور
en: Together with the other one, Parvez, we struck and killed him; we took our brother's revenge. But now, in the land of Pishin, it isn't right to stay here; here they will hunt us down and strike. Striking our Niazo is no easy job, and...
en_old: Brother Parvez, you struck and killed someone and took revenge for your brother, but now there's no staying here in the land of Pishin; here they will strike... Niazo, striking us was not an easy job.

brh: او تدوکا نا غمو غونا فسکے نیازونا لخا بریر۔ گراف زدہ عید کپبو بشخانہ ایڑے شدیز گسمبو خنمبو۔
en: And with the grief of what has passed... they will come to Niazo's... Grief-stricken, don't celebrate Eid... we will forgive... sister... see.
en_old: They come to Niazo's family carrying the grief of the past. Don't celebrate Eid; we will share it, and we'll see them again.

brh: جمال پریشان کپہ سینے مچ حوصلہ غان کار ہیمہ اللہ کلے جوان ہکیک۔ ہو میر ہو نن اسکان حوصلہ کرین کسے اسکان میر خنتنے۔ جمال کنا ایلم نی تینے تنیا سمجھی پی نن نیتو اوار آن
en: Jamal, don't worry; keep your heart firm and act with courage; God will make everything right. Yes, Mir, yes, we have kept up our courage until now... until..., Mir, we haven't seen... Jamal, my brother, don't think you are alone; we are with you.
en_old: Jamal, don't worry, keep your courage up. God will make everything right. Yes, Mir, yes, we've kept our courage until now, until we see it through, Mir. Jamal, my brother, don't think you're alone. We are with you.

brh: دا جنگ صرف نا اف ننا ہم ارے جمال داسا تولنگ ہننگ نا ٹائم اف بش مبو تینا بدلے اوڑان ہرفبو جمال بش مکا گڈ صاحب نن اینا
en: This war is not yours alone, it's ours too. Hey Jamal, now is no time to sit around; get up, all of you, and take your revenge from him. Jamal, get up and go. All right, sir, we're going.
en_old: This war isn't only yours, it's ours too. Jamal, now is no time to sit around. Get up and take your revenge on him. Get up, Jamal. Alright, sir, we're going.

brh: اوار
en: Together.
en_old: Together.

brh: دیر خنارے آخا؟ او دیر باز ئس خنان گون سیر کرین۔ الہ کنکے دیر ہتے تا دیر انم بننگٹ ہورے۔ رضانت مرو دیر ہتے تو مئے خپرتے نا دیر ہتے تو۔ نم چاوا کنا ناڑ کنے ملاسی ہن کسفرے۔ اللہ خیر کے اللہ خیر کے دیر باز مرو۔
en: Did you see the water, no? Oh, we saw a lot of water; we went around together. God, bring water for me... the water is coming, look... bring water... bring the water of the... You know, you have killed me with thirst. God protect us, God protect us, there will be a lot of water.
en_old: Did you see the water? Oh, I saw a lot of water; I walked around in it. God, the water is coming in now. My veins have gone numb with fear. God protect us, God protect us, there will be a lot of water.

brh: خدا خلیفہ در بدر جند در بدر
en: God... the chief is driven from door to door, we ourselves are driven from door to door.
en_old: We're forsaken and homeless, our lives scattered.

brh: ننے ہم در بدر کرے گل خان اللہ دا انت مسونے نی یار
en: Gul Khan has made us homeless too. God, what is this that has happened, my friend?
en_old: He made us homeless too, Gul Khan. God, what has happened, my friend?

brh: میر صاحب دا کل کنا ہمو کتاغ مونی ایلم نا کاریم کو۔ ننے ہمے ٹائم پارین ایلم تے نہ سمجھائف، سمجھائف توس تے دا سخل کنے ہمے جرا پور کرے، میر صاحب ئے نما مونا شرمندہ اوٹ، ئے دا سخلے تینا ایلمی کسفے وی نما مونا تینا
en: Mir sahib, all of this is the doing of that ... elder brother of mine. We told them at that very time to make my brother understand; they didn't make him understand, and this ... did that ... to me. Mir sahib, I am ashamed before you; this ... killed his own brother right in front of you.
en_old: Mir sahib, all of this is my older brother's doing. We told him back then not to do it, but he wouldn't listen, and that wicked man finished it. Mir sahib, I'm ashamed before you. This wicked man killed his own brother in front of you.

brh: خٹ تے گلزا کے گل خان ننے تو اوار ہندا سرائی مکہ کا نمبر اٹ پٹین خلے جیو حکم
en: ... Gul Khan, together with us, at this very ... by number we searched... strike... Yes, as you command.
en_old: Gul Khan, the one who was with us at this same inn, we found him at number... Long live, at your command.

brh: ادا ہنداڑ کے دیر ہزتہ کہ جولا خلوئی تھی اڑے نی پاننگٹ او کرو زبم بے سینت دیر
en: Here, at this very spot, the water... so that thirst would strike... hey, you are saying... water.
en_old: Here, at this very spot, the water came... You said it, now let's go.

brh: ئے داسہ ہناٹ کہ جودہ خل ودیانی
en: I'm going now, so that... (unclear).
en_old: I went just now to stir up a fight.

brh: ارے مولو کنا ایلمی خلکورے کسفیرے داڑے نی بے پرواہ چرنگیسے
en: Hey Mulo, they struck my brother and killed him, and here you are wandering around without a care!
en_old: Hey, Mullah, they've killed my brother, and you're grazing your animals here without a care!

brh: او لو، امر کہ کنا ایلم ء خنکوسے اونا انجام انو مس، بار اکبر بار اسیتو تا
en: Olo, just as you saw [what happened to] my brother, his end came today... Akbar...
en_old: Oh, just as you saw what happened to my brother, his end will be the same. Allahu Akbar!

brh: مردار کرینے۔ باز جوان کرینے۔ سلفوز نا۔ کان کھیلو تا پٹے خالی کرینے۔ راہی مے۔
en: We've killed it off. We've done very well. With sulphos. We've emptied out the ... ground. Let's get going.
en_old: He's killed it. Very well done, with sulphos (poison). He's emptied the... Let's go.

brh: ایلو مخل کو سوڑ کوختہ ویس، داسہ داڑ کوغنگوس، دا گنگیلو مانم زدہ کاریم کرے ہئے، پاشا دا سوغنگلے، جانی تنا کش ننے ہم پاشا
en: The other... now here... this... has done a mournful deed, hey; Pasha... dear one... us too, Pasha.
en_old: Leave the other gathering... now you've come here... he did this work... Pasha, our dear one, Pasha too...

brh: دا ہلک پٹے رخالے رے بشا خانک ئے آغائے نی پرے دادے ہائے
en: This one took... Agha, you tell this one, hey.
en_old: This boy... Agha, you tell him this.

brh: امار اکرام؟ زبردست مزہ کیک کپک۔ او یار، سخت لگیٹ کن مزہ۔
en: How is it, Ikram? Is it great fun or not? Oh friend, I enjoyed it a lot.
en_old: What's up, Ikram? Having a great time? Oh, my friend, I really enjoyed it.

brh: ادا دات ہستے ایلم نا تینا بدلے ئس ہستے تینا یخ کر
en: Here, take this; take your brother's revenge, take it, and cool your heart.
en_old: Here, take this. Take your brother's revenge and cool your heart.

brh: تواں کے خبر ئے ت عام جلسن مین ہوندو آ، دیہہ رات جلسن مین ہوندو آ، لیکن ہانے مدرسے مین ضرور، کہیں بھی ڈھور کے ٹنگ مین رسو بدھندو تو پو پرے نہ ونجی سگھندو، پر انسان مین اللہ یہ خوبی رکھی آ
en: You know that it happens in public gatherings, it happens in gatherings day and night, but now certainly in the madrasa. If anyone ties a rope to an animal's leg, it then cannot go far, but Allah has put this quality in human beings.
en_old: You know that it happens in public gatherings, in gatherings day and night, but now certainly in the madrasa. If a rope is tied to an animal's leg, it cannot go far, but Allah has placed this quality in human beings.

brh: تھی آ جو دینی رسو آسان مین بدھل آہے پر گھمن پھرن تے پابندی ناہے انشاءاللہ جو مدرسو بھی ہلندو وعظ بھی ہلندا جلسہ بھی ہلندا اللہ ہن گھرانے مان دین کھے کڈہیں بھی کمزور نہ کندو انشاءاللہ ڈینہوں ڈینہہ ہن خاندان مین اللہ سئیں دین کھے
en: It is that the rope of religion is tied on us, but there is no restriction on moving about. God willing, the madrasa will keep running, the sermons will keep running and the gatherings will keep running. Allah will never let religion become weak in this household, God willing. Day by day, in this family, Allah Sain will make religion...
en_old: ...we are bound by the rope of religion, but there is no restriction on moving about. God willing, the madrasa will continue, the sermons will continue and the gatherings will continue. Allah will never let religion weaken in this household, God willing. Day by day, in this family, Allah will make religion...

brh: کے مضبوط فرمائندو اینن مدرسن جی صدقے بے آسان مین کائے خوبی ناہے مدرسن جی کرے جو اسانجو مدرسن سا واسطو آ مان تو پٹرن کے کدی کدی کھلندے چوندو آن مان تو ٹرے مدرسے جو شوق ہی چے ابا سائیں
en: ...strong, thanks to these madrasas; otherwise there is no virtue in us. It is because of the madrasas, because our connection is with madrasas. I sometimes say to my sons, laughing, 'I have a longing for three madrasas.' They say, 'Father, sir...'
en_old: ...stronger, thanks to these madrasas. Otherwise there is no virtue in us. It is because of the madrasas, because we have a connection with madrasas. Sometimes I joke with my sons and say I had a passion for three madrasas, father, sir...

brh: آسان کاڏو ہلائینداسین، مان چیو رب ہلائیندو، مڙئی مدرسو ٺہی، ڪنہن عالم کے ڏینداسین، اہو ثواب قبر ۾ پیو ملندو ئے رہندو، ملندو رہندو، قیامت انشاءاللہ اہو ثواب جاری ہوندو، وڏیرو ہوندو، ٻنی جی ڪوشش ڪندو
en: 'How will we run them?' I said, 'The Lord will run them. Just let the madrasa be built, and we will hand it to some scholar.' That reward will keep reaching you in the grave, it will keep coming, and God willing that reward will go on until the Day of Judgment. A landlord would strive for farmland...
en_old: 'How will we run it?' I said, 'The Lord will run it.' Just let the madrasa be built and hand it to some scholar. That reward will keep coming to you in the grave, and God willing it will continue until the Day of Judgment. A landlord would strive for land...

brh: دا پنج جریب وٹھاں مولوی ہوندو چوندو مسجد ٹھارایاں مدرسو ٹھارایاں مان تواں کا پچھاں تہو مسجد جو اللہ کیڑو شان رکھیا آ مدرسے کیڑو شان آ جو چوویھ کلاک جی ادارے مین قران پڑھیا ونے قال
en: ...[saying,] 'Let me acquire five jaribs.' A maulvi would say, 'Let me get a mosque built, let me get a madrasa built.' I ask you, what glory Allah has given the mosque, and what glory the madrasa has, that in it, an institution running twenty-four hours, the Quran is read. [The Prophet] said...
en_old: If I had five jaribs of land, a maulvi would say: build a mosque, build a madrasa. I ask you, how much glory has Allah given the mosque, and how much the madrasa, an institution where the Quran is read twenty-four hours a day? He said...

brh: آ رسول اللہ پڑیو نی اینا کان ودیک بے نیکی کیہڑی، بھلے جی اماں مولوی نہ تھیاں ہا، تیرہ چودہ سال مدرسن مین مان نہ پڑھاں ہا، بکھ نی انجن تے جیکن آسان مدرسن مین زندگی نہ گزاریاں ہا
en: ...the Messenger of Allah ... what good deed is greater than this? Well, if I had not become a maulvi, if I had not studied in madrasas for thirteen or fourteen years, if we had not spent our lives in madrasas through hunger and thirst...
en_old: The Messenger of Allah said... what greater virtue is there than this? If I had not become a maulvi, if I had not studied in madrasas for thirteen or fourteen years, I would have gone hungry. If we had not spent our lives in madrasas...

brh: ہا تہ جماء جرات سا کرسی دے وئی و نہ سگا وا آستہ کرے ونجا پر جرات نہ ریا وا علمی طاقت نہ ریا ہم اترو ضرور یقین ہی الحمدللہ
en: ...then I could not have sat in this chair with full courage. I might have come along slowly, but I would have had no courage and no strength of knowledge. But this much I am certainly sure of, praise be to God.
en_old: ...with full courage he could sit on the chair, or he couldn't and would move slowly. The courage was gone and the scholarly strength was gone, but this much faith certainly remains, praise be to God.

brh: چودہ سال ہنسا وفاداری کئی آ گڈ گزارو تسے ہنکھے پڑھو تسے ہن جی معنی پڑھی سے حدیثوں پڑھیوں سے پو ت دستار بندی کرایوں او جکھنے ڈیو تما باریندا ایو جی پان کھے فائدو نہ پوندو تس پر اورے
en: For fourteen years I stayed loyal to it and spent my time with it. I read it, read its meaning and read the hadiths, and then the turban-tying ceremony was held for me. Like those who light lamps: it may not benefit them themselves, but others...
en_old: For fourteen years he stayed loyal to them and spent his time with them. He taught him, read its meaning and read the hadiths, and then held his turban-tying ceremony. Like those who light lamps: it may not benefit them, but it benefits others.

brh: مون پارن کے فائدو ضرور ڏی ڇو تہ روشنائی آ، ایتری روشنی ضرور آہی جو اللہ جی قران کے سمجہی سگہون ٿا، دل ٺری ٿی پوی، ٿڪ لہی ٿا وڃن۔
en: ...it certainly benefits those around me, because it is light. There is certainly enough light that we can understand Allah's Quran; the heart is soothed and the tiredness goes away.
en_old: It certainly benefits me, because it is light. There is at least enough light that we can understand Allah's Quran. The heart is soothed and the tiredness goes away.

brh: ہکڑو ائیں معنی کرے وئو ائیں نہ، گرامر سان، ترکیب سان، تجوید سان، سب اللہ گالیوں رکھیون قران مین جی انہی رستے سان تواں ہلو نہ، گھر ئے وسری وندو، چوندو بس ہاݨے قران کھاں باہر کاڈے ونجوں
en: Not just translating it roughly this way or that, but with grammar, with syntax and with tajweed: Allah has put all these things in the Quran. If you walk on that path, you will even forget your home, and you will say, 'That's it, now where would I go outside the Quran?'
en_old: One translates it this way, not that way, using grammar, syntax and tajweed. Allah has put everything in the Quran. If you walk on that path, you will forget your home and say, 'Where would I go now, outside the Quran?'

brh: اللہ قران ۾ ایڏو مٺاج رکیو آ، قران پڙہبو بہ آہی، ٻئی جی زبان تان ٻڌبو بہ آہی، پاڻ بہ پڙہو، پر جیڪڏہن ٻیو پڙہی تہ پوء ڪن ڏئی ٻڌو، ڇو تہ قران تہ قران آ نہ۔
en: Allah has put so much sweetness in the Quran. The Quran is to be recited, and it is also to be heard from another's tongue. Recite it yourself too, but if someone else is reciting, then listen attentively, because the Quran is the Quran, isn't it?
en_old: Allah has put so much sweetness in the Quran. Reciting the Quran brings reward, and so does listening to it from someone else. Recite it yourself, but if someone else is reciting, listen closely, because the Quran is the Quran, isn't it?

brh: ویھاریندا ہا فرما پٹ قران پڑھ ت ما محمد قران ٻڌا صحابی چے یا رسول اللہ قران جو نزول تواں تے ئے اللہ جا نبی آیو تواں جی پٹ
en: He would have him sit and say, 'Son, recite the Quran so that I, Muhammad, may listen to the Quran.' The Companion said, 'O Messenger of Allah, the Quran was revealed to you.' The Prophet of Allah said, '[From] you, son...'
en_old: He would sit and say, "Son, recite the Quran," and Muhammad would listen to the Quran. A Companion said, "O Messenger of Allah, the Quran was revealed to you." The Prophet of Allah said, "I want to hear it from you..."

brh: قران ۾ ڪیڏو اللہ مٺاج رکیو آ جو ڪافر بہ مسلمان ٿیا حضرت ابوبڪر صدیق سائین قربان وڃانس پنہنجی گہر ۾ اندر قران پڙہندا ہئا ائین تہ پابندی ہئی حضور سائین کے
en: How much sweetness Allah has put in the Quran, that even disbelievers became Muslims! Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq Sain, may I be sacrificed for him, used to recite the Quran inside his own house, because there was a restriction like that; on the Holy Prophet...
en_old: Allah has put so much sweetness in the Quran that even disbelievers became Muslims. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq, may I be sacrificed for him, used to recite the Quran inside his own house, because there was a ban; for the Holy Prophet...

brh: چوندو استے پڑھاں پر قران مین ایڈو مزو ایندو جو ڈاڈھا پڑھی ویندا ہا درجے باہروں بھی ماڻہو جی کڏہن کو ٹپی ونجے تڏہن بھی قران ٻڌندو ہو حضرت ابوبکر سائیں پان پنہنجی گھر مین قران پڑھندو ہو کافرن جون عورتوں
en: He would say, 'Let me recite quietly,' but he found so much delight in the Quran that he would recite very loudly, so that even people outside the doorway, if anyone ever passed by, would hear the Quran. Hazrat Abu Bakr Sain himself used to recite the Quran in his own house. The women of the disbelievers...
en_old: They say recite slowly, but he found so much delight in the Quran that he would recite it loudly, so that even people outside heard the Quran if anyone passed by. Hazrat Abu Bakr himself recited the Quran in his own house. The women of the disbelievers...

brh: ویوں پانے بھرن ہاڑے تا گھر گھر مین نلکا ہن پانے جو سسٹم آ اگے کھوہن تان پانے بھرن عورتوں ٹلن جا ٹلا کرے ویندیوں ہوں کھلیوں مشک کھڑی کرے ویندیوں ہوں حضرت ابو
en: ...went to fetch water. Nowadays there are taps in every house and there is a water system. In the old days women fetched water from wells. They would go in groups upon groups, carrying waterskins on their shoulders. Hazrat Abu...
en_old: ...would go to fetch water. Nowadays there are taps in every house and there is a water system. In the old days women fetched water from wells. They would go carrying pot after pot and open waterskins. Hazrat Abu...

brh: ابوبکر صئی جی دروازے کون جو ٹپن پیوں تا حضرت ابوبکر صئی قران پڑھے پیو عورتوں جی کنن تے قران جو آواز آیو ہک بے کے چیو تھوڑا بیو تا سہی کیڈو تا مٹھو آواز آ قران کیڈو تا مزو
en: ...Bakr Sain's door, as they were passing, Hazrat Abu Bakr Sain was reciting the Quran. The sound of the Quran reached the women's ears. One said to another, 'Stop for a little while, just listen. How sweet the voice is, how much delight there is in the Quran!'
en_old: ...as they passed Hazrat Abu Bakr's door, Hazrat Abu Bakr was reciting the Quran. The sound of the Quran reached the women's ears. One said to another, "Just listen for a little while. What a sweet voice, how delightful the Quran is!"

brh: ذرا ذرا پنج منٹ ویہو پوتہ پانے بھرنہ ہلیو حالانکہ مشرکانی ہویوں کافرن جو عورتوں ہویوں ئے مسلمانو رب کعبہ جو قسم قدم کھنی نہ پیا سگن سبھی ویہی کرے حضرت ابوبکر
en: 'Sit for just five minutes, then we'll go and fetch water.' Even though they were polytheist women, women of the disbelievers, O Muslims, by the Lord of the Kaaba, they could not lift their feet. They all sat down at Hazrat Abu Bakr's...
en_old: They sat for just a little while, five minutes, and then forgot to fetch water. Even though they were polytheists, the women of disbelievers, O Muslims, by the Lord of the Kaaba, they could not move their feet. They all sat down at Hazrat Abu Bakr's...

brh: مرد جو قران پئی بدھلے دیر تھی وئی مرد پریشان تھی ویا یار او عورتو جلدی تو ہن اج دیر چھو کیتو گڈ جو لگا تہ حضرت ابوبکر جی دروازے تے سب عورتو ویٹھو ہن
en: ...listening to the Quran, it got late. The men grew worried: 'Hey, those women are usually quick, why have they been late today?' When they found out, all the women were sitting together at Hazrat Abu Bakr's door.
en_old: ...listening to the Quran. It got late, and the men grew worried: "Hey, the women are usually quick. Why are they so late today?" Then they found out that all the women were sitting at Hazrat Abu Bakr's door.

brh: اللہ جو قران تو بدھ ئے قران مین مزو ہی گھرن مین ونجو قران ضرور پڑھ معتبر نہ تھی تکڑیا آئیں بہ پڑھ وڈیرو آئیں بہ پڑھ مولوی آئیں بہ پڑھ چھو تہ ہن
en: Listen to Allah's Quran; there is delight in the Quran. Go to your homes and be sure to read the Quran. Don't just act the notable: even if you are powerful, read it; even if you are a landlord, read it; even if you are a maulvi, read it, because without this...
en_old: Listen to Allah's Quran; there is delight in the Quran. Go to your homes and be sure to recite the Quran. Don't just be a dignitary. Whether you are powerful, a landlord or a cleric, recite it, because...

brh: دے سوا عزت نہ ملندی عزت آہے قران مین پینجھی آخرت کے ٹھاہ پینجھی قبر کے ٹھاہ پینجھی موت کے یاد کر قران مین عجیب عجیب واقعہ ہن حضور اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم جڈے قران
en: ...honor will not be found. Honor is in the Quran. Build your hereafter, build your grave, remember your death. There are wondrous events in the Quran. When the Holy Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, [recited] the Quran...
en_old: ...there is no honor without it. Honor is in the Quran. Think of your place in the hereafter and your place in the grave, and remember your death. There are wondrous events in the Quran. When the Holy Prophet ﷺ was reciting the Quran...

brh: پڑھدا ہنا پو جکنے عذاب جا واقعہ ایندا ہا جہنم جا واقعہ ایندا ہا موت جا واقعہ ایندا ہا تو حضور ﷺ قران بند کرے روئندا ہا گھوڑا ریندا ہا او پانجے لئی نہ تو آسان لئی تہ علامہ
en: ...was reciting, and when accounts of punishment came, accounts of Hell came, accounts of death came, the Prophet ﷺ would close the Quran and weep; he would shed tears, not for himself but for us. Allama...
en_old: ...and he came to accounts of punishment, accounts of Hell and accounts of death, the Prophet ﷺ would close the Quran and weep, weep bitterly. It was not for himself but for his ummah. Allama...

brh: ئے اللہ امت تے رحم فرما، ئے اللہ جہنم جی باھ ڏاڍی سخت آ، ایڏی وڏی سزا آھی جہنم ۾، اللہ منھنجی امت جی پارت ھجئی، مردن عورتن جو پارت ھجئی ئے اللہ
en: O Allah, have mercy on the ummah. O Allah, the fire of Hell is very severe; there is such a great punishment in Hell. Allah, my ummah is entrusted to You; its men and women are entrusted to You, O Allah.
en_old: "O Allah, have mercy on the ummah. O Allah, the fire of Hell is very severe, and the punishment in Hell is so great. Allah, my ummah is in Your care, its men and women are in Your care, O Allah."

brh: منہنجی امت کے جہنم جی باہہ کان بچاء ربا مان محمد ڳوڙہا ٿو ہاریان اہی اڃا آیا ئے ناہن پر مان روئیندو ٿو وتان تہ منہنجی امت جی پارت ہجئی اللہ منہنجی امت کے جہنم کان بچاء منہنجو سہڻو روئیندا ہئا دعائون پیا گہر
en: Save my ummah from the fire of Hell. O Lord, I, Muhammad, am shedding tears. They have not even come yet, but I go about weeping, that my ummah is entrusted to You. Allah, save my ummah from Hell.' My beloved one would weep and keep asking in prayer...
en_old: "O Lord, save my ummah from the fire of Hell. I, Muhammad, shed tears. They haven't even come yet, but I weep for them, because I am responsible for my ummah. O Allah, save my ummah from Hell." My beloved Prophet would weep and keep praying.

brh: عرض کہ جنت جا واقعہ ایندا ہا کلمے وارو مسلمانو حضور کھلندا مرکن دا ہا قران کے بند کرے دعاؤں گھردا ہا منجھا مولا جنت مین وڈا مزا ہن ہائے جنت مین سعد خوش نصیبی ویندا اللہ منجھا امت کے جنت مین
en: In short, when accounts of Paradise came, O Muslims of the Kalima, the Prophet would laugh and smile, close the Quran and ask in prayer: 'My Lord, there are great delights in Paradise. Ah, the blessed and fortunate will go to Paradise. Allah, [take] my ummah into Paradise...'
en_old: ...and when he came to accounts of Paradise, O Muslims of the Kalima, the Prophet would smile and laugh, close the Quran and pray: "My Lord, there are great delights in Paradise. The fortunate ones will go to Paradise. Allah, bring my ummah into Paradise..."

brh: آخ لاندے اللہ منجی دل تری ٹھر دے جی منجی امتی جنت ونجن ئے منجا مولا تیس تائیں مین جنت مین قدم نہ رکھدم جیس تائیں منجی امتی جنت ونجے رب کعبہ یو قسم کھلندے کھلندے دعا وی گھوردا روئندے
en: He would say, 'Allah, my heart will only be soothed when my followers go to Paradise. O my Lord, until then I will not set foot in Paradise, until my followers go to Paradise.' By the Lord of the Kaaba, laughing and laughing he would pray, and also weeping...
en_old: He would say, "Allah, comfort my heart by letting my ummah enter Paradise. My Lord, I will not set foot in Paradise until my ummah enters Paradise." By the Lord of the Kaaba, he would pray smiling, and weeping...

brh: اللہ یعنی جہنم کان بچاء جی جنت جی تعریف ہلی تہ وری خوش ٿی ڪری وری دعا گہر اللہ جنت جی وڏی تعریف آ قران ۾ اللہ مون کے بہ انہی جنت ۾ داخلا ڏی مان بہ رہان انشاء اللہ قران سامہون رکیل ہوندئی ہٿ کڻیل ہوندئی ڳوڙہا ہاریندی اللہ
en: 'Allah, that is, save me from Hell.' And when the praise of Paradise comes, become happy again and pray again: 'Allah, there is great praise of Paradise in the Quran. Allah, grant me too entry into that Paradise, so that I too may live there.' God willing, with the Quran placed in front of you, your hands raised and tears flowing, Allah...
en_old: "Allah, save us from Hell." When praise of Paradise came, he would become happy again and pray again: "Allah, there is great praise of Paradise in the Quran. Allah, grant me entry into that Paradise too, so that I may live there too, God willing." With the Quran placed in front of you, hands raised and tears flowing, Allah...

brh: دعا کے قبول فرمائیندو جہنم کو آزاد کرے جنت عطا فرمائی پر سمجھوں تا روؤں قران کے سمجھوں پو تا روؤں جی جہنم جو نالو اچے بڈجی ونجو جی جنت جی خوشخبری اچے
en: ...will accept the prayer, free you from Hell and grant you Paradise. But understand, then weep; understand the Quran, then weep. When the name of Hell comes, sink in dread; when the good news of Paradise comes...
en_old: ...will accept the prayer, set you free from Hell and grant you Paradise. But weep with understanding. Understand the Quran and then weep. When Hell is mentioned, be terrified; when the good news of Paradise comes...

brh: رجی ونجو اللہ فرمائے آن الذین امنوا وعملوا الصالحات قران تو فرمائے جی کلمو پڑھو وری چنگا کم کئی اللہ فرمائے تو پوری دنیا مین یو مانو ما خدا کے ڈاڈو پیارو آ
en: ...be filled with joy. Allah says, 'Inna alladhina amanu wa 'amilu as-salihat' (Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds). The Quran says that whoever recites the Kalima and then does good deeds, Allah says, in the whole world that person is very dear to Me, God.
en_old: ...be filled with joy. Allah says, "Inna alladhina amanu wa 'amilu as-salihat" (Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds). The Quran says that whoever recites the Kalima and then does good deeds, Allah says, that person is dearer to God than anyone in the whole world.

brh: انی جی وڈی عزت آ، ایڑے مانو کے ما آخرت دنیا مین عزت عطا فرمائیندوس، ئے صحابہ سبھی ہوندہ، صحابہ دیندار ہوندہ، صحابہ نمازی ہوندہ، صحابہ
en: His honor is great; to such a person I will grant honor in the hereafter and in this world. And the Companions were all [like this]: the Companions were devout, the Companions were regular in prayer, the Companions...
en_old: His honor is great. I will grant such a person honor in this world and the hereafter. The Companions were all like that. The Companions were devout, the Companions prayed regularly, the Companions...

brh: قران جا عاشق پروانہ ہوندا، قران جا حافظ قاری عالم ہوندا، بھکھن تے زندگی گزاریندا، اڃ تے زندگی گزاریندا، پر قران کے یاد کندا ویندا پڑھندا ویندا، نفلوں بھی پڑھدا
en: ...were lovers of the Quran, [drawn to it] like moths; they were memorizers, reciters and scholars of the Quran. They lived through hunger and lived through thirst, but they kept memorizing the Quran and kept reciting it, and they also offered voluntary prayers.
en_old: ...were lovers of the Quran, drawn to it like moths. They had memorized the Quran, recited it and were scholars of it. They lived through hunger and lived through thirst, but they kept memorizing and reciting the Quran, and they also offered voluntary prayers.

brh: اکبر! ہرف دا زغمے، کان کیرے، نیازوئم خلینہ کین، تباہ و برباد کین۔ نیازو! ارا خلینہ کین انتنے ڈکانوس؟ دانگ میدان آ پیش تم!
en: Akbar! Take up this sword. Let's go, [come on]. We'll kill Niazo too, we'll destroy [him] utterly. Niazo! Hey, we're going to kill [you], why have you hidden yourself? Come out here onto the field!
en_old: Akbar! Take this sword. They'll kill us; we'll kill Niazo and destroy him. Niazo! Why are you hiding? Come out onto the battlefield now!

brh: اینو ننے زندے لپنے جمال خان خدا خیر کے
en: Today Jamal Khan kept us alive, may God bless him.
en_old: Today Jamal Khan saved our lives, God bless him.

brh: نازو اراڑے ڈکانوس دیرے
en: Nazo, where have you hidden the water?
en_old: Nazo, where have you hidden the water?

brh: اگر نی بدمعاشی کریسے، تو نا سینہ ٹی جغر ئس ہم مرو۔ بدمعاشی کننگ آسان اف کنتو، ہر خلنا کنتو لکیسے تنے۔ راڈ کو!
en: If you act the thug, then there had better be guts (a liver) in your chest too. Being a thug isn't easy with me; with me you'll take every blow on yourself. [Get] the rod!
en_old: If you're going to be a thug, you need guts in your chest too. Being a thug isn't easy, brother, you have to take every beating yourself. Get the rod!

brh: ارے حارث ہنے چائے ہس شاباش فرش کتے جائی لے ایلو کنا گولی کھٹارے او پارے
en: "Hey Haris, go [get] a tea, good lad, [sweep] the floor, and also [bring] my pills," he said.
en_old: "Hey Haris, go bring the tea, good lad, clean the floor, and bring my pills too," he said.

brh: گم کخلتے کخا یا گم کخلتے
en: Lost [...] or lost [...]? [garbled]
en_old: Did you lose the keys, or did the keys get lost?

brh: کمال نا بابا گودی ہچ کتوس دا
en: Kamal's father [and] the lady did nothing at all to this one.
en_old: Kamal's father and mother didn't do anything to him at all.

brh: زخم وٹیو نا لخے خلیرے، ڈرائیور کن! ارے یادوئی مت کیس!
en: The wound [...], strike [him] on the neck, for the driver! Hey, don't forget!
en_old: The wound... hit it, for the driver! Hey, don't forget!

brh: نیازو بش مر، ئے نینا زندء اسہ لکھ مروٹ
en: Niazo, get up! I'd give myself a hundred thousand times over for your life.
en_old: Niazo, be happy, I'd give my life a hundred thousand times over for yours.

brh: ارے نازو ارانگ نرسے میر ہمبل کنا ایلم ئے اگر کنا دو کلتا وسیا تے نی زندہ لپیسے
en: Hey Nazo, where will you run off to? Mir Hambal is my brother. If my hands [ever] reach you, you won't stay alive.
en_old: Hey Nazo, where... Mir Hambal is my brother. If my hands ever reach you, you won't stay alive.

brh: گل خان ٹاٹ کٹا تے۔ آ میر صاحب کٹنگ وٹنگ تے کٹنگ وٹنگس مف کنے اسہ وار کٹو کے او ختم کیوتے۔
en: Gul Khan, cut him down! O Mir Sahib, [enough of] this cutting and such, I don't need any cutting and such: let me strike [him] once and I'll finish him off.
en_old: Gul Khan, you killed him. Mir Sahib, enough of this killing business. Let me hit him just once and I'll finish him off.

brh: میر صاحب اورتے کس غلہ کستانی ئے تینا ایلومے کاو کڑنا خن پارے۔ میر صاحب اورتے کس کا خا بس ادا ہمبرس کینگ مینگانی۔
en: Mir Sahib, someone [...] his own brother [...], he said. Mir Sahib, someone [...] came, just there [...] a [...]. [largely garbled]
en_old: Mir Sahib... my brother... he said. Mir Sahib... came, and something happened here.

brh: ایلم نی ہم کئیتو کسینس لیکن اینو دے نی کینو پر
en: Brother, you too have killed [people] alongside me, but today you are [doing it] to me.
en_old: Brother, you never did anything for me either, but today you're doing it for me.

brh: اوئے سئیب ایلم نا خلنگ اٹ است نہ افٹ اینو ئے تینا ایلم ء درد ئس خلپوٹ
en: Oh sir, I don't have the heart to strike my brother; today I will not cause my brother any pain.
en_old: Oh sir, I don't have the heart to hit my brother. Today I won't cause my brother any pain.

brh: خانی، دا مکر ئس نی انتئے داد خلکوس؟ دا نا خلنگ نا حقدار دا سچ ئس کہ دا نا ایلم ئے خلکاسس؟ داد، دا کسیفوس؟ پورا دا نا است یخ مسکا اور دا نا حق مدام مس؟ نی انتئے دونو ظلم کریس؟
en: Khani, why did you deal this one such a treacherous blow? Did he deserve to be struck down? Is it true that he had struck his brother? Look, had he killed [anyone]? Had his heart been completely appeased (cooled), and had he always been in the right? Why did you commit such cruelty?
en_old: Khani, why did you play this trick on Dad? Did he deserve to be hit? Is it true that he had hit his brother? Dad, did he make him cry? His heart had gone completely cold, and he was always in the right. Why did you commit such cruelty?

brh: دنت ئے دا خلقوس بس محمد اکبر علم دا دے خلقوٹ کنا علم ئے کنا استاد آغا بلٹ تپستے خاسوس کاغذ تے خاسوس کنا اعزاب تے سوس بس دے خلقوٹ تینا علم ئے دا دے نما مونا کس
en: This is how you struck it. That's it, Muhammad Akbar, today I have planted this flag (alam). My flag, my teacher Agha B[...] [...] the papers [...] my [...]. That's it, today I have planted my own flag here, today, in front of you. [partly garbled]
en_old: This is what I've done. Muhammad Akbar Alam, today I've done it. My knowledge, which my teacher Agha Bilal gave me, the papers I read, my honors... today I've raised my knowledge in front of you.

brh: بس اینو انو مانا نا ختم کل ایلومون۔ ایلے بوتا کچک نا لاشی گام بوتا سا۔ یو ایس ئے گندہ ایلوم او سکین مچے لکے تینا دوناراس کنے کوئٹہ وال چے
en: That's it, today [...] it is all over, brothers. [...] a dog's corpse [...]. [...] a bad brother [...] his own [...] me [...] Quetta [...]. [mostly garbled]
en_old: That's it, today it all ends with the brothers. ...a corpse... the US... brother... Quetta...

brh: میر صاحب دا گل خان بھلو قربانی ئس تس پینا ایلو مے خلق
en: Mir Sahib, this Gul Khan has made a great sacrifice: he killed his other brother.
en_old: Mir Sahib, this Gul Khan made a great sacrifice: he killed his own brother.

brh: جمال اینو ہم پدا ننے سمجھے کہ گل خان نا ایلو او کنا کل نا ایلو میر صاحب گل خان نی تینے اینو ہم پدا دا دنیا ٹی
en: Jamal, today once again [this] made us understand that Gul Khan's brother and my [brother] are the brother of all of us. Mir Sahib, Gul Khan, today once again you yourself in this world [...]
en_old: Jamal, today once again make us understand that Gul Khan's brother is the brother of all of us. Mir Sahib, Gul Khan, today once again you yourself in this world...

en: Consider [us] your own: we are all your brothers.
en_old: Understand this yourself: we are all brothers.

brh: تو الا بس زاڑی بس شام لو مئے تینا پائے اما پائے جی ابا پائے دوں کنے کرے دا نیو چار وکو دے اسے دوشہ جنگلٹی گھٹ کے کنے دا قبلہ زار ٹوڑے گھٹ کرے کنے ولدا ایلو قبلہ زار ہر چار قبلہ غوار کٹ کنے رپک کنے ہلو پائے کے ہنو پارتن کے ہنے
en: So she came, [she] came in the evening and said to her mother, 'Mother!' 'Yes?' she said. 'Father,' she said, 'this is what was done to me: one day a snake in the jungle held me tight; it squeezed me toward this side, then again toward the other side, in all four directions [...] me, it [grabbed] me and said it would take [me] [...] go [...].' [partly garbled]
en_old: So she came, the woman came in the evening, and said to her father, the mother said, yes, the father said, she did this to me. This new one looked; one day the demon took me into the jungle, she took me to this direction, then to the other direction. I went in all four directions, and she kept me. She grabbed me and said, where are you going, where?

brh: کنے او برام کیک تو اینے کمپرک کپا کنے تو ئے گڑا کنے ونے داسا ئے شرماں کرے داسا نی انت لمہ پاو کنے دوشے برام کورا کھلہ خوفم پاتینونے داسہ مجبور اوٹ سا دوستو گڑاسے نی پاریر وا نین بس تو دانیاری پیا پا نین کنا الوات بے ہنا
en: 'He will marry me, so don't do this to me.' Then [...] me [...] now she felt ashamed. 'Now what do you say, mother? [Will you] marry me to a snake? I am very afraid, and now I am helpless.' So, friends, [...] you said [...], then this woman said, [...] my [...]. [partly garbled]
en_old: She is going to marry me, so don't do this to me. Then she shamed me. Now what do you say, mother? Marry me to the demon? I was very afraid, and now I'm forced. So, friends, something you said... come again, then tell this girl, tell her, my brothers without...

en: Now there was [one], a little one [...]. She said, 'I will marry [you] [...] properly [...].' [She] went [...]. He said, 'You said yes,' he said; 'you said so,' he said; 'go on, you said,' he said; 'you said so: [...] will marry,' but, well, fine. Now [...] graze [...] nothing [...]. This one wandering about, the one wandering about, was just a sorcerer of magic. [partly garbled]
en_old: Now there is a story, a small one. She said, I will marry, you take it properly. That son of hers said, yes, I said it; he said, go on, say it. I will marry you, but come, fine. Now she wants nothing to be done. This one grazing, the one grazing is just a great sorcerer.

brh: داسہ کہ داسہ داسہ دا چناتا مونا غانی نین جادو کیک تینے دوشس کیک ئے ہم بندہ سے دا مائیے کرے برام داسہ قدرت ہنا مس مس آخر دا نیاڑی مار ئس مس ہنا ئے جادو ایرا داسہ چنکاتا مونا دوشس ئے
en: Now, now, in front of these children he does magic: he turns himself into a snake, [yet] he is also a human being. He married this woman. Now, by the power of God, it happened, it happened: in the end this woman had a son. [...] his magic [...]; now, in front of the children, he is a snake.
en_old: Now, now, in front of these children she does magic; she turns herself into a demon, and she is also a person. She married this one. Now by God's will it happened, after all this was a woman's son. Her magic, now in front of the children, she is a demon.

brh: ئے ونتنے بندہ کے یعنی دو شبی کن کے تنے ہر وار جادوگر آ قانونی وقتس تنے امر کے وقتس امر کے جادوگر تو ہنا مار کرے قدرت مچ بس اونا اویداس مچ بھرنوک مزاس ہنا ایرو تا وار چیرنگے دیر خراس تو خوافرو واپس بئیرک داسا زائی پتو ہنا
en: He [makes himself] a human, that is, [...] he makes himself [...]. Every time, the sorcerer has a fixed (lawful) time; [it comes] somehow, a time [comes] somehow. The sorcerer then [...] her son [...] by God's power [...] his hope [...] full [...]. [...] their turn [...] a long while [...] they will graze [...] will come back. Now [...] does not know [...]. [largely garbled]
en_old: She said to him, a person, meaning for two nights... each time the sorcerer has a legal time; a time comes, a time comes. The sorcerer married her son. God's power gathered, his hope was fully gathered, his taste... today it's their turn to part; it's been a long while, so they want to come back. Now she doesn't know...

brh: سلاہ کرے کہ دا مال ہخس کرے نا مار نی مونا کنا تو ہچ اوچڑا سفر اٹی تو دا مالا ننا مارے چوف داسہ اگر نی ضعیفہ پریزاستے ستو او دے کینا زوال او دے پردہ کینا یتین او دوشس کے او کنے او تڈے
en: She took counsel that this [...] your son, in front of you [and] me, never [...] on a journey; so [look after] this son of ours. Now if you [...] the old woman, the fairy [...], we will bring about her downfall, we will cover her up; believe [me], he is a snake [...] me [...]. [partly garbled]
en_old: She advised that this son of hers... the son in front of you, in front of me, never on a journey. So look at this son of ours. Now if you are a weak fairy... I will bring her decline, I will veil her, believe it, she is a demon, she is mine, and she...

brh: دمس خلیو تو کھیک جتے پین دوشو خلیوتو تینا ہتھاریو دوشنا مثال کیو خلیوتو دمس کھیک گڑا دا مال ننا دا نہ مرے تو ہمیشو منگاء الما ہرا کہ محل اسو صفائی کرے کئی کے تو دوشے برام کرے داسان پئے بس ٹھیک ہی کریتو طریقہ داسان وری ہمے چھنکا
en: If I strike [it] once, it [...] separately; if I strike another snake, with my own weapons I will make an example of the snake; if I strike once, [...]. Then if this [son] of ours does not [survive], then always [...]. Which palace she cleaned [...], so she married the snake. 'From now on,' [she] said, 'just fine, do it [this] way'; from now on again that little one [...]. [partly garbled]
en_old: If I strike once, she dies separately; if I strike again, with my weapon I make an example of the demon. If I strike once, she dies. Then if this son is not ours, always... the palace that she cleaned... so she married the demon. From now on, just fine, do it this way, from now on again that little one.

brh: ئے لمہ داڑان اسے گھڑیس بے مر مفک ہیتے بسا پگہ لمہ باوان ئے یاد کیدا ئے تکلیف ملے پائدہ سامت کنا چنا ایرے پگ پاسوئے تا پائدہ سنی ہننگ کرک او کار مال تو ہنگا بسونی بشنگ کٹے دوشس کچنے پیہ او
en: 'O mother, from here [...] not even a single moment can pass without [...].' The word came. Tomorrow [...] will remember mother and father [...] will be in pain [...] benefit [...] my child is here [...] tomorrow [...] can go. [...] the work, the son [...] came there [...] a snake [...]. [largely garbled]
en_old: Mother, from here, not even a moment can pass. The words came. Tomorrow mother will remember father, she will be in pain; for the benefit, my child is here. Tomorrow, for the benefit, she can go. That work, the son, has come there; he released it. The demon will take him, you see.

brh: دے مس بس تو پارے ارا خوار تو گڑا گدرٹ سپولا اینا پن اسکہ سپولا دا کہرا دوشنا چنانا پن اسکہ چھارکو گڑا گدرٹ سپولا اراخ کے بس تو بسیں کہ بڑزا کرے گڑا نی
en: When day came, then she said, 'Where is [...]?' Then [time passed(?)]: Spola, her name was Spola; this [...] the snake's child's name was Charko. Then [...] Spola [...] came; then [she] came and lifted [it] up high; then you [...]. [partly garbled]
en_old: When the day came, she said, the sister is here. Then at night, Spola, his name is Spola, in this house the demon's child's name is Charko. Then at night Spola, the sister, came; she came and lifted it up, then you...

brh: ئے ہمو دے شئے کریٹ تینتو کڑوٹ شائس و خلے چڈماس شوٹیک ستیک، دا اینار مالے خواف ہیرینگ ہمبس، تو چار کوئی بے خبر اسہ کہ لمہ باوہ کنا ایلو نا دشمنی ئے کیرہ، دا دا اسہ یعنی ساہ اتخ یعنی ایلو مے نقصان منگلے پکو، تو ہینگ ہمبس مالے
en: That day I made [a plan] with myself [...] I will [...] and strike [...]. This [...] the son [...] graze [...]. So Charko was unaware that mother and father were hostile toward my brother; this, that is, [his] life [...], that is, no harm should come to the brother, surely. So it went on like that, the son [...]. [partly garbled]
en_old: That day I made a plan with myself: I'll take a stick, beat it, it will be hurt. This mother of his wants... So Charko was unaware that mother and father are hostile toward my brother. This, meaning his life, meaning harm should not come to the other, surely. So it went like that, the son.

brh: بادشاہ نا ہلی گرسہ پائے بادشاہ مونی کمک کرف داڑے ودا دندنے تپینوس وزیکنے نت ٹی تے تپینوس ہلیئے تینا ڈوور پڑدہ کینوس تا بادشاہ پائے بلے کچ پداسو تول کتا دنیا تو ہس کے دانا وزنے ہموخہ دنیا تیونے داسہ انتس کہ مس غلطی مس ہا ٹھیک
en: Dragging the king's horse, he said: "King, help me first. Here you have tied ... you have tied me by the feet, you have taken the horse and covered it up with your own hands." Then the king said: "Well, put it on the scale and weigh it ... its weight, that much wealth I will give you." Now, what happened was that a mistake was made. Yes, all right.
en_old: Crying, the king's [servant] said: "King, help me first. You buried... here, and you buried me in... you took it and covered your own..." The king said: "But after weighing it, you gave the world... you gave its weight, that much of the world. Now what happened? A mistake was made. Yes, all right."

en: There are a lot of fruits on it, so that these fruits' ..., the clusters of its leaves, its twigs, its trunk, all of it is golden rupees; on its fruits ... a pot falls ... such ... this tree is a beautiful one; there ... at night.

en: ... we come near, near ... that afterwards this tree ... this coming out ... that ... near ... He said: "Tell me, after all, what is this like?" He said: "This is my tree, don't you see? It is such that it bears fruit; its fruit ..."

en: Agha, he took it and carried it off ... you will take it to another area, you will take it ... this sahib, the prince ... a minister of yours, a counsellor stood (by) himself ... look ... came out ... a demand ... a small thought of yours ...

He said, "Yes, I won't kill, I won't ..." "Fine."
