At first these (the companions) looked few to them, but when they came close, the companions looked like thousands to the enemy, and to the companions that same enemy looked few. This too is Allah's q... [cut off]
en_old: So think a little: his companions were few, and they faced such a huge army. To them the companions looked few, but when they drew near, the companions looked like thousands to the enemy, while the enemy looked few to the companions. This is Allah's...

brh: غیبی مدد، چئی بے اللہ جی غیبی مدد، اللہ فرمائے جبرائیلا جی سائیں، چئی جلدی ونج منجھ محمد کریم انتظار مین آ، ہزار ملائکہ وٹھی ونج سیں جنگ جی لاء منجھ سوہنے کے چوسے ہی بے لشکر تنجے ہتہ مین آ، ہی بے وڑندا۔
en: ...unseen help. They say this too is Allah's unseen help. Allah says, "Gabriel!" "Yes, Lord." He says, "Go quickly, my noble Muhammad is waiting. Take a thousand angels and go to the battle, and tell my beloved: this army too is in your hands." These too will fight.
en_old: Unseen help. Call it Allah's unseen help. Allah says, "Gabriel!" "Yes, Lord." "Go quickly, the noble Muhammad is waiting. Take a thousand angels with you, go to the battle and tell my beloved: this army is in your hands." That is greatness.

brh: سبحان اللہ کہ بے وڈنگا، ئے ملائکن جی طاقت ٻڌایاں، حضرت ابراہیم علیہ السلام ڏے تن کان متھے ملائک آیا، پو چار کر یا پنج کر، بابا کیئن آیا او تواں ماڈے، ابراہیم علیہ السلام پچھا کئی۔
en: Glory be to Allah, they too will fight! Let me tell you the power of these angels. More than three angels came to Hazrat Ibrahim, peace be upon him; say four or five. "Sirs, why have you come to me?" Ibrahim, peace be upon him, asked.
en_old: Glory be to Allah, how great! This shows the power of the angels. Angels came to Hazrat Ibrahim (peace be upon him) before, maybe four or five of them. "Sirs, why have you come to me?" Ibrahim (peace be upon him) asked.

brh: چئیس آئیاں ہوں، لوط علیہ السلام جی قوم ڈی ونجوں تھا، زمین پٹے ہیٹھوں متھے کھنی وینداسے، پو متھوں وری اوندھی زمین کرے سٹینداسے پٹی کنداسے، ہویا چار پنج، چار پنج ایڈی وڈی زمین، ترے پٹ کرے کھنی ویا، وری متھوں اوندھی زمین کرے جو سٹیا
en: They told him, "We have come because we are going to the people of Lot, peace be upon him. We will tear up the land and lift it from below to up high, then from above we will throw the land down upside down and flatten it." There were four or five of them, four or five, and such a huge land: they tore it up, carried it off, and then from above turned the land upside down and threw it down, and...
en_old: They said, "We have come because we are going to the people of Lot (peace be upon him). We will lift the land up from below, then throw it back down upside down and destroy it." There were four or five of them, such a huge land. He lifted it up with three feathers and then threw it down upside down.

brh: ہزارے فٹ زمین ہیٹھ وئی، اینا تائیں اونی زمین نا متھوں پانے موجود آ۔ طاقت آہے یا ناہی؟ ہکڑو ملائکہ چئے ہا، بے دشمنن جی لاء کافی ہو، لیکن ئکہ پئی بھرجی، صحابہ جو تکین پیا نا، تو بو مزو
en: ...the land went thousands of feet down, and to this day there is water standing on top of that land. Is that power or not? One angel, you could say, would have been enough even for the enemies, but so that the eye would be filled — the companions were watching, you see — and then there is the delight...
en_old: The land sank thousands of feet, and its water is still there on top today. Is that power or not? One angel, he would say, would have been enough for the enemy, but a thousand came so the companions would feel reassured, and then the fun...

brh: مضبوط ٿن پر اڃا بہ ڳالھ سمجھو جیئن جو ویجھا آیا اللہ فرمایو سونھڻا ٻیو ڪجھ نہ ڪر مٽیء مان مٺ ڀری ہی پٿریلی زمین آ نہ ہڪڙو مٺ اڇلی ڏی پوء مان ڄاڻان منہنجو ڪم ڄاڻی تون صرف ایترو ڪم ڪر
en: ...so that they would become strong. But understand the matter further: as soon as they came near, Allah said, "Beautiful one, do nothing else. Fill your fist with dust from the ground — this is rocky ground, isn't it — and just throw one fistful. After that I know what to do; My work knows. You only do this much."
en_old: They are strong. But still, understand the point: when they came near, Allah said, "Beloved, do nothing else. Take a fistful of dirt from this rocky ground and throw just one fistful. Then I know my work. You only do this much."

brh: ہی جو مٹھ جھلی سبن کے ئے بجرا بہ لگا ئے بزدل بہ تھی ویا کمزور تھی ویا بھجن لگا۔ چھا تہو سئیں؟ صحابہ کڈھ، ملائکہ کڈھ۔ چودہ صحابہ کل تیراں اوتے شہید تھی ویا، ہکڑو زخمی تھئو ٹنگ تے۔
en: When he flung this fistful, these pebbles hit every one of them; they turned cowardly, grew weak, and started to run. What happened, sir? Count out the companions, count out the angels: of fourteen companions, thirteen in all were martyred there, and one was wounded in the leg.
en_old: When he threw the fistful, it hit every one of them. They lost their nerve, grew weak and started to flee. What happened, sir? Count the companions, count the angels. Fourteen companions in all, thirteen of them were martyred there, and one was wounded in the leg.

brh: او وڈجی پس کٹ جی پسی کل تیراں او ہودوں وری ستر جہنم مین ونجی پہتا ستر کن سردار انہن جا پکڑجی پیا گرفتار تھی ویا شکست ملے وین الحمدللہ اسلامی جھنڈے کے بدر مین رب سائیں بلند کرے چھڈیو یا کہنجی طاقت آ بابا کہنجی طاقت آ
en: He was cut, cut down... thirteen in all. And on the other side, seventy went into hell, and some seventy of their chiefs were caught and taken prisoner. They suffered defeat. Praise be to Allah, at Badr the Lord raised the flag of Islam high. Whose power is it, sir? Whose power is it?
en_old: And on the other side, count them all... seventy went to hell, and seventy of their chiefs were seized and captured. They were defeated, praise be to Allah. At Badr the Lord raised the flag of Islam high. Whose power is this, sir? Whose power is this?

brh: اللہ جی طاقت آ، او ہکڑو نوجوان جینو ٹنگ کٹجی وئو، حضور فرمایو، حضور سائیں کے وری پرتے واری دے متھاں ہکڑو چھپرو ٹھائے ڈنو ویو، اوتے وری جھنڈو لگل ہویو، تہ جکے زخمی آیو حضور اوہیو ئے تھوا، انہی چھپرے مین ونجو حضور
en: It is Allah's power. That one young man whose leg was cut off — the Prophet said... For the Prophet a shelter had been put up on top of a sandy rise, and a flag was planted there, so whoever came wounded, the Prophet was right there: "Go into that shelter," to the Prophet.
en_old: It's Allah's power. That one young man whose leg had been cut off... a canopy had been set up for the Prophet on high ground, with a flag on it, so the Prophet said that whoever came wounded should go into that canopy.

brh: او سے ویٹھا ہی نی ہاڑے اوتے جامع مسجد ٹھیلا جامع مسجد وڈی جامع مسجد ٹھیلا پو زخمین کے نیندا ہا جکے سلاہ مشورو ہوندو ہو حضور دے ویندا ہا پو یو زخمی نوجوان جوان دو ٹنگ وڈھل اسے حضور فرماؤ اینکے آتے چھڈو
en: He sat there. Now a Jamia mosque has been built there, a big Jamia mosque has been built. Then they would take the wounded there; whatever consulting there was, they would go to the Prophet. Then this wounded young man, the young man whose leg had been cut off — the Prophet said, "Leave him here."
en_old: They sat there. Now a Jamia Mosque has been built there, a big Jamia Mosque. Then the wounded were brought to the place where they held their consultations, to the Prophet. Then there was this wounded young man whose leg had been cut off. The Prophet said, "Leave him here."

brh: جنگ ختم ٿی ہن جو علاج مدینی ۾ ڪنداسین ڪاٿی بابا مدینی ۾ نہ تہ حضور سائین چوی ہا تہ رستی ۾ شہید ٿیندو ویچارو نہ اللہ فرمائی حیاتی موت منہنجی قبضی ۾ آ ڪنہن نبی کے بہ خبر ناہی
en: The battle ended: "We will treat him in Medina." Where, sir? In Medina. Otherwise the Prophet would have said that the poor man would be martyred on the way. No — Allah says, "Life and death are in My control"; not even a prophet knows.
en_old: "The battle is over, now we'll treat him in Medina." Where, sir? Not in Medina. Otherwise the Prophet would have said so; the poor man would have been martyred on the way. Allah says, "Life and death are in My control." Not even a prophet knows.

brh: دینی رسے سا او نوجوان وفات کرے ویا شہادت ملے سائیں سائیں عبیداللہ ہی تو وفات کرے رو پان فرمے بس مدینے نکھڑوس اتھے ئے جنازو پڑھوس اتھے ئے دف
en: ...on the road to Medina that young man passed away; he received martyrdom. "Sir, sir, Ubaidullah has passed away." He himself said, "Just don't take him to Medina. Perform his funeral prayer right here, [bury him] right here..."
en_old: ...the young man passed away; he attained martyrdom. Ubaidullah, sir, he passed away, and he said, "Just don't take me to Medina. Say my funeral prayer here, bury me here..."

brh: دفن کنداسے آسان کراچی ہوندا ہوں بے جنازو گھنائیندا ہیں ابے دے بھرسا رکھ جائی ماسات دے بھرسا رکھ جائی چاچے دے بھرسا رکھ جائی سمجھو تھا حضور اوتے ئے جنازو اوتے ئے دفن کرے الحمدللہ چودیواری آ
en: "...we will bury him." Even we, if we are in Karachi, have our bodies taken back home for the funeral: "Lay me beside my father," "lay me beside my mother's family," "lay me beside my uncle." Do you understand? But the Prophet held the funeral right there and buried him right there. Praise be to Allah, there is a boundary wall [around it now].
en_old: "...we will bury you here." We who live in Karachi have our funerals taken back home: count on your father, count on your mother's side, count on your uncle. Understand this: the Prophet said his funeral prayer right there and buried him right there. Praise be to Allah, there is a boundary wall.

brh: انہی صحابی جو قبر وچ تے موجود آہی ہاڻی تہ برڪت خاطر پری پری جا ماڻہو بہ پنہنجا جنازہ آتے پڙہن ٿا آتے قبرستان ٺہیل آ پر انہی صحابی جی برڪتن جی ڪری اہو صحابی ڪٿی دفن ڪیون منہنجی امام الانبیاء انہن جا سردار گرفتار ڪیا انہن جا وڏا
en: That companion's grave is there in the middle. Now people from far away also bring their funerals there for the blessing; a graveyard has grown up there, all because of that companion's blessings. That is where they buried that companion. My Imam of the Prophets captured their chiefs, their big...
en_old: That companion's grave is there in the middle. Now people come from far away to say their funeral prayers there for the blessing, and a graveyard has grown up there because of that companion's blessings. That is where the companion was buried. My Imam of the Prophets captured their chiefs, their elders.

brh: ماڻہو گرفتار ڪین آخر ۾ دشمن ابو جھل ہو ابو جھل پیو مرڻ جی قریب ہڪڙو صحابی آیو یا رسول اللہ منہنجی دل نہ ٺری آ ماریا اٿم ڪافر پر اڃا دل نہ ٺری آ اجازت ڏیو ڪنہن کے
en: ...men were captured. In the end there was the enemy, Abu Jahl; Abu Jahl was lying close to death. A companion came: "O Messenger of Allah, my heart has not cooled. I have killed unbelievers, but my heart is still not satisfied. Give me permission to [kill] someone..."
en_old: ...the people were captured. In the end there was the enemy, Abu Jahl, lying close to death. A companion came: "O Messenger of Allah, my heart is not at peace. I have killed unbelievers, but my heart is still not at peace. Give me permission to..."

brh: ماری اچان فرمائی وڃ ڳول ڪافرن جی لاشن ۾ ڏس جنہن ۾ ساہ ہجی انہی کے مار اہو جو ویو سڌو حضرت پاڻ ہی صحابی جو ویو تہ ابوجہل پیو آ پر ساہ اٿس نبی جو دشمن پیو آ وڏو
en: "...so I can go kill and come back." He said, "Go and search among the corpses of the unbelievers; see whichever one still has breath in him, and kill that one." He went straight there, the companion went himself, and there lay Abu Jahl, but he still had breath in him. The Prophet's great enemy was lying there.
en_old: "...go kill someone." He said, "Go and search among the bodies of the unbelievers. Whoever is still breathing, kill him." The companion went straight there himself, and Abu Jahl was lying there, still alive. The Prophet's great enemy was lying there.

brh: او دشمن سا ہوئے سے صحابی ونی متھوں بیٹھس تے او نبیا دشمن اج ما ایواں تو جی متھوں ماری دو مائی جیڑے مار بھلا پر مجی گال بدھ ونی محمد عربی کے مجو پی
en: He was the enemy. The companion went and sat on top of him: "O enemy of the Prophet, today I have come on top of you to kill you." He said, "Fine, kill me, but listen to my words and go tell Muhammad the Arab my message:
en_old: He was the enemy. The companion went and sat on top of him: "O enemy of the Prophet, today I am going to kill you." He said, "Fine, kill me, but take my message to Muhammad the Arab.

brh: پیغام پونچا ابو جھل جدی جیرو ہوبے توساں دشمنی رکھے پئیو ہانے جی مان مران تو تری بھی محمد عربی ساں منجی دشمنی باقی آ اونی تلوار نا منڈی دار
en: deliver the message: as long as Abu Jahl was alive, he kept up his enmity with you, and now, even if I die, my enmity with Muhammad the Arab remains." With the blunt edge of his own sword...
en_old: Deliver the message: as long as Abu Jahl was alive, he kept up his enmity with you, and even as I die, my enmity with Muhammad the Arab remains." The hilt of his sword...

brh: رسو ٻڌی گہیلیندی گہیلیندی حضور جی خدمت ۾ آڻیسین ابو جھل جو مڇس چہرو آ سری ابو جھل جو آ مان توہان کان پڇان ٿو جیڪی منہنجی پاڪ محمد سان جن دشمنی ڪئی ڇا انہن پنہنجا ٻئی
en: ...they tied a rope to it and, dragging it and dragging it, brought it before the Prophet: "This is Abu Jahl's face, this is Abu Jahl's head." I ask you: those who made enmity with my pure Muhammad, did they not [ruin] both their...
en_old: Tied with rope, they dragged and dragged him and brought him before the Prophet: "This is Abu Jahl's face, this is Abu Jahl's head." I ask you: those who were enemies of my pure Muhammad, did they not have both their...

brh: جہان تباہ برباد کرے ویا اللہ سے مجھے نبی جی غیبی مدد کئی صحابہ جی غیبی مدد کئی الحمدللہ ہانے بھی اللہ سے آسان جی مدد کندو حق واری جماعت جمعیت علمائے اسلام جی جماعت آ انشاءاللہ
en: ...worlds, destroyed and ruined? Allah gave unseen help to my Prophet and unseen help to the companions. Praise be to Allah, now too Allah will help us. The party of truth is the party of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam, God willing.
en_old: ...worlds ruined? Allah gave unseen help to His Prophet and unseen help to the companions. Praise be to Allah, Allah will help us now too. The party of truth is the party of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam, God willing.

brh: الیکشن مین بھی انھی جماعت جی جھنڈے مین ھجو، الیکشن کان سواء بہ جمعیت علماء اسلام وارن سان گڏ ویھندو تہ پوء ایمان مضبوط آ، باقی اوئن آزادی آ تہ عالمن سان گڏ، پر جی امتحان اچے الیکشن جو، پوء روڙی پرتی ویٺو آ، سائین توھان نہ اچو، آسان توھان جا آھیون۔
en: In the elections too, be under this party's flag. Even apart from elections, if one sits with the Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam people, then the faith is strong. Otherwise, normally one is free to be with the scholars, but when the test of the election comes, he backs off and sits far away: "Sir, don't you come, we are yours."
en_old: In elections they are also under that party's flag. Outside of elections they sit with the Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam people, so their faith is strong, and otherwise their freedom lies with the religious scholars. But when the test of the election comes, they go and sit with the Pir: 'Sir, you don't need to come, we are yours.'

brh: اڙی وڏی رنج نظر ۾ دشمنی پیدا ٿیندی، تنہنجی مانا تنہنجو ایمان اڃا تائین ڪمزور آہی، چئو انشاءاللہ اہڙو ایمان نہ کپی، ایمان مضبوط کپی، اللہ ہن مدرسی کے توہان جی ویہڻ کے سڀن کے اللہ
en: "Oh, there will be great resentment, enmity will arise in their eyes" — that means your faith is still weak. Say, God willing, such faith is not wanted; strong faith is wanted. May Allah [bless] this madrasa, your gathering, everyone; Allah...
en_old: Such great grief and resentment breeds enmity, which means your faith is still weak. Say, God willing, such faith should not be; faith should be strong. May God (bless) this madrasa, your gathering, and everyone...

brh: نی اسہ لشکر ئس تشکیل ایتے، کلے لائن نا صرف دا اخس کہ ملنگ اریر، پلی خط تخل بو، ہمکنگ تلوار نا گٹے ہمیرے استو کباب کرین، تلوار نا ماؤ ماؤ نی ہموڑے تخوک ئے یار نومے اللہ خلئے اسہ دا کاریمے اگڑا سے ٹی کباب کیرے نومے چھچکے اللہ
en: You formed an army, and the only thing about the whole line is that they are malangs (vagabonds)... with the swords they made kebabs..., and you keep the sword lying there. Friend, God damn you all! In one go you turn this job into kebab — God [curse] you!
en_old: You formed an army... the only thing is that there are malangs (dervishes)... keep the letter... the sword... they made kebab of it all... you have kept the sword there, friend, by God's name... they make kebab of this work in one go, by God's name...

brh: ئے غواص خلے نو می اینو ئے غوڑا نا ملے ئے غوڑا سما فرا چوری کشی جنگ چسی کیس بادشاہ سلامت اوم نم سائی تسی بیش سیمو ڈا تین نی غواص خلے اتور پائے نور نی بادشاہ اوٹ کنکھ نرو غوڑا سرک انت کہ دا مادی غا غوڑا یتی سے
en: ...today I... the horse's... the horse was stolen... the war... Your Majesty... a donkey... he says... you, the king... the horse ran off... what is it, that this mare horse...
en_old: ...the diver... the horse... the horse was stolen... a fight broke out... Your Majesty the King... you, the King... what is it that this horse...

brh: ایشن او سوالہ تفیسہ تے داڑے ایلو تے استبل ٹیم نرنگا گوڑا تے تو جنگ نا ٹیم او بیلیف مزک کنگو ئے ڈبو چے بے ایم سے ئے چوری خنیف بو گم کبو تے ازے دا یکہ صبح شام پاسی ئے چائے ارا دا کنے تے گوڑا بیلیف مس اونا کرچن او کنگوس دا
en: ...he tied it up here; the others... at stable time the horses running off... and at war time... report it stolen, make it lost... this one alone, morning and evening... tea at home... the horse became... his...
en_old: ...these questions... here the others... at the stable at that time the horses... at the time of war... the horse was stolen and lost... morning and evening... tea... then the horse believed in me...

brh: دا نا پاش تن تو کن من دیلوک زگ دا گوڑک بیخی مف پاش راک کنیسے ارے دوس اسپونگ نی داسے گوڑانہ پاش تیشور کنے اللہ خلق نمے دا بادشاہ نا موری مونکدے بدنسلاک
en: ...these horses are not at all... show... hey friend... these horses'... God damn you, you ill-bred ones of this king's...
en_old: ...this horse is not at all... my friend... this horse... may God's creation... this King's... the ill-bred ones...

brh: ایلا خل دے شندے شکا بیشہ ششوار مروک اب جنگ کے نی ئے بلو سرکوکس خانانو امونو زی اتول یار اسپے دا توپ انامونے اتیو نی نما امونہ دا سلطنت ئے چھٹیپو نام و نشان چھٹنگ نا بادشائی نا بادشاہ سلامت نی مروڑے تیو وار داسے
en: ...one day... becoming a donkey rider... now in the war you... they have seen a big tortoise... friend, this cannon... I'll give you... you all... this kingdom... abandoning the name and trace of the kingship, Your Majesty, you... this time...
en_old: ...war... you... friend... this cannon... you abandon this kingdom of yours... abandoning name and trace of the kingship... Your Majesty the King, you... this time...

brh: ئے دے کسے تنے وار سے سے دا کھنگورے مرو رنو پیک روکا گھگڑا گھمبھریا کنا پدی خلیسا بلیا پیٹے تومچی وردش کر گھومر جنگٹی نی دے و خیرا بشر پدا ہتہ یسے شونو نی تو مخ تن جنگ کپس بادشاہ سلامت پی بھامس نت ک گرا غنے رازغمو وقتم خلوکو
en: ...one day someone... this time... hitting me from behind... belly... do exercise... in the war you... brought back... you can't fight, Your Majesty... leg... at the time of striking...
en_old: One day someone... this time... behind me... do exercise... in the war you... you could not fight, Your Majesty the King... at the time of striking...

brh: ئے جنے کسہ سرا ایف بنے کنے امبلا مس کنتو تلوار الو کے ارا تلوار برو ٹاٹی ٹوری ٹا خانے نی ہمو جنگ جنگ چسے کے ہمو دے شروان نا پوشکو نسے کے یار کنگو نی بے غیرتہ سہی چسس نی کنے ہستے پوشکو نسے
en: ...I became friends with him... I had no sword with me... a sword... you, in that war... that day... [your] sherwani... yellow... friend, you shameless one, you did fine... to me...
en_old: ...it happened to me... a sword... where the sword... you, in that war... that day... friend, you shameless one, you did right... you gave me...

brh: ہمو ڈیتھ سرٹیفیکیٹ جوڑ کریسے ہموتا زی آ پشکون ئس ہکے۔ ئے رشوت کننگ ئس کنے۔ او ودی مروک والو گگو۔ او ڈاسے کونگونی نی فون فون تو اف ننا بادشاہ تر دیرے خط لکھار کپوت نا لکھٹ چیلنج کفا فقیروستی پبا بوائے لوڑا۔
en: You had that death certificate made... on top of them a yellow... I... a bribe... he, being born... you don't have a phone... our king... to whom did they write a letter... the writing... challenge... beggar... papa boy...
en_old: They made that death certificate... a bribe... he was born... you have no phone... our King... wrote a letter... the challenge... the beggar...

brh: پین اسہ ہرا اینو نا ہیت آک دا وڑ او نن اتھو ہچ اسہ دماغ کاریم کننگ اٹی اف کہ نور خان انت کننگ اٹی ئے اور نی انت کننگ اٹی اوس نی ئے ہشتاد وار رنگ کریٹ نی کنا نمبر افتیس اوکان پد ہردے پاسہ کنے پیسہ ایتیبو پیسہ ایتیبو ولدا
en: Another thing: today's matters are like this, and as for us, our minds aren't working at all about what Noor Khan is doing and what you are doing. I rang you eighty times and you didn't pick up my number, and after that every day you say, 'Give me money, give me money,' again.
en_old: Another thing: today's matters are like this, and we... no mind is working on what Noor Khan is doing and what you are doing. I called you eighty times, you didn't pick up my number, and after that every day you say give me money, give me money, again.

brh: کنے کنے پارینوس نی پین کنا بغیر اجازت آن نور خانے امر تسونس تنی ایلو ئے نا نمبرے ٹرائی کریٹ نا نمبر بند اسکہ ئے کسارا کرے نور خانے خناٹ نا پیساتے ئے نور خانے تسٹ مگر او ٹھگ
en: You have told me, 'Why did you give it to Noor Khan without my permission?' Brother, I tried your number and your number was switched off. On the way I saw Noor Khan, so I gave your money to Noor Khan, but he is a cheat.
en_old: You told me, "Why did you give the money to Noor Khan without my permission?" I tried the other one's number, but his number was off. I saw Noor Khan, so I gave the money to Noor Khan, but he's a cheat.

brh: کنا پیسہ تے تنے کنا ایلم دماغ تولنگٹی اف کہ ٹک نی ئس یا تو نور خان ئے نی باز غلط کرینوس نی کنے آن ہرفوسوس کنا پیسہ تے سٹا تین تے کو تسونس بس ٹھیک ہی داسہ یکا وہ نور خان ئے ہورے وی اگر نور خان پیسہ تے تتے
en: My money, give it to me. My brother, I can't figure out whether you are the cheat or Noor Khan. You have done me a great wrong: you took my money from me and you went and gave it to someone else. Fine, okay. Now let me go and see Noor Khan; if Noor Khan doesn't give the money...
en_old: My money, give it to me. Brother, I can't get my head around whether it was you or Noor Khan. You've done me a great wrong. You took my money from me, so why did you give it to someone else? Okay, fine. Now wait, Noor Khan, come here. If Noor Khan doesn't give the money...

brh: ئے تا وگے پارے کہ کنے پیسہ تے تنوس گڑا ولا ئے نیٹے ہپرو۔ ادا ئے او دے پیسہ تسنوٹ اگر او منے پک گڑا جتا او ئے تسے۔ نی داسہ ہنا کنور خان آن تینا پیسہ غاتے ہلت۔ اگر او نی پیسہ تتاو گڑا نی او دے خل۔
en: He told me, 'Give me the money, then, by God, I won't come after you.' So I have given him the money. If he won't admit it, that is a separate matter; I gave it to him. Now you go and take your money from Noor Khan. If he doesn't give you the money, then hit him.
en_old: He told me, "Give me the money, then I won't fight with you." So I gave him the money. If he doesn't believe it, then he gave it separately. Now go and take your money back from Noor Khan. If he doesn't give you the money, then hit him.

brh: خالی بپیس پیسہ ہلیس اینتے بہانہ کرو کہ خیرو کنے پیسہ تیتنے لیکن ئے اون ایتا تیا بھروسہ کپیس بھروسہ کپیس جنگا ٹم اوڑا پیسہ ہلیس خیرو اگر ایتاک دادو
en: Don't come back empty-handed; take the money. He'll make the excuse that 'Khairo hasn't given me the money,' but don't trust his words, don't trust him. Even if it takes a fight, take the money from him. Khairo, if he gives...
en_old: Don't just talk, take the money. I make excuses, "Khairo, give me the money," but don't trust him. Don't trust him. When it comes to a fight, take the money from him. Khairo, if he doesn't give it...

brh: نی اوت پیسہ تے سنوس تو گڑا نور خان نا خیر اف ئے داسہ کاوے اوڑان پیسہ تینا ہلی بس ٹھیک ہی نی ہن اوڑان تینا پیسہ ہٹ کا داسہ خدا حافظ
en: If you have given him the money, then it won't go well for Noor Khan. I'll go now and take my money from him. Fine, okay; you go and get your money back from him. Now, goodbye.
en_old: If you gave him the money, then Noor Khan's in trouble. Now go and take your money from him. Okay, fine, go and take your money back from him. Goodbye for now.

brh: خیرو تیتنا حملہ کرے ہنا داسا کیرے ننا واریئے
en: Khairo has made his attack; go on now, it's our turn.
en_old: Khairo has attacked us. Go now, now it's our turn.

brh: داسہ ننے حملہ کروئی ئے خیرو تو جوانو تماشس کروئی ئے ہاؤ نور خان ہاؤ خیرو تو تماشہ کروئی تمک داسہ خیرو ننے حملہ کرے جوان کتاؤ او تو جوان کتاؤ داسہ گری نن مورتو جوان کپرو
en: Now we have to attack. We have to put on a good show with Khairo. Yes, Noor Khan, yes, we'll have to make a show of Khairo. Now Khairo has attacked us; he didn't do well, he really didn't do well. Now then, we won't go easy on him either.
en_old: Now we have to attack, Khairo. We have to put on a good show. Yes, Noor Khan, yes, Khairo, we have to put on a show. Now Khairo has attacked us. He didn't do well, he really didn't do well. Now let's see, we won't let it go.

brh: خیر ئے ادا نی غصہ غصہ اوننگٹی ئس ننے آ؟ نور خان! ئے ہکا نی غصہ اوننگٹی اٹ۔ نی ادا مے دے پاریس کہ
en: Khair, why are you so angry with us here? - Noor Khan! I really am angry with you. You said here the other day that...
en_old: Khair, why do you look so angry with us? Noor Khan! Why do you look angry? You said the other day that...

brh: خیرو دا بندغ تا موبائل ادرینے دافتے پیسہ تیتنے۔ کنے ریفسے خیرو اینو کنے عباس کنے پارے کہ نا پیسہ تیتس نور خانی اور نی کنے پیسہ تیتوس کنے ریفس گدرے
en: Khairo has taken these people's mobile and hasn't given them the money. Khairo deceived me. Today Abbas told me, 'I gave your money to Noor Khan,' and you didn't give me the money. You deceived me.
en_old: Khairo, these people's mobile... give them the money. Khairo tricked me. Today Abbas told me, "I gave your money to Noor Khan," but you didn't give me the money. You tricked me.

brh: فضو ہم کترس۔ ہنو کیرہ بندغاک۔ خیر ئے ایلوم نی دے پارے۔ دماغ نی تو ہنداٹی۔ کنا دماغ ہنداٹی۔ نا دماغ ہنداک کہ مخل کترے فیسے۔ خیر و پیسہ تے گن۔
en: Fazo didn't do it either. That's how people do things. Well, brother, I told you. Your mind is set on that. My mind is set on that too. Your mind is such that... don't interfere... Khairo, count the money.
en_old: Fazo didn't do it either. That's what people do. Khair, brother, you said that. That's where your mind is. That's where my mind is. Your mind is set on... Khair, count the money.

brh: نور خان، کنا پیسہ تے تسونے؟ او نی، کنے ایہہ ودی ریٹ فکس کرینے۔ او ہیت ٹھیک ہی نی دا پا، نی دیر پاریکے اینا پیسہ تے خیرو آن ہلکونوٹ۔ نور خان!
en: Noor Khan, has he given you my money? And he has fixed this rate on me. - That's fine, but you tell me this: who told you that I have taken your money from Khairo? Noor Khan!
en_old: Noor Khan, did you give me my money? Oh you, you've fixed a rate on me. That's fine, but tell me this: who told you that I took the money from Khairo? Noor Khan!

brh: اینو خیرو بس پارے کہ نا پیسہ دے مچے تو مرے کیتی صورت نور خان ئے نور خان ئے تننگ افتا ایلو خیرو کرے دروغم تھڑے کہ اگر اینا پیسہ دے ہلکوٹے نا پیسہ دے نی سر کریٹے
en: Today Khairo just said that your money would all be settled; there's no way it was given to Noor Khan, to Noor Khan. Brother, Khairo has told a lie, because if I had taken your money, I would have handed your money over to you.
en_old: Today Khairo just said that your money... in any case, Noor Khan didn't give it. Khairo lied, saying that if I had taken your money, I would have handed your money over.

brh: خیرو نا بابس ہنوس کرے ہلکونس کہ کنا پیسہ تے دھرینوس ایلوم اینا پیسہ تے ہلتنوٹ اگر نی دا ہیتے ثابت کریس کہ نا پیسہ تے خیرو ہلکونٹ اسہ ڈان ئے رٹ جرم دیونے خیرو نا
en: Khairo's father did the same thing: 'You have taken it, you have taken my money.' Brother, I have not taken your money. If you can prove that I took your money from Khairo, I'll pay a fine, Khairo's...
en_old: Khairo's father did this. He took it, saying, "You held on to my money." Brother, I didn't take your money. If you can prove that Khairo took your money, I'll pay a fine, Khairo's...

brh: زبان نا ہچو بھروسہ کپہ دا خالی روغہ تھڑیک، برخانی دانت پاننگٹی ئس دانا ہچ دماغ تولنگٹی اف، دا ہتہ کننگٹی ارے نی خیرونن تو، ایلوم کنے خدا گنج تسنے اگر نا
en: Don't trust his tongue at all; this one does nothing but tell lies. [Noor] Khan, what is this you're saying? This one can't think straight at all. This is what he's doing, you with Khairo. Brother, God has given me plenty of wealth; if your...
en_old: Don't trust his tongue at all. He does nothing but lie. What is he even saying? He can't think straight at all. He's doing this... you, Khairo. Brother, God has given me plenty of wealth. If your...

brh: پیسہ تے ہلکٹہ نی تسٹہ تا ئے امر کیوتہ کنے خدا گنج تسونے ئے دا مسلمان تا پیسہ تے ہلکوسٹے او تینا جان نا خلاص کننگ کن نیتون ہنا دروغے تھڑے ہنا
en: ...if I had taken the money, I would have given it to you; what would I do with it? God has given me plenty of wealth; why would I have taken this Muslim's money? He told you that lie to save his own skin.
en_old: Did he take the money? Did you give it? What would I do with it? God has given me plenty of wealth. Why would I take this Muslim's money? He lied to you to save his own skin.

brh: دروغ تڑے تدا دروغ دا وار نا اونا کاٹ پی ہتے باز نی فیری ایلوم نی داسا صبر کا ایور تو تینٹ کاوٹ ایوا او کنے حملہ کرے نی داسا ہور کے نن کینے او کنے پد نا پیسا کم ظاہر مرے او کنے
en: He told a lie, that lie... this time his head... too much... Brother, be patient now; I'll go myself. He attacked me. Now you watch what we do. Later on, the matter of the money will come out too, he... me...
en_old: He lied, a lie... this time his head... you've gone too far. Brother, be patient now, I'll come myself. He attacked me. Now you see what we'll do. Later on, the money will come out...

brh: بنا دروغ ہم ظاہر مرے خیرو نا دروغ ہم ظاہر مرے ئے ہلکونوٹ یا ہلتنوٹ، وہ کل خبر تمے کائک۔ نور خان، ئے نیان معذرت خواہوٹ، شاید او دروغ تڑے نی، ئے بس اونا ہک نی ہلکٹ۔
en: Your lie will come out too, and Khairo's lie will come out too, whether I took it or didn't take it; everyone will find out. Noor Khan, I apologize to you. Maybe he lied to you. I only took his due from you.
en_old: Your lie will come out too, and Khairo's lie will come out too. Whether I took it or not, everyone will find out. Noor Khan, I apologize to you. Maybe he lied. I only took what was his due.

brh: ٹھیک ہی اللہ خیر کے نو اسیل ہبو کا پد پورے نا کانے دعا ٹی یاد ادا بشما بوکان دا لوفر خلن چھڑ دروغ تھڑک زیان نا
en: Fine, may God make it well... remember me in your prayers. Here, get up, go! Let's beat this loafer; he does nothing but tell lies, with his tongue...
en_old: Okay, may God make it right... remember me in your prayers... this loafer, beat him. He does nothing but lie, the harm of his tongue...

brh: زند ئے لویا فک خیرو نا کاٹو بینا داسا او
en: Life... Khairo's head... now he...
en_old: Life... Khairo's head... now he...

brh: دے حسین نا ریف این رائی کرین تہ سائیں کائیک سہیل خان تو جنگ کیک سہیل خان باز گھمنڈ استے نا زیا
en: ...Hussain's deceit... Sain goes and fights with Sohail Khan; Sohail Khan was very arrogant, your...
en_old: ...Hussain's... the Sain comes. Sohail Khan fights. Sohail Khan is very arrogant...

brh: گل خان خیر تو تولوکے؟ ہاؤ دا او خنے وتے۔ اوڑان پاسے بمبس خلیوی انتء یلہ کئی۔
en: Gul Khan, all well, are you sitting comfortably? - Yes, he saw this. I'd hit him with a bomb from that side; why are you letting him go?
en_old: Gul Khan, is all well, are you sitting? Yes, he saw this. Why didn't you hit him from over there, why did you let him go?

brh: ارے نور خان ہکل تو ترو سس نی ہرا ہکل تسس کہ ننے ہکل تین خیرو ہرا واری
en: Hey, Noor Khan, you gave a shout; what was that shout you gave, saying 'call us'? Khairo, whose turn is it?
en_old: Hey Noor Khan, you gave a shout; the shout you gave was for us... shout, Khairo, whose turn is it?

brh: کیسہ ہمو وڑ خنیسہ خیرو نی چالاکی کریس پیسہ تینا نا کنوسینو لکھ نا کائیک ادا لکھ کنا ایمپک لکھ تو نما ارمسٹ نا کائیک خاموش داسہ ہور لکھ نما
en: You do it, you see it that way; Khairo, you were clever... your own money... it comes to lakhs... here the lakhs are mine... the lakhs are yours... Quiet now, look, the lakhs are yours.
en_old: You see it that way, Khairo, you played clever; you'll take your money, it comes to lakhs. These lakhs are mine... the lakhs come for your... Quiet now, the lakhs are yours.

brh: یا کنا کاک یا ننا کاک لختو نما کاک نم سنگتاتے کنا غل کورے نی ہنو نو کاریم کھریس کنا سنگتا خلنگار خیرو داسہ نی ہم خلنگیسے نام خیرف نم دا خو بہادرورے گڑا تفکاتے تینا بٹبو اسیل اوئے دوا سورین گڑا
en: Either it goes to me or to us; the lakhs go to you... you, my friends... You did such a thing that my friends got beaten; Khairo, now you'll be beaten too. It won't go well for you. If you're so brave, then put down your guns and let's [settle it] with our hands then.
en_old: Either my uncle or our uncle... your uncle, you and your friends... You did such a thing, my friends were beaten, Khairo, now you'll be beaten too. You think you're so brave? Then put your guns down, hey, let's see then.

brh: اوڑا خبر تمک کہ بہادر دیرے؟ ایلم بہادر نیوس۔ ادا بہادر ایوٹ، اوڑا بشمہ ہمبلاتے خلین۔ ایلم ہاؤ بشمرینے، پینٹ بازی مرے دشمن تو، نور خان نی مچا ڈک سے فک۔ نور خان نی چکپ۔
en: He'll find out who is brave. Brother, are you brave? Here I'm the brave one. Get up there, let's attack them. Brother, yes, he has got up. There'll be a fight with the enemy. Noor Khan, you can't hide at all. Noor Khan, you won't get away.
en_old: Does he know where Bahadur is? Brothers, Bahadur... Here Bahadur is alone, hit them. Brother, yes... a fight with the enemy. Noor Khan, you... Noor Khan, you won't escape.

brh: پکا نی نی خلیپا بشما ایلم ئے بش تومرے ونے خبرے نور خان کاویو دختیک بشاڑے نور خان ہچ کپک بشماڑے نور خان خلے نا
en: Surely you won't hit... Get up, brother... get up... Noor Khan... get up, Noor Khan won't do anything... get up, Noor Khan, hit your...
en_old: Surely you won't hit... Let the brothers go... Noor Khan won't do anything... Noor Khan, hit him...

brh: نیکے تھوفکے بٹیس نور خان ہم نی دو اٹ خلیک تھوفک اٹ خلپک
en: Put down the gun. Noor Khan will hit you with his hands too; he doesn't hit with a gun.
en_old: Put the gun down. Noor Khan will hit you with his hands too, not with a gun.

brh: برہ نور خان برہ کہ ہم دنتو جنگ کیوے
en: Come, Noor Khan, come, so that I can fight you like this too.
en_old: Come on, Noor Khan, come on, let's fight like this too.

brh: پیسہ تنے تو تتا بن اینو نی ہم کسء پیسہ تونا وار کننگیسے نی ہٹی دنو خن خمپارہ کینی خلیز ننے
en: You didn't give the money... today you too will be struck down over someone's money... you, like this, look, you'd fire mortars at us.
en_old: Give the money, bring your father too; you'll also be... over someone's money... you'd fire mortars at us.

brh: جنگ مت کر ننا پیسہ آتے نن کان۔ ایلوم ہمبت تٹی کرے جنگ مریک پیسہ تننگ مفک۔ نن جنگ کپنہ ننا پیسہ آتے نم جنگ کیرے دا ہزت کننگ اونی۔ نن جنگ کپنہ ننا پیسہ آتے نم اگر جنگ کتویرے ننا ہزت ہم کتویرے نما اوسک کرے جنگ خوائک جنگ۔
en: Don't fight — we want our money. Brother, ... there will be a fight, but the money won't be given. We aren't fighting, it's our money; you're the ones fighting — is this showing respect? We aren't fighting, it's our money. Even if you haven't fought, you haven't shown us any respect either; it's your heart that wants a fight, a fight.
en_old: Don't fight, we want our money from you. Brother, fighting is one thing, but the money isn't being given. We don't fight over our money; you're the one fighting, and this isn't respectful. We don't fight over our money. If you don't fight, you'd respect us too, but your man wants a fight, a fight.

brh: نن جنگ کپن نن ئے زورٹ جنگ پٹیسے نوم کے ایت الپیرے نوم تو جنگ مرے جوانی دا پابو کے ارا دے ئے میدانہ بریرے میدانہ ببو ہموڑے گڑا سرپٹوس جوانو مریک نن جنگ کپن نن
en: We won't fight. You are forcibly picking a fight with us; you won't take my word. If it's going to be a fight with you, fine — tell me which day you'll come to the field. Come to the field; there you'll find out, and it'll be fine. We won't fight, not us.
en_old: We don't fight. You're forcing us into a fight. You won't give the name. If there's going to be a fight, fine. Which day will you come to the field? Come to the field and then settle it properly there. We don't fight.

brh: پیسہ اتیتی، نومے جنگ کروئیے بندغ تینا حق کہ جنگ کیک، ٹھیک ئے نی زور خلنگوس نن ہم تینکے کسر ئس پٹنہ، بس ٹھیک ئے ایمبو کسر ئس تینکے پٹبو، ارا دے آ کہ بسرے تینا فون ئس کیرے، ئے تینٹ میدانہ بریوہ
en: For the money you have to fight — a person fights for his right. Fine, you're using force; we too will find a way for ourselves. Fine then, go, find yourselves a way. Whichever day you come, give me a call; I'll come to the field myself.
en_old: When it comes to money, you have to fight; a person fights for his rights. Fine, you're using force, so we'll find a way for ourselves too. Just fine, we'll find our own way. Whichever day you come, give me a call and I'll come to the field myself.

brh: دا مرے اموڑے شغولس ٹھیک ہی ولانے جوان اورے ننان ہمبو
en: Let it be ... over there. Fine, all right; you're fine — go away from us.
en_old: Let it be, leave it there. Fine, but you're good people, and so are we.

brh: ایمبو نم کنے انت اوریرے؟ زو ایمبو! غصہ بس کنے خلوٹ نمے گڑا نڑے، ادا دا سلوت دادے پرہیز دا اگر بسور ولا انت کینے؟ ادا او اسل ب۔
en: Go! What are you staring at me for? Go, quickly! If I get angry I'll beat you, and then you'll run off. Here, this ... if they come, then what will we do? — He'll never co[me] here.
en_old: Now what will you do to me? Come on, quickly! I got angry, I'll hit you, then... Here, this... if they come, then what will you do? He'll never come here.

brh: بفسہ سے ہزار کہ ننے خلیرہ اسل بفسہ نی خبرے کارتوس اخس مہنگائے غریب بندہ تو
en: They won't come. Three thousand, that they'd shoot us over it? They'll never come. You know how expensive a cartridge is for a poor man.
en_old: He won't come. Three thousand to shoot at us? He'll never come. You know how expensive cartridges are for a poor man.

brh: لٹہ سنبھالنگ کپکک، دا اسل بفسا، نی بے فکر مر، بس قرض قرض اینک، ٹھیک ٹھیک
en: He can't even handle a stick. He'll never come, don't you worry. He just keeps going 'loan, loan'. Fine, fine.
en_old: He can't even handle a stick. He'll never come, don't worry. He just keeps saying 'loan, loan.' Okay, okay.

brh: او نور خان، نور خان ئے او نور خان
en: Hey Noor Khan! Noor Khan, hey Noor Khan!
en_old: Hey Noor Khan! Noor Khan! Hey Noor Khan!

brh: ادا انتوئے لس لک مئے نور خان ء توار ء ٹھیورے، نور خان خیرو بلو زور ئس سرفینے۔
en: What's going on here, why are you calling out Noor Khan's name? — Noor Khan, is everything all right? ... a great force has been brought down on us.
en_old: What's going on here, why are you calling for Noor Khan? Noor Khan, is everything alright? Bilo is pushing us around.

brh: خیر انت مس کنا دا ایلم نا موبائل ئس ہلک داسہ پیسہ تے فنگیننے زور اٹ پاننگے بابو میدان آ کنتو جنگ کبو داسہ ننا مدد ٹی نی کنا غریب نا جنگ کننگ کپنے بالکل نور خان کیرے غریب تا مدد تے کبو
en: Well, what happened is this: he took a mobile phone of this brother of mine, and now he isn't paying the money. He's saying, forcefully, 'Come to the field and fight me.' Now help us — poor me, I can't fight. Surely, Noor Khan, you help the poor; please help us.
en_old: Well, what happened is my brother took a mobile phone and now he isn't paying the money. He's using force, saying, 'Come to the field and fight me.' Now help us. Can't you fight for a poor man like me? Of course, Noor Khan, you help the poor.

brh: نور خان نی او کیک ہکا ٹوس نیکی بالکل کینہ چرت خلپہ اللہ کل جوان کیک نور خان نا باز باز مہربانی دا حوالہ تے بو کہ خیر وراڑے کے نور خان بردا سنئے
en: Noor Khan, will you do it? — ... I'll certainly do this good deed. Don't worry, God will make everything all right. — Many, many thanks, Noor Khan. We leave this in your hands, so that, God willing, ... Noor Khan ...
en_old: Noor Khan, you'll do it? Of course I'll do good, I'll definitely do it. Don't worry, God will make everything alright. Many, many thanks to Noor Khan. Well, hopefully Noor Khan will bring it.

brh: خیر و عافیت دے نی رائے بابو کان، کان ہرن تے او مخلوق کے جواب امر ایتک؟ ہلو کا رزق، تینا دے ہلیرا، ہر کہ اما ہلیرا تا۔
en: Peace and well-being ... set off — come on, let's go and see him: how does he answer people? ... the livelihood (he) took; they take their own days; whoever it is, that's how they take it.
en_old: Good health to you. Go to Babu. How does he answer the people? Whatever livelihood they've taken, they take their days as they come.

brh: خیر ئے ادا خیر ئے انت مسنے؟ ارے نی دا مخلوق ء جواب ء کسے واپس انت مسنے؟ خیر ئے ایلم دیر ئے جواب کرے
en: Is everything all right here? Is all well, what has happened? Hey, are you turning these people away? Why ... what has happened? Is everything all right, brother? Who refused whom?
en_old: Is everything alright here? What happened? Hey, did you give these people an answer? What happened? Is everything alright, brother? Who gave the answer?

brh: نوٹ ننے اولہ جواب کریس نوم بسونرے گنوک اینتہ کنے جواب کیوہ اولہ بسون جواب کریس ننے پاسہ میدان بابو جنگ کیوئے تہو نوما داسہ منے پیس کنا ایلوم نا موبائل اسنا پیسہ او نہ پیسہ تے ایتنہ اینتہ کے جواب
en: Look, you refused us first. You came, you madman — why are you refusing me? You came first and refused, and you tell us, 'Come to the field, I'll fight.' ... Now the money for my brother's mobile — you won't give the money; why the refusal?
en_old: Look, you answered us first. You came, you madman. Why are you answering me? You came first and answered, told us to come to the field and fight. Now your money, the money for my brother's mobile, I won't give the money. Why answer...

brh: بکینا، ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی اگر جواب کپیسے، دا سپاہ، کنے چھوئے آتے سپاہ تے، نور خان اراٹی منن تو پیسہ ماس، ئے تینا ٹنویا فون کیوا ببو، تینا پیسہ غاتے
en: ... Fine, fine — if you don't turn (us) away ... these soldiers, my lads, the soldiers ... Noor Khan, whenever we get the money, I'll phone you myself; come and take your money.
en_old: Okay, fine, fine. If you don't answer, these soldiers, my boys, the soldiers... Noor Khan, if I'm not there, the money... I'll call my people. Come, your money...

brh: ئے دمو اوئے تاتے نی تفنہ ننے ٹیم اسیٹی اراٹیما پیسہ تیسر شنالا برے ئے فون انے اسے ٹیم اسیٹی نی ہمو ٹیما بریں پیسہ تینا افینے کھڑی چار دے پد پا نور خان دا پاکٹ دا کھڑی انت اسے پارا
en: Hey ... you aren't giving it to them. Give us a time — at what time will you give the money? ... I'll phone at a certain time, you come at that time, and then 'the money isn't there' ... the watch ... after four days you say, 'Noor Khan, this pocket, this watch, what is it' ...
en_old: Hey, you didn't give it to them. Come to us at some point and give the money... call. Come at that time. Your money isn't here. The watch... after four days say, 'Noor Khan, this pocket, this watch, what is it?'

brh: کھنی ہمو دے پارہ کہ زوت ایسا یا ہورے آت ایسا یا رفیث ننے۔ یار دا کھنی نا غول باز خراب اوئی تسے۔ کھنی تو باز خراب لگینٹینے پاننے ٹائم ئس ننے ہمو ٹائم آ برے۔ نور خان مہنگائی ئے خلس فی الحال اینے کرے ٹائم او۔
en: That day the Khan says, 'Give it quickly or give it late, but give it to us.' Man, this Khan's mood has turned really bad; the Khan really looks nasty. Tell (him) to give us a time and come at that time. — Noor Khan, inflation has hit us; for now give us some time.
en_old: That day Khani said to give it to us quickly, or else give it later. Man, Khani's group has become really bad. Khani seems very bad, he's saying to give us a time and come to us at that time. Noor Khan, inflation has hit us. For now give us some time.

brh: دیرین کپرا داسا تو ایننگٹ اوٹ مسٹمی کو دے برے ونیا پیساتی ہورستخس تتویس تا گڑا ہنون چا کہ نی تروئی افاس واللہ کہ رے کنا دوان
en: Don't delay. Now I'm going; I'll come on the third day — (have) the money ... If you haven't given it by then, you'll find out ... By God, ... at my hands!
en_old: Don't delay. Now come on, whichever day it is, you'd give the money, then see that you don't have to give it. By God, my...

brh: بچ پروز او نور خان کنا پنی ہنا خبر مرینے ہا نور خان ہا فی الحال دا ٹیمانی ہنک مہنگائی ننے گنو کرے نی نی تو ننے گنو کپ
en: ... O Noor Khan ... — Yes, Noor Khan, yes. For now, these days, inflation here has driven us crazy; don't you drive us crazy too.
en_old: Bach Parwaz, hey Noor Khan, I got news. Yes, Noor Khan, yes. For now, at this time, inflation here has driven us crazy. Don't you drive us crazy too.

brh: پا تازہ نو خان کھائیک، ہسیٹمی کو دے بروٹ، پیساتی مچ کیس تخیس، ولا پاروس کنے پاتاو، ولا خالی ہم پروٹ، گنوکی
en: Listen, ... I'll come on the third day; collect the money and keep it ready. Then you'll tell me ..., and I'll have come back empty-handed again. What madness!
en_old: Say, Noor Khan, I'll come some day. Collect the money and keep it ready. Then you said you'd... then I'll go back empty-handed too. What madness.

brh: کروڑ گڑو کے ہاؤ نوش خان ہاؤ مہربانی کزو ہنک، مارا کوہ رائے مہ بوخان اللہ کلے جوان کیک مسدے گدرینگک دا مورے افا
en: ... Yes, Noor Khan, yes; please do us a favour ... God will make everything all right; these days will pass, it won't stay like this.
en_old: Yes, Nosh Khan, please do us this favor — we're not going anywhere; God will make everything right, the days will pass, it won't stay like this.

brh: خدا خلیتے دا نور خان تو اسل گنوکو بندغ سے، گنوک افس صفا گنوک سے ایلوم، جائی پاسہ دا نور خان واقعی
en: God strike him, this Noor Khan is a truly crazy man — not just crazy, completely crazy, brother. — You're right, this Noor Khan really is.
en_old: By God, this Nur Khan is a truly crazy man — not just crazy, completely crazy, brother. You're right, this Nur Khan really is.

brh: ہنو کسے دا سامک ایندا تو فل نی چیلنج کرینا دا نور خان کے ہنون پارے دا ہنون کے آک دانہ بندوبستے کروئی تمک علم گڑان طریقے نور خان نا بندوبستے کین نیکان میر بہادر خان نا نور خان نا ئے
en: Whoever ... you have challenged this Noor Khan outright ... they said ... something has to be done about him; one way or another we'll deal with Noor Khan ... Mir Bahadur Khan's ... Noor Khan's ...
en_old: Whoever it is, you have challenged Nur Khan. They said something must be arranged for him; by some means we'll deal with Nur Khan — Mir Bahadur Khan's, Nur Khan's...

brh: ئے جوان و بند و بست کیوا
en: I'll make a proper arrangement (for him).
en_old: ...I'll make a good arrangement.

brh: او میر بہادر خان، او بہادر خان، اینو مراڑے کو
en: O Mir Bahadur Khan, O Bahadur Khan, where are you today?
en_old: O Mir Bahadur Khan, O Bahadur Khan, what's happening today?

brh: زوبراک ننے اسل بلو والہ اسل کنے
en: A bully has really ... us a lot — really, me.
en_old: Strongmen have really (harassed) us a lot, me especially.

brh: ادا خیرے انمس بھلو توار ئس خلنگورے میر بہادر خان اسل ہرف بیس خیرے انمس میر صاحب نور خان توفکے حرفیس بس ذرا سٹینا نی خلق اسس خیرے اندکے نور خان خلک نی میلو
en: What's wrong here, what happened? You're shouting so loudly. — Mir Bahadur Khan, really ... — Is everything all right, what happened? — Mir Sahib, Noor Khan has taken up his gun! — Just wait a moment, you're one of the village folk ... is everything all right? Why did Noor Khan hit you ...?
en_old: Is everything well here? Why are you shouting so loudly? Mir Bahadur Khan, is everything really well? Mir Sahib, Nur Khan has come with his gun... wait a moment, you are a man of the people. Is everything well? Nur Khan is beating people...

brh: میر صاحب نی خبر اف کہ نور خان بلوچ زوراک اسے۔ ادا زوراکس مرے پانے نم تو اندے فکر دینی۔ میر صاحب نم پی بندغاسے نلکن موبائل ئس کرزٹ۔ دا ٹما میر صاحب ننتو پیسہ اف کہ نن اوفتے تن۔ نور خان زورٹ پائیک کہ نموت پیسہ اتبو۔ نن پارے۔
en: Mir Sahib, don't you know that Noor Khan Baloch is a bully? He's become a strongman here, and you just ... Mir Sahib, ... we took a mobile phone on credit. At this time, Mir Sahib, we don't have the money to give them. Noor Khan says, forcefully, 'Give the money.' We said ...
en_old: Mir Sahib, don't you know that Nur Khan Baloch is a strongman? He's a strongman here; you people just worry like that. Mir Sahib, you are a good man; we had mobile phones. At this time, Mir Sahib, we have no money to give them. Nur Khan forcibly says, 'Give me money.' That's what we said.

brh: کہ داٹھے مننتو پیسہ افک نور خان زورٹ پائک کہ ننم پیسہ توبو ہنا خاطرہ میر صاحب نور خان انیا دوئی پکے کشا ئے گڑا آن نما خدمت ئس کننگ کیو نفا بو کنے میر صاحب نا خدمت ہنا دے کہ نی ننے کلاشن استے کہ نن کا نور خان تو جنگ کے ہاو ایلم کلاشم
en: ... that at this time we have no money, but Noor Khan forcefully says, 'Give us the money.' Because of that, Mir Sahib, Noor Khan has raised his hand against us. — Then can I do you a service? — The only service I ask of Mir Sahib is that you give us a Kalashnikov so that we can go and fight Noor Khan. Yes, brother, a Kalashnikov.
en_old: Since we have no money, Nur Khan forcibly says, 'Give us money.' For that reason, Mir Sahib, Nur Khan has pulled out his hand on us... Can I do you a service? My only request of Mir Sahib is that you give us a Kalashnikov so that we can fight Nur Khan, brother, a Kalashnikov.

brh: خواجہ اگر پارے ئے ہم بریوٹو ہمو مسئلہ صفا میر صاحب نی تینے تکلیف کپہ بس ننے کلاشن نی خالی ایتے بس نن کاٹ ٹھیک ہی ایلم ٹھیک ہی ہلبو دا کلاشن نی
en: Sir, if you say so, I'll come too, and that problem will be completely settled. — Mir Sahib, don't trouble yourself; just give us the Kalashnikov alone, that's all, and we'll go. — Fine, brother, fine; take this Kalashnikov.
en_old: Sir, even if he says he'll come, the same problem. Mir Sahib, don't trouble yourself, just give us an empty Kalashnikov, that's all — we'll set it right, brother, we'll take care of it with this Kalashnikov.

brh: ننا میدان آ ببو جینا چنے دو ئس دیر تا کٹ واری ہننا کوچی تو گوڑا فک ہور لنگ گنوک مسونو ننا دبا ڈیگا تکا فس گیتنا ہموتے بولوچنا یلہ کر بولوچتا چونڈے کلکونو ننا گاٹات کسفینو یار
en: Come to our battlefield... water... with the nomads, then they have all gone lame and mad... our... let them go to the Baloch; the Baloch have struck..., they have killed our guards, man.
en_old: On our field... the horses... have gone... our... leave them to the Baloch... the Baloch... friend, they have ruined our...

brh: جنگک تو مئی دے کھارے خیر کینے دا پا مہنگائی نا مر مرے کنا ابا مرے شہزادی انارکلی الہ خنک پک ارے مون نا تو والی دیوالے لیپ کریس ستنا مونا اوستنا ئے ارے کنا نام توشنگا یک شے
en: War... may it go well... say this: of inflation... my father... Princess Anarkali... sees... surely... the guardian of the front... you plastered up the wall... in front... my name...
en_old: War... may it be well... this inflation... my father... Princess Anarkali... before you... plastered the wall... in front of... my name...

brh: شہزادی تو لیو کرین سمٹ چلو گنا مکیو لیو دے چخ شاغن لیو کرین شہزادی ئے او ننا مار خنک پخ شہزادہ سلیم انے اوم نرا اینا دونس گوبری او لیو ئس کریس انار کلے مسے واری چانہ ولئی باموس تری
en: Plaster in the princess... cement, come on... plaster... pour it... let's plaster in the princess. She... our son... Prince Salim... he too fled... you plastered Anarkali in... three times...
en_old: The Princess... let's go... the Princess... our son... Prince Salim... Anarkali... this time...

brh: چکتی سوٹ گڑا کسکیہ الا خلینومے یار رسوا کرین تنے داسہ نا اگی کسکوٹ کنا وارثوم کس فدا ملکیدا شلتنے دادا جائیداد آتے دے سنبھالے ننتو پورا وانگڑنا فصل سے غرق
en: ...then... man, we have disgraced ourselves. Now if I die, who is even my heir? ... Who will look after these properties? Our whole ... crop is ruined.
en_old: ...friend, you have disgraced yourself... now... my heirs... this property... who will look after the property? Our whole crop has been ruined...

brh: ہلی نیا ارا انگا جوڑ اٹی بس اسہ سلامت او خن نا چلی نی ئنا سحر خل تویس تینٹ اینٹونار کلے ئنا سحر خلک پیاذ کیاتو درناک عجب پیاذ کیاتو ایمونے نی خط او بس کریس پیاری وا خیراتی ڈگی نا پیاری ہلی
en: ...just one is safe, Your Majesty... you did not cast the spell yourself; Anarkali cast her spell... 'pyar kiya to darna kya' (when I have loved, why fear)... strange, 'pyar kiya to'... you... a letter... dear... charity... dear...
en_old: ...just one, Your Majesty... you cast a spell... Anarkali cast a spell... strange... you, the letter... dear... charity... dear...

brh: ملکئے کرکر خاتون خنک پا ملکئے کرکر خاتون ڈسکاخ ہمے صوبہ نی پش مسونی خاص گٹنا خلنگی ہم پاشے چڑاکنے کنے پئے بونش صرف تے کنتا ہمے گشتینی بلکنا باڈر دن گچکپہ بس شکل خلنا خلیکو نا تلوادے
en: The queen... lady, see, say: the queen... lady... that province has gone to pieces... especially... also clearly... only... the border, don't... like that... just... your sword.
en_old: Malika Karkar Khatun... that province... especially... only... the border... the sword...

brh: ئے دا دے اونو دوئی چلینگے کک دوئی ٹی لکھینا خلوئے اونا کانے آ او دوئی ناری نا جنگ چگے ٹی تیز نا بند کم بے ہوش مریک ئے نٹ تینا زوئے ئنا ناری نا وجہ غان خبر تنے ئے اصلی او سفر وا دے شاہس دا اچھا دا مائی با
en: That day his hand moves... in his hand... to his eyes... in the battle... he faints... because of his own... the real one... the journey... a king... this is good...
en_old: That day he... in his hand... in the war... he falls unconscious... because of his... the real one... the journey... this day... king... good...

brh: آرام خریت ہمو خننگان ننے سکھے بسائے فقیرو ئس مچ کریسر پیسہ یل کریسر جائیداد سیل سنتی جوڑ کریسر فقیرو ئس تین ہرفیٹ ایری تا بآرام خریت بس بادشا جوڑ مسٹ چنگنا خاموشی انچے سودا خریت کمالو گلیچی واہ رے ئے ننے پلپلی
en: Bought comfort... from seeing that, ease came to us... they had collected..., let go of the money, sold the property and made [him] a beggar... bought comfort... I just became king... silence... what a bargain he bought, wonderful... wow, ... us...
en_old: Peace and rest... from seeing that... gathered a beggar... money... property... made a beggar... peace... he became king... silence... a bargain... wonderful...

brh: او انجہ سلکٹ دائے دم بادشاہ سلامت کنکے پلی او انجہ سل توبیس ننئی نواسکی منتوانی بس رازک رازو ایتک بازو کرکر خاچن بننگٹی اوکا مسکی برے معلومات مریتے نیدون کرک لسٹ جوڑ کرک ہنڈا فنڈ والا خیرات والا پی غلہ بننگٹی دا وار نا غریباتی کے ہا سئی ایت جوڑ کے
en: ...at this moment, Your Majesty, for me... thanks... just secrets... information becomes known... make a list like this... the fund people, the charity people... grain is coming... make a proper one for the poor this time.
en_old: That... Your Majesty the King, to me... thanks... secrets... information... they made a list... the charity people... the grain is coming... this time for the poor...

brh: او تالے دا پٹ خننگ پکسائی چراتی خنوس پین تو افک پین ئس نی پٹوسو دا پٹ اٹ انتس لکھو بانگو نا چکاٹ لٹک نا بانگو نا ایرا ٹمبو خلک ننے پٹ ننے پیروک الائیک پٹ نا کا اینستنی گومے اینک شلغم نا پٹ
en: Oh, look at this field... you'd see... there isn't another, you would have searched for another... what is there in this field... the rooster's... tail... the rooster's... it's a turnip field.
en_old: Oh, look at this field... you searched, what is written in this field... ...a turnip field.

brh: او چخلیا اینا ارے چخلیا کونگولی چخلیا
en: Oh, tasted it... it is... tasted it, turnips, tasted it.
en_old: He... the Chakhliya... the Chakhliya...

brh: ادا ئے قرضدارے کرے کس کسفتنے ہتے نا پیسہ غاتے نا والا نا مغز تو خراب متنے کہ یکا فون کیسی ارا دے آ پیسہ کہ مس
en: Here, he is a debtor; he hasn't killed anyone. As for the money... the fellow's brain hasn't gone bad, that he would suddenly call and say the money will be there in two days.
en_old: Here he took a loan and never paid anyone back their money. The guy's brain isn't so messed up that he'd suddenly call and say the money will be there in two days.

brh: نی تینٹ نی آ فون کیوا بر پیسہ تے تینا درک بس زیادہ کرے جک خلپہ داسہ انسان مر عید تے پو مرک نتہ بسٹ ہموڑے گڑا گٹو کیو نی موڑے کرے خبرے نی اسل کسے کرے کسفتنوس
en: I'll call you myself: 'come, take your money.' Just, you've overdone it; don't talk nonsense. Now be a decent human being, understand that it's Eid... otherwise, if I come over there, then I'll choke you there... who knows, maybe you have never actually killed anyone.
en_old: You call yourself, come on, you've raised the money yourself... don't shout. Now be a decent person, Eid is coming... if you don't come, then I'll do that thing... you did that; maybe you've never paid anyone back at all.

brh: ہاؤ ہاؤ قرار ایت کرک، ئے تو اسل صفا ننے گرو کرے سلیاس، ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی بس داسہ خدا حافظ۔ سہی دے، سہی دے، آئی لوم خیرے نم انت؟
en: Yes, yes, calm down. This one has really put us completely in hock. All right, all right, that's it, goodbye for now. Fine, fine. Hey brother, is all well? What about you?
en_old: Yes, yes, calm down. He has really driven us crazy. Okay, okay, fine, now goodbye. Fine, fine... well, what about you?

brh: کہ بسونو رے کنا ایلوم ئے بسونٹ نا ایلوم دا ایلوم آن کنا الکو نی موبائل ئس اور مسٹ تو مسونے پیسہ دے تننگٹی اف دا سا کرے نم کنا ایتا تے بنتنو روپیہ دا سا نم مونا کرے ٹیپون نما پیسہ غاتے کرے مسٹ تو مننگے دا دے کرے پورا شش تو مننگٹی ئے ننے کہ زبان کرینے اسٹو اسینہ سہی ئے
en: When I came, my brother — I've come, your brother — you took a mobile from this brother of mine. What's done is done, but you aren't paying the money. Now you haven't listened to what I said... rupees... now you've put it off... the telephone... your money... it has now been a full six (months); you gave us your word... that's right.
en_old: When I came, brother, I came, brother. I bought a mobile from this brother. If it's done, it's done, but the money isn't being paid. Now you've held up my things... rupees. Now you put it off... your money... it's been six full... We made a promise, that's right.

brh: دا صاحب پیسہ دے مچیدو مننگے، دا اوٹی نمہ دے بس او نمہ مچیدو اینا صاحب اوٹی نم دا مہنگائی خنپیرے، نن دا سائرانن کہ نوتھلے کلینے نمہ پیسہ تیتے، او اینا صحیح ئے نم تو پیسہ اف او ایلم نا موبائل اینتھ گدا نا
en: Sir, the money is being collected... just... collected... sir, don't you see this inflation? We... that we would give you your money. Oh, right, so you have no money; oh brother, your mobile...
en_old: Sir, the money will be collected... don't you see this inflation? We... that we would give your money... that's right, you don't have the money, brother, the mobile...

brh: علم کاس قرضداری تو دنیا کے کئک نن موبائل داڑن الکن گناہ سے تو کتن گناہ سے تو کتانو داسہ موبائل الکنوری داڑن دس پیسہ تہم ارکیرے ایلم فی الحال ئے تا کنا دوخنی موبائل بنگنت فی الحال نن تو پیسہ افت وڑا رات ہم ننے پیسے ترے
en: ...the whole world takes on debt. We bought a mobile from here — have we committed a sin? We haven't committed a sin. Now we have bought a mobile from here... ten... money... brother, for now... my... mobile... for now we have no money; ... give us money too.
en_old: Debt is something the whole world takes on. We bought a mobile from him. Did we commit a sin? Did we commit a sin? Now that we bought the mobile from him, ten... money... brother, for now... my mobile... for now we don't have any money; give us money too.

brh: ادا دا سا دا ئے تے ہم پاننگ کپر نی توڑا ہمرفا پئے سننے دا سا چھوئے تیس پیسہ آتے نوم دا سا دن کبو اینو ہم بو بھلا پگا ببو توڑا پاونومے کہ را دے پیسہ اتیتے بنما۔ ایلم نوم پگا بننگ کپنے ننے دا سا پا کہ راٹم ننے پیسہ اتیس۔ انسا
en: Here, now this can't even be said to him... the money... now you do this: 'today go, well, come tomorrow, then I'll tell you that in two days... the money.' Brother, we can't come tomorrow; tell us now that you'll give us the money in two days.
en_old: Here, now don't tell them this either... now don't do this: 'come today, come tomorrow'. Tell us that in two days you'll get the money. Brother, you can't keep coming tomorrow; tell us now that in two days you'll give us the money.

brh: آنئے اسئے ہیتس پارٹ و پو مریکک پارٹ نمے کہ پگہ ببو پاوہ نمے ایلوم نم پگہ بننگ کپا ننئے دا صفا دا مہنگائی ٹی دیر پٹرول خرچ کرے سکائک ایلوم قرض قرضداری کرے رے دا صفا خرچو کروئی تمک نمے کنا ایلوم قرضدار نا رندٹ ہمیشہ بندغاک پیسہ خرچ کیرے
en: I told you one thing, understand? I told you: 'come tomorrow, I'll tell you.' Brother, we can't come tomorrow; for us, in this inflation, so much petrol gets spent... brother, we've taken loans and gone into debt... you'll have to cover this expense. My brother, people always spend money chasing after a debtor.
en_old: I'll tell you one thing... I tell you 'come tomorrow', but brother, you can't come tomorrow. In this inflation we spend so much on petrol... brother, taking loans... you have to spend. My brother, people always spend money chasing after debtors.

brh: کرا کے را کارا او کپتنے نا قرضاتے الیرے انم تو بسونو قرضات الینگے ننے پیسنے ادا اگر کنتو پیسہ مروس نا اولیکو پاننگا نی پیسہ تسوٹ ٹھیکے رسدا پاننے کرا دے پیسہ واتے برے
en: ...you take loans... we have come to collect the debts, our money... Here, if I had the money, I would have given you the money the very first time you asked. All right, then tell us which day the money will come.
en_old: ...they collect his debts. We came to collect the debts, we have money... Here, if I had the money, I'd have told you at the very start that I'd given you the money. Fine, tell me which day the money will come.

brh: پارے نی پگہ بر پگہ کہ بسس وڑا پاوٹ داندے نی پیسہ ملنگ چلو واواز دے نی خداک پکہ پرے نی یانہ دس کانے ٹھیکے داسہ ہمبو پگہ ببو
en: He said, 'You come tomorrow'; when you came tomorrow, then I would say that day you'd get the money... okay... for God's sake... ten... Fine, now go, come back tomorrow.
en_old: He said come tomorrow. When you came tomorrow, I said that day you'll get the money... for God's sake... ten... Fine, now go, come back tomorrow.

brh: ادا دا سنار پکا بسک دا بلوچستان ئے ادا نی بے فکر مرک نی قرض کرسائے نک تننگ تے کنا کاریمے
en: Here... for sure... this is Balochistan. Here you be carefree; you keep on taking loans, and repaying them is my job.
en_old: Here, this is Balochistan for sure. You don't worry, you keep taking loans; paying them back is my job.

brh: او کنا ایلم قرضدارے اینو اسکان تس کستنی نی اسل ہچ غم کپہ نی بس قرض کرسا ہنک مہنگائی خنیسے دا حکومت کرے ننے تو برباد کرے
en: He's my brother, a debtor; to this day he hasn't given anything back to anyone. Don't you worry at all, just keep on taking loans. You see the inflation; this government has ruined us.
en_old: He's my brother, a debtor; he hasn't paid back to this day. Don't worry at all, you just keep taking loans. You see the inflation; this government has ruined us.

brh: بندہ غان ہنا دا قرض کینا کنے نا اگر وقت سخت حساب کتاب ئس مس تو حکومت نا زی آ ٹی انتئے کہ مہنگائی باز زیادہ کرے نی قیامت آ ٹی کرے سوال جواب او تیرو ٹھیک ہی ایلم ٹھیک ہی ادا عید باز مسنے تسا گام بو او چنا
en: We go to someone and take this loan... if at that time there is a strict reckoning, it is on the government, because it raised inflation so much; on Judgment Day it will be questioned. All right, brother, all right. Here, Eid has... ; take a step, child.
en_old: He went to the man and took this loan... if there's a strict reckoning, it's on the government, because it raised inflation so much. On Judgment Day there will be questions and answers... Fine, brother, fine. Here, Eid has come, take a step, child.

brh: کانا
en: Let's go.
en_old: Mine.

brh: ارے پارے نی پیسہ ملنگ نی ملنگ نی ہکا پونڈ گیسے مغز ننا کھنگونس فٹ جینا خراب کریس نی انسان اسیس انت بلا اسیس اسو ہچ ہیتس بوم افسے بس دعا کر کے
en: Hey, he said: 'you'll get the money, you'll get it'... you've wrecked our brains... Are you a human being or what kind of monster are you? There's nothing at all... just pray.
en_old: Hey, he said you're asking for money... you've wrecked our brains. Are you a human or some monster? There's nothing at all, just pray.

brh: ئے انگور بسے والا پیسہ باز مریک ہا خدا حافظ ادا نم بسورے ہاؤ ایلم نم بسون واقعی زوانہ کرے پکا او بندغ بسورے دا صبا مر کسے پیسہ داتا
en: ...the money adds up to a lot. Yes, goodbye. Here, you've come. Yes, brother, we've come. Really, you did well... surely that man came... tomorrow... someone... money...
en_old: ...there's a lot of money. Yes, goodbye. Here, you've come. Yes brother, you've come, really... that man came... tomorrow... gave someone money.

brh: چوتھی سنانے ہا جوان کریرے کہ بسورے دا سدھن کبو کہ ہمبو پگہ ببو ولا پاون نمے ارا دے کرے پیسہ ملک ایلم دا انت پاوینوس نی یار درو پاریس کہ ببو پگہ پاونو ہاؤ ایلم ئے منیوہ کہ
en: ...Yes, you did well to come. Now do this: go, come tomorrow, then we'll tell you that you'll get the money in two days. Brother, what is this you're saying? Man, yesterday you said, 'come tomorrow, I'll tell you.' Yes, brother, I admit that...
en_old: ...heard. Yes, good that you came. Don't do this, 'go, come tomorrow, then I'll tell you you'll get the money in two days.' Brother, what are you saying? Man, yesterday you said come tomorrow. Yes brother, I admit that...

brh: اینمے پاریٹ، زہ اور داسام اینمے پاننگوٹ، اینو نم ہمبو، ول پگا ببو، اینمے پاوا کہ نمے ارادے آ پیسہ ملیک، اینم دان تماشہ کننگوس ننتو، تماشہ ہچ اب دا کل کرے
en: I told you that, and I'm telling you now too: today you go, then come back tomorrow, and I'll tell you that you'll get the money in two days. You're making a spectacle of us like this. No spectacle at all; now all this...
en_old: I told you, and I'm still telling you now: go today, come back tomorrow, and I'll tell you that you'll get the money in two days. You're making fun of us. No making fun at all, now all this...

brh: مہنگائی نا کارم کو مہنگائی ہم پیری دا ئے مجبورٹ ڈھنگ کپے ننے خوار کپے ننا پچ او پیسہ تس ننے ارا دے کہ دا مہنگائی ختم مس ہمو دے پیسہ ملور نمے عجیب و تیکے زدہ مہنگائی چے او ختم مرو دا مہنگائی پین زیادہ مروئی کم مفروئے دا سئی مرو
en: It's inflation's doing; inflation also... I'm helpless with this. Don't..., don't humiliate us... money... us... the day this inflation ends, that day you'll get your money. Strange... will this inflation ever end? This inflation is bound to get even worse, it won't come down; that's how it will be.
en_old: It's inflation's doing; inflation too... I'm helpless. Don't make a scene, don't humiliate us... he gave us money... in two days, when this inflation ends, that's the day you'll get the money. Strange... will this inflation ever end? This inflation will only get worse, it won't go down, that's how it'll be.

brh: میر صاحب نی ننے آ کرے بلو احسان ئس کریس سختی نا ٹیما کرے ننے بلو کارم ئس تسس نا ایلم نا دا ہچ ئس اف نم کے کنا جان ہم قربان ء دا جمٹو گلاس ہچو گلاس اف
en: Mir Sahib, you have done us a great favour; in a time of hardship you gave us great help. — No, brother, no, this is nothing; for you even my life is a sacrifice. This little 'glass' [likely the Kalash(nikov)] is nothing at all.
en_old: Mir Sahib, you have done us a great favor; in hard times you have given us a great help. Brother, this is nothing — even my life is sacrificed for you. This glass is no ordinary glass.

brh: میر صاحب بس ننے کن دعا کر بس داسہ کنے نور خان ء خلین، بالکل ننے کن دعا کر کہ اللہ ننے مدد ہمت ایت نور خان ء خلین، ٹھیک ئے میر صاحب ٹھیک ئے داسہ خدا حافظ
en: Mir Sahib, just pray for us; now let us kill Nur Khan. Really, pray for us that God gives us help and courage so we kill Nur Khan. — All right, Mir Sahib, all right. Goodbye now.
en_old: Mir Sahib, just pray for us; now we will kill Nur Khan. Just pray for us that God gives us help and courage to kill Nur Khan. All right, Mir Sahib, all right, goodbye now.

brh: ادا دا ساکنی میر صاحب نا کلاشن بس نور خان ء خلینہ ولہ کلاشن ء مکیسہ کلاشن ء سودا کینہ کنینہ پین امر کینہ
en: Here, this Kalashnikov of Mir Sahib's: are we just going to kill Nur Khan with it? But the Kalashnikov, won't you... We'll sell the Kalashnikov and live on the money. What else would we do?
en_old: Here, with this Mir Sahib's Kalashnikov, we'll just kill Nur Khan? Or won't we sell the Kalashnikov? We'll sell the Kalashnikov, what else would we do?

brh: کینتے ہو ہو ادا ادا مہنگائی کرے مخلوق ء گنوک خدا کپہ نتہ پین ہما کینتے بالکل سہی پاسہ ادا بس راہی مگانہ
en: We'll do it, yes, yes. Here, inflation has driven people crazy. God forbid, but otherwise what else would we do? You're absolutely right. Let's just get going from here.
en_old: We'll do it, yes yes. Here inflation has driven people crazy. God forbid, otherwise what else would we do. You're absolutely right; just get on the road.

brh: وار نور خان بر کینتھ احوالے ادا حال احوال دادے خیرو کیرے مسدینا
en: Come, Nur Khan, come, let's catch up on the news. How are things here these days? This Khairo... the three days...
en_old: Come, Nur Khan, let's ask how things are here. How are you, is everything well these days?

brh: ٹیم تس ننے، اگر او مسدے ٹی پیساتی تیتو، انجام تے ہندن مرو، دن کہ ریچھ بھولو نا حالے بدحال کرے، خان بالکل سئی پاننگ ئس مسدے ٹی کہ اسدے ئس بچانے، نور خان ایلو خیر ات ننے
en: He gave us a deadline: if he doesn't give the money within three days, his end will be like this, like the way the bear left Bholu in a wretched state. — Khan, you're absolutely right. Of the three days, one day is left. Nur Khan, otherwise all is well with us.
en_old: He gave us time: if he doesn't give the money within days, the outcome will be like when the bear wrecked Bholu's condition. Khan, you're absolutely right — within days, one day, he'll save us... Nur Khan, the other, gave us well-being.

brh: منیفک، او نا علاج ء سر نی کیسہ؟ بالکل، ئے او نا علاج ء کیوہ، ہم خلاص مرے داسا کنے خبر تما کہ او دنیا آن گرز افنے، دنیا تو کرینے، پر نور خان آن مشکل ء او نا بچنگ
en: Won't it work? Will you sort him out properly? — Absolutely, I'll deal with him and it'll be finished. Now I've learned that he isn't one to flee from anyone in the world; he has dealt with the world. But escaping from Nur Khan is hard for him.
en_old: Won't it work? Will you take care of him? Absolutely, I'll take care of him, and it'll be finished. Now I've learned that he's not afraid of the world — he's dealt with the world — but escaping from Nur Khan is hard for him.

brh: کنا پنی نور خان، مشکلے کنے آنو نا بچے جان۔ السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام ایلم جوڑ۔ شکرے دعا ہی نور خان، تنے وش بچے۔ خیرے تنے وش تکڑائیے پی خیرے۔
en: My name is Nur Khan; it's hard for anyone to get away from me alive. — Peace be upon you. — And upon you peace, brother, are you well? — Thanks, by your prayers I'm fine, Nur Khan. Are you well? — All well. Are you well and strong? All well.
en_old: My name is Nur Khan; it's hard for anyone to escape me. Peace be upon you. And upon you peace, brother, are you well? Thanks, by your prayers, Nur Khan, may you stay well. All well, are you well and strong? All well.

brh: خوش او، مہربانی قربان احسان، تکڑا ئے، انت حال احوال خیر ئے دادا؟ حال احوال آک ایلوم خیر ئے ہنا خیر و خون ئے مخلوق نا پیسہ اینات ئے ہلی کنے، کائنات ئے ہلی کنے، کل نا تے کنے، کل ئے ہضم کے، ہر کسے پئے کنے و جواب دے۔
en: I'm well, thank you, I'm grateful for your kindness; I'm strong. What's the news, is all well here? — Things are all well, brother. It's just that he takes people's money. He takes everything, everyone's, and swallows it all; whoever asks him, he turns them away.
en_old: Be happy, thank you, I'm grateful, kind of you. Are you strong? How are things, all well here? Things are all well, brother. But this is the welfare: he took the people's money from me, he took everything from me, everyone's from me, he swallowed it all — whoever asks me, I give an answer.

brh: دے وا اچھا ننا پیسہ درینی دا علم تان درینی ہاؤ دا ہستیاں ہاؤ نور خان نا ہیت آک بالکل صحیح او دا ببا ظالم و بندہ واسے ننا ہن شست و مریک پنجاہ ہزار درینی ننا ہم جواب کرینے
en: Well, OK, he has taken our money too, he has taken it from everyone. Yes, these people, yes. Nur Khan's words are absolutely right. This fellow is a cruel man. From us, sixty, or it comes to fifty thousand, he has taken, and he has turned us away too.
en_old: Well, okay, our money was taken, it was taken in this way; yes, these people... Nur Khan's words are absolutely true. This father is a cruel man; ours was sixty or so... fifty thousand was taken, and he has given us an answer too.

brh: ار دے رنکینی اتہ پاو پگہ تیوانے، ایلو دے تیوانے، بس پیسہ ہچ اف۔ دا سا تیوان، اینار ہیت آک، دا سا پیسہ کھلوئی انتے ہمت ئس کبو ہلموئی انتے نہ ہلی نی ہلی نی یانتے پیسہ کھلوئی انتے جنت تو مفک بندہ غمو، پیار محبت اٹ ہلی۔ ایلو ہر وڑ رے دنیا ٹی۔ او، ہاو ہاو۔
en: Every day we call him; he says 'tomorrow I'll give it to you', 'the day after I'll give it to you', but there's no money at all. 'I'll give it now,' that kind of talk. Now why should the money...? Have some courage. Why should it be taken... why not take it, you take it, you take it. Why should the money...? Man, this won't get you into paradise; take it with love and affection. Otherwise everything happens in the world. — Oh, yes, yes.
en_old: Every day you call and say tomorrow it'll all be sorted, the next day it'll all be sorted, but there's no money at all. Now it's everything, these other matters. Why do you need to take money now? Have some courage. Why won't you give, why won't you give, why take money? Man, it's not paradise; give with love and affection. Everything else in the world is like that. Oh, yes, yes.

brh: اچھا نو ہندے سے نا پیسہ او، ننا دا ایلم نا موبائل ء درے، ایلم نما موبائل ء درے نی او ہچ الیپک، او گڑس ککڑس ملیا تا ملیا پک، تو اسہ مکھن دا سدے کرے تستے، ابا سدو بندغ ئس ئے کرے ظالمو بندغ ئس نو اونا کاریم کانوڑو بندغ نی دا خریف انگا ٹیس سنگت آ بندغ نن تو بلونا
en: Okay, so it's this same man's money. He took this brother of ours' mobile. Brother, he took your mobile; he doesn't leave anything. He... something... then he buttered you up... Man, he passed himself off as a straight person, but he's a cruel person; his dealings are those of a crooked man. You thought this was a decent, friendly person; as for us, a big...
en_old: Okay, so it's the same person's money. This brother of ours has a mobile. Brother, you have your mobile, you don't leave anything, he... something... so he made it cold for you. Father, he's a cold person, a cruel person, he works like a blind man. You... this... friendly person, we are big...

brh: ایلو مزاس مسمک کندے تو کلہ اللہ نا بدوا تے ٹی یاد بائے انشاء اللہ ولا ملین حال احوال کین ٹھیک ہی اللہ خیر کے
en: Otherwise it was a pleasure. Always remember me in your prayers to God. God willing, we'll meet again and catch up. — All right, may God keep things well.
en_old: Another time it happened... remember us in your prayers to God. God willing, we'll meet again and catch up. Okay, may God make it all well.

brh: ایلم نور خان تو توسونے دا سخت اوریسے ہنتس گڑا ایلم دا ستا نی جیب آن تینا بمبٹ کشا خسا ہنت ہاؤ کڑا نور خان بمبٹ خلیف نی تو تینا
en: Brother, Nur Khan is sitting there. This is tough. Then, brother, now take your bomb out of your pocket, throw it and go. Yes, then hit Nur Khan with the bomb, you with your own.
en_old: Brother, Noor Khan is sitting there, he's very tough... then, brother, take your bomb out of your pocket and go. Yes, then, Noor Khan, throw your bomb...

brh: بمبے خستہ گڑا اونا قسمت کے ئے بچے۔ ٹھیک ئے ایلم ٹھیک ئے سئی ئے
en: Throw the bomb; then if it's in his fate, he'll survive. — All right, brother, all right, right.
en_old: He threw the bomb, then his luck saved him. Okay brother, okay, right.

brh: ایلم دا نور خان تو گرنیڈ آنم کھس بمب اوفتے ہچ کتو دا سہی گولی آٹی خلے وتا ایلم ہورے سینڈس ہمت خا خلتا ہو وڑے ہو باخٹ خلے وتا
en: Brother, this Nur Khan: the grenade too, the bomb did nothing to them. Now shoot him properly with a bullet. Brother, look... have courage, shoot him, that way, shoot him.
en_old: Brother, this Noor Khan, the grenade, the bomb did nothing to them. This time hit him with a bullet. Brother, look, have some courage, hit him that way, hit him...

brh: ارے خیرو کھڑپت ہکل دت روسوس بغیر ہکلاں خلیسہ ننے نور خان کھستنے داسکان زندہ ہی
en: Hey Khairo, you shouted... you'd have hit him without shouting. Nur Khan hasn't died on us; he's still alive.
en_old: Hey Khairo, ... shout... without shouting you'd... Noor Khan has... us, he's still alive.

brh: ہر کنے تو انت کیوے، نور خان پیالوہ تماس، ہیتاتے آن تمتوس، دا سئی نی سم اٹی خلوہ
en: Look, what will you do to me? — Nur Khan, you fell for the cup; you didn't fall for words. Now I'll shoot you with a bullet.
en_old: What will you do to me? Noor Khan, you've fallen into the trap, you didn't fall for words. Now I'll hit you with poison.

brh: خیرو تاب تور نرسرنگ نور خان داسہ گنو کیٹی بس نی داسکا نور خانا دو لغتنے
en: Khairo, hold on... running... Nur Khan is in a frenzy now. It's just that you still haven't laid a hand on Nur Khan.
en_old: Khairo, hold on, don't run. Noor Khan has now come into... you still haven't let go of Noor Khan's hand.

brh: ہمت کے خیرو خاستہ نی نور خانوس ئے ہم تو خیرو وٹ ایلم ہمہ کریس نور خان
en: Have courage, Khairo, you're tired. You, Nur Khan... me too, with... Khairo, brother, you did the same thing, Nur Khan.
en_old: Have courage, Khairo, you're tired... you too, Noor Khan... Khairo, brother, you did the same, Noor Khan.

brh: نی خلکو ساخا ایلو نور خان مگہ مرو اسہ کے خلے وتے ڈھکانے تنے ہمت کزو بخستے نور خان داسہ خلنگ مننگ اف داسہ زو کس نروئی علم کسہ نا دے ئے تک نروینگہ بسو او ڈھکانے تنے خلنگ مفک او کٹوک نر پن گڑا مرو
en: You strike... Nur Khan, though, will... Hit him once! He has hidden himself. Have courage... Nur Khan can't be hit now. Now, quickly, we have to run... he has come, he has hidden himself, he can't be hit. He's winning. Run, or something else will happen.
en_old: If you shoot, the other one, Noor Khan, won't die. Hit one, hide yourself, have courage... Noor Khan can't be hit now. Now quickly, nobody run... he's come, he's hiding, he can't be hit. He's cut off, don't run, otherwise what will happen?

brh: ٹھیک ایلو منتس کنا مرضی فصل نی این پاسے نرین پین گڑا مکن ادا نرنگ جوان افک اگر نرے پنتو نور خان خلک ننے ادا چنا سے چنا نی ایتلے بس نرا کان ٹھیک ہی بس نرا بو
en: Okay, otherwise, it's my wish... the decision... you say so; let's run, nothing else. — Then don't; running here is no good. — If we don't run, Nur Khan will shoot us here... a child, your child... Just run, okay, everyone just run.
en_old: Okay, the other one... as I wish... you say so, let's run, nothing else. Running here isn't good; if we run, Noor Khan will hit us here... just run, okay, just run.

brh: ایرو سلیبو نرے رے رانگیا سلیڑے رانگ نریسہ اریسک نریپسہ نریسہ راڑے کا بچپیسہ
en: [Kh]airo, stop! ...running... stop... you're running... you won't run... you're running. Where will you go? You won't escape.
en_old: ...running, they keep running, not running, running... they're not escaping.

brh: خیرو اگر نی آخیر مفک تے نور خان رحیم تے پک
en: Khairo, if this doesn't come to an end, Nur Khan will show no mercy.
en_old: Khairo, if you don't finish it, Noor Khan will surely... Rahim.

brh: نور خان دا خیرو تو نرا ادا خیرو نرا تو پاچھے تیرا ہرا اودا سا نور خان آن اراڑے بھچیک ننا سوچس کہ خیرو بروئے پیسہ تیرو تو سو حملہ کرئی ننا حملہ کرے جوان کرے
en: Nur Khan, this Khairo ran off; here, Khairo ran, then went back behind... Now where will he escape to from Nur Khan? Our thinking was that Khairo would come and give the money, and then... but he attacked us; well, he did it well.
en_old: Noor Khan, this Khairo ran away, here Khairo ran. Where would he escape from Noor Khan? Our thinking was that Khairo would come and give the money, then we'd attack, but he attacked us, and did it well.

brh: ارے او دا دپہ ہنا حملہ مونا کاٹومے کونیک ٹھیک ہی نوخاں بس ٹھیک ہی
en: Hey, he went this way... the attack in front... head... Okay, Nur Khan, that's enough, okay.
en_old: Hey, he went this way, attack from the front... okay, Noor Khan has come, okay.

brh: اسلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ خیرو نی بسنس؟ جی۔ خیر مرے یا نہ، پیسہ تے کنا تو آتے تنس؟ دا خیر مریک، نا پیسہ غاتے
en: Peace be upon you. — And upon you peace. Khairo, have you come? — Yes. — Is it good news or not? Haven't you brought my money? — It'll be fine, your money...
