en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you peace. Khairo, have you come? Yes. Whether all is well or not, did you bring my money? It's fine, your money...

brh: ئے نور خان دے تسونٹ دان پاننگو نور خان کنا پیسہ دے تسونس غلط پاننگٹی ئس نی ئے ہمے دے نا نور خان ئے ہناٹ ہرا بندہ غا سودا موڑے پدا افتین موبائل ئس درینے دافتے پیسہ تننگٹی اف اور ئے پاریٹ تے واقعی دا ہیت سہی ئے
en: I gave it that day, Nur Khan, I'm telling you. — You gave my money that day? You're lying. — That same day, Nur Khan, I went to the man I had made the deal with. Then it turned out he has taken a mobile from them and isn't giving these people their money. And I said to him, 'Is this really true?'
en_old: Noor Khan, I gave it that day, I'm telling you. Noor Khan, I gave my money that day, you're saying it wrong. That same day I went to Noor Khan, the person I made the deal with, and then he has a mobile, he isn't giving their money. I said to him, is this really true?

brh: ئے کنے آن ہم شستونا پیسہ درے ہر دے رنگ کینے یا دو پی پیسہ افک نور خان ایڑے تسوسہ تا تو کنے پارے کہ سیدھاؤ بندہ بس ادا نی نور خان ء تپیسے او ٹھگو بندغ سے نا پیسہ غاتے ئے اودے تسونوٹ مگر او نی پیسہ غاتے تتنے نور خان خوش
en: He took sixty (thousand) from me too. Every day I call him, and he says there's no money. Nur Khan, when I had given it there, I was told he's a straight man, just give it here. You don't know, Nur Khan, he's a con man. I gave your money to him, but he hasn't given you your money. Nur Khan, be happy.
en_old: He has had my money since sixty days. I call him every day, but there's no money. Noor Khan, when I gave it here, he told me he's a straightforward man, come here. You don't know Noor Khan, he's a con man. I gave him the money, but he hasn't given your money. Noor Khan is happy.

brh: شکے ئے و نی جنگ کین ئے ہناٹ تینا پیسہ غاتے نور خان آن ہتا ہتار منتو گڑا ئے او تو پانجا ہورٹ خیرو نی داسہ پاننگٹی ئس نور خان نا ہمیدے آ خناٹ تا ئے تک تے
en: There's doubt, and you and I would fight. I went to get my money back from Nur Khan, but it didn't happen; then I looked at him... — Khairo, now you're saying that on that same day you saw him at Nur Khan's...
en_old: Suspicion... and you fight... I went to get my money from Noor Khan, it didn't happen, then I saw him... Khairo, you're now saying that you saw Noor Khan that same day...

brh: او بندغ نی ہمہ کنے گٹو کنے گٹو کنے گٹو نیکولا گٹو مریر جوانی
en: Hey man, it's you, the same one, choking me, choking me, choking me... (unclear)... choking... (unclear).
en_old: O man, you all, strangle me, strangle me, strangle me... it's good.

brh: ئے نا دوا گھٹو ئے خانہ خراب نی پیسہ کے کنا گھٹو کسے پیسہ کے پیسہ جوان ئے کنا ئے جوان اٹ نی جوان اسس ولے لیکن نی تینا قدرے تتوس داسا کرے گھٹو ہکنے
en: Your hand, choking... hey, you wretch! You... my money... choking someone over money. Money is fine, mine is fine... You were a good man, but you didn't value yourself. Now he's choking me!
en_old: His hand... strangle... you wretch, the money... strangle me... someone's money... money is good, mine is good. You were a good one, but you didn't value yourself, now strangle...

brh: گٹو! نور خان کپا بابا کپا کنے گٹو کپیس، نور خان ادا کپا ادا کپا کنے گٹو کپا پیسہ تنے اتیوا، بس بس بئے چپ، الے داد گٹو کیوا، او گٹو کیوا دادے!
en: Choking! Noor Khan, don't, man, don't, don't choke me! Noor Khan, brother, don't, brother, don't, don't choke me, I'll give you the money! Enough, enough, be quiet. Let me, I'll choke this one, oh, I'll choke this one!
en_old: Strangle! Noor Khan, don't, father, don't, don't strangle me! Noor Khan, here, don't, don't strangle me, I'll give you the money. Enough, enough, be quiet, I'll strangle this one, I'll strangle him!

brh: پدا کرے دا دا دوا گٹو کر، الے کر گٹو کیوہ دا گٹو، الے پرتے، دادا جلالی ٹی بسٹ گٹو کیوتس الے پرتے، دادا داد الے پر، او باوا دا پارے کنے گٹو کپہ الے تہ مسکینے دا
en: Then he pulled back... this one, this one's hand... choke him. Let me do it, I'll choke this one. I won't let him go! I've flown into a rage at this one, I'll choke him, I won't let him go! This one, this one, I won't let him go! Oh father, this one said, 'don't choke me'. Let him go, he's a poor wretch.
en_old: Then do it, swallow this medicine, Ale, do it. I'll swallow this. Ale turned back; Dada came in a rage, I was about to swallow it, Ale turned back... and Father said, don't make me swallow it, Ale, poor thing...

brh: او کوڑہ دا پا پیسہ تے کنا تیسہ ہا اوتے اوتے اوتے دانا پیسہ تے تیسہ سنگتاتے اوتے اوتے اوتے دانا سنگتاتا پیسہ تے تیسہ اوتے اوتے یلہ کبو چپ یلہ کبو بس چلی بوتو خالی بو خاموش ایلو مردانہ
en: Hey you, tell this one: will you give my money? Yes, to them, them, them. Will you give this one's money to the friends? Them, them, them. Will you give this one's friends' money? Them, them. Let go, all of you! Quiet! Let go! Enough, go away, clear out, quiet, the rest of you men.
en_old: Hey Kora, tell him, will you give my money? Them, them, them... will you give his money to the friends? Them, them... his friends' money... Leave them, quiet, let go, enough, get out, clear out, quiet, the other men.

brh: ہنا ئے تے بنپ دا سامنا منا کننگٹی ئسیٹ کے منا کے کننگ گٹو گپو گڑا گیندے گٹو کسے داسے زور خالوس گڑا اونا دوا گٹو اسے دا سامنا دا کے گٹو کریر تے سات بند کرے گڑا منا موس منا دوا کرے
en: Don't listen to him. I was forbidding it in front of this one, telling him don't, don't choke him. Then he choked someone, he had put such force into it, then his hands were choking him. In front of this one they choked this one and stopped his breath, then my... my hand...
en_old: Don't let him see... in front... don't strangle... then... he applied force... then his hand... they strangled him... closed... then my hand...

brh: آ بس خیر اسے داسا کہ منا داسا معاف کتے داسا نم پستون جلالی ٹی بسو منا ایو منت اوکے کنے خبرے نی وختس جلالی ٹی برسے شہرا کلیرے لیکن بس معاف کتے ایلے تے ہن پی نا خاطرا بشخارتے پر زرے ننا
en: Ah, enough, it's all right now; now forgive him. Now you've flown into a (Pashtun?) rage. My mother pleaded with me and told me: whenever you fly into a rage, you'll (wreck?) the city. But just forgive him, let him go; for (someone's) sake forgive him, but it's our money.
en_old: Ah, enough, all is well now, forgive me now. Now you've come into Pashtun rage. My mother pleaded and told me: when you get enraged some time, you'd burn down the city. But just forgive, let the others go, for father's sake forgive them...

brh: بس دا سا ٹائم تیخیت تیننے؟ خیرو دا با پیسہ تیرا دم تیخی بس ہلو غصہ دے کنے فیر ٹائم ئتو بوپتی دا پیسہ تے دیوتے ہلو غصہ دے کھٹہ پسا کھٹہ پسا نی دیکھا ہا دیکھا نو جی ہا
en: So will you give it some time now? Fine (Khairo?), this money... take a breath. Enough, calm down, don't be angry; give me time again... I'll give them this money, calm down, don't be angry, I'll gather the money, gather the money. You see? Yes, see, no... yes sir, yes.
en_old: Just give me some time now? Khairo, this money... just give me time, take it, don't be angry, then give me time... this money for them, take it, don't be angry... you see, yes, see, yes sir.

brh: سودا کانے ہمو ٹریکٹر نا کینے لیلا۔ ٹھیک ہی دادا پین سودا ٹی۔ وائل نا۔ ٹھیک ہی نا پین سودا ٹی۔ ٹھیک ہی دانا کیتے ول ہمے کساپ نا تے کیتے کساپ نا ترسا۔ ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی گڑا ننے منظور ئے ننے ہندے سودا کے ٹریکٹر نا۔ او بالکل کنے منظور ئے
en: The deal: let's go make the deal for that tractor... (unclear). OK, this is in the other deal... OK, in your other deal. OK, I'll do his, and settle the account again, the account... OK, OK, then we agree; we'll make this very deal for the tractor. Yes, absolutely, I agree.
en_old: Kane, the deal is for that tractor, Leela. Okay, this is the deal... okay... the price... the butcher's... Okay, okay, so we agree, we have a deal on the tractor. Yes, I absolutely agree.

brh: اوئے سجاد جی جی ایلو ماما کسر نا سلاہ سلاہ نا دے بسکارے ٹھیک ٹھاک دے سودا کینے ایفتے ہڈے ریشے
en: Hey Sajjad! Yes, yes. The other uncle... the advice about the road... the day for consultation has come. All right, one day we'll make the deal... (unclear).
en_old: Hey Sajjad, yes, yes, the other uncle... the day for advice has come, all right, the deal is done...

brh: او اینو پگہ اینو پگہ اینو پگہ او توئی دے گڑا دا سے چوٹے دا سے تال سیدھا او مکھا فین ٹریکٹر ایتھے لنگا رنی کھڑا او مکھا فین ٹریکٹر ایتھے لنگا رنی کھڑا او مکھا فین ٹریکٹر ایتھے گیت سودا دا چلے فنگ چائک آ بس سئی ہی آ دا چلے فنگ چائک بس سوار
en: Oh, today or tomorrow, today or tomorrow, today or tomorrow, and the (other) day. Then this small... this... straight... [in Punjabi] oh, the tractor passed by here, it stood... oh, the tractor passed by here, it stood... oh, the tractor here... the deal is going ahead... just right... the deal is going ahead... just get on.
en_old: Today, tomorrow, today, tomorrow... then this small one... straight... the tractor passed through here... the deal goes ahead... okay, okay... get on.

brh: خدا دے تنے نا جان ئے چھٹے بابا ہر دے نا مسدے مسدے دا سال لڈی مسدے افک ٹھیک ئے ٹھیک ئے نا پیسہ دے متی سے ہاؤ نما پیسہ دے متی سے چلو ٹھیک ئے ہاؤ دے دے تنے نا بس ٹھیک ئے ادا خدا نا امان اسو ببو کانے
en: May God (spare) your life, Baba. Every day... this year... there hasn't been... OK, OK, your money... yes, your money... come on, it's fine. Yes, here, it's yours, that's fine. Brother, go in God's protection; come on, come along, let's go.
en_old: May God grant you life, father... every day... this year... okay, okay, the money... yes, your money... come on, fine, yes, give it... just fine. Here, go in God's protection, goodbye Kane.

brh: دا زار نا باروٹی آ کہ داڑے امر مخلوق رہینگک؟ آ؟ جی بالکل دا صفا پوک ئے وتے۔ پوک سے؟ ہا پوک ئے وتے۔ گل جان! دا کنے انت پوک ئیکہ کہ دا واسطہ کتی نی تو پوک ئے نہ نہ ئے پو مسٹ نی دا کنتو ہیت کپاٹ وار پارینوٹ نی آ نوکر کے تے نخرہ کے آئی دے!
en: About this town: what kind of people live here? Huh? Yes, absolutely, this one is completely useless. Useless? Yes, he's useless. Gul Jan! What useless thing are you telling me, that you made this plea? You're the useless one! No, no, me useless? Don't you talk to me like this. I've told you before: you're a servant, and you put on airs!
en_old: About this area, what kind of people live here? Huh? Yes, absolutely, this place is completely empty. Empty? Yes, it's empty. Gul Jan! What nonsense are you telling me... you're the empty one, no, no... you didn't talk to me, I told you once already, you're a servant, don't put on airs!

brh: ئے دے ئے دے ئے دے ئے دے ئے دے ئے دے ارے کپ ئے ئے دے ئے دے ئے دے ئے دے خدا نا منت او خلائی بخروک ئے دے ئے دے ئے دے طبع ئے دے پنت اوار دے اٹ ئے دے خواجہ یار ئے دے ئے دے ئے دے
en: Hey de, hey de, hey de, hey de, hey de, hey de, oh don't, hey de, hey de, hey de, hey de. Thanks be to God and to the Bestower (of creation?), hey de, hey de, hey de, (good) nature, hey de, together with advice, hey de, Khwaja Yar, hey de, hey de, hey de.
en_old: Hey, hey, hey... thank God, O generous Creator... hey, hey... with advice... Khwaja Yar, hey, hey...

brh: عیدی ارا کے تنے سالے کے عید برے عیدی تنے عیدی عیدی عیدی عیدی تنے عیدی عیدی عیدے عیدے عید عیدے اینے اعلان کۂ کل کل کل پی عیدے عیدے ڈاں نانگ مئے عید تس مے جی
en: Eidi! Who gives Eidi? Once a year, when Eid comes, give Eidi! Eidi, Eidi, Eidi, Eidi, give Eidi! Eidi, Eidi, Eid, Eid, Eid, Eid! Today the announcement was made: tomorrow, tomorrow, tomorrow... Eid, Eid... he gave us Eidi, yes sir.
en_old: Eidi, who gives... the year when Eid comes, he gives Eidi... Eidi, Eidi, Eidi, Eidi... Eid, Eid... today the announcement that everyone, everyone... Eid, Eid... gave us Eid...

brh: بابو، بابو، ئے او ٹی او ٹی گلجان ڈسکو، ڈسکو، بابو، دوزہ صف بابو گلجان ڈسکو
en: Babu, Babu, hey, oh... oh... Gul Jan, disco, disco, Babu, (unclear), Babu, Gul Jan, disco.
en_old: Babu, Babu, hey, oh, Gul Jan disco, disco, Babu... Babu, Gul Jan disco.

brh: ئے اوٹ ئے ارے خانہ نیک نی تو صفا کنا زو ہستے کشاس ہا بابو ئے ہمار لگینگٹ دا بلا پجھا تن بابو او خانہ نیک کش ادا پجھا غاتین کوٹ کیتین ہاو
en: Hey... hey, oh Khana Nek, you've really yanked my... off! Yes Babu, hey, it's stuck... this damn thing, pull it back, Babu. Oh Khana Nek, pull it, brother, back... (unclear) yes.
en_old: Hey... Khana Nek, you've really pulled my hair! Yes Babu... this thing is stuck... pull it back, Babu, oh Khana Nek, pull it back...

brh: دھنگ بر ہن مزار نا اونی دھنگ تو بر تول داغ کوٹ کپرتی کوٹ کپرتی تول داغ او ہاننے دا ہنت کرینو استنے اسے وار ہرتنے شیشہ ٹی خاننے تھنے ور اسو گنو کاتمب
en: Come this way, go to the shrine... come this way with him, sit... don't... sit... and I did this... then once I looked at myself, I saw myself in the mirror: a crazy-looking head.
en_old: Come on, let's go to the shrine... come... I did this, then once I turned around and looked in the mirror at my head...

brh: کرے نوس تے کشی دفتے نہ بابو دادے کشپرا بابو ئے بینگنوٹ کرا دشتا رے کرے بلو پوجا باز دوست مریک بابو اندا خاطرے دا وگ ئیل کنٹ تینگے او خانہ نیک اوڑتے نی چہرے تے نی صفا
en: You've done it to him, take it off. No Babu, I won't take this off, Babu. Hey, I've heard... Billo Pooja likes it a lot, Babu; that's why I've put this wig on myself. Oh Khana Nek, ... your face, you're totally...
en_old: Don't take them off, Babu, don't take this off, Babu... Bilo loves puja very much, Babu, that's why this wig... oh Khana Nek, your face is completely...

brh: او نو کمباروس کشیدہ دے بابو ئے نو کمباروس او نو کمباروس ئے زیب آوٹ بابو او زیب آؤس نی بابو
en: Oh, a new... embroidered... Babu, hey, a new... oh, a new... Have I become beautiful, Babu? Oh, you have become beautiful, Babu.
en_old: Oh, a new embroidered... Babu... oh you've become beautiful, Babu, oh you look beautiful, Babu.

brh: ئے نوک امبر وٹی توبے امبر انتئے ہفٹ؟ ارے بابا ارونت پاننگ اٹیٹ جوانو ئس نی۔ بابو ئے پھل امبر انتئے ہفٹ آ؟ ہا ننے دے۔
en: Hey, ... amber... oh my, why did I pick amber? Oh Baba, what are you saying, you're a fine one. Babu, hey, why did I pick the amber flower, huh? Yes, for us.
en_old: Hey, why didn't you bring the amber...? Oh Baba, what are you saying, you're a good one. Babu, why didn't you bring the amber flower? Yes, for us.

brh: ہن مسوسہ پوم افیدے نی پاوہ ٹپ کپائٹ انٹوٹ بابو ئے اگر پھل ئس مسٹوٹے تو ارا پھل مسٹوٹے بابو خاننے گھوڑخ نا پھل مسوسہ گھوڑخ نا پھل گھوڑخ نا پھل ہاؤ بابو
en: ... you say ... (unclear) ... Babu, hey, if I were a flower, which flower would I be? Babu: Look, you'd be a ghorakh flower, a ghorakh flower, a ghorakh flower. Yes, Babu.
en_old: ...you say don't... Babu, if you were a flower, which flower would you be? Babu, look, I'd be a ghorakh flower, a ghorakh flower, yes Babu.

brh: اوئے چمبیلی نا پھل انتئے مٹاوٹئے؟ نہ اگہ ئے چمبیلی نا پھل ئس مسوٹ گڑا انت مسکہ بابو؟ ارے کنا نی دماغ ء کنگس، دماغ ء، دماغ ء کنگس، کنگس، اوہ بابو، بابو کنا لگے کہ موسنے بے سری ریڑی چلیفیس
en: Hey, why wouldn't I be a jasmine flower? No, if I were a jasmine flower, then what would happen, Babu? Oh, you've eaten my brain, my brain, my brain, eaten it, eaten it! Oh Babu, Babu, it seems to me that you're driving a headless cart.
en_old: Hey, why did you change the jasmine flower? No, if it had been a jasmine flower, what would have happened, Babu? Oh my, you've eaten my brain, eaten my brain! Oh Babu, Babu, I felt like you were driving a headless cart.

brh: ارے بس اوننا لٹنا پیریاک پاننگو ارے نی دے باری گی بیش ریڑی چلے وینٹ نی سمائی کے جواننگا بندغاتے خسار کنے محبوب محبوب خلپیس محبوب فجنا تیکنے محبوب کنا جواننگا
en: Oh, enough of telling those stories of his! Hey, you go drive a donkey cart... you ruin good people. Mahboob, Mahboob, don't hit me! Mahboob... (unclear)... Mahboob, my dear one.
en_old: Hey, that's enough of their talk... hey, you drive the cart... you're losing good people... my beloved, beloved, don't hit... beloved, my dear...

brh: بابو ہیچ جام پٹک دگہ ننا نوان ئنا ئنا بابو کسمے انو لگے کسپائے وقتی ماسٹر جی گسمسوسنے بابو اڑے ئے پا چپ کر چپ کر ایت بابو اوہ ہندوں پٹ اوہ سونگ کریس کریس
en: Babu isn't looking for anything... again our new... Babu, today it seemed... at that time Master-ji had gone missing, Babu. Hey, say it... be quiet, be quiet... Babu. Oh, search like this... oh, you're putting on an act, you are.
en_old: Babu isn't looking for anything... our new... Babu, it seemed... at that time the schoolmaster went missing, Babu. Hey, say it... quiet, quiet, Babu, oh look for it like that, oh you made a song...

brh: ہلہ ہلہ! بلتنگٹ بابو پین ہمہ پلہ۔ ئے تو بینٹ کورس اٹاؤ۔ ہی ئے چمبیلی نا پل۔ ارے کڈے اکھلے، ہٹ کٹو کریس کنے، نتے کنے بلٹ۔ معاف کیس بابو، معاف کیس۔ ہلہ تے کنے شاغو۔
en: Come on, come on! ... Babu, that other side too. Hey, you... (unclear). Hey, jasmine flower. Oh... you've hurt (squeezed?) me, you... me. Forgive me, Babu, forgive me. Come on, put me down.
en_old: Come on, come on! ...Babu, the other side too. ...Hey, jasmine flower. Hey... you've hurt me, you hit me. Forgive me, Babu, forgive me. Come on, put me down.

brh: جی بابو، سے بابو ٹی، چمبے نا ٹکور، اوئے اڑے!
en: Yes Babu, ... Babu, a jasmine compress, hey you!
en_old: Yes Babu... Babu, a jasmine bud, hey you!

brh: دا بٹو ٹیم ئس بس کنے آ، پینزاری کنے دن نوکری آن مہمان مہمان مہمان ہر دے مہمان، اوئے کنکے ئے کا
en: This ... time came to me. I'm fed up with this kind of job: guests, guests, guests, guests every day. Hey, ... go!
en_old: This... came to me... from work, guests, guests, guests, guests every day, hey...

brh: میر صاحب اراک بائیکانی ابا ابا اور اندونی ٹی کنے ریپنگ اٹی ء دا وڑ والا تے اسل احساس اف کہ ئسیٹ نوکر ئس ئنا میرو عرف میر جان ہی ہی میرو اریسٹ
en: Mir Sahib, which... Dad, Dad, and... me... people of this sort have no real sense that someone is a servant. Miro, alias Mir Jan, hee hee, Miro is here.
en_old: Mir Sahib, who are you... Father, Father... people like this have no real sense that someone is a servant... Mir, also called Mir Jan, hee hee, Miro is here.

brh: دا نوکرس، داٹی اچہ کفک۔ امی انت پارے تے، نوکر گیتے نخرہ کے میرو میرو اینوم! ابوئی، نی انت کننگ ئس ئے ئے چاپ خلنگ اٹ اٹ، ڈانس کننگ اٹ اٹ، پین انت کننگ اٹ اٹ؟
en: This one's a servant; nothing comes of this. What did Mom tell him? The servant puts on airs. Miro, Miro, today too! Dad, what are you doing? I'm clapping, I'm dancing, what else would I be doing?
en_old: This is a servant, nothing happens with this. What did Mom say? Servants put on airs. Miro, Miro, today! Dad, what are you doing? Clapping, dancing, what else are you doing?

brh: وت نزانی کہ گومن دیما چے او بیت وتی سنگت تانی کرا رے تئی چے خیال ء تئی سنگت ترا وتی کرا دارنت مسٹر
en: You don't even know yourself what lies ahead for me. You are going to your friends' place; what do you think, will your friends keep you with them, mister?
en_old: You don't know yourself what lies ahead. Go to your friends. What do you think, will your friends keep you with them, mister?

brh: بشر ئے خیالا شوا تینا دلا پکش من زانی پدا ہما برورے بابا تو برو آرام کر ما اشیر وت سرپد کنا
en: Keep Bashir's thought in your heart... I know. Then... Father, you go and rest; we will make him understand ourselves.
en_old: Keep Bashir's concern in your heart, I know. Then that brother... father, you go and rest. We'll work it out ourselves.

brh: چھ بوگوشین من ہچ مننگ مچ کار نہ کنت ہر چیزے کہ بوگوشین بے فائدہ گنت
en: What can I say? None of my [words] work. Whatever I say turns out to be useless.
en_old: What can I say? Nothing works for me. Whatever I say is useless.

brh: جاوید، بزا تا فیصلہ غتک۔ کرن، پمے یک راہ ہم نمتہ۔ او دہ پسی تب شر نیت، رفعت۔
en: Javed, I mean, the decision is [unclear]... For us not even a single way is left. And father's health isn't good either, Rifat.
en_old: Javed, well, it's their decision. Karan, there isn't a single way left for us. And his mood isn't good either, Rifat.

brh: دے مسلٹ او دے منی زندہ صاحب انت راہ دیر کجگہ ضرورت ہم نیت چیا کہ دوہ جنجال آتا کپے جاوید
en: Those are problems, and those are my life, sir. There is no need to go a long way either, because you would get caught up in troubles, Javed.
en_old: Those days have passed, and those days were my life, sir. There's no need to go far, because of these troubles, Javed.

brh: ترا یاد ات مچو نی چنے واب تیستگتے کجا شتنت تئی مہر تئی محبت کمی یاد بکن
en: Do you remember how many dreams you had shown me? Where did they go? Your love, your affection, remember them a little.
en_old: Do you remember all the dreams you showed me? Where did they go? Your love, your affection, remember them a little.

brh: کمی بیمار
en: A little sick.
en_old: A little sick.

brh: السلام علیکم میر صاحب۔ وعلیکم السلام بیا واجہ فتح جان۔ چہ حال ئے طبیعت؟ جوڑ وش۔ بیا بننگ۔ بیا روا۔ بیا۔ اللہ۔ چہ حال ئے منی واجہ؟ چہ حال ئے جوڑ وش ئے جوڑ۔ الحمدللہ۔ ملک جوڑ ئے شکر۔
en: Peace be upon you, Mir Sahib. And upon you be peace; come, Mr. Fateh Jan. How are you, how is your health? Fine and well. Come, sit down. Come, come in. Come. God... How are you, my dear sir? How are you, are you fine and well? Fine. Praise be to God. Is everyone back home fine? Thank God.
en_old: Peace be upon you, Mir Sahib. And upon you be peace, come, Mr. Fateh Jan. How are you, how's your health? Fine and well. Come, come in. Come, sit. Come. God. How are you, my dear sir? How are you, fine and well? Fine. Praise be to God. Is the country well? Thank God.

brh: اللہ سخی، خوش عالم جوڑ وشے، مہربانی اللہ، مہربانی، ہلکا برے، چھو ماتگے، چے حال چے احوال ترا گون حال احوال بائد تو وت زانے، منا امید تے کہ تو منا نا امید نہ کنے
en: Allah Sakhi and Khush Alam, are they fine and well? Thank you, God; thank you. How is the village? How have you come? How are things, what's the news? I need to have a talk with you, as you know yourself. I hope you won't disappoint me.
en_old: God is generous, Khush Alam. Are you well? Thanks be to God, thank you. Come a little closer. Have you come after a long time? How are you, what's the news? I need to talk with you, as you know yourself. I hope you won't disappoint me.

brh: منی دل ہم لوٹیت کہ متارا ناامیت مکنہ بلے دنیائے تژنانی سگگ سک گرانت او پدا
en: My heart also wants not to disappoint you, but bearing the world's taunts is very hard, and then...
en_old: My heart also wants not to disappoint you, but it is very hard to bear the world's taunts, and then...

brh: واجہ فتح جان ئے ہبراتو شری ازانے او سرپدی کہ م لغوری بہتام ازرت نہ کنا او پدی ئے عمرہ
en: Mr. Fateh Jan, you know this matter well and you understand that we cannot bear the accusation of cowardice, and then, at this age...
en_old: Mr. Fateh Jan knows these matters well; he understands that I cannot take on the blame of laziness, and after that, the rest of his life...

brh: باز مشکل انت باز۔ سہی گشے میر صاحب بالکل سہی گشے۔ ولے میر صاحب زند ئے پیمہ نہ گوزیت۔ بازے مردم ہمے پیمہ زند آ گوازینور۔
en: It's very difficult, very. You're right, Mir Sahib, absolutely right. But, Mir Sahib, life doesn't pass like this. Many people spend their lives in just this way.
en_old: It's very difficult, very. You're right, Mir Sahib, absolutely right. But Mir Sahib, life doesn't go on like this. Sometimes people spend their lives just like this.

brh: بلے نو شاد وشحال ہمو اہمیت نشتا گنے۔ ایہہ گرانے کاری نا ہی سکھیں گرانے کاری میر سکھیں گرانے کاری بوگہ پرچہ؟
en: But now joy and happiness no longer have that importance. This is a difficult matter, a very difficult matter, Mir, a very difficult matter. Why is it becoming so?
en_old: But now happiness and joy no longer have that importance. This is hard work; why, Mir, is it becoming such hard work?

brh: اچھا کہ ما وتی دود و ربیدگ ء حسابا توشے زانے کہ ئے دنیا ہا
en: Well, according to our customs and traditions, you know too that this world...
en_old: Well, according to our customs and traditions, you know that this world...

brh: مئے چاگردے تہا چپ آ ارزانی و آسانی آ کس وتی بدلہ ئے الہ دتہ نہ کنت میر صاحب یک نہ یک روچے چشما وش بیت
en: In our society nobody lets go of their revenge so cheaply and easily, Mir Sahib. One day or another it will come out well.
en_old: In our society nobody can take their revenge so cheaply and easily, Mir Sahib. One day or another, things will turn out well.

brh: بھلے ئے میڑہ عزت و شرف بدیت تو باز جوان بے میر صاحب ہمے اوارے سرا شما کمو کے سوچ بھی کریت ہاو
en: If this mēṛh [reconciliation delegation] is given honour and dignity, it would be very good, Mir Sahib. Please think a little about this matter too, yes.
en_old: If he is given honour and dignity, that would be very good, Mir Sahib. Please think a little about this matter too, yes.

brh: نم گڑا منا اجازت انت۔ تئی مہربانی، مہربانی، مچاری نش۔ جان، اللہ یار۔ مچاری دلا جیڑے، مہربانی۔
en: Well then, I take my leave. Thank you, thank you, don't worry. Dear, God be with you. Don't take it to heart, thank you.
en_old: Then I'll take my leave. Thank you, thank you, don't worry. Dear Allah Yar, don't worry in your heart. Thank you.

brh: شر ہرچی کہ منی دلء عدالت فیصلہ کے نن منم ہما وڑ کنے انسپکٹر ہرچی واہشت تو زرتا اور منی لوگ
en: Fine, whatever the court of my heart decides, I will do the same. Inspector, whatever you wanted, you took, and my house...
en_old: Fine, whatever the court of my heart decides, I will act accordingly. Inspector, take whatever you want, and my house...

brh: او غاتگے او منیسا الزام جتگے او غا آئندہ منی لوگا تو ہمے وائسہ زورت او منیسا الزام جنگہ کوشش کرتے تو من برزا گپ جنی
en: He came and accused me. If in future he comes to my house with this same thing and tries to accuse me, then I will speak out loudly.
en_old: He made a mistake, he accused me. If he ever comes to my house again with such things or tries to accuse me, I will speak out loudly.

brh: او جنگل نا قانون ئے او جنگل نا قانون ئے
en: That is the law of the jungle, that is the law of the jungle.
en_old: Oh, it's the law of the jungle, it's the law of the jungle.

brh: ماترا ایدامی اترا لوٹانتو کے
en: We have called you here because...
en_old: We want you here so much.

brh: مارا حال رست کہ دا یک گینگ یست کہ آ ڈرگ و دگہ ہمے وڑے کاروبارء کنت او برے برے کشت و خون ہم بینت
en: We received news that there is a gang here that deals in drugs and other businesses of that kind, and sometimes killings and bloodshed also happen.
en_old: We received news that there is a gang that deals in drugs and other business like that, and sometimes killings and bloodshed happen too.

brh: ئے بابتا تو مئے کمکء کرت کنے۔ واجہ منتھک شریفی مردمے آن ئے کاروبار چنکئی ء دا بھوگ ء اینت۔
en: In this regard you can help us. Sir, I am a decent man; this business... [unclear].
en_old: You can help us in this matter. Mr. Mantahak Sharifi is the man who built this business up from something small to this level.

brh: بلے من نہ زانیں کہ کاروبار ء کئے کنت واجہ من تو میر نذیر ء مردم اون ما میر نذیر ء شری ء زاناں۔ بلے ہر وہدا کہ تئی ضرورت کپت ترا ہم ما لوٹائیناں۔ ئے گپ ء وتی ذہن ء بدار۔ برو بوتے۔
en: But I don't know who runs the business, sir. I am just Mir Nazir's man. We know Mir Nazir well. But whenever we need you, we will call you too. Keep this in mind. Go, that's all.
en_old: But I don't know who runs the business, sir. I'm Mir Nazir's man, and we know Mir Nazir well. But whenever we need you, we'll call you too. Keep this in mind. Go, that's it.

brh: جی بالکل سر، انو توشوت کنے، مہربانی واجہ۔
en: Yes, absolutely, sir. Now you can go. Thank you, sir.
en_old: Yes, absolutely, sir. You can go. Thank you, sir.

brh: ہیلو جاوید توئے؟ ہما ما رواگاں، ایئرپورٹ ء۔ ہاں نوں رواگاں، ہمے خاطرا من ٹیلیفون کتوں شمارا خدا حافظ نہ کتوں تا شمارا خدا حافظ بہ گشیں۔ تئی پیسہ ادہ نئنت۔
en: Hello, Javed, is that you? Yes, we are leaving, for the airport. Yes, we're leaving now; that's why I phoned. I hadn't said goodbye to you, so I could say goodbye to you. Your money isn't here.
en_old: Hello Javed, is that you? We're leaving, for the airport. Yes, we're leaving now. That's why I phoned you. I hadn't said goodbye to you, so I called to say goodbye. Your money isn't here.

brh: رفعت حمید ہند جاویدا تو چے گوشاگائے تو ہفت دریا آدیم رواگائے وارانون تو ئے خاطرہ ٹیلیفون کرتگ کہ مارے خدا حافظ بگوشہ
en: Rifat, Hamid... what are you telling Javed? You are going away beyond the seven seas, and you phoned just for this, to say goodbye to us?
en_old: Rifat Hamid, what are you telling Javed? You're going across the seven seas, so he phoned to say goodbye to us.

brh: جی! خیرین چے؟ جاوید تو شری سرا زانے کہ مگیسے حالت چے بند۔ ہنگا تو تو اینکس دور رواگا؟
en: Yes! Is everything all right? Javed, you know very well what our household's situation is. So then you are going this far away?
en_old: Yes! What's the matter? Javed, you know well what state we're in. So why are you going so far away?

brh: ہاؤ ترا گناہ ئس نیستے مرچا دور انچو شے
en: Yes, it's not your fault. These days the times are like this.
en_old: Yes, it's not your fault. Times are like this these days.

brh: رفعت بزور جاوید ء فون ء۔ ہیلو۔ جاوید؟
en: Rifat, take Javed's phone. Hello. Javed?
en_old: Rifat, pick up Javed's phone. Hello. Javed?

brh: گبانی، تو مروچی وتی کسہ بگوش کہ مدام تو گوشئے کہ منی باز مزنیں کسہ باز مزنیں کسہ۔ ہاں بانو، کسہ تو سک باز مزن
en: Gabani, tell your story today, since you always say, "My story is a very big one, a very big story." Yes, Bano, the story really is very big.
en_old: Granny, tell your story today, since you always say, "My story is a very big one, a very big one." Yes, lady, the story really is very big.

brh: ہمے خاطرا دلگوشائیں کہ دگے روچے شوانہ گشیں دگے وختی ئے تئی دگہ واد دگہ واد کدی گٹ مروچی بگوش۔ شہر بانو۔
en: That's why I'm keen: you say another day, in the evening, another time. This is yet another promise of yours, another promise. Until when? Tell it today, Shahr Bano.
en_old: That's why I'm eager: you always say another day, this evening, another time. Your promise is followed by another promise. When? Tell it today. Shahr Bano.

brh: اخس شما ملامت گوشگایت لاچار کننگایت الو امر چمن گوشیننے ئے دے ئے کچاساری ملے سانگ ملے ناکو زت کبو تگت
en: You keep blaming me and forcing me into helplessness. Now how can I tell... one day... my betrothal, my uncle... (the rest is garbled).
en_old: How much you blame me and leave me helpless... how will Chaman say... one day... uncle...

brh: من وتی السے خاطرا چے چے نہ کٹ محنت کٹ مزدوری کٹ شپ و روچ کار کٹ ئے وتی مہری خاطرا بلے بلے یک پچائے گپ مرے درے سرا سنگے وڑ آ پروشٹ
en: What didn't I do for my family! I toiled, I did labor, I worked day and night for the sake of my love. But, but a single word struck like a stone against a door, and it shattered.
en_old: What didn't I do for my family? I toiled, I labored, I worked day and night for the sake of my love. But one wrong word hit like a stone against a door and shattered it.

brh: کمنی مئی نا کواپ اما مالو زر واتر کوتنت کمن پارو سے خاطر آ داتگے تنت من گوشت کے منی قصور چے انت شما
en: ...in reply they returned the goods and the money, saying they had given them for that reason. I said, "What is my fault?" You...
en_old: ...the in-laws gave the money back... they said they had given it for that reason... I said, what is my fault? You...

brh: شما ئے مارزا رند چیا واتر کنگائت؟ شما زانت کہ ئے چے گشت؟ آئی ء گشت کہ تو غریب ئے۔ نہ، ما سیری مردم انت۔ ہمے خاطرہ، ہمے خاطرہ ما وتی جنک ء یک سیری مردمے ء دات۔
en: Why are you sending (her) back after this? Do you know what he said? He said, "You are poor." No, we are well-off people. That's why, that's why we gave our daughter to a well-off man.
en_old: Why are you sending her back after a while? Do you know what he said? He said you are poor. No, we are well-off people. That's exactly why we gave our daughter to a well-off man.

brh: ہمار او چپ منے دلٹ ترشت ماوتی مہرانی ماڑی کے پاو واہگے وستگات آ ٹک و ٹک بوتھے منے وشے
en: That day my heart broke. The palace of love that we had built with longing fell to pieces, and my happiness with it.
en_old: That silence broke something in my heart. The palace of love we had built shattered piece by piece, and so did my happiness.

brh: منی وشی لغت مار کرک اٹی ات، منی خاطرا زند ء درای راون کننگ اٹی ات، یک روچے، یک روچے پموتی دے سا یک مزنے سنگے بست او وتی میتگ
en: My happiness lay in... (unclear); for my sake it lay in keeping life's journey going. One day, one day I put a big stone on my heart, and my village...
en_old: My happiness was in my husband's arms, and for my sake he was carrying on life's journey. One day, one day, he tied a big stone on his... and his village...

brh: وتی ماسٹر پیس، وتی براس و گہار، یل داتٹ، او ادا شہرا سربوتٹ، وادیکے، وادیکے من ادا سربوتٹ، من ہمے فکر کوٹ
en: My mother and father, my brother and sister, I left them, and arrived here in the city, a valley, a valley, I arrived here, and I thought this...
en_old: My masterpiece, my brother and sister, I left them all and arrived here in the city, in the valley. I arrived here, and I thought this...

brh: کیسن چھونکوزیت بلے وختی کہ ادامن ماسے پیسے براسے او گوہارے مہ کے دست تو من انے فکر کت کہ ئے گمانی ترا تو ادا ہرچی رسگائنت ترا یکایک
en: (Unclear start)... but when I had no mother, no father, no brother and no sister here to give me a hand, I thought that perhaps whatever comes to you here comes to you all at once.
en_old: No one asks, but when I had no mother, father, brother or sister here to hold my hand, I thought that maybe whatever came to you here would all come at once...

brh: مہرین نا صدقہ بلے بلے ادا توم مہرانی آنبار انت ہمے خاطرا من فیصلہ کوٹ کہ موتی گستگیں گاماں بے خیال کینتے ہمے لوگا زند گوازینتے
en: Thanks to the loving ones... but, but here the people are storehouses of love. That's why I decided to put my past steps out of my mind and spend my life in this house.
en_old: For the sake of love... but here the people are a store of love. That's why I decided to forget my broken steps and spend my life in that house.

brh: او گواش یا گوازینت ہمبانوک ہما روچا بیگرت روچے مروچی ئے گمانی ہمے بے سر و سامانی ہست گوازینت ہمے بے سر و سامانی
en: And she spent it... that lady, from that day until today, perhaps, she has spent it in this destitution, this destitution.
en_old: And she spent it... that lady, from that day until today, maybe in that destitution she spent it, that destitution.

brh: ئے دنیا ہمے وڑ انت کمانے، تئی قصہ باز دردناک انت۔
en: This world is just like this, Kamane. Your story is very painful.
en_old: This world is just like this, Kaman. Your story is very painful.

brh: من ہمے مارتہ گٹ کہ آ کمی صبر کنت بلے نو منا چیزے نہ چیزے کنگی ات
en: I had sensed that she would be patient a little, but now I had to do something or other.
en_old: I thought she would be a little patient, but now I had to do something or other.

brh: دولت تھی اسر نو نزدیک ہتا تو بلا ہیں ٹاہی جتک پس سزائے واستہ تیار ببو
en: Dolat... now that he has come close and struck such a terrible blow, then be ready for the punishment.
en_old: Dolat... when he came near, then he slapped... then be ready for punishment.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ بیا انسپکٹر بیا بننگ۔ تھینک یو۔ چھالے؟ چھالے؟ خیریت؟ تودستے من پدا ہتھون۔ شما چا۔۔۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Come, inspector, come and sit. Thank you. What news? What news? Is everything all right? You... I have come again. You...
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Come, inspector, come and sit. Thank you. Tea? Tea? Is everything all right? You... I came again. You...

brh: ایشے گشتگٹ، مئے درستیں زند ہمودا گوازینی۔ نہ، انسپکٹر نہ، چوش بوت نہ کنت۔ نو تو وتی فکرا بکن۔ میر صاحب۔
en: He has said this: we spend our whole life there. No, inspector, no, that cannot be. Then you think about yourself. Mir sahib.
en_old: He has said this; we spend our whole lives there. No, inspector, no, that can't be. Then think about yourself. Mir sahib.

brh: مار وتی فکر ئس بلے مار، تئی فکر ہم کنا۔ شمے سرا حملہ بوتک۔ شمے چے خیال ئے میر دولت آ؟ نہ۔
en: We have our own worries, but we worry about you too. You have been attacked. What do you think about Mir Dolat? No.
en_old: We have our own worries, but we worry about you too. You were attacked. What do you think about Mir Dolat? No.

brh: امیر دولت نا اینت من شر زانین منا چی کنا گیئنت شمے مہربانی نمے صاحب ہر کس کہ بیبیت ما پ
en: Mir Dolat, I know him well. What can he do to me? Thank you for your kindness, sir. Whoever it may be, we...
en_old: I know Amir Dolat well. What can he do to me? Thank you for your kindness, sir. Whoever comes, we...

brh: پٹ پول کنے۔ ئے ہمے فرض ئ۔ شما وتی فرض آن بزان ات۔ شمے دگہ ہم بازیں فرض استت۔ اگہ شما ہم سرپد ببو ات۔ من سرپند بوؤگ اون
en: Investigate. That is your duty. Know your duty. You have many other duties too. If only you would understand too. I do understand.
en_old: Investigate. That is your duty. You know your duty. You have many other duties as well. If only you understood too. I do understand.

brh: میساب منان معلومین کہ منا چے کنگی ء او چے نہ کنگی ء خیر من دوانہ پدکائے شر
en: Mir sahib, I know what I must do and what I must not do. Anyway, I'll come back again. All right.
en_old: Sir, I know what I should and shouldn't do. Anyway, I'll go back home later, fine.

brh: او مانی، او مانی
en: Oh Mani, oh Mani.
en_old: Oh Mani, oh Mani.

brh: تو آخر چے گوشگ لوٹئے؟ آن بگوش!
en: What is it you want to say, after all? Say it now!
en_old: So what is it you want to say, after all? Say it now!

brh: انکل شما پرچی اونی پشت کپتگے؟ شما ہم نابلت؟ تاؤ چونے گپ جنغائے؟ مچے آتے پشت کپتا، ہاں؟ ہنچے گپ اسے بجن کے بٹئی چٹ۔ او پدا تیج ئے
en: Uncle, why are you going after him? Are you unaware too? How are you talking? Everyone has gone after them, huh? Say something like that so that... (unclear). And then it's sharp.
en_old: Uncle, why are you after him? Don't you know either? Why are they talking to you? Are they all after them, huh? Some talk... and then fast.

brh: شیخ علی، تو مارا یلہ دے، دگہ نمہ گروئے ہا؟ اینا، ما تیارٹ، چے چے نہ کرتہ، ولے یک گپ یاد بتہ۔
en: Sheikh Ali, let us go; you won't take any more, will you? No, we were ready, what didn't we do! But one thing came back to mind.
en_old: Sheikh Ali, leave us. Won't you take anything else? Look, we were ready. What didn't we do? But one thing came to mind.

brh: دا کینیڈا ہی ادے قانون، ادے عدالت، ایشانی دیم آ اوشتک باز گران انت۔
en: This is Canada. The law here, the courts here: standing up against them is very hard.
en_old: This is Canada. Its laws and its courts are very hard to stand up against.

brh: باز کنا نیت۔ چونٹ تو مننگ کپانہ سرپد پئے شما انکل ملوٹ
en: It is very much my intention. How... we cannot accept it; understand, you, uncle... (the end is garbled).
en_old: That was hardly my intention. How can you not understand? You've met uncle.

brh: دل ئے وڑ نہ بوتو تو عجبیں مردمے تو وت وتارا سزا دیگ لوٹئے وت وتی جندے زندے پشتا کپتگئے بچار تو
en: The heart can't accept it this way. You are a strange person. You want to punish yourself; you yourself have turned against your own life. Look at yourself.
en_old: If your heart isn't right, you're a strange person. You want to punish yourself, and you've fallen behind in your own life. Look at yourself.

brh: گپہ سرپد بوگی جودہ بکھن تو ہنو ایوکا نئیں تے آروز بوتا تو منی زاماسے منی منی جنکے زند کون تو ہم گرینچنٹ
en: Make an effort to understand the matter. You are not alone now. It was (your) wish: you are my son-in-law, and you too are bound up with my, my daughter's life.
en_old: Try to understand the matter properly. You are not alone. If you wish, my son-in-law, you too are bound to my daughter's life.

brh: چھی، بخشندہ کے ہچ توس سرپد نبی انکل منتی ایورن سرپد اوین، ما فیصلہ کرتہ گن، ما نوتی سنگتانی کران رین
en: Tsk, forgive me, but you don't understand anything, uncle. I understand. We have decided; we will now go to our friends.
en_old: Shame, forgiving one... you don't understand anything, uncle. We understand. We've decided, and we'll go to our new friends.

brh: دے چے مطلب انت؟ من شپ و روچ ہمیدا منندی ترا بچاریں؟ من کدی گشتتوں منا پچا؟ تو نوں منا چی کارا چارے؟
en: What does that mean? Am I supposed to sit right here day and night watching over you? When did I ever tell you to look after me? So why are you keeping an eye on me now?
en_old: What do you mean by that? Am I supposed to sit here day and night watching you? When did I ever tell you to look after me? So why are you looking at me now?

brh: منزانی تئی چے مطلب انت منی خیال شما مونا پبا گپتگت ئے ملک آزاد انت ئے ملک اٹا ہر کس وتی زندے گوازینگے حق است
en: I know what you mean. I think you have taken me [wrongly]... This country is free, and in this country everyone has the right to live their own life.
en_old: I know what you mean. I thought you understood. This country is free, and in this country everyone has the right to live their own life.

brh: ارتہ! آئندہ ایوڑنگ گپ مکنئے۔ آئندہ چو گشتئے۔ گڑا شر نبیت۔ چیا تو چو نگشئے۔ افسوس کہ تو بزانتے۔ چے؟
en: Hey, you! Don't talk like this again in future. If you say that again, it won't be good. Why don't you say so? It's a pity... if only you understood. What?
en_old: Arta! Don't talk like that ever again. Don't say that again, or it won't be good. Why don't you say so? It's a pity you don't understand. What?

brh: چپ زنتلو! ترا وا غوشا غا بے فائدہ غے۔ بے فائدہ غے۔ سوب سوبا منی دماغ خراب مہ کہ۔ آئندہ تو چوشنگ گپ جتے گڑا شر نہ بیت۔ شر نہ بیت؟ تو گڑا تو چے کنے ہا؟ شاباش انت را۔
en: Shut up! Telling you anything is useless. Useless. Don't wreck my head first thing in the morning. If you say such things again in future, it won't be good. Won't be good? Then what will you do, huh? Well done to you.
en_old: Shut up! Listening to you is useless. Useless. Don't mess with my head every morning. If you say things like that again, it won't be good. Won't be good? So what will you do? Bravo to you.

brh: شاباش ترا ہنچوش کنا بلوچی سے تئی پس وت مئے کرا اتکے منی بچا زاماس بکننگ مانے ادا افسوس
en: Bravo to you, [behaving] like this... Balochi... Your father himself came to us [asking us] to make my son [our] son-in-law, and here... alas.
en_old: Bravo to you, like this... Your father himself came to us, my son... I'm sorry here.

brh: افسوس، من ہمے مارد اٹ کہ تو دا کائے محنت کرے، جوہد کرے، کوشش کرے، او یک شرے زندے گواسینے۔
en: Alas, I was hoping that you would come here, work hard, strive, make an effort, and live a good life.
en_old: Sadly, I was hoping that you would come here, work hard, struggle, try, and live a good life.

brh: بلے نا تو تنے گپ بدل نہ بوتگے تو ہما مردم کے ہموتہ بوتگے او بدا ترائے یکے داتا کہ تو منی جنکا گون ہی پیم ہابرے
en: But no, you haven't changed at all; you are the same person you were back then. And afterwards [you were] given one... that you [treat] my daughter in this way.
en_old: But your words haven't changed. You're the same person you were back then, and then he gave you one, for talking to my daughter like that.

brh: کنے نا چاوے صاب نا تو مزنے ردیئے کنا گائے ردیئے انکل منچھے ردی کورتگون کرن منی وائف ہنا آ ساریہ منی
en: [...] sir, no, you're making a big mistake, you're making a mistake. Uncle, what wrong have I done? My wife, she... Sariya, my...
en_old: I don't know, sir. It's a big mistake, my mistake. Uncle, I made a mistake because my wife...

brh: جنک انت رندا تئی وائف انت؟ تو زانہ وتی آترا نوکری ء جوڑ کوشش تا کرتگے؟ انکل تو زانے ادا جوب ء درگیجگ باز مشکلیں کار انت ہچ مشکل نہ انت
en: She's [my] daughter first, and only then your wife? You know... have you tried to get a job for yourself? Uncle, you know finding a job here is a very difficult thing. It's not difficult at all.
en_old: The girl is your wife, then? Do you know... have you tried to find a job for yourself? Uncle, you know finding a job here is very hard. It's not hard at all.

brh: تو چودو کوشش ہم نہ کوتا تو بس لوٹیکے ادا ہر چیز ترا مفتہ بیرسیت منی مردم تیاترا باز جودو کوشش کورتس بھلے ترا کار کناگی نینتس تو خوشی ہر چیز ترا ادا مفتہ بیرسیت بس
en: You didn't even make that much effort; you just want everything here to come to you for free. My people tried very hard for your sake, but you have no wish to work. You'd like everything here to just come to you for free, that's all.
en_old: You didn't even make that much effort. You just want everything here handed to you for free. My people worked very hard for you... You think everything here just comes to you for free.

brh: اگر تو منی سرا بوتام جنگے تو ایشر کنگا نوے جوان ہنو من تئی سرا بوتام جنگان تو منا گشگرائے افسوس
en: If you heap slander on me, doing that isn't right; and now when I [supposedly] slander you, you say 'what a pity' to me.
en_old: If you had sworn on my head, doing this would have been fine; now that I swear on your head, what I say is a matter of regret.

brh: افسوس انت منا تو مے مہر و محبتانی صلہ ئے پیما مارا دیگا ئے پیما برے ہنا ہدا چوش نبیت بلے یک کپی جاچ بدار
en: It pains me: is this how you repay us for our love and affection? No, by God, it won't be like that; but wait a little.
en_old: Alas, is this how you repay our love and affection? God forbid it should be like this, but wait a little.

brh: تو فکر مکہ آ سرپد مٹ تئی گپ آ سرپد مٹ تو وتارا مننگ
en: Don't you worry, he'll understand; he'll understand what you're saying. You just have to accept it yourself.
en_old: Don't worry, he understood; he understood what you said. You just accept it yourself.

brh: جی تو
en: Yes, you.
en_old: Yes, you.

brh: بیا سجا بیا، بیا نن، یار بشیر، مرچن عجب بابا گندا کوا، او ترا بش کنے، ہمے چہ حالت کنے
en: Come, come here, come sit down, friend Bashir. Today you look strange, man... what state have you got yourself into?
en_old: Come here, come, come on, friend Bashir. Today something strange happened, father. Forgive you... what state you're in.

brh: بابا، تنے نوک، چے بدے، یار بشیر، آ ایرانی مسودہ گنے، ایشانی منا سک پریشان کرت۔
en: Man... what can I say, friend Bashir? That crazy Iranian cousin has troubled me a lot.
en_old: Father, what's wrong? Friend Bashir, that crazy Iranian has troubled me a lot.

brh: یار اسد تیز دیر تننگ نا زندگی تو تو چسنگ ہبچنک منا بچار سنگہ جوڑ بوتگٹ سنگہ جی چے مطلب یار اسد ہن شکا لاسا
en: Friend Asad, ... life ... look at me, how I've ended up... how? What do you mean, friend Asad?...
en_old: Friend Asad, a life of... look at me, look at what I've become. What do you mean, friend Asad?

brh: چکا زالک کپتہ گنوک انسان او انسان او تو چکوشہ کے بل سرپد نبوا گنوک
en: The children and wife have fallen... a crazy man; a human, oh, a human. However much [you're told], you won't understand, you madman.
en_old: The woman has fallen. Crazy person, oh person, you won't understand, you crazy.

brh: گپ چے؟ گپ باز مزے نا دے۔ ئے گونڈو جنی تہو تے جگر آ تو بیت۔ ہا ایرونی ماسو زاک۔ ہائے ایرونی ماسو زاک۔
en: What's the matter? It's a very serious matter. [...] in your heart. Yes, the Iranian cousin. Ah, the Iranian cousin.
en_old: What's the matter? The matter is a lot of fun. ...on the heart. Hey, Irani, cousin. Hey, Irani, cousin.

brh: ارے ارے ماسو براہسن جی بشیر ئے توت ئے توت جی خوشاگے آئی رونی ماسو زاک تئی ماسو
en: Hey, hey, cousin-brother? Yes, Bashir, this is your..., this is your... yes... the Iranian cousin, your cousin.
en_old: Hey, hey, cousin brother, yes Bashir... yes, happy. Irani, cousin, your cousin.

brh: ما زو براسل؟ ہاؤ اسد، ہاؤ منی ما زو براسل۔ منی گناہ نی سزا، ہاں رسہ گین۔ من، زر ء عیش اترا، انسان چے جانور جوڑ بوتوٹ۔ او دا منی براسل۔
en: Cousin-brother? Yes, Asad, yes, my cousin-brother. The punishment for my sins has caught up with me, yes. For the sake of money and luxury I turned from a human into an animal. And this is my brother.
en_old: Cousin brother? Yes, Asad, yes, my cousin brother. My sin, your punishment, yes. For money and luxury, I went from a human to an animal. And this is my brother.

brh: اچ مردمانائے دوستی یا شمو چیزا زیات نشہ دوست داشتہ من اوتے براسے علاج کننگے باز جود کرستن پرے ہچ ہچ
en: More than friendship with people or anything else, he loved drugs. I tried very hard to get my own brother treated, but nothing, nothing [worked].
en_old: He loved drugs more than friendship with people or anything else. I tried very hard to get my brother treated, but nothing, nothing.

brh: منی ماس منی ماس ہرا دم کیتہ او ترسینڈ ہیتو اگے نشہ یل نہ دے تم من نشہ شروع کرے
en: My cousin, my cousin... whenever [he]... I threatened [him]: if you don't give up drugs, then I'll start taking drugs [too].
en_old: My mother, my mother, when she... I told him to quit drugs, he didn't quit, then I started taking drugs too.

brh: اچھا جان ئے وڑا منی ماسب لشا شروع کرے گڑا تو ئے چنا کٹ اسٹ منے باز جوت کتو
en: Okay, dear, this is how my cousin started [taking] drugs; then you... I tried very hard.
en_old: Okay dear, when my... started, then... tried very hard.

brh: باز کوشش کرتون، کہ اینی راج بے ولے ہچ نہ مس، ہچ نہ مس، عمر چٹ دیر مس، خدایا مچے کسء نی
en: I tried very hard so that he would come right, but nothing came of it, nothing came of it; it got far too late. O God, [let this happen to] no one...
en_old: I tried very hard to... but nothing happened, nothing happened. Life went by too late. O God...

brh: چکاس لوگ انت کہ آنے روشنائی اٹ تاری آ بدل بوت نو ایوار نبیت بشیر نو ایوار نبیت چنکا مطلب
en: How many homes there are whose light has turned into darkness! No, it won't go on like this, Bashir, it won't go on like this. What do you mean?
en_old: ...when light turned into darkness, it won't be together, Bashir, it won't be together. What do you mean?

brh: ئے میر کیس ئے پین میرانی راج اٹ تانکہ گو انسان نا زندگی اللہ نا کوٹ نا مکار اسد جان اسد جان ایشان نا خلاف آواز
en: This Mir... the rule of these other Mirs... so that human life... God's... deceivers... Asad dear, Asad dear, [raise your] voice against them.
en_old: These chiefs and the rule of other chiefs... human life... Asad dear, Asad dear, a voice against them.

brh: مرک کنا آسان بلے عمل کنا باز مشکل باز مشکل وحید مک مک قانونی مدد کین قانون قانون ایچ کتو تہ کنا
en: Dying is easy, but acting is very hard, very hard. Waheed, help, help, let's get legal help. The law, the law did nothing for me.
en_old: Dying is easy for me, but acting is very hard, very hard. Waheed, help, help, give legal help. The law, the law did nothing for me.

brh: ہیچ کتو متو۔ نی تو بچار بشی۔ کہ نن ایشانہ چپ غار و گم ساہ کین، اسد جان، ہر ایک
en: It did nothing, nothing happened. You just watch, Bashir, how we silence them and make them vanish, Asad dear, every one [of them].
en_old: Did nothing. You just look, Bashi, we make them silent and lost, Asad dear, every one.

brh: کپو تم ہم کو تو ہواروں ہواروں
en: ...I'm with you too; together, together.
en_old: Whenever... together, together.

brh: نی کنج اسے آ تولوک او خننگ اٹی اوس۔ پیرو، نی اسینا نا خیال تے است آن کشہ۔ اسینا نا برام تختی ہم نی تمننگ کپک۔ انتئے؟ انتئے کہ اسینا پین کس نا تختی ٹی ء۔ تھینک یو پیر ماما۔
en: You sit in a corner and keep seeing (dreams). Peeru, get thoughts of Hasina out of your heart. Hasina's marriage will never fall to your lot either. Why? Because Hasina is in someone else's fate. Thank you, Uncle Peer.
en_old: You saw her sitting in a corner. Peeru, get her out of your heart. She can't be married to you either. Why? Because she's destined for someone else. Thank you, Peer Uncle.

brh: محمد پیرو زندئے اونا تختے ٹی کس بپروئے اونا خام خیالے ئے خیر اسل گپ ئے تو ئے گیرام کریٹ پیرو ایستو توغ اٹی خناٹ کہ ماما شیر جان واپس خلق آ بسنے ئے آئی ہم چڑا غندا توغی خنک نی ہم ہندا توغی خنسے اور پیرو ئسیٹ
en: Muhammad Peeru, by my life, no one will come into her fate; that's his wishful thinking. Anyway, I forgot the real thing. Peeru, just now I saw in a dream that Uncle Sher Jan has come back to the village. Mother, too, always sees this same dream, you see this same dream too, and Peeru...
en_old: Muhammad Peeru, no one else will be in her destiny, that's just her delusion. Anyway, I forgot the main thing. Peeru, I just dreamed that Uncle Sher Jan came back to the village. I see dreams like that too, you see the same dream too, and Peeru...

brh: بس پاوے، اینو اسکان ئے ہرا توغے خنانٹ کل راست مسنو۔ اگر نا توغ راست مسر گڑا نی انت کے پاریس پیر جان نندوک کرو۔ اچھا، گڑا کنتون برام کیس والا؟ او نی تینا ئے
en: I'm just saying, every dream I have seen up to today has come true. If your dream comes true, then what will you do? Peer Jan, I'll ... (unclear). Okay, then will you marry me? Oh, you yourself...
en_old: Just tell me, every dream I've had up to today has come true. If your dream comes true, then what would you say? Peer Jan, I'll make you sit down. Okay, then will you marry me? Oh, your own...

brh: دا سلیس ایناٹ۔ کاسے؟ او۔ ہائے نیک۔ ہمو خنازدہ اینداڑے موسم لندن نا موسم ئ۔
en: Right, I'm off now. Are you going? Yes. Hi, Nick. Look, the weather here is London weather.
en_old: This is ... What? Oh. Hi, Nick. That... the weather here is London weather.

brh: شیر خانی لمہ۔ سلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام، بر شیر خانی لمہ۔ احوال دے؟ ابا تولو۔ آ نئے لمہ، نن کانہ خلقا۔ انتئے؟
en: Sher Khan's mother. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Come in, Sher Khan's mother. How are things? Father, sit down. Oh, mother, we are going to the village. Why?
en_old: Sher Khan's mother. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam, come in, Sher Khan's mother. How are you? Father, sit down. Oh Mother, we're going to the village. Why?

brh: دا چنا تے دروئے خلق نی نشان تروئی نا دا خزو شور ارے داتے کاو مچے شانے تے خلق نی ئے مچے ظاہر کرینو ٹکھیرے مورا سرے نا عجیب و بندہ غسے خلق واری
en: He will take these children and show them the village. This ... is a lot of noise. I'll take these ... all the ... of the village, they have made it all plain ... your strange person ... the village...
en_old: These children... the village... you have to show them... gather all these... the village... has shown everyone... a strange person from the village...

brh: داڑے بس دا سما تے واپس خلک تے دننگ اٹی، نہ دا ئے تو پکھ ئے دا دے خلک تے تنیا ایننگ کپرا، اگر تنیا ایناٹ نا تو باز مشکل ئے کہ پدی برے، ہندا خاطر
en: Here they're just taking these back to the village. No, this is certain: these days I can't go to the village alone; if I go alone, then it's very hard to come back. That's why.
en_old: Here they're just sending these back to the village. No, this... can't be brought from the village alone. If brought alone, it's very hard to come back, that's why.

brh: تینت تینا ماتی دننگٹی اٹ، دا کنے واپس زو ارفرا تیرا شار۔ شیر خانی لم، زو واپس بریس، انتئے کہ ایو سنا کرینے والا نم کے ضعیف کین۔ آہو بالکل بالکل زو برینہ۔ زوال جان!
en: I'm taking my mother myself; they'll soon bring me back to the city. Sher Khan's mother, come back soon, because otherwise ... you'll make us waste away. Yes, absolutely, absolutely, we'll come back soon. Zawal Jan!
en_old: I'm sending my mother myself, they'll bring me back soon. Sher Khan's mother, come back soon, because otherwise we'll grow weak. Yes, absolutely, I'll come back soon. Zawal Jan!

brh: جی انکل۔ دا میرو انت انت دا ننگ اٹے۔ جی انکل۔ یار او تے، او نا وجہ آن تو ننا ٹائم پاس مریک۔ ئے تو خواہوک اٹ ہم داڑے نم تو مریو۔ بھلے ابا پائے پائے، دینی تے؟ سمار پین مامر زی۔

en_old: Their voice... well done to you, I go but it's hard, well done to you, he goes.

brh: کڑ کڑ مٹھائی کڑ، گلینگا ٹو چاس مسکہ دا مٹھائی تیتون واہ کے لومیتس، ابا عید نا دے ابا گل چا مرک، مئے عید کنا خل پئے کہ گلجان میر، میر گلجان نا سئے
en: Eat, eat, eat the sweets. While eating there should be a tea with these sweets, wow... [unclear]. Dad, it's Eid day, Dad... (tea)... My sister, I think Gul Jan Mir — Mir Gul Jan — your...
en_old: Eat, eat the sweets, eat... tea, butter, along with these sweets, wow... Dad, on Eid day, Dad... my Eid... Gul Jan Mir, Mir Gul Jan...

brh: سخت خدی ہا؟ انتئے؟ اللہ امانتے مگر کنا مار تون جنگ و جیڑہ والا سے۔ شکر ئے کنا مار باز شریف و سادہ ء چنا سے۔ بالکل بالکل نا مار تو باز شریف ئے ہندا خاطر تو سالم کریٹ تا ہا؟ پیسہ پیسہ پیسہ۔
en: Very stubborn, huh? — Why? — God keep him, but he's one who fights and quarrels with my son. Thank God my son is a very decent, simple child. — Absolutely, absolutely, your son is very decent; that's exactly why I gave them my salaam, right? Money, money, money.
en_old: Very... huh? Why? God protect us, but (he's) a quarrelsome one with my son. Thank God my son is a very decent and simple child. Absolutely, absolutely, your son is very decent, that's why I agreed, right? Money, money, money.

brh: انت مس؟ انت مس؟ داسہ مانی آ؟ یا مولی، انت زلزلہ بس؟ زلزلہ بتو، مصیبت بس، غضب مس۔ انت مس؟ انت متو؟ داسہ اینو انت مس؟ زوبہ! ابوئے چلی پیڑی! دیر مس پنتھے؟ بو گلجان، گلجان۔ ابوئے کنکے انت مس گلجان ئے؟
en: What happened? What happened? Now what is it? O Lord, what, did an earthquake come? No earthquake came — a calamity came, a disaster happened. What happened? What didn't happen? Now what has happened today? Hurry! Abu... [unclear]! Has it gotten late? ...Gul Jan, Gul Jan. Abu, what has happened to me — Gul Jan?
en_old: What happened? What happened? Now what? Or radish? What, did an earthquake hit? No earthquake hit, a calamity came, a disaster happened. What happened? What didn't happen? Now what happened today? Zoba! Abu, what... Is it late? Go, Gul Jan, Gul Jan. Abu, what happened to Gul Jan?

brh: گل جہانی مرو زوت جوانسہ کہ ہا باغ اٹی ننا ننا کنا مقصد دادے ہر بستے ئے ایڑے پھل ہتی ٹی ڈکانے تنے توار خلنگٹی ئے موڑ انتئے کنے خبر اف کنا مستی دا ورپتے الو ورپوتے ابا باٹکریہ باٹکریہ باٹکریہ
en: Gul Jahan... quickly... well, in the garden, our, our... my purpose was this: whoever came... (they) have hidden flowers there in the... [unclear]... calling out... why, I don't know... [unclear]... Dad... [unclear].
en_old: Gul Jahan... quickly... in the garden, our... my purpose is this... here flowers... calling you... why, I don't know... Dad, thank you, thank you, thank you.

brh: اہ ہا ہا ہا انت مس؟ ابا ئے داسس بسونے ابا، داسس بسونے؟ جی او ابا، گڑا، گڑا نی امر کریس؟ ابا اینا بہادر انگا مسڑ اٹ کیاری انگا کشتس کشاٹ خلکوٹ کاٹومٹ تے
en: Ah, ha ha ha, what happened? Dad, a thief has come, Dad! — A thief has come? — Yes, oh Dad. — Then, then what did you do? — Dad, I'm your brave daughter: I pulled out a brick from the flowerbed and hit him on the head.
en_old: Ah ha ha ha, what happened? Dad has just come, Dad, has he just come? Yes, oh Dad, then, then how did you do it? Dad, with his brave daughter, dug up the flower bed...

brh: بے ہوش کرستے؟ ہاؤ۔ دال پانے گٹیوس۔ ابا اینا بہادری نا مسڑ اٹ۔ جوان کرستے جوان کرستے جوان کرستے جوان کرستے تل تل جوان کرستے ہندنو مصیبت ئس تو کم متسکہ۔ کم بخت۔
en: You knocked him unconscious? — Yes. — [unclear]... — Dad, I'm your brave daughter. — You did well, you did well, you did well, you did well... (sit, sit)... you did well. A menace like that is at least one fewer. The wretch!
en_old: Did they knock him unconscious? Yes. ... Father, she's a brave daughter. They did well, they did well, they did well, they did well... they did well. Such trouble is rarely seen. Wretch.

brh: امباہ کسکو! دے ئس مست کیس کنا خیال پئے چھٹا! امبا کسکوٹ ئے دے بننگٹی سلیم چیانٹ امبا!
en: Mama, I'm dead! ... [unclear: a day, a fist?]... take care of me (?)... Mama, I'm dead! ... while coming... [unclear]... Mama!
en_old: Amba Kasko! Before the day... I think... Amba Kaskot... when the day comes, Salim... Amba!

brh: کسکوٹ؟ دا دے ہندوس؟ ہمو۔ گل جان؟ کسکوٹ۔ ہمو۔ گل جان؟ اسلام علیکم۔ ئے ابا! ئے ابا! ئے دے نا الہ ہمدا ہمدا۔
en: I'm dead? — Is this how it is today? — Him. — Gul Jan? — I'm dead. — Him. — Gul Jan? — Peace be upon you. Oh Dad! Oh Dad! ...(garbled, apparently reciting 'there is no god but God')...
en_old: Kaskot? Is this day here? That one. Gul Jan? Kaskot. That one. Gul Jan? Assalamu alaikum. Hey Dad! Hey Dad! ...the same, the same.

brh: چنڈا نا کسکوٹ چنڈا نا گلجان گلجان خیرات مریو نا خنتے گلجان ئے دادٹ چپ کے بدتمیز کنے اوس نوکر نی دیر اجازت تس اوڑے صوفہ غا تولوس گڑا خلپیکے دانا مزغ ہم اینا اینا جی کسکوٹ خشت
en: ...I'm dead... Gul Jan, Gul Jan, may I be sacrificed for your eyes, Gul Jan! — Hey, shut up, you rude one! You're a servant to me — who gave you permission to sit there on the sofa? Then... [unclear]... his brain too... his, his... — Yes... I'm dead... the brick...
en_old: Chanda's Kaskot, Chanda's Gul Jan, Gul Jan, may I be sacrificed for your eyes, Gul Jan... Shut up, you rude one, you're my servant! Who gave you permission to sit there on the sofa? Then... his brain too... yes, Kaskot...

brh: ئے گل جان ایڑے پٹنگٹ ئے گل جان ہت مس ہت مس کنا مارے آ تاتا مانگنج نی ہم مسوس بر خدا تنے تاتا مانگنج دراکان لمہ اوٹنا اماں
en: Hey, Gul Jan was digging there; hey, Gul Jan... he's been hit, he's been hit — my son! ... [unclear]... You too have become... For God's sake, you... [unclear]... from where... mother... Mama!
en_old: Hey Gul Jan, digging here, hey Gul Jan... it happened, it happened... my son... you too became... come, by God, you... from where, mother... Mom.

brh: اماں نا خشتس خلکنے اماں، گڑا کاٹومٹ کنا خشتس خلک اماں، ابوئے کنکے ہلوم، ڈاکٹرئے درتا، آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے آئی دے ڈاکٹرئے در، ڈاکٹرئے در، امیرو!
en: Mama, someone has hit me with a brick, Mama! Then she hit me on my head with a brick, Mama! Abu, take me... bring the doctor! Ow, ow, ow, ow! Bring the doctor, bring the doctor! Oh Miro!
en_old: Mom hit me with a brick, Mom! Then ... hit me with a brick, Mom! Take me to Dad, call the doctor! Ow, ow, ow, ow! Call the doctor, call the doctor, Meeru!

brh: جی میرو اینک زو کر، گاڈی ء سدا ڈاکٹرٹ، شاباش، ہمت نا گاڈی ء، ئے ڈرائیور ء پاس زو کر، گڑا جولان جول کین، دین تے پیشن ہمبر، گڑا بٹ کبو، بٹ کبو، بٹ کبو، آئی ڈی، آئی ڈی
en: Yes. Miro, go now, hurry — take the car straight to the doctor, well done. ...the car... tell the driver to hurry. Then... [unclear]... let's take him outside. Then... [unclear], [unclear], [unclear]... Ow, ow.
en_old: Yes, Meeru, hurry up now, bring the car, call the doctor. Well done, be brave... the car, tell the driver to hurry, then we'll go... take them outside, then shut it, shut it, shut it... ow, ow!

brh: بس کنا مسر تڑن تڑن کنا مسر دا کنا پلٹ ئے نی شوشوڈو ئے کلوٹ ئے نی لومے ہمک آن دا کلس کسکٹ آئی دے خشتنا آئی دے کسکٹ اینٹ ملانے آئی دے بس آسمان کسکٹ ہراڑے
en: Enough, my daughter... [unclear]... my daughter, this is my plate... you've... [unclear]... I... you... from... this whole... I'm dead, ow, the brick... ow, I'm dead, the brick has hit (me)... ow, just... the sky... I'm dead, where...?
en_old: That's enough, my daughter... my daughter, you've broken my plate... you've... ow, the brick... ow, ... ow, just the sky, where...

brh: ثنا جی پپا کنا مسڑ داسا نی برام نا تیاری کروئی ئے جمال نا باوہ کنے شیر خان جی جی
en: Sana! — Yes, Papa. — My daughter, now you have to get ready for the wedding. Jamal's father, Sher Khan, [told] me... — Yes, yes.
en_old: Sana. Yes, Papa. My daughter, now you have to get ready for the wedding. Jamal's father told me, Sher Khan. Yes, yes.

brh: تینا مار نا برام نا تیاری کننگ اٹی۔ ولے جمال تون کنے دا ہیت ء ڈسکس کتو۔ کنا مسڑ امر نی تون ڈسکس کے۔ خیر نی دا پا کہ دا رشتہ غان نی خوش تو ارے س نی
en: He's busy preparing for his son's wedding. — But Jamal didn't discuss this matter with me. — My daughter, how would he discuss it with you? Anyway, tell me this: are you happy with this match?
en_old: They're getting ready for their son's wedding. But they didn't discuss this with Jamal. My daughter, how would they discuss it with you? Anyway, tell me, are you happy with this match?

brh: یا اللہ
en: Oh God.
en_old: Oh God.

brh: درشتہ خیر ندرشتہ کیس راٹی اللہ ناراضا کنا سٹ مسٹ سے لدا نا نصیبہ جوڑ کیس
en: Make this match a blessed one... O God, by your will... she is my only daughter, make her destiny good.
en_old: Whether the match is good or bad... God, don't be angry with me... make a good fate for her.

brh: پیرو، او پیرو! ہا، انت سے پا؟ ایستو اسے توغس خلنگے۔ اوہو، کنے خبر ئے نی توغ اٹ ہندا خنانس، کنا وس اینا نا برام مننگے۔
en: Peeru, oh Peeru! — Yes, what is it, tell me? — Last night I had a dream. — Oho, I know, you saw the same thing in your dream: my wedding with her taking place.
en_old: Peeru, oh Peeru! Yes, what is it? I just had a dream. Oho, I know you saw the same thing in your dream. If it were up to me, she would be married to me.

brh: او دن کہ جمال و میرو جوان تینا خلق کے کار تینا قوم تینا ایلم تا خدمت کن ہوروف تے خنیر۔ نظام دا تو جوان و ہیت اسے۔ ہن کن ثنا خننگ پک۔ و انداڑے کہ وراٹی داسہ کنے چا تس دا سہی نا۔
en: It's like this: Jamal and Miru are fine young men who work for their village and serve their nation and their brothers, and people see them do it. Nizam, this really is a good thing. That's why I'm surely looking at Sana [for him]. And here at home she has just given me tea; is that right?
en_old: Like Jamal and Miru, they should see good people doing work for their own people, their nation and their brothers. This arrangement is a good thing. That's why it deserves praise. And here in the village, now let me know whether this is right.

brh: اینا برام نا قصہ امر مس؟ ہو ابا ورائی کرے پارے سو ولدا مسڑ کنا خوش بتو۔ مسڑ خوش کتنس؟ ہو خوش تو کرے ٹوھری دا خبر ئس کہ مسڑ کنا خوش کیک اینا
en: What happened with today's marriage matter? Yes, Father arranged it and said yes, but then my daughter didn't like it. Didn't you get the daughter to agree? Yes, I did get her to agree, but then this news came that my daughter would agree today.
en_old: How did today's wedding matter go? Yes, father said in the village, he said yes, but then my daughter won't agree. Didn't the daughter agree? Yes, she agreed, but the news was that my daughter agrees today.

brh: لمہ باوے تینا مونیٹ او تینٹ کسے مونیٹ اسے۔ اسے وار ئس کنا سنگت جمال جان نا سانگو برام مرے ولدا ہورین۔ ہاؤ دعا کرک کہ ثناء او جمال نا رشتہ مرے
en: Mother and Father, right in front of them... and he himself is in front of someone. Once my friend Jamal Jan's engagement and wedding have taken place, then we'll see. Yes, pray that the match between Sana and Jamal comes about.
en_old: Mother and father themselves... One time my friend Jamal Jan's engagement took place, and then we saw. Yes, pray that the match between Sana and Jamal happens.

brh: شکر خدائے مئے رزلٹ ہم بسونے باز جوان دا تو خوشی نا ہیت اسے دا پا کہ پاس مریسے یا کل پاس تو مسونٹ و رزلٹ فرسٹ ڈویژن ٹی بسونے ماشاءاللہ مبارک مرینے باز باز باز باز شکر خدائے
en: Thank God, our result has come out too, and it's very good. This really is happy news. Tell me, did you pass? Yes, I passed in everything, and the result came in first division. Mashallah, congratulations! Many, many, many thanks to God.
en_old: Thank God, our result has come out too, and it's very good. That's something to be happy about. Tell me, did you pass? Yes, we all passed, and the result came in first division, mashallah. Congratulations! Many, many thanks to God.

brh: خیر خیر تموس تموس بابا پھسکون پھسکون یل کننگٹی او یار السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام
en: Careful, careful, you'll fall, you'll fall, Baba! It's slipping, slipping, it's coming loose! Oh friend, peace be upon you. And upon you be peace.
en_old: Fine, fine, sit, sit, father, slowly, slowly, letting go... Oh friend, peace be upon you. And upon you be peace.

brh: خیر مسک مٹھل خان ئے خناٹ یار شکر ئے پین شکر ئے خیر ئے ٹھیک ٹھاک ئے شکر ئے اللہ نا احسانی او پین پا خیر بیرنگ ہرفینوت نی یار بس ہندن وڑنگٹ ایٹ لیکن اینو تونسے عید ئس ارے کنے
en: Is all well? I'm seeing Mithal Khan, friend! Thank God, otherwise thank God, it's fine, all good, thank God, it's God's grace. And tell me more, all well? You've packed up your bedding? Friend, I'm just going along like this, but today there's an Eid for me, you see.
en_old: Is all well? I saw Mithal Khan, friend. Thank God, all is well, everything's fine, thanks be to God, it's God's grace. Tell me more, why have you picked up the bag? Friend, I'm just wandering around like this, but today or tomorrow there's an Eid for me.

brh: ئے دیرے گل جان کنے پارے کہ کان شہر آ، ئے پاریٹ کہ بئے نی دن گڑھ مٹل خان تینت ہم شہر آ داٹی مٹل خان ایون ہم شہر نا باشوق ئے نی، تو کتو کاری مارے ہم بازار آٹے، ہاؤ یار شہر نا چکر آ
en: Gul Jan told me, 'Let's go to the city.' I said, 'Come on, you too.' Mithal Khan, you yourself [come] to the city too; Mithal Khan, you're also fond of the city, so... the boy too, to the bazaar. Yes, friend, [I'm off] on a trip to the city.
en_old: Gul Jan told me to come to the city, and I said come along, you too, Mithal Khan, to the city. Mithal Khan, you're fond of the city too, so didn't you go to the bazaar? Yes, friend, on a tour of the city.

brh: دا توغانی ہم باز دوستی، سلک نی تون اسہ قصہ ئس کے، آن کھرہ قصہ، او کنا ایلم قصہ دادے کہ کنا مسڑ کن زلی، دا توغاتی خانانی کہ شیر خان شاران واپس بسونے، اراٹی تا بلو خوشی اسے، دول و
en: These dreams too [are] very [much about] friendship. Wait, let me tell you a story, a short story. Oh my brother, the story is this: for my daughter... in these dreams I saw that Sher Khan has come back from the city, and there's great joy in their house, drums and...
en_old: These folks are very friendly too. Let me tell you a story, a short story. Oh my brother, the story is this: for my daughter... these families say that Sher Khan has come back from the city, there's great happiness in the village, drums and...

brh: چپ آکو، او کنا خواجہ قصہ دون مفرو، اسل قصہ دونے کہ شیر خان واپس شارا مفک، انتئے؟ بئے گل بے بے کوننگا ضعیفہ تون گزارہ کننگ باز مشکل ئے ہچ مفک، او ہمر دا مش
en: Be quiet. Oh my master, the story won't go like that. The real story is that Sher Khan won't come back from the city. Why? Because living with Gul Bibi, an old, frail woman, is very hard; it won't happen at all. And how this...
en_old: Be quiet. Oh my sir, the story won't go like that. The real story is that Sher Khan won't come back from the city. Why? Because living with Gul Bibi, the old woman, is very difficult, not at all...

brh: ٹکٹی وال دا برے یار توبہ توبہ کرک دنو عید کپہ کنا ایلم دنو عید کپہ بابا داس کان ہر گڑا کین شیر خان نا وراٹی خنانٹ ہمو تجربہ نا بنیاد آ عید کنے گٹیو آئی وراٹی جناب دول و چاپ مفک لٹ
en: ...this time, friend, God forbid, God forbid! Don't have an Eid like that, my brother, don't have an Eid like that, Baba. From everything I have seen in Sher Khan's house up to now, on the basis of that experience, sir, Eid at his house will be a hard one for me; there won't be any drums and clapping.
en_old: The ticket man, this time, friend, God forbid, God forbid, don't have such an Eid, my brother, don't have such an Eid, father. Until now I have seen everything in Sher Khan's village, and based on that experience, Eid... in the village, sir, there won't be drums and dancing.

brh: او گٹ مریک شیر خان آ چیاٹ مریک لیکن خوشی نا عیدی کپیس۔ یرا عیدی تا نٹور آ سو۔ دعا کر کہ اللہ خیر کیک۔ بس اللہ خیر کیک بابا کنا دوٹی تو اف۔
en: He'll be in a bind; it will happen to Sher Khan, but don't expect an Eid of joy. Hey, the Eid gifts... but pray that God makes it turn out well. Only God will make it turn out well, Baba; it's not in my hands.
en_old: He gets angry, he gets angry at Sher Khan, but you don't give the Eid gift of happiness. Hey, the Eid gifts... Pray that God makes it good. Only God will make it good, father, it's not in my hands.

brh: یرا جانداد معاف کیس مچے شتا فیروٹک، ہسینہ نا دا لوما پارے کا کے اینا تٹیکا نا گڑا سورنگ اٹیک سما مہمانس بریک زو ئس سودا سودا سچ پر سما مہمانس بروئی۔ واہ واہ جوانی کنے مینو جی او بابا مہمان اللہ نا رحمت ئے بابا بیا اینی ہم دے واٹ چن۔ اللہ بلور۔
en: Hey, dear, forgive [me]... Hasina's mother said, 'Go on, do it, today something's going on; I know a guest is coming. Quick, some groceries, groceries!' Truly, I sense a guest will come. Wow, wow, good, tell me. Oh Baba, a guest is God's mercy, Baba. Come, today too... God...
en_old: Hey, forgive the property, all of it... Hasina's mother said do it, something is cooking today, I know a guest is coming, quick, the shopping, the shopping. Really, I know a guest is coming. Wow, wow, nice, tell me. Oh father, a guest is God's mercy, father, come, today too... God willing.

brh: او کاری بس کرے تکھا دے او یار ہمت کبو اڑے زور تینے مضبوط زور تینے خیال دتوث ننے بابا سنبھال کے بسم اللہ اڑے یا اللہ یا رحمان زور ناتے
en: Oh, he's stopped working, it wears you out. Oh friend, take courage! Hey, strength, make yourself strong, put your strength in, mind yourself! Baba, hold us steady. In the name of God! Hey, O God, O Most Merciful, give strength!
en_old: He came to work... Oh friend, don't lose courage, hey, be strong, make yourself strong, take care of yourself, father, look after us. In the name of God, hey, O God, O Most Merciful, give strength.

brh: تولے نو تو تینے تولے نو۔ الہ ایمپک۔ بخیر اٹ، بدہ کتو، تول بخیر اٹ۔
en: Sit down then, sit yourself down. Oh, it's nothing. I'm fine, nothing bad happened; sit, I'm fine.
en_old: Sit down, sit yourself down. No, I won't. I'm fine, don't worry, sit, I'm fine.

brh: اینو نی امر کسرا دت کرینوس؟ اینو اسہ خاصو کارم سیٹ بسونٹ۔ دا کل کارم خاصو ارا کارمسے کہ خاص صف۔ اگہ کنا ہر کارم کہ خاص مریک تو بن اینو ہم اسہ خاصو کارم سیٹ
en: What brings you this way today? Today I've come on a special errand. All your errands are special; which errand of yours isn't special? Well, if every errand of mine is special, then today too [I've come] on a special errand.
en_old: How did you find your way here today? Today I've come for a special task. Every task is special, which task is special? If every task of mine is special, then today too I've come for a special task.

brh: بسنٹ۔ گڑا ئے تولی؟ خلیپا قصہ وراٹی پا۔ بنگنٹ نی کیتاتی گل بے بے نا ایلم ترسا بسنے۔ کن کتو بسنے بنگنٹ نی کے ہم بسنے۔ گڑا انت خیال نا؟ اردو سارا قصہ وراٹی ہم پل؟
en: ...[I've] come. So shall I sit down? Khalifa, tell [me] what's going on at home. I've heard that Aunt Gul Bibi's brother has come, in a fright. Who has he come for? I've heard he has come for you too. So what do you think? Should I tell the whole story at home as well?
en_old: I came. So shall I sit? Tell the story in the village... I heard that Gul Bibi's brother came in fear. Why did he come? I heard he came for you too. So what do you think? Should I tell the whole story in the village too?

brh: امر کے نی جوان چسہ؟ ولے دا خیل تاتی گلببی امر بس کہ ننو نا ایلم تو برام کینہ؟ او دے تو خیال بفروئے، اونا ایلم تے دا خیال بروئے؟ اللہ معاف کے، تینا شکل تے خنانو کہ ننتو برام کننگ نا خواہشمند او؟ خواہش آتیا تو خط آ، کس
en: How do you know so well? But how did Aunt Gul Bibi get the idea that we would marry her brother? She herself wouldn't get that idea, so would her brother get it? God forgive me, have they seen their own faces, that they're eager to marry into us? As for wishes, though, no one...
en_old: How do you know so well? But how did Gul Bibi come to think that our brother would marry? She wouldn't have that thought, so would her brother have that thought? God forgive me, have they seen their own faces, to want to marry us? As for wishes, on paper, someone...

brh: پابندی خلنگ کپک۔ انت مطلب؟ دن کہ نی شار والا مار نا توغ تے خنیسہ اور نا خواہش کہ نا برام اوڑتو مرے۔ اور نا خواہش کہ نا برام پیرو تو مرے۔ ہائے پیرو نا ایتے کپیس۔ او تو تینا ما
en: ...can put a ban on them. What do you mean? Like, you dream of the city man's son and wish your marriage could be with him. And you wish your marriage could be with Piro. Oh, don't talk about Piro. He is, after all, his own...
en_old: No restriction can be placed. What do you mean? Like you look at the city man's son and wish your marriage would be with him. And you wish your marriage would be with Peeru. Oh, don't mention Peeru's name. He is his own...

brh: پاٹ تینٹی سادہ انگا پیرجا۔ دعا کہ ماما شیر خان برے، نتو نوسنا ارمانک نوسٹیسلور۔ انتئے؟ گڑا نیکی رسال دیر بروئی، کنکن تو وخت نا وخت کسس بروئی، ولے نیکن دیر بروئی؟ انتئے تاتی گلبے؟
en: ...in himself a simple soul. Pray that Uncle Sher Khan comes, otherwise your heart's wishes will stay in your heart. Why? Then will your match come late? For me someone will come in good time, but for you it will come late? Why, Aunt Gul Bibi?
en_old: Say it to yourself simply. Pray that Uncle Sher Khan comes, otherwise our longings will remain unfulfilled. Why? Then your proposal will come late. For me someone will come in good time, but for you it will come late? Why, Gul Bibi?

brh: بے بے نیلم! انت مننگٹی ئس بخیر اٹ، تو خیر اٹ تاتی۔ امر ئس جان؟ لمہ نا جوڑی؟ اللہ نا فضل اٹ۔ بس اسینا گڈائی کاوہ۔ انتئے؟ ئے بس سوٹ ونی کاسہ۔ تاتی ارا تاتی؟
en: Bibi Neelam! What's going on? I'm fine; are you well, Auntie? How are you, dear? How is Mother's health? By God's grace. I'm just going to get something cut [at the tailor's]. Why? I'm just going for a suit. Auntie? Which auntie?
en_old: Bibi Neelam! What's going on? I'm fine, are you well, Tati? How are you, dear? How is mother's health? By God's grace. I'm just going to someone's place. Why? I'm just going to get a suit sewn. Is Tati here?

brh: نم نصیب اسوٹ، کاو نتے رخ کیو کہ ابا بروئے لنگڑ مروئی نی ہم نتے بیغاسے ئنا داسہ کاو بیغ، بجوانی ڈیناٹ، بجوان اللہ حافظ، نین زو نتے بیغ
en: It was your good fortune. Let me go and get the dough ready, because Father will come and he'll be hungry. You knead the dough too... now go knead. Go well, good night; go well, goodbye. You, quickly, knead the dough.
en_old: You were lucky. Go, I'll take you along. Father will come... you too, take them along. Now go. Good night, goodbye. Go quickly, take them.

brh: دا مسینک ارے نا فس۔ ایرا گھنٹہ مرے کیناٹ خلکا، داسہ کاسی آلوئے صفاک کانی۔
en: Is this a machine of yours, or what? It's been two hours since I put them in, and the woollens still haven't come out clean.
en_old: This is the machine, isn't it? It's been two hours since I put them in, and the clothes still haven't come out clean.

brh: ابا انت سوچ کننگٹیو؟ ابا ئے دا سوچنگٹیو کہ نن سیدھا مٹھن نا اورا غا کان یا تینا اورا غا کان۔ او ابا!
en: Father, what are you thinking about? Dear, I'm thinking about whether we should go straight to Mithan's house or to our own house. Oh, Father!
en_old: What is Father thinking? Father is thinking about whether we should go straight to Mithan's house or to our own house. Oh, Father!

brh: دا مٹل دیر اسے؟ دا مٹل کیرنا؟ جمال جان نا معلوم ئے ئے عجیب او ہیت اسے، علم نا نی سنگ مسنے نا برام مسنے معلوم؟ یار نی تو چپ کے۔
en: Who is this Mithal? Whose [son] is this Mithal? Jamal Jan, you know, it's a strange thing: are you aware that you've got engaged, that your wedding has happened? You know? Man, you just keep quiet.
en_old: How old is this proverb? Whose proverb is it? Jamal jan, do you know, it's a strange thing. Do you know about knowledge's engagement, its wedding? Man, you just keep quiet.

brh: او فوزیہ ننے چہ عید کے ودا ایلم کریت ڈانس تیکہ فا بابا نم تینا دا قصہ غاتے الیبو دا پبو کہ ہرا ہند کاندہ سامر کیک ابا کنا خل پدا کا کانے خلکی اوراغا
en: Oh Fauzia, at Eid for us... and the brothers will do a dance. Come on, Baba, drop these stories of yours and tell us where we're going, where... happens. Father, my... let's go back, let's go home.
en_old: Oh Fauzia, at Eid we'll dance... Come on, Father, leave these stories of yours and tell us where... Father, let's go home.

brh: واللہ او تو راغہ کنے او کہ واپس شارء برے تھینک یو راغہ ایڑے لمانہ مقابلہ مرکے صبا تاسہ کنا آستہ کنا آستہ مرے جانوئی تس کرے ائینہ مقابلہ ئے تو کنا وسن تیرے
en: By God, he came to me [saying] that I should come back to the city. Thank you. He came... Sister, there's a contest tomorrow... slowly, slowly... the contest is within my power.
en_old: By God, he came to me and said I should come back to the city. Thank you. He came... There's a competition tomorrow. Slowly, slowly... the competition is within my reach.

brh: مہر عباس گوشت بلے آ دارک نہ بوت روہ کنے داشت کنت ایہ شر نہ کورت آنٹی کاری چیزے است
en: Mehr Abbas said, 'But the medicine didn't work... he was kept... it didn't make him better.' Auntie, is there something to be done?
en_old: Mehr Abbas, but there's no meat... It didn't turn out well. Auntie, I have some work to do.

brh: من حاضر اٹ۔ من وش بے۔ اللہ تنے سلامت کے۔ نمے اجازت ئے ابا ننے چا بو۔ نم ارے پد کائے۔
en: I'm at your service. I'm glad. May God keep you safe. You have [our] leave, Father... us... You go back later.
en_old: I'm ready. I'm happy. May God keep you safe. With your permission, Father, let's go. You come later.

brh: ترا ہشپ گدائیتے ایواداتے گیارام کناگا تومنا بواوا گلے ئنا بواوا زند بگستینا وڑا باشارت ایڑے ملکانا تو چارگے مشینی زند گوازینگا مردوما وتو
en: You... remember the tents, how life goes in the clan camps, life lived in a different way. Look at the countries over there: people live a mechanical life.
en_old: You think beggars... Go and see how the people of the villages live. Look at life in these countries: people live a machine-like life.
