brh: خیالانی دنیار در پہ کپ، چیزے کار پہ کن، تو چے او گشے، من چوم بکنیں، چیزے نہ چیزے کار تو ترا کنوئی کپیت، ہنچو زند نہ گوازیت۔
en: Come out of your world of daydreams and do some work. What do you say, 'How should I do it'? You'll have to do some work or other; life can't be lived like this.
en_old: Come out of your world of daydreams and do some work. What, you say you'll do it this way? You have to do some kind of work. Life doesn't go on like this.

brh: تو راوے ولے اینا چارے تے کہ ماسے منی او پسہ چے حال انت او پسہ چے بوتا او مشما فکر مکرے مارو دے کچو مستوش مارو کونے او مشما سگتا او
en: You're going, but look in on them: how my mother and father are, and what has happened to Father. And don't you worry about us; we [unclear]... we [unclear]... and we [can bear it(?)]...
en_old: You're going, but check on them: how my mother and father are, what happened to Father. And don't you worry about us; we... our friends...

brh: بروچی بندے اولاد
en: A Baloch man's offspring.
en_old: The offspring of a Baloch man.

brh: مردم چے امید ارکنت؟ جاوید! خیر ئے چے گپ ئے تو چیا چو پریشان گندگہ کائے؟ خیر تو استے نا؟ استے تو خراب اوتا۔
en: What hope can one have? Javed! Is everything all right? What's the matter, why do you look so worried? Is all well with you? Has something gone wrong?
en_old: What hope do people have? Javed! Is everything alright, what's the matter, why do you look so worried? Everything's fine, isn't it? Nothing's wrong, is it?

brh: ایرے ٹکا متے او نو وا ہسپتال اٹ ہچ نزانی کہ مچ چونکانی نو گڑا تبو گشنا چونکانی
en: [Unclear opening, possibly about an injection] ... and now at the hospital they don't know anything either, so how are we to manage? Now then, you tell me, how do we manage?
en_old: Now they've said that at the hospital they know nothing about where the children are, so then what can be said about the children?

brh: منی خیال ئے نا واپس روگ ہینت۔ واپس روئی؟ ئے تو چے گوشغے؟ تو زانغے کہ نوما ایئرپورٹ آ سربوتغے او مے ٹکٹ ہم اوکے ہینت۔ جاوید پدا مارا
en: I think we should go back. Go back? What are you saying? You know that we've now reached the airport, and our tickets are all set too. Javed, then for us...
en_old: I think we should go back. Go back? What are you saying? You know that we've reached the airport and we've already bought the tickets. Javed, then for us...

brh: ویزہ ہم نہ رسیتے، اللہ خیر کنتے، بابہ کے را، آنٹی استے، باز خیال داری بھی تے ایئے، آ جوڑ بھی تے، تو ہیچ غم مکہ، فکر مکہ۔
en: [...for us] the visa won't come through either. God will make it well. Dad [unclear], auntie is there, she'll look after [her] very well, and she'll get well too. Don't you grieve at all, don't worry.
en_old: We haven't even got the visa yet. God will make things well. Father is coming, auntie is there, she'll take good care of you, and she'll get well too, so don't worry at all, don't be anxious.

brh: او توئی ہمزانہ کہ پدا مارا ویزا ہچبر نہ رسیت۔ ما چوں کنے۔ غم مکہ بابا انشاءاللہ جوڑ بیتے۔ تو بچارہ کہ ما چوں۔
en: And you also know that after this we'll never get the visa again. What would we do? Don't worry, dear, God willing she'll get well. You see how we [are]...
en_old: And you also know that we'll never get a visa again. What will we do? Don't worry, father, God willing it will be fine. You see how we...

brh: کہ رسے کینیڈا او حال رسیت کہ آ جوڑٹ تو ہچ غم اف۔ جوڑ وش تونک تا گشی
en: When [we] reach Canada and the news comes that she is well, then there is no worry at all. [Then] you'll say [she is] well and happy(?)...
en_old: When she reaches Canada and the news comes that she is well, then there's no worry at all. Tell her to get well soon.

brh: خیر واسطہ کار کنے، بگس، بگس، بگس، بگس، بگس، مہر صاحب منے کشنگ، مہر صاحب منے کشنگ، من گشنگ مہر صاحب توار کشنگ، بگس، خیر واسطہ کار کنے، من گشنگ خیر واسطہ کار کنے
en: Who(?) do you work for? Mercy! Mercy! Mercy! Mercy! Mercy! Mir Sahib will kill me, Mir Sahib will kill me! I'm telling you, Mir Sahib [will] kill [me]... Mercy! Who do you work for? I'm asking, who do you work for?
en_old: For God's sake, help me! Grab him, grab him, grab him, grab him, grab him! Mehr Sahib is killing me, Mehr Sahib is killing me! I'm calling out to Mehr Sahib! Grab him! For God's sake, help me, I'm saying for God's sake, help me!

brh: میر صاحب منے بخشے، معاف کر بابا، معاف کر خدا نا واسطہ، تو کئی واسطہ کار کرینے۔ بگوش! میر صاحب منے بخشے بابا، مہربانی کر۔ میر صاحب نا واسطہ کار کرینے۔ بگوش! میر صاحب نا واسطہ کار کرینے۔ میر صاحب نا واسطہ کار کرینے۔
en: Mir Sahib... spare me! Forgive me, sir, forgive me for God's sake! Who have you been working for? Tell me! Mir Sahib... spare me, sir, have mercy. I've been working for Mir Sahib. Tell! I've been working for Mir Sahib. I've been working for Mir Sahib.
en_old: Mir Sahib, forgive me! Forgive me, father, forgive me for God's sake! Who have you been working for? Tell me! Mir Sahib, forgive me, father, please. I've been working for Mir Sahib. Tell me! I've been working for Mir Sahib. I've been working for Mir Sahib.

brh: بیوریشہ! ئے تو معلوم بوت کہ میرے واسطہ کار کنت۔ ٹھیک ہی یار تئی ماری! ئے تو معلوم بوت کہ شما دوئیں میرے واسطہ کار کنے ہا؟ بگوش! بگوش!
en: Bring him! So it turns out he works for Mir. Fine, man, [unclear]! So it turns out you two work for Mir, huh? Tell! Tell!
en_old: Bring him! So it's clear that he works for Mir. Alright, friend, hit him! So it's clear that you two work for Mir, huh? Tell me! Tell me!

brh: بس، لغش، لغش، بس، سیدھا بس، سیدھا بس، ئے تو معلوم بوت کہ شما دوئی المیری واسطہ کار کریر، ہنو پچ، لغش، بس، لغش
en: Enough! Kick [him](?)! Kick [him](?)! Enough! Straight, enough, straight, enough! So it turns out you two have been working for the Mir. Now open up! Kick [him](?)! Enough! Kick [him](?)!
en_old: Enough, kick him, kick him, enough, straight, stay straight! So it's clear that you two worked for Mir. Now open up! Kick him, enough, kick him.

brh: بغس! انسپکٹر! من تنے ساریا گوشت کرینٹ، ایچ معلوم نت۔ تنے معلوم نی ہا؟ بغس! بغس! پاد آ! پاد آ! پاد آ! بغس! من ایچ نساریا، من۔۔۔
en: Mercy! Inspector! I've told you everything; I don't know anything [else]. You don't know, huh? Mercy! Mercy! Get up! Get up! Get up! Mercy! I don't know anything, I...
en_old: Grab him! Inspector! I've told you everything, I don't know anything. Don't you know? Grab him! Grab him! Get up! Get up! Get up! Grab him! I didn't know anything, I...

brh: نزور، نزور، نزور، نزور، بگوش، بگوش، کر، کر، کشنگ ترا، منتر، منتر، منتر کشنگ، منتر کشنگ، بگوش
en: Not so hard(?), not so hard, not so hard, not so hard! Tell! Tell! Do [it], do [it]... [I'll] tell you... I, to you, I to you... I'll tell you, I'll tell you! Tell!
en_old: Harder, harder, harder, harder! Tell me, tell me! Do it, do it! Kill you... the spell, the spell, the spell, recite the spell, recite the spell! Tell me!

brh: بغش بغش بغش بغش توک کیو آستہ کرکنے
en: Mercy, mercy, mercy, mercy! [Unclear]... go easy [on me]!
en_old: Grab him, grab him, grab him, grab him! I'll talk, take it easy on me!

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ بیا میر صاحب۔ چا ہالے؟ چا ہالے، خیریت؟ جوڑ؟ دیر خیریت، جان جوڑ؟ مہربانی، مہربانی۔ پلیز۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Come, Mir Sahib. How are you? How are you, all well? Fine? Is everything else all right, are you in good health? Thank you, thank you. Please.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you too. Come, Mir Sahib. How are you? How are you, is everything well? Are you fine? Is everything well, are you in good health? Thank you, thank you. Please.

brh: میر صاحب شما پرچے تکلیف کرتے۔ شما مارا بگوشتے، ما وت حاضر بوتے۔ اچ شما پیش ہرچ کسیکے
en: Mir Sahib, why did you take the trouble? You should have told us; we would have presented ourselves. Before you, whoever...
en_old: Mir Sahib, why did you trouble yourself? You should have told us, we would have come ourselves. Who is greater to us than you?

brh: ئے دا ئے سیٹ آتکا ہرچ کاری کہ کرتگش پیسرا چما سوج شم کرتہ او ئے گپا تو زانے کہ ما ئے شہرا اتکا
en: ...came to this post, whatever work he did, he would first consult us. And you know this, that we [unclear: 'came to'] this city...
en_old: Whatever work was done in this place before, why did you ask us about it... and about this matter, you know that we came to this city.

brh: چار مردم باز نی چار مردم مارا ہم پجکاریت، ما عزت داریں مردمیں، ما وتی مخلوق ء وتی مردمانی کارا کائیں، او
en: A few people, not many, a few people know us too. We are respectable people; we come to the aid of our own folk, our own people, and...
en_old: Four people, many... four people recognize us too. We are respectable people; we come to help our own people and our folk, and...

brh: مئے مردم، گوما مہر و محبت ہم کنت۔ جی میر صاحب، من زانیں۔ تو زانے گڑا مئے مردما پرچے لوٹائتک؟ انچو۔
en: Our people, too, show us love and affection. Yes, Mir Sahib, I know. If you know, then why did you summon our man? Just like that.
en_old: Our people also show you love and affection. Yes, Mir Sahib, I know. If you know, then why did you rob our people? Just like that.

brh: او اما شمے مردما لوٹائنگ تگا انسپکٹر انچو کسے مردما نہ لوٹائنگ انسپکٹر پہ لوٹائنگا شمارا ایوکا
en: But summoning your(?) man [like this], Inspector: nobody summons a person like that, Inspector. To summon [him], you only...
en_old: And you came asking for our man, Inspector; no one comes asking for a man like that, Inspector, but you alone came asking for him.

brh: مئے مردم دست کپتنت، دگہ کس شما نہ دیست؟ باز افسوز نا گپے، باز من افسوزٹ۔ میر صاحب، ایشتا ناراض بوئنگ نا چے گپے، ئے مئے ڈیپارٹمنٹ نا روٹین ئے من منیو کہ تئی روٹین ئے
en: Only our people fell into your hands? You didn't see anyone else? It's a very regrettable thing; I'm very sorry about it. Mir Sahib, what is there to be upset about in this? This is our department's routine. I accept that it's your routine.
en_old: Our people weren't caught, and no one else saw you? It's a great pity, I'm very sorry. Mir Sahib, what is there to be angry about? This is our department's routine, I accept it, it's your routine.

brh: بلے انسپکٹر ئے گپ آ من ترا شریا سرپد کنے کہ ما چوشیں مردومانی چکوتانہ وت کنے او شما پاد کائیت مئے مردومانی چکوتانہ کنیت
en: But Inspector, let me make you understand this point properly: we ourselves deal with such people, and you take it upon yourselves to come and deal with our people.
en_old: But Inspector, understand what I'm saying properly: we slap such people ourselves, and you come and slap our people.

brh: چش منی خیالا بوتہ نبیت او اگہ چدو دیم آئندہ ہا ئے وڑ بوت گڑا مارا اللہ مہ
en: In my view it shouldn't be like this, and if from now on, in the future, it happens this way again, then don't [blame] us(?)...
en_old: In my opinion it shouldn't have been like this, and if it happens like this again in the future, then God forbid...

brh: برزا گپ جنک کپیت او دگہ گپے ہمدا رئے انسپکٹر رشید گشاں کہ شمے ئے وڑیں کار و کردار ئے رہبند کہ شما زورتگ یک جوانیں اثرے مستاگانہ دت انسپکٹر ایشی وتی دلا بدار
en: [No need for] loud talk(?). And one more thing, right here: Inspector Rashid, I'm telling you that this kind of conduct and approach you have adopted will [not] leave a good effect in the future(?). Inspector, keep this in your heart.
en_old: Don't raise your voice. And one more thing, Inspector Rashid, I'm telling you that the conduct and behavior you have adopted will have a good effect in the future. Inspector, keep this in your heart.

brh: بجت ترو یا
en: [Garbled: possibly 'Did he hit you, or...?']
en_old: Will you go or not?

brh: گپ و گپ و شینا گپ تو زار نا بگوش چے گپ ئے برے گپ جت واجہ اسد بشیر ابوشہرات کے ہا ہا ہمم
en: Talk and talk and [unclear] talk; you [unclear], tell me, what's the matter? Sometimes(?) [someone] spoke... Mr. Asad, Bashir, [unclear]... ha ha, hmm.
en_old: Talk after talk... what's the matter, speak up, said Mr. Asad Bashir Abushahrat... ha ha, hmm.

brh: مگہ پیہ درشت، جی مرشد، جوان، جوان، سد پد بوتو، بشیر و اسد، منی راہا ڈک کنت، منی دے مکائت
en: [Unclear]. Yes, Murshid, good, good, I understood. Bashir and Asad, you're blocking my way; don't come in front of me!
en_old: But come out. Yes, Murshid, good, good, all right then. Bashir and Asad are blocking my way; don't stop me.

brh: منا کپ تو آئی تو برو تو راوے برو
en: [Unclear] ... you go; you're going, so go!
en_old: If you don't find me, then come, come to him, come by the road.

brh: ایلو غریب آ تا ڈغار تے انتئے قبضہ کیک انتئے پریشان کیک نی مخلوق کے دا جوان و بندغہ صاف دا لچ و لوفر سے مخلوق کے لچی کننگٹی مخلوق کے پلنگٹی مخلوق کے لٹنگٹی دا لچو
en: Why does he seize the lands of the other poor people, why does he harass them? You [present] this to people as a good man; plainly this is a scoundrel and a loafer. He is harassing the people, robbing the people, looting the people, this scoundrel...
en_old: Why does he seize the land of the other poor people, why does he trouble them? You tell people he's a good, decent man, but he's a scoundrel and a loafer. He harasses people, robs people, loots people, this scoundrel.

brh: نی تو دے نی بش مننگے نی وسرتا ہیتس پاتنے نی داسہ فلانی نا زبانہ بسو دا گڑا کریس داسہ ایلو دے پٹے جاہی تفیتہ تو داٹی خراب خلیکے با پگہ چار خاندان کنیا ہیت ارفیرہ دا نو گڑا نی کپہ کنا ایلو
en: You, then, the day you stand up, you haven't said a word... Now, on so-and-so's say-so, you came and did this thing. Now the next day they won't give (you) a place, so this is bad. Tomorrow four families will start talking about me. Don't do this new thing, my other...
en_old: You, the day you get up, you say things that have been forgotten: 'You've now come out with so-and-so's words, you did this thing.' Then the next day you won't give them a place. That's bad in this. Tomorrow four families will talk about me. Don't do this new thing, my other...

brh: دلدانی پوفیسندا ملوک چاربازو، ایلم نما چاربازی کیرے، ہنو دانہ مونا ننا ہتاتے کرے کٹے ایکہ دا چاربازو بندو، دلدا دا درو وتھڑے کمک ننا چار
en: Dildar, the (professor?), is a smooth-mannered trickster. Brother, you people are playing tricks. Then, in front of him, he twisted our words, saying that this is a tricky person. Dildar, this, yesterday... help, our...
en_old: Dildar, who belongs to the professor, is a Charbazu. Brother, you are Charbazis. Then in front of him he did our things, saying that this Charbazu man, Dildar, this... help our Char...

brh: دا صدقہ تنن کپنم۔ دا تینا مونا ہچس بننے بس۔ نی انتئے دا دروغ تڑسہ کس۔ دانا زی آ تڑسہ، اسینا دانا ایلم نا زی آ بس، دا مسونے دادے نا مونا سلوک۔ دلدار نا آن سمجھی دروغ تڑوے۔ ایلم نی۔
en: We will not give this away as charity. Nothing of this came up in his presence. Why do you keep telling this lie? You are lying about him; one... it came down on his brother. This has happened, and he is standing in front of you. Dildar, understand... he is lying. Brother, you...
en_old: We won't give this charity. Nothing of this came before him. Why are you lying about this? You lie about him; it came upon his brother. This has happened, standing in front of him. He lied, understanding it from Dildar. Brother, you...

brh: ئے درو ترپیس ور دا بندغاتے اودو نا مونن اسے ہیتنے منیک ئے تاف دا ایلم تتو ہیسنس تے دا اسے ہیت ئس کرنگٹی ء
en: You shouldn't lie... these people, in front of him, he accepts one thing... this brother did not give... in saying one thing.
en_old: ...you wouldn't make it happen, these people in front of him, one thing he accepts... this brother didn't give... in saying one thing.

brh: ایلو منہ ئے چٹ لکھ جوان افس۔ السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ نثار خان باجئی، بھلو سکرہ، بے خیری، سکرہ، طبیعت صحت، بھلو سکرہ، بے خیری، اشرف جان جوڑ، بھلو سکرہ، خوش۔
en: Otherwise it is not good at all. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Nisar Khan Bajoi, many thanks to God, no trouble, thanks; your health is good; many thanks, no trouble; is Ashraf Jan well? Many thanks, happy.
en_old: The other, it's not good at all. Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you too. Nisar Khan sir, very well, no trouble, well, health is fine, very well, no trouble, Ashraf Jan is fine, very well, happy.

brh: جوڑ جوڑ جوڑ جوڑ خیرات خیرات خوش باش خیرات خوش باش خیرات خیرین تال توالک ایلو حال حوال ئنا دے دا
en: Well, well, well, well; fine, fine, happy and well, fine, happy and well, fine, all good... and otherwise, how are things, what's your news...
en_old: Alright, alright, alright, alright. Charity, charity, happy and well, charity, happy and well, charity, good... and now, how are you doing, what's the news?

brh: بس کنے منے مست مہالو دا ہیتس کرے بیبر نا بارہ ٹی۔ اچھا۔ تو بیبر نی غلط پارے نی دروغ پارے نی غلط تو ہیت کرے ہاو بیبر دائے لو ہیت کرے دائے لو ہیت ہاو سئی۔
en: Well, earlier he told me something about Bibar. Okay. So Bibar said wrong things to you, told you lies, talked wrongly to you... Yes, Bibar said this, said this, yes, right.
en_old: So my drunk ex-wife said something about Bibar. Okay. So Bibar, you said it wrong, you lied, you spoke wrongly. Yes, Bibar spoke about this, spoke about this, yes, right.

brh: گڑا اینو ہسینے ایسنے دا ایرپ تو، ایرپ تو مسلمان خننے شریف بندغس، بائے بائے ننا ہیت کرے ننا گڑا کرے دا دروغ تو، ہنے انتئے دو کس، انتئے دو کس، اسہ بندغس اسہ چہ غلط پائے
en: Then today he has brought these two; the two of them, as we've seen, are Muslims, decent people. Brother to brother, they talked about us, did things to us; this is a lie. Then why did you do so, why did you do so? A person says one wrong thing...
en_old: Then today they came, these two. Both of them are Muslims, decent people. Bye-bye, they talked with us, did things with us. This is a lie, so why did you do it, why did you do it? One person says something wrong.

brh: ئے دم ہیلو منہ اونا کڑتے تخش۔ اور نی اسہ گپہ سوج کات باری سوال آ ہینو ایسنو دا اینو مقابلہ کننگ اٹی اٹ۔ باز خوش اٹ اینو دا منے باوا اور باری ننا دا پین دا بس دا جنگ خیر تری خوش و سنا جوان۔
en: ...put his shirt... And you asked one thing, about the question; I came today to face this. I am very happy today, this... father, and about our other... this fight, may it end well, happy and good.
en_old: ...keep his clothes. And you asked one thing, about the question, I came today to compete. I'm very happy today, this is my father, and about our other... this fight, may it be well, happy and good.

brh: انسان ایرا بندغ نا جومٹ خوش کیک، شیطان فشماری کیرا بندغ نا جوم کیک، چلو اسے بندغ اسہ مرے کہ انسانی پالو نا دوئی اسیٹس تینا زبان نا اسیٹس کشا لیکن ایلو بندغ نا تا
en: A human being brings two people together and makes them happy; Satan, by stirring up trouble, works on the two people (against each other). Say a person happens, being human, to let one thing slip with his hand and one thing out of his own tongue, but the other person's...
en_old: A human makes a person happy, Satan, with anger, makes a person... Let's say a person is such that he shows human sympathy with one hand and with his tongue... but the other person's...

brh: دا کپک ء کائے او نا عید ء ایڈے سر کیرا بندغے دا ایلو جنگ ئے دا جوان اف دا سوچ کے سمجھ کے مرے کس آ نا غلطی مرے غلطی آ انسان نا زبان آن پیش تمک لیکن ایلو بندغ او درپ ایلو ایلو مسرپک
en: He does not do this... his Eid... people... This fighting is not good. It should be done with thought and understanding. If it is someone's mistake, mistakes slip out of a person's tongue, but the other person should not take it (to heart)...
en_old: He doesn't do this... his Eid... spoils a person. This fighting is not good. It should be thought through and understood. If someone makes a mistake, a mistake slips out of a person's tongue, but the other person shouldn't...

brh: سمجھاس کنا ئے ننا اوپکار پین کس کپک۔ جوان۔ اگر اسے چس ہیت کیرے نی ولانی ہتا مقابل کے جنگ ایتیتا۔ ایلو نی او اینو اللہ ہیس مہربانی کر دادے سمجھائف۔ دا گڑا جوان واف دا ساسین جنگ اسے ٹی تینا
en: Understand, no one else will do us a favor. Good. If someone says something, you go and confront so-and-so's words and start a fight. And you, today, for God's sake, please make him understand. This thing is not good; this... a fight in which one's own...
en_old: Understand, no one else will do us a favor. Good. If someone says something, you go up against them and give them a fight. The other... today, God willing, please make him understand. This thing is not good, in a fight his own...

brh: دا کس و سرمان سینا اخس و نسخانی مرے بس اللہ ہیس بالکل زر خان کنے نا جوان خبر ہن او ایرا وار مال نا وارنو حساب کتاب مسونے دا دیندار نا ہمو بندغاتے خلقونے ننت دوتے دا پھرغانی دینداری بس و پارت کے فلانی
en: Whatever someone's loss or damage may be... by God, absolutely... Zar Khan, good news for me... and between the two sides there was a settling of accounts over property. These men of the pious one have beaten those people and broken their legs and arms; so much for piety! And they said that so-and-so...
en_old: Whatever someone's loss or harm is, God willing, quite soon... the good news... and there were accounts of goods between the two. These people of the religious one hit them and broke their hands. Is this religiousness? And so-and-so said...

brh: ننے دو پارے نی بر فلانی پارے ئے تو برے کنے مقابل پیدا خلاسی نی نمانتے بسنووے۔ ئے پائے نن او نی پارے بر او پارے ننے دو پارے بر نی پارے سگاٹھے مان نن پن نی پارے ہتوس۔ ہمو وجہ آن خلق اوفتہ نت دو برغا۔ ادا نن نی پارے۔
en: He told us like this: 'You come.' So-and-so said: 'Then come and face me'... you came to you... He says, we... and you said 'come', and he said, he told us like this, 'come', you said... we... you said... For that reason people broke their legs and arms. Here we... you said.
en_old: He told us, 'Come.' So-and-so said, 'Then come.' You created a confrontation with me, you came to you all. He says, 'We...' You said, 'Come.' He said to us, 'Come.' You said... we... you said, 'He came.' For that reason people beat them. Here we... you said.

brh: شاباش افسوس کہ نی بچہ ئس پدا آئندہ دوں کپہ دا گڑا تینا دوں کپہ او بس مہربانی کپہ ہندا مسونے کہ بندغ نا بچہ فیروٹ امید ئے دا دے کسے فیتو اچھا ہلی تماٹٹ شاباش ہمو مسلمانے پیر وریسے حاجی سرا کمبخت
en: Well done. A pity that you are a youngster. Never do like this again in the future; don't do this thing like that yourself, and just, please don't. This is what happened, that a person's child... hope... today no one... okay... Bravo, that Muslim, the old man, the Hajji... wretched...
en_old: Well done. A pity that you are a child. Don't do this again in the future, don't do it yourself, and please don't. This is what happened, that a person's child... hope... nobody... okay, well done, that Muslim, the elder, the Hajji, the wretch...

brh: او منت کرے کرے لیلاک، ئے فٹی لٹ، اینو بتا ایلو بیتء گلی ساتھ کرے ایلو بیتء با دلہ خانی دا، کہ دا انسان نا سمجھسی، بس اللہ ہدایت دے، ناس نادانس
en: And he begged and begged... today the other... went along with the abuse... the other... that this is a human's understanding. May God just guide him; he is an ignorant person.
en_old: He pleaded and pleaded... today the other... went along with the abuse... the other... this, that this is human understanding. May God guide them, they're ignorant people.

brh: ہسے ئے ونس کہ دونو کاریم کے گڑا ولدا کہ درگزر ہسے اب دا ٹیم آ گرس نی دا بندغے درگزر کر آئندہ دا اینو نا زی آ شاباش کسے خبر اف کہ دنیا ٹی انت مس انت متنے صحیح ئے بھائی بس دا ہیتے کہ
en: So he said that people do such things, and then again forgiveness... Now, at this time, you forgive this person; in future... on today's matter, well done. No one knows what has happened in the world and what has not. Right, brother, just this thing that...
en_old: Like this, he said that such things were done, then he forgave. Now at this time... you forgive this person, in the future... on today's matter, well done. Nobody knows what happened in the world and what didn't. Right, brother, just this thing that...

brh: نا کپل نا مخلوق خوار زار اینت واجہ ننا واجہ ئے این آئی تے دے کیڑے سر کیگی این ادا ورتو داڑے کل شیطان خوش مریک انسان خوش مریک ہا سنگت وت آدم نا بیوقوف کنیا بارو
en: ...the people of your... are miserable and wretched. What, sir, our sir... here... at this Satan becomes happy, a human becomes happy. Yes, friend... the fool of Adam's race... about me...
en_old: ...people suffer misery. What, sir, our sir... here, everyone... Satan is happy, a human is happy. Yes, friend, the fool of Adam... about me...

brh: دا باز ہنا ہنا نا ہیتہ بش کرے کائٹ جنگ کے جنگ کرینو بندہ سے واسطے ہیتہ بش کرینو ئے سمجھ وارو بندہ غا صرف پہلا بندہ غا نی ئس کہ ہنا بندہ نا باری ٹی نی اوتھ ہلکنس ایلو بندہ غتو پفجائی باری ٹی بس ہڑتومغاتے نی آفت تے جنگ کرے
en: He raised a lot of talk about this one and that one... fought, raised talk for the sake of someone. A sensible person... only the first person... that about that person you took it up... about the other person... you just made trouble and fought with both of them.
en_old: He raised many things about this and that, a fight... fought, raised things for someone's sake. Understanding person... only the first person... you, about that person you... about the other person... you fought with both of them.

brh: نی شاباس ہی نی لکھ رحمت ہی کہ نی سمجھدار بندغ اسیس ماشاءاللہ باز فراخ دل بندغ اسیس خوارو بندغ اسیس صاحب یار مسیت دے کہ خناٹ نی داسہ اینو ہنا خاطرا دادے خسیٹوٹے شاباس ہی نی بندغ دے اچانک
en: Well done to you, a hundred thousand blessings on you, for you are a sensible person, mashallah, a very large-hearted person, a humble person, sir. Friend, the day I saw you at the mosque... now today, for his sake, (you) ... him. Well done to you, a person who suddenly...
en_old: Well done to you, a hundred thousand blessings on you, that you are a sensible person, mashallah, a very generous person, a good person, sir. Friend, the day I saw you... now today for his sake I brought him. Well done, you are a man... suddenly...

brh: بس چٹائے، اینتے کتو مکھ مس، ہاز مہربانی، نا باز مہربانی، بدہ سئی دے بو مسوس، آفرین، چلو ٹھیک ہی دا وہ پارینے، پدی تو خدا، صحیح، صحیح، ناراض مفے، اللہ حافظ، تولی خیکہ، تولی خیکہ نہ ئے اللہ نی خوش
en: That's it, it's all finished. Why... many thanks, many thanks to you... Bravo. Okay, fine, he has said this. Then, God... right, right. Don't be upset. Goodbye. Sit... sit... no, may God keep you happy.
en_old: That's it, all of it. Why didn't... thank you very much, many thanks to you. Then, right, it was bad... bravo. Okay, fine, he said this. Then, God... right, right. Don't be upset. God be with you. Sit, sit. No... may God keep you happy.

brh: مشتے گدھو نو گڑا قدم تاؤنو گڑا کپیس ہنا مہربانی جی کے ادا نی تو تکلیف مگڑی مدد نی نہ نہ ابا دا ہنا نی داڑس کائیس بس خیر ئس مشتے گڑا کپیس تا گڑا سمجھا تولس ئے کبو تولس ئے کبو
en: Don't do anything bad, don't take any such step. Thank you for your kindness, sir, for taking the trouble here... help... you... no, no, dear, this... you came all the way here, that's all, it's fine. Don't do such a thing... understand... please sit down, please sit down.
en_old: Don't do anything bad, don't take a wrong step... Thank you, sir. You've gone to trouble here, helping... no, no, father, you came here, that's all, it's fine. Don't do anything bad... understand... sit down, sit down.

brh: ابدا ثناء اللہ نگہبان نومبو تینا کاریم ماریم تے کبو آئندہ ایلم آنبار ایلم آنبار اللہ نگہبان ابدا تکلی ماف درو مسخرے یا نی گڑاس کرے تینٹ بشخے ایلم آنبار ایلم آنبار
en: Now, Sanaullah, God protect you. Go on with your work and so on, all of you. In future be like brothers, like brothers. God protect you. Now, forgive the trouble; if there was any joking, or you did something, forgive each other among yourselves, like brothers, like brothers.
en_old: Now, God protect you. Stay well, go on with your work and such. Brother, brother, God protect you. Now, forgive the trouble. If there was any joking, or if I did something, please forgive me. Brother, brother.

brh: دا یکہ غو صحیح تینا ہند آن ہنا غٹ خبردار آوا خبردار اسٹ دا یکہ غو صحیح تینا ہند آن ہنا غٹ
en: Look after this one properly, from its own place, all of it. Careful, careful, one... Look after this one properly, from its own place, all of it.
en_old: This one, move properly from your place, all of you. Beware, beware, one... this one, move properly from your place, all of you.

brh: اماں خبر افنے اماں خبر افنے اینو متے غیلس ئس ہمو غیلس ئس ولے خبر افنے ولے افسوس ہا بارستورے یا ڈکاں اوستے وڈے دا با نی ماشاءاللہ باز سمجھدار او بندہ وسس
en: Mother, you don't know, mother, you don't know. Today... that same... but you don't know; but alas... yes... you, mashallah, were a very sensible man.
en_old: Mother, there's no news, mother, there's no news. Today there was no... the same... but there's no news. What a pity... father, you, mashallah, were a very sensible man.

brh: دا دا دا بندغ نا کاری بندغ آتے کہ او بس نی پارے کہ فلانی نی دو پارے نی دے پارے او پند بس تسس کہ بئے فلانی ئے پاروئی تو برے کنے مقابل پائے اینتے پائے ہرا بندغ کہ برے نی پائے کہ فلانی نی دو پارے نی
en: This, this, this man's way with people was that, when you just said 'so-and-so said this to you, said that to you', he only gave this advice: 'If something has to be said to so-and-so, come and say it to my face; why do you say it...' Whatever person comes and you say that 'so-and-so said this to you'...
en_old: This, this man's work for people was that when someone said, 'So-and-so said this about you, said that about you,' he would simply advise: 'If you have something to say about so-and-so, come and say it to my face. Why say it...' Whoever came and said, 'So-and-so said this about you...'

brh: ہنو سمجھ کینہ ننا چنت نی پارے کڈے نی دو نا زبانہ ہم نی مس کینہ ننا او پارے کینہ تو نی ماشاءاللہ باز سمجھدارو بندہ اسیس باز سیالو بندہ اسیس کہ دا کاریم نی کنے گٹی اسیس اگر ننا کل مخلوق کن او پارے کہ تو ننا خلق اٹی ننا ملک اٹی ننا علاقہ اٹی
en: So we understand... you said... in your words too... and he said... So you, mashallah, are a very sensible person, a very good kinsman, for doing this work for me. If all our people did as he said, then among our people, in our country, in our area...
en_old: That's how we understand it... you said... in your words as well... you, mashallah, are a very sensible man, a very kind man, for doing this work for me. If for all our people... among our community, in our country, in our area...

brh: نی جنگ ازمرو نی فساد ئس نی پینس اگر ہر بندہ ایلو نا ایتا عمل کپ ہرا کسے پارے کہ فلانی دو پارے نی بٹ واٹی تے چپلس تو کاریم جوان مرے معاملہ ہچ سہی مرے
en: there would be no fighting, no strife, nothing else, if no one acted on another's words, and if, whenever someone says 'so-and-so said this about you', you gave him a slap; then things would go well and the matter would be set right.
en_old: There would be no fighting from you, no strife from you. If no one acted on what others said, if whoever says 'so-and-so said this' were ignored, then things would go well and matters would be set right.

brh: سمجھا سمجھتوس، باز اسہ جوان بندغ اسے، باز اننگو، باز گچینو، نی اللہ آباد کے، اللہ خیر کے، گڑا داسہ نن نی کنے اجازت، اللہ امانت، زندگی مس، تکلیف معاف، زندگی مس، برے نمے تون ملینہ انتئے کہ ئے اسہ کاریم اسے نی آ بسوٹ، جی جی، لیکن دا ٹیم ئے پاپا ربطہ سے دا مسئلے دا حساب مچے پریشانی مسوٹ
en: Understood, understood. A very good person, very ..., very fine. May God keep you prosperous, may God do you good. So now give me leave. Go in God's care. If life allows, forgive the trouble; if life allows, we will come and meet you all, because I had come to you about a matter. Yes, yes. But this time... contact... this problem, this account... I was a little worried.
en_old: Understood, understood. A very good person, very kind, very fine. May God keep you prosperous, may God bless you. So now give me permission. God keep you. If life allows, forgive the trouble. If life allows, we'll come and meet you, because I came to you for a matter. Yes, yes. But this time, papa, contact... this problem, this whole account... I was worried.

brh: اللہ پاک نی منت ننا ہر امید اللہ پاک پوار کرے
en: God Almighty, thanks to your kindness; may God Almighty fulfill our every hope.
en_old: May God Almighty bless you, and may God fulfill our every hope.

brh: اینو دا بندغ نا خاطران بچا، نتہ دا اینو بچتو غکنا دعا، دلدار خان نا باز مہربانی، ننا خاطرے کریس، نی اودے یلہ کریس، دہونا بندغ نا دوا ہننو، نت و دوک تے پنر کہ پین کس ہننو کارم کپ، ولدا ام نی کریس، مہربانی کریس، ننا عزتی کریس، نی دا غلطنگا بندغ
en: Today he was saved for this man's sake; otherwise he would not have survived today. My prayers — many thanks to Dildar Khan: you did it for our sake, you let him go. The cure for a man like that is this: break his legs and arms so that he never does such a thing to anyone else. And yet again you did it — you showed kindness, you honored us — toward this man who was in the wrong.
en_old: Today he was saved for this man's sake, otherwise he wouldn't have survived today, by my prayer. Many thanks to Dildar Khan, you did it for our sake, you let him go. Don't pray for a man like that, and tell your hands and feet not to do such a thing again. You did it again too, you showed kindness, you honored us, you, this wrong man.

brh: دے ولدا ننا خاطرا نی الاس باز نا مہربانی
en: Today again you let him go for our sake — thank you very much.
en_old: Thank you so much for standing up for us again today.

brh: شرف خیرے اینو مونجا خننگسہ۔ ہاو کنے آ خیرے نی امیدے آ دلدارے کنا مونا لوفر پاریس۔ ہاو۔
en: Sharaf, all well? You look sad today. — Yes. — As for me, it's fine; but you called Dildar a loafer in front of me. — Yes.
en_old: Sharaf, it's fine, today he's looking sad. Yes, it's fine with me, you, with hope, called Dildar a loafer in front of me. Yes.

brh: او پاریٹ تے گڑا دا سرائی مہ کنتو کن خیر تیرے ئے انے ارام کن دیوانی داسا دلدارہ دلدارہ مونا لوفر پاتے گڑا منے وانی او ایلم ہرا دے آ وقت بس عید مونا نا موت لوفر پاوہ کنیا
en: I told him, 'Then don't make this fuss; it's all right, calm down.' Madness — now he called Dildar a loafer right to Dildar's face! Then that brother, on the day the time came, just before Eid, calls me a loafer to my face.
en_old: He said, then don't make this fuss, it's fine, for my peace... now Dildar, Dildar, he called him a loafer to his face, then... the brother who on that day, the time came, before Eid, he calls me a loafer to my face.

brh: دا دنیا ہپ، ئے پاننگ کیوٹے، اگر پاننگ کیوٹے تو رائے مکھان پاتے، ہراٹھے ما وقت بس ایودے پاوان ئے تینا کسرے ہلت ہنک، خلیس ہنتیکے، دا سبقان پاتے، نی چوا ہجل افے نی
en: This world... I can say it; and if I can say it, then I told him: 'Don't send him off.' Whenever the time came, I would tell him: 'Take your own road and go.' He got scared and went off; for that reason I told him: you, you are not...
en_old: This world, no... I can say it, if I can say it then I said don't give an opinion. Wherever the time came, I tell him to take his own path and go, you hit, go away. I said this from this lesson, you don't know, you're not big.

brh: ئے چاوٹ پاو یا پاپڑ نا جاننت خسکیک کنا جان خلک کپک اسوار کانے کنا مون لوفر پاتے اوڑایت ختم ایلوم ایت ختمے نی
en: I know — whether I say it or not... my life can't bear it — once he came and called me a loafer to my face. Then it's over, brother; it's over for you.
en_old: I know, whether a pao or a papad... my life is burning, I can't stand it. The rider came and called me a loafer to my face. Then it's over, brother, it's over, you.

brh: تینا کسرے ہلی اینک ئے تینا کسرے ہلپرے اینو ہرا لٹ اینے دلدارا دیوا اشرف جان اینو نی نشہ تو کتنوس ئے نشہ کتنوٹ ڈرائیو مکا دلدارا اللہ رفیق دا
en: 'Take your own road and go' — I won't take my own road. Today, whatever happens, I'm going to Dildar's. — Ashraf jan, you haven't been taking anything intoxicating today, have you? — I haven't taken anything. — Don't drive to Dildar's. God be with you.
en_old: Take your own path and go, don't take your own path. Today, whatever beating it is, Dildar, crazy Ashraf jaan, today you haven't been drinking, have you? I haven't been drinking. Don't drive, Dildar, God be your companion, this one.

brh: دا ناموس نی مغز خراب، الے تے رائے مکان
en: This is a matter of honor — your head is messed up. Brother, don't send him off.
en_old: This honor... you, your brain is messed up, brother, don't give them an opinion.

brh: دا اسہ نما جوان کنے کاٹم
en: This young man of yours — he's on my head.
en_old: This one is your good one, he's beating me.

brh: اڑے نم کنے ہران کاری ہنمل نی ہڑی تو متھنوس
en: Hey, where are you taking me? You've gone mad.
en_old: Hey, where are you taking me? Go, you're not even sober.

brh: ئے اڑے متھن اٹ راہی مکان دلدار نا پیش کے ونے۔ پدائی وفرے ئے نا نوکر اٹ یا دلدار نا نوکر اٹ کہ نی تو برے وی نی بروئی تمنے گھرا لٹے انت کہ آخیر انت کہ برے وی تو۔
en: Hey, don't send him off in this crazed state — he'll go before Dildar. Afterwards... am I your servant or Dildar's servant, that you say you must come, you have to come home? Why, after all — why should I come?
en_old: Hey, he's drunk, don't go along with him, Dildar's... before... Afterwards, whether with his servant or with Dildar's servant, you must come, it's necessary for you to come home, because in the end, why should you come too.

brh: تو نی نی دا وجم بروئی تمیک نی دلدارے لوفر پارینوس اینو دے وی دلدار تو مقابلہ کے ونے ادا دا خاخوتو تفاسنگنے امر کیندار دا دلے کانے دا امر اکیسے نم تو کنے الرے
en: So you, you have to come for this reason: you have called Dildar a loafer. Today there will be a showdown with Dildar. Here, this... how... this heart... how is this? You are with me.
en_old: So you, you have to come for this reason, you called Dildar a loafer. Today, Dildar will fight you too. Here these... how, how do you do this, this heart came, how do you do this, you are with me.

brh: آئی نو مائی لیبر از، آئی نو اینو مے دلدارہ لازمی دیوے، دانی ننے دلدارہ دننگ کپیسہ، نماگے میشور نی ننے ہکلے سے دیسہ، نی سلے اناڑے ہننگ جوانوس، برا ایمکان اینو
en: I know, my... I know, today I'm definitely going to Dildar's. Now you can't take us [away] from Dildar's. Will you give us orders? You'd do well to go and stand over there. Come on, not today.
en_old: I know my labor, I know today I'll definitely hit Dildar. Now you can't stop us from Dildar. Yours... you will give us a call, you'd better go over there, come on, don't today.

brh: نی کنے آن ہرا نکس ہینو؟ او ہرا جلیٹی
en: What are you taking from me? Which one is that?
en_old: What are you taking from me? Which one, that one?

brh: ارے نی تینے انت سمجھانوس؟ ئے تینے انت سمجھف، سدھا کانہ دلدارہ۔ دا سہ کانہ دلدارہ۔
en: Hey, who do you think you are? What should I think of myself? We're going straight to Dildar's. We're going to Dildar's now.
en_old: Hey, what do you think of yourself? What does he think of himself? Go straight, Dildar. Go to this side, Dildar.

brh: پا دلدارا برے صفا فیسے دلدارا تینا مرضی اٹ کاوا نی تو اسل بفرہ بفرہ بفرہ مے کن تو بروئی تمک نی انت کہ غگ کنے دلدارا دے سہ کونینگ نی دا دلدار چوا
en: Look, it's clear: I'll go to Dildar's of my own will. You, don't come at all — don't come, don't come. For me it is necessary to go. Why... me to Dildar's today... you know this Dildar.
en_old: Say, Dildar, come, it's clear, Dildar comes of his own will. You shouldn't come at all, don't come, don't come. For us, it's necessary to come. Why... me, Dildar, today... you, this Dildar, you don't know.

brh: نی دا وڑ نا دلدار ئس دے، نی دلدارے لوفر پاریس، اینو کان نی دلدار نا مونا اود لوفر پا، نی کنے دلدار اسو نن کپیس، دلدار نی دیوے دیوے دیوے، اینا لکھے خلیوے مگے دلدار
en: You, with this kind of Dildar — you called Dildar a loafer; today go and call him a loafer to Dildar's face. You didn't... me... Dildar. Dildar — you'll take him on, take him on, take him on? You're scared like this, but Dildar...
en_old: You're that kind of Dildar, today you called Dildar a loafer. Today you come and call Dildar a loafer to his face. You didn't do me any Dildar... Dildar, you hit him, hit him, hit him, you'll hit like this, but Dildar.

brh: نی انت کہ دا خلیس ء دلدار نا خلیس ء دفا نی نی آن خلیوے نی دلدار آن خلیوے 40 پرسنٹ کہ نی خلیس ء ہلکونس کہ دلدارا برے مگر انت کہ دلدارا برے دلدار نا مگے کردار اوٹ برے ئے مگے ہیٹ ئس ایٹ نی عقل ئس کس کہ مگے میل ئس
en: Why did you get scared — scared of Dildar? This time you are afraid of me; you are afraid of Dildar. Forty percent that you've got scared about coming to Dildar's — but why would you come to Dildar's? Dildar's character... am I a goat or what? Have some sense; but a...
en_old: Why did you hit? You hit Dildar... you, you'll hit, you'll hit Dildar, 40 percent, you hit and took... that Dildar should come, but why should Dildar come? Dildar's character... but a goat... you, have some sense, but a desire...

brh: ضرور نی داسہ کنے نی ہنو کنے دننگ کپیسہ۔ ئے نی دلدارہ دے تانکو لوفر اونا مونا پاتہ مسونٹ۔ دلدارہ دننگ کنے کنے داسہ۔
en: Surely you can't take me now — you can't take me like that. I have called Dildar a loafer to his face to this day. Going to Dildar's — that's me, me, right now.
en_old: Sure, now you, me, you can't stop me now. You called Dildar a loafer to his face until today. Stop Dildar, me, me, now.

brh: ارے نی دلدار نا شونکی نا نی ہن دلدار کنے انت گدے دلدار ارے صفا۔ راست پاہ راست پاہ خدا ہلی دا دیر وشنو ہلی ہلی کھٹی ہلکونو کسر اٹ۔ ہندرے کنے انت گدے
en: Hey, you... Dildar's... you go — Dildar, what is it to me? Dildar is clean. Tell the truth, tell the truth, by God... take it, take it... they took ... onto the road. What is it to me like this?
en_old: Hey, you, Dildar's fondness... you go, Dildar, what's wrong with me? Dildar is clean. Tell the truth, tell the truth, by God, this... take it, take it, took the bed onto the road. Like this, what's wrong with me?

brh: ہنو مشتا کیو نی کنے الے، دا ہناڑے مشتا کیو، ہناڑے ہنو، کنے الے وا حاجی کہ دا ہناڑے مشتا کہ، دا ہن کنے الے، ارو مما تا ہمو چکہ ہمو گدا تا ادا
en: Let me wait like that — you're my brother; let me wait over there; go over there. My brother, Haji, wait over there; this — go, my brother... that same one... those same ones here.
en_old: Go wait, you're my brother. Go wait over there, go there. My brother, Haji, go wait there again. This, go, my brother... today, at Mama's, that same one, those same ones here.

brh: چکن گنگونی تئی دادے کسے فیور داننے دلدارا دے درازو گٹو کتے بس ادا بس نی ہم تمانو ہلا سالیبو ادا خیر ہن بس کسنا نی ہم ہلکونور اسیلوی دا اربل تمانے ڈائڈمبا
en: ...Dildar... it took a long while; he just came here. You too have fallen in... stand up... here, all right, go... you too have taken...
en_old: ...Dildar... it took a long time, then he came here. You sit down too. Go on, welcome, he came here. Whose... you too will take... sit down.

brh: بر کنے دلدارا بر دلدارا مرگ این دلدار نا مگی خرداروڑ دا کنے دلدارا دیکھ یا دانا نوکروٹ یا دلدار نا نوکروٹ کنے دیکھ زورٹ زورٹ دیر دے نی کھے مگ ہیٹ اسو میٹ اسو دا کلے کائک کنے دلدار نا چہرہ ئے کینو نوم ہلکو نا داڑیا سلو پٹ کنے گورے ہاں جی ئنا
en: Come, take me to Dildar's, come to Dildar's — death today... Dildar's... look at me, to Dildar's — am I this man's servant or Dildar's servant? Look at me! By force, by force... how long... am I some goat or something? ... Dildar's face... your beard... yes, sir.
en_old: Come, Dildar, come Dildar... Dildar's... look at me, Dildar. Look, either his servant or Dildar's servant, look at me. Forcefully, forcefully, for how long... Dildar's face... yes, sir.

brh: دا زلدار لوفر پارے، دا ساسل دے زلدار پارے، پرواہ صفا گڈا، اگر او پارے دے ہم خیر اسے، الے تا داسا کرے پرواہ صفا نام و نام دے زلدار خنے اخس خلقک، نی بس او زلدارے توریس، نی کنے بچیفیس، ادا اینے ئنا خا دے
en: This one called Dildar a loafer; that day he said it to Dildar — then I don't care at all. If he said it, that's fine too. Brother, now he has done it — I don't care at all. By name... that day Dildar saw how hard he strikes. You just held Dildar back; you saved me, here, today...
en_old: Dildar called him a loafer. Dildar said it, and he didn't care at all. If he said so, fine. Now brother did it, he didn't care at all. Dildar saw how hard he hits. You just held Dildar back, you saved me, here...

brh: دا مچے وڈ کنے بیوقوفی او کاریم کیسہ دا مسلمان خبر ہیتس کنے کتا ننے اینا زنا ہیتس ہر کسے دے او دے پارستہ کنے دا پارنے گردتا بس داسا جنگ کپبو نی تینا کسرے اٹلا بو تینا کسرے ہلی بے وقتی ہنو کاریم کپبو جنگ کپبو ہو
en: All this sort of foolishness — why do you do such things? This Muslim fellow told me something: to us, a remark like this about [our] women; he said it to everyone, said it to him too, and said this to me... Just don't fight now. Take your own road, take your own road; don't do such a rash thing, don't fight, okay?
en_old: This is all foolishness. Why do you do such things? This Muslim said something about my wife to us. He said it to everyone, he said it to me too. Just don't fight now. Go your own way, take your own path. Don't do anything rash, don't fight, okay?

brh: او برے کن تو دلدار ہمو رننائی ٹی کھے گڑا ئے الیوا۔ نی داسا بیور کے داسا دلدار تو جنگ تے سے ایڑے نی داسا تا جوانو کارم کننگ اٹی ئس ہنا ایتا تے نا الیوا داسا کرے ہنک۔ ٹھیک ئے چاچی داسا کا ہندا دے کھپتے دلدار۔ ٹھیک ئے ٹھیک ئے ہالی نی ہن داکا داسا
en: If he comes for that, then Dildar... in that... then I'll let it go. Now you believe it — now there will be no fight with Dildar. There, you are now doing a good deed; for the sake of your words I'll let it go. Now it's done, go. — Okay, auntie, now go... Dildar. — Okay, okay; now you go from here, now.
en_old: He came for that. Dildar wants something in the light. Now you, Bewar... now Dildar is fighting. Now you're doing good work... now he did it, go. Okay, auntie, now Dildar... Okay, okay, now you go from here.

brh: آ جیدات خدا خلیدا شیطان اسے، شیطانیا وارفتے، بابا او بے دماغ اسے نم تو سر ہالو نورے، نم وڑو
en: Ah... may God strike this one — he is a devil, gripped by devilry. Baba, he is a brainless one; you people, at least, have sense — people like you.
en_old: Oh Jeedat, God has struck him, he's a devil, a devilish one. Father, he's brainless. You just go to sleep, you sleep.

brh: ہلبو نم فائدہ ٹی مریرے بالکل آ جی دا ہیت آک سہی اف دا سہی اف کنا ہیت ء ہلبو ہمبو ہورا تا دیر
en: Accept it; it will be to your benefit. — Absolutely, sir. — These things are not right; this is not right. Take my word; go on, look, it's late.
en_old: Leave it, it'll be to your benefit. Absolutely, yes, these words aren't right. This isn't right. Listen to me, leave it. Look how late it is.

brh: او دلدارا بر ہیسے بخیسے، او دماغ نا کاریم کے، اسہ وار پاتا ونے، پنچ وار پارٹ نی کہ دلدارا بفر، دلدار خیرات تس کرے نین برے۔ ئے دے وی دلدار نا مونا منج شو ونے، ہرا دے ونے۔ ئے نی دے وی دلدار نا مونا
en: Oh, you came to Dildar's... seeking forgiveness... Use your brain! I told you once; I told you five times: don't go to Dildar's. Dildar let you off out of charity — did you come? That day too, in front of Dildar... which day... and you too, that day, in front of Dildar...
en_old: Oh Dildar, come... oh, use your brain! I told you once, I said five times, Dildar, come. Dildar gave charity, did he come today? Today too, in front of Dildar... today you too, in front of Dildar...

brh: ایو دماغ ء کنا خراب کپہ بس الے ہنک۔ کنا اسو دلدار تو لگے پک کنا
en: Hey, don't mess with my head; just go, brother. I'm bound to clash with Dildar, for sure.
en_old: Hey, don't mess with my mind, just go, brother. My one Dildar, I was sure.

brh: او تو انتس کائے کہ دلدارا برے دلدارا کہ بفیس ہمے لوفر انتک فیس ننا پین ہم بدنام فیس لوفر پارے دلدارے نی وا خیر بدنام اسوس ٹھیک کہ لوفر پارے سے دا
en: And why does he go, that he should come to Dildar's? [I told you] don't come to Dildar's, that same loafer, why do you...? You're dragging our name into disgrace too. He called Dildar a loafer. Well, you were already disgraced anyway. Fine, so he called him a loafer, that's all this is.
en_old: Why did he even come, Dildar? Why did you bring Dildar? Why do you call him a loafer? You've disgraced us even more. He called Dildar a loafer. You're already disgraced anyway. Fine, he called him a loafer.

brh: دا سا مون انت پافیس لوفر پافیس آتے نان دے خالی ئے برے مون انت پافتے ئے او دلدار جنگ کین نی خوش برک نی وا جک سر سیل کننے جنگ کے کپنے
en: Now don't say anything to his face, don't call him a loafer. He comes to us empty-handed; don't say anything to his face. That Dildar fights and you enjoy it; you just stand by and watch the show, you don't fight [yourself].
en_old: Now what will you say to their faces? You'll call them loafers. They come empty-handed, what will they say to their faces? That Dildar fights, you're happy, you just sit and watch the fight and don't fight.

brh: پچھے چا ہمیرک ڈوپر پارے سدا سا پولیسن جی سرانسر ادا پولیس پولیس نا ایچو ہیت ئس افک نن ہیت ئس کرین کہ کتو ور نی ننا لکھٹی تماس بابائے لجانے ننا ہنے نی ارا کا بے پخ ننا لکھٹی تماس ہمو کن کے لکھ
en: Afterwards ... he said at noon, 'Now the police, sir...' Here the police, the police have nothing at all to say. We said something, that ... you fell to our lot ... [you] have shamed father ... our ... where are you going ... for that ...
en_old: Behind... Dopar said, always the police, sir. Here, police, the police have nothing to say. We said something... you shamed our father... our...

brh: ایلم نا تما نندارے لوفر پارے، دا ارانگنا خیر مس، ارانگنا، کنے انت خبر ارانگنا، ایلم نا تو جادوگری سبق و، کدا ایلم جادوگری
en: Look at your brother's spectacle, he called [him] a loafer. Where did this one go off to, well? Where to? What do I know where to? Your brother had magic lessons; since when has [my] brother done magic?
en_old: Look at your brother's show, Loafer said. Where did this happen? Where? What do I know about where? Your brother learned magic lessons. When did brother do magic?

brh: میر صاحب نی جادوگر ئس اٹی غائب کریسٹے۔ دا پا سوچ نی دیسس، نن نا مونا خنت نا مونا گران کنا خبر ہم تپوس۔ ایلوم کنے غائب کریس و داسہ بہانہ کننگ اٹی ئس ئے بہانہ کننگ افٹ، نا ایلوم چیلن نرا داسہ نی بہانہ کننگ اٹی ئس ایٹ پٹ۔
en: Mir Sahib, you are a magician, you made him disappear. Say it, think about it: you ... in front of us, before our eyes ... and you didn't even tell me. You made my brother disappear and now you're making excuses. 'I'm not making excuses.' Your brother ran off ... now you're making excuses; go find him.
en_old: Mir Sahib, you're a magician, you made him disappear. Think about it, you... right in front of us, before our eyes, and you didn't even tell me. You made my brother disappear and now you're making excuses. Don't make excuses. Your brother... now you're making excuses. Find him.

brh: نا ایلم بلو جادوگر اسے تینٹ تینٹ غیب کرے کنا ایلم تینٹ غیب کتا نی نی کرینوس تے غیب ئے اود غیب کتوٹ او تینٹ تینٹ غیب کرے ئے اسل اود الے پرورا غند الے پرورا پٹے وتو زیادہ کنے اود ہر حال اٹ دلدارا دروئی غیب مننگٹ او
en: Your brother is a great magician; he made himself disappear on his own. 'My brother didn't make himself disappear; you, you have made him disappear.' I didn't make him disappear, he made himself disappear on his own. Actually, leave him, don't worry ... leave him, don't worry, [he'll] turn up ... more to me ... In any case, Dildar, he has been missing since yesterday.
en_old: Your brother is a great magician, he made himself disappear. I didn't make my brother disappear. You did it, you made him disappear. I didn't make him disappear, he made himself disappear. Really, I don't care... anyway, Dildar disappeared yesterday.

brh: کنے ہم بچپک، بہانہ کپہ، دا پا ایلوم کنے ہم تریکٹ غیب کریس، بہانہ نی کنے گوس، نا ایلوم تین تینٹ غیب کرے، دا سہی کاوے، او کنے ہم بچپک، او نی لازمی پٹے
en: I won't be spared either. Don't make excuses. Tell me: you made my brother disappear with a trick, and me too; you're making excuses to me. 'Your brother made himself disappear on his own, that is the truth.' He won't spare me either. You must find him.
en_old: Save me too, don't make excuses. You made my brother disappear too, you're making excuses to me. Your brother made himself disappear, that's right. He won't save me either. You must find him.

brh: ادا خیرٹ بسوس انت حال احوال ئے دلدار خان عید ئس بنگنوس بنتنوس؟ ادا عید و ہیچ بنگنرو ڈمر و ہیچ ئس اف۔ نی امر خبر اف؟ بیور غیب مسونے، دا امر عید ئس کرے مٹے۔ بیور کراڑے؟
en: Welcome here, what's the news, Dildar Khan? Did you have an Eid or not? 'There was no Eid here at all, nothing at all. How do you not know? Bewar has disappeared; how could anyone have celebrated Eid?' Where is Bewar?
en_old: Welcome, how are you, what's new, Dildar Khan? Did you celebrate Eid? There was no Eid here at all, nothing. How do you not know? Bewar has disappeared, how could we celebrate Eid? Where is Bewar?

brh: غیر مس امر غیر مس زمین ٹی پین ٹی نن تن لوس تینا بیور کیبو تے نیتو مقابل کیبو لیکن ہمو کہ غیر مس او شارٹ کرے تینا کائے او گومبار مرے اوڑتو نن آنتوس امر گومبار مرے دست کئی تینا صفائی پیش کتو
en: He disappeared. How did he disappear, into the ground, or somewhere else? We ourselves, with our own Bewar ... [we said] 'compete with you' ... but the one who disappeared, he cut it short and goes his own way, and he gets lost. With him we were ... how does he get lost? ... He never presented his own side [to clear himself].
en_old: He went missing. How did he go missing? Into the ground or somewhere else? We were with our Bewar... we would compete, but when he went missing, he... how could he be... he didn't prove his innocence.

brh: کنا بے عزتی مسٹ ئے اون کنا اوڑتو ہچو کاری مسف نی تینا بے عزتی نا خاطر کتیس تے پٹتے بلی ہتتے ہرا کہ پٹتے ہتتے دے تو غیب مسف داسا کرے نی اودے پٹ ہت
en: I have been disgraced, and I had nothing at all to do with him. You did it for the sake of [avoiding] your own disgrace. Find him, indeed, bring him; the one you're to find and bring has disappeared. Now go, you find him and bring him.
en_old: I've been disgraced, and I had nothing to do with him. For the sake of your own disgrace you did those things; go find them and bring them. The ones you were supposed to find and bring have disappeared. Now go find him and bring him.

brh: ادا حمید آ ئے لانی ہمو پیرغانہ خاطر کے پورہ دہ سال بسس ولدا نی کنے تا انت ہیسس حال احوالے ترنگ کے بیبرغ مسنے، غیبی تے تپر، ئے نی درست کیوہ نی چاوہ، بسس نی کنے پاریس
en: Here, Hamid, for the sake of that old man you came after a full ten years. Then what news did you bring me? [You said] Bibarg has gone missing ... the missing one ... 'I'll set it right, I know how.' You came and you told me.
en_old: Here, Hamid, you came for that old man after a full ten years. Then what did you tell me? You didn't ask how I was. He has disappeared, don't give... I'll fix it, you know. You came and told me.

brh: داسا نی پٹہ ہرا کامرے او دے ہتہ اسیتو ہمو ہسک کنیا نی بفیس بسس تو داسا پٹہ او دے داسا ایلوم اینے الے پر غیب مسونے پٹہ ہتہ تے
en: Now you search wherever he went and bring him here. ... you don't come to me; you came, so now search for him. Now, brother, today ... he has disappeared; search for him and bring him.
en_old: Now find whoever it is and bring him here. ... you didn't come, so now find him. Now, brother, he has disappeared; find them and bring them.

brh: اگر ڈکانی تینے پٹ ہتت، پٹ آئینو بدلہ بسو نی دا حوال ایسوس، کا پٹ ہتت، دا شلئے برات، ہنزو پٹ ہتت، خدا خلیجا مخلوق یا بندغان
en: If he's hidden, find him yourself and bring him. Instead of searching, you came and brought this news. Go, find him and bring him; brother, go find him and bring him. God the Creator, the creatures or the people ...
en_old: If the shopkeeper finds him himself, ... in return you brought this news. Go find him and bring him, brother, go find him and bring him. May God ... the people or the men.

brh: دا ہنو خراب کیرہ بد رد کیرہ خوامخواہ کیرہ دا سئی دا دے اسو للے پر
en: These ones cause trouble, they hurl abuse, they do it for no reason. This is true ... this day ...
en_old: These people spoil things; they spoil things and reject them for no reason. This ... today ...

brh: ارنگنا گومہ صیب
en: Where to, sir?
en_old: Where are you off to, sir?

brh: دا پا بیبرگ ہرا دے ہمے دے انکے بیبرگ نا نیامو دے ہمفت خنتانوٹ سے بلائے تے ہرفیس ایو نا بلائے ہرفتا روتے تینتے غائب کرے ہڑیسنے ڈکادے نی ہرفیس انتیک خولیس دیرم خولیس
en: Tell me this, Bibarg: which day? That very day ... in the middle of Bibarg's ... I have never seen [such a thing]; you took up some goblin; ... took up the goblin ... made themselves disappear ... hid him ... you took [him] up. Why are you afraid? Who else was afraid?
en_old: Say this, Bibarg: on which day? That day, among the Bibargs, we saw a calamity with our own eyes. The one you took ... he made himself disappear. Why are you afraid? I'm very afraid.

brh: خولیس، دلدار نا خولیس، پین دے نا خولیس، دلدار نا انت خولی کو، دلدار نا اسل خولی پاک، او تہ خولی سینہ، دا سفت دلدار نا ئے دے، ٹھیک ئے رائے مگات، واہ بھائی واہ، بس کا۔
en: Fear, Dildar's fear, the fear from the other day. What fear does Dildar have? Dildar's real fear is pure ... and his fear is in his chest. This is Dildar's quality today. Fine ... Wow, brother, wow. Enough, stop it.
en_old: Afraid, Dildar is afraid, afraid since the other day. What is Dildar afraid of? Dildar's real fear is inside his chest. That's Dildar's quality today. Alright, wow brother, wow. That's enough.

brh: جوان مس کہ نم بسورے بیور کرا دیو بیور غف بسیدو متیسر بسیا عمر یادا مڑ ستورے ادا گپا دے
en: It's good that you came. Bewar ... Bewar ... came ... Umar, or this man ... here, on this matter.
en_old: Good that you came, Biwar ... Umar ... stay here, on this matter.

brh: نی تو کرے بیورک، تو دا غریبی نی انت کریسس؟ دا دے انت خبرے کنے؟ دا دے کوتل کریسس، ایلم تمرے یا غریب تمرے، دا تو نی تو ہیت کتنے، نی تو ہیت کرنے بیورک، ہول دے پٹ دے۔
en: Bewar did it with you. So what did you do to this poor man? What do I know about it today? Today you led him away by the hand; whether a brother falls or a poor man falls. He hasn't talked about this with you; Bewar has talked with you. Go search for him.
en_old: You did it, Biwar. So what did you do to this poor man? What do I know about this today? Today you killed ... whether a brother fell or a poor man fell. You didn't talk about this; you didn't talk, Biwar ... find him.

brh: بیور کمی دیت کے دا مڑ موجود صدام سلو بزدا مچ مچیت کرے مدام مدام نا۔ ہا ایلم دا نما انت گپ او۔ دلدار صاحب ننے ایچو گپ اسے نا معلوم اف دا انت گپ کین دے۔ ایلوم نیکی مالو مپک وڑا دا
en: Bewar ... this man is present, Saddam, standing ... always, always. Yes, brother, what is this matter of yours? Dildar sahib, we don't know of any matter at all; what is this matter you're raising today? Brother, it isn't known, it's like this.
en_old: Biwar ... the man present here, Saddam ... always, always. Yes, brother, what is this matter of yours? Dildar sahib, we don't know anything about what this matter is. Brother, we don't know.

brh: انت کنے ہیسپوس، دا چھیڑی کنے ابسک پکان دلدارا، ننے ام معلوم انت سے دعوت سے انت سے، ئے داڑ کے دعوت کے وکے کنے ہیسپوس، دا مور اینو مے امونیک بدورت کے
en: Why didn't you bring me? This teasing of me ... Dildar. We know too what an invitation is, what it is. Is there an invitation here, and you didn't bring me? This ... today ...
en_old: Why did you ... me? This girl ... Dildar. We also know what an invitation is ... Is there an invitation here? ... me ... today ...

brh: دا نامجدمینی دا دستک وا نی نرے الیسو اور دا دندیر پی ایلوم نون کنیاں انت تکلیف و دکھس خنانورے نن ئے صاحب ایچ درد ئس خنتانون ایلوم دا انت گپ آ دروغ تھڑنگ نو ماسی آ ایلوم
en: ... this ... brother, what trouble and grief have you ever seen from me? 'Sir, we have seen no pain at all.' Brother, what kind of talk is this, telling lies ... brother.
en_old: ... and this ... brother, what pain and grief have you seen from us? Sir, we have seen no pain at all. Brother, why are you lying about this matter ...

brh: دا بے روزگار اراٹی ما بے کار ماسرا دروخت ہڑکا ایرا بندغے جنگ اتیک ننا اینو ہچکنا سے مسلمان اسنا خلاف ہیتم کتن ایلم نی انتئے دونو کاریم کیسہ یات کاتئے
en: These are unemployed ... we are idle ... setting two people against each other in a fight. Today we haven't said a single word against any Muslim. Brother, why do you do such things? Remember it.
en_old: These people are unemployed; we are idle. People who stand around all the time start fights. Today we haven't said anything against any Muslim. Brother, why do you do such things? Remember that.

brh: نی کھرپزے یا کاڈیڈ کھرپزے دا جوانوں گپو داسہ دا نمونہ پائیک کہ نم تو نو گپ کتنوں نن بنتنوں نی انت کہ دا شیلے جوڑ کیسہ نی انت دا ٹی وی لے ہرا ایلو مے جنتے سے ہرا ٹیوے ناراض کیسہ دلدار
en: Are you a melon, or a ... melon? That's a fine thing to say. Now this oddball says that we haven't talked with you, we haven't heard. Why do you make this up? What is this TV ... which brother ... which TV are you upsetting, Dildar?
en_old: Are you a melon or a ... melon? That's a good point. Now this sample says that you didn't talk to us ... What are you making of this? What is this on TV that ... makes ... angry, Dildar?

brh: آسان دا دے چان تے اکنا دماغ تے خراب ئے دے چم مخلوق کے جنگ آتے بسم اللہ دا تو بند کر فص، مون ایڑو بے غریب بھٹ کرے سیسوس، دا مسلمان تو پئے کرے ہچ خبر اف
en: Easily, this ... ruins their minds ... people ... fights. Bismillah, stop this ... in front ... the poor ... This Muslim doesn't know anything at all.
en_old: Easily, these ... ruin people's minds ... people ... fights. Bismillah, stop this ... you've made the poor ... This Muslim doesn't know anything.

brh: نمونہ تا کاریم کپہ، جوان مار کنا، ایلو جوان اسے تیسیریا بندغ آ، تیکی، علامتی، ایکا اودے خلے بیا اوکڑی خلے نی انتس ملیک داڑے؟ دا گڑاٹی تو نی ہچس ملپک، پین نی ضرورت مریک
en: Don't do what oddballs do, my good son. The other is a good one, a third person ... symbolic ... he hits him, then hits him again. What will you get here? You'll get nothing out of this thing; you'll need something else.
en_old: Don't do the work of samples, my good son. Another good one ... a third man ... symbolic ... he hit him, then hit him again. What do you get out of this? You get nothing from this; you need more.

brh: کنے آ پر ئے تینا ایلم نا خدمت ئے کیوا اگر انتس مس کنے آ نی ایتیوا تا گڑا تیکہ پتی نا مونی دا جوان و گڑا افس ایرا ایلم جنگ کے ایرا ایلم در بدر مریر نی ہلی
en: It is my duty to serve my own brother. If anything happens to me, I will give you ... then ... in front of ... this is good, and it's not a [small] thing: two brothers fight, two brothers become homeless wanderers. You ...
en_old: It is my duty to serve my brother. If anything happened to me, you would give ... then ... this is good and things ... brothers fight, brothers become homeless; you leave.

brh: اینا بجک رو بس سردار صاحب نا ایلوم تے فینوسس او مسلمان نا مونا غان پائے ننے ہچ خبر اف۔ تو دا سدھیرے بیبرک مودی غیب مس۔ دا سر اڑے پٹی سے۔ کنا است خراب منے ئے ہناٹیکاف جنگس گیر گڑاس کیتو۔ نی اللہ نا۔
en: Today ... Sardar sahib's brothers ... and in front of that Muslim he says, 'We know nothing.' So this ... Bibarg ... disappeared. This ... search ... My heart is troubled that ... a fight, someone did something. You, for God's sake.
en_old: Today at ... o'clock, Sardar sahib's ... brothers ... in front of that Muslim, he says we know nothing. So this Sudhir ... Biwarak Modi disappeared. ... My heart is upset that ... a fight ... someone did something. You, for God's sake.

brh: غضب باری، دلدار صیب دا کنے خال سبق خستے گڑا دا برابر مریرہ، ایلو دا ہچکاری مسکتنے، ئے داستا ہچس بن تنے ٹائینو اسکا پچاس سالا
en: What an outrage, Dildar sahib! This taught me a lesson ... then these become equal. Besides, this one has done nothing at all; until now nothing has been heard ... up to fifty years.
en_old: What a calamity, Dildar sahib. This taught me a lesson; then these become equal. The other one didn't do anything ... till now nothing ... for up to fifty years.

brh: ننا اوفتو دوستی ء ایلمی ء، نن اینو اسکا دفتہ ء امر خلے کٹتہ غا ناجائز، نا زبانہ کٹتہ تو پھڑی کنیاں پین بندغس ہرفو، پئی دنیتو وختان سمتو ایلمی
en: Our friendship and brotherhood with them ... until today, how could it be cut off unjustly ... may your tongue be cut ... another person will take [it] from me ... brotherhood since the old times of the world.
en_old: Our friendship and brotherhood with them ... today, up to ... they cut it off unjustly. Your tongue was cut ... another person took ... brotherhood since the old days of the world.

brh: بٹنگ الے پنتیں، اگر او پئی گنوکوٹ ننم گنوکون، ننم سرپیرون الے پنتیں، او انئی تکو، او ادا ہندائی تکو
en: [Unclear opening: "don't ... like that"]. If he is crazy, are we crazy too? We are grey-haired elders too. [Unclear] ... he ..., he ... right here.
en_old: Don't say such things. If he's crazy, we're not crazy, we're not fools, don't say that. He didn't see that; he only saw what happened here.

brh: بلکل اللہ ئے پا۔ اگر ئے دا کنا دے اینا مینا نا چٹ۔ نی کاسا نا اللہ نگہبان نن تینا لائق اونا۔
en: Absolutely, leave it to God. If I ... this ... my day [unclear]. You go, may God protect you; we can manage on our own.
en_old: Absolutely, leave it to God. If this is my day... Go, may God protect you; we will be worthy of him.

brh: واللہ لوفر آ تو دو، دا بیدار لوفر آ تو
en: By God, he is a loafer ... this wide-awake loafer.
en_old: By God, you're a loafer, this shameless loafer.

brh: ادا بس او جوان کریس، ننے دا گنڈیری کنو۔
en: Brother, that's it, you did well; we'll eat this sugarcane.
en_old: Here, just be kind and buy us this sugarcane.

brh: ادا گنڈیری گھنے نو یا فس دلدار گنڈیری تونے نو لیکن بیبر باز خرے
en: Brother, [about] the sugarcane ... or else, Dildar, the sugarcane ... but Bibarg is very angry.
en_old: Here, buy the sugarcane, or Dildar, buy the sugarcane for yourself, but it's very expensive.

brh: ادا خیرے انت مس ویور گنتس کرے ہو تو ہچس کننگ کپک اینو کنا مونا نی شیف پل کپک پارے دلدار دغا کنا مخلوق نا قبضہ کے
en: Brother, is all well? What happened? Did Zewar do something bad? Yes, then he can't do anything; today, in front of me, he can't rob you. He said Dildar deceitfully seizes [the land] of my people.
en_old: What happened here? He can't do anything. Today you can't do anything in front of me. Dildar said this cheat is seizing my people's land.

brh: ہالو کے خلیک بٹٹ ئے نی دہ باز خرابو کرے دلدار پئے لوفر اسے ازا دان پاننگوس او دلدارے لوفر پاننگے نی او میر صاحب او
en: ... [unclear] ... you did something very wrong. You are calling Dildar a loafer ... he is calling Dildar a loafer. You, O Mir Sahib!
en_old: ...you've made it very bad. Dildar, you called him a loafer, and calling Dildar a loafer... you, oh Mir Sahib, oh.

brh: او دلدارے لوفر کنا مونا پاریٹ ادا دا زال لوفر کنیک نا کاٹومے تیان گناز کدی اینے جوان جوان پاریٹک سما مرے نی پینس کس مخپینا ادا او نرینہ سے کنے برے مقابل پائے نی انت
en: He called Dildar a loafer right in front of me. Brother, this wretched loafer ... your head ... Now [you're] saying nice, nice things. Be warned! ... someone else ... Brother, if he is a man, let him come and face me and say it. What are you?
en_old: Oh Dildar, you called me a loafer to my face! Here this woman is calling me a loafer. I'll pull the hair on her head. You talk so nicely now; know that you won't get away with it. Here, if that man comes up against me, tell me what you are.

brh: دا سان نا خیر افک ادا او کنے لوفر پاتنے دا تو نی پاسے دا ہیتے اینے دا ہیتے پاتور زیور نی لوفر پارے دا ہیتے تو ئے نا باہم بنگوٹ
en: There's no good in this. Brother, he has not called me a loafer; it's you who are saying this. This thing, now, this thing they never said. Zewar, you said 'loafer'. This thing, I heard it from your own mouth.
en_old: There's no good in this. Here he called me a loafer. You're the one saying this. They said this. Zewar, you called me a loafer; this matter is between the two of us.

brh: او تو دا ہیتے ئے اونا بان بنتنٹ، نی تو ہننو کاری مسکے، پیندے ہننو ہیت کننگنا لائق مفیس۔ ئے تو نیکی ئس کنے پارینے تو خنے الینگو صفا۔ نا دا جرات نی کنے لوفڑ پاریس؟ ناڑی دا مجال؟
en: As for him, I have not heard this thing from his mouth. You have turned out to be that kind of person; you are not fit to talk like that ever again. As for me, if he had told me [something] as a kindness, I would have let it go completely. How dare you call me a loafer? Do you have that much nerve?
en_old: He heard this matter at his house: "You were doing such work, then you are not worthy of talking like that." I did him a favor, and he left me completely. How dare you call me a loafer? Where do you get this nerve?

brh: اینو نی تو ئے تادی اسکوا بے وقت آنو ہیت تپیس
en: Today you, up to now ... you shouldn't say such untimely things.
en_old: Today you didn't say anything at the wrong time.

brh: خیر ئے آن مئے نورا؟ حاجی صاحب نی خبر اف دا کنے لوفر پارے نی ادا نی آ خیر ئے مئے دا خاندان نا بندغ آتے لوفر پاسے۔ حاجی صاحب ئے دا لوفر پاتن اٹ، دا بیبرگ لوفر پارے۔ ئے نی کیک اٹ سہی کیک اٹ تو دس کنے خلنگے۔
en: Is everything all right ...? Haji Sahib, don't you know, this one called me a loafer. Brother, are you in your right mind, calling the people of this family loafers? Haji Sahib, I have not called him a loafer; it was Bibarg who said 'loafer'. If I did it, if I really did it, then hit me ten [times].
en_old: Is all well, Nora? Haji Sahib, don't you know, he called me a loafer. Brother, are you well, that you call the people of this family loafers? Haji Sahib, he called me a loafer, this Bibarg called me a loafer. If I did it, if I did right, then tell me to be beaten.

brh: ادا پارے نی نی بیبرگ نی خلیسہ دادے؟ ہندے دا نا ناجائزو کاریمے کیسی حاجی صاحب ئے ناجائزو کاریم کننگ افٹ۔ ئے تو بیبرگ نا با دا ہیتے بنتوٹ، دا ہیتے بس دا کرے، کنے دا بس لوفر پارے۔
en: Brother, he said: 'You, Bibarg, are you going to beat this one?' You are doing this unjust thing. Haji Sahib, I am not doing anything unjust. I did not hear this thing from Bibarg's mouth; this one simply did this, it was this one who just called me a loafer.
en_old: He said, "Bibarg, are you beating this one?" That's why he is doing this improper thing; Haji Sahib, I am not doing anything improper. I heard this matter from Bibarg's father; he just did this, he just called me a loafer.

brh: حاجی دا سدا دے امر الے؟ پارے ننے لوفر بیبرک نی دا مسلمانانتے خلیس؟ حاجی صاحب بیبرک دا لوفر پارے گڑا ئے دا بس پاریٹ۔ اوکے ادا بہادر اسے گڑا برے کنے پائے نی انتگے پائے۔ واہ!
en: Haji, how is this [matter] of that day? He said 'loafer' to us: 'Bibark, are you going to beat these Muslims?' Haji Sahib, Bibark called him a loafer, so I just said it. Okay, brother, if he is brave, then let him come and say to me, 'why do you say it?' Wow!
en_old: Haji, how did this happen the other day? He said, "Bibarg, you call us loafers, you beat these Muslims?" Haji Sahib, Bibarg called him a loafer, so I just said this much. If he is a brave man, let him come and tell me why you said it. Wow!

brh: کہ داہیتے دلدار سئی پاننگٹی ئے انتئے نی اسہ کسم نا شیطانی ئس کننگٹی ئس اگر او بیبرک داہیتے کے تو برے مقابلہ پا کہ نی دونو بندغس ئس میر صاحب ئے اسہ نیکی ئس کرٹ، نیکی لخت ٹی تما۔ نیکی نا لخت ٹی تمپتو، انتئے کہ او پارے
en: Dildar is telling this matter correctly; why are you doing a kind of devilry? If that Bibark did this, then come face to face and say that you are that kind of person. Mir Sahib, I did one good deed, and the good deed fell into the mud. The good deed wouldn't have fallen into the mud, because he said...
en_old: Dildar was saying this matter, why were you doing a kind of mischief? If Bibarg did this, then come and say it face to face, that you are such a person. I did Mir Sahib a favor, and the favor fell into the trouble. It wouldn't have fallen into the trouble of the favor, because he said...

brh: ارے یا پارچو نی دا ہیتے کپروشوس ننا دا لخت آن نی ہم بننگ اٹی ئس نا با ہیتے بننگ اٹی اٹ ئے ہم بننگ اٹی اٹ دلدار ہم بننگ میر صاحب نی جوان پنینس دا تیرے تیرے جنگ تننگ اٹی نی جوان و ہیتس کریس دادے حق کیک کہ دا
en: Oh my, [unclear]: you shouldn't have done this. From this mess of ours you are listening too; I am hearing the matter from your mouth, I am listening too, Dildar is listening too. Mir Sahib, you have heard it well: this one is setting people against each other. You made a good point; it is right that this...
en_old: Yes, or you broke this matter apart; you too are coming from this trouble of ours, your father is hearing this matter, I am hearing it too, Dildar is hearing it too. Mir Sahib, you understood well; they are making them fight among themselves. You did a good thing, he deserves that this...

brh: اشرف دا سئی او ہیتس اف، اینی دے منا ہیتس بنیسہ، دادے بارشے پاسہ، حاجی صاحبے پاسہ، دا کرے قسم نا شیطانی اسے، دا کڑہ کپبو، دا جوان اف۔
en: Ashraf, this is not right, this is no way to talk. Today you hear something, you tell it to this one, you tell it to Haji Sahib. This is a kind of devilry. Don't do this; this is not good.
en_old: Ashraf, this isn't right, that's not the matter. Today you are hearing our matter, you tell it to Barsh, you tell it to Haji Sahib. This is a kind of mischief; don't do this, this is not good.

brh: او کیاریب نی انت کے پائک او نا دشمنی سے کنتو تو برے بہادری اسیتو کنتو کیتے نی نی انت کے او پائک بس کنے آن غلطی ئس مس کنے معاف کبو نی دا ہمر معاف مرے
en: Oh ..., what is he saying? If he has some enmity with me, then let him come and show some bravery with me. What is he saying: 'I just made a mistake, forgive me'? How can this be forgiven like that?
en_old: Oh Kiyarib, what are you saying? If he has an enmity with me, then let him come and show bravery with me. What are you... He says, "I just made a mistake, forgive me." How would you forgive like this?

brh: سے کنے بسونس نی لوفر پارینوس او خاندان ہیتس کرے کتب دا ٹیما تو نی بسس کنے پاریس کنے لوفر کریس خاندانا بندغے او ک نریناسے
en: ... you have come to me and called [me] a loafer. The family talked it over and settled it at that time; then you came and told me, you made me out to be a loafer, a man of the family, one who is a man...
en_old: You came to me, you called me a loafer; the family talked and settled it. Then you came and told me, you called me a loafer, the people of the family, and that man...

brh: نی کنتو برو ہیت کرو ہنتس کہ کرے تو کنے سامو پائک نی انت کہ کنے بسوس پاریس نی امر معاف کیوہ نی اینو ئے گٹو کیوہ داڑے بس دیدار خان دا سئی نا دوٹی ہلکنوٹ دا وختی کرے نی ولے معاف کرک نی پیرو ہریسیس نا خاطر
en: Come and talk with me; whatever [he] did, he should tell me to my face. What is it that you came and told me? How will I forgive you? Today I'll strangle you! Here, Didar Khan, I have just put this in your hands; this time [it's done]; still, I forgive you, for the sake of the elders.
en_old: Come and talk with me; whatever he did, then he tells me face to face. What did you come and tell me? How should I forgive you? Today I will quarrel with you. Here Dildar Khan just took this matter into his hands; at this time, you should still forgive, for the sake of the elders who are watching.

brh: تیرے دادے الیوا، نت دادے اینو گھوٹو کرے ٹی نم تینٹ پیرو بندغورے، ئے خاندان ہیتس کرے کتب، دا کے بس میرنا مونغا کنے لوفر پارے، حاجی دے تہ خدا داسا نا خاطرانی معاف کیوتے، دلدار خان نا بھاز
en: I would let him go; otherwise I'd have strangled him today. You yourselves are elderly men. The family had talked it over and settled it, and this one just called me a loafer in front of the Mir. Haji, well, by God, for your sake I forgive him now. Dildar Khan, many...
en_old: We would leave him to each other; why did he quarrel today? You yourselves are elders; the family talked and settled it. He just called me a loafer in front of Mir. Haji, for God's sake, for the sake of the present, I will forgive him, many thanks to Dildar Khan.

brh: مہربانی ننا عزت ئے کریس یلہ کتے مہربانی ئے وقتس کہ رے ہنون کرے پاپیس کسے کہ نیا فلانہ دہوں پارے دہوں نا
en: ... thanks: you honored us and let him off. Please, whenever someone does such a thing, don't tell anyone, 'so-and-so said such-and-such about you.'
en_old: Thank you, you have respected us, you didn't let it go. Please, at some point don't do that, don't tell anyone that so-and-so said such-and-such.

brh: نی کسے پاپس، کبھی کسے ایلوئے پاپس کہ نی فلانہ دہن پارے، دا جوانو ہیت افس، سیدھا دوبارہ ہنو کرے غلطی کپیس، ٹھیک ہی صاحب ٹھیک ہی پین ہز ہیت کپرا، ادا پین وخت کس کسے ہندرو ہیت پارے، نی کسے پاپس
en: Don't you tell anyone; never tell another person 'so-and-so said such-and-such about you.' This is not a good thing. Simply put: don't make such a mistake again. Okay, sir, okay, I won't say anything like that again. Brother, next time if someone says such a thing to someone, don't you tell anyone.
en_old: Don't tell anyone, never tell another that so-and-so said such-and-such; this is not a good thing. Straight away, don't make such a mistake again. Okay Haji Sahib, okay, I won't say anything more. Next time if someone says such a thing to someone, you don't tell anyone.

brh: اگر بنگس ہم کسے پاپس انتئے کہ ولا کسے پارے کہ انجام نی داڑان زیادہ خراب مرو ٹھیک ہی میاں صاحب پین دے تو نیکی افیس نی تو نیکی کننگ افیس دا بدی کننگ اٹی ئس اینا ہیتئے داڑا سر کیسہ دانا ایڑا سر کیسہ ٹھیک ہی
en: Even if you hear something, don't tell anyone, because if you tell someone, the outcome will be worse than this. Okay, Mian Sahib. From now on it is no good deed: you are not doing good, you are doing evil; you carry that one's words to this one and this one's words to that one. Okay.
en_old: Even if you hear something, don't tell anyone, because if you tell someone, the outcome will be worse than this. Okay, Mian Sahib. Then that was not a good deed, you were not doing good, you were doing evil, bringing one's words to another and another's to the other. Okay.

brh: پین ڈسکس ایٹم با پرو خدا
en: Let's discuss another item, for God's sake.
en_old: Let's discuss another item, for God's sake.

brh: حاجی دا نا خاطری دا بندغ اینو بچت او ادا نا باز مہربانی کہ ننا عزت ء کریس ننا خیال ء کریس او دے الاس حاجی صاحب ووٹ تو ہنو مرے پین
en: Haji, for his sake this man was spared today. And brother, many thanks to you for honoring us and being considerate of us; you let him go. Haji Sahib, ... so let it be like that from now on.
en_old: Haji, for his sake this man was saved today, and many thanks to him for respecting us and taking care of us. Leave that day, Haji Sahib; that's how it should be.

brh: پین دے ئس ایراٹے جنگ تف، انتئے کہ دا اینو پگ بندغ خنا ایتا جکنگو نا، نا ئے دے بنغ کنے پارے، کنا ئے دے پارے تو بندغ رس خوار مریک، جنگ ہنافتیا مریک، پین ہنتیا مریک، پین تو دشمنی ننا کرے کسر
en: Another time, don't set two people fighting, because these days people go around slandering: one day someone told me something about you, another day someone said something about me, and then people are humiliated. Fights happen over such things, other things happen over such things, and then enmity lies in our path.
en_old: Another day don't fight with each other, because today these people have come... he told me something one day, someone told me something another day, then people get humiliated; fights happen over such things, other things happen, and then enmity is on our path.

brh: ٹو ولو نہ کرین جلدانہ اسک نہ بیبرگ نا اسک او دا ہیتس کریک دا توستا خرام ئس او میر صاحب حقیقت پاسہ کرے ہنو نا ہیتاتے آ کرے دا جنگاک مریرہ ناراضی مریرہ خون ریزی مریرہ کرے ہنو نا ہیتاتے آ چھنکا ہیتے کس کنے پارے ئے ایدے پارے ہنو
en: ... neither ... nor Bibarg's ... and he talks like this; this is a sinful thing. And Mir Sahib, you are telling the truth: over such matters these fights happen, resentments happen, bloodshed happens, over such small matters: someone told me something, I told him something...
en_old: ...Bibarg's... he was saying this thing; this is very wrong. And Mir Sahib, you are telling the truth: over such things these fights happen, resentments happen, bloodshed happens; over such small matters, someone told me something, someone said something that day.

brh: دا ہیتاتے آ کرے ناراضی ئس بھلو بش مریک او حاجی صاحب ئے تا گنونو ئے مسٹ چار بندغے محال ہم پنت تسنو ئے مسلمان ہیت کرینے کترنے بس کنے اینو بنفے کنا استے خراب کرے داسہ
en: Over matters like these a great resentment arises. And Haji Sahib, [unclear] three or four people of the neighborhood also gave advice; the Muslims had talked it over and settled it. Just today he made me hear it, and now he has upset my heart.
en_old: Over such matters a big resentment arises, and Haji Sahib... four men gathered, and even then didn't allow... Muslims talked and settled it. Just today he made me hear it and spoiled my heart now.
