en: Well, that's up to you, Javed jan. Brother, what have I ever said to you that you hate me this much, brother?
en_old: Anyway, never mind, Javed jan, brother. What did you say, brother, that this person hates me?

brh: مہرو مہرو انت مسنے خیری؟ او انکل پشاور روڈ نا خڑک آ منہ بندغ اسرہ اوفک پاریر کہ اگہ پگہ نی دا شار اٹ خنان تو
en: Miro, Miro, what has happened, is everything all right? Oh, uncle, there were some men near Peshawar Road. They said that if we see you in this city tomorrow, then...
en_old: Miro, Miro, what happened, is everything okay? Oh uncle, near Peshawar Road there were some people. They said that if they see you in this city tomorrow...

brh: نا خیر مفرورئے میرو دا دیر اسورے پا کنے دیر اسورے نہ انکل ئے دا خواپرا کہ کنا واجہ کسس نی تو ایت کے ئے پگا واپس تینا
en: ...it won't go well for you. Miro, who were these people? Tell me, who were they? No, uncle, I don't want anyone [to get into trouble] on my account. You just let me go; tomorrow I'll go back to my own [village].
en_old: It won't end well for you, Miro. Who are you? Tell me who you are. No, uncle doesn't know that my master is someone. You go back to your ... tomorrow.

brh: خلقہ کا، نیرو، نیرو نی گنوک مسونوس انت، نی داخا محنت اٹی دا ڈگری الکونس، دا واپس کا ہمو خلقہ تینا، میلتی خوافیسے
en: Go to the village? Miro, Miro, have you gone mad or what? You earned this degree with so much hard work, and now you'll go back to that village of yours and graze sheep?
en_old: Go to the village? Miro, Miro, have you gone mad? You earned this degree with so much hard work, and now you'll go back to that village of yours to herd sheep?

brh: میرو، اگر ایندا چنکا چنکا ایتا تیتے تعلیم ملیسے تو کنے لگے پکے نی زند ٹی مونی ہنوس۔ نین اخہ کہ مریک نی تینا تعلیم ء جاری تخک۔ پگہ دا بندغاک برور نا موتاج مرو۔ میرو!
en: Miro, if you get past little things like these and get an education, I'm sure you will go far in life. Whatever happens, keep up your education. Tomorrow these very people will come to you in need of you. Miro!
en_old: Miro, if these little ones get an education, I feel sure you will move forward in life. Whatever happens, keep up your education. Tomorrow these people will need you. Miro!

brh: میرو شازیہ راس پانے نی ٹی نی تینا توجہ خواننگ آ ایتے نا خواننگ باز جوان ئے نی خوان دا بندغاتے ئے سنبھالیوے
en: Miro, Shazia is right: you should give your attention to your studies. Your studies are going very well. You study; I'll handle these people.
en_old: Miro, Shazia was saying that you should focus on your studies. Your studies are going very well. You study; these people will be taken care of.

brh: ایڑے نو ہمار ننا کنڈا رد کرین رے میر پسند خان نی تو اسس ننا اورانا کسرے ہموستندریس۔ دونی چیت صف علیم خان ہمار کین کسر
en: Sister, how is it that you've strayed over to our side? Mir Pasand Khan, it's as if you'd forgotten the road to our house. It's not like that, Aleem Khan ... (unclear) ... the road.
en_old: Come on, let's go, let's turn toward our side. Mir Pasand Khan, you were ... the road to our house... Aleem Khan, let's make our way.

brh: کاروباری زند اندرون گدرینگک کہ انسان نا سوب شام نا ہمیست آ متمبک۔ چوا کہ پیسہ کٹنگ نا جوفہ زیات مسنے۔ السلام علیکم آنٹی۔ وعلیکم السلام ماشاء اللہ۔
en: Business life goes on in such a way that a person loses track of morning and evening, because the greed for making money has grown. Assalamu alaikum, aunty. Wa alaikum assalam, mashallah.
en_old: Business life goes on in such a way that a person stays busy until evening, since the craze for making money has grown. Assalamu alaikum, aunty. Wa alaikum assalam, mashallah.

brh: کنا مسڑ تو باز بلن مسنے۔ آنٹی نم تو ہم بلو وخت اسے آن پد ننا ارا غا بسنرے۔ شازیہ کنا مسڑ میر پسند خان ئس باز وخت اسے آن پد ننا ارا غا بسنو۔ نی ہن چا ستئی کے۔
en: My daughter has grown up so much. Aunty, you too have come to our house after a long time. Shazia, my daughter, Mir Pasand Khan and his family have come to our house after a long time. You go and make some tea.
en_old: My daughter has grown so big. Aunty, you've also come to our house after a long time. Shazia, my daughter, Mir Pasand Khan has come to our house after a long time. Go and make some tea.

brh: جیو بابا داسہ تیبے۔ میر پسند خان، ایتو بو احوال اینو امر بسنورے۔ ایلو نن اینو جاوید جان کین نما مسڑ شازیہ جانے کینا رسال بسنون۔
en: Bless you, child. Now then, Mir Pasand Khan, tell us the news: how come you've come today? Well, today we have come with a marriage proposal for your daughter Shazia jan on behalf of Javed jan.
en_old: Bless you, child, now sit down. Mir Pasand Khan, tell us, what brings you here today? Well, today we have come with Javed jan to ask for your daughter Shazia jan's hand in marriage.

brh: اور جاوید کرس شازیہ باز خوش تہوئے انشااللہ۔ ایڑ شازیہ کنا اسٹو مسڑسے۔ ہرا وخت کہ شازیہ نا لمہ وفات کرے شازیہ باز چنکس اسے۔
en: And, God willing, Javed will keep Shazia very happy. Sister, Shazia is my only daughter. When Shazia's mother died, Shazia was very small.
en_old: And God willing, Javed will keep Shazia very happy. Well, Shazia is my only daughter. When Shazia's mother passed away, Shazia was very small.

brh: دانا کیرے داسہ لما میوٹ باوا میوٹ کنے منا وقت ئس ات بو کہ ئے سوچ کے ولدا نمے برندی ایتوٹ
en: Since then, all this time, I have been both her mother and her father. Give me a little time so that I can think it over; then I'll give you an answer.
en_old: Since then I have been both her mother and her father. Give me some time to think it over, then I'll give you an answer.

brh: ندیم صیب کنے اجازت تس ضروری میٹنگ اسے نوئی۔ چا نا پارینوں چاس کنبو ولدا ہنبونہ۔ پین وخت کنے انشاءاللہ چا نا۔
en: Nadeem Sahib, please give me leave; I have an important meeting. We've already ordered tea; have some tea and then go. Another time, God willing, I'll have your tea.
en_old: Nadeem Sahib, please excuse me, I have an important meeting. We've already made tea, have some tea and then go. Another time, God willing, I'll have tea.

brh: کنا ورکن ئے ہم مرزین ماشاءاللہ شازیہ نا چا تینگ بس مہربانی جوان اللہ حافظ اللہ حافظ ہمو وخت امر زو
en: You must come over to my place too. Mashallah, Shazia's tea... No, thank you, that's enough. All right, goodbye. Goodbye. How quickly that time...
en_old: Come to my place too, God willing; have tea at Shazia's. Please come. Fine, goodbye. Goodbye. We'll see how it goes then.

brh: دا او گدرینگک۔ دا ساہ زیات آ خبلن مسکے، مخلوق رسال کے مننگٹی۔
en: This too passes. Now that she has grown up more, people are coming with marriage proposals.
en_old: This will pass. If this gets any more out of hand, people will be getting hurt.

brh: ہیلو، السلام علیکم۔
en: Hello, assalamu alaikum.
en_old: Hello, assalam alaikum.

brh: وعلیکم السلام میر پسند خان انت احوالے؟ علیم صاحب جاوید نا سانگ نا باری ٹی انت سوچار؟ میر پسند خان ئے باز سوچ کریٹ مگر کنا ارادہ متو۔ انت مطلب؟ میر پسند خان بندغ کیرے گانٹ
en: Wa alaikum assalam, Mir Pasand Khan, how are you? Aleem Sahib, what have you thought about Javed's betrothal? Mir Pasand Khan, I thought about it a lot, but I could not bring myself to agree. What do you mean? Mir Pasand Khan, it takes a person...
en_old: Wa alaikum assalam, Mir Pasand Khan, how are you? Aleem Sahib, what have you thought about Javed's marriage proposal? Mir Pasand Khan, I thought about it a lot, but I couldn't make up my mind. What do you mean? Mir Pasand Khan, a person makes a household...

brh: گاڈی دولت و بنگلہ دا گڑا تون کے ارے زند گدر فنگ کپک بندغ کے ارے بندغ تون زند گدر فک نا مطلب انت؟ کنا مطلب دادے میر پسند خان نی تینا مصروفیات نا وجہ غان تینا مارے وقتی تنوس
en: A car, wealth and a bungalow: life can't be lived with these things; a person is what's needed, life is lived with a person. What do you mean? What I mean is this, Mir Pasand Khan: because of your busy schedule you never gave your son any time.
en_old: Cars, wealth and bungalows: life isn't lived with these things, a person is needed; life is lived with a person. What do you mean? What I mean is, Mir Pasand Khan, because of your busy schedule you never gave your son any time.

brh: او نا سہی پرورش کتنوس ہنا خاطر آن نا مار نا دو آن پیش تمانے
en: And you didn't bring him up properly; that is why your son has slipped out of your hands.
en_old: You didn't raise him properly, and that's why your son has slipped out of your hands.

brh: انکل، ئے اینو باز خوش وٹ۔ خیر تو ارے؟ جی او۔
en: Uncle, I am very happy today. Is everything all right? Yes.
en_old: Uncle, you're very happy today. Is everything all right? Yes.

brh: میرو خیر توارے ننے باز خوشوس؟ ہاؤ ئے اینو پبلک سروس کمیشن نا ایگزام پاس کرینوٹ۔ پاپا جی کنا مسڑ۔ پاپا میرو اینو پبلک سروس کمیشن نا امتحان
en: Miro, is everything all right? You're very happy? Yes, today I passed the Public Service Commission exam. Papa! Yes, my daughter. Papa, today Miro [passed] the Public Service Commission exam...
en_old: Miru, is everything all right? You seem very happy. Yes, today I passed the Public Service Commission exam. Papa, my girl... Papa, today Miru passed the Public Service Commission exam.

brh: مانی پاس کرینے دادو باز خوشی نا ہیت سے۔ میرو کنا مار باز جوان۔ ہمون محنت کروس تو منزل تینٹ نیان خڑک مروئی۔
en: ...has passed it? This is very happy news. Miro, my son, very good. If you keep working hard like this, your goal will come close to you on its own.
en_old: Mani has passed, that's very happy news. Miru, my child, very good. Keep working hard like this and success will come close to you by itself.

brh: دا باز خوشی نا ہیت اسے مونا محنت کیس
en: This is very happy news. Keep working hard from here on.
en_old: This is very happy news. Keep working hard from here on.

brh: انکل، داہن مسنے؟
en: Uncle, how did this happen?
en_old: Uncle, how did this happen?

brh: میرو کنا مار ہچ متنے کنے بس چنکو ایکسیڈنٹ ئس مسنے داسہ جوان اٹ ڈاکٹر صاحب پین خطرہ نا خو ہیت اف نہ سفت اسے ٹی علیم صاحب ڈسچارج کنے
en: Meero, my son, nothing has happened to me, just a small accident happened. I'm fine now. Doctor sahib, there's no more question of danger, is there? In a week we'll discharge Aleem Sahib.
en_old: Miru, my child, nothing happened. I just had a small accident. I'm fine now. The doctor says there's no more danger, and Aleem Sahib will be discharged within a week.

brh: جوان ڈاکٹر صاحب، مہرو، جی انکل، کھانا تیار ہی نی دون کرک، نی خلک اینک، تینا باوہ لمہ ء زوت ہتے
en: All right, doctor sahib. Mehru! - Yes, uncle. - (The) food is ready... You do this: you go to the village and quickly bring your father and mother.
en_old: Fine, doctor. Mehru... Yes, uncle. The food is ready, so you do this: you go home and take your father and mother with you.

brh: انکل، دا نین پنیگٹیوس، ئے نی ہمرت حالت اٹ ہلی کا، کنے ہچ متانے، ئے جوان اٹ داسہ
en: Uncle, you're saying this? Should I leave you in this condition and go? - Nothing has happened to me, I'm fine now.
en_old: Uncle, I'm not leaving you in this condition. Nothing has happened to me, I'm fine now.

brh: مے خلک اینک بہال مئے تھنا ہتہ کنا فکر کپے۔ او انکل ئے کاوٹ۔
en: Go to the village and bring your father and mother; don't worry about me. - Okay, uncle, I'm going.
en_old: You go home and rest, it's just me here, don't worry about me. Oh, uncle, I'm going.

brh: ہو کنا مار اللہ ہیس
en: Yes, my son, (go) with God.
en_old: Yes, my child, God bless you.

brh: دے ئس خوش مس۔ دا بنف کے علیم صاحب نا طبع مرے امر ئے داسے؟ ابا علیم صاحب نا ایکسیڈنٹ مسنے۔ او کنے نم کے راہی کرینے
en: It was a happy day. Tell me, how is Aleem Sahib's health now? - Father, Aleem Sahib has had an accident. He has sent me to you.
en_old: It was a happy day. How is Aleem Sahib's health now? Father, Aleem Sahib has had an accident. He has sent me to you.

brh: ارے تغل ہوریسنت بشے بشے کان داسہ کرائی مرین شار کے خان عباس صوبہ داسہ شار ایننگ کے لاری ملپک الے مارے دم دروکے نی ولدا داسہ پاسہ دکہ
en: Hey, are you still asleep? Get up, get up, let's go, now we'll have to pay fare to get to the city. - Khan Abbas, it's morning now; there won't be a bus to go to the city. - Leave it, son, take a breath; now you're saying it again...
en_old: Hey, look over there, get up, get up, the fare is going up now. Khan Abbas, it's late now, there's no bus to get to the city. Hey son, take a breath; and now you're saying it again...

brh: او اما ئے ہنو شام تینا گدان ٹی خاچو۔ ہی پکا داسکا گدانی اسندتنو۔
en: And today, this evening, I'll sleep in my own tent. Well, for sure - until now I've never (slept) in a tent.
en_old: And today we'll spend that evening in our tent. Well then, we haven't stayed in a tent before.

brh: ادا آہا دا امر مس دا ایکسیڈنٹ اراڑے مس امر مس دا سے
en: Brother, oh, how did this happen? Where did this accident happen, how did it happen...
en_old: Oh, what happened here? Where did this accident happen, how did it happen?

brh: تپنے ماری ایلم شاہ مراد انتس کہ نصیب اٹ لکھوک ئے او تو مریک ہاؤ ہاؤ داہی تراستی
en: ... Brother Shah Murad, whatever is written in one's fate, that does happen. - Yes, yes, that's true.
en_old: ...son, Shah Murad, whatever is written in fate happens. Yes, yes, that's true.

brh: داسہ بش ونتانے طبیعت امرے داسہ باز جوان ئے ایلم شاہ مراد مگر زند ئنا ہچ بھروسہ اف اینے
en: Now, have you got up yet? How is your health? - Now it's much better, brother Shah Murad, but there's no trusting life at all.
en_old: Now I've woken up, how's your health? Now it's much better, brother Shah Murad, but there's no trusting life, you know.

brh: خلق ئنا اندا خاطر آن خواف ایٹ کے نا مار میرو باز جوان و مار سے کنا کل کاریم تے سنبھالانے ئے دا سوچاٹ کے
en: I had you called from the village for this very reason: your son Meero is a very good son; he has taken care of all my work. I've been thinking this, that...
en_old: It's for this reason that I can't sleep, people say Mir's son is a very good son, he has taken care of all my work, with this thought...

brh: تینا شازیہ مسڑ نا دو نا مہر نا دوٹی تے اگر نم خواری تو۔ صاب اللہ نمے دراخ و جوڑ کے۔
en: If you are willing, I would put my daughter Shazia's hand in your Meero's hand. - Sahib, may God keep you healthy and well.
en_old: If you want your Shazia daughter's hand in marriage... Sir, may God keep you well and healthy.

brh: اللہ نمے بلو زند ئس ایتے، داڑان زیات نن پین انت خواہنہ۔ خواجہ، دا تو نما لک تورہ واکو ننیا، نن تو باہو لو بننگٹ۔
en: May God give you a long life; what more than this could we want? Khwaja, this is just what you wished, and what we wished too; we ourselves were (about to) come (for this).
en_old: May God give you a long life, what more could we want than this. Sir, this is your own house, ours too; we are just coming outside.

brh: او باجی بس بس کنکو غریب و بدنام نہ ایلو مراد نا غریبی امیری اللہ نا کنڈان بارک
en: Oh sister, enough, enough - not poor or disreputable... Brother Murad, poverty and wealth come from God.
en_old: Oh sister, enough, enough, don't call me poor and disgraced; brother Murad, poverty and wealth come from God.

brh: غریبی ئے بس افک میرو باس جوانو مار اسے تاران زیات پینی خدا غان انت خواہوے خدا نا تیروکا جائیداد
en: Poverty is nothing; Meero is a very good son - what more than that would one want from God? The property that God has given...
en_old: Poverty is nothing, Mir is a good son, what more would you ask of God than that? The property God has given...

brh: باز کنتو شازیہ کنا مسیٹنگا مسڑے دا جائیداد ہم شازیہ نا ئے او میرو نا ئے
en: I have plenty. Shazia is my only daughter; this property is Shazia's too, and it's Meero's.
en_old: I have a lot; Shazia is my only daughter, this property is also Shazia's and it's Mir's.

brh: سئی جان خانی سدا اینو پگہ نا مار کوتے دا میر پسند خان نا مار
en: Right, dear Khani - always, the sons of these days... this son of Mir Pasand Khan!
en_old: Sai Jan, Khani, always these days' sons... this is Mir Pasand Khan's son.

brh: جاوید جان ارا وختان کہ بلو مسونے دا علاقہ نا مخلوقے کلے تنگ کرینے یار دا میر پسند خان نا مار اف دا پسند نا مارے میر پسند خان نا ہمدا علاقہ ٹی چنک بلو مسونے ولے ایڑن تو کس زہیر متو
en: Ever since Javed Jan grew up, he has harassed all the people of this area. Man, he is not Mir Pasand Khan's son, he's just 'Pasand's' son - Mir Pasand Khan also grew up from childhood in this very area, but nobody was ever upset with him.
en_old: Since Javed Jan grew up, he has troubled all the people of this area. Friend, he's not Mir Pasand Khan's son, he's Pasand's son; Mir Pasand Khan grew up from childhood in this same area, but nobody ever got upset with him.

brh: او خدائے تمرے گڑا دن کین کانو نا باوے پچ پوکین دا نا بارہ وٹ گڑا نانت خیالے کنا خیال دا ٹائم میر بشیر خان او راٹی مروئی بالکل او ببو کین
en: Oh God... Then let's do this: let's go and explain it to his father. - Then what's your opinion about him? - I think Mir Bashir Khan should definitely be at home at this time. - Okay, come on, let's go.
en_old: Oh, God help us, then what about his father... what do you think about him? I think Mir Bashir Khan should be at home at this time, definitely, let's go.

brh: سلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ جی نمے دیر تو کاریم ارے؟ میر پسند خان اوراٹی۔ اسہ منٹ سیلور ایف تیک؟ جی مہربانی۔
en: Peace be upon you. - And upon you be peace. - Yes, whom do you have business with? - Is Mir Pasand Khan at home? - One minute, please wait... - Yes, thank you.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Yes, do you have some work? Is Mir Pasand Khan home? Could you call him for a minute? Yes, thank you.

brh: میر صاحب گڑاس بندغ بسونے ملنگا توار کیک
en: Mir Sahib, some people have come; they're calling for you to meet them.
en_old: Mir Sahib, some people have come and are calling for you.

brh: السلام علیکم، وعلیکم السلام، بس خیریت، جوڑ، سب ٹھیک ٹھاک؟
en: Peace be upon you. - And upon you be peace. - All well? Fine? Everything all right?
en_old: Peace be upon you, and upon you be peace, just fine, well, is everything all right?

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ تل۔ خیر وانے؟ او جوڑ آتے اللہ نا شکر انت۔ جوان، بھلا خیر انت۔ ٹھیک ٹھاک۔
en: Peace be upon you. - And upon you be peace. - Sit down. Is all well? - Yes, (we're) fine, thanks be to God. - Good. Well then, what's the matter, is all well? - All fine.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Sit down. Is all well? Yes, they're fine, thank God. Good, well, all fine. Fine.

brh: ایت باوالس خیرٹ بسرے میر صاحب ننا داڑے اسہ جوان و زندگی ئس گدریفینو ولے اینو اسکان ننا ہچوئی تس متنے ئے نمائی تنے مطلب پومتا وٹ انت پین خواہرے میر صاحب
en: ... welcome, you've come in peace. - Mir Sahib, we have spent a good life here, but until today nothing of the sort has happened to us from your side... - Meaning? I didn't understand - what else do you want, Mir Sahib?
en_old: Welcome, father, you've come in peace, Mir Sahib. We've spent a good life here, but until today we've had no trouble from you. I mean, I didn't understand, what else do you want, Mir Sahib?

brh: صاحب نن دا پاننگ خوانہ کہ ہرا وختان کہ دا جاوید جان ملون مسونے دا نا دوتیاں مچے علاقہ بیزارے ہرا وخت کہ کرکٹ کیک کل
en: Sahib, we want to say this: ever since this Javed Jan grew up, the whole area has been fed up because of him; whenever he plays cricket, all...
en_old: Sahib, we want to say that ever since Javed Jan grew up, the whole area has been fed up with him, whenever he plays cricket, everyone...

brh: ہن گدرکو کا بندغاتے گند ٹھپیکیک او کہ موٹرسائیکل کشیک موٹرسائیکل نا سائلنسر نا وجہ غان مچ علاقہ داران بیزاری۔ ایلم جان، ئے نمے آن بشخنداری خواہوہ، پین وخت دن مفرو۔
en: He hits the people passing by with the ball, and when he takes out his motorcycle, the whole area is fed up with it because of the motorcycle's silencer. - Dear brother, I ask your forgiveness; it won't happen like this again.
en_old: He insults the people passing by, and when he rides his motorcycle, because of the motorcycle's silencer the whole area is fed up with it. Brother, I apologize to you, it won't happen again.

brh: ایو دے پوک او جی نمہ باز مہربانی میر صاحب دا سگڑہ ننے اجازت ئے چا کمبو جی نا باز باز بس داسہ ننے بش مرو اللہ حافظ میر صاحب امید ئے تنے سد ٹکا پاروسہ نا نا
en: All right, understood. - Yes, thank you very much, Mir Sahib. Now give us permission (to leave). - Have some tea. - Thanks so very much, that's enough, now we should get going. Goodbye, Mir Sahib; I hope you'll tell him, one hundred percent...
en_old: Yes, very well, thank you very much, Mir Sahib. Now please give us permission to leave, thank you so much, now we'll be fine. Goodbye, Mir Sahib, I hope you'll tell him off properly.

brh: مہربانی، دونے چٹ، جی، باز مہربانی، جی، بخیر ئے دا انت کن؟
en: Thank you - (your) hand... - Yes, thank you very much. - Yes, you're welcome. What is this for?
en_old: Thank you, give me your hand, yes, thank you very much, yes, you're welcome, what is this for?

brh: ننا لڈی ء مار نا غاوک بسوسو۔ نی ہچ سما اف کہ دا خلق اٹ انت کننگ اٹی ء دا مار۔ پوک کرک دادے۔ پوک کرک۔
en: Complaints had come about our darling son. You have no idea at all what this son is doing among the people of the village. He has ruined this. Ruined it.
en_old: A complaint about our son has reached the village. You have no idea what this boy is up to in the village. He's ruined it, ruined it.

brh: دا کنا بے عزتی کننگ اٹی ء۔ مخلوق نا است آک اوشنگ اٹی ء۔ اوفتے تون موٹر سائیکل اف۔ جاوید جان نا موٹر سائیکل ء خنیرہ تو اوفتا برداشت مفک۔ ورکا ورکا۔
en: This is disgracing me. People's hearts are burning. They don't have a motorcycle; when they see Javed Jan's motorcycle, they can't bear it. ... (unclear: 'varka, varka')
en_old: This is an insult to me. People's hearts are burning. They don't have motorcycles. When they see Javed Jan's motorcycle, they can't stand it. Petty, petty people.

brh: خیر اینو ہم باز غصہ ٹس اینو منا بندغ بسوسو جاوید نا باراوٹی باوائے نا دیچا انت پاریر چاوائے نو واللہ ئے لم نا پیشان گڑاس کھرینے کنا مار نی پومفیسہ مخلوق ننا جاہ
en: Anyway, today too there was a lot of anger. Today some people came about Javed; who knows what they said to your father, you know. By God, something [unclear] ... My son, you don't understand, people ... our place ...
en_old: Anyway, today I was very angry again. A man came to me today about Javed, father... you know what they said? By God, something has gone wrong in his head. My son, you don't understand, people... our place...

brh: دادو گڑا تیان ہوشنگرا جوان ہمیدا سکا باک ہم مچ آرام کے
en: Better than burning [yourself up] over these two things ... you too rest a little.
en_old: Better than these two things, also get some proper rest.

brh: عامر عامر نزل من
en: Amir, Amir, ... (unclear)
en_old: Amir, Amir, come down.

brh: کپک بشے یا اللہ گامز عامر بشے عامر بشے
en: He's not getting up. O God! ... Amir, get up! Amir, get up!
en_old: He won't get up, oh God... Amir, get up! Amir, get up!

brh: جاوید! دا نیس؟ ہاؤ بے ن تینا دو تٹ تینا وراخ برباد کریس۔ ن سمجھ؟ دا کن چنکا الو عامر، عامر۔
en: Javed! Is this you? Yes, hey, you have ruined your own home with your own hands. Do you understand? This little brother, Amir, Amir!
en_old: Javed! Is this you? Yes, you've ruined your own home with your own hands. Do you understand? That's why, little Amir, Amir.

brh: اوہ چاوہ دانا چنکا ایلم ہامرے نی ایلوتہ ورائے برباد کریسہ اینو ہور
en: Oh, I know... his little brother Amir — you have ruined the other one's home too, today, look.
en_old: Oh, you know, his little brother Amir... you've ruined the other one's home too today.

brh: دینا دوت تے دینا اورائے برباد کریس، بابا سا القصاص بالقصاص، ہمار کروس
en: You have ruined your own home with your own hands. Baba, retribution for retribution (qisas for qisas) — what will you do now?
en_old: You've ruined your home with your own hands. Father, an eye for an eye, retribution for retribution. What have you done?

brh: ہنتو خناس
en: What did you see?
en_old: Didn't you see?

brh: ایلو ایلو بش مئے اسہ مشاعرہ ہی بابا مشاعرہ ہی بشہ بشہ اونا رئیٹ پروفیسر بڈو بے پرواہ ہی بڈو بے پرواہ اونا رئیٹ ننا گچین و
en: Next, next — get up, there's a mushaira (poetry gathering), baba, a mushaira! Get up, get up. Beside him is Professor Buddu Beparwah, Buddu Beparwah; beside him our finest and ...
en_old: Next, next, get up, there's a mushaira (poetry gathering), father, a mushaira, get up, get up. After him, Professor Buddu Beparwah, Buddu Beparwah; after him, our finest and...

brh: شاعر ست لوکی بیگو شری تو داسا نن باقاعدہ مشاعرہ نا بنائی کینہ او رواج نا ردٹ ئے نما مہماندار شاکر غتلو
en: ... the poet (Sat Loki?) Begu Shari. So now we formally begin the mushaira, and according to custom, your host Shakir Ghatlo ...
en_old: Poet... well done. Now we'll formally begin the mushaira, and as is the custom, our host Shakir Ghatlo...

brh: تینا کلامن دا مشاعرہ نا بنائی کیوے بلائی دے خرچ زیادتے بیگماتا کل ببو ہڑتال کے خرچ زیادتے بیگماتا کل ببو ہڑتال کے تینا ڈکی نا
en: ... will open this mushaira with his own verse: '... The wives' expenses are too much — come, everyone, go on strike! The wives' expenses are too much — come, everyone, go on strike!' His own ...
en_old: will open this mushaira with his own poem: 'The expenses of the days are too much, wives, let's all go on strike! The expenses are too much, wives, let's all go on strike!' His own...

brh: جاگہ سے یا کوہ قافہ بال کیت، کوہ قافہ بال کیت، تو ئنا تنخواہ کے رے جھٹ سے ٹی دانگ ہنگبا، تو ئنا
en: ... some place, or it flies off to Mount Qaf, flies off to Mount Qaf; your salary — in a flash it goes off, your ...
en_old: ...somewhere, or off to Koh-e-Qaf it flies, off to Koh-e-Qaf it flies; your salary disappears over there in a flash. Your...

brh: تونا تنخواہ ء کیرے جھٹ اسے ٹی دانگ اینگ چار دے او سونا اوکان گڈ چا ڈال کے تونا تنخواہ ء کیرے جھٹ اسے ٹی دانگ اینگ چار دے او سونا اوکان گڈ چا ڈال کے
en: Your salary they scatter here and there in an instant: four days of gold, and after that, make do with tea and dal. Your salary they scatter here and there in an instant: four days of gold, and after that, make do with tea and dal.
en_old: Your salary disappears in a flash: four days, then gold, and after that just tea and dal. Your salary disappears in a flash: four days, then gold, and after that just tea and dal.

brh: مسنے مہمان اسینو مرنا دوستس کنا، واہ جی، آ پروفیسر صاحب، مسنے مہمان اسینو مرنا دوستس کنا، نن ارا شرمان اوڑکن ساگ شلغم دال۔
en: A guest came, a friend of mine from far away — wow! Oh, Professor sahib! — a guest came, a friend of mine from far away; to our shame, for him we [made] greens, turnips and dal.
en_old: A guest came, a friend of mine. Wow! Oh, Professor sahib! A guest came, a friend of mine; out of shame we made greens, turnips and dal for him.

brh: مسنے مہمان سین و مرنا دوستس کنا مسنے مہمان سین و مرنا دوستس کنا
en: A guest came, a friend of mine from far away; a guest came, a friend of mine from far away.
en_old: A guest came, a friend of mine. A guest came, a friend of mine.

brh: نن ارا شرمان اوڑکن ساگ شلغم دال کین، واہ سئیں واہ، سوب و شام سئیں، سوب و شام و سو چٹی ہندا اریر ئے سنگتاک، ہندا بیگم آتا پاوہ
en: To our shame, for him we make greens, turnips and dal. Wow, sir, wow! Morning and evening, sir, morning and evening it's this same [punishment], friends — this is what I say about the wives.
en_old: Out of shame we made greens, turnips and dal for him. Wow, sir, wow! Morning and evening, sir, morning and evening, it's the same every time, friends; that's what the wives say.

brh: صبح شام و سو چٹی ہندارے رے سنگتاک دا ارغ تے بے وسنگا نن امر کنگال کے
en: Morning and evening it's this same [punishment], friends; how are we, helpless and broke, to [eat] these meals?
en_old: Morning and evening it's the same every time, friends. How are we supposed to eat these meals without getting sick of them?

brh: او نا شاپنگ کن ئے تینا سائیکلے سودا کریٹ او نا شاپنگ کن ئے تینا سائیکلے سودا کریٹ یا خدا بس عید بلا دے رسے آ سوال کین باو

en: He is coming back, and he talked about it: the doctor said that as soon as he comes to his country this time, God willing, the very first thing he will do is operate on your eyes, and after that it is as God wills.

en_old: Doctor sahib, come in, come in. Wa alaikum assalam, doctor sahib, is all well? This is our patient, just take her bandages off. In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

en: Yes, bebe, open your eyes. Say Bismillah. Well done, open your eyes, open your eyes, open your eyes.
en_old: Yes, bebe, open your eyes. Say Bismillah. Well done, open your eyes, open your eyes, open your eyes.

brh: سکینہ؟ عمر؟ ہو نی اونی کیس؟ مبارک مرے خیر مرے
en: Sakina? — Umar? — Yes, you [...]? — Congratulations, may it be for the best.
en_old: Sakina? Umar? Yes, how are you? Congratulations, may all be well.

brh: نما باز باز مہربانی۔ بے بے خننگ اٹی ئس جوان اٹی؟ جی او۔ شکر کہ شکر۔ عمر، لمہ باوہ ہراڑے کے
en: Thank you very, very much. — Bebe, are you seeing well? — Yes. — Thanks be to God, thanks be to God. — Umar, where are mother and father?
en_old: Thank you very, very much. Bebe, can you see well? Yes. Thank God, thank God. Umar, where are mother and father?

brh: او دے رضا کٹ پاتوٹ، ئے پٹ او دے سرپرائز ایتیٹ۔
en: I haven't told them; I kept it a secret. I want to give them a surprise.
en_old: I had told Raza that I'll find him and give him a surprise.

brh: سکینہ، نی آخدر بے نصیب اسئے اوس۔
en: Sakina, you were such an unfortunate one.
en_old: Sakina, you were so unfortunate.

brh: دا وخت اسکان دا زیب دارہ پلاتے خنتویس دا روشنائی آن بے سوب مسوس زیبائی تو انسان نا خا
en: Until now you had never seen these beautiful flowers; you had been deprived of this light. Beauty, though, is in a person's [own self]...
en_old: Until now you had never seen these beautiful flowers; you were deprived of this light. Beauty is in a person's...

brh: انتیٹی مریک ارا کہ گڑاتے زیبدار جوڑ کیرے زیبائی تو انسان نا جند اٹ مریک انسان نا کردار اونا سیرت اونا توش و بش اونا سوچ اٹ مریک دا کلے گڑاتے
en: What does it matter if things are made beautiful? Beauty, after all, lies in a person's own self; it lies in a person's character, his nature, his conduct, his way of thinking. All these things...
en_old: What happens when things are made beautiful? Beauty is in the human being himself, in a person's character, his nature, his manners, his thoughts. All these things...

brh: تے جوڑ کروک اڑے آسمان آتیا تولوک کنا رب دا ڈغار آسمان پھل و درخت آک دا کل گڑا تے او جوڑ کرینے دا کل اونا زیبائی او نن کل
en: ...the one who made them is my Lord, seated above the heavens. This earth, the sky, the flowers and trees: He made all these things. All of this is His beauty, and all of us...
en_old: ...the One who created them, my Lord seated above the heavens. This earth, the sky, the flowers and trees, He created all these things. All of this is His beauty, and all of us...

brh: گل تو ظاہرے زیبائی نا مٹ جوڑ مس۔ دا کائنات ٹی انتس کہ جوڑ کرینے کنا رب او کل ثناء و سفت نا لائق او۔
en: The flower was made as the very image of outward beauty. Whatever my Lord has made in this universe, He is worthy of all praise and glory.
en_old: The flower became a symbol of outward beauty. Whatever my Lord has created in this universe, He is worthy of all praise and glory.

brh: سکینہ، زرے، تپنا بند بندے
en: Sakina, just a moment... [it is] shut, shut.
en_old: Sakina, just a moment, close the door.

brh: نانتس، نیتو کنا پرواہ اف، ئے مچہ دے تا اوراٹی تنیا منجا مریوا۔ منجا مریسہ؟
en: What's wrong with you? — You don't care about me at all. I've been alone at home for so many days, and I get sad. — You get sad?
en_old: What's wrong? You don't care about me. I get bored alone at home for so many days. You get bored?

brh: دا اسٹڈی روم کتاباتیان پرے کتاب خوان، دا بھلا ٹی وی لگوکے ٹی وی ہر، پیشن چکر آئی نی کسس تورینے تے تورینے، ہرا وقت ئس
en: This study room is full of books: read books. This big TV is installed: watch TV. [Go] out for a walk. Has anyone held you back? Held you back? Whenever...
en_old: This is the study room, full of books, read books. This big TV is installed, watch TV. Go out for a walk. Who have you talked to? Talked to? Whenever...

brh: اسکان ٹی وی اریف، ہرا وخت اسکان کتاب خوانف، تنیائی کنا رندے لپک، ئے تو نی باز وار پارینوٹ کہ بکان پیشن چک
en: How long can I watch TV, how long can I read books? Loneliness won't leave me alone. I've told you so many times, let's go out for a walk.
en_old: How long can I watch TV, how long can I read books? Loneliness is chasing me. I've told you so many times, let's go out for a walk.

brh: میرو لسی عرض ئے خواجہ ہا عرض کرک صیب نی ہم عرض کر مہربانی مہربانی مہربانی مارٹ ابانہ کیوہ مقابلے ہر غکنہ
en: Miro Lusi, please recite. Sir, yes, recite; sir, you recite too. Thank you, thank you, thank you. 'I am my father's son, I will take on everyone in a contest.'
en_old: Miro Lusi presents [his poem]; he presents it to the gentleman. Sir, you present too, please, thank you, thank you, thank you. ...I will [unclear] competitions with everyone.

brh: مار و ٹھبانہ چھیوے مقابلے ارغکنا تو فقط پلاسٹک نا تو فقط پلاسٹک نا تو فقط پلاسٹک نا تو فقط پلاسٹک نا واہ واہ واہ واہ لوسی صاحب باز باز مہربانی باز مہربانی
en: 'I am my father's son, I will take on everyone in a contest, with a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic.' Wow, wow, wow, wow! Lusi sahib, thank you very, very much, thank you very much.
en_old: Son and [unclear]... competitions... you are just made of plastic, you are just made of plastic, you are just made of plastic, you are just made of plastic. Wow, wow, wow, wow! Lusi sir, thank you very much, thank you very much, thank you very much.

brh: کنے انی تاؤ تفہ تینا بروتاتی، سبحان اللہ جی، او بدبرک بندغے صاحب، ئے شاباش، کنے انی تاؤ تفہ بروتاتی تینا، سبحان اللہ واہ، بالے توٹ ئے کپوتاتی تینا، واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ
en: 'He twists his moustaches at me.' Glory be to God, yes, he is an ill-tempered(?) man, sir. Bravo! 'He twists his moustaches at me.' Glory be to God, wow! '[...] the wings of his pigeons.' Wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow!
en_old: Don't twist your moustache at me now — glory be to God, yes, he is a bad-natured man, sir — bravo! Don't twist your moustache at me now, glory be to God, wow! ...your pigeons... Wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow!

brh: بس جوڑ مہربانی بروتاتے کپوتاتے واہ ہم برابر کرے بندشے ماشاءاللہ ماشاءاللہ چپ ما مونا کنا ٹھنگ مروئی بکنا اوہو توفک اٹ پلاسٹک نا توفک اٹ پلاسٹک نا توفک اٹ پلاسٹک نا توفک اٹ پلاسٹک نا واہ صاحب واہ صاحب واہ واہ صاحب واہ
en: Well done, thank you. Moustaches and pigeons, wow, he even matched the rhyme! Mashallah, mashallah. 'Quiet in front of me, or there will be a bang [...]', oho! 'With a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic.' Wow, sir, wow, sir, wow, wow, sir, wow!
en_old: Well made, thank you. The moustaches and the pigeons — wow — and he matched the rhyme too, God bless, God bless. Be quiet in front of me... you are a gun of plastic, a gun of plastic, a gun of plastic, a gun of plastic. Wow sir, wow sir, wow, wow sir, wow!

brh: باز مہربانی باز مہربانی کنے آن بلو پین ورنا اسل اف کنے آن پین بلو ورنا اسل اف اگر مرے کنے آن برز اسل اف
en: Thank you very much, thank you very much. 'There is absolutely no other young man bigger than me; there is no other young man bigger than me at all; and if there is one, he is not taller than me at all.'
en_old: Thank you very much, thank you very much. There is no greater young man than me at all, there is no other greater young man than me at all; if there is, there is none higher than me at all.

brh: اگر مرے تو کنے ہم برجس اسولف بسوس ڈیوٹی کنا کشکوٹ لٹ کنا بروس ڈیوٹی کنا
en: 'If there is one, then he too is not taller than me at all. [...] of plastic, a begging bowl of plastic, [...] of plastic.'
en_old: If there is, then I too had [unclear]... he came, my duty... my [unclear]... he came, my duty.

brh: ٹیک نا کشکول لٹیک نا توفک ئس پلاٹیک نا توفک ئس پلاٹیک نا واہ واہ واہ واہ صاحب واہ واہ صاحب واہ واہ واہ واہ صاحب توفک ئس پلاٹیک نا صاحب واہ واہ چاو کہ اینو واللہ بسنے اجل نا
en: '[...] of plastic, a begging bowl of plastic, a gun of plastic, a gun of plastic.' Wow, wow, wow, wow, sir! Wow, wow, sir! Wow, wow, wow, wow, sir! 'A gun of plastic', sir! Wow, wow! 'Know that today, by God, the hour of death has come.'
en_old: A begging bowl of plastic, a gun of plastic, a gun of plastic. Wow, wow, wow, wow, sir! Wow, wow, sir! Wow, wow, wow, wow, sir! A gun of plastic, sir. Wow, wow! Look, by God, today death has come.

brh: چاو کے اینو واللہ بسنے اجلنا، نی سما اف کنا رائفلنا، گم مروئی نی آن کسر قبلہ ء دے ٹکنا
en: 'Know that today, by God, the hour of death has come; you have no idea about my rifle. You are bound to lose your way, both to the qibla and to the sunrise.'
en_old: Know that today, by God, the time has come... you have no idea of my rifle; get lost from me, the road, the qibla, the day [unclear].

brh: تو فقط پلاسٹک نا، تو فقط پلاسٹک نا، ہر کس، ہر کسہ دو کنا وہانی، او ابو جاغہ غا خاچانی
en: 'With a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic. Anyone, whoever my hand [reaches] lies down right there on that spot.'
en_old: You're just made of plastic, you're just made of plastic. Everyone, everyone's hand is my [unclear], and they sleep in that place.

brh: ہر کسہ دو کنا وھانے او ہمو جاگہ غا خاچانے پیلہ کہ متپسہ تاوے کنا چھننگ نا تو فقط پلاسٹک نا
en: 'Whoever my hand [reaches] has lain down right there on that spot. [...] my [...], with a gun of plastic.'
en_old: Everyone's hand is my [unclear], and they sleep in that very place, unless you [unclear] my strength to break... you're just made of plastic.

brh: نی تینا بلپئے باڑیا، نی بلپئے تینا باڑیا، ئے زوراکٹ ارفراڈیا
en: 'You [...] your [...] on [your] arm(?), you [...] your [...] on [your] arm(?); I am strong, [I] take up [...].'
en_old: You will carry your load, you will carry the load yourself, you will lift it by force.

brh: جالی و سندس ارے کن تو میٹرک نا واہ واہ تو پکڑ پلاسٹک نا تو پکڑ پلاسٹک نا تو پکڑ پلاسٹک نا واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ واہ بس مہربانی کل دلیراتے آن دلیرٹ واہ واہ
en: 'I have a fake certificate, of matric.' Wow, wow! 'With a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic.' Wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow! That's all, thank you. 'I am braver than all the brave.' Wow, wow!
en_old: There is a [unclear]... you're matric [unclear]. Wow, wow! You're a grip of plastic, you're a grip of plastic, you're a grip of plastic. Wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow! That's all, thank you. I am the bravest of all the brave. Wow, wow!

brh: ئے شاباش گل دلیر آتین دلیر او سبحان اللہ شیر نا زیا سوا شیر اوٹ کنا سینہ ٹی
en: Bravo! 'Braver than all the brave.' Oh, glory be to God! 'Over and above a lion, there is a lion-and-a-quarter in my chest.'
en_old: Bravo, brave among the brave, and Subhanallah, more than a lion, there is a lion in my chest.

brh: بلو است سے پٹک کشینہ پٹک نا دو فکٹ پلاسٹک نا دو فکٹ پلاسٹک نا دو فکٹ پلاسٹک نا واہ واہ واہ دعا کبو آمین آمین ثم آمین
en: 'With a big heart we draw [...], with a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic.' Wow, wow, wow! 'Pray!' Amen, amen, and again amen.
en_old: With great hope they pull out a bag, the bag's handle is plastic, the handle is plastic, the handle is plastic. Wow, wow, wow! Pray: Amen, Amen, and again Amen.

brh: دعا کبو دعا کبو بفر غصہ ٹی سئیں بفر غصہ ٹی چلو دعا ختم کبو کس زندہ سلپروئے غصہ ٹی خیال کبو
en: 'Pray, pray! Don't come at me in anger, sain, don't come in anger. Come on, finish your prayers; no one stays alive in my anger. Be careful!'
en_old: Pray, pray, don't come in anger, don't come in anger. Come on, finish the prayer, nobody stays alive in anger, be careful.

brh: خیال کبو چک کوٹ چاپ ئے اٹومیٹک نا۔ توفک اٹ پلاسٹک نا، توفک اٹ پلاسٹک نا، توفک اٹ پلاسٹک نا۔ واہ واہ واہ! باز مہربانی۔ سبحان اللہ سر۔ پلاسٹکی توفک۔ باز مہربانی، باز مہربانی۔
en: 'Be careful: I'll fire off the crack of an automatic, with a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic, with a gun of plastic.' Wow, wow, wow! Thank you very much. Glory be to God, sir. A plastic gun! Thank you very much, thank you very much.
en_old: Be careful, the automatic's trigger and click. With a plastic gun, with a plastic gun, with a plastic gun. Wow, wow, wow! Thank you very much. Subhanallah, sir. A plastic gun. Thank you very much, thank you very much.

brh: باز جوان باز جوان باز جوان باز جوان داسہ نن برینہ تینا اسے ہنینو شاعر سے خواہفین دلیان بسور خواجہ نما خدمت اٹ تینا چبش آ شعر اتون اوار برے چبش چبش مامانا پنا ماما
en: Very good, very good, very good, very good. Now we come to one of our own dear poets; we invite him. He has come from Dilyan(?), sir, to serve you with his chabsh poems. Chabsh, chabsh: 'The Uncle in Name Only'.
en_old: Very good, very good, very good, very good. Now we invite one of our famous poets, who has come from Dilyan, sir, to your service with his chabsh poems. Chabsh, chabsh: the uncle, uncle only in name.

brh: پدام کرینے ماما نا پنا ماما پدام کرینے سبحان اللہ سبحان اللہ کستو پدام ہلکے ماما نا پنا ماما پدام کرینے تینے چچو نامارس او پام
en: '...has brought disgrace; the uncle in name only has brought disgrace.' Glory be to God, glory be to God. '[...] with someone [...] disgrace; the uncle in name only has brought disgrace. [...] himself [...]'
en_old: He has made a mess, the uncle only in name has made a mess. Subhanallah, Subhanallah. Somebody made a mess, the uncle only in name has made a mess, how... himself...

en: 'He has [fixed up] his teeth for himself; that is [his] excuse.'
en_old: He has hidden his teeth; for himself that excuse.

brh: او بہانہ واہ واہ واہ پیری ئے اسل جائی گیرام کرے نی ماما نا پنا ماما پدام کرے نی پدام کرے نی پدام کرے نی واہ واہ واہ عرضے ہاو تولو
en: 'That excuse.' Wow, wow, wow! 'You have truly and utterly forgotten old age; uncle in name only, you have brought disgrace, you have brought disgrace, you have brought disgrace, you have brought disgrace.' Wow, wow, wow! Recite, yes, [please] sit.
en_old: That excuse. Wow, wow, wow! You have completely ruined old age, uncle only in name, you have made a mess, you have made a mess, you have made a mess. Wow, wow, wow! Please sit and recite.

en: [Unclear] ... Wow, wow, wow, wow ... he has given a prize. Wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow! Thank you. Wow, yes, wow, wow, bravo, wow, wow, bravo, wow. 'The Uncle in Name Only'.
en_old: ... wow, wow, wow ... gave a reward. Wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, wow! Thank you. Wow, yes, wow, wow, bravo, wow, wow, bravo, wow. The uncle only in name.

en: '...has brought disgrace, has brought disgrace, has brought disgrace.' Wow, yes, wow! I submit (recite): yes, yes. 'Even the shed bits, the left-over bits.' Wow, wow! 'The bits too.' Yes.

en: 'Even the left-over bits, the left-over bits; you have made your beard and moustaches like this, borrowed(?).' Very good, very good, very good, thank you. 'Uncle in name only, you have brought disgrace.'
en_old: Even those behind, those that are behind; you have made the beard and moustache like this. Very good, very good, very good, thank you. Uncle only in name, you have made a mess.

en: 'Miswak, [...], kohl, hair dye, whenever [...] the bedsheets [...]'
en_old: There was no taste; the kohl was rusty at the time of the quilts.

en: 'He has even auctioned off [...]; the uncle in name only has brought disgrace, has brought disgrace, has brought disgrace.' Just a minute, just a minute, just a minute.

brh: شوکت اتہ اور چبش واہ واہ واہ خفٹی ٹی تیناش یا اللہ کنے توبہ کنا باوے توبہ کنا پیری توبہ کنا خاندان توبہ بس مہربانی اللہ خیر کیک بس اللہ خیر کیک مہربانی شوکت اتہ اور چبش
en: Shaukat, give [us] another chabsh! Wow, wow, wow! 'In his ears [...]' O God, I repent! My father repents, my old age repents, my family repents! Enough, thank you, God will make it well, just let God make it well. Thank you. Shaukat, give another chabsh!
en_old: Shaukat gave another chabsh. Wow, wow, wow! In his ears... O God, I repent, my father repents, my old man repents, my family repents. That's enough, thank you. God will make it good, God will make it good. Thank you. Shaukat gave another chabsh.

en: 'In his ears [...]; he has made [his] eyes almond-shaped.' Wow, wow, wow! Glory be to God, glory be to God! Once more, once more, Shaukat, that style of chabsh! Wow, wow! 'In his ears...'
en_old: In his ears he has made his eyes almond-shaped. Wow, wow, wow! Subhanallah, Subhanallah. Once again, once again, Shaukat's chabsh. Wow, wow! In the ears...
