en_old: I take over the other corner, what else? Oh, yes, chances like this don't come again and again. Hahaha, hey, you did it very well, so just, yes, I always say good things, so just...

brh: انشاءاللہ دے گپ فکر کپے او نکرے ہیت انت بے پی سخر او با چھکرک نی او شکرک نی او شکرک ئے بنگٹ کھلی تا کہ بنگٹ نی او شکرک انتس کہ مس بران اللہ وڑے نی سما ئے کہ اوند پاننگٹ اسور او کنے خبر ئے اوند پاننگٹ اسور بیرا نی
en: God willing, don't worry about this matter. And what is the matter... be grateful, be grateful, be grateful... I'm listening... be grateful. Whatever happened, by God... You know what they were saying, and I know what they were saying. Anyway, you...
en_old: God willing, don't worry about it. And what's the matter... be thankful, be thankful... What happened? By God, you know I was saying it about him, and I know I was saying it about him. Anyway, you...

brh: بکھر بکھر بکھر ئے پامنے لپار او پدی نائیتے
en: Come, come, come. Hey, I won't let... and after...
en_old: Come, come, come, hey, the other side, and after that...

brh: پیرو او پیرو زلی نی
en: Piro, oh Piro, ... you...
en_old: Piro, oh Piro, you...

brh: پیرو دا پا یخ زیب اٹ نی باز زیب اٹ ئے ہم مچ زیادہ۔ نا عید پیرو ورنا اٹ ہندا خاطر خپانی گھٹ ئے ہم مچ زیادہ زیب اٹ چا پیرو دا پا نا است دے رے۔ ابا!
en: Piro, tell me this: how beautiful am I? You... I'm very beautiful, and even a little more. ... Piro, I'm young, that's why... I'm even a little more beautiful. Look, Piro, tell me this: your heart... Oh my!
en_old: Piro, this is really beautiful. You're very beautiful, even more so. Your Eid, Piro... that's why... even more beautiful. Look, Piro, this... Father!

brh: اون دکے۔ دا با دا خاطر کنے دوست مریک کہ او رائے اللہ شہر نا را۔ نا ابا نا اینو وجہ نو رائے اللہ شارے نا۔ دا با نی تو خلک کلے پیسے م پیسہ
en: Look at him. This, dear, this is why I like him: that he's ... of the city... Your dad's ... today, because of ... the city. This, dear, you've ... all the money, money.
en_old: Look at him. This, father, is why I like it, that he's from the city of Raiallah. Your father's reason today... from Raiallah city. This, father, you... money, money.

brh: آئی نا وڑنے اڑے ئس مرے ئے اینو راہی الو ونے رے وکاوے پیرو ئے تو دو نا فٹ ہن مطلب کنا مطلب ئے ئے نا مطلب ئے پومسٹ نی کنتو برام کننگ خواسہ او پیرو
en: Like that one... today... Piro, I... I mean, what I mean is... do you want to marry me, oh Piro?
en_old: Someone like him might come along. Today he's not on the road... Piro, I mean, what I mean is... you want to marry me, oh Piro?

brh: اولی کوئٹہ دے تانکہ ابا بتن ئے برام کپرے۔ انتئے؟ انتئے کہ تانکہ ابا بتن ئے برام کپرے، نکاح نا باوہ دے مروئی۔ ئے داسہ برام کپرے کنا تو دزکاہ گوازی نہ
en: First, Quetta... as long as Dad hasn't come back, I won't marry. Why? Because as long as Dad hasn't come back, I won't marry; the father has to be there for the nikah. I won't marry now; for me it's ... not a game.
en_old: First, in Quetta, unless father arranges the marriage... Why? Because unless father arranges the marriage, the nikah has to happen. If you don't arrange the marriage now, for me it's no game.

brh: دیکو اگہ دا سفر ہم کرٹ کنا عالم ہم بر مروئی انتئے انتئے کہ بلاک پارہ تینا اوست نا رازاتے کسے پاپیس نی مر کنا کسر ال کنا سنگتاک انتظارٹی او کاو چدہ گوازی کیوے اسہ شرط اسئے
en: Look, if I make this journey too, my ... will also have to ... because, because the elders say: don't tell the secrets of your heart to anyone. You... leave my way; my friends are waiting. I'll go and play. There's one condition.
en_old: Look, if I make this journey too, my world will also... because people say don't tell anyone the secrets of your heart. You go, my way... my friends are waiting. Come, let's play a game, on one condition.

brh: چٹ ایلو ونے۔ اوند۔ پیرو، دا باک اینے اخس دوست اٹ۔ گڑا کنے الیسے؟ او۔ نی کنے باز دوست ئس راست؟ او راست۔
en: Quite the other one... his. Piro, tell me, how dear am I to you? Then will you leave me? Oh. You're very dear to me, right? Yes, right.
en_old: Completely the other one. His. Piro, how much do you love father? Then would you leave me? Oh. You loved me very much, right? Yes, right.

brh: پیرو ننا مونا چنک بلن مس، ہندن و سادہ چناسے، اگہ نا بنام
en: Piro grew up from small to big right in front of us; such a simple child... if your name...
en_old: Piro grew up from small to big in front of us, such a simple child, if your name...

brh: او تو مس نہ، نی ہاؤ کس نہ، نما زند باز خوشی ٹی گدرینگے۔ انت ہیت کننگو سائیں؟ اگہ کنا برام پیرو تو مس، گڑا تاتی گل بے بے کنا انت مریک؟ بلغور مریک! اگہ کسے نا بلغور تاتی گل بے بے
en: That's settled then, isn't it? You said yes, didn't you? May your life pass in great happiness. What are you talking about, sir? If my marriage to Piro happens, then what will Aunt Gul Bibi be to me? Mother-in-law! If someone's mother-in-law is Aunt Gul Bibi...
en_old: If that hadn't happened, if you hadn't done that, our life would have passed in great happiness. What are you saying, sir? If I marry Piro, then what will Tati Gul Bibi be to me? A relative by marriage! If someone's relative by marriage is Tati Gul Bibi...

brh: او ماری اونا زند و برباد ء پیرو نا سدھائنگا باوام تو ہموراٹی ئنا فی الحال تو او راٹی اف تاتی گل بے بے نا دو آن خلکے الا نرہ ئنا اگہ کنا برا ہموراٹی مس ئے تو دا دنیائے الا
en: ...his life is ruined. For Piro's ..., father too was in that house; for now he isn't at home. At Aunt Gul Bibi's hands ... he left and ran away... If my marriage happens into that house, I'll leave this world.
en_old: Oh Mari, his life is ruined... Piro was being set straight, father was there; for now he isn't there, Gul Bibi has been beaten by his hand... if my brother had been there, this world would...

brh: روٹ نہ روٹ خدا کا پامار وئی کنے گٹیوس ئے تندادی پیرو تے نا علم تے آنبار ورانوٹ ئے امر اوڑتو برام کننگ کیوہ ئے دا سگلو گل بے بے آن تو او دے شر
en: ... by God ... I've come to know Piro's ways... how can I marry him? Compared with this ... Gul Bibi, that one is better.
en_old: Day after day, by God... I've learned all about Piro's ways; how can we arrange a marriage with him? All this from Gul Bibi... and that day...

brh: نم بتو؟ اونا ارے ورا ایلا نرہ اینا، او سانگو برام نا ایتے کننگے، اخہ اخہ دا ایتا فک، او تو دا ایتا شیر خان نا نرہ نا مست کرے سس، کنا کنڈن نا سمجھ، ئے کاوا زلی کنے انتظار ئے
en: Did you come? He left his house and ran away... and there's talk of the engagement and marriage. No, no, it isn't this matter. He had driven Sher Khan's ... wild... Understand it from my side. I'm going; they're waiting for me.
en_old: Did you come? He has... the engagement and marriage are being arranged. No, no, it isn't this. He had driven Sher Khan's... crazy. Understand it from my side; Kawa Zali is waiting for me.

brh: توبہ ئے توبہ ئے اینو پگہ نا اولاد ئے نن تینا لمہ باوہ نا مونا ہیت کتوینہ دا بے شرماتیور امر جواب اتیرا
en: Heaven forbid, heaven forbid! The children of these days! We never used to speak in front of our mother and father, and look how these shameless ones answer back!
en_old: God forgive us! Today's children... we never spoke in front of our mother and father, and look how these shameless ones answer back!

brh: ہیرو! ہنداسے۔ نی مچٹ دت کن تو نیمہ کیسی ہنداکے۔ سیتس پاوانے جوان۔
en: Hero! Like this. You, for a little ... half ... like this. ... say it properly.
en_old: Hero! It's here. For a little while you... half... it's here. Tell him to sit properly.

brh: ننے نی کنے ار دے ریفسے؟ کنے ہن ضرورت کرے نی کنے ریفپ۔ اینے تو راست راست پاوے یا کنکے اسکپیس؟ درو دروغ تڑپیس راست راست پاس۔ نا بابے؟ کنا بابے؟ او نا بابے!
en: Why do you deceive me every day? I need it too; don't deceive me. Now, will you tell me the plain truth or not? Don't tell lies; tell the plain truth. Your father? My father? Yes, your father!
en_old: Why did you deceive me for two days? I needed you not to deceive me. Now tell me straight, or are you going to dodge it? Don't tell lies, tell the truth straight. Your father? My father? His father!

brh: تو کنا باوہ پندین نہ باوہ، نی خبرے نہ باوہ راڑ کے، کلہ خلقی خبرے، ابا اینہ دوت انرانی شار اینانے، سہی بالکل سہی، نی سمائی نہ باوہ را وختہ خبر کے، کنے ہن سمائی، کنے دونن لگے کہ ابا این
en: So my father... no, father, you know, don't you, father... the whole community knows: Dad has gone to the city in Iran. Right, absolutely right. You didn't know, father, when ... I knew too; it seemed to me that Dad...
en_old: So my father... no, father, you know, father... everyone knows, father... the city of Iran... right, absolutely right. You didn't realize, father, when... I realized; it seemed to me like, father...

brh: کنا دوتان مچ آ زند بفروئی، بس کس نا داغے خلنگا، اگر باوانا بھتو چاس کے نا برام مٹو، یار دنو ہیت کپے، استے کنا خراب کننگٹ اوس، مون ابین مون ابین پا، انت سے؟
en: My whole life, by my own hands... just someone's stain being put on me. If father ... found out, your marriage won't happen. Friend, don't say such things; you're upsetting me. Say it to my face, to my face: what is it?
en_old: Don't ruin my whole life with my own hands. Someone's stain has just been put on me; if father... my marriage won't happen. Friend, don't say such things. You're out to ruin me. Say it to my face, say it to my face — what is it?

brh: نالمے، کنا لمے، او نالمے، او وڑے کنا لمے، نالمے تاتی سکینہ تون نا سانگا نیتی کھریکے، ئے تو ہن چدا خوراتی او کوڑ مریک چدا، او مونہ پنتسی، ہلک پارے کنا
en: Your mother, my mother, oh your mother, oh my mother! Your mother has fixed your engagement with Aunt Sakina... I ... there ... and one goes blind there... and in front ... she said, my...
en_old: Your mother, my mother, oh your mother, oh my poor mother! Your mother, with Sakina, your engagement... she will eat it there... he goes blind there... he said, my...

brh: ہیلو عیسی کے بہا ونے ہیلو کسٹٹی چداتم گڑا برو کا کسٹٹی تیوانے ٹھیک ہی کن پی نمبر باز ئے تارے چٹل چٹل او ابا ابا
en: Hello, Isa... the price... hello... on the way... whenever... then come... on the way... fine... the number is big... hurry, hurry. Oh Dad, Dad!
en_old: Hello Isa, come... hello... whenever... then... it's fine... the number is big... quickly, quickly. Oh father, father!

brh: جذباتی مفہ سکینہ جذباتی مفہ ئے باز سوچ کریٹ نیتون کنا گزارہ مفک سکینہ ئے نیتون مہر کیوہ اوستنا ہب اٹ
en: Don't get emotional, Sakina, don't get emotional. — I have thought about it a lot; living with you is not going to work for me. — Sakina, I love you with all my heart.
en_old: Don't get emotional, Sakina, don't get emotional. I've thought about it a lot. I can't get along with you, Sakina. I love you with all my heart.

brh: نی تو مہر کیوسہ سکینہ نی نی دا ظاہرے زیب ء اوننگٹی ئس ئے ئے نمونہ دو تفو دا ہیت ء کپہ سکینہ کپہ دا ہیت ء کنے پین شرمندہ کپہ نی تینے حد ء کٹے اورانس
en: You do love [me], Sakina — you, you are looking at this outward beauty. — I, I ... [spit?] on your face ... — Don't say this, Sakina, don't! Don't say this, don't shame me any more. You have crossed your limits.
en_old: You do love, Sakina, but you only see outward beauty. Don't give me examples, don't say this, Sakina, don't say this, don't embarrass me any more. You have crossed your limits.

brh: بس کا، کنے آزاد کا، کنا مہر اٹ، جاگہ سے غان کمبوتی ئس مسٹ تو کنے پا، ئے اودے پورو کیو، کنے پا، پنی کسے، کنے بس اکی نی پا، دا کنا زار
en: Enough, set me free. — If there was any shortcoming in my love somewhere, then tell me, I will make it up. Tell me ... just tell me, you tell me — this is my plea.
en_old: Enough, set me free, my love. If something was lacking somewhere, tell me and I'll make up for it. Tell me, tell me, just tell me. This is my plea.

brh: دا زند، تینا زند، تینا مرضی ٹی گدریفنگ خواوہ، تینا خوشی تے نیکن قربان کننگ کپرا۔
en: This life, my own life — I want to spend it as I wish; I cannot sacrifice my happiness for you.
en_old: I want to live this life, my own life, the way I choose. I can't sacrifice my happiness for you.

brh: کنا ڈوہ ء تو پا، کنا قصور ء تو پا، کنا انت قصور ء، انت قصور ء کنا پا۔ کنے نفرت ئے نیان بس کنے آزاد کر۔
en: At least tell me my fault, at least tell me my offence — what is my offence, what offence of mine? Tell me. — I hate you; just set me free.
en_old: At least tell me what I did wrong, tell me my fault. What is my fault? Tell me, what is my fault? I hate you, just set me free.

brh: کنے طلاق ایت، ئے بخت ء گرام کریسٹ، گرام کریسٹ ئے بخت ء، نی پارے سس، کنا مہر نی ئس کنا کنا
en: Give me a divorce. — I had blessed my fate, blessed my fate; you had said, 'You are my love, my, my...'
en_old: Give me a divorce. I've cursed my fate, I've cursed my fate. You had said, you are my love, my...

brh: دوست نیوس، کنا سنگت، کنا سیال، کنا قریب نیوس، نی کنا زند ئس ہرا کنا سب وقت آتے ئے وقت آ، ئے کور اسوٹا، ئے وقت آ نی کور الپیس، الپیس ئے وقت آ۔
en: '...you are my friend, my companion, my kin, you are the one closest to me, you are my life,' through all my times, at that time. — At that time I was blind. — At that time you were not blind; you were not, at that time.
en_old: You were my love, my friend, my family, the one closest to me. You were my life, at every moment. I was blind back then, weren't you blind back then?

brh: نی ہتھاکور نی ہتھاکور اللہ نا سفت نی نی نی نی دا داسہ داسہ کور مسس دا دا دنیا نا روشنائی نا خنتہ کور کرینو نا خنتہ نورے پلانو نی داسہ کور مسس
en: You are utterly blind, utterly blind. Praise be to God — you, you, you, you have now, now become blind. The light of this, this world has blinded your eyes, has robbed your eyes of their light; now you have become blind.
en_old: You're blind, you're blind, praise be to God. Now you have gone blind. The eyes that saw the light of this world, the eyes that spread light, now you have gone blind.

brh: ظاہر و زیب، زیب و زینت نا تپہ، پاشکا زیب و زینت نا تپہ، نی رتھ سکینہ نا زند برباد کپہ، تو تفے نا مونا نا۔ دا عجب و زبردستی اسے، اینے تون رینگ خواپارا، نی آن جدائی خواوا۔
en: Looks and beauty — the craze for beauty and adornment; it's out in the open, this craze for beauty and adornment. — You, don't ruin Sakina's life ... [spit?] on your face. This is strange, and it is coercion. I don't want to live with you; I want to be separated from you.
en_old: Outward appearance and beauty, this craving for beauty and glamour. Don't ruin Sakina's life, in front of your father. This is strange, this is coercion. I don't want to live with you, I want to be separated from you.

brh: سکینہ سکینہ کنا ہیت ء تخفتو نی رد ئس تینا زند ء برباد کننگٹی ئس تینا لمہ باوہ نا پنی
en: Sakina, Sakina, you didn't heed my words. You are in the wrong; you are ruining your own life and your parents' good name.
en_old: Sakina, Sakina, you didn't listen to me. You are ruining your life, and your parents' name.

brh: خراب کنے گٹ چٹ کنے ایتہ ہفتا من کنے ایتہ من کنے ایتہ نیکی بابئی کنے یلہ کا ئے نیتون گزارہ کننگ کپرہ بس کنے آزاد کا
en: ...bad... give me ... give me ... give me ... let me go. I can't get along with you; just set me free.
en_old: ...bad... give me... give me... leave me. I can't live with you, just set me free.

brh: کنے آزاد کا عمر کنے آزاد کا بس کنے طلاق ایت کنے طلاق ایت
en: Set me free, Umar, set me free. Just give me a divorce, give me a divorce.
en_old: Set me free, Umar, set me free. Just give me a divorce, give me a divorce.

brh: سئی؟ جی سر۔ دا فائل اکاؤنٹ برانچ اٹ دیس۔ جی سر۔
en: Right? — Yes, sir. — Take this file to the accounts branch. — Yes, sir.
en_old: Yes? Yes sir. Give this file to the accounts branch. Yes sir.

brh: فیس جی اینو پگا قیوم صاب بس چھٹی کننگٹی ئے ہم نن تو اسدیس چھٹی کننگ کپن کنا خیال
en: Faiz, these days Qayyum sahib is just taking leave, and as for us, we can't take even a single day off, I think.
en_old: Faiz, Qayyum sahib is taking leave today and tomorrow too. I don't think we can take even one day off.

brh: پلپئی دو دا پین جاگس گٹی کنے ہمندوں لگک سکینہ بے بے خیر ئے انو مونجا مونجا خننگیرے کسس نا انتظار مٹی
en: ... in this other place, it seems that way to me. Sakina, ma'am, is everything all right? Today you look sad, very sad. Are you waiting for someone?
en_old: ...it feels the same to me. Sakina, is everything alright? You look sad today, sad. Are you waiting for someone?

brh: اروئے؟ دا جاگہ سے نوئے تا؟ جی نا، دنو ایچوئے تصف۔ کنا تپ جوان اف۔ خواجہ! خواجہ! جی سر۔ میڈم، ئے دا دے توننگ نا باز کوشش کریٹ، ولے منیتو پئی میڈم ناریوٹ۔ کرم۔
en: Is that so? Is this place new [to you]? — No, nothing like that. I'm not feeling well. — Khawaja! Khawaja! — Yes, sir. — Madam, I tried hard to stop him, but he wouldn't listen; he says, 'I'm madam's husband.' — Please.
en_old: Is it? Is this place new? No, nothing like that. I'm not feeling well. Khawaja! Khawaja! Yes sir. Madam, I tried hard to stop him today, but he wouldn't listen, madam was angry. Please.

brh: نی تاڑے تسکن بسس؟ ئے دا کن گدرینگاٹ ئے پٹ نیم تن تنو راکاتی چھٹی نا ٹائم سوئے مس۔ نا ئے تینا کاریمے کیوا تینٹ بروٹ۔
en: What did you come here for? — I was passing this way; I thought [I'd go] with you, since it's closing time. — No, I'll finish my own work and come by myself.
en_old: How far did you come? I was passing by here. It's half past, it's break time. No, I'll do my own work and come myself.

brh: ایوا پلیز نم بنبو اوکے اوکے تولبو چاس کنبو خواجہ تھینک یو تھینک یو تھینک یو تھینکس آ لاٹ
en: Oh, please, come in. Okay, okay, sit down, have some tea. Khawaja! Thank you, thank you, thank you, thanks a lot.
en_old: Eva, please come in. Okay, okay, sit down, have some tea. Khawaja, thank you, thank you, thank you, thanks a lot.

brh: فیس گڑاس خناس؟
en: Faiz, did you see anything?
en_old: Faiz, did you see anything?

brh: خدر زیبائی اوریتے است کارس مروئی لمہ باواتا خنت تر کرینو مسیتٹ تسونو اگر لمہ باواتے کور اسرو خنتوسو کم از کم
en: Beauty should be a matter of the heart. You have filled your parents' eyes with tears; ... at the mosque they have given ... If you had at least seen your parents [as] blind ...
en_old: Beware, beauty should be in the heart. You have filled your parents' eyes with tears. If only you had seen your parents as blind, at least...

brh: او سہی نا خن تومہ لوک ہسورہ، نی انت ہیت کیسہ؟ پیسہ ہرا بیٹ ڈکیک۔ خناستہ اخہ سوٹ بوٹ اسکہ۔ بنگلہ گاڑی ہم مروئی تا۔ واقعی میڈم نی راست پاس۔ نی داڑے انت کننگ اٹی ئس
en: Oh, right — [his] eyes ... people ... [unclear]. — What are you talking about? Money hides every flaw. Did you see what a suit and shoes he had? He must have a bungalow and a car too. — Really, madam, you're right. — What are you doing here?
en_old: Oh, the one-eyed one is laughing — what are you talking about? Money hides every flaw. Look, he doesn't even have a suit and shoes. He won't have a bungalow or a car either. Really, madam, you're right. What were you doing here?

brh: گومرک چاتا، ٹھیک ئے کڑک او چاس مرے جی او دا
en: ... tea ... OK, let it be a strong tea. Yes, and this ...
en_old: He didn't know... okay, look, he would know, yes, this...

brh: السلام علیکم۔ جی ماما عمر ہیت کنے آ جوٹ۔ جی الحمداللہ۔ جی او خیر۔
en: Peace be upon you. Yes, Uncle, this is Umar speaking. I'm fine. Yes, thank God. Yes, and all is well.
en_old: Peace be upon you. Yes, Uncle Umar, talk to me. Yes, thank God. Yes, all is well.

brh: مما نمے ئس تکلیف ئس تروئی ء زحمت تروئی ء نمے نی او تاتی دن کہ بو دا شار ئنا نیام
en: Uncle, we'll have to trouble you, to put you to some bother: you and Auntie, please come over to the middle of this city.
en_old: Mum, we'll have to trouble you, to bother you — you and Dad, come like this to the middle of the city.

brh: ننے گڑتی کپبو، ادو مسلہ اف بس نم اخس کہ زوت بننگ کیرے رسفبو تینے جی او باز مہربانی سلام
en: Don't worry; there's no problem there. Just come as quickly as you can, get yourselves here. Yes, and thank you very much. Goodbye.
en_old: Don't keep us waiting. There's no problem there, just get here as soon as you can. Yes, thank you very much, goodbye.

brh: نی دا خدر مت
en: Don't you go this far!
en_old: Don't be so stubborn.

brh: لبی مروء، نن سوچنگ کپنہ۔ او مسڑ! مچیٹ اسم تینا لمہ باوانا عزت نا خیال ء کروسس، ننا گڑا ئس رسم و دود ئس
en: [unclear], we can't even think of that. O daughter! You should at least once have thought of your parents' honour; we have our customs and traditions.
en_old: Be quiet, we can't even think of it. Oh daughter! At least once, think of your mother's and father's honour; we have our customs and traditions.

brh: عمر، امر؟ عمر، ہمو وخت نا دوئی ہلک، ہرا وخت نا خنا روشنی بننگ نا امید الو، نیتو برام کرے، نی خوانیفے، نی خوش تخا، نی تینا اریتو انتئے
en: Umar, how? Umar took your hand at a time when there was no hope of light ever coming to your eyes. He married you, educated you, kept you happy, made you his own — why ...
en_old: Umar, how? Umar took her hand at a time when there was no hope of her eyes ever seeing light. He married you, educated you, kept you happy, gave you everything he had — why...

brh: ایوے مونی کسہ انتئے مون ملپیسے توتا کنا مسڑ زیبائی بندغ نا تئی ہنوارک تینا رے تنگ کپا
en: Hey, why do you keep turning your face away, why won't you show your face? ... My daughter, a person's beauty goes away; you can't keep hold of it.
en_old: Why do you keep turning away? Why won't you face it? My daughter, beauty doesn't stay with a person forever; you can't hold on to it.

brh: نم پیر مسنرے، اینو پگاہ ننا ایتاتے سرپد مفیرے، کنا او اونا ہتہ برابری اسے۔ مخلوق کنے آ ملنڈ کیک، ہرا وخت آ کہ نی کوڑسسے۔
en: You have grown old; nowadays you don't understand what we say. Is there even any equality between me and him? People mock me whenever you [are with me] ...
en_old: You've grown old, nowadays you don't understand what we're saying. There's no match between him and me. People mock me whenever you walk beside me.

brh: زوبیر! دا بف کے اسینے پین ہستس دے، ابا نی زوبیر! اگر نی بفیسے نی ہم ئس ئے اشارہ سر مروٹ، زوب ابا! او ابا! ابا!
en: Zubair! Don't come now ... another ... day(s). Dear, you, Zubair! If you don't come, you too [give] a signal, [and] I will get there. Zub[air], dear! Oh dear! Dear!
en_old: Zubair! Bring this... a few more days. Oh, Zubair! If you bring it, you too... a signal and I'll be there. Zubair! Father! Oh father! Father!

brh: السلام علیکم سر۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ السلام علیکم سر۔ بسورے؟ جی سر۔ ئتو بو۔ مہربانی سر۔ ئتو بو الے سر احوال نن تول خیرے۔ ہمم۔ سر اندونو نیک و نیاڑی سے۔ چپ۔ نیاڑن کس۔
en: Peace be upon you, sir. And upon you be peace. Peace be upon you, sir. Have you come? Yes, sir. Sit down. Thank you, sir. Sit down ... sir, as for news, all is well with us. Hmm. Sir, such a good woman [she was]. Quiet. The woman ... [unclear].
en_old: Peace be upon you, sir. And upon you be peace. Peace be upon you, sir. Have you come? Yes, sir. Sit down. Thank you, sir. Sit down. Sir, as for news, all is well with us. Hmm. Sir, such a good woman she was. Quiet. Some woman...

brh: صارفے تینا مونا شوروزء بائنڈ گڑی ڈیو امبر انجی سر صاحب ہن پانے ہندونو نیکو نیاڑیس ہندونو نیکو نیاڑیس اسس کہ شیر خان نا ضعیفہ تو اینو میرے اونا ضعیفہ نا سفت کننگ اٹی کتو وسول گڑا اٹی کنا مونا اونا ضعیفہ
en: [Unclear opening: '... in front of himself ...'] Sir, sahib, what can I say: such a good woman, such a good woman she was, Sher Khan's wife, who today ... I could not finish praising his wife ... then, in front of me, his wife ...
en_old: ...Sir, what can I say — such a good woman, such a good woman she was, Sher Khan's wife, who died today. I couldn't praise his wife enough... in front of me, his wife...

brh: بس سفت کبو۔ جی۔ اینو کنے دا کسر آ راہی کریسے شوٹ کنے مریبو شیر خان قصوروار ارے یا افک راست پاننگٹی ئے یا دروغ۔ سر قصہ دنے کہ شیر خان اسہ وخت سیٹھ دیناز نا زلف نا دیوان آن تنگ مس او شارا بسک۔
en: Just keep praising [her]. Yes. Today you have sent me down this path; [tell] me whether Sher Khan is guilty or not, whether he is telling the truth or a lie. Sir, the story is this: Sher Khan once got fed up with [the] court of Seth Dinaz's [zulf?] and came to the city.
en_old: Just praise her. Yes. Today you have put me on this path; tell me whether Sher Khan is guilty or not, whether he is telling the truth or lying. Sir, the story is that Sher Khan once got fed up with Seth Dinaz's... and came to the city.

brh: سربل ککال کونگا بندغ دا دعا ء کیک کہ زیفہ مرے تو گل
en: [Unclear: 'sarbal kakāl ...'] a person makes this prayer, that he may have a wife [like that], then [a] flower (gul).
en_old: A person... prays that... then it's fine.

brh: ئے ہم بار ورنہ اسل مف شاباش نی اونا فنم یاد کریس واہ بھائی واہ سر نیک انگا نیاڑی دیر اوستندیک سر سر شیر خان یاد کریک دا خدا غو خڑینک خنتیان تمار سر جی جی سر توبہ ئے کسر سر اگہ کنے سما مسکہ کہ خلق نا نیاڑی داغس
en: I too ... otherwise not at all. Well done, you remembered her [face/name]. Wow, brother, wow! Sir, a good woman, who ... [unclear]. Sir, sir, Sher Khan remembers [her]; by God, tears fall from the eyes. Sir, yes, yes, sir. Heaven forbid ... sir, if I had known that a village woman is like this...
en_old: ...never at all. Well done, you remembered her face. Wow, brother, wow. Sir, a good woman... sir. Sir, Sher Khan remembers; by God, tears fall from my eyes. Sir, yes, yes, sir. God forgive me, sir. Sir, if I had known that people's women were like this...

brh: اریت کھڑنگ بٹیر، تو ہرگز شارٹ برام کتوٹ، خلک اٹ برام کریٹ سر۔ بس ٹھیک ہی نومبو؟ سر ئے داسہ کاوہ راغا، تینا ارا والائے ہم پاوہ کہ دنو نیاڑی مرے بس ٹھیک ہی گنو غفتو؟
en: [Unclear: 'arit khaṛang baṭīr'] then I would never have married in the city; I would have married in the village, sir. Just — alright, is that so? Sir, I'm going now, and I will also tell my household that a woman should be like this. Just — alright, isn't it?
en_old: ...I would never have made a hasty marriage; I married... sir. Just fine, right? Sir, now go, and tell your folks too that there should be such a woman. Just fine, isn't it?

brh: سر دا ہچ غلطی اف تینا دا ہچ دکا بروس اگر کسر ئس تینا چار پٹ کاٹومہ نری نا تمبل ہرفوس سر تو گڑا ئے اسل وراغے مپر ٹھیک ہی سر اسل وراغے مپر سر سر کن کے انتو کمک ئس سر خانہ باد جی نی چڑو بندغ اسس
en: Sir, this is no fault of yours at all ... if [there were] a path, your own four ... head ... you would pick up the ... then I would never ... Alright, sir, never ... sir. Sir, what help [is there] for me? Sir, may your house prosper. Yes, you were a single (unmarried) man.
en_old: Sir, this is no fault of yours at all. If you... then don't come at all. Right, sir? Don't come at all, sir. Sir, what help is there for me, sir? May your house prosper. Yes, you were just one person.

brh: جی، نیدیر تو ایت کروس، سردی والا تو ایت کیوہ سر، شیر خان نا نیاڑی، اندونو تیزنگا نیاڑی، اندو مخلص کرے کا سر، توبہ توبہ اللہ
en: Yes, who were you talking to? I talk with the [sardi?] people, sir. Sher Khan's wife — such a clever woman, so sincere, sir. Good heavens, good heavens, O God!
en_old: Yes, you spoke... sir, Sher Khan's wife, such a sharp woman, so sincere, sir. God forgive us, God forgive us, O God.

brh: معاف کے کنے سر، ہندونو نی اڑیا کن سر، داسہ کنے اجازت ئے سر۔ ٹھیک ئے نی دکہ کرک۔ جی سر۔ شیر خانی نت ئے جی۔ نن تو پاریسن کہ دا شہر والا گواست تیز مریرہ زوراک مریرہ دا خلق والا گمی تو پاوہ کسیاں گم ا۔
en: Forgive me, sir, you ... so much ... for me, sir; now may I have permission [to go], sir? Alright, you ... [unclear]. Yes, sir. Sher Khan ... yes. We used to say that these city people are clever and strong, [but] these village people, I'd say, are no less than anyone.
en_old: Forgive me, sir, I didn't know you were here, sir; now give me permission, sir. Alright, you may go. Yes sir. Sher Khan, stand up, yes. We used to say that these city people are fast and strong, but these villagers, I'd say, are lost to everyone.

brh: توبہ توبہ سر توبہ، سر اجازت ئے کنے؟ اجازت ئے شیر خان ایتے، جی سر۔ پو مسوس آغا؟ آ پو مسوٹ، شار آئینہ او ایننے۔ شار آئینہ اوئے؟ ایلو مگر ئے او شار آئینہ نہ، تو داڑے مٹل او۔
en: Good heavens, sir, good heavens. Sir, do I have permission? You have permission, Sher Khan, [I] give it. Yes, sir. Did you understand, Agha? Yes, I understood: he went to the city, he has gone. He went to the city? Otherwise, if he had not gone to the city, he would be here.
en_old: God forgive us, sir, God forgive. Sir, do I have permission? You have permission, Sher Khan. Yes, sir. Did you understand, Agha? Yes, I understood, he is coming to the city. Is he coming to the city? Otherwise, if he isn't coming to the city, then stay here.

brh: جوان داد ننا خوارزادہ نا ڈغار تے قبضہ کریر تو گڑا ننا انت مروئی ایڑان جواب ایتون نی فکر کپہ ئے ایڑے تینٹ جواب ایتیوئے بس گڑا کان کاچوم کنا خٹ کننگا چار سائیڈ آ اڑے او یار ادا بس ادا بس
en: Fine, [dād?] — if they seize our nephew's land, then what will become of us? Shall we answer them from there? Don't you worry, I will give the answer there myself. Just, then let's go ... my ... [dug?] on all four sides. Oh friend, here, just here, just here.
en_old: Fine, if they seize our nephew's land, then what will become of us? Give the answer there; don't you worry, he'll answer there himself. Just then, from the hill, my... it's been dug on four sides there. Oh friend, enough here, enough here.

brh: دا کنا سنگت شیر خان نا احوال، ایلم نن دا تعویذ ء داڑے جوٹ سلنگ کے۔ دا تعویذ؟ کنا مطلب دادے کہ نن شیر خان ء داڑے پٹنگ کے بسوسن۔ تھارا جاگہ ء پٹنگ نا، ہوشیار ٹینوم داڑے توسروت پٹنگورے۔ دا
en: This is the news of my friend Sher Khan. Brother, we [should] set up this amulet here. This amulet? I mean that we have come here to search for Sher Khan. Searching a dark place ... be careful, you are searching here ... [unclear]. This...
en_old: This is the news of my friend Sher Khan. Brother, we have to stand this amulet up properly here. This amulet? I mean that we came here to look for Sher Khan. Searching in a dark place — be careful, people search here quietly. This...

brh: دا نی پاک ء نی دیر ئس ئس ہنا سنگتی! اگہ نا سنگتی نی تو اینو نیم پٹ چٹہ۔ جوان جوان ئے تینٹ کاوہ شارانٹ تولبو ئے تینٹ کاوہ پٹیوے۔ ئے شارٹ پٹہ تے این پٹ چٹہ نی بکانک تولنگ ء چاس گوننگ
en: Is this your pure ...? You ... the friendship is gone! If it were your friendship, today you would have searched thoroughly. Fine, fine, I'll go myself; you sit in the city; I'll go myself and search. I'll search for him in the city ... while you [keep] sitting [at the shop?] and drinking tea.
en_old: This is your pure... you went far, friend! If you were a friend, today you would... Fine, fine, he'll come himself, sit down... he'll come himself and search. Search... today you... sitting in the house and drinking tea.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ تول سر۔ بشیر خان تول داڑے، مہربانی۔ تول تول۔ تولو صاحب؟ جی او تولو گل تولو بس ہمتے۔ او تول تول تول۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Sit down, sir. Bashir Khan, sit here, please. Sit, sit. Shall I sit, sir? Yes, oh, sit — sit, [gul], just sit there. Oh, sit, sit, sit.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Sit down, sir. Bashir Khan, sit here, please. Sit, sit. Shall we sit, sir? Yes, sit down, friend, just sit there. Oh, sit, sit, sit.

brh: مہربانی صاحب۔ شیر خان! ایدادے کنا باری ٹی باز معلومات کرینے۔ جی۔ باز بندغاتے نریفینے۔ او نی کے رے سلسبیل بے گناہ اوس۔ ئے چکاسٹ۔
en: Thank you, sir. Sher Khan! [He] has made a lot of inquiries about me. Yes. [He] has had many people running around. And you, [salsabil?], are innocent. I checked.
en_old: Thank you, sir. Sher Khan! He has made a lot of inquiries about me. Yes. He has made many people flee. And you... Salsabil was innocent. I checked.

brh: حضور اسک تنوش صاب نمے معلوم ئس نہ کہ ئے بے گناہ اٹ ونس اگین اران اٹ شیر خانی تو خلق نہ را شیر بسوس جی ولے دا سپاہ نہ شہر والاک ننے را رنگ کر ابا
en: Your honor, [asak tanosh?] sahib, didn't you know that I am innocent? ... Sher Khan, you came from the village to the city. Yes, but these soldiers, these city folk, have frustrated us, oh.
en_old: Your honor, Tanosh sahib, didn't you know that I was innocent? Where else would I be from — Sher Khan came from the village, yes, but these city people of the army gave us trouble.

brh: تو ہنت داڑیم گلب بے بے ہمبارو تیزو نیڑی ارے گلب بے بے کے کرے شکر کشبو شہر والا نیڑی تے خنتنس شہر
en: So ... here too, Gulab Bibi is also a very clever woman. Be thankful for Gulab Bibi! You haven't seen the city women, the city...
en_old: So he went here; Gulab Bibi, there's a very fast flood together; Gulab Bibi, what did she do? Give thanks; you have seen the floods of the city people, the city...

brh: ولے دا پو دا پکا بندی کسارنگیا؟ چپ ہرانگے نوٹ کا او تینا اڑائی ء او ماتی پٹ
en: But this ... this sure prisoner — where are you going? Quiet! Note down where [he goes], and search his own ... and ...
en_old: But this... where is this solid prisoner being taken? Quiet, wherever... note it, and look for his fight and mother.

brh: ئے وا کہ بیس سال مست وفتے الاسوٹ ایناسوٹ داکٹ ہمو کنا باز بلو زند نا بے عقلی اسس کہ ئے ورائے الاٹناٹ شیر خان انسان کرے کم عقلی ٹی بلو غلطی ئس کیک جی ارباب صاحب او دا غلطی نا اود بلو نقصان ئس مریک ہو او دن کہ
en: I ... that twenty years ago I had left them, I had gone ... that was the greatest folly of my life, that I left the house. Sher Khan, a person makes big mistakes out of foolishness. Yes, Arbab sahib, and this mistake leads to a great loss. Yes, and so...
en_old: Twenty years ago I had them... that was the biggest foolishness of my life, that I had them... Sher Khan, a human being makes a big mistake out of foolishness. Yes, Arbab sahib, and that mistake causes great harm. Yes, and so...

brh: ننے نقصان مسنے جی ہاؤ بالکل ولے اسیت اسپونی جی نیکرے داسہ ننے اسہ لذت ئس ارے ارانکاز ئنا اینکے سے ٹھیک ہی صاحب نیکرے ہرا ٹائم کنا ضرورت مس
en: We have suffered a loss. Yes, yes, absolutely. But ... [unclear], yes ... now we have a certain pleasure ... [unclear]. Alright, sir, ... whenever you need me.
en_old: We have suffered a loss. Yes, absolutely, but... yes, you do it; now we have a pleasure... alright sir, you do it, whenever you need me.

brh: اینو گیشرٹ صاحب نما باز باز مہربانی نم کنا تدی باز خدمت کریرے ولے دا پولیس والا تا بارٹ بنگسٹنا کہ او تینا باوہ نا میتھ ہم بسہ اگہ باوہ ملزم مرے تو
en: Today ... sir, thank you very, very much; you have done me a great deal of service, but I had heard about these policemen that they would come even for their own father if the father were an accused.
en_old: Today... sir, thank you very, very much; you have served me a lot, but I have heard about these policemen that they would even come for their own father if the father were the accused.

brh: نی دا سے کریننگ کے سے؟ اچھا نما باز باز مہربانی، باز مہربانی نما۔ صحیح آ، آن نی مڑ کتو سے، دا دے ہر مڑ مسٹ او۔
en: What are you doing this for? Alright, thank you very, very much, many thanks to you. Right ... you did not [turn back?] ... today everyone has [turned?].
en_old: Are you doing this? Alright, thank you very, very much, many thanks to you. Fine, you didn't turn back; today every one of them has turned.

brh: یاد بس کنے صاحب، ونت بس کنا سے پوتونکس اسکا، پوتونکس
en: It came back to me, sir — [the time] came [when] I had three grandsons(?), grandsons(?).
en_old: I remembered, sir, it was the time I had three grandsons, grandsons.

brh: او عکس سمجھوڑ کرینے۔ اوڑتون اوار غلام مصطفی نا جوڑ کروک آ براہوئی سجی نا مچ سمائی ہرسا باز آ ہروکاتا با دیر کننگ آ مجبور مرے مصطفی تینا براہوئی ثقافت نا امین ئس مننگ تون اوار اوار اسہ ماحول ء ساہدار دوستو بندغ ئس ہم ارے۔
en: He has made the image ... [unclear]. Along with that, the sculpture of Brahui sajji made by Ghulam Mustafa makes the mouths of many viewers water. Along with being a custodian of his Brahui culture, Mustafa is also a lover of the environment and wildlife.
en_old: He has made the picture understandable. Along with it, the scene of Brahui sajji made by Ghulam Mustafa forces many viewers to linger. Along with being a custodian of his Brahui culture, Mustafa is also a lively, friendly person in his surroundings.

brh: کونا جوڑ کروکا شکاری تا سمنہ گواچی مروکا مارخور نا مجسمہ درد او استخوائی نا اسہ بھلو داستان ئس درشان کیک
en: The sculpture he made of a markhor falling prey to hunters tells a great story of pain and longing.
en_old: The statue of a markhor, which goes missing in the face of hunters, made by Kona, tells a great story of pain and longing.

brh: غلام مصطفی صاحب نا لکھ منت وار ننے دا براہوئی ٹی وی نا شو ٹی
en: A hundred thousand thanks to Ghulam Mustafa sahib [for being with] us on this Brahui TV show.
en_old: Many thanks to Ghulam Mustafa sahib for joining us on this Brahui TV show.

brh: بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم، کلہ مستی چہ کنے نما بولانی صاحب نما منت وار
en: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. First of all, I thank you, Bolani sahib, thank you.
en_old: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. First of all, thank you, Bolani sahib.

brh: منتوار اٹ مٹ ایم این ئے منتوار اٹ کہ اینو کنے دا ارا کہ براہوئی زبان نا مل بلوچستان نا ارا کہ دا ثقافتی گڑا تیٹی نوم کنے بخش تننگا چورے دا کنے صرف عید نا تحفہ دوئی کروکو تا کہ دا
en: I am grateful, [unclear: 'mat MNA'] grateful that today, in these cultural matters of the Brahui language [and] of Balochistan, I have been given recognition; this for me is [like] receiving an Eid gift, that this...
en_old: Thank you, thank MNA... thank you that today I was given recognition in these cultural things of the Brahui language and Balochistan; for me this is nothing less than an Eid gift.

brh: کنا دا وطن نا کنا زبان نا کنا کنا دھرتی نا کنا کنا مخلوق نا پچھان ئے دا۔ دا شوک نی دا ایلو مسکہ اسہ نجی چینل اسہ کنا اوٹہ نا پروگرام چلینگا رے۔
en: This is the identity of my homeland, of my language, of my, my land, of my, my people. This passion ... you [know], the other day a private channel was running a program about my [ōṭa].
en_old: This is the identity of my homeland, my language, my land, and my people. This hobby of yours, the other day a private channel was running a program about my home.

brh: اور کنے ننا براہوی تا ننا اینتسے کہ داٹی اسہ خاصیت ئس پانے کسس یا خرابی ئس پانے کہ نن کنے ریسٹرکٹڈ آن مطلب محدود آن نن کنے چینج داخہ جلدی برداشت کپنہ الپنہ تے تینے ٹی داخہ کنے مطلب ایلو لینگویج آک الیر انت کنے ننا براہوی نا کنے مطلب داخہ
en: And, um, our Brahui, our thing is that it has one characteristic, someone may call it a quality or call it a flaw: we are, um, restricted, meaning limited. We, um, don't accept change that quickly. We don't let it into ourselves as much as, um, I mean, other languages let it in. Our Brahui's, um, I mean, so much...
en_old: And our Brahui has a characteristic — call it a quality or a flaw — that we are restricted, meaning limited. We don't accept change so quickly, and we don't absorb things into ourselves as much as other languages do.

brh: اینت کہ لنگوسٹکلی ہسٹری ٹی چینجنگ متنے داخہ کے ایرو لینگویج آتہ مسونو تو ہنا خاطرن ننا کے امی ٹائم نا کے اینت کہ برا ساؤنڈ آک او اورا کے اینت کہ تواک او اینت کہ تو او کے اینو ئس تمنا موجود او۔
en: Because in linguistic history it has not changed as much as other languages have changed. That is why our, um, sounds from that old time, um, whatever sounds there were, um, are still present even today.
en_old: Because changes occur in linguistic history, so many languages have changed. That is why, in our time, the sounds that existed are still present today.

brh: براہوئی ادبی ادارہ غاک براہوئی زبان نا رد اٹ ہرا کاریم کننگ او ادب و زبان نا رد اٹ ہرا کاریم کننگ او اوڑے لسٹ
en: The work the Brahui literary institutions are doing for the Brahui language, the work they are doing for literature and language: there, in the list...
en_old: What work are Brahui literary institutions doing regarding the Brahui language, and what work regarding literature and language? The list there...

brh: لسانیات نا پڑ آ بندغ آک نی باز کم نظر بریکہ، نی مفتی انت کلوہ تنے؟ نن خواری کہ براہوئی ادبی ادارہ کو، براہوئی اکیڈمی، براہوئی ادبی سوسائٹی یا ایلو ادبی ادارہ غاک او، اوڑا وڈ وڈ اٹ کاریم کیر کہ ننا لسانیات نا دا کہ ڈغار ء، اوڑے اڑاس نا کڑاس تارے مننگ کے۔
en: People in the field of linguistics are seen very rarely. What message would you give? We want the Brahui literary institutions, the Brahui Academy, the Brahui Adabi Society or the other literary institutions to work on it in various ways, so that something can be produced there, on this ground of our linguistics.
en_old: People in the field of linguistics are seen very rarely. What message would you give? We want the Brahui Adabi Board, the Brahui Academy, the Brahui Adabi Society or other literary institutions to work in various ways on this ground of our linguistics, so that something can come of it.

brh: کنا تو دا ونے کہ آخر کے براہوئی نا کیرے لسانیات
en: My view is this: that, after all, Brahui's, um, linguistics...
en_old: My point is that, after all, Brahui linguistics...

brh: لسانیات نا رند تعلق تے غرے دن کہ مورفولوجی ئے سنٹیکس ئے سیمنٹکس ئے فونولوجی ئے تو دافتے کیرے او تاکہ اینالسس ئے کتنو تاکہ اوفتے ریسرچ کتنو تاکہ پٹ و پول کتنو تاکہ اوفتے این کتنو تینٹ مطلب
en: The areas connected with linguistics, such as morphology, syntax, semantics and phonology: these, um, have still not been analyzed. Nobody has researched them yet or investigated them, nobody has yet, um, worked on them. Personally, I mean...
en_old: The related branches of linguistics, such as morphology, syntax, semantics and phonology — these have not yet been analyzed, researched or investigated.

brh: مونی بتنو اور دا کارم کتنو تو ننتو کہ رے دا کارم زیادہ ایننگ کپک، اینو کہ رے مطلب ئے بش مسٹ تو کنتو کہ رے تین چار پی بش مریر، کو کپت کہ رے اسٹوڈنٹ آتے تین چار بش مسٹ، دون آہستہ آہستہ کہ رے داڑے کہ رے کارم مننگ کے کارم مستک تو کپت ننتو نن آ
en: Nobody has come forward and done this work, so we felt this work would not go very far. Today, I mean, I have woken up, so I think three or four more will wake up. If three or four of the students wake up, then slowly, slowly, work can happen here, work will get done... [unclear]
en_old: They came forward and did this work. We thought this work wouldn't progress much, but today, if I am awakened, then three or four more people will awaken; three or four students have awakened, and so gradually work can happen here.

brh: دا جندنا اسہ اینتس واسٹو اینتس جوڑ مریک کہ کورن دوں کہ بلوچی نا کیرے پیشی ملکاتے ٹی ڈیپارٹمنٹ موجود ئے تو ننا منا کوشش کے نن تینا تلاکا ٹی اونا ڈیپارٹمنٹ جوڑ کین کہ مطلب اونا اینتا لسانیات آ کاریم کین اونا زبان آ کاریم کین
en: This itself becomes a, um, a real thing, because Balochi, for example, um, has departments in foreign countries. So our effort, my effort, is to build a department for it in our own region, so that, I mean, we work on its, um, linguistics and work on its language.
en_old: This itself becomes something, because Balochi, for example, has departments in foreign countries, so our effort should be to build its department in our own region, so that we work on its linguistics and on its language.

brh: اور کرپشن نا تو او کبت ولہ ننا سے انتس مروک ء پیشن کانو پیشن دادے فروغ ایتنو مستی دادے جی بالکل گودی ننا ہرا کہ کاریم ء براہوئی زبان نا لٹ سطح غا کرزک کہ ننا براہوئی زبان نا سائنسی مطالعہ غا
en: And as for corruption, it... but what is happening with ours: outside, nobody has promoted it any further. Yes, absolutely, madam. The work our Brahui language needs at a high level is the scientific study of our Brahui language.
en_old: And corruption... what will happen; outsiders promote it further. Yes, absolutely — now work on the Brahui language is needed at a high level, on the scientific study of the Brahui language.

brh: ایسا جوان وڑے سے اٹے کارم کننگ او رے گڈی گڈسر ٹی براہوئی ٹی وی نا اوروکاتے اور براہوئی ٹی وی نا ٹیم نا رد اٹ انت پانو بس؟ بس دا باز جوانو کارم اسے کننگ ٹی او اور کہ دادے اندن مستی ایندے تینا کوشش
en: Work is being done in a very good way. Finally, what would you say to the viewers of Brahui TV and about the Brahui TV team? Just that this is very good work they are doing, and they should keep up their effort and carry it forward like this.
en_old: Very good work is being done. Finally, what would you say to Brahui TV viewers and about the Brahui TV team? Just that very good work is being done, and that your efforts should continue like this in the future.

brh: کوشش جاری تخیر دو انشااللہ مونی کہ باز اینتس مریکک براہوی زبان کن بے باز جوان و اینتس مریکک اور کہ ایوں بندغات کن بے باز اینتس مریکک کہ اوفتہ پہچان اوفتہ کلچر اوفتہ اینت مستی برسی کک اور کہ مخلوق اودے خنے کہ اور اینت کیک منت وار بودی شربتدارک نن تو داسہ کا شاہزیب ہم مولا
en: They should keep up the effort. God willing, a lot will happen in the future for the Brahui language, very good things will happen, and a great deal will happen for these people too, so that their identity, their culture, all of it comes forward, and people see it and what it does. Thank you, respected listeners. Now we also have Shazia Maula...
en_old: Keep up the effort, God willing, in the future a lot will happen; it will be very good for the Brahui language, and very much will happen for people too, so that their identity, their culture, all of it comes forward, and people will see what it does. Thank you, respected listeners. Now we also have Shahzeb, God willing...

brh: بخش ارا کہ براہوئی زبان نا لسانیات نا پیڑا جوانو وڑ سے ٹ کاریم کرینے جی شرفدار آک دا وخت ننا توسیٹی وحید شاہ صاحب ارا کہ او ہم براہوئی لسانیات اٹی کاریم کرینے ایم فل براہوئی ٹی مسنے اینو شازیہ بخش نا ارا کہ
en: ...Bakhsh, who has done good work on the linguistics of the Brahui language. Yes, respected listeners, with us at this time is Waheed Shah Sahib, who has also worked in Brahui linguistics and has done an MPhil in Brahui. Today Shazia Bakhsh's, which...
en_old: Bakhsh, who has done good work on the linguistics of the Brahui language. Respected listeners, at this time we have with us Waheed Shah Sahib, who has also worked in Brahui linguistics and has done an MPhil in Brahui. Today, Shazia Bakhsh's...

brh: پریزنٹیشن ئس او دے تٹ ننا اوڑے ننا رفن کوا نا کیون پنی فاک۔
en: She gave a presentation; there, our... [rest unintelligible].
en_old: ...gave a presentation; there, our ... named ... .

brh: جی میڈم نا ریسرچ اسکا ورب نا حوالہ ٹی فیرابی چی وربا کمر چینج مریرہ آن فکسز انت سے سفکسز انت سے یا اوور آل افکسز انت سے کہ لفظاتی تن چینج کنے کوا نا صفا مٹی لو فامٹ چینج کنے کوا نا تت انت چینجز بریک لفظاتی ٹی گڑا دا
en: Yes, madam's research was on the verb: how verbs change, what the infixes are, what the suffixes are, or overall what the affixes are that change words, that completely change their form, and what changes come into words. So this...
en_old: Yes, madam's research is about the verb: how the verb changes, what the affixes are, what the suffixes are, or overall what the affixes are that change words, that completely change the form, and what changes come into the words. So this...

brh: ٹاپک بیسکلی ئنا گڑا نا زی اسہ کہ مروک مکو سوال ہرا اسہ کہ اگر نن نیگیٹو کننگ خوانہ تو انت یوز کینہ؟ جک نو کہ او پارے نومے کہ جک پوزیٹو ورڈ ئس نیگیٹو کینہ تو اوٹ آن انفکس یوز کینہ۔ توم کہ بریوہ، بفرہ۔ ورڈ بریوہ پوزیٹو ئے
en: The topic was basically about this thing. One question that came up was: if we want to make something negative, what do we use? As she told you, when we make a positive word negative, we use an infix in it. For example, bareva ('I will come') becomes baffara ('I will not come'). The word bareva is positive.
en_old: The topic is basically about this: the question was, if we want to make something negative, what do we use? For example, she said that when we make a positive word negative, we use an infix in it. For example, 'bareva' (I come) becomes 'bafara'. The word 'bareva' is positive.

brh: داڑان پوزیٹیو آن نیگیٹیو کینا تو فا ساؤنڈ اینان سینٹر آٹی آ نیام اٹ شاعغے نا تو داڑان ورپ نا فارم چینج مرے پوزیٹیو آن نیگیٹیو مرے نو منصف مریرے براہوئی زبان نا پین خاص لسانیات نا رد اٹ کاریم نا ضرورت ئے لسانیات براہوئی زبان نا زی آ
en: So when we turn it from positive to negative, we put the 'fa' sound in the center, in the middle of the word. That is how the verb's form changes and it goes from positive to negative. You will agree that the Brahui language needs more work, especially in linguistics, on the linguistics of the Brahui language.
en_old: When we change this from positive to negative, the 'fa' sound goes into the center, in the middle of the word, so the form of the verb changes from positive to negative. Fair-minded people will agree that more work is needed on the Brahui language, especially in terms of linguistics, on the linguistics of the Brahui language.

brh: ئے تینا خلپک دا غا زیادہ کاریم متنے ہم ارٹ ننا ننا ئے مئے کلے خبر ء تو ضرورت تو ارے کاریم نا گڑاس لسبیلہ یونیورسٹی کنٹریبیوٹ کننگٹی ء ننا اسٹوڈنٹ آک باز اسٹوڈنٹ آک لینگویج نا زی آ ریسرچ کننگٹی ء گڑاس ٹاپک آتیا کاریم ء اوکان علاوہ باز کاریم آک متنے او اودے زی آ کاریم متنے اور مننگ پائے کہ
en: In my own [view], not much work has been done on this, and we all know it, so there is certainly a need for work. Lasbela University is contributing somewhat: our students, many students, are doing research on language, and there is some work on some topics. Apart from that, not much work has been done; no work has been done on it, and work should be done so that...
en_old: ...in my view, not much work has been done on this. We all know there is a need for work. Lasbela University is contributing somewhat; our students, many students, are doing research on language and working on some topics. Apart from that, much work has not been done on it, and it should be done.

brh: بروک آ کچاری ئس کا تینا شونکار آ برادر برکات ء اجازت ہبو اللہ امان
en: Until the next session, give your producer, Brother Barkat, leave to go. Goodbye, God keep you.
en_old: We will meet again in a coming gathering; allow your host Brother Barkat to take leave. Goodbye.

brh: ہمکنگ، ہندے کہ او خدانا مونا شیطان نا ہیتے منار او اوفک خدانا نافرمان جوڑ مسر۔ ہندے کہ خدا پاک ئے او گناہ گار اونا مونا سلنگ کپک۔ گڑا خدا آدم او حوا
en: [...] because in God's presence they obeyed Satan's word, and they became disobedient to God. And because God is holy, a sinner cannot stand before Him. So God [...] Adam and Eve...
en_old: ...together, because they obeyed the word of Satan before God and became disobedient to God. Because God is holy, that sinner cannot stand before Him. So God [drove] Adam and Eve...

brh: خداۓ باغ عدن آن کشا اوف خدا نا حکمی منیتویسور ہناران شکی اسور ہنا ثواب آن آدم حوا اوفتا نسلی ڈکھ و مرگ نا سزاسے گانگا مہروانا خدا نا استٹی ئس کہ او امر آدم تون ولدا سیالی گنڈے
en: God drove them out of the Garden of Eden. They had not obeyed God's command, so they were guilty. Because of that, Adam, Eve and their descendants received the punishment of suffering and death. The merciful God had it in His heart to restore His relationship with Adam.
en_old: God drove them out of the Garden of Eden. They had not obeyed God's command, therefore they were sinners. Because of that, Adam and Eve and their descendants received the punishment of suffering and death. It was in the heart of the merciful God to restore His relationship with Adam.

brh: تانکے او ہر وخت اونا بادشاہی ٹی رنگے، پاکا کلام ٹی خدا نا ارادہ دن درشان کیک کہ انسان ہرا سزانا حقدار ء اودے اوڑان چٹفنگے او اونا شکی گری ء چٹفنگے
en: ...so that he could always live in His kingdom. In the holy word, God's intention is expressed like this: man would be freed from the punishment he deserves, and freed from his guilt.
en_old: ...so that they would always live in His kingdom. In the holy word, God's intention is expressed this way: that man would be freed from the punishment he deserves and freed from his sinfulness.

brh: تانکہ انسان پدا ئے خدا نا بادشاہی ٹی رہینگنگ کے، خدا تینا دا ارادہ نا اسے بشخ ئس ابراہیمی ظاہر کرے
en: So that man could live in God's kingdom again, God revealed one part of this intention of His to Abraham.
en_old: So that man could again live in God's kingdom, God revealed a part of this intention of His through Abraham.

brh: ابراہیم خدا نا فرمانبرداری کرے او اونا بلو نیے منا خدا ابراہیمے برکت بشخنگ او اونا وسیلت دنیا نا قوماتے برکت تننگ نا قولے کرے خدا دا قولے ہم
en: Abraham obeyed God and accepted His call. God promised to bless Abraham and, through him, to bless the nations of the world. God also made this promise...
en_old: Abraham obeyed God and accepted His call. God promised to bless Abraham and, through him, to bless the nations of the world. God also made this promise...

brh: کرے کہ ئے نا نسلء ودفیسہ آسمان نا استارو دریا نا ریکا تیامبار کرو۔ ابراہیم خدا غا ایمان ایس ہنا سببان خدا اودے تینا نیکینگا بندغاتیٹی اوار کرے۔ اسے دے خدا
en: ...that 'I will multiply your descendants like the stars of the sky and the sand of the sea.' Abraham believed in God, and for that reason God counted him among His righteous people. One day God...
en_old: ...that He would multiply his descendants like the stars of the sky and the sand of the sea. Abraham believed in God, and for that reason God counted him among His righteous people. One day God...

brh: او ابراہیمی ہرا کہ او اوڑا بھروسہ کیک او اونا حکوماتی منی کہ نہ۔ او ابراہیمے پارے کہ تینا مارے کنکے خیرات کر۔ ابراہیم چائسکہ کہ ہنا مارنا وسیلہ اٹ خدا اونا نسلے ودیفنگ نا قول کرینے۔ ولدا ہم
en: ...looked to see whether Abraham trusted Him and obeyed His commands or not. He told Abraham, 'Sacrifice your son for me.' Abraham knew that God had promised to multiply his descendants through that son. Even so,
en_old: ...[tested] Abraham whether he trusted Him and obeyed His commands or not. He told Abraham to sacrifice his son to Him. Abraham knew that God had promised to multiply his descendants through that son. Even so,

brh: او خدا غا بھروسہ کرے او اونا حکمے مننا ہندا خاطران او تینا مارے خدا کن خیرات کننگ کن تیار مس
en: he trusted God and obeyed His command. For that very reason, he became ready to sacrifice his son for God.
en_old: he trusted God and obeyed His command; for this reason he became ready to sacrifice his son to God.

brh: او چنائے قربان کننگ کن روانہ مس، ہرا وخت او تینا مارے قربان کننگ کن لیٹیفے تو خدا پارے تہ، ئے جوان چاو کہ نی کنے آن خلوسہ او کنا حکم ء منیسہ۔ ولدا ابراہیم خنا کہ اونا مونا خڑاسے او مرغاک تہ جراٹی
en: He set out to sacrifice the child. When he laid his son down to sacrifice him, God said to him, 'I know well that you fear Me and obey My command.' Then Abraham saw a ram in front of him, with its horns caught in the bush.
en_old: He set out to sacrifice the child. When he laid his son down to sacrifice him, God said: stop, I know well that you fear Me and obey My command. Then Abraham saw that in front of him was a ram, caught by its horns in the bushes.

brh: ابراہیم او کھڑے ارفیو خدا کین خیرات کرے مہروانا خدا ابراہیم نا مار نا بدلہ ٹی کھڑس رسیفے تو دنچا کے او انسان تے تینا مہر
en: Abraham took that ram and sacrificed it to God. The merciful God provided a ram in place of Abraham's son. In this way He [showed] His love to mankind...
en_old: Abraham took that ram and sacrificed it to God. The merciful God provided a ram in place of Abraham's son. In this way He showed His love to mankind.

brh: ظاہر کرے او نا مہر انونے دنکے باوہ نا مہر مارا کنے دا قصہ غان خدا دائے تے ظاہر کرے نی کہ او انسان نا گناہ تا سلنگ کن خیرات و قربانی نا بندوبست کرے نی
en: ...revealed that His love is like a father's love for his son. Through this story God revealed that He made provision for an offering and sacrifice to put an end to the sins of mankind.
en_old: He revealed that His love is like a father's love for his son. Through this story God revealed that He arranged a sacrifice and offering for the forgiveness of mankind's sins.

brh: خدا تینا پاکا کلامٹی نبی تا وسیلہٹ دا ایتے ظاہر کرے کہ او بنی آدم نا گناہ و شکی گری ٹی مڑ کننگ کن اسہ بے گناہ و بندغ ئس مون تروئی و دا بلا قربانی نا ذریعہٹ ایمان اتوکا تے کن خدا تون خڑک مننگ نا
en: God revealed this in His holy word through the prophets: that He would send a sinless man to take away mankind's sin and guilt, and that through this great sacrifice, for those who believe, [the way] to draw near to God...
en_old: God revealed in His holy word through the prophets that He would send a sinless man to die for the sins and wrongdoing of mankind, and through this great sacrifice, for those who believe, [a way] of drawing near to God...

brh: او گلیل نا شار کفر نا او مٹ بس او ہر نیما غا رومی تا حکومت ئس او مخلوق خدا
en: He came to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. On every side there was the rule of the Romans, and the people [were waiting for] God's ...
en_old: And the city of Galilee became a place of unbelief, and in every region the Romans ruled, and the people [waited for] God's...

brh: دانا مقرر کرو کنا انتظار اٹ اسو کہ او اوفتے ظلم آن بچیفے
en: ... appointed one; they were waiting for him to save them from oppression.
en_old: They were waiting for His appointed one to save them from oppression.

brh: دا دا کرائی تو متو گڑا اسپائے ننے گڑا تو کس ایت کے عیسی ننے پائے
en: If he does this, this... then nothing happened; then... then who will give to us? Let Jesus tell us.
en_old: If he does this... then who will give us... Jesus tells us.

brh: اسے وخت اسے را بندغ بلہ عبادت خانہ غا عبادت کننگ کن ہنار
en: Once, two men went to the great house of worship to pray.
en_old: Once two men went up to the temple to pray.

brh: اوفتے آن اسٹ ئس فریسی او ایلو محصول مچ کروکو ئس سسکے فریسی فرقہ نا بندغ جتا تنیا سلیس او دعا کریسہ پارے ئے خدائی نا شکر ادا کیوہ کہ ئے لالچی او بندغ ئس افٹ بے ایمانی او کاریم کپرا زناکار ئس افٹ
en: One of them was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector. The man of the Pharisee sect stood apart by himself and, praying, said: 'O God, I give you thanks that I am not a greedy man; I do not do dishonest work; I am not an adulterer.'
en_old: One of them was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector. The man of the Pharisee sect stood apart by himself and prayed, saying, 'O God, I thank you that I am not a greedy man, I do not do dishonest work, and I am not an adulterer.'

brh: ئے شکر ادا کیوہ کہ دا محصول مچ کروکا بندغ آنبار افٹ ئے ہفتہ ٹی ارا دے روچ آتے خیوہ او تینا آمدنی نا دہمیکو بشخ نی ایتیوہ ولے محصول مچ کروکا سے کنڈا سلیس و دعا کریسا پارے
en: 'I give thanks that I am not like this tax-collecting man. I fast two days in the week, and I give you a tenth part of my income.' But the tax collector stood off in a corner and, praying, said:
en_old: 'I thank you that I am not like this tax collector. I fast two days a week and I give you a tenth of my income.' But the tax collector stood off to one side and prayed, saying,

brh: ئے لائقہ پٹکنے ہن دعا کیو ئے گناہگار اٹھ ئے خدا دا گناہگار انگا بندہ غا ترس کم ئے نومے پاوا اولی بندہ غنا ایراٹمی کو بندہ غنا گناہ تے خدا معاف کرے انت کہ ہرا بندہ تنے عزت والا چائک خدا اودے بے عزت کیک او ہرا بندہ تنے کم عزت والا
en: Feeling unworthy, he prays thus: 'I am a sinner. O God, have mercy on this sinful servant.' I tell you, of the first man and the second man, it was the second man's sins that God forgave, because whoever considers himself honorable, God will dishonor him, and whoever [considers] himself of little honor,
en_old: He would not even lift his eyes, but prayed: 'O God, I am a sinner; O God, have mercy on this sinful servant.' I tell you, God forgave the sins of the second man, not the first, for whoever considers himself honorable, God will humble, and whoever considers himself of little honor,

brh: چائے خدا اودے عزت ایتک۔ نم دا کشتیئے دیر ئنا نیامٹی دبو۔ او مچے ہلنگ کن تینا جال تے دیرٹی بٹبو۔ او خواجہ نن درست مچے ہلنگ کن جال آتے دیرٹی بٹین ولے ہچ ملتئو۔
en: ... considers, God will give him honor. 'Take this boat out into the middle of the water, and cast your nets into the water to catch fish.' 'Master, the whole night we cast the nets into the water to catch fish, but we got nothing.'
en_old: God will exalt him. Put this boat out into the middle of the water, and cast your nets into the water to catch fish. 'Master, we cast our nets into the water all night, but we caught nothing.'

brh: ولے ئے تینا چالی تیرٹی بیٹو اٹ انتئے کہ نی پاسہ یعقوب یوانہ
en: But I will cast my nets into the water, because you say so. James, John!
en_old: But I am sitting in my boat, because you say, James, John...

brh: یعقوب، یو نا، تینا کستی ء تکا۔
en: James, John, [bring] your boat!
en_old: James, John, pull in your boat.

brh: او منا بندغت کبو، او منا بندغت کبو، تو، ہننگ کپنے، نن مصروف آن ہا باز، باز مہر
en: Help us, help us! Then... we can't go, we are busy... Thank you very, very much.
en_old: Help me, help me... so, we can't go, we are very busy, much love.

brh: خواجہ کنا خورکانیں ئے گناہ گار بندہ غسیوٹ
en: Master, go away from me; I am a sinful man.
en_old: Master, go away from me, I am a sinful man.

brh: نی خلیپہ، خدا نا کلام ایلو مخلوق آ تیان اسہ سفت اسے۔
en: Do not be afraid; [you will bring] God's word to other people.
en_old: Do not be afraid; God's word is a blessing for other people.

brh: کنا ہیتاتے بنبو، کنا شاگرد مبو، اونم ہمیشنا زندگی ئس حاصل کیرے۔ ہمو وخت اسکان کہ موقع ارے تو خدانا کسرہ بابو او اونا مدد تے خواہبو۔ ئے گناہگاراک تینا گناہ تے الیبو او گناہ نا بارہ وٹ سوچ کپبو او پدی خدانا کسرہ بابو۔
en: Listen to my words, become my disciples, and you will gain eternal life. As long as there is opportunity, come to God's path and ask for his help. O sinners, leave your sins and do not think about sin, and then come to God's path.
en_old: Listen to my words, become my disciples, and you will gain eternal life. While there is still a chance, come to God's way and ask for His help. O sinners, leave your sins and do not think about sin, and then come to God's way.

brh: خدا یقینا نمیا رحم کیک او نما گناہ تے معاف کیک تاکہ نم خوشی اٹ تینا زندگی ء گدریفنگ کیرے او خدا بغیر پریشانی اٹ نما رہنمائی کیک او بننگو او داڑیکو ہور
en: God will surely have mercy on you and forgive your sins, so that you can spend your life in happiness, and God will guide you without trouble, both in the [life] to come and here as well.
en_old: God will surely have mercy on you and forgive your sins, so that you may live your life in happiness, and God will guide you without worry, both now and hereafter.

brh: عیسی عیسی عرض کیوہ کنا مسڑے بچف خواجہ رحم کرک اونا عمر صرف دوازدہ سال ئے او کینگٹی ئے خواجہ خدا کنتو بر یا یار کنے افسوس ئے عیسی نا مسڑ کسک
en: Jesus, Jesus, I beg you, save my daughter! Master, have mercy, she is only twelve years old and she is dying. Master, for God's sake, come with me! ... Jairus, I am sorry ... your daughter has died.
en_old: Jesus, Jesus, I beg you, save my daughter! Master, have mercy, she is only twelve years old and she is dying. Master, come with me... Friend, I am sorry, your daughter has died.

en: [She has died.] Now don't trouble Jesus [to come] to the house. Don't be afraid. Just have faith, and she will be saved.
en_old: Your daughter is now dead; do not trouble Jesus and the teacher anymore. Do not be afraid. Just believe, and she will be saved.

brh: اوخ پبو چنا کستنے بلکہ خاچانے
en: Do not weep; the child has not died, she is only asleep.
en_old: Do not weep; the child is not dead but asleep.

brh: مسڑ بش مئے
en: Girl, get up.
en_old: Girl, get up.

en: Give the girl something to eat. Don't tell anyone about this. After this, Jesus saw a tax collector named Levi, sitting in the office.
en_old: Give the girl something to eat. Don't tell anyone about this. After this Jesus saw a tax collector named Levi sitting in the tax office.

en: Tax collector.
en_old: Tax collector.

en: Sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty. Two more for me. What do you mean? You, two more. Woe to you, that you are rich now; you have spent your days of comfort.

en: ...that I had to be at my father's place? Then Jesus went with them to the town of Nazareth. Jesus kept growing, becoming big and wise. His honor rose high before God and people.

en: ...the prophet's book it is written that someone, calling out from a desolate place, said: Make a road for the Lord God, make his road straight
en_old: wrote in the book of the prophet that a voice calls out from the wilderness, saying: Prepare the way for the Lord God, make his paths straight.

en: Make it. Pits, hills and mountains will be made level, every mountain and slope will be made level, and the crooked roads will become straight.
en_old: Every ravine, mountain and hill shall be made level, every hill and slope made even, and the crooked roads shall be made straight.

brh: او شے برزنگا کسراک برابر کننگرے، او ہر بندہ خدا نا نجات تروکائے خنک، ننا باوکے ہاو پاننے انت کروئی مرے، او نم منافقاک، دا انت خواسہ کننگرے، با با ہرا کسرے؟
en: And the high roads will be made level, and every person will see the one who gives God's salvation. Our father, yes, tell us what we should do? O you hypocrites, what is it you want to do? Baba, which way?
en_old: And the rough roads shall be made smooth, and every person shall see God's Savior. Father, tell us, what should we do? You hypocrites, what is it you want to do? Sir, which way?

brh: ہر کس تون کہ ایرا کوسرے اوفتیان اسٹ ئس دادے ایتیبو او ہر کس تون کننگ کین ارے بشخیبوتے واجہ
en: Whoever has two coats, give one of them to this one, and whoever has something to eat, share it. Sir,

en: We are tax collectors, how should we do it? However much has been fixed, do not collect more than that. And we, what...
en_old: We are tax collectors, what should we do? Don't collect more than what has been fixed. And what about us?

brh: ننے انت کروئی مرے؟ نم کسہ سیان زورٹ پیسہ ہلپبو، او کسہ سے تون دروغ تڑپبو، تینا تنخواہ ہٹ گزارہ کبو۔
en: What should we do? Do not take money from anyone by force, do not tell lies to anyone, and get by on your own salary.
en_old: What should we do? Don't take money from anyone by force, don't falsely accuse anyone, and be content with your wages.

brh: ننے پا انت نی خدا نا نائب ئس ئے نمے دیر اٹ بے شولنگ اٹی اٹ، ولے اسٹ ئس بننگ اٹی ئے

en: who is higher than me; I am not even equal to his feet. He will come and give you something, the power of God's Holy Spirit. He will come, and it is in his hand, so that he may properly gather the grain into his own granary
en_old: who is greater than me; I am not even worthy of his sandals. He will come and give you the power of God's Holy Spirit. He comes, and it is in his hand, so that he gathers the wheat well into his barn

en_old: They saw the mother sitting there and the child lying in the manger. After this they were the first to tell the story to others. A week later, the child was circumcised.

en: ...time came, and he was named Jesus. Then Mary and Joseph took the child to present him before the Lord. In the temple there was a good and righteous man upon whom God's Holy Spirit had come; [God] had promised him that he would not die until he had seen God's appointed one.
en_old: When the time came, he was named Jesus. Then Mary and Joseph brought the child to present him to the Lord. In the temple there was a good and righteous man on whom the Holy Spirit of God had come. God had promised him that he would not die until he had seen God's appointed one.

brh: او نا پن شمعون ئس ئے خدانی، تینا اقرار ء پورا کریسس، داسہ کہن کہ تیار اٹ۔ ئے تینا خنتٹی نجات تروک ء خناٹ۔
en: His name was Simeon. 'O God, you have fulfilled your promise. Now I am ready to die, for I have seen the Savior with my own eyes.'
en_old: His name was Simeon. O God, you have kept your promise. Now I am ready to die, because I have seen the Savior with my own eyes.

brh: کنے ہی راہی کریس تے، دا نمے برکت ایتے، ہرا وخت آ کہ موسی نا شریعت
en: '[Now] send me on my way. May this [child] bring you blessing.' When, according to the law of Moses,
en_old: Now send me on my way. May this bring you blessing. When, according to the law of Moses,

brh: ت نا مطابق کل رسماتے پورا کریر۔ تو یروشلم آن واپس ناصرت آ اینار۔ ہرا وخت آ عیسی نا عمر دوازدہ سال مس تو یوسف و مریم بچہ فنگ نا عید
en: they had fulfilled all the rites according to the law, they returned from Jerusalem to Nazareth. When Jesus was twelve years old, Joseph and Mary, for the feast of Passover,
en_old: they had fulfilled all the rites according to the law, they returned from Jerusalem to Nazareth. When Jesus was twelve years old, Joseph and Mary, for the feast of Passover,

brh: اودے یروشلم آ دریر۔ عید خلاص مس، اوف کراغا راہی مسر، ولے عیسی یروشلم اٹی سلیس۔ اوف اودے پٹنگ کن پدی یروشلم آ ہنار۔ مسٹ
en: took him to Jerusalem. The feast ended and they set off for home, but Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. They went back to Jerusalem to look for him. On the thi-
en_old: took him to Jerusalem. When the feast was over, they set off for home, but Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. They went back to Jerusalem to look for him. Three...

brh: امیکو دے اوف چنائے بزرگاتے تون خنار۔ درو سوالہ رفوقہ دنا چنائے؟ دا نصرت ناسی۔ ننا خیال ئس کہ دنن تونی۔ دارا نن معافی خواہنہ۔ رافکو دے بنغور۔
en: -rd day they found the child with the elders. 'Who is this child who asks such questions?' 'He is from Nazareth. We thought he was with us. For this we ask your forgiveness.' '…days they listened [to him]…' [partly unclear]
en_old: On the third day they found the child with the elders. Is this the child who asks so many questions? He is from Nazareth. We thought he was with us. We ask your forgiveness. ...day...

brh: اوفک اہران مسور؟ بچہ نی ننتو انتئے دن کریس؟ نا باوا او اینے انت انت جدر اٹ پٹار۔ نم کنے انتئے پٹارے؟ نمے خبر الو؟
en: They were amazed. 'Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have searched for you in such distress.' 'Why were you looking for me? Didn't you know?'
en_old: Where have you been? Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been searching for you anxiously. Why were you looking for me? Didn't you know?

brh: دا میر منے خواہ پاک ضرور گنوک اسے افسوس نیا کہ داسہ مخر سے انتئے کہ او غوس پدا
en: This rich man... is surely a madman. Woe to you who are laughing now, because you will weep afterwards.
en_old: This rich man... is surely a fool. Woe to you who laugh now, because you will weep later.

brh: دا سے کل بندغاک نما بارہ وٹ جوان ہیت کیرے۔ اندا ہیتاتے مست نا بندغاک دروغ نا نبی تے پاریسو۔ ولے ئے نمے پاننگ خواوہ، دشمن تتون محبت کبو۔
en: Now all people speak well about you. The people of former times said these same things about the false prophets. But I want to tell you: love your enemies.
en_old: Now all people speak well of you. Their forefathers said such things about the false prophets. But I want to tell you: love your enemies.

brh: نفرت کروکا تے تو جوانی کبو اوفتے نیکینگا دعا اتیبو اراف نومے بد دعا اتیرا
en: Do good to those who hate you; give good prayers for those who give you curses.
en_old: Do good to those who hate you, pray for good for those who curse you.

brh: اگر کسس چپلیس خلے نومے، تو نم ایلو نیمہء اوڑا کبو۔ اگر کسس گڈیء نا خوائے، تو دے تینا ہوسے مستی
en: If someone strikes you with a slap, then turn the other side to him as well. If someone wants your coat, then give him your shirt too.
en_old: If someone slaps you on the cheek, turn the other cheek to him as well. If someone wants your cloak, give him your shirt as well.

brh: اگر کسس نیان خوائے او دے ہمو گڑا ایتے، اگر کسس نمان گڑا تے خوائے اوڑان واپس خواپوتے
en: If someone asks something of you, give him that thing; if someone asks for things from you, do not ask for them back from him.
en_old: If someone asks something of you, give it to him; if someone takes things from you, do not ask for them back.

brh: اندن کبو دن کہ تینکے سوچ کیرے اگر نم تینا مہر کروکا تون مہر کیرے تو انت احسانس مروئی
en: Act in the way you think of for yourselves. If you love those who love you, what favour would that be?
en_old: Treat others the way you would want for yourself. If you love those who love you, what favor is that?

brh: انتئے کہ گناہگار ہم تینا مہر کروکا تتون مہر کیرے، او گہ جوانی کروکا تا بدل اٹ جوان سلوک کیرے، تو برکت نا حقدار امر مریرے۔ دا وڑ تو گناہگار ہم کیرے۔ دا او دے وڑ دو خلک۔
en: Because sinners too love those who love them, and if you treat well in return those who do good, then how will you be worthy of blessing? Sinners also do it this way. This one touched him in this way.
en_old: Because even sinners love those who love them, and if you do good to those who do good to you, how do you deserve a blessing? Even sinners do the same.

brh: دا ورتون تکیت کرے شرم نا وجہ آن ئنا دشمن تے تو مہر کبو اوفتا خیر ء
en: He insisted in this way: out of shame... love your enemies, [wish] them well...
en_old: He stressed this: love your enemies, and wish them well

brh: خوابو، وام تننگ آن پد واپس خوافبو تے۔ خدا داناسے بھلو بدلاسے تک۔ ہندن نم خدا نا مار پاننگرے۔ انتئے کہ او ناشکر و بے غیرت آتا زی آ مہربان ء۔ رحم کبو، ہمک کہ خدا رحم
en: [wish them well]; after giving a loan, do not ask it back. God will give a great reward for this. Then you will be called children of God, because he is kind to the ungrateful and the shameless. Be merciful, just as God is merciful.
en_old: lend, and after lending do not ask for it back. God will give you a great reward for this. Then you will be called sons of God, because he is kind to the ungrateful and the shameless. Be merciful, just as God is merciful

brh: ننے بچی فیسا ئے کشرے تو نما ہمے وقت پیش تمور الزام خلیرے نمے آ ہم الزام لگگے
en: If you pass judgment, then at that very time it will come out against you; if you accuse, accusation will be laid on you too.
en_old: If you judge others, at that same time you will be judged; if you accuse others, you will be accused as well.

brh: معاف کیرے، نومے معاف کننگک، ننے تینا کسرے نشان ایٹ خواجہ خدا، ایتیبو نومے ہم تننگک
en: If you forgive, you will be forgiven. Show us your way, Lord God. Give, and it will be given to you too.
en_old: Forgive, and you will be forgiven. Lord God, show us your way. Give, and it will be given to you too.

brh: ارایت اتیٹ کٹ کیرے نم کہ ام کٹکاننگے کور کورے کسر نشان تننگ کپک اگہ دن مست آ توم آ کٹ اٹ تمور نی تینا سنگت نا خن تا بوش نظر بریک ولے
en: With whatever measure you measure, you will be measured with it too. A blind man cannot show the way to a blind man; if so, they would both fall into a pit. You see the speck in your friend's eye, but...
en_old: Do not judge, and you will not be judged. A blind man cannot show the way to a blind man; if he did, both of them would fall into a pit. You notice the speck in your friend's eye, but…

brh: خواجہ رہنمائی کر داسہ نن نی خوانا خواجہ خدا خوش قسمت ئے ہمو لمہ کہ نی انبارو مار ودی کرینے بختاور اوفک ارا کہ خدانا پیغامہ بنرہ او عمل
en: Lord, guide us; now we call on you, Lord God. Fortunate is the mother who gave birth to a son like you. Blessed are those who hear God's message and act [on it].
en_old: Lord, guide us; now we call on you, Lord God. Blessed is the mother who gave birth to a son like you. Blessed are those who hear God's message and act on it.

brh: دادے درستی راستی نا ضرورت ہی نا خیال اٹ این تو خدا نا مقرر کروک مننگ کیک
en: There is need to get acquainted with this man; in my view he may be the one appointed by God.
en_old: Considering all this and the need for truth, he may be the one appointed by God.

brh: دا فریسی عیسی ء تینا اوراغ آ دعوت تس عیسی اونا اوراغ آ ہنا اراغ کننگ کن توس نوم دا کائم بچو نا بلنگ اٹ افیرے
en: This Pharisee invited Jesus to his house. Jesus went to his house and sat down to eat. You (pl.) are not... [rest unclear].
en_old: This Pharisee invited Jesus to his house. Jesus went to his house and sat down to eat. … not …

brh: نمبو شاباش دا گرانا گرا شرارت تو زرو کیرے دا تاڑینت کنے گٹیے کنے خبر اف
en: Bravo to you! You are surely making serious mischief... this one is watching... I don't know.
en_old: Well done to you! This is serious mischief. … I don't know.

brh: آکا دا واکے
en: Brother, this one... really.
en_old: Brother, this is it.

brh: ئے پیغمبر اسیتو او پو مرے کہ دا نیاڑی کہ اودے دو خلنگاٹی ئے اخہ گناہگار زندگی ئس گدریفنگاٹی ئے شمعون، ئے دا نیاڑی ئے چاوے، ئے نی گڑاس پاوے
en: If he were a prophet, he would understand what a sinful life this woman who is touching him has been living. Simon! I know this woman. I will tell you something.
en_old: If he were a prophet, he would know that the woman touching him is living a sinful life. Simon, do you see this woman? I have something to say to you.

brh: اسے قرض تروکا اسے بندغے قرض تس اسٹ اسے پنچ سد چاندی نا او ایلوئے پنجاہ چاندی نا روپئی تس ہڑتوما قرضے ترنگ کتوور ہندا خاطر آن او اوفتے معاف کرے دیر زیات قرض تروکان خوش مریک کنا خیال اٹ ہمو ہراٹی زیات معاف کننگانے نی راست پاریس
en: A lender gave a loan to people: to one five hundred in silver, and to the other he gave fifty silver rupees. Neither could repay the loan, and for that reason he forgave them. Which of them will be happier with the lender? In my view, the one who has been forgiven more. You have said rightly.
en_old: A moneylender lent money to two people: one owed five hundred silver coins and the other fifty. Neither of them could pay him back, so he forgave them both. Which of them will be happier with the moneylender? I think the one who was forgiven more. You are right.

brh: دا نیاڑی ہناس، ارا وخت آ اینا وراغہ بسوٹ، نی کنا نت تا سلنگ کے دیر ہم کنے تتویس، ولے دا نیاڑی کنا نت تا تینا خڑینک تتو سلا، او تینا پجھتا تو بارفے تا۔
en: You see this woman. When I came to your house, you did not even give me water for washing my feet, but this woman washed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair.
en_old: Do you see this woman? When I came to your house, you didn't give me any water to wash my feet, but this woman washed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair.

brh: ئے بسٹ نی کنے خمب کتویس، ولے دانے اڑے کنا نتاتے بکھل کو دیسکا ہلنگٹی ئے نی کنا کاٹم کے تیل تتویس، ولے دانے اڑے کنا نت تے عطرٹ سلا، ولے ئے نی پاوے
en: When I came, you did not kiss me, but look, this one has been kissing my feet ever since; you did not put oil on my head, but look, this one washed my feet with perfume. But I tell you...
en_old: When I came, you did not kiss me, but this woman has not stopped kissing my feet since I came in. You did not put oil on my head, but she has washed my feet with perfume. But you say…

brh: اونا باز گناہک معاف کننگانو، ہندا خاطران او باز محبت کننگٹی ئے ولے ارانا کم گناہک معاف کننگانو، او محبت کم کیک۔
en: Her many sins have been forgiven; for this reason she is loving much. But the one whose sins forgiven are few loves little.
en_old: Her many sins have been forgiven, and that is why she loves so much. But whoever has been forgiven little loves little.

brh: نا کل گناہک معاف مسر نا ایمان نی جوڑ کرے نی خدا حافظ
en: All your sins are forgiven. Your faith has made you well. Go with God.
en_old: All your sins are forgiven. Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.

brh: عیسی شار شار خلق خلق خدا نا بادشاہی نا پڑو کرسا ہنا اورتون دوازدہ خاص انگا شاگردات او منا ناڑی کہ اوفتہ جنات تے کشنگ
en: Jesus went from town to town and village to village, announcing the kingdom of God. With him were the twelve special disciples and some women from whom jinn had been driven out.
en_old: Jesus went from town to town and village to village, proclaiming the kingdom of God. With him were the twelve special disciples and some women he had freed from demons.

brh: مریم کہ مگدلینی پاننگے، یوآنا ہیرودس نا دیوان خوزہ نا زائفہ، او سوسنا۔
en: Mary, who is called Magdalene; Joanna, the wife of Chuza, Herod's steward; and Susanna.
en_old: Mary, who is called Magdalene; Joanna, the wife of Chuza, Herod's steward; and Susanna.

brh: گورنر ایرودس مسیت اسٹ نا ایلمن تلاغ ترفیسس و برام کریسس تا۔ یا یا اودے
en: Governor Herod had caused his own brother's [wife] to be divorced and had married her. Yahya [John] ... him...
en_old: Governor Herod had taken his brother's wife and married her. … him.

brh: مانا کریسوس او ایرودس یا یا یا جیلٹی بندی کریسوس راست را وقت نا چار نا پارٹی غا بسون تو بندغاک اسہ جنازہ ئس دننگٹی اسور ہمو مردہ جنازہ نا سینہ غا سیٹنگا مار ئس پیسا غونا لمہ غا اوغنگا خنا تو اونا
en: [John] had forbidden it, and Herod had put Yahya [John] in jail. When we came to the ... of the town, people were carrying a funeral bier. On that dead man's bier lay a young son; then he saw his mother weeping, and his...
en_old: They had … and Herod had put him in prison. When he came to the town gate, people were carrying a funeral. On the bier lay a dead young man, and his mother was crying. When he saw her, his…

brh: خنک خڑینگی بسور او کفن اتہ دو خلکو پارے ورنا ئے نی حکم ایتیوہ بش م پدا مردہ بش مس توس او عیسی اودے اونا لمہ ات تس عارف پا نی خدا نا مقرر کروکا ئس کہ آیا پارے سوس
