en: eyes filled with tears, and he touched the shroud and said, 'Young man, I command you: get up!' Then the dead man got up and sat, and Jesus gave him to his mother. 'Ask him: are you the one appointed by God, who [was to come]?' he said...
en_old: eyes filled with tears. He touched the shroud and said, "Young man, I command you: get up!" The dead man got up and sat up, and Jesus gave him back to his mother. "Ask him: are you the one appointed by God," he said…

brh: یا پین کسس بریک
en: or will someone else come?
en_old: or will someone else come?

brh: خواجہ، یا یا ننے رفنگ کے راہی کرینے، کنے ہمو بندغ ئس کہ
en: Lord, Yahya [John] has sent us to ask: [are you] that person who...
en_old: Lord, he has sent us to ask you: are you the one who…

brh: ایرا دے بروئے، یا پین کس نی کسرے اورن، ارا گڑا تے خنارے او بنگرے، یا ہی ہپ ہاپ او، کورا خنرے، لنگا کینکرے، خوش قسمت اوف کہ کنا زیا شک کپسے۔
en: ...the one who is to come, or should we wait for someone else? — Tell John the things you have seen and heard: the blind see, the lame walk. Blessed are those who do not doubt me.
en_old: Whoever comes, or anyone else on your way, tell them the things they have seen and heard: the blind see and the lame walk. Blessed is the one who does not doubt me.

brh: کنے ارف بو۔ کوپہ غاتے تلٹ۔ داسہ کنے کسے۔ کنے اسو نظر بننگٹی ئے اسہ زمیندار ئس غولم تسی۔
en: Lift me up! Onto the shoulders. Now me! ...I'm seeing... A farmer was sowing wheat.
en_old: Listen to me. Look at the fields. Now listen to me. A farmer went out to sow seed.

brh: او گپ ایش تما۔ ہر وخت او بجاتے ڈغارتے چھٹ تیس گلاس اوفتے آن کسر اٹ تما۔ او باز انگاتے مخلوق لتاڑ او چکاک کننگر۔ گلاس خالی آ ڈغار اٹ تما۔ وخت ئس آن پد فصل
en: He... (unclear) fell. As he was scattering the seeds on the ground, some of them fell on the path. People trampled many of them and birds ate them. Some fell on bare ground. After a while the crop...
en_old: He scattered the seed. As he scattered the seeds on the ground, some fell on the path. People trampled many of them, and birds ate them. Some fell on bare ground. After a while the crop…

brh: اسہ خروالے اوفتے مسہ لوہ اندا خاطر آن باریسو۔ باز انگا بج جک جرا تٹ تمار۔ ولے جراک زوبلون مسو او خولومے ڈکار۔ گڑاس بج جوانی گا ڈغار تے آ تمار۔ فصل درک کرے او اسہ دانہ غان
en: ...they were scorched (?) and so they withered for that reason. Many seeds fell among the thorn bushes, but the bushes quickly grew big and smothered the wheat. Some seeds fell on good ground. The crop came up, and from one grain...
en_old: A farmer scattered them for this purpose. Many seeds fell on rocky ground. They sprouted quickly, but the seedlings withered. Some seeds fell on good soil. The crop grew, and from one grain…

brh: باز دانا جوڑ مسر۔ خواجہ، دا مثال نا انت مانی ء؟ وختس مچے خڑک مریک۔ خدا نا پوسکننگا پیغام نا ڈکوک آ ہیت آک نمے پو کننگ اٹی ء۔ ولے ایلو مخلوق ء مثال تاتی پاننگ ء کہ مخلوق ہورے ولے توجہ تف سے، او بنرے ولے پو مف سے۔
en: ...many grains were produced. Master, what is the meaning of this parable? A time is drawing a little nearer. The hidden matters of God's new message are being made clear to you. But to the other people it is told in parables, so that the people look but do not pay attention, and they hear but do not understand.
en_old: …yielded many grains. Master, what does this parable mean? Once a crowd gathers near. The hidden things of God's new message are being made clear to you. But to other people it is told in parables, so that they look but pay no attention, and they hear but do not understand.

brh: دا مثال نا مطلب دادے
en: The meaning of this parable is this.
en_old: This is the meaning of this parable.

brh: بجاک خدا نا پیغام او۔ کسر اٹ تموکا بجاک ہمو بندغاکو کہ پیغام ء بنیرہ ولے ابلیس اوتا است تیان پیغام ء کشک۔
en: The seeds are God's message. The seeds that fell on the path are those people who hear the message, but the devil pulls the message out of their hearts.
en_old: The seeds are God's message. The seeds that fell on the path are the people who hear the message, but the devil takes the message out of their hearts.

brh: تاکہ اوفتے ایمان مف او اوفتا نجات مف۔ بجا کہ خلیا ڈغار تیا تمار ہمو بندغاک او کہ اوف خدا نا کلام ء خوشی اٹ بنیرہ او ایمان تخیرہ ولے روتا ہلپسہ۔
en: ...so that they do not come to faith and are not saved. The seeds that fell on rocky ground are those people who hear God's word with joy and believe, but do not put down roots.
en_old: So that they will not believe and will not be saved. The seeds that fell on rocky ground are the people who hear God's word with joy and believe, but do not put down roots.

brh: ولے آزمائش نا وخت آ ایمان آن ہرسنگرے۔ بیج آ کہ جڑ تا تہٹی تما، اوڑان مراد ہمو بندغاکو کہ بنرے ولے دنیا نا فکر مال و مڈی و زند نا آسراتیک اوفتے زور مریرے۔ اوفتا بھرم اسل بسپک۔
en: But at the time of testing they turn back from the faith. The seed that fell among the thorn bushes means those people who hear, but the worries of the world, wealth and possessions, and the comforts of life overpower them. They never bear fruit.
en_old: But in a time of testing they turn away from their faith. The seed that fell among the thorns means the people who hear, but the worries of the world, wealth and the hopes of life overpower them. Their fruit never ripens.

brh: او ارا بیجک جوانینگا ڈغارٹی تمار ہمو بندغاک او را پیغام ء بنرے او ایمانے تینا استاتیٹی تخرے اندن کہ خولم جوان و فصل ایتک
en: And the seeds that fell on good ground are those people who hear the message and keep faith in their hearts, just as good wheat yields a crop.
en_old: And the seeds that fell on good soil are the people who hear the message and keep faith in their hearts, so the seed is good and yields a crop.

brh: کس ئس ہم چراغ ئس لگیفے او نا زی آ کاسہ یا اودے کٹ نا کیرا غا تخپک بلکہ ہموڑے تخک تے اراڑے اراٹی آسانی اٹ روشنائی مرے ارا گڑا ڈکو کے روشنائی ٹی پاش مریک ہندن ارا ایتاک بندغ نا استاٹی ڈکو کو اوفک
en: No one lights a lamp and puts a bowl over it or puts it under the bed; rather, he puts it where it can easily give light in the house. Whatever is hidden becomes visible in the light. Likewise, whatever words are hidden in a person's heart, they...
en_old: No one lights a lamp and then puts a bowl over it or puts it under the bed. Instead they put it where it can easily light up the house. Whatever is hidden becomes visible in the light. In the same way, whatever words are hidden in a person's heart…

brh: ساحر مرے نی خیال کبو ہرا بندہ کنا ایتا تیا یقین تخک خدا اودے پین پوم مننگ نا طاقت ایتک، ولے ہرا بندہ کہ یقین تخنگ نا کوشش تے کپک خدا اودے طاقت تفک، خواجہ نا لمہ و ایلم نی کے پیشن سلوکو نی تو
en: Be careful (?) and pay attention: whoever believes my words, God gives him the power to understand more; but whoever does not try to believe, God does not give him that power. — Master, your mother and brothers are standing outside for you, [wanting to see] you.
en_old: Be careful and consider: whoever believes my words, God gives the power to understand more. But whoever does not try to believe, God does not give that power. Master, your mother and brothers are standing outside for you…

brh: ملنگ خواری کنا لمہ و ایلمہ کمو توار آ خدا نا ہیتے بنرے او یقین تخرے۔ اسہ دے عیسی تینا شاگرد آتے تو
en: ...my mother and brothers are those who hear God's word and believe it. One day Jesus, with his disciples...
en_old: …my mother and brothers are those who quietly listen to God's words and believe them. One day Jesus, with his disciples…

brh: ننا وار کشتی ٹی توس۔ اوفتے پارے جھیل نا ایلو کنارا رخ آ ہنبو۔ ہرا وخت آ کشتی راہی مس، عیسی خاچا۔
en: ...sat in the boat. He told them, 'Let's go toward the other shore of the lake.' When the boat set off, Jesus fell asleep.
en_old: Once we were sitting in the boat. He told them to head toward the other shore of the lake. When the boat set off, Jesus fell asleep.

brh: خواجہ او خواجہ خواجہ عیسی نن کائنگٹیون نن پٹلنگٹیون نن کل ڈپالے ننا نی بچف خواجہ
en: Master! O Master, Master Jesus, we are dying, we are going under, we are all drowning! Save us, Master!
en_old: Master, O Master, Master Jesus, we are dying, we are drowning, we are all sinking. Save us, Master!

brh: نما ایمانا رنگا
en: Where is your faith?
en_old: Where is your faith?

brh: ایسا خدا تعالی نا مار نی ننے ننت خواسہ ننت خواست کینہ کہ ننے سزائے
en: Jesus, Son of God Most High, what do you want from us? We beg you not to punish us...
en_old: Jesus, Son of God Most High, what do you want from us? We beg you not to punish us.

brh: دا تفے نا پنتیرے لشکر خواجہ خدا منت کینے ننے
en: What is your name? — Legion. Master, for God's sake, we beg you... us...
en_old: What is your name? Legion. Master, we beg you…

brh: کڈہ سیٹ شاہ پی ننیا خواست کینے او کما تے نیامٹی ہننگ کے ہلی
en: ...(unclear) we beg you, let us go among those pigs.
en_old: …we beg you to let us go among those pigs.

brh: اوہ واپس مبو سیفو سیفو پدا جنی
en: Oh, go back! ... (unclear) ... the demon again!
en_old: Oh, go back… again the demon…

brh: دا بندغ آن پیش تما مار او اوکا ماتا تئی ٹی نار دا کانمبو او جادوگر ننے الیبو دا جاگہ
en: Come out of this man and go into the pigs! ... Go away from here. O sorcerer, leave us, [leave] this place!
en_old: Come out of this man, you son of the mother of fire, this demon and sorcerer, leave us this place.

brh: دانہ نمبو، دنا رندٹ لیبو، دا کٹ پیشن نمبو، ارا کنے کاسے نیتو بریوے، مہربانی کبو، کنے تینتو دبو
en: Get away from here, (unclear) after him, get out of this place! ...I will come with you. Please, take me with you.
en_old: Leave from here, go behind him, get out of this house, whatever you have nothing to do with me, please, take me with you.

brh: تینا راغب او پبوک خدا نا نام کے انت کرینے
en: [Go back] to your home and tell what God has done for you.
en_old: What have you done for the sake of the name of your Lord and Father God?

brh: عیسی او نا شاگرد آک پد بیت صیدا پنی آ شار آ روانہ مسر
en: Then Jesus and his disciples set out for a town called Bethsaida.
en_old: Then Jesus and his disciples set out for a city called Bethsaida.

brh: ہرا وخت آ مخلوق ء خبر تما، او کنر نا ڈٹی نا اٹ
en: When the people found out, they followed after him.
en_old: When the people found out, they followed him.

brh: نی برو چمپات
en: You, come... (unclear)
en_old: Come, get in.

brh: پترس اوفتے پارے، خواجہ دا بندغاتے اجازت ایتے کہ دا قریئی نا خلقاتے آ کار او تینا کننگ و خاچنگ نا بندوبست کیر، انتئے کہ دا ویران جاہ اسے۔
en: Peter said to him, "Master, give these people permission to go to the villages around here and arrange their own food and lodging, because this is a deserted place."
en_old: Peter said to them, "Lord, give these people permission to go to the surrounding villages and arrange for their own food and lodging, because this is a deserted place."

brh: ولے نمو مفت کننگ کے گڑا ایتے بو؟ نن تون صرف پنچ ایرا کو او ایرا مچے او۔
en: But you give them something to eat. — We have only five loaves and two fish.
en_old: But how can we give them something for free? We have only five loaves and two fish.

brh: مبارکے تو خواجہ خدا
en: Blessed are you, Lord God,
en_old: Blessed be the Lord God.

brh: ارا نا کہ بادشاہ زمینا نراغ پیدا کیک
en: you who are King, who bring forth bread from the earth.
en_old: Whose kingdom brings forth the light of the earth.

brh: زکائی، دڑنگ زوبے، ئے اینو نا مہمان اٹ۔ کلاو راغا؟ دانا اوراٹی دیر رہینگے خوش کے۔ زکائی اسہ غنیمت چائے۔
en: Zacchaeus, come down quickly, today I am [your] guest. [unclear words] Who would stay in this man's house? He is glad; Zacchaeus considers it a great windfall.
en_old: Zacchaeus, come down quickly, I am your guest today. Has everyone come? He stayed long in his house and was happy. Zacchaeus considered it a blessing.

brh: بمبو ئے
en: Listen, I...
en_old: Bambo.

brh: ئے تینا دلوت نا نیمہ سے غریب آتے یا اگہ ئے کسے نا حق کنوٹ تو اونا چار گنائی واپس کیوے
en: I [give] half of my wealth to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone out of what is theirs, I will pay it back fourfold.
en_old: I will give half of my wealth to the poor, and if I have taken anyone's due, I will pay it back four times over.

brh: یقین بفک کہ اسے محصول الو کس
en: I can't believe it, that [he is] a tax collector.
en_old: I can't believe he was a tax collector.

brh: دا وراٹی اینو آسراتی بسنے، انتئے کہ دا بندغ ہم ابراہیم نا مارے، ئے گم
en: Today well-being has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham. I [came for] the lost...
en_old: Today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham. I [came for the] lost.

brh: بمبو نن کل یروشلم آ اینگٹیون ایڑے خدا نا مقرر کروک نا حق
en: Listen, we are all going to Jerusalem; there, regarding the one appointed by God,
en_old: Bambo, we are all going to Jerusalem; there the right of the one appointed by God

brh: کہ نبی تا ذریعہ ٹھار ہیت پورا مریک او غیر قوم تا دوٹی تننگک اوڑا ملنڈ کننگک او نا بے عزتی ء کیرہ اوڑا تف کیرہ او دے چابک خلیرہ او کسفرے تے
en: that the words [given] through the prophets will be fulfilled: he will be handed over to the Gentiles, he will be ridiculed, they will dishonour him, spit on him, whip him and kill him.
en_old: that what was said through the prophets will be fulfilled: he will be handed over to the Gentiles, they will mock him, dishonor him, spit on him, whip him and kill him.

brh: ولے او مسٹمی کو دے پدا بش مریک۔ عیسی ء خبر اسکہ کہ او یروشلم شارٹی بندغاتا گناہ تا خاطر کن کسفنگوئے ولے دارن انکار کتاؤ بلکہ ولدا
en: But on the third day he will rise again. Jesus knew that in the city of Jerusalem he was to be killed for the sake of people's sins, but he did not refuse it; rather, again
en_old: But on the third day he rises again. Jesus knew that he would be killed in the city of Jerusalem for the sake of people's sins, yet he did not refuse it; rather, again

brh: دا ہم یروشلم نا کنڈے نا او نا بننگ اٹ باز آ خوش مسور اوفک اودے تینا بادشاہ جوڑ کننگ خواسورہ
en: These people of the Jerusalem area too were very glad at his coming; they wanted to make him their king.
en_old: These people were also from the area of Jerusalem, and they were very happy at his coming; they wanted to make him their king.

brh: رابی، تینا شاگرداتے چپ مننگ نا حکم ایت، اگہ ئے تینا شاگرداتے چپ کرفیوٹ
en: Rabbi, order your disciples to be quiet. If I make my disciples be quiet,
en_old: Rabbi, order your disciples to be silent. If I silence my disciples

brh: تو دا خلق کنا سفت ء کیرے، ہم عزت صحت
en: then these stones will sing my praise. [unclear: 'also honour, health']
en_old: So these people praise me, and honor and health as well.

brh: عیسی یروشلم نا کنڈا ہرا او نا مخلوق نا زی آ افسوس کرے
en: Jesus looked toward Jerusalem and lamented over its people.
en_old: Jesus looked toward Jerusalem, and he grieved over its people.

brh: افسوس نی ہمودے سلامتی نا کسرے چائسوسہ ولے داسہ اونا خنتین مر مسونے او دے برے کیا وختہ نا دشمنک نا چارمہ کنڈ مورچہ بند مریرے او نی تنگ کیرے
en: Alas, if only you had known on that day the way of peace! But now it has gone hidden from your eyes. The day will come when your enemies will entrench themselves on all four sides of you and hem you in.
en_old: Alas, if only you had known on that day the way of peace, but now it is hidden from your eyes. The day will come when your enemies will set up barricades around you on all four sides and hem you in.

brh: اونا ورائت اباک ایرے اوفک نمے اوننا چناتے کسفیرے او کسس زندے لپسے انتئے کہ ارا وختہ خدا نی جتہ روکا ایرائ کرے نم اونا حکماتے منے توبیرے
en: [unclear words]; they will kill you and your children and will not leave anyone alive, because when God [came to you, unclear], you did not accept his commands.
en_old: Its heirs are there; they will kill you and your children and will not leave anyone alive, because when God came to save you, you did not accept his commands.

brh: یروشلم اٹے بلا عبادت خانہ واپار تا سے جاگہس جوڑ مسوسس
en: In Jerusalem the great house of worship had been made into a place for traders.
en_old: In Jerusalem, the great temple had been turned into a place for merchants.

brh: پنچ، شش، ہفت، ہشت، نو
en: Five, six, seven, eight, nine.
en_old: Five, six, seven, eight, nine.

brh: بست و دو، بست و سہ، بست و چار، بست و پنج
en: Twenty-two, twenty-three, twenty-four, twenty-five.
en_old: Twenty-two, twenty-three, twenty-four, twenty-five.

brh: دا وٹی لکوک ئے کنا ارا عبادت نا جاگہ ئے داڑے دکان تے مخلوق نا لٹنگ کے بلانو رے دا کنا پانڈ تے غنڈہ گردی ئے اوڑے توبہ توبہ نا
en: It is written thus: my house is a place of worship. Here you have made [it] shops for robbing the people. This is thuggery in my [house]... there, God forbid, God forbid...
en_old: It is written: my house is a place of worship. Here you have set up shops to rob the people... this is thuggery in my house, repent, repent!

brh: بلہ ماما کو سردار کو نا خلاف مسر، ہنداکے مخلوق او دے بادشاہ پاریر او توار کریر۔ ئے چاوہ بازنگا بندغاک او دے بادشاہ پاریر او توار کریر۔ بادشاہ؟ بخیرت او دز آتا بادشاہ، دا
en: The chief priests and the leaders turned against him, because the people called him king and shouted. I know many people called him king and shouted. King? Shameless one, king of thieves, this...
en_old: Then the elders and chiefs turned against him. These same people called him king and shouted. I know many people called him king and shouted. King? Shameless one, king of thieves, this one...

brh: اوڑو عباس خان نا نٹ بریرہ بلو ایت کیرہ او کارہ او دماغ ہم پیش تمیرہ بکواس کپے دانا مریدک دے پدی زیات مننگٹی او مخلوقک اونا تعریف ء کیرے او سمجھیرا دا بادشاہ سے اینے آغا کننگ خواہوے
en: Over there they come to the feet of [unclear], they talk big and act, and their minds get carried away too. Don't talk nonsense. His followers are growing day by day, and the people praise him and think he is a king; he will want to make himself master.
en_old: Over there, people come to Abbas Khan's door and make big talk. He acts, and his mind shows too. Don't talk nonsense. His followers are growing day by day, and the people praise him and think he wants to become a king and a master.

brh: اگہ دا بندغ پین کسے نقصان تس تو دانا جواب تروک نی مروس۔ نوا کہ جوان مرے دا سہ وقت ارے کہ گلیلی ء روکنگے۔
en: If this man does harm to anyone else, you will be the one answerable for it. It would be good... now is the time to stop the Galilean.
en_old: If this man harms anyone else, you will be the one held responsible. Better yet, now is the time to stop the Galilean.

brh: تینا بندغاک او ہماماک عیسی نا خلافیت کریر۔ انتئے کہ عیسی اوفتے منافق پاریکہ۔ ہندا خاطر آن منافقاک مستن زیات اونا خلاف مسر۔ ولے باز انگا ایلو یہودیک اونا خوش مسر۔ عیسی عبادت خانہ ٹی اسہ غریب و جنوزان اسے خیسونے راٹ کشاغنگا خنا۔
en: His own people and the priests opposed Jesus, because Jesus called them hypocrites. For this reason the hypocrites turned against him even more than before. But many other Jews were pleased with him. In the house of worship Jesus saw a poor widow putting in two copper coins.
en_old: His own people and the leaders opposed Jesus, because Jesus called them hypocrites. For this reason the hypocrites turned against him even more. But many other Jews were pleased with him. In the temple, Jesus saw a poor widow putting in two small coins.

brh: انت نی تو پین اف اینومے پاوے دا غریب جنوز آن کلہ تیان زیات شاغانے انت کہ ایلوف مال و مڈی نا زیادتی نا نظر کن چندہ شاغار ولے دا غریبی ئے
en: [unclear] I tell you, this poor widow has put in more than all of them, because the others put in donations out of the excess of their wealth, but this one [out of her] poverty...
en_old: Don't you see? I tell you truly, this poor widow has put in more than all of them, because the others gave donations out of their abundance of wealth, but she gave out of her poverty.

brh: انتسس شاغاتے ننے پا نی دا پا انت اختیارٹ کیرے نی دا حق دیر تسنے دا سئی نمے آن سوال ئس ارفیوے یحیی نا وختہ پاک صاف مننگ نا بے شولنگ نا حق خدا نا کنڈان بس یا بندغ نا
en: [unclear] Tell us, by what authority do you do this? Who gave you this right? Now I will ask you a question: in John's time, did the right of cleansing by bathing [baptism] come from God or from man?
en_old: What sign will you show us? Tell us, by what authority do you do this? Who gave you this right? I will also ask you a question: in John's time, did the right to baptize come from God or from man?

brh: نن انت پان، اگر دا خدا نا کنڈ آن ئس تو پائک نی اونا یقین انتئے کتویس، اگر نن پان دا بندغ آن بسوسس دا کل مخلوق ننے خل خلے رے
en: What shall we say? If [we say] it was from God, he will say, 'Why did you not believe him?' If we say it had come from man, all these people will stone us.
en_old: What shall we say? If we say it was from God, he will say, 'Why did you not believe him?' If we say it came from man, all these people will stone us.

brh: انتئے کہ بندہ غاک یحیی نی یحیی پیغمبر اسس۔ ننے خبر اف ارا جاگہ نا اوس۔ گڑا ئے ہم نمے پاپرا کہ دیر کنے دا کاریم تا حق ء تسنے؟
en: Because the people [hold that] John, John was a prophet. We do not know where it was from. Then I too will not tell you who gave me the right to do these things.
en_old: Because the people believe John was a prophet. We do not know where it came from. Then neither will I tell you who gave me the right to do these things.

brh: اسے بندغہ سنگور نا باغس خا
en: A man [planted] a vineyard.
en_old: A man planted a vineyard.

brh: او اودے اجارہ غا تس۔ واسے بلو وختس ایکن اراغان پیش تما۔ ارا وختہ کہ انگور نا فصل بسس تو تینا نوکرس اجارہ دار تے آ مون تس تاکہ اوفتے آن تینا انگور نا بشخ ئے ہلی
en: And he leased it out to tenants and went away from there for a long time. When the grape harvest came, he sent a servant of his to the tenants so that he would take his share of the grapes from them.
en_old: And he leased it out to tenants and went away for a long time. When the grape harvest came, he sent a servant to the tenants so that they would give him his share of the grapes.

brh: ولے اجارہ دار آک او دے خلکر و خالی دو مونی تسو۔ پدا ایلو نوکری مونی تس۔ ولے اجارہ دار آک او دے ہم خلکر و بے عزت کریر و خالی دو راہی کریر۔ ولدا باغ نا مالک مسٹمیکو نوکری راہی کرے اجارہ دار آک او دے ہم خلکر۔
en: But the tenants beat him and sent him back empty-handed. Then he sent another servant. But the tenants beat him too, dishonoured him and sent him away empty-handed. Then the owner of the garden sent a third servant; the tenants beat him too.
en_old: But the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed. Then he sent another servant, but the tenants beat him too, treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty-handed. Then the owner of the vineyard sent a third servant, and the tenants beat him as well.

brh: ٹپی کریر اورا غان مونت سورتیر۔ پدا مالک سوچ کرے ئے انت کیو؟ کنا خیالٹی دا سے ئے تینا مارے رائی کیوے۔ اجارہ داراک اودے ضرور عزت ترو۔ ہرا وخت آ اجارہ داراک مارے بننگا خنار او کسے لوٹے تینا پاریر بابو دادے کسر
en: They wounded him and drove him out from there. Then the owner thought, 'What shall I do? I think I will now send my own son. The tenants will surely show him respect.' When the tenants saw the son coming, they said [among themselves], 'Come, let's kill this one.'
en_old: They wounded him and threw him out of there. Then the owner thought, 'What shall I do? I think I will send my own son. The tenants will surely respect him.' When the tenants saw the son coming, they said to one another, 'Come, let us kill him.'

brh: دا غسفین دا نا جائیداد ننہ مریک۔ پدا انت مس؟ او مارے باغ آن پیشن کشار او دے غسفیر۔ ولے داس انگور نا باغ نا مالک اوفتے تون انت سلوک کیک؟
en: "Let's kill this one, and his property will become ours." Then what happened? They dragged the son out of the vineyard and killed him. Now what will the owner of the vineyard do with them?
en_old: This is the heir; his property will become ours. Then what happened? They threw the son out of the vineyard and killed him. But now what will the owner of the vineyard do to them?

brh: او بریک وفت کسویک و انگور نا باغے پین اجارہ داراتے تیک پدا دا کلام نا معنی انتئے ہرا خلق نا ٹھیکیدار آک رد کریسر ہمو کل آن زیات اہمیت حاصل کرے
en: He will come and kill them and give the vineyard to other tenants. Then what is the meaning of this saying: the stone that the builders had rejected has become more important than everything?
en_old: He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to other tenants. Then what is the meaning of this saying: the one whom the people's builders rejected has become the most important of all?

brh: ہر کس دا خل نا زیتہ موئے او ٹکر ٹکر مروئی او اگر ہفتیا دا خل تما تو مش جوڑ مریرے خواجہ نی راست پاسہ او راستی لتے سہ
en: Whoever falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, and if this stone falls on someone, they will be crushed to dust. Master, you speak truly and teach the truth.
en_old: Everyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, and if this stone falls on anyone, they will be crushed to dust. Master, you speak truly and teach the truth.

brh: نن چانہ کہ نی کس نا طرفداری کپیسہ او نی خدا نا کسر نا تعلیم ایتسہ۔ ننے پا انت رومی حکومت ء جزبہ تننگ ننا شریعت نا مطابق روا ارے یا نہ؟ خواجہ دا ہریفنگ خواہیک؟ کنے؟
en: We know that you do not take anyone's side and that you teach the way of God. Tell us, is it lawful under our law to pay tribute to the Roman government or not? Master... does he want to test me with this? Me?
en_old: We know that you show no partiality and that you teach the way of God. Tell us, is it lawful according to our law to pay taxes to the Roman government or not? Master, who is this trying to trap? Me?

brh: چاندی نا روپئی ئس نشانی ٹی بو۔ دانا ضیاء الدین نا پن چاپ کروکے۔
en: Show a silver coin. The name of [unclear] is printed on it.
en_old: Bring a silver coin as a sign. Whose name is printed on it? Ziauddin's.

brh: محصول شہنشاہ نا ئے اودے شہنشاہ ئے اتبو، او ارا خدا نا او اوفتے خدا ئے اتبو۔ دا سپاتیری رغنائی ت خڑپنی گٹیاس ارا دے؟
en: The tax belongs to the emperor, so give it to the emperor, and what belongs to God, give that to God. The feast of unleavened bread was drawing near, which day...
en_old: Taxes belong to the emperor, so give them to the emperor, and what belongs to God, give to God. Where is this ...?

brh: کہ فصح پاننگاکا عیسی پطرس او یوحنائے راہی کرے کہ نم ہبو او بچافنگ نا عید کے رخت تیار کبو
en: which was called the Passover. Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and get the things ready for the feast of deliverance."
en_old: When the Passover came near, Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and prepare things for the feast of salvation."

brh: مونا کنے آ مصیبت بریک ولے کنا است خواہک کہ دا ایدا نم تو تولیوے ایرا کونیوے دا کان پد ہما وقت اسکان تکمپر اور تانکے بچائفنگ نا آئی
en: Suffering is coming to me ahead, but my heart longs to sit here with you and eat this meal. After this I will not eat until that time when salvation [comes].
en_old: Suffering lies ahead of me, but my heart longs to sit here with you and eat this. After this I will not eat until the time of salvation comes.

brh: دانا سئی مانا پورا متنے
en: until its true meaning is fulfilled.
en_old: until its true meaning is fulfilled.

brh: مبارک اسنی ئے خواجہ دا جہان نا مالک ہرا کہ ٹال آن میوہ ودی کیک داڑان کل نماسے اسے گلم ہلبو انتئے کہ ہمو وقت اسکان کہ قیامت بتنے ئے انگور نا
en: Blessed are you, Lord, master of this world, who brings forth fruit from the vine. All of you take one sip each from this, because until the time that the Day of Judgment has come, of the grape...
en_old: Blessed are you, Lord, master of this world, who brings forth fruit from the vine. All of you, take from this one cup, because until the time the resurrection comes, [I will not drink] of the grape...

brh: جوس کمپرہ مبارک اسنی ئے خواجہ
en: juice I will not drink. Blessed are you, Lord,
en_old: I will not drink the juice. Blessed are you, Lord.

brh: جہان نا بادشاہ ارا کہ ڈغاران ارخ پیدا کیک دا کنا جانے ارا کہ نم کے تننگک
en: King of the world, who brings forth bread from the earth. This is my body, which is given for you.
en_old: King of the world, who brings forth bread from the earth. This is my body, which is given for you.

brh: کنا یات اٹی ہندن کبو دا پیالہ کنا جان نا باری او ئے تینا جان ء خدا کے قربان کیوے
en: Do this in remembrance of me. This cup is for my life; I am sacrificing my life to God.
en_old: Do this in remembrance of me. This cup is for my life; I sacrifice my life to God.

brh: ولے اوربو کنے الو کنا دو کنتو اوار میزٹیو او ئے آدم نا اولیاد کسفنگوے ولے ہمو بندغ اخس بدقسمت دے کہ کنتو غداری کیک
en: But look, the hand of the one who will hand me over is with me at the table. And I, the son of Adam, will be killed, but how unfortunate is that person who betrays me.
en_old: But look, the hand of the one who betrays me is with me on the table. The Son of Man will go, but how unfortunate is that person who betrays me.

brh: ماننگ کپک ماننگ کپک اسل مفک غدار نا پنی پاو خواجہ
en: It can't be, it can't be, it will never happen! Tell us the traitor's name, Master.
en_old: It can't be, it can't be, not at all! Tell us the traitor's name, Master.

brh: ولے ہر کس ئس نومیاں بلونے شیف توریتنے او سردار خدمت کرو کمبار مرے بلون اراسٹے
en: But whoever among you is great should lower himself, and the leader should be like one who serves. Who is greater?
en_old: But whoever among you is great should become lowly, and the leader should be like one who serves. Who is greater?

brh: اسٹ ئس کہ تولوک ارغ کننگٹی ئے یا ایلو کہ خدمت کننگٹی ئے بے شک ہمو ہرا کہ ارغ کننگ کہ توس۔ ولے
en: The one who is sitting down eating, or the other who is serving? Surely the one who sat down to eat. But
en_old: The one who sits eating, or the other who is serving? Surely the one who sat down to eat. But

brh: ئے نما نیامٹی خذمت کروکو ہمباروٹ، ولے نم کنا غم تے ٹی کنتو اوار مسونرے، ہندن کنا باوا عدالت نا کاریم تے کنے تے سنی ئے ہم نمے آتے وتے۔
en: I am among you like one who serves. But you have stood with me in my sorrows. Just as my Father has given me the work of judgment, I also give it to you.
en_old: I am among you as one who serves, but you have stood by me in my sorrows. Just as my Father has given me the work of judgment, I also give it to you.

brh: نم کنا بادشاہی نا تخت آ تولو رے او اسرائیل نا دوانزدہ قوم آتہ فیصلہ کرو رے۔ تو گڑا کس خطردار مفروئے؟ شمعون شمعون ارک شیطان نا رضا ئس کہ نم کلے آزمائفے تاکہ جوان و بد ء جتا کے دن کہ زمیندار خولم ء پغان جتا کیک۔ ولے پطرس ئے نی کن دعا
en: You will sit on the throne of my kingdom and judge the twelve tribes of Israel. So then who will not be in danger? Simon, Simon, look, it was Satan's wish to test all of you, so as to separate the good from the bad, the way a farmer separates the wheat from the chaff. But Peter, I [have prayed] for you
en_old: You will sit on the throne of my kingdom and judge the twelve tribes of Israel. Then who will not be in danger? Simon, Simon, look, Satan wanted to test all of you, to separate the good from the bad, the way a farmer separates wheat from the chaff. But Peter, I [have prayed] for you

brh: ئے نی نٹ کہ نی ایمان اٹ سنگ پیسے۔ اور آ وخت آ نی کنا کنڈا بس تو تینا سنگتا کے مضبوط کر۔ خواجہ ئے نی تون اوار جیل ئٹی ہننگ کے او نی تون اوار کہنگ کے تیار اٹ۔ نی پاو پطرس اینو نا نن بانگو بانگ تفک ہمو وخت اسکان کہ نی مسٹ
en: that you may not waver in your faith. And when you come back to me, strengthen your companions. Master, I am ready to go to prison with you and to die with you. I tell you, Peter, tonight the rooster will not crow until you have three
en_old: that your faith may not fail. And when you come back to me, strengthen your friends. Lord, I am ready to go to prison with you and to die with you. I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have

brh: دوار پاتنس کہ ئے ئے ساھد درست کپرے
en: times said, 'I don't know him.'
en_old: He said again that I will not bear witness.

brh: انتے نمے لوٹ پیسہ و چوٹن بغیر راہیکرینوٹ گڑاس کمی مس؟ نا، ہچ گڑاس اینو متو۔ ولے داسا ہرا بندغ تو پیسہ تے ہو کہ لوٹ یا کشکول ارے ہرفیتے، ہرا بندغ تو زغم افک کوٹ ئٹے تینا سودا کے زغم ئس ہلی تنکے، ئے نمے پاوہ خدا نا کتاب ٹی لکھوکے کہ مخلوق
en: When I sent you out without a purse, money or sandals, were you short of anything? No, nothing at all. But now whoever has money, let him take it, whether a purse or a bag, and whoever has no sword, let him sell his coat and get himself a sword. I tell you, it is written in God's book that the people
en_old: When I sent you out without a purse, bag or sandals, did you lack anything? No, nothing at all. But now whoever has money, a purse or a bag, let him take it, and whoever has no sword, let him sell his coat and buy a sword. I tell you, it is written in God's book that the people

brh: او کلمہ مجرم پائیک۔ ارا ایتا کتاب ٹی لکھوکو ضرور پورا مریرے۔ خواجہ نن تو نی راضی غم و۔
en: will call him a criminal. What is written in the book will surely be fulfilled. Master, we have two swords.
en_old: He was counted among the criminals. What is written in the book must surely be fulfilled. Master, we are content with you.

brh: ہندا بازو یہودی پیرنگا تا دیوان مس تاکہ فکر کیر کہ او عیسی نا مرت نا جان ء خلاص کیر ہمو وخت آ شیطان یہوداہ اسکریوتی اوفتا تون ملا کہ او
en: Here a council of many Jewish elders was held so that they could plan how to put an end to Jesus's life. At that time Satan... Judas Iscariot met with them, he
en_old: Then the chief priests of the Jews gathered in council to consider how they might put Jesus to death. At that time Satan entered Judas Iscariot, and he met with them so that he

brh: ہمو دوازدہ شاگرد آتیان ئس او اوفتو تون اوار مس، او عیسی الینگ نا منصوبہ ئس جوڑ کرے۔ عیسی یروشلم آن پیش تما، او زیتون نا مش آ دعا کن ہنا۔
en: one of those twelve disciples. He joined them and made a plan to have Jesus arrested. Jesus went out of Jerusalem and went to the Mount of Olives to pray.
en_old: One of those twelve disciples joined them and made a plan to hand Jesus over. Jesus went out of Jerusalem and went to the Mount of Olives to pray.

brh: دعا کبو کہ نما آزماشت ٹی پورا مریر۔ یہودا اسکریوتی عیسی ء چاندی نا سے ٹکر نا بدلہ ٹی الیفے۔
en: Pray that you come through your trial. Judas Iscariot had Jesus arrested in exchange for thirty pieces of silver.
en_old: Pray that you may stand firm in your trial. Judas Iscariot handed Jesus over in exchange for thirty pieces of silver.

brh: عیسی چائسکہ کہ مخلوق نا گناہ تے کن اونا مرگ نا ساعت آک تیزی اٹ خڑک بننگ اٹی او۔ او دعا کرے
en: Jesus knew that the hour of his death for the sins of the people was rapidly drawing near. He prayed,
en_old: Jesus knew that the hour of his death for the sins of the people was rapidly approaching. He prayed

brh: او باوہ! اگر نا منشا مرے تو دا مصیبت تے کنے آن مر کے، ولے کنا خواہش نہ بلکہ نا خواہش پورو
en: O Father! If it is your will, take this suffering away from me. Yet not my wish, but let your wish be fulfilled.
en_old: Father! If it is your will, take this suffering away from me; yet not my will, but let your will be done.

brh: واسے ملائکہ ئس اسمان آنی ساغہ ظاہر مس، او اودے طاقت تس، او نا جانا خیدک ڈغار آ تمنگا لگار، او خیدک تا ڈغار آ ہندن تمارا، دن کہ
en: Then an angel appeared from heaven and gave him strength, and the sweat of his body began to fall on the ground, and the drops of sweat were falling on the ground just as if
en_old: Then an angel from heaven appeared to him and gave him strength, and the sweat of his body began to fall on the ground, and the drops of sweat fell on the ground as if

brh: ٹپی نہ دے تکشولنگرا
en: a wounded man's blood were dripping.
en_old: Sleeping from sorrow

brh: خدا انتے جوڑ کیرے۔ دانا ہیتے جوانی اٹ پومتا وی نم محصول مچ کروکا او ایلو گناہ گارا بندغاتاتو توسنورے کنیرے؟ سلامت آتے طبیب نا پکار اف ولے ہمو
en: ...they build nests. This matter was not understood well: you sit and eat with tax collectors and other sinful people? The healthy have no need of a doctor, but those
en_old: Why does God do this? If you understand his words well, why do you sit with tax collectors and other sinners? The healthy have no need of a doctor, but those

brh: فتے کہ ناجوڑ ء۔ ئے راست پاروکاتے توبہ کرفنگ کن بتنوٹ بلکہ بے کسر آتے۔ ننے بادشاہی نا باروٹ پادانائی لاباہم رے ئے کنا شاگردا کھلی پٹوٹ۔
en: who are sick. I have not come to make the righteous repent, but the misguided. Tell us about the kingdom ... [unclear] ... I ... my disciples ... [unclear].
en_old: who are sick. I did not come to call the righteous to repentance, but those who have lost their way. Tell us about the kingdom... my disciples... I did not open.

brh: کبو۔ خدا نا مابت ء ہمبار نما خیال اٹ تخبو کہ نما ہمیش نا زندگی حاصل کیرے۔ تینا مال مڈی تے سودا کبو او غریب آتے ٹپش کبو۔ جنت اٹ تانا بدلہ ملیک۔ خدا نا رحمت آک دنیا نا خزانہ تیان زیات او۔ نہ دز دزی کننگ کیک تے او نہ ملخ کننگ کیک تے
en: ...do so. Keep God's love in your thoughts in such a way that you obtain everlasting life. Sell your goods and wealth and give to the poor. Its reward will be received in heaven. God's mercies are greater than the treasures of the world. Neither can a thief steal them, nor can a locust harm them.
en_old: Keep the love of God in your mind so that you may gain eternal life. Sell your possessions and give to the poor. You will receive their reward in heaven. God's mercies are greater than the treasures of the world. No thief can steal them, and no locust can destroy them.

brh: نوما اوستاموڑی لگے کھراڑے مالومٹ دے زیاتو
en: Your ... [unclear] ... it seems ... it is known ... more days.
en_old: ...it seemed... I learned... more days.

brh: او او دے شفا ملہ دا تو موچا سے او دا سوجوانی برا کوڑ ہو ہو ہو خواجہ خدا نا سفت ئے
en: He... she has received healing. This is truly a miracle, and this ... [unclear] ... oh, oh, oh! Praise be to the Lord God!
en_old: And that day he received healing; this is a miracle, and this goodness... praise be to the Lord God.

brh: ہژدہ سال خدانے برکت دے۔ ہفتے ٹی شش دے کاریم کننگ نا او۔ و ہندا شش دے ہم شفالنگ کے بننگ کے رے، ولے عبادت و آرام نا دے آ نہ۔ ئے منافق!
en: Eighteen years! God has given a blessing. There are six days in the week for doing work. On those same six days you may come to receive healing, but not on the day of worship and rest. O hypocrite!
en_old: Eighteen years... God bless. There are six days in the week for work, and on those six days you may come to be healed, but not on the day of worship and rest. O hypocrite!

brh: منافقاک، نومے آن کس ئس عبادت و آرام نا دے تینا بیخ و خراستے دیر تفک یقینا اترے۔ او دا نیاری ابراہیم نا اولاد ئے او دا دے ہژدہ سال آن جن نا سگے۔ عبادت و آرام نا دے آ نیکی نا کاریم کننگ و جن کشی ئ جوانی۔
en: Hypocrites! Is there anyone among you who does not give water to his donkey and ox on the day of worship and rest? Surely you do. And this woman is a descendant of Abraham, and for eighteen years she has been suffering under a jinn. On the day of worship and rest, doing good works and casting out jinn is good.
en_old: Hypocrites, does not each one of you untie his ox and donkey on the day of worship and rest? Surely he does. And this woman is a descendant of Abraham, and she has been bound by a demon for eighteen years. Doing good and casting out demons on the day of worship and rest is good.

brh: ئے بے ایبنگا خواجہ، ئے انت کیو کہ جنت ٹی کاو؟ نی کنے بے ایب اریس۔
en: O faultless Lord, what should I do so that I may go to heaven? You call me faultless?
en_old: O blameless Lord, what should I do to go to heaven? You call me blameless.

brh: صرف یو خدا بے عیب اون نم خدا نا حکماتے چارے، زنا کپبو، کسے کسپبو، دزی کپبو، دروغ پاپبو، تینا لمہ باوہ نا عزت ء کبو، اینا مچا ورنائی ٹی دا حکماتے منانو۔
en: Only the one God is faultless. You know God's commandments: do not commit adultery, do not kill anyone, do not steal, do not lie, honor your mother and father. I have obeyed these commandments all through my youth.
en_old: Only God is blameless. You know God's commandments: do not commit adultery, do not kill anyone, do not steal, do not lie, honor your mother and father. I have obeyed these commandments throughout my youth.

brh: داسہ نی اسہ کاریم ئس کروئی ئے دن کہ تینا مچ آ مال جائیداد ء سودا کر غریب آتے تیتے، نی آسمان آن خزانہ ئس ملیک، ولدا بر کنا شاگرد بن۔ ولے نی انت سوداگر اون، امیر اون۔ امیر نا خدا نا بادشاہی ٹی ہننگ امر مشکل ئے
en: Now there is one thing you must do: sell all your goods and property and give to the poor; you will receive a treasure from heaven; then come and become my disciple. But you are such a merchant, you are rich. How hard it is for a rich man to go into God's kingdom!
en_old: Now you must do one thing: sell all your property and possessions and give to the poor, and you will receive treasure in heaven; then come and become my disciple. But you are a merchant, you are rich. How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!

brh: امیت نا خدا نا بادشاہی ٹی ایننگ دن مشکل ئے دن کہ اوٹ نا سیلا نا ٹنگ آن گدرینگنگ گڑا دیر نجات حاصل کیک؟ ہرا کاریم تے انسان کننگ کپک او خدا کننگ کیک۔
en: For the rich, going into God's kingdom is as hard as a camel passing through the hole of a needle. Then who obtains salvation? The things that man cannot do, God can do.
en_old: It is as hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God as for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle. Then who can be saved? What humans cannot do, God can do.

brh: خدا نا بادشاہی ایلو بادشاہی تے آنبار ارا جاگہ بروئے؟ ولے خدا نا بادشاہی ظاہر ایٹ بفروئے، کسس دا پاپک ہور داڑے کنے یا ایڑے کنے۔
en: Will God's kingdom come to some place, like the other kingdoms? But God's kingdom will not come visibly; no one will say this: 'Look, it is here,' or 'It is there.'
en_old: Will the kingdom of God come somewhere like other kingdoms? But the kingdom of God will not appear visibly; no one will say, 'Look, here it is,' or 'There it is.'

brh: خدا نا بادشاہی نما نیام ٹی ئے گڑاس وخت آن پد نما خواہش مریک کہ پدی برے ولے نم کنے خننگ کپیرے گڑاس بندغ پاریر
en: God's kingdom is among you. After some time you will long for me to come back, but you will not be able to see me. Some people will say
en_old: The kingdom of God is among you. After some time you will wish that I would return, but you will not be able to see me. Some people will say...

brh: ارواہ خدا نا مقرر کروک بسونے ولے اوفتائی تاتیا یقین تخپبو دن کہ گروک خلیک تو کل آسمان روشن مریک۔ اندن ارا وختائی پدی بریوہ تو دروغ نا بندغہ کنا زندگیا سختی کیرے۔
en: 'Look, the one appointed by God has come,' but do not believe them. Just as when lightning strikes, the whole sky becomes bright, so it will be at the time when I come back. The people of falsehood will make my life hard.
en_old: Some will come claiming to be sent by God, but do not believe them. Just as when lightning strikes the whole sky lights up, so it will be when I return. Lying people will make my life hard.

brh: آسمان و ڈغار نا خلاص کننگ باز کوبینے ولے شریعت نا سچوکو ہرف ئس مٹائفنگ اوڑان باز کوبینے مست نا بازنگا پیغمبر و بادشاہ تا خواہش اسہ کہ اوف دا کاریم تے خنیر و بنیر ولے اوف خننگ و بننگ کتوور
en: Bringing heaven and earth to an end is very difficult, but erasing even one small letter of the law is much more difficult than that. Many prophets and kings of earlier times wished to see and hear these things, but they could not see or hear them.
en_old: It is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for even the smallest letter of the Law to be erased. Many prophets and kings before wished to see and hear these things, but they could not see or hear them.

brh: ننا مارکیں، کلام اٹ انت لکھوک کے، نی ہما پومریس تے، خواجہ خدا تینا خدا غان، تینا مچا استے، تینا مچا جانے، تینا مچا طاقتے، او تینا مچا عقلان محبت کے، او تینا ہمسایہ تو تینا جند نا وڑ مہر کے، نی را؟
en: Our master, what is written in the Word? How do you understand it? 'Love the Lord God, your God, with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength and with all your mind, and love your neighbor like your own self.' You are r[ight]...
en_old: Our master, what is written in the Scripture? How do you understand it? Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind, and love your neighbor as yourself. Is that right?

brh: آسمانی گٹیس اندنکا زندہ مرے سے۔ کنا ہمسایہ دیرے؟ دا سپاہی کپفس۔ کیسر نا باروٹ انت خیالے؟ اسہ وخت ئس اسہ یہودیس یروشلم شار آن یریحو شار نا کنڈ آ ہنگٹی ئس کہ دزاک اوڑا حملہ کریر، لٹار تا باز خلکور تا کہ او کہنگا بس۔
en: ...you would win heaven; that way you will live. Who is my neighbor? [unclear]. What do you think about the road? Once a Jew was going from the city of Jerusalem toward the city of Jericho when robbers attacked him; they robbed him and beat him badly, so that he came close to dying.
en_old: ...you will live like that. Who is my neighbor? This he did not say. What do you think about the way? Once a Jew was going from the city of Jerusalem toward the city of Jericho when robbers attacked him, beat him badly, so that he was half dead.

brh: ہمو کسرٹ اسہ یہودی تا امام ئس گدرینگا کہ ہرا وخت او ٹپنگا بندغے خنا تو تینا کسرٹ چپ دست ہنا۔ اندن پین یہودی ئس ہم ہموکا ہنا او نا خڑکا بس ہرا او ایلو کنڈا ہنا۔ پدا اسہ پردیسی ئس ہمو کسرٹ سفر
en: A priest of the Jews passed along that road, and when he saw the wounded man he went off to the left side of his road. Likewise another Jew also went that way; he came near him and then went off to the other side. Then a foreigner travelling on that road
en_old: A Jewish priest passed along that road, and when he saw the wounded man, he went by on the left side of his path. Likewise, another Jew also went that way, came near him, and went off to the other side. Then a foreigner traveling on that road...

brh: او ہمو بندغ نا کنڈ آ بس اونا ٹپ آتے صفا کرے او تیل خلک تفے تہ او ٹپی ء تینا سواری آ سوار کرے او اسے سرائے سے ٹی درے اوڑے اونا خیال ء تخا پگہ کے سرائے نا مالک ء
en: came over to that man, cleaned his wounds, poured oil on them and bandaged them, then put the wounded man on his own mount, took him to an inn and took care of him there. The next morning, to the innkeeper
en_old: And he came over to that man, cleaned his wounds, poured oil on them and bandaged them. Then he put the wounded man on his own mount, took him to an inn, and took care of him there. The next day, to the innkeeper...

brh: چانڈینہ ارا ٹکر تے سو دے پارے دا بندغ نا خیال ئے کہ سرا وخت آ ایدا کسرٹ پدی برے و اخس کے داڑ آ خرچ مسنے آتے وتنئے۔ نما خیال اٹ دا مچے ٹانڈیر جوان او؟
en: [he gave] two pieces of silver and said: 'Take care of this man, and whenever I come back along this road, whatever has been spent on him I will repay.' In your opinion, which of these three was good?
en_old: He gave two silver coins and said, 'Take care of this man, and whenever I come back this way, I will repay whatever has been spent on him.' In your opinion, which of these was good?

brh: ہر کس کہ داڑے رحم کرے، نمن دن کبو، آ، چناتے کنے الیبو، اوفتے منع کپا بو، انتئے کہ آسمان نا بادشاہی اوفتائے۔
en: Whoever showed mercy to him — you too do likewise. Come, let the children come to me, do not forbid them, because the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
en_old: Whoever humbles himself here like this... come, let the children come to me, do not stop them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to them.

brh: ئے نمے پاوے، ہر کس خدا نا بادشاہی ء چنا تے آنبار قبول کیک او داڑے بننگ کیک۔ او ہر کس دا چنا ء کنا پن اٹ قبول کیک کنے قبول کیک۔
en: I tell you, whoever accepts God's kingdom like children can come in here. And whoever accepts this child in my name accepts me.
en_old: I tell you, whoever receives the kingdom of God like children can enter here. And whoever receives this child in my name receives me.

brh: ہر کس کنے قبول کیک او کنا راہی کروکے قبول کیک ہر کس نمے انچو نکے ہمو بلائے
en: Whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me. Whoever is the least among you, that one is great.
en_old: Whoever receives me also receives the one who sent me; whoever is the least among you is the greatest.

brh: ئے داڑے انت مننگٹی ء؟ دا انت اسے؟ باجی احسان ناصر ئے ہننگٹی ء۔
en: Hey, what is happening here? What is this? It's Jesus of Nazareth going by.
en_old: What is happening here? What is this? Baji Ehsan Nasir is going.

brh: نی انت خواسہ کنے نیکی کیو؟ ئے خواوہ کہ پدی خنے مریو۔
en: What do you want me to do for you? I want to be able to see again.
en_old: What do you want me to do for you? I want to see again.

brh: لاہور نائمہ نی جوان کرے ئے خننگ کیوہ ئے خننگ کیوہ ئے خننگ کیوہ
en: [Look,] your faith has made you well. I can see, I can see, I can see!
en_old: Lahore Naima, you did well. I can see, I can see, I can see!

brh: ہرا وخت آ عیسی
en: When Jesus
en_old: When Jesus

brh: یروشلم اٹی اینو گٹی اسے۔ ہور تان ہر جاگہ بندغاک ملار۔ مخلوق او دے راستینگا کسر ء نشان تننگ ء خدا نا بادشاہی نا بارو اٹ ہیت تننگ نا عرضی کیرہ۔
en: was going to Jerusalem, people gathered from every place. The crowd asks him to show the true path and to speak about God's kingdom.
en_old: There is a gathering in Jerusalem today. People came together from everywhere. The people ask him to show them the right path and to speak about the kingdom of God.

brh: دا وادھ یقین اٹ نبی آ سے کنا مالک کنا خواجہ کنا بچے ئے خواجہ خدا نا نبی آ سے
en: This one is surely a prophet! My master, my lord, save [us]! He is a prophet of the Lord God!
en_old: This one is surely a prophet. My Lord, my Master, Son... Lord, he is a prophet of God.

brh: بچے ننے خواجہ خدا نا سفت کینا خواجہ ننے راستینگا کسر نا نشان ایٹی مخلوق او دے مالک او خواجہ قبول کریر۔ یروہو ٹی زکائی پنی آ محصول مچ کروکس او باز کوشش کرے کا کہ عیسی ء خنے او دے اورنگ کن اسہ بلو درخت اسے آ لگا۔ او محصول ہلوک ئے
en: Save us! We praise the Lord God. Lord, show us the true path! The crowd accepted him as master and lord. In Jericho there was a tax collector named Zacchaeus, who tried hard to see Jesus, and to look at him he climbed up a big tree. He is a tax collector.
en_old: Son, let us praise the Lord God. Lord, show us the right path. The people accepted him as Master and Lord. In Jericho, a tax collector named Zacchaeus tried hard to see Jesus and climbed a big tree to see him. He is a tax collector.

brh: نم انتئے خاچو کرے بش مبو دعا کبو کہ نم ازمائشٹی پورا مریرے
en: Why are you asleep? Get up and pray that you may come through the test.
en_old: Why are you sleeping? Get up and pray that you may stand firm in temptation.

brh: یہودا
en: Judas.
en_old: Judas

brh: نا حکم کننگ نا مانائے کہ نی کنتو غداری کیس۔ واجہ! نن تینا زہم و ہتھیار ہرفین؟
en: The meaning of your giving the order is that you would betray me. Master! Shall we take up our swords and weapons?
en_old: The meaning of your command is that you are betraying me. Lord! Shall we take up our swords and weapons?

brh: دادے گرفتار کبو باز مس ہسپتال پین موجس
en: Arrest this one. That's enough! ... (unclear: 'hospital', 'another' ...)
en_old: Arrest him. Enough! ... hospital ... another ...

brh: نم زغم و لٹاتی تو بسنورے نم نا خیال اٹی ڈاکو اسے اوٹ ئے بلا عبادت خانہ اٹی نم تو اسوٹ ولے نم کنے گرفتار کتویرے ولے داسہ وخت بسنے نم کنے گرفتار کیرے
en: You have come with swords and sticks. In your view am I a robber? I was with you in the great house of worship, but you did not arrest me; but now the time has come, and you arrest me.
en_old: You have come with swords and clubs; do you think I am a robber? Every day I was with you in the temple, yet you did not arrest me; but now the time has come, and you arrest me.

brh: اوڑے گٹ سلیبو
en: Stand firm there!
en_old: Crucify him there!

brh: ہمو بندغاک کہ عیسی ء ہلکسر، عیسی غے مسخرہ کریر او دے خلکر۔ دا بادشاہ نا پوشاک ء بینف!
en: Those men who had seized Jesus mocked Jesus and beat him. "Put this king's robe on him!"
en_old: The men who had seized Jesus mocked him and beat him. Look at this king's robe!

brh: ارے سپاہ بو انت پنی گٹی ئے بادشاہ سلامت نی ننے بچفیسہ، انت ننے آسراتی نا سبب جوڑ مریسہ؟ دا بندغ ہم یسوع تون اوار ئس گودی تا دے۔
en: Hey, soldiers! What ... (unclear: 'pinī guṭṭī e'). Your Majesty, will you save us? Will you become the cause of our comfort? This man too was with Jesus. Lady, ... him (unclear).
en_old: Hey soldiers, what's that on his neck? Your Majesty, will you save us, will you become our source of comfort? This man was also with Jesus the other day.

brh: ئے ہفتے وار خناسٹ
en: I had seen him ... (unclear: 'hafte vār', weekly / on Saturday).
en_old: I saw him on Saturday.

brh: بے وس آ خدمت گار کسہ سے نا محتاج مننگ نا کمن لگے
en: The helpless servant ... becoming dependent on someone ... (rest unclear: 'kaman lage').
en_old: The helpless servant girl began to need someone.

brh: نی ہم ہموفتے آنوس؟ بلے ئے تو فٹ۔
en: Are you one of them too? No indeed, I am not.
en_old: Are you one of them too? No, I am not.

brh: کنے خدا دروغ تر کپ، دا عیسی نا شاگرد اسے، انتئے کہ دا ہم گلیلی اسے۔ او اینک دا کا، کنے خبر اف نی انت پاننگٹی اوس۔
en: May God not make me a liar: this man is a disciple of Jesus, because he too is a Galilean. And ... (unclear: 'ēnk dā kā') I don't know what you are talking about.
en_old: May God not make me a liar, this man is one of Jesus' disciples, because he is a Galilean too. He said this: I don't know what you are talking about.

brh: عیسی چک خلک پطرس نا کنڈا ہرا ہمو وختہ پطرس ء خواجہ نا ہمو ہیت یاد بس کہ او پارے سس تا اینو بانگو نا بانگ تننگ آن مست مسے وار کنے درست کپروس
en: Jesus looked toward Peter, and at that very moment Peter remembered that word of the Lord which he had said to him: "Before the rooster crows today, you will not acknowledge me three times."
en_old: Jesus turned and looked at Peter, and at that moment Peter remembered the word the Lord had spoken to him: "Before the rooster crows today, you will deny me three times."

brh: ئے خدا نن نا سفت کینہ انتئے کہ نی کل آن طاقتور ئس نن نی درخواست کینہ کہ نن نی جوانی اٹ پیش بر
en: O God, we praise you, because you are mightier than all. We ask of you that you deal with us in kindness.
en_old: O God, we praise you because you are the most powerful of all; we ask you to deal with us in goodness.

brh: او ڈی یاد ئے ہرا وخت آ کہ نن نا باوہ پیرہ غا نا حکم آن انکار کریسور ہندے ناراض مسوس ولے اوفتے معاف کریس اوفتے
en: You remember the time when our forefathers had refused your command; you became angry, but you forgave them.
en_old: Remember the time when our forefathers refused the Lord's command; you became angry, but you forgave them.

brh: سفت اویس بلکن نی اوفتے تو باز محبت کریس اوفتے بچائفنگ نا اقرار کریس ہندا خاطر آن اوفتے ہتہ تسکو گس
en: Praise be to you, for you loved them greatly and promised to save them; for that reason you brought(?) them ... (unclear: 'hata tisko gis').
en_old: Praise be to you, for you loved them so much and promised to save them; that is why you gave them a home.

brh: ہانے دیر خلک؟ قاسم پیغمبری کا، نی دیر خلکونے؟ حل بوتے!
en: Hey, who hit you? (unclear word 'Qasim'?) Prophesy: who has hit you? Solve it!
en_old: Hey, who hit you? Prophesy, who hit you? Tell us!

brh: ئے پارے ٹل وتے او دے دیوان نا نمونہ پیش کبو اینک بلا امام آتا دا دیوان ئے عیسی نا رفنگ کن خواہست ئے
en: He said: "Move him along and present him before the council." Now the chief priests of this council want to take Jesus.
en_old: He said, bring him and present him before the council. Now the chief priests of this council want Jesus taken away.

brh: پا انت نیوز
en: Tell us, are you ...
en_old: Say, what news?

brh: مسی، اگہ اینو مے پاو، نم راستنا زی آ یقین تہ فیرے، او اگہ اینو مے آن سوال ئس کیو تو نم جواب تہ فیرے
en: ...the Messiah? If I tell you, you will not believe the truth, and if I ask you a question, you will not answer.
en_old: Messiah, if I tell you today, you will not believe the truth, and if I ask you a question today, you will not answer.

brh: ولے داکان پد خدا نا مقرر کروک خدا تو اوار اونا راست میکو کنڈا تولک گڈا انتنی خدا نا ماروس نم تینٹ پاریرے کہ ئے اریٹ
en: But after this, the one appointed by God will sit together with God at his right-hand side. "Then are you the Son of God?" "You yourselves say that I am."
en_old: But after this the one appointed by God will sit with God at his right hand. Then are you the Son of God? You yourselves say that I am.

brh: دا انت کے پارے نن تینا خف تیٹی بنگون
en: What is this he has said! We have heard it with our own ears.
en_old: What more is there to say? We have heard it with our own ears.

brh: نن دادے پلاتس نا کنڈا دین، بالکل دادے ختم کبو، ختم کبو دادے، خراب کبو دادے ختم کبو
en: We will take him to Pilate. Finish him off completely; finish him off, ruin him, finish him off!
en_old: We will hand him over to Pilate. Finish him off completely, finish him, ruin him, finish him!

brh: او فکو دے گورنر پلاتوس نا کنڈا دریر، ارا کہ رومی حکمران آتے ٹی کل نا زیات خونی وزارت نا تخت غا پانسی تننگ نا ذمہ دار ئس او نم صوبہ نا مالو داڑے
en: They took him to the governor Pilate, who of all the Roman rulers was the most murderous, responsible from the seat of office for handing out hangings, and ... of the province, already here (unclear).
en_old: They took him to the governor Pilate, the most bloodthirsty of the Roman rulers, who was responsible for executions by hanging, and he ruled the province here.

brh: انت کہ بسنورے گڑاس پاننگ خواری او دا بندہ مخلوقہ غے گمراہ کننگٹی ئس دا بلائے بد خوارانہ بازارٹی عذاب جوڑ کریسس دانہ سزانت مروئی سزائے بتہ دا نئچو کسورے صفک دا بندغ کنا مونا مجرم افک کنا خیالٹی او ڈوداری او مخلوقے کیسرے جزیہ تننگا منع کرے
en: Why have you come? You want to say something? "This man has been leading the people astray; he had stirred up trouble in the market ..." What should his punishment be? ... (unclear) This man is not a criminal before me, in my view. "And ... he forbade the people to pay tribute to Caesar."
en_old: What have you come to say? This man has been misleading the people; he caused trouble in the market. What should his punishment be? ... I don't see this man standing before me as a criminal. In my view he ... the people, and he forbade them to pay tribute.

brh: او مسیح مننگ نا دعوی کیک، اسہ بادشاہس۔ بادشاہ؟ انت نی یہودی تا بادشاہ ئس نی تینٹ پاسہ۔ شروع تو گلیلی ٹی کریسس، ولے داسہ داڑے بسونے۔
en: He claims to be the Messiah, a king. "King? Are you the king of the Jews?" "You say so yourself." He had started in Galilee, but now he has come here.
en_old: He claims to be the Messiah, a king. King? Are you the king of the Jews? You say so yourself. He started in Galilee, but now he has come here.

brh: گلیلی ٹی؟ ہندا بندغ گلیلی سے؟ گڑا دا معاملے حاکم ہیرودیس الکننگ کے او داسکان یروشلم اٹی ئے۔
en: In Galilee? This very man is a Galilean? Then the ruler Herod can settle this matter, and he is still in Jerusalem.
en_old: In Galilee? This man is a Galilean? Then this matter is for the ruler Herod to deal with; he is in Jerusalem right now.

brh: دادے مئے پارغہ دبو
en: Take this one over to our(?) side.
en_old: Hand him over to us.

brh: نی تینے انت پاسے؟ او مفتی کنے شاگرد پاسہ او
en: What do you call yourself? ... (unclear: 'o muftī') you call me a disciple ...
en_old: What do you call yourself? ... they call me a disciple.

brh: بنگوسن کنے باز معجزہ نشان ایتے سے ننے ہم نشان ایت
en: We had heard that you have shown many miracles and signs; show us a sign too.
en_old: We have heard that you have shown many miracles; show us a sign too.

brh: مخلوق کنا بارہ ٹی انت پارے؟ گڑاس بندغاک پارے کہ نی یحیی ئس او گڑاس بندغاک پارے کہ نی پیغمبر الیاس ئس او گڑاس پارے کہ نی مست نا اسہ پیغمبر سے ئس
en: What did people say about me? Some people said that you are John, and some people said that you are the prophet Elijah, and some said that you are one of the prophets of old
en_old: What did the people say about me? Some people said that you are John, and some people said that you are the prophet Elijah, and some said that you are one of the earlier prophets.

brh: پدی زندہ مسنس نومنت پارے کہ ئے دیر اٹ نی
en: ...who has come back to life again. What do you say, who am I? You...
en_old: After he came back to life, he said to them, "Where are you from?"

brh: خدا نا مقرر کروکو اوس دا ہیت نا باروٹ کسے پاپیرے کہ آدم نا اولاد کنے ہمو مصیبت بریک کہ او کسکنگوئے او مسے دے آن پد پدی زندہ مرے
en: You are the one appointed by God. Do not tell anyone about this matter: that that suffering will come upon me, the Son of Man, that he will be killed, and after three days he will come back to life again
en_old: You are the one appointed by God. Do not tell anyone about this, that the Son of Man must suffer, that he will be killed and after three days come back to life.

brh: نمے اندیر کنا پدٹ بریک؟ خواجہ اینو توم بریوہ۔
en: Who among you will come after me? Lord, today I will come with you
en_old: Why are you following me? Lord, today we will come with you.

brh: ولے کنے الے ئے ورا کاوے اجازت ہلی و برے اگر بندہ خدا نا کسر آ برے و سوچے کہ ئے ہڑسینگیو داڑان خدا نا کاریم تے ہچ فائدہ مفک اگر کسس کن تو برے تو او تینا بارٹ سوچ کپ او ہر دے کنا خاطر ہن صلیب آ تفنگ کن تیار مرے
en: But let me go home, take leave and come back. If a person comes onto God's path and thinks 'I will turn back', God's work gains no benefit at all from that. If someone comes with me, he should not think about himself, and every day, for my sake, he should be ready to be bound to the cross
en_old: But he told them that whoever wants to come must obtain permission and come; if a person comes on the path of God and thinks that he will turn back, God's work gains nothing from that. If anyone comes for me, he should not think about himself and should be ready every day to be crucified for my sake.

brh: ارا بندغ دا دنیا ٹی تینا زند ء دوست تورک او مونا دنیا ٹی خدا نا سزا غان بچنگ کپک ولے ارا بندغ کنا خاطر آن تینا جان ء مال ء قربان کیک اوڑتون مونا دنیا ٹی خوشی حاصل کیک اگر کسس کنا
en: Whoever holds his life dear in this world cannot escape God's punishment in the world to come; but whoever sacrifices his life and property for my sake will attain happiness with him in the world to come. If anyone... my...
en_old: Whoever loves his life in this world cannot be saved from God's punishment in the world to come, but whoever sacrifices his life and wealth for my sake will find joy with me in the world to come, if anyone, my...

brh: ئے تاتے حکومتے منپک۔ توئی آدم نا اولاد تینا باوا خدا نا ملائکتہ جلال اٹ برے وی او پاوے دا بندہ کنا شاگرد افک۔
en: ...does not accept [my] words and rule, then the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father God and of the angels, and will say, 'This person is not my disciple.'
en_old: He does not accept their rule. Then the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father God with the angels and will say, "This person is not my disciple."

brh: نی یقین کے، داڑیکے گڑا اسندنو مریر ارا کہ خدا نا بادشاہی ئے اورنگن مست کس پسی
en: Believe me: here there are some such people who will not die before they see the kingdom of God
en_old: Believe me, there are some standing here who will not die before they see the kingdom of God.

brh: پدیسا پطرس یوحنا و یعقوب تینتو اوار مش آ دعا کننگ کن درے
en: Afterwards he took Peter, John and James along with himself to the mountain to pray
en_old: Then he took Peter, John and James with him and went up the mountain to pray.

brh: ہرا وخت او دعا کننگٹ ہسکہ او نمون بدل مس او پچاک تا پیون برفم بار مسر و سے وار
en: While he was praying, his face changed, and his clothes became white like snow, and...
en_old: While he was praying, his appearance changed, and his clothes became as white as snow and shining.

brh: دا تون ایرا بندغ ظاہر مسر اوفت عیسی تون ہیت کننگ اٹی اسر اوفت پیغمبر موسی و الیاس اسر ہرا کہ آسمانی جلال اٹ ظاہر مسر۔ نوم خدا نا مقصد نا مونا ہتنگ کیرے۔ نما قضیت یروشلم اٹ مریک۔
en: Just then two men appeared; they were talking with Jesus. They were the prophets Moses and Elijah, who appeared in heavenly glory. 'You will carry God's purpose forward. Your death will take place in Jerusalem.'
en_old: Just then two men appeared and were talking with Jesus. They were the prophets Moses and Elijah, who appeared in heavenly glory. You can carry God's purpose forward. Your death will take place in Jerusalem.

brh: ہرا وخت آ او ایننگا ٹیسور، پترس عیسی ئے پارے، خواجہ! دا خاص جوان مرے کہ نن انداڑے نم تون رہینگن، نن مسہ کدان جوڑ کین
en: As they were leaving, Peter said to Jesus, 'Master! It would be very good for us to stay here with you; let us make three tents.'
en_old: As they were about to leave, Peter said to Jesus, "Master! It is very good that we stay here with you. Let us make three shelters."

brh: اسٹ ئس نی کن، پطرس ہیت کننگ اٹی ئس اسٹ ئس موسی کن کہ جمار آ اوفتے ڈکار، اسٹ ئس الیاس کن عیسی نا شاگرداک خلیسور۔ جمار آن خدا پارے، دا کنا گچین کروکا مارے، دانا ہیتاتے بنبو۔
en: 'One for you,' — Peter was speaking — 'one for Moses,' when a cloud covered them, 'one for Elijah.' Jesus' disciples were afraid. From the cloud God said, 'This is my chosen son; listen to his words.'
en_old: "One for you," Peter was saying, "one for Moses" — when a cloud covered them — "and one for Elijah." Jesus' disciples were afraid. From the cloud God said, "This is my chosen Son; listen to his words."

brh: خواجہ خواجہ کنا چنا غا رحم کرک
en: Master, master, have mercy on my child
en_old: Master, Master, have mercy on my child.

brh: او دے بچے دا کنا سٹنگا مارے چنا نا مدد ء کر ایرا شاگرد آتے خواست کریٹ ولے اوفک ہچ کننگ کتو ئے بے یقین ء چپی انگا قوم
en: Save him, this is my only son; help the child. I asked your disciples, but they could not do anything. O unbelieving and perverse nation!
en_old: Save him, he is my only son. Help the child. I asked your disciples, but they could not do anything. O unbelieving and perverse generation!

brh: ہی ارا وخت ئس خنتہ نوم تو اوار داہی تاتسہ گوٹ مارے دانگتے
en: Oh, how long [must I be] together with you...? Bring the son here
en_old: How long will I be with you? Bring your son here.

brh: شکل تو جوان مس؟ اچھا بوئی تسے؟
en: Did it turn out looking nice? Okay, did it give off a smell?
en_old: Did it turn out looking good? Okay, did you give it a scent?

brh: ننے دعا کننگ نا طریقہ ہیڑفہ، دن کہ نی یحیی ء ہیڑفاس۔ ہرا وخت آ دعا کیسہ پا، ئے باوہ ننے کہ آسمان ٹی ئس نا پن پاک ہلنگے۔ نا بادشاہی برے۔ نا مرضی ہندن کہ آسمان ٹی ئے زمین آ ہم مرے۔
en: Teach us the way to pray, as you taught John. When you pray, say: 'O our Father, who are in heaven, may your name be held holy. May your kingdom come. May your will be done on earth just as it is in heaven.'
en_old: Teach us how to pray, as you taught John. When you pray, say: O our Father who is in heaven, hallowed be your name. Your kingdom come. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

brh: ننا روزانہ نا ایراغے ننے اینو ایت۔ ننا گناہ تے معاف کر۔ ہمو کہ نن تینا قصورواتے معاف کینے، ننے آزمائش ٹی بٹپہ بلکہ بدی تیان بچائف۔
en: Give us today our daily bread. Forgive our sins, as we forgive those who have wronged us. Do not throw us into temptation, but save us from evils
en_old: Give us today our daily bread. Forgive our sins, as we forgive those who wrong us. Do not lead us into temptation, but deliver us from evil.

brh: خوابو اتک نومے پٹبو تو خنرے تے ٹک ٹک کبو ملنگک
en: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened
en_old: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and it will be opened.

brh: ارا گڑا نم خواری نمے ایتک ارکس پٹک حاصل کیک تے و ارکس ئس کے ٹک ٹک کیک اوڑکن دروازہ ملنگک
en: Whatever you ask for will be given to you; whoever searches obtains it, and whoever knocks, for him the door is opened
en_old: Whatever you ask for will be given to you. Whoever seeks finds, and whoever knocks, the door will be opened for him.

brh: نو اینا نا ارا باوہ ئیک کہ او نا مار مچے خوائیک او اودے دوش ایتک یا کہ مار بیدہ خوائے او نا باوہ اودے تیلش ایتک نو مکھا سمو گناہ گار مریرے ولے تینا چناتے جوان و گڑاس ایتیرے
en: Now, which father among you is there who, if his son asks for a fish, gives him a snake? Or if the son asks for an egg, does his father give him a scorpion? Now you, though you are sinners, still give good things to your children
en_old: Now which father among you, if his son asks for a fish, gives him a snake? Or if the son asks for an egg, does his father give him a scorpion? So even though you are sinners, you still give good things to your children.

brh: ہندنو کہ کسس تینا باوہ خدا غان خواہک خدا اودے ضرور ایتک او تینا پاک انگا روح نا طاقت اٹ اڑائی کیک ئے نمے پاو دا خیال کپبو کہ انتس کنوئیے او انتس بینوئیے
en: In the same way, when someone asks his Father God, God will surely give to him, and [guides him] by the power of his Holy Spirit. I tell you, do not worry about what you will eat and what you will wear
en_old: In the same way, if anyone asks his Father God, God will surely give to him; he guides him by the power of his Holy Spirit. I tell you, do not worry about what you will eat and what you will wear.

brh: نم دا ہیتاتے است آن کشبو انتئے کہ زندگی نا معنی داف کن اوبین نم چکاتے ابو اوفتے تو فصلاتے مچ کننگ کن گودام ہم اف ولے خدا اوفتے تک
en: Put these things out of your heart, because the meaning of life is not these things. Look at the birds: they do not even have a storehouse to gather crops in, yet God provides for them
en_old: Take these words to heart, because this is not what life means. Look at the birds: they do not even have a storehouse to gather crops in, yet God feeds them.

brh: ولے نما قدر چکاتے آن زیات ئے فکر کیسہ تو نی انت خننگ کیسہ، انت نی زندگی ء ودفنگ کیسہ؟
en: But your worth is greater than the birds'. If you worry, what can you see come of it? Can you lengthen your life?
en_old: But you are worth more than the birds. If you worry, what can you gain? Can you add anything to your life?

brh: اگر نی دا چنکائی تے کننگ کپیسہ تو گڑا نی انت کے خلئیسہ؟ نم پلا تے ہبو اوفک مٹرک کیرے اوفک ارم کپیسہ ولے ودرے
en: If you cannot do even these small things, then why are you afraid? Look at the flowers, they [...]; they do no work, yet they grow
en_old: If you cannot do even these small things, then why do you worry? Look at the flowers, how they grow. They do not toil, yet they grow.

brh: بادشاہ سلیمان تینا دولت و پوچاتیٹی دنزے وا لڈوکے دا اسٹہ پل۔ اگر خدا دا جنگلی پلاتے دنو پوشاک بیرفک ولے دا منا دیٹی باریرے ولے نما زندگی دا پلاتے آن زیات
en: King Solomon, in his wealth and clothes, was [not] adorned like one of these flowers. If God dresses these wild flowers in such clothing, though in the days ahead they wither, yet your life is more than these flowers...
en_old: Even King Solomon in all his wealth and clothes was not dressed like one of these flowers. If God clothes these wild flowers like this, which are in the field today... and your life is worth more than these flowers.

brh: استے۔ خدا نمے کوننگ کیتک۔ ننا ایمان مضبوط کرک۔ اگر نما ایمان گزنیش نا دانہ نا برابر ہم ارے، توت نا درختی پابو، ماس سے تو پیش تم و سمندر اٹی ترک کرک، او نما حکم منک۔
en: ...is. God will give you [food] to eat. 'Make our faith strong.' If your faith is even the size of a grain of mustard, say to the mulberry tree, 'Come out by your roots and sprout in the sea,' and it will obey your command
en_old: Apostles: Lord, we ask you, strengthen our faith. If your faith is even as small as a mustard seed, you could say to the mulberry tree, 'Be uprooted and planted in the sea,' and it would obey your command.

brh: آزمائش نا بننگ ضروری ء۔ افسوس دادے کہ او نا ثواب آن برے۔ دادے ننا جوانی نا نسخہ نا خلے او نا لخٹ شاغنگے او دے سمندر ٹی پٹنگے۔ بے دے
en: Trials are bound to come. Woe to the one through whom they come. It would be better for him that a millstone be put around his neck and he be thrown into the sea...
en_old: Temptations are bound to come, but woe to the one through whom they come. It would be better for him to have a millstone hung around his neck and be thrown into the sea.

brh: دا ڈنگ کے او چکا تینا گناز کرے فے۔ ایمانت خو کاتا تعداد ہم مروئی۔ او اندونے کے اسے بندغ ئس گڈاس دغار اسیٹی دسے گڈا ترکک او بلو درخت ئس جوڑ مریک۔ او چکاک اونا شاختیا تینا
en: ...on this branch, and the birds made their [nests]. Faith must be there, even in a small amount. And it is like this: a man sowed a seed in a piece of ground; the seed sprouts and becomes a big tree, and the birds in its branches their...
en_old: ...and the birds made their nests. Even a small amount of faith is enough. It is like a man who sowed a mustard seed in his field; it grew and became a big tree, and the birds [nested] in its branches.

brh: کنا خواجہ دا کل مخلوق خراب کننگٹی ئس دا تینے بادشاہ اسپائک۔ دا بندہ بادشاہ؟
en: My lord, this man was leading all the people astray; he calls himself a king. This man, a king?
en_old: My lord, this man is corrupting all the people, and he calls himself a king. This man, a king?

brh: جہان نا خواجہ دادے جوان خلبو دادے پیلا توز نا کنڈا دبو
en: Lord of the world! Beat him well and take him off to Pilate.
en_old: Lord of the world, beat him well and take him to Pilate.

brh: دا اونا صوبے
en: This is his province.
en_old: This is his province.

brh: دادونو ہچو جرمس کتنے کہ دادے کینگنا سزا ایتیو
en: This man has not committed any crime for which I should give him the death sentence.
en_old: This man has committed no crime that he should be given the death sentence.

brh: ہندا خاطران ہندا دے کوڑہ خلیوہ ہویلک کیوہ نی ہر وقت ہر سال دا عید نا وقتا ہر بندہ
en: For that reason I will have this very man whipped and release him... every time, every year at the time of this feast, every person...
en_old: That is why I will have him whipped today and release him; every year, at the time of this feast, one person is released.

brh: انتء غیالک کیسہ؟ برابائے نن کے۔ غیال کر۔ جی۔ دا بندغے ختم کر۔ جی او ننے برابائے۔ دا دے پاش۔
en: What are you thinking? Barabbas for us! Think! Yes. Finish this man off! Yes, and Barabbas to us! Set him loose!
en_old: What are you thinking? Give us Barabbas. Think. Yes. Finish this man. Yes, give us Barabbas. Release him.

brh: نی نی دادے کوڑہ خنپو
en: You, you, whip him!
en_old: You, don't you see him being whipped?

brh: نی انت سے کورنگٹ اسپیل آ توس؟ دا عیسائی! ننے انت الاتی رنگٹ تورے
en: What sort of state are you sitting there in? This Christian! What sort of state has he kept us in!
en_old: What colour have you put on? This Christian! What colour has he put on us?

brh: دا دے ٹنگی بو
en: Hang him!
en_old: Hang him.

brh: ولے او زور زوراں شور کرے رات کہ عیسی ئے پھاو ایتبو، پھاو ایتبو۔ گڑا پیلاتوس عیسی ئے مرگ نا سزا نا حکم تس۔ او برابا ہرا کہ جیل اٹ قتل و فساد نا جرم اٹ بند اسکا۔
en: But they kept shouting very loudly, 'Send Jesus to the gallows, send him to the gallows!' Then Pilate gave the order for Jesus to be sentenced to death. And Barabbas, who had been locked up in jail for the crime of murder and rioting...
en_old: But they shouted loudly, 'Crucify Jesus, crucify him!' Then Pilate ordered that Jesus be sentenced to death. And Barabbas, who was in prison for the crime of murder and rioting...

brh: مخلوق نا خواہش نا مطابق عیسی ء کسفنگ کن فوج نا دوٹی تس
en: In accordance with the people's wish, he handed Jesus over into the hands of the soldiers to be killed.
en_old: According to the people's wishes, he handed Jesus over to the soldiers to be crucified.

brh: ہی؟ نا پن دیرے۔ شمون کرینے خواجہ۔ دادے ہرف۔
en: Hey? What is your name? Simon of Cyrene, sir. Pick this up.
en_old: Hey? What is your name? Simon of Cyrene, lord. Pick it up.

brh: چٹ آ دے تڑبو، ئے دا دے آ، مونی دا دے ہت۔
en: Cut the rope off him. Hey, this one, bring this one forward.
en_old: Put the wood on him, hey, on this one, bring him forward.

brh: اسریلہ کبو ارے ہدی برما بو
en: ... do it, hey, ... get up!
en_old: Get up, come on, go on.

brh: پانوک او تان ننے کہ او گینا کنتا۔ خواجہ، کن دافتے، کن۔ ئے یروشلم نا نیاڑیتا۔
en: He used to tell us that he had committed no sin. Master, ... these ones, ... O women of Jerusalem.
en_old: He was telling us that he had committed no sin. Lord, for them, for... O women of Jerusalem.

brh: کنکے او ببو، ولے تینکے او تینا چناتے کے او ببو، ہنتے کہ پاروننگا پاٹ تون دن مننگاٹی ئے تو باروننگا پاٹ تو انت مروئی خدا نا مدت۔
en: Do not weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children, because if this is happening with green wood, then what will happen with dry wood? God's help...
en_old: Do not weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children, for if this is done when the wood is green, what will happen when the wood is dry, by God's...

brh: مونی مبو، داڑے اتبو تا، زو کبو، زو کبو
en: Move forward, bring them here, quickly, quickly!
en_old: Move forward, come here, hurry up, hurry up.

brh: داسہ نی اینو بے پاشا مس زو کبو نی زو کبو زو کبو داسہ نی زو کبو ہئی وا
en: Now today you have become a king! Hurry up, you, hurry up, hurry up, now you, hurry up, hey!
en_old: Now, today you... hurry up, you hurry up, hurry up, now you hurry up, hey.

brh: چٹاتے مچے آ لکبو
en: Pull the ropes a little.
en_old: Raise the crosses a little.

brh: واہ واہ دافتے معاف کر، داتی پسہ کے انت کہ
en: Father, Father, forgive them; they do not know what they are doing.
en_old: Father, Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.

brh: او ایلوفتے بچیفی، داسہ تینے بچیفی۔ او، اگہ نی خدارا مقرر کروکوست، تینے بچیف او باوہ غان شیف تڑینگ۔ ننے ہم تینا معجزہ ء نشان ایت۔

en_old: God willing, he'll be fine within a week. Stay well, goodbye everyone. Goodbye, doctor. Goodbye.

en: How is it? Any news? Yes, they had come here and ... (unclear), but before we could get here they went back to their own homes. That's where we came upon them. That's all.
