brh: آ گڑاس ملو مسے انہ؟ ہاؤ۔ راہی کے۔ کسر سینا باؤٹ اٹ۔ دیر اودے تینا باؤٹ کرینے؟
en: So, did you find out anything? Yes. He was sent off. Under whose protection? Who has taken him under his protection?
en_old: So did you meet anyone? Yes. Sent him on his way. Under whose protection? Who has given him protection?

brh: ئے خلق نا سردار پسند خان او دے تینا باوٹ کرینے ہا گڑا نی انت پاسے قربان خان انتس کہ کروئی اسے کہ ئے تینٹ کیوے نہ دا
en: Pasand Khan, the chief of that tribe, has taken him under his protection. Ha, then what do you say, Qurban Khan, what is to be done? Should I do it myself or not?
en_old: Pasand Khan, the tribal chief, has given him protection. Then what do you say, Qurban Khan, what should be done? Will you do it yourself or not...

brh: داسہ نما کاریم ختم مس۔ داسہ کنا کاریم شروع مس۔ داسہ نم فارغ ارے۔ میر بہادر خان۔ اینو مالو پاریٹ کہ نما قصہ ختم مس۔ داسہ نما ہچو کاریم اف۔ کنا کاریم تو داسہ
en: Now your work is over. Now my work has begun. Now you are free, Mir Bahadur Khan. This morning I said that your story is finished. Now you have no work left at all. As for my work, now...
en_old: Now your work is over. Now my work has begun. Now you're free, Mir Bahadur Khan. I told you today that your story is finished. Now you have nothing left to do. My work now...

brh: شرو مس نی دا فیصلہ غاتے پومفیسہ نی چنا سے ئس ہین ہین تینا باوہ غان ہرف او نی تینٹ پوکیک ئے چانٹ پوکیک
en: ...has begun. You don't understand these decisions; you are a child. Go, go, learn from your father, and he himself will explain it to you, he will make you understand.
en_old: ...has begun. You don't understand these decisions; you are still a child, learn from your father. You yourself understand nothing.

brh: اوئے دا قصہ ہم ختم کیوے او نا پنا دروغ ئے ہم ختم کیوے دا سوٹ ٹپی ہی آخر کنا دوٹی برے کنا کنا ڈی
en: Hey, I'll finish this story too, and I'll put an end to the lie of his name as well. This one is wounded; in the end he will fall into my hands, my, my dear.
en_old: Hey, I'll finish this story too, and I'll put an end to his false name too. This... will come into my hands in the end, my...

brh: یار دا سئی پومسوٹ ئے تو
en: Man, I've understood this properly, you know.
en_old: Man, you didn't even understand this properly.

brh: ئنا بیسہ تھینا بدلے ضرور ہلی وی ضرور ہلی وی ببو فہیم۔
en: ... I will surely take my revenge, I will surely take it. Come on, Fahim.
en_old: ...I will surely take revenge for my money, I will surely take it. Come on, Fahim.

brh: نی فکر کپہ کنا مسڑ، دا تو ظلم ئے میر بہادر نا محل و بانٹ چار ضعیفہ او، تاتی، دا زنی تینٹ انصاف کے۔
en: Don't you worry, my daughter, this is plain injustice. Mir Bahadur's palace and ... four wives ... aunt ... this one will see justice done herself.
en_old: Don't you worry, my daughter. This is the injustice of Mir Bahadur's palace and household... frail old women, my dear... this woman will deliver justice herself.

brh: ئے ہم کڑو سٹ۔ اسلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ امر ئس کنا مار؟
en: I too ... Peace be upon you. And upon you peace. How are you, my son?
en_old: ...come too. Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. How are you, my son?

brh: جوڑ اماں جان بس شکر۔ نم کنے معاف کبو کنا وجہ آن نم پریشان مسورے۔
en: I'm fine, dear mother, thank God. Please forgive me; you were worried because of me.
en_old: I'm fine, mother dear, thank God. Please forgive me; you were worried because of me.

brh: بس بختاوا ایبر تول آ خیرے او خیرے خیرے نی پاو پگہ دا شیرین نا لمہ باوہ بننگٹی او استے گڑاس بندوبست کیرغ مرغس اینا اللہ تیتا
en: Just sit here, Bakhtawar. It's fine, oh, it's fine, fine. You say Shireen's mother and father are coming tomorrow, so some arrangement has to be made, God willing.
en_old: Bakhtawar, just sit here. All right, all right. You're saying Shireen's parents are coming tomorrow, so we need to arrange something. God willing.

brh: او پریشان مفہ پریشانی نیت سے صرف خوشی نیت سے۔ نی فکر کپہ کل انتظام مریرے۔
en: Oh, don't worry. There's no cause for worry, only for happiness. Don't you worry, all the arrangements will be made.
en_old: Oh, don't worry. It's not a time to worry, only a time to be happy. Don't worry, everything will be arranged.

brh: شیرینی! دا دوز آ تمبرین اینان زرو
en: Shireeni! Take these down from the line.
en_old: Shireeni! Take these down from the line.

brh: ایلو خواجہ نی برے اما کنا
en: Brother Khwaja, will you come with me?
en_old: Brother Khwaja, will you come with me?

brh: ولے نی دا فکر کریس کہ ننا نیمہ غا دیر آن ہیس؟ ولے شیر اسیت اسیت آ تخس کس ہم تینا ورا ہتپک
en: But did you ever think about this: who brought it over to our side? But Sher set each one in its place, and nobody brings anything of his own.
en_old: But did you ever think about who brought this to our side? But Sher put each one in its place, and no one...

brh: دروازہ ملوک، ایشان کس؟ ئے وٹ۔
en: Open the door. Who is it? It's me.
en_old: Open the door. Who's there?

brh: کنا مار؟
en: My son?
en_old: My son?

brh: خیر تو رے مچے پریشان خننگسہ ہاؤ با
en: Is everything all right? You look a little worried, father.
en_old: Well, why do you all look so worried, father?

brh: ابنے راست پارے سے کنا ایڑ بے قصور ء خامخا سردار نا مار نا رند اٹ ہیسوٹ ہاؤ کرامت کل قصور کنا ء
en: Father, you are right. My sister is innocent; for nothing I went chasing after the Sardar's son. Yes, Karamat, the whole fault is mine.
en_old: Ibn was right. My innocent sister was dragged into this for nothing because of the Sardar's son. Yes, Karamat, it's all my fault.

brh: دا وڑ نا جنجال آک ودی مسر۔ اگہ ئے تینا حالات کے جوان سوچاٹ نا تو اینو اینو دنو دے خنتوٹا جوان مس نمے احساس مس کنا شیرین تو تینے بچفنگ نا
en: This is how these kinds of troubles arose. If I had thought carefully about my circumstances, I would not be seeing such a day today. It's good that you have realized it. My Shireen, to protect herself...
en_old: That's how these troubles started. If you had thought carefully about your situation, you wouldn't be seeing a day like this. It's good that you realized it. My Shireen, to protect herself...

brh: او مار، ئے راست پاوٹ، ئے اف تٹی گنوک آتیا امبار اینا رند اٹ ہیسوٹ۔ بس کنا مار، نی دم کا، پگہ صوبہ مالہ تینے تیار کا۔
en: Oh son, I'm telling you the truth, I went chasing after it like a madman. That's enough, my son, you rest; get yourself ready early tomorrow morning.
en_old: Oh son, I'm telling you the truth, I'm fed up with running after these madmen. That's enough, my son, you rest and get yourself ready for tomorrow morning.

brh: نن کانہ سردار نور آغائے شیرین پدا تینا ہو ببا ئے ہفتے آن معافی خواہوے انتئے کہ سردار نا مار کنا دو ء ٹپی مس ہو کنا مار او تو نا
en: We will go to Sardar Noor Agha, and about Shireen we will again ask them for forgiveness, because the Sardar's son was wounded by my hand. Yes, my son, and...
en_old: When will we go to Sardar Noor Agha about Shireen again and ask her father for forgiveness? Because the Sardar's son was wounded by my hand, and my son is...

brh: ایڑے زتھس اونا حفاظت کرے۔ نتھو ہنو پگنہ وختٹ دیر دنو کننگ کے۔ بس ایلے بدائی۔
en: Sister, take good care of her. We'll be going now, it's getting late. Well then, brother, goodbye.
en_old: Brother, take good care of her. We'll go now, it's getting late. Well then, goodbye.

brh: داسہ کامبو ارغ کنینہ، ارغ تیار ئے بر کنا مار۔
en: Now come along, let's eat; the food is ready. Come, my son.
en_old: Now let's go and eat, the food is ready, come, my son.

brh: نمیر صاحب ئے نمہ منت وار اٹ نم کنا خنتی ملارے او کنے معاف کبو نمیر صاحب دونو ایچ اف نی کنکے باز محترم ئس
en: Namir sahib, I am grateful to you, you have opened my eyes; please forgive me. Namir sahib, it's nothing like that; you are very respected to me.
en_old: Nameer sahib, thank you, you have opened my eyes, please forgive me. Nameer sahib, it's nothing like that, you are very respected to me.

brh: ئے دادے کہ انسان آن غلطی تو مریک انسان کمزور گڑاسے اور انسان ہمو وخت عظیم مریک کہ او تینا غلطی ء منیک۔ ننے داڑے بسرے اینو نا منت وارن۔
en: The thing is, a human being does make mistakes; a human is a weak thing, and a human becomes great at the moment he admits his mistake. Thank you for coming to us here today.
en_old: Yes, it's that people do make mistakes. People are weak, and a person becomes great when he admits his mistake. Thank you for coming here today.

brh: ٹکری صاحب دا نما مہربانی دا مسیت نا پنا ٹی سورے او تینا باوٹ کرے دا ننا رسم و دود ئے نیتو معلوم ئے کہ کس کسے نا پنا ٹی مریک تو امر بریک
en: Takri sahib, it is your kindness that you took this daughter under your protection and made her your bahot. This is our custom and tradition; you know how it is when someone comes under someone's protection.
en_old: Takri sahib, it was your kindness that you came under the protection of this mosque and put your trust in us. This is our custom and tradition. You know how it is when someone takes refuge with someone.

brh: ئے چاوٹ اللہ نمے سلامت کے داسہ کنے اجازت۔ جی تل مرزا داسہ امام بخش اسکن بننگٹی اٹ اوفتو ملنگو ہرا۔ جی نا ٹکری صاحب پین وختس۔ تو کنے رخصت کن۔ جی نا بس مہربانی اللہ نا دعا اللہ نا دعا۔
en: Yes, I know. May God keep you safe. Now give me leave. Yes, sit, Mirza; Imam Bakhsh is coming now, meet them, won't you? No, Takri sahib, some other time. So let me take my leave. No, no, just your kindness; God's blessings, God's blessings.
en_old: Yes, may God keep you safe. Now allow me to leave. Yes, Mirza, I'm going to Imam Bakhsh now to meet him. Yes, Takri sahib, another time. So let me take my leave. Yes, just your kindness, God's prayers, God's prayers.

brh: اللہ نا جوڑی ٹی
en: In God's safekeeping.
en_old: A match made by God.

brh: ہیلو، ہنوک آ باز منت وار اٹ کہ نم کنے عزت تسورے کنا
en: Brother, I am very grateful that you have honored me.
en_old: Hello, thank you very much for coming and for honoring me.

brh: دا مسٹ تینا باہوٹ کریرے، نو دا احساناتے ہچ وڑ گیرام کپروٹ، نی مئے پاش داٹی احسانانتی تسے، دا تو جوانی تس مس کہ جوانی ٹی خوشی
en: You made this daughter your bahot; I will never in any way forget these favors. You did me a kindness in this. This was simply a good deed, for in goodness there is happiness.
en_old: You did this out of your trust in us. I will never forget these favors. You did us a favor in this. It was goodness, and in goodness there is happiness.

brh: ایتے مہر محبت اٹی، خیر اٹی، اور ہمدردی اٹی دا قصہ خلاص مس۔ ئے لمہ نی تو نن کے فرشتہ ئس جوڑ مسس بسس۔ نم دائے تا تلے بو، نم کنے دا پاو بو کہ نمے ہم گڑاسے احساس مس متو۔
en: With love and affection, with goodwill and with compassion, this story has come to an end. Mother, you came to us like an angel. You all sit here, and tell me this: did you also feel something or not?
en_old: And so this story ended in love, goodwill and compassion. Mother, you became like an angel for us. You tell me, did you feel anything too or not?

brh: راست پاس ایلم لمہ باوانا دا فرض ئے کہ او تینا اولاد کن جوان سوچ کیر نن تو بس دیر و پیسہ نا لالچ اٹ تینا اولاد تا خوشی تے خاک اٹ شاغنہ۔ ہمم اندائے۔
en: You're right, brother. It is the duty of parents to think of what is good for their children, but we, out of greed for wealth and money, just throw our children's happiness into the dust. Yes, that's just how it is.
en_old: You're right, sister. It's the duty of parents to think of what's good for their children, but we just ruin our children's happiness out of greed for land and money. That's exactly how it is.

brh: ایڑے کنا مسٹ ارا دے؟ داسہ ئے شیرینہ تبا۔ ہاؤ۔ امام بخش شیریں ماشاءاللہ باز لائق ء
en: Sister, where is my daughter? Now bring the sweets. Yes. Imam Bakhsh, Shireen, mashallah, is very capable.
en_old: Where are my two guests? Now give them something sweet. Yes. Imam Bakhsh Shireen, mashallah, is very capable.

brh: او عزتی او ہوشیار مسس ہم باز خوش قسمت ارے کہ اللہ پاک امیدونو مسستس شیرین
en: She is respectable and clever, and it is great good fortune too that God Almighty gave such a daughter, Shireen.
en_old: He is respectable and wise, and Shireen is also very lucky that God gave her such a...

brh: شیرین، شیرین کنا مسہ، زیت کبو، تروک دا کبو، مسہ کبو
en: Shireen, Shireen, my daughter, hurry up, get this done, daughter, do it.
en_old: Shireen, Shireen, my daughter, hurry up, come here, daughter.

brh: ئے باز خوشوٹ، نما وار مسورے۔ باز مہربانی کنا ایڑ، نما باز مہربانی۔
en: I am very happy that you have joined us. Thank you very much, my sister, thank you very much.
en_old: I'm very happy that you have come. Thank you so much, my brother, thank you so much.

brh: امام بخش، اندا خوشی ٹی اینے مئے نس گراس خواہ۔ جی لمہ، نم حکم کبو۔ حکم نا۔
en: Imam Bakhsh, in this very happiness I want something from you. Yes, mother, just command. Your command.
en_old: Imam Bakhsh, in this happy moment today I want something from you. Yes, mother, just say the word. Just say it.

brh: عرض سے جی ادا خواہ کے شیریں کنا مشار مرے او کنا مار نوما مار مرے
en: I have a request: I want Shireen to become my daughter-in-law and my son to become your son.
en_old: I have a request: I want Shireen to become my daughter-in-law, so that my son becomes your son.

brh: کنا ہیلوم کنا شیرین جان تو مالو غان
en: My brother, my dear Shireen...
en_old: My sister, my dear Shireen...

brh: ننا مسٹ دنو ایچوئی تسف اللہ پاک ہر بندہ کن وسیلہ جوڑ کیک او کنا مار نا کمک کرے تو نی احسان کتو بلکہ تینا فرض پورا کرے نی دا کنا باوٹو نی کسس ایچ
en: No, daughter, there's nothing like that. God Almighty makes a means for every person. And if my son helped you, he did you no favour; rather, he fulfilled his own duty. You are here with me now; no one can ... you ...
en_old: Our daughter, nothing like that. God Almighty makes a means for every person. You helped my son, so you did no favor; rather, you fulfilled your duty. You are under my protection; you are no one's...

brh: پانے ک پگ مللے او کنے داسہ زند الے پروئے او کنے سمائی کنا ایلم تو کنے سول معاف ک پروئے تان ک زند اوٹ نی آک کسہ
en: He said that ... and now he won't let me live, and I know that my brother will never forgive me as long as I am alive ...
en_old: She said that... she no longer cares about life, and she knows that my brother would never forgive me as long as I'm alive...

brh: تینا خنت برزا کنے کپر او دا کنا نیت کالی او لمہ جان استون لنگڑون گڑاس کوننگ کے متھیرا خالی مجلس کیرے استون ہچ کونتنو نما قربان تینا مارکن ئے دا ساتپ
en: I can't raise my eyes [to them], and this is my intention ... And mother dear, we're hungry, [get us] something to eat; you're just sitting chatting, we haven't eaten anything. I'd give my life for you. For my son, I ... this ...
en_old: Don't raise your eyes at me, this is my intention... and mother dear, you hold empty gatherings and nothing comes of them... I would sacrifice myself for you; this is for my son...

brh: دتی نی پریشان کپہ بو، کل گڈانہ فیصلہ ایٹٹ مریک، ببو دا ختو۔ ئے امام بخش، نی دا پا کہ نامسر نا دس و نشان مسنے یا نہ؟ جی او پیر صاحب، تو گڑا میر پسند خان نا
en: Don't you worry; in the end everything will be settled. Come on, let it be. Hey, Imam Bakhsh, tell me, has any trace of your daughter been found or not? Yes, Pir sahib. Then Mir Pasand Khan's ...
en_old: Don't worry, everything will be settled in the end. Come, let it be. Hey Imam Bakhsh, tell me, has any trace of your daughter been found or not? Yes, Pir sahib. Then Mir Pasand Khan's...

brh: ئے کا سے ئے تینٹ کاو میر صاحب ئے تے بلن کنے خواب ارا ئے تینٹ کاوا ئے تے بلن کننگ نا انت مطلب میر صاحب ئے دادے کہ کنا مچٹ دا برا
en: I'll go, I'll go myself, Mir sahib; I don't want to [marry] her [off]. 'I'll go myself', 'I don't want to [marry] her' — what is that supposed to mean? Mir sahib, it's that my [daughter] ... this marri[age] ...
en_old: I myself... Mir sahib, I had a dream... What do you mean, 'I myself'? Mir sahib, it's that my little one...

brh: نی امر و باوس ئسس؟ نی غیرت ئپ، نا مسڑ پین نا اوراٹی ء اور نی بیغم تولوک ئس؟ امام بخش، ہسی تو سیات نا کس، نا مسڑ کنا پین
en: What kind of father are you? Have you no sense of honour? Your daughter is in someone else's house, and you were sitting there without a care? Imam Bakhsh, ... your daughter ... my ...
en_old: What kind of father are you? Have you no honor? Your daughter is in someone else's arms and you were sitting there carefree? Imam Bakhsh, your daughter... my...

brh: ئے تینٹ کا وتے وتے نمیر صیب نا دا صورت نا چٹالو کسہ دا صیب دا نن چان ننہ کاریم چائے امام بخش دا ئے تے گرام کننگٹی ئس
en: I'll go myself and ... her ... Mir sahib's this face ... Sahib, we know our own job. Imam Bakhsh, I was [going to marry] her ...
en_old: I myself... this face of Mir sahib's... Sahib, we know our job. Imam Bakhsh was...

brh: نا مسنا برام کن تو مننگٹی ئس او کنا عزت ئے ئے اونا عزت نا خیال تخنگ کیوے نمیر صاحب داسہ کنا خنک ملنگار داسہ ئے تینا مسنا زندے برباد کننگ نا خواب ارا
en: You were agreeing to your daughter's marriage, and my honour ... I can look after her honour myself, Mir sahib. Now my eyes have opened; now I don't want to ruin my own daughter's life.
en_old: Your daughter's marriage was going to happen, and my honor... I can keep his honor in mind, Mir sahib, but now my eyes have opened. Do I now dream of ruining my own daughter's life?

brh: جوان، داسہ نی کنا مونا خنتہ برزا کننگ نا کوشش کننگ ٹی ئس میر صاحب، ئے راست پاننگ ٹی اٹ۔ نی تینا خنتہ مل۔ نا عمر شست سال ئے
en: Fine — so now you're trying to raise your eyes to me? Mir sahib, I am telling the truth. Open your eyes. You are sixty years old.
en_old: Good, so now you're trying to raise your eyes in front of me? Mir sahib, I'm telling the truth. Open your eyes. You're sixty years old.

brh: او کنا مسڑ نا عمر؟ بیرا ہشت دہ سالے۔ تو مالو نی دا ہیت نا خیال الو؟ مالو؟ مالو ئے کورا سٹ۔
en: And my daughter's age? Just eighteen. So didn't you think about this before? Before? Before, I was blind.
en_old: And my daughter's age? About eighteen years. So didn't you think about this before? Before? Before, I was blind.

brh: دا سکنا خنک ملنگار دا سکنا سما تما کے پریسٹ ئٹی بندغ خوشی تے النگ کپک امر کے مرے امام بخش ئے تینا عزتی زور اٹم دیوے
en: Now my eyes have opened; now I have realised that a person cannot get happiness by force. How can that be? Imam Bakhsh, I will take my honour even by force.
en_old: Now my eyes have opened, now I understand that a person can't find happiness in... How can that be? Imam Bakhsh, I'll... my honor by force...

brh: اورمڑ صاحب، دا اسکان ئے ہم آرام اٹ کننگ اٹی اٹ، او جوانی اٹ داٹی کن ہم دا کٹیبو، و اینو پد
en: Mir sahib, until now I too was going about this calmly, and kindly ... but from today on ...
en_old: Sahib, until now I was doing this calmly, and properly too... but from today onward...

brh: کنا مسڑ نا پنی ملپیرے، امام بخش ئے ہم نی ہندن او سبق ئس ایتوٹ کہ نی زندگی بھر یاد کروس۔
en: Don't mention my daughter's name. Imam Bakhsh, I too will teach you such a lesson that you will remember it for the rest of your life.
en_old: Find my daughter, Imam Bakhsh, or I'll teach you such a lesson that you'll remember it for the rest of your life.

brh: توتہ سا انت سوچینوس؟
en: So now what have you decided?
en_old: So what are you thinking now?

brh: کنا خیال مسٹ دا اخ ننا پناٹی ارا وختی کسس بس ئے تو گپ کرے پدا اوڑتو ئے تو گپ کین انتس کہ ننا دود
en: My thinking is this: she is under our protection. When someone comes and talks to me, then I'll talk to him, because our custom ...
en_old: I thought that since she is under our protection, whoever came, he would talk; then I'd talk with him, because our custom...

brh: ہیلو، ئے میر بہادر خان رند گپ کننگ اٹی اٹ۔ کنے درست کرے رے؟ آ۔۔۔
en: Hello, this is Mir Bahadur Khan Rind speaking. Did you recognise me? Ah ...
en_old: Hello, this is Mir Bahadur Khan Rind speaking. Did you recognize me? Ah...

brh: امیر صاحب بالکل درست کریٹ ننے دیر درست کپک اینو مین دا خاطر ہم فون کریٹ کنا اسے امانت ئس نم تونے امانت؟ او کنا مطلب دادے کہ کنا دشتار نما وراٹی پناہل کنے او ہو ہو ہو
en: Mir sahib, of course I recognised you. Who doesn't recognise us? Today I've also called for this reason: something of mine is held in trust with you. In trust? Yes, I mean that my fiancée has taken refuge in your house. Oh ho ho ho.
en_old: Mir sahib, of course I recognized you; who doesn't know you? Today I called for this reason too: you have something of mine held in trust. In trust? I mean that my fiancée has taken refuge in your house... oh ho ho...

brh: بالکل او کنا پناہ ٹی ئے اور بالکل حفاظت ٹی ئے تو گڑا چہ وخت برے اورا دننگ کے؟ میر صاب کنا خیال نا بننگ نا ضرورت اف۔ او ہم لاوارث مفرو او دے لمہ باوہ ایڑے لمہ سمروئے
en: Absolutely, she is under my protection and completely safe. So then, when should I come to take her home? Mir sahib, I don't think there's any need for you to come. She is not without guardians either; she has a mother and father ...
en_old: Absolutely, she is under my protection and completely safe. Then when should I come to take her? Mir sahib, I don't think there's any need for you to come. She is not an orphan either; she has a mother and father...

brh: او کنے خبرے مچ ہریرے توڑا اونا لمہ باوہ بریر نوم چارے کہ کنا برام اورتو مننگٹ اسکہ بالکل چاو نا برام اورتو مننگٹیس لیکن مسڑ رضامند اف کنے تو برام کننگ کن
en: Yes, I'm aware ... so then her mother and father will come. You know that my marriage to her was being arranged? Absolutely, I know your marriage to her was being arranged, but the girl is not willing to marry you.
en_old: He brought me the news, then her parents came and told me that her marriage was being arranged with him. Yes, the marriage was indeed being arranged with him, but the girl isn't willing to marry.

brh: آخر نا مطلب انت صفا صفا پا کنے۔ نئے صاحب کنا ہچو مطلب اسف۔ کنا مطلب دا دے کہ کنا خیال دا عمر ٹی نیکن برام کننگ سہی اف۔ اور ایلو کسے تو کرے زور زبردستی برام کننگ ہم ٹھیک اف۔
en: What do you mean, after all? Tell me plainly. No sir, I don't mean anything. What I mean is that, in my view, marrying at this age is not right for you. And besides, marrying someone forcibly is not right either.
en_old: What do you mean, after all? Tell me clearly. No sir, I don't mean anything. I mean that in my opinion it isn't right for her to marry at this age. And besides, forced marriage isn't right either.

brh: آ تو چکری تینا نصیحتاتے تینتو نلے۔ اینے نصیحت کپن میر صاحب، ئے حق نا ہیت ء کننگ اٹی اٹ۔ ہسی تو پان میر صاحب، ئے تینا باوہ ٹا تینا
en: Ah, so keep your advice to yourself. I'm not advising you, Mir sahib; I'm only speaking what is right. Still, I'll say this, Mir sahib: for my father's sake, my own ...
en_old: Well, Chakri doesn't keep his advice to himself. Don't advise me, Mir Sahib, I'm only speaking the truth. Then say it, Mir Sahib, to your own father...

brh: جانم قربان کنے تیوا۔ تو دا سنی کنے دھمکی تننگٹی ئس میر صاحب ئے نی دھمکی انتئے تیوا۔ بہرحال انتس کنے خیال کیس ہندن خیال کرک۔ پومسس۔
en: ... I would sacrifice my life. So now you're threatening me? Mir sahib, why would I threaten you? Anyway, whatever you think of me, think it. Understood?
en_old: I'll lay down my life. So are you threatening me, Mir Sahib? Why would you threaten me? Anyway, think of me whatever you like. Understood.

brh: دیر ئس خاموش آستہ لسہ کے میر بہادر خان۔ عمرے تور برام کننگیر۔
en: Who will quietly silence Mir Bahadur Khan ...? Getting married at [his] age!
en_old: For a while he stayed silent, Mir Bahadur Khan. You'll spend your whole life celebrating.

brh: اڑے او ہرا دے نا شیرنگ آ سنگت تینے ڈکانے؟ ور کنا ایلم دنو ہچو ہیت ئس اف۔
en: Hey, since when has that sweet friend of yours been hiding himself away? No, my brother, it's nothing like that.
en_old: Hey, since when has he passed himself off as such a dear friend? No, my brother, it's nothing like that.

brh: او باز عزت دار و بندغ اسے، نی تو اونا احسان مند مروئی انتئے کہ او نا ایڑ نا عزت ء بچیفے، او نا حفاظت ء کرے، ہمودے اگر شیر خان متوکہ تو نا عزت او کنا ایڑ ء نرفینے درینے، و نی باسہ کہ نا عزت؟ نہ سنگت، دنو ہچو ہیت ئس اف۔
en: He is a very honourable man. You should be grateful to him, because he saved your sister's honour and protected her. That day, if Sher Khan hadn't been there, they would have abducted your honour, my sister, and carried her off — and you talk about your honour? No, friend, it's nothing like that.
en_old: He's a very honourable man. You should be grateful to him, because he saved your sister's honour and protected her. If Sher Khan hadn't been there that day, they would have run off with your honour, with my sister, and you talk about your honour? No, friend, it's nothing like that.

brh: ہمودے او جنگلٹی شکار کننگٹی اسکہ۔ اسے بندغ ئس اونا رندٹی ئس کمک کن توار کرے تے۔ شیر خان اودے خنا فائر کرے یاتے، شیر خان نائیڑے پناہ تسکہ نائیلوم۔ نی ہمودے باز غصہ ٹی اسوس۔ اگر شیر خان نائیڑے
en: That day he was out hunting in the forest. Someone behind him called out to him for help. Sher Khan saw it and fired. Sher Khan gave your sister refuge, brother. That day you were very angry. If Sher Khan ... your sister ...
en_old: That day he was out hunting in the forest. Someone behind him was calling for help. Sher Khan saw him and fired. Sher Khan gave your sister shelter, my brother. You were very angry that day. If Sher Khan hadn't... your sister...

brh: ایڑے نا جوٹی سے گچو نی خلکو سے تھے او صرف سوب نا انتظار کرے کہ سوب مرے واپس ارا غا سر کیو تے ولدا نم خنارے تے فائر شروع کرے رے گولی لگا تے ڈاسا موراٹی تے نا تما نی تہین پانے وچت
en: ... your sister ... you would have killed her. He was only waiting for morning, so that once it was morning he could take her back home. Then you saw him and started firing; the bullet hit him, and now he is ...
en_old: You had hit your sister... He was only waiting for morning so he could go back home in the morning. Then you saw him and started firing, the bullet hit him, and now he's dying... you tell me...

brh: یار ئے راست پاننگٹو نائٹ تینٹ نی پائک دا ہی انت کریٹ تینا محسن ئے تینا دوتیٹ ٹپی کریٹ اوف
en: Friend, I'm telling the truth. Say it yourself: what is this I have done? I have wounded my own benefactor with my own hands. Oh!
en_old: Friend, tell the truth. You say it yourself: what is this you've done? You wounded your benefactor with your own hands.

brh: کنے معاف کیسیرے نن نی ہم باز سزا تسٹ اینو ہم معافی خواہو
en: Please forgive me. We punished you a great deal too; today I am asking for forgiveness as well.
en_old: Forgive me. We punished you a lot too. Today I'm also asking for forgiveness.

brh: شیر خان نا لوما؟ ہا، ہندانگ برک، ہند مٹ، ہرا؟
en: Sher Khan's mother? Yes, come this way, here. Which one?
en_old: Sher Khan's house? Yes, come this way, here. Which one?

brh: او راٹی ئے ہن پنی کیوا انکے نم سوچانو رے ننے دا سنگ بندی قبولی باز منت وار امام بخش باز منت وار
en: ... [unclear] I will do it; as you have thought it over, this engagement is accepted by us. Thank you very much, Imam Bakhsh, thank you very much.
en_old: ...whatever you think. We accept this engagement. Thank you very much, Imam Bakhsh, thank you very much.

brh: مہربانی کنا خواجہ
en: Thank you, my master.
en_old: Thank you, my lord.

brh: سلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ ارے خمیسہ! ادا دا ایرا توئے مسہ توئے کنا پیسہ تے ہٹنا درینوس پیننگا توئے او پیسہ تے کٹے ارے خمیسہ! پیسہ بھٹ
en: Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace. — Hey Khamisa! Brother, look, it's been two months, three months; you have taken my money [unclear], another month, and you have used up(?) the money. Hey Khamisa! The money...
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Hey Khamisa! Here, this... two or three of you, you've taken my money... the money was stolen, hey Khamisa! The money, brother...

brh: صاحب جواب انے
en: Sir, what is the answer?
en_old: Sir, the answer is yes.

brh: عاشوق ئے ٹیرانگ دے سہ بھڑیا دے وتے بھڑیا دے وتے جند و خس
en: [Song lyric, largely garbled:] The lover ... a day of clashing, himself ... a day of clashing, himself ... (his) own body ...
en_old: The lover ... a day of fighting, a day of fighting, fighting for himself...

brh: اراہیٹے جانو ٹکرے ولا پین کسے طاقت اف کہ اونا پنی ہلی نازک شامہ بابو اراہ زار دے۔
en: [Song lyric:] ... darling, a piece(?) ... but no one else has the strength to (even) take his name ... delicate ... [unclear].
en_old: ...a fine piece, and no one else has the strength to ... his delicate evening, father, weeps bitterly.

brh: خیر الویلا مسون میر اعتبار خان سئیں دا خلق الانا مال ادھینا انت کہ انت وجہ بس وڈیراس انت ملکیت دہینا
en: Well, [unclear] Mir Itibar Khan, sir, this is the livestock of the village people ... what is it, what reason has come up that some wadera (landlord) ... what ownership...?
en_old: Well, it's been a while. Mir Aitbar Khan, sir, this is the people's property here. What reason has come up that a wadera claims it as his own property?

brh: خدا پوجیو ظالم ئتو بھلو ظالمو بندو ظالمو بندو سے واہ اللہ مرو طبیعت نا جوانو طبیعت کنا اللہ رحم کے پین پیاس کبو نم ننکن سئیں دس بارہ نا تمانے مرے اللہ خیر کے کہ ماما برے ماما توئی تس کینے دس نم کبو
en: God ... he is a tyrant to you, a big tyrant, a cruel man, a cruel man. Oh God ... is your health good? — My health — God is merciful. ... do (it) for us, sir; it will come to about ten or twelve ... May God grant that uncle comes. Uncle ... gave me ... ten, you (pl.) do (it).
en_old: Worship God; with the oppressor... a great oppressor, an oppressive man, an oppressive man. Wow, God... how is your health? My health is good, may God have mercy. Don't make any more... for us, sir, ten or twelve... may God make it good. Uncle, come, uncle... you gave... don't you do ten.

brh: نوا جند ہمو تو واللہ میت کر نا جند اینک دا علم و گدریف کائے ہک ہتکان انت مس داس؟ ہا؟ انت مس؟ دادا خلق نو اعتبار خانہ بندغاک اعتبار خانہ جند مال و مڈئی ہسکا غو تونسونو
en: ... your own self ... by God ... (your) own self; now this ... passes ... What has happened now? Huh? What happened? Brother, the village's ... Itibar Khan's men, Itibar Khan himself ... the property and goods ... [unclear].
en_old: ...himself, by God... this knowledge and ... what happened just now? Huh? What happened? This is the people's... Aitbar Khan's men, Aitbar Khan himself, the property and livestock...

brh: او رینگڑی و رینگڑی تان اخہ زو برا مکھینن آ برا مکھینن سلی بابا سلی بابا دا اخہ دا اخہ وقت اینی دا بابا گوم کتے او ظالم بندہ غوٹ دے پچی بابا گوم کتے او ظالم بندہ غوٹ دے پچی او ظالم ترندے گوم کتے ایلم بابا سلی بابا
en: Oh, in rags, in rags ... how soon will he come ... Sali Baba, Sali Baba, how long, how long it has been now; father has gone missing — that cruel man ...; father has gone missing — that cruel man ...; that cruel one has made him disappear; brother, father, Sali Baba!
en_old: Oh, ... how soon will it come... it will come... Sali Baba, Sali Baba, this... what time is this now, father, he has gone missing. Oh cruel man, ... father has gone missing. Oh cruel man, ... oh cruel one, he has gone missing, brother, Baba Sali.

brh: داد خدائے داد کے
en: Justice! May God grant justice.
en_old: Justice, may God grant justice.

brh: دا کنے گڑاس کیک ئے ظالم بندہ خوائے کے گڑاس ورز نا نم کن ئے دے چو رحم اف بابا کسے نا ئے ظالم بندہ سے ئے بھلو ظالم سے شابو جی اور گلو جی نم ادا ہنبو ناتیا نا جند تنک ہمے دے پاتا بابا چلو ٹھیک ئے ننا ایلمی خلکو رے غلطی مس ننا ماتی
en: He will do something to me; he is a cruel man. May God ... something ... For you (pl.) there is no mercy at all, father, for anyone; he is a cruel man, he is a great tyrant. Shabo ji and Gulo ji, you, brothers, go ... [unclear] ... that same day they said: 'Father, come on, it's all right; you took from our brothers; a mistake was made; our mother...'
en_old: This does something to me... cruel man, may God do something... for you there is no mercy at all, father, for anyone. He is a cruel man, a great tyrant. Shabo-ji and Gulu-ji, you here... that same day they said, father, okay, fine. Our brothers have been killed, we made a mistake, our mother...

brh: والی واپس کرو۔ ہاں ٹھیک ہی ہم کیندا داسہ، ماما ہم داڑے، ماما برے گڑا اوٹ توئی گپ ئس کینہ ولہ کانہ میرا، میر ندیم آ۔ ہاں ٹھیک ہی کانہ۔ صحیح ہی نا؟
en: ...give (it) back. — Yes, all right, we'll do that now too; uncle is here too. Let uncle come, then we'll have a talk with him, and then we'll go to the Mir, to Mir Nadeem. — Yes, all right, we'll go. — That's right, isn't it?
en_old: Give it back. Yes, okay, we will do it now. Uncle is here too. Uncle, come, then we'll have a word together, then we'll go, Mir, to Mir Nadeem. Yes, okay, we'll go. Right, isn't it?

brh: ہاں صحیح ہی ہا بس صحیح ہی او ننے اجازت ہی اللہ خیر کیک داسہ، ئے را لٹہ نیش بفنگ مالے پدا تیرم صحیح ہی ہاں ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی صحیح ہی
en: Yes, that's right, yes, enough, that's right, and we have your leave. God will make things well now ... [unclear] ... the livestock back again ... — Right. Yes, all right, all right, right.
en_old: Yes, right, yes, just right, and we have permission. God will make it well now... then... right, yes, okay, okay, right.

brh: لکھمیر خان مال نا خس پیسہ کرین۔ لکھمیر خان اعتبار نا زی آ تو اعتبار اف لیکن مال نا ارا لکھ روپئی کرینے۔ لکھمیر خان منے یک لکھ روپیہ دا منے باز ضرورت ئے منے۔ پیسہ باز مریک دا پیسہ باز مریک۔
en: Lakhmir Khan, how much money did we make from the livestock? Lakhmir Khan, there is no trusting Itibar at all, but he has made two lakh rupees from the livestock. Lakhmir Khan, (give) me one lakh rupees; I need it badly. It will be a lot of money, this will be a lot of money.
en_old: Lakhmir Khan, how much money did you make from the property? Lakhmir Khan, there is no trust in the trust, but you made two lakh rupees from the property. Lakhmir Khan, give me one lakh rupees, I need it very badly. It's a lot of money, this is a lot of money.

brh: امیر خان دا پینٹ انگ انت مسڑے گھوٹا ہنانو پیندا تھپارے واہ بوسکو ہلکونٹ تے تیزے امر جوان مس کے ہیسوستا ننے ام پارے
en: Amir Khan, what has happened with these pants? ... [unclear] ... Wow, ... I've bought it, it's sharp. How nicely it turned out ... tell us too.
en_old: Amir Khan, what happened to these pants... wow... how did it get so good... tell us too.

brh: گڈویاس راہی ماشاءاللہ ئے پاٹ تے گڈ
en: ... [unclear: 'to be cut'?], traveler(?), mashallah — cut the logs.
en_old: ...Rahi, mashallah, the wood...

brh: ماما جی دا اعتبار ئس اودے خلق نو اونا ڈاغیا فینودرینو تا تامر مدد
en: Uncle, this was Itibar('s doing); ... the village ... they have seized and carried off his cattle herd ... help.
en_old: Uncle, this was Aitbar; to him, the people's... their help.

brh: دے کنا خن ئے سوچے کر، کنا میر حنیف صاحب تون ہیت کنے، تو ننا ڈاگے واپس کرو، ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی گڑا کامبو، ہاؤ
en: ... think it over for my sake (lit. 'my eye'); we'll talk with my Mir Hanif sahib, then give our cattle herd back. — All right, all right, all right; then let's go. — Yes.
en_old: ...think about my eye; I'll talk to my Mir Hanif sahib, so give our ... back. Okay, okay, okay, then let's go. Yes.

brh: سلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ خیراٹ بسونرے۔ سائیں ننا ایلمی خلکورے خیر سے۔ ننا مالے واپس کبو۔ مہربانی کبو۔ توار۔ شان پاننگے۔ دا اسہ نما۔۔۔
en: Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace. — Welcome. — Sir, you took from our brothers; well then, give our livestock back. Please. [A voice] ... [unclear] ... This one of yours...
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Welcome. Sir, our brothers have been killed, all well? Give our property back. Please. ... This is one of your...

brh: مالے واپس کے وا۔ ابا اینا ابا اینا کھلی وتا ابا اینا بس کرائے وتا بس۔ انت مس مار دا خلق دے کھلی سا؟ ابا دا نا ایلم درینے مال پیڑیا سودا کرینے۔ گڑا دا بسونو پارا کے ننا مالے نی درینو۔
en: Give the livestock back, will you. — Father, [unclear] ... father, [unclear] ... enough. — What happened, son, (why) this village ...? — Father, his brother took the livestock and sold it at the market. So these people have come saying, 'You took our livestock.'
en_old: Give the livestock back. Father, my father... I came, I came for the rent. What happened, son, why did you come to this village? Father, his brother took the livestock and sold them at the market. So he came saying, you took our livestock.

brh: ابا حوصلہ کر مار حوصلہ کر ابا نی بسونس ناتے دافتے چٹ کریٹ بس مار خیر اسے خیر ابا نو محل فی الحال ہمبو اللہ خیر کے
en: Father, be patient. — Son, be patient. Father, you have come; I have finished off all these of yours(?). — Enough, son, it's all right, it's all right. — Father, for now ... [unclear] ... may God make it well.
en_old: Father, be patient. Son, be patient. Father, you came... I've cleared all these up. Son, it's all right, it's all right. Father, the house for now... may God make things well.

brh: اسلام علیکم میر صاحب۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ ابا خمیسہ خیر ئے میر صاحب جانو وپاری ایٹ کنا درے نی دا مسٹ توئے تس پیسہ تننگ اٹی اف ہمکے۔ ادا شاباش جانو ہم دا سفت استروئی مریک۔
en: Peace be upon you, Mir sahib. — And upon you be peace. — Father Khamisa, is all well? — Mir sahib, Jano the trader took my goat, and now it's been three months, and he isn't paying the money [unclear]. — Brother, well done, Jano! This too is a ... quality [unclear].
en_old: Assalamu alaikum, Mir sahib. Wa alaikum assalam. Father, Khamis, is everything well? Mir sahib, Jano the trader took my... and he isn't paying the money for it. Here, well done, Jano. This kind of quality should be kept in mind too.

brh: حساب کا ئے غریب و بندغ سے اٹ کنا پیسہ تفک ہمار کے
en: Settle the account; I am a poor man; he won't give me my money [unclear].
en_old: Settle the account. He's a poor man, and he won't give me my money...

brh: وعلیکم السلام، بلمستو خوش اسو؟
en: And upon you be peace. Are you well and happy?
en_old: Wa alaikum assalam, are you safe and well?

brh: ٹھیک ٹھاک اسو؟ مہربانی۔ بے سار خوش ئس تگڑا ئس بڈ ئس دا خمیس آ امر بس؟ غلام مصطفی، جانو واپاری خمیس نا ہیٹی درے ننداسہ دا تو امر کین؟
en: Are you doing all right? — Thank you. — [unclear] ... it was healthy, it was sturdy, it was [unclear]. How did this happen with Khamis? — Ghulam Mustafa, Jano the trader took Khamis's goat; now what shall we do about this?
en_old: Are you doing fine? Thank you. ...Healthy, strong... how did this business with the shirt happen? Ghulam Mustafa, Jano the trader took the matter of the shirt. What should we do about it now?

brh: نیو دے پگ خان جی وحید جی سائیں ببو کان پیڑی ٹی جانو ئے ہرین شاباش خان نی غلام مصطفی نا خدمت ئے کریس
en: [unclear] Khan ji, Wahid ji, sir, come, let's go and look for Jano in the market. — Well done, Khan, you have done Ghulam Mustafa a service.
en_old: Today, Khan ji, Wahid ji, sir... take Jano to the market. Well done, Khan, you served Ghulam Mustafa.

brh: میر سراج جان نوخانی راہب، یا ہا؟ غلام مصطفی خنتون نامرادے، ماما اگر خنانٹ ٹکر کرینے
en: Mir Siraj Jan Nokhani, the monk(?) — or what? — Ghulam Mustafa, we haven't seen the wretch; uncle, if I had seen him ... he has clashed (with someone).
en_old: Mir Siraj Jan Nokhani the monk, or what? Ghulam Mustafa is a wretch in our eyes, uncle, if he has clashed with us.

brh: اللہ خیر کے ایلو کل ہیت آک سہی او لیکن دا اعتبار خان نا ایلم باز خراب ء قدم ئس ہرفنگا ٹی ء ہمدے خدائی خلق نا
en: May God make it well. All the other matters are fine, but this brother of Itibar Khan is taking a very bad step against these same poor people of God.
en_old: May God make things well. All the other things are right, but this brother of Aitbar Khan has taken a very bad step against these same people of God.

brh: ارونا ڈاگی ہفینو دارینو میر صاحب اوکان پد اودونا ایلوم کینانو اعتبار آ او اعتبار منیتنے تپالے ننا مہر
en: They have seized and carried off the cattle herd of [unclear], Mir sahib. After that his brother ... [unclear] ... to Itibar, and Itibar has not listened ... our kindness.
en_old: ...Mir sahib, after that his brother... he trusted Aitbar, he trusted... our love...

brh: ایلم درینے پیٹی ٹی سودا کرینے مالے نوام والوم کنے ابا ننگا تیرے توفہ کفینے اوفتے اتورینے وڑو کمپدو نا بابا بسونے روکانے داڑکم گڑاس نمے کروئی مرے سوچوئی مرے نیوز ماما بھلا نمو رے
en: His brother has taken them and sold the livestock in the market... me... father... them... father has come... Something has to be done about this by you too, it has to be thought over; uncle, you are the elders.
en_old: His brother took them and sold them in the market, the livestock... Father... the boy's father came... you have to do something about this, you have to think about it...

brh: بس کنے او ہم ننا ہمسے آئی گڑا نا گڑاس داٹ کے کروئی مریک بابا نی تینا چاسہ او باز خرابو بندغ ولا مہرین گڑاس کینہ ادا گڑاس تو کروئی مریک ئے تتے الے بو مار نا
en: Enough. For me, he is our neighbour too, so something has to be done about this. Father, you know yourself he is a very bad man, but let's do something kindly. Brother, something really does have to be done... leave it... your son.
en_old: So for me too, he is our neighbor, so something has to be done about this. Father, you know yourself that he is a very bad man, but let's do something kindly. Something has to be done here...

brh: مہر نا سالگرہ چغائے مہر نا سالگرہ ٹی رات ئے اریر ایتوار سے نم دعوت ایتیوا گڑا ہت گپ کینہ رئیس صاحب بس ٹھیک ئے ننے داسا اجازت ایتیبو
en: It's Mehr's birthday. On Mehr's birthday, on Sunday night, I am inviting you all; then we'll talk. Rais Sahib, all right, fine; now give us leave.
en_old: It's Mehr's birthday. For Mehr's birthday on Sunday night, you are invited, and then we'll talk. Rais sahib, all right, now please give us permission to leave.

brh: اڑے جانو، نی دا قمیص نا ہیٹ ہرے درے؟
en: Hey Jano, where did you take the goat for this shirt?
en_old: Hey Jano, where did you take this business with the shirt?

brh: مسی تو مننگٹی ء، اونا پیسہ تے انتئے کتہ فیس؟ وحید! پیسہ ویسہ اف، جواب ایتینومے، ہاؤ، جواب ایتینو نی
en: It's happening anyway. Why wasn't his money, the fee, paid? Waheed! There's no money at all. I'll give them an answer. Yes, I'll answer you.
en_old: Of course it's happening. Why didn't you pay his money? Wahid! There's no money. I'll answer you, yes, I'll answer you.

brh: وحید! دا چپل ء یاد کیوائے، اسل استان دپہ را۔ کنا مستانا پائے کہ دا چپل ء نی اسل استان دپہ، اور پین غریب آتیا دونو ظلم کپہ۔ وحید!
en: Waheed! I remember these sandals; never, ever forget them. My elder told me: never forget these sandals, and don't commit such cruelty against other poor people. Waheed!
en_old: Wahid! Remember these sandals, never forget them. My father told me never to forget these sandals, and never to commit such cruelty against other poor people. Wahid!

brh: جوان کترس خان اینو علاقہ نا معتبر آتے پاپا گامے خان نا سالگرہ اینو مئے
en: Well done, Khan. Today tell the notables of the area that today is Khan's birthday.
en_old: Well done, Khan. Today, invite the notables of the area. Today is Khan's birthday.

brh: دعوت کے حاضر سائیں حاضر عبداللہ ہمودے کاوٹے
en: Invite them. At your service, sir, at your service. Abdullah, I'll go right away.
en_old: He invites. At your service, sir, at your service. Abdullah, I'll do that.

brh: پش نماز امر کے اعتبار خان تنی تفر دوٹی ہلمہ کسائنا سما نہیدا اینا ڈزاکا توار کرے ت بس من کنے خنا تینا نرا تما ہندٹ ہلمہ کسائنا سما نہیدا نادر نا ہوٹل ڈی بندا گس بس چوریر کنے بس
en: The prayer leader... how... Aitbar Khan took his axe in his hand... nobody knew... there was a sound like a gunshot... then I saw him run and fall right there... nobody knew... at Nadir's hotel, a man... then they... me.
en_old: After the prayer, Aitbar Khan... I didn't know who it was. The sound of gunshots came... then I saw... at Nadir's hotel... they came for me...

brh: نی مجبور مسوٹک، لکھیتہ خنتے، او دا کنے خبر اف، انو بہادر بندغ اسس نا باز نا، باباو ہیتاتے الیبو کہ دا ٹماٹر تے دیبو کہ باریرہ، او دا بس الیبو ہیتاتے ٹماٹر تے دیو کاوا
en: You were helpless... and I don't know about this; he was such a brave man... Father, leave these matters and water these tomatoes, or they'll dry up. And just leave these matters; I'm going to water the tomatoes.
en_old: You were forced... I don't know about this. He was a very brave man. Father, leave these matters, give me these tomatoes, they're going bad. And just drop this talk, give me the tomatoes, I'll take care of it.

brh: ایلم آ کینو کنا مار نا سالگرہ ہی دا خوشی نا موقع ٹی بلوچستان نا زیب آ فنکار سیداد جمالی اخوا فے نون نما خدمت ٹی حاضر ہی
en: Brothers, today is my son's birthday. On this happy occasion, the pride of Balochistan, the artist Sedad Jamali, is here at your service.
en_old: Today is my son's birthday, and on this happy occasion the pride of Balochistan, the artist Sedad Jamali, is here with us at your service.

brh: او اعتبار نا بندغ آتے خولیسہ تنکیسہ مالے خولیسہ ہنا سئی اف میر صاحب اعتبار نا زیاد اعتبار اف ولدا ہم کوشش ئس کینہ کوشش نا بشرط کہ کس تو ناجائز کپائے اینے پانے گٹ
en: That Aitbar goes around frightening and harassing your people, frightening them over the livestock; that's not right. Mir Sahib, Aitbar can't be trusted. Still, we'll make an attempt, on condition that nobody does anything unjust. Tell him that.
en_old: He goes around deceiving people who trusted him, and deceiving people isn't right. Mir Sahib, trust can't be trusted anymore. Still, we'll try, on condition that nobody does anything wrong. Tell him that, then.

brh: مست تو ئے ناجائز کتانوت لیکن داسہ کنا استٹی ارے استٹی ارے تو ابا استن کشہ تہ پگا نی بر اسکول نا میدانا ولدا نی تو ئے ہیت گپ کیوہ چلو ٹھیک ہی ئے بریوہ
en: Before, I did nothing unjust, but now it's in my heart, it's in my heart. So, father, take it out of your heart. Tomorrow you come to the school ground, and then I'll talk with you. Okay, fine, I'll come.
en_old: Before, you wronged me, but now it's in my hands. So, father, take it out. Come to the school ground tomorrow and then we'll talk with you. Okay, fine, we'll come.

brh: ہیلو! ارے او وحید! داغ میتہ نا بر۔
en: Hello! Hey, Waheed! Come here.
en_old: Hello! Hey, Waheed! Come here, Mitha.

brh: انت سے؟
en: What is it?
en_old: What is it?

brh: ئے اللہ رہوا
en: Yes, may God keep you.
en_old: Yes, may God keep you.

brh: نی دا ہندا کس کریس کہ ولدا ہوریسے
en: Who did you have in this place, that you keep looking back?
en_old: What did you do here that you keep looking back?

brh: صاحب خیریت ئے زبردست صاحب خیریت ئے صاحب نی تروئی نا کچاس ئے ٹھیک ئے صاحب۔ ہیلو۔ جی۔ مہمان۔
en: Sir, is everything all right? Great, sir, everything's fine. Sir, how much do you have to pay? All right, sir. Hello. Yes. A guest.
en_old: Sir, is everything well? Great, sir, everything is well. Sir, how much do you have to pay? Okay, sir. Hello. Yes. A guest.

brh: دے کچہ سئے؟ جی ہا
en: How many days has it been? Yes.
en_old: How many days has it been? Yes.

brh: ادا بابو خیر اٹ۔ ادی نور خیر اٹ۔ ابا بھائی ماما مستونگ آ ہننگ اٹی نا۔ میر صاحب ماما او۔۔۔
en: Brother Babu, goodbye. Sister Noor, goodbye. Father, brother, uncle, we're going to Mastung. Mir Sahib, uncle, he...
en_old: Brother Babu, goodbye. Sister Noor, goodbye. Father, brother and uncle are going to Mastung. Mir Sahib, uncle, he...

brh: او تو دا گپ ء تپوار کنے شکار کنے۔ وحید ماما رٹیم آ بس پاتہ تنے اسکول نا میدان نا سر کے۔ وحید ہنا ایتے یاد کیس۔ بابا جان خدا حافظ۔ ٹھیک سے اللہ حافظ۔
en: He didn't tell me about this... hunting me. Uncle Waheed came on time and told him to get himself to the school ground. Waheed, go, and remember that. Father dear, goodbye. Okay, goodbye.
en_old: He didn't tell me about this, he was hunting me. Uncle Waheed came on time and told you to come to the school ground. Waheed, go, and remember me. Father, goodbye. Okay, goodbye.

brh: تکمیر خان جی ہمار چیتا منا لکھ روپیہ دادا ویزا بیزا منے دبئی آ روان ادا سنگت ئے پار تنے ئے کلاس ئے او ٹھیک ئے دادا
en: Takmir Khan, yes... a lakh rupees, brother; the visa and all will be done, then off to Dubai. Brother, tell our friend... the class... Okay, brother.
en_old: Takmir Khan, yes, we're taking a lakh rupees, brother, for the visa and such, and sending us to Dubai. Brother, tell our friend about the class. Okay, brother.

brh: دا اتوار خا، دا اتوار خا ہم پارے کہ ئے برے اسکول نا میدانہ گڑا ننے انکار کینہ کہ ننے انکار کینہ۔ او اتوار چائے کہ ئے چاو اسکول نا میدانہ ئے تینٹ کاو نی ہن نصیب اللہ نا برام آ کوئٹہ۔ جیس۔
en: This Aitbar Khan, this Aitbar Khan too said to come to the school ground, so should we refuse, should we refuse? That Aitbar knows I'll go to the school ground; I'll go myself. You go to Naseebullah's wedding in Quetta. Yes.
en_old: Itwar Khan, Itwar Khan also said to come to the school ground, so we're refusing, we're refusing. Itwar knows you'll come to the school ground yourself. You go to Naseebullah's wedding in Quetta. Yes.

brh: منظور ڈیوٹی آ ہننگ اٹی ئس جی او۔
en: Manzoor was going to work, yes.
en_old: Manzoor was going to work, yes.

brh: ایتوار خان اینو پارینے اسکول نا میدانہ ببو ایتوار نا زی اینو ایتوار اف اسہ وار کان اسکول آ حاضر سائیں کان اسکول نا میدانہ ٹھاکر بس کبو اسکول نا میدانہ
en: Aitbar Khan said today: come to the school ground. Aitbar can't be trusted today. Let's go to the school just once. Ready, sir. Let's go to the school ground... just do it at the school ground.
en_old: Itwar Khan said today to come to the school ground. Today isn't Sunday. Be at the school just once, sir, and get ready at the school ground.

brh: ادا میر ندیم بسوٹ تو انت ہیت کسے؟ انت اسے نا ہیت اسے۔
en: Brother Mir Nadeem, I've come, so what's the matter? What sort of matter is it?
en_old: Brother Mir Nadeem, I've come, so what were you saying? What kind of talk is this?

brh: ادا انت مس ادا اعتبار نا زیا ہچو اعتبار اف
en: Brother, what happened? Brother, Aitbar can't be trusted at all.
en_old: Brother, what happened? Brother, trust can't be trusted anymore.

brh: واہ ماما واہ ماما واہ ماما واہ ماما واہ ماما واہ ماما بس داسہ کامبو
en: Bravo, uncle! Bravo, uncle! Bravo, uncle! Bravo, uncle! Bravo, uncle! Bravo, uncle! That's enough now, go.
en_old: Wow, uncle, wow, uncle, wow, uncle, wow, uncle, wow, uncle, wow, uncle! That's enough now, let's go.

brh: اوئے توبہ رے نی دا خرک تے خلنگ ٹی ئس انت کہ دا نا جاہ ہن کپا مار کنا ابا نی دا سہ پیر مسنس نی تول تینا جاہ گا
en: Oh, for God's sake! You were beating these donkeys, what for? Don't go in his place, my son. Father, you have grown so old now; sit in your own place.
en_old: Oh my God, you were hitting these donkeys, what for? Don't take his place, my son. Father, you've grown so old now, sit in your own place.

brh: ہلوڑ کپا مار باوانا ہیتئے من ہنا سئی اوفنے کے جوان مریک جوان مریک ابا گڑا کنا ہیتئے منپیسہ نا ٹھیک ہی گڑا ئے ہنی گٹیٹ
en: Don't make a fuss, son; accept your father's word and go. It will be good for them, it will be good. Father, so you won't accept what I say? Fine, then I'm going.
en_old: Don't fight, son, listen to your father. It's not right to go. It'll be good for them, it'll be good. Father, so you won't listen to me, right? Fine, then I'll go.

brh: اسد دا علاقہ ٹی ننے بدمعاشی کروئی ئے خاخار شاغونی ئے ٹھیک ئے دا نی انت پاس ٹھیک ئے ایلوم بربادی کروئی ئے دا علاقہ ٹی بربادی
en: Asad, in this area we have to act like thugs, we have to set fires, okay? What do you say to this? Okay. Brother, we have to wreak havoc, havoc in this area.
en_old: Asad, in this area we have to act like thugs and spread terror, okay? What are you saying, okay? Otherwise we have to wreak havoc, havoc in this area.

brh: دے کروئی کنا منا راضی بش مبو ہور رینتس
en: This has to be done; I'm agreed. Get up, all of you, look...
en_old: This has to be done. Be pleased with me, just look at it.

brh: اڑے نی انت بیماری ئے اعتبار خان ئے وحید نا دوٹ باز برباد مسٹ انت داغی خلک نی اعتبار خان
en: Hey, what's your illness? Etibar Khan, I've been badly ruined at Waheed's hands. What, did cholera strike you? Etibar Khan...
en_old: Hey, what's wrong with you, Etibar Khan? You've been badly beaten at Waheed's hands. Why did he hit you, Etibar Khan?

brh: ڈاکی کنے خلتو کنے وحید خلک نن گڑا امر کین اعتبار خان اعتبار خان ئے غریب اٹ کنا مدد ء کر
en: Cholera didn't strike me; Waheed struck me. So what should we do, Etibar Khan? Etibar Khan, I'm a poor man, help me.
en_old: It wasn't a robber who beat me, Waheed beat me. So what do we do, Etibar Khan? Etibar Khan, I'm a poor man, help me.

brh: اسد گلاس ء ایت دا دے۔ ہو ہن جانو آئنہ ء
en: Asad, give the glass, this one. Yes, yes, dear...
en_old: Asad, give me that glass. Yes, sure, dear, I'm coming.

brh: صحیح دے خلس ہاؤ صحیح آ مہربانی کڑیں، مہربانی کڑیں مہربانی
en: Hit him properly. Yes, properly. Thank you, thank you, thanks.
en_old: He hit him right. Yes, right, thank you, thank you, thank you.

brh: ادا اینو ندیم ء خلوئی ء نن آ، ہندا ہسخالک ندیم خان۔ ہاؤ۔
en: Here, today we have to strike down Nadeem. That's the one... Nadeem Khan. Yes.
en_old: Here, today we have to kill Nadeem, that's what was said, Nadeem Khan. Yes.

brh: دا نا گنا افم دا دے خلیوا دا نا پٹاک کنے وڑ پاسا خیرو خلستا
en: It's not his fault either; I'll hit this one. His... you tell me how... hit them...
en_old: He's no fool, I'll kill him. His... I won't spare him, I'll kill him.

brh: ارے خدا خل، خل ماتے ایلا نورے تا، دکمیر خان خل تا چٹ کتا دادے اسل
en: Hey, for God's sake, hit! Hit... don't let them go... Dakmir Khan, hit them, finish this one off for good.
en_old: Hey, by God, kill, kill him, don't let him go. Dakmir Khan, kill them, finish this off completely.

brh: ارے جامبو ہتھیار کنے ملا ئے وحیدے خلیوا اڑا اونا بعد دادے سودا کیوا
en: Hey Jambo, I've got a weapon. I'll kill Waheed, hey, and after that I'll strike a deal over this one.
en_old: Hey Jambo, I've got weapons. I'll kill Waheed, and after that I'll make a deal for this.

brh: جمبو ارے وحید ارڑ کے ترا خبر نئے
en: Jambo, hey, where is Waheed? Don't you know?
en_old: Jambo, hey, Waheed... don't you know?

brh: ارے وحید اینو اینے زندہ الیپرا
en: Hey Waheed, today I won't leave you alive.
en_old: Hey Waheed, today I won't leave you alive.

brh: اڑے نم پارے رے ننے پچ اف، ادا پچ آک دادو ہمت کبو پلیبو
en: Hey, you said we don't have any clothes; here are clothes, these ones. Take courage and grab them.
en_old: Hey, you said we don't have clothes. Here are the clothes, have courage and run.

brh: پیر صاحب، امر کرے رے؟
en: Pir Sahib, how did you get on?
en_old: Pir Sahib, how did it go?

brh: اینا اتباری خنا رے اسکول نا میدان۔ جی ہا ادا نن اینا روانہ خلنگ نا تیاری کریسس۔ گڑا او تمک کریر اینو۔ ماما بس اوفتہ بندغس خلک گڑا اتبار نرا۔
en: Did you see Etibar today at the school ground? Yes sir, we had made preparations here today to set out. Then they made their move today. Uncle, he just struck one of their men, and then Etibar ran away.
en_old: Today Etibar... the school ground. Yes, we had made preparations here to send him off. Then they attacked today. Uncle, they just killed one of their men, so Etibar fled.

brh: وحید نی تو چا سا اعتبار نا زئی آ اعتبار اف وحید دا سا اعتبار ایلوئے اف دا سا جنگ نا تیاری کبو جنگ نا تو تیاری کینے لیکن
en: Waheed, you know there's no trusting Etibar. Waheed, now there's no more trust in Etibar. Now get ready for war. We are getting ready for war, but...
en_old: Waheed, you know Etibar's word can't be trusted. Waheed, this Etibar belongs to no one. Get ready for war. We are getting ready for war, but...

brh: منظور نا چھٹی پورا مسنے تو تو الیبو کائت نا ڈپٹی کے اعتبار کنن کن کافی او۔ نا بابا ئے ڈپٹی ہم پارے۔ ڈپٹی ہم پیزے گڑا تیاری کبو جنگ نا۔ اعتبار دا سز نا۔
en: Manzoor's leave is over, so leave it; the deputy is enough to deal with Etibar. The deputy has also told your father. The deputy is also on hand, so get ready for war. Etibar, this is your punishment.
en_old: Manzoor's leave is over, so let the deputy... that's enough to trust. Your father told the deputy as well. The deputy also said so, so get ready for war. This is Etibar's...

brh: ٹھیک بس وائے داسا اعتبار نا زند ایلو یاف
en: Fine, that's it; alas, now Etibar's life is no more.
en_old: Fine, that's it, now Etibar's life is over.

brh: ئے گراٹ وار خانے سولیٹ پرا ہمیدے عام سفرٹ ڈکھے تہ خل گڈو سوٹ نرا ہنا ہینگان ہاؤ سائیں ہاؤ اعتبار خانہ بندغس کنا ہیتس درینے وحید وحید خلک لکھے تہ کزیفے
en: ...Hamid... on an ordinary journey... hit... fled, went off that way. Yes sir, yes. A man of Etibar Khan's brought me word: Waheed, Waheed struck... and killed...
en_old: ...Hamid... on the usual trip... kill... Yes sir, yes. A man of Etibar Khan's told me something: Waheed, Waheed beat him...

brh: ارے خلبہ دا پورائیتے چٹ کبو
en: Hey, hit them! Finish off all of these!
en_old: Hey, kill them, finish all of them off.

brh: سائیں بابا کنا مارے دواس کبو اعتبار خانے او خوامخواہ خون کنا گٹی ئے دواس کبو دا جان تو صحیح مرے جان انڑو دواس کرتا تو بس
en: Sain Baba, pray for my son, Etibar Khan; he is needlessly committing murder. Pray that his life turns out all right; just say a prayer for him now, that's all.
en_old: Sain Baba, pray for my son Aitbar Khan. He's needlessly out for blood. Pray for him, that his life will be all right. Just pray for his life.

brh: برباد مرے بس ختم مرے ننے پیان روشتو بدنام کرے نی ابا دعا کر سائیں بابا اللہ خیر کیک
en: He'll be ruined, he'll just be finished; he has disgraced us... You, father, pray. Sain Baba: God will make it well.
en_old: Ruined, it's just finished, he's disgraced us for the rest of our days. Father, you pray. Sain Baba, God will make it all right.

brh: اڑے درو نی دا خا وخت ارانگ مسونس؟ بس یار اتوار ئس لٹی مسونن پین اراڑے مسونن؟ جوان مس کہ بسونس میر ندیم تو جنگ نا تیاری ئے
en: Hey, where were you all this time yesterday? Well, friend, it was a Sunday; we were lazing around. Where else would we have been? It's good that you've come; Mir Nadeem is preparing for war.
en_old: Hey Daru, where have you been all this time? Well, friend, it was Sunday, I was lying around, where else would I be? Good thing you came, Mir Nadeem is getting ready for a fight.

brh: میر صاحب ما اختت تے مجاہد بے اچارہ۔ توار۔
en: Mir Sahib, we... the poor, helpless mujahid. (A voice.)
en_old: Mir Sahib, our helpless mujahid... (voice).

brh: تمیل ندیم نا بندہ او، اوڑتو وفاداری کتنوں ننتو ہم وفاداری کیرہ۔ واہ کے سئی پاشا، ضرور نی ہم تینا
en: They are Nadeem's men; we have been loyal to him, and they will be loyal to us too. Wow, that's right, Pasha; surely you too, your own...
en_old: We are Nadeem's men. We were loyal to him, and they are loyal to us as well. Wow, Kesai Pasha, you too, surely, your own...

brh: دو اینو حلال کر
en: Slaughter two today.
en_old: Today, sacrifice the two.

brh: سئے اعتبار خان ننتو ناجائز کننگٹی ئے دعا سکا کہ نن کامیاب مرے ابا اللہ مدد ایتے نمتو، مولا علی مدد ایتے نمتو، خدا نمے کامیاب کے۔
en: All right: Etibar Khan is doing wrong by us. Pray that we succeed. Dear, may God help you all, may Mawla Ali help you all, may God make you successful.
en_old: Aitbar Khan is doing wrong by us. Pray hard that we succeed. Father, may God help you, may Mawla Ali help you, may God make you successful.

brh: خان دا لا سیر اسے، نمینا نصیر اسے، ہمت کا جنگ کبو
en: Khan, this is a lion; it is your destiny. Take courage and fight.
en_old: Khan, this is a lion, this is your fate. Have courage and fight.

brh: اتوار تھی مرچی آخری روشے درخو درابی
en: On Sunday... today is the last day...
en_old: Sunday is the last day today, the end of the world.

brh: وحید اینو زندگی نا ختم ئے اعتبار اورے نا کینو دنا زندگی ختم مرے نایا کنا
en: Waheed, today your life is over. Etibar: we'll see whose life ends, yours or mine.
en_old: Waheed, today is the end of your life. Aitbar, come on, let's see whose life ends, yours or mine.

brh: اللہ پاک آن ہچ جتا مفک۔ عیسی نا مننگ نا سبب آن اونا قربانی نما سیادی ء اللہ پاک تون مکمل و پورا کیک۔ مگر ایلو تحفہ غاتا وڑ دا ہمو وخت اسکان نما مفک ہرا وخت
en: ...is not separated from God at all. Because of accepting Jesus, his sacrifice makes your relationship with God complete and whole. But like other gifts, this does not become yours until the time when
en_old: Nothing is separate from God. Because of Jesus, his sacrifice makes your relationship with God complete and whole. But like other gifts, it isn't yours until the time

brh: او امی پنج روپئی والا گولی تے پنج سو آئی تیکن یا توماک نمے ملوک رے شریکو رے نمے تفک لگے گل نان چس او کنا ایلہ نما دے میڈیکل سنبھالیکک ہنی دون ڈار بس ٹوٹ اوئے تاتے گم کدک یار پچ نی نا پاش کیسنی چٹ
en: Hey, those five-rupee pills, [they sell] them for five hundred... or... to you... partners... it seems to you... my brother, your medical [store] takes care of [it] for the day... then just... they lose them, friend... you've exposed it all...
en_old: Hey, they sell those five-rupee pills for five hundred, or tomorrow you'll get them, partner, don't you think so? My brother, your medical store takes care of it... as soon as it arrived, they lost them, friend. Why don't you reveal it at all?

brh: ابو ایلم جان دھیان گنہ پنا ابو ئے خلک دھیان گنہ پنا اللہ کے پووش کنے سکنہ نی کنے ارے او ڈڈو چارجر مئی دھیان لوٹے تفک لگے گولی مولی اسے کنے ارے کنا پنزکوٹائے انت او چارجر پاسہ کنے گونڈ
en: Dad, dear brother, pay attention... he hit Dad, pay attention... by God... do I have it?... that... charger... it seems... I have a pill or something... what about my...? That charger, tell me... short...
en_old: Dad, dear brother, pay attention, he's hitting Dad, pay attention, by God... do you have it for me? That charger... I don't think so, I have a pill or something. What about my wallet? That charger, tell me, short...

brh: اللہ کرے انی کنے اینتئے دم پاچکنے بربٹ چنے دا کدا جتا بھٹور اینے چیلہ خل کو نی کاچمی نا بھٹور مگے ترکی والا میسہ چٹ بھٹور چیلہ خل ارے نیدا ہمے دے ننا امو تاتنا ماتے چیلہ خل کو نس دا ارٹ دے ننا
en: God willing... why did you... my breath... this one is a separate shot, give the injection... the... shot... the Turkish one... give the shot... that same day you gave their mother an injection... these two days of ours...
en_old: God willing, why did you take my breath away... this one is a separate injection, give the injection... you, the Kachmi injection... the Turkish one... the injection is given. That same day they gave their mother an injection, these two days of ours...

brh: کیدانی ننو دے خاچوکم ڈیوٹیا ارے گٹارس ڈیوٹی تیٹک ننم اوڈ گٹار خلیکے کنا خوش نصیب ئے یار میغ ہولز خلیر پئی تک کسویس ئے بے بخت نا ئے دیرے بانگو بابو بابو نزیف ئے خلکو سیلس کش کنا
en: Our day... even the one sleeping is on duty; there's a guitar, during duty we too play the guitar there. It's my good fortune, friend... they give... the unlucky one's... Father, father... gave Nazif a needle... pull out my...
en_old: Our day... is on duty. There's a guitar, during duty we play the guitar there. It's my good fortune, friend... they give injections... the poor unlucky one... Father, father, Nazif gave the injection... my...

brh: نی پاتین نا نی تو فک لگے کس ویسل ئس والا کے پل ڈاکٹر فرشتہ سے نی تو موت نا فرشتہ ئس نی تو فک لگے او خانی سے تو کلانہ تینا مونا کنے تسر نی دا
en: You'd say... it seems... someone... a doctor is an angel, [but] you are an angel of death, it seems to you... oh Khan... in front of yourself... they gave me... you this...
en_old: You'd say... you don't think so, someone... a doctor is an angel, but you're an angel of death, don't you think? Khan... you put it in front of me, you this...

brh: اربستوں گواہی تروکا اینو گڑا شیلے خلیپنہ والا دانام تیمینہ والا وخت ئنا سمیا دفتر یار ارے شیلے قندھاری کنا دنا نری یا بوٹور انت کہ خلے سر تے خلے نی دا خس کننگے با کنا شیلے خلنگے
en: ...the ones who give witness... today then we won't give injections... time... the office, friend, there's the Kandahari injection... my... this one's... or the... what, he gives it... strikes the heads... you're doing this much... my injection is being given.
en_old: Witnesses... today they don't give injections... at this time the office... friend, there's the Kandahari injection, my... what, he hits the head, you're doing so much, my injection is being given.

brh: دا انتو ٹی چھڑا دے اللہ خیری نی دا تفنگٹوس بلا بنگولے ئے مخلوقے بیزار کرینوس ئنا میڈیا والاک مشہور اسے وار نی کونا تے ہلکورے منجھ لٹکی شورے نومے داری دنا انتو اڈے سے خانے نی گڑا پاسے لکھ
en: What is this... only a day, God have mercy, you... you have made people sick and tired; the media people [made it] famous. Once you took the... hang... what is this... Khan, then you say a lakh...
en_old: What is this, just a day, God bless, you didn't... you've tormented people, the media people made it famous. Once you... hang them... say... what is this place, Khan, then you say a lakh...

brh: اینا ٹوپہ تخف تفف تخف رغنہ پیش تامر دنا تینا امر چیلے لگک ایلے بوٹورا خلینتے کل خلے فیروانا آبادی و پردہ گیر ئے ہرا ہرا غیرت مند بوٹورا خل پین چیلے خلے ہنا چیلے دینا نا بوٹورا خلے و نا ڈول ڈول شرینگوس دکانٹ خلے نی امر چیلے
en: Put his cap on... how would his own needle feel? He gives the injections to others... he gives everyone... the population, and the veiled women; whoever is honorable, he gives [them] the... gives yet another injection... gives injections in all sorts of ways, gives them in the shop. How do you [give] injections?
en_old: Put his cap on... how does he give his injection? He gives it to the other ones, he gives everyone... the population is veiled. Whoever is honorable gives the injection, gives another injection... gives injections in all sorts of ways, gives them in the shop. How do you give injections?

brh: او دا پوڈری اسے لغاتی خلسا مخلوق اف تے بے ہوش ہم ولسا سا نا خبر تمپک ننے گولی اسے تے گومرک توفک نا سے انت نا گولی سے تے منے مغز نا نارساک خان نی کلو گراکا کموکا کوکوڑو کرے نراکا ننے نا گراکی ہم خراب کرے سگے
en: And he puts in some powder... makes people unconscious too, and one doesn't even find out. He gives us a pill... what kind of pill is it... the brain's... Khan, you... all the customers... you've ruined our customer base too.
en_old: He puts some powder in and even knocks people unconscious, we don't even know. He doesn't give us a pill, what kind of pill... the nerves of the brain, Khan, you... you made people foolish, you ruined our customers too.

brh: ارے یار ارے دا صفا حکومت ء ودی رہنہ سر عام نا ڈاکٹر نا ہتہ ٹی مچے ہنا کہ دو نمبری انگا کو بغیر کاغذی انگا کو جعلی کو ہائے بشونی گوزبغات ینو مرتہ اوم ڈاکٹر مشورہ کن نمے نمے مرچ شریف ء نم سار اللہ خلئے نی کہ شریف پگنے بس ہرا دے
en: Hey friend, hey, this is clearly [the doing] of the government... openly, in the doctor's hands, all of them, the fake ones, the ones without papers, the counterfeit ones... today... for a doctor's consultation, you, you... by God, may God strike... that Sharif... just whichever day...
en_old: Hey friend, yes, this is clearly the government's doing. Openly, in the doctor's hands, all the fake, unlicensed, counterfeit ones... today they die. For a doctor's consultation... by God... that Sharif... whichever day.

brh: نی نا ایڑے لوسے لوسہ وہ مسٹمی دے ملانی میڈیکل ڈاکٹر مسنے باوہ کے کنے ئے لونڈو نی نا ایڑے سنت نا ٹھیکیدار فک لسی استے کڈک تینا سنت ہم داسے مہنگا مسنے خانیک واہ اوڑم
en: Your sister... on the third day... the mullah has become a medical doctor... father... boy, your sister... the circumcision contractor... takes out... even his circumcision has become so expensive now. The Khans, wow...
en_old: You there, on the fifth day... has become a medical doctor... father... boy, you there, the circumcision contractor, you think... take it out... even his circumcision has become this expensive, Khan, wow.

brh: نی اتراسک؟ ہنداکے مہنگا مسونے سنت نا خن اٹ۔ ارے پٹرول الے مہنگا ئے او تو ہک لگے سنت نا کاریم پٹرول تو انت مہنگنی ئے ٹرک اسے چلیفیسے مخلوق ئے ٹرک اٹ سنت کننگ اٹی ئس خنک توبہ۔
en: How much are you [charging]? It's become this expensive for a circumcision. Hey, petrol is expensive, [but] he [thinks] circumcision work [is like] petrol? What's so expensive about it, are you driving a truck? People [would] see circumcision being done in a truck. God forbid!
en_old: How much are you? It's become so expensive for the circumcision. Hey, petrol is expensive, he thinks the circumcision work... petrol, what's so expensive about it, he's driving a truck, people see circumcisions being done in a truck, God forbid.

brh: او پیسہ کشوئی یار داسہ نی مسس سنگت نی داسہ پاش پاش پان پین ہما کینہ یار یا پیسہ کشیرے گدان غریبہ گدان کنومے اللہ خلے کے شریف پکنومے اسہ ٹس خوانیندا وڈا ڈاکٹر ئس مائیوشس ئے اخبارے چپی خواناسہ درو بے وڈا ڈاکٹر مسس
en: Money has to be taken, friend. Now you've become a friend, now say it openly, what else shall we do, friend? Or you take money... from the tent, from the poor man's tent... may God strike... Sharif... he studied a little bit, became a big doctor... reads the newspaper upside down, [and] yesterday he became a big doctor.
en_old: He's going to take money, friend. Now you've become a friend, now tell it openly, what else can we do, friend, or they take money... the poor... God bless Sharif... he studied a little, became a big doctor... reads the newspaper upside down... became a big doctor.

brh: کوشش کن کہ ئے راہ نو دے قسمے دروشک خناٹ نی سہی کلس یا آئس کریم سودا کریس ڈولی سیٹی وداسے ڈاکٹر ہراڑ کورچ کریس نی خلے نقل کرین پاس کرین تینے دا کہ ڈاکٹر خوانان مچہ ایل کرین منے دے تو سیلان
en: Try... which way... the other day I saw you... you were selling ice cream... with a whistle... now a doctor? Where did you do [your] course? You cheated and passed, [telling] yourself 'I studied to be a doctor', left everything, and today you [give] injections.
en_old: Try... in which way... you went... or bought ice cream... a doctor, where did you study? You cheated and passed, telling yourself you'd study to be a doctor, you left it all... and today the injections...

brh: ہم بتو کنے ننے اچ نمو خسیلے خلکو تے اینو اسکم پٹنگ ننے ئے بائے بلوچستان نا اللہ خیر کیوے سجا خیر کیو حکومت تے اللہ آباد کے نم کونا تے ننے گرت منے تسنے وا اللہ خیر دے مخلوق ننا کسر افک ڈاکٹرے ڈرپ
en: ...come to me too... the injections you gave... today [they are] looking for us... of Balochistan... may God do good, may He do good to all, may God keep the governments prosperous... you gave us... and may God grant good; people, we have no way out... the doctor, the drip...
en_old: Come to us too... the injections they gave, today they're searching for us... of Balochistan, may God do good, may He do good, may God keep the government prosperous. You gave us... and may God do good, people, we have no way, the doctor, the drip...

brh: پشکلک دا ڈرپ پازیدا خپاجی ڈرپ خلنگ ئس مخلوق ئے کہ کس کستادے واری شماری کا اٹ بندغے کس فینوس والام ڈاڑے کس شریف بک نی توفک زدے ہم جئے پی است کنا ایسس ہمے مائیں سیلس خلکوٹ کسک یار کسک امرے کسک پگے
en: ...this drip... giving a drip to people, so that someone... in turns... a person... someone... Sharif... you... my... the same... I gave an injection [and] he died, friend, he died, how did he die...
en_old: ...this drip... giving drips to people, that someone... taking turns, a person... someone... Sharif... you don't think so... my... the same... I gave injections, he dies, friend, he dies, how does he die...

brh: خلے خلے ستین اسے غاتے کونگو نکاٹومینا بھنڈی کاٹومی بلا پیڈے تو خازگو پوتنا ننگند برے کسپہ کھڈا سٹے ملخس کشکونے اوے نال پوتنا ننگند کھیک دونکھے تلا پٹ پوتگل مرے انو یار یار کچکی کرے کرندنا ننگنے خل
en: Give it, give it... the... the head's... okra... the... head... the pit... took out a locust... friend, friend, he made a mess... give...
en_old: He gives, he gives... a needle... cut the okra... the dog... he took out... with it... the dog... friend, friend, he did badly... gave...
