en_old: Ah, I have to give a phone number to someone, I'll be back; make tea for me. Hey, why are you telling the things in your heart?

brh: تے پا پسی تو نی پاتے نی تاکہ ئسیٹ آن تو جان چٹے اوئے باز ہوشیاری کننگ نا استے نی نا اوئے پولیس والا سے اوٹ کن تو ہوشیاری کننگ نا ضرورت اف پپا سوسے یار رمزو جان نیا کنا کواک
en: ...you said that you'd be rid of... Hey, you're very keen on acting clever. Hey, I'm a policeman, there's no need to act clever with me... friend Ramzu, dear, you're my...
en_old: ...say, you said that you'd be rid of... Hey, you need to be very clever. You're a policeman, there's no need to be clever for... Ramzu, my dear...

brh: دے تینا برباد کننگٹیس اینک اراغا عید ی چناتے تینا کئے عید ی کئے چناک نا انتظار ئے کننگٹیر نی داڑے ہمک کننگٹیس اینک اوئے نی ہم داں بسسے مگر نا چناک نی اراغان کشانو اللہ نا مہربانی تو کنا جی
en: You're ruining your day. Now, where is the Eid money for your children? The children are waiting for the Eid money. What are you doing here now? Hey, you've come here too, but your children — where have they taken you out from? — By God's grace, my dear.
en_old: You're wasting your day. Now where is the Eidi? The children are waiting for my Eidi. What are you doing here now? Hey, you've come here too, but where did you bring your children from? By God's grace, my dear.

brh: کنا چناتا لائق او کاروبار کیرے کنے آزاد کرینو انتس کہ کیو کنا مرضی ہی
en: My children are capable and run a business; they have set me free, so whatever I do is my own choice.
en_old: My children are capable, they run a business, they've set me free; whatever I do is my own choice.

brh: ارواح سبزو اللہ خوش کے تینا ارواح تو سنگتاک بنگورے میر صاحب نا زیبدار آ ہیتاتے انشاءاللہ دونو پروگرام نم کے ہتسا کرون نما باز باز مہربانی
en: May his spirit stay fresh, may God keep his spirit happy. So, friends, you have heard Mir sahib's fine words. God willing, we will keep bringing you programs like this. Many, many thanks to you.
en_old: Bless his soul, may God be pleased with his soul. So, friends, you heard Mir sahib's beautiful words. God willing, we will bring you more programs like this. Thank you very much.

brh: باوہ لمہ ایڑ لم ارمان تے اٹ کرور نی گم سیال عزیزاک نی تو نا وار لہتے سکان برور اکروم باوہ لمہ ایڑ لم ارمان
en: Father, mother, sister and brother will lose you, full of regret; your relatives and loved ones will come along with you only as far as the grave... father, mother, sister and brother, with regret...
en_old: Father, mother, sister, brother will weep with longing; your lost kin and relatives, your turn will come within a few... father, mother, sister, brother with longing

brh: آتے اٹ کرور نی گم سیال عزیزاک نی تونا وار لھتس کان برورک رم زوزو شاغور مشتے نیا تے خور خلیا خیشتے نیا خیال کر مچٹ ایلم کنا دے
en: ...they will lose you, full of regret; your relatives and loved ones will come along with you as far as the grave. Hurriedly, quickly they will pour handfuls of earth onto you and lay bricks over you. Think a little, my brother: one day...
en_old: ...they will weep; your kin and relatives, your turn will come within a few... the poor ones... think, my brother, one day...

brh: خالق کرم چٹ ایلم کنا دے ئس دا کاہنوئی ئے وقتس اچانک گاڑی سلو عزرائیل نا سائے ہلو خیسن نا راڈو چلوے دوتے آنے پینس ملو
en: Think a little, my brother: one day you will have to leave this place. At some moment the vehicle of your life will suddenly stop and the shadow of Azrael, the angel of death, will seize you. Your gold Rado watch will keep running, and it will be unbuckled from your hands... [one word unclear].
en_old: O Creator, have mercy... think, my brother, one day you will go. Suddenly the vehicle will stop, the shadow of Azrael will take you, ... your hands and feet will be bound(?)

brh: دین پچاتے کشور شاغور کفن خیال کر مچیٹ ایلم کنا دے ئس دا کہن اوئے تنگ تہار مہو جاگہ سینا تہیٹی نی تموئے دنیا
en: They will take off your clothes and put a shroud on you. Think a little, my brother: one day you will have to leave this place, and you will have to fall into a narrow, dark, black place. The world...
en_old: They will take off your clothes and dress you in a shroud. Think, my brother, one day you will go to a narrow, dark place and fall into it, O world...

brh: تاتو گھٹ س شام و سحر یاد بفس قبر حشر خیال کر مچٹ ایلم کنا دے ئس دا کہن اوئے پکا غماڑی محل و مکن
en: You are busy with the world evening and morning; you do not remember the grave or the Day of Resurrection. Think a little, my brother: one day you will have to leave here, leaving solid mansions, palaces and houses...
en_old: ...many an evening and morning, remember the grave and the Day of Judgment. Think, my brother, one day you will go, leaving solid palaces and houses.

brh: کچا غا کوٹی مونا گدان خنتی کرے سر پینا مروڑ ہنتری تٹی تاس امان پکا غماڑی محل و مکان کچا غا کوٹی مونا گدان خنتی کرے سر
en: ...mud-walled rooms with a tent in front... [unclear] ...will become someone else's... [unclear]. Solid mansions, palaces and houses, mud-walled rooms with a tent in front... [unclear]
en_old: A mud room, a tent in front... your head... solid palaces and houses; a mud room, a tent in front... your head...

brh: درپنا مرو ہنت ریتٹی تاسمان ہرتو مادو کنے خالی مرو خنتانی زیہا پچستفور ہرتو مادو کنے خالی مرو خنتانی زیہا پچستفور خیال کر مچے
en: ...will become someone else's... [unclear]. Both your hands will be empty, and they will tie a cloth over your eyes; both your hands will be empty, and they will tie a cloth over your eyes. Think a little, my brother...
en_old: ...will be... your eyes will be left empty... think, my brother...

brh: ٹی ایلوم کنا دے است دا کہن اوئی ئے تنگ تہار مہو جاگہ سے نا تٹی نی تموئی ئے دنیا تو گھٹوس شام و سحر یاد بفسا قبر حشر خیال کر مچٹی ایلوم کنا
en: ...my brother: one day you will have to leave here, and you will have to fall into a narrow, dark, black place. You are busy with the world evening and morning; you do not remember the grave or the Resurrection. Think a little, my brother...
en_old: ...think, my brother, one day you will go to a narrow, dark place and fall into it. O world, many an evening and morning, remember the grave and the Day of Judgment. Think, my brother...

brh: مستو جوانی خنوس ورنا دوتے مونٹی خلوس خیال کر مچٹ ایلم کنا دے ئس دا کا ہنوئی ئے تنگ تہار مہو جاگہ سے نا تٹی نی تموئی ئے
en: You will see your heady youth go by, young man, and you will put your hands to your face. Think a little, my brother: one day you will have to leave here, and you will have to fall into a narrow, dark, black place.
en_old: You saw a youth full of intoxication, young ones raised their hands before you. Think, my brother, one day you will go to a narrow, dark place and fall into it.

brh: ئے دنیا تو گٹس شام و سحر یاد بفسا قبر حشر خیال کر مچیٹ ایلم کنا دیس دا کان ہنوئی ئے اللہ تے نا یاد کر کا
en: ...you will have to fall in. You are busy with the world evening and morning; you do not remember the grave or the Resurrection. Think a little, my brother: one day you will have to leave here. Remember your God...
en_old: ...the world is just a... morning and evening, don't you remember the grave and the Day of Judgment? Think, my brother, one day I have to leave this place; keep remembering Allah.

brh: آخرت آباد کراک غم تہ سہہ دنیا نا مگر ئے غم تیان آزاد مراک اللہ ہی تینا یاد کراک آخرت آباد کراک غم تہ سہہ دنیا نا مگر
en: Build up your hereafter; bear the sorrows of this world, but become free of those (other) sorrows. Remember your God, build up your hereafter; bear the sorrows of this world, but...
en_old: Whoever builds up the hereafter will be freed from the sorrows of this world; Allah Himself remembers them. Whoever builds up the hereafter, the sorrows of this world...

brh: ئے غم تیان آزاد مروک سخت و خراب ہاس وقتس مرو پسنگ و کا بد بختس مرو خیال کر مچے ٹی علم کنا دے ئس دا کہنوئی یے تنگ تہار مہو جاگس نا تے
en: ...become free of those sorrows. A hard and bad time will come; an ill-fated [unclear word] time will come. Think a little, my brother: one day you will have to leave here, (into) a narrow, dark, black place...
en_old: ...will be free of sorrows. There will be a hard and bad time, there will be a wretched one. Think, my brother, one day I have to go to a narrow, dark place.

brh: دین اٹ تموئی ئے دنیا تو گھٹس شام و سحر یاد بفسا قبر حشر خیال کر مچھٹ ایلم کنا دے ئس دا کاہنوئی ئے
en: ...you will have to fall into it. You are busy with the world evening and morning; you do not remember the grave or the Resurrection. Think a little, my brother: one day you will have to leave here.
en_old: You must turn to religion; the world is just a... morning and evening, don't you remember the grave and the Day of Judgment? Think, my brother, one day I have to go.

brh: ہن مقصد یعنی دا تے نیم نیم کرایہ او کنا پورا۔ تو نا خطرہ پا وہ کہ نازیہ بوجھ مف۔ ئے لم جان کنے ہچ تکلیف اف انشاءاللہ صب برو۔
en: Yes, the point is, I mean: half-and-half rent for them, and mine in full. I'm saying it for your sake, so that it won't be a burden on you. Oh dear brother, it's no trouble for me at all; God willing, (he) will come in the morning.
en_old: Yes, the point is, half and half of the rent, and mine in full. So I'm worried that it shouldn't be a burden. Brother dear, it's no trouble for me at all; God willing, it will come tomorrow.

brh: نہ گلیلو ما مرینگنے ہا بس ملیٹر مونی ایندا تو واللہ جوان سما تموئے بس پولیس کنے آزمائفوس ایوارس آزمائفنگ نا ضرورت ئے دا گتنی اریرے خواجہ
en: No... [unclear] ...yes, just the military in front, like this, and then, by God, you'll understand properly. Will you test me just like the police do? Is there any need to test (me) once more? These are... [unclear], sir.
en_old: No... just the military ahead... by God, you'll understand it well. The police tested me only once; is there any need to test again? These are hard times, Khawaja.

brh: ئے تو اینے پینجا غسی شانتے وا؟ نہ نہ بے بے صاحبہ، ہچ مسلہ اف۔ میڈم نم حکم کبو، نن تینا کمرہ ٹی جاگہ ایتنہ تے۔ آ، نہ بے بے ننہ ہچ اعتراض اف۔ امر خیر محمد؟
en: So will you put him somewhere else today? No, no, Bibi Sahiba, no problem at all. Madam, you just give the order; we'll give him a place in our own room. Ah, no, Bibi, we have no objection at all. Right, Khair Muhammad?
en_old: ...so will you give him five...? No, no, Bibi Sahiba, no problem at all. Madam, just say the word, we'll make room for them in our room. Ah, no, Bibi, we have no objection at all. What do you say, Khair Muhammad?

brh: بلکل بلکل اناڑی کنتو اوار کمرہ ٹی مروئی ہا دا تو باز جوان مس نی کنا مچ آ بوجھ ئے چفس دا کرایہ دار اینو پد نی تو نا کمرہ ٹی رہنگوئی دا سا کنے اجازت میڈم توسا سے خدمت سے چا بسکوٹ
en: Absolutely, absolutely, Anari will have to stay in the room together with me. Yes, this has turned out very well; you've taken my whole burden off me. From today on, this tenant will have to stay with you in your room. Now, with your permission, madam, (let me offer) a little hospitality: tea and biscuits.
en_old: Absolutely, absolutely, Anari will stay in the room with me. Yes, that's very good, you've lifted a burden off my whole... this tenant, from today you will stay in your own room. Now with your permission, madam, let me serve you some tea and biscuits.

brh: مہربانی مہربانی، پین تیوہ سینا چائے کونے وا، داسہ کنے اجازت، گڑا اللہ نگہبان۔ بر، بر تئی ٹی بر، بر۔
en: Thank you, thank you. I'll have tea some other time. Now please excuse me, so God protect you. Come, come, come inside, come.
en_old: Thank you, thank you. Will you have another cup of tea? Now, if you'll excuse me, God protect you. Come, come inside, come.

brh: خیال خیال دانگ خنتتے نا ڈمپل کپہ نا جاگہ ایدے ئے جاگہ ئس خنان وٹی برک بش
en: Careful, careful! This way... don't [unclear: 'dimple'] your eyes. This one is your place. I found a place... [unclear]... up.
en_old: Think, think... the dimples of your eyes... where is your place? I saw a place, it comes in... nice.

brh: دا زکنائی تے جوانیٹ خفتو دا کمرے اگر دا کمرے ٹی نی جوانی کریس تو نن اوار مرون نتھو
en: Keep this [unclear] well, this room. If you behave well in this room, then we'll get along together; otherwise...
en_old: Take good care of this beauty... this room; if you do well in this room, we'll be together...

brh: ٹاٹا بائے بائے ایلم جانی ئے نی مالو پاریٹ ئے اسہ غریب و مسکین و بندغس اٹ نمے انشااللہ کنے آن ہچو شکایت ئس مفرو ایلم کنا
en: Ta-ta, bye-bye. Dear brother, I told you before: I am a poor, humble person. God willing, you will have no complaint about me at all, my brother.
en_old: Ta-ta, bye-bye, brother dear. I told you before, I'm a poor, humble person; God willing, you'll have no complaint about me, my brother.

brh: ہاں بس تو گڑا نی کنا رازدار مروس۔ رازدار؟ ہن مطلب؟ مطلب دا چٹھی ئے تینا زیبانہ پنا لکھوے۔ چٹھی؟ زیبا؟
en: Yes, well, then you'll be my confidant. A confidant? Meaning what? Meaning, write this letter to my Zeba. A letter? Zeba?
en_old: Yes, then you'll be my confidant. Confidant? Meaning what? Meaning, write this letter in the name of your Zeba. Letter? Zeba?

brh: دانا مطلب دادے چٹھی ذرا سیاں کے نام لکھ دے حال مرا دل کا تمام لکھ دے ہمن نی یار نی تو باز سمجھدارو بندغ اسس باز ہوشیارو بند
en: That means this: 'Write a letter to my beloved, write the whole state of my heart' (Urdu song lines). Yes, friend, you are a very sensible person, a very clever person.
en_old: That means: 'Write a letter to my beloved, write my heart's whole condition.' Yes, friend, you are a very sensible person, a very clever person.

brh: توبہ توبہ توبہ توبہ یا اللہ خیر معاف کے او ایلم ننا ایت کپہ دا برائی دونو کاریم زندگیٹ کتل قران
en: God forbid, God forbid, God forbid! O Allah, have mercy, forgive (me)! Oh brother, don't say such things to us. This is a sin; I have never done such a thing in my life, I swear on the Quran.
en_old: God forgive me, God forgive me! O Allah, have mercy, forgive us. Brother, don't make us do this; such a sinful act in life... the Quran.

brh: باز جوان کریس عالم بیال مروز گلی تے ٹی کاغذ مچ کروز ئنا چناک فوڈٹ خلور نی ہا بابا ہیلنت ئے تو مفتٹ پاسنگٹ فریٹ
en: Very well done! You'll end up wretched, collecting scraps of paper in the streets, and your children will [unclear] beat you. Yes, mister... [unclear] ...you'll get trapped for nothing...
en_old: Very well done! You'll end up wandering, collecting scraps of paper in the streets, and your children will die of hunger. Yes, father, learn it, otherwise you'll fail for nothing.

brh: نی مفت اٹی مرو پاسنگس بس یار نی لی دا ہیتاتے کنا برام مس کنا وزیر نی مروس وزیر آہ آہ ہن مرو
en: You'll get me trapped for nothing. Come on, friend, (listen to) these words: when I get married, you will be my vizier (the bridegroom's best man). Vizier? Ah, ah, yes, so be it.
en_old: You'll fail for nothing... just, friend, these words of yours... when I get married, you'll be my minister. Minister? Ah, ah, yes, it will be.

brh: ہو یار بادشاہ تو وزیرس مریگنے وزیرس دس کنا برامتنی یار کنا ارا عمرے دا عمرے برام کننگنا ادا سنیورت
en: Yes, friend, a king (the bridegroom) has a vizier, a vizier... my wedding, friend. What is my age? This is the age for getting married, brother; it's the Sunnah...
en_old: Yes, friend, a king has a minister, a minister... my marriage, friend, my age... this is the age to get married...

brh: خوشبو بے بے داسکانے برام کتنے جان جان داسہ پومسٹ مچے ہستے ہستے نی خبر افتا دیوار تیام خفرے دن مف کے ئنا ایتا تے خوشبو بے بے
en: Khushbu Bibi hasn't married until now? Dear, dear, now I understand. Gently, gently! Don't you know the walls have ears? Don't let it happen that your words... Khushbu Bibi.
en_old: Khushbu Bibi, have you married until now? Dear, dear, now the postman... slowly, slowly, don't you know the walls have ears? Don't let it happen that your words... Khushbu Bibi.

brh: بے بے نا خط ئے سرکار بس سلے دا ایتا تے ایلو ایتا تے واللہ پاوا یار داسہ نی تینے سادہ کھپہ تے نی
en: Bibi's letter, sir... just stop, this talk and that talk. By God, I'm telling you, friend, don't play innocent now.
en_old: Bibi's letter, sir, just... give this to them, give that to the others. By God, I'm telling you, friend, now don't play innocent.

brh: دز دز دز دز اوئے لمہ جان دان تے سما چپ تمن ئنا ایو چھپ چھپ خیری ئنا
en: Thief! Thief! Thief! Thief! Oh, mother dear... hush, hush. Are you all right?
en_old: Shh, shh, shh, shh! Oh mother dear, don't let them find out. Quiet, quiet, is everything okay?

brh: دا بولو امبار کیرے دیوال نا چسی ئے بول خلنگا ٹیوس خیری ئنا چاوہ کہ خوشبو بے بے تو کاری مسرے نی اڑے اگر کاری مسرے غٹ لیمو نی کھنے پا ئے کاوا پا
en: What's all this? You were making noise down by the wall. Are you all right? You know, Khushbu Bebe, did you get hurt? Hey, if you've been hurt, tell me everything. Tell me and I'll go.
en_old: This ... the wall's ... smells nice, Bebe. If it's done, then tell me. If it's done, then lemon ... tell me, I'll go.

brh: او خیرات کنے اوڑتو ہچو کاری بسلو کنا پینجٹی خلٹس ئے مچے برزاشے بسوٹے چاو کہ پینجٹی نہ خلٹسہ کہ غم کپہ کنتو ہندون
en: Oh dear, nothing has happened to me. I just knocked myself on something. I was going up and down a little, you know, and that's how I knocked myself. So don't worry, that's just how it is with me.
en_old: Oh, it's fine, nothing happened to me. I just bumped my ... I was going up and down, you know, and I bumped it. Don't worry, that's just how it is with me.

brh: جوان او پکی ارے اگہ اتپتنے نی خالی کھنٹے ہندنو سارے غاما خلس کہ دا گلی والک زیانہ مچ مروک حیران مروک کہ دا دیرے ئے خیرات کنے پکی نہ ضرورت اف ئے ہندن ورزش کیوہ برزا شیف کیوہ تا
en: Fine. And is there any medicine powder? If not, you'd have raised such an uproar that the people of this lane would have gathered in crowds, astonished, wondering who this is. Dear, I don't need any powder. I'm just exercising like this, going up and down.
en_old: Fine, it's cooked. If you hadn't ..., you would have just ... done something that would make the people of this lane gather, surprised, wondering what's going on. Oh, it's fine, no need for cooking. I'm just exercising like this, going up and down.

brh: نی کلہ تکلیف بور مریک؟ ولے دا پا کہ نی انت تکلیف اسس کہ دا نیم ننا داڑے تولوک ئس بس ئے دراصل دادے کہ بس ئے پیشم پیش تماٹ حویلی ٹی ئے پاریٹ مچے ہنارے لیٹی استار آتے حساب کیو نوا کہ
en: When are you ever bothered by any trouble? But tell me, what trouble do you have that you're sitting here in the middle of the night? Actually, it's just that I came out into the courtyard and told myself I'd lie down there for a while and count the stars, maybe.
en_old: Since when do you get bored of pain? But tell me what pain you had that made you sit here half the night. Actually, I came out into the courtyard early and said I'd go lie down and count the stars.

brh: توغ بریک نی او خیرات نی توغ والا گولی چٹے وی سوب اسکان نن خاچوس نن آرام کروسہ گنوک! بس بس ضرورت اف نی گولی نا، گولی ئے توس کنے گڑا جوان۔
en: Are you able to sleep? Oh dear, take your sleeping pill so we can sleep until morning and get some rest. Crazy! Enough, enough, I don't need your pill. If you'd given me the pill, then fine.
en_old: Can you sleep? Oh, it's fine, take your sleeping pill so we can rest until morning. Crazy! Enough, enough, there's no need for your pill. If you give me the pill, then fine.

brh: کنا ٹھونگانی نوٹ نی چاو کہ گولی باز کنگونوسہ ہنا خاطرا ہندونس دن کہ مولی ئے یخ ہلی کنے ضرورت اف گولی تا او خیرات کنا بلا خان نی ہندارے تول استاراتے حساب کر
en: My... you know the pills affect me badly. That's why it's like this... I don't need pills. Oh dear, my dear Khan, you just sit here like this and count the stars.
en_old: My ... You know pills make me very dizzy, so it's like that. I don't need pills. Oh, it's fine, my dear, just sit like this and count the stars.

brh: ئے نا ٹک تو تندورے او خن نی چم پد تمے یا نا مکھ کلون پغاث
en: You're as hot as an oven, and look, your eyes have sunk back, and your face has gone dark.
en_old: Your ... is like an oven. Look, your eyes have sunk in and your face is swollen.

brh: اینو اسکان ئے خوش
en: I've been happy up until today.
en_old: Happy until today.

brh: او بے بے ادن مونجا خنتنوٹ خبرہ فنسوچ خلکک چاو کہ او دے سہر نا ضرورت ئے بس ئے او دے دا سہرہ ایٹوٹ انشااللہ خیر
en: Oh Bebe, I've never seen you this sad. I've been thinking... you know, the wedding garland (sehra) will be needed that day. Just, on that day I'll present this sehra. God willing, all will be well.
en_old: Oh Bebe, I saw a dream earlier ... the talk ... you know he needs the morning. I'll keep him for this morning. God willing, all will be well.

brh: مامت یا اللہ کنا است نا مراد آتے پورا کیس ہر گندہ شیطان نا تمنو
en: Amen. O God, fulfil the wishes of my heart, and may every wicked devil fall.
en_old: Mother, oh God, fulfill my heart's wishes and keep away every evil devil.

brh: او خیر انتس پٹنگ اٹی ئس دن پریشان سلوک ئس نی نی دنو ہچو ہیتس اف۔ ارے پریشان ئس خیرے گڑاس نا گمسونے تو پا۔ نی نی ہچس اف۔
en: Oh, is everything all right? What are you looking for? Why are you standing there so worried? No, no, it's nothing like that. Come on, you are worried. Is everything all right? If you've lost something, tell me. No, no, it's nothing.
en_old: Oh, is everything okay? What are you looking for? Why are you standing there so worried? You... it's nothing like that. Yes, you're worried. Is everything okay? If you've lost something, tell me. It's nothing for you to worry about.

brh: بس اندو؟ ایڑا نا گم مسنے تو کنے با مسئلہ نا حل کیوئے، ایچو مسئلہ سف یار، نوم پولیس والا کیرے سے بھانس خواری ئے تس مارے بس پولیس والا تنے سر کیرے، ہن بئے خارے متے نا کر، او پولیس والا دا خارے
en: Is that all? If your sister has gone missing, come to me and I'll solve the problem. It's not that kind of problem, friend. You police people... gave a lot of trouble, son. The police just... themselves. Go on, come on, don't get worked up. Oh, this policeman is angry.
en_old: Is that all? If you've lost your sister, then come to me and I'll solve the problem. It's no problem, friend. The police ... gave a lot of trouble ... then the police will ... go, come ... that policeman ...

brh: ایمانداری ٹی مخلوق نا مسئلہ غاتے حل کے، پریشانی تے ختم کے، پومزوز، بیزار اینو مئین، نما نہ سنگتی جوانی نہ دشمنی، این بھائی این تینا کاریم ء کرک، ہو ئے تو کاوہ، ولے نی دا باغ نی دا ازغند تینا کاریم آن تینتو نس، پومزوز
en: He solves people's problems honestly and puts an end to their worries, understand? I'm fed up today. Neither your friendship is any good nor your enmity. Look, brother, mind your own work. Yes, I'm going, but you, this garden, this... from your own work... understand?
en_old: Solve people's problems honestly, put an end to their troubles ... I'm fed up today. Not your friendship, nor your enmity. Brother, today I'm doing my own work. Yes, I'll go, but you, this garden, this thorn ... from your own work ...

brh: ئے کاو یمپر نین تینا کاریمے کٹاو، خیر ئے تو کاوے، ولے دا پاو نی کہ نن نیتے ہندون کشنگے کٹ سس تمام تمے پبو مسس، ئنا خاطر ئے تو ننے
en: I'll go over there; we'll get on with our own work. Fine, I'm going, but you tell me this: we pulled you out like this... it was all over... it was for your sake that we...
en_old: Should I come up? We'll do our own work. Fine, I'll go, but tell me: we were so worn out, everything was finished ... that's why we ...

brh: پھری مفنے او بکواس گپہ ایرا گنے توفرے اوٹ او مسوسہ سدا مرگ سدا اوٹ بلاک مونی
en: Hasn't it...? Oh, don't talk nonsense... two... always... always...
en_old: Didn't it ... that nonsense talk ... always death ... always ...

brh: خیر ئے نو مونا کٹورم باریا ڈی تینا مونا ہور دن کے قصاب نا دکان اٹ شوٹنگ ئے خیر ئے واہ
en: Well, now look ahead, look in front of you: there's a shooting at the butcher's shop, just like that. Well, wow.
en_old: Well, now in front ... ahead of him ... there's a shooting at the butcher's shop. Well, wow.

brh: نی ونت چھٹی کرینوس؟ ئے چکرس بس ہندن۔ نی خیری؟ کنے تو چکرس لگنگے دا پاک واد مروڑ سلنگے نی او خیری۔ بئے دا کنے پا عید
en: Have you taken time off? Just a little stroll, that's all. Are you all right? I'm feeling a bit dizzy, and there's this cramp... Are you all right? Come, tell me about Eid.
en_old: Did you take time off? Just a little outing, that's all. Are you okay? It feels like an outing to me too ... are you okay? Come, tell me about Eid.

brh: استر آ کھاؤ یا امپر ہا؟ خنا مرضی۔ دینی اینا ریپیٹ کے نی اینو انتئے وقتی بسنس؟ ہاہاہا ولے خیرو اسہ اینت ئس پانے۔ نی یا قسط کے کنڈے تلا خلنگ کیسہ خل ولے ہچ ئس
en: Will you go down there or up there? It's your choice. Repeat today's... Why did you come early today? Hahaha. But Khairo has said something. You can either pay in instalments or throw it down on the floor in the corner, throw it, but it's nothing.
en_old: Will you eat in bed or up there? It's your choice. Repeat today's ... Why did you come early today? Hahaha, but well, he said something. You can put the installment under the corner, put it there, but nothing.

brh: دا نا مطلب دادے کہ دھام برام نا چک
en: What this means is: the fanfare of a grand wedding...
en_old: This means Dham Bram's ...

brh: ولے خوشبو بے بے نا برام مست و کھنتو مریک؟ انتئے کہ خوشبو بے بے کنے دوست ہیک۔ دراصل نی دم کرک دا کل بسکوٹاتیان ایرا ایرا ڈبہ داڑے پک۔
en: But will Khushbu Bebe's wedding happen before...? Because I'm fond of Khushbu Bebe. Actually, wait a moment: put two boxes of each of these biscuits here.
en_old: But why would Khushbu Bibi's celebration be happy and joyful? Because Khushbu Bibi likes me. Actually, wait a moment, put two boxes of each of these biscuits here.

brh: او افطاری نا وخت مسٹ ایٹی ئنا ایرا پئی کٹے باقر خانی نا پٹیک کنے۔ پین ہکم کمو اینو ما پین انت خدمت کننگ کیو۔ انت مطلب؟ ئے پومتو اٹ۔ مطلب دادے کہ نما خدمت کننگاٹی کنے۔
en: Oh, it's iftar time. Give me two of these, and boxes of baqarkhani. Any other order? What other service can I do for you today? What do you mean? I didn't understand. I mean that I'm at your service.
en_old: Oh, at iftar time, two pieces of baqarkhani for me. Any other order? What else can I do for you today? What do you mean? I didn't understand. I mean that I'm here to serve you.

brh: واہ خرم ایچس مریس دا خیراتی کلہنگوک دیرے سنگت خیرو خواہ مخواہ نا توختے فننگٹیء نا توختے خو ئے تو انخیالی نا گلا مچے دانگ با
en: Wow, Khurram, what's become of you? Who is this one handing out charity? Friend Khairo, you're wasting your time for nothing... Me, I... come over this way a little.
en_old: Wow Khurram, what are you doing? This charity is being handed out, my friend Khairo, you're needlessly wasting time... it's just a pile of nonsense.

brh: مہر لگا کنا ارادہ کنا یار انشو
en: I've fallen in love. My mind is made up, my friend, God willing.
en_old: I've fallen in love, that's my intention, my friend Anshu.

brh: سوجنگٹی ئس او ہمدا مسخرہ نا سوجنگا ببندی لنگوگے ئے سوجنگا برے کنا مطلب دا افک ئے پاوہ کہ عید خڑک بننگٹی ئے چاوہ کہ
en: You're thinking, and this joker is thinking too... What I mean is, I'm saying that Eid is getting close, you know.
en_old: Thinking... and this joker is thinking too... I don't mean to say that Eid is coming close, I know that...

brh: دا زو چنگٹ کنا یار او بس انداڑس نا وار سواری کڑا سوچاٹ او بس اوزے اینگو اینگو نمبل خیراتے وختس دانگ پیری کے وختس دانگ پیری کے
en: This is... quick, my friend. He just went for a ride once like this, and I thought he'd just... Sometimes he circles this way, sometimes he circles that way.
en_old: This is so small, my friend. He just went for a ride once like this, I thought he'd just gone off... sometimes onto the water, sometimes onto the water.

brh: خبر اف انت سوچنگٹی امل او کنے جوان سما ئے کہ اون سوچنگٹی ئے ولے دا پاہ خان نیک نی انت سوچنگٹی ئس کنا یار او یاری ئے سوچنگٹی اوٹ
en: I don't know what he's thinking, but I know well that he's thinking about something. But tell me this, Khan: what are you thinking about, my friend? I'm thinking about friendship.
en_old: I don't know what Amal is thinking. I know very well that he's thinking, but tell me, Khan, what are you thinking, my friend? I'm thinking about friendship.

brh: جی ئے دا خوشبو انت کے کسے دیو؟ انن کے نی سوچنگٹی ئس اندا وڑٹ ئے ہم سوچنگٹی اٹ کنا یار۔ امر کے؟ باز بیکار سنگت اسے۔
en: Yes, I'm wondering what this Khushbu will do, who she'll give it to. The way you're thinking, I'm thinking the same way too, my friend. How so? What a useless friend you are.
en_old: Yes, who will Khushbu give this to? You're thinking the same way I'm thinking, my friend. How so? What a useless friend.

brh: واہ زٹ اسے نا اوست نا والینے بائیک نی اونا سوجر ویستے نا سوج دا وار کسے اگہ نا پٹیٹ خلٹن تے
en: Wow, ... of the heart... the bike... you, his questions... your question... this time, if I hit you on the back...
en_old: Wow, ... bike... this time if I hit you on the back...

brh: خواجہ خیر ء، نی وا انچو چنگٹو ٹی ئس یار انت مس؟
en: Khwaja, is everything all right? Why are you so down, friend? What happened?
en_old: Khawaja, is everything okay? Why are you so down, friend, what happened?

brh: دا کل تازیل و تو دز او، ہر اسیت تا کن تو برام کننگ نا سوچنگ اٹی ئے دا تینا ارا تے چنا تے استون داری نو، دا عید بے داڑے کننگ خواہیرہ، کنے تو دا
en: All these [unclear]... each one is thinking about holding a wedding for them, these two children of theirs, [together?]. They want to hold it here this Eid. As for me, this...
en_old: All of these ... everyone is thinking about a wedding for them, for these two children of theirs together. They want to have it this Eid, here. As for me ...

brh: ہیچ سمجھ بپس دے کائک ولدا شامان تارمہ برے کے کنکن ٹپہاک مریرا
en: I don't understand anything at all. The day goes by, then from evening on darkness comes, and wounds open up for me.
en_old: I don't understand anything. The day passes, then darkness comes from the evening, and my songs ...

brh: ہلیا ابئی غے لمہ جان خلیفیس دنی آن مستی ئے پر مرگی الگی
en: [Garbled] ... father ... mother dear ... [unclear] ... before this ... but ... [unclear].
en_old: ... mother dear ... before that, but ...

brh: نیشٹ، با تنے صفا کرک، نم کل تنے اوستار ایتک، پننگ کپیرے، ایلم کلنے معاف کیرے، سچا بندہ بس۔ اوہ، ولے دا ہمت ننے ٹی اف، نی پا ہمر کین، ہندا۔
en: No, come, clear yourself. You all give yourselves [unclear]; you can't say it. Brother, you forgive everyone, be a true person, that's all. Oh, but we don't have that courage. You tell me how we should do it, that's it.
en_old: Enough, come and clear yourself. All of you ... you can't say it. Brother, forgive everyone, be a true man. Oh, but we don't have that courage. You tell me how. That's it.

brh: آن ہتھرے دا سوچاٹ کے در کے پھل کشنے، الکس نا پن پیش تما، خوشبو ودی مس، مبارک بلے مبارک، اوہ چالاک گلیزا بنگ دا پالے
en: [Unclear] with this thought, so that he'd bring out the fortune lot: [someone]'s name came up, Khushboo came out. Congratulations, yes indeed, congratulations! Oh, clever [unclear] this time.
en_old: ... thinking this, he took out the flower. Alex's name came up, and the fragrance spread. Congratulations, congratulations! Oh, clever ...

brh: او بابا او حاجی صاحب زیادہ ایت کپہ کنا دماغٹ نا ایت آک لگنگٹی اسل فکر کپہ دا کل نا مونا پشتمے رے یار بس بس زو پا ہڈے کنا اوست
en: Oh Baba, oh Haji Sahib, don't talk so much; your words are getting into my head. Don't worry at all. In front of all of these [unclear]. Man, enough, enough, tell me quickly, [unclear] my heart.
en_old: O Baba, O Haji Sahib, don't talk so much, your words are getting into my head. Don't worry at all, in front of everyone ... friend, enough, enough, tell me quickly, my heart ...

brh: ہمم مٹو! ہا! داڑکے اسے مٹو ئس ہتوئی تمک۔ رکشہ نا کیک۔ ارے مٹو! کنا خیال پائیک جندے تا بلو پنجرہ سے ٹی بند کین او
en: Hmm, parrot! Ha! A parrot has to be brought here. [Unclear]. Hey, parrot! My mind says we should shut them up in a big cage, and...
en_old: Hmm, Mitthu! Ha! A Mitthu is needed here. ... the rickshaw ... Hey, Mitthu! I think I should lock myself in a big cage.

brh: او تینا باٹی اسے اسے ٹال لفافاتے کشیسا کے او ٹھیک ہی گڑے بساپ بپوتا کہ نن رسال بسن نن ننے اسے ٹی قبول کے اڑاڑی مرے کے
en: And it was pulling out the envelopes one by one with its beak, and right then [unclear] that 'we have come as a betrothal party, accept us [into it]...' [unclear].
en_old: He was taking the envelopes out of his bag one by one ... we have come to ask for her hand, accept us ...

brh: اوئے دا ہمر مریک؟ اوئے ایلم تو گڑا کنائے مننگ ئے سچا بندغہ سیٹ ئے شہ پئے بہو کاتیر نا رفتار چپ پی کسس دا پار کسس ئے پار چپ پی اوڑے دا مٹھوئے
en: Hey, how can this happen? Hey brother, then it has to be mine, [unclear: a true person...]. The speed of [unclear]... left... this side of the road, the other side, left... there, this parrot!
en_old: Hey, how does this happen? Hey brother, then it must be mine, a true man ... speed ... over there, that's Mitthu.

brh: ایرا کھبروئی تہو پسلگنی او کھنا کھاریمے فرانسیسی او مٹھو اسہ توئی تمک او استاتا رازاکے ہم چائیک اور ہر کڑائے چائیک اڑے خلک چا خدا داسے ڈک
en: [Garbled] ... and a parrot is needed. It knows even the secrets of hearts, and it knows everything. Hey [unclear], God knows, now [unclear].
en_old: ... French ... and a Mitthu is needed. He knows the teachers' secrets too, and he knows everything ... God knows ...

brh: اوٹ بے عزت کرفک ننے، دا پاکے دا مٹو دنائے، او ایلم نجومی ئس ینائے، کرائے دیتک ننے، یار او خپہ مونی، سفارش مفارش مانی کیانہ
en: They'll humiliate us there. He says this parrot is like this, and that brother is an astrologer [of ours?]; they'll [unclear] us. Man, he's upset; we'll put in a good word or something.
en_old: They humiliated us there. He says Mittho is like this and the other one is an astrologer. They gave us a hard time. Friend, they're upset with us; we'll pull some strings or something.

brh: مرو ہنی دانا مطلب دادے کہ نی سیریس افس کمالی اڑے کنے تھک بفک او نی پاسے ئے سیریس افٹ جوڑا انتئے خلیسہ
en: Well then, that means you're not serious. Amazing! Hey, I'm not getting tired, and you say I'm not serious. Why are you making a fuss?
en_old: Well then, that means you're not serious. Amazing, man! I'm not getting tired, and you're not serious about anything, so why are you making a fuss?

brh: ایلو ہر کس نا قسمت نا فال کل نا مون آ پیش تمک۔ ولے دا پا کہ دا فال امر کشوئی؟ او ایلو نن کل نا پن تے نمشتہ کین۔ ارا نا پن مٹو پریم کشا
en: Then everyone's fortune lot will come out in front of everyone. But tell me, how is this lot to be drawn? And then we'll write down everybody's names. Whoever's name the parrot [unclear] draws...
en_old: Then everyone's fortune will be drawn in front of everybody. But tell me, how will the lot be drawn? Then we'll all write our names, and whoever's name Mittho Prem draws…

brh: خوشبو مبارک برے مبارک برے کنے او او نی باوہ اوئے دا لفافہ غا کس نا مرو واہ رمضان جان نا عقل مٹھو آ بکھالم کنے گٹی اسہ کنڈ آن
en: Khushboo, congratulations to me, congratulations to me! Oh, oh, you, father? Hey, whose name will be on this envelope? Wow, Ramzan Jan's brains, the parrot... [unclear] me ... from one side.
en_old: Khushboo, congratulations, congratulations to me! Oh, you, father, hey, whose name is on this envelope? Wow, Ramzan Jan's wisdom, Mittho… I'll… from one side.

brh: پھنگ نی مشتہ مریر ایلو کنا مبارکبادی مریر ہا ہمم مسلہ دادے کہ گل خان نا پن پیش تمے او ایلو لفافہ ہرفے او خالی مرے گل خان نا پن برے گڑا
en: [Unclear] will be written, then congratulations will be mine. Yes, hmm, the problem is that if Gul Khan's name comes out, and then he picks up the envelope and it is empty, Gul Khan's name comes out, then...
en_old: Phang, you'll be written in, and then congratulations from me. Yes, hmm, the problem is that Gul Khan's name comes up, he picks up the envelope and it's empty, Gul Khan's name comes out, and then…

brh: اوئے دا پاکیٹ نی دا سیل کوسس کننگٹی ئس اوئے لمہ دون مفروئے او مروخانی ار گڑاس منیک نما مونا منیک انشاءاللہ۔ کھنے منظورے نی تینا پاو۔
en: Hey, this packet, are you trying to seal it? Oh mother, it won't be like that. And [unclear], everything will happen in front of you, God willing. I accept. You say yours.
en_old: Hey, this packet, were you sealing it? Hey mother, it won't be like that. Mrokhani, something will happen, it will happen in front of you, God willing. Do you accept? Say yours.

brh: او مٹھو بھائی ٹھیک ہی مجبوری ہی کنے منظور ہی تینا پاو مٹھو رنگ او ایلم کنے منظور ہی دا زکاو مٹھوئے ایتوے تاکہ دا جنجالاک ہمیش کن ختم مریر بس ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی
en: Oh, Brother Parrot, okay, it's a compulsion, I accept. Say yours, [unclear]. And brother: I accept. This [unclear] must be given to the parrot so that these troubles end forever. Okay, fine, fine.
en_old: Oh Mittho brother, okay, it's a compulsion, I accept. Say yours, Mittho Rang. And the other one: I accept. Give this zakat to Mittho so these troubles end forever. Okay, okay.

brh: اوکے مچے خیال کیس گوج مونی کنا استنا صیبالس بندے شکر الحمدللہ یا تو استنا وال ملنگوئی یا ہمیشہ کے ٹوپ بند مروئی اڑے اللہ مانی تے
en: Okay, think it over a little [unclear], my heart's [unclear] is shut. Thank God, praise be to God. Either my heart's [door] has to open, or it has to be shut tight forever. Oh God, [unclear].
en_old: Okay, everyone, think about it. In front of me, my heart's… is shut. Thank God. Either my heart's wish has to come true, or it will be shut forever. Oh God…

brh: امر جان رے؟ ہمہ ئے جان اٹ شکر ئے نیمہ بنبو۔ نو امر رے جان رے؟ امر نما عید نا چھٹی ک مسو؟ نی داسکان متو نو آن شاء اللہ سہی وڑ اٹ شروع مریرہ۔ عید تو خڑک بننگ اٹی ئے نم تینا عید نا شاپنگ ئے کرینورے؟
en: How are you, are you well? Everyone's well, thank God, [and on] your side? So how are you, are you well? How about your Eid holidays, have they started? Not yet? Then God willing they'll start properly. Eid is coming near; have you done your Eid shopping?
en_old: How are you, dear? Everyone's fine, thank God, tell us about you. So how are you, dear? How were your Eid holidays? You haven't yet… God willing, it will start well. Eid is getting close. Have you done your Eid shopping?

brh: انشاءاللہ ئے نی تینے بے فکر کر ئے تینا عید نا شاپنگ تے پورا کروٹ۔ صحیح ئے نو ہرا تم کہ اوکا پیش تنگی رے کنے پارے نو ئے مونا وروط۔ جی او انشاءاللہ ئے نومے پاو خدا حافظ و انشاءاللہ ملنے۔
en: God willing. You don't worry; I'll finish my own Eid shopping. All right then, whenever any shortage comes up, tell me and I'll come over. Yes, and God willing I'll tell you. Goodbye, and God willing we'll meet.
en_old: God willing, don't worry, I'll take care of all your Eid shopping. Okay, whenever there's a need, tell me and I'll come forward. Yes, God willing, take care, goodbye, and God willing we'll meet again.

brh: اوئے صاحب بہادر او صاحب خلیپ خلیپ صاحب ہمے دے آ کنے آن غلطی مسک صاحب
en: Oh honourable sir, oh sir, Khalif[a?] sir, sir, that day I made a mistake, sir.
en_old: Oh sir, brave sir, oh sir, Khalif sir, sir, I made a mistake that day, sir.

brh: ابا نا عرض ہمدا عرض سے صاحب نمے تو معلوم ئے صاحب ئے غریب و بندغس اٹ صاحب دا مہنگائی ٹی صاحب پورتی مننگ مفک او صاحب کنا چنکو چنکو چنا او صاحب اوفتا اسکول نا فیس ئے دا
en: Oh, the request is just this one request, sir. You know, sir, I'm a poor man, sir. In this inflation, sir, I can't make ends meet, and sir, my little little children, and sir, their school fees, this...
en_old: Father's request is just this one request, sir. You know, sir, I'm a poor man, sir. With this inflation, sir, I can't make ends meet, and sir, my little children, sir, their school fees…

brh: عذر ئنا بلا قصور صاحب اللہ چائے ئے باز مجبور اٹ کنا ایرا تو نا تنخواہ ء صاحب نا سنگت آک تینگٹی افس آخر نی پاننگ اٹو نا سے صاحب کنا ایرا تو نا تنخواہ ء ہمو پیسہ غاتے مہربانی کربو ایتبو صاحب نی کنے شریف ء بندغ ئس لگیبو صاحب
en: I beg your pardon, it was no fault [of mine], sir. God knows I'm very helpless. My two months' salary, sir; your friends, sir, aren't [unclear]. After all, you were saying [unclear], sir. My two months' salary, that money, please give it to me, sir. You seem a decent man to me, sir.
en_old: Forgive me, it wasn't my fault, sir. God knows I'm very helpless. My two months' salary, sir… your friends aren't themselves… after all, you're saying… sir, my two months' salary, please give me that money, sir. You seem like a decent man to me, sir.

brh: اللہ نی آباد کے صاحب مہربانی کر کے صاحب ناحق کے ناحق بائیدے غریب ناحق غریب رزینگے نی سلے سمنٹ ئس ئے کاودا کل نا اد پتی لکھ کے
en: May God keep you prosperous, sir. Please, sir. For nothing, for nothing, [unclear] a poor man, a poor man is suffering for nothing. You... a [settlement/statement?]... write down everyone's address and...
en_old: May God keep you prosperous, sir. Please, sir, for no reason, a poor man is being wronged and harassed. You… a sack of cement… write down everyone's address…

brh: کلم کے وی او صاحب نی رب آباد کے، دعا کیس، ماشاءاللہ، شکر
en: I'll do all of it(?). Oh sir, may the Lord keep you prosperous; pray [for me]. Mashallah, thank you.
en_old: Everyone… oh sir, may God keep you prosperous, I pray for you. Mashallah, thank you.

brh: کھل آن درک کنے سے زیبا و رائستس او است کنا خوش مس یا اللہ نا شکر یا اللہ نا شکر
en: From [unclear] he took it out; I got a fine [unclear], and my heart was glad. Thank God, thank God!
en_old: From… I got a beauty, and my heart was happy. Thank God, thank God!

brh: گنجو! ارے بابا دیر ئس اونا گند
en: Baldy! Hey man, who is it? His stink...
en_old: Baldy! Hey man, it's been a while, his mess…

brh: او دشمنی کپے خدائے تینا منی کپے کپ کپ کپ کپ کپ کپ کپ دیوس نی دیوس او خیرونی او کپے
en: Oh, don't make enmity! For God's own sake, don't [unclear]. Don't, don't, don't, don't, don't, don't, don't! You cuckold, you cuckold! Oh Khairo, you... oh, don't!
en_old: Don't be hostile, God, don't do it to me. Don't, don't, don't, don't, don't, don't, don't. You lunatic, you lunatic, oh Kheroni, don't do it.

brh: ئے باز مصیبت تیٹ تینا براہم کریٹ تینٹ اینو تینا کیسہ ظالم او ہندے منینا گندو ئے خیرو نی ہن سمجھاسس کہ خوشبو بے بے نا اورانا گودی مروئی ہتو کنا متو
en: I [made my own marriage plans(?)] myself, through so many hardships, and today you take her for yourself, you cruel one, and this [unclear]... Khairo, you had thought that Khushboo was to become the lady of Bebe's house, and she didn't become mine.
en_old: I raised them myself through so many hardships, and today my own… cruel one, and the same… Khairo, you thought Khushboo would become the bride of Bebe's house. Wasn't she mine?

brh: تو کسہ سے نہ مفروئے او بابا گوازی ہائے ہائے دا توغ اسے
en: So it won't amount to anything. Oh man, it's a game. Alas, alas, this is a dream.
en_old: So it won't come to anything, oh man, it's a game. Alas, alas, this is a lie.

brh: ئے باز خوش قسمت ء بندغ اسے اٹ کہ نی کنے مہر کیسا۔ نی ارس مہر نا لائق، نی امبار ء بندغ آک دا دنیا ٹی باز کم پیدا مریرہ، نی باز سخی
en: I am a very lucky person, that you love me. You are worthy of love; people like you are born very rarely in this world. You are very generous.
en_old: I am a very lucky person that you love me. You are worthy of love; people like you are born very rarely in this world. You are very generous.

brh: جی تو بندہ سے ئس ابو کنا زاکے۔ انت مس؟ دا کنا تعریف کپہ کنے خوشی آن اٹیک مف۔ پرواہ کپہ وا ہم پنس نی مروئی کے
en: Yes, well, you are a (fine) person ... father, my ... What happened? Don't praise me like this, or I might get a heart attack from happiness. Don't worry ... you will have to be mine.
en_old: Yes, so a man... father is my... What happened? Don't praise me, it doesn't make me happy. Don't worry, still you have to be...

brh: خیر و تنا محبت کے قربان مسٹ، کنے تون زو قربان مننگ نا شوق اف، ئے نی تون خوشبو بے بے زند گدریفنگ خواوہ، دا زند نی تون انجوائے کننگ خواوہ، انتئے کہ کنا استٹی باز
en: Well, I am devoted to (lit. sacrificed for) your love, but I have no wish to be sacrificed (die) so soon. I want to spend my life with you, Khushboo Bibi; I want to enjoy this life with you, because in my heart there is so much ...
en_old: Well, I'd give my life for your love, but I have no wish to die soon. I want to spend my life with you, Khushboo Bibi. I want to enjoy this life with you, because in my heart there is so much...

brh: مانا کو ہرا تم کہ نی برے سے اسے خوشبو ئس تالان مریک ہمو وختہ کنے چکیں چاچم معلوم مریک کہ ئے باز خوش قسمت ء بندغ ئس اٹ ولے نی ہم ئس کنے تو مہر کیوہ
en: I mean, whenever you come, a fragrance spreads, and at that moment I feel that I am a very lucky person. But you too ... I love you.
en_old: I mean, whenever you come, a fragrance spreads, and at that moment I truly feel that I am a very lucky person. But you too... I love you.

brh: کنے خبر ئس کہ نی کنے مریسک، خوشبو بے بے نی کنا اوس صرف کنا اوس، اگر نی کنے ملیتوس تو کنے دا زند
en: I knew that you would be mine. Khushboo Bibi, you are mine, only mine. If you had not met me, then this life of mine ...
en_old: I knew that you would be mine. Khushboo Bibi, you are mine, only mine. If you hadn't met me, then this life of mine...

brh: ئے نم جز و غتف۔ اوہ! ببو ایلمک، معاف کیس، ئے تینا خیال اٹی اسٹ۔ تینا خیال؟ تین دن تخ، ئے داسہ نا خلاف لکھے وتے وی
en: I ... Oh! Come on, brothers, forgive me, I was lost in my own thoughts. — Your own thoughts? ... Now I'll write against you ...
en_old: I... Oh! Sorry, brother, forgive me, I was lost in my own thoughts. Your own thoughts? Keep your... I'll now write against...

brh: نی نی خدا نا پنٹ دم کپیس دم کپیس انتئے کہ ئے توغس خناٹ ہندا خاطر ئے تینا اوشٹی اللوٹ بس کنے معاف کر خیال کیس دیٹ خنوک توغس

en: My household... You are all married men, your households are all safe and sound, and you're saying that you're not married. Anyone who lies to his own household or to his own children belongs to no one. Bibi...
en_old: My wife... you are all married men, your wives are well matched with you, and you're saying we're not married. Anyone who lies to his wife or to his children belongs to no one, Bibi.

brh: ئے تو ئے دیہ سم خوار فے نوٹ۔ دروازہ ملوک ئے اوئے متو۔ السلام علیکم ابا! وعلیکم السلام۔
en: As for me... [unclear]... The door is open... oh, it wasn't. Peace be upon you, father! And upon you be peace.
en_old: ...The door is open, oh, it didn't... Assalamu alaikum, father! Wa alaikum assalam.

brh: ئے کنا مار نی آئی ڈی تیسٹ؟ ابا ئے پارے کہ بریرے بپھیرے ایدا، تو کہ بپھیرے نن کل چناک برینے، نخرہ مخرہ نا ضرورت افک۔ دا صفا خیر محمد! ئے داڑے کیسٹ یا اوراغاکاسٹ؟ ئے ہمینکا وی
en: Hey, my son, what about your ID test? Father, I said: 'Come, settle here; once you do, all of us children will come; there's no need for any fuss.' This is clearly Khair Muhammad! Should I stay here or go home? I just...
en_old: Hey my son, what is your ID test? Father said, bring them here, so that they come, all of us children will come, there's no need for fuss. This is clearly Khair Muhammad! Are you doing it here or over there? Just like that.

brh: عید کننگے گل خان نینٹ بس او بے بے واقعی نن باز بلور ردیس کننگٹی ئسن خوشبو بے بے او نمنا باز باز مہربانی نم ننا خنتی ملارے
en: To celebrate Eid, Gul Khan... Oh Bibi, truly we were making a very big mistake. Khushboo Bibi, many, many thanks to you; you opened our eyes.
en_old: Gul Khan came for Eid, and oh Bebe, we were really having a great time. Khushboo Bebe, thank you so very much, you made us happy.

brh: نندہ سہ ئے تینا چنا تے تو کین انشاءاللہ تینا عزیز قریب آتے کن انشاءاللہ نی انت پاسہ یار محمد ئے ہچ پننگ کپپرے انتئے کہ دا براہوئی نا وٹ جوان گڑا نم تینا
en: Now we'll [celebrate] with our own children, God willing, with our own relatives, God willing. What do you say, Yar Muhammad? I can't say anything, because this is a fine Brahui custom; then you, your own...
en_old: Raise your children, God willing, and for your relatives, God willing. What do you say, Yar Muhammad? Don't say anything at all, because this is a good thing about Brahui, you your own...

brh: نائے رے ہنداڑیکا بو او نوم کل تینا تینا بستر غاتے ہبو دوبارہ داڑے بننگ نا ہچ ضرورت اف نوم کل کنتو دروغ تڑیرے نوم کنے دھوکہ تسورے اسیت ئس یاد کیرے کہ دروغ تڑوکا بندغ نا ہچ جاگہ عزت اف نا وراٹی
en: Now go away from here, and all of you take your own beds; there's no need at all to come here again. All of you lied to me, you deceived me. Remember one thing: a lying person has no place and no respect anywhere.
en_old: Go from here right now, all of you, go to your own beds. There's no need at all to come here again. All of you lied to me, you deceived me. Remember one thing: a liar has no respect anywhere in this world.

brh: نور آغا نا پیشن نوم کل ہننگ چارے بنگورے کان کنا مار ولے یار جان نی این اسہ خواست ئس ہی خوشبو بے بے تون ننا سفارشے کے ننے داکہ کشف ننے اناڑ الے
en: Out of Noor Agha's [place], all of you; did you hear? Go, my son. But dear friend, I have one request of you: put in a word for us with Khushboo Bibi, so that she doesn't throw us out of here and lets us stay there.
en_old: All of you are about to go out to Noor Agha's place, at night, my son. But dear friend, I have one request: put in a word for us with Khushboo Bebe, so she gives us pomegranates.

brh: ٹھیک ہی ئے کوشش کیوے نمتے نام عید نا پارے کبو دا بابت ولدا ایت کنا اللہ مالک ئے ہر دے پریشان مریو نمے کل کنا کنڈان عید مبارک
en: Fine, I'll try. ... your Eid ... about this matter, again ... God is the master. Every day I get worried. Eid Mubarak to all of you from me.
en_old: Fine, I'll try to give you all Eid greetings. About this, then, God is my master. I worry every day. Eid Mubarak to all of you from me.

brh: نم ننا کاریم ٹی بسنورے تینا کمبتن۔ الا امر او ہیت کسے۔ ئے ہم تو نا مارم باروٹ۔ ماگل نا حالات آ کنے باز افسوس ئے نا افسوس کنے گھٹنت مپک۔
en: You came to our [event] yourselves... But how did that thing happen? I too [was concerned] about your son as well. I am very sorry about Mahgul's situation; my sorrow for you does not lessen.
en_old: You came to our work, your own brothers. Except for Amar, who spoke. I too am about your son. I feel very sorry about Mahgul's situation; my sorrow for you doesn't lessen.

brh: انتس کہ کنا قسمت اٹ ارے ہما مرے نن محرومی تے خنان، ہندا خاطر نن خوانن کہ دا خلق نا محرومی تے مر مرے مخلوق اٹ شعور برے، علم۔
en: Whatever is in my fate, let that happen. We have seen deprivation; that is why we study, so that the deprivations of these people come to an end and awareness comes to the people, and knowledge.
en_old: Whatever is in my fate, let it be. We see deprivation, that's why we study, so that the deprivations of these people end, and awareness and knowledge come to the people.

brh: ہنر نا دروازہ غاک ملنگر، او ظلم و زورا کے نا برخلاف نرینہ، نیاڑی، چنا، بلا، پیر، ورنا، ہرادے دا کل ظلم و زورا کے نا خلاف توار ء بڑزا کریر، صاحب کڑادون چاکینہ نا کامیابی۔
en: So that the doors of skill open, and against oppression and coercion men, women, children, adults, the old and the young, everyone, all raise their voices against this oppression and coercion. Sir, that is how we would know success.
en_old: The doors of skill opened, and against oppression and force, men, women, children, old and young, all of them raised their voices against oppression and force. Sir, that is how we see success.

brh: ضرور مرے انشاءاللہ، او ضرور مرے جراک، ہیتٹم باز چالاک مسونس۔ ملک صاحب ابا کین، دا ہوشیاری چالاکی۔
en: It will surely happen, God willing. — And it will surely happen [unclear]. You've become very clever with words too. Malik sahib, father... this is just shrewdness and cunning.
en_old: It will surely happen, God willing, and the fight will surely happen; he has become very clever with words. Malik sahib, father, this is cleverness and cunning.

brh: دا کل نا مہربانی کنا دا ہیت تے نی تینا است اٹ کتویس ہمون لگک کہ نی داسکان خوش افس نا دا ہیت اف کنے بیرہ نا خوشی پکارے ئے تو تینا
en: Thank you for all this. You didn't take these words of mine to heart. It seems you're still not happy. — No, it's not that; I only need your happiness. I, for my own part...
en_old: Thank you for all this. You didn't take my words to heart. It seems you're still not happy. That's not it; I only want your happiness, I for my part...

brh: خوش اٹ، نا خوشی تے کرے قربان کریٹ، نی خوش مریس تو ئے ہم خوش اٹ۔ مگل، اینو دا دت پومریس کنا مسڑ۔ کاکا۔
en: I'm happy. I have sacrificed it for your happiness; if you are happy, then I'm happy too. Magul, understand this today, my daughter. — Uncle.
en_old: I'm happy, I sacrificed my happiness for yours. If you are happy, then I'm happy too. Magul, today you understood this, my daughter. Uncle.

brh: نی دفتے بوکک، دف کنے زندگی برباد کننگ خوارہ۔ ئے دا سنگتی ٹی خوش افٹ۔ بس، ماہ گل ارے، ماہ گل۔
en: You make them understand: they want to ruin my life. I'm not happy in this relationship. — Enough. Mahgul, hey, Mahgul.
en_old: You know them, they want to ruin my life. I'm not happy in this friendship. That's it, it's Mahgul, Mahgul.

brh: ماما، ماما، ہما گڑتی تے توار کپہ داسہ، او داسہ نا توار ء بنبو، او بچارہ گنہ۔
en: Uncle, uncle, don't voice those thoughts now, and now listen to your own voice; and the poor thing... it's a sin.
en_old: Mama, mama, don't call those people now, and don't hear their voices now, the poor thing is innocent.

brh: ما گلناز کسئے، نی داڑے سلوک کنا ہیتا تے بننگوسے، کنے آن پارے، نی کنا ہیتا تے پومہ فیسہ چاوہ، نی آخر انتئے ہر ہیتا کنے آن ڈکیسہ، اینا زئی
en: Mahgul Naz [unclear]... you were standing here listening to my words. Tell me — you don't understand my words, I know — why on earth do you hide everything from me? Today's [unclear]...
en_old: Mahgul Naz, listen, you came here to hear what I had to say. She said to me, you understand my words, why do you hide everything from me in the end? Today...

brh: ئے اٹ ئے نا پریشانی ئٹی ارنگ کپارہ۔ ہلو جی جی ہا صاحب اینا دے پیش صاحب جی جی حاضر صاحب بس پاوتو بلکل
en: I can't bear to see you in distress. — Hello? Yes, yes, yes sir. Today... before you, sir. Yes, yes, at your service, sir. Just say it — absolutely.
en_old: I can't stay in your worry. Hello, yes, yes, sir, today in front of you, sir, yes, yes, present, sir. Just tell me, absolutely.

brh: دے نا فون ئس سر نورل نا فون ئس سر۔ انت پانگٹیس؟ مار فڈ ئس سر۔ انت پاریستا؟ ئے بس سر بازار آن برینگٹوسٹ۔ اینے، منع کریسٹ کہ اوڑے
en: It was his call, sir — Noor Ali's call, sir. — What are you saying? — Son... [unclear], sir. — What did you tell him? — Sir, I was just coming back from the bazaar. — Look, I had forbidden it, that there...
en_old: There was a phone call today, sir, Noral's call, sir. What were you saying? A son, sir. What did you say? I've just brought it from the market, sir. Today, I told you not to go there.

brh: فون بس تو فون اتھ انچ کپیس سرکار نا غلطی مس پاک سیمس جوز مائیکی ننا کاریمٹ غلطی کننگ نا گنجائش اف غفک
en: The phone rang, and you don't answer the phone? — Sir, it was a mistake... [unclear]. — In our work there is no room for making mistakes, [unclear].
en_old: When the phone came, why didn't you answer the phone like that? It was the government's mistake. In our work there's no room for making mistakes.

brh: کچک نا گچاشف، بس بس، ہلو ہلو، بس بس، کچک بس، ہلو
en: The dog [unclear]! Enough, enough! Hello, hello! Enough, enough! Dog, enough! Hello!
en_old: Chase the dog away! Enough, enough, go, go, enough, enough, the dog has come, go!

brh: ہا، ابا جان انت حالے؟ جی، چہ وخت آ؟ ٹھیک ئے
en: Yes, father dear, how are you? Yes, at what time? Okay.
en_old: Yes, father, how are you? Yes, at what time? Okay.

brh: بے بے فریدہ، داسہ نی اڑے تینے یکتنے خیال کر، تینا ہکا تے پومرے۔
en: Bibi Farida, now you — hey — take care of yourself on your own; understand your rights.
en_old: Bibi Farida, now you must take care of yourself, understand your rights.

brh: نیاری ارا خاص کے طاقتور مرے نیاری نیاری ئے نا دا ایتف دا سا ہموس نا وخت اف دا سا نیاری زند نا ہر میدان ٹی ننا
en: A woman should, especially, become strong. — Women, women... I... it's not that; now is not the time for that. — Now women, in every field of life, our...
en_old: Women are, especially, powerful... women, women... this is not the time for that now. Now women, in every field of life, our...

brh: نرینہ غاتے تو نا وار ہمو کہ مرے ہر گڑا نا اختیار نرینہ غاتے نی آخر انتئے دن خیال کیسہ دا خاطر آن کہ ہر گڑا کنا مونا ٹی ئے نا دو نہ اف ئے تے
en: As for men, the way it is, whatever happens, men have authority over everything. — Why on earth do you think like this? — Because everything happened before my eyes; it is not in your hands, I...
en_old: For men, your turn is whatever it may be, men have authority over everything. Why do you ultimately think like this? Because everything is in front of me, it's not in your hands...

brh: پو مننگ نا ضرورت ئے فریدہ، نی خبر ئے کہ ماگل انتئے اراغان غائب ئے کنے خبر ئے ولے انتس کننگ کیک؟
en: There's a need to understand, Farida. Do you know why Magul is missing from home? — I know, but what can she do?
en_old: You need to understand, Farida. Do you know why Magul is missing from home? I know, but what can she do?

brh: اونا مونا، ایرا کسر او، نما باوہ نا فیصلہ نا مونا ہانکے یا گڑا انکار، او تینے کشی نہ فریدہ، دانا علاج داف، تو گڑا امر کے، ئے ایندا پاننگ کینٹ
en: Before her there are two paths: either she says yes to your father's decision, or else she refuses. — Or she takes herself away... — No, Farida, that's not the solution to this. — Then what should she do? — I can tell you this much.
en_old: In front of him, there are two ways: either agree to your father's decision or refuse. He can't pull himself back, Farida. This is not the solution, so then how? I can say this much.

brh: داڑے بس ہنوٹ کے نی تینا رغے پوکا کسس نا خواہشاتے زبردستی یا پیسہ ٹی بندغ ہلنگ کپک دا کل گڑا خوشی ٹی مریرہ ئے باز کوشش کریٹ
en: I have come here just so that you make your [unclear] understand: a person cannot get someone's wishes by force or with money. All these things happen willingly, with happiness. I tried a lot.
en_old: I came here so that you would understand that a person cannot be bought by force or with money, by someone's wishes. All these things happen with happiness. I tried a lot.

brh: نی تینا کوششاتے مونی دروئی ئے حوصلہ اٹ، جوانی اٹ، مہر محبت اٹ، نیاڑی تینا ایتے ہلو اسکان سر کننگ کیک، آخر نم ہم پانے خواری
en: You must carry your efforts forward with courage, with goodness, with love and affection; a woman can carry her case through to a resolution. After all, you too want to say...
en_old: You have to carry your efforts forward with courage, with goodness, with love and affection. A woman can carry her rights all the way through. After all, you too say it's hardship...

brh: ئے دا پاننگ خواہوا کہ نی ادہ نور الہی پوہ کا کہ اراخ زور زبردستی اٹ آباد مفسا بلکہ مہر و محبت اٹ آباد مریرہ فریدہ مئے
en: I want to say this: that you make him, Noor Elahi, understand that homes do not flourish through force and coercion; rather, they flourish with love and affection. Farida, [unclear]...
en_old: I want to say this: you should understand, Noor Elahi, that homes are not built through force and coercion, but are built with love and affection, Farida.

brh: او گلس، ئے زوت بارومہ مسڑسے، او دے پریشان کپہ، پومسس؟ جان، گڑا خدا حافظ۔
en: O Gul, I'll come soon, daughter. And don't trouble her, understood? — Okay dear, then goodbye.
en_old: Oh sister, I'll come soon, don't worry, don't trouble her, understand? Dear, then goodbye.

brh: جنگے ننت آ خدرم کوزہ مٹنوکی۔ دا ہورل دا سنگے؟
en: The fight... [unclear] pitcher [unclear]. This... is this a stone?
en_old: Fight... (partly unintelligible) ... Is this a stone?

brh: جی خواجہ، برے ک، موری نا جل برے ک تو گڑا او برے ک، گڑا نا موری
en: Yes, master, it will come. When the outlet's water comes, then it will come; then your outlet...
en_old: Yes, master, he will come... the fine for Mori will come, so then he will come, then Mori's...

brh: اچٹ بسوکے کلو کنتو جوڑہ خان جوڑہ خان جوڑہ خان نی حکم کر
en: [unclear] the message that came... with me. Jora Khan, Jora Khan, Jora Khan, you give the order.
en_old: Suddenly the one who came... Jora Khan, Jora Khan, Jora Khan, you give the order.

brh: نورنا دے کٹفنگ نا جنگے نا ئے اودے پین اسہ سبق تننگ خواوا ئے اودے اسہ اندنو سبق ئس تننگ خواوا کہ مچا سندھ چات خے
en: Over Noor's fight about cutting the days, I want to teach him another lesson; I want to teach him such a lesson that the whole of Sindh will know.
en_old: The fight over cutting Noor's days... I want to teach him another lesson, I want to teach him such a lesson that all of Sindh will know.

brh: کھرا پین برائے برانہ پین چوراکے چوراک واجہ نن کین بروکو مچے ہمو داسا ہچ کپہ سیر کپہ ولیک
en: [unclear]... another one will come, another... thieves, thieves, sir! We'll... all those who come... Now don't do anything to that one, don't wander around, but...
en_old: Another will come, another will come, thieves, thieves, sir, we will do... the one who comes... now don't do anything, don't wander around...

brh: نور علی سے کپ، ئے ہودے سندھو نا سزا تنے خواوہ کنے، ہکا او مرگ خواہتو دے مرگ نصیب مف، او کہ زند خواہتو دے زند نصیب مف۔
en: Noor Ali — don't. I want to give him such a punishment that if he wants death, may death not be granted to him, and if he wants life, may life not be granted to him.
en_old: Don't tell Noor Ali, I want to give him the punishment of Sindh: if he wants death, may he not be granted death, and if he wants life, may he not be granted life.

brh: نی کمزور سمجھیپیرے؟ ہنچ؟ ننا انت خوار؟ ننا انت خوار کہ ئے کمزور اٹ، ہا؟ خواجہ تینا دا مطلب افس۔ نا مطلب ئ جوانی اٹ توم ہرے مٹ؟ بس ئے دا ہیت ئ۔
en: You take me for weak? Like that? What misery is ours? What misery is ours that I should be weak, huh? — Master, that's not what I meant. — So you meant it in a good way, then? — That's all; I meant just this.
en_old: Do you consider me weak? Why? What is our hardship? What hardship do we have that I'm weak, huh? Master, that's not what I meant. Did you mean it well? That's all I'm saying.

brh: مرک نی دو بل چورک کے چورک
en: [unclear]... you... hand [unclear]... thieves, thieves!
en_old: Death... you hand over... thieves, thieves.

brh: ہیلو؟
en: Hello?
en_old: Hello?

brh: ہیلو، ئے شریفہ نا؟ جی ہو نم دیر ہیت کننگ اٹی ارے؟ ئے مراد ہیت کننگ اٹی اٹ۔ انتاسے کہ فون کرینوس؟ ئے نم سرور تون ہیت کریٹ۔ ہولڈ کرک۔
en: Hello, is this Sharifa's? — Yes, yes, who is speaking? — It's me, Murad, speaking. — What is it that you've called about? — I'd like to speak with your Sarwar. — Hold on.
en_old: Hello, is this Sharifa's house? Yes, who's speaking? It's Murad speaking. Why did you call? I'd like to talk to Sarwar. Hold on.

brh: چٹوئی کن ہناٹ ملاخی جوٹ مستوس مستوس مطلب خا تو تہم کنے مستوس کے براہوئی ادب ٹی کنے کاریم کروئی ئے تو تہم ئے ڈاکٹر براہوئی نا شخصیت اسہ کے اوڑان باز متاثر مسوٹ انت کہ او براہوئی خلقی ادب ٹی مچ کاریم کرے اچھا ہموکانہ او جی او بالکل
en: I went for [unclear] ... it happened, it happened — I mean, so then I too came to feel that I should do work in Brahui literature. And there was also the personality of Dr. Brahui, by whom I was very much impressed, because he had done collecting work in Brahui folk literature. — I see, from there. — Yes, sir, yes, exactly.
en_old: I went for studies, met... at first I had in mind that I should work in Brahui literature. And in my mind there was Dr. Brahui's personality, and I was very impressed by him, because he did all that work in Brahui folk literature. I see, from there. Yes, exactly.

brh: دا نمونہ او ہک بلوک پدا سے کاریم کرینے اوٹی اونا خلقی قصہ غاتے مچ کریسس او اونا خلقی شاعری تے کرے ئس کتاب ئس جوڑ کننگ نا فینت اسیس تو کا پد کرے ئے ہندا سوچاٹ کہ بھئی ئے کرے ئے ہم دا کاریم دا ایلو ہشبرے کاریم کیوہ او کا پد

en: Do you agree with that thing in this Brahui folk poetry? — Well, after all, if one looks at what kinds of places our Brahui people [lived] in, and there was the winter-and-summer [migration], there was nothing else; here, a place — here our people lived; it was mostly nomadic. — Right. — Okay, our people's...

en_old: ...names, you give names, descriptive names, descriptive names, Mandri, Burzko, Burzanga, Para, Shatko, Shatko, I mean names of this kind, that's it. Okay, Abrar sahib, oral folk tales — thank God we have plenty, what, we have epics, how...

brh: مثال بلوچی ٹی اگر نن پانا کافی داستان آک مشہور او تے لوک داستان پانا۔ براہوئی ٹی لوک داستان ہم ارے یا صرف عام او قصہ او؟ براہوئی ٹی خضدار آ کین ننا لوک داستان کین عشقیہ داستان پانا ہم ارے۔ صحیح صحیح۔ اسہ ٹی ننا
en: For example, if we say, in Balochi quite a few epics are famous; we call them folk epics. In Brahui are there folk epics too, or only ordinary tales? — In Brahui, toward Khuzdar, our folk epics, which we call romantic epics, exist too. — Right, right. — In one of them, our...
en_old: For example, in Balochi, we'd say many epics are famous, we call them folk epics. In Brahui, are there also folk epics, or only ordinary tales? In Brahui, at Khuzdar, our folk epics, we also call them romantic epics. Right, right. In one of them our...

brh: مخلوق اٹی دا کم مسنے۔ صحیح صحیح۔ خن زی اگر نن ہورین تو اسہ مثنوی معنوی نا ذکر ئس ارے آواز ئس ارے ببرک ملک ننے پین نن دا دے شاید جوان سمجھتنون انت متو متو بیرو کتون دا دے دا گڑا تینا کین ڈکاون کتون دا گڑا تو براہوئی ٹی ہندا وڑ نن کنے براہوئی ٹی کنے
en: ...among the people this has been little. — Right, right. — Look, if we look, there is a mention of the Masnavi-e-Ma'navi, there is a voice ... [unclear] ...; we perhaps have not understood this well; why we did not ... this, this thing of our own we did not ...; so in Brahui, in the same way, we ... in Brahui ...
en_old: ...this happened among the people. Right, right. Look, if we look, there is mention of the Masnavi-e-Ma'navi, there is a voice, the cry of the reed (ney) reaches us; we perhaps today don't understand this well, why we didn't ... this day, this thing of ours ... this thing, so in Brahui in the same way we, in Brahui, me...

brh: یعنی خلقتی شاری باز زیادہ ملک ہرا کہ عشقیہ داستان کنے او ننا ملک گے گو کھرے بس او ہندا شے کنے دا شے تیرا پد اٹی بالکل ارے دا ہرا کہ نی دا مطلب دن کہ دا
en: I mean, folk poetry is found very, very much, which [includes] the romantic epics, and our ..., that's it; and this same thing, this thing, after ..., is completely there — this which you, I mean, like that, that this...
en_old: ...I mean, folk poetry is found very much, which is the romantic epics, and our ... that's it, and this same thing, this thing after... it's entirely there, this which you, I mean, that this...

brh: دا سے بازے گلکا توملا نن او پدا شہری فلان بندغہ تفینوٹو دا سم ننتو ارے بندغہ تفنگانے بندغہ داسے نن کے دا چھانجل نی او چسے نا اذیت تفنگانے ہا ہندن کیرے نن دوستاتے اذیت تفنگانے مگر ئے کیڑا نن داستان تے ایڑو زمان تے خننے یوٹی شیریں فرہاد نا پدا
en: This, very much ... we, and then the city, such-and-such person ... we have this too — ... a person ... a person — now, for us, this folk song, you, the torment of ... — yes, like that — we [put] friends through torment; but when we look at the epics of other languages, in which, after Shirin-Farhad...
en_old: ...this is very ..., we and then the city, we left such-and-such person, we have this ..., leaving a person, a person, this to us, you that ... leaving the suffering of ..., yes, we do this, leaving friends in torment, but ... we see the epics of other languages, in which, after Shirin Farhad...

brh: ہو مطلب ہمو یا پین ایلو پازے دن اسہ دم اٹی کیرے دن باز نظر اٹی کسہ غاتے ننا ملنگ ٹی اف او نا ممکن ئے کہ ہمے ننا کلچرل سبب مرے کہ ہمو نا گڑائے باز مونی ہتنون اچھا دا شاعری ئے مچ کرے ماشاء اللہ نما کتاب اٹی
en: Yes, I mean that one, or other ones like that ... in one breath, like, many such tales in view are not found among us, and it is possible that it is because of our cultural reasons that we did not bring that thing forward much. — Okay, this poetry [you] collected, mashallah, in your book...
en_old: Yes, I mean that, or other ones like that, in one breath, like many in view, the tales are not found among us; it's possible that it's due to our cultural reasons that we did not bring its things forward much. Okay, this poetry was collected, God willing, in your book...

brh: تینا باوہ غان ہریف کہ او دا وخت آراڑے مس؟ منیر! منیر
en: Ask your own father where he was at this time! Munir! Munir!
en_old: Ask your father where he was at that time. Munir! Munir!

brh: ضرور منک ولے کنا خیال پائے کہ نی باز مہر و درستی اٹ کرینوس صاحب ئے تو بس کریٹ ولے مانو منک
en: Of course it will happen, but I thought you had done it out of great love and friendship, sir, so I just stopped. But it will happen.
en_old: Of course, it will happen, but I thought you did it for sir out of great love and friendship, so I stopped. But it will happen.

brh: سروف مانیکہ، مانی گٹو سروف مانیسے، مانی دا غصہ انت برداشت کیسی واہ پرنسپل!
en: ... Why do you put up with this anger? Wow, Principal!
en_old: Sir, wait, wait, sir, wait! Why do you put up with this anger? Wow, Principal!

brh: ئے کنے جوانی اٹ چاسہ، نن جوانو دے اسے جاگہ غدریفین، کم از کم ہمو سنگتی او دوستی نا خیال تو کر، بس کرک
en: You know me well; we spent good days together in one place. At least have some regard for that companionship and friendship. Stop it.
en_old: You know me well; we spent good days together. At least think of that companionship and friendship. Just stop.

brh: ئے کسسنا دوست
en: Me, someone's friend?
en_old: Whose friend are you?

brh: او تپٹ اگہ دوست ارے تو تینا فالتو ہورے وی کس اسے معاف کپرے ئے ہچ او چلمسی ہوریس او مسوس او مسوس
en: And... if he's a friend, then you won't forgive anyone over your own pointless... I... nothing, and you look... and you became... you became...
en_old: And I didn't know. If someone is a friend, he doesn't forgive anyone for his own excesses, not at all. And you became... you became...

brh: انت؟ ئے مجرم؟ ہاؤ، مجرم اسنی۔ او، اسیت ئس کنا پیناک
en: What? Me, a criminal? Yes, a criminal you are. And one thing... my...
en_old: What? You, a criminal? Yes, a criminal. Oh, someone... my name...

brh: ئے اینو اسکان نہ کسے تو سنگتی تخانوٹ نہ کسے تو دوستی تخانوٹ مسونے تو کنا فائدہ نہ ایت مسونے متنے تو ہچس متنے او مسوس
en: To this day I have kept neither companionship with anyone nor friendship with anyone. When it happened, it did me no good; whether it happened or not, nothing came of it. And you became...
en_old: Until today I have kept neither companionship nor friendship with anyone. When it happened, it did me no good; when it didn't, nothing happened. And you became...

brh: تو بڑا ئے نی کہ انت کنے کیوا۔ داسہ بسوس نہ کسر آ۔
en: So, big man, what will I do to you? Now you've come round to the right path, haven't you?
en_old: So you're the big one who will do something to me. Now you've come onto the road, haven't you?

brh: انسپکٹر صاحب اینو فاریٹ کے کنے ماگو نی
en: Inspector sir, I told you today that I... Maqbool...
en_old: Inspector sir, let me go today. Why are you...

brh: ہچ خبر اف، ہچ خبر اف، ہچ خبر اف نی آ کنے ہچ خبر اف، خلو، صاحب، دا داسہ خلیس، انت داسہ خلیس کے
en: I don't know anything, I don't know anything, I don't know anything; I don't know anything. Beat me? Sir, now you're beating this one. Why are you beating him now?
en_old: I know nothing, I know nothing, I know nothing; I don't know anything about you. Hit him, sir, he's been hit now, what, he's been hit now.

brh: بس بس بس دا غبلو ایچس مسنو نم کنے دستکانے ڈکان ایتے
en: Enough, enough, enough! Nothing has come of this... and you people are handing me over...
en_old: Enough, enough, enough! This nonsense has gone far enough. You are handing me over to the thieves.

brh: حوصلہ، حوصلہ افضل جان حوصلہ! ابا ماگھو لرانگنا نی اینے، اینے پاوہ نی۔ الہ نی چپ کا، ابا ئے پاننگٹ ماگھو لرانگنا نی
en: Courage, courage, dear Afzal, courage! Father, where is Maqbool? Tell me, tell me. Oh, you keep quiet. Father, I'm asking: where is Maqbool?
en_old: Patience, patience, dear Afzal, patience! Father, why are you crying? I'll tell you. Mother, you be quiet. I'm asking Father why he is crying.

brh: باغول کے تو نن تینٹ پریشان اون ننے تینٹ خبر اف کہ واران گم مسنے نامراد نومے ہما خبر اف
en: Maqbool? We ourselves are worried; we ourselves don't know where he has gone missing, the wretch. You don't know either.
en_old: Make him understand. We are worried ourselves; we don't know ourselves where he has gone missing. The wretched one, we don't even know about him.

brh: او اسے نن آئی خاچوکا سٹے اسے بندغ ئس بس کنا زی آ حملہ کرے اوڑان پد ما گڑا ہچ درک اف کہ ارانگ ہنانے نی دروشم ختویس تا دروشم ختیٹ تا کنا مار او
en: One night I was asleep when a man came and attacked me. After that I have no idea where he went. Didn't you see his face? I didn't see his face, my son.
en_old: That one... we were asleep at night when a man came and attacked me. After that I don't know anything about where he went. Did you see his face? I saw his face, my son.

brh: خانہ ٹی بندے، اونا پن جورک ئے او ملک نور محمد اوتے جوانی کچائے کر، گڑا مقبولء خبر تمہ؟ دا تو ئیک، مقبولء ہچ خبر تمہ، گڑا جورک انت پائیک؟ گڑا جورک پائیک کہ
en: He is locked up in the house; his name is Jorak. And Malik Noor Muhammad, deal with them thoroughly. Then will Maqbool find out? That's one thing: Maqbool won't find out anything. Then what will Jorak say? Then Jorak will say that...
en_old: He is locked in the house. His name is Jorak, and Malik Noor Muhammad, question them properly. Then will Maqbool find out? That's one thing; Maqbool won't find out anything. Then what does Jorak say? Then Jorak says that...

brh: کنے خبر اف جوان ابا دا سدا کنا کار اف نا ابا نا خدا نی بس کونو زندہ استس ئے داسا نی پین جنجالٹی شاغنگ خواپرا نا ئے نا دن مننگ کپک نان خیال کے
en: I don't know, good father; this was never my business. No, father, for God's sake... just alive. Now I don't want to drag you into another mess. No, no, it can't happen like this. Think about it.
en_old: I don't know, good father. This was never my business. Father, for God's sake, just keep me alive. Now you want to throw me into another mess. It can't be like this. Think about it.

brh: او سدھ پدھ بیلو، وراثت نا دونو مخلوق کنے انت پائ؟ داسہ ئے چاو کنا کاریم چائے۔ ابا، افضل، افضل، افضل جاہ۔ حوصلہ، حوصلہ ادی حوصلہ، اللہ خیر کیک۔ افضل جوڑا صیب، او انتس کروئی جوان کروئی حوصلہ کر پین۔
en: Oh, he's out of his senses. What will such heirs say to me? Now I'll see what my work is. Father! Afzal, Afzal, Afzal dear! Courage, courage, sister, courage; God will make it well. Afzal is fine, sir; whatever has to be done should be done well. Have a little more courage.
en_old: Oh, sorry. What will the people of the inheritance say to me? Now you see, my work... Father, Afzal, Afzal, Afzal! Patience, patience, sister, patience. God will make it well. Afzal is fine, sir. What should we do? We'll do what's good. Keep patience a little longer.

brh: اصلے، اللہ خیر کے مس تو ننا ہمت مرے، اینو نن مس ما گول کن پریشان آن او دا ایلو جنجال ات نا لٹی ہٹی بننگ اٹی آن نا نا، نن دعا کیبو کہ اللہ خیر کے گواچو نا سفت او ماشاءاللہ ورنائے ئس
en: Really, God will make it well; if that happens, we'll have courage. Today we are worried about Maqbool, and with this other trouble we're getting tangled up. No, no, let's pray that God makes it well. Truly, he deserves praise, and mashallah, he was a young man.
en_old: Truly, God willing, if it happens it will give us courage. Today we are worried about him, and this other trouble is coming in between. We pray that God makes it well. Praise him, and mashallah, he is a young man.

brh: افضل اسلہ کبو دعا کبو اللہ خیر کے افضل
en: Afzal, have courage, pray; God will make it well, Afzal.
en_old: Afzal, calm down, pray. May God make it well, Afzal.

brh: منیب منیب استونی دعوت اسے ئنا سوسنا
en: Munib, Munib, there's an invitation...
en_old: Munib, Munib, there is an invitation...

brh: ماما فریج انتئے کہ خالی ئے انت خالی ئے انت مطلب؟ مطلب دادے کہ فریج اٹی نہ پال تخوک او، نہ چکن تخوک ئے نہ فروٹ تخوک او، ارانگ ہنار دا ہفتی نا گونگٹ؟
en: Mama, why is the fridge empty? What do you mean, empty? I mean there's no milk kept in the fridge, no chicken, no fruit. Where has this week's stuff gone?
en_old: Mom, why is the fridge empty? What do you mean empty? I mean there's no milk in the fridge, no chicken, no fruit. Where did it all go this week?

brh: تو گڑا ئے کن گٹے، گڑا دیر کن گٹے؟ ئے کنے وتا؟ کمال کیسی اگر ئے کن گٹے تو نی پاریٹ، نا غصہ افک، دا عمر اٹ ئے اونا دماغ نا پیچک ئس ڈیل
en: So then, is all of it for him? Then who is all of it for? For me myself? You're something else! If it's all for him, then I told you, don't be angry: at his age a screw in his brain has come loose.
en_old: So who is it for, then? Who is it for? Is it for me? It would be amazing if it's for me. Then you said it, it's not your anger; at this age a screw in his brain has come loose.

brh: خیر ئے ایلو، اینو باز منجھا منجھا؟
en: Is everything alright, brother? You seem very upset today.
en_old: Is everything fine? Why so gloomy today?

brh: بس ئے ہند پاوم اسہ مجرم اسے مو چا زندے لوتا و رات برباد کرے
en: I'll just say this much: a criminal looted my whole life and ruined my nights.
en_old: I'll just say this much: one criminal ruined my whole life and my nights.

brh: دا ستی نا کروکا کرم تے کین پشیمان ایلوم دا تو باز جوان او ہیت اسے کم از کم اودے دا احساس مس کہ او رت ارے ولے دا بندغ دیرے
en: He is remorseful for the deeds he has done, brother; that is actually a very good thing. At least he has realized that he is in the wrong. But who is this man?
en_old: To regret the wrong you've done to her, I mean, that's actually a very good thing. At least he realized that he has blood, but where is this man?

brh: جوڑت پینت
en: Well and fine.
en_old: Health and well-being.

brh: ئے کلات ٹی تسوٹٹ تو ہمو کہ کنے سنگت آت مشورہ تس کہ نم کنے براہوئی فاضل کبو ئے حالانکہ بے ئے ٹی کرے سٹ صحیح او براہوئی فاضل کرے تو او ٹائم بسوٹ براہوئی اکیڈمی نا افس ئس ہکے جناح روڈ آ ہمو گلی ٹی
en: When I was in Kalat, my friends advised me: 'You should do the Brahui Fazil,' even though I had already done my BA. Right. And when I did the Brahui Fazil, at that time I came; the Brahui Academy's office was on Jinnah Road, in that lane.
en_old: When I was studying in Kalat, my friends advised me to do Brahui Fazil, even though I had done my BA. Right. When I did Brahui Fazil, at that time I came to the Brahui Academy office, which is on Jinnah Road, in that lane.

brh: ایسے کے ملوٹ ایسے کے تو اوڑے کسرے ئے بسوٹ تو سنگت آتے یعنی کتابم نا کتاب صورت تقریبا او ٹائم براہوئی اکیڈمی نا ہر کوٹہ خوانا تر ہموڑے کسرے ئے براہوئی فاضل نا امتحان سے تسوٹ سر تو اوکان پد کسرے ولدا ادا وختی کسرے ئے بسوٹ
en: Like that... when I came there, then the friends, I mean, books, almost in book form... at that time I used to study in every room of the Brahui Academy. There I took the Brahui Fazil exam, sir, and after that I came back here again at that time.
en_old: I passed my SSC. When I came there, my friends... that is, books, almost in book form; at that time I studied in every room of the Brahui Academy. There I took the Brahui Fazil exam, and after that I came back here again.

brh: 79 نا نومبر اٹ پی ٹی وی ٹی کنے اسٹوڈیو پروڈیوسر لگاٹ تو او ٹائم کنے کنے دا سے کنے ئے دا اوڑے بسٹ تو کنا ادب تو تعلق مس اور کنا کنے مخلوق مختلف رائٹرات تو کنا کنے رائٹر
en: In November '79 I started as a studio producer at PTV. At that time, when I came there, I became connected with literature, and... people, various writers... writers...
en_old: In November '79 I was appointed studio producer at PTV. At that time, when I came there, I got connected with literature, and I met various people and writers.

brh: سب ٹھیک جوڑ مریخ نا؟ انشاءاللہ اماں، اللہ خیر کے انشاءاللہ، اسے دے۔
en: Everything will be fine and well, won't it? God willing, mother; God will make it well, God willing... [unclear: 'ase de'].
en_old: Everything will be fine, right? God willing, mother, may God make it well, God willing, one day.

brh: مہربانی ڈاکٹر صاحب، تکلیف کرے۔ نہ نہ، ہچ مسئلہ اف۔ اماں، اللہ خیر کے۔ انشاء اللہ، اللہ خیر کے۔
en: Thank you, doctor sahib, you took the trouble. — No, no, it's no problem at all. Mother, God will make it well. God willing, God will make it well.
en_old: Thank you, doctor sahib, for your trouble. No, no, it's no problem at all. Mother, may God make it well. God willing, may God make it well.

brh: ارے دا او شٹ بس ہمزل یا اللہ یا اللہ یا اللہ باز شکر اللہ شکر
en: Hey, he — he has come to his senses, Afzal! O God, O God, O God, many thanks, thank God!
en_old: Oh, he's come around now! Oh God, oh God, oh God, thank you so much, thank God.

brh: کنا ساہ افضل جان افضل جان ایلم سرور کنا مار کنے درست کرے نی کنا مار کنے درست کرے نی افضل
en: My life, Afzal jan, Afzal jan! Brother Sarwar, you have made my son well for me — you have made my son well for me! Afzal...
