en_old: My life, Afzal jan, Afzal jan, brother Sarwar, my son, you've saved me, my son, you've saved me, Afzal.

brh: او توفیق کنا زہ یا مولا یا مولا شکر اللہ دا تو کسے درست کتوکہ دا بژدینا کرک دا ہی وسیلہ جوڑ مس یا اللہ
en: Oh Taufiq, my dear — O Lord, O Lord, thank God! Otherwise no one would have made him well [unclear: 'bažd-īnā kark']; it was this one who became the means, O God.
en_old: Oh Taufiq, my brother, oh Lord, oh Lord, thank God. He was the one who saved him; he became the means, oh God.

brh: ہن مس ہنزیکو ہن مس ہچ متنے کنا ساہ ہچ متنے ئے ئے تو خوشیان اوغنگٹی اٹ او
en: What happened? [unclear: 'hanzīko'] What happened? — Nothing has happened, my life, nothing has happened. It's just that I'm crying from happiness.
en_old: What happened? What happened to you? Nothing happened, my life, nothing happened. Yes, yes, I'm crying out of happiness.

brh: اللہ دا، اللہ دا، ئے ماغورٹ، برے رب برے رب، اوار مسکا ماتے، نی مبارک برے، مراد ایلم نی مبارک برے، افضل جان درست کننگے کلے واہ، ہاو ہاو، افضل کرم مار، افضل جان
en: Oh God, oh God, [unclear: 'ye māɣorṭ'], O Lord, O Lord, [unclear: 'avār maskā māte']. Congratulations to you! Brother Murad, congratulations to you! Afzal jan has been made well — wow! Yes, yes, Afzal, dear son, Afzal jan.
en_old: Oh God, oh God, my Lord, oh Lord, oh Lord, he's come to, mother. Congratulations to you, brother Murad, congratulations to you. Afzal jan has been saved by everyone. Wow, yes, yes, Afzal, dear son, Afzal jan.

brh: او نی برو تینا مار کے خیر نصیب کنٹ نم بچو انت کے او اللہ نی صحت دے
en: Oh, you — come; may good fortune be granted to your own son. [unclear: 'num baccū ant ke' — your boy, what would he...] Oh God, give you health!
en_old: Oh, come, may your son be blessed. You saved him, what can I do? Oh God, give him health.

brh: اندو زوت مر سندھ باز کک کنے۔ اندیرت کک۔ او گلاس۔ اندیرت۔ او گلاس۔ پات گرم کرتہ۔ ہا ہا زوت کین۔ زوت کین۔ او باس کک۔
en: This way, hurry up — [unclear: 'sindh'] do it for me a lot. [unclear: 'andīr-aṭ'] do it. That glass. [unclear]. That glass. Warm his feet. Yes, yes, we'll be quick, we'll be quick. Heat that up.
en_old: Hurry up now, it's very cold for me. Bring it quickly. That glass. Quickly. That glass. Warm up the feet. Yes, yes, do it quickly. Do it quickly. Oh boss, it's cold.

brh: جوڑ مریسہ، اللہ جوڑ کیکنے افسر جان، اللہ جوڑ کیکنے، آرام کر، نہ نہ ابا انس انس
en: You'll get well; God will make you well, Afsar jan, God will make you well. Rest. — No, no, father, [unclear: 'ans ans'].
en_old: You'll get better, God will make you well, Afsar jan, God will make you well. Rest, no, no, father, it's alright, it's alright.

brh: ابا ہنمس افضل جان ئے تو ئے تو تارا چسوٹ تارا امر بسوٹ ابا ئے نی اسوٹ تھانہ غان اراٹی استے نا ہچو مسئلہ اف نہ کنے دیر ئس ئے اسوٹ نی کنا مار ئے اسوٹ
en: Dear, what happened, Afzal jan? — Well, well... [unclear: 'tārā cesoṭ'] how did I get here? — Dear, I was [coming] from the police station to the house; there's no problem at all. No, I was a little late... You are my son...
en_old: Father, what happened to Afzal jan? Yes, yes, I was looking for you, how did you come? Father, you were at the police station. There's no problem at all from there. No, it took me a while. Yes, you're my son, you were.

brh: دائے دا تیل ئے افضل جان آرام کر نی آرام نا ضرورت ئے لیٹ لیٹ آرام کر شاباش کنا مار لیٹ شاباش بسم اللہ اللہ نا لکھ لکھ شکر ئے کنا مار جوڑ مس کنا دم چٹے آرام کر
en: Here, this is oil. Afzal jan, rest; you need rest. Lie down, lie down, rest. Good boy, my son, lie down, good boy. In the name of God — a hundred thousand thanks to God, my son has recovered, I can breathe again. Rest.
en_old: Here, this oil, Afzal dear, rest, you need rest, lie down, lie down and rest, well done my son, lie down, well done. In the name of God, a million thanks to God, my son has recovered, my heart is at ease, rest.

brh: ایلو کمرہ ٹی کا، آرام کر، خاچ کنا مار، خاچ کنا مار، آرام کر کنا مار، گام
en: Go to the other room and rest. Sleep, my son, sleep, my son; rest, my son. Step along.
en_old: Go to the other room, rest, sleep my son, sleep my son, rest my son, go.

brh: انسپکٹر صاحب، دا انت طریقہ سے ایلوفتو راٹی بننگ نا؟ ننا اودے ہرا گرفتار کبوتے۔
en: Inspector sahib, what kind of way is this, coming into other people's houses? Which of us have you come to arrest?
en_old: Inspector sahib, what kind of way is this to come into other people's houses? Whom have you come to arrest?

brh: خیر ئے کنا کسر زیات چالاکی کننگ نا ضرورت اف نی چورک سیدھا سیدھا پا کہ ما بول نا راہی
en: Never mind, this is my way. There's no need for too much cleverness. You [unclear: 'cūrak'] — just tell me straight where Mahgul is.
en_old: Fine, my way, there's no need to be too clever, you thief, just tell me straight where Mahgul is.

brh: کنا تو سلی نا کشفے اسیتو کنا اراٹی بغیر اجازت نا بسنس اینو کنے غے الزام خلنگٹی ئس کہ مغل ارارے
en: As for me, [unclear: 'salī nā kašfe asītu'] — you have come into my house without permission, and today you're accusing me over where Mahgul is.
en_old: Neither a warrant nor anything, you came into my house without permission, and today you're accusing me that Mughal is in the house.

brh: جان جان سیدھا سیدھا پارے کہ ما گل نا رڑ کنے نتھو انسپکٹر صاحب اینے پاریٹ کہ ما گل نا کنے سنبھال اللہ نور صاحب
en: Dear, dear, say it straight — where is Mahgul? [unclear: 'kane natho']. — Inspector sahib, I've told you that I [don't know anything] about Mahgul [unclear: 'kane sambhāl'] — Allah Noor sahib.
en_old: Dear, dear, tell me straight, where is Mahgul, don't hide it from me. Inspector sahib, I told you, Mahgul's... take care of me, Allah Noor sahib.

brh: دا نعمت اللہ شیر بو۔ جی سائیں۔ اوستا صاحب۔ ئے نی پاریٹ کہ ماہ گل داڑے اف۔ نم مفتٹ تینا وخت ء برباد کننگ اٹی رے۔
en: This — Naimatullah, [unclear: 'šer bo']. — Yes, sir. — Usta sahib. — Yes, I told you that Mahgul isn't here. You're wasting your time for nothing.
en_old: This is Nematullah Sher. Yes sir. Master sahib. You said Mahgul isn't here. You are wasting your time for nothing.

brh: جورک اینو اسکان غلط دوکانیٹ کرتنے وگا کرینے تو گڑا نا خیر
en: [unclear: 'jūrak'], to this day I haven't done any wrong dealings; and if I have, then that's up to you.
en_old: Thief, until today you haven't done wrong business, and if you have, then it's your own matter.

brh: کتنے نا جان نا حق کتنے ولے مجرم اینوس کہ منانے کہ ئے جرم کرے تا دا کتنے
en: He hasn't done it — by your life, he hasn't done it! But which criminal today will admit, 'Yes, I committed the crime'? [They all say] 'I haven't done this.'
en_old: You haven't done right by your life, but the criminal today doesn't admit that he committed the crime, that's what he did.

brh: سردار تو پین کسر سیدھا پا سیدھا سیدھا پا کے ماگولہ راڑ کے انسپکٹر صاحب پین وی
en: Sardar, there's no other way — tell it straight, straight, tell me straight where Mahgul is. — Inspector sahib, again...
en_old: Sardar, so no other way, tell me straight, straight, straight, where Mahgul is. Inspector sahib, again...

brh: پاریٹ کے ماگول نا کنے سما اف۔ واہ جی واہ۔ ماگول نا سما اف۔ ئے جانی اٹ کنے بسے۔ انور! جی سر۔ ہربو بٹ ایٹ۔
en: I've told you that I don't know about Mahgul. — Wow, sir, wow. You don't know about Mahgul. [unclear: 'ye jānī aṭ kane base']. Anwar! — Yes, sir. — Look around [unclear: 'baṭ eṭ'].
en_old: I said I don't know about Mahgul. Wow, wow. You don't know about Mahgul. You came to me in person. Anwar! Yes sir. Take him away.

brh: او تا گاڑی ٹی او ریوک ہم اگن دا مر پاپاکک ہستے ہین تو مونی ما راست پانے گٹیٹ کان مونی
en: ...in their car... [unclear: 'o rēwok'], even if this... [unclear: 'mar pāpākak haste'], go — then ahead... tell the truth... [unclear: 'gaṭīṭ kān'] ahead.
en_old: Oh, in their car, oh, even if he's going... then ahead, tell the truth, from the throat onward...

brh: ہیلو، السلام
en: Hello, peace be upon you.
en_old: Hello, peace be upon you.

brh: ہا، حوصلہ نورل صاحب حوصلہ، نی فکر کننگ نا ہچو ضرورت ئس اف۔
en: Yes — take heart, Noor sahib, take heart; there's no need at all for you to worry.
en_old: Yes, patience, Noor sahib, patience, there's no need for you to worry at all.

brh: کنے خبر ئے خبر ئے کنے، ہندا خاطر آ پاوہ کہ بے فکر کنے نچو سنگت اسے۔
en: I know, I know — that's exactly why I'm saying I'm free of worry: you're a true friend to me.
en_old: I know, I know, that's why I'm telling you not to worry, I have no friends.

brh: جیو ہاں تاݨے ٹی ئے ہمم ماگل ارانکا
en: Bless you — yes, [he's] in the police station? Hmm... where has Mahgul gone?
en_old: Yes, yes, in the cupboard? Hmm, Mahgul isn't there.

brh: بکل خاخرے خاخر کسفو کا خاخر الوپ دیر اٹ کننگ ئس ئے منیروٹ نی دیر ئس آ افضل اٹ کننگ اٹ۔ آ افضل۔
en: [unclear: 'bakal'] Fire! Fire! Go, put out the fire! Fire... [unclear: 'alūp'] it's taking a long time... It's me, Munir; you... [unclear] Afzal... Oh, Afzal.
en_old: Come on, sleep, sleep, go to sleep, sleep... I was waiting for a long time, you were late... Afzal, Afzal.

brh: امر فون کریس؟ ہا یار ذراس کنے ماگل ٹویٹ کرف۔ ماگل داڑے راکبس۔ چاوا کے نی دسکاں بے ہوش ئس یار منیر مسخرہ کپ کنے ماگل ٹویٹ کرف۔
en: How come you called? — Yes, friend, just let me talk to Mahgul for a moment. — Mahgul came here? I know you're still not in your senses, friend. — Munir, don't joke; let me talk to Mahgul.
en_old: How come you called? Yes, friend, just put Mahgul on the phone for me. Mahgul hasn't come here. I know you're unconscious, friend. Munir, don't joke, put Mahgul on for me.

brh: ئے گنوک مسوس، ما گلداری راکبس، یار بن پانے اٹیوس، بند کر دا بکواس تینا، ایلہ پانے ئس کے ونان دے ٹی اونی پاسہ، افضل غصہ کننگ نا ضرورت افک، اگنے یقین بفک
en: Have you gone mad? Mahgul came here? Friend, listen, I'm telling you... — Stop this nonsense of yours! [unclear: 'ēla pāne-as ke vanān dē-ṭī onī pāsa'] — Afzal, there's no need to get angry; if you don't believe [me]...
en_old: Have you gone mad? Mahgul hasn't come, friend, I told you... Stop this nonsense of yours. I already told you that you'd say so in a couple of days. Afzal, there's no need to get angry, if you don't believe me...

brh: منیر نا باوا منیر نا باوا جی فون اینا ننا ٹیلیفون ادا مراد نائے
en: Munir's father, Munir's father! Yes, the phone, it's for him... our telephone, it's brother Murad's call.
en_old: Munir's father, Munir's father, yes, the phone... our telephone here is Murad's.

brh: ہیلو، ہیلو، ادا مراد انت حال احوال ئے ہمیشا ہر کنا ہیتم، انت ئے خیر توارے ایلو؟ ئے برباد مسونٹ، نا گڑا ہیتم۔
en: Hello, hello, brother Murad, how are you, what's the news? I always... every word of mine... What is it, is everything all right, brother? I've been ruined... then...
en_old: Hello, hello, brother Murad, how are you? Always... what's wrong, is everything alright? I'm ruined, my things...

brh: خبر اف ارا نینا دے؟ ہنت؟ ماگل! آخر ارا نینا دے ماگل؟ ہنت دا تو خبر اف ایلم، ئے باز پریشان اٹ۔
en: There's no news... where...? What? Maagul! After all, where is Maagul? What... I don't know this, brother; I'm very worried.
en_old: We don't know where she's been for days. What? Maghul! Where has Maghul been for days? What? I really don't know, brother. I'm very worried.

brh: نی فکر کپہ، ئے انشاءاللہ زوت انی سر کیوہ۔ اللہ خیر کیک، نی تسلی کرک۔ اللہ نگہبان۔ وان تسی کہ فون کرے؟ خدا حافظ۔
en: Don't worry, God willing I'll get to you soon. God will make it right; take comfort. May God protect you. ...that he phoned? Goodbye.
en_old: Don't worry, God willing I'll be with you soon. God will make it right, take heart. May God protect you. ...that you called? Goodbye.

brh: ارفتاتیا دا خا مصیبت بننگٹی ء گڑا اللہ جوان چائے ما انت مصیبت ئس بس ماگل داسہ خبر اف کہ ارانگ ہنانے اونا درک اف
en: For two weeks now this trouble has been coming, and God knows best what calamity has befallen us. Maagul... now there's no news of where she has gone; there's no trace of her.
en_old: For the past few days this trouble has been coming, and God knows what trouble has fallen on us. Maghul — now we don't know where she's gone, there's no trace of her.

brh: دا تو مروئی اسکا۔ اینو اسہ ٹٹہ سے تو۔ بند ک بائتھ نا۔ کم از کم عید تو جوانو کرک۔ ئے وڑم راستنگا عید بندغے تورک۔
en: This was bound to happen. Today is a... Stop this talk. At least celebrate Eid properly. In a way, the real Eid holds a person.
en_old: This was bound to happen. Today, at least for a moment... at least have a good Eid. In a way, Eid really does weigh on a person.

brh: باوا ایت جوان و کڑک۔ تینو ایت کے سنی۔ اینی گا ٹوٹی خلکا۔ واہ خلک واہ خلک۔ تھیرینی ادے خلکا داسہ کاسہ۔ باوا نی باز ایت کپا۔
en: Father, the talk is good and strong... He shot at that one. Wow, he hit it, wow, he hit it! He shot it just now; now you go. Father, don't talk so much.
en_old: Father, speak well and firmly. Speak for yourself... she laughed. Wow, well done, well done... Father, don't talk too much.

brh: او مسس اینا ٹوٹی خلکا اسیتو دا بابا ننا عید ء
en: Oh, it happened, he hit his... This, father, is our Eid.
en_old: Oh, she's grown up, she laughed and joked — this, father, is our Eid.

brh: مسلمانی پاک ہمم خدائے تعالی نا امانت آتھے کر جہان ٹی رسوا و بدنام کننگے تو کنا مسلہ غا گلر اڑے ارے با کنا مسلہ غا گلر اڑے
en: Pure Muslims too... to disgrace and defame God Almighty's trusts in the whole world... then they rejoice over my trouble; oh, over my trouble they rejoice.
en_old: ...to disgrace and defame the trust God Almighty gave us in front of the world. So who will grieve over my problem? Hey, who will grieve over my problem?

brh: ادا، نی ہراٹ بے ماگول کنتونس؟ اگہ ماگول داڑے مسکہ گڑا نی داڑے خواہفیسٹہ۔ کنے ڈپی کریس، او داسہ پاسہ
en: Brother, how is it you're with me without Maagul? If Maagul were here, you wouldn't be calling here. You came down on me, and now you say...
en_old: Brother, where did you lose Maghul while she was with you? If Maghul had been here, you wouldn't have come here. You've disgraced me, he'll say now.

brh: ماہ گل داڑے افک، دا گدو توتف، کنا معصوم آ زردے کرے، اف اللہ، ئے کنے باور کا، ایڑے پارت کے، ماہ گل داڑے اف، کنا راگی نا کرم
en: Maagul isn't here... my innocent heart... Oh God! Believe me, I said so there: Maagul is not here, by the grace of my...
en_old: Mahgul isn't here. This wretch has bewitched me and hurt my innocent heart. Oh God, believe me, say it like this: Mahgul isn't here, on my soul.

brh: ارنگ نا اللہ اللہ کے ابود تینٹ تینا مرضی ٹی ورائلانے نانے انت ایت کنے
en: Where... by God, by God... she left by herself, of her own will. What can I tell you?
en_old: Where, by God... she went off on her own, of her own will. What can I tell you?

brh: او دے تینا باوہ نا عزت نا احساس ارے خاندان نا عزت نا احساس ارے او تو دن کنے کپک اسل دن کنے کپک
en: She has a sense of her father's honor, a sense of the family's honor. She would never do this to me, never do this to me.
en_old: She cares about her father's honor, she cares about the family's honor. She would never do this to me, never do this to me.

brh: اینا ہران دیر تریتے؟ آ پٹ، ئے تمام برتکہ، کنا مسڑ نا بندغ آ برتکہ، مسڑ خدا نا امانت، رسول نا امانت کنا مسڑ نا بندغ برتکہ، کنا مسڑ نا کنے ہیت کر، اللہ۔
en: Who took her, and from where? Search... I... all of it... my daughter's people... A daughter is God's trust, the Prophet's trust... my daughter's people... Tell me about my daughter, O God.
en_old: Who took her from here? ...They all came, my daughter's people came. A daughter is God's trust, the Prophet's trust. My daughter's people came. Tell me about my daughter, O God.

brh: نی تینے پریشان کپہ، اللہ خیر کے، دا کنا نی تو وعدہ ہی باگل نا ہراڑے دست رشنگا، پھٹیرے ٹوپی دے کاواتے، گناہ غا سر کے۔
en: Don't worry yourself, God will make it right. This is my promise to you: wherever Maagul is found... they will be brought to account for the sin.
en_old: Don't worry yourself, God will make it right. This is my promise to you: wherever Maghul is found... they will pay for their sin.

brh: نی مئے آزارک ہندا ہوٹل نا باروٹی وٹ کنا مسڑ کنے رسینگتو ئے قیامت ئس کنے بخش بروٹک ئے نی پاریٹ بس کنا مسڑ نا
en: You torment me over this very hotel business. If my daughter doesn't come back to me, a doomsday will fall to my lot. I told you, just my daughter...
en_old: You're tormenting me with talk of this hotel. If my daughter doesn't come back to me, it will be doomsday for me. Forgive me... just tell me about my daughter.

brh: خدائے نا منت، دا رحمت ئ کنے اسہ۔ نا باز باز مہربانی مرو۔ اللہ خیر کے۔ باز مہربانی مرو۔ نورال، کہانی جوان ختم
en: By God's grace, this is a mercy for me. It would be very, very kind of you. May God make it well. Thank you very much. Nooral, the story ended well.
en_old: Thank God, this is a mercy for me. Thank you so very much. God bless you. Thank you so much. Noral, the story ended well.

brh: دا جہان ٹی ما گلے مرادے کنے وس پا کنے کنے ہی ونے
en: In this world, Maagul and Murad... just tell me, tell me...
en_old: In this world, who do I have besides Murad? Tell me, tell me.

brh: دنے لپاروٹ، نی ہم رسوا کروٹ، ادا مراد
en: Don't talk like that; you'll disgrace us too, brother Murad.
en_old: Don't say that, you'll disgrace me too, brother Murad.

brh: ادا مراد دا امتحانک بریرہ کاری بائیدے کہ بندغ حوصلہ اٹ کاری ملے آن حوصلہ اٹ کاری ملے
en: Brother Murad, such trials do come. A person must face them with courage, with courage.
en_old: Brother Murad, trials like these come. A person has to face them with courage, with courage.

brh: او ئے کسے مون نشان تننگ نا قابل افٹ وراغان پیش مننگ کپرا زند ختم مسونوٹ او نی باز حوصلہ کر نا نا نا دن پاپا اگر نی ہندے داغس پریشان کیس تو مخلوق پین زہن
en: Oh, I'm not fit to show my face to anyone. I can't appear before anyone; my life is over. Oh, have great courage. No, no, no, don't say that. If you worry yourself like this, people will think even more...
en_old: I can't show my face to anyone, I can't face anyone, my life is over. Oh, be strong, no, no, no, don't say that. If you worry yourself like this, people will think even more...

brh: ادا زی ایک دکیک، اینی جوڑ کیک مخلوق، دا انت کک، ئے دا ہیت ء ڈک کٹ، اما ڈک کین کیوا دا ہیت ء، ادا ادا، ئے کہریٹ، اینی تے پریشان کپا۔
en: Brother... people will make things up. What is this? I'll hide this matter; I can hide this matter. Brother, brother, I... don't worry yourself.
en_old: Here, look, people are making a fuss. What is this? Hide this matter; we will keep this matter hidden. Here, here, look, don't worry them.

brh: نی تینے اسل پریشان کپہ، کل اللہ جوان کیک۔ ہنست، افضل ہنست، گام، گام، ہنست، افضل، افضل، ابا ہنست، ہنست، ہنست۔
en: Don't worry yourself at all; God will make everything all right. What's wrong with him? Afzal, what's wrong? Step, step... what's wrong? Afzal, Afzal, oh dear, what's wrong, what's wrong, what's wrong?
en_old: Don't worry yourself at all, God will make everything fine. Enough, Afzal, enough, step by step, enough, Afzal, Afzal, father, enough, enough, enough.

brh: افضل جان ہن مس کنا ماری ایلو ہن مس افضل جان ہن مس ایلو افضل جان ہن مس کنا ماری ہن مس
en: Afzal jan, what happened? My son! Brother, what happened? Afzal jan, what happened? Brother... Afzal jan, what happened? My son, what happened?
en_old: What happened to Afzal jan, my son? What happened to the other one? What happened to Afzal jan? What happened to the other one, Afzal jan? What happened to my son?

brh: بجلی نا، بجلی نا، الہ زو، ڈاکٹر ہتے، ڈاکٹر ہتے، او ماتی، او ماتی، ہمت کر، ہمت کر، ہمت کر، ہمت کر، بے ہوشی، بے ہوشی
en: The electricity, the electricity! Quick, bring the doctor, bring the doctor! Oh mother, oh mother, be brave, be brave, be brave, be brave! Unconscious, unconscious!
en_old: The electricity, the electricity, quick, bring the doctor, bring the doctor! Oh mother, oh mother, be brave, be brave, be brave, be brave! Unconscious, unconscious!

brh: جونگی خان، او دے جورہ خان خنے پگینو؟ جورہ خان نورالخان نا رند اٹ ہنانے، اور نی تو سما ہی کہ جورہ خان اسہ وار
en: Jongi Khan, hey, have you seen Jora Khan? Jora Khan has gone after Nooral Khan, and you know that Jora Khan once...
en_old: Jongi Khan, have you seen Jora Khan? Jora Khan went after Noorul Khan, and you know that Jora Khan once...

brh: کسے نا رندٹ تمنے اوٹ دا دنیا غان ختم۔ راست پاش ایلو۔ ہما سوس نہ۔ خبردار قسمس تینا جاگہ غا سوڑیں خبردار۔ ہرا دے جوڑا کرادے۔ صابنے سما افک۔ ہمرے سما اف جوڑا کرادے پاوٹ۔ معاف کر۔ خبردار۔
en: Once I go after someone, he's finished from this world. Tell the truth, brother... Careful! I swear, stay in your place! Careful! Who did this? Sahib, I don't know. I don't know who did it, or I'd tell you. Forgive me. Careful!
en_old: Chasing after someone, I'm done with this world. Tell the truth, the rest. Not that one. Careful, I swear, stay where you are, careful. Whoever made it, made it. Saban doesn't know. I don't know, I'll say who made it. Forgive me. Careful.

brh: خاخار ئے خاخار، کسفو خاخارا ننو، مونا کچا ننو، مونا کچا، مونا، مونا
en: Fire, oh fire! The fire will kill us! Forward... us forward, forward, forward, forward!
en_old: Brother, brother, which brother of ours, bring us forward, forward, forward, forward.

brh: ڈاکٹر صاحب او مسکنا مارے کنا اسیٹنگا مارے دادے جوانی اٹ ہبو اماں بے ہوش ء جھٹاسے آن پد تینا ہوش اٹ بریک نم تینے پریشان کپبو اللہ خیر کیک ادی اسلم ڈاکٹر صاحب ڈاکٹر صاحب
en: Doctor sahib, he is my son, my one and only son; look after him well. Mother, he's unconscious; after a while he'll come back to his senses. Don't worry yourselves, God will make it well. Sister, Aslam... doctor sahib, doctor sahib.
en_old: Doctor sahib, he is my son, my only son, take good care of him. Mother, he's unconscious; after a while he'll come back to his senses. Don't worry yourselves, God will make it fine. Here, Aslam, doctor sahib, doctor sahib.

brh: اللہ خیر کے، اللہ خیر کے، نا بابا خطرہ نا ہچ چٹ ہچ چٹ صفا اگر خطرہ نا ہیت مسکہ تو ئے نی تینٹ پاریٹ کہ دادے شہر اٹ دبو آمین اللہ خیر کے انشاء اللہ دا پنچ منٹ آ پد نی خوشخبری ئس بروک ء پریشان کپا بو دیدی
en: May God make it well, may God make it well. No, father, there's no danger at all, none whatsoever. If there were any question of danger, I would have told you myself to take him to the city. Amen, may God make it well. God willing, in five minutes you'll get good news. Don't worry, sister.
en_old: May God make it well, may God make it well. No, father, there's no danger at all, none whatsoever. If there were any danger, I'd have told you myself to take him to the city. Amen, may God make it well. God willing, in five minutes you'll get good news. Don't worry, sister.

brh: اسکول ئے خواننگ نا تہمور ئے بعد کہ اوفتے تون دا ناانصافی مف۔ ماسٹر صاحب، دا نمیا بارہ پاز ماسٹر بسورے نار، ولے اوفتے ایتے کسے؟
en: ...[at this age] they need to study at school, so that this injustice is not done to them. Master sahib, many masters came here before you and went, but did anyone give them anything?
en_old: ...they should study at school, so that this injustice isn't done to them. Master sahib, many masters came here before you, but who gave them anything?

brh: بس بنتو او ہندن واپس ہنار ناگل خان نی ہمو اینو کا ماسٹر آتے نا فٹر
en: They just came and went back like that. No, Gul Khan, don't count [me] among those masters.
en_old: They just came and went back like that. Gul Khan, don't count me among those masters.

brh: ئے داسہ دا کٹہ سوپن پاروچ ئے اسہ اسہ وراغے کاوا اسہ اسہ پرانا گلی ٹی ٹکی فیوا اوفتہ لمہ باوائی مجبور کیوا
en: Now I... I will go to each and every house, knock in each and every old lane, and press their parents
en_old: Now they'll say this is a broken dream; I'll go house to house, knock on every old alley, and persuade their parents.

brh: کبو تینا چناتے اسکول آ مون ایتر۔ السلام علیکم ماسٹر صاحب۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ ماسٹر صاحب کنے خواننگ نا باز شوق ء۔ ولے کنے خواننگ کن لپ ٹاپ ئس اف۔ ہاں؟
en: ...to send their children to school. Peace be upon you, Master sahib. And upon you be peace. Master sahib, I love studying very much, but I don't have a laptop to study with. Hmm?
en_old: Do it so that they send their children to school. Peace be upon you, master sahib. And upon you be peace. Master sahib, I really love studying, but I don't have a laptop to study with. Yes?

brh: دے خواننگ نا شوق ء، ولے اسکول ء لپاسہ دیر؟
en: He has a passion for studying, but who won't let [him go] to school?
en_old: They have a passion for studying, but how will they go to school?

brh: جی میر صاحب۔ منے فک کے ماسٹر اسکول ئنا ہنگٹی ئنا؟ جیو میر صاحب۔ دا پاو کے چنا کے اسکول ئنا ہنگٹی ئنا؟ میر صاحب کسے نا مجال کے تینا چنا کے اسکولا رائی
en: Yes, Mir sahib. [So] the master is going to the school? Yes, Mir sahib. Tell me this: are the children going to the school? Mir sahib, who would dare send their child to school?
en_old: Yes, Mir sahib. Did you hear that a master has come to the school? Yes, Mir sahib. Tell him, who will send their children to school? Mir sahib, who would dare send their child to school?

brh: شاباش شاباش گلو باز جوان نم ماسٹر ء سکولوس ہنیرے اوتے دا پاہ بو کہ نی ہخس کہ کوشست کیس
en: Well done, well done, Gullu, very good. Go to the master at the school and tell him this: however hard you try...
en_old: Well done, well done, Gullu, very good. Go to the master at the school and tell him that you'll try as hard as you can.

brh: دا کس کو دا خواننگ کے صبح فسے او ہاں ماسٹر دا پابو کہ میر جلال خان نا چنا ہی خوانفنگ کے نی وراغ بروئی تمیک او مننگٹ ئس نا
en: This one, about this studying in the morning... Oh yes, tell the master this: you must come to the house to teach Mir Jalal Khan's children too...
en_old: Who is this who studies here in the morning? Oh yes, tell the master that he'll have to come to the house to teach Mir Jalal Khan's children too, or else...

brh: جی میر صاحب، انت حکم؟ ایرہ کھو، واہ، نی نوکرک کے ماسٹر نا نظر ٹی خہ۔ ہن کے، انت حکم میر صاحب؟
en: Yes, Mir sahib, what is your order? ... Wah! You, servant, keep an eye on the master. Go! What is your order, Mir sahib?
en_old: Yes, Mir sahib, what are your orders? Sit down, well, you're a servant, keep an eye on the master. Yes, what are your orders, Mir sahib?

brh: نیکی انت کوم؟ انت کوم کئیک ہمے نیکی؟ ہن ہن ہن ڈغار تا کنڈ ئنک غیب مر کنا مون آن۔ ٹھیک ہی میر صاحب۔
en: What use is a good deed? What good does that good deed do? Go, go, go, to the far corners of the land, disappear from my sight! All right, Mir sahib.
en_old: What use is goodness? What good does that goodness do? Go, go, go to the ends of the earth and get out of my sight. All right, Mir sahib.

brh: ہندا وڑ نن مخلوق ء پاننگ کینہ کہ او تینا چناتے بریر خوانفیر۔ ہو دا تو اوفتا کے دا وڑ
en: In the same way, we can tell the people to come and have their children taught. Yes, this is for their [good], in this way...
en_old: In the same way, we can tell the people to come and have their children educated. Yes, this is theirs, in this way...

brh: اسلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ جی حکم۔ خیریت چے؟ شکر ئے کنا پن ماسٹر خدابخش۔
en: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Yes, at your service. Is everything well? Thank God, [all is well]. My name is Master Khuda Bakhsh.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. Yes, how can I help? Is everything well? Thank God. My name is Master Khudabakhsh.

brh: کنا ٹرانسفر دا اسکول ٹی مسونے، مس دا اسکول بند اسکہ، داسہ ملنگانے، نمے آن دا خواست ء کہ نم تینا چناتے اسکولے مون ایت بو۔ ماسٹر صاحب دا تو خوشی نا ہیت ء، ننا چناک ہم خواننگ خواہرہ، ولے داڈیکہ
en: I have been transferred to this school. This school used to be closed; now it has been opened. My request to you is that you send your children to school. Master sahib, that is happy news indeed; our children also want to study, but until now
en_old: I have been transferred to this school. This school was closed, and now it is being reopened, so I request that you send your children to school. Master sahib, that is happy news. Our children want to study too, but until now

brh: خوانے فوکلو، داسہ انشااللہ نن بسونن، نما چناک خوانیور، ولے داسہ نما چناک ارادے؟ داسہ تو ہنانو کاریمہ، انشااللہ پگہ چناتے مون ایتنہ، باز
en: there was no teacher. Now, God willing, we have come, and your children will study. But where are your children now? Right now they have gone to work. God willing, we will send the children tomorrow. Many
en_old: who would teach them? Now, God willing, we have come, and your children will study. But where are your children now? Right now they are at work. God willing, we will send the children tomorrow. Thank you very

brh: جان نما باز مہربانی تول بو چاس مرے نا پین وختس برینا چا تو نوار ارغ ہم کنوٹ باز خوشی نیتے اللہ نومے ہتے مہربانی مہربانی اللہ خواجہ باز مہربانی اللہ نومے آباد کے نا باز خوش مسٹ نمے تون ملسا باز مہربانی
en: Thank you so much, dear. Sit down and have some tea, all right? We'll come another time. As for tea, I don't drink it, and I've already eaten too. Very glad... may God [bless] you. Thank you, thank you. God protect you. Thank you very much. May God keep you prosperous. I was very happy to meet you. Thank you very much.
en_old: Thank you very much. Please sit down and have some tea, all right? I'll come another time. I don't drink tea, and I've already eaten. You're very kind, may God reward you. Thank you, thank you. May God keep you well. Thank you very much, may God keep you prosperous. I was very happy to meet you. Thank you very much.

brh: باز مہربانی۔ گل خان ہناس نا؟ باز خوش مریرے مخلص آ کاکا۔
en: Thank you very much. Gul Khan, you're off, are you? Stay very happy, my dear, sincere uncle.
en_old: much. Gul Khan, how are you? Stay happy, my dear uncle.

brh: بیٹا بات سنو نا شاباش ادھر آ جاؤ شاباش شاباش آ کنا
en: Son, listen, okay? Well done, come over here. Well done, well done, come, my dear.
en_old: Son, listen, all right? Well done, come here. Well done, well done, come here, my dear.

brh: دے خفتو او، نما خلک اٹے اسکول بلینگانے، ٹھیک ہی نا؟ پگاہ صبحے نم کل اسکول آ بریرے نا؟ جی سائیں، جی سائیں، ہا، اسکول اٹ نمے کتاب، تختی، سلیٹ، کاپی، ہر گڑا ملوئے، ٹھیک ہی نا؟
en: Listen, a school has been opened in your village, all right? Tomorrow morning you will all come to school, won't you? Yes sir, yes sir. Yes, at school you will get books, a wooden writing board, a slate, notebooks, everything, all right?
en_old: Listen, a school has been opened in your village, all right? Tomorrow morning you will all come to school, won't you? Yes sir, yes sir. Yes, at school you will get books, a writing board, a slate, notebooks, everything, all right?

brh: نم کتو وعدہ کبو پگہ ئے سوبے اسکول آ نمنا انتظار کیوہ۔ ٹھیک ہی جی ہاں! شاباش۔ باز جوان۔ اللہ حافظ۔ ماسٹر صاحب زندہ باد! ماسٹر صاحب زندہ باد!
en: All of you, promise me: tomorrow morning I will be waiting for you at school. All right? Yes! Well done. Very good. Goodbye. Long live Master sahib! Long live Master sahib!
en_old: All of you promise me. Tomorrow morning I will be waiting for you at school. All right? Yes! Well done. Very good. God be with you. Long live Master sahib! Long live Master sahib!

brh: حق اللہ حق بابا جی اینو رے کریس چاوا کے جاگہ سے ناسس نہ
en: Haq Allah Haq. Baba ji, where did you go today? I know you were somewhere, weren't you?
en_old: Haq Allah Haq. Baba ji, where did you go today? Did you go somewhere?

brh: ئے چجا گس اٹ اسٹ۔ نی کنے یاد کریس؟ دا دے بسوٹ۔ اباجی واقعی دا صبا سری خلسا خلسا نی یاد کریٹ۔
en: ...I was at [someone's] house. Did you remember me? I came today. Abba ji, truly, since this morning I kept remembering you over and over.
en_old: …I was at such-and-such a house. Did you remember me? I came today. Father, truly, this morning I kept remembering you.

brh: نی کنے یاد کریس؟ یاد کرمسٹ۔ نی امر ئس کنا مار؟ جوانٹ بابا جی۔ نی کے چاء شاو؟ نہ۔ چاء کمپر۔ دانا کھٹٹ اینت اسے؟
en: Did you remember me? I did. How are you, my son? I'm well, Baba ji. Shall I pour you some tea? No. I don't drink tea. What is that you have there?
en_old: Did you remember me? I did remember you. How are you, my son? I'm fine, Baba ji. Will you have some tea? No. I don't drink tea. What is that in your hand?

brh: دا، دا قلم اسے، نی خبر ئے قلما، دانا لکھی رٹے اخہ بلو طاقت اسے
en: This, this is a pen. Do you know what a pen is? What great power there is in its writing!
en_old: This, this is a pen. Do you know what a pen is? What great power there is in its writing.

brh: دا قلم زغمانم تیزی۔ ہنت بابا دا نہ لکیر زغمانم تیزی۔ راست پاو کنا مار دا نہ قدر و قیمت تے پو مرک۔
en: This pen is sharper than a sword. What, Baba? Its line is sharper than a sword? I'm telling you the truth, my son; one comes to understand its worth and value.
en_old: This pen is sharper than a sword. What, Baba? Its line is sharper than a sword. It's true, my son, people don't understand its value.

brh: دانہ کے طاقت نی پد دنیا نا ہچ گڑا سیٹی مف۔ دانت پاننگس باوا جی۔ راست باوا کنا مار۔ اندامو طاقت ئے
en: Such is its power that nothing in the world [can match it]. What are you saying, Baba ji? It's true, my son. That is how much power it has.
en_old: Without its power, nothing in the world is worth anything. What are you saying, Baba ji? It's true, my son. That is how great its power is.

brh: اراسل دا دے حاصل کرے تو دا دنیا ہو نمس حق اللہ حق بابا ئے عید تہ غٹ ایتو ولے تولنے عید کنے
en: Whoever acquires this, this world is his. Haq Allah Haq. Everyone will give Baba his Eid gift, but... Eid for me...
en_old: Whoever gains this, the whole world is theirs. Haq Allah Haq. Baba gives everyone their Eid, but sit down, my Eid…

brh: ماسٹر خان میر صاحب خوشوننے
en: Master, Khan Mir sahib has called for you.
en_old: Master, Mir Khan sahib is calling you.

brh: تینا میر صاحبے پاک کہ دا وختی کنا اسکول نا وختی ئے وندا بریو شاید نمے میر صاحب نا غصہ غان معلوم افک کمر غصہ او بندغاسے او ٹھیک ئے نی بریوہ
en: Tell your Mir sahib that right now it is my school time; I'll come later. Perhaps you don't know about Mir sahib's anger; he is a very hot-tempered man. Oh, all right, I'll come.
en_old: Tell your Mir sahib that this is my school time, and I will come later. Maybe you don't know about Mir sahib's anger; he is a very angry man. All right, I will come.

brh: وری او کنا میثاق سخت غصہ والا سے۔ بگانہ کا۔ ننا ڈبوسٹ مرس۔ نی برے۔ ورہ۔
en: Oh dear, my Mir sahib is a very hot-tempered one. Go quickly. We'll be ruined. You come along. I'm coming.
en_old: Go on, he is a very angry man. Come quickly. We'll get in trouble. You come. I'm coming.

brh: او ماسٹر اینا انتظار ئ کننگ اٹی اٹ جی میر صاحب نم یاد کریرے نن
en: Oh Master, I have been waiting for you. Yes, Mir sahib, you sent for us?
en_old: Oh Master, I've been waiting for you. Yes, Mir sahib, you sent for us?

brh: حاضر مسن۔ ماسٹر! نم ایراٹ ٹی مارک ہراڑے بسنرے؟ ولے کنا ملنگ ہت بتنورے؟ ہنو دہ خلک کٹ کنا ایراٹ پکو دے۔
en: We are at your service. Master! Where have you two come from? But why haven't you come to meet me? This village here is mine, for certain.
en_old: I'm here. Master! How is it that you've come to our village? Why didn't you come to see me? Those ten houses are our whole village.

brh: پدا نما کنے خبر ملو، او پدا دا خلکٹی کسے درست ہم کپرا، اینو سیدھا اسکولے ناٹ، اسکولے ملاٹ، جوان، تو اسکول نا چناک، مئے بخیر کریر
en: Then I would have got word from you, and besides, I don't even know anyone in this village. Today I went straight to the school and opened the school — good — and then the school's children welcomed me.
en_old: Then I got your message, and still nobody in this village did anything right. Today I went straight to the school and visited it. Good. The school children welcomed us.

brh: میر صاحب خبر اف کے اٹ وخت آن اسکول بند ئے او کسس ئے خبر ام اف آہستہ آہستہ کسس ئے خبر تمو تو برے سے کرور باز مشکل ئے کہ کسس تینا چناتے اسکول ا مون دے
en: Mir Sahib, nobody knows how long the school has been closed, and nobody even has any word of it. Slowly, slowly people will find out and then they will start coming; right now it is very hard for anyone to send his children to school.
en_old: Mir Sahib, nobody knows how long the school has been closed. Slowly people are finding out. Now it's very hard for anyone to send their children to school.

brh: انت میر صاحب؟ خواننگ تو اوفتہ حق ء۔ امر وکس میر صاحب چاوہ کہ نی دایتے گیرام کرینے
en: What, Mir Sahib? Studying is their right. How so, Mir Sahib? I know that you have forgotten about them.
en_old: What, Mir Sahib? Getting an education is their right. How would Mir Sahib know that you have kept them away from it?

brh: ئس کہ چنا تا ہنتک کو، جوان، دسے نیکن ئے دا بوگس کہ دا علاقہ ٹی چنا تا ہنتک کو، کنا خیال پارے کہ ماسٹر نیکن ئے ٹی پیشے، انتیکہ اسکول نا چپراسی کنے کلے دادے پارے نی
en: ...that the children don't go. Well, let me tell you this: in this area the children don't go (to school). I thought the master was away, because the school's peon told me all this.
en_old: …that the children don't go. Well, today this happened: in this area the children don't go. I thought the master was not around, because the school peon told me this.

brh: اگر کنے چاسنن تو داڑے خالی کنا مارے خوانیفوس۔ دا خلک ٹی اسے چنا اسکول بفرودہ پومرک۔ اگر نماڑ تو نوار دا خلک نا چار چنا پین علم نا روشنائی فائدہ ارفیرہ۔
en: If you know who I am, then here you will teach only my son. In this village not a single child will come to school, understand that. If ... then four other children of this village would also benefit from the light of knowledge.
en_old: If you had known me, my son alone would have studied here. Not a single child from this village comes to school, and that's a problem. If you do this, four more children from this village will benefit from the light of knowledge.

brh: تو گڑا دا ٹینتھ فرق تمبے؟ ماسٹر! اینے پریڈ نا؟ پین کس ئس اسکول آ بفرور، بس۔ نوم کنا مانی خوانفوری، بس
en: So then, what difference does this make to you? Master! Today's period? No one else will come to the school, that's it. You will teach my son, that's it.
en_old: So will that make a difference for tenth grade? Master! What about today's class? Even if no one else comes to school, fine. Just let my Mani study.

brh: ٹھیک ہی مصاحب، اگر کس بتو تو ئے پدی کاوا، ئے بیرہ نوا چنائے
en: All right, Mir Sahib. If nobody comes, then I will go back. Me, only for your child?
en_old: All right, Mir Sahib. If nobody comes, I won't go back. I'll teach just your child.

brh: نما وراٹی فانی فنگی بفروٹ۔ انتے کہ ئے سکول نا ماسٹر وٹ، نا چنا نا ماسٹر افٹ۔
en: I will not come to your house to teach, because I am the school's teacher, not your child's teacher.
en_old: I won't come to your aid, because I am the school's teacher, not your child's teacher.

brh: جاروے، کیک من ایندے پاتکائے؟ دے گروچ اللہ ما جست پکا تاکہ مانو تو نقصانہ مروئی
en: (Balochi) ... why did you say this today? Another day God will question us, so that you don't come to harm.
en_old: Jaro, why did you say that today? May God keep us from such talk, or else there will be harm.

brh: ہابرے بدے وتی حال احوالہ، میریں بیچارہ دریا گار بوت میر، خالو تو ایچے گوشہ کہ گنوک تروک بوتگے، ہاں چیزو روچ پیشا طیوب میرین نا کستیں
en: (Balochi) Yes, well, tell me how you are. Poor Miren was lost at sea. Uncle, you are saying this as if you've gone mad. Yes, a few days ago Miren's boat...
en_old: Tell me how things are with you. Poor Mir was lost at sea. Uncle says he has gone mad. Yes, a few days ago Mir's boat…

brh: جیڑا بوتگت، چوش تو نی کہ ارا دریائے تو کتو ڈب داتگے؟ توبہ توبہ توبہ۔ منا ایرے چنکس منع کو۔ دریائے ہماروک، طوفانے توڈ سے۔ بلے منی گپ مزرتئے
en: (Balochi) ...had happened. So is it that the sea has drowned him? God forbid, God forbid, God forbid. I forbade him so much. The sea was rough, there was a storm. But he didn't heed my word.
en_old: Had there been a fight? So are you saying the sea drowned him? God forbid, God forbid! I tried to stop him a little. The sea was raging, and the storm broke the boat. But nobody listened to me.

brh: اللہ کے منے گپ بو زور تہ مرچی اینو چنا چارتگا اللہ مکہ نازو منا چئی تے جدائی اچ سگنگ مپنی اللہ چھیرو
en: (Balochi) O God, if only he had taken my word, today he would be looking after his children. O God, Nazo, I cannot bear being separated from him. O God...
en_old: Oh God, if only my words had carried weight, the children would be looked after today. Oh God, Nazo, my children can't bear being apart from me. Oh God…

brh: وش میاری کہ من تو جتا بتو من من بے تو زندہ متنہ کنا مائی سے ہم مرنگ تس تو او مائی سے ہم کواسنگ تس تو نا کسے
en: (Balochi, partly garbled) ...that I was separated from you; without you I would not stay alive. My mother too died, and her mother too ... yours ...
en_old: It's a good thing I wasn't separated from them. Without me they wouldn't have survived. My mother died too…

brh: اینا نازک چشمہ کش دراز زندگ بھوگی وتی ہترا ئے ساگانی ہترا زندے تہہ چوشے اڑاند و جنجال کائنت و روانت بلے ایشی مطلب اینت
en: (Balochi) Nazuk, don't be like this; may you live long. In everyone's life such obstacles and troubles come and go, but that doesn't mean...
en_old: Nazuk, may you have a long life. In everyone's life such obstacles and troubles come and go, but that doesn't mean…

brh: ئے مردم او تارا ہلاس بپکو تارا مقابلہ کنگی نازک ایڑان تو جنجالانی مقابلہ کنگی ئے تارا کو حوصلۂ چکار زیرگی ئے وتی زند کو ہزین کیئی
en: (Balochi) ...that a person should finish himself off. We have to face them; Nazuk, we have to face these obstacles and troubles, we must take courage and make our life beautiful.
en_old: …that a person should end themselves. We have to face difficulties, find courage and make our lives beautiful.

brh: ناظر تو زانیں مئے روچ و شپ ہکا محنت چیا کناں؟ ہر چہ کہ من لوٹاں کہ ہمے یک بھلائیں لوگے ببئی۔ ہمے تئی کسر ئٹی ہر آسراتی ببئی۔
en: (Balochi) Nazir, do you know why I work so hard day and night? Because I want us to have a big house, and that you have every comfort on your way.
en_old: Nazar, do you know why I work so hard day and night? Because I want us to have a big house and for you to have every comfort along the way.

brh: بزگ، بزگ بوانا مزنی مردم جوڑ مرو، تو زانے تئی واستہ من چے سوچتہ؟ چے سوچتہ؟
en: (Balochi) Study — study and become a great person. Do you know what I have thought of for you? What I have thought of?
en_old: Child, when you grow up and become an important person… do you know what I've planned for you? What have I planned?

brh: ملوکان پد دستے اوچ مرے دیمے نندوک اویر او منتار انچو بچارہ دنیائے ہر وشیا منتی دامنے ہیکر او
en: (Balochi, partly garbled) After meeting (him), the hands were raised; the one sitting in front ... poor thing, it was as if every happiness in the world (fell) into my lap.
en_old: After meeting, he raised his hands. The one sitting in front… poor thing, it was as if all the happiness in the world were in my lap.

brh: نازک ء دست ء ہچ کار مفک ہچ زرہ دست ء مفک
en: (Balochi) Nothing gets done by Nazuk's hand; no money comes into her hand.
en_old: Nazuk's hands can't do any work. She has no heart for anything.

brh: نازک منی گواڑ من تے دردہ سرپدوم تارا میرین برا سیاد ایگینا مائی شمش نہ کنے نہ کنے
en: (Balochi) Nazuk, my sister, I understand your pain. Miren was a brother and kin to you; we will never forget him, never.
en_old: Nazuk, my sister, I understand your pain... a relative like you... won't do it to me, won't do it to me.

brh: استو راست گوشی، ہر کس کہ منچو نزدیک بے یا آیا گو مارا مہر بیت، ہر چہ آسانی ء دلبورت نہ کنے، بلے چیزے مردم انچو شتا، کہ آیانی خاطرا ہم مروچی وداری، کہ یک نہ یک روچے واپس کائے۔
en: (Balochi) You speak the truth. Whoever is close to me or has love for us, one doesn't let them go easily; but some people leave in such a way that even today we wait for them, hoping that one day or another they will come back.
en_old: To tell the truth, whoever was close to me or loved us, nobody lets go of them easily, but some people left in such a way that even today we wait for them, hoping that one day they will come back.

brh: منی مئی نی زند چون گوازینی ما چون گوازین ئے زند منی گوار زندے روچاں گو حوصلہ ہمتا چلائینگ لوٹی اگر تو کمی بے بے حوصلہ بوتے
en: (Balochi) My dear, how will you spend your life now? How will we spend this life? My sister, the days of life have to be carried on with courage and resolve; if you lose heart even a little...
en_old: My dear, how did you spend your life, how do we spend life... my sister, the days of life have to be lived with courage and determination; if you lose heart...

brh: دے، ورتی زاگہ نی چے بت، چے بت زاگہ نی، ئے برباد مٹنا، نکے چے بت اشانی، چشمہ گوش، ترا زاگہ نا زند گوازینگی، بلے چے بت
en: (Balochi) Look, what will become of your children now? What will become of the children now? They will be ruined; what will become of them? Don't say that; you have to live your life for the children. But what will become...
en_old: Look... what happened to your son, what happened to your son... this was ruined... what happened to them... your son's life is passing, but what happened...

brh: جون! منی گوار بگو نا جون! خوازینے زندہ! صبر کر منی گوار، اللہ خیر کا، نمرہ مے شام کا۔
en: (Balochi) Dear! My sister, say it, dear! You will live your life! Be patient, my sister, God will make it well; Nimra will come in the evening.
en_old: Life! My sister, say life! Life is sweet! Be patient, my sister, God will make things well; our Nimra will come in the evening.

brh: ہا ہا ہا چیالے وش ادرے جوڑے شیردل ارمتی
en: (Balochi) Ha ha ha, how are you? Good, you're well here, Sherdil...
en_old: Ha ha ha, how nice, here, well done, Sherdil...

brh: بورے باز ودارا کتگوں ہاؤ نا نا چشنگا پینے من گوتو برابریئے بنیادا حساب کتاب کنک لوٹی مردمہ سرا بائیدے مردم کسنے بیست
en: (Balochi) We have waited a long time. Yes, no, no, not like that. I want to settle accounts with you on the basis of equality; one has to rely on people, a person...
en_old: We have waited a long time... I want the accounts to be settled on the basis of equality; one should be fair to people, no one is...

brh: صحیح کئیں یار، بارڈرے ئے نیمگے ذمہ واری منی، آ نیمگے ذمہ داری تئی۔ ادا ہرچی کہ مردم دیمہ دینہ، آہانے ذمہ داری تئی ئے آہاں، بالکل۔ من تو ہمے لوٹین۔
en: (Balochi) That's right, friend: the responsibility for this side of the border is mine, and the responsibility for that side is yours. Whatever people we send ahead from here, the responsibility for them is yours, absolutely. That is exactly what I want.
en_old: Right, my friend, the responsibility for this side of the border is mine, and the responsibility for that side is yours. Whoever we send ahead from here, they are your responsibility, absolutely. That is exactly what I want.

brh: نہ بابا تو تو بیگم بے ادا سرکاری مردم منی دستا ہا او پدا منی دستا چوم مبا منا اینی ہر پائشگی فیلو کنا گاؤں ہا ضرور ضرور منی تے
en: (Balochi, partly garbled) No, man, don't you worry; here the government people are in my hands, and then in my hands ... every fellow of my village ... definitely, definitely ...
en_old: No, father, you will be... here the government people are in my hands, and then don't be like this with me... every fellow from my village, definitely, definitely...

brh: گند نندے بیت، او بھلے شکے، کاروبار ہمیشے بیسہ سرا بیت، اللہ نگہبان شیر دل، اللہ نگہبان، السلام علیکم واجہ، کالو تو؟
en: (Balochi) Nothing bad will happen, and no doubt — business always runs on money. God protect you, Sherdil, God protect you. Peace be upon you, sir. Uncle, is that you?
en_old: Bad times come and go, and there is no doubt, business always runs on trust. God protect you, Sherdil, God protect you. Peace be upon you, sir. How are you, Kalu?

brh: دا شاعری کل محفوظ ئے اللہ تعالی نا دا مہربانی ئے ننا اور نما خاص کنٹریبیوشن ئے کنے دا سہ نا خطرہ اف کہ دا گم مرو۔ دا شاعری تیرہ تو مچ کرے ارا شاعر شعر نمے زیادہ متاثر کرے محسوس کرے کہ یار دا تو
en: This poetry is all preserved; this is the kindness of God Almighty, and it is our and your special contribution, and now I have no fear that it will be lost. You collected this poetry: which poet's verse affected you most, so that you felt, 'Friend, this really...'
en_old: This poetry is all preserved, by the grace of God Almighty; this is our and your special contribution, and I have no fear that it will be lost. When you collected this poetry, which poet's verse impressed you the most, where you felt, 'Friend, this is truly...'

brh: کمال نا شعر ئس ئے ہمے سد سالا تا مچ مسنے گڑاس وخت ئس ئے ارنو سوچاری نہ جونی نا کجھ ئس ئے براہوئی نا نی خبر کہ نن ارا شعر مچ کیون نی او ار شعر کیرے نمارے ئے دا سے کلمبلا گڑا دادے کہ ارا کنا نا سے
en: It is a wonderful verse, one that has been collected over a hundred years. Something... it is from a time... a thought... something of life, of Brahui. You know which verses we would collect, which verses you... This is a really big thing; the thing is, which of mine...
en_old: ...a marvelous verse, the same that has been collected over hundreds of years. Sometimes there is a thought, something of life, in Brahui. You know, when we collect a verse, you make that verse yours. This is something big, the thing is that which of mine...

brh: شن فاکور ہمم ہمم برنازنا ایوریس او دے کیرے او دے کیرے تقریبا زیادہ تر اراٹ ٹپہ ٹمری مسٹ ٹپہ ٹمری چاراٹ ٹمری مختلف اریو ارا لیلی مورے لیلی مور اٹ کیرے ننے کہ زیادہ تر متاثر دا وجہ مسونے کہ تمام کیرے ننا مخلوق کیرے تینا ارا خیالاتے
en: [unclear] hmm, hmm, [unclear]... they do it, they do it. Mostly there are two tappa-tamri, three tappa-tamri, four tamri; there are different kinds, among them Laili Mor. With Laili Mor... it mostly impressed us. The reason for this has been that all our people have their own thoughts, which...
en_old: Hmm, hmm, Barnaz's... they do it, they do it. Mostly there were the tappa and tamri — tappa, tamri, and four kinds of tamri, different ones, and the Laili Mor. They do it in Laili Mor. The reason it impressed us most is that our people expressed all their thoughts...

brh: درشان کرینے داٹی کاری زیادہ مسنے اندا کہ لیلی مور تقریبا اگر مچ کین دوانزہ سیز سیزدہ ٹپہ مچ کرے اوٹو دا دوانزہ سیزدہ سس ٹپہ مونا جی ہاں مونا صرف لیلی مور لیلی مور ئس مچ کیو اوٹو دانا ہم سد دادے کہ اخذ کے در لیلی مور نا کے اخذ زیادہ کرے داٹی کاری مسنے
en: ...have expressed them; most work has been done on this. For example Laili Mor: if we collect about twelve, thir-, thirteen tappas, once they are collected, then these twelve or thirteen tappas are in front of us. Yes, in front of us. Only Laili Mor: if one collects a Laili Mor, then its [purpose] too is that one draws from it; more has been drawn from Laili Mor, and work has been done on it.
en_old: ...expressed in it; most of the work was done on this. For example, the Laili Mor: if we collected about twelve or thirteen tappas, then these twelve or thirteen tappas came before us — yes, before us — and if one collects just Laili Mor, the result is that more was drawn from Laili Mor; work was done on it.

brh: افس کے ٹپم پانے دان لاچو۔ او کہ دا ہرا مسٹ آ ٹپ ئے ئس ٹکی نی مذہب نگاری کے سے ایلو ٹکی تینا مقصد ئے پاسے۔ صحیح صحیح صحیح صحیح۔ اچھا تو انت پنرے داسہ او اسہ بھلو کاری مسنم کرے، دا اسکا کننگ اٹی ارے تو
en: ...[unclear] he has sung a tappa from here [unclear]. And in this three-part tappa, on one side you compose on religion, and on the other side you state your own purpose. Right, right, right, right. Okay, so what would you say now? A big work has been done, which you did, and you are still doing it, so...
en_old: ...someone sings a tappa from here. In the tappa that was done, in one part you portray religion, and in the other part you state your purpose. Right, right, right, right. Okay, so what would you say now — a big work has been done, and this is still being carried on, so...

brh: او اسل تو ہنا بنفوک مستقبل ٹی نم انت پین کننگ خواہرے ایلو زمینی سوال ہنا مرو کہ انت مننگ بائیدے دا پین سوگو کننگ محفوظ کننگ خلقی ادبیت اور کن انت کاریم نا ضرورت ارے
en: And actually, in the coming future, what more do you want to do? The other supplementary question would be: what should be done to secure and preserve this further? What work is needed for folk literature?
en_old: And actually, what do you want to do further in the future that we will hear about? The other basic question would be: what should happen to further strengthen and preserve this, and what work is needed for folk literature?

brh: بلا گلہ دادے کہ ننا براہوئی اکیڈمی نا اوار آک ہنورے او ہم دا کوشش کننگ اٹی او کہ دا سیمونار تے ننا تینا خلقی ادب نا ہچ کن۔ سہی۔ اچھا خلقی ادب نا کلان بلا گلہ دادے کہ ننا بندغاک ہننگ اٹی او دا دنیا نا۔ ہمم۔ دا سے بس اٹی دا سے کہ دا سے کہ
en: The big complaint is that the members of our Brahui Academy [unclear]: they too are making this effort, but these seminars do nothing for our own folk literature. Right. Okay, the biggest complaint about folk literature is that our people are leaving this world. Hmm. This is just... this is that, this is that...
en_old: The big complaint is that the members of our Brahui Academy are also making this effort to hold these seminars for our own folk literature. Right. Okay, the biggest complaint about folk literature is that our people are going away from this world. Hmm. This is just, this is that, this is that...

brh: موت خان شمالانی ئس بس کشوان ئس کنے پیر بندغ ئس نواسہ ئس ئس ہائے ہرا وڑ بس وراغے کنا قصہ بین فیداء کرے امدا ددنیا ہلان ہلان او پی کنے تو باز قصہ ئس ورا مگر اسہ ہمو وقتی کہ کنے ہرا زہن آن ہلو مفک بس اللہ جنے نصیب کیتے
en: A man, Mot Khan Shamalani, came, a Kashwan [unclear], and an old man, a grandson... Oh, the way he came and [told] his story did me good. He has left this world, left it. He told me many stories, but there is one from that time that never leaves my mind. May God grant him paradise.
en_old: Mot Khan Shamalani came, a Kashwan; I was an old man, a grandson... oh, how he came and told me his story, did me good. This world is going, going. He told me many stories, but one of that time which never leaves my mind — may God grant him paradise.

brh: او ڈنگرا سیل کٹ۔ اچھا ولدا ننا پین گڑا نوجوان آ کاریم کننگ اٹی او ڈسکا ہرا ماحول اٹ منو وختم پد دا چھٹ رے۔ داسہ ننے یقین کے باز تیزی ٹی کاریم کروئی خاص کر دا خلقی کسر آ تے مچ کننگ ٹی۔ یقین کے اسہ درکا پد دا چھٹ رے۔ آمین اللہ خیر کے۔
en: ...and he went for a walk with the cattle [unclear]. Okay, then our other thing: young people are working, and in whatever environment there is now, after some time this will be lost. Now believe us, we have to work very fast, especially on collecting these folk ways. Believe me, after a while this will be lost. Amen, may God make it good.
en_old: ...and he sold the cattle. Okay, then our other things — young people are working, and in the environment that will be, after a while this will be lost. Now believe us, we must work very quickly, especially in collecting these folk ways. Believe me, after a while this will be lost. Amen, may God do good.

brh: دا انٹرنیٹ نا دور ئے موبائل آک ہراڑے سر مسنو۔ نہ نہ اینا دا منافق نا پد اینا منافق نا پد کیرے دا کار ئے ہمو ماحول نا چھٹنگ اٹی انت کہ دا بندغاتے ایلو کرے کہ بد پکنے پدا ہمو ماحول آ فٹ دا ہمو قصہ نا پاننگ آ ایلو ختم مننگ اٹی۔ دا ہم ورناک ننا دا شو۔
en: This is the age of the internet; mobiles have reached everywhere. No, no, nowadays people go after this hypocrisy; nowadays they do this work after hypocrisy. That environment is being lost because it has made these people different; things have gone bad, and then in that environment the telling of those stories is coming to an end. These are our young people too, this show.
en_old: This is the age of the internet; where have mobiles reached? No, no, after this hypocrite, after this hypocrite they do this work. In leaving that environment, what happens is that these people have left it, it has gone bad, then that environment is gone, the telling of those stories is ending. These are also our youth, this show.

brh: شکریہ کہ ننا دا وخت آ کیرے ہر شہر ٹی ورنا مچے براہوئی ادب نا خدمت کننگ ٹی اوار ء او داسہ مچ کننگ ٹی اوٹ تو ماشاءاللہ کنے باز خوشی مس کنا جند نا مونا کنے تو داسہ کیرے تقریبا ہرے ہنداخس مواد کہ ایرا مسہ کتاب آ داسہ پین ہم ہنداخس کتاب ماشاءاللہ جی ہرے ہنداخس کتاب
en: Thank you. In this time of ours, in every city the young people have all joined in serving Brahui literature, and now they are collecting too, so, mashallah, I was very happy. Right in front of me I now have about, look, this much material, enough for two or three books, and now as many books again, mashallah, yes, look, this many books.
en_old: Thank you for giving us this time. In every city the youth have gathered and joined in serving Brahui literature, and they are now collecting it, so mashallah, I was very happy. Before my own eyes, there is now about this much material — I have three books — and now there are as many books more, mashallah, yes, about this many books.

brh: گنی گیٹ کوشست اندا خلقی الوئے ساری الوئے ساری مچ کننگ کے اور خلقی کھرے کسراتے مچ کننگ کے کوشست کننگ اٹ انشاءاللہ۔ افضل مینگل صاحب ننے فخر ء نمے آ نما کاریم آ فخر ء یقین چارے کہ نما نم نما کاریم ننا زبانے ننا تہذیب ء
en: ...[unclear] an effort to collect all of this folk [heritage], all of it, and to collect the genuine folk ways; I am making the effort, God willing. Afzal Mengal sahib, we are proud of you, proud of your work. Be assured that you, your work, our language, our civilization...
en_old: ...an effort to collect all of this folk heritage, all of it, and an effort to collect the true folk ways, God willing. Afzal Mengal sahib, we are proud of you and of your work. Rest assured that your work is our language, our culture...

brh: ننا کلچرے، ننا خلقی شئیری تے، اور قصہ غاتے زندہ تے خانے، او ئے ہن سمجھیوہ کہ اگر نم دا تپہ ہنتویرے کا، تو ننے بھلو نقصان ئس مسکہ، تو افضل صاحب نما باز مہربانی، آ، دا ننے
en: ...our culture, our folk poetry and stories: you have kept them alive. And I see it this way: if you had not gone after these tappas, we would have suffered a great loss. So, Afzal sahib, thank you very much. Ah, this, to us...
en_old: ...our culture, our folk poetry, and you have kept the stories alive. And I understand that if you had not gone (to collect) this, we would have suffered a great loss. So Afzal sahib, thank you very much, ah, this to us...

brh: زیبدارو ہیت ننے بنفیرے تو سنگتاک نوں افضل صاحب نا ہیتاتے بنگورے براہوی خلقی شاعری ٹی بھلو درد اسے ہرا معاشرہ ٹی غربت مسنے ہرا معاشرہ ٹی ڈکھ مسنے ہرا معاشرہ ٹی استحصال مسنے تو ہمے معاشرہ ٹی ہرا شاعری
en: ...you tell us beautiful words. So, friends, now you will hear Afzal sahib's words. In Brahui folk poetry there is great pain. Whichever society has had poverty, whichever society has had sorrow, whichever society has had exploitation, then in that society the poetry that...
en_old: You make us hear beautiful words. So friends, now listen to Afzal sahib's words: in Brahui folk poetry there is great pain. In whichever society there has been poverty, in whichever society there has been sorrow, in whichever society there has been exploitation, in that society the poetry...

brh: جن جن جادو جادو دا انت پاننگ اٹی اسنے؟ راست پاننگ اٹی اٹ۔ کانوئے لکوئے انت کروئی ہندا خل کٹے
en: Jinn, jinn, magic, magic, what is this you are saying? I am telling the truth. Reading, writing: what is one supposed to do with them? Just this [unclear]...
en_old: Jinn, jinn, magic, magic — what were you saying? I was telling the truth. Reading and writing — what's to be done, just leave it at that.

brh: یا ماسٹری کروئی یا بابو ئس مروئی بس
en: Either do teaching or become a clerk, that's all.
en_old: Either become a teacher or become a clerk, that's all.

brh: صاحب، انت مس؟ دا تھرما میٹر نی انتئے سننگ اٹی ئس
en: Sir, what happened? Why were you [shaking?] this thermometer?
en_old: Sir, what happened? Why were you breaking this thermometer?

brh: ارے! گڑا گلو پائتہ زند اٹ بس، ہندن مریٹ مرزا صاحب نم تسلی کبو
en: Hey! Then Gulu [unclear] came back to life. It will be like this, Mirza sahib, you rest assured.
en_old: Hey! Then Gulu came into (my) life — that's how it will be, Mirza sahib, rest assured.

brh: السلام علیکم بابا، ئے بسٹ؟ ارا وختان خننگٹونے کہ داڑے تولوکس، تول کنا مار۔
en: Peace be upon you, Baba. Have you come? I have been seeing for a long while that you were sitting here. Sit down, my son.
en_old: Peace be upon you, Baba, have you come? I've been seeing for a while that you've been sitting here. Sit down, my son.

brh: حق اللہ
en: Haq Allah (God is the Truth).
en_old: God is the Truth.

brh: حق! کنا مہر، ئے بفرتوٹ نی اندن شام اسکان کنا انتظارے کیس؟ ہن؟ ہن، جی واہ، وخت اندن گدرینگنگے
en: Haq! My dear, if I hadn't come, would you have kept waiting for me like this until evening? Huh? Yes. Wow, time passes just like this.
en_old: Truth! My dear, didn't I tell you, will you keep waiting for me like this until evening? Huh? Yes, oh wow, time is passing like this.

brh: برے سما چلی کنا مار نی امر احساس مریک نا خن تو
en: Come, let's go, my son. How does it feel to you? Look, then.
en_old: Come on, let's go, my son, you'll see how it feels.

brh: ئے چلتن نا مش نا زیل آ بو بابا کنے ہندن لگیک ہندا مشک کنتو ہیت کنف خوائے دا کنے سے بلو ہیت ئس پاننگ خوائے ہک
en: Baba, at the foot of Chiltan mountain it seems to me as if this very mountain wants to talk to me, as if it wants to tell me something big.
en_old: Look at the foot of Chiltan mountain, father, it seems to me as if this mountain wants to talk to me, as if it wants to tell me something big.

brh: تھک کلا دا کلونا مطلب دادے کہ حق علم اور راستی ہندا دے چلتنا کلو
en: Right. The meaning of this whole message is that truth, knowledge and honesty: that is exactly Chiltan's message.
en_old: Truth is, all of this means that truth, knowledge and honesty are the very essence of Chiltan.

brh: اوک راستی علم نا روشنائی
en: That is it: truth, the light of knowledge.
en_old: That is truth, the light of knowledge.

brh: ماسٹر صفب ئا چائس مہربانی
en: Master sahib, have a cup of tea. Thank you.
en_old: Master sahib knows, thank you.

brh: ارے گل خان! گل خان! دا الکہ نا مخلوق آک تینا چنا تے انتئے اسکول آ مون تفرہ؟ ماسٹر صاحب ئے نی پاریٹ داڑے کس
en: Hey Gul Khan! Gul Khan! Why don't the people of this area send their children to school? Master sahib, I'll tell you: here nobody...
en_old: Hey Gul Khan! Gul Khan! Why don't the people of this area send their children to school? Master sahib, I told you, come here.

brh: سستینا چناتے خوانفنگ کرائی کپک ولے انتئے تعلیم تو اوفتا حقے بایدے کہ ہر لمہ باوہ تینا چناتے سکولے مونی تیر
en: ...gets their own children educated. But why? Education is their right; every mother and father should send their children to school.
en_old: Educating children doesn't cost anything, but because education is their right, every parent should send their children to school.

brh: تعلیم نا زیور آن وفتے محروم کپس۔ او تو ٹھیک ئے ولے۔ ولے انتئے گل خان؟ ماسٹر صاحب اسے تو سپا اونی دا علاقہ نا مخلوق کل زمیندار او۔
en: They should not deprive them of the jewel of education. That's right, but... But why, Gul Khan? Master sahib, [you see], the people of this area are all farmers.
en_old: Don't deprive them of the jewel of education. That's right, but... but why, Gul Khan? Master sahib, don't you know that all the people of this area are farmers?

brh: اگر او تینا چناتے محنت مزدوری کرفپس تو کنیرہ داکان نہ گل خان دا ہیت اف دا پاسونگا چناتا دا عمر اف کہ او کار زمین تیا کاریم کیر اوفتے دا عمرے
en: If they don't make their children do hard labour, then how would they eat? No, Gul Khan, that's not the point. These children are not of the age to work on farms and land; at this age they...
en_old: If they don't make their children do labor, how will they eat? No, Gul Khan, that's not the point. These children aren't at the age to work on farms and land; at their age...

brh: جی اومن۔ تدو۔ مہرین نا لوگ آ شتگت؟ جی واجہ ابلی۔ بلے چے؟ نازک چیز آ نا نظر واجہ۔ چے؟ نازک چیز آ نا نظر۔
en: Yes, it's me. Well? Did you go to Mehreen's house? Yes, sir, of course. So, what happened? Nazuk didn't even look at the thing, sir. What? Nazuk didn't look at the thing.
en_old: Yes, it's me. Come. Did you go to Mehreen's house? Yes, sir. But what? Your eye is on Nazuk, sir. What? Your eye is on Nazuk.

brh: ئے تو چپ اوشاکا کالو۔ واجہ او منا باز بے عزت کرے گس کے دوبارہ ایدا آیا گے ضرورت نیس واجہ۔ جوان۔ تو ایگا پینت۔
en: Hey, you're standing there silent, Kalo? Sir, he insulted me badly and said there's no need to come here again, sir. All right. You may go now.
en_old: Why are you standing there silent, Kalu? Sir, he insulted me badly; there's no need for him to come here again, sir. Fine. You go out.

brh: تو ناگمان ایشیا ناگمان ناگمان ناگمان من نو سرپد بوتون من ناگمان آن چے سبق ء ودی کین کہ ناگمان سدہ ء بر یاد بکنٹ
en: So it's Nagman, this Nagman! Nagman, Nagman, Nagman. Now I understand. I'll teach Nagman such a lesson that Nagman will remember it a hundred times over.
en_old: You, Nagman... Nagman, Nagman, Nagman... I understood. What lesson do I learn from Nagman, that Nagman should be remembered...

brh: بس خانو بس برو تو تو بچار کہ من ناگمانا گون چونے کاری کنین دا ناگمان منا ذلیل کرت درپدر کرت منا
en: Enough, Khano, enough, go. You just watch what I do to Nagman. This Nagman disgraced me, he made me a homeless wanderer.
en_old: Enough, Khano, enough, go. You'll see how I deal with Nagman. This Nagman humiliated me and made me homeless.

brh: ناکو قاسم کجامے فکرے تہا گارے چے بشخنترا واجہ
en: Uncle Qasim, what thoughts are you lost in? What? Excuse me, sir.
en_old: Uncle Qasim, what are you lost in thought about? What is it, sir?

brh: بس ہمے زند نا اڑاند و جنجال ہمے پریشانی۔ آخر چے بوت نی آکو بگوش۔ واجہ مالک آ یکدار آ بہاکرت نون من او منی بچک۔
en: Just these hardships and troubles of life, this same worry. But what happened, after all? Tell me, uncle. Sir, the owner sold the boat; now me and my children...
en_old: Just the troubles and hassles of this life, these worries. So what happened? Tell me. Sir, the owner sold the boat; now me and my children...

brh: بے کارا ناکو قاسم تو یک نامدارے ناخدائے ترا ہر کس وتی یکدار دنت اواجہ نون یکدار او
en: Out of work, Uncle Qasim? You are a renowned captain; everyone would give you their boat. Oh sir, now the boats...
en_old: It's useless, Uncle Qasim. You are a famous boat captain; everyone gives you their boat, sir. Now the boat...

brh: نا خدا سک باز بوتگن۔ مارا قید جوست کنت واجہ۔ چوشم نئے، نو حکومت مائی گیرانی دیم رویہ خاطرا جوہد و کوشست کننگائے۔ واجہ، ئے حسرتی مارا کجا رسیت۔ او پدا
en: Captains have become far too many. Who even asks after us, sir? It's not like that; now the government is making every effort for the progress of fishermen. Sir, where will these hopes ever get us? And then...
en_old: Captain, things have become very hard. They arrest us and interrogate us, sir. It's not like that; the government is making efforts for the fishermen. Sir, where will these hopes take us? And then...

brh: مئے غریب ئنا اودا کس سربوا گام نی یلی تو وجہ ڈاکو قاسم چوش نین ہمو کے دا ہمت کننگ لوٹی اگر تو جودو کوشش کرتے تو ئے جنجال مدامی خلاص بیان وجہ من وڑ
en: For poor people like us, nobody there lets us take a step forward, sir. Uncle Qasim, it's not like that; one just has to show courage. If you strive and make an effort, these troubles will end forever. Sir, I...
en_old: For us poor people there is no one there to step forward... Uncle Qasim, it's not like that; you need the courage to do this. If you make an effort, these troubles will end forever...

brh: بچہ شمے کرا دیم دئیں، شما ایرا سفت بکن۔ ہو ہو بالکل دیم دئے، شما بگوشت شما ایدا چون؟ بس ناکو قاسم، من خیال کرتوں کہ جیٹھی ارین
en: Son, I'll send it over to you; you just... Yes, yes, absolutely, send it. Tell me, how come you're here? Well, Uncle Qasim, I thought that at the jetty...
en_old: Son, I'll send it to you, you just say the word. Yes, yes, absolutely, send it. Tell me, how come you're here? Well, Uncle Qasim, I thought that...

brh: تازہ گے مائیک زوری۔ ئنا شما وتی چکرہ بجنیت، من انشاءاللہ شمے مائیک ء سر کنین ئنا من ناگمانہ گشتگوں، آ ترا ودنت۔ شر، شرے واجہ۔ شریں، شریں۔ خدا حافظ۔
en: ...I'd pick up some fresh fish. Now you go about your round; God willing, I'll get the fish to you. I've told Nagman; he will give it to you. Good, good, sir. Fine, fine. Goodbye.
en_old: Now take the mic. You go do your round, and God willing I'll get the mic to you. I just said it without thinking, it will reach you. Good, good, sir. Fine, fine. Goodbye.

brh: اوش ہمیدے پس چے بوتا چے بیک نتھائے کپتگے ایچ ناب بس انچو
en: Oh, it's just this... so what happened? What is it, has something come over you? Nothing, it's just like that.
en_old: Hush, so what happened? What's happened? Nothing has happened, nothing at all, it's just like that.

brh: ہنا ضرور گپے استے او منا چوں نازکئے بابتہ فکر کنا گائیتو چے بتائرہ ہراتو چنے بوتاک بلے ظالمے دنیا چہ مہار
en: No, there's definitely something, and I'm so worried about Nazuk. Tell me what happened, whatever it is that happened. But this cruel world...
en_old: Yes, there's definitely something going on, and I'm worried about my Nazuk. Tell me what happened to you... but this cruel world won't leave us alone.

brh: ئے ظالم دنیا ہرا نند گانہ الیتدہ۔ منتی گپہ سرپد بو گنو۔ ئے تو چے گشغے؟ گنجل۔ منا تو انچو لگیٹ کہ میر احمد کے استے چے گوتہ مٹ۔
en: This cruel world that won't let anyone sit in peace. Understand what I'm saying, you fool. What are you saying? It's trouble. It really seems to me that Mir Ahmad has something to do with it.
en_old: Oh, this cruel world that won't let a person sit in peace. Understand what I'm saying, you fool. What are you saying? It's a mess. It really seems to me that Mir Ahmed has something to do with this.

brh: میر احمل، میر احمل آنگت کچنہ خوت کے، بلے مان چمارگان کہ میر احمل الما چیز نی چیزی کنا لوٹیت، پرچہ کہ باز لالچی مردم ء، او ابے چا فائدہ غا، ہچ ہم نقا
en: Mir Ahmal, Mir Ahmal hasn't done anything yet, but I reckon Mir Ahmal wants something in return for everything, because he's a very greedy man, and without some benefit he doesn't do anything at all.
en_old: Mir Ahmal, Mir Ahmal still hasn't come, but I think Mir Ahmal will want something in return for anything, because he is a very greedy man, and he does nothing at all unless there's something in it for him.

brh: ئے تو چے گشگا؟ مراس ئس گشگام۔ مرچی مان کالو ہائے لوگ ء دراغ آ چادسٹ۔ چا، ئے مزنے بے غیرت مڑدوم ء؟ ہمے ہیت آ تو فکر کننگام۔ ہو ہمے تو فکر ء گپ ء۔
en: What are you saying? I'm telling you something. Today I saw Kalo outside the house. What, that big shameless man? That's exactly what I'm worried about. Yes, that's exactly the worrying thing.
en_old: So what are you saying? I'm telling you something. Today I saw Kalo coming out of the house. What, that big shameless man? That's exactly what I'm worried about. Yes, that's the worrying part.

brh: حاجی بے بے آغا تو گوش کنا توڑا ما ئے نازوکے او اماں او اماں چے بوتا چے ککار کنا گری
en: Haji Bibi Agha, you listen... our Nazuk... Oh mother, oh mother, what happened? Why are you wailing and crying?
en_old: Haji Bibi Agha, listen to me, my Nazuk... Mother, oh mother, what happened? Why are you crying?

brh: اما توئے مائی ہمزو چھئے کباب پکا او چھئے بٹی توکپکا زوت کہ دیر مکہ امرتوم شتاپی انت او روانگی کراچی ہاو بیا شمبے منی بچ ننت بابا تو
en: Mother, quickly cook some fish kebabs and some rice; hurry, don't be late, today we're in a hurry and leaving for Karachi. Yes, come Saturday, my son... father, you...
en_old: Mother, quickly cook some kebabs and pack some bread for me. Don't be late, we're in a hurry today and leaving for Karachi. Come back on Saturday, my son... father.

brh: ئے چونے مردما؟ ابا باز جوانی مردو بنتا۔ امائی ئے کاروبار کرک لوٹا۔ امار کھرچنگا مائی گرا مچ نا زورا۔ ئے تو باز جوانی گپے بتو ابا۔ جیو ابا امی اتیرانو۔
en: What kind of man is he? Father, he's a very good man. He wants to do this business with us. He'll cover our expenses and take the fish. That's really very good news, father. Bravo, father! We...
en_old: What kind of man is he? Father, he's a very good man. He wants to do business. Our expenses will be covered and things will get better. That's very good news, father. Long live father, we're happy.

brh: بابا ننا ہمو وتی شکارا گیش کننگے ہینت۔ بچا شامیر! بابا شکارے گیش کننگ نا خاطرا تو چو وکن نا توتی واستہ یک دگے یکدارے بوزور۔ او بابا من ہم ہمے فکر اٹ تون چے زر منی دستا برے
en: Father, that way we'll increase our own catch. Son Shamir! Baba, to increase the catch, do this: take another boat for yourself. Yes, father, I've been thinking the same thing, so that some money comes into my hands.
en_old: Father, our man wants to increase his catch. Son Shamir! Father, to increase the catch you'll have to take on a partner. Yes, father, I'm thinking the same thing, so that some money comes into my hands.

brh: تو اڑم نی یکداری پوتوزورا۔ آ شمیر بخش، نو تو چوبے کہ ئے ماہی ء کاروبار کہ استے نا، نو دراہیں ماہی ء کاروبار نو اوتے دستاوکا۔ ابا تو گسا آرام کا، تو فکر مکہ، نو دراہیں کارا مووداریم۔
en: Then you take a boat too. Oh Shamir Bakhsh, now you see, this fish business that there is, the whole fish business is now in their hands. Father, you rest at home, don't worry, now I'll handle all the work myself.
en_old: Then I'll take on a partner too. Oh Shamir Bakhsh, you know how this fish business works, the whole fish business is in their hands. Father, you rest at home, don't worry, I'll handle all the work.

brh: او بچ یکان چن ذمہ واری استند کہ اہنم ہرا پورا کنیکینت۔ چے مطلب بابا تو وتی ذمہ واری پیلو کنے کنت؟ او ما وتی ذمہ واری پیلو کننٹ۔ آ چو کن تو بار بار نی مسخرہ بچار کے وراک تیار ئے
en: Son, everyone has some responsibilities that they have to fulfil. What do you mean, father? That you'll fulfil your responsibilities? Yes, we'll fulfil our own responsibilities. Why do you keep joking over and over? Look, the food is ready.
en_old: Son, everyone has responsibilities that they have to fulfil. What do you mean, father? That you can fulfil your responsibilities? We fulfil our own responsibilities. Why do you keep making jokes? Come and see, the food is ready.

brh: تیار نی تیمور منے ہشتا پینا؟ شاباش۔ برو۔ اما زو کہ کنے دیر بوہ گائے۔
en: Are you ready, Taimur? Did you hear me? Well done. Let's go. Mother, hurry, I'm getting late.
en_old: Are you ready, Taimur, did you hear me? Well done. Come on. Mother, hurry, I'm getting late.

brh: ویران۔ جی۔ ہنو، ئے وتی پسی پیما دریا ہا مڈامیہ پلاس کننگ لوٹوٹ۔ ہیس۔
en: It's deserted. Yes. Now, I want to finish off these... of mine at sea for good. Yes.
en_old: It's deserted. Yes. Now, I want to take my old boat out to the sea for fishing. Yes.

brh: میر دریائے خزانگ چوں زوت خلاص نبنت۔ خلاص تو نبیت بلے من ایشانی واستہ پہ مدامی خلاص کنگ لوٹینے ۔ چے مطلب واجہ؟
en: Mir, the sea's treasures won't run out so quickly. They won't run out, but I want to finish it off for them for good. What do you mean, sir?
en_old: Mir, the sea's treasure won't run out so quickly. It won't run out, but I want to finish them off for good. What do you mean, sir?

brh: مطلب شمارا باندہ خبر لگیت۔ یا کلو۔
en: Meaning, you'll find out tomorrow. Come on, Kalo.
en_old: Meaning you'll find out tomorrow. Or else.

brh: چے بیتا مئے بچ
en: What happened, my child?
en_old: What happened, my son?

brh: چی بتہ جان؟ ہروغئے؟ ہا؟ اما بابا کدی کائت؟ انگا دگہ زیات ایتا۔
en: What happened, dear? Are you crying? Huh? Mother, when will father come? I miss him even more now.
en_old: What happened, dear? Are you crying? Huh? Mother, when will father come? I miss him so much.

brh: تے بابا باز دیر شتہ باز دیر شتہ
en: Father has been gone a very long time, a very long time.
en_old: Father has been gone a very long time, a very long time.

brh: امہ، مئے بابا واستہ زہیر کڑتا۔ ئے واستہ مستہ جی نا باز زہیر کڑتا۔ نم انتئے بخشام؟
en: Mother, I miss our father. I miss him very much too. Why are you...?
en_old: Mother, I miss father. I miss him very much too. Why are you crying?

brh: واقعی کہ تو راست پاش کرے ۔ بلے ہر چیز کہ بوت جوان نبوت ۔ جوان نبوت ۔ بلے انو مارا درست ئنا مئے فکر کننگ نا مٹت وجہ کہ دا واقعہ پرچہ بوت ۔ بالکل ۔ بالکل صحیح ۔ بالکل ۔
en: Truly, you have spoken the plain truth. But whatever happened was not good. Not good. But now all of us need to think about the reason why this incident happened. Absolutely. Absolutely right. Absolutely.
en_old: Truly, you have spoken the truth. But whatever happened was not good. Not good. But now we all need to think about why this incident happened. Absolutely. Absolutely right. Absolutely.

brh: بابا شاہ مرید، واجہ قاسم، شما ہمدا منندے، من واجہ گون ہبرا کناں، ٹھیکیں؟ نندت ہمدا شو۔
en: Baba Shah Murid, Mr. Qasim, you stay right here; I'll talk with the gentleman, okay? Sit right here, you all.
en_old: Baba Shah Mureed, Mr. Qasim, you stay right here, I'll talk with sir, okay? Sit right here.

brh: ئنا خو خیر انت؟ او یاترا مچے اوشا، ما توجا برباد بوتٹ، تباہ بوتٹ واجہ، مے روزگار ئے وسیلہ یکے یکدارا، نظر آ قصہ مے یکدار برتک واجہ، نتو آ۔۔۔
en: Is all well, though? Oh friend... we have been ruined, destroyed, sir. Our means of livelihood was a single boat, and someone has taken our boat, sir. Now...
en_old: Is everything well with you? ... We have been ruined, destroyed, sir. Our only means of livelihood... the evil eye took ours, sir, now...

brh: بوش، مئے واری غریبی مردم نون چے بے خواجہ؟ اچھا، شمارا کسے سرا شک؟ واجہ، ما غریبی مردم آن نہ کسے گومے جنگے است، نہ کسے گومے جھیڑائی است، نہ ما کسے گوم
en: Well, what will become of poor people like us now, sir? Okay, do you suspect anyone? Sir, we are poor people; we have no fight with anyone, no quarrel with anyone, nor do we [have anything] with anyone...
en_old: Wait, what does anyone want with us poor people, sir? Alright, do you suspect anyone? Sir, we poor people have no fight with anyone, no quarrel with anyone, nor do we...

brh: الے حوال کنا واجہ ما کیسر شک بکننت۔ فدام شما پہ جوانی ئے فکر بکنیت۔ چیزے نہ چیزے اللہ مہست۔ نہ واجہ میتگے توکا مئے کسے گوما نہ جنگ
en: What can I tell you, sir, whom could we suspect? Then you think it over carefully. There must surely be something or other. No, sir, inside the village we have no fight with anyone.
en_old: Tell me, my sir, do you suspect anyone? Please think it over carefully. God will grant something or other. No, sir, in the village we have no fight with anyone.

brh: ئے استنا مکسر ناراض کٹک، نہ چا مہم قصہ گونگو، ئے وڑنگا پین بوتک۔ راچون، درائے یکدار نا کلے تو، شمے یکدارا بر۔ بچا مے تو پریشان ہنت، کہ ہا انکس یکدار یلدات۔
en: ...nor have we made anyone angry, nor was there any important matter; it turned out this way. ... someone took your boat. That is why we are worried, that the boat was let go just like that.
en_old: He was very angry... no important matter... it turned out differently... took your one... We are worried that so much was let go.

brh: یو کپ منی یک داٹک نشان کت ہمیتو ما پریشاں کہ چونیا بوت او پچا بوت خیر شما نو دومی کمرہ بریت ایف آئی آر کٹ بکنیت ما وتی کوشش کنا او شما وتی جہد بکنیت شرے مچا مچا
en: ...my boat... [unclear]... that is why we are worried about how it happened and why it happened. Well, now you go to the other room and file an FIR. We will make our own efforts, and you make your own effort. Good, all right, all right.
en_old: This... showed one mark, that's why we are worried about how and why it happened. Well, you go to the other room and file an FIR. We will make our efforts and you make yours. Good, all right.

brh: چاگہ توبلوٹے مئے قہرا سامبوت گوتکن مئے اکدر ہلوماراسید واجہ توقموکی اگر جوت بیکنی واجہ اللہ خیر کنت انو شما بریت دومی کمرہ ایف آئی آر کاٹ بیکنت اللہ ترا آباد بیکنت واجہ تو ہمے کس گوشت ہمے کس مئے خاطر آباد
en: ...our anger... our boat... sir, if you... sir. God will make it well. Now you go to the other room and file the FIR. May God keep you prosperous, sir; you are the one who... for our sake...
en_old: ...our anger... sir, if... God will make it right. Now you go to the other room and file an FIR. May God bless you, sir, you are the one who... for our sake.

brh: باز مہربانی واجہ، ٹھیک واجہ، باز باز مہربانی واجہ۔ اللہ خیر کن، شما نبریت۔ شر واجہ، مہربانی۔ واڑے ناگمانو!
en: Thank you very much, sir. Okay, sir. Many, many thanks, sir. May God make it well; you may go. Good, sir, thank you. Well, well, Nagman!
en_old: Thank you very much, sir. Okay, sir, many, many thanks, sir. May God make it right; you go. Good, sir, thanks. Wow, Nagman!

brh: اوہ! انو کشکولہ بزور، دریائے لمبک خیرات بلوٹ۔ منتوں ترا میر، تو انچیں کاری کو کہ مترا چے بشی۔
en: Oh! Now take up the begging bowl and go beg for alms along the seashore. Thank you, Mir; you have done such a deed that... what could we give you?
en_old: Oh! Now take the begging bowl and go beg for alms along the riverbank. I beg you, Mir, don't do such a thing that would ruin you.
