en_old: Mehrgarh is a sign of eleven thousand years, and many other monuments have also come to light, so Brahui is among the oldest languages of Asia. Unfortunately, we haven't valued the Brahui language, and for this reason...

brh: زبان ارا کہ داسہ داسہ گٹی اقوام متحدہ کہ ارا کہ تینا اسلو ئس جاری کرے کہ یعنی بروکا وخت آٹی تیس سال پد چھل سال پد یا پنجاہ سال پد کہ یعنی باز
en: ...language, which, just recently the United Nations issued a (report) of its own saying that, I mean, in the coming times, after thirty years, forty years or fifty years, that, I mean, many...
en_old: ...language. Just recently the United Nations issued a report saying that in the future, after thirty, forty or fifty years, many...

brh: اوفتے ٹی کرے ارا دا زبان نا کہ کار دنیا آن ختم مننگو اوفتے ٹی ایلو زبان تے تو ہوار ہوار براہوئی زبان ہم ارے ننا دا پنت تینا قلم کار آتین تینا ادیب آتین تینا راج نا مکھ کماش آتین پیر انگا آتین کہ بھئی تینا زبان ء سنبھال بو تینا
en: Among them, the languages that are about to disappear from the world, among them, together with the other languages, the Brahui language is also there. This is our advice to our writers, our literary figures, the leaders and elders of our nation, the aged ones: brother, look after your language, your...
en_old: Among the languages that are about to disappear from the world, alongside other languages, Brahui is also there. Our advice to our writers, our literary figures, and the leaders and elders of our nation is: brother, look after your language, your...

brh: تینا زبان نا زیا کاریم کبو اینو سندھی چینل لگے بیس بائیس چینل تینا زبان اٹ ہیسونے تو نن انتئے نالائق اون نن انتئے نابود اون کہ نن تو چینل افک اینو وش وش کنا چینل افک وش کنے ٹائم تفک اور بولان ٹی وی نا زیا کہ نن فخر کینہ تو بولان ٹی وی ایم کاریم
en: Work more on your language. Today there are about twenty, twenty-two Sindhi channels running in their own language, so why are we incompetent, why are we worthless, that we don't have channels? Today, fine, fine, I don't have a channel; fine, they don't give me airtime. And as for Bolan TV, which we take pride in, Bolan TV's work too...
en_old: Do more work for your language. Today twenty or twenty-two Sindhi channels are running in their language, so why are we so incompetent and worthless that we don't have channels? Today I'm happily without a channel, and happily nobody gives me airtime. As for Bolan TV, which we are proud of, Bolan TV also works...

brh: کنا افک کنا دعوی جی افک کنے اونا جی آ کرے مکمل گرفت افک کنا اونا ہچو اللوس برابر تئی افک اگہ او کنے چوبیس گھنٹہ ٹی بیرا ایرا گھنٹہ تیک تو گڈا ئے دادے تینا زبان ہمر پاو او دادے تینا علاقہ نا ارا کہ کردار
en: ...is not mine. I have no claim on it, I don't have full control over it, I have no equal share in it at all. If it gives me only two hours out of twenty-four, then how am I to speak my language in that, and how (am I to show) the role of my region, which...
en_old: It's not mine, I don't claim it, I don't have full control over it, and I'm not equal to it at all. If they give me only two hours out of twenty-four, then how will one speak one's language, and how will one's area play its role...

brh: ئے باز منت وار جاوید جھالاوان صاحب جی دن کہ خنارے دا سخی جاوید جھالاوان صاحب ہرا کہ تینا دا قدیمی ثقافت نا گڑا تا نمے باروٹ ہم پارے ہور تینا براہوئی قوم بلکہ نا پیغام تینا خواہنگٹی ئے کہ یعنی ہراڑے کہ ہرا تینا زبان ئے گیرام کپست
en: ...Thank you very much, Javed Jhalawan sahib. So, as you saw, this generous Javed Jhalawan sahib also told you about the things of his ancient culture, and his message to his Brahui nation, or rather his wish, is that wherever you are, whoever you are, do not forget your language.
en_old: Thank you very much, Javed Jhalawan sahib. So you saw generous Javed Jhalawan sahib, who also told you about his ancient cultural heritage. His message and wish for his Brahui nation is that, wherever you are, you should not forget your language.

brh: ننا زبان ء اہمیت ترجیح ترے بروک آ پروگرام اسکان آتے بنے اجازت اللہ نا امانٹ مرے
en: Give importance and priority to our language. Until the next program, give us leave. May you be in God's keeping.
en_old: Give importance and priority to our language. Until the next program, allow us to take our leave. May you be in God's protection.

brh: کنا ڈوکاک ہندا تفک نا توار تون چھٹار کنا لمہ باوہ نا ارمان پورا مس کنے کنے ایلم ئس مس ڈائی تے کنا ساہ کشاس ئے ہرا نمسوٹ خبر پنت مسونے
en: With the sound of this gun my sorrows have ended. My mother and father's wish has been fulfilled; I have got a brother. Midwife, ... my life... the news that has been heard.
en_old: With the sound of this gunshot my sorrows were released. My parents' wish has come true. I have a brother... my very soul... the news you have heard.

brh: ایون باوہ نی خب باز خوش مروئی دا پیری ٹی مار اسنے باوہ جوڑ مس نی سما ئے گوہرام او نا اندا خوشی کنے پانزدہ سالن دکھ تے ننگٹی ئس کہ او دے کنا جگہ غا مار ئس انتئے متو
en: Oh, Father, you must be very happy: in this old age you have become the father of a son. Do you know, Goharam, this joy of his gives me the pain of fifteen years, (the pain) that on that day, why wasn't there a son in my place?
en_old: Father, you must be very happy. In this old age you have become the father of a son. You know, Goharam, this joy of his has kept me grieving for fifteen years. Why wasn't there a son in my place that day?

brh: عارف، دا کنا کنڈان نمستے، ہندا خاطر انتو تینا خوشی ء مسکان سر کیدہ
en: Arif, this is your good-news gift from my side; that is exactly why I bring my joy to you.
en_old: Arif, these are greetings from my side. That is why you should share your joy with a smile.

brh: گنوک ئے ہم تو تینا ہر خوشی ہر ڈکھے نیسکن سر کیو پینا رنگ دے وتہ
en: Silly, I too bring every joy and every sorrow of mine to you; to whom else would I...
en_old: Crazy one, you too should share every joy and every sorrow with your own...

brh: خان محمد اللہ نا شکر ئے نی مار ئس نا باوہ مسس کنا مستائی ئے کشہ۔ شکر ئے اللہ نا او کنا ایڑ انت ئے نی
en: Khan Muhammad, thank God, you have become the father of a son. Give me my reward for the good news. Thanks be to God. Oh my sister, what is it you...
en_old: Khan Muhammad, thank God you have become the father of a son. Accept my congratulations. Thanks be to God. Oh my sister, what are you...

brh: خنتے اٹ آ کنا ایڑ کنا ایڑ کنے ارمان ء کہ کنتون پین ہچ ئس اف کہ نی مستاٹی تسٹے۔ خدا غان واگہ ڈغار
en: Gladly, my sister, my sister. I regret that I have nothing else that I could give you as a reward for the good news. By God, the land...
en_old: Seeing it with my own eyes, my sister, my sister, I regret that I have nothing else to give you as a reward for the good news. By God, land...

brh: رس کنا پنا مرو سوس اودے ئے نا پنا کریٹ ایلوم ادا ڈغارے کنا پناٹ کریسے گڑا دا پوسکننگا خواجہ کے انت سے تسس او کنا ایڑ اونا نی فکرے کپہ
en: ...that was in my name, I have put it in your name. Brother, you have put this land in my name; then what have you given to this new little master? Oh my sister, don't you worry about him.
en_old: The land that was in my name, I have put in your name, brother. This land was in my name. So what have you given to this new little master? Oh my sister, don't you worry about him.

brh: او تینا تینٹ پورا کیک مار اسے مگہ مسڑ اسے
en: He Himself takes care of it fully, whether it is a son or a daughter.
en_old: He fulfills it Himself, whether it is a son or a daughter.

brh: واہ میر صاحب واہ چاوکے لگاتے بالاچ خان میر صاحب نا نشانہ وخت ئس ہم خطا مفوئے کہ داسا مروئی کنا اوز دن پدین مفک کنا اوز دے تما پدین مریک
en: Wow, Mir sahib, wow, you hit it squarely, Balach Khan! Mir sahib's aim never misses, not even once. Now it must be... my heart doesn't usually fall behind like this, (but) today my heart falls behind yours.
en_old: Wow, Mir sahib, wow, you hit it perfectly, Balach Khan! Mir sahib's aim never misses, not even once. Now it's my turn. My strength doesn't fall behind, but today my strength falls behind yours.

brh: برا تما گولی شکار نا استٹ لگے شاکر میر
en: Brother, your bullet hit the prey right in the heart, Shakir Mir.
en_old: Brother, your bullet hit the prey right in the middle, Shakir Mir.

brh: اسے مینٹ اسے ملٹ در بے بے گوارام جان بسنے پچونا نا فوٹو تے الیوا۔ بخیر اٹ گوارام جان۔ انتالے تاتی جوڑ ئس جی جوڑ اٹ، نی جوڑ
en: One minute, just one minute, wait, Bibi Goharam jaan has come. I'll take photos of the boy. Welcome, Goharam jaan. How are you, auntie? Are you well? Yes, I'm well; are you well?
en_old: One minute, just a minute, wait, sister. Sister Goharam jaan has come. Take photos of the baby. Welcome, Goharam jaan. How are you, aunt? I'm fine, yes, I'm fine. Are you fine?

brh: خیر جوڑ ئس شکر ہی مبارک مرینے۔ خیر مبارک۔ تاتی مچٹ ئس مونی تپاش کیس۔ ارے زگار مچے مونی دے۔ کنا فوٹو ایفس۔ نی مونی دے۔ انو مایل کر انو مایل کر۔ ئے مکھنگٹی اٹ۔ ارے۔
en: Well, (I'm) fine, thank God. Congratulations to you. Congratulations to you too. Auntie, show (his) face a little. Hey, dear, show the face a little. It's not my photo (you're taking). You, (show) the face. Now smile, now smile. I am laughing. Hey.
en_old: Well, I'm fine, thank God. Congratulations to you. Congratulations to you too. Aunt, show the face a little. Hey, show the whole face. Take my photo. You, the face. Now smile, smile. ...Hey.

brh: ئے کنے چنا او کنے سلیس ئے دا خبرے بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم مچٹ ئس مونی تے دانگ کیس ماما داد داد سلاس
en: ...to me, child... to me... this news. In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Turn (his) face this way a little. Uncle Dad, Dad, hold still.
en_old: ...to me, child, he... this news... In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Show the face a little... Uncle Dad, Dad, greetings.

brh: الہ نم انتئے چپ کریرے، شید خل بو خوشی کبو
en: Hey, why have you all gone quiet? Cheer up and celebrate!
en_old: Mother, why have you gone quiet? Cheer and celebrate!

brh: دا مو پیسہ غو۔ آ جی ہمو پیسہ غو۔ ہو دا ہفتہ؟ دا مو بشام اٹ کہ توسن تا پدا واپس تسنے پنجاہ و پنج جی۔ میر صیب ئے خان محمد بسنے۔ برے کتے۔
en: Is this that money? Ah yes, that very money. Yes, this week? This is the one from the rainy season that was given back afterwards: fifty-five, sir. Mir sahib, Khan Muhammad has come. Let him come in.
en_old: This is that money. Ah yes, that money. Yes, this week? This is from the evening... after it was returned, fifty-five, yes. Mir sahib, Khan Muhammad has come. Come...

brh: السلام علیکم امید صاحب۔ وعلیکم السلام بر خان محمد بر۔ خیرٹ بسنس؟ او امید صاحب دا
en: Peace be upon you, Umeed sahib. And upon you be peace. Come, Khan Muhammad, come. Is all well, that you've come? Oh, Umeed sahib, this...
en_old: Peace be upon you, Umeed sahib. And peace be upon you. Come, Khan Muhammad, come. Have you come in good health? Oh, Umeed sahib, this...

brh: نی متیس اسکن انی نی او بلو ڈاز ڈیزس اسکن ہما کنڈا مارس مسنے بنگنٹ مبارک مرے نی خیرے نماری صاحب
en: You... until... you... a big (doctor?)... I've heard that a son has been born over there. Congratulations to you; all good wishes to your son, sahib.
en_old: You... becoming a big doctor... a son has been born over there. Congratulations to you. Are you well, Nimari sahib?

brh: اللہ بخش نا کیتے بس دا ششن نا انی نی تیتس صاحب پین انت ہوس میر صاحب اللہ نا مالے اسہ ٹومار ئس پین تے ثاقب جان تے خاڈ ثاقب
en: Allah Bakhsh's... came... this session's... you gave, sahib. What else is there, Mir sahib? It's all God's wealth... one... others... Saqib jaan... Saqib.
en_old: Allah Bakhsh's... came, this session... What else, Mir sahib? By God's blessing, a bundle... Saqib jaan, Saqib...

brh: خان محمد اسل بابو گری او پینستے خانوسیت بو ورا شاہرا اینوئے بلو افسرس جوڑ مروئی اوم چا نی امبار بزغرس مروئی اندا
en: Khan Muhammad, actually, (aim for) an educated man's job... educate him, then he will go to the city and become a big officer; otherwise he too will become a farmer like you, that's all.
en_old: Khan Muhammad, never... educate him, and he will go to the city and become a big officer. Otherwise he will become a farmer like you, that's all.

brh: دا ڈغار تیا کاریم کروئی بس غریبو پنا استخاسہ یت نن امیر صاحب ہندا چٹو مار اسے کنا داتے انشاءاللہ خوانے فے امیر صاحب ہرا خواری دے ہرا بے بختی
en: Working on these lands is just poverty... Amir sahib, this is my one little son; God willing, I will educate him, Amir sahib, whatever the hardship, whatever the misfortune.
en_old: Working on these lands is just the lot of the poor... Amir sahib, this is my only son. God willing, I will educate him, Amir sahib, whatever the hardship, whatever the misfortune.

brh: ٹی ٹی خنانٹ انشاءاللہ اورٹ خنیف بروٹ خان محمد خولم نا اسے گونی اٹ خوانفنگ مفک بلہ بلہ بندغاک
en: I'll see. God willing, I'll come and see [him]. Khan Muhammad, you can't get [a child] educated with one sack of wheat; that's for big, big people.
en_old: I saw... God willing, I will come there to see. Khan Muhammad, you can't educate someone with one sack of wheat; that's for the big people.

brh: بات برے رے، نمیر صاحب، انشاءاللہ تینے بہا کھروٹ مگر اودے ضرور خوانے فوٹ، ہمم، جوان
en: Even if it comes to that, Mir sahib, God willing, I will sell myself, but I will definitely educate him. Hmm, good.
en_old: Very well, Amir sahib. God willing, even if I have to sell myself, I will definitely educate him. Hmm, good.

brh: ادا قمر کنا رضا اللہ سرسوب کنے ادا دا مٹھائی تو تکونین جی بسم اللہ نوش جان
en: Brother Qamar, God has made my Raza successful! Brother, at least taste this sweet. Yes, in the name of God, enjoy.
en_old: Brother Qamar, my Razaullah has succeeded! Brother, at least taste this sweet. Please, go ahead, enjoy.

brh: مسہ کنے مخ ال
en: Don't make me laugh.
en_old: Don't make me laugh.

brh: ثاقب
en: Saqib.
en_old: Saqib.

brh: گورم تہ نی بر کنا مار بر دا کا گدرینگ او تاتی بر کنا مار ئے بنگٹ چنا نا نتپ خرابی ہاو کنا مار بر بر بر پینکے تو تاتی داڑے
en: Gorum, it's you, come, my son, come, come through here. Tati! Come, my son. I heard the child is unwell? Yes, my son, come, come, come... Tati, here.
en_old: Gorum, come, my son, come, pass through here. Tati, come, my son. I heard the child's health is bad? Yes, my son, come, come, come... Tati is here.

brh: پین انت حال ئے جوڑ ئس نی جوڑ ئس اورا والا کل جنجوڑ؟ شکر بالکل نی جوڑ ئس تاتی چاوا اورا ٹی تنیا ئس ہو کنا مار
en: What else, how are things? Are you well? Are you well? Is everyone at home well? Thank God, absolutely. Are you well, Tati? I see you're alone at home? Yes, my son.
en_old: What else, how are you? Are you well? Is everyone at home well? Thank God, all well. Are you well? Tati, look, are you alone at home? Yes, my son.

brh: ما مانا ڈغار تیا کاک، مسڑیکے دے درست ہمسایہ تا وراٹی، آئی دے بس مسڑ، ارانگ ہسوس نی مسڑ، اما تینیٹ تو ہنتسوس کنے
en: [He] goes off to the uncle's lands, and the girl spends the whole day in the neighbors' houses. The girl has only just come back. Where had you gone, girl? Amma, you had gone off yourself, so I...
en_old: Mother works on other people's lands, and the girl spends all day in the neighbors' houses. Today the girl came back. Where had you gone, girl? Mother had gone herself, so I...

brh: جاگہ ئس راہی کرک، نی بس کاسہ موڑے گھنٹہ ئس خلیسہ۔ این، گوہرام جان بسونے، چاس کرک ئے کتا۔
en: If I send you somewhere, you just go there and spend an hour. Look, Gohram jan has come; make some tea for him.
en_old: Someone sends word, and you just come and spend an hour. Look, Gohram jan has come, make him some tea.

brh: کرم چان مسٹ لومہ باوہ کے بھاز بھلو ڈکھ ئس مریک خیر اٹ داسہ ایلم تا ہم بھلن مننگٹی ئے نن خوانہ کے اودے خوانفین اینو پگہ ایونوم خواننگن بیدس پین انت
en: Karam jan, for a daughter's mother and father it is a very great grief. Well, now her brothers are growing up too; we want to educate her. Today or tomorrow, even today, what else is there besides education?
en_old: Karam jan, losing a daughter is a very great grief for parents. Well, now the brothers are growing up too. We want to educate him, today or tomorrow... what else is there besides studying?

brh: او صحیح تاتی، خلق نا سکول تا نیس مائی، ماسٹرک ہفتہ ہفتہ داڑے غیب او، او شار نا خوانفنگ، نن غریب تا وسٹی افک، ہا او تاتی
en: Oh, right, Tati. The village schools, you know: the teachers are absent here week after week, and educating [children] in the city is not within the means of us poor people. Yes, Tati.
en_old: Oh, right, Tati. As for the public school, the teachers are absent here week after week, and studying in the city is beyond the means of us poor people. Yes, Tati.

brh: نی راس پاشہ۔ اوئے اماں اوئے اوہ راس پاش دا مسڑی اوئے اماں دوکنا اوجنگا اوہ ادا دے اسہ ٹاڈہ پیالہ ئس پارے دو اچنا اوشاپ۔ تاتی نی زو اچن ویٹ ئس پٹہ۔ اوہ اللہ پین انت۔ وار کرے
en: You're right. Oh mother, oh! Oh... this girl... Oh mother, my hand got burned! Oh, brother, a cup of cold [water]... Tati, quickly look for something. Oh God, what else. It happened.
en_old: You tell the truth. Oh mother, tell the truth, this girl... oh mother, she said there's only one cracked cup... Tati, quickly look for something. Oh God, what else. Done.

brh: ئے دوک نی تو، گنوک، دوکنا اوشنگتنے، ئے تو بس تاوراٹہ کیپ، نی کنکے اخس پریشان مریسہ۔ دا سوراسنا، آخا پریشان مریسہ۔
en: Hey, you're crazy, my hand hasn't been burned; hey, just don't make a fuss. Why are you so worried about me? This is... why are you worried?
en_old: Hey, you're crazy... just stay at home. Why do you worry so much about me? Brother, why do you worry?

brh: اوہ اوہ اوہ وائی دادے بس ایہہ سیٹ بیٹھا ٹی ہتہ کنے تتی گڑتی کپہ جوز جوان مرے
en: Oh, oh, oh, oh dear! Just bring her over here to sit on this seat. Don't worry about me. May it heal quickly.
en_old: Oh, oh, oh, wow, just sit here on this seat. Don't make me upset, may you be well.

brh: ئے گڈا کاوا کنے وری مننگ مٹی۔ اللہ بابا ہرون کسء داسا؟ خیر استا تپنے وس۔ ئس پیالہ چانہ پاریٹ او ہم نی تومتا۔ گورا ہم جان بابا ہرون اینا؟
en: Well then, I'm going; I'm getting late. Oh God, Baba, where are you going now? Well... I asked for one cup of tea, and even that you didn't [bring]. And Gorum jan, Baba, where is he today?
en_old: Then I'll come... Oh God, father, where are you now? Well... I asked for a cup of tea, that too... Is Gora here too, father, where is he?

brh: السلام علیکم بابا۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ خیر ئے بابا چا ودم درینگانورے؟
en: Peace be upon you, Baba. And upon you be peace. Is everything well, Baba? Are you tired?
en_old: Peace be upon you, father. And upon you be peace. Is everything well, father, are you taking a rest?

brh: گورم جان دم درے تو ہر دے نارے ولے نی دا کتاب تیان دا خوانے نا ٹائم ملیک نی ورستا
en: Gorum jan, being tired is an everyday thing, but do you get any time from these books, from this studying?
en_old: Gorum jan, resting happens every day, but do you get time from these books to study?

brh: ئے تو ایرن اٹ کے دا مر خوانے غا سکھ چھٹی پکھ بس بابا دعا کرک کہ خواری کنا پوک مف کنا ڈاکٹری نا سیٹ مرے ہمم جوان
en: Well, with this studying, comfort and holidays [are gone]... Just pray, Baba, that my hard work doesn't go to waste and that I get a medical seat. Hmm, good.
en_old: I'm studying... father, just pray that my hard work doesn't go to waste and I get a medical seat. Hmm, good.

brh: تو نی ڈاکٹری نا سیٹ کن داخس خوانے گٹیوس ئے وا پارٹ تحصیلداری ماصیلداری سے کن خوانے گٹیوس ہم دے بابا ڈاکٹری ما گچن کو گڑا سے
en: So are you studying this much for a medical seat, or, say, for a tehsildar's post or some such? Well, Baba, what is better than being a doctor?
en_old: So did you study this much for a medical seat, or for some tehsildar-type post? Father, how does being a doctor compare to anything else?

brh: غلام جان نی تو دنیت کنے گٹی کسپئی ڈاکٹر آتے خنتنوٹ تینا سیخا غان بیدس پین کس مفک ایتو تا تینا بیگ ایم تینٹ ہرفیرہ دا ڈاکٹر آک
en: Ghulam jan, haven't you seen the doctors of this world? Apart from their own shadow, no one else matters [to them]; these doctors just look after their own bags themselves.
en_old: Ghulam Jan, you've seen what the doctors in our area are like. They care about nothing but their own pockets. These doctors just fill their own bags.

brh: جوان چاوہ دا ڈاکٹرا تے بابا گڑا تحصیلداری ٹی انت اسرے؟ وارم۔ ئے منیوہ۔ ئے منیوہ کہ تحصیلداری دا خوبو۔
en: Fine, I know about these doctors, Baba, but then what is there in being a tehsildar? Alright. I accept. I accept that being a tehsildar is good.
en_old: Fine, I know about these doctors, father, but what is there in being a tehsildar? Fine, I accept it. I accept that being a tehsildar is good.

brh: لوگڑا صاحب۔ ولے رعب راب تو برابر اینے۔ چار لیویز والاک مونٹ تے، چار لیویز والاک پدت تے، انت رعب اسے دا تحصیلدارینا، نی
en: Well then, sir. But the prestige is equally there: four Levies men in front of him, four Levies men behind him. What prestige this tehsildar has! You...
en_old: There you go, sir. But the prestige is just as great. Four Levies men in front of you, four Levies men behind you. What prestige a tehsildar has! You...

brh: نی ڈاکٹری ء تحصیلداری تو برابر کننگٹی ئس بابا نی دا گڑا ء ہر کہ دا خلقت ٹی اسہ جوانو ڈاکٹر ئس اف۔ اگر دا اسہ جوانو ڈاکٹر ئس مسکہ تو دا خلقت نا بندغ
en: You are putting doctoring and tehsildari on the same level, Baba. Look at this: among these people there isn't a single good doctor. If there had been one good doctor here, the people of this community...
en_old: You're putting a doctor and a tehsildar on the same level, father. Look at the fact that there isn't a single good doctor among these people. If there were a good doctor here, the people here...

brh: دا علاج ا کن شارے انتوئے رے، و مونا نکان کے و مونا نکان کے لمہ بیمار ئس اگر داخل کٹے اسے ہم جوانو ڈاکٹر ئس مسکا تو نو اینو ننا لمہ ننا خنتا مونا مسکا۔
en: ...go to the city for treatment; and before us, before us, mother was sick. If, when she was admitted, there had been even one good doctor, then today our mother would still be before our eyes.
en_old: They go to the city for treatment, and right in front of us, right in front of us, mother was sick. If there had been even one good doctor in the hospital, our mother would still be with us today.

brh: گورم ارا بندغ نا کے دیک پورو مریر او دے کستو نی کپک
en: Gorum, when any person's days are complete, then no one can hold them back.
en_old: When two people's needs are taken care of, no one will die.

brh: ڈاکٹر نا ڈاکٹر نا باوم برے ئے بندغے توننگ کپک پومسس
en: A doctor, even if a doctor's doctor's father came, he could not hold back a person whose [days] were complete.
en_old: A doctor, a doctor, father... even a doctor can't keep a person alive forever.

brh: زند نا ہر روشنائی او تارمٹ
en: Every light and darkness of life
en_old: Every light and every darkness of life

brh: تینے تنیا خیال کر پس روشنائی ٹی اسے خاصے ہمبر اوتار مٹ اسے گروشک اسے ہمبر
en: Imagine yourself alone: then in the light, someone is a special companion, and in the darkness, someone is a glimmer of a companion.
en_old: Imagine yourself alone, as if in a special light, like a darkness, like a shadow

brh: کنے تینا رئی آ کنوس
en: You will keep me by your side.
en_old: Let me go my own way.

brh: برے پیوا وا
en: Come... I will come in (with you)...
en_old: Come on, let's go.

brh: خوارام جان آخر انت گوازی کنے دن ڈکوئٹ نشان تننگ خواستی کنے بابا پیرو بابا دا وراٹ نی ہم بندغ مسنس ہمو
en: Gwaram Jan, after all, what game is this? Did you want to show me off as a dacoit like this? Me, Baba, Piro Baba... have you too become that same kind of person in this way?
en_old: Khurram Jan, what game were you playing? Why did you want to make me look like a bandit? Pir Baba, father, have you become that kind of person too?

brh: چنکی آن الیس بلنی اسکان کنا ہر ضد ء پورو کرینے، چا کہ اینو ہم کنا مار ہنچو پنت ایتوئے
en: From childhood until adulthood he has fulfilled every demand of mine; I know that today too he will give my son such advice.
en_old: From childhood until I grew up, you gave in to every one of my demands. I know that even today you would give me, your son, the same advice.

brh: اسیکہ نی تینا خنت تے ترکہ، اینے گڑاس نشان ایتو۔ تو نی پاتو اسیکہ انت گڑاسے؟ پیرو بابا! ہا بس بابا دادو، کنا خنک مسور ترک، بس۔ ہا، دا س۔
en: Once, when you shut your eyes, it would show you something. Then you would say, 'What is it this time?' Piro Baba! Yes, just, Baba Dado, my eyes got shut, that's all. Yes, this...
en_old: When you close your eyes, do you see some signs? Then you said, what is it now? Pir Baba! Yes, father Dado, my eyes were just closed, that's all. Yes, that's it.

brh: امل خنتیتینا بلے تا امل دا تینا فوٹو سیبو
en: Amal, your own eyes... yes... Amal, this is your own photo...
en_old: Amal, look at your... Amal, this is your photo.

brh: بلی خنتہ ملنگ تون نام و ننگتہ وارس ناموسی خا
en: Indeed, upon his eyes opening... the guardian of name and honor, of honor...
en_old: ...seeing with the eyes, meeting, for name and honor, the heir of honor...

brh: ہو کنا مسڑ ہر انسان نا زند ٹی اسہ توار ئس مریک اسہ سے خاص
en: Yes, my daughter, in every person's life there is a voice, a special one.
en_old: Yes, my daughter, in every person's life there is a voice, a special one.

brh: فرق دادے کہ کسس دادے ملوک آ خنٹ خنک کسس تفوکا خنٹ تا بلے راست پاسے
en: The difference is this: someone sees this with open eyes, someone with closed eyes. Yes, you speak the truth.
en_old: The difference is that some see it with open eyes and some with closed eyes, but both tell the truth.

brh: پیرو بابا نی تو سمائی لمہ نا مہر اسے خائتو خنتو اٹ ولے باز وختان پد دانا مہر اسے خائخنانٹ ودا دے گونگ خاپرا
en: Piro Baba, you know, I never saw a mother's love, I never saw it, but after a long time I saw this one's love, and this...
en_old: Pir Baba, you understand. You saw your mother's love with your own eyes, but I only saw her love after a long time, and...

brh: ئے گواہ اٹ پاراتٹ پیر بابا یا اللہ خیر
en: I am a witness, I said it, Pir Baba. O God, let all be well!
en_old: I'm telling you as a witness, Pir Baba. O God, may all be well.

brh: خلوص نی وا بام مور کتہ خلوص نی اوئے بیٹے ئس نی خا نی ئے بیٹے خیالٹ چرنگاٹ کیا ڈاٹ
en: Khulus, you again... Khulus, you, oh son, you... you... son, I was wandering in my thoughts...
en_old: Khulos, you've done it again... Khulos, oh, sit down, you... sit, I was lost in thought...

brh: پیک چینہ اللہ بارک ادا دے گنوک مسنے تینا مور پیرو بابا خدا نا پیر ملک ارے کور مسس پیرو بابا متھے سستنے خانہ نیک خیرے خیرے واکو کوپاڑوئے نا رحیم داد
en: ...God bless, today he has gone mad, his own... Piro Baba, by God... has gone blind, Piro Baba... is everything all right? All right?... Rahim Dad of ...Paro.
en_old: ...God bless, today he has gone mad, his... Piro Baba, by God... is blind, Piro Baba... well, well... Rahim Dad.

brh: پوکو پاڑو ہند ہند بریک ابو کنے پنگوس تے ہا پوکو پاڑو خان نیک نی خبرے ہند مشکل اٹ دستی چٹی دا خلکرہ ہفتہ ٹی بریک ہندا خوشی ٹی ہتے وتہ کنا ئے کسے
en: Poko Paro, it comes here, here... father, me... yes, Poko Paro Khan, well, your news... here, with difficulty, a letter comes by hand; it comes once a week; in this happiness... my...
en_old: Poko Paro, it comes like this, father... Poko Paro Khan, well, your news... with difficulty, a letter in hand... it comes within a week, in this happiness... mine...

brh: دا ئے ہلہ بیرے؟ نی دا سیلے ہیتاتے مغز خلیسہ، دا پا دنا چٹھی بسنے؟ یارے! دنا چٹھی؟ گوارام جان نا! گوارام جان نا چٹھی؟ ہئو، ئتو ئتو دے رسے پف۔ بس چالاکی سے ئتو ئتو کدی۔
en: What's all this hurry? You are quarrelling over these silly matters. Now tell me, has his letter come? Friend! His letter? Gwaram Jan's! Gwaram Jan's letter? Yes... give it, give it... Just some trickery... give it, give it...
en_old: What is this? You rack your brain over these silly things. Tell me, has his letter come? Friend! His letter? Gwaram Jan's! Gwaram Jan's letter? Yes... don't... Just a trick...

brh: اوئے سیٹھ کیوٹا مٹھائی ئے نی ہلیس ئے تینٹ زیوہ تخ ہئو ابا تپہ تپہ انتو بہ اللہ دے جوان بر بر بر بر
en: Oh Seth, the sweets you bought... keep them with yourself. Yes, dear... by God, it's a good day! Come, come, come, come.
en_old: Oh Seth, the sweets you bought, I'll take them myself, keep them. Yes, father... by God, it's a good day, come, come, come, come.

brh: برک برک بر بر گوارام جان او گوارام جان
en: Come, come, come, come! Gwaram Jan, oh Gwaram Jan!
en_old: Come, come, come, come, Gwaram Jan, oh Gwaram Jan.

brh: اباش شہر آن چٹی ئس لبا سونیدا رحیم داد۔ سلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام داد۔ زندہ مروس۔ اللہ نا کرم ئے نی جوڑ ئس تگڑ ئس نی جوان ئس ہیں؟ جوان مسنوس۔ جوان اٹ جوان اٹ داد۔
en: Dear, a letter has come from the city, Rahim Dad. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace, Dad. May you live long! By God's grace, are you well, are you strong, are you fine? You've turned out well. I'm fine, I'm fine, Dad.
en_old: Father, a letter has come from the city, Rahim Dad. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace, Dad. May you live long. By God's grace, are you well and strong, are you fine? Have you gotten well? Fine, fine, Dad.

brh: گواہ رمضان ابا گڑاس ننیم پاسے یا تین تو تینٹ مکسے
en: Gwaram Jan, dear, tell us something too, or will you keep it all to yourself?
en_old: Witness Ramzan, father, tell us something, or you'll finish it yourself.

brh: او بابا دا کنا میڈیکل نا سیٹ نا چٹھی ئے کنا سیٹ نا سدھیرو بابا کنا دا سکنے ڈاکٹر گوارام پاو پین وختنے ڈاکٹر مسنوٹ ہاو سدھیرو بابا نا ڈاکٹر گوارام خان
en: Oh Baba, this is the letter for my medical seat, for my seat, Sadhiro Baba. Now call me Doctor Gwaram! In a little while I will have become a doctor. Yes, Sadhiro Baba's Doctor Gwaram Khan.
en_old: Oh father, this is the letter for my medical seat, my seat... Sadhiro Baba, my... Doctor Gwaram, say I'll become a doctor some other time... yes, Sadhiro Baba's Doctor Gwaram Khan.

brh: زیندات نی داخہ جوانو ہیتس کن کیسونس داخہ جوانو پشیس کیسونس ارے دا نمستے وارم جان
en: Long may you live! You have done such a good thing, you have done such a good deed. Here, this is your reward, Gwaram Jan.
en_old: Zindat, you have done such a good thing for this, such a good... this is for you, Gwaram Jan.

brh: اللہ نی اسے کا بلڈاس کرس جوڑ کے پدان مستوئی باز الہوئی ئنا رحیم داد ہرف دا تے ہرف ہرف ارا گڑا استٹ تلنگے اودے بندغ نہ کپک
en: May God make you a great doctor and keep you well... afterwards... a lot... Rahim Dad, letters, these letters, letters... whatever is in the heart, a person cannot (put into words).
en_old: May God make you... afterwards... a lot... Rahim Dad, words, these words, words... the thing that was... a person doesn't do that.

brh: شاباس باز مجبور کننگٹی اٹ وری خیر گڑا اجازت دے اللہ نگہبان اللہ بلو نصیب کرس اللہ عمر ئس ایتنے سلام علیک وعلیکم السلام یا اللہ
en: Well done. I'm insisting very much... well, all right, then give me leave. May God protect you, may God grant you great fortune, may God give you a long life. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. O God.
en_old: Well done, very... compelled... well then, give me permission. May God protect you, may God grant you great fortune, may God give you long life. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. O God.

brh: یا اللہ کنا شکر ئے نی کنا ہر دعا ئے قبول کرین خان گوہرام جان میر صاحب آن اندا ایتا نا مٹھائی الین نا پیرو بابا دا خوشی نا مستائی ئے
en: O God, I thank you, you have accepted my every prayer. Khan Gwaram Jan, the sweets were got from Mir Sahib... Piro Baba, this is the reward for this happiness.
en_old: O God, thank you, you have accepted my every prayer. Khan Gohram Jan, from Mir Sahib... give sweets... Piro Baba, this is the congratulations for this happiness.

brh: ئے پین اسہ ننے خواہوہ، انتئے کہ اوم تینا ہر خوشی نی مست ئے کنے ننے پیرو بابا نی خوش سمائی بابا غان زیات او کنے خوشی تپو مریک، ورام جان۔
en: Someone else will need us too, because for him too, his every happiness is you... me, us... Piro Baba, you know, more than a father... and for me there is happiness..., Gwaram Jan.
en_old: Yes, someone else wants us, because his every happiness is you... Piro Baba, you... more than a father... there is no happiness for me, Gwaram Jan.

brh: کنا دا پجاغاک ہندا وڑ ئنا خوشی و غم تنے ہمٹ پیہن مسنو۔ کوڑائی دا ہمرت پارے کہ دا وڑ ئنا ہرا بندغ تنے خوشی تے ہرا دے کیک۔ پیرو بابا!
en: These hairs of mine have turned white through just such joys and sorrows. Who ever said that a person of this kind would (give up) his own happiness on any day? Piro Baba!
en_old: These relatives of mine have shared such joys and sorrows with you as well... said that what kind of person... which day... Piro Baba!

brh: کنا زندی اوڑن بے دیسی مننگ کپرہ نی خو بیس سالن کنتو اوار مسنس نی کنا سنگت مسنس ہر گام آ کنتو اوار مسنس
en: My life... I cannot live apart from it like a stranger. For twenty years you have been with me, you have been my friend, at every step you have been with me.
en_old: My life cannot be without... You have been with me for twenty years, you have been my friend, you have been with me at every step.

brh: کنا ہر گڑا نی مسنس پیرو بابا دا کنا آخری کو ضد ئے دا ضد آن کنے توپیس داڑان کنے توپیس پیرو بابا
en: You have been my everything, Piro Baba. This is my last wish; don't hold me back from this wish, don't hold me back from this, Piro Baba.
en_old: You were my everything, Piro Baba. This is my last wish; don't stop me from this wish, don't stop me from this, Piro Baba.

brh: گڑا
en: Then...
en_old: Then.

brh: نی شارک آسا نی تو پاریسٹ کہ ہر گام آ نی تو نا واروٹ نی گڑتی کپہ ئے زو ئس چا رن برو نی نی باز انتظار کلیفوٹ
en: You... I told you that at every step I will be with you. Don't worry. I will come back quickly; I won't keep you waiting long.
en_old: You were... you used to say that at every step with you... you won't turn back... come quickly... I made you wait a lot.

brh: ولے ایندا انتظار کنے آن مروک اوئے؟ گنوک اوست آن خواہوکا گڑائے
en: But will I be able to bear this waiting? You crazy one, it is something longed for from the heart.
en_old: But whose waiting will this be from me? Crazy... the thing wanted from...

brh: جون، ئے ہندا منٹ ئٹی بسٹ۔ جون، فیروز آ؟
en: Jon, I came just this minute. Jon, to Feroz's?
en_old: John, I came this very minute. John, at Feroz's?

brh: پیرا تہ جولی ٹی او کلمہ پیرا تہ جولی ٹی او
en: They are in the lap of the saints, the kalima; they are in the lap of the saints.
en_old: Pour it into the lap, oh, recite the Kalima, pour it into the lap, oh.

brh: انت پائنگٹی اسس؟ تینا زند۔
en: What were you saying? My own life.
en_old: What were you saying? My life.

brh: نی انتس خوائسے ئے خو تینا خواہوکا گڑائے باز وقتی خوائسٹ اینو خو بس اورنگ کتاب ئس اوٹ سما اف کہ اوتے دننگ کن
en: What do you want? As for me, I wanted my favorite things a long time ago; today I'm just looking at a book. I don't know whether to take them.
en_old: What are you reading? I've read my favorite things for a long time; today I just wanted to look at a book, I don't know whom to give it to.

brh: ہرا وخت آ بریسے زو باز
en: When will you come? Very soon.
en_old: When will you come? Very soon.

brh: ولے وائے است نا ہر منت ئس پورو مریک
en: But oh, every wish of the heart gets fulfilled.
en_old: But oh, every wish of the heart is fulfilled.

brh: ئے اونا مہر منیش مرے نا کے تپنگیس وقت ئس اونا ودی مننگ کین او وقت ئس اونا واپس
en: I... his love... may it be... a time for his being born, and a time for his return.
en_old: May his love... the time of his birth, that time of his return.

brh: ولے دا کنا منشتو کنا بھروسہ ارادے کے تفنگ اٹ ایو
en: But this is my wish, my trust, in holding fast to the resolve.
en_old: But this is my intention, my trust, to keep my resolve.

brh: کنے انتظار ئے کسے نا
en: I am waiting for someone.
en_old: I'm waiting for someone.

brh: چاو او ننے تنیا کرینے
en: Maybe he has left us alone.
en_old: Look, he has left us alone.

brh: کنا مسٹ مہر اسٹ چپ اوئے
en: My mad(?) love, the one... Hush, hey!
en_old: My dear, beloved one, hey, be quiet!

brh: تکرار اسے نی دا کپوتاتے وختس خیال کریس؟ دافتے منس ہندن واریر کے سنٹے تینا ڈغار آ خلیرا۔
en: Over and over... Have you ever noticed these pigeons? Look at them, how they keep striking their beaks on the ground like this.
en_old: Have you ever noticed these pigeons? Look at them, how they keep pecking at their ground over and over.

brh: ول غلہ نا اسہ دانس نصیب مفکتہ ول دا ایلو کپوتاتے تو اوار ہمو دانہ نا وختا تینے اسہ امید ئسیٹ سر کیرہ اینو دا دانس نصیب مریرہ
en: Yet not a single grain of wheat falls to their lot; then, together with these other pigeons, at that feeding time they bring themselves there with a hope that today they will be granted a grain.
en_old: Then they don't get even a single grain of wheat, and then these other pigeons come along with them at feeding time, hoping that today they will get a grain.

brh: السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام بہادر خان، بہادر خان بر ہندا واری ہیتس کروٹ
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace, Bahadur Khan. Bahadur Khan, come, this time I'll say something.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you too, Bahadur Khan. Bahadur Khan, come, I'll do the talking this time.

brh: اوئے ہمت خان ننے خواہفینے، پڑائلو سما درک ہرفو کرک، شاہ محمد خان۔ بابا، ئے تو ہنانے ئے تو ہنانے ہنسا۔
en: Hey, Himmat Khan has called us... (unclear)... Shah Muhammad Khan. Baba, I'm off, I'm off, going.
en_old: Hey Himmat Khan, we've called you... Shah Muhammad Khan. Father, I went, I went, you went.

brh: ننے ایلو خواہفینس خیرے ئے نو نمے خواہفیٹ ہندا خاطرن کہ نم بابو داڑے نمے ہنت ضروری ایتیوے لیکن ٹریکٹر، موٹر سائیکل، گاڑی، ریل دا کل
en: You've called the rest of us too, is everything all right? Well, I called you for this very reason: here, sirs, I have something important to give you. But tractors, motorcycles, cars, trains, all of these...
en_old: We called the others too, that's fine, but we called you because, sir, it's necessary to give you something here. But tractors, motorcycles, cars, trains, all of these...

brh: کلے پلبو، کلے نٹبو، اگر نما دو سر مریگ، جہازا اودے ہم پلبو، ئے ٹورو کٹ، گورنمنٹ چائے، ئے چاؤ، کلہ خلاص او۔ بہادر خان! جیو! مئے این او فائیو ایٹ ہندا خاطر او۔
en: Rob them all, loot them all; if your hand can reach it, rob the plane too. As for the government, leave that to me; everything is clear. Bahadur Khan! Bravo! (unclear)... it's for this very reason.
en_old: Stop all of them, block all of them. If your hand can reach it, stop the plane too. I'll... government tea... it's all over. Bahadur Khan! Long live! That's exactly why...

brh: کہ نوم بابو اور دا میٹنگ اینو تو کرینگٹی گورنمنٹ نا نوم خلاص وری یو بروشمو تک دا کاری بے کروئی اینو ننے تو دا میٹنگ ہندا خاطرا مس غریب آتا خیالے کیرے
en: So you, sirs, and this meeting today... the government's name... finished... this work must be done. Today this meeting of ours was held for this very reason: that you look after the poor.
en_old: So, sir, this meeting today... the government's name is finished... today we held this meeting for exactly this reason: you care about the poor.

brh: غریب اسہ راہی خنارے، اسل مسکین اسے، اودے تینا طرف آن پیسہ تبو، داڑے ببو، اینو مئے پیسہ تبو۔ جیا و! غریب نا مدد ء کبو، ارے امیر تے، بھلا بھلا وزیر تے پلو کبو، کڑائی تے
en: If you see a poor traveler, a truly needy one, give him money from your own side. Come here, give money today. Bravo! Help the poor; hey, the rich, the big big ministers, rob them, the... (unclear).
en_old: If you see a poor traveler, a truly needy one, give him money from your own side. Come here, give us money today. Long live! Help the poor, and as for the rich, rob the big ministers...

brh: او مسورے انتس کہ نمے پاریٹ انشاءاللہ نمتو سلوکوٹ اور بے فکر مبو ہمت خان نا وعدہ ء نمتو نم کل گڑا خلاص مرے کس نما پینا سلنگ کپک اور کس نما سیڈا ہورنگ کپک
en: And as for what happened, I told you: God willing, I stand with you, so don't worry. It's Himmat Khan's promise to you: you will be free of everything. No one will be able to stand in your way, and no one will be able to look you straight in the eye.
en_old: What happened is that I told you, God willing, I'll stand with you, so don't worry. It's Himmat Khan's promise to you: everything will be settled for you. No one will block your way and no one will look at your...

brh: تو کل ماب ہوم اسوری یو گورنمنٹ نا طرف آن بالکل خلاص ارے دایتا تینا کیرے ذہن اٹ تخبو اور کسان گھبراہٹ پبو
en: So all... (unclear)... as far as the government goes, you are completely free. Keep this in your minds, and farmers, don't panic.
en_old: So all of it... on the government's side it's completely finished. Keep this in your mind, and farmers, don't panic.

brh: تو بے فکر منیو ہنتس کہ نا حکم اینے نا حکم نا تابعداری کرو سنگتاک تو مسورے ہنت کہ مہربانی وتی ہون نا زیادہ کوشش کرو اینے پیر احمد خان نیان زیادہ ننے پیسہ ضرورت ئے ہنتس پاس نا حکم ئے
en: So rest easy: whatever your order is, we will obey your order. Friends, so it is that, please, put in more effort, even with your own blood. Pir Ahmad Khan, we need money more than you do. Whatever you say is your command.
en_old: So don't worry, whatever your order is, we will obey it. Friends, so it was that please make more effort... Pir Ahmad Khan, we need money more than you do. Whatever your order is.

brh: شکر خان نی باز جوانو عید کریس ہندو شکر خان نا پن ہنو شکر ہمار نا جند نا عیداکم گواہو۔ الو بائدے ہندنو کاریمو کبو ہنینو کریس دوست برینو۔ میر صاحب سیل آپا پن نانم پائیسا کہ با
en: Shukar Khan, you did a very good Eid(?)... Shukar Khan's name... a witness to... the Eids... One must do work like this... friend... Mir sahib... the name... you say that...
en_old: Shukar Khan, you had a very good Eid. Shukar Khan's name... a witness to the Eid. Don't do that kind of work... a beloved friend. Mir sahib... you say that...

brh: واہ چھتا ہر گڑا ئ گنج کینہ انشاءاللہ واہ نور خان واہ اینا ہیتاتے آن باز خوش مسٹ اگر ہندنو بند پین مرے ئے پین زیادہ خوش مرے ولے دیا میر صاحب کنے کس نا زیا رحم بفک انت کہ ئے ہرا درخت نا نیام
en: Wow... we'll amass heaps of everything, God willing. Wow, Noor Khan, wow, I'm very pleased with your words. If there were more men like this, I would be even happier. But, Mir sahib, I don't feel pity for anyone, because I... in the middle of whichever tree...
en_old: Wow, God willing, we'll gather up everything. Wow, Noor Khan, I'm very happy with your words. If there were more people like this, I'd be even happier. But Mir sahib, I don't feel much pity for anyone, because I'm in the middle of whichever tree...

brh: کسر غن تولے وا ہمودے ہم گڈے وا نی حکم ئس کرک نا ہر حکم کنا خنتیا نی پا کنے دیرے خلوئے دیرے افوئے دنا زیا ظلم کروئی پا کنے
en: ...I'll sit by the road and cut him down too. You just give an order; your every order is on my eyes. You tell me whom to kill and whom not; tell me upon whom such cruelty must be done.
en_old: ...sits on the road, and even then... you give an order; your every order is on my eyes. You tell me: bring water, fetch water. Tell me to commit even such great cruelty.

brh: میر صاحب پا کنے بسنے نا حکم مرے رحمان نی جوانو بندہ سے ئس اور ناکے ظلم ناکے باز بننگو ہندا ظلم کننگوس کنے باز دوست بننگوس اور کے ظالمی بلا بلا بندہ واکو غریباں دے مچٹ
en: Mir sahib, tell me, enough; let it be your order. Rahman, you were a good man, and you liked cruelty a lot. I liked doing this very cruelty a lot, and... the cruelty... the big big men... the poor...
en_old: Mir sahib, tell me, your order has come. Rahman, you were a good man, and you liked cruelty a lot. I liked doing this cruelty a lot, and the big cruel men... the poor...

brh: میر صاحب نا حکم مرے انت کہ بس ہموڑ مرے ملک ٹی تباہی شاغین لٹ مار کین خسیلوئی اف امیر و بھلا بندغ ہم باز کنو داسہ اوفتے ہم منت ہلوئی
en: Let it be as Mir sahib orders, because let it just be that way: let us spread ruin in the country, let us loot and plunder; no one is to be spared. The rich and the big men have also devoured plenty; now they too will have to plead.
en_old: As Mir sahib orders, because let it be just like that: we'll spread destruction in the country, loot and plunder, there's no need to spare anyone. The rich and powerful too; now we'll have to beg them as well.

brh: دلاور خان ننے کنے منتھلی نا ہچو ضرورت اف، نن پانا کینوم بھلا بندغاتے لٹ و پوت وبو، غریب آتے منتھلی مرے غریب آتے، اینو پگ گورنمنٹ غریب آت منتھلی ایتک، بھلا نا ہلپک
en: Dilawar Khan, we have no need at all for a monthly payment. We say that you should loot and plunder the big men; the monthly should go to the poor, to the poor. Sooner or later the government gives the poor a monthly; it takes nothing from the big ones.
en_old: Dilawar Khan, we have no need for a monthly payment. We say: loot and rob the big men, and let the poor get a monthly payment. Today the government gives a monthly payment to the poor, not to the rich.

brh: اور نویک حقک ننا دلٹ اوار او، اور پیسہ تو۔ میر صاحب دا کرے مخلوق کنے پارے گاڈی دیر حساب کتاب کیر، ئے کرے مطلب او کنا گڑا سے لتے چرس، نشہ، بھنگ، ہر گڑا یو کے لتے۔
en: And the new rights are together with our hearts, and with money. Mir sahib, this happened: the people told me, 'The car, whose is it? Settle the accounts.' I did; I mean, my stuff... charas, drugs, bhang, everything...
en_old: And the new rights are with our hearts, and with the money. Mir sahib, people did this; they told me to stop the car and do the accounting. I did. I mean, I had stuff: charas, drugs, bhang, everything.

brh: میر صاحب ہوتہ گاڑی دزنگور ہوتہ ٹریکٹر دزنگور ہوکے گاڑی تا غم مفرو ئنا برو لشکر خان ننے بنگتے صرفی نی قاضی رو ٹھنٹر نیپاس کھلی تھانہ حساب جوڑ کے
en: Mir sahib, their cars have been stolen, their tractors have been stolen. There will be no grief over the cars... come, Lashkar Khan... you are the judge... the police station... settle the account.
en_old: Mir sahib, there are car thieves there, tractor thieves there. Don't worry about the cars... Lashkar Khan, you're the judge... open the police station and settle the accounts.

brh: کس کس آن مردننگ کپک نی کنا زندوس او تینا زند ئے کس گرام کننگ کپک بھلے گرام دا ایت اخس آسان اف نا پاوات
en: No one can be torn away from anyone. You are my life, and no one can forget their own life. Even forgetting — this thing is not as easy as you say.
en_old: Nobody can be separated from anyone. You are my life, and nobody can give their life to someone else as a beloved. Even if they do, it's not as easy as you say.

brh: ئے تے اسل منپک، نی خو بس دا ہستیا وا کہ کنا باوہ کنتون باز مہر کیک، او دا مہر خدائے نا
en: ...that won't happen at all. You should just understand this much: my father loves me very much, and this love is from God.
en_old: ...doesn't matter at all. Just know this much: my father loves me very much, and this love is from God.

brh: او زلمی
en: Oh, young man!
en_old: Oh, young man.

brh: بے بے او دربی بے خیر ئے اینو نی ڈغار تے آ زو بسس، بابا اینو باز دم درینگانوٹ، دا زیبو ہرا دے؟
en: Bibi, oh Dur Bibi, is everything all right? You came to the fields early today. — Baba, I'm very tired today. Where is this Zebo?
en_old: Mother, oh mother, is everything all right? You came to the fields early today. Dad, I'm very tired today. Where is Zebo?

brh: ئے پاتات ہیرغشیت ننے۔ زیبو راٹی مرے کڑاری نی کے کاریم کیک۔ درو دیگی اوشا اینو مانا زستورا غینانے۔ ابس۔
en: [Unclear] us. Zebo, bless her, the girl does the work for you. Yesterday [unclear]... today she has gone to Manaz's. That's all.
en_old: ...tell us, don't worry. Zebo, may she be happy, what work does the girl do? Today she went to Manaz's place. That's it.

brh: انو ئے دیر مس؟ ماناز، ماناز نا باوہ ئے خناٹ۔ پارے مسڑ نا کنا برام ء۔ اینو پگہ مسڑ نا برام تننگ ہم اسہ ویل اسے۔ مسڑ نا تو ہر گڑا ویل اسے۔ یا۔۔۔
en: Now who was that? Manaz — I saw Manaz's father. He said, "It's my daughter's wedding." These days marrying off a daughter is a burden too. With a daughter, everything is a burden. Or...
en_old: Who was it today? Manaz... I saw Manaz's father. He said, 'My daughter's wedding.' These days, marrying off a daughter is a burden too. Everything about a daughter is a burden. Or...

brh: قسمت کہ دا مسڑ کہ کسس بریک او نندادے اورائی او جاگہ کین۔ زیبونہ لومہ اینے حیران او۔ مخلوق نا شش شش مسڑ او گنوک متیو۔ نا زیب مسڑ اسے نین او گنوک مسس۔ مخلوق آتہ ایتہ کسہ مخلوق آتہ مسہ
en: It's fate — this girl: whenever someone comes and sits down... [unclear]. Zebo's mother is bewildered today. People whisper: hasn't the girl gone mad? Your Zeb is a girl who has gone mad. People's talk, people's stories...
en_old: It's fate that whoever comes to this girl sits down, and she gives them a place. Zebo's mother is astonished. With people's whispering, the girl went mad. Our Zeb, a girl, went mad. People said...

brh: زنگ نامسنا ور گنوکو سادا افس، اوراغان پیش تمیک تاکہ واپس وطن کنا بٹٹی سیک افک۔ در بے بے اللہ خیر کیک، ئے درے گنوکو وری غنانا نامسل کینم بندغس ودی مروئی۔
en: [Unclear] she is no plain madwoman; she goes out of the house so that [unclear] back home. Bibi, God will make it well; [unclear] someone is bound to turn up.
en_old: She's not just some simple madwoman. She goes out from there so that she doesn't come back home to me. Mother, God will make it right. ...a person will be born.

brh: نی تو جواننگا ہیتہ کیم بس دوتہ لانچیسہ کن تو جنگا کے آ بشے اینی رغسہ تو بشے کاوا او بشام رٹ کٹ رٹ کٹ گسیے گسیے
en: You only talk nicely, just waving your hands about; with me you fight... [unclear] then I'll get up and go, and get up — rat-kat, rat-kat... [unclear]
en_old: You talk nicely, just waving your hands, but for me, in the fight... you're turning around, and at night, tick-tock, tick-tock, again and again.

brh: مہناز! اوہو زیب النساء مسٹ کپا! سیلہ دوٹی کنا لگے
en: Mahnaz! Oho, Zeb-un-Nisa, don't laugh! The needle pricked my hand.
en_old: Mahnaz! Oh, Zeb-un-Nisa, don't laugh! The needle pricked my hand.

brh: چاوا کہ غصہ اوس، نیکن تو نیت کپتو جوانی انتئے؟ ارادیان پد نی بنی اوس، امر غصہ مفو۔ ماناز، اما نی چاسا، اینو نا برام نا بانہ ئے پت
en: I know you're angry — but didn't I mean well by you? Why, then? After making the plan you were supposed to come; how could I not get angry? Manaz, but you know, today the wedding was just the excuse...
en_old: Do you know that you were angry? You didn't mean well, why? After the decision you were... how could I not be angry? Manaz, mother, you know, today the excuse of the wedding...

brh: پیش تمانٹ ئے ہم ارادہ آن پد دخل کو دا واری الوکا وا او غصہ ارمان کروس کن کے زیبو انت مس؟
en: I did go out too, after the plan... this time [unclear], and you'd be angry and regretful. Tell me, what happened to Zebo?
en_old: I went out too, and after deciding, I went in. This time I was angry and regretful: what happened to Zebo?

brh: نی جائی تا او غنگوس ئے تو مسخرہ کریٹا تیچا کنا انت قسمت اسے مانس گرامم کنے تنہا ایلنگے
en: You... are you crazy? I was only joking... What a fate I have — he forgot me and left me all alone.
en_old: ...and if you had gone mad, I would have mocked you. What a fate is mine, my beloved left me alone.

brh: ئے امیران اٹ کنے انت کنے خڑینگ بٹنگوس؟ ہندا خاطر آن تو غیبہ کنے نا است کنے تسلی تریتک گودی نی فکر کپہ اسہ ٹس ودی مروئی کہ نی تسلی
en: Why do you make me shed tears over hopes? That's why my heart used to secretly console me: "Lady, don't you worry, someone will come along who will console you."
en_old: Why did you make me wait with hope? That's why my heart secretly comforted me: sister, don't worry, a day will come when you'll be comforted.

brh: دا داوار نا غولوم نا اسا دے۔ غولوم نا نوم ئے سما ئے داوار نا بوت خلک دے پورا ہشتاد گونی کم مسونو۔
en: This is about Dawar's servant. You know the servant's name. The day Dawar [unclear] struck, a full eighty sacks came up short.
en_old: This is the day of Dawar's servant. You know the servant's name. The day Dawar's boot struck, a full eighty sacks went missing.

brh: داڑے ہمو پیسہ غاتے لکاٹ کے بشام نمے ارائی کرے دا پنجاہ پنج ہزار روپئی۔ آ داڑے کیرے دا لکو کے ہمو ٹوبیل آتہ۔ السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ برکوارم۔ منشی دا حساب کتابے ولدا ہوریننے نیسلے۔
en: Here I've written down that money which was paid to you in the evening — this fifty-five thousand rupees. And here, put it — write this in those ledgers. — Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace. My dear boy. Munshi, go over this account again.
en_old: Here I wrote down the money you lent last night: this fifty-five thousand rupees. Write this here in those ledgers. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Welcome. Munshi, look over this account again.

brh: ورہ منشی پاریکہ کہ شار آن ڈاکٹری نا چٹھی بسنے؟ جی ابا، آخر تینا ڈاکٹری نا ضد پورا کریس۔ ئے تو خواہسٹ کہ دا سیزن اٹ سنگ و برامے نا
en: The munshi was saying that a letter about your doctor's degree has come from the city? — Yes, Abba. — So in the end you fulfilled your insistence on becoming a doctor. I had wanted this season for your engagement and wedding...
en_old: Elder Munshi was saying that a doctor's letter came from the city? Yes, father, you finally fulfilled your stubborn wish to be a doctor. I had wanted this season for the engagement and wedding...

brh: بابا سانگو برام کے تو عمر استے ہو گئی خواجہ ڈاکٹری کلو صف کے شارہ درے سر کرستو بسوس
en: Son, you have come of age for engagement and marriage; Khwaja, you've finished all your doctor's studies in the city and come back.
en_old: Father, the age for engagement and wedding has passed. You finished the whole doctor's course in the city and came back.

brh: ہم کل کارم تا ویئے کنک۔ بابا ئے گڑاس پانے خواسوٹ۔ او گورم نی
en: And all this work eats up one's years too. — Baba, I wanted to tell you something. — Yes, go on.
en_old: ...also eats the share of all the work. Father, I wanted to tell you something. Yes, go on.

brh: تیری بابا تب نہ تو جوانی او تب کنا جوانی نی گڑاس
en: Your... Baba, back then it was neither your youth... and back then my youth... you, something...
en_old: Your father, back then neither your youth... and back then my youth, you something...

brh: بانے خائس اسے؟ نہ دونو خاص ہیت ئس الو بس ایلو دے آ شار آن اینگی گٹی اسوٹ دا پریٹ آ مونا سلوٹ۔ آ دا شار آن یاد بس کنے کہ ملک شاہ بیگ آ ضرور کاس نت گلہ کے کنے آن۔ کاو برو۔
en: Is it something special? — No, nothing special as such; it's just that the other day I was coming back this way from the city and stopped in front of this place. Then, coming from the city, I remembered that you must definitely go to Malik Shah Baig, otherwise he'll complain about me. — Let me go, then.
en_old: What's going on? No, nothing special, it's just that the other day I was coming back from the city and stopped at this crossroads. Then from the city I remembered that I must go to Malik Shah Baig, otherwise he'll complain to me. Come on, let's go.

brh: دا قسم یاد کپہ کنے کہ ولدا گیرام کنے گپ و روز کنے
en: Don't make me this vow — that you'll forget me again... [unclear] me.
en_old: Don't swear like that to me, that you'll say goodbye to me again and leave me.

brh: نی دیر گرام کننگ کے گنوک
en: Whom would you forget, you crazy one?
en_old: Who are you saying goodbye to, you crazy one?

brh: گھرجم گڑا تے نا مچ کریس؟ او پیرو بابا گڑا تے خو استو مچ کریسٹ
en: Have you gathered all your things? — Yes, Piro Baba, I've already gathered the things.
en_old: Did you gather the household things? Oh, Piro Baba, I've gathered the things, haven't I.

brh: نی سہم آن رخصت کریس؟ او، بابا غان ہم رخصت کرٹ۔ دا ڈیوٹی نا انت حساب ئے پیرو بابا؟
en: Have you taken leave of Saham? — Yes, I took leave of Baba too. What's this duty business, Piro Baba?
en_old: Did you say goodbye to Saham? Yes, I said goodbye to Baba too. What kind of duty is this, Piro Baba?

brh: نی کڑنو باز دوستے نی نشار اینی گٹوس ہنا خاطر نی
en: You love it very much; it's for that you're going off to the city.
en_old: You're very fond of rice, you're going to the city for its sake.

brh: کن تیار کرے فٹ ہا کنا مار نی تینے ننگ کے پین کسے پین چسہ پیرو بابا دا مرویت کسہ نا مہر
en: It has been got ready for me, all set. — Yes, my son, you yourself... someone else... — Piro Baba, this kindness, this love...
en_old: Prepare for me quickly, my son, you yourself... someone else... Piro Baba, this kindness and love of yours.

brh: ہر گڑا غان زیات ء نی کنے چنکیان بلون کرینوس پیرو بابا دا خسمیر کہ نی کنے تسنوس دا خسمیر تو اسہ باوہ سے نا مار ء ہم تنے کپک
en: More than anything, you raised me from childhood, Piro Baba. This care you have given me — even a father cannot give such care to his son.
en_old: More than anything, you raised me from childhood, Piro Baba; this upbringing you've given me, even a father doesn't give his own son.

brh: تا کہ ئس مہران زیادہ پین اند پنی کیک تننگ کے نی چنا تیاری تے کر بے صاحب کنے پاریسوس کے
en: ...what more than love could anyone give? — You get your preparations done, child; Bibi Sahib had told me.
en_old: So that someone, more than love... you make your preparations; the master told me.

brh: گاڈی ٹی نشارم اوڑے نبیرو بابا یسے وار آ پیر صاحب نا جاگہ غا کاوا زیارت کین ہیرم پدی بس اٹ کاوا گاڈی نا ضرورت اف
en: In the car — I'll take you there. — No, Piro Baba, first I'll go to Pir Sahib's place and pay my respects at the shrine; afterwards I'll go by bus. There's no need for the car.
en_old: I'll sit in the car there, Piro Baba. Once I'll go to Pir Sahib's place to visit the shrine, then I'll come back by bus; there's no need for the car.

brh: بہادر خان، اسکا نی پا کہ نی اوفتہ بلا اوس۔ برے فکر مرو، پو مسورے؟ جی او، جی او۔ خیرو، ہدا سنگت آتے شربت ایتے جی او سر۔
en: Bahadur Khan, now you tell them that you are their chief. Don't worry, did you all understand? Yes sir, yes sir. Khairo, give these friends some sharbat. Yes sir.
en_old: Bahadur Khan, now you tell them that you were their leader. Don't worry, understood? Yes sir, yes sir. Khairo, give these friends some sharbat. Yes sir.

brh: لشکر سنگتاک دمداسہ اللہ نگہبان ہمبو تینا کاریم تے کبو۔ جوان مرزا صاحب نا توکل نا دعا کیس۔ بش مرو سنگتاک۔
en: Lashkar, friends, that's it for now. May God protect you; go and do your work. All right, Mirza Sahib, say a prayer of trust in God. On your feet, friends.
en_old: Lashkar, friends, that's all for now. May God protect you, go and do your work. Well, Mirza Sahib, pray that we put our trust in God. All right, friends.

brh: خیرو، اندر ہورزہ کنے ہندرز کنے، بشہ دودھ پتیء چاس کر، لیکھے نہ خلیوہ۔ حاضر میر صاحب۔ کنا مار اینو اسکولء انتئے ہنتنس؟
en: Khairo, go inside and have a look for me, make some milk tea, and no skimping. At your service, Mir Sahib. My son, why haven't you gone to school today?
en_old: Khairo, look inside and bring me some milk tea. Don't be stingy with it. Right away, Mir Sahib. Why didn't my son go to school today?

brh: نن اتوار چھٹی ئے اچھا؟ ہا۔ ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی کنے خرچی ایت۔ ارنگا سب؟ پشاور آ۔ دا خرچی دا چھوٹو تے ایتس گڑا؟ ہا۔ ٹھیک ہی ہمبو چکر خلبو گڑا زو ببو۔ علی جان خان دا ہمت خان ہم باز
en: We have Sunday off, okay? Yes. All right, all right, give me some pocket money. Where are you all going? To Peshawar. Did you give this pocket money to this little one too, then? Yes. All right, go and have an outing, then come back soon. Ali Jan Khan, this Himmat Khan is also very...
en_old: We have Sunday off, okay? Yes. Fine, fine, give me some pocket money. Where are you all going? To Peshawar. Did you give this pocket money to the little ones, then? Yes. Fine, go have your outing and come back soon. Ali Jan Khan, this Himmat Khan is also very...

brh: او بیکار و بندغ ئس پیش تما۔ ایو دا خلانو تو لگیک جوان و بندغ ئس مونٹی جوان لگیک استٹی باز خراب ئے ہیت مروڑا؟ جیو۔ کنے تو لگے پتا نم۔ بس نی بندغاتے درست کپیسا؟ ئے کنا تو غیرا ئے ہیت کرے جوان و بندغ ئس
en: He turned out to be a worthless man. When you look at him he seems like a good man; on the outside he seems good, but inside he is very bad, isn't that so? Yes. Well, that's how it seemed to me, you know. So can't you tell what people are like? With me he talked differently, like a good man.
en_old: He turned out to be a useless man. When you look at him, he seems like a good man. On the outside he seems good, but inside he's very bad, isn't that right? Yes. I sensed it, you know. Can't you tell what people are like? I was talking about someone else, a good man.

brh: چلو نی پاسہ تو ٹھیک ئے ناہی تے منے نا میر احمد خان پگہ بلو خیرات ئس کننگا ٹی او دعوت ئے نی پگہ بارہ بجے
en: Come on, if you say so, then it's fine; otherwise... Mir Ahmed Khan is holding a big charity feast tomorrow, and you are invited, tomorrow at twelve o'clock.
en_old: Come on, if you say so, it's fine, otherwise... Listen, Mir Ahmed Khan is holding a big charity feast tomorrow, and you're invited. Tomorrow at twelve o'clock.

brh: حاضر میر جان حاضر تول بو چا خدمت ئس ممکن ئے مہربانی اللہ نگہبان مہربانی سنگتاک
en: At your service, Mir Jan, at your service. Please sit down, have some tea. Is there anything I can do for you? Thank you, may God protect you. Thank you, friends.
en_old: At your service, Mir Jan, at your service. Tell me, is there anything I can do for you? Thank you. May God protect you. Thank you, friends.

brh: سنگوری میر علی جان بھلو پگہ خیرات ئس کیک بارہ بجا نمے کلے دعوت ئے سنگتاتے وتی رے اور ایڑے بھلا بھلا بندہ برہ اوفتے نشاندہی کبو اغوا کبو اوکا پد کیرے ئے تورو کوٹ
en: Friends, Mir Ali Jan is holding a big charity feast tomorrow at twelve o'clock, and you are all invited. Take the friends along, and very important people will come there. Point them out, kidnap them, and after that you will keep them held in the fort.
en_old: Sangori Mir Ali Jan is holding a big charity feast tomorrow at twelve, and you're all invited. Take your friends with you. Very important people will come there. Point them out and kidnap them. After that, keep them locked in the fort.

brh: دا ننا خوش قسمتی ئے پگہ خیرات ہم ارے جوان آ جوان آ بھلا بندغاک بریرہ اللہ نا پاک غا کاریم مس ہمو سنگتاک سنگتاک پگہ ہبو اوفتے درست کبو پگہ
en: It's our good luck that there is also a charity feast tomorrow. Fine, important people will be coming. By God's grace the job is done. Friends, friends, go tomorrow and pick them out, tomorrow.
en_old: We're lucky that there's also a charity feast tomorrow. Very important people will come. God's blessed work is done. Friends, go tomorrow and pick them out.

brh: خدا کرے استاد زیا اسٹ اشٹا کاروائی کبو تاکہ اسہ اسہ بندہ بھلا بھلا بنداتے ہن اغوا کرسا کبو اور پیسہ دن بوئی انت پیسہ ضرورت ئے ننے
en: God willing, Ustad, carry out one or two operations so that you keep kidnapping the big people one by one, and the money will come in that way. Money is what we need.
en_old: God willing, Ustad, pull off one big operation so that you kidnap the important people one by one, and the money will come in like that. Money is what we need.

brh: سناتاک میر علی جان دعوتس ننے خیرات نا اینا ریڈی خنارے بند واتی
en: Friends, Mir Ali Jan has invited us to his charity feast. Get ready today...
en_old: Friends, Mir Ali Jan has invited us to a charity feast. Get ready today, I'll come myself.

brh: میر صاحب بندہ آتے ہم جوان خنان اور دعوت ئس ہم جوان او جوان او دا بندہ بھلا بھلا بندہ آتے ہورارے نی کرے رے اسل ہندنو بندہ خنان کہ نا دعا مرے میر کاری کھلا مرے
en: Mir Sahib, we got a good look at the people too, and the feast was good as well, very good. These big people, if you had looked at the big people... we really did see such people. With your prayers, Mir, the job will get done.
en_old: Mir Sahib, I got a good look at the people, and the feast was good too, very good. You saw these important people. I've never seen people like that. With your prayers, Mir, our work will succeed.

brh: بے فکر مرو ہمت کبو ہمت کبو نمے ئے ہندا مستم پارینوٹ کہ بھلا بندغ اسو ہموفتے دوانتس کروئی ئے نمے
en: Don't worry. Take courage, take courage. I told you before that they are big people; you have to deal with them.
en_old: Don't worry, take heart, take heart. I told you before that they were important people and you have to deal with them.

brh: او غریب آتینا بچہ او۔ پیر نا غریب نا ہوغنگ ء الے، ہرفتے نا ہوغنگ نا کو۔ کنا دماغ ء کیک کرینے۔ پنجاہ وار پارینٹ کہ غریب نا گھر خلکائینٹیس۔ دا ہرا ہیت ء کننگ اٹی ئس
en: They are the children of the poor. The weeping of the old man, the poor man... their weeping... It has messed up my head. I've told you fifty times not to hit a poor man's house. What is this thing you're doing?
en_old: They are the children of the poor. The cries of the poor... it has driven me out of my mind. I've told you fifty times not to rob a poor person's house. What were you doing?

brh: بندہ غریب نا پین ہیلپ کیرے، نن غریب پرست اون غریب آتا مدد کروکو بندہ اون نن ہمے میتھیا نف اون کہ ہرا غریب آتے او ہمیتے کلے لوٹیرہ، نن ہمے بندہ غیت اون پین تے غریب نا ہیلپ کرے
en: Man, you are supposed to help the poor. We are devoted to the poor, we are people who help the poor. We are not the kind of people who loot the poor and all of them; we are people who help the poor.
en_old: We help other people who are poor. We care about the poor. We are people who help the poor. We are not the kind who rob the poor. We are people who help the poor.

brh: نی الکس، لٹیر مخلوق، میر! ٹھیک ہی غریب نا بخرہ ئ شکنگ اٹی ئس غریب نا بخرہ ئ شکنگ اٹی ئس نن تینا جان ئ تینا دیر ئ جتا کرینن ہنا کتی مٹ کین۔ نی غریب نا بخرہ ئ ہرفوئی کسے؟ غریب نا مدد ئ۔
en: You took it, you looting lot! Mir! All right, you were snatching the share of the poor, you were snatching the share of the poor. We have given up our own lives and our own homes for this. Should you take what belongs to the poor? It's for helping the poor.
en_old: You... you looter, you lowlife, Mir! All right, you were taking away the share of the poor. You were taking away the share of the poor. We've put our lives on the line and left our homes. Should you be taking what belongs to the poor? Help the poor.

brh: خلوئی ننے، امیدے خلوئی، امیدے پلوئی، امیدے لٹوئی، لٹو لٹوئی، دا مخ کہ نمس غریب ئس نا پوتونگا سفرے بریرے، دا گڑا کنے ضرورت اف، سمجھارے؟
en: We have to strike: the rich must be struck, the rich must be robbed, the rich must be looted, loot, they must be looted. Not this, that you go robbing some poor man on his journey. I don't need that, understand?
en_old: We have to strike. We hope to strike, we hope to rob, we hope to loot. But don't do it if some poor person is on a journey. I don't need that, understand?

brh: آئینو ابا دا ہنو غلطی کپیرے غریب آتہ پنی ہرفیرے ٹھیک ہی نا ٹھیک ہی دعا سمجھرے کلمہ کلام لائی تو ہاؤ ٹھیک ہی
en: From now on, Aba, you won't make such a mistake, taking from the poor. All right? All right. Understand the prayer? Swear by the Kalima, then yes, all right.
en_old: From today on, Father, we won't make such a mistake. We won't take anything from the poor. Okay, okay, understand the prayer. Swear by the Kalima, then yes, okay.

brh: نا بارہ ٹی
en: About you.
en_old: About you

brh: باز باز مہربانی شکریہ
en: Thank you very, very much. Thanks.
en_old: Thank you very, very much. Thanks.

brh: اب تنے دادے شہباز خان پریشان کن خبر بشانتی او جیا او نا جوان چاودانو مرزا بے کنے دانا سمائی استنا کل احوال دے او یار مہربانی ئس کر دادس پریشان انی ہم پریشان کنتی بشانی خبر آ بس بابا آن پندادے دانا
en: Now you, Shahbaz Khan, have brought this troubling news. Oh dear, oh... your good friend Mirza... tell me all the details of this, everything on your mind. Oh friend, do me a favour: this one is worried, and you have worried me too with the news you brought. Just ask Baba about this.
en_old: Now you've given me this troubling news, Shahbaz Khan. Oh dear, his good friend Mirza, give me all the details you have about this. Please, my friend, this is very troubling, and you've brought me troubling news too. Father, ask about this...

brh: اگر مرضی ئے چاوے نی کنا مرضی ہم کو بس ایلم اینن بف یسے محبتس کیس تو محبت دندوم مریک یسے گڑاس ئے اود پاننگ کپیس تو نا محبت نا فائدہ انت مس نی بائیدے اور تو اینک محبت نا اظہار کر اور تو ملے ہرے ئے
en: If it's your wish, you know, then my wish too is just this, brother: if you love someone, the love grows; if you can't say anything to them, then what is the use of your love? You must express your love to them, and then they will come to know.
en_old: If you love someone, then show it. Even my wish is just this, brother: if you love someone, the love grows; but if you never say anything to them, what's the use of your love? You should express your love to them, and then they'll find out.

brh: تو بغیر شک آن ہم پاتے محبت ہندن مفا کہ نی گننگ اٹ ئس ایمر کے ودی ہچ پانہ کپرو۔ دا ہندن سوچ کے اوستٹی کاف۔ دا ئے تو پاوا تو دو دو لیکن ایڈے کاف اوستٹی ہچ پانہ کپرو۔ بئے نی اسہ کاریم ئس کننگ کیس؟ انت کاریم ئس ایمالٹا نا اسہ کلو ئس
en: So, without a doubt, I'll also say this: love isn't such that you keep it to yourself and never say anything. Don't just think it over like that in your heart. Say it, then; but don't keep it here in your heart without saying anything. Hey, can you do a job for me? What job? A kilo of those oranges...
en_old: Then, without a doubt, I'll say this: love isn't like that, where you can't say anything after counting. You can't just think it in your heart. Say it, then... but don't keep it in your heart without saying anything. Can you do one job? What job? A kilo of oranges...

brh: اسہ کدرود پغدت گفٹ تسونے، خانہ باد مالٹام کس گفٹ درینے مستی ادا سا، بس یار شاباش این پف، اینو پکر ماڈرن زمانہ ہی بھئی، نیس کلو مالٹانہ یا مٹھائی نا اسہ دریت گفٹ ایتتے او تینٹ سمجھے کہ او بھئی نی شکن تکیسے
en: Someone has given a gift... Bless their home, someone has even brought oranges as a gift... Well, my friend, well done... These days it's the modern age, brother: they give half a kilo of oranges or a box of sweets as a gift and think to themselves, 'Oh brother, you've done something great.'
en_old: Someone has given a gift for nothing. Bless your home, someone brought oranges as a gift. Well, my friend, well done, you say. Today they think it's the modern age, brother. They give twenty kilos of oranges or a box of sweets as a gift and think, oh brother, you're doing something great.

brh: جائی بسے بس یار کمال اینے اللہ نی آباد کے اللہ نی بس جائی او بس جلیل ہم نی تو ساتھ تو نا ایناڑے مین او بس ایناٹ بس صحیح ہی خدا جوان کنے
en: Really, just... friend, that's wonderful. May God keep you prosperous, may God... really, just... and Jalil is with you too... just here... just, all right. May God make it good.
en_old: You've come to the right place. Well, my friend, that's wonderful, may God bless you. May God... you're in the right place. And Jalil is with you too... alright, may God make it good for me.

brh: ارے لشکو جی میر اینو کنے راہی کرے ہن سنگتاتے ہورک انت غزا کیرہ اینو نور خانے راہی کرے ہورک انت غزا کیک
en: Hey Lashko! Yes? Today the Mir sent me: 'Go, look at the friends, see what food they are eating.' Today he sent Noor Khan: 'see what he is eating.'
en_old: Hey Lashko, Mir sent me today: go see what the friends are eating. Today he sent Noor Khan to see what they're eating.

brh: برے خبر تمی اوڑان جو مریک پٹہ میر صاحب کنے راہی کریسس نور خان انتے راہی کرینوس نی ڈغار خنے ازا نی ہمراہی کینہ خبر تمی گڑا اونا وزن آن
en: Look, you'll find out; it will become clear from him. Mir Sahib had sent me. Noor Khan, why have you sent me? You see the land... I'll go along with you. Then you'll find out, from his weight.
en_old: It's bad news, it becomes clear from him. Mir Sahib, did you send me? Noor Khan, why have you sent me? You see the land, I'll go with you. It's bad news, then from its weight...

brh: او مسہ سیلوم
en: Oh, three times.
en_old: Oh, three floods.

brh: السلام علیکم میر صاحب۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ خیریت؟ ٹھیک ٹھاک؟ خوش؟ خیر؟ بے خیری؟ خیر ئے بابو، جوڑ ئس سیٹ ئس بے خیر، قضا صیحب، کدی رے بسورے؟ گنج مس، ایرا سائیکل موٹر پھلا نسٹ۔
en: Peace be upon you, Mir Sahib. And upon you be peace. All well? Doing fine? Happy? Good? No trouble? All is well, sir; healthy and fine, no trouble. Qazi Sahib, when did you come? It's been quite a while. Two motorbikes...
en_old: Peace be upon you, Mir Sahib. And upon you be peace. All well? Fine? Happy? Good? Any trouble? All good, dear, healthy and fine, no trouble. Qazi Sahib, when did you come? It was a lot; we went on a motorcycle.

brh: ہاؤ سائیں جوانو وڈیرا تا سو یا نو غریب آدمو رو جوانو زمیندارو کچ قاعدہ خوش کریسو گڑا ہا جوانو نگا وڈیرا تا جتو وئی شاباش بلال نا کرے زمیندارو غریب آتے فلانو بھاز کوکو نو ہمت کرینو رے ہمت کرینو سیلاب نا مالے سیلاب نا مالے
en: Yes, sir, the good landlords... or the poor man... good landowners made them happy in some way. Then yes, the good landlords... Well done, Bilal: the landowner did a great deal for the poor, showed courage, showed courage. The flood relief goods, the flood relief goods.
