brh: اوڑا آن پانے داسہ ئے تو سدھا اٹ کہ نم کنے سدھا اف۔ نئیں نئیں نئیں دا لالو بس کنے پاروس کہ ئے نی جان را مانیو ہناڑا بس چہ بس بئے اگر کہ داسہ داسہ لائق ئنا لیسے تو بہتر ئے
en: Tell her: now I'm being straight, but you aren't straight with me. — No, no, no, this Lalu just tells me that [...] your life [...] — just, enough. If you become worthy now, right now, that's better.
en_old: Tell him that now it's clear you're not straight with me. No, no, no, this Lalu just told me that you are dear to me... just, if now you're worthy, then that's better.

brh: دا سے اسل جوان و سلاہ سے تیوانے ہن سلاہ سے بس نی داسے دوں کر چھو کو تاوان نس کیز خاص اسے لاکٹ اسے درود ئے سر کر ہاؤ ہاؤ امر و لاکٹ اسے اسے لاکٹ اسے مرے ہن قسم نا مرے یا
en: Here's a really good piece of advice I'll give you — the advice is: just do it like this now [...] no loss [...] — get a special locket, a locket, and deliver it. — Yes, yes, what kind of locket? — A locket; let it be a locket of any kind, or...
en_old: This is truly good advice, a piece of advice: just do this, don't cause any loss, bring a special locket, yes yes, what kind of locket, a locket of what kind, or...

brh: کیسو نا ئس مرے، انت نا ئس مرے، لاکٹ ئس مرے، خاص نا دو نا نشانی ئس مرے، درو نا دو اٹ تختے۔ سمجھا ئس اوت پاو کینے کہ نشانی ئس ایسوں۔ بس! واہ بھائی واہ خوش مرے، شاید خوش مرے، لالو! جی! پیرن پاو نی ہمناڑے مرو بس ئے
en: Let it be anyone's, let it be of anything — let it be a locket, let it be a keepsake specially from your own hand — put it in [her] hand. Understand? Then tell her that you've brought a keepsake. That's it! — Wow, brother, wow! She'll be happy, maybe she'll be happy. — Lalu! — Yes! — [...] tell [her], and you be right there, that's all.
en_old: Whatever kind it is, a locket, a special keepsake from the hand, bring it from yesterday's hand. Understand, then tell me that I've brought a keepsake. That's it! Wow brother, wow, be happy, maybe happy, Lalu! Yes! Tell Peeran you'll be there.

brh: زو کنے نی زو لٹ بس رغال کیتے بس ہمکیں تے بس بس اللہ ہدایت کیتے اول تو محبت کپے کسے تو مونا متے پاننگ ہم کپے
en: Quickly, you [...] me, quickly [...] just [...] — just like that, enough, enough, may God guide him. First of all, one shouldn't fall in love, and if one does love someone, one can't even say it to their face.
en_old: Quickly, you just scold me quickly, just like that, may God guide you. First of all, don't love anyone, and if you do, don't even say it to their face.

brh: ماما اسے نا
en: Of a maternal uncle...
en_old: Of an uncle...

brh: دا کسرٹ بیمار ئس اسہ سائیکل نا زی آ بسونہ مچو، بابا دون مریک کائیک، السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام
en: On this road a sick man has come along a little way on a bicycle. Father, that's how it goes, it goes on. — Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace.
en_old: On this road a sick person came on a bicycle... Baba, how are things going? Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam.

brh: وعلیکم السلام۔ موٹر سائیکلے پل ارے؟ موٹر سائیکلے؟ او، درست کرے نو؟ او درست کرے تے نور خان سمن پل ارے تے۔ نور خان سمن؟ او، جوان چاوہ تے نور خان سمن تے۔ فضائل مسمن کے نران کان۔ وریندا؟ بس نی آ گڑا ہمک کے۔ اللہ مالک سے۔
en: And upon you be peace. — Have they robbed the motorcycle? — The motorcycle? — Yes. — Did you make them out? — Yes, I made them out: Noor Khan Saman robbed it. — Noor Khan Saman? — Yes, I know Noor Khan Saman well. [...] we [...] ran off [...]. [...]? — Then you just do the same. God is the protector.
en_old: Wa alaikum assalam. Was the motorcycle stolen? The motorcycle? Yes, did he really do it? Yes, he did it — Noor Khan Saman stole it. Noor Khan Saman? Yes, I know Noor Khan Saman well. ... Will you come? Just do that thing. God is the guardian.

brh: خیر ئے پانو دیدہ پاک نا ہرس گمتہ نی؟ جی مے گمتہ
en: Is everything all right? Tell me, [dear] — do you have some sorrow? — Yes, I have a sorrow.
en_old: Is everything all right, tell me, did you lose something? Yes, we lost it.

brh: نی تینا است نا ہتے صفا پاک کنے کہ نا استٹی انتس ارے اچھا کنا استٹی انتس ارے کنا استٹی
en: Tell me plainly what is in your heart — what is in your heart. — All right, what is in my heart... in my heart...
en_old: Speak plainly about what is in your heart, what's in your heart. Okay, what's in my heart, in my heart...

brh: بانو صرف نا صورت ئس اچ وخت ئے ہم دن باہنہ کروٹ لیکن اینو ئے پانہ گت اٹ
en: Bano, it's only your face [...]; never at any time did I say it like this, but today I am saying it.
en_old: Bano, I never said it to your face at any time, but today I'm saying it.

brh: دا سینئر افیس کنا استا علی تو ئے صاف پاننگٹ کہ کنا استے اسریفیس اسریفیس اور کنے نی تو باز محبت ارے باز شاباش کنے نی تو باز محبت ارے
en: This [...] of my heart — I am saying it plainly — that you have captivated my heart, captivated it, and I love you very much — bravo! — I love you very much.
en_old: This senior officer, my dear Ali, is saying clearly that my heart... and you love me a lot, well done, you love me a lot.

brh: وائے بنیان ہنا مئے زندگی نیان بغیر مفک کنا تیر زندگی وائے بنیان ہنا مئے زندگی نیان بغیر مفک کنا تیر
en: Oh, without you [...] my life — without you my life will not pass. Oh, without you [...] my life — without you my life will not pass.
en_old: Oh, my beloved, my life won't pass without you; oh, my beloved, my life won't pass without you.

brh: او اینو نی انے ہیتے کہ خواری کرے مجبور کنے استنے پاوے
en: Yes, today you [said] something that made me wretched and forced me to speak my heart.
en_old: Today you said something that forced me to tell what's in my heart.

brh: خوار و نیانی نا مہر زندگی، نی آن بغیر مفک کنا تیر زندگی، خوار و نیانی نا مہر زندگی، نی آن بغیر مفک کنا تیر زندگی، نی آن بغیر مفک کنا تیر
en: Wretched [me], and your love is [my] life; without you my life will not pass. Wretched [me], and your love is [my] life; without you my life will not pass, without you it will not pass.
en_old: Love and affection of my life, my life won't pass without you; love and affection of my life, my life won't pass without you, my life won't pass without you.

brh: بگا تل بو بگا خان بھڑوسو ٹھیک ٹھاک ئس پین خیر اما
en: Bagga, sit down. Bagga Khan, are you well? All fine? Is everything else well?
en_old: Bagga Khan, sit down. Bagga Khan, are you well, all fine? Is everything else good?

brh: ننا بسونو سو او ہمت خان نا ٹولی ننا مارکو تو پھلانو ننا بسونو نی کہ اونے پین سیٹ نا عبدالصمد ئے پین نور خان ئے بے دا ایسٹ نو
en: They came to us — that Himmat Khan's gang — and robbed our boy; they came to us [...] him, and also Abdul Samad of [...], and also Noor Khan [...]
en_old: Himmat Khan's gang came to us and stole our motorcycle... tell him, and also Abdul Samad, and also Noor Khan...

brh: بگا خان حقیقت چے ہنا آسرا یا پینا آسرا؟ ہاؤ سئیں ہنا آسرا نا درست کریندا۔ جوان چائے آسروئے تا؟ ہاؤ چائے آسروئے۔ چلو ٹھیک ئے اللہ جوڑ کیک انشاءاللہ۔ مہربانی کر مئے قربس کر۔ بگا خان نی تینا پریشان کپہ انشاءاللہ اینا موٹر سائیکل واپس کرفیوا۔
en: Bagga Khan, truly, were they his men or someone else's? — Yes sir, they were his; I made them out. — Do you know well that they were [his]? — Yes, I know they were. — All right, fine, God will set it right, God willing. — Please, do us a kindness. — Bagga Khan, don't trouble yourself; God willing, I'll get your motorcycle returned.
en_old: Bagga Khan, truly, is it your hope or someone else's? Yes sir, my hope is that you will fix it. Do you know well? Yes, I know. Okay, fine, God will make it right, inshallah. Please, do us a favor. Bagga Khan, don't worry, inshallah I'll get your motorcycle back.

brh: انشاءاللہ بے فکر مرے ہا بچا ہمدا احوال
en: God willing, don't worry. — Yes, son, that's the whole story.
en_old: Inshallah, don't worry. Yes, son, that's the situation.

brh: ایتہ بوک اینو خوانے نا چوری، ہیلو میر صاحب
en: Give [...] today [...] the theft [...] — Hello, Mir Sahib.
en_old: Give it... today the theft... Hello, Mir Sahib.

brh: السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ انتء حال ئے میر صاحب خیریت ئے طبیعت سیٹ ئے مہربانی۔ نم بڑو رے؟ شکر اللہ نا احسان ئے نم جوڑ رے؟ خیریت ئے الحمدللہ۔ نم بڑو سیٹ ٹھاک او؟ میر صاحب خیر اٹ فون کریس ننے خوافیس۔ شاباز ئے نی ہنا خاطر آ۔
en: Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace. — How are you, Mir Sahib? Is all well, is your health fine? — Thank you. Are you well? — Thanks, it's God's grace. Are you well? — All is well, praise God. Are you well, all fine? — Mir Sahib, I hope all is well — you phoned and called us? — Bravo, [it's] for [...] sake.
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam. How are you, Mir Sahib? Is all well, is your health fine? Thank you. Are you well? Thank God, by God's grace. Are you all well? All is well, praise be to God. Are you fine and well? Mir Sahib, all good that you called us and invited us? Well done for my sake.

brh: خوار فٹ کہ میر ہمت خان آستہ بندغہ کہ بگا خان آستہ موٹرسائیکلے پلانو۔ نی ہن ہمت خانئے پا کہ گنیا برے کنتو ہیت گپ ئس کے اچھا، جی ہا، سئیں فون آن تے پاپیسٹ، کنتو اوفتا نمبر افس
en: I called [you] because Mir Himmat Khan's men have robbed Bagga Khan's motorcycle. You go and tell Himmat Khan to come to me and have a talk with me. — All right, yes. — Sir, won't you tell them by phone? — I don't have their number.
en_old: I wanted to say that Mir Himmat Khan's men stole Bagga Khan's motorcycle. You go and tell Himmat Khan to come here and talk with me. Okay, yes. Sir, can't you tell them by phone? I don't have their number.

brh: بس او جی ہا چلو ٹھیک ہی گڑا کاہن پاہن ٹھیک ہی با صحیح جی ہا لال محمد بشہ کاہن
en: That's it. — Yes, sir. — Come on, fine then, let's go and tell [him]. — Fine, all right, yes. — Lal Muhammad, get up, let's go.
en_old: Just that, yes, okay fine, then go and tell him. Fine, alright, yes. Lal Muhammad, go.

brh: اسلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام ئے بہادر خان جوڑ تگڑا چٹ صحت
en: Peace be upon you. — And upon you be peace, Bahadur Khan. Are you well, strong, in full health?
en_old: Assalamu alaikum. Wa alaikum assalam, Bahadur Khan, are you well, strong and in full health?

brh: شاباس خان خیرل بسنس بہادر خان کنے میر آدم خان راہی کرینے دا پارے کہ نی ہن میر ہمت خانے پا کنے ئس گبرے کنے
en: Bravo, Khan, welcome. Bahadur Khan, Mir Adam Khan has sent me and said this: you go and tell Mir Himmat Khan to come to me.
en_old: Well done, Khan, welcome. Bahadur Khan, Mir Adam Khan has sent me and said: you go and tell Mir Himmat Khan to come to me.

brh: نور خان، آن شاء اللہ سنگت دیر اٹی بر۔
en: Noor Khan, God willing, friend, come [back] in a while.
en_old: Noor Khan, inshallah, friend, come soon.

brh: بابا سے روپئی سمتے فون آ ٹھیک ہی ٹھیک ہی خلتا نی آ پین ہیتھ بمپرا ایرا گھنٹہ ڈیرا گھنٹہ دہ کروڑے سوس ٹھیک ہی ہتہ ویس لاشے در مارنا دے پین ہیتھو
en: Father, a rupee... [unclear] on the phone. Okay, okay... [unclear] I won't listen to another word from you. Two hours, an hour and a half. Ten crore... okay, bring it, or take your son's body; no other talk.
en_old: Father, about the money: on the phone, okay, okay, and then the other thing... an hour, an hour and a half... ten crore... okay... the son's body... another thing.

brh: جوان اللہ حافظ۔ سب خیر اینو مس۔ کنا مارے اغوا کرینو درینو۔ نا بابا؟ جی آ۔ ہو جی جی۔ ہیرو ہیرو فون
en: Okay, goodbye. Everything was fine, and today this happened: they have kidnapped my son and taken him away. Your father? Yes. Yes, yes. Hello, hello, the phone...
en_old: Okay, goodbye. Is everything all right today? They've kidnapped my son. Your father? Yes. Yes, yes. Hello, hello, the phone.

brh: خبر اف ددا سرا خبر تکا دیر او ہنا تو بعد ٹی معلومات مریک او پارے کہ کنے اغوا نا پیسہ تا ایتبو ئے پاریٹ بابا ننتو پیسہ اف
en: There's no news; we don't know who they are. We'll find out after that. And he said, 'Give me the kidnapping money.' I said, 'Baba, we don't have any money.'
en_old: There's no news of who took him. Later we'll find out. He said, 'Give the ransom money for the kidnapping.' I said, 'Father, we have no money.'

brh: جی آ فرسٹ پرائز پوا او پارہ دس کروڑ روپیہ توبو دس کروڑ جی آ برا صبر مریک بس اللہ جوان کے پٹین تا واللہ اولاد اینہ لاخس ایلو ہچ کپور ہچ سوپو برار براس مچو مچو لیکن
en: Yes, first prize [unclear], and they say: give ten crore rupees. Ten crore, yes. Brother, have patience. God will make it right; let's search for them. By God, children [unclear]... the other won't do anything, nothing [unclear]... brother, brother, just a little, a little, but...
en_old: Yes, he won first prize. He says he'll give ten crore rupees. Ten crore, yes. Brother, be patient. May God make it right. By God, children... nothing else... but...

brh: امریکہ نا آصف بندغ ئس درینو ہفتہ پیسہ ایتن ولا پھگا پینس دیرا ہرار مارنا نن پیسہ ایتن اللہ خیر کے واہ میر بہا ہن پارے فی الحال تو بلو ہیتہ کرے کک ٹھیک ہی عاطف بہا پیسہ
en: They have taken a man, Asif from America. 'We'll pay the money within a week, by God; otherwise [unclear]...' We'll pay the money for the son; may God make it well. Bravo, Mir, brother! He said, 'For now he has made big talk.' Okay, Atif brother, the money...
en_old: They've taken a man called Asif from America. 'Pay the money within a week, or else...' We'll pay the money for the son. May God bless. Wow, Mir, brother. He said that for now he's talking big. Okay, Atif brother, the money.

brh: دا اسکان دوپئی ئے ہچو پیسہ تفرہ۔ میر دا پیسہ تفک دانا مارے خسفن۔ فی الحال صبر۔ دا زدا مارے ہمو جنگل اسیا دبو ہمو۔ او میر ڈٹھو ٹال اسو۔ ہمو ایلا کٹے سوغو تھبو ارا گھنٹڑی پیسہ ہیس۔
en: Until now I won't give a penny, no money at all. If the Mir won't give this money, we'll kill his son. For now, patience. Take this son quickly to some jungle there. And the Mir [unclear: is stubborn/stalling]. Keep him there [unclear] until the moment he brings the money.
en_old: So far they haven't paid any money. If the Mir doesn't pay this money, they'll kill his son. For now, patience. They've taken his son into some jungle. And the Mir... they'll keep him there for hours until they get the money.

brh: او مارتا واپس کین ٹھیک ہی ہتہ دکھے تہ خلکو ہسکو جی دادے دانا بوگی تاتل ماتل کرے ہتتہ بس چپنی ہستے پا کباب کباب خراب پورہ ایتہ پیسہ تہ کرے دانا باوا کشینے
en: And we'll return their son, okay. [unclear] they struck... yes, him, his [unclear] they messed up... just [unclear]... the kebab, the kebab is spoiled. Give the full money... his father has pulled it out [unclear].
en_old: And they'll return the son, okay... They beat him and messed up his... just... kebab, the kebab got spoiled... give the full money... his father has been killed.

brh: واہ میرو واہ خوش مریش اگر نی ہننو ہماشے کہ ڈیڈا کے ہتیس تو نا تو زندگی جوڑ مرے ئے نم کے جوان او کاریم کے وئی نم ہندا پاوہ کہ بھلا بندہ ہندا بو دہ کروڑ ہربو بیس کروڑ ہربو دورو کاریم کبو
en: Bravo, Mir, bravo, may you be happy! If you go there and bring him, then your life will be made. He'll do well by you and do the work. We just tell you this: a big man should be like this — take ten crore, take twenty crore, do [big] work.
en_old: Wow, Mir, wow, you'll be happy. If you go there and bring him, your life will be made. Do good work for us. We just say that a big man should be like this: taking ten crore, taking twenty crore, doing big work.

brh: دا غریبئے دیرے بریرے اوڑا ٹیٹر کننگ کے اف اوڑان انت ارینو ہندا کاریم تے کبو ایلم تو سلوک ئے ٹھیک ئے میر کس سے آ خلیفہ او بھلا تے چٹ کبو بھلا کنے جوان کے
en: Who are you to come at this poor man? There's no [unclear] to be done to him; what has he got? Do these jobs; behave properly toward the brother. Mir, to someone [unclear] khalifa, and finish off the big ones. Big man, do right by me.
en_old: Who is this poor man, coming and going? There's no point teasing him. What does he even have? He does these jobs. Brother, his behaviour is fine. Mir... the elders... Elder, make things right for me.

brh: بہادر خان مار کونا خدمت ء کننگ ارے؟ میر مار کونا فکر ء الے نی نی دا حوال ء ایت کہ امر کنے امل پیسہ تیک؟ اللہ خیر کے جوانک مریک پیسہ تو ہلینہ ہیت اسے۔
en: Bahadur Khan, is my son being looked after? Mir, don't worry about the son. You just tell me this: how will he give me the money? God willing, it will turn out well. As for the money, we'll get it; that's a separate matter.
en_old: Bahadur Khan, is anyone looking after my son? Mir, don't worry about my son. You just tell me how they will give me the money. May God bless, it will turn out well. As for the money, we'll take care of that.

brh: مارے مطلب جوان خیال اٹ تخیرے مارے کسو لشکر خان نا ڈیوٹی او کنے گٹی کے تخیرے ہاؤ اونا خیال اٹ کیرے پیسہ بھاز مرے پیسہ نا چورتی خلپیرے پیسہ گنج مرے فی الحال میر آدم خان مننگٹی تو اف
en: Keep the son — I mean — in good care. The son is Lashkar Khan's duty, and [unclear] keep... Yes, take care of him. There'll be plenty of money; don't worry about the money; the money will be plentiful. For now, Mir Adam Khan isn't agreeing.
en_old: Take good care of the son. The son is Lashkar Khan's duty, and keep me tied up. Yes, take care of him. There'll be a lot of money, don't steal any of it, the money will be found. For now, Mir Adam Khan isn't available.

brh: بھر حال کوشش کینہ انشاءاللہ گنج مرے ہمو پانے گٹی میر؟ میر آدو خان فی الحال مننگ اٹی اف تائیت۔ میر گڑا چاوے کہ نادو خان نا ہم گھاٹم کائ۔ تو بھر حال اللہ خیر کے ہرینہ ولدا۔
en: Anyway, we'll try; God willing, it will work out plentifully. [unclear], Mir? Mir Adam Khan isn't accepting their terms for now. Then, Mir, I know that your Adam Khan's head will also roll. So anyway, may God make it well; we'll see again.
en_old: Anyway, we'll try. God willing, it will be found. What is that, Mir? Mir Adam Khan isn't available at the moment. Then the Mir knows that Nadu Khan also... So anyway, may God bless. We'll see again.

brh: ئے میر آدم خان نا پوزیشن اٹ یا مار نا کاٹم کا یا پیسہ ایتک بے فکر او پیسہ باز مرے ٹھیک ئے میر حوصلہ تو باز تسس ننے
en: Mir Adam Khan is in a position where either his son's head goes or he pays the money. Don't worry, the money will be plentiful. Alright, Mir, you've given us a lot of courage.
en_old: In Mir Adam Khan's position, either it falls on the son's head or he pays the money. Don't worry, there'll be plenty of money. Okay, Mir, you've given us a lot of courage.

brh: ننا آواز خئے اللہ خیر کے
en: Our voice [unclear]... may God make it well.
en_old: Our voice... may God bless.

brh: ادا لمار کوئی درینو اسحاق کے درینو نجلہ کپیسے نتے نتا تے فنس فنس پیسا خوائے گٹیو پیسا ایدے تن میر علی جان خان کنے گڑاس خبر استو تو ئے گڑاس کیون کنے تو داسکان ہچ خبر اف
en: Here someone has taken the son; they've taken Ishaq. [unclear]... they want money; [they say] give the money. Mir Ali Jan Khan, if you have any news for me, then do something for me; I have had no news at all so far.
en_old: Here they've taken my son, they've taken Ishaq... they want money... give the money. Mir Ali Jan Khan, if you have any news, tell me. So far I have no news at all.

brh: نی ہنا خبر مرے ئے پیسہ روپئی سوم تفرہ باقی اگر کنا مارے خلے ریتے را تو ئے لاش ہلنگ کے تیار اوٹ۔ نی کنے استا نمبر آ تیدا ہتی ئے پیسہ ایتے و ہتی۔ ئے لم کنا ہیتے بن پیسہ نا نی ایتے سا نا ئے ایتے وا پیسہ۔
en: You'll get word of it: I won't give the money, not a rupee. As for the rest, if they kill my son [unclear], then I'm ready to collect his body. You... me... the number [unclear]... I give the money [unclear]. Mother, listen to my words: neither will you give the money, nor will I give the money.
en_old: You'll find out. They haven't paid the money. As for the rest, if they kill my son, I'm ready to collect the body. Give me the number; whoever pays the money... listen to my words, pay the money.

brh: ایسا تننگ نا ہچ ضرورت اف۔ تو ٹھیک ہی گڑا بشا ما کان میر ہمت خان آ کان۔ ٹھیک ہی ہنا ئے تینا سہی ہی کان میر ی ہورین کہ انت پائیک۔ بشا ابا گڑا کان۔ بر ابا
en: There's no need at all to give it like that. Okay then, get up, let's go; let's go to Mir Himmat Khan. Okay, I'll [go] myself, right; let's go to the Mir and see what he says. Get up, father, let's go then. Come, father.
en_old: There's no need to give it like that. Okay then, let's go to Mir Himmat Khan. Okay, let's go and see what he says. Come on, father, let's go. Come, father.

brh: دعا خیر کرین اوئے میر صاحب ئے خراس ئس دزات ہمودے پنجاہ ہزارے سودا کرے نیک ہیسٹ پنجاہ ہزار دعا خیر کریس میر
en: Let's say a prayer of blessing. Oh, Mir Sahib, I stole an ox; that same day I sold it for fifty thousand. Good, I brought back fifty thousand. Say a blessing prayer, Mir.
en_old: Pray for good. Oh, Mir sahib got a donkey that day and sold it for fifty thousand. Good, I got fifty thousand. Pray for good, Mir.

brh: او صاحب ئے اینو بھلو کاریم ئس کرینٹ اینا ڈیر کو باری مخالف قرار تسنے بھلو کاری مسنے دا اینو جھنڈا کے کھڈے تک ہسانے پنج لکھ روپیہ سوجی تے ئے پاٹ اینو ننا امیر نا کاریم ئس
en: Oh sir, today I've done a great job: [unclear] has been declared an opponent. A great deed has been done. Today this one has burned [unclear] down to the pit; five lakh rupees' worth burned [unclear]. Today, a job for our leader.
en_old: Oh sir, today we did a big job. He has been declared an opponent. It has been a big job. Today the flag has been raised... five lakh rupees... today a job of our leader.

brh: داہم جوانو کاری گو، نی امر ہریس؟ داہم جوانو کاری گو، نی امر ہریس؟ میر صاحب نا اینو دا اوچت دزا، ستر ہزار آ سودا اٹ نی مبارک بائے۔ داہم جوانو کاری گو، نی انتس ہریس؟
en: This too is a good deed; what do you think? This too is a good deed; what do you think? Today this one of Mir Sahib's stole a camel(?); congratulations to you on the sale at seventy thousand. This too is a good deed; what do you think?
en_old: This is also a good deal. What do you think? This is also a good deal. What do you think? Mir sahib got this unexpectedly today. Congratulations to you on the deal at seventy thousand. This is also a good deal. What do you think?

brh: ئے ریلے پٹ اٹ نی انتس کرینوس؟ سائیں بلہ سینا چنٹی تو زہ لک روپیہ سوڑی تے، کھلی تا نی گھیسوڑی تے، باز غلطو کاریم ئس کرینوس، دا کاریم نوا کرے وڑنگٹ ئے افس، اینو مستو کاریم اٹ کہ انتہ نیاڑی نا ہڑکا ہنپیرے
en: What have you done in that [unclear]? Sir, Bala [unclear]... you burned(?) [ten] lakh rupees, you [unclear]... You have done a very wrong thing; this deed of yours is not fitting. Today, in this [unclear] deed, why don't you go to the woman's [unclear]?
en_old: What have you done in this matter? Sir, on father's chest... you burned a lakh rupees, you wasted... you did a very wrong thing. This deed doesn't suit you. Today, in this drunken act, why don't you go to the woman's side?

brh: او کنے غریب آتیا مچ سلیرے میر صاحب دا ہرا ہیت کسے او ہندا ہیت آک نی چنچو کہ لکھ روپیہ مسنے بلہ سینہ اسل کہ کروڑ آتہ بلہ سینہ بلہ نا نیاڑی نا خلق آ اینو یاف ننے بلہ ملہ تو کار اف پیسہ تو کار اف ننے ئے پینجا وار پارے نو ولدا کنے دا ہیت کرے نی
en: And all of you stand with me, with the poor, Mir Sahib. What kind of talk is this? And these words of yours, that it came to a lakh rupees; actually it's crores... to the village of Bala's wife... Today we don't need Bala or anyone; we don't need money. I have told [you] fifty times, and still you said this to me again.
en_old: He has gathered all the poor against me, Mir Sahib. The thing you say, these words of yours... it has become a lakh rupees; on father's chest, in fact crores... In the village of father's wife, today we don't need father, we don't need money. He told us five times, and then again you said this to me.

brh: خیر عافیت نا واہ ئے ننا دوتے یکا تفینٹ تورینٹ دا جوانو کاریم کتے ویری بلے پھلا نورے ئس کنا پچرا سلیفے اسہ سے گولی خلینونے میر دانت کننگٹی ئس ہڑدے برکھ دا اسہ ننتو پریشانی سے اینو پد ننا ننا کسر جدائی ضرورت اف پیش تمن بوتا
en: Wow, so much for well-being! I have kept our hands tied and held back; this was not a good thing you did. The enemy(?) [unclear] set someone up behind me and fired a bullet or so. Mir, what is this you are doing? Every day [unclear]... This is a trouble for us. From today on our paths are separate; there's no need; we're leaving [unclear].
en_old: Thank God for the well-being. You tied our hands and broke them; this was not a good deed. The enemy... shot at my back, fired one or two bullets. Mir, what is this you are doing... This is a trouble for us. From today on our paths are separate; there is no need, go ahead.

brh: فرسٹ اف آل، صبر کر، کلے نا ماسہ سے گولی خنیوہ، فرسٹ اف آل، لیسگو، ضمیر، نی ہم کنے اوڑ گاڑیک، چلو کنا ماسہ، نی ہم اینا، ہمبو!
en: First of all, be patient; [unclear] a bullet, I'll see. First of all, let's go, Zameer. You too, [get] me [into] his car(?). Come on, beside me. You too, here. Go!
en_old: First of all, be patient, I'll see about a bullet. First of all, let's go, Zameer, you too take me along. Come on, my uncle, you too come here, let's go!

brh: السلام علیکم میر صاحب خیریت ہی وعلیکم السلام مراد خان ٹھیک ٹھاک؟
en: Peace be upon you, Mir Sahib, is all well? And upon you peace, Murad Khan; are you fine and well?
en_old: Peace be upon you, Mir Sahib, is all well? And peace be upon you, Murad Khan, are you fine and well?

brh: میر واجہ پی خیرے؟ میر خوش بیدا؟ واجہ نوجوان ئے صحت سئی ئے پی خیرے؟ ٹھیک ٹھاک؟ خوش بیدا؟ پی خیرے؟ مرتضی صاحب وڑس خیریت ئے ٹھیک ٹھاک پی خیرے؟ سنگت آ پی خیرے؟ ٹھیک ٹھاک خوش بیدا پی خیرے؟ اللہ نا احسان ئے
en: Mir, sir, is all well? Mir, are you happy? Sir, is the young man in good health, is all well? Fine and well? Happy? All well? Murtaza Sahib, is everything well in every way, fine, all well? Are the friends well? Fine, happy, all well? It's God's grace.
en_old: Mir, sir, how are you? Mir, are you well? Sir, is the young man healthy, how are you? All fine? Well? Murtaza sahib, is everything fine? How's the friend? Fine and well? Thanks be to God.

brh: جی میر علی جاہ تیرا خیر نا احوال اتس۔ بابا لتس جی۔ خیریت اٹی میر صاحب نا بسورون اٹی او؟ جی۔ اللہ تنے مارے کرے آباد کرے نا۔ جی۔ ننا مدد آتے کرک۔
en: Yes, Mir Ali Jah, give us your news of well-being. Baba [unclear], yes. Is all well? Are all well at Mir Sahib's [home]? Yes. May God keep your son and keep you prosperous. Yes. He helps us.
en_old: Yes, Mir Ali Jah, how are you? Baba, yes. Is all well at Mir Sahib's home? Yes. May God keep your son and keep you prosperous. Yes. He helps us.

brh: جی میر صاحب نما سلام آ، پین احوال آ، خیر آ، خدا خیر کے، پین خیر، خوش مرے، خیر تکڑا، پین خیر، خوش مرے، خیر تکڑا، خیر تکڑا، جی میر صاحب نما احوال، خیر احوال، حال احوال تا خواجہ سے، حال احوال تا خواجہ سے، ہندا حوال
en: Yes, Mir Sahib, greetings to you; and other news? All well? May God keep it well; otherwise all well, be happy, well and healthy; otherwise well, be happy, well and healthy, well and healthy. Yes, Mir Sahib, your news: news of well-being; a master of exchanging news, a master of exchanging news. That's the news.
en_old: Yes, Mir Sahib, peace to you, and how are things? All well, may God keep it well, all good, be happy, well and strong, all good, be happy, well and strong, well and strong. Yes, Mir Sahib, how are you? All is well; you're the master of asking after people, the master of asking after people. That's the news.

brh: اللہ اللہ کنے ہندا نما حال احوالے دبو تسا تولوک اسرے اللہ نمے ہیس نما سلامت تخے خیر جوڑ تکڑا خوش ٹھیک ٹھاک درست صاحب درست سہی ہی بلکل خیر تکڑا خوش خیر خیر مہربانی شکریہ
en: God, God, give me your news like this; you were sitting [unclear]. God brought you; may He keep you safe. All well, good, healthy, happy, fine, right, sir, right, correct, absolutely, well and healthy, happy, well, well; kind of you, thanks.
en_old: God, God, just give me your news... May God keep you and yours safe. All well, strong, happy, fine, alright sir, alright, yes, absolutely, well and strong, happy, well, well, thank you, thanks.

brh: میر علی جان، جی، میر آدم خان مار کینا ننے، جی، نن سوس کہ او بندغ دوئی او، لیکن تا نامہربانی نا خاطر آن نن کوشش کینا، نن
en: Mir Ali Jan, yes; Mir Adam Khan, the son [unclear] us. Yes. We knew that that man is two-faced(?), but for the sake of your kindness we'll try, we...
en_old: Mir Ali Jan, yes, Mir Adam Khan is our son, yes. We knew that the man was double-dealing, but for the sake of your unkindness we are trying, we...

brh: بہادر خان، کنے اجازت ئے اللہ مدد نی کنے اجازت دیس ہمت خان نا پاس کہ اعظم خان نی تینا جائیداد پاک کے۔ ٹھیک ہی خدا حافظ۔ ڈیرے لو، ڈیرے لو، ڈیرے لو۔
en: Bahadur Khan, give me leave. God help you. You give me leave [to go] to Himmat Khan [and tell him] that, Azam Khan, you clear your property. All right then, goodbye. [unclear: 'dere lo', said three times]
en_old: Bahadur Khan, I have permission, God willing you give me permission to go to Himmat Khan, so that Azam Khan, you clear your property. Alright then, goodbye. Take it, take it, take it.

brh: بابا جی صاحب لشکر ہمینگ نا لشکر تیار سلوک صاحب
en: Baba ji sahib, the army, that one's army, is ready and standing by, sahib.
en_old: Baba ji sir, Lashkar, this same Lashkar is ready, sir.

brh: میر ہمت خان اینے ہنا خاطر آ داڑے خوارفت تکلیف تسوٹ نہ بندغاک بگا خانہ موٹر سائیکل خلانو ہنا دے کنے واپس کرفت میر آدم خان کنے خدا گنج تسونی
en: Mir Himmat Khan, I called you here for this reason, and I'm sorry to have troubled you: men took Bagga Khan's motorcycle; that day [it was] returned to me [unclear]. Mir Adam Khan: God has given me a treasure.
en_old: Mir Himmat Khan, I came here for that reason, I bothered you to call them, the men took the motorcycle from Bagga's house, you returned it to me that day. Mir Adam Khan, you gave me a treasure from God.

brh: ایرے گری موٹر سائیکلا پرواہ اف، اسہ موٹر سائیکلا ننے بیس موٹر سائیکل نیتے او۔ میر ہمت۔
en: Never mind the motorcycle, it doesn't matter; for one motorcycle we [can give] you twenty motorcycles. Mir Himmat.
en_old: We don't care about one motorcycle; for one motorcycle we'll give you twenty motorcycles. Mir Himmat.

brh: او خان، اگر نا بندغاک موٹر سائیکل ء پلتنو تو نی پین جاگہ سے آن ہنپہ، داڑے پٹ، عیب کرے اخس کہ پیسہ خوار ء ئے تیوا۔ صاحب، ئے پین دا کاریم ء کرے رونٹ کپروا، میر اعظم خان۔
en: O Khan, if your men didn't snatch the motorcycle, then don't go anywhere else; search here. It's a shame. However much money gets wasted, I'll pay it. Sahib, he has done this thing again, [unclear], Mir Azam Khan.
en_old: O Khan, if your men have stolen the motorcycle, then don't go anywhere else, search here. It's a disgrace, however much money it takes. Sir, he did this deed again, he won't let it go, Mir Azam Khan.

brh: کنے انت ضرورت ئے اونا موٹر سائیکل ء پٹے
en: What need do I have to search for his motorcycle?
en_old: What need do I have to search for his motorcycle?

brh: ئے سا ونت کرے استمو اسکوٹر اٹ۔ بگہ خان ئے میر ہمت خان استے
en: He [unclear] on a scooter. Bagga Khan is Mir Himmat Khan's [man].
en_old: He did ... on a scooter. Bagga Khan is Mir Himmat Khan's man.

brh: داڑے خوائف تے نا بیٹھک آ، ایف تے ہنا ہیت گپ خلق و لیکن، ئے کنا ہیت ء منے پسا، ئے تینے باز بڑزا خسیرہ، ماشاءاللہ، ننا ہم اللہ ئے ٹھیک ئے اللہ جوان کیک آن شاء اللہ۔
en: I called them here, to your guesthouse, and we discussed that matter, but they don't accept what I say; they think very highly of themselves. Mashallah, we have God too. It's fine; God will make it right, God willing.
en_old: Here at the guesthouse, they were talking about it, but they don't accept what I say, they think too highly of themselves. Mashallah, God is with us too, it's fine, God will make it right, God willing.

brh: ہاؤ میر صاحب کنا موٹر سائیکل ء پل اٹ دز اٹ۔ دے پل اٹ؟ میر صاحب چاوتہ بس پنی تا لنک اف میر صاحب۔ اچھا۔
en: Yes, Mir sahib, my motorcycle was snatched, stolen. When was it snatched? Mir sahib, you know, I just have no connection with the notorious ones, Mir sahib. I see.
en_old: Yes Mir sahib, my motorcycle was stolen, stolen by thieves. Stolen when? Mir sahib, just yesterday. There is no trace of it, Mir sahib. Okay.

brh: دا سدا پنی ظالم گپیس جی او میر صاحب ظالم بندہ کو نی چاوا لشکو ہنتس نہ میر صاحب ئے دیپر ہنتٹ دا سنی راہی کے او لشکوء سدا ہن لشکوء مڑی ناموس ء دے ریموٹ سائیکل ء واپس کے
en: This really is a notoriously cruel business. Yes, O Mir sahib, a cruel man. Do you know Lashko? Haven't you gone [to him]? Mir sahib, I don't know [him]; I haven't gone. Now I'll send you to Lashko. Go straight to Lashko; [for honour's sake, unclear] he will return the motorcycle.
en_old: This is truly a cruel matter. Yes, Mir sahib, a cruel man. Do you know Lashkar? Go, Mir sahib, I'll go tomorrow. Send him to Lashkar right away; go straight to Lashkar, for the sake of honor, so he returns the motorcycle.

brh: ٹھیک ہی وکیل صاحب، ہا باز باز نا مہربانی، سدھا لشکو وائے، خیر لگنا کے وکیل صاحب! سدھان برو ئے لشکو وائے، وئی لشکو وائے، حال احوال اسک؟ لشکو، بندوبست اٹ کے؟
en: All right, lawyer sahib, yes, many, many thanks. Straight to Lashko, then. May it go well, lawyer sahib! [I'll] come straight. Hey Lashko! Oh, Lashko! How are things? Lashko, have you made the arrangements?
en_old: Alright, lawyer sahib, yes, thank you very, very much. Go straight to Lashkar. Lawyer sahib, may it go well! Come straight, it's Lashkar, oh Lashkar, how are you? Lashkar, have you made the arrangements?

brh: ہلو دوستو! السلام علیکم! ہندا دا پوسکونو فریاد ئس بسونے، ہندا دا
en: Hello friends! Peace be upon you! Here, a new complaint has come in. Here it is.
en_old: Hello friends! Peace be upon you! A new complaint has come in, here it is.

brh: او بندہ بش مس کہ، ہاؤ ہاؤ، او سوبار بندہ ہیت کرے کہ، جی جی، ہا جوانو ہیت اسے، واللہ جوانو ہیت اسے
en: That man stood up and, yes, yes, that [unclear] man said that... Yes, yes. Yes, that's a good point; by God, that's a good point.
en_old: That man was pleased, yes, yes, and the man spoke well. Yes, yes, that is a good point, by God, that is a good point.

brh: ننا اوڑکا باز باز کین کرے سلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام لشکر خان نیوز لشکر خان
en: [unclear] did a great deal for us. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Lashkar Khan News, Lashkar Khan.
en_old: He greeted us very warmly. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Lashkar Khan News, Lashkar Khan.

brh: خان ئے اوٹ کنا سا تم دکا ایلم کنے میر صاحب راہی کرے کنا موٹرسائیکل ئے دزانو اچھا جی او نی راہی کرے کنے راہی کرے نی نی لشکر خان ئے جی او صحیح لشکر خان کنا پن ئے چنو جی سر ہمو کے خلوات
en: [unclear] Khan... my dear... brother, Mir sahib sent me; they've stolen my motorcycle. I see, yes, so he sent you? He sent me. You, you are Lashkar Khan? Yes, right, Lashkar Khan is my name. Chano! Yes, sir. Do the usual [unclear].
en_old: Khan, my brother was in the shop. Mir sahib sent me; my motorcycle has been stolen. Okay, yes, he sent you. He sent me. You, you are Lashkar Khan? Yes, right, Lashkar Khan is my name. Yes sir, do that.

brh: تتا دلس گلاس ء۔ جی او۔ ایلم دا دلس ء کنتل اٹ۔ برا کنے نا مائدہ ء ٹھنڈا کک کنا سنگت۔ نی دا گلاس ء نی کنوئی ء دا نا مائدہ ء ٹھنڈا کک نا موٹرسائیکل مسٹ ء ٹی استے وائے۔ ایلم بس کنا موٹرسائیکل نا کھرک کٹ۔ نی غم کپہ کنا سنگت۔ لشکر خان کنا پ۔
en: Bring a glass of thadal. Yes. Brother, I haven't drunk this thadal. Come, it cools your stomach, my friend. You must drink this glass; it cools your stomach. Your motorcycle is in [my] fist. Brother, it's just my motorcycle [I'm worried about]. Don't you worry, my friend. Lashkar Khan is my name.
en_old: Give him a glass of yogurt drink. Yes. Brother, I drank this yogurt drink. Come, it cools my stomach, my friend. You drink this glass, it cools your stomach; your motorcycle is in my hands. Brother, it's just that my motorcycle is worrying me. Don't worry, my friend. Lashkar Khan is my name.

brh: آتے نا پین، نصیلو موٹرسائیکل مائی کیس لو، بس پگہ برے سر، خدا حافظ
en: What's your name? Naseelo. The motorcycle, [unclear: 'my case']. Just come tomorrow, sir. Goodbye.
en_old: Take the rest, your motorcycle is in my hands. Just come tomorrow, sir. Goodbye.

brh: ثمینے جی سر یار خلاص جی ہاؤ خلاص بس پین موٹر سائیکل امیر کنے رائی کرے نی لشکر خان آ واللہ ام بریک کک دا پگا بس پگا نا تے تسس تے گلاس تسس تے سلو دے موٹر سائیکل ئے مست آن درو جی ہاؤ جی ہاؤ
en: Samine! Yes, sir. Friend, is it done? Yes, yes, done. Just, another motorcycle: the Mir sent [someone] to me, to you, Lashkar Khan. By God, [unclear] this 'tomorrow', just 'tomorrow'. You gave them, you gave them the glass... [unclear] he will take the motorcycle from [unclear]. Yes, yes, yes, yes.
en_old: Samina, yes sir, friend, it's done. Yes, done. Just another motorcycle, the Mir sent me to you, Lashkar. By God, I'll bring it tomorrow, just tomorrow. You gave the glass; tomorrow the motorcycle will be brought out in front of you. Yes, yes, yes.

brh: میرن یاد کرو کہ لشکر خان تون کین تو کاریم کننگے، ہمت کر زیبا گڈا تا، تیار تیار تیار انشاءاللہ
en: The Mir will remember that with Lashkar Khan the job gets done. Make an effort, nicely, then: ready, ready, ready, God willing.
en_old: The Mir will remember that working with Lashkar Khan gets the job done. Take courage, after that, ready, ready, ready, God willing.

brh: او خان چاو رے کٹوم چاو سے خبراں توسے ماما جی شاباش خاوری کٹوم برے
en: Oh Khan, [garbled]... news... Uncle, well done, [garbled]... come.
en_old: Oh Khan... the news... uncle, well done... come.

brh: السلام علیکم وعلیکم السلام وعلیکم السلام واجہ صاحب خیر جوڑ بخت تکڑا سے خوش من خیر جوڑ طبیعت سے خوش ماما جوڑ تکڑا سے خوش واجہ بشام صاحب دا خبر خیر ئے دا خبر میر صاحب ننے امر خواری
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. And upon you be peace. Sir, are you well and in good health, fortunate, strong and happy? Well and healthy, in good spirits and happy. Uncle, are you healthy, strong and happy? Sir Basham, is the news good? The news, Mir sahib: why have you summoned us?
en_old: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. And upon you be peace. Sir, is all well? Good, fortunate, strong and happy. All well, in good health and happy. Uncle, well, strong and happy. Sir Basham, is this news good? This news, Mir sahib, how are we?

brh: خواجہ فیس ہم یاد کرے سینوں۔ ئے نی اینو ہندن خواجہ فیس۔ ہا۔ کنا است ہندن خوش مس۔ اچھا۔ کہ شاباش خان۔ اچھا۔ کنا اگر نی سالو مریس۔ تو واہ واہ۔ ہاں۔
en: Khwaja Fees also remembered [you]. You are just like Khwaja Fees today. Yes. My heart became so happy. I see. That [he said], 'well done, Khan.' I see. If you became my brother-in-law, then wow, wow! Yes.
en_old: He also remembered Khwaja Fees. Today you are just like Khwaja Fees. Yes. My heart was so happy. Okay. Well done, Khan. Okay. If you were mine... then wow, wow. Yes.

brh: ماما اور کنے دے پاتاوٹ نی جی شہباز خان نا ورنا چنا سے بالکل سہی او دے سلام کیو بالکل دا باز جوان ہیت اسے بہادر خان باز بندہ سے جوان ئے
en: Uncle, didn't I tell [you]? You are Shahbaz Khan's young son. Absolutely right. I salute him. Absolutely, that is a very good thing; Bahadur Khan is a very good man.
en_old: Uncle, they told me that you are the young son of Shahbaz Khan. Absolutely right, I greet him. Absolutely, that is a very good thing. Bahadur Khan is a very good man.

brh: او کنا دودو
en: Oh, my Dodo!
en_old: Oh, my Dodo.

brh: نم ہت کبو دے با۔ تیار کبو دے۔ السلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ بسس کنا سا؟ جی او ایلم بسٹ کنا مکرس کنا بس پکا دے نا موٹر سائیکل آ۔ ایلم کوشش کنا کنا سو یقین کنا۔ انشاءاللہ نا موٹر سائیکل نی ملیک۔ چمنی! جی سر۔ گلاس۔
en: Bring it, get it ready, all of you. Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Have you come, my dear? Yes, brother, I've come... [unclear] just the fixed day for your motorcycle. Brother, the effort is mine, I'm a hundred percent sure; God willing, you'll get your motorcycle. Chamni! Yes, sir. A glass.
en_old: Don't touch it. Don't prepare it. Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you. Have you come, my dear? Yes, brother, I came, my... definitely on that motorcycle. Brother, keep trying, my... my belief. God willing, you will get your motorcycle. Chamni! Yes, sir. Glass.

brh: صلوات تھا دل نا یارے جیو ایلو منا گلاس آتے خلپر ئس تھا دل اسو درو زور تسس کنے دانا میدہ ٹھنڈا کیک دانا زندگی ئے جوان کیک دا تھا دل ایلو مسٹ زور ئے دا خل اسے گلاس خلتی یعنی پیلم نی پیندے اسورینت دا نی خلنے
en: Blessings! A friend of thadal, long live! Brother, [unclear] the glasses... A thadal yesterday gave me strength; it cools one's stomach and makes one's life good. This thadal, brother, is intoxicatingly strong. Drink this; down a glass... that is, [unclear]... you drink this.
en_old: Blessings, friend of the heart, long live! Brother, put out my glasses... it gave the heart strength. It cools my stomach and makes life good. This heart, brother, has become strong. This is a drink. Pour a glass, I mean... you drink this.

brh: اسے گلو مس، سکونیان تے یار، ایاتے نی ٹھنڈا مس؟ ہمار مس، سرا اینو برابر مسونے، واہ لشکر خان یاد کروس کن کنے تسس
en: One [glass] is done. Are you relaxed, friend? Have you cooled down? I've calmed down; my head has come right today. Wow, Lashkar Khan, you remembered [me] and gave it to me.
en_old: One became... friends, have you cooled off? It's... my head is fine today. Wow, Lashkar Khan, you remembered and gave it to me.

brh: جمینی! جی سر۔ خبر خناسی یارے؟ جی او سر۔ دا پگہ بسنے؟ جی او۔ موٹر سائیکلے مچ آندرو؟ جی او صحیح پاسے۔ بارو کہ لشکر خان! جی سر۔ گند و انت اللہ کرے دا بند۔ صحیح پاسے بالکل جی او۔
en: Jamini! Yes, sir. Did you see the news, friend? Yes, sir. Has this one come, [the] 'tomorrow' [one]? Yes. Will he take back the whole motorcycle? Yes, you're right. Will he come, Lashkar Khan? Yes, sir. Filth and what not; may God put a stop to this. You're right, absolutely, yes.
en_old: Jamini! Yes, sir. Did you see the news, friend? Yes, sir. Did this come in the morning? Yes. Did you bring the whole motorcycle? Yes, you're right. Come, Lashkar Khan! Yes, sir. It's bad, and what... God has shut this down. You're right, absolutely, yes.

brh: سلام علیکم۔ وعلیکم السلام۔ ایدو، لشکرا خان نا حال؟ لشکر خان اف اینانی میر مات آ۔ مات خان اینانی؟ جی او۔ او؟ جی او۔ زو برے کورے غا؟ سما معلوم اف۔
en: Peace be upon you. And upon you be peace. Hey, how is Lashkar Khan? Lashkar Khan isn't [here]; he has gone to Mir Mat. Mat Khan has gone? Yes. Him? Yes. Will he come back soon, or [unclear]? I have no idea.
en_old: Peace be upon you. And peace be upon you. Hey, how is Lashkar Khan? Lashkar Khan isn't here, he's at Mir Mat's. Mat Khan isn't here? Yes. Him? Yes. Will he come back soon? I don't know.

brh: پگہ برک، پگہ برک، جی او، دا دہ سال ئے پگہ ننا، ننا اف دا لشکر نا تولوک افک، ایلو گپہ سے گلاس سے خلیف ننا یار، اف ایلو ہم دا سے تینے جوڑ کرتنے پگہ بر والا تینے، ایلو ہم گپہ یار اسہ گلاس سے، اف اف دا سہ نا، اف پگہ او، جی او
en: He'll come tomorrow, he'll come tomorrow. Yes. It's been ten years of 'tomorrow' for us, for us... no, this Lashkar isn't one to stay in his seat. Brother, give our friend a glass. No, brother, this one too has made himself the 'come-tomorrow' man. Brother, give the friend a glass too. No, no, [unclear], no. Tomorrow, yes. Yes.
en_old: He'll come tomorrow, he'll come tomorrow. Yes, it's been ten years, tomorrow... he isn't one of Lashkar's regulars. Brother, have a glass, my friend. No, the other one has also made himself out to be the one coming tomorrow. Brother, have a glass too, friend. No, no, this... no, tomorrow, yes. Yes.

brh: او ہلیناں لیکن امیر اعظم فاضل نن الگی گھٹی اف دا جوانو بندہ ئس اف انتئے کہ دا مچ خرین طبیعت اونا مار ہنانے اونا خاطران نہ نا خاطران کوشش کینہ بندہ غاتے سنگت خلانہ تمنہ میر صاحب نا باز مہربانی ئس پارے
en: We will take him, but Amir Azam Fazil, we are not separate ... This is not a good man, because he is completely bitter-natured; his son has gone. Not for his sake, for your sake we are making the effort ... the men ... friends ... "Mir Sahib, many thanks to you," he said.
en_old: He left it, but Amir Azam Fazil, we are not separate; he is not a good man, because this whole bad temper has gone to his son. For his sake, not for yours, we try; we don't make friends with men. Mir Sahib said thank you very much.

brh: انشاء اللہ، بس بندہ خننگا، سمجھ بس، بے فکر مر، ہاؤ صاحب، باز باز مہربانی، مہربانی
en: God willing. Just, the man will be seen to. Understood, that's enough. Don't worry. Yes sir, many, many thanks. Thank you.
en_old: God willing, the man will just see. Understood, don't worry. Yes sir, thank you very much, thank you.

brh: جی میر داسہ تولی نا وخت اف بشبو کہ کان بنداتے ننا نقصان غا بس بشبو کہ کان بس بشبو کہ کان
en: Yes, Mir, now is not the time to sit around. Get up, let's go; the men ... to our harm. Just get up, let's go; just get up, let's go.
en_old: Yes, Mir, now is not the time for sitting. Release them, because the men came to do us harm. Release them, release them.

brh: بہادر! ہاں میر۔ اول نا ننا حساب اسس، ہمو حساب آک ننا نا ختم مسو۔ ہمو میر آدم خان نا مارے واپس کر۔ عزت اٹ یلہ کر۔ میر! تمنو تو خراب اف۔
en: Bahadur! Yes, Mir. Before, there was a score to settle between you and us; those accounts between us and you are finished. Return Mir Adam Khan's son. Release him with honor. Mir! It won't be bad for you.
en_old: Bahadur! Yes, Mir. We had an old account between us; those accounts of ours are settled. Return Mir Adam Khan's son. Release him with honor. Mir! It won't be bad for you.

brh: دا خواری کڑو نی واپس ہم کڑو دا۔ اینے پالنگا جیوٹ یلہ کتو۔ نا میر نا چپ کر۔ نی واپس تیوتے نی زیاتی کیوتے۔ نی کڑاہی جیل پی سے۔ بالکل ہپر دے۔ ہمت خان دا نا عیوض کڑو ہم ارے نی نی کتو جو۔
en: You will go through this misery, and you will give it back too. ... not released alive. Shut up about your Mir! You will give it back; you are overstepping. You'll end up ... in jail. Absolutely ... Himmat Khan, the compensation for this too ... you did it.
en_old: You'll pay for this trouble and you'll give it back. I won't let go of you alive. Shut up about your Mir. You won't return it; you are doing wrong. You'll end up in jail. Absolutely, that day. Himmat Khan, you'll pay for this too; you did it.

brh: دا آدم خان خبرے ونے سمجھا لیتو نہ پیسے راہی کیک نہ کنے او چورانہ حال احوال کیک بہادر خان
en: This Adam Khan ... the matter ... understood; he neither sends money nor asks after me ..., Bahadur Khan.
en_old: This Adam Khan knows and understands; he neither sends money nor asks after me, Bahadur Khan.

brh: خان! نن ہمو بندغاک آن یارا درخت نا کیراں تولینہ، ہمو درخت تے ہم پلینہ، ہمو دم نن معاف کپنہ، گڈو خان ہمے لینہ نن۔ خان! دا پیسہ کم، پل کے دو شا مروڑ۔
en: Khan! We are the people who sit beneath a tree and also rob that same tree; at that moment we do not forgive. Afterwards, Khan, we ... that too. Khan! This money is too little ...
en_old: Khan! We are the people who sit in the shade of a tree and also uproot that same tree; at that moment we don't forgive, Khan, we take it back. Khan! This money is little, give two more.

brh: او باب او جنید لوط ننا مشتے مارا گپ مفن بیا نو گرک ہچاتے تیاری کرک دانا بندوبست کروئی ئے نی فکر کپہ بہادر خان ہنو کہ تاجو نا
en: O Bab, O Junaid, ... so that no talk arises about our son. Come, ... get everything ready; arrangements must be made for this. Don't you worry, Bahadur Khan; we'll go to Tajo's.
en_old: O father, O Junaid, so that our honor isn't spoiled, get ready and prepare everyone; this must be arranged. Don't worry, Bahadur Khan, let's go to Tajo's.

brh: بانگو نا کاٹم اینا کسے دسے دے تتہ، آدو خانہ نا کاٹم ہنو اینو، واہ دوخا واہ، ہرا ہمت کر کچے نا تیاری کر سنگت مچ کر، ٹھیک ہی بس اینک
en: The rooster's head ... today; today Ado Khan's head will go. Wow ... wow! Come on, take courage, get ready for the march, gather all the companions. Okay, yes, just today.
en_old: Bring Bango's head here; Ado Khan's head goes today. Wow, brother, wow! Whoever has courage, get ready, gather your friends. Okay, just come here.

brh: سموتک ہمت خان نا مجال کنے چپل اٹ خلکو اینو چوٹو ہننو تاتی اسکیو کہ اونا نسل یاد کے
en: ... Himmat Khan had the nerve to hit me with a sandal! Today I will go and do something to him that his lineage will remember.
en_old: Damn it, the nerve of Himmat Khan to hit me with a slipper! Today I'll go teach him such a lesson that his whole lineage will remember it.

brh: صاحب تے الیکے دربو! ہمبارنم! چلو! لشکر خان! جی، دا ٹوپیا دیرے سے؟ دامو دے کندھو بنگو ٹک۔ اچھا، ہڑداک سالے؟
en: Take the sahibs ...! ... Let's go! Lashkar Khan! Yes. Who is this one in the cap? ... shoulder ... Okay, all of these, the bastards?
en_old: Bring the sahibs out! Come on! Let's go! Lashkar Khan! Yes, whose hat is this? Put it on his shoulder. Okay, both of them?

brh: بہادر خان دادے انتئے خلکنس دادے دا وڑ آن خلکوٹ کہ اورپ کہ دا کلاشن گولی صحیح خلگے یا خلپک باقی زبردستو نشانہ سے ٹی
en: Bahadur Khan, why have you shot this? I shot it like this to see whether this Kalashnikov fires bullets properly or not; otherwise, it is an excellent shot.
en_old: Bahadur Khan, why did you shoot it? I shot it like that to find out whether this Kalashnikov fires properly or not; otherwise it's a great target.

brh: او لشکر خان! ہیلو! ہا آدم خان!
en: O Lashkar Khan! Hello! Yes, Adam Khan!
en_old: Oh Lashkar Khan! Hello! Yes, Adam Khan!

brh: اودو خان نی جاگہ نا ہیت ء سمجھتوس، دا پیسہ نی مار آن زیات دوست او، تو دا مار تون ہچ کسر نا خبر تمپک نی ہڑدے ہرو، کنے یل کہ۔
en: Odo Khan, you didn't understand the point. This money is dearer to you than your son, so you have no idea at all about this son. Every day you ... Leave me alone.
en_old: Odo Khan, you didn't understand the point. You love this money more than your son, so you don't care about your son at all. You go off every day; leave me alone.

brh: ہاں انت خلاص؟ تیخہ مپاس آتے موڑ برو گٹی تیرا۔ نی ہم انت یاد کروس؟
en: Yes, what, is it over? ... And what will you remember too?
en_old: Yes, what, is it finished? ... What did you remember too?

brh: ادوان ہوریننے اوڑا دا مرے پیسہ غاک باز دوستو تمار نا کاٹمنے کڈے گڑا چپ کیک مار نا پرواہی مپتے برک بہادر خان برک
en: ... to him money has become very dear; ... your head ..., then he keeps quiet; he has no concern for the son. Bahadur Khan is coming, he's coming.
en_old: Since then ... money is very dear to him, he ignores his son and doesn't care about him. Bahadur Khan is coming.

brh: اللہ تو نی جوان کے دا رے ننے فکر اف نما رے کنے فکر اف
en: May God make you well. Here we have no worries; I have no worries about you.
en_old: May God make you well. We have no worry about this; I have no worry about you.

brh: السلام علیکم باوا۔ وعلیکم السلام، شالا صفا خیر۔
en: Peace be upon you, father. And upon you be peace; may all be completely well.
en_old: Peace be upon you, father. And peace be upon you; may all be well.

brh: عباس خان ہمار بسونٹ زلی حاضر خانی دا وجہ ہمار بسونٹ نی خبر ئے کہ نی حاضر خان نا مار اغوا مسونٹ دا وجہ دا وجہ نی ہمار بسونٹ کہ نی معلوم مروڑ ئس
en: Abbas Khan, I have come here ... Hazir Khan; this is the reason I have come. You know that Hazir Khan's son has been kidnapped; that is why, that is why I have come, so that you would know.
en_old: Abbas Khan, I have come with Hazir Khan for this reason. You know that Hazir Khan's son has been kidnapped. That is why I have come, so that you would know.

brh: شاباش ہن، بس اودے جوان کریس، مگر وراٹی کنا، نا عزت ء کیوہ، ئے وخت آ دونو ہیت کن پیزاری، مار تے کہ دوست ماری اغوا مسونی، ایچ بدبخت، بے مکے مچٹ بدبخت
en: Bravo, go! You've just done it well! But ... my ..., I respect you; at such a time, such talk disgusts me. The son, my beloved son, has been kidnapped. You wretch, ... you wretch!
en_old: Well done, go. You just did it well, but ... you respect me. At such a time, such talk... the son who was dear has been kidnapped. You wretch, you shameless wretch!

brh: ئے اگر دیر تٹ، ئے اودے واپس ہتیوٹ، نہ، شہباز خان نہ، بال بدام مف، ماما، جی، بندغ آک ہچ پرواہ سلف، انشاءاللہ، کان تنے مریٹ
en: If I ..., I will bring him back. No, Shahbaz Khan, no ... Uncle, yes, the men ... no worry at all ... God willing ...
en_old: If I'm late, I'll bring him back. No, Shahbaz Khan, no... Uncle, yes. People don't care at all. God willing, I'll be with you.

brh: آدرو خان! اگر نی درینوس تے، تو نی مارے واپس کروئی مریک۔ خاموش ہم! آدرو خان نا مارے گرکپ تونی، اڑا تس داٹی۔ اگر نی تو نی تو نی اود واپس کروئی
en: Adro Khan! If you have taken him, then you must return the son. Be quiet, you too! Adro Khan's son ... where ... in this. If you ..., you ..., you must return him.

Then put the onions there, the onions get a bit crunchy and dry, so spread the onions out flat so they dry well. When the onions have dried, then they crush the onions, they grind them, they add them, or they don't add them. They take them out of the ghee there, then the chicken's... the meat afterwards...

brh: گڑا اوڑےاوطریقہ ولدا ہندن کیرہ سی شاغاس تہ سیت ئے تہ بسیس کشاس نہ گڑا داسا ولدا سو کٹاس جوڑاس ولدا داسا سیت ئے ٹی شاغاس گڑا ککڑ ئے شاغرہ تہ اوڑے ککڑ ئے شاغاس ککڑ نا زیا بے شاس بے کیک اوڑے گڑا لہر تیسہ تہ ہرا گند ارے ککڑ نا اوڑے گڑا گند ککڑ نا کائک جوان زیبا لار کریرگڑا ولدا ہندن آ اے بیدیر امہ کریس دا
en: Then there they follow the same method again: you've put in the oil, you've heated the oil and taken [them] out; then now you've cut the meat and prepared it, then now you've put it into the oil — they add the chicken there. You've added the chicken there; put the salt on top of the chicken, salt it. Then you cook it there, so whatever smell the chicken has, the chicken's smell goes away there. They fry it nicely, then like that, the curry — once you've done the, um, this
en_old: Then they follow the same method there: you've put in the ghee, you've cooked the onions and taken them out, then now you cut the meat, prepare it, then you put it in the ghee, then they add the chicken. You've added the chicken there, you add the salt of the chicken on top, the salt, then you keep frying it so that whatever smell the chicken has, the chicken smell comes out. They fry it really well, then like that the curry is made, this...

brh: بیدیر ئے بھی ولدا ہمون کیسہ ٹماٹرشائسہ تہ ٹماٹرات ئے تہ شائسہ جوان زیبا ہڑسسہ تا ادرک شائسہ تا پلپل شائسہ تا بھلا پوٹا مسالحہ ارے ای تو نے داکل ئے شاغسہ تہ گڑا جوان زیبا لہر تیسہ تہ لہر کرے داسا ٹماٹراک تہ کڑھارنہ چائسس داسا خوڑت مریرہ داسا ایہن لہر ئٹی لہر ئکے دیر شاغسہ تہ گڑا پیمازات ئے تہ کٹے گڑا ولدا
en: You make the curry the same way too: you add tomatoes, add the tomatoes, stir them nicely, add ginger, add chillies, black cardamom, spices if you have them — you add all this, then you cook it nicely, let it boil. Now the tomatoes have cooked, you see, now they're getting mushy. Now while it's boiling like this, you add water, then pound the onions, then again
en_old: You make the curry like that too: you add tomatoes, add the tomatoes and fry them well, add ginger, add chillies, there's whole spice (garam masala), you add all of this, then you fry it well. Let it cook. Now the tomatoes cook down, you see, now they become soft. Now while frying like this you add water, then grind the onions, then...

brh: ہشنگرہ انت مسالحہ غاک گڑا کر بائے تہ بند بند کریس تہ گڑا جوان لہر کےکےکے اسہ بڑکیس تس ارا بڑکی مسہ بڑکی گڑا ملہ ہر تا کہ داسا امراے تہہ انت ئنا تہ انت پارہ تہ خرمین نا تہ گند ہنانے ہنتنے ہنانے گڑا ولدا بس کہ تہ پلپل مسالحہ گڑات ئے شاغاس گڑا مچہ اےانت شاتہ
en: (Otherwise) they burn, the spices and such. Then close the lid; once you've closed it, let it boil well, let it bubble once, twice, three times. Then open it and look at how it is now, its, um, what do they call it, the khurmin's: whether the smell has gone, not gone, gone. Then again, once it's done and you've added the chilli, the spices and so on, add a little of, um, the whatsit.
en_old: Then whatever spices there are, close the lid, and once you've closed it, stir it well, let it boil once, twice, three times, then keep checking how it's doing inside, how the date mixture is on that side, how the onion is going, then once again, when you've added the black pepper and spices, then all of it...

brh: دھانڑاکتر کہ شاغ تا گڑا گلو کرک
en: Chop some coriander and put it in, then it is drunk (sipped).
en_old: Add the coriander and then dish it out.

brh: گلو کر نا مرضی تریت کر ارغ ئے تینا شاغ چوڑہ بورہ تریت کر کن اوڑے بھی بھازمزہی مریک یا گلو کر ہرا چٹ ئے انت ئے چھٹفک زکام ئے جھکہ ئے دا کل ئے ختم کیک جھکہ نا اسل ئے انت اے دشمن اے چھٹفک تہ جھکہ ئے سینہ ئے گڑا ہندنو کر کن دوائی کپہ دوائیک بندغ ئے بدتر بھازانگا بیمار کیرہ
en: Drink it however you like. Make tharid: put your bread in, crumble it up, make tharid and eat it; that way it's very tasty too. Or drink it (as it is); it gets rid of the, um, whatever: colds, coughs, it finishes all of these off. It's the real, um, enemy of a cough; it clears the cough out of the chest. So make it like that and eat it; don't take medicine. Medicines make a person worse, make them much sicker.
en_old: Dish it out however you like. Make tirit: put your bread in, crumble it up and make tirit, it's very tasty that way too. Or dish it out as it is; it chases away colds, flu and coughs, it gets rid of all of them. It's the real enemy of a cough, it drives the cough out of the chest. Something like this, so don't take medicine; medicines make a person worse, they make you even sicker.

brh: ہموہن نن کہ جوڑرہ خرمین نا بیدیرئے ایلو پین انت کیس تہ سوئے قیما بھی تو کیرہ پین انت بٹالوسے ٹی شاغس تہ انت گوگڑو سے ٹی شاغس تہ شاغسہ تہ ہرا گڑا ٹی مزہی کیک تہ برنج ئٹی شاغ ککڑ ئے برنج ئٹی کیسہ برنج ئٹی بھی مزہی مریک انت
en: That's how we, how they make the khurmin curry. Otherwise, what else do you do with it? They also make meat qeema with it. What else? You put it in a potato dish, put it in a turnip dish; whatever you put it in, it makes it tasty. Put it in rice; if you make chicken with rice, it's tasty in rice too.
en_old: That's how we make it. Apart from the date dish, what else? If you make it, people also make qeema with it. What else? You can put it in a pot or in a ... put it in whatever it tastes good in. Put it in rice; if you make chicken with rice, it's tasty in rice too.

brh: ئسے ٹی کہ اللہ تسنے نے شاغ کر تہ مزہی مریک
en: Whatever God has given you, put it in and it becomes tasty.
en_old: Whatever God has given you, put it in and it will be tasty.

brh: ای داسا نمے ہندا پاروٹ تعلیم نا اخسو اہمیت ئس اے ننامعاشرہ نا تہٹی ننا مذہب انت پائک تعلیم نا زیا تعلیم نا بھاز بھلو اہمیت ئس اے اخہ چاس تہ ہموخس اے تعلیم ظاہر اے انت ئسے نا بھی روا اے انت کہ پارہ پائہہ اللہ بشخہ کنے مونی پدی مطلب
en: Now I'll tell you this: how much importance education has in our society, and what our religion says about education. Education has a very, very great importance; however much you know, that's how much it is. Education, obviously, um, it's also right, um, as they say, may God forgive me (for anything said) before or after, I mean...
en_old: Now I'll tell you how important education is in our society, and what our religion says about education. Education is very, very important. The more you know, the more... education is obvious... it's even right to say, may God bless me, forward and backward, I mean...

brh: پائہہ اسٹ ئس اسٹ ئسے آن ہرفے کہ پائہہ نے اسٹ ئس پائہہ کہ نی تینا مسڑ خوانفوس بھاز یا ما اسہ مارئس مرے نے اسہ مسڑ ئس مرے نی بھازی تینا مسڑ ئے خوانفوس یا بھازی تینا مار ئے خوانفوس پائہہ گڑا پارے پائہہ ای تینا مسڑ ئے خوانفوٹ پائہہ گڑا بندغاک ہرفیر ای آن تہ پائہہ انتئے مسڑ ئے خوانفوس مارئے انتئے خوانفوفیس اودے او دا پارے کہ مطلب کہ ہنداخہ مرے نے گنجائش اسٹ ئے خوانفنگ کہ اسٹ ئے
en: They say someone asked someone: 'Suppose, one... would you educate your daughter more, or, if you had one son and one daughter, would you educate your daughter more or your son more?' He said, 'I would educate my daughter.' Then people asked him, 'Why would you educate the daughter, and why wouldn't you educate the son?' He told him this: I mean, if you only have enough means to educate one, then one...
en_old: Someone asked someone else, saying, "Suppose you have one daughter and one son: would you educate your daughter more, or your son more?" He said, "I would educate my daughter." Then people asked him, "Why would you educate the daughter and not the son?" He meant that if you only have the means to educate one of them,

brh: خوانف ایلو ئے خوانگپہ کپہ مطلب گڑا نی اوڑے اراد ئے پاروس خوانفو گڑا او پارے گڑا ای پاروٹ ای مسڑئے خوانفو مار ئنا پن ئے ہلتو پائہہ گڑا اسٹ ئس ہرفے ای آن تہ پائہہ انتئے پائہہ گڑا مط اہمیت ئے تعلیم نا پاوہ گڑا او پارے پائہہ گڑا مسڑئے ای داوجہ غان خوانفوٹ کہ مسڑ اگر ہنا خوانا گڑا سمجھو او اسہ نسل ئسے چلیفک نیاڑی
en: ...educate (one) and you can't educate the other, I mean; so which one would you say you'd educate? Then he said, 'I'd say I'd educate the daughter,' and he didn't mention the son. Then someone asked him why; I mean, I'm telling you the importance of education. Then he said, 'I'd educate the daughter for this reason: if the daughter goes and studies, then understand that she, the woman, carries a whole generation forward.'
en_old: you educate one and can't educate the other, I mean, so which one would you choose to educate? He said, "I would educate the daughter," and didn't mention the son. Then someone asked him why, I mean, about the importance of education. He said, "I would educate my daughter because if a daughter is educated, then understand that she carries a whole generation forward, the woman does."

brh: اگہ خوانا نیاڑی اگہ تعلیم یافتہ ؤس مس گڑا او مطلب اسہ نسل ئسے انت کیک بڑھائیفک اسہ نسل ئس اوڑا بڑھیک بھلن مریک مونی کائک گڑا او نسل در نسل او تعلیم یافتہ مریرہ اگہ ظاہر اے اگہ نیاڑی بے خوانندہ مس نرینہ خوانندہ مس او نیاڑی خوانتو اونا چناک ہندن اسٹ اسٹ نا
en: If the woman studies, if she becomes educated, then she, I mean, um, raises a whole generation; a generation grows up through her, grows big, moves forward, and generation after generation they become educated. Obviously, if the woman is uneducated and the man is educated, the woman hasn't studied, her children likewise, each one...
en_old: If a woman is educated, then she, I mean, raises a whole generation. A generation grows up with her, grows big, moves forward, and generation after generation they become educated. Obviously, if the woman is uneducated and the man is educated, the woman hasn't studied, her children each one...

brh: اریر او خوانرہ بھاز ہندنو اریر او خوانپسہ اگہ پٹیا خوانا پٹیا تینا چنائے خوانفک تینا مسنت ئے خوانفک تینا مارت ئے ڈسک تینا مسڑ ئے ڈسک تے اوفتے
en: ...there are those who study, and there are many such who don't study. If the woman has studied, the woman educates her children, educates her daughters, teaches her sons, teaches her daughter, teaches them,
en_old: There are those who study, and many like that who don't study. If a woman is educated, she educates her children; she educates her sons, she teaches her granddaughter, teaches her daughter, teaches them,

en: she teaches them sitting and standing, teaches them everything: how to sit, how to stand, how to talk with your elders, how to talk with children, how to talk with old people, how to talk with the people of your own house, how to talk with outsiders. Then that child learns everything. If the mother hasn't studied, you know, the father is like this, the father is out of the house; how much can the father (teach) the child,

en: he can't teach and train (them), can't give upbringing. So he said 'the woman', that 'I'll educate the woman'; the woman, that is, produces a whole generation. This is one great importance of education. He didn't name the son; he named the girl. So we know that in our homes we should educate every one of our daughters, daughters, children; let us educate the sons too, and daughters
en_old: teach and train them? He can't give that upbringing. So the man said, "I would educate the woman," meaning a woman creates a whole generation. This is a great importance of education. brh: ئے بھی خوانفن بھازاک ہندن او مارت ئے خوانفرہ مسنت ئے خوانفپسہ پائہہ مسنک ہندن مریر کور مریر تو شوماک مسنک کور مسرتو گڑا نما نسلاک ئے انت مریرہ کور مریرہ اصل گڑا تینا نیاڑی آ توجہ ایت تینا نرینہ غا بھی ایت برابری نا ئے پارینے ئے انت اسلام لیکن اگہ ہراڑے چاسہ کہ اے انت کنتو بھاز
en: too, let us educate them. Many are like that: they educate their sons and don't educate their daughters, saying, 'Girls are just like that, they'll stay blind (ignorant).' If your girls become blind, then what will your generations become? They'll become blind. Really, then, give attention to your women, and give it to your men too; Islam has spoken of, um, equality. But if somewhere you know that, um, I don't have much

But if you know somewhere that I don't have much

brh: گنجائش اف اسہ بندغ ئسے خوانفنگ کیوہ گڑا کوشش کہ تینا مسڑ ئے خوانف ہا مار ارے نے اللہ نی تینا مارے بھی خوانف جوان اے مارئے بھی خوانف جوان اے مار بھی خوانہ مسڑ بھی خوانہ اگر او خوانا تو بندغ گڑا اللہ نا اللہی ئے بھی خواننگ آ چائک اگہ نی خوانتویس تو نی تپیسہ کہ اللہ دیر ئس اے نی خوانوس تو گڑا اللہ نا اللہی ئے بھی گڑا نی خواننگ آ چاہوس
en: means, I can only educate one person, then try to educate your daughter. Yes, if you have a son, by God, educate your son too, that's good; educate the son too, it's good; let the son study and let the daughter study. If a person has studied, then they also know how to read God's divine word. If you haven't studied, you won't know who God is; if you study, then you'll know how to read God's divine word too.
en_old: means and I can only educate one person, then try to educate your daughter. If you have a son, God willing, educate your son too, that's good; educate the son too, that's good. The son should study and the daughter should study. If a person is educated, then they can read and understand God's divinity too. If you haven't studied, you won't know who God is; if you have studied, then you can read about God's divinity too.

brh: اگہ نی خوانانس کسرآ ہناس اللہ نا پن ئس تموکو خناس بھی نی اودے ہرفوس احترام ئے تہ کروس چوک کرو ای آ تہ
en: If you've studied and you're walking along a road and you see God's name lying fallen, you'll pick it up, you'll show it respect, you'll kiss it,
en_old: If you're educated and you're walking along the road and you see God's name fallen on the ground, you'll pick it up, you'll respect it, you'll kiss it,

brh: خنتا تخوس اگہ تتنس چاگڑا ہندن زیا تہ اللہ معاف کے لتاڑوس الوس ہنوس تہ اگہ نی پٹیا ئے تینا خوانفس اونا اسہ بھاز بھلو فائدہس اے دا بھی کہ داچنا خوانا پھگہ دےاو تینا چنا ئے خوانفک او تینا چنا ئے خوانفک او تینا چنا ئے خوانفک ہندن تین تو تینے خوانفسٹ کارہ ہندن با خنسہ
en: you'll put it to your eyes. If you hadn't known, then, God forgive, you'd trample on it, leave it and go. So if you educate your womenfolk, one very big benefit of it is also this: this child has studied; tomorrow she educates her child, and that one educates their child, and that one educates their child; like that they'll go on educating one another, you'll see it go like that.
en_old: you'll put it to your eyes. If you were uneducated, then, God forgive us, you'd trample it and walk on. So if you educate your woman, one very big benefit is also that this child studies; tomorrow she educates her child, and that one educates their child, and that one educates their child, and so on. You yourself would have educated yourself, and you'd see it continue like that.

brh: ہرا بندغ نا لمہ ئے انت کرے روفہ رزان کرے تو او تینا چنا ئے روفہ رزان ڈسک ہرا کہ ئے کہ انتے کرے ئے انتےیی کا کرے انت ہنرئسے تہ ہرا مطلب پچ سلائی کیک گنڈیک گڑا او تینا چنا ئے چن گنڈفنگ ئے سکھفک مطلب ہرا کشیدہ کرکنے کشیدہ خلکنے سیلہ خلکنے او تینا چنا ئے سیلہ ڈسفک ہرا
en: Whatever a person's mother did: if she did the sweeping and the dishes, she teaches her child sweeping and dishes. Whatever she did, um, whatever skill she has: I mean, if she sews and stitches clothes, then she teaches her child sewing; I mean, whoever has done embroidery, done kashida, done needlework, she shows her child needlework. Whoever
en_old: Whatever a person's mother did, if she did sweeping and household chores, she teaches her child sweeping and chores. I mean, if she does embroidery, if she does needlework, she teaches her child needlework. Whoever

en: has studied, or has taken up a pen in her hand, has picked up a pen in her hand, she also puts that same pen into her child's hand. So it's the mother who gives: the father is outside, the mother is at home. brh: سمندرات آ تہٹی داسا موتیت ئے پٹرہ کشرہ او امر کشرہ تا قران آن واضح اے قران آن خنانو داگڑات ئے داسا او گڑات ئے کیرہ پین ہندنو گڑا ارے کیئی نن داسا قران ئے ہپنہ کپنہ داسا انگریز انگریزاے منپک تہ بھی قران ئے خوانک صحب شام انئے خوانک اوٹی ہر گڑا ارے اللہ ہر گڑا ئے بیان کرینے تینا نعمتات ئے کل ئے قران ئٹی
en: Now they search inside the seas and pull out pearls, and how they pull them out is clear from the Quran; they have seen it from the Quran. These things — now they do those things; there are many other such things. We nowadays don't [look into] the Quran, we don't act on it. Now the English, the Englishman, even though he doesn't believe, still reads the Quran morning and evening. Why does he read it? Everything is in it; Allah has described everything, all His blessings, in the Quran.
en_old: Now they search the seas and take out pearls from them, and how they take them out is clear from the Quran; from the Quran they see these things and do these things. There are many other such things that we now don't understand in the Quran. Now the English, the Englishman doesn't believe in it, yet he still reads the Quran morning and evening. Why does he read it? Because everything is in it; Allah has described everything, all His blessings, in the Quran.

brh: پارینے سمندرات ئے ٹی موتی مریک مشت ئے ٹی ارے خیسں مریک او ہموکا پٹرہ ہموکا خنرہ ولدا اللہ خن تسنے خن انسان نا مہ تعلیم انسان نا مسٹمیکو خن اے پائہہ کور او بندغ مفک کہ ہرا بندغ خنا خنپ کور اصل ئٹی ہمو مریک ہراد ئے تعلیم افک
en: It has said that there are pearls in the seas, and in the mountains there is gold, and they search for it there and find it there. Then, Allah has given eyes, a human's eyes; and education is a human's third eye. They say the blind one isn't the person who can't see with his eyes; in reality the blind one is the one who has no education.
en_old: It says that in the seas there are pearls, in the sand there are... and they search for those and find them. Then Allah has given eyes, the eyes of a human, and education is the third eye of a human. They say a person isn't blind just because he can't see with his eyes; in reality the blind one is the one who has no education.

brh: اصل کور ہمود اے پارہ کور اصل اودے پاپسہ کہ ہرا خن اٹ خنپک اصل کور تعلیم نا بے مننگی اے کور پارہ اگہ تعلیم ئس مس تو سمجھو نے مسٹمیکو خن اے تو ای ہندا پاروٹ کہ کس تینا چنا تا مسٹمیکو خن ئے پلپ مسٹمیکو خن ئے اوفتے تے چنا چھنک اے تو نے آٹ اے نی
en: The real blind one is that one; they call him blind. You don't really call the one who can't see with his eyes blind; the real blindness is the absence of education — that's what they call blind. If you have an education, consider it your third eye. So I would say this: nobody should snatch away their children's third eye; the third eye of theirs, of the children — it is in your hands, yours.
en_old: The real blind one is the one they call blind; the real blind one is not the one who can't see with his eyes. The real blindness is the lack of education, that's what they call blind. If you have education, consider it your third eye. So I would say that no one should leave their children's third eye closed; it is up to you to give that third eye to your children.

brh: اودے تعلیم ایت نی اودے خوانف نی اودے سکول آ راہی کر اودے مدرسہ غا راہی کر مسجہ مدرسہ نا دینی تعلیم ایتہ تہ دنوی تعلیم ایتہ تہ تاکہ تومکا تعلیماک اوڑتو مریر اوتا ہر گڑا ئے چائہہ دا نہ دہن پاپہ کہ دینی تسٹ تہ دنوی تفر تہ یا دنوی تسٹ تہ دینی تفر تہ نہ تومنگاک تعلیم او ہر تعلیم ئے ایتہ تہ ہر تعلیم ئے خوانک
en: Give them education, you; teach them, you; send them to school, send them to the madrasa. Give them the religious education of the mosque and the madrasa, and give them worldly education, so that both kinds of education are with them and they know everything. Don't say it like this: 'I've given the religious, I won't give the worldly,' or 'I've given the worldly, I won't give the religious.' No — both educations; give every education, and let them study every education.
en_old: Give them education, teach them, send them to school, send them to the madrasa, the mosque madrasa. Give them religious education and give them worldly education, so that both kinds of education are with them and they know everything. Don't say, 'I've given religious, I won't give worldly,' or 'I've given worldly, I won't give religious.' No, give both kinds of education, give every kind of education, and let them study every kind.

brh: چنا پٹیوس اے بھی ہر تعلیم ایتہ تہ ہر تینا تعلیم ئے خوانہ چائہہ پین کے
en: Even if the child is a girl, give her every education too; let her study and know all of her education, and more.
en_old: Even if it's a girl, give her every kind of education too, let her study all of it and know everything.

Along the way — this child had such a passion for studying. He said, 'You go on — what does it matter? — you keep going on the horse, and I'll keep coming along with you like this. You keep going, I'll keep coming; just teach me that much there, while I'

brh: سوال ہرفسٹ کروٹ ای آن نے نی کنے صرف جواب ترسٹ کر بس سوال کروٹ جواب ایت پین آہہ تعلیم ہناد اے ظاہر اے ہلی آ خرنگنگ آخرنگوکا خواننگ تو ہندن مرو پین تومروف داسادوٹی پین ئس تختیس پینسل ئس ربڑئس تو ہرفوف ہننگ ہننگ ئٹی تو دا چنا نا ہر نی شوق اے پائہہ ای نے آن سوال کروٹ است آن نی کنے جواب ترسٹ کیس
en: I'll keep asking you questions, and you just keep giving me answers. I'll just ask the question, you give the answer.' Well, education is like that, obviously. Studying on horseback while going along would be like that; there wouldn't be a slate, a pencil, an eraser in hand to carry. So on the way — such was this child's passion. He said, 'I'll ask you questions from memory, and you keep giving me answers.'
en_old: 'I'll ask questions to you, you just give me the answers. I'll ask, you answer.' Well, what else, education, obviously. Riding a donkey, reading while riding, would be like that; it's not as if there were slates, pencils, erasers back then to carry. So on the way, this child had such a passion. He said, 'I'll ask you questions, you'll give me the answers.'

en: So daily the teacher came twenty-five kilometers, and this child came along with him, running. As far as that king's house he would keep to the road, and from there he would go back again; again up to that place the child went running, without [unclear], daily. This was the child's routine; daily, daily he kept coming like this. That's how it was; he kept doing it like this.

With him the king's... he would ride, and then he would go back again from there; the child would run alongside, without... daily. This was the child's routine; daily, daily he would come like this. That's how it was, he kept doing this.

en: They say that child later studied, became great, and became Imam Ghazali. Yes, those were people, learned people, educated people. Everyone should have a passion for studying. brh: بھلا بھلا بندغات ئے پیشن نا پیشن نا بندغاک بسر گڑا پائہہ داسا نا شاگردات ئے تینا بش کہ سلیف ہرن تا کہ نا دا شاگردات ئے ٹی اخہ خوانوکو بندغ ارے
en: to great people'; people came from outside, from far abroad. Then they said, 'Now have your students get up and stand, so we can see how many learned people there are among these students of yours.'
en_old: Great people, people from far and wide came. Then they said, 'Now have your students stand up and speak, so we can see how many learned people there are among your students.'

en: So they got up. Great people had come — many ministers, kings, from many countries, gathered together; it was a turban-tying (graduation) ceremony. Then he told his students, 'Get up — what are you doing there? Speak now, stand up.' One got up, said some jumbled things just like that, and went and sat down; then the other got up and said jumbled things like that. He became very angry; he said,
en_old: So they gathered; great people had come, many ministers, kings, from many countries together, it was a turban-tying ceremony. Then he told his students, 'Stand up, what are you doing, speak now.' One stood up and spoke just any old way, then sat down; another stood up and spoke any old way. He became very angry.

brh: ای دافت ئے داخہ خوانفیٹ تینا زندگی ئے تباہ کریٹ اوفت آ خرچ کریٹ کہ او خوانر او خنی مریر ہچس سکھتوس پائہہ گڑا ہمو ہراڑے کہ او چنائے ارسطو ہراڑے کہ بندغ خوانفیکہ استاد اس گڑا پائہہ اونا ہمو دروازہ نا حد آ اسہ ایہنو انت ئس اسکہ چپراسیس اسکہ گڑا دس چبراسی پراے پائہہ ای بریوکیو پائہہ ہو دافت ئے ہرافت ئے کہ تعلیم تسٹ
en: 'I taught these so much, I ruined my life and spent it on them so that they would study and gain sight, and they learned nothing.' Then, at that place where that child — where Aristotle taught people, he was a teacher — at the threshold of his door there was a, what do you call it, a peon. Then the peon said, 'I will come too.' He said, 'Yes — these whom I gave education

en: ...cut them with the sickle-blade; if you have a knife, cut them with the knife and make them nice and fine. Wash them: first wash them, then chop them.
