en: In another, uh, incident it comes that these sacrifices for the sake of religion were so great, that, uh, our Prophet of God said: how much suffering they gave me for the sake of religion, I know. Of all the prophets who have come until today, they have given me this much suffering for the sake of religion; the Master said: they have not given it to anyone else.
en_old: In another incident it is mentioned how great these sacrifices for the sake of religion were, that our Prophet of Allah said, 'How much suffering I was given for the sake of religion, I know. Whatever prophet has come until today, no one has been given as much suffering for the sake of religion as I have,' the Master said, 'no one else was given such.'

brh: کہ ہرا بندغ ئس اوفتے آ بسکہ او اوفت تن خیر خواہی کریرہ اورخیرخواہی ان علاوہ اوفتے پاریرہ کہ بھئی نم ببواور دا گڑا ٹے نمے اسہ بھلو انتس ملکک ا-ا
en: that whoever came to them, they would show him goodwill, and besides the goodwill they would tell him, "Brother, you come too, and in this you will find something great, uh...
en_old: Whenever someone came to them, they wished them well, and besides wishing them well they told them, "Brothers, come, and in this you will gain something great, uh...

brh: ا- سہولت ئسم ملک نمےاور داگڑا نم کہ بھاز جوان اے۔ تو ہراہموٹیم نا بندغاک اسرہ ہمو ا-حالات نا مطابق بسرہ ہناڑے اواوکا علاوہ ایلواسٹ تو تین تو گپ کریرہ ا- اوکا پد ولا اوفتا گڑاس ہمو گڑا ئے پو مسرہ تو پاریرہ ٹھیک اے داتو اسہ بھاز جوانو اسہ گپ ئس اے۔ داکا زیادہ ننے پین انت ضرورت اے۔
en: uh, you will also get ease, and this thing is very good for you." So the people of that time came there according to those, uh, circumstances, and besides that they would talk it over among themselves, uh, and after that some of them would come to understand that thing, and they would say, "Fine, this is a very good thing. What more do we need than this?"
en_old: ...you will find ease too, and this thing is very good for you." So the people of that time came according to those circumstances, and besides that they talked it over among themselves, uh, and afterward, when they understood that thing, they said, "Fine, this is a very good thing. What more do we need than this?"

brh: اچھا پین اسہ گڑاس بننگٹن اے کہ اسہ پیرو نیاڑیس اسک ہر بھلہس اس۔ تو دا بھلہ ئے ہنن پاریسر کہ فلانا اسہ بندغ ئس ارے اور دانا نم اگہ ہیت ئے بنگرے اور دانا ہیت ہنداخہ نما زیا، زیا نما اثر مرو کہ ا- انت کہ نم پارہ ولاہمو کرورہ۔
en: Okay, another thing we hear is that there was an old woman, an elderly woman. This old woman had been told that there is a certain man, and if you listen to his words, his words will have so much effect on you that, uh, whatever he tells you, you will then do exactly that.
en_old: Okay, another story we hear is that there was an old woman, an elderly lady. This old lady had been told that there is a certain man, and if you listen to his words, they will affect you so much that, uh, you will end up doing whatever he says.

brh: تو دا بھل ہنا خلیس ان اسہ گڑاس تینا کاٹم نا زیا تخاسس ہننگٹ اس تو دا تینا گامت ئے ارفسا ہننگٹ اس تو ہناڑے ئے- ننا نبی اودے خنا اور ہنا کہ اونا زی- سرہ نا زیا اسہ انت ئس گنڈ ئس تخوک اس ہنا گنڈئے تہ ارفے تینا سرہ نا زیا تخا۔
en: So out of that fear this old woman had put something on her head and was leaving; she was going along step by step, and there, uh, our Prophet saw her, and what was on her he- head, some kind of bundle placed there, he picked up that bundle and put it on his own head.
en_old: This old woman was carrying something, a bundle, on her head as she went, dragging her steps along, and our Prophet saw her there. He took the bundle that was on her head and put it on his own head.

brh: تو ہرفتے ای ان تہ کہ بھل نی ارانگ ہننگس۔ تو پارے باوہ ای بنگنٹ کہ دا شارئٹے اسٹ ئس ارے ہرا بندغ تو ا- اسہ وارس گپ کیک او ہمو گپات ان پد او بندغ پین ہچ کننگ کپک۔ تو ای نرنگٹن اٹ۔ تو پارے کہ پن تہ دیر اے تو او بھلا پارے کہ اونا پن محمد اے۔
en: Then he asked her, "Old mother, where are you going?" She said, "Son, I have heard that in this city there is someone who, uh, once he talks with a person, after those words that person can't do anything else. So I am running away." He said, "What is his name?" And the old woman said, "His name is Muhammad."
en_old: Then he asked her, "Mother, where are you going?" She said, "Son, I have heard that there is someone in this city who, uh, once he speaks to a person, after those words that person cannot do anything else. So I am running away from him." He asked, "What is his name?" The old woman said his name is Muhammad.

brh: توپارے بھلو ای اٹ۔ تو ہمو بھلہ پارے ای نا پوؤ بندغ ئسے اٹ۔ دا گڑات ئے پومتنٹ کہ نم داخس تورحمدلواور داخو مہربانو نم بندغ ارے۔ تو گڑا ہمو بھلہ ہموڑے پارے کہ ای ہم داسا ہنا نما رحمدلی ئے خناٹ ای داسا مسلمان مسٹ۔
en: Then he said, "Old mother, it is me." And the old woman said, "I am an ignorant person. I had not understood these things, that you are such a merciful and such a kind person." Then right there the old woman said, "Now that I have seen your mercy, I too have now become a Muslim."
en_old: Then he said, "Mother, I am he." The old woman said, "I was an unaware person. I did not know that you are such a merciful and kind person." Then the old woman said right there, "Now that I have seen your mercy, I have become a Muslim."

brh: اسہ پین ہننو واقع بھاز بنگٹن او کہ اسٹ بسکہ اللہ نا ہرا ارا اسکہ۔ اللہ نا ارا ٹی ہرڑے کہ نن اللہ نا نمازے تین انت کینہ خواننہ۔ تو ہنداڑے اسٹ بسک تینا تقاضہس کرے ہنداڑے ہرادے یعنی کہ تینا چروسے ہناڑے اللہ ن ارا ٹےچرو کننگ ئے شروع کرے۔
en: Another such incident we have heard a lot is that someone came to the house of God, the house of God where we, uh, perform God's prayers. Someone came there and had his need, that is, his urine, and right there in the house of God he started urinating.
en_old: Another such incident we hear about a lot is that someone came to the house of Allah, the house of Allah where we perform our prayers. Someone came there, had a need, that is, to urinate, and started urinating there in the house of Allah.

brh: تو ہموٹیم ئنا دور ئنا ہرا صحاباک اسر بش مسر کہ دا بندغ ئے نن خلین لٹھ ئناپھیریس ایتن تہ تو گڑا خواجہ فرمائفے کہ دادے البو فی الحال دا تینا ہراکہ ہنا حاجات ئے کننگٹ اے ہرانا زیا تولوک اے چپ کبوالبو تہ۔
en: So the Companions of that time, of that era, stood up, saying, "Let's beat this man and give him a few blows of the stick." Then the Master (the Prophet) said, "Leave him. For now he is doing that need of his, which is what he is sitting there for. Be quiet and leave him."
en_old: The Companions of that time got angry: "Let's beat this man and give him a few strokes of the stick." Then the master (the Prophet) said, "Leave him. For now he is relieving himself, which is why he is sitting there. Be quiet and leave him."

brh: تو ہراتم او تینا حاجات ان تینا پیش تما ولا خواہفے تہ تولفے تہ او ہنا فرمائفے پارے تہ کہ ہبو دا اللہ نا ارا اے۔ اللہ نا ارا ٹی دا گڑا جوان اف۔ ہراگڑائے نی کننگ اس۔ تو گڑا پارے نم دیر ارے۔ پائہہ ہندا کل مسلمان ان۔
en: When he had finished his need, he called him over, sat him down, and graciously said to him, "Look, this is the house of God. In the house of God this thing is not good, the thing you were doing." Then the man said, "Who are you people?" He said, "We here are all Muslims."
en_old: When he had finished relieving himself, the Prophet called him over, sat him down and said, "Look, this is the house of Allah. What you were doing is not proper in the house of Allah." Then the man asked, "Who are you?" They said, "We are all Muslims."

brh: او ہنا اللہ نا نبی نا رحمدلی ئے خنار ہنا گڑات ان ہناخہ زیاہ نت مسر کہ اوپارے کہ ای ٹھیک نما ای بریوہ اسلام ئٹی۔ تو پاننگ نا مقصد دادے کہ ہرانسان نا تہٹی ہر اسہ بندغ نا۔
en: He saw the mercy of God's Prophet and was so affected by those things that he said, "Fine, I will come over to you, into Islam." So the point of saying this is that inside every human being, every single person...
en_old: He saw the mercy of the Prophet of Allah and was so impressed by it all that he said, "Fine, I will come into Islam with you." So the point is that within every human being, every person...

brh: تہٹی دا گڑا نن کہ سبخ ئس اے کہ رحمدلی ننا است ئٹی مرو تو ہخسو بھلو انت ئس مرو۔ تو اسہ پین بننگٹن اے کہ اسہ نیاڑیس اس اور نیاڑی دا ہناکہ یعنی کہ غلطو کاریم کریکہ۔ امہ کریکہ نیاڑی؟ غلطو کاریم کریکہ، تو ہنا نیاڑی بننگٹن اے اسہ واقعہ سے ٹی کہ اسہ کچک ئس اس، سہدارس اس۔
en: ...inside, this thing is a lesson for us: if there is mercy in our hearts, what a great thing that will be. Another thing we hear is that there was a woman, and this woman, uh, that is, did wrong work. What did the woman do? She did wrong work. And we hear, in one incident about that woman, that there was a dog, an animal.
en_old: ...this is a lesson for us: if there is mercy in our hearts, it will be something truly great. Another story we hear is that there was a woman, and this woman, that is, did wrong work. What did the woman do? Wrong work. We hear of that woman in an incident where there was a dog, a thirsty one.

brh: داسہدارئے تینا خہ- ہنا خمب ئٹی سہدارے دیر تس۔ تو ہنا رحمدلی نا وجہ غان سہدارے دیر تننگ نا وجہ غان۔ اونا بھاز بھلو فائدہس مس او اونا آخرت ٹی اوڑکہ بھلو اسہ نفعس مس۔ تو پاننگ نا مقصد داد اے کہ امرو بندغ ئس مرے او بندغ نا اونا ہراکہ کردار اے او کردار ئے اونا اسہ سیڈا تخبو۔
en: She gave water to this animal in her, uh, in her arms (cupped hands). And because of that mercy, because of giving water to the animal, she received a very great benefit, and in her afterlife it became a great reward for her. So the point of saying this is that whatever kind of person someone may be, that person's character, whatever it is, keep that character of theirs straight.
en_old: This person gave water to the animal from his cupped hand. So because of his kindness, because he gave water to the animal, he got a very great benefit, and in his afterlife it was a great reward for him. So the point of telling this is that whatever kind of person someone is, you should keep that person's character upright.

brh: اونا ہراکہ مہر، محبت اے دا گڑات ئے نم انت کبو۔ دہنکہ ننے اسکا ننا براہوئی مخلوق اے آ-آ- بھاز مخلوق ننا ہنن سمجھہ مخلوق ننا غریبو بندغ او۔ داسا ننا بلوچستان نا ہراکہ براہوئی مخلوق اے دا ہزارا سال مست ئنااو۔
en: The love and affection that person has, uh, practise these things. Like, for us, up to now, our Brahui people, uh, many of our people, understand it this way, our people are poor people. Now the Brahui people of our Balochistan go back thousands of years.
en_old: His love and affection — what will you do with these things? Like, until now our Brahui people, many of our people, are understanding people; our people are poor people. Now the Brahui people of Balochistan go back thousands of years.

brh: دابندغاک ہمے ٹیم ان تینا غریبی ٹی ہنا مہر محبت ئٹی، ہنا اسہ اراس بسنے تو ہمو ارا نا ہراکہ بھلا مسنے خیر خواہ مسنے۔ اوڑتو اوار دہ پانزہ ا- پین ارا اواری کرینے کہ اور دا اواری تو اوار دا تینا
en: These people, since that time, in their poverty, in that love and affection: one household came, and whoever had become the elder of that household became a well-wisher. With him ten or fifteen, uh, other households joined together, so that with this union, together, their...
en_old: These people, at that time, in their poverty and in their love and affection — one household came, and then the elder of that household became a well-wisher. With him, ten or fifteen other households joined, so that with this unity, together, their...

brh: پارینو کہ بھئی نی خیرخواہو بندغ ئسے اس۔ بھاز جوانوسے اس اور نی بھاز رحمدلو بندغ ئسے اس۔ ننا ہخسو مخلوق ئس اے دا کل نن نے تو خلکن۔ دہنکہ بلوچستان ناعلاقہ اے بھازامخلوق اوڑے مست آن اوڑے دہنو کڈی الو۔ کڈی الو گدان اس۔ تو دا مخلوق ہموڑے تین کہ گدان خلکرہ۔
en: They told him, "Brother, you are a well-wishing person. You are a very good one, and you are a very kind person. However many people we have, we will all pitch our tents with you." Like, in the area of Balochistan, for many of the people there, from earlier times, there were no such houses there. There were no houses; there were tents. So these people would pitch tents there for themselves.
en_old: They said, 'Brother, you were a well-wishing person. You were a very good one and you were a very kind person. However many people we have, we will all settle with you.' Like, in the areas of Balochistan, many of the people there in the past had no houses. There were no houses, there were tents. So these people would pitch their tents there.

brh: گدان خلکرہ او ہنا گدانت ئے جوڑ کریرہ آ- ہرادے پارہ کہ میڷ نا کاس۔ میڷ میڷ نا کاس ان دادے گڑا جھلک ئسے اٹ جوڑ کریرہ جھلک اٹ۔ جھلک آن پد دانا اسہ دھسک ئس جوڑ مسکہ۔ دا دھسک ان ولادانا جوڑ کریرہ ہنا گدان نا کونٹی پارہ تہ۔ کونٹی ئے جوڑ کریرہ۔
en: They would pitch tents, and they would make those tents from, uh, what they call sheep's wool. The sheep's wool they would then make into yarn with a spindle, with a spindle. After the spindle, a thread would be made from it. From this thread they would then make what they call the kunti of the tent. They would make the kunti.
en_old: They pitched tents, and they made those tents from what they call sheep's wool. Sheep's wool — they would spin it into yarn. After spinning, a strip of it would be made. From these strips they would then make the panels of the tent, what they call kunti. They made the kunti.

brh: اوکا پد داد ئے اوار شاغارہ موغارہ تہ او دادے گندار تسرہ، داتا گدان جوڑ مسکہ۔ دا اوفتا جاگہ اس رہنگنگ کہ تا۔ گندامسہ چار گندار تسرہ تہ ہنداڑے رہینگارہ۔ ایلو مخلوق بسکہ داڑے رہینگاکہ۔ رہینگنگ ان پد گڑا ہنا مخلوقاک کس پہوال اسرہ، کس تینا پہوالی کریرہ اوفتے میڷ اس۔ اوتینا میڷ کس ئے ہیٹ اس۔
en: After that they would put the pieces together and sew them, and they would set it on poles, and that is how their tent was made. This was their place to live. They would put up three or four poles and live right there. Other people would come and live here too. After settling, those people, some were herders, some did their herding; they had sheep. Some had their sheep, some had goats.
en_old: After that they would join them together and sew them, and they would stitch them up, and that is how their tent was made. This was their place to live. They would put it up on four poles and live right there. Other people would come and live here too. After settling, those people — some were herders, some did their herding, they had sheep. Some of them had goats as their livestock.

brh: کس ئے خراس اس۔ کس ئسے ہچ اسر۔ تو دافتا ہیٹ، ہچ ئنا، میڷ ئنا یا خراس نا دافتا پاڷت ئے ۔
en: Some had oxen. Some had camels. So the milk of their goats, camels, sheep or oxen...
en_old: Some had donkeys. Some had camels. So the milk of their goats, camels, sheep or donkeys...

brh: خرواڷ کریرہ۔ دافت ان خاسن جوڑ مسکہ اور دافت ان ہراکہ ننا ا-ا-ا خرود جوڑ مسکہ اور دافتے دا بندغاک اوکا پد تینا استعمال ٹی ہیسرہ۔ گڑاس ہنن کہ خاسن اس۔ خاسن ئے دا مخلوق ہیزک ئسے ٹی یاانت ئٹی خواسے، خوا ٹی دیر شاغارہ، ہیزک ئٹی دادے پور- پوریرہ ہرادے پورنگ پارہ، سرفیرہ تہ۔
en: they would make it into kharwal (colostrum milk). From these, buttermilk was made, and from these our, uh, qurut (dried whey) was made, and these people would then put them to their own use. Something like buttermilk: these people would make the buttermilk in a skin bag or in, what, a water skin; they would pour water into the water skin, and in the skin bag they would ch- churn it, which is called poring (churning); they would shake it.
en_old: they would churn it. From this, buttermilk was made, and from this our, uh, qurut (dried whey) was made, and these people would then put them to use. Some things, like buttermilk: these people would put the milk in a skin bag or in a pot, add water, and in the skin bag they would shake it, which is called churning; they would churn it.

brh: دانا تہہ نا سی ئس کشارہ، سی ان پد خاسن جوڑ مسکہ۔ دا خاسن ئے ولا اوڑان دا اسہ لار تسرہ سی جوڑ کریرہ ہرادے پارہ براہوئی اٹ خریش۔ تو دا خریش ہناخہ، ہنداخہ رحمدل اسرہ کہ ہرا ارا ٹی خریش جوڑ مسکہ م-م- بیست ارا اسر یا بیست و پنچ ارا اسرہ کل ئے دریرہ بشخارہ تسرہ۔
en: They would take out the butter from inside it, and after the butter, buttermilk would be left. Then from this buttermilk they would boil it once and make butterfat, which in Brahui is called kharish (ghee). And they were so, so kind that whichever household kharish was made in, if there were, um, twenty households or twenty-five households, they would take it to all of them, share it out and give it.
en_old: They would take the butter out from inside it, and after the butter, buttermilk was left. From this buttermilk they would then cook a dish, which in Brahui is called khareesh. And they were so kind that whichever household made khareesh, if there were twenty or twenty-five households, they would divide it up and give it to all of them,

brh: کہ کنا ایلم ای کنیو اور کنا ایلم لنگڑ مف۔ ہنا نسبت اٹ اوفتا ہراکہ دا ا-ا-ا پہوالی سسٹم اسکہ، شوان اسرہ او مش تا زیا اوفتا دا ہیٹ، میڷ سہدارک تا دافتا ہموفتیٹ تینا سہدارت ئے جھلارہ۔ چلہ نا گرمی شش تو اسکا داہموڑے مسرہ بلوچستان نا نیمہ غا۔ ہراتم کہ دامخلوق ہرارہ کہ داسا ننے علاقہ ٹی
en: so that as I eat, my brother eats too, and my brother does not go hungry. Along those lines, their, uh, herding system was this: they were shepherds, and on the mountains, their goats, sheep and animals, there they would tend their animals. In the summer heat, for up to six months, they would stay there on this side of Balochistan. When these people saw that now, in our area...
en_old: so that my brother eats as I eat, and my brother does not go hungry. In the same way, they had their herding system: they were shepherds, and up on the mountains they grazed their goats, sheep and animals. Through the summer heat, for six months, they would stay there, in the highlands of Balochistan. When these people saw that now, in our area...

brh: بلوچستان ئٹی براہوئیک ہراکہ مخلوق اسرہ کہ داڑے ننا پہوالی سسٹم اے داسا یخ مریک تو ہنا یخ ئنا حساب آ پیش تمارہ گڑا نا بیست بیست پنچ ارا اسرہ دافتا خیرہ خواہی اس، دافتا رحمدلی اسکہ، دا مخلوقاک کس ئے اگہ ارا ہچ اسرہ۔ تو تینا چنا نیاڑیت ئے ہچات آ سوار کریرہ۔
en: in Balochistan, the Brahuis, the people who were there, saw that here, where our herding system is, it is now getting cold, so because of the cold they would set out. Then there would be twenty, twenty-five households, and this was their goodwill, this was their kindness: among these people, if someone had two camels, they would seat their children and women on the camels.
en_old: the Brahuis in Balochistan, the people, saw that here, for our herding system, it is now getting cold, so because of the cold they would set out. Then there were twenty or twenty-five households, and this was their goodwill, their kindness: if someone had camels, they would put their children and women on the camels.

brh: پیرنگات ئے ہر پیرہ اسرہ، پیرہ- پیرہ غات ئے مچا سوار کریرہ ہرا کہ ورنا غا نا ا-اسرہ نرینہ غاک تینا ورنا غا نرینہ غات ئے پاریرہ کہ بابا داسا نم دہن کبو کہ نم ہچ ئنا مغار ئٹے ہلبو او نم پند کبو۔
en: The old people, whoever was old, they would seat all the old ones on the animals; as for the young, uh, the men would tell their young men, "Son, now you do this: take hold of the camel's halter and walk on foot."
en_old: The elderly, whoever was old, they would seat all the old ones, and the young men... the men would tell their young men, 'Son, now you do this: take hold of the camel's halter and walk on foot.'

brh: ہراکہ پہ- پند کریرہ پیرنگات ئے، نیاڑیت ئے، چھنکا چنات ئے ارا سہدار اسر یا مسٹ، کس ئتو خراس اس، کس ئتو ہچ ئس اس دافتا زیا سوار کریرہ۔ گڑا دا سوار مسرہ، داخیر خواہی اس ہنارہ جاگہ سے آ مچا دے دا پند کریرہ، پند کرسا اسہ بھلو گڑا ڈیھ ئسے آ سوار سر مسرہ۔
en: Those who walked did so, and the old people, the women, the little children, whatever two or three animals there were, some had an ox, some had a camel, they would seat them on these. Then these rode; this was the goodwill. They would go to a place, walking the whole day, and walking along they would arrive, the riders too, at a big, uh, stretch of country.
en_old: Those who walked... the elderly, the women, the small children — whatever animals there were, some had donkeys, some had camels — they would seat them on these. Then they rode; this was the goodwill. They would travel to a place, walking all day, and walking, they would reach a big plain.

brh: سر مننگ ان پد دا ہخس کہ مخلوق اسرہ ہناڑے دا غریب اسرہ۔ خیر خواہی دا اسکہ کہ دا اسہ بھلو دیگ ئس جوڑ کریرہ برنج نا دانا تہہ ٹی دیر شاغارہ، دادے لار تسرہ۔
en: After arriving, however many people there were, they were poor there. The goodwill was this: they would make one big pot of rice, put water in it and boil it.
en_old: After they arrived, however many people there were, they were poor there. The goodwill was that they would make one big pot of rice, put water in it, and cook it.

brh: او ہراکہ داف تو خاسن اسکہ ہنا خاسن ئے توسرہ دا ہخس کہ ارا اسرہ ایلو اسٹ ئے ہنا خیرخواہی نا وجہ غان ایلو اسٹ ئے بشخارہ، ایلو اسٹ ئے تسرہ کنگرہ۔ دافتا دا طریقہ غٹ دا۔
en: And the buttermilk they had, they would keep that buttermilk, and however many households there were, out of that goodwill they would share with one another and give to one another, and they would eat. This was their way.
en_old: And the buttermilk they had, they would pour that buttermilk in, and however many households there were, because of that goodwill they would share with one another and give to one another to eat. This was their way.

brh: انت ہر دا ہنا تینا گڑا گامت ئے ارفسا داکا ہنسا ہناکہ ہراکہ مولہ والا کسر اسکہ ہرادے دا مولہ نا کسراٹ تقریبا دا ہناخہ مریک کہ کس ئے پانزدہ دے کس ئے بیست دے ئس صحب شام ہمیڑاسکا ہنسا ہاں ارٹمیکو دا مسکہ کہ کس ئسے نا پڈ ئس خڷ کریکہ یا کس نا کاٹم خڷ کریکہ تو کس ئسے نا چنا نا پڈ ہناکہ تو گڑا دا ہموٹیم ئنا ہرا براہوئی گڑیئو ہرا کہ بوچ اسرہ۔
en: So each of these would set out on foot from here along, uh, the Mula route, and on this Mula route it took roughly this long: for some fifteen days, for some twenty days, going morning and evening all the way to there. Yes, and the second thing was that if someone's foot hurt or someone's head hurt, or someone's child's foot, uh, then at that time there were the Brahui herbs, the bushes, that were there.
en_old: So each would pick up their belongings and set off from here, along the migration route. On the migration route it took roughly this long: some fifteen days, some twenty days, going morning and evening. Yes, and the second thing was that if someone's foot hurt, or someone's head hurt, or someone's child's foot hurt, then at that time there were the Brahui herbs, which were dried.

brh: براہوئی گرو بوچات ئے ہرافتے ٹی ننا اسرہ گوئے مادران، آلونج، پیہن پھلی بھاز پین مختلف ک- ہرا انت ئنا اسرہ براہوئی گریئو ہرا دارو اسرہ تو دا داروت ئے ہمو بندغ ئے دیر ئٹے شاغارہ، کس نا پڈ خڷ کریکہ دیر ئٹی شاغارہ تسرہ اونا الحمداللہ پڈ نا خڷ صحیح مسکہ۔
en: The Brahui herbs and bushes, among which we had goe madaran, alunj, white phalli and many other different ones, these were the Brahui herbs that were medicines. They would put these medicines in water for that person: if someone's foot hurt, they would put them in water and give it to him, and, praise God, the pain in his foot would get better.
en_old: The Brahui herbs, the dried ones, among which were our goē mādarān, ālonj, white phalli and many other different ones — these were the Brahui herbs that were medicines. They would put these medicines in water for that person. If someone's foot hurt, they would put the herbs in water and give it to him, and thank God, the pain in his foot would get better.

brh: تو خیر خواہی اسکہ، مہر محبت اسکہ، غیربیک اسر لیکن او بندغات ئے ٹی بھاز بھلو اسٹو محبت اس۔ ہنا خیر خواہی مہر محبت نا وجہ غان دا بندغاک کس پو متوکہ کہ دا تینا ایلم ئس اے یا پین کس قوم ئس اے۔
en: So there was goodwill, there was love and affection. They were poor, but among those people there was a very great love, as if they were one. Because of that goodwill, love and affection, none of these people could tell whether someone was their own brother or from some other tribe.
en_old: So there was goodwill, there was love and affection. They were poor, but among those people there was great unity and love. Because of that goodwill, love and affection, these people never thought about whether someone was their own brother or from another tribe.

brh: ہندن مسکہ بیست ارا او براہوئیت آ اوفتے ٹی اسہ یا ارا ارا تین تو ایلم او ہرا کہ بیست ارا اسرہ دا پین اسرہ۔
en: It was like this: of twenty Brahui households, among them one or two households were brothers to one another, and the rest of the twenty households were other people.
en_old: That is how it was: of twenty Brahui households, among them one or two households were their own brothers, and the rest of the twenty households were others.

brh: تو دا قربانیت آ وجہ غان اللہ نم کہ نن کہ کل ئکہ بھاز بھلو اسہ
en: So because of these sacrifices, Allah, for you and for us, for all of us, a very great...
en_old: So because of these sacrifices, Allah has made for all of us a very great...

brh: ا- مونی کہ کسرئس بھاز بھلو جوانو کرینے۔ تو دا ہیت ان ہبو اوکا پد ہخساتے کہ اللہ نا نبی ان پد صحاباک جوڑ مسر اسہ بھاز بھلو اسہ ہنو افراد ئس جوڑ مسر کہ ہرا ایلو اسٹ نا خیر خواہی نا درس تسر۔ مہر محبت نا درس تسر۔
en: ...uh, has made a very great, good path for the future. So look at this matter: after that, how after the Prophet of Allah the Companions became, they became a very great, such a group of people, who gave the lesson of goodwill toward one another, who gave the lesson of kindness and love.
en_old: ...made the path ahead very good for us. So listen to this, after that, how the Companions after the Prophet of Allah became a very great group of people who gave each other the lesson of goodwill, gave the lesson of love and compassion.

brh: تو دا دیر کہ مس دا نم کہ نن کہ مسر ایلم ۔ اینو اگہ اللہ نا بھلو اسہ ننا زیا اسہ مہربانیس اے اسہ ا- فضل ئس اے کہ اللہ نم کہ نن کہ لمہ نا کھٹ ئٹے دا گڑات ئے اللہ ننے عطا فرمائفے۔
en: So for whom did this happen? It happened for you and for us, brothers. Today, if anything, it is a great kindness of Allah upon us, a, uh, grace, that for you and for us, from our mother's lap, Allah granted us these things.
en_old: So that is how we all became brothers. Today, it is a great kindness of Allah upon us, a grace, that Allah has granted us these things from our mother's womb.

brh: اگہ نن اینواوفتا قربانی او اوفتا رحمدلی نا وجہ غن ننا اگہ دا گڑا ئے او کتورہ نن خبر اف اینو اراڑے اسنہ۔ دا نم ہبوداخسو بھلو ہیت او۔
en: If today, because of their sacrifice and their compassion, if they had not done this for us, we don't know where we would be today. You see, this is such a great thing.
en_old: If today, because of their sacrifices and their compassion, if they had not done this, we do not know where we would be today. You see, this is such a great thing.

brh: حالانکہ نم صحابات آ ایلو قصہغات ئے ہبو کہ تینا ہنا دین نا خاطرا، تینا ہر گڑات ئے الار،تینا مال، تینا جان نا کل گڑانا تینا ہر گڑات ئے الار ہنا دین نا خاطرا پیش تمار کہ بھئی نن پیش تمون پھگہ دے اینو اگہ او پیش تمتورہ ننا انت حال مسکہ۔ اینو ننا ہراڑے مسنہ۔
en: Indeed, look at the other stories of the Companions: how for the sake of that religion of theirs they left everything of theirs, their wealth, their life, everything they had, they left it all and set out for the sake of that religion, saying, 'Brother, let us set out, for the sake of tomorrow.' Today, if they had not set out, what would our condition have been? Where would we be today?
en_old: Indeed, listen to the other stories of the Companions, how for the sake of their religion they left everything, their wealth, their lives, everything they had, they left it all and came forward for the sake of religion, saying, 'Let us come forward.' If they had not come forward that day, what would our state be today? Where would we be today?

brh: ہموفتا قربانی نا وجہ غان نن کہاللہ داخسو بھلو اسہ آسانیس کرے کہ ننا۔
en: Because of their sacrifice, Allah made such a great ease for us.
en_old: Because of their sacrifice, Allah made things so much easier for us.

brh: تو مقصد داد اے کہ بندغ تینٹ ہم خیر خواہی کے، تینٹ ہم جوانو کاریم کے، تینٹ ہم دین نا کاریم کے تو داسا نم اینو ہبو ہموتا قربانی نا وجہ غان داسا بلوچستان نا ہننو علاقہ او ہرا علاقہ غاتے ٹی داسا پنجگور اے، پنجگور ئٹی بھی فرمائفنگٹن اے کہ ہموڑے ہن ہراکہ ا-ا- منہ صحابا نا ہموڑے قبر اریر ایلم دا انت ئکہ بسر۔
en: So the point is that a person should himself also do good to others, should himself also do good deeds, should himself also do the work of religion. So now, look, today, because of their sacrifice, there are now such areas of Balochistan, among them Panjgur; in Panjgur too it is said that there, uh, there are graves of some Companions. Brothers, why did they come?
en_old: So the point is that a person should himself show goodwill, should himself do good deeds, should himself do the work of religion. Now you see, because of their sacrifice, there are now regions of Balochistan, regions such as Panjgur, and in Panjgur too it is said that there are graves of some Companions there. Why did they come?

brh: دا بسر خیر خواہی کہ ہن کہ بھئی دا کلمہ زندہ مرے دا مخلوقاک مسلمان مریر مونی کہ دافتے کہ آسانی مرے۔ سندھ ئنا علاقہس ئس ارے اوڑیم ہندنو اسہ خلق ئس اے ہموخل ئٹی ہم فرمائفرہ کہ ہرا مسہ ہراکہ صحابا اودافتم قبر مبارک اریر۔ دا انت ئکہ بسر اوڑے۔
en: They came out of goodwill, so that, brother, this Kalima would stay alive, these people would become Muslims, and things would be easy for them in the future. There is an area of Sindh; there too there is such a village, and in that village too they say that three Companions, their blessed graves are there too. Why did they come there?
en_old: They came out of goodwill, so that this Kalima would stay alive, so that these people would become Muslim, so that things would be easier for them ahead. There is a region of Sindh, there is a place there too, and in that place too it is said that there are the blessed graves of three Companions. Why did they come there?

brh: دا بسرک دا وجہ غن اوڑے بسرکہ بھئی دام ننا کہ ہخس کہ امت اے اللہ نا نبی نا دا دوزخ ان بچرجنت ٹی کار۔
en: They came, they came there for this reason: that, brother, these too, for us, however many are the ummah of the Prophet of Allah, may they be saved from Hell and go to Paradise.
en_old: They came there for this reason, that as many as there are of the ummah of the Prophet of Allah should be saved from Hell and brought into Paradise.

brh: دا ہنا وجہ غن دا کوشش کریر ہنا وجہ غن دا مخلوق محنت کرے کوشش کرے کہ بھئی دافت ئے نن دا گڑاتے او اللہ نا ذات آن کہ دہنو مہربانو اللہ کریم ذات ئس اے۔
en: For this reason they made this effort; for this reason these people worked hard and strove, so that, brother, these people, we, would get these things from Allah's being, who is such a kind, generous being.
en_old: For this reason they made efforts, for this reason these people worked hard and strove, so that we would get these things from Allah, who is such a kind and generous being.

brh: اسہ واقعہس بننگ اے کہ حجاز بن یوسف ہراتم کہنگٹ اسکہ اونا لمہ جیجا زاروقطارہوغنگٹ اس پاریکہ کنا مار کنا مڷ ا-ا- تو مار پارے تہ اے کنا لمہ نی انتئے ہوغسہ تو پارے کنا مار خبر کہ نی ارانگ دوزخ ئٹی کاسہ یا ا-ا- جنت ئٹی تو تینا لمہ ئے پارے کنا لمہ جیجا اگہ اللہ جان نمے اسہ دنیا ٹی اسہ ہندنو گڑاس ایتہ کہ دا نما مار اے دادے نم دوزخ ئٹے بٹنگ خوارے یا جنت ئٹی تو کنا لمہ نم انت کرورے؟
en: There is a story that when Hajjaj bin Yusuf was dying, his mother, his mommy, was weeping bitterly, saying, 'My son, my son.' So the son said, 'O my mother, why are you weeping?' She said, 'My son, who knows whether you will go to Hell or, uh, to Paradise.' So he said to his mother, 'My mother, mommy, if dear Allah gave you, in this world, such a thing, saying this is your son, would you want to throw him into Hell or into Paradise? Then, my mother, what would you do?'
en_old: There is an incident that when Hajjaj bin Yusuf was dying, his mother was weeping bitterly, saying, 'My son, my son.' So the son said, 'Mother, why are you crying?' She said, 'My son, who knows whether you will go to Hell or to Paradise.' So he said to his mother, 'Mother, if Allah gave you such a thing in this world, saying this is your son, would you want to throw him into Hell or into Paradise? So, my mother, what would you do?'

brh: تو او پارے کنا مڷ ا- اگر اللہ جان دہنو اسہ ہیتس کے تو ای تینا مارے
en: So she said, 'My son, uh, if dear Allah does such a thing, then I, my son...'
en_old: So he said, my son, if Allah does such a thing, then I [will send] my son...

brh: لازمی جنت ئٹی راہی کروٹ تو گڑا او پارے کنا لمہ، کنا جیجا، کنا گودی ای نے کہ خیرات مریو کہ دا اللہ نا دنیا نا اسہ لمہ سے ارے داخہ کن تن مہر کیرہ او کنے ہمو اللہ مہربان نا، کریم نا زیا بھاز بھلو اسہ گڑاس مروک کہ کن کہ بھاز بہتر مرو۔
en: ...would certainly send to Paradise.' Then he said, 'My mother, my mommy, my lady, may I be your sacrifice: if a mother of this world of Allah loves me this much, then from that kind, generous Allah there will be something very great for me, which will be much better for me.'
en_old: I will surely send him to Paradise. Then he said, my mother, my dear, my lap — I would be sacrificed for you, for there is a mother in this world of Allah who shows so much love; [and] that gracious, generous Allah would have something far greater for me, which would be much better for me.

brh: تو پاننگ نا مقصد داد اے کہ ہمیشہ بندغ اللہ نا اسہ ہمو مہربانی او اللہ نا رب العزت نا ہراکہ شہ- ننا زیا شفقت اے ننا زیا انت اے۔ دا گڑاغان بندغ کبھی انت مفک۔ تو ہمیشہ بندغ دا گڑاک اریرک۔
en: So the point of saying this is that always a person, that kindness of Allah, of Allah the Lord of Glory, which is His compassion upon us, whatever is upon us, a person is never left without these things. So a person always has these things.
en_old: So the point of saying this is that a person [should always remember] that kindness of Allah, the Lord of Glory, which is His compassion upon us, His [grace] upon us. A person is never without these things. So a person always has these things.

brh: اینو نن شکراے اللہ نا کہ اللہ رب العزت نمے ننے لمہ نا خمب ئٹی عظیمو اسہ ننے اسہ کلمہس ننے اللہ عطا فرمائفے۔ اینوبم ہبواگہ اللہ نا نبی نا دا قربانیک او صحابات آ قربانیک دا متورہ ننا نما انت حال مسکہ ہاں؟ تو داکا مست ئنا ہرا مخلوق ہراکہ اسرہ بندغاک۔
en: Today we give thanks to Allah that Allah, the Lord of Glory, granted you and us, in our mother's lap, a great thing, Allah granted us a Kalima. Today too, look, if these sacrifices of the Prophet of Allah and the sacrifices of the Companions had not happened, what would our, your condition have been, eh? So the people before this, those who were, the people...
en_old: Today we thank Allah that Allah, the Lord of Glory, granted us, in our mother's womb, a great Kalima. Today, look, if these sacrifices of Allah's Prophet and the sacrifices of the Companions had not been there, what would our condition be, yes? So the people before us, those who were people [of the past]...

brh: پاننگٹن او کہ اوفتا ہرابسرہ ہمونبیک اوفتا زیا محبت کریرہ ہیت ئے ہلتورہ او اوفتا ہیت ئے ہلتورہ گڑاس ہنو نبی اسرہ ہرا بسکہ نبی اونا اسہ امتیس اس۔ گڑاس نا ہنو اسرہ پنجا اسرہ۔ گڑاس نا سد اسرہ۔ اوفت ئے پاریرہ نم خوانبو کلمہ نم کامیاب مرورہ۔ ہرا وخت ئنا اونا نبیت آ ہیت ئے ہلککہ او مسرہ ہنارہ۔
en: It is said that the prophets who came to them, those prophets loved them, but they would not accept the word, they would not accept their word. There were some prophets who came, and the prophet had only one follower. Some had so many, fifty; some had a hundred. They would tell them, 'Recite the Kalima and you will be successful.' Whenever someone accepted the word of his prophet, they would make it through.
en_old: It is said that whichever prophets came to them, they would love them and they would not listen to them; they would not listen to their words. Some prophet would come and the prophet would have just one follower. Some had five, some had fifty, some had a hundred. They would tell them: recite the Kalima and you will be successful. Whenever they did not listen to their prophets, they were destroyed.

brh: اگہ کس ئس ہلتوکہ اونا ناکام مسرہ۔ تو نن ہخسو بھلو اللہ نا ننا زیا احسان ئس اے کہ اللہ رب ال داخسو عظیمو ہستیس عطا فرمائفینے۔
en: If someone did not accept, they would fail. So how great a favor of Allah is upon us, that Allah the Lord has granted us such a great personality.
en_old: If someone did not listen, they failed. So it is such a great favor of Allah upon us that Allah, the Lord, has granted us such a great personality.

brh: تو داکا زیادہ ننے پ- پین انت مریک کہ ہرا ہمیشہ نن کہ صحب شام چڑہ غا اوغاکہ مصلح غا اللہ نا ارا ٹی، مسیت ئٹی نن کہ ہمیشہ دوت ئے تینا بڑزا کریکہ کہ یا اللہ کنا دا بندغات آ زیا نی بھازبھلوانت ئس کیس۔
en: So what more than this could there be for us, that he would always, for us, morning and evening, always weep on the prayer mat, in the house of Allah, in the mosque; for us he would always raise his hands, saying, 'O Allah, do something very great for these people of mine.'
en_old: So what more can there be for us than this, that always, morning and evening, on the prayer mat, in the presence of Allah, in the mosque, he would always raise his hands [and say]: O Allah, show great [mercy] upon these servants of mine.

brh: ببا خواکہ نن قربان مرین کہ اینو نن کہ داخہ درو اسہ بھلو گڑاس جوڑ کرے ہنا۔ حتی کہ نم دا ہبوکہ ہراتم دا دنیا غان ہننگٹ اس۔ دنیا غن ہںنگٹن اے خواجہ ولام دوک بڑزا او ہاں مہربانا اللہ غن کہ اے اللہ کنا دا بندغات آ انت مرو؟ کنا امتی نا انت مرو؟
en: Oh dear, may we be sacrificed for him, for today he made such a great thing for us. Even, look at this, when he was leaving this world, the Master is leaving the world, and still his hands are raised, yes, to the merciful Allah: 'O Allah, what will become of these people of mine? What will become of my ummah?'
en_old: Come, may we be sacrificed for him, who today made such a great thing for us. Even, you see, when he was leaving this world — leaving this world — he raised his hands to the kind Allah: O Allah, what will become of these servants of mine? What will become of my Ummah?

brh: تو آخراٹ ہم ہننگٹے اے نن کہ نیک دعا کننگٹن اے دوت ئے بڑزا کرینے۔ ہاں ہمو دوتا بڑزا کننگ ان پداللہ رب العزت صحابات ئے جوڑ کرے۔ ہنو ہننو بھلو قربانی تسر علاقہاتے ٹی تینا علاقہات ئےالاراوکا پیش تمارہرعلاقہات ئے ٹی سر مسر۔ دا پو- مچ ہخس ئے کہ ارے کلا دنیا ٹی دا ہنارسرمسر۔
en: So even at the end, as he is going, he is making good prayers for us; he has raised his hands. Yes, after that raising of the hands, Allah, the Lord of Glory, made the Companions what they were. They gave such great sacrifices in the lands: they left their own lands and then set out, and reached every land. All of it, however much there is, in the whole world they went and arrived.
en_old: So even at the end, as he was leaving, he was praying for good and had raised his hands. Yes, after raising those hands, Allah, the Lord of Glory, made the Companions. They gave such great sacrifices; they left their own lands and set out, and reached [other] lands. How many of them are there — all over the world they went and arrived.

brh: ہراڑے داسا نن نما داگڑانے پاننگ اٹ دہنکہ پنجگور ئٹی آ- چار پنچ قبراوہرا ہنا صحابات آ ارے۔ گڑاس سندھ ئٹن اواے علاقات ئے ٹی اریر۔ تو کنا ایلم دا انت ئکہ بسنو۔ دا کل ہنا دین ئنا محنت کہ بسرکہ دین اینو ننا نمے ٹی ننے ٹی دا اگہ زندہ مرو
en: For example, as we are now telling you these things: in Panjgur there are four or five graves which are of the Companions. Some are in Sindh and in those areas. So, my brothers, why did they come? They all came for the effort of the religion, so that the religion, today, among us, among you, among us, if it would be alive...
en_old: Where now, as we are telling you these things — for example in Panjgur there are four or five graves which are of those Companions. Some are in Sindh and in these areas. So my brothers, why did they come? They all came for the effort of religion, so that religion would be alive today among us and you.

brh: تو نن کہ بھاز بھلو فائدہس مرو۔ تو ہنا رحمدلی نا وجہ غان خیر خواہی نا اللہ رب ال نے کہ نن کہ کل ئکہ اسہ بھاز بھلواسہ آسانیس کرے۔
en: ...then it will be of very great benefit to us. So because of that compassion and goodwill, Allah the Lord made a very great ease for you, for us, for all of us.
en_old: So it will be of great benefit to us. So because of their compassion and goodwill, Allah, the Lord, has made a very great ease for all of us.

brh: پین اسہ گڑاس ای نمے پاننگ اٹ کہ ہندنوگڑاس بننگٹن اوہرا واقعہاک ہرافتے ٹی ا-ا- ننے اسکا ننے براہوئی مخلوق ئے ہمو ہرا کہ بلوچستان نا دا ہراکہ بھلا مخلوقاک پارہ اینو ہبوننا پیرنگاک اسرہ حالانکہ ہچو دہنوپین گڑاس سکول ئس الو، دا گڑاک الورہ ولام نمازے تینا خوانارہ، خیرخواہی اس۔
en: Another thing I am telling you: such things are heard, such events, in which, uh, up to us, to us Brahui people, those of Balochistan, which the elder people say: today, look, our elders were like that; even though there was nothing else of the kind, no school, these things did not exist, still they would say their prayers, and there was goodwill.
en_old: Another thing I am telling you: such things are coming, such events, in which — up to us, our Brahui people of Balochistan — the elders say: look, our ancestors were [like this], even though there was no school or anything like that, these things didn't exist, but they would offer their prayers; there was goodwill.

brh: اینو نن گڑات ئے داسا خواننگ ان دا اینوان مست ہزارا سال مست اوفتا تہ ٹی اسرہ۔ او دا گڑاک نن کہ بھاز بھلو اسہ گڑاس اے۔ تواچھا ننا براہوئی مخلوق ہراکہ بلوچستان ئٹن اے دافتا ہراکہ ہ-ہ- اسلامی ت-تریقہات کو ہرافتے ٹی ننا مخلوق کہ تینا چنات آ برام ئے ایترہ اور اوفتے دا کل ہنا ننے اسکا اریر۔
en: Today we are now reading about things that were among them thousands of years before today. And these things are a very great thing for us. So, well, our Brahui people who are in Balochistan, their, uh, Islamic customs, in which our people hold their children's weddings, all of these of theirs have come down to us.
en_old: Today we are now reading things that were among them thousands of years before today. And these things are a very great thing for us. So, well, our Brahui people who are in Balochistan, their Islamic ways in which our people marry off their children, all of that has come down to us.

brh: داسا ننا علاقہ نا ہراکہ چھنکا چناک اوبراہوئیک او صحب ئنا مالو بش مریرہ۔ دا بش مننگ ان پد تینا ہراکہ مال ئے، تینا گڑاک او ہراکہ بزگل اے دافت ئے ہرفرہ پیش تمرہ۔ تو دا اسلام ہم دا گڑا ننے پارینے کہ صحب ئنا مالو بش مبو۔ او ہنا گڑا ٹی خیر خواہی اے بش مرورے
en: Now in our area, the small children who are Brahuis get up early in the morning. After getting up, they take their livestock, their things and the goats, and set out. So Islam too has told us this: get up early in the morning. And in that there is good; you will get up...
en_old: Now in our area, the young Brahui children wake up early in the morning. After waking up they take their livestock, their things, and their flocks and go out. So Islam too has told us this: wake up early in the morning. And in that there is goodness; you will wake up.

brh: اور کل ان مست صحب ئنا مالو بش مریسہ اوٹی رزق ئٹی ہم اللہ نما بھاز بھلو اسہ برکت ئس تخکک۔ تو اوکا علاوہ دا گڑاک کہ ہرا ننے اسکا بسنو۔ دا اینو بتنو کنا ایلم داہزارا سال مست ئنااو اوہنا قربانی نا ہنا ق- ہنا قربان قربانیت آ وجہ غن کہ نن کہ اینو اللہ آسانی فرمائفے۔
en: ...and by getting up early in the morning before everyone, Allah puts a very great blessing in your sustenance too. So besides that, these things that have come down to us, my brothers, these have come today from thousands of years before, and it is because of their sacrifices that Allah has granted us ease today.
en_old: And by waking up early in the morning before everyone, Allah also puts a very great blessing in your sustenance. So besides that, these things that have come down to us — these have come today, my brothers, from thousands of years ago, and because of those sacrifices of theirs, Allah has granted us ease today.

brh: نم ہبو نا کہ داخہ درارا کہ صحاباک اسرہ اور اللہ نا نبی نا اسکہ دا قربانیک اور ہراتم کہ اللہ نا نبی دا جنگ کرے دین ئنا خاطرآ، پیش تما اور دا مخلوق دا انت جہاد کرے دا انت وجہ ان کرے؟
en: Look, you see how much it was: the Companions were there, and these sacrifices of the Prophet of Allah too; and when the Prophet of Allah fought this war for the sake of religion and set out, and these people waged this jihad, for what reason did they do it?
en_old: Don't you see how much the Companions were, and these sacrifices of Allah's Prophet; and when Allah's Prophet fought this war for the sake of religion, he went out, and these people — what jihad did they do, and for what reason did they do it?

brh: دا نم کہ نن کہ کرے ہرا کہ ہنو اسرہ ہراکہ ہمو ٹیم ئنا تینا علاقہ نا بھازبھلو پنیئو بندغ اسرہ۔ دا بندغاک تینا کس ئس تا ہمو علاقہ نا بھلوس اس۔ ہراتم کہ دا تینا اسلام ئٹی بسرہر گڑا ئے الار دہنکہ حضرت عمر فاروق اسکہ ہاں۔
en: They did it for you and for us: those who were such that at that time they were very famous people of their area. Each of these people was a leader of that area. When they came into Islam, they left everything, as Hazrat Umar Farooq did, yes.
en_old: What you and we did — those people who were, at that time, very well-known people of their area. These people were the leaders of their area. When they came into Islam, they left everything, like Hazrat Umar Farooq, yes.

brh: ہراتم دین ئٹی لگا تو پارے کہ ای ہموعمرفاروق اٹ کہ کنے تینا باوہ جان کنے راہی کرے کہ ہچات ئے خواف، ای تینا ہچات ئے جھلنگ کتوٹہ۔ ہاں ہراتم ای دین ئٹی کہ دوانزہ لکھ ا-ا- دوانزہ لکھ مربع ایریا نا یعنی کہ پائہہ ای انت مسٹک کنے ہمو امیرجوڑکریرتودا دین ئٹی۔
en: When he joined the religion, he said: 'I am that Umar Farooq whom my dear father sent to graze the camels, and I could not even herd my camels. Yes, when I came into the religion, of twelve lakh, uh, twelve lakh square [miles] of area, I mean, what did I become? They made me the Amir, so in this religion.'
en_old: When he joined the religion, he said: I am that Umar Farooq whom my father sent to herd the camels, and I could not herd my camels. Yes, when I [came] into religion, of twelve lakh — twelve lakh square [miles of] area — I mean, I became, they made me the Amir in this religion.

brh: ولا فرمائفیکہ ای دین ئٹی بسٹ ای کنے دین چمکفے۔ توہاں دا گڑاک او تو حضرت ابو بکر صدیق نا اونا واقہ نما مون اٹ او ہاں کہ اللہ نا دین نا انت مرے اوٹی گڑاس مونی پدی مرے اورابوبکر زندہ مرے۔ اینو اگہ دین ئنا ہراکہ قربانیک او توابوبکرنا قربانیک او۔ حضرت عمرنا قربانیک او۔
en: Then he would say, 'I came into the religion, and the religion made me shine.' So yes, these are the things; and the story of Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq is before you, yes: that anything should happen to Allah's religion, that something in it should be changed, while Abu Bakr is alive? Today, if we have the religion, its sacrifices are Abu Bakr's sacrifices, they are Hazrat Umar's sacrifices.
en_old: Then he would say: I came into religion, religion made me shine. So yes, these things, and the story of Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq is before you, yes: [he said] what would become of Allah's religion if something in it changed while Abu Bakr is alive? Today, if there is religion, it is because of the sacrifices of Abu Bakr, the sacrifices of Hazrat Umar.

brh: غاتے ٹی خلقاتے ٹی تو چناک داڑے امر تعلیم ئے دوئی کننگ کرورک تعلیم دوئی کننگ کن ہم اسہ ماحولس آسراتی ئس ہمو گڑات آ پوروئی مننگ المی اے اسہ سکول ئسے ٹی استادنا مننگ ماڑی سے نا تفنگ ہمو ماڑی ٹی
en: ...areas, in the villages. So how will children here be able to get an education? To get an education, an environment and facilities are also needed; it is necessary for those things to be in place: a teacher being present in a school, a building being put up, and in that building...
en_old: ...and regions. So how can children get an education here? To get an education, an environment and facilities must also be in place: a teacher in a school, a building, and in that building...

brh: ولدا ہرا کہ پین سہولتاک او کڑسی مرے ٹیبل مرے او ہرا کہ خواننگ نا پین ایلو آسراتیک او
en: ...and then the other facilities there are, whether chairs or tables, and the other facilities for studying...
en_old: ...then the other facilities too, like chairs and tables, and the other facilities needed for studying.

brh: دور ئٹی دنیا بھاز مونی ہںانے ولے داسکان نن تو ہمو چاک ئنا ہراکہ نن بلیک بورڈائے استعمال کینہ ہمو تو نن تو داسکان او ننا چناک داسکان پڑچاتے آ تولرہ ننا داسکان ہرا کہ سکولاک او اوتاچھتاک داسکان کیڑا
en: ...in this era the world has gone far ahead, but we still use that chalk and the blackboard. We still... and our children still sit on mats. Our schools and their roofs are still...
en_old: In this era the world has moved far ahead, but we are still using chalk and the blackboard. Our children still sit on mats. Our schools and their roofs are still made of mud...

brh: ٹی او اوتا چھتاک کچہ او سکول نا دیوالاک کچہ او ہرسال سکول ئے لپائی کہ شار ئنا مخلوق بیوساک تینا آ تینٹ کارہ سکولاک ئے لپائی کیرہ کچہ انگا وختس کہ بھلو دیرئس بس سکول ئے دیر دیک تو داڑے سکول نا حالت ہندن مریک کہ موسمات آ نا وجہ
en: ...their roofs are mud and the school walls are mud. Every year the poor, helpless people of the town go on their own and plaster the school; they plaster the schools, the mud ones. When a big flood comes, the water carries the school away, so the condition of the schools here is such that because of the weather...
en_old: ...and their roofs are mud and the school walls are mud. Every year the poor people of the town plaster the school themselves, with their own hands. They plaster the schools with mud. When heavy rain comes and it rains on the school for a long time, the school's condition here becomes such that because of the weather...

brh: غان سکولاک کیئی ہفتہ غاک بند مریرہ ہفتہ غات آ ہفتہ تو تا توک بند مریرہ تو داڑے اسہ دے ئس اسہ چنا سے نا اگر اونا سبق ضائع مس دہن چا اونا زندگی ٹی بھلو اسہ کمی ئس بسک اسہ او بھاز پدی تما دہن کہ اسہ واقعس بزرگس پائک کہ
en: ...the schools stay closed for several weeks; they stay closed for weeks on end. So here, if a child's lesson is lost for even one day, you know, a big gap comes into his life and he falls far behind. It is like a story: an elder says that...
en_old: ...the schools close for several weeks, for weeks at a time. So if a child here misses his lesson for one day, a big gap opens up in his life and he falls far behind. It's like the story an elder tells, that...

brh: کہ اسہ بزرگ ئس تولوک اسکہ تو اودے پاریر کہ فلانی نا مچا ارا ہشنگا تو او پارے ہچ مسلہ اف ہچ متو ولدا زرسے آن پد پاریر تہ کہ فلانی گاڈی ہشنگا پائہہ اودے ہم ہچ اف مسلہ اف تو زرسے آ اسٹ ئس بس پائہہ فلانی نا چنا سکول آ
en: ...that an elder was sitting, and they told him that so-and-so's whole house had burned down. He said, 'No problem, nothing has happened.' Then after a while they told him that so-and-so's car had burned. He says, 'That's nothing either, no problem.' Then after a while someone came and says that so-and-so's child, to school...
en_old: ...an elder was sitting, and they told him that so-and-so's whole house had burned down. He said, 'No problem, it doesn't matter.' Then a little later they told him that so-and-so's car had burned. He said that was no problem either. Then a little later someone came and said that so-and-so's child, on the way to school...

brh: ہننگ نا ارے آ سکول آ سر مس تو استاد ہمو سبخ ئے ختم کریسس تو پائہہ تینا ہور ئے
en: ...being late in going, got to school late, and the teacher had already finished that lesson. Then, they say, he [put] his finger...
en_old: ...was late, and when he got to school the teacher had already finished the lesson. Then, they say, he bit his finger...

brh: دندانتے ٹے ہلک فریشان مس پائہہ او او او بھلو نسخانس مس دا پارے دا قصہ نا واقعہ نا داد اے کہ او پارے کہ زند ئٹی دا ہرا کہ دنیا نا نسخاناک او ہچ نسخانس اف نا زند ئٹے اگہ سبخ ننا ارے مس تعلیم نا
en: ...between his teeth and became distressed. He says, 'That, that, that is a big loss that has happened.' What he said, the point of this story, this incident, is that he said that in life these losses of the world are no loss at all in your life, but if our lesson, our education...
en_old: ...between his teeth and got upset, and said that this was a big loss. The point of this story is that he said the world's losses are no loss at all in your life, but if we miss a lesson, if we miss our education...

brh: ارے مس یا اسہ دیس نی سکول آ ارے آ ہناس ہرا وخت کہ استاد سبخ ئے خوانفے ایسر کرے ولدا نی سرمسس دا اسہ بھاز بھلو نسخان ئس اے انت ئکن کہ داوخت ئے نی ولدا پدی ہتنگ کپیسہ ہرا کہ تعلیم اس ہرا کہ نا دے اس ہرا کہ نا
en: ...is missed through lateness, or one day you go to school late, at a time when the teacher has finished teaching the lesson and you arrive afterwards, that is a very big loss, because you can never bring that time back again. That was education, that was your day, that was your...
en_old: ...or if one day you go to school late and arrive after the teacher has finished teaching the lesson, that is a very big loss, because you can never bring that time back. That was your education, that was your day, that was your...

brh: سبخ نا وخت اس او ہنا داسا پورا دنیا ہخس اسہ سیڈ مرے نی ہمو وخت ئے واپس پدی ہتنگ کپیسہ تو داڑے دا پاش مس کہ تعلیم بھاز اہم اے بندغ کن بھاز المی اے داڑان تو پو نا زندئٹی اسہ بھاز بھلو اگہ
en: ...lesson time, and it is gone. Now even if the whole world were to come together on one side, you cannot bring that time back. So here it became clear that education is very important, very necessary for a person. From this, understand that in your life a very big [loss happens] if...
en_old: ...lesson time, and it is gone. Now even if the whole world tries its hardest, you cannot bring that time back. So it became clear here that education is very important and essential for a person. From this he understood that in life a very big...

brh: وختس کہ او اسہ دے ئس اسہ دے ہم نہ بلکہ اسہ پیرڈ ئس اسہ پیرڈ ئٹے اسہ استاد ئسے نا اسہ سبخ آ اگہ سر متو تو ہمو بزرگ نا وڑاٹ کہ بھاز بھلو نسخان ئس مس اینا گاڈی ہشنگا نہ ہچ مسلہ اف اوپھگہ واپس اونا بدل بریک اینا ہر ہشنگا ہچ
en: ...at some time, one day, and not even one day but one period, if in one period he did not make it to one teacher's lesson, then, in the manner of that elder, a very big loss has happened. If your car burns, no, no problem, tomorrow its replacement comes back. If your house burns, no...

brh: اوفتے ٹی کل ئٹی ہندا ارے مسلہ داسکان کہ او ہراکہ اینو پھگہ پوسکن انگا وخت ئٹی بروکا کہ اسٹ ایلو تون اوار تخنگ کہ دنیا بھازا مونا ہنانے بلے ننے ہرا کہ ننا معاشرہ ٹی ننا علاقہ کن ننا مخلوقاک او۔ اودافتان کل آن پدی تمانو۔
en: In all of them there is still this same problem: the new things of today's times for keeping connected with one another. The world has moved far ahead, but we, those who are our people in our society and of our area, have fallen behind everyone in these things.
en_old: In all of them there is still this same problem: the new means of these times for staying connected with each other. The world has moved far ahead, but our people in our society, in our area, have fallen behind in all of this.

brh: ننا کل آن داسکان کہ ہمو علاقہ تے ٹی متکن انگا مر انگا خبر ہلنگ آن ہمو ریڈیوت ئے استعمال کیرہ۔ باقی ہراکہ چھنکا چھنکا شہراک اریرک اوفتے ٹی گڑاس ہندا بروکا سوشل میڈیا پاس، یا ٹی وی پاس یا داگڑاک او خبرت ئے ہلیرہ۔
en: Most of ours in those old, remote areas still use those radios to get news. As for the rest, the small towns that exist, some in them get the news through the new social media, or through TV, or such things.
en_old: Most of our people in those areas, the far-off ones, still use those radios to get news. The other, smaller towns get some news through the new social media, TV or such things.

brh: باقی خبر ہلنگ آن کل آن ہمودے کہ داسکان کہ مخ- مختلف انگا مست ئنا ہمو وڑ ئے استعمال کیرہ۔ ای جند کنا، کنا جند ئنا یاد ہندا بریک کہ کنا پیرنگا یا کنا وال- او- باوہ صاح- باوہ یا او بانگ- پیرانگا، پیرہ اسکہ داسکان کہ او ہمے ریڈیوت ئے استعمال کریرہ۔ اور داسا کہ بسر مچہ مونا بریرہ۔
en: Otherwise, for getting news, most people still use those va- various old ways. I myself, my own memory is this: my elders, or my fa- father, sir- father, or my grand- elders, grandfather, they still use those same radios. And only now are they coming forward a little.
en_old: As for the rest, to get news most people still use the different old ways. I myself remember that my elders, my father, or my grandfather and the elders still used the radio, and only now are they slowly coming forward.

brh: لیکن ننا ہمو علاقت ئے ٹی بجلی نہ مننگ نا وجہ آن او دسکان کہ پد تموک او۔ بروکنگا چناک، ہرا چھنکا چھنکا چناک او یا داسنا دہن ننا وختاک او۔ دا وختاتے ٹی مونا بننگ اے گڑا او تینا جوانو وخت ئے استعمال کننگ کہ بروکا سوشل میڈیا ئے پاس یا ایلوتن ہلیرہ۔ داسا کہ ہرا ننا معاشرہ ٹے۔
en: But because there is no electricity in those areas of ours, they have still fallen behind. The coming children, the very small children, or our present times, like now: in these times, things are moving forward, so they use their good time, getting [news] through the new social media or from others. Now, what is in our society,
en_old: But because there is no electricity in those areas of ours, they are still behind. The coming children, the small children, or people of our time like now, are moving forward in these times, so they make good use of their time by getting news through the new social media or other things. brh: ننا مخلوق اے داسکان کہ حوال کیک اسٹ ایلو آن خبر ہلیک۔ اورسرس پند مریک تینا علاقہ آن دانگے آ۔
en: our people still ask after each other's news and get information from one another. And in this way they become aware of things in their area.
en_old: our people still exchange news and get information from each other. And they learn something about their area this way.

brh: ننا جند داسکان کہ کانہ علاوہ غئے داسکان کہ ہمو وڑ مرینہ کہ زنڈنہ اسہ جاگہ کل ارا والاک، چھنکاک، بھلاک مطلب رشتہ داراک ہمسایک کل تولنہ اسٹ ایلو آن ہنداخبرت ئے ہلینہ کہ بھئی نم ا انت مسنے ارکا انت مسنے اراڑے انت گدرینگانے۔ دا کل ئے اسٹ ایلو آن تینا بننہ۔
en: We ourselves, when we go to the area, are still that same way: we sit in one place, all the household members, young and old, I mean relatives and neighbours, all of us sit and get this news from one another: 'Brother, what has happened to you (pl.), what has happened to whom, what has been going on where.' We hear all of this from one another.
en_old: We ourselves, apart from that, are still the same way: we meet in one place, everyone, young and old, I mean relatives and neighbors, we all sit together and get this news from each other: brother, what has happened to you, what has happened to whom, what has happened where. We hear all this from each other.

brh: داسکان کہ نن مطلب ہمے وخت ئنا وڑات ئے کرسا ان۔ ننا دیہاتے ٹی، ننا خلقاتے ٹی، ننا مرانگا خلقاتے ٹی ہمو وڑاک چلینگسہ او۔ بروکا کہ بازاراک کہ اریرشاراک ہرا اریرک۔
en: We are still, I mean, following the ways of that time. In our villages, in our settlements, in our remote settlements, those ways are still going on. The new ones, the markets and towns that exist,

en: in them, nowadays, what they are using for getting news is the new things: they hear each other's news or pick up something from each other's areas; they do all of that. But our areas, which are very far off, still use [the things] of that same time.
en_old: today they use the new things to get news, to hear each other's news or to pick up something from each other's areas; they do all of that. But our areas, which are far off, still use the ways of that old time.

brh: باقی بوجھ داسکا اینو پھگہ ہرا کہ اریر اگہ سہ- دنیا ٹی چلینگسہ او۔ او کلاک او کلاک ہنداد اے کہ مونائے کارہ پوسکنو گڑا استعمال کیرہ۔
en: Otherwise, the rest nowadays, those who exist, if ... who are going along in the world, all of them, all of them, it is like this: they go forward and use new things.
en_old: As for the rest, those that exist today and are going on in the world, all of them go forward and use new things.

brh: پوسکنو گڑا ہتیرہ اوفتے کہ بننگ کہ، او اسٹ ایلو تو خڑک مننگ آن اسٹ ایلو تون ہیت کننگ آن، اسٹ ایلو تون بننگ آن یا اسٹ ایلو نا مسلہ تے اسہ جاگہ ایلوکننگ آن، لیکن ننا مخلوق، ننا مخلوق داسکان کہ ہمے وخت ئنا گڑات ئے استعمال کرسہ اے۔
en: They bring new things in order to hear, and for getting close to each other, for talking with each other, for hearing each other, or for sorting out each other's problems together. But our people, our people are still using the things of that time.
en_old: They adopt new things so that they can hear, get close to each other, talk to each other, listen to each other or solve each other's problems in one place. But our people, our people are still using the things of that old time.

brh: سوج ئس داد اے کہ نی ارا ارا زبانات ئے تیاسہ، اوتے ٹی ہیت کننگ، اوتے ٹی م- سمجھ کننگ او اودے سرسوج کننگ۔ ہیت داد اے اولیکو ہیت داد اے کہ زبان ہندنو گڑاس اے کہ ہر مخلوق کہ دا ضروری اے۔ دا لازمی اے کہ وہ ہر زبان ئے ہیل کے۔
en: One question is this: which languages do you know, speaking in them, und- understanding them, and making inquiries in them. The point is this, the first point is this: language is such a thing that it is necessary for every person. It is essential that he learns every language.
en_old: One question is which languages you know, how well you speak them, how well you understand them, and how you get information from them. The point is, the first point is that language is something that is necessary for every person. It is essential that one learns every language.

brh: ہرا معاشرہ ٹی نی رہینگسہ اونا زبان ئے، اونا وڑات ئے اونا انت حساب کتاباک اواوفتے نی ہمووڑ چلینگسہ تو او علاقہ ٹی نی گدریفنگ کیسہ وخت ئے۔ دہنکہ داسا نن اگر رہینگنہ علاقہ بلوچستان ٹی او اوٹی بھاز زبان مریکک۔
en: Whatever society you live in, if you go along with its language, its ways and whatever its dealings are, in that same way, then you can spend your time in that area. For example, now, if we live in the region of Balochistan, many languages are [spoken] there.
en_old: If you follow the language of the society you live in, its customs and its ways, then you can spend your time in that area. For example, we now live in the region of Balochistan, and many languages are spoken there.

brh: ننا پشتو ہم ارے، براہوئی ہم ارے، بلوچی ہم ارے، فارسی ہم ارے تو ننے دا کل زباناتے ئے اگر ہیل کینہ تو علاقہ ٹی نن رہینگنہ۔ او علاقہ ٹی نن جوانی سے ٹے اسٹ ایلو آن سرپند مرینہ۔ اسٹ ایلو ئے تینا نن جوانی سے ٹے نن بننگ کینہ۔
en: We have Pashto as well, Brahui as well, Balochi as well, Persian as well, so if we learn all these languages, then we [can] live in the region. In that region we understand one another well. We can listen to one another well.
en_old: We have Pashto, we have Brahui, we have Balochi, we have Persian, so if we learn all these languages, we live in the region. In the region we understand one another well. We can get along with one another well.

brh: اسٹ ایلو تو تیان انت کریم ئس مریک، اسٹ ایلو تو تینا رشتہ داری ئس مریک، اسٹ ایلو تو تینا ہمسایہ گری ئس مریک نن تو تو او جوانی سے ٹے گدریفنہ۔
en: Whatever work we have with one another, whatever kinship we have with one another, whatever neighbourliness we have with one another, we spend it well with them.
en_old: Whatever dealings we have with one another, whatever kinship we have with one another, whatever neighbourliness we have with one another, we spend it well with them.

brh: زبان ہندنو گڑاس اے کہ ہراڑے نی رہینگسہ دہنکہ نن سکول ئسے ٹی مرینہ، سکول ئٹی نن کل آن مست ہنداد اے کہ ہرا تینا لمئیئا زبان اے، او لمئیئا بولی اے، اودے ہیل کینہ ارا ٹی، اوڑان پد کانہ کہ سکول ئسے آئے، سکول نا ماحول ٹی نن انت کینہ، ولدا ارے اردو ئے ہیل کینہ۔
en: Language is such a thing, wherever you live. For example, we are in a school. In school, first of all it is this: the one that is our own mother tongue, that mother's language, we learn it at home. After that, when we go to a school, what do we do in the school environment? Then, well, we learn Urdu.
en_old: Language is something like this: wherever you live, for example when we are in a school, in school the first thing is our mother tongue, the mother language; we learn it at home, and after that we come to a school, and in the school environment, what do we do? Then we learn Urdu.

brh: او ہم اسہ زبان ئس اے اودے دا وجہ غان اودے ہیل کینہ کہ نن ہراڑے رہینگنہ، ہراڑے کہ ننا مخلوق، ہرا ننامعاشرہ ٹی مریک، ہراننا مخلوق کہ گڑاس کیک، گڑاس پوسکنو بریکک، گڑاس مریکک یا انتس مننگٹی اے دا کل ئے ہیل کننگ کہ ننے او زبان ئے ہیل کروئی تمک۔
en: That too is a language, and we learn it for this reason: where we live, where our people are, whatever happens in our society, whatever our people do, whatever new comes, whatever happens or whatever is happening, to learn all of this we have to learn that language.
en_old: That is also a language, and we learn it because where we live, where our people are, those in our society, whatever our people do, whatever new things come, whatever happens or is happening, to learn all of this we have to learn that language.

brh: زبان ئے نن ہیل کرین تو نن کہ دا ہچ ولدا مشکل مفکک کہ نن دا زبان ئے کہ ہیل کرینن۔ دوارہ اودے سمجھنک، اوتو ہیت کینک، اونا بارہ ٹی پو مرینک۔ او زبان نا بارہ ٹی نن پو مسن، ہیت کرین، سمجھان تہ۔ ولدا اوکان پد نن اوزبان ئٹی جوان مونا ہننگ کینہ۔
en: Once we have learned a language, it is then not difficult at all, since we have learned this language. Then we understand it, we speak in it, we become familiar with it. We became familiar with that language, we spoke it, we understood it. Then after that we can go well ahead in that language.
en_old: Once we have learned a language, it is then not difficult at all, since we have learned this language. Then we understand it, we speak with them, we become familiar with it. We became familiar with that language, we spoke it, we understood it. Then after that we can progress well in that language.

brh: ہندن کہ ننا ہرا ہمسایہ انگا اریرک۔ ہمسایک اریرک، اوفتا ہرا زبان اے اگہ نن اوتے ہیل کینہ، اوتے سمجھنک تو اوتو نن رشتہ داری ہم کننگ کینہ۔ او تو نن زنڈنگ بش مننگ کننگ کینہ، اوتو نن تینا ہر گڑا ئے کننگ کینہ۔ نن اوتو کاریم کننگ کینہ، نن اوتو ہر گڑا ئے کننگ کینہ۔
en: Likewise, the neighbours we have: there are neighbours, and if we learn whatever their language is and understand them, then we can also form kinship ties with them. We can sit and mix with them, we can do all our things with them. We can work with them, we can do everything with them.
en_old: Likewise, our neighbours who are there. There are neighbours; if we learn their language and understand them, we can also form relationships with them. We can live and get along with them, we can do everything with them. We can work with them, we can do everything with them.

brh: تو زبان ہندا وجہ غان ہر جاگہ ضروری اے۔ نن ہرا زبانت ئے ہیل کینہ تو اوڑان فائدہ داد اے کہ کل آن مست کہ ننا جند ئے فائدہ ملک۔ او داد اے کہ اگر ای ہرا زبان ئے ہیل کریٹک۔
en: So for this reason language is necessary everywhere. Whatever languages we learn, the benefit from it is this: first of all, we ourselves get the benefit. And it is this: if I have learned some language,

en: [if] the four people of that [language] know the meaning of that thing, that language, that talk, then I too will come to know that same thing, understand it and learn it quickly. So that is how language is. Language is learned most of all in that area, by living with those people, sitting and mixing with them, being with all of them; together with that, we learn that language.
en_old: when four people around him talk about the purpose of that thing, that language, that matter, then I will also understand that same thing, become familiar with it, and learn it quickly. So that is how language is. Language is learned most of all in that region, by living with those people, sitting and getting along with them, being with them in all of this; that is how we learn that language.

brh: ہندن کہ کنا جند ئے بریکک تقریبا چار سے پنچ زبان بریک کنے۔ کنے پنچ زبان بریک دانا مطلب ہنداد اے کہ ای دات ئے ہیل کریٹ تو دا وجہ غان ہیل کریٹ کہ کنا سنگتاک، کن تون اوار تولوکاک، کن تو اراو رہینگوکاک دا کل اسہ جاگہ اسرہ۔ داف تو زنڈانہ بش مسنہ۔ داتو ہیت کرینہ۔
en: For example, I myself know about four to five languages. I know five languages, which means that I learned them, and I learned them for this reason: my friends, those who sat with me, those who lived with me in the house, were all in one place. We used to sit and mix with them. We used to talk with them.
en_old: For example, I myself know about four or five languages. I know five languages, which means that I learned them, and I learned them because my friends, those who sat with me, those who lived with me at home, were all in one place. I lived and got along with them. I talked with them.

brh: تو دا ننکہ ہچ اسہ ایلو نا پدآئے گڑاس مفکک۔
en: So for us nothing at all goes on behind one another's backs.
en_old: So for us it is nothing, being behind one another in anything.

brh: تو ہرا وخت نن علاقہ غان پیشن تمان دانگ بسنک تو داڑے مخلوقاک پین زبان اسرہ۔ دہنکہ پنجاب داسا ئٹی پنجابی پارہ تہ، داف تو زنڈان، داف تو بش مسن ہنداد ئے ہیل کرینک۔ ہرا کہ ایلو ہمسایہ ملکات ئے ٹی ارے۔ ہرا ہمسایہ دائیک اریرک نن اوف تو زنڈان اوتا زبان ئے ہیل کرینک۔
en: So when we left our area and came over here, the people here spoke other languages. For example, in Punjab they now speak Punjabi; we sat with them, we mixed with them, and we learned exactly that. The same is in the other neighbouring countries. Whatever neighbours there are here, we sat with them and learned their language.
en_old: So when we came out of our region to here, the people here had other languages. For example, in Punjab they now speak Punjabi; we lived with them, got along with them, and learned that. The same is in the other neighbouring countries. Whatever neighbours are here, we lived with them and learned their language.

brh: ہنداوجہ غان کہ مخلوق ننا کہ کوشش کیک ننا جند ئنا پیش تمان علاقہ غان ہندا کوشش اے ننا کہ ننا علاقہ نا چار بندغ اوکا پیش تمرک، نن کہ ہیل کیر، نن کہ خوانرک تاکہ پھگہ نا دے اگرای اینو پیش تمانٹ تینا ارا کہ، علاقہ کہ چار بندغ ئے کشانٹ، ای جوڑ کرفنگٹ تا تو باید کہ وہ ہم ہندا گڑات ئے کے، او وہ ہم ہنداوڑ جیاڑ کے۔
en: For this reason our people are making an effort; we have come forward from our own area. This is our effort: that a few people from our area come out and come forward, learn for us and study for us, so that tomorrow, if I have come forward today and brought out a few people for my own home and for the area, and I have had them built up, then they too should do the same things, and they too should build up others in the same way.
en_old: For this reason our people try to have some of our own come forward from the area. Our aim is for a few people from our area to come forward, teach us and educate us.
