brh: اوفتے ٹے دادھوکہ بازی ہچ افک او مخلوق ئے ریفپسہ او مخلوق ئے دزپسہ او مخلوق تن دونمبری کپسہ ننا دا مخلوق ننا چاگڑداک دا گڑاتے ان دا گندئیتے ان پر او ہندا وجہ غان ننا چاگڑد اٹ بھروسہ اف ہنداسوب ان نن پدی انک نن مونی ہننگ کپنہ سرسہب
en: Among them there is no such deceitfulness at all; they don't deceive people, they don't steal from people, they don't do crooked dealings with people. Our people, our societies are full of these things, these corruptions, and for this very reason there is no trust in our society. For this very reason we are backward; we cannot go forward, [we cannot become] successful.
en_old: Among them there is no such deception at all; they do not cheat people, they do not rob people, they do not do fraud with people. Our people, our societies are full of these things, these evils, and for this reason there is no trust in our society. For this very reason we are backward; we cannot go forward or become successful.

brh: مننگ کپنہ تودان داڑے ننے دا سرپند مروئی تمک کہ ننے ہروئی تمک کہ واقعی ننا چاگڑد ئٹے امر ارے اف
en: [we] cannot become. So from here we must understand this, we must see how it truly is in our society, whether it is there or not.
en_old: ...So here we must understand, we must see, how truly it is in our society, whether it exists or not.

brh: سہ بھروسہ افک تو اونا نشانیک داد او ہنداوڑ نن پدی ان او ہرا چاگڑد ئٹے سہ بھروسہ نا روتغاک زندہ او تو او سرسہبو شون ہلوکون او بھاز دانا اہمیت ارے تو ولدام اگہ نن پین داد دادے داوڑ اٹ ہم نن ہننگ کینہ
en: Where there is no trust, these are its signs, and in this way we are backward. And the society in which the roots of trust are alive is successful and has progressed, and this has great importance. So then, if we look at this in another way too, we can see
en_old: Where there is no trust, these are its signs, and in this way we are backward. And the society in which the values of trust are alive is successful and developed, and this has great importance. So then, if we look at this in another way too, we can...

brh: کہ اسہ قومس پورا قومس زند تدیفنگ اے اسہ علاقہ سے ٹے اسہ شار ئسے ٹے تو او اسہ ایلو تو سنت و سیوت اٹ اگہ زند تدیفنگ او اوفتے اسہ ایلوڑا بھروسہ ارے تین پتینی ارے اوتے ٹے او اسہ ایلو ئے چارہ سیالداری ارے اوتے ٹے او بھاز آسراتی ٹے زند
en: that a nation, a whole nation, is living its life in an area, in a city; and if they are living life with one another in harmony and togetherness, and they have trust in one another, there is solidarity among them, they know one another, there is kinship among them, then they live life in great prosperity.
en_old: ...see that a nation, a whole nation, is living in an area, in a city, and if they live with one another in harmony, they have trust in one another, they have mutual fellowship among them, they know one another, they have kinship among them, they live their life in great prosperity.

brh: تدیفرہ اوفتا آسراتی نا سوب داوڑمریک کہ ہرا وخت آ کہ دا چاگڑد ئٹے اسہ بندغس فریشان مریک تو پورا مخلوق ہمونا سیڈ آ کارہ مخلوق ہرک اڑے انت ئسے فریشان اے اونا ہمو فریشانی ئے خ ایسر کیرہ اوڑتو کمک کیرہ اگہ اسہ بندغس
en: [they] live. The reason for their prosperity is this: whenever a person in this society becomes troubled, all the people go to his side; the people see what he is troubled about, they put an end to that trouble of his, they help him. If a person
en_old: The reason for their prosperity is this: whenever a person in this society is troubled, all the people go to his side. People see what he is troubled about, they end his trouble, they help him. If a person...

brh: اسہ ے ویل ئس بسک تو ایلو مخلوقاک اونا ویل ئنا ایسری کن اوڑتو کمک کیرہ دادے پارہ بھروسہ والا دادے پارہ تین پتینی سنت و سیوت اگہ کہ اسٹ ئس کنتوک تو ایلوک ہم ہموڑے بھروسہ متووک چاگڑد ئٹے تو ہر اسٹ تینا وڑ تینا اراٹے تینا خاہوت تن تینا
en: If a trouble comes upon one person, the other people help him to put an end to his trouble. This is called being trustworthy; this is called solidarity, harmony and togetherness. If one person did not do so, the others would not either, and there would be no trust there. In such a society, then, each one, in his own way, in his own house, with his own family, on his own,
en_old: When one person has a problem, the other people help them to solve it; this is called trust, this is called mutual custom and tradition. If one person does something, the others also... in a society where there is no trust, everyone lives in their own way, in their own house, with their own family, on their own.

brh: زندئے تدیفک او ولے خلوق ئٹے ا پین ہخس فریشان مریر لنگڑ مریر ملاس مریر پین کسس کس اوڑائے ہپک داخاطران او خلق ئٹے بھروسہ اف اودے دا م دا سرپند مفک کہ آیا جائی نا او ملاس اے جائی نا او لنگڑ اے یا ہندن تینے ظاہن تینے پاش
en: lives his life. And among the people, however much others become troubled, become hungry, become thirsty, nobody else, nobody looks at them. That is because there is no trust among the people; he cannot even tell whether this one is really thirsty, really hungry, or is just showing himself off, putting himself on display
en_old: ...lives their life, but among people, however worried they become, crippled, sick, nobody else cares about them. That is why there is no trust among people; they don't even understand whether he is truly sick, truly crippled, or just pretending, showing himself off...

brh: کننگ اے دا بے بھروسہی نا علامتاک او داڑان بھاز چاگڑداک پدی تمرہ شون ہلپسہ تو بلوچستان نابھاز بھلو اہمیت ئس ارے کہ نن داد ئے پو مرین کہ دا بھاز چاگڑداک ئے مونی دیک او داڑان اوک تینے مونی دننگ ئٹے شون ہلیرہ تو دا وغہ تن پاوہ کہ چاگڑد ئسے کہ بھروسہ
en: is doing so. These are the signs of mistrust, and because of this many societies fall behind; they do not progress. So for Balochistan it is of very great importance that we understand this: that this takes many societies forward, and through it they progress in taking themselves forward. So in this sense I say that for a society, trust
en_old: ...doing so; these are signs of mistrust, and many societies fall behind because of this, they don't develop. So for Balochistan it is of great importance that we understand that many societies move forward because of this, and through it they develop themselves. So in this sense I say that for a society, trust...

brh: بھاز اہمیت تخک
en: holds great importance.
en_old: ...holds great importance.

brh: تو نن ہرا معاشرہ ٹی مرینہ، ہرا جاگہ ئے مخلوق تو مرینہ، ہراوڑ ئٹی مرینہ ہمو زبان ئے ہیل کرین تو ہمو زبان نن کہ بھاز مون آئے جوان مریک۔ زبان اسہ ہندنو گڑاس ئے ہر بندغ کہ بھاز لازمی اے۔ انتئے دا وجہ آن کہ نی اگر زبان ئے ہمو بندغ نا ہیل کریس۔
en: So whatever society we are in, with whatever place's people we are, in whatever way we live, if we learn that language, then that language will be very good for us going forward. Language is something that is very necessary for every person. Because if you learn that person's language,
en_old: So whatever society we are in, whatever place, whatever people we are with, in whatever way we are, if we learn that language, that language takes us far forward. Language is something that is very essential for every person. Because if you learn that person's language,

brh: تواونا ہر ہیت، اونا ہر وڑ، ہر تولنگ بش مننگ، ہر گڑائے نی ہیل کیسہ۔ نن کہ ہرعلاقہ ٹی ہر جاگہ نا زبان ئس جتا اے۔ داسا اگر اینو پھگہ نن دا پوسکن انگا زباناک ہرا کہ مخلوق ئے- ئیافت کرین تا۔
en: then you learn his every word, his every manner, every way of sitting and standing (of socializing), everything. For us, in every region, every place has a different language. Now if today or tomorrow we [come to know] these new languages that people [speak]...
en_old: then you learn his every word, his every manner, every way of sitting and socializing, everything. For us, in every region, every place has a separate language. Now if today and tomorrow we get these new languages that people have...

brh: او تون ہیل کین، او زبانت ئے مرین۔او تون چلینگن،او تولن بش مرین، اودے ہیل کین، او انت کیرہ او ارانگ مونا کارہ نن اوف تون اوار اوفت آ ہیل کین زبان ئٹی اوتا پو مرین تو نن اوتون اوار چلینگنگ کینہ۔ اگہ نن نن دا گڑاتےآ توجہ تتون۔
en: We learn with them, we become part of those languages. We go along with them, we sit and mix with them, we learn it: what they do and which way they move forward. We learn from them, together with them, we come to understand their language, and then we can go along with them. If we did not pay attention to these things,
en_old: We learn with them, we become part of those languages. We walk with them, we sit and get along with them, we learn from them, what they do, how they progress; we learn along with them, become familiar with them in their language, and then we can walk along with them. If we did not pay attention to these things,

brh: نن دا خڑک تولتون، نن دافت ئے ہیل کتون۔ گڑا ننا مطلب ہندا مریک کہ نن اوت آن پد سلنہ۔ تو زبان ہندا وجہ غان بھاز ضروری اے۔ کہ نن ہراڑے مرین، امر مرین او مخلوق نا زبان ئے ہیل کین۔ او ننا جند ئٹی ہندا گڑا ارے کہ ہراڑے ننے شوق مسک کہ ہندا گڑا ئے ای ہیل کیوہ۔
en: if we did not sit close to them, if we did not learn these, then for us it means that we stay behind them. So language is very important for this very reason: wherever we are, however we are, we should learn the language of those people. And within ourselves there is this very thing: wherever we feel the desire, 'I will learn this very thing,'
en_old: if we did not sit near them, if we did not learn these, then it means we stay behind them. So that is why language is very important: wherever we are, however we are, we learn the language of those people. And within ourselves there is this thing that we get the desire to learn that very thing.

brh: بندغ ہیل کیک تہ۔ تین تو زنڈاس، مخلوق تو زنڈاس بش مسس ولدا زبان ئے ہیل کریسک۔ اوف تون اوار بش مسس توسس اونا زبان ئےہیل کیرہ اسٹ ایلو آن زبان ئے۔ ہراڑے نی رہینگسہ۔ ہراڑے رہینگسہ نا مخلوقاک، نا سنگتاک، نا بھازچادری ٹی چاردیواری ٹی زنڈوک او۔
en: a person does learn it. If you yourself sat with them, sat and mixed with people, then you learned the language. If you stood and sat together with them, they learn his language, the language from one another. Wherever you live, where you live, your people, your friends, who live within your 'veil and four walls' (your private home)...
en_old: A person does learn. You lived with yourself, lived with people, got along, and then you learned the language. You got along with them, and they learn their language from one another. Wherever you live, wherever you live, your people, your friends, live within your close circle, within the four walls.

brh: دا کل ہمو زبان نا مریر یا نی اوتا زبان ئے ہیل کیس یا او نا زبان ئے ہیل کیر گڑا نم اسٹ ایلو توجوانی سے ٹے گدرینگرہ۔ نم اسٹ ایلو توجوانو کاریم ئس کنن کیرہ۔ نم اسٹ ایلو تو سرپدی کننگ کیرہ۔ اسٹ ایلو آن انت ہر گڑا ہیل کننگ خوارہ، کیرہ تہ۔
en: If all of these are of that language, either you learn their language or they learn your language, then you will spend your time well with one another. You can do good work with one another. You can understand one another. Whatever you want to learn from one another, you do learn it.
en_old: If all of them speak that language, either you learn their language or they learn yours, then you will spend time well with one another. You can do good work with one another. You can understand one another. Whatever you want to learn from one another, you do learn it.

brh: ننا علاقہ ٹی ہراکہ براہوئی اور بلوچی زبان اے۔ مخلوق کل ہیل کیک تا،او پائک تا او ہیت کیکک۔ انتئے دا وجہ غان کہ اوڑے مخلوق دا گڑات آن مر مس۔
en: In our area, where there are the Brahui and Balochi languages, people all learn them, speak them and talk in them. Because, for this reason, people there have [become used to] these things.
en_old: In our region there are the Brahui and Balochi languages. People all learn them, speak them and talk in them. Because there people became familiar with these things.

brh: داد ئے ہیل کتو یا براہوئی ئے یا بلوچی ئے تو او اسٹ ایلو آن بھاز مشکل مریک ولدا زنڈنگ بش مننگ۔ انتئے کہ اگر ای نا ہچ ئے تتوٹ نی کنائے تتوس تو دوارہ ہیت مفک۔ ہندن ننا مثال ولدا کنگ ئنا مریک کہ اسٹ ایلو دوارہ ہندن سرپد کینہ۔ تو ہندا وجہ غان زبان ہراڑے مرے۔
en: If someone did not learn this, either Brahui or Balochi, then it becomes very difficult for them to sit and get along with one another. Because if I do not know anything of yours and you do not know mine, then no conversation happens. Then our situation becomes like that of mute people, the way we would make each other understand [by signs]. So for this reason, wherever a language may be,
en_old: If one has not learned this, either Brahui or Balochi, then it becomes very hard to live and get along with one another. Because if I do not understand anything of yours and you do not understand mine, then there is no conversation. Then our example becomes like that of mute people, how we would make each other understand. So that is why, wherever a language may be,

brh: ارا اسٹ نا زبان مرے۔ کلاک بہترین او بس اودے ہیل کننگ کہ نی اوتون اگر بھاز زیادہ شوق تخسہ ای دادئے ہیل کیوتو ہیل کننگ کیسہ تہ۔ ننا جند ئنا علاقہ ٹے بر بھاز مخلوق ئس چار، پنچ، شش زبان ہیل کرینو اور ہیل کیرہ۔
en: whichever one's language it may be, all of them are excellent, and you just have to learn it: if you have a very great interest in it, 'I will learn this,' then you can learn it. In our own area, a great many people have learned four, five, six languages and are still learning.
en_old: whatever anyone's language may be, all are excellent, and you just have to learn it; if you have a great interest in it, 'I will learn this', then you can learn it. In our own region, many people have learned four, five, six languages and are learning them.

brh: انتئے کہ وونا داپار ایپار تولوکا مخلوق کل زبان تا اسٹ ایلو نا سرپد مریرہ۔
en: Because the people living on this side and that side of it all understand each other's languages.
en_old: Because the people who live around there all understand each other's languages.

brh: تو زبان ہیل کننگ کہ نے کل آن زیادہ ضروری ہناد اے کہ نی تینا مخلوق ئے ہیل کرف، ہیل ایتہ او تینٹ ہیل کرک او اسٹ ایلو تو گپ شپ کیرہ، ہیت میت کیرہ، اسٹ ایلو تو زنڈرہ، اسٹ ایلو تو بنرہ تو اسٹ ایلو آن نم ہیل کیرہ۔ ولدا ہرا کہ ننا علاقک او۔
en: So, in learning a language, the most important thing for you is this: that you teach your people, give them learning, and they learn among themselves, and they chat with one another, talk with one another, sit with one another, listen to one another, and so you learn from one another. Then there are our areas:
en_old: So to learn a language, the most important thing for you is to teach your own people. Let them learn, they learn by themselves, and they chat with each other, talk with each other, laugh with each other, listen to each other, so you learn from each other. Then there are our areas.

brh: اوڑے تقریبا مسٹ، چار، پنچ زبان ہندا وجہ آن مخلوق ہراسٹ ئے بریک۔ ہر اسٹ داگڑات ئے ہیل کیک انتئے کہ او رہینگوک انگا بندغاک ہنداکان تعلق تخرہ ولدا او دا زبانت ئے ہیل کیرہ۔
en: there are about three, four, five languages there, and for this reason people know every one of them. Everyone learns these things, because the people living there belong to that very place, and so they learn these languages.
en_old: There are about three, four, five languages there, which is why people come to every one of them. Everyone learns these things, because the people who live there belong to that place, and then they learn these languages.

brh: اسہ سوج ئس دا مسک کہ ہراکہ جمہوری اے کہ وہ ہرا گورمنٹ ئکہ بھاز ضروری اے ہنا۔ دانا ہیت داد اے کہ نن ہرا علاقہ ٹی رہینگنہ۔ ہرا معاشرہ ٹی رہینگنہ۔ اوڑے مخلوق ننا کل داگڑاتون اوار اے۔
en: One question was this: what democracy is, which is very important for a government. The point of this is: in whichever area we live, in whichever society we live, the people there are bound up with all these things of ours.
en_old: One question was which is democratic, or which government is very important. The point of this is which area we live in, which society we live in. The people there are connected with all of these things of ours.

brh: انتئے کہ نن ہراڑے رہینگنہ، ہراڑے تولنہ بش مرینہ اوڑے اسہ ہندنو نظامس اسہ حسابس جوڑ اے کہ اوڑے کہ ہر بندغ امر بریک اوڑے ہر مخلوق ہرا اوڑے بریک مون آئے، انتئے کہ بریکک، نا انت حساب و کتاب او۔ دافت آ کلات آ خڑک کننگ کن، اسہ جاگہ مننگ کن تو دا نظام جوڑ اے۔
en: Because where we live, where we sit and get along, a kind of system, an arrangement, is set up there: how each person comes there, every people who comes there in the future, why they come, what your accounts and affairs are. To bring all of these close together, to bring them into one place, this system is made.
en_old: Because where we live, where we sit and stay, there is a system, an arrangement in place there: how each person comes there, every person who comes there in the future, why they come, what their accounts and dealings are. To keep an eye on all of these, to bring things together in one place, this system has been created.

brh: تو دا ہرا کہ گورمنٹ پارہ تہ۔ دا اسہ وار جوڑ ئے نن کہ کل ئکہ۔ نا مخلوق ہراڑے رہینگک۔ ہرا علاقہ ٹی رہینگرہ۔ تو اوڑے اسہ حسابس جوڑ کہ اولیکو وار ہمو علاقہ والاک تین کہ اسہ بندغس ہتیرہ۔
en: So this is what they call government. It is made once for all of us. Where your people live, which area they live in, an arrangement is made there so that first of all the people of that area bring forward a person for themselves.
en_old: So this is what they call government. It is formed once for all of us. Where your people live, which area they live in, an arrangement is made there so that first the people of that area choose a person from among themselves.

brh: اسہ بندغ ئے مونا تخرہ کہ بھئی نی ننا علاقہ نا مونے ہر ہیتس اے، ہر کاریمس اے، ہر حسابس اے نی دات ئے بن، دات ئے مسلہ تے، دا حسابات ئے نی کرتا مونا۔ او ولدا دائیدئے دیکک مونا، کہ ہرا کہ ہمو ڈسٹرک لیول نا مریرہ۔ ولدا اوت آئے دیک تہ۔
en: They put one person in front: 'Brother, whatever matter, whatever work, whatever affair our area faces, you listen to these, to these problems, and you take these matters forward.' And then he takes this forward, to those who are at the district level. Then he takes it to them.
en_old: They put a person forward: brother, whatever matter there is in front of our area, whatever work, whatever affair, you listen to these, to these problems, and you take these matters forward. Then he passes them on to those who are at the district level. Then they pass them on further.

brh: وہ دا حساب ئے کہ بھئی ننا علاقہ ٹی دا مخلوق ٹی دا حساب اے۔ دا مسلہک اریرک۔ تو او ولدا مون آئے ہتیرہ تا تینا بھلا ولدا صوبہ نا زیا کہ دا بھئی دا علاقہ ٹی دا مسلہ ئے دا مخلوق تو ارے۔
en: Or this matter: 'Brother, in our area, among these people, this is the situation. These problems exist.' So then they take it forward to their own superiors, then up to the province: 'Brother, in this area these people have this problem.'
en_old: Or this matter: brother, in our area, among these people, this is the situation. These are the problems. So then they take it forward to their own elders, then to the province, saying, brother, in this area these people have this problem.

brh: ننا گورمنٹ ہرا کہ ارے وہ ہندا وجہ غان جوڑ اے کہ ننا مخلوق ارے اوڑے کہ دات ئے امہ کین داتے کن انت مسلہ ارے۔ دانا تعلیم امہ مریک دانا ام- دانا صحت امر مریک۔ دانا
en: The government that we have is made for this very reason: our people are there, so we see how we should deal with them and what problems they have, how their education is, how their health is, their...
en_old: Our government that exists is formed for this reason: for our people there, so that we see what problems they have. How their education is, how their health is. Their...

brh: ہمومخلوقاک کہ رہینگرہ اوڑے، اوت آ دیر نا م- کاریمس اے۔ اوت آ بجلی نا کاریمس اے، اوگیس نا کاریمس اے، اوت آ سیلاب نا کاریمس اے یا پےانت کاریمس اے علاقہ ٹے تا ارے کننگ ئس اے، بیننگ ئس اے، رہینگنگ ئس اے، جھگڑہس اے،داس اے، ایس اے کلات ئے کن اسہ گڑاس جوڑ اے اودے پارہ گورمنٹ۔
en: Those people who live there have some water-related work. They have electricity work, gas work, flood work, or whatever other work there is in their area, whether it is eating, clothing or housing, a quarrel, this or that: for all of these something has been made, and they call it government.
en_old: The people who live there, they have some water issue. They have an electricity issue, a gas issue, a flood issue, or whatever other issue there is in their area—doing something, hearing something, living, a quarrel, this, that—for all of these something has been formed, and that is called government.

brh: او گورمنٹ ہنداد اے کہ ہر بندغ کن اسٹ اے۔ اوڑے ہرا بندغ اوڑے رہینگک۔ اودانا حصہ ئس اے اور دا حصہ مننگ کہ اودے انت کروئی تمک۔ داڑتو اودے جڑوئی تمک۔ او اوڑتو جڑائنگا، داتون اوار مسک تودات ئے مون ائے ولدا اسہ جاگہ کیرہ۔ دا ہرا کہ ننا مخلوقاک وونٹ بٹرہ۔
en: And government is the thing that is one for every person. Every person who lives there is a part of it, and to be a part of it, what does he have to do? He has to join with it. He is joined with it, he becomes one with it, and then they bring these things forward together in one place. This is what our people [vote for].
en_old: That government is the one that is one for every person. Every person who lives there is a part of it, and to be part of it, what does he have to do? He has to connect with it. He is connected with it, he joins it, and then they bring these things forward together in one place. This is what our people share among themselves.

brh: اوناہم ہنداد اے کہ بھئی نی تینا ہندنو بندغس ہت مون آئے کہ پھگہ نا دے نے اسہ کاریمس مرے۔ نے کہ اسہ مسلہس مرے علاقہ ٹی، نے کہ اسہ حسابس نا علاقہ ٹی مرے۔ نی کاس اوڑآئے تینا عرض ئے دیس کہ بھئی دا کنا دا مسلہ مسنے۔ کنا ارا ٹی بجلی اف کنا ارا ٹی دا گڑا افک۔
en: Its purpose too is this very thing: 'Brother, bring forward such a person of your own, so that if tomorrow you have some work, if you have some problem in the area, if there is some issue in your area, you go to him and take your request to him: brother, I have this problem. There is no electricity in my house, my house does not have this thing.'
en_old: His is also the same: brother, choose such a person of your own to put forward, so that if tomorrow you have some work, if you have some problem in the area, if there is some matter in your area, you go to him and submit your request: brother, I have this problem. There is no electricity in my house, my house doesn't have this thing.

brh: مون ائے نی، نا حصہ سے اٹک کن کہ نی دا کاریم ئے کر۔ داسا دا گورمنٹ نا ہرا سسٹم مرے نہ مخلوق ئٹے و ننا علاقہ نا ہراکہ سربراہک مریرہ، ہرا بھلاک مریرہ۔
en: Going forward, you have your part in it, so that you can get this work done. Now whatever system this government has rests with the people and with whoever are the heads of our area, whoever are the elders.
en_old: Going forward, you have a share in it so that you get this work done. Now whatever the system of this government is, it rests with the people and with the heads of our area, the elders.

brh: تو وہ اوڑے تولرہ، ولدا مخلوق نن اخس ارے او کل اسہ جاگہ زنڈرہ، ہیت کیرہ کہ بھئی نن داڑے اسہ بندغس تینا ہندنو ہتین کہ مون آئے نن پھگہ نا دے اسہ کاریم ئسے ٹی ہراڑے نن تین تو ہڑینگان، نن تین تو گڑاسے ننے سرپدی متو۔ اسہ گڑاس ئے نن تتونک کہ مون ائے امر کین۔
en: So they sit there, and then however many of us people there are, all sit together in one place and talk: 'Brother, let us bring forward a person of our own here, so that in the future, tomorrow, in some work where we ourselves get stuck, where we ourselves do not understand something, something we do not know, how to go forward...'
en_old: So they sit there, then however many of us people there are, all laugh together in one place and talk: brother, let us choose a person of our own here, so that in future, tomorrow, if we get stuck in some work, if we ourselves don't understand something, if we can't figure out how to go forward...

brh: گڑا دا نن کہ مون ائے کائہہ ہندانا کاریم ئے کشہ۔
en: then he will go forward for us and get that very work done.
en_old: Then he will come forward and do that work.

brh: کہ ننا علاقہ کہ نن تعلق تخنہ۔ اوڑے بھاز ہندنو مخلوق ارے کہ نن اوت ئے مونا ہیسنک۔ نن کہ ولدا انت کاریمس تمانے، مخلوق تو ننا انت مسلہس مسنے۔ اوکل ئے ننا مسلہ تے بنگن او۔ او مون اے اوت ئے حل کرینو۔ داسا نن ہراخلق ئٹی رہینگنہ۔ اوڑے دیر نا ننے بھاز مسلہ اسکہ۔
en: Like the area we belong to: there are many such people there whom we have brought forward. Then whatever work we had, whatever problem our people had, they listened to all our problems and then solved them. Now, in the village we live in, we used to have a big water problem.
en_old: Like the area we belong to. There are many such people there whom we have sent forward. Then whatever work we had, whatever problem our people had, they listened to all our problems and solved them later. Now the village we live in, we used to have a lot of water problems there.

brh: دیر ننا مخلوق ئے ہچ الوکا، ہنارہ بھاز مر آن دیر ہیسرہ۔ داسا ننا جند اسنہ اے ٹیم ائے چنک ارفینہ ریڑیت ئے ہنانہ مر آن دیر تین کہ ہیسنہ۔ دا وا ہرا ٹیم ائے بسر ہندا سسٹم مسک تو نن ہم داکرینک کہ بھئی مخلوق ئے تنااسہ جاگہ کرین کہ ننا تینا دا بندغ ئے تینا۔
en: Our people had no water at all; they used to go and bring water from very far away. We ourselves, at that time, would take small carts and go and bring water for ourselves from far away. When this time came and this system came about, we too did this: 'Brother, let us gather the people in one place, so that this person of ours is our own.'
en_old: Our people had no water at all; they had to go very far to fetch water. Now we ourselves at that time would take a little child, take the donkeys and go far away to bring water. Then, when the time came that this system was set up, we also did this: brother, let us gather the people in one place and choose our own person.

brh: ولدا دا بندغ ننا مون ائے بریک۔ نن کہ اسہ جاگہ مریک۔ نن کہ کائک مون ائے داڑے ہیت کیکک او نن کہ ہنداڑے اسہ نظامس جوڑ کیک کہ نن ہنداک آ خلق ئنا تہہ ٹی تین کن دیر کنین۔ تو داسا او بسک ہنداڑے ولا نن کہ ہندا کاریم ئے کرے۔
en: Then this person comes forward on our behalf. Things come together in one place for us. He goes forward for us, talks here, and sets up a system for us right here so that we can drink water for ourselves inside these very villages. So now he came here and did that very work for us.
en_old: Then this person comes before us. We gather in one place. We come forward and talk here, and we set up a system right here so that we can get water inside this very village. So now he has come here and did that very work.

brh: ننا خلق ئٹی بورئس خلک ولدا نن داسا ہمو خلق ان دیرکنینہ۔ ہندن ہندا کاریماک ہندا ہر علاقہ ٹی ننا، ہر مخلوق ٹی ننا، ہر حساب ئٹی ننا اریرک، ہندا وڑ کہ ننا ایلو خلقاک او۔ ہموکہ دیہاتی خلقاک او، او داسکان کہ ہندن او۔ اوت ئے بجلی افک۔ توبجلی نا کاریم یے تہ کیرہ۔
en: A borehole was dug in our village, and now we drink water from that village. In the same way, these same kinds of work exist in every one of our areas, among all our people, in all our affairs, just as with our other villages. Those that are rural villages are still like that to this day. They have no electricity, so they do the electricity work for them.
en_old: A borehole was dug in our village and now we get water in that village. Likewise, these same issues exist in every one of our areas, among all our people, in all our affairs, just like in our other villages. Those rural villages are still like that to this day. They have no electricity, so they do the electricity work.

brh: ہراڑے دیر افک اونا دیر نا کریم ئے کیرہ۔ ہراڑے گیس افک اونا گیس نا کاریم ئے کیرہ۔ ہراڑے صحت افک اونا صحت نا کاریم ئے کیرہ۔ انت کہ کاریمس اوڑے ارے اوتینا ہمو بندغ ئے کہ ہیسنو اوت ئے ولدا مونا اتیرہ۔ کہ بھئی نی نن-ز-دا کاریم ئے کرک۔
en: Where there is no water, they do the water work for it. Where there is no gas, they do the gas work for it. Where there is no health care, they do the health work for it. Whatever work there is there, they bring forward that person of theirs whom they have brought in: 'Brother, you do this work for us.'
en_old: Where there is no water, they do the water work. Where there is no gas, they do the gas work. Where there is no health care, they do the health work. Whatever work there is, they send forward the person they have chosen: brother, you do this work for us.

brh: تو اونا مون ائے کائکک کہ بھئی دا ننا علاقہ اے۔ نن داکہ تعلق تخنہ۔
en: So he goes forward on their behalf, saying: 'Brother, this is our area. We belong to it.'
en_old: So he comes before them and says, brother, this is our area, we belong to it.

brh: اور دا مخلوق نا دا دا کاریماک او نن دا کاریمات ئے کبو۔ داسا ہندن ہرا کہ ننا علاقک او۔ اونا بھلوس اے۔ ہندا بیل داسا کائکک اوڑائے بھاز آبادی کم اے۔ بلہ او آبادی کم مرے ہم لیکن تینا او کاریمات ئے خواہرہ۔
en: And these are the people's tasks, these ones, and [we say]: do these tasks. Now it is like this: our areas are such that they are vast. At this time, if you go there now, the population is very small. But even though the population may be small, they still want those tasks of theirs [done].
en_old: And these are the people's tasks, and we should do these tasks. Now, our areas are like that, they are large. The same goes now: there the population is very small. But even if the population is small, they still want their work done.

brh: زندہ مننگ کہ اوت ئے کلات ئے ہندا ضروریئؤ گڑا او ہرا کہ نن پانہ کہ بنیادیئا حقاک او، او کل اریرک۔ تو کلات ئے کہ ضروری اے اوراوکلات ئے کہ خوارہ۔ تودانا وجہ غان ہندا سا کہ سسٹم ئس جوڑ اے۔ اونا وجہ غان ننا دا سسٹم ئے پانہ 'گورنمنٹ'۔ ہرا گورمنٹ ہراٹیم نن کہ مریکک۔
en: To live, they all need these necessary things; and the things that we call basic rights, all of them exist. So they are necessary for everyone, and everyone wants them. So because of this a system has been made. Because of that, we call this system of ours 'government'. The government which, when it is there for us,
en_old: To stay alive, everyone needs these necessary things, what we call basic rights, all of them. So everyone needs them and everyone wants them. Because of that, a system has been made. Because of that, we call this system 'government'. The government is something that comes about through us.

brh: ننا کاریمات ئے کیکک، ننا مسلہ غات ئے حل کیکک۔ ننا جھیڑ و جھیڑہ غات ئے تینا اسہ جاگہ نا اواوتے ختم کیکک۔ ننا مخلوق ئٹی انتس کہ ہراڑے بے تعلیمیئو، تعلیم ہتیکک۔ ہراڑے کہ بجلی اف، بھلی ہتیک، ہراڑے کہ انت کاریمس ارے او کاریمت ئے کیکک۔
en: does our work and solves our problems. It ends our quarrels and disputes in one place of its own. Among our people, wherever there is no education, it brings education. Where there is no electricity, it brings electricity; wherever there is some work [needed], it does that work.
en_old: It does our work and solves our problems. It ends our disputes and quarrels in one place. Among our people, where there is no education, it brings education. Where there is no electricity, it brings electricity; wherever there is some work to be done, it does that work.

brh: تو دا اسہ ہندنو نظامس گورمنٹ نا جوڑ اے کہ ہر جاگہ ننا ہراکہ مخلوق کائہہ ننا بلوچستان ٹی، ہرہرکونہ غائے، ہرخلق ئٹی، ہرحساب ئٹی مخلوق ئکن ہمونگ کارہ آگاہی ایترہ۔ کہ بھئی نی تینا دہن اسہ بندغس ہت مونا۔ او وبندغ ئے نم ووٹ ایتبوولدا اوبریک مون ائے۔ نما انتس کہ علاقہ ٹے کاریمس ارے۔
en: So this is such a system of government that has been made: everywhere our people are in our Balochistan, in every corner, in every village, in every respect, they go there to the people and make them aware: 'Brother, bring forward a person like yourself. Give that person your vote, then he goes forward.' Whatever work there is in your area,
en_old: So the government has built such a system that everywhere our people live in our Balochistan, in every corner, in every community, in every respect, they go to the people and make them aware: brother, bring forward a person like yourself. You give that person your vote, then he goes forward. Whatever work there is in your area,

brh: نما انتس کہ علاقہ ٹی کاریم مسنے۔ نما داس ہندنو کاریم اریر کہ ہچ متنو۔ ہچ بنتنوتا۔ تو اوفت ئے نما کل ئے کیکک۔ او ہندنو کاریمس ارے کہ ہچو مخلوق بتنے۔ دہنکہ داسا بھاز ہندنو ننا علاقہ ارے داسکان کہ بجلی اف تا۔ ہندنو علاقہ ارے داسکان کہ دیر بریکک ہراٹیم پھربھازمریک۔ ولدا اوفت ئے دیک۔
en: whatever work has been done in your area, and the work you now have that has not been done at all, that has not come about at all, he does all of it for you. And there is such work that no one has come [to do]. For example, there are still many such areas of ours that until now have no electricity. There are such areas where until now water comes [only] when it is plentiful. Then he takes those [problems] up,
en_old: whatever work has been done in your area, and whatever work you have that has not been done at all, has not happened at all, he does all of that for you. And there are such tasks that no people have done. For example, there are still many areas of ours that have no electricity even now. There are areas where water comes only when it rains a lot. Then he provides them with it.

brh: اوتا مون ائے اسہ بندس خلننگ کہ۔
en: to build a dam in front of them.
en_old: To put up a dam in front of them.

brh: اوفتا مون ائے اسہ بند ئس تخنگ کہ یا اوتے کہ گڑاس ہندنو سہولت ئس ایتر کہ بیمار مریرہ کسس سوج ئے تا کپک۔ ولدا اوتے خڑک ہننگ کہ ڈاکٹردائے افک۔ تو ایکا مرآن بننگ کہ وہ بریرداڑے سرمننگ کہ اوتے بھلو وخت لگک۔ اوتے بھاز جنداک تا ہندن بھازمشکلات مریرہ کہ وہ داڑے امر بریر سر کیر۔
en: To put a dam in front of them, or to give them some such facility, [because] when they fall sick no one asks after them. And then there is no doctor near them to go to. So they have to come from far away like that, and to come here and arrive takes them a long time. They have a lot of trouble, many such difficulties of how they can come here and get here.
en_old: To build a dam for them, or to give them some facility such that when they get sick, no one asks about them. Then there is no doctor near them. So they have to come from far away, and it takes them a long time to reach here. They have many hardships, many difficulties in how they can come and get here.

brh: تو دا کلات ئے کن جوڑ مننگ کن ہنا ہرکہ گورمنٹ پارہ تا۔ دا گڑات ئے حل کیک۔ ننا جند ہراعلاقہ غان تعلق تخنہ۔ تواوعلاقہ ٹے ہم ہندا مسلہک اریرک۔ کہ اوڑے صحت ننا مخلوق مست ہنداکا بھاز مر ہناکہ تینا علاج کہ۔
en: So for all these things to be built, what they call government solves these matters. The area we ourselves belong to also had these same problems: there, for health, our people used to go very far for their treatment.
en_old: So to get all this done, what we call government solves these things. The area that we ourselves belong to also has these same problems: that for health our people used to go very far for their treatment.

brh: داسا اوڑائے گورمنٹ ہنداد اے کہ خڑک اسہ کرے ہسپتال ئس تاکہ مخلوق ئے داخہ مر ہنپ ولدا برے ہنداڑے تینا علاج ئے کے۔ تینا خیال ئے کے۔ تینا حساب کتابس اے ہنداڑے کے تہ۔ ہندن دیر نا مثال مسک، ای دیرنا پاریٹ کہ دیرمس مرآن ہیسنہ۔ ننا جواک اسرہ ہمیکا وختس دیر بسکہ ہنانہ ہمیکا دیرڈوہانہ ہیسنہ اراتے آ۔
en: Now the government there is such that it has built a hospital nearby, so that people do not go so far but come right here, get their treatment, look after themselves, and do their business right here. The same with water, for example. I spoke about water: we used to bring water from far away. We had streams; when the water came, we would go there, carry the water and bring it back to the houses.
en_old: Now the government there has made it so that it has built a hospital nearby, so that people don't have to go so far and can come right here for their treatment, take care of themselves, and do their accounts here. The same with water, for example. I said that we used to bring water from far away. Our mothers used to, when the water came, go and bring water carried on donkeys.

brh: داسا اڑا تے آ جنداتے ٹی ننے دیر ملکک۔ ہندن باقی ہراکہ تعلیم ننا پاسک۔ تعلیم والا حساب ئے ننا اوہم نن مست ہنانہ بھاز مر خواننگ کہ۔ مرو جاگہس ہنانہ ہمیڑے خوانانہ۔
en: Now we get water in the houses themselves. Likewise the rest, what we call education: in education too, we used to go very far to study. We would go to a distant place and study there.
en_old: Now in those very areas we get water. Likewise the rest, what we call education. As for education, we too used to go very far to study. We went to a distant place and studied there.

brh: ہنا کہ ہنانہ پیدل ہمیڑائے ولا ایکا بسنہ داڑے تو ہر بندغ ہننگ بننگ داخس ایلو کننگ کتوکہ تو داسا اینو پھگہ ہمو حساباک کہ ہمیڑے اسرہ ہنانہ ہمیڑاے ہمینگ مر ہنانہ داسا او بسنے ہندا جند ئنا ننا خلق ئٹی۔ ہندا خلق ئٹی نن ہیل کرینن۔ ہنداکا خوانانن۔ اورہا داسکان کہ ہمو خلقاک۔
en: We would go there on foot and then come back here, so not every person was able to do that much going and coming. So now, nowadays, those things for which we used to go over there, go so far, have come right into our own village. In this very village we have learned; we have studied right here. Otherwise, until now, those villages...
en_old: We went on foot there, and then came back here, so not every person could manage that much going and coming. So now, today, those things for which we used to go far away have come to our own community. In this very community we have learned, we have studied here. Otherwise, until now, those communities...

brh: پئے بہ تعلیم ئٹے جوان مسنو۔ ہنداوڑ کہ بھازحساب تہ اریرک ننامخلوق ئٹے ہراڑے کہ جھیڑہس مریکک ہراڑے جھگڑاس مریک، اسٹ ایلو ئے تینا خلیرہ یا اسہ اوتا ہندنو زمین نا گڑاس مسلہ ئس مریکک۔
en: Even so, they have become good in education. Likewise, there are many matters among our people where there is a dispute, where there is a quarrel: they beat one another, or they have some such problem over land.
en_old: ...would not have become good in education. Likewise there are many matters among our people where there is a dispute, where there is a quarrel, they hit each other, or they have some problem over land.

brh: اسٹ ایلوتو تینا ہڑینگرہ، اسٹ ایلو نا تینا زمین ئے ہلیرہ زبردستی اٹ پلرہ، تو وہ تے کہ اسہ گورمنٹ اسہ حسابس تخانے کہ بھئی ای ہم نما دارے- مسلہ ئے حل کیوہ۔ پین ہرا کہ شناخت نا پاسہ۔ شناخت ہنداد اے کہ بھئی ہر بندغ ہمو علاقہ ٹی رہینگک۔
en: They fight with one another, they take one another's land and seize it by force. So for them the government has set up an arrangement: 'Brother, I am yours too, here; I will solve the problem.' Another thing is what we call identity. Identity means that, brother, every person lives in a particular area.
en_old: They fight with each other, they seize each other's land and take it by force. So for that the government has set up a system: brother, I too am yours, I will solve the problem. Then there is what we call identity. Identity means that every person lives in that area.

brh: اونا علاقہ نا جند نا تہ اسہ کارڈس جوڑاے ای کہ تہ کہ بھئی نی دا علاقہ ناسے اس۔ دا نا قوم اے، دانا قبیلہ اے، دا گڑاک او نا۔ نا کل ئے پہچان ئے ہنداڑے ایتکک ولدا۔ وابھی علاقہ ئے تہ ہرا کہ گورمنٹ پارہ تہ او کل ئکن اسٹ اے۔
en: A card of his own area is made for him, saying: 'Brother, you are from this area. This is your nation, this is your tribe, these things are yours.' Then it gives your whole identity right there. And as for the area, what they call government is one and the same for everyone.
en_old: For his own area a card is made, saying, brother, you are from this area. This is your nation, this is your tribe, these things are yours. Your full identity is given right there. And as for the area, what we call government is the same for everyone.

brh: اور اے گورمنٹ ئکہ اخس ارے مخلوق ہمورہینگک، خرک او یا مراو، ہراڑے کے ہمر او، ہرا مریرک انت قومس مریرک اوفتے کہ کل ئکہ اسٹ اے۔ بس اوتا ہنداد اے کہ او تین کہ اسہ جاگہ اسہ گڑاس جوڑ کیرک۔
en: And for this government, however many people live there, whether they are near or far, wherever they are, however they are, whoever they are, whatever nation they belong to, it is the same for all of them. It is just that they make something for themselves in one place.
en_old: And for the government, however many people live there, whether near or far, wherever they are, however they are, whatever nation they belong to, it is the same for everyone. It's just that they come together in one place and build something for themselves.

brh: اسہ گڑاس تین کہ ہندا جوڑ کہ بھئی نن کل اسہ جاگہ مرینہ دا مخلوق ئے تینا، دا بندغ ئے تینا ہتینہ، دا مونائے ہنداڑے نن کہ مریکک۔ اور دا نن ہیتات ئے مونائے دیکک۔ اور پین ہندا پائکک کہ بھئی نن دا علاقہ نا دا دا بندغاتے کہ دا دا مسلہک اریرک۔
en: They make something for themselves like this: 'Brother, we all gather in one place and bring forward this people of ours, this person of ours, and here he is out in front for us.' And he takes our matters forward. And he also says: 'Brother, the people of this area of ours have these and these problems.'
en_old: To make something for ourselves so that, brother, we all come together in one place, bring forward our people, our person, and through him we move forward. And he takes our matters forward. And he also says, brother, in our area, these people have these problems.

brh: نن ہنداوڑ کہ علاقتے آن پیش تمنہ، پیشن آ برینہ بھلا شارتے آ بھلا شارتے آ خننہ کہ اوڑے مخلوق بھاز موناٹ اے۔ توولدا ننا ہندا مریکک کہ یار ننا مخلوق انتئے پد اے۔ لیکن اگہ نن خواننہ، پیش تمنہ خننہ۔
en: Likewise, when we leave our areas and come out to the big cities, the big cities, we see that the people there are far ahead. Then it occurs to us: man, why are our people behind? But if we study, go out and see,
en_old: Likewise, when we leave our areas and come out to big cities, we see that people there are far ahead. Then we think, friend, why are our people behind? But if we study, go out and see,

brh: دائیس کینہ، دںیائے خننہ، کل ئےپومرینہ تہ کہ ولا امر کینہ پانہ تا کہ واقعی بھئی نن ہناخس کہ تینے ہمو حد اسکا سر کینہ ہرا حد اسکا کہ مخلوق سرمرسہ اے۔
en: do this, see the world and understand everything, then afterwards [we know] how to do it, and we tell them: truly, brother, we go so far as to bring ourselves up to the level that [those] people have reached.
en_old: do these things, see the world, understand everything, then we can say how we can truly bring ourselves to the level that people have reached.

brh: تو ننا مخلوق ہمو کا علاقہ غان داسکان کہ پیش تمک داسکان کہ بریک، خوانک، پیش تمک کہ بھئی ای بریو پیشن ائےگڑا جوڑکیو تینے، گڑاس مریوک، دنیا ہمر کہ ہنسہ اےای ہمووڑ کاوک۔ تینا مخلوق کہ، تینا علاقہ کہ، تینا بندغاتے کہ، تینا کلات ئے کہ ای گڑاسے نہ گڑاس جوڑ کیوک۔
en: So our people from those areas, until they come out, until they come, study, and go out [thinking]: 'Brother, I will come out and make something of myself, become something, go the way the world is going; for my people, my area, my folks, for everyone, I will make something or other.'
en_old: So our people from those areas, until they go out, come out, study, and go out thinking, brother, I'll come out and make something of myself, become something, go the way the world is going, and make something or other for my people, my area, my folks, for everyone.

brh: ہنا وڑ کہ داسا کس ئے کہ علاقہ غان پیش تمک بھازاک خوانرہ جوانو جاگہس سر مریرہ۔ ولدا تینا علاقہ غئے کارہ تینا مخلوق کہ گڑاس کیرہ۔ اورہندن گڑا تعلیم ہندنو گڑاس اے کہ ہر بندغ ئے ہنا حق ارے کہ او خوانہ پیش تمہ، تینا مخلوق ئے کشہ، تین کہ خوانہ او تینا مخلوق کہ خوانہ۔
en: These days, when someone comes out of the area, many of them study and reach a good position. Then they go back to their area and do something for their people. And likewise, education is such a thing that every person has the right to study, go forward, and lift up his people; to study for himself and to study for his people.
en_old: Nowadays, when someone comes out of the area, many of them study and reach a good position. Then they come back to their area and do something for their people. Likewise, education is something every person has the right to: to study and move forward, to lift up their people, and to study for themselves and for their people.

brh: کڑاس تین کہ جوڑ کے تینا مخلوق کہ جوڑ کے۔
en: To make something for himself, and to make something for his people.
en_old: Build something for yourself, and build something for your people.

brh: تینا ایلم ئس ئے، تینا ہمسایہ ئس ئے، تینا رشتہ دارس ئے اوتے کہ کلاتے کہ، او کلاتے کہ ہنا کے کہ بھئی ای اگہ پیش تماٹ اینو گڑاس جوڑ مسٹ یا گڑاس جوڑ کریٹ تین کہ تو ای تینا مخلوق کہ، تینا بندغ کہ، تینا علاقہ کہ کلاتے کہ گڑاس جوڑ کیوہ۔
en: His brother, his neighbor, his relative: he does it for them, for all of them, [thinking]: 'Brother, if I went out and became something today, or made something of myself, then I will make something for my people, my folk, my area, for everyone.'
en_old: Your brother, your neighbor, your relative: you do it for all of them. You say, "Brother, if I have moved forward and become something today, or made something of myself, then I will do something for my people, for my own folk, for my area, for everyone."

brh: ہنا وڑ کہ گورمنٹ ئٹے بریسہ تو نا علاقہ نا بندغاک کہ اوڑائے ہرادے کہ تینا مون ئے یا چیرمین پاس تہ یا اوڑان بڑز پاس تہ وہ ہم ہندا وجہ غان بریک کہ بھئی ای اگر دا مخلوق کنے ہیسنے اسہ وجہ سے آن ہیسنے۔
en: In the same way, when you come into government, the people of your area there, whom you call their representative, or chairman, or something higher than that: he too comes for this reason: 'Brother, if these people have brought me, they have brought me for a reason.'
en_old: In the same way, when you come into government, the people of your area who elect you, whether as councillor, chairman or something higher, do it for this reason too. You think, "Brother, if these people have brought me forward, they have done it for a reason."

brh: داد اے کہ ای اگر بریوہ داڑے تو کنے دا گڑا ملکک ای تینا مخلوق کہ کاریمس کیو۔ او علاقہ ٹے ہرا۔
en: It is this: if I come here and get this thing, then I should do some work for my people, in that area, whichever it is.
en_old: It is that if I come here and get this position, I should do some work for my people, in whatever area it is.

brh: مریک او۔ گوئے انتس کاریمس مرے اوتا علاقہ نا، ہرا بندغ نا انت کاریمس مرے۔ باید کہ اوفتا کلات آ کاریمات ئے کے۔ ہنداوڑائے کہ ہراکہ گورمنٹ نا نن پانہ تہ گورمنٹ ہمومریکک کہ اوڑے کل ئکہ لمہ باوہ ہم پارہ تہ، کہ بھئی داڑ کہ کل ئکہ اسٹ اے۔
en: That is how it is. Like, whatever work their area may have, whatever work any person may have, he should do the work of all of them. In the same way, what we call government is something that people also call the mother and father of everyone, so that, brother, here everyone is equal.
en_old: That's how it is. Whatever work their area needs, whatever work a person needs, he should do it for all of them. In the same way, what we call government is something where everyone is like mother and father, so that, brother, here everyone is one.

brh: ہرا اسٹ نا انت کاریمس مریک، ارا ٹے تہ گڑ- کاریمس مریک یا پیشن ائے ہمسایہ سے نا تہ یا ارا نا تہ ماس ئنا گلی ئسے ٹے مریکک تواوکلاتے کہ او کاریمات آ پائہہ کیرہ۔
en: Whatever work anyone has, whether there is some work in his house, or outside at some neighbor's, or in some lane at the foot of his house, then, as they say, they do those tasks for all of them.
en_old: Whatever work anyone has, whether it is at home, at a neighbor's outside, or in a street of the neighborhood, he takes care of that work for everyone.

brh: ننا علاقہ ہراکہ تعلق تخوہ اوڑے دا کاریمات ئے نن بھاز خنانک کہ بھئی مخلوق ئسے اگر اوکا ہناکہ، ہندن خاکہ ؤ کسر ئسے آن تو اودے ولدا گورمنٹ بسکہ کریکہ ای کہ تا پکا۔
en: In the area we belong to, we have seen this kind of thing a lot: if a person went that way, along some such plan and path, then he would come into government and get it done, like, properly.
en_old: In the area we belong to, we have seen this kind of thing a lot. If a person came forward that way, along some path, then he would bring the government back and get things done, for example.

brh: ولدا ہندن پے اسرہ کہ بھئی اونا بھازمخوق ئے خنانہ کہ او خوانارہ، گڑاس سرمسرہ تینا مخلوق کہ، تین کہ، تینا ارا کہ اسہ گڑاس سپورٹ کریرہ۔ ہندا وڑ بھازجاگہ نن خنانن کہ ہراوڑکہ مخلوق بسکہ ہنا تون اوارمسکہ گورمنٹ ئتومسکہ تواو تیناعلاقہ کہ، تینا مخلوق کہ، تینا کلاتے کہ کاریم کریکہ، تیناعلاقہ ئے جوڑ کریکہ، تینا علاقہ ٹے۔
en: Then there were also others like that: brother, we saw many of his people who studied, got somewhere, and supported something for their people, for themselves, for their homes. In the same way, we have seen in many places how people came, joined in and became part of the government, and then worked for their area, for their people, for everyone; they built up their area, in their area.
en_old: It was also like that before. We saw many of his people who studied, reached somewhere, and supported their people, themselves and their homes. In the same way, we have seen in many places that people came, joined the government, and then worked for their area, their people and everyone, and built up their area.

brh: انت کمیس اس اودے زیات کریکہ تینا علاقہ ٹے۔ انت حساب کتابس، بڑزوشیفیس اسرہ او کریکہ تہ کہ کنا مخلوق، کنا علاقہ ہندن مف کہ ایلو علاقہ تن پد تمپ۔
en: Whatever shortfall there was in his area, he would make it up. Whatever accounts, whatever ups and downs there were, he would handle them so that 'my people and my area should not end up falling behind other areas.'
en_old: Whatever shortcomings there were in his area, he would make up for them. Whatever accounts and high-level matters there were, he would handle them so that "my people and my area are not left behind other areas."

brh: انتئے کہ داسا اینو خننہ کہ نن دنیا اراڑے سر مرسہ اے، ہخس مونا ہنسہ اے تو نن ہندا سوچنہ کہ نن ہم باید کہ ہنداخس برین، ہنداخس خوانن، ہنداخس سرسوج کین، ہنداخس ایلوہیل کین کہ نن ہموتون برین اوار سرمرین۔
en: Because now, today, we see where the world has reached and how far ahead it has gone. So we think that we too should come that far, study that much, inquire that much, and learn that much more, so that we come along with them and arrive together.
en_old: Because today we see how far the world has reached and how far ahead it is going. So we think that we too should come that far, study that much, understand that much and learn that much, so that we can keep up with them and get there together.

brh: ولے تینا مسڑ نا پروا افک نی اینو دا زامر پوک ء، کنے پوک کپہ، ئے تینے پوک کروک۔ اوہو!
en: But you have no concern for your own daughter? Today this [unclear] has gone to waste. Don't waste me; I am the one who has wasted myself. Oh ho!
en_old: But you don't care about your own daughter. Today you made a fool of this old man — you didn't make a fool of me, you made a fool of yourself. Oh no!

brh: داتو خلیگ ننے ادا دا تو مس ایلوم دا تو خلیک مفک اسانم گور کے نرنگ کا دان پننگوس نرنگ ایلوم انتینا نرنگے ارا پینا سے نرنگے کہ مخرے ننے آ ہیکہ بہ نرنگ کا
en: This one is going to beat us here! This is what has happened, brother: this one will beat [us], it won't do. [unclear] run, go! You're saying 'run'? Run, brother? What kind of running is that? Some other kind of running, so that [unclear] us? Come on, run, go!
en_old: This is fear for us here. This has happened, brother. This won't be fear. Easily... run... why run? There's no other way but to run, before the fools come at us. Let's run.

brh: ٹکری دوارے خلیس تے مرکس تے بس اسہ خلوئی دے ایلو ہم اسہ رادے کروئی افک داد پاننگ اٹی ٹکری خلیسے نن کے غل تمنتے او ننے
en: Takri [got scared] again [unclear]. Just one has to be struck, and the other one mustn't be let off either. [unclear] Takri [got scared]; we [unclear], he [unclear] us.
en_old: Takri, there are fears and deaths again. Just one has to be hit, and the other one can't be dealt with either. When it comes to praise, Takri is afraid... we didn't get into trouble, he did it to us.

brh: ارے نن تینا ہناڑے ڈکانورے کاشم نا بوڈھاٹی ، نم انت خیالے؟ نم ٹکریاں بچیرے؟ ٹکری! ئے تو نا ایلم اٹ۔
en: Hey, you've hidden yourselves over there in the reed thicket. What are you thinking? Will you escape from Takri? Takri! I'm your brother, after all.
en_old: Hey, we're here in our old age... what do you think? Will you escape from the Takri? Takri! Hey, it's your brother.

brh: نی کنا خلیس اسے نی است مرے وی بے وقوف نا دوا خلنگے نی ڈکری نا ہیتے ہلتویس۔ بشہ بوڑے تمنو۔
en: You're afraid of me? [unclear] The cure for a fool is a beating. You didn't heed Takri's words. [unclear] fell.
en_old: You are a fear for me... The only medicine for a fool is a beating. You didn't listen to the Takri's words... fell down.

brh: او ٹکری! ہلکو صبا کرے زنے، انت اسے بشمرون؟ بنگلو نانے، با ایڑے ڈھورام باری، نا باداڑے شیڑمس، پیندے سیتے ہلی سے ہلپسہ۔ او ٹکری!
en: O Takri! [unclear] What is it, [unclear]? [unclear] bungalow [unclear]... you won't take [unclear]. O Takri!
en_old: Hey Takri! Good morning... what is it, Bashmarun? ...over there... Hey Takri!

brh: نی خواجہ ایسس نائتھ نا نمارول پانے ننا جرات تینا نائتھ ہلپنے ارے بارکو بشلتے ارے نا دا جرات کنے ہلکوئی میتوریس ٹکریں ننگ دوپانے
en: You, Khwaja, [unclear]... our courage... [we won't take] [unclear]. Hey, [Barko], [unclear]. Hey, this nerve of yours... me [unclear]... Takri [unclear].
en_old: You, Khwaja... our courage... hey Barko... this courage of yours... Takri...

brh: نی خلیس سے لٹ ننا بے خلیس اسے نا دوا تھوننگ ئے جوان چاسے یلہ کبو کنے نت نا اڈے کسیفی بنومے ئنا بجان تو ننے یلہ کپنے نی ننے کسیفیسے ارے مارکوک یلہ کبو کنے اگر نما دوا پیش
en: You're scared... [the] stick... the cure for a fearless one like us is a [thrashing]; you know that well. Let me go! [unclear] [you'll] kill [me]... You won't let us go; you'll kill us! Hey boys, let me go! If your cure [unclear]...
en_old: You are a fear. The medicine for our fearlessness is a beating, good. Let me go... you won't let us go, you'll ruin us. Hey Markos, let me go, if your medicine...

brh: شان دے لٹڑ سلیب نہ کشی وا خبردار ٹکری الکاو میر علی بیگ نا ضرورت اف ٹکری ننا ایلومے نن شان ٹکری چائے ارا غا بسونس واپس ہما کسرٹ تینا ہنک بیوقوف ایرا وار انجینئر غان تنگ کریس اینے مٹ
